tcz: Pathen in Semtilin van le leiset asem tai.
en_web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
en_kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Semtil’ in Pathenin van le leiset ahinsemtai.

tcz: Leiset chu agong bei le ahomkeu ahin, muthim chun twipi thuhtah chu akhukhum ahin, Hiche twipi chung'a chu Pathen lhagao chu ana lhale ahi.
en_web: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
en_kjv: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin leiset chu alim le agong bei, twipi thuh tah a ki khang chule achungnga thim pi jingahin, twipi chu Pathen Lhagaovin a-opkhum’ e.

tcz: Pathen in; “Vah hung umhen,” atin, Vah chu aum tai.
en_web: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
en_kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “kho hungvah hen,” atile, ahungvahtai.

tcz: Pathen in vah chu aven pha asah e. Chule Pathen in vah chu muthim akon in asep khen tai.
en_web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
en_kjv: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin khovah chu avetle apha lheh jengin, muthim le khovah asep khentai.

tcz: Pathen'in vah chu sun asah in muthim chu jan asah tai. Hiche apat chun nilhah le jingkah ahung umdohtan hichu nikho masa pen ahung hitai.
en_web: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
en_kjv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin khovah chu “sun” asah-in, muthimchu “jan” asah-e. Jan akichaijin jingkah ahitan, nikhat alhingtai.

tcz: Hichun Pathenin aseiyin, “Twipi sukhen dingin, vanthamjol hung kidal hen lang Van, twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah sukhen hen,” atin.
en_web: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
en_kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, Twipi lah a chun vanthimjol hung kidal hen, Twipi chu alang langa dalten hen, atin;

tcz: Hiti chun asei bang in aum in, van twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah asukhen tai.”
en_web: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
en_kjv: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthimjol ajamdoh-in, twipichu chung le noiya adaltanin asepkhentai.

tcz: Pathen in onghom chu vanthamjol asah in, hichun nilhah le jingkah achedoh kitin ahileh nikho nina ahi tai.
en_web: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
en_kjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi daltenna chu Pathenin “vanthamjol” asah-e. Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni ni alhingtai.

tcz: Chule Pathen in aseiye, “Vantham jol'a twi umjouse chu mun khat'a kikhol khom hen lang chule tolgo lai um doh hen,” ati. Asei bang chun aum jeng tai.
en_web: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
en_kjv: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “vanthimjol noiya twipi mun khat’a veikhom hen, tolgo hung doh hen,” atileh, aseibangin aumtai.

tcz: Pathen in tolgo lai chu leiset asah in chule twi jouse kikhol na mun chu twikhanglen asah e. Pathen in aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
en_kjv: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
tcz_gospelgo: Tolgo lai chu Pathenin, “leiset” asah-in, twipi veikhom chengse chu “twikhanglen” asahtai. Aphatdan chu Pathenin amudohtai.

tcz: Chuin Pathen'in aseiye, “Leiset in hamphung ho, amu nei hamphung, agathei hamhing chi chom chom leh thingphung aga amunei ho, hiche ho chun ama ama chi dungjui cheh ahin sepdoh kit diu ahi,” ati. Hiti chun ahung kehdoh tauve.
en_web: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
en_kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “leiset’in hampa, amunei hamphung, agathei thing, achi ding amunei cheh, ama amachi dungjui cheh-in hinsepdohhen, leiset chunga kehdohhen,” atileh ahung kehdoh tauve.

tcz: Leiset'in hamphung thingphung ama ama chi dung juiyin ahung kehdoh in, agathei amu nei thingphung ama ama chi dungjui yin ahung kehdoh tauvin ahi. Pathen'in aven pha asah lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
en_kjv: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’in hampa ahinsep doh tan, hamphung ama ama chi dungjuiyin akehdoh-in, agathei amunei thingphung achi dungjuiyin ahung kehdoh tauve. Ahoidanchu Pathenin amudoh tai.

tcz: Nilhah khat le jingkah khat achekit in nithum alhing tai.
en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
en_kjv: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nithum alhingtai.

tcz: Chuin Pathen'in aseiye, “Sun le jan sepkhen dingin vanthomjol avah thei vahho hung kigol uhenlang, hiche ho chu kum kihei chin melchihnan jong, nikho simtoh nan jong chule kum simtoh nan jong pang'u hen.
en_web: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
en_kjv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “sun le jan sepkhendin vanthamjol’a avah thei vahho hung kigol’u hen, kum kiheichin kum simtoh nan jong panguhen;

tcz: Chujong le hiche ho chu vana vanthamjol akon in leiset salvah-in pang u-hen,’’ atin ahileh, hiti chun aum tai.
en_web: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
en_kjv: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a konin leiset hinsalvah-u hen,” atileh, aseibang in aumtauve.

tcz: Hiche achun Pathen in vah alen cheh ni asem in, vah alenjo chu sunlaiya thunei ding in apansah-in, chule vah aneojo chu janlaiya thunei ding in apansah tai; hiti chun ahsi ho jong ahin sem tai.
en_web: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
en_kjv: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vah len cheh ni asemin, nichang chu sun laiyin avahsah-e. Hiti hin ahsi ho jong asemdoh tai.

tcz: Pathen in vahho chu vanthamjol apat in leiset salvah din apansah tai.
en_web: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
en_kjv: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, vah cheng chu leiset salvah ding le

tcz: Sunlaiya thunei ding, janlaiya thunei ding, chule khovah le muthim sepkhen ding in apansah tan ahi. Pathen in aven ahileh pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
en_kjv: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun lai le jan laiya vah ding, muthim le khovah sepkhen din vanthamjol’a agoldohtai. Aphatje chu Pathenin amudoh tan ahi.

tcz: Hichu nikho li alhin ni ahi.
en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
en_kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nili alhingtai.

tcz: Pathen in aseiye, “Twija kon in nga ho leh ganhing ahingthei dangho umhen, chuleh vanthamjol ajong vachate ajat kimsoh in hung leng leu hen,’’ati.
en_web: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
en_kjv: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “twi lah a ahon hona kijot le ding ganhing hiungdimset hen, “atin;

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in twikhanglen'a ganhing ahing thei jouse ahona kijot le ding in asem in, hiche ho chun twi a kidil sah sah-uvin, ama ama jat cheh in alha uvin ahi, chujong le ajat jat in alhanei vachate jong asem in ahi. Hichu Pathen in aven pha asalheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
en_kjv: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin twi lah acheng din ganhing lentah tah ho le adang dang ganhing tamtah asemin, akijot le nauva Twi, akidil chet chut jin, chule alha lengthei vachate aloi loiyin asemdoh-e. Aphat dan Pathenin amudoh tai.

tcz: Pathen in abonchauvin phatthei aboh in, “Hinpha uvin lang chule pung uvin, twikhanglen'a twi lah dimset uvin, chule leiset chunga vachate jong pung u-hen,’’ ati.
en_web: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
en_kjv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Abonchauvin Pathenin phatthei aboh-in, “Hinphauvin, pungun, Twikhanglen le twi lah jouse dimset’uvin, chule vachate jong leiset’a pungu hen,” ati.

tcz: Chuin nilhah khat le jingkah khat achen ni nga lhinna ahi tai.
en_web: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
en_kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni-nga alhingtai.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in aseiye, “Leiset in ama akon in sa jat chom chom hin hingdoh hen! Ama ama jat dungyui cheh in, vah ngui thei gancha, tol'a kithol ganhing, leh gamsa ho jong hihen” ati. Hiti chun aum jeng tai.
en_web: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
en_kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “leiset’in ganhinglen le neo, ina vahthei le gamlah alha ding hinsep doh hen,” atileh, asei bangin aumtauve.

tcz: Chuin leiset chunga gamsa ho ama ama jat cheh in chule gancha ho jong ama ama jat cheh in a-opma kithol ajat jat in asem'e. Pathen in hiche ho chu aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
en_kjv: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin leiset’a ganhing le sa jouse chule tol’a kithol ganhing jouse aloiloiyin asemdoh-in, avet le apha lheh jenge.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Eihon mihem ho, eiho lim pu'in sem u-hitin. Amaho chun twikhanglen sunga nga ho jouse chunga thunei diu, vanlai jol'a leng le vacha ho chule vah ngui thei gancha ho, le gam sa ho, chule a opa a kithol chengse chung'a thunei vaihom in pang'u hen,” ati.
en_web: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
en_kjv: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Pathenin, “Eiho lim le mel pun mihem semu hitin, ama ho twi lah anga jouse le chunga vacha te, leiset’a ganhing namkim, ina kivah le gamlah alha ho, alen aneo jouse chunga thunei vaihomin panguhen,” atin;

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in ama lim mong mong in mihem chu asem in, Pathen lim tobang bang in ama lim chu asem tai, pasal le numei asem doh tan ahi.
en_web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
en_kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama lim le mel tobangin Pathenin mihem asemin, numei le pasal asemdohtai.

tcz: Pathen in amani chu phatthei aboh in amani jah'a aseiye, “Chipha lhon in chule pung jing lhon in simseng louvin leiset chung hinlo dimset un, chule nangni noiya vaihom na umhen, vanlai jol'a leng vachate chunga jong chule twikhanglen'a ahingthei jouse chunga hijong le aboncha ganhing namkim hihen chule leiset chunga lhale ganhing jouse hile achung uva thunei vaihom in pang lhon tan,’’ ati.
en_web: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
en_kjv: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ama ni chu phatthei aboh-in, “Chinphan pung lhonin, nason napah lhon leiset hung dimhen, twilah a nga, ju le vachate, leiset chunga ganhing namkim chunga hung vaihomu hen,” ati.

tcz: Pathen in hitin jong seiye, “Ve lhon in keiman leiset chunga muchi gathei phung jouse le thingphung gathei jouse aboncha hi nangni kihinso theina dinga kapeh lhon nahitai.
en_web: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
en_kjv: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “ven, leiset’a muchi chivo, thingphung gathei jouse naneh lhon din kapen,

tcz: Chule leiset chunga um gamsa jouse hihen chunga leng vachate ho hijongle tol'a aop'a kithol ganhing jouse hijongle ahaithei hinna nei jouse aneh ding uva hamhing jouse kapeh doh ahi tai,’’ atile, hitobang chun aum tai.
en_web: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
en_kjv: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a sa jouse le vachate, tol’a kithol ganhing ho le adang ho nehdin hamhing kapetai,” atin, hiti chun aumtai.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in asemsa chengse chu aboncha'n aven, “Apha lheh jeng in ahi,” hichea chun nilhah le jingkah khat ahung um doh in nigup lhinni ahung hitai.
en_web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
en_kjv: And God saw every thing that he had made, and behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pathenin athilsemsa chengse avet le ahoi behseh jengin pha asai. Hiti hin jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nigup alhing tai.

tcz: Hiti chun van le leiset chule asunga thil umjouse chu loupi tah a sem chai ahi tai.
en_web: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
en_kjv: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin thilsem pumpi akijousoh tai.

tcz: Hichun ni sagi lhin nin Pathen in athilsem chu aboncha achaiyin, hiti chun a thilsem ho jouse akon in ama akicholdo tai.
en_web: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
en_kjv: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni sagi lhinnin Pathenin Athilsem ajousoh-in anatoh acholdotan ahi.

tcz: Hiche ni sagi lhinni chu Pathen in phatthei aboh in chule atheng ahi tin aphongdoh tai, ajeh chu athilsem le anatoh jousea kon'a akicholdo ni ahi.
en_web: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
en_kjv: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilsem aboncha ajosoh a, ni sagi lhinnia acholdo jeh-in hiche nikhohi Pathenin Phatthei aboh-in asuthengtai.

tcz: Hiche hi van le leiset ahung kisemdoh a akhanggui hung kipatdoh dan ho chu hiti hi ana hi. Pakai Pathen in leiset le van ahinsem patni chun.
en_web: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
en_kjv: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi thilsempumpi hung kisemdoh ahi.

tcz: Leiset chunga tollhang a jong hamphung keh doh loulai ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in gotwi leiset chunga ajuhsah loulai ahin chule hia chu koima natong ding umlou lai ana hi.
en_web: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
en_kjv: and every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga hampa louhing akeh hih laiyin, muchijong adondoh hih laiye. Ajeh chu Pakai Pathenin go ajuh sah hih laiyin, loubol ding mihem jongaum hih laiye.

tcz: Ahin leiset'a kon in twimei a hung kaiyin chule leichung jouse chu twiyin achapnou vin ahi.
en_web: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
en_kjv: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’ konjoh chun meijun ajamdoh jin, chutengle leichung ahinle chapkotjie.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichunga kon in vutvai achun mihem asemin, chule a nahhom'a hinna hu alhakhum a ahile mihem chu hinna nei ahung hitai.
en_web: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
en_kjv: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin leiset alan mihem asemin, anahhom sunga hintheina hu ahailut peh le, mihem chu mihing asohdoh paiten ahi.

tcz: Chuphat in Pathen injong niso lama Eden hon aphut dohin hiche achun asem sa mihem chu akoi tai.
en_web: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
en_kjv: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Pakai Pathenin niso lam Eden mun’a chun hon khat asemin, hikomma hin amihem sempa chu akoitai.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichung a kon in vetnom nom umle neh ding thingga namkim akedoh sah in ahi, chule honlai lung'a chun hinna thingphung jong chule ase le apha hetna thing-phung jong akesah in ahi.
en_web: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
en_kjv: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Honsunga hin vetnomnom thingphung gapha tahtah Pakai Pathenin akesah-in, alailungtah a chun hintheina thingphung le se le pha hetna thingphung jong akeh-e.

tcz: Hiche Eden hon'a kon chun honlei chapnou jing ding in vadung along in, vadung chu vadung li in ahung long khen'in vadung li asohdoh e.
en_web: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
en_kjv: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
tcz_gospelgo: Edan honlei chap nou din hnleiya konin vadung khat ahung lhongin, honkal’a lhalka lin alongkhenin, vadung li asohdoh paitai.

tcz: Vadung khatna chu ahile Pishon ahin, hiche chu sana kimuna vadung ahin Havilah gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
en_web: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
en_kjv: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
tcz_gospelgo: Vadung masapen chu pishonahin, Havilah gamkol vel’in alongin,

tcz: Hiche gam'a sana kimu ho chu ahoi thei lheh in a namtwi jah nom umtah chule song namtwi jong akimui.
en_web: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
en_kjv: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche gama hin sana theng atamin, samphai chang le songval chang jong akimui.

tcz: Vadung ni lhinna chu amin Gihon ahin, hiche vadung chu Cush gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
en_web: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
en_kjv: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
tcz_gospelgo: Vadung nina chu Gihon ahin, Cush gamkol vel’a alongin ahi.

tcz: Vadung thum lhinna chu ahile Haddekel ahin, hiche vadung hin sah solam gam'a Asshur gam pumpia long ahin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.
en_web: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
en_kjv: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
tcz_gospelgo: Vadung thumna chu Tigris ahin, Assyria niso lama alongin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in amisem dohpa chu Eden hon sunga apuilut in hiche hon'a natong ding le avetup ding in apansah tai.
en_web: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
en_kjv: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu aleibol ding le angah din Edanhonsunga akoitai.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in mipa koma athupeh chu, “Nang man hiche honsunga theiga ho khu nadei dei naneh thei cheh ahi.
en_web: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
en_kjv: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin mihempa jah a, “honsunga thingga jouse naneh thei ahinan,

tcz: Hinlah nangman hon lailung'a ase le apha hetna theiga vang naneh lou beh ding, hichu naneh nini, na thitei tei ding,’’ ahi.
en_web: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
en_kjv: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
tcz_gospelgo: Se le pha hetna thingga vang khu naneh thei louhel dingahi; naneh ni ni le nathi tei tei ding ahi, ati. 18 Pakai Pathenin, “Mihempa achangseh a aum hi anompoi, aki- thopi ding aki- angtopi thei khatsempeh inge,” atin;

tcz: Chujong le Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Mihempa achanga a-umhi apha poi hijeh chun keiman a umkhom pi ding khat sempeh ing kate,’’ ati.
en_web: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
en_kjv: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leivui chu leingan a sosah in chu in leichunga ganhing namkim asem in chule vacha ho chung lam'a alensah in chuin hiche ho jouse hi amin ipi pi asah em tin mihempa kom'a ahinpui khom in hiche a mihem pan amin vo najouse chu tuni geia amin a pangden ahi tai.
en_web: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
en_kjv: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset alan Pakai Pathenin sa namkim le vacha jouse asemin, ipi asah ding vetnan mihempa henga abonchan ahin hoiluttai. Hichea hi mihempan aminsah pen pen chu aminu hijeng ahitai.

tcz: Hiti chun mihempa in ganhing namkim chu aminvo cheh in chunga lengthei vachate ahin, chule loujaova sahang jouse jong aminvo soh keiyin ahin mihempa kithopi ding akimu doh hih laiye.
en_web: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
en_kjv: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found a help meet for him.
tcz_gospelgo: HIti hin mihempan vacha jouse le sa namkim aminvo chehtan, ahinla khat cha beh jong ama kithopi thei le aki-angtopi thie aumtapoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu a imut-mil sah in a imut-mil kah chun Pathen in anahgu khat aladoh in anung chu aphe in atom jol peh in ahi.
en_web: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
en_kjv: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
tcz_gospelgo: HIjeh chun Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu a-imut milsah-in, a-ihmut lanin anahgu khat aheh lhan, anung chu aphen atonjol’in,

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam nahgu a lah doh'a kon chun numei khat asemdoh in amanu chu Adam kom'a ahin puilut in ahi.
en_web: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
en_kjv: and the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Anahgua kon chun numei khat asemdoh-in, mihempa henga ahinpuilut tai.

tcz: Hichun mihempan aseiye, “Amanu hi keima gu akon'a kisemdoh ahin, chule aphevou jang jong keima phevou ahin, amanu hi tu apat'a numei kiti ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi pasal'a kona kiladoh ahi,” ati.
en_web: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
en_kjv: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mihempan: “ Hiche hi kagu kachanga kon, Kaphe kavouva kiladoh ahijeh aPasal’a kona kiladoh ahijeh a ‘Numei’ kiti ding ahi.” ati.

tcz: Hijeh a chu pasal in anu le apa a dalhah a aji numei'a beh ding chule amani chu tipum khat kiti lhon ding ahiye.
en_web: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
en_kjv: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pasal’in anu le apa alhakanga aji akol chah joh a, chule ama ni phe khat vou khat hilhonahi.

tcz: Ahin hichepet chun pasalpa ahin numeinu ahin ani gel lhon a sagoh keuva um lhon ahin, ahi vang'in jachat na anei lhon pon ahi.
en_web: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
en_kjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet chun mihempa le ajinu asagohkeo ahilhonin, ahivangin akijapi lhonpoi.

tcz: Pathen thilsem jouse laha gul hi a lungthim thempen ahi. Nikhat chu aman numeinu adong in, “Pathen in honsunga theiga jouse naneh thei lhon lou beh ding ahi tia asei mong em?” ati.
en_web: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
en_kjv: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathen thilsem ganhinglah a doha thuh pen chu gul ahi. Gul hin numei nu jah a,” Honsunga theiga ho khu naneh lhon louhel dia Pathenin akha mongham?” atile;

tcz: Numei nu chun gul jaha keini'n “Eden hon sunga theiga jouse kaneh thei lhon ding ahi nai.”
en_web: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
en_kjv: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
tcz_gospelgo: Numei nun,” Theiga dang vang kinetheiye;

tcz: Ahin Pathen in hitin aseiye, “Hon lailung a theiga vangkhu naneh lhon lou hel ding, lo jong nalo lhon lou hel ding ahi. Ahin iti ham khat'a nalo lhon a naneh lhon le nathi jeng lhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
en_web: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
en_kjv: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
tcz_gospelgo: Honlai lunga vang khu neh jong kaneh thie lhon lou ding, katoh khah lhon jongle kathi tei tei lhondin Pathenin eiseipeh lhon nai, “ati.

tcz: Hinlah Satan in numeinu jah a aseiyin, “Nathi lhon loubeh ding ahi.
en_web: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
en_kjv: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun gul’in numienu jah a, Thi lhon hih hel’in nate.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in ahet ahi hichu naneh nini lhonle namit lhon hung hahdoh intin Pathen toh nabah lhon ding thilpha le thilse hetheiya naum lhon ding ahi ti Pathen in ahet jeh'a asei ahi bouve,” atitai.
en_web: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
en_kjv: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Naneh lhon teng namitlam lhon kikeodoh a Pathen masap’a thilpha thilse nahetdoh lhonding jeh a Pathenin akha ahibouve, “ati.

tcz: Hiche a chun numeinun theiga chu aven ahile neh dinga tui chule mitvet dinga jong vetnom nom um, chule mi achihsah jeng ding jeh chun ahaduchat cheh tai. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilo in anetan chule a pasalpa jong them khat apen amapan jong ala in ane tai.
en_web: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
en_kjv: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingphung chu numei nu mitvet’ in ahoi lheh jengin, akineh le mi achihsah ding jeh-in jong aducha cheh jenge. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilon anen, ajipa jong apen, aman jong anetai.

tcz: Hiche apat chun amit lhon chu ahung hahdoh in tahsa sagoh keo ahilhon chu aki hechen lhon tai. Hichun thing-phung na akilo lhon in atahsa lhon chu akisel na lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
en_kjv: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in amitlamlhon akikeodoh paiyin, asagohkeoahi ahedoh lhonin, theichang na akilmat mat lhonin kaipelengin akikai lhontai.

tcz: Chuin nisa dai lhah lamin honsunga Pakai Pathen awgin chu ajalhon in hijeh chun hon lailung'a thinglah a chun amani tah Pakai Pathen masanga akisel mang lhon tai.
en_web: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
en_kjv: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa dailhah lamin honlei laiya Pakai Pathen va le husa aja lhonin, mihempa le ajinu hongsung thing lah a akisel lhontai.

tcz: Ahivang in Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu akouvin, “Adam hoiya umna hi tam?” atile,
en_web: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
en_kjv: And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakai Pathenin, “Vo Adam, hoiya um nahim?” tin ahinkouve.

tcz: Adam in jong adonbut in “Keiman nangma honsung'a na hung chu ka hen ahile ka sagoh keo ka hijeh a ka kichat'a kisela kahi,” ati.
en_web: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
en_kjv: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihempan, “Honsunga nahusa kajah le, sagohkeo kahijeh a kichaa kisel kahi, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in jong aseiye, koi ham nangma sa gohkeova na um'e tia na seipeh a chu? Honsung'a theiga nehih in kati chu naneh hitam? atile,
en_web: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
en_kjv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin, “kon sagohkeo nahi atim? Neh lou dia kisei thingga chu naneh hitanteong?”ati.

tcz: Adam in adonbut in, “Keiman ka um khompi dinga nangman neipeh numeinu hin theiga chu themkhat eipen keiman kana netai,” ati.
en_web: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
en_kjv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihempan, “Eilenkhompi dia neipeh numei nu hin thingga chu eipeh a kaneh ahitai,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Chuphat in Pakai Pathen in numeinu jah'a aseiye, “Nang in ipi dinga hitobang pihi nabol hitam!” atile numei nun adonbut'in, “Hiche gul hin eijol jol phat'a kaneh ahi bouve,” ati.
en_web: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
en_kjv: And the Lord God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ibol’a hitabangpi chu nabol ham?” tia Pakai Pathenin numei nu adoh le, amanun, ‘Gul chun eidohabol’a kaneh hichu me, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in gul jah'a, “Nangman hiche nana boldoh jeh in, ganhing jouse lah a nanghi sapset nachan ding na hinkho lhung keiya na oipoh'a na kithol tho ding, chule na hinkho sunga leivui naneh ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
en_kjv: And the Lord God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Pakai Pathenin gul jah a, “Nathilbol jeh a hi gaosap nachan a, ganhing jouse lah atalen namat ding, nahinkho lhumkeiya na-op’a kithol’a leivei naneh ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangle numeinu chilhah kah a kidouna kakoi ding, amapa chun nangma hi na luchang avohchip a; nangman amapa kengphang na chuh peh ding ahi,”ati.
en_web: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
en_kjv: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei nu to kakidousah a, ama chilhah le nang chilhah kigal to ding ahi. Ama chilhah pan nalu avoh chip’a, nangin akhotaljum nachuhpeh ding ahi.”ati.

tcz: Pathen in numeinu jah'a chun hitin a seiye, “Keiman na naovop hahsatna kabe peh ding, nao-sonat gentheiya cha nahin doh ding ahi. Najipa chung'a vai nahom nom jing ding, ahi vang'a najipan nang chunga vai ahop ding ahi,”ati.
en_web: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
en_kjv: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin numei nu jah a, “Na-naovop teng gim gentheiyanaum a, nat hahsa thot acha nahinding ahi. Hijongle najipa jeng lhangaiya nahin’a aman nachunga vai ahom ding ahi, “ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam jah'a hitin ati, “Nangman naji thu nangaiya naneh louhel ding ahi tia ka thupehsa theiga naneh tah jeh in nangma jeh a leiset hi sapset chang ahitai. Chule na hinkho damlai sungse a gimna le genthei thohpum pum'a neh na kihol a naneh ding ahi.
en_web: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
en_kjv: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
tcz_gospelgo: Mihempa jah aPakai Pathenin, “Naji nu thua nanun aneh lou dia kaseipeh thiega na neh jeh a leiset jeng jong hi gaosap chang ahitai. Nahinkho lhumkeiya tohgim genthei puma tol natuh a neh ding nakihol ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nang doudin ling le mi-at thei jong hung kehdoh intin, chule nangma anche louhing a naki vahding ahi.
en_web: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
en_kjv: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
tcz_gospelgo: Nakidoupi din leiset’a theimi ling le meithai seltho ling hung keh-in tin, chule tollhanga anche louhing naneh ding ahi.

tcz: Na ti-ul na mai ja long pum'a anneh na kihol'a na neh ding, chule nangma leiset a kisemdoh nahin leiset na leso kit ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
en_kjv: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakisemdohna leiset”a nakile kit kah a, namaiya ulsa long longa na natohgim a’neh le chah nakihol ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemdoh nahin, Leivui nalesokit ding ahi, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Adam in ajinu chu amin Eve asah tai. Ajeh chu amanu mijouse hung pen dohna minu ahi tan ahi.
en_web: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
en_kjv: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem nankim penna nu ahiphat’in Adamin ajinu chu amin Eve asah-e.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in savun akon in Adam le Eve ding von akhui peh in amani chu asilpeh in ahi.
en_web: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
en_kjv: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin mihempa le ajinu din savun ponsil asemin asilpehtai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Tuapat'a hi Adam hi eiho lah'a khat tobang ahung hi tan, thilpha le thilse hethei jin a um tai, chule tunjong aman hinna thingphung ga khu kilo intin hin ne lhon leh tonsot'a hing den ding ahi tai ati.”
en_web: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
en_kjv: And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin, “Mihemhi ilah-uva khat bangin thilpha thilse hethieyin aumtan, hichea hi hinna thiega khu neh khahsah atonsot’a hinsah louhel ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche'a pat chun Pakai Pathen in Adam chu Eden hon a kon'in achondoh in amopohna chu alah peh tai.
en_web: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
en_kjv: therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun akisemdohna leiset loubol’a kivah din mihempa chu Pakai Pathenin Edan honna konin asoldoh tai.

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in Adam anodoh jouvin, Eden hon nisolam'a hinna thingphung ngah ding in vantil Cherubim chu achen sah in, chule chemjam kou jeju chu akipei kimvel le sahtan ahi.
en_web: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
en_kjv: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna thingphung lampi ngah din hon niso lama Vantil lhanei chu akoiyin, chemjam deuje ju chu akipei kimvelsah tai.

tcz: Chujouvin Adam le Eve akitimat lhon in ahile Eve'in nao ahin vopin Cain chu ahung peng tai, hiche'a chun amanu'n hitin aseiye, Pathen phatthei bohna jal in cha pasal khat kanei tai ati.
en_web: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”
en_kjv: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Adamin ajinu Eve akitimetpin, amanu agaiyin chapa khat ahinge; “Pakai panpi jal’a achapa kahin,” tin amin Cain asah-e.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun Eve chun chapa Abel ahing kit tai, hichun khonung in chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhon tan, Abel chu kelngoi ching in ahung pang in, Cain vang chu loubol mi ahung hi tan ahi.
en_web: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
en_kjv: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin asopipa Abel ahing kit’in ahi. Abel chu kelngoi chingin apangin, Cain chu loubol’in apange.

tcz: Phat phabep jouvin Cain in alousohga alhun phat in alousohga phabep ahin pon Pathen ading in kilhaina ahung sem tai.
en_web: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
en_kjv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Khongnungin Cain chun alhosoh gan Pakaiya kilhaina abol’in,

tcz: Hitobang ma chun Abel in jong akelngoi lah'a apeng masa athao pen tah khat chu Pathen ading in ahin pedoh tai, Hichun Pathen in Abel lam joh aven athilto jong kipahtah in asanpeh tai.
en_web: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,
en_kjv: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
tcz_gospelgo: Abel’ in jong akelngoi peng masapen, athaopen khat athat’in, kilhai nananeiye. Hichea hin Abel kilhaina chunga Pakai alung lhaiyin, athilbol asanpeh tai.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Cain thilto maicham chu asanpeh tapoi, hijeh chun Cain chu hatah in alunghang in akaiku jeng in ahi.
en_web: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
en_kjv: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
tcz_gospelgo: Cain thilto vangchu asangpon, ama jong akhohsahtapoi. Cain alunghang behseh-in akaiku jenge.

tcz: Hihe phat chun Pathen in Cain jah a, “Ibola nangle nang kilunghan nahi ham? chule ibola namai thim jeng a ham?
en_web: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Cain jaha, “Ibol’a lunghanga kaiku jeng nahim?

tcz: Thilpha bol dinga kilomho chu nabol le na kisan pehda ding ham? Ahin thilpha boldinga kilomho chu na bolnom loule kichih theiyin chonsetnan naval lhum ding ahitai. Hiche hohi na chinpha ding joh ahi,” ati.
en_web: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
en_kjv: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih bol le chun kipah ding nahin, thilse nabol jeh-in chonsetnan kotphunga nachang lhi jinge; jotho dia nagot vangin, nangin najotei ding ahinai,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat chu Cain in asopipa Abel jah'a “Eini thinglhang lam'a che hite atin, gamlang agei lhon phat in Cain chu asopipa Abel chunga achun athat tai.”
en_web: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
en_kjv: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
tcz_gospelgo: Cain chun asopipa Abel jah a, “Gamlah a che hite, “atin; gamlah agei lhon phat’in Cain asopipa chunga achun athattai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Pakai Pathen in Cain jah a, “Nasopipa Abel hoiya um hitam?” atile Cain'in jong adonbut in, “Kahe poi, Keima hi ka sopi pa Abel ching tup ka him?” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh hin, “Nasopipa Abel la em?” tin Pakaiyin Cain ahindongtai. Aman, “Kei kasopipa ching gun set ka hi ong?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in jong Cain jah'a “Ipi nabol hitam? Na sopi pa Abel thisan chu tol'a kon'in keima angsung gei in ahung peng in ahi.
en_web: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
en_kjv: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Ibol’a nahim? Tol’ a kona naopipa thisanin eihinsap sap khu me’.

tcz: Hijeh chun tua patna nangma hi leiset chunga sapset na noija uma na hitai, na sopi pa Abel thisan in na chup ahitai.
en_web: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
en_kjv: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche leiset hi pohkhia nasopipa thisan achop lut tah jeh hin, nang jong gaosap chang nahitan, leiset jeng jong hi lou va na bol thei lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Leiset a kona nangma dinga ga imacha pung ding ahi tapoi, itobang in natong jong leh chun nangman leiseta in mun neilou gamvah mangpa na kiti ding ahi.”
en_web: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
en_kjv: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi tujongle chun hung kehdoh louhelding, chen mun det beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding nahitai” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Cain chun Pathen henga aseiye, “Keima gotna kachan hi kei thoh jou hoi ahi poi.
en_web: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
en_kjv: And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Cain chun Pakai jah a, “Neipeh talen hi alen behseh tan kapoh jouhoi ahitapoi.

tcz: Vetan tunin nangma akon in neidel mangtai, nang in leichunga umna neilou neihi sahtai, tua pat'a hi koihijongle eitoh khapen pen chun eitha ding ahi tai.”
en_web: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
en_kjv: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
tcz_gospelgo: Na- angsunga kona neisoldoh a, chenmun det beiya leiset’a kavah thai le ding, eitoh khapen penin eitha ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Pathen in adonbut in, “Ahipoi koi tobang nangma hinkho sumang dinga kigo a aumle keiman ama chunga sagi vei ka phulah ding ahi.” Hichea chun Pathen in Cain chu koiman atha louna ding in Cain chunga melchihna khat akoipeh in ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Chutiponte, Cain hinthat pen pen chunga sagi vei phuki la ding ahi,” atin; atoh kha khan atha louhel na din Cain chalpanga melchihna khat akoi-peh e.

tcz: Hichea kon chun Cain in Pathen kom adalhan Eden niso lam a Nod muna chun acheng tai.
en_web: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
en_kjv: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai angsunga konin Cain apotdoh-in, Eden solam gamkai, “Vahthai gam” sunga achengtai.

tcz: Cain chun ajinu aki timatpin ahile nao ahin vop kit tan hiche nao chu Enoch ahi. Chuin Cain in phat phabep jouvin khopi khat ahinsem dohin, achapa min aput sah in hiche khopi min chu Enoch asah tai.
en_web: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
en_kjv: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
tcz_gospelgo: Cain ajinu akitimatpi le agaiyin, chapa khat ahingin, Enoch asah-e. Cain chun khopi khat asemdoh-in achapamin aputsah -in, Enoch asah-in ahi.

tcz: Enoch in chapa Irad ahing in, Irad chun Mehujael ahing in, Mehujael chun Methushael ahing in, Methushael chun Lamech ahing'e.
en_web: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
en_kjv: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
tcz_gospelgo: Enoch chun Irad ahingin, Irad-in Mahuja-el ahingin, Mahuja-el chun Methusha-el ahingin, Methusha-el ‘in Lemech ahinge.

tcz: Lamech chun ji numei ni anei jin amasa nu chu ahile Adah ahin chule anina nu chu Zillah ahiye.
en_web: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
en_kjv: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
tcz_gospelgo: Lemech chun ji ni akop, in Khatnu Adah ahin, khatjonu Zillah ahi.

tcz: Adah in Jabal ahing in, amahi ahiye, khoilupon in a chenga gancha chingho ding'a apau chu.
en_web: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
en_kjv: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
tcz_gospelgo: Adah hin Jabal ahingin, Jabal hi ponbuh achengte le gancha ching miho penna pa ahunghi.

tcz: Chule asopi pa min chu Jubal ahin, ama chu lathem gosem mut them masa pen ahiye.
en_web: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
en_kjv: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
tcz_gospelgo: Jabal sopipa chu Jubal ahin, semjang saite le theile mutte chengse penna pa ahung hikhai.

tcz: Zillah jong chun Tubal-cain ahing in, ama chun manchah ding abonchan sum-eng jong thih jong ahin kheng'e. Chule Tubal-cain chun sopi numei khat anei jin amin Naamah ahi.
en_web: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
en_kjv: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
tcz_gospelgo: Zillah hin Tubal Cain ahingin, amahin sum-eng manchah ding alhan, thih khengin apange; Tubal Cain sopinu chu Naamah ahi.

tcz: Chujou vin nikhat chu Lamech chun ajite ni jaha hitin a seiye , “Vo Adah le Zillah ka aw kasei ngai lhon in, ‘Ajeh chu pasal khat in eimavo jeh in ka that'in golhang khat'in eiden jeh-in ka that tai.
en_web: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
en_kjv: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: For I have slain a man to my wounding, And a young man to my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Lamech chun ajite nijah a, “Adah le Zillah kasei ngai lhonin, Vo Lamech jie ni kisei hi melchih lhontan; Gollhang khat’in eiden jeh-in kathat tai.

tcz: Koi tabang mikhat in Cain chu atha le sagi vei gotna chang ding ahile keima hinkho lading koi tobang aumle som sagi vei gotna chang ding joh ahiye.”
en_web: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
en_kjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
tcz_gospelgo: Cain tha jeh a sagi vei phu aki lah ding le Lamech tha jeh a som sagi le sagi vei phukila ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Adam chun ajinu akitimat pikit in ahile amanun chapa khat ahing kit in, amin Seth asah tai; ijeh inem itile amanun hitin aseiye, “Pathen in chapa eipeh kit hi Abel khel a ei kipe ah ahi, ajeh chu Cain thapa khel ding in eipe tai,” ati.
en_web: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
en_kjv: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
tcz_gospelgo: Adamin ajinu akitimatpi kit le cha pa khat ahing kit’in, “Cain thapa Abel khel’a chi khai din Pathenin chapa khat eipekit tai,” tin anun amin Seth asah -e.

tcz: Seth chu mipi lhing ahung hiphat in chapa khat aneiyin amin Enosh asah-e. Hiche apat chun mipi hon Pathen chu amin pan in ahou pan tauvin ahi.
en_web: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos; then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Seth-in chapa khat ahingin Enoch asah-e. Ama khanglaiya pat hin min ‘Pakai’ minin chibai ahinboh pantai.

tcz: Hiche hohi Adam te insung khanggui umdan kijihna lekhabu ahi. Pathen in mihem asem chu ama lim tobang din asem in ahi.
en_web: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
en_kjv: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Ama lim ma bang banga asem mihem- Adam khanggui thusim chu hiti ahi.

tcz: Pathenin numei le pasal ana semdoh in aman amisem doh teni chu phatthei aboh in chuin amani chu mihem asah tai.
en_web: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
en_kjv: male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei le pasal asemin, phatthei aboh-in, amin jong ‘Mihem’ asah tai.

tcz: Adam chu kum jakhat le kum somthum alhinin ama limle ama mel to kilou cha khat ahing in hichepa chu amin Seth asah tai.
en_web: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
en_kjv: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
tcz_gospelgo: Adam kum ja khat le somthum alhinin ama lim le melto kilo tah chapa khat ahingin, Seth asah-e.

tcz: Seth apen jou chun Adam chu kum jaget tabang ahin be kit in, chu achun Adam in cha numei le pasal anei be na laiye.
en_web: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Seth pen nungin Adam kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Adam chu kum jako le kum somthum ahing nomsel in hiche jou chun ama athi tai.
en_web: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le somthum lhin kumin athitai.

tcz: Seth chu kum jakhat le kum nga ahi chun ama chu Enosh pa ahung hi tai.
en_web: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
en_kjv: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
tcz_gospelgo: Seth kum jakhat le nga ahin Enosh ahingin,

tcz: Enosh pen jou chun Seth chu kum jaget le kum sagi ahin be nalai in chu achun aman cha numei le pasal adang ahin be nalaiye.
en_web: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Enosh pen nungin Seth kum jaget le sagi ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Hichun Seth chu kum jako le kumsom le kumni ahing in hiche jou chun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en_web: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le som le ni alhin kumin athitai

tcz: Enosh chu kum somko ahi chun ama chu Kenan pa ahung hi tai.
en_web: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
en_kjv: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
tcz_gospelgo: Enosh kum somko ahin kenan ahingin,

tcz: Kenan pen jou chun, Enosh chu kum jaget le kum som le kum nga ahing na laiyin chujou chun cha numei le cha pasal ahing na laiye.
en_web: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: kenan pen nungin Enosh kum jaget le som le nga ahinben chanu chapa tam pi ahingin,

tcz: Enosh chu kum jako le kum nga ahing in ama athi tai.
en_web: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le nga lhin kumin athi.

tcz: Kenan chu kum som sagi alhing in ama chu Mahalalel pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
en_kjv: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
tcz_gospelgo: Kenan kum som sagi ahin Mahalalel ahingin,

tcz: Mahalalel pen jou chun, Kenan chu kum jaget le kum somli ahing na laiyin, chule aman chapa dang le chanu dang jong anei be nalaiye.
en_web: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
en_kjv: and Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Mahalalel pen nungin Kenan kum jaget le som li ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Kenan chu kum jako le kum som gei ahing in chuin ama hinkho abeitai.
en_web: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kumjako le som khat lhin kumin athi.

tcz: Hichun Mahalalel chu kum somgup le kum nga alhing in ama chu Jared pa ahung hi tai.
en_web: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
en_kjv: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
tcz_gospelgo: Mahalalel kum somgup le nga ahin Jared ahingin,

tcz: Jared pen jou chun, Mahalalel chu kum jaget le kum som thum jen ahing nalaiyin chule cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
en_web: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Jared pen nungin kum jaget kum jaget le somthum ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Hichun Mahalalel kum jaget le kum somko le kum nga gei ahing in hichun ama leiset hinkho abeitai.
en_web: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jaget le somko le nga lhin kumin athi.

tcz: Jared chu kum jakhat le kum somgup le kum ni alhin in ama chu Enoch pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
en_kjv: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
tcz_gospelgo: Jared kum jakhat le somgup le ni ahin Enoch ahingin,

tcz: Enoch pen jou chun, Jared chu kum jaget gei ahingin, chuban in chapa le chanu dang jong ahing na laiye.
en_web: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Enoch pen nungin Jared kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Jared chu kum jako le kum som gup le kumni ahing in, hichun ama aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en_web: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le somgup le ni lhin kumin athitai.

tcz: Enoch chu kum som gup le kum nga alhin in ama chu Methuselah pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
en_kjv: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
tcz_gospelgo: Enoch kum som gup le nga ahin Methuselah ahingin,

tcz: Methuselah pen jou kum jathum sungin Enoch chu Pathen toh kinai tah in aum jing jeng in chule chapa dangle chanu dang tampi jong ahinbe nalaiye.
en_web: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Methuselah pen nungin kum jathum jen Pathen to akivop jingin, chanu chapa tampi ahinben,

tcz: Hiti chun Enoch chu kum jathum le kum somgup le kum nga ahing in ahi.
en_web: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
en_kjv: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jathum le somgup le nga lhingin ahinge.

tcz: Pathen toh kingaitah a umjing ahin nikhat chu ama akimu tapon Pathen in akou doh ahi tai.
en_web: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
en_kjv: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
tcz_gospelgo: Enoch ahinkho lhumkeiyin Pathento akivop jingin, Pathenin ahing laiya alah phat’iin akiholmotai.

tcz: Methuselah chu kum jakhat le kum somget le kum sagi alhin in, ama chu Lamech pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
en_kjv: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
tcz_gospelgo: Methuselah kum jakhat le somget le sagi ahin Lamech ahingin,

tcz: Lamech pen jou chun, Methuselah chu kum jasagi le kum somget le kumni ahing in, hichun aman chapa le chanu dang tamtah anei be nalaiyin ahi.
en_web: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Lamech pennungin Methuselah kum ja sagi le somget le ni ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,

tcz: Methuselah chu kum jako le kumsom gup le kum ko ahing in hichun ama ahinkho abeitai.
en_web: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le somgup leko lhin kumin athi.

tcz: Hichun Lamech chu kum jakhat le kum som get le kumni alhinin chapa khat ahing in,
en_web: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
en_kjv: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
tcz_gospelgo: Leamech kum jakhat le somget le ni ahin chapa khat ahingin,

tcz: Ama min chu Noah asah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in agaosapsa gim genthei thoh'a ikhut uva i-tohgim nau hiche leiset'a kona ama hin eitha-ol sah ding'u ahi,”ati.
en_web: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
en_kjv: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathen gaosapsa, ikhut’ uva itoh gim nau hiche leiset’a kona hi hiche naosen hin eitha-ol sah diu ahi,” tinan amin Noah asah-e.

tcz: Noah pen jou chun, Lamech chu kum ja nga le kum somko le kum nga ahing in hijou chun cha pasal le numei tamtah ahing na laiyin ahi.
en_web: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
en_kjv: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
tcz_gospelgo: Noah pen nungin Lamech kum janga le somko le nga ahinben, cha tampi ahingin,

tcz: Lamech chu kum jasagi le kum som sagi le kum sagi ahing in, hichun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en_web: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
en_kjv: and all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum ja sagi le som sagi le sagi lhin kumin athitai.

tcz: Noah chu kum ja nga alhin'in, ama chu Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahing in ahi.
en_web: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
en_kjv: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah kum janga ahin chapa thum ahingin; Sem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuve.

tcz: Hiche achun leiset chunga mihem ahung pung pan tan ahile alah uva chanu jong tampi ahing tauve.
en_web: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga mihem hapunin apungin, cha le nao tampi ahing tauve.

tcz: Chuin Pathen chapate chun numei hoitah ho chu amu uvin ama hon adei thei lheh jeng uvin, hijeh chun adei dei akilhen uvin ajinu ding in akipui tauvin ahi.
en_web: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
en_kjv: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
tcz_gospelgo: Van miten mihem chanu hoitah tah ho amudoh phat’un adei dei ji din akipuiyui.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Ka lhagao mihem sunga atonsot kumkho in chengden thei deh ponte, ajeh chu ama tahsaphe bou ahin, ahin nikho jong kum jakhat le kum somni bou hiding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakaiyin, “Kalhagao mihem sunga tonsot’ in chengden deh ponte; mihem hi tahsaphe bou ahin, ahinkho jong kum jakhat le som ni bou hiding ahi, “ati.

tcz: Hiche lai chun leiset chunga Nephilim miho ana um uvin, chujong le Pathen chapate mihem Chanute henga ahunglut nung'u chun amahon jong cha ahin peh tauve; hiche ho chu khanglui laiya mihat te ana hiuvin, chule mi minthang ho chu ana hiuvin ahi.
en_web: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
en_kjv: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem chanu ho le van mite chihlhah ho hi chulai le khonung geiya leiset’a mihatte chu ahiuvin, khanglui laiya mihat minthang ho chu amaho ahiuve.

tcz: Pathen in leiset chunga mihem ho setna chu akhol chen jing in, chule Pathen in mihem ho thil phalou agel'u ahi loule lungthima ase abolnom ho'u chu aboncha aphalou jeng ahi chu amu doh tai.
en_web: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
en_kjv: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a cheng mitin gitlu le niseh a thilse jeng agel’u Pakaiyin amudoh tan,

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathenin mihem asem'a leiset chung'a aumsah hatah in akisih tai.
en_web: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
en_kjv: And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem asem’a leiset’a achensah akisih-in, alung na behseh tai; hijeh chun kasemsa jouse, mihem geiyin leiset’a konin sugam tange, : tin Pakaiyin aseitai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman kasem doh mihem hohi leiset chunga kon'a kasuh mang ding ahitai, mihem jouse alen aneo, gancha alen aneo tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse chule chunglam a leng vachate ahi uvin, ajeh chu hicheng pi kana semdoh hi ka kisih lheh tai,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah chunga vang Pakai alung lhainai.

tcz: Hinlah Noah chun Pathen lungdei lam in aum jing in ahi.
en_web: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
en_kjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche hi Noah le a insung mite umchan thusim ahiye, Noah chu mi chonpha, hiche khanglai'a chu leichung'a mona neilou va um chu Noah bou anahi, chule Noah chu Pathen toh ki lhakang louhel le Pathen toh kihou mat jing mi ahi.
en_web: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
en_kjv: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah hinkho chu hiti ahi: midih, akhang sunga nolnabei, Pathen to kivop jing mihem ahi.

tcz: Noah chun chate thum aneiyin amaho chu ahi le Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uve.
en_web: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
en_kjv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah chun chapa thum ahingin, Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahiuve.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in leiset chung ahinven ahile mihem ho phatlou na le kitahlou jeng amudoh tan ahi.
en_web: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
en_kjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen mitmun leiset mihem abonchan aphamon, asegamtan, muntin’a pumhat jengin akinotauve.

tcz: Pathen in jong thilpha lou jouse le thudih louva vannoi pumpia mihemte khat cheh a jong asetnao chu amudoh sohhel tai.
en_web: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
en_kjv: And God looked upon the earth, and behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a cheng mihemte lam hilouva akihei gamtauvin, Pathenin avet le leiset asetsoh hel chu amudohtai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah jah'a aseiyin, “Keiman tua hi hinna neiya avahle thei jouse ka suhmang ding ahi tai. Ajeh chu amaho jeh hin leiset chunga pumhat'a kino na jeng adim tan ahi, vetan kei man abonchauva leiset toh ka suhmang tha ding ahi tauve.
en_web: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
en_kjv: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Noah jah a, “Leiset pumpi hi mihemte thilse bol dimsoh ahitan, hijeh a chu abonchauva kasuhgam’a, chitin namtin leiset puma kasuhgam ding ahitai.

tcz: Nangman Gopher thingin kong innei lentah khat kisem in lang, kong innei sunga chun indan adan adan in khah tanin, chuteng asung le apo twilut na thei lai jouse na huhbing sohkei ding ahi.
en_web: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
en_kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
tcz_gospelgo: Gopher thingin kong innei khat kisuiyin, kong sunga chu adan danin khah tanin, asung le apo begon loijol’in.

tcz: Hiche kong chu tong jali le somnga sao hiding, chule asan dan chu tong somsagi le nga a sang hiding, chule avai lam chu tong somli le nga a len hiding ahi.
en_web: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
en_kjv: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: the length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
tcz_gospelgo: Kong innei chu adung tong jathu, avai tong som nga chule atun tong somthuma nasem ding.

tcz: Kong innei chu bangkot hong inlang achunglam chu khap somle get in sem inlang kong abanga kotpi hong in lang, indan noi nung danni lhinna, chule dan thum lhinna geiya nasem ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
en_kjv: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
tcz_gospelgo: kong innei chu inchung nakhua, alhung khu tongkhat bou len ding, kong kotpi asih lama nahon a, lhong danthuma nadoa, achungnungpen, aban’a chule anoinungpen nado ding;

tcz: Tun ven kei man leichung jouse hi twisanglen a ka chupsah ding, hichu ganhing ahai thei jouse ahinkho kalah mang ding ahitai. Chule leichung'a umjouse ka suhmang ding ahi.
en_web: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.
en_kjv: And behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
tcz_gospelgo: leiset chunga haitheiya hing jose sumang dia keiman twiksang kaletsah ding, leiset’a ganhing namkim thisoh hel ding ahi.
