tcz: Hinlah keiman nangma toh kitep na khat nei ing kating, chujou teng le kongsunga nang nahin, na chapate ahi uvin, najinu chule namou tetoh nabon chauva kong sunga lut tauvin,
en_web: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
en_kjv: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangto vang kitepna khat kaphudoh a, naji le nachapte chule namoute chengtoh kong innei sunga nalut diu ahi.

tcz: Chule tahsa neiya hing gamsa namkim anu khat le apa khat cheh in kongsunga hin puilut un, ajeh chu twisang hatah ahung let teng na hinso jou thei nadiu ahi.
en_web: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
en_kjv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule achikhai dinga ganhing namkim- anu khat le achal khat-kop khat cheh kong sunga napui lut ding ahi.

tcz: Vacha ho akop toni, gancha ho lah a jong ama ama jat dung juiya, tol'a aop'a kithol tho lah a jong ama ama jat dung jui cheh a anu khat le achal khat cheh navah hing dinga nahenga hung kitol lut ding ahi uve.
en_web: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.
en_kjv: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Vacha hihen ganhing dang hileh, tol’a kithol ho geiya ama ama jat dungjuiya chikhai dia nakoma hung kitol lut diu ahi.

tcz: Chule nasuhmil theilou ding chu kong sunga naneh dingu an naneh diu ninglhingset a naki pohlut diu nakikhol khom diu ahi, Ajeh chu hiche an neh dingho chu nangho le gancha hon ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”
en_kjv: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh thei jouse nalo khoma, nang ho le ganhing namkim neh dia nakhol khom ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Noah in jong Pathen in asei peh bang bang in abolpan tan ahi.
en_web: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
en_kjv: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aseipeh bang bangin Noah-in aboltai.

tcz: Chuin ima jouse ahina ding bang ahijou phat in Pathen in Noah chu ahoulim pitai. “Nangma le na insung mite kongsunga lut tauvin ajeh chu leiset chunga mihem holah'a mi chonpha thudih achon nang bou nahi”ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Noah jah a, “Hiche khanga midih nang bou kamui, na-insung mite toh kong sunga luttan.

tcz: Nangman gancha theng lah a konin kop sagi, kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh, chule gancha thenglou lah a kon a jong kop sagi ma kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh ki kailut inlang,
en_web: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
en_kjv: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
tcz_gospelgo: Satheng jat khat’a konin kop sagi-anu khat le achal khat cheh to, saboh jat khat’a konin vang kop khat bou-anu khat achal khat cheh lan,

tcz: Chule chunga leng vachate lah a jong kop sagi cheh na puilut ding amaho lah a chu achal khat le anu khat akopto cheh ana puilut ding hichengse chu twisang let a kona nahinso thei na dinga navah a chikhai dinga nahing hoi ding ahi.
en_web: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
en_kjv: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vacha jat a konin kop sagi cheh leiset’a achikhai din kong sunga kai lut’in.

tcz: Ni sagi jouva pat go hatah a leiset chunga ka juhsah pan ding ahitai, chule go chu ni somli le jan somli sunga ka juhsah ding leiset chunga umjouse le ahing thei jouse ka suh mang hel ding ahi tai,”ati.
en_web: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
en_kjv: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni sagi lhinteng nisom le jan som li sunga go kajuh sah-a, kasemsa ahing thei jouse kasuh mang hel ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Noah injong Pathen in athupeh bang bang chun abonchan abolsoh kei tan ahi.
en_web: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.
en_kjv: And Noah did according unto all that the Lord commanded him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseipeh chan abang bangin Noah-in aboltai.

tcz: Leiset chunga twisang ahunglet chun Noah chu kum jagup ana lhingtan ahi.
en_web: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
en_kjv: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga twisanglet chun Noah kum jagup alhingtai.

tcz: Hichun Noah chu achapate toh, ajinu toh, chule amoute toh twisanglen na kon'a ahoidoh theina diuvin kong sunga alut tai.
en_web: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
en_kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisanglet’a hoidoh na din Noah le ajinu, achapte le ajiteu kong sunga alut tauve.

tcz: Satheng ho lah a ahin, sa thenglou ho lah a konin jong tol'a kithol thoho lah akonin jong,
en_web: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
en_kjv: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thupeh bangin satheng le sangboh kop khat che-anu khat le achal khat cheh toh, vachate le tol’a kithol ho geiyin,

tcz: Akop kop a anu khat le achal khat cheh, Pathen in Noah ahoulim pi nabang chun kong sunga chun Noah koma avahlut cheh tauvin ahi.
en_web: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
en_kjv: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
tcz_gospelgo: ni nin Noah to kong sunga akijot lut tauve.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi lhin jou chun twisanglen go ahung ju pantan, leiset chung chu gotwi in achup tai.
en_web: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
en_kjv: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni sagi jouvin leiset’a twisang alentai.

tcz: Noah chu kum jagup alhin kum lhani lhin na ah, leinoi ja twi umjouse ahung put tan, chule vanthamjol apat in hatah in go alon tho tai.
en_web: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.
en_kjv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah kum jagup lhin kum, lha ni na, nisom le sagi lhin nin twinah jouse ajal tan, van a gokot jouse jong akihong tai.

tcz: Ni somli le jan somli sung in go chu tang lou hel'in hatah in ajujom jing tan ahi.
en_web: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
en_kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in ni som li jan som li sung in go aju ju jenge.

tcz: Hiche nitah chun Noah ahin, Noah chapate Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uvin, Noah jinu ahin, amoute thum ahi uvin abonchauvin kong sunga alut tauve.
en_web: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
en_kjv: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho le lea chu Naoh le ajinu, achapate-Shem, Ham chule Japheth le ajiteu kong sunga lut ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho ahi uvin, kong sunga um gamsa hang ahin insa gancha alen aneo chule tol'a aop'a kitholtho ho jong ama ama jat dungjui cheh in, vachate jong ama ama chilhah dungjui a vacha namkim a kon ahiuve.
en_web: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
en_kjv: they, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing namkim, insa le gamsa, alen aneo, vacha namkim,

tcz: Akop akop in amaho chu kongsung ahin jon cheh un, hichun avetsah chu ahile hinna neiya tahsa hing ahiuve ti photchet na ahi.
en_web: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
en_kjv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Akop kop’in kong sunga alut’un,

tcz: Hichu gancha ho lah a anu khat le achal khat ahung lut soh phat un Pathen in Noah atep peh bang chun, Pakai Pathen in kot akhah tai.
en_web: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.
en_kjv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in.
tcz_gospelgo: Anu khat achal khat cheh, Pathenin Noah to akijot lut tauve. Noah alut phat’in Pakaiyin kongkot akhah tai.

tcz: Chujouvin ni somli le jan somli sung in hatah in twisanglen chu akhang in leiset chung jouse achup tan, hichun kong chu twi in ahin potou cheh cheh tan leiset sanga sang jon alet dohtai.
en_web: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
en_kjv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: nisom li le jan som li sungin leiset’a go ajun, twi apomtou tel tul’in Leiset sanga sang jon kong alet doh tai.

tcz: Twi chu nasa tah in akhang tul tul jeng tan ahile kong chu twi chunga akitol le len ahi.
en_web: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
en_kjv: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chung twi adimtel tul jengin, along matsoh tan, kong jong twi chunga akitol le lei.

tcz: Achaina geiyin twi chun mol jouse lah a asangpen geiyin abonchan achup soh heltai.
en_web: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
en_kjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
tcz_gospelgo: Twi atamval’in van noiya molsang jouse geiyin achupsoh tai.

tcz: Twi chu akhanbe jing in mol jouse lah a asangpen jong chu tong som ni jen thuh-in achup mang hel tai.
en_web: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
en_kjv: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
tcz_gospelgo: Twi chu akhang tou tou nalaiyin, molsang jouse sangin tongsom le ngan asangjoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun leiset chunga um ahing thei ahaithei jouse, chunga leng vachate ahin, in na kivah gancha ho ahin, gam'a gamsa ho ahiuvin, ahon hon a kiloiya leiset chung kitol le ganhing namkim ahiuvin chule mihemte geiyin agam soh heltai.
en_web: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
en_kjv: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun leiset ganhing namkim-ju le va, ahon honin, mihem geiyin athisoh heltauve.

tcz: Ima jouse leiset chunga um kiti pou anahhom a hinna hu neiya haithei jouse abonchan athi gam soh tan ahi.
en_web: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
en_kjv: all in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
tcz_gospelgo: Tolgoa cheng ganhing nah hai thei jouse athisoh tauve.

tcz: Pathen in leiset chunga thil ahing thei jouse asumang sohhel tai. Mihem ho jouse, gancha ho, ganhing gamsa ho, tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse, chunga leng vachate jouse abon'in athi soh hel tai. Ahin hichea sohcha a hing doh Noah le a insung mite chule kong sunga um ganhing anu khat le achal khat um ho bou ahiuve.
en_web: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
en_kjv: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a hing thei mihem le ganhing namkim, ju le va, tol’a kithol ho le chunga leng jouse Pakaiyin asugamin, Noah le kong sunga aumpi chengse chubou asoh chauve.

tcz: Hiche twisanglen chu leiset chung ni jakhat le nisom nga sung achup me.
en_web: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
en_kjv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni jakhat le som nga sung geiyin twi akemsuh hih laiye.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Noah le gamsa hole gancha ho kong sunga umjouse ageldoh jingin, Leiset chunga huipi hattah ahin nun sahin ahile twisanglen chu ahung kem lheh tai.
en_web: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
en_kjv: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
tcz_gospelgo: Noah le kong sunga aumpi ganhing chengse Pathenin agel khoh jingin, Leiset chunga hui anun sah le twi akemsuh pantai.

tcz: Leinoi lam a twi ho jong along kang tan, chule chunglam a van'a kona go nasa tah a ju jong athip tan ahi.
en_web: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
en_kjv: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
tcz_gospelgo: Twinah jouse le van’a go-kot chengse akikhah-in, go ahaiyin kho aphan,

tcz: Hichun twisanglen chu leiset chunga kon in ni jakhat le ni som nga jouvin akang hei hoitan ahi.
en_web: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
en_kjv: and the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni jakhat le som nga sungin leiset’a twi akang hei hoitai.

tcz: Hiti chun ni somle ni sagi lhinni lha sagi chan na chun kong chu Ararat molchunga ahung kinga tai.
en_web: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
en_kjv: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha sagi lhin na, nisom le ni sagi lhin nin Ararat lhanga molvum khat’a kong aki-ngamtai.

tcz: Lhani le akeh jouvin twi chu ahung kemtul tul'in mol dang dang ho jong molvum ahung kimu pantan ahi.
en_web: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
en_kjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
tcz_gospelgo: Twi vang akemsuh jing jengin, lha som lhinna, ni masapen nin molvum jouse akimu theitai.

tcz: Chujouvin ni somli jou chun Noah in huikot kong sunga asem chu ahin hong doh tan,
en_web: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
en_kjv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
tcz_gospelgo: Nisom li lhin nin Noah- in kong bangkot khat ahongin,

tcz: Hichun vavom khat alha doh in ahile, leiset chung adung avaiyin aleng len, leiset chunga twi akan loulai jeh'in ahung kinungle kit tai.
en_web: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
en_kjv: and he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: va-ah khat alha leh, leiset’a twi akanloulai jeh-in adung avaiyin alenglenahung kile kit tai.

tcz: Chuin Noah in jong leiset chunga twi kang soh tam ti vetna dingin vakhu khat alendoh sah kit'in ahi.
en_web: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
en_kjv: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
tcz_gospelgo: Twi kan le kan lou hetnan Noah-in vakhu khat alha kit leh,

tcz: Hinlah vakhu chu kingah na ding mun amu hihlaiye, Ajeh chu twijin leiset achup nahlai jeh in ahung ki nungle kitin, hichun Noah in vakhu chu akhut a adomlhan asung langa akoi lha kit tai.
en_web: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
en_kjv: but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset pumpi twiyin achup nah laijeh-in vakhu chun touna ding aholmon kong lama ahung kile kit;in, Noah-in agahsang lhan kong sunga achoilut tai.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi akho ngaiyin, chujouvin kong'a kon chun vakhu chu alha doh kit'a ahile,
en_web: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
en_kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
tcz_gospelgo: Noah ni sagi akho ngaiyin, vakhu chu alha kit leh,

tcz: Vakhu chu nilhah lang in ama henglam'a ahung kile kit'in, vetau amuh achun athah beh a kiloulha Olive thingna khat ahin pon, hijeh chun Noah in jong leiset chunga twipi akangsoh tai, ti ahedoh pai jin ahi.
en_web: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
en_kjv: and the dove came in to him in the evening; and lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah lamin vakhuchun amuh a olive thing nathah khat ahinpon, ahenga ahung kile kit’e. Hichea hin Noah-in leiset’a twi kan ahe-tai.

tcz: Chujouvin Noah jong ni sagi ma akho ngai kit'in vakhu chu alha doh kit'in ahile vakhu chu ahung kinung le kit tapoi.
en_web: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
en_kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah-in ni sagi ma a-ngah -in vakhu chu alhadoh kit leh, hichea vang hin vakhu chu ahenga ahung kile kit tapoi.

tcz: Noah hinkho chu kum jagup le kum khatna lha masapen, chu che lha ni masapen ni chun leiset chunga twipi abonchan akang soh heltan, hijeh chun Noah'in jong kong kusin chu ahoh lhan agahven ahile leiset chung chu ana go heltan ahi.
en_web: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dry.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah kum jagup le khat (601) lhin kum, lha masapen, ni masa nin leiset’a twi akangsoh-in, Noah-inkong in chung khu ahodoh aavet leh, leiset chung twi akangsoh heltai.

tcz: Hiti chun lhani jou don chun leiset chung hoitah in ago hel tai.
en_web: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
en_kjv: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha ni na nisom ni le sagi lhin nin leiset chung twi akang goheltan ahi.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in ahoulimpin hitin ati,
en_web: God spoke to Noah, saying,
en_kjv: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Noah jah a,

tcz: “Na boncha uvin kong sunga kon chun pot doh tauvin, nangma nahin, na jinu ahin, na chapate ahiuvin, chule na moute ahi uvin kilhon doh pin.
en_web: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
en_kjv: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: “Najinu le nachapate chule ajiteu toh kong sunga konin potdoh tauvin.

tcz: Tahsa a hing ganhing jouse, naum khompi ho vachate ahi uvin, gancha ho ahi uvin, leiset chunga a op'a kitholtho ho ahiuvin, hiche ho chu leiset letthe thua ahung chikhai uva, ahung hinphat uva chule ahung punjalna ding uvin hinpui doh tan,” ati.
en_web: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
en_kjv: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Naumpi ganhing namkim-ju le va, tol’a vah tahsaa hing jouse, apunjal’uva leiset adimsetna diuvin hinkai doh tan,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Noah ahin, ajinu ahin, achapate ho ahin amoute toh konga kon chun ahung potdoh tai.
en_web: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
en_kjv: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun konga konin Noah le ajinu, achapate le ajiteu apotdoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin gancha jouse alen aneo abonchauvin vacha ho ahiuvin ni ni in akop kop in anu khat le achal khat konga konin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
en_web: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
en_kjv: every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing ho jong, tol’a kithol ho le vachate, leiset’a lhale jouse kong sunga konin akop kop’in ahung potdoh tauve.

tcz: Hichun Noah in maicham Pathen henga asemin, hi achun aman kipeh dohna maicham pumgo thilto saho chule vacha ho amaho akipeh doh na dung jui cheh in pumgo thilto ding in agou vam in ahi.
en_web: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
en_kjv: And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah-in Pakai din maicham khat asemin, gancha theng le vacha theng lah akonin khat cheh adongkhomin, maichamphunga pumgo thilton agouvamtai.

tcz: Chuin anam tui maicham ahung kisem jeh chun Pathen alung lhai lheh jengin hitin ama aki houlim in aseiye, “Mihem jeh in keiman leiset hi gaosap kit tapong'e, ajeh chu mihem lung ngaito him him hi aneocha kipat'a hung gilou pan ahi tai; chule ganhing ka semsa ho jong hi sumang kit tapong'e.
en_web: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
en_kjv: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
tcz_gospelgo: Amuinam chun Pakai alung lhiayin alung sunga, “Aneocha pat mihem lungthim hi asesa kahet jeh-in, mihem thilse bol man a tukal leiset hi kagaosap kit lou hel ding ahitai. Tua kasuhgam banghin ganhing ho jong sumang ta ponge.

tcz: Iti nama jongle leiset aum laisen muchi tuphat, chang aat phat, gam dap phat, gamsat phat, nipi lai le phalbi lai, sun laile jan beilou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
en_kjv: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset aum laisea muchi tuphat, lho lhun phat, gamsat le gamdap phat, nipi laile phalbi lai chule sun le jan um jing ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achapate phatthei aboh in hitin ahou limpi in hitin aseiye, “Chale nao hing uvin, pung uvin lang leiset lochan sohkei uvin ati.
en_web: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
en_kjv: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

tcz: Leiset chunga um sa jouse ahin chunga leng vachate jouse ahin chule gamsa a op'a kithol tho ho ahiuvin chule twikhanglen'a nga ho ahiuvin abonchauva nangho naki chat cheh dingu ahi, abon chaouva nangho khut na kapeh doh ahi tai.
en_web: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
en_kjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

tcz: Ahing theiya avahle thei jouse nangho dinga anneh a pang thei cheh ahiuve, anche louhing kapeh ma banga chu aboncha kapeh doh nahitauve.
en_web: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
en_kjv: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

tcz: Hinlah nangman naneh thei lou ding chu sahing athisan pum pum a naneh lou beh ding ahi.
en_web: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
en_kjv: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall you not eat.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kakhol childing chu koi tabang khat touvin mihem hinkho asuhbeiya thisan asole, itiham khat a gamsan mihem athale hiche gamsa chu thadoh pai ding chule koitabang in mihem hinkho asuh bei leh ama hinkho hi tabang ma achu suhbei ding ahiye.
en_web: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
en_kjv: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.

tcz: Koitobang in mihem hinkho asuhbei le hiche mihem hinkho sumang pachu ama hinkho jong hi tobang achu kisumang ding ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in mihem hi ama lim bang banga asem doh ahiye.
en_web: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
en_kjv: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

tcz: Tuhin nangho hatah in punguvin lang leiset le asung dimset in cha le nao hing uvin lang, pung uvin chule hinlo chan soh kei uvin,” ati.
en_web: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
en_kjv: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achate ahoulim pin hitin aseiye.
en_web: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
en_kjv: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

tcz: “Kei man kaki tepna avel'in ka sudet nom lheh tai, nangtoh na chilhah te chengse ding injong,
en_web: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
en_kjv: And I, behold I establish my covenant with you and with your seed after you;

tcz: Chule gancha nam kim nangma toh kong sunga um chengse toh vacha ho ahin, insa ho ahin, chule gamsa hang ho jouse ahin chule leiset chunga atoi thei avahthei jouseding ahi.
en_web: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
en_kjv: and with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

tcz: Keiman nangho toh ka kitepna ka phudoh na ajehpen tah chu hiche hi ahi, tahsa a hingho twisanglen a kisumang kit louhel ding ahin, chule leiset suh mang na dinga jong twisang letna um kit louhel ding ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
en_kjv: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih hijongle ganhing namkim twiya kisumang talouding, a-itih geiya jong twisanglenin leiset asuhmang lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ka phudoh hi nangho le nalhat khom piu ganhing nam kim ho ahi uvin chule tonsot'a khangguija mite ding ahin, i-kah uva amel chihna hiche hiding ahi.
en_web: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
en_kjv: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho le ganhing namkim dinga mantih neilou kitepna kaphudoh het jingnan,

tcz: Keiman ka semdohsa nisa vah emsel chu vantham jol'a ka koiye, hichu leiset le kei kikah a kitepna khat aum melchihna hiding ahi.
en_web: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
en_kjv: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang lah a kathalpi kakoiye; hiche hi vannoito kakitep het jingna hiding ahi.

tcz: Keiman meibol lhang leichunga kahin sol teng nisa vah emsel ho chu meilhang lah a hung kilang ding ahiye.
en_web: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a meilhang kajinsah teng thalpi chu kimudoh ding,

tcz: Hiche phat le chun keiman nangho le ikah uva ka kitepna chu hingel doh kit ingting, chuteng le gotwi chu tahsa hingte sumang dinga twi sanga hunglen kit lou hel ding ahiye.
en_web: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
en_kjv: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule ganhing namkim-ahing jouse twilenin asuhmang louna dia nahenguva kakitepna kageldohji dingahi.

tcz: Keiman nisa vah emsel meilhang lah a kamuji tengle Pathen le leiset chunga tahsa a ahing thei jouse kah a tonsot kumkho a dinga kitepna chu kagel doh ding ahi,”ati.
en_web: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
en_kjv: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu meilhang lah athalpi ahung kilah teng, leiset chunga ganhing jouse le kei kah a mantin neilou kitepna chu kageldoh ding ahi.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah ahoulim pin hitin aseiye, “Hiche hi leiset chunga tahsa ahingthei jouse toh kei kikah a kitepna ka phudoh chu amelchihna hi ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
en_kjv: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thalpi hi ganhing namkim to kakitepna malchihna ahi,” ati.

tcz: Noah chate ho kong sunga kon'a hung potdoh ho chu ahi leh Shem, Ham chule Japhath ahiuve, Ham kiti pa hi Canaan pa ahiye.
en_web: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
tcz_gospelgo: Kong sunga hung potdoh Noah chapate chu Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuvin, Ham hi Canaan pa ahi.

tcz: Amaho chenghi Noah chate a kona vannoi mihem hung dim ahi.
en_web: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
en_kjv: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Noah chapa thum ho hi leiset chung cheng mihem chitin namtin penna pului ahitauve.

tcz: Chuin twisanglet kichai jou chun Noah in tolgo lah achun lou abol pan tan hia chun lengpi phung aphut doh tai.
en_web: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
en_kjv: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
tcz_gospelgo: Noah hi loubol mi ahin, leiset’a lengpilei bol masapenin apange.

tcz: Chujouvin nikhat chu Noah chun lengpitwi adon in ahile akham tan khoilupon buh sung ah chun asagoh keovin alum tai.
en_web: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
en_kjv: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah-in lengpitwi adon le akhamin, aponbuh sunga del cheng louvin alumtai.

tcz: Ham Canaan pa chun apa Noah sagoh keova aum chu amun apot doh paiyin asopi teni aga het sah in ahile,
en_web: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
en_kjv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan pa Hamin apa Noah del cheng louva lum amun, polama asopite ni agaseipeh-e.

tcz: Hichun Shem le Japheth in ponsil achoi lhon in alengkouva adom gel lhon a nunglam ngan anung toi lhon in apa akeova um chu agakhu khum lhonin, amai lhon vang ahei manggel lhon in apa akeova um amulhon poi.
en_web: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
en_kjv: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Shem le Japhet-in ponsilchol khat ala lhonin, alengkouva akhai lhonin, apa del chenglouva um chu mu lounadin akihei mangin, anunglam ngan pnonbuh sunga atoi lut lhonin, apa lhon chu agakhu khum lhone.

tcz: Noah hichun alupna a kon in ahung khah doh phat in achapa neopen in ana limbol chu ahedoh tai.
en_web: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
en_kjv: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah lengpitwi kham alimdoh phat’in achapa neopenin abolna chu ahedoh-in,

tcz: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiyin: “Canaan vang gaosap chang hen, Asopi teni henga soh jouse soh in hung pang hen,” atin,
en_web: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
en_kjv: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun, “Canaan hi gaosap chang hen, Asopite nin soh-in nei lhon hen.

tcz: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in Shem phattheiboh mai hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi soh himai hen,
en_web: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
en_kjv: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; And Canaan shall be his servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, Shem Pathen vang vahchoiyin umhen, Shemin Canaan hi soh-in hinneihen.

tcz: Pathen in Japheth gam chu hatah in keh let peh hen, chule Japheth in Shem pon buh sung dunga jong chen sah hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi pa soh hijing mai hen,” ati.
en_web: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
en_kjv: God shall enlarge Japheth, And he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; And Canaan shall be his servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Japheth punsah hen, Achilhahte Shem chilhahto hung chengkhomu hen; Canaan vang Japheth soh-in hung pang hen,” ati.

tcz: Twisanglen kichai jouvin Noah chu kum jathum le kum som nga ahing nalaiye.
en_web: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
en_kjv: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisanglet nungin Noah kum jathum le som nga ahing nalaiyin,

tcz: Hitichun Noah hin nikho abon bonin kum jako le kum somnga alhing in, chujouvin ama athi tai.
en_web: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
en_kjv: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum jako le som nga lhin kumin athi.

tcz: Hiche thusim hohi Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah thusim chu ahiye; Twisang let jou chun amaho akonin cha tamtah ahung punbe in ahi.
en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
en_kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah ho khanggui thusim chu, twisanglet nungin athum’uvin chapa tampi ahing cheh-ui.

tcz: Japheth chilhah ho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
en_kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
tcz_gospelgo: Japheth chapate chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.

tcz: Gomer chilhah ho chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmath ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
tcz_gospelgo: Gomer chapate chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve.

tcz: Javan chilhah ho chu Elishah, Kittim, chule Rodanim ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
en_kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
tcz_gospelgo: Javan chapate chu Elishah, Spain, Cyprus chule Rhodes ahiuvin;

tcz: Hiche apat chun amaho chilhah chengse chu leiset ahin toupha pan tauvin ama ama hithei na leh aphung achang akaidol chehin ama nam hina dol chehin acheng tauvin ahi.
en_web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
en_kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen pang dunga hung cheng ho penna pului ahiuve. Hicheng hi Japheth chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a akichen’uvin, ama pao cheh akithouve.

tcz: Ham chilhah ho chu Cush, Mizraim, Put, chule Canaan ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
tcz_gospelgo: Ham chapate chu Cush, Egypt, Libya chule Canaan ahiuve.

tcz: Cush chilhah ho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
tcz_gospelgo: Cush chapate chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah chule Sabteca ahiiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahi.

tcz: Cush kitipa hin leiset chunga mihat ahung pang masapen Nimrod chu ahing'in ahi.
en_web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
en_kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Cush-in Nimrod kiti chapa khat ahingin, leiset’a gal-hat masapenin apange.

tcz: Hiche phat laiya chu vannoiya gamlen hat sakap them pen ahung hin, chule Pathen ging tah mi jong ana hi'e, hijeh chun mihon Nimrod banga gamlen hat sakapthem pen ahi tin aseiuve.
en_web: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.
en_kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai panpi jal’in Nimrod hi sathat thei tah ahin, hijeh chun mihon, “Nimrod bangin Pakaiyin sathat thei nahisah hen,” akitijiuve.

tcz: Hichun Cush chun alenggam chu Babylon khopi sunga Babylonia tin ahin semdoh'in, hiche khopi ho chu Erech, Akkad, chule Calneh ahiuve.
en_web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
en_kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
tcz_gospelgo: Nimrod lenggam chun Babylon, Erech chule Accad, Babylon gamsunga um chengse ahopsoh keiye.

tcz: Aman hiche akon chun Assyria ajonin hikom achun Nineveh khopi aphut doh in aban'a Rehobothir khopi ahin Calah khopi jong ahin phut doh kit e.
en_web: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
en_kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche gama kon hin Nimrod Assyria gama achen, Nineveh khopi, Rehoboth Ir khopi, Calah khopi,

tcz: Chuban chun Nineveh le Calah khopi teni kikah achun Resen khopi aphut doh in khopi lentah ahi.
en_web: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
en_kjv: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
tcz_gospelgo: chule Nineveh khopi le khopi minthang tah Calah kikah a Resen khopi aphutdoh-e.

tcz: Mizraim chu Ludite, Anamite, Naphuhite chule Lehabite ho cheng pa ahi.
en_web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
en_kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt chapate chu Lydi, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh,

tcz: Pathrusim ho, Casluhim ho, chule Caphtorim ho a kon a chu Philistine te hung kon dohna chu ahi.
en_web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
en_kjv: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim) and Caphtorim.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathrus, Casluh chule Caphtor ahin, Caphtor hi Philistine mite penna pului ahi.

tcz: Canaan chapa tahpen chu Sidon, Sidon chilhah te hung kon dohna ho chu ahiuvin chule Hit chilhah ho jong Canaan akon ahiuve.
en_web: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
en_kjv: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan chapate chu amasan apeng masapen Sidon le Heth ahi lhonin,

tcz: Jebus ho, Amor ho, Girgash ho ahin,
en_web: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
en_kjv: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
tcz_gospelgo: chule Canaan chilhah chu Jebus mite, Amor mite, Girgash mite,

tcz: Hivi teho, Arki ho, Sin ho ahin,
en_web: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
en_kjv: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiv mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,

tcz: Arvad ho, Zemar ho, chule Hamath ho jouse hi ama hinsa cheh ahiuve, ahin khonung in Canaan insung kon mite chu gamtina akithe cheh soh kei uvin ahi.
en_web: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
en_kjv: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: Arvad mite, Zemar mite le Hamath mite ahiuve. Khonung in Canaan insung kon chengse gamtin’a akithe chan soh keiyun,

tcz: Hiche apat chun Canaan gamgi chu Sidonna pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin aki lhung lut peh in, Sodom lang jon in aki lhung in, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahin phan, chule Zeboiim ahop in Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.
en_web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
en_kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
tcz_gospelgo: agamgiu Sidon a pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin akilhung lut peh-in, Sodom lang jonin akilhungin, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahinphan, chuin Zeboiim ahopan Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.

tcz: Amaho cheng hi Ham chilhah ho ahi uvin, ama ama insung dungjuile, apao dung juile, agam dung jui chuleh ajat dung jui uva ahiye.
en_web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi Ham chihlhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a achengun, ama pao cheh akithouve.

tcz: Shem chate pasal ho jouse apunbe in ama chu Japheth upa ahin, Ebel chilhah ho jouse hi Shem'a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuve.
en_web: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
en_kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
tcz_gospelgo: Japheth upa Shem chu Hebrew mite penna pului ahi.

tcz: Shem chilhah ho chu ahile Elam, Asshur, Arphaxed, Lud chule Ram ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
en_kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
tcz_gospelgo: Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud chule Aram ahiuve.

tcz: Ram chilhah ho chu ahile Uz, Hul, Gether, chule Mash ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
en_kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
tcz_gospelgo: Aram chapate chu Uz, Hul, Gether chule Meshkek ahiuve.

tcz: Arphaxad chu Shelah pa ahin, chule Shelah chu Ebel pa ahiye.
en_web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
en_kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
tcz_gospelgo: Arpachshad chapa chu Shelah ahin, Shelah chapa Eber ahi.

tcz: Ebel chun cha ni aneiyin amasa pachu Peleg (Hichu kisuh khenna tina ahi) ahi, Ijeh inem itile ama phatlai a chu vannoi chu ama ama paotho doh dungjuiya ahung umdoh laitah chu ahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
en_web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
en_kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
tcz_gospelgo: Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, khatpa khanga hi leiset mite paocheh jeh a akikhen jeh-un amin Peleg akitin, khatjo pa chu Jokatan ahi.

tcz: Joktan chapa chu Almodad ahin, Sheleph ahin, Hazarmaveth ahin, Jerah ahin,
en_web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
en_kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
tcz_gospelgo: Joktan chapate chu Almodad, Shelph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

tcz: Hadoram ahin, Uzal ahin, Diklah ahin,
en_web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
en_kjv: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
tcz_gospelgo: Hardoram, Uzal, Diklah,

tcz: Obal ahin, Abimael ahin, Sheba ahin,
en_web: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
en_kjv: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
tcz_gospelgo: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

tcz: Ophir ahin, Havilah ahin chule Jobab ahiuve. Amaho chengse hin Joktan chilhah cheh ahi uve.
en_web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
en_kjv: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
tcz_gospelgo: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahiuvin, abonchauva Joktan chapa jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Ama hon gam ki-vaipohna atoupha u-chu Mesha apat'in Sephar lang jonin ahung kilhung in, nisolam'a thinglhang gamsung geiyin ahung kilhunglut peh-in ahi.
en_web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
en_kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar, a mount of the east.
tcz_gospelgo: Joktan chapate gamgi chu Mesha a pat Sephar lang jonin solam thing lhang gamsung geiyin akilhung lutpeh-e.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Shem chilhah ahi uvin, a phungle achang, a pao tho'u dung jui le, agam dung jui le, ajat dungjui uva Shem chilhah te ahi uve.
en_web: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi Shem chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agakai sung cheh a achengun, apao cheh akithouve.

tcz: Hiche phungle chang hung kimin phah se hi Noah chate a kon'a chi le nam hung kisem doh ama gui penna dung juiya vannoiya nam jouse hi hiche phungpi a kon'a twisanglet jouva patna hung um doh ahi.
en_web: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
en_kjv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche miho hi ama ama jat dungjui le akondoh nau insung dungjuiya kisimtoh Noah insung kon cheh ahivin, twisanglet nunga leiset chung mihem hijat hi amahoa kondoh jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Phatkhat lai tah chun vannoiya mihem jousen pao khat bou ana tho uvin, apao cheng manu jong tha khat cheh ana hi.
en_web: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
en_kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche laichun leiset miten paokhat seh athon, thu cheng jong tha khat amanguve.

tcz: Hiche lai chun miho chu nisolama konin ahung kichon uvin ahile Shinar gamsunga chun phaicham mun ong lentah ahin mudoh uvin, hikoma chun acheng tauve.
en_web: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte chu niso lama akitol leu leh Babylon gama phaicham khat’a ahung lut’uvin, hikoma chun achengtauve.

tcz: Hichun ama ho khat le khat aki hou un, “Eihon cheh gadengu hitin goutah lheng'u hite,” akiti uvin; hiti chun song panna pang dingin cheh amang uvin, songlou dingin leingan amang uve.
en_web: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
en_kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho khat le khat akihouvun,” Hungun, cheh dengu hitin goutah lhengu hite,” atiuvin; song panna pangdin cheh adenguvin, song lou din leingan amangui.

tcz: Hichun amahon hitin aseiuve, “Hung un eihon khopi khat kisah uhitin, chule in sangtah khat a tingvum vantoh kibang khat sadoh uhitin, vannoiya imin'u ki thansah uhite, achuti loule leiset chunga iki moh thethang gam ding'u ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
en_kjv: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon,” khopi khat semu hitin, insang, atingvum vanto kibang khat sau hitin imin kithansah-u hite, achutiloule leiset chunga ikimoh thethang gam diu ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai Pathen chu mihemten khopi asah'u le insang asah doh'u veding in Pakai ahung kumlha tai.
en_web: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
en_kjv: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte khopi sem le insang sah chu vedin Pakai ahung kum lhai.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Vetan mipiho hi aki pumkhat thei lheh jeng uvin chule pao khatseh bou atho uvin, hijeh chun phat chomkhat jou teng le amaho hin ipi hijongle abolgot ho u-chu ajo lel lou beh dingu ahi.
en_web: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Pakaiyin, “Mihemte hijat khat bou ahin, pao khatseh bou athouve; athilbol’u hi tua bana aboldiu apatna bou ahinalaiyin, tukal abolnom nom abol jeng diu dol ahitai’

tcz: Hijeh chun hung un eiho ga kumsuh'u hitin apao'u ga suhkhen peh uhite, chutile khat le khat athusei kihet mon um tauvinte,” ati.
en_web: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
en_kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum lhau hitin apaovu gasucheh leu hen khat le khat kihou mon um’uvin tin atohban haitauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai Pathen in leiset chung ah abon uvin, athe cheh soh hel'in hiche apat'a chu khopi insah chu hung bouiya ahiuve.
en_web: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
en_kjv: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi Pakaiyin miho chu leiset chunga ahtecheh soh phat’in akhopi sah ban ahaitauve.

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche kopi insang kisah chu Babel kiti ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in mipi ho lung asuhboui a paochom paochom athosah ahi tia hi Pathen in vannoiya ana thecheh'u ahi.
en_web: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
en_kjv: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma kona hi Pakaiyin mihemte pao asuh cheh a, leiset chunga athe chehsoh hel jeh-in akhopi min Babylon akisah lot tai.

tcz: Hiche hi Shem insung mite thusim ahi e. Twisang let kum ni jouvin Shem chu atahsa kum jakhat alhing in achapa Arpachshad chu ahing'e;
en_web: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
en_kjv: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
tcz_gospelgo: Shem chilhah ho thusim hiti ahi. Twisanglet nung kum ni lhin kum, Shem kum jakhat ahin achapa Arpachshad ahinge.

tcz: Arpachshad apen jou chun Shem chu kum ja nga ahingin, hichun aman cha numei le pasal tamtah ahinbei.
en_web: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Arpachshad pen nungin Shem kum ja nga ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei.

tcz: Hichun Arpachshad chu kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Shelah pa ahung hitan ahi.
en_web: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
en_kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
tcz_gospelgo: Arpachshad kum somthum le nga alhinin achapa Shelah ahingin,

tcz: Shelah ahung pen jouchun Arpachshad chu kum jali le kum thum ahingin, chuin aman cha pasal le numei tamtah ahinbei.
en_web: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Shelah pen nungin Arpachshad kum ja li le thum ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei.

tcz: Shelah kum som thum alhin in ama chu Eber pen na pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
en_kjv: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
tcz_gospelgo: Shelah kum somthum alhinin achapa Eber ahingin,

tcz: Eber pen jou chun, Shelah chu kum jali le kum thum ahinbe in chuin cha pasal le cha numei jong ahin be nalaiye.
en_web: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Eber pen nungin Shelah kum ja li le thum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi ahinbei.

tcz: Eber kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Peleg pa ahung hi tan ahi.
en_web: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
en_kjv: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
tcz_gospelgo: Eber kum somthum le li alhinin achapa Peleg ahingin,

tcz: Peleg pen jou chun Eber chu kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahinbe nalaiye.
en_web: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Peleg pen nungin Eber kum ja li le somthum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.

tcz: Peleg chu kum som thum alhinin, ama chu Reu pa ahung hitan ahi.
en_web: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
en_kjv: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
tcz_gospelgo: Peleg kum somthum alhinin achapa Reu ahingin,

tcz: Reu pen jou nung in Peleg chu kum jani le kum ko ahin be nalaiyin, cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
en_web: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Reu pen nungin Peleg kum ja ni le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.

tcz: Reu chu kum som thumle kum ni bou alhinin Serug pen na pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
en_kjv: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
tcz_gospelgo: Reu kum somthum le ni alhinin achapa Serug ahingin,

tcz: Serug pen jou chun, Reu chu kum jani le kum sagi ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jouchun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah anei be nalaiye.
en_web: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Serug pen nungin Reu kum ja ni le sagi ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.

tcz: Serug kiti pachu kum som thum bou alhinin Nahor pa ahung hitai.
en_web: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
en_kjv: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
tcz_gospelgo: Serug kum somthum alhinin achapa Nahor ahingin,

tcz: Nahor pen jou chun Serug chu kum jani ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei phachompi ahinbe nalaiye.
en_web: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahor pen nungin Serug kum ja ni ahing nalaiyin, cha dang tampi jong ahinbei.

tcz: Nahor chu kum som ni le kum ko bou alhin in Terah apeng tai.
en_web: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
en_kjv: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
tcz_gospelgo: Nahor kum som ni le ko alhinin achapa Terah ahingin,

tcz: Terah pen jou chun Nahol chu kum jakhat le kum som le kum ko ahing nalaiyin, hichun aman cha pasal le cha numei simsen lou ahinbe nalaiye.
en_web: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Terah pen nungin Nahor kum jakhat le som le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.

tcz: Terah vang chu kum som sagi jen ahung lhinin Abram, Nahor, chule Haran ahin hingin ahi.
en_web: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
en_kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
tcz_gospelgo: Terah kum som sagi alhinin Abram le Nahor chule Haran ahinge.

tcz: Hiche hi Terahte thusim kisei ahi. Terah chun Abram, Nahor, chule Haran pa ahin, chule Haran chu Lot pa ahiye.
en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
en_kjv: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
tcz_gospelgo: Terah chilhah ho khanggui chu hiti ahi; Terah-in Abram le Nhor chule Haran ahingin ahi. Haran hin Lot ahinjou,

tcz: Ahin Haran chu apa Terah thi masang in, apenna Chaldeans gam'a Ur khopi achun athitai.
en_web: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
en_kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
tcz_gospelgo: Apa Terah hinpet’ in Babylon gamsung achena khopi Ur a athitai.

tcz: Ahin chutobang lai chun Abram le Nahor chun ji anei gel lhon in, Abram jinu min chu Sarai ahin, Nahor jinu min chu ahile Milcah ahin, Haran chanu ahiye; (Milcah le a sopi nu Iscah chu Nahor sopi pa Haran Chanute ahi lhon e).
en_web: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
en_kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin Sarai akichenpin. Nahorin Haran chunu Milcah akichenpi: Haran hin Iscah jong ahingin ahi.

tcz: Ahin Sarai chu aching in naovop thei louvin cha hing lou vin aum tai.
en_web: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
en_kjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarai achingin cha neilouvin aumtai.

tcz: Nikhat Terah chun achapa Abram le amounu Sarai chule Haran chapa atupa Lot akipuiyin abonchauvin Chaldea gam khopi Ur a kon chun Canaan gam jon ding in ache tauve; Ahin Haran khopi ahin phah phat uvin hiche muna chun acheng den tauve.
en_web: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
en_kjv: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
tcz_gospelgo: Terah hin achapa Abram le amou nu Sarai-Abram jinu, atupa Lot-Hanran chapa akipuiyin, Babylon gama Ur khopi dalhan Canaan gam jonin achetauve. Amahon Haran ahinphauvin, hikoma chun achengtauve.

tcz: Hichun Terah hinkho chu kum jani le kum nga alhing in, chujou vin Haran khoa chun Terah athi den tai.
en_web: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
en_kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
tcz_gospelgo: Haran a chun Terah kum ja ni le nga alhinin athitai.

tcz: Pathen in Abram chu ana houlimpi in “Nagam, na insung mite, na sopiho chule napa sopi ho dalhan keiman gamthah ka musah ding khu jon tan,” ati.
en_web: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
en_kjv: Now the Lord had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Abram jah a, “Nagam leiset le na phung na chang, na- insung mite dalhan, keiman kavetsah got gam jonin chen.

tcz: Keiman nang hi nam lentah kasoding nahiye; chule keiman nangma phatthei kaboh ding chule namin kaki than sah ding chule midangho phatthei chan na nahi ding ahi.
en_web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
en_kjv: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman nachilhah tampi kahisah a, nam lentah kaso ding, phatthei kaboh a min thang tah a ka koi ding, chu teng nangma phatthei bom nihi ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nangman phathei naboh ho chu phathei chang diu, chule nangman na sapset techu ka sapset ding; chule nangma jeh a leiset chunga phung nam kim phatthei chang ding ahiuve.
en_web: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
en_kjv: and I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma phatthei na boh te phatthei kaboh a, Nagaosap jouse kagaosap thuh ding; Nang jeh achitin namtin phatthei kaboh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in athu mop dung jui chun Abram chu akichon in, chule Lot in ama aki lhonpi in. Abram chu Haran dalha a akichon doh chun akum kum somsagi le kum nga ana lhing tan ahi.
en_web: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
en_kjv: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram kum som sagi le nga ahin, Pakaiyin aseipeh bangin, Haran akonin akipatdoh- in, Lot chun akilhonpi.

tcz: Aji ngaitah Sarai, asopi pa Lot, anei agou, agam jouse toh, agancha jouse, chule Haran a ana um laiya a insungmi ana kisemdoh chengse chu aki puiyin Canaan lam ajon tauve.
en_web: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin ajinu Sarai le asopipa cha Lot akipuiyin, Haran a alamdoh goujouse pon, soh chengse to kilhonin Canaan gam jonin achatauve. Canaan gam ahung lhun phat’ un,

tcz: Abram in alamjot'na a Shechem chu ahopa in saotah ajot un, hiche achun ngah mun Moreh thingphung kom ah akinga uvin hiche mun chu Canaan mihon ana lodim un ahi.
en_web: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
en_kjv: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Shechem muntheng lai, Moreh muna gangpi theng phung ahinphah kahsen Abramin gamsung chu akhol khol jenge. Hichepet hin gamsunga Canaan miho anachenguve.

tcz: Hichun Pathenin Abram chu akimupi'n “Keiman hiche gamhi na chilhahte kapeh ding ahiye,” hichun Abram injong ahenga hung kilah Pakaiya ding in hiche muna chun maicham khat asem in ahi.
en_web: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
en_kjv: And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the Lord, who appeared unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram henga Pakai ahungkilah-in ajaha,” Nason nachilhahte kapehgot gam chu hiche hi ahi,” ati. Hichun ahenga hung kilah Pakai din Abramin maicham phung khat hikoma chun asemdoh tai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun, Abram in noilam gam ahin jon in kingah na mun ding thinglhang lam'ah asem doh in hichu nilhum lama Bethel khopi, niso lam a Ai khopi, akah achun ponbuh akison in akinga in, hiche mun achun aman Pakaiya dingin maicham khat asem in chule Pakai min in atao tai.
en_web: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Bethel khopi nisolam, lhanglam thinglhang gam manon Abram achen, nilhum lama Bethel le niso lama Ai kikah a ngahmun akisemtai. Hikoma jong hin maicham khat asemin Pakai minin ataove.

tcz: Hichun Abram chu noilam'a ahung chalbe ben Negev lam jonin ache paiye.
en_web: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
en_kjv: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Abram muntin’a avah len, Canaan gamsung lhanglam gamkai sung ajontai.

tcz: Hiche lai phat dontah chun Canaan gam sunga nasatah in kel alhan, Abram chu Egypt ma chelou thei ahi tapon, hikom achun Abram chu gampam mi vaitah in ana um'in ahi.
en_web: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
en_kjv: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan gamsunga kel lhah jeh a ahhsat behseh phat’ in Abram puhsuiya khopem din Egypt gam jonin achesuh-e.

tcz: Abram chu ahung suh deu vin Egypt gamgi ahung lhun phat chun, Abram in ajinu Sarai jah achun aseiyin, Sarai “Ven nangma hi numei melhoi tah nahin.”
en_web: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gamsung alut ding konin Abramin ajinu Sarai jah a,” Veteh, mitvet’a numei mel-hoi tah nahi kahei.

tcz: Egypt miten namu teng u-leh, amahon hitia asei diu, “Ama hi ajinu ahi, amapa hi that doh'u hitin hiche teng chule ajinu hi eiho ichan thei ding'u ahi ati ding'u ahi.”
en_web: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.
en_kjv: therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt miten namu tengu keiji nahi heuvintin, kei eithauva, nang nakihoi diu ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun nang chu kei sopinu hi kahi tin kisei in lang hile chun kei dingin phapen intin chule nangma jal'a chu kei jong ei hinghoi ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
en_kjv: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang jeh a eihing hoijuva eibol phatna diuvin kei naovin kiseiyin,” ati.

tcz: Thudihtah khat chu ahile Abram chu Egypt ahung lhun chun mipiho chun Sarai chu amelhoi chu amudoh sohtauvin ahi.
en_web: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram Egypt gamsung alut phat’ in Egypt mite mitvet’ in jong ajinu chu numei mel- hoitah ahi nget’e.

tcz: Chule Pharaoh lengpa chapaten amudoh phat uvin Pharaoh koma amanu chu aphat sei lheh jeng tauve. Hichun Sarai chu Pharaoh insunga apuilut tauvin ahi.
en_web: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
en_kjv: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharaoh leng chapaten amudoh-un, Sarai mel- hoi dan lengpa jah a aseiyui; hijeh chun Sarai chu leng inpia apuilut tauve.

tcz: Hichun Sarai jeh chun Pharaoh in Abram chu thil mantam tah apen, kelngoi hon ahin, bong chalte ahin, sangan chal ho ahiuvin; soh pasal hihen soh numei ho hileh, sangongsao ho ahin sangongsao api ho ahiuvin anei doh sah lotai.
en_web: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
en_kjv: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarai jal’ in lengpan Abram abol phan, kelngoi hon, kelchate, bong hon, sa-ngante, soh le kol chule sangonsao tampi apei.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Pharaoh le ainsung mite chu Abram jinu Sarai jeh chu het phahlou thoh hah tah chun abolgim lheh jeng tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
en_kjv: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lengpan Abram jinu Sarai akipuijeh-in, Pakaiyin lengpa chung le a-insung mite chunga nat khoh tah alansah tai.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Abram chu nasatah in ahousal in, “Ipi bol'a kingaito nahim,” atin, “I bol la naloinu na jinu ahi chu nei seipeh lou ham?”
en_web: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
en_kjv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pharoah- in Abram agakousah-in ajah a, “Idia hita neibol ham? Hiche nu naji hitaa idia naseida ham?

tcz: Ibola ka sopi nu ahi natia kaji dinga neiki pui sah ham? Hijeh chun ven tunjong hikom a na jinu aum e ki puiyin lang gangtah in chedoh tan,” ati.
en_web: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
en_kjv: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
tcz_gospelgo: Ibol’ a nanao ahi na tia, jia naipuisah mongham? Hin hin naji hi, kipuiyin potdoh loiyin.” tin anotai.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in asemang pachong ho thu apetan, “Abram ahin ajinu ahin chule anei agou abonchan hiche gam'a konin gathah doh un,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharaoh-in amite aseipeh-in, amahon Abram le ajinu chule athil keo alokeo pumin gamsunga konin akaidoh tauve.

tcz: Hichun Abram'in ajinu Sarai, asopipa Lot toh, Egypt gam chu adalha uvin chunglam Negev mun lang jonin achetou tai.
en_web: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
en_kjv: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin ajinu akipuiyin, anei jouse apon, Lot to kilhonin, Egypt’ a konin Canaan lhanglam jonin achetai.

tcz: Abram chun gancha anei lheh jeng tan, hiche keo hilouvin sana le dangka jong ahao lheh jengtan ahi.
en_web: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
en_kjv: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin kelngoi le kelcha, bong chule sana dangka tampi aneiyinmihao tah ahitan ahi.

tcz: Hitichun Negev apat Bethel geiyin ahung cheng un, chuleh Bethel le Ai kikah mun a khoilupon in asong un phat masa a ana um bang in,
en_web: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
en_kjv: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan lhanglam gamkaiya konin akholjin len, muntin achonin, Bethel lang ahinjon’e. Masanga ngahmun asemna Bethel le Ai kikah ahinphan,
