tcz: Hiche mun chu ahile Abram in maicham anasem dohna mun ahin hikom achun Pathen in avel in ana hou kit tai.
en_web: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga maicham asemna muna chun Pakai min ataove.

tcz: Lot, Abram toh kilhon jing pa jong chu ahung hao lheh tan kelngoi hon ahin kelcha hon ahin tamtah ahin nei tan chule khoilupon in jong ahin nei doh tan ahi.
en_web: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
en_kjv: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot’ in jong atumtah-in kelngoi le kelcha chule bong tampi le soh tampi aneiyin, a-insung mite toh ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah gam achen nau chu Abram le Lot dingin ahung neo lheh jeng tai, ajeh chu akelngoi hon ho le kelcha hon ho ahin gancha dang ho aum khom thei tapouve.
en_web: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.
en_kjv: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram le Lot’ in gancha tamtah gel anei lhon phat’in, ganchate neh ding gam aneo behseh tan acheng khom thei lhon tapoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Abram le Lot gancha chingho kahlah a kihet khelna ahung um doh tan hiche phatlai chun Canaaan mite le Perizzite mite jong ana cheng khom uve.
en_web: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
en_kjv: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram gancha ching ho le Lot gancha ching ho akinahso tauvin, akitohmo tauve. hichepet hin Canaan gamsunga Canaan mite le Periz mite acheng nalaiyui.

tcz: Achainakeiyin Abram in Lot jah'a hitin aseiye, “Eini kiheto themsel hite nang ma le kei gancha ching ho kahlah'a, ajeh chu eiho hi ucha kinai tah ihi bouve.
en_web: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
en_kjv: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin Lot jah a, “Insung khat kihi, namite le kamite kina thei pouvinte.

tcz: Ven na masanga gam-ong lenpitah hi nanga ahiye, nangman kilhen in hoilam hi nadei ham kilhen in ikihop ding ahi. Leiset gam ong veilam nadei le keiman gam ong jetlam kaki lah ding, nangman jetlam aphajoi nati le keiman na dei lou lang chu kaki lhen mai ding ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
en_kjv: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikhenta hite. Na- angsunga gam ongmo ngap lou, nadei dei lai kilhenin; jetlam nalhen le veilama cheng ting, veilam nalhen le kei jetlama chenge,” ati.

tcz: Lot chun phat sottah gam chu aven gam pha leithao potna mun Jordan phaicham lang chu Zoar lang toh kinai lang deu, hilang chu ahile aphat seh a twiyin achapnou na mun gam Pathen honlei toh bang twi chap nou jing ahi louleh Egypt te honlei banga hoitah ahi. Hiche phatlai chu Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang masang ana hi.
en_web: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
en_kjv: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot akhodaa avet leh, Jordan phaicham pumpi, Zoar geiyin agah mun, twi atha lhingin, Pakai honsung le Egypt gamsung abang jengin ahi. Hichepet”a chu Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang loulai ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Lot in jong Jordan vadung phaicham pumpi chu akilhen in, hiti chun Lot chu niso lam jonin akitol tai; hitobang hin amani aki inkhen lhontan ahi.
en_web: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
en_kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
tcz_gospelgo: Hi jeh chun Lot’ in Jordan phaicham pumpi akilhenin, nisolam jonin akitoldoh tai. Hitia cuh Abram le Lot kikhen ahilhon’e.

tcz: Hichun Abram Canaan gam'a cheng din aum tai. Chua chun Lot'in ama khoilupon buh chu Sodom gam toh kinai phaicham geiyin aga songdoh pehin ahi.
en_web: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
en_kjv: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram Canaan gama acheng denin, Lot chu Jordan phaichama khopi ho lah a chun apansan, Sodom koma ngahmun asem’e;

tcz: Hinlah hiche Sodom mite chu apha mothei lheh un, chule agilou thei lheh un Pathen douna in akisa chavai lheh un ahi.
en_web: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.
en_kjv: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom kho mite chu a- engseuvin, Pakai dounan achonseuve.

tcz: Lot apotdoh jou phat in Pathenin Abram chu ahoulim pi in, “Vetem in namit a namu phah chan gam ninggei achunglam anoilam, solam le lhumlam.
en_web: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
tcz_gospelgo: Lot’in adalhah nungin Pakaiyin Abram jah a,” Nadin mun laitah akonin najet navei, sah le lhang vegolsoh keiyin;

tcz: Keiman nangma hiche gam jouse namit'a namu phah jouse nangma le na chilhahte jouse tonsot'a nei le gou va kapeh na hitai.
en_web: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
en_kjv: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Gam hitepi nang le nason napah kapeh ding, tonsot’a nagamu hiding ahi.

tcz: Keiman na son na chilhahte chu leiset'a leivui jat ka phahsah ding, leiset leivui jat sim jou lou banga nang son le chilhahte jong simjou lou ahi bouve.
en_web: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
en_kjv: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
tcz_gospelgo: Nason nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding, tam behseh jenguva leivui jat pha diu koman asim jou lou ding ahi.’

tcz: Hijeh chun kipatdoh in lang agamsung hi adung avai asuh atung in ga kholtoh in, Ajeh chu ken nangma kapeh ding ahi.”
en_web: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
en_kjv: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman agam pumpia kapeh tah ding jeh-in, kipatdoh-in abonchan gakholsoh keiyin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abram'in aumna chu Hebron mun a achon in gangpi thing kena kom Mamre kiti mun chu ahi. Chule Abram in hiche mun achun Pakaiya dingin maicham khat asem in ahi.
en_web: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.
en_kjv: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Abram jong achen, Hebron a Mamre thingphung theng ho koma chun apansan, hikoma chun Pakai din maicham khat asemtai.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah chun gal kinah kiboui na ana um'in, hiche a ana ki boui ho chu ahile Amraphel Babylon lengpa Ellasar Arioch lengpa, Elam Kedorlaomer lengpa, chule Tidal Goiim lengpa ahiuve.
en_web: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin Babylon lengpa Amraphel le Ellasar lengpa Arioch, Elam lengpa Chaedorlaomer le Goiim lengpa Tidal

tcz: Chule akidou piu ho chu Sodom gam lengpa Bera, Birsha Gomorrah lengpa, Shinab Admah lengpa, Shemeber Zeboiim lengpa, chule Bela lengpa (Zoar) kitipa ahiuve.
en_web: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
en_kjv: that these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
tcz_gospelgo: Akon’ uvin Sodom leng pa Bera le Gomorrah lengpa Birsha, Admah lengpa Shinah le Zeboiim lengpa Shemeber chule Bela ahiloule Boar lengpa chunga gal agabol tauve.

tcz: Hichea anunung'a leng ho hi Siddim phaicham twithi kol phaicham a apang un ahi.
en_web: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
en_kjv: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Tulaiya Twikhanglen thisa, Siddim phaichama hiche leng nga ho hi anapangkhom’ uve.

tcz: Kumsom le kumni sung'a ama ho hi Kedorlaomer lengpa noiya ana kun jing'u ahin, amavang kum som le kum thum lhin kum'in adouvin ahung pang tauve.
en_web: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
en_kjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum somle ni sungin leng nga h hi Chedorlaomer lengpa noiya alut lo tauvin, nah nha- in kum som le thum kumin ahindou pan thie bep’ ui.

tcz: Kum khat jou chun Kedorlaomer lengpa le ama pankhompi lengho chu ahung kon uvin, Rephaim mite chu Ashteroth-Karnaim achun ajou un, Zuzites mite chu Ham achun ajou un, Emim mite chu Shaveh-Kiriathaim achun anajou un,
en_web: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
en_kjv: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin la kum som le li lhin kumin Chedorlaomer le apanpi leng ho ahung kon’ uvin, Ashteroth Karnaim a Rephaim mite ajouvun, Ham mun’ a Zuzim mite ajouvun,

tcz: Chule Horite mite chu amolsangu Seir apat gamthip lang gamgi Ei-Paran chan geiyin aga joupeh uvin ahi.
en_web: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
en_kjv: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Edom molsang lhanga Hor mite ajouvun, nelgam pamchim a Elparan geiyin agadel jampeh-uve.

tcz: Hichun amaho hikoma kon chun akinungle kit uvin Kadesh kiti, tuhin En-misphat achun Hazazontamar a cheng Amorites mite leh Amalekites mite chu agam sung pum pin ajou tauve.
en_web: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
en_kjv: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.
tcz_gospelgo: Chua konin ahung kile kit’ uvin, masanga ‘Enmishpat kiti, tulai Kadesh mun akhun ahunguve. Hikoma hin Hazazon Tamar a cheng, Amor mite le Amalek mite ajouvun agam pumpi alauve.

tcz: Hichun leng phalou akiphin ho sese chu Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, chule Bela (Zoar kitipa) galkon din akigong un twipi-thi phaicham achun gal asat uvin,
en_web: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
en_kjv: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar); and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim chule Bela leng ho akikhom’ un Siddim phaiya galbol din akigotauve.

tcz: Elam gam lengpa Chedorlaomer le Goiim lengpa Tidal toh, Shinar lengpa Amraphel toh chule Ellasar lengpa Arioch chutoh akisat uvin, hicheng leng li ho chun leng nga ho chu anadou un ahi.
en_web: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
en_kjv: with Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng nga hin Elam le Goiim, Babylon, Ellasal- leng li dou din agouve.

tcz: Amaho se gal akisat jou uchun Twipi-thi kol phaicham achun thih e meichang adim jengin ahi. Hichun Sodom lengpa le Gomorrah lengpa sepoi ho chu ajamdoh un, ama ho loi khat chu kotong sunga alut un, amaho lah a loikhat chu thing lhang lama ajam cheh tauve.
en_web: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.
en_kjv: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
tcz_gospelgo: Siddim phai hi bon- ngan bol adimset’ in, Sodom le Gomorrah lengpa galmun’ a kona ajam lhon le bolsunga alha lut lhontan, leng dang thum vang chu molsang lama ajamdoh tauve.

tcz: Gal hangsan mihat ho chun Sodom le Gomorrah alokhum un galman chah ho jouse chule neh le chah ho jouse akichom khomun ache tauve.
en_web: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
en_kjv: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng li honSodom le Gomorrah khopi sunga thilkeo ijakai, anneh geiyin akichom’ un achetauve.

tcz: Amaho chun Lot, Abram sopipa jong chu amanu vin Sodom a chengpa chu anei thil le agou jouse jong alah peh tauve.
en_web: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
en_kjv: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Sodom khoa cheng, Abram sopipa chapa, Lot jong gal- hingin akaiyui, athilkeo jouse jong akipoh thauve.

tcz: Hinlah Lot insung mite khat ana sohcha in, amapa chun Abram Hebrew mipa aga seipeh tai, hiche lai chun Abram chu Eshcol le Aner sopipa, Amorites mi Mamre gangpi thing phung vel dunga chun ana cheng nalaiye, amaho jong chu Abram toh ana pangkhom ahiuve.
en_web: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.
en_kjv: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal’ a hung jamdoh mi khat’ in thilsoh chengse hi Hebrew mi Abram jah a ahung seitai. Hichepet hin Abram hi Amor mi Mamre thingphung theng ho koma anachenge. Mamre’n sopi Eshcol le Aner aneiyin- Abram to pangkhom cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Hichun Abram in asopipa Lot kimat ajahdoh phat chun aman natoh tohgon ahin neitan, mihem ja thumle som le get phatah a galbol kithem chuhsa ama insunga peng cheh ahin lhengdoh in ama tah in alamkai yin amaho chu Kedarlaomer sepai ho chu Dan geiyin aga nungdel peh'in ahi.
en_web: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.
en_kjv: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopipa chapa min gal- hinga akaimang jeng ajah phat’ in Abramin ainsung mi galbol thei cheh akhop le, jathum le som le get alhingun, ama lamkai nan leng li ho chu Dan geiyin agadel peh-ui.

tcz: Hichun Abram in amaho chu ahom khenin jankim laitah in abulu'un Kedarlaomer sepai ho chu ajam cheh tauve, Abram in amaho sepai ho chu gamla tah anojam'in Damascus khopi sah lang Hobah chan geiyin agadel peh-uvin ahi.
en_web: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
en_kjv: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin asepaite chu aloi loiyin ahomkhenin, agalte chu janlaiyin anokhumin ajoutai, chu leDamascus sah lam, Hobah geiyin agadel jampeh-uve.

tcz: Hiti chun Abram injong asopipa Lot jong, athilkeo chengse toh, numeiho ahiuvin mipi ahiuvin abonchan ahin nungpui soh tai.
en_web: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
en_kjv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin asopipa chapa Lot le numei chapang joouse ahin puiyin, athilkeo anei agou chengse le athil chomdoh-u abonchan ahin nungpoh kit’e,

tcz: Abram chun Kedarlaomer chuleh apankhom pi leng ho aga jo a ahung kinungle lam chun Sodom lengpan Shaveh phaicham (Shaveh tichu lengpa phaicham tina ahi), achun alamto ding in ahunge.
en_web: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
en_kjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.
tcz_gospelgo: Chedorlaomer le leng dang ho agajao ahung kile kit chun ‘ lengpa phaicham’ kisah Shaveh phaiya Sodom lengpan Abram analamtoi.

tcz: Hichun Melchizedek Salem lengpa chule Pathen thempu chung-nung pen a pang pan Abram chu lengpitwi chuleh chang-lhah ahin poh peh e.
en_web: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
en_kjv: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chu le Pathen Chungnungpen Thempupa, Salem lengpa Melchizedek chun Abram din changlhah le lengpitwi ahinchoipeh- in,

tcz: Melchizedek in Abram chu hiti hin phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Van le leiset hin phutdoh a Pathen chungnung pen kom'a, Abram phattheiboh chang hen,
en_web: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
en_kjv: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Phatthei boh nan ajah a, “van le leiset sem, Chungnungpen Pathenin Abram phatthei boh hen’

tcz: Chule na galte nangma khut lum'a lousah a, chungnung pen Pathen chu loupi hen,” ati. Chuin Abram in Melchizedek chu thil jousea kon in hopsom a hopkhat khat apesoh keiye.
en_web: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
en_kjv: and blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
tcz_gospelgo: Nagalte josah Chungnungpen Pathen chu vahchoiyin um hen.’” ati. Abramin athil chomdoh jat hopsom a hop khat cheh Melchizedek apei.

tcz: Sodom lengpan Abram jah'a hitin aseiye, “Kanam mite na hentup ho chu nei nungpeh tan, amavang thilkeo ho chengse nang in na mat dohho vang chu nangma adin na kikoi theiye,” atile,
en_web: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
en_kjv: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom lengpan Abram henga, “Nathil chomdoh chengse chang denin lang, kamite vang neipen,” tin athum’e.

tcz: Abram in Sodom lengpa hitin adonbut in, “Van le leiset hin phutdoh Pakai Pathen chungnung pen koma kaki hahsel ahi tai,
en_web: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
en_kjv: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the Lord, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom lengpan jah a Abramin, “Van le leiset sem, Chungnungpen Pathen, Pakai angsunga khut tunga kihahselsa kahi,

tcz: Keiman patse jang khat cha hihen lang, kengchot khao jeng cha hijong leh nang thil kiti poupou khatcha kalah louhel ding ahi, nangman Abrham ka hao doh sah tai,” tia nasei thei louna ding in;
en_web: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
en_kjv: that I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Abram kahaosah-e,’ nati louna din, patse jang cha hihen, kengchot khao jang cha hijongle, nang thil pou pou laponge.

tcz: Ahin keiman ka lah ding chu gollhang hon aneh doh ule mihon ana nehchai hobou chu ahi, chule keiman ka dei lhen pentah chu ahile achen ding uva kilom thil le gouho chu kaloi ka mite Aner, Eshcol chule Mamre amaho petan.
en_web: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
en_kjv: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
tcz_gospelgo: Golhang ho nehdoh le kalhonpi ho lahdoh tilou adangima ding katipoi; kapanpi Aner le Eshcol chu le Mamre’ n vang achan ding dol kilah cheh-u hen,’ ati.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou nung hin; Pathen in gaovin Abram aki houlim pin hitin asei peh'e. “Abram imacha kicha hih in, ajeh chu keiman ka huhding; kipa man jong atam atam na chan ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
en_kjv: After these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Abramin mu anei pet’in Pakaiyin ajah a, “Kicha hih-in Abram, nang dial um a kisung kahin, kipaman tampi namu tei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Abram in adonbut in, “O Pakai Pathen loupi pen nangma phatna na phatthei hohi keiman chapa kanei poi, ajeh chu nangman chate ding nei peh lou jeh in, ka insung a soh a pang Eliezer Damascus amapa bou hin ka gou alo ding joh in aum tai.
en_web: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
en_kjv: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin, “Thaneitah Pakai, cha le nao neilou kei tobang dinga kipamaan chu ijajong phachom ding ham? Kagou jeng jong hi Damascus khoa Eliezerin alo ding dan ahibouve.

tcz: Pathen nang man keima chilhah ding a chikhai ding, neipe ta pon, hijeh a chu ka sohte lah a khat hin ka gou alo ding ahi tai.
en_web: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
en_kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
tcz_gospelgo: Cha la neihinsah pon, kasohte khat hin kanei le kagou jouse alo ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Pathen in ama chu ahoulim pin, “Ahipoi nangma soh hon na gou alo thei lou ding ahi, nangma a kona chapa um ding ama chun na gou alo ding ahi.”
en_web: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
en_kjv: And behold, the word of the Lord came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin ajah a, “Hiche soh Eliezer khun nanei nagou alo louhel ding, nachapa mong mongin nagou alo ding ahinai, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathenin Abram chu polama akou doh in aki hou pin, “Vanchung lam ven Ahsi ho khu simtem in nasim jou nah em? Hitobang chu ahi na chilhah atam ding dan chu,” ati.
en_web: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”
en_kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now towards heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin inpo lama apuidoh-in, “Van a ahsite khu gahsim gotemin; nason nachilhah jong hijat khu hung pha diu ahi, ;ati.

tcz: Chuin Abram in jong Pakaiya tahsan na dihtah in aneitan ahile hichu ama ding in dihchan nan akisimpeh tai.
en_web: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.
en_kjv: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: hichea khen beihel’a Abramin Pakai atahsan jeh chun, Pakai alung lhaiyin, them achansah tai.

tcz: Chujou vin Pathen in Abram ahoulimpi kit in, “Hiche gamhi nalo ding in na pe-ing'e tia Chaldea gam Ur khopia kona nangma na hin puidoh a Pakai chu keima kahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Abram jah a, “Babylon gam Ur khopia pat hinpuiya hiche gam nape goa Pakai chu Keima kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abram in adonbut in, “O Pakai ka Pathen hiche hi kalo ding ahi ti ipia iti kahet doh thei ding ham?” ati.
en_web: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
en_kjv: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin, “Thaneitah Pakai, hiche gam keiya ahiding chu iti kahet ding ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abram ahou lim pin ajah a, “Bongnou kum thum lhingsa khat toh, kelngoi chal kumthum lhingsa khat toh, chule vahui nou khat le vapal nou khat ka henga hin choi tan,” ati peh e.
en_web: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Take me a heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.
tcz_gospelgo: Adonbut nan Pakaiyin, “kumthum lhingsa cheh bongla khat le kel la khat chule kelngoi chal khat hinkaiyin, chule vakhu khat le vapal khat hinchoiyin hungin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abram in hichengse chu ape doh in athat in, hichun ahapsat cheh in, ahap lang ton alupsah in hinlah vacha ho vang chu asemkeh poi.
en_web: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
en_kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin gancha ho chu Pathen henga din ahinkaikhomin, athat’in ahapsat cheh-in, ahap Langton ajamin, vachate ni vang chu asemkeh poi.

tcz: Chuin muthongho ahung lenglhao vin hiche sa kikoi ho chu ane kigo uvin ahile Abram in muthongho chu anodoh jin ahi.
en_web: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
en_kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
tcz_gospelgo: Sa ho chu muthongten ahinvel tengu Abramin adeldohjie.

tcz: Chuin nisa alhum dingkon in Abram ahung imut soh tan, chu jongle tijat umtah muthim lhangkhal ahung jing in amapa chu ahin jinkhum tai.
en_web: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
en_kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa lhumsuh lamin Abram nguijen juntah-in a-ihmutsoh tan, chule tijat umtah muthim lhangkhal’in ahinjin khumtai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abram ahoulimpi in, “Nangman thonlou dinga nahet ding chu na chilhah hohi gam danga hung mah thah diu ahiye, amaho se chu kum jali sunga mi bol genthei thoh'a ga um ding ahiuve.
en_web: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
en_kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
tcz_gospelgo: chutah-in Pakaiyin Abram jah a, “Nason nachilhahte gam hi loubeh, kholgam khat’a khopem diu, gasoh changuva kum ja li sunga min genthei hesoh tah a abolgim diu ahi.

tcz: Ahin keiman hiche nam sugenthei ho chu ka phulah ding ahi, chule phat ahung sot a achaina teng amaho chu hatah a nei le gou ahin nei diu ahi.
en_web: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
en_kjv: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachilhah ho soh a vul nam mite chu ken talen kapah a, nachilhah hon nei le gou tampi kipoh a migam chu adalhah diu ahi.

tcz: Nangman vang lungmong sel'a na pute heng na jot ding, chule na kum lhing set'a na hinkho kichai a na kivui ding ahiye.
en_web: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
en_kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin hinkho nomtah naman’a, nateh thia kivui ding, napu napate heng najot ding ahi.

tcz: Chule amaho hi khangli ahung lhin phat le hiche gam'a hi hung ki nungle kit diu ahi, ajeh chu tuchan gei hin Amor mite khan gitlouna hi pilhing lou lai ahiye,” ati.
en_web: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
en_kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachilhahte hi khangli channa a hikoma hung kile kit diu ahi; ajeh chu tu chan geiyin Amor mite gitlouna akichai hih laiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin nisa alhum phat in mu athim tan ahile, meikhu belsung khat ah mei al-lenglung khat le meivah tobang khat ahung kitol in, hiche pi chu sa kihapsat a kikoi teni kah achun ahung kitol lelen ahi.
en_web: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche chu photlot louvin sahap kisat ho kah a chun ahung lengjap jengin ahi.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abram chu hitin a kihoulimpi in, kinoptona aneilhon in hiche nichun, “Keiman nason na chilhahte kapeh gam chu hiche hi ahi, Egypt gamgi apat luipi dung gei Euphrate vadung gei,
en_web: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
en_kjv: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho hin hikoma chun Pakaiyin Abram to kitepna asemin, “Keiman nason nachoilhahte chu hiche gam, Egypt gamgia pat Euphrates luipi dung gei,

tcz: Gamsung tutua Kenites, Kenizzites chule Kadmonites ten atoupha se,
en_web: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
en_kjv: the Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
tcz_gospelgo: Ken mite gam jouse pum, keniz mite gam gei; e Kadmon mite gam puma,

tcz: Hittites mite Perizzites mite chule Rephaites miten atoupha se,
en_web: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
en_kjv: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
tcz_gospelgo: Hit mite gam jong, Periz te gam, Rephaimite gam,

tcz: Amorites mite ahi-uvin, Canaan mite ahiuvin, Girgash miho ahi uvin, chule Jebus miho gam ahi uve,” ati.
en_web: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
en_kjv: and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
tcz_gospelgo: Amor mite gam gei, Canaan mite gam, Girgash mite gam le Jebus mite gam jouse puma kapeh dia kitep kahitai,” ati.

tcz: Tun Abram jinu Sarai chun cha anei thei tapon ahin lah Sarai chun Egypt mi soh numei khat ana neiyin amanu chu Hagar ahi.
en_web: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
en_kjv: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram jinu Saraiyin cha ahinpeh tapon, ahin Sarai hin Egypte numei Hagar chu soh-in anavul’e.

tcz: Chuin Sarai'in jong Abram jah a aseiye, “Ven Pakaiyin keila cha eihin sah tapon, lungset tah in ka sohnu koma ga lut tan; ijem itile amanua kona khu ka inchen dohsah thei nahi,” atile, Abram in jong Sarai thu angai tai.
en_web: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
en_kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the Lord hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Abram jah a, “Keila Pakaiyin cha neilouvin eikoitan, cha eihinpeh khat leh, kasoh nu-nugah khutoh galumkhomin,” ati. Sarai sei chu Abram anomtai.

tcz: Hichun Sarai Abram in-neipin Hagar chu apuiyin Abram ji din apetai, hiche phat laitah chu ahile Abram kum som Canaan na achen jou don ahi tai.
en_web: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
en_kjv: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Saraiyin asohnu Hagar chu Abram thaikem din apetai. Hiche hi Abram kum som jen Canaan gama achen nunga thilsoh ahi.

tcz: Hichun Abram toh Hagar chu akitimat lhon tan, chuin Hagar chun nao ahin vop tan hichun apinu Sarai chu noise tah in ahin vepan tan ahi.
en_web: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
en_kjv: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin Hagar agaluppi le amanu agaitai. Hagarin agai akihet phat’in akiletsah-in Sarai anoise boltan ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Sarai in Abram jaha aseitai, “Hiche ho jouse hi nang suhkhel ahi, ka sohnu hi nangma dannoiya ka koi ahin, Hinlah tuhin amanun nao avop tan keima noise tahin eive tan hijeh chun keile nang kah a Pakai thutan in hung pang jeng hen!” atitai.
en_web: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”
en_kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Saraiyin Abram jah a, “Hibanga eikinoisena gu hi nachunga chuhen! Kenba nakikoipi din kasohnu kapen, aman agai akihet phat’in eihiti noisetai. Koijoh moa dih am Pakaiyin ikah lhona thu hintan jeng hen!” ati.

tcz: Abram'in adonbut in “Ven amanu khu nasoh hilou ham, nangman pha nasah dungjuiyin bol tang em?” ati. Hichun Sarai in Hagar hatah in ahin sugenthei pantan hichun amanun (Hagar) ajamsan tai.
en_web: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
en_kjv: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
tcz_gospelgo: Abramin la Sarai jah a, “Nakhut’a um nasohnu chu me, nadei deiyin bol jeng tang-em,” atipeh-e. Hijeh chun Saraiyin Hagar chu thohda daa abolgim leh, ajammang lo tai.

tcz: Pakai Vantil in gamthip Gam'a twikhuh phungkhat'a Hagar chu aga mudoh in ahi, hiche twi khuh chu Shur jotna lampia um ah ahiye.
en_web: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
tcz_gospelgo: Shur jotna lampia twisam phung khat’a Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in Hagar akimupin,

tcz: Pakai Vantil chun aseiye, “Hagar, Sarai sohnu hoilanga kona hungsoh doh na him? Hoilam jon ding na him?” atile Hagar in adonbut in, “Kapi nu Sarai kom'a kon ahung jam doh kahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
en_kjv: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah a, “Sarai sohnu Hagar, hoiya kona hoilam jon ding nahim?” tin adong e. Hagarin, “Kapi Sarai dalha hung jam kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Vantil chun amanu ahoulimpi in, “Nangma na pinu kom'a kinungle in chule amanu dan noiya nakun angaiye.”
en_web: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun, “Napi henga kile kit’in asoh-in gapang kittah,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Vantil chun ahoulimpi na laiyin, “Keiman na chilhahte tamtah ka pehbe ding nahi, sim jong na sim joulou ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kon Vantil’in Hagar jah a hitin jong aseiye, “Keiman koima cha simsen lou son le pah kapeh ding na hi.

tcz: Pakai Vantil chun ahoulimpi nalaiyin, “Tua hi nangma naovop na hitan chapa khat nahin ding, hiche naosen chu amin Ishmael nasah ding ahi. (Pathen in angailhi jing'e tina ahi), ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin na gimna chu na khongai peh tai.
en_web: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa khat nahin ding ahin, hesoh a nataona Pakaiyin asanjeh a amin Ishamael nasah ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nachapa hi mihem laha gam'a sangan lungthim bei bang ding, mitin douna akhut hinlap a chule mitin khut ama chunga hung chu ding, chuleh aphunggol jouse toh kido toa hung khosa ding ahi.”
en_web: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”
en_kjv: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachapa vang chug am sa-ngan ngol’a ngol ding, mitin adouva, mijousen ama aledou diu; ainsung mite to kikhena chang chen ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Hagar in ajah a thu hin sei Pakai chu amin in asah peh in, “Nangma hi keima eimudoh a Pathen na hi,” ati. Ajeh chu amanu'n “Tahbeh monga keiman Pathen kamu a chule ama ka mu nunga ka hing'a ka um nah lai ham?” atin ahi.
en_web: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
en_kjv: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
tcz_gospelgo: Hagarin ajah a thusei Pakai chu aminin akouvin, “Mi mudoh thei Pathen nahi,” ati. Ajeh chu, “Tahbeh monga ken Pathen kamua ahivanga hing nalai kahim?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Twisam putna chu amin Beerlahairai asah tai, hichu Twikhuh hi Kadesh le Bered kikah aum ah ahiye.
en_web: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
en_kjv: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a hi mihon Kadesh le Bered kikah a twikul chu, “Eimudoh a Hing jing Pa twikul,” atiu ahi.

tcz: Hichun Hagar in Abram chapa khat ahin peh tai. Hichun Abram in achapa min chu Ishmael asah tai.
en_web: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
en_kjv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
tcz_gospelgo: Hagarin Abram chapa khat ahinpeh-in, Ishmael asah-e.

tcz: Hagar in Abram ding'a Ishmael ahin peh chun Abram chu kum som get le kum gup alhing tan ahi.
en_web: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
en_kjv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin Abram kum somget le gup alhing tai.

tcz: Abram chu kum somko le kumko alhin in Pathen in ahoulimpi in hitin aseipeh e, “Keima Elshaddai Pathen chungnung kahi. Hijeh chun lunglhaisel in nei hou jing in lang, chule thenna hinkho mang jing in,” ati.
en_web: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
en_kjv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram kum somko le ko alhinin ahenga Pakai ahung kilah-in ajah a, “Keima Hatchungnung Pathen kahi, kathunnungin thildih bol’in.

tcz: Keiman nangma to ikikah a kitepna nape ing ka-ting hichu thonlou hela nangma chilhah simsen lou kapeh ding nahi.
en_web: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
en_kjv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangto Kitepna kasema, nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abram in amai tol lang aven hichun Pathen in ahin hou vin hitin aseiye,
en_web: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
en_kjv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Abram tol’a abohkhup jengle, Pathenin ahenga,

tcz: Hiche hi keima le nangma kinop tona ahi, keiman nangma hi nam jouse mipa kaso ding nahi ati.
en_web: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
en_kjv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche hi nahenga kakitepna ahi: Chitin namtin penna pa nahi ding;

tcz: Abanna jong na min jong kakhel peh ding, Abram nahi tahlou ding, Hinlah nangma hi Abraham na kiti ding ahi tai, ajeh chu nangma hi nam jouse mipa nahi ding ahi tai.
en_web: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
en_kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
tcz_gospelgo: namin jeng jong Abram hitalouva Abram* hiding ahi, ajeh chu chitin namtin penna paa kasem nahi.

tcz: Keiman nangma hatah a kaga sah ding, na lolhin ding na chilhah ten nam tamtah ahin sondoh diu, chule leng thupitah tah jong amaho lah a hung umdoh ding ahiye.
en_web: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
en_kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachilhah mihem hapuna kapunsah a, abang bang jong leng le lal hung chang diu, nason napah tam behseh jenga nam lentah tah hungsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman athah a nangma to iki noptona chu na chilhahte to kaki tepna avela ka phudoh kit ding nangma nunga na chilhahte a dinga jong, khang le khang kikah ajong, hiche hi atonsot'a hiding, keima na Pathen nu kahi jing ding chule nanam, na chilhahte Pathen jong kahi jing ding ahi.
en_web: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
en_kjv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nang le khonung geiya nachilhahte, akhang khanga, tonsot teiya kakitepna chu kanit jing ding ahi. Nang Pathen jong kahiya, nachihlhahte Pathen jong kahi ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman Canaan gam pumpi ahin, tua nachen na gam kholjin banga nachen nau hi nason na chilhahte atonsot a goulo dinga ka peh ding, chule amaho dinga jong a Pathen'u kahi jing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
en_kjv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua nakhopemna gamsung hi nang le nachilhahte kapeh ding; Canaan gam pumpi hi chilhah mite changuva, tonsot geiya apua pang diu, chu le Keima a-pathenu kahi ding ahi, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abraham ahoulimpi in, “Nangma tah in jong kinopto na hi na jui ding, chule na nunga nason na chilhahte dinga jong akhang lhum kei uva ajui ding'u ahi.
en_web: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
en_kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Abram jah a Pathenin, “Nahenga kakitepna hi nang nahin, khonunga nachilhah ho hijongle nanit soh kei diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi ahi kinopto na nangma le na chilhahte jousen ajui cheh ding, nangho lah a pasal jousen chep akitan soh kei ding'u ahi.
en_web: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
en_kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang le na chilhah ten na lah-uva pasal jouse chep natan cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Nangman na bollou a hitheilou chu na tahsa vun val abohlai chu na chelhah soh kei ding, hichun avetsah chu ahile keima le nangma kikah a ki nopto na hijing ding ahi.
en_web: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
en_kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
tcz_gospelgo: I-kah lhon a kitepna het jingna dia nangin chep natan ding,

tcz: Hiche hi nangma insung mite seh hilou vin, koi tobang nasoh na kol nangma insunga dinga na choh doh ho jouse jong ahop tha cheh ding,
en_web: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
en_kjv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
tcz_gospelgo: nakhang lhumkeiyuva, nachilhah insunga pengden mong hihen, suma kicho soh-midang hijongle, pasal jouse chu niget lhin nia chep natan cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Abonchauva chep na kitan cheh diu, na tahsa uva maha na poh u-chu keima toh atonsot na iki nopto na'uva umjing ding ahiye.
en_web: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
en_kjv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung pengden hihen soh a kicho hijongle pasal jouse chap natan diu ahi. Hitia hi kakitepna chu natahsa vuna naput’uva, tonsot’a um jing jeng ding ahi.

tcz: Koi tobang pasal khat tou hiche kinopto na cheptan hi bol lou aumle ama chu kinopto na insunga kon'a paimanga um ding ahi, ajeh chu kinopto na ajuilou jeh ahi.
en_web: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
en_kjv: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Keito kitepna suhkeh a chep tanlou pasal koi hileh kamite lah a kisimtha louhel ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abraham ahoulimpi in “Sarai na Inneipi Sarai na ti tahlou ding ahi, ijeh inem itile amanu min jong hi tua patna Sarah hiding ahi tai.
en_web: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.
en_kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham jah a Pathenin, “Najinu min Sarai tilouva, tukal Sarah natijohding ahitai.

tcz: Keiman amanu hi phatthei kaboh a chu jongle ama nu akon a hi chapa khat kapeh ding nahi, hitia chu keiman amanu hi phatthei kaboh a ama jong “Sarah” chitin namtin nu hung hi ding mitin vaipi leng ding ho jeng jong amanu akona hung peng doh ding ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
en_kjv: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hi ken phatthei kaboh teng, chitin namtin penna nu hung hi ding, chule achilhahte lah a leng le lal jong hung pengdoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham jong akun in tol lang aven anui tai, chuin alungthim in amale ama akihou vin, Keima hi kum jakhat kahi nunga mipa kahi thei ding ham? Chule ka inneipi Sarah jong kum som ko le kum ko ahi jouva naosen iti anei thei ding ham? ati.
en_web: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
en_kjv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham tol’a aboh khup’in, “Kum jakhat lhingsa pasal’in cha anei mong ding hiya, kum somko nunga Sarah-in cha anei thei mong ding ham?” tia agel le, amoh nuijat lo tai.

tcz: Abraham'in Pathen heng'a asei in, “Ahi thei ding le Ishmael hi nangma phattheibohna noiya um jing tahen.”
en_web: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
en_kjv: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin Pathen koma, “Ishameal chu kagou nalosah jengle iti-am?” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in adonbut in, “ahipoi Sarah na inneipi in nangma adinga chapa khat nahin peh ding, nangman hiche chapang chu amin Isaac nasah ding ahi. Chule keiman amale ama nunga ason achilhahte dinga kinopto na chu atonsot geiya kinopto na a umjing dinga kaphu doh ding ahi.
en_web: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
en_kjv: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathenin, “Ahipoi. Najinu Sarah hin chapa khat nahinpeh tei tei ding, amin Issac nasah ding ahi. Kakitepna chu ama le achilhahte dinga, tonsot geiya kanit jing ding ahi. Hichu kitepna guitan mo ahi.

tcz: Ishmael jong chu phatthei kaboh ding nangman nathum ma bang'a , ama jeng jong hatah a kapun sah ding, chule ama chilhahte ho jong hatah a pung dingu ahi.
en_web: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
en_kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
tcz_gospelgo: Ishamael ding nasei jong kahenai, phatthei kaboh a cha le nao son leh pah tampi kapeh ding, lengvai pothei cheh pasal som le ni ahin ding, achilhah mite nam lentah kaso ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keima kitepna vang chu Sarah in khovei tulai phat'a hi nahin ding Isaac chuto bou ka phudoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
en_kjv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla khovei tulai phat’a Sarah-in ahinding nachapa Issace chunga bou kakitepna kaphudoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pathen in thu aseijou phat chun Abraham chu adalhatai.
en_web: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
en_kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham jah a thu aseisoh phat’in Pathen chu akaltoutai.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in jong achapa Ishmael ahin, asoh pasal ama insunga peng den hihen, sum a achoh tho hi jongle, Abraham mite lah a pasal jouse chu apuikhom in, Pathen'in aseipeh bang bang chun hiche nikho mama chun chep atan peh soh kei in ahi.
en_web: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
en_kjv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin Pathen thusei anit’in achapa Ishmael leh a-insung mi pasal jouse, a-insunga pengden hihen suma achoh ho hijongle, soh pasal geiyin, hiche nikho le le chun chep atanpeh soh keiye.

tcz: Abraham'in chep akitan chun akum kum som ko le kum ko ana lhing tai.
en_web: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
en_kjv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
tcz_gospelgo: Chep akitan chun Abraham kum somko le ko alhingtai,

tcz: Chule achapa Ishmael in chep akitan chun kum som le kum thum ana lhing tan ahi.
en_web: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
en_kjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
tcz_gospelgo: achapa Ishmael kumsom le thum alhinge.

tcz: Ani lhon in Abraham le achapa Ishmael chu nikhat na chep tan lhon gel ahi.
en_web: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
en_kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
tcz_gospelgo: Anilhonin nikhat’in chep akitan lhonin,

tcz: Chule a insunga pasal jouse, insunga pengden hihen lang gam dang mi soh dinga akichoh tho hi jongle aboncha amatoh tha khat'a chep kitan thah cheh ahiuve.
en_web: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
en_kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham soh pasal jouse jong ahiuve.

tcz: Mamre munna gangpi phung komma chun Pakai chu Abraham henga ahung kilah in ahi. Nikhat hi nichangsat pettah hin Abraham chu aponbuh maiya ana touvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
en_kjv: And the Lord appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
tcz_gospelgo: Mamre thingphung theng mun achenna a, nisa hahsat jeh a ponbuh kotphungbul’a atoupet’in Abraham henga Pakai ahung kilah-in,

tcz: Ama ahung dahdoh in ahile akomma mithum ana din amun ahi. Amaho chu amu phat in ama alhai jel in amaho lemnan tol ah abohkhup in ahi.
en_web: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
en_kjv: and he lift up his eyes and looked, and lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
tcz_gospelgo: Abramham akhodaa agahvet leh, pasal thum anadinguve. Amu mun alamdot din alhaidoh paiye. Tol’a aboh khup’in,

tcz: Chuin Abraham'in “Ka Pakai,” tin adonbut in, “Nanghon pha nasah uleh phat chomkhat naki ngah thei diu ham.
en_web: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
en_kjv: and said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
tcz_gospelgo: “Kapu, nang jen dia hikoma ki-uma, ka-in hopa louvin neijot pai hih beh-in.

tcz: Nakeng sil na ding'u kahin choi kah in hiche thing limnoiya hin ana kicholdo ta diu vin.
en_web: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
en_kjv: let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
tcz_gospelgo: Nakeng dopna diu twi hindom ing ting, hikom thingphung noiya hin kicholdo’uvin.

tcz: Chule nang hon na lhacha pa hi khoto na neitah a nei hungvil ngal'u ahi leh na kholyin na mano masang in na tha kido na ding un naneh ding'u them khat nahin gon peh ing nge, ama hon aphai, nasei bang chun hin bol tan ati uve.
en_web: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
en_kjv: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that you shall pass on: for therefore are you come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-in hinhopa ngal tauva, ikhat beh jong bolpeh ung ting, najin nauva natha nei theina diuvin na kamkhat beh jong nehsah unge,” ati. Miho chun, “Kipa aume, naseibangin hinboltan,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Abraham chu apon buh kom langa alhai jel'in Sarah kom ah asei tan ahi, “Kinloi tah in changbong ate na dimthum tedoh in lang twi to mehnang in, chule changlhah hin keng loi tem in,” aga tin ahi.
en_web: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
en_kjv: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungkin tah-in Abraham ponbuh sunga alut’in Sarah jah a, “Nachangbonh neldi phapen dip’a konin atena thum tedoh-in, changlhah phabep hinkang loi temin,” agatin;

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in gancha ho kivah na lang ajon in bongnou athao pen asohte ho apen, gangtah in ahin hon sah in ahi.
en_web: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
en_kjv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
tcz_gospelgo: chuin bonghon lah a alut’in bongnou hoisel athao khat amanin, sohpa khat apen, aman jong athat’in ahon min loutai.

tcz: An neh ding ho amin phat in Abraham'in bongnoi ha le bongnoi toh chule bongnou sa ahon u-chu amaho angsung ah aneh diuvin aga lui peh in amaho anneh laisen ama jong thinglim a chun ading jinge.
en_web: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
en_kjv: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin bongnoi le theilhum kihal, bongnoi twi chule bongnousa minsa chutoh ahindomin, miho angsunga aluiyin, thingphung noiya chun aneh laiseuvin amatah ajenlen apange.

tcz: Chuin ama hon Abraham jah'a “Na loinu Sarah hoilam a um aham?” atiu leh Abraham'in ponbuh sunga aum nai ati.
en_web: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
en_kjv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Abraham jah a, “Najinu Sarah la?” atiuleh; aman, “Ponbuh sunga khun aum nai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amaho lah a khat chun aseiyin, “Keima hi khovei tulai phat mama le kahung ki nungle kit ding ahi, vetan hiche phatteng chule na inneipi Sarah khun chapa khat ana hin ding ahi,” ati chu anunga ponbuh sunglam a um Sarah chun angai lhin ahi.
en_web: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
en_kjv: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jinpan, “Khovei tulai phat, nahenga kahung kit teng le najinu Sarah-in chapa khat ahinding ahi,” ati. Anung, ponbuh kotpunga chu Sarah uma angai lhih ahi.

tcz: Abraham le Sarah chu atahsa kum lhon chu atam gel lhon tan, chule Sarah jong nao nei phat kum akhel ahi tai.
en_web: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
en_kjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham le Sarah ateh lheh lhontan, Sarah chu athinei jong atangtai.

tcz: Hichun Sarah guhthim in ama le ama aki nuisat in hitin aseiye, “Iti hithei ding ham, kei tobang aching sa numeiyin kipana thilpha kamu ding ham, ka jipa jeng jong akum atam lheh tai,” ati.
en_web: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
en_kjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Sarah-in Alungthimin, “The nung voi nunga kitimatna ki nei jongle anopje jong imlou ding, kajipa jong tehse voisa hilou haimo?”ati.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham jah achun aseiye, “Ipi dinga Sarah khu nuiya ka teh nunga keiman cha kanei tahbeh mong ding hi nam,” ati ham?
en_web: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin Abraham jah a, “I-bol’a Sarah nuiya, ‘The nung voi nunga cha kaneibeh ding hinam?’ati ham?

tcz: Pakai Pathen ading'a ipi ahahsa umham? keima khovei tulai phat na kahung kit ding chule Sarah in cha pasal khat anei ding ahi.”
en_web: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
en_kjv: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai dia ipi ahah sa um am? Kaseisa banga khovei tulai phat le ka hung teng Sarah-in chapa khat ahin ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Sarah chu atija tan hichun Sarah in aseilep tan, “Keima ka nuipoi” atin ahin la, “Pathen in adonbut in nangma na nui nai,” ati.
en_web: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
en_kjv: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Sarah akichan akilep’in, “Nuibon kinui louva,” ati. Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Ahinpoi, nanui nai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun pasal thum hochu an aneh jou un ading doh un Sodom lang chu galdot un, ama hon adalha uvin, Abraham chu amaho thah doh ding tin lampi gei aga kilhonpin ahi.
en_web: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
en_kjv: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho akipatdoh-un Sodom khopi gah vetsah theina mun khat ajon’uve; Abraham jong alhadoh diuvin amaho akilhonpi.

tcz: Pathen chun aseiye, “Keiman katoh gon hohi Abraham kom a kasei lou ding ham?” ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Kathil bolgot hi Abraham impehda tange.

tcz: Ajeh chu Abraham chu len tah le nam hattah chule vannoi ja nam jouse Abraham jeh a phatthei chang ding ahi ngal'in,
en_web: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
en_kjv: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu ason achilhah mite nam hattah le nasatah hung hiya, amajeh a chitin namtin ken phatthei boh ngal ding chu.

tcz: Chule achapate le ama ban a ainsung mi aman thu apeh a, chutia chu adih abol theiyu va, thu adih a atan thei na dinguva Pakai lampi ajui thei uva, chuteng le Pakaiyin Abraham chung chang'a akitep nasa chu ahin molso theina dinga ama hi kilheng doh ahiti la ka henan,” ati.
en_web: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
en_kjv: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Acha anao, ason achilhah miten kathu angaiyuva thildih le akitoh abol theina diuva hil dinga ama kilhengta. Achilhahten kathu angaivu le ken kathutep aboncha kabolpeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Abraham ahoulimpi in “Sodom le Gomorrah douna thu kisei asangval tan chule achonset nau jong ase val tai,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun Abraham jah a Pakaiyin, “Sodom le Gomorrah dounan thuse akihasei behseh tan, achonset nau jong aval thanghoitai.

tcz: Keima che suh ing kating ka henga thu hung kisei dungjuiya hi abol cheh'u ham, ahilou ham gapho chen inge,” ati.
en_web: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
en_kjv: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
tcz_gospelgo: Chesuh ing ting asset nau kisei chengse atah ajou gapho chen tange,” ati.

tcz: Hichun miho chu chukom akon in aki heiyun Sodom lang chu ajon un ache tauve, ahin lah Abraham chu Pakai masanga chun ading chah den jing in ahi.
en_web: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
en_kjv: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nin chukom adalhan Sodom lang ajon lhontai; Pakaiyin vang Abraham aumpi.

tcz: Abraham'in Pathen chu anailut in hitin aseiye, “Nangman michonpha atheng chule mi phalou agilouho aboncha nasuh mang tha ding ham,” ati.
en_web: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
en_kjv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Abrahamin Pakai anailut’in ajah a, “Mona beiho chu chonsete toh nasuhgam tha tahbeh ding ham?

tcz: Ijem tin khopi sunga chun michonpha som nga bang um ta le, asunga michonpha som nga ho jal'a jong chu akhomun chu khen dehlou hela nasuh mang jeng ding ham?
en_web: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
en_kjv: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
tcz_gospelgo: Ijemtia khopia khun themmona bei mihem som nga um jongle akho pumpin nasugam nah nah dem? Mihem som nga um jongle akho pumpin nasugam nah nah dem? Mihem som nga huhdohna khopi chu na hinghoi lou ding ham?

tcz: Nang dinga hitobang thil nabol a, michonpha le migilou agoma natha cheh a, michonpha le migilou akibah ding chu bolda hel jengle chun kati! Leiset thutan pan adih a atan lou ding ham?” atile.
en_web: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
en_kjv: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin midih le migilou kibanga nabol’a nathagel ding, akikhetna beiya nabol ding vang bolda hel le chun kadeiye! Leiset pumpi thutan Pan adih a atan lou ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen'in adonbut in, “keiman mi somnga thudih thilpha bol Sodom khopi a kamu doh theile, amaho jal'a chu khopi kahuhdoh ding ahi.”
en_web: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Sodom khopia themmona bei mihem som nga bang kamudoh joule, amaho jal’a kho pumpi kahinghoi ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in asei kit in, “Ka Pakai nangman neiphal peh thei dingle kasei ban ho kajom nom in keima vang bohse vutvai tobang kahin,
en_web: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
en_kjv: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin asei kit’in “Pakai, imacha lou, leivui le meivam bep ken ngamtah a na henga thu kaseijom kit ding jeh-in nei-ngaidamin.

tcz: Ijem tin mi somli le nga tobang chonpha mitheng mi som nga sanga lhomjo namu le amaho jeh'a chu khopi hi nasuh mang ding ham, mi nga lhahsam jeh chun, Pathenin adonbut in, Keiman hiche khopi a hi mi som li le nga kamu doh jouva ahile sumang ponge,” ati.
en_web: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
en_kjv: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
tcz_gospelgo: Khosunga chun themmona bei mihem som nga lhing lel hen som li le nga she umta leh, midih nga lhahsam jeh chun kho pumpi nasugam jeng dem?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Midih som li le nga ka mudoh le khopi chu sugam ponge, “tin adonbut’e.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in adeichat angaichat avel in aseiyin, “Ijem tin mi som li bou umta le,” atin chuin Pakaiyin ahoulimpi kit in, “Keiman amaho mi somli jeh a chu kasuh manglou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
en_kjv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham, “Ijemtin somli she hile la?” tin adonge. Pakaiyin, “Som li she um jongle khopi chu sumang ponge,” ati.

tcz: Ka Pakai lungset tah in lung hanglou jenin, Abraham atao kit leovin, neiphal peh theile chun kasei nom na laiye, Ijemtin mi som thum muta le chun,” atile Pakai Pathen in ahoulimpi in “Keiman mi somthum hijong le ka suhmang lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham, “Pakai, lung himo hih beh-in, kasei kit nom’e. Ijemtin somthum sehseh umta leh?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Somthum jeng kamu jongle bolda tange, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in aseikit in, “Nangman neiphal peh theile ka thusei hi ka jom nome, Ijem tin mi som ni hi jongle atile,” Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Mi somni kamu jongle ka suhmang lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
en_kjv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin, “Pakai, imacha lou, leivui le meivam bep ken ngamtah a nahenga thu kaseijom kit ding jeh-in nei-ngaidamin. Ijemtin midih som ni seh bou umta leh?” tin adong kitleuve. Pakaiyin, “Som ni she kamudoh jongle khopi chu sumang ponge,” ati.

tcz: Abraham'in achaina in asei peh tan, “Ka Pakai Pathen nei lung han hih beh in lang, khatvei neisei sah kit le tia katao ahi, mi som muta le chun” hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Mi som kamu doh jongle kasuh manglou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
en_kjv: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin, “Lung hang hih beh-in Pakai, khatvei seh bou gah sei kit tading’e. Midih som khatseh bou kimudoh le la?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Midih som khatseh um jongle sumang ponge,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham henga athusei dingin aboncha aseisoh phat'in Pakai chu ache tai; Abraham vang chu a in mun lam a ahung kile kit tai.
en_web: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
en_kjv: And the Lord went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham to akihou jouvin Pakai chu achemangtai, chule Abraham jong in lama ahung kile tan ahi.

tcz: Hiche ni nilhah lam in vantil ni ahung lhon in ahile Lot chu Sodom khopi kelkot a anatou pet ahin Lot in vantil teni amu phat chun alamto dingin akipat don in amani masanga tol ah abohkhup'in ahi.
en_web: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
en_kjv: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil te ni chu Sodom khopia ahung lhun lhon le lot chu khopi kelkot phunga anatouve. Amani amu phat’in Lot chun agalamtoi. A-ang sung lhona aboh khup’in,

tcz: Chuin Lot in hitin aseiye, “Ka Pakai hung un ka insunga nakeng hung kisop lhonin, chule tujan kain a geh lhon inlang, jingpi matah in thou lhon in lang na kholche na lhon aban na jom thei lhon ahi,” atile, amanin ahi poi hithei ponte ati lhon in “Keini tujan hiche mun a ong dunga geh mai lhon tange,” ati.
en_web: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
en_kjv: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pu te ni, hikoma nangni kinbol dia umah kahi; ka-in a hung lhung lhonin. Keng kisil lhonin natin nage khovah thei lhon ahi. Jingpi tah-in thou lhonin natin chepai lhon nan nate,” ati.Amani adan, “Ahipoi, kholai dunga geh khovah lhon tange, “ati lhontai.

tcz: Hinlah Lot in aha sei behset jeh chun amani jong Lot in lang a geh din ache tauve, hichun Lot in amani neh ding chol kisolou changlhah akanpeh in amani in jong ane lhon tai.
en_web: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
en_kjv: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot ín amani chu ahajolten phat’in anom lhonin, Lot in lam ajontauve. Maljin te ni dinga changlhah kanpeh a anneh tuitah sempeh din Lot’in alhacha ho asol’in ahi. Lhachahon neh asem jou phat’uvin an anetauve.
