tcz: Hinlah anehjou don khojin masang chun Sodom khopi sunga khangthah, tehse, kiti jouse ahung kikhom un amaho gena in chu aum kimvel tauvin ahi.
en_web: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
en_kjv: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
tcz_gospelgo: Maljin ten in lupna ajot masangin, khopi sung mihon in chu ahin-umtauve, In umho lah a khosung gollhang upa apang soh keiyuve.

tcz: Amaho chun Lot henga asam tauvin “Nangma koma ageh dinga hungho chu hoilam a nakoi hitam? amani chu hinpui doh in amani chutoh ka lupkhom diu ahi tin athum tauve.”
en_web: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
en_kjv: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Lot ahinkouvun, “Tujan na-in a geh dia hung te ni chu hoiya um lhon tam? Hinpuidoh loiyin, numei bol’a kabol diu ahi!” tin asamtauve.

tcz: Hichun Lot chu ahung pot doh in amaho toh kihoulim din, anung lam a kot chu akhah in ahi.
en_web: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
en_kjv: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
tcz_gospelgo: Lot apotdoh-in kotpi anungkhan,

tcz: “Lungset tah in sopite ho” tin ama atao tan, “Hitobang thilphalou hi bolda uvin.”
en_web: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
en_kjv: and said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
tcz_gospelgo: miho jah a, “Golle paite, hitobang lom hin khang gilou hih beh-uvin!

tcz: Veuvin Keiman chanu nungah thengsel ni kaneiye. Keiman ka chanu teni hin puidoh ing ting nangho koma, amani chu nadei dei a nabol theiyu ahi.
en_web: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
en_kjv: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
tcz_gospelgo: Veuvin, pasalto kitimat louhel lai chanu nu kaneiyin, anin hinpuidoh peh-uving ting nanop nop’in bol jengun, maljin te ni vang imacha lodauvin, ka-in a hung lhung kamaljin ahilhon bouve,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah amahon Lot chu “Kinung chen,” ati uvin, chu jongle amahon aseiyun “Hiche pa hi ahung khopem len chule eiho thutanna pang ding akigo vehta! tua amaho (Vantil teni), ki gim bol na ding sanga nangma agilou cheh a kabol ding'u nahi,” atiuve. Hitichun Lot chu hatah in anouvin kotpi jong chu phutjal ding in ahin go tauve.
en_web: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.
en_kjv: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla amahon ahoh lhauvin, “nei ot’un khopempa! I-tobang mi nahiya keiho toh ding neihil leu ham? Nei ot’uvin, ajo le amani sanga melse cheh a nang kabol lo diu ahi,” ati tauve. Hiti hin Lot chu anung sot’un, kotpi phung phujal ding akigotauve.

tcz: Hichun vantil teni chun Lot chu akhut na aman lhon in akailut lhonin insunga kot chu akhah tauve.
en_web: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
en_kjv: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in insunga um ten in Lot chu akailut loi lhonin, kotpi akhah lhontai.

tcz: Hichun vantil teni chun kotpi phunga miho chu ateh jong akhangthah jong abonchauvin amit'u achosah lhon in ahile abonchauvin kotphung holmon akisu lungdong gam tauve.
en_web: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
en_kjv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great; so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
tcz_gospelgo: Kotphunga um mi alen aneo abonchauva Vantil ten in amit’u achotsah lhon leh, suhna ding helouvin akimaitho gamtauvin ahi.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou vin vantil teni chun Lot jah a hitin asei lhon e, “Hiche khopi a hi sopi ule nao adang nanei nahlai em? na chanu jipa ho hihen, na chapate hihen, na chanu ho hihen lang koi dang dang hi jong le hiche khopi sunga nangma mi poupou chu abonchauvin hiche mun akon hin pui dohtan.”
en_web: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
en_kjv: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi ten in Lot jah a, “Hiche khosunga hi heng le kom-chanu chapa, tu le cha-adang koi koi nanei nah laiyam? Abonchauvin puidoh loidoh loiyin;

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche khopi hi pumsuh mang ding kati lhon ahi tai. Awgin hung kithong hi aphatmo na alen lheh tan Pathen kom ahin pha tai, chujeh a chu keini hi asumang dia eihin sol lhon ahi.
en_web: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”
en_kjv: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu hiche mun hi kasuh mang lhon ding a hitai. Hiche miho dounaa thuse melse tah kisei chengse chu Pakaiyin ajadoh tan, hijeh a chu Sodom sumang dia eihinsol lhon ahi,” ati lhone.

tcz: Hijeh chun Lot chu apot doh in achanute ni jipa ding teni jah a chun, “Kinloi tah in hiche khopi akon hin potdoh loi lhon in, ajeh chu Pakaiyin hiche khopi asuhmang ding ahi tai,” aga ti leh, achanu teni jipa ding teni chun a tot dan in ana gel lhon e.
en_web: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
en_kjv: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get ye out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in achanu te nit oh kitepsa pasalte henga Lot achen, “Kapat’un hikoma konin jamdoh loiyun; mun hi Pakaiyin asuhmang ding ahitai,” agate. Ahinla amanin atot danin anagel lhon’e.

tcz: Kho ahung vahlhah a jingkah chun vantil teni chu ahung kino lheh lhon tan, “Gang in Lot,” tin asei peh lhon e, “na jinu chule na chanute pui doh in hikom akon in pot doh'in tutu hin achuti louleh nangma hiche khopi toh'in suhmang tha a na um ding ahiye,” ati lhon e.
en_web: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
en_kjv: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah khovah lhah-in Vantil te nin Lot anoloi lhonin, “Khopi hitoh nakisuh mang tha louna diuvin, nachanu te ni le najinu kipuiyin jamdoh loiyun,” ati lhon’e.

tcz: Lot chu akhongai na laiyin, vantil teni chun ama khut, ajinu khut, chule achanute ni khut na aman lhon in khopi pam lam ah ajamdohpi lhon in ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in amaho angailut lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
en_kjv: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot akinomsot nah lai vangin, Pakaiyin akhohsah jeh-in, Vantil te nin akhut’in akai lhonin, ajinu le achanu te ni pumin khopi pamlama alhoh doh lhontai.

tcz: Amaho khopi pam langa ahin puidoh lhon phat in Vantil teni in thu amop in “Naki hinso thei na dingu vin jam dohloi jin hung jong hung kinung hei hih uvin phaicham dunga jong bangpa hihhel uvin, thinglhang lam'a jam doh loiyun achuti louleh nangma jong suhmanga na um tha khah ding ahi,” ati peh lhon e.
en_web: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil khat chun, “Nathi louna diuvin jamdoh loiyun! Kinung hei hih-un, phaicham dunga jong kibangpa hih hel’uvin, thinglhang gam a jamlut’uvin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Lot chun amani jah'a “Ahipoi ka Pakai,” atin!
en_web: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
en_kjv: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Lot’in adonbut’in, Ahipoi kapu, thing lhang lama neisol dauvin.

tcz: Nangman neina ngailu lheh in chule ka hinkho jong neina huhdoh in chukeo hilouvin ngailut na sangtah jong nei musah in, Hinlah molsang langa kache jou lou ding ahiye, thinan eiphah lo ding ahi, ka hinkho kichai ding ahi.
en_web: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
en_kjv: behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
tcz_gospelgo: Khohsah tah a kahinkho bon huhhing ta, thing lhang lam agamla behseh-in, kalhun masanga manthah nan eihin lap den’a kathi den ding ahibouve.

tcz: Vetem in khoneo phai-cham khat muthei in aum'e, jamlut nading in abailam in chule naicha bou ahi; ka kihinso na ding in lungsettah in hikom a khun nei jamlut sah tan,” ati.
en_web: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
en_kjv: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven hiche khopi khu, naicha bou ahi, hikoma khun neijamlut sah-in, khopi neocha ahivanga hoidohna thei ahinai,” ati.

tcz: Vantil in adonbut in “aphai tua nasei jong hi nanop peh ingting, chule keiman hiche phaicham gam'a um khopi nasei jong khu sumangda tange.
en_web: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
en_kjv: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun, “Aphai, hiche khopi khu suhmangda tange.

tcz: Ahin kino gang un, jamdoh loijun, Ajeh chu keiman ima ka bolthei lou ding nangma ho khulam na lhun kahseu vin,” (Hiche in avetsah ahil chet chu khopi min chu Zoar kiti ahin hiche chu ahile khomun neocha tina ahi).
en_web: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
en_kjv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
tcz_gospelgo: Man-gangin! Lhaiyin! Khukom nalhun ma imacha kabol thei l ou ding ahi,” atipeh-e. Khopi neo tinaa amin Zoar kisah ahitai.

tcz: Lot Zoar mun agah lhun chun jingkah nisa hungso doh jou tah ahi.
en_web: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
en_kjv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot Zoar kho alhunin nisa ahung soh tai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in vanthamjolla konin meikong chule hui thanei thina thei akongthei hui Sodom le Gomorrah chunga ajuh sah tai.
en_web: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.
en_kjv: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;
tcz_gospelgo: Phot lot louvin van a Pakaiya konin, Sodom le Gomorrah chunga Pakaiyin Kath le meikong goju bangin ajuhsah-in,

tcz: Chule Pathen in khopi teni jong, phaicham geiya akhopi teni sunga cheng jouse ahin, tolla kehdoh thingna louna abonchan asugam hel tai.
en_web: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
en_kjv: and he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: phaicham pumpi le khopi te ni, asunga cheng mihem jouse le tol’a keh thingna louna jouse geiyin asugamhel tai.

tcz: Hinlah Lot Inneipi chu aki nunghei jin anunglam agah vet leh chiphung asoh in khom bang in akitung den tai.
en_web: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
en_kjv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Lot jinu agah kinunghei leh, chilhang asoh-in, songkhom bangin akitungdentai.

tcz: Chule Abraham chu ajing jingkah matah in ache loijin Pakai angsunga adinna mun a chun ading in,
en_web: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
en_kjv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: jingkah matah-in Abraham alhaijel’in, Pakai masanga anadin na muna chun agadingin,

tcz: Sodom le Gomorrah lam gam chu agah vesuh in ahile, vetan agam meikhu pi chu meihol kilhut bang in akhu akitung doh jen jun jeng chu amu tan ahi.
en_web: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
en_kjv: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom le Gomorrah gamkaise se agah vetsuh patep leh, hol kilhut khu bangin meikhu ahung kitungdoh jen jun jengtai.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Abraham taona ageldoh in hijeh chun asopipa Lot chu phaicham khopi asuhmang masang in apuidoh in, chujou vin Lot chenna khopi teni chu a sumang tai.
en_web: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Lot chenna, phaicham akhopi te ni asuhmang jeng vangin Abraham agel khoh jeh-in Lot chu ahindohna thei muna ajamdohsah nai.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin Lot le achanu te nin Zoar mun chu adalha uvin, thinglhang lam ajon in, songko sung khat a achanute ni chu toh'a cheng khom tauve.
en_web: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
en_kjv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Zoar khoa chenden ding akichan, achanu te nit oh Lot thing lhang gama acheuvin songko sung khat’a achengtauve.

tcz: Nikhat chu Lot chanu teni alenjo nu chun anao nu kom a hitin aseiye “Hikom gamsunga pasal gollhang aum tapoi midangho banga ji enei lhon lou ding ahi tai. Chuleh eihing hon ipa jong hungvoija ateh lang ahi tan, cha aneilou ding ahi tai.
en_web: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
en_kjv: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Lot cha au-nun anao nu jah a, “I-pa la atehtan, hiche gamsunga eini kichenpi ding pasal dang jong aumpon,

tcz: Hung in ipa hi khamna thei donsah hitin, akham teng iki timatpi lhon ding ahiye, hiche akona chu eiho insung hi ipa akon a chilhah inei doh lhon ding ahibou e,” ati.
en_web: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
en_kjv: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
tcz_gospelgo: i-pa hi ju donkhamsah hitin, luppia chi khaipeh din bol hite,” atin;

tcz: Hichun amanin hiche jan chun apa lengpi twi akham sah lhonin, chuin alenjo nu chu asunglhan apa to aga kiti mat lhon tan ahin apa chun achanu aluppet jong atho doh pet jong ahepoi.
en_web: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
en_kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche jan chun ju adonkhamsah lhonin, au-nun apa akitimetpi leh, ju akham behseh jeh-in apan ima abollam ahephapoi.

tcz: Ajing ni chun alenjo nun anaonu kom ah hitin aseiye, “Keima janlhah chun ipa to kaki timat ka lum lhon tai, tujan jong lengpi twija khamsah hitin, tujan teng nangma gache in lang ga ki timatpi in hiche akona eiho chilhah hi ipa a kona bou ikisem doh thei ding bou ahi,” ati.
en_web: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajingin au-nun anaonu jah a, “Jan nilhah-in i-pa to kalumkhomtan, tujan jong ju donkhamsah hitin, nangin galuppin; chute leh i-pa to cha inei cheh lhon ding ahi, “ati.

tcz: Hiche jan chun amanin apa lhon lengpi twi adonkham sah lhon in chuin aneojo nu aga sunglha kit in apa to aga ki timat lhon kit tan, amasa abang chun achanu aneonu ahung lup pet akitho dohpet jong ahepoi.
en_web: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
en_kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun chuche janin jong apa ju adonkhamsah kit lhonin, acha neojo nun apa aluppin akitimatpi tai. Apa ju akham behseh jeh-in ima abollam ahephapoi.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Lot chanute ni'n apa akon in nao ahin vop gel lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
en_kjv: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Lot chanu ten in apaa konin nao avop gel lhontai.

tcz: Achanu alenjo nu chun nao pasal khat ahing tan amin chu Moab asah tai, amapa chu nam khat ahung hitan tua Moab mite kiti hohi ahiuve.
en_web: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
en_kjv: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
tcz_gospelgo: Au-nun chapa khat ahingin amin Moab* asah-e. Moab hi tulai Moab mite penna pului anahi.

tcz: Aneojo nun nao pasal khat ahing kit in, amanun achapa min chu Ben-ammi asah tai. Amahi nam khat mipa lamka ahung hin tua Ammon mite hohi ahiuve.
en_web: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
en_kjv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
tcz_gospelgo: Anao nun jong chapa khat ahingin amin Benammin* asah-e. Ama hi tulaiya Ammon mite penna pului anahi.

tcz: Hiche akon chun Abraham chu Negev gam langa akichon in Kadesh le Shur kikah a phat chomkhat ana cheng in, chuin Gerar lang gei in aga cheng in ahi.
en_web: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
en_kjv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea kon hin Abrahamin Canaan lhanglam gam ajonsuh-in, Kadesh le Shur kikah a chengtai. Khonunga Gerar a achenlaiyin,

tcz: Abraham'in a inneipi Sarah chu “Ka sopinu ahi,” tin ana phong don in ahile Gerar lengpa Abimelech chun mi asol'in Sarah chu aga pui sah tai.
en_web: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
en_kjv: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin ajinu Sarah chu anao nun alep’in, hijeh chun Gerar lengpa Abimelech chun Sarah hi aji din anapui man’e.

tcz: Hinlah hiche jan chun Pathen in Abimelech amang in aki musah in hitin aseipeh'e, “Nangma hi athisa nahi ahi tai, ajeh chu numei na kipui hi aji nei numei ahi bouve!”
en_web: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”
en_kjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khat Abimelech mangin Pathen ahung kilah-in, “Nangin mi jisa hiche numei hi nakipui jeh a nathi tei tei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahin Abimelech chun amanu (Sarah), chu akitimatpi loulai ahi, hijeh chun Abimelech in “Pakai nangin hiche imacha hechenlou nam hi na suhmang mong ding hitam?
en_web: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
en_kjv: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
tcz_gospelgo: Abimelech vang chu Sarah koma analut kha loulai ahinai; hijeh chun aman, “Pakai, nangin themmona bei miho jong natha jeng ding ham?

tcz: Hitia chu Abraham tah in jong ka sopinu ahi tia eina houlimpi hilou ham? Chule amanun jong ka sopipa ahi atia,” hijeh achu keiman ka lungthim a jong themmo na beihel a chule ka khut teni jong atheng ahi bouve ati.
en_web: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
en_kjv: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham jengin jong anaonua aseiya chule aman jong chutimaa asei ahi. Hijeh a chu lung thengsel’a kabol’a, thil dihmo kabol loulai ahi, “ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen in amang in adonbut in, “Ahinai, keiman nangma hetthem louna ho chu ka henai. hiche ho jeh achu nangma keima douna a chonset a konna kasuh khen a chule hiche ho jeh a chu numeinu to kaki timat sah lou ahi.
en_web: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.
en_kjv: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
tcz_gospelgo: Amangin Abimelech chu Pathenin adonbut’in, “Adih-e, lung thengsel’a nabol ahi kahenai;hijeh achu kadoumah ten chonsetna chu bolsah louva, tugeiya hiche nu hi tongkha louva kakoi nahi.

tcz: Tun numeinu chu a inneipu komma soltan, amapa a inneipun taona naman peh ding ahi, ajeh chu ama themgao ahi, chuteng nangma nadam kit ding ahi tai. Ahin nahet ding khat chu a inneipi nanung peh doh louleh nangma chule na mite nathi gam diu ahi.
en_web: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”
en_kjv: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun vang ama hi ajipa nungpeh tan. Hichepa khu Themgao ahin, aman nataopeh teng thi tapon nate. Nanungpeh lou vangle, kagih dim demsa nahi, nang jong namiten jong nathilo tei tei diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Abimelech jong jingkah matah in a kithu doh in chuin asoh ho jouse gang tah in akou khom tan, chuin Abimelech in thusoh jouse chu asohte ho lah achun aseiyin tijat na adim tauve.
en_web: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
en_kjv: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing jingkah matah-in Abimelech chun alhacha chengse akoukhomin thilsoh jouse abonchan aseipeh leh, akinlih leu jengui.

tcz: Hichun Abimelech in Abraham chu akou vin ajah'a “Ipibol a hiti pia hi nei hung bol'u hitam? Itobang a nang douna a kana chonset hitam, hitia keile ka leng gam chunga chonset nasatah hi nahin pohlut ham? bol louhel ding thil nangman neibol khum ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
en_kjv: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Abimelech-in Abraham akouvin, “I-neilou ham? Ipi adih louva kabolpeh khah a kei le kalenggam chunga hitobang manthahna hi nahinpoh lut jeng ham? Eikibolna louhel ding khat’a neibol ahi.

tcz: Chuin Abimelech in Abraham komma aseiye, “Nang in ipi nabol na ham?”
en_web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
tcz_gospelgo: Idinga hita chu neibol mong mong ham?” tin adongtai.

tcz: Abraham'in adonbut in, “Hiche munhi Pathen ginglou mihem tamna mun ahi tin kagel in, ka loinu chu ka sopinu ahi kiti leh ama nu jeh a chu eitha lou diu ham kati ahi.”
en_web: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
en_kjv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin adonbut’in, “Hikoms Pathen tahsan mi aum dingla kagel loujeh a kajinu deichatnan eitha louvinte kati ahi.

tcz: Adihtah asei dinga ka sopinu jong ahi nai, kapa eihing lhonpa khat ahin kanu lhon vang achom chom ahi. keiman kaji din kaki pui tai.
en_web: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
en_kjv: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Atah beh a jong ama hi kasopi ahinai. Kanu hin mong ahilou vangin kappa chanu ahin, jia kanei jeng ahibouve.

tcz: Pathen in eina kou doh chun kapa insung kanada lhah chun mun khat a patna mun chom a kana vale lhon lai chun kana seiye, thil ngaichat kaneiye katin, hoilang hi jongle iche le naho gamsunga na sopipa tin miho lah a neiphon doh ding ahi tin kana seipeh e.”
en_web: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pathenin kappa insung dalhaa gam choma eihinsoldoh a pat, ‘Nei ngailut phot chetnan mijouse henga nasopin neiseiyin’tia kahilsa mong jong anahi, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Abimelech in akelcha ho le kelngoi hon ho chule abong hon chule numei pasal asoh ho chu Abraham apetai. Abimelech in a inneipi Sarah jong chu anungsol peh kit tai.
en_web: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
en_kjv: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Abimelech-in Sarah chu Abraham anungpeh-in, kelngoi le gancha dang chule soh te jong apeh thai.

tcz: Hichun Abimelech in adonbut in, “Dah'in lang vetem in kagam sung nang in nadei pen na mun a na chen thei ahiye.”
en_web: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham jah a, “Ven, namuphah chan hi kei gamsung ahi, nadei lai laiya chengin, “ati.

tcz: Abimelech in Sarah jah'a aseiye, “Ven keiman na sopipa dangka sang khat kapen, hiche sum hi na koma um chengse mitmu a asuh khel kihet them to na dinga kapeh ahi, chule japi angsunga nangma boina nanei tapoi,” ati.
en_web: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”
en_kjv: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarah jah a Abimelech chun, “Ven, nasopipa dangka sang khat kapen, hiche hi nakoma um chengse mitmua jum ong huhna kapeh ahin, japi angsunga them nakichan ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in Pathen kom a taona amang in Pathen in Abimelech asu dam tan, chule a inneipi le asoh numei ho jouse naobu jouse jong cha aneithei na diuvin aki hong gam tai.
en_web: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
en_kjv: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Abrahamin pathen henga ataopeh le, Abimelech le ajinu adamsah-in, soh numei ho geiyin adamsah-in amahon cha ahingtauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Abraham jinu Sarah jeh a Pakaiyin Abimelech insunga numei naobu jouse ana kha tan peh ahiye.
en_web: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
en_kjv: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Abraham jinu Sarah jal’a abimelech insung numei jouse chu Pathenin chahingmoa anakoi ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin ana seisa bang chun Sarah ahung vil in Sarah chunga asuh bulhit peh tai.
en_web: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.
en_kjv: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarah chu ateppehsa bangin Pakaiyin phatthei ahungboh-in,

tcz: Hichun Sarah in nao ahin vop'in, Abraham chu atehset nung in Pathen in atep peh phat don tah in chapa khat ahin pe tan ahi.
en_web: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
en_kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham ateh nungin Sarah agaiyin chapa khat ahinpeh tai. Achapa chu Pathenin ateppeh dontah a chu hung peng ahi.

tcz: Abraham'in achapa chu amin Isaac asah tan ahi.
en_web: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
en_kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin amin Isaac asah-in,

tcz: Chule Isaac pen jou niget alhin nin Abraham'in Pathen thupeh bang in achapa chu chep atan pehtai.
en_web: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
en_kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen seibangin apenjou niget lhin nin Abrahamin achapa Isaac chu chep atanpeh-e.

tcz: Isaac ahung pen chun, Apa Abraham chu kum jakhat ana lhing tai.
en_web: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
en_kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Isaac pen chun Abraham kum jakhat alhingtai.

tcz: Chuin Sarah in aphong doh in, “Pathen in nuina eipei,” ati.
en_web: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
en_kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarah-in, “Pathenin eikipehsah a einuisah ahitan, ajapha chan nuiya eikipapi ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chule aman, “Sarah hin chale nao noi hin chep sah inte tin koipen in Abraham kom a ana sei ngam dem? ahin lah keiman atehset nung in chapa khat kahin peh tai,” ati.
en_web: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
en_kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Sarah hin cha le nao hinga nao noi chepsah dia koipenin Abraham anaseipeh ngam dem? Ahin la atehset nungin keiman Abraham chapa khat kahinpeh tai,” tin jong aseiye.

tcz: Isaac chu ahung khanglen diu in an neh masa pen Abraham'in kipanan kikhop na asem e.
en_web: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
en_kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
tcz_gospelgo: Isaac akhondoh a noichep aban phat’in Abrahamin naolop golvah loupi tah abol’e.

tcz: Hichun Sarah in jong achapa chu Egypt mi Hagar'in Abraham ahinpeh Ishmael to aki chep lhon chu amudoh tai.
en_web: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
en_kjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikhat Egypt numei Hagar chapa Ishmael le Sarah chapa Isaac akichem lhon’e.

tcz: Hichun amanun Abraham kom ah hitin aseiye, “Hiche sohnu le achapa chu solmang in ajeh chu hiche chapang hin keima chapa toh chanvou anei khom lhon ding aum poi; Isaac toh ki komto thei lou ding ahi.”
en_web: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
en_kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
tcz_gospelgo: Akichep lhon aven Sarah-in Abraham jah a,” Sohnu le achapa hi solmang tan. Sohnu chapa hi kachapa Isaac chan ding nagou halcha jong chang theiponte,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in nopmo asa lheh jeng in ajeh chu Ishmael jong chu achapa ahiye.
en_web: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
en_kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
tcz_gospelgo: Ishmael jong achapa ahijeh-in Abraham din Sarah thusei hi anommo lheh-e.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Abraham chu ahoulimpi in, “Nangman chapang chung chang chule na sohnu jeh in ima lungphat mo na nei hih in, Sarah in bol in atiho chu bol in ajeh chu Isaac akonna bou na chilhah te hung kisim ding bou ahi.”
en_web: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
en_kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin la Pathenin Abraham jah a, “Sohnu le chapa din lung gimdan. Sarah sei sei chu boltan, Isaac a kona nachilhah kisimjo ding ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman Hagar chapa jong chu nam lentah khat kaso thou thou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa jong chu nangma chapa jong ahi thouve.”
en_web: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
en_kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
tcz_gospelgo: Nacha ahijeh chun sohnu chapa konin jong nam khat semdoh nange, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham ajing in matah in akithou vin, neh ding bu asutup'in chule twipoh na ding twibom Hagar chu apen aleng kouva aledoh peh tan ahi, hichun amanu le achapa chu asolmang in, chuin Hagar chu suhna ding helouvin Beersheba gamthip noiya avah lelei.
en_web: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
en_kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingpi tah-in Abraham athouvin changlhah alan, twipaiya twi akhumin Hagar apen, achapa akipohsaah-in asolmangtai. Hagar achen Beersheba gamthip laiya avah le lei.

tcz: Hichun twi ahung bei chun amanu (Hagar) chun naosen chu hampa nang boh lim noi ah akoi tai.
en_web: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
en_kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipaiya twi adon jou lhon phat’in Hagarin Ishmael chu hampa nang noiya aleh lut’in,

tcz: Hichun amanu (Hagar) apot doh in atou lha tan achang seh in lamsom tobang kikah in “Keiman hiche chapang thi hi kamu nompoi,” atin amanu chu alhi along in akap tai.
en_web: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
en_kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
tcz_gospelgo: meer jakhat jen gamlan ache paiyin, atouvin, “Kanao thi ding kave ngampoi!” ati. Hichepet tah chun anao chu ahung kaptai.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in chapang ka awgin chu ajan chuin Pakai Vantil in vanna kon in Hagar chu ahin kouvin, “Hagar ipi boina nanei ham? Imacha kichatna nei hih in, Pathen in chapang ka awgin chu ajatai aumna muna kon in ati.
en_web: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
en_kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
tcz_gospelgo: Nao kagin chu Pathenin ajan, Pathena kon Vantil’in Hagar jah a, “Hagar, i-bol’a lung gim nahim? Kicha hih-in, nao kagin chu Pathenin ajatai.

tcz: Kipat doh inlang nao khu gaki dop loiyin na khut in kipom chah jon, ijeh inem itile keiman ama khu nam lentah ka hisah ding ahi.”
en_web: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
en_kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
tcz_gospelgo: Chen lang nao khu gadomin, kipomin, lhembi loiyin, keiman ama chilhah akona nam lentah kasemdoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Hagar mit chu kho amusah in chua twi tamtah amusah tan, hichun amanun gangtah in twipai chu asu dim in chapang chu adon sah tai.
en_web: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
en_kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Hagar mit ahasah leh, aman twikul khat amudoh paiyin, achen savun twipai dimin twi agathal’in, nao chu themkhat adonsah tai.

tcz: Chule chapang chu Pathen in ahin umpi jing in neocha ahi apat gamthip gamnoi jenga ahung cheng in, thalpi kap ahung them lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.
en_kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
tcz_gospelgo: Nao chu akhangtou touvin, Pathenin akivoppi jinge, Paran gamthip noi jenga apansan, sadel themtah ahin,

tcz: Chule Ishmael chu Paran gamthip noi a ana cheng in, chule anun Egypt gam'a ama ji ding in numei khat aga pui peh in ahi.
en_web: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: anun Egypt numei khat jin apuipehtai.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah chun Abimelech le asepai jalamkai Phicol chu Abraham vil din ahung'e. “Pathen in nangma hi na umpi jing in, na thilbol na jouse ah na kithopi jinge,” tin ahung seiye.
en_web: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
en_kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelai hin Abimelech asepai lamkaipa phicol toh Abraham henga achen, “Nang hi natohna chan a Pathenin napanpi.

tcz: Pathen min'in kitem in, chule nei joulhep louhel ding, ka chate jong ahilou leh ka chilhah ho jong, kei vang nangma adia thilpha bolnom jing, chule tuhin naki hahsel ding, thilpha na bol jing ding hiche gam-sunga maljin gampam nahi laisen,” ati.
en_web: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
en_kjv: now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopema nahung chenna hiche gamsunga kei le kachate, kason kalhah chengse chunga hepina neiya naum’a, ken kabolna bang banga nabol’a neijou bol louhelna din Pathen maiya kitep masan,” ati.

tcz: Abraham'in adonbut in “Heng'e kaki tem e,” ati.
en_web: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
en_kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin, “Kakitep’e, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in Abimelech komma lunglhai louna aphong doh in Abimelech sohten twikul namphu a Abraham sohte ana lah peh'u thu chu ahi.
en_web: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
en_kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhuh khat asohten alahpeh jeh-un Abimelech henga Abraham akiphin le,

tcz: “Tuchung hi hiche thu kajah masah pen ahi,” tin Abimelech in a donbut'e. “Keiman hiche chungchang hi koi oimo a, koi ngoh ding ham kahepoi. Ajeh chu phat masan ima thu nana sei kha poi,” ati.
en_web: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
tcz_gospelgo: Abimelech-in, “Twikhuh lahpeh a chu koipen hiuvam kahe hih beh-e. Seila neiseipeh pon, tua chu bou kajah ahi nalaiye,” ati.

tcz: Abraham'in hichun akelngoi ho, kelcha ho, chule bonghon ho Abimelech apen kinop tona anei lhon'e.
en_web: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
en_kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Abrahamin kelngoi phabep le bongchal phabep Abimelech apen, kinoptona asemdoh lhontai.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in kelngoi nou sagi ho chu achom a alheng doh'in ahi.
en_web: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
en_kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin akelngoi lah a konin kelngoi sagi agahoidoh leh,

tcz: Abimelech in Abraham chu adonbut in “Hiche Kelngoi nou sagi ho hi ipi tina ham? amaho hina tum lhen doh in,” ati.
en_web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
tcz_gospelgo: Abimelech chun, “Idia nagahoi khen ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Abraham'in adonbut in, “Hiche twikhuh keiman ka laisa ahi, tia ahetoh aneipan peh na dinga hiche kelngoi pi sagi hi keima khut tah a na kisan ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
en_kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin, “Hiche twikhuh hi kei semsa ahi nanop phot chet nan hiche kelngoi sagi hi kilah-in,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun ama in hiche mun chun Beersheba asah tai. Ajeh chu mihem teni akihet tona mun lhon ahiye.
en_web: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
en_kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chu ama nin kitepna anasem lhonjeh a Beersheba kisah ahi.

tcz: Beersheba mun a kihet tona muna aki muto jouvin, Abimelech le Phicol sepai lamkai pachu Philistine mun lama akinung le lhon tan ahi.
en_web: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
en_kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang kihoutohna asem chai phat’un Abimelech le Phicol Philistine gama akilekit lhontai.

tcz: Abraham'in Beersheba mun achun chahthing phung aphutdoh in, hiche achun aman Pathen chu tonsot Pathen ahi tin aphong doh e.
en_web: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.
en_kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
tcz_gospelgo: Beersheba muna chun Abrahamin chah thing khat aphut’in, Pakai tonsot Pathen henga ataove.

tcz: Hichun Abraham chu Phillistine muna chun phat sottah achengin ahi.
en_web: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
en_kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.
tcz_gospelgo: Philistine gamsunga sottah Abraham akhopem dentai.

tcz: Thil hijatpi kichai jouvin Pathen in Abraham chu ave patep in aman hitin aseiye, “Vo Abraham,” atile, hikoma kaum e Pakai ati.
en_web: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chom khat nungin Pathenn Abraham apatep’in ajah a, “Abraham!” tin akouve. Aman, “Hikoma ka-um’e!” tin ahouve.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Nangailut tah na chapa changkhat seh Isaac chu pui jin lang Moriah gam'a chen kei man kahin seipeh ding molsang khat pen pen chunga chu pumgo thilto maicham adin pedoh tan,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
en_kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “Na-ngailut tah nachapa chang khat seh Isaac chu Moriah gama puiyin, kahinko peh ding molsang khatpen pen chunga pumgo thilto kilhai nan ganeitan,” ati.

tcz: Chuti chun Abraham chu jingkah matah in athoudoh in asanngan teni akigon tup in chule asoh pasal ni akipui'in achapa Isaac apuiyin, pumgo thilto agovamsa ding in thing akipoh in akipat doh in Pathen in aseipeh na mun chu ajon tai.
en_web: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
en_kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing jingpi tah-in Abraham athouvin, pugo thiltoa manchah din thing achomin sangan apohsah-in, alhacha mi nit oh Isaac apuiyun, Pathenin aseipehna mun jonin achetauve.

tcz: Ani thum chanan Abraham chu adah in aven ahile amun chu gal'a kon in amu tai.
en_web: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
en_kjv: Then on the third day Abraham lift up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Nithumjen ajot nungun Abrahamin ajot nau mun chu gamla tah-in agah mupha bep nalaiye.

tcz: Abraham'in asoh teni jah a aseiyin, “Nangni hikoma hin sangan toh ana um tauvin, keile ka chapa khulam akhun gache lhon tadinge, Pathen kaga hou lhon ding kahung kinung le vah lhon ding ahi.”
en_web: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”
en_kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide you here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhachate ni jah a Abrahamin, kei le boipu hilampeh a khun gatao lhon ing ting, nahenguva hung kit lhon nange,” ati.

tcz: Abraham'in thinglom maicham a pumgo thilto halna ding chu Isaac apohsah in chule achempai achoi jin amani hiti chun akijot lhon in achelhon tai.
en_web: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
en_kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumgo thiltoa tiding thinglom chu Abrahamin Isaac aputsah-in, meicho na ding song meihol le chemcha aman achoiye. Achepet lhon hin

tcz: Chuin Isaac in apa Abraham jah'a “Hepa” atile Abraham'in jong “Hoijo kacha” ati, hichun Isaac in “Veteh mei le thinglom la aumtan, pumgo thilto kelngoi hoiba ham?” ati le.
en_web: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
en_kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
tcz_gospelgo: Isaac-in, “Hepa!” atileh; aman, “I-ham kanao?” ati. Isaac-in, “Hepa, meicho na ding song meihol le tiding thinglomla aumtan, kilhaina ding kelngoi hoiba ham?” ati.

tcz: Abraham'in adonbut in “Pathen ama tah in hin gong nante, kelngoi pumgo maicham adin, kachapa deitah,” hichun amani achebe lhon in ahi.
en_web: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
en_kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin, “Pathenin kelngoi hin ki-ngaito nante,” atin, akijotpai lhontai.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham aseipeh na mun ahung lhun lhon phat in Abraham chun maicham khat asem in, thinglom chu agol chan ajam'in chuin achapa Isaac chu aheltum in maicham chunga alup sah tai.
en_web: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
en_kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin akipehna mun alhun lhon phat’in, Abrahamin maicham khat asemin, maicham chunga thinglom agolchan akoiyin, Isaac akantumin, maicham chunga thinglom chunga chun alupsah-e.

tcz: Hichun aman achem chu apaiya kon in aladon in, achapa chu sut agon akilam tai,
en_web: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
en_kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun chemcha asatdoh-in achapa tha din agotai.

tcz: Hinlah vana konin Pakai vantil in “Abraham, Abraham” tin ahin kouvin ahile, Abraham'in “Pakai keima hikoma ka um'e,” ati.
en_web: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
tcz_gospelgo: Vana Pakaiya hungkon Vantil chun, “Abraham, Abraham!” tin ahinsamtai. Abrahamin, “Hikoma ka-um’e!” tin ahouve.

tcz: Ama chun “chapang pa chunga na khut nalha lou hel ding, imacha jong nalo lou ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen na gin jeh-in nangman na chapa chang khat seh jeng jong keima adin na khut kih poi, tihi tun kichen tah in kahe doh tai,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
en_kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun, “Chapang chu ima lodan, supop hih beh-in, Pathen nagin jeh a nachapa chang khatseh tha na dia jong khut kih louva napan kahetai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Abraham adah doh in avet leh, “Vetan anung langa nanglom laha kelngoi chal khat akia kihen amun ahi,” hichun Abraham jong achen kelngoi chal chu aga kaiyin achapa khel chun maicham thilto chun atoh'in ahi.
en_web: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
en_kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham akiheile leh, kelngoichal khat hampa nangtom lah a kit e nia kihen amudoh-in, agakailut’in achapa khel’in pumgo thilto kilhai nan aneitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun Abraham'in hiche mun chu Pathen in hin ngaito nante tin asahtai (Yahweh-Yireh), tuni geihin hiche “Pathen'in amolsang chung ah hin kingaito nante,” ti thuchih hi akisei jing nalaiye.
en_web: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”
en_kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelai mun chu Abrahamin, “Pakaiyin thilto aki-ngaitona mun,” asah-in, hijeh chun tuni geiyin mihon, “Pakai molvuma aman thilto aki-ngaitona mun,” ati jingui.

tcz: Pakai vantil chun vanna konin Abraham tin a nivei na a ahin koukit in ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
tcz_gospelgo: Vana Pakaiya hungkon Vantil chun anivei nan Abraham ahinkou kit’in,

tcz: Hitin aseiye, “Keima ka tahsa tah a ka kihahsel ahitai, hitobang a thilhi nabol ngam jenga na chapa chang khat seh chunga khut kih louva napan jeng phat-in tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
en_kjv: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai amatah kihahsel’a asei chu, “Neigin jeh a nachapa chang khatseh chunga jong khut kih louva napan hin kei kitep’ah kahitai.

tcz: Keiman kitah tah a phatthei ka boh ding nahi, chule na chilhahte chunga ahsi jat ka phahsah ding chule vadung panga neldi jat ka sosah ding nahi, na chilhah ten amelma teu kelkot ahin toupha diu ahiye.
en_web: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
en_kjv: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
tcz_gospelgo: Nangman phatthei kaboh a, nason nachilhah van a ahsite jat le Twikhanglen panga neldi jat hungpha ding, namelmate ahinjosoh hel diu ahi.

tcz: Chule nangman ka thusei nangai jeh a leiset chunga namtin vaipi na son na chilhah te vanga phatthei hung kiboh ding ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”
en_kjv: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei nanit jeh a nason nachilhah phatthei kaboh banga hi phatthei kaboh ding deiya chitin namtin kahenga hung tao diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in asohpa kom langa ahung kinungle in, chuin amaho Beersheba lam ajon un, hichea chun Abraham chu Beersheba a aum tai.
en_web: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
en_kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhachate ni henga Abraham ahung kile kit’in, Beersheba geiyin ahung kilhon’un, hikoma chun Abraham achengtai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun Abraham chu thu aseipeh un Milcah jong hin nasopi pa Nahor to cha pasal phachompi ahing lhone.
en_web: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
en_kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chom khat nungin Milcah-in asopipa Nahor chapa get jen ahinpeh thu mihon Abraham ahung seipeh tauve.

tcz: Uz chu atahpen ahin, Buz hi anichan na ahin, Ram hingpa Kemuel ahin,
en_web: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
en_kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
tcz_gospelgo: Nahor chate aping masapen pa Uz ahin, anaote chu Buz, Aram pa kemuel,

tcz: Chesed ahin, Hazo ahin, Pildash ahin, Jidlaph ahin chule Bethuel ahi uve,” ati.
en_web: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
en_kjv: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
tcz_gospelgo: Chesed, Hazo, pildash, Jidlaph chule Bethuel-

tcz: Bethuel chun Rebekah ahing'e. Abraham sopipa Nahor chu Milcah cha hicheng get hi ana hin peh e.
en_web: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
en_kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Rebecca pa ahiuvin, abonchan Abraham sopipa Nahor chapate, Milcah hin chengse get ahiuve.

tcz: Hicheng val in jong athai-kemnu amin Reumah kiti nu jong chun Tebah toh, Gaham toh, Tahash toh chule Maacah ana hing'e.
en_web: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
en_kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahor thaikem nu Reumah-in jong Tebah ke Gaham, Tahash le Maacah ahinge.

tcz: Sarah chu kum jakhat le kum som ni le kum sagi jen ahing in,
en_web: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
en_kjv: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarah chu kum jakhat le som ni to sagi ahingin,

tcz: Sarah chu Kiriath-arba kiti muna athi tan, hichu Hebron kiti Canaan gam sunga um ahi, hichun Abraham chu Sarah umlou jeh a lunghel le mitlhi long in achup in ahi.
en_web: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
en_kjv: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan gamsung, Kir-iath-arba kiti, Hebron khoa athin, Abrahamin ajinu pul adouve.

tcz: Hichun ajinu long adalhah ding jeh in Hit mite ho kom a aseiyin,
en_web: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
en_kjv: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajinu thilong phung dalhan Abraham achen Hit mite jah a,

tcz: “Keima gam chom mi kahin nangho lah a maljin bou kahi. Gambeh neo khat nei choh sah un, chuti le keiman ka jinu hi phaten kivui thei ing'e,” ati.
en_web: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
en_kjv: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keima maljin, nahenguva hung khopem kahin, kajinu long kavuina din gam leiset mun khat neichohsah-uvin,” agate.

tcz: Hit mite ho chun Abraham adonbut un,
en_web: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
en_kjv: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Hit miten Abraham jah a,

tcz: Ja umtah kapu thuseiyu ngaiyin, nangma Pathen a leng chapa banga kei ho lah a uma keiho lhan khuh aphapen khat'a khun na thilong chu vui jeng in, ka lah uva mihem khat cha jong hi alhan khuh na itpeh a na thilong na vuisah lou ding aum poi,” atiuve.
en_web: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
en_kjv: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ngaitemin kapu, kalah-uva nangma Pathen tun lamkai lentah hiya, kalhan semsau phapen khat’a khun najilong vui jengin; koi hijongle naji vuina din kipah tah-in lhan khat pejeng ung kate,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Abraham ading doh in agamsung mipite Hite miho chu salam bol din abohkhup tai.
en_web: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
en_kjv: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hit mite masang tol’a Abraham abohkhup’in,

tcz: Abraham'in aseiyin, “Nangman nei kithopi nom kahen ahithei dingle Ephron Zohar chapa koma neisei peh uvin.”
en_web: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
en_kjv: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
tcz_gospelgo: “Hikoma kaji neivuisah nomu ahinah leh, Zohar chapa Ephron henga khun,

tcz: “Ajeh chu agamgi chin a um ama Machpelah songlhan keo khu eipeh theiya ahile ken jong lhan muna kaman jing dingin nangho umpet tah hin aman alhingset in peng kate,” ati.
en_web: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
en_kjv: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
tcz_gospelgo: aloupam chin a Machpelah songko khu neithumpeh-uvin. Hiche khu lhanmol’a kanei den din, nang ho maiya leiman lhingset’a eichohsahna din neiseipeh-uvin, “tin angeh-e.

tcz: Ephron chu mipi lah a atou pet ahin, Abraham chu adonbut in midang hon jong athusei chu aja cheh un, Hite mite ho khopi sunga umjouse jah ah hitin aseiye.
en_web: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
en_kjv: And Ephron dwelt amongst the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Kelkot phung, mipi kikhopnaa hi Hit midang ho chutoh Ephron jong toukhom ahiuvin; mi jouse jah din ahindonbut’in,

tcz: “Hithei ponte ka Pakai,” tin Abraham chu adonbut'e, “Lungset tah in ka thusei hi ngaiyin, keiman ka gam sunga adam lai, atong lai, kapeh ding nahi. Tuhin mipi ho masanga nangma kapeh ding nahi, chule nangman naji nu alongdamsa navui thei ahi.”
en_web: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
en_kjv: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kapu ngaitemin, lou pumpi le asunga songko pumin napenge. Najilong navuina din loumun le songko chu kamite angsung laitah a pejeng ing’e,” ati.

tcz: Abraham chu agam mipiho masang a abohkhup kit in,
en_web: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
en_kjv: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivang in Hit mite angsunga Abraham akunin,

tcz: Hichun Abraham'in Ephron le mipi atou cheng ho jah'a aseikit in, “Hithei ponte, lungset tah in ngaiyun, nangho koma ka choh nom lheh e, keiman gam man chu ka peh lhing nom e, ka loinu longdamsa kavui thei na ding in,” ati.
en_web: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
en_kjv: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
tcz_gospelgo: Ephron jah a chun mipi jah thei din, “Nei ngai themin ikhat dong inge. Loumun pumpin chotange, aman alhingin kilah-in, chule kajilong jong vui inge, “ati.

tcz: Hichun Ephron in Abraham adonbut in,
en_web: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
en_kjv: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Ephronin Abraham jah a,

tcz: Ka Pakai lungset tah in ngaiyin hiche gam man hi dangka jali ahiye, amavang eini golcha kingailut nahi mantam ahi? che inlang na loinu long damsa chu gavui tan ati.
en_web: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
en_kjv: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi-ngaiyin kapu, dangka shekel ja li man bep leimun chu nang le kei kah a ipi tahpi ham? Najilong chu kivuina jengin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Abraham chun Ephron in aseijat dangka jali chu apetan, hiche lai phat na kailhang thil man dung jui jin, thil kichoh dan ho chu Hit mite lah a tehse hon amu cheh uve.
en_web: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
en_kjv: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham anomin, Hit mite jah changtah a Ephronin aseidohsa dangka shekel ja li chu, kivei miho thiltena dungjuiyin atedoh peh tai.

tcz: Abraham'in Ephron koma gam Machpelah kiti Mamre koma um chu acho doh tai. Hiche mun in ahop chu ahile atong, adam sung, chule akoma thingphung um jouse jong ahi.
en_web: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
en_kjv: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga hi Mamre niso lam Machpeleh mun a Ephron loumun le asunga songko lhan toh, loupam ching geiya keh, loulai thing jouse jong Abraham changkha ahitai.

tcz: Abraham dinga chu anei agou ahitan, hichea chun Hit mite kelkot kom a chenghon jong ahe soh un ahi.
en_web: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
en_kjv: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikhopna hung pang Hit mi jousen jong loumun Abraham kipehdoh chu ahetpehsoh keiyui.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Abraham'in ajinu Sarah long Machpelah a Mamre koma Hebron kiti Canaan gamsunga avuitan ahi.
en_web: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan gamsung, chulai songko lhan sunga chun Abrahamin ajinu Sarah avuitai.

tcz: Aleimun le aleilaiya songlhan keo chu Hite miten alhan mun dingin Abraham achansah tauve.
en_web: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
en_kjv: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Hit mipa loumun le asunga songko pumin lhan din Abraham achan thatai.

tcz: Abraham chu akum ahung tam lheh tan Pathenin hatah in anatoh na jouse ah phatthei aboh sohkeiye.
en_web: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
en_kjv: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.

tcz: Chuin Abraham'in nikhat chu asohte lah a atahpen insung vaihom pa heng ah hitin aseiye, “Nakhut chu kaphei noiya koiyin lang naki hahsel ding ahi.”
en_web: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
en_kjv: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

tcz: Chuteng le Pakai van le leiset sempa min in ki hahsel in hichu nangman kamou ding hi Canaan gamsung tu a ichen nao muna konna hi nahin puilou ding ahi.
en_web: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
en_kjv: and I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, amongst whom I dwell:

tcz: Hinlah nangma che inlang keima um nalui gam ka sopi holah a Isaac ji ding naga pui peh ding ahi ati.
en_web: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
en_kjv: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

tcz: Sohpan Abraham adonbut'in “Ijemtin numeinu chu keiho toh hiche gam'a kanung hinjui ding da tale ikalo ding hitam? Ahiloule keiman nachapa Isaac hi nangma hung kondoh na gam a chu kanung puikit thei ding ham?” ati.
en_web: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
en_kjv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

tcz: Abraham'in adonbut'in “hoitah in gelchen in lang ka chapa vang kholam a patna na hin nung pui lou beh ding ahi.”
en_web: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
en_kjv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

tcz: Pakai van Pathen kanam mite le kapa insunga kona eipui dohpa, ka penna gam'a patna eihin puidoh pan kitepna aneiyin hitin eina seipeh e, nangma chilhah te hiche gamhi kapeh ding na hiuve.
en_web: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
en_kjv: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

tcz: Hinlah numeinu chun na hinyui nomlou le nangma keima dan kitepna a kona ongthol na hitai, thil khat chu ahile ka chapa hilanga kon chun nahin nungpui lou ding ahi.”
en_web: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
en_kjv: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

tcz: Hichu Abraham sohpan apu Abraham malnoiya akhut akoiyin apun ahilna thudol ahin aki hahsel tai.
en_web: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
en_kjv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

tcz: Hichun asohpa chun sangongsao som apupa Abraham kom ah alan thil mantam ajat jat apon Mesopotamia lama Nahor khopi jon din ache tai.
en_web: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
en_kjv: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

tcz: Aman sangongsao ho chu twi veina kotong koma khopi pam a akichol sah in nilhah langkai ahiphat in numei ho chu twi khai dingin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
en_web: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
en_kjv: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

tcz: Chuin Abraham sohpa chun, “O Pakai kapu Abraham Pathen, tunia neipi lhin sah na dingin na-angsunga kataove, kapu Abraham dingin khoto na hinneiyin.”
en_web: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
en_kjv: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

tcz: Vetan keima hiche twikhuh phunga hin kadinge, chule hiche khopi sunga miho chanute twi khaiya hung ding ahiuve.
en_web: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
en_kjv: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

tcz: Hichehi kangai chat ahi. Alah uva khatpen pen chu kadoh ding, lungset tah in nakhon a twi chu neidon sahin. Amanun hitia hi ahin donbut leh, heng'e, donin, chule na sangongsao ho jong keiman hin donsah ing'e! Hiche nu chu nangman Isaac inneipi a dinga nalhen doh hiding ahi. Hiche akon a chu keiman ichan geiya kapu chunga guitan lou ngailutna nachan ham ti kahet ding ahi.
en_web: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
en_kjv: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

tcz: Asohpa taona achai masang in Rebekah numei khangthah nu chun aleng kouva Twibel ahin pun ahung pot doh tan ahi, Amanu chu Bethuel chanu, Abraham sopipa Nahor le ajinu Milcah toh ahin lhon ahi.
en_web: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
