en_kjv: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

tcz: Rebekah chu nungah melhoi vetnom nom a melhoi khat ahin, chule pasal tojong kitimat na neikha lou hel lai ahiye. Amanu chun Twikhuh sunga achelut in a twibel dimset in twi aga kithal in chu jouvin ahung kaldoh tai.
en_web: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.
en_kjv: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

tcz: Abraham sohpa chu Rebekah kom lama alhai in hitin aseiye, “Lungset tah in nabel a twi chu themkhat neidon sah thei ding ham,” atile,
en_web: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
en_kjv: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

tcz: Rebekah in jong “Henge kapu nadon thei ma ma ahi,” chuin amanun a twi poh chu a lengkouva pat in ahin dom lhan Abraham sohpa chu adonsah tai.
en_web: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
en_kjv: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

tcz: Chuin Rebekah in twi adonsah jou chun, ana khongai tadin “Keiman na sangongsao ho ding jong twi gadom ta ding e ati, chule na sangongsao hon adon chim tokah sen keiman gathal peh ing'e,” ati.
en_web: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”
en_kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

tcz: Hichun Rebekah chu gangtah in atwi poh chu gancha ho twikong sunga alheilhan, twikhuh langa chun twithal dingin a lhaijel kit'in amapa sangongsao ho abonchauvin twi adon chim sah soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
en_kjv: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

tcz: Chuphat'in sohpan thipbeh in Rebekah umchan chu aven ama akingaiton Pakaiyin ka hung kholyin lona penhi a lolhin sah ding khat hitam, hilou ham tin phot chen ding gon Rebekah um chan chu thip behchan ave ave jeng in ahi.
en_web: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
en_kjv: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin sangongsao ho jousen twi ahin donva cheh tauvin, hichun sohpan sana bilba anah a budin ahin ladoh in chule sana chao jang ni lentah akhut cheng teni a bupeh din ahin ladoh tai.
en_web: As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

tcz: Amapan adong tan, “Nangma hi koi chanu nahim? lungset tahin eihin donbut in, napa in mun a chu tujan kaki ngah thei diu ham?” ati.
en_web: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”
en_kjv: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

tcz: Amanu'n adonbut in, “Keima hi Bethuel chanu kahi atin, kapu le kapi chu Nahor le Milcah ahi.
en_web: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
en_kjv: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

tcz: Henge, adih e, keihon chang pol tamtah kanei jun sangongsao ho neh thei ding, chule jin lhun in jong kanei uve,” ati.
en_web: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
en_kjv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

tcz: Hichun sohpa abohkhup in Pakai Pathen athangvah tai.
en_web: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.
en_kjv: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.

tcz: Pathen vahchoiyin umhen, kapu pa Abraham Pathen atitai. “Pakaiyin a lungsetna longlou chule phatkim na kapu pa amusah tai, ajeh chu ahile imacha boina umlouva kapu sopite koma eipui lhungjel tai.”
en_web: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
en_kjv: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

tcz: Hichun khangthah nungahnu chu gangtah in a inlama alhai jel in ama chunga thilsoh um cheng a insung mite aga hetsah in ahi.
en_web: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
en_kjv: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

tcz: Rebekah chun sopi Laban aneiyin, amapa chun twikhuh kam'a chun ahung gamkon ho kimu pi din ahung tai.
en_web: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
en_kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

tcz: Laban chun anah'a sana akiba a akhuta sana chaojang akibu chu amu tan, chuleh Rebekah in amaho chung chang thu asei chengse chu ajan, hichun ama alhaidoh pai jin twikhuh umna lama sangongsao ho nunga adin chu amun ahi.
en_web: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

tcz: Laban chun sohpa koma aseiye, “Hung in keiho kom a nage thei diu ahi, Pathen in phatthei abohsa teho khopam a iti nadin ding'u ham? Keima in a nangho gena ding mun aum e, chule na sangongsao te kol na ding jong gonsan aum'e.”
en_web: He said, “Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
en_kjv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

tcz: Hichun amapa chun Laban toh insung alut tauvin, Laban chun sangongsao ho chu alham lhan changpol ho apen aki choldo na diu, chuleh aneh diu jong twi jong sohpa ding, chule sangongsao hoiya pang ho dinga akeng kisop ngim na ding un apen ahi.
en_web: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
en_kjv: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

tcz: Hichun aneh diu an ahung kilui doh tan ahin Abraham sohpan aseiye, “Imacha kaneh nompoi kahung na ajeh kasei masang in,” aphai tin Laban in adon but in, “Neisei peh un” ati.
en_web: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
en_kjv: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

tcz: “Keima hi Abraham sohpa kahi,” tin aman asei tai.
en_web: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
en_kjv: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

tcz: Chule Pathen in kapu pa hi hatah in phatthei aboh in ama nei le gou jong ahao thei lheh tan ahi. Chule Pathen in kelngoi hon, le sa namkim jong anei sah tan, chule sana dangka le soh numei le pasal, sangongsao tamtah jong chule sangan tamtah apetan ahi.
en_web: The LORD has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. The LORD has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
en_kjv: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

tcz: Chuin kapu pa loinu Sarah chu akum ahung teh jou nung in, kapupa chapa pasal khat ahing in, kapu pan achapa chu anei agou jouse ama ape doh tai.
en_web: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
en_kjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

tcz: Hia chun kapu Abraham'in eikitep sah in, Aman hiti aseiye, “Nangman hiche ka chapa hi Canaan numei ho toh na kichen sah lou hel ding ahi.”
en_web: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
en_kjv: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

tcz: “Amavang ka pate kom langa, ka insung mite kom lang joh a nache a ka chapa Isaac ji ding nei gapui peh tan,” ati.
en_web: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
en_kjv: but thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kapu ka donbut in “Keiman ipi kalo ding ham? numei khangthah keima toh hung kinung le ding ka mu thei lou leh kati'e.
en_web: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’
en_kjv: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

tcz: Aman ei donbut'in, “Pakai ama umna limnoiya eiumpi pan avantil te nahin solpeh ding na kin jong thupitah a na lolhin sah ding ahi. Adih e! Hijeh a chu ka chapa aloinu ding keima insung miho lah a nahin pui tei ding ahi.
en_web: He said to me, ‘The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.
en_kjv: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

tcz: Hiche teng chule, keima a kona na ongthol ding ahitai. Kasopi ho lah a naga che a amahon a chanu u chu nangtoh hung ding anoplou ule hiche achu nangma na themmo tapoi.
en_web: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’
en_kjv: then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun in, keima hilai twikhuh mun a hin ka touve, O Pakai, kapu pa Abraham Pathen tuchung hi ka hung ki gonna kin hi lungset tahin neilo lhin sah in kati'e.
en_web: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘The LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
en_kjv: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

tcz: Ven, keima hilaiya twikhuh koma kadin pet ahi, numei khangthah hon hiche twikhuh a twi thal a ahung teng ule hitia hi kasei ding, lungset tahin na khon na chun twi themkhat nei donsah thei ding ham?
en_web: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”
en_kjv: behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

tcz: Ama nun henge ati a chule keiman na sangongsao ho jouse jong twi ka donsah soh ding ahin tileh amanu chu kapupa chapa Isaac ji ding in nei petai tia ka lah ding ahi tai.
en_web: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.’
en_kjv: and she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master’s son.

tcz: Keiman ka lungthima katao chai masang in Rebekah in alengkou va twibel ahin pun twikhuh lam ahin jon in, hichun keiman amanu jah'a hitin kaseiye, lungset tah in don ding twi neipen kati'e.
en_web: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
en_kjv: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

tcz: Hichun Rebekah in jong gangtah in a lengkouva twibel a twi aput chu ahin domlhan hitin asei tai. Henge aphai, twi nadon thei ahiye chule keiman nagancha Sangongsao ho jouse jong twi donva sah cheh nange ati, hichun ken jong ka don in, a sangongsao ho jong abonchauvin twi avahva cheh in ahi.
en_web: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.
en_kjv: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

tcz: Hichun keiman ka dong in nangma hi koi chanu nahim katile aman eidonbut'in, “Bethuel chanu kahin Nahor le Milcah chu kapu le kapi ahi, hichea chu keiman anah a sana bilba kaba peh a akhut teni a sana chaojang kabu peh ahi,” ati.
en_web: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
en_kjv: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

tcz: Hichun keima ka kun in ka boh khup in Pakai kavah choiye, kapu pa Abraham Pathen chu, Ajeh chu Pathen in lolhing tah in eipui jin ama sopi atute kom lama achapa ji puithei ding muna kaum tah jeh in ati.
en_web: I bowed my head, and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
en_kjv: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

tcz: Neisei peh in, nangman kilungset na longlou chule kingailut phot chetna hi kapu pa nasuh bulhit sah ding ham? ahilou leh ipi neilo ding ham? hiche teng chule keiman aban bolbe ding chu kigel tang kate.
en_web: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
en_kjv: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

tcz: Hichun Bethual le Laban in adonbut lhon in, “Pathen in hikoma hi na hin pui uchu ka nom e keima ho emacha seibe ding kahe pouve.”
en_web: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from the LORD. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
en_kjv: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

tcz: Rebekah hi kipui jun che tauvin nadei ma bang in na pupa chapa inneipi din kipui tauvin, Pathen in nahin puiji mabang in atilhone.
en_web: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the LORD has spoken.”
en_kjv: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the Lord hath spoken.

tcz: Abraham sohpan hiche thu kisei ho jouse chu ajah phat chun tol'a abohkhup in Pathen a thangvah tai.
en_web: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.

tcz: Hichun Abraham sohpan dangka sum eng chule sana khivui, pon mantam ho chu Rebekah apeuvin, hiche tilou chun thil thupi mantam tah Laban le anu jong apen ahi.
en_web: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
en_kjv: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

tcz: Hichun amahon an ane khomun Abraham sohpa le ahin lhonpi ho jouse hiche jan chun ageh un, Hinlah jingkah matah in, Abraham sohpan hitin aseiye, “Ka pupa koma kinungle din neisol tauvin,” ati.
en_web: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
en_kjv: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

tcz: Amavang Laban le anun, “Rebekah chu nisom tobang aum be ding in adei lhon nalaiye. Hiche jouteng amanu chethei tante,” atiuve.
en_web: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
en_kjv: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

tcz: Ahin sohpan nei ni chon sah sah hih un, ajeh chu ka Pakai ka hung na kin lenpen tah hi eilo lhin sah peh ahi tai. Lungset tah in kapu pa koma din eiki nungle sah tauvin.
en_web: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

tcz: “Aphai,” ati uvin, “Keima hon Rebekah kouvu tin dong ute aman ipi agel em.”
en_web: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
en_kjv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.

tcz: Hichun amahon Rebekah akou vun, “Amapa toh'in nache ding hitam,” tin adong uve. Chuin ama nun adonbut in “Henge kache ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
en_kjv: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

tcz: Hichun amahon damsel tauvin tin Rebekah chu alhau vin, Abraham sohpa toh ahin kilhonpi hotoh asol tauvin ahi. Rebekah chu aneova patna ahin sasah nu jong asol peh thauvin amanu toh kilhon ding ahi.
en_web: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
en_kjv: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

tcz: Amaho Rebekah in adalhah kon un hitin phatthei aboh un “Ka sahtah u sopinu nangman mi asang sang hin hing inlang, na chilhah te jong hat jing'u hen. Amahon amelma teu kelkot hinkal lhah jing'u hen,” atiuve.
en_web: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”
en_kjv: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

tcz: Hichun Rebekah le asoh numei ho chu sangonsao chunga kaldoh un, Abraham sohpa nung chu ajui tauve, Hiti chun Abraham soh pan Rebekah chu apuiyun ahung tauve.
en_web: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
en_kjv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

tcz: Hiche petna chu Isaac chu Beerlahai-roi japat achenna mun Negev lama ahung kinungle pettah ahi.
en_web: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
en_kjv: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

tcz: Nilhah khat Isaac chu avah len atao dinga ache le pet in phailei lam agahven ahile sangong-sang ho ahung chu amun ahi.
en_web: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.
en_kjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lift up his eyes, and saw, and behold, the camels were coming.

tcz: Chuin Rebekah agah khodah in ahile Isaac amuphat in sangongsao chunga kon in ahung kum lha tai.
en_web: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
en_kjv: And Rebekah lift up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

tcz: “Koiham khulanga phailei lama vahle a eiho eigal dot'u khu,” tin Rebekah'in sohpa chu adongtan ahi. Chuin Abraham sohpan adonbut'in “Ama khu kapupa ahi,” hichun Rebekah'in adel alan akikhu khume.
en_web: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.
en_kjv: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

tcz: Hichun sohpan Isaac chu ima jouse thusoh ho chu asei peh tan ahi.
en_web: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
en_kjv: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in Rebekah chu anu Sarah ponbuh in na ahin puilut in, aman Rebekah chu aji din asang tan hatah in alungset in, amanu chu Isaac anun adalhah jou alung hem na jouse jong amil tai.
en_web: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
en_kjv: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

tcz: Abraham'in ji numei khat aneibe kit in, amanu min chu Keturah ahi.
en_web: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
en_kjv: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

tcz: Amanu chun cha hicheng hi ahing in, amaho se chu Zimran ahin, Jokshan ahin, Medan ahin, Ishbak ahin, chule Shuak ahiuvin;
en_web: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
en_kjv: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

tcz: Jokshan chun Sheba le Dedan ahingin, Dedan chilhah ho chu ahile Assurite ho ahin, Leteshite ho ahin, chule Leumimite jouse jong ahiuve.
en_web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
en_kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

tcz: Midian chate ho chu Ephah ahin, Epher ahin, Hannoch ahin, Abida ahin chule Eldaah amaho jouse hi Abraham cha Keturah a konna peng ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

tcz: Chule Abraham'in anei jouse achapa Isaac chu apetan ahi.
en_web: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
en_kjv: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

tcz: Amavang Abraham'in athi masang in aji kopte cha ho jouse jong thilpeh anei soh keiyin chule nisolam gamma abon'un aki in chonsah tai.
en_web: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.
en_kjv: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

tcz: Abraham chu kum jakhat le kum som sagi le kum nga alhing in;
en_web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
en_kjv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

tcz: Hichun Abraham kum sottah ahing in lolhing tah in ahinkho amang in aleiset hinkho abeitai, chuin ama apu apa amite to akivui thatai.
en_web: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
en_kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

tcz: Chule achate ni Isaac le Ishmael in apa lhon Abraham chu songlhan keova Machpelah achun avui lhon tai. Hichu Mamre kom ahin hiche mun chu Ephron chapa Zohar Hittites ho komma kicho doh anahi.
en_web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,
en_kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

tcz: Hiche gam hi Abraham'in Hite mite ho koma a inneipi Sarah kivuina dinga ana choh doh mun chu ahi.
en_web: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
en_kjv: the field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

tcz: Abraham thijou chun, Pathen in hatah in Isaac chu Beerlahoi-roi Negev mun a phatthei abohtan ahi.
en_web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
en_kjv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

tcz: Hiche hohi Ishmael chilhah Abraham chapa Hagar a kona hung peng Egypt mite numei Sarah sohnu akon ahi.
en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
en_kjv: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

tcz: Anoija hohi Ishmael chilhah amin, anam, aphung dungyui ja kipe, apeng masa penpa Nebaioth ahin, Kedar ahin, Adbeel ahin, Mibsam ahin,
en_web: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
en_kjv: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

tcz: Mishma ahin, Damah ahin, Masah ahin,
en_web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
en_kjv: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

tcz: Hadard ahin, Tema ahin, Jetur ahin Naphish ahin chule Kedarmah hicheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
en_kjv: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

tcz: Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuvin, aminu jong akhotin a kisem a chuleh a ngahmun dung-juiya akilah le aphung khaijin haosa chapa cheh som le ni alhing uve.
en_web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
en_kjv: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

tcz: Chule Ishmael chu kum jakhat le kum somthum le kum sagi ahing in, chuin ama aleiset hinkho abeitan hichun apu apate along lup naova ama jong akichol dotai.
en_web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
en_kjv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

tcz: Chule Ishmael chilhahte chun gam leiset Havilah apat Shur chan gei alodim un, hiche hi Assyria gam jotna Egypt gamto kinai Asshur ahung kipan ahi. Amaho chu asopi ule nao hotoh kivet dagunset in ana umjing uve.
en_web: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
en_kjv: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest towards Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

tcz: Hiche hi Isaac Abraham chapa insung chilhah thusim ahi.
en_web: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
en_kjv: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

tcz: Chuin Isaac kum som li alhin in aji ding in Rebekah Paddan- Ram gam'a Bethuel chanu Aramean mi Laban sopinu chu a kipuiyin ahi.
en_web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
en_kjv: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

tcz: Isaac ajinu ding in Pathen heng'a ataovin ahi, ajeh chu aching in cha neilouva aum phat in, hichun Pathen'in Isaac taona chu asan pehtan ahile Rebekah chu ahung kikopmo tan naosen ni ahung kijil tan ahi.
en_web: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren. The LORD was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
en_kjv: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

tcz: Hinlah naosen teni chu anu naobu sunga ahung kiboi jing lhonin hichun amanu Pathen dong dingin achen hiche hi itidan ham? ati.
en_web: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of the LORD.
en_kjv: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of the Lord.

tcz: Pathen in amanu ahoulim pi in “ naobu sunga naocha teni chu nampi ni hung hiding hiche nam teni hi abulla patna hung kitoh mo peh lhon ding ahi, nam teni lah a khat hung hat intin, nacha teni lah a aupan anaopa chu ahin jenle ding ahi”.
en_web: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.

tcz: Chuin naonei na ding phat ahung lhin chun Rebekah in naoni avop chu ahin kihet chen bep'in ahi.
en_web: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
en_kjv: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

tcz: Chuin ahung peng masa pachu asanin atahsa pumpi chu amul in atom in hichun ama chu Esau asah tauvin ahi.
en_web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
en_kjv: And the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun asopipa ahung peng lhatan akhut teni a chun a upa keng atuh chah kheh in, Hichea chu amapa min chu Jacob asah un, ajinun amani ahin peh pet hin Isaac chu kum som gup ana lhingtai.
en_web: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
en_kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

tcz: Chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhonin, Esau chu gamleng sakap them gam vahmi ahung hikhan, Jacob vang chu mi mong khat ahin pondal buh a umjing mi ahi.
en_web: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
en_kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

tcz: Isaac in Esau chu hatah in angailun ahi, Ajeh chu asa delsa ahin poh lut aneh jing jeh in, Hinlahh Rebekah in Jacob chu alungset lheh in ahi.
en_web: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.
en_kjv: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

tcz: Nikhat chu Jacob in changchim ahon pet in Esau chu agamlen na a konin ahung lhung in, nasa tahin agil akeltan atha alhasam lheh tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
en_kjv: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

tcz: Hijeh chun Esau in Jacob jah ahitin asei tai, “Kagil akel valtai na changchim hon salenglung chu them khat neipe tan” ati. Hijeh a chu amapa min Edom kisah ahi.
en_web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
en_kjv: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

tcz: Aphai, tin Jacob in adonbut in, “Amasa pen in na upat nahina chu neipe doh tan,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

tcz: Esau in hitin aseiye, “Keima gilkella thi dinga um ka hitan hiche mi upa chu ipi kaphat chom pi ding ham?”
en_web: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”
en_kjv: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

tcz: Jacob in asei kit in, “Amasa pen a naki hahsel angaiye,” hichun Esau chu aki hahsel tan mi upa ahina chu Jacob komma akijoh doh tai.
en_web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
en_kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware to him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Esau chu changlhah toh chang-noi apetan hichun aman anevan adon chim set'in akithou doh in achetai, Hichun Esau in mi upa ahina chu akijoh dohtai.
en_web: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
en_kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

tcz: Chuin gamsunga chun nasatah in kel ahung lhatan, hiche kel lhah chu Abraham damlaiya ahah tabang in, Isaac chu Gerar langa Philistine lengpa Abimelech heng a ache tai.
en_web: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
en_kjv: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistims unto Gerar.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in Isaac chu ahou limpin hitin aseiye, “Keima thusei ngaiyin, Egypt langa nache thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
en_kjv: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

tcz: Chule nangma hiche gam a hin gampam kholyin mi bang in um'in keiman hatah a phatthei kaboh ding nahi. Chule gam jouse hi nangma le na chilhahte jouse kapeh ding nahi, Ajeh chu keiman napa Abraham komma kaki hahselna kamolso tei ding ahi.
en_web: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
en_kjv: sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

tcz: Keiman na chilhahte van chunga ahsite jat banga kapun sah ding, hiche gam ho jouse hi kapeh ding, chule nangma chilhahte a konna vannoi mi jouse phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
en_web: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,
en_kjv: and I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi kabol ding ahi. Ajeh chu Abraham'in kathu angaiyin, kathu lhahna ahin, ka thupeh ahin, ka chondan thu ahin, chule ka danthu a nitsoh keiyin ahi.
en_web: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”
en_kjv: because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

tcz: Hichun Isaac Gerar gamma acheng tan ahi.
en_web: Isaac lived in Gerar.
en_kjv: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

tcz: Hiche gamma cheng miho chun Isaac jinu Rebekah chu koi ham tia adoh ule aman adonbut in, “Kasopinu ahi ati peh e,” ajeh chu hiche miho hin Rebekah jeh hin, “Keima eitha lo get uvinte tia anagel jeh a ka sopinu ahi anati ahiye. Ajeh chu amanu amelhoi jeh ahi.”
en_web: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”
en_kjv: and the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

tcz: Hinlah ni phabep jou chun Abimelech Phalistines lengpan bangkot a kon agahven ahile vetan Isaac in Rebekah aji bol'a akinoupi pet amudoh tai.
en_web: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistims looked out at a window, and saw, and behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

tcz: Hichun gang tah in Abimelech in Isaac chu akouvin, “Amanu chu na jinu hilou ham? ibola amanu chu ka sopinu ahe tia nasei ham?” Isaac in adonbut in, “Ka seina ajeh chu ahile ka innneipi jeh a koi tabang khat in eitha lo ding ham kati ahi.”
en_web: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”
en_kjv: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

tcz: Abimelech in aseiye, “Ipi dinga hiti pia chu neibol'u hitam? ilou themkhat in ka mite lah a khat touvin na jinu chu ana kipui hen ana luppi kha ta hen lang hileh nangma jeh a kei hon chonset lentah a neilhah sah ding'u hita chula em.”
en_web: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

tcz: Hichun Abimelech in danpi khat asem in mipi jouse henga aphong doh in ahi, “Koihi jong leh hiche mipa hihen ajinu hijong le ahin tongkha asuse aum leh thina chan a gotna kipe ding ahi.”
en_web: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
en_kjv: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Hiche kum chun Isaac in muchi akitun ahile kum dang sang in ajat jakhat val jena tamjon aki-aat e, hiti chun Pakaiyin ama phatthei ana boh'e.
en_web: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.
en_kjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.

tcz: Chua kon chun Isaac chu neile gou in ahung hao doh tan, anei le agou hatah in apun be cheh, apun be cheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
en_kjv: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

tcz: Hitobang chun neile gou keu hilouvin kelngoi jong, keltah jong, bonghon jong chule soh le kol jong tamtah ahin neitan, hiche ho jeh hin Phalistine miten nasatah in ahung engse tauvin ahi.
en_web: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
en_kjv: for he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistims envied him.

tcz: Hichun Phalistine miho chu athangthip jeh'un Isaac twikhuh jouse chu abonchan asuhbing peh tauvin ahi. Hiche twikhuh ho sese hi apa Abraham adamlaiya asohten ana laihou chu ahi.
en_web: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
en_kjv: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistims had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

tcz: Chuin Abimelech in achaina in Isaac komma aseiye, “Nangma keiho komma kon in chedoh tan ajeh chu nangma keiho sang in natha lhing jotai,” ati.
en_web: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
en_kjv: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

tcz: Hichun Isaac chu amaho komma kon in achen Gerar phaicham ah amaho ponbuh akison uvin hiche mun achun aching tauve.
en_web: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.
en_kjv: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in Apa Abraham thi jouva Palestine mipiten ana huhbing peh'u twikhuh ho sese chu alai hong kit'in apa Abraham'in ana minsah twikhuh min ho chu avel sah kit in asem hoisah kit tai.
en_web: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
en_kjv: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistims had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

tcz: Isaac sohten Gerar phaicham chu twikhuh alai uva ahile twisam phungkhat alai doh tauve.
en_web: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.
en_kjv: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

tcz: Ahin Gerar gamma kelngoi chinghon Isaac kelngoi chingho komma chun “hiche twikhuh hi keiho twikhuh ahi,” atiuvin a kinelpi tauvin ahi; hichun Isaac in hiche twikhuh chu “Esek” asah'in hichun avetsah chu “Kiboina mun,” tina ahi.
en_web: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
en_kjv: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

tcz: Hichun Isaac sohten twikhuh chom dang khat alai kit'un ahile hiche mun jong chu boina ahung um kittan hichun Isaac in “Sitnah” (Tichu kitomona mun tina ahi) asah tan ahi.
en_web: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.
en_kjv: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in hiche mun chu adalhan akichon in twikhuh chom beh khat alai kit in ahile hiche mun a vang chun akinahpi tapouvin ahi, hijeh chun Isaac in hiche mun chu “Rehoboth” asah tai. “Ajeh chu tun vang Pathen in eiho ding in gam eihon peh tauve, agamsung ahin eiho cha le nao vin pungjal tauhite,” ati.
en_web: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
en_kjv: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

tcz: Hiche mun a pat chun Isaac in Beersheba ah akichon kittai.
en_web: He went up from there to Beersheba.
en_kjv: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

tcz: Hiche jan lele chun Isaac henga Pathen ahung kilah in “Keima napa Abraham Pathen chu kahi, Imacha gichat na nei hih behin ajeh chu keiman nangma ka umpi jing nai, chule phatthei ka boh ding nahi, nason nachilhah te jong hatah a ka punsah ding amaho nam lentah ka soding ahi. Hiche hohi kasuh bulhing ding ahi. Ajeh chu ka sohpa Abraham koma kana kitep nasa ahi.”
en_web: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
en_kjv: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

tcz: Hichun Isaac in hiche mun achun maicham asem in Pathen ahou tai, chule aman aponbuh jong asongdoh kit in asohten twikhuh khat alaikit un ahi.
en_web: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
en_kjv: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

tcz: Ni khat chu Abimelech jong Gerar gamma pat na semangpa Ahuzzath chule asepai lamkai Phicol akipuiyin Isaac to kimuto dingin ahungtai.
en_web: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
en_kjv: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

tcz: Isaac in amaho chu adong in, “Ipi dinga ka henga hung nahiuven nei vetda uva nagam uva patna neino doh hitalou ham?” ana ti.
en_web: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
en_kjv: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

tcz: Ama hon adon but'un, “Keihon Pathen in nangma na umpi hi phatechan kamu chen tauve. Hijeh chun nangho le keiho kikah a kihou cham ding kanom ui, chule ikah uva kitepna khat sem kanom uve.
en_web: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,
en_kjv: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

tcz: Ahi theile ki hou cham na inei thei ding'u dei aum lheh e, keima hon jong nangho chunga imacha bolse pou ving'e, kei hon nang ho ka ngailu jing uve. Chule lung damsel a kasol doh joh nahiuve. Ven! tun nangho Pathen in nasatah in phatthei naboh tauve.
en_web: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”
en_kjv: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.

tcz: Hichun Isaac in kinopto na ankong nehkhom na asem in amahon abonchauvin anekhom un adonkhom un ahi.
en_web: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
en_kjv: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

tcz: Ajing in jingpi matah in akithou’ un amaho khat khat in kitepna anei uvin, hichun Isaac in amaho chu a in lam uva asolkit tan, amaho jong lunglhai sel in akinung le tauve.
en_web: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
en_kjv: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

tcz: Hiche ni ma ma chun Isaac sohten twisam thah khat alai doh'u chu thu ahung peuvin amahon aseiyun, “Keihon twisam thah khat kamu uve,” ahung tiuve.
en_web: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

tcz: Hichun Isaac in twisam thah chu Shebath asah tai. (Shebath tichu kinoptona tina ahi) Hiche nia patna chu tuni gei a hi Beershiba khopi kiti ahiye.
en_web: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.
en_kjv: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

tcz: Esau chu kum som li alhin chun Hit mite numei Beeri Judith le Hit mi mama Elon chanu Basemath chu ji ding in akipui jin ahi.
en_web: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
en_kjv: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

tcz: Amavang Esau ji teni chu Isaac le Rebekah din thoh lel aum lheh jeng lhon in ahi.
en_web: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
en_kjv: which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

tcz: Ateh a kho amu chen lou nung hin nikhat hi Isaac in achapa alenjo pachu akouve.
en_web: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

tcz: “Ka chapa! Keima hi ateh kahi tai, Itih thiding kahim kasei thei tapoi,
en_web: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
en_kjv: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

tcz: Hijeh chun tun nangma kigong in lang na man chah nathalpi kigot inlang gamlah a kei ding sa gakap'in,
en_web: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
en_kjv: now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

tcz: Chuteng le keiman kadu lamtah in hin lhonin lang hinchoi jin keiman kaneh ding chuteng le nangma hi kahinkho abei masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi ati.
en_web: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
en_kjv: and make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

tcz: Ahin Isaac le Esau kihou na chu Rebekah'in guhthim chan ana ngai jin hichun Esau chu gamleng ding a akon doh phat in;
en_web: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
en_kjv: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

tcz: Rebekah in Jacob jah'a hitin aseiye, “Ngaijin napa Isaac in na upa Esau hitin ahoulimpi kaja'e,” ati.
en_web: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
en_kjv: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

tcz: “Sa neiga delpeh inlang kadu lamtah in hinhon in lang hinchoi in keiman ne ingting chule Pathen masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi, kahinkho abei masang in,” ati.
en_web: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’
en_kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun kachapa ka thusei hi phatechan ngaiyin kathu sei hohi najui ding ahi.
en_web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
en_kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

tcz: “Nangma kelngoi hon lah a gachen lang ahoitah cheh anouni hinkai jin chuteng le keiman napa dulam tah a kahon peh ding,
en_web: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
en_kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

tcz: Hiche teng chule nangman napa komma nachoi ding aman aneh a aneh jou teng phatthei na boh ding ahi, ama ahinkho adampet ahi,” ati.
en_web: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
en_kjv: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

tcz: Ahin Jacob in anu Rebekah adonbut in ajah'a, “Vetem in ka upa Esau a tichung amul in ahin keima vou nem a timul lou ka hi.
en_web: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
en_kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

tcz: I kati ding ham? kapa in eihin jut le ta le jou a kabol ahin hetdoh leh koi phatthei chan sanga sapset na joh kachan joh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
en_kjv: my father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

tcz: Hinlah anu Rebekah in adonbut in, “Sapsetna ho aumle keiman abon'in keiman kipoh tang kate ati, chapa bol in ka ti hohi na bol angaiye, che inlang kelngoi chu ka henga hin kailut loiyin ati!”
en_web: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
en_kjv: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

tcz: Hichun Jacob jong achen kelngoi chu anu kom'a ahin kailut tai. Chuin anun jong apa dulam tah in ahon peh tai.
en_web: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
en_kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

tcz: Hichun Esau von holah a aphapen chu insunga kon in agala doh in achapa aneojo pa Jacob chu avonpeh tan ahi.
en_web: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
en_kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

tcz: Chule kelngoi nou teni mulchu akhut teni le angong amul bei lai achun atom peh in ahi.
en_web: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
en_kjv: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

tcz: Hichun Rebekah in sa twitah a ahon chule changlhah ama semsa chu achapa Jacob khut a apetan ahi.
en_web: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
en_kjv: and she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in changlhah le kelsa chu apa aga pen “Hepa” atileh aman jong “Hoiyo koipen nahim ka chapa?”
en_web: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
en_kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

tcz: Jacob'in a donbut in, “Keima Esau na chapa apeng masa chu kahi,” ati. “Keiman kahin subulhit tai nei nganse na chu lungset tah in kithou inlang ka hin choi sa twitah a kihon hi ne inlang phatthei neiboh tan,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in achapa chu adonbut in, “Iti dan ham? man gangtah in nahin vaidoh loijen in ka chapa atile aman jong adonbut in Pakai na Pathen in gangtah a eihin lolhin sah ahi bouve,” ati.
en_web: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”
en_kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.

tcz: Hichun Isaac in Jacob henga, “Hung ki khin nai jin katham phah thei nadin, nangma hi ka chapa Esau nahi mong nam nahi lou ham na jutle tem inge.
en_web: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
en_kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

tcz: Hijeh chun Jacob in apa Isaac anailut in ahile ahin jutle tan ahi, a awso hila Jacob awso ahin, akhut teni vang hi Esau khut ahi ngal in atin ahi.
en_web: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
en_kjv: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

tcz: Amavang Jacob ahi chu ahetchen thei lou ahitai, ajeh chu Jacob khut chu a upa Esau khut tobanga mul ahijeh'in hichun Isaac chun Jacob chu phatthei abohtan ahi.
en_web: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
en_kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

tcz: Isaac in adong pha kit leuvin, “Nangma hi kachapa Esau nahi mong hinam? atile, Jacob in adonbut in “Ka hinai,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
en_kjv: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

tcz: Chuphat in Isaac in aseiye, “Ka henga hindom naitan nangma phatthei kaboh thei na dingin kachapan gangtah a naga mat sa na hon chu ne ing kate,” ati, chuin Jacob in ahin doppeh phat in anen chule lengpitwi jong ahin dop peh in ahile Isaac chun adon tai.
en_web: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
en_kjv: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

tcz: Hichun apa Isaac chun ajah a “eihin nailut in lang neihin bengchop tem in ka chapa,” atile,
en_web: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
en_kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

tcz: Jacob'in anai phei jin apa chu abengchop tai, chuin Isaac kivonna ho gimnam chu anah le len chuin achapa chu phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Vetan kachapa gimnam hi Pakai phatthei bohsa gamlah gimnam abang'e.
en_web: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.
en_kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:

tcz: Tun Pakai Pathen in vana kon in daitwi na chap jing hen, leiset'a leipha lai lai nachan sah jing hen; chule chang le mim chule juning ninglhin sah jing hen.
en_web: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
en_kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, And the fatness of the earth, And plenty of corn and wine:

tcz: Nam simsen lou vin naja hen chule mihem tamtah nangma noija kun cheh hen lang, nasopi ho chunga vai hin hom jing in lang; nanu sunga peng doh pasal jouse jong na henga kun cheh uhen. Nangma na gaosapte chu gaosap chang hen, chule nangma phatthei na bohte chu phattheiboh chang hen!” ati.
en_web: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
en_kjv: Let people serve thee, And nations bow down to thee: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be he that blesseth thee.

tcz: Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh chai chai jin; Jacob in apa angsung agah dalhah ding kon chet in a upa Esau chu agam lena a kon in ahung lhung pai jeng tai.
en_web: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

tcz: Chuin Esau in jong nehding a althet in ahon peh in apa henga ahin dop peh apa jah a aseitai. “Hepa hung kithou in lang na hai hai pet'a phatthei neiboh na ding in na chapa thasa hi hung ne o!” ati.
en_web: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”
en_kjv: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

tcz: Ahin Isaac in adonbut in, “Nang koi nahim? Esau in adonbut in, “Na chapa apeng masa Esau kahi,” ati.
en_web: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
en_kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

tcz: Isaac hatah in ati akithing tan aseiye, “Koiham Ijo langa hin dom a hung achu, keiman ama hin dop chu kana ne tai. Nangma hung lhun masang jep chun phatthei jong ka boh jou tai; phatthei na jouse jong ama achang jou tai.”
en_web: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
en_kjv: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

tcz: Chuin Esau in apa thusei jouse chu angai chai sohhel phat'in Esau jong ha kan akap'in hatah in alunghang in apa komma atao kit'in, “Hepa keima jong phatthei nei boh teitei in ong,” ati.
en_web: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
en_kjv: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

tcz: Hinlah Isaac in aseiye, “Na sopipa ahung in eihung lhem lha tai, nang phatthei na chan ding jouse nalah peh gam tai.”
en_web: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
en_kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

tcz: Esau in adonbut in, “Hiche jeh a chu amin Jacob kisah hitei jinte ong? Ajeh chu aman nivei jen eilhep lhah ahitai, phat masa in ka upat hina eina lah peh in, tun ka phatthei chan ding ana kilah doh kit e, atin hichun keiya dinga phatthei khat beh jong neina khen pehlou hitam?” atile.
en_web: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”
en_kjv: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

tcz: Isaac in Esau adonbut in, “keiman Jacob chu nangma chunga vaihom ding in ka koi tai, chule asopite jouse ama noija kun cheh diu, chule chang le mim ahin, juning ahin, haothei na jong kapeh ahitai,tua hijat nunga nangma ipi kabolpeh thei nahlai ding ham kachapa?” atitai.
en_web: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”
en_kjv: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

tcz: Ahi vang'in Esau in apa jah a “O hepa phatthei na khat chabeh jong umlou hitam? phatthei neiboh teitei yin ong Hepa!” atin apeng in akap tai.
en_web: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
en_kjv: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lift up his voice, and wept.

tcz: Chuin apa Isaac in ahoupin ajah a “Nangma leichung phalou lah lah a cheng ding na hitan, chule van daitwi in jong hin chap khata ponte.
en_web: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.
en_kjv: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above;

tcz: Nangma na chemjam a naki vahding chule na sopipa noija na um ding ahin nangma na hung ki- ondoh teng vangleh nangong chang'a kona ama namkol chu na pai lhah ding ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”
en_kjv: And by thy sword shalt thou live, And shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, That thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

tcz: Hiche phat a pat chun Esau in Jacob chu hatah in ahin vetda pan ahi tai; ajeh chu apa Isaac in phatthei na jouse Jacob aboh jeh ahi. Chule Esau in alung thim sunga hitin agel tan, “Kapa hin nikho jong hi sotta pon tin a kichai teng le keiman ka naopa Jacob hi ka tha ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
en_kjv: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

tcz: Ahin achapa alenjo Esau lungthim tohgon jouse chu Rebekah jah a aki seidoh khatan ahin Rebekah in mi asol'in achapa neojopa Jacob chu aga kousah in ajah a asei pehtai, “Ngaiyin na upa Esau khun nang thana ding in lungthim tohgon anei tai,
en_web: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
en_kjv: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

tcz: Chapa chingthei tah in ngai jin, tun kigong inlang kasopipa Laban kom Haran langa jam tan.
en_web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
en_kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

tcz: Hiche mun achun ni ejat hijong leh ga umtan na upa Esau lungdam kahsen.
en_web: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—
en_kjv: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

tcz: Ama ahung lungdam a nabolset naho asuhmil hel'a ahung lungdam mong mong teng leh keiman mi hinsol ing ting nahung holdoh sah nang'e. Nang ni ucha nikhat a na manthah lhon ding ka nompoi.
en_web: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
en_kjv: until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

tcz: Hichun Rebekah in Isaac komma aseiye, “Keiman hiche Hit mite numei ho kathei chim behset jeng tai, Ijem tin Jacob in hiche numei ho jin ahin kipui kit ding ka gel thei poi kathi lo tei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”
en_kjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

tcz: Hichun Isaac in Jacob akouvin, phatthei aboh-in chule athu lhah in ajah a hitin aseiye, “Nangman hiche Canaan numei hohi jia nakipui thei louhel ding ahi;
en_web: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
en_kjv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

tcz: Hijeh chun gangtah in kipatdoh in lang Padan-Ram a nanu upa Bethuel in a chen chukom akon chun nanu sopipa Laban Chanute joh ga kipuitan.
en_web: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
en_kjv: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.

tcz: Pa Pathen in phatthei naboh hen lang nacha nanao tha lhinsah hen, na punsah hen, chule amaho chu nam lentah hung himaiyu hen.
en_web: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,
en_kjv: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

tcz: Pathen in nangma le nachilhahte chunga phatthei naboh uhen, napu Abraham kom a anaki tepna ho chu tua nangma na khopem nagam jong hi nahin losoh ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen in Abraham ana pehsa ahitai.
en_web: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”
en_kjv: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

tcz: Chule Isaac in Jacob chu asol mang tai, ama jong Padan-Ram langa Jacob le Esau hingnu Rebekah sopipa Syrian mi Bethuel chapa Laban henga ache tai.
en_web: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
en_kjv: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

tcz: Esau in ahechen tai apa Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh a Padan-Ram langa numei ji a gakipui dinga a phatsah a, chule phatthei aboh pet'a agihsal a “nangman hiche Canaan numei ho ji a naki pui thei lou ding ahi,” tia asei peh jong aja tai.
en_web: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”
en_kjv: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

tcz: Chule Jacob in apa le anu thu angaiya Padan-Ram lam ah achetai.
en_web: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.
en_kjv: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

tcz: Chule Esau chun apa Isaac in Canaan numei ho chunga a lunglhai poi ti ahe chen tai.
en_web: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
en_kjv: and Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

tcz: Hichun Esau jong apu Ishmael henga achen Abraham chapa Ishmael chanu Nebaioth sopinu Mahalath chu aji masa teni belap ding in aga kipui ben ahi.
en_web: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
en_kjv: then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

tcz: Chule Jacob in Beersheba chu adalhan Haran lang ajon tai.
en_web: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
en_kjv: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

tcz: Hiti chun gamkim lai khat ahung geidon hin nisan alhum den tai, hichun ama jong jan chun chukom muna ageh dentai, age na muna songho khat chu alan lukhap in aneiyin alumden tai.
en_web: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
en_kjv: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

tcz: Ama hiti chun alup lhah chun amang a kalbi saotah akido amun leiset apat vantham jol geiya kidolut amun, hichun Jacob in Pakai vantilte akaltou akumsuh jing u chu amun ahi.
en_web: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
en_kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

tcz: Chule kalbi achung langa chun Pakai adding in hitin aseiye, “Keima Pakai Pathen napu Abraham Pathen napa Isaac Pathen kahi. Tua naki choldo na mun hohi nangma leh nachilhahte kapeh doh ahitai.
en_web: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.
en_kjv: And behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

tcz: Na chilhahte chu tol'a leivui ja kaphahsah ding amaho chun solam, lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam aboncha ahin lodim soh dingu ahi, chule leiset chunga nangma le na insung mite jeh a vannoi phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
en_web: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
en_kjv: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

tcz: Itihchan hi jongle nangma ka umpi jing ding nache nachan a nikhat teng hiche gam'a hi kahin nung pui lut kit ding nahi, ajeh chu kaki tepna jouse ka suhbulhit masangse a donlouva ka koi louhel ding nahi.
en_web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
en_kjv: And behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

tcz: Hichun Jacob a emutna kona ahung khang doh in hitin aseiye, “Hikom ahin Pathen a um mong'e tihi kana hetphah lou ahi.”
en_web: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
en_kjv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.

tcz: Hinlah ama chu tijatnan adim in hitin aseiye, “Hiche lai mun hi Pathen in ahiloule thildang imacha ahi tapoi; chujong le hiche lai hi van gam kelkot phung ahi bouve,” ati.
en_web: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
en_kjv: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

tcz: Hichun Jacob jingkah matah in athouvin alukhap song chu alan khom phun aphut'in achunga chun thao twi asun khum in ahi.
en_web: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
en_kjv: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

tcz: Hiche mun chu Bethel asah tai, hichun avetsah chu Pathen hou in tina ahi; phat masalai chun Luz tin ana kihei.
en_web: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
en_kjv: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in kigahna khat aneiyin, “Keima Pathen in ei umpi jing le kakhol jinna hi kaneh ding bu chuleh sil le chen eipeh ding ahi,” ati.
