en_web: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
en_kjv: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

tcz: Chule keima kapa in damsel a ei nungpui lhung kitleh ama chu ka Pakai Pathen dihtah mong ahi tia ding det kahitai.
en_web: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,
en_kjv: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:

tcz: Chule hiche song khomphu a ka phudoh hi Pathen hou na in kiti ding ahi. Chuleh Pathen in eipeh jouse hi hopsom a hopkhat nangma kapeh ding ahi ati.
en_web: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
en_kjv: and this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

tcz: Hichun Jacob akhol che chu abanjom in solam mite gam chu ahung lhung tai.
en_web: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
en_kjv: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

tcz: Chuin aman agah ven ahile loulai a Twisam amun akomma chun kelngoi hon loi thum'a akol jong amun hiche gancha ho chu twikulla don ding twi ngah ahiuve, chule twisam chu songpi lentah in adal khum ahi.
en_web: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
en_kjv: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

tcz: Hitia chu kelngoi hon ho abonna ahung kisuh kimteng uleh kelngoi ching hon twikhuh kamsin songpi chu akhin doh jiuva kelngoi te twi achip sah jiuva achipva teng ule song chu akikoi na ngai ngai twikhuh kam a chu ale khin lut kit jiu ahi.
en_web: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.
en_kjv: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in amaho jah a “Sopite ho hoiya hung kon na hiu ham?” atile amahon adon but un “Keiho Haran gam'a hung kon ka hiuve,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

tcz: Amapan adong kit in amaho chu “Nahor chapa Laban chu nahet khah hih uvem?” atile “Amahon jong kahe nauve,” atiuve.
en_web: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in ajah uva “Ama chu dam dam a hinam? tia adohle amahon “henge adam jingnai ven tua hung kelngoi hontoh hung kilhon khu achanu Rachel hija khu,” atiuve.
en_web: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

tcz: Jacob in ama ho jah a “Tuhin nisa sangtah hinalai ja gancha hoi khom phat bon hilou lai, kelngoi hon chu twi chipsah uvin lang gavah pha uvin,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
en_kjv: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

tcz: Ama hon a donbut un, “Gancha ho jouse ahung kikim tokah in twi kipethei ponte atiuve, hichun kelngoi chingho chun songpi chu twisam kot apat chun atangdoh un kelngoi hon jouse twija ka vah va ding ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”
en_kjv: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

tcz: Amahon hitia akihou lim pet tah uchun Rachel chu apa kelngoi hon hotoh ahung ki jot luttai, Ajeh chu amanu jong kelngoi ching a pang ahiye.
en_web: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
en_kjv: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in anu sopipa Laban chanu Rachel le anu sopipa Laban kelngoite amu phat in anai lut in twikhuh kamsin songpi chu alih doh in apupa kelngoi hon chu twi achip sah in ahi.
en_web: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel chu abeng chop in awging tah in akap'e.
en_web: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
en_kjv: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

tcz: Jacob in Rachel jah a apa sopinu Rebekah chapa ahi thusim aseipeh tan ahile Rachel chu achen apa aga hetsah tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
en_kjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

tcz: Laban in Jacob asopinu chapa ahung lhun ahet chun akimu pin akoi jin achop jeng in chuin a in lama ahin puilut tai. Hichun Jacob in ima jouse thusimho chu aseipeh tai.
en_web: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

tcz: Chuin Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi kagu ka chang chule ka phevou mong nahi,” ati. Hichun Jacob chu apu Laban kom'a lhakhat sung aum tai.
en_web: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.
en_kjv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

tcz: Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi ka insung mi nahi vang'in mohseh a tohman beiya na um ding chu adih thei poi, natoh man ipi hiding ham neisei peh tem in? tin adong tai.”
en_web: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
en_kjv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

tcz: Laban in chanu ni aneiyin, alenjo nu min chu Leah ahin, chule aneojo nu min chu Rachel ahi.
en_web: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
en_kjv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

tcz: Ahin Leah mit chu aleng thim in ama vang Rachel chu amelhoi jin, amaiso jong lungset aum lheh jenge.
en_web: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
en_kjv: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

tcz: Jacob'in Rachel chu hatah in adeichat jeh in hitin aseiye, “Keiman nang ding in kum sagi na nei tohsah in lang, na chanu aneojo nu Rachel hi keima ji din kipui tang kate,” ati.
en_web: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
en_kjv: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

tcz: Laban in adonbut'in, “Hithei nante,” ati. “Ajeh chu keiman midang ho kapeh sanga nangma kapeh ding chu thilphajo ahibouve, Hijeh chun keima koma um jingtan,” ati.
en_web: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
en_kjv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in kum sagi sung in Rachel man toh kitoh ding in na atong tan, Hinlah Jacob in Rachel angailut behset jeh chun ni chomcha toh abahsah in ahi.
en_web: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
en_kjv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

tcz: Chujouvin Jacob in Laban jah a hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ho jouse ka subulhit tai, kajinu tun neipe tan ka luppi nom tai,” tin ahung thum tai.
en_web: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

tcz: Hichun Laban in jetle veija cheng ule nao jouse akou khom soh keiyin kichen na golvah chu aboltai.
en_web: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
en_kjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

tcz: Hinlah hiche jan ahung thim phat chun Laban in Leah chu Jacob koma aga that lut pehtan, Jacob in hichenu chu alup khom petai.
en_web: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

tcz: Laban in asohnu Zilpah jong chu Leah kithopi a pang ding in apeh tha tai.
en_web: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
en_kjv: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for a handmaid.

tcz: Ahin jingkah matah in Jacob ahung kitho leh Leah joh anahin, Jacob in Laban jah a aseiyin, “Ipi iti a hiti a hi neibol hitam? kum sagi nangma noiya na kana toh chu Rachel manding a katoh hilou ham? “Ibol a nei jou lhep ham? tin aseiye.
en_web: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

tcz: Laban in adonbut in “Kei ho chondana a unu umpet a hi anaonu jinei doh thei lou ahi.”
en_web: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
en_kjv: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

tcz: Hiche hapta khat sunghi ji nei dan hi subu lhit tadin, hiche teng chule Rachel jong kapeh ding na hi, ahin nangman kum sagi ma kana, natoh kit ding ahi ati peh e.
en_web: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”
en_kjv: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in Leah chu hapta khat lhing in akichen pin hiche jou chun Laban in Rachel jong ajinu ding in ape tai.
en_web: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
en_kjv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

tcz: Laban'in asohnu Bilhah jong chu achanu Rachel jenle a pang dingin apehtha tai.
en_web: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
en_kjv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel jong alup khom pitan, aman Rachel chu Leah sang in hatah in adei jon, hichun Jacob in kum sagi ma Laban na atong kit'in ahi.
en_web: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.
en_kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Leah kihot bol chu amudoh tan, hijeh chun anaobu ahondoh peh in, amavang Rachel chu aching in cha neilou in aum tai.
en_web: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
en_kjv: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

tcz: Leah vang chu achung agih tan; chapa khat ahing in amin Reuben asah tai, Ijeh in em itile, “Pathen in ka gimna ho eihet pehtai, hiche jeh a hi ka jipan eilungset ding ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”
en_kjv: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

tcz: Chuin aman nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing kit tai, ajeh chu “Keima eikihot bolhi Pakaiyin ajah doh phat'a chapa hiche jong hi eipeh kit ahiye,” Hijeh achu amin Simeon asah tai.
en_web: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
en_kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

tcz: Hichun Leah achung gih in, nao avop kittan ama nun hitin aseiye, “Tua pat'a hi ka jipa toh thakhat tipum khat kahi lhon ding ahi tai, ajeh chu keiman cha pasal thum ka hin pehtai hichun naosen chu amin chu Levi asah tai.”
en_web: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
en_kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

tcz: Chujouvin Leah in nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing in, “Tuchunga vang Pakai ka thangvah na ding ahi,” atin hijeh chun amin Judah asah tai, chujou a pat in vang cha abang tan ahi.
en_web: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
en_kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

tcz: Hichun Rachel'in Jacob cha ahinpeh lou akihet chet phat in a sopinu athangset pin, hijeh chun Jacob komma atao tan, “Keijong cha le nao nei hinpeh in achuti loule keima thi ding ka nom jotai atin ahi.”
en_web: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
en_kjv: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

tcz: Jacob chu Rachel chunga alung hang jah jeng in, “Keima Pathen ka hipoi ama ahi cha nei louva na koi, na naobu khah tan achu,” ati.
en_web: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
en_kjv: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

tcz: Hichun Rachel in adonbut in, “Kasohnu Bilhah hi galup khompi tan, chutile amanun nao eihin peh intin chua konna chu keiman jong ka chilhah insung kaki semdoh thei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
en_kjv: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

tcz: Rachel in Bilhah asohnu chu Jacob ji din apetai chuin Jacob'in Bilhah chu akitimat pitai.
en_web: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
en_kjv: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

tcz: Bilhah in nao ahinvop'in Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin peh tai.
en_web: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
en_kjv: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

tcz: Hichun Rachel in aseiye, “Pathen in ka lunggel eisu bulhit pehtai, chule katao na jong eisan peh in chapa eipe tai atin hijeh chun naosen min chu Dan asahtai.”
en_web: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
en_kjv: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

tcz: Chuin Rachel sohnu Bilhah chun nao avop kit in Jacob chapa anina ahin peh kittai.
en_web: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
en_kjv: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

tcz: Hichun Rachel'in, “Keiman ka sopinu toh hatah a kaki set delna lhon a keiman kajou tai,” atin hichun naosen min chu Napthali asah tai.
en_web: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
en_kjv: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

tcz: Leah in nao aneikit tah lou ding ahin kihet doh phat in asohnu Zilpah chu ji din ape tai.
en_web: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
en_kjv: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

tcz: Hijeh chun Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin pehtai.
en_web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
en_kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

tcz: Hichun Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob chapa anina chu ahin peh kitin ahi.
en_web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
en_kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

tcz: Leah chun aseiye, “Keiya din iti thanop um hitam, tua hi numei dang jousen hatah a eiki papi diu ahitai,” atin hiche naosen min chu Asher asah tai.
en_web: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
en_kjv: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

tcz: Nikhat Reuben chu suhlou chang vohlai in akon in ahile loulai achun *Joldei-Ai (Mandrake) amun anu Leah ahin poh peh in ahile, hichun Rachel in Leah koma “lungset tah in na chapa Joldei-Ai hinpoh chu kei jong nei hom thei ding ham tin athum tai.”
en_web: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
en_kjv: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

tcz: Hinlah Leah in Rachel jah a “Ka inneipu neilah peh jong thil neocha na bola, tua jong kachapa Joldei-Ai hinpoh jong lahpeh ding neiti ham?” atile Rachel in adonbut in, “Chuti ahile nachapa Joldei-Ai poh man ding in tujan Jacob'in nangma na lupkhompi thei nante,” ati.
en_web: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”
en_kjv: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

tcz: Hiche nilhah chun Jacob phailei lama kona ahung ki nungle phat in Leah achen aga kimu pin, “Tujan hi keima toh ilupkhom ding ahi, Ajeh chu tujan adinga ka chapan nao neitheina hinpoh a tujana dinga ka choh na hitai,” hichun Jacob chu hiche jan chun Leah to ageh lhontai.
en_web: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.
en_kjv: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

tcz: Pathen in Leah taona chu asan pehtan, nao ahin voptan Jacob chapa nga lhinna ahin neipeh tai.
en_web: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
en_kjv: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

tcz: Hichun Leah in asei tan, “ka sohnu chu kajipa ka pehdoh jeh in Pathen in ka choh doh man eipe tai,” atin hichun naosen min chu Issachar asah tan ahi.
en_web: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
en_kjv: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

tcz: Chujouvin jong Leah chun nao avop kit'in Jacob ding in chapa gup lhinna ahin peh kit tai.
en_web: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
en_kjv: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

tcz: Hichun Leah in asei tan, “Pathen in keima numei thilken phatah tah eiken peh tai, tuapat'in kaji pan ngailutna sangtah einei ding ahi tai, ajeh chu chapa gup kaneipeh tai,” hichun amanun naosen min chu Zebulun asah tai.
en_web: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
en_kjv: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

tcz: Ahin phat chomkhat jouvin nao numei khat ahingin amin chu Dinah asah in ahi.
en_web: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
en_kjv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Rachel chu asumil pon Pathen in ataona asanpeh in anaobu chu ahon pehtai.
en_web: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
en_kjv: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

tcz: Hijeh chun Rachel in jong nao ahin vop'in chapa khat ahin neitai; hichun Rachel in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in kaja chatna jouse asubeitai,” ati.
en_web: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
en_kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

tcz: Rachel'in anao min chu Joseph asah in hitin aseiye, “Pakaiyin chapa dang khat jong eihin sah kit teitei hen o!” ati.
en_web: She named him Joseph, saying, “May the LORD add another son to me.”
en_kjv: and she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.

tcz: Rachel in Joseph ahin neijou phat chun, Jacob in Laban koma asei tai, “Nei nungsol tan kagam lang uva,” ati.
en_web: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

tcz: Kajite kachate neipe dohtan phat sottah nangma in alhachan ka pangtan, tua hi keima ki nungle phat ahung hitai, chule ito banga nangma na katoh peh nahim nangman nakihet nai ati.
en_web: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
en_kjv: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

tcz: Ahin Laban in Jacob jah a aseiye, “Ahithei dingle lungset tah in neida lha hih in ajeh chu nangma ka insunga na hung lutna pat in Pathen in phatthei eiboh lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.”
en_kjv: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.

tcz: Chule Jacob in asei in, natoh man ding ijat ham neisei peh tan keiman kapeh ding nahi ati.
en_web: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
en_kjv: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in adonbut in, “Nangman na henai itobanga nangma na katoh a na gancha ho hung pung thei ham?” ati.
en_web: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

tcz: “Ajeh chu keima ka hung masang chun themcha bou na neijin tun apung jal tan, Pathen in hatah in phatthei na boh tan ahi. Ahile itih phat hi ding ham? keima insunga ding katoh na ding,” ati.
en_web: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
en_kjv: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

tcz: Chule Laban in adong kitin, “Ipiba ka peh ding ham? Jacob'in aseiye, Imacha neipe hih in, ahin thil khat neibol peh le chun keiman nagancha na vettup peh nang'e ati.
en_web: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
en_kjv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

tcz: Tun keiman na gancha kelngoi ho ga khol sohkei jing ting, amaho lah achun apol jouse hin lheng doh inting, chule keltah ho laha jong apol thim hihen hapol apol jouse hin lheng doh ingting, hichengse chu keima natoh man in neibol pehtan ati.
en_web: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.
en_kjv: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

tcz: Khonung teng kana toh man sutoh dinga nahung teng ka kitah na nahin muchen thei na dingin, kelchate lah a apol lou hihen, ha pol a pol lou akimu doh khah a, kelngoi lah a jong apol lou khattou aum khah a ahile hiche ho se chu nangma akona kaguh a kisim jeng thei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”
en_kjv: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted amongst the goats, and brown amongst the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

tcz: Hichun Laban in adonbut in, “Apha lheh jeng'e nangman nasei bang chu himai tahen,” ati.
en_web: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
en_kjv: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

tcz: Hinlah Laban in hiche nikho ma ma chun kelcha achal asandup apol, chule abeh beh a kang kelcha anu apol ho, chule kelngoi avom ho jouse chu achapa koma abon'in agathah doh sah sohkei in ahi.
en_web: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
en_kjv: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown amongst the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

tcz: Hichun aman Jacob to nithum jen lampi a kigam lat'in asol mangtai, chule Jacob in Laban gancha aki thah lou jouse chu aching jom jing tan ahi.
en_web: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
en_kjv: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in Almond le Shiga phung bah ho chu amal ngim in hiche thingbah avel akang lai ho chu kelcha ho amusah in ahi.
en_web: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
en_kjv: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in thingbah amal ngim hon chu kelngoi ho twi donna konga akoiyin, kelngoite twichip dinga ahung ji teng ule kijang matji ahi jeh uva akoi ahi.
en_web: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
en_kjv: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

tcz: Kelngoi ho chu thingbah akang lai masanga chu ki jang mat ji, chuteng chule kelngoite chun akang pol jong, hapol a pol jong ahin hing doh doh tauve.
en_web: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
en_kjv: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

tcz: Jacob in kelngoi ho chu ahoikhen in Laban kelngoi hon lah a akangpol ho leh avom ho chu ahoikhen in ama chan ding chengse chu atum in akhen doh in, Laban a lah achun ahoi lut tapoi.
en_web: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.
en_kjv: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

tcz: Hiti chun kelngoi lah a asapha ho chu aki jang mat teng ule thingbah ho amu uva, aki jang mat theina ding uvin Jacob in jong thingbah ho amasang uva twi lonna kom laiya aga jam peh jin ahi.
en_web: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;
en_kjv: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

tcz: Hinlah Jacob'in kelngoi atahsa phalou ho ahi tengle aga jamle jipoi, ajeh chu Laban a chu asapha lou jeng ahin, Jacob a vang chu asapha jeng ahiuve.
en_web: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
en_kjv: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

tcz: Hijeh chun Jacob chu ahung hao thei lheh tan, kelngoi tamtah ahin neitan, soh numei ahin soh pasal ahin tamtah aneiyin, chule sangan le sangangsao jong tamtah anei doh tai.
en_web: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
en_kjv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

tcz: Jacob in Laban chapate ama chung'a alung damlou'u thu aja tan ama hon aseiyun, “Jacob in ipau thil jouse akilah tan, chule anei agou athil keu jouse khu ipauva konna akilam doh ahi,” ati tauve.
en_web: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
en_kjv: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was of our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

tcz: Chujong le Jacob in Laban maiso aven ahile alung lhailou lungthim chom agel jong ahe chen tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
en_kjv: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and behold, it was not toward him as before.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Jacob chu ahoulimpin, “Nangma ki nungle kit tan, napu napa chule na sopite chenna gam'a kei man ka umpi jing ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in mi asol in loulam a akelngoi chin nauva Rachel le Leah aga kou sah tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
en_kjv: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

tcz: Chuin Jacob in hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka hechen tai, napa lhon maiso kavet le lungthim chom chom aneitai, masang tobang ahi tapoi, hijong le kapu ka pate Pathen in ei umpi jingnai.
en_web: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
en_kjv: and said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

tcz: Nangnin jong nahe lhon nai, katha nei sun kajo chan a napa lhon ding na toh ka tonge.
en_web: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
en_kjv: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

tcz: Hinlah aman eijou lhep tan, kanatoh man jong somvei tobang eikhel pehtai, amavang Pathen in keima chunga vang thil phalou imacha alhunsah pon ahi.
en_web: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
en_kjv: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

tcz: Aman hitin aseiye, gancha apol ho jouse chu nangma nikho tha man hitante atile gancha ho chu apol jeng ahe hatah in ahung pung tul tul kit tan, hichun aman alunggel akhel kit in gancha availang jenga pol ho atikit leh gancha anou jouse chu adung le avai langa pol bou apeng kit tai.
en_web: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
en_kjv: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

tcz: Hitia hi Pa Pathen in napa gancha ho jouse alah a keima eipehsoh ahitai.
en_web: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
en_kjv: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat jou kelngoite kijang mat lai in jan mang khat ka neiyin, ka khodah in ahile kelpi chunga kal doh kelchal ho chu apol hole adup ho aki timat piu ka mui.
en_web: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
en_kjv: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

tcz: Chuin hitia mang kanei petin Pakai vantil khat in eihin houpin Jacob eihin tin kenjong “Hoijo hikoma kaum e,” kati.
en_web: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
en_kjv: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

tcz: Chuin Pakai vantil chun dah inlang gahve temin, kelpi ho chunga kal doh kelchal ho khu apol, adup, akangpol, availanga pol jeng in amat e, Ijeh inem itile Laban in na bolsetna jouse keiman abonchan ka musoh keitai.
en_web: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
en_kjv: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

tcz: Keima na Pathen Bethel, muna song khom thao nanu a na kigah na Pathen chu kahi, tun kipat doh in hiche gam hi dalhan lang na penna gam langa kile kit tan.
en_web: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
en_kjv: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

tcz: Chuphat in Rachel le Leah in adonbut in, “Keinin imacha boina kanei lhonpoi; kapa lhon neile gou chanvou ka chan lhon ding um beh ham?”
en_web: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
en_kjv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

tcz: Aman dalpam mi a eigel lhon hilou ham? Ajeh chu aman eijoh doh lhon a keini kichoh na sum jouse jong eisuh mang peh tauve.
en_web: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
en_kjv: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

tcz: Chule nei le gou jouse Pathen in kapa lhona kon a alah mang peh ho jouse chu eiho le ichate ho a ahi bouve. Hijeh chun tun Pathen in najah a asei jouse chu ipi hi jongle bol jeng in,” ati lhon tai.
en_web: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
en_kjv: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

tcz: Hichun Jacob akipat doh in ajite le achate jouse chu Sangan chunga atoudoh sah soh kei tan;
en_web: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
en_kjv: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

tcz: Chule agancha ho jouse amasang lamuva ahoiyin Padan-Ram gam'a anei agou jouse aki suhtup in Canaan gam'a apa Isaac henga che dingin aumtai.
en_web: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Chuin Laban chu kelngoi mulvou dinga akon doh phat'in Rachel in apa insung semthu pathen chu ana kiguh mang tai.
en_web: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
en_kjv: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

tcz: Jacob'in jong Laban Syrian mipa chu alhem lhan in, ajam doh dingu jong aseipeh pon ahi.
en_web: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
en_kjv: And Jacob stale away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in anei agou jouse akipoh in Eupharate vadung apal galkai in Gilead thing lhang lam ahin jontai.
en_web: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
en_kjv: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

tcz: Ahin ni thum jouvin Jacob ajam mang tai tithu chu Laban ahin seipeh un;
en_web: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
en_kjv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

tcz: Chuin Laban in asopi ho cheng akou khom in, Jacob chu ahin nung del tauvin ahile, nisagi lhin ni chun Gilead lhang gamsunga ahin juilut tan ahi.
en_web: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
en_kjv: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Laban Syrean mipa chu jan in ana kimu pin hitin aseiye, “Kichih thei jin Jacob chu imacha nalo theilou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
en_kjv: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

tcz: Hichun Laban'in Jacob chu ahin phatan, chule Jacob in thing-lhang lah a chun apon buh akison tauvin, chuin Laban le a U anaoten jong Gelead thinglhang a Jacob to kigam lhat louvin aponbuh'u akison tauve.
en_web: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
en_kjv: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

tcz: Chuin Laban in Jacob jah'a aseiye, “Ibola hi tobanga hi neijou lhep hitam ati, chule iti dana ka chanu teni jong gal a sohchang ho banga na bol jeng ham?
en_web: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
en_kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

tcz: Ibola guhthim cha a najam mang uham? Ibol'a neijou lhep ham ati, chule nache ding iti dan a neihet sah lou beh ham? Neina hetsah le chun thupitah a kilhahna ankong le la a ngei tah tah kisan tin, tumging to kithoa kivai lhah ta dinga ati.
en_web: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
en_kjv: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

tcz: Nathil bol hohi ngolna in na dimset'e, ka chanu teni cha katute jong kabeng chop man tapon, kilhahna jong kana bol thei tapoi! ati.
en_web: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now have you done foolishly.
en_kjv: and hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

tcz: Tua hi nangma ka suhbei thei nahi, Hinlah napu napate Pathen in jan hi nilhah in eina kimuto pin gihna jong eineiyin Jacob chu na suhboi theilou ding ahi eiti!
en_web: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
en_kjv: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

tcz: Nangma lunggel na in lam a nache ding na thanop na chu ka hethem lheh'e, kham thei jong na hipoi, napa insung miho toh kimu to kal nanga lel jong kahe nai, Hinlah ibola ka Pathen houna doiphung chu naguh ham? ati.
en_web: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
en_kjv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

tcz: Jacob in adonbut in, “Keiman nangma kana ging lheh in ahi, ajeh chu nang ma in, nachanu teho chu namphu a nei lah peh ding ham tia kana gel ahi.
en_web: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
en_kjv: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

tcz: Amavang nadoi bom vang chu ahile nang man hol in lang namu doh thei leh namu na michu koi hile ahinkho subei jeng tan ati, chule nangma thil ho jong keima sopiho in anala kha aumle kanung peh ding nahi; Jacob in vang Rachel in analah chu anahet lou ahi.
en_web: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
en_kjv: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

tcz: Laban chu Jacob ponbuh a ache masa pen in doibom hol in, aban'in Leah kom ah, hiche jou chun Leah soh teni komah achen Hinlah imacha amudoh pon, achaina in Rachel pon buh a alut in ahi.
en_web: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
en_kjv: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

tcz: Rachel in apa insung doibom chu ana ladoh in Sangan pho kah a chu ana sel'a chule achunga chu ama ana tou ahi, hichun Laban in ponbuh sung aning akah aphet vang'in imacha amudoh tapon ahi.
en_web: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
en_kjv: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

tcz: Ama nun apa komma asei tai, “Lungsettah in nei ngaidam in ka Pakai keima numei hina lhinna kanei jin kadin theilou ding ahi,” Laban vang ahol chu atang dehpon amavang insung doibom chu amudoh pon ahi.
en_web: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
en_kjv: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

tcz: Hichun Jacob hatah in ahung lunghang tan Laban apupa jah'a asei tan ahi, “Keima ipi ka guchat na ka jonna umham atitan, chule ipi mong kabol khel a hichan geiya hi ka nung neihin del a keima migucha banga nei bol hitam?
en_web: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
en_kjv: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

tcz: Nang man kanei kathil koina jouse naphet in aning akah geiyin, twin neivet sah in ipi na khol doh ham nang thil, hinpo doh in sopi ule nao ho masang laitah ahin amahon eini kah lah a thutanna neimaiyu hen ati.
en_web: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
en_kjv: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

tcz: Nangma koma kum som ni na gancha ho kana vettup peh in, na gancha ho kelngoi ahin na kelcha ho ahin imacha boina ana umpon hiche kum hijat kana vettup sunga chun kelngoi khat jong kana kilah khapoi.
en_web: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
en_kjv: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

tcz: Keiman gamsa in, gancha ho athasa jong kahin polut khapon, athi amang ho jong keima nikho tha to suhto din kana boljin, gancha ho sun hileh jan hileh amang ho jouse chu keima lhalo toh suhto din neikah pehjin ahi.
en_web: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
en_kjv: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

tcz: Hiche hi keima dinmun ana hi, Hitipi chun sun teng nisan eihal vampai gon, jan tengle dap kathoh jin, kamit tenin la kei eimut na him him amupha pon ahi.
en_web: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
en_kjv: Thus I was in the day, the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

tcz: Hitobang achu kum somni nangma insunga kana kiman chah ahi. keiman kum som le kum li nangma insunga lhacha in ka na pang in, na chanu teni lona in kum gup ka na tohbe in gancha ho lona in chule kana toh man somvei tobang neikhel peh in ahi.
en_web: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
en_kjv: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

tcz: Kapate Pathen, Abraham Pathen, kapa Isaac ginpa chun eipanpi lou hile tua hi nangman khut keohel tah bah a neina solmang ding ahitai. Pathen in ka gentheina le kakhut tah a katoh gimna hi amua jan nilhah a chu na gihsal ahiye,” ati.
en_web: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
en_kjv: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

tcz: Hichun Laban in hitin Jacob adonbut in, “Hiche numei hohi ka chanu ahin, hiche chapang hojong kachate katute ahi, chule gancha ho jouse jong abonna keima gancha ahi. Chule ipi hitale namu phah chan hi aboncha keiya jeng ahi cheh nai. Amavang keiman tua hi ka chanute chule achate ho chunga ipi kabol ding hitam ati.
en_web: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
en_kjv: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

tcz: Hijeh chun hung in eini kikah a kitepna nei hite hichun eini eikan khom cheh lhon ding ahi.”
en_web: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”
en_kjv: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in hetjing nading in song khom khat aphut dohtai.
en_web: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
en_kjv: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in asopi ho lah a aseiyin, “Songho hin chom khom un,” ati, amahon song chu khat chunga khat asethop un, hichun Jacob le Laban song kise thop komma atou lhon in kitepna ankong chu anekhom lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

tcz: Songlhuh kise chu Laban in Jegar-sahadutha asah-in, hiche ma ma chu Jacob'in Galeed asah-e.
en_web: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
en_kjv: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

tcz: Hichun Laban in, “Tuni nikhoa hiche song lhuh hi kei le nang kah a sakhia panga ahi tai,” tia, hiche jeh chun amin jong Galeed asah in ahi.
en_web: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
en_kjv: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

tcz: Hiche mun jong hi Mizpah akiti tai, aman aseiyin, “Ajeh chu nangma le keima jong khonung teng jong leh gamla tah a umjongleh hen Pathen in ei umpi jing lhon hen.”
en_web: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
en_kjv: and Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

tcz: Ka chanute ho nahin suh genthei ja numei dang ho jia nahin kipuiya ahile, koima chan muhih jongle abonchan Pathen in amusoh keiye, Pathen hi nangle kei kikah a kitepna a hiche thua hi pang jing ding ahi.
en_web: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
en_kjv: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

tcz: Hiche song athopma kise ho hi Jacob in Laban jah ah, “Vejing in kei le nang kah a kihet themna hijing ding ahi tai.
en_web: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
en_kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

tcz: Hiche song kise thop hile songphu hi sakhia a pang ahin, ken jong nangma suse dinga hiche hi kahin khokhel lou hel ding, nang in jong keima suse dinga hiche hi nahin khokhel louhel ding ahi.
en_web: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
en_kjv: this heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

tcz: Abraham Pathen, Nahor Pathen chule amani pa-Pathen chu eini kah a thutan ding ahi tai,” ati. Hijeh chun Jacob jong apa Isaac ginpa min akihahsel tai.
en_web: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
en_kjv: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in hiche molchunga chun Pathen henga maicham asem in kitepna ki hetthem na ankong jong asem in, an neh anei jou u-chun hiche jan machun molchunga chun ageh tauve.
en_web: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
en_kjv: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

tcz: Jacob chu akhol jinna amachal jing in, chule Pakai vantilten analam touvin ahi.
en_web: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
en_kjv: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

tcz: Jacob in amaho amu chun hitin aseyin, “Hilai mun hi Pathen ki choldo na mun ahi,” ati. hiche mun chu Mahanaim asah tai.
en_web: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
en_kjv: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Seir gamsunga Edom gamkaiya a upa Esau henga ding in thupo ding in mi asol masan.
en_web: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
en_kjv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

tcz: Aman hitin athumop in, “Kapu Esau kom ahi tia hi nasei ding ahi. Na sohpa Jacob in hitin aseiye, tuni gei hin Laban komma kaum jing nalaiye.
en_web: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
en_kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

tcz: Keiman gancha bong hon ahin, sangan hon ahin, kelngoi hon ahin, kelcha hon ahin, sohle kol jong tamtah ka neitai. Tua ka Pakai pa masanga ka hung tao ahi hichu nangma mitmun ngailut kachan thei nading tia nangma seipeh dinga mi ka hinsol ahiye ati, tin ga seitauvin,” ati.
en_web: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
en_kjv: and I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

tcz: Thu hettoh sah ho ahung ki nungle chun, Jacob komma hitin asei un, “Nasopi pa kaki muto piuvin, tua hi ama nangtoh kimuto ding in mi sang li toh ahung kon doh in ahi.”
en_web: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”
en_kjv: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

tcz: Ahin Jacob chu hiche thu ajah chun akicha lheh tan, hichun aman a insung mite ahin, gancha kelngoi ho jouse ahin, keltah ho se chule sangongsao hose ahin hop nin ahom khen in ahiye.
en_web: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
en_kjv: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

tcz: Jacob in hitin agel lin, “Esau vin honkhat chu ahung bulu tah jongle honkhat pa beh asocha theiye,” ati.
en_web: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
en_kjv: and said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

tcz: Hichun Jacob ataovin, “Vo kapu Abraham Pathen, kapa Isaac Pathen, O ka Pakai, “Nagam langa ki nungle kit tan, na sopite lah atin neina houlim pin, keiman nang ding in aphat phat nan bol peh nang'e, tia seiya chu nang ma nahi.
en_web: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
en_kjv: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

tcz: Nasohpa na mi ngailut na, long louva na kitah na ho chu keima chang thei ka hipoi. Ajeh chu ka tenggol keoseh puma hiche Jordan hi hung galkaiya kahin, tun mehem loini lhingset ka lamdoh tai.
en_web: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
en_kjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

tcz: O ka Pakai lungset tah in ka sopipa Esau khut a kon in nei huhhing teiyin, keima kati aja lheh jeng'e; Ajeh chu aman kajite ho chule ka chate ho jong eihung no khum ding ahi tai.
en_web: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.
en_kjv: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

tcz: Hinlah nangman, nang ding in aphat phat nan bolpeh nange, na chilhah te jeng jong twikhanglen panga neldi jat hin phantin, tam behseh jeng a kisim jou lou ding ahi,’ tin nana kitep e,” ati.
en_web: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
en_kjv: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

tcz: Jacob chu hiche muna chun ajan geh in athil poh ho lah achun alhengdoh in Esau asopipa peh ding in,
en_web: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
en_kjv: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

tcz: Kelpi jani, kelchal somni, kelngoipi jani chule kelngoi chal som ni toh,
en_web: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
en_kjv: two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

tcz: Sangongsao pi som thum toh, anoute se toh, bongpi somli toh, bongchal som toh, sanganpi somni toh, chule sangan chal som toh alheng doh e.
en_web: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
en_kjv: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in hiche gancha ho chu hopni in ahom in amaho vekol ding chun soh khat cheh anganse in, hichun asoh ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Nanghon hiche gancha hotoh hin keima masanglam a che tauvin Hinlah gancha hon teni kikah a chun mun ong umsah un,” ati.
en_web: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
en_kjv: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

tcz: Hichun ama hon lamkaipa jah achun hitin aseiye, “ka sopipa Esau to na kimuto lhon teng aman thu na hin doh teng, nangho hi hoilam jon ding na hiuvem? chule nangho koi gam mi na hiuham? tua gancha ho ahung masa ho chu koiya ham? ahin ti teng leh,
en_web: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
en_kjv: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

tcz: Hiche teng chule hitia hi amaho na donbut dingu ahi, “Hiche gancha ho se hi na sohpa Jacob ma ahi, amaho hi kipa thilpeh adia kapu Esau a dinga kahin poh ahiye. Chule ama jong kanung lam uvah ahung e,” tiuvin ati.
en_web: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
en_kjv: then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and behold, also he is behind us.

tcz: Hiti chun Jacob in soh masa pa athuhil bang chun anina pa ahin, athum napa geiyin gancha ho vetup lamkai jouse chu asei peh cheh tan, “Esau toh nakimu to tengu le na thusei hou chu ki bang cheh ding ahi.”
en_web: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
en_kjv: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall you speak unto Esau, when you find him.

tcz: Chujong le vetan na sohpa Jacob jong kei ho nunga ahung'e,’ tia na seipeh ding'u ahi,” atin ahi. Ijeh inem itile Jacob gel a chu, “Ka masanga kitol thilpeh chengse hin ama jol lung dam thei khat ingting, ajou teng amai kamu thei ding ahi; ijem atile bon eina sang jeng khat inte,” tia angaito ahi.
en_web: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
en_kjv: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

tcz: Jacob in ngailut thilpeh ho chu ache masang in asol tan ahi, amavang hiche mun achun ajan geh in akhovah den tai.
en_web: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
en_kjv: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

tcz: Hiche jan chun Jacob in ajite ni chule asoh teni chule achate pasal som le khat chu athoudoh tan Jabbok vadung chu agal kai pitan ahi.
en_web: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
en_kjv: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in amaho chutoh vadung agalkai phat chun anei agou jouse toh asol tan ahi.
en_web: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
en_kjv: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

tcz: Hichun Jacob chu achanga adalha tauvin, pasal khat in ama chu khovah geiyin akibot pin ahi.
en_web: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
en_kjv: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

tcz: Pasal akibot pipa chun ajolou ding phat chun Jacob akonggu ahomlai tah chu asuhboh pehtan ahi.
en_web: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.
en_kjv: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

tcz: Hichun pasal mihem pa chun aseiye, “Nei lhatan kho hungvah ding ahitai.” Amavang Jacob in adonbut in, “Phatthei neiboh toh kah a nangma kalha lou ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
en_kjv: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

tcz: Mihem pasal pa chun adong in, “na min ipi ham? ati, hichun aman adonbut in, “Jacob ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
en_kjv: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

tcz: Mihem pa chun adonbut in, “Na min hi Jacob hitalou ding, tua patna Israel kiti ding nahitai. Ajeh chu nangma Pathen to na kibot in jong na hat in, mihemte jong na hinjo ding ahi,” atipeh e.
en_web: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
en_kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

tcz: Jacob in adong in, “Lungset tah in na min neisei peh in,” ati, mipa chun adonbut in, “Ibola kamin chu nahet nom ham,” ati. Hichun aman Jacob chu hilai mun a chun phatthei abohtan ahi.
en_web: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.
en_kjv: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in hiche mun chu Peniel asahtai. “Ajeh chu keiman Pathen kaki maito pitan chule kahin kho jong ei huhdoh peh in ahi.”
en_web: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
en_kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

tcz: Jacob in Peniel adalhah chun nisa ahung soh dohtan ahi, ajeh chu akonggu anat jeh ahi.
en_web: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
en_kjv: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun tuni geihin Israel chaten akonggu to kijop matna khelgu hon sunga thapigui hi anepouve; ipijeh inem itile aman Jacob konggu hom sunga thapigui ana hebal peh in ahi.
en_web: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
en_kjv: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

tcz: Hichun Jacob akhodah in avet a ahile “Ven Esau chu mihem jali jen to ahung amu tan,” chuin Jacob in jong achate chu Leah le Rachel chule asoh numei teni ahop peh soh keiyin,
en_web: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.
en_kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

tcz: Hichun asoh numei le achate ho jouse amasat sah in, abanin Leah le achate achesah in, chule achaina in Rachel le Joseph apansah e.
en_web: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
en_kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

tcz: Chuin Jacob ama mong mong amaho jouse masanga chun achen, aupa heng ahin phah toh kahsen sagi vei jen tol'a abohkhup in ahi.
en_web: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
en_kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

tcz: Hichun Esau alhai phei jin apum koijeng in, chule angong koiya achop a ahile ani lhon in aki ka lhon tai.
en_web: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
en_kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

tcz: Hichun Esau in numei ho chule achate ho chu aven adong in, “Amaho hi koi hiuva ham,” ati. Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche chapang hohi Pathen in na sohpa phatthei eibohna ahi,” ati.
en_web: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”
en_kjv: And he lift up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

tcz: Hichun soh numei teni le achate hon ahin nailut un Esau masanga chun abohkhup tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
en_kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

tcz: Leah le achate jong ahung nai lut uvin abohkhup'in asalam uve; chule anu khah pen in Joseph le Rachel ahung nailut lhon in abohkhup lhon in salam abol lhon tai.
en_web: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
en_kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

tcz: Esau in adong tan, “Ahile hiche kahin kitopi gancha honpi chu ipi na bolna ham,” ati. Jacob'in adonbut in, “Nangma masang'a lunglhai na kamuna tei ding kati ahi,” ati.
en_web: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
en_kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

tcz: Esau in adonbut in, “Kanao keiman jong tamtah kanei nai ati, nangma thil chu nang ding in ki koi tan,” ati.
en_web: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
en_kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

tcz: Ahin Jacob in asei teiyin, “Nangman hiche kipa thilpeh hohi nalah louva hithei lou ahi, keiman nangma mai kamu hi Pathen mai mu tobang kahi, nangma mai kamu theiya nanui awgin kajah hi thina akona galkai kahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
en_kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

tcz: Lungset tah in hiche thilpeh hohi neisan peh teiyin, Pathen in ka ngaichat jouse eipe tai, hichun Jacob'in ahasei behset jeh chun Esau chun thilpeh ho chu asang tai.
en_web: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
en_kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

tcz: Esau in aseiye, “Aphai atitai, keiman na lamkai jing ting eini che ta hite.”
en_web: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”
en_kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

tcz: Jacob'in adonbut in, “Ka Pakai neihet them peh mai jin, chate ho hi alhasam thei lheh na laiyun, gancha bongnou hole kelnou ho jong api hontoh ki khen thei lou lai ahiuvin, nikhat sunga hatah in kihoi pai taleh gancha honte aboncha thigam jeng thei ahiuve.
en_web: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
en_kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

tcz: Hijeh chun lungset tah in na sohpa masanga kapu ana masa jeng in lang keiman olcha chan ka masanga gancha ho ki kalvan bang ule chapang te kikalvan bang bangu hin, Seir gam'a kapu heng kahin phah kah sen hung nange ati.
en_web: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
en_kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

tcz: Apha lheh jenge tin Esau in adonbut in, “Hinlah ka miteho them khat tou dalhang kating nangho lam hil ding chule boina le hahsat na a pan lathei ding ati, Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche hochu ngai ponte, lungset umtah'a kapu neina lamdot hi alhingset in ka sange,” ati.
en_web: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
en_kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

tcz: Hichun Esau chu aki nunghei jin Seir gam jon ding chun hiche ni mama chun achekit tai.
en_web: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
en_kjv: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

tcz: Jacob vang chu ahile Succoth lama achen hiche muna chun inlim gancha ho din asong in, chule ama chenna ding in jong in aki sahtai. Hiche jeh a chu hiche mun chu Succoth kiti ahi. (Succoth tichu chenna mun tina ahi).
en_web: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
en_kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Jacob chu Padan-Ram lammah kon in Shechem Canaan gam ahung lhung tan, hiche khopi phah masanga chun ngah mun khat asem kit tai.
en_web: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
en_kjv: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

tcz: Jacob'in Shechempa Hamor chate khut akon chun gam leiset phabep sum (Qesitah*) jakhat in aki choh in hikom achun ponbuh akison tai.
en_web: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
en_kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

tcz: Hichun aman maicham atungdoh in amin chu *El-Elohe Israel asah tai.
en_web: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
en_kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-Elohe-Israel.

tcz: Jacob le Leah chanu Dinah chu nikhat apot doh in hiche gam'a cheng numei khangthah hotoh kimuto din achen ahi.
en_web: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
en_kjv: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

tcz: Ahin hiche gam'a lengpa chapa Shechem Homar Hivite kitipa chun Dinah chu aman in aluppi tan ahi.
en_web: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
en_kjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

tcz: Ahin amapa chun ahin ngailu lheh tan, hichun aman thudihtah a kihou limpi a nopsah ding chu adei lheh tai.
