en_web: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
en_kjv: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

tcz: Shechem in apa Homar jah a asei tan, hiche numei nuhi neipui peh un kaji din ka deiye ati.
en_web: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
en_kjv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in thusoh aja tan Shechem in Dinah aluppia asuhset chu ahe tan, ahin Jacob in achate gamlah a gancha ho ching ahi jeh u chun amaho ahung lhun angah in kam chang khat jeng cha jong akeh poi.
en_web: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
en_kjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

tcz: Hamor Shechem pachu Jacob henga kihoulim ding in ache dohtai.
en_web: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
en_kjv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

tcz: Chuin Jacob chate loulam akon in ahung lhung tauvin amahon hiche thuho ajah uchun alung nommo lheh un kidang jong asa lheh uvin hatah in alunghang uvin, asopinu Dinah Shechem in asuhset na Jacob insung asuhboi chu bollou ding khat ahiye atiuve.
en_web: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

tcz: Hamor in Jacob le achate aki houlim pin, aman aseiye, “Kachapa Shechem in na chanu alungset lheh jeng in ahi, lungset tah in amani chu ki chensah uhite.
en_web: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
en_kjv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

tcz: Ahithei dingle eiho chate kila tou hite, kei hon nangho chanu ho kipui uving kating, keima ho chanute ho jong nangho chapate ho din kipui un ati.
en_web: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
en_kjv: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

tcz: Hiche gamsunga hi ichen khom theiyu ahi, chule khosa uvin bolthei toh thei tong un, na nop chanu neile gou jong na kilam theiyu ahi.”
en_web: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
en_kjv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade you therein, and get you possessions therein.

tcz: Shechem chu Dinah sopiho le apa jah a ataotan, “Lungset tah in nei khotou vin, ahithei ding le kaji din kaki pui nom e chule nangma hon na thum channu chu keiman ka peh ding na hiuve.”
en_web: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
en_kjv: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

tcz: Numei nu chu kaji dinga nei peh pou ule keiman ipi thilpeh hijongle suhto thei ding alen aneo hileh kapeh ding ahi ati.
en_web: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
en_kjv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

tcz: Hinlah Shechem in Dinah ana luppi a asuhset tah jeh chun Jacob chate chun Hamor le achapa Shechem chu lungpha lou tah in ahoulimpi tauve.
en_web: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
en_kjv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, “Hiche hi keima ho moh nop lhah thei ka hi pouve, Ajeh chu nangho hi chep tanlou na hiuvin, ka sopinu'u nanghon nakipui dingu chu keiho dinga jachat umtah khat hung hi ding ahi.
en_web: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
en_kjv: and they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

tcz: Hinlah kihou cham theina khat vang aum'e, hichu ahileh na pasal ho jouse achep na tan thei diu le atiuve.
en_web: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
en_kjv: but in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

tcz: Hiche teng chule ka chanu teho'u kapeh theiyu, chule nang ho chanu ho jong keima hon jong kaki pui thei dingu ahi atiuve.
en_web: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
en_kjv: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

tcz: Ahin nangho pasal hon acheptan ding anop lou ule ka sopinu'u ka peh theilou dingu ahi atiuve.
en_web: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
en_kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

tcz: Hamor le achapa Shechem chun amaho thilgon chu pha asa lhon in ahi.
en_web: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
en_kjv: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

tcz: Shechem chu alunglhai lheh in bol ding ho chu agei sang tapon, ajeh chu Dinah Jacob chanu adei behset jeh chun Shechem chu amaho insung milah a jathei umdol tah khat ahi.
en_web: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
en_kjv: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

tcz: Chuin Hamor le achapa Shechem khopi kelkot a ahung lhon in mipi ho laha aki hou na'u kinop tona ho chu ahung phong doh lhon in hitin asei lhon in ahi.
en_web: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
en_kjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

tcz: Ama nin aphong doh lhon in hiche miho hi mipha eiho mi ahi ati lhon e, veuvin gam jong lentah enei uvin amaho chenna thei ding, amaho toh chengkhom uhitin, bolthei thei bol uhitin, eihon jong amaho chanute ijon thei ding'u chule amahon jong eiho chanute aki chenpi thei dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.
en_kjv: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

tcz: Amaho toh eiho ichen khom thei na diuvin thil khat aum e, hichu ahileh eiho pasal jouse amaho banga chep ekitan tengu le ichen khom thei ding'u ahi.
en_web: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
en_kjv: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

tcz: Hinlah thilpha khat ihet dingu chu ichen khom tengule, agancha hou, anei agou hou jouse aboncha a eiho a hung hithei ahi. Hijeh chun amahon adei atup ho chu bolpeh leuhen amaho jong eiho lah a chen ding tha nom tah a hung cheng diu ahi tai.
en_web: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
en_kjv: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

tcz: Hichun khopi sunga cheng aching athem jouse Hamor le achapa Shechem thupeh chu anom cheh tauvin, chule pasal jousen achep akitan soh hel tauvin ahi.
en_web: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
en_kjv: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

tcz: Ahin nithum jou don chun amaho cheptan na maha jong damtheng loulai in Jacob chateni Simon le Levi a sopinu Dinah toh peng khom teni chu ahung kon lhon in hiche khopi sunga pasal jouse chemjam in asat lih lhontan ahi.
en_web: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

tcz: Hiche athi ho lah achun Hamor le achapa Shechem jong ajao lhon tai, Hichun Dinah chu Shechem in muna kon in amaho inlam a ahin pui lhon tan ahi.
en_web: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
en_kjv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou in Jacob chate ho ahung lhung cheh tauvin, amahon khopi sunga mipi athi amang akithat ho chu asopinu u ki suhthang na khopi chu achom theng hel uve.
en_web: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
en_kjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

tcz: Amahon akelngoi hou ahin, abongchal hou chule sangan ho jouse phaicham khopi sungle tollhang a thil keo jouse akilah tauve.
en_web: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
en_kjv: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

tcz: Anei agou jouse jong alah peh soh keijun, amaho jite chate jong alah peh un, amaho hetkhah nalouva apui mang tauve.
en_web: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
en_kjv: and all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

tcz: Jacob in phat chomkhat jouvin Simon le Levi koma hitin aseiye, “Keima hi neisuh mang lhon ahi tai, hiche gam mite le Canaan mite le Perizzites mite koma hin ka namse in ka ui lheh tai. chule eiho lhomcha ihiuvin amaho ahung kihou toh tengule eiho eisuh mang dingu ahi. keima kahin ka insung pumpi kaki chai helding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, amongst the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

tcz: Ama hon lung hang tah in asei jun, “Ipi bol'a chu isopinu u chu numei kijoh banga abolset ham?” atiuve.
en_web: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
en_kjv: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Jacob ahoulimpin, “Kithouvin lang Bethel lama kinungle kit inlang hikom a chun gacheng tan, chule na upa Esau koma nahung jampet'a nahenga hung kilah Pathen ding chun hikoma chun maicham khat gasem in,” ati.
en_web: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
en_kjv: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in a insung mite ahin midang akoma cheng ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Doiphung jouse pai mang un, natahsa kisuhthengun, vonthah kivon un,
en_web: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
en_kjv: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

tcz: Tua eiho Bethel lama iche diu Pathen henga maicham ka semding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai in ka hahsat laitah a kataona eisan pehin, Ama in kache na kalam jotna jouse a eiumpi jinge ati.
en_web: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
en_kjv: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

tcz: Hichun amahon gamdang mite indoi akoi jouseu chule abil uva abilba u abonchan Jacob apeuvin ahile Jacob'in abonchan Shechem nai vel'a gangpi phungnoi khat ah agavui mang tai.
en_web: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
en_kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

tcz: Amaho ahung kon doh uchun Pathen a kona tijat na mipi adimun, hijeh chun Jacob insung mite bulu din koimacha ahung kondoh ngam tapoi.
en_web: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
en_kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

tcz: Jacob le a insung mite Luz kiti mun hichu Bethel Cannan gam sunga um ahi. (Bethel ti chu Pathen in tina ahi).
en_web: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
en_kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.

tcz: Chule hikom'a chun Jacob in maicham khat asem in, hiche lai mun chu EL-Bethel asah in ahi. Ajeh chu aupa henga kona ahung jam doh a chu hikoma chu Pathen ama among mong ahenga hung kiphong ahi.
en_web: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
en_kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

tcz: Rebekah jenle nu Deborah athi a chu Bethel noiya gangpi phungnoi khat ah ana kivui ahin, hiche jeh a chu hiche min chu lhilon na gangpi phung kisah ahiye.
en_web: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
en_kjv: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Jacob Padan-Arama kona ahung chun ana kimuto pi kitin, chuin Bethel muna Pathen in phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
en_web: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
en_kjv: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

tcz: Pathen in ahoulimpin ajah'a, “Namin hi Jacob ahin tunia patna hi nangma Jacob na kiti talou ding ahi. Amavang ISRAEL kiti ding na hitai,” hichun Pathen in ama pa min chu Israel asah tai.
en_web: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
en_kjv: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keima El-Shaddai kahi. Pathen hattah ka hi, hatah in ga un, hatah in pung tul tul un, nam lentah ka so ding nahi, chule chilhah jong tamtah kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
en_kjv: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

tcz: Chule khatvei Abraham, Isaac kapeh gamchu nangma le na insung mite kapeh kitding nahi, khonung teng jongle nangma kapeh ding nahi.
en_web: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
en_kjv: and the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

tcz: Hichun Pakai vantil chu Jacob akihoulimpi na akon in achemang tai.
en_web: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
en_kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

tcz: Jacob'in Pakai toa kimuto na melchihna ding in hiche muna chun song khom khat aphut doh kitin, hiche khom chunga chun kilhaina ju asun khum in, chule hiche chunga chun Olive thao twi asun khume.
en_web: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
en_kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

tcz: Chule Jacob'in hilai mun chu Bethel asah tan ahi.
en_web: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
en_kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.

tcz: Jacob le a insung miten Bethel chu adalhau vin, Ephratha lam ajot laitah un Rachel chu anaovop nat ahung kipantan, akhol che nao jong lhung joujep lou lai ahin, amanu soh dingin ha nat nat'in ahung natai.
en_web: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
en_kjv: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

tcz: Rachel chu soh dinga hanat'a anat pet chun anaodom a pang a sohnu numei ho chun hitin ahoulimpi uve, “Nangma kicha hih in, lungneo hih beh in, chapa khat na neibe ding ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

tcz: Hinlah Rachel chu alhagao apotdoh tai, ajeh chu amanu athia ahitan ahi; hijeh chun aman jong nao min chu Ben-oni asah in (Ben-oni tichu, ka thoh gimpeta kacha tina ahi), apan vang Benjamin asah tai. (Benjamin tichu, kajet lama pang chapa tina ahi).
en_web: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

tcz: Rachel chu athitan Ephratha lampia avui tau vin ahi.
en_web: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
en_kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

tcz: Jacob'in angailut hetjing nan Rachel lhan song asem peh in, tuni gei hin hiche Rachel lhan hi aum jing nalaiye.
en_web: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
en_kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

tcz: Hichun Israel (Jacob) chu achen pondal buh chu Eder inting vum geiyin atung doh e.
en_web: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
en_kjv: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

tcz: Israel chuche gamsunga ana cheng nalaiyin, ahin Reuben in apa jithahnu Bilhah chu ana chonsetpin ana luppi tan, hiche thu chu Israel in jong aja tai. Chule Jacob chapate chu som le ni alhinguve.
en_web: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

tcz: Leah chapate chu Reuben, Jacob chapa apeng masa pen, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar chule Zebulun ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
en_kjv: the sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

tcz: Rachel chapate ni chu Joseph le Benjamin ahi lhon'e.
en_web: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
en_kjv: the sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

tcz: Rachel sohnu Bilhah chapate nichu Dan le Naphtali ahilhon in,
en_web: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
en_kjv: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

tcz: Leah sohnu Zilpah chapate ni chu Gad le Asher ahi lhone. Hi chengse hi Jacob'in Padan-Ram gamsunga ahindoh achapate chu ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
en_kjv: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

tcz: Hichun Jacob apa Isaac koma ahung kinungle kit tan Mamre a Kiriath-arba gam (Hebron tiajong kisei) phatkhat laia Abraham le Isaac maljin na ana umna'u mun chu ahi.
en_web: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
en_kjv: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

tcz: Isaac chu akum kum jakhat le kum som get ana lhing tan ahi.
en_web: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
en_kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

tcz: Hichun Isaac ahaitan in ahinkho abeitai, anam mite ho jouse ateh akhang abonchauvin a nilhum gei in op cheh un, chuin achate ni Esau le Jacob in avui lhon tai.
en_web: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
en_kjv: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

tcz: Hiche hose hi Esau phunggui Edom tiajong kisei ahi.
en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
en_kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

tcz: Esau in Canaan nungah ni aji din ana ki pui'in khat nu chu Hite mi Adah Elton ahi, anina nu chu ahile Oholibamah Anah chanu ahin Zibeon Hivi tedinga atunu u ahi.
en_web: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
en_kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

tcz: Chule Esau in asopinu Basemath Ishmael chanu Nebaioth naonu jong ajidin aki puiye.
en_web: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
en_kjv: and Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

tcz: Adah chun chapa amin Eliphaz Esau ahin peh in Basemath chun chapa Reul ahing in ahi.
en_web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
en_kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

tcz: Oholibamath chun Canaan gam'a achen laiyin chapa thum Esau din ana hinpeh in, amaho min chu ahile Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
en_web: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: and Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Esau in ajite le achate cheng abonchauvin, agancha ho jouse, abongchal ho jouse, chule anei agou thil jouse Canaan gam'a achen laiya alam doh jouse apon mun chom ajon tan, asopipa Jacob chu adalhatan ahi.
en_web: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
en_kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amaho anei agou ho chu apung lheh tan, aum khom ding'u ahahsa lheh tan, chule gamsung jong adam jou tapon, amani gancha ho lhat khom na ding jong ahi thei tapon ahi.
en_web: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
en_kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Esau (Edom) chu thinglhang lam a Seir kiti muna acheng tai.
en_web: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
en_kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

tcz: Hiche hohi Esau thusim Edomite pa Seir thinglhanga ahung chen namun chu ahi.
en_web: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
en_kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

tcz: Ama hohi Esau chilhahte ho min ahi, Eliphaz kitipa hi Adah in ahin chule Reul kitipa hi Esau loinu Basemath in ahin ahiye.
en_web: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
en_kjv: these are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

tcz: Eliphaz chilhah ho Teman, Omar, Canaan chule Kanaz ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
en_kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

tcz: Timna, Eliphaz jithahnu chapa khat ahing in amin chu Amalek ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Adah in ahin ama hung kikhailha chilhah ho ahiuve.
en_web: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
en_kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.

tcz: Reul chapate ho chu Nahath, Zerath, Shammah chule Mizzah ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Basemath chilhah ho ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

tcz: Esau chate ho Aholibamath in ahin ho chu, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahi uvin, Aholibamah hi Anah chanu Zibeon dinga atute ahung hitai.
en_web: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
en_kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

tcz: Hiche hohi Esau chate chilhahte phung choma hung lamkai ho ahi uve, Esau chapa tahpen chilhah ho Eliphaz a hung kikhai lha ho, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz ahin,
en_web: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
en_kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

tcz: Korah chule Gatam chule Amalek amaho se hi Eliphaz phung lamkai Edom gamsunga cheng ahiuvin, amaho jouse hi Esau jinu Adah chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
en_web: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
en_kjv: duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

tcz: Esau chapa Reul a kona hung pengdoh ho phung lamkai ho chu, Nahath, Zertah, Shammath chule Mizzah ahiuve. Amaho chenghi phung lamkai Edom gam sunga Reul chate ahin, Esau jinu Basemath chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

tcz: Esau chate ho Oholibamah toh ahin ho Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve. Amaho se hi phung lamkai cheh jong ahung hitauvin, hiche phung lamkai ho sese hi Esau loinu Oholibamah kitinu Anah chanu chilhah a hung kon doh ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

tcz: Hiche phung hohi Esau a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuvin, amaho hi Edom mi jong a kitiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

tcz: Seir Horite kitipa chate chengse hiche gam'a ana cheng ho chu amaho hi ahiuve, Lotan, Shobal, Anah chule Zeboan ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
en_kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

tcz: Edom gam'a cheng Seir chate langa pangho chu Horite chilhah ho chu Dishan, Ezer, chule Dishon ahiuve.
en_web: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
en_kjv: and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

tcz: Chule Lotan chate ho chu Hori le Heman ahin, Lotan sopinu min chu ahile Timna ahi.
en_web: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
en_kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

tcz: Shobal chapate chu Alvan ahin, Manahath ahin, Ebal ahin, Shepho ahin, chule Onam ahi.
en_web: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
en_kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

tcz: Zibeon chateni min chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone. Zibeon chapa Anah kitipa hin apa gancha sangante achin pet a nel gamgo lah a twisam putna ana mudoh ahi.
en_web: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
en_kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Aiah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

tcz: Anah chate ni chu Dishon le Anah chanu Oholibamah ahi lhone.
en_web: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
en_kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

tcz: Dishon chapate chu Hemdan le Eshban toh, Ithran toh, chule Cheran toh ahiuve.
en_web: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
en_kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

tcz: Ezer chate ho chu Bilhan ahin, Zaavan ahin, chule Akan ahiuve.
en_web: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
en_kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

tcz: Dishan chate ni chu Uz le Arana ahi lhone.
en_web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
en_kjv: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

tcz: Horite mi upa lamkai ho chu Lotan ahin, Shobal ahin, Zibeon ahin, Anah ahin,
en_web: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
en_kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

tcz: Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan amaho cheng hi Horite mi upa ho amaho phung dungjuia Seir gamsunga cheng ahiuve.
en_web: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
en_kjv: duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

tcz: Hiche lengho hi Edom gamsunga vai ana hom un amaho masanga Israel mite lah a leng vaipo ana um khalou lai ahi.
en_web: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

tcz: Beor chapa Bela chun Edom gamsunga lengvai anapon, ama khopi chu amin Dinhabah ahiye.
en_web: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
en_kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

tcz: Bila athi jou chun Zerah chapa Johab chapa chu Bozrah gamsunga vaipon ahung pang in ahi.
en_web: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

tcz: Johab athi jou chun Husham Temanite gam mipa chun lengvai ahin hom kit tai.
en_web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

tcz: Hosham athi jou chun Bedal chapa Hadah chu lengvai ahinpon, ama chenna khopi Avith a pat'in Moab gamsunga Midianite ho jouse gal'a ahin joutan ahi.
en_web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
en_kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

tcz: Hadah athi jou chun Masrekah khopi a cheng Somlah in lengvai ahinpo kit tai.
en_web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

tcz: Samlah athi jou chun Rehoboth vadung toh kinai khopi a cheng Saul chu ahung vaihom in ahi.
en_web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

tcz: Saul thi jou chun Achor chapa Baal-Hannan kitipa chun lengvai ahipo kit in ahi.
en_web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

tcz: Achor chapa Baal-Hannan athi jouchun, Hadar in Pau khopi apat in lengvai ahipo pantan, Hadar jinu min chu Mehetabel ahin Matred chanu Mazehab dinga atunu ahitai.
en_web: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
en_kjv: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

tcz: Amaho phung lamkai jouse hi Esau chilhah a kona hung kondoh cheh ahiuvin, Timna gam'a cheng ahiuvin, mi upa Alvah ahin, mi upa Jetheth ahin,
en_web: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
en_kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

tcz: Mi upa Oholibamah ahin, mi upa Elah ahin, mi upa Pinon ahin,
en_web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
en_kjv: duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

tcz: Mi upa Kenaz ahin, mi upa Teman ahin, mi upa Mibzar ahin,
en_web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
en_kjv: duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

tcz: Mi upa Magdiel ahin, chule mi upa Iram ahi; hicheng hi leiset atoupha na gamsung uva akho mun dung jui uva Edom chilhah a kon a mi upa ho chu ahiuve.
en_web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
en_kjv: duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

tcz: Hichun Jacob Canaan chu apa khopem na Canaan gamsunga anung chen kit tai.
en_web: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Hiche thusim hohi Jacob insung mite a ahi, Joseph kum som le sagi alhinin apa kelngoi ho asopi ho toh aching tup jingin avahva jingun, asopi ho apa jithah chate ho Bilhah le Zilpah chate ho toh natong khom jing ahiuve. Ahin nikhat chu Joseph in asopiho umchan phatlou dan apa kom ahin lhut tan ahi.
en_web: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
en_kjv: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

tcz: Amavang asopite hon Joseph chu avetda cheh un ahi, Ajeh chu apan midang ho sanga Joseph angailut najeh in amahon Joseph henga ngailut thucheng thupha seiding hahsa asa lheh un ahi.
en_web: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
en_kjv: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

tcz: Joseph in nikhat mang anei in amang chu asopiho asei pehle amahon avetda cheh un ahi.
en_web: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
en_kjv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

tcz: Aman aseiye, “Ngaijun ka mang ho kasei ding ahi ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

tcz: Ehon phailei lama chang phel ikan khom un, hiche tah chun hetman louvin keima changphal ho chu ading doh in, nangho changphal ho chu keima changphal masanga abohkhup uve,” ati.
en_web: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
en_kjv: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

tcz: Hichun asopi hon adonbut un, “Amapa chun keiho chunga vaihom ding kigong nahim? Ahiloule keiho chunga thanei ding kigo mong nahim,” atiuve. Hichun amahon amang neitoh athusei doh ho jeh in hatah in avetdau vin ahi.
en_web: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
en_kjv: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

tcz: Joseph in mang khat aneibe kit in chuin asopi ho chu asei peh kit in aman aseiye, “Ngaijun mang khat ka neibe kitne ati, tun nisa, lha, chule ahsi som le khat ho jong keima masanga abohkhup cheh uve,” ati.
en_web: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
en_kjv: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

tcz: Tua mang aneipa hi Joseph in apa chule asopite ho jouse jong abonchan aseipeh soh keiyin ahi. Ahin apa in aphoh thip'in,” hiche mang chu ipi tina ham tin adonbut e, “nanu toh kei chule nasopi teho jouse atahbeh a kahung uva nang masanga ka hung boh khup dingu ham?”
en_web: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
en_kjv: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

tcz: Ama vang Joseph sopiho chu alung ahang lheh un athangthip thei lheh un, apa vang chun hiche mang chu ipi tina ham ahet thei lou jeh in alung adong lheh in ahi.
en_web: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
en_kjv: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun Joseph sopiho chu Schechem lama apa kelngoi ching ding in achekit tauvin ahi.
en_web: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
en_kjv: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

tcz: Amaho chedoh jou phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in Joseph koma aseiye, “Nasopite ho Schechem lam a kelngoi hon ho aga vah un ahin, nangma naga che lou khoh ahi atin, Joseph in adonbut in, “keima kaga che ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

tcz: Jacob in adon but in, “Nangma gache inlang na sopite ho chule kelngoi ho iti hina uvem gaven ati. Amaho thusoh kajah nom kitne, Hebron phaicham apat in asol tan, hichun Joseph hiche Schechem chu ahung lhung tan ahi.
en_web: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
en_kjv: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

tcz: Ahin vetan gamlah a lampi akimansah a ava koile na a mi khat in atoh khan mipa chun adongin “Ipi ham nahol le?” atile.
en_web: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
en_kjv: And a certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

tcz: Joseph in adonbut in, “Ka sopite ho kahol ahi atin, hoi langa gancha ho achin uham neisei peh thei ding ham,” ati.
en_web: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
en_kjv: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Amaho kihou limna kajan eiho Dothan lama chetau hite,” aki tiuve.
en_web: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
en_kjv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

tcz: Joseph ahung chun asopihon gam la thimtah ahivang in ahe pai tauvin, ama ahung lhun masang in asopite hon Joseph thadoh nading tohgon anei tauvin ahi.
en_web: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
en_kjv: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

tcz: “Tuhin mang neipa ahung tai,” amahon atiuve.
en_web: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
en_kjv: And they said one to another. Behold, this dreamer cometh.

tcz: Hung un amahi that doh taute, chule hiche kotong ho sung khat a pai mang taute. Ipa'u koma hitin seiyu hite, “Gancha khat in Joseph chu a nedoh tai, chule eihon veu hite ama amang ho chu hunggui lhung nam,” atiuve.
en_web: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
en_kjv: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

tcz: Ahin Reuben in amaho tohgon lung thim ho chu ahet phat in Joseph kitho pi ding in ahungin, “Aman asei tai Joseph hi tha datau hite,” ati.
en_web: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
en_kjv: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

tcz: Ibola thisan imoh lonsah ding'u ham? hilai kotong gamgo lah a seplut leuhen ama cham in eihon that hih jong leu hen ama thi ta lou ding ham. Reuben chu a lungthima Joseph chu huhdoh tei ding tichu ama dei ahi.
en_web: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
en_kjv: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him, that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

tcz: Hichun Joseph ahung lhun chun asopite hon a sangkhol chol hoitah chu asut lhah peh pai tauvin ahi.
en_web: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

tcz: Hichun amahon Joseph chu adah a aman uvin kotong sunga aseplut tauvin, hiche kotong chu imacha umlou twi jong veilou ahi.
en_web: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
en_kjv: and they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

tcz: Chule amaho sun an ne dinga aumlai tah'un, aga dadoh uva ahile vetan Gilead a kona hung sumkol veile Ishmael miho a sangan ho toh hung kilhona bego le thingthao namtwi toh chule lou namtwi hinpoa Egypt gam lang jonsuh ding amu uvin ahi.
en_web: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
en_kjv: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lift up their eyes and looked, and behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

tcz: Hichun Judah in a sopiho jah a aseiyin, “I sopipau itha doh uva ipi apha chom ding umham,” ati, chule athi san isel mang uva chu ipi phachom ding ham?
en_web: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
en_kjv: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

tcz: Hung uvin Joseph hi Ishmael te koma joh doh tauhite, isopi nah nah iphe ivou nah nah chu a chunga jong ikhut lhapou hite,” atile asopiten jong asei angai cheh tauve.
en_web: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
en_kjv: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

tcz: Hiti chun Egypt gam'a kivei miho chun apui tauvin Joseph chu asopihon kotong a kon in a kaidoh un, Ishmael miho Midianite miho koma dangka somni in akijoh doh tauve.
en_web: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
en_kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lift up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Reuben chu kokhuh langa chun achekit'in ahile Joseph chu kokhuh sunga ana umtapoi, hichun Reuben chu alung akham lheh jengtan asang khol ho chu abottel in ahi.
en_web: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
en_kjv: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

tcz: Hichun Reuben asopiho lah'a akinungle kit in lungkham tah in, “Joseph chu aum tapoi! tua hi keiman ipi kabol ding hitam,” ati.
en_web: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
en_kjv: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

tcz: Hichun Joseph sopihon kelnou khat athat uvin, athisan chu Joseph sangkhol a chun anu tauve.
en_web: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
en_kjv: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

tcz: Amahon hichu sangkhol thisan anu u-chu apau Jacob athot un, mihon jong apau henga achoi uvin, “Hiche pihi ka mudoh uve, vetem in na chapa sangkhol chol hiya ham hilou ham,” atiuve.
en_web: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”
en_kjv: and they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.

tcz: Jacob'in gangtah in ahedoh pai in, hitin asei tai, “Hiche hi kachapa sangkhol ahi monge gamsa khat in vang anehdoh ahitai ati, Joseph vang hi aphe avou lahthei hita ponte,” ati.
en_web: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
en_kjv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in apon ho chu abot tel in khaodip pon akikhu khum tan, Ama ni sottah lung hemin genthei tah in achapa pul adoutan ahi.
en_web: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
en_kjv: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

tcz: Jacob chate jouse le achanute jousen lhepbi ding agong un, ahin amavang lhepbi jou ahitapoi, hitin amapan aseiye, “Keima lunghem pum in kachapa lhankhuh jon tang kate, tin Jacob chu akap e.”
en_web: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
en_kjv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouchun Midian miho chun Joseph chu Potiphar kitipa Pharaoh Egypt lengpa koma semang pachong pa koma ajoh doh tauve. Potiphar natoh chu ahile sepai lah a semang pachong ahi.
en_web: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
en_kjv: And the Medanites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah chun Judah chun asopite adalhan Adullan kiti muna Hirah kitipa toh ana cheng khom lhon in ahi.
en_web: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
en_kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

tcz: Chule Judah in Canan numei amin Shua kitinu chu aki chenpin chule ana kiti matpi tan ahi.
en_web: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
en_kjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung kivopmon nao ahin neitan chule nao min chu Er asahtan ahi.
en_web: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
en_kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

tcz: Chuin amanu akivopmo kit in nao pasal khat ahin hinbekit in nao min chu Onam asah tai.
en_web: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
en_kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

tcz: Abanin amanun nao pasal athum lhinna pachu amin Sheila asah in, Sheila apen lai tah a chu amaho Kezib kiti muna achen laitah'u ahiye.
en_web: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
en_kjv: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Judah in achapa atah pen Er ding in numei khang thah amin Tamar chu ajidin apui peh e.
en_web: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
en_kjv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

tcz: Hinlah Er chu migilou miphamo tah ahijeh chun Pakaiyin ahinkho ala dohtai.
en_web: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.
en_kjv: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.

tcz: Hichun Judah Onam kitipa, Er sopipa koma hitin aseiye, “Nangma che inlang Tamar khu gaki chenpi tan ati, ajeh chu pasal khat insunga ahinkho abeitah le dan in aphal ahi, asopipan avet thei ding, na sopipa dinga chilhah nasem doh peh tei ding ahi.”
en_web: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
en_kjv: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

tcz: Amavang Onan kitipa chu anompon ama chilhah ahilou ding chu, hijeh chun a sopi pa ji toh alup khom lhona a kitimat teng abotwi ho chu tollhanga abolha jin, hijeh chun Tamar chun nao avop thei tapon asopipa adin jong chilhah gou aum doh jou tapon ahi.
en_web: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
en_kjv: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

tcz: Amavang Pakaiyin Onan umchan chu gilou engse asa lheh in asopi pa athisa adin chapa ahin peh nom lou athang thip jeh ahi, hijeh chun Pakaiyin Onan hinkho jong asuh chom pehtai.
en_web: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.
en_kjv: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord: wherefore he slew him also.

tcz: Hichun Judah in Tamar amounu jah a hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Sheila kikhan lhit kah in napa in'a meithai jin ga umdohtan,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile asopite ni bang in ama jong thiget in te tia anagel ahi. Hijeh chun Tamar jong achen apa in nah aga chengtai.
en_web: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
en_kjv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou in Shua chanu Judah jinu jong athi tai; ahin Judah chu aki lhep lung mong dom phat in agolpa Adullam mi Hirah chutoh Timnah a akelngoi mul vouho henga aga che tauve.
en_web: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
en_kjv: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

tcz: Koiham khat in Tamar chu aseipeh in, “Ven na tehpu khu Timnah a kelngoi mul vou ding in ache touve,” a kiti peh e.
en_web: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
en_kjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

tcz: Chuphat in amanun jong ameithai von chu akhel loijin, ponlu akikhun, akitomjol in Timnah lampia Enaim lamkot'a chun atou tai; ijeh-inem itile Sheila kikhan lhit ahitan, aji dinga amanu akipeh lou akimu ahitai.
en_web: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
en_kjv: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

tcz: Judah in amanu (Tamar), chu amun ahin Judah in numei kijoh ho ahisah in ahi, ajeh chu amanun amai asel jeh ahi.
en_web: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
en_kjv: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; because she had covered her face.

tcz: Hichun Judah akihei jin, Tamar umna lampi koma amapan aseiyin, “Eini kitimat hite atin,” amapan amounu ahilam chu ahet doh lou ahin, hichun Tamar in adong tan “Ipi ijat neipeh ding ham ilupkhom lhon ding leh,” ati.
en_web: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
en_kjv: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law:) and she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

tcz: Chuin Judah in adonbut in, “Keima kelnou lah a khat nahin thah peh nang'e,” ati, hichun ama nun aseiyin, “Nakitep naho chu ahung guilhun kaha iti ka tahsan thei ding ham,” ati.
en_web: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
en_kjv: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

tcz: Judah in adong in, “Itobang kitepna na dei ham ati,” amanun adonbut in, “Na Mohor le nakhao toh chule nakhut a nachoi na tenggol chu toh,” ati. Hijeh chun amapan hichengse chu apen amanu chu aluppin ahile aman jong nao avop tai.
en_web: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
en_kjv: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Tamar a in lama a kinungle kit in a sangkhol chol akoi lhan masanga akivon na lui meithai sangkhol chu akivon in til abang chun hinkho amang kit tai.
en_web: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
en_kjv: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

tcz: Judah chun kelnou chu aloipa Adullam mipa khut'a numeinu henga khamgah na thil lhat doh dinga aga thahsah a ahile, Adullam mipan amanu chu agahol motan ahi.
en_web: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
en_kjv: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

tcz: Hichun Adullam mipa Hira in hi koma cheng ho chu adong in, “Ena-im jotna a tou numeinu aki johnu chu hoilam a che hitam, ama hon adonbut un, “Keima hon hikoma hin numei phalou atahsa joh kamu kha pouve,” atiuve.
en_web: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
en_kjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

tcz: Hichun Adullam mipa Hirah ahung ki nunglen thu umchan ho chu Judah asei peh tan ahi, “Keiman amanu umna chu kahol doh jou tapoi, chule chua cheng mihon jong hi tobang numei phalou atahsa joh aum poi,” atiuve.
en_web: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
en_kjv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

tcz: Judah in aseiye, “Thil kana peh ho chu ama nun eina koi peh maita hen, kaki nopto na lhon dungjui a kelcha nou khat ka pen ahin nangman na holmo tan, amanu chu enung hol kit le khosunga mijousen ei nuisat ding'u ahi tai.”
en_web: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
en_kjv: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

tcz: Lhathum jou don chun Judah chu mihon asei peh tauvin, “Tamar na mounu chu numei kijoh banga ana bol thu ahije, chule tuhin amanun nao avoptai atiuve.” Hichun Judah in aseiye, “Amanu chu hinpui doh unlang halvam tauvin,” ati.
en_web: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

tcz: Amavang amahon Tamar chu tha dingin ahin puidoh tauvin, Tamar in atehpu thu athot in hitin aseiye, “Hiche thil neipa tenggol ahin, khaodip ahin, Mahor ahin, koi thil pen ham? Ipi dinga thip beh cha um aham hiche neipa akona hi nao kavop ahi,” ati.
en_web: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
en_kjv: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

tcz: Judah in gangtah in ama nei le gou chu amu mun agel doh paitan ahi, “Tamar hi keima sanga chonpha jo ahiye ati. Ajeh chu keiman kachapa Sheila toh akichen lhon na ding imacha kana gonlou jeh ahi,” ati, chupet tah chun Judah chu Tamar toh apum kitimat tapoi.
en_web: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
en_kjv: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

tcz: Tamar dinga nao neina phat ahung naitan, amanun nao pasal ni pengkop ding ahi chu ahe tauvin ahi.
en_web: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

tcz: Naoso nat akipan tan hiche pet tah chun naocha teni lah a khatpa akhut ahung doh in hichun numei lhacha a pangho chun patsan akhut'a akan peh un, “Hichepa hi hung peng masa ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

tcz: Hinlah hiche naocha chun akhut akailut kit tan, asopipa joh ahung peng masa tai. Hichun numei lhacha ho chun “Hiche hi ipi ham atiuve.” Nang in iti dan'a amasa a peng dingpa nahin chop khup ham atiuve.” Hichun amapa min chu Perez asah tauve.
en_web: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

tcz: Chujouvin, naosen patsan a akhut kikanpa chu ahung peng tan hichun amapa min chun Zerah asah tauve.
en_web: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
en_kjv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

tcz: Joseph chu Egypt gam'a ana puijun hiche apat a chu Ishmaelite sum-kolvei mihon Potiphar kiti pa koma ana joh un ahi. Potiphar natoh chu Egypt lengpa Pharaoh sepai lamkai a pang ahi.
en_web: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
en_kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

tcz: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jing in, hijeh chun Egypt gamsunga abol lam jouse a alolhing jingin ahi.
en_web: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
en_kjv: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

tcz: Joseph chu Pathen in aumpi chu athil bol na jousea kon in apupan ahin muchen tan ahi.
en_web: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.
en_kjv: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar chu Joseph chunga alunglhai lheh jeng in, Joseph chu ama ban tah in akoi tan ahi. chule Potiphar in Joseph chu a insung jouse chule anei agou jouse vetup ding in atungdoh tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
en_kjv: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

tcz: Hiche nia pat'a chu Joseph chu apupa Potiphar insunga ima jouse vetup in anganse tai, chule Joseph chonphat jeh chun Potiphar insung chu Pakai phatthei bohna chu Potiphar nei jouse chung le a insung chung chule alouma chungah a achu tan ahi.
en_web: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.
en_kjv: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu ama insung vetup ding le anei agou ho jouse vetup ding in thanei na jouse ape dohtai, chule Joseph umjeh chun aman imacha ah akisaboi tapon, lungkham na jong aum tapon, chule aneh ding anneh tilou thil dang thil dang imacha ahepha tapoi. Joseph chu mi melhoitah vetnom nom umkhat ahi.
en_web: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
en_kjv: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

tcz: Chule phat chomkhat jouvin, apupa loinun Joseph chu ahin velel tan, “Hung in eini lumkhom hitin kitimat hite tin Joseph chu ajol tai.”
en_web: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

tcz: Amavang Joseph anom pon, Joseph in Potiphar inneipi chu hitin adonbut e, “Ka pupan hiche insunga thil ho jouse vetup dinga ei nganse ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.
en_kjv: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

tcz: Hiche insunga hi keima tilou thanei dang aum poi, kapu pan nangma chung a thaneina eipe poi, ajeh chu nangma aloinu nahi jeh in hi tobang thilpha lou chu iti keiman katoh a Pathen douna a chonset kabol ding ham ati.
en_web: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
en_kjv: there is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

tcz: Hiti chun ama nun aniseh in Joseph chu ano ano jeng in, amavang Joseph chu amanu toh lupkhom a ki timat ding chu pum noplou ahin, ahithei chan a jammang ding joh chu agot ahiye.
en_web: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

tcz: Nikhat vang chu koima cha umlouna achun Joseph chu ama ngaiya natong ding in achen.
en_web: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
en_kjv: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung lut in a sangkhol ah akai jin, “Hung loiyin eini ilup khom lhon ding ahi,” ati. Hichun Joseph in a sangkhol asut lhan aki tom doh tai. Ahin a sangkhol chu Potiphar loinu khutna adalha den tan ahi.
en_web: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
en_kjv: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

tcz: Hichun Joseph la ajamdoh tan ahin amanun akhut a um asangkhol chu achoiyin,
en_web: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

tcz: Amanun insunga asohte jouse akou khom soh keiyin, hiche phat chun aja jousen ahin dellut cheh un, amanun hitin aseiye, “Kaloipan hiche Hebrew sohpa hi buhon, anneh sem dinga ahin puilut in, amahi ka insung demna a ahunglut in suhset ding eigon ahin keima awsangtah in kapeng in ahi,” ati.
en_web: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
en_kjv: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

tcz: Keima hatah a awsangtah a kapen phat in polam a ajam doh in ahin aman asangkhol chu kakoma ada lha dentai.
en_web: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
en_kjv: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

tcz: Hiti chun amanun sangkhol chun aloipa in ahung lhun masang in phatechan a koitup sel in ahi.
en_web: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
en_kjv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

tcz: Hichun amanun aloipa koma thusoh ho chu asei tai; “Hebrew sohpa nahin puilut pa khun insunga ahung lut in suhset ding eigoi,” ati tai.
en_web: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
en_kjv: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

tcz: Amavang keima awsangtah a kapen phat in polam ah ajam doh in a sangkhol ada lhah ahi.
en_web: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
en_kjv: and it came to pass, as I lift up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar chu hatah in alung hang lheh tan ajinu thusimho Joseph in abolset kigot na thuho ajah doh phat chun.
en_web: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu songkul'a akoitan chule lengpan songkul'a umho to akihen khom un, ama jong hiti chun aum den tai.
en_web: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
en_kjv: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Joseph chu songkul'a jong aumpi jing in, angailut na ho jong avetsah jing in chule Pathen in Joseph chu songkul ngahpa tohjong kingailut na ape kit tai.
en_web: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
en_kjv: But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin songkul ngahpan Joseph chu songkul'a umho lah a alenpen in akoitan, hiche songkul sunga thil soh bouina jouse chu Joseph thaneina noiya akoi tai.
en_web: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
en_kjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

tcz: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jeh in imacha boina aumtapoi, athil bolna anatoh na jouse alolhingsel in hijeh chun songkul ngah pa jong imacha aboita poi, ajeh chu thil jouse Joseph in anga jeh chun imacha aphamo ding aumpoi.
en_web: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.
en_kjv: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the Lord was with him, and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.

tcz: Hicheng thilsoh kichai nung chun Pharaoh lengpa natong ju vaihompa le an vai hompan apupa Egypt lengpa doumah abol lhon in achonse lhontai.
en_web: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
en_kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche lamkai teni chunga hi Pharaoh nasatah in alunghang tan ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in amani chu Joseph umna lengpa songkul natong ho umna ah akoiyin ahi.
en_web: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
en_kjv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

tcz: Songkul ngahpan amani chu Joseph thanei na noiya a umsah in Joseph in jong amani chu vetkolna anei jing in ahi.
en_web: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
en_kjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
