en_web: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
en_kjv: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

tcz: Joseph asopi ho lah a akiphongtai “keima Joseph chu kahi kapa chu dam nalai hinam ati, Hinlah asopihon adonbut thei tapouve ajeh inem itile ama angsung laitah a chu moh tijat a thigam ahitauve.
en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

tcz: Hung kikhin naijun ati, amapan hichun ama hon anai lut un, chuin ama aki phongdoh kit in “Keima hi Joseph kahi,” ati, na sopiu soh chang dinga Egypt gam'a na joh pa'u chu kahi ati.
en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

tcz: Ahin nang hon nopmo sahih un, chule nangho lunghan khat jong bolda tauvin, keima hiche gam'a neina joh doh uhi hichu Pathen thil gon ahi bouve, nangho hinkho huhdoh na dinga Pathen in eina masol ahibouve ati.
en_web: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
en_kjv: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

tcz: Hiche gamsung a hi kum ni bou kel hah hung kipan bep ahin, ahung lhung ding kum nga sunga chang um talou ding ahiye.
en_web: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
en_kjv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

tcz: Pathen in nangho huh doh dinga eina sol masat joh ahi, nangho le na insung mite thilouva leichunga achi aman na lou ding ahi.
en_web: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
en_kjv: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

tcz: Hiche chu nanghon na bol ahipon, Pathen in eina masol joh ahi, chule Pathen in Pharaoh hithei ding ama lenggam ma Egypt gamsung a semang a pang ka hitai.
en_web: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hijeh chun gangtah in kino uvin lang kapa koma thu galhut loiyun, gahet sah un, nachapa Joseph in hitin ga seiyun ati; Pathen in Egypt gamsunga vaipo alen pen in eipansah tai hungsuh loiyun geisang lou jen in ati.
en_web: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
en_kjv: Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

tcz: Nangho Goshem gamsunga na chen dingu ahi, keima toh kinai tah a naum dingu na chate chule natute geiya chule na gancha ho le nangho na boncha uva kakom a naum dingu ahi ati.
en_web: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
en_kjv: and thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

tcz: Hikoma chu keiman neh le chah na nato nange, ijeh inem itile kel lhah na ding hi kum nga jen aum nalaiye, achuti louva ahile na insung mi chule nanei jouse navai mah thah pai dingu ahi,”ati ga tiuvin.
en_web: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’
en_kjv: and there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in athusei ajom in “Veuvin nangho che un, ka sopipa Benjamin neiven keima Joseph ka hi ati.
en_web: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
en_kjv: And behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

tcz: Cheuvin lang kapa Jacob chu gasei peh loi un, mun phatah hiche Egypt gamsunga kanei uve, chule amachu thil namu jouse seipeh un, chule aganna thei chan in hilanga hinpui jun ati.
en_web: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”
en_kjv: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in Benjamin chu angong koiyin akap tai, chuti ma chun Benjamin in jong akoiyin akap tai.
en_web: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
en_kjv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

tcz: Joseph in asopi ho chengse chu akoiyin akap tai, chule asopite hon lungthoi na um louvin aki houlimpi tauve.
en_web: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.
en_kjv: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

tcz: Joseph sopi ho ahung lhung tauve tithu chu Pharaoh le a insung miten jong aja tauve, chule amaho jong akipa pi lheh un ahi.
en_web: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
en_kjv: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma aseiyin, “Na sopi ho chu seipeh in gangtah in na sangan chung uva napot hou chu hengdoh unlang gangtah in Canaan gam a ki nungle loiyun,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

tcz: Chule napa ahin adang insung mite jouse keima koma hinle pui loiyun Egypt gamsunga aphapen kapeh diu nahi; chule agam ga soh a hoipen na neh diu ahi ati.
en_web: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
en_kjv: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma asei in, “Na sopiho chu seipeh tan amahon kangtalai chu kipuiyu hen lang chapang ho le a jiteho'u chule napa'u chu ka henga hinpui jun.
en_web: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
en_kjv: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

tcz: Nangma ho thil neocha nangma lannaiya na nei hou chu boipi da tauvin, ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga ahoipen aphapen jouse nang ho a hiding ahitai.”
en_web: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
en_kjv: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

tcz: Hichun Israel chaten amaho thu kisei peh bang chun abol'un, Joseph in jong kangtalai ho chu agontup peh in Pharaoh in aphatsah le athupeh dungjui in, chule lampi kah a neh le chah ding jong agontup peh in ahi.
en_web: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

tcz: Chule aman asopiho chu vonthah apecheh in, Benjamin vang chu golvah von nga chule dangka sum eng jathum toh apen ahi.
en_web: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
en_kjv: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

tcz: Joseph in apa din sangan chal ho poh thei Egypt gamsunga atwi aphapen ho jouse athot in chule sangan anu som dimset changlhah a pohsah in lampi kah a akihinso thei na dingu ahi.
en_web: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
en_kjv: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in asopiho chu alha doh in, amaho akipatdoh ding kon un, Joseph in amaho chu availhah in “Lampi najot lai un nangho kina pa hih un,” ati.
en_web: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
en_kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

tcz: Chuin amahon Egypt chu adalha uvin Canaan gam lang apa Jacob kom anung lhun kit tauve.
en_web: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
en_kjv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

tcz: Amahon apao chu aseipeh un hitin atiuve, “Joseph chu ana hing nalaiyin, chule Egypt gam pumpia vaipoa khu ama hijah ahiye,” atiuve. Ahinah vang chun Jacob in la amaho a tahsan loujeh in alungthim akiloh dehpoi.
en_web: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.
en_kjv: and told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

tcz: Ahin amahon Joseph thusei chu avel vel in apao chu a seipeh un, chule Joseph in apa poh na dinga kangtalai chu agah ven amuphat in apao Jacob lhagao chu akidodoh kit tai.
en_web: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.
en_kjv: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

tcz: Hichun Israel in aphong doh tai, “Keima kanomtai adih ahitai, Joseph hi ahing mong nai ka hinkho abei masang in kaga kimupi ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
en_kjv: and Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

tcz: Hichun Jacob chu Egypt gam jon din akipat dohtan anei agou jouse jong apon Bersheba ahung lhungin hiche jan chun apa Isaac Pathen min in maicham asem in ahi.
en_web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
en_kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

tcz: Hiche jan chun Pathen in gaova akihoulim pin, “Jacob Jacob tin akouvin,” hichun aman jong, “Hoijo Pakai keima hikoma ka ume,” ati.
en_web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

tcz: Keima napu napate Pathen kahi tin ahoulim pin, nangma Egypt gam langa suh cheding kicha hih beh in ajeh chu keiman nangma hiche muna chu nam lentah kaso ding nahi ati.
en_web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
en_kjv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation.

tcz: Keiman Egypt lama nasuh cheteng ka kilhonpi ding nahi, chule keiman nangma ka hin nungpui kit ding nahi ati; chule Joseph in namit ha geiya najen ding ahi.
en_web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”
en_kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Beersheba adalhan chule achate sen Egypt lama apui tauvin, kangtalai chunga ama ahin chapang naosen ho jong chule ajite ho chengse jong Pharaoh in ima ma agontup peh bang in apuisuh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
en_kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

tcz: Amahon anei agou jouse chule agancha hou jouse Canaan gamsunga ana kilamdoh ho jouse jong apo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
en_kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

tcz: Achate hou sese chule atute ho jouse jong chule achanute ho jong chule achanute chate jouse jong ama chilhah namkim jouse toh Egypt ahin jon tauve.
en_web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
en_kjv: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

tcz: Tua min hung kipe ho chengse hi Israel chilhah Jacob chate Egypt gam'a anache ho chu ahiuve, Reuben chu Jacob chate lah a atahpen ahi.
en_web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
en_kjv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

tcz: Reuben chate ho Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
en_kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

tcz: Simeon chate amaho hi ahiuve, Jenuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Johan.
en_web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
en_kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

tcz: Levi chate ho, Gershon, Kohath, chule Merari, ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
en_kjv: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Judah chate ho chu, Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, chule Zezah ahiuve. Er le Onan chu Canaan gam'a ana thi lhon tai; Perez chate ho Hezron le Hamul ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
en_kjv: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

tcz: Issachar chate ho chu, Tolah, Puvah, Jashub, chule Simron ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
en_kjv: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

tcz: Zebulun chate ho chu Sered, Elon, chule Zahleel ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

tcz: Hiche pasal min hung kijih hohi Jacob le Leah Padan-Ram gam'a achen lai uva peng ho se ahiuve, chule amaho tilouva apenbe chu ahile achanu Dinah jong ahi; Jacob chate jouse numei le pasal abon'a Leah a kona hung peng doh jouse chu agoma som-thumle thum ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
en_kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

tcz: Gad chate ho chu, Zephon ahin, Haggi ahin, Shumi ahin, Ezbon ahin, Eri ahin, Arodi chule Areli ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
en_kjv: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

tcz: Asher chilhah ho chu, Imnah ahin, Isvah ahin, Ishvi chule Beriah ahiuve; chule Serah chu asopinu ahin Beriah chate ho Heber chule Malkaiel ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Ishui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

tcz: Hiche pasal ho sese hi Zilpah chate ho Leah sohnun akon a Jacob chilhah ho ahiuvin agom a som le gup ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

tcz: Jacob chilhah Rachel in ahinpeh Joseph le Benjamin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
en_kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

tcz: Joseph chate ni Egypt gam'a peng Mannaseh le Ephhraim ahi lhone, amani nu min chu Asenath Potiphera chanu On gam'a thempu pa chanu ahiye.
en_web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
en_kjv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

tcz: Benjamin chate ho chu, Bela ahin, Bekar ahin, Ashbel ahin, Gera ahin, Namaan ahin, Ehi ahin, Rosh ahin, Muppim ahin, Huppim ahin, chule Ard ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
en_kjv: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

tcz: Hiche a pasal hung kijih hohi Rachel le Jacob ma kona hung peng doh abonchauva som le li ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

tcz: Dan chapa chu, Hushim ahi.
en_web: The son of Dan: Hushim.
en_kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

tcz: Napthali chate ho chu, Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin chule Shillem ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
en_kjv: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

tcz: Hiche pasal ho hi Jacob chate Bilhah in ahin peh Laban in Rachel soh dinga apeh nu akon a chu ahi, abon'un cha pasal sagi ahing lhone.
en_web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

tcz: Jacob chilhah te Egypt ma amatoh che ho chu achate jiho sim louvin mihem somgup le gup ahiuve.
en_web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
en_kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

tcz: Hiche tilou chun Jacob in Egypt ma cha pasal ni aneiben hijeh chun abonchauvin Jacob insung mite chu Egypt gam'a anachen laiyu chun mihem som sagi alhingset un ahi.
en_web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
en_kjv: and the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

tcz: Amaho alamjot naova alhun nadiu ahung naithim tan, Jacob in Judah chu Goshem jotna lamhil hedin asol in, chuin phat chomkhat jouvin amaho alhung tauve.
en_web: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
en_kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

tcz: Joseph a sakol kangtalai chunga atou doh in apa Jacob chu Goshem lama aga kimuto pitai, Hichun Joseph in apa Jacob amu phat chun phat sottah a ngongkoi in akap tai.
en_web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
en_kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in ahin hou in, Joseph koma aseitai, “Keima tua hi thithei ka hitai, Ajeh chu nangma nana hing nalai in tuhin namai ka mutai,” ati.
en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
en_kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in asopite le apa insung mite jah a “Keima chetou ing ting Pharaoh jah a thu galhut ing ka ting ajah a, ‘Canaan gam'a cheng ka sopite le kapa insung mite ka heng ahung lhung tauve!
en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

tcz: Amaho hi kelngoi ching mi ahiuvin, chule amahon anei thil jouse le agancha hou jong ahin kipui uve gati ing'e.
en_web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
en_kjv: and the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

tcz: Ahin Pharaoh in nahin hou teng ule nahin doh dingu ahin, “Nangma hohi ipi na natoh ji uham ahin ti ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

tcz: Nangma hon hitia hi na donbut dingu ahi, keiho nasoh teho hi ka neo uva patna kapate kapute banga kelngoi ching ka hung hitauve nati diu ahi, chuteng chule Pharaoh in Goshem lhanglam a nahin chen sah diu ahi; ajeh chu Egypt miten kelngoi chingho athei nom pouve.”
en_web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
en_kjv: that ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

tcz: Hiti chun Joseph ache lut in Pharaoh henga thu agalhut in, ‘‘Kapa le ka sopite akelngoi ho jouse le aganchau toh chule aneijouseu toh kilhon in Canaan gam'a kon in ahung lhung tauve; tuhin Goshem gamsunga aum uve,” aga ti.
en_web: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”
en_kjv: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in asopi ho lah a mi nga alhengdoh in Pharaoh henga phondohna aneiyin ahi.
en_web: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in amaho chu thu adong tan, “Nangma ho ipi natong nahiu ham?” amahon adonbut un, “Keima ho nasohte ho hi kapu kapate khanga patna kelngoi ching ka hiuve atiuvin ahi.”
en_web: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

tcz: Amahon Pharaoh henga ahoulim un, hiche gam'a cheng dinga hi keiho ka hung taovu ahe, ajeh chu nasoh teho hi kelngoi vah ka hiuvin, hamdong jong Canaan lhang lama aum tapoi; Hijeh chun lungset tah in Goshem lhang langa nei chen sah un kel hah sung in atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
en_kjv: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph jah a aseiye, “Napa ahin, na sopi ho nangma koma din ahung tauve.
en_web: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

tcz: Nangman lhen peh tan Egypt gamsung pumpia amaho achen thei na diuvin, chule Egypt gamsung a apha pen chu pen ati; Hichun Goshem lhang lam chu pen amaho din ati. Chule amaho lah a miching thepna nei aumle keima gancha ho vetup din nei koi peh in,” ati.
en_web: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”
en_kjv: the land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any man of activity amongst them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in apa Jacob chu Pharaoh koma ahin puijin akihet tohsah in chujouvin Jacob in Pharaoh chu phatthei aboh in ahi.
en_web: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in “Kum ijat na hitam tin Jacob chu adong in ahi.”
en_web: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

tcz: Jacob in adonbut in, “Keima hi leiset chunga lam ka hin jotna patna hi kum ja khat le som thum tobang ka hitai; Amavang ka hinkho hi kapate ho kapute ho sang in achom jo na laiye,” ati.
en_web: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Pharaoh avel in adalhah masang in avel in phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
en_web: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

tcz: Joseph in apa Jacob ahin asopiho abonchauvin Egypt gamsunga achensah tan, chule nei le gou jong apen gam jong apha pen Ramases lhangjol lam chu Pharaoh thupeh dungjui in ape tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
en_kjv: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in apa ahin, asopite ahin abonchauvin amahon angaichat dungjui in ape sohkei jin, chule chapang neocha cha ho gei ding in jong ape jeng tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.
en_kjv: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin neh-leh-chah ahah lheh jeng tan, anchang kikoi jouse jong ane chai gam tauve, Egypt gamsung le Canaan gamsunga mipite jouse neh le chah hahsat jeh in mipi thi ding in aum gam tan ahi.
en_web: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
en_kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

tcz: Joseph in sum le pai akhol doh jouse chu Egypt gamsung ahin Canaan gamsunga anchang achoh nau sum jouse chu Pharaoh gou kholna muna ahin polut tai.
en_web: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
en_kjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

tcz: Mipite jouse Egypt akon ahin, Canaan a kon ahin, sum le pai jouse alhahsam phat in Joseph koma ahung taovun ahi, Amaho akap'un “Sum le pai Sana le dangka ho jouse akichai tai; an neh ding neipeh lou ule nangma mitmua thiding ka hitauve atiuvin ahi.”
en_web: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
en_kjv: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in adonbut in, “Na dangka hou abei tah le nagancha hou keima henga hinkai jun, keiman nangho gancha hotoh kitoh ding an neh ding kalhet peh ding na hiuve ati.
en_web: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
en_kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

tcz: Hichun amahon an nehtoh lheh ding in agancha hou jouse Joseph koma ahin kaiyun, chule sakol hon ho ahin, kelngoi hon hole keltah hon ho ahin chule abong hon ho le sangan ho jouse jong Joseph koma alheh cheh un hichun aman kum khat an neh ding apeh be kit tan ahi.
en_web: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
en_kjv: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

tcz: Amavang hiche kum chu akichai kit tan, kumthat ahung lhung kittan hichun amahon a seikit tauve, “Nangma akon in imacha ka im thei tapouve, Ajeh chu ka dangka hou se la aki chaitan, ka gancha hou ka bong hou la abei tan, tua hi keima hon imacha peh ding ka neita pouve, tua hi ka tahsao le ka leiset bou'u aum tai.
en_web: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.
en_kjv: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also had our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

tcz: Nangma mitmua iti ka moh thi thei diu ham keima ho tahsa ahin ka leiset'u hi an neh ding toh lheh jeng tau vinge atiuve; ka leiset u ahin ka tahsau ahin Pharaoh soh in umtau ving kate, hijeh chun anchang neh ding neipe uvin, kathi lou na diuvin, chule leiset gam chu mohseh a umlou a asetna lou ding in atiuve.
en_web: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”
en_kjv: wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in Egypt gamsunga leiset jouse Pharaoh din Egypt mite koma kon in achodoh soh tan ahi.
en_web: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.
en_kjv: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

tcz: Mipi ho vang chu ahile khopi akon in gam ong thinglhang lama asol in Egypt gamsunga mun khat a patin mun chom a asol in ahi.
en_web: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
en_kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

tcz: Gam leiset Joseph in ana choh lou chu ahile thempu ho gam ahi. Ajeh chu hitobang thempu ho chu ana kipe doh aum in, amaho chun Pharaoh a kona an neh ana kisan'u ahi jeh ahi, chule agam leiset'u jong kichol ngai lou ahi.
en_web: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.
en_kjv: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in mipite lah a ahoulim in, “Veuvin tunia keiman nangho chule nagam leiset'u Pharaoh adia ka chohdoh ahitai keiman nangho muchi kapeh ding nanghon na phailei uva chang na tu theiyu ahitai.
en_web: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
en_kjv: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

tcz: Chule nangman chang na at teng hop nga lah a hop khat Pharaoh adia napeh ding hopli chu nangma muchi adia na kikoi diu, chule nangma ho insung mite an neh a pang ding aneocha cha ho geija kapeh na hiuve.
en_web: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

tcz: Amahon aphong doh un, “Keima ho hinkho hi nangman neihuh doh peh'u ahi atiuve, chule nangma phatsah bang hi jeng hen; chule lungset tah in ka pakai pa Pharaoh soh in pangmai jeng tau vinge atiuvin ahi.”
en_web: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
en_kjv: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

tcz: Chule Joseph in dan asem in Egypt gam'a tuni geihin aki mang na laiye, hichu ahile Pharaoh in hop nga lah a hopkhat ane jing na laiyin, thempu ho a tilou chu gam leiset abona Pharaoh a ahi tai.
en_web: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
en_kjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

tcz: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin, Israel mipite chun Egypt gamsunga Goshem lhanglam chu alodim tauvin, hichea pat chun amahon nei le gou akilamdoh un, abol jouse'u jong nasatah in apung tul tul jengun ahi.
en_web: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
en_kjv: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possession therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

tcz: Hichun Jacob chu Egypt ahung lhun jouvin kum som le kum sagi ahinbe in Jacob hin nikho abon bon'a kum jakhat le kum som li le kum sagi alhing in ahi.
en_web: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
en_kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

tcz: Israel chu athi tei ding nikho ahung nai tul tul phat in aman jong achapa Joseph akouvin ajah a “Na mit mua nangma ka lung lhaisah jouva ahile gunchu tah le kitah tah a nei bolna ding in kataipi gui noi tuhin lang Egypt gam'a neihin vuilou hel na dingin kitep in;
en_web: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
en_kjv: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

tcz: Keima ka hinkho ahung beiteng lungset tah in ka tahsa hi Egypt akon in eipo doh inlang kapu kapate kivui na muna neivui in, hichun Joseph jong aki hahsel in, “Keiman nangma seibang bang in hinbol peh nang kate,” ati.
en_web: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”
en_kjv: but I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in avel in aseikti in, “Nangma kitep in ati, hichun Joseph akihahsel tan, chuin Jacob chu alupna a akhup lang in alum tai.”
en_web: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
en_kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

tcz: Tun hitin ahung um phat chomkhat jouin nikhat chu Joseph chu thu asei peh un, “Napa chu alha suh lheh jeng tai; hichun Joseph chu apa kimu pi din achen achate ni Ephraim le Manasseh jong akipui in ahi.
en_web: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
en_kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

tcz: Chuin Jacob chu aseipeh un, “Ven nachapa Joseph chu nangma kom ahin jone,” hichun Jacob atha ahung kido in alupna apat in athou doh in atoutai.
en_web: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.
en_kjv: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Joseph chu ahoulimpin, “Pathen hatchungnung in Luz muna Canaan gam'a eiki mupi chun phatthei eiboh e ati.
en_web: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
en_kjv: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

tcz: Chuin aman eihoulim pin “Ven nangma kaga sah ding chule kapun sah ding chu jong le nangma chilhah tamtah'a kasem doh ding nahi; nachi lhah techu Canaan gam hi amaho nei le goudia atonsot a kapeh ding ahitai tin eihou limpi'e.
en_web: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
en_kjv: and said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

tcz: Keima hung lhun masanga Egypt gamsunga nacha teni Manasseh le Ephraim hi keima a hiding ahi; Reuben le Simeon keija ahitobang hi amani jong hi keiya ahi lhon'e.
en_web: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.
en_kjv: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

tcz: Hinlah chapang naosen tu khonunga peng ho vang nangma a hiding ahitai; chule amaho se chu asopi ho goulo min lah aki simtha ding ahi lhon e.
en_web: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
en_kjv: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

tcz: Phatkhat lai chun keima Padan- Ram lama kahung kinunglen Rachel chu Canaan gam'a athipa tan keima ho Ephrathah toh kikah gamla thim lheh nalaiyin lung kham tah in Rachel chu Ephratha Jerusalem lampi noiya kahin vuitai.”
en_web: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”
en_kjv: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in chapang teni chu aven adong kit in “hiche chapang teni hi nangma chate ham ati.”
en_web: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”
en_kjv: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

tcz: Joseph in adonbut in adih e ati, “hiche chate ni hi Pathen in hiche Egypt gamsunga eipeh ahi.” Jacob in adonbut in “Amani chu keima koma hinpui nai uvin phatthei kaboh ding ahi.”
en_web: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

tcz: Jacob chu akum atam phat in amittha jong alhasam lheh jeng tai, Ajeh chu aha muchen joutapoi; hichun Joseph in achateni chu apa kom Jacob naideu in ahin pui in chuin apan amani chu achop in akoiyin ahi.
en_web: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
en_kjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

tcz: Israel in Joseph koma aseiyin, “Keiman nangma maichang mu kitdinga hi kana kigin chat lou ahitai, ahin tuhin Pathen in na chate ni jong eimusah tai,” ati.
en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
en_kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in achateni chu apa Israel khup akon in akhin doh in amai tolang angan abohkhup tai.
en_web: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
en_kjv: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

tcz: Joseph chun achate ni chu ani tah lhon in akaiyin, Ephraim chu akhut jet lam in Israel khut veilama chun akai lutpeh-in, chule Manasseh chu Israel khut jetlam a, akhut veilam in akai lut in anilhon chun amapa henga apuiluttai.
en_web: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
en_kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand towards Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

tcz: Ahin Israel in Ephraim chu aneojo ahivangin akhut jetlam chu achunga angamtan, chule Manasseh chu apeng masa ahivang in Israel in akhut veilam chu Manasseh chunga angam tan ahi.
en_web: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
en_kjv: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Joseph phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Ka Pathen kapu Abraham kapa Isaac masanga lamkai jingpa ka Pakai kelngoi chinga hung pang jing ka hinkho pumpi tuni geiya eipui hoipa;
en_web: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
en_kjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

tcz: Thil gilou tin chenga kona eina lhatdoh jing vantil chun chapang teni hi phatthei hin boh hen; chule amani chunga hin keima min le kapu Abraham min, kapa Isaac min hung kihedoh jing jeng hen; chujong le amani hi leiset vaipi jalah a mipi atama tam in hung pung lhon hen,” ati.
en_web: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
en_kjv: the Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

tcz: Ahin Joseph chu alunglhai molheh jeng in apa Isaac in akhut jetlam Ephraim chunga angap jeh chun, ahin Joseph in apa khut chu atuh in ajetlam chu Manasseh chunga angap sah in akhut veilam chu Ephraim chunga angap sah tai.
en_web: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
en_kjv: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

tcz: “Hepa ahipoi ati amapa joh hi apeng masa ahi bouve, nangma khut jetlam chu Manasseh chung joh ahin ngamtan,” ati.
en_web: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

tcz: Amavang apa Israel anom poi, ka hethem nai chapa keiman Manasseh jong ama chilhah te jong hunglen diu mitamtah hiding ahin anaopa amasanga hung nasa joding ahi, chule ama chilhah ho chu nam tamtah hung hiding ahibouve.
en_web: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”
en_kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

tcz: Hichun Israel in chapang teni chu phatthei aboh in hiche ni chun ama a kona phatthei jouse aboltai; nangma min a Israel in hiche phatthei hi naboh ding ahi, Pa Pathen in nangma hi Ephraim le Manasseh bang in pung jing tahen.
en_web: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.
en_kjv: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in Joseph koma aseitai, “Ven keima kathi na ding anaitai, ahin Pathen in phatthei naboh ding, chule Canaan a napu na pate gam'a nanung puikit ding ahi.
en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
en_kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

tcz: Na sopite ho kapeh sanga nang ma lentah gam kapeh be ding nahi; chule leiset gam Amorite mite khut a kona kachoh dohsa Shechem molbih khat kapei atin ahi.
en_web: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
en_kjv: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in achate jouse akou khom in hitin aseiye, “Keima naivel a hung kikhom un, chule keiman nangho thuguh kasei peh ding nahiuve, khonunga ipi hung lhung ding ham naseipeh uvinge,” ati.
en_web: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
en_kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

tcz: Hung un chule ngaijun, nangho Jacob chate ho napao Israel thusei ngai jun,
en_web: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
en_kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.

tcz: Reuben kachapa atahpen katha hat pen laiya kanei, ka khanghoi lai tah a kahin chule nangma amasa penna jana chang chule nangma amasa pena thahat chang nahi.
en_web: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
en_kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, My might, and the beginning of my strength, The excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

tcz: Nangma twi kimang banga phatna najou tapoi, ajeh chu napa lupna jalkhun nasuboh tai.
en_web: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
en_kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; Because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; Then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

tcz: Simeon le Levi sopi khat ahilhone, chule aman chah lhon ho chu galsat na ding bou ahi.
en_web: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
en_kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

tcz: Keima lhagao vang amaho lah a jaoda mai hen, chule amaho natoh gon jong jahda ding kanome; ahin amaho alunghan teng ule mihem hinkho ahin suhbei dingu ahi, chule amaho deilah a bongchal ho ahin hellhuh diu ahi.
en_web: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
en_kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; Unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: For in their anger they slew a man, And in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

tcz: Jacob chate ho lah a kahop khen ding keiman Israel sunga amaho chu kathe cheh ding ahitai, alunghan nau sapset ahitai, ajeh chu tijat umtah, alunghan nao jong phalou tah ahi.
en_web: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
en_kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; And their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel.

tcz: Judah nangma nasopi houvin nathang at ui, nangma namel mate angonga na matchah ding, nasopi ho jouse nangma masanga kun cheh diu ahi.
en_web: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
en_kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: Thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; Thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

tcz: Judah ka chapa hi keipi nou tobang ama chu aneh jou tobang pet ahi, keipi bangin akitaulei, chule keipi nou konba anodoh jou ding gam.
en_web: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
en_kjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp: From the prey, my son, thou art gone up: He stooped down, he couched as a lion, And as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

tcz: Hiche tenggol chu Judah a kona potdoh lou ding ahi, chule dan thempu a kona akeng teni kikah ajong pot doh lou ding Shiloh ahung lhun to kahsea anam miten athu angai jing dingu ahi.
en_web: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
en_kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, Nor a lawgiver from between his feet, Until Shiloh come; And unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

tcz: Aman a sangan chu lengpi thei phunga ahen in chule sangan nou chu abah hoipen lengpi bah a ahenin, chule apon ho chu lengpi twiya asop in chule ama von ho chu lengpi twiya asop ngime.
en_web: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
en_kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; He washed his garments in wine, And his clothes in the blood of grapes:

tcz: Amit teni chu lengpi twi sangin asangjon chule ahatu jouse chu bongnoi twi bang phet phut ding ahi.
en_web: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
en_kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.

tcz: Zebulun chu twi-khanglen panga cheng ding ahi, chule ama koma chu kongho kinga ding chule agamgi chu Sidon geiya cheng diu ahi.
en_web: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
en_kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; And he shall be for a haven of ships; And his border shall be unto Zidon.

tcz: Issachar vang chu ahile sangan hattah ahi, ama chu hahsat na molni kikah aum ahi.
en_web: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
en_kjv: Issachar is a strong ass Couching down between two burdens:

tcz: Aman ngahmun khat amudoh in, chule agam nop dan jong chu dei chat um ahi; hijeh chun aman thilpo ding in alengkou adon, namphu in soh dingin akipelut tai.
en_web: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
en_kjv: And he saw that rest was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And bowed his shoulder to bear, And became a servant unto tribute.

tcz: Dan vang chu amite ding in lungmon ahin, bolpeh ding Israel te phungkhat hin na ahin to ding ahi.
en_web: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
en_kjv: Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.

tcz: Dan chu lampi lhanglang a gul tobang ahi, chule lampi a gulse kijam tobang ahin, ama chun sakol keng achuh le achunga toupa akinung le lhah tai.
en_web: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
en_kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, An adder in the path, That biteth the horse heels, So that his rider shall fall backward.

tcz: Keiman nangma katahsane huhhingna kachan thei na din o ka Pakai.
en_web: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.
en_kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

tcz: Mipihon Gad chunga lam ajot diu ahin achaina aman amaho chunga lam ahin jot ding ahi.
en_web: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
en_kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: But he shall overcome at the last.

tcz: Asher chu an neh neng ding ahiye, chule aman lengho neh thei ding hoitah le twitah a ahon thei ding ahi.
en_web: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
en_kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.

tcz: Napthali chu sajuh pi kihen lou tobang ahin, aman thu ngei tah a pao doh ding ahi.
en_web: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
en_kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.

tcz: Joseph hi lengpi thingga phatah tobang ahi, chule twinah phung thingbah ga phatah ahi, abah hon jong bang akhokhel gamtai.
en_web: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
en_kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, Even a fruitful bough by a well; Whose branches run over the wall.

tcz: Thalpi kapthem hon avetda lheh un, amapa akap un chule abol genthei lheh jeng uve.
en_web: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
en_kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, And shot at him, and hated him:

tcz: Ahin amapa thalpi alhou lheh in suhset bun aum poi. Chule abanthahat na jong aki peh ben, Jacob Pathen thahatna chun aumpi jing'e; chule kelngoi chingpa chu Israel te hongpi a pang ahi.
en_web: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
en_kjv: But his bow abode in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong By the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (From thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

tcz: Chule na panpi Pathen in na kithopi jeh in hatchung nung pen phatthei naboh mai hen, chujong leh van chunga phattheina tin changmai jin, chule leithol noilanga twi dim bang in phatthei na chang jing in, chule noitwi akon, naobu akon phatthei na jouse chang tan.
en_web: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
en_kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; And by the Almighty, who shall bless thee With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that lieth under, Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

tcz: Napan phatthei na bohna ho chu masanga napute phatthei na ho sang in phatthei joh hi maihen, chule molsang pen ho sang in sangpen main. Hiche phatthei na ho jouse hi Joseph chunga umjing tahen, ajeh chu amahi asopite lah a dinga leng cha ahi.
en_web: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
en_kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors Unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

tcz: Benjamin chu Sial tobang ahi, ajeh chu jingkah lam le amelmate chu aval lhum jin nilhah lam teng alotup ho chu ahomkhen jenge.
en_web: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
en_kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at night he shall divide the spoil.

tcz: Amaho se hi Israel phungsom le phungni ahiuve, hiche thucheng ho hi apan asei peh'u ahi; amaho jouse chu phatthei aboh in chule ki lhahna thu cheng aneiyin, chule amaho jouse khat khat in ama hina cheh in phatthei aboh cheh in ahi.
en_web: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
en_kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in hitin ahil e, amaho se chu keima hi thivah ding kahitai, chule kapute kapate ho lah a jaovah ding kahitai, Ephron Hite gam'a kapute kapate kivui na muna chu kei jong neivui un ati.
en_web: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
en_kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

tcz: Abraham'in hiche songlhan chu Machpelah loumun Mamre nisolam Canaan gamsunga um ahin, ama lhan mun dinga Hite mipa Ephron henga loumun ana choh doh ahi.
en_web: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
en_kjv: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

tcz: Hiche muna chun Abraham le Sarah akivui lhon in, chule hiche mun chu Isaac le aloinu Rabekah jong aki vuijin chule keiman jong hilai mun a chu Leah kana vui ahi.
en_web: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
en_kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

tcz: Hiche gam chu phaicham kotong lam chu kapu Abraham'in Hite mipa koma ana choh doh ahi.
en_web: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
en_kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

tcz: Hichun Jacob chu achapate athu lhah chai in jalkhun chunga akeng teni asep doh in ama ahaitan tai, chuin ama amite to akivui tha tai.
en_web: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
en_kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

tcz: Hichun Joseph apa mai senan akineiyin apa chunga kap pum in akoi jin achop in ahi.
en_web: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
en_kjv: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in asohte louthem ho chu apa longdamsa tom din thu apen, hichun louthem ho chun atom tauvin ahi.
en_web: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
en_kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

tcz: Hitobanga longdamsa kitom chu nisom li tobang lut jia ahi; chule Egypt miho ama chu nisom sagi alunghem pi vin ahi.
en_web: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.
en_kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

tcz: Hichun lunghem na nikho ho chu ahung kichai tan, Joseph in lengpa Pharaoh insung mite chu ahoulimpin, “Lungset tah in kadei khat neibol peh thei diu ham Pharaoh koma keima khel in neiga sei peh dingu kanom e,” ati.
en_web: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
en_kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

tcz: Kapa in adamlai in eina kihahsel sah in hitin aseiye, “Keima ka hinkho beivah ding ahitai, hijeh chun keima tahsa hi Canaan gam'a nei nung lhut teiyin ati, chule keima kivui na dia lhan ka kisem na muna nei vui tei ding ahi ati. Hijeh chun lungset tah in neisol inlang kapa ga kivui ingting kin kivuina akichai teng tep son louva kahung kinungle ding ahi tai.
en_web: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
en_kjv: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in adonbut in, “Napan nangma na kitep sah na bang in gachen lang napa chu gaki vuitan,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

tcz: Hichun Joseph chu apa Israel vui din achetan ahile Pharaoh in alhon piding in Egypt gamsunga alen alal ho ahin asohte ahin, asemang pachong ho jouse toh asol than ahi.
en_web: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
en_kjv: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

tcz: Joseph in a insung mite ahin asopite ahinpui in chule chapang neocha hole gancha hole kelcha ho ahin, sangan hole bongho le adang hose vang Goshem a ahin dalhau vin ahi.
en_web: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
en_kjv: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

tcz: Chuin amaho jouse toh sakol kangtalai toh sakol chunga atou un Joseph chu alhon piuvin ahi.
en_web: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.
en_kjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

tcz: Hichun amaho Jordan vadunga Atad chang vohna mun ahung lhun un amaho gimna tah in a lunghem na aneiyun lhase tah in aum un Joseph in jong nisa gi jen lunghem tah in aum in ahi.
en_web: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
en_kjv: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

tcz: Chuin hiche a cheng Canaan gam miten Atad chang voh na muna amaho lunghem tah a aumu chu amu uvin , hichun amahon hitin asei uve, “Tuhi Egypt mite dinga nasa taha lunghem lhaset phat ahin hijeh chun hiche mun chu Abel Mizraim asah tauvin ahi.”
en_web: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
en_kjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

tcz: Hichun Jacob chaten ama in athupeh bang bang in abolpeh'un ahi.
en_web: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
en_kjv: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

tcz: Ama hon apa longdamsa chu Canaan gam'a apolut tauvin Macphelah kotong phailei a Mamre koma Abraham'in hiche mun chu Ephron Hititte pa koma atonsot a kivui thei na dinga ana choh doh ahitai.
en_web: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
en_kjv: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

tcz: Aman apa Jacob chu avui jou chun Joseph ahin asopite ho jouse chule midang akilhon pi jouse Egypt gam'a ahung ki nungle tauvin ahi.
en_web: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
en_kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

tcz: Ahin tua hi amaho apao umtah luo jeh chun Joseph sopi ho chu hatah in ahung tija tauvin, amahon aseiyun, “Joseph chun alunghan na ho eihon inabolset nau jouse chu ahin phulah ding ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
en_kjv: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon hiche thucheng ho hi Joseph hetdin athot tauve, napa athi masang chun hiche thuguh ho eina seipeh uve.
en_web: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
en_kjv: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

tcz: Joseph henga hiti hin sei peh uvin lang, “Na heng'a ka tao ahi, na sopiten na chunga thil gilou abol uva suhkhel anei nau chu ngaidam in,” ‘tin aseiye tiuvin,’ ati. Hijeh chun keiho na henga katao vui, na hingpa napa Pathen sohte suhkhel na chu ngaidam tan atiuve; ajah a athusei jeh-u chun Joseph akap tai.
en_web: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
en_kjv: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

tcz: Hichun asopi ho ahung un ama masanga akun un hitin aseiyun, “keima ho hi nangma soh kahiuve.”
en_web: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
en_kjv: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

tcz: Ahin Joseph in amaho chu a houlimpi in, “Nangho tija hih un, keima Pathen khel a ka hipoi?”
en_web: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

tcz: Nangma hon thil phalou nana gong un ahin Pathen in aphalam tah in ahin gong in tu tua mutheiya um mihem tamtah hinkho huhhing'a um thei ahi.
en_web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
en_kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangma ho kicha hih un, nangma ho ahin nachate hou ahin, ka ngailut na kajom jing ding ahi, chule Joseph in avel in angailut avetsah in thu ngeitah in ama ho chu ahoulim pin ahi.
en_web: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
en_kjv: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

tcz: Joseph ahin asopite ho jouse Egypt ma acheng soh keiyin, Joseph chu atahsa kum ja khat le kum som alhing tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
en_kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in khang thum chan na geiya Ephraim chilhah ho jong amun chu jong leh Joseph thagui a peng Manasseh chapa Machir chate jong ana mupeh in ahi.
en_web: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
en_kjv: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in asopite jah a, “Keivang kathina ding anai lam tan, ahivang in Pathen in nangho nahungvil tei yun tin, hiche gam a kon hin Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga anaki hahsel nagama dingin nahin puitou vunte,” ati.
en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
en_kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in Israel chate chu aki tepsah in chuin aman hitin aseiye, “Pathen in nahin kithopiuva hiche muna kona nahung pui teng ule hiche muna kona kagu kachang ho hi na nungpoh teitei diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
en_kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

tcz: Hichun Joseph kum jakhat le kum som ahin ahinkho abeitai. Hichun Egypt miten Joseph long damsa chu atom un athi kong chu Egypt gam sunga thingkong sunga akoi tauve.
en_web: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
en_kjv: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

tcz: Israel mite (hichu, Jacob chapate), ama insung mi cheh hin kipuija Egypt gam-sung'a apau toh kitollut ho min chu hicheng hi ahiuve:
en_web: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
en_kjv: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt jon a Jacob to kilhon achate chu, ainsung cheh to lhon a che

tcz: Reuben, simeon, Levi, Judah.
en_web: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
en_kjv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
tcz_gospelgo: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,

tcz: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin
en_web: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
en_kjv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
tcz_gospelgo: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin,

tcz: Dan, Naphtali, Gad chule Asher amaho cheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
en_kjv: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
tcz_gospelgo: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve.

tcz: Abonchauvin, Egypt gamsung'a Jacob chilhah chengse chu som sagi alhing'un chule Joseph vang agamsung'a ana um jingsa ahitai.
en_web: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
en_kjv: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob inkonse se abonchauvin som sagi alhingui. Achapa Joseph vang Egypt lhungsa ahitai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Joseph le asopi chengse athigam tauvin, hiche khang mite se chu akichai tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
en_kjv: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chom khat nungin Joseph le asopite, chule hiche khanga mite chu athisoh taove;

tcz: Ahinlah ason achilhah teu, Israel chate chun tu le cha tampi anei tauvin apung lheh jeng un, ahung hatdoh cheh cheh un gamsung pumpi ahin lodim tauve.
en_web: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongle achilhah-u Israelte chun cha le nao tampi ahingun, apung lheh jenguvin, Egypt gamsung dimset’in ahunei lhehtauve.

tcz: Egypt gamsunga chun Joseph chung chang thule ana toh ho hephalou leng thah khat thaneina ahung chang tan ahi.
en_web: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
en_kjv: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt a Joseph phatna hephalou lengthah khat ahung laltai.

tcz: Amapa chun amite henga thu aseijin, “Vetem'un! Israel mite hi eiho sang'in apung'un chule eiho sang'in ahat lheh jeng tauve.
en_web: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
