en_kjv: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are moe and mightier than we:
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin amite jah a, “Hiche Israelte hi atamval’un ahunei behseh jeh-un eiho din kihol lel aumtai.

tcz: Amaho hi apunbe lou na diuvin, tohgon khat nei tauhite. Achuti louva ahile hung hatdoh untin, chule gal hung um taleh, imelma teu ahin panpi diu eihin dou'uva gamsunga kon'a jamdoh ding ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
en_kjv: come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Galbolna khat um kha le melmate ajop’uva eisat’uva pang thei, gamsunga kona jamdoh diu ahi. Apunbe be louna diuva alonaje khat het ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Egypt miten Isarel chate jouse soh in amangcha tauvin, achung'uva toh vaipo mikhanse tah tah ho apan sah un, chutobang bolgim na soh natoh akon'a chu suhnem ding akinem'un, namphu chang'in lengpa thilkhol na ding Pithom leh Rameses khopi chu asah sah uvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
en_kjv: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Egypt miten Israelte na hahsa tohsah a suhgepsit set din ahunguva toh vaipo akoiyun, lengpa thil kholna munpi din Pithom le Rameses khopi asah sah ui.

tcz: Ahinlah Egypt mite'n amaho asuhgim chan'un apungbe uvin akithejal cheh jo tauvin ahi, Egypt mite chu kichat nan aum jo tauvin ahi.
en_web: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
en_kjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Egyptten Israelte ahabol hesoh cheh-ule ahapun cheh-un, akithejao cheh jengun, gamsung alobe be jengui. Hiti hin Egypt ten Israelte akicha tauvin,

tcz: Chutah chun Egypt miten Israel mite chu ngailut na beihel'in thohgim hahsa athohsah uvin na atohsah un ahi.
en_web: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
en_kjv: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
tcz_gospelgo: gim genthei thoh-in natongin agoiyun,

tcz: Aki manchah na jouse uva gimna alhun sah un, bon ngan achilsah un, leilhang asemsah un, loujaova natoh jouse atohsah un, atoh nalam jouseuva gimbolna achansah tauvin ahi.
en_web: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
en_kjv: and they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
tcz_gospelgo: ada acham louvin soh goiyin agoiyun, voujang nalouhel’in insa loubol’in agoiyuve.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh, Egypt lengpan Hebrew mi nao dom teni Shiphrah leh Puah henga hiche thupeh hi aneiyin:
en_web: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
en_kjv: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan Hebrew numeite naodoma pang numei ni Shiphrah le Puah akihoupin,

tcz: “Hebrew numei hon nao anei uva nao dom'a napan teng lhon le, hichu phatah in vechil lhon in lang, naosen chu pasal ahileh natha lhon ding; numei ahile vang na hinghoi lhon ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
en_kjv: and he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hebrew numei ho nao nadop teng, pasal cha cha that’in, numei ho hinghoi lhonin,” ati.

tcz: Ama vang nao dom teni chun Pathen agin lhon jeh chun, lengpa thupeh chu anahsah lhon tapon, naosen pasal'a hungpeng lha ho jong chu ahinghoi lhon tan ahi.
en_web: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
en_kjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla naodom ten in Pathen agin lhon jeh-in lengpa thu anit lhonpoi, pasal ho geiyin ahinghoi lhontai.

tcz: Chu in lengpan nao dom teni chu aheng'a akouvin, “Ipi jeh a hiche hi nabol lhon hitam?” tin adong'in, chule “Ipi jeh a naosen pasal ho chu, nahinghoi lhon ham?” tin ajah lhon'a aseiyin ahi.
en_web: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
en_kjv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan naodomte ni agakousah-in, “Idia kasei ngai louva Hebrewte cha pasal ho nathada lhon ham? tin adonge.

tcz: Naodom tenin adonbut in “Hebrew numei ho hi Egypt numei hotoh abang pouve, amaho hi athoh hat un aheng'u akilhun masang'in amaho le ama ho beilam tah in ana ki doplhah jitauvin aphatchan kalap ji lhonpoi,” tin asei lhon'e.
en_web: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
en_kjv: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Naodomte nin, “Hebrew numei ho hi Egypt numeiho tobang ahipouve, anaopen’u abaiyin, khatjoh sang kalhun masang lhonle aping lhaji tauve,” ati lhon’e.

tcz: Pathen chu naodom teni din aphalheh jeng'in, Israelte chu apungbe cheh cheh tauvin ahile, athanei nau jong ahung hatdoh cheh cheh jeng tan ahi.
en_web: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
en_kjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin naodomte ni akhoton, Israelte apunbe be jengun, ahat lheh tauve.

tcz: Naodom teni in Pathen agin lhon jeh chun, Pathen in amani chu ama a ama a ding cheh insung asem dohpeh lhon'in ahi.
en_web: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
tcz_gospelgo: Naodomte nin Pathen agin lhonjeh-in Pathenin ainsung lhon phattheina apei.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in amite jouse hiche thupeh hi aneiyin: “Hebrew naosen'a penglha pasal kiti phot chu Nile Vadung lam'a na pailhah jeng diu, ahin lah numeiya hung peng chengse vang chu hing hoiyun,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhonnan Pharaoh-in amite jah a, “Hebrewte cha naosen pasal peng jouse man khom’un Nile luidunga sep lut’un, naosen numei ho vang hung hoi peh-un,” tin thu apei.

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin, Levi insung'a kon pasal khat leh Levi insungmi numei khat ma aki cheng lhon tan ahi.
en_web: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
en_kjv: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin Levi pasal khat’in Levi chanu khatma akichenpi.

tcz: Numeinu chu ahung gaijin chapa khat ahing tai. Amanun achapa chu aven ahile lunglhai umtah naosen ahin, lhathum sung'in asel tan ahi.
en_web: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
en_kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajinu hin cha pasal khat aneiyin, mel-hoi tah ahijeh-in ait behseh-in lha thum jen aseltai.

tcz: Ahivang'in amanun achapa chu asel joulou phat in, sinkhup Pyparus naang'a kisa khat agalan twilut na lou ding'in avonglai jouse ahubit sohkeiye. Chuin sinkhup sung'a naocha chu akhum'in Nile Vadung pang phaipheng lah achun alha lut tai.
en_web: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
en_kjv: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
tcz_gospelgo: Asel lel hel phat’in, pumping nanga kisa pocha khat’a naosen chu akoiyin, twi lut thei louna din gom aloiyin, luipang pumping lah a chun akitolsah tai.

tcz: Chuin naosen unu jong gamlha thim'a kon'in ading'in naosen chu i-atidem tin agalvet in ahi.
en_web: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
en_kjv: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
tcz_gospelgo: Naosen u-nun gal’a pangin ave vei.

tcz: Chu jouvin Pharaoh chanu vadung'a kisil ding'in ahung suh tan, asot tolle hojong vadung pang achun avah le uvin ahi. Chuin amanun phaipheng phung lah a sinkhup chu ahin mudoh tan, aga la din asoh nu chu asol tan ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
en_kjv: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa chanu luidunga kisil din ahungin, vapanga achele len, pumping lah a pocha amudoh phat’in, nu-ngah khat agalahsah-e.

tcz: Lengpa chanun jong sinkhup chu ahongdoh in ahile, naocha chu amu in ahi. Chu-in naocha chu akap'in, amanun jong naocha chu avoujang natpi lheh in, “Hiche hi Hebrew mite cha khat hitei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
en_kjv: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa chanun pocha ahondoh le naosen pasal hoitah chu amun, ahung ka phat’in avoujang anan, “Hebrewte cha hitei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun naosen sopinun jong Lengpa chanu heng ahin naijin. “Keima kache a Hebrew numei khat naosen don ding kagahol peh ding ham?” tin adong'e.
en_web: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
en_kjv: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun naosen u-nun lengpa chanu jah a, “Naosen hi navahpeh dia Hebrew numei ho khat kagakoupeh ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Lengpa chanu in jong, “Henge, gapui jin!” tin adonbut in, numeinu jong ache-in naosen hingnu mama chu aga puiye.
en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman jong, “Neigakoupeh nget-o,” ati. Naosen u-nun anu ma ma chu agakoutai.

tcz: Chuin lengpa chanu'n jong naosen hingnu jah'a aseijin. “Naosen hi lanlang neidon peh'in, Keiman na don man ka peh ding nahi,” ati. Chuin numeinu in jong naosen chu a-inlam'a adom'in amapa chu adon tan ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichenu jah a chun lengpa chanun, “Naosen hi neivah peh-in, nachol man penange,” ati. Aman jong akilah-in avah-in apangtai.

tcz: Khonung'in, chapang pa jong akhang len tan ahile, anu in amapa chu Pharaoh chanu henga ahung thah tan, amapa chu lengpa chanu chapa in ahung pang tai. Lengpa chanu in amapa chu amin Mose asah tai, ajeh chu amanun aseijin, “kei man amapa hi twi lah a kon kaloidoh ahi,” ati.
en_web: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
en_kjv: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
tcz_gospelgo: Naosen chu akikhan lhit phat’in lengpa chanu henga apuile, aman chapan akisimtai. Lengpa chanun, “Twi lah a kalahdoh jeh-in amin Moses ah ing’e,” ati.

tcz: Kum phabep ache nung in, Mose jong ahung khang lentan, amapa jong asopiho vil din ache toutan, aman jong asopi Hebrew mite hunam'a na atohsah nau aga mudoh tai. Agavil pet chun, Egypt mikhat in asopi Hebrew mikhat chung'a akhut alha chu amu paijin ahi.
en_web: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew, one of his brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose akhanlhit phat’a amite vea ache le, gim hesoh thoh a na hahsa atoh-u agamui. Egypt mi khat hin Hebrew mi khat atha geiyin agamudoh-in, athapa chu Mose insung mite khat ahikhai.

tcz: Akimvel avet a koima eive poi ti aphot chen phat in, Mose'n Egypt mipa chu athat in neldi lah a asel tan ahi.
en_web: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
en_kjv: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n jet le vei, sah le lhang avegol’in, koima amu lou phat’in Egypt mipa chu athah’in nellei lah a avuilut tai.

tcz: Ajing nikho in, asopi ho vildin Mose apot doh kit tan ahile, Hebrew mini akinah lhon aga amun ahi. “Ipi jeh a na golpa navoh ham?” tin kinah hin panpa heng'a chun Mose'n aseiye.
en_web: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
en_kjv: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajinga ache kit le Hebrew mi ni kina kibon agatoh khai. Athemmo jep pa jah a chun Mose’n, “I-bol’a na-Hebrew mi hipi chu navoh ham?” tin aphoh-e.

tcz: Amapan adonbut in, “Koiham nangma keiho chunga leng'a na pansah le thutan ding'a thaneina nape? Janhi a Egypt mipa natha banga chu keima jong tha ding neigot ham?” tin aseiyin ahileh, Mose jong akichan “Ka thil bol mijousen ahetai.” tin angai ton ahi.”
en_web: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
en_kjv: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ahin donbut’in, “Kon nang vaipo le thutan a natun em? Egypt mipa natha banga tha neigot ham?” ati. Hichun Mose jong akichan, “Kamitha hi mihon ahetdoh ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Mose thilbol chu Pharaoh in ahin jadoh tahbeh tan, chuin amapan Mose chu tha ding ago tan ahi. Ahivang'in Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon'in ajam'in Median gamsung'a chengdin ache tai. Median alhun chun Mose jong twikul pang'a atou tan ahi.
en_web: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
en_kjv: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharoah-in ajahdoh phat’in Mose chu tha din aholtai. Mose ajamin Midian gamsugna cheng din achetai. Nikhat Mose chu twikul panga atoupet’in

tcz: Tun Median thempupa chun chanu sagi aneiyin amaho chengse chu apau ganchahon ho ding'in twi kongho chu athal ngai bang'un ahung thal dim'un ahi.
en_web: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
en_kjv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Midian Thempupa Jethro chanu sagi jen chu apa kelngoite le kelcha te don ding twi thal’in ahungui.

tcz: Ahinlah kelngoi ching midang phabep ahung'uvin amaho chu anodoh un ahi. Hichun Mose jong achomdoh jeng'in kelngoi ching hoa kon chun numei chapang ho chu ahuhdoh tan ahi. Chuin amapan amaho ganchate a ding twi chu athal peh tan ahi.
en_web: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
en_kjv: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin kelngoiching midang phabep’in Jethro Chanute chu anodoh-un, hichea hin Mose’in akithopin, nu-ngahho ganchate chu twi achipsahsoh keiye.

tcz: Numei chapang ho chu apau Reuel heng ale lhun uchun, amapan adong un, “Ipi jeh-a tuni nahung kimale uham?” ati'in ahile,
en_web: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
en_kjv: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that you are come so soon to day?
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah ho apa henga ahung lhun phat’un, apauvin, “I-atile tunia matah a hung nahiuvam?” tin anadonge.

tcz: amahon jong adonbut uvin, “Egypt mi khat in kelngoi ching hoa kon'a eihuhdoh uva, chule amapa chun keiho ding le igancha hon houva ding twi eithal peh jeh'u ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
en_kjv: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngahhon jong, “Egypt mi pasal khat’in kelngoi chingho eideljam peh-un, ganchate don ding twi geiyin eithalpeh-un ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: “Ahile amapa hoiba ham?” tin apauvin adong'in, “ipi ding'a amapa chu chukom'a chu nahin dalhah uham? Ahung'a ankong isokhom diuvin gakouvun,” ati.
en_web: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
en_kjv: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Apauvin, “Hoiya umtam? I-bol’a nahin dalhah-u ham? Gakouvun an beh nekho’u hite,” ati.

tcz: Mose'n jong akounau chu asanpeh in, lengpa toh chun hiva chun acheng khom tan ahi. Hiche phatlai chun, Reuel'in achanu Zipporah chu Mose ji ding in ape tan ahi.
en_web: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
en_kjv: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose chengden din akigon, Jethron jong achanu Zipporah to akichensah-in,

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, amanun chapa khat ahing'in, Mose'n Gershom asah tai “Ajeh chu keima hi gamchom beh'a khopem kahi,” tina ahi.
en_web: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
en_kjv: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
tcz_gospelgo: Zipporah hin chapa khat ahinpeh-e, . Mose’n jong, “Hiche gam a khopem kahin, amin Gershom kiti ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Kum phabep ache nung in, Egypt lengpa athitan ahi. Hinlah Israelte chu soh kihen ohna noiya pohgih poa khoisa jing nalai ahiuve. Panpi ngaiyin akap un, aka awgin'u chu Pathen angsung alhung tan ahi.
en_web: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum phabep nungin Egypt lengpa athitan, ahivangin Israelte sohchang hesoh genthei thoh-in, panpi ngaichan apeng peng jengui. Aka apen’u Pathen kom alhungin,

tcz: Akhoisat nau Pathen in aja tan, chuin Abraham, Isaac leh Jacob heng'a akitepna ahin geldoh tan ahi.
en_web: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
en_kjv: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Abraham, Issac chule Jacob to akitepna chu ageldoh-e.

tcz: Aman Israel mite chu avesuh in, chuin tunvang toh phat ahitai ti chu ahe tan ahi.
en_web: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.
en_kjv: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Israelte sohchan, gim hesoh thoh amun athoh lel pi.

tcz: Mosen nikhat anupa pa Median thempu pa Jethro kelngoi achin laijin. Kelgoi hon chu gamlha tah gamthip lam'a apuiyin, Pathen molsang, Sinai lam'a chun ahung tan ahi.
en_web: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
en_kjv: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikhat Mose’n anupa pa Jethro, Midian Thempupa, kelngoite le kelchate chingin, gancha honte hoiyin, lhang theng, Sinai molsang aphatai.

tcz: Hiche laimun'a chun Pathen vantil meikong in hamboh lah'a ahung kilah in, Mose in lungdong tah in aven ahi. Hamboh chu akong jeng in hinlah akavam deh pon ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: Sinai molsanga Pakaiya kon valtil chu hamboh lah a meikouvin ahung kilah-in, hamboh meiya kouva, kavam thei louva um chu Mose’n amui.

tcz: Chuin Mose ama leh ama aki houlim in, “Hiche hi datmah umtah thil ahiye, ipijeh pentah a hiche hamboh khu kavam lou ahidem? kache a kavet tei angaiye” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
en_kjv: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman jong, “Akidang nah-e! Iti hamboh khu kavampai lou ham? gave tem’inge,” ati.

tcz: Hichu ve dinga Mose in hilam chu anailut jep jep e ti Pakaiyin amuphat'in, Pathen in hamboh lailung akon in, “Mose! Mose!” tin akouvin ahile, Mose in jong a donbut in “Keima hiva ka um'e,” ati.
en_web: When the LORD saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
en_kjv: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n anailut Pakaiyin amu phat’in, hamboh lah a kon chun “Mose! Mose!” tin ahinkouve. Mosen’n, “Hoi, ka-um nai,” ati.

tcz: “Hin nailut hihbeh in” tin Pakaiyin agih tan ahi. “Nakeng chot kisut in, ajeh chu nang ma muntheng'a ding nahi.
en_web: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
en_kjv: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “Hin nailutbe tahih-in. Nakengchot kisut’in, munthenga ding nahitai.

tcz: Keima napa dinga a-Pathen kahi - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, leh Jacob Pathen kahi”, ati. Hichu Mose in ajah phat in amai akhutai, ajeh chu Pathen avet ngamlou ahi.
en_web: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
en_kjv: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei hi napu napate-Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob Pathen kahi,” ati. Pathen avet ngam lou phat’in Mose’n amai akitomtai.

tcz: Chuphat in Pakaiyin ahenga aseijin, “Egypt a kamite kibol gimna ka muchen tai. Achung'uva tohvai hom hon asuh gimnau aka awgin'u kaja tan ahi. Heng'e, a thohgim nau abonchan ka hechen tai, ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
en_kjv: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Egypt gamsunga kamite engse tah a abol’u kamun, tohvai pote bolsetnaa kon huhdoh ngaicha akau kajatai. Ahesoh genthei nao kahesoh tai.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Egypt mite thannei nanoiya kon'a amaho huhdoh ding le Egypt gam'a kon'a gampha tah, khoiju le bongnoi lon na gam hichu - Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite Chule Jebus mite tua achenna'u gam'a puilut dinga Keima hikoma hung kumlha kahi, ati.
en_web: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
en_kjv: and I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Egypt mite khut’a kona amaho huhdoh dia hung kumlha kahin, mun lentah, gam phatah, Canaan mite le Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite chenna gamsunga puilut ding kagot ahi.

tcz: Vetan! Israel chate ka awgin ka angsung ahung lhung tai, chule Egypt miten asuh gimnau kichen tah in kamutai.
en_web: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
en_kjv: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite ka le pen kaja mong mongin, Egypt miten abol hesoh nau kamudoh tai.

tcz: Tun che jengin, ajeh chu Keiman nanghi Pharaoh henga kasol nahiye. Kami Israelte Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
en_kjv: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Agamsunga kona kamite puidoh dia Egypt lengpa koma kasol nahi,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Mose Pathen heng'ah akiphin in, “Kei koi kahia Pharaoh henga kaga kilah ding ham? Kei koi ka hia Israelte Egypt gam'a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Mose’n Pathen kom a, “Kei bep hi iti Egypt lengpa koma chea Israelte kagapuidoh thei ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Pathen in adonbut in, “Keiman ka umpi jing ding nahiye. Keiman kasol nahina nangma dinga melchihna hiche hi ahi: Nangman miho chu Egypt gam'a kon'a nahin puidoh teng leh, hiche mol tah a hi Pathen na hou ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
en_kjv: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pathenin, “Ken nalhonpi nange, Egypt a kona Israelte nahinpuidoh teng hiche molsang chunga hi neihou diu, hichu kei sol nahi phat chetna hi ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahivang'in Mose akiphin'in, “Keima Israel chate henga kachea ajah uva, ‘Napu napateu Pathen in na heng uva eihinsol ahi,’ tin sei leng ‘Amin ipi ham?’ tia eidoh diu ahi, chuteng amaho chu iti ka donbut ding ham?,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Israelte henga cheng ting ‘Napu napateu Pathenin eihinsol ahi,’ gati jong leng, ‘Ama chu amin ipi ham?’ tin eina dongun tin, chuting ipi kaseipeh thei diing ham?” ati.

tcz: Pathen in Mose a donbut in, “Keima hi Keima ka hi jeng'e. Hiche hi Israelte heng'a seipeh in: Keima chun na heng'uva eihinsol ahi,” tin ati.
en_web: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
en_kjv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “Kei chu Kei kahijingin, naseipeh tei ding chu-‘KEIMA kiti chun nahenguva eihinsol ahi’ nati ding ahi,

tcz: Pathen in jong Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi Israelte heng'a seipeh in: Yahweh,* napu napateu Pathen - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen in - naheng uva eihin sol ahi. Hiche hi ka tonsot min ahi, akhang akhang'a nageldoh jing diu kamin ahi.
en_web: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
en_kjv: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte jah a apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen chun ahenguva nasol’a naseipeh ding ahi. Hiche hi tonsot’a kamin ahin, khang nu-nunga miten hiche a hi eikou diu ahi.

tcz: “Tun chenlang Israel sung'a upa ho gakou khom tan. Aheng'uva seipeh in 'Yahweh, napu napauteu Pathen - Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob Pathen - kahenga akilah in ahi. Aman kajah-a aseiyin, “Keiman naichan kanave jing'un, chule Egypt miten na-engbol nau keiman kamui.
en_web: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.
en_kjv: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
tcz_gospelgo: Israel lamkaite gakoukhomin lang, apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen chu nahenguva hung kilah a anseipeh ding ahi. Egypt miten abolsetnau kamu jeh a avil’uva hung kahi hi seipeh-in.

tcz: Keiman nangho Egypt a nagenthei thoh nauva kon'a huh doh ding'a kakitep ahi. Keiman khoiju leh bongnoi lon na gam'a chu kapuilut ding nahiuve - hichu Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite Chule Jebus mite tua achen nau gam khu ahi,” ati.
en_web: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
en_kjv: and I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a kona puidoh kagot ahitai, gim genthei thoh a aum nauva kona puidoh a gam phatah-Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite gamsunga puilut ding kagot ahi.

tcz: “Israel upa hon nathusei angai diu ahi. Chuteng nang leh Israel upa chengse Egypt lengpa heng'a nache tei uva, ‘Pakai, Hebrew mite Pathen chun, eikimupi uve. Hijeh chun lungset tah in nithum sung'a gamthip lam'a kakhol jin uva Pakai ka Pathen'u henga kilhaina kasem dingu ahi” tia aheng'a nagasei diu ahi.
en_web: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD, our God.’
en_kjv: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and you shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.
tcz_gospelgo: “Naseipeh chan chu kamiten angai diu ahi. Chuteng Israel lamkaite to Egypt lengpa henga nacheuva, ‘Pakai Hebrew te Pathen kahenguva ahung kilah-in, hiche Pakai ka-Pathenu koma chu kilhaina kabolna diuvin nithum sung din gamthip’a neisol’un,’ nati diu ahi.

tcz: “Amavang Egypt lengpa chu khut thahat in ano kahse a nahin soldoh lou diu keiman kahei,” ati.
en_web: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
en_kjv: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Ada achamlouva akibol ngal loule Egypt lengpan nalhadoh lou diu kahenai.

tcz: “Hijeh a chu Keiman kakhut ka lhan a, chule Egypt mite kajep ding, alah uva thil kidang jouse kabol ding ahi. Ajona le Aman nahin soldoh ding'u ahi.
en_web: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
en_kjv: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle agama chu tijat um thil datmoa, katha hangsan a Egypt mite talen kamatsah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt lengpan nalhadoh diu ahi.

tcz: Chule keiman Egypt mite mitvet a khotona ka hin chan sah ding na hiuve. Ama hon thilpeh na hin peh dingu chuteng khut goh keova na dalhah lou diu ahiye.
en_web: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
en_kjv: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
tcz_gospelgo: “Egypt mite naginsah ungting, kamite akitoldoh tengu, khutgoh keova nalhadoh lou diu ahi.

tcz: Israel numei jousen akinaipiu Egypt mite leh a in'uva um gamchom numei ho hokom'a sana leh dangka chule ponsil akithum cheh ding'u ahi. Na chanu teu leh na chapa teu hiche ho chu navon peh dingu, Egypt mite haosatna jouse na holhah peh dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
en_kjv: but every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel numei jousen achenpi le aheng akom Egypt numeiho koma nihchen ponsil le sana dangka, sanajem athum diu ahi. Athumdoh chengu chu Israelten achateu numei pasal jouse jepna aneiyuva, Egypt gamsung nei le gou apoh mang diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Mose avel'in akiphin kit in, “Eitahsan lel-u henlang kathusei ngai hih uleh iti tantem? 'Nangma heng'a Pakai akilah kha him him poi' tiu leh iti tantem?”
en_web: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
en_kjv: And Moses answered and said, But behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n Pakai adonbut’in, “Israelten eitahsan dau hen kasei ngai hih leu, chule nang chu kahenga hung kilah louvin sei taleu ikati ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah a, “Nakhut a nachoi chu ipi ham?” tia adoh le, Mosen a donbut in “Tenggol ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Pakaiyin, “Nachoi chu ipi ham?” ati. Mose’n “Kakiphu tenggol ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin ajah a, “Tol'ah seplhan,” ati. Hichun Mosen tenggol chu tol'ah asep lhan, chuin gul ahung kisoh tan! Mose anung chop jeng'in ahi.
en_web: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
en_kjv: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Tol’a seplha temin,” atile; Mose’n ase lhah lhah chun gul asoh paiyin, Mose’n ajamsan tai.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin aheng'a, “nakhut lhangdoh in lang ameiyin man tem'in” ati. Hichun Mosen akhut alhangdoh in aman in ahile, akhut ah kelngoi chinna tenggol ahung kinung soh doh kit tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Bungin lang ameiyin kimat temin,” atile; Mose jong bunga akimat le, kiphu thei tenggol asoh kittai.

tcz: Pakaiyin ajah-a, “Hiche melchih nahi nabol ding ahi. Chuteng apu apateu Pathen - Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chuleh Jacob Pathen chu nangma heng'ah akilah mong'e ti ahin tahsan dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
en_kjv: that they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Pakai apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isacc Pathen chule Jacob Pathen nahenga hung kilah phot chetna dia hiche hi Israelte koma nabol ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'ah, “Tunna khut chu na pon ah sung nadip a koiyin,” atile, Mose'n jong akhut chu apon ah sung adip a akoiyin, akhut chu alah doh kit a ahile, akhut chu avun aphah in buhbang bangin abang jeng'in ahi.
en_web: The LORD said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
en_kjv: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a asei kit’in, “Napon noiya nakhut koilut’in,” ati leh; Mose’n akoiyin, agah lah doh chun akhut josue anaphah-in, buhbang banin anabangtai.

tcz: Pakaiyin, “Tun nakhut chu napon ah sung nadip'a avel'in koikit tem in,” atin ahi. Hijeh chun Mose in jong akhut chu anung koilut kit in, chuin ala doh kit in ahile atidang bang'in atahsa adamsel tan ahi.
en_web: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
en_kjv: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Napon noiya nakhut koilut kit’in,” atin, Mose’n jong akoiyin, agah lah doh phat’in anadamsel’in ati dang bang bang ahitai.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “ijem tia nangma natahsan lou uva chule melchih na masapen jeng'a jong atahsan theilou uva ahile, melchina anichanna a atahsan diu ahi tai.
en_web: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Israelten thil kidang mai maiya natahsan dauva alung nachim louvu jongle, hiche geiya vang lung nachim tei diu ahi.

tcz: Chule hiche melchih na teni jeng'a jong atahsan thei lou'uva ahile, Nile Vadunga kon in twi themkhat la in lang tolgo laiya sung lhan. Hichu nabol teng, Nile Vadung twi chu tolgo laiya thisan kisoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thil kidang te ni geiya jong natahsan dauva nasei angai dau le, Nile vadung twi phabep thaldoh-in tol’a sung lhan. Twi chu thisan soh jeng ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahin Mose Pakai heng'a ataovin, “O Pakai, keima thusei them kahipoi. Achesa phat hihen, chule tujeng in jong, kahenga thu nasei nung hijong leh, ka lei a-oh jin, chule kathusei a-ngongkai jie,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to the LORD, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Mose’n, “Ahipoi, Pakai neisol da tan. Thusei them la kahipon, neikihoupia jong hi kam kipeh lou kahi neihet hi-me. Mi paomo, pao gang thei lou, ngongkai chet chot kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose adong paijin, “Koiham mihem kam sem? Koi ham mihem apaothei ahilou leh apaomo, kho jathei ahilou leh ana ngong, kho muthei ahilou leh micho umsah nadia gellhuh na sem ji? Hichu Keima, na Pakai kahi hilou ham?
en_web: The LORD said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, the LORD?
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin ajah a, “Mihem kam sempeh koi hiya, na ngong le paomoa koiya koi ham? Kho musah le mit chotsah thei loi ham? Kei-Pakai hi kahi.

tcz: Tun chen! napao doh na chan'a Ka umpi ding, chule na thusei na chan'a Keiman kalamhil ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
en_kjv: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun che jengin! Thusei kithoping ting, nasei ding hil nange,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Mose avel in Pakai heng'a ataovin, “Pakai, lungset tah in! midang khattou sol tan,” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
en_kjv: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Mose’n, “Ahipoi Pakai, midang khat soljo tan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Mose chung'a alung hang tan, “Aphai,” ati. “Na sopipa Levi mi Aaron um'a hilou ham? Aman lei kileh pel'in thu aseitheiye ti keiman kahei. Chule vetan! Tun nang toh kimuto ding in ahung tai. Nang toh kimu ding lung thanop na'a dim ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
en_kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hin Pakaiyin Mose alhunghan khumin, “Nasopipa, Levi chilhah Aaron chula em? Athusei themla kahenan. Nakimupi dia hungtah bah a khu, nakimupi teng kipah lheh veh ta.

tcz: Ama chu houlim pin lang, thuho hi akamsung'a mop in. Keiman napao doh na chan lhon'a ka umpi ding, na ni lhon'a nathilbol nachan lhon'a nalamhil lhon nang'e, ati.
en_web: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
en_kjv: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
tcz_gospelgo: Sei ding jouse nahil masah thei ahi. Sei ding kithpi lhon ing ting, nasei lhon ding hil nange.

tcz: “Aaron hi nangma ding'a miho lah a thuseija pang ding ahi. Nangma ding'a nakam sung'a pang ding chule ama ding'a nangma hi Pathen khel'a na din ding, aman ipi asei ding nahil ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
en_kjv: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakam sanga panga, nathalhenga mipi akihoupi ding ahi. Nangin Pathen banga asei ding chan nahil ding ahi.

tcz: Na kelngoi tenggol hi kichoiyin lang, melchih na bol ding'a ka thumop chengse bol nading'in mang chan,” ati.
en_web: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
en_kjv: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiphuthei tenggol kichoiyin, hichea hin melchihna kidang nabol ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Mose in lam anu-pa-pa Jethro heng lam'a akile tan ahi. “Lungset tah in kasopi ho heng lam Egypt gam'a kile tange,” tin Mosen aseiyin, “Hing nalaiyu hinauvam tijong hepha lou kahi,” ati in ahile, Jethro in “lungmong in chen,” tin adonbut in ahi.
en_web: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
en_kjv: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose, anupa pa Jethro henga agache masan ajah a, “Egypt’a ka inkote dam le bit a um nauvem, gavil kit tange, neisolin,” agate. Jethron jong pha asan, lung lhaisel’in asoltai.

tcz: Mose in Median adalhah masang'in Pakaiyin aheng'a aseiyin, “Egypt a kile tan, ijeh-inem itileh nangma nathat nom ho abonchauvin athi gam tauve,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose chu Midian gamsunga asum nalaiyin, Pakaiyin ajah a, “Than ago jouse athisoh tai, Egypt a kile kit tan,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Mose in ajinu leh achate akipuiyin, sangan chunga atousah in, chuin Egypt gam'a akile tauvin ahi. Akhut a Pathen tenggol chu achoiyin ahi.
en_web: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
en_kjv: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n ajinu le achapate sanga chunga atousah-in, Egypt jonin akitolpin, Pathenin ahil bangin kiphu thei tenggol chu akichoiye.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Egypt gamsung nalelhun teng, Pharaoh henga chen lang keiman bol ding'a thuneina kapeh bang'in thil kidang ho jouse abonchan gabol'in, ati. Ahinlah Keiman alungthim kasuh tah ding chuteng miho chedoh ding aphal lou ding ahi.”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseikit’in, “Egypt gam nalejot kit ahitan, Egypt lengpa angasunga, boltheina tha kapeh banga, thil kidang chengse chu nabol tei tei ding ahi. Hijongle lengpa lung katahsa a, mipi alhadoh louhel ding ahi.

tcz: “Chuteng nangman aheng'a nasei ding, “Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahiye: Israel hi keima chapa peng masapen ahi.”
en_web: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘The LORD says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
en_kjv: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng kei Pakai thusei hi naseipeh a, ‘Israel hi kachapa masapen ahi.

tcz: Keiman thu kapeh nahi, “Ka chapa soldoh tan, chuti leh aman keima eihou thei ding ahi.”'Ahivanga nangman nah sah louva na koi jeh in, tua hi keiman nang chapa amasapen katha ding ahi tai!”' ati.
en_web: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”
en_kjv: and I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachapa nalhadoh dia kasei ahi. Eihou dia kasol ahin, nalha doh poi. Hijeh a chu nachapa masapen khatha peh ding nahi,’ tin aseiye, tia nahil ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Egypt gam ajot laiyun Mose leh a insung mite jan geh din ngahmun khat'a akinga tauvin, Pakaiyin amapa chu akimaitopin, amapa chu atha pai ding ahitai.
en_web: On the way at a lodging place, the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him.
en_kjv: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.
tcz_gospelgo: Lampia gebuh khat’a Pakaiyin Mose akimupin tha din agotai.

tcz: Amavang Mose jinu Zipporah, in songiel chem alan achapa chep atan peh in ahi. Amanun chep chu amapa keng atohkhah sah in hiti hin aseiye, “Tua hi nangma hiche thisan jal'a kei dia moulang nahitai,” ati.
en_web: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
en_kjv: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose jinu Zipporah chun songhemkhat’in achapa chep atanin, Mose kengphanga aloiyin, “Cheptan chonchan dungjuiya jia kanei nahi,” ati.

tcz: (Amanun “thisan jal'a moulang” tia asei chu chep tan chu aseina ahi.) Chujou chun Pakaiyin amapa chu adalhatai.
en_web: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
en_kjv: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose ahing hoiye.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Aaron henga, “Mose kimupi din Gamthip lam'a khun chedoh in,” ati. Hijeh chun Aaron Pathen molsang lam'a achen Mose aga kimupi in, a angkoiyin ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
en_kjv: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Aaron jah a, “Gamchang noiya Mose gakimupin,” tin asol’e. Aaron jong Mose kimupi din molsang theng lama achei; akimupi phat’in achop chuh chuh jengin ahi.

tcz: Hichun Mose in jong Aaron jah a Pakaiyin sei dinga athupeh jouse ajah a asei peh tan ahi. Chule bol dinga athupeh thil kidang melchih naho chung chang ho chu aseipeh tan ahi.
en_web: Moses told Aaron all the LORD’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
en_kjv: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Mose’n Egypt gama kile kit dia Pakaiyin asol’a aseipeh chengse abonchan aseipehson tai; thil kidang bolsah dia ahil chengse jong aseitai.

tcz: Chuin Mose le Aaron Egypt gam ahung kile lhon'in Israel upa jouse abonchan akoukhom lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaron chu Egypt’a ache lhonin, Israel lamkai jouse akhom lhontai.

tcz: Aaron in Pakaiyin Mose athumop chengse chu abonchan amaho jah a aseipeh soh keiyin, Chule Mose in melchihna thil kidang hochu aheng uvah abol in avetsah soh kei uve.
en_web: Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
en_kjv: and Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose jah a Pakai thusei chengse Aaronin Israel lamkaite aseipeh-in, mipi angsung laitah a Mose’n thil kidang chengse chu abolsoh keiye.

tcz: Hichun Israel miten Mose leh Aaron chu Pathen in ahin sol mong ahi ti atahsan tauve. Pakaiyin amaho chung chang agelkhoh in agim hesoh nau amu taiti ajahdoh phat un, abohkhup uvin ahou tauvin ahi.
en_web: The people believed, and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
en_kjv: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten atahsan’un, min engse tah a abolset nau amu jal’a avil’uva Pakai hung ahi ajah doh phat’un boh khup’in chibai aboh tauve.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chu Israel upa hole lamkai chengse heng'a asei peh chai lhon phat'in, Pharaoh heng'a Mose le Aaron achelhon in aga sei lhon tai. “Hiche hi ahi Israelte Pakai, Pathen in asei chu: gamthip noiya kami Israelten keima jabol naa kut abolna diuvin soltauvin,” tin amapa henga asei lhon tai.
en_web: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”
en_kjv: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaron Egypt lengpa koma achen, “Pakai Israel Pathenin, ‘Gamchang noiya kut bola eihou theina diuvin kamite sol’in’ tin aseiye,” agate lhone.

tcz: Pharaoh in ale donbut in, “Hichu hi mong ham? Pakai kitipa chu koiham? Keiman ipi jeh a ama thu kangaiya Israelte chu kasol doh ding ham? Pakai kitipa chu keiman kahekha poi, chule keiman Israelte kasol doh lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know the LORD, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan, “Pakai kitipa chu koi hiya, athu kangaiya, Israelte kasoldoh ding ham? Pakai la kahepon, Israelte la soldoh ponge,” tin aseitai.

tcz: Ahinlah Aaron leh Mose apang tinten lhon in, “Hebrew mite Pathen chun eikimupi lhon ahi,” tin aphongdoh lhon'e. “Hijeh chun ni thum sung'a gamthip a kache uva Pakai ka Pathen'u henga kilhaina ka ga sem na diuvin neisol tauvin. Achuti louva ahile, Pakaiyin gamna hise ahinlan sah ding ahilou leh chemjam'a eitha gam diu ahi,” ati lhon'e.
en_web: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”
en_kjv: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaronin adonbut’in, “Hebrewte Pathen chu kahenguva ahung kilahtai. Nithum lampi peh a Pakai ka-Pathenu gahouva, kilhaina kabolna diuvin neisolun. Kabol louvule natset ham, gal ham khat jo sanga eithagam diu ahi,” ati lhone.

tcz: Pharaoh in a donbut in, “Mose leh Aaron, ipi ding'a mipite ana toh nauva konna alungu nalahmang lhon'a nasuboi lhon ham? Na kitoh kit tauvin!
en_web: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”
en_kjv: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan Mose le Aaron jah a, “Mipin tohban iti ngah hen nati lhon ham? Soh ho khu na tohsahkit’un!

tcz: Ven, “Gamsung'a namite hi tampi ahiuvin, ahin nangnin amaho hi anatoh nau natansah lhon tai,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and you make them rest from their burdens.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho Egyptte sanga jong natamjoh tah-u khu! Aban jop’a na tohda nagot’u ahi-ong!” ati.

tcz: Hiche nikho mama chun Pharaoh in Egypt mite ding'a soh natong vaipo ho leh Israel lamkai ho chu hiche thupeh hi ape tan ahi:
en_web: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
en_kjv: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chun Egypt lengpan sohte chunga tohvai pote le Israel lah a toh lamkai ho thu apen,

tcz: “Chehlhang semna ding'in changpol pe tahih un. Ama ama cheh kihol sah tauvin!
en_web: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
en_kjv: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mipi hi cheh a sem ding changpol peh dauvin, amaho gakiholsah-uvin.

tcz: Ahivang'a masang'a na bolsah ngai bang'uva chehlhang nasem sah jat u kibanga nasem sah dingu ahi. Achanvou u lhom jong lhom sah hih un. Athase gam tauve. Hijeh chun amahon, 'cheu hitin I-Pathen'u henga kilhaina gasem tauhite,' tia asap jengu ahi, ati.
en_web: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
en_kjv: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, you shall lay upon them; you shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti jongle changpol napeh pet’uva asemdoh-u cheh sanga khat cha jong lhasam deh louhel ding ahi. Toh ding aneilou phat’uva potdoh a a-Pathenu houva kilhai dinga kahenga tao tao ahiuve!

tcz: Achung'uva natoh hahsa cheh koibe peh un! A-ulsau lonsah un! Hichun jou thu angaisah lou na diuva ahil dingu ahi!” ati.
en_web: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
en_kjv: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
tcz_gospelgo: Na hatohsah-un, ong manlouvin lhauvin, chutile thujou kisei hoihi ngai manlouvin umtauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Hichun soh natong vaipo ho leh natong lamkai ho chu acheuvin mipi ho heng'a asei peh tauvin: “Pharaoh in asei hiche hi ahi: Tuapat changpol kapeh talou ding'u nahi.
en_web: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
en_kjv: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohte chunga tohvai pote le Israelte toh lamkaite acheuvin Israelte jah a, “Lengpan changpol napeh lou diuvin aseitai.

tcz: Cheuvin lang nangma nangman ga kipoh uvin. Hoilaimun hijongle namu thei chan'un ga kihol tauvin. Ahinlah masanga banga chehlhang atam nathei chan'a na sem doh dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
en_kjv: Go ye, get you straw where you can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
tcz_gospelgo: Namu thei thei nauva changpol nahol thu’uva, ahivanga niseh a nasemdoh jat’u chu lhasem thei louhel ding ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun mipi jong Egypt gamtin ah changpol hol nan aki the cheh tauvin ahi.
en_web: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
en_kjv: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin mipi changpol holin Egypt gamsunga akithe chansoh jengui.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin, Egypt natong vaipo hon gah tah in aboljom nalaiyun, “Changpol kapeh laiyuva nasem bang'uva, niseh leh chehlhang nasem doh ding jat u nasuh bulhit tei ding'u ahi” tin ngeh na aneiyuve.
en_web: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
en_kjv: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohte chunga tohvai poten changpol apeh laiyuva asemdoh jat’us cheh asemdoh theina diuvin ada acham louvin ano no jengui.

tcz: Chuin Israel natong lamkaiya anganse hou chu ajep uvin, “Ipi ding'a janhia chule tunia jong natoh doh diu jat na toh doh louvu ham? tin ngehna aneiyuvin ahi.
en_web: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
en_kjv: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt mi, sohte chunga tohvai poten Israelte toh lamkai ho chu adeng deng jengui. “I-bol’a masanga nasemdoh jat jat cheh semdoh jou louva um nahiuvem?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuphat in Israel natong lamkai cheng Pharoah heng'a ache un chule atao uvin, “lungset tah in nasohte hi hitin neibol hih un,” tin athum un ahi.
en_web: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
en_kjv: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
tcz_gospelgo: Israel toh lamkaite Egypt lengpa koma acheuvin, “Vo lengpa, idia hita neibol jengu hitam?

tcz: “Changpol la eipe pouvin, ahinlah soh vaipo hon angeh nalaiyun “chehlhang sem'un!” tin eivo jing'un, ahinlah hiche hi keiho themmo ahi poi! Nangma mite ho mama ngoh ding ahijoi!” tin asei uve.
en_web: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
en_kjv: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
tcz_gospelgo: Changpol la eipetapouvin, cheh kasemdoh jat jat’u semdohsah eigouve! Tun eivo vo jengun, hiche hi nang thusah mong ahibouve,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahivang'in Pharoah apeng jah jeng'in, “Nangho na thaset u ahi! a thase na hiuve! Hijeh a chu hitia hi naseiyu ahi, 'Cheu hitin chule I-Pakaiyu heng'a kilhaina ga toh doh ute natiu ahi.'
en_web: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
en_kjv: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan adonbut’in, “Thasea natohda jal’a Pakai henga kilhaina boldia kilepdoh dia kahenga kithum thum nahiuve.

tcz: “Tun natong din kileuvin! Nangho changpol na kipe lou diu, ahivang'a chehlhang nasem doh diu jat lhingset a nasem doh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
en_kjv: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
tcz_gospelgo: Na gatong loiyun! Changpol nakipe lou diu, ahivanga cheh nasemdoh jat jat lha louva nasemdoh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: “Niseh a chehlhang nasem jat u nakemsuh sah theilou ding'u ahi,” ati jeh u chun Israel natong lamkai hon nasa tah abol gim'a aum'u chu amu tauvin ahi.”
en_web: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
en_kjv: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte toh lamkaiten cheh asemdoh jat jat asemdoh diuva aseipeh phat’un abolset nom mong mongu ahedoh tauve.

tcz: Pharoah thutanna insung ahin dalhah phat un, pam lang'a amaho ana ngah Mose leh Aaron chu aki mupi uvin ahi.
en_web: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa adalhah phat’un, amaho ngah jinga ana-um Mose le Aaron to akimutouve.

tcz: Chuin natong lamkai ho chun ajah lhon'ah, “Pakaiyin nachung chang thu lhon tan hen lang gotna nape lhon hen, ijeh inem itileh Pharaoh leh alhacha ho angsung'a nei suh namset u ahi. Nangnin amaho khut a chemjam na koipeh lhon in, neitha gamsah kigot un ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
en_kjv: and they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because you have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaron jah a, “Nathilbol lhon Pakaiyin amusoh tai, lengpa le avaitpote neihotsah jeh-uva Pakaiyin talen namatsah lhon ding ahi. Pansatna neiya eitha lo na diu nabol doh lhon ahitai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Mose Pakai heng'a akile in akiphin tai, “Ipi ding'a namite chung'a hitobang gimna hi nalhun sah hitam, Pakai? Ipi ding'a keima nei sol ham?”
en_web: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
en_kjv: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai lam ngan Mose akiphinin, “Pakai, idia namite nabolset ham? Ipi bol dia neisol ham?

tcz: Nangma thalheng'a thusei dinga Pharoah heng kahunga kipat namite chunga akhanse cheh cheh jon ahi. Hinlah nangman amaho huhdoh nadin ima nabol poi!”
en_web: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
en_kjv: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
tcz_gospelgo: Namina Lengpa henga thuseiya kache chea pat, Israelte engse sen aboltai. Nangin imacha kithopi din nagopon!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, “Tua hi keiman Pharoah chung'a ipi ka bol'am namu ding ahi. Aman ka ban thahatna ahin hetdoh teng, aman mipi ho chu ahinsol doh ding ahi. Dih tah a, aman namphu a agamsung dalha dinga ahin soldoh ding'u ahi!”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
en_kjv: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Lengpa khu i-kalom, hinmu nan nate. Tahbeh a kasei ahi-Israelte khu Egypt a kona adeldoh tho dingjoh ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Mose henga aseiyin, “Keima Yahweh - 'Pakai' kahi.
en_web: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.
en_kjv: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Kei hi Pakai chu kahi.

tcz: Abraham henga, Isaac henga, chule Jacob henga El-Shaddai - 'Hatchungnung Pathen' - aheng uva ka kilah in ahi, hinlah kamin, Yaweh, ahi ti amaho heng'a kaphong doh poi.
en_web: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them.
en_kjv: and I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob henga Hatchungnung Pathenin kakilah-in, ahivangin kamintheng, Pakai hin kakihetsah hih laiye.

tcz: Chule kholjin miho banga achen nau gam, Canaan gam peh dinga kakitep na keiman amaho toh avel'in namdet na kanei kit in ahi.
en_web: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
en_kjv: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho to kitepna kaneiyin, akhopem nau gam, Canaan gamsung khu peh din kakitep’e.

tcz: Israel mite, tua Egypt mite soh a pang ho thohgim na kaja nai ti hi naginchat mong thei ahi. Chule amaho toh ka kitepna jong phatah in kahe jing nai.
en_web: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
en_kjv: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun Egyptten soh a avul, Israelte ka le mao ogin kajan, kakitepna kageldoh tai.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, Israel mite henga seiyin: 'Keima Pakai kahi. Egypt gam'a nasoh tan nauva kon'a kahuhdoh ding chule nathoh gimnauva kon'a kalha ong ding nahiuve. Keiman nangho ban thahat tah le thutan'a gimnei tah a kalhatdam ding nahiuve.
en_web: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
en_kjv: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Israelte dia kasei hi ajah-uva seipeh-in, ‘Kei hi Pakai chu kahi, nasohchan nau Egyptte khut’a nahuhdoh ung ting kajalen sah ding nahiuve. Kaban-gol jeng ting Egyptte talen kamatsah a, nang ho kahuhdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Keima mite nahi mong'uve tia kachu dingu, chule na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Chuteng keima hi nangho Pakai na Pathen'u Egypt gamma nathoh gim nauva kon'a nahin lha ong pau chu kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en_web: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
en_kjv: and I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamiten nasem ung ting, na-Pathenu kahi ding; Egypt gam sohchanna muna kona kalhadoh tengu, Pakai na-Pathen kahi hetauvin nate.

tcz: Keiman Abraham, Isaac, chuleh Jacob heng'a kakihahsel na gam'a chu ka puilut ding na hiuve. Nangho goulo ding mong monga kapeh ding nahiuve. Keima Pakai kahi!'”
en_web: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”
en_kjv: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob koma giltah a kakitep’a, peh dia kakoisa gamsung kalhut diu, leiset gou dia kapeh ding nahiuve. Kei hi Pakai chu kahi,’ tin aseiye, tin,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin asei bang'in Mose in jong Israel mite heng'a asei peh in, ahinlah amahon avel'in angainom tapouvin ahi. Ajeh chu amaho asoh channauva aki sugim'u chun alungphatmo sah val tauvin ahi.
en_web: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
en_kjv: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Mose’n Israelte aseipeh-in, ahivangin angaipouve, sohchan hesoh valjeh-in lhung lhalhop’in aum gamtauve.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a,

tcz: “Egypt lengpa Pharaoh heng'a leche in lang, Israel miten nagamsung dalha tauhen tin aheng'a gaseiyin.”
en_web: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
en_kjv: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chen lang Egypt lengpan Israelte khu agamsunga kona asoldoh tei tei din gaseiyin,” ati.

tcz: “Ahinlah Pakai!” Mose anompon, “Ka miten kathusei eingaipeh tapouvintin. Iti Pharaoh in ka thu ngai mong nante tia kakinep ding ham? Keima mipaomo kahi.”
en_web: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”
en_kjv: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Israelte bon kathu ngailou, lengpan kathu iti angai ding ham? Mi paomo kei tobang hi!” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a thu aseiyin Israelte ding leh Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ding'a abol lhonding ho ape lhon'in, Pakaiyin Israelte Egypt akon puidoh ding'in Mose leh Aaron thupeh anei tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron thu apen, “Israelte leh Egypt lengpa jah a chun anng hi Egypt’a kona Israelte puidoh dia kasol ahi seipeh lhonin,” ati.

tcz: Hichengse hi apu apate'u khang chedol'a Israel insung upa ho ahi: Israel insung'a apeng masapen Reuben chapate se chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi. Amaho chilhahse hi Reuben insung kon ahitauve.
en_web: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
en_kjv: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob chapa masa pen Ruebenin chapa li aneiyin-Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi ahiuvin; Reuben chilhah phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Simeon chapate se chu: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Shaul ahiuve. (Shaul hingnu vangchu Canaan numei ahi.) Amaho chilhahse hi Simeon insung kon ahitauve.
en_web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
en_kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
tcz_gospelgo: Simeonin chapa gup ahingin, Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar chule Canaan mi numeito ahin lhon-Shaul ahiuvin, Simeon phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Levi chilhahte se amaho insung minbu dungjuiya achapate chu: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. (Levi chu kum ja le somthum le sagi ana hing'e).
en_web: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
en_kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
