tcz_gospelgo: Levin chapa thum ahingin, Gershon, Kohath chule Merari ahiuvin; Levi phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve. Levi hi kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahinge.

tcz: Gershon chihahte chu Libni leh Shimei ahi lhonne. Anigel lhonin insung khangguiyin akisim lhon tan ahi.
en_web: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
en_kjv: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
tcz_gospelgo: Gershon hin chapa ni ahingin, son le pah tampi anei lhone.

tcz: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi. (Kohath chu kum ja le somthum le thum ana hing'e.)
en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
en_kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
tcz_gospelgo: Kohath hin chapa li ahingin, Amaram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuvin, Kohath hi kum jakhat le somthum le thum ahinge.

tcz: Merari chilhahte chu: Mahli leh Mushi ahi lhon'e. Ama ho chengse hi Levi insung chedol minbua amin cheh uchu ahi.
en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
en_kjv: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Mararin chapa ni ahingin, Mahli le Mushi ah. Hiche hi phung khai khaiya kisim Levi chilhah ahiuvin, achilhah chengu to ahi.

tcz: Amram chun apa sopinu Jochebed chu jin aneiyin, amanun chapa ahin peh in, Aaron leh Mose ahi lhon'e. (Amram chu kum jale somthum le sagi ana hing'e.)
en_web: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
en_kjv: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaram hin apa sopinu Jochebed akichenpin Aaron leh Mose ahinge. Amram kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahinge.

tcz: Izhar chapate chu Korah, Nepheg leh Zicri ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
en_kjv: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
tcz_gospelgo: Izhar hin chapa thum ahingin, Korah le Nepheg chule Zichri ahiuve.

tcz: Uzziel chapate chu, Mishael, Elzaphan leh Sithri ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
en_kjv: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
tcz_gospelgo: Uzziel’sin chapa thum ahingin, Michael, Ezaphan chule Sithri ahiuve.

tcz: Aaron in Elisheba aki chenpin, amachu Amminadab chanu chule Nahson ding'a asopinu ahi. Amanun chapa ahindoh ho chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahiuve.
en_web: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
en_kjv: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
tcz_gospelgo: Aaronin Amminadab chanu, Nahshon sopinu, Elisheba akichenpin, Nadab le Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar ahinge.

tcz: Korah chapate hochu Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph ahiuvin, amaho chilhah hi Korah insung mi ahitauve.
en_web: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
en_kjv: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
tcz_gospelgo: Korah in chapa thum ahingin, Assir, Elkanah chuleAbiasaph ahiuve; Korah phungkhai sung kihom khenna a amaho hi phung upa cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Aaron chapa Eleazar chun Putiel chanute lah a khat ji in aneiyin, chuin amanun chapa khat ahing'in Phinehas ahi. Amaho chenghi Levi insung'a pu le pate ho insung bahkai dungjuiya chengse chu ahiuve.
en_web: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
en_kjv: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
tcz_gospelgo: Aaron chapa, Eleazar chun Putiel chanu akichenpin, Phinehas ahinge. Hichengse hi Levi phunga ama ama insung dola phungkhai upa cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Aaron leh Mose hichelaiya kimin phah teni mama hi ahilhon'e Pakaiyin ajah lhon'a, “Israel mite chu Egypt gamma kon in sepoyte bang'in hin lamkai lhon in,” tia asei chu.
en_web: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
en_kjv: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Egypt’a konin Israelte puidoh lhonin,” tia asol teni chu Mose le Aaron ahi lhone.

tcz: Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh koma Israel mite Egypt gam'a konna puidoh ding'a thu sei chu, Mose leh Aaron ahi lhon'e.
en_web: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
en_kjv: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaron hin Egypt lengpa chu Israelte lhadoh dinga asollhon ahi.

tcz: Egypt gam'a Pakaiyin Mose ahoulimpi achun,
en_web: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gama Pakaiyin Mose jah a thu asei chun,

tcz: Aheng'a aseiyin, “Keima Pakai kahi! Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh henga seiyin, keiman naheng'a kasei jouse chu.”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
en_kjv: that the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei hi Pakai chu kahi. Kasei jong Egypt lengpa seipeh-in,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Mose in Pakai akinel pin, aseiyin, “Hichu ka bolthei lou ding ahi! ajeh chu keima mipaomo kahi! Ipi jeh a Pharaoh in ka thusei angai ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
en_kjv: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Kei mi paomo kahi nahet chume, lengpan iti kathu angai ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi phatechan ngaiyin. Pharaoh lengpa koma Pathen tobang'a kasem ding nahiye, chule na sopipa, Aaron, hi nang dia themgaova pang ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Lengpa koma chu Pathen tobang kahisah a, nasopipa Aaronin lengpa koma nathemgao tobanga thu asei ding ahi.

tcz: Kathupeh jouse hi Aaron jah'a sei in lang, Aaron in Pharaoh heng'a Israel mite agamsung'a kon'a asol doh nading'a thu apeh tei ding ahi.
en_web: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
en_kjv: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh chengse hi Aaron hilsoh keiyin, aman lengpa chu agamsunga kona Israelte asoldohna din seipeh nante.

tcz: Ahinlah Keiman Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, chuteng melchihna le thil kidang tampi Egypt gamsung'a kapunsah ding ahi.
en_web: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang lengpa lung kasuhtah ding ahin, Egypt gamsunga itobang tijat um thil kidang bolkhum jong leng nathu ngaiponte.

tcz: Hiche a jong chu Pharaoh in na thu angai lou lai ding ahi. Keiman Egypt gamsung'a ka khut kahin lhanjah ding. Keiman ka thaneina kon - kamite, Israelte - Egypt gam'a kon thutanna gimnei tah pum'a ka huh doh ding ahiuve.
en_web: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
en_kjv: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Egypt gamsunga talen gihsa tah chuhsah ing ting, agamsunga kona kamite kapuidoh ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman ka khut ban thahat ka hinlhan'a Israelte kahin puidoh teng, Egypt miten Keima hi Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai.”
en_web: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
en_kjv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaban-gol kajet’a agamsunguva kona Israelte kapuidoh teng, Egypt ten Pakai kahin hedoh tauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakai thupeh bang'in Mose leh Aaron injong abol lhon tan, ahi.
en_web: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.
tcz_gospelgo: Msoe le Aaronin Pakai thupeh peh chu abol lhon nai.

tcz: Pharaoh heng'a ngehna aganei lai lhon chun, Mose kum somget ahitan, chule Aaron chu kum som get leh kum thum ahitai.
en_web: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa koma thu aseilai lhonin Mose kum som get alhing tan, Aaron kum som get le thum alhingtai.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'ah thu aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a,

tcz: “Pharaoh in ngehna ahin nei ding, ‘thil kidang neivetsah lhonin.' hitobang ahin seiteng, Aaron henga seiyin ‘nateng gol chu la in lang Pharaoh masang laiya chun sep lhan, chuteng gul hung kisoh ding ahi.”
en_web: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”
en_kjv: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nathanneina lhon phot chetna dia Pharaoh-in thil kidang nabolsah got lhon le, Aaron chu atenggol lengpa angsunga selhah sah in, gul hungsoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achelhon in Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tai. Aaron in tenggol chu Pharaoh le avaipipo teho angsung'a chun asep lhan ahile, gul ahung kisoh tai!
en_web: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thupeh bangin Mose le Aaron lengpa koma chen agabol lhontai. Lengpa le avaipote angsunga Aaronin tenggol aseplhan, gul ahungsoh tai.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in ama miching ho le doithem ho a koukhom in, Egypt gamma mitphel doithem hon jong chuche tobang chu athemguh un abol'un ahi.
en_web: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
en_kjv: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan jong miching mithemte, mitpheldoi them ho akouvin, amahon jong hitobangma chu abol theiyui.

tcz: Atenggol'u tol'a a seplha cheh uvin ahile, amahoa jong gul aki sohtai! Ahinlah Aaron tenggol chun amaho tenggolho chu aval lhum soh tai.
en_web: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
en_kjv: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
tcz_gospelgo: Atenggol’u aselhah-ule, gul asohgamtai. Ahivangin Aaron tenggol gul chun amahoa avallhum soh keiye.

tcz: Hicheng nung jeng hin jong Pakaiyin asei masat bang chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiyin, thu ima ngaisah in anei hih laiye.
en_web: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
en_kjv: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakai sei bangin, lengpa alungtah den nalaiyin, Mose le Aaron sei angai deh poi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Pharaoh lungchang atah in, chule aman mipiho soldoh ding anom naipoi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Lengpa alungtah cheh in, Israelte sohdoh ding adai.

tcz: Hijeh chun jingkah teng Pharaoh vadung lam'a hung suh teng nangma na che ding. Nile vadung pam'a nadin ding, hikoma chu nakimupi ding ahi. Na tenggol gul kisoh chu kichoi teiyin.
en_web: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.
en_kjv: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah teng Nile vadung ajotsuh phat le gakimupin, gul soh theiji tenggol chu choiyin, luipanga ana ngah-in.

tcz: Chuteng akoma hiti hin seiyin, 'Pakai, Hebrew mite Pathen in nakoma thuseiya eihin sol ahi: “Kamite soldoh tan, chuteng amahon gamthip noiya keima eihou na ding uvin.” Tugeiyin, nangman ama thusei iman na ngaisah poi.
en_web: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”
en_kjv: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung teng ajah a, ‘Pakai, Hebrewte Pathenin amite nalhadoh a, gamchang noiya Ama agahouna diuva seipeh dia eihinsol ahi. Ahivangin tu geiyin kasei nangaipoi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: “Keima Pakai kahina ka kilah sah ding ahi.” Vetan! Ka khut'a um tenngol hi mang cha'a Nile twi kajep ding, chu teng vadung hi thisan kisoh ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo lengpa, tua hi Pakai chu itobang ahi athilbol’a nahetdoh ding ahi. Ven hiche tenggola hi luidung twi jouse thisan soh ding ahitai.

tcz: Asung'a Nga jouse thi ding, chule vadung uilhahel ding, Egypt miten Nile vadung'a kon twi adon thei lou hel diu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
en_kjv: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
tcz_gospelgo: Nga jouse thisoh a, twi jouse names ding, Egypte miten adon thei louhel ding ahi,’ tin gasei peh tan,” ati.

tcz: Chu jongle Pakaiyin Mose heng ah aseiyin: “Aaron jah a seiyin, 'Na tenggol kimat in lang Egypt gam'a twi jouse chunga na khut jah in lang - vadung jouse, twinah jouse, luikhuh jouse chunga. Twi jouse thisan so sah tan. Egypt gam muntin'a twi jouse, thingtwikong le songkong jouse sunga twi jouse geiya thisan soh ding ahi.'”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Aaronin hiche tenggol chu luidung jouse le twilam jouse, Egypte gamsunga twikul jouse chunga adop sang din seipeh-in. Twi jouse thisan soh ding, gamsung pumpi thisan soh a, thinghom dungle songko dung geiya thisan veisoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron in jong Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tan ahi. Pharaoh le athunei vaihomte hon avet laiyun, Aaron in jong a tenggol ajahdoh'in Nile luidung chu ajep jeng tan ahi. Phulou helouvin, Vadung twi apumpin thisan akisoh hel tan ahi.
en_web: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the Lord commanded; and he lift up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose leh Aaronin Pakai thupeh bangin abol lhontai. Lengpa le avaipote angsung tah a Aaronin tenggol alamin, luidung twi ajep le twi josue thisan asoh gamtai.

tcz: Luidunga nga jouse athisoh heltan, chule twi anen behseh phat chun Egypt miten adon thei tapouvin ahi. Egypt gamsung pumpi mun jouse thisan dim ahitai.
en_web: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stunk, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Nga jouse athigamin, Egypt miten adon thei tapouve. Egypt gamsung thisan adimsoh jenge.

tcz: Ahivang'in Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong adoiyu mangchan amahon jong twi thisan asosah uvin ahi. Hijeh chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiye. Pakaiyin asei bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu nahsah in anei hih laiye.
en_web: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
en_kjv: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the Lord had said.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpa mitpheldoi themten jong chutobangma abol thei thouvun, lengpa jong angai bep’in alung tah cheh-in, Pakai seisa bangin Mose le Aaron thu angai deh poi.

tcz: Pharaoh jong a leng inpi lam'ah akilen, hicheng thilsoh jouse ho chu alungthim'a gel lut kham asa hih laiye.
en_web: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghei tah sangin leng inpi akijot’in, thilsoh ho chu nahsah in jong aneipoi.

tcz: Ahin Egypt mite jousen luipang dung alai thuh'un twi akihol le tauvin ahi, ajeh chu amahon Nile luidunga twi chu a donthei tah louvu ahi.
en_web: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
en_kjv: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung twi adon thei lou phat’un Egypt miten luipang dung twichim holnan alhaiyun don ding ahol’ui.

tcz: Pakaiyin Nile luidung ajep kal nisagi alhing tan ahi.
en_web: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.
en_kjv: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the Lord had smitten the river.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Nile vadung asuh nehna ni sagi alhing tai.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng ah chen lang hiti hin gasei kit tem in, “Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi: Kamite soldoh jeng tan, chutileh amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahiye.”
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa koma chen, Pakaiyin hintin aseiyin, ‘Eihou theina diuvin kamite sultan,

tcz: “Nahsah moa amaho nasol doh louva ahileh, nagam sung pumpia ukeng kahin lansah ding ahi.”
en_web: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
en_kjv: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
tcz_gospelgo: nada le nagamsung dimset’a uphoh kalha ding ahi.

tcz: “Nile luidung jong ukeng dimlha jeng ding ahi. Na insung leh na lupna channa hungkal doh diu! Na mite leh na nung jui ho jouse kom channa lhung ding, na chang lhah meh nau jouse'a jong hung lut dimset ding ahiuve.”
en_web: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
en_kjv: and the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
tcz_gospelgo: Nile luidung uphoh dimset’a, na-leng inpi geiya hung kitol lut diu, nalupna indan, najalkhun, navaipote in jouse, namite in dung, nathuh phung le nakhangbel sung geiya dimset diu ahi.

tcz: “Ukengte chung leh nanung juiho jouse chung'a chom le ding'u ahi.”
en_web: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
en_kjv: and the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang chung, navaipote chung le namite chung geiya hung chomdoh diu ahi,’ ati, tin gaseitan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron jah'a sei jin lang, ‘Egypt gamsung pumpi ukeng ten ahinlo dim nading in, natenggol jah in, twinah jouse, twilam jouse leh luidung jouse chu jeptan! Ukengten Egypt gam pumpi hinluo dim tante,tin seipeh in,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Aaronin luidung jouse le twilam dung, twikul dung tenggol ajap a, Egypt gamsung dimset’a uphoh hungdoh din bolsah in,” ati.

tcz: Aaron'in jong Egypt gamsung twi chung'a akhut ajah'in ajep tan ahile, ukengte ahung potdoh'un Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim jeng tan!
en_web: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun Aaronin twi umna jouse tenggol ajapkhum jengle, uphohte ahungdoh-un gamsung adimset tauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong hitabang chun abolthei uve. Ukengte chu gamsung'a alhalut thei un ahile gam pumpi chu ukengte adim lhatai.
en_web: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitpheldoi themten jong chutiman abolun, gamsung uphoh adimsettai.

tcz: Chu phat'in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron akouvin hiti hin aseije, “Pakai heng'a tao lhon tan, ajeh chu keima le ka mite jouse'a konna ukengte alah doh na ding in, chu teng keiman namite'u ka soldoh ding, amaho che uva Pakai kin aga bol diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
en_kjv: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the Lord, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan Mose le Aaron akouvin, “Uphohte asuh gamna din Pakaiya neitaopeh lhonin, Pakaiya kilhaina abol theina diuvin namite lhon solpeh tange,” ati.

tcz: Mose'n adonbut in, “Nang le na sohte, chule namite ding'a itih phat'a katao ding nei seipeh in ati. Chuteng na in dung jouse'a ukengte Nile vadung lam'a kitol ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n adonbut’in, “Kipah tah in taopeh nange, nang le navaipte, namite itih teng kataopeh ding phat chubou neiseipeh lhonin, chuting u-phoh ten dalhan natin, Nile luidung tilouva khatcha jong um taponte,” ati.

tcz: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah a, “Jing teng bol in,” ati. Mose'n henge, “Nasei bang bang hita hen. Chuti leh nangman keiho Pakai, Pathen tailou dang aum poi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
en_kjv: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan, “Jing teng neitaopeh-in,” ati. Mose’n, “Nasei bangin taopeh nange, chuting Pakai ka-Pathenu tobang pathen dang umlou hedoh tan nate.

tcz: “Ukengten nangma leh na nungjui ho jouse le namite naboncha uva na dalhah diu, Nile luidung a bou umden diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
en_kjv: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang, navaipoho, chule namite u-phohten dalhauvin tin, Nile luidung tilouva u-phoh khat cha jong um lou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in achedoh lhon in, Mose chu Pakai lam sang in kap pum in ataovin, Pharaoh le amite akon in ukengte ladoh tan ati.
en_web: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaronin lengpa adalha lhonin, lengpa chunga alonvuh sah u u-phoh te sumang din Pakaiya Mose atao tai.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose taona chu asanpeh tan, indung jouse, lou jao leh gamsung'a ukeng jouse a sumang hel tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
en_kjv: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose ngeh bang bangin Pakaiyin abol’in, in dung le thupi tanna in dung chule loujao dunga u-phohte athitam tauve.

tcz: Egypt miten ukeng thisa hochu aloh khom'un ahile gamsung pumpi a uilha jeng tan ahi
en_web: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
en_kjv: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt miten u-phoh ho chu alhuh lhuh in aseuvin, gamsung khangngam leuvin alhauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Pharaoh'in dinmun ahung oldom taiti ahin hetdoh phat in, angaija bang in a lungthim atah kit tai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu anahsah kit tapoi.
en_web: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
en_kjv: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
tcz_gospelgo: U-phohte gamsoh amu phat’in lengpa angaiyin alungtah kit’in Pakaiyin asei bangin aumtai, Mose le Aaron thusei jong angaideh tapoi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron heng'a sei inlang, ‘Na tenggol jandoh in tol lhang jep tem in. Chuteng Egypt gam pumpi'a thousi vaishi chule nen'in ahin lodim jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mosel jah a, “Aaron khu atenggol’in tol jepsah le chun, Egypt gamsung leivui jouse thousi vaibong soh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang in Mose leh Aaron'in jong abol lhontan. Aaron'in jong akhut ajah'in atenggol'a tol lham chu ajep'a ahile, thousi vaibong tamtah'in Egypt gam pumpi le gamsa jouse a lodim jeng tan chule boh nen in gamsung alodimjeng in ahi.
en_web: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Aaronin tenggol’in tol ajep le, Egypt gamsung leivui jouse thousi vaibong asoh-in, mipi le gancha jouse atomjol soh keiyui.

tcz: Pharaoh doithem choihon atabang bang abolthei jing vang uvin, tunvang alosam tauvin abolthei tapouvin ahi. Thousi vaibong'in mipi hole gamsung'a gancha jouse atomlha tauvin ahi.
en_web: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.
en_kjv: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitpheldoi themten thousi vaibong sosah agot vangun abol thei tapouve. Muntin thousi vaibong adimsoh tai.

tcz: Hiti chun doithem choihon jong Pharaoh heng'a asei un, “Hiche hi Pathen khutnung mong ahi,” atitauve. Ahinlah Pharaoh lungthim chu angaija bang'in atah jing na laiye. Pakaiyin a seidoh sa bang in, Pharaoh'injong amaho thusei chu anahsah deh pon ahi.
en_web: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
en_kjv: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule mitpheldoi them hon lengpa jah a, “Hiche hi Pathen bol mong mong ahibouve,” atiuve. Ahivangin Pakai seisa bangin lengpa alungtah jingin, Mose le Aaron sei angai dehpoi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hitihin a seikit tai, “Jingkah teng Nile vadung lam'a Pharaoh hung ding chuteng nangman na kimu piding.” Ajah'a Pakaiyin hiti hin asei je: “Kamite soldoh tan, ajeh chu amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahi,” tia nasei ding ahi, ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Jingkah jingpi tah a lengpa luidunga ache teng gakimupin, ajah a Pakaiyin, ‘Eihou theina diuvin kamite sultan.

tcz: Na soldoh louva ahile, “Keiman namite, nanung juiho chule na insung jousea thousi vaisi kahin lansah ding ahi. Egypt mite in jouse thousi vaisin atomlhah jeng ding, Gam leiset pumpi jong dimlha jeng ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
en_kjv: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagih masah dim dem nahi-thu na-ngailou le nangle navaipote chule namite ka-engbol ding ahi. Egypt mite insung thoulhe dimset ding, toldung jouse dimsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah kamite chenna Goshen achom beh'a kahoidoh ding ahi. Thousi khatcha lenglut louhel ding ahi. Chuteng leiset pumpin keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.
en_kjv: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite chenna Goshen gamsung vang tongkha ponge, thoulhe khat cha lengle ponte, chuting Kei Pakai hi hiche gamsunga natong thilbol kahi hedoh tan nate.

tcz: Keiman kamite leh na mite kah'a kikhenna ka sem doh ding, “Hiche thil kidang meilchihna hi jing nikho teng soh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”
en_kjv: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite le namite kah a lamdanga kabol’a hitobang thil kidang hi jing teng hungsoh ding ahi,’ tin aseiye gatin,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang'in aboltan. “Thousi vaibong techun Pharaoh insung, anungjui ho ingsung leh gamsung in jousea a lenglut tauvin adimlha jeng tai.” Thousi vaibong ahon hon in Egypt gamsung'a ahung kitol lut tan ahile gamsung pumpi chu athim lha jeng tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
en_kjv: And the Lord did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin thoulhe ahon honin leng inpi sungle avaipote insung dimset set’in alhalut tai. Egypt gamsung pumpi thoulhe dimset’in gamsung in amanlo tai.

tcz: Chuphat in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron aga kouvin, hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai! che uvin lang Pakai maicham gasem taovin, ati.” Aman asei jin “Hichu Egypt gamsung'a na bol ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in lengpan Mose le Aaron akouvin, “Cheuvin lang hiche Egypt gamsunga hin na-Pathen kom’uva gakilhai tauvin,” ati.

tcz: Mose'n a donbut in hitin aseije, “Hichu adih thei poi. Keihon Ka-Pakaiju le Ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina maicham kasem diu chu, hiche lai Egypt mite adia thil kitoh thei louding ahiye. Ven! Hitabang thilho pi chu bol taleng'u Egypt miten song'a eise lih gam ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?
en_kjv: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n, “Dih ponte, Pakai ka-Pathenu houna katha diu gancha ho chu Egypt miten alunghanlo diu ahi. Hiche ganchate hi Egypt miten amu phahna diuva that ung lunghanlo taleu, songa eise lih jeng diu ahi.

tcz: “Ka-Pakaiju leh ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina hi nithum sung hitei ding ahi, hichu Pakaiyin keima hodia a seidohsa ahi, ati.”
en_web: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”
en_kjv: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the Lord our God, as he shall command us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ethupeh bang banguva nithum lam kajot’uva, gamchang noiya Pakai ka-Pathenu koma kilhai ding kahibouvui,” ati.

tcz: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah'a hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai, che tauvin,” keiman nangho gamthip noija na-Pakai ju kinbol ding'in kaphal tai, amavang na che gamlhat louhel ding'u ahi. “Tun che uvin lang keima ding in neitao peh'un,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only you shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan, “Nache gamlat behseh lou pouvule gamchang noiya Pakai na-Pathenu koma kilhai din sol nauvinge, neitaopeh pou pouvin,” tin angeh tai.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose thupeh anei jin,“Pharaoh heng'a che kit in lang ajah'a hiti hin sei jin. Hiche hi ahi Hebrew mite Pakai, Pathen'in asei chu: Kamite che'u hen lang, Keima kin gabol uhen.
en_web: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
en_kjv: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa koma chen Pakai, Hebrewte Pathenin, ‘Eihou din kamite soldoh-in.

tcz: Na soldoh louva Israel mite hi na umsah jeng ding'a ahile,
en_web: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
en_kjv: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
tcz_gospelgo: Nasolda leh,

tcz: Na loujaova na gancha jouse na sa kolte, sangante, sangongsao te, gancha hon, kelngoite leh na kelchate chung'a gamna hise kahin lansah ding thigam kei ding ahiuve, ati.
en_web: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.
en_kjv: behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
tcz_gospelgo: ka-engbol’a naganchate –sakolte le sa-ngan ho, sa-ngongsang ho le bong jouse, kelngoite, chule kelcha ho pul kalha khum ding ahi.

tcz: Ahin lah Pakaiyin Isrrael te gancha ho leh Egypt mite gancha ho chung'a chom khenna ahin sem ding, Israel mite ganchaho vang chu khatcha jong thilou ding ahi!
en_web: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”
en_kjv: And the Lord shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children’s of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte gancha ho le Egyptte gancha ho kasekhen a, Israelte gancha khatcha jong thi lou diu ahi.

tcz: “Pakaiyin hiche gamna hise ahin lan sah ding ahitai. Aman aseije jing nikho teng gamsung pumpia ahinlan sah ding ahi.”
en_web: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”
en_kjv: And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei-Pakaiyin jing teng hiche hi abol kagot ahitai,’ tin aseiye gatin,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang in aboltai. A jing jingkah in Egypt mite gancha athigam hel tan, ahinlah Israel mite gancha vang chu khatcha jong athi hih beh jeng'e.
en_web: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
en_kjv: And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajingin Pakaiyin asei bangin aboltan, Egyptte gancha ho athigamin, Israelte a vang khat cha athipoi.

tcz: Thilsoh umchan dol khol chil ding'in Pharaoh'vin asohte hochu asoltan ahile, Israel mite gancha hochu khat cha jeng jong athi pon ahi! Ama vang Pharaoh lung thim chu angaiya bang'in atah jing nalaiyin* aman mipiho chu asol doh dehpon ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh sent, and behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan thilsoh umchan adongtoh-in, Israelte gancha khatcha thilou aseipeh tauve. Ahivangin alungtah nalaiyin Israelte asoldehpoi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a asei jin, “lhum sung'a kon in vutdi tampi kiham lhon'in, hichu Pharaoh mitmu chang tah'a Mose'n vanlam'a athe touding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it towards the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a, “Thuh phunga vutvam khut dim khattou gaham lhonin, Mose’n lengpa angsunga vanlam ngan thethang hen.

tcz: “Egypt gamsung pumpi chu vulvai nelsel chun alodim jeng ding, chuteng mihem chung hile gancha chung hile uilut natna huoisen alhundan jeng diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”
en_kjv: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gamsunga leivui khu banga leu ding, muntina uilut jangtea panga, mihem le gancha pomchet chut a alha ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: “Chuin amanin jong lhumsung'a konin vutdi aki ham lhonin, Mose angsung'a ading lhon tai,” Pharaoh'vin avet jing laiyin, Mose'n vutdi chengse chu vanlam angan athetou le, vutdi niel chun gampumpi aluodim jing tan mihem le gancha hochung'a uilut natna huoisi alang’ tai.
en_web: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.
en_kjv: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaronin vutvam phabep ahamdoh lhonin, lengpa angsunga adingin, Mose’n chunglama athe thangle, uilutjang asoh-in, mihem le ganchate pomchet chut in alhaitai.

tcz: Egypt gam'a doithem choiya thilbol ho chung'a jong achutan Mose angsung'a ading ngam ta pouvin, ajeh chu uilut natna huoisi chun amahole Egypt mite jouse alhun den jeng ahitai.
en_web: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.
en_kjv: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitpheldoi themho geiyin, Egypt mite dang banga uilut avei jeh-in, Mose masanga ahung thei tapouve.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah nalaijin, “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseidohsa bang'in, Pharaoh in ngainahsa in anei hih laiye.”
en_web: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.
en_kjv: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakaiyin lengpa lungthim atahsah-in, aseisa bangin lengpan Mose le Aaron sei angaidehpoi.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei yin, “Jingkah matah'in thouvin Pharaoh angsung'a ga ding'in lang, ajah'a seijin. Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen in hiti hin aseije: “Kamite soldoh tan, keima kin agabol na ding uvin.”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Jingpi tah le lengpa kimupin, Pakai Hebrewte Pathenin, ‘Eihou din kamite sultan.

tcz: “Na soldoh louva ahile, keiman natna huoisi ka hin lansah benah lai ding nangma le nanung juiho chule namite chung'a ka hin lansah cheh ding, chuteng nangman keima Pakai tailou leiset'a Pathen dang aum poi ti na hin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
en_kjv: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang navaipote le namite keo ka-engbol lou ding, vannoiya Kei tobang pathen umlou nahetna dia nang geiya ka-engbol ding nahi.

tcz: “Tu jeng ajong keiman ka khut ka lhan jah'a nangma le namite chung'a gamna huise ka lansah'a leiset chung'a hi kasuh mang hel jeng thei na hiye.”
en_web: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;
en_kjv: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangle namite natset lhunkumsah dia khut kalapsa hile, nathigam diu ahitai.

tcz: “Ahinlah keiman leiset pumpia ka thaneina ka musah bou na hin hichu leiset pumpia kithe jal ding ahi.”
en_web: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,
en_kjv: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathahat vetsahna, vannoi pumpi kaminthanna dia kahinsah nah lai nahi.

tcz: “Ahinlah hicheng jouse nung injong nangma leh nangma na kichoisang gunset in, kamite na soldoh hih laiye.”
en_web: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
en_kjv: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

en_kjv: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa dalhan Mose Pakaiya atao le,

tcz: Pakaiyin nisolam a kon in hui hattah ahin nunsah'in ahile, hiche huipi chun khaokhote jouse twikhanglen dung laiya alhoh lut soh hel jeng tai. Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhote chu khat jeng cha jong aum ta hih hel jeng'in ahi.
en_web: The LORD sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the Lord turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin nisolam huipi chu lhumlam khohuiyin akhel’in, khakhote abonchan Suez twikola alhoh lutsah soh tai. Egypt gamsunga khaokhote khat cha akimudoh tapoi.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah jeng na laijin, Pharaoh in jong mipi ho chu asol doh hih laiye.
en_web: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.
en_kjv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung atahsah-in, lengpan Israelte alhadoh kit tapoi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Nakhut ban jah'in lang vanlam sang tem in, Egypt gamsung pumpi muthim'in alo soh hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Vanlam sang le chun, Egypt gamsung tomjol khopset mujin hung lhung ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mose'n jong Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in vanlam asan jeng'a ahile, “Egypt gamsung pumpi nithum sung mu athim lha jeng tan, ahi.”
en_web: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
en_kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n vanlam asanle, nithum sungin Egypt gamsung mu athimsoh hel’e.

tcz: Hiche phatsung chun khat le khat akimu thei tapouvin, koimacha jeng jong pot le thei lou ahi tai. Ahinlah Israel chate chenna mun vang chu khovah'in aumpi jing uve.
en_web: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
en_kjv: they saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt mite khat le khat jong akimu thei tapouvin, insung dalha a potdoh jong aumtapouve. Israelte chenna sungsea vang kho avah jingnai.

tcz: Ajonan Pharaoh in jong Mose a koukit tan, a heng'a aseije, “Cheuvin lang Pakai kin gabol tauvin,” nachate'u kipui jun lang, ahinlah na kelngoi hon teu vang na dalhah ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpan Mose akouvin ajah a, “Pakai gakihou thei tauvin nate; numei chapang geiyin che jengun. Kelngoi le kelcha, bong ho geiyin vang pui dauvin, hikoma dalhauvin,” ati.

tcz: Mose'n adon but in, “hichu hithei him him ponte.” Ka gancha te'u chu nei puisah tei teiju angaije, ajeh chu ka Pakai u-leh ka Pathen angsung'a kilhaina a kaman chah ding'u ahi, ati.”
en_web: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
en_kjv: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the Lord our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n, “Achutile Pakai ka-Pathenu houna dia pumgo thilto dia tha ding gancha neipeh diu ahi.

tcz: “Ka gancha teu aboncha, ka pui teitei diu ahiye; khat jeng cha jong ka dalhah thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu ka ganchate'u lah a konna hi keihon Pakai angsung'a kilhaina'a kat doh ding'a ka lhen doh cheh cheh diu ahi. Chule amun ka lhun kahse uva itilam dol'a Pakai kin ka bol diu ham ti ka hechen nai pouve,” ati.
en_web: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve the LORD our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve the LORD, until we come there.”
en_kjv: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not a hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the Lord our God; and we know not with what we must serve the Lord, until we come thither.
tcz_gospelgo: Achutilou vangle gancfha aboncha kapui diu khat cha jong kadalhah lou diu ahi. Ganchate lah a Pakai ka-Pathenu houna dia lom kalhehdoh diu ahi nalaiye. Kilhaina ding mun lhun masanga itobang gancha thapeh ding kihe thei loulai ding ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu khatvei a sutah kit nalai jin, Pharaoh'in jong mipiho chu asol doh hih laiye.
en_web: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.
en_kjv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung atahsah jing jeh-in, Israelte asoldoh deh tapoi.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh jong apeng jah jeng tan, “Mose henga aseiyin, ka- angsunga kon in potdoh jeng'in!” ati. “Keiman nangma ka gih nahiye. Avel'a nei hung kinung mupi kitthei lou hel ding ahi! Nei kimupi kit ngai ngaiya ahile hiche nikhoa chu nathi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”
en_kjv: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan Mose jah a, “Kakoma konin potdoh loiyin! Mu jong neikimusah kit hih-in! Kamu ni ni le nathi ni kitoh ding ahi!” ati.

tcz: Mose'n a donbut in, “Apha jenge,” “Avella ka kimaito pi tah lou ding nahiye,” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”
en_kjv: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n jong, “Naseidih bouve, neimu kit louhel ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Keiman Egypt gamsung leh Pharaoh chung'a ka hin lhunsah ding hoise khat aki vat nalaije. Hiche hi aso chai chai teng le, Pharaoh vin agam sung dalha ding'a nahin no jeng ding'u ahitai,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.
en_kjv: (And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa le amite bolsetna ding talen khat bou kahentai. Hiche talen amat jou teng nalhadoh tauvinte. Nasol nom lot’uva nadeldoh tho diu ahi.

tcz: “Israel mite heng'a seipeh in lang, ama ama cheh'in aheng akom Egypt mite sana dangka akijep na ding uvin kithum cheh taohen,” ati.
en_web: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”
en_kjv: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun Israelten aheng akomuva sana le dangka, sanajem pahvui akithum diuvin seipeh tan,” ati.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Israel chate chu Egypt mite mitmun lunglhai na achansah tai. Chule Mose chu Egypt gamsung pumpia amin akithang in, Pharaoh mitmu chang leh mipite mitmun amin che lheh jeng tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
en_kjv: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.)
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Egyptte chu Israelte ajabolsah lheh jenge. Ahingmongin vaipote le mipin Mose chu mi nasatah a agel’u ahitai.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n Pharaoh heng'a asei jin Hiche hi Pakaiyin aseiye: “Keiman jankim tah le Egypt mite lungthim kahin suhthou ding ahi.”
en_web: Moses said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,
en_kjv: And Moses said, Thus saith the Lord, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n Egypt lengpa koma, “Pakaiyin, ‘Jan khangkim teng Egypt gamsung kakholsoh ding,

tcz: Egypt gamsung'a chapang peng masa jouse, Pharaoh chapa peng masapen ahin, a laltouna'a peng masa penpa ahin, a sum buh laiya chang bong goija pang a sohnu chapa changei ja abonchauva thigam kei ding, gancha peng masa jouse jong aboncha thisoh hel ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.
en_kjv: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
tcz_gospelgo: chapa peng masa jouse, leng chang ding, lengpa chapaa pat sumheiya chang goi soh numei chapa geiya, Egypt gamsung chapa jouse thisoh diu ahi. Gancha peng masa jouse jong thigam ding ahi.

tcz: “Chu teng Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao kithong lhading, ajeh chu hitabang thilsoh gimnei hi imatih channa anaum kha loulaiya ahin, Avella hung kilah kit talou ding chu ahi.”
en_web: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.
en_kjv: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gamsung ka le mao ogin thongsoh ding, hitobang hi kija kha loulai, jajong kija kit lou ding ahi.

tcz: “Ahinlah Israel mite vang chu lungmon nan aumpi jing diu, uicha jeng jong hampoh lou ding ahi. Chu teng Pakaiyin Egypt mite leh Israel mite kikah'a ijakai datkhenna asemdoh tai, hichu nanghon na hetdoh cheh ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.
en_kjv: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte lah a vang uicha hamgin le ganchate uhpoh jong kija lou ding ahi. Chuteng Kei-Pakaiyin Israelte le Egyptte kadat khen dol nahetdoh ding ahi,’ ati, tin gaseiyin,” ati.

tcz: “Chu teng Egypt gam'a nanung juiho leh nasohte abonchauva keima lam'a hung kipelut ding'u hitia hi asei diu ahi, khaiye! “Nangma leh nanung juiho abonchauvin hikoma kon hin potdoh tauvin,” tin aseije atipeh tai. Chuin Mose jong lungphamo tah'in Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a che doh tan ahi.
en_web: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.
en_kjv: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
tcz_gospelgo: Achainan Mose’n, “Navaipote ka-angsunga hung bohkhup a, kamite kapuidoh dia hung tao diu ahi. Chutah le kadalhah ding ahi,” ati. Hiti hin lung hang tah-in Mose’n Egypt lengpa adalhai.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Pharaoh vin nangma thusei ahin moh ngai thei lou ding, ahinlah keiman Egypt gamsung'a thil kidang melchihna ka bolbe nahlai ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt gamsunga thil kidang hijat hi kaboldohna thei dia Egypt lengpan nasei angai deh loulai ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mose leh Aaron'in jong Egypt gam Pharaoh angsung'a thil kidang melchihna tampi aki lahsah lhon'in, ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu ki dang tah in asutah jing nalaijin ahile, Pharaoh'vin Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung a kon in ana soldoh hih laiye.
en_web: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaronin Egypt lengpa angsunga thil kidang hijat pi hi aboldoh lhonin, Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung asuh tah jeh-in Israelte Egypt gama konin asoldoh deh poi.

tcz: Israel mite Egypt gamma aum jing laijun, Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a hicheng hi thupeh aneiye:
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gama Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a,

tcz: “Tuapat hiche lha hi nang ho ding'a lha kipatna ahin, kumkhat adia lha kipatna'a kisim ding ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
en_kjv: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche lha hi kum sunga lha kipatna nasim diu ahi.

tcz: “Israelte kikhop khomna munpi jouse ah ga seipeh lhon tan. Hiche lhasung nisom alhin niteng leh ama ama cheh in apu apateu insung kai lhah apat, insung khat cheh akon kelngoi khat cheh kat doh ding'a ahin kai diu ahiye.”
en_web: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;
en_kjv: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for a house:
tcz_gospelgo: Israel pumpi hitin hilchah lhonin; hiche lha nisom lhin ni le a-inson a sungsa tha dia kelngoi ham kelchagol ham khat naki-ngaito cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Kelngoinou khat kitha ding'a insung khat'a mijat chu alhom khah'a ahile, inneipu le aheng akoma pa kinop to ding kelngoi nou adol ding cha bep khat chu aga kimat lhon ding, amichan cheh'in aneh khopset ding kelngoinou khat ding mijat chu phatecha nasim toh lhon ding ahi.
en_web: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.
en_kjv: and if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi tobang insung chun sungsa kithat aneh lel dingle, a-inhengte to sa chu kihomuva, aneh khop bep dia chang thei ahiuve.

tcz: “Kelngoinou chu nolna beihel hiding, kumkhat lhingsa hitei ding, hiche kelngoinou chu kelngoi honlah'a konna hihen kelcha honnlah konna hijong leh athah beh mong mong'a na kimat ding'u ahi.”
en_web: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.
en_kjv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi ham kelcha ham natha theiyu ahin, hoijoh hile kum khat lhingsa, nolnabei achal hiding ahi.

tcz: “Hichea manchah ding kelngoinou chu hiche lha nisom leh nili lhinni geija nahen cheh diug'u hichu nilhum lam teng leh Israel kikhom pumpi chun ama amacheh adia akitha ding'u ahiye.”
en_web: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.
en_kjv: and ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lha nisom le ni li lhin ni, nilhah lam teng Israel pumping an atha diu ahi.

tcz: Gancha kithat thisan chu phabep a sodoh diu, hichu kelngoinou thisan a chu in kotpi phung le inkam'a aloinat cheh cheh diu ahi.”
en_web: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.
en_kjv: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
tcz_gospelgo: Aganthau sa anehna diu in tin a, kotpi chung inkama thisan aloinat soh kei diu ahi.

tcz: “Hicheni jan teng chule kelngoinou sa chu meiya akihul min uva aneh cheh diu, hichu cholso lou changlhah leh anchekha toh ametha cheh cheh diu ahiye.”
en_web: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
en_kjv: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jan hile sungsa chu ago min’uva, anche kha le cholsolou changlhah to ame diu ahi.

tcz: “Hiche sa chu asel puma hihen twija kihonminsa hijong leh koimachan naneh thei lou hel diu ahi. Sa pumpi aluchang le akeng chule asung jouse jaona meiya na kihulmin tho uva naneh cheh diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.
en_kjv: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Asel’a jong, hon thota jong naneh lou diu, apumchang, alu pum, akeng pum, asungsa jouse puma gomin thoa naneh diu ahi.

tcz: “Sahel moh neocha jong jingkah chan'na na khovah sah louhel diu ahi. Jingkah geija ana um taphot chu meiya na govam jeng ding'u ahiye.”
en_web: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.
en_kjv: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh moh imacha jong jingkah khovah geiya nakoiden lou diu, neh moh pou pou nagovam jeng dingu ahi.

tcz: “Hicheng hi sa naneh teng ule najui cheh ding'u ahiye: nangma cheh na kivon lhingsel uva, nakeng chot ho'u na kisi cheh diu, chule nakhut uva tenggol na kiphu soh kei ding'u ahi. Chu teng naneh khom soh kei uva hichu Pakaiya dia kalchuh kut ahiye,” ati.
en_web: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’s Passover.
en_kjv: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord’s passover.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholjin dia gotsa, tenggol choiya, kengchot busa, chule dinmun pum le kinotah a naneh diu ahi. Hiche hi Pakai-Kei jabolna Kalchuh Kut ahi.

tcz: “Hiche jan teng chule keiman Egypt gamsung kahin jotpa'a mihem leh gancha aboncha apeng lha masa jouse kasuh gam hel ding ahi. Chule Egypt gamsung'a milim doi kisemthu jouse chung'a jong thu katan ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi!” ati.
en_web: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.
en_kjv: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche jan hileh Egypt gamsung kakholsoh hel’a, mihem hihen gancha hile, apeng masa chengse kathagam ding, Egypt gamsung doi le kao jouse kasuhgama talen kamatsah ding ahi. Kei hi Pakai kahi.

tcz: “Ahinlah nangho jouse ding'a hiche thisan kiso chu melchihna hung kilah tading, keiman Egypt gampumpi ka hinsuh mang ding, hiche thisan chu kahin mudoh jiteng keiman nangho jouse chung'a natna hoise hung lang theijouse akonna kaven doh ding na hiuve,” ati.
en_web: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Kotpi inkam chunga thisan kiloi chun nachen nau in eihetsah ding-melchihna ahi. Hiche thisanchu kamu teng kalchuh ing ting, Egypt mite talen kapehna nangho suse ponge.

tcz: “Hiche nikho hi nangho ding'a het jing na nikho'a pang jeng ding ahitai. Hichu kumsih chule akhang akhang'a Pakaiya dia kut nikho ahi ti na gel doh jeng ding'u ahiye. Na khang lhumkei uva chonna dan hiti'a nanit jing diu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
en_kjv: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and you shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; you shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho hi, Kei-Pakai thilbol geldohna, sakho kut a nanei diu ahi. Akhang khangin bol jinguvin,” ati.

tcz: “Ni sagi sung'a cholso lou chang lhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi. Ni sagi alhinni teng leh nangma insung cheh'a chol umjouse pamlamma na paidoh soh kei ding'u ahi. Nalah uva koitabang khat chun hiche cholso lou changlhah, ni sagi lhinnia pat naneh khah ngeingei uva ahile, amachu Israel mite lah'a konna kisumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
en_kjv: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Ni sagi sungin cholkiso changlhah nehhih hel’un, cholsolou changlhah bou neuvin. Kut kipatni le insunga chol kikoi chengse napai diu ahi, ajeh chu kut sung ni sagi sunga chol sa changlhah nekha chan chu kamite to kisimtha lou ding ahitai.

en_web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

tcz: “Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho nilhah lam teng leh na boncha uva hiche chol solou chang lhah chu naneh pan diu ahi”

en_web: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

tcz_gospelgo: Ni sagi sunga koimacha insunga cholsosa changlhah kikoi thei lou ding, cholsosa changlhah koi pen pen gamsung mi hihen, khopem hile-Israelte Houbunga kisimtha lou ding ahi.

tcz: ‘Hiche phatsung hin amitakip'in cholsosa changlhah kiti phot na neh lou hel ding'u ahiye. Ajeh chu chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.”
en_web: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

tcz_gospelgo: Cholsosa changlhah him him naneh lou diu, na umna jouseuva cholso lou changlhah bou naneh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Naganthau thisan chu hyssop ponin deovin lang, kotpi khom le inkam jol’a loisan soh keiyun. Jingkah masanga koiman insung nakhokal thei lou diu ahi.

en_web: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

tcz_gospelgo: Nangho le natu nachateu geiyin, hiche Dan hi a-itih a jong anit jing diu ahi.

en_kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khangkim laiyin Egypt gamsung lengpa goulo ding chapa masa pen apat kulsunga kihen sohchang chapa masapen gei Egypt gamsung chapang masa jouse gancha peng masa ho geiyin Pakaiyin athath gamtai.

tcz: Jankim laijin Pharaoh, asohteho chule Egypt mite abonchauvin athou doh taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao awgin akithong helsoh tai. Ajeh chu intin chang'a mi thina lou umlouva ahi tai.

en_web: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as you have said!
en_kjv: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from amongst my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve the Lord, as ye have said.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajan janin lengpan Mose le Aaron agakousah-in, “Na-Israelte toh potdooh loi lhonin! Kagam sung dalhauvin, Pakai chu nadei bangin kihou tauvin.

tcz: “Na seima bang in na kelngoi jouseo leh nagan cha jouse'u abonchan ki pui unlang, che tauvin, nei dalhah ding tah jeh'un keima jong phatthei neichan lhon ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

en_kjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

en_kjv: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan mite le Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite gamsung napeh diuva napu napateu koma Pakai giltah a kitepsa ahi. Hiche gampha sunga nahin puilut tengule, kum seh a lha masa pena hiche kalchuh kut hi naman jing diu ah.

en_web: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

en_web: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
en_kjv: and it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the Lord slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

en_web: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
en_kjv: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.

en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

en_web: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”
en_kjv: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph-in Israelte giltah a akitepsah dungjuiyin, Mose’n Jospeh long apoi. Joseph chun “Pathenin nahuhdoh tengu hiche mun a kona kalong napoh doh tei diu ahi,” anati.

tcz: Israel miten Succoth mun ahida lha uvin gamthip lah Etham kiti mun ahung lhung tauvin hiche mun'na chun ngahmun akisem tauve.”

tcz_gospelgo: Sun teng achunguva Pakai meilomin akisongin, alekhun, jan teng amasanguva meikouvin akidal’in asalvah-e; hijeh chun sun le janin lam ajot theiyu.

tcz: “Hitia chu keima avel'a Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, aman nangho nung ahin delding ahi.* Ajeh chu keiman ka gontupsa ahitai, Pharaoh le agalsat mite chung'a ka loupina kakilah sah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt mite'n keima Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai! Aheng uva kisei peh bang'in Israel mite'n hiche munna chun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
en_web: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.

tcz: “Pharaoh lengpa le asohte ho heng'a Israel mite ajam tauve tithu alhun phat in, Pharaoh leh asohte lungthim akikhel kit tan, “Ipi khat ibol uva Israel mite asoh chan nauva kon'na jam gam'u hitam?” tin asei uve.
en_web: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”
