tcz_gospelgo: Israelte jamdoh thu Egypt lengpa aseipeh-u le, ama le avaipoten lung akhel’un, “I-bol kheltauve. Israelte isoldoh-u hi soh a inekhah lou diu ahitai!” atiuve.

en_web: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
en_kjv: But the Egyptians pursued after them (all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army) and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt sepaiten sakolte le kangtalai ho, kangtalai tolte pumin adel del jengun, Pi-Hahiroth le Baal Zephon kom, Twikhanglensan a aki-ngah nauva aphapa tauve.

tcz: Pharaoh jong Israel mite umnalam anailut jep phat'in amahon Pharaoh lam chu avetou uvin, hichun amahon anung lam uva Egypt mite ahung kitol chu amu tauve. Abonchauvin Pakai heng'a atao uvin,
en_web: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.

tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpa le asepaiten ahindel khum amu phat’un, Israelte akichauvin Pakaiya panpi ngaichan ataotauve.

tcz: Mose heng'a asei un, “Ipi ding'a gamthip noija hi thigam ding'a neihin puidoh'u hitam? Hitia ka thi gam sang uva Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'mu phajo lou ham? Ka chung uva ipi nabol jing hitam? Ipi dinga Egypt gamsung'a kona nei puidoh'u ham?
en_web: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

tcz_gospelgo: Israelten Mose jah a, “Egypt gama kivuina lhankhuh beiya nabol’a, nel gama lup kamsah dia neihin puiyu ham? I-khoh tah a Egypt a kona nei hin puidoh mongu ham!

tcz: Egypt gamsung kaum lai uva chu, hi tabanghi soh tei ding ahi tia ka seiju hilou ham? Tunjong na henga ka seiju ahi, “Nei dalha jeng tauvin! Egypt mite khut noija soh in umkit tau vinge. Hiche laimunna ka thigam sang uvin Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'u apha joi!” tin asei tauve.
en_web: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
en_kjv: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti dia hi ihung kipatdoh masanguva pat kasisau hilou ham? Neidon dauva Egyptte soh a pang den dia kaseipeh sau nahi. Gamchang noiya lup kam sanga Egyptte soh a pan phajo ta dinga,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah Mose'n mipi heng'a asei jin, “Kicha hihhel un, dingdet jing un veuvin, tunia hi Pakaiyin na huhdoh diu ahiye. Chule tunia kipat avella Egypt mite namukit tah lou diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n, “Kicha hih-un, pangdet’un, nahuhhingna diuva ahi. Hiche Egypt mite hi namu kit louhel diu ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Nangho sat ngailouva Pakaiyin gal nasatpeh diu ahi,” ati.

en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

en_web: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
en_kjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n Twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah le, Pakaiyin Twikhanglen chu niso lam khohui asemkhensah-in akiting kih tai. Hui anung khovah hel’in, Twikhanglen lai lung tolgo asoh tai. Twipi skihom khenin,

tcz: Chuphat'in Israel mite abonchauvin tolgo laiya chun akitol'un alang alang'abang-bang'in twi chu kiting tan ahi!
en_web: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten ajet aveiya twipi bangdan a kisung, Twikhanglen lailung tolgon ajotdoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Egypt mite Pharaoh galsat sakol jouse, sakol kangtalai jouse chule sakol touthem jouse jaona'n Twikhanglen lailung'a kitol Israel mite chu adel tauvin ahi.
en_web: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
en_kjv: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt miten sakolte le kangtalai jouse chule atol ho pumin Israelte nung adel’un, Twikhanglen lailung ageitauve.

tcz: “Jingpi ahi phat in Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu meikong leh meilom mangchan ahin vesuh tauvin ahile, chuin Egypt galsat miho chu abonchauvin suh na ding beijin a nohgam tauvin ahi.
en_web: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah konchan Pakaiyin meilomle meikouva konin Egypt sepaite ahinven, ameidoisah soh hel tai.

tcz: Pakaiyin a kangtalai jouse'u abonchan a tuhtang gam tan ahile, kangtalai hochu abonchan a kitang den gam tai. Egypt miten jong aseita'u vin! “Israel mite angsung'a kon'in jamdoh loiju hite,” ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Israel mite apan pin Egypt mite chung'a gal asat tai,” atiuve.
en_web: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”
en_kjv: and took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
tcz_gospelgo: Kangtalai velkol jouse a-odensah-in, atolchal tapouve. Egypt miten, “Pakaiyin Israelte panpi eikisatpi tauve. Jamdoh jengu hite!” tin aseitauve.

tcz: Israel mite agalkai phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt mite twijin ale lonkhum na ding'in na tenggol jahdoh inlang twipilen chungvum hi jep tem in, ati.”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Twikhanglen chunga khut jah le chun, twipi hung kichia, Egyptte le kangtalai ho chule atolte achupden ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Nisa ahung sodoh toh ki lhon'in, Pakaiyin a thupeh bang in Mose'n Twipilen chung vumma akhut ajah tan ahile, Twipilen jong angai ja bang bang in ahung um doh kit tai.
en_web: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
en_kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n Twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah jengle, khovah lhah-in twipi ahung kichin, aveina ngai ngaiyin aveitan, Egyptte chu twi lah a kon jamdoh agot vangun Pakaiyin twi lailunga laeh lut soh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Twi akitol mat kit tan, Israel mite nung hindel a Egypt galsat miho le sakol touthem jouse, kangtalai jouse abonchauvin Twi jin achup gam hel taovin khat jeng cha jong asohcha tapouvin ahi.
en_web: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
en_kjv: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi akichin kangtalai ho le atolte, Egypt sepaite, Israelte nung del Twikhanglen lailunga lutsa ho chu, khat beh jong khen louvin achup lihsoh hel’e.

tcz: Ahinlah Israel mite chu Twipilen lailung'a tolgo achun akitol jing uvin, twipi jing jong ajet aveija akisong den jeng in ahi.
en_web: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
en_kjv: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte vang chu jet le veiya twipi bangin akisungin, alailung tolgoa akijotdoh soh hel’uve.

tcz: Hiche nikho'a hi Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite khut akon'in ahu doh'in Israel mite'n amit tah uvin twi-khanglen galla Egypt mite thilong kijam hochu amutaovin ahi.
en_web: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
en_kjv: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho hin Egypt mite khut’a konin Pakaiyin Israelte ahuhdoh-in, Twikhanglen pamchin a Egyptte thilong akijamchap leu chu Israelten amutauve.

tcz: Egypt miten Isreal mite douna anei uva Pakai thahat le natoh ki dang amuchen ta uvin ahile, Israel mite'n Pakai chu aging tauve. Pakai le alhachapa Mose jong aging uvin, tahsan ki phudetna anei tauvin ahi.
en_web: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.
en_kjv: And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin tha hangsan taha Egyptte asuhgam amudoh phat’un, Israelten Pakai aging cha tauve.

tcz: Chuin Mose le Israel mite'n Pakai avahchoijun la asa uve: “Keiman Pakai vahchoila ka sah ding, ajeh chu aman loupitah in gal ajou tai; sakol ahin achung toupa Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga aseplut tan ahi.”
en_web: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
en_kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: The horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Israelten Pakai vahchoi nan hiche la hi asauve: “Pakai vahchoi la sange, Aman gal ajoutai! Sakolte le achunga toute Twikhanglen lailunga aleh luttai.

tcz: “Pakai hi kei dinga, ka thahat nale ka vahchoi ding'a lomtah ahi; ajeh chu aman galjona eipetai.” Amahi ka Pathen, ka vahchoi ding ahi, chule kapau Pathen ahin, choiat ding'a lom Ama bou ahi!
en_web: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
en_kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, And he is become my salvation: He is my God, and I will prepare him a habitation; My father’s God, and I will exalt him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakulpi detpen Pakai ahin, Eihuhhinga Ama ahi. Ka-Pathen ahi vahchoiyinge, Kapa Pathen loupije sachoi lenge!

tcz: “Pakai hi galhattah ahin, ajeh chu amin jong Yaweh ahiye!”.
en_web: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.
en_kjv: The Lord is a man of war: The Lord is his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai gal-hang ahin, Amin jong Pakai ahi.

tcz: “Pharaoh kangtalai jouse le agalsat jouse, Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga asep lut tauvin; Pharaoh deitum le alhen tumho abonchauvin Twikhanglen san dunga aseplut gamtauvin ahi”.
en_web: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
en_kjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
tcz_gospelgo: “Egypt sepaite le kangtalai jouse Twikhanglena alehlut soh tai. Egypt sepai vaipo them josue Twikhanglensanin achupsoh tauve.

tcz: “Twikhanglen kinong in achup gamsoh heljing uvin; abonchaovin songtum bangin Twinoi lamma a lhalhum gam tauve.”
en_web: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
en_kjv: The depths have covered them: They sank into the bottom as a stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen thuh alut lhumun, Songtum kileh lutbangin lito ageitauve.

tcz: “O Pakai nakhut jetlam hi loupe le thahat chungnung ahi. Melmate jeng jong a sugam hel tan ahi.”
en_web: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.
en_kjv: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: Thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: “Naban thahat akidange Pakai, Melmate nabottelsoh tai.

tcz: “Na lalna leh na loupina jal in na melmate naleh khup jing e, Nalunghan na nasatah in nahin tahlang jitan ahile; abonchauvin meiyin changpol akah vamkei bang'in a kavam soh hel tauve.”
en_web: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
en_kjv: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: Thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
tcz_gospelgo: Loupi chung nungin Namelmate najoutai; Nalunghan chun abonchauvin changpol meiya kileo nabahsah tai.

tcz: “Nangma husan akonin twipi kinong jeng jong alhuh den in ahile atang jeng tai! Chule twikhanglen lailung'a twi kitangjong chu ale chupsoh heljeng in ahi.”
en_web: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
en_kjv: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, The floods stood upright as a heap, And the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen namut le Twipi alhuh lhuh-in akinongin; Banglai kksung abangin, Twito thuhpen jong leitah asoh jenge.

tcz: “Chuin Melmapa chun hitin aseiye, keiman anung ka del ding ka phah tei ding ahi. Thil kiladoh kale lah ding chule ka deichat bangtah'a kakile lah ding ahiye; kachem jam ka sadoh ding, abonchauva kasat chap jeng ding ahiuve.”
en_web: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
en_kjv: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Melman, ‘Kadel’a kamuat ding; Agouvu kadei dei kachom ding, chemhem hat’a anei jouse kalah ding ahi,’ ati.

tcz: “Ahinlah nangman na haikhum in ahile, abonchauvin twikhanglen in a chup tauve. Twipi hattah lailung'a alhum gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
en_kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: They sank as lead in the mighty waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai nakisem husan Egyptte twiyin ahcuptai; Twithuh lailunga ngenchang kilehlut abangui.

tcz: “O Pakai, Pathen dangho jouse lah jeng'a jong koi macha nang kal lhah aumpon, amaho chu imacha toh'a kite thei deh pouvin, nangma kala koima cha thenna chang ding aum hih e. Loupi na leh tijat umtah'a thilbola koiham?”
en_web: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
en_kjv: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? Who is like thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Pakai Nangto tethei pathen koi ham? Thengpentah Nang tobang koiham? Nabol tobang thil kidang datmo boldoh ding koi ham?

tcz: “Nangman nakhut jetlam najahdoh in ahile, hichun leiset'a melmate avallhum gam tauve.”
en_web: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
en_kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, The earth swallowed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhut jetlam najahle leiyin namelmate aval lhumtai.

tcz: Na lungsetna long louvin, na lhatdohsa mite aumpi jing in ahi. Na chena mun geijin namite nahin puilhung tai.”
en_web: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
en_kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: Thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepna Molson nahuhdohsa mite napuidohtai. Nathahat’in puiyin nagamtheng nalhut tai.

tcz: “Mitin vaipin hichu ahin jasoh tauvin ahile; Philistine gamsung'a cheng jouse din nat hesoh achang tauve.”
en_web: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
en_kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid: Sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipin ajauvin akihot lhulsoh tauve; Philistine mite kicha lih pai diu ahitai.

tcz: “Edom gamsung'a lamkai kitiphot alung thomlhao gamtan; Moab gamma lamkai jouse jong aki thing soh hel tauve. Canaaan gam'a cheng jouse jong alung thoi gamta uve.”
en_web: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
en_kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; The mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; All the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
tcz_gospelgo: Edom mite lamkai ho atijauvin, Moab mihatte akihot hot’ui. Canaan gam mite amei doi gamtauve.

tcz: “Nangman namite nahin puilut ding nangma molsang chungvum a chu na tundoh ding ahiye; ajeh chu nangman hiche laimun chu na chenna dinga na tundoh sa ahi tai, O Pakai nangman mun theng laijeng jong chu na khut te nia na tundoh ahi tai, ati.”
en_web: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
en_kjv: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, In the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, In the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahin puilut’in nagamsung Mol le lhang natomjolsah-in; Nang-Pakaiyin nalhendohsa mun, na-in Houin-nasahsa dung nalhutsohtai.

tcz: “Pakai hi tonsot tonsot'a chung nung chang ahi tai!”
en_web: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”
en_kjv: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai nangma, Tonsot tonsot’a leng chang ding nahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pharaoh sakol kangtalai jouse twikhanglen lailung'a atol lut in, Pakai thahat chun achungvum uvah twikhangklen chu alechup sah gam ahitai. Ahinlah Israel chate abonchauvin twi-khanglen lailung tolgo lah achun akijot galkai sah tauvin ahi.
en_web: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
en_kjv: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten Twikhanglen lailung tolgon ajotdoh tauve. Egypt mite kangtalai ho le sakolte chule kangtalai tol ho puma Twikhanglen lailung agei phat’un Pakaiyin twipi akichisah kit’in achupsah soh tai.

tcz: Chuin Aaron a sopinu, themgao Miriam akhut'a khutbeh khat chu akilah in, numeija kaijousen amanu nung chu ajui tauvin, khutbeh jaonan apotdoh uvin alam uve.
en_web: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
en_kjv: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
tcz_gospelgo: Aaron sopinu Miriamin khutbeh akipat’in, numei dang sen jong ajop’un khutbeh bengin alamtauve.

tcz: Chule Miriam chun hiche jaila hi a-oijin ahi: “Pakai vahchoila sa'u hite, Aman loupitah'in gal asat'in ajou tai; sakol chung'a toupa jeng jong twikhang len lailung'a aleh khup jeng tai.”
en_web: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
en_kjv: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; The horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeiho lamkaiyin Miriamin la asan: “Pakai vahchoiyun, Minthangtah-in gal ajoutai. Sakolte le achunga tou mihem josue Twikhanglen a aleh luttai,” atiuve.

tcz: Mose'n jong twikhanglen San akon'in Israelte chu ahin pui nalaijun, chuin Shur kiti neldi gam'a akitol lut tauvin ahi. twidon ding thei louvin nithum sung'in akitol tauve.
en_web: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
en_kjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte chu Mose’n Twikhanglensan apat Shur gamthip lama apuitai. Nithum sung nelgam jeng ajot’u le, twi him him amu tapouve.

tcz: Marah mun ahung geitauvin ahile hiche mun'na twi chu akha'n don thei ahi tapoi. Hijeh chun hichelai munchu Marah asah tauvin ahi (hichu akha tina ahi).
en_web: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
en_kjv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
tcz_gospelgo: Marah kiti lai ahinphauvin, chukoma twi chula akhan adon theipouve. Twikhat jeh a Marah asah lo’u ahi.

tcz: Chuin mipi Mose chung'a aphunchel gamtaovin hiti hin aseyuve, “Ipi kadon diuva hitam?”
en_web: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
en_kjv: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi Mose koma akiphin’un, “Ipiba kadon diu ham?” tin anotauve.

tcz: Mose jong Pakai lamsang in kap pum in atao tai. Pakaiyin thing lhon neokhat avetsah in hichu asat doh'in twi lah chu akho lut'a ahile twi chu donthei ahung sohdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin hiche Marah munna chun Israelte ding in chonna dan khat a sempeh'in Ama'a akitah jing na diuvin jong hilchetna aneiyin ahi.
en_web: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
en_kjv: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
tcz_gospelgo: Mose jong lunggil tah-in Pakaiya ataovin, Pakaiyin thing hal khat avet sah-in, hichu twikha lah a lelut le donthei asohtai. Hikoma hin Pakaiyin achonna diu Danthu apen, pajong apate’e.

tcz: “Aman hiti hin aseije, “Nangman ching thei tah'in na Pakai na Pathen thusei ngaijin, Ama mitmu'a thudih jeng'a na chon ding, a thupeh jouse na nit ding, hi tia chu Egypt mite chung'a gamna hoise ka lan sah chu nangho chung'a ka lansah louhel ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima nadamsah na Pakai chu kahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”
en_kjv: and said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Thildih a kagel chu thakhen louva nabol’uva, kathupeh chengse nanit jingule, Egypt mite kathagamna nat ho khatcha nachunguva chuhsah ponge. Kei hi nadamsah-uva Pakai chu kahi,” ati.

tcz: Marah mun adalhah phat'uvin Israel mite jong Elim kiti twiko somleni putdoh namun tom-thing somsagi kenna munna twipang achun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
en_web: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
en_kjv: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Abanin Elim ahung lhungun, hikoma hin twinah phung som le ni aumin, chahthing hung som sagi akeh-e; twipanga chun aki-ngauvin ahi.

tcz: Elim akon'in Israel mipi akitol uvin Sin* kiti gammang lam hichu Elim le Sinai molsang kahlah ahiye. Hiche mun chu Egypt gamsung'a konna ahungpotdoh kal'u lhani alhing tan, hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinin ahunglhung taovin ahi.
en_web: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche mun jeng ajong chun Isreal mite Mose le Aaron heng'a aphunchil taovin ahi.
en_web: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
en_kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

tcz: Ama hon aseiyun, “Kada tangei uve! Egypt gamsunga kana um laiyun saneh ding hihen changlhah hijong le adimlha jeng jin, tun nangman hiche gamthip noiya hi kelthohsah'a thi gam sah ding nei got u hitam,” atiuve.
en_web: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
en_kjv: and the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Vetan! Vanna konna keiman nangma ann kahinpeh ding nahiye. Nisih niseh'a aneh diu adeichannu agakilo ding'u ahi. Keiman amaho kapatep ding ahiuve, ajeh chu kathu angai nah uvem.”
en_web: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
en_kjv: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

tcz: “Nigup lhinni teng keiman aneh khopset diuva an'neh kahin pehding ahiuve, hichu anehkhopset diu ajatnia tam hiding ahi.”
en_web: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

tcz: Chuin Mose le Aaron'injong Israel mite heng'a aseipeh lhon tan, “Nilhah lam teng na hetdoh ding'u ahiye, ajeh chu koiham Egypt gamsung'a konna nahin puidoh paochu,” atipeh lhon tai.
en_web: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

tcz: “Chule jingkah lamteng Pakai loupina namudiu ahi, ajeh chu nangho nakiphin nau awgin Aman ajasoh tai, hichu Amadia doumah um ahin, hichu keini chung'a doumah naneijin phun hihhel un, ati lhon'e.”
en_web: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
en_kjv: and in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

tcz: Mose'n asei aseikit in, “Pakaiyin nilhah lamma naneh diu sa nahin peh diu, jingkah lama naneh diu changlhah nahin peh diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nangho na phunchel uva ama douna thu na seinau aja soh tai. Keini a kon ipijeh'a na kiphin'nu ham? Henge, na phunchel nau chu keini douna hilouvin, Pathen douna ahijoi,” ati lhonne.
en_web: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”
en_kjv: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Israel mite jouse heng'a seipeh tem in: Nangma cheh Pakai angsung'a kipe lut uvin, ajeh chu Aman nang ho phunchel na ajahsoh ahi tai, tin seiyin,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
en_kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.

tcz: Aaron'injong Isreal mite jouse heng'a aseiyin ahile, amahon gammang lah chu avel le jeng tauvin ahi. Amahon Pathen loupina thil chu vanlam'a amu tauvin ahi.
en_web: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.

tcz: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Keiman Israel mite phunchelna ka jahsoh tan ahi. Tun nangman aheng uvah seijin, nilhah lamteng naneh diuva sa ka hin peh ding na hiuvin chule jingkah lamteng naneh diuva changlhah kahin peh ding na hiuve. Chuteng nanghon keima hi na-Pakai u-leh Na-Pathen'u kahi na hetdoh ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
en_kjv: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Hiche nilhah lam chun vamimte ahung kitol tauvin ahile ngahmun chu alo dimlha jeng tauve. Jingkah khovah machun ngahmun kim vel lah jouse chu daitwi jin ana chup in ahi.
en_web: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

tcz: Chuin daitwi hochu ahung kihoh dohtan ahile, gammang lah akon chun thilpha tah khat alomlom chan ahung umtan, hichu abeh beh'a kigol'in anaum in ahi.
en_web: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
en_kjv: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

tcz: Israel miten jong hichu ahinmudoh taovin ahile, amaho akidong tochheh un, “hiche khu ipi ahidem?” amahon ipi ahichu ahedoh jou pouvin ahile. Chu in Mose'n ahil chen un, “Hiche hi nehding'a Pakaiyin napeh uvah ahi,” ati.
en_web: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.
en_kjv: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.

tcz: “Hicheng hi Pakaiyin aseije: Nangma insung cheh'in naneh khopset diu kilah unlang, chule mikhat'in vamim jatnia tamjo napon buh sung uvah kichoi lut un,” ati.
en_web: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”
en_kjv: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

tcz: Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi, kimkhat in tampi a kichoi jun, akim khatma chun achoi khambep cheh aki choi uve.
en_web: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

tcz: Ahinlah Omer dimkhat cheh atetoh uvin ahileh, tamtah hinkilah ho ahin chule ama ding khambep hin kilah ho jong hiti chun, kitam lah chom leh kilhom lah chom um louvin; abonchauvin kitoh chat chat'in akihom uvin aki choiyuve.
en_web: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
en_kjv: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n aheng uvah aseiyin, “Jingkah khovah lhah channa ahelsi cha jeng jong na koi loudiu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
en_kjv: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

tcz: Kimkhat chun a ngaisah pouvin changlhah aneh moh uchu jingkah lam chan in akoi jun ahile, chang lhah akoi den hou chu thaan achu tan a uilha gam tai, Mose jong ama ho chung'a chun a lungpha mo tan ahi.
en_web: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

tcz: Jingkah sih'in Mipiho chun aneh khop cheh diu changlhah chu aga kilo jiuvin, nisa ahungsat doh teng levang changlhah hochu ajunmang jitan ahi.
en_web: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
en_kjv: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

tcz: Nigup lhinni teng le changlhah chu achan jatbep cheh diuvin akilo jiuvin, hitia abol'u toh kilhon chun khompi lamkai ho ahung uvin Mose heng'a asei jiuvin ahi.
en_web: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

tcz: Aman aheng uvah aseiyin, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseije: Jing nikho teng nangho nakicholdo diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiya dia Sabbath nikho theng ahi. Changlhah na kisem theijat channu tunin kisem unlang, hiche hochu jinglam'a ding jong kikoi doh taovin,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which you will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

tcz: Mose'n athupeh bang'un, changlhah phabep chu achom in jingkah khovah chan in akoi jun ahi. Jingkah'in changlhah hochu ima ati tapon than jong chu louvin hoitah'in ana um'e.
en_web: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
en_kjv: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

tcz: Mose'n aseijin, “Hiche changlhah hi tunin neuvin, ajeh chu tunikho hi Pakaiya dia Sabbath ahi. Ajeh chu tol lhamma chang lhah umlou ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.
en_kjv: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

tcz: Nigup sung'a changlhah na kilo cheh diu, ni sagi niteng nalo thei lou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en_web: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”
en_kjv: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

tcz: Kim khat chu Sabbath nikhon changlhah kilo din acheuvin, hinlah changlhah khat jeng cha jong amu tapouve.
en_web: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “hiche mite hin itih chan kathu peh apalkeh diu hitam?
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

tcz: “Amahon ageldoh diu chu Sabbath nikho hi Pakaiya akon ahin Aman eipeh'u ahiye. Hijeh achu Pakajin nigup sung'in changlhah neh ding na peuvin, nigup lhinni man nini sung'a neh ding changlhah na peuve. Nalah uva koi hijong leu chun naum na cheh uva umthim beh jeng uvin lang,’ nisagi lhinni teng koima cha achenna munna konin pamlama potda jeng tahen,” ati.
en_web: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
en_kjv: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

tcz: Nisagi lhin ni leh na boncha uvin ima ne louvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: So the people rested on the seventh day.
en_kjv: So the people rested on the seventh day.

tcz: Israel miten chang lhah chu Manna asah tauvin ahi. Hichu muchi mu tabang bang ahin, atwi dan jong khoiju ta bang ahiye.
en_web: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
en_kjv: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

tcz: Mose'n asei in, “Pakai thupeh chu hiche hi ahiye: “Nakhang lhumkei uva umjing ding in Manna ki hamdoh cheh uvin, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva mite hon Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hinpui uva gammang thip lah'a Manna'a kahin vah nao ahidan ahetdoh thei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
en_kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

tcz: Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Belneo khat latem'in asung'a chun Manna phabep khat khum'in. Hichu akhang akhang'a umjing dia Pakai ansung'a nagakoi ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Aaron in jong aboltan ahi. Pakai angsunga akhang akhang'a het tohsah'a pang ding'in kitepna thingkong maiya chun akoi tan ahi.
en_web: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
en_kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

tcz: Israel mite'n jong achenna diu mun ahin phah kahseo vin, kum somli sung sen Manna jeng ahin neuvin, Canaan gam ahung lhun kahse uva ding'in Manna jeng chu ahin ne tauvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

tcz: Manna Omer dimkhat chu Ephah khatseh hopsomma hop khat toh aki bang in ahi.
en_web: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
en_kjv: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang in Israel chate abonchauvin Sin* gammang akon in akitol uvin mun khat akon munchom khat'a akitol leuvin ahi. Rephidem kiti mun'na ngahmun akisem'uvin hinlah hiche lai mun'na chun twidon ding aumta pon ahi.
en_web: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
en_kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

tcz: Mipi jong Mose heng'a avel lin a phunchel kit tauvin, “Don ding twi neipe uvin,” ati tauve. Mose'n a donbut in ajah uva, “Ipi ding'a kei koma ki phin'a na hiuvem? Chule ipi ding'a nang hon Pakai na patep u ham?”
en_web: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”
en_kjv: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide you with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?

tcz: Mipihon twi angaicha jing uvin Mose dounan thu aseijun akiphin gam tauvin, “Ipi ding'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nei hin puidoh mong mong'u hitam? Nangman keiho le, ka chate'u chule ka gan chate'u ka boncha uva dangchah'a thigam sah ding nei got uva hitam?” tin asei uve.
en_web: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
en_kjv: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

tcz: Chuin Mose jong Pathen heng'a kap pum'in ataovin, “Hiche miteho ding'a ipi kabol ding hitam? Song'a selih ding eigo tauve,” ati.
en_web: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
en_kjv: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

tcz: “Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Mipiho ma'sang a konchun ki khen doh tem'in chule Nile vadung San najepna tenggol chu kichoiyin lang Israel upa ho phabep kipuijin.”
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

tcz: “Keiman Sinai molsang* songpi chungvum'ma ka dinpi ding nahiye, chuteng songpi chu jep lechun twi hung kikho doh jeng ding, Israel miten adon thei diu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
en_kjv: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

tcz: Mose'n jong hiche mun chu Massah asah tan ahi (hichu ‘patepna’ tia kihe ahi) Chule Maribah (hichu ‘ki khoh doh’ tina ahi) ajeh chu Isreal mite Mose heng'a aphunchil uva, Pakai doumah jing asei doh uvin, “Na Pakaiyin keiho hikoma hi ei umpi mong uva hinam?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”
en_kjv: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord amongst us, or not?

tcz: Israel mite Rephidim mun aum jinglai yun, Amalek mite ahung kon uvin akisat petauve.
en_web: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
en_kjv: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong Joshua heng'a thupeh aneiyin, “Amalek mite toh kisat ding pasal galsat ding phabep khat lheng doh tem'in. Jing nikho le keima gamlah molsang'a ka din ding hichea chu Pathen bantha hat ka dopsang'a ka pan ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

tcz: Mose thupeh bang'in, Joshua'n jong Galsat ding pasal phabep alheng doh tan Amalek mite chu gal akisat pi tauvin ahi. Chuin Mose, Aaron leh Hur amaho cheng chu gam lah molsang lam'a akal tou tauvin ahi.
en_web: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
en_kjv: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

tcz: Mose'n akhut teni a dopsang chan in Israel mite ahat be cheh jiuvin, chule akhutteni akham teng le vang Amelek mite ahat jita uvin ahi.
en_web: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

tcz: Mose khut teni chu ahung khaam tan ahile aman jong adomsang joutapon chuin Aaron le Hur'in jong akhut ngap nading'in song ahol le hontan, a khut teni chu song chung'a angam lhan toumun in nilhum keijin akhut chu chol lou helin a domsang thei tan ahiye.
en_web: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
en_kjv: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

tcz: Ajonan Joshua le agalsat mihon Amelek mite chu ajoutaovin ahi.
en_web: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
en_kjv: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

tcz: Gal ajo phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Het jing na ding'in lekhajol khat lanlang hiche gal kisat chung chang thuhi sunlut'in lang Joshua nabeng'a avella nasim peh tan: vannoiya Amalek kihetna kiti keiman kasuh mang hel ahitai,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

tcz: Mose'n jong hiche lai munna chun maicham asem in, “YAWEH-NISSI” (Pakai chu kaponlop ahi) tin asah tai.
en_web: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.
en_kjv: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:

tcz: Aman aseijin, “Amalek mite'n Pakai doumah'a chon masao ahin, tunvang! Pakaiyin imatih channa Amalek mite akidou peding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
en_kjv: for he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

tcz: Mose ding'a anupa pa, Jethro Midian thempupa'n Mose le asopi Israel mite chung'a Pakai natoh thil kidang abolho ajadoh tai. Amapan jong Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'ma kon'na ahin lhatdoh chu ki dang asaval jeng'in ahi.
en_web: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
en_kjv: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa, Jethro heng'a ajinu Zipporah le achapateni chu asol'in, chuin amahon insung'a apuilut uvin ahi.
en_web: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
en_kjv: then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

tcz: Mose chapa pengmasa min chu Gershom ahin*, achapa apen lhah chun Mose'n hiti hin aseiye. “Mi gamsung'a khosa kahi,” tia ana minsah chu ahi.
en_web: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
en_kjv: and her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

tcz: Ani channa achapa min chu Eliezer* asah in, Mose'n hiti hin aseije, “Keima khangluiya pat ka Pathen chun Pharaoh chemjam akon eihuh hing ahi,” tia asah ahi.
en_web: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
en_kjv: and the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

tcz: Mose nupa pa, Jethro chu Mose vil lin gammang lam'a ahung tan ahile. Aman ajinu le achapa teni chu ahin puijin, Mose le amiten gamthip lah Pathen molsang kom'a ngahmun akisem nau mun'na ahinpha taovin ahi.
en_web: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.
en_kjv: and Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

tcz: Jethro'in jong Mose chu thu athot tan, “Keima Jethro nanupa pa kahin, keima nangma vil'a najinu le na chapa teni jaona hung kahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”
en_kjv: and he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

tcz: Mose jong pamlam'a agache doh'in anupa pachu agakimu pitai. Amajong akum lhan abeng achop peh tan ahi. Hiti chun khat le khat akilem touvin Mose chen'na ponbuh sung'a alut taovin ahi.
en_web: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
en_kjv: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa heng'a Pakaiyin ichangeiya Egypt gam'a konna Israel mite chung'a na-ahintoh ham ti thudol'a aseipeh'in ahi.Chule lamkah jouse'a thohgim hahsa athoh nau le agenthei najouseo abonchan anupa pa heng'a asei peh in ahi.
en_web: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
en_kjv: And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the Lord delivered them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Israelte ichangeiya Egypt mite khut'a kon ahin panpi hitam tithu le ahin huhdohna thudol phatah'a ahet chet phat'in alungthim akipah lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
en_kjv: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the Lord had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

tcz: Jethro'n hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen thangvah in umhen.” “Ajeh chu Aman Pharaoh le Egypt mite akona nahin huhdoh jal in. Henge, Pakai bou chu ahiye Egypt mite thanei na konna na huh doh uva! ati.”
en_web: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
en_kjv: And Jethro said, Blessed be the Lord, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

tcz: “Tun keiman ka hechen sel taije, Pakai hi pakai jouse lah a thanei chung nungpen Pakai ahiye. Ajeh chu Aman aban thahat apan'in Egypt mite akiletsah nauva kon'na ahin huhdoh ahi,” ati.
en_web: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
en_kjv: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

tcz: Chuin Jethro amachu Mose ding'a anupa pan jong Pathen angsung'a pumgo thilto kilhaina asem in ahi. Aaron le Israel sung'a upa ho ahung uvin Pathen angsung'a kilhaina ankong chu asoh khom uve.
en_web: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
en_kjv: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.

tcz: Ajing nikhon Mose'n jong atouna a kon'nin mipiho thutan ding'in ahung doh tan ahile, mipiho jong chu nilhum keijin ading tauve.
en_web: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

tcz: Mose nupa pan, hitia mipiho chung'a athilbol amudoh phat'in aman Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche laimunna hi ipi mong mong tongdoh inge nati ham? Ipi bol mong inge natia jingkah'a kipat nilhah lamchangeiya mipiho hi nahiti din sah hitam?” ati.
en_web: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
en_kjv: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

tcz: Mose'n adonbut'in ajah'a, “Ajeh chu mipiho hi kaheng'a hung uva Pathen akon kavai hopna hi akilah mang kigot uva ahi.”
en_web: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
en_kjv: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to inquire of God:

tcz: “Amaho hi ahung kinah komu le kaheng ahin jonlut jiuvin, chuteng keiman thu katan peh jiuvin, Pathen akon nun leh khan dan toh kitoh'a Pathen phatsah bang'a ka hilchen jiuva ahiye,” ati.
en_web: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
en_kjv: when they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

tcz: Chuin Mose nupa pan ajah aseiyin, “na thilbol hi adih poije!” ati.
en_web: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
en_kjv: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

tcz: “Mipi ahin nangma nahin na bon'uva na gimna diuva ahi bouve ajeh chu nathilbol hi abeipon ahi. Nangma changseh adin thi lhah satah khat ahiye,” ati.
en_web: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
en_kjv: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

tcz: “Tun keiman kahil nahiye, ajeh chu keiman kultah'a kahil nahi ngaijin lang Pathen'in naum pijing hen. Mipiho jouse khella hi Pathen ansung'a ding jing nahin, akibaotam nao jouse Pathen angsung'a na selhah ding ahijoi,” ati.
en_web: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
en_kjv: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

tcz: “Mipiho hi Pathen akon chonna Danho le phatsahna ho hilchen in lang,hichu aboltei na diuva na thumop'a chule ajui cheh na diuva jong nasei ngaija ahi.”
en_web: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
en_kjv: and thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

tcz: “Ahinlah mipiho lah akonna thilbol thei miman tam, Pathen ging, nehguh chah guh beija natong thei ding nalhen doh ding ahi. Amaho chun mijakhat lah hihen sangkhat lah hihen jakhat lah hijong le aloi loija vaihomma na pansah ding ahiye.”
en_web: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
en_kjv: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

tcz: “Phat tinna mipi thutanna napan sah diu, thupi diuva thutanna ding aumvang le nangma heng'a hinpuiyun tin, thuneo hojouse vang chu amahon ama chamma atan lhah jeng theiju ahi. Nangma dia jong agom lam hijo ding chule amahon jong nangma nahin kithopi nau jong ahi,” ati.
en_web: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
en_kjv: and let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

tcz: “Hichengse hi na jui'a ahile, nangma chunga Pathen in tohding nahin peh teng doujou'na tha naneijoh ding chule mipihon jong lungmoung sella ama ama in cheh akile jut thei diu ahi.”
en_web: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
en_kjv: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa Jethro thusei chu angaijin, aman aseibang bang'in aboltan ahile apha lheh jeng tai.
en_web: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
en_kjv: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

tcz: Israel mite lah akonin thilbol thei miman tam cheh alheng doh tan. Amaho chengse chu Israel mite lah'a lamkaija pang ding hichu mi sangkhat, jakhat chung'a vaihomin apan sah soh kei uve.
en_web: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
en_kjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

tcz: Amaho chun kiphunna le baotam na nei ho chu Mose heng'a ahin lhut lut jiuvin ahi. Thuneo boina hovang chu amahon acham'un a sulham jiuvin ahi,
en_web: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
en_kjv: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

tcz: Hicheho jouse nung hin, Mose'n anupa pa asol in, anupa pa Jethro in jong alam pi ahung'na mama chu ahoh in akile tan ahi.
en_web: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
en_kjv: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

tcz: Israel miten Egypt gamsung* ahin dalhah kalseo lhani lhin'in Sinai mun gamthip ahung lhung atovin ahi.
en_web: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
en_kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Rephidim ngahmun ahin sukeh un ahin dalha tauvin, chuin Sinai mun'na ngahmun a kisem uvin hichu Sinai ngahmun tin aminsah uve.
en_web: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
en_kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

tcz: Mose molchung lam akaltou tan Pakai toh agakimu ton ahile, Pakaiyin molchung'a kon'in ahin kouvin aseije, “Thupeh hicheng hi; Jacob insung le Israel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin:
en_web: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
en_kjv: And Moses went up unto God, and the Lord called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

tcz: “Egypt mite chung'a ipiti lamdolla na katoh, nang hon na musoh kei uve. Keiman nangho muvan lai lhaving'a ka hin pui uve ti namu chenset tauvin ahi.”
en_web: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
en_kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

tcz: Chule tua hi kathu nangai uva kakitepna nakoi jing uva ahileh, nangho hi vannoi mite jouse lah'a keima dia atumbeh'a naum diu; ajeh chu vannoi leiset pumpi hi keima'a ahi.”
en_web: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;
en_kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

tcz: “Chule keima lenggam machu nangho naleng chan diu, kagam theng nalo ding'u ahi. Hiche thuhi nangman Israel mite heng'a naseipeh teiding ahi,” ati.
en_web: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
en_kjv: and ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

tcz: Chuin Mose molchung akon'in akumsuh'in Israel sung'a upa ho akou khom'in Pakaiyin a thupeh chengse abonchan a seipeh soh kei uve.
en_web: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.
en_kjv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the Lord commanded him.

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut cheh uvin, “Ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'a keihon kabol diu ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.
en_kjv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Keima naheng'a meilhang kiheh bang'a kahung ding, Nangma Mose kahin houpi teng Israel miten ajah cheh diu, chuteng amahon jong nangma nahin tahsan jing diu ahitai,” ati. Mose'n jong Israel miten adonbut'na chu Pakai heng'a aseijin ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Pakajin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang keima kahung nading'in Israel mite gongtup tan, tuni le jing nikhoa din seipeh uvin chule avon jeng u-jong kisop theng cheh u-hen,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

tcz: “Nithum lhin'nia ding'in kigontup sah soh kei uvin, nithum lhin niteng a mitmu tah uva Pakai chu Sinai Mol chung'a pat hung kumlha ding ahi tipeh'un,” ati.
en_web: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
en_kjv: and be ready against the third day: for the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

tcz: “Mipiho abonchauvin akimvel'uva melchih'na sempeh'in lang, seijin, kichih thei un! Koima molchung lam'a kaldoh hih hel'un chule akim vellah jeng jong koiman natham khah theilou diunahi. Koi hile molchung tham khachan chu thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

tcz: “Melchihna pal kallhah khut kiti phot'in atohkhah'a ahile, hichejeh'a chu; song'a selih jeng ding, ahilou jong le, thalpi'a kap lih ding gancha hihen mihem hile hitabang'a chonchu ahing'a kiumsah ngailou ding ahi, tin seipeh un. Sumkon ahung kimut gin apat mipi jong molchung lam'a hung kitol diu ahiye.”
en_web: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
en_kjv: there shall not a hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

tcz: Mose'n jong mipi lam chu ahin jonsuh tan. Aman mipi thenso'na anei jin, mipihon jong ama ama von cheh akisop theng uvin ahi.
en_web: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
en_kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

tcz: Aman mipi heng'a asei jin, Nithum lhin nia ding in ki gotup cheh uvin chule numei angsung ki tiajong na lut louhel ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
en_kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

tcz: Nithum lhin'ni jingkah khovah lam'in vahthamjol aki thing'in kolphe avah in, molchung vum chu meilhang'in atom lha jeng tan ahi. Sumkon hatah'in ahung ging tan ahile, ngahmun sung lam'a um mipi abonchauvin akicha lheh jeng tauve.
en_web: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

tcz: Mose'n jong mipi abonchan Pathen toh kimaito ding'in ahin pui uvin, chuin mipi abonchauvin molchung kipatna lam'a chun adding den gam tauve.
en_web: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
en_kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

tcz: Sinai molchung akon in Pakai chu meikong'in ahung kum lhan ahile, lhum sung'a kon'na meikhu bang'in ahung khudoh'in ahintomlha jeng tan, ling jong akihot lha jeng'in ahi.
en_web: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
en_kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

tcz: Sumkon gin chu ahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahile, Mose jong akipat'in hiti hin aseije, van gin kithong lah akon'in Pathen'in ahin houpin ahi.
en_web: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
en_kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

tcz: Pakai chu Sinai molchung vum'a kon'in ahung kumsuh tan chuin, Molchung vum'a kon'in Pakaiyin Mose ahin kouvin ahi. Mose jong akipatdoh'in molchung lam'a chun akal touvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
en_kjv: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang mipi heng'a seipeh loijin, ajeh chu Pakai ahinmu nomuva pal kigen khu ahin tumlhah ngai uva ahile thigam bep ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.

tcz: Chule thempu ho jeng jong atahsao amacheh kithenso uva eihin nailut thei diu bou ahi. Chutile Pakaiyin amaho lam pal chu atumkeh lou ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”
en_kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.

tcz: Mose'n jong Pakai heng'a aseijin, ahinlah Pakai in, mipi abonchauva Sinai molchung'a hung kal theilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangma thupeh bang'a molchung kimvella pal gen uvin, tia nei thupeh sa'u ahiye, ati.
en_web: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin. “Chesuh inlang Aaron gakipuiyin lang hinki lhon pitan. Amavang mipi abonchauvin thupeh neijin lang khat cha jeng jong paltum keh'a Pakai lam'a hung theilou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.

tcz: Pakajin athupeh bang in Mose achesuh in mipi ho heng'a aga seipeh soh kei uve.
en_web: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
en_kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin mipi heng'a thupeh hichengse hi anei in.
en_web: God spoke all these words, saying,
en_kjv: And God spake all these words, saying,

tcz: Keima na-Pakai u-leh na-Pathen chu kahi, Egypt gamsung'a nasoh chan nauva konna nalhatdoh pau chu keima kahi,” ati.
en_web: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
en_kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

tcz: “Keima tailou Pathen dang nanei louhel diu ahi.”
en_web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
en_kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

tcz: “Nang hon vannoi leiset hihen twikhanglen'a um thil hijong leh alim na semthu uva pathen lim'a naman theilou ding'u ahi.”
en_web: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
en_kjv: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

tcz: “Hicheng ho ang sung'a chu naboh khup louhel diu, ajeh chu keima, na-Pakaiyu-leh na-Pathen-u kahin pathen dang na kisem uva ahileh, keiman nangho heng'a ka lethuh diu napu na pate'u le nangma insung cheh chule a khang thumle li na channa lethuh ding kahi,” ati.
en_web: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
en_kjv: thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

tcz: “Keima thupeh nit jinga, eingailu mi chu asang aja chung'a kalungset nalong lou chu ka umsah jing ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
en_kjv: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

tcz: “Nangman Na-Pakai le Na-Pathen min jeng jong ajehbeija namin phah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Ama min ajehbeija minphah chung'a themmo achansah ding ahi.”
en_web: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

tcz: “Cholngah nikho hi atheng'a nanit jing ding ahiti, sumil hih hel'in.”
en_web: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
en_kjv: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

tcz: “Natoh ding cheng nigup sungse'a natoh chai ding,
en_web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
en_kjv: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

tcz: Ni sagi lhinni hi na-Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho, hiche nikhoa hi nangman natoh ima nabol louhel ding chule nangma nahin, nachapa, nachanu, na sohpa, na sohnu, na gancha jouse le na kelkot phung hungsung lha'a na kholjin mi naboncha uva ima natoh thei lou hel diuva ahiye.”
en_web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
en_kjv: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

tcz: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin nigup sungsen van le leiset, twikhanglen le asung'a umjouse ana sem in; hiche nikhoa chu Pakaiyin cholngah nikho hi phatthei aboh'a ana lhandohsa ahi tai,” ati.
en_web: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
