en_kjv: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

tcz: “Chule Pakai na-Pathen in napehsa hiche leiset chunga na hinkho asot thei na ding in nanu napa ging jing in.”
en_web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
en_kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

tcz: “Toltha nabol lou ding ahi.”
en_web: “You shall not murder.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not kill.

tcz: “Mitoh jon nabol lou ding.”
en_web: “You shall not commit adultery.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

tcz: “Guchat nabol lou ding.”
en_web: “You shall not steal.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not steal.

tcz: “Na sopi muda man'na thuse pole a napan lou ding.”
en_web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

tcz: “Na kinaipi khat inchen chu na thangsetpi lou ding ahi. Na sopi ji khat chu na deichat lou ding, chule asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin abong chal ahin, asangan hijong le na sopi chule na kinaipi koma thil ima navet lal lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
en_kjv: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

tcz: Mipihon van gin nasa tah chu aja tauvin, kolphe jeng jong amu tauvin, sumkon gin jing jong athong jeju jeng tan, molchung lam'a kon meikhu amukit tauvin ahile amaho chung'a kichatna alhung ta, chuin amahon anailut ngam tapouvin ahile gamlha tah'in aum den tauve.
en_web: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
en_kjv: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

tcz: “Chu in mipihon jong Mose heng'a asei tauvin, ‘Sei ding a na deisah chan keima ho heng'a seijeng tan, na sei kangai diu ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in keiho heng'a thu seikha taleh mohseh'a ka thi gam lhah jeng ding'u ahi!”
en_web: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
en_kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

tcz: “Mose'n a donbut uvin hiti hin aseiye, “Kicha hih un,” Pathen na gin diu chule na chonset thei lou na diuva, nangho sudet ding'a Pathen hung'a ahi joi!” ati.
en_web: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

tcz: “Meilhang kiheh muthim'in atom nalah Pathen angsung'a chun Mose ache lut tan ahile, mipi jong chu akicha uvin gamlha thimma chun ading densoh kei tauve.”
en_web: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
en_kjv: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche hi Isarel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin: vanna kon in nang ho toh kihouna kaneije, tihi na mit tah uvin namu tauve,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

tcz: “Geldoh jing un, ka masang'a dangka'a kijem patthen dang na sem louhel diu, dangka'a ki sem pathen dang kiti phot khat jeng cha jong nasem lou beh diu ahiye,” ati.
en_web: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
en_kjv: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

tcz: “Keima ding'in vannoi leiset na maicham khat nasem ding, hiche maicham chung'a chu pumgo thilto, chule chamna thilto jouse jaona kelngoi nou ahin, bongchal thilto a ding chengse jong na todoh ding, hoichan'na hijong le Keima geldoh jing'na ding'a naheng'a kahung jing ding phatthei ka chansah ding nahiye,” ati.
en_web: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
en_kjv: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

tcz: “Chule nangman song maicham kiti khat nasem ding'a ahile, hicha song naman chah ding chu kijem pol ding chule songchung'a chu khut themma thiljem najihlut ding kitup tah'a na koi ding ahiye.
en_web: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
en_kjv: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

tcz: “Maicham chungvum lam'a kalbi nado son ding chule nangma na sagohkeo jeng jong kimusah louva, ding-chang khenna na um ding ahiye,” ati.
en_web: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

tcz: “Hicheng se hi Israel mite chon'na ding dan ahiye.
en_web: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
en_kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

tcz: “Hebrew mi soh ding'a na choh teng le, amachun kumgup sungse'a sohna chu atoh jing ding, kumsagi ahung lhin teng vang le soh'a kivul michu chamlhat chang ding che ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
en_kjv: If thou buy a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

tcz: “Soh'a pangpa chu amachang seh seh bou ahileh, amabou kile ding Chule, jineisa ahi khah tah le, ajinu jaona anilhon'na kilhon doh lhon ding ahi.”
en_web: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
en_kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

tcz: “Hiche sohpa chu apupan ji aholpeh'a ahile, achate sese leh sohpa jinu chu apupa chang ding, ajona teng le sohpa chu achang seh'a che ding ahi.”
en_web: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
en_kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

tcz: Ahinlah sohpa chu hitia asei ding, ka pupa ahin ka jinu chule ka chate abonchauvin kalha ngaijin,’ chamlhat chang din che da jeng ing'e tia aseija,
en_web: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
en_kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

tcz: Hichepa chu apupan Pathen heng'a ahin puiding, hiche asohpa chu kotphung gei hihen kotphung khom chang hijongh leh ahin puija, chuteng apupan thihtul khat'a asohpa bilkol a vuhom peh ding, hiche teng chule sohpa chun nilhum keija apupa kin'a kisa lal ding ahiye.
en_web: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
en_kjv: then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

tcz: Pasal khat bang chun achanu soh ding'a akijoh doh ding'a ahile, amanu chu soh pasal ho bang'a kisol doh lou ding ahi.
en_web: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
en_kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

tcz: Hiche sohnu chun apupa lunglhaina mong mong aboldoh jou lou ding'a ahile, apupan jong mi dang akilhat doh sah thei jeng ding, apupan hiche sohnu chu kitahna nei louvin anabol tan ahile amanu chu apupan jong gamchom ma joh doh son nading ima agel lou ding ahi.
en_web: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
en_kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche sohnu chu apupan achapa sohnu a pang ding a agella ahile amanu chu achanu ngai ngai banga bol ding ahiye.”
en_web: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
en_kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

tcz: “Ibang khat a achapa chun amading'a ji achom akipui khah tah a ahile, sohnu chu aji hina'a an-neh ding, sil-le-chen ding leh athaneina ima asuhnem peh chom lou ding ahi.”
en_web: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
en_kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

tcz: “Asohnu dinga chu hicheng thum hochu abolpeh louva ahile, asohnu chun bat ima neilouva sum jong pelouva adalhah jeng thei ding ahi.”
en_web: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
en_kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

tcz: “Khat touvin midang chun'a akhut alha khah'a ahile, akhut lhapa chu tha teitei ding ahi.”
en_web: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
en_kjv: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

tcz: “Ahinlah kihetkhelna maimaija konna ahile, hichu Pathen in amosah lou ding, keiman nangma munding kasem pehsa nahiye atia ahile hiche laimuna chu mivolihpa jamlut'a kihuh hing thei ding ahi.”
en_web: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
en_kjv: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

tcz: “Amavang, khat touvin aloipa hamkhat chu atha jeng'a ahile, hiche mithat pachu keima maicham phung'a konna tha ding'a napuidoh ding ahi, ati.”
en_web: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
en_kjv: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

tcz: “Koi hile, anuham apa ham vo'a achung'a khut lha aumma ahile ama chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
en_web: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
en_kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

tcz: “Mihem gumang aum'a, amiguhpa bang chu ana johdoh tah'a chule akomma ana um nah laiya, akomma aum pet hichu amatoh kimudoh khom hijong leh, akimu doh pachu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
en_web: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
en_kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

tcz: “Koiman anu apa a engbol thei lou ding amavang anu engbol mihem chu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
en_web: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
en_kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

tcz: “Tun, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah a, khatpan jong khat pachu song tum'a asuh ham akhut tumma akhet hamma ahile hiche amisuh pachu thipei dehlouva ahile jalkhun anga ding ahi.”
en_web: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
en_kjv: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

tcz: “Ahinlah alhupa chu ahung kitho doh'a tenggol mangcha a ava le theiya ahile, ama anasukhapa chu achungchang kisutheng thei ding, anat nasung'a aki jenna phat mansah chengse alepeh ding chule ajen dam sel ding ahiye.”
en_web: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
en_kjv: if he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

tcz: “Mihem khat touvin asohpa ham asohnu ham chung'a khut alha'a athikhah a ahile, soh neipa chu thina chang ding ahiye.”
en_web: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
en_kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche soh kijep penchu nikhat ahilou le nini sung'a adam theng tah'a ahile, sohchung'a khut lha mihem chu thina chang lou ding ahiye. Ajeh chu soh kivul michu ama nei gou khat ahi.”
en_web: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

tcz: “Tun tekah nan, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah tan, numei naovop lai chu asuh khah tah lhonna anaovop chu kisuhmo'a aphat louva ahungpot doh khah tah le, numeinu suhkha penpen chu ajipan jong anop channa aman adel khum jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah apeh ding chengse chu thutan vaihom hon aphatsah peh'u angaiye.”
en_web: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
en_kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

tcz: “Amavang numeinu kisuklhahna khonung'a ahung nat khat tah ahile: hiche hinkho khel ding'a chu hin kho khat ma lepeh ding ahi.”
en_web: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
en_kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

tcz: Mitchang khella michang hiding, haa khella haa hiding, khut khel la khut hiding, keng khel la kengg na peh ding ahi,
en_web: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
en_kjv: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

tcz: Meiyin akah'a ahile meikah jeh'a meiya nale peh ding, kimavo jeh'a namavoa chule kijep jeh'a chu nale jep jeng ding ahi, ati.
en_web: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
en_kjv: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

tcz: “Mihem koitobang khat chun asohpa ahilou leh asohnu ham mit asuh khah peh'a ahile, hiche soh chu amit adam loutah jeh'a chamlhat ding'a asol doh jeng ding ahiye.”
en_web: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
en_kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

tcz: “Soh goiya pang pan jong asohnu ham, asohpa ham khat achu ahaa asuhlhoi peh a hile, ahaa asuh lhopipeh tah jeh'a hiche sohpa ham sohnu ham chu chmalhat chansah ding'a asol doh ding ahitai.”
en_web: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
en_kjv: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

tcz: “Bongchal khattou vin numei ham pasal ham khat chu aki'a ahin pihlih khah'a ahile, hiche bongchal chu song'a selih jeng ding ahiye. Amavang bongsa chu koiman aneh theilou ding chuteng bong neipa ding'a achungchang thu kisutheng ahitai,” ati.
en_web: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
en_kjv: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang kisanna mihem dang ana pihlih sa ahileh, aneipa jeng'in jong anahsah lou ahitah leh, hiche bongchal in jong numei ham pasal ham chu aki a apihlih khah'a ahileh, bongchal chu thadoh jeng ding chule aneipa jeng jong anigel la tha teitei lhon ding ahiye.”
en_web: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
en_kjv: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

tcz: Amavang athipa chu longlhat na ding'a aki peh doh'a ahile, aki pehdoh sah jatchu aman jong long lhatna ding'a apeh ding ahi.”
en_web: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
en_kjv: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

tcz: “Hiche bongchal chun numei ham pasal ham khat ahin peh lih khah bang le, hiche gancha neipa chu dan kisem dungjuija kitham gah ding ahi.”
en_web: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
en_kjv: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

tcz: “Bongchal chun soh numeija pang ham pasal ham khat chu ahin pihlih bang leh, bongchal neipan jong sohneipa chu dangka shekel somthum apeh teitei ding chule hiche bongchal chu song'a aselih pai jeng ding ahi.”
en_web: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
en_kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

tcz: “Tekah nan mikhat chun kokhuh khah bit louva adalhah jeng'a chule hiche kokhuh sin kikhah bit louva adalhah'a sangan ham bongchal ham kokhuh'a alhah lut'a athi den tah'a ahileh,
en_web: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
en_kjv: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

tcz: “Kokhuh neipan jong aphat toh kitoh chatna asem phat ding, gancha neipa jong sum apeh ding, a gancha pohlih vang chu ama chang ding ahi.”
en_web: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
en_kjv: the owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

tcz: “Mihem khat bongchal chun mi dang khat bongchal a suhkhah a asuh khah bongchal chu athi jeng'a ahile, bong nei ten jong hiche bong chal athinai louchu akijoh doh diu aki johdohna man vang chu kihom lhon ding, hiche bongchal thisa jeng jong chu aman kihom lhon ding ahi.”
en_web: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
en_kjv: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang jeng'ajong gancha dang ana pihlih jeng'a ahile, aneipa jeng in jong ahilchahsa ahi a chule ngaisah'a akoi louva ahile, anei pan jong bongchal thi chu bongchal khat mama'a alesah ding, bongchal thisa vang chu ama chang teitei ding ahiye.”
en_web: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
en_kjv: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

tcz: Mikhat touvin bongchal ham kelngoi ham aguhdoh'a hichu akitha ham ahilouleh akijoh doh'a ahile bongchal khat jat chu bongchal nga'a ale ding, chule kelngoi khat man dia kelngoi li alepeh ding ahi.
en_web: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
en_kjv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

tcz: Gucha chun jankah a inbang aphetvang jeh'a ama chu akimatna aki vohlih khah tah'a ahileh, hiche guchapa hinkho that pachu tolthat a kisim lou ding ahi.
en_web: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
en_kjv: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche thisoh hi sun khovah pet ahi leh vang mithat pachu tolthat a kisim ding ahi. “Ajeh chu gucha kiman chun, athil guhdoh jouse aboncha alesah kit ding ahin, a le sah joulouva ahi leh ama chu kijoh doh a athil guh ho sahna a kinei ding ahi.”
en_web: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
en_kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

tcz: Khat touvin bongchal hihen lang, Sangan hihen, Kelcha hi jong leh aguh doh sa khat ama insung neilegou lah'a aga kimatdoh khah a ahileh ajat leni'a asah kit ding ahi.
en_web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
en_kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

tcz: Mihem koihile loulaija gancha alut sah'a lengpi lei ham khat gasoh aneh khah'a ahileh gancha chingtup louva loulaija alha thang jeh'a hichepa chun aloulaija gasoh phapen achu a lepeh teitei ding ahiye.
en_web: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
en_kjv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

tcz: Chule Loulai meiyin ahinkah khah'a ling le khao leilah ahin kah jeng'a, chang aki at-lai leh a ki-at loulai mun lah chule loulai chu akah vam lhah jeng tah'a ahile, meihal kong pen pen chun akahvam cheng se aboncha ale sah cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en_web: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
en_kjv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

tcz: Tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akoma sum ham thil khat koiding'a angensea ahile, hiche thil chu akoipa insung'a konna aki guhmang khah tah'a ahile hiche gucha pachu akimat matna'a athil guh chengse aboncha ajat nia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
en_web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
en_kjv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

tcz: Amavang hiche guchapa chu akimat doh kha tah louva ahile athil koipa chu alah ham alou ham ti hetchetna ding'a Pathen ang sung'a kipui lut ding ahiye.”
en_web: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.
en_kjv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

tcz: Ajeh chu kitahsan lelna chung chang kiti phot'a chu bongchal chung chang hihen, sangan chung chang hihen, kelngoi chule ponsil thua hijong le thil kiman sah chung chang thua khat touvin, “Hiche hi keima thil ahi”, hiche hi keima thil ahi titeni chung'a achu athem joh pen hetchetna ding'a Pathen ama-angsung'puilut’a umlhon ding ahi. Amani chu koipen themmo nachang'a Pathen angsung'a konna hetchet ahiteng ajatnia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
en_web: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
en_kjv: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

tcz: Tun tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akom khat ngansena aneija sangan ahilou le bongchal ham kelngoi ham gancha khat pen pen apeh a ahile, hichu koima muphah nalou munkhat'a akidel mang tai.”
en_web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
en_kjv: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

tcz: Hitia chu aumkhah tah le ani gellhon na Pakai angsung'a kihahselna anei lhon ding ahi. Chu teng gancha neipan jong kihahselna chu anganse jeng ding hiche gancha chu asah lou ding ahi tai.”
en_web: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
en_kjv: then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

tcz: Ahinlah akoipa akonna kigumang anahi khah tah le, gancha koipan aneipa chu phatecha alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
en_kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

tcz: Gamsa hang in atha khah ahitah le hiche hetchetna chu gancha koipan jong avetsah ding, chu teng gancha koipan asah tah lou ding ahi.
en_web: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
en_kjv: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

tcz: Mi khat touvin asopi khat koma gancha vaiding'a alah ham ahilou leh manchah ding hamma alah'a hiche gancha chu akisuh khah, ahilou leh athi khah tah'a ahile, hiche vang chu bat'a lapan aman phatah'a lepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en_web: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
en_kjv: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

tcz: Ahinlah aneipa umpet toh aki tokhah'a ahile alapa chun asah tah lou ding, manpeh ding'a avai ahi jong le avaiman toh akito sah cheh cheh ding ahitai.”
en_web: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
en_kjv: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be a hired thing, it came for his hire.

tcz: Pasal toh ki hepha loulai nungah khat chu pasal khat in ajol lhah'a alupi khah'a ahile, Pasal pan jong hiche nungahnu man chu apeh ding chuteng jia anei pai ding ahi.
en_web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
en_kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

tcz: Ahinlah nungahnu pan achanu chu hiche pasalpa chu apeh nom hih beh jeng'a ahileh, a lupkhom pipa chun nungah thengho man ki khum peh jat jat bang'a apeh ding ahiye.”
en_web: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
en_kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

tcz: Nangman numei doithem kiti jong na tha jeng ding ahiye.
en_web: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

tcz: Chule koi hijong le gancha toh lumkhom kitiphot chu tha jeng ding ahiye.
en_web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
en_kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Koi hijong leu chun Pakai kom tailouva kilhaina dang nei mihem chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
en_web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
en_kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

tcz: Maljin kiti chu adih louva na bol louhel ding, na suhgenthei lou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsung'a maljin ana hisa na hiuve.
en_web: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Meithai le chaga jeng jong nangailut ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
en_kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

tcz: Amaho na suhgim uva ahile amaho ka heng lama hung diu chuteng keiman amaho taona ka san ding ahi, ati.
en_web: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
en_kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

tcz: Chuteng ka lungsatna na chung uva hung lhung ding najiteo kasat lhuh gamdiu, nacha teo chaga kisoh gam ding ahiuve, ati.
en_web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
en_kjv: and my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

tcz: Chule na heng na kom'a um ka mite khat tou sum le pai na bat sah ahile, vaichapa chung'a chun sumkol vei tabang'in umdan lang, sum tong jeng jong ama chung'a chu nadel khum lou hel ding ahiye.
en_web: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
en_kjv: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

tcz: Naheng nakom ponsil khat tou tundoh ding'a nalah'a ahile, nisa leplhah masang'a hiche ponsil chu aneipa na ga lepeh ding ahi.
en_web: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
en_kjv: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hiche bou chu tahsa ponsilla anei ahin, pondang silla imutpi ding anei louva ahin ipi pon akisil ding ham? Keima heng'a hungtao khata henlang hile keiman amachu kangaipeh teitei ding ahi ajeh chu keima hi milainat pi jing kahi,” ati.
en_web: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
en_kjv: for that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

tcz: Pathen dou mah nasei thei lou ding chule namite lah'a vaihompa jeng jong gaosapna nabol lou ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

tcz: Na lhosoh ga le na lengpi gasoh chengse chu lungopkaina neilou hel'a nakat doh jing ding, nachapate lah'a apeng masapen chu keima ding'a na todoh ding ahi, ati.
en_web: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

tcz: Na bongchal le na kelngoi jeng jong hitia chu nabol ding, hiche gancha nou chu nisagi sung'a ahonsung umden jeng ding, ahinlah niget lhin niteng le keima neipeh doh ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
en_kjv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

tcz: Nangman jouthu na sei thei lou ding, muda jeh'a thet umtah hettohsah'a napan thei lou ding ahiye.
en_web: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

tcz: Chule thilse bolding'a mihem chele hojong najui a najop lou hel ding, mipi nung najui louva amaho khat le khat kikah'a them achan theina diuva jong hettohsah'a napan lou ding ahiye.”
en_web: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

tcz: Vaichaho thukitanna jeng ajong pan nalah lou hel ding, sih neina lang neina jeng jong nabol lou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
en_kjv: neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

tcz: Chule na melma khat sangan ahi loule bongchal vah mang jong nadon peh lou ding, hiche gancha chu ama heng'a nahin le kailut peh joh ding ahi.
en_web: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
en_kjv: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

tcz: Nangma doumah bolpa sangan in apot apoh lal tah'a aopkhum ma ahile hichu, na dalhah jeng lou ding, sangan akitho doh theina ding'a na panhu teitei ding ahi joi.
en_web: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
en_kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

tcz: Vaicha thutanna'a adinmunanna konna achanding dolla thudih chu napam paipeh lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

tcz: Jouthu phot'a kinilna le kihehtona chu najam san jeng ding, themmona beija mihem chu natha lou ding, ajeh chu keiman kahenai agiloupa chu them kachan sah him him lou ding ahiye.
en_web: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
en_kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

tcz: Nehguh chahguh jong nakilah thei lou ding, ajeh chu nehguh kitihi vaihomma pangpan amit asel mang jin chule adih'a pangte chu akhup athal'a alekhup jeng ahi.
en_web: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
en_kjv: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

tcz: Kholjin mijong na suhgim lou ding, ajeh chu kholjin mihon ichanna lunggel nei uvem ti na hetauve, amaho bang chu nanngho jong Egypt gamma khol jin mi'a nanaum'u ahiye.
en_web: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Kum gup sung'a phatah'a na gam sung'a ann-ga natu ding, muchi gasoh na kilokhom ding ahi.
en_web: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
en_kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

tcz: Kum sagi alhin teng hiche kum sung'a chu nagamsung nakicholdo sahding hiche nangma miten avaicha ho chun aneh diu, louna tong lou beh'a naki chol damsah thei ding, amahon aneh joulou aneh moh chengseo vang chu gamsa hon aneh diuva ahitai. Hiche bang bang'a chu lengpi leilai le Olive chu nabol cheh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
en_kjv: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

tcz: Nigup sung'a hi natoh ding chan natoh ding, chule ni sagi lhinni vang le nasangan jeng jong na choldam sah ding, na bongchal ahin sangan jeng jong choldo thei ding, na sohnu chapa ahin na jin ho jong ki chol do thei diu ahi.
en_web: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
en_kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

tcz: Naheng uva kasei doh hi nanit jeng jing diu, chule hichengse hi nakam sung uva jong napotdoh sah lou hel diu ahi.
en_web: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
en_kjv: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

tcz: Kumkhat sung'a keima dinga kut thumvei chan nabol ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
en_kjv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

tcz: Chol solou chang-lhah kut, keiman phat katepeh dung juiya hi ding, Abib* lhasung hichu cholsolou changlhah ni sagi sung sea naneh ding hiche lhasung'a hi Egypt gamsung'a kon'a na hung doh na lha ahiye. Hijeh achu khat cha jong keima angsung'a khut goh keuva hung sung lha thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
en_kjv: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:

tcz: Loulaija na lhosoh ga amasapen penchu nangman lholhun kut'a ding'a na kat doh jeng ding, hi tabang ma chu lou lai pumpia na lhosoh ga nahin chop khom teng jong le kut nabol ding ahi.”
en_web: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
en_kjv: and the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

tcz: Kum khat sung'a namite holah'a pasal'a kai lhah kiti phot chu Pakai Pathen keima ansung'a thumvei hung ki lah cheh diu ahi.”
en_web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
en_kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.

tcz: Keima angsung'a kilhaina gancha kithat chu cholsosa changlhah jaona nahin totha thei lou ding, kaheng'a kilhaina sathao jeng jong khovah geija nakoi den lou ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

tcz: Na leiset ga soh lah'a gamasa pen pen chu na Pakai na Pathen heng'a na hin poh lut masat pen ding, kelngoi sakithat jeng jong chu api noitwi mangcha'a nahon lou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
en_kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

tcz: Ven! Na chena channa nangma na ventup ding le na lhon pijing ding'in namasang lama vantil khat ka sol peh in ahi.”
en_web: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
en_kjv: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

tcz: Vantil khu jabol'in lang, athu napal keh thei louding, ama doumah thei himhim nabol lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu aman nasuhkhel channu ngaidam intin, ajeh chu amasung'a khu keima min um jeng'a ahi.
en_web: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
en_kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

tcz: Aman aseichan lunglut tah'a nangai jing ding, keiman kasei chan nabol'a ahile, namel mate dia melma'a kapan ding, nadoute ding'a adouva pang ding kahi, ati.
en_web: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
en_kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

tcz: Ka Vantil chu namasang lama lamkai jing ding, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Canaan mite, Hivi mite, chule Jebus mite jouse abonchaova nahin pui teng leh keima tah in abonchauva ka suhmang hel jeng ding ahi, ati.
en_web: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
en_kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

tcz: Chule mihem in asem thu milim doi pathen ho masang kitia naboh khup lou ding, hicheho ding'a jong chu na kisahlal louhel ding, anatoh bang bang uva jong ima natoh thei lou ding aboncha na phuhlhuh ding, a songkhom tincheng jong na lekhup jeng ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

tcz: Na boncha uva na Pakai Na Pathen nahou uva ama kin jeng na bol diu ahi.” Na boncha uva na Pakai na Pathen kin jeng a na kisah lel diu, amatah in na changlhah neh diu le na twidon ding jing ujong phatthei aboh ding, chu teng keiman na jalah uva konna phatthei nasa tah ka hin boh ding ahi, ati.”
en_web: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
en_kjv: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

tcz: Nangma gamsung achu koima aching kal val jong um thei lou ding, ama vang nangma hinkho chu ka suh bukim sel joh ding ahi.
en_web: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
en_kjv: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

tcz: Na masang tinna mihem ten aki chat thei chan ka ma sol peh ding, kidoupi ding'a nahin tupchan lungsung kasuh mol peh jing ding, chuteng nangma nahin doute jamcheh diu nangma nung lam jeng'a bou khodah diu ahi.
en_web: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
en_kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

tcz: Na masang'a khoi-ngel te kalha masat peh ding, Hivi mite, Canaan mite, Hit mie abonchauva khoingel ten a delmang hel diu ahi.
en_web: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
en_kjv: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

tcz: Na masang'a vang amahochu kumkhat sung'a kadel cheh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu gamsung ahomkeu va aum khah le gamsa hungpung lha jeng ding gamsa ten nagma nahin dou khah diuva ahi.
en_web: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
en_kjv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

tcz: Nangma na hung pun be jing ding, chuteng amaho khu aloiloija ka del cheh ding ahiuve, ati.
en_web: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
en_kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

tcz: Na gam gi chu twisan dung len aki pat Palistinete twikhanglen chan hop'a ka kaipeh ding, gamang lah akipat Euphrates vadung channa kakai peh ding nahiye, ajeh chu hiche gamsung ana lo jouse keiman nangho khut a kapeh doh ding, amaho chu nangman jong nadelcheh jeng diu ahiye, ati.
en_web: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
en_kjv: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

tcz: Amite jouse lah hihen a semthu uva pathen hijong le kitepna neocha jong nanei theilou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
en_kjv: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

tcz: Amaho jouse khu khat jeng cha jong na gamsung'a cheng thei loudiu ahi, ahinlah amaho pathen lim sem thuho kin nabol khah ngai ngaiya ahile vang, hichea chu nasatah'a nangma na kipel lhuh ding ahi, ati.
en_web: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
en_kjv: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, Pakai heng lama hung kal touvin nagma chule Aaron chule Nadab ahin, Abihu chule Isarel upate mi som sagi jong jaonan na boncha uva na hung diu ahiye. Gamlha thimma kon in chibai nahin boh diu ahi, ati.
en_web: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
en_kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

tcz: Mose bouseh Pakai heng'a hung lut thei ding, adangse vang khat'a khat cha jong Pakai heng na hin nailut thei lou diu ahiye, hitia chu Mose le mipi aboncha hung kilhon lut thei lou ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
en_kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

tcz: Chuin Mose jong akum suh tan Pakaiyin apeh chonna dan thu abonchan mipi ho heng'a aseipeh soh keiyun ahi. Mipin jong ki thutoh tah'in awkhat in adonbut uvin asei uve, “Pakaiyin asei chan chu aboncha kabol diu ahi,” tin asei uve.
en_web: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”
en_kjv: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.

tcz: Mose in jong Pakai thupeh chengse abonchan a sundoh soh keiyin, jingkah matah in athou doh in, molsang chung lama chu Israel phungsom leni bang bang chun, Maicham a keng somleni neikhat asem doh tan ahi.
en_web: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
en_kjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

tcz: Mose'n jong Israel te lah'a gollhang sese a sol tan, ama hon abonchauvin Pakaiya din pumgo thil to ahin choi cheh tauvin ahi.
en_web: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.
en_kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.

tcz: Mose'n jong thisan phabep pi chu athal in, twibel sung ho achun asung lut in ahi. Chule thisan kehlang khatse chu maicham maija a chap khum in ahi.”
en_web: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
en_kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong kitepna lekhabu chu ahin choiyin mipi angsung'a chun ahin phongdoh tan ahile, mipi'n jong abonchauvin asei uvin, “Pakaiyin a sei chan aboncha ka bol kimsoh kei uva, chule keiho hin asei chan kangai uva pha tah a ka umdiu ahi” tin asei uve.
en_web: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”
en_kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong thisan phasah khat alan mipiho chu achap khum uvin, aseipeh taove, “vetaovin, Thu kisei doh chengse toh ki saiya Pakaiyin nangho dia hiche thisan hi kitepna asem ahi” ati.
en_web: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”
en_kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

tcz: Hi chengse a kichai jin, Mose, Aaron, Nadab chule abihu jaonan, Israel mite lah'a upa som sagi chu akal tou taovin ahi.
en_web: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
en_kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

tcz: Abonchauvin Israel mite Pathen chu aga mu tauvin, Pathen keng phang noiya chun Sapphire song jeng keng lampi khat ana um in, athen dan jong van chung vum kihohsel la theng bep bep'in ana um in ahi.
en_web: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
en_kjv: and they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel mite chung'a chun doumah abol tapon, Pathen loupina chu nasa tah'in amu tauvin ahile, anneh jong phatah in aki sem un ane uve.
en_web: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
en_kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei peh in, Molsang chung lama khun keima heng'a hung kal in lang, hiche laimunna chun neina ngah tem in, keiman mipiho heng'a chonna dan ka sei peh chan chu hiche song puma khu ka peh tha ding na hitai, ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

tcz: Mose jong achetan, alhacha Joshua chu akipuije, chuin Pathen molsang chung lama chun akal tou tan ahi.
en_web: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
en_kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

tcz: Mose'n jong upa ho heng'a seipeh uvin, “Kei ni naheng uva ka hung kile kit kahse lhona hiche laimun na hi nana umjing diu ahi, Aaron le Hur vang nangho toh na umkhom jing diu, nalah uva koi hile seinom nei chan Amani heng'a che a aga sei ding ahiye, ati.
en_web: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
en_kjv: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

tcz: Mose jong molsang lama akaltoutan ahile mei lhang in mol chu ahin tomlha jeng tan ahi.
en_web: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
en_kjv: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

tcz: Hichun Pakai loupina chu Sinai molsang chung'a ahung kingam jeng tan ahile, nigup sungse hiche molsang chu meilhang in atom in athim lha jeng tai, nisagi lhin nin meibol abonchan ahung kihoh doh tan ahile Pakaiyin Mose ahin kou vin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
en_kjv: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

tcz: Molsang chung vumma Pakai loupina ahung kilah jeng chu Israel mite jouse mitmun jong meikong in thil akah vam tabang in amu tauvin ahiye.
en_web: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

tcz: Mose chu Meibang kiheh lah a chun ache lut tan ahile, Mose jong molsang chung vum lama chun nisom li le jan som li a hung umden tan ahi.
en_web: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
en_kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse heng'a seipeh inlang, keima henglam'a thilto ding adon khom diu, amichang cheh keima ding'a thiltoh doh nom chan in thil hin dong khom cheh uhen, ati.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

tcz: Israel chate jouse'a konna na don diu thil ho chu hicheng hi hiding ahite: “Sana, dangka, chule sum eng hiding ahi.
en_web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
en_kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

tcz: A eng-dup, asan dup, asan thim, ho leh kelcha vun hose hiding,
en_web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
en_kjv: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

tcz: Chule aki jut jolsa kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun jao nan thinggi thing hi ding ahiye.
en_web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
en_kjv: and rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

tcz: Thaomei hoa manchah ding thaotwi jong, kinujol nading thao twi tah jaona hi ding ahi.
en_web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
en_kjv: oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

tcz: Thempu in aki-O ding leh alengkou chung a a kikhai ding song mantam chu hi ding ahi.
en_web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
en_kjv: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

tcz: Chujou teng Israel mite lailung a ka chenna ding muntheng tah khat na sem doh ding ahi.
en_web: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
en_kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell amongst them.

tcz: Houbuh le asunga thilkeo ding ho aboncha ka vet sah ding hiche dung jui'a chu na bol diu ahiye, ati.
en_web: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
en_kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

tcz: Israel miten thinggi thing mangcha'a thingkong khat asem diu hichu, adung tongni, tong keh khatna sao hi ding, avai tongkhat le tongkeh'a sao chu asem ding u ahiye.
en_web: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
en_kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

tcz: Thingkong chu asung ahin apo sana a natom jol ding, agei gol jong sana a natom jol ding ahi.
en_web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

tcz: Hiche thingkong'a manchah ding achu sana chao kol li nalhah jun ding, chaokol ni chu thingkong pang lang khat'a akeng teni chung'a na khai ding, khat teni machu alang khat teni chung'a na khai lhah ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

tcz: Nangman thinggi chu mol lhon ni tah nasui ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu anigella sana twiya natom jolsel ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

tcz: Hiche mol lhon teni chu kong putna kimang thing ahin hichu apang lang khat'a chaokol teni sung'a chu nathol lut cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

tcz: Mol lhon teni chu thingkong pang a chaokol ki khai lha teni sung'a chu aputna dia kikhai den jing ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu koi macha gache a aga sut lhah lou hel ding ahiye.
en_web: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
en_kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

tcz: Hiche thingkong sung keiman ka peh ding hettoh sahna chu na khum lut ding ahi, ati.
en_web: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the Testimony which I shall give thee.

tcz: Sana touna chu na lah ding hiche a chu ngailut hepi touna khat na sem doh ding, hichu avai tongkhat le tong keh'a hi ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

tcz: Nangman jong sana cherub ni nasem ding hichu ngailut hepi touna among lang tenia nakhet beh ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

tcz: Amang lang khat'a ding chu cherub khat nasem teitei ding, ngailut hepi touna among lama ding'a na boncha uva Cherub nasem cheh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
en_kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

tcz: Cherub lha teni chung ani gel'a a chunglam angat lhon ding, alhate nichun ani gel'a ngailut hepi touna chu alekhu teitei lhon ding ahi.
en_web: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
en_kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

tcz: Hiche mun na chu keiman nang ka hin kimu peding, Ngailut hepi touna le hettoh sahna thingkong chung'a um Cherub teni kikah achu keiman Israel chate ding'a thil man lutah ka sei ding hichu keiman thu peh'a kapeh ding nahiye, ati.
en_web: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the Testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

tcz: Thinggi thing na manchah ding hichu dokhang khat na sem ding, adung tong nia sao hi ding, avai lang tong khat hi ding, atun tong khat le akeh sao hi ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
en_kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

tcz: Hiche dokhang chu sana thengsella phatah'a natom khum ding, apam jouse aboncha sana keu seh'a natom peh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

tcz: Dokhang kim vel'a chu a kol'a kiveithei ding ban jang toh ki bang'a lenkhat na kaikol ding, hiche akim vel'a kivei kol jong chu sana'a kijem lhah ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

tcz: Dokhang'a manchah ding sana chaokol li nasem ding, hiche chaokol li chu dokhang keng ningli hosea chu naba peh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

tcz: Dokhang kol kimvel chule chaokol hose chu kimatsoh kei ding, dokhang chu akijon teng le hiche chaokol ho achu thing jol thil lut ding chu teng kipuding ahi.
en_web: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
en_kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

tcz: Thinggi thing phatah'a moljol phasah pikhat nasui nam ding hichengse chu sana'a natom jol ding, moljol hosese chu dokhang jon na le a kimang ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

tcz: Lheng kong phasah pikhat na koi ding, lengpi twi sunlut nathei lheng le hai khat jong nakoi tha ding ahiye; hichu aboncha sana a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

tcz: Hiche bang bang'a chu nangman jong keima ka umjing nai ti photchetna ding'a dokhang chung'a keima changlhah na koi jing ding ahi, ati.
en_web: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

tcz: Sana keu seh'a kisem thaomei khom khat nasem ding, thaomei tunna ding'a akhom chu sehcha'a na khet beh ding, akhon hose le alu langse chule pahcha a kijem chengse aboncha thakhat chat'a kigom khom ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

tcz: Thaomei phung ajet le avei apat abah gup hung um doh ding, thaomei pang lang khat a abah thum hung um doh ding chule khat lang'a ma chu abah thum hung kisep doh ding ahi.
en_web: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
en_kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

tcz: Hiche abah khat cheh apat chu thingga jom'a kisem doh bang'a khon thum chule aluchang umdoh ding, hichea pahcha jouse jong jaonan, hiti chun thaomei phung'a kon chun abah ahung jam doh'in ahi.
en_web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
en_kjv: three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

tcz: Thaomei khomjong chu thingga ajom bang bang'a kisem khon li ahin alulam jaonan apahcha jouse chutoh ajao vin ahi.
en_web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
en_kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

tcz: Thaomei phung'a kon hung jamdoh abah gup chengse chu aluchang lamtoh thakhat chat'a hung soh doh tha ding ahiye.
en_web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
en_kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

tcz: A lulam se ho chu toh thaomei chu thakhat chat'a hung um ding, thaomei pumpi chu sehcha a kideng toh chet chet hiding, hichu sana theng sel'a kimang cha hiding ahi.
en_web: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
en_kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

tcz: Hichea det kong ding'a thaomei sagi na sem ding, amalam salvah dia hiche thaomei sagi ho chu tun doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

tcz: Amei kong at tan na ding choi che ahin adop na kong tong aboncha sana twiya kisem jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
en_kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

tcz: Hichea kimangcha thilkeo jouse chu aboncha sana thengset a kisem cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
en_kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

tcz: Ven! hiche ho jouse hi aboncha molsang chunga alim nakimusah bang bang a nasem doh ding ahi, ati.
en_web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
en_kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

tcz: Nangman nasah ding houbuh chu tupet pon'a kikhong hiding, pondal som khat'a nasah ding, pondum chule pon pol them naman khom ding, pondal chengse chu Cherub ho lim hoitah'a kisem bang'a nakhai cheh cheh ding'u ahiye. Hichengsea chu houbuh nasah ding ahi.
en_web: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
en_kjv: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

tcz: Pondal tinchang chu adung tong som ni le tong get'a len le sao hiding, pondal khat cheh vang chu tong li cheh hiding, pondal kiti phot aboncha adung avai alet le aneo dan kibang cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en_web: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
en_kjv: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

tcz: Pondal nga chengse vang chu kigom soh keiding chule alang khat'a pondal nga jong chu kigom soh kei ding ahi.
en_web: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
en_kjv: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

tcz: Pondal masa chengse chu aninggol hoa akol kol'a tampi patdum'a nasem ding, hichebang bang'a chu pondal gol niloilah'a apam nung pen pondal gol lah'a chu abil nasut hom ding akol kola tampi nasem doh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

tcz: Pondal kimkhat chu abil navu hom pehding akol kol somnga nasem peh ding, chule pondal kolni lhinna gollah ajong abil navu ding akoljong somnga jen nasem peh ding ahi. Akol navu hom chengse chu amacheh lhing'a toding ahi.
en_web: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
en_kjv: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

tcz: Sana kol somnga nasem ding, hiche sana sumkol ho achu pondal chengse chu na kaimat cheh cheh ding, chuteng houbuh thil hojouse kigom khomma houbuh khat'a nasah doh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

tcz: Houbuh chung khuna ding nangman kelcha mul'a kikhong pon phabep naman chah ding, agoma ding'a pondal somle khat nasem ding ahiye.
en_web: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

tcz: Pondal khat'a tongsom'a sao hi ding chule avai tong li cheh hiding, hiche pondal som le khat se chu aboncha alet le aneo dan kibang chet ding ahi.
en_web: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
en_kjv: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

tcz: Pondal ngaho vang chu nakil mat soh kei ding, adang pondal gup jong na kilmat soh keiya, agup channa pondal vang chu ponbuh maiya chu na khu ding ahi.
en_web: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
en_kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

tcz: “Chule pondal golmasa pen chu apam chin lah'a akol somnga jen nasem ding, pondal golni channa jong chu aning gol hoa akol somnga mama navu hom ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

tcz: Nangman sum eng somnga jen na sem ding, sumkol hose chu aboncha pondal kol navu hom hoa chu nathil lut ding, ajeh chu ponbuh chu khatseh'a akitun doh na ding'a na kaimat soh kei ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

tcz: Chule ponbuh'a pondal amoh chengse chu, houbuh ponbuh nunglama chu nakailhah sah cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
en_kjv: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

tcz: Ponbuh kisahna'a amoh chengse ho chu alang khat'a hihen khat lang a hijong le, houbuh lang to gella ding'a tongkhat cheh kikhai lhasuh ding ahi.
en_web: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
en_kjv: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

tcz: “Hiche ponbuh khu nading'a chu nangman jong kelgnoi chal vun le kelcha vun nemlai jeng naman chah ding ahiye.
en_web: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

tcz: Houbuh'a manchah thil ho chu nanagman thinggi thing jol namsella nasem cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
en_kjv: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
