en_kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

tcz: A tunna chengse chu abonchan sana in atom jol nam soh keiyin, sanakol jouse jong chu agolvai ho manchah din asempeh in, agolvaiya ho jouse jong chu sana mama'in atom jol soh keiye.
en_web: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
en_kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

tcz: Houbuh chung lam'a pansa ding chun Bezalel in pondum, ponsandup le asan-ao tupat pon mang chan asem in, hiche pon chu khut themna nei tampi'n asem cherub lim tampi akhuijin ahi.
en_web: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
en_kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

tcz: Hichea pansa ding chun thingggi thing-li a sem doh in chule akhom jong sana-li in ajol nam sel in, akol asempeh'in akhom li ding machun sana jong lijen asem'in ahi.
en_web: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
en_kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

tcz: Chule aman ponbuh kot phung lam'a pansa ding chun adum, asan dup, asa-ao chule tupat pon jeng'a ajem in ahi.
en_web: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
en_kjv: And he made a hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

tcz: A kikhaina chengse chu sana jeng'a kisem atunna nga asempeh in ahi. Akhom chengse ahin chule atomna chengse chu sana jeng'in atom jol soh keiyin akhom nunglam'a pansa ding vang chun sumeng jeng mangchan asem'in ahi.
en_web: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
en_kjv: and the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

tcz: Chu ban'in Bezalel chun thinggi thing mangchan thingkong asem tan; adung tongni le akeh ahin, avai tongkhat le akeh chule atun tongkhat le akeh ma alhing in ahi.
en_web: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
en_kjv: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

tcz: Aman jong asung lam le apolam ani gellin sana'in atomjol sellin, akimvel jouse jong sana mama in atom'in ahi.
en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
en_kjv: and he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

tcz: Aman jong aning gol'a pansa ding chun sana kol-li asem in pang lang khat'a chun kol-ni asem'in ahi.
en_web: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
en_kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

tcz: Chun aman moljol ni thinggi thing mangchan asuiyin, sana mama'in atom na'in ahi.
en_web: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
en_kjv: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

tcz: Thingkong putna ding in moljol teni chu thingkong geiya chaokol teni achun athil lut'in ahi.
en_web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
en_kjv: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

tcz: Chuin aman sana thengsellin thingkong khuna asem in, chule hepi touna jong asem in adung lam chu tong ni le akeh ahin, availam chu tongkhat le akeh alhing in ahi.
en_web: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
en_kjv: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

tcz: Chuin aman sana sehcha'a kikheng cherub lim bang'a um ni asem doh'in hepi touna among lam'a chun hiche teni chu apansah'in ahi.
en_web: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
en_kjv: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

tcz: Chule aman cherub khat aning lam khat achun apansah'in among langkhat ma achun Cherub khat ma apan sah in hichengse chu khat'in asem doh'in ahi.
en_web: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
en_kjv: one cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

tcz: Cherubim teni chun chunglang anga lhon'in chule alha ajap lhon'in hepi touna chu alhaving tenin a veng bit lhon in ahi.
en_web: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
en_kjv: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel in jong thinggi thing mangchan dokhang asem in ahi. Adunglam chu tongni in asem in, avai chu tong khat ahin chule atun lam chu tong khat le akeh alhing'in ahi.
en_web: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
en_kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

tcz: Aman akhom ho jouse chu sana in atom jol soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
en_kjv: and he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

tcz: Akimvel sechu khutphang tebep a saovin akhuna asem in chule ageikol jouse jong sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en_web: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
en_kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of a handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

tcz: Chuin aman dokhang'a manchah ding in sana chaokol-li asem in, dokhang keng-li lama chung apansah'in ahi.
en_web: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
en_kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

tcz: Chaokol chengse chu abonchan kinai chan aumsah sohkeiyin, chaokol hose chu dokhang akijon teng kimang cha ding ahi.
en_web: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
en_kjv: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

tcz: Aman hichengse chu thinggi thing jeng mangchan asuiyin, abonchan sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
en_kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

tcz: Chule dokhang'a machah ding chun sana kong thengsel phabep asem'in lhengkong ahin, gimnamtui halna ding chule lengpi twi chapna ding jong abonchan sana in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en_web: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
en_kjv: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel'in thaomei khom asem'in hichu sana theng sela asem ahi. Thaomei khom tuna ding ahin aputna ding, anigellin phatah'in sehcha'n akheng in ahi. Hichea pahcha kijem'a pang le alutom ijakai jouse chutoh thaomei khom jong jaonan khat'in asem doh tan ahi.
en_web: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
en_kjv: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

tcz: Thaomei khom chu gup ahin, aning ho a kon in abah thum cheh ahin jamdoh'in ahi.
en_web: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
en_kjv: and six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

tcz: Alang alanga abah gup jamdoh hoakon chun thaomei vah khon bang in ajamdoh'in alu ajum in apah jeng jong ahung um doh in ahi.
en_web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
en_kjv: three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

tcz: Hiche thaomei khom chu almond pahbang'in aning li aum'in ahi.
en_web: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
en_kjv: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

tcz: Thaomei khom akonna hung jam doh abah gup chengse chu toh'a noilam'a chengse jao nan khat in asem doh tan ahi.
en_web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
en_kjv: and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

tcz: Almond bah hung jam doh chengse chu toh abonchauva khat ahung soh doh theiyin, hichengse chu sana thengsella kikheng jeng seh ahi.
en_web: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
en_kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

tcz: Aman jong thaomei sagi asem in amei khao che tanna chengse jaonan sana thengsel in asem doh in ahi.
en_web: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
en_kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

tcz: Thaomei khom chu ahin, aman chah jouse jaonan sana thengsel dangka somsagi le nga mangchan asem doh in ahi.
en_web: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
en_kjv: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

tcz: Bezalel chun gimnam tuiya ding'in maicham khat thinggi thing'in asem'in ahi. Hichu adung tong khat chule atun tong khat ahi. Chule hichea kimang cha saki chengse chu toh khat in ahung um doh in ahi.
en_web: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
en_kjv: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

tcz: Aman maicham chu sana theng sel in atom namsel in, achung vumlam ahin chule ajet le avei jeng ajong, chu le a saki jouse jong abonchan sana in atom namsel in ahi. Hiti chun aboncha'n a kimvel jouse'a chun sana ajem in ahi.
en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
en_kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

tcz: Sana ki jem pah noiya akol a pang ding in aman sana chaokol ni asem doh in, khat cheh chu akingat tohsah in akhaiyin, maicham put le na manchah ding in asem doh in ahi.
en_web: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
en_kjv: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

tcz: Aman amoljol jouse jong chu thinggi thing jeng'in asemin sana'in atomnam soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
en_kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

tcz: Chuin aman kinu thei ding'in thaotwi asem doh'in gimnamtui jeng jong chu halnam thei ding'in asem'in ahi. Hichengse chu abonchan thaosem them hon asemdoh bang bang'in asem tan ahi.
en_web: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
en_kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

tcz: Chuban in Bezalel in jong thinggi thing amangchan, pumgo thilto maicham asem in ahi. Hichu atun feet sagi le akeh ahin asaodan jong feet sagi le akehma alhing'in chule asan dan tong li-le-akeh alhing'in ahi.
en_web: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
en_kjv: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

tcz: Aman aningli chengse a chun saki-li asem'in hiti chun saki chengse le maicham chu khat'in aum doh theiye. Aman maicham chu sum-eng in atom in ahi.
en_web: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
en_kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

tcz: Chule aman maicham'a manchah ding in sum-eng a mangchan bel ahin, khe keh, khangbel, kong le sum khe asem in ahi.
en_web: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
en_kjv: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

tcz: Chu jouvin aman sum-eng jeng in lhuhkhuh asem in ahi.
en_web: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
en_kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

tcz: Aman hiche dopna ding chun ningli asem'in ajol toh tho a pansahna ahin, hichengse chu sum-eng jeng mangcha'a alhah ahi.
en_web: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
en_kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

tcz: Aman thinggi mangcha'n thingjol jouse chu sum-eng jeng'in atom'in ahi.
en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
en_kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

tcz: Aman maicham putna ding'a akol-li asem ho chun, moljol chengse athillut'in ahi. Chuin maicham chu aumna ding asemtuoh'in ahi.
en_web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
en_kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

tcz: Bezalal chun ponbuh kotphung'a lhacha'a pang numei ho kisil'na kong ahin chule atunna ding jong chu sum-eng jeng'a asem'in ahi.
en_web: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the looking-glasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel'in pal agen kimsoh keiyin, pal'a khaiding poun jouse chu tupat pomnem ma kisem jeng ahi. Chule lhanglam'a khai ding poundal se chu feet jakhat to somnga alhing'in ahi. hiche pal lhanglama khaiding pondal chengse jong chutupat ponnem jing a kikhong ahin agom chun tong jakhat jen ahilhng e.
en_web: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
en_kjv: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

tcz: Apal khom somni ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Palkhom'a akol kisem chengse jong dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
en_web: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
en_kjv: their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

tcz: Aman pal sah lam'a pansa ding'in feet jakhat thoh somnga chule akhom somni jaona hichengse chu sum-eng jeng'a asem ahi. Pal khom ahin, akhaina kol aboncha sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en_web: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
en_kjv: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

tcz: Chule lhumlam'a pondal pal chengse chu feet somsagi le nga alhing'in akhom ahin, akol kisem jouse chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en_web: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
en_kjv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

tcz: Mailam'a pansa pondal chengse jong chu tong somsagi le nga sao ahi.
en_web: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
en_kjv: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

tcz: Kelkot polam'a pondal khat chu Tong somnileni akeh alhing in, chule atunna khom jong thum ahi.
en_web: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
en_kjv: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

tcz: Chule kelkot langkhat'a pansa jong chu kibang'in asem'in Tong somni le ni ahin, chule atunna khom jong thum’ ahi.
en_web: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
en_kjv: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

tcz: Pal kigetna'a pansa pondal jouse chu tupat ponnem jeng'a kisem ahi.
en_web: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
en_kjv: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

tcz: Palkhom ahin atunna khom aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Akhom'a kimang ho jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
en_web: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
en_kjv: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

tcz: Aman palmai kot phung'a ding chun pondal asem'in ahi. Hichu Tong somthum in asaovin, asandan tong sagi le akeh ahi. Aboncha pal'a kigen chengse toh chun kibang ahi.
en_web: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
en_kjv: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

tcz: Akhom chengse chu li ahin, atunna jouse jong chu sum-eng jeng ahi. Chule atunna, akhaina kol jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en_web: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
en_kjv: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

tcz: Houbuh ahin chule akimvella pondal jouse jong sum-eng jeng ahi.
en_web: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
en_kjv: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

tcz: Hichengse houbuh ahin, chule hettohsana houbuh hichu Mose thupeh dungjuija kisem, thempu Aaron chapa Ithamar ngaisahna dungjuija Levi teho natoh nading'a kisem ahi.
en_web: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
en_kjv: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of Testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

tcz: Chule Juda phung khaiya kon Hur chapa, Uri chapa Bezalel'in jong Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang chu bolkim soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Amapa chu Dan phung akon Ahismach chapa Oholiab chule khut themna neitah le ijakai thilbol them patdum ahin,ponsandup chule tupat ponnem bol them'a jong pang ahi.
en_web: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
en_kjv: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

tcz: Houbuh le muntheng sahdohna ding'in sana Shekhel somni le ko leh ja sagi leh somthum ahin choi khom uve.
en_web: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
en_kjv: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

tcz: Israel pumpi'n dangka talent jakhat toh Shekhel sangkhat toh jasagi leh som sagi leh nga jaonan apedoh'uvin muntheng sahna'a kimangcha shekel dungjuija kisim ahi.
en_web: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
en_kjv: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

tcz: Hiche dangka kidongkhom chengse hi min kisim dungjuiya hung kipielut chu ahi. (Hichu beka khat shekel kehkhat toh kibang ahin, muntheng laiya manchah ding ahi) Pasal Kum somni'a pat chunglamsea konna ki dong sangjagup le sangthum le janga le somnga alhing'in ahi.
en_web: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
en_kjv: a bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

tcz: Muntheng chung khunading, chule atunna ho aboncha'n sana le dangka sangsagi le janga alhing in atunna khat cheh chu dangka somsagi a ki sem ahi.
en_web: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
en_kjv: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

tcz: Amoh cheng sang le dangka somli le nga chengse chu akhom ahin, akhaina nading'a kisem akol chengse tomnan amang in ahi.
en_web: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
en_kjv: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

tcz: Chule mipi chun sum-eng a kisem dangka sangnga le jathum le somkhat ahin choijun ahi.
en_web: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
en_kjv: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

tcz: Hichengse chu akhomho chule houbuh semnan amang'in maicham achun sum-eng apansah'in chule sum-eng chu thil ijakai semnan jong amang'in ahi.
en_web: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
en_kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

tcz: Sum-eng mangchan palkikai jouse, kelkot chule houbuh sung'a thil ijakai jouse semnan aneiyin ahi.
en_web: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
en_kjv: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

tcz: Muntheng'a natong ding hon aman chah diu'vin asan-dup chule asanpol bang'a kikhong pon akikhuiyu'vin—Aaron'in muntheng'a na-atoh teng akivonna ding hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
en_web: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made clothes of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun sana mangcha'n konggah asem'in hichu asandup le asan-ao patnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
en_web: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
en_kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

tcz: Aman sana khat lim'in hoisel in khut them tah'in asem'in ahi. Hichu asandup, asan-ao patdum mangcha'n sehcha'n akheng tuoh'in asemdoh in ahi.
en_web: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
en_kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

tcz: Chule konggah akon chun akhaina ding anung le ama lam'a aumtuo'n lengkou changei jin akhailhah'na aum'in among lam chu akijopmat'in ahi.
en_web: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
en_kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

tcz: Hiche jong hi a ngaija bang'in hoisel'in asem'in: phatah'a ki pheh, adum, asan-dup, asan-ao sana jeng'a ki tom ponnem mangcha'a kisem, hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh dungjuija kisem ahi.
en_web: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Chule Onyx song chu-ni amang chau'vin chuin sana alhon'in agol tuoh sohkeiyun ahi. Song-ho chu Israel mite ama ama insung dungjui cheh'in amin'u mohor kinam khum bang'in agol tuoh soh kei u've.
en_web: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

tcz: Aman hiche song-agol chule kong-gah lengkou vumma ki khailha akon chun, Israel mite geldoh jing na ding'in asem tuoh sohkeijin. Hichengse jong hi Pakaiyin Mose a thupeh bang in abol sohkei u've.
en_web: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun khutthem tah'in Ompho asem'in ahi. Aman konggah bang bang chun asemdoh'in hichu sana ahin, adum chule asan-dup ponnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
en_web: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
en_kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

tcz: Aman ompho chu lheptup theiyin asemdoh'in akilhep teng adung avai khutchang ko ahiye.
en_web: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
en_kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

tcz: Amahon song-mantam chu golli'n akoi jun. Amasan Carnelian song-san apansah'uvin, pale-green, chule emerald song ahi.
en_web: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
en_kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

tcz: Golni channa ding'in blue lapis lazuli, chule songgil ahi.
en_web: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
en_kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

tcz: Gol-thum channa ding'in aiha song, khipi chule umbel song ahi.
en_web: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
en_kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

tcz: Gol-li channa ding'in song-eng, Onyx song chule song-mantam-eng apansah'uve. Hi chengse hi abonchan sana twiyin akaimatsoh keiyun ahi.
en_web: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
en_kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

tcz: Song-gol khat cheh chun Israel mite ama-ama kailhah dungjuiyin amin jouse toh akijih tha'n songkhat cheh achu Mohor kisem ahiye.
en_web: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
en_kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

tcz: Ompho le konggah kijopmatna ding chun sana thengsel la kisem khao bang'in akhuiyun ahi.
en_web: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
en_kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

tcz: Chule sana pat-jaang'a kisem le sana akol-ni jong asem uvin sana-kol teni chu ompho ning lama chun akaimat'uvin ahi.
en_web: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
en_kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Ompho tenia kikhai sana kol teni chu akhaimat'uvin ahi.
en_web: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
en_kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Chule sana-pat-jaang teni le sana golteni chu a jopmat uvin ahi. Konggah khaina leng-kou tenia kon chun agen kikhailha tenichu ompho maiya chun abehpeh peh'uvin ahi.
en_web: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
en_kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

tcz: Chuin ama hon sana kol-ni asemkit'vin, ompho geilam hichu konggah toh chun akaimat uvin ahi.
en_web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
en_kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

tcz: Chule sana-pat-jang kolni a semdoh kit uvin ani tah chun lengkou vumma konggah ki khaina achun akaimat uvin ahi.
en_web: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
en_kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

tcz: Chuin ompho chu pat-jaang khat mangcha'n akolsung'a chun athilmat'uvin konggah'a beh akol chengse toh athilmat uvin ahile phatah'a kipheh bang'in aumdoh tan ahi. Hitia abol phat uchun konggah le ompho chu achah kheh jeng tan ahi. Hichengse chu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in abol sohkei uvin ahi.
en_web: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun adum'a kikhong kivonna ding'in sang-khol asem'in
en_web: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
en_kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

tcz: Hichu Aaron'in aki-ah ding chule hiche songkhol chol chu agei gol akhui-eh cheh cheh'in ahi.
en_web: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
en_kjv: And there was a hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

tcz: Ama hon sangkhol-chol chu kolbu thei jem'in asem uvin patdum, asan-ao chule ponnem mangcha'n asemdoh'uvin ahi.
en_web: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
en_kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

tcz: Chuin amahon sana thengsel'in chaojang asem'uvin hichengse chu abonchan kolbuthei jem le sangkhol golla chun akoiyun ahi.
en_web: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
en_kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

tcz: Chao jang khat khaina achun kolbu theijem khat in akiba cheh-cheh in ahi. Hiche sangkhol-chol thempu khat chun na-atoh teng hoilai mun hijong le Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kivon ding ahiye.
en_web: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Ama hon Aaron le achapate ho jouse ding'in sangkhol chol len tupat jeng'in asem peh'uvin ahi.
en_web: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
en_kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

tcz: Delkop chule lukhuh ding jong jaonan toka-chol jong poun phatah'in asem'uvin ahi.
en_web: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
en_kjv: and a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

tcz: Kigah-ding jouse chu pon-nem asan-dup, san-ao phatah'a heo jang'a kisem jeng, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kibol ahi.
en_web: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: and a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Achaina'n lal lukhuh sana thengsel in a sem uvin ahi. Mohor kinam den bang in aum khum uvin: Pakai atheng e ti thucheng akoi un ahi.
en_web: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.
en_kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

tcz: Ama hon lukhuh chu adum khat Aaron delkop ding'in asem'uvin, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en_web: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiti chun ajona lam in kikhop khomna hou buh* chu sahchaiyin aum tai. Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong atong chai sohkeiyun ahi.
en_web: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.
en_kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

tcz: Chuin ama hon Mose heng'a houbuh chule thil-le-lo ijakai abonchan ahin choijun: akhaina-kolho, agolho, akhomho, akhom noi nung'a ho hiti chun abonchan ahin choi sohkeiyun ahi.
en_web: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
en_kjv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

tcz: Ponbuh khuna ding chun kelngoi chule kel chal-vun; hichengsea chu khuding ahi;
en_web: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
en_kjv: and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

tcz: Hettoh sahna thingkong; thingkong putna dinga moljol teni; chule hepi touna jaona,
en_web: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
en_kjv: the ark of the Testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

tcz: Dokhang le thilkeo ho; chule changlhah thilto chengse jaona ahi;
en_web: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
en_kjv: the table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

tcz: Sana thengsel'a ki semdoh thaomei-khom chule thaomei-khon chengse jaona, amanchah chengse le athaotwi jong jaona ahi;
en_web: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
en_kjv: the pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

tcz: Sana'a kisem maicham, chule kinu ding thaotwi; gimnamtui jaona le pondal jouse jong ahi.
en_web: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
en_kjv: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

tcz: sum-eng'a kisem maicham; chule aputna ding'a sum-eng jolho jaonan; kisilna kong le atunna jouse jong ahi.
en_web: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
en_kjv: the brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

tcz: Bangpheija kigol pondal ho; pal khom chengse ahin; chule houbuh lutna lam; houbuh'a kimang thil-le-lo jouse jaona ahi;
en_web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
en_kjv: the hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

tcz: Thempu hoding'a hoitah'a kikhui hichu muntheng laiya na-atoh teng ule akivon nadiu Aaron thempu, chule achapate hon thempu kin abol teng ule akivon nadiu ahi.
en_web: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
en_kjv: the clothes of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh bang chun Israel mite'n jong abonchan ajuikimsoh keiyun ahi.
en_web: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
en_kjv: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n anatoh jouseao abonchan avelhan ahi. Amahon tohding ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'in atong kimsoh keiyuve ti amuchet phat chun, phatthei aboh taovin ahi.
en_web: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
en_kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Kum-thah nikho masa pennia houbuh natundoh ding ahi.”
en_web: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

tcz: “Chule houbuh sung'a chu hettoh sahna thingkong na koi ding, hiche thing-kong chu muntheng chungnung mun ahin, hichu pondal na khu ding ahi”
en_web: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the Testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

tcz: “Dokhang hinpu'n lang, manchah thil-le-lo hojong jaonan, chule thaomei khom ahin thaomei vah chengse jong na hinchoi ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

tcz: “Hettohsahna thingkong maija chu gimnamtui lhut'na maicham nakoi ding ahi. Chuteng houbuh kotphung'a chu nakhai ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the Testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

tcz: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh lutna maiya chu hiche pumgo thilto maicham chu nasem ding ahi.”
en_web: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

tcz: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh le pumgo thilto maicham kimlai donna chu kisil-na kong nakoi ding, adimset'a twi nadip ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

tcz: “Chule ponbuh kimvel jousea pal kaiyin lang, kelkot lut'na chu pondal nakhai cheh cheh ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

tcz: “Kinu thei thao chu choiyin lang houbuh sung'a thil-le-lo ijakai nanu sohkei ding, aboncha atheng ding'a nathenso ding ahi.”
en_web: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
en_kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

tcz: “Chule pumgo thilto maicham ahin athilkeo jouse jaona thao nanu ding, atheng ding'a thensona nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hiche maicham chu atheng chungnung'a pang ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
en_kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

tcz: “Chu jou teng, kisilna-kong le atunna ho aboncha thao nanu ding, thensona naneipeh ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
en_kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

tcz: “Aaron le achapate chengse kikhop-khomna ponbuh sung lam'a hinpuijin lang, kong'a kilui twiya chu nasil diu ahi.”
en_web: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

tcz: “Aaron chu thao nanu ding chule ponsil theng pen'na navon ding, ajeh chu keima kinbol thempu a pang diu ahi.”
en_web: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

tcz: “Chule achapate chengse jong hinpuijin lang abonchaova sangkhol-chol na-ah peh ding ahi.”
en_web: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

tcz: “Apau Aaron thao nanu bang chun, amaho chengse jong thao nanu sohkei ding ahi. Ajeh chu abonchauva keima kinbol thempua pang diu ahi.”
en_web: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
en_kjv: and thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

tcz: Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun Mose'n jong atong kimsoh kei tan ahi.
en_web: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
en_kjv: Thus did Moses: according to all that the Lord commanded him, so did he.

tcz: Kumkit-kum thah lha masa nikho ma sapen'in houbuh chu atung doh tan ahi.
en_web: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

tcz: Mose'n hichengse jaonan houbuh chu ana-tung doh tan ahi; akhom ho, amoljol ho, pal khom ho abonchan atong kimsoh keiyin ahi.
en_web: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
en_kjv: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

tcz: Chuin aman houbuh chung lam'a pon akhu'n Pakai thupeh bang'in abol'in ahi.
en_web: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman hettohsahna song-pheng chengse chu alan tingkong sung lam'a chu akoiyin ahi. Chuin aman thingkong chungvum'a chun moljol chu akoilut'in thingkong chungvum'a chun hepi touna akoiyin ahi.
en_web: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
en_kjv: And he took and put the Testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

tcz: Aman thingkong chu houbuh lailung'a ahin pu'n pondal kikhu chu ahohdoh paijin, Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun abol in ahi.
en_web: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the Testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuban in Mose'n houbuh sung lam'a chun dokhang akoiyin, polam pondal kilan'na achun akoiyin ahi.
en_web: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
en_kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

tcz: Chule aman dokhang chung'a chun Pakai angsung'a ding in changlhah akoiyin ahi. Hichu Pakai thupeh bang'a abol ahiye.
en_web: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman houbuh lhang lam dokhang chule muntheng laiya chu thaomei atung doh tan ahi.
en_web: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
en_kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

tcz: Chuin aman thaomei chu atung doh tan, Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en_web: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman houbuh kotphung maija chun
en_web: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
en_kjv: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

tcz: Chule aman houbuh lut-na kotbul'a chun pumgo thilto maichan chu akoiyin ahi. Achung'a chun pumgo thilto akatdoh'in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en_web: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Chu ban in Mose'n houbuh le maicham kimlaija chun kisilna-kong chu akoiyin ahi. Aman kong dimset chun twi adip tan, ajeh chu thempu kinbol'a pang hon kisilna'a amanchah ding ahi.
en_web: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
en_kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

tcz: Mose chule Aaron le achapate'n kong- sung'a twi chu kisilna'a aman chah diu ahi.
en_web: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

tcz: Houbuh maicham lam ahinjut lut teng ule, kisil ngimna'a aman jing ding'u ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
en_web: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: when they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuin aman houbuh le maicham kimvel chengsea chun pondal akhaiyin ahi. Chule kelkot lam'a jong pondal akhaijin ahi. Ajonan Mose'n natoh ijakai atong kimsoh keijin ahi.
en_web: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
en_kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

tcz: Meibol'in ponbuh chu akhu jeng tan ahile, Pakai loupina chu kikhop khom'na ponbuh adim lha jeng tai.
en_web: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
en_kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

tcz: Mose chu houbuh sung lam'a chun alut thei tapon akiting den tai, ajeh chu meibol lom chu kiheh jeng ahitan, chule Pakai loupi na chun houbuh chu atomlhah jeng ahitai.
en_web: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
en_kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

tcz: Tun meibol jong chu houbuh akon'in ahung kitol tan ahile, Israel mite jeng jong meibol chie dungjuijin akitol tha jitauvin ahi.
en_web: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
en_kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

tcz: Amavang meibol aum den laisen, amaho jong aumden jitauve.
en_web: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
en_kjv: but if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

tcz: Pakaiya konna meibol chun nilhum kei jin houbuh chu atomlha jeng tan, janteng mei-kong in akilah'jin ahile Israel mite'n amittah'uvin amuthei jun ahi. Hiche hin a kholjin na chan uva ahin jui peh ahi.
en_web: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
en_kjv: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose chu houbuh akon in akouvin, ajah’a hiti hin asei peh tai.
en_web: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

tcz: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte hengah seipeh in, “Nang hon Pathen henga pumgo thilto nabol teng uleh, gamkol sung akon bong hon hihen kelcha hijong leh nato jing thei diu ahi.”
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

tcz: Nangman gancha nato ding chu pumgo thilto ding gancha akul sunga pat hiding, nolna bei thilto hi ding hichu Pathen in asan thei na dinga houbuh kotphunga todoh ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
en_kjv: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord.

tcz: Hiche gancha pumgo thilto chu aluchunga nakhut ngamlhan, chuteng kithoidam nadia hiche thilto chu Pakai adia santhei dol hiding ahi.
en_web: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
en_kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

tcz: “Chuteng leh Pakai Pathen ma sanga bongchal nou natha ding chule Aaron chapate leh thempu hon gancha thisan chu houbuh maiya maicham akimvel jousea athe khum diu ahi.”
en_web: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Chutengleh gancha chu avun nalip ding abong bonga nasat chen ding ahi.
en_web: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
en_kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

tcz: Hitia chu Aaron chapate thempu hon maicham chunga mei atikong diu, meikong chunga chu thing alom loma akoi diu ahi.
en_web: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;
en_kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

tcz: Amahon maicham kitonaa sa kisem ho chu, aluchang leh athao hochu maicham chung meikou lah achu aban bana akoi diu ahi.
en_web: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
en_kjv: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

tcz: Ama vang sasung jouse leh akeng ho jouse amasa pena twiya sop lhah ngimsel ding, hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo thilto maicham chung meiya ahal vam ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen adia namtui tah thilto hi ding ahi.
en_web: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: but his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman pumgo thilto dinga gancha hon lah akon napeh teng, kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha hithei ahi; amavang hichu achal hitei ding chule nolna beihel hiding ahi.
en_web: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
en_kjv: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

tcz: Chuteng gancha chu maicham chunglama natha ding, Pakai angsunga Aaron thempu leh achapate hon, gancha thisan chu maicham phung anigli chunga achap kimvel soh diu ahi.
en_web: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
en_kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

tcz: Hiche teng chule thempu pan gancha maicham chu atum tum, alhang lhang nga asat khen ding, aluchang, alap leh athao jouse pumgo thilto maicham mei kong nga ahalvam ding ahi.
en_web: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,
en_kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

tcz: Ahinla sasung jouse chule akeng jouse chu amasa tah’a twiya asop theng ding ahi. Hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo maicham pumpia maicham phung meiya ahal vam soh ding, hichu thilman lutah kipe, Pakaija dia gimnamtui kihal vam ahi.
en_web: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: but he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman Pakaija pumgo maicham’a vacha napeh le, nalhen kah ding vakhu ahilou le vapal napeh ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.
en_kjv: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the Lord be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

tcz: Hiche teng chule thempu pan vapal leh vakhu ham chu maicham phunga akoi ding, chuteng aluchang chu maicham phung chunga atan lhah ding, thempupan amasa pena hiche thisan jouse chu maicham aning gol jousea achap khum ding ahi.
en_web: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
en_kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

tcz: Chule thempu pan achang-oi le amul jouse apaimang ding, niso lam maicham phung meivam lah’a ase lhah ding ahi.
en_web: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
en_kjv: and he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

tcz: Chuteng thempu pan vapal lha ving tenia amat a abojal ding; asat tel lou hel ding chule maicham chunga meiya ahal vam ding, hichu pumgo maicham, gimnamtui Pakai adia kikat doh ahi.
en_web: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: and he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman lhosohga Pathen maichama napeh tengleh, hiche lhosohga changbong neldisel chu nalhen doh ding, hiche changbong chunga chu Olive thao nasunkhuma, Bego toh nachap khum ding ahi.
en_web: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
en_kjv: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

tcz: Hichu Aaron chapate, Thempu ho koma nahin choi ding, Thempu ho chun changbong thaotwi toh kihalsa chu, khut a sip-kham khat ahamdoh ding, Bego namthei toh kihalsa changbong ho chengse chu maicham phunga ahal diu ahi. Hichu Pakaiya dia thilpeh pha leh gimnamtui tah hiding ahi.
en_web: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: and he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:

tcz: Gasoh maicham amoh chengse chu Aaron leh achapate jouse na hoppeh ding, hiche maicham thilpeh hi Pakai adia thilpeh athengpen leh aman lupen hiding ahi.
en_web: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
en_kjv: and the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

tcz: Na lhosohga thilto changlhah chu lhummeiya kisang minsa ahileh changlhah chu thao thengsel'a kikeng hi ding, chol kiso lou hi ding ahi.
en_web: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
en_kjv: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

tcz: Na lhosohga maicham chu khangbela naken min ahijong leh changbong lah’a anel pen hiding, chule Olive thao naloi ding, hijong chu chol jao lou hiding ahi.
en_web: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
en_kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

tcz: Hiche chang bong hose chu, atum tum in homkhen inlang chuteng Olive thao toh nuhel in, hichu lhosohga maicham ahi.
en_web: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
en_kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

tcz: Nangman lhosohga maicham anbela nahon teng, hiche changbong chu anelpen leh Olive thao ahoi pen toh kihel hi ding ahi.
en_web: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
en_kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

tcz: Ipi lhosohga maicham hijong leh, iti kisem hijong leh thempupa koma hinpuiyun amapa chun maichama akatdoh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

tcz: Thempupa chun lhosohga maicham akatdoh chu, maicham chunga agovam ding ahi.
en_web: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Hiche lhosohga maicham amoh chengse chu Aaron le achapate kipe ding amahon anneh chohnaa anei diu, hiche maicham chu atheng pen, ahoipen leh lunglhaina dimset Pakaiya dia kikat doh hiding ahi.
en_web: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
en_kjv: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

tcz: Nanghon lhosohga maicham nabol teng uleh chol kisolou changlhah jeng hiding, Pathen henga na pehdoh jouseu chu khoiju leh chol jaona ho chu maicham phunga na halvam theilou hel diu ahi.
en_web: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.

tcz: Theichang gathah ho jouse jong, Pakai angsunga thilto dia nahin choi thei ahinai, hinlah hiche ho vang chu maicham phunga ki gouvam theilou hel ding ahi.
en_web: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
en_kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

tcz: Na lousohga maicham todoh ding jouse chu chi-al toh na haltha cheh ding ahi. Hichu Pathen tonsot'a dia na kiteppi nau na geldoh jing nau hiding ahi.
en_web: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
en_kjv: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

tcz: Na lousohga amasa pen maicham nasem tengleh, changvui lah a ahinhoi apumchep ho chu meiya na hulgot a, Pakaiya dia nahin todoh thei ahi.
en_web: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
en_kjv: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

tcz: Na anchang ho chu Olive thao sunkhum inlang Bego namthei toh hal in.
en_web: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

tcz: Thempu pan lousohga phasah khat chu alah a Olive thao asunkhuma, Bego toh ahal ding, chu teng Pathen adia thilto loupi hi ding meiya ahal vam ding ahi.
en_web: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman gancha akul apat maicham nasem teng, achal hihen anu hijong leh nato thei ding, amavang nolna bei hi ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.
en_kjv: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.

tcz: Gancha luchunga chun nakhut ngam inlang, chule Houbuh lutna a chun that in. Chutengle Aaron chapate, thempu ho chun, thisan chu maicham ning jousea chu athe khum diu ahi.
en_web: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
en_kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

tcz: Thempu pa chun chamna thilto phabep chu Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah a apeh dingu ahi. Hichea hi athao jouse le asung ho jouse ahin,
en_web: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
en_kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

tcz: Akongbuh toh kinaiya um akal teni le akimvela beh athao chengse, chule athin chunga beh athao jouse jong jaoding ahi. Hichengse hi akal toh kiladoh khoma,
en_web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
en_kjv: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

tcz: Chule Aaron chapaten hichengse chu pumgo thilto dinga maicham chunga meikonga chu ahal vam diu ahi. Hichu Pakaiya dinga lunglhai um gimnam tuitah, thilpeh lupen hiding ahi
en_web: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman gancha kul sunga kona gancha chu Pakaiya chamna thilto a naton ding tengle, hichu achal ahiloule anu hiding, amavang nolnabei hiding ahi.
en_web: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.
en_kjv: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the Lord be of the flock, male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

tcz: Nangman nato ding thilto chu kelngoi ahile, Pakai henga nahin kailut na,
en_web: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;
en_kjv: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the Lord.

tcz: aluchunga nakhut nangapma, chule Houbuh maiya chu natha ding ahi. Chutengle Aaron chapaten kelngoi thisan chu maicham ning jousea chu athekhum soh kei dingu ahi.
en_web: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
en_kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

tcz: Thempupa chun hiche chamna thilto a athao jouse chu Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah a apeh ding ahi. Hiche lah a chu atingpigu amei kitanlhah na geiya beh athao ho, agila beh athao jouse,
en_web: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
en_kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the back bone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

en_web: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

en_kjv: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the Lord; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

tcz: Thiltheng nasuhset ho chu aman napeh a nasem phat kitding kit ding, chule adang soma ni jong napehtha ding ahi. Thempupa koma napeh tengle, aman kilhaina kelngoichal toh chun chonset thilto a ato a nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.

en_kjv: then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

tcz: Chonset thilto dinga chu, nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kaiding, nangma a aumlouleh aman kibahpi khat nachoh ding ahi.
en_web: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.
en_kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

en_web: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
en_kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them besides the altar.

tcz: Chujoutengle avonho chu asutlhah ding, avon ngaiya kivon kit ding, chule vutvam ho chu ngahmun polama munthenglai khatna apohdoh ding ahi.
en_web: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

tcz: Hiche phat sunga chu maichama mei chu kou jing ding; mitsah louhel ding ahi. Jingkah sehle thempupa'n meilah a chu thing ahetbe jing ding chuleh pumgo thilto a dinga agontup jing ding ahi.

en_web: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

en_web: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
