en_web: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Nikhat sung chun bongpi anou jaonan chule kelngoi api chutoh, kelpi le anou chu ki lhaina nabol kop louhel diu ahi.
en_web: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
en_kjv: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

tcz: Pakai lama thangvah thilto na katdoh teng uleh, santhei ahina tei ding in, abol ding dan kisem jouse hi abonchan jui cheh un,
en_web: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
en_kjv: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer it at your own will.

tcz: Hiti chun nathilto doh nikho mama chun nechai jeng un, ajing nikho chan in naneh moh houchu khen hih hel un,
en_web: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
en_kjv: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.

tcz: Pakiyin aseiye, ka thupeh chengse bol un ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi, ati.
en_web: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
en_kjv: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the Lord.

tcz: Ka mintheng hi suthang hih hel un, Israel pumpin kathen dan joh seiphong hen, keima Pakai chu kahin, keiman ka suhtheng nahiuve, ati.
en_web: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
en_kjv: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the Lord which hallow you,

tcz: Nangho Pathen hina dia Egypt gam'a kona kahin pui galkai nahi tauvin, keima Pakai chu kahi, ati.
en_web: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
en_kjv: that brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a seipeh tan, Pakai dia phat tepsa kut na bonchauva atheng ahitia na phondoh cheh diu, keima dia hiche phat tepsa kut ho chu ahileh,
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

tcz: Nigup sunga mihon na akitoh cheh ding, nisagi lhinni vang chu imacha bol louva ki choldo nikhoa nanei cheh diu, hichu thengsel'a kikhop nikhoa ding ahi, hiche nikho kitia hi natoh nabol thei louhel diu ahi. Hoilai chana cheng jong leu chun, hiche nikho hi kicholdo nikhoa nanit jing diuva thupeh ahi.
en_web: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
en_kjv: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.

tcz: Hicheng hi Pakaiya dia phat ana kitepsa kikhop khomna theng chu ahin, hitobang nikho jousea hi aphat kitepsa dung juicheh a, nanghon mi nakou khom diu ahi.
en_web: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
en_kjv: These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

tcz: Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho, hiche nilhah lam vang chu Pakai dia kalchuh kut hiding ahi.
en_web: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
en_kjv: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord’s passover.

tcz: Chule hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinni chu, Pakai dia cholsolou changlhah kut nikho ding ahin, ni sagi sung vang chun chol solou changlhah tang loua naneh diu ahi.
en_web: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
en_kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

tcz: Nikho masapen nileh na bonchauva khompi theng naman diu, lel nathei na natoh lou diu ahi.
en_web: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
en_kjv: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

tcz: Ni sagi sungsea chu Pakai dia govam thil tang louva na katdoh diu, ni sagi lhin nikho vangleh khompi theng nikho ahitan, hiche nikho tengchu leh na bonchauva na kichol diu lelna thei na natoh lou diu ahi.
en_web: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
en_kjv: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin seiyin, keiman kapeh nau gamsung nahin phah uva gamga soh nahin lo teng uleh, nachangphal gao masapen chu thempupa lama nachoi diu ahi.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

tcz: Hichea kona chu thempu pan nangho santhei dol nahi thei nadiuva nathenso diu, ajing nikho cholngah ni teng leh thempu pan thensona anei ding ahi.
en_web: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
en_kjv: and he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

tcz: Hiche thensona kibol nikhoa changpal nakatdoh teng uleh, kelngoinou achal khat jong Pakaiya dia nolnabei hel chu nakat doh tha diu ahi.
en_web: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.
en_kjv: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf a he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa lhosohga katdoh ding chu, suhlou changbong neldisel Ephah khat dim, hopsoma hopni kiso ding; hichu thaotwi toh kihal, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui sela govam ding, don ding lengpithei jong chu khon dimkhat hoplia kona hopkhat chu hichea ding chu ahi.
en_web: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
en_kjv: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

tcz: Chule hiche nikho masang chun, na Pathen pa diuva thilto ding nahin pohlut kahseo vin, changlhah jong nehdao vinlang, chang kikang poh ahin changlhah kigou tho jong nehdauvin, hoilai chana cheng jong leuchun hicheng hi nakhang nakhang uva chonna dan in jui jing un.
en_web: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
en_kjv: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

tcz: Cholngah nikho aki chai apat, changpal nahin choi uva, thensona thilto nabol nikho uva pat nikho nasim cheh cheh diu, hapta sagi chan nasim diu ahi.
en_web: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
en_kjv: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

tcz: Cholngah nikho vel sagi chan geiya nasim uva chule ajing nikho nisomnga lhin changeiya nasim tha diu, chujou tengleh Pakai heng lama lhosohga thilto nakatdoh diu ahi.
en_web: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
en_kjv: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the Lord.

tcz: Na inson cheh uva pat Ephah dim khat cheh hopsom lah a, hopnia kikhen thenso thilto dinga changlhah lhonsao ni jaona nahin choi diu ahi, hiche teni chu cholsosa ahin, Pakaiya dia lhohsoga masapen thiltoa pang ding ahi.
en_web: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
en_kjv: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the Lord.

tcz: Chule hiche changlhah jaona chu kumkhat lhing tasa nolna beihel kelngoi sagi, bongchal golpai khat, kelngoi chal ni jaona nakat doh uva, hiche gancha ho chu Pakaiya dia pumgo thiltoa kimang ding gimnamtui sela meiya govam ding ahi.
en_web: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Chonset thilto ding in kelchal khat mang unlang, chamna thilto le gantha ki lhaina dinga kum khat a tah kelchal ni nahin kat diu ahi.
en_web: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
en_kjv: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

tcz: Chule hicheng ho chu thempu pan Pakai angsunga thensona anei ding, lhosohga masa thilto changlhah jaonaa, kelngoi chalteni jong chu athenso tha ding ahi, hiche hose hi thempu dia Pakai angsunga thil thengsel'a um ahi.
en_web: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
en_kjv: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa hi khompi khat nanei diu, hichu khompi thengsel'a naman uva, lel nathei natoh nabol lou diu, na khang lhum keiyuva hoichana chejong leuchun, hiche hi chonna dan dungjuiya najui jing diu ahi.
en_web: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
en_kjv: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be a holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

tcz: Na bonchauva na gamsung uva kona chang na-at teng uleh, na lou jao uchu apam chin jousea na-at chai lou diu, nachang at na nung uva chang khai ho jong nachom thengsel lou diu ahi; vaichate leh kholjin hodia na koipeh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima nangho Pakai, Pathen kaum jing e, ati.
en_web: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”
en_kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in hiti hin bol in, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin sei peh tan, lha sagi lhin teng, hiche lhasung nimasa nileh na bonchauva naki chol uva khompi theng nanei diu, sumkon mutgin tothoa naphon jal jidiu ahi.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

tcz: Thabeina thei natong hih un, Pakai henga pumgo thilto nahaimil lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
en_kjv: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Lha sagi lhin nikho nisom alhin nikho hi ki thoidamna ahin, hiche nikhoa hi thonlouva khompi theng khat nabol diu, an ngol tothoa Pakai dia pumgo thilto nato doh diu ahi.
en_web: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa hi koima chan thabeina thei natoh nabol lou diu, ajeh chu kithoidamna nikho loupi khat ahin, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu henga thoidamna nanei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
en_kjv: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.

tcz: Koi hijong leh hiche nikhoa an ngol lou aum leh, amite lah akona pampeiya um ding ahi.
en_web: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
en_kjv: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

tcz: Hitia chu koi hijong leu chun, hiche nikhoa hi thabeina thei natong aum khah leh, ama chu amite lah a kona kasuh mang ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
en_kjv: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

tcz: Na bonchauva natoh thilbol akon na nakikangse cheh diu, hoilai muna hijong leh na chenna jouseuva chonna dan ahitia, najui cheh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
en_kjv: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

tcz: Hiche nikho hi na boncha diuva kicholdo nikhoa naman jing diu, hitia chu an ngol tothoa, hiche lhasung nikho ahung lhin niapat, ajing nilhah lam chana choldonaa naman cheh diu ahi, ati.
en_web: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
en_kjv: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

tcz: Pakiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse henga seipeh tan, lhasagi lhinna chule nisom le ninga lhin nikhoa pat, ni sagi sungse hi Pakaiya dia ponbuh kut a kimang ding ahi.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the Lord.

tcz: Kut akipat nikho chu khompi theng nikho ahin, hijeh chun thabei nathei natoh ima bolhih un, ati.
en_web: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
en_kjv: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

tcz: Tanglou hela ni sagi sunga Pakaiya dia thilto nabol jom jing diu, niget alhin nikho tengleh khompi theng khat nabol diu, Pakai ansunga pumgo thilto nakat doh diuchu ahin, hichu khompi theng laitah ahijeh'in thabei nathei natoh akon nakikangse cheh diu ahi.
en_web: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
en_kjv: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.

tcz: Achunga kimin phah chengse hi, Pakaiya dia phat tepsa kut hochu ahin, hiche nading chun Israel chate koukhom soh keiyun lang, khompi theng tothoa, thilto ding ho ahin, pumgo thiltonaa naman diu, anikho mama a abol ding dan jouse govam ding hihen, donthei lengpitwi hi jongleh, nabol diu ahi.
en_web: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
en_kjv: These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi na bonchauva Pakaiya dia na thiltou hichu deilhen choma na thilto uva ahitan, chule athenso ho jouse jaonan, nathil pehdoh jouseu leh Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho le adang dang nanit kimsel hou kisim tha lou ahi.
en_web: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
en_kjv: beside the sabbaths of the Lord, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the Lord.

tcz: Lhasagi chan nisom leh ninga lhin nikho leh, na bonchauva gamsung lho sohga nachop kimsoh niuva pat nasim uva Pakaiya dia ni sagi sungsea kut tang louva nabol jom jing diu, hiti chun kut akipat nichu choldo nikho theng hiding, niget lhin nichan chu choldo nikhoa naman diu ahi.
en_web: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
en_kjv: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

tcz: Kut kipat nikho teng thingga ahoilai nalo lhah diu, lusuna tampi jaona, thingboh phatah tah na helhah diu, vadung pang lah a tomdo he tohthoa, hicheng chu na kichoi uva, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu angsunga tang louva nakipa jing diu ahi.
en_web: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
en_kjv: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.

tcz: Kumkhat seh le Pakai heng lama ni sagi tang louva kut khat nabol jing diu, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dan ngaiya naman chah jing diu, lhasagi lhinna lhasung achu naman diu ahi, ati.
en_web: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
en_kjv: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the Lord seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

tcz: Ni sagi sunga na bonchauva lhambuh a nachen diu, Israel sungkon agammi cheng aboncha lhambuh sunga cheng ding ahiuve.
en_web: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
en_kjv: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

tcz: Hichea kon chun nachilhah teuvin keima tah in Egypt gam'a kona, Isarel chate jouse kahin puidoh chun lhambuh sung a bou kachen sah ji'e ti, ahin hetdoh thei diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahi, ati.
en_web: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
en_kjv: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Mose’n Pakai dinga phat tepsa kut ho jouse chu, Israel chate jouse lah a aphondoh peh ahi.
en_web: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
en_kjv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu asepeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Isarel chate ho henga seipeh tan, mit theilou helding vah jing din, olive thaomei chu nahin choipeh nading un seipeh tauvin.
en_web: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
en_kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

tcz: Ki khop khomna ponbuh hettohsahna pon kilang doh, hiche muna chu Aaron in thaomei kivah chu tang louva avet kol jing ding ahi. Hiche thaomei hi Pakai angsunga nilhah muthima pat jingkah khovah geiya kivah khovah hel ding ahi. Hiche hi nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dana nanei jing diu ahi.
en_web: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
en_kjv: Without the vail of the Testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

tcz: Aaron in jong Pakai sana thaomei khom phunga chu, hiche thaomei kivah jouse chu avah jingnai ti, photchetna avetkol jing ding ahi.
en_web: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
en_kjv: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

tcz: Chule nangman chang bonga kigoidi chu nalah ding, hichu changlhah lhonsom le ni nasoa naken ding, lhonkhat cheh chu Ephah dimkhat hopsoma hopni lhingsela kisem hiding ahi.
en_web: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
en_kjv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

tcz: Chang lhah nasemsa chu golni nia nagol ding, golkhat achu changlhah lhongup pang ding, sana thengsel'a kisem touna chunga chu nagola nakoi ding ahi.
en_web: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.

tcz: Gimnamtui nalah a changlhah golkhat chu nasun den ding, hichu nangman nato doh changlhah toh chun Pakaiya dia govam thiltoa kitoh doh tha ding ahi.
en_web: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Cholngah nikho seh le hichu Pakai angsunga kigol doh ding, hitia chu beitih umlouva Israel chaten machah thei hochu akatdoh jing diu ahi.
en_web: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

tcz: Hiche thilto hose hi Aaron le achapate ho ding ahin, hitia chu hiche thilto hochu muntheng laiya anehji diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche thilto chu Aaron ding Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto kitoh dohsa, ama chanvou dia thiltheng tah ahin, hichu tang louva chonna dan dinga juijing ding ahi.
en_web: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
en_kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, by a perpetual statute.

tcz: Pasal khat chu anu Israel numei chule apa Egypt mi, hichepa chu ahungvah doh le tan ngahmun khat a avah lut in ahileh, hichun Israel chaten aum kemvel tauvin, chuin Israel numei nu chapa jong Israel chapa khat toh chun akiboi lhontan ahi.
en_web: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
en_kjv: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

tcz: Israel numeinu chapan jong Pathen pa min panin taitomna toh thon agao sapjeng tai, chuin mipi hon ama chu Mose heng lama ahin pui tauve. Hichepa anu min chu Shelomith ahin, Dan phung akona Dibri chanu ahi.
en_web: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
en_kjv: and the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

tcz: Amahon jong hichepa hi iti ding hi tam atiuvin, Pakai lunglam aheng uva ahung kilah kahsea din, mihenna kul sunga chun akhumlut tauve.
en_web: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
en_kjv: and they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Pathen gaosap mipa chu polam ngahmuna hin kaidoh inlang, aman agaosapna awchang japha chan in, aluchunga akhut angap lhah cheh diu, hiche jouteng leh khompi thenga mipi jousen song in seplih jeng tauhen, ati.
en_web: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
en_kjv: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

tcz: Chule Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh tan, koi hileh Pathen gaosap mihem aum khah leh, hiche mihem chun amatah themmona akipoh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
en_kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

tcz: Pathen taitom mihem chu thajeng ding ahi, khompia pang mihem jousen amachu songa aselih diu, kholgammi hihen agamsung chengden hi jongleh, Pathen min taitom mihem kiti phot chu thana chang ding ahi.
en_web: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
en_kjv: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

tcz: Chule mihem khat that chu, ama jong thina chansah ding ahi.
en_web: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
en_kjv: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Koi hileh gancha that achu ama chun akhel apeh doh pai ding, hiche gancha khel thei dia chu gancha hing khat alepeh ding ahi.
en_web: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
en_kjv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

tcz: Koi hileh ain-heng khattou amavo khah leh, aman hichepa abolna banga chu ama chunga jong bolgimna lhung ding ahi.
en_web: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
en_kjv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

tcz: Agu ham achang ham asuh chep a ahileh, ama jeng jong agu achang suhchep del ding, amit asuh chot tah jong leh ama mit jong hitia chu suhchot peh ding, aha ham khat asuh lhoi khah jong leh ama ha jong suh lhoi pai ding; aman mi abol gimset banga chu ama chunga jong abepbep a lhunsah ding ahi.
en_web: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
en_kjv: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

tcz: Gancha that aum leh hiche athat pen pen chun akhel ahola apeh le ding, mihem chunga hem lama thatpa chu ama jeng jong tha ding ahi.
en_web: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
en_kjv: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kholgam akona mihem hihen, agamsung akon hijong leuchun abonchauva danthu khat a chondel del diu, ajeh chu keima Pakai leh nangho jouse Pathen pachu kahi, ati.
en_web: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
en_kjv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Mose jong hiti chun Israel chate jouse jah aseipeh soh tan, chuin amahon Pathen taitomna neipa chu polam ngah munkhat a ahin kaiyun, amapa chu song in aseplih tauvin ahi. Pathen thupeh bang in Israel chate jousen abolun ahi.
en_web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chunga konin, Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in,
en_web: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a seiyin, na bonchauva keiman kapehna gam nahung lhun teng uleh agam pumpia jong Pakaiya dia choldam kum anei tei ding ahi.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.

tcz: Kumgup sunga na loujaova muchi nathe ding, hitia chu kumgup sunga na lengpi thei nalho ngimsela, chuteng aga nakilo ding ahi.
en_web: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
en_kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

tcz: Kum sagi lhinkum levang agamsung pumpin choldam kum anit ding, hitia chu lou jaova muche jeng jong natu thei lou ding, na lengpithei lei jong nalho ngimtah lou ding ahi.
en_web: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
en_kjv: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

tcz: Chule changval hung kehdoh ho jong na-at lou ding, lengpi lei lholou laiya hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon da jeng ding, ajeh chu na boncha diuva choldamna kum ahi.
en_web: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
en_kjv: That which groweth of it own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

tcz: Gamsung pumpia dia choldamna kum ahitan, ami chan cheh ading in chule nangma nahin nasoh pasal ham nasoh numei hijon gleh; natha lah mihem hihen lang gamchom ahung kholjin hijong leh, na bonchauva dia anneh ding nahin ngaito peh diu ahi, ati.
en_web: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
en_kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

tcz: Nangma gancha ho ahin, na gam'a um gamsa ho jaona hiche gamga soh hochu aneh diu ahi.
en_web: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
en_kjv: and for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

tcz: Kum khat sunga hapta sagi nasim dohji ding, hatpa sagi veijen na simdoh ding hitia chu agoma kumsom li leh kumko aphah ding ahi.
en_web: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
en_kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

tcz: Hiche jou tengleh nangman lha sagi lhinna hiche lhasung mama achu, nisom lhin nikho chule sumkon namut ging ding, hichea chu kithoidamna nikho nagam pumpiuva thong jejua sum kon na lhangsap uva nathejal soh diu ahi.
en_web: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

tcz: Kum nga don ahung lhin teng hiche kum chu kum theng tah ahi, hichu na phonjal diu, gamsung pumpia khosa jouse henga chamlhat kum ahitia naphon jalsoh diu ahi; hiche kum hi naboncha diuva jubilee kum ahitan, mihem koi hileh athilkeo jouse akile lah kit ding, mihem jeng jong ama cheh in muna kile cheh ding nahiuve.
en_web: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
en_kjv: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

tcz: Hiche kum somnga lhinkum hi nangho jouse dia jubilee kum ahitan, hiche kuma hi muchi jeng jong natu louhel diu, achama hung keh muche chang jeng jong na-at da jeng diu, lengpilei nalho louna beh a hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon lou ding ahi, ati.
en_web: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
en_kjv: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

tcz: Ajeh chu Jubilee kum hi kum theng tah ahi, na boncha diuva atheng ahi; hijeh chun agamsunga anagasa hobou naneh diu ahi.
en_web: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
en_kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

tcz: Hitia chu Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng, na boncha uva koi hileh agoulo cheh chu na kile pehto diu ahi.
en_web: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
en_kjv: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

tcz: Na kinaipi henga na thil joh ham, ahilouleh nathil chohsa ham jeng jong chu, hitia thil joh chung chang leh akijoh doh thil chung changa na sopi khat toh adih louva na kibol to thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
en_kjv: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

tcz: Chule Jubilee aki chaiya pat naheng nakoma na thilchoh chule akum ijat sunga hi jongleh, agamga soh toh kitoh a nangma koma thil ale joh ding ahi, ati.
en_web: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
en_kjv: according to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

tcz: Kum vang chu ahung tamkhah tah leh hiche thilman chun nasan sah ding, ahinlah akumjat chu alhom khah vangleh athilman jeng jong nalhom sah ding ahi, ajeh chu akum kisim jat dungjuiya aman jong gamga toh ajoh ahi, ati.
en_web: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
en_kjv: according to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

tcz: Na bonchauva khat leh khat nakisuh gimlou heldiu, hiche sangchun na Pathen chu ging jing in, ajeh chu keima na Pakai leh na Pathenu chu kahi, ati.
en_web: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
en_kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan jouse najuikim soh kei diu, hiche ho jouse chutoh natoh doh diu ahi, chuteng gamsung pumpia na bonchauva lungmong sela nakhosah diu ahi.
en_web: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
en_kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

tcz: Agamsunga jong gamga pha hung um doh ding, hitia chu oiva sela naneh thei diu, agam sunga lungmong sela nachen thei diu ahi.
en_web: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
en_kjv: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

tcz: Na bonchauva na ngaito uva, kum sagi ahung lhin kum le ipi ham ineh diu, muchi la itu ta pouvin, chang jeng jong i-at lou diu hitam, tia na lung don khah uva ahi leh,
en_web: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
en_kjv: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

tcz: Keima tah in kumgup alhin kumle na boncha chung cheh uva phattheina kahin bung lhah peh diu, hichun kum thum sungsea naneh khop diuva anga ahin sodoh ding ahi.
en_web: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
en_kjv: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kum get lhin kum apat muchi tujong leu chun lhosoh ga aumsa alui hobou naneh diu, kumko ahung lhina lhosohga athah kahsea lhosohga alui hobou naneh na ai diu ahi, ati.
en_web: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
en_kjv: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

tcz: Gam leiset kiti jong najoh doh thei lou diu, aneipa kei kahin, na bonchauva gamchom mi kholjina kanei nahiuve, ati.
en_web: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
en_kjv: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye were strangers and sojourners with me.

tcz: Hijeh chun hoilai chan hi jongleh nachen na jouse uva, gam leiset lhatdohna man na bonchauva napeh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
en_kjv: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

tcz: Na sopipa hamkhat hahsatna ato jeh a, agam leiset ajoh doh khah a ahileh, ama bana asopipa chu hunga athiljoh doh chu ahung lhat ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
en_kjv: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

tcz: Ahinlah ajoh dohpa ham khat chun, asopi alhat doh thei mi anei tah louva, amavang khonunga ahung haodoh thei dinga auma ahileh, aman ahin kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
en_web: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
en_kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

tcz: Hitia chu agamjoh doh pan jong ajohdoh kuma pat phatah a sim ding, ajohna pa henga chu aman jat apeh dia lom cheng chutoh apeh dohtha ding, chujou tengleh ana chodoh pa chun agam leiset chu aboncha anung peh kit ding ahi.
en_web: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
en_kjv: then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

tcz: Ahinlah amapa chun alhat dohna ding aneilouva ahileh, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea ajoh dohnapa koma chu athil joh doh chu chuti um ding ahitan, Jubilee kum ahung lhun phat levang chun achopa chun ale lhatdoh ding, athil neipa chu lechan kit ding ahi.
en_web: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
en_kjv: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

tcz: Kula kigensa gam leiset behkah khat tou johdoh a umleh, hiche ajohdoh pa chun ajoh kum sunga chu akile lhat dohthei ding ahi. Ajeh chu kum khat sunga chu akile lhatdohna dia thu anei ahi.
en_web: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
en_kjv: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

tcz: Ahinlah a-in chu kum sunga chu alhatdoh jou louva ahileh, khopi sunga kul ki gensa ki johdoh a akichohpa chun akhang lhum keiya anei ding ahitan, Jubilee kum hung lhung jongleh akile lhatna ding thu anei lou ahitai.
en_web: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
en_kjv: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be stablished for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

tcz: Kul kigen lou khopi neocha sunga in ki johdoh ho vang chu, amin mai maiya ki sim peh ding, hiche ho chu lhatdohna tha um ding, hichu Jubilee kum ahung lhunteng lhatdoh ding ahi.
en_web: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
en_kjv: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

tcz: Ahinlah Levite chenna khopi ho chu, ama ho ana chennasa akhopi sung uva in ho vang chu, Leviten itih phatlai hi jongleh akile lhatdoh thei diu ahi.
en_web: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

tcz: Koi hileh Levi mite akona athuneina aman chah louva ahileh, amaho chenna khopi sunga ana kijoh dohsa in vangchu, Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng kile peh cheh cheh ding ahi, ajeh chu Israel chate chenna tin cheng chu Levi mite dia amaho goulo jeng ahibouve.
en_web: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

tcz: Levi mite dia kikoi gam beh jouse chu, khat a khat cha kijoh doh thei lou ding, hichu amaho dia tonsot goulo ding ahi.
en_web: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
en_kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

tcz: Na sopipa chu aneilel valtah a, nakom tah a akivah lelna aum doh a ahileh, nangman jong ima dang gel louva ama chu navah jeng ding, kholgam akona jin banga nakom a khosa jeng ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
en_kjv: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

tcz: Natoh le tham akon in apung akal jong tep peh dan lang, na Pathen maiven na sopipa chu nakoma khosa teijo hen, ati.
en_web: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
en_kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

tcz: Ama chu veikan dia sum bat napeh thei lou ding, nehle chah jeng jong apung dia nei peh lou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

tcz: Ajeh chu kei matah hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahin, nang ho Pathen kahiye tia Cannan gam kapeh diu ahitia, Egypt gam'a kona nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi, ati.
en_web: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
en_kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangma nai lama cheng na sopipa chu anei lelval tah a nangma koma ama le ama ahung ki peh lut tah leh, ama chu soh tobanga nagoi thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
en_kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

tcz: Amapa chu na koma thalah mi banga khosa jeng ding, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea na koma khosa ding ahi.
en_web: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
en_kjv: but as a hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

tcz: Jubilee akichai teng nangma dalhaa pot tading achate jouse jaona che diu, a insung lama leche diu, apu apa khanga gou ho chu lechan ding ahiuve.
en_web: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
en_kjv: and then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

tcz: Ajeh chu abonchauva keima lhachaa pang ahiuvin; abonchauva Egypt gam'a kona kahin puigal kai ahiuve, hiche jeh chun amaho hi abonchauva sohjoh a najoh doh lou diu ahi.
en_web: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
en_kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

tcz: Nangman ama ho jouse munemna neitah a thu nasei lou ding, na Pathen ging khencha hinkho naman ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

tcz: Soh pasal ho in numei jong nanei jeng thei ahin, hiche soh ding achu nakom lah a namtin vaipi hochu na chohdoh a navul thei ahi.
en_web: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
en_kjv: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

tcz: Na bonchauva nalah uva chenglut kholgam mih hochu nachoh doh uva, soh a nalap thei diu ahi, nagam sung pumpiuva chengsa ho jong nachoh thei diu, hitobang mi nachoh doh hou chu na in cheh uva uma nalap le thei diu ahi.
en_web: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
en_kjv: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

tcz: Chule soh ho chu na chateu banga na goulo diuva na umsah uva, khonunga goulo ding jong nakoi peh diu, nangho Israelte lah a vang khat in khat chunga thuneina tah a vaihoma chatloh thei lou ding ah.
en_web: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
en_kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

tcz: Na koma cheng kholjin mi chu ahung haodoh jeng tah a, na koma cheng na sopi pakhat machu achen dan ahah satval tah a ahileh; amajeng jong na koma cheng kholjin mipa koma ahung kipeh doh jeng tah a ahileh, chule asopi ho kom ham khat a akijoh doh jeng tah a ahileh,
en_web: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
en_kjv: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

tcz: Hitia akijoh nunga chu lelhat kit thei ahi, asopi ho lah akona khat penpen in amapa chu ale lhat kit ding,
en_web: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
en_kjv: after that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

tcz: Ahilouleh apaneo ham apaneo chapa ham khat in jong ale lhat thei ahi, amatoh kinai asopi aheng akom aphung chan khompi ainsung toh kinai pen khat injong alhat doh thei ding, hiche kala chu ama le ama ahung neijou tah levang ama chama kilhat ding ahi.
en_web: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
en_kjv: either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

tcz: Ana ki chohdoh patoh akinopto banga, ama le ama akijoh doh niapat Jubilee kum chana asim ding, aman jat chu akum tam leh lhom dungjuiya alepeh ding ahi, anakichoh pan amapa alap sungsea chu thalah man toh kibang ding ahi.
en_web: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
en_kjv: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of a hired servant shall it be with him.

tcz: Jubilee kum lhunna ding kum phabep avat nah laileh, aki lhatdohna dia ana ki chohdohna man chu alang khat alepeh ding ahi.
en_web: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
en_kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

tcz: Ahinlah Jubilee lhinna ding chu kum lhomcha akivat tah a ahileh, aki choh apat akum jat chu avet toh lhon ding, hiche kuma pat chu atohman jat dungjuiya avaldoh chengse chu akile lhat dohna dia ale dip ding ahi.
en_web: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
en_kjv: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

tcz: Tohman akisim teng hichepa chu thagoi man bep bep a kisim peh ding, koi hileh hichepa tobang chunga engset nanei thei hoa kona navet tup ding ahi.
en_web: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
en_kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse nunga hi, amapa hi aki lhatdoh joulou tah vangleh, chuti uma Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng lhat ding, ama ahin achate jouse jaona lhat tha ding ahitai.
en_web: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.
en_kjv: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Israel chate hi abonchauva keima lhacha ngen ahiuvin, amaho hi ka lhacha ahin, Egypt gam'a kona keima tah in kahin puigal kai ahiuvin, keima hi na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu chu kahi jinge, ati.
en_web: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
en_kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva milimdoi nasem thu louhel diu, milim akisem hihen songa tun ding hi jongleh, khat a khat cha natundoh theilou diu ahi, gamsung pumpi naumnau kitia hi song milim natundoh theilou diu, hiche ho chu nabol uva amasanga naboh khup loubeh diu ahi; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen pau kaum jing e, ati.
en_web: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
en_kjv: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka cholngah nikho chu nanit kimsoh kei diu chule ka muntheng jeng jong jabolna napeh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi.
en_web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.
en_kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan ho najui kimsoh keidiu, ka thupeh chengse jong aboncha nanit kimsoh keidiu aboncha nabol kimsel teng uleh,
en_web: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
en_kjv: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

tcz: Hichea chu keima tah in nangho jouse dia gotwi kahin lhah sah ding, chuting leh agam leiset pumpia konin gamsa hung kisep doh becheh ding, thingga jeng jong hagaa hung ga ding ahi.
en_web: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
en_kjv: then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

tcz: Chuteng na loujao dung uva thingga lou ding le lengpi theiga lou ding, alhang alhanga mihem kikaiya, chuteng na oivasel uva changlhah naneh cheh diu nagam sung jeng uva jong lungmong le lhamonga na khosah diu ahi.
en_web: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
en_kjv: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

tcz: Chuteng keiman nangho gamsung pumpia chamna ka umsah ding, nomtah a na choldo diu koiman nasuh kichat tahlou diu ahi, gamsung pumpia gamsa phalou jouse katol manghel ding, na chennau gam jenga jong hem mangchaa kitona um talou ding ahi.
en_web: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
en_kjv: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

tcz: Namel mateu nadel jam diu, na masang lai tah uva chem jam tothoa nasat lih jeng diu ahi.
en_web: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
en_kjv: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

tcz: Nang hoa kona mi nga jeng in jong mi jakhat nadel jam thei diu, chule nangho mi jakhat seh in melma sangsom nadel jam thei kit diu ahi, namel mateu chu chemjam lama nasat chop joukei diu ahi.
en_web: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
en_kjv: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

tcz: Na bonchauva kagel khoh cheh diu, na boncha chung uva ka kitepna jong guilhun sah ding kahi.
en_web: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
en_kjv: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

tcz: Na bonchauva nahou thei diu lho sohga abeisa naneh uva, lhosohga thah ahung lhun kit teng aumsa ho chu na otdoh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
en_kjv: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

tcz: Keima tah jong nalah uva khosa ding kahin, ka lungsung jenga jong kidah tah a na kibol kit lou diu ahi.
en_web: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
en_kjv: And I will set my tabernacle amongst you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

tcz: Chule nalah uva kalhat le ding, na Pathen pau chu kahi jing ding, na bonchauva ka mite nahi jing diu ahi.
en_web: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
en_kjv: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

tcz: Egypt gam mite soh nahi lou na diuva, agam sung uva kona hinpui galkai Pakai na Pathen uchu keima hi kahin, keiman na bonchauva namkol chu kasuh chip a nangho jouse dingdet puma ka che sah nahiuve.
en_web: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
en_kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kathu nit ding nanom pouve, thupeh jouse jong najui tapouvin ahi.
en_web: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
en_kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

tcz: Ka chonna dan aboncha nahsah louva na koi uleh, na hinkho sung uva ka chondan ho kidah le thet a nakoi khah uleh, ka thupeh khat cha beh jong bol ding go louhela naum uva, ka kitepna napel keh khah tah uleh,
en_web: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
en_kjv: and if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

tcz: Keima tah in naboncha chung uva hitobang chu ka lhunsah ding. Na chung cheh uva lunggim hesoh lhung jeng ding chule na gam nadiu ka lhunsah a, nahai hu jengu jong bing leuva ka lhunsah ding ahi, namel mateu neh chai ding bep sohdoh ahi.
en_web: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
en_kjv: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

tcz: Na bonchauva kaki doupi soh keiyuva, namel mateu masanga jong na kisuhgam set diu ahi, nadei lou uleh nathet bol teu aboncha nangho chung vum'a vaihom thuneiya umdiu, koima dellou beh a ha jama najam cheh diu ahi.
en_web: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
en_kjv: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies; they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

tcz: Akisei chengse nahsah a koi louva kathu jeng jong na kijah mosah ngei ngei uleh, na chonset nauva kona vel sagi jen bolgimna ka lechuh sah ding nahiuve.
en_web: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
en_kjv: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

tcz: Na kiletsah nau le natha nei sunu aboncha kasuh manghel ding, na chung cheh uva thih ka chuh sah a, na gam sung jengu jong sum eng ka hisah ding ahi.
en_web: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
en_kjv: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

tcz: Hitia chu na thanei na jouseu pannabei jeng hi tading, nagam leiset pum piuva jong lhosohga um talou ding, gamsung pumpia thing phung jouse gasoh thei louhel ding ahi.
en_web: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
en_kjv: and your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

tcz: Keima dounaa na kisah uva na chon khah uleh, keima tah in nat phalou jouse na gamsung ule na boncha chung uva, kalan sah ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
en_kjv: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times moe plagues upon you according to your sins.

tcz: Keima tah in na boncha chung uva gamsa hang jouse kahin hoilut peh diu, na chateu aboncha abah gamset diu, gancha jeng jong natha chai peh kei uva; na bonchauva na manthai cheh cheh diu, naki jotna jouseu jong thip del ding ahi.
en_web: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
en_kjv: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse nunga jong na khah doh thei lou uva, nei ki doupi nah lai uva ahileh,
en_web: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
en_kjv: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

tcz: Keiman na bonchauva kahin kile doupi diu, na chonset jaluva na bonchauva talent namat cheh diu, na pumpiuva kasuh gamset ding nahiuve.
en_web: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
en_kjv: then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

tcz: Kitepna phulahna chemjam hem chu na chunguva kahin jah jeng ding, Na khopi lai lung uva kikhom khom unlang aning aum jong leu chun, na boncha chung cheh uva natna huise hung lang in tin, chuteng na kidou piteu ma sanga nakun cheh diu ahi.
en_web: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
en_kjv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

tcz: Nang ho hinna changlhah mol chu kalah peh diu, nalah uva numei som seh seh in jong chang lhah pha bep cha bou anei diu, hichu kitup tah a atena toh kitoh chet a tepeh cheh cheh ding, naneh jeng vang uva oivanaa neh diu ahitapoi.
en_web: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
en_kjv: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

tcz: Kathu naki jah mosah uva, nei ki doupi nah laiyu ahileh,
en_web: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
en_kjv: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

tcz: Na chunguva lungsatna tothoa ka doudal diu, hiche chonsetna nanei jaluva ajat sagi vei nachung cheh uva lethuhna chu ding ahi.
en_web: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
en_kjv: then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

tcz: Na chateu tahsa geiya, numei kithei lou pasal kitheilouva nahin neh nah laidiu ahi.
en_web: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
en_kjv: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

tcz: Na chunguva munsang lai jouse kahin suh chim jeng ding, gim namtui na halvam nau maicham phung jeng jong kasuh jaldeh ding, hinkho lhum keiya ka kidah uva kathet ding nahiuve.
en_web: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
en_kjv: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

tcz: Na chennau khopi aboncha aching ding koima um louva kalha ding, muntheng lai nanei chengseo jong thipdel ding, nagim namtui lhut nam jengu jong kanah sahpeh lou ding nahiuve.
en_web: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
en_kjv: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

tcz: Gamsung pumpi akeuseh a um ding, nagam sunguva um nakidou piteuvin nalung don jeng diu ahi.
en_web: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.
en_kjv: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

tcz: Namtin chitin lah a kathejal sohhel diu, chemjam kalap a hajam a kajam sah diu, nagam sungu aboncha akeova umding, nakhopi jengu jong thip dela um ding ahi.
en_web: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
en_kjv: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

tcz: Na bonchauva na kidoupi teu gam'a na vaitham sung seuva na gamsung uchu thip dela koima um louva umding, chuteng agam sung pumpi chu kitha kimat ima louva choldam sel ding ahi.
en_web: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
en_kjv: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

tcz: Gamsung chu akeuva aum channa chol damsel ahin, ajeh chu nachen laiyuva cholngah nikho nanit tapouvin hijeh achu cholngah nikho banga chol damsel ding ahitai.
en_web: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
en_kjv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

tcz: Nalah uva kona athi moh cheng ahing nalai na kidou piteu gamsunga cheng ho jeng jong alungthimu kasuh nemdeh peh diu, nathu khat a kheh lhah a agin khu chemjam kilam banga tijat tothoa jam lele uva, mikhat seh del maimaia jong jamcheh ji diu ahi.
en_web: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
en_kjv: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

tcz: Koima del louva ama ho le ama ho kigela chemjam in adel banga jamcheh diu, khat le khat kinolhua jamcheh cheh jeng ding ahiuvin, na bonchauva naki doupiteu masang kitia nalhuh lhuh jeng diu ahi.
en_web: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
en_kjv: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

tcz: Namtin lah a navaitham gam kei diu, na kidou piteu gam leiset chun nasuh gamset jeng diu ahi.
en_web: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
en_kjv: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

tcz: Na kidou piteu gamsunga chengho ahing doh chengse jong chu achonset jaluva meidoi gamkei diu, apu apateu chonset a alhah nauva kona amaho jouse jong apu apateu akilo diu meidoi joukei diu ahi.
en_web: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
en_kjv: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

tcz: Abonchauva keima douna jeh’a chon khelna abol uva, keima eiki doupi uva joule nal thua achon uva apu apateu chonset phondohna neiya,
en_web: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,
en_kjv: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

tcz: Hitia achon khah tah jeh uva chu keiman jong akale lama lethuhna achung'uva ka lhunsah ding, akidoupi teu angsunga kapui lut nau ajehmpentah aphondoh thei ule; alung tahna jengu,jong aki suhnem thei uva, achonset nauva kona kisem thahna anei thei uleh,
en_web: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,
en_kjv: and that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

tcz: Jacob henga ka kitepna kageldoh kit ding chule Isaac toh ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, hitia chu Abraham henga ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, agam leiset pumpi jong kahin geldoh thaa ka huhdoh kit ding ahi.
en_web: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
en_kjv: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

tcz: Adalhahna agam sung pumpiu chu cholngah nikho tobanga anisih a choldamnaa aman chah diu, hitia chu chondan jouse nahsah moa akoi uva ahinkho sung uva keima doumah le kidahna achonset jouseova kona kisemphatna achunguva lhung ding ahi.
en_web: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
en_kjv: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse jal'a hi abonchauva akidou piteo gamsunga achen teng uleh, keiman jong abonchauva sumil louhela ka hebol cheh diu, ka kitepna jong umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen uchu kahi jing jenge, ati.
en_web: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
en_kjv: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God.

tcz: Amaho jouse Pathen kahi jing na dinga keima tah in Egypt gamsunga kona mi jouse mitmu changtah a kahin puigal kaiyu ahin, apu apateu chunga kana kitepna keiman achunguva gelkhohna kanei ding ahi, keima Pakai chu kahi jing jeng e, ati.
en_web: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”
