en_kjv: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.

tcz: Hiche chondan jouse ahin chonna dan jouse jaonan, danthu chengse toh Pakaiyin ama tah le Israel chate dinga akoichu ahitia, Mose henga ana thupeh chengse chu ahi.
en_web: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
en_kjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga chondan chengse hi asei peh in, kinop toh jeh a mihem khat chu Pakaiya dia kipeh dohna anei ding ahi, sum aki seijat hi apeh a kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the Lord by thy estimation.

tcz: Kitepna dungjui cheh le aki chepi bang banga pasal kum somni apat kumsom gup chan chu dangka somnga jaonan shekel jaonan sanaa kisem shekel somnga hichu muntheng laiya ding ahi.
en_web: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
en_kjv: And thy estimation shall be, of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

tcz: Chule numei ahileh amanu chun dangka somngaa kitepna anei ding ahi.
en_web: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
en_kjv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

tcz: Hitia chu Pasal kum nga apat somni chan, dangka somni hiding, numei vang chu dangka somkhat hiding ahi.
en_web: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
en_kjv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

tcz: Chule naosen kum nga apat noilam dangka cheng nga hi ding, numei ahileh dangka cheng thum hi ding ahi.
en_web: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
en_kjv: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

tcz: Amavang pasal kum somgup chunglam dangka somle nga hi ding, numei kum somgup chung lamse ahileh dangka somkhat a lhatdoh thei ahi.
en_web: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
en_kjv: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

tcz: Ahinlah hitobanga kitepna nei dingpa chun, hiche chepi ding chu angaplal banga ahileh, ana kikat dohsa mihempa chu thempu lama apui ding, chuteng thempu pan aman ato khambep ateppeh ding, hiche mipan ajokham ding chu atep peh ding ahi.
en_web: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
en_kjv: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

tcz: Amavang hiche kitepna hi gancha peh ding toh kisaiya kitepna nei ding ahileh, Pakai lama santhei ding, hitia chu Pakaiya dia kipe dohsa chu atheng ahi.
en_web: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.
en_kjv: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.

tcz: Kitepna neipa chun gancha chu aphajo ding gelna jal'a adang khat a akhel thei lou ding, apeh khel dia aum jong leh, akatdoh masat le akhel dia akatdoh chu ania atheng ahi.
en_web: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.
en_kjv: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

tcz: Pakai lama katdoh theilou hichu gancha theng lou kitepna ahi vangleh, kitepna nei dingpa chun agancha chu thempupa heng lama akai ding ahi.
en_web: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;
en_kjv: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

tcz: Thempu pan aman lutdan le aman lut lou dan atetoh ding, thempu pan aphatsah dungjuiya hichu achaina hi ding ahi.
en_web: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
en_kjv: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

tcz: Ahinlah akatdoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, aman jat jaonaa jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding ahi.
en_web: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
en_kjv: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

tcz: Chule mi koi hileh a in atheng dinga Pakai henga apehdoh noma ahileh, in ahoi dan le ahoi loudan dungjuiya thempu pan jong atetoh chet ding, thempu pan atetoh bang banga chu achaina hi jeng ding ahi.
en_web: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
en_kjv: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

tcz: In pedoh pa chun akile lhatdoh noma ahileh, aman sum leh jakhat lah a somni chu toh ale peh tha jeng ding ahi. Hichea bouchu akitepna banga lechan thei ding ahi.
en_web: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
en_kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

tcz: Chule koi ham khat chun Pakaiya dia agam beh khat tou apeh doh noma ahileh, hiche gambeh khat chu muchi kitu lutjat ding toh atetoh a, chuteng suhlou chang shekel somni ki tulutna thei gambeh chu sum somkhat man jat atepeh ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
en_kjv: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: a homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

tcz: Thil kile pehna kum kut kon chaa apeh doh khah ahile vang, aki tepehna banga aman jat jong lhingset a apeh ding ahi.
en_web: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
en_kjv: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

tcz: Ahinlah agambeh chu apat a alhat doh jou louva ahileh, thil kile pehna kum kut ahung lhun kahsea dinga thempu pan aman jat atetoh peh ding, aman hichea chu lhat dohna anei thei ding ahi.
en_web: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
en_kjv: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

tcz: Agam beh pedoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, sum aman jat bang banga jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding, hichea bouchu lechan thei ding ahi.
en_web: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
en_kjv: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

tcz: Pakai henga chodoh louva midang kom khat touva agam beh chu ajoh doh khah bang leh, hichu itih chan hijong leh akile lhatdoh thei talou ding ahi.
en_web: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
en_kjv: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

tcz: Amavang thil kile peh to kum ahung lhung ding, chuting leh imatih chana Pakai gambeh mong monga um ding, hitia chu thempu pan ama neiya akisim ding ahi.
en_web: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
en_kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

tcz: Chule koi hileh aki chodohsa gambeh khattou Pakaiya dia apehdoh noma ahileh, hichu ama gambeh hilou ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
en_kjv: And if a man sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

tcz: Hitia chu thempu pan thil man lepeh kum ahung lhun ding to kitoh a aman jat atepeh
en_web: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.
en_kjv: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the Lord.

tcz: Thil kilepeh na kum ahung lhun teng leh, hiche gambeh chu aneisa pa ahilouleh aki naipi henga lepeh kit ding ahi.
en_web: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
en_kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

tcz: Thilman ho aboncha chondan dungjuiya akiman dan bang banga ale teppeh cheh ding, hichu Gerah somni jaona shekel toh kitoh ding ahi.
en_web: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
en_kjv: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

tcz: Gancha masa jouse aboncha Pakaiya ding bou ahin, hicheng chu aboncha koima chan atum beh a apehdoh thei lou ding, bong nou hihen kelngoi nou hihen, kelnou hi jeng jong leh hichu aboncha Pakaiya bou ahi.
en_web: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.
en_kjv: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord’s.

tcz: Amavang gancha thenglou masa vang chu akile lhatdoh thei ding, amanjat chule jakhat lah a somni chutoh apehtha ding, ahinlah ale lhat dohtah louva ahile, chonna dan dungjuiya midang khat henga ajoh thei ding ahi.
en_web: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
en_kjv: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

tcz: Hitia chun mihem ahin, gancha hihen, gambeh jeng jong, ajeh um louva Pakaiya dia kipeh dohsa chu koiman ale lhat thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.

tcz: Ajeh beihela Pakaiya kitoh doh chu mihem jeng jong kiledoh thei louva, thina chan sah jeng ding ahi.
en_web: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.
en_kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Lhosohga chang ahin, thingga hihen, ipi chu hi jongleh gamga jouse chu hopsom lah a hop khat vang Pakaiya ding ahi.
en_web: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.
en_kjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord’s: it is holy unto the Lord.

tcz: Koi hileh thil somakhat kipeh dohsa le choh nom aum leh, chonna ngai banga aman jat jaonan jakhat lah a somni alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
en_kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

tcz: Hitobang chun gancha jouse som lah a khat chu Pakaiya ding ahin, hitia chu gancha kiti phot, som lhinna jouse aboncha khat chu Pakaiya ding ahi.
en_web: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.
en_kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.

tcz: Gancha neipan jong agancha hochu ahoi leh apha alhen chil lou ding, alhen kah le lou ding ahi. Gancha khat khela chu achom khat apeh khah bang leh ani tah a Pakai chang jeng ding. ale lhat thei lou ding ahitai.
en_web: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”
en_kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

tcz: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte henga Pakayin Sinai molchunga Mose athupeh ahi.
en_web: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
en_kjv: These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

tcz: Israelten Egypt gamsung ahin dalhah kal u kum khat ahung lhin chun Pathen in Sinai gamthip a houbuh a chun Mose ahoulimpi tan ahi. Hichu alhani channa nikho masapen ni ahin, Pakaiyin hitin asei peh e,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

tcz: “Israel namsung pumpi a kon in aphung cheh uva kon a gal hangsanho leh ainsung mihou min jouseu aumden ding in jihlut cheh in. Pasalho jouse chu jihlut soh hel in.
en_web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,
en_kjv: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

tcz: Kum somni apat chunglam gal boltheiho jouse chu Nang le Aaronnin amin u najihlut teitei lhon ding,
en_web: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
en_kjv: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

tcz: chuleh hiche phungho jouse lah a kon a chu lamkai khat cheh in nangma nakithopi ding ahi.
en_web: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
en_kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

tcz: “Hiche phungho a kon a Lamkai hohi nakithopi dingho chu ahiuve. Reuben Shedeur chapa Elizur
en_web: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
en_kjv: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

tcz: Simeon Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel
en_web: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
en_kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

tcz: Judah Anminadab chapa Nahshon
en_web: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
en_kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

tcz: Issachar Zuar chapa Nethanael
en_web: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
en_kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

tcz: Zebulun Helon chapa Eliab
en_web: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
en_kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

tcz: Joseph chapa Ephraim Ammihud chapa Elishama Joseph chapa Manasseh Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel
en_web: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
en_kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

tcz: Benjamin Gideoni chapa Abidan
en_web: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
en_kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

tcz: Dan Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer
en_web: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
en_kjv: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

tcz: Asher Ocran chapa Pagiel
en_web: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
en_kjv: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

tcz: Gad Deuel chapa Eliasaph
en_web: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

tcz: Naphtali Enan chapa Ahira
en_web: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
en_kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

tcz: Amahohi japilah akon a kilhengdoh lamkai cheh, apu apa phung kailhah a pat lamkaiho chuleh Israelte phung hoa kon a mi upa cheh ahiuve.”
en_web: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
en_kjv: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

tcz: Hichun lamkai kilhen doh chengse chu Mose le Aaron in akou khom lhonin,
en_web: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

tcz: hiche nikho ma ma chun Israelte jalhang pumpin jong akhom tup lhonin ahi. Mipiho jouse chu ama ama phung leh insung cheh kailhah a konin amin akijihlut cheh in ahi. Pathen in Mose athupeh bangin, Israel pasal kum somnia pat chunglamse chu khat khatnin akijihlut in ahi.
en_web: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.
en_kjv: and they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

tcz: Hitichun Mose in amaho min jouse Sinai gamthip lai mun a chun anasutup soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
en_kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Ama ama phung dungjui cheh a amin u kijihlut bang a pasal kum somnia pat achunglam galsat a konthei amijatho chu hicheng hi ahi. Phung Mijat Reuben (Jacob chapa tahpen) 46,500
en_web: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
en_kjv: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war; those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Israel phung somleni lamkaiho toh Mose le Aaron in akhumlut u pasalho cheng hi abonchauva ama ama phung chilhah dungjui cheh a kikhumlut cheh ahi uve.
en_web: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.
en_kjv: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

tcz: Amaho chu ama ama insung duijui cheh a kikhumlut ahiuve - Israelte pasal kiti pou kum somni apat chunglam gal bolthei jouse hi abonchauva a insung dung jui'a kijihlut cheh ahiuve.
en_web: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—
en_kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

tcz: Amaho chu agomma 603,550 ahiuve.
en_web: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
en_kjv: even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche kisim khomna a hin Levite vang apang pon ahi,
en_web: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.
en_kjv: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

tcz: Ajehchu, Pathen in Mose kom hitihin ana seiyin ahi,
en_web: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Min najihlut teng Levite hi najihlut loubeh ding, Israel mite lah a nasim tha loubeh ding ahi.
en_web: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
en_kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh le aki mangcha thilho aboncha a Levite mopohna napehding, nachena chan uva Ponbuh le aman chah chengse aboncha amahon apoh uva, akimvella ngahmun semtoh thoa alhacha a pang ding ahiuve.
en_web: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
en_kjv: but thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of Testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

tcz: Kikhop khomna ngahmun chon phat alhin teng, Levi chapate cheng in aphet lhah diu, hitia chu ngahmun nalhun teng uleh amahon thah sondoh kit diu, ama vang koi hileh phalna beiya kikhop khomna ponbuh ganailut behseh chan chu thiding ahi.
en_web: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
en_kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

tcz: Phung jousen ama ama insung ponlap cheh utoh ngahmun akisem diu ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

tcz: Israel pumpi chung a Pakai lunghan louna dinga Levi chapaten vang kitepna ponbuh kimvella ngahmun akisem cheh uva avetsui diu ahi. Hitia chu hiche ponbuh ventupna chu Levite mopohna hiding ahi.
en_web: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
en_kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of Testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of Testimony.

tcz: Hitichun Pathen in Mose henga athupeh bangtah chun Israel chaten emajouse aboltauvin ahi.
en_web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron chu thu hicheng a hin hilchahna aneitan ahi:
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

tcz: “Israelten ngahmun asem teng uleh, ama ama phung kai cheh a umding ahiuve. Aphung phung leh ama ama insung micheng chu ama ama ponbuh noija khosa cheh ding ahiuve. Aphung aphung a kihomtohho chun angahmun cheh uchu kikhop khomna houbuh pangli kiemvel a akisem ding u ahi, hinlah hichu kikahjep hiding ahi.
en_web: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.
en_kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh niso lama ngahmun semding phungho chu Judah, Issachar leh Zebulun hidiu ahi. Anoia hohi amin kikhum galsat ding jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Judah Amminadab chapa Nahshon 74,600
en_web: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab. His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah. And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Judah phung lamkaina noiya galsat mi ahung kikhom jat chu mihem 186,400 ahi. Israelten ngahmun thah ajot a asemji teng uleh hiche phung thumho leh alamkai hou hi mapui a pang ding u ahi.
en_web: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
en_kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

tcz: Reuben, Simeon leh Gad chu kikhop khomna ponbuh lhanglam a ngahmun sem a pangding phungho chu ahiuvin, aphungjem u noi cheh a um cheh ding ahiuve. Anoia hohi galsat ding a amin kikhum jat, aphungmin uleh alamkai hou chu ahiuve. Reuben Shedeur chapa Elizur 46,500 Simeon Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel 59,300
en_web: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur. His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred. “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. en_web: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
en_kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

tcz: Amaho lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.

en_kjv: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: “Kohath hon Houbuh sunga anatoh ding u chu manchah thil athenga umho jouse vettupna chungchang chu ahi.
en_web: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
en_kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

tcz: Amahon ngahmun u achon ding teng ule Houbuh maicham sunnung pondal chu Aaron le achaten alahlhah diu kitepna thingkong khuna a anei ding u ahi.
en_web: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
en_kjv: and when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of Testimony with it:

tcz: Chuteng hiche pondal chu kelcha vun kisuhtah a atom dingu, hiche ho jouse chu pondum khatseh a apha chansoh ding u ahi. Chiho jouse kichai teng thingkhong chu aputna thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
en_web: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
en_kjv: and shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

tcz: “Abankit a Changlhah a umpi jing ahiu melchihna, hiche Changlhah kikoina dokhang chunga pondum khat aphajal ding u ahi. chuleh hiche pon kipha chung a chu lheng kongho, gimnamtui halna lhengho, khonho, tui lhitthengna, chuleh deisahtah a aumjing jeng changlhah ho kikoi ding ahi.
en_web: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
en_kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

tcz: Amahon hicheho jouse chu ponsan a akhu diu, chutengle kelchavun thengsel'a hiche ponsan chu kikhuson kit diu ahi. Chujouteng dokhang chu aputna ding thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
en_web: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
en_kjv: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

tcz: Hicheban jom a chu amahon pondum-eng achu thaomei khum chu ahin khu a, thaomei semtohna, achoina kong, chuleh Olive thao kikoina khon jong chu akhu khum dingu ahi.
en_web: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
en_kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

tcz: Chule amahon pondum a chu thaomei khom leh athil manchah ho jouse chu kelchavun thengsel'a atom khum uva chuleh hiche alom chu akiputna kolchahna chung a chu akoi ding u ahi.
en_web: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
en_kjv: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

tcz: “Chuban leh pondum khat a sana gimnamtui maicham kilhaina chung a aphajal ding u, kelchavun thengsel'a hiche pon chu akhu diu ahi. Chuteng aputna ding thinglhon toh maicham chu asuhto ding u ahi.
en_web: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
en_kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

tcz: Maicham kin a dia manchah akigongtuplou laise chu pondum khat a tomding, kelchavun thengsel khat a hiche pon chu kitomson ding, chuteng aputna kolchah a chu kikoi ding ahi.
en_web: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
en_kjv: and they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:

tcz: “Amahon kilhaina ding a maicham phung a kon a vutvam hochu alodoh diu, chule ponsandup a maicham phung chu atom diu ahi.
en_web: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
en_kjv: and they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

tcz: Maicham thilkeuho jouse - meihalna kong, thihkhe, leilodohna longkhol, kisilna kongho, chuleh thilkoina ho jouse - pon chung a chu kikoi a, chuleh kelchavun thengsel chu hiche ho chung a chu kiphajal a kikhu ding ahi. Chuteng aputna thingjol chutoh asuhto ding u ahi.
en_web: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
en_kjv: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

tcz: Aaron le achapaten munthengho ahin, atheng a um thil le lo ho ahin, ahintom jousoh teng ule ngahmun a kon a kitol theidiu ahitai. Kohath chapaten hiche hi lhun nading mun chan ahin putdiu ahi. Ahivang a thil theng hochu asuhkhah louhel ding u ahi, achuti louleh thilo ding ahiuve. Hichengse hi Kohath chapaten houbuh a kona aput diu ho chu ahi.
en_web: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Aaron chapa Eleazer thempupa mopohna chu thaomei khom a thaotuiho, gim namtui ho, niseh a kitoh lhosoh thiltoho, kinuding thaotui ho avettup jing ding ahi. Houbuh pumpi leh asung thil ijakai, muntheng le muntheng a akimangcha jouse chu Eleazar vettup na noi a um ding ahi.
en_web: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
en_kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

en_kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

tcz: Muntheng pen thil ho ahin nailut teng a thilou nadiuva nang in hiche hi nabolpeh ding ahi. Aaron le achapaten aki lhonlutpi jing diu chule amichang cheh a atoding abol ding u chu napeh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;
en_kjv: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

en_web: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
en_kjv: but they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

en_kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

en_web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Gershon chilhahte chu japi natohna a leh thilgih domding ho chung a mopoding ahiuve.
en_web: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
en_kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

tcz: Amahon Houbuh pondal ho jouse apoh diu, Houbuh jong aki tomna pon puma, kelcha vuntheng sel a akitomna pum a, chuleh houbuh lutna kotphung a pondal toh ahinpoh tha diu ahi.
en_web: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
en_kjv: and they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

tcz: Houbuh polama ahin amalam ahin houbuh leh maicham phung vel'a pondal ho jouse jong, khaoho ahin, chuleh amaho natoh toh kisai a amanchah hou jouse ahi. Hicheho jouse chung a hi Gershon chilhahten avettup diuva mopohna chang ahiuve
en_web: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
en_kjv: and the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

tcz: Aaron le achapate mopohna Gershonten amopohna hou jouse, thil dople ding hihen, natohna dang dang tohna ding hijongle Aaron leh achapaten akomu peh jing diu ahi. Gershon chilhahten thilgih putna ding a jong ngansena apeh ding u ahi.
en_web: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
en_kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

tcz: Hichengse hi Gershon chilhahten Houbuh sunga atohdiu kipe chu ahin, Ama hohi Aaron thempupa chapa Ithanar vetsuina noi a umdiu ahi.
en_web: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
en_kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

tcz: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
en_web: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
en_kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

tcz: Amaho chapate lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.

en_kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

tcz: chukit jongle houbu kimvel a pal khomho leh atotheh ho, akikhainaho le khaoho chuleh amaho natoh toh kisaiya amanchah ho jouseu jong avettup ding u ahi.
en_web: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.
en_kjv: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

tcz: Hichengse hi Merari chilhahten Houbuh sunga atohdiu kipe chu ahin, Ama hohi Aaron thempupa chapa Ithanar vetsuina noi a umdiu ahi.
en_web: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
en_kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

tcz: Hichun Mose, Aaron chule phung lamkai hon Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou anasim un anajih lut tauvin ahi.
en_web: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
en_kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

en_kjv: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

tcz: Chule amaho chu agom a mi 2,750 ahiuve.
en_web: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
en_kjv: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

tcz: Hicheng hi Kohath chilhah ho lah a Houbuh a natong thei cheh ding a lhin na nei ho ahiuve. Pathen in Mose athupeh bang in Mose le Aaron in jong ajihdoh lhon in ahi.
en_web: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
en_kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

en_kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.

en_kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

en_web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
en_kjv: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

tcz: Pathen in Mose thu apeh dungjuiya, aminhou jouseu jihlut a aumphat chun, pasal khat cheh chu atoh ding dol cheh uleh apoh ding dol cheh u akipecheh tauvin ahi. Hitichun Pathen in Mose thu apeh bangtah in min kijihlutna natoh chu akichai tai.
en_web: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin thu hichengse hi Mose hilchahna anei e:
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Israel mipite lah a koi hijong leh tiphah nei, boina nei, ahilouleh mithilong suhkhah jeh a chonna dan dungjui a athenglou a uma ahileh, ngahmun chu adalhah sah nading uvin thu pen.
en_web: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.
en_kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

tcz: Hiche thupeh hi numei leh pasal chung a umgel ding ahi. Ngahmun a amaho lah a cheng kahin, asuhboh lou nading un amaho chu koidoh un.”
en_web: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”
en_kjv: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose thu apeh bang chun Israel mipiten hitobang hochu ngahmun a kon in akoimang, hiti chun aboltauve.
en_web: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Anoija hilchahna chengse hi Israel mipite pen: Pasal hihen, numei hihen, koi hijeng jongleh, midang chung a thilphalou bol a Pathen joulhep a chu themmo chang a ahitai.
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;

tcz: Amahon achonsetnau aphondoh teitei diu chuleh athilbol khel cheng chu aboncha a aledit ding ahi. Hiche chungvum a asuhkhel na pachu asuhkhelna jakhat lah a 20 abelap peh nalai ding ahi.
en_web: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
en_kjv: then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

tcz: Ahinlah aki suhkhel napa chu athi tah a, asuhkhel ho dit nading asopi a-u, a-nao aumtah louva ahile, pehdinga umjouse chu Pathen ding ahitan chuleh thempuho kipe ding ahiuve. Themmona neiho vang chun Pakai henga kilheina dia kelngoinou ahin kai ding, chuteng suhtheng a umdiu, Pathen toh kicham diu ahi.
en_web: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.
en_kjv: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

tcz: Israelten pumgo thilto ahin poh jouseu aboncha a ama chanding ahi.
en_web: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
en_kjv: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

tcz: Atheng a kipehna a hung kitohho jouse aman asan chan chu, ama ama thempu cheh chun akikoi ding ahiye.

en_web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
en_kjv: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

tcz: Bongchal nou khat, kelchal khat chule kelngoi achal kum khat lhingsa chu pumgo maichamma a ding in,
en_web: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
en_kjv: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

tcz: chule kelchal khat chonset kithoina maicham a pang ding in ahinkai in ahi.

en_kjv: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:

en_web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.
en_kjv: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

tcz: Nisom le ni lhinna in Enan chapa Ahira, Napthali phung lamkaipan amaicham ahin tohdoh in ahi.
en_web: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,
en_kjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

tcz: Ahira in sana dangka jaonan gimnamtui toh ahin toh doh in ahi.
en_web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
en_kjv: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

en_web: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
en_kjv: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

en_web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
en_kjv: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

tcz: Israel a phung lamkai hon maichamphung thao ana kinu a kilhandohna maicham dia ahintodoh hou chu: Sumeng lheng kong len som le ni, Sumeng kisilna kong som le ni, Gimnamtui kikholna Sana lhengkongho ahiuve.
en_web: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;
en_kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

tcz: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sumeng lhengkong len khat gihdan chu 3-1/4 pounds ahin chuleh Sumeng kisilna kong khat gihdan chu 1-3/4 pounds ahi. Sumeng mong mong agihdan chu 60 pounds ahi.
en_web: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
en_kjv: each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

tcz: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sana lhengkong somleni khat cheh gimnamtui jaona a agihdan chu 4 ounces ahin. Sana mong mong agom a agihdan chu 3 pounds ahi.
en_web: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;
en_kjv: the golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

tcz: Bongchal anou somleni, kelngoi achal lhingset somleni, kum khat lhing cheh kelngoi achal som le ni pumgo thilto a ding in ahung kitoh in, todoh ding a umsa lhosoh maicham jong ahi. Chonset kilheina maicham ding in kelcha achal som le ni ahung kikailut in ahi.
en_web: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
en_kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

tcz: Chamna maicham ding in Bongchal somni le li, kelngoi achal lhingset somgup, kelchal somgup, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal somgup ahung kitohdoh in ahi. Hicheng hi maicham phung thao akinu jouva maicham phung a dia kikatdohna maicham dia hung kitohho ahi.
en_web: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.
en_kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

tcz: Mose chu Pakai toh kihou ding a Houbuh sunga alutji teng, aman houpina awgin thingkhong akhu (Themmona akon a themchanna mun - Kitepna thingkhong chung a kinga) chung a Cherubim teni lailung a kon chun aja jin ahi. Hiche lai mun a kon a chu Pakai in amachu ahin houpi ji ahiye.
en_web: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
en_kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of Testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Aaron in hiche hilchahna ho hi pe in: Thaomei khom sagi chu atunna a natundoh teng le, amalam ma thaomei khom mailah chu a salvah jou nading nading in tundoh in.”
en_web: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
en_kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

tcz: Aron in chutichun aboltan ahi. Thaomei khom Sagiho chun amailam salvahna din Pakaiyin Mose henga asei bang bang chun atungdohtan ahi.
en_web: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiche thaomei khom aboncha a, akhombul apat ajem kisemna changei chu sana kikhen a kisemdoh ahi. Hiche hi Pathen in Mose alim umding dol avetsah bangtah a kisem a ahi.
en_web: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.
en_kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahisei in,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Tun Israel mipi adangho jouse a kon in Levite tumkhen inlang, chonna dan ngai bang in sutheng sohkei in.
en_web: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
en_kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

tcz: Kisuhtheng na tui chu nathinkhum ding, amaho apumpiuva atahsa uva amul jouseu kivoumui diu chule amanchah jing apon hou akisoptheng diu ahi. Hitia chu abolteng uleh chonna dol a atheng a ahitauve.
en_web: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
en_kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

tcz: Bongchal gol khat leh lhosohga maicham a kon a changbong Olive thao a kisunum chip chep, chule Bongchal golkhat mama toh chonset kilheina maicham a ding a ahin to dingu ahi.
en_web: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
en_kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

tcz: Chuteng Israel nam mite jouse chu nakhopkhom a Houbuh kotphung a umdia Levite chu na peh doh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

tcz: Pathen na dinga Levite chu napeh doh teng le, Israel miten amaho chunga chu akhut u angap diu ahi.
en_web: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
en_kjv: and thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

tcz: Aaron in akhut teni adopsanga Israel mipite lah a kon a Levite chu Pathen a dinga atumbeh a katohna aneiding, hitiachu Pathen lhacha natong ding a lhandohna anei ding ahi.
en_web: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.
en_kjv: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche jouteng chule Levite jousen Bongnou achalni chung nga khut ngapna anei diu, Bongchalnou khat chu chule chonset maicham kisem chu pumgo maicham kisem na ding ahin, Pathen henga Levite chun ki suhtheng na anei diu cham dela umdiu ahiye.
en_web: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
en_kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.

tcz: Aaron le achaten Levite chu Amaho ma sanga adin sah uva, akhot u adop sang jou teng uleh Pathen masanga loupi tah’a maicham a sempeh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.
en_kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.

tcz: Levite chu Israel mipi telah akonna natum khandoh diu, ajeh chu amaho keija umjing diu ahi.
en_web: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
en_kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

tcz: Hi chengse kichai teng, Houbuh sunga chu lut diu ana toh diu ijakai ajom thei diu ahi tai. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu asuh thenga na pehdoh ahi tan nangma heng nga loupi tah ana peh doh ahi tai.
en_web: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
en_kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

tcz: Israel mipite ding in Levite hi keima dinga kikoisa ahin Israelte chi lhah’a pang masa pen ho chu keima kona phondoh le lhen doh tum ahi tai. Levite chu numei chilhah apat kilah doh ahiye.
en_web: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
en_kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

tcz: Israel mipite lah’a peng masapen mihem pasal ahin gancha hi jong leh keima ahi soh keiyin, Egypt mite pasal chapa masapen jouse kana suhmang nia pat chun keima dinga kana gontup sa ahi tai.
en_web: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
en_kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

tcz: Levite phung hi keiman Israelte lah’a chapa peng masa penna ka koi ahi tai.
en_web: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

tcz: Aaron le achate ho hi Levite vetup ding nga ki sem ahi tai. Israelte tha khel lah maicham Houbuh a kin theng na tong ding ahiuvin, pumgo maichamma kisuh thengna kin thenga a na tong le ding mong mong ahiuve.
en_web: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
en_kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

tcz: Mose Aaron chule Israel mipi jousen Levite chu alheng doh un Pathen in amaho thu apeh dung juiyin abol tauvin ahi.
en_web: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
en_kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

tcz: Leviten achonset na’u chu aki soptheng uvin chule aponsil ho jong aki noilhah un. Pathen masang nga loupi tah in maicham asem peh tai. Aaron in amaho chu maicham athengsel na ding uvin abolpeh in ajeh chu Pathen toh chamdela aum na diu ahiye.
en_web: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
en_kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

tcz: Chu teng Levite chu Houbuh maicham’a sunglha diu kintheng na toh apat diu, Aaron le achaten aki thopi diu ahiye. Amaho thu nit ding aki pat jouse Pathen in Levite jui dinga Mose ahin hetsah ho chun anit soh keiyun ahi.
en_web: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
en_kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

tcz: Chu in PakaiyinMose hengah hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Hiche dan hi Leviten anit’u ngaijin, Houbuh sunga chu kintheng na toh apat na diuva chu kum-somni le nga beh alhin’u ngaiding ahiye.
en_web: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
en_kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

tcz: Chule Levite chu kum-somnga alhin teng ule kichol thei ding ahitauve.
en_web: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,
en_kjv: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

tcz: Levite chu akichol joulam teng ule asopiu aloi agol hon Houbuh kimvella ajenle a jong pangthei nalaiju ahi. Ahin lah akintheng na tong vang pang thai ta lou ding ahi. Hi chengse hi Levite kin theng natoh na muna aman chah diu dan ahiye.
en_web: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”
en_kjv: but shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

tcz: Israelte chu Egypt a patna ahung kichon doh jou kum khat ahung lhing chun Sinai lhang a gamthip lah a chun Pakaiyin Mose kom a ahin seiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

tcz: Kalchuh kut kiman na ding phat kitepna a hi aman ding uvin Israel mite chu seipeh tan ,
en_web: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
en_kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

tcz: hichu lha masa pen nisom le nili lhina a khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hiche kipathanop kibol ding dan thupeh ho leh dan umho phate a najui sah ding ahi.
en_web: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”
en_kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

tcz: Mosen jong mipi henga kalchuh kut kipa golnop abol ding uvin aseipeh tan ahi,
en_web: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.
en_kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

tcz: ajeh chu Sinai lhang gamthip lah a nisomle nili ahung lhin a khovah chip chep in ahinphah den un ahitai. Pathen in Mose thu apeh bang bang chun amahon jong kipagolnop chu aboltauvin ahi.
en_web: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
en_kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

tcz: Ahinlah ama ho lah a mi phabep chun mithi long ana thamkhah jeh un, chonna ngai bang in akisuboh a ahitauvin, hiche nikho a Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a chun alha thei tapouve. Hiche nikho chun Mose leh Aaron kom a ahung un
en_web: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.
en_kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

tcz: “keihon mithi long ka tham khah tah jeh un, chonna ngai banga atheng louva ka hi tauve. Hijong leh Israel mipin asem leng a keihon jong Pathen ang a maicham kasem mo diu ham?” ahungtiuvin ahi.
en_web: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
en_kjv: and those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

tcz: Mose chun a donbut, “Nangho ding a Pathen a kon a hilchahna kamu kah khongai un” ati.
en_web: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose ahin donbutna chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: “Hiche hilchahna ho hi Israel mipite seipeh in: Tukhang hihen lang khang hunglhung ding ho hijongleh chonna ngai bang a akisuhboh kha hihen, kholgam a chedoh ho hijongleh Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a pangthei ding u ahi.
en_web: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.

tcz: Kalchuhkut kipa golnop kichai lhakhat lhin teng kalchuh kut maicham thilto abol ding u ahi, hichu lhani lhinna a nisom le nili lhinna khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hicheteng chuleh Kalchuh kut kelngoi sa chu anche kha le cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha dingu ahi.
en_web: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
en_kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

tcz: Amahon kelngoi chu jingkah khovah geija akoi thei lou ding u, chuleh hiche agu jong asuh boh thei lou dingu ahiye. Kalchuh kut kiman na chungchang a dan umho hi ajui cheh ding u ahi.
en_web: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
en_kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

tcz: “Ahin Israelmi hiya chon na ngai a aboh jong hilou, kholche a jin doh jong hilou, ahivang a Kalchuh kut nahsah lou miho chu Israel nampi akonna kah lhah’a umding ahi. Pathen maicham jong aphat tah ahin todoh lou leh achonsetna jal a themmo chang a um ding ahiuve.
en_web: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
en_kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

tcz: Nangho lah a nam dangmi Kalchuh kut golnop a jaonom aumleh, nit ding leh jui ding a kipe jouse hi anit ngaiyin, hiche dan hin Israel nam chilhah a kon hihenlang, gamdang chilhah a kon a koi hijongle akan soh kei ding ahi.
en_web: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”
en_kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

tcz: Houbuh ahin phudoh nikho uchun, meilom in Houbuh chu atom tan ahi. Houbuh chung nga meilom nilhah apat jingkah geiya umchu meikong lomtoh abang jeng in ahi.
en_web: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
en_kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the Testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

tcz: Hiche meilom houbuh chung a um, jan tengle meikong alom a hung kilah ji tobang chun aum jing tan ahi.
en_web: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
en_kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

tcz: Houbuh chunga meilom chu akihohdal ji teng, Israel mipiten hiche amaicham ponbuh chu aphet lhah jiuvin meibol lom chu ajui ji uvin ahi. Chuleh hiche meilom akingah ngah na a chun Israel mipi ten ngahmun akisemkit jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
en_kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

tcz: Hitichun che ding a Pathen thupeh amu dung juiyin lam ajot un, ngahmun asa jiuvin ahi. chuleh houbuh chung a meilom aum chan chun ngahmun dalhalouvin aum jiuvin ahi.
en_web: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
en_kjv: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in the tents.

tcz: Hiche meilom chu Houbuh chung nga nisot tah aum ji teng Israel techu akichol jiuvin Pathen Houna dinga atoh ding umho chu atong jiuvin ahi.
en_web: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.
en_kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.

tcz: Phatkhat khat teng Pathen thupeh dungjui in meilom chu Houbuh chung nga ni chom chacha bou akingaji in, amaho jong ni chomcha bou akichol jiuve. Chuteng Pathen thupeh dung in ngahmun chu aphet lha uvin ache jomkit jitauvin ahi.
en_web: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.
en_kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.

tcz: Phat chomkhat kit teng Meilom chu jankhovah in aum in Jingkah teng akichon doh jin ahi. Ahinlah sun hihen jan hita jong leh hiche meilom chu ahung ki hohdoh teng ngahmun chu aphetlha jiuvin ache jom jingji un ahi.
en_web: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
en_kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

tcz: Houbuh maicham chunga meilom chu ni ni umhen, lhakhat umhen, ahilouleh kumkhat umjong leh, Israel mipite chu ngahmun na chun aki chol jing jiuvin apotdoh jipouvin ahi. Amavang Meilom chu Houbuh chunga ahung kihoh dal teng ngahmun chu aphet un achejom kit jitauvin ahi.
en_web: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
en_kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

tcz: Hitichun Pakai thupeh bangtah in akichol un, akalsong jing un ahi, chule Pathen in Mose a kon a athupeh jouse chu abolkim soh jing un ahi.
en_web: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
en_kjv: At the commandment of the Lord they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Mipi ho koukhomna ding leh ponbuh phetlhahna ding a melchihna a manchah din dangka sehcha a kikhengjol pengkul ni sem doh in.
