en_web: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.
en_kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece thou shalt make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

tcz: Hiche Pengkul teni chu ahung kimut ji teng mipi ho chu Houbuh lutna kotphung a nangma masang nga hungkhom ji ding u ahi.
en_web: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Ahinlah pengkul khat bou chu ahung kimut tah vangleh Lamkai hobou - Israel phung lamkai jouse atahsa tah uva na masang a hung kilah cheh diu ahi.
en_web: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
en_kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

tcz: Nangma in hiche gin a chu hetsahna nanei teng, Houbuh a kon solam a ngahmun nei phung ho chun angahmun u chu aphet lhah uva malam a chu che jom ding ahiuve.
en_web: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
en_kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

tcz: Nangma in hiche gin a hetsahna anivei channa nanei teng lhanglam a ngahmun neihon ajui ding u ahi. Achejom jing ding u hetsahana a chu nangman agin chom naginsah ding ahi.
en_web: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
en_kjv: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

tcz: Ahinlah mipi kikhom khom hen nati teng, pengkul chu awgin chomjep in mut in.
en_web: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
en_kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

tcz: Aaron chilhah, thempu ho bou chun pengkolho amut thei ding u ahiye. Hiche hi nanga ding a akhang akhang a aumden jing ding leh nitjing ding dan chu ahi.
en_web: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
en_kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

tcz: “Nangma ho gamsung nga na hung lut uva, nangho doujing namelmateho sat ding a nakon doh ding teng uleh pengkulho kigottup nadia naginsah diu ahi. Hiche teng chu leh na Pakaiyin na hin geldoh ding, na melmate akonna nahuh doh ding ahi.
en_web: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
en_kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

tcz: Na pengkulho chu kipa thanop phat na jong na mut ging ding, kumsung a kipa golnop ho leh lha thah hung ki sim pan phat ho a jong namut ging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho chu kipana maicham kisem phat hihen, pumgo maicham kibol sih hijongle hiche maichamho chung a chu namutging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho gin chun na Pathen ana kitepna hin gel doh sah ding ahi. Keima na Pakai, Pathen chu ka hiye.”
en_web: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
en_kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.

tcz: Kumni jouva Israelte Egypt gam a konna ahung dohnau - alhani channa a ni somni alhinni chun - meilom chu kitepna ponbuh akon chun akikhang doh tan ahi.
en_web: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the Testimony.

tcz: Hijehchun Israel mipi chun Sinai gamthip lah a kon in ahungdoh un Paran gamthiplah aphah uva meilom akingah masang sen mun chom chom in ana kitol le le un ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

tcz: Mose in Pakaiya kon hilchahna amu bang tah a, Israel mipi ho amasapen a ding a ahung kitol pan un chun,
en_web: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
en_kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Judate aloiloi a um ho chun aponlap noi uva lam akai un ahi. Chuleh alamkai uva pang chu Aminadab chapa Nahshon ahi.
en_web: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
en_kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

tcz: Amaho banjom chu Issacharte ahiuvin, a hin Lamkai a chu Nathanel kitipa Zuar chapa ahi.
en_web: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

tcz: Chule Zebulun chilhah hon ajom un, Helon chapa Eliab chu ahinlamkai in ahi.
en_web: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

tcz: Hichun Houbuh chu aphet lha uvin Levite sung a kon a Gershon te le Merari te chun houbuh apo uvin abanjom in acheuvin ahi.
en_web: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
en_kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

tcz: Reubente ho aloiloi a umho chun aponlap noi uva abanjom un, Sheduir chapa Elizer chun amaho ahin lamkai in ahi.
en_web: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
en_kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

tcz: Aban achu Semeonte aloiloi a umhon ahinjuiyun, amaho Lamkai pachu Shelumiel, Zunishadai chapa ahi.
en_web: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

tcz: Chule aloiloi a um Gadte ahiuvin, Elisab kitipa, Deuel chapan ahin lamkai in ahi.
en_web: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

tcz: Hiche banjom chu Levite lah a kon a Kohathte ahiuvin houbuh sung a manchah atheng ho jouse ahin po un ahi. Ngahmun thah alhun masang un Houbuh chu Ngahmun thah a chun tun dohsan ana um jitan ahi.
en_web: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
en_kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

tcz: Hiche banjomma chun Ephraimte chu aponlop noiuvah aloiloi in ahung kitol un ahi. Amaho Lamkai a hungpang a chu Amihud chapa Elishama ahi.
en_web: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
en_kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

tcz: Amaho chu Manasseh te aloiloi a umho chun ahinjui un, Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel kitipan ahin lamkai un ahi.
en_web: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

tcz: Chuleh Benjamin phung a kon aloiloi a umho ahiuvin, Abidan chapa Gideon in ahin lamkaiyin ahi.
en_web: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

tcz: Anunung pen chu Dan phung a aponlap noi a aloi loi a kitolho ahiuvin, amaho hi phungho jouse ngahmun vengtup a ahiuve. Amaho Lamkai pachu ahi leh Ahiezel, Ammishaddai chapa ahiye.
en_web: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
en_kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

tcz: Amaho Banjomma hung kitol ho chu ahileh Okran chapa Piegel lamkaina a Asherte aloiloi a umho ahiuve.
en_web: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

tcz: Chuleh Enan chapa Ahira in ahin lamkai, Naphtali te aloiloi a umhon ahin jui un ahi.
en_web: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
en_kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

tcz: Hitia hi agol gol a Israel chilhahte, ama ama kihopkhen dol cheh a hung kitol jiu ahi uve.
en_web: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
en_kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

tcz: Nikhat chu Mose’n ajinu sopi pa, Median mipa Reuel chapa Hobab kom a aseiyin, “eiho hi Pakaiyin ei tep pehnao lam chu jot jing ihiuve, ajehchu Pakaiyin asei chu, 'ka pehding nahiuve'. Nangma keima holah hung tan, keihon nangma ngailut tah a kabol diu ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte chu kidangtah phattheina ho bohding kitepna anei ahi' ati.
en_web: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.

tcz: Hobab in adonbut in, 'Ahipoi, keima kache louding ahi. Keima ka gam le ka insung mite henga kile ding kahiye.'
en_web: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

tcz: Mose ataovin ahi, 'Neidalhah hih un, gamthip a hoilai a ngahmun kisongding ham ti nang in nahet ahi. Hungin land neihun lamhil un.
en_web: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
en_kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

tcz: Kaseinei nop peh leh, Pakaiya kon phattheina kachanho jouseu i nei khom diu ahi' ati.
en_web: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”
en_kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

tcz: Hitichun Pakai molsang chung adalhah jou uchun nithum sung ana kitol un, kingah nading mun phochen ding in Pakai kitepna thingkong in ana amakai un ahi.
en_web: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
en_kjv: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

tcz: Hitia niseh a lam ajot jing lai un, Pakai meibol lom in akhu khum jing un apuile jing uve.
en_web: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
en_kjv: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

tcz: Chule thingkong chu akitoldoh ji teng, Mose’n aw sangtah in a sam ding, “kipatdoh tan, O Pakai, namelma te kithecheh uhen, nangma angsung a kon in jammang uhen” atiding ahi.
en_web: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; And let them that hate thee flee before thee.

tcz: Chule thingkong chu akikoi lhah teng, “Simsenlou asang sang umna Israelte heng a hung ki le kit tan Pakai” tia aman aseikit ding ahi.
en_web: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
en_kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin mipite hochu hahsat genthei jeh a lunglhei louna ahin phong doh tauvin, chule Pakai in aseidohho jouseu abonchan ajasoh keiyin ahi. Hiche Pathen lunghanna chu amaho chunga akoujah jengtan, amaho hal vam ding meikong asoltan, chule ngahmun polam a um mi phabeppi chu asumang tan ahi.
en_web: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
en_kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

tcz: Hichun mite hochu Mose henga kithopina ngaichan akap un amao tauvin, chuin Mose chun Pathen henga taona anei phat in, meikong chu athiptai.
en_web: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.
en_kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouchun, hiche lai lhang chu Taberah(Hichu 'mei kou namun' tina ahi) tin akihetai ajehchu Pathenna konna meikong chun amaho lah a mi phabep ahal lhah namun ahi.
en_web: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.
en_kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.

tcz: Israel mite toh lamjot khom namdang ho chun Egypt gam'a neh le chah ho chu ahin ngaicha tauvin, hichun Israel chate jong ahung kiphin kit tauvin, “Oh, Sa themkhat beh neipe un!” tin a eujah tauvin ahi.
en_web: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
en_kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

tcz: Egypt gam sung a nga aman beija kaneh jiu ka lhangai jun ahi. Chule changmaiho, donkhoho, leeks, louthul atil neiho, chule changnam(Garlic) ho akingai cha chan akimutheije tin asam uve.
en_web: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
en_kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

tcz: Ahinlah tuhin imacha ka duchat hou kanei tapouvin, Tua kamu kaneh jing uhi hiche Manna bou hi ahitai.
en_web: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
en_kjv: but now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

tcz: Manna kiti chule louthul amu neocha cha hotobang ahin hiche ai-eng tobanga eng dup a kiselum a ahi.
en_web: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
en_kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

tcz: Mipi chu pamlam a gache uva ahin kilokhom uva, changbong tobang asothei nadia khutpei changsuhgoina manchah amangcha jiuvin ahilou jong leh agoi nel tho jiu ahiye. Hiche amahon changbong tobang chu bel lah ahon uva changlhah pheng ahin sodoh sah jiu ahi. Changlhah pheng chu Olive thao toh kihal jia nehthei tui in atui in ahi.
en_web: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
en_kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

tcz: Hiche manna chu ngahmuna jankim teng daitui toh hung khelha tha jia ahiye.
en_web: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
en_kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n mipi ho jouse ama ama insunga amaponbuh a in kotbul a kiphinna husa ajan, chule Pakai lunghanna akhong gei leutan, Mose jong alung nopmo asah lheh in ahi.
en_web: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
en_kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

tcz: Chu in Mose’n Pakai henga aseijin, “Ipidia nasoh hi hiti lom lom a hi nei gimbol hitam? Kachung a khotona nei nei in! Bolkhel ipi kanei a, mipi ho pohgih jouse kapoh ding naphal ham?
en_web: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

tcz: Keiman amaho hi kahindoh sa hiuvem? hiche vannoiya hi ka hin poh lut hiuvem? Minun naosen ajenle a apoh le bang a ipi dia amaho hi kaban a kadople ding a neiseipeh ham? Apu apateo nana peh na gam a chu iti keiman amaho hi ka puilut jou ding ham?
en_web: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
en_kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

tcz: Keiman hoilam a hiche mipi ho neh dinga saphe ka lah ding hitam? Amaho akiphin phin jeng un, “Saphe kaneh ding nei piuvin!” atiuve.
en_web: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
en_kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

tcz: Keiman hiche mipi ho hi kachangin ka jou tapoi! Hiche pohgih hi kapohjou kalval in agihtai!
en_web: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
en_kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

tcz: Hitobang tah a hi gimsah ding mong neitileh, kipat in lang nei that doh tan. Neihin khohsah in lang hiche gim genthei ho a kon hin nei huidoh o!”
en_web: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
en_kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Mose kom a ahinsei in, “Keima angsung a Israel mipi te lamkai leh Upa ho som sagi hin puilut in. Hiche lamkai hochu Houbuh a nang doh ding khom uhen.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

tcz: Keima hung kumlha ingting kahin houpi ding nahi. Keiman nang a um lhagao phabep khat la ingting amaho chunga hiche lhagao chu ka khumlut peh ding ahi. Amahon mipiho pohgih chu a pohhu diu, nang in nachang a napoh ngailou ding ahitai.
en_web: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
en_kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

tcz: “Chule mipi ho chu seipeh un, 'nangho kisutheng un, ajehchu jing nikho teng nang hon sa nehding nanei ding u ahitai. Nangho na kiphin un, chuleh Pathen in naka nau ajatai. 'Saphe themkhat jeh in Egypt ma um kanom jouve! na tiuve' tuahi Pakai in nang ho nahin peh diu naneh tei dingu ahi tai.
en_web: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
en_kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for you have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

tcz: Hichu nikhat ahi louleh nini tina jong ahi tapon, ni nga, nisom chule nisomni tina jong ahi tapoi, ati.
en_web: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
en_kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

tcz: Nang hon lhakhat sunga nachimdeh tokah uva naneh diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon nakom uva umjing Pakai napampai un, chuleh ama kom a kiphinnan naseiyun, “Idia Egypt gam ihin dalhah mong mong uham” natiuve.””
en_web: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
en_kjv: but even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

tcz: Ahin Mose chun Pakai chu adonbut nin, “tuahi mihem sang jagup keima toh um kahiuve, ahin Pakai nangma in 'lhakhat sungse aneh diu kapeh ding ahi! nati.'
en_web: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
en_kjv: And Moses said, The people, amongst whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

tcz: Kaganchan neihou jouse kithat jongleh, mihem hijat kipejou nantem? tui khanglen’a um nga jouse kiman hen lang hita jong leh hiche ho jeh achu lhing mong ding hinam?
en_web: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
en_kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Ka khut hin atha lhasam aham? Tua hi nang man kathusei hi atah ahi alhem ahi na hetchen ding ahitai!” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

tcz: Hichun Mose aga potdoh tan Pakaiyin ahenga asei bang chun mipi ho aga hetsah tan ahi. Mosen Upa ho mi som sagi asukhom in chu Houbuh kim vella chun adin sah tan ahi.
en_web: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
en_kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

tcz: Chuin meilom lah a kon chun Pakai ahung kumlhan Mose chu akihoulim pitai. Hichun Upa somsagi ho chu Mose apeh bang bang Lhagao chu amaho jouse chungnga apetan ahi. Chule lhagao ho chun mi somsagiho chunga achuh phatun, gaova thu aphongdoh tauvin ahi. Ahinlah hiche tobang thil umchan dol chu asoh kit tapon ahi.
en_web: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
en_kjv: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

tcz: Mipa ni Eldad le Medad chu ngahmun nunglam ah aum lhon in ahi. Amani chu upa ho min kijih lut na a ajao lhon in, ahinlah amanin houbuh chu adalhah hon lou beh ahi tai. Ahijeng vang in amani chunga jong chun Lhagao chu aum tan, hichun amani jong chun gaothu aphong doh lhon e.
en_web: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
en_kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

tcz: Pasal gollhang khat alhaiyin Mose koma thu chu agah lhut tan, “Eldad le Medad in gaothu aphong doh lhon tai!” ahung ti.
en_web: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
en_kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

tcz: Nun chapa Joshua, aneo laiya pat a Mose kithopi a hung pang pa vang chun lunglhai louna aphong doh in “Mose kapu, Eldad le Medad khu kicholdo sah tan!” tin aseiye.
en_web: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
en_kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

tcz: Ahinlah Mosen a donbut in, “Keima a ding ngaito na a ipi na thangset pi ham? Keiman ka dei pha ka sah vang chu mi jouse hi themgao hihen lang chuleh Pakai in alhagao chu amaho jouse chung nga jong chun koi cheh le kati!” atin ahi.
en_web: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord’s people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!

tcz: Hichun Mose jong chu Upa ho chutoh ngahmun kom langa akile kit tauve.
en_web: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
en_kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

tcz: Hitichun Pakaiyin Vamin puiding in tuikhanglen a huipi ahin nunsah tan, ngahmun chung leh kimvel jousea vamin akhehsah tan ahi. Amaho umna akon a avetna lamlam u miles a gamlha chan a chun tol a kon feet thum sang bou leng thei Vamim adimsoh tan ahi.
en_web: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
en_kjv: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

tcz: Hichun mipi chu a potdoh'un hiche Vamim chu nilhum kei jin aman un hiche ni jan khovah keijin jong chuleh ajing gei jong chun aloh khom na laijun ahi. Koiman bushels somnga sang a lhomjo amanpouvin ahi! Ngahmun kimvel a chun Vamin sa ho chu agot nading in aphou un ahi.
en_web: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
en_kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

tcz: Ahinlah Israelten saphe chu akam uva alhai’u aval lhah ding kontah u chun Pakai lung hanna achung'uva ahung chu tan, pul gimneitah alhunsah tan ahi.
en_web: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.
en_kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun hilaimun chu Kibroth-Hattaavah(milop ho lhankhuh) aki sahtai ajehchu amahon Egypt lamah saphe ngai cha jing miho avuinao chu ahi.
en_web: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
en_kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

tcz: Kibroth-Hattaavah apat chun Israel mite chu Hazeroth gei chu ahung kitol un, phat chomkhat hilai mun a chun ahung kichol uve.
en_web: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
en_kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

tcz: Hazeroth muna aum laijun, Mose in Cush a kon numei khat akichenpi jeh in Miriam le Aaron chun ama demna thu aseilhontai.
en_web: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
en_kjv: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

tcz: Amani hiti hin asei lhon in, “Pakai chu Mose henga bou kilah thei ham? Eini heng a jong hung ki lahdoh hung kilah hilouham?” atilhon e. Hilah amani thusei chu Pakaiyin ajasoh kei in ahi.
en_web: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
en_kjv: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.

tcz: (Mose chu akineosah lheh jeng in ahi- Leiset a akineosahpen pa sang in akineosah joh nalai in ahi).
en_web: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
en_kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

tcz: Hichun gang tah in Pakaiyin Mose, Aaron chule Miriam chu akouloi in hitin asei peh tai, “Nathum un Houbuh lama gache taovin” ati, hichun amaho thum in jong hilam chu ajon tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
en_kjv: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

tcz: Chuin Pathen chu meilom in ahung kumlhan houbuh lutna a chun ading den in, “Aaron leh Miriam” tin ahinkou in ahileh, amaninjong ahin nailut lhon in ahi.
en_web: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
en_kjv: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

tcz: Chu in Pathen in ahoulim pilhon in tuhin ka thusei hohi ngailhon in: “Nangma ho lah’a themgao um ahileh, Keima, Pakaiyin, gaova kaki phon tah hih ding ham. Ahilouleh manga kaki houlim pi ding ahi tai, ati.
en_web: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
en_kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

tcz: Hinlah kasohpa Mose vang hitobang chu ahipoi, Ka insung pumpi a amahi katahsan pentah ahi.
en_web: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
en_kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

tcz: Keima amatoh gaophelphul hilouva kichentah kimaingat toa kihoulim kahi lhon e! Aman Pakai chu ahina bang tah a amu ahi. Chiti ahileh idia kasohpa Mose dem ding kicha lou nahivem?
en_web: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
en_kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

tcz: Pakai chu amaho chunga chun alunghang lheh jeng tan, a dalha lhon tai.
en_web: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
en_kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.

tcz: Houbuh chunga meilhang akitol toh lhon in, Miriam chu ading in, Tiphah natna jeh chun avun chu buhbang bang in abang tan ahi. Aaron in Miriam chunga thilsoh ijakai amusoh phat in,
en_web: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
en_kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

tcz: Mose henga akaptan, “Oh! kapu hiche ngolhoitah chonsetna kana boldoh jeh lhon in gotna neipelhon hih beh in.
en_web: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
en_kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

tcz: Amanu jong hi naosen athisa a hung peng, apen lhah lhah a amonsa bang in koi hih beh in,” ati.
en_web: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
en_kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

tcz: Hichun Mose Pakai anga a akapjah jeng tan, “O Pakai, katao ahi, lung set tah in amanu hi damsah tan!” ati.
en_web: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
en_kjv: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin Mose jah a seitan, “Amanu hi apa chun achil aset khum hitaleh, ni sagi sung chu aboh a um a jum le ja athoh lou ding ham? hijeh chun amanu hi ngahmun pamlamma nisagi sung koidoh un lang, chujou teng lah lut kit thei hiding ahi” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

tcz: Hiti chun Miriam chu ngahmun pam lamah ni sagi aumsah un, chuleh akitol kit masang un, amanu chu ngahmun sung nga ahung kit ding chu mipiho chun angah un ahi.
en_web: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
en_kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

tcz: Hitichun Hazeroth adalha tauvin ache peh un Paran gamthip munkhat a ngahmun khat akisemkit tauvin ahi.
en_web: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
en_kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu hichengse hi aseijin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Canaan gam gakhol toh ding Pasal ho jouse chuga hetchen sahtan, gam chu keiman Israelte kapeh ding ahitai Pasal khat cheh phung dungjuiya lamkai hinah jallin acheding in ngense cheh un.
en_web: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
en_kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n Pathen in anganse na dungjuiyin abol in, gamthip lah’a pat chun Mose’n Pasal somleni Israel phungsom le ni ho lamkai ho chu ngahmun apat’nin asol doh in ahi.
en_web: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

tcz: Ama cheh phung min chule alamkai ho chu; Reuben-Shammur, Zuar chapa ahiuve.
en_web: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
en_kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

tcz: Simeon-Shaphat, Hori chapa ahin,
en_web: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

tcz: Judah-Cazb hi Jiphanneh chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

tcz: Issachar- Igal hi Joseph chapa ahiye.
en_web: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

tcz: Ephraim-Hosea hi nun chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

tcz: Benjamin- Pate hi phunglmakai Raphu chapa ahiye.
en_web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

tcz: Zebulun- Gadad hi Lamkai Guset chapa ahiye.
en_web: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

tcz: Manasseh- Gadi hi joseph chapa ahin suse chapa ahiye.
en_web: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

tcz: Dan- Ammiel hi Lamkai Gemnah chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

tcz: Asher- Sethan lamkai Michal chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

tcz: Napthali-Nabi hi Vophsi chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

tcz: Gad- Guel hi mala chapa ahi.
en_web: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi Mose’n gamkhol chin ding nga alhen doh ho, Mose’n Hosea chule Nun chapa amachu akouvin Joshua min asah tai.
en_web: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
en_kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun, Jehoshua.

tcz: Mose’n hiche Pasal a soldoh ho chu hiche thugah na ho chu aneiyun gam leiset kholchil ding nga nganse na anei dung juiyin nangho cheuvin sahlam mah negar hopat un thinglhang lam naho diu ahi, ati.
en_web: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
en_kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

tcz: Cheuvin lang gam umdan ijakai kholchilna ganei jun lang mihem um dol jong hinve chil unlang, hiche muna cheng ding chu mi ijat adol ding ham tijong hinkhol un, ati.
en_web: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
en_kjv: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

tcz: Amaho chenna gamho chu apha ham, aseham akhosah dan u ijakai hinkhol un chule khopi umdan jong hinve chil un.
en_web: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
en_kjv: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

tcz: Leiset chu thao putna ham ahilouleh gamgo apha lou ham? Hilai kom dunga chu thing phung tamtah umham? Thei phung thing phung aga hoi pen tah vetchil dia na hinpoh diu ahi.
en_web: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
en_kjv: and what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first ripe grapes.

tcz: Hichun achie tou un Zin gamthip apat akhol chil un Rebob kiti gei chu Leboh Hamath kom dung gei chu abonchan gakholsoh keiyun.
en_web: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
en_kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

tcz: Sahlam ahoh paovin gamthip kiti mun chu ajot paovin chuin Hebron alhung tauve. Hikom mun chu Amal chilhah te ahin Sheshal chule Tamal ho chun ana um uve. Hebron khopi chu Egypt khopi Zoan kiti sanga kum-sagi masanga kisem masa ahi.
en_web: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
en_kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

tcz: Amahon Eschort phaicham ahin phah uchun lengpi thei boh khat ahin sat lhauvin amani kikah ah ahin polut un chuleh kolbu thei jong Olive phung jong jaonan ahinpo lhonne.
en_web: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
en_kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

tcz: Hiche lai mun chu Eschort phaicham aki tin ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mihon hikomma chu lengpi thei avat u ahi.
en_web: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
en_kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

tcz: Ni somli jen gam le go kholchih na anei jou phat un Pasal ho chu ahung kinung le gam tauve.
en_web: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
en_kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

tcz: Tun amaho ahung ki nung le taovin Mose le Aaron kom ahin chule Israel mipi jouse jong chu Paran gamthip ma chun aum un ahi.
en_web: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
en_kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

tcz: Hichun amahon Mose jah hiti hin asei un, keiho nei nganse nauva kaga che un gam leiset vedin, hiche gam hi khoiju le bongnoi lonna chule hichengse hi gamsunga gasoh ho ahi.
en_web: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
en_kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

tcz: Ahinlah hilai gamma umho chu thil bolthei na hangsan tah ahiuvin, khopi ho jong chu hoitah in aveng tup un amel’u jong alen theiyin hikomma chun Anak mite a khosa uvin ahi.
en_web: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
en_kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

tcz: Amalek mite vang noilam alouvin, hit mite ahin Amor mite ho jouse thinglhang lam aloh soh un, chuleh Cannan mite vang'in Jordan phai vadung lang tui khanglen kom lang aloh soh hellun ahi.
en_web: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
en_kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

tcz: Ahinlah Caleb in mipi ho chu aphoh thip in Mose heng lam adin ahung taovin, Caleb in hitin aseiyin, eiho che’u hitin hiche gam chu lahlut ding ngaito tauhite, ajeh chu hiche mite hi ijo teidiu ahi.
en_web: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
en_kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

tcz: Amavang Caleb toh gam kholle a che ho lah mi phabep loi chu anom pouvin, Anak mite ho chu eiho sanga hat jo ahiuvin, eiho Amaho chu ima ilo theilou diu ahi tin asei uve.
en_web: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
en_kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

tcz: Hichun Amaho lah’a mi phabep loi chun hiche thupha lou hi Israel mite lah’a ahin sei phong uvin ahi. Gam leiset keiman ka khol chil jou pon nang ho gam neite ahat theiyun Amahon hetman louva eisuhgam jeng theiyu ahi, ati.
en_web: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
en_kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

tcz: Keihon Anak mite chu kamu uvin amaho toh teding in eiho hi khongbai tabang bep ihiuvin Anak mite jeng in jong hitia chu eigellu ahiye.
en_web: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
en_kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

tcz: Hichun Israel mite abonchauvin aw-sang tah in akap un chu leh amaho chu jan khovah geijin akap’un hiche mipiho awgin chu lakisa’a ki thong bang in Mose leh Aaron dounan aboldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
en_kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

tcz: Hiche mipi awgin lakisa chu akithong jing in Mose le Aaron douna kibol ahin Egypt gamah ana thidoh kihi le pha jonte tin asam uve.
en_web: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
en_kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

tcz: Pakaiyin hilang gam lah ahi eipui doh jing’u ham gal’a thi bep dinga ka jite hou numei chapang jaona athigam bep dinga Egypt gamsunga konna nei hin puidoh u ham tin asei uve.
en_web: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
en_kjv: and wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

tcz: Hi chun Amaho khat le khat aki hou khom mun eihon lamkai thah lheng u hitin Egypt lamah kinung le tauhite tin akihou lim tauvin ahi.
en_web: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
en_kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

tcz: Hichun Mose le Aaron chu Israel mite jouse masang tol lang ngan akun lha lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

tcz: Pasal mini gam kholla che teni chu Nun chapa Joshua le Jephanneh chapa Caleb chun aponsil lhon abotkeh lhon tai.
en_web: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
en_kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

tcz: Ama nin Israel mipi teho lah’a asei lhon tan, keini’n ka khol chil lhon gam ho chu ki dang tah le loupi tah ahiye, tin asei lhon’e.
en_web: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
en_kjv: and they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

tcz: Chule Pathen hi eiho dinga hiche gamsung khu eiphatsah peh uva ahi tan Pakai chun agamsunga ei pui lut diu, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam ahiye.
en_web: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
en_kjv: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

tcz: Pakai chu douhih un, chule hiche gamsunga chengte jong kicha hih un. Eiho a ding in amaho khu apanpi ding umlou anchah a pang tobangbep ahiuve! Avengtup ding aneipouve, Pathen thahat chungnung aum in aman abanthahat in ei panpi jing diu ahiye.
en_web: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”
en_kjv: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.

tcz: Amavang Mipi jouse chu Joshua le Caleb chu songa se lih ding agong tauvin Pakai, Pathen loupina chungnung chu Israelte chunga ahung kitah lang tan houbuh thingkong chu ahung kilah tan ahi.
en_web: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
en_kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

tcz: Chu in Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpi tan itih chan hiche Israel mite hin donlou nahsah louva eikoi diu hitam? Thet-um tah thil ki dang tampi aboldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

tcz: Keiman amaho chu ka kihet mosah ding chule ka suh mang ding ahiuve. Ahinlah keiman nangma mihat tah ka so ding, Amaho sanga hat jo phajo ka so ding na hi, ati.
en_web: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
en_kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

tcz: Ahin lah Mose vang chu anom pon a lung phamo lheh in Egypt miten ipi agel diuvem hiche thil um dan ahin het teng ule Mose’n Pathen chu adong tan Egypte ahat soh hel lin nangma tha hatna Israel mite na hin pui doh’a Egypt apat na hung sohchat’u ahiye.
en_web: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

tcz: Pakai, Pathen nangma tun hiche Israel mite hi na suhmang le Egypt miten agamma cheng ho lah’a alhut diu, nangma toh kimai to ahiuvin chule jan teng meikonga napui jun sun teng meilhang in na pui jiuve.
en_web: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
en_kjv: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

tcz: Pakai nangman amaho hi ilou theh a nasuh mang leh hiche nam mite na puidan kidang tah ana hesa nam mite chun, sei uvintin,
en_web: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
en_kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

tcz: Pakaiyin Amaho chu a suhgam na ajeh chu atep peh na’u gamsung chu apui lhung jou tahlou jeh ahi ati diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
en_kjv: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangma boltheina natoh chu jom in vetsah kit in. Pakai nangma in kiphong doh kit inlang,
en_web: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
en_kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

tcz: Pakai, Pathen hi lung neng tah lunghang vahlou chuleh ngailutna dim jing chonset ngaidam them ahin suhkhel neite angaidam jing Pakai hi chonsetna ho ngaidam themji ahi kiti chu musah in.
en_web: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
en_kjv: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

tcz: Ngaidam min hiche mite chonset nahi keima Mose ka taona nei ngai peh inlang nami hepina leh ngailutna jal’a nangman hiche mite Egypt apatna na hin ngaidam jing sa bang chun.
en_web: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
en_kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

tcz: Hichun Mose chu Pathen in ahin houlim pitan nangma thusei dung juiyin ka ngaidam tai, ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
en_kjv: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

tcz: Tahbeh’a kasei ahi Keima hingjing Pathen chu kahi jeh in vannoi Leiset hi ka loupina dimset jing ding ahi.
en_web: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—
en_kjv: but as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche Israel chate ho lah’a hi koima jong katep peh gam lhung jou talou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Amaho jousen ka loupina chu ahetsoh hel’u ahin, chule thil kidang tah melchihna Egypt gam’a jong ka bol lin chule gamthip lah’a jong ka bol lin ahin lah amahon tun avel lin ima lou tah in awgin sangtah in asam un, aki phin uvin ahi.
en_web: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
en_kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

tcz: Keiman apute apateu ka teppihna gam chu a amu lou beh diu, Amaho lah’a koi tobang eidou dal ho jouse chu imacha amu lou beh ding ahi.
en_web: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
en_kjv: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

tcz: Ahin lah ka lhachapa Caleb vang hi midang hotoh alungel’a kibah louna aum in Caleb hin hom tho tah’in eihou jing in hi ti ahijeh achu agam kholna muna chu ka pui lhung tei ding ahi, Caleb le achilhahte jouse hiche gam chu aboncha a alo soh hel diu ahi.
en_web: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
en_kjv: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

tcz: Tun nangma ki nunghei tan, nangman Amalek teho, Canan miteho chenna lang chu na jot lou beh ding, jing teng nangma kipat doh in gamthip lam nama no ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
en_kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

tcz: Itihchan hiche migilou namho toh hin ka chenkhom’a ka umpi jing ding ham? Kipah lou lunglhai louva ka chung’a aum jing uhin ipi avetsah hi tantem, ati.
en_web: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
en_kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

tcz: Tun amaho chu seipeh un. Keima hi Pathen ka hin ka umjing in nangma na sei doh na geldoh lou chu ka bol peh ding na hi tauve.
en_web: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
en_kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

tcz: Nangho gamthipma thiden ding nahi tauve, ka chunga lungkim louna na neitah jeh un kum som nia pat chunglam sen thina ato ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
en_kjv: your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

tcz: Katepna gamsung na lo tahlou diu, Caleb, Jephanneth chapa chule amani Joshua, Nun chapa amani bou chun alo lhon ding ahi.
en_web: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
en_kjv: doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Ahinlah nachate khangthah ho nanghon mi thagam ding bep a na gel hou chu keiman ka panpi ding agam leiset na deimo sau gam chu a toupha diu ahi.
en_web: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
en_kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

tcz: Amavang nangho jouse na thilong uchu hiche gamthip nelgam ahi kivui lhum ding ahi tai.
en_web: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
en_kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

tcz: Na chate ho nachilhah hou vang hikom gam thip lah’a kum somli-le-li gei kelngoi chinga pang ding ahi tauve. Hi tobang’a chu nanghon nalou chalna hou na mu diu hiche nelgam ahi na thi soh heldiu ahiye.
en_web: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
en_kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, na lamkai hon ni somli jen lutna gam leiset kholla cheuva ahin na chonset jeh’a kisuh genthei ding na hitai nikhat lampi chu kum somli jen na jot ding u ahi tai. Hiche teng chule nanghon Pathen toh melma a umhi itobang’a hahsa ham ti nahet doh diu ahi.
en_web: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
en_kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

tcz: Keima Pakai, Pathen kahin na ka hin toh pan ding ahi tai hiche mipi ho lah’a eidou’a pang jing ho chu hikom nelgam ma hi suh gentheiya umdiu chule amaho chu a hinkho kicha soh hel diu ahi.
en_web: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
en_kjv: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

tcz: Pasal som ho lah’a Mose gam velhi dinga asol ho lah’a ami khat Pathen douna ana tong gopa chu ahi.
en_web: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
en_kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

tcz: Pathen henga amapa chu pul in athi tai.
en_web: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
en_kjv: even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

tcz: Gam kholchin lah’a pasal somle ni ahiuvin amaho lah achu Joshua le Caleb bou asoh cha uvin ahi.
en_web: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
en_kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

tcz: Mose’n Pathen thu cheng seidoh jouse chu Israel ho lah a asei peh phat chun mipi ho chun nopma asah thei lheh jeng un ahi.
en_web: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
en_kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

tcz: Amaho chu a Jing nikho in, jingkah matah in aki thou un mol chungvum laitah a akaldoh un, aki hou uvin, Pathen douna a chonset natoh ibol doh’u ahitai, tun vang Pakai jin ei teppeh na’u gam chu jon tauhite aki tiuve.
en_web: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”
en_kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.

tcz: Ahinlah Mose’n a donbut in ibola nangho Pathen thupeh palkeh dia na got uva, Gamthip gam a kile ding na kisah u baham?
en_web: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?
en_kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.

tcz: Tun nanghon hiche gam-tep gam lam’a lut ding jong got datauvin, na melmateu khut ah gamlha bepseu un nate, Ajeh chu Pathen in na kithopi louhel diu ahitai.
en_web: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
en_kjv: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

tcz: Nanghon Amalek mite le Cannan mite na ki dinte pi teng uleh amahon na tha gamhel lo diu ahi tai. Ajeh chu ama nana dalhah tah jeh uva, Pathen in nang ho jong na dalhah’u ahitai.
en_web: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”
en_kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.

tcz: Hinlah mipin atum tentun uvin, Mose jong pang lou, Pakai thingkong jong jao talou hel in, aki tol uvin thinglhang lam chu ama no tauve.
en_web: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
en_kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

tcz: Hichun thing lhang molchung lamma pansa ho chu Amalek mite leh Canaan miten ahin bulhu tauvin, hiti chun Hormah chan ahin del tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
en_kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

tcz: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel mite chu hiche thuhil hohi seipeh in, keiman ka peh ding gam Leiset mun chu na lhun teng ule,
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

tcz: Nangman pumgo maichamn thiltoh gimnamtui sellah Pathen heng nga napeh ding ahiye. Na gancha hon bong, kelngoi hon lah chule kelchal ho lah ajong ahoicheh pumgo maicham thiltoh kumlhunsih akibol banga chu napeh diu ahiye.
en_web: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—
en_kjv: and will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd, or of the flock:

tcz: Nangma hiche maicham hohi bol ding tia na gel teng Pathen Pakai chu mim le chang a kon na chang bong chu gopni hi ding chule Olive thao chu Hopkhat hi ding ahi.
en_web: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.
en_kjv: then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil.

tcz: Kelngoi chu khat pumgo maicham thiltoa na kat diu pumgo maicham thil to na dia lengpi tui jong hop khat maicham na hin to ding ahi.
en_web: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
en_kjv: And the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

tcz: Pumgo thilto chu kelngoi ahile chang bong kipe dol chu gal la Pathen’a dinga gim namtui tah hi ding ahiye.
en_web: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
en_kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil.

tcz: Chule lengpi thei tui chu khon thum tabang tuija maicham din sem in hichu Pathen adinga gimnam tui tah ahi.
en_web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Nangman bongchal nou pumgo maicham thilto nabol teng Pathen’na dia kipana maicham kisuh thengna na bol ji ding ahi.
en_web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,
en_kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:

tcz: Nangman mim le changbonga kisem hop gup hi ding chule Olive thao jaona hi ding ahi.
en_web: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
en_kjv: then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half a hin of oil.

tcz: Chule nangman hopni lengpitwi na peh ding hichu Pakai, Pathen adia gimnamtui tah hi ding ahi.
en_web: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Pumgo maicham jouse aboncha Kelchal hihen, Kelpi hihen, Kelnou hihen, chule adang jong hitia chu na bolsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
en_kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

tcz: Nangman pumgo thilto napeh teng hiche thupeh hohi najui ding ahi.
en_web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
en_kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

tcz: Nang ho Israel mite hiche mumna peng jousen Pathen heng nga gimnamtui maicham, napeh teng ule hiche thupeh hohi najui’u angaiye.
en_web: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Koi tobang nangho kom a kholjin mi aum ham ahi lou leh acheng den aum khah jong leh Amaho jong chun hiche dan hi ajui cheh diu ahi.
en_web: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.
en_kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.

tcz: Israel mite agam leiset muna peng dan hihen gampam ma kon hung pemlut mi hijong leh Pakai mitmu’a thakhat cheh ahiuve. Hijeh’a chu Dan khat noija um cheh ahiuve. Hiche hi nang ho dia tonsotna jui dinga dan kisem ahin hichu najui diuva kipe ahi tai.
en_web: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.
en_kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.

tcz: Nangho ding hihen gamchom mi hung pemlut ho hiu jong leh, Hiche thupeh jui ding’a kigong hohi na bolcheh diu ahi.
en_web: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
en_kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

tcz: PakaiyinMose heng ah asei be kit in.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israelte chu anoija thupeh thuhil ho hi seipeh tan, nangho ka pehna gam nalhun uva,
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
en_kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

tcz: Hiche gamsung gasoh ho naneh teng ule Pathen maicham ding jong na khen doh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.
en_kjv: then it shall be, that when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up a heave offering unto the Lord.

tcz: Na lousoh mim le chang aga masa penchu changbong a na suhdi ding changlhah lumma na sem ding hichu Pathen a dinga gamasa pen ahi jeh’a napeh doh ding ahi.
en_web: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
en_kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for a heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding khonung khang geija hiche maicham atheng Pathen hengnga pehdoh ding hi a kumsih leh najui ding na lou gasoh amasa pen chu na koidoh jing ding ahiye.
en_web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.
en_kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord a heave offering in your generations.

tcz: I-ham tia Pakaiyin Mose henga athupeh chengse hi nahsahmo jeh hilouva, hetthem lou jeh joh’a na suhmil khah uva,
en_web: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—
en_kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,

tcz: Khonung’a Na chilhah ho jeng in jong Pathen thupeh ho a suhmil khah uva,
en_web: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
en_kjv: even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

tcz: Hiche suhkhelna chu mipi jousen ana hetthem lou jeh ahi khah tahleh Israel mipi techun Bongchal nou khat Pathen heng’a gim namtui thilto dia ato diu ahi. Chuleh Anneh ding thilto leh don ding thil to toh, chonset thilto adia kelnou khat ato tha diu ahi.
