en_web: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
en_kjv: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

tcz: Hiche muna chun Israel miten Pathen vahchoila asauvin, ama thangvah nan adim uve.
en_web: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
en_kjv: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; Sing ye unto it:

tcz: Hiche tui umna muna chun lengnu apang hoi ahiuvin, lamkai ho ahin, abonchauvin twikhuh chu alaiyun chu in Mattanah lam jon in ache tauvin ahi.
en_web: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
en_kjv: The princes digged the well, The nobles of the people digged it, By the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

tcz: Mattanah apat’in Nahaliel gam chu ajon un chu in Nahaliel apat in Bamoth ajon un ahi.
en_web: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
en_kjv: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

tcz: Bamoth phaicham alhung tauvin hichu Moab gamsung ahin Pisgah mun hiche apat chu Jeshimon lam ki galdot ahi tai.
en_web: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
en_kjv: and from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

tcz: Chuin Israel miten Mose lamkaijin Amor mite lengpa Sihon henga thuthot aneiyun ahi.
en_web: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
en_kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

tcz: Keima hon nagam leiset chu kapel thei diu ham keiho ching thei tah a kachi diu chule lengpi lei lah a kachi lou diu nangho tuikhuh a jong tui kadon lou diu ahi. Nangho gamkai sunga hi lengpa lamlen bou kaho pa diu ahi bouve, tin aseiyun ahi.
en_web: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”
en_kjv: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past thy borders.

tcz: Ahinlah Amor mite lengpa Sihon chun Israel mite chu agam ajotpa na diu chu aphal peh tapon, phalpih malah chun lengpa Sihon chu agalsat techu akou khom in abonchauvin gam thip laitah ah chun abulu tan Jahaz kiti mun a chun aki bulu to tauvin ahi.
en_web: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
en_kjv: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

tcz: Isreal miten jong Amor mite chu ale thuh un agam leiset ho jouse jong atou pha tauvin, Arnon vadung apat Jabbok vadung gei Isreal mite chu Amon mite gamgi chan ahung galkaijun Amon mite khopi chu hoitah a kigen kul ahijeh chun hiche muna chun ahung lhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
en_kjv: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

tcz: Hichun Isreal mite le Amon miten agam le lei jouse alo sohtauvin Hesbon khopi ahin adang dang khovel ho jong atou pha sohtauvin ahi.
en_web: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
en_kjv: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

tcz: Amor mite lengpa Sihon dinga Hesbon khopi ana hin Moab mite lengpa kulpi jong ana tou pha in chule Arnon vadung gei ana toupha in ahi.
en_web: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
en_kjv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

tcz: Mimasa hon Sihon thusimho anajihlut un ahile Hesbon lang apat nang ho hung umdol thusim chu hiche ahin Sihon khopi avella kitung doh kit ahiye.
en_web: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
en_kjv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, Let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

tcz: Hesbon na kon in mei kong ahung kong doh in Sihon kiti’a konin meikhu ahung khu doh in Maob khopi a Arnon umna Moab khopi Arnon chu meikong in ahal lhatai Arnon mite lah a sangtah'a umho chu asuse taove.
en_web: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
en_kjv: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath consumed Ar of Moab, And the lords of the high places of Arnon.

tcz: Moab mite hi itabang genthei nan alhun khum hitam! Chemosh boh khup teho nangma akichai na hitai Chemosh in pasal ho umna neilou bang asoh tan a chanu te vang chu Sihon, Amor mite lengpa khut’a asoh achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
en_kjv: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons that escaped, And his daughters into captivity Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

tcz: Eihon amaho chu Hesbon a pat’a Dibon gei chu isuh cheh taovin, eihon amho chu Nophah apat Medeba gei chu ipum nocheh taovin ahi.
en_web: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
en_kjv: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, Which reacheth unto Medeba.

tcz: Hiti ahi jeh chun Isreal miten Amor mite chenna gam alo khum taovin ahi.
en_web: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
en_kjv: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

tcz: Mose’n phat chomkhat jouvin Jaazer lam ah’a khol chedin asoltan Isreal miten hiche vel'a khopi um jouse chu atou pha tauvin hikom a cheng Amor mite chu abonchauvin ano doh tauve.
en_web: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
en_kjv: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

tcz: Hichun Isreal mite aki nung hei taovin Bashan jotna lam ajon tauvin, amavang Bashan lengpa Og chun ama nam mite jouse chutoh Edrei mun ah ana bulhu uvin ahi.
en_web: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
en_kjv: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

tcz: Pakajin Mose henga thu aseiyin Bashan lengpa Og chu ging hih beh in ajeh chu keiman nangma hi gal jona ka peh ding, amaho gamle leiset jouse chule amite chunga thanei na le galjona kapeh nahi tai. Heshbon vaipopa Amor mite lengpa Sihon nabol na bang tah a nagal jo kitding ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

tcz: Hichun Isreal miten Og lengpa kiti pa ahin amite jouse chu koimacha ahing a nakoi loubeh diu ahi tai. Hichun Isreal miten Bashan mite jouse chu agam le aleiset atou pha taovin asat gam tauve.
en_web: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
en_kjv: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

tcz: Hichun Israel mite Moab phaicham langa akitol un Jordan sahlam Jericho mun’a chun akichol dotauvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

tcz: Zippor chapa Moab mite lengpa Balak in Isreal miten Amor mite chunga anatoh jouse’u kidang asah behseh tan ahi.
en_web: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
en_kjv: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

tcz: Moab miten Isreal mite ahung kitol taove veuvin amaho chu tijatnan adimset un ahi.
en_web: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

tcz: Moab lengpa chun Midian mite lamkai ho kom ah ahil chah taovin, mipi ima bol lal toh lal anei lou diu ahi bong hang in hampa hing avel lhum tobanga loulai a avet lhih jeng ding ahi tin lengpa henga chun aseiyin ahi.
en_web: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
en_kjv: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

tcz: Thu athot tan Balaam pa chapa heng nga hiche Balak kitipa khu amaho gam Pithor leh Euphrates vadung kom a pansah cheng chu Balak thucheng hiche hohi athot in, veuvin hiche mipi ho hi Eygpt apat na hung kipat doh ahiuvin, amaho hin leiset pumpi alo dim tauvin chule amaho leiset mite kinai tah in aum mun ahi.
en_web: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
en_kjv: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

tcz: Lungset tah in hung phei in Isreal mite hi gaosap in ajeh chu keima toh kito din ahat val un ahi. Hiche teng chule kavang aphat le keiman amaho chu hiche leiset na pat ahi kadal doh thei ahin keima kahet na aum in nangma hitabang mite chung nga vang naboh le amaho chung nga chu vangboh-phatthei na chang ding u chule nangma in na gaosap te chung nga chu sapset nachan diu ahi.
en_web: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”
en_kjv: come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

tcz: Balak’s ding a thutan seiphong nga nang ho chu Midian le Moab mite aki go doh tauvin, Sumle pai toh Balaam chu Isreal mite chung nga agao sap na ding in, amaho chu ache tauvin Balak lam ah thuthot ding in akalsong tauve.
en_web: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
en_kjv: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

tcz: Balaam in adonbut in tujan hikom ah geh den tan ati, keiman jingkah tengleh kasei peh ding nahi tai Pathen in itobang a ei houlim pi ding ham? Hiti ahi jeh chun Moab a konna migun hochu Balaam toh ageh khom tauvin ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

tcz: Hiche nijan chun Pathen Vantil in Balaam heng ngah koiba hitam nangma toh kimuto a hung jihohi tin aseiye.
en_web: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”
en_kjv: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

tcz: Balaam in Pathen Vantil hengah asei tan Zippor kiti pa chapa Balak Moab lengpan hiche thu hohi eihin thot e, ati.
en_web: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

tcz: Vetan Eygpt a patna hung kipat doh mi hon hijat aum uvin chuleh Amahon vannoi pumpi alo dim tauve. Hiche mipi hohi hung gaosap in, hung tem in chuti leh keiman amaho chu ka nodoh jou thei khat leh tia eihung tem ahiuve.
en_web: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”
en_kjv: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen Vantil in Balaam chu ahin houlimpi tan, hiche mite hi Pathen phatthei chang ahi tauvin amaho na gaosap lou ding chuleh amaho lam nache loubeh ding ahi, ati.
en_web: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
en_kjv: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

tcz: Balaam aki thoudoh in hiche nikho a jing chun Balak mi hung lamkai ho komma hitin asei tan, nangho in lam a che tauvin Pathen Vantil in nangma hotoh chekhom din ei phal poi ati tai.
en_web: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”
en_kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

tcz: Hichun Moab lamkai milun ho chu Balak lengpa komma din aki nung le tauvin chule amahon Balaam thuthot ho chu ahung thadiu thaset naho chu asei peh taovin ahi.
en_web: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
en_kjv: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

tcz: Balak in khatvei apatep kit in hiche phat na hi Balak in migun tamtah asol lin amijat jong tamjo chule aphat masah peh sang a thupijo ahi.
en_web: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.
en_kjv: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

tcz: Amaho chu Balaam heng lamah acheuvin hiche thu hohi aga lhut tauve, hiche thucheng hohi Balak kiti Zippor chapan asei tan, lungset tah in emacha kisuh boisah hih beh in keima komma nahunga neikithopi nadin, ati.
en_web: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
en_kjv: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

tcz: Keiman nangma hoitah a tohman ka bol peh ding nahi chule ipi hita jongle nangmain bol lin nati chu ka bol peh ding hiche mite hohi a gaosap din ki gong in hung jeng in ati.
en_web: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”
en_kjv: for I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

tcz: Ahinlah Balaam in Balak chu hitin a donbut in Balaam in alenggam toh ei peh tha henlang sana dangka toh kikoi dimset hita jongle ka Pathen lungdei lou ahikhah le keiman imacha ka bol theina ding’a, thilbol theina neilou ka hi ding ahiye, ati.
en_web: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
en_kjv: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.

tcz: Ahinlah jan khat tabang umbe un, keiman jong Pakai, Pathen in kahenga epi aseibe ding ham kahetdoh thei nadin.
en_web: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”
en_kjv: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Pathen Vantil chu Balaam heng a ahung kilah tan hiche miluntah hohi na heng’a ding a hung kholjin ahi tah jeh un, nangma kipatdoh inlang amaho toh chekhom un, ahinlah nangman keima thupeh na jui ding ahi.
en_web: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”
en_kjv: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

tcz: Hichun ajing in Balaam aki thoudoh in asangan a atoudoh in Moab mite lamkai hochu toh akipat doh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
en_kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

tcz: Hitia Balaam ache jeh chun, Pathen chu alunghang tan hijeh chun Pakai Vantil asol in lamlen laitah a Balaam tingtan ding chun ana pang tai. Balaam chu asoh mini toh kilhon ahi.
en_web: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
en_kjv: And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

tcz: Balaam sangan chun Pakai Vantil lamlen na aum a, achemjam akhut a achoi chu a mudoh tan sangan chu lamlen a kon in phailei lam a lhai lha tan amavang Balaam in sangan chu ajep in lamlen ah ahin puilut kit tan ahi.
en_web: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
en_kjv: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

tcz: Hichun Pakai vantil chu lam ajum lang aneo lang lengpi thei lei teni kikah ah ana ding tan ahi.
en_web: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
en_kjv: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

tcz: Sangan chun Pathen Vantil chu amu phat in aki tol doh kigo in Balaam keng toh bang chu anom beh khatai. Hichun Balaam in sangan chu ajep kit tan ahi.
en_web: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
en_kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crusht Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

tcz: Pakai Vantil chu aki phei khin doh kit in akeng jep ah chun, ajet le avei ja sangan lhaidoh na ding umlou na ahchun ana ting kit’e.
en_web: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

tcz: Hi chun sakol chun Pakai Vantil chu amu phat in, Balaam anoija abohkhup tan ahileh, Balaam chu alung hang lheh in sangan chu ajep tai.
en_web: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
en_kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin sangan chu thusei theina apen; Balaam chu ahin donbut in, “Ipi kabol khel’a thumveijen nei jep hitam?” tin adong tai.
en_web: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
en_kjv: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

tcz: Nang in kei mingol tah neiso tah hila” tin Balaam akisen in, “Ka khut na hin chemjam um choi hileng ka dot lih ding na hitai”, ati.
en_web: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

tcz: Na damsung’a na tou jingna na sangan chu kahi hilou ham? tin Sangan chun ahin donbut in, Keima nidang a chu hitabang a hi ka um khah em? ati. Balaam in adonbut in “Ahi nai! Na um khapoi” ati.
en_web: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”
en_kjv: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

tcz: Hichun Pakai-Pathen in Balaam mitchu ahin hadoh sah tan hichun Balaam in Pakai Vantil lamka laiya adin’a chemjam akhutna aki choi chu amu phat in, amai ja akun suh in Pakai Pathen abohkhup tai.
en_web: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
en_kjv: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

tcz: Pakai Vantil chun thudoh anei jin, ipi bolla na sangan chu navoh hitam ati Ven- keima nalampi su bing nga hung nga kahi ijeh inam itileh nangma hi mi louchal tah nahi, ati.
en_web: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

tcz: Sangan chun thumveijen ei mu ahin ei otdoh ji, tun keima in Sangan hi ka hoidoh sah a nangma hi katha doh ding nahi tai.
en_web: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
en_kjv: and the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Pakai vantil komma chun ngaidam athum tan, keima kachon kheltan keiman ka lampia neina tin chu ka geldoh lou ahi. Ka in lam ah kinungle kit tang kate, Pakai jin neiphal peh lou leh tin aseiye.
en_web: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

tcz: Ahilah, Pakai- Pathen chun Balaam chu a donbut in hiche miho toh hin kilhon in chen, Ahinlah kei seiho bou na bol ding ahi. Hichun Balaam chu Balak milun ho chu toh achekhom tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

tcz: Balak Lengpa in Balaam chu ahung ahet phat in lamlen’a kimu pi din ache tai, Balak chu Moab mite gam ning gei Arnon vadung gei aga lam ton ahi.
en_web: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
en_kjv: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

tcz: Balak in Balaam thudoh aneitan keima heng nga gang tah a nahung na ding a thu ka hin nei hilou ham Ibol’a na hung louham ati. Keiman kipa man ka peh dia ka thutep hohi na tahsan louham tin asei in ahi.
en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
en_kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

tcz: Balaam min a donbut in ven, keima vang ka hung tai ahinlah keiman bolthei imacha ka nei poi, keiman ka dei dei a jong ka seithei ahi poi, Pakai, Pathen in ka kam a eipeh bou ka kasei doh ding ahi bouve, ati.
en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Balak chu Kiriath Huzoth tigei aki lhon pin ahi.
en_web: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
en_kjv: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.

tcz: Hilai mun achun Balak lengpan abolngai jing bang in, kengoi le Bongchal ah pumgo thilto maicham aneiyin ahi. Balak in hiche Saphe tham khat chu Balaam toh alhonpi ho chu apen ahi.
en_web: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
en_kjv: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

tcz: A jing jingkah chun Balak in Balaam chu Bamoth Baal molsang chung a apuidoh in, ahi, ajeh chu hilai mun apat na hi Israel mite vahle ho chu a umna apat kimu ahi.
en_web: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

tcz: Chuin balaam’in jong Balak lengpa komma asei tan Pumgo thilto Maicham nato na ding mun-sagi nei bol peh tan chuleh bongchal sagi chule kelngoi chal sagi neigon tup peh tan ati.
en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

tcz: Balak in Balaam thupeh ho chu angaijin chu in achelhon tan, pumgo maicham asem lhon in bongchal nou ahin kelchal pumgo thil tona chunga akatdoh lhon tai.
en_web: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
en_kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Balak komma hitin aseitan, hikom pumgo maicham kihal na ahin ana um ta din, keima Pathen in eiki hou lim pi hinam ti kaga kholchil ding, chuteng hiche ho chu nangma ka sei peh ding na hi ati. Hichun Balaam chu Molchung gei achangin akal tan ahi.
en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to a high place.

tcz: Hilai achun Pathen in Balaam akimupin a sei pehtai, “Kei man Mai-cham sagi ka bol tai, chuleh bongchal nou khat cheh le kelngoi chal khat cheh ka lhandoh tai ati.
en_web: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
en_kjv: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Balaam chu ahoulim pin Balak asei peh ding thu apen; Hijou chun Nangma nung che tan Balak heng lam ah hiche ka thu sei doh hohi sei peh tan, ati.
en_web: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
en_kjv: And the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

tcz: Balaam chu a hung ki nung le tan ahi leh Balak lengpa chu Moab mi a milunho chu toh pumgo maicham lhan doh na muna ana ding kim tauve.
en_web: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
en_kjv: And he returned unto him, and lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

tcz: Ahinlah, Pakaiyin a gaosap lou ho chu keiman iti ka gaosap ding ham? Pathen in themmo achan louho chu iti themmo ka chan ding ham ati.
en_web: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?
en_kjv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? Or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?

tcz: Keiman molchunga pat kaven, amaho chu molvum apat hin kamu soh kei uve. Hiteho hi chidang nam dang te akon lhenchom ahiu kamu doh e.
en_web: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
en_kjv: For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him: Lo, the people shall dwell alone, And shall not be reckoned among the nations.

tcz: Koiham Israel chilhah ho simjou ding chu, simseng lou neldi ja ahiuve. Israel mite chu koima chan simjou lou ding ahi. Keijong hiche nam thengho bang in um inting, amaho thi bang in thileng kati.
en_web: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
en_kjv: Who can count the dust of Jacob, And the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my last end be like his!

tcz: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam heng’a asei jin, Ipi neilo hitam? ka melma te gaosap dinga ka kou na hin ahinlah nang in Phatthei na boh jo tai ati
en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
en_kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

tcz: Ahinlah, Balaam chun a donbut in “Keiman vang Pathen in thu cheng ka lung thimma ei seipeh ho bou ka sei doh ding ahi bouve” ati.
en_web: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”
en_kjv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?

tcz: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam chu mun chomma akou kit in. Hilai’a khu nang in mi dang chi dang Israel nam chom khat aum in, amavang abonchauvin kati poi hiche a um ho beh khu nei gao sap peh in kati.
en_web: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
en_kjv: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

tcz: Balak chu Zophim kiti damchup aum Pisgah molchunga apui touvin Balaam in maicham phung-sagi a tung doh in hiche maicham phol chunga bongnou chal chuleh kelngoi khat chu akat doh tan ahi.
en_web: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
en_kjv: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

tcz: Balaam in jong Balak lengpa komma aseitan, nangma hikomma ana um ta din phat chomkhat keima kaga potdoh ding Pathen in ipi ei houlimpi ding ham keima Pathen toh kihou lim’a pot doh ding ka hi.
en_web: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
en_kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.

tcz: Chule Pakaiyin akimupin aki houlimpi tan, hichun Pathen in Balak komma che in lang hi tin ki houlimpi in a thuhet ho chu hetsah tan, ati.
en_web: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
en_kjv: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

tcz: Balaam chu akinung le phat in Balak lampi ahin Moab mite hochu toh maicham phol muna chun thanom tah le ngahlal tah in ana um un ahi. Balak in a dongtan Pathen in epi nasei peh hitam tin a dong tan ahi.
en_web: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”
en_kjv: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?

tcz: Balaam in hiche thuchih ho a sei dohtan, Zippor chapa Balak ka thusei hohi ngai tem in, Ki thoudoh tan, ati.
en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
en_kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; Hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

tcz: Pakai hi mihem ahilou jeh in jou asei poi, Pathen hi mihem ahi loujeh in lunggel akhel ngai poi, Pakai-Pathen nin ana phondoh ana sei doh aboltan atoh lou um kha tam? Pathen in ana kitepna atoh doh louna suhbulhit louna um kha tam? tin aseiye.
en_web: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
en_kjv: God is not a man, that he should lie; Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and shall he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

tcz: Ngaijun keiman Pathen holna ding in thupeh kamui, Pakai-Pathen in phatthei aboh sa chu koiman akham thei poi, ka nung lah doh thei poi, ati.
en_web: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
en_kjv: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; And I cannot reverse it.

tcz: Ama tohgon na a Jacob din manthah na imacha aum poi Israelte din lhaset na toh phalou imacha aum poi Pakaiyin ei umpi jing uvin Isreal a ana ki phut det ihi tauve.
en_web: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
en_kjv: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, Neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: The Lord his God is with him, And the shout of a king is among them.

tcz: Eygpt a konna Pakaiyin ahin pui doh u ahi tai Israelte ding a Pakai chu bongchal hang sen tah ahiye.
en_web: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
en_kjv: God brought them out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

tcz: Sapset na in Jacob a sukhah lou beh ding, Isreal chung nga hile gam thahat kitah lang ding hi jong le, tuapat Jacob henga patna hiti a ka sei ding Pathen in Israel te din hitabang loupina abol ahi tai, ati.
en_web: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
en_kjv: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, Neither is there any divination against Israel: According to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

tcz: Veuvin mipi hochu keipi bang in ading doh un chule keipi bahkai bangtah in a ding doh tai, anneh ding an chah aval lhum masang nga kum lha lou ahi sa kitah thisan adon kahse a ding ahi, ati.
en_web: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
en_kjv: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, And lift up himself as a young lion: He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, And drink the blood of the slain.

tcz: Hichun Balak lengpa chun Balaam henga asei tan aphai amahohi nagaosap lou ding ahitah leh phatthei jong boh dajeng tan, atileh;
en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
en_kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

tcz: Ahin Balaam in Balak chu ahoulim pitan kana phondoh bangtah in Pakaiyin a phondoh hochu ka bol ding ka toh ding ahi kana ti ahi ajeh chu Balaam in thuphon dohna chu thumvei anei ahi.
en_web: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”
en_kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?

tcz: Chu in Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan, lungset tah in neihin jui tan keiman nangma hi munchom’a kapui ding akhatna Pathen lunglam ahung hi thei leh Israel mite chu keima a ding a nei gaosap peh thei ahi.
en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
en_kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

tcz: Balak in Balaam chu Peor molchung sang lam ah apui tou tan gam ong tamtah ahung kisuh vet na munah chun apuijin ahi.
en_web: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
en_kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

tcz: Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan hikom ahin maicham phung sagi nei sempeh in chule bongnou chal sagi chule kelngoi achal sagi maicham kintheng adin nei gonpeh in, ati.
en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

tcz: Hichun Balak in Balaam dei dol tah le asei dung jui jin bongnou chal sagi maicham phol chunga akoi in chule kelngoi chal sagi umna maicham phol chunga ajam lhatan, ahi.
en_web: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
en_kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

tcz: Balaam Israel mite phatthei aboh leh Pathen a lunglhai chu ahet phat chun phat dang laiya bang’in doithu ho mangcha din aki go ta pon, gamthip lam agal vet e.
en_web: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
en_kjv: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

tcz: Hitia Balaam a dadoh a avetpet chun Israel mite ama phung cheh a akigol u-chu amu tan chu in Pathen lhagao chu Balaam chung ah ahung chu tan ahi.
en_web: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
en_kjv: And Balaam lift up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

tcz: Hichun Balaam in akam akehdoh in asei pan tai. Beor chapa Balaam in asei doh ho; kho kimusah pa thusei dohho;
en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
en_kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, And the man whose eyes are open hath said:

tcz: Pathen thupeh awgin japa chun, hatchung-nung gaova muthei pa, Ama angsung a bohkhup a amit-ha let-sah pa:
en_web: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
en_kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, Which saw the vision of the Almighty, Falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

tcz: Vo Jacob na ponbuh hohi iti hoiya hitam mo! O Israel na inpi ho lungset aum tangeije.
en_web: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
en_kjv: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, And thy tabernacles, O Israel!

tcz: Palm thingna hing dildel bang leh luipang a honlei kisem bang in a kijao-jahdeh jeng in; Pakaiyin a phudoh sa, Vadung pang’a keh Cedar phungho to abang jeng’e.
en_web: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
en_kjv: As the valleys are they spread forth, As gardens by the river side, As the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, And as cedar trees beside the waters.

tcz: A twibel akon twi hing hung putdoh intin; a chilhah hon angaichat jouse anei uve. A lengpa’u jong Agag sang in thupi jo in, a lenggam’u jong ki domsang ding ahi.
en_web: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
en_kjv: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, And his seed shall be in many waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.

tcz: Pathen chun Eygpt a kon ahin pui doh ahi; Ama thahatna chu Gam-bong hangsan tah abangin, Amaho douvah nam jouse avallhum sohtan, agu achang jouseu asuh boh pih in, athalpi hattah chun a kap ji.
en_web: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
en_kjv: God brought him forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: He shall eat up the nations his enemies, And shall break their bones, And pierce them through with his arrows.

tcz: Keipi bang chan Israel ten alonvuh un, alo tauve; Koiham amaho suthou ngam ding’a chu? Vo Israel nangma na phatthei ho chu ahampha uvin, Nangma na gaosap ho chu avangse ahiuve.
en_web: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
en_kjv: He couched, he lay down as a lion, And as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, And cursed is he that curseth thee.

tcz: Hichun Balak chu Balaam chunga hatah in alung hang tan Balak in Balaam khut teni chu a volhan chuin Balak in Balaam kom mah hitin asei tai, keiman ka melmate gaosap ding a kakou nahin nangman lolhing tah a thumvei phatthei naboh joh ahitai.
en_web: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
en_kjv: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

tcz: Tun nangma na gam lamah kinungle kit tan, keiman nangma hi loupi tah a jabol ding tia kana seidoh ahin, dih tah a sei ding in Pathen in thupitah a nachen na ding ah kon in na tum chondoh joh ahi tai.
en_web: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”
en_kjv: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.

tcz: Hichu Balaam in Balak kom ah asei tan keiman a solchah pa komma ka na seipeh hita lou ham? Keima henga nahin solpa heng lamma chu, ati.
en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
en_kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

tcz: Balaam chun aseiyin sana le dangka insung dimset eikipe jongle keima Pathen thupeh kalval ah ka che be theipoi ati thilpha bol ding chu kakin ahin, keima dei bang tah in ka chal thei poi. Pathen in ei houlimpi ho chu keiman ka sei doh ngai ahi.
en_web: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?
en_kjv: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?

tcz: Chule tua jong keima dihtah a sei ding ahileh kanam ka insung mite lah a che ding ka hitai, hung tan keiman ka sei peh nahi hiche mipi teho hin nangma mite nam lentah chunga ahin bol diu khonung teng Balaam in gaova thusei livei na chan chu hiding ahi.
en_web: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
en_kjv: And now behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

tcz: Hichun Balak hin athu lhun bu chu aki lah in hitin asei tan, Balaam chapan hitin a seije pasal koi tabang khovah muthei hon hitin aseiye, ati.
en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
en_kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, And the man whose eyes are open hath said:

tcz: Balak in hitin aseijin Pathen thu chu aja tauvin chungnung penna thujong aja tauvin ahi. Chungnung penna gaothu mitphel in ahung lhung tan ahin amit chun kho amutan ahi.
en_web: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
en_kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, And knew the knowledge of the most High, Which saw the vision of the Almighty, Falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

tcz: Ama chu ka ven hinlah ka mu theipoi, amavang Jacob apatna valpa khang hung doh ding ahi. Israel la patna tenggol khat hunngpeng doh ding chule Moab te aning keh ajep chip ding Tumelt chate asuh gam ding ahiye.
en_web: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
en_kjv: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: There shall come a Star out of Jacob, And a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, And shall smite the corners of Moab, And destroy all the children of Sheth.

tcz: Sedom jong toupha a um ding Seir doupa jong toupha a umding ahi. Amavang Israel chu thahat cheh ding ahi.
en_web: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
en_kjv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; And Israel shall do valiantly.

tcz: Jacob a patna hung ding jahda chun thaneina anei tah ding hiche khopi a amapa umjing nalaipa chu suhgam’a um ding ahiye.
en_web: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
en_kjv: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, And shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

tcz: Chuin Balak in Amalekte techu aven Amalekte mite chu nam lah a amasa loi pentah ahin, amahi athini geiya anu khah penna pang ding ahi.
en_web: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
en_kjv: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; But his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

tcz: Chuin Balak in Mitbah Oraeh chu aki lah kit tan chu in hitin asei tai nangma pansat nahi ada tangeiye ati.
en_web: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
en_kjv: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling place, And thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

tcz: Nangma Cannan mite jong suhmanga na um ding Asshur ten soh changa nangma na koi ding ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
en_kjv: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, Until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

tcz: Hichun Balak in gaova aseitan, Oh hitobang tah a hi Pathen in na atoh le koi cheng jou ding hinam?
en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
en_kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

tcz: Chuin twikong ahung kipat doh tan amaho chun Assyria mite chule Eber chu ahopa uvin, amaho jong chu suhmang a um ding ahiuve, ati.
en_web: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
en_kjv: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, And shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, And he also shall perish for ever.

tcz: chujouvin Balaam in adalhan a inlamma akiletan, chuleh Balak jong achi nading lampi ah achitan ahi.
en_web: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
en_kjv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

tcz: Israel mite chu Acacia Grove mun’a aum laitah uchun Pasal chengse Moab mite numeiho toh ajong tauve.
en_web: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
en_kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people begun to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

tcz: Hiche Moab numei techun a Pathen kom uvah kilhan doh din atem uvin ahi. Israel mite chun akilhan na thilho’u chu ane uvin hiche a pathen angsung uvah jong abohkhup tauve.
en_web: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
en_kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

tcz: Hiti pichun Israel miten Baal-Peor kiti ahou uchu ajop tauvin; Pathen lunghan na chu ahung deu jah jeng tai.
en_web: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.
en_kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.

tcz: Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpin hiche mite lamkai hohi kou khom un Pathen masang ah; sunkim laitah leh amaho hinkhom in alamkai na’u lahdoh pehtan, hiche jeh achu Israel mite chunga Pathen lunghanna aki chon mang thei na ding in, ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n Israelte Thutan lamkai ho thu atan tai: Nang hon namite lah uva koi hitajong leh Baal-Peor hou nungjui jouse na thadoh diu ahi ati.
en_web: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.

tcz: Hichun Israel mi khat nin Ama insung mite masanga Midian numei khat Mose masang laitah achun ahin puilut’e; Hichu Israel mipite chu houbuh masanga kap le maova aum lai tah u ahiye.
en_web: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Chuin Phinehas kiti Eleazer chapa Aaron thempu pa tupa chun amu phat in, Israel mipi kikhopna chu a dalhan, achom doh phut in, a khutna tengcha a kichoi jin ahi.
en_web: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
en_kjv: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from amongst the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

tcz: Apon buh sunggei ajui lut in, A tengpi hin choi chun Pasal pa tahsa leh numeinu oipoh chu asun peijin akilbeh tha jeng tai. Hiche jeh chun Israel mite chunga gotna Hise lang chu atang hel tai.
en_web: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
en_kjv: and he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

tcz: Pul’a thi mi jat mong mong chu sang-somni le sangli ahi.
en_web: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu aseiyin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Eleazer chapa Phenahas kiti Aaron thempu tupa ama tah hin Israel chate chunga ka lung hanna jouse eisuh mang peh’a; ei kipasah ahitai. Ajeh chu amapa hi keima dinga thangtom tah leh gunchu tah in apang in, hiche ho jeh a chu Israel chate ka suh mang lou ding ahi tai, tin a seije.
en_web: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
en_kjv: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

tcz: Tun ama ga seipeh un; Israel te chungah Cham le lungmon anei tah diuvin kitepna kabol e.
en_web: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
en_kjv: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

tcz: Ka kitepna ahin keiman Ama ahin Ama chilhah ho chunga atonsot na thempu phunga ka semdoh ding ahi ajeh chu Phenehas chu a Pathen ding’a thang tom tah a pang ahi tan Israel chate ding a ki suhtheng na maicham sem dohpa kiti ding ahi tai.
en_web: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
en_kjv: and he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

tcz: Midian numei toh thi khom pasal pa min chu Zimri ahin, Salu chapa ahin Simeon phung lamkai pa chilhah ho ahi.
en_web: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
en_kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

tcz: Chuleh Midian numei thina toh chu ahi leh Cozbi akitin Zur chanu ahin Zur chu ahile Midian te insung phung lamkai ahi.
en_web: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
en_kjv: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga thu hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Midian mite chu sugimtan chule amaho chunga gimna nalhunsah ding ahi, ati.
en_web: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;
en_kjv: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

tcz: Ajeh chu Moab mite in na suhgam thei’u ahin Peor Baal kimanchah na dung juiya Cozbi thua jong nabol sahtan, Midian te lamkai pa chanu jong chu pulla thi lo ahitai. Ijeh nam itileh Peor Baar jeh a hichu lhung ahiye.
en_web: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
en_kjv: for they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.

tcz: Gamna hoiset naphat aki chai tan Pakaiyin Mose ahin Eleazer kiti Aaron thempupa chapa koma hitin asei tan ahi,
en_web: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
en_kjv: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

tcz: “Israel chate minlahna neijun kum somnia pat chunglam jouse apa insung a konna hiding amaho chengse chu galsat ding ahiuve.”
en_web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
en_kjv: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

tcz: Chu in Mose le Aaron chapa Eleazer thempu pa’n hiti hin aseijin Moab tolpi laiya Jordan kom ah Jericho gal lang a aum laitah un, Israel lamkai ho hengah hiti hin aseijin ahi:
en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
en_kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Israel mite Eygpt ma konna ahung doh uva patna thupih dungjuiya kum som nia pat chunglam min jihlutna neiyun ati bang tah chun abol tauvin ahi.
en_web: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Israel chapa Reuben chate hochu Hanoch ahin, Hanoch chate ho jouse hung kondoh nau apabullu chu ahiye.
en_web: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
en_kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

tcz: Hezron mite ho hi Hezron a hungkon doh ahiuvin chule Carmite jonghi Carmi a hung peng ahiuve.
en_web: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
en_kjv: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

tcz: Reuben insung mite jat chu sangsomli le sangthum toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
en_kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

tcz: Pallu chu Eliab te hungkon doh na ahi,
en_web: The son of Pallu: Eliab.
en_kjv: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

tcz: Eliab chate thum Dathan,Abiram, chule Nemuel amaho cheng hi nampi phungpi lah a afel pentah hochu ahiuvin chule Dathan le Abiram hi Korah toh kiloikhom uva Mose le Aaron ana doudal’uva, Pakai jeng jong nahsah louva anadoudal u ahi.
en_web: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;
en_kjv: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:

tcz: Chuin gamthip leiset chu meiyin ahin katan amaho jouse chu Korah toh abonchavin phung lamkai nam lamkai jouse aval lhum in athitauvin ahi. Hiche meikong in ahalvam chu mi jani le somnga ahiuvin amaho chu muthei melchih in aum tauve.
en_web: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
en_kjv: and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

tcz: Ahinlah, hiche nikho chun Korah chate chu anathi pou vin ahi.
en_web: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

tcz: Simeon chapate ho aphung min dung jui a Nemuel akihi sah in Nemuel te chilhah ho vang Jamin ahiuvin, Jamin chilhah hochu Jachin ahi uve, Jachin chilhah hochu Jachin te tin akihe.
en_web: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
en_kjv: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

tcz: Zera chilhah techu Zera tin akihen Zelha chilhah techu Shaul akiti uvi, amaho chu Shual te chilhah akitiuvin ahi.
en_web: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
en_kjv: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Simeon chilhah te ahiuvin agomma sangsom ni le sang ni toh jani ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

tcz: Gad chilhah te phung dungjui in-Zephonte akiti uvin Zephonte a kon chu Haggi ahiuvin, Haggi te chilhah apat na Shuni hung pengdoh a Shuni mite hung kitiuva ahiye.
en_web: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
en_kjv: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

tcz: Ozni phungmi a konna chu Ozni mite hung kondoh ahiuvin Eri a konna chu Eri insung mite hung kon ahiuve.
en_web: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
en_kjv: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

tcz: Arod mite a konna phung mite jouse hung kondoh ahiuve, Areli a konna Areli mite hung kondoh ahiuve.
en_web: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
en_kjv: of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

tcz: Amaho jouse Gad-insung phung mite jouse chu amijat mong mong sangsom li le sangnga ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Juda in chapa ni anei in, Er le Onan ahilhon in chuleh amani hi Canaan gam aumlai uva anathi lhon ahitai.
en_web: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
en_kjv: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Amaho phung dungjuiya Shela akiti uvin Shela chilhah akon Perez a konna Pera mite akitiuvin, Zera mite hi Zerah chilhah a konna hung kon doh ahi uvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
en_kjv: And the sons of Judah after their families were, of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

tcz: Chule Perez chilhah te hochu Hezron akiti uvin chule Hamul akon nin Hamut te chilhah ahung kondoh uvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
en_kjv: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

tcz: Hiche hohi Judate chilhah ho insung dungjuiya mijat chu sangsom sagi le gup toh janga ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Issachar te chilhah ho insung dungjui ja Tol'a akiti uvin Tol'a te a konna chu Puah ahung hiuvin hiche a konna chu Puah phungmi hungsoh doh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
en_kjv: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

tcz: Jashub a konna Jashub insung mite chilhah ho a hung kondoh un Shimron a konna Shimron chilhah te hung kon doh ahiuve.
en_web: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
en_kjv: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

tcz: Amaho hi Issachar chilhah ho ahiuvin amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom guple sangli le jathum ahi.
en_web: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

tcz: Zebulun insung mi chilhah hohi Sered ahiuvin Sared te akon in Elonite insung mi ahung doh’un chule Jahleel a konna Jahleel insung mite ahung kondoh un ahi.
en_web: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Zebelun insung mite ahiuvin amaho jouse mijat abonchauvin sangsom gup le janga ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Joseph chilhah ho Manasseh le Ephraim a konna chateho ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
en_kjv: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

tcz: Manasseh chilhah ho-Makir chilhah ho Makir in Gilead ahing in Gilead apatna Gilead insung mite chilhah ho hung pengdoh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

tcz: Gilead chate son le pah ho chu Iezer mite hungdoh ahiuvin chule Helek a konna Helek mite chilhah ho hung pengdoh ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
en_kjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

tcz: Asriel apatna Asriel son le pah ho hung pengdoh ahiuvin Shechem mi apatna shechem chilahah hung kondoh ahiuve.
en_web: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
en_kjv: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

tcz: Shemida apatna Shemida mite hung kondoh ahiuvin Hepher a patna Hepher mite son le pah hung kondoh ahiuve.
en_web: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
en_kjv: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

tcz: Tua hin Hepher’s chapa Zelophehad nin chapa khat jong anei tapon, ahinlah Zelophehad nin vang chanu ahing tan amaho chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve.
en_web: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
en_kjv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Manasseh insung mi son le pah chilhah mijat chu sangsomnga le sangni toh jasagi jen ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

tcz: Ephraim chate hochu ahiuvin ahi: Shuthelah chilhah hohi nam min a konna hung potdohu ahin Beker chilhah ho jong Beker a kon ahin Tahan chilhah son le pah ho jong Tahan na hung kondoh Ephraim, Shuthelah, Beker ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

tcz: Shuthelah son le pah amaho hi ahiuve, Eran chilhah a konna Eran mite hung kondoh u ahiye.
en_web: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

tcz: Ephraim chate chilhah hi amaho jouse hi ahiuvin, amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom thumleni toh janga ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
en_kjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

tcz: Benjamin chate hi Bela a konna Bela mi ahung kon doh un, Ashbel la konna Ashbel insung mite ahung doh in Ahiram ma konna Ahiram son le pah chilhah te hung peng doh u ahi.
en_web: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
en_kjv: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

tcz: Shupham ma kon in Shupham insung mite hojouse ahung kon doh un Hupham a konna Hupham mite hung kondoh ahi.
en_web: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
en_kjv: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

tcz: Chule Bela chate hi Ard le Naaman ahin Ard na konna chu Ard insung mite jouse hung kondoh a Chule Naaman a konna Naaman mite hung kon doh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
en_kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

tcz: Benjamin chilhah a konna hung peng doh jouse hi sangsomli le sangnga le jagup ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Dan insung phung mite ahiuve Shubam ma konna Shubam chilhah te jouse hung peng doh ahin amaho jouse hi Dan insung chilhah ahiuve.
en_web: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
en_kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

tcz: Shubam mite jouse chu insung mite chilhah jouse abonchauvin sangsomgup le sangli le jali ahiuve.
en_web: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
en_kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

tcz: Asher chilhah amaho jouse hi ahiuvin Jimna chilhah te ahung peng lhauvin, Jesuit chilhah a kon in Jesui son le pah ho ahung penglha un chule Beriah te chilhah a apat nin Beriit te son le pah ho ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
en_kjv: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

tcz: Beriah te chilhah akon Heber ahung pengtan Heber a kon in Heber son le pah ho ahung peng’un ahi.
en_web: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

tcz: Asher chanu chu Serah ahi.
en_web: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
en_kjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

tcz: Hiche hohi Asher insung mi chilhah hochu ahiuvin amijat u chu sangsomnga le thumle jali aiuve.
en_web: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

tcz: Naphtali insung mite a konna hung kondoh chu Jahzeel, Jahzeel chilhah ho ahung pengdoh un chule Guni apat nin Guni son le pah ho ahung peng un ahi.
en_web: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
en_kjv: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

tcz: Jezer a patnin Jezer mite ahung pengdoh un, Shillem ma pat nin Shillem chilhah hochu ahung pengdoh un ahi.
en_web: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
en_kjv: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

tcz: Hiche mipi jouse hi Naphtali son le pah chilhah jouse ahiuvin, abonchauvin mijat sangsomli le sangnga le jali ahiuve.
en_web: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
en_kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

tcz: Hicheho jouse hi Isreal mite jat ahiuve, abonchauva sangsom gup le khat le jasagi le somthum le ko ahiuve.
en_web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
en_kjv: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga hiti hin aseiyin,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Hiche gam leiset hi hoppih tan, aphungdung jui, Anam dungjui chuleh amijat kijihlut dungjui in.
en_web: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
en_kjv: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

tcz: Phung tam mitam hochu atam dungjui ja nei le gou achanvou uchu natam peh ding chule phung lhom diu hochu chanvou alhom jep napeh ding ahi amaho jouse achanvou uhi achandiu lom cheh a na peh angaiye.
en_web: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
en_kjv: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

tcz: Ahin lah gam le leiset ho ama ama vang dungjuiya kihom ding ahiuve, ama ama hungkondoh na phung min dungjui ja kihom khan cheh ding ahi.
