en_web: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

tcz: Hitia chu vang kisan dungjui a atam leh alhom a gam chu kihom ding’u ahi.
en_web: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
en_kjv: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

tcz: Amahohi aphung dungjuija Levite insung mite ahiuvin; Gershon insung mite chu, amaho chu Gershon son le pah kiti diu, Kohath a konna chu Kohath chilhah kiti diu chule Merari a konna hungpot doh ho chu Merari chilhah hi diu ahi.
en_web: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
en_kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

tcz: amahohi Levite insung mite ahiuvin Libnite kiti diu ahi. Amaho hi Hebron insung mite kiti diu, Amaho chu Mahlite chilhah kiti ding, Mushites insung mite kiti ding, Korath te insung mite kiti diu chule Korath kitipa hin Amram ahing in ahi.
en_web: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
en_kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath begat Amram.

tcz: Jochebed hi Amram inneipu ahin Levite chanu Eygpt ma Levi insunga peng ahin, Jochebed chate ho chu Aaron le Mose chule asopi nu lhon Miriam toh ahiuve.
en_web: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
en_kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

tcz: Aaron chate hochu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar ahiuve.
en_web: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
en_kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

tcz: Chule Nabad le Abihun Pathen meikong thupih phallou a ahal lhon jeh in athi lhon tai.
en_web: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
en_kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.

tcz: Tuhin amaho Levite jouse pasal chapang lhakhat apet chunglam jouse sangsomni le sangthum jen chu Israel midang hotoh kisim tha lou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Isreal te lah achu amaho neile gou kisim thalou ahi.
en_web: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

tcz: Israel miho chu Moab gam a Jordan gallam mah Jericho pang lah a Mose le Aaron Thempupa in mi jat asim doh lhen doh hochu ahiuve.
en_web: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
en_kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

tcz: Sinai molchunga Mose le Aaron thempu pan Israelte ana sim hin amaho jouse hi kasim thalou ahitai, ajeh chu amaho hi cannan gamma khoiju le bongnoi lon nagam lut lou diu ahitai.
en_web: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
en_kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho hi Pathen in ana sei peh in “Amaho jouse hi thonlouva gamthip lah’a thitei ding ahi tauve” amaho lah achu pasal khat jong lutthei talou ding Caleb kiti Jephunneh chule Joshua kiti Nunchapa amani tailou adangse khat jeng cha jong lutthei lou diu ahi.
en_web: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
en_kjv: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Joseph chate Manasseh chilhah ho Zelophat chateho Hepher chate Gilead chateho, Makhir chate chule achanu teuho min hou jouse chu mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve amaho jouse ahung khomsoh keiyun ahi.
en_web: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
en_kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Chuin amaho chu Mose masang, Eleazer thempu masang, chuleh Japi lamkai ho masanga houbuh leitol ah ading un ahi.
en_web: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
en_kjv: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

tcz: Kapu teuchu gamthip lah a ahinkhou ana beitan, Korah mite lah a khat pen chu ana hi pon amachu mi holah a Pathen lungdei lou bol ho khat chu ahin amavang ama chonset jal'a ahinkho beija ahitai chule chapa neilou ahiye.
en_web: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
en_kjv: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

tcz: Epijeh a kapateu min chu aphung sung uva kon mang jeng ding ham chapa aneilou jeh mei a? Chanvou neilegou ka insung mite dang ho a tabong neipiu vin ati.
en_web: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
en_kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n amaho thule la boina chu Pathen masanga apolut tan ahi.
en_web: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
en_kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose hitin ahin donbut in ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Zelophehad chanute kiphin ahi ding mong tah ahiye. Mose nangman amaho neile gou apaho sopite ho lah a ding’a hin napeh tei angaiye chule apate ho chan vou ding u chu na peh teidiu ahi, ati.
en_web: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
en_kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

tcz: Israel mite chu sei pih tan, pasal khat chu ahinkho abeiya chule chapa neilouva aum tah a ahile anei le agou jouse chu achanute chang ding ahi.
en_web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
en_kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

tcz: Amapa chun chanu anei tah hih le anei le agou hou chu asopite na peh ding ahi tai.
en_web: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
en_kjv: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

tcz: Israel mikhat chu athi tah a sopi aneitah lou leh achan vou aneile agou chu apa sopite ho napeh ding ahiye.
en_web: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
en_kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

tcz: Nikhat Pathen in Mose komah asei in, “Nisolam vadung kom a molchung khat pen ah kel tou inlang chule keiman Israel te kapeh nading gamsung khu gah vetem in ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

tcz: Nangma in natahsa tah a namu teng nangma jong nasoopipa Aaron bonga nathi ding ahitai,
en_web: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
en_kjv: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

tcz: Ajeh chu mipite ho gamthip lah Zin’a akiphin laitah un keiman kathendol amaho kom a twichungah phongjel lhonin kati chu nangnin keima doumah joh in nachon lhon tan ahi. (Hichehi Kadesh kiti Zin gammang a Meribah twi chu ahi).
en_web: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
en_kjv: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Pakai henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
en_web: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
en_kjv: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,

tcz: Pakaiyin vannoiya lhangho jouse mi jouse pasal jouse chunga vaihom ding lheng doh tahen, ati.
en_web: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
en_kjv: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

tcz: Amaho lah a konna hungpot doh ding amaho lah a gamsung lutthei hiding koitabang amaho lah a konna hin puidoh theiya hin nung lhunsah kit thei hiding Pathen mipi te, hijeh achu kelngoi aching umlou bang nga a umlou nadiu ahi.
en_web: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
en_kjv: which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

tcz: Chu in PakaiyinMose aki houlimpi tan Joshua kiti Nun chapa lhagao neisa pahi nangman heng a kou inlang achungah nakhut ngam in atie.
en_web: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

tcz: Eleazer thempu pa leh mipi jouse masangah dinsah inlang chuleh mipi jouse het in amachu mipite puihoi din thupeh nei in.
en_web: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
en_kjv: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

tcz: Chule Joshua chu nangman thanei nachu napeh ding hiche jeh achu Israel mipi te lah a thuneina anei thei nading ahi.
en_web: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
en_kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

tcz: Eleazer thempu pa masang a ding ding chule Pathen lam gel doh jing a aum na laiya Urim thutanna umna ahin, amapa thupeh dungjuiya potdoh diu chule amapa thuneina a hung sung lha diu Joshua le Israel mipi jouse umkhom diu ahi.
en_web: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
en_kjv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh dungjui in abollin hichun Mose’n Joshua chu Eleazer thempu pa masang leh Israel mipite masangah adinsah tan ahi.
en_web: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
en_kjv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

tcz: Chule Mose’n akhut chu Joshua chunga angam in phatthei abohtan Pathen nin aphatsah a thu apeh bangtah in aboltan ahi.
en_web: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.
en_kjv: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel mite henga hiti hin seijin, keima dinga govam thilto keima neh ding, hochu kipel lou hela aphat cha ka henga na hin lhut jing diu ahi.
en_web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
en_kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

tcz: Chule amaho henga hitia hi naseipeh ding, nanghon Pakai dinga govam thilto nabol diu chu hiche hi ahi. Nisih le abei theilou ding thiltoa pang ding, kumkhat lhingsa, kelngoichal nolna bei natodoh jing diu ahi.
en_web: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
en_kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

tcz: Hitia chu kelngoi khatpen chu jingkah lama nato doh diu, khatma chu nilhah lama na todoh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,
en_kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

tcz: Chule lhosohga thilto a pangdia chang bong neldisel ephah dim khat hopsomma hopkhat le thaotui kiheh lhasa Hin dim khat, hopsomma hopsom a hopli toh kihelsa jaona natodoh ding ahi.
en_web: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
en_kjv: and a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

tcz: Hiche thilto hi beitih neilou pumgo thiltoa pang jing dinga Sinai molchunga thupeh anahitai.
en_web: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Lengpitwi jaona to ding chu kengoi khat cheh jaona to ding ahi jeh chun Hin dimkhat hoplia hopkhat jaona hi ding ahi. Muntheng laiya hiche lengpitwi thengsel hi Pakai dinga nasun lhah ding ahi.
en_web: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.
en_kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.

tcz: Chule kelngoi khatpen jong chu nilhah lam teng natodoh ding, jingkah lama na thilto banga lhosoh leh lengpi twi ki bolna banga, meiya govam thiltoa nabol ding Pakai dinga gim namtui tah naso ding ahi.
en_web: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
en_kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

tcz: Cholngah nikho seh le kelngoi achal ni kumkhat lhingsa nolna bei na todoh diu, lhosohga thilto dinga jong changbong neldisel Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopkhat thaotui toh helsa hi ding, lengpitwi jaona hi ding ahi.
en_web: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
en_kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

tcz: Hichu bei tih nei louva pumgo thilto kitoh le lengpitwi sim louva jong, hichu cholngah nikho seh a thilto ding chengse ahi.
en_web: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
en_kjv: this is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

tcz: Kum sunga lha na sim nau lha kipat na jong chu Pakai dinga thilto na bol diu ahi. Kumkhat lhingsa bongchal ni nolna bei hel leh kengoi chal khat toh kelngoi achal sagi jaona hi ding ahi.
en_web: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,
en_kjv: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

tcz: Chule bongchal khat cheh toh to tha dinga lhosohga thilto ding changbong neldisel Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hop thum thaotui jaona hi ding ahi. Kelngoi chal khat toh totha ding changbong neldisel ephah dim khat hopsomma hopni thaotui toh helsa hi ding ahi.
en_web: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;
en_kjv: and three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

tcz: Kelngoi chal khat cheh toh totha dinga lhosohga thilto jaona ephah hopsomma hop khat thaotui jaona hiding, hichengse chu gimnam tuitah pumgo thiltoa pang ding, Pakai dinga meiya govam thilto ding ahi.
en_web: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
en_kjv: and a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

tcz: Lengpitwi thilto ding chu bongchal khat dinga lengpitwi Hin khat hopthumma hopkhat dim hiding, chule kengoi khat jaona toding chu Hin dimkhat hoplia hop khat hiding, hichengse hi kumkhat sunga lhaseh le pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi.
en_web: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
en_kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of a hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of a hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

tcz: Chule Pakaija chonset thilto dinga manchah ding chu kelngoichal khat hiding, hichu tantih nei louva to jing ding pumgo thilto lengpitwi komma chu todoh ding ahiye.
en_web: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
en_kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, besides the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

tcz: Chule lhamasa pen nisom leh nili lhin nikho hi Pakai dinga kalchuh kut ahi.
en_web: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
en_kjv: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche lha nisom le ninga lhinni hi kut nikho ding ahin, nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.
en_web: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
en_kjv: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

tcz: Kut nikho masapen nile khoppi theng kibol ding, hiche nikho teng natoh nabol lou hel diu ahi.
en_web: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,
en_kjv: In the first day shall be a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

tcz: Meiya govam thilto hichu Pakaija dinga natoh doh nikhou hiding ahi. Hiche dinga chu bongchal ni leh kelngoi chal khat jaona chule kumkhat lhingsa cheh kengoichal sagi jaona hiding ahi. Hichengse chu nolna bei jing hidiu ahi.
en_web: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,
en_kjv: but ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

tcz: Hichengse toh totha ding chu lhosohga thilto changbong nel disel thaotui toh Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopthum chu bongchal khat toh nato tha diu, kelngoi chal khat dinga Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopni jaona na to ding ahi.
en_web: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
en_kjv: and their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

tcz: Kelngoi chal khat toh totha dinga ephah dim khat hopsomma hop khat jaona kelngoichal sagi ding ahi.
en_web: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
en_kjv: a several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

tcz: Na boncha diuva chonset ki thoidam na thilto a pang dinga kelchal khat jong hi ding ahi.
en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
en_kjv: and one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

tcz: Jingkah seh le tantih neilouva kitoh doh thilto pumgo thilto sim louva hichengse jong hi todoh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
en_kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

tcz: Ni sagi sunga hitia chu nabol jing diu, nisih leh meiya govam ding, Pakai anneh ding hichu gimnam tuitah dinga natodiu, hiche jong hi tantih neilou kitoh pumgo thilto leh lengpitwi ki todoh na muna chu na todoh diu ahi.
en_web: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
en_kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

tcz: Ni sagi lhinni leh khoppi khat na bol diu, hiche nikho a chu na toh hahsa na bol lou hel diu ahi.
en_web: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
en_kjv: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

tcz: Hapta seh le kut na bol jing diu, Pakai dinga lhosoh thilto changthah na hin todiu, lhoh sohga masa na hin to nikhou jong leh khoppi theng na nei diu, hiche nikho sih le chun natoh hahsa na bol thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
en_kjv: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

tcz: Hiche ho jouse sanga chu Pakai dinga gim namtui pumgo thilto na todoh joh diu ahi. Hichu bongchal golni kelngoi chal khattoh achal cheh sagi jaona hi ding, kelngoi hose chu aboncha kum khat lhingsa cheh hi ding ahi.
en_web: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
en_kjv: but ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

tcz: Lhosohga thilto toh tho ding chu bongchal khat jaona changbong neldisel thaotui toh halsa Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal khat dinga hopsom ma hopni bou hi ding ahi.
en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
en_kjv: and their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

tcz: Kelngoi chal sagi hi ding chu khat cheh dinga hopsom ma hop khat hi ding ahi.
en_web: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
en_kjv: a several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

tcz: Na kithoi dam na diuva kelchal jong hi ding ahi.
en_web: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.
en_kjv: and one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

tcz: Tantih nei louva ki bol leh lhosohga thilto kibol tai louva jong nanghon hichengse chu na todoh diu, lengpitwi thilto jaona natotha diu, thilto jouse chu nolna bei hel hi ding ahi.
en_web: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
en_kjv: Ye shall offer them besides the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

tcz: Lha sagi alhin teng, nikho masa khat nasem diu hiche nikhoa chu natoh hahsa kiti na toh lou diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu nangho dinga sumkon kimut ging ni hi ding ahi.
en_web: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
en_kjv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai dinga gimnamtui pumgo thilto nahinto cheh diu, hichu bongchal gol khat kelngoi chal khat, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoi chal sagi jaona hi ding ahi.

en_kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

tcz: Hichengse hi Mose’n pasal le numei kah a chondan mipa leh a chanu a nungah laiya, insung a chen laiya apa toh akah lhonna ding’a a thupeh chu ahi.
en_web: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
en_kjv: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu a seipeh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate hi Midian mite chunga galjona chansah tan, Hiche thilsoh akichai teng nangma jong namite a thisa ho toh umkhom ding ahitai.
en_web: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
en_kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n japi henga a seipeh tan, cheuvin lang Midian mite gasat tauvin, ajeh chu hiche mite chunga hi Pakaiyin phu nalah teitei diu, na lah uva mi phabep galvon tothoa na kon diu ahiye.
en_web: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.
en_kjv: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.

tcz: Israel phung sung’a kon mi sangkhat cheh dong khom unlang amaho chu galsat akon ding ahiuve.
en_web: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
en_kjv: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

tcz: Chuin Israel mi asang sang lah akon in ama phung sunga kon mi sangkhat cheh adong khom tauvin, galsat ding mong mong in mi sangsom le sangni a kondoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
en_kjv: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

tcz: Amaho jouse chu galsat ding in akondoh tauvin, ama phung sunga kon mi sang khat cheh leh Eleazer thempupa chapa Phinehas jaonan, muntheng laiya kimang Bubel phabep, mut ging ding in a khuta pha bep a kichoi jin ahi.
en_web: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
en_kjv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga a thupeh bang chun a mahon Midian mite chu gal asat khum tauvin, Pasal a kailhah kiti phot a that chai hel tauve.
en_web: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.
en_kjv: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

tcz: A mitha na lah uva chun Midian mite lah a Lengho jong ajao uvin, Leng atha hou chu Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur chule Reba ahiuve. Midian mite chu leng nga ahiuvin, chule Beor chapa Balaam jong chu Israel chaten chemjam in asat lih tauvin ahi.
en_web: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
en_kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

tcz: Hiti chun Israel miten Midian numei le chapang hochu ahin pui tauvin, a gancha hou ahin, a thilkeo jouse’u abonchan ahin chom gam hel taove.
en_web: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

tcz: Midian mite chenna jouse chule angahmun jouseu leh akhopi jouseu abonchan meiyin ahal vam hel taovin ahi.
en_web: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
en_kjv: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

tcz: Thil asuh set jouseu ahin, gancha abonchan a chom soh kei tauvin ahi.
en_web: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
en_kjv: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

tcz: Chu in galsat miho chun galhing hochu abonchaovin agal thilkeo hou jaonan akai tauvin ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu Mose henga chule Eleazer thempupa henga, Israel chate khopi pumpi henga ahin kaijun, Moab phaicham, Jordan vadung pang, Jericho ngahmun a sem na’uva chun abonchauvin ahin kai lhung soh kei tauvin ahi.
en_web: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
en_kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

tcz: Mose leh Eleazer thempupa chule khopi sunga lamkai jouse chu polama ache tauvin, galsat miho chu toh aga kimu to tauve.
en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
en_kjv: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

tcz: Chuin Mose jong galsat miho asang sang ahin, aja ja chunga thunei lamkai ahung kinung le ho chunga chun alung hang tan ahi.
en_web: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
en_kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

tcz: Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin a sei tan ahi. Ipi dinga numei ho hi na hing hoiyu ham?
en_web: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
en_kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

tcz: Hiche Numei ho jeh leh Balaam thuhil jeh’a Peor chung chang thu’a Israel chate jouse Pakai adia thet-umtah'a ana chon ahiuvin, hiche jeh chun Pakai mite chunga gamna hoise ana lan sah ahi.
en_web: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
en_kjv: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun naosen na hin poh lah uva pasal akai lhah jouse that tauvin, chule numei hija pasal toh ana kitimat sa jouse jong that jeng tauvin ati.
en_web: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
en_kjv: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

tcz: Ahinlah numei hija pasal toh kitimat lou lai chengse chu nang ho ding in hing hoiyun.
en_web: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
en_kjv: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

tcz: Chule nangho jouse lah’a gal a mithat ahin, mithi tongkha chan chu, ngahmun polam a ni sagi sung naum diu, nangho jouse na hiuvin, galhing a nahin kai jouse’u nithum lhinni le nisagi lhin nia na kisuh theng soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
en_kjv: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

tcz: Na ponsil u kelvun a kisem ahin, savun a kisem, chule thing them akonna kisem manchah jouse aboncha nasuh thengsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
en_kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.

tcz: Eleazer thempu pan galsat akon ho henga a seiyin, PakaiyinMose a thupeh sa danthu a kisem chondan chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;

tcz: Sana leh dangka, sum eng, chule hahngeh jaona bou ahi.
en_web: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
en_kjv: only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

tcz: Thilkeu mei jin akah vam thei lou chengse bou chu meiya na leudiu chu teng athenga na sim bep diu ahiye. Chule thilkeu ho chu thil theng lou kisopna tui mangcha a na sop theng diu, meiya leuva atheng theilou jouse jong na soptheng tho cheh diu ahi.
en_web: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
en_kjv: every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

tcz: Nisagi lhinni teng leh na ponsil jouse’u nasop theng soh kei diu, chu teng na then bep diu, hichea chu ngahmun nahung lut thei bep diu ahi.
en_web: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
en_kjv: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin a seipeh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

tcz: Nang leh Eleazer thempu ahin, khopi sunga lamkai chengse ahin, gal hinga nahin puiyu mihem ho leh ganchaho jouse a-bonchan simtoh tem’un.
en_web: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
en_kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

tcz: Galsatna akonna ki chomdoh thilho chu hopni na soding, hopkhat chu galsat miho napeh ding, chule khopi pumpi vang chu chan khatpen chu napeh ding ahi.
en_web: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
en_kjv: and divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

tcz: Galsat miho lah akon chun Pakai ding in kai dong sem in lang, mihem ahin, bongchal, sangan, kelngoi ho jong janga lah a khat cheh na lah doh ding ahi.
en_web: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
en_kjv: and levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

tcz: Hiche lahdoh ding ho hi galsat miho chan akon lah doh ding ahin, Pakai dinga thilto ding hichu Eleazer thempupa chang ding ahi.
en_web: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.
en_kjv: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for a heave offering of the Lord.

tcz: Israel chate jouse lah a konna chan ding chu mihem hihen, bongchal hi jong leh, sangan ho ahin, kelngoi hon, gancha jouse jong somnga lah a khat cheh lahdoh ding, hi chengse chu Pakai houbuh kinbolna mun’a na tong Levi mite chan ding ahiye.
en_web: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
en_kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang chun Mose leh Eleazer thempupan jong abol lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Gal muna kon galsat mihon ahin chomdoh u gal thil jouse ahin, kelngoi sang ja gup leh sang som sagi leh sang somnga alhing in ahi.
en_web: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
en_kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

tcz: Chule bong sang somsagi leh sangni ma alhing in ahi.
en_web: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
en_kjv: and threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

tcz: Sangan vang chu sang somgup le sang khat ahi.
en_web: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
en_kjv: and threescore and one thousand asses,

tcz: Mihem pasal toh kitimat loulai numei agomma sang somthum leh sang ni alhing in ahi.
en_web: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
en_kjv: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

tcz: Galsat akondoh ho chan ding chu kelngoi sang jathum le sang som thum leh sang sagi toh janga ahi.
en_web: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
en_kjv: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

tcz: Hichengse lah a Pakai chan ding chu kelngoi jagup leh som sagi leh nga alhing in ahi.
en_web: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
en_kjv: and the Lord’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang somthum le sang gup ahin, hiche lah achun Pakai chan ding chu somsagi leh ni alhing in ahi.
en_web: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.
en_kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and twelve.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang som thum leh janga alhing in, Pakai chan ding chu somgup leh khat alhing in ahi.
en_web: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.
en_kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and one.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding mihem chu sangsom le sang gup ahin, Pakai chan ding mihem chu mihem somthum le ni ahiye.
en_web: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
en_kjv: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was thirty and two persons.

tcz: PakaiyinMose athupeh bang chun Mose chun Pakai dinga a thilto-lom chu Eleazer thempupa henga apedoh tan ahi.
en_web: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord’s heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Galsat miho chan akon ahin Israel chate chan akon akeh khat cheh Mose’n achomma a koidoh in ahi.
en_web: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
en_kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

tcz: Khopi chan dinga kikheng doh akeh khat jat mong mong chu kelngoi sang jathum leh sang som thum sang sagi leh janga alhing in ahi.
en_web: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
en_kjv: (now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

tcz: Bong vang chu sang somthum leh sang gup alhing in ahi.
en_web: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
en_kjv: and thirty and six thousand beeves,

tcz: Sangan chu sang somthum leh janga alhing in ahi.
en_web: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
en_kjv: and thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

tcz: Mihem mong mong chu sang somthum le sanggup alhing in ahi.
en_web: and sixteen thousand persons),
en_kjv: and sixteen thousand persons;)

tcz: Israel chate chan akon chun Mose’n phabep khat akheng doh kit in, Pakayin Mose henga asei bang in, Mihem ahin ganchalah akon hileh somnga lah a kon chun khat cheh alheng doh in, hichengse chu Pakai houbuh alhacha a pang Levi mite ho chu apen ahi.
en_web: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.
en_kjv: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuleh Galsat miho asang sang chunga vaihom thuneiya pang, asang sang chunga vaihom le aja ja chunga vaihomma pang ho chu Mose henga ahung khom soh keiyun ahi.
en_web: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
en_kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

tcz: Galsat lamkai ho chun Mose henga hiti hin aseitaovin ahi. Na lhacha a pang keihon ka thuneina noi uva um galsat miho abonchan ka sim toh soh kei un, mihem khat jeng cha jong kalah uva alhasam le amang thai aum poi, atiuve.
en_web: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
en_kjv: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

tcz: Pakai ding’a thilto chu kei hon mihem ama ama kipehdoh na cheh in, sana kol a kisem chaokol ahin, chao jang, mohor numna khut jem, bilba ho, khi vui ho, hichengse akon in Pakai angsunga keiho kithoidam na ding in ka hin choi tauve, tin asei un ahi.
en_web: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”
en_kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Eleazer thempupan Galsat mihon ahin choi thilo jouse chu a kilah lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
en_kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

tcz: Pakai henga amanin atodoh thilto ho chu sana bouseh chu dangka shekel sang som le sanggup toh jasagi leh somnga alhing in, aboncha galsat lamkai ho, asang sang chung leh aja ja chunga thunei hon a todoh u ahi.
en_web: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
en_kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

tcz: Galsat akon miho jouse chun ama ama chan ding dol thil akilah soh keiyun ahi.
en_web: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
en_kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

tcz: Mose leh Eleazer chun galsat mi asang sang chunga thunei vaihom apang ho akon chun sana tampi chu ala lhon tan, Pakai angsunga Israel chate geldoh a aum jing na ding in kikhopna ponbuh sung lam achun ahin choi lut lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
en_kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.

tcz: Reuben leh Gad chilhahten bong hon tampi anavul un ahi. Chuin Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amudoh taovin ahile, hiche mun chu bong honte vahna ding’a ki lem tah a sohdoh tan ahi.
en_web: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
en_kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for cattle;

tcz: Chuin Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Mose leh Eleazer thempupa leh khoppi lamkai ho jouse hengah ahung un hiti hin a sei tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
en_kjv: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

tcz: Dibon leh Ataroth, Jazer, Nimrah, Hershbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo chule Beon ahiuve.
en_web: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
en_kjv: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

tcz: Pakaiyin mitmu changtah ah hichete ho Israel khoppi ana suhmang ahin, hiche gamsung chu bong vahna ding mong mong in aum tan, lhacha a pang ho jeng in jong bong ka nei uve atiuvin ahi.
en_web: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
en_kjv: even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

tcz: Chuin hiti hin aseijun, namitmua na lunglhaina lam katouva ahile, hiche gamsung hi nalhacha keiho chanvou in neisem peh tauvin, Jordan vadung gal lamma vang nei puida tauvin, tin asei uve.
en_web: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
en_kjv: wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

tcz: Mose’n jong Gad leh Reuben chate henga aseijin, na sopite hou galsat laitah a hi nangho tou thip beh a um deng ding na tiuham.
en_web: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
en_kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in a pehsa hiche gamsunga alut diu chu ipi dinga na lungthoi sah jeng’u ham?
en_web: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
en_kjv: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?

tcz: Napate uvin jong Kadesh Barnea apat hiche gam velhi dinga ka sol chun hiti hin asei un ahi.
en_web: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
en_kjv: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

tcz: Abonchauvin Eshcol phaicham geijin akitol tauvin, hiche gamsung chu amit tah uvin agamu tauve, Pakaiyin Israel chate apehsa gamsung alut diu sa chu ana lung thoisah jeng tauvin ahi.
en_web: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
en_kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.

tcz: Hiche nikho chun Pakai, Pathen alung hang doh jeng tan ahile hiti hin ki hahselna anei tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

tcz: Kum somnia lhah chunglam se, Egypt gamsung’a konna hungpot doh hon, Isaac, Abraham leh Jacob henga ka kitep nasa gamsunga chu lut theilou hel diu ahitai. Ajeh chu amaho hin cham kimsel in kanung ajui tapouvin ahi.
en_web: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
en_kjv: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

tcz: Keniz apat Jephunneh cha Caleb leh Nun chapa Joshua kalvalla adang koima chan hiche gamsung khu amuthei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amani hin Chamkim sella Pakai, Pathen nung ajuilhon ahi.
en_web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
en_kjv: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.

tcz: Israel chung’a Pakai, Pathen alunghang jeng tan ahile, chuin Israel mite hiche khang mite ho chu Pakai mitmua thilse bol jouse athigam kahsen kum som li sung in gamthip noiya avale sah tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
en_kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.

tcz: Nangho jong napu napate hou akonna chonsetna chun nahin jui peh taovin, hijeh chun Israel mite chunga Pakai lung hanna chu asang jocheh a lung hansah ding nagel uve!
en_web: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
en_kjv: And behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.

tcz: Chule Pakai nung najuina uva konna na kihei mang hel uva ahile, aman hiche mite hohi gamthip noiya don louva ahin koi ding, chu teng hiche mite ho chunga hi manthahna na alhunsah teitei ding ahi tai, ati.
en_web: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
en_kjv: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

tcz: Chuin Gad leh Reuben chate Mose ang sung’a ahung lut tauvin, hiti hin asei uve, hiche muna hin kelngoinou tampi ka nei uvin, hijeh chun kelngoi kul ka sempeh uva, chule ka cha ka naote hou dinga jong chenna in phabep ka sah peh diu ahi.
en_web: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
en_kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

tcz: Khat cheh in manchah kapat uva, Israel mite gal lamkaiya ka pan diu, amaho jouse chenna ding mun kamu kahse uva kigosa demma umjing ka hiuvin, ahinlah a gamsunga chengte ho jal a hi numei chapang ho kulpi kaikhum ma ven bit ding ka tiu ahi.
en_web: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
en_kjv: but we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

tcz: Chule Israel chaten khat cheh a chen mun anei kahse’a keiho inlam hung kile lou ding kahi tauve.
en_web: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
en_kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho toh Jordan vadung gal lamma khu gou kalo khom thei lou diu ahi. Solam gamkai Jordan lam hi keiho goulo ding a hung kisep doh ahitai.
en_web: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
en_kjv: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong amaho jouse henga aseijin, na bonchao va hitia hi na bolsoh kei diu, khat cheh manchah toh na kondoh uva, Pakai ansunga galsat dinga na kon doh sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
en_kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,

tcz: Gal manchah choi jouse Jordan vadung na galkai soh kei diu, chu teng Pakaiyin amasang lama amel mate asat gamhel kahsea Pakai angsunga gal na sat jing diu ahi.
en_web: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
en_kjv: and will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

tcz: Hiche gamsung chu Pakaija konna athua ki nunsah na ahung um doh teng leh na boncha uva Israel mite na chung uva kigahna ho Jousea konna na onthol diu, na hung kinung lekit uva chu teng hiche gamsung hi Pakai, Pathen jal'a nangho jouse chenna hiding ahi tai.
en_web: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
en_kjv: and the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.

tcz: Hi tabang’a hi nabol lou uva ahile, nangho jouse jong Pakai doumah a umna hidiu, hiche na chonset nau hin na hin holdoh teidiu ahi, tihi kichih theijun, ati.
en_web: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
en_kjv: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.

tcz: Na numei chapang ho ding in chen mun phabep sahpeh unlang, na kelngoi tehou kul jong sem peh uvin lang, amavang na kitepna’u aboncha na bolsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
en_kjv: Build ye cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

tcz: Chuin Gad leh Reuben chate hon Pakai henga hiti hin asei tauvin ahi. Nei thupeh bang bang uva na lhacha ten ka bol jing diu ahiye.
en_web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
en_kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

tcz: Ka chasen jouseu leh ka jite hou, kelngoite jouse abonchan Gilead khopi mun alha ngai diu ahi tai.
en_web: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
en_kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

tcz: Ka heng uva na thu lhah banga hi nalhacha te galman chah panna Pakai angsunga galsat ding in Jordan vadung galkai soh kei diu kahi, ati.
en_web: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”
en_kjv: but thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n aboncha’u chung thudol a Eleazer thempupa ahin Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel chate phung kailhah ama ama pa janglhah cheh henga thu ape tan ahi.
en_web: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

tcz: Mose’n amaho henga hiti chun thu aseijin, Gad chate ahin Reuben chate abonchauva galmanchah choiya Pakai angsunga galsat dinga Jordan vadung agalkai soh kei uva, agam jeng jong hi Pakai angsunga ama thua anun a ahile, Gilead gam mun hi Amaho chen mun ding’a na peh doh jeng diu ahi.
en_web: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
en_kjv: and Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hin gal manchah la kichoi ngal uva nangho jaona agal kaikhom tah lou uva ahile, amaho hin Canaan gamsung’a nangho jouse lah’a chenna mun anei lou diu ahi.
en_web: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
en_kjv: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Chuin Gad chate leh Reuben chaten ahenga hiti hin asei un, na lhacha ho josue henga Pakaiyin asei bang banga keihon jong ka suh-bukim soh kei diu ahi, tai.
en_web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
en_kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

tcz: Ka boncha uva galmanchah choija ka kipat doh diu Pakai angsunga konna Jordan ka galkai uva Canaan gamsung ka lut diu, ka chen mun ahin ka goulo diu ijakai Jordan vadung gal lamma ana umsa hita hen, atiuve.
en_web: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
en_kjv: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Joseph chapa Manasseh phung phabep chu Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam leh Og lenggam, agamgi chin dunga khopi josue hain chule agam sunga khopi jouse abonchan apedoh sohkei tan ahi.
en_web: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
en_kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

tcz: Gad chaten khopi atundoh hou chu Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
en_web: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
en_kjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

tcz: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
en_web: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
en_kjv: and Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

tcz: Beth-nimrah, Beth-haran khopi jouse chu kul akai khum soh keiyun, kelngoite um nading mun jong tampi asem doh peh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
en_kjv: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

tcz: Reuben chate jong chun Heshbon leh Elealeh khopi Kiria-thaim,
en_web: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
en_kjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

tcz: Nebo, Baalmeon hichengse hi atundoh tauvin, main jeng u-jong akhelsoh hel tauve, Sibmah jong anatungdoh uvin, amahon atundoh khopi josue abonchan amin akhelsoh keityun ahi.
en_web: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
en_kjv: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

tcz: Chuin Manasseh chapa Machir chate acheuvin Gilead agasat uvin ahile ahin jou tauve, agamsunga ana cheng Amor mite chu abonchaovin adel jam gamhel taovin ahi.
en_web: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
en_kjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

tcz: Mose’n jong Manasseh chapa Machir chu Gilead henga ape doh tan, khosunga chun acheng khom tauvin ahi.
en_web: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
en_kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

tcz: Manasseh chapa Jair chu a kipat doh kit tan a kimvel’a khoneo hochu abonchan agalo tan, hi chengse chu Jair ngahmun asah soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
en_kjv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

tcz: Hitichun Nobah jong akondoh paiyin Kenath khopi abonchan agalo kittan, hichengse chu amin Naboh aputsah tan ahi.
en_web: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
en_kjv: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

tcz: Egypt gamsunga konna ahin lhonpi Mose leh Aaron makaina kon ahung kitol uva kon in, a kholjin na’u chan chin bannei chan ahung um peh in ahi.
en_web: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
en_kjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai, Pathen thu peh bang bang chun Mose’n jong bannei chan anajih lut tan, ahung kipat doh na’u mun jouse banga bannei cha ahung kholjin na hou chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
en_kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

tcz: Lhamasa pen, nisom le ninga lhinni chun Israel chate Rameses khopi lam akon in ahung kitol tauvin, kalchuh kut kichai sun kim don tah in Egypt mite mitmu tah in ahung ki toldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
en_kjv: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

tcz: Hiti chun Egypt mite gamsung a kon’a chapa peng masa chan chun thina atoh tan, Pakaiyin thina atosah chan un Amahon jong akivui jing tauvin, ajeh chu Pakaiyin Egypt mite lah a milimdoi kisem thua umho chung’a jong thutanna alhunsah a hitia hi alhun den jeng u ahi tai.
en_web: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.
en_kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

tcz: Israel chate chu Rameses khopi akon in ahung kitol pan tauvin, Succoth muna ngahmun a kisem un a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

tcz: Succoth muna kon chun akitol kit uvin, gammang lah a Etham kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
en_kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

tcz: Etham muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Baal-zephon solam gamkaija um Pihahiroth lama akile tol kit un, Migdol maija chun ngahmun a kisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
en_kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

tcz: Hahiroth akon chun akitol kit tauvin tuikhanglen lai lung chu apal galkai uvin Etham gam thip noiya chun ni thum sung in akitol tol tauvin, Marah kiti laiya chun ngahmun a kisem uvin hiche muna chun a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
en_kjv: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

tcz: Marah akon chun akitol kit tauvin Elim mun apha tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tuinah som-le-ni ana um'in, tom phung jong somsagi akeh in, hikomma chun ngah mun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
en_kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

tcz: Elim akon in akitol kit tauvin Tuikhanglen sen pang’a chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kichol do tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
en_kjv: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

tcz: Tuikhanglen sen pang a kon chun a kitol kit tauvin, Sin gammang lah a chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
en_kjv: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

tcz: Sin gammang lah akon chun akitol kit tauvin, Dophkah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
en_kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

tcz: Dophkah muna kon chun a kitol doh kit uvin, Alush kiti muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
en_kjv: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

tcz: Alush muna kon in akitoldoh kit tauvin, Rephidim muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tui don ding ana um tapon ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
en_kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

tcz: Rephidim muna kon chun a kitol kit tauvin Sinai gamthip laiya ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
en_kjv: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Sinai gamthip laiya kon chun akitol kit tauvin Kibroth-hattaavah muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin aki choldo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
en_kjv: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

tcz: Kibroth-hattaavah akon akitol kit tauvin Hezeroth muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
en_kjv: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

tcz: Hazeroth muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Rithmah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
en_kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

tcz: Rithmah akon in akitol kit tauvin Rimmonperez muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
en_kjv: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

tcz: Rimmon-perez akon in akitol kit tauvin Libnah muna ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
en_kjv: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

tcz: Libnah akon chun a kipatdoh uvin Rissah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
en_kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

tcz: Rissah akon a kitol kit uvin Kehelathah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin akicholdo kittauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
en_kjv: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

tcz: Kehelathah akon in akitol kit tauvin Shepher molsang achun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
en_kjv: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

tcz: Shepher molsang akon akitol kittaovin Haradah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
en_kjv: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

tcz: Haradah akon akitol kittaovin Makheloth muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
en_kjv: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

tcz: Makheloth akon in akitol kit tauvin Tahath muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kittaovin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
en_kjv: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

tcz: Tahath akon akitol kittaovin Terah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
en_kjv: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

tcz: Terah akon in akitol kit uvin Mithkah achun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
en_kjv: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

tcz: Mithcah akon in a kitol kit uvin Hashmonah muna ngah mun a kisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
en_kjv: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

tcz: Hashmonah akon a kitol kit uvin, Moseroth kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
en_kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

tcz: Moseroth akon in akitol kit uvin Benejaakan kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
en_kjv: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

tcz: Bene-jaakan kitilaija kon chun akitol kit tauvin, Hor-haggidgad muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
en_kjv: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

tcz: Hor-haggidgad mun laiya kon in akitol kit tauvin Jotbathah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
en_kjv: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

tcz: Jotbathah akon in aki tol kit uvin Abronah kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
en_kjv: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

tcz: Abronah akon in akitol kit uvin Ezion-geber muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
en_kjv: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.

tcz: Ezion-geber kiti laiya kon chun a kitol kit uvin, Kadesh muna chun naghmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahin.
en_web: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
en_kjv: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

tcz: Kadesh akon chun akitol kit uvin Edom gami Hor mol chunga chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en_web: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
