en_web: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
en_kjv: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

tcz: (Sidon mite chun Hermon molsang chu Sirion tin akou un chule Amor miten Senir tin akou uve.)
en_web: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
en_kjv: (which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

tcz: Tun eihon Gilead le Bashan gamkai pumpi ijousoh tauvin, Og lengpa gamvai pohna Salecah le Edrei changeiyin ijousoh hel tauvin ahi.
en_web: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
en_kjv: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

tcz: (Bashan lengpa Og chu Rephaim mite dinga leng nukhah pen ahitan. Alupna chu thih a kisem ahin, chule asan dan adung feet som le thum, availam letdan feet gup alhing in ahi. Hiche lengpa lim hi Ammon mite khopi Rabbah muna aum nalayin ahi.)
en_web: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
en_kjv: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

tcz: Hiche gam pumpi chu ilo tauvin ahileh, keiman Reuben le Gad insung ading in Aroer apat Arnon Gorge changei in chule Gilead gam kehkhat le khopi phabep jaonan kapedoh tan ahi.
en_web: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
en_kjv: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

tcz: Manasseh chilhahte ding in, Gilead gam kehkhat le Bashan gam pumpi Og lengpa lalna gam chu ka pedoh tan ahi. (Hiche hi Bashan gam Argob gamkai pumpi hi Rephaim tia kihe ahi).
en_web: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
en_kjv: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

tcz: Manasseh insunga lamkai amin Jair, ama hin Bashan, Argob gamkai pumpi ajousoh hel in, Geshur mite le Maacah mite gamgi changei ahi. Jair chun hiche gam chu ama min aputsah in, Jair khopi asah tan, tuni chan in Jair tin akihe jing na laiyin ahi.
en_web: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
en_kjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

tcz: Keiman Gilead chu Makir insung kapedoh tai.
en_web: I gave Gilead to Machir.
en_kjv: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

tcz: Chule keiman Reuben le Gad insunga ding in Gilead gam phabep jong kapen ahi. Arnon Gorge lhanglam lailung apat Ammon mite chenna Jabbok vadung chan ahi.
en_web: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
en_kjv: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon, half the valley, and the border, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

tcz: Jordan phaicham Galilee dillen lhanglam San dung, apat Jordan vadung gamgi changei ahi. Hichu solam Pisgah toh kimat ahitai.
en_web: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
en_kjv: the plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

tcz: Hiche phatlai chun keiman ama insung cheh, lhumlam Jordan a cheng ding in thupeh ka neiyin ahi: Hiche gam pumpi hi Pakai, Pathen in nangho napehsau hijongleh, na gal-miteuvin na sopite ho chenna Jordan gam aho pauva galkai diu ahi.
en_web: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

tcz: Chule najiteu, nachateu chule na gancha jouseo jaona keiman kapeh khopi hoa cheng diu ahi.
en_web: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
en_kjv: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

tcz: Pakaiyin Israel mite dinga kivenbitna gam napedoh tauvin, chuin amahon Jordan vadung changeiyin aching uvin, chuin nangho nabon chauvin Pakaiyin na pehnau gam achun nacheng khom tauvin ahi.
en_web: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
en_kjv: until the Lord have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

tcz: Hichun keiman Joshua henga thupeh hicheng hi kaneiyin: Nanghon hiche leng teni chunga Pakai natoh abonchan namusoh tauvin. Pakaiyin lhumlam gamkai Jordan chengsea angaiya bang banga na atoh ding ahi.
en_web: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
en_kjv: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche nam mite khu kicha hih in, Pakaiyin nangma dinga gal asat ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”
en_kjv: Ye shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.

tcz: Chuin keima Pakai henga katao vin hiti hin kaseiye.
en_web: I begged GOD at that time, saying,
en_kjv: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,

tcz: O Thanei chungnung Pakai, nangman keima nasohpa henga naban thahat naki lahsah in ka musoh tai. Koiham pathen dang van leh leiset a hitobang thil kidang bol thei ding?
en_web: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
en_kjv: O Lord God, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

tcz: Nalung ahileh, Jordan hi nei galkai sah in lang, gamhoi tah Lebanon molsang ho nei musah tan, ati.
en_web: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
en_kjv: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

tcz: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan, ka taona angaisah tapoi. Chuin aman aseiyin, aphatai! Imadang seibe datan, ati.
en_web: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
en_kjv: But the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

tcz: Pisgah molchunga kaltouvin lang, gam jouse gavetan, amavang Jordan vadung na galkai lou ding ahi.
en_web: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
en_kjv: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

tcz: Nangma khel in, Joshua thaneina pen lang hilchah jotan, ajeh chu Joshua in mipi aboncha Jordan chan agalkai pia, alam kai ding ahi. Masanga namu gam jouse aboncha aman mipi apeh ding ahi.
en_web: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
en_kjv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

tcz: Chuin Beth-peor kiti muna chun kaum tauvin ahi.
en_web: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
en_kjv: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

tcz: Tun, Israel miten danthu kahil jouseu phatah in ngaiyun, Pakai, Pathen in napu, napateu khanga pat napehnau gam nalhun thei nadiu le agama nachen thei nadiu ahi.
en_web: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.
en_kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers giveth you.

tcz: Kathupeh a kon in ngaisah louna ima neihih hel uvin. Pakai, Pathen akona ka thupeh chengse hi phatah a najui diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
en_kjv: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.

tcz: Baapeor muna Pakaiyin nangho dinga ichangeiya na atoh namusoh keiyun ahi. Hiche muna chun Pakai, Pathen in Baal doi hou jouse abonchan asugam sohkeiye.
en_web: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
en_kjv: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen tahsan a thua nung jouse, tuni chan in nabon chauvin nadam nalaiyun ahi.
en_web: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.
en_kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.

tcz: Vetan, Pakai, Pathen akona juiding dan hichengse hi nangho dinga thupeh ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi gamsung nalut teng uleh phatah a najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
en_kjv: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

tcz: Hichengse hi najui uva ahileh, na kimvel uva cheng nam dangte sanga athem leh achinga naum diu ahi. Hitobang nunle khan ahin jahdoh teng uleh, hiche nam mite hi datmah umtah in aching lheh uve tia asei diu ahi!
en_web: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
en_kjv: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen ikom cha uva aum jing banga, eiho Pathen tobang nam dang ten anei khah ngai em?
en_web: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?
en_kjv: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

tcz: Hitobanga chu keiman jong na masang uva ka koipeh danthu hijatpi hi, kicheh tah’a ka koipeh banguva koi dang nam in hitobang anei khah ngai em?
en_web: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
en_kjv: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh vetan! Nanghon namit tah uva namu chan uchu nahaimil lou diu ahi. Hiche hi na damsung uva nalung thim uva kona na jamdoh sah lou diu ahi! Natu na chate changeiya achin jing diu ahi.
en_web: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
en_kjv: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

tcz: Chule Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mol chunga adin nikhoa ka henga thu asei chu na haimil lou diu ahi. Mipi ho abonchan ka henga hinpuiyin, keiman ijakai kahil diu ahi. Chutileh amahon keima gin ding dan ahet uva, atu acha khang gei uva jong keima eigin jing diu ahi.
en_web: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
en_kjv: specially the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

tcz: Nangma mol chunga na keng in nahung ding in, Molchung vum jouse meibol in atom in chuin mu athim lhatan ahi.
en_web: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
en_kjv: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burnt with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin nangma henga thu aseiyin, meikong in akilah in, Ama awgin chu najan ahinlah tahmel in namupoi; ajeh chu awgin bou najah ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

tcz: Pakaiyin kitepna asem in, Thupeh som nanit jing diuvin thupeh aneiyin, songpheng ni chunga ajihdoh in ahi.
en_web: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
en_kjv: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

tcz: Hiche muna chun Pakaiyin thupeh aneiyin, nangho gamsung nalut kon teng uleh danthu najui diuvin abonchan eihil in ahi.
en_web: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
en_kjv: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho ching theiyun! Sinai mol chunga Pakaiyin najah uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon tahmel in namu pouve.
en_web: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
en_kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

tcz: Hijeh chun nanghon milim doi numei leh pasal lima semthu a-angsunga na bokhup uva na kisuhboh louhel diu,
en_web: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
en_kjv: lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

tcz: tol-lhang lah a ganhing hihen, twipi noiya um ganhing limsem thu kitiphot angsunga na bohkhup lou diu ahi.
en_web: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
en_kjv: the likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

tcz: Chunglang vea lha, ahsite chule vanthamjola thil ho jong bohkhup a akin bol ding na ngaito louhel diu ahi. Hichengse khu aboncha Pakai, Pathen in leiset a cheng mihemte apeh ahi.
en_web: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
en_kjv: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho hi Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gamsung meilhum lah’a kiloidoh a Pathen dei tum mong mong dinga tunia hi nasemu ahin, hichu nasuhmil lou diu ahi.
en_web: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
en_kjv: But the Lord hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

tcz: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan. Pakaiyin kitepna asem in keima Jordan vadung galkaiya, keima hiche gamsunga khu kalut thei lou ding ahitai.
en_web: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;
en_kjv: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

tcz: Keima khela hiche gamsung lodinga Jordan vadung nagal kai diu ahi. Keima vang hiche solam vadung pama hi thiden ding kahi tai.
en_web: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
en_kjv: but I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

tcz: Hijeh chun chingthei un Pakai, Pathen in kitepna napeh hou aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi. Pathen doumah milim doi sem ding gohih un, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga doumah umtah ahi.
en_web: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
en_kjv: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the Lord thy God hath forbidden thee.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen hi meikong a kilahji ahin; thangtomna aneiji ahi.
en_web: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
en_kjv: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, tu le cha nahin neiyuva gam sunga na hung chen teng uleh, milim doi kiti sema a-angsunga na bohkhup louhel diu ahi. Hitobang thil hi Pakai dinga thet umtah leh Pakai lunghan na ahi.
en_web: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
en_kjv: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:

tcz: Tuna van leh leiset kasan hi nangho hettohsahna ding ahi. Ka kitepna na suhkeh uva ahileh, Jordan vadung galkaiya gamsunga na hetman lou uva na manthah jeng diu ahi. Hinkho chomcha bou nanei diu; hetman louva thinan na lhunden diu ahi.
en_web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
en_kjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto you go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

tcz: Ajeh chu nam dangte lah a Pakaiyin nathe cheh diu, lhom cha bouvin gamsung nalo diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.

tcz: Hiche muna chu, gamdang mite lah a milim doi song le thinga kisem thu, ima jathei lou, muthei lou ho kin nabol diu ahi.
en_web: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
en_kjv: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen nahin hol kit diu, nalung thim pumpiuva nahin hol teng uleh namu bep diu ahi.
en_web: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
en_kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, hitobang din muna naum uva gim genthei nan nalhun den teng uleh, Pakai, Pathen angsung nahin bel diu, Pakai thusei jouse nangai diu ahi.
en_web: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.
en_kjv: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

tcz: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, Pathen uhi ngailutna a dim jeng ahin; na lung na heija Pakai lam nahin bel teng aman na damsah ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh, napu napateu khang apat akitepna ageldoh jing in ahi.
en_web: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
en_kjv: (for the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

tcz: Tun leiset ahung kisem apat tuchana Pathen in ichangeiya mihemte akhohsah ham, ti thusimle vanthamjola ijakai jouse kholdoh uvin. Hitobang thil ki dang hohi najah a namu khah uvem?
en_web: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
en_kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

tcz: Nanghon meikonga Pathen akilah a, awgin najah bang uva nam dang ten hitobang thil kidang atokhah tah uvem?
en_web: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
en_kjv: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

tcz: Pathen dang in nampi khat gim hesoh na a kon apui doh a, thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah gal asat peh, ban thahat pana kithopina, ki dang tah a na-atohna um kha tam? Ahinlah nangho Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gam naum lai uva anatoh ijakai na musoh kei tauvin ahi.
en_web: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
en_kjv: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

tcz: Pakaiyin ijakai na muchen sah tauve, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen tobang dang umlou ahi.
en_web: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.
en_kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else besides him.

tcz: Pakaiyin vana kon in awgin na jahsah uvin, thupeh ijakai aneiyin ahi. Pakai meikonga akilah in nang ho nahou piu vin ahi.
en_web: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
en_kjv: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napu napateu angailun chule a chilhahte changei phatthei aboh ahi. Pakaiyin abanthahat apan in, Egypt gam'a kona nahin pui galkaiyu ahitai.
en_web: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
en_kjv: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

tcz: Nangho ding in namdangte gamlha tah in achon doh in, Pakaiyin nangho chenna ding gamnom tah na peuvin, tunin na cheng tauvin ahi.
en_web: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
en_kjv: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

tcz: Hijeh achu hiche hi na geldoh jing diu leh na lungthim uva na chin jing diu ahi: Pakai, Pathen hi vana jong leiset a jong Pathen ahin, Pathen dang ama tobang aumpoi.
en_web: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
en_kjv: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha na juikim soh keiyuva ahileh, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding nachateu changeiya phatthei chang diu ahi. Imatih chana gam sunga kipah leh lungmonga nachen diu, na hinkhou asotna dinga Keiman thupeh hichengse aboncha kapeh nahiuve.
en_web: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.
en_kjv: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, for ever.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n khopi thum solam Jordan vadunga kichol nading in atung doh in ahi.
en_web: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
en_kjv: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

tcz: Koi tobang'in mihem khat alam louva atha a, suhna ding beiya auma ahileh, ama chu hiche muna hi jamlut ding ahinkho aki huhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
en_kjv: that the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

tcz: Khopi thum hochu: Bezer kiti gamthip lah a hichu Reuben in sunga ding; Ramoth kiti Gilead muna hichu Gad in sunga ding; Golan kiti Bashan muna hichu Manasseh insunga ding ahi.
en_web: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
en_kjv: namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

tcz: Thupeh hichengse hi Mose’n Israel mite henga aseipeh ahi.
en_web: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

tcz: Hichengse hi danthu jui ding’a Mose’n Israel miten Egypt gam adalhah uva apeh,
en_web: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
en_kjv: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

tcz: Beth-peor toh kinai solam Jordan vadung phaicham ngahmun aum laiyuva apeh ahi. Phat masa chun hiche gam hi Amor mite lengpa Sihon in Hesbon muna kona ana vaipoh ahi. Hinlah Egypt gam'a kona Mose leh Israel mite ahung doh uchun ana sugam hel tauvin ahi.
en_web: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
en_kjv: on this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

tcz: Chuin Israel miten Bashan lengpa Og lalna gam leh anei agou jouse achom chai keiyuvin, solama Amor mite leng teni jaona ahi.
en_web: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
en_kjv: and they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

tcz: Israel miten Aroer apat Arnon Gorge chule Sirion mol Hermon tiajong kihe changeiyin ajousoh hel tauve.
en_web: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Zion (also called Hermon),
en_kjv: from Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

tcz: Chuin amahon solam gamkai Jordan vadung pang leh, lhanglam San dung changeiyin ajousoh uvin, Pisgah noilam changei ahi.
en_web: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
en_kjv: and all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

tcz: Mose’n Israel mite akoukhom in aheng uva aseipeh tan ahi, Israel miten phatah in ngaiyun. Tunin Dan thupeh chengse hi jasoh keiyun, kihilnan neiyun lang najui kimsoh kei diu ahi!
en_web: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
en_kjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mola kitepna eisem peh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
en_kjv: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipu-ipateu toh asem ahipon, amavang tunikhoa eiho jouse dinga asem ahi.
en_web: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
en_kjv: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

tcz: Pakai mol chunga meikong in akilah in nangho kimaiton nakihou limpiuvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
en_kjv: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

tcz: Nangho leh Pakai kimlaiya keima ka ding in ahi, ajeh chu nanghon meikong nakicha uvin molchung na nailut ngam tapouve. Pakaiyin ka henga thu aseiyin, athusei doh aboncha nangho kapeh son ahi. Pakai thuseidoh chu hiche hi ahi:
en_web: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
en_kjv: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

tcz: Keima na Pakai leh na Pathen kahi, Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva na huhdoh pau chu kahi.
en_web: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
en_kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

tcz: Kei tailou Pathen dang nanei loudiu ahi.
en_web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
en_kjv: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

tcz: Milim semthu kiti nanei thei lou diu, van le leiset chule twikhanglen sunga hijongleh pathen lim semthu nanei thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

tcz: Hitobang lim semthu ho ang sunga chu naboh khup uva, akin nabol louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima na Pakaiyu leh na Pathen u-kahin, pathen dang semthua kona thang-tomji ka hin, hiche chonset nachu nacha teu khang geiya pap kalhunsah ding; keima ei pam pai insung pumpi chunga, khangthum leh li chan geiya lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
en_kjv: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

tcz: Hinlah ka thupeh nit a keima eingailu jing ho chunga, akhang akhanga ngailutna kalhunsah ding ahi.
en_web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
en_kjv: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen min nasuhboh louhel diu ahi. Koihileh Pakai min suboh chan chu ngaidam chang lou ding ahi.
en_web: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh banga, Sabbath nikho theng chu nanit jing diu ahi.
en_web: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
en_kjv: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.

tcz: Natohna ding nigup naneiyun ahi,
en_web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
en_kjv: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

tcz: hinlah nisagi lhinni Sabbath nikho hi Pakai, Pathen dinga nikho theng ki katdoh ahi. Hiche nikhoa hi koi machan insung natoh abol theilou ding, hiche hi nangho nahiuvin, nachapateu le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho le nasoh numei hou, bongchal holeh, sa-ngan ho chule nagancha jouse jaona, chule gamdangmi nalah uva hung cheng ho jaona hi ding ahi.
en_web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
en_kjv: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

tcz: Hiche hi nasuhmil lou diu ahi, khatvei chu Egypt gam sunga soh a um nahiuvin, hinlah Pakai, Pathen in abanthahat pana nahin puidoh'u ahi. Hiche jeh achu Pakai, Pathen in Sabbath nikhoa ki chol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
en_web: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
en_kjv: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in nanu, napa jabol un. Chutileh nahinkhou sot ding Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga lung monga nachen diu ahi.
en_web: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
en_kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

tcz: Toltha nabol lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not murder.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not kill.

tcz: Jon thanhoi nabol lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not commit adultery.
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

tcz: Gu chat nabol lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not steal.
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou steal.

tcz: Na sopi nalhep chatvai lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

tcz: Na sopi jitoh nalupkhom lou diu ahi. Chule nasopi gam jong nachu lou diu, asoh numei hihen pasal hijongleh, abongchal hihen, asangante hijongleh nasopi nei le gou, ijakai lepthola nalah thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

tcz: Hichengse hi molchunga nakal laiyuva Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahitai. Pakai chu meikong in akilah in aw-sang tah in asam in, chuin meibol le muthim in atomlha jeng in ahi. Hiche laimuna chu aboncha aseiya chule hichengse chu aboncha song pheng nia ajihlut a keima eipeh ahi.
en_web: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
en_kjv: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

tcz: Nanghon awgin le mu-athime ti najauvin chule molchung pumpi athimlha jeng tan ahileh, na insung cheh uva koin lamkaiho le upa ho ka henga ahung uvin ahi.
en_web: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

tcz: Amahon hiti hin aseiyuve, vetan! IPakaiyu le i-Pathen uvin aloupina ki dangtah in eimusah uvin aw-sangtah meikonga kilah chu kaja uvin, tunin kamu tauve. Ajeh chu Pathen in mihemte henga thu aseiyin, hinlah ima kati deh pouvin ahi.
en_web: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
en_kjv: and ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

tcz: Tunvang ipi dinga thi ikichat kit diu ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in iheng uva thu asei kit a ahileh, thinan ilhun den uva meikonga iki govam jeng theiyu ahi.
en_web: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
en_kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.

tcz: Haina hu neiya hing itobang hijongleh, eiho banga hing jing Pathen awgin ja'a thi louva hing thei aum dem?
en_web: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
en_kjv: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

tcz: Tun nangho cheuvin lang Pakai, Pathen in ipi asei em gangai tauvin. Chule hung kile kit unlang Pakaiyin ipi asei em ti kaheng uva hung seiyun, chuteng keihon kangai uva kajui diu ahi.
en_web: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
en_kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

tcz: Keima henga nangeh chan’u Pakaiyin ajasoh tan ahi. Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, mipihon nangma henga ipi asei uvem ti keiman ka hesoh keiyin, chule amahon thudih aseiyu ahi.
en_web: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
en_kjv: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

tcz: Oh, hitia hi amahon lung ngaichatna anei jing diu chule hiche bang achu amahon keima eigin jing diu, ka thupeh jong anit jing diu ahi! Hitia chu achon jing uva ahileh, amaho leh achilhah teu chan geiya phatthei chang diu ahi.
en_web: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
en_kjv: O that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

tcz: Nangma chen lang aheng uva gasei tan, “Na ponbuh cheh uva kile tauvin.”
en_web: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
en_kjv: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

tcz: Hinlah nangma hiche muna hin ding den nalaiyin chonna dan thupeh aboncha kasei peh ding nahi. Chule hichengse hi aboncha mipiho henga naseipeh ding chutileh amahon achen nau gamsunga chu ajui jing diu ahi.
en_web: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
en_kjv: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n mipiho henga aseiyin, nang hon chingthei tah in Pakai, Pathen thupeh aboncha jui ding go uvin.
en_web: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
en_kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nathupeh nau lampi chu jui jing uvin. Chutileh nalhun nadiu gamsunga hinkho sot tah nachen thei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
en_kjv: You shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho seipeh dinga danthu eipeh hichengse hi ahi. Hiche gamsung nalut teng uleh, najui kimsoh kei diu ahi,
en_web: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;
en_kjv: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

tcz: chutileh nadam sunguva natu nachateu khang geiya keima eigin jing diu ahi. Pakai thupeh aboncha nanit soh keiyuva ahileh, lungmonga naum diu chule nahinkhou jong sot ding ahi.
en_web: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
en_kjv: that thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

tcz: Phatah in ngaiyun, Israel, ajeh chu hichengse hi najui kimsel diu ahi. Chutileh ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding, napu napateu khanga pat Pakai, Pathen kitepna banga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam'a chu nachen diu ahi.
en_web: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
en_kjv: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

tcz: O Israel ngaiyun! Pakai hi i-Pathen’u ahi, chule Pakai ama bou ahi.
en_web: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.
en_kjv: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord:

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai le na Pathen'u nalung thim pumpiu le natha neisun in ngailu uvin.
en_web: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
en_kjv: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha chunga kipehna naneiyuva najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
en_kjv: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

tcz: Hichengse hi nachateu henga avel vel'a naseipeh diu ahi. In muna naumpet'u hihen, lam najot pet'u hihen, nalup konu hihen, nakithodoh pet'u hijongleh, aheng uva naseipeh jing diu ahi.
en_web: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
en_kjv: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

tcz: Hichengse chu na khut’uva kikhi jing unlang chule nachalpang uva jong nakhi chah jing diu, hitia chu na suhmil lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
en_kjv: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

tcz: Na in kot phung uva jong jih unlang chule kelkot mai ajong najih sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
en_kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

tcz: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, na Pathen uvin napu na pateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga akitepna gam sunga napuilut vah diu ahitai. Hiche khopi hoa hi ijakai bukimsel, hichu nang hon man beiya namu diu ahi.
en_web: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
en_kjv: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

tcz: Insung hoa chu neileh gou ijakai aki lamsa hi ding ahi. Twikul ho jong aki laisa ahin, Olive thing phung le adanghoa kona jong aga naneh diu, hicheho jouse hi nanghon tu lou hela aga nalo diu ahi. Hiche hohi naneh teng uleh gamsung pumpi nalodim diu ahitai.
en_web: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
en_kjv: and houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

tcz: Chuleh chingthei un Pakai, na Pathen'u nasuh mil lou diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin na huhdoh’u ahi.
en_web: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
en_kjv: then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u nagin diu chule Pakai kin jenga na kisah lel diu ahi. Ki hahselna nanei ujongleh Pakai min pana naki hahsel diu ahi.
en_web: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
en_kjv: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

tcz: Na kimvel uva nam dangte pathen semthu angsunga naboh khup lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
en_kjv: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen hi thangtom thei ahi. Pakai lunghanna chun leiset chunga kona natol mang jeng theiyu ahi.
en_web: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
en_kjv: (for the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

tcz: Nanghon Massah muna Pakai, Pathen napatep banguva avela napatep kitlou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
en_kjv: Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh phatah a nanit jing diu, Dan jouse najui kim sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
en_kjv: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

tcz: Pathen mitmua apha jeng bol ding go uvin, chutileh ijakai pha chamkim soh kei ding ahi. Chuteng Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga pat’a kitepna gam sunga nachen diu ahi.
en_web: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
en_kjv: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers,

tcz: Pakaiyin asei bang in, hiche gam sunga nagal miteu aboncha Pakaiyin asuhmang hel ding ahi.
en_web: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.
en_kjv: to cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the Lord hath spoken.

tcz: Khonung le nachateu vin hitia hi ahin sei diu, hiche dan le thupeh jui ding hohi ipi jeh a Pakai, Pathen in napeh ham? tia nahin doh diu ahi.
en_web: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”
en_kjv: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God hath commanded you?

tcz: Chuteng nanghon hitia hi na donbut diu, keiho Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh angsunga soh a kana um laiyuva Pakai, Pathen in abanthahat a eihin huh doh'u ahi.
en_web: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
en_kjv: then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh le amite henga thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah in, ipu ipateu khanga pat akitepna gamsunga cheng dia eihin puiyu ahi.
en_web: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
en_kjv: and the Lord shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga kona eihin puigal kaiyu ahin, ajeh chu eihon hiche gam ilo thei nadiu ahi.
en_web: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
en_kjv: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

tcz: Hijeh achu Pakai, Pathen in hiche dan thupeh jui ding jouse hi eipeh uva, hichengse ijui kimsoh kei uva ahileh ihinkhou sot ding chule imatih chana phatthei ichan diu ahi. Hichu tuni chan geiya idamnau ahi.
en_web: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
en_kjv: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen akona dan le thupeh aboncha ijui uva ahileh Pakaiyin eiho jouse them changa eisim diu ahi.
en_web: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”
en_kjv: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin gam sunga nahin puilut teng uleh, nam dang tampi umho khu asuhmang ding ahi: Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite ahi. Hiche nam sagi hohi nang ho sanga hatjo le pungjo ahiuve.
en_web: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
en_kjv: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

tcz: Pakaiyin akhut akona nang ho nahin pehdoh tenguleh, nang hon abonchauva nasuh gamsoh keidiu ahi. Amaho toh ki chamna ima semlouva abonchauva natha gam diu ahi.
en_web: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
en_kjv: and when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

tcz: Chule amaho toh chun na kichen thei lou diu ahi. Na chanuteu le nachapate hou chu amaho chanute le chapate toh nakichen sah louhel diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
en_kjv: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama hon na chateu apui mang diu, semthu pathen angsunga abohkhup sah diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai lunghanna nachung uva hung chu jeng ding, chomlou kah a na manthah lo diu ahi.
en_web: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
en_kjv: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

tcz: Hitia hi nabol teidiu ahi, amaicham phung hou le akhom ho aboncha naphuh lhuh peh diu ahi. Chule Asherah ho jong naphuh lhuh diu aboncha meiya nahal vam diu ahi.
en_web: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
en_kjv: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho Pakai, Pathen in vannoi mite lah atumbeh a na lhen’u ahin, chule nangho amagou nahi tauvin, Pakai dinga mithengte nahi tauve.
en_web: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
en_kjv: For thou art a holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

tcz: Pakaiyin namdang te banga thalhing le hatjo nahijeh uva nalhen tumu hilouvin, amavang nam neopen nahijeh uva nalhen joh’u ahi!
en_web: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
en_kjv: The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were moe in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akitepna ageldoh jing in, nachung uva ngailutna anei jing in ahi. Hijeh achu Pakaiyin athahat pana Egypt gam Pharaoh akon suhgimna nachan nauva kona nahuh doh’u ahi.
en_web: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
en_kjv: but because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

tcz: Hijeh chun hethem un Pakai, Pathen hi nang ho Pathen dihtah mong ahi. Pakai ngailua athupeh nit jing mite chunga, akhang akhanga akitepna akoi jing in ngailutna jong anei jing in ahi.
en_web: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
en_kjv: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

tcz: Hinlah Pakai nasah louva umho chunga gim genthei alhunsah in asumang jin ahi.
en_web: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
en_kjv: and repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

tcz: Hijeh chun tunia thupeh kapeh chengse hi aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
en_kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

tcz: Dan le thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathen in na chung uva alungsetna longlou chu akoi jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu napateu khanga pet akitepna ahi.
en_web: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
en_kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the Lord thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

tcz: Pakaiyin phatthei naleh Ami ngailutna chun naumpi jing diu chule cha jong tampi nahin diu ahi. Pakaiyin gampha tah gaphaso nading leh naganchateu kivahna ding napeh diu, napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam nalhun tenguleh louga phatah nachom khom diu, lengpi thah leh Olive thao chule bonghon tampi leh kelngoi hon tampi jaona nanei diu ahi.
en_web: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
en_kjv: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

tcz: Chutengleh Vannoiya nam dangte jouse sanga phatthei nachan diu ahi. Numei, pasal hihen nagancha teu hijongleh cha nei louva khatcha naum lou diu ahi.
en_web: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
en_kjv: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

tcz: Chule dammo veisetna akona Pakaiyin navenbit jing diu ahi. Egypt gam'a gim genthei nathoh bang uva nathoh sah lou diu, na doumah jouseu aboncha asuh mang ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
en_kjv: And the Lord will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nam dangte nakhut a apehdoh chengse aboncha nasuh gam diu ahi. Ngailutna beiya nabol diu chule amaho pathen angsunga nabohkhup lou heldiu ahi.
en_web: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
en_kjv: And thou shalt consume all the people which the Lord thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

tcz: Amavang nanghon hitia hi nasei diu, hiche nam mite hi eiho sang in ahat jouvin, iti iki doupi thei diu ham?
en_web: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
en_kjv: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are moe than I; how can I dispossess them?

tcz: Hinlah nakichat thei lou diu ahi! Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga ichan geiya na atoh ham ti nageldoh diu ahi.
en_web: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
en_kjv: thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the Lord thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin amaho chunga tijat umtah’a na atoh geldoh jing un, hichu nangho mitmu tah a thilsoh ahi! Chule thil ki dang ijakai akilahsah ho geldoh jing uvin, abanthahat pana anatoh thil kidang hoa kona Egypt gam'a pet nahin puiyu chu na suhmil lou diu ahi. Hiche banga chu Pakai, Pathen in tua nagal miteu chunga na atoh ding ahi.
en_web: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
en_kjv: the great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the Lord thy God brought thee out: so shall the Lord thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin tijatna phabep namasang lam uva ahin koi ding, chuteng ijakai atol mang soh ding ahi.
en_web: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
en_kjv: Moreover the Lord thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

tcz: Hiche nam mite chunga chu kichatna nanei louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na umpi jing uve, Pathen thilbol thei kidang ahi.
en_web: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the Lord thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin hiche nam mite hohi aloi loiya asuh mang ding ahi. Khatvei pansa nasuhmang jeng thei lou diu ahi. Achuti louva ahile gamsate hung dimlha jeng ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
en_kjv: And the Lord thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin abonchauva nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi. Amaho abei kahseuva Pakaiyin asuhnoh phah diu ahi.
en_web: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
en_kjv: But the Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

tcz: Pakaiyin alengte hou nangho khut a apehdoh ding, chuteng nanghon leiset a amin hou nasuh mang diu ahi.
en_web: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.
en_kjv: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

tcz: Chule amilim doi semthu hou aboncha nahalvam peh diu, milim doi tomna ki mang sum-eng hijongleh khat jeng cha na kilah thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
en_kjv: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

tcz: Na insung'u suboh thei ima nanei thei lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho kibolna banga nangho jong thina nachan diu ahi. Hitobang thil hoa kona gamna kipan ding chule na kidalse jing diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse hi chingthei tah in jui bukim soh keiyuvin. Chutileh nahinkhou sot intin, Pakaiyin napu napate khanga pat peh dinga akitepna gam nalo thei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
en_kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin kum somli gamthip lah akona nahin puidohna geldoh jing un, ajeh chu Pakai thupeh ijakai nanit kimsoh nadiuva nangho patepna ahi.
en_web: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
en_kjv: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

tcz: Henge, Pakaiyin gilkiela naum laipet tah uvin mana napiuvin ahi. Hiche tobang an-hi napu, napateu khanga jong um khalou ahi. Ajeh chu mihemte hi changlhah jengseh a hing jou ahipoi ti, Pakaiyin nahetsah nau ahin; amavang Pakai kam sunga kona hung potdoh thu changa bou hinga nahiuve.
en_web: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.
en_kjv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.

tcz: Kum somli sung in von-ah ding jong nangaicha pouvin chule nakeng ujong imacha atipon ahi.
en_web: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
en_kjv: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

tcz: Hichu geltem uvin: Minu mipan acha ahilna banga, Pakaiyin nang ho phatchomna dinga bou nakhoukhah nau ahi.
en_web: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
en_kjv: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse abonchan nit kimsoh keiyun lang, Pakai ging jinga hinkho naman diu ahi.
en_web: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
en_kjv: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na gamu phatah twi nenna muna nahin puiyuva, hichu phaicham leh thing lhang gam aboncha ahi.
en_web: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
en_kjv: For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of the valleys and hills;

tcz: Hiche gam pumpi hi mimchang le kolbu lei jeng ahin; theiba phung, kolbu thei phung, Olive phung leh khoiju lonna gam ahi.
en_web: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
en_kjv: a land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

tcz: Hiche gamsung hi Pakaiyin ijakai kimsela twi achap nou ahin, chule agam sunga thih jong song banga kimang ahin, thinglhang gam song mantam jeng uma ahi.
en_web: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
en_kjv: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

tcz: Agamsungga naneh teng uleh Pakai, na Pathen'u thangvahna napeh jing diu ahi.
en_web: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
en_kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

tcz: Hinlah chingthei tah in um uvin! Ajeh chu hiche gampha laitah jeh a chu tunikhoa Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh nasuh millou diu ahi.
en_web: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
en_kjv: Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

tcz: Nanghon innom nahin kisah doh diu chule haosatah a nain chen diu,
en_web: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;
en_kjv: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

tcz: chule nagan chateu jong hung pung cheh cheh ding, sana leh dangka ijakai kimsela nahin neidiu chuteng chingthei tah naum diu ahi.
en_web: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
en_kjv: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

tcz: Chutengleh kiletsah hoithona imacha naneilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga gim genthei nathoh lai uva Pakai, Pathen in nahuh doh’u ahi.
en_web: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
en_kjv: then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

tcz: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya aipi hang leh gulse holah a nahin puidoh nau nagel doh jing diu, hiche mun chu tolgo lah le gamsa mun ahin, hinlah Pakaiyin twi nape uvin ahi.
en_web: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
en_kjv: who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

tcz: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya manna in navah vaset uvin, hichu napu napateu khanga um khalou anneh ahi. Hiche hi Pakaiyin nangho patepna dinga abol ahin athua nanun cheh diu ahi.
en_web: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
en_kjv: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

tcz: Hiche ho jouse Pakaiyin nang ho dinga na atoh ahin, keima hatna a ka kilamdoh ahitia ima nasei louhel diu ahi.
en_web: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
en_kjv: and thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen'u na geldoh jing diu ahi. Pakai bouvin nangho lolhin theina dinga tha napeh’u ahi, ajeh chu napu, napa teu khanga pat kitepna gui lhunsah nading ahi.
en_web: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
en_kjv: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

tcz: Hiche hi nahet jing diuva ka thupeh ahi: Pakai, na Pathen'u sumila pathen dang angsunga na bohkhup uva ahileh, na chung uva thina lhung jeng ding ahi.
en_web: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
