tcz: Chule pasal khat chun pasal dang jikhat chu aluppi khah tah'a ahileh, numeinu ahin pasal pa ahin anigel lhonna thina chang lhon ding ahi. Hitobang achu Israel sunga thil dihlou chonna jouse nasuh bei diu ahi.
en_web: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
en_kjv: If a man be found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both of them die, both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.

tcz: Chule khopi sunga nungah thengsel khat chu pasal khat touvin, kholai dung ham khat a chu aki timatpi jeng tah'a ahileh,
en_web: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,
en_kjv: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto a husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;

tcz: Hitobanga chon teni chu ani lhonna khopi sung lam kelkot phunga nahin kaidoh diu, ani lhona songa na selih jeng diu ahi. Ajeh chu numeinu jong chu apanpi thei mi tampi kho sunga aum in, ahinlah ama peng doh louhel in aum in, pasal pan jong aheng akom chu asuh set jeng ahin, hitobang chondan dih lou jouse hi nalah uva kona nasuh thengsel diu ahi.
en_web: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
en_kjv: then ye shall bring them both out unto the gate of that city, and ye shall stone them with stones that they die; the damsel, because she cried not, being in the city; and the man, because he hath humbled his neighbour’s wife: so thou shalt put away evil from among you.

tcz: Hinlah nungah khat chu mitoh lumkhomsa ama chu gamlah a pasal khat touvin ana lupkhom pia, pasalpa chun numeinu chu tha guma amat chah a aki timat pia ahileh, hiche dinmuna vang hi pasal pa bouseh thina chang ding ahi.
en_web: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;
en_kjv: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field, and the man force her, and lie with her: then the man only that lay with her shall die:

tcz: Hitobang dinmun thilsoh chung chang hi, numeinu ima kilo theilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu numeinu chunga hin thina chan gotna pehna ding aum pon, pasal khat in asopipa lam ajot lutna thina achansah tobang ahi.
en_web: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;
en_kjv: but unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death: for as when a man riseth against his neighbour, and slayeth him, even so is this matter:

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche numeinu chu pasal pan gamlah a adel khum a aki timatpi ahin, numei khangdong nun jong kithopi ding ngaicha in apeng in, hinlah koiman ajah peh lou ahi.
en_web: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.
en_kjv: for he found her in the field, and the betrothed damsel cried, and there was none to save her.

tcz: Chule pasal khat touvin nungah theng tah khat chu alup pi khah tah a, thahat husana amanu chu aki timat pia alup pettah lhon akimat doh a ahileh,
en_web: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,
en_kjv: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin, which is not betrothed, and lay hold on her, and lie with her, and they be found;

tcz: Hiche pasalpa, nungahnu ki timatpi pa chun numeinu pachu dangka shekel somnga apeh ding ahi, ajeh chu amapa chun numeinu chu aki timatpisa ahitan, a hinkho lhum keiya ji dinga aki puiya hinkho aman ding ahi.
en_web: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.
en_kjv: then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.

tcz: Pasal khat chu til lahsa leh hinpi kitansa ahileh pampeiya um ahi. Amapa chu Pakai hou’in sung kikhopna muna hunglut thei talou ding ahi.
en_web: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly.
en_kjv: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord.

tcz: Chule nalah uva kona noti cha jeng jong Pakai houbung sunga jao thei lou ding, khang som changeiya noti chanu—chapa teho chu khat jeng cha jong, Pakai houbung sunga lha thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD’s assembly.
en_kjv: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the Lord.

tcz: Hitia chu Ammon mite ahin, Moab mite ani lhona Pakai houbung sunga lha theilou diu ahi. Khangsom chan geiya Pakai houbung sunga lutthei lou diu, hichu imatih chana ding ahi.
en_web: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into the LORD’s assembly forever,
en_kjv: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the Lord for ever:

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gamsunga kona nahung potdoh uchun, lampi dunga changlhah leh tuisih neo chan jong nana lamto pouvin ahi. Amavang Mesopotomia gamsunga Pethor muna Beor chapa Balaam chu ana lamhil uvin, achena mun chana dingin aga thah kit un ahi.
en_web: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
en_kjv: because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakai, Pathen in Balaam thusei chu anahsah pon, Pakai, Pathen in Balaam henga gaosapna aneiyin, chuin nangma ding’in phatthei nan aheidoh tai, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangma nangai lun ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless the LORD your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.
en_kjv: Nevertheless the Lord thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the Lord thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the Lord thy God loved thee.

tcz: Imatih chana nanghon amaho chamlen nading leh ahaosatna diuva lampi ima nasem doh peh thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.

tcz: Amavang Edom mite kiti nolna nanei thei lou diu, nangho dinga na sopiu ahi. Egypt mite jong thetbolna nanei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsunga ana khopemsa nahiuve.
en_web: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.

tcz: Edom le Egypt mite chengse vang khang thum alhin tengleh, Pakai houbung sunga lhathei diu ahi.
en_web: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.
en_kjv: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the Lord in their third generation.

tcz: Chule namelmateu toh gal kisat dinga nakon doh tenguleh, nangho jong thilse jousea kona na kikangse diu ahi.
en_web: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
en_kjv: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.

tcz: Ajeh chu jankah chun namite lah’a khat touvin botui hinche doh taleh, amapa chu ngahmuna kona pam lama paidoh a um jeng ding, ngahmun sung kitia chu hungvah lut kit lou ding ahitai.
en_web: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
en_kjv: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:

tcz: Nilhah lam tengleh vang ama chu twiya ki sutheng ding, nilhum lam teng ngahmun sunga hung lut thei ding ahi.
en_web: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
en_kjv: but it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.

tcz: Ngahmun polama chu ehkul khat nasem diu, hiche muna chu eh-thaa na cheji diu ahi.
en_web: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
en_kjv: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:

tcz: Nagal manchah'u poh lah a chu lei-tuhna thei khat naki poh jing diu, ehtha dinga naum tenguleh hiche lei laina achu na leiyuva naeh nathah diu, na thah chai tenguleh hichu leiya nale vuh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
en_kjv: and thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho nahuhdoh diu leh ngahmuna chu nangho huhdoh dinga umjing ahin, hiche naum nau ngahmun chu kisutheng jing ding ahi. Chutileh Pakai, Pathen in naum nau ngamuna chu thil thenglou ima amudoh lou ding, nang hoa kona kihei mang louva na umpi jing diu ahi.
en_web: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
en_kjv: for the Lord thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.

tcz: Aneipa akona hung jamdoh soh chu, nanghon aneipa chu namoh peh jeng thei lou'u ahi.
en_web: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:

tcz: Amatoh chun nachen khom jing diu, hoilai muna hijongleh na khopi sung'uva chu aman adeilhenna mun pena chu nachen sah jeng diu ahi. Chule hiche soh chu nanghon jong achunga gimna ima nalhun sah thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
en_kjv: he shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.

tcz: Chule Israel insunga kona numei khat jeng cha jong noti a kichem chavei um thei lou ding ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel insung’a pasal hon jong milim semthu doia neiya notia kisa chavei um theilou ding ahi.
en_web: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
en_kjv: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

tcz: Ucha kithana man le notia kona man chu Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nato doh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche teni hi Pakaiya dinga thet umtah ahi.
en_web: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the Lord thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the Lord thy God.

tcz: Na sopi khat chu sum thoiya nabat sah theilou diu, napeh'u jongleh hichu athoiya napeh thei lou diu, ipi hi jongleh aneh chan chu bat a ima um thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:

tcz: Amavang hitobang chu gamchom miho chunga nabol thei diu, ahinlah nasopi kiti pou chunga athoi kiti napeh thei lou diu ahi. Athoi nalah lou'uva ahileh tua nachen lutna diu muna khu Pakai, Pathen in phattheina lhingsela naboh diu ahi.
en_web: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
en_kjv: unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen adia thilkhat peh ding natiuva ahileh hichu napeh ding tenguleh lungkihna ima nanei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho chunga ahin del khum jeng ding, napeh lou'uva ahileh hichu nangho dinga chonset a kisim ding ahi.
en_web: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
en_kjv: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the Lord thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the Lord thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.

tcz: Kitepna nanei lou'uva ahileh hichu chonset a ki sim lou ahi.
en_web: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
en_kjv: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.

tcz: Nakam a nasei dohsau khat chu nabol doh tei nadin ki hambol jing uvin, ajeh chu nangho jong Pakai, Pathen henga kitepna nei puma nakam'uva napot dohsah'u ahitai.
en_web: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
en_kjv: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; even a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the Lord thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.

tcz: Chule nangho lengpi leiya nachen lut tenguleh nadei chan'u naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Ahinlah neocha jeng jong nasakhao-dip sung'uva naki het lut louhel diu ahi.
en_web: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
en_kjv: When thou comest into thy neighbour’s vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.

tcz: Na heng nakom pau loulaiya nagache lut tenguleh achangvui chu na kisi theiyu ahi. Amavang, koite mangcha a naheng nakompa changvui chu na-at thei louhel diu ahi.
en_web: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
en_kjv: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour’s, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour’s standing corn.

tcz: Pasal in numei chu ji dinga akipui teng, hiche numeinu chu achung’a themmo na ana um khah tah a, ajipa chu alung lhaisah jou tah louva ahileh, ajipan jong kidana lekha phatah asut ding hichu akichoi sah a, a insunga kona asoldoh ding ahi.
en_web: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
en_kjv: When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

tcz: Chuteng numeinu chu che a, pasal dang khat toh gaki cheng thei ahi.
en_web: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.
en_kjv: And when she is departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

tcz: Chule hiche ajipa jong chun numeinu chunga chu, lungkim louna aneikhah a ahileh, amasa ngaiya banga kidana lekha asut peh ding akichoi sah a a-insunga kona asoldoh jeng ding ahi. Ahinlah aji luipa chu ana thi khah tah leh,
en_web: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;
en_kjv: And if the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth it in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her to be his wife;

tcz: Ama nu dinga ajimasa pa aluipa chun, ji dinga aki lepui thei tah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hitobang thil hohi Pakaiya dia thet umtah ahin, Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsunga hitobang thilpha lou aboh hohi na umsah loudiu ahi.
en_web: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.
en_kjv: her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that is abomination before the Lord; and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.

tcz: Pasal khat chu ajinei thah ahileh, amapa chu galsat mia panda hen chule natoh dang jong bolsah lou ding ahi. Kum khat lhingset ain muna um ding, alungdei pennu chutoh noma umkhom ding ahi.
en_web: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.
en_kjv: When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: but he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken.

tcz: Chule koiman chang sum man, sumhei song man hijong leh thil dang khat toh kisaiya bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Hichu alah khah tah a ahileh, mihem hinkho thil bat mana alah ahitai.
en_web: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
en_kjv: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh a man’s life to pledge.

tcz: Koi hileh asopi Israel mi khat tou aguh a aguh pattah akimat doh’a ahileh, hiche ami guhdoh chu soh banga abol tah a, aki joh mang jenga, hitobang gucha chu thina nachan sah diu, hiche ho chu nalah uva kona nasuh mang diu ahi.
en_web: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
en_kjv: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.

tcz: Chule phah natna chung chang thudol ahin, Levi thempu hon nahilna bang uva nabol na diuvin limgeh chan um uvin, keima thupeh banga nanghon jong nabol doh theina diu ahi.
en_web: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.
en_kjv: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, so ye shall observe to do.

tcz: Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kona nahung potdoh uva Pakai, Pathen in Miriam abolna chung thudol achun limgeh chan um un.
en_web: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
en_kjv: Remember what the Lord thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.

tcz: Na sopi khat touvin thil khat bat a alah khah tah’a ahileh, nangho jong ama insunga chu namoh lut lou diu chule hiche hi akhela kaki lah ding ahi, tiajong thil ho chu nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
en_kjv: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge.

tcz: Chule nangho in polama naum diu, nangho thil bat a lapa vang chu insunga lut a, nabat sahna diuva thil na lepeh diu pen chu ahin choidoh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.
en_kjv: Thou shalt stand abroad, and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee.

tcz: Nangho thil bat a lapa chu mivaicha neilal ahi khah tahleh, nanghon achunga asea lethuhna nanei lou diu ahi.
en_web: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
en_kjv: And if the man be poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:

tcz: Nisa lhum tengleh hiche athil bat man chu nale sah diu, chuteng aman aponsil achol pen chu lupna a aman ding, nanghon jong phatthei nachan tei diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen maiya thil dih tah ahi.
en_web: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.
en_kjv: in any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down, that he may sleep in his own raiment, and bless thee: and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the Lord thy God.

tcz: Soh thalah khat chu nasuh gimlou hel diu, hitobanga vaichaa hinkho mang mihem chu, nagam sung'uva cheng nasopi mikhat tou hi nante.
en_web: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not oppress a hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates:

tcz: Hitobang mihem chu naki thalah nikho mamau nilhum masang a, atohman chu napeh diu ahi. Ama chu mivaicha tah ahin, athaman chu anga jing ding, a chuti louva ahileh ama akona lhasetna hung lhung thei ding, aman jong nangho douna jal'a Pakai henga thu hinsei in tin, hichu nangho dinga chonset ahi.
en_web: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.
en_kjv: at his day thou shalt give him his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he is poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he cry against thee unto the Lord, and it be sin unto thee.

tcz: Chule mipa ho chu achate jal'a thina ki chansah louhel diu, achate jal'a jong apate thina ki chansah lou ding ahi. Amavang koi hileh ama ama chonset jal'a bou chu thina kichan sah ding ahi.
en_web: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
en_kjv: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

tcz: Khopem mikhat leh chagapa chung thua adihna thutan chu nahei loudiu, meithai ho ponsil jong thilbat mana nalah peh thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;
en_kjv: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, nor of the fatherless; nor take a widow’s raiment to pledge:

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsunga soh changsa nahiuvin, Pakai, Pathen akona lhatdamsa ihiuve, ti nasuh mil lou diu, hiche pen tah jeh’a chu keiman bol in tia ka thupeh chu nabol jeng diu ahi.
en_web: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
en_kjv: but thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt, and the Lord thy God redeemed thee thence: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

tcz: Lou laiya chang at a nakon tenguleh, lou laiya changpal nada lhah thei lou diu, changpal le akhai athang ho jong nanung lo thei lou diu ahi. Hiche ho chu chaga hole nubei, pabei meithai ho ding ahi. Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nabol natoh jouseuva kona phattheina dimset naboh diu ahi.
en_web: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
en_kjv: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

tcz: Olive thing na phuh lhuh tenguleh, avel vel'a nivei chang naphuh lou diu, mivaicha, chaga, nulou, palou ho dinga nakhen tei diu ahi.
en_web: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
en_kjv: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

tcz: Lengpi leiya lengpiga naki chop khom teng ujongleh, nada lhah nasa nung'uva akhai chengse chu na donlou diu ahi. Ajeh chu chaga, mivaicha, meithai nulou, palou ho ding ahiye.
en_web: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
en_kjv: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam sunga ana soh changsa chu nahiuvin, hichu nagel doh jing diu chule hichengse hi nabol diuva ka thupeh nahi.
en_web: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
en_kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

tcz: Mihem khat le khat akinah a, akiheh lhona ahileh, thutan vaihom hon achungthu lhon atan peh diu, themmo nanei lou chu them achansah diu, themmo nanei chu themmo achansah diu ahi.
en_web: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.
en_kjv: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.

tcz: Chule themmo changpa chu voh ding alhah khah tah a ahileh, thutan vaihompa chun themmo changpa chu alupsah ding, them changpa mitmua chu athemmona jat dung juiya avoh ding ahi.
en_web: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
en_kjv: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.

tcz: Hitobang mihem chu molsom li chan thoh thei ding, hiche kal achu thoh thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa chu miho masang in kijep jep jing tahen lang hileh, aki neosah behseh jeh achu muset a naum thei diu ahi.
en_web: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.
en_kjv: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.

tcz: Chule insunga pasal ni chengkhom teni chu khat joh sang chu chapa beiya thina ato khah tah a ahileh, athipa jinu chu pasal dang ang sunga chea jinei thei lou ding ahi. Amavang numei nu jipa sopipa vang chu hiche nu angsunga chu, che ding amanu chu ajia aki puiding ahi. Asopi ji khat kive kol bang banga avet kol ding ahi.
en_web: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
en_kjv: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband’s brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother unto her.

tcz: Hichea chapa ahin masat pen chu, a sopipa athi tasa chu khanggui jop mat nadinga, Israel insunga ama minchu suhmanga um lou ding ahi.
en_web: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.
en_kjv: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.

tcz: Ahinlah adam nalaiya sopipa chun athipa jinu chu deilouva, ji dinga akipui nom tah louva ahileh, asopipa jinu jong che ding kelkot phung lama thutan vaihom ho henga hitia hi agasei ding ahi. Ka jipa sopipan athisa asopipa hi Israel insunga amin ajop nom tapon ahi.
en_web: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”
en_kjv: And if the man like not to take his brother’s wife, then let his brother’s wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband’s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband’s brother.

tcz: Chuteng hiche khopi sunga upa chengse chu, cheuva amapa koma chu agasei diu ahi. Amavang hichan nunga jong ‘Keiman hichenu hi kaji dinga ka kipui lou ding ahi’ tia asei nah laiya,
en_web: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”
en_kjv: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;

tcz: Chule asopi athipa ji nun jong anailut ding, amapa chu akengchot asut peh ding, amai chang chil aset den ding, hitia hi ahenga asei peh ding, ‘Pasal koi hi jongleh asopipa khela insung khat sem doh nomlou chu hitia hi kibol ding ahi,’ tia asei ding ahi.
en_web: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”
en_kjv: then shall his brother’s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother’s house.

tcz: Amavang chu amin Israel insung ahi tia kisei ding, chule akengchot kisut lhah peh pa insung tiajong kihe ding ahi.
en_web: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”
en_kjv: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.

tcz: Pasal khat leh khat chu akinah a, pasal dang khatpa jinu ham chun khatpa akona chu ajipa chu huhdoh ding agot a ahileh, hiche nu chun anai lut a khatpa chu ahinpia amat a ahe peh jenga ahileh,
en_web: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,
en_kjv: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:

tcz: Hiche numei chu akhut natan peh diu, lung sa-ihna beihel a naum diu ahi.
en_web: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.
en_kjv: then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.

tcz: Chule nasakhao sung jeng'uva jong thil tena ni napoh kop lou diu, khat alen khat aneo tia napoh kop lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.

tcz: Nangho insung jenga jong thil tena alenkhat ahin, aneokhat hiteni chu nakoi tha lou diu ahi.
en_web: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.
en_kjv: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.

tcz: Thil agih tena achoma nakoi diu, aboncha bukimsel ding, hitia chu najui kim soh keiyuva ahileh, Pakai, Pathen in nangho nachennau gamsung jousea phat theina lhingset naboh diu ahi.
en_web: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
en_kjv: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

tcz: Ajeh chu hitia thil adih louva bola natohna jouse chu Pakai, Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
en_web: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.
en_kjv: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the Lord thy God.

tcz: Nangho Egypt gam sunga kona nahung pot laiyuva, Amalek miten ichan geiya nabol gimu hitam, nalam lhah nauva nabol na jouseu chu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en_web: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,
en_kjv: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;

tcz: Amahon nalam lhah laitah un nadel khum jeng uvin, na chol laitah uva ichangeiya gim genthei a nalhau hitam? Pathen ging louhel in nachung uva na atong tauvin ahi.
en_web: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
en_kjv: how he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho choldamna nape tauvin, nakim vel'uva namel mateu jousea kona nacholdo sah diu, Pakai, Pathen in napehnau nagoulo nadiu muna nachen lut tenguleh, nanghon jong vannoi leiset a Amelek mite chenna jouse chu nasuh mang hel diu ahi, tichu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en_web: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.
en_kjv: Therefore it shall be, when the Lord thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.

tcz: Nangho Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsunga nachenlut tenguleh,
en_web: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,
en_kjv: And it shall be, when thou art come in unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and possessest it, and dwellest therein;

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napeh'u, nalou lhosoh-gau masa akona phabep khat nakoidoh diu, hichengse chu pucha sunga nakoi khom diu, chuteng Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna mun achu nachea'uva naga lhut diu ahi.
en_web: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
en_kjv: that thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the Lord thy God giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to place his name there.

tcz: Hiche laimuna thempu natongpa koma chu nache uva, hitia hi ahenga nagasei diu ahi. Tunin keiman Pakai, Pathen henga ka phondoh ahitai, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in ipului khang uva pat aki tepna gamsunga keima ka hung lhung tai, tia nasei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
en_kjv: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the Lord thy God, that I am come unto the country which the Lord sware unto our fathers for to give us.

tcz: Hiteng chule, Thempu pan jong na pocha uchu na doplhah peh diu, hichu Pakai, Pathen maicham maiya nagakoi peh diu ahi.
en_web: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.
en_kjv: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the Lord thy God.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen henga hitia hi nasei diu, keima pupa chu Ram mi anahin, hiche muna chu khopem ahin, ami jeng jong lhomcha bou ahi. Chomlou kah in Egypt gamsunga nam lentah ahung hidoh tan, ahung hatdoh jeng tan ahileh mihem jeng jong tampi ahung hidoh tan ahi.
en_web: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
en_kjv: And thou shalt speak and say before the Lord thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:

tcz: Chujouvin Egypt miten ei sugim lheh jeng tauvin, gentheina tin chang eithoh sah uvin, soh le kol in hinkho iman sah uvin ahi.
en_web: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
en_kjv: and the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:

tcz: Chuin kapu, kapa luiteu khanga pat, Pathen henga chun ka tao un, Pakaiyin ka taonau awgin ajatan ahileh, ka thoh gimna jouseu le gim hesoh a ka umna jouseu amusoh kei tan ahi.
en_web: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.
en_kjv: and when we cried unto the Lord God of our fathers, the Lord heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

tcz: Chutah chun Pakaiyin athahat apan in, abanjang thahat apantan, kichat umtah leh melchihna kidang tamtah tothon Egypt gamsunga kon chun Pathen in eihin puidoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;
en_kjv: and the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:

tcz: Hichea kon chun eihin pui galkai uvin ahileh, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsunga chun ka hung galkai lhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
en_kjv: and he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.

tcz: Tun Pakai vetan, nagman nei peh'u leiset gamasa chengse kahin lhut tai. Chuteng leh Pakai, Pathen angsunga hi natun doh diu, Pakai, Pathen chu chibai naboh diu ahi.
en_web: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.
en_kjv: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O Lord, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the Lord thy God, and worship before the Lord thy God:

tcz: Pakai, Pathen akona thilpeh jouse hin kipana nachan sah diu, nangho nahiu vin, Levi mite ahin chule nalah uva hung kholjin miho jouse jaona na kipa soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.
en_kjv: and thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the Lord thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.

tcz: Chule hopsom pehna dinga, kum thum sunga peh ding dol chengse nasim toh soh kei diu, hichengse chu Levi mite ahin, nulou palou, meithai ho dinga na khindoh ding, na khopi sung'uva cheng jousen aneh uva va sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.
en_kjv: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;

tcz: Chule Pakai, Pathen angsunga nasei diu, ka insunga kon in ijakai atheng jouse chu ka koidoh soh kei tan ahi. Hiti chun, athil theng jouse akon chun Levi mite, kholjin mi, nulou, palou chule chaga hole meithai ho kape tan ahi. Na thupeh abonchan ka subukim soh keiyun ahi.
en_web: You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.
en_kjv: then thou shalt say before the Lord thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them:

tcz: Kaboi pet tah jeng in jong hopsom ka mangcha hih nai, atheng lou dinmuna kaum laiyin jong hopsom neocha jong ka kilah hih uve, hopsom kiti hi mithi opnan jong thilpeh a kamang khapouvin, keiho hin Pakai thupeh abonchan kajui jing un, nangma thupeh bang bang in ijakai ka bol kimsoh keiyun ahi.
en_web: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.
en_kjv: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

tcz: Na umna muntheng laiya kon chun neihin vetan, chule nami Israelte napehna gamsunga hin phatthei lhingset hin boh tauvin, ajeh chu hiche gamsung hi khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam ahin, kapu kappa teu khang apat eipeh sau ana hitai, tia nasei ding ahi.
en_web: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
en_kjv: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai, Pathen in tuni hin nanghon hiche chondan josue hi na jui diuvin nape tauve. Hicheng ho jouse hi nahinkho lhum keiyuva natoh doh nadiuva limgeh chaa naum diu ahi.
en_web: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
en_kjv: This day the Lord thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon hiche hi tunia, Pakai thudola naphon doh'u ahitan, nangho dia tonsot Pathen ahijing in, ama lampi jinga na lamlhah diu chule achonna dan jouse le athupeh aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
en_kjv: Thou hast avouched the Lord this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:

tcz: Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiyin, na chung chang thua aphongdoh in, nang hohi aman aphondoh banga amite mong mong ama dia lhentum chu nahi diu, athupeh jouse hi nanit bukim soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
en_kjv: and the Lord hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin, asemsa vannoi leiset mite lah a choi-atna dim, jabolna dimset a natun doh diu ahitai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang banga nang hohi nam thengte nahi jing diu ahi.
en_web: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.
en_kjv: and to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be a holy people unto the Lord thy God, as he hath spoken.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu Israel upa chengse toh akilhon tan, miho henga hiti hin aseiye. tunia ka thupeh chengse hi aboncha nanit soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
en_kjv: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsung nahin jot uva Jordan vadung nahung gal kai tenguleh, song len phabep natun diu hiche songho chu songlou mangchaa abona na loinam soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
en_kjv: And it shall be on the day when you shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:

tcz: Hiche song kiphut ho chunga chu Pakaiyin, napu luite hou henga athutepsa banga nagal kai tah jeh uva, Pakai, Pathen in na pehnau gamsung nalut tengule, dan thu akisei thu chengse aboncha najihlut soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
en_kjv: and thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

tcz: Tunia kathupeh banga Jordan nagal kai tenguleh songho chu naphudoh soh kei diu, Ebal molchunga chu natun doh soh kei diu, hiche songho chu aboncha song-lou mangchaa na loijol namsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
en_kjv: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.

tcz: Hiche muna chu Pakai, Pathen dinga maicham khat natun doh diu, maicham chu song jeng mangchaa nasem diu, songho suhnamna dinga chu thih jeng naman lou diu ahi.
en_web: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
en_kjv: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the Lord thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen dinga natun doh'u maicham chu thih manchah jeng hilou ding, hiche maicham chu pumgo thilto katdohnaa naman chah diu ahi.
en_web: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
en_kjv: Thou shalt build the altar of the Lord thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the Lord thy God:

tcz: Hiche maicham chunga chu chamna thil jong nakat doh diu, asa jong chu nanghon naneh jeng diu, Pakai, Pathen angsunga kipah tah a naum diu ahi.
en_web: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.
en_kjv: and thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the Lord thy God.

tcz: Chuteng danthu jouse hi aboncha kichihsela, hiche song chunga hi najih doh sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
en_kjv: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

tcz: Hiti chun Mose jong Levi thempuho jaonan thu aseiyin, Israel insung pumpi henga hiti hin aseiyin. Vo Israelte ngaiyun, tunia pat nangho Pakai, Pathen dinga amite nahi tauve
en_web: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.
en_kjv: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the Lord thy God.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei jeng nangai diu, athupeh leh tunia achona dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
en_kjv: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the Lord thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

tcz: Mose’n jong mipi jouse chu aphohsal jeng in, aheng uvah hiti hin asei tan ahi.
en_web: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
en_kjv: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

tcz: Jordan vadung nagal kai tenguleh, mipi aboncha phatthei bohna chang dinga aboncha Gerizim molchunga ding den soh kei diu ahi. Simeon ahin, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph chule Benjamin hichengse chu hidiu ahi.
en_web: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
en_kjv: These shall stand upon mount Gerizzim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

tcz: Ebal molsang gaosap chansah dinga mipi hijat chu kitang den ding Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan chule Naphtali ahiuve.
en_web: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
en_kjv: and these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

tcz: Chuteng Levi miten jong aw-sangtah'a aphondoh uva, Israel pumpin hichu ajah soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
en_kjv: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

tcz: Chule Pakaiya dia thet um mihem khutsem milim kilha jol ho, guhthima hou ding go ah michu apat patna gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia lhangphong tah a asap jal diu, mipin jong hichu adonbut’a Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the Lord, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa jabol lou mihem chu gaosap na chang jeng hen tia asap teng, hichu adonbut uva Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Aheng akom asopi toh agamgi sukeh chan chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon adonbut diu, Amen! ati peh diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Lamlhahna dunga mitcho elbai sugim ham, puicha vai ham khat chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hiche jong chu mipin a donbut’a, Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Kholjin miho leh chaga meithai kikah a thu adih louva tan mihem chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hitia ahinsei teng mipin adonbut’a, Amen! ati sohkei diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Pasal khat touvin apa jinu chu aluppi khah tah a ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa hin apa jinu nih ahopeh’e atiuleh mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Ijemtia gancha toh lumkhom aum khah tah ahileh, amachu gaosapna chang jeng hen, tia asei teng mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Pasal koi hileh apa sopinu toh lum khom ham, ahilouleh anu chanu toh lumkhom auma ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei tengleh, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Pasal koi hileh ajinu, nu toh lumkhom auma ahileh ama chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei teng, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Mihem koi hijongleh aheng akoma chenga sopipa aguh a thimtha tapou chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Themmona beiya mihem chunga thina chansah dinga sum guh ne mihem chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
en_kjv: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Koi hileh athu seidohsa aboncha tong molso lou chan chu gaosapna achung’a chang ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon abonchauva Amen! tia adonbut soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
en_kjv: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thua nanun jing'uva tuni khoa ka thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pakaiyin vannoi leiset a nam jouse lah’a nangho achungnung pena natun diu ahi.
en_web: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thusei aboncha nangai jing'uva ahileh, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
en_web: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
en_kjv: and all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God.

tcz: Khopi sung le lou jao lah ajong, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
en_web: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
en_kjv: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

tcz: Natu nachateu jong phatthei na chang jing ding, nalou gasoh jeng ujong phattheina chang ding, nagan chateu jouse jong phattheina chang ding, naganchateu le nasangan teu jouse jong phat theina lhingset chang diu ahi.
en_web: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
en_kjv: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

tcz: Na dip jeng ujong phattheina chang dimset ding, nachang sum buh ujong phattheina chang ding ahi.
en_web: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
en_kjv: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.

tcz: Na vailhun navaikon teng ujongleh, phattheina nachan diu ahi.
en_web: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
en_kjv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

tcz: Nagal mite jouseu Pakaiyin lethuhna aneiya gal alal sah ding, lampi khat a bou hung kon diu ahin, ahinlah lampi sagi jena jam cheh soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
en_kjv: The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

tcz: Na chang pang jong phatthei naboh peh diu, nabol natoh jouseu jong aboncha phatthei naboh peh diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga chu phattheina lhingset lhung ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
en_kjv: The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh chengse aboncha nanit soh keiyuva, Ama lam jeng nakat uva ahileh, nangho henga akitepna banga vannoi leiset a nam mite jouse lah a, nam dei lhena natun diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.
en_kjv: The Lord shall establish thee a holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and walk in his ways.

tcz: Hitia chu nabol tenguleh, namtin vaipin ama hi Pakai jal ahimong’e ti aphot chet diu, namtin vaipin nagin soh kei diu ahi.
en_web: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
en_kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the Lord; and they shall be afraid of thee.

tcz: Ima jouse bukimsela phatthei naboh diu, nacha na nanao teu jouse, nagancha teu, nalou ga jouseu, napu napateu khanga pat Pakaiyin asei dohsa kapeh ding ahi, atina gamsunga chu nangho haosatna dimset a naum diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin agoukholna jouse hin hong doh soh keiyin tin, kum kihei phat cha ahibanga gotwi hung juntin, natoh jouseu chu aboncha phattheina changsoh hel ding, namtin vaipi ho na neichan batna napeh diu, ahinlah nanghon mi danga na batlou diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
en_kjv: The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho aluchang lama napansah uva, ameito lam mong monga na pansah louhel diu ahi. Khantouna jeng nahi diu, lhahsuh nan nahin jui louhel diu ahi. Tunia chonna dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, nangho phatthei nachan tei diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
en_kjv: And the Lord shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengsea kona hi na kihei mang thei lou diu, jetlam le veilam ani gela na palkeh loudiu, pathen milim semthu hoa kona naki kangse diu, hiche ho tobang chu najen le lou hel diu ahiti, sumil louva nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en_web: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
en_kjv: and thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen thupeh nahsah louva na koiyuva, tunia keiman ka thupeh leh ama hoa kona thupeh chonna dan chengse nabol doh theina diuva chingthei tah’a najui lou'uva ahileh, anoiya gaosapna hohin nalhun den jeng diu ahi.
en_web: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
en_kjv: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

tcz: Na chennau khopi sung ahin loumun hi jongleh, gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
en_web: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
en_kjv: cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

tcz: Na dip'u ahin, nachang bong goina jeng ujong, gaosapna chang ding ahi.
en_web: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
en_kjv: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.

tcz: Na chilhahteu ahin, naleiset ga chung'uva jong gaosapna lhung ding, naganchateu jong pung thei louva, nakelngoi nouteu jong pung be talou ding ahi.
en_web: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
en_kjv: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

tcz: Na vailhun, navai kondoh geiyuva gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
en_web: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
en_kjv: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva gaosapna tinchang ahin lhun den ding, kisuh nohphahna, lung-opkaina, chule gimna ijakai jouse keima thupeh chengse nadonse tahlou jeh'uva nachung'uva hijatpi chu lhung jeng ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
en_kjv: The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.

tcz: Na jotna diu gam sunga nachen lut kahseh uva Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva hise natna jat kim nachung'uva alhunsah ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
en_kjv: The Lord shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

tcz: Pakaiyin natna ki dang nachung'uva alhunsah ding, khosih, tipat, tichung sat, chemjam pana nasat gamhel diu, nget leh thing lung nachung'uva alhunsah ding, bolgimna hijatpi hi, nathi masang seuva najui le diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
en_kjv: The Lord shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

tcz: Nalu lam'uva von chengse sumeng kisoh tading, natahsa noilam chengseu thing kisoh ding ahi.
en_web: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
en_kjv: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nagam sung'uva gotwi jouse leivui leh neldi aki sosah ding, nathi masang seuva vana kona hung leng suh suh jing ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
en_kjv: The Lord shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho namel mateu masanga na panpi lou diu, na melmateu toh ki maito dinga lampi khatseh bou na juisah diu, nagal miteu masanga lampi sagi kisoa na jam cheh diu, hi tia chu leiset chunga lenggam jouse lah a kicha puma hinkho naman jing diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
en_kjv: The Lord shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

tcz: Nathi long jouseu chungleng vachaten aneh diu, leiset a ganhing namkim in kivahna anei diu, hitia chu aneh tenguleh, leiset a mihem khat jeng cha jong ahoh mang dinga hung ki lulah lou diu ahi.
en_web: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
en_kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga naum laiyuva uilut ana lansah banga ahin lansah kit ding, na tichung'u pom ding, thisan soh leu ding, boldammo hela tipat natna naneiyuva hinkho naman diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
en_kjv: The Lord will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangol sah diu, kho namu thei lou diu, nalung thim pumpiu na suhnoh phahpeh diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
en_kjv: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

tcz: Chuteng nangho mitcho banga sun jenga jong naki mai lele diu, ipia ki salal jong leu chun na machal thei lou diu, mitin in nasuh genthei diu chule amaho chun nachom gamset diu ahina laiye.
en_web: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
en_kjv: and thou shalt grope at noondays, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

tcz: Jidia numei nakihol diu, amanu chu pasal dangkhat toh lum khom ding, in jong naki sah diu hinlah asunga nachen theilou diu ahi. Chule lengpi lei jong nalho diu, ahinlah aga chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
en_web: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
en_kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

tcz: Nama sang laiyuva na bongchal uchu ki that ding ahinlah asa chu naneh thei lou diu, hunama nasangan'u kila ding ahinlah na kile lah thei tah lou diu, nakelngoi jeng ujong nangho melmate khut a kipedoh ding, koi machan nangho napan hu tahlou diu ahi.
en_web: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
en_kjv: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.

tcz: Chule nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu abonchauva namdang te khut a kipedoh tadiu, nilhum in velhi jong leuchun nachan kit tahlou diu, naban thahat'u pana amaho chudoh jouna tha nanei lou diu ahi.
en_web: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
en_kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.

tcz: Imatih a nahet khah lou'u nam dang khat in, nalou-gasoh'u nahin hampeh chai keiyun tin, chuteng nangho chunga tantih nei louva hiche thoh gimna chu umjing ding ahi.
en_web: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
en_kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:

tcz: Namit teniuvin venan nate, ahinlah nangho mingol kibol nabanga na kidel mang diu ahi.
en_web: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
en_kjv: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

tcz: Natibah hou hungdul doh ding, abeh beh a hung pat ding, na kengtouva pat nalu chan'u pat ding nadam doh lou diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
en_kjv: The Lord shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.

tcz: Nangho nahiuvin, nachung'uva lengvai homte ahin, Pakaiyin napu, napateu jeng in jong ahet phah louhel nam mite khat angsunga nahin puilut diu, hiche muna chu thing le songa kisem pathen lim nahou diu ajen lea napan diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
en_kjv: The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

tcz: Hiche muna chu Pakaiyin napui lhung diu, mitin ma angsunga kicha puma naum lodiu, imatih chana sei chah a naum diu ahi.
en_web: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.
en_kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.

tcz: Chule loulaiya tuthei muchi ijakai napoh diu, ahinlah aga seikham lou chakhat nalo khom diu, ajeh chu khaokhopi ten aneh chaigam diu ahibouve.
en_web: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
en_kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

tcz: Lengpi lei jeng jong nalho'uva naki sah lel pi diu, ahinlah lengpitwi chu nadon louhel diu, hiche lengpi chu lung in aneh gamset ding ahi.
en_web: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
en_kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

tcz: Nachennau gamsunga Olive thingphung tampi nanei diu, ahinlah atwi chu nakinu thei deh deh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Olive thingphung nanei chengseu aboncha kisat chop ding ahi.
en_web: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
en_kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.

tcz: Chule nanghon chapa tamtah nanei diu, ahinlah khat a khat jeng cha jong nachan lou diu, aboncha sohchang dinga chediu chule nangho panhu ding mihem khat jeng cha jong kisep lou ding ahi.
en_web: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
en_kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

tcz: Nathing phunghou ahin chule nachennau leiset aboncha khaokhote chenna jeng ding ahibouve.
en_web: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
en_kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

tcz: Na heng'uva hung chenga kholjin mi chu nangho sanga khang toujing ding, nangho vang na kheh suh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
en_kjv: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.

tcz: Nanghon jong ama koma chu thil ijakai bat a nakilah diu, ama jeng hatna chang ding, nangho ameiya napan diu amavang alua pang ding ahi.
en_web: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
en_kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi gaosapna ahin nachung'uva lhung tading, hichengse chun nangho nung ahindel ding naphah thu thu'uva, chuteng nangho naki suhgep hel diu ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei nangai tapouvin, achonna dan thupeh chengse jong jui ding nagel lou-u ahi.
en_web: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
en_kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

tcz: Hitobang gaosapna hi nachung'uva umjing ding, melchihna le datmo umtah soh ding, nachi lhahteu chan geiya mangthei louva umjing ding ahi.
en_web: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
en_kjv: and they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

tcz: Chuteng nangho thil hijat jouse chunga hin lungthim kipah in naum jou tahih uvin, Pakai, Pathen kin jeng jong bolding nago tapouve.
en_web: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
en_kjv: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

tcz: Chule nangho gilkela naum diu, ponsil jeng jong nanei lou diu, thilse hijat chunga jong Pakaiyin namel mateu dinga ahinsol miho jenlea napan diu, naman thah kahseuva sohnam kihen oh nachun nakan chah diu ahi.
