tcz: Tappuah a patnin gamgichu lhumlam ma akilhung ngin Kanah vacha a kon in Mediterranian twikhanglen na alutnin ahi. Hichehi Ephraim phung bahkai jouse gamloding chu ahi.
en_web: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
en_kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

tcz: Hiche banna chun khopi phabep le vella khoho Manasseh phung kehkhat chandinga ana kipe jongchu Ephraim phung dingin akikoipih tan ahi.
en_web: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
en_kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

tcz: Amahon Gezer akonnin Canaan mite chu ananodoh joupouvin ahinlah Gezer mite chu tuni chan geijin Ephraim mite sohin apang taove.
en_web: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
en_kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

tcz: Gamloding kihopna abannachu Joseph chillhah chamasa Manasseh phung akehkhat chu akipen ahi. Makir Manesseh chamasa chu Gilead dia apa ahi. Ama chilhah hohi galhatmi ahiyehun Jordan solam gamkaija um Gilead le Bashan chu anakipesa ahi.
en_web: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
en_kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

tcz: Hitichun Jordan lhumlam gamkai Abizer, Helek, Asreil, Sechom, Hepher, chuleh Shemida hohi Manasseh phungkhai sung lah’a avatnalai insungho chan ding ahi. Hiche bahkhai hohin Joseph cha Manasseh chilhah pasalho thalheng ahiuve.
en_web: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
en_kjv: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

tcz: Ahiyeng vang'in Manasseh chapa Makir, Makir chapa Gilead, Gilead chapa Hepher, Hepher chapa Zelophahad chu cha neilou ahin, aman chanubou aneiyin amaho minchu Malah, Noah, Haglah, Milcah chuleh Tirzah ahiuve.
en_web: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
en_kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Hiche numei hohi, thempupa Eleazer, Nun chapa Joshua, chuleh Israel lamkaiho kommah ahungun hitin ahungseijun ahi, “Pakaiyin, Mose jah’a eyhole kasopiteu pasalho gamlodi eipehdiovin thupeh anapen ahi” atiove. Hijeh chun Joshua’n jong ama hochu Pakai thupeh banga apa-ngahteo chan bangin gamchu anapen ahi.
en_web: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
en_kjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

tcz: Hijeh chun Manasseh chan apumpi chu Jordan vadung galla Gilead leh Bashan gamchan banna chu gamchan oma hung lhingtan ahi.
en_web: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
en_kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

tcz: Ajeh chu Manasseh chilhah numei hojong pasal chilhah chanto kibanga achanjeh’u ahi. (Gilead gamchu Manasseh chilhah pasal amoh ho kipeh ahi).
en_web: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
en_kjv: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.

tcz: Manasseh phung gamgichu Asher gamgi hina kon in Secheme kom Micmethath changei jin ahung kikholutnin ahi. Hichea konchun gamgichu Micmethath’a kon in achesuhin Tappuah twinah putna komma chenna munho geijin ahung kilhung lut in ahi.
en_web: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
en_kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

tcz: Tappuah velkolla gamho chu Manasseh chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi a um Tappuah khopi tah vang chu Ephraim phung mite chan ahi.
en_web: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
en_kjv: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

tcz: Tappuah twinah putna akonnin Manasseh gamgi chun Kanah vadungneo chu ajuijin Meditteranean twikhanglen'ah alutnin ahi. Hiche vadungneo lhanglanga khopi phabep chu Manasseh gamsung ahi, ahinla hiche hochu atah beh’in Ephraim phungho chan ahi.
en_web: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
en_kjv: and the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

tcz: Alhanglhon invang, hiche vadungneo lhanglam gamchu Ephraimte chan ahi, chuleh vadungneo sahlang gamchu Manasseh te chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi vadungneo sahlang gamkai chutoh akilhonin Mediterranean nah a atangin ahi. Manasseh sahlang chu Asher gam ahin chuleh sahlang vangchu Issachar gam ahi.
en_web: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
en_kjv: southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

tcz: Ahivangin Issachar le Asher gamgi sunga um khopi ho, Beth-shan khopi, Ibleam khopi, Dor khopi (Hichu Naphoth-dor), Endor, Taanach khopi chule Megiddo khopi holeh agamsunga cheng hojouse chu Manasseh chan din anakipe tan ahi.
en_web: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
en_kjv: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

tcz: Ahinlah Manasseh chilhah chengse chun hiche khopi ho chu analalut joupou vin ahi. Amahon Canaan mite chu anadel-mang jou pouvin tuni geijin aum nalaijun hai.
en_web: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
en_kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

tcz: Ahinlah khonunga Israelte ahung hatdoh phatnuvin Canaan mite chu soh in amang taovin ahi. Ahinlah agam sunguva kon in anodoh joupouvin ahi.
en_web: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
en_kjv: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

tcz: Joseph chilhahte Joshua kommah ahungun hiti hin ahung dong’ui, “Pakaiyin hibanga eipunsahuva ipi dinga kachenna dio gamhi chan khatbou neipeh ham?”
en_web: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”
en_kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?

tcz: Joshua’n adonbutnin “Nangho natamlheh jengtah uva Ephraim thinglhang gam nangho dinga aneotaha ahileh hiche Periz mitele Reph mite channa gammang lahkhu nangho dingin gakisuhtheng taovin atipeh in ahi.”
en_web: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
en_kjv: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

tcz: Joseph chilhahte chun adonbutnin, “Thinglhang gamhi keiho dingin alhing joupoi katiu hi atahbeh ahi. Ahinlah Canaan mite gamnomma cheng holeh Jezreel phaichamma um hohin thih sakol kangtalai aneiyun, amahohi keihon kadoudio vin ahahsa valle atiove.”
en_web: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
en_kjv: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

tcz: Hichun Joshua’n Joseph chilhahte Ephraim le Manasseh phungmi teho kommah hitin aseije “Nanghohi natammuve nahatlheh jeng taove ahileh nangho dingahi chan khatval kipeding nahiuve.
en_web: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
en_kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

tcz: Thinglhang gammang lahkhu nangho nachan bediu ahi. Nanghon nasuhtheng nom chanun gakisuhthengun agam lapen aningkoi changeijin galo tauvin phaichamma Canaan mite jeng jongkhu hatlheh uhenlang thih sakol kangtalai neijongleo ganodoh taovin,” ati.
en_web: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
en_kjv: but the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

tcz: Tunvang gamsung chu Israelte khut noiya uma ahitai, Israel mite chu abonchauvin Shiloh a akikhomun hichea chun kikhopna ponbuhkhat atungdohn tauve.
en_web: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
en_kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

tcz: Ahinlah hichea chun phung sagi hochu alodiu chennagam kipeloulai aum nalaijin ahi.
en_web: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
en_kjv: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

tcz: Hichun Joshua’n amahochu adongin, “Napu napateu Pakai Pathennin nalodiuva napeh u gam nachandiu chu itih changei nanga diuham?” ati.
en_web: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
en_kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are you slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?

tcz: “Phungkhat a mithum cheh hinlhengdoh unlang keiman amaho chu gam vetoh dingin gahsol intin, amaho cheuvin tin amaho cheh in alodiu gamchu hinvetoh untin keikoma thu ahinlhut kitdiu ahi.
en_web: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
en_kjv: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

tcz: Judahten achannu lhanglam gamleh Joseph in achennao sahlang gam panglouva amahon agamvet uchu hop sagi’a ahopdiu ahi.
en_web: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
en_kjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

tcz: Hitia chu amahon agamvet u ajihlutnao chu keikoma ahin choilutdiu, aphungdung jui'a achondiu akipehtheina dinga keiman Pakai Pathen angsung’a vang theng kasanding ahi.
en_web: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
en_kjv: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.

tcz: “Levite chun gamchan aneiloudiu ahi. Amaho chanding chu Pathen thempu kinbol chu hiding ahi. Chuleh Gad, Reuben leh Manasseh phung kehkhat hochu gam chanbeloudiu ahitai. Ajeh chu Pakai lhacha Mose’n amahochu Jordan vadung solam gamkaija anapehsa ahitan amahon gamchan chu akimusao ahitai,” ati.
en_web: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
en_kjv: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.

tcz: Amaho gam gakholtoh dingleh gajihdoh dinga akipatdoh uchun Joshua’n hitin thupeh ananeijin ahi, “Cheuvinlang agamchu gakholtoh unlang kichihtah in hinjihdoh un. Chujouteng kakomma hungun, huting keiman Shiloh munna Pakai angsung’a vangsan na kaneiding chuteng aphung dungjui a agam chu kahoppehdiu nahiuve” ati.
en_web: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”
en_kjv: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.

tcz: Miho chun gampumpi chu agakholtoh dungjuijin ahin jihdoh un khopi dingleh khoneoding agongtoh un hopsagi in ahommun lekhabua ajihkit un Shiloh ngahmunna Joshua komma ahinpo lutnun ahi.
en_web: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
en_kjv: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

tcz: Chuleh Shiloh achun Joshua'n Pakai angsung’a vangsan’na aneiyin hoilai munchu koi phungpen chang dingham ti avetan ahi.
en_web: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
en_kjv: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

tcz: Vang kivetna-a chan masa chu Benjamin phunga alhungin ahi. Hiche chan hi Judah le Joseph gamchan kikah’a um gam chu ahi.
en_web: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
en_kjv: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

tcz: Benjamin channa sahlang gamgi chu Jordan vadunga hung kipan ahin, Jericho sahlang juilang ajonnin, hitichun lhumlama thinglhang gamleh Beth-aven ahin pal galkaijin ahi.
en_web: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
en_kjv: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

tcz: Hiche apatin gamhi chu Luz (Bethel tina) lhanglama achepeh in hijouchun achesuh in noinung Beth-horon lhanglam thinglhang chunga um Ataroth-addar munna alutnin ahi.
en_web: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
en_kjv: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

tcz: Gamgi chu ahung kileheijin lhanglang ajonsuh in Beth-horon maingat thinglhang lhumlam gei hina alutnin Kiriath-baal (Keriath-jearim tina) khokhatna atangin ahi. Hichehi Judah phung khopi khat ahi. Hichehi lhumlam gamgi chu ahi.
en_web: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
en_kjv: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

tcz: Lhanglam gamgi chu Kiriath-jearim khopamma konin ahung kipanne. Hiche lhumlam gamchinna konhin ahung kilhungin Naphtoah twinah put namun ahinjotpan,
en_web: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
en_kjv: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

tcz: Ben-Hinnom phaicham pangmol bullah alutnin ahi. Hichehi Rephaim phaicham sahlang kichaina mun ahi. Hichea konhin Hinnom phaichamma achesuh peh-in Jebus mite chenna lhanglam suh apaltannin En-Rogel changei in achonlut peh in ahi.
en_web: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
en_kjv: and the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

tcz: En-Rogel gamgia kon in sahlang jotna lammah alutnin En-Shemesh ahinjonin Geliloth (Adummin langa kaltouna toh kigalsai ahitai) chunga alut jellin ahi. Hichea konhin Bohan (Reuben chapa min) songphung geijin achesuh in ahi.
en_web: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
en_kjv: and was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

tcz: Hichea konhin Jordan phaicham hin galdotna sahlang gamkai langa achepeh in ahi. Hitichun gamgi chu phaicham lamma achesuh in ahi.
en_web: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
en_kjv: and passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

tcz: Beth-hoglah sahlang lhang apal galkaijin Chitui-len sahlang pangah alongin ahi. Hichehi Jordan vadung lhang langa achaina ahitai. Hiche lhanglang gamgi chu ahitai.
en_web: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
en_kjv: and the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

tcz: Solam gamgi chu Jordan vadung ahitai. Hichehi Benjamin phung bahkai ho jouse gamlo dinga kipe gamgi chu ahi.
en_web: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
en_kjv: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

tcz: Hicheho hi Benjamin phung sunga abahkai ho kipe khopichu ahi. Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
en_web: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
en_kjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

tcz: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
en_web: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
en_kjv: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

tcz: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
en_web: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
en_kjv: and Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

tcz: Kephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba— khopi somleni chule vella khoho ahiuve
en_web: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
en_kjv: and Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages.

tcz: Chujongle Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
en_web: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
en_kjv: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

tcz: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
en_web: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
en_kjv: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

tcz: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
en_web: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
en_kjv: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

tcz: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (hichu Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim — khopi somleli chule avella khoho ahiuve. Hicheng hi Benjamin phungmite le abahkai ho lodia kipe gam ho chu ahi.
en_web: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
en_kjv: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

tcz: Anichanna’a alodiova gam kipechu Simeon phung sunga phung bahkaiho chu ahiuve.
en_web: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
en_kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

tcz: Simeon gamlo dinga kipe hochu Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,
en_web: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
en_kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

tcz: Hazar-shual, Belah, Ezem,
en_web: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
en_kjv: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

tcz: Eltolad,Belhul, Hormah,
en_web: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
en_kjv: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

tcz: Ziklag, Bethmarcaboth, Hazar-susah,
en_web: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
en_kjv: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

tcz: Beth-lebaoth chuleh Sharuhon khopi somle thum toh vella khoho puma ahop ahi.
en_web: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
en_kjv: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

tcz: Hichun Ain, Rimmon, Ether, chule Ashan khopi li hotoh akhoneo hojong ahopme.
en_web: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
en_kjv: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

tcz: Avelluva khohop jouse toh Baalath-beer (Negev ma Ramah jong akitin ahi) changei ahi. Hiche hohi Simeon phungle abahkhai ho gamlo dinga kipea chu ahi.
en_web: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
en_kjv: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

tcz: Amaho kipe gamhi Judah te gamphabep kikah lha a kipe ahi. Ajeh chu Judah gamchu amaho dinga analen valla ahi. Hijeh chun Judah gamsunga kon in Simeon phungin gamchan phabep aneiyin ahi.
en_web: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
en_kjv: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

tcz: Athum channa gamloding chan kipe chu: Zebulun phung sunga abahkhai ho ahiuve. Zebulun chenna gamgei chu Sarid na ahung kipan ahi.
en_web: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
en_kjv: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

tcz: Hichea konchun lhumlamma achen Maralah ahopan Dabbeesheth akhokhellin Jokneam vadungneo lang ajonnin ahi.
en_web: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
en_kjv: and their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

tcz: Sarid napat chun agamgihi gamchom jep'a akiheijin, Kishloth-tabor gamgi lang nisolamma nisa hungsodoh nalam ajontai. Chuin Deberath lang ajon kitnin, Japhia langa akilhung touve,
en_web: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
en_kjv: and turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

tcz: Japhia patchun nisolam ahin lhahin nisa hungsodoh jina Gath-hepher gal Eth-kazin geijin ahung kilhung paiyin chuin Rimmon channin akilhung doh peh in Neah lang jonin ahung kiheikon tai.
en_web: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
en_kjv: and from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

tcz: Abanin sahlamma agamgi chu Hannathon langa akiheijin Iphtah-el phaiya abeitai.
en_web: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
en_kjv: and the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

tcz: Khopi hochu Kattath ahin, Nahalal ahin, Shimron ahin, Idalah ahin, chuleh Bethlehem toh ahi, khopi somleni toh akhoneo jousetoh ahithai.
en_web: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
en_kjv: and Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

tcz: Hichenghi Zebulun chate chan agam goulo ahin ainsung dungjui uva khopi hicheng toh akhoneo jouse toh chantha ahiuve.
en_web: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
en_kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Ali channa gamloding chan kipe chu Issachar phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en_web: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
en_kjv: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

tcz: Agamgi hopsunga chun Jezreel jong, Kesul’loth jong Shunem jong.
en_web: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
en_kjv: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

tcz: Hapharaim jong Shion jong Anaharath jong,
en_web: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
en_kjv: and Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

tcz: Rabbith jong Kishion jong Ebez jong,
en_web: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
en_kjv: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

tcz: Remeth, En-gannim jong En-haddah jong, Beth-pazzez jong ahopdoh tai,
en_web: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
en_kjv: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

tcz: Agamgi chun Tabor jong Shahazuman jong chle Beth-shemesh jong ahopan, Jordan vadungah chun agamgi abeitai. Khopi somlegup toh akhoneo jouse toh ahiye.
en_web: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
en_kjv: and the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

tcz: Hiche hi Issachar chate phung miho goulo achandio ahin, ainsung dungjuijin khopi chujat chutoh khoneo chengse toh achantha taove.
en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
en_kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

tcz: Anga channa gamloding chan kipe chu Asher phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en_web: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
en_kjv: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

tcz: Agam chu Helkath jong Hali jong , Beten jong, Achshaph jong,
en_web: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
en_kjv: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

tcz: Allammelech jong, Amad jong chule Mishal jong ahoptai, nilhum lamma Carmel le Shihor-libnath jong ahopsoh keijin,
en_web: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
en_kjv: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

tcz: Chuin agamgi’n nisolam ajotnin, Beth-dagon geijin akilhung in, Zebulun leh Iphtahel phaicham ahopan, sahlam alhah in, Beth-emek leh Neiel geijin akilhung lut in ahi, chujouvin jong agamgi chu Cabul sahlamma achen,
en_web: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
en_kjv: and turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

tcz: Ebron lam, Rehob lam, Hammon lam, Kanah lam ajonnin, Sidon lengpa geijin akilhung lutne,
en_web: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
en_kjv: and Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

tcz: Hichun Ramah lamma agamgi chu ahung kihei kitnin Tyre khopi kulpi kikai khumchu ahinpha peh in ahi, chujouvin Hosah lam jonnin akihei kitnin chule Mediterranian twilena atangtai, Mehebel jong Achzib jong,
en_web: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
en_kjv: and then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

tcz: Ummah jong, Aphek jong chuyle Rehob jong ahin, khopi somnile nitoh akhoneo jouse jong ahi.
en_web: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
en_kjv: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

tcz: Hichehi ainsungu dungjuija Asher chate phung goulo ahin, khopi hijat leh akhoneo jousetoh ahiye.
en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
en_kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Agup channa gamloding chan kipe chu Naphtali phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en_web: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
en_kjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

tcz: Agamgi chu Heleph a kipat Zaanan-nim apat chule Adami-nekeb apat, Jabneel apat Lakkum chan geijin akilhung lut peh in, chuin Jordan vadunga atangtai.
en_web: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
en_kjv: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

tcz: Chujouvin agamgi chu nilhum lamma akiheijin, Aznoth-tabor lam ajonnin chua kon in Hukkok lam ajonpai paijin lhanglamma Zebulun ahopan nilhum langa Asher gamgi ahopa kitnin nisolamma Jordan vadung ajuijin ahi.
en_web: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
en_kjv: and then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

tcz: Kulpi kikaikhum hochu, Ziddim ahin, Zer ahin, Hammath ahin, Rakkath ahin, Kinnereth ahi.
en_web: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
en_kjv: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

tcz: Adamah ahin, Ramah ahin, Hazor ahin,
en_web: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
en_kjv: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

tcz: Kedesh ahin, Edrei ahin, En-hazor ahin,
en_web: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
en_kjv: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

tcz: Yiron ahin, Migdal-el ahin, Beth-anath ahin, chule Beth-shemesh ahi, khopi somleko toh khoneo chengse toh ahiye.
en_web: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
en_kjv: and Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

tcz: Ainsung utoh kithuh bepma hichenghi Naphtali chate phung chan agamu ahi, khopi hohi ahin khoneoho ahin akisim than ahi.
en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
en_kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

tcz: Asagi channa gamloding chan kipe chu Dan phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en_web: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
en_kjv: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

tcz: Chule Dan phung chan agoulo gamchun khopi Zorah jong, Eshtaol jong Ir-shemesh jong,
en_web: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
en_kjv: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

tcz: Shalabbin jong, Aijalon jong, Ithlah jong,
en_web: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
en_kjv: and Shaalabbin, and Aijalon, and Jethlah,

tcz: Elon jong Timnath jong, Ekron jong ahin,
en_web: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
en_kjv: and Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

tcz: Eltekah jong, Gibbethon jong, Baalath jong,
en_web: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
en_kjv: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

tcz: Jehud jong, Bene-berak jong, Gath-rimmon jong,
en_web: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
en_kjv: and Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

tcz: Chule Me-jarkon le Rakkon toh Joppa to kimai ngat gamsungse sejong ahopsoh keijin ahi.
en_web: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
en_kjv: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

tcz: Dan chaten agamsung achanlou phat uvin akon touvun Leshem khopi agasat uvin, alah jouvun chemjammin asatgam helluvin atoupha uvin asunga acheng tauve, Leshem jong chu apu apau min aputsah uvin Dan asah taove.
en_web: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
en_kjv: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

tcz: Hichenghi ainsung tohkham bepma Dan chate phunggoul achannu ahin, khopi hojong khoneo hojong ahithai.
en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
en_kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Gamsung chu abih bih a gouloa chenpha dia akihopsoh helphat uvin, Israel chaten Nun chapa Joshua jong chu alah uva goulo ding gam apeovin ahi.
en_web: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.
en_kjv: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

tcz: Pakai thusah in Israelten Joshua chu athumpen pen khopi Timnath-serah kiti, Ephraim thinglhang gamsunga khopi chu ape taove, amanjong akhopi chu akisah phatnin chennan aneitan ahi.
en_web: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
en_kjv: according to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

tcz: Eleazer thempupa leh Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel aphungkhai leh ainsung dungjui uva alamkai houvin Shiloh munna Pakai angsung laitah’a vang asan’uva anahopdoh peh naogam ahin, hichu Pakai chenna ponbuh kotpi phunga anahopmu ahiye, hitichun amahon agamchu ahomsoh taovin ahi.
en_web: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
en_kjv: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

tcz: Pakaiyin Joshua kommah hitihin thu ahinseije:
en_web: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
en_kjv: The Lord also spake unto Joshua, saying,

tcz: “Tun keiman Mose kana seipeh bangin Israel techun kiselna ding khopiho chu akilhendoh diovin seipehtan
en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,
en_kjv: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

tcz: ‘Koitabang hamkhat in mikhattou tupna mong umlouva ahilou leh hettoh louva ahin tha khah tah a ahileh athatpa chunga phulanom athipa sopiho khutna konna ajamlut nading kiselna khopi ho umding ahi.
en_web: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
en_kjv: that the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

tcz: Hiche khopiho khatpen’a hi ajamlut teng hiche mithatpahi khopi kelkot phunga upa ho masanga achungthu akiphondoh ding, amahon hichepa hi khopi sunga alutsah uva amaho komma achenthei nading agonpeh diu ahi.
en_web: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.
en_kjv: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

tcz: Ijemtia athipa insung mite chu phula dinga ahungu leh lamkai hochun mithatpa chu amaho komma apehlut louding ahi, ajeh chu amapa chun tumasanga kinahna umlou chuleh tupna mong imacha umlouva khutsoiya anatha khah jeh ahi.
en_web: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.
en_kjv: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

tcz: Ahinlah mithatpa chu hiche khopia chu umden ding, khopi chun achung thu akhol toh uva athu atandiu ahi, chuleh hiche thilso petna thempu chungnung natongpa hinlai sea hiche komma chu cheng ding ahi. Hijouteng chuleh ahung jamdohna khopi sung ain munna chu kilekit thei ding ahi.
en_web: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”
en_kjv: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

tcz: Hicheho hi kiselna khopi hochu: Naphtali thinglhang gam'a din Galilee a um Kadesh, Ephraim thinglhang gammadin Sechem, Judah thinglhang gam'a din Kiriath-arba (Hebron tina),
en_web: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
en_kjv: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

tcz: Jericho gallang Jordan vadung solama din hiche khopiho hi alhengdoh un ahi: Reuben phung phaicham gammang langa din Bezer; Gad phung mite gamsunga din Gilead na um Ramoth, Manasseh phung mite gamsunga din Bashan’a um Golan ahiuve.
en_web: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
en_kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

tcz: Israelte hihen alah uva cheng gamchom miho hijongleh hiche khopi hohi kigonpeh a ahiuve. Hichehi amun khoppi masanga thu kikholna umman louva phulahna a kilhana dinga konna hoidohna aumtheina dinga tohgon ahi.
en_web: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.
en_kjv: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Levi phung sunga lamkaiho chu ahungun Eleazer thempupa toh, Nun chapa Joshua toh chuleh Israel pumpi phung lamkaiho ahung kihoutoh piuvin ahi.
en_web: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

tcz: Amaho chu Canaan gam'a Shiloh munna ahungun hiti hin aseijuve, “Keihohi kaganchateo nehding hampa phatna gamleh keiho chenna ding khopiho eipehna diuvin Pakaiyin Mose kommah anaseijin ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”
en_kjv: and they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

tcz: Hitichun Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Israel mipite chun hiche khopiho le hampa phatna gamhohi amaho gamchan dingin Levite chu ana piuvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.

tcz: Levi phungsunga konna Kohath phung bahkai insung miho Aaron chilhah hochu atil abulla Judah, Simeon leh Benjamin phungho ana kipe khopi somlethum hochu ape taovin ahi.
en_web: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
en_kjv: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

tcz: Tumasang Ephraim, Dan leh Manasseh phung akehkhat anakipesa khopi somkhat chu Kohath phungkhai insungmi dangho chu anapeovin ahi.
en_web: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
en_kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

tcz: Tumasang’a Issachar, Asher, Naphtali chuleh Manasseh phungkeh khat ana kipesa khopi somle thumchu Gershon phung bahkhai hochu anapeuvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
en_kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

tcz: Tumasang’a Reuben, Gad leh Zebulun phungho ana kipesa khopi somleni hochu Merari phungkhai hochu anapeovin ahi.
en_web: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
en_kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose anathupeh dungjuijin Israel chaten khopi hichengse hileh hamhing phatna gam hichenghi vangkisanpeh bang banga Levite anapeh u ahiye.
en_web: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Judah leh Simeon phunga kon in Israel chaten khopi hichengsehi anape taove.
en_web: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
en_kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

tcz: Akhopi chengsehi Aaron chilhah ho Kohath chate insung leh Levi miho mama insungkhat ching taovein ahi, ajeh chu vangkisan chu amaho dia hung pha masa ahi.
en_web: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
en_kjv: which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

tcz: Israel chaten amaho chu Kiriath-arba kiti, hichea Arba hi Anak pa ahin, akhopi Hebron jong kiti, Juda thinglhang gamma khopi le akimvella hamhing gamchengse chu apetaove.
en_web: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.
en_kjv: And they gave them the city of Arbah the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

tcz: Khopi loujao chengsele akhoneoho vang chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb chenna dinga kipesa ahitai.
en_web: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
en_kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

tcz: Aaron thempupa chilhahte chu Israel chaten mithatho kiselna khopi Hebron le ahamhing gamsung jouse apeovin, Libnah le ahamhing gam pumpi jong anapeuve.
en_web: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

tcz: Jattir khopile Eshtemoa ahamhing gamjong apeovin ahi.
en_web: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: and Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

tcz: Holonle ahamhing gamjouse apeovin, Debirle hamhing gamjong apeh thaovin ahi.
en_web: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: and Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

tcz: Chule Ain khopile ahamhing gamsung apehthaovin Juttah le ahamhing gamjong apeove. Beth-shemesh le ahamhing apeh taovin, hitichun hiche phungni sunga kon hin khopi ko apedoh taove.
en_web: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.
en_kjv: and Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

tcz: Benjamin phunga kon in Gibeon khopile ahamhing gamjong apeovin, Giba le ahamhing gamjong apeovin,
en_web: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

tcz: Anathoth khopile ahamhing gamsungsese toh apummin Almon khopile ahamhing gamsungse jong apeovin ahi.
en_web: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Aaron thempupa chilhah achate chan khopi chengsechu abonchan khopi somlethum toh ahamhing gamsungse toh ahopthan ahi.
en_web: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

tcz: Levi mite lah a Kohath insungmi, Kohath chate amoh chengse chu Ephraim phunga konna achandio khopi akihoppeh tai.
en_web: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
en_kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

tcz: Hiche Kohath chate amoh chengse chu mithatho kiselna ding khopi Shechem le ahamhing gamsunga, Ephraim thinglhang gamsung chu apeovin, Gezer khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin ahi.
en_web: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

tcz: Kibzaim khopi le ahamhing gamjong apeove, khopi li alhingin ahi.
en_web: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: and Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Chule Dan phunga kon in Eltekeh khopile ahamhing gam apeovin Gibbethon khopi le ahamhing gam apeove;
en_web: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

tcz: Aijalon khopile ahamhing gamjong apeove, khopi li ma alhing in ahi.
en_web: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Manasseh phunga kon in jong Taanach khopile ahamhing gam apeovin Gath-rimmon khopile ahamhing gam apeove; hichu khopi ni ahi.
en_web: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
en_kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

tcz: Kohath chate amoh chengse insung mite chan khopichu abonchan khopi somkhat le ahamhing gamjouse toh ahopthai.
en_web: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

tcz: Levite inko lah’a ainsung khat Gershon chate jongchu Manasseh phungkah khat a kon in asandiu chu apeovin, Bashan gamsungse Golan khopile ahamhing gamsungse apeove; hiche khopi jong mithat ho kiselna khopi mama ahi, chule Be-eshterah khopi le ahamhing gamsung jong ahin, khopi ni hi apeovin ahi.
en_web: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
en_kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.

tcz: Chujongle Issachar phunga kon in jong Kishion khopi le ahamhing gamsung apeovin, Daberath khopile ahamhing gamsung sese jong apeove.
en_web: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

tcz: Chule Jarmuth khopi le ahamhing gamsung apeovin, En-ganmin khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeh thaovin ahile, khopili alhing in ahi.
en_web: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Asher phunga kon in jong Mishal leh Abdon khopi le ahamhing gamjong apeove,
en_web: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

tcz: Helkath khopi le ahanhing gamsung jong apeovin chule Rehob khopile ahamhing gamjong apeovin ahileh khopi li ma alhingtai.
en_web: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Naphtali phung sunga kon in jong Galilee gamsunga Kedesh le ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin, hiche khopi jonghi mithat ho kiselna khopi ma ahi, Hammoth-dor le ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin, chule kartan khopi le ahamhing gamsung jong apeh thaovin, abonnin khopi thum alhingtai.
en_web: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

tcz: Gershon chate inko chujat dinga khopi kipedoh chengse chu abonchan khopi somle thum alhingin ahamhing gamsung sesetoh ahi tha cheh in ahi.
en_web: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

tcz: Levite mi amoh chengse, Merari chate chu Zubulun phunga kon in achandio akipen, Jok-neam khopi le ahamhing gamsung apeovin, Kartah khopi le ahamhing gamsung apeove.
en_web: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

tcz: Dimnah khopile ahamhing gamsungse apeovin, Nahalal khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeove, abonnin khopi li alhingin ahi.
en_web: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Reuben phunga kon in jong Bezer khopile ahamhing gamsung chu apeovin, Jahaz khopile ahamhing gamsungse sejong apeove.
en_web: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

tcz: Kedemoth khopile ahamhing gamsungse apeovin chule Mephaath khopi le ahamhing gamsungse sejong apeovin ahileh khopi li alhinge.
en_web: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
en_kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

tcz: Gad phunga kon in jong Gilead gamsunga Ramoth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se apeovin, hiche khopi jonghi mithat ho kiselna khopi mama ahiye; Mahanaim khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin,
en_web: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

tcz: Heshbon khopile ahamhing gamsungse sejong apeovin, Jazer khopi le ahamhing gamsungse se apeovin ahileh abonnin khopi li alhingin ahi.
en_web: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.
en_kjv: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

tcz: Merari chate inko chujatpi Levi inkote lah a aum nalaiho dia kipedoh khopi chengse abonchan khopi somleni alhingin ahi.
en_web: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
en_kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

tcz: Israel chate lah a Levite khopi chengse chu abonnin khopi somlileget alhingin, ahamhing gamsungse setoh ahitha cheh in ahi.
en_web: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

tcz: Khopi hijatchun akimvel khopam dunga hamhing gam aneicheh uvin, hitobanga hi khopi chujat chu changsoh hel ahiuve.
en_web: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.
en_kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

tcz: Hitobang hin apu apateo henga akihahselna bang bangin Pakaiyin Canaan gam pumpi chu Israelte apetai; Israel tenjong agam pumpi chu atoupha uvin achengtaove.
en_web: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
en_kjv: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

tcz: Chujongleh apu apateo henga akihahselna bangchun Pakaiyin Israelte chu ajet avei’a mitea kon in akicholdo sahtai; agalteo khatna khat jengcha jong amaho ting tan jouvah abeihel tan ahi; ijeh nem itileh Pakaiyin agalteo abonchan akhut uva apedoh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
en_kjv: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.

tcz: Pakaiyin Israelte insung dinga akitepna pha chengse chu khatcha alhinglel abei hellin, abonchan athutep chengse agui lhung sohkeiyin ahi.
en_web: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
en_kjv: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

tcz: Joshua Reuben chate le Gad chate chule Manasseh phungkeh khat chutoh akoukhommin,
en_web: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
en_kjv: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

tcz: Ajah uva hiti hin aseitai, “Nang hon Pakai lhacha Mose in nathupeh jouse abonchan nanitsoh keiyun, keiman nango kaseipeh kathusei jouse jong nangai taove,
en_web: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
en_kjv: and said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

tcz: Nikho hijat sunghin tuni geijin nanghon nasopi phungdang teho jong nadalha dehpouvin, Pakai na-Pathenn uvin nathupeh chnegseu jong chingthei tah in nanit soh kei’un ahi.
en_web: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God.
en_kjv: ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.

tcz: Tunvang Pakai na-Pathen uvin athutep bang bangin nasopi phungdang te hojong jong akitepna bangin akicholdosah tai, hijeh chun tun kiheijun lang Jordan gal lamma Pakai lhacha Mose’n napeh naugam, nangho chenna gamsung nagoulo’u, na inlammu jonnin chetaovin,
en_web: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.
en_kjv: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get ye unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose’n nathupeh u danthupeh chengse chu nanit jingna diuvin ching theiyun, Pakai na Pathennu nangailut nuva ama lamlhah jouse najuithem uva athupeh chengse nanit’uva amajong nakolchah jinguva, chule nalungthim pumpiu le nahinkho pumpiuva amakin jeng naboldiu nagin jing diu ahi.” ati.
en_web: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
en_kjv: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

tcz: Hitichun Joshua’n amaho chu phatthei aboh in, phatthei abohjou phatnin asoldohtai, amaho jong ainlam cheh uva achetaove.
en_web: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.
en_kjv: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

tcz: Manasseh phung akehkhat chu Bashan gamsunga Mose’n achandiu gam anapehsa ahin, Manasseh phungkeh khatma chu Joshua’n Jordan vadung gal nilhumlam, asopiteo dangho lah a chenmun anapeh ahiye. Amaho chu Joshua’n ainlammuva asoldoh phatnin abonchaovin phatthei abohsoh keijin ahi;
en_web: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,
en_kjv: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

tcz: Ajah uva Joshua’n hitin ati, “Neilegou tampitah kipoh uvin lang gancha jong tamtah kipoh uvin lang naponbuh sonna muncheh a kile taovin, nagal mite uva konna nachomdoh jouseu jong kihommun” ati.
en_web: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”
en_kjv: and he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

tcz: Hijeh chun Reuben chate le Gad chate chuleh Manasseh phung kehkhat chun Israel chate amoh chengse chu Canaan gam'a Shiloh kiti khopiah chun adalhauvin, amaho chu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh banga agamlosa sung’u Gilead gamsung jonnin ache taove.
en_web: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
en_kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

tcz: Ahin amaho chu Canaan sung’a aum jinglai un, Geliloth kiti mun Jordan vadung kommah chun, Reuben chate le Gad chate chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chu akinga pa un, maicham phung lentah le thupitah khat asemmun ahi.
en_web: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.
en_kjv: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

tcz: Israel chaten, Reuben chate le Gad chate, chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chun Canaan gam mongchin Jordan vapang lhangchung khat’a Israel chate gamsunga khun maicham asemmu chu ajahdoh taove.
en_web: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”
en_kjv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

tcz: Athudol hi Israel chaten ajahdoh phatnun Shiloh munna cheng Israel chate khopi pumpi akikhommuvin amahochu galla sat thodin agotaove.
en_web: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.
en_kjv: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

tcz: Ahinlah, amasan, Eleazar thempu chapa Phinehas lamkainan mi phabep Reuben phung mite le Gad chule Manasseh phung keh khat toh kihoudin anasol uve.
en_web: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

tcz: Hichea kihoulimpi dia kalsong mihochu Israel phunglah’a lamkai som ahiuvin, a insungkhat bahkailhah’a aluboh cheh, chule Israel insung phung khatcheh a konna kilhengdoh phung upacheh mi ahiuve.
en_web: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.
en_kjv: and with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was a head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

tcz: Amaho chu Gilead gam ahunglhun phat un, Reuben chate le Gad chate chule Manasseh phung kehkhat hengah hitin aseijuve,
en_web: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,
en_kjv: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

tcz: Pakai khoppi amiten hitin aseijun, “Ipi dinga nanghon tulaija hi Israel Pathen douna thil nabolluva Pakai nung najuidauva nakiheimang jenguva nacham chamma maicham nakisem jeng uva Pakai douna hitobang pihi nabollu hitam?
en_web: “The whole congregation of the LORD says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against the LORD?
en_kjv: Thus saith the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the Lord?

tcz: Peor munna ichonsetnao jong phaset nasah louvu ham? Hichea konna bon ithensoh jou loulaiju hilouham? Hiche ichonset jeh uva jong chu Pakai khoppi mipi chunga jong gamna hise ana langsa ahi,
en_web: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD,
en_kjv: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,

tcz: Tuni geija jong nangho hitobanga hi Pakai chu iti nadalhah uva nakihei mang jengdiu hitam? Tuni jenga jong nanghon Pakai doumah nabolluva ahileh amachu Israel khoppi pumpi chung jeng ajong hung lunghang jengding ahi.
en_web: that you must turn away today from following the LORD? It will be, since you rebel today against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
en_kjv: but that ye must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

tcz: Nachennao gamsung athenlouva ahijongleh hung galkai junlang Pakai houbuh kisonna gamsung Pakai gamsunga khun keiho lah a hung cheng jenguvin, Pakai doumah hi nabol louhel diu, Pakai I-Pathennu maicham semna tailouva nacham nachamma nakisem thu-uva keiho geija doumah hol neiso louhel dingu ahi.
en_web: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than the LORD our God’s altar.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the Lord, wherein the Lord’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the Lord, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the Lord our God.

tcz: Suhmang dinga kikat dohsa thil-ho chunga Achan kitipa Zerah chapan tohkhel aneiyu chu Israel khoppi pumpi chunga lunghanna hungchu jengsa hilouham?” ahung tiuve.
en_web: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”
en_kjv: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

tcz: Reuben chate le Gad chate chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chun Israel phungsunga insungmi upa ho donbutnan aneiyun,
en_web: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
en_kjv: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

tcz: “Pakai, Hatchungnung chu Pathen ahi! Pakai, Hatchungnung chu Pathen ahi! Aman thudih le thutah chu ahenai, chule Israel chaten jong nahet uva pha ahi. Keihon maicham kasemmu hi Pakai doumah nadia kabollu ahipoi. Kathilbol uhi doumah lam ahitah a Pakai dinga tahsan suhbeina ahidingleh keihohi tunin eighing hoida jenguvin,
en_web: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against the LORD (don’t save us today),
en_kjv: The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,)

tcz: Ahin maicham khat kasemdoh jeh uva Pakai nungjuija konna kihei mang’na ahi mongding leh ahilouva keihon hiche maicham chunga hi pumgo thil hihenlang lhosoh thilto hijongleh chamna thilto hijongle kato’uva ahivangleh Pakaiyin kachunguva gotna eipe jeng uhen.
en_web: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let the LORD himself require it.
en_kjv: that we have built us an altar to turn from following the Lord; or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the Lord himself require it;
