en_web: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,
en_kjv: But to the king of Judah which sent you to inquire of the Lord, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

tcz: Nangma nalungkham’in , nang le nang nakisunem lhehjingin, nangin hiche khopi le amite douna kasei hiche gamhi sapsetna aching ding chule ahomkeo hung hiding ahi, kitichu najah phat’in lungkham tah in napon nabottel jengin chuleh kisih tah in nakap jah jengin ahi. Hijehchun keiman tahbeh in nataona chu kajatai tin Pakaiyin aseije,” ati.
en_web: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says the LORD.
en_kjv: because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the Lord.

tcz: “Hijeh chun keiman kateppeh hamsetna chu nangma nathi’a lungmong’a nakivui kahsen hinchuhsah taponge. Keiman hiche khopi chunga kachuhsah ding suhgimna chu nangin namutah louding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun amanu kona thupeh chu lengpa kom’ah ale pohlut peh tauvin ahi.
en_web: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.
en_kjv: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

tcz: Hijou chun lengpan Judah leh Jerusalem a lamkaiho jouse akoukhom’in,
en_web: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuin lengpa chun Judah le Jerusalem a mipiho jouse toh thempu holeh themgao hotoh mipi aneopen leh alenpen geijin Pakai houin’ah akilhon khompi in, hichea chun Pakai houin na kimu Pakai toh kitepna lekhabu chu lengpan mipi holah’a abonchan asimphong in ahi.
en_web: The king went up to the LORD’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.

tcz: Lengpa chu thuneina mun khompi panga chun adingin Pakai ang’ah chun kitepna chu panthah lah na aneipi in ahi. Aman mipi ho jouse koma chun, Pakai dan thupeh jouse, chondan ho jouse chu chu alungthim pumpiuva anitsohkei dingin ngehna aneiyin ahi. Hitihin aman lekha jolla kijih Pakai toh kitepna chu asudet’in ahi, chuleh mipi hojong chu ama cheh Pakai ang’a kitepna aneiyun ahi.
en_web: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.
en_kjv: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

tcz: Chuin lengpan Hilkiah thempulen chule amasanga neojo thempuho chutoh chuleh Houin kotngah hochu Baal houna leh Asherah leh vanlaijol thuneiho houna thilho jouse chu Pakai houin akona alahdoh dingun thu apen ahi. Lengpan hicheho jouse chu Jerusalem polanga Kidron phaicham munnah meiyin ana go-lhah sah tan ahi, avam hochu Bethel lang’a apo mangun ahi.
en_web: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of the LORD’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
en_kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order; and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burnt them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

tcz: Tumasang’a Judah lenghon ana pansah’u doi houna kimangcha thempu hochu aman ana sumang gamtan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Judah gamsung jouse ah, pathen neilouho doiphung ang’a kilhaina ana bolji jiu ahi. Amahon Baal, nisa le lha, ahsi hole van thuneina hojouse ang’a kilhaina anabol ji jiu ahi.
en_web: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.
en_kjv: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burnt incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

tcz: Hichun lengpan, Asherah kihouna doikhum jong Pathen Houin’a konin aladoh in Jerusalem pamlam Kidron phaicham’ah ahallha gam in ahi. Aman doikhom hochu agoibong in vut ason mipi kivuina lhan chunga athe thang tan ahi.
en_web: He brought out the Asherah from the LORD’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.
en_kjv: And he brought out the grove from the house of the Lord, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burnt it at the brook Kidron, and stampt it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

tcz: Aman pasal kijoh hole numei kijoh ho achennao mun jouse chu aphelhan, Pakai houin sunga akijohnao doiphung jong asuhset pehin. Hichea numei hon Asherah ahounao ponlukhuh ding akhon nao ahi.
en_web: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
en_kjv: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

tcz: Josiah in, Judah khopi dang danga cheng thempu hojouse chu Jerusalem’ah ahin polut’in ahi. Aman Geba le Beershaba kikah a um Pathen neilouho doiphung kilhaina gantha abolnao munchu asuhbohpeh in ahi. Aman Jerusalem a gamvaipo Joshua kelkot’a hunglutna munna kithoina doiphung jong ana sumangin ahi. Hiche kelkot hi khopi igahlutna a kelkot veilanga um’ah ahi.
en_web: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
en_kjv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burnt incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

tcz: Hiche Pathen neilouho doiphunga thempu ana pang hochu Jerusalem a Pakai maicham a na atohdiu ana phal pon ahi, amavang thempu dang hotoh cholsolou changlhah anehdiu vang aphal in ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to the LORD’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
en_kjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

tcz: Chujou chun lengpan Ben-hinnom phaicham a um Topheth maicham jong chu ana suboh peh in ahi. Hijehchun hilai munna hin koiman Molech anga katding’a achapa hileh achanu hileh meiya govam dia kilhaina abolsah tapouvin ahi.
en_web: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
en_kjv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

tcz: Aman sakol lim kisemthu Judah leng masa hon nisa houna a ana tundoh’u jong chu Pakai houin na konin ana ladoh in ahi. Hicheho chu Nathan-melech kiti nukiso thu kitanna a pipui khat in hotoh kinaija uma ahi. Lengpan sakol kangtalai nisa houna a anakatdoh jiu jong chu ana hal-lha tan ahi.
en_web: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of the LORD’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
en_kjv: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burnt the chariots of the sun with fire.

tcz: Leng inpia Ahaz indan chungnung chungvuma inchung’a Judahte leng danghon ana sem’u maicham phungho chu, Josiah in ana suchip in ana subeiyin ahi. Chuleh Pakai houin hongcha teni a Manasseh in anasem maicham jong chu lengpan ana sumang in ahi. Aman ahel hellin ana vochip in, ahel hochu Kidron phaicham’a ana the jallin ahi.
en_web: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.
en_kjv: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

tcz: Solomon lengpan kidah umtah semthu doiho houna dinga Jerusalem solang chuleh Olive mol lhang langa maicham ana tundoh hochu Josiah in asuhboh peh in ahi. Solomon in ana semdoh doi hochu, Ashtoreth kiti kidah umtah Sidon mite numei pathen, Chemosh kiti kidah umtah Moab te pathen chuleh Molech kiti Ammon mite pathen ahiuve.
en_web: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
en_kjv: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

tcz: Josiah in doikhom jouse ana volhun, chuleh Asherah ahounau doiphung jong ana phuhlhun, hijouchun hiche munho a chun mihem gule chang ho chu ana thekhum’in, asuhboh peh sohkei jin ahi.
en_web: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.
en_kjv: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

tcz: Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna Bethel’a semthu pathen houna chu ana jep lhun ahi. Aman adoiphung’u chu ana halvam in chuleh Asherah doikhum jong ana hal-lhai.
en_web: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
en_kjv: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burnt the high place, and stampt it small to powder, and burnt the grove.

tcz: Hijou chun Josiah ahung kiheiyin ahileh mol lhang lang panga lhanmol tamtah hochu ahin mudoh in ahileh aman aguhou chu ahin chomdoh uva Bethel doiphung ho chu suhbohna dingin achung'uva guho chu ahal lhahsah in ahi. (Hiche thil sohhi Jeroboam chu kut nikhoa maicham panga ana din phat’a hiche thilsoh ding hi Pakai jin Pathen mipa ana phondohsah ahi). Chuin Josiah agah dadohleh Pathen mipa lhan chu agah mun, amachu hiche thilsoh ding ana phongdoh pachu ahi.
en_web: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the LORD’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
en_kjv: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burnt them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

tcz: “Hiche lhankhu koija ham?” tia Josiah in adohleh, mipihochun, “Hiche lhan hi Judah a kona hung Pathen mipa tunia Bethel’a nahintoh dingho ana seidohpa lhan chu ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”
en_kjv: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

tcz: Hichun Josiah in adonbut in, “Hichu limsah hih un, agu jong suboi hih un,” ati. Hijehchun amahon ama guchu ahal tapouve, hitobang machun Samaria kon themgaopa a jong asuloh pouvin ahi.
en_web: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.
en_kjv: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Joshia in Bethel’a abol bang bangin Samaria’a jong ana bollin, khopiho sunga pathen neilouho doiphung hole ainhou aban vohset peh in ahi. Hiche hochu Israel leng tamtah'in ana tundoh uva Pakai ana lunghan sah’u anahi.
en_web: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
en_kjv: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

tcz: Hichun Josiah lengpa, pathen neilouho doi houna a thempu a pangho jouse chu amaicham chung tah uva athat’in mihem guhochu amaicham chunguva ahallin hiti chun ana suhboh peh in jouvin Jerusalemma ahung kile tai.
en_web: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burnt men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuin Josiah lengpan mijouse het dingin thupeh khat aphongdoh in, “Pakai toh kitepna lekhabu dung juiyin nanghon Pakai na Pathen’u kom’a kalchuh kut namantei teidiu ahi,” ati.
en_web: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”
en_kjv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

tcz: Israelten thutan vaihom ho khanglai apat’a Israel lengte khanglai le Judah lengte khanglai geija jong hitobang kalchuh kut hi ana kimang kha talou ahitai.
en_web: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
en_kjv: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

tcz: Josiah leng chan kal kum somle kumget alhin kum a bou hiche kalchuh kut hi Jerusalem khopia hung kimang pan kit bep ahi.
en_web: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: but in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the Lord in Jerusalem.

tcz: Josiah in gaochang miho jong asumang in, mitpheldoi them ho jong asubeijin, indoile milim doi kisem tapou chu Judah gamsung le Jerusalem’a amudoh thet umtah thil tapou chu asubei jingin, Pakai houin sunga Hilkiah thempupan ahin mudoh lekhajol sunga kisun Pakai thusei jouse chu atohdoh thei tei nadin aboltan ahi.
en_web: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.

tcz: Josiah masang in ama tobang leng alungthim pumpi le ahinkholhum keija chule athanei na jousea Pakai jinga kingaija Mose danthua kisei ho aboncha jui sohkei koima ana umpon, ama nungin jong koima dang ahung umkit tapon ahi.
en_web: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.
en_kjv: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

tcz: Ahijingvangin Pakai chu Judah chungah ana lunghang lheh jengin ahi. Ajeh chu Manasseh in thilphalou tamtah ana tohdoh a Pathen ana choudoh ahi.
en_web: Notwithstanding, the LORD didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin hitin anaseije, “Keiman Israel katolmang banga Judah jong katolmang soh ding ahitai. Chule Keiman kalhendoh Jerusalem khopi leh ahouin a kamin kija dinga kana lhendoh jonghi kapaidoh ding ahitai.,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”
en_kjv: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

tcz: Josiah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse le anatoh jouse hi Judah lengte thusimbu kijihlutna lekhabua aumsoh keijin ahi.
en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
en_kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Josiah leng chanlaijin Egypt lengpa Neco chun Assyria lengpa kithopi dingin Euphrates vadung lang ana jontan ahi. Josiah in asepai ho akipuijin aga kisatpin ahi. Ahinla Neco in Megiddo muna akimaitopin ahileh Josiah lengpa chu amahon athattan ahi.
en_web: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.
en_kjv: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

tcz: Josiah noija sepai lamkai hon atahsa chu sakol kangtalai’ah Megiddo a konin Jerusalem’ah ahin polut’un ama lhankhuh achun anavui tauvin ahi. Hijouchun agamsung mipiten Josiah chapa Jehoahaz chu amakhel in leng achansah tauvin ahi.
en_web: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
en_kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

tcz: Jehoahaz chu leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni thum ana lhingtan ahi. Chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah lha thum leng ana changing ahi. Anuchu Libnah khopi akona Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
en_web: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
en_kjv: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

tcz: Amahin apu apateu chonna bang bangin Pathen deilou jeng ana bollin ahi.
en_web: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
en_kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

tcz: Pharaoh Neco in Johoahaz chu Jerusalem’a avaihoplou nading in Hamath gam’ah Riblah mun’ah songkulla aheng in ahi. Chule aman Judah ten dangka pound sang sagi le ja nga chuleh sana pound som sagi le nga kai apeh dingin ana ngeh in ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh Neco in Josiah chate lah’a khat Eliakim kitipa chu apa khellin leng chang ding in atung in a, amin jong akhel peh in, Jehoiakim asah tan ahi. Ahin Jehoahaz vang chu Egypt gam'a soh chang dingin apuijin hikom’a chun ahung thiden tan ahi.
en_web: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.
en_kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

tcz: Pharaoh Neco kom’a kai apeh jouna dingun Jehoiakm in Judah mipite lah’a konin sana le dangka ama ama neile neilou dungjuijin adongin ahi.
en_web: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.
en_kjv: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

tcz: Jehoiakim chu leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le nga ana lhingtan ahi. Jerusalema chun kum som le khat sung vai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Rumah khopi akon Pedaiah chanu Zebidah ahi.
en_web: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
en_kjv: Jehoiakim was twenty and five year old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

tcz: Ama jong hin apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin ahi.
en_web: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
en_kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

tcz: Jehoiakim vaihom laijin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in Judah gam’ah gal ahin sattan ahileh, Jehoiakim in kisatpi louvin amale agamsung jouse chu Nebuchadnezzer khut’ah ana kipelut tan ahi. Aman kum thum sungin kai anapen, chuche jouvin akiphintan ahi.
en_web: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
en_kjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Babylon mite, Syria mite, Moab mite, Ammon mite ahin tildoh in Pakaiyin themgao ho kam’a ana phondoh sahbang bangin aguilhung tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.
en_kjv: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

tcz: Hitobang hamsetna Judah gam’ah ahunglhun hi Pakai thupeh akon ahi. Aman amitmu’a kona Judahte atolmang kigutna ajeh hi Manasseh in thilse tamtah ana boldoh jeh ahi.
en_web: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,
en_kjv: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

tcz: Chule Jerusalem a themmona neilou thisan anaso’a ana hesosah jeh ahi, Pakaiyin hichu a ngaidam lou ahi.
en_web: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.
en_kjv: and also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.

tcz: Jehoiakim vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse jong Judahte lengho thusim kijihna lekhabua aumin ahi.
en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
en_kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Jehoiakim chu athi phat’in, achapa Jehoiachin lengin ahung pangtan ahi.
en_web: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
en_kjv: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

tcz: Egypt lengpan hichejou apat hin ahung galkondoh jou tapon ahi, ajeh chu Babylon lengpan Egypt in kagam ahi tia ahopsah chengse chu Babylon lengpan abonna alahpeh soh ahitai. Aman ana kilah lut gam hochu Egypt vadunga apat Euphrates vadung chan-gei ahi.
en_web: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

tcz: Jehoiachin chu alengchan kum chun ama kum somle kum get alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem chu lha thum bou lengvai anapon ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem makon Elnathan chanu Nehushta ahi.
en_web: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

tcz: Jehoiachin in apa bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol in ahi.
en_web: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.
en_kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.

tcz: Jehoiachin vaihom sungin, Nebuchadnezzer in Babylon akonin anoija sepai pipui ho ahinsollin Jerusalem ahung umkhum tauvin ahi.
en_web: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
en_kjv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

tcz: Hichun Nebuchadnezzer amatah jong hiche khopi aum sungu hin ahung lhungtan ahi.
en_web: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,
en_kjv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

tcz: Hichun Jehoiachin lengpan lengnu toh ama thumop hotoh, asepai lamkaiho le pipuho Babylonte khut’ah akipelut tauvin ahi. Nebuchadnezzer lengvai ahom kum som le kum get alhin in, Jehoiachin chu aman’in soh chang dingin ana kai tauvin ahi.
en_web: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.
en_kjv: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

tcz: Pakaiyin ana phondohsa bangin Nebuchadnezzer in Pakai houin akonin chuleh leng inpia konin sumle pai, sana dangka, neile gou ho jouse le, sana akisem thil-ho jouse, Solomon’in houin a ana koiho abonchan achom theng hel tan ahi.
en_web: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.
en_kjv: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.

tcz: Hiti chun Nebuchadnezzer in Jerusalem khopi sung’a cheng jouse, asepai lamkai ho jouse le sepai galsat themho jouse, khut thepna neiho le thilsem themho abonchan mihem sangsom tobang Babylon gamlang’a akaijin ahi.
en_web: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.
en_kjv: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

tcz: Nebuchadnezzer in Jehoiachin lengpa, lengnu anu, ajite ho chule apipui ho jaonan Babylon gam'a akaimang tan ahi
en_web: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
en_kjv: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

tcz: Chuleh aman sepai ahangsan cheh sang sagi leh khut thepna neiho abon’un mihat galsat thei cheh sangkhat ho chu gam chom’ah asoldoh tan ahi.
en_web: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
en_kjv: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

tcz: Hichun Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa’ngah pa Mattaniah chu leng in atung in, chule amin jong akhellin, Zedakiah asahtai.
en_web: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
en_kjv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

tcz: Zedekiah leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le khat ana lhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle khat sungin lengvai ana pon ahi. Anu chu Libnah akon Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
en_web: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
en_kjv: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

tcz: Ahinlah Zedekiah in Jehoiakim bol bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol’in ahi.
en_web: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
en_kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

tcz: Jerusalem leh Judah chung’ah thilsoh ho achuhna jeh hi, Pakai lunghan jeh ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, ama angsunga kona apaidoh a, hitia hi gamchom’a sohchang gam’ah ahi tauve. Zedekiah hin Babylon lengpa a konin kiphinna anei tan ahi.
en_web: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
en_kjv: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

tcz: Hiti chun Zedekiah lengvai ahom kal kum ko alhin kum, lha som na, chuche lha, nisom lhin nin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in asepai jouse ahin puijin Jerusalem khopi chu ahin bulutan ahi. Amahon khopi chu aum’uvin pal akai khum tauvin ahi.
en_web: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

tcz: Zekediah lengpa lengvai ahom kal kum somle khat alhin in, Jerusalem chu galmi ten aumkhum tan ahi.
en_web: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
en_kjv: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

tcz: Lha li lhinna, niko lhin nin khopi sunga neh ding akilhasam tan, kel ahahsa behseh tan, anneh twidon ding akinehchai gam tauvin kel athohpan tauvin ahi.
en_web: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
en_kjv: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

tcz: Hijou chun khopi pal chu themkhat avutbang’un, chule sepai ho jouse chu ajam gam tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu khopi chu Babylon ten aumkhum chahkheh chule jankhovah hella achanlhih jeng vangun, pal le pal kikah a lengpa honleiya chun ajamdoh tauve. Amaho chu Arabah lang jonin ache tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.
en_kjv: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

tcz: Ahinlah Babylon sepaihon lengpa chu adellun Jericho phaicham’a chun aman tauve, ajeh chu asepaiten adalhah uva kithecheh gam'a ahitauve.
en_web: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
en_kjv: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

tcz: Amahon Riblah kho muna Babylon lengpa kom alhut tauvin, hilai munah chun Zedekiah lengpa chu achungthu atan tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.
en_kjv: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

tcz: Amahon achateu atha peh uchu avetsah’un ahi. Hijou chun amit akaldoh peh’un sum-eng khaoguija akan un Babylon lang’ah akai tauvin ahi.
en_web: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
en_kjv: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

tcz: Nebuchadnezzer lengpa lengchan kal kum somle ko lhin kum, lha nga lhin na, chuche lha, ni sagi lhin nin, Babylon lengpa sepai pipui chuleh leng vesui lah’a lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem ahung lhung atan ahi.
en_web: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

tcz: Hichun aman Pakai houin, leng inpi chuleh Jerusalem a in jouse ahal lhan chuleh khopi sunga insang aphadom jouse jong asuse gam tan ahi.
en_web: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.
en_kjv: and he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.

tcz: Chujongle aman Babylon sepai hojouse chu Jerusalem pal ho avohlhuh sah in, ajet avaija umjouse jong asuhset sah sohkeijin ahi.
en_web: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

tcz: Babylon lengpa tahsa vesuija pang ho lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, Jerusalem khopi sunga ana kidalha mipi amoh chengse, Babylon lengpa lang’a ana pang chengse chutoh mipi ahon jamah amoh chengse chu sohchang dingin ahin toldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.
en_kjv: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

tcz: Hichea hin Sepai lamkaipa hin mipi holah’a avaichapen hochu lengpilei leh lou lhou dingin adalhan ahi.
en_web: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
en_kjv: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

tcz: Pakai houin maiya sum-eng khom kiphut holeh Pakai houin sunga sumeng twikonglen atunna sum-enga kisem chengse jong chu Babylon sepaiten avo chipdellun, sum-eng chengse chu Babylon lamah akipoh atove.
en_web: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.
en_kjv: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

tcz: Chujongle Babylon mite chun bel jouseu le tupheng jouse jong, chaiche ho ahin gim namtui hal namna lhengho ahin, houin kin bolna dinga kisem sum-enga kibol umle bel lhengle kong abonchan akipoh mang tauve.
en_web: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
en_kjv: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

tcz: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun gim namtui kihalna le kong ho chule sana le dangka thengsel'a kisem thildang dang ho jouse jong akilah gam’in ahi.
en_web: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.
en_kjv: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

tcz: Sum-eng’a kisem khompi teni, twikonglen, akhom atunna tenia kimang umle bel, lheng le konga kimang sumeng chengse chu agihdan anasa behseh jengin tejou hilou ahi. Hiche thilkeo hose se hi Solomon lengpan Pakai houin na pang dinga anasem ho chu ahi.
en_web: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.
en_kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

tcz: Khomkhat chu asandan tong som le tong get alhingin, aluvumma chu alutomding sum-enga kisem asandan tong thum cheh a lhingin,chule khut them lah a kijempah a kolbuthei pahcha jem banga aluvum kimvella kisem sohkei ahi.
en_web: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.
en_kjv: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

tcz: Nebuzaradan sepai lamkaipa chun thempulen Seraiah le thempu ni lhinna Zephaniah kitipa chutoh kelkot ngah apangji mithum chutoh sohchang dingin akai mangin ahi.
en_web: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;
en_kjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

tcz: Chujongleh khopi sunga akisel nalai mipi holah a konin, Judah te dia gal lamkaipa leh lengpa thumop a pang mi nga, sepaite gamsungmi simtohle apang alamkai pauvin lekhasun’a amanpa leh khopi sunga kimandoh mi somgup chutoh anakai mangthan ahi.
en_web: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.
en_kjv: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

tcz: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, amaho jouse chu Riblah khomun ah Babylon lengpa henga ahinkai luttan ahi..
en_web: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
en_kjv: and Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

tcz: Riblah kho Hamath gamsunga chun Babylon lengpan abonchauvin adengin athat sohtai. Chuin Judah mite chu agamsung uva konin sohchang din aki kaimang sohtauvin ahi.
en_web: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
en_kjv: and the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

tcz: Hijou chun Nebuchadnezzer lengpan Shaphan tupa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu Judah gam’ah hung kidalha mipiho chunga gamvaipo dingin ana pansah in ahi.
en_web: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.
en_kjv: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

tcz: Babylon lengpa Nebucahdnezzar in Gedaliah kitipa hi gamvaipon apansah taiti Judah mi sepai holeh apipui houvin ajah phat’un, amahon Gedaliah chu Mizpah a akimupi din ana cheuvin ahi. Amahochu Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kereah chapa Johanan, Netophath khomi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maacath khomi chapa Jezaniah chule akho midang jouse ahiuve.
en_web: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
en_kjv: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

tcz: Hichun Gedaliah chu amaho kom’achun akihahsel’in hitin aseije, “Ima kichatna le tijatna nei hih hellun, gamsunga chun lungmong in cheng un, chule Babylon lengpa thuhi ngaiyun, chutile nangho dinga imajouse phajeng ding ahi,” tin alungmon sah’un ahi.
en_web: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”
en_kjv: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

tcz: Ahivangin hiche kumma lhasagi lhin phat’in leng insunga peng mi, Elishama tupa Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu sepai somkhat toh ahung konin Mizpah khoa hin Gedaliah leh Judah mite toh Babylon mite umkhom apanpi chengse chu ahung delkhum mun athat tauve.
en_web: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.
en_kjv: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Judah ho aneovapat alenpen geijin chujongleh asepai lamkaiho geijin kichatah’in Egypt lang’ah ajam gam tauvin ahi, ajeh chu Babylon miten i-ahinlo diu ham tichu kicha a ahiuve.
en_web: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
en_kjv: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

tcz: Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchanna kum somthum le sagi alhin’in, Hiche kum chuche lha, nisom ni le ni sagi lhin nin Evil-merodach chun Babylon lengmun ahinlo tan ahile, Jehoiachin chu akhoto in songkulla konin alhadoh tan ahi.
en_web: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

tcz: Amahin Jehoiachin chu ngailutna neitah’in akihoupi in, Babylon’a leng dang kihen ho sangin mun sang apen jana ana pen ahi.
en_web: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
en_kjv: and he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

tcz: Aman Jehoiachin chu songkul von khel chun vonthah anapen chuleh ahinkho lhung keija lengpatoh anneh khom dingin phalna anapen ahi.
en_web: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;
en_kjv: and changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

tcz: Hiti chun Babylon lengpan ahinkho lhumkeiya niseh’a aneh ding an agontoh peh in, ama neh ding chan khat akisem jing jeng tan ahi.
en_web: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
en_kjv: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

tcz: Adam son le achilhahho Seth, Enosh;
en_web: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
en_kjv: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

tcz: Kenan, Mahalaleh, Jareh,
en_web: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
en_kjv: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

tcz: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
en_web: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
en_kjv: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

tcz: Chule Noah, Noah chate ho * Shem, Ham chule Japheth.
en_web: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
en_kjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

tcz: Japheth chilhahho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, chule Tira ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
en_kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

tcz: Gomer son achilhahho chu Ashkenaz, riphath * chule Togarmah ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

tcz: Javan son achihlhahho chu Elishah, Tarshish, kikttim chule Rodanim ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
en_kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

tcz: Ham chapate chu Cush, Mizraim, *Put chule Canaan ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
en_kjv: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

tcz: Cush son achilhahho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

tcz: Cush jong hin Nimros ahingin, Nimros hi leiset chunga galhang masapen in ahung pang tai.
en_web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
en_kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

tcz: Mizraim hin Ludim toh, Anamim toh, Lehabim toh, Naphtuhim toh,
en_web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
en_kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

tcz: Pathrusim toh, Casluhim toh, Caphtorim toh ahingin, amaho’a konna hi Philistine ho hung kondoh ahiuve.
en_web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
en_kjv: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

tcz: Canaan chapa masapen/tahpen chu Sidan ahin, Sidon chu Sidon mite ahung pen nau bulpi ahung hitai. Chujouvin Canaan in Heth kitipa chu ahinge.
en_web: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
en_kjv: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

tcz: Jebus mite, Amor mite, girgash mite,
en_web: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
en_kjv: the Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

tcz: Hivi mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
en_web: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
en_kjv: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

tcz: Arvad mite, Zemar mite, chule Hamath mite jong ahiuve.
en_web: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
en_kjv: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

tcz: Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Aphaxad, Lud, chule Ram ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
en_kjv: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

tcz: Arphaxad kitipa hin Shelah ahingin, Shelah kitipa hin Eber ahinge.
en_web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
en_kjv: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

tcz: Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, chapa masapa chu amin Peleg akiti ( hichu kikhentel tina ahi ); ijeh-enem itileh ama khang laiya leiset mite chu pao le ham chom chom’a kikhentel anahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
en_web: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
en_kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

tcz: Joktan hin Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
en_web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
en_kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

tcz: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
en_web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
en_kjv: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

tcz: Obal,*Abhimael, Sheba,
en_web: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
en_kjv: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

tcz: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahingin ahi. Mi hichengse hi abonchauva Joktan son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
en_kjv: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

tcz: Shem son achilhah : Arphaxad, Shelah, *
en_web: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
en_kjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

tcz: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
en_web: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
en_kjv: Eber, Peleg, Rehu,

tcz: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
en_web: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
en_kjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

tcz: Chule Abram, ama hi khonunga Abraham kitipa chu ahi.
en_web: Abram (also called Abraham).
en_kjv: Abram; the same is Abraham.

tcz: Abraham chapa teni chu Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
en_kjv: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

tcz: Akhanggui kisim dan’u chu hiti hi ahiye : Ishmael chapate chu Nebaioth ( apeng masapen ), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
en_web: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
en_kjv: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

tcz: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
en_web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
en_kjv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

tcz: Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuve.
en_web: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
en_kjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

tcz: Abraham thaikemnu Keturah chapate chu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahiuvin ahi. Jokshan chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
en_kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

tcz: Midian chapate chu Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, chule Eldaah ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Abraham thaikemnu Keturah son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

tcz: Abraham hin Isaac anahingin ahi. Isaac chapate ni chu Esau le Israel* ahilhone.
en_web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
en_kjv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

tcz: Esau chapate chu Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
en_kjv: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

tcz: Eliphaz chapate chu Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz chule Amalek ahiuve. Amalek hi Timna sung peng ahi.
en_web: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
en_kjv: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

tcz: Reuel son achilhaho chu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, chule Mizzah ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
en_kjv: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

tcz: Seir son achilhahho chu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Nah, Dishon, Ezer, chule Dishan ahiuve
en_web: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

tcz: Lotan chapate ni chu Hori le Heman ahilhonin, chule Lotan sopinu min chu Timna akiti.
en_web: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
en_kjv: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

tcz: Shobal son achilhahho chu Alvan, *Manahath, Ebal, Shepho,* chule Onam ahiuve. Zibeon chapate ni chu Ariah le Anah ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
en_kjv: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

tcz: Anah chapa chu Dishon ahin; Dishon chapate chu Hemdan, * Eshban, Ithran, chule Keran ahiuve.
en_web: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
en_kjv: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

tcz: Ezer chapate chu Bilhan, Zaavan, chule Akan * ahiuve. Dishan chapate ni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
en_kjv: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

tcz: Israelte chunga mi koima lengvaipoa pang anaum masanga Edom gamsunga lengvaipoa anapang miho chu leng hichengse hi ahiuve.* Boer chapa Bela ahin, a lengvaipohna khopi min chu Dinhabah akiti.
en_web: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
en_kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

tcz: Bela athi phat in ama khel’in Bozrah kho’a mi Zerah chapa Jobab chun lengvai anapon ahi.
en_web: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

tcz: Jobab athi kit phat chun ama khel’in Teman mite gamsunga mi Husham kitipa chun lengvai anapon ahi
en_web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

tcz: Husham athi phat’in ama khel’in Moab gamsunga midan sepaite kisatpia jou lengpa Bedad chapa Hadad chun akhopi min Avith kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi.
en_web: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
en_kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

tcz: Hadad athi kit phat chun Masrekah khoa mi Samlah chun ama khel’in lengvai apotai.
en_web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

tcz: Samlah athi phat’in ama khel’in luipi dunga cheng Rehoboth khoa mi Shaul kitipa chun lengvai apotan ahi.
en_web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

tcz: Shaul thi nungin ama khel’in Acbor chapa Baal-hanan kitipa chun lengvai apon ahi.
en_web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

tcz: Baal-hanan athi kit phat’in ama khel’in Hadad chun akhopi min Pau kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi. Ajinu min chu Mehetabel ahin, Matred chanu chule Me-zahab tunu anahi.
en_web: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
en_kjv: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

tcz: Hadad jong athi kit tai. Edom gam'a ahung lamkai/haosa ho chu Timna, Alvah,* Jetheth,
en_web: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
en_kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

tcz: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
en_web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
en_kjv: duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

tcz: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
en_web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
en_kjv: duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

tcz: Magdiel, chule Iram ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Edom gam'a phung lamkai ( Haosa ) jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
en_kjv: duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

tcz: Israel chapate chu Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
en_web: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
en_kjv: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

tcz: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve.
en_web: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
en_kjv: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

tcz: Judah chun Canaan numei nu Bathshua kitinu akon in chapa thum ahingin ahi. Amaho min chu Er, Onan, chule Shelah ahiuve. Achapa apeng masapa Er kitipa hi Pakai mitmun agilou behseh jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong amapa chu athat tai.
en_web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
en_kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

tcz: Judah hin amounu meithainu Tamar chu tohjong chapa pengkop ni Perez le Zerah chu ahing kit’in, hijeh chun Judah hin chapa nga jen aneiyin ahi.
en_web: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
en_kjv: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

tcz: Perez chapate ni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
en_kjv: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

tcz: Zerah chapate chu Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, chule Darda ahiuvin mi nga jeng alhing uve.
en_web: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
en_kjv: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

tcz: Carmi ( Zimri son achilhah ) chapa chu Achar ahin, amahin suhmang dinga kikoisa thet ho chunga Israelte anabol gim lheh jengin ahi.
en_web: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
en_kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

tcz: Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi.
en_web: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

tcz: Hezron chapate chu Jerahmeel, Ram, chule Caleb* ahiuve.
en_web: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
en_kjv: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

tcz: Ram hin Amminadab ahingin, chule Amminadab hin Judahte leng chapa Nahshon ahingin ahi.
en_web: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
en_kjv: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

tcz: Nahshon hin Salmon ahingin, Salmon hin Boaz ahingin,
en_web: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
en_kjv: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

tcz: Boaz chun Obed ahingin, Obed in Jesse ahinge.
en_web: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
en_kjv: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

tcz: Jesse chapa apeng masapaen chu Eliab ahin, anina pa Abinadab ahin, athum lhinna pa Shimea ahin,
en_web: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
en_kjv: and Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

tcz: Ali lhin na pachu Nethanel ahin, Raddai chu nga lhinna ahi.
en_web: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
en_kjv: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

tcz: Ozem chu achapa gup lhinna ahin, chule asagi lhinna chu David ahitai.
en_web: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;
en_kjv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

tcz: Amaho hin sopi numei ni aneiyun amin lhon jong Zeruiah leh Abigail ahilhone. Zeruiah hin chapa thum ahingin, Abishai, Joab, chule Asahel ahiuve.
en_web: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
en_kjv: whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

tcz: Abigail hin Ishmael mi Jether kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
en_web: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
en_kjv: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

tcz: Hezron chapa Caleb jong hin ajinu Azubah kitinu Jerioth khoa minu chu toh chapa phabep ahing lhonin ahi. Amanu chapate chu Jesher, Shobab, chule Ardon ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
en_kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

tcz: Azubah hi athi nungin Caleb in Ephrathah akichenpi’in, chule chapa khat Hur kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
en_web: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
en_kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

tcz: Hur hin Uri ahingin, Uri in Bezalel ahinge.
en_web: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
en_kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

tcz: Hezron hin akum kum som gup jen alhin nungin, Gilead sopinu Makir chanu chu akichenpin ahileh, chapa khat amin Segub kitipa chu ahing lhonnin ahi.
en_web: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
en_kjv: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

tcz: Segub hin Gilead gamsunga khopi somni le thum jen semdoh’a chule lengvaipoa pang Jair kitipa chu ahingin ahi.
en_web: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
en_kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

tcz: Ahin Geshur le Ram chun Jair ngahmun khopi toh Kenath khopi toh chule akhobah chengse kholen cheh somgup jen alah tha lhon tai. Mi hichengse hi Gilead hingpa Makir son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
en_kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

tcz: Hezron chu Caleb-Ephrathah ngahmun khopia athi nungin ajinu Abijah chun chapa khat Tekoa hingpa Ashhur kitipa chu ahinpeh-in ahi.
en_web: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
en_kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

tcz: Hezron chapa apeng masapen Jerahmeel chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, Bunah ahin, Oren ahin, Ozem ahin, chule Ahijah ahiuve
en_web: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

tcz: Jerahmeel kitipa hin ji chom khat jong aneiyin, amin chu Atarah akiti. Amanu hin Onam chu anahinge.
en_web: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
en_kjv: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

tcz: Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu Maaz, Jamin, chule Eker ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

tcz: Onam chapate ni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonnin, chule Shammai chapate ni chu Nadab le Abishur ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
en_kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

tcz: Abishur le ajinu Abihail chapate ni chu Abhan leh Molid ahilhone.
en_web: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
en_kjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

tcz: Nadab chapate ni chu Seled le Appaim ahilhone. Seled chu cha nei louvin athitan,
en_web: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
en_kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

tcz: Ahin Appaim hin chapa khat amin Ishi kitipa chu aneiyin ahi. Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahin, chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi.
en_web: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
en_kjv: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

tcz: Shammai sopipa Jada chapate ni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Jether hi cha nei louvin athitan,
en_web: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

tcz: Hinlah Jonathan hin vang chapa ni Peleth le Zaza ahinge. Mihem hijat hi Jerahmeel son achilhah ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

tcz: Sheshan in chapate aneipon, ahin chanu tampi ahinge Sheshan hin Egypt mi pasal khat soh aneiyin, amin jong Jarha akiti.
en_web: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
en_kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

tcz: Sheshan in hiche asohpa Jarha kitipa hi achanu khat toh akichensah in ahileh achanun amapa chu toh chapa khat amin Attai kitipa chu ahing lhone.
en_web: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
en_kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

tcz: Attai hin Nathan ahingin, Nathan in Zabad ahinge.
en_web: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
en_kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

tcz: Zabad hin Ephlal ahingin, Ephlal chun Obed ahingin ahi.
en_web: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
en_kjv: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

tcz: Obed hin Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu hin Azariah ahinge.
en_web: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
en_kjv: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

tcz: Helez hingpa chu Azariah ahin, chule Eleasah hingpa chu Helez ahi.
en_web: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
en_kjv: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

tcz: Sismai hingpa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Shallum hingpa chu Sismai ahi.
en_web: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
en_kjv: and Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

tcz: Jekamiah hingpa chu Shallum ahin, chule Elishama hingpa chu Jekamiah ahi.
en_web: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
en_kjv: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

tcz: Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate lah’a apeng masapen Mesha chun Ziph ahingin, chule Mareshah hin Hebron ahinge.
en_web: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
en_kjv: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

tcz: Hebron chapate chu Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, chule Shema ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
en_kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

tcz: Shema hin Raham ahingin, Raham hin Jorkeam ahinge. Chule Rekem hin Shammai anahingin ahi.
en_web: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
en_kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

tcz: Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin, chule Maon chun Beth Zur ahingin ahi.
en_web: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
en_kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

tcz: Caleb thaikemnu chun Haran, Moza, chule Gazez ahinge; chule hichea hin Haran hin Gazez chu ahingin ahi.
en_web: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
en_kjv: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

tcz: Jahdai chapate chu Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, chule Shaaph ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

tcz: Caleb thaikemnu achom khat Maachah kitinu jong chun Sheber le Tirhanah ahingin ahi.
en_web: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
en_kjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

tcz: Amanu ma ma hin jong Madmannah pa Shaaph chule Macbenah le Gibea pa Sheva anahingin ahi. Caleb hin jong chanu khat aneiyin amin Achsah akiti.
en_web: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
en_kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

tcz: Mihem hijat hi abonchauva Caleb son achilhah jeng ahiuve. Caleb jinu Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate chu Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal,
en_web: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
en_kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

tcz: Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-Gader pa Hareph ahiuve.
en_web: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
en_kjv: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

tcz: Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal son achilhahho chu Haroeh sung kon Manahath mi akeh khat jen toh,
en_web: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
en_kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

tcz: Chule Kiriath-Jearim insung mite Ithir miho ahiuvin, Puth miho ahiuvin, Sumath miho ahiuvin, chule Mishrai miho toh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Zorah miho le Eshtaol miho hung kondoh ahiuvin ahi.
