en_web: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
en_kjv: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

tcz: Salma chapate chu Bethlehem miho ahiuvin, Netophath miho ahiuvin , Atroth-Beth-Joab miho ahiuvin , adang miho chu Manahath miho leh Zor miho akeh khat jen jong ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
en_kjv: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

tcz: Chule Jabez khoa cheng danthu lekha sunna pang miho insung mite jong Tirath miho ahiuvin, Shimeath miho hi Recab insung penna Hammath kitipa sung peng ngen ahiuvin, Ken mi jeng ahiuve.
en_web: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
en_kjv: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

tcz: Hebron khopia achen laiya David in ahin achapate chu hicheng hi ahiuve: achapa apeng masapen chu Ammon ahin, apenna nu chu Ahinoam akitin Jezreel kho mi ahi. Achapa ni lhinna pachu Daniel ahin, Carmel kho numeinu Anogail toh ahinlhon ahi.
en_web: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
en_kjv: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

tcz: Athum lhinna pachu Absalom ahin, anu chu Maacah akitin, Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu ahi. Li lhinna pachu Adonijah ahin, anu chu Haggith ahi.
en_web: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
en_kjv: the third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

tcz: Nga lhinna pachu Shephatiah akitin, anu chu Abital ahi. Gup lhinna pachu Ithream ahin, David in ajinu Eglah toh ahinlhon ahiye.
en_web: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
en_kjv: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

tcz: Hebron khopia kum sagi le akeh khat sunga lengvaipoa anapan sungin David chun chapa gu hi anahingin ahi. Chujouvin kum som thumle kum thum sungin Jerusalem khopia lengvaipon anapangin ahi.
en_web: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
en_kjv: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

tcz: Jerusalem khopia achen laiya David in anahin achapate chu Shammua, Shobad, Nathan, chule Solomon ahiuve. Amaho penna nu chu Ammiel chanu Bathsheba ahi.
en_web: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
en_kjv: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

tcz: Chujouvin David in chapa ko ahinbe’in amaho chu Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
en_web: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
en_kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

tcz: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
en_web: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
en_kjv: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

tcz: Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
en_web: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
en_kjv: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

tcz: Athaikemho toh ahindoh ho tailouvin hichengse hi David chapate jeng ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei Tamar kitinu bouseh aneiyin ahi.
en_web: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
en_kjv: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

tcz: Solomon son achilhah ho chu Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
en_web: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
en_kjv: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

tcz: Jeroram, Ahaziah, Joash,
en_web: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
en_kjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

tcz: Amaziah,Uzziah, Jotham,
en_web: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
en_kjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

tcz: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,
en_web: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
en_kjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

tcz: Amon, chule Josiah ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
en_kjv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

tcz: Josiah chapate chu apeng nasapen pa Johanan ahin, ni lhinna pa Jehoiakim ahin, athum channa pa Zedekiah ahin, li lhinna pachu Shallum ahi.
en_web: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
en_kjv: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

tcz: Jehoiakim son achilhah ho chu achapa Jehoiachin leh asopipa Zedekiah ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

tcz: Babylon miten soh-chaga anakaimangu Jehoiachin chapate chu Shealtiel,
en_web: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
en_kjv: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

tcz: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, hoshama, chule Nedabiah ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
en_kjv: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

tcz: Pedaiah chapate ni chu Zerubbabel le Shimei ahilhone. Zerubbabel chapate ni chu Meshullam le Hananiah ahilhonin, Amani sopinu chu Shelomith akiti.
en_web: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
en_kjv: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the son of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

tcz: Aman chapa adang nga jong ahingin, amaho chu Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, chule Jushab-Hesed ahiuve.
en_web: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
en_kjv: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.

tcz: Hananiah chapate ni chu Pelatiah le Jeshaiah ahilhone. Jeshaiah chapa Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa Arnan ahin, Arnan chapa Obadiah ahin, Obadiah chapa Shecaniah ahi.
en_web: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

tcz: Shecaniah chapa le atute chu achapa Shemaiah ahin; chule Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush ahin, Igal ahin, Bariah ahin, Neariah ahin, chule Shaphat pumin mi gup alhing uve.
en_web: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
en_kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

tcz: Neariah chapate chu Elioenai ahin, Hizkiah ahin, chule Azrikam pumin mi thum ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
en_kjv: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

tcz: Elioenai chapate chu Hodaviah ahin, Eliashib ahin, Pelaiah ahin, Akkub ahin, Johanan ahin, Delaiah ahin, chule Anani ahin, abonchauvin mi sagi alhing uve.
en_web: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
en_kjv: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

tcz: Judah chapate chu Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, chule Shobal ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
en_kjv: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

tcz: Shobal chapa Reaiah kitipa hin Jahath ahingin, jahath hin Ahumai le Lahad ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Zorath insung mite jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
en_kjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

tcz: Atam chapate chu Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, chule asopinu Hazzelelponi, Gedor hingpa,
en_web: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
en_kjv: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

tcz: Penuel, chule Hushah hingpa Ezer ahiuve. Mi hicheng hi Bethlehem hingpa Ephrathah chapa apeng masapen Hur son achilhah ho ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
en_kjv: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.

tcz: Tekoa pa Ashur chun ji ni anei in Amani chu Helah le Naarah ahilhone.
en_web: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
en_kjv: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

tcz: Naarah hin Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, chule Haahashtari ahingin ahi.
en_web: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
en_kjv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

tcz: Helah chun Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
en_web: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
en_kjv: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

tcz: Chule Anub pa Koz, Zobedah le Harum chapa Aharshel insung mite chengse chu ahingin ahi.
en_web: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
en_kjv: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

tcz: Jebez kitipa ji asopite dang dang sanga agunchu jeh’in anun jong, amahi nat chung nunga kahin ahi tin amin Jabez asah’in ahi.
en_web: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
en_kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

tcz: Jabez hi Israel Pathen henga ataovin hiti aseiye, “O Pathen, nangin keima phathei neiboh tei teiyin lang, neikaile jing jengin lang, chule hahsatna le gentheina jousea kon’in neichom khen jing jengin,” atin ahi. Hichun hiche ataona hi Pathen’in anop peh tai.
en_web: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
en_kjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me. And God granted him that which he requested.

tcz: Shuhah sopipa Kelub chun Mehir anahingin, Mehir chun Eshton ahingin,
en_web: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
en_kjv: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

tcz: Eshton chun Bethrapha, Paseah, chule Tehinnah ahingin ahi. Tehinnah chun Irnahash ahingin ahi. mihem hichengse hi Recah son achilhah ahiuve.
en_web: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
en_kjv: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.

tcz: Kenaz chapate ni chu Othniel le Seraiah ahilhonin ahi. Othniel chapate ni chu Hathath le Meonothai ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
en_kjv: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

tcz: Meonothai chun Ophrah ahingin, chule Seraiah chun Geharashim pa Joab ahingin ahi; amaho hi khut them thing thembol mi ahiuve.
en_web: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
en_kjv: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

tcz: Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu Iru le Elah toh Naam ahiuve; chutengle Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi.
en_web: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
en_kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

tcz: Jehallelel chapate chu Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, chule Asarel ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

tcz: Ezreah chapate chu Jether, Mered, Epher, chule Jalon ahiuvin. Mereh jinu ho lah’a mi khat’in Meriam le Shammai toh Eshtemoa pa Ishba ahinpeh-in ahi.
en_web: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

tcz: Chujongle Mered hin Judah numei khat jong akichenpi’in, amanun Gedor pa Jered ahingin, Soco pa Heber ahingin, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel jong anahingin ahi. Mered chun Pharaoh channu Bithia kitinu jong ana kichenpi’in, chule amanun jong chapa phabep ahinpeh-in ahi.
en_web: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
en_kjv: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

tcz: Hodiah jinu chu Naham sopinu anahi. Amanu chapa lah’a khat chu keilah kho’a Garm mite pa ahin, chule khat pachu Eshtomoa mi Maacath miho pa ahi.
en_web: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
en_kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

tcz: Shimon chapate chu Amnon le Rinnah toh, Ben-hanan le Tilon ahiuve. Ishi chapte ni chu Zoheth le Ben-Zoheth ahilhone.
en_web: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
en_kjv: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

tcz: Shelah kitipa hi Judah chapate ho lah’a mi khat anahi. Shelah son achilhah ho chu Lecah pa Er; Mareshah pa Laasah; chule Beth-Ashbea kho’a tupat pon khonga pang insung mite toh;
en_web: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
en_kjv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

tcz: Jokim; Cozeba mite le Joash chule Jashubi-Lehem le Moab gamsunga vaipoa anapang Sraph ahiuvin ahi. mi hijat le abonchauva amin nu chu khanglui laipeh’a athusim mu kisutna lekhahoa ana kisunlut peh ahitai.
en_web: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
en_kjv: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi bel denga pang ho, Netaim le Gederah kho’a cheng ahiuve. Hichea hi amaho hi cheng khom’uva lengpa natonga pang ji ahiuve.
en_web: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
en_kjv: These were the potters, and those that dwelt amongst plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

tcz: Simeon chapate chu Jemuel*, Jamin, Jarib, Zohar,* chule Shaul ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
en_kjv: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

tcz: Shaul son achilhah ho chu Shallum le Mibsam, chule Mishma toh ahiuve.
en_web: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
en_kjv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

tcz: Mishma son achilhah ho chu achapa Hammuel ahin; Hammuel chapa Zaccur ahin; chule Zaccur chapa Shimei ahi.
en_web: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
en_kjv: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

tcz: Shimei hin chapa som le gup jen ahingin, chule chanu gup ahinge; ahinlah asopi pasal dang vang cha tamnei aum pouvin ahi. Hijehchun, Simeon insung mite hi Judah insung mite bangin apung thei mong mong pouve.
en_web: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
en_kjv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

tcz: Amaho hi Beersheba le moladah, Hazar-Shaul,
en_web: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
en_kjv: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

tcz: Bilhah le Ezem Tolad dunga achenguvin,
en_web: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
en_kjv: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

tcz: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
en_web: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
en_kjv: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

tcz: Beth-Marcoboth, Hazarsusim, Beth-biri, chule Shaaraim dunga jong acheng uve.
en_web: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
en_kjv: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

tcz: David lengvaipoa ahung pan masanga kho hijat hi amaho thuneina noiya um ngen ahiuve. Amaho son achilhah hochu Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, chule Ashan pumin khopi nga,
en_web: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
en_kjv: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

tcz: Chule kimvel dunga akhobah chengse chutoh Baalath mun chan geiyin jong achenguvin ahi. Hicheng hi amaho chenna mun ahin, chuleh, hiche min chengse ho hi amaho khanggui kisimna lekhabua ana kisun lut’ah ahi.
en_web: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
en_kjv: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

tcz: Simeon son achilhah dang hochu Meshobab, Jamlech, chule Amaziah chapa Joshah,
en_web: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
en_kjv: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

tcz: Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu toh, Seraiah chapa ahin, Asiel chapa ahin,
en_web: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
en_kjv: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

tcz: Elioenai ahin, Jaakobah ahin, Jeshohaiah ahin, Asaiah ahin, Adiel ahin, Jesimiel ahin, Benaiah ahin,
en_web: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
en_kjv: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

tcz: Chule Shiphi chapa Ziza ahin, Allon chapa ahin, Jedaiah chapa ahin, Shimri chapa ahin, chule Shemaiah chapa ahi.
en_web: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
en_kjv: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

tcz: Tua amin cheh’a kisimdoh hohi Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate cheh ahiuvin; apu apau insung dungjui cheh in jong nasatah in aphatheiyuvin akhangtou theilheh jenguve.
en_web: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
en_kjv: these mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

tcz: Chule amaho hi Gerar gamkai langa akitol’uvin, phaicham gam'a niso lam geiyin jong acheuvin, akelngoi hon teu din hamhing um umna ahol’uvin ahi.
en_web: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
en_kjv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

tcz: Hikoma chun amahon gam phatah, hamhing thalhinna gam len tah, chule chamlenna le lung mong tah’a chenna thei akimuve. Hiche gam a ana cheng masa mite chu Ham son achilhah mi phabep anahi uvin ahi.
en_web: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
en_kjv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

tcz: Hinlah, Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate chu hikoma hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah lengvaipoh layin ahung lut’uvin, hikoma anachengte Ham son achilhah phabep ho chule Meun mite ponbuh ho ahin, achennau in ho ahin, amuphah phah asumanguvin ahi. Hiti hin amaho chu asuhmang phat’uvin amaho khel’in anachenguvin, tuni gei hin amahon mun chu alo nalaiyuve. Ijeh-inem itileh hiche gam'a hi akelngoiteu neh ding hamhing pha amu’u ahi.
en_web: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
en_kjv: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

tcz: Chuin, Simeon mite lah’a mihem ja nga tobang chu Seir molsang geiyin akitol’uvin, a lamkai diuvin Pelatiah le Neariah toh, Rephaiah, le Uzziel, abonchauva Ishi chapate chu anapansah uvin ahi.
en_web: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
en_kjv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

tcz: Amaho hin Amalek mi athimoh’a jamdoh chengse jong asumanguvin, chule amaho khel’in tuni geiyin acheng den tauve.
en_web: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
en_kjv: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

tcz: Israel cha amasapen chu Reuben ahi. Ahinlah, aman apa jalou tah’a apa thaikemho lah’a khat alupkhom-pi jeh chun a upat hi asopipa Joseph chapate joh achanguvin. Hiche jeh’a chu Reuben hi khanggui kisimna lekhabua chun apen masah dung juiyin akijih lut tapoi.
en_web: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
en_kjv: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

tcz: Judah son achilhahte chu athahat pen’a ahung pan uva chule amaho phunga kona leng khat ahung kisep doh jing vang'in, upatna kiti hi Joseph bou achangin ahi.
en_web: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
en_kjv: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)

tcz: Israel chapa apeng masapen Reuben chapate chu Hanoch ahin, Pallu ahin, Hezron ahin, chule Carmi ahi.
en_web: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
en_kjv: the sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

tcz: Joel son achilhah ho chu Shemaiah ahin, Gog ahin, Shimei ahin,
en_web: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
en_kjv: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

tcz: Micah ahin, Reaiah ahin, Baal ahin,
en_web: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
en_kjv: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

tcz: Chule Beerah ahi. Assyria lengpa Tiglath-Pileser pachu Beerah anahi.
en_web: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
en_kjv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

tcz: Beerah inkote chu ama phung sunga akhangguiya akisimtoh’a akijih toh tengleh ahaosa chu Jeriel ahin, Zechariah jong ahi;
en_web: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
en_kjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

tcz: Chule Azaz chapa Bela ahin, Shema chapa ahin, chule Joel chapa jong ahi. Reuben mite ho hi Aroer apat Nebon changei, chule Baal-Meon chan geiya cheng ahiuve.
en_web: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
en_kjv: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

tcz: Chule amaho hin Gilead gam'a chun gancha tamtah anei jeh’a niso lama jong achenguvin, nel gam jot nalampi lang apat Euphrates luipi gal lam geiyin acheng uvin ahi.
en_web: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
en_kjv: and eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

tcz: Shual lengvaipoh laiyin jong Reuben mite hin Hagar mite chunga gal abol uvin ahi, hiche Hagar mite chu ajophat uvin Gilead niso lama amaho ponbuh jouse a chun alhung keiyin achen den lo tauvin ahi.
en_web: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
en_kjv: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

tcz: Gad son achilhah ho chu Reuben mite ho toh kigalsaiyin achenguvin Salecah chan geiyin alouve.
en_web: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
en_kjv: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:

tcz: Joel chu Bashan khoa haosan apangin, Shapham ama ban in apangin, ama ni ban’a Janai le Saphat apang ahilhone.
en_web: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
en_kjv: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

tcz: Amaho insunga phunggui sagi haosa ho chu Michael ahin, Meshullam ahin, Shiba ahin, Jorai ahin, Jacan Zia ahin, chule Eber ahi.
en_web: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
en_kjv: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

tcz: Hiche ho chengse hi abonchauva Huri chapa Abihail son achilhah jeng ahiuve; Huri chu joroah chapa ahin, Joroah chu Gilead chapa ahin, Michael chu Jeshishai chapa ahin, Jeshishai chu Jahdo chapa, chule Jahdo chu Buz chapa ahi.
en_web: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
en_kjv: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

tcz: Ahi chu Abdiel chapa ahin, Abdiel chu Guni chapa ahin chule Guni hi amaho insung lhah’a haosa ahi.
en_web: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
en_kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

tcz: Hiche Gad mite hi Gilead gamsung, Bashan gamsung, chule akhobah jouse le Sharon gam hamhing phatna lai jousea achenguvin ahi.
en_web: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
en_kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

tcz: Mihem hijat khanggui thusim hi Judah lengpa Jotham lal lai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam lal laiya kisimtoh a kijih doh ahiye.
en_web: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
en_kjv: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

tcz: Reuben chapate leh Gad chapate chule Manaseh phung keh khat jong hin galhang mihat, pho le chemjam thoa gal bolthei, thalpi kap them, galsat themtah tah sepai sangsom li le sang ni le ja sagi le somgup jen gal bol dia gonsa anei jinguvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
en_kjv: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

tcz: Amaho hin Hagar mite chung le Jetur mite chung, chule Naphish mite le Nodab mite chunga gal abol’uve.
en_web: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
en_kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

tcz: Gal lai hin amahon Pathen hengah panpina athum un, amahon Pathen tahsanna anei jeh’uvin, aman ataona chu asanpeh tai. Hijeh chun amahon Gar mite le amaho panpi chengse chu ajou soh hel tauve.
en_web: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.
en_kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

tcz: Amahon akisatpi Har mite thil achompeh ho chu sangongsao sangsom nga jen ahin, kelngoi le kelcha sang jani le sangsom nga jen toh ahin, chule mihem sang jakhat jen galhingin akaiyun ahi.
en_web: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
en_kjv: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

tcz: Gal kisat chu Pathen in apanpi jeh’in Har mite simsen lou akijam chap jengin ahi. Soh-changa akitol mang kah seuvin amaho gamsunga chun Reuben mite, Gad mite, chu Manaseh mite acheng tauve.
en_web: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
en_kjv: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

tcz: Manaseh phung kehkhat jong mihem atam lheh jenguvin, Bashan gam'a pat Baal-Hermon gei, Senir gei, chule Hermon molsang geiyin achengdoh peh jenguvin ahi.
en_web: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
en_kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

tcz: Ama ama pajang lhah ainsung cheh-uva a upa chengse chu: Epher ahin, Ishi ahin, Eliel ahin, Azriel ahin, Jeremiah ahin, Hodaviah ahin, chule Jahdiel toh ahiuve. Amaho mihat galhang ho hina lama minthanna anei uvin, chule ama ama insung pajang lhah a a upa chengse chu ahitauvin ahi.
en_web: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
en_kjv: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

tcz: Ahivangin amaho hin apu apateu Pathen ahou khel’uvin, Pathenin asuhmangsa mite gam'a vaipo ho Pathen lim semthu doi ho akou tauvin ahi.
en_web: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
en_kjv: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

tcz: Hichejeh hin Pathenin Assyria lengpa Pul (Tiglath-Piteser jong akiti ) lungthim ahintildoh peh in, hiche Reuben mite le Gad mite toh, chule Manaseh phung akeh khat hi akaimangin ahi. Assyria ten amaho hi Halah kho le Habor kho, Hara kho, chule Gozan vadunga ahinkai lut’uvin, tuni geiyin aumden tauve.
en_web: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
en_kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

tcz: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari toh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
en_kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel toh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

tcz: Amram chapate chu Aaron ahin, Moses ahin, chule Miriam toh ahi. Aaron chapate chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar toh hichengse hi ahiuve.
en_web: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
en_kjv: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

tcz: Eleazer hin Phinehas anahingin, Phinehas hin Abishua anahinge.
en_web: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
en_kjv: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

tcz: Abishua hin Bukki anahingin, Bukki hin Uzzi ahinge.
en_web: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
en_kjv: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

tcz: Uzzi hin Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah in Meraioth ahinge.
en_web: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
en_kjv: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

tcz: Meraioth hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah hin Ahitub ahinge.
en_web: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
en_kjv: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

tcz: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok hin Ahimaaz ahinge.
en_web: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
en_kjv: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

tcz: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, Azariah chun Johanan ahinge.
en_web: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
en_kjv: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

tcz: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, amahi Jerusalem khopia Solomon hou-in sahdoh sunga thempu chungnunga hung pang ahi.
en_web: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: and Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

tcz: Azariah hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah chun Ahitub ahinge.
en_web: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
en_kjv: and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

tcz: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok chun Shallum ahinge.
en_web: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
en_kjv: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

tcz: Shallum hin Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah chun Azariah ahinge.
en_web: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
en_kjv: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

tcz: Azariah hin Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah chun Jehozadak ahingin ahi.
en_web: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
en_kjv: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

tcz: Pakaiyin Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite soh-changa asol manga Nebuchadnezzar khut’a atolmang sah phat’in Jehozadak jong hi soh-changin achemang tan ahi.
en_web: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
en_kjv: and Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

tcz: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari ahi.
en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
en_kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Gershom chapate ni chu Libni leh Shimei ahilhone.
en_web: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
en_kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel ahi.
en_web: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
en_kjv: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

tcz: Merari son achilhah teni chu Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Anoiya mi hichengse hi apu apau kailhah cheh ama ama insung dol cheh’a Levi miho insung jeng ahiuve:
en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
en_kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

tcz: Gershon insung ahileh, Libni ahin, Jahath ahin, Zimmah ahin,
en_web: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
en_kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

tcz: Joah ahin, Iddo ahin, Zerah ahin, chule Jeatherai ahi.
en_web: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
en_kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amminadab ahin, Korah ahin, Assir ahin,
en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
en_kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

tcz: Elkanah ahin, Abiasaph ahin, ahimoth ahin,
en_web: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
en_kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

tcz: Tahath ahin, Uriel ahin, Uzziah ahin, chule Shaul ahi.
en_web: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
en_kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

tcz: Elkanah son chilhah ho ahileh, Amasai ahin, Ahimoth ahin,
en_web: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
en_kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

tcz: Elkanah ahin, Zophai ahin, Nahath ahin,
en_web: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
en_kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

tcz: Eliah ahin, Jehoram ahin, Elkanah ahin, chule Samuel ahi.
en_web: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
en_kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

tcz: Samuel chapate ni chu apeng masa Joel ahin, chule anni lhinna pachu Abijah ahi.
en_web: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
en_kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

tcz: Merari son achilhah ho chu Mahli ahin, Libni ahin, Shimei ahin, Uzzah ahin,
en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
en_kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

tcz: Shimei ahin, Haggiah ahin, chule Asaiah ahi.
en_web: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
en_kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

tcz: Pakai hou-in sunga Pathen thingkong ahung kitol lut nunga David’in hou-in sunga la lamkaiya pang dia anganse miho chu hicheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.
en_kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

tcz: Jerusalem khopia Solomonin Pakai hou-in asah doh masangsen la lamkaiya pang ho hi mipi kikhopna ponbuh’a la lamkaiyin anapanguvin lhacha na atong jinguve. Hitobang hin amahon atoh dingdol kinse chu hoikeichan atong jing jenguve.
en_web: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
en_kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

tcz: Hichea la lamkaiya pang ho leh achapateu chu aban'a kisei ho hi ahi-uve: Heman tumging thempa chu Kohath chilhah miho lah’a Joel chapa ahin, Joel chu Samuel chapa ahin,
en_web: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
en_kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

tcz: Samuel chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Jeroham chapa ahin, Jeroham chu Eliel chapa ahin, Eliel chu Toah chapa ahin,
en_web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
en_kjv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

tcz: Toah chu Zuph chapa ahin, Zuph chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Mahath chapa ahin, Mahath chu Amasai chapa ahi.
en_web: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
en_kjv: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

tcz: Amasai chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Joel chapa ahi, Joel chu Azariah chapa ahin, Azariah chu Zephaniah chapa ahi.
en_web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
en_kjv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

tcz: Zephaniah chu Tahath chapa ahin, Tahath chu Assir chapa ahin, Assir chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin, Ebiasaph chu Korah chapa ahi.
en_web: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
en_kjv: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

tcz: Korah chu Izhar chapa ahin, Izhar chu Kohath chapa ahi; Kohath chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Israel chapa ahi.
en_web: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
en_kjv: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

tcz: Heman’in manchah phapenna anei masapa Gershon chilhah miho lah’a Asaph kitipa chu Berekiah chapa ahin, Berekiah chu Shimea chapa ahi;
en_web: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
en_kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

tcz: Shimea hi Michael chapa ahin, Michael chu Baaseiah chapa ahi. Baaseiah chu Malkijah chapa ahin,
en_web: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
en_kjv: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

tcz: Malkijah chu Ethnic chapa ahi; Ethnic chu Zerah chapa ahin, Zerah chu Adaiah chapa ahi,
en_web: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
en_kjv: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

tcz: Adaiah chu Ethan chapa ahin, Ethan chu Zimmah chapa ahi; Zimmah chu Shimei chapa ahin,
en_web: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
en_kjv: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

tcz: Shimei chu Jathah chapa ahi; Jathah chu Gershom chapa ahin, Gershom chu Levi chapa ahi.
en_web: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
en_kjv: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

tcz: Hemanin manchah phapenna anei ani channa pa Merari chilhah miho lah’a Ethan chu Kishi chapa ahin, Kishi chu Abdi chapa ahin, Abdi chu Malluch chapa ahin,
en_web: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
en_kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

tcz: Malluch chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Amaziah chapa ahin, Amaziah chu Hilkiah chapa ahin,
en_web: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
en_kjv: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

tcz: Hilkiah chu Amzi chapa ahin, Amzi chu Bani chapa ahin, Bani chu Shemer chapa ahin,
en_web: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
en_kjv: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

tcz: Shemer chu Mahli chapa ahin, Mahli chu Mushi chapa ahin, Mushi chu Merari chapa ahin chule Merari chu Levi chapa ahiye.
en_web: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
en_kjv: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

tcz: Amaho sopite Levi phung sung mite jouse chu abonchauvin Pathen hou-in houbuh sunga natong kinbol din akipansah soh keiyuvin ahi.
en_web: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
en_kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

tcz: Aaron le achapate jeng bouseh chu Thempu kin tongin apanguvin ahi. Amahon pumgo thilto kigona maicham chung le gimnaitui kihalvamna maicham chunga thilto ding jouse toh-soh in apanguvin, Muntheng Phunga natohna ding thil toh din apanguve, chujongleh Pathen lhachapa Mose thupeh dungyuiyin Israelte kithoina kinbol’in apang jiuve.
en_web: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
en_kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

tcz: Aaron son chilhah hochu hicheng hi ahiuve: Aaron chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Phinehas ahin, Phinehas chapa chu Abishua ahi.
en_web: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

tcz: Abishua chapa chu Bukki ahin, Bukki chapa chu Uzzi ahin, Uzzi chapa chu Zerahiah ahi.
en_web: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
en_kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

tcz: Zerahiah chapa chu Meraioth ahin, Meraioth chapa chu Amariah ahin; Amariah chapa chu Ahitub ahi.
en_web: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
en_kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

tcz: Ahitub chapa chu Zadok ahin, chule Zadok chapa chu Ahimaaz ahiye.
en_web: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
en_kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

tcz: Hichengse hi amaho gamgi hop sunga achenna mun chengseu chu ahiye: Aaron chapate Kohath phung sung mite dinga phun kisan chu aphat jeh’in,
en_web: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
en_kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

tcz: Mihon amaho chu Judah gamsunga Hebron khopi le akimvel gamse se toh chule avel’a hamhing gam gancha vahna ding jouse chutoh apeh tha taove;
en_web: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
en_kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

tcz: Amavang akhopi loujao lah chengse leh akhoneo dung jouse chu Caleb kitipa Jephunneh chapa chu apetauve.
en_web: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
en_kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

tcz: Aaron chapa dinga khopi anapeh’u chule ahamhing gamsunga cheh toh anakipeh tha ho chu: Hebron khopi ( kiselna khopi ), Libnah khopi, Jattir khopi, Eshtemoa khopi,
en_web: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

tcz: Holon khopi, Debir khopi,
en_web: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
en_kjv: and Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

tcz: Ain khoppi, Juttah khopi, chule Beth-Shemesh khopi toh hichengse hi ahi.
en_web: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;
en_kjv: and Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:

tcz: Chuleh Benjamin phunga kona alahdoh-u khopi ho chu Gibeon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Geba khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Alemeth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin,chule Anatholh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahi. Aaron chapate ainsung pumpiuva achan jat’u khopi chu abonchan khopi som le khopi thum alhingin ahi.
en_web: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
en_kjv: and out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

tcz: Kohath chapate amoh chengse din Bamau insung dinga phum aphatna dungjuiyin, Manasseh phung keh khat, hichea phunga kon chun khopi som khat jen akipen ahi.
en_web: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
en_kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

tcz: Gershom chapate chu phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Issachar gam'a kon, Asher gam'a kon, Naphtali gam'a kon, chule Jordan solam’a um Bashan gam'a Manasseh phunga kona kidong khom khopi agomin khopi som le khopi thum achanguvin ahi.
en_web: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
en_kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

tcz: Merari chapate jong phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Reuben gam'a kon, Gad gam'a kon, chule Zebulun gam'a kon kidong khom khopi som le khopi ni acheng uvin ahiye.
en_web: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
en_kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

tcz: Hitobang hin Israel chaten Levite chu khopi chujat chutoh ahamhing gamsese toh anapeuvin ahiye.
en_web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
en_kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

tcz: Hitobang hin phun phatna dungjuiyin, Judah phunga kon, Simeon phunga kon, chule Benjamin phunga konin achunga kisei khopi ho hi anapeuvin ahi.
en_web: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
en_kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

tcz: Kohath chapate insung mi phabep jong Ephraim phunga konin agamsunguva khopi phabep le ahamhing gamsungse cheh achanguvin,
en_web: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
en_kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

tcz: Issachar chapa li ho chu Tol'a, Puah, Jashub, chule Shimron ahiuve.
en_web: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
en_kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

tcz: Tol'a chapate chu Uzzi le Rephaiah toh, Jeriel le Jahmai toh, Ibsam le Shemuel ahiuve. Amaho hi apau Tol'a insungkon mite lah’a upa cheh ahiuve. Daniel lal laiyin amaho hi gal-hang mihat jeng ahiuvin, sepai 22,600 alhinguvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahi. Izrahiah chapate chu Michael, Obadiah, Joel, chule Isshiah ahiuve. Amaho mi nga hi aphung sunguva lamkai cheh in apanguve.
en_web: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
en_kjv: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

tcz: Amaho hi numei ji tampi le chapa tamtah aneiyuvin, hijehchun amaho chapate sunga galsat thei sepai hi agomin mi 36,000 alhinguve.
en_web: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
en_kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

tcz: Issachar insung mite mong mong jong gal-hang mihat jeng jeng jong abonchauvin 87,000 alhinguvin ahi. Amaho cheng chu akhanggui lekhabu’va kijih lut’ah ahitai.
en_web: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
en_kjv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

tcz: Benjamin chapa thum hochu Bela, Beker chule Jediael ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
en_kjv: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

tcz: Bela chapa nga ho chu Ezbon le Uzzi toh, Uzziel le Jerimoth toh, chule Iri ahiuvin ahi. Amaho hi amau insung apu apau lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuve. Chujongle akhangguiyu kisimna akisut dol chun gal-hang sepai agomin 22,034 alhinguve.
en_web: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
en_kjv: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

tcz: Beker chapate chu Zemirah ahin, Joash ahin, Eliezer ahin, Elioenai ahin, Omri ahin, Jeremoth ahin, Abijah ahin, Anathoth ahin, chule Alemeth toh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
en_kjv: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

tcz: Amaho hi apu apateu lhah’a insung upa cheh ahiuve. Amaho hi akhangguiya lekhabu’a kisut lut dungjuiyin mihat gal-hang sese le lamkai sese chu agomin mihem 20,200 alhinguvin ahi.
en_web: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
en_kjv: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

tcz: Jediael chapa chu Bilhan ahi. Bilhan chapate chu Jeush le Benjamin toh, Ehud le Kenaanah toh, Zethan le Tarshish toh chule Ahishahar ahiuve.
en_web: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
en_kjv: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

tcz: Amaho cheng hi apu apateu insunga phung upa cheh ahiuve. Hichengse phung sunga hin gal-hang mihat galbol thei cheh agomin 17,200 alhinguve.
en_web: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
en_kjv: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.

tcz: Ir chapate ni chu Shuppim le Huppim ahilhone. Hushim chu apa Aker ahi.
en_web: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
en_kjv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

tcz: Naphtali chapate chu Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin, chule Shillem ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Jacob thaikemnu son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
en_kjv: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

tcz: Manasseh son achilhah ho lah’a Aramean numeinu toh ahin chu Asriel ahi. Amanu hin Gilead hingpa Makir jong ahinge.
en_web: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
en_kjv: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

tcz: Makir hin Huppim le Shuppim jong ji apuipeh cheh’e. Makir hin sopi numei khat aneiyin amin Macaah akiti. Ason chilhah ho lah’a numei khat chu Zelophehad ahin, amanu hin chanu jeng bou ahingin ahi.
en_web: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
en_kjv: and Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

tcz: Makir jinu Macaah chun chapa khat ahingin amin jong Peresh asah’e ; chule asopipa min chu Sheresh ahi. Peresh chapate ni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone.
en_web: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
en_kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

tcz: Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichengse hi Manasseh chapa Makir son chilhah ho lah’a Gilead insung mite jeng ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

tcz: Makir sopinu Hammoleketh kitinu chun Ishod, Abiezer, chule Mahlah ahingin ahi.
en_web: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
en_kjv: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

tcz: Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechen, Likhi, chu Aniam ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
en_kjv: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Shuthelah ahin, Bered ahin, Tahath ahin, Eleadah ahin, Tahath ahikit’in,
en_web: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
en_kjv: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

tcz: Zabad ahin, Shuthelah akiti kit’in, Ezer ahin, Elead ahiye. Ezer le Elead,, ama ni hi Gath kimvella cheng loulhou mi hon anathat tauvin ahi: ijeh-inem itileh ama ni hi aganchau guhpeh dinga hung konsuh jing ahilhone.
en_web: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
en_kjv: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

tcz: Apau Ephraim chun nikho phabep sungin amaho pul adou jengin, alhem lung mong din asopite jong ahunguvin ahi.
en_web: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
en_kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

tcz: Chujouvin Ephraim hin ajinu aluppi kit’in ahileh amanu ahung gaiyin chapa khat ahing kit’e: ainsunga chutobang vangsetna alhun jeh’in Ephraim in achapa pengthahpa chu Beriah akisah’in ahi.
en_web: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
en_kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

tcz: Aman chanu khat ahingin amin jong Sheerah akitin ahi. Amanu hin Beth-horon chung nung le anoinung chu anasadoh’in chule Uzzer-Sheerah jong anasadoh’e.
en_web: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
en_kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Rephah ahi, Resheph ahin, Telah ahin, Tahan ahin,
en_web: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
en_kjv: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

tcz: Ladan ahin, Ammihud ahin, Elishama ahin,
en_web: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
en_kjv: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

tcz: Nun ahin, chule Joshua ahiye.
en_web: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
en_kjv: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah hon gam alouva achenphana mun’u chu Bethel khopi le agamsunga kholen dom jouse toh, niso lama Naaran ahin, nilhum lama Gezer le akholen dung jouse jong ahithan, chule Shechem khopi le akholen len ho jong ahin, Ayyah khopi le akholen dung jouse changei jong ahithai.
en_web: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
en_kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

tcz: Chutengle Manasseh mite gamgi dunga hung kilhah ahipeh’in, Beth-Shan le akholen dung jouse ahin, Taanaeh le akholen ho toh, Megiddo khole akholen dung jouse le Dork hole le akholen dom jouse toh ahiye. Khopi hijat sunga hi Israel chapa Joseph son chilhah chengse anacheng ahiuve.
en_web: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
en_kjv: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

tcz: Asher chapate chu Imnah ahin, Ishvah ahin, Ishvi ahin, chule Beriah ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei khat aneiyuvin amin Serah ahi.
en_web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
en_kjv: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

tcz: Beriah chapate ni chu Heber le Malkiel ahilhonin, Malkiel hi Birzaith pa ahiye.
en_web: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
en_kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

tcz: Heber chapate chu Japhlet le Shomer toh, chule Hotham ahiuve. Amaho hin sopi numei khat bou aneiyuvin amin Shua akiti.
en_web: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
en_kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

tcz: Japhlet chapate hin Pasach, Bimhal, chule Ashvath ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
en_kjv: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

tcz: Shomer chapate chu Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, chule Ram ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
en_kjv: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

tcz: Shomer sopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imma, Shelesh, chule Amal ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
en_kjv: And the son of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

tcz: Zophah chapate chu Suah, Harnephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
en_web: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
en_kjv: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

tcz: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, chule Beera ahiuve.
en_web: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
en_kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

tcz: Jether chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
en_kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

tcz: Ulla chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
en_kjv: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

tcz: Asher son achilhah mi hichengse hi, apajang khai cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve. Mihat gal-hang mi jeng leh milen milal jeng ahiuve, ti phatea phot chetsa cheh ahitauve. Akhanggui lekhabua galsat’a manthei cheh mihing kisimdoh chengse chu 26,000 alhinguvin ahi.
en_web: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
en_kjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their fathers’ house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

tcz: Benjamin chapa apeng masapen chu Bela ahin, ni lhinna pachu Ashbel ahin, athum channa pachu Aharah ahin,
en_web: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
en_kjv: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

tcz: Li lhinna pachu Nohah ahin, chule a nga channapa chu Rapha ahi.
en_web: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
en_kjv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

tcz: Bela chapate chu Addar ahin, Gera ahin, Abihud ahin,
en_web: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
en_kjv: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

tcz: Abishua ahin, Naaman ahin, Ahoah ahin,
en_web: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
en_kjv: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

tcz: Gera ahin, Shephuphan ahin, chule Huram ahiuve.
en_web: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
en_kjv: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

tcz: Ehud chapate,Gam'a cheng mite dinga ainsung cheh uva mi upa jeng ho chu, abonchauvin Manahath gamsunga min soh-chang din akaimang tauve.
en_web: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
en_kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

tcz: Ehud chapate chu Naaman ahin, Ahijah ahin, chule Gera toh ahiuve. Gera hin soh-changa apuimang’u ahin, amahin Uzza le Abihud ahingin ahi.
en_web: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
en_kjv: and Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

tcz: Shaharaim hin ajite ni Hushim le Baara ada nungin jong Moab gamsunga cha tampi anei nalaiyin ahi.
en_web: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
en_kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

tcz: Ajinu Hodesh kiti nu chuto jong chapa Jobab le Zibia toh Mesha le Malcam ahing lhonin,
en_web: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
en_kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

tcz: Jeuz le Sakia toh, chule Mirmah ahing lhonin ahi. Hichengse hi amapa chapate ahiuvin, ainsung cheh uva mi upa cheh ahiuve.
en_web: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
en_kjv: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

tcz: Aman ajinu Hashim tohjong chapa ni Abitub leh Elpaal ahing lhonin ahi.
en_web: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
en_kjv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

tcz: Elpaal chapate chu Eber ahin, Misham ahin, chule Shemed ahi: ( Shemed hin Ono khopi le Lod khopi toh chule akholen dung jouse anasan ahin),
en_web: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
en_kjv: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

tcz: Beriah ahin, chule Shema jong ahilhone. Amaho hi Aijalon khopi’a cheng insung phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule Gath’a cheng ho toh kisat’a nomanga pang ho chu ahiuve.
en_web: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
en_kjv: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

tcz: Chujongle Ahio le Shashak toh chule Jeremoth jong ahiuve.
en_web: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
en_kjv: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

tcz: Zebadiah ahin, Arad ahin, chule Eder jong ahiuve.
en_web: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
en_kjv: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

tcz: Michael le Ishpah toh Joha, amaho hi Beriah chapate jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
en_kjv: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

tcz: Zebadiah ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
en_kjv: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

tcz: Ishmerai ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
en_kjv: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

tcz: Jakim ahin, Zicri ahin, Zabdi ahi,
en_web: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
en_kjv: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

tcz: Elienai ahin, Zillethai ahin, Eliel ahin,
en_web: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
en_kjv: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

tcz: Adaiah ahin, Beriah ahin, chule Shimrath ahin, amaho hi Shimei chapate ahiuve.
en_web: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
en_kjv: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

tcz: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
en_web: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
en_kjv: and Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

tcz: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,
en_web: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
en_kjv: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

tcz: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
en_web: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
en_kjv: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

tcz: Iphdeiah, chule Penuel hichengse hi Shashak chapate jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
en_kjv: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

tcz: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
en_web: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
en_kjv: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

tcz: Jaareshiah, Elijah, chule Zicri hichengse hi Jeroham chapate ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
en_kjv: and Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

tcz: Mihem hijat hi akhangguiyu lekhabua kisut dungjuiyin ama ama insunga phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia anachenguvin ahiye.
en_web: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

tcz: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopia anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
en_web: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
en_kjv: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:

tcz: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon akitin ahi. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
en_web: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
en_kjv: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

tcz: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah,
en_web: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
en_kjv: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

tcz: Chule Shimeam hingpa Mikloth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi ainkoteu toh kigalsai cheh’in Jerusalem khopia chun anachenguvin ahi.
en_web: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
en_kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

tcz: Ner chun Kish ahingin, Kish chun Saul ahingin, Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
en_web: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
en_kjv: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

tcz: Jonathan’in Meribaal ahingin, Meribaal in Micah ahinge.
en_web: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
en_kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

tcz: Micah chapate chu Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, chule Ahaz ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
en_kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

tcz: Ahaz chun Jadah ahingin, Jadah chun Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahinge. Zimri hin Moza ahinge.
en_web: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
en_kjv: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

tcz: Moza chu Binea pa ahin, Binea chu Rephaiah pa ahin, Raphaiah chu Eleasah pa ahin, chule Eleasah chu Azel pa ahi.
en_web: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
en_kjv: and Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

tcz: Azel hin chapa gup aneiyin, amaho chu: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
en_kjv: and Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

tcz: Ezel sopipa Eshek chun chapa thum ahingin ahi: Apeng masapen chu Ulam ahin, ani lhinna pachu Jeush ahin, chule athum channa pachu Eliphelet ahi.
en_web: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
en_kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

tcz: Ulam chapate chu mihat gal-hang jeng, thalpi kap them jeng ahiuvin ahi. Amahon chapa tampi pi aneiyuvin chule tute jong tamtah aneiyun, abonchauvin mi 150 jen alhinguve. Mi hichengse hi Benjamin son chilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
