en_kjv: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

tcz: Hijehchun Israelte chun abonchauvin akhangguiyu akisim soh keiyin, akisim doh jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim lekhabua akijih lut soh keiye. Judah miten Pakaiya kitah louna anei jeh-uvin Babylon gamsunga soh-changin min akaimang taove
en_web: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
en_kjv: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

tcz: Agamsunguva hung lut kit’a akhopi dunguva hung cheng lut masaho chu thempu ho, Levi mite, houin lhacha ho, chule Israel mite adang dang ahiuve.
en_web: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
en_kjv: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

tcz: Judah mite lah’a abang bang, Benjamin phunga ahin, Ephraim phunga ahin, chule Manasseh phunga ahiuvin, Jerusalem khopia ahung kitol lut’uvin chule achenguve.
en_web: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
en_kjv: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

tcz: Judah chapa Perez chapate lah’a inko khat hung kinungle chu achapa Bani, Bani chapa Imri , Imri chapa Omri, Omri chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Uthai chu ahi.
en_web: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
en_kjv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

tcz: Adang inko ahung kinungle ho chu Shilon mite lah’a achapa apeng masapen Asaiah le achapate ahiuve.
en_web: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
en_kjv: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

tcz: Zerah phung sunga ahung kinungle chu Jevel le ainkote chengse ahiuve. Judah phung sunga ahung kinungle inko chu abonchauvin 690 alhinguvin ahi.
en_web: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
en_kjv: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

tcz: Benjamin phung kon’in Meshullam chapa Sallu ahin, Sallu chapa Hodaviah ahin, Hodaviah chapa Hassenuah ahin,
en_web: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
en_kjv: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

tcz: Jeroham chapa Ibneiah ahin, chule Elah chu Uzzi chapa Micri chapa ahin, chule Meshullam jong chu Shephatiah chapa ahin, Shephatiah chu Reuel chapa ahin, Reuel chu Ibnijah chapa ahi.
en_web: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
en_kjv: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

tcz: Amaho chengse hi ama ama insung lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule akhanguiyu thusim lekhabua kijih lut soh kei ahiuve. Benjamin phunga kona hung kinungle agomin inko 956 alhinguve.
en_web: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
en_kjv: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

tcz: Thempuho lah’a hung kinungle ho chu Jedaiah le Jehoiarib toh Jakin ahiuve.
en_web: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
en_kjv: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

tcz: Azariah kitipa Hilkiah chapa jong chu ahin, Hilkiah chu Meshullam chapa ahi; Meshullam chu Zadok chapa ahin, Zadok chu Meraioth chapa ahi; Meraioth chu Ahitub chapa ahi. Azariah chu Pathen hou-in’a vaibol lamkai pipua pang ahiye.
en_web: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
en_kjv: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

tcz: Thempu adang hung kinungle ho chu Jehoram chapa Adaiah ahin, Jehoram hi Pashhur chapa ahin, Pashhur chu Malkijah chapa ahin, chule Aiel chapa Maasai ahin, Meshullam chu Meshillemith chapa ahin, chule Meshillemith chu Immer chapa ahi.
en_web: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
en_kjv: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

tcz: Hicheng tilouvin jong thempu adang ahung kinungle agomin mi 1,760 ahiuve. Amaho hi apu apauva ainsung kailhah’a phung upa chengse ahiuvin, chule mi hangsan ngen jong ahiuve. Chule amaho hi Pathen houin sunga natonga mopohna nei cheh ahiuve.
en_web: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
en_kjv: and their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

tcz: Levi phunga mite chu Hasshub chapa Shemaiah ahin, Hasshub chu Azrikam chapa ahi; Hazrikam chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Merari chapate lah’a khat ahi.
en_web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
en_kjv: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

tcz: Bakbakkar, Herish leh Galal jong ahiuvin, chutengle Mica chapa Mattaniah ahin, Mica chu Zicri c hapa ahin, Zicri chu Asaph chapa ahi.
en_web: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
en_kjv: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

tcz: Chule Shemaiah chapa Obadiah ahin, Shemaiah chu Galal chapa ahi; Galal chu Jeduthun chapa ahin, chule Asa chapa Berekiah ahi; Berekiah chu Elkaneh chapa ahin, ama hi Netophah gamsunga cheng anahi.
en_web: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
en_kjv: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

tcz: Kulpi kelkot ngah’a pang miho chu Shallum ahin, Akkub ahin, Talmon ahin, Ahiman ahin, chule a inkoteu toh ahiuve.
en_web: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
en_kjv: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

tcz: Chule masang chun amaho hi niso lama lengpa kelkot ngah’in apanguve. Hiche miho hin Levi mite ngahmun kelkot jong angah’uvin ahi.
en_web: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
en_kjv: who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

tcz: Kore chapa Shallum ahin, Kore chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin; Korah phunggui akon ahi. Ama le ainkote, Korah mite chengse chu houin kinbol’in apu apateu Pakai ngahmun ngah’a apan banguvin apanguve.
en_web: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
en_kjv: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.

tcz: Masanglaiya chu Eleazar chapa Phinehas kitipa hi amaho kulpi kelkot mopoa anapang ji ahi; hijeh chun Pakaiyin jong amapa chu ana umpi jing jenge.
en_web: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
en_kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.

tcz: Chule hiche jou chun Zechariah kitipa Meshelemiah chapa chu kikhopna ponbuh kotphunga kot ngah’in anapang jin ahi.
en_web: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
en_kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

tcz: Chuche laichun hongcha kelkot dung ngah dinga kilhengdoh miho mong mong chu mihem 212 alhinguvin ahi; chule amaho hi akhangguiyu kisimna’a akho kho uva kisim soh kei ahiuve. David le mitva neipa Samuel chun amaho hi akitah jeh’uva apu apateu ho chu hitobang apan mun’uva hi apansah lhon ahiuve.
en_web: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
en_kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu amaho le son chilhahho chu Pakai hou-in, ponbuh’a hou-in kelkot phung dung ngah’a in-ngah’a apansah’u ahiye.
en_web: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
en_kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

tcz: Hiche kelkot dunga kot ngah’a pang ho chu niso lam, nilhum lam, Sahlam le lhang lam’a pang soh keiyuva, mun lia pang ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
en_kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

tcz: Amaho kithopi din ainkoteu, akho mun cheh’a hunguva ni sagi gia amaho hi ahung panhu jing jenguvah ahi.
en_web: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
en_kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

tcz: Kelkot ngah’a pang lamkai cheh Levi mi li ho chu indan jouse leh Pathen hou-in sunga thil kibol jouse ngah’a jong pang ahiuve.
en_web: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
en_kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

tcz: Amaho hi Pathen hou-in kimvel a geh jiuva, hitia hi amaho chunga in-nga kiti mong mong chu kikoiya, jingkah seh leh kot ahon jiu ahi.
en_web: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
en_kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

tcz: Kelkot ngah’a pang mi phabep khat chu hou-in kinbolna kimangji manchah thil le lo simtoh’in apang jiuvin ahi; ijeh-inem itileh hitobang thilkeo ho chu akilah doh le akikoi lut chan’a amanlouna dinga simtoh ji ji ngai monga ahi.
en_web: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.
en_kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

tcz: Midang ho jong chu thilkeo dang le manchah thil thengho, changbong ding le lengpitwi, thaotwi, gimnamtuui le adang dang lhutnam ding anamtuui ho vetup din apansah’uvin ahi.
en_web: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
en_kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

tcz: Hinlah thempuho chu lhutnam ding gimnamtwi chohhal din apansah’uve.
en_web: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
en_kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

tcz: Levi mi Mattithiah kitipa leh Korah insung kon Shallum chapa apeng masapen pachu changlhah pheng semna din avaibol’in apangin ahi.
en_web: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
en_kjv: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

tcz: Chujongle Kohath phunga kon mi phabep jong chu cholngah nikho seh leh todoh ding changlhah semin apanguvin ahi.
en_web: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
en_kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

tcz: Levi miho lah’a tumging/lathem tah tah ho chu hou-in sung dan’a acheng den jenguvin ahi. Amaho hi hou-in kinbolna ho’a ongthol’in aum theiyuve;ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi asun ajan a lasa pang pang jengji ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
en_kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

tcz: Mi hichengse hi Jerusalem Levi miho apu apauva ainsung lhah cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve.
en_web: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
en_kjv: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

tcz: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopi anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
en_web: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
en_kjv: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:

tcz: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon ahiye. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
en_web: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
en_kjv: and his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

tcz: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, chule Mikloth ahiuve.
en_web: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
en_kjv: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

tcz: Mikloth hi Shimeam pa ahiye. Inko hijat hi Jerusalem khopia ki-inmai ngatto cheh’in anachenguve.
en_web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
en_kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

tcz: Ner hin Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahinge. Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
en_web: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
en_kjv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

tcz: Jonathan chu Merib-Baal pa ahin, chule Merib-Baal chu Micah pa ahiye.
en_web: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
en_kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.

tcz: Micah chapate chu Pithon ahin, Melech ahin, Tahrea ahin, chule Ahaz ahiye.
en_web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
en_kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.

tcz: Ahaz hi Jadah pa ahi. Jadah chu Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri pa ahi. Zimri chu Moza pa ahi.
en_web: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
en_kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

tcz: Moza chu Binea pa ahi. Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahiye.
en_web: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
en_kjv: and Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

tcz: Azel hin chapa gup ahingin, aminu chu Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheriah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
en_kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

tcz: Philistineten Israel chunga gal ahin bol tauve; chule Philistinete masanga Israelte ajam gam tauvin ahi. Gilboa molsang chunga gal alel’uvin akijam chap jeng tauvin ahi.
en_web: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
en_kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

tcz: Philishtineten Saul le achapate ajamnauva apha uvin, hichun achapa thum-Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malkishua ho chu athat tauve.
en_web: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
en_kjv: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

tcz: Saul din gal kisat chu adou hah cheh cheh jeng tan, chuin Philistine thalpi kapthem mihon ma Saul chu amudoh’uvin chule melse tah’in amavouvin ahi.
en_web: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
en_kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

tcz: Hichun Saul’in jong agalvonpopa jah’a aseiyin, “Nachemjam satdoh jengin lang neithat pai jengin, achuti louva ahileh hiche cheptanlou Philistine mite khu hung uvin tin kichepna einei diu ahitai,” ati. Ahivanginla agalvonpopan chutia bol jeng ding chu atijat behseh jeh’in anompon aboldeh tapoi. Hiche jehchun Saul’in jong achemjam akisadoh jengin, achunga alhun akibah lut jenge.
en_web: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
en_kjv: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

tcz: Hichea hi agalvon popanjong Saul thi amudoh phat’in ama jong achemjam chunga akibah lut pai jengin athi pai pai tai.
en_web: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
en_kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

tcz: Hitobang hin Saul le achapa mi thum hochu chumun’a chun abonchan athi khom cheh tauvin, alenggam vaihomna phat sungu jong ahung kichai tai.
en_web: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
en_kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

tcz: Hichun Jezreel Phaichama cheng Israel mite leh asepai teu ajam gamtauvin, Saul le achapate jong athitauve, ti amudoh phat’uvin achennau khopi jouse adalhauvin ajam gamtauve. Chuin Philistinete ahung kitol lut’uvin akhopi ho chu alotauve.
en_web: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
en_kjv: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

tcz: Ajing nikho’a Philistine mite chu mithi long chomdoh’a ahunguva ahileh, Saul le achapate long chu Gilboa molsanga amudoh tauve.
en_web: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon jong Saul galvon chu ahoh lhauvin, chule alu jong akitan lhah tauve. Chuin amahon ami lim doi houvu leh Philistia gamsung pumpia mitin henga Saul athi kipana thu alhangsam lele tauvin ahi.
en_web: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
en_kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

tcz: Amahon Saul galvon chu a Pathen lim semthu ho hou-in sunga akoiyun, chule alu jong chu Dagon hou-in sunga atah’uvin ahi.
en_web: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
en_kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

tcz: Hinlah Jabesh- Gilead khoa cheng mitakip’in Philistineten Saul abolnau ajah doh phat’uvin,
en_web: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
en_kjv: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

tcz: Agal-hang lai jouse akipat’uvin Saul tahsa along le achapate long jouse chu abonchauvin Jabesh khoa ahinpo lut soh keiyuvin ahi. Chujongle agubuh jouseu chu Jabesh khopia gangpi phung noiya avuiyun, ni sagi sungin an angol’uvin ahi.
en_web: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
en_kjv: they arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

tcz: Hitobang tah hin Saul chun Pakai thupeh anit pon, chule gaochang mi pou adong len, iti chon ding ham, ti doh ding agopon ahi. Hichejeh’a chu Pakaiyin ama chu athadoh’a, lenggam chu Jesse chapa David joh apeh ahitai.
en_web: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
en_kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it;

tcz: Hichun Israel mipite chu Hebron khopia David heng ah chun ahung uvin, keiho hi nangma tahsa tahle thisan kahiuve atiu vin ahi.
en_web: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
en_kjv: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

tcz: Masang Saul leng ana hi laia jong nangma hi Israel te gal lamkai ana hijing jeng nahi, chule Pakai na Pathen in nasei pih banga nangma hi Israel mipi kelngoi chingpha le lamkai dia lhendoh nahi.
en_web: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
en_kjv: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

tcz: Hiti chun Hebron mun’a chun David in Pakai le Israel upa ho masang ah kitepna theng ana sem in ahi. Hichea Pakai in Samuel kom’a anasei bang chun David chu Israel te dia leng ding in thaonu ana hin ahi.
en_web: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
en_kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

tcz: Chujouvin David le Israel mipi techun Jerusalem chulai phat’a jebus tiajong ana kihe mun chu ana nokhum un anasat uve. Hilai chu Jebus mite gamnei dihtah te chen na gam ahi.
en_web: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
en_kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

tcz: Chule Jebus miten David chu akhopi sung’u alut ding ana nom povin ahi. Ahivang inla David in Zion kulpi tua David khopi tia kihe mun lai chu ana lotan ahi.
en_web: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
en_kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

tcz: David in asepai miho kom’a hitin asei e. Koi hijong leh Jebus mite kisat pia hinthat masa pen aumleh ka sepai jalamkai luboh’a pang ding ahi ati. Hichun Jebus mite hinsat’a that masapen in Joab kitipa David sopinu Zuriah chapa chu ahung hitoh kilhon in, David gal lamkai panmun masapen chu ana chang tan ahi.
en_web: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
en_kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

tcz: David in kulpi chu chenna in, amang in hichu David khopi tin akikou e.
en_web: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
en_kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

tcz: David in akhopi chu nisolam’a pat avel dung jouse chu akehlet be in ana semtoh in ahi. Chule Joab in amoh chengse chu ana semphan ahi.
en_web: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
en_kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

tcz: Hatchung nung Pakaiyin apan pi jih’in David thaneina chu ahung hatdoh cheh cheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.
en_kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.

tcz: Amaho hi David galhang lamkai’a pang Israel mipi toh kitho khom a Pakaiyin ana kitep na banga David aleng diuva hin tungdoh ding ho chu ahiuve.
en_web: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.
en_kjv: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

tcz: David gal-hang lamkai minthang ho chu hiche ho hi ahiuve. Amasapen chu ahile Jashobeam kitipa Hachmon mi David gal hat mi thumho lah’a lamkai ahi. Amapa hin achemjam mangcha in akidoupi galmi mi jathum chu khatvei in ana that jou in ahi.
en_web: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
en_kjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lift up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

tcz: Anina pen chu ahileh Ahoah son chilhah Dodai chapa Eleazar ahi.
en_web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
en_kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

tcz: Amapa hi Pas-dam'mim a Philistine te ana kisat lai’u chun galmun’a hi David toh ana kitho khom lhon ahi. Chule hiche galmun hi sakol chang dimset ana ke khah jeh chun Israel mite chu anajam tauve.
en_web: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
en_kjv: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

tcz: Ahivang in Eleazar le David hi galmun’a kon nung chon louvin Philistine mite chu anasat lhon in ahi. Chule Pakaiyin amani ana huhdoh in minthang tah in galjona sangtah jong ana chang lhon e.
en_web: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
en_kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.

tcz: Sepai lamkai minthang somthum lah a thum hochu David Adulam songkoa anaum lai chun Raphiam phaicham a Philistine sepai ho toh ana kimu touvin ahi.
en_web: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
en_kjv: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

tcz: David hi chuche phatlai chun akulpi sunga ana um'in ahi. Chule Philistine miten Bethlehem khopi anatou phaovin ahi.
en_web: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
en_kjv: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth-lehem.

tcz: David in amite jah’a chun hitin aseije, Ohe koitabang eingailu toukhat aum a hiche Bethlehem kelkot phunga twitheng khu eigathal peh thei hile tin aseije .
en_web: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
en_kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate.

tcz: Hichun galhat lamkai thumho chun Philistine bang chu apal keh un, Bethlehem kulpia um twi chu David don ding in ahinle choi pih uve. Ahivang in David in hiche twi chu don louvin Pakai a ding joh in ana kat doh in ahi.
en_web: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
en_kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,

tcz: Pathen in hiche twi hi kadon lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche twi hi ahinkho phal ngam’a twi thal a che ho thisan mantam tah toh kibang ahi tin aseijin, David in twi chu anadon pon ahi. Hichu galhang mithum ho natoh lolhin na vetsahna ahi.
en_web: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
en_kjv: and said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

tcz: Abi'shai hi Joab sopipa lamkai somthum ho lah a pang ahi. Amapa hin achem jam keoseh mangchan akidoupi agalmi mi jathum jen chu ana that jouvin ahi. Hichea kon chun galhat mithum ho bang in ahung minthang tan ahi.
en_web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
en_kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

tcz: Abi'shai hi galhat mithum ho lah a apan jou lou vang'in mi somthum ho lah a hin lamkai minthang tah khat ahi.
en_web: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
en_kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah kiti galhang tah Kabzeel kho a kon mi khat jong ana um e, Amapa hin mihat tah ho natoh jong aboldoh in ahi hiche lah’a chu Moab mite galhang mini jong ana that in; chule buhbang lhah lai ni jingkah in jong Keipi bahkai khat jong ana that e.
en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
en_kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

tcz: Aman achang seh in khetbuh mai mangchan Egypt galhang milentah asan dan feet sagi le akeh khat’a sang tengcha lentah kichoija galvon lhingset’a kivon pachu ana that in ahi. Benneah in Egypt mipa tengcha chu alah peh in, ama thanan anei e.
en_web: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
en_kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and pluckt the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

tcz: Hitobang thil nasatah ahinbol doh’a kon hin mi minthang galhang thumho bang in ahung loupi doh e.
en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
en_kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

tcz: Hiti chun amahi mi thumho lah a apan lou vang'in somthum ho sang in, jana sangtah ana chang in chule David in ama vengtup a lamkai din apan sah tan ahi.
en_web: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
en_kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

tcz: David sepai mihat ho chu ahileh Joab sopipa Asahel toh Bethlehem kho a kon Dodo chapa Elha'nan toh ahiuve.
en_web: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
en_kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

tcz: Harod kho kon Shammoth le Pelon mi Helez jong ahi.
en_web: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
en_kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

tcz: Teko'a khoa Ikkesh chapa Ira jong ahin, Anathoth kho a mi Abi-zer jong ahi.
en_web: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
en_kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,

tcz: Hushath mi Sibbecai ahin Ahoh kho a kon Ilai jong ahi.
en_web: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
en_kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

tcz: Netoph'ah mi Ma'harai ahin, Netophiah mi Ba'anah chapa Heled jong ahi.
en_web: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
en_kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

tcz: Benjamin chate gamsung Gib'eah kho a Ribai chapa Ithai jong ahin, chule Pirathon kho a kon Bena'iah jong ahi.
en_web: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
en_kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

tcz: Gash luidung a kon Hurai jong ahin, Ar'bath kho a kon Abi'el jong ahi.
en_web: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
en_kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

tcz: Baha'rum khoa mi Az'maveth jong ahin, Sha'al'bon kho a mi Eli'ahba jong ahi;
en_web: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
en_kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

tcz: Gizon kho a kon Hashem ahin, Harar khoa mi Shagee chapa Jonathan jong ahi,
en_web: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
en_kjv: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

tcz: Harar khoa mi mama Sachar chapa Ahi'am ahin, Ur chapa Eli'phal jong ahi;
en_web: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
en_kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

tcz: Mecherath kho a mi Hepher ahin, Pelon mi Ahi'jah jong ahi,
en_web: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
en_kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

tcz: Carmel kho a Hezro ahin,Ezbai chapa Na'arai ahi,
en_web: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
en_kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

tcz: Nathan sopipa Jo'el ahin,Hagri chapa Mibhar ahi,
en_web: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
en_kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

tcz: Ammon mi Zelek ahin, Be'eroth kho mi Na'harai ahi, amahi Zeru'iah chapa galvonpoa pang ahi,
en_web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
en_kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

tcz: Ithir kho kon Ira ahin, Ithir kho a mi ma ma Gareb ahi;
en_web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
en_kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

tcz: Hit mi Uri'ah ahin, Ahlai chapa Zabad jong ahi ,
en_web: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
en_kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

tcz: Reuben phung a kon Shiza chapa Ad'ina ahin, ama jong hi Reuben chate lah a lamkai khat ahin, Sepai som thum apui ye,
en_web: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
en_kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

tcz: Maacah chapa Hanan ahin,Mathan mi Josh'aphat ahi,
en_web: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
en_kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

tcz: Asterath kho a mi Uzzi'a ahin Aro'er mi Shama le Je-i-el ahilhon e,
en_web: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
en_kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

tcz: Shimri chapa Jedi'a-el le asopipa Joha ahilhon in, Tiz kho mi ahi cheh lhon e,
en_web: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
en_kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

tcz: Mahav mi Eli'el ahin, chule El'na-am chapa teni Jer'ibai le Joshavi'ah ahilhon e, chule Moab mi Ithmah jong ahi,
en_web: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
en_kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

tcz: Chujongle Mezoba kho mi Eli'el le Obed toh chule Ja-asi'el ahiuve.
en_web: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
en_kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

tcz: Kish chapa Saul kom Ziklag mun a ana kisel lai a David toh ana umkhom ho chu galhang mi David toh gal anasat khom ho chu ahiuve.
en_web: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
en_kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

tcz: Hiche miho hi Benjamin phung a kon Saul sopite ahiuvin thalpi kap them cheh chule akhut jetle vei mangcha thei a songchang bom kap them cheh mi ahiu ve.
en_web: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
en_kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

tcz: Gabiah mi Shemah chapa Ahiezar hi amaho dia lamkai pipu pen ahin amanoi bantah a lamkai chu Joash ahi. Chule Azmaoth chapateni Pelet le Jeziel, Bareah le Anathoth kho a kon Jehu jong ahi.
en_web: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
en_kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

tcz: Gebeon a kon Ishmiah kitipa hi galhang somthum ho lah a lamkai le kinthang pen ahi. Chule Gederah kho a kon Jerrmiah, Jahaziel, Johanan le Jozabad ahiuve.
en_web: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
en_kjv: and Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

tcz: Haruph kho a kon Eluzai, Jeremoth, Beliah, Shemariah le Sephatiah ahiuve.
en_web: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;
en_kjv: Eleuzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

tcz: Korahites phung a kon Elkanah , Issiah, Azarel, Joezor le Jashobeam ahi.
en_web: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
en_kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

tcz: Gedor a kon Jeroham chapateni Joelah le Zebediah ahi.
en_web: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
en_kjv: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

tcz: David gamthip noi kulpi a anaum laiyin Gad nammite galhang galbol them cheh ho chun ana pan piu vin ahi. Amaho chu lumchoije le tengcha kho themcheh Keipi bahkai bang a gin umtah chule sakhi golpai bang a chom jangkhai jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
en_kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains:

tcz: Ezer chu lamkai pipu pen ahin anichan na chu Obadiah ahin, athum chan na chu Eliab ahi.
en_web: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
en_kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

tcz: Mishmamnah chu ali chan na ahin chule Jeremiah chu angana ahi.
en_web: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
en_kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

tcz: Agup channa chu Attai ahin, chule sagi chan na chu Eliel ahi.
en_web: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
en_kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

tcz: Aget channa chu Johanan ahin chule ako channa chu Elzabed ahi.
en_web: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
en_kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

tcz: Jeremiah chu asom channa ahin, Macbannai chu somle khat chan na ahi.
en_web: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
en_kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

tcz: Amaho hi Gad mite galhang lamkai pipu cheh ngen ahiuvin ahi. Chule anem nung pen chu sepai jakhat ahiuvin asang jo pen ho chu sangkhat vel ahiuve .
en_web: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
en_kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

tcz: Hiche mite ho chu kum kihei kumbul a Jordan vadung letlha hel la twi hunglon chun vapam achen nao mun a kon in solam le lhumlam gam a ana homkhen uvin ahi.
en_web: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
en_kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

tcz: Chule adangho Benjamin le Judah phung mite chu David kulpi a chun ahung un ahi.
en_web: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
en_kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

tcz: Chuin David jong amaho kimu pin ahung pot in, hitin asei e. Kipah tah a keima kithopi dia hung nahiu le eiho loikhat ihiuve. Amavang kagal mite angsung a keima pedoh ding a hung nahiule vang kapului-u Pathen in nangho chunga gotna napeh diu ahi.
en_web: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
en_kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

tcz: Chuin Amasai kitipa somthum ho lah a lamkai pachu lhagao houpi na achangin hitin asei e, “Jesse chapa David keiho nang a kahiuve, nagma lam a pang ding kahiuve, chamnale phatthei nan najui jing hen chule nangma nakithopi jouse jong lolhing uhen ajehchu Pathen in nangma napanpi ahi.” Hitichun David in amaho chu akiloipin asepaite chung a lamkai ding in jong apansah tan ahi.
en_web: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
en_kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, And on thy side, thou son of Jesse: Peace, peace be unto thee, And peace be to thine helpers; For thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

tcz: David Philistine te toh kithokhom a gal ana konlai chun Manasseh chate Israel sepai ten jong ana pan piu vin ahi. Ahivang in Philistine sepai lamkai ho chun David hi nikhokhat le Saul lang joh a hung pang a eiho suh gam le elol u tan a hung pang thei ahi atiuvin David toh kilhon khom jing chu ana nom tapouvin anasol mang tauve.
en_web: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
en_kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

tcz: David ziglak a ana kile Manasseh chaten David anajop ho chu ahile Adnah , Jozbed, Jedial, Michael Jozabed , Elihu le Zillethai ahiuve. Amaho lamkai nanoi a Manasseh phung a kon sepai mi sangkhat ahiuve.
en_web: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
en_kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho hin David chung a gal hinbol gamho jouse chu hatah in ana dou un ana kisat piuvin ahi. Chule amahohi mihangsan tah galhang lamkai thei cheh ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
en_kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

tcz: Chule aniseh in David lang a pang ding le akithopi ding sepai akibe jing in, Pathen sepai tampi bang a ahung umdoh kahsen mi ahung kikhom jing e.
en_web: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
en_kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

tcz: Pakai thupeh dungjui a saul lenggam vaipohna pumpi David chansah ding a Hebron khopia hung kikhom doh sepai ami mong monga akihop jat-u hicheng hi ana hiuve.
en_web: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
en_kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

tcz: Juda phung sung a kon galvon le tengcha thothei cheh mi sang gup le jaget alhing e.
en_web: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
en_kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

tcz: Chule Simeon phung a galhang galsat thei cheh agom a mi sang sagi le jakhat alhing e.
en_web: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
en_kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

tcz: Levi phung a kon galhang mi sangli le jagup alhing in ahi.
en_web: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Hichea hin Aaron insung a kon Jehoaida lamkai nanoi a mi sangthum le jasagi alhing e.
en_web: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
en_kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

tcz: Chule Zadok kiti galbol mihang santah insung a kon in jong gallamkai cheh mi somni le ni alhing e.
en_web: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
en_kjv: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

tcz: Benjamin phung a kon a Saul inkote galsat sepai mi sangthum ahiuvin chule amaho lah a atam jo hi Benjamin insungmi a kon Saul lam a pang ana hi jing uve.
en_web: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.
en_kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

tcz: Ephriam phung a kon in jong galsat hangsan tah mi sang somnile get alhing in chule ama hung kondoh na phunggui sung a dia jong jaum tah le mi minthang cheh ahiuve.
en_web: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
en_kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

tcz: Manasseh namkeh khat Jordan lhumlam a kon sepai sang somle sang get umho chun David leng ahung hi nading in ana kitho piu vin ahi.
en_web: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
en_kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

tcz: Issachar mite le a insungmi a kon in jong lamkai mi jani ana lhing e. Hiche miho jouse hi Israel te chung a thil hunglhung ding le phat kihei dan ho hetthem nanei cheh mi ahiuve.
en_web: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
en_kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

tcz: Zebulun phung a kon in jong galbol a them tah galhang sepai mi sang nga alhing e. Amaho hi David toh kitho khom a galsat dia galman chah toh kigo sa cheh ahiu vin ahi.
en_web: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
en_kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

tcz: Naphtali phung a kon in jong galhang cheh galman chah lhingset a lumpho le tengcha mangcha thei sepai lamkai mi sangkhat le galsat sepai mi sangthum le jasagi alhing uve.
en_web: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
en_kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

tcz: Dan phung sung a kon in jong galmun a dia kigo sadem a galsat ding mi sang somni le sang get le jagup alhing uve.
en_web: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Asher phung a kon in jong galbol dan kichuh sepai sang somli jong galsat dia kigo sa ahiuve.
en_web: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
en_kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

tcz: Chule Jordan vadung nisolam a kon in jong Gad mite le Reuben phung mite chule Manasseh nam kehkhat chu galsat dia manchah chom cheh kichoi lhingset sepai mi sang jakhat le sang somni alhing uve.
en_web: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
en_kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

tcz: Hebron mun hinjon a galsat dia kigosadem a um sepai tampi ho ahiuvin chule Isareal mipi jousen jong David chu Isareal pumpia a leng ding in adeisah soh kei uve.
en_web: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
en_kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

tcz: Chuin ainsungmi asopiten David chu vailhun na ding thil ijakai agong toh uvin nithum sung in David toh ann nehkhom le lengpitwi donkhom na anei uve.
en_web: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
en_kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

tcz: Avel a um Isachar, Zebulun le Naphtali ho cheng in jong sangan le sangongsao chule sakol pol le bongchal ho chu neh ding poh nan amang chaovin ahi. Chule nehding don ding changlhah hihen theichang ga changlhah, bongchal, kelngoi le kelcha ho geiyin golnop bol nadin ahinpolut uvin ahi. Hichu Israel pumpia ding a kipa golnop loupi tah ana hin ahi.
en_web: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
en_kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

tcz: David in asepai sangkhat chung a lamkai hole jakhat chung a lamkai ho chu thu adong toh soh kei in ahi.
en_web: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
en_kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

tcz: Chuin aman Israel mite jouse kom a chun hitin asei e, “Nangho le Pakai Pathen lunglam ahile Israel mite chenna jouse a Thempu ho le levi mite jaona a ibon chaova iki-khop khom soh theina diu vin thu lhangsapna nei u hite,” ati.
en_web: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
en_kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

tcz: Saul lengvai poh lai in Pathen kitepna thingkong chu nahsah mon ana umjongleh tuhi anung lahphat tah chu ahi.
en_web: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
en_kjv: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we inquired not at it in the days of Saul.

tcz: Akihoukhom mipi jousen hichu pha asah utoh kilhon in abon chaovin boldin kinopto na anei taove.
en_web: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
en_kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

tcz: Hitichun David in Pathen thingkong chu nung put lut kit na ding in Kiriath Jeriam mun a kon in muntin a Israel mite aumnao Egypt lhanglam gam shehor vadung a pat chule sahlam gam Lebohamath khopi vel dung a kon abon'uva ahung kikhop khom nadiu vin kouna anei in ahi.
en_web: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
en_kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

tcz: Pathen thingkong nunglah kit nading in David le Israel mite chun Judah gam Baalah Kiriath jeriam tiajong kikou mun a chun ana cheu vin ahi.
en_web: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
en_kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

tcz: Chuin amahon Pathen thingkong chu Abinadab insung a kon in ahin la doh un bongkang thah leh a akoi uve. Chule hiche bongkang chu Uzzah le Ahio tenin ahin tol lhon in ahi.
en_web: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
en_kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

tcz: Hichun David le Israel mipite chun Pathen ang ah kipah le thanom tah in la asauvin, selangdah le semjang asaiyun, khongle dah chule kipa khutbeh toh thon saki pengkul ana mut uvin ahi.
en_web: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
en_kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

tcz: Ahivang in amahon Nacon changphol lai ahin phah u chun bongchal chu ahung kipal lhun Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chu tuh ding in akhut ana lhang in ahi.
en_web: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
en_kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

tcz: Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chung a akhut ajah a pat in achung a Pakai lunghan na ana chutan hijeh chun Pathen in Uzzah adeng in ama angsung a ana thiden tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
en_kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

tcz: Pakai in Uzzah chung a alunghan na aphon jal jeh chun David jong analung nalheh jeng in ahi. Hijeh chun David in hilai mun chu Perez- Uzzah asah in ahi, hichu Uzzah kisuh gep namun tin tuni gei in akikou in ahi.
en_web: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
en_kjv: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

tcz: Chule David kicha tah a aumphat chun Pathen adong in aseitai. Pathen thing kong chu eti keiman kaga nunglah kit a kakom a kakoi ngam ding ham ati.
en_web: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
en_kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

tcz: Hijeh chun David injong Pathen thingkong chu David khopia poh lut joh sangin Gath mipa Obed-edom insung a analhut jotan ahi.
en_web: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
en_kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen thingkong chu lhathum Obed-edom insung a ana umden in hiche sung chun Pakai in Obed-edom insung mite chu anatoh nalam cheh uva phatthei anaboh in ahi.
en_web: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
en_kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

tcz: Tyre gam a leng Hiram in asottole a pang thingthem bol le songkhen them ho chu Cedar thing ho a David inpi sah pih ding in ana sol in ahi.
en_web: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
en_kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

tcz: Chule Pakai in israel pumpi a lengdia atun a amite Israelte ding a aleng gam phatthei na aboh chu David in jong ana geldoh tan ahi.
en_web: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
en_kjv: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lift up on high, because of his people Israel.

tcz: Chujouvin David in Jerusalem a chun ji akipui be in chanu le chapa jong tampi anei kit in ahi.
en_web: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
en_kjv: And David took moe wives at Jerusalem: and David begat moe sons and daughters.

tcz: Amaho hi David in Jerusalem’a anahinsa achapate chu ahiuve: Shammu, Sobad, Nathan, Solomon
en_web: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
en_kjv: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

tcz: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet
en_web: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
en_kjv: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

tcz: Noqah, Nepheg, Japhia
en_web: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
en_kjv: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

tcz: Elishma, Beeliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
en_web: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
en_kjv: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

tcz: David Israel pumpia a leng chan ding chu Philistine miten ajah phat uvin Philistine sepai ho chu David man ding in ahung kon uvin ahi, David in jong hiche thu ajah phat chun ama ho kimaito pi din akondoh pai kit in ahi.
en_web: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.
en_kjv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

tcz: Hiti chun philistine sepai ho chun gang tah in Raphiam phaicham chu ahin nokhum pai jeng un ahi.
en_web: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
en_kjv: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

tcz: Hichun David in Pathen adong in, “Hiche Philistine te khu gasat leng achung'uva galjona neichan sah ding ham?” ati. Chuin Pakai in adonbut in, “Chenlang gasat in achung'uva galjo na nachan ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
en_kjv: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

tcz: Hichun David le asepai techu Baal-Perazim lam jon in akitol uvin Philistine techu agasat uvin ana jou tauve. Chuin David in hitin asei e, “Pathen in kamelmate chung a twisuh long bang a kalonkhum na din eina mang chai,” ati. Hijehchun hichelai mun hi Baal-perazam ana kisah in ahi.
en_web: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
en_kjv: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

tcz: Chuin Philistine te anajam uvin milim doi Pathen semthu ana dalhah hou chu David in ana hal vam sah in ahi.
en_web: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
en_kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burnt with fire.

tcz: Ahivang in Philistine techun hetman lou kah in phaicham chu ahin nokhum paikit uvin ahi.
en_web: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
en_kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

tcz: Hijeh chun David injong ipi bol ding hitam tin Pathen adong kit in ahile Pathen in amaho nungjui kit lou in amasang lam uva kon a ahinle del khum a balsom thingphung a hinno khum un tin asei e.
en_web: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
en_kjv: Therefore David inquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

tcz: Nangman thingleh vum lang a pat mitampi kijot kengto gin najah teng pot inlang galsat pan jeng in ajeh chu Pathen in Philistine sepaite satgam nadia nangma nahin panpi ding chu avetsah ahi.
en_web: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
en_kjv: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

tcz: Hitichun David in jong Pathen thupeh bang in abollin ahile Philistine sepaite chu Gibeon a kipat in Gezer chan in ana del jam suh in ahi.
en_web: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
en_kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

tcz: Chuin muntin jousea David ahung minthan phat in Pakai in David chu namjouse te ginle ja in aum sah tan ahi.
en_web: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
en_kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.

tcz: David in akhopi a chun injong tampi anasa in chule Pathen thingkong koi nading jong ponbuh phatah ana song in ahi.
en_web: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
en_kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

tcz: Hichun David in hitin asei e Pathen thingkong pudia chu Pakai deilhen Levi mite tailou chu akin bol a pangthei lou ding ahi ati.
en_web: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
en_kjv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

tcz: Hichun David in Pakai thingkong koina dingmun semna a pulut ding in Jerusalem khopi a um Israel mite chu ana kou in ahi.
en_web: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
en_kjv: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

tcz: Hiche a anakikou miho chu ahile Aaron thempu le Levi chate ho ahiuve.
en_web: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
en_kjv: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

tcz: Uriel lamkai na akon in Kohath nambah ami jakhat le somni ahin ,
en_web: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
en_kjv: of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

tcz: Asaiah lamkai na a Meraei nambah akon mi janile somni ahi,
en_web: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
en_kjv: of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

tcz: Joel lamkai na akon Gerahon nambah mi jale somthum alhing uve,
en_web: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
en_kjv: of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

tcz: Elizaphan son chilhah akon Shemaiah lamkaina mi jani alhing e,
en_web: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
en_kjv: of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

tcz: Hebron son chilhah a kon Eliel lamkai na in mi somget alhing uve,
en_web: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
en_kjv: of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

tcz: Aminadab lamkai na in Uzziel chilhah techu mi jale somleni ma alhing uve.
en_web: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
en_kjv: of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

tcz: Chuin David in thempu ho Zadok le Abiathar chule Levi mite lah a kon in Uriel, Asaiah, Joel ahin Shemaiah ahin Eliel le Aminadab ho chu akou khom soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
en_kjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

tcz: David in amaho kom a chun hitin asei e; “Nangho Levi insung mite dia lamkai pipui nahiu ve. Hijeh chun Israel Pathen pakai thingkong chu akoina ding a kagotna mun a nahin nungput kit nadiu vin nang ho ahin chule nainsungmite cheng nabon un kisutheng un,” ati.
en_web: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
en_kjv: and said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

tcz: Pakai ina-doh lou jeh’u chun Pakai vantil Pathen lunghan na ichung uva ana chu’in Levi mite chun thingkong chu nana pohlut thei lou-u ahi.
en_web: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
en_kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

tcz: Hijeh chun thempu ho le Levi mite jouse chun Israel Pathen Pakai thingkong Jerusalem mun’a putdoh nadin kilhai na ana nei uvin ahi.
en_web: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
en_kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.

tcz: Chuin Pakai in Mose athuhil bang chun Levi miten Pathen thingkong chu moljol in alengkou un ahin pu uvin ahi.
en_web: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
en_kjv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.

tcz: Hichun David in jong lamkai ho chu thu apen Levi mite lasathem le tumging them hon kipa lasah a tumging le semjang sai a khutbeh gintho ding in asei e.
en_web: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
en_kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

tcz: Chuin Levi hon jong Joel chapa Heman Levi tetoh sopi Merari nambah sung a kon Berekiah chapa ahin, Kushaiah chapa Ethan ho cheng ana pan sah uvin ahi.
en_web: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
en_kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

tcz: Chule amaho noi bantah a ding in Zacharaiah, Zaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehid, Unni, Eliab, Bennaiah, Massaiah, Mattithiah, Eliphileh, Mikniah le kotkhah ngah a pang Obed-edom le Jeiel ho chu ana pansah uvin ahi.
en_web: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
en_kjv: and with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

tcz: Tumging them lah a Heman , Asaph le Ethan ho chu sumeng semjang sai ding in ana lheng uvin,
en_web: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
en_kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

tcz: Chule Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Measaiah le Benaiah ho cheng chu selang dah sai din ana lheng doh uvin ahi.
en_web: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
en_kjv: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

tcz: Chule Mittithiah, Elipelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel chule Azaziah ho chu la aw lhingsetna sahna kimang semjang saidin apan sah uve.
en_web: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
en_kjv: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

tcz: Chuin Levite lah a lamkai Kenaiah hi lasah lambolthei tah ahijeh chun la lamkai din apan sah uve.
en_web: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
en_kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

tcz: Chule Pathen thingkong vengtup ding in Berekaiah le Elkanah chu ana pansah uve.
en_web: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
en_kjv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
