tcz: Shebanaiah, Joshephat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zecharaiah, Beniah le Eliezer ho cheng hin Pathen thingkong mai a kitol uva saki a kisem pengkul amut diu ahi, chule Obed-edom le Jehiah chu Pathen thingkong kotngah in apan sah uve.
en_web: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
en_kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

tcz: David le Israel upate chule sepai lamkai pipuho chun Pakai kitepna thingkong chu Jerusalem a ahin pohlut a loupi tah a kipa pi ding in Obed-edom inpia chun ana cheuve.
en_web: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
en_kjv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Levi mite akithopi a, amahon Pakai kitepna thingkong ahin pohlut jeh u chun bongchal sagi le kelngoi sagi kilhai nan anathat uve.
en_web: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

tcz: David le Levi mite Pakai thingkong pua pang ahin, lasa a pang ho le la lamkai Kenaniah ho chu tupat ponnem in ana kivon uve. David jong chun thempu ho lengban khat jong ana kiban in ahi.
en_web: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
en_kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

tcz: Hiti chun Israel mite chun kipana aw thong’a sampum le sumkon gin le saki mutgin chule khutbeh beng ginle semjang saiging tho in Pakai kitepna thingkong chu ahin pulut uvin ahi.
en_web: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
en_kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

tcz: Pakai kitepna thingkong David khopia ahin pohlut u chun, Saul chanu Michal in in bang kot apat ahin vetsuh le leng David kipa thanop thoa achop le chu amun ana japi in ahi.
en_web: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

tcz: Hichun amahon Pathen thingkong chu David in akoina dia ponbuh hoitah ason namun a chun ahin polut uvin ahi. Chua chun amahon Pathen a kilhai na pumgo thilto jong ana kat uvin ahi.
en_web: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
en_kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

tcz: David in kilhaina kin aneijou in amite chu Pakai min in phatthei aboh in ahi.
en_web: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

tcz: Chujouvin aman ami Israel te numei pasal abonchauvin changlhah alhang a kisem ahin, lengpithei ga’a kisem nehthei ana peh ahi.
en_web: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
en_kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

tcz: David in Levi mite chu Pakai thingkong maiya Israel Pathen Pakai phattheina sima, a vahchoi lasah le thangvah ding in mipi jouse lamkai din ana pansah e.
en_web: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
en_kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:

tcz: Asaph chu amaho lah a lamkai ahin, amahin lasah na a kimang tumging sumeng kivo ging asai yin ahi. Amaban tah’a chu Zechariah ahin chule ama kithopi ding in Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom le Jeiel ahiuve. Amaho hi semjang le selangdah sai a pang ahiuve.
en_web: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
en_kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

tcz: Chule Pathen thingkong kitepna masang a chun thempu Benaiah le Jahaziel chun tanglouvin sumkon ana mut lhon in ahi.
en_web: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
en_kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

tcz: David in hiche nikho chun Asaph le ami Levite chutoh Pakai a kipa na thangvah na lasah na ana peu vin ahi.
en_web: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
en_kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

tcz: Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin chule aloupina seiphong uvin vannoi leiset pumpin athibol jouse hecheh hen,
en_web: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
en_kjv: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, Make known his deeds among the people.

tcz: Thangvah toh thon ama vahchoi un chule namtin jouse chung a athilbol kidang ho hillhang uvin,
en_web: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
en_kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, Talk you of all his wondrous works.

tcz: Amintheng chu hapah in kipapi un, eiho Pakai mite ehiuve,
en_web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
en_kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

tcz: Tantih neilouvin Pakai thahatna chu holjing unlang hou uvin,
en_web: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
en_kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, Seek his face continually.

tcz: Thil kidang tampi le datmo umtah aboldoh hole athu tan naho geldoh jing un,
en_web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
en_kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

tcz: Nangho alhacha Israel chate ho chule Jacob son chilhah anam deilhen mite ho,
en_web: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
en_kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

tcz: Amahi eiho Pakai Pathen ahi, Ama thupeh dihtah hi vannoi jousen amu ding ahi.
en_web: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
en_kjv: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

tcz: Aman aitih khang chan in jong akitepna agel doh jing in ahi,
en_web: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
en_kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; The word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

tcz: Hiche hi aman Abraham toh kitepna asem chu ahin chule Isaac heng a kitepna ana neichu ahi,
en_web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
en_kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, And of his oath unto Isaac;

tcz: Aman hichu Jacob heng a Israel mite toh aitih khang gei a tonsot'a dia kitep na thulhuh le suhdetna ana nei ahi.
en_web: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
en_kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, And to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

tcz: “Nangma chan ding goulo nading Canaan gam chu kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
en_kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

tcz: Aman hiche aseilai chun nangmaho Canaan gam'a hon lhomcha a khopem bang a nana umlai u ahi, ati.
en_web: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
en_kjv: When ye were but few, Even a few, and strangers in it.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho chu namkhat apat namkhat in anavah uvin chule lenggam khat apat gamdang a ana vah leu ve,
en_web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
en_kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people;

tcz: Chujongle aman amaho chu koima suhgentheina le bolgimna ana neisah pon, amaho jeh in leng dang ho joh thugah na ananei jon ahi,
en_web: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
en_kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

tcz: Kami lhenchomte natohkhah thei loudiu chule kathemgao ho jong nasuh genthei loudiu ahi,
en_web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
en_kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, And do my prophets no harm.

tcz: Leiset pumpin Pakai chu vahchoi hen chule aniseh in ami huh hingna thupha chu seiphong leuvin,
en_web: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
en_kjv: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; Shew forth from day to day his salvation.

tcz: Namtin vaipi lah a athilbol loupi ho phongjal un, chule athilbol kidang ho mitin vaipi hetsah un,
en_web: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
en_kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; His marvellous works among all nations.

tcz: Pakai chu thunei pen ahin amin loupi vahchoi dia lomtah ahi. Chule Pathen dang jouse sang a gin le jadia lom ahi,
en_web: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
en_kjv: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: He also is to be feared above all gods.

tcz: Namtin vaipi dang ho hou hi semthu milim doi Pathen ahi, eiho Pakai vang hi vanlaijol sempa ahi,
en_web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
en_kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: But the Lord made the heavens.

tcz: Jana le lalna jouse le thahatna chule kipana Pakai ama kom a um ahi,
en_web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
en_kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; Strength and gladness are in his place.

tcz: Vannoi namtin vaipin Pakai thahat nale aloupi je chu hecheh hen,
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, Give unto the Lord glory and strength.

tcz: Pakai chu loupina jouse chang dia lom ahi, amuntheng dung jousea Pakai chu thilpeh toh thon houvun,
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come before him: Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

tcz: Leiset mite jouse Pakai masang a tijan kithing jeng hen, leiset jong linglouhel in dettah in ding jing hen,
en_web: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
en_kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: The world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

tcz: Vanna le leiya kipa thanop nan lodim soh hen chule Pakai vaihomna namtin vaipi jousea seiphong leuvin,
en_web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
en_kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: And let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.

tcz: Twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong avah choina sam u hen chule loulai dungle mimle chang ho jong kipah thanom in hung pohjal jeng uhen,
en_web: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
en_kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: Let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

tcz: Gammang thingphung jouse jong kipah lasah in kilingdoh soh hen, Pakai chu leiset na thutan’a ahung teng,
en_web: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
en_kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, Because he cometh to judge the earth.

tcz: Pakai chu aphatna jallin thangvah na peuvin, ama a um tahsan umtah mingailutna chun tonsot'in athoh jing e,
en_web: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; For his mercy endureth for ever.

tcz: “O Pathen eihuh hing paovin namtin vaipi lah a kon in neipui khom uvin lang neihuh doh uvin, chuteng nangma mintheng chu kakipa piuva kavah choi diu ahi.
en_web: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
en_kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, That we may give thanks to thy holy name, And glory in thy praise.

tcz: Pakai Israel Pathen chu vahchoiyun amachu tonsot tonsot gei a hingjing ahi chule amite jousen Pakai chu vahchoi in sam uhen,” Amen.
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.

tcz: Hitichun David in Pakai kitepna thingkong a aniseh a angaichat najouse a natong le ding in Asaph le ama mi Levi mite chu ana pansah in ahi.
en_web: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
en_kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

tcz: Hiche holah a chun Jeduthun chapa Obed-edom, Hosah le Levi mite misom gup le get chu kotkhah ngah in ana pang uve.
en_web: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
en_kjv: and Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

tcz: Chule David in Zadok thempu le Levi mite chu Gibeon gamsung a Pakai Pathen houbuh a kimang cha din ana koi in ahi.
en_web: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
en_kjv: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,

tcz: Pakai in Israel te chung a dan thupeh juidia ana nei bang in amahon Pakai a jingkah nilhah in kilhaina thilpeh maicham jong ana nei uve,
en_web: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
en_kjv: to offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;

tcz: Pakai akitah nale mingailut na tonsot na athoh hat na jallin ama thang vah na pe ding in David in Heman le Jeduthun ana lhengdoh un chule midang ana minphah chan jong ana pang uvin ahi.
en_web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;

tcz: Hitichun amahon sumkon mut ginle khutbeh ginle tumging theijat tampi ho mang chan Pathen anavah choi uve, chule Jeduthun chapa chu kotkhah ngah in ana pansah uve.
en_web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
en_kjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

tcz: Chujouvin mipi jouse chu ama inlam cheh a ana kileu vin David jong ama inlam a ainsung mite phattheiboh ding in ana che tan ahi.
en_web: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
en_kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

tcz: David chu ama inpia ana umlai in Themgao Nathan chu akou in akom a hitin asei e, “Keimala Cedar thing a kisa innom tah a kacheng in, ahivang in Pakai kitepna thingkong vang chu ponbuh a kisa mai mai noi a ana kikoi in ahi.”
en_web: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
en_kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in a house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

tcz: Nathan in adonbut in, “Nalung a um nagel chan chu bollin ajeh chu Pathen in naumpi nai.”
en_web: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
en_kjv: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

tcz: Ahivang in, hicheni jantah chun Pathen in Nathan kom a anasei e,
en_web: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
en_kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

tcz: “Chenlang kasohpa David kom a gahiltan nangma hi keima umna ding munsem ding chu nahipoi’tin ana sei e.”
en_web: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
en_kjv: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in:

tcz: Keiman Egypt gam a kon Israel te kahin pui doh nikho apat tunigei in ka insung a kacheng kha hih laiye, Hiti chun ponbuh a kisong houbuh munkhat a kon mun chom chom a kana ki chon le jin ahi.
en_web: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
en_kjv: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

tcz: Keiman Israel mite toh kilhon khom ding le kamite kelngoi ching a pang lamkai ho kom a jong Cedar thing a kisa in eisah pih diu in jong kana sei kha hyh e.
en_web: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
en_kjv: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me a house of cedars?

tcz: Tun nangma chen lang kalhachapa David kom a hitin gasei tan, “Van Pakai thanei chungnung in hitin aphong doh e,keiman nangma hi hamhing lah a kelngoi ching a napan na’a kon kapuidoh a kami Israel te chung a lamkai dia kapan sah ding nahi, ati.
en_web: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
en_kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

tcz: Chule keiman nangma nache namun jousea kalhonpi jing a, nangma masang a namelmate jouse jong kasuh gam jeng ding leiset chung a mi minthang ho bang a namin kakithan sah ding ahi.
en_web: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
en_kjv: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

tcz: Chule kamite Israel te ding a achen nadiu munjong kapeh ding dettah a lungmongsel a cheng uva koiman jong asuh ling thei loudiu ahi. Namdang ten jong masang a banga asuh mang kit loudiu ahi.
en_web: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
en_kjv: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

tcz: Keiman aphat dungjui a kamite Israel te chung a Lamkai vaihom ding kapan sah jing ding chule namel mateu aboncha kasuh gam ding chuche kal a jong Pakai in naleng gam sung u phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en_web: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.
en_kjv: and since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee a house.

tcz: Nahinkho abei nung a napu napate kom a dia nache nungteng jong le keiman nadalhah nason nachilhah te lah a nachapate khat pen kadopsang ding ahi chule aleng gam jong lentah a kaphudoh peh ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will stablish his kingdom.

tcz: Amapa chun keima ding a houin khat eisah peh ding chule keiman alenggam laltouna chu aitih chan a kaphudet jing ding ahi.
en_web: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
en_kjv: He shall build me a house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

tcz: Hiche mipa ding a chu keima hi apa kahi a ama chu kachapa hiding ahi. Nangma masang a mipa chung a kangailutna kana lahdoh bang a, ama chung a hi kanung lah doh lou ding ahi.
en_web: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
en_kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

tcz: Keiman ama kainsung a le kagamsung a leng a kapan sah ding chule alenggam laltou na chu atonsot geiya kaphudet pih a longlouva umjing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
en_kjv: but I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

tcz: Hiti chun Nathan ahung kile in Pakai in amusah thil hojouse chu David kom a ahung seipeh tan ahi.
en_web: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
en_kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

tcz: Chuin David alut in Pakai angsung a atao vin hitin asei e, “O Pakai Pathen keima hi koi kahi a chule kainsung mite hi ipi hija hichan gei a neihin pui peh jing u ham?
en_web: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
en_kjv: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

tcz: Tun thil hicheng jouse kal val in jong O Pathen, nalhachapa keima khunung a insung thudol khanggui sotpi hunglhung ding jong neisei doh pih in ahi.
en_web: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.
en_kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

tcz: Hitabang a nalhachapa neijabol na hi nangma kom a ipi kasei be nahlai ding ham, nalhachapa keima itobang kahi la neihet soh kei ahitai.
en_web: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
en_kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

tcz: Nalhachapa keima neigel khoh najal le nalungel lam tah bang in kachung a thil loupi tampi mite muthei jin nabol doh in ahi,
en_web: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
en_kjv: O Lord, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

tcz: O Pakai, nang tabang koima dang aumpoi, nangma tabang Pathen dang jong kanei pouve,
en_web: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
en_kjv: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

tcz: Nami Israel nam mite tabang leisetna koidang um am? O Pathen, nangma tah in namite asoh chan nagam a kon in nana huhdoh jeh in namin akithang in ahi, nangman thil kidang tah nabol in namite masang a ding ho jong nana del jam in ahi.
en_web: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
en_kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

tcz: Nangman Israel mite chu nangma mite dih tah mong in nana lheng doh in Pakai nangma chu a Pathen u nahitan ahi,
en_web: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
en_kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.

tcz: O Pakai tunvang keima nalhacha kahitai, keima le ka insungmi chung chang thua nakitepna bang in bol jeng tan chule hiche kitepna hi aitih chan a ding hita hen.
en_web: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
en_kjv: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

tcz: Nangma min kiphut doh henlang mijousen tonsot'in jana pecheh hen chule Pakai thanei chungnung pen Israel Pathen chu Israel Pathen ahi mong e tia kisei ding, nalhachapa David insung jeng jong nangma angsung a phudet a um ding ahi.
en_web: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
en_kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

tcz: O ka Pathen keima hi nangma ang a ngamtah a hungtao a kahi, ajeh chu nalhachapa keima hi ka in ding neisah peh a lenggam khat neitundoh peh ding chu kicheh tah in neimu sah tai.
en_web: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
en_kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him a house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

tcz: O Pakai nangma bou Pathen nahi chule hitabang thilpha tampihi nalhachapa kei ding in kitepna nanei e.
en_web: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
en_kjv: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

tcz: Tunjong nalhachapa insung phatthei naboh a hichu nalhachapa a ding a aitih gei a nangma masang a umjing ding ahi. Ajeh chu O Pakai nangma phathei boh chu ipi hijong le phattheiboh chang jing ding ahi.
en_web: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
en_kjv: now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.

tcz: Chule David in Philistine te ana kisat pin anajou vin Gath khopi le avel a kho umho jong chu analo in ahi.
en_web: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
en_kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

tcz: Chuin David in Moab mite chu ana kisat pin ana joukit in ama khutnoi in aum uvin sum donle kai jong David ana peuvin ahi.
en_web: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
en_kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

tcz: David in jong Euphrates luipang a kon thahattah'a ahung kon toulai uvin Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepai techu Hemanath chan in anasat in ajouvin ahi.
en_web: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
en_kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

tcz: Hitichun David in kangtalai sangkhat anaman in chule kangtalai tol'a pang mi sang sagi ma aman in keng lamjot sepai sang somni ahin chule kangtalai kai a pang sakol jouse akeng atanpih in kangtalai jakhat kaikham bou akhen in ahi.
en_web: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
en_kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

tcz: Chule Aramean mite Damascus khopi a kon a Hadadezer lengpa kithopi dia hung kon ho chu David in mi sang som nile sangni jen ana that in ahi.
en_web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
en_kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

tcz: Hichun David in Aramean gam a Damascus khopi a chun sepai tampi atou sah in, Aramean mite chu David khutnoi in anaum uvin donlekai jong ana peuvin ahi, chule Pakaiyin David chu agal kon nalam jouse a galjona apejing e.
en_web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
en_kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

tcz: David in Hedadezer sepai lamkai ho kipoh sana lum ho jouse chu Jerusalem ah ahin polut'in ahi.
en_web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hadadezer khopi Tebah le Cun a chun David in sumeng tampi ahin kilah in chule Solomon in hiche sum-eng ho chu kisilna twi kong le sum-eng khompi le Pathen houna in a manchah ding thil dang sem nan anei in ahi.
en_web: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
en_kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

tcz: Hamath lengpa Toi in Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepaite jouse David in abonchan ajoutai tithu anajan,
en_web: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
en_kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

tcz: hichun amapan achapa Joram chu David galjona kipapi dingin anasol in ahi. Ajeh chu Hadadezer hin Toi ana kisat pi jing lai ahi, Joram chun David chu thilpeh tampi sana, sumeng le dangka ho anapen ahi.
en_web: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
en_kjv: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

tcz: Leng David in hiche thilpeh hung jouse ahin sumeng le sana namdang mite Edom, Moab, le Amaleke mite kom a ahinlah doh jouse chu abonchan Pakai ading in ana katdoh in ahi.
en_web: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
en_kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Abishai kitipa chun chikhuh phaicham a chun Edom mite mi sangsom le get jen ana that in ahi.
en_web: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
en_kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

tcz: Chuin aman Edom gamsung a chun sepai atousah in chule Edom mite chu David khutnoi in ana um uve, Hitichun David chu ache nachan a Pakaiyin galjona apejing in ahi.
en_web: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
en_kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

tcz: Chujouvin David chu Israel pumpia lengvai pon apang in ama natoh thilbol ho jouse chu ami Isareal te a ding a thilpha le adih jeng ahi e,
en_web: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
en_kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Joab chu sepai lamkai in apang in chule Ahilud chapa Jehosaphet chu thuching le lekha sun in ana pang in ahi.
en_web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
en_kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

tcz: Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimeleche chu thempun apang lhon in chule Seraiah kitipa chu thutanna mun a lekha sun in apang e.
en_web: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
en_kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Beniah chu lengpa veng a pangho chunga vaipon ana pang e, chule David chapate chu lengpa kinbol na a vaihom pipun ana pang uve.
en_web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
en_kjv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou a Ammon mite Lengpa Nahash ahung thi chun achapa Hanun chu leng in ahung pang tai.
en_web: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
en_kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

tcz: David in, “Keiman Hanun chung a hi kakitah na kapoh doh ding ahi, ajeh chu apa Nahash hi keima chung a akitah jing in ahi,” tin asei e. Hiti chun David in Hanun pa thina jeh a lunghem na akon lungmon sah nading in asottol le ho asol in ahivang in David sottolle ho Ammon gam ahung lhun phat in,
en_web: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
en_kjv: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

tcz: Ammon mite lamkai pa chun Hanun kom ah chun, “Nangman hiche mipite hohi napa jabolna jal'a hung a nagel mong ham? Hichu hilou a David in amaho hi agam umdan ho vetoh le a chujouteng le hung kon uva agamsung mite jouse hi nokhum ding lung agot joh ahi,” tin asei e.
en_web: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
en_kjv: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

tcz: Chuin Hanun in David sottolle ho chu aman in asam u avo peh un chule aponsil hou jong akongjang atobuh dung uva achetan peh in abon chaovin David heng a anung sol tauve.
en_web: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
en_kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

tcz: David in amite chunga hitobng thilsoh umchan le asottolle ho ajachat naho thu ajah jeh chun Jericho khopi ah chun akhamul u ahung khandoh kah uva tham den uva chujouteng hung kile ding in asei e.
en_web: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
en_kjv: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

tcz: Ammon mite chun, David lungdou na athilbol u ahetdoh phat u chun Hanun le Ammon mite chun Zoab le Aramaacah chule Ram-naharaim gam a kon sakol touthem sepai le kangtalai tampi thalah nadin dangka talent sangsom sagi le sang nga jen ana thot in ahi.
en_web: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
en_kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

tcz: Chujongle amahon kangtalai sang somthum le ni jong athalah uvin, Maacah le asepai te jong ana kitho piu ve. Chule hiche sepai ho chu Medaba mun a Hanun in amakhopi tah a anapan sah sepai ho toh chun ana umkhom uvin ahi.
en_web: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
en_kjv: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

tcz: David in hichu ajah phat in Joab le asepai gal hang ho chu ama kisat pi din ana sol pai in ahi.
en_web: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
en_kjv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

tcz: Hichun Ammon mite jong ahung kon doh un khopi kelkot phung ah chun galsat ding in ahung kigol doh tauve, chule galsat dia hung kon leng ho jong chun ama hinathei cheh in galsat dia kigot na panmun akisem uvin ahi.
en_web: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
en_kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

tcz: Joab in amelmaten anung ama a ahin nokhum amu doh phat in Israel te sepai hatlai ho chu Aramean sepai te kisat pi ding in alhengdoh in ahi.
en_web: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
en_kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

tcz: Chule aman sepai dang adalhah chengse chu asopipa Abishai lamkai nanoi a Ammon mite kisat pi ding in apan sah e.
en_web: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
en_kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

tcz: Joab in asopipa jah a chun, “Aramean mite chu kahin jolal le neihung kithopi ding chule nang in jong Ammon mite nanjolal le kahung kithopi ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
en_kjv: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

tcz: Hat unlang hangsan tahin pang un e Pathen khopi ule emiteu va ding in gal isat diu ahi. Pakai in ama deilam in hinbol jeng tahen.
en_web: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”
en_kjv: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.

tcz: Joab le asepaiten Aramean mite àsat un anadel jam tauve.
en_web: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
en_kjv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

tcz: Chule Ammon miten Aramean mite jam amu doh phat u chun Abishai a kon in anajam un akhopiuva ana kile tauve.
en_web: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Aramean miten Israel te ajolel u ahetdoh phat uchun Euphrates luipang le avel dung a kon in Aramean sepaite akoukhom in amaho chu abon'un Hadadezer sepai jalamkai pa thunoi in ana um sah uvin ahi.
en_web: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
en_kjv: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

tcz: David in hitobng thilumchan ho ahet doh phat in jordan vadung vel dung a kon jousea Israel sepaite chu galsat din ana kou khom in Aramean mite toh ana kisat tauvin ahi.
en_web: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
en_kjv: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

tcz: Chule Aramean mite chu Israel te a kon in anagal lel un, anajam kit tauvin ahi. Hichea chun David sepai ten Aramean sepai lamkai pipu Shobah pum in sepai kangtalai tol mi sang sagi le kenglam sepai mi sang somli jen ana that uvin ahi.
en_web: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
en_kjv: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

tcz: Hadadezer thunoi a leng umhon jong Israelten gal ajo amudoh phat uvin, David angsung a akipelut uvin ama thunoi in aum tauve, chule Aramean miten aitih a jong Ammon mite akitho pi kit diu anom tapouve.
en_web: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
en_kjv: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

tcz: Chuche kum chavang lai a lengpa galbol dia ahung chun Israel mite chun Job lamkai na noi in Ammon mite anasat uvin ahi. Hichun aman Rabbah khopi chu ana umkhom in ahi. Hinlah David chu Jerusalem ah chun ana umden in ahi.
en_web: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

tcz: David Rabbah khopi ahung lhun in lengpa lallukhuh chu aladoh in aman akikhuh in ahi. Hiche lal lukhuh chu sana pah jem a kisem chule agih dan jong pound som sagi le nga ahi. David in jong thilman tampi khopia chun ahin kipoh in ahi.
en_web: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
en_kjv: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

tcz: Aman Rabbah kho mite chu soh in ana mang in, amaho chu thingat, thih khenchi a leilai le heicha’a thing chan in anapan sah in, Ammon mite chu engbolna ana pen ahi. Chujouvin David le asepaite chu Jerusalem a anache tauve.
en_web: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chujouvin jong Israel te le Philistine techu Gazer mun a gal in ana kisat kit in ahi. Hiche akisat nau va hin, Hushah kho a Sebbecai jin milen galhat minthang ho chilhah a kon Saph kitipa ana that in chule Philistine ten gal analel tauvin ahi.
en_web: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
en_kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

tcz: Philistine te toh gal kisat na mun khat ma ana um kit in, hichea chun Elhanan chapa Jair chun Gath khoa kon Goliath sopipa Lahmi chu anathat in ahi. Chule Lahmi tenglum chu lentah ahi.
en_web: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
en_kjv: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.

tcz: Philistine tetoh Gath khopia gal ana kisat namun uva jong chun milentah galhat mi khut jung gup le keng jung gup nei abon'a somni le li nei khat ana pang e, amahi gollui lai galhang minthang ho son chilhah a kon ahi.
en_web: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
en_kjv: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

tcz: Chule aman Israel mite totnop nale noise tah a anabol jeh chun David sopipa Shimea chapa Jonathan in’a anathat tai.
en_web: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
en_kjv: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

tcz: David in anatha Philistine galhang mite hi Gath kho akon milui galhang ho son chilhah jeng anahiu ve.
en_web: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
en_kjv: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

tcz: Israel douna din, Satan’in Israel chate mijat simdin David lengpa atildoh tai.
en_web: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.
en_kjv: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

tcz: Hijeh hin David nin Joab le a sepai lamkai ho jah ah, “Sahlam gamkai Bersheba apat lhumlam gamkai Dan chan gei Israel mijat gasim uvin lang, nasimdoh jat u chu kaheng’a hinchoi’un, keiman kahet nom’e.
en_web: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
en_kjv: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

tcz: Ahin Joab’in adonbut’in, “Pakaiyin Israel chate ajat ja’n hin punsah hen. Ahin ka Pakai le ka Lengpa, amaho khu namite hilou ham? Iding’a ka Pakaipa’n hiche nabol nom ham? Iding’a Israelte chung’a themmona lhunsah ding nagot ham?” ati.
en_web: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
en_kjv: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many moe as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

tcz: Ahivang’in, lengpan athusei chu apetchah in, hijehchun Joab jong lengpa thupeh nit’in Israel chate chenna gam jousea mijat agasim in Jerusalem ahung kile tai.
en_web: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun ajatsimdoh jat chu David heng’a ahetsah tai. Gaalhang chemjam lamthei cheh chu mi nel khat le sang jakhat alhingin, Judah mite jong Sang jali le sang somsagi alhing uve.
en_web: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
en_kjv: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

tcz: Hiche jatsim ahin Joab in Levi mite le Benjamin mite vang asimtha pon ahi ajehchu, lengpa thupeh chu Joab in ama boldia adeimo behseh jeng ahi.
en_web: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
en_kjv: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

tcz: Hichun, Pathen in mijatsim kibolchu alunghanpi jeh in ami Israelte chu gotna achantan ahi.
en_web: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.
en_kjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

tcz: Chuphat’in David in Pathen jah a hitin aseitai, “Vo Kapathen, keiman nangma doumahtah kaboldoh tai, ngolhoitah hijongle neingaidam kit in,” ati.
en_web: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
en_kjv: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

tcz: Chuphatchun, Pathenin David ding’a mitva neiya pangpa Gad heng’a hitin aseitai,
en_web: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

tcz: “David heng’a gache’n lang Pathen in hitin aseiye tin gaseipeh tan”, gimbolna thum lah a hin khat kilhen inlang, hichu keiman ka guilhun sah teiding ahi”, ati.
en_web: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
en_kjv: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

tcz: Hijeh chun David heng’a Gad ahung’in hitin aseitai, “Pathenin hicheng thum hi nagon pehtai,”
en_web: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:
en_kjv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee

tcz: “Kum thum sung’a kel lhah ding nadei’am, na galmiten chemjam a lhathum sungsea nasuhgam ding nalhen ding ham ahiloule, ni thum sung a gamna hise nasatah a lhung’a nalenggam sung pumpia pakai vantil in namite asuhgam ding hoichi nalhen joh ding ham?” “Eihin solpa Pathen heng’a iti kalhut ding nalhen joh hitam?” ati.
en_web: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”
en_kjv: either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

tcz: “Kadinmun ahahsa valtai” tin David in Gad jah a aseitai. “iti nama jongle mihem khut a kipeh sang’in Ka Pakai, Ka Pathen khut joh’in kipelut tang’e. Ajehchu, amihepina kidangtahchu kakinem nalaiye” ati.
en_web: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”
en_kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

tcz: Hichun, Pathenin Israelte lah a gamna hise alan sah tan, mi sangsom sagi jen in thina atoh tai.
en_web: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
en_kjv: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

tcz: Chuban’a jong, Pathenin Jerusalem sugamhel din mithat vantil ahinsoltan ahileh, akigotjinglai un, Pathenin alung ahin heiyin, vantil jah’a, “Aphaset tai, ngatan” tin aseitai. Chupettah chun, mithat vantil chu Jerusalem chungvum’a ana pansa tan ahi. Hichu Jebus mipa Araunah changphol ahitai.
en_web: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
en_kjv: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

tcz: David in vanlang a Pakai vantil ten chemjam pum a Jerusalem suhgam ding agot u amu phat’in. Israel lamkai pipuho toh kisih pumin tol lang ngan, khaodip ponsil pum’in.
en_web: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
en_kjv: And David lift up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

tcz: Chuin, David in Pathen jah’a aseitai, “Israelte mijatsim ding’a thupeh nei chu keima kahi, abolkhel le achonse chu keima kahi, kamite vang kelngoi bang’a themmona ipi aboldoh u hitam? O ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nalunghanna kei le ka insung mite chung’a chuhsah tan, namite vang sugam hih hel in.
en_web: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
en_kjv: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

tcz: Hichun, Pakai vantil’in Gad jah a David achetou a Jebus mipa Araunah changphol a maichamphung asah din thupeh aneitai.
en_web: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
en_kjv: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

tcz: Hijeh chun David in Gad thulhut bangin Pathen thupeh chu boldin achetou tai.
en_web: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.

tcz: Araunah le achapate mi li chun suhlou chang ana den pettah in Vantil chu amu uvin ahileh, achapate chu akichat jeh un ajam uvin akisel gam taove.
en_web: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
en_kjv: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

tcz: Araunah in David chu changphol ahinphah amu phat’in, a bolban dalhan Lengpa chu ana bohkhup tai.
en_web: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
en_kjv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

tcz: David in Araunah jah a hitin aseitai, “Na Changphol mun hi aman lhingsel keiman nape’ng ting, Pakai maicham phungkhat satang’e, chuteng Pakai lunghan na hiche gimna hise jong thip tante”.
en_web: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
en_kjv: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

tcz: “Kilah inlang nadei bangtah in mangcha tan Kapu, chujongleh keiman Pumgo thilto a manchah din Bongchalte, maicham mei ti nadin changsuh thing chule, thilto din suhlou chang jong pehtha nge” tin Araunah in David jah a aseitai.
en_web: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
en_kjv: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

tcz: Ahivangin Leng David in Araunah adonbut in, “keiman aman lhingset napeng ting, nangma thil vang maicham thilto din kilah tha pong’e”.
en_web: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
en_kjv: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

tcz: Chuin, David in Araunah chu sana pheng jagup chu changphol man dingin apetai.
en_web: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
en_kjv: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

tcz: Hilaimun hin David in maicham phungkhat asan, pumgo thilto le kichamna maicham asemin, taona amang tan ahile, Pathenin asanpeh hetna din van'a kon meikou ahin sol lhan pumgo thilto jouse akavam hel tai.
en_web: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
en_kjv: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathenin Chemjam ana lam’a kigo vantil chu a chempai a anungkoi din thu ape tai.
en_web: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
en_kjv: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

tcz: Pathen in amaicham sem asanpeh ahet phat’in David in jong Araunah changphol mun chun kilhaina maicham asemtai.
en_web: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
en_kjv: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

tcz: Hiche phat laiya hi, Pakai houbuh maicham le pumgo thilto maicham phung, Mose in gammang laiya anasem chu Gibeon mun a aumpet ahi.
en_web: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
en_kjv: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

tcz: Ahivangin David chun hiche laimun a chu Pathen lung gahol a gache ding chu agel le mithat vantil chemjam toh gotsa dem a anaum jeh chun angapcha pon ahi.
en_web: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.
en_kjv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

tcz: Chuin David in aseitai, “Hilai mun hi Pathen Houin mun chu hiding ahitai, chule kilhaina, pumgo thilto namun jong hiding ahi.”
en_web: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
en_kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

tcz: Hijeh chun Leng David in gamsung a kholjin mi jouse akoutup in, aboltheina cheh un Houin sah nading song khengjol loi apansah tai.
en_web: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
en_kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

tcz: David in Kelkot a man ding thingkil semna din thih tampi leh sum eng te khopset apen ahi.
en_web: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,
en_kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

tcz: Tyre le Sidon miten Leng David ana peh Cedar thingtum ho jongchu tampi ana peh thai.
en_web: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
en_kjv: also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

tcz: David in aseitai, “Kachapa Solomon hi achapang nalaiyin, jilna le hetna jong neibeh nailou hijongle, Pathenin anganse a Houin sahdoh ding hi loupi ding, minthang ding chuleh leiset pumpia dia jong nasatah hiding ahin, hijeh a chu tuahi kagonpeh pan ding ahitai.” Hijeh a hi David in athi masang a Houin sah nadia thil le lo tampi akoitup ahitai.
en_web: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
en_kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

tcz: Hichun, David in achapa Solomon jah a Israelte Pathen chenna ding Houin theng asahdoh natei din athumop tai.
en_web: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
en_kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.

tcz: “Kachapa, keiman ka Pathen jabol nadin a Houin theng khat kasadoh nom’e.” David in aseipeh in,
en_web: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.
en_kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house unto the name of the Lord my God:

tcz: “Ahivangin Pathenin kajah a aseiye, nangman nagalbolna munna mi tampi nathat tan”. “Chuleh, keima mitmua thisan tampi naso tah jeh a, nangman keima jabol nadia ka Houin theng nasah theilou ding ahitai”.
en_web: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
en_kjv: but the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

tcz: “Ahivang’a, Chamnasem chapa khat nahin ding ahi, aman Lengvai apoh sungsea Israel gam leh akimvel a agalmite kisan geiya chamdel a kalhat sah ding ahi. Amin Solomon kiti ding chuleh ama lengvai poh sung’a hi Israel cham kalensah ding ahi.”
en_web: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
en_kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

tcz: “Ama hi ahi keima jabol nadia Houin theng sadoh ding chu. Kachapa deitah hintin, keima apa kahi ding ahi. Chuleh keiman a itih a alenggam sung’a chamna le lungmonna kapeh ding ahi.”
en_web: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
en_kjv: He shall build a house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

tcz: Kacha tuhin, Pakaiyin nakithopi intin; aman nangma chungchang thudol’a asei tobang'in, nangman jong Pakai, Pathen houin nahinsah doh tei ding ahi.
en_web: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
en_kjv: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.

tcz: Pakajin thil hetkhen themna le datkhenji dan napeh ding, Israel chunga vaihom a natun ding, ngansena nahin peh teng jongleh Pakai, na Pathen danthu nanit jingna dingin nabol peh tahen.
en_web: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.
en_kjv: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.

tcz: Israelte dinga Pakaiyin Mose athupeh chonna dan ahin, chondan jouse chu nanit jing ding chule ching thei tah’a nakhan toupi thei ding ahi. Hijeh chun hat inlang, hang in, kicha hih hel in chule lungthoina jong nanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

tcz: Genthei hesohna tothon keiman Pakai houin sahdohna ding in, sana talent sang jakhat kakhol khom in ahi. Chule dangka talent nelkhat jong kakhol khom in, sum eng le thih jong ajat’a tekham valset kakhol khom e, ijeh-inem itileh atam in, in thil le lo jong kakhol khom soh keijin, hiche ho jouse hi nangman nabolbe ding ahina laiye.
en_web: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
en_kjv: Now behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

tcz: Natong ding mihem tampi semdoh in: song kheng them miho, thing thembol miho, thing vaibol miho, aloi loija mihem simjou lou mihem khutthemna neiho nakoi ding, khut themna neitah beh,
en_web: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;
en_kjv: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

tcz: mi sana lha-them, dangka kheng them, sum-eng lha them, thih kheng them chule adang mitampi nakoi ding ahi. Tun kipat in na-tong tan, Pakaiyin napanpi jing tahen! ati.
en_web: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”
en_kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.

tcz: Chuin David in Israel mite sunga lamkai chengse thupeh aneiyin, achapa Solomon akithopi diuvin thu aseijin ahi.
en_web: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
en_kjv: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

tcz: “Pakai, na Pathen uvin nangho napanpi jingo hilou ham? Amatah in na jet le naveiju hungkon nagal miteu asuh thip’a chamna naneiju hilou ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, amatah in agamsunga cheng mite chu keima khut’a apedoh in, hijeh chun agamsung jouse hi Pakai ansung leh amite masanga suh-nem’a uma, mite noija kikunsah ahitai.
en_web: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.
en_kjv: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

tcz: Tun nang hon na lungthim pumpiu Pakai, na Pathen-u hol tauvin. Kipat un Pakai, Pathen muntheng houin satauvin; chutileh Pakai kitepna thingkong le Pathen houin a manchah bel le um chule thilkeo atheng jouse hiche Pakai dinga houin kisadoh sunga chu pohlut’a umding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”
en_kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

tcz: Chuin David ahung teh in, akum atamphat in achapa Solomon chu Isrealte lengpan apansah tai
en_web: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
en_kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

tcz: Aman Isreal gam a lengte, thempuho chule Levi mite akhom in ahi
en_web: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
en_kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

tcz: Levite chu kum somthum apat chunglam se chu khat khat in akisim un, pasal mi sangsom thumle get alhing ui.
en_web: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
en_kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

tcz: Hinlah mi sang somni le sang li chu Pathen houin sunga naa atoh sah in, chule mi sang gup chu alamkai le thutan vaihom dingin apansah tai.
en_web: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
en_kjv: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:

tcz: Chukitle mi sangli chu kot ngah din akoi in, mi sangli ma chu aman apeh tumging ho mangchan Pathen vahchoi jing dingin umhen tin David in aseije.
en_web: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
en_kjv: moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

tcz: Chuin David chu Levi chate Gershon, kohath le Merari min in akhen kit in ahi.
en_web: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
en_kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Gershon mite hochu Laaadan le Shimei ahi
en_web: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
en_kjv: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
