tcz: Laadan chate chu Jehiel le Zatham le Joel agom a thum
en_web: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
en_kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

tcz: Shimei chate chu Shelomith leh Heziel le Haran ahi. Amaho hi Laadan insunga mi upa ho ahiuve
en_web: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
en_kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

tcz: Chule Shimei chate chu Jahath, Ziza, Zeush chule Beriah. Amaho li hi Shimei chate ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
en_kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

tcz: Chule Jahath chu Haosa lamkai ana hin, Zizah chu ani channa anahi, amavang Jeush chule Beriah teni hin chapa tampi ana hing lhon lou jeh in pakhat insung in akisim tai.
en_web: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
en_kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.

tcz: Kohath hin chapa li ana hingin amahochu; Amran, Izahar, Hebron chule Uzziel ana hiuve.
en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
en_kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

tcz: Amaram cha Pasal teni chu Aaron chule Mose ana hi. Aaron hin Pathen a dingin pumgo thilto ana lhantheng jing thei nadia chule ama achapaten atonsot a Pathen anga thilto gimnamtwi ana hal jing uva; ama lenggam a dinga akipehdoh jing uva, chule ama minna phatthei achan jing thei nadiuvin, asopipa toh ana ki sukhen in ahi.
en_web: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
en_kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

tcz: Mose hi Pathen mipan ana kisim in ahi. Achapa techu Levi chilhah noiya ana ki minvon ahi.
en_web: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
en_kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

tcz: Mose chapa techu Gershom chule Eleizer ana hi hone.
en_web: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
en_kjv: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

tcz: Gershom chapa telah a chun Shebul chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi,
en_web: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

tcz: Chule Eleizer chapate lah a Rehabiah chu ana Haosa lamkaiyin ahi. Eleizer hin chapa dang ana hingpon ahi, amavang Rehabia hin chapa tampi ana hing in ahi.
en_web: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
en_kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

tcz: Izhar chapa te lah a Shalomith chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi.
en_web: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

tcz: Hebron chapate lah a Jeriah chu ana tah pen in ahi, Amariah chu anina an hin, Jahaziel chu athumna chule Jekameam chu ali channa ana hi.
en_web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

tcz: Uzziel chapate lah a Micah chu atahpen in chule Issiah chu ani channa ana hi.
en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

tcz: Merari Chate ho chu Mahli le Mushi ahin Mahli chapate chu Mahli, Eleazer le Kish ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
en_kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

tcz: Chapa neilouva Eleazar thi chule chanu bou anei in ahi. Chule asopi Kish chapaten achanu te akichen pin ahi.
en_web: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
en_kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

tcz: Mushi Chateho chu Athum uvin- Mahli, Eder chule Jeremoth ho ahiuve
en_web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
en_kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

tcz: Hichengse hi Levi insungmi le ason apah ho chengse ahiuve- amin kikhumlut dungjui in insung lamkai ho chengse jong achangseh'in akisim in ahi
en_web: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
en_kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.

tcz: Chuin David in, Isreal Pathen chun amite cholngah sah in chule atonsot a Jerusalem a cheng ding ahi.
en_web: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
en_kjv: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

tcz: Pathen houbuh a kimang le athil ho chengse jong Levi ten anungpoh kit lou diu ahitai.
en_web: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
en_kjv: and also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

tcz: David hilchah na achainapen dungjui in, Levi techu kum somni a tah le achunglam apat kisim pan ahi.
en_web: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
en_kjv: For by the last words of David, the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

tcz: Levi techun Pathen houbuh a Aaron chapate akithopiuva, indan ho sutheng le ding, thil thengho koitup ding chule Pathen houbuh a natoh chengse vetup ding ahiuve.
en_web: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
en_kjv: because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

tcz: Dokhanga changlhah luidoh ding, todoh ding changbong ho chule ajat alet aneo dungjui a haltoh ding chengse jong avettup diu ahi.
en_web: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;
en_kjv: both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

tcz: Jingkah seh le ding uva Pathena vahchoi dingu ahi. Nilhah le angaima banga abol kit diu ahi.
en_web: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;
en_kjv: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;

tcz: Chule amahon Sabbath nikho le Lhathah nikho a Pakai anga thilto abol teng ule amijat ana ngaichat dungjui a abol diu ahi.
en_web: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;
en_kjv: and to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

tcz: Hiti chun Leviten ten ponbuh a kinbol hihen muntheng kibol hihen, asopiu Aaron chapate chu Pakai kibol na’a akithopi jing diu ahi.
en_web: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: and that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.

tcz: Aaron chapate kihop khen dan chu hiti hi ahi: Nadab ahin, Abihu ahin, Eleazer leh Ethamar amaho cheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
en_kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

tcz: Nadab le Abihu hi apa sang in athimasa lhon in, chajong aneiman lhon tapoi; chuin Eleazer leh Ithamar chu thempu ahung hilhon tai.
en_web: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
en_kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

tcz: Eleazar chapate lah'a kon’le Zadok le Ithamar chapate lah’a kon Ahimelech panpina jal’in David chun ama ama natoh ding toh kisaijin agoltoh sohkeijun ahi.
en_web: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
en_kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

tcz: Ithamar chapate sang in, Eleazar chapate sunga chun miupa atam un, hijeh chun Eleazar chapate lah’a chun apu apateu insung lhahdol cheh in, lamkai somle gup alhengdoh un, amaho lamkai nan aum un ahi. Chule Ithamar chapte ding in lamkai miget bou ana lhengdoh un ahi.
en_web: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
en_kjv: And there were moe chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar: and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

tcz: Akilhengdoh le lamkaija kipansah hohi kibang chetna vang kisansah ahiuvin, hitia akibolnaa kon chun Eleazar leh Ithamar chapate lah’a kon in, muntheng a natong vaihom dingleh Pathen natohna vaibol ding tampi kisepdoh ahi.
en_web: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
en_kjv: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

tcz: Nathanel kiti Levi mi Shemiah hi danthu them ahin, amaho chengse chu lengpa le milen milalte angsung, Zadok thempupa angsung le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech angsung le thempu ho chule Levi miho, apu apateuva pat phung upa chengse lekha in ajihlut tan ahi; ajeh chu pa khang khat lhahse chu Eleazar insunga kon kilhengdoh ahin, chule pa khang khat lhah chengse ma chu Ithamar insunga dia kilhengdoh ahi.
en_web: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
en_kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

tcz: Vang kisan masapen chu Jehoiarib chunga achun, chuin ani na chu Jedaiah chunga achun,
en_web: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
en_kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

tcz: athumna chu Harim chunga achun; alina chu Seorim chunga achun,
en_web: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
en_kjv: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

tcz: angana chu Malchijah chunga achun, agupna Mijamin chunga achun,
en_web: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
en_kjv: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

tcz: asagina chu Hakkoz chunga achun, agetna chu Abijah chunga achun,
en_web: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
en_kjv: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

tcz: akonan Jeshua chunga achun, asomna Shecaniah chunga achun,
en_web: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
en_kjv: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

tcz: asom le khatna Eliashib chunga achun, asomle nina chu Jakim chunga achun,
en_web: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
en_kjv: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

tcz: asomle thumna chu Huppah chunga achun, asomle li na chu Jeshebeab chunga achun,
en_web: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
en_kjv: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

tcz: asomle nga na chu Bilgah chunga achun, asomle gup na chu Immer chunga achun,
en_web: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
en_kjv: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

tcz: asom le sagi na chu Hezir chunga achun, asomle get na chu Happizzer chunga achun,
en_web: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
en_kjv: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

tcz: asomle ko na chu Pethahiah chunga achun, somni na chu Jehezkel chunga achun,
en_web: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
en_kjv: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

tcz: asomni le khat na chu Jachin chunga achun, asomni le ni na chu Gamul chunga achun,
en_web: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
en_kjv: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

tcz: asomni le thumna chu Delaiah chunga achun, asomni le li nah cu Maaziah chunga achun ahi.
en_web: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
en_kjv: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi akipansahna cheh uvin, natoh ding anei cheh un, Pathen houin sung ahung lut phat uleh, Pakai, Israel Pathen in Apupau Aaron thu anapeh bang leh, Aaron in amaho chengse tohding agontoh bang in atohdiuva kilom cheng chu atong jiuvin ahi.
en_web: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
en_kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.

tcz: Levi chapate adangse chu: Amran chapatea kon Shubael, chule Shubael chapatea kon Jehdeiah ahi.
en_web: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
en_kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

tcz: Rehabiah chapate chu: Rehabiah chapatea kon Isshiah chu aupa pen ahi.
en_web: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
en_kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

tcz: Izhar chapatea kon Shelomoth ahin, Shelomoth chapatea kon Jahath ahi.
en_web: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
en_kjv: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

tcz: Hebron chapate chu: Jeriah chu aupapen ahin, ani channapa chu Amariah ahin, athum channapa chu Jahaziel ahin, ali channapa chu Jekameam ahi.
en_web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
en_kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

tcz: Uzziel chapatea kon Micah ahin, Micah chapatea kon Shamir ahi.
en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
en_kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

tcz: Micah sopipa chu Isshiah ahin, Isshiah chapatea kon Zechariah ahi.
en_web: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
en_kjv: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

tcz: Merari chapate ni chu Jaaziah Mahli le Mushi ahilhon e. Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno ahi.
en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
en_kjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

tcz: Merari chapate chu Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno le Shoham, Zaccur le Ibri ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
en_kjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

tcz: Mahil chapa chu: Eleazar ahin, amapa hin chapa ana hing tapoi.
en_web: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
en_kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

tcz: Kish akon Kish chapatea kon Jerahmeel ahi.
en_web: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
en_kjv: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

tcz: Mushi chapate chu Mahli le Eder chule Jerimoth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Levi mitea kon chapa, apu apateu lhah’a ama insung cheh’a kon kisimdoh ahiuve.
en_web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
en_kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

tcz: Amaho chengse hin apa jang lhah insung cheh in, asopiteu umchan bang in Aaron chapate nunle khan athouvin ahi. David lengpa angsung le Zadok angsung, Ahimelech chule thempu ho apu apateu insung cheh’a kon chule Levi miho masanga chun vang akisan cheh tauve.
en_web: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
en_kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

tcz: David le a sepai jalamkaiten Asaph, Heman chule Jeduthun insungmi chu Kipana thupha sapphong tohthoa semjang gin ngei, tumging chule Khutbeh la lamkai din alhengdoh taove.
en_web: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
en_kjv: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

tcz: Asaph chapate Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah chule Asarelah in jong a pau maikainan lengpa thupeh dungjuiyin kipana thupha chu alhangsap uve.
en_web: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
en_kjv: of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

tcz: Heduthun chapate, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshiah, Shimei, Hashabiah chule Mattithah mi gup cheng hin jong a pau makainan semjang gin ngei, thangvah le vahchoi toh thon kipana thupha sapphong toh thon Pathen athangvah uve.
en_web: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
en_kjv: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.

tcz: Heman chapate chu Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romam’ti-e’zer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir chule Mahazioth cheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
en_kjv: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

tcz: Lengpa Themgao a pang Heman hin Pakaiya a konin chapa Somle li le chanu thum ahing e.
en_web: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
en_kjv: all these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

tcz: Heman le achapate chu Houin sunga tumging thei, Selangdah gin ngei, Semjang sai chule khutbeh a Pakai vahchoina lamkaiya pang ahiuve. Chule ijakaiyin, Asaph, Jeduthun chule Heman jong lengpa toh aki thukop jing uve.
en_web: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
en_kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

tcz: Amaho insung hi Pakai vahchoi na mun a tumging sai ding mong a hung kitillu ahi. Abonchauvin tumging sai thei cheh mi Jani somget le get alhing uve.
en_web: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
en_kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

tcz: Mi hichengse hi teh le khang hihen jilkung le simlai umlouvin athepna cheh uva apang un chuleh vang kibang in akisan cheh uve.
en_web: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
en_kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

tcz: Mi jani somget le get ho hin, chapa somle ni cheh in asauvin, hichengse ho hi hop somni le li in aki homson uvin asopite cheng to vang akisan uve.Vang kisan masapen chu Asaph chilhah lah a Joseph le asopite ahiuvin. Anina a vang kisan chu Gedaliah le asopite ahi,
en_web: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
en_kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

tcz: a somle sagi na Joshbekashah,
en_web: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
en_kjv: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

tcz: a somni le thumna Mahazioth,
en_web: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
en_kjv: the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

tcz: a somni le li na Romamti-ezer.
en_web: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
en_kjv: the four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

tcz: Kelkotbul ngah ho kivaihop dan chu hiti ahi: Korah chilhah a konna Kore chapa Meshelemiah kitipa hi Abiasaph insung a kon ahi.
en_web: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
en_kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

tcz: Meshelemiah in chapa sagi ahin chu atahpen Zechariah ahin, abanna Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel,
en_web: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
en_kjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

tcz: Elam, Jehohanan chuleh Eliehoenai ahiuve.
en_web: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
en_kjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

tcz: Kelkot ngahpa Obed-edom chu Pathenin chapa get jenin phattheina dimset aboh in, amaho cheng chu atahpen Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sacar, Nethanel,
en_web: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
en_kjv: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

tcz: Ammiel, Issachar chule Peullethai ahiuve.
en_web: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
en_kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

tcz: Obed-edom chapa Shemaiah chun chapa miboltheicheh ahing’in a phungsung u vaihom na a panmun nasatah alo cheh uve.
en_web: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
en_kjv: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

tcz: Amaho chengse chu ahile, Othni, Rephael, Obed chule Elzabad ahiuve. Chubanle, asopiteniu Elihu le Semakiah jongchu miboltheitah ma ahi lhon e.
en_web: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
en_kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

tcz: Obed-edom chilhah, achapate le a tute mi somgup le ni chengse hi natohna a feltah le bolthei cheh ahiuve.
en_web: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
en_kjv: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.

tcz: Meshelemiah chapate mi somle get le asopite chengse hi miboltheitah ahicheh uve.
en_web: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
en_kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

tcz: Merari phungsung a konin Hosah chun Shimri chu achapate lah a atahpen ahilouvangin lamkai din alhengdoh tai.
en_web: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
en_kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

tcz: Achapate chu aninapa Hilkiah, Tebaliah, Zechariah jong ahiuvin. Hosah chapate le asopite mi somle thum chengse chu kelkot ngah in apang uve.
en_web: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
en_kjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

tcz: Hitobanga kelkot ngah ho kivaihop danhi Levi dangho banga a insungmi cheh in Pakai na chu atoh u ahi.
en_web: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.

tcz: Kelkot ngah dia kelkot tin a insungmiten ahin deilhen hi kumle lha hihen, theple theplou man a kive hilouin a vang kisan dungjui a pang ji ahiuve.
en_web: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
en_kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

tcz: Solam kelkot ngah a pang din Meshelemiah le aloite nganse ahitaovin, sahlam chu michingtah a kihepa Zechariah,
en_web: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
en_kjv: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counseller, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

tcz: Lhanglam kelkot chu Obed-edom nganse ahin, achapate chu thilkholna kelkot ngah in apang uve.
en_web: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
en_kjv: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

tcz: Shuppim le Hosah chu lhumlam kelkot apat a Shallecheth kelkot changei ngah din lamkai a apang lhonin, anga pi hochu akimaingat sah in limgeh in apang uve.
en_web: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
en_kjv: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

tcz: Solam kelkot phung chun niseh in mi gup, sahlam a mi li, lhanglam a mi li ma chuleh mi li kingato cheh in thilkhol na kelkot phung in apang jing’ui.
en_web: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
en_kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

tcz: Lhumlam kelkot phunga mi gup chuleh mi li chu kotpi a kon a Shallecheth chan apang un, mi ni ma avel lah chun apang’e.
en_web: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
en_kjv: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

tcz: Korah le Merari phungsung a kelkot ngah ho kivaihopdan hiti chu ahi.
en_web: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
en_kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

tcz: Ahijah lamkainan maicham thilkhol namun le houin gou ho khol namun avetup uve.
en_web: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
en_kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicate things.

tcz: Gershon phungkhai, Libni insung’a konin Jehiel chu lamkai khat in apang’e.
en_web: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
en_kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

tcz: Jehiel, Zetham chule Joel chapate jong Pathen maicham thilkhol namun chu ngah din nganse na achang taove.
en_web: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche lamkai a pang cheng hi Amram, Izhar, Hebron chuleh Uzziel chilhah ahiuve.
en_web: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
en_kjv: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

tcz: Amram phungsung a dia, Shebuel chu Mose chapa, Gershom chilhah ahin.
en_web: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
en_kjv: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

tcz: Asopite Eliezer in ahin ho chu, Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zocri chule Shelomoth ahiuve.
en_web: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
en_kjv: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

tcz: Shelomoth le asopite hi Leng David, insung lamkai pipu, sepai jalamkai chuleh mi thupi hon Pakaiya dia maicham thilto a ahin peh hou anga u ahi.
en_web: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
en_kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicate things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

tcz: Galmun a kon a kichomkhom thilhoi lai2 ho jong Pakai Houin sunga manchah le din ahin lhandoh jiuve.
en_web: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.

tcz: Chujongle, Shelomoth le asopiten Themgao Samuel, kish chapa Saul, Ner chapa Abner le Zeruiah chapa Joab thilto ho jong achingtup jing uve.
en_web: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.
en_kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

tcz: Izhar phung a konin Kenaniah ahung pengdoh in, a chapate toh Israel sung a vaibol le thutan in apang uve.
en_web: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
en_kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

tcz: Hebron phung a konin Hashabiah ahung pengdoh in, asopite thil bolthei cheh sang le ja sagi toh Jordan vadung a patna lhumlam a um Israel te gambeh sunga, Pathen thulam hihen lang Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lentah achang taove.
en_web: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
en_kjv: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.

tcz: Chujongle, Hebron phung a konin Jeriah ahung pengdoh in, amahi Hebronte phunggui kisut dan a lamkai le khat anahi. David lengpa kum somli alhin a akhouldoh dungjui uva, Hebron te lah a mibolthei tampi Gilead gam Jazer khopi a amudoh u ahi.
en_web: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
en_kjv: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

tcz: Miboltheitah mi ho chu mi sangni le ja sagi chengse chu Jeriah sopite ngen jeng ahiuve. Amaho hi Leng David in Jordan vadung a pat a solam a asol a Reuben leh Gad chule Mannaseh chilhah akehkhat langpi vekol ding a ejakai a Pathen thulam hihen, Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lhingset chang ahiuve.
en_web: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
en_kjv: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

tcz: Israel sepai jalamkaite le a vaibol teuvin lengpa hongbit dia a sepaite ahon hon a aki vaihop dan u chu hiti ahi. Sepai hon khat a mi sangsomni le li alhing uvin, kum khat le lhakhat cheh pan ala teiyun ahi.
en_web: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: Sepai hon ho panmun la masapen a lamkai chu Zabdiel chapa Jashobeam ahi,
en_web: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: Ama hi Perez insung a kon sepai vaihom ho jouse lah a jong thaneipen ahi.
en_web: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
en_kjv: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

tcz: Sepaihon lhanina a pan la a lamkai chu Ahoah insungmi Dodai kitipa ahin, anoidou a thanei vaihom din Mikloth kitipa akikoi e.
en_web: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhathum channa a pan la sepaihon lamkai chu Jehoiada chapa Benaiah ahi.
en_web: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: Beniah kitipa hi David sepai hangsan, mihat somthum ho lamkai a jong ana pang ahi. Achapa Ammizabad chu anoidou din apansah e.
en_web: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
en_kjv: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

tcz: Joab naopa Asahel in a lhali channa sepai hon te alamkaiyin ahi. Amahi achapa Zebadiah in athijouin apanmun akhel tai.
en_web: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhanga channa sepaihon lamkai chu Shammah ahin, amahi Izrahite tinjong aki hei.
en_web: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhagup channa din Tekoa vangkhoa kon, Ikkesh chapa Ira chu lamkai in apang’e.
en_web: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhasagi channan Pelon akon a Ephraim insungmi Helez a lamkai e.
en_web: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhaget channan Hushah a kon Zerah insungmi Sibbecai a lamkaiyin.
en_web: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhako channan Benjamin gamsung, Anathoth a kon Abiezer a lamkai in.
en_web: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom nan Netophah a kon Zerah insungmi Maharai in a lamkaiye.
en_web: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom le khat nan Epharaim, Pirathon a kon Benaiah a lamkaiyin.
en_web: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom le ni na in Netophah a kon Othniel insungmi Heled in a lamkaiye.
en_web: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
en_kjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

tcz: Reuben phung lamkai chu Zicri, Eliezer chapa ahi. Simeon phung lamkai chu Maacah chapa, Shephatiah ahi.
en_web: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
en_kjv: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

tcz: Levi Phung lamkai, Kemuel chapa Hashabiah ahin, Aaron themgaote phung lamkai chu Zadok ahi.
en_web: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
en_kjv: of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

tcz: Judah te lamkai chu David sopipa Elihu ahin, Issachar lamkai chu Michael chapa Omri ahi.
en_web: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
en_kjv: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

tcz: Zebulun lamkai in Obadiah chapa Ishmaiah apangin, Naphtali lamkai chu Azriel chapa Jeremoth ahi.
en_web: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
en_kjv: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

tcz: Ephraim Phung lamkai chu Azaziah chapa Hoshea ahin, Lhumlam Manasseh lamkai chu Pedaiah chapa Joel ahi.
en_web: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
en_kjv: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

tcz: Solam Gilead a Manasseh lamkai chu Zechariah chapa Iddo ahi. Benjamin lamkai a Abner chapa Jaasiel apang in.
en_web: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
en_kjv: of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

tcz: Dan lamkaiyin Jeroham chapa Azarel apang’e.
en_web: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
en_kjv: of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

tcz: Leng David in mijatsim abolna achun kum somni a pat anoilam ho asimtha pon ahi. Ajehchu, Pathenin Israel chate chu van'a ahsi jat a phatthei aboh dia akitepna akoisa ahitai.
en_web: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
en_kjv: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Joab chun mijatsim ejat a aboldoh kigot vang'in alosap jing’e. Ajehchu Pathen lunghan na chang a, Leng David khang a Israel mijatsim chu lolhing lou ahitai.
en_web: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.
en_kjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

tcz: Adiel chapa Azmaveth chu lengpa thilkholna ngahtup din nganse ahin, Uzziah chapa Jonathan chu khopi thilkholna mun jouse ngahtup din nganse ahitai.
en_web: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
en_kjv: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

tcz: Kelub chapa Ezri chun Lengpa loubol ho vetup din Loumun angah in,
en_web: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
en_kjv: and over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

tcz: Ramah a kon Shimei chu Lengpa lengpi lei ngahtup in apang in, Sepham a kon Zabdi chu Lengpa Ju le Lengpi twi thah a apang’e.
en_web: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
en_kjv: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

tcz: Geder a kon a Baal-Hanan chun Judah te moul bul a um Lengpa Olive honsung chule theichang, theiba lei chu angahtup in ahi. Lengpa heng’a Olive thao thah jing din Joash ngansena achang’e.
en_web: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
en_kjv: and over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

tcz: Sharon a kon Shitrai chu Sharon munjang lang’a Bong ching in apangin. Adlai chapa Shaphat chu phaicham lang’a apang e.
en_web: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
en_kjv: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

tcz: Ishamel chilhah Obil in Sangong saote aching in. Meronoth a kon Jehdeiah in Sangaan aching e.
en_web: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
en_kjv: over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

tcz: Hagrite mi Jaziz in Lengpa kelngoi le kelcha aching in. Amaho chengse hi Lengpa gou ching jeng ahiuve.
en_web: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.
en_kjv: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.

tcz: David pa-ngahpa Jonathan chu michingtah le thil hethei tah chule lengpa semang khat ahin. Hachmoni chapa Jehiel chu lengpa chapa jilkung in apang’e.
en_web: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
en_kjv: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counseller, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:

tcz: Ahithophel kitipa hi Leng insung a thumop themtah ahin. Ark kho a Hushai kitipa hi Lengpa dia agol khat ahi.
en_web: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
en_kjv: and Ahithophel was the king’s counseller: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:

tcz: Benaiah leh Abiathar chapa Jehoiada in Ahithophel athi jouvin a panmun ahin khel in, Joab chu Lengpa sepai jalamkai a apangtai.
en_web: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
en_kjv: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.

tcz: David in alenggam sung’a sepai jalamkai, vaipo le vaibol jouse, phung lamkai hihen gou ching hihen, hetthei a panmun la jouse chuleh gaalhang jouse Jerusalem a akou sohkei un.
en_web: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

tcz: Akipatdoh in hity hin aseitai, “Ka sopi le Ka miteho, keiman Pathen kitepna thingkong a itih a aum jing nading, Pathen houin theng sahdoh ding ka ngaiton, kigotnan thil le lo angaicha tampi jong kakoitai.
en_web: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
en_kjv: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

tcz: Ahinlah, Pakai Pathenin keima gaal-hat tah chuleh mi tampi that kahi jeh in eiphal pon ahi.
en_web: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
en_kjv: but God said unto me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

tcz: Hijeng jongle, Israel Pathenin Judahte lah a konna, ka insung uva pat keimatah, a itih hijongle Israel leng dia ei thaonu ahitai.
en_web: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
en_kjv: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

tcz: Chutahle, chapa tamtah phatthei eiboh ho lah a konna ka chapa Solomon in ka lengtou namun ei khel ding ahi” ati.
en_web: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.
en_kjv: and of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

tcz: Pathenin kajah a aseiye, “Nachapa Solomon in Ka houin theng le akimvel asahdoh dia kalhendoh ahitan, keiman angaichat ijakai kapeh jing ding ahi” ati.
en_web: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
en_kjv: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

tcz: Chutahle, “Ka thupeh chengse anit jing’a ahile, Keiman a lenggam a itih a ka umpi jing ding ahi” ati.
en_web: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
en_kjv: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, Pakai le houbung pumpi angsung chuleh, Israel mite mitmun chingtheiyun lang na pakai na Pathen thupeh chengse nit jing un, chutileh lungmong a gampha lai na lo uva, nachateu le na tuteu khang geiya Pakai phatthei na nachan jing diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
en_kjv: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

tcz: “Chujongle, Solomon kachapa, na Pu le na Pa phattheiboh jing na Pathen chu haimil lou jen’in. Nalungthim pumpin choi’an jing inlang athun umjingin, ajehchu thil ijakai amun, ahe sohkeiyin, bel jing lechun, na lhaso lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
en_kjv: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, nalung gil in ngaiton. Pakai Pathen in a houin theng sa dia nalhendoh ahitan. Hat jing in lang natohdoh tei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
en_kjv: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

tcz: Chuin, David in athilgon ejakai, thil kholna indan ho chule chonset kingaidam na munho umdol jouse Solomon apetan ahi.
en_web: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
en_kjv: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

tcz: David in alunggil a agontohsa, Houin lim asung apo, indan dang dang chule Maicham kibolna Muntheng dia agon ho jouse achapa Solomon aseipeh tai.
en_web: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
en_kjv: and the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicate things:

tcz: Chujongle, Houin sunga Themgao hole Levi mite panmun hihen, Pathen hou nadia thil le lo kimang ding jouse jong ahiltan ahi.
en_web: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—
en_kjv: also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.

tcz: David in Pathen Hou na a Sana le Sum eng man dia lom jat jong ahiltoh in,
en_web: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
en_kjv: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

tcz: Solomon jah a Sana thaomei semna ding le sum eng thaomei semna ding chuleh sana le sum eng alut ding jat jong ahilthem in ahi.
en_web: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;
en_kjv: even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

tcz: Changlhah hung kitohdoh ho koina ding Sana theng a kisem Dokhang chule, sum eng a kisem dokhang ho jong akisem na a sana angaicha ding jat jong ahilthem e.
en_web: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
en_kjv: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

tcz: Thih-khe sana thengsel ijat a sem a, khon, Kong, Sil kong ho jouse sana ijat cheh a sem ding aboncha a atetoh peh soh e.
en_web: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
en_kjv: also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

tcz: Chujongle, gim namtwi hal nading maicham phung semna dia sana thengsel man ding jat, chule Kangtalai sung a Cherubium vantil in a lhaving teni a akhu khum, Pakai kitepna thingkong sem ding dan jong ahiltan ahi.
en_web: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.
en_kjv: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

tcz: “Thilgon hichengse hi”, tin David in Solomon jah a, “Pathenin akhut tah a asut eimudohsah akon kahet ahi” ati.
en_web: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
en_kjv: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

tcz: David in abanjom in, “hat in lang hang jingin, natohdoh ding ahi. Kichat le lunglhah daina neihih hel in. Pakai Pathenin na umpi jing’e. Nanganse nabang’a nachai theng tokah a Pakai Pathen in na lhonpi jing ding ahi”.
en_web: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
en_kjv: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.

tcz: “Themgao ho le Levi mite akinganse na banga pakai kin abol diu, adangse injong akipeh nathei chan uva pan alah uva, gamsung vaipo ho jouse le thuneina aboncha a nangma thunoi a umding ahi” ati.
en_web: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
en_kjv: And behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

tcz: Hichun, leng David in houin sung’a mipiho lam chu angan hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Solomon hi Pathenin ka lengmun khel dia athaonusa chu ahin, ama chapang nalai intin, jilna neibeh nailou hijongle, atoh dia lom Pathenin angansena, a houin sah dikhu mihem mai maiyin ajo chi vang ahipoi.
en_web: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
en_kjv: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.

tcz: Manchah theichan mangchan keiman ka Pathen Houin sah nadin sana, songmantam, thing le song ijakai angaicha jouse kakoitup peh tai. Hiho chu alhingset a dia, Sana, Sum eng, thih, thing chujongle, Onyx tampi seh hilouin, Songmantam, Songval, Songpol, Marble song jong alhingset din kakoitup peh tai.
en_web: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
en_kjv: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

tcz: Tunjong, keiman ka Pakaiya dia kakipehdoh nan ka Sana le sum eng jouse jong a Houin sah nadia kagotpeh ho ban’in kapedoh tai.
en_web: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:
en_kjv: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

tcz: Chuleh, keiman Houin bang dung ho sah nadin, Ophir a kon Sana talent jakhat somleni chuleh, sum eng thengsel talent jani somgup le ni jong kapedoh tai.
en_web: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;
en_kjv: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

tcz: Chuban a, Khutthem ho tham ding Sana le Sum eng avat ding chengse ho hi, koi tobang ka Pakai ka Pathen a dia keijong kakipehdoh nom’e ti e um uvem?
en_web: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”
en_kjv: the gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?

tcz: Hichun, mi upa ho le Israel phung lamkai ho ahin, sepai jalamkaiho, gouching ho chuleh, lengpa vaibolho jouse jong kiphaltheng tah in akipedohsoh taove.
en_web: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
en_kjv: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly,

tcz: Pathen Houin theng sah nadia akipehdoh nao abonchauva apehdoh jat uchu, Sana talent jakhat somget le get, Dangka talent sangsom, sum eng talent jathum somsagi le nga, thih lhe talent jagup somsagi le nga chuleh, thih talent sangthum jasagi le somnga alhing’e.
en_web: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.
en_kjv: and gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

tcz: Chujongle, Gershon chilhah a kon Jehiel in maicham thilkhol namun avetsui din anganse un, songmantam tampi jong atoh be cheh uve.
en_web: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
en_kjv: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

tcz: Maicham thiltho ho jouse mipi ten hongphal tah le kiphaltheng tah a to jeh uvin akipah cheh uvin ahi. Chujongle Lengpa David jong kipa leh thanop nan adim’e.
en_web: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
en_kjv: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

tcz: Chuphat chun, Lengpa David in mipi jouse masang’in Pathen athangvah’e. “Kahung kondoh nao Vo ka Pathen’u, atonsot tonsot'in nun nom in, namin kithangvah jinghen.
en_web: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
en_kjv: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

tcz: Vo ka Pathen’u, minthanna jouse, loupi na jouse, thaneina jouse, jabol na jouse, ijakai nang’a hijing hen. Leiset pumpi le Vanthamjol abonna nang’a ahi. Vo Kapathen’u thil ijakai nangma lenggam thaneina ahi.
en_web: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
en_kjv: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

tcz: Houna le Jabolna nang’a kon bou ahi. Ajehchu, emajouse nangma thunoi a umjeng ahi. Thaneina le loupina nangma khut a aum’in. Nangma khut’in minthanna le thaneina aboncha aum’e.
en_web: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!
en_kjv: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

tcz: Vo ka Pathen’u, namin thangvah le choi’ann na kahin peuve.
en_web: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
en_kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

tcz: Ahinlah, keima Koi kahiya, ka mite chu ipi hiuvam, nangma angsung a kipah le thanomtah a ipi hijongle kapeh jing thei uham? Kanei, kagou jouseu nangma a konna kamu jeng u ahin, kapeh hou jouse nangman neipehsao ngen jeng ahi.
en_web: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.
en_kjv: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

tcz: Chuleh, kapu kapateu bang’a, Hiche leiset a hi khopem le maljin maimai kahiuvin, kahinkhou jong nilim kihei bang’in agei na akihepha ji tapoi.
en_web: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.
en_kjv: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

tcz: “Ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nangma jabol na, na Houin theng sah nadia kahin to khom u ijakai hi nang’a ahin, nangman neipeh jeng u ahi.
en_web: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.
en_kjv: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

tcz: Ka Pathen, nangman kalung’u nakholchilsoh jin, nalunglhai na chung’a nakipapi ji’e ti keima neihetsah in, chule lunggil tah a keiman thil hicheng kabol jong nahen ahi. Kamiten jong kipah le thanom tah thilto, thilpeh nangma houin theng sahdoh nadia ahin choi u jong neimusah jing’e.
en_web: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.
en_kjv: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

tcz: Vo thaneipen Pathen, Kapu’u Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Israelte Pathen, namiten nathu angai jing ding uvin kahung tao’e. Nangma na jabol le na hepi nao jong mu jing’in.
en_web: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;
en_kjv: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

tcz: Kachapa Solomon’in alungthim pumpia nathupeh chengse anit a, na danthu le na hettohsah hihen, ejakai ajui jing’a, keiman kagontup pehsa na Houin theng kisahdoh kahsen lungvul na pejing o.
en_web: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
en_kjv: and give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

tcz: Chuphat’in, David in mipi ho jah a, “Na Pakai, na Pathen’u thangvah un” ati. Hichun, mipi jousen Pathen athangvah un, Apu apateu Pathen masang’in abohkhup un, chibai abol uvin, lengpa jong jabolna apeuvin ahi.
en_web: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.
en_kjv: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.

tcz: Ajing nikhon, mipiten Pakaiya kilhainan Bongchal sangkhat, Kelngoi sangkhat le kelngoichal sangkhat ahin choijun, pumgo thilton atoh uve. Chujongle, Israel pumpi min’in lengpitwi le kilhaina tampi jong ahin choi uvin ahi.
en_web: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
en_kjv: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

tcz: Ann nehkhom abol’un, lengpitwi adon’un, Kipah le thanomtah in Pathen athangvah uve. Chujongle, Leng David chapa Solomon chu mipi ho masang’in leng hung chang din thao anu un, Zadok jong chu thempu din thaonuna achangtai.
en_web: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
en_kjv: and did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

tcz: Chuin, Solomon in apa Leng David laltouna mun chu ahin khel tan, imalam jousea apa athakhel jou in, Israel pumpin jong ajabol sohkei taove.
en_web: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
en_kjv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

tcz: Mi thupiho, Gaalhang ho chuleh Leng David chapate jousen jong Lengpa Solomon adin kitepna le kipehdohna anei taove.
en_web: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
en_kjv: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

tcz: Chuban’a Pathenin Leng Solomon chu Israel pumpi masang a adomsang’in, a itih a Israel lengten jong ana chan phahlou, minthanna, loupi nale jabolna sangpenin Pathenin phatthei abohtai.
en_web: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
en_kjv: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

tcz: Hitobanga hi, Jesse chapa Leng David hin jong Israel pumpin Lengvai ana pon ahi.
en_web: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
en_kjv: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

tcz: A Lengvai poh chu kum somli alhing’in, kum sagi sung Hebron chuleh, kum somthum le thum sung chu Jerusalem a lengvai ana po’i.
en_web: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinkhon haona, jabolna achang’in, kum sottah hinkho kipah le thanom in amang in, atehset a ahinkho lhin mong’in athin, chuphat’in achapa Solomon in a Lengmun ahin khel e.
en_web: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
en_kjv: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

tcz: Leng David vaipoh sungsea thil ejakai kijihlut ho jouse chu, a mitvaneipa Samuel thusimbu, Nathan themgaopa thusimle lekhabu, mitvaneipa Gad thusimbu a akijihlut soh in ahi.
en_web: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
en_kjv: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

tcz: Hiche thilsoh ho jouse hin Leng David loupi na aphochen uvin, chuleh a lengvaipoh sung’a Israel le akimvel lenggam hoa thilsoh jouse jong ajao cheh e.
en_web: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
en_kjv: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

tcz: David chapa Solomon chun alenggam dettah in atungdohtai; Ijeh inem itihleh Pakai a Pathen chun aumpia chuleh sangtah'a athaneisah ahitai.
en_web: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.
en_kjv: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

tcz: Solomon chun Israel lamkaiho galsat sepai asang, aja chunga luboh ho thutan vaihom ho, gamsung lamkai hojouse chule phung lamkai ho akoukhomin ahi.
en_web: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.
en_kjv: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
