tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng nu-ngah hoipen chu Vashti khel’in lengnun pansah-in,” atiuve. Aseiyu hi lengpan thilphan agel’in aboltai.

tcz: Hiche laitah chun Susa khopi sunga chun Jair chapa Mordecai kiti Judate mikhat ana um'in ahi. Amachu Benjamin phung sunga Kish le Shimei chilhah khat anahi.
en_web: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,
en_kjv: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;
tcz_gospelgo: Susa khopi a chun Juda mi Jair chapa Mordecai achenge. Mordecai hi Benjamin phunga mi, Kish le Shimei son ahi.

tcz: Amahi Nebuchadnezzer lengpan Juda lengpa Jehoiachin Jerusalema konna Babylon na ahin kailut tha holah a insung mikhat ahi.
en_web: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
en_kjv: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
tcz_gospelgo: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzarin Judah lengpa Jehoiachin le sohchang dang Jerusalema kona akaimang chun alah-uva Mordecai jong apange.

tcz: Hiche mipa hin Hadassah ahilou leh Esther tiajong kihe, apangahpa chanu khat ana vahdoh ahin, amanu hi mimel hoitah leh dei umtah nungah ahi. Amahi anule apa athi phatna Mordecai hin ainsung mikhatna ahin kilah lutna achanu tabang banga ahn kikhou khah ahi.
en_web: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.
en_kjv: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecai hin asopite chanu khat achanu banga akisem, Hebrew paova amin Hadassah kiti Esther, nu-ngah mel-hoi tah le gongso hoitah khat aneiye. Anule apa thi phat’a mordecai hin achanu bang banga avopdoh ahi.

tcz: Lengpa dan thupeh dungjuija khangdong numei dang tamtah toh Susa khopi sunga leng in na numei kikholna mun ah ahin puilut’un Hegai vesuina noijah akoi taovin ahi.
en_web: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.
en_kjv: So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan nu-ngah jouse khop dia thuphondoh abol phat’in, Susa khopia nu-ngah ahinpuilut nauva Esther jong apangkhai. Esther jong leng inpia, leng numeiho in vaipo Hegai thu noiya akoitauve.

tcz: Amanu hin Hegai chu alung lhaisah lheh jengin hijeh chun amanjong Esther chu khohsahna neitah in ajen pantan ahi. Aman gangtah in nehle chah atuipen agonpeh in, amelhoina dinga akinuding jong agonpeh loi jengin ahi. Aman amanu jenle dingin leng inpia kon in nungah sagi agonpeh in numei kikholna a mun nompen laitah a ajenle nungah hotoh aumsah in ahi.
en_web: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.
en_kjv: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king’s house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.
tcz_gospelgo: Hegaiyin Esther adeiyin, Eshterin jong hegai along lhaisah lheh-e. Hegaiyin man gangtah-in Esther semhoina ding le atahsa thaosah lai din na atongpanin, neh le chah pha pha apetai. Esther chu leng inpi numeiho umnaa mun nompen apen, akibol din leng inpia numei sagi jen apansah tai.

tcz: Mordecai in aseipeh dungjuijin amanu hin koi nam mi koi insunga kon ahi koimacha kom’a aseidoh pon ahi.
en_web: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.
en_kjv: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin ahilchah masah jen-in, Estherin Judah mi ahi chu aseidoh poi.

tcz: Niseh in, Mordecai chun Esther chunga chu itobang thu sohtam ti ahetnom jeh'in numeiho kikholna munlai tah leitol vella chun avahle le jin ahi.
en_web: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.
en_kjv: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women’s house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh le Esther chu itobanga, achunga ipi soh ding ti hetdoh gon, Mordecai chu leng inpi numeiho umna maiya adung avaiyin achelejie.

tcz: Hiche nungah hochu lengpa jalkhunna akipuilut masangin lha somleni melhoina dinga kijenna phat chu kipea ahi; lhagup sungchu Myrrh thao kinuding, lhagup ma chu gim namtui phapen ho akinudiu ahi.
en_web: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).
en_kjv: Now when every maid’s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)
tcz_gospelgo: Numei semhoina phat chu angaiya kum khat ahin, lhagup ma myrrh kinua tahsa mehnou chet ding, chule balsam thao nu na lhagup ma lutbe ding ahi.Hichengse akichaisoh hel teng nu-ngahho chu khat khat a lengpa Xerxes anga puilut ding ahi.

tcz: Lengpa kom’a acheding tengleh numei kikholna konna chu numei kijep pahna thil itobang hijongleh akichoi nom penkhat akichoi ding ahi.
en_web: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.
en_kjv: then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king’s house.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei inpia pat leng inpi ajot teng nu-ngah chun ipi hijongle adei dei akivon ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nilhah teng chuleh amanu chu lengpa indan tumbeh khatna kipuilut ding, chujou teng ajing jingkah tengle lengpa inpi numei kholna anichanna lengpa jite chenna a chu puilut ding ahi. Hichea chu lengpa thaikem ho chingpa Shaashgaz vetsuina noija umdiu ahi. Amachu ijemtia lengpan ngaichatna aneija aminna ahinkou tilouva lengpa kom’a chu lutkit lou helding ahi.
en_web: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.
en_kjv: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah teng lengpa henga lut ding, jingkah teng numei inpi chom khat’a apuilut’uva, lengpa thaikemho vaipo, nukiso Shaashgaz noiya um ding ahi. Hiche a lutsa chu lengpan adeiya amin a akou kit loule lengpa koma lut kit lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Esther chu Mordecai pangah Abihail chanu ahi (Mordecai jin apangahpa chanu khangdongcha Esther chu ahin vahdoh ahi). Lengpa kom’a Esther chephat ahung hiphat in, numei kholna a avesui apang nukiso Hegai in ahilna chengse chu akimel chih in ahi. Amanun thildang imacha donlouvin amapan aseipeh bouchu akichoijin ahileh amujousen a-ot chalheh jengun ahi.
en_web: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.
en_kjv: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
tcz_gospelgo: Amupha chan seiphat, Abihail chanu, Mordecai chagavopnu, Esther lengpa henga lutna ding phat ahitai. Esther alut phat’in, numei inpi vaipo, nukiso Hedgaiyin von dia aseipeh bangin akivontai.

tcz: Esther chu leng Xerxes avaihomna kum sagi channa phalbi hunglhun tilchun lengpa khopia lengpa koma chun apuilut’un ahi.
en_web: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
en_kjv: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Xerxes lengchan kal kum sagi na, lha som lhin, Tebeth lhan, leng inpia Xerxes lengpa angsunga Esther apuilut tauve.

tcz: Lengpan khangdong numei dangho sangin alungset jon ahi. Lengpan amanu chu adeilheh jengin, hijeh chun lallukhuh chu akhuhpeh in Vashti khellin lengnun atung tan ahi.
en_web: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
en_kjv: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan Esther chu nu-ngah dang dang sangin adeipenin, nu-ngah dang sangin aman lengpa sei abol’in angailotai. Lengpan lallukhuh akhuhpeh-in, Vashti khel’in lengnun asemtai.

tcz: Hiche chu alopna in Esther min’in milen milal holeh vaihom hochu golvah abolpeh in gambih ho jousea nikhat choldo nikho alhapeh in kipa thilpeh jong mijouse apen ahi.
en_web: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.
en_kjv: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Esther jabolnan lengpan golvah abol’in, vaipo vaibol chengse akousoh keiye. Lenggam pumpia choldo nikho aphongdoh-in leng khat peh lomtah thilpeh tampi ahomdoh-e.

tcz: Khangdong numei hochu numei kholna anichanna a chu asollut jouvun, chule Mordecai chu khopi sunga vaihom khat in ahungpang tan ahi.
en_web: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.
en_kjv: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king’s gate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepat hin lengpan Mordecai chu vaipo khat’in apansah tai.

tcz: Hichan geijin jong Esther chun anam leh akonna insung aphongdoh hih laiye. Aman Mordecai in na aumlaija athu angai bangin tunjong athupeh ajui nalaije
en_web: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.
en_kjv: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Esther in Juda mi ahi aseidoh hih laiye. Mordecai hin koimacha aseipeh lou dia ahiljeh a, aneocha lhah thu anun jing banga, athua nunga aseidoh lou ahi.

tcz: Nikhat hi Mordecai chu lengpa kotpi kom’a anatohna munna ana toupet chun lengpa dinga nukiso, lengpa achom’a agena indan ngah teni Bigthan le Teresh chu lengpa Xerxes chunga alung hang lhonnin thadoh dingin agong lhontan ahi.
en_web: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.
en_kjv: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin leng inpia na atoh pet hin, lengpa indan sunga lutna kelkot ngahte ni-Bigthana le TEresh-in lengpa Xerxes adou lhonin, tha din ago lhontai.

tcz: Ahinlah Mordecai jin athilgon lhonchu ana jadoh in lengnu Esther kom’a chun thu chu analhut in ahi. Amanun hichu lengpa kom’a aseidoh in Mordecai akonna kihedoh ahichu ana hetsah e.
en_web: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.
en_kjv: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai’s name.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilgon lhon hi Mordecaiyyin ahetdoh doh-in Esther ahil le, Mordecai thil het chu Estherin lengpa aseipeh tai.

tcz: Hichu kholtohna aneiyun ahile Mordecai thusei chu adih monge ti photchetna aum phat in nukiso teni chu thingchunga akhailih taovin ahi. Hichehi Xerxes lengpa thusimbua akijih lut tan ahi.
en_web: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.
en_kjv: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Phatah a akholchil’u le, thudih ahin, mithat gote ni thingchunga akhailih tauve. Aumdol hi lenggam thusimbua jih lut din lengpan thu apetai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin leng Xerxes in Agag mipa Hamadatha chapa Haman chu atohmun akalsah in amithupi holah a achungnung pen’in apansah in, aleng gamsunga vaihom ho jouse lah a thanei pen’in apansah tan ahi.
en_web: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.
en_kjv: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chom khat jouvin lengpa Xerxes-in Haman kitipa chu Semang pipun atung lentai.Haman hi Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa ahi.

tcz: Lengpa dinga vaipo ho jousen lengpa thupeh dungjuija Haman masanga hi dilsu sohkei diu jana apeh chehdiu ahi. Ahinlah Mordecai hi adilsu nompon jana jong ape nompon ahi.
en_web: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.
en_kjv: And all the king’s servants, that were in the king’s gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.
tcz_gospelgo: Akinbol vaipo jouse kun cheh a Haman jabolna chibai aboh cheh diuvin lengpan aseitai. Abonchan abol cheh-un, Mordecai seh she adai.

tcz: Hichejou hin lengpa kelkot kom’a um lengpa khopi vaipo a panghon Mordecai jah a, “Nang in ipi dinga lengpa thupeh nanit louham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”
en_kjv: Then the king’s servants, which were in the king’s gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king’s commandment?
tcz_gospelgo: Leng inpia vaipo dangsen, lengpa thupeh anit louna jeh Mordecai adongun;

tcz: Amahon niseh in aseipeh jengun ahinlah aman thupeh chu ajuideh pon ahi. Hijeh chun amahon Mordecai chu Judate ahi chu ahet utoh kilhon chun Haman chun i-alo am ti in Mordecai umchan chu Haman chu aseipeh un ahi.
en_web: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.
en_kjv: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
tcz_gospelgo: niseh-in anit teina din asol sol jengun, amala anom naisaipoi. Aman, “kei Juda mi kahin, Haman noiya kun a chibai kaboh thei lou ding ahi,” ati.Vaipoten athusoh hi Haman aseipeh-un, Mordecai umchan angaidam ding le angaidamlou didng along dong lheh-ui.

tcz: Haman in Modecai chun a-anga abohkhup lou chuleh jana apehlou chu amun alung ahang lheh jeng tan ahi.
en_web: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.
en_kjv: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Akoma Mordicai kun a chibai boh ding nop lou ajah phat’in Haman alung hang behseh jengin;

tcz: Aman Mordecai chu koi nam mi ahi ti ahin hetdoh phat in, Mordecai chung seh seh a thilse bolding chu ahin sit tan ahi. Hijeh chun Xerxes lenggam pumpin Judate te jouse suhmang dingin ahin gongtan ahi.
en_web: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone, for they had made known to him Mordecai’s people. Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai’s people.
en_kjv: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
tcz_gospelgo: chule Mordecai m aJuda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’in, Mordecai she talen matsah sanga khoh cheh bolagoi. Hiti hin Persia gamsung pumpia Juda mi jouse thagam ding thil agongtai.

tcz: Hiti chun leng Xerxes vaipoh kum somni le kumni channa Lhatun lhasung in athilgon ho tohdoh na dinga hi ipi lhapen lhasungin phading ham tichu Haman kom’a vangvetna ana um'in ahi (Hiche vangvetna chu Purim akiti). Anikho kilhengdoh chu alha Lhakao lha nisagi ni ahin, hiche nikho chu kumkhat jou anahi.
en_web: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
en_kjv: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa Xerxes lengchan kal kum somle ni lhinna, lha masa, Nisan lhan, athilgon molsona ding nikho pha le lha kitoh holdoh didng deinan Haman hin Purim phun san ding aseitai.

tcz: Hijouchun Haman in leng Xerxes kom’a chun achen aga sei tai, “Naleng gamsunga hin namchom jatkhat aum in ama hohi gambih jousea hin akithe thangsoh hellun, chule midanga konin atumbeh in aumin ahi. Amahon midanga toh kibanglou dan chombeh aneiyun, lengpa na dan sem jonghi anit pouvin ahi. Hijeh chun amaho hinghoi ding lengpa dingin thilpha hiponte,” ati peh tai.
en_web: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.
en_kjv: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king’s laws: therefore it is not for the king’s profit to suffer them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Hamanin lengpa jah a, “Naleng gamsunga hin mihem nam khat kithecheh a, gamkai jousea chegnsoh kei aum’e. Hiche nam mite hin midangto kitoh louhel chonchan dan aneiyui. Akhoh cheh-in, amaho hin gamsung danthu jong anit pouvin, hijeh a chu amaho hinghoi hoi ding nan gdin hung phaponte.

tcz: “Hijeh chun lengpa nalung lhaina ahiding leh amaho hi suhmangna dingin dan khat semdoh jengin lang hiche din tongdoh ding hochu keiman dangka talent sang som pe nange, amahon hiche lengpa sumkholna insunga koinao vinte.” ati.
en_web: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”
en_kjv: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadeile thugahna khat sunin lang hiche nam mite hi kithatgamle phante. Nanop pou poule, leng gamsung kivaipohna manchah din dangka talent sangsom peng ting, leng thil kholnaa koiyinge,” ati.

tcz: Lengpan aphatsah in, athulhuh nachu suhdetna in akhutna kon in akhutjem aladoh in Agag mipa Hammedatha chapa Haman Judate galmipa kom’a chun apetan ahi.
en_web: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.
en_kjv: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan khutjem mohor a kisem, thuphondoh jouse kinamkhumji chu asut lhan, Judate melmapa, Agag chilhah Hamandatha chapa Haman apetai.

tcz: Lengpan aseijin, “Hiche sum chuleh mipi hochu nang khutna aum’e phante nati dan dannin boltan” ati.
en_web: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”
en_kjv: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Haman jah a, “Judate le asum jouseu nanga ahitan, pha nasah lam lamin bol jengin,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Lhatun nidan nisom le nisagi ni hin lengpa lekha sun hochu akoukhom un chuleh Haman dei dungjuitah chun dan khat jihdoh in aumtai. Hiche chu lengpa vaihom lenpen ho, gambih a gamvaipo ho, chuleh gambih jousea milen milal ho, amaho lekha jemleh apaocheh un akijihdoh in ahi. Hiche dan chu leng Xerxes min in akijih in achunga lengpa mohor chu akinam khum in ahi.
en_web: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.
en_kjv: Then were the king’s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king’s ring.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha masapen nisom le nithum nin Hamanin lengpa lekhajihho jouse akoukhomin, leng gamsunga kimang lekhajem jouse le pao jouse aledoh a jih ding, chule vaipote l egamvaipo chengse thotsoh hel din, thuphondoh khat ajihsah tai. Lekha chu lengpa Xerxes min a kijih, amohor kinamkhum ahi.

tcz: Hiche lekha hochu gangtah a aga hopdoh loi diuvin thupole a pangho chu akisoldoh in, amahon lenggam sunga gambih ho jousea agahomdoh un Judate ho jouse khangdonga patna tehse gei, numei chapang puma nikhat sunga thadoh ding, suhmang chuleh suhbeihel ding ahi akiti. Hiche kinhi kumkit alha Lhakao ni sagi nia tohdoh teidinga thupeh ahi. Hitobanga kithat Judate ho thilkeo chu athat ho chang ding ahiuve.
en_web: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.
en_kjv: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.
tcz_gospelgo: Solle hon hiche lakha chu gamsunga ahomsoh tauve. Asunga kisun chun-nikhatseh sung, Adar lha nisomle nithum ni le-Judate abonchauva, ateh akhang, numei chapang thagam hel dia asei ahi. Hepi beihel’a thagam ding, anei agou chengseu chomsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche dan kijihna lekha hi gambih jousea thot-lut sohding chuleh mijouse lekha phondoh ding hitia chu akitep nikho ahunglhung teng tohdoh jeng theina diuva kigong ahi.
en_web: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.
en_kjv: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho alhin teng miho kigingsa aum theina diuva gamkai jouse thuphondoh chu phonjalsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Lengpa thupeh a kon in, dan kisodoh hochu thupole hon gangtah a ahopdoh diu, Susa khopia akiphongdoh tai. Hiche jouchun lengpa le Haman atou lhonin adonkhom lhontai; ahinla Susa khopia mipite lah achun lungkham nale boina alhungtai.
en_web: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.
en_kjv: The posts went out, being hastened by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa thupeh-in thugahna chu munpipen khopi Susa a aphongdoh-un sole hon athu ho gamkai jouse alhutsoh tauve.Susa khopi sung mipi lung donga kihel lei loi pet hin lengpanle Hamanin nomtah-in toumun ju adon lhon’e.

tcz: Mordecai jin hitobanga thilsoh hi ahetdoh phat in, apon abot’eh in khaodip pon aki ah in vut akinun, chuin khopi achun alhailut in awging tah le lungna tah in apengjah jeng tan ahi.
en_web: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.
en_kjv: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh jouse Mordecaiyin ajahsoh phat’in lung gimin aponsil chengse abottelsoh tai. Khaodip pon asil’in, lujanga leivui kiloiyin, khopi lailunga avah len, lhase tah-in othongje jun akap’in,

tcz: Hiti chun ama khopi kelkot geijin ache in ahi, ajehchu hitobanga lung hesohna von pum in koima khopi kelkotna lutthei lou ahi.
en_web: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
en_kjv: and came even before the king’s gate: for none might enter into the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
tcz_gospelgo: leng inpi kulpi kotphung geiyin ahunge. Khaodip ponsil koima lut ding aphal loujeh-un leng inpia alut poi.

tcz: Chuleh hiche lengpa dan aga kiphondoh na gambih jousea chun Judate ho lah a lunghem na nasatah alhungtai. Amahon an angol’un, akap un, aping un, chuleh mitamtah in vut akinu uvin khaodip pon akisil un ahi.
en_web: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
en_kjv: And in every province, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa thuphondoh kisseidohna gamkai jousea, Judate lah a lunghem ka ogin thong akijai, Judate an ngol le kap le lunghemin aum’un, atamjonkhaodip pon dil’in vutvam lah a akijamtauve.

tcz: Lengnu Esther jenle nungah holeh nukisohon Mordecai umchan chu aseipeh phat un, ama jong alungkham lheh jengtan ahi. Amanun khaodip pon akisil khella akisil dingin pon agah thotnin ahinla Mordecai chu anompon ahi.
en_web: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.
en_kjv: So Esther’s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecai umchan hi nukiso ho le Esther aseipeh phat’un, alung gim lheh jenge. Khaodip pon kheldohna dia Mordecai hi ponsil athot vangin, Mordecaiyin akilah dehpoi.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Esther in lengpa dinga nukiso holah a ama lhacha dinga kipansah pa Hathach chu akouvin, Mordecai chun ipi hahsatna atoh ham chule ibola lunggim tah a uma ham ti gakholdoh dingin asol tan ahi.
en_web: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.
en_kjv: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Estherin alhacha dia lengpan akoipeh, leng inpia nukiso, Hathach chu akouvin, ipi jeh a Mordecai chute chon ahidol photoh din asoltai.

tcz: Hijeh chun Hathach chu khopi kelkot mai lang leitol a um Mordecai kom’a chun agachen ahi.
en_web: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.
en_kjv: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king’s gate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hathach chu Mordecai umna, khopi ningkoi, leng inpi lutna kotphunga achei.

tcz: Mordecai in thusoh ho jouse leh Judate suhmang’a aumna dinga Haman in sum ijat lengte sumkhol na a dinga atodoh got ham tichu hoitah in ana seipeh soh keijin ahi.
en_web: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.
en_kjv: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh chengse Mordecaiyin aseipeh-in, Judate akithagam le leng inpi thil kholnaa Hamanin akoilut nom sum jat jong aseithai.

tcz: Judate jouse kisuh mangna dinga Susa khopi sunga kisodoh dan lekha pehkhat chu Hathach anapen ahi. Aman hiche lekha chu Esther anavetsah ding chuleh thil umdan chu hoitah a ahilchet dingin Hathach chu agah ngan sen ahi. Aman Hathach jah a chun Esther chu sollin lang lengpa kom’a amite inging a taohen ati.
en_web: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.
en_kjv: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
tcz_gospelgo: Judate kithagamna dia Susa khopia kona kihomdoh thuphondoh lekha jong pheng khat Hathach apei. Mordecaiyin Hathach hin lekha chu Esther koma apeh a, aumdol hilchet’a, chule Esther asol’a amite chunga lengpan hepina anei theina dia ngeh didn aseipeh-e.

tcz: Hiti chun Hathach chu Mordecai jin angan sena pumchun Esther kom’a chun ahung kile tai.
en_web: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
en_kjv: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
tcz_gospelgo: Hathach chun asei bangin abol’in,

tcz: Hiche jouchun Esther in Mordecai kom’a, athu lepoh dingin Hathach chu asolkit in ahi.
en_web: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:
en_kjv: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai:
tcz_gospelgo: Estherin ma Mordecai henga thu lethah kit dingin asol’in,

tcz: “Lengpa vaipo hole gambih hoa cheng mipiho jouse jengin jong, koihileh lengpan akou hilouva lengpa kom’a lut aum a ahileh lengpan a sana tenggol ahin lhunlut louleh thitei tei ding ahi ti hi mijousen ahet khatchu ahi. Tuhin lengpan eikou louna ni somthum alhingtai” ati.
en_web: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”
en_kjv: All the king’s servants, and the people of the king’s provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
tcz_gospelgo: “Numei hihen pasal hile, kou louva leng inpi sung gil’a lut tapou chu thi jeng ding ahi. Hiche hi Danthu ahin, lengpa thumop ho apat gamkai mitinin ahet cheh ahi. Hiche danthu peldohna ding lam khat aumin, lengpan aleng tenggol adop khumpa vang sohcha ding ahi. Ahinla lengpan eikou louna hi lha khat jen alhingtai,” ati.

tcz: Hathach chun Esther thusei chu Mordecai kom alhut kittai.
en_web: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.
en_kjv: And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin Esther thu thot amu phat’in,

tcz: Mordecai in Esther chu adonbutna alethot in; “Khopi sunga naum man in Judate jouse akitha gamteng kihoidoh nante tin kigel hih in.
en_web: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.
en_kjv: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: gihsalna thu alethot’in, “Leng inpia naum vangin Juda dang sangin hoidoh nang tin kinep dan.

tcz: Hitobang phat nahi thipbeh a naum a ahileh, hoilang ham khatna kon ahi Judate tedinga hoidoh nale olna hungsohdoh ding, amavang nangle nainsung mite thiding ahi. Kon ija ahetn em hitobang phatna ding jeh’a hi lengnu mun nalo hithei tah ahi!”
en_web: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
en_kjv: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang phat’a hi naum thim le van a konin Judate kithopi ding hunga, huhhinga um tei diu nang vang nathi tei ding, napa khanggui bei ding ahitai. Kon ija ahet’em, ijem itile hitobang phat hung lhun ding jeh alengnua napan khat jong hithei tah ahi!” ati.

tcz: Hichejou chun Esther in Mordecai chu hiti hin thu athot kitne;
en_web: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,
en_kjv: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer:
tcz_gospelgo: Estherin hiti hin Mordecai adonbut’in,

tcz: “Susa khopia um Judate jouse gakoukhom inlang keidingin an-ngollin hungtao vun. Nithum sungin anjong nelou twijong donlouvin asun ajan in um un. Kanungah hole kenjong hitima chu kaboldiu ahi. Hiche jouteng chuleh dan in aphallou hijongleh, kathile kathi, kahinle kahin, lengpa kom’a kagalut ding ahi,” atipeh tai.
en_web: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”
en_kjv: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day; I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
tcz_gospelgo: “Susa khopia Judate gakhomin lang, kei din an ngol’in neitaoeh-un, nithum l ejanthumin neh le chan bolda jengun. Kalhacha nu-ngahho le kenjong chutima kabol diu ahi. Chujoule, Danthu to kikal hijeng jongle, lengpa koma kalut ding, kahtilo jeng idng hijongle kathi mai ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Mordecai apotdoh in Esther in ahin thupeh dungjui chet chun aga boltai.
en_web: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
en_kjv: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecai akipatdoh-inEsther sei jouse aboltai.

tcz: A an-ngol nithum lhinni chun, Esther in lengnu von in akivon in, indan sungnung’a alut in, lengpa touna laltouna na chu angan agading tai. Lengpa chu indan sunga alatouna a chun atouvin, kotphung lam chu ana nga in ahi.
en_web: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.
en_kjv: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, over against the king’s house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.
