en_kjv: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
tcz_gospelgo: EStherin, “Eihehseuva kamelmau, hiche migiloupa Haman hi ahi!” ton akoh tai.

tcz: Hiche jouchun lengpa chu lunghang tah in adingdoh in khopi honlei langa chun apotdoh tan ahi. Haman vangchu lengnu Esther in ahinkho ahuhdohna dinga tao dingin aumden tan ahi, ajehchu lengpan amachu ahinghoi louding akihet ahitai.
en_web: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
en_kjv: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa lung hangval’in akipatdoh-in, indan sung dalhan, leng inpi polam honleiya agavah lei. Lengpan talen amatsah tei ding amudoh phat’in Haman aumdenin, lengnu Esther koma ahinghoi teina din atao tao jenge.

tcz: Alungkham man’in lengnu lupna chunga chun abohkhup jengtan ahileh lengpa khopi honlei langa konna ahung kilekit langtoh akitoh khan ahi. Lengpan asamjah jengin, “Amahin kamaikoh tah jenga jong lengnu hi hitia hi adelkhum jeng ding hitam? Lengpa agah paodoh jouchun alhacha hon Haman chu amanthah nading vetsahnan amai pon in akhu taove.
en_web: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
en_kjv: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahepi teina dinEsther jalkhuna akisep lhun ataove. Hichepet tah chun honleiya konin lengpa ahung nungkit’in insung ahunglut’e. Aumchan amudoh phat’in lengpa akisenjah jengin, “Hichepa hin kaleng inpi sung jenga jong, kamitmu changtah a lengnu geiya suhset aot hitam?” tin aseitai. Lengpan asei jou lou laiyin nukiso hon Haman luchang atom paitauve.

tcz: Hiche jou chu lengpa dinga nukiso khat Harbona atiuchun ahin seijin, “Haman hin thinglhon amuh hemkhat feet sam sagi le nga a sao aleitolla akoije ati. Hiche chu aman lengpa min athana dinga ana huhdohpa Mordecai chu thana dinga anagon chu ahi. “Hichu ahileh hichea chun Haman chu khailih taovin,” tin lengpan thupeh aneitai.
en_web: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”
en_kjv: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
tcz_gospelgo: Nukiso ho lah a Harbonah chun, “Nahuhhinga Mordecai thana din Haman hin thingpel semsan a-in a akoiye. Thingpel lentah, metre somni le ni jen sang ahi!” ati. Lengpan, “Ama khailih nan ganeiyun!” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Haman in Mordecai khailih na dinga anasem thinglhon achun amajoh achu akhailih taove.
en_web: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
en_kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Mordecai khailihn adinga asemsa thingpel a chun Haman akhailih-un, lengpa jong alungdamtai.

tcz: Hicheni mama chun Xerxes lengpan Judate galmi Haman thil leh lo ho jouse chu lengnu Esther apedoh tai. Hichejou chun Esther in Mordecai chu insungmi ahi lengpa kom’ah aseidoh tan ahileh Mordecai chu lengpa kom’a ahin puilut taovin ahi.
en_web: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.
en_kjv: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews’ enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chun lengpa Xerxes chun Judate melma Haman thille lo, neile gou abonchan Esther apetai. Mordecai apa-ngah ahichu Estherin lengpa aseipeh-in, hichea pat hin Mordecai lengpa koma alut theitai

tcz: Lengpan Haman’a konna ana nung lahdoh asoi namna khutjem chu aladoh in Mordecai chu apetai. Hiti chun Esther chun Mordecai chu Haman thil le lo chunga vaihom in ana pansah tan ahi.
en_web: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
en_kjv: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan Haman khut’a anunglah, akhutjem, mohor umna chu asut lhan Mordecai apetai. Estherin Mordecai chu Haman neile gou jouse chingtup din akoitai.

tcz: Hijou chun Esther chu lengpa kom’a ache kit'in akeng khopi muh a abohkhup in Agag mi Haman in Judate te douna thil giloutah ana gon chu suh-tangna dingin mitlhi pumin anataovin ahi.
en_web: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.
en_kjv: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Esther lengpa khophangbul;a lhun akap’in, Agag chilhah Haman thilse gon, Judate thagam dia agot chu suhtangna dia thil khatbeh bolsah din a-ngeh tai.

tcz: Avellin lengpan Esther dingin asana tengol chu ahin lhungdoh in hiti chun ama athoudoh in a-angsung’ah adingtai.
en_web: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.
en_kjv: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan Esther din leng tenggol adop khumin, amanu dingdoh-in aseitai,

tcz: Esther in ajah a, “Lengpa nalunglhai dinga chuleh khotona kamu theiding ahija chujongle nalung lhaina kachanthei dinga ahile Agag mipa Haman thupeh hohi suhbei na dingin dan khat semdoh le chun kati, ajehchu aman lengpa gambih jousea cheng Judate ho jouse suh gamna dinga thupeh ananei ahi,” ati.
en_web: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.
en_kjv: and said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king’s provinces:
tcz_gospelgo: “Lengpan pha nasah a, kei thi ding nadaa, dih nasah le, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Haman thupeh, leng gamsunga Judate thagam dia thupeh aneisa suh tangna din thuphondoh khat sodoh le chun kati.

tcz: Ajehchu kamipite le kainsung mite akitha gamma akisuhmang ding ken iti kathoh dingham?”
en_web: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”
en_kjv: for how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang manthahna kamite chunga lhunga ka-inkote geiya kithagam ding chu iti kathoh ding hitam?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Xerxes lengpan lengnu Esther le Judate mi Mordecai kom’ah, “Keima Haman thilkeo jouse Esther kape tan chuleh aman Judate te suhmang ding agot jeh in thinglhon chunga amajoh akikhailih tan,
en_web: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.
en_kjv: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun lengpa Xerxes-in lengnu Esther le Juda mi Mordecai jah a, “Ve-lhonin, Hamanin Judate thagam agotjeh-in kakhailih-in, anei agou jouse Esther kapetai.

tcz: Tun lengpa min’in Judate techu nadei dandan’in thuthot tan chuleh lengpa khutjem chun mohor namkhum tan. Chule lengpa minna khatvei mohor kinamsa chu kinung lahdoh kit theitalou ding ahi, ti melchih lhon in, atipeh tai.
en_web: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”
en_kjv: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa min a thuphondoh kisema leng mohor kinam khum vang chu kikhel theiponte, Judate vang chu nadei deiya lekha nathot thei lhon ahi; kei min a najih lhon a leng mohor nanamkhum thei lhon ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun lhathum lhinna, Sivan lha, nisom ni le nithum nichun, Mordecai in lengpa lekha jeh a pangho chu akikou khomin chuleh Mordecai jin jih in ati dungjui chun ajih taovin ahi. Hiche chu Judate ho komlah vaihom ho jouse kom, gamvaipo ho kom, gambih jakhat le somni le sagi, India a patna Ehopia changeijin milen milal ho jouse kom’ah akithot dohtan ahi. Hiche dan chu lenggam sunga mipite Judate op um'in ama ama paole ama lekhajem cheh in akisunin ahi.
en_web: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.
en_kjv: Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha thum lhinna, Sivan lha, nisom ni le nithum nia hiche hi soh ahi. Mordecaiyin lengpa lekhajih ho akoukhomin, Judate le gamvaipote, vaibolte, India pat Sudan gei gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athot’ui. Lekhaho chu agamkai pao le lekhajem cheh, Judate din jong Judate lekhajem le apaovun ajihsoh keiyui.

tcz: Hiche dan chu Xerxes lengpa minna kisun ahin, akhut jemma mohor kinamkhum ah ahi. Mordecai in hiche thuhi gangtah a homdoh dingin lengpa kin’a kimang sakol lhaihat cheh chu asoldoh in ahi.
en_web: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.
en_kjv: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin lekha thot ho chu lengpa Xerxes minin ajihsah-in, leng mohor anamkhumsoh keiye. Lekha thot jouse chu leng sakolbuh a kihen, sakol jangkhai cheh mangin mi atousah-in agahopsah sohkeiye.

tcz: Hiche leng thupeh hin khopi tinna um Judate hochu kipun khomna kihuhdohna anei thei diu ahi. Koi nammi hihenlang hoilai gambih a konna hijohgleh aji achateo leh amaho hindel buluho jouse chu athaova, asuhmang diu chuleh asuhgamhel theidiu chuleh agalmi hou thilkeo akichom theidiu ahi.
en_web: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,
en_kjv: wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekha thot hoa kisei chu-khopi jousea cheng Judaten akihuhdoh na diuva pangkhom thei din lengpan aphalpeh-e. Gamkai hoilai hihen, itobang manchah choi min hindel khum’u jongle, asat thuh-uva, numei chapang geiya athagam diu, khatcha hing hoi louva, anei agou jouseu geiya akichom diduvin aseiye.

tcz: Xerxes lenggam jousea hitobang tohna dinga nikho kilhengdoh chu Lhakao nisagi ni kumkit hiding ahi.
en_web: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
en_kjv: upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thugahna hi lha somle ni lhinna, Adar lha, nisom le nithum ni, Judate thagam pumpia manchah dia kisei ahi.

tcz: Hiche dan kisodoh hi gambih jousea juiding dan hiding mipiah jousea phondoh ding, hitia chu Judate ten hiche nikho ahi agalmihou chunga phu alah thei nadiu ahi.
en_web: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
en_kjv: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Athu hi pondoh a Danthua pang ding, gamkai jousea mitin hetsah ding, hiche nikho chule Judate amelmateuva akihuhdoh theina diuva, kigingsa aumna diuva seipeh ding ahi.

tcz: Hichehin leng thupeh chun akinotah ahijeh'in, thuhomjal leho chun lengpa kin’a manchah dinga kikoi Sakol hatcheh aman uva gangtah a ahopdoh diu ahi. Hiche dan Susa khopi sunga jong akiphong doh tan ahi.
en_web: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.
en_kjv: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa thupeh-in sakol themte leng sakol chunga atouvun, jangkhai vel’in alhaitauve. Thugahna chu munpi pen Susa khopia jong japi ahetsah-ui.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Mordecai chun lengpon oupe aduple akang akisil’in, sana lallukhuh akikhuh in, tupat ponnem le pondup akisil’in lengpa a kon in ahung potdoh'in ahileh khopi sunga mipi chu akipah in othong je-jun asam sam jengun ahi.
en_web: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.
en_kjv: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin leng inpi dalhan, leng pon loupe, adumle akang, tupat ponnem sil’in, lallukhuh loupe tah khuh-in akondodh tai. Susa khopi sung kipa ogin athongsoh hel’e.

tcz: Judate techu kipanale thanopnan adimun chene chan uva miho jana aching un ahi.
en_web: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.
en_kjv: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
tcz_gospelgo: Judate din kipa lung olle, nopna chule galjona lungthin aumdoh tai.

tcz: Gambih tinle khopia, lengpa dan lhunna channah Judate te akipah un alopna aneiyun anikho nitdingleh mipin golvah neikhom dingin aphongdoh un ahi. Gamsunga mipi lah achun Judate chu ahung pungjal jengun ahi ajeh chu Judate hochun eibolse get unte tia akichat’u ahitai.
en_web: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.
en_kjv: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi jouse le gamkai jouse, lengpa thuphondoh kisimphah na jousea, Judaten toh bangin kipa golnop abolsoh keiyui. Dihtah-in midang tampi jong Juda mi asoh gamtauve. Ajeh chu mijousen aginlo tauvin ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun alha Lhakao nisagi nichun lengpa dan thusoh teni chu ahung chelha paitan ahi. Hiche nikho chun, Judate kidoupiho chun amaho chu matchom jengding anagot u ahin, ahinla akaleh lang tah in asohtan ahi. Judate ho johchun agalmi houchu ajolo taovin ahi.
en_web: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),
en_kjv: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king’s commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
tcz_gospelgo: Leng thuphondoh manchahna ding, Asar lha, nisomle nithum ni amelmateuvin Judahte matchom agot niu ahung lhungati. Ahinla Judahten amaho ajolotauve.

tcz: Judate techu amaho khopi holeh gambih ho jousea pumkhat in dding khom un ahin nokhum hou chu asat chap jeng’un ahi. Koimachan amaho chu akimaito ngam tapouvin ahi, ajehchu mijousen amahochu aging taovin ahi.
en_web: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.
en_kjv: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng gamsung, Judate chenna mun jousea, asat diuva kigochanto kisat jeng din Judate akikhomtauve. Muntin a min Judate akichauvin, koiman adehjou tapouve.

tcz: Gambih a milen milal ho ahin, vaihom lenpenho ahiuvin, gamvaipoh ahiuvin chuleh lengpa vaihom ho ahiuvin Mordecai akichat jeh un abonun Judate te akithopi gamtaove.
en_web: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.
en_kjv: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh-in, Mordecai aginjeh-un, gamkai vaipote le, gamvaipo ho, vaibol ho chule leng thalhenga antong jousen, Judahte apanpi cheh tauve.

tcz: Ajehchu lengpa khopia chun Mordecai chu sangtah'a atunlet ahitan, Gambih jousea jong aminthang cheh cheh jengin chuleh athahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahi.
en_web: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.
en_kjv: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
tcz_gospelgo: Lenggam pumpia, leng inpia Mordecia thenai, aneibe cheh cheh thudol akithangsoh tai.

tcz: Hijeh chun Judate chu anikho kitep nikhon agal miteu chu chemjam in asat chap jengun ahi. Amahon agal miteu athat’un asumang gamji taovin amaho hin vetdaho jouse chu anop nop in aboljeng jiuvin ahi.
en_web: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.
en_kjv: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Judahten amelmateu alo nom nom alo thei tauve. Chemjam choiyin adekhum’un, asat chap jenguve.

tcz: Susa khopi sung seh seh a jong Judate ten mi ja-nga athat un ahi.
en_web: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.
en_kjv: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
tcz_gospelgo: Munpi pen Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’uve.

tcz: Amahon Parshandatha, Dalphon leh Aspatha athatnun,
en_web: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
en_kjv: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
tcz_gospelgo: Amitha lah-uva Judahte melma, Hammedatha chapa Haman chapate som khat jong apangun,

tcz: Chuleh Poratha, Adalia le Aridatha athatnun,
en_web: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
en_kjv: and Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
tcz_gospelgo: Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Asidai, chule Vaizatha ahiuve.

tcz: Parmashta toh Arisai, Aridai le Vaizatha athatnun,
en_web: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,
en_kjv: and Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

tcz: Judate galmi, Hammedatha chapa Haman chate som jong chu athatdoh taovin ahi. Ahinla athil alo hou achom pou’ve.
en_web: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
en_kjv: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilkeo ima vang achomtapouve.

tcz: Hiche nikho tah chun Susa khopia athajat nuchu lengpa kom’a ahetsah taovin,
en_web: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.
en_kjv: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikhoa Susa khopia mihem kithah jat chu lengpa aseipeh-uve.

tcz: Hiche jouhin lengpan lengnu Esther akouvin ajah a, “Judate ten hiche Susa khopi seh seh a jong mi 500 athat un chule Haman chate som jong athat taove. Amahon hilaitah a bon chujat atha uleh gambih dangho a ijat athat tadiuvem? Tuahi ipi nadeibe nahlai ham? Nakibolpeh ding ahi, seijin ipi thumbe ding nanei nah lai’em? Nathum chan chu kibolpeh nalai ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”
en_kjv: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan lengnu Edther jah a, “Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’un, Haman chapa som khat jong apangtai. Gamkai dang danga ijat i-alo dda diu ham! Ipi nadeibe nah laiyam? Namu thei ahi. Seiyin, namu jeng ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Esther in adonbut in, “Lengpa nalung lhaina ahiding leh Judate techu Susa khopia tunia abol tobang un jing jongle bolsah kit’in lang chuleh Haman chate 10 chu mol lhon chunga kikhai sanghen,” ati.
en_web: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”
en_kjv: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
tcz_gospelgo: Estherin, “pha neisah peh dingle, thunia abol banguvin Judahten jing jongle bol kit tadiu hen. Chule Haman chapa som khat chu thingpel a khaisang din noppeh-in,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun lengpan anoppeh tan Susa khopi sunga hiche dan chu akiphong doh in chuleh Haman chate thilong o mho chu mol-lhon chunga chun akhaisang taove.
en_web: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
en_kjv: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan hiche jong hi aphalpeh-in, Susa khopi sunga thuphondoh khat ahomjaltauve. Haman chapa som khat long chu japi vet din aphoujah tauve.

tcz: Hichun Susa khopi a Judate hochu pumkhat’in dding khom’un alha Lhakao ni get nin mi jathum athat be kitnun athillu vang achom pouve.
en_web: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
en_kjv: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Adar lha nisomle nile nin, Susa khopia Judahte akikhom’un, khosunga mihem jathum jen athabe kit’ui. Thilkeo vang achomdeh kit pouve.

tcz: Hiti chun lengpa gamkai jousea Judate chu amaho kihuhna dingin dding khom un ahi. Avetda’uva pang mihem sang som sagi le sang nga athat gam’un, agalmi teuva kon in a-ongthol taove. Ahinla amahon athil le lo imacha akichom pouve.
en_web: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
en_kjv: But the other Jews that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
tcz_gospelgo: Gamkai jousea Judahte jong akikhom’un, akihuh cheh tauve. Avetdauva pang mihem sang som sagi le sang nga athat gam’un, amelmateuva konin aongthol tauve. Thilkeo ima vang achompouve.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh ho chu Adar lha nisomle nithum nia thilsoh ahi, ajing nikho nimsom le nili nin akicholdo uvin agaljo nao chu kipahtah in golvah abollun alopna aneiyun ahi.
en_web: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
en_kjv: on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng chu Adar lha nisomle nithum nia thilsoh ahi. Ajing nikho, nisomle nili nin vang mi athabe tapouvin, kipa golvah nikhon amangjo tauve.

tcz: Susa a Judate hon agalmite nisom le thum, nisom le nili geiya mi athauva chule nisom le ni nga ni akicholdo un kipana golvah anabollun ahi.
en_web: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
en_kjv: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
tcz_gospelgo: Susa khopia Judahten vang nisomle nithum, nisomle ni nga nia ahaijeh-un, nisomle ni nga ni choldo nin amanguve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, tuni changei’in thinglhanga um Judate kho gamla a umhon hiche nikholeh, phalbi kichai kon lamleh kumlhun golvah abollun akipah khomun nehle chah thilpeh ho akithot to jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.
en_kjv: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu khote dunga cheng Judahten Adar lha nisomle nili ni hi kipa nihtnega amanjiu ahin; golvah bolna le khat le khat neh le chah kipetou ahi.

tcz: Mordecai in hiche thilsoh hohi ajih lut’in Xerxes gamsung jousea anai ahin agamla a um ahin Judate hohi lekha anathot jin ahi.
en_web: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,
en_kjv: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
tcz_gospelgo: Mordecaiyin thilsoh hicheng hi ajihdoh-in, Persia gam pumpi, gamla naiya cheng Judahte jouse athot’in,

tcz: Hiche nini sung hi kumseh a golvah abolji diuvin ana sei peh tan ahi.
en_web: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,
en_kjv: to stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
tcz_gospelgo: kumseh le Adar lha nisomle nili ni, nisomle ni nga ni nithenga anit diuvin aseipeh-e.

tcz: Ama hiche nikho sunga hi kipana golvah bolding leh nehle chah kipehto a, gentheite manbeiya pehding in ana seipeh in ahi. Hiche hin Judate agalmi teuva konna kipana amunao, alunggim naova konna thanopna amunao ageldoh jing nadiu ahi.
en_web: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.
en_kjv: as the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikhote nia hi Judahten amelmateu athagamu ahi; hiche lha hi lung gim hesoh a kona kipa nopna kiheidohn alha ahi. Hiche nikhote ni hi golnop kut le anlhung nehna, neh le chah kithah toa, vaichate anthahna nei din aseipeh tai.

tcz: Hiti chun Judaten Mordecai thilgon hohi anop peh un, hiche hi kumseh in achepi tauvin ahi.
en_web: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,
en_kjv: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
tcz_gospelgo: Judahten Mordecai thupeh ajuiyun, hiche golnop hi kum vanlhah kut’in aumdoh lo tai.

tcz: Judate galmi Agagi mi Hammedatha chapa Haman chun Judate tehi suhmang helna dinga nikhokhat lhendohna dinga vangvetna ananei ahi. (Hiche avangvetna chu Purim akiti)
en_web: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;
en_kjv: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
tcz_gospelgo: Judahte melma, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Hamanin Judahte suhgamna din Purim kiti mangin phun anasanin, nikho hoipen a suhgam didn ahol’in, thagam hel din anagoi.

tcz: Ahinlah lengnu Estherhi lengpa anga ahunglut phat in, aman dan chomkhat ahin sem’in hichun Haman tohgon phaloutah chu amachunga achuhlo tan ahi. Haman le achate chu mol lhon hemjet chunga akhailih ataove.
en_web: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
en_kjv: but when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Esther lengpa koma alut’in, lengpan thugahna asemin, Judahte bolna sia thilgon chu Haman chungjoh a achuh lon, amati acahpate ti thingpel a akhaisoh tauve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu hiche golnop nahi Purim kiti ahi, ajehchu hiche hi gollui paova vangvetna ktina ahi. Amaho tah in anathoh khahsao ahijeh leh Mordecai in anajihlut ahijeh'in ahin chepi taove.
en_web: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,
en_kjv: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche nithengte ni hi Purim kisah lo ahitai, Mordecai lekha thot ho jeh le achunguva thilsoh ho jal’in,

tcz: Gamjousea Judate ten hiche chon nahi chepi dingin anom’un chuleh achilhahte jousen jong ajui diuvin ana kilol’un ahi. Amahon hiche nikho teni hi kumseh leh akitepna nikho ahi alopna neijing dingin ana phongdoh un ahi.
en_web: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;
en_kjv: the Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
tcz_gospelgo: Judahten Dan akisem lo’uvin, amaho tah le atu achateu, koi hile Judah mi hung hithei, Mordecai thupeh dungjuiya kumseh le aphat phat cha hiche nikho teni ho nit jing din aboltauve.

tcz: Hiche nikho ho chu lenggam sunga khopi hole gambih ho jousea insung jousen akhang akhanga ageldoh jinguva anit jing diu ahi. Hiche Purim golvah ankong hi Judate lah a itih hijongleh mangthah louva anit jing ding chuleh ipi thil anasoh ham tihi akhang akhanga mansah louhel ding ahi.
en_web: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.
en_kjv: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
tcz_gospelgo: Kinoptona asem’un, Judah insung mite jousen, akhang khanga, gamkai jouse le khopi jousea, ahung lhun phat tin a, Purim nikho te ni hi geldoh a nit jing din aseitauve.

tcz: Abihail chanu lengnu Esther le Judate mi Mordecai in lekha khat anajih lhonin, masangjep a Mordecai in ana sutsa Purim kiman di thudol se se chu, lengnun thanei tah namdetna anei tan ahi.
en_web: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.
en_kjv: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengnu Esther, Abihail chanu le Mordecaiyin jong lekha ajih lhonin, masangjep a Mordecia sutse Purim thudol asei chu, thalhingset’in namdetna anei lhontai.

tcz: Hiche lekha chu Judate jouse anathot un chule Xerxes lenggam a gambih jakhat le somni le sagi sungah ana thot soh hel un ahi. Lekhathot a chu Judate lah a chamna le lungmon na leng hen akitin ahi.
en_web: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,
en_kjv: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekha chu Judahte jouse athot’un, atobng cheh chu Persdia lenggam gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athotsoh hel’ui. Lekhaa chun Judahte lah a cham le lungmon len ding akiseiyin,

tcz: Judate mi Mordecai leh lengnu Esther in dan a anatundoh lhon Purim golvah hi anikho kipeh dungjuija kumseh a nit dinga ana kiphutdoh ahi. (Mipite hin amaho dingleh achilhah ho diuva anngol naleh lunghemna anathoh khom banguva hiche Purim golvah jonghi ana tundoh u ahi).
en_web: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.
en_kjv: to confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungkham lunghem a an ngol’a nit dia kisei bang banga, aphat phat cha Purim nikhote ni chu amaho le atu achateu geiyin anit diuvin aseipeh lhon’e. Hiche thupeh hi Mordecai le Estherin asei cheh lhon ahinai.

tcz: Hitia hi Purim chon nahi Esther thupeh in namdetna anei hetjing dingin lekhajol khat’a kijih lut tai.
en_web: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
en_kjv: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
tcz_gospelgo: Estherin Purim nit dol Dan kisem namdetna anei chu lekhajol khat’a akisuntai.

tcz: Xerxes lengpa hin ama gamsung pumpi keo hilouva twikhanglen pang mun gamlatah a jong kai analah ahi.
en_web: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.
en_kjv: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa Xerxes hin gamgil lama chengho hihen, Twikhanglen pang dunga cheng ho hileu-agamsung pumpia elbol natoh tohsah ding abol cheh-e.

tcz: Ama tohdoh thupitah tah hole, aman ana tunlet Mordecai nasatna hohi Media le Persia lengte thusimbu’a kijihlut’a ahi.
en_web: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
en_kjv: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
tcz_gospelgo: Thil loupe le mingthang abol ho, Mordecai tohmun len a akhandoh thusim lhingkeiyin Persia le Media lengte thusimbua akijihsoh keiye.

tcz: Judate mi Mordecai hi Xerxes lengpa bantah a thanei in apangin ahi. Amahi Judate te lah a mithupitah ahung hin chuleh jana sangtah anapeuvin ahi, ajehchu aman amite dingin thilpha anatong jingin chuleh khang nunungho changeija aphatna diuvin thu anaseijin ahi.
en_web: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.
en_kjv: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah mi Mordecai chu lengpa Xerxes bantah ajauvin adei cheh-ui. Anam mite phatna dingle atu achateu lungmon theina ding jeng anatonge.

tcz: Phatkhat hin Uz gam sunga Job kiti mikhat ana cheng in, amapa chu nolnabei leh lungtheng sel ahi. Amapan Pathen aging in thilphalou jousea kona kikangse jinga um ahi.
en_web: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.
en_kjv: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Uz gamsunga Pathen ginga tahsan Job anachengin, chondih tah ahin, thilse bol louhel ahi.

tcz: Joh hin chapa sagi le chanu thum aneiye.
en_web: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
en_kjv: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in chapa sagi le chanu thum aneiye;

tcz: Chule Job hin kelngoi sang sagi, sangongsao sang thum, bongchal kop janga, le sanganpi janga aneiye. Amapa hin soh jong tamtah anei ahi. Atahbeh in Job hi hiche gamkai sungse dinga ahaopen ahi.
en_web: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
en_kjv: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
tcz_gospelgo: kelngoi sang sagi le sa-ngonsao sang thum, bongchal sang khat le sa-ngan ja nga aneiyin, soh tampi avul’in, niso lama mihao pentah ahi.

tcz: Job chapate aphat lhingpen pen chun ainnuva nehkhom donkhom abol tenguleh, asopiu numei thumho jong chu golvah bolkhompi din akou jiuve.
en_web: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
en_kjv: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Job chapate aban banin kilhan golvah abol jiuvin, adang ho hung lhasoh kei ahiuvin, asopiu numei thum jong akou jiuve.

tcz: Hiche golvah chu akichai teng nikho phabep jouleh Job chun achate athenso jin ahi. Job chu jingkah matah in athou jin khat cheh a din govam thilto abolpeh ji'e. Ajeh chu Job in hiti hin aseijin, “Kachate hi ana chonseuvin tin chule alungthim uva jong Pathen agaosap sao himai theijinte,” ati. Hiti hin Job in abol jing jenge.
en_web: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.
en_kjv: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Golvah boljou jingkah teng Job jingpi tah-in athouvin, achate suh theng nadin kilhaina aboljin ahi. Job geldol’a achate khattouvin hetoh louva Pathen a-enghoukah diu agin mo ahi.

tcz: Nikhat hi van thutanna in na thutanho ama ho cham chamin Pakai masanga ahung kikhomun chule hehhatpa Satan chu amaho toh ahung lhung khome.
en_web: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.
en_kjv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni khat van mite Pakai anga ahung kikhop nauva Satan jong alah-uva apange.

tcz: “Hoiya konna hung nahim?” tin Pakaiyin Satan adonge. Satan in Pakai adonbut in, Leiset chung kaga vet lhih lea, thilsoh jouse kaga vetle ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah nahim?” atileh, Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Kalhachapa Job khu nahet em? Leiset a dinga miphapen ahi. Amahi nolnabei, milungthengsel ahin, aman Pathen aging in chule thilphalou jousea konin akikangsen ahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Kalhacha Job chu namum? Ama banga kitah le pha leiset chunga midang aumpoi. Aman chibai eiboh jingin, thilse pou pou bol louhel ahi,” ati.

tcz: Satan in Pakai adonbut in, “Henge Job in Pathen aginna ajeh hoitah anei ahi.
en_web: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
en_kjv: Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
tcz_gospelgo: Satanin, “Job’in ajeh beiya Pathen agin beh ham?

tcz: Ama ahin ain ahin chule anei jouse kulpi kikai khum banga, akim vella pal banga naum chahkheh’a nangin atohna jousea nakhan tousah jeh’a bou ahi. Ven ichan geija haosa hitam?
en_web: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
en_kjv: Hast not thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin ama le a-insung mite chule anei jouse vettup peh jing chu. Anatoh jouse phatthei naboh-in, gamsung pumpi agancha nadimsah tai.

tcz: Nakhut lhangin lang anei jouse lahmang peh le chun; chuteng leh namai chang tah’a na gaosap jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”
en_kjv: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun ijemtin anei jouse lah peh le chun namai change nagaosap ding ahi!” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin Satan jah’a aseijin. “Aphai, amapa khu napatep thei ahi. Chule anei jouse chunga nabol nom chan nabol thei ahinai, atahsa vang suhset peh hih in,” ati. Chuin Satan in jong Pakai umna adalhatai.
en_web: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.

tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah le nahim?” ati. Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati.

en_web: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

en_web: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

en_web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

en_web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
en_kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my roarings are poured out like the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh le chah khel’in lunghemin ka-umin, Gim genthei kathoh jinge!

tcz: Keiman kaki chat pen ipi ham khat kachunga asoh in, hatah a kakichat leh kalung gimna pen ahung lhung tai.
en_web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.
en_kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, And that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaginpen thil’in eiphan, Katijatna penin eilhun dentai!

tcz: Lungmonna kanei poi, thipbeh cha umna kanei poi, choldona kanei pon, boina le hahsatna bou ahung ji'e.”
en_web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
en_kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; Yet trouble came.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungmon le choldona kaneipoi, Kagentheina abei thei tapoi!

tcz: Teman mi Eliphaz chun Job chu adonbut in;
en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
en_kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Eliphaz-in Job jah a, “I-khat kiseileh ngaidan natem?

tcz: Keiman thukhat seijinge, nangaida ding ham? Koiham thusei louva eikoi ding chu?
en_web: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
en_kjv: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
tcz_gospelgo: Paopoh louva umna thei la Nahitapon!

tcz: Phat chesa ho ah nangin mitam tah natil khoujin, alhasam ho nana hatdohsah jin ahi.
en_web: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
en_kjv: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tampi nahildoh-in, Lhasamte bantha nahatsah-e!

tcz: Alhu ding ho jong nangma thusei chun atilkhou jin ahi, akhup kithinghojong na tilkhou ji'e.
en_web: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
en_kjv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
tcz_gospelgo: Cholle nanga kisep lhu jouse Natilkhouvin nahatsah me!

tcz: Ahinlah tua genthei nan nahin phah phat in lungthim nalhaso tai. Hiche hahsatnan nahin phah phat in kichat tijatnan nanei tai.
en_web: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
en_kjv: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
tcz_gospelgo: Genthei nan naphah phat’in Imacha dou thei louvin na-um’e!

tcz: Na Pathen ginna chun tahsan detna napeh hilou ham? Nachon phatna chun kinepna napeh hilou ham?
en_web: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
en_kjv: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, Thy hope; and the uprightness of thy ways?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ginga manabei nahin, Kisonna le kinepna nanei ding dol ahi!

tcz: Khongaijin lang chule ngaito temin, themona bei mi hithi ngaiji ham? Itih a milungtheng sel ho kisumang jiem?
en_web: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
en_kjv: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the righteous cut off?
tcz_gospelgo: Phate chan gel temin, Hoikom pen a midih-in manthahna atom?

tcz: Keithil hetna in vang hahsatna muchi tua kitu ho leh thilse bol hon thakhatna aga akilo cheh diu ahi.
en_web: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
en_kjv: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow wickedness, reap the same.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihet’in vang thilse louma gut’a gut, Thilphalou muchi tua tun aga akilo teiye.

tcz: Pathen hu haikhumchun asemgo jiuvin, alung hanna husa ginna chu mang del jiu ahi.
en_web: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
en_kjv: By the blast of God they perish, And by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang mite chu Pathenin khopihui semmang abahsah jie.

tcz: Keipi akitumin chule sangah in mi angih in ahin keipi thahattah hajouse kisubong ding ahi.
en_web: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
en_kjv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute sakei banga akisenlet lut vangun, Pathenin ameh thipjin ahau avopusoh jie.

tcz: Sahing neh ding lhahsam jeh in keipi bahkai hang leiloijin kel athohjin chule keipi bahkai noute jong kithecheh diu ahi.
en_web: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
en_kjv: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh ding sahing kimat jou lou sakeite thigam, Anoute vahcheh bangin aum’uve!

tcz: Hiche thutah hi guhthim chan kana benga mao hiuheu vin ei kisei peh e.
en_web: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
en_kjv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a little thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Thip beh chan thu khat ahung lhungin, Guh thim chan kajai!

tcz: Mihem aimut lhuh pet tah jan laijin imut sunoh phah in hiche gaova mang thilmuna hi kahenga ahunge.
en_web: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
en_kjv: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men.
tcz_gospelgo: Ihmutlan a singdel bangin Kahung kinkhangin;

tcz: Kichatnan eiphan chule kagu kachang ho akithinge.
en_web: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
en_kjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakicha behseh jengin, Kapum changing kakithing thinge!

tcz: Thilha hun kamai ahin jap in chule akichaijin katimul ahungkithou sotsotne.
en_web: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
en_kjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up:
tcz_gospelgo: Kamai ahung kijep dap hoiyin, Katimul athousot’e!

tcz: Thilha chu adingin ahinla kenla agongso kamuthei pon, agongso kamit teni masang kamaija agongso aum denne. Phat thip laitah chun hitia kisei o khat kajai.
en_web: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
en_kjv: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: An image was before mine eyes, There was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: I-khat ahung ding jang keiyin, Kavet vangin kamuchen theipoi. Athip del jengin, Chuin ogin khat kajai!

tcz: Thithei mihem hi mona beija Pathen anga umtheija, asempa masanga athenga umtheiding hinam?
en_web: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
en_kjv: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathen mitmua them chang ding koi hiya, Asempa angsunga theng jou ding koi ham?

tcz: Pathen in avantil ho jeng jong atahsan louva, athupole ho angol naova apho jia ahile,
en_web: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
en_kjv: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; And his angels he charged with folly:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vanmi alhachate jong aging chapon, Avantilte themmona jongaphoh jie!

tcz: Nikhatna kisem mihem hi ichan gei tahsan na anei lhom ding ham? Amaho chu leivuija kisem bailam tah a suhchip thei mitthah tobangbep ahi.
en_web: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
en_kjv: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Which are crushed before the moth?
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset a kisemdohho aginchat dia nabol’a, Nget banga thin lhah thei leivuiya kisem chu aginchat ding ham?

tcz: Amaho chu jingkah langleh ahing jiuvin ahinlah nilhah langleh athijiuvin, amelchihna beijin athiji tauve.
en_web: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
en_kjv: They are destroyed from morning to evening: They perish for ever without any regarding it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah a damseh mihem chu, Hetman louva nilhah kah a thi thei ahi.

tcz: Aponbuh henna akibo lhuh teng leh apon buh u alhujin chule hetna lhasam in athiden ji tauve.
en_web: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
en_kjv: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? They die, even without wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinlose akilahpeh teng, Ngoljeh-in mihem athiji tai,” ati.

tcz: Na kithopi ding kou temin mikhat beh in nahin donbut na dem? Vantil ho koipen in nahin kithopi ding ham?
en_web: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
en_kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; And to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
tcz_gospelgo: “Kouvin Job, koiham nahou ding? Nakiheina ding Vantil hoipen ham?

tcz: Tahbeh in lung hanna hin mingol asuhmang jia chule thangsetna in chihna neilou ho asumang ji'e.
en_web: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
en_kjv: For wrath killeth the foolish man, And envy slayeth the silly one.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gim hesoh nathipi ding vang, Pannabei ngol hoitah ahibouve.

tcz: Keiman mingol ho chomkhat kahsung alolhin nao kamui ahinla vangset na chun hetman louvin alhunkhum jitai.
en_web: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
en_kjv: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol lungmong tah a um kamun, Hetman louvin ka-in gapsah jie!

tcz: Achateo jong ajong ajellin gamsa chonin achonun amaho dingin panpina agamlan ahi, ahuhdoh diu umlouvin thutanna munna amehgoi jiuve.
en_web: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
en_kjv: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
tcz_gospelgo: Achapateu ameidoi gam’un, Thutann aphunga ding ngam jong aumpouve.

tcz: Achang chu lingleh khauva akium jeng vang'in agilkel ten avallhum peh un, agou chu adangchah ten hai hot hot in adel uve.
en_web: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
en_kjv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns, And the robber swalloweth up their substance.
tcz_gospelgo: Lingle khao lah a keh jongle, gilkelten mingolte lhoga akilon; Midang chahten agou adei chauve.

tcz: Thilse hi leivui lah a konna hungput doh ahipoi chule hahsatna hi leisetna konna hung dondoh ahipoi.
en_web: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
en_kjv: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse hi tol’a hungkeh ddoh ahipon, Gentheina jong Leiset’a hungpeng ahipoi.

tcz: Meilah a konna meisi chunglanga lengtou dinga gotsa aum banga mihem tehi ahahsa ding monga penga ahi.
en_web: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
en_kjv: Yet man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhum sunga kona meisi alentou banga, Gentheina hi mihemin akiboldoh ahibouve.

tcz: Keihi nang chu hileng Pathen koma cheng ting chule kachung chang thu ama koma kase lhah ding ahi.
en_web: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
en_kjv: I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause:
tcz_gospelgo: Kei hivang leng Pathen heng jon ing ting, Kachung thu akoma sep lhang’e!

tcz: Aman thil oupe tah hetdoh jou hoi hilou ajat sim joulou thil kidang aboldoh e.
en_web: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
en_kjv: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; Marvellous things without number:
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol loupitah tah ihekhen pouvin, Thil kidang abolla simjou ahitapoi.

tcz: Aman leiset chunga go ajuh sah jin, chule loulaija jong twi alonsah soh keije.
en_web: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
en_kjv: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields:
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga go ajuhsah jin, Loulai dung twi achap jie.

tcz: Aman mivaichate khantouna apen chule genthei hesoh thohte ahuhdoh ji'e.
en_web: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
en_kjv: To set up on high those that be low; That those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
tcz_gospelgo: Miham domsanga, Lunghemte lhamon chu Pathen ahi.

tcz: Athil gonu asuh nohphah peh in, hijeh chun akhut uva atoh jouseu amolso joulou diu ahi.
en_web: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
en_kjv: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman doha thuh ho htilgon asunoh-in, Imacha amolso sah hteipon;

tcz: Miching ho chu aki chihsah nauva amang jin hijeh chun aduha thuh nauva athil gonnu asuhbei pehji tai.
en_web: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
en_kjv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: And the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichihsah ho achih nauvin amanin, Angaito jouseu asubei loijie.

tcz: Amahon sun laijin muthim atoh khauvin sunkim laijin amaho chu janlai bangin aki mai le leuve.
en_web: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
en_kjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, And grope in the noonday as in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun chang laiyin khon ajinden’un, Janlai bangin akimai leuve!

tcz: Mikam hatte a konin mi vaichate ahuhdoh jin chule mithahat ten atuhchah kheh hou jong amaho a konin ahuhdoh ji'e.
en_web: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
en_kjv: But he saveth the poor from the sword, From their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vaichate ahinson, Bolset’a um milhasamte ahuhdoh jie!

tcz: Chule hiche ho a chun achaina leh mivaichan kinepna aneiyin, chule mihahem te kam jong ahuhbit jin ahi.
en_web: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
en_kjv: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute aphoh thip’in, Vaichate akinepsah-e!

tcz: Ahinla Pathen in asuhdih ho kipana khu ngaito temin, nachonset tengleh Hatchungung pan nahilna khu don louvin koi hih in.
en_web: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
en_kjv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin asuhdih thei mihem chu anun nom’e, Napho teng nagida hih-in!

tcz: Aman amavo jin chule boljong aboldam jin aman ajep jin ahinla akhut in asudam kitjin ahi.
en_web: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
en_kjv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: He woundeth, and his hands make whole.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mi amavona atomjol jin, Navohna chengse aboldam jinai!

tcz: Vangsetna gupma konin nahuhdoh intin asagi veina teng jongleh thilse akonin nahoi doh inte.
en_web: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
en_kjv: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Gupvei jen hahsatnaa nahuhdoh ding, Sagi geiyin vang thilsen phapon nate!

tcz: Kellhah lai jongle thina akonin nahuhdoh intin gallai jongleh chemjama konin nahuh doh inte.
en_web: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
en_kjv: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: And in war from the power of the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Kel lhah teng jongle nahinso ding, Gal’a jong nathisah ponte!

tcz: Misuminse nom te akonin hung hoidoh in natin chule manthahna ahung lhun teng kicha tapon nate.
en_web: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
en_kjv: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin koima houset sah pon natin, Manthahnan phajongle chun huhdoh nannate!

tcz: Manthah nale kel alhah teng nangin nanuisat ding gamlah a gamsa jouse nagin louding ahitai.
en_web: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
en_kjv: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumhat le kel nanuisat ding, Gamsa hang jong ging pon nate!

tcz: Nangma gam lah a songho toh lungmong tah a naum khoma chule gamlah a gamsa ho toh lungmonga nalhat khom diu ahitai.
en_web: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
en_kjv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hollei lah lhou khapon natin, Gamsa hangin jong sesepon nate!

tcz: Nachenna nain abitne ti nakihetna, nanei nagou ho nagavet teng imacha akiholmo umlou ding ahi.
en_web: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
en_kjv: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; And thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Naponbuh a lung monga nachen ding, Nakelngoite jong ima tilou ding ahi.

tcz: Nangin chate tamtah neijin natin, nason nachilhahte hampa banga hung tam diu ahi.
en_web: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.
en_kjv: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nason napah biha phaiha ja pha ding, Nacha nanao jong hampa jat pha ding ahi.

tcz: Nateh teng lhankhuh hin jonin natin, aphat cha changpholla changpal kichom khom nahung bah ding ahi.
en_web: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
en_kjv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
tcz_gospelgo: Chang minset akoi tobanga, Tehkem geiya nahin ding ahi.

tcz: Keihon hinkho hi kakhol uvin, chule hichehi dih din kamu doh uve, kahilna hi ngaijin chule nangma tah a dingin mangchan.
en_web: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
en_kjv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
tcz_gospelgo: Job kasei hi phat sotpi kasimtohsa ahi. Adih ahin, tun kisanin!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Job apaodoh kit in:
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: But Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in,

tcz: Kagenthei naho hi tedoh thei hihen lang ka natna hi kilep toh thei henlang hileh,
en_web: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
en_kjv: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, And my calamity laid in the balances together!
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, kanat thoh genthei jouse Kitetoh thei leh,

tcz: Twikhanglen'a neldi umjat sangin gih jonte, hiche ho jeh a chu khongai man louhella kaseidoh ji ahi.
en_web: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.
en_kjv: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: Therefore my words are swallowed up.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen a neldi jat sangin gihjon tin, Hibanga kahansetna hi datmo pon nate!

tcz: Hat Chungungpa thal hanging eikap lhuh tah jeh chun athal gu chun kalhagao asukhan, Pathenna kon tijatna ho chu keidou din ahung kigoltoh tauve.
en_web: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.
en_kjv: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pathen thalpin eikap paiyin, Athalgun eichansoh tai; Pathenin tijat jatnan eibol jenge!

tcz: Kalunglhai louna thu seitheina tha kanei hilou ham? Gamlah sangan chun nehding hampa akimu jilou teng penglouva umjia chule bongchal ten jong neh ding aneilou teng buji hilou ham?
en_web: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
en_kjv: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?
tcz_gospelgo: Sa-nganin hamhing akimu teng along lhaiyin, Bongchal’in an aneh teng athip’e!

tcz: Chiso louna anneh chunga chu mihon alung lhailou nao aseiji louvu ham? A-alna bei ahtwi kang podal khu kon adu ding ham?
en_web: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
en_kjv: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
tcz_gospelgo: Koiham chiso lou anche tamne nom? Ahtui pokang khu almong nam?

tcz: Kavet jiteng ka-an duna abei jitai, neh dinga kangaito najouse akikhah tansoh jitai.
en_web: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
en_kjv: The things that my soul refused to touch Are as my sorrowful meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Chu tobanga anneh kaduchapon, Kaneh jongle kaloh asoh-e!

tcz: Oh, keiman kadei khat kaki thum thei ding hihen, Pathen chun kadei chu eipeh ding hileh,
en_web: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
en_kjv: O that I might have my request; And that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
tcz_gospelgo: Idia Pathenin kadei eipeh da a, I-bol’a kataona eihou lou ham?

tcz: Aman eisuh chip jeng ding kadeije, akhut ahin lhandoh a chule eitha jeng ding kadeije
en_web: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
en_kjv: Even that it would please God to destroy me: That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
tcz_gospelgo: Akhut’in eituh hen Eijep lih le ahijenge!

tcz: Natgim genthei thoh'a kimusetna ho a konna hiche beh a hi lung monna kaneiding ahi. Athengpa thusei nahsahmon kabol khapoi.
en_web: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
en_kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; Yea, I would harden myself in sorrow; let him not spare: For I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
tcz_gospelgo: Eitha ding heleng kichom jeng inge, Itobang nat genthei thoh jong leng, Pathen thenje kahe jingin, Athupeh peh nel ponge!

tcz: Ahinlah athoh jou nading thahat kaneipoi, keiman hinpi ding imacha kaneipoi.
en_web: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
en_kjv: What is my strength, that I should hope? And what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
tcz_gospelgo: Hinjouna ding thala kanei tapon, Athive ve ding ibol’a kahin hin ham?

tcz: Songthahatna chu nei kahim? Katahsa hi sum eng kisem ham?
en_web: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
en_kjv: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?
tcz_gospelgo: Song tah a tah kahiya, Sum-eng lhouva lhou kahim?

tcz: Ahipoi keima ahin lolhinnaphat gomkom neilou kithopi beihel kahi.
en_web: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?
en_kjv: Is not my help in me? And is wisdom driven quite from me?
tcz_gospelgo: Kihinsona thei tha kaneitapoi, Bel ding jong kaneitapoi.

tcz: Agol apai lhasam khat dinga lungsetna nei mi hiding ahinla nangin Hatchungungpa kicha louvin themmo neichanne.
en_web: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
en_kjv: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; But he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen heng he hih leng, Hitobang gim genthei teng golpha ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Kasopi teho aphat phat cha long ji vadung neocha banga tahsan theilou, khaltwi vadung neocha akam dima long tobang nahiu naphot chenu ahi.
en_web: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
en_kjv: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, And as the stream of brooks they pass away;
tcz_gospelgo: Kagol kapaiten la neilhem chavaiyun, Gotwi bei teng lhanghoh go neibahsah-ui!

tcz: Buhbang lhang le buhbang twi kikhol khom chu,
en_web: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
en_kjv: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, And wherein the snow is hid:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhanghoh dunga buhbang alhang lhangin akisen, Thop chet chut’in akikhol’ui.

tcz: Kholum phat ahung lhun tengleh twi chua amangjin, vadung neucha chu asat jeh chun amang jitai.
en_web: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
en_kjv: What time they wax warm, they vanish: When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholum teng leh ajun lhan, Alon mang teng lhanghoh akeovin aumji tai.

tcz: Kholjin miho chu holdoh kitna ding in akihei doh jiuvin, ahin donding aum loujeh chun athiji tauve.
en_web: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
en_kjv: The paths of their way are turned aside; They go to nothing, and perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholjin miten twi aholmo’uvin, Nelgam save vu lah a athidenji tauve.

tcz: Tema a hung kholjin miho chun twi ahol jiuvin, Sheba a hung kholjin miho chun neiding akinem uve.
en_web: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
en_kjv: The troops of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Tema kon kholjinten twi ahol’un, Sheba a hungkonten mutei akinem’ui!

tcz: Akinep nao chu asim jiuvin ahinlah alunglhai jipouve, ahung lhun tengleh akinep nao akisudong jitauve.
en_web: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
en_kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; They came thither, and were ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: AKinepnau abei phat’in alhaseuvin, Lhanghoh go lah a akisudong’ui!

tcz: Nanghon jong kithopina neipe pouve, kavang setna namuvin chule naki chauve.
en_web: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
en_kjv: For now ye are nothing; Ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Keidin hiche lhanghoh gosa tobang nahiuvin, Kagenthei namu phat’un na-nung kin’ui!

tcz: Ahinlah ipijeh ham? Keiman thilpeh khattou kathum khah em? Keiman nanei ikhat tou keiding tuma kathum khah em?
en_web: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
en_kjv: Did I say, Bring unto me? Or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
tcz_gospelgo: I-khat neipeh diu kathumbeh ha, Khattou sumguh neigapeh peh diduva katem ham?

tcz: Melma pa a konin nei huhdoh un tia kasei khah a, ahilouleh lungsetna neilou miho a konin nei huhdoh un tia kaseikhah em?
en_web: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
en_kjv: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
tcz_gospelgo: Melmapa akona neihuhdoh diu kasei ha, Mibolsepa a kona neilha doh diuva kasei ham?

tcz: Neihillin, chutilehthipbeh in um inge, ipi kabol khel um'em neivetsah in?
en_web: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
en_kjv: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
tcz_gospelgo: Aphai, kamona iham neihil’un, Thip beh-in nasei ngaiyinge!

tcz: Lungtheng sella kiseidoh thucheng hi itobanga thahat hitam? Ahin neidem nao ijat aphah hitam?
en_web: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
en_kjv: How forcible are right words! But what doth your arguing reprove?
tcz_gospelgo: Thutah-in mi athu nuntei me, I_bol’a manlou thujeng naseiyu ham?

tcz: Kalung natna kakana ija naselou tenguleh nathusei houhin mi jouvinte natiuvem?
en_web: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
en_kjv: Do ye imagine to reprove words, And the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh beiya moh pen pen a neigel’um? Itiba gentheiya kasei neidonbut’u ham?

tcz: Chagate ahiloule nagol napaite jeng jong soh in naso jiuve.
en_web: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
en_kjv: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, And you dig a pit for your friend.
tcz_gospelgo: Chaga soh chang ho pou vang san a kihom, Nagol ngaitah tah kiveina nei nahiuve ong!

tcz: Neihin vetan, namai chang tah a kajou ding ham?
en_web: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
en_kjv: Now therefore be content, look upon me; For it is evident unto you if I lie.
tcz_gospelgo: Neive changmel’un Jou sei ponge!

tcz: Kachonsetna hi dih nante tin gelda tauvin, ijeh inem itile keiman bolkhel kaneipoi.
en_web: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
en_kjv: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; Yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Naval behseh tauve, adihlou bolda jengun; Mo neichan hih-un, kadih nai!

tcz: Thujou seidinga nei gelluvem? Aphale ase hekhen thei lou ding kahim?
en_web: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
en_kjv: Is there iniquity in my tongue? Cannot my taste discern perverse things?
tcz_gospelgo: Jousei bep’in neigel’un, Adih amo hekhen louva neigel mongum?

tcz: Mihem jouse hinkho hi hahsatna toh kidel jing hilou ham? Ihinkho uhi kitha lah khut tobang hilou ham?
en_web: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
en_kjv: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? Are not his days also like the days of a hireling?
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset mihem hinkho hi namnah a kisol sepai tobang, Thalah soh goiya kigoi tobang;

tcz: Liim ngaicha aum natong mi tobang ahin, soh atohna man ngah tobang ahi.
en_web: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
en_kjv: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, And as a hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
tcz_gospelgo: Che phat ni kihei ngah jing soh, Atohman ki-nga jing natong tobang ahi.

tcz: Keima jong lha phabep sunga chu phatchomna bei natoh eikipen ahi, lunggel gentheina dimset in jankho sot noijah genthei kathoh e.
en_web: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
en_kjv: So am I made to possess months of vanity, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.
