tcz_gospelgo: Lha hijat sung hi kahinlo aumpon, Jansim she-in gim genthei kathoh be be!

tcz: Jalkhun chungah kalumin, itih tah le jingkah ahitadem tin kagel jin, ahinlah jan in eisu chol in khovah kahsen kaki pehle le jin ahi.
en_web: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
en_kjv: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? And I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalup nah vnagin ihmu mon ka-umin, Khovah kal ngah lel’in kakipeh peh jie!

tcz: Kati chungla than leh akhih in atom dimin ka vun jong apohkeh gamin anai along longe.
en_web: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
en_kjv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin is broken, and become loathsome.
tcz_gospelgo: Katichung tinakhemdimin athansoh tai, Katinakhem akikhodoh leh vousan jeng ahi!

tcz: Ka nikho ho jong pon khong ho patphei kilham sangin ging jon, kinepna beijin akichai ji'e.
en_web: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
en_kjv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And are spent without hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho patphei kilham sangin achaljon, Kinepna beiyin abeiloi jitai.

tcz: O Pathen, kahin kho hi hai khat bep bou ahi ti nei geldoh peh in, chule keiman kipana hi kanei kit lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
en_kjv: O remember that my life is wind: Mine eye shall no more see good.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, kanopna abeitai, Kahinkho chomdan geldoh jingin!

tcz: Nangin tua hi neimu ahin, ahinlah nei musot pon nate, nangin neiven natin ahinlah keima ana chemang tange.
en_web: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
en_kjv: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: Thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua neimu vangin neimukit pon nate, Neive jongle chunbeipai tange!

tcz: Meilhang akithecheh a aman hel bangin, athiho khu hung kile kit tapou vinte.
en_web: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
en_kjv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: So he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang kitol mang banga Mihem athi teng hung kile kit lou ding,

tcz: Amaho chu ainuva patna tonsotna mukit tah lou dinga chemang ahitauve.
en_web: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
en_kjv: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hesa jousen jong Asuhmil loi diu ahitai.

tcz: Keima thusei louvin kaum theipoi, kalung genthei naho kasei doh a ka lhagao genthei jeh a kiphin ding kahi.
en_web: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
en_kjv: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahipoi, moh umthim thei ponge, Hibanga gentheiya kilung hang Thu kasei tei ding ahibouve!

tcz: Keima hi twikhanglen'a kichat chat um ganhing len ahilouleh gullui kahia nahonbit nanoija chu neikoi jeng ding ham?
en_web: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
en_kjv: Am I a sea, or a whale, That thou settest a watch over me?
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen ngapi ngap a neibol ham, Nei nga jing jeng ding?

tcz: Keima kalupna in eilhamon intin, chule ka imut teng kanat genthei na ho olsah tante tin kagelle.
en_web: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’
en_kjv: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo din lum ing ting, Kanat ol domna ding gel’inge!

tcz: Ahinlah nangin mangse neimatsah jin, chule gaothil mu in nei kichat sah ji'e.
en_web: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,
en_kjv: Then thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions:
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla mangse se neimat sah-in, Mu nei neisah-in, sing neidelsah-e!

tcz: Hitia genthei thoh sang hin, eikimeh lih jeng hen lang thileng pha kasa joi.
en_web: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
en_kjv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than my life.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang nat genthei kathoh sangin, Kikhailih leng katijoi!

tcz: Kahinkho kadei mon hitia hin hin ding hi kadei tapoi, O nikho lhomcha kanei sung hin kachangin nei dalha jengin.
en_web: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
en_kjv: I loathe it; I would not live alway: Let me alone; for my days are vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachim’e, kahin nompoi; Kahinlo jong aumpoi, neilimsah dan!

tcz: Mihem hohi ipi hiuva, nangin hibanga hi na khohsah a chule nagel jing jeng ham?
en_web: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
en_kjv: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? And that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi ija nabol’a hibanga thupia nagel’a, Idia abol chan namelchih keo ham?

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin jingkah seh le nakhol chil soh in, chule phat jousen na patep jinge.
en_web: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
en_kjv: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, And try him every moment?
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah she-in nakholtoh-in, Phatseh-in napatep’e!

tcz: Kachil valna ding phatsung beh a ipi dinga nei dalhah lou ham?
en_web: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
en_kjv: How long wilt thou not depart from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
tcz_gospelgo: Kachil beh kaval manna dia Neivetda a nakihei mangle iti-am?

tcz: Chonset kanei ahilehnang chunga ipi kabol khah ham? O mihem te vejing pa, keihi nanga dinga pohgih kahija, natup penna neisem ham?
en_web: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
en_kjv: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? Why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, So that I am a burden to myself?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo mihemte Chingpa, kachonset nang dia ipi khoh am? Idia bidoiya neinei ham? Nang dia pohgih hahsa mong kahim?

tcz: Kachonsetna hi ngaidam jengin lang chule kathemmona ho nei lahmang peh tan, ajeh chu leivui lah a kijam a thivah ding kahitan, nangin hin ven natin chemang tange.
en_web: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
en_kjv: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, And take away mine iniquity? For now shall I sleep in the dust; And thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset na-ngaidam joulou mong hiya, Kasuh khel nachulnam mo ham? Keila lhankhuh akijam loi tang ting, Neihol hol jongle chun Neiholmo tan nate!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad in Job chu adonbut e:
en_web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Shuh mi Bildad-in adonbut’in,

tcz: Hitia hi itih chan naum nah lai ding ham? Nathusei chu kichat umtah huinung gin abange.
en_web: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
en_kjv: How long wilt thou speak these things? And how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
tcz_gospelgo: “Hamve vua nasei na-ngah lou li ham?

tcz: Pathenin thutah chu aletun ding ham? Hatchungnung pa chun adih chu aletun khah em?
en_web: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
en_kjv: Doth God pervert judgment? Or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
tcz_gospelgo: Patheninthudih aletun ngaipon, Itih-in jong adihlou abol ngaipoi!

tcz: Nachate chun ama douna a chonset anabollu hitei ding ahi, hiijeh a chu ahibep seuva ki engbollu ahi.
en_web: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
en_kjv: If thy children have sinned against him, And he have cast them away for their transgression;
tcz_gospelgo: Nachate jong chonsea hitei diu, Hijeh a chu Pathenin asuhamng ahi!

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen koma taova chule Hatchungnung pa lunglhaina naholla ahileh
en_web: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
en_kjv: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle hung kiheiyin, Tun Pathen henga taovin!

tcz: Chule atheng nahija, lung thengsella nahin leh aman atahbeh a nakai thouva na inchen kipana a nasem phat peh ding ahi.
en_web: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
en_kjv: If thou wert pure and upright; Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung theng lungdih nahileh, Pathenin hung panpin tin, Nadih man’a nanei kiledoh a Na-in kisah phat namu loi ding ahi.

tcz: Chule lhomchan kipan jongle chun tamtah'a nachai ding ahi.
en_web: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
en_kjv: Though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanei mangjat hi imacha hilou, Pathenin napeh ding chuto tethei hilou ding ahi.

tcz: Khang masalai chu dongin lang pule paten ana mudoh sao hug ah ngaiton,
en_web: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
en_kjv: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
tcz_gospelgo: Golui lai chihna ho ven, Pule paten dih asah-u hi gel temin!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile eiho janhi bepma peng ihiuvin imacha ihepouve. Leisetna ihin nikho u jong nilim cheloi loi tobangbep ahi.
en_web: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
en_kjv: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
tcz_gospelgo: Kum lhomcha, imacha helou, Ihinkhou jong nilim kihei mang bep ahi.

tcz: Ahin eiho masanga hunghon nahil uvintin, amahon gollui lai thu nahil diu ahi.
en_web: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
en_kjv: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle khanglui lai mite chihna kihilsah-in, Aseiyu nagi phan!

tcz: Doplah hilouva umping sangtah'a khang theija, doplah hampa chu twibeija khang theijem?
en_web: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
en_kjv: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?
tcz_gospelgo: Sitwi nomna louva pengthei akeh pon, Dop lah louva akimu ngaipoi.

tcz: Satlhah phat lou laiya apah jing laijun jong hampa ho sanga gang jon agoplha ji tauve.
en_web: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
en_kjv: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, It withereth before any other herb.
tcz_gospelgo: Sat lhuh amanchah thei ahi masangin jong, Twi kan teng agop masan apang’e.

tcz: Chutobang chu Pathen sumil te chunga jong chu ji ahin, Pathen neiloute kinepna chu twihu banga mang ji ahi.
en_web: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
en_kjv: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen heloute jong chu che pengthei tobang ahiuvin, Pathen asuhmil tengu akinepnau abeijitai!

tcz: Atahsan nao jong patjanga kikhai ahin, amachu maimom panna kingai ahiuve.
en_web: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
en_kjv: Whose hope shall be cut off, And whose trust shall be a spider’s web.
tcz_gospelgo: Akinepnau achavai jin, Akison nau maimom panjang bep ahi.

tcz: Amahon ahoidoh nadiuvin ainnu atuh un ahinlah dding joupoi, amahon hatuh a tuh ding agot vangun adou jou deh poi.
en_web: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
en_kjv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
tcz_gospelgo: Maimon pan a kingai leu adou jouva, Patjanga kikhaileu atuh jou ding ham?’ atiuve.

tcz: Pathen neilou khu nisa noija khangdoh hampa abah ho honsung jamdoh a tobang ahiuve.
en_web: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
en_kjv: He is green before the sun, And his branch shooteth forth in his garden,
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute sunlai loudong abangun, Honsung anche dongpha abangui.

tcz: Song kise thom lah a ajung kholutna, songho kah a hing ahi.
en_web: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
en_kjv: His roots are wrapped about the heap, And seeth the place of stones.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajung kikhon song ho aveichah-in, Songpi khi kah dunga akigol dettai.

tcz: Ahinlah akibodoh tengleh anaum khalou bangin te.
en_web: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
en_kjv: If he destroy him from his place, Then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla kibotdoh leh, Koiman akena lam jong heponte!

tcz: Hichu ahinkho kichaina ahitan, chule amun lo khel dingin adang hung kehdoh tante.
en_web: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
en_kjv: Behold, this is the joy of his way, And out of the earth shall others grow.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute nopna chu hiti bep chu ahin, Midangin amun alahpehji tai!

tcz: Ahin ven Pathen in milung thengho apaidoh lou ding, migilou dinga jong akhut alhan doh lou ding ahi.
en_web: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
en_kjv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he help the evil doers:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kitah vang Pathenin adonda khapon, Migiloute apanpi khah poi.

tcz: Aman khatvei kipah tah a nanuisah kitna, chule nane tenia kipathu nasap doh ding ahi.
en_web: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
en_kjv: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, And thy lips with rejoicing.
tcz_gospelgo: Nolnabei hile chun nui heovin lhan natin, Kipa othongin thu seiyin nate!

tcz: Nangma vetda ho chun jachatna ponsilla akisilluva chule migiloute chenna in chu kisumang ding ahi.
en_web: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
en_kjv: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahote vetdan tin, Migiloute in-gap diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun job in asieikit in :
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: Then Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in, Hitin aseiye:

tcz: Henge, keiman alhangpin hiche hi adih e ti kahei. Ahinlah Pathen mitmua mihem khat chu themmona neilou ahitai tia kiphong doh thei ding ham?
en_web: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
en_kjv: I know it is so of a truth: But how should man be just with God?
tcz_gospelgo: “Nasei jouse hi masanga kajahsa ahinai, Hinla Pathen maiya them chang ding koi ham?

tcz: Mikhat touvin Pathen chu kiheh pi ding nom taleh ama chu khatveija sang khat vei kidonbut jou thei ding hinam?
en_web: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
en_kjv: If he will contend with him, He cannot answer him one of a thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiham Pathen to kinel thei ding? Koima adonbut joulou asang sang thudoh nei ding chu!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen chu ha chih a chinga, chule thahattah ahi. Koipen in ama chu aphin doh a anel jou ding ham?
en_web: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
en_kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu chingtah le hattah ahin, Koiman kidintepi theiponte.

tcz: Aman hetsahna masat beijin molsang ho achon mang jin, alunghan teng leh aleh khup jin ahi.
en_web: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
en_kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: Which overturneth them in his anger.
tcz_gospelgo: Hetman louvin molsang ho atolmang jin, Alunghan teng asumangji tai!

tcz: Aman aumna munna konin leiset ahot ling jin chule abul akithing ji'e.
en_web: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
en_kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, And the pillars thereof tremble.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ling akihosah-in leiset akilinge; Leiset bulpi khom jouse ahot lingjin ahi.

tcz: Aman thu apeh a ahile, nisa soh tapontin chule lha jong vah taponte.
en_web: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
en_kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; And sealeth up the stars.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa athimsah jouvin, Janteng ahsite athimsah theiye.

tcz: Vanho jong aman achanga apha jal'a chule twikhanglen kinong jong gamgi asem peh ji ahi.
en_web: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
en_kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathein van buhsona ason chun koima panpi angaipon, Twikhanglen ngapi achotphan koima athalah poi.

tcz: Ahsi somleng, Bombiel leh juhei suhtum, vantham jol lhanglang kaija ahsi ho jouse abonna aman asem ahi.
en_web: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
en_kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, And Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanlaijol ahsite, Ngambom uichal le Ngambom lungthu, bombel le Lhanggam ahsi jouse Pathen semsa ahicheh-e.

tcz: Aman hetphah hoi hilou thil oupe tah tah ho asem in, sim senglou thil kidang aboldoh e.
en_web: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
en_kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; Yea, and wonders without number.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol loupe ho hejou poutin, Thil kidang abol jong akhonbei ahi.

tcz: Ahivangin, ahung naiji teng, kamu theipon, ache teng jongle ache kamu deh poi.
en_web: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
en_kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eihin hopa nan Kenla kamu thei hih beh-e!

tcz: Mikhat chu ahinna alah peh a ahileh kon a suhtang thei ding ham? Ipi bolla nahim tin adong ngam dem?
en_web: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
en_kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Adei dei akilah thei, Aphoh tang ding umlou; ‘I-bol nahim? Ti-ngam koi ham?

tcz: Chutia chu Pathen in alung hanna chu atuhtang lou hileh twikhanglen'a ganhing tamtah tah ho jong akeng tonoija achilngim ding ahi.
en_web: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
en_kjv: If God will not withdraw his anger, The proud helpers do stoop under him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen alunghan teng Amelma amal tel jin; Adouva Rahab gulpi panpi jouse Asugoiyin asugam jitai!

tcz: Hijeh a chu kei koi kahija, Pathen chu donbut dia kagot ding ham? Ahilouleh kaki nelpi jeng ding ham?
en_web: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
en_kjv: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words to reason with him?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ahijeh hin, Ipi seiya Pathen kadonbut thei ding ham?

tcz: Keima ana dih kha jeng jongleng kihonna ding kanei lou ding ahi. Eihepi nadinga bou katao thei ding ahi.
en_web: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
en_kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, But I would make supplication to my judge.
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei hijong leng, Kachung thu tan ding Pathen henga chu Eilungset dia katao tho didng ahibouve!

tcz: Chule keiman ama chu kouving lang, chule aman eihou nama jongleh aman kathusei angai ding kaging chapoi.
en_web: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
en_kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; Yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
tcz_gospelgo: Eipaosah mong jong le, Kasei ngaidin katahsangpoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman huipi gopi a eino khuma chule ajeh beija tang louhella eisuh nat ding ahi.
en_web: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
en_kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, And multiplieth my wounds without cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh beihel’in jong eisuse din, Gopi huipi eidel khumsah bouve.

tcz: Aman ei haijom sah theipon ahinlah gentheina khaveng vungin eisun dim khume.
en_web: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
en_kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hing gentheiyin eihinsah-in, Haisa theiyin eikoipoi.

tcz: Thahat sanna no ding hijeng jong leh, ama chu thahattah ahin thudih'a tanding kiti jongleh koipen in ama chu thutanna munna dinga akou ngam ding ham?
en_web: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
en_kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: And if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
tcz_gospelgo: Pumhat’a kano dingle, Koiham Pathen pumhat’a noding? Kihehpi ding kitijongle, Koiham Ama koulut jou ding?

tcz: Keima hijeng jong leng, keima kamtah in themmo eichansah ding ahibouve, themmona neilou hijong leng chonse a eiki sim nalai ding ahi.
en_web: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
en_kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: If I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitahle monabei kahinan Kasei chan thusen akilan, Kapaodoh chanin Kamona kaseidoh loi!

tcz: Keima nolna bei kahi, ahinla hichun keija dingin kikhelna eibolpeh deh pon, kahinna jong kadei tapoi.
en_web: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
en_kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei hijong leng khoh kasapoi, Hinjong kahin nom tapoi;

tcz: Nolna bei mi hihen michonse hijong leng Pathen dingin abonchan akibang cheh in hijeh a chu themmona neilou le michonse ania asuhmang cheh ahi, kati.
en_web: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
en_kjv: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Moleng mohih leng imachom ahipoi, Pathenin hoijoh akhendeh poi.

tcz: Vangsetnan ahin lhun khuma nolna bei mi thina chu aman anuisat bepme.
en_web: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
en_kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei mi hetman louva athi teng Pathenin anuisat’e.

tcz: Leiset pumpi hi migiloute khutna um ahin, chule Pathen in thutanho mit asuh chotji ahi. Ama bol ahiloule koibol ba hiding ham?
en_web: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
en_kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: He covereth the faces of the judges thereof; If not, where, and who is he?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vannoi hi agiloupa apedoh tai. Vannoi thutan vaihomte mit achotsah-in, Pathen tilou koidangin Hitia abol thei ding ham?

tcz: Milhai hat pa sangin kahinkho achegang jon kipana mukhalou hellin aleng mang jitai.
en_web: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
en_kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: They flee away, they see no good.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahin nikho akitol jeng jungin, Thilpha mu man louvin ka-um’e.

tcz: Pumpenga kisem kong bangin akitol mang jitai, muvanlai aneh ding kimat dinga gangtah a hung lenglha abange.
en_web: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
en_kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: As the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho kong kitol hattah abangin, Jucha man dia mu manlouva hung lenglha muvanlai abange!

tcz: Keiman kakiphin naho sumil ingting, kalung gimna maiso pailhang ting, chule thanom tah in um inge tia kaki gelji vang'in,
en_web: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’
en_kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
tcz_gospelgo: Nui heova kanatna suhmil kagot vangin, Kagimna apong jitan;

tcz: Kanat thoh genthei naho hi nasatah a kichatna leh lunggimna kaneije, ajeh chu O Pathen, nolna beija neimu lou ding kahei.
en_web: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.
en_kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mo eichan kahen, Kichan gim genthei kathoh thou thouve.

tcz: Ipi iti henlang hijong leh themmo hange eikimu ding ahileh ipi phachom dinga ei kibol gim gim ham?
en_web: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
en_kjv: If I be wicked, Why then labour I in vain?
tcz_gospelgo: Them channa chom deh lou, Ipi kakhohsah ngaiyam?

tcz: Kei le kei sabon in kisil ngim jeng jong leng chang-al in kakhut sop theng jong leng,
en_web: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
en_kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;
tcz_gospelgo: Buhbang twiyin kisil ing, Cha-ngel’in kisop jong leng,

tcz: Nangin bon lhoh umna kotong sunga nei sonlut in natin chule keima vonnen hon jong eideimo diu ahi.
en_web: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
en_kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eh-khul sunga eileh lut’a, ponse nen sanga kibohjo ding!

tcz: Pathen chu kei banga thibai hilou ahin, hijeh chun ama to kakinel theipoi, ahilou jongle thutanna munna kapuilut theipoi.
en_web: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
en_kjv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, And we should come together in judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hi mihem hileh Ddonbut’a kihehpi thei kahi.

tcz: Keini eisucham theilhon khat anaum hihen lang, mikhat touvin thakhatna eipui khom thei lhon hihen,
en_web: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
en_kjv: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle Pathen le kei kah thusei ding aumpon, Thu eitanpeh lhon ding aumpoi.

tcz: Misuchampa chun Pathen chun eijep a asuhtang thei hileh ama bolgenthei kichatna chu kanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
en_kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his fear terrify me:
tcz_gospelgo: Talen neimatsah datan Pathen! Neihoh kichat chat datan!

tcz: Chutileh kichatna beihel a ama koma thu kasei thei ding ahin, ahinlah keiman keima thahat in hichu kabol theipoi.
en_web: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
en_kjv: Then would I speak, and not fear him; But it is not so with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungthimin kamona kahepoi, Gin beiyin ngampel’in seiyinge!

tcz: Kahinkho hi kahechen tai, lhangphong tah in kiphin inge, kahin gentheina jeh a hi kiphin ding ahi.
en_web: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
en_kjv: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahin nom tapoi, Kiphin ing ting kanop nop seiyinge!

tcz: Pathen koma ima hilouvin nei themmo sah hih in kati ding ahi. Keidouna mona eihin lhut khum peh ding chu nei seipeh in.
en_web: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
en_kjv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Themmo neichandan Pathen! Neiseipeh jon iham mo neichanna?

tcz: Kei nei suhgenthei na chu ipi phatchomna naneijem? Nakhut monga nasemsa keihi ibola nei paidoh ham? Migilou thilgon chunga meheuva naumpet nahi.
en_web: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
en_kjv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
tcz_gospelgo: Giloutah anasemsa neidonda, Migiloute thilgon phasah hi dih nam?

tcz: Namit teni hi mihemte mit tobang hija, mihem hon amuthei hou bou hi namu thei ham?
en_web: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
en_kjv: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho mihem thilvet banga Nangin jong navet ngap hitam?

tcz: Nahinkho hi mihem hinkho chanbep bou saova ham? Nahinkho hi chomlheh jenga ham?
en_web: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
en_kjv: Are thy days as the days of man? Are thy years as man’s days,
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkhou chom banga Hinkho chom nahim?

tcz: Hijeh chun kathemmo naho kintah in neikhol chil peh in lang chule kachonsetna nahol hol jeng ding ham?
en_web: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
en_kjv: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin?
tcz_gospelgo: I-bola kachonset jouse nakholsoh keiya, Kasuh khel chan namelchih ham?

tcz: Themmona bei kahi nahet jeng vang'in nakhut teni a konin koiman eihuhdoh jou ponte.
en_web: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
en_kjv: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; And there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathemmo loula nahen, Nakhut’a kona koiman eichulhah lou ding jong nahei!

tcz: Nakhut tenia neigonna neisem ahijeng vang'in tun nei sumang hel tai.
en_web: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
en_kjv: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhuttah a neisemsa chu Nakhutma maa seisuhmang ahitai!

tcz: Leivuija konna neisem ahi, neigeldoh in lang, leivui nei nungso sah loi kit ding ham?
en_web: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
en_kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?
tcz_gospelgo: Geldoh-in leivuiya neisemdoh ahin, Leivui sosah kit neigot hitam?

tcz: Nangin kathilgon hoa neipui hoijin, chule naobu a neigong in ahi.
en_web: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
en_kjv: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And cruddled me like cheese?
tcz_gospelgo: Kapa thisan a neilhoh lhah a, Kanu naobu sunga neikijilsah ahi.

tcz: Katahsa leh kavunin neitomin, kagu le kachang ho neijop mat peh in,
en_web: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
en_kjv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagu kachang kalhintwi nasemin, Kaguho phe le cunin natomjol’e.

tcz: Nangin hinkho neipen chule nangailutna thonlou neimu sah in; ame hoidamna noija kahinkho neihoitup peh e.
en_web: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
en_kjv: Thou hast granted me life and favour, And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihinsah-in nei ngailui, Neikhohsah jal’a ihngbou kahi.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nachaloh dan adih tah, nathilgon dihtah ho,
en_web: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
en_kjv: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hina hichanpia hi kathemmo le, Thadoh dia guhthimcha neigot kahetai.

tcz: Nangin neivet lhih jinga chule kachonsetna ahileh kachonsetna chu nei ngaidam pon nate.
en_web: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
en_kjv: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset leh ngaidam louva Suhmang din neichang lhi jinge.

tcz: Kachonset khah a ahileh keija dinga phamo lheh jeng ahin, chule nolna bei hijeng jong leng kalu kadomsang theipoi. Ajeh chu jachatna leh gentheinan eikidip letset e.
en_web: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
en_kjv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset tih tih neibolgim jin, Thilpha bol jong leng kaphatchompi deh poi. Gin genthei leh jum le Jachat kathoh bep’e!

tcz: Ijem tin kalu domsang taleng, nangin keipi bahkai sadel bangin neidellin natin, keidouna a kichat tijat naumna nathanei nachuneimu sah bep ding ahi.
en_web: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
en_kjv: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: And again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadinkang khen khe leh, Sakei mibolna bangin neichon lhun, Datmo mo neibol khum jin, Neimavo lo jitai!

tcz: Kei douna a nanatoh chu avel vellin nahet tohsah jin, nalung hanna khang toujing chun kachunga neisun khumin chule kei dou dingin sepai hon thah thah nahin puilut ji'e.
en_web: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
en_kjv: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me; Changes and war are against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihehse ding nanei jingin, Neilunghan jingin suhsetna thei khat nagong jinge!

tcz: Chuti chu ahileh ipi dinga kanu naobua konna nei lahdoh ham? Kapenna chu ipi dinga nei thiden sah lou ham?
en_web: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
en_kjv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen, i-bol’a neipensah ham? Koiman eimu thei masanga thidoh hitave leng!

tcz: Chutile ahung peng khalou hel kabah a naobua konna jangkeija lhahkhuh anache tadinga,
en_web: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
en_kjv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutileh hing man louhel’a, Naobua kona lhankhuh jonpai ta ding!

tcz: Keiman nikho lhomcha bou kanei ahitan hijeh chun kachangin nei dalha tan phat chomcha khat beh nopsahna phat kanei nadingin,
en_web: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
en_kjv: Are not my days few? cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
tcz_gospelgo: Thi ding koncha kahitai, Chomkhat beh nom sange, neidondan!

tcz: Kile kit lou dinga kadalhah a khojin le muthim lhangkhal kiheh nagam kajot masangin,
en_web: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
en_kjv: Before I go whence I shall not return, Even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kile kit lou din chevah tange, Mithim lhangkhal monmo nagam jon tange!

tcz: Jan khangkim lai banga khojin nagam muthim leh nohphah nagam, khovah jeng jong jan khang kim lai khojin toh abah nagam chu!
en_web: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
en_kjv: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; And of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim lungdon, noimigam, Khovah jeng jong muthim bep hina gam chu!

tcz: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun Job adonbut in,
en_web: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Na-amath mi Zopharin adonbut’in:

tcz: Twilon banga long thucheng hi mikhat beh in adonbut lou ding ham? Thu tamtah kisei hin mi khat chu nolna bei ahi ti aphotchet ding ham?
en_web: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
en_kjv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?
tcz_gospelgo: Ngol-thubuh hijat donbut louva kikoiya, Kamtam man a mi them chang mong nam?

tcz: Nasei sei laijahi kei kamoh umthim jeng ding ham?
en_web: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
en_kjv: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
tcz_gospelgo: Kadonbut mou nahim, Job? Neidai chatvaiyu hi kamoh thip diu ham?

tcz: “Katahsan athenge, chule Pathen mitmun keima kangime,” tin naseije.
en_web: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
en_kjv: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangsei bou dih nasan, Pathen vet dia thengin nakiseiye!

tcz: Pathen m among mongin seihen, m among mongin alunggel naseipeh ding hileh,
en_web: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
en_kjv: But O that God would speak, And open his lips against thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hung paodoh hen, Nahin donbut jengle katitave!

tcz: Ama mong mongin chihna thuguh ho chu naseipeh ding hihen, ajeh chu chihna dihtah chu thumai mai hilou ahi, ngaijin “Pathen in nathemmona sanga lhomjoa nabol genthei joh nahlai ahibouve.”
en_web: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
en_kjv: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, That they are double to that which is. Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin chihna nahil’in tin, Mihem hetdoh theilou giltah tah aum’e. Nathoh ding sanga jangkhaijoa Pathenin talen napeh ahinalaiye!

tcz: Pathen chihna thutah'a kisel guh chu naholdoh jou ding ham? Hat chungung ahina ho jouse chu naholdoh jou mong ding hinam?
en_web: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
en_kjv: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thahat loupije athuh je le agilje Naholdoh jou mong ding hinam?

tcz: Hiche tobang chihna hetna hi van sanga sangjo ahin chule nang koi nahija hiche hinoimigam sanga jong thuhjo ahi, nangin ipi nahet em?
en_web: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
en_kjv: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
tcz_gospelgo: Van sangin asang jon naholdoh jou ahipon, Noimigam sangin athuh jon nahetthei ahipoi.

tcz: Hiche hi leiset sangin alenjon, chule twikhanglen sangin alenjoi.
en_web: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
en_kjv: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen loupina leiset sanga lenjo, Twikhanglen sanga lenjo ahi.

tcz: Pathen chu hunga mihem khat songkul'a koihen ahiloule thutanna munna kou taleh ama chu kon apho tang thei ding ham?
en_web: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
en_kjv: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, Then who can hinder him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin thutanna phunga kailut le chun Kon phoh lha theiyintem?

tcz: Ajeh chu aman midihlou ho chu ahet ahin chule achonsetna hou aboncha amelchih ji ahi.
en_web: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
en_kjv: For he knoweth vain men: He seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin pannabei jouse amun, Athilse bol chengseu amusoh-e.

tcz: Milhoh bei chu hung ching lou ding hicheng jouse chunga chu gamlah sangan in anou ahin thei joh ding ahi.
en_web: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
en_kjv: For vain man would be wise, Though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamlah sa-ngan nou akivah ngoi teng Mi-ngol jong chingjep tante!

tcz: Ijemtia nangma tah in nalung nagel phatna, chule taona'a nakhut tenia amalam nasanna ahileh,
en_web: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
en_kjv: If thou prepare thine heart, And stretch out thine hands toward him;
tcz_gospelgo: Lungdih pun, Job, Pathen lam sangin!

tcz: Pathenin nachonsetna abonna na onthol sah a, chule themmona jouse nanunga nadalhah sah ding ahi.
en_web: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
en_kjv: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, And let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilpha lou chengse paidoh-in, Thil dihlou na-insunga koidan,

tcz: Chutengle nolna beija namai hung vahdoh ding ahin hung hatdoh in natin chule gin nanei tahlou ding ahi.
en_web: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
en_kjv: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be steadfast, and shalt not fear.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng mai lhaisel’a Hangtah a napan ding ahi.

tcz: Nalung gentheina jouse sumil tan natin, twilong mang tobangbep hiding ahi.
en_web: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
en_kjv: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, And remember it as waters that pass away:
tcz_gospelgo: Nagimna chengse sumil’in natin, Hohtwi kitolmang bep’a nagel ding ahi.

tcz: Nahinkho chu sunlai nisa sangin hung vah hoijon tin, muthim jeng jong jingkah sangin vah hoi jonte.
en_web: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
en_kjv: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; Thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahinkho sunlai nisa sanga vahjoa, Muthim jeng jong jing khovah bang ding ahi.

tcz: Kinepna nanei chun hansanna napen tin nahuhdoh a chule lhamong tah a nekicholdo ding ahi.
en_web: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
en_kjv: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
tcz_gospelgo: Namelmate nagin lou ding, Mi tampin nang panpi ngai chante.

tcz: Kichatna neilouvin umen natin chule mitam tah in kithopi noma navet diu ahi.
en_web: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
en_kjv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

tcz: Ahinla migiloute vang amitnu kisucho a, amahon jamdohna anei lou diu, amaho akinep nau chu thina bou chu hiding ahitai.
en_web: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
en_kjv: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall not escape, And their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten jet le vei veu jongle Jamdohna ding lampi mupon tin, Akinepnau pen tah chu Laicha haisam chubou hitante.

tcz: Chujou chun Job in aseikit in,
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: And Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Nangho mihem te hin thil ijakai nahet soh keiju hilou ham? Chule nathi teng uleh chihna jong nangma toh thitha ding ahi.
en_web: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
en_kjv: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho tamjo jongleur chun Nathi tengu nachihnau jong beitante.

tcz: Aphai, kei matah in thil themkhat hetna kaneije, chule kei sangin nang naphajo deh poi; hitobang thilho hethei lou nangin thu nasei sei jeng ding ham?
en_web: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
en_kjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
tcz_gospelgo: Keijong nahetchanu hea, lhasam deh kahipon, Nasei jouseu min ahesoh keinai.

tcz: Kagol kapai ten einuisat un, eidonbut ding kinema Pathen kakou jeh chun, keima hi midih nolnabei kahin; ahijeng vang'in einuisat uve.
en_web: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
en_kjv: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, Who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: The just upright man is laughed to scorn.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunvang kagol kapaiyin einuisat’un, Nolnabei adih hijong leng einuisat bep’ui; Hinla phat khat teng Pathenin kataona sang nante.

tcz: Anop nopma um mihon, hahsat natoh ho chu ija selou tah in anuisat jiuvin, amaho chun akipal ho chu ason opden jiuve.
en_web: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
en_kjv: He that is ready to slip with his feet Is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
tcz_gospelgo: Hahsatna neilouva neidai thangu ahin, Thi dingkonsa kei neijep beuve ong!

tcz: Ahinlah michom ho chu mong tah in aki dalhan, chule Pathen sulung hang ho bitsel in achengui.
en_web: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
en_kjv: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahat nau Pathen banga songte Gucha le pathen heloute mongtah-in aum’ui.

tcz: Ganhing ho chudong jong le chun amahon nahil dingu ahi; van lai jolla vachate chu dong le chun amahon naseipeh unte.
en_web: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
en_kjv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Hetbe nom chanin ju le va kidoh-un, Chunga leng vachate le ganhing hon hil nauvinte.

tcz: Leiset chu kihoupi le chun abol ding dan nahil ding ahi, twikhanglen'a nga hon nakoma thu seijuhen.
en_web: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
en_kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Tol’a ganhing ho le Twikhanglen ngate Chihna kidoh-un, hil nauvinte.

tcz: Kamanthah nachu Pakai khutna hung kon ahi ti ahet sohkeiju ahi.
en_web: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,
en_kjv: Who knoweth not in all these That the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ganhing jouse hin Pakai semsa ahiu akihet cheh-ui.

tcz: Ajeh chu thil ahing thei jouse hinkho leh mihem jouse haina hi ama khut a um ahibouve.
en_web: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
en_kjv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind.
tcz_gospelgo: Asemsa chengse hinsah Pathen ahin, Mihem hinkho jong ama khut’a um ahi.

tcz: Kam in anneh ho atui a-al ahetkhen banga nakol in jong ajah ho hi apatep ji ahi.
en_web: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
en_kjv: Doth not the ear try words? And the mouth taste his meat?
tcz_gospelgo: Naleiyin antui atekhah cheh bangin Nakhangin thu angai nom’e.

tcz: Chihna hi upa ho a ahin, chule thil hetkhenna hi tehseho a ahi.
en_web: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
en_kjv: With the ancient is wisdom; And in length of days understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Tehsete aching theiyin, Ahingsot ten ima ahekhen theiye.

tcz: Ahinlah chihna tahbeh leh thahatna chu Pathen koma bou kimu ahin, thumop themna le thil hetkhen thei nahi ama a ahi.
en_web: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
en_kjv: With him is wisdom and strength, He hath counsel and understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna le thahat hi Pathena ahin, Thu mopthem, thil hekhen them ahi.

tcz: Ipi hijongleh aman asuh mangsa chu kisapha kit theilou hel ahi; aman mi khat chu songkul'a akhum teng jamdoh nading umthei lou ahi.
en_web: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
en_kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aphet lhah teng kon asah phat’a, Pathenin songkul’a ahen teng kon alhadoh jou idng ham?

tcz: Aman go chu atuhtang teng leiset chu nelgam asohji tai, twi chu ahin lhadoh teng leiset chung ahin chup soh jitai.
en_web: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
en_kjv: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: Also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin twinah asipbing teng Gotwi akang jin; Twinah ahondoh teng Twisang alen ji’e!

tcz: Henge, thahatna leh chihna chu ama a ahin, milhem lhaho leh akilhem lhaho chu ania athaneina um lhon ahi.
en_web: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
en_kjv: With him is strength and wisdom: The deceived and the deceiver are his.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hi hattah, gal lel ngailou, Mihema le alheppa ajotho cheh-e!

tcz: Thumopma pangho ho apui mangin, athutan phatnao alah mang peh jin, thutan chingtah ho ahung ngol ji tauve.
en_web: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
en_kjv: He leadeth counsellers away spoiled, And maketh the judges fools.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaihomte chihna alamangin, Lamkaite angolto abahsah-e!

tcz: Aman lengpa sangkhol chol asutlhah peh in, akong buh uva khao akiveijin puimangin aumji tauve.
en_web: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
en_kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, And girdeth their loins with a girdle.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng ho asu-lha jin, Sohchangin ahenji tai!

tcz: Aman thempu ho apui mangjin, adinmun u alahmang peh in, kum tamtah thahatna pang ho chu aleh khup jin ahi.
en_web: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
en_kjv: He leadeth princes away spoiled, And overthroweth the mighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempute jong apui chavaiyin, Thahatte jong asu nemjie.

tcz: Tahsan umtah thumopma pang ho asuthip in, upa ho thil hetkhen theina alahmang peh jitai.
en_web: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
en_kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the aged.
tcz_gospelgo: Son umtah miho aphoh thip’in, Upate chihna alamangjie!

tcz: Leng chapate chunga minsetna asunlhah khumin, mithahat manchah beijin akoije.
en_web: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
en_kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, And weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuneite ajumson, Vaihomte hatna asubeijie!

tcz: Muthim lah a kisel thil kidang ho ahohdoh jin khojin mang keina mun ahin salvah jin ahi.
en_web: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
en_kjv: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim lhangkhal kiheh lai ahoh doh-in, Muthim jinglah avahsah theiye!

tcz: Namtin vaipi atungdoh jin chule aman ama ho chu asu mang jin, namtin vaipi ho chu akikehjal sah jin chule don louvin akoi ji'e.
en_web: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
en_kjv: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi achoi-an jin, Chuteng gal alelsah-in asu mangjie!

tcz: Leng ho thil hetkhenna alahmang peh jin, lampi umlouna gam phalou lah a vahle din adalha jitai.
en_web: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
en_kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
tcz_gospelgo: Alamkaiteu angolsah jin, Lung dongin avamangsah jie!

tcz: Khovah beijin muthim lah a akimai leleuvin, jukhamma londang dang ho bangin aseme.
en_web: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
en_kjv: They grope in the dark without light, And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim lah a akimai le leuvin, Jukham bangin alonle leuve!

tcz: Ven keiman hiche ho jouse hi kamit tah in kamun chule kanakol tah in kajan tun keiman kahetai.
en_web: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
en_kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, Mine ear hath heard and understood it.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, hijatpi hi kamun, Kajan kahekhensoh nai.

tcz: Ken nathil boldoh jouseu kahenai, kei sangin nangho naphajo deh pouve.
en_web: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
en_kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also. I am not inferior unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahet jat’u kahen, Nang ho sangin kalhasamjopoi!

tcz: Hatchungnung pa koma keija ding seh seh a jang keija thu kaseija kachung chang thua keiman Pathen ama tah chu kaki nelpi nom ahi.
en_web: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
en_kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen koma kiphin a Kinelpi hel ding nom kahi!

tcz: Nanghon vang, jou le nallin kahinkho nei suhset peh un, thempu banga nangho hi pannabei kithemput sah nahiuve.
en_web: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
en_kjv: But ye are forgers of lies, Ye are all physicians of no value.
tcz_gospelgo: Joule nal’a kilep them, Panna bei Thempu jeng nahiuve!

tcz: Thipbeh chan umthim thei leuchun, hichu nangho dinga nachih napen uva nabolthei sun u chu hiding ahi.
en_web: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
en_kjv: O that you would altogether hold your peace, And it should be your wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Umthim beh leu chun Khattouvin michingin geljo’uvinte!

tcz: Mo kachansah nau hi ngaijuvin, kanelna hohi phaten ngaijuvin.
en_web: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
en_kjv: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngai phauvin tun, Kachung chang thu seiyinge!

tcz: Pathen chu jouva nahonbit diu ham? Ama jeh a chu lungtheng lou puma nanel diu ham?
en_web: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
en_kjv: Will you speak wickedly for God? And talk deceitfully for him?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia thujou naseiyu ham? Najouthuu hi Pathen dia thilpha nagel’um?

tcz: Naum chan hou chu ama nadei sah nau jeh a langnei nadeiju ham? Pathen chung chang thu a nanghon ama dinga nanel peh diu ham?
en_web: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
en_kjv: Will ye accept his person? Will ye contend for God?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenchu huh dia go nahiuva, Thutanna in a kinelpi go nahiuvam?

tcz: Nathil bol hou ahin mudoh tenguleh ipi iti ding hinam? Bailam tah a mihem ho nangol bol banguva ama chu nangol bol theidiu ham?
en_web: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
en_kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathein nakholchil’u leh thilpha mun tem? Mihem lhep’a Pathen nalhep jou diu ham?

tcz: Ahipoi, guhthima ama langa lang neina naneijuva ahileh ama toh naboi dingu ahi.
en_web: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
en_kjv: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly accept persons.
tcz_gospelgo: Guh thimin gingmo jongleur chun Patheninnaphosal tei diu ahi.

tcz: Aloupina hin nakichat sah louvu ham? Nakichat nau chun nasun khum louvu ham?
en_web: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
en_kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? And his dread fall upon you?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lal loupina naginlou diu hiya, Ama nakichat lou diu ham?

tcz: Nathil geldoh theikit nau jong vutvai bep bou ahin, ami huhdoh nau jong leibel tobanga keh bai bep ahi.
en_web: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
en_kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, Your bodies to bodies of clay.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathuchih jouseu vutvai bep, Nakihon nau jong leipal chimbep ahi.

tcz: Tun umthim unlang chule kachangseh in nei dalha tauvin, thu seijing ting, chule thil hung soh jouse kimaito pi tange.
en_web: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
en_kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, And let come on me what will.
tcz_gospelgo: Thip chet’un kadei kagot seiying ting, Asoh soh soh jeng hen!

tcz: Henge, ken kahin kho chu kakhut in kilah ing ting, chule kalunggel mong mong sei tange.
en_web: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
en_kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in mine hand?
tcz_gospelgo: Thilo hel ding hijong leng Kagel gel kasei jeng ding ahi!

tcz: Pathen in eitha maithei ahin, ahinlah kinepna ding dang kanei poi. Ken kachung thua ama kakinelpi ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
en_kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: But I will maintain mine own ways before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiholpoi, Pathenin eitha thei ahi, A-angsunga kakihonna seiyinge!

tcz: Ahinla hiche hi eihuhdoh dinga chu ahin keima Pathen neilou kahipoi. Achuti loule ama masanga kadin jou lou ding ahi.
en_web: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
en_kjv: He also shall be my salvation: For a hypocrite shall not come before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou bon Pathen angsunga pao ngamlou, Hangtah-in pang leng kahinlo thei ahi!

tcz: Kasei ding jouse hi naichan ngaiju vin, kasei hi ngaijun.
en_web: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
en_kjv: Hear diligently my speech, And my declaration with your ears.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei jouse ngai phauvin, Kaphondoh chan lung nachangin ngaiyun!

tcz: Kachung chang thu kaki gontoh soh in, nolna bei kahi ti eiki photchen peh ding ahi.
en_web: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
en_kjv: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadih kahetjeh hin, Kachung thu sei ding kigoa kahi.

tcz: Hicheng ho chunga hi kon eikinelpi thei ding ham? Kathep mona naphotchen theijuva ahileh thipbeh chan um ingting thi tange.
en_web: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
en_kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? For now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Mo neichan ding ham Pathen? Mo neichan dingle kihon dang ting thi tange!

tcz: O Pathen! Thilni seh seh neiphal peh in, chutile nangma toh kimaito dinga kadin jou thei ding ahi.
en_web: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
en_kjv: Only do not two things unto me: Then will I not hide myself from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen kachunga thil ni neibolpeh dan, Chutile namai kamu ngam ding ahi!

tcz: Kachunga konin nakhut ham tah chu neilah doh peh in, chule ame umpina kichat umtah chun nei kichat sah tahih in.
en_web: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
en_kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: And let not thy dread make me afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen neimatsah dan lang, Neihoh kichatsah dan!

tcz: Tun neihin kouvin keiman nadonbut inge, ahiloule ken thu seijing ting chule nei donbut in,
en_web: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
en_kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: Or let me speak, and answer thou me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neikou masan Pathen, nahouvinge! Ahiloule ken seiyinge neihouvin!

tcz: Ipi themmona kanei ham? Neiseipeh in, kachonsetna leh nang kadouna nei vetsah temin.
en_web: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
en_kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset ipi pi hiya bolkel i-kanei ham? Mo neichanna ipi ham?

tcz: Ipi dinga keija konna naki heimang ham? Ibola namelma khat banga nei bol ham?
en_web: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
en_kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And holdest me for thine enemy?
tcz_gospelgo: I-bol’a neidon da a, Melma banga neigel hitam?

tcz: Huimut lonle thingna banga nei kichat sah kit ding ham? Changpol gosa nadel ding ham?
en_web: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
en_kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
tcz_gospelgo: Thingna bep kei hoh kichat neigot’a, Changpol gosa beo neisel khum got ham?

tcz: Nangin keidou nan themmona thilse tah tah najihdoh in, chule kakhangdon laiya kachonsetna jouse nahin sulange.
en_web: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
en_kjv: For thou writest bitter things against me, And makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaneo lai chonset geiyin neiphul’in, Giloutah tah-in eihehsei!

tcz: Nangin kakeng teni nakoi khomin chule kalam lhah jouse navelhi jinge, kakhonung jouse naholdoh in namelchih jinge.
en_web: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
en_kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And lookest narrowly unto all my paths; Thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakeng thihkhaovin nasomin, Kakho-lhah nave-lhi keiyin; Kakho-ni nung Namelchih jing jenge!

tcz: Pannabei thingmotsa tobang apin anehchai sa to kabange.
en_web: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
en_kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, As a garment that is moth-eaten.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thingmot kiloilhu kabangin, Nget nehsa ponsil kabangtai!

tcz: Mihem hinkho hi ichan a lhasam a hitam? Hinkho hi ichanna choma ichanna gentheina dimsetna hitam?
en_web: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
en_kjv: Man that is born of a woman Is of few days, and full of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mitin lhasam le panpi ngaiya peng, Hinkho chomcha, gim hesoh dimset ahicheh-e!

tcz: Pahcha bangin ahung pah doh un chule agop lhaji tai, nilim kihei banginamang loi jitai.
en_web: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
en_kjv: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pahcha banga pah a pulloiji, Nisa lim banga kihei mangloiji ahi!

tcz: Hitobang bep hinkho lhasam tah thilsem hi namitna navet jing ding hija chule keija konna kahin nikho jat sutoh dinga nei ngeh ham?
en_web: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
en_kjv: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang bep mi hi neivet chil’a, Neikhol’a kathu natan ding ham Pathen!

tcz: Miboh a konna thenna kon apohdoh jou ding ham? Khat chan jong podoh thei ponte.
en_web: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
en_kjv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem banga thilboh lah a Thil theng khatcha kiloidoh ponte!

tcz: Kahin khou jong achom asau teptohsa nakoi ahin, lha ijat kahin diu ham tijong nahetsa ahi. Chule mitphet kah khat hin be ding jong neiphal peh pouve.
en_web: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
en_kjv: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months are with thee, Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hinkho kitepsa, lha jat kisimsa, Khelmo hel dia nasuhtohsa ahitai!

tcz: Hijeh chun kachangun nei dalhauvin chule kicholdo tauvinge. Keiho khut thalah tobang kahiuvin hijeh chun lung mongin kana toh u neitoh jou sah un.
en_web: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
en_kjv: Turn from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahithei le gim hesoh hinkho hi nom asahna din, Vet vet dan, limsah datan!

tcz: Thingphung jengin jong keinepna tam jo aneiyin kisatlhu jeng ta jong leh hung don thah kit intin, chule abah tamtah hung dondoh kit inte.
en_web: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
en_kjv: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingphung phuhsa din jong kinep aum nalaiyin, Mit-thah kit’a hingdoh thei ahi!

tcz: Leinoiya ajung ho chu kikhan lhit henlang thi tajongle, chule aphung chu mot tajong leh,
en_web: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
en_kjv: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;
tcz_gospelgo: Akungbul apkai hen, Leichunga ajung go jong leh,

tcz: Twi thalhin jallin hungdonthah kit intin akeh thah bangin hung itt hah inte.
en_web: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
en_kjv: Yet through the sent of water it will bud, And bring forth boughs like a plant.
tcz_gospelgo: Gotwi lhah teng akeh thah bangin dondoh-in tin, Thingtoi thah banga abah jemdoh didng ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ho athi teng vangleh athahat nau chemang ji ahitan, ahainau akichai teng leh hoiya umjiu hitam?
en_web: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
en_kjv: But man dieth, and wasteth away: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem athi teng akichai ahitan, Athi teng hoiya um jim?

tcz: Dilla konna twi ahua alen bangin, vadung jong nichangsat teng abeimang jitai.
en_web: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
en_kjv: As the waters fail from the sea, And the flood decayeth and drieth up:
tcz_gospelgo: Twi long lai vadung kantan le Damvei lai twi kang bangin,

tcz: Mihem hohi thoukit talou dingin choldo din akilup sah ji'e. Vanho abeihel kah sea amaho thoukit lou ding ahiuve.
en_web: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
en_kjv: So man lieth down, and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be raised out of their sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem athi teng athoukit ji poi, Van kitolmang kah a mihem ihmut’a kon thou lou diu ahi.

tcz: Nangin lhankhuh a neisol mang ding kanome, chule nalung hanna achemang soh kahsen nei sumil hel jengin, ahinlah nei geldoh kit nadingin nikhosim na a namelchih in,
en_web: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
en_kjv: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me.
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigama neiselmanga, Phat khat teng geldoh kit dia Nalunghan beikah a Neiselmang ding kadei lheh-e!

tcz: Mithi chu hing thei kit ding ham? Chuti ahileh hahsat gentheina kadouna kum ho a hi kinepna nei peh ding ahi. Chule ken thina a kilhadoh ding chu kanga jing ding ahi.
en_web: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
en_kjv: If a man die, shall he live again? All the days of my appointed time will I wait, Till my change come.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem athi teng hingkit theiyam? Kenvang hesoh phat kichai, Phat pha hung lhun ding ngah jing inge!

tcz: Nangin nei kouvin natin chule ken kadonbut ding nahi. Chule nakhut semsa keima neimu nom ding ahi.
en_web: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
en_kjv: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: Thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutia neihin kou teng houving ting, Neisemsa kachunga Lung lhaitan nate!

tcz: Kachonsetna ho jouse navet khella nangin kakal son jousea neihonbit ding ahi.
en_web: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
en_kjv: For now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng kakho-lhah melchih jong le chun Kachonset him him holdoh pon nate!

tcz: Ka chonsetna jouse sakhao sunga nakhum tup a chule kathemmo na nakhu khum ding ahi.
en_web: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
en_kjv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou sewest up mine iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Mudoh jongle chun ngaidamon natin sumangtan nate, Kabol khel abonchan theh ngaim nate!

tcz: Ahinlah molsang ho ahal halla akelhah a akitol lhah khella chule songho kola akitahlhah banga,
en_web: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
en_kjv: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, And the rock is removed out of his place.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsang jouse chimsoh a, songpi lentah tah kitolmang ding;

tcz: Twijin songho alhoh lhah a chule twisoh in leiset alhoh mang banga chu nangin mihemte kinepna nasuhmang pehji ahi.
en_web: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
en_kjv: The waters wear the stones: Thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; And thou destroyest the hope of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Song jouse twiyin lhoh a, Songpi lentah tah tah kitolmang ding; Mihem hinkhoa kinepna jong Sumangin nate Pathen!

tcz: Nangin amaho chu hunam in nabol in, chule amun adalha jitauve. Nangin amaho chu thina in nasu melsen chule nasol mang jitai.
en_web: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
en_kjv: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem nasu-nemin, itih a din nasolmang jin, Athin amai molsoh ji tai!

tcz: Achateu atuteu jabol theija khangdoh hinauvem ti amahon ahepha naisai pouvin ahilouleh hetkham louvin a lhum mang jitauve.
en_web: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
en_kjv: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Atu achaten gunche mujongle ahepon, Jum le ja toh jongleu ahetapoi!

tcz: Amahon natna nasatah athoh un ahinkhou chu gentheina adimset e.
en_web: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
en_kjv: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, And his soul within him shall mourn.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsa nat thoh lel bou ahen, Alung gim hesoh bou ahei!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Teman mipa Eliphaz in adonbut in;
en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbut’in:

tcz: Michingin hitobang thu hom keu chu donbut ponte. Nang hi imacha hilou nahin chule khohui hungnung bep nahi.
en_web: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
en_kjv: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, And fill his belly with the east wind?
tcz_gospelgo: “Michingin hita hi ahomkeova Khohui nung banga thu asei ding ham?

tcz: Michingin tang louva thu homkeu sei din akigo jipon, hitobang thu a chu ipi phatchomna um'em?
en_web: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
en_kjv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
tcz_gospelgo: Miching koiman nasei bang aseipon, Lah theilouvin kihonna aseipoi.

tcz: Pathen ginna neilou nahim, ama dinga jana neilou nahi.
en_web: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
en_kjv: Yea, thou castest off fear, And restrainest prayer before God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadih mong le koiman Pathen ging pontin, Akoma tao nom jong umponte!

tcz: Nachonsetna ho chun nakama ipi seiding ham ti naseipeh untin, nathucheng hohi joulhep themtah chunga kingam ahi.
en_web: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
en_kjv: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathuseiya nagitlou akilangdoh-in, Kilepdohna ding jeng thu naseiye!

tcz: Nangma kam tah chun themmo nachan sah ahin, kei kahipoi; namuh mama chun nang douna a thu asei ahi.
en_web: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
en_kjv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken themmo kachan ngailouvin, Nasei chanin themmo nakichantai!

tcz: Nanghi apeng masapen nahim? Molle lhang ho kisem masanga peng nahim?
en_web: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
en_kjv: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou made before the hills?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem lah a peng masapen a kibol nahim? Mol le lhang hijat sanga kisem masa nahim?

tcz: Pathen in guhthima nahilna ho nangai hinam? Chihna chu nangma tum dinga nanei hinam?
en_web: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
en_kjv: Hast thou heard the secret of God? And dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
tcz_gospelgo: Asemdoh masanga Pathen thilgon najah lhih ham? Mihem chihna nan gbou chang nahim?

tcz: Keihon kahet louvu ipi nahetna, keihon kahet khen theilouvu nangin nahet khen thei um'em?
en_web: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
en_kjv: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?
tcz_gospelgo: Kahet louvu imacha nahepon, Kadat khen thei louvu imacha nadat khen thei deh poi.

tcz: Keiho langa hin upa tah tah samkangsa apangun amaho chu napa sanga hatah a tahjo ahiuve.
en_web: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
en_kjv: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, Much elder than thy father.
tcz_gospelgo: Upa tehse tah a kihil ching, Napa sanga upajo koma kihil them kahiuve!

tcz: Pathen in nalhamon chu nang dinga neo behseh a ham? Nemma athusei chu lhing joulou ham?
en_web: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
en_kjv: Are the consolations of God small with thee? Is there any secret thing with thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin nalhamon chu ida nadonda a, Lung geltah a kaseiyu nadonda ham?

tcz: Naki gellhah na chu ipin nalah mang peh ham? Na khomu theina chu ipin alhahsam sah ham?
en_web: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
en_kjv: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? And what do thine eyes wink at,
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung phamo pai jengin, Mitdih mitchangin neive pouve!

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen dounan nakihei mangin, chule hitobang thuphalou hi naseije.
en_web: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
en_kjv: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, And lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen nalunghan khumin, Nahouse se jenge!

tcz: Thithei khat tou chu theng theijem? Numeija pengdoh mihem chu adih a umthei ding ham?
en_web: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
en_kjv: What is man, that he should be clean? And he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi theng jou mong ding hiya? Pahenkoma themchang jou um mong ding ham?

tcz: Ven Pathen in vantil ho jeng jong atahsan joupoi, ama mitmu in vanho jeng jong athengsel poi.
en_web: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
en_kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Avantilte jong aging chapoi, A-angsunga them achangjou pouve.

tcz: Chonsetna dimho leh lheplhahna dimho leh gitlouna a dangchah ho chu ichan geijin thenna alhasam tadem?
en_web: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
en_kjv: How much more abominable and filthy Is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemin thilse twidonin adonin, Asea le ahomkeobou ahi!

tcz: Kathusei nangai dingle keiman navet sah inge, ken katahsa tah a kahet ho a kon in nadonbut inge.
en_web: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
en_kjv: I will shew thee, hear me; And that which I have seen I will declare;
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyin kahet chan Kamu chan seipeh inge!

tcz: Apa teuva konna hiche thu mama hi ajah uva, michingho hetsah dungjuija hiche hi kisudet ahi.
en_web: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
en_kjv: Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it:
tcz_gospelgo: Im beihel’a apu apateuvin ahil them, Thutah jouse eiseipeh tauve!

tcz: Gamdang miho hunglhun masang sot laipeh a chu koiham khat hitobang ho a konna gamkhat ana kipe ahi.
en_web: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
en_kjv: Unto whom alone the earth was given, And no stranger passed among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Agamsunguva gamchom mi alut theipon, Pathen a kona pui mang thei koima aumpoi.

tcz: Migiloupa chu ahinkho lhum keijin nat gim genthei thoh in akipeh peh in lungsetna neilou ho dingin hahsat gentheina kum jat tamtah kikhol ahi.
en_web: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
en_kjv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, And the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang bolsea migilou chu Ahinkho lhumkeiya genthei ding ahi!

tcz: Ama banga kichat tijatna O aging jingin chule nikho phaho jeng jong misumang hon ahin delkhum dio kichatnan aneiye.
en_web: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
en_kjv: A dreadful sound is in his ears: In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijat jatna thu jeng ajan, Nom asah pet tah-in guchan achomjie!

tcz: Muthim lah a chedoh ding amahon angapcha pouve, kichatna jeh a amahon tol atha dingu ahi.
en_web: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
en_kjv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthima jamdoh din akinempon, Chemjam a lou dia um ahitai!

tcz: Gamtinah avahle leuvin changlhah hoiya kakimu ding ham tin aseijuve. Amahon amanthah nadiu nikho anaije ti aheuve.
en_web: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
en_kjv: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthongten athilong neh din angah jingun, Akhonung thu hahsat akihet’e!

tcz: Muthim nikhon amaho chu akichatsah uvin, galkon dinga kigong lengpa bangin lung gentheina leh lung natna dimset in ahing uve.
en_web: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
en_kjv: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; They shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
