tcz_gospelgo: Leng hattah bangin, Manthah nana del khumgoi!

tcz: Hatchungnung pa asuhboh uva Pathen akhut u athin khum jeh u chun,
en_web: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
en_kjv: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, And strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen douna khat lam a, Hatchungnung seisea Mihem chu chutobang ding ahi.

tcz: Alummu hattah chu akichoijun amadou nan isah loutah in anokhum jiuve.
en_web: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
en_kjv: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, Upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
tcz_gospelgo: Hi tobang mihem chu, Kiletsah-in doumah mah abol’in,

tcz: Migiloute chu athaovun chule sumle paijin akhangtou cheh cheh un akongu jong athaovin apom doh sah uve.
en_web: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
en_kjv: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, And maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal-lum choiyin Pathen jeng jong anakhumjie!

tcz: Ahinlah akhopi hou hi kisumang thah ding ahin, amaho chu dalhahsa ingemma hung chenguva; sotlhuh ding sa a um cheh ahiuve.
en_web: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
en_kjv: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, And in houses which no man inhabiteth, Which are ready to become heaps.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin khopi jouse alan, In jouse alo teng aneiho ajam’un, Hinla hiche khopi ho le in ho hi Gal’in alah peh doh kei ding ahi.

tcz: Ahaosat nau jong sot tapontin, anei agou hou sot ponte; anei agouho jong kolmong geijin hung kikho khong soh taponte.
en_web: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
en_kjv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Aneila umsot lou ding, haosot lou ding; Nisa lim bangin kihei mang loitante!

tcz: Muthim lah a konin jamdoh thei pouvin tin, ajih hung dondoh ho jong nisan halgop intin chule Pathen hu haikhum chun amaho asuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
en_kjv: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthima jamdoh lou ding, Mei hulgotsa thingphung le Apah jouse hui mutmang Thingphung to bang ding ahi.

tcz: Haosatna homkeu tahsanna chun amaho leh amaho kilhem lha sot tapou vintin, amaho dinga akipaman u chu ahomsa hiding ahi.
en_web: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
en_kjv: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: For vanity shall be his recompence.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsea ngolman a kinem chun Thilse akisan ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinkhou hoilai tah le thingbah kilhamlha bangin kisat lhauvin tin abah hou jong avellin hung engdoh kit tapou vinte.
en_web: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
en_kjv: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.
tcz_gospelgo: Aphat lhin kah-in gop lhan tin, thingbah gop bangin nou kit ponte.

tcz: Amaho chu lengpi phung aga matah a kilou lha bangle Olive thingphung aga kisem masanga apah pullha bang diu ahi.
en_web: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
en_kjv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive.
tcz_gospelgo: Aga min masanga puljou lengpigui tobang, APah pulsa olive thing tobang ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu ahomkeu ahiuvin, nehguh chahguh a haosa ho in chu kavam ding ahi.
en_web: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
en_kjv: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, And fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen helouten son le pah neiponton, Nehguh a kisa in meiyin kante!

tcz: Amahon boina naovop bangin avop un chule gitlouna ahing doh jiuve. Anaobu houvin joule nal asodoh uve.
en_web: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
en_kjv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, And their belly prepareth deceit.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bol’a baotam pandoh chu hitobang ahiuvin, Lhep lhah ding bou agel’ui!

tcz: Chuin Job apaodoh kit in;
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: Then Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi masanga kanajah sa ahitai, itobang genthei um milham nahiu hitam?
en_web: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
en_kjv: I have heard many such things: Miserable comforters are ye all.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hitobang hi kajahsa ahin, Neilhamon’u jong gimna bep ahi!

tcz: Hui sathethu nung hi nasuh tang theilouvu ham? Ipi hin tang louhella thu nasei sah sah jengu ham?
en_web: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
en_kjv: Shall vain words have an end? Or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei sei jeng ding ham? Ipi lunghimona neiya neidonbut kit ham?

tcz: Keiumna munna hi um hileu chun ken jong hitobang hi kaseithei ding ahi. Ken vang douna thu twilon banga kalon doh sah a chule kalu kathin khum ding nahi.
en_web: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
en_kjv: I also could speak as ye do: If your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, And shake mine head at you.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei tobangin, nang ho tobang leng, Kalu peikhum ing ting Thu tampi kasei den ding, Nasei seiyu kasei thei ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah kei chu ana hileng katil khouva nalengvai naho lahmang peh ding kagot ding ahi.
en_web: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
en_kjv: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhamonna diu seiya, Kamchah leuva katilkhou diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche ho khel hin kathoh gimna in kei le kei kaki vengbit in chule thusei ding kada jongleh kathoh natna alhom chom deh poi.
en_web: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
en_kjv: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: And though I forbear, what am I eased?
tcz_gospelgo: I-kisei jongle aphachompon, Umthim jong leng kanat a-olpoi.

tcz: O Pathen nangin tollhanga nei koilhan chule kachilhah nasugam tai.
en_web: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
en_kjv: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-insung mite la nasubeisoh tan, Neichaisoh ahitai Pathen!

tcz: Kana chonsetna ho photchet peh ding bang in, nangin kavun le kagu keuseh in neikoitai. Katahsa gong lhenglhung hin kei dounan aphochen tai.
en_web: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
en_kjv: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: And my leanness rising up in me Beareth witness to my face.
tcz_gospelgo: Neimanin kamelma nasoh tai, Kagu –lheng lhol bou aumtan, Hiche hi kachonset photchetnan Mihon agelsoh tauve!

tcz: Pathen in eivet dan chule lunghang tah in ahal hal in eibot tellin, aha eigel khum khume, chule amitchang sal tenin eihin vei.
en_web: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
en_kjv: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: He gnasheth upon me with his teeth; Mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung hangtah-in Pathenin einoigep’in, Midih michangin eivepoi.

tcz: Mihon eija piuvin chule einuisat uve, amahon isah loutah in kabengphe eibeh peh un kei dou dingin mipi ahung kikhom uve.
en_web: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
en_kjv: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; They have gathered themselves together against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon anop agot eiseikhum’un, Eiumchah-un ka-ngeiphe abengun ahi.

tcz: Pathen in michonse ho khutna eipedoh in, aman migiloute khutna eiseplut tai.
en_web: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
en_kjv: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, And turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Pathen hephaloute eipedoh-tan, Migiloute khut’a eisep luttai!

tcz: Aman eisat teldeh kahsen thipbeh in kaum in, kalol in eiman in ahal hal in eisuchip jengin chuti chun abidoi dingin eitung doh e.
en_web: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
en_kjv: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: He hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, And set me up for his mark.
tcz_gospelgo: Thei nop’a ki-umpet eileh kadah-in, Kalol’in eimanin eijep goiyin, Eive lhi jingin, Mitt hip tenin eibol’e!

tcz: Chule tun athalkap them hon eium kimvel un, athal chang uvin lungsetna beihel in eisun uvin tollhanga kathisan avei jenge.
en_web: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
en_kjv: His archers compass me round about, He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Jet le vei sahle lhanga konin thalpi eikap’in, Athalchangin eidotpai jeng vangin eivoujang natpipoi.

tcz: Keidou nan avel vel in eisu teldeh jengin, gal hatpa mibolna bangin eino khume.
en_web: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
en_kjv: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, He runneth upon me like a giant.
tcz_gospelgo: Avel vel’in eimavon, Sepai ngol bangin eidel khumtai.

tcz: Kagenthei vetsahnan khaodip pon kakisil in kaki letsahna leivui lah a akijam tai.
en_web: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
en_kjv: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And defiled my horn in the dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghemin khaodip pon kasil’in, Leivui lah a katoutai!

tcz: Kaka kanan kamit asan lhatan, kamit teni athim sohtai.
en_web: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
en_kjv: My face is foul with weeping, And on mine eyelids is the shadow of death;
tcz_gospelgo: Maisan hel’in kakap tan, Kamit kamai apomsoh tai!

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in thil dihlou kabolpon chule kataona athenge.
en_web: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
en_kjv: Not for any injustice in mine hands: Also my prayer is pure.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla thilse kabol pon, Kataona jong athenge!

tcz: O leiset kathisan selmang hihbeh in, keikhellin hung kapdoh uhen.
en_web: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
en_kjv: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no place.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo leiset! Kathisan vuhmang dan, Thudih ka-ngeh jong suthip hih-in!

tcz: Tu jengin jong eihetdoh sah ding vanna aume, kachung thu eiseipeh ding chu chung sanga aume.
en_web: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
en_kjv: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And my record is on high.
tcz_gospelgo: Van a eidinpia Eipanpi ding khat aumnai!

tcz: Kagol kapai ten eideimo uvin ahinlah ken kamitlhi Pathen a kasung lhai.
en_web: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
en_kjv: My friends scorn me: But mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagol kapaiten eihouse seuvin, Pathen koma ka-mit lhi alonge!

tcz: Gollepaiho sucham theipa banga Pathen le kei kikah eikicham sah thei ding mi khattou kangai chai.
en_web: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
en_kjv: O that one might plead for a man with God, As a man pleadeth for his neighbour.
tcz_gospelgo: Min agol apai ding aseipeh banga Pathen henga eitaopeh ding ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Kahung kinung lekit tahlou nading lamlenna chu chesuh vahding kahitai.
en_web: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
en_kjv: When a few years are come, Then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakum abei hei hoitan, Thina gam kajonpantai!

tcz: Kalhagao akisuchip in, kahinkho haisam pai ding ahitan lhankhuh jong keima ngah a gotsa uma ahitai.
en_web: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
en_kjv: My breath is corrupt, My days are extinct, The graves are ready for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Haisam a thipai ding kahitan, Lhankhuh tilou imadang kaneipoi!

tcz: Mi nuisat nom hon eium kimvellun ichan geija gilouva eiphin lunghang uvem tia kavet vet jeng ahi.
en_web: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
en_kjv: Are there not mockers with me? And doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-kiheina lam lam a Eidaithangun kadoujou tapoi!

tcz: O Pathen nangin nolnabei kahin neihon bit peh in koimacha keima dinga hung dingdoh ding umlou hel ahi.
en_web: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
en_kjv: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; Who is he that will strike hands with me?
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei kahi kasei neilahpeh-in Pathen! Eiseihu ding koima aumtapoi!

tcz: Nangin amaho hi ima ahetkhen theilou nading uva alung mit u nakha peh ahin, ahinlah amaho hi lunglhaina pehih in.
en_web: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
en_kjv: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
tcz_gospelgo: Alungthimu sumoh tajongle chun Kachunga noplensah hih hel’in!

tcz: Amaho phatchomna dingin aloi agol hou chu apedoh jiuvin hijeh chun achateu gilkel thoh in kho helouvin umsah in.
en_web: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
en_kjv: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Agol apai lhep lhahna sumguh kilah chu Achaten mitchot lonte!’ kiti

tcz: Aman mipi ho lah a konna einuisat ding chu asem ahin, kamaija chil eiset khumuve.
en_web: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
en_kjv: He hath made me also a byword of the people; And aforetime I was as a tabret.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thuchih hi kei housetnan amangun, Ahungun kamaiya chil eiset khum’ui.

tcz: Kaka ka nan kamit apom doh joutai. Keima hi kana hinasa alie maimai bou chu kahi.
en_web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
en_kjv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunggim lhilonin kamit athimlon, Kakhut kakeng gu-lheng lhon keo ahitai!

tcz: Michonpha hon eimu teng uleh atija soh ji tauve, nolna bei miho chu Pathen neilou miho dounan ahung kipat doh jiuve.
en_web: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
en_kjv: Upright men shall be astonied at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthenga kigel hi atijauvin, Pathen hephalou bangin eiboltauve!

tcz: Michonpha ho chu malam jonin akitol jing uve. Chule akhut teni thengsel'a umho chu ahat cheh ahat cheh jiuve.
en_web: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
en_kjv: The righteous also shall hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
tcz_gospelgo: Gin le ja akigel hon Themjo danin akigel cheh cheh jengui!

tcz: Nangho nabon Chauvin kinelna a phajep in hung kile kit uvin, nangho lah a miching khat beh kamu doh lou vang'in
en_web: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
en_kjv: But as for you all, do you return, and come now: For I cannot find one wise man among you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla kamasanga hung idngu jongleh Alah-uva aching khat beh mudoh ponge.

tcz: Keima hin nikho aki chaitan, kakinepna amangthah tai. Kalung ngaichat jouse akeh gam tai.
en_web: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
en_kjv: My days are past, My purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Kanikho abeihei hoiyin, kathigon ho athontan, Kakinepna jong abeitai!

tcz: Hiche miho hin jan hi sun ahi tin asei uvin, amahon muthim chu khovah ahi tin asei jiuve.
en_web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
en_kjv: They change the night into day: The light is short, because of darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaloi kagolten janlai jong sun abahsah-un, Muthim jong kho vah loi din aseiyui!

tcz: Lhankhuh a chu che taleng ipi itin tem? Chule muthim lah a chun lupna kisem leng?
en_web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
en_kjv: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigam bou kakineppi ahitan, Hikoma chun muthim lah a kijam tange!

tcz: Lhankhuh chu kappa nahi tin kou leng, ipi itin tem? Chule than chu kanu ahi loule kasopinu tileng;
en_web: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
en_kjv: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: To the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhankhuh chu pan neiying ting, Thante chu kanu le kasopinun bol inge!

tcz: Kakinepna hoilamba hita a mikhat touvin amu dem?
en_web: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
en_kjv: And where is now my hope? As for my hope, who shall see it?
tcz_gospelgo: Kakineppi ding hoikoma um a, Kakinepna thei kon amun?

tcz: Ahipoi kakinepna chu keima toh lhankhuh a kumlha suh khom ding kahi lhone. Leivui lah a kaki choldo khom ding ahi.
en_web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
en_kjv: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, When our rest together is in the dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigam kajotsuh teng Kinepna neitaponge!

tcz: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad chun adonbut in:
en_web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Shuh mi Bildah-in adonbut’in:

tcz: Nathusei nangah masang a ichan sauva nasei nahlai ding ham? Ka donbut diu nadeija ahile chihna thu seijin.
en_web: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
en_kjv: How long will it be ere you make an end of words? Mark, and afterwards we will speak.
tcz_gospelgo: “Job nang tobang nathip jengle iti-am? Sei ngaile chun kahil thei diu nahi!

tcz: Nangin keiho gamsa ho sanga phajo maimaija neigel uham? Nangin keiho hi mingol a nei ngai tou ham?
en_web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
en_kjv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, And reputed vile in your sight?
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin keiho cheng hi Gancha ngol neibahsah-u ham?

tcz: Nalung han man in nalu jang sam chu botchai theijin nate, ahinlah hichun leiset asuhmang thei ding ham? Songpi ho akithin sah theiding ham?
en_web: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
en_kjv: He teareth himself in his anger: Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? And shall the rock be removed out of his place?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalunghan chu nanatlo bep ahi. Nalunghan jeh a leiset kidonda a, Nalungdamna dinga Pathenin molsang jouse atolmang ding ham?

tcz: Tahbeh in migilou te thaomei kimut mit peh intin ameikong jeng u jong vahdoh lou ding ahi.
en_web: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
en_kjv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou meivah kimut mit ding, Kongdoh kit lou ding ahi.

tcz: Aponbuh uva athaomei jengu jong hung thim ding ahi, achung lang uva kikhai thaomei jong kimutmit ding ahi.
en_web: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
en_kjv: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, And his candle shall be put out with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou insunga mu athimin, Thaomei vah jong akimut mittai.

tcz: Migilouvin ama kam'a kitahsan tah a akalson nau kisuhchom peh ding, amaho thilgon mama a chu kipal lhu diu ahi.
en_web: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
en_kjv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.
tcz_gospelgo: Golkha tah a kal ason jongle achomtan, Athilgon chengsea akipaltai.

tcz: Migilou chu lenna a ohin kokhuh sunga alhalut jiuve.
en_web: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
en_kjv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon a snare.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangkol achonlut’in, Khuh sunga avah lut tai!

tcz: Thang kikam chun akhotal jum u akhit khan thang chun akhit chah kheh e.
en_web: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
en_kjv: The grin shall take him by the heel, And the robber shall prevail against him.
tcz_gospelgo: Akeng thanga a-oh den tan, thangkol a akihen-oh tai!

tcz: Khaokol chu tolla akisel den nalaijin, alampiuva khao akijung galkai peh e.
en_web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
en_kjv: The snare is laid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Alampia thang akikamin, Leivui akivuh khum’e!

tcz: Migiloute chu kichat tijatnan aum kimvel un chule akalson jouse asuboi ji'e.
en_web: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
en_kjv: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall drive him to his feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Jet le vei sahle lhanga tijatna jengin, Akho-nung ajui jinge!

tcz: Akelthoh u chun athao asulhom in chuleh vangset nachun amaho kipal lhuh ding chu anga ahi.
en_web: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
en_kjv: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And destruction shall be ready at his side.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihao tah chunk el athoh tan, toset to akikhen tapoi!

tcz: Natna in ativun u anen, thinan atibah u aval lhum tai.
en_web: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
en_kjv: It shall devour the strength of his skin: Even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina khop hel’in atipat’in, Akhut le akeng amonpai gotai!

tcz: Ahoidoh nau ainuva konna kibotkhen uva, chule kichat umtah lengpa henga chun akipui lha tauve.
en_web: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
en_kjv: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, And it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
tcz_gospelgo: Amonpi insunga alhop lhan, Thina angsunga akailuttauve!

tcz: Migiloute in chu kihal lha a ain chung uva kath meikong akijuh lhah sah e.
en_web: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
en_kjv: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kat meiya akisuh theng teng, A-insunga apu louhel mi chengtante.

tcz: Ajungu golha a abah u jong goplha ding ahi.
en_web: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
en_kjv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Abulbal ajung agop panin, Abah jouse agopantai!

tcz: Aum ingo kihetna ho jouse leisetna konna mangthah ding ahin koima chan amaho min chu ageldoh kit lou ding ahi.
en_web: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
en_kjv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.
tcz_gospelgo: Khosungle gamsunga amin thang tapon, Koiman ageldoh him him tapoi.

tcz: Khovah a konna muthim lah a kisep lut ding ahiuvin vannoi leiset a konna kidel manga ahi tauve.
en_web: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
en_kjv: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Son le pah la aneipon, Achilhah jong abeitai!

tcz: Amahon chate hihen tute hijongle anei tahlou ding u ahi, achennau gamsung a hung cheng ding son leh pah hung beihel ding ahi.
en_web: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
en_kjv: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, Nor any remaining in his dwellings.

tcz: Nilhum lam miten avangset diu akichat peh un, solam amite akichauve.
en_web: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
en_kjv: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.
tcz_gospelgo: Niso le nilhuma ahinkho thusim japha chan, Tijan akihot lhul soh tauve!

tcz: Hichehi migilou Pathen neiloute chenna mun ahi tin hin seiju vinte.
en_web: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
en_kjv: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou, Pathen hephalou chu Hiti chih cheh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiti hin Job in asei kit e:
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: Then Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Itih chan nei suhgenthei nahlai dingu ham? Itih chan nathu sei uva chu suhchip ding neigot nahlai diu ham?
en_web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
en_kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, And break me in pieces with words?
tcz_gospelgo: “Idia neisuh lung jing jing uva, Neiseithan gdeh jengu ham?

tcz: Nanghon somvei jen neijumsou ahitai, aphalouva neibol u hi najachat pi louvu ham?
en_web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
en_kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: You are not ashamed that you make yourselves strange to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neiphin phin jengun, Neihousetnau jong najahcha pouve.

tcz: Keiman chonsetna nei jeng jong leng hichu keija bou ahin nangho a ahipoi.
en_web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
en_kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Bol khel nei mong jong leng, Nang ho dia i-khoh ham?

tcz: Kei sanga phajo a nakigel u ham? Nei suh jachat nau hi kachonset hettohsahna a man ding natiu ham?
en_web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
en_kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach:
tcz_gospelgo: Keisanga phajoa kigel’a, Kagimna hi kachonsetgaa nagel’um?

tcz: Themmo eichanna chu Pathen ahin, alenna eimat ahi.
en_web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
en_kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, And hath compassed me with his net.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen bol kahi namu louvu ham? ka-o na ding thang eikampeh chume!

tcz: Nei kithopiuvin tia kapen jah vang'in koima chan ei donbut poi, kanel kal in ahinlah thudih'a thu kitanna aum deh poi.
en_web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
en_kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumhat’a eibol kanel vangin koiman angaipon, Thudih kakhohsah vangin koiman angaipoi!

tcz: Pathen in kalampi akhotan jeh in kachat thei poi, kalampi muthim lah a eilhun lut peh e.
en_web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
en_kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, And he hath set darkness in my paths.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin kalampi akhah-in kachepai theipon, Kalamlhah jouse asuchotai!

tcz: Aman kaloupina eilah mang peh in chule kalu chunga konin kalal lukhuuh eilahdoh peh tai.
en_web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
en_kjv: He hath stript me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagou jouse eilahpeh tan, Kaminthanna asubeisoh tai!

tcz: Aman kasih lang jousea eikai lhun chuleh abeipai kahitai. Thingphung lhusa bangin kahinna jung jouse eibodoh peh tai.
en_web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
en_kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: And mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
tcz_gospelgo: Jetle vei sahle lhanga eijep chinton, Kakinepna thingboh abotdoh tai!

tcz: Alunghanna chu kachunga ahung deujah jengin amelma khat bangin eisem e.
en_web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
en_kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, And he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin lung hangin eidel khumin, Amelma giloupen abngineiboltai!

tcz: Asepai honpi amasan amahon kei bulu nading lampi asem uvin kaponbuh kimvella ngahmun asauve.
en_web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
en_kjv: His troops come together, And raise up their way against me, And encamp round about my tabernacle.
tcz_gospelgo: Asepaite eidelkhumsah-in, Ka-inkima apangun eiumchah tauve!

tcz: Kasopi jouse kakomma konin gamla tah a aum uvin chule kaloi kagol te jong kei doudin akihei gam tauve.
en_web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
en_kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin kasopite eijamsan sah-in, Eihesa chengsen het louvin eiboltauve!

tcz: Ka inkote akichai soh tai, chule kakinai pi kagol ten jong eisumil tauve.
en_web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
en_kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, And my familiar friends have forgotten me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopi, ka-insung mite, kagol ngaitah tah ten Eijamsansoh tauve!

tcz: Kasohte le kasoh numei ten hetkhah lou mi danin eigel tauvin, keihi amaho dinga gamchom mi toh kabang tai.
en_web: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
en_kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maidens, Count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-in alhung jing maljin hon eisumilsoh tan, Kasoh numeiten hetphah lou maljin bangin eibol’ui!

tcz: Kasohpa kakou chun ama ahung tapoi, amapa koma katao ding angaije.
en_web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
en_kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhacha khat kakou jongle eihoupon, Kamdama katao jongle eidonpoi!

tcz: Kahai jong kajinu dinga theida um ahin, keihi kain koten eile mang u ahitai.
en_web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
en_kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, Though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.
tcz_gospelgo: Kajinun jong kakam-ui ajanompon, Kasopiten jong einailut nompouve!

tcz: Chapang neucha cha ho jengin jong ija se louvin eibol uvin, thusei dinga kadin doh chun amahon anunglam eingat uve.
en_web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
en_kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangten nahsah mon eibol’un, Nuijat nopnan eineitauve!

tcz: Kakinaipi kagolten eikidah uvin kangai tah tah hon jong eidou tauve.
en_web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
en_kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: And they whom I loved are turned against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagol ngaitah tah ten eivet dauvin, Ka-ngaipen tah hon eidoutauve!

tcz: Kavun leh kagu kachang bouseh a eikikoi ahitan, chule kanevun teni khu apang kaven maimai jeh a thina a kona jamdoh kahi.
en_web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
en_kjv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagu le kavun keobou um ahitan, Kapao paojeh a hingdan kahibouve!

tcz: Nei khotouvin, kagol kapai ho, nei khotuvin, ijeh inem itile Pathen khut in eitham khah ahi.
en_web: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
en_kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eijep lhuh ahitai! Neivoujang natpiuvin kagolle kapaite!

tcz: Pathen in eibolna banga nangin jong nei bolgim ding ham? Nei lhaingem lou jeh a hi chimlou nahim?
en_web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
en_kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eibolna kah a idia neibolgim’u ham? Neibol gim nau chimlou nahiuvem?

tcz: O kathusei hohi sahlut thei hihen, O hiche hohi hetjing nathei khat a kimin chon sah hile,
en_web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
en_kjv: O that my words were now written! O that they were printed in a book!
tcz_gospelgo: Khattouvin kaseiho hi melchih din Lekhabua jihlut leh katitave!

tcz: Thih paicha in kikhen doh hen lang chuleh ngen twi kisunkhum hen lang a itih a umjing ding songpi chunga kikhen doh hen.
en_web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
en_kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead In the rock for ever!
tcz_gospelgo: Ahiloule songpheng chunga kijih pol’a Aman louna dia kajihvomsoh hel hileh!

tcz: Ahinlah keija dingin vang eilhandampu ahinge ti keiman kahei. Akhon naleh leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi.
en_web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
en_kjv: For I know that my Redeemer liveth, And that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla akhonna kheh a eihung panpi ding Van a khat um kahei!

tcz: Chule katahsa akemsuh jou nung hihen, hijeng jongle katahsa tah a Pathen kamu ding ahi.
en_web: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
en_kjv: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, Yet in my flesh shall I see God:
tcz_gospelgo: Kavun jouse patsoh tajongleh Katahsaphea Pathen kamutei ding ahi!

tcz: Keima gimbolna dinga ichan geija hangsan nahim? Hiche hi ama thepmo ahi natijiu ham?
en_web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
en_kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him? Seeing the root of the matter is found in me;
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Keihon iti kabolgim beh-um?’ natijeh-un. Neidel khum theina diuvin Kamona ding nahol thu’ve!

tcz: Nang chunga chu ding gimbolna chu naki chat ding ahi. Na chonna toh kitoh bep a gimbolna nachan kihet in.
en_web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
en_kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: For wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin chonset satgamna alap Chemjam chu ginguvin! Thutah a khat aumdol nahetna diuva Chemjam alapji ahi!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun adonbut in:
en_web: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Naamath mi Zopharin adonbbut’in:

tcz: Kadonbut tei ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keima nasatah in eiki sunoh phah e.
en_web: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
en_kjv: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, And for this I make haste.
tcz_gospelgo: “Job, neilung hansah tan Kadonbut tei ding nahitai.

tcz: Nami phosal nahi kahin thoh joulou ahitan, ahinlah ka lhagaovin donbut nomna eihin neisah ahitai.
en_web: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
en_kjv: I have heard the check of my reproach, And the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphinna thusei nahin, Adonbutje kahenai!

tcz: Phat kipat tillai leiset chunga mihem te ana um masat pen laiju chu geldoh in,
en_web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
en_kjv: Knowest thou not this of old, Since man was placed upon earth,
tcz_gospelgo: Khanglui laipeh, Leiset’a mihem kichensah a pat,

tcz: Migilou te kichoisang nahi phat chomcha bou ahin, chule Pathen neiloute kipana jong chomkhat a ding bou ahi.
en_web: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
en_kjv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
tcz_gospelgo: Mi phinse migilou ahingsot pon, Pathen helou jong anopsot lou nahei!

tcz: Pathen neiloute kiletsah nan van pha hen lang, chuleh alu uvin meibol ga tong kha jongleh,
en_web: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
en_kjv: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou minthang hen, van pha ding, Van a meilah nol’in sang jongleh,

tcz: Amaho chu tonsot'a mangthah ding ahiuvin, a eh u kipaimang banga amaho jong kipai mang ding ahiuve. Koi hijongle ahepha jousen dong uvin te.
en_web: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
en_kjv: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
tcz_gospelgo: Huiya leivui kithe-mang banga, Ahesahon jong ageina lam ahetlou diu ahi.

tcz: Amahohi janmang bangin mangun tin chule kinung mukit lou diu ahin, amahohi jan a thil kimu aman bangin mangthah tauvinte.
en_web: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
en_kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan-mang banga leng mang ding, Jan-mang banga kimukit lou ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu amukha sa hon anungmu kit lou diu ahitan, ainkoten anungmu kit louhel diu ahi.
en_web: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
en_kjv: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amusan jong mukit pontin, A-in mun a jong kilulah kit ponte.

tcz: Achate houvin mivaichate komma akhut do uvinte, ijeh inem itile amahon aguh u haosat naho chu anung peh kit diu ahi.
en_web: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
en_kjv: His children shall seek to please the poor, And his hands shall restore their goods.
tcz_gospelgo: Achaten vaichate henga thumin tin, Apau bat jouse choltah a asah diu ahi.

tcz: Khangdong hijong leu agubuh u leivui lah a kijam ding ahi.
en_web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
en_kjv: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, Which shall lie down with him in the dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsa nouchet jongleh Thia leivui sohvah ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon agitlou nau chu kipana ana neiju ahin, alei noi uva hung junlha ding ahi.
en_web: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
en_kjv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue;
tcz_gospelgo: Gitlouna thu ngeitah-in sei hen, Thutah seilep le le hen,

tcz: Amahon twi asauvin akamsung uva sottah akoi uve.
en_web: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,
en_kjv: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; But keep it still within his mouth:
tcz_gospelgo: Seidoh da hel hen Im mang jeng jongleh;

tcz: Ahinlah hetman louhel in a oisung uva a anneh u chu athuh jitai, a oisung uva thina thei gu aum jeh chun,
en_web: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
en_kjv: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.
tcz_gospelgo: Agilpi sunga aneh jouse sentin, Gulse gu banga sesoh hel ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon aval lhum sau anei agou hou chu alodoh un ahin Pathen in akoi lhahsah lou diu ahi.
en_web: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
en_kjv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin aguchat gou lodoh-intin, Agilpi sung geisa jong Pathenin akhodoh peh ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon gulsoh gu hin chop untin gulsen amaho ahintha dingu ahi.
en_web: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
en_kjv: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper’s tongue shall slay him.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin aneh chu gutwi tobang, Gul gu tobanga athipi ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon olive thao twidung banga long ahiloule khoiju leh bongnoi vadung banga long amukhah kit louhel diu ahi.
en_web: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
en_kjv: He shall not see the rivers, The floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
tcz_gospelgo: Olive thao luiya long amu lou ding, Khoiju le bongnoiya long vadung amu lou ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon atohman uva amu thil jouse anungpeh uva anei agou jouseuvin nopsahna hin lhut peh pouvin te.
en_web: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
en_kjv: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: According to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Atohga chengse apehdoh soh ding, Aneile agou nopsahna anei man lou ding ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amahon vaichaho asu genthei un chule genthei lengvai jin adalhau vin amahon asah u hilou hel inho akilah uve.
en_web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
en_kjv: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; Because he hath violently taken away a house which he builded not;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu vaichate achomgamin, Nam nan mi in alahpeh-e!

tcz: Amaho akilose uvin chuleh lung nachimna anei pouve, aval beihella thil jouse nei cham kim ding bou agel gel uve.
en_web: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
en_kjv: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, He shall not save of that which he desired.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung nachim tih la aneipon, Gouthil khat cha jong kholdoh ponte!

tcz: Imacha khen neilou hellin amaho changseh in anei jou hel uvin hijeh a chu ahaosat nau jong umsot lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
en_kjv: There shall none of his meat be left; Therefore shall no man look for his goods.
tcz_gospelgo: Aneh teng nehmoh la akhenpon, Tua hi agou beiloi didng ahitai!

tcz: Neng tah a aumlai tah ule hahsatnan ahin lhunkhum in hahsat gentheina achung'uva hunglhung ding ahi.
en_web: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
en_kjv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Alolhin pet tah a hi Manthah nan atupai ding ahi.

tcz: Pathen in amaho chu hahsat gentheina a a oisung dimset uvin peuhen Pathen in alunghanna achung'uva hin juhlhah sah hen.
en_web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
en_kjv: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, And shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
tcz_gospelgo: Adu angai jouse nehen, Pathenin save vun hinbol nante!

tcz: Thih hemma konna jamdoh ding go jongle sum-eng a kisem thalchang in adot pai ding ahi.
en_web: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
en_kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of steel shall strike him through.
tcz_gospelgo: Chemham masanga jamdoh jongle, Sum-eng thalchangin kap khante.

tcz: Thalchang chun atungtun langa konna ki botdoh ding chule athalchang muh chu thisan nat dehduh a thina kichat umtah chu achung'uva chu ding ahi.
en_web: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
en_kjv: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; Yea, the glistering sword cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thalchangin akap paiya athinkha akapjah teng, Thin long kangin tin, thi ding tija kihot ding ahi.

tcz: Agou jouse muthim lhangkal kiheh lah a kisep lut ding, athil keu jouseu akidalha beihel a gamlah meiyin akahvam gam hel ding ahi.
en_web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
en_kjv: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: A fire not blown shall consume him; It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
tcz_gospelgo: Agou kholsa aboncha mangthah a, Ama le a-insung mi meiyin akah vam ding ahi.

tcz: Vanho jousen athemmo nau ahin phon jal ding chule leiset in jong ama douna ahin phot chet ding ahi.
en_web: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
en_kjv: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; And the earth shall rise up against him.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanin achonset jouse phongdoh-intin, Leiset’in adouna thu seiyinte.

tcz: Ain jouseu twisoh in alhoh manga Pathen lung hanna chu twi hattah long banga hung longlha ding ahi.
en_web: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
en_kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, And his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chun lung hangtah a Agou chengse asuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Pathen in migilou apeh ding tohman hiche hi ahin, Pathen in achan diuva ateppeh sau chu ahi.
en_web: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
en_kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang thilse hi Pathenin migilou chan dia akoipeh chu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Job in asei kit in:
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: But Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Kathusei hohi ipi ham ti naichan hin ngai uvin, hichu kilhamonna neipeh thei sun u chu ahi.
en_web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
en_kjv: Hear diligently my speech, And let this be your consolations.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kasei hi phaten ngaiyun, Chutileh neilhamon nau hijonte!

tcz: Neithoh piuvin chule ken thu sei inge, keiman thu kasei jou teng leh nanghon nei nuisat pan kit nauvin nate.
en_web: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
en_kjv: Suffer me that I may speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei ngai lhauvin Chuteng atot nom nom tot’un!

tcz: Pathen koma kiphin kahin, mihem ho koma ahipoi, kanga sot joulou nau ajeh hoitah kaneije.
en_web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
en_kjv: As for me, is my complaint to man? And if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
tcz_gospelgo: Thi thei mihem to kinel kahipon, Umthim theihoi kahipoi!

tcz: Nei veuvin chule thipchet in um un, nakhut uvin nakam kisip cheh uvin,
en_web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
en_kjv: Mark me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Neivet’uva hi kam kisip a Thip beh a umma kahilou ham?

tcz: Ken ipi kasei ding ham tia kagel teng, kaki thing tuntun in katahsa akihot hot e.
en_web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
en_kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, And trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachunga thilsoh kagel teng, Kati ajan kithingin kakihotjie!

tcz: Ipi dinga migiloute hi khang tou touva ateh gei uva khang uva chule thahat hiuvem?
en_web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
en_kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, are mighty in power?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia Pathenin migiloute ahing hoiya, Ahaosah a ateh thisah ham?

tcz: Chule amahohi achateu khantou leh a inchen uve dinga hing ahiuvin chule atuteu chunga akipah uve.
en_web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
en_kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, And their offspring before their eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Cha le tu anei jong jon’un, Akhan lhit geiyun ahingui!

tcz: A in hou jong kichat tijat na a konin a ongdoh un chule Pathen in agimbol poi.
en_web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
en_kjv: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijat kichat la anei khapouvin, A-in-gap kh apouve!

tcz: Abongchal hou jong nou neilou vin aum pouvin, abongpi houvin nou aneiyun athollha jong aumpoi.
en_web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
en_kjv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
tcz_gospelgo: Aganchau aphat chan ajangmanin, Hahsa louhel’in anousoh jingui!

tcz: Kelngoite bangin achateu akichop le sah uvin, achapang hou chu akichom un chule alam lam uve.
en_web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
en_kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.
tcz_gospelgo: Atu achateu kelngoi noute bangin Alamkai le jengui!

tcz: Amahon semjang saigin leh selang dah toh lhonin la a asauvin, theile kimut gin in kipa golnop abol'uve.
en_web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
en_kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the organ.
tcz_gospelgo: Semjang kisaigin le Theile kimut gingin alam’uve!

tcz: Amahon ahin nikho hou nopsah nan amangun, chuti chun lungmong tah in lhankhuh ajon ji tauve.
en_web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
en_kjv: They spend their days in wealth, And in a moment go down to the grave.
tcz_gospelgo: Cham le lung mongin ahing lhumkeiyun, Nat genthei thoh louvin athijiuve!

tcz: Amahon chemangin nathil imacha kadei pouvin, nalam lhah jong kadei pouve tin PAthen koma aseijuve.
en_web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
en_kjv: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute Pathen hohdal din agon, Ahinkhouva adeilam het ding anompouve!

tcz: Hatchungnung kitipa chu koi hija chule ipi dinga athu kangai diu ham?
en_web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
en_kjv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kinbol phatchom nan agelpouvin, Ahenga tao jong iman agel pouve!

tcz: Amahon ahausat najouseu hi amaho thahat a kilam doh danin agel un, ahinlah hitobang lunggel na a chu keiman imacha bol ding kanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
en_kjv: Lo, their good is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahatsan a pachangin akigel’un; Kenvang alunggel’u kadeipoi.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in migilou thaomei jong akimumit peh khapoi. Amaho hin hahsatna anei khah uvem? Pathen in lunghang tah a lung genthei nahi amaho ana hoppeh khah em?
en_web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
en_kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! And how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin hahsa atojing monga, Manthah nan aphah jing mong am? Pathenin migilou chu Talen apeh jing mong ham?

tcz: Changpol banga amaho huijin amasang amutmang khah hitam? Huipi hat in changvai alhohmang banga alhoh mang khah hitam?
en_web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
en_kjv: They are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi huiya changpol kithe bang le Chimpeiyin leivui apoh mang bang mong ham?

tcz: Aphai Pathen in achateu beh agimbol ding ahi tin nasei juvin ahinlah chonset bol pen pen vang chu agim bol ding ahi tin kaseije. Chutile ama thutanna chu ahet thei diu ahi.
en_web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
en_kjv: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: He rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
tcz_gospelgo: Apa chonset jeh a Pathenin achapa talen apeh-in naseiyin, Ahipoi, achonset akihetna diuvin amaho joh talen pejo hen!

tcz: Amanthah nau amahon amit tah uvin veu hen hatchungnung pa lunghanna thuhtah chu twidon in don uhen.
en_web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
en_kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, And he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonseten achonset mankipoh-u hen, Hatchungnung Pathen lungsat toh khau hen!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ama athi nung teng le ainkoteu iti dingu ham ti angaito pouve.
en_web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
en_kjv: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem athi teng leh Atu acha akhohsah mong em?

tcz: Ahinlah koipen in Pathen chu ahil thei ding ham? Mithahat chung thu jeng jong atan ji ahi.
en_web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
en_kjv: Shall any teach God knowledge? Seeing he judgeth those that are high.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengle lalte thutan ji Pathen chu Mihemin ahil thei ham?

tcz: Mikhat chu hausa tah le lungmong tah hin boina beihel in athi jin ahi.
en_web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
en_kjv: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem abang khat nei le nga lhing, Tahsa dam theiyin,

tcz: Mithahat misalhing hole tahsa damthei ho lim chu ahi.
en_web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
en_kjv: His breasts are full of milk, And his bones are moistened with marrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa damthei leh hat’in, Adong hoi theiyin, chuteng athin;

tcz: Mikhat kit chu nopsahna hepha louhel in vaichatna khonteh in athi jin ahi.
en_web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
en_kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, And never eateth with pleasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Abang khatma gim genthei thoh-in, Lung gentheiyin hingin, chuteng athi.

tcz: Ahinlah ani honna chu leivui lah a kivui cheh ahi lhonin, ani lhonna than hon aneh cheh lhon ding ahi.
en_web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
en_kjv: They shall lie down alike in the dust, And the worms shall cover them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla hoijoh chu ahin athin akivuiyin, Thanjangten atomlhah deh-un aneuve.

tcz: Ven nangin ipi nagel kahen nangin kei douna a nathilgon kahen ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
en_kjv: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung gel’u kahen, Themmosah tei neigot’u ahibouve!

tcz: Achonset jeh uva ain u mang hella migilou leh mihausatah thu neihin seipeh ding ahi.
en_web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
en_kjv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon, ‘Thilse bol, Milen milalpa in hoilam ham?’ natiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah akimvella um hohi dong le chun amahon adihtah chu naseipeh dingu ahi.
en_web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
en_kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? And do ye not know their tokens,
tcz_gospelgo: Kholjinte toh nalhon khah-um? Ipi thu ahinpoh-u nahet lou ham?

tcz: Vangset phat laileh amaho chu aki hing hoijin chule manthah na a konna ajamdoh diu jong akiphal peh e.
en_web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
en_kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? They shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lung hanga talen apeh nil eh, Migilo a-ongtholjo ji bouve!

tcz: Koima chan amaho hi lhangphong tah in aseise ngam pouvin ahiloule anatoh athilbol hou jeh in jong lethuhna akipe pouve.
en_web: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
en_kjv: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou chu athilse bol housea Lethuh ding koima aumpoi!

tcz: Lhankhuh jonna amaho akiput tengu le alhan u chu mihon nidan kah khat bep bou anga peh jiuve.
en_web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
en_kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, And shall remain in the tomb.
tcz_gospelgo: Athia phate cha ki-ngahtup Lhanphung jon a akiput teng,

tcz: Lhanmol a chun mithi kivuina kin akimang in atahsa choldo dinga akilupsah namun a chun mihon ajanau apeuve, chule leiset in kicholdo na nomtah in apei.
en_web: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
en_kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And every man shall draw after him, As there are innumerable before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi asang sangin akijot’un, Along jeng jong leiset’a ol heovin akijam’e.

tcz: Nanghon keihi iti dan a thu hom keuva nei lhamon diu ham? Nahil chet najouseu jong jou ahi.
en_web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
en_kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
tcz_gospelgo: Achutileh nanghon iti chutobanga Kahenga lhamonna thu naseiyuva, Jouthu jenga neidonbut’u ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Teman mi Eliphaz in adonbut in:
en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
en_kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbut’in:

tcz: Pathen kithopina dinga mikhat in abol thei ding um'em? Miching khat jeng jong chu Pathen ding a kithopi pha hithei ding ham?
en_web: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
en_kjv: Can a man be profitable unto God, As he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
tcz_gospelgo: “Mihem aching chungnungpen jong Pathen dinga phachom ding hinam?

tcz: Michonpha ana hile chun Hatchungnung pa a dinga phachom nana hikha dem? Mipha chamkim hile chun Hatchungnungpa a dinga phachom nahidem?
en_web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
en_kjv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
tcz_gospelgo: Nathildih bol chu Pathen dia phachom a Naphatna chu Pathen dia phachom mong nam?

tcz: Pathen thengtah a nahou jeh a ama chun themmona chansah ham? Chule nang douna a thutan ahin pohlut ding ham?
en_web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
en_kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? Will he enter with thee into judgment?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakitah jeh a Pathenin talen napeh hiya, Nahougut jeh a Hatchungnungin nathu atan ham?

tcz: Ahipoi nagitlou na jeh ahibouve. Nachonsetna angahna umlou ahi.
en_web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
en_kjv: Is not thy wickedness great? And thine iniquities infinite?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahipoi, nachonset val jeh leh Nathilse boljeh ahibouve!

tcz: Vetsahnan nagolpa chu sumbat din pen lang nabat man dingin aponsil ho chu neipen tin lang henge agu achang geijin lahpeh jengin.
en_web: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
en_kjv: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Asum betjeh-in nasopi ponsil nahoh lhan, Sagoh keovin dap nathohsah-e!

tcz: Nangin adangchah ho twi peh ding nom hih in lang chule agilkel an peh ding nom hih le chun,
en_web: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
en_kjv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
tcz_gospelgo: Gilkel la an napepon, Dangchah la twi napepoi!

tcz: Nangin gam chu athahatpa a ahi timai theijin natin ahinlah hiche a chu mikhat bouvin thaneina anei ding ahi.
en_web: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
en_kjv: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honourable man dwelt in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanei nathahat namangin, Gam pumpi chohdoh nagoi.

tcz: Meithai khat tou chu khutgoh keuva nasol mang hikhat inte chule chagate kinepna jong nasuhkeh thei ahi.
en_web: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
en_kjv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithaiho la nakithopi pon, Chagate jong nachom gamtai!

tcz: Hiche ho jeh a chu thang’a naki umkimvel ahi, chule hetman louva kichat najeh a kitihot hot nahi.
en_web: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
en_kjv: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu nakiheina lam lam nalhuhna ding jeng, Hetman louva kichat tijat dimset nahitai!

tcz: Hiche ho jeh a chu muthim lah a namu theiji lou ahi. Chule twi kinong in achup ji ahi.
en_web: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
en_kjv: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; And abundance of waters cover thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Mu athimin kho namutapon, Twisoh—innalonvuh tai!

tcz: Pathen chu alen behseh in vanho sangin jong alen joi. Ahsite lah a agamla pen sangin jong agamla joi.
en_web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
en_kjv: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenchu chunglampeh a cheng hilou ham? Sangtah a kigel ahsite chunga cheng ahi!

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen in kanatoh hohi amuthei jilou ahin, muthim jing lah a hi iti thu atan ding ham tin nadonbut e.
en_web: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
en_kjv: And thou sayest, How doth God know? Can he judge through the dark cloud?
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin, ‘Pathenin i-het’em? Meilhangin tomchah a, i-thuu tanthei ponte,’ nati.

tcz: Ajeh chu meibol satah chun ana velkol lele a hiche jeh a chu aman eimu theilouvu ahi. Ama chung sangpeh a khun aumin vanna thilkholna mun ho a chu vahle ahi.
en_web: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
en_kjv: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; And he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset kah a ava le nah a, Meilhangin tom a kho mulou ding nagel’e!

tcz: Migiloute lamlhahna lampi lui chu najot nahlai ding ham?
en_web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
en_kjv: Hast thou marked the old way Which wicked men have trodden?
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute nung nung jui dia Kigo mong mong nahim?

tcz: Ahinkho kibul patna twijin alhoh manga ahinkhou it um laitah le asalhah peh ji ahi.
en_web: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
en_kjv: Which were cut down out of time, Whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute chu athi phat lhin masangun Twisoh-in atolmangji tauve.

tcz: Hatchungnungpachun kachung uva ipi abolthei ding ham? Kachangin nei dalhauvin tia Pathen koma asei jeh u chun,
en_web: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
en_kjv: Which said unto God, Depart from us: And what can the Almighty do for them?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang ho hi Pathen nahsah loute, Imacha alo thei diuva tahsan lou ho ahiuve!

tcz: Henge ama chu a insung uva thilpha tamtah dipset a chu ama ahi, hijeh a chu keiman hiche tobang lunggel a bolthei ding imacha kaneipoi.
en_web: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
en_kjv: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Aphat theisah-ula Pathen ahi-ngal’in, Migiloute lung gel hi kahethei hih beh-e!

tcz: Michonpha ho chun migiloute manthah na chu amuteng uleh kipah unte, chule nolna bei miho chun isah loutah a anuisat dingu ahi.
en_web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
en_kjv: The righteous see it, and are glad: And the innocent laugh them to scorn.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten talen amat teng Miphale monabeite kipah-in anuiyui!

tcz: Veuvin melmate iti kisuhmang hija anukhah pen chu meiyin akavam tai tin sei uvinte.
en_web: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
en_kjv: Whereas our substance is not cut down, But the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute nei akisumangtan, Amoh chengse meiyin akavamtai.

tcz: Pathen a kipelut in chutile lungmong a naum ding ahi, chuteng leh nanga dinga ijakai phasoh kei ding ahi.
en_web: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
en_kjv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Job, Pathento kichamin lungmongle chun, Aman phatthei boh tan nate!

tcz: Ngaijuvin athuhil hi chuleh nalung chang ah khollin.
en_web: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
en_kjv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thine heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilna chengse ngaiyin, Aseiho nalungthimin chingin!

tcz: Hatchungnung pa komma nakile kitna ahile nakilepeh kit ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nahinkho chu sutheng in.
en_web: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
en_kjv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, Thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungnem tah-in Pathen hinjon kit’in, Na-insung athilse kibol jouse sebeiyin!

tcz: Sum ngailutna napeh doh a ahile, chule nasana mantam tah chu vadunga naselut a ahile,
en_web: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, And the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasana jong pai mang jengin, Nasana lupen nelgum lah a vui mangtan!

tcz: Hatchungnungpa amatah chu nagou hijeng ding ahin, ama tah chu nanga dinga dangka manlu tah hiding ahi.
en_web: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
en_kjv: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, And thou shalt have plenty of silver.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pathen chu nasanan gel’in, Ama chu dangka kisevum bangin ngaiton!

tcz: Chutile Hatchungnungpa koma konin nomsahna kilah in natin, hiteng chule Pathen chu ven.
en_web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
en_kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Pathen jenga ki-ngaiyin natin, Amaa kipana jeijing tan nate!

tcz: Amakoma taovin natin chule aman na taona najah peh ding ahi. Chule nangin ama koma nakitepna chu namolso ding ahi.
en_web: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
en_kjv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, And thou shalt pay thy vows.
tcz_gospelgo: Natao teng nahouvin tin, Nakitepnasa nit jing tan nate!

tcz: Ipi hijongle bol dinga nagot chan namolso ding ahi. Chuleh namasanga lamlen chu vah'in hinsal vah peh tan nate.
en_web: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
en_kjv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: And the light shall shine upon thy ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Natoh jousea lolhingin natin, Nalampia khovah jingtante.

tcz: Mihemte chun hahsatna ahin nei teng ule kithopiu vin tin seijin natin, chule Pathen in ahuhdoh diu ahi.
en_web: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
en_kjv: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; And he shall save the humble person.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahte Pathenin asu-lhan, Kineosahte achoisangjie!

tcz: Michonse ho jeng jong, huhdoh in um unte, nakhut thenna jeh a chu huhdoh a umdiu ahi.
en_web: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
en_kjv: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: And it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih nabol’a monabei nahileh Pathenin huhdoh tei nante!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Job in aseikit in:
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: Then Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Kakiphinna tuni chan geijin akhoh cheh cheh in chule pendoh lou ding hatah in kagoi.
en_web: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
en_kjv: Even to day is my complaint bitter: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.
tcz_gospelgo: “Tugeiya lung himoa Pathena kiphin, Kanat thoh lel cheh cheh kahi!

tcz: Keiman Pathen ama umna bouseh kahol doh thei hileh keima athutanna munna kache ding ahi.
en_web: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
en_kjv: O that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen umna kahet hihen lang, Aheng jotna lam kahet hitave leh!

tcz: Kachung chang thuhi kaluidoh a chuleh kaki phin a thu kasei ding ahi.
en_web: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
en_kjv: I would order my cause before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.
tcz_gospelgo: A-angsunga kathu lhut’ing ting, kadeilamin kachungthu kisei tange!

tcz: Chuteng leh keiman eidonbutna kangaija chuleh kakoma ipi asei ham ti kahetdoh ding ahi.
en_web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
en_kjv: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi eiseipeh a, Iti eidonbut ding kahenom lheh-e!

tcz: Athahatna jousea chu keima einel ding ham? Ahipoi aman ngainom umtah'a eidonbut ding ahi.
en_web: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
en_kjv: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hangsangin einel mong dem? Ahipoi, kasei nagijonte!

tcz: Milungtheng ho chun amatoh ngaito khom theijun tin hijeh a chu keima thutanna'a konna a itih a dinga lhadoh a kaum ding ahitai.
en_web: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
en_kjv: There the righteous might dispute with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei kahin, Pathenti kihoutoh ing ting, A-itih a monabeiyin eikoiteiyinte.

tcz: Solama kachen ahin hiche mun a chun ama anaumpon, lhumlam a kachen ahinlah ama kaga mu poi.
en_web: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
en_kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; And backward, but I cannot perceive him:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu niso lam la kaholmon, Nilhum lama jong kamudoh poi!

tcz: Sahlang gam kahol in kaga mu joupoi, ijeh inem itile ama kisel ah ahi. Keiman lhanglang gam kaven ahinlah ama akisel mangah ahitai.
en_web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
en_kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
tcz_gospelgo: Sah le lhanga na atoh jing vangin Chulama jong Pathen kamudeh poi!

tcz: Ahin aman hoiya kache ahen ahi, chuleh aman ei patep tengle sana thengsel banga kahung doh ding ahi.
en_web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
en_kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pathenin kakho lhah ahe jingin, Eipatep jongle kamona muponte!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lampi a um kahin kihei mang louhel a alampi chu kajui ahi.
en_web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
en_kjv: My foot hath held his steps, His way have I kept, and not declined.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhoni nung kajui jingin, Alampi ka-lho khel ngaipoi!

tcz: Athupeh a kon in kapotdoh khapon ahinlah niseh anneh twidon sangin athusei ho gou khol in kaki khol e.
en_web: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
en_kjv: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
tcz_gospelgo: ASeichan kabol jing jengin, Ama lung lam jeng kabol’e!

tcz: Ahinlah aman khatvei kigel lhahna anei tengleh koipen in alungthim akhelsah thei ding ham? Aman abol nomchan chu ipi hijongle abol jing ding ahi.
en_web: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
en_kjv: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikheltih neilou, nel theihoi ahipon, Abolnom suhtang thei ahipoi!

tcz: Hijeh a chu ipi hijongle kachunga kathilgon jouse chu eibol doh peh a kavanga ana umsa chu aman athuneina noija akoi ding ahi.
en_web: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
en_kjv: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Eigonpeh chu amolso tei ding, Eigonpeh chu tamtah lah a khatbou ahi!

tcz: Datmo louhel in ama aum tengle kaki cha behseh jin hiche ho kagel tengle kaki cha behseh ji e.
en_web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
en_kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: When I consider, I am afraid of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Ama angsunga Gingkhen chan ka-um jinge!

tcz: Pathen in kalung anat sah in lungchang nan eisem in Hatchungnung pa chun ei tijat sah e.
en_web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
en_kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, And the Almighty troubleth me:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eisugim behseh jengin, Hatchungnungin eimeidoisah tai!

tcz: Muthim in ei umkim vellin athimdan seijou lou chu muntin a aume.
en_web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
en_kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mu eithim khumsah-in, Muthimin kamit chotlo tai!

tcz: Ipi dinga Hatchungung pan migiloute khu thutanna munna dinga ahin pui lou ham? Ipi dinga Pathen ging ten panna beija ama anga nga diu ham?
en_web: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
en_kjv: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, Do they that know him not see his days?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia Pathenin thutanna ding phat atepda a, Akinbolte them chan nikho akoida ham?

tcz: Miphalou ten gamgi melchihna achonun gam leiset agu jiuve. Amahon gancha akiguh uvin chuleh amaho gamsunga hamhing lah a alhalut uve.
en_web: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
en_kjv: Some remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten gamgi song achon’un gam akeh-un, Kelngoi agu’vin akelngoihon lah a alhauve!

tcz: Amahon chagate sangan akilah un meithai ho bangchal bat man na apeh diuvin angeh jiuve.
en_web: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
en_kjv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, They take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Chagate sa-ngan akai mangun, Meithai bongchal chu thilman din atunsah-ui!

tcz: Mivaichate chu lampam ah asondoh un migiloute chu ahoidoh nadiuvin akisel khom jiuve.
en_web: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
en_kjv: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth hide themselves together.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaichate chan ding lom akhapeh-un, Tahlelte adeljam’un akiseltauve!

tcz: Gamlah sangan ho gammang lah a aum bangin mivaichaten aphat jouseu neh ding holnan amangun achateu neh ding nelgam sanna aga hol uve.
en_web: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
en_kjv: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, Go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: The wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh hin vaichaten gamlah a sa-ngan bangin neh akihol’un, Achateu neh ding amujou tapouve!

tcz: Amaho a hilou loujau lah a chang a-at jiuvin chule migiloute lengpilei lah a akhai achomkhom uve.
en_web: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
en_kjv: They reap every one his corn in the field: And they gather the vintage of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Milouva neh lon chang a-at’un, Migiloute lengpiga alopeh-ui!

tcz: Jan khovah vah'in daplah ah akeuvun ponbeijin ahiloule kikhukhum ding neilouvin alum jiuve.
en_web: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
en_kjv: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, That they have no covering in the cold.
tcz_gospelgo: Janteng ponsil beiyin alum’un, Kihuilumna ding imacha aneipouve.

tcz: Amaho chun molla konna hung phinlha gotwijin akot soh jiuvin chule chenna in ngaichan songpi bel din alhai khom jiuve.
en_web: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
en_kjv: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsanga kitatjal gotwi akotsoh tauvin, Songpi lim dung bel din ahol’uve!

tcz: Migilou ten meithai ho chasen chu anu oplhanga konin aloilhah peh un nausen ho chu thil manna tun din alahpeh jiuve.
en_web: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
en_kjv: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute pabei naosen soh-in asem’un, Vaichate chate thilman din alauve.

tcz: Mivaichate chu ponsil beijin akeuvun acheleuvin amaho tah anngol pumin midang ding chang a atkhom peh uve.
en_web: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
en_kjv: They cause him to go naked without clothing, And they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
tcz_gospelgo: Vaichate ponsil beiyin aumsah-un, Kel thoh pumin chang a-atsah-ui.

tcz: Amahon Olive thau achil lhauvin ahinlah atep diu jong akiphal peh pouve, chule dangchah thohpum pumin lengpi thei hehna khol ah na atohsah uve.
en_web: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
en_kjv: Which make oil within their walls, And tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
