tcz_gospelgo: Olive thao alhoh-un, lengpiga achil’un, Amaho la dangchah athohsah-ui!

tcz: Khopi a konin mithi ding kon ho ahung pengdoh uvin chule maha pu hon kithopi ngaichan akap uve. Ahivangin Pathen in ataonau imachan agelpeh poi.
en_web: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
en_kjv: Men groan from out of the city, And the soul of the wounded crieth out: Yet God layeth not folly to them.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sunga mapua thi dingkon ho ataovun, Hinla Pathenin ataonau imab agelpoi!

tcz: Migiloute chun khovah adouvun, amahon alampi hetpeh ding anom pouvin ahiloule alampi a jong aum pouve.
en_web: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
en_kjv: They are of those that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Khova deimo mihem aum’un, Het din jong agel pouvin, jui din jong akhohsah pouve!

tcz: Mivaicha ho leh mi genthei ho that dingin tolthat ho chu jingpi phal vah'in athou jiuvin jan teng amapa chu guchan apang jin ahi.
en_web: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
en_kjv: The murderer rising with the light Killeth the poor and needy, And in the night is as a thief.
tcz_gospelgo: Tolthat chu jingpi tah-in athouvin, Tha din vaichate ahol’in, jan teng aguchai!

tcz: Numei jon pipan khomut chip chep angah jin hiche phat chuleh koiman eimu taponte atin koiman ahetdoh louna dingin amai asel jin ahi.
en_web: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
en_kjv: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying, No eye shall see me: And disguiseth his face.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei jonpi chun khomut ave-lhin, Min amumo na din amai akitom’e!

tcz: Migucha ho chun jan tengle mi in asuse jiuvin chuleh sun leh a ihmu jiuve. Amaho chu khovah toh kihekha lou ahiuve.
en_web: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
en_kjv: In the dark they dig through houses, Which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: They know not the light.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan teng guchaten inbang aphevangun, Sun khovah teng akiselji tauve!

tcz: Jan muthim chu amaho din jingkah ahin amaho tah hi khojin kichatna toh kijopmat ahiuve.
en_web: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
en_kjv: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: If one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun khovah agingun, Muthima akichapouve!”ati.

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hi twinoi langa twihu bangin amang ji tauve, athilnei jouseu hi gaosapna ahi chule amaho alengpi lei uva alut diu jong akichauve.
en_web: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
en_kjv: He is swift as the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: He beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
tcz_gospelgo: “Migilou chu twisoh-in alhoh-in, Agam leisset’jong Pathenin agaosap-in, Alengpi leiya jong Natong din akontapoi!

tcz: Nichangsat leh sat in buhbang twi amanchah banga lhankhuh in jong michonse ho amanchah ahi.
en_web: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
en_kjv: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: So doth the grave those which have sinned.
tcz_gospelgo: Buhbang nisan ajolsah a huiyin atolmang bangin, Chonsete jong mihing gamsunga abeijitai!

tcz: Ahingnu tah'un jong hin sumil untin than hon amaho chu twitah in hin neuvin tin, koima chan amaho chu geldoh tapouvin te. Migiloute chu huipi gopin thingphung amutlhuh tobang hiuvinte.
en_web: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
en_kjv: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
tcz_gospelgo: Anu jengin jong agelpha tapon, Thinglong lung neh bangin thanjangten anejouji tai!

tcz: Kithopi ding chapa neilou meithai ho alhemlha jiuvin meithai gentheiho kithopi ding amaho anom pouve.
en_web: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
en_kjv: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: And doeth not good to the widow.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithaite abolgima, chabei numei akhoto loujeh a Achunga hitobang thil shoji ahi!

tcz: Pathen thanei nan miho chu akaimang jin amaho chu kichoisang maithei unte, ahinlah ahinkhou iti ding ham ti hetchetna anei pouve.
en_web: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
en_kjv: He draweth also the mighty with his power: He riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin athanei nan mihat jong asumangin, Pathenin abol teng migilou athijie!

tcz: Amahohi lungmong tah a ahin diu kiphal peh jeng jongleh Pathen in amaho chu avelhi jing jenge.
en_web: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
en_kjv: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; Yet his eyes are upon their ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ahinghoiya alungmon sah thei, Hinla avet lhih jing jeng ahibouve!

tcz: Chuleh tuhin amaho hi oupe lheh jong leu mitphet kah louvin adangho bangin che mang tauvin tin, changvui bangin satlhah in um uvinte.
en_web: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
en_kjv: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone And brought low, they are taken out of the way as all other, And cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou akhantou vangin, Changpal kisih tan le hampa bangin agop loiji tai!

tcz: Ahilou jongleh khat touvin achu thei ham? Koipen in kadih louna aphotchet thei ding ham?
en_web: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
en_kjv: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kon aseilep theiya, Kasei ho adih louna seichen thei koi ham?”ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Shuh mi Bildad in adonbut in:
en_web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
en_kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Shuh mi Bildad chun adonbut’in:

tcz: Pathen hi thahattah le kichat umtah ahin, vanho a lungmon athaneina aumsah ahi.
en_web: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
en_kjv: Dominion and fear are with him, He maketh peace in his high places.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathen chu thanei tah ahin, Japin gin cheh ding ahi; Van a Alenggam sunga jong Cham alensah jinge!

tcz: Koipen in avan sepai ho asim thei dingham? Akhovah chun leiset chung pumpi asalvah hilou ham?
en_web: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
en_kjv: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kinbol Vantilte simjou ding koi hiya, Pathen khovah-in asalvah loukom hoilai ham?

tcz: Thithei mihem hi Pathen masanga nolna bei a um thei ding ham? Numeija konna pengdoh mihem hi thengsel thei ding ham?
en_web: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
en_kjv: How then can man be justified with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen angsunga dihjou ding koi hiya, Numei sung peng akoma thengjou ding koiham?

tcz: Pathen hi lhathah sanga loupijo ahin ahshi ho sangin jong aha vah joi.
en_web: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
en_kjv: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; Yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen mitmun lha jong avah chenpon, Asite jong avah thengpoi!

tcz: Tekah pi dingin mihem tehi than tobangbep ahi. Eihohi than ho sanga lhasam jo ihiuve.
en_web: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
en_kjv: How much less man, that is a worm? And the son of man, which is a worm?
tcz_gospelgo: Achutileh thanjang le lungtol tobang Mihem hi Pathen angsunga ipi hintem?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Job in thu aseikit in:
en_web: Then Job answered,
en_kjv: But Job answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in adonbut’in:

tcz: Thabei chu nangin iti nana kithopi ham? Atha lhasam chu iti naki thopi ham?
en_web: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
en_kjv: How hast thou helped him that is without power? How savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vaicha le lhasam tah keima Neikithopi nau apha behseh jenge!

tcz: Kangolna hi iti nahetdoh sah thei ding ham? Ipi chihna chu neihil khah em?
en_web: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
en_kjv: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? And how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
tcz_gospelgo: Keitobang mi-ngol hi nahetna neihil’in, Phatah-in thu neimop tai!

tcz: Hitobang chihna thusei hohi hoiya nakilah ham? Koi lhagauvin nanga konna thu asei ham?
en_web: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
en_kjv: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came from thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Koipen nagijou dia chujat naseiya, Kon nathumop’a hitobangpi hi nasei ham?” ati.

tcz: Athisa twitonoija umho chu akithinge.
en_web: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
en_kjv: Dead things are formed From under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lei noiya twito jouse akithingin, Twipi le asunga cheng jouse akichauve!

tcz: Pathen masanga chun noimigam jong akeu ahi, manthahna mun chu akihol doh tai.
en_web: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
en_kjv: Hell is naked before him, And destruction hath no covering.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen maiya noimigam jong akihongsa, Husih beiya akeova kijam ahi!

tcz: Pathen in van sahlang kai chu onghom laiya ahin khang doh in chule leiset chu imacha umlouna ah akhaije.
en_web: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
en_kjv: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin sahlam vanthamjol ajamdoh-in, Leiset jong onghoma akhaithoi!

tcz: Aman go chu meilhang satah in atom in chule agih a chun apohkeh dehpoi.
en_web: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
en_kjv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin twipi hi meilhangin ajeldoh-jin, Aki-ngapna meibol jeng jong apojalsah hih-e!

tcz: Aman lha chu amai atompeh in ameilhang ho a chun akhumin ahi.
en_web: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
en_kjv: He holdeth back the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha jong atomjol jin, Meilhang abol khumsah jie!

tcz: Aman leisetna konna twi achom khenna chu kolmong ana semdoh ahi. Sunle jan gamgi asempeh ahi.
en_web: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
en_kjv: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, Until the day and night come to an end.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin twipi chunga velkol ajel’in, Sun le jan ahomkhen’e!

tcz: Van khombul ho akiling in aman asapset teng akithing tuntun jin ahi.
en_web: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
en_kjv: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his reproof.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin apho tengleh Vanthamjol khompi jouse kichan akithing jiuve!

tcz: Ama thahat in twikhang len thipchet in aumin athilbol theina in twikhanglen'a ganhing len chu asuhchip ahi.
en_web: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
en_kjv: He divideth the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahat’in Twikhanglen aphoh thip’in, Achihnan kiletsahte asu-thip’e!

tcz: Alhagauva vanho hoitah a asem ahi. Athaneina a gulpi kilap lele chu asutpai ahi.
en_web: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
en_kjv: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; His hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol amut thengsel jin, Akhut’in gulpi kithol janglai athil paiye!

tcz: Athilbol ho lah a hicheho hi akipatna mai mai bou ahi nalaije. Athilboltheina husa mai mai bou ahin kon hitia chu van kithin thahatna chu ahet thei ding ham?
en_web: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
en_kjv: Lo, these are parts of his ways: But how little a portion is heard of him? But the thunder of his power who can understand?
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi athahat kihetna them khat, Athusa kijamai mai bou ahin, Pathen lal loupin akon ahetjou jai ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
en_web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
en_kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in aseiban ajop paiyin:

tcz: Kathaneina eilah mang peh pa Pathen a kihahselna kaneijin kalhagao eisuhnatpeh Hatchungnung pachu,
en_web: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
en_kjv: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
tcz_gospelgo: “Adih a thu eitanpeh nomlou, Hin gentheiya eihinsah Hatchungnung Pathen min a kitep kahi!

tcz: Pathen a konna haina hu kaneija kahai laisung sea,
en_web: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
en_kjv: All the while my breath is in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
tcz_gospelgo: Hai theina hinna hu eipea Pathenin eihinsah laisen,

tcz: Kakama thuse kasei lou ding chuleh kalei jin jong thujou sei ponge.
en_web: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
en_kjv: My lips shall not speak wickedness, Nor my tongue utter deceit.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu gilou seipong ting, Thujou him him seiponge!

tcz: Keiman nadihna kapom peh louhel ding ahi, kathi chan geija lung thengsel'a kaum na hi kahuh jing ding ahi.
en_web: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
en_kjv: God forbid that I should justify you: Till I die I will not remove my integrity from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho la dihsah naisai pong ting, Kathi ni geiya monabeiya kisei ding kahi!

tcz: Keiman nolnabei kahina hi lhaso louhela katuhchah jing ding kahin lai sung sea ka selepha hetna hi thengsel ah ahi.
en_web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
en_kjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadihna la lhaso pong ting, Lung opkaina him him jong kaneipoi!

tcz: Kamelma pachu migiloupa bangin kigim bolhen, kamelma te jong miphalou ho tobang hiuhen.
en_web: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
en_kjv: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Eidouva eikinahpi jousen Migilou midih lou bangin talen man cheh hen!

tcz: Pathen in asatlhah tengule Pathen neilou ten ipi kinepna anei nahlai diu ham? Chuleh ahinkhou akilah mang teng leh,
en_web: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
en_kjv: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, When God taketh away his soul?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ahinkhou athum teng Pathen hephaloute dia kinepna i-um am?

tcz: Hahsatna achung'uva ahunglhun tengle Pathen in akanau angai peh dem?
en_web: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
en_kjv: Will God hear his cry When trouble cometh upon him?
tcz_gospelgo: Gentheina hung lhun teng Pathenin atao nau ngai nantem?

tcz: Hatchungnung pa komma kipana akimu diu hinam? Itih phat hijongle Pathen ahou thei diu ham?
en_web: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
en_kjv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call upon God?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kipana ngai chaiuvin tin, Ahenga tao jing teiyunte!

tcz: Pathen thahatna chu keiman kahil ding nahi. Keiman Hatchungnung pa chungchang thu imacha im kanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
en_kjv: I will teach you by the hand of God: That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thahat thilbol thei hil’ung ting, Hatchungnung Pathen thilgon hilchen unge!

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi namusoh ahitan ahivangin pannabei thu jeng kakomah nasei nalaije.
en_web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
en_kjv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye thus altogether vain?
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang namusa cheh-u ahitan, I-bol’a ngolpao pao nahiuvam?

tcz: Migilouvin Pathen komma konna amu ding chu hiche hi ahi, Hatchungnung pa a konna agou chan diu chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
en_kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: “Migilou, pumhat’a mino chu Pathenin hitin bol’inte:

tcz: Chate tamtah nei maithei unte, ahinlah achateu chu gal kidouna ahiloule an ngolla thidiu ahi.
en_web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
en_kjv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa tampi nei jongleur galmuna thisoh ding, Ason apah jouseu vaicha tahlel jing diu ahi.

tcz: Ahingdoh nalai ho chu gamna hise a thidiu, chule ameithai hou jeng in jong apul u adou lou diu ahi.
en_web: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
en_kjv: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: And his widows shall not weep.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahingdoh cheng jong natset’a thia, Ajiteu meithaihon aka man lou diu ahi.

tcz: Miphalou ten sum alom lomin nei maithei untin chule ponsil lhemlhung bangin sevum maithei unte.
en_web: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
en_kjv: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin dangka simden lou nei hen, Ponsil alhuh lhuh-in sejong leh;

tcz: Ahinlah hiche ponsil ho chu michonpha hon akivon diu chule nolna bei miho hiche sum chu kihom diu ahi.
en_web: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
en_kjv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.
tcz_gospelgo: Aponsil chu miphahon kisil bep’in tin, Milungdih ho adangka chang bep’inte!

tcz: Migilou hon mompan banga se baijin in kisah untin, thingbah kanga kisa bangin paset in kisah unte.
en_web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
en_kjv: He buildeth his house as a moth, And as a booth that the keeper maketh.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou insah chu maimom pankai beep, Loubuh kisong bep ahibouve!

tcz: Migiloupa chu alupna ah hausa tah in chen tin ahin ahung khah doh teng anei jouse ana beisoh amu ding ahi.
en_web: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
en_kjv: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: He openeth his eyes, and he is not.
tcz_gospelgo: Haotah-in kitalle le jongleh, Athodoh teng vaichat’in tunte!

tcz: Kichat nan twisoh bangin vuh khum untin chuleh amaho chu janna khopi hui nung chun amut mang tauve.
en_web: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
en_kjv: Terrors take hold on him as waters, A tempest stealeth him away in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijatnan alonvuh jeng diu, Jankah a khohuiyin alhoh mang diu ahi.

tcz: Solam hui chun amaho apomang un chule amaho chu achemang a kitheh anga hi tauve.
en_web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
en_kjv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: And as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
tcz_gospelgo: Solam khopi huiyin A-inmun’uva konin atolmangtai!

tcz: Dipdapna neilouvin apei lhu uvin, hiche thaneina a konna jamdohna ding akiha bol uve.
en_web: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
en_kjv: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Jamdoh ding agot vangun, Voujang nalouvin akhup athal’in aleh-in alhoh mangtai!

tcz: Ahinlah mijousen anuisat u chu iman agel pouve.
en_web: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
en_kjv: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajamna lam lam’uvah asemlon len, Manthahna thei hel’in ahoh kichai!” ati.

tcz: Mihem ten dangka kilaidohna aheuvin, chule iti kilhit theng ding ham ti aheuve.
en_web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
en_kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, And a place for gold where they fine it.
tcz_gospelgo: Leithao lah a dangka akilaidoh jin, Sana lhahjolna mun jong aum’e!

tcz: Leisetna konna thih kilaidohna ding mun aheuvin, songpi a konna sum eng sontwi je aheuve.
en_web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
en_kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, And brass is molten out of the stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Min leiset’a thih alaidoh-in, Song a konin dah-thih asoldoh-e!

tcz: Chule leiset a gambeh gamla pen pen jong akhol doh uvin, thih ahol nau muthim lah a khovah sah je aheuve.
en_web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
en_kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out all perfection, The stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Min muthim lah a leinoi langpeh alaiyin, Muthim lah a songpi alaidoh doh-e!

tcz: Mihem ho chenna a kon gamla tah a leiset a kokhuh avut un, khaovin akumsuh uvin anung leh ama ah akivol leuve.
en_web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
en_kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; Even the waters forgotten of the foot: They are dried up, they are gone away from men.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing lenna lou, mihem kithahna khoh lou, Mihemin leithao lah alaiyun, Khuh sunga khaovin akikhaiyun Nunglen machop thon na atongui!

tcz: Neh le chah hi leiset chunga kitu ahin, ahinlah anoi langa leiset hi meiya kihal jun ji ahi.
en_web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
en_kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: And under it is turned up as it were fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Leicuhnga neh thei chah thei ake vangin, Leinoi lam vnag meikouva kileo abange!

tcz: Hiche a songho lah a chu songval mantam tah um ahin, chuleh leivui lah a chu sana umah ahi.
en_web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
en_kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: And it hath dust of gold.
tcz_gospelgo: song lah a hin songmantam sapphire akimun, Asongdi jong sanadia jeng tobang ahi.

tcz: Hiche gou hohi chunga leng hingne hon jong amu theilou, chule vacha neo mit in jong amutheilou ahi.
en_web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
en_kjv: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, And which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
tcz_gospelgo: Leithao kilhaina lampi chu mubongin amukhapon, Muthong jong aleng lut khapoi.

tcz: Hiche gou ho chunga hi gamsa ho jengin jong ajot khah louhel ahin, keipi bahkai jengin jong atin a akhoi khah louhel ahi.
en_web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
en_kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, Nor the fierce lion passed by it.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukom lamthip’a chun Sakei hihen sahang dnag hijongleh alengkhapoi.

tcz: Mihem in songgel song keh soje aheuvin chuleh mol lekhup je jong aheuve.
en_web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
en_kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemin hitobang songtah lah hi alaiyin, Molsang bulpi jong akalkang theiye.

tcz: Amahon songpi lah a kohom avut un chuleh song mantam manlu tah tah ho chu aladoh uve.
en_web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
en_kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi lah avi nauva hin Song mantam jong alaidoh-ui.

tcz: Valha chet chut a long luidung ating tan jiuvin chuleh akiselguh gou jouse khovah a ahin polut jiuve.
en_web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
en_kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisamphung luinah dung jong alaidoh-un. Itobang thilguh um jong ahedoh-ui.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya kimudoh ding ham ti ahet uvem? Thilhet khen theina hi hoiya amu thei diuvem?
en_web: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
en_kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahile Chihna hoiya kimun tin, Hetkhen themna hoiya kisimdoh tantem?

tcz: Hoiya kimu ham ti koima chan ahepoi, ijeh inem itile hichehi mihing gamsunga kimulou ahi.
en_web: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
en_kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem lah a chihna kiholdoh ponte, Koiman chihna gilje ahepoi.

tcz: Hiche ah aumpoi tin twikhanglen in aseijin Twipi thuhtah in jong keikomma aumpoi ati.
en_web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
en_kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: And the sea saith, It is not with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen le twipi lithuh laiyin jong, Twithuh laiya chihna kimudeh lou aseibouve.

tcz: Chihna chu sana a choh thei ahipon, dangka a choh thei jong ahipoi.
en_web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
en_kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna hi sana le Dangka chohjou jong ahipoi.

tcz: Ophir am asana jouse sanga jong manlu jo ahin, manlu tah onyx leh songval sanga jong thupi jo nalai ahi.
en_web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
en_kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
tcz_gospelgo: Ophir sana le onyx, sapphire song mantam Hicheng tojong hin chihna kilheh theiponte.

tcz: Chihna hi sana leh songval sanga mantam jo ahin, song mantam kijepna chung sana hoitah chonga jong choh thei hilou ahi.
en_web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
en_kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: And the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Sana sanga jong chihna manlujo, Sana dangka sanga jong mantamjo ahi.

tcz: Chihna chohna dingin coral leh jesper songmantam teni jong hi phachom lou ahin, chihna man ding chu hiche song mantam sang sanga jong sangjo nalai ahi.
en_web: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
en_kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: For the price of wisdom is above rubies.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna hi song mantam carol. crystal chule twikohchang sanga manlujo ahi.

tcz: Ethopia gam'a song mantam Peridot tojong lhet thei hilou ahin, sana theng pen pen sanga jong manlu jo ahi.
en_web: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
en_kjv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna hi song mantampen topaz le Sana thengsel tojong tepi thi ahipoi.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya konna kimuthei ding ham ti ahe thei diuvem? Thil hettheina hi hoiya amu diu ham?
en_web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
en_kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna hi hoiya hungkonba ham? Hoilaiya ihet khen them diu ham?

tcz: Mihem te mitmu a konin akisel tan chung leng vacha mit hat pen in jong amu doh joulou ahi.
en_web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
en_kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the fowls of the air.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing khat chan amukhapon, chungleng vachan jong amupoi.

tcz: Manthah nale thinan asei lhonin keinin jong chihna hi hoiya kimu ding ham tithu kithang bou kaja lhone.
en_web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
en_kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
tcz_gospelgo: Thinale manthah nan jong Chihna thu thang ajah thon asei lhon’e.

tcz: Pathen ama changseh in bou chihna lampi hoiya kimu ding ham ti ahet ahi.
en_web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
en_kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihna lampi Pathenin bou ahen, Hoiya chihna kimu ding jong amun ahei.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile aman leiset chung hi apumpia avet ji ahin, vannoija thil umjouse hi amusoh kei ahi.
en_web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
en_kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathenin van mong geiyin amudoh-in, vannoi thil jouse amusoh-e!

tcz: Aman hui ichan hat a nunsah ding chule go ichan a juhsah ding ti agel lhuh sa ahi.
en_web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
en_kjv: To make the weight for the winds; And he weigheth the waters by measure.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin huipi anunsah-in, Twikhanglen atetohsoh keiyin;

tcz: Aman gojuh ding dan asempeh in chule kolphe vahna ding lampi asempeh e.
en_web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
en_kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder:
tcz_gospelgo: Go juhna ding mun asemtoh-in, Kolphe lampi asemjange.

tcz: Hiti chun aman chihna chu ana mun chule manlu tah ahi, ahin munkhat ah akoiyin hoitah in akhol chiljin ahi.
en_web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
en_kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; He prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng chihna umna aphongdoh-in, Angai nom jouse din aseiphonge. Akholtoh chet’in, Aphudet tai!

tcz: Chule aman mihem te jah a asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakai gin kiti hi chihna chu ahin, thilse a konna kiheidoh kiti hi thil hetkhen theina chu ahi.
en_web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
en_kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin miho jah a Pathenin: “Chihna dia Pakai chibai boh ding, Hetkhen themna dia thilse bolda ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
en_web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
en_kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in aseiban ajop kit’in:

tcz: Pathen in eina chin hoi jing lai kum chemangsa ho kagel doh kit e.
en_web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
en_kjv: O that I were as in months past, As in the days when God preserved me;
tcz_gospelgo: “OPathenin eina khohsah lai Kahinkho chu kile kit thei leh kati!

tcz: Kamasang lampi eivah peh a muthim lah a bitsel a kana vale lai.
en_web: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
en_kjv: When his candle shined upon my head, And when by his light I walked through darkness;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin einalhonpi jingin, Muthim lah jot jong leng eisalvah jinge!

tcz: Pathen toh golcha a ka in a apansah lai, aluboh pen a kapan lai chu hileh.
en_web: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
en_kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, When the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
tcz_gospelgo: Chulai chu kaphat thei lai nikho ahin, Pathento kakijol’in ka-insung avengtup jinge!

tcz: Hatchungnung pachu kakoma aum jing lai, chuleh kachate kakimvel a anaum laijin,
en_web: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
en_kjv: When the Almighty was yet with me, When my children were about me;
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pathenin eina umpin, Kachaten eina-um chah kheh-ui.

tcz: Kabongpi ten bongnoi ninglhing set a asosah thei laiju chuleh kahon na keh hon olive thao alondoh sah laiju chu hileh.
en_web: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
en_kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, And the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
tcz_gospelgo: Kabongpi le kakelpi ho noitwi alhingin, Song-hol lah jenga jong ka-olive thing aphattheiye.

tcz: Khopi kelkot phung kajot a ja um tahtah le lamkai len leh lalte ho toh katou khomle lai nikho ho chu hileh,
en_web: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
en_kjv: When I went out to the gate through the city, When I prepared my seat in the street;
tcz_gospelgo: Khosung upate kikhopna chan a Ken jong tou mun kalon kapang jinge!

tcz: Khangdong hon eimu teng ule eipel doh jiuva upa tehseho jengin jong akoma kahung tengle jana neitah a adindoh ji laiju.
en_web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
en_kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: And the aged arose, and stood up.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdong hon lam ei-ot teiyun, Eija nan upate adin gdoh jiuve.

tcz: Leng chapate jong thipbeh a aum uva chule akam uva akhut u akoi uva.
en_web: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
en_kjv: The princes refrained talking, And laid their hand on their mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi lamkaite geiyin athip chet’un,

tcz: Khopi sung vaipo lenpen pen ho thipchet a adin uva jabolna a adin uva aleiju atuh chahkheh uva.
en_web: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
en_kjv: The nobles held their peace, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupipen ho jeng jong paopoh uhsa aumpouve.

tcz: Kathu japha ho jousen eipahcha uvin, eimu kha jousen phatechan eihoupi jiuve.
en_web: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
en_kjv: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; And when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-umchan ja ho hihen eimu ho hileh, Abonchauvin katoh phat sei ding anei cheh-ui.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile mivaicha ten angaichat nau leh chagate kithopina ngaicha ho chu kakithopi jin ahi.
en_web: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
en_kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, And the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaichate atao tengu kapanpi teiyin, Suhna ding helou chagate kapanhui.

tcz: Keiman kinepna beimi ho chu kaki thopin ahile amahon phatthei eiboh jiuve, chule meithai ho lungthim kakipa doh sah jin, chuteng amahon la asajiuve.
en_web: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
en_kjv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: And I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Genthei chungnung ten eipah Chauvin, Meithaite kakithopin along mongui.

tcz: Kabol jouse chu lungtheng sellin kabol in chonphat nan sangkhol chol bangin eikhu khume, chule thutan dihna chu lukop bangin kakikop e.
en_web: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
en_kjv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: My judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitoh tah le dihtah-in Thil kabol’in thu katanjie.

tcz: Mitcho ho din mitchang tenin kapang in, chule elbai ho din akeng tenin kapange.
en_web: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
en_kjv: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitchote mit’in kapangin, Elbaite kengin kapange!

tcz: Chaga pabeite din mipan kapang in chuleh het khahlou hel miho jong kithopi angaichat nau vah kapanpi ji e.
en_web: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
en_kjv: I was a father to the poor: And the cause which I knew not I searched out.
tcz_gospelgo: vaichate pan kapangin, Maljin gentheiho kakithopi.

tcz: Keiman Pathen neilou mi engse ho ha kasuhbal peh jin, chuleh gimbol a um chu aha a konin kasalhah peh ji'e.
en_web: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
en_kjv: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, And pluckt the spoil out of his teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-engsete kasu-lhan, Amibolseteu kahuhdoh jie.

tcz: Hinkho pha sautah kahin man nung hin tahbeh mongin kathi tengle kainko ten eikimvel unte tin kana gel’e.
en_web: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
en_kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand.
tcz_gospelgo: Sottah hinga inlum a Thi din bou kakinem’e.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, thingphung ajung hon twi lah aphah a abah ho daitwi in achap nou jing tobang kahi.
en_web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
en_kjv: My root was spread out by the waters, And the dew lay all night upon my branch.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanou jing jeng thingphung, Twi nomna leipha lah a keh tobang kahi.

tcz: Jabolna thah thah kachunga kilong louhel in eikipe jing jin, chuleh kathahatna jong tang louhel in akibelap jinge.
en_web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
en_kjv: My glory was fresh in me, And my bow was renewed in my hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitinin eivah choiyin, Katha alhasam kha hih hel’e.

tcz: Amichang cheh in kathumopna angaijun kathusei ding hi amahon thipchet in angah uve.
en_web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
en_kjv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence at my counsel.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi thu kamop teng, japi athip chet’un, Kasei phaten angai cheh-ui.

tcz: Chuleh kasei chai tengle amahon belap ding anei ji pouve, Kathumop chun amaho alung lhai sah jeh u chun.
en_web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
en_kjv: After my words they spake not again; And my speech dropped upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei chaisoh tengleh seibe ding aneipouvin, kathusei gobah lha abngjie.

tcz: Mihem ten gojuh ding kinem tah a anga jing bangun amahon kathusei ding kinem tah in angah jiuvin, kathusei ho chu chavang gotwi bangin adon uve.
en_web: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
en_kjv: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
tcz_gospelgo: Chavang laiya loubol min gotwi ahomtho bangin, Mitinin kaseiho adei cheh-uve.

tcz: Amaho alunglhah teng uleh ken amaho chu nuiseuvin kave jin ahileh mailhai sel a kavet chu amaho a din manlu tah ahiji.
en_web: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
en_kjv: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.
tcz_gospelgo: Kinepna aneilou tengu nuiheuvin kaven, Kamail lhaisel chun atilkhouji tauve!

tcz: Haosapu bangin amahon atoh diu kaseipeh in sepai hon lah a chun lengpa bangin kacheng in chuleh lengvai ho kalhamon jin ahi.
en_web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
en_kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu neitah-in atoh diu kasempeh-in, Lengpan sepaite alamkai bangin kalamkaiyin, Alung lhahna chan’uva kalhamonji’e!

tcz: Ahinlah tun vang apateu kelngoi chinga pang kauicha ho toh lhaikhom dinga jong lhing joulou mihem, kasanga dong jo golhang khangdong ho nuisat bep in kaum doh tai.
en_web: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
en_kjv: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I would have disdained To have set with the dogs of my flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla kasanga dongjo chengin eidai thangun, Apateu jong pannabei jeng, kelngoi chinga kikoi Uichate toh kivop dia jong kadeimo jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho khu keija dinga tamtah'a pha ahiuvin, hiche ho chu von sesa lungset um ahiuve.
en_web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
en_kjv: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, In whom old age was perished?
tcz_gospelgo: Mi meisan mithabei jeng ahiuvin, Imacha eibolpeh thei jong aumppouve.

tcz: Amaho chu akel thoh jeh uva gong ahiuvin, chuleh nel phai gam mihem chen louna leh gaso talou leiset muthim gam'a chu jam ah ahiuve.
en_web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
en_kjv: For want and famine they were solitary; Flying into the wilderness In former time desolate and waste.
tcz_gospelgo: Akelthi diu tengleh Janlaiyin gamlah munthip’a thing jungmot pou aket’uve.

tcz: Hiti chun amahon hamboh lah a konin gamlah a na eng ho chu akilo uvin chuleh muntheh phung jung ho chu akilah un anejiuve.
en_web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
en_kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, And juniper roots for their meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya hamjung pou, Tuile al neilou longlao bal pou akibo’uvin aneuve.

tcz: Amaho chu mihem kiloikhom na a konna kidel mangah ahiuvin, chuleh gucha ahijeh uvin mihem ten amaho chu asamse jiuvin ahi.
en_web: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
en_kjv: They were driven forth from among men, (They cried after them as after a thief;)
tcz_gospelgo: Gucha kihoh dal bangin, Amupha chanin ahohdal’un adeljam’ui.

tcz: Hiti chun gom kokhuh thuhtah tah lah a timul thou pumin leiko lah leh songpi ho lah a chun ching uve.
en_web: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
en_kjv: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, In caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
tcz_gospelgo: Songko dunga achengun, Songpi pang dunga akisel’ui.

tcz: Amaho chu hamboh lah a sa loupitah a aum bangun a ao chehchuh jiuvin thahpi ho noija chun alhaikhom jiuve.
en_web: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
en_kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; Under the nettles they were gathered together.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamlah a ganhing bangin a-aocheh chuh-un, phaiphung noi dung pouva ageh-ui.

tcz: Amaho chu kiloikhomna a kon kipaidoh mingol minbeiho ahiuve.
en_web: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
en_kjv: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: They were viler than the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pannabei, minbei, imacha hilougol, Gamsunga nodohsa jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Chuleh tun amahon pao ngeilou louvin isah loutah in einuisat jiuvin eiphin phin jiuve.
en_web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
en_kjv: And now am I their song, Yea, I am their byword.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun eihung nuisat leuvin, Atot nopna diu bep kahi-ong!

tcz: Amahon iman eisep pouvin chuleh kamaija chil set khumpeh ding tailouvin kakomah ahung pouve.
en_web: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
en_kjv: They abhor me, they flee far from me, And spare not to spit in my face.
tcz_gospelgo: Imacha sah louvin eibol’un, eijamsan’un, Kamaichanga chil eiset khum jengui.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in kathal khao eisattan peh in aman eisuhnem ahin, hijeh a chu thuneina umnaho jouse chu apaimang u ahi.
en_web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
en_kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, They have also let loose the bridle before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eisuh lhah a panpi beiya eikoijeh hin, Lung hangtah-in eidoutauve!

tcz: Hiche akideldoh ho chun kamaichang tah a eidoudal un, kilhon changnam pet dingin eisol un chuleh kalampi ah thang eikampeh uve.
en_web: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
en_kjv: Upon my right hand rise the youth; They push away my feet, And they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Hite ho pi hin sel del’in eidel’un, Nokhong kheh din eidel del jenguve.

tcz: Amahon kalamlhah jouse eikha peh un chule keiman eikithopi ding koimacha kaneilou ahet jeh uvin eisuhmang nathei diuvin abolthei jouseu abol'un ahi.
en_web: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
en_kjv: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, They have no helper.
tcz_gospelgo: Kajamdohna ding lampi akhah-un suhmang din eigouve; Aphoh tang diu jong koima aumpoi.

tcz: Amaho muntinna konin kakomah ahungun keima kalhah suh pet in amaho kachungah akichom uve.
en_web: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
en_kjv: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: In the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapal vangkah dunga ahung lut’un, Tolte eichil that ha jengui.

tcz: Tun vang kicha tah in kahingin eikijabol najouse huilah a akithe mangin kanei leh kagou jouse meilhang kitol mang bangin amangthah soh tai.
en_web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
en_kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: They pursue my soul as the wind: And my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakicha behseh tan, kaloupina la abeitan, Kanei kagou jouse meilhang kitolmang bep ahi.

tcz: Chuleh tua hi kahinkho along mang ahitan, kanikho ho jong genthei hesoh nan eihen den tai.
en_web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
en_kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; The days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vnag thi ding kahitan, Kanat oldomna ding jong aumtapoi.

tcz: Jan teng kagu kachang ho natnan alodim jin hichun tang louhel in eichip eichip ji'e.
en_web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
en_kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: And my sinews take no rest.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan teng kagu kachangin eichip’in, Kanat jong a-oldom deh poi.

tcz: Khuthat tah in Pathen in ka sangkhol eilah peh in ka sangkhol ngong ah eimanchah kheh in ahi.
en_web: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
en_kjv: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin kalochangin eimanin, Kaponsil eivei-lhop peh tai.

tcz: Aman bonlhoh lah a eisep lut in keima hi leivui leh vutvam sanga jong panna beijo kahi.
en_web: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
en_kjv: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: Bon-ngan lah a eileh lut’in, bonlhoh beh kahitai!

tcz: Nahenga hung tao kahi O Pathen, ahinlah nangin nei donbut pon, namasang a ding kahin, ahin nangin vet ding'in jong neigo poi.
en_web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
en_kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen nahenga kataovin, Nangin neihoupoi!

tcz: Keija dinga lungsetna beihel nahung hitai. Nathahat na chu kei engbol nan namange.
en_web: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
en_kjv: Thou art become cruel to me: With thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Engse tah-in neibol’in, Nathanei sunin neibolgimtai.

tcz: Nangin chimpei lah a neisep lut in chuleh huipi kinong in nei sumange.
en_web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
en_kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, And dissolvest my substance.
tcz_gospelgo: Huipi neilhohsah sah jengin, Khopihuiya neileh lenglei.

tcz: Chuleh nangin mihing jouse lhunna kathina ding munna chu neisol ahi ti kahei.
en_web: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
en_kjv: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.
tcz_gospelgo: Athi dia neibol kahenai. Mihem thina jon’a neipui ahi.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin genthei hahsatna a kithopi ngaicha ahung tao tengule koima cha hiche genthei thoh ho lang ngan kihei pouvinte.
en_web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
en_kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, Though they cry in his destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Manthahna geisa, thildang beiya lungset thum bep Hitobang mihem hi idia nadel khum khum ham?

tcz: Hahsatna toh ho dinga kapji kahi lou ham? Vaicha genthei tedinga nasatah a ka genthei pi ji hilou ham?
en_web: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
en_kjv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the poor?
tcz_gospelgo: Akapte kakapi dam? Angaichate kapehda khah am?

tcz: Hijeh chun thilpha kave jin ahinlah hiche sang chun thilphalou joh chu ahung jin ahi.
en_web: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
en_kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: And when I waited for light, there came darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung navah a nopna kakineppin, Lung jinna le muthimin eilhundentai.

tcz: Kalungthim agentheijin chuleh cholngahna kanei theipoi. Kagentheina nikho te hin eisu genthei lheh e.
en_web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
en_kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: The days of affliction prevented me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nat lung gim a thipai ding kahitan, Ani nin kanat akhoh cheh cheh jenge!

tcz: Nisavah umlouna muthim lah a kavah len mipi kigol toh chet lah a kadingin kithopi ngaichan kakap e.
en_web: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
en_kjv: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung navahna bei, lung jingin kavah len, Japi lah a kadingin panpi kathum’e!

tcz: Hiche ho khellin keima gam-ui sopipa simbupi toh kikoppan eiki ngaiton ahi.
en_web: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
en_kjv: I am a brother to dragons, And a companion to owls.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagim behseh tan kamkei hamin kahamin, Va-ngongsao maovin kamaove!

tcz: Kavun ho aduplha soh tan chule kagu kachang ho jouse khosih in kati apeh henhun e.
en_web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
en_kjv: My skin is black upon me, And my bones are burnt with heat.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagu kachang nan kakhosih-in, Katicuhng adupsoh tai!

tcz: Ka selangdah gin in jong lungkham la ahin sa in katheile gin jong kana ogin in aginge.
en_web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
en_kjv: My harp also is turned to mourning, And my organ into the voice of them that weep.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana tumging thei gin ka-ngai ngaiya, Tun vang lunghem a kagin bou kajatai!

tcz: Keiman kamit teni toh kigahna kasem in khangdong numei chu jon lunga vet lou dingin,
en_web: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
en_kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; Why then should I think upon a maid?
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah him him jonlunga kavet louna din Kalung giltah-in kakitep’e.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile chunga Pathen chun eiho ipi dinga eilhen u ham? Chungsang a um hatchungnung pa a konna goulo ding chu ipi ham?
en_web: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
en_kjv: For what portion of God is there from above? And what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pathenin i-eilo jiuva, Mihem tohman ipi apeh jim?

tcz: Migiloute dinga vangsetna hilou hija chule thilphalou bolte dinga vangset umtah dinmun chu hilou ham?
en_web: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
en_kjv: Is not destruction to the wicked? And a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih lou bolte chu Hamsetna le manthahna alhunkhumsah-e.

tcz: Pathen in kabol katoh jouse amulou hija chuleh kakalse jat jong ahet hilou ham?
en_web: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
en_kjv: Doth not he see my ways, And count all my steps?
tcz_gospelgo: Kabol katoh Pathenin ahesoh keiyin, Kakalsonna chan jong amu jinge!

tcz: Mikhat tou koma jou kasei khah a chuleh mikhat tou kalhep khah em?
en_web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
en_kjv: If I have walked with vanity, Or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bolloudia kihahsel kahin, Midang jou lhep loudia kihahsel kahi.

tcz: Thudih kitena chun Pathen in eitetoh hen, ijeh inem itile aman kalung thenna hi ahet ahi.
en_web: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
en_kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance, That God may know mine integrity.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin kitoh chet’in tetoh leh Monabei kahi mudoh tante.

tcz: Alamlhah a konna ahilouva ijem tia kamu ji ho a kalungthim jon lung ngaichatna kanei khah a ahiloule chonsetna dang khat a themmona kanei khah a ahile,
en_web: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
en_kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, And mine heart walked after mine eyes, And if any blot hath cleaved to my hands;
tcz_gospelgo: Lamdih kapeldoh ham, Thilse kabolnom ham Kakhutte ni jong Thilse kibolnasa ahikhah leh,

tcz: Hiti chun mikhat touvin hange mim kaphu na ana nejeng hen, kaphu doh chengse abonchan kibotdoh soh jeng hen.
en_web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
en_kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamuchi tusa gamlha jeng hen, Kasemsa an midangin nehen!

tcz: Ijem tia kalungthim in numei khat tou alheplhah a ahiloule ka inheng pa jinu jon lunga kavet khah a ahile,
en_web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
en_kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, Or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-inhengpa jinu kadeichat’a, Akptphunga kachan lhih khah leh,

tcz: Chuti chun kajinu jong pasal dang ji hijeng hen, pasal dang khat in luppi jeng hen.
en_web: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
en_kjv: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her.
tcz_gospelgo: Kajinun pasal dang an honpeh hen, Achunga pasal dang lum hem!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile jon lung put hi jachat umtah chonset ahi, hiche dandih louva chon ho chu gimbol dinga lha ahi.
en_web: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,
en_kjv: For this is a heinous crime; Yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu hitobang chonset hi Thina thei tale peh dia lom mong ahi.

tcz: Hichu damun lampi lhung keija meiyin akah tobang ahin, kanei jouse kamang hel ding ahi.
en_web: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
en_kjv: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, And would root out all mine increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen chu damun meikong, Kanei kagou kavam thei manthahna ahi.

tcz: Ijemtia kasohpa ham kasoh numei adih louva kabolla ahileh amahon akiphin nau kakoma ahinlhut teng uleh,
en_web: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
en_kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, When they contended with me;
tcz_gospelgo: Lhacha kiphin aum jongleh Ka-ngaiyin phaten kabolpehjie.

tcz: Pathen chu iti kakimaito pi ding hitam? Aman thu eihin doh teng ipi kasei tadem?
en_web: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
en_kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
tcz_gospelgo: Bolpeh da leng Pathen iti kamua, Pathenin kathu atan teng iti kihon tang-em?

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in kei leh kasoh te kaniuva eisem kop u ahi.
en_web: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
en_kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?
tcz_gospelgo: Keima eisema Pathen chun Kalhachate jong asem ahi.

tcz: Vaichate panpi ding kada khah a ahiloule meithai ho kinepna kasuh keh peh khah em?
en_web: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
en_kjv: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
tcz_gospelgo: vaichate la kakithopi jingin, Meithai khatcha jong lung lengvaiyin kakoipoi.

tcz: Ka anneh chunga kachip khah a chaga pabeite toh nehkhom ding kada khah em?
en_web: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
en_kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman kaneh laisen la Chagate nelouvin kakoipoi.

tcz: Ahipoi, mipa khat bangin, kaneo laiya pat in chagate kahin hoitup in chule kahinkho lhumin meithaite hoitup nan kahin mange.
en_web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);
en_kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, And I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
tcz_gospelgo: APenlhah a anun adalhah a pat, Apau bangin kahinvah khange.

tcz: Itih lai hijongle chenna ding neilou ponbeija umho chule von ding neilou gentheiho kamu tengle
en_web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
en_kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, Or any poor without covering;
tcz_gospelgo: Vaicha lhasam, Nihchen ponsil cholel kamu leh,

tcz: Akisillum diuva samul pon kapeh ji jeh a eipachat jiu hilou ham?
en_web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
en_kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
tcz_gospelgo: Keima kelngoi kul’a kisem mong mong, Samulpon kasilpeh teng eivahchoi cheh-ui.

tcz: Thutanpa kalanga apan nadinga chaga khat douna a kakhut kadop khah a ahile,
en_web: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;
en_kjv: If I have lift up my hand against the fatherless, When I saw my help in the gate:

tcz: Hiti chun kalengkou aumna a konin kisatlha jeng hen, kaban jang jong akisuhto na a konin kisatlha jeng hen.
en_web: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
en_kjv: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.
tcz_gospelgo: Kabanjangte ni kivobang jeng hen, Kalengkoute nia koin kisat lha hen,

tcz: Hichu Pathen thutanna kimaitopi sangin phajonte, ijemtia oupe Pathen chun einan chahkheh a ahile kinepna ipi kanei ding ham?
en_web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
en_kjv: For destruction from God was a terror to me, And by reason of his highness I could not endure.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin talen eipeh ding kagingin, Hitobang thilse hi bol ponge.

tcz: Keiman katahsanna summa kakoi khah a ahile, ahiloule kasana a hi kakison khah a ahile,
en_web: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
en_kjv: If I have made gold my hope, Or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
tcz_gospelgo: Neile gou, sana dangka Kakisonpi ngaipon;

tcz: Kanei kagou jouse leh kakhol khom jouse jeh a kipah a kahile,
en_web: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
en_kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because mine hand had gotten much;
tcz_gospelgo: Kahaona chengse jong hi Hoithonan kanei khapoi.

tcz: Vantham jol ho a vahpel a vah nisa leh lha alampia chesuh khu kavet a,
en_web: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
en_kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness;
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa vah jong kahou khapon, Lha mel-hoi jong chibai kabohpoi.

tcz: Chuleh aguh a kalungthim kalheplhah a amaho houna kaga galchop khah a ahile,
en_web: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;
en_kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, Or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa lhathah hou din eikilhem lhapon, Ni le lha hounan kakhut kachop khapoi.

tcz: Achuti tah a ahile thutan vaihom hon eigim bol uhen, chuti chu ahi tah leh van Pathen thusei kangaipeh lou hiding tina ahi.
en_web: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.
en_kjv: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: For I should have denied the God that is above.
tcz_gospelgo: Hita bolna hin Hatchungnung Pathen ataitomin, Abol’a chu thina thei talen matsah lom ahi.

tcz: Kamelma techu manthah nan ahin phah tenga ahiloule alampiuva hahsatna ahung tengle, hetnom ten tena aum jeh uva kipah kahile,
en_web: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
en_kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or lift up myself when evil found him:
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate genthei kakipapi khapon, Hamset atotengu nom kasa khapoi.

tcz: Ahipoi, keiman mikhat tou kaspset a, ahiloule phulah ding kasei kha pon, hitobang chonsetna hi kabol khapoi.
en_web: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
en_kjv: (Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin By wishing a curse to his soul.)
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate thina dia taova, Hitobang chonset chu bol louhel kahi.

tcz: Kasoh pan jong adangho chu gilkel in kachesah tai tin asei khapoi.
en_web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
en_kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, O that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
tcz_gospelgo: Maljin ho kalhunsah jing hi Kanatong jousen ahesoh keiyui.

tcz: Hetkhah lou mi jong kakihei mangsan kha pon, ahinlah mijouse din kot kahonpeh ji bouve.
en_web: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
en_kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: But I opened my doors to the traveller.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholjin jouse in a kalhunsah jin, Kholai dung tol-lhanga alum khapouve.

tcz: Midangho banga ken kachonsetna selmang ding kagot a, kasuhkhel kalung thima ka imden khah ham?
en_web: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
en_kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
tcz_gospelgo: Min achonset asel cheh-un, Kenvang kasel ngaipoi.

tcz: Mipiho kakichatna ahiloule kikhop khom naho kadeimo a hiche ho jeh a chu thipbeh a insunga kaum den khah ham?
en_web: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
en_kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, Or did the contempt of families terrify me, That I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
tcz_gospelgo: Japin eidem ding jong kagingpon, Mihouset ginnan kot kal lhah louvin kaumthim ngaipoi.

tcz: Mikhat tou beh in kathusei eingai peh hen lang hileh ven kakihonna dinga kamin soi kakai ding ahi. Hatchungnungpa chun eidonbut hen lang eiheh pan kei douna thu sundoh hen.
en_web: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
en_kjv: O that one would hear me! Behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, And that mine adversary had written a book.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman kasei eingaipeh lou ding ham? Adih cheh kaseiye, Hatchungnung Pathenin eidonbut hen! Min eiheh nau hi kasim thei dia Kijihdoh soh keiya kikoi hileh,

tcz: Keiman themmo eichan sah nau chu kiloupi sah tah a kaki maitopi ding lallukhuh banga kakikhuh ding ahi.
en_web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.
en_kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, And bind it as a crown to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahpi tah a kalengkouva kaput ding, Kalua lallukhuh banga kakhuh ding ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile keiman kathilbol adihtah chu kaseipeh ding ahin, ama masanga chu leng chapate banga kahung ding ahi.
en_web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.
en_kjv: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: kabol chan Pathen seipeh ing ting, A-angsunga kalu kadosangsah le ding ahi.

tcz: Kagam in themmo eichansah khah tah a tucha maha jouse kitoh tah a ahung ka soh keijuva,
en_web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
en_kjv: If my land cry against me, Or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
tcz_gospelgo: Kaloumun leiset hi Aneipaa kona kaguh thoa,

tcz: Ahilouva achang leh mim kana guh khah a ahiloule anei ho kana tha khah tah a ahile,
en_web: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
en_kjv: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lousoh gilkel kathohsah leh,

tcz: Chuti chun gehu khellin ling leh khau agama chun keh henlang, chang khellin hampa keh hen. Job thusei ho akichaitai.
en_web: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
en_kjv: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
tcz_gospelgo: Suhlou chang le sakol chang khel’in Lingle khao hung keijo hen!” ati. Job thusei akichaitai.

tcz: Job in nolna bei kahi tia apanchah kheh phat in aloi agolte thumho chun donbut be ding anom tapouve.
en_web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
en_kjv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Job chu ama them akichansoh hel phat’in, akinelpi pasal thum chun donbut louvin akoitauve.

tcz: Hichun Ram phunga Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihu chu ahung lunghang tai. Job in chonset kana bol nai chuleh Pathen in eigim bolna hi adih e ti ding anop lou jeh a lunghangah ahi.
en_web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
en_kjv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin akihouvu ngaiya pang, Ram phunga Buz insunga Barakel chapa, Elihu chu along hangtai. Ajeh chu Job’in Pathen mo apeh a amajoh them akichan hi nom asapoi.

tcz: Job in anel nau adonbut thei uva Pathen joh chu dihmo dinga akilah jeh uva Job loile golte thum chunga jong kinga ahi.
en_web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
en_kjv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
tcz_gospelgo: Job golte mi thum chunga jong along hange; ajeh chu Job anel lhah thei louvu hin Pathen chu themmo dol’in akilange.

tcz: Elihun adangho Job koma thu asei diu chu anga nga jeng ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho chu ama sanga upajo ahiuve.
en_web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
en_kjv: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
tcz_gospelgo: Alah a chun Elihu hi adongpen ahin, midang seichaisoh angah-in ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah amahon adonbut be tahlou u amu phat in lunghang tah in ahung paodoh e.
en_web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
en_kjv: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi thumin Job adonbut thei lou phat’un, along hangtan,

tcz: Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihun aseitai. Keima khangdong kahin nangho upa nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nangho komma kalunggel kasei ding chu kakhongai ahi.
en_web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
en_kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
tcz_gospelgo: thu aseipantai.

tcz: Keigel in ateh jep hon thu seiju hen, ijeh inem itile upa ho a hi chihna hung ahi.
en_web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
en_kjv: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: UPa domin naseiyuva, Khanglui dominchihna nahil diuva kagel ahi.

tcz: Ahin mihem te sunga chu lhagao um ahi. Hatchungnungpa hu haikhuma amaho sunga um hiche chun achihsah u ahi.
en_web: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
en_kjv: But there is a spirit in man: And the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Hatchungnung Pathen Lhagao chu Mihem chunga hung chua chihna apeh ahibouve.

tcz: Phatkhat tengle upa ho jong aching ji pouve. Khatvei vei teng thutan dihje ahe pouve.
en_web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
en_kjv: Great men are not always wise: Neither do the aged understand judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: UPat man a mi chinga jong ahipon, Kum tam man a ima kihethem deh jong ahipoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun kasei ngaijun chuleh kalunggel seipeh uvinge.
en_web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
en_kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapang jong leng kasei ngai leu chun kadeiye, Kalunggel seipeh-unge.

tcz: Keiman nang thusei phat hitih chan sung hin kahin ngah in nakinel nahou lunglut tah in kahin ngaijin, khomulouva nathusei doh hou kangaije.
en_web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
en_kjv: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, Whilst you searched out what to say.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseiyu ka-ngai nagi jengin, Thu ngei ngei nahol’u jong ka-ngah-e.

tcz: Nathusei hou kangaije, ahin khat chan jong nanel thei pouve. Ahiloule aminelna nadonbut thei pouve.
en_web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
en_kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, And behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, Or that answered his words:
tcz_gospelgo: Phatah a ka-ngai vangin, Khat chan jong Job nanel lhapouve.

tcz: Amapa hi eiho dingin aching beh seh e, Pathen bouvin ama ajo ding ahi tin kakoma sei hih un.
en_web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
en_kjv: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
tcz_gospelgo: Iti kachinge nati thei diu ham? Nanel lel’u ahitan, Pathenin Job donbut nante.

tcz: Job chun keima einel hihen hileh nanghon namanchah u hettheina bangin donbut ponge.
en_web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
en_kjv: Now he hath not directed his words against me: Neither will I answer him with your speeches.
tcz_gospelgo: Job chu nang ho to kihou nahiuvin, kei eihoupoi; Hijongle nang ho donbut bangin donbut ponge.

tcz: Seibe ding helouva lunggimma tou nahiuve.
en_web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
en_kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: They left off speaking.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu asei khel soh tauve, Job; Nadonbut thei pouve!

tcz: Tua nangho thipbeh a naum bang uva hi ken kanga nga nahlai dingu ham? Keijong thipbeh a kaum jing ding ham?
en_web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
en_kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, But stood still, and answered no more:)
tcz_gospelgo: Sei din gbon neitalou ka-nga nah lai ding ham? Sei ding helouvin amoh dintauve.

tcz: Ahipoi halkhat beh kaseija kalunggel kasei ding ahi.
en_web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
en_kjv: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong donbut ing ting, kalunggel kasei ding ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, kalung in adol joulou thu cheng tampi ho seidoh hi kasunga ka lhagaovin seidoh dingin eino tuntun e.
en_web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
en_kjv: For I am full of matter, The spirit within me constraineth me.
tcz_gospelgo: Seikal ka-nga lel thotan, Kalungin kadoljou tapoi.

tcz: Keima ahom umlou jubom tobang kahin, jupohna thah pohkeh ding sa tobang kahi.
en_web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
en_kjv: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; It is ready to burst like new bottles.
tcz_gospelgo: Kho-ngaisot leng, lengpitwi thah-in Savun peng atumkeh banga kapojal thei ahi.

tcz: Kalung ol theina dinga kasei ding ahi. Hijeh chun ka donbutna penge.
en_web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
en_kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngah jou tapoi.Seijeng tange!

tcz: Kadei tah in jong kichem ponge, ahiloule koimacha pachat lhem bol ponge.
en_web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
en_kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, Neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
tcz_gospelgo: Langkaina jong nei pong ting, Koima jong lhemlha ponge!

tcz: Keiman joulhep ding kagot a ahile eisempan gangtah in eisumang jeng hen.
en_web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
en_kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; In so doing my Maker would soon take me away.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi lhep lhahje jong kahepon, Lhem jong leng Pathenin eisuhmanglo ding ahi.

tcz: Job kathusei hohi ngaijin, kathusei dingho hi lunglut in ngaijin.
en_web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
en_kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, And hearken to all my words.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahile tun Job, Kasei ding hi lunglut tah-in nagiphan.

tcz: Tun kathusei hitihin pan kit ing ting banjom tange.
en_web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
en_kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi hijongle kalunga akgel hi Seidoh jeng dinga kigoa kahitai.

tcz: Kasei jouse hi lung thengsel'a kasei ahin, thutah kasei ahi.
en_web: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
en_kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: And my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung thengsel’a Thudih tah sei kahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lhagauvin eina sem ahi. Chuleh Hatchungnung pa hu haikhumin kahinna hi eipeh ahi.
en_web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
en_kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Lhagoavin einasemin Eina hinsah ahi.

tcz: Naki ngachat leh nei donbut in, nachung chang thu kisem toh'in, chuleh nadin namun ah dingin.
en_web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
en_kjv: If thou canst, answer me, Set thy words in order before me, stand up.
tcz_gospelgo: Naki-nga chat le neidonbut’in, Neinelna ding kigeltoh chet’in.

tcz: Ven nang leh kei inia Pathen a ihicheh e. Keijong leingan a ana kisem ah kahi.
en_web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
en_kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen mitmua nang le kei thakhat ihin, Leivuiya kisemdoh cheh ihibouve.

tcz: Hijeh a chu kei neikichat nading aumpoi, huham tah a kahung kumsuh lou ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
en_kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Neiginna ding jong aumpon, Kenjong jothon bol ponge.

tcz: Nangin kajah ding thu naseisa ahitan, chule nathusei ho achang cheh a kajah ahi.
en_web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
en_kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, And I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin naseipen tah Kajahsa chu hiche ahi:

tcz: Nangin keima kathengin, kei chonsetna bei kahi, kei nolna bei themmona kaneipoi tin naseije.
en_web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
en_kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Bol khel kaneipon, kathemmopoi; Monabei, chonsetna neilou kahi.

tcz: Pathen in eikinah pin chuleh amelma in eingaito e.
en_web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
en_kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eidouva, Melma banga eibol ahibouve.

tcz: Kakeng teni khaokol sung ei chotlut sah in chuleh kakholhahna jouse amelchih e.
en_web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
en_kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakeng thih khaovin ahenin, Kakal chalna ave-lhi keove,’ nati.

tcz: Ahinlah nang nadih poi, chuleh ipi jeh ham ti navet sah inge. Ijeh inem itile miching ho sanga oupe jo ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
en_kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, That God is greater than man.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseikhel heltai, Job: Pathen chu mihem sanga chungnungjo ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ipi dinga nadouna a nanokhum ham? Ipi dinga aman mihem te kiphinna adonbut poi nati ham?
en_web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
en_kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? For he giveth not account of any of his matters.
tcz_gospelgo: Idia mihem kiphinna nahsah loudan a Pathen na-oimo ham?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile mihem ten ahet theilou vanga Pathen in avel vel'a asei ahitai.
