en_web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
en_kjv: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin avel vel’a asei vangin Asei koiman nagisah-in aneipouve.

tcz: Janmanga ahim, muneina ahim a mihemte ha imut a aimut pet u, ajalkhun chunga alup pet uva aman aseipeh u ahi.
en_web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
en_kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem jan ihmut lanin jong Pathenin amangule Themgao thilmua thu aseiye.

tcz: Aman anabeng tenia ol chakhat in aseije, chule kichat tijatna a agih ji ahi.
en_web: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
en_kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,
tcz_gospelgo: Athusei mihemte ajahsah teng, Agihsaln aho jal’in atijauve.

tcz: Athilse bolnau va konna akinungle sah ji a, akiletsah nau alahmang ji ahi.
en_web: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
en_kjv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, And hide pride from man.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset jom louna diuva Pathenin asei ahin, Akiletsahda na diuva apho ahi.

tcz: Lhankhuh a konna ahuhdoh a thina lui agal kai diuva jong ahuhdoh jiu ahi.
en_web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
en_kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanthahsah nom lou ahin, Thina theiya kona huhhing agot ahi.

tcz: Ahiloule Pathen in mihem tehi dammona jalkhun chunga natle sat toh tang louhel a agu achangin achi a hitia hi asuhdih ji ahi.
en_web: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
en_kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem adih dohna din Pathenin anatsah jin, Ati pumpi adammosah jie.

tcz: Chuteng leh amahon anneh twipen pen jong aduchatna mang ji ahitai.
en_web: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
en_kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Adam louvin ima aduchapon, Antui tah mu jongle achil pulpoi.

tcz: Amaho tahsa agongsuh tan chule agu achang aki langdoh soh tai.
en_web: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
en_kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsa agongte tul’in, Agu aching keobou ahitai.

tcz: Amaho chu thina kotkhah gei ahitauvin, thina vantil chun amaho ana nga jiu ahitai.
en_web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
en_kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, And his life to the destroyers.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhankhuh sung jon ding kon, Mithigama kumsuh ding kon ahitai.

tcz: Ahinlah vantil khat vanna kon in hung kilang hen, thupole chombeh khat chun mikhat dingin tao peh hen, chuleh amapa hi lungthengsel ahina phongdoh henlang,
en_web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
en_kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, One among a thousand, To shew unto man his uprightness:
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte toh ding hiljia Pathen Vantil asang sang lah a Khattouvin vang ahung panpi thei ahi.

tcz: Amapa chu milungset them hihen lang, lhankhuh a konin huhdoh tauvin, ijeh inem itile keiman ahinkhou kilhatdoh na man ding chu kamutai tin seihen hileh,
en_web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
en_kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahepi jeh a Vantil chun, ‘Lhadoh tan, Alhatdoh man aumnai, mithigam jotsuhda ta hen,’ ati thei ahi.

tcz: Chutileh atahsa chu chapang tahsa dehchet leh khangdong lai phat bangin hung damthei kit inte.
en_web: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
en_kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: He shall return to the days of his youth:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng ati noudoh kit’a, Atha hung kiledoh kit ding ahi.

tcz: Pathen komma atau tengleh amachu kisan peh ding ahi. Chule Pathen in kipah in sang intin, chule adinmun hoitah in koi kit inte.
en_web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
en_kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: And he shall see his face with joy: For he will render unto man his righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Atao teng Pathenin houvintin, Kipah a Pathen ahou ding, Pathenin ijakai aboltoh peh ding ahi.

tcz: Amapan aloi agolte komma phongdoh intin keima kachonse tai chule thutah adihlou lamin kaheijin ahinlah hichu phatchomna bei ahi.
en_web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
en_kjv: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not;
tcz_gospelgo: Aman japi lah a, ‘Kachonsen, thil dihlou kaboltai;Hichan jong hin Pathenin eihing hoiye.

tcz: Pathen in lhankhuh a konin eihuhdoh in chule tun kahinkho hi avahdoh tai.
en_web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
en_kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, And his life shall see the light.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mithigam a eisol loulai jeh-in, Tugeiyin kahing nalaiye.’

tcz: Henge, Pathen in hitobang thil hohi avel vella mihem tedinga abolji ahi.
en_web: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
en_kjv: Lo, all these things worketh God Oftentimes with man,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichengse hi Pathenin Mihem chunga avel vel’a abolji ahi.

tcz: Aman amaho chu lhankhuh a konin ahuhdoh in hijeh chun amaho chu hinna khovah a chun kipah tauvinte.
en_web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
en_kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, To be enlightened with the light of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: Mikhat ahuhhing jin nomtah-in ahinsahjie.

tcz: Job hiche hi phatechan melchih in, kathusei hi ngaijin. Ijeh inem itile keiman seiding kahaove.
en_web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
en_kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Job, kasei hi ngaiyin lang, Umthimin ken seiyinge!

tcz: Ahinlah seibe ding nanei nahlaija ahile seiben, seijin, ijeh inem itile keiman nathem channa chu mukal ngahlel a um kahi.
en_web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
en_kjv: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Seiding nanei vang leh seiyin, Them kachansah nom lheh nahi.

tcz: Chuti chu ahilouva ahile kathusei ngaijin, thipbeh chan um jingin, keiman chihna thu nahil inge.
en_web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
en_kjv: If not, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Seiding nanei loule ngai thimin, Chihje nahil inge,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Elihu in aseijin:
en_web: Moreover Elihu answered,
en_kjv: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Elihun asei pai kit’in:

tcz: Miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, chihna themna neihon phatechan hin ngai uvin.
en_web: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
en_kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: “Naching them thei lheh-ui, Tun kei sei ding hi ngaiyun!

tcz: Ngaijuvin kam’in antwi leh twilou ahet khen bangin bilkol in jong thucheng ajah jouse hi apatep jin ahi, tin Job in aseije.
en_web: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
en_kjv: For the ear trieth words, As the mouth tasteth meat.
tcz_gospelgo: An tui le tui lou kamsungin atep bangin, Thu ngei le ngei lu nabengin angaiye.

tcz: Ipihi adih ham ti eima cheh a din hekhen u hitin, ipi hi thilpha ham ti kihilkhom sohkei uhite.
en_web: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
en_kjv: Let us choose to us judgment: Let us know among ourselves what is good.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thildih lhengu hitin, Thilpha datkhen temu hite.

tcz: Hijeh chun Job in jong aseijin keima hi nolna bei kahin ahinlah Pathen in kathusei eilah mang peh tai.
en_web: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.
en_kjv: For Job hath said, I am righteous: And God hath taken away my judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Job them akichan nah vangin, Pathenin them achan nompoi.

tcz: Keima nolnabei kahin ahinlah amahon mijou eitiuve. Kachonset lou vang'in kathoh gimna hi jendam thei ahipoi.
en_web: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
en_kjv: Should I lie against my right? My wound is incurable without transgression.
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in, ‘Monabon kinei lou Jouseiyin bou eikigeltan, kachonset lou vangin Talen hah tah eikipetai,’ ati.

tcz: Dang goleuva daichat vaina leh nuisatna thoh jing Job tobang mi aum kha dem? Neiseipeh tem uvin.
en_web: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
en_kjv: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scorning like water?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen jabol louhel Job tobang mihem umkham?

tcz: Amapan kalhat khompi dingin thilse bolte alhengin aphat ho jouse migiloute toh amang khom e.
en_web: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
en_kjv: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute to bou akivop’in, Chonset toh akijot lei!

tcz: Ipi dinga Pathen lunghol na a phat jouse namoh manchai ding ham ti chanin amapan aseije.
en_web: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
en_kjv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungdei juigot hi A-itih a thilphan aseipoi.

tcz: Thilhet khen themna neihon ngaijuvin kathusei hi, Pathen in chonset abolpoi ti mi jousen ahet ahin, hatchungnungpa chun thil dihlou aboltheipoi.
en_web: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
en_kjv: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Ima hethem nang hon kasei ngai phauvin, Hatchungnung Pathenin thil dihlou abol ngaiyam?

tcz: Aman mihem hi atoh dungjui cheh a lethuhna apeh ji ahin, aman mihemte hi achonna dungjui a alethuh ji ahi.
en_web: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
en_kjv: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin miho atohman apeh cheh a, Achan diu lom achansah ahi.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin Pathen in thil dihlou abol louhel ding ahi. Hatchungnung pa chun thudoh chu aheimang lou ding ahi.
en_web: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
en_kjv: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pathenin itih-in thilse abolpon, Koima adih louvin abol ngaipoi.

tcz: Mihem khat touvin leiset pumpi hi athu noija akoi khah em? Leiset pumpi hi kitup chetna koipen in akoi ham?
en_web: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
en_kjv: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin athaneina hi koi koma apalah ham? Kon Pathen chu vannoi poh theina tha apeh theiyam?

tcz: Pathen chun alhagao ana kinunglah khat tou hihen chuleh ahaina hu chu akinung lah hitaleh,
en_web: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
en_kjv: If he set his heart upon man, If he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mihema konin alhagao kilah hen, Hat theina hu kinung lah kit leh;

tcz: Hinkho jouse kichai ding ahitan, chule mihingte jouse hi leivui soh kit ding ahitai.
en_web: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
en_kjv: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihing jouse thin tin, Leivui lesokit diu ahitai!

tcz: Tun miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, ipi kasei lunglut tah in ngai uvin.
en_web: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
en_kjv: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.
tcz_gospelgo: Miching nahileh Kasei ngaiphan!

tcz: Thudih deilouva Pathen in vai ahom ding ham? Hatchungnungpa thutan hum o nachan ding ham?
en_web: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
en_kjv: Shall even he that hateth right govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dihtah chu mo nachansah a, Thudih ahot banga nagel ham?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile aman leng ho jah a nang hi migilou nahin chuleh milen milal pa komah nanghi langnei nahi tin aseije.
en_web: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
en_kjv: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? And to princes, Ye are ungodly?
tcz_gospelgo: Agitlouva aphatchom lou tengu Pathenin leng ho le vaihomte themmo achansahjie.

tcz: Aman mihem chu itobangin oupe jongle iman agelpon chuleh mivaichapa sangin mihausa pachu akhohsah chompoi, aboncha ama khutsem ahi cheh e.
en_web: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.
en_kjv: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? For they all are the work of his hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin sempa ahijeh-in Pathenin Vaihomte panpia vaichate douna mihao panpi ahipoi.

tcz: Mitphet kah louvin athi theijin, jankim lai teng jongle amangthah jiuvin, mithat hatpa jong chu mihem khat pang louvin akisumang jitai.
en_web: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
en_kjv: In a moment shall they die, And the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: And the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi jan ihmut lan a thi thei. Pathenin aden teng dihlhuh a mangthah thei, Mihat lai lai jong Imacha louhel’a atha thei ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in mihem tehi iti hin ham ti ave jingin, athilbolu amusoh keije.
en_web: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
en_kjv: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, And he seeth all his goings.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mihem kho-lhah Kalson amelchih jinge.

tcz: Migiloupa kiselna ding chun muthim jong ama mitmun kiselna din alhing joupoi.
en_web: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
en_kjv: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonse kiselna din Khojin muthim jong ajingpoi.

tcz: Pathen thutanna'a itih le idin diu ham ti eihon, gonsan ikoi pouve.
en_web: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
en_kjv: For he will not lay upon man more than right; That he should enter into judgment with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih tah le mihem thu atanpeh ding Pathenin phat tep angaipoi.

tcz: Aman mihat pachu koimacha dong louhel in asumang jin, chule ama munna chu adang khat atung doh ji'e.
en_web: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
en_kjv: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, And set others in their stead.
tcz_gospelgo: Lamkaite haisah a akhel diu holna din, Het khel kholtoh khoh angaipoi.

tcz: Aman ipi abol'u ahet ahin, chuleh jan tengle alehkhup in chuleh asumang jitai.
en_web: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
en_kjv: Therefore he knoweth their works, And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mi natoh ahe cheh-in, Jan kah-in akhup athal’in aleh-in asugoijitai.

tcz: Aman agitlou jeh uvin ajeplhu jin mijouse mu thei dingle ima jousen amu theidin abol ji'e.
en_web: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
en_kjv: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;
tcz_gospelgo: Michonsete chu japi mitmun Pathenin ajep cheh jin ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, ama nung ajui nauva konin akihei mangun alampi jeng jong donlouvin akoi tauve.
en_web: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
en_kjv: Because they turned back from him, And would not consider any of his ways:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathen nung ajui tapouvin, Athupeh chengse adonda tauve.

tcz: Amahon mivaichate chu aka sah un, akanau chu Pathen koma alhunge. Pathen in mi gentheite kana ho ajahpeh jin ahi.
en_web: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
en_kjv: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaichate Pathen henga akasah-un, Pathenin ataonau asangin panpi agoi.

tcz: Ahinlah ama chun thipbeh a um ding chu lheng jo tahen lang hileh kon amachu themmo achan thei ding ham? Aman amai aselmang teng mikhat ham ahiloule namkhat hijeng jongle koiman aholdoh joupoi.
en_web: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
en_kjv: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Whether it be done against a nation, Or against a man only:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ima bolda agot teng Kon a-oimo theiyam Akihei mang tengleh Mihemin suhna ding heponte.

tcz: Mihemte thanga a o louna diuvin aman Pathen neiloute vaihomin apansah jipoi.
en_web: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
en_kjv: That the hypocrite reign not, Lest the people be ensnared.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hephaloute achunguva avaihom teng, Namtin vaipin jong alonaje hepouvinte.

tcz: Kachonse tai, ahin chonset bolkit taponge tia mihem ten ipi dinga Pathen koma aseikit jilou u ham?
en_web: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
en_kjv: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
tcz_gospelgo: Job, nachonset jouse Pathen koma naphondoh a, Chonse kit loudia kitep nahitah em?

tcz: Ahiloule ipi thilse kabol kahekha poi neisei peh in thilse kabol aum khah leh tutah hin ngai jeng inge.
en_web: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
en_kjv: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Namona chengse Pathenin navetsah dia nathuma, Thilse bol loudia nom nahitah-em?

tcz: Nathum najeh a chu Pathen in athudih nachu asemphat ding ham? Ijeh inem itile nangin ama chu napaidoh sa ahin, akilhen ding chu nang nahin, kei kahipoi, sei jomin lang nachihna chu keiho komma phong doh in.
en_web: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
en_kjv: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, Whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thilbol bon deilou, Nadei nabolpeh ding kinam nahi nah em? Nathu thu ahi, kei kahipoi; nagel gel seidoh jengin!

tcz: Hicheng jou nungin milungval hon eiseipeh untin chuleh miching hon kathusei ngai uvinte.
en_web: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
en_kjv: Let men of understanding tell me, And let a wise man hearken unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gel thei jouse nomteiyin tin, Kasei ngaiya miching jousen:

tcz: Job in hetoh louva asei ahin, athucheng ho chu agilpoi.
en_web: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
en_kjv: Job hath spoken without knowledge, And his words were without wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Job hin hetoh louva asei ahin, Asei jouse lah thei aumpoi, tinte.

tcz: Job migilou thuseija nathusei jeh a akhonna leh nachung thu kitan ding nakikhol khom ahi.
en_web: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
en_kjv: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end Because of his answers for wicked men.
tcz_gospelgo: Job sei jouse hi geltoh chet’un, Asei jouse hi migilou thusei tobang ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile nangin nachonset na chunga doumah nabol ben, nangin Pathen dounan lunghanna thu nasei lelen, jabolna nanei tapoi.
en_web: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
en_kjv: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, He clappeth his hands amongst us, And multiplieth his words against God.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset besen Pathen doumah abol’in, Imaichanguva Pathen ataitom jenge!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Elihun aseijin:
en_web: Moreover Elihu answered,
en_kjv: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Eluhun aseibe nalaiyin:

tcz: Pathen masanga keima hi chonpha kahi tia sei ding hi dih nakisah ham?
en_web: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
en_kjv: Thinkest thou this to be right, That thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God’s?
tcz_gospelgo: “Job, Pathen angsunga monabeiya Nakisei jeng hi nadihpoi!

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, chonphatna a hinkho aman hi ipi phatchomna kaneijem? Keija dinga phachom ipi um'em? tinjong nasei ji'e.
en_web: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
en_kjv: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? And, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Pathen koma, ‘Kachonset loule ipi phachom a, Kachonset le na—ilou ham?’ nati hi adihpoi.

tcz: Ken nadonbut ing ting chuleh naloi nagolho jousen jong na donbut uhen.
en_web: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
en_kjv: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang jong donbut ing ting, Nagol napaite jong kahouset ding ahi.

tcz: Van thamjol khu ven lang, chule nachung langa meilhang ho khu ven.
en_web: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
en_kjv: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol khu vetemin, Meilhangho khu vena sang thei lheh-e!

tcz: Chonset bol ta le chun Pathen ichan geijin asuna dem? Avel vel in chonse ta le chun ama lungthim ichan gei asukha dem?
en_web: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
en_kjv: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? Or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
tcz_gospelgo: Chonse jongle chun Pathen din ima aloupoi. Thil bol khel jongle chun Pathen asuh khah am?

tcz: Chonphat bol hile chun ama a dinga thilpeh loupi khat ahidem? Ama chu ipi nape tadem?
en_web: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
en_kjv: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thine hand?
tcz_gospelgo: Dih lheh le chun Pathen ahu theiyem? Nanga konin Pathenin imacha angaichapoi.

tcz: Ahipoi nang chonset chun nangma tobang mihem ho chun adoulel ahin, chule nathilpha bol jong chun mihem mama aphatchom pi sah ahi.
en_web: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
en_kjv: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; And thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachonset teng namihem chanpin athoh lel’in, Thilpha nabol leh aphatchompi,

tcz: Mihem techu bol gentheija aum teng ule apeng jah jeng jiuvin, mithahat thaneina noija chun apeng peng jiuve.
en_web: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
en_kjv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: They cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemin bolset ato teng na asauvin, Ahuhhing diu akouvui!

tcz: Jan laileh la a hin saji pa eisempau Pathen chun hoiya umham ti jeng jong nadong kha pouve.
en_web: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
en_kjv: But none saith, Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night;
tcz_gospelgo: Agenthei pettah-uva kinepna pathei ASempau Pathen heng ajonpouve.

tcz: Ganchate sanga hoijo a eisem pau leh chunga leng vachate sanga chingjo a eisem pau chu hoiya umham?
en_web: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
en_kjv: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
tcz_gospelgo: Ju le va, ganhing sanga eichihsah thei Chihna eipeu Pathen heng ajonpouve.

tcz: Chule mihemte chu akiletsah jeh uvin aka teng uleh Pathen in adonbut jipoi.
en_web: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
en_kjv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.
tcz_gospelgo: Agit louva akiletsah jeh-un, Panpi angeh vangun Pathenin adonpouve.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in ajah peh pouvin hatchungnung pa chun ngaisah in aneipoi tia seiding chu dihlou ahi.
en_web: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
en_kjv: Surely God will not hear vanity, Neither will the Almighty regard it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pannabeiya kap a peng nahiuve; Hatchungnung Pathenin ajapon angaipoi.

tcz: Nangin kamu theipoi tin naseije, ahinlah nanga hat le bou thudih chu hungdoh ding ahi.
en_web: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
en_kjv: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, Yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Job, Pathen namuthei louvin seidan, Lung nengtah-in ngah-in a-ang sunga nathu alhungtai.

tcz: Nangin michonse ho chu lunghang in alethuhpoi natin chule migiloute ngaisah in aneipoi tin naseije.
en_web: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,
en_kjv: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; Yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin chonset khohsah louva, Talen amatsah louvin nagel’e.

tcz: Ahinlah Job nangin thu homkeu jeng naseiyin, mingol khat bangin thu naseije.
en_web: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
en_kjv: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Napao pao jong pannabei ahi, Hetoh louva thusei nahi akichentai,” ati.

tcz: Elihu in athusei ajom nalaijin:
en_web: Elihu also continued, and said,
en_kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Elihun aseibe kit nalaiyin:

tcz: Thutah muchet sah ding kanei nahlai jeh in seibe kit nalai inge, ijeh inem itile Pathen thalhenga seiding kanei nalaije.
en_web: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
en_kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee That I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lung nengtah-in kho-ngai jep’in, Pathen thalhenga kasei hi ngaiphan.

tcz: Keiman eisempa chonphatna thu giltah a nelna kapeh ding ahi.
en_web: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
en_kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahetna ajaovin, Eisempa dihje Vetsahnan kahet bangin seiyinge,

tcz: Keima hetna bukim nei kahi jeh in thutah tailou thudang imacha keiman kaseipoi.
en_web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
en_kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: He that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Najah a jou khatcha kaseipoi; Namasanga miching tahbeh namutai.

tcz: Pathen chu hatchungnung pa ahin, ahinlah aman koima isah louvin abolpoi. Ama chu thanei naleh thil hetkhen themna akopto a hatchungnung pa ahi.
en_web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
en_kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength and wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen itihat hitam! Koima anahsahmo pon, Ahet lou thil khatcha aumpoi.

tcz: Aman migilou ahinghoi jipon, ahinlah suhgentheija umho chu them achan ji'e.
en_web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
en_kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: But giveth right to the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonsete ahinghoi ngaipon, Vaichate adih-in abol jinge.

tcz: Aman nolna bei miho a konin amit ahei mang ngaipoi, ahinlah laltouna a leng ho toh atoukhom sah jin chuleh aimatih channa din achoisang ji'e.
en_web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
en_kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings are they on the throne; Yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte ahong jingin, leng bangin vai apohsah-in, Tonsot’in jabol achansahjie.

tcz: Thihkol a ana kihen hihen lang chuleh gentheina a chu kha ana hijong leu,
en_web: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
en_kjv: And if they be bound in fetters, And be holden in cords of affliction;
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla miho achonna dungjuiya Thihkhaova kihen amudoh tengleh,

tcz: Aman akiletsah nau amuchet sah jin, chuleh achonset nau avetsah ji'e.
en_web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
en_kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, And their transgressions that they have exceeded.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin achonsetnau leh Akiletsah nau avetsah jie.

tcz: Alungthim u alahmang peh in, chule thilse a konna akilehei nadiu thupeh apejin ahi.
en_web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
en_kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsea kona akihei mangna diuvin Miho chu agihsal jin ahi.

tcz: Amahon thu ngaiju hen, chuleh athusei ngaipeh ule ahinkho lhum kei uva khantouna jousea phatthei kiboh diu ahi.
en_web: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
en_kjv: If they obey and serve him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thu angaiyuva alhacha apan’u leh, Ahao theiyun along mongui.

tcz: Ahinlah athusei ngai ding anoplou uleh amaho chemjam a kithat ding ahin, chuleh hetna lhahsam jeh a thidiu ahi.
en_web: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
en_kjv: But if they obey not, They shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Achutilou leh khopho louvin athiuvin, Mithigam jonin luipi agalkaiji tauve.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu lunghan nan adimset un, aman a engbol teng u jongle nei kithopiuvin tia kou ding chu anom ji pouve.
en_web: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
en_kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: They cry not when he bindeth them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen heloute chu along hang jingun, Talen amat’u jongle panpi ngaiyin atao pouve.

tcz: Ahinkhou chonchatvai na a aman jou nung uleh khangdong cha chan athijiuvin ahi.
en_web: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
en_kjv: They die in youth, And their life is among the unclean.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdong lai laiyin athiuvin, Mi maiya jumle ja thoh-in aum’ui.

tcz: Ahinlah agenthei thoh jeh u chun aman ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile agenthei nauva kon thungaije ahiljin ahi.
en_web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
en_kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, And openeth their ears in oppression.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vang thoh gimna hi mihil nan amangin, Gentheina hi kho muthei nan amange.

tcz: Job Pathen in vangsetna ho a konin napui doh in lungnat naho a konin ongthol tah in nahoijin, nadokhang chungah anpha pha nalui doh peh e.
en_web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
en_kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin gimna konin napuidoh-in lang mongin nakoiyin, Nadokhang chung neh le chah adimtai.

tcz: Ahinlah nangin Pathen neiloute thu kitan ding kichat nan nadim in, lungkham hih in thutanna leh thudih'a thutanna chu machal jing ding ahi.
en_web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
en_kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold on thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun nachan ding lomin Talen namantai.

tcz: Ahin kivephan, achuti louleh nei le gou vin nalhem lha khantin nehguh kilah jeh in nang leh nang chonse hih in.
en_web: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
en_kjv: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: Then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nehguh jeh alhep chatvaiya naum louna ding, Hao deichat jal’a navamang louna din ching theiyin.

tcz: Nanei leh nagou ahiloule thahattah'a nakihabol naho chun lung gentheina jouse a konna nahoidoh jou ding hinam?
en_web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
en_kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, Nor all the forces of strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi ngaiyin peng jongle chund phachom pontin, Nathahat’in jong ima boldoh peh theiponte.

tcz: Jan hunglhun kal ngahlel hih in, ijeh inem itile hichu mihem te kisuhmang nading jan ahibouve.
en_web: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
en_kjv: Desire not the night, When people are cut off in their place.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi manthahna ding, Jan hung lhun ding kinem hih-in.

tcz: Kiging phan thilse a konin kileheijin, chonsetna hinkho a konna nahoidoh nadinga Pathen in hiche gentheina hohi ahin lhunsah ahi.
en_web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
en_kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse nabol louna dia genthei kithohsah nahi.

tcz: Ven Pathen hi thahat chungnung ahin ama tobang mihil thei ding koi um'em?
en_web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
en_kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: Who teacheth like him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thanei loupije geldoh-in, Ama mihil them chungnungpen ahi.

tcz: Koima chan hichehi nabol ding ahi atitheipon, ahilouleh nabolkhel tai tia seithei ding chu,
en_web: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
en_kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu thilse bol’a moso thei le Abol ding hil masa thei koi ham?

tcz: Hiche ho khel chun athil bolthei thahatna chu achoian un, vahchoina la ho asauve.
en_web: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
en_kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, Which men behold.
tcz_gospelgo: Atohna chung aseiphat aching jingin, Nangin jong navahchoitei ding ahi.

tcz: Gamla tah ahijeng vang'in hiche ho chu mijousen amucheh uve.
en_web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
en_kjv: Every man may see it; Man may behold it afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitinin athilbol amucheh-in, Koiman vang ahejou jaipoi.

tcz: Ven Pathen hi eihon ihet sang uvin aloupi jon amakum ho chu sim jou hilou ahi.
en_web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
en_kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, Neither can the number of his years be searched out.
tcz_gospelgo: Aloupina kihechen joupontin, Akum jong kisim thieponte.

tcz: Aman twi chu ahu in achop touvin chuleh chuti chun alhitheng in go asosah kit e.
en_web: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
en_kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: They pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a kona twi chopdoh a, Gotwiya hinjuhsah kitji Pathen ahi.

tcz: Meilah a konin go ahin sung lhan, chuleh mi jousen aphatchom pi ji'e.
en_web: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
en_kjv: Which the clouds do drop And distil upon man abundantly.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin namtin dia hung ju-lha din, Meilhang lah a konin gotwi ajuhsah-e.

tcz: Meilom hung kijel ji khu kon ahet theija chule vanna vanging kithong jeju a akitol lele khu kon ahetdoh jou ding ham?
en_web: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
en_kjv: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, Or the noise of his tabernacle?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chenna vanpi kinim le Meilhang kitolle koiman ahetheipoi.

tcz: Ven ama kimvel a kolphe khu iti avahsah ji a, chule twikhanglen to geija avahsah khu iti ham?
en_web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
en_kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, And covereth the bottom of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah nan, Twikhanglen lithuh laila athim jing theiye.

tcz: Hiche athahat athil boltheina ho a hi mihem te avah khang ji a nehle chah neng jeng junga apeh ji ahi.
en_web: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
en_kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; He giveth meat in abundance.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi Pathenin mipi avah jinga Neh le chah neng jeng junga apeh ahi.

tcz: Aman akhut in keh chang aki choijin chuleh adoina laitah a chudin aseplha jin ahi.
en_web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
en_kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; And commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhut’in kehchang achoiyin, Adoina mun sepkha din alhai.

tcz: Hiche van gin chun ahina aphondoh a huipi gopi chun alunghan alungsatna chu aphondoh ahi.
en_web: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
en_kjv: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, The cattle also concerning the vapour.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopihui hung ding teng van akinimin, Ganchaten ahung ding aheuve.

tcz: Hicheng hohi kagel ji teng ka lungchang aphudot dot jeng jin, kasung a hin akithing thing jin ahi.
en_web: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
en_kjv: At this also my heart trembleth, And is moved out of his place.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin keijong kalung ling laovin, kalungchang achomdoh deh deh jenge.

tcz: Pathen kamsung'a konna hung doh a ogin thong khu phaten ngai uvin.
en_web: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
en_kjv: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabonchan Pathen ogin khu ngaiyuvin, Akamsunga kon van kinimpi khu!

tcz: Van dung lhungin agin akitol in chuleh kolphe vah'in ningtin asalvah phan ahi.
en_web: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
en_kjv: He directeth it under the whole heaven, And his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset mong langa kon lang khat geiyin, Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah-e.

tcz: Chuti chun huipi gopi kitum gin in alal loupina ogin nasatah in ahung in thu asei teng jongle akituh tang deh poi.
en_web: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
en_kjv: After it a voice roareth: He thundereth with the voice of his excellency; And he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng a-ogin akijan, Van-gin kithong chutoh keh kisep akimui.

tcz: Pathen Ogin chu van gin in aloupisah in athahat aloupina chu eigel phah hoi ahipoi.
en_web: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
en_kjv: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thusah jal’in datmo umtah thil asoh-in, Ihet thei louvu thil kidang asoh-e!

tcz: Aman buhbang leisetna longlha din thu apejin, go jong leiset chunga longlha din thu apeji e.
en_web: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
en_kjv: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; Likewise to the small rain, And to the great rain of his strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga buhbang alhahsah-in, Gobah le gose ajuhsah jin ahi.

tcz: Chuteng leh mijousen anatoh u angan hiti chun athaneina chu ave jiuve.
en_web: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
en_kjv: He sealeth up the hand of every man; That all men may know his work.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen natong jing ahi ahetdohna diuvin, Mihemte natoh avohaijin ahi.

tcz: Gam'a gamsa ho akikhu khum un chuleh akosung uvah aum den ji tauve.
en_web: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
en_kjv: Then the beasts go into dens, And remain in their places.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsa jousen jong abusing Akosung, age na akijot cheh-ui.

tcz: A indan sunga kon in huipi gopi ahungin chuleh hiche a kon chun huidap ahung nunge.
en_web: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
en_kjv: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: And cold out of the north.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhanglama konin khopihui ahung nungin, Sahlama konin phalbi dap hui ahung nunge.

tcz: Pathen hu haikhum chun buhbang lhang asosah in chuin twi chu atebep bep chun akan den sah jin ahi.
en_web: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
en_kjv: By the breath of God frost is given: And the breadth of the waters is straitened.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen nahlai husan twipi amut leh, Twiho chu geltwi asohjie.

tcz: Meiho chu twi akhumdim jin chule kolphen avahsah ji'e.
en_web: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
en_kjv: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: He scattereth his bright cloud:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin meilhang lah ameilom asel’in, Meilom ho apokeh teng kol pheji ahi.

tcz: Ama thusah a meilhang hohi kitol leleuva, leiset chunga hi aman thu apeh jouse aboljiu ahi.
en_web: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
en_kjv: And it is turned round about by his counsels: That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the world in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang ho hi Pathen deiyinakitol len, Vannoi gamtina Pathen lungdei abol’ui.

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi mihem engbolna ham ahiloule tang theilou ngailutna vetsahna a abolji ahi.
en_web: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
en_kjv: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, Or for his land, or for mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chapnou dia Pathenin go ajuhsah ahin, Mihem bolgimna le lungsetna go amanchah thei ahi.

tcz: Job hiche hi phaten ngaijin, Pathen natoh thilbol kidang tah tah ho ngaito din khongaijin.
en_web: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
en_kjv: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chomkhat kho-ngaiyin phaten nagiton-in.

tcz: Itobang tah a Pathen in huipi gopi athua anunsah a chule meilah a konna kolphe ahung vahdoh sah ji hi nahet em?
en_web: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
en_kjv: Dost thou know when God disposed them, And caused the light of his cloud to shine?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin thu apeh a kol aphetsah Hiti ho hi nahet chet mong nah am?

tcz: Akhut themna leh akidanna chamkim keija meilhang ho atolle le ji hi iti dan ham ti nahet doh jou ding ham?
en_web: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
en_kjv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thilbol kidang tah, Vanthamjol’a meilhang kitol dan nahet the-em?

tcz: Nangin na-ul naponna nakitheh tengle lhanglam hui hung nung intin chule thil ijakai thipchet in aum jitai.
en_web: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
en_kjv: How thy garments are warm, When he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
tcz_gospelgo: Lhanglam khohuiyin leiset ahinsem hoh teng Gamsa nathoh lel ding chubou nahei.

tcz: Sum-eng phatvet bangin van thamjolla konin asa chu akikhodoh sah jin ahi, hichu nangin nabol the idem?
en_web: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
en_kjv: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen banga nangin vanthamjol Phatvet banga dumje ju khu najamdoh theiyam?

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen komma ipi kasei diu ham? Keihon imacha hetna kanei pouve.
en_web: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
en_kjv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; For we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthima ima kicop pouvin sei idng kaneipouve. Pathenkoma kasei diu neihil’un.

tcz: Pathen in akomma thu kasei nom hi eihet peh dem? Mihem te jengin jong thil ahetkhen theilou teng ule thu akisei thei diu ham?
en_web: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
en_kjv: Shall it be told him that I speak? If a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen to kihou ding ka-ngap chapoi, I-bol’a kakisuhmangsah ding ham?

tcz: Huijin meibolho amut theng soh tengleh vantham jol'a nisa khu avah behseh jeh in eihon ive thei ji pouve.
en_web: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
en_kjv: And now men see not the bright light Which is in the clouds: But the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol avah behseh-in kave-ngampouve, Khopihuiyin amut thengsel’e.

tcz: Pathen hi molsang a konna sana lal loupina a kijemma hung'ah ahin ama chu alal loupina leh ahoina jousea kijemma ahi.
en_web: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
en_kjv: Fair weather cometh out of the north: With God is terrible majesty.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahlama sana vah chansel bangin akimun, Tijat umtah Pathen loupina vah chun eisalvah-ui.

tcz: Hatchungnungpa thahat naho chu ei ngaito phah hoi hilou ahi. Ahijeng vang'in athudih in chuleh achonpha jinge. Aman eiho eisumang pouve.
en_web: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
en_kjv: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, And in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thahat anasan kanai ngampouve, Adih-in thudih jengin mi abol’e.

tcz: Datmo umtah in muntinna mihem ten ama aging uvin, miching ho jouse ajanau avetsah uve.
en_web: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
en_kjv: Men do therefore fear him: He respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitinin agin cheh ding mong ahi, Kichihsah ho vang iman agelpoi,” ati.

tcz: Chuti chun chimpei kipei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job chu ahin donbut tai:
en_web: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
en_kjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Khopihui chimpei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job ahindonbut’e:

tcz: Koi hiya hitobang hetna neilou chu chenga kachihna thu hin donga chu?
en_web: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
en_kjv: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?
tcz_gospelgo: “Kichihna song lel nang koi nahiya, Khopho louva thu hijat sei nahim?

tcz: Pasal pha bangin nakong kigah in, ijeh inem itile keiman nangma thu kadoh ding nangin hiche ho chu nei donbut ding ahi.
en_web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
en_kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal nahileh dingdoh-in, kadoh chan neidonbut ding ahi.

tcz: Leiset bul kaphu a chu hoiya nana um'em? Nahet leh nei seipeh in.
en_web: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
en_kjv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi kasemdoh a chu naum am? Hijatpi nahet leh neiseipeh temin!

tcz: Kon alet aneu dan aga te a chuleh ageigol hohi akaitoh ham?
en_web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
en_kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who hath stretched the line upon it?
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi itea sem ding kon aboltoh a, Kon atetoh ham nahet le seiyin!

tcz: Abul hi ipin atheh ham? Aninga songpi chu koi koiham?
en_web: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
en_kjv: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner stone thereof;
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset khonpiho ipi chunga kitunga, Vannoi bulpi ning songkhom koi phu ham?

tcz: Jingvalpa ten la asahkhom uva chuleh vantil jouse kipah a hung pengdoh diu ham?
en_web: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
en_kjv: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuche ni jinglah chun ahsi ten la asauvin, Van miten kipah-in asem’ui.

tcz: Naobu sunga hung pengdoh banga twipihi gamgi chin kah khat sunga kon akoija?
en_web: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
en_kjv: Or who shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen twipi akoa kona alonjal ding teng Akotpi kamkhuma ting bingjia koi ham?

tcz: Chuleh meibol ponsilla kakisil a chuleh muthim lhangkhal a kakitoma,
en_web: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
en_kjv: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddling band for it,
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen meilhanga tomjol a, Muthim lhangkhal a sel chu Kei kahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu vapam kasem peh a, anunga kotpi akhel louna dinga kakam khum ahi.
en_web: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
en_kjv: And brake up for it my decreed place, And set bars and doors,
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen gamgi kasempeh-in, Kulpi kot kakam khumtai.

tcz: Hichan a gamla chule hisanga gamlajo a nahung louna dinga hiche mun a hi kiloupi sah tah a nakinon nangah ding ahi tin kaseije.
en_web: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
en_kjv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Hichan gei hin veiyin lang, Hichan a bou natwidil ka-nga ding,’ katipeh-e.

tcz: Jingkah khovah nadinga thu napeh khah a khovah jong solama konna hung kipan dinga nahil khah em?
en_web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
en_kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; And caused the dayspring to know his place;
tcz_gospelgo: Job, mahinkho sunga hi Nikhat beh jong jinglah khovah dia naseipeh-em?

tcz: Khovah hin leiset kolmang geija asalvah nadinga nasema, gitlouna jan muthim changei bou vah dinga nasem khah em?
en_web: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
en_kjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, That the wicked might be shaken out of it?
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset pumpia kho vahsah a, Migiloute kiselna muna deldoh dia naseipeh khah am?

tcz: Khovah ahung nai tengle leingan chunga mahor kinam bangin leiset jong agong ahung kilang doh jitai.
en_web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
en_kjv: It is turned as clay to the seal; And they stand as a garment.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun khovah hin mol le lhang akimun, Ponsil kijal bang le leingan a mohor kinam bangin akimui.

tcz: Khovah hin migiloute asunoh phah in chuleh kihat sah tah a kidom sang ban lhang jong asuhai tai.
en_web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
en_kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm shall be broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Sunlai khovah hi migiloute din akichen behseh-in, Pumhat change thilbol angampouve.

tcz: Twipi hung lon doh patna twinah phung nagahol doh khah a hem? athuh dan nakhol doh khah hitam?
en_web: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
en_kjv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen laigil twisam putna nache khah a, Twikanglen tonoi lama navale khah tah-em?

tcz: Thina kelkot hoiya um'em ti nahet khah ta hem? Muthim lhangkhal kihehna kelkot namu khah ta hem?
en_web: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
en_kjv: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? Or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigam mithikhul kotpi Kelkot pung dung navetsah tah-uvem?

tcz: Leiset letdan nagel doh khah a hicheng chu nahet leh nei seipeh in.
en_web: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
en_kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? Declare if thou knowest it all.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi hi ite pham? Nahet leh neiseipeh-in.

tcz: Khovah hoiya konna hung kipan doh ham? Chuleh muthim hoilanga cheji hitam?
en_web: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
en_kjv: Where is the way where light dwelleth? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
tcz_gospelgo: Hoiya kona kho hungvah a, Muthim kipatna bulpi nahet-em?

tcz: Khat cheng chenga a in na napuilut theija chuleh amun lhunje chu nahet em?
en_web: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
en_kjv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
tcz_gospelgo: I-chan geiya nasol theiya, Nalesol kit thei ding ham?

tcz: Ahinlah hicheng chu nahet maithei ahi, ijeh inem itile thil ijakai kisem masanga penga nahi tan, hijeh a chu ijakai nahet themsoh ahitai.
en_web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
en_kjv: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? Or because the number of thy days is great?
tcz_gospelgo: Vanno kisemdoh a bon anaumta a, Hibanga upate bol theiteiyin nate!

tcz: Buhbang kikhol khomna mun naga chelut khah ta hem? ahiloule gelchang kikhol khomna mun naga mu khah ta hem?
en_web: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
en_kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
tcz_gospelgo: Buhbang le gelchang kakholna Hiche kikholna chu namu khah tah-em?

tcz: Genthei hesoh nikho a gal manchah dinga kakhol ahin, kidou nikho leh kisat nikho a dinga kakhol khom ahi.
en_web: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
en_kjv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?
tcz_gospelgo: Gim hesoh ni le gal nikhoa Manchah dia kakhol khom ahi.

tcz: Khovah hung kondohna lampi chu hoilai hija, solam hui chenna chu hoilai ham?
en_web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
en_kjv: By what way is the light parted, Which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa hung konna nagavet khah a, Solam khohui hung nun patna navet khah hitam?

tcz: Go hattah a hung long jung jung twilam chu kon asemma kolphevahna lampi kon adopeh ham?
en_web: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
en_kjv: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, Or a way for the lightning of thunder;
tcz_gospelgo: Gotwi lonna ding kon asempeh a, Kehchang lhahna ding lampi kon asem ham?

tcz: Hampa ke louna gamgo lah leh nelgam mihem chenlouna gam'a chu kon go ajuhsah ham?
en_web: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
en_kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem chenna louhel nelgam geiya Go juhsah jing thei koi ham?

tcz: Tolgo lah sunouva dangchim sah dinga go juh sah chu koi hija chule hampa louhing kedohsah a koiham?
en_web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
en_kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; And to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
tcz_gospelgo: Hampa louhing hin theina dia Tolgo lah chapnouna dia go juhsah koi ham?

tcz: Go in pa aneijem? Daitwi kon ahin pen doh sah ham?
en_web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
en_kjv: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
tcz_gospelgo: Geltwi le daitwi hin Ahinga Pa anei ngap lhon ham?

tcz: Buhbang lhang hingnu chu koiham? Vanna hung kon buhbang twihi kon ahin ham?
en_web: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
en_kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
tcz_gospelgo: Geltwi le daibang Hinga anu lhon koiham?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile twi chu song banga tah in akisoh jin chuleh twi chung chu akan den jin ahi.
en_web: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
en_kjv: The waters are hid as with a stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.
tcz_gospelgo: Geltwi le daibangin twi chu song asosah-in, Twikhanglen chunga akidalsah jie.

tcz: Ahshi ho kitol ding dan khu nahil theija bombiel akoi ho khu alomma nakan theija, ahiloule juhei suhtum khu akhau nalhap kang thei ngaijem?
en_web: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
en_kjv: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahsi bombel ho khu nakan gom theiya, Ngambom lungthu ahsi khu nalhap kang theiyam?

tcz: Kum kiheichin hohi aban ban cha che dinga nahil theija ahiloule ahsi somleng chu anoute toh van jotpai dinga napuile theijem?
en_web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
en_kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? Or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
tcz_gospelgo: Kum kiheichin hetna dia ahsi nalamkai theiya, Ngambom uichal ahsi len le neo nahil thieyam?

tcz: Thilsem jouse chondan hi nahet soh keija, leiset hi dan dungjuija naman chah thei ding ham?
en_web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
en_kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? Canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a kimang Danho nahet’a, Hiche Dan ho hi leiset’a naman theiyam?

tcz: Meibang lom chu nakouva chule go nasosah theijem?
en_web: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
en_kjv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang ho nahohsal theiya, Twi napehna dia nakou lhah theiyam?

tcz: Kolphe chu nakilah sah theija chule naseina mun chu navah sah thei ding ham?
en_web: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
en_kjv: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?
tcz_gospelgo: Kol naphetsah thei leh Najah a, ‘Nathun kanunge,’ ati ding hinam?

tcz: Lungchang thil het jeng theina pea chu koi hija chule lungthim angaina a khohetna pe a chu koiham?
en_web: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
en_kjv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the heart?
tcz_gospelgo: Nile vadung twilet ding vachate seipeh koi hiya, Gojuh ding ahchal hilmasa koiham?

tcz: Meilhang ho sim jouna dinga chihna lhingsetna neikoi hija, vanna twi kikholna mun loukhoija khoilet jou ding koiham?
en_web: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
en_kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? Or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang simna theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya choh chamthei,

tcz: Tolla leiset hi akikoi got setna chule leiset chu leilhanga atahsah thei ding ham?
en_web: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
en_kjv: When the dust groweth into hardness, And the clods cleave fast together?
tcz_gospelgo: Gotwi chu leivui chapnou sah a, Bon ngan sosah thei koiham?

tcz: Keipi dinga neh ding namat khom peh a chule keipi bahkai noute gilkel chu alung nachim a navahva jouva,
en_web: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
en_kjv: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? Or fill the appetite of the young lions,
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei te ding neh le chah namupeh a, Sakeinou gilkelte navahna khah em?

tcz: Akosung uva alupnauva ahiloule nang noija abohmat pet tengule,
en_web: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
en_kjv: When they couch in their dens, And abide in the covert to lie in wait?
tcz_gospelgo: Akosunga akisel’uva, Akhuh sunga an anga tengu leh!

tcz: Vavomte khu kon an apeh a anoute khu Pathen jah dinga apenna chule gilkella amoh toilele tenguleh kon an apeh jiu ham?
en_web: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
en_kjv: Who provideth for the raven his food? When his young ones cry unto God, They wander for lack of meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Va-ahte gilkel nahol teng vahva koi hiya, Anouten an athum teng pejia koiham?

tcz: Gamkel ho khun itih phat le nou anei jiuvem ti nahet em? sajuh ho gam lah a aso u khu namu khah tah em?
en_web: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
en_kjv: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
tcz_gospelgo: Lhangvuma kolsa nou so phat nahet’a, Sakhi nou so phat nahet-em?

tcz: Lha ijat gai uvem ti nahet khah em? itih phat le soh diu ham ti nahet em?
en_web: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
en_kjv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
tcz_gospelgo: Itih chan nou akolpi nahet’a, Anouso ding phat nahet-em?

tcz: Anou neina dingin tolla aboh mat jiuvin chule ason chu ahing doh jiuve.
en_web: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
en_kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, They cast out their sorrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih tah leh kol’uva Nousoh diu nahet hinam?

tcz: Anou ho chu tollhanga akivah khang jiuvin chuti chun achennau adalhah teng ahung kinungle ji tapouve.
en_web: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
en_kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; They go forth, and return not unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamlah a anoute akhangdoh-un, Avah mangun ahung kile kitji pouve.

tcz: Gamlah sangan khu kon chamlhatna apeh a chule akihenna khao kon alhap peh ham?
en_web: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
en_kjv: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
tcz_gospelgo: Koiham gam sa-ngante jalensah a, Lhathanga vathangsah a khu?

tcz: Gamthip lah hi amaho umna dinga kapeh ahin achenna diuvin hamhing ke louna gam kepei.
en_web: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
en_kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, And the barren land his dwellings.
tcz_gospelgo: Gammang lah a chensah a, Chikhuh dunga lhatsah a Kei kahi!

tcz: Khopi sung husa atheinom pon chuleh ahohsal diu kangtalai tol jong aumpoi.
en_web: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
en_kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, Neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi husa kijah phah louna aum’un, Koiman vah a natohsah din ajoupoi.

tcz: Molsang lah chu akivahnau mun ahin, hamhing don thah jouse ahol lelei.
en_web: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.
en_kjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhang sang dunga alhauvin, Neh din hamhing dum ahol leuve.

tcz: Gamlah bongchal chu vahngoi din anop peh dem? Nagancha an koina huong sunga chun jan khat beh aum nadem?
en_web: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
en_kjv: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, Or abide by thy crib?
tcz_gospelgo: Gambong chal’in na natohpeh theiya, Nabongbuh a geh mong nam?

tcz: Gam bong chu naloukhoi nalang konna chu nakhum theija nalou nakhoipeh ding hinam?
en_web: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
en_kjv: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Khao nakhia lou nakaisah a, Naloulaiya langkon nakaisah theiyam?

tcz: Athahat na chu eipente ti natahsan em? nadalhah a chule nana natoh peh ding chu natahsan em?
en_web: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
en_kjv: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
tcz_gospelgo: Bongchal thahat nason a Na hahsa natohpeh ding naginchat am?

tcz: Nachang in langa po dinga nanganse ding ham? Chuleh na changphol a konna chang nahin pohpeh ding hinam?
en_web: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
en_kjv: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather it into thy barn?
tcz_gospelgo: Changphal nalo khom peh a Cahngphol a nakaipeh dia nagel ham?

tcz: Vangongchai jin alha ahin jap jin ahinlah nachakang toh tekah thei ahipoi.
en_web: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
en_kjv: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? Or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
tcz_gospelgo: Va-ngonsaovin lha ijatvei ajap’a, Patva len alengthei nam?

tcz: Vangongchaijin atwi leiset chunga atha jin leivui khun akahlum dinga akoiji ahi.
en_web: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
en_kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, And warmeth them in dust,
tcz_gospelgo: Va-ngongsaovin tol’a tui aop’in, Leihu ahulsat sah theiye.

tcz: Thilkhat touvin akengin chonkeh inte ahiloule gamsa khattouvin sumathah inte tijong agelpoi.
en_web: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
en_kjv: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may break them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ikhat’in achotkeh peh ding ahephapon, Gamsan aholgoi peh thei jong ahepoi.

tcz: Anoute chunga jong a engse lheh jengin ama a hilou bang bangin athi diu jong khoh asapoi.
en_web: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
en_kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: Her labour is in vain without fear;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama tui lou bangin agel’in, Hahsa tah a athah lhah jong khohsah lou bangin aum’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in ama a konna chihna alahdoh peh a, thil hetkhen theina apehlou ahi.
en_web: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
en_kjv: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Hibanga ngolsah a Chihsah lou chu Kei kahi.

tcz: Ahinlah itih phat hijongle lhai dinga ahung chopdoh phat phat uleh sakol lhaihat pen pen jong achunga toupa toh adalha tha jitai.
en_web: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
en_kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla adin janga kithinga alhai leh, Sakol adeljamin achunga toupa geiyin akichai!

tcz: Sakol thahat khu nangin napeh hija ahiloule angonga amul bahkai khu nangin nakesah ham?
en_web: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
en_kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? Hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
tcz_gospelgo: Hibanga sakol hatsah a, Angongmul bah kesah hi nang nahim Job?

tcz: Khaokhopi kichop thei banga akichop theina khu nangin napeh ham? Anah khon gin khu tijat jat aum jenge.
en_web: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
en_kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? The glory of his nostrils is terrible.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolte khaokhopi chop a chopsah a, Nah khon gin hamdeldul sah hi nang nahim?

tcz: Galsat dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle atin in leiset akhot in athahat in akipah jin ahi.
en_web: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
en_kjv: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength. He goeth on to meet the armed men.
tcz_gospelgo: Phaicham tolgo akhot’in, Galmun thal le teng lah anolut jeng jie.

tcz: Chemjam masanga ajam pon, kichat kiti chu anuisat in chuleh kichatna aneipoi.
en_web: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
en_kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; Neither turneth he back from the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichat tijat ahepouvin, Chemjam masanga gingdan ahipouve.

tcz: Thalchang amalam ngan aleng jeng jung in, chuleh tengcha leh tenglung aval lah lah jenge.
en_web: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
en_kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, The glittering spear and the shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakol chung touho gal manchah Thal le tengkol nisan akhoval lah lah-e!

tcz: Lunghang tah in akengtin in tol akhot jal lah lah in chule kelngoi ki ahung kimut ging phat in galmun manon alhaikit jitai.
en_web: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
en_kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: Neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung hangtah-in sakolten maanouvin, Sumkon kimut teng adding thim theipouve.

tcz: Saki kimut gin chun anah akhongin gamla tah a konin gal gimnam ajan, gal kisat gin thong leh captian pa thupeh ngah in akinuh nuh jenge.
en_web: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
en_kjv: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumkon gin chai tengleh ahamin, Galmun aphah masangin Galvui nam ajan, Gal lamkaiten mano dia Lhang asap’u ajauve.

tcz: Mu khu nangin nachihna a nahilla vanlama sangtah'a lengle le a chule alhaving teni khu lhanglam nga ajah ji ham?
en_web: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
en_kjv: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, And stretch her wings toward the south?
tcz_gospelgo: Mu khu lenje nahil hiya, Lhanglam nga leng thei ham?

tcz: Muvanlai sangtah'a alentouva chunglang peh a buh asah khu nangin nepeh ham?
en_web: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
en_kjv: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, And make her nest on high?
tcz_gospelgo: Muvanlai khu molvum sang laiya Bu asahna dinga nang thupeh anga ham?

tcz: Kolsong chunga achengin gamlatah songkuo hoa chenna in akiseme.
en_web: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.
en_kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, Upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi vum a bu akisen, Songpi khi kah chu kulpin aneiye.

tcz: Hiche a konhin aneh ding sahing akihol in mitchim keuvin avelhi jingin ahi.
en_web: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
en_kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, And her eyes behold afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi chunga konin gamtin aven, Ganhing thaa neh ding ave-lhi.

tcz: Anouten thisan achop chop un gancha thikam umna hiche munna chu ama namu ding ahi.
en_web: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
en_kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are, there is she.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilong phunga muthong akikhomun, Anoute thisan achop’ui,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Job komma aseijin:
en_web: Moreover the LORD answered Job,
en_kjv: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Job jah a aseitei:

tcz: Hatchungnungpa chu nakinelpi nom nah laijam? Pathen thutan dihlouna podohpa nahin, ahileh donbutna ding nanei nahlai em?
en_web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
en_kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? He that reproveth God, let him answer it.
tcz_gospelgo: “Job, Nangin Hatchungnung Pathen nachouve, Na-ngah didng ham ahiloule nadonbut ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Job in Pakai chu adonbut in,
en_web: Then Job answered the LORD,
en_kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: “Ka-ngol thu kasei ahitai Pakai, Ipia kadonbut thei nah lai ding ham?

tcz: Keima ima hilou kahi, adonbutna ding chu iti kaholdoh jou ding ham? Kakhut in kamuh kisip ing katin,
en_web: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
en_kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ima ma jong keiman Seida tang’e!

tcz: Thu tamtah kaseidoh ahitan, seibe ding kanei tapoi.
en_web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
en_kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: Yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei ding abonchan kaseisoh tai, Velsei kit taponge,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Pakaiyin chimpei lah a kon in Job ahin donbut in,
en_web: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:
en_kjv: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun huipi le gopi, chule chimpei lah akonin Pakaiyin Job jah a ahinseiyin:

tcz: Pasal phatah bangin nakong kigah in, keiman nangma doh ding thudoh themkhat kaneijin, chuleh nangin hiche ho chu nadonbut ding ahi.
en_web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
en_kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pasal nahileh dinginkadoh chengse neidonbut’in.

tcz: Kathutan dihna hi tahsan louva nakoija, chule nangma dihna photchetna dinga kei themmo neichan joh ding ham?
en_web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
en_kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
tcz_gospelgo: Kei hi moso ding neigot’a, Nang kithemsah a Kei mosah neigot ham?

tcz: Pathen banga thahat nahin, Pathen ogin banga nangin van nagin sah thei ding ham?
en_web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
en_kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? Or, canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
tcz_gospelgo: Kei banga nahat am? Kei banga na-oginin van akithisah jouvam?

tcz: Aphai naloupina leh nagun chenan kivon in lang, ja naumna leh aming than nan kivon temin.
en_web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
en_kjv: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; And array thyself with glory and beauty.
tcz_gospelgo: Najo leh, kilsetsah le gunche tah-in dingin, Minthangna le loupe nan kivontemin.

tcz: Nalung hanna ngoh ding hol in lang, mikiletsah teho jouse chunga chuhen.
en_web: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
en_kjv: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: And behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kiletsahte khu ven lang, Lung hankhumin su-lha temin.

tcz: Mikiletsah techu namit hei chun jachat sah in lang, migiloute chu adin nauva chun chot phan.
en_web: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
en_kjv: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked in their place.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahi, ven lang loilhu, Migiloute adin muna noigep’in.

tcz: Leivui lah a chun vui in lang, amaho chu mithigam songkul'a hunk hum den tan.
en_web: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
en_kjv: Hide them in the dust together; And bind their faces in secret.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a vuimangin lang, Mithigam a kanchahsan koiyin.

tcz: Chutia chu kei jengin jong kapachat ding nahi, ijeh inem itile nabangol thahat chun nahuhuhdoh ahitai.
en_web: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
en_kjv: Then will I also confess unto thee That thine own right hand can save thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Ken pahcha masapen ing ting, Najona thu sei masa pen inge.

tcz: Behemoth khu vetemin, nang kasem banga kasem ahin, bongchal bangin hampa ane e.
en_web: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
en_kjv: Behold now behemoth, Which I made with thee; He eateth grass as an ox.
tcz_gospelgo: Behemoth twisai khu vetemin, Ama jong nang jong kasem cheh ahin, aman bong bangin hampa anei.

tcz: Akengphang athahat nale, a oipoh a aphe ho khu ven.
en_web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
en_kjv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the navel of his belly.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsa khi ichan geiya hat, Aphe avouva itobang thahat kisel ham!

tcz: Amei jong khu Cedar thing bangin atah in, akhel teni a aphe ho khu detchet a kipheh khomahi.
en_web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
en_kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his stones are wrapt together.
tcz_gospelgo: Amei atun teng cedar thing tobang ahin, Amalphe ho jong atah cheh chuh jenge.

tcz: Agu ho jong sum-eng long abangin atibah ho jong thihjol tobang ahi.
en_web: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
en_kjv: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; His bones are like bars of iron.
tcz_gospelgo: Agu aching jouse sum-eng tobang ahin, Akeng ho la thiljol abange.

tcz: Pathen khutsem ho lah a vetkah theipen ahin, chuleh asempa bouvin agihsal thei ahi.
en_web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
