en_kjv: He is the chief of the ways of God: He that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathilsem lah a datmo umpen, Asempa Kenbou kajouve!

tcz: Gam'a gamsa jouse lhatle namun hiche molsang hohin amaho dinga anneh phapen pen chu apeh nom u ahi.
en_web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
en_kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field play.
tcz_gospelgo: Hamhingin kavah khangin, Thinglhang gamsa lah a alhai,

tcz: Thambal pahcha phung noija chun akol jin, pengphung boh lah a akisel jin ahi.
en_web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
en_kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, In the covert of the reed, and fens.
tcz_gospelgo: Lingnang noi dunga akol jin, Si lah a pumpeng lah a akiseljie.

tcz: Vadung pang thingnem ho lah a pahcha phungho chu amadin lim in apange.
en_web: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
en_kjv: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; The willows of the brook compass him about.
tcz_gospelgo: Lingnangho le luipanga huisum phung ho hi Ama din limin apangui.

tcz: Vadung twisoh in ama asunoh phah pon, Jordan vadung soh hen lang chup jongle alungkham deh poi.
en_web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
en_kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: He trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung soh jongle aging ppon, Jordan luipi soh jongle iman agelpoi.

tcz: Koima chan amandoh joupoi, ahiloule anah avu a, thihkol abu peh a chuleh akaimang theilou ahi.
en_web: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
en_kjv: He taketh it with his eyes: His nose pierceth through snares.
tcz_gospelgo: Koipen hin amit chotsah a amat theiya, Nah vupeh a nahkhao avopeh ding ham?

tcz: Ngakoija Leviathan namat thei ding ham? Ahiloule aha a khaokol nabu peh thei ding ham?
en_web: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
en_kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a hook? Or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
tcz_gospelgo: Leviathan khu ngakoiya nakoidoh theiya, Alei khu khaova nakan theiyam?

tcz: Anahhom sunga khao nathil lut theija, ahiloule akhalhang thihhem a nasut vang thei ding ham?
en_web: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
en_kjv: Canst thou put a hook into his nose? Or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
tcz_gospelgo: Anah hom sunga khao nathil lut theiya, Akhanoi jong thihtul’a nadotvang theiyam?

tcz: Nakhoto ding ngeh na a, hung taova ahiloule nalainat pi dinga hung tao tuntun nam?
en_web: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
en_kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Will he speak soft words unto thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhadohna dia nahenga taova, Nahepina dia nakoma tao ding ham?

tcz: Ahinkho a nasoh a panga nanatong dinga nanop peh ding hinam?
en_web: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
en_kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? Wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakoma kitep’a aitih a nakinbol dia Kinoptona abol dia nagel ham?

tcz: Nangin hiche khu vacha banga nangailut bol thei hiya, ahiloule nachapang neunu kichepna dinga napeh thei ding ham?
en_web: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
en_kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
tcz_gospelgo: Vacha banga nakhi theiya, Nalhacha nu-ngah ho kichepna napeh thei ham?

tcz: Kivei mihon athiljoh nau mun ho a joh dinga ahung kichoh diu hinam?
en_web: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
en_kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? Shall they part him among the merchants?
tcz_gospelgo: Nga manhon aman jat kidehna aneiyuva, Kiveihon joh dia ahoptel diu ham?

tcz: Avun khu tengcha a nasut khah theija, ahiloule aluchang ngathal a nakap khah thei ding ham?
en_web: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
en_kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish spears?
tcz_gospelgo: Alip khu ngatenga nasut theiya, Aluchang khu tenghema nasut thei ham?

tcz: Achunga nakhut ngam in lang hile chun kidounan ahin jui ding khu geldoh in natin, avel a nabol patep kit lou hel ding ahitai.
en_web: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
en_kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, Remember the battle, do no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaphin patep’in, bol kit ngampon nate; Kisatpi kit nom hih hel’in nate.

tcz: Ahipoi hiche mat ding got chu phatchomna bei ahin, sadel hatpa thiltup jong chu kisuhnem peh ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
en_kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
tcz_gospelgo: Leviathan mit a mu mai main jong Kinlih leova tol’a kisep lhu jeng ahi.

tcz: Chuleh a itih a koima chan asuhnoh phah ngamlou ahin, koiham kamasanga ding ngam ding chu.
en_web: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
en_kjv: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: Who then is able to stand before me?
tcz_gospelgo: Akiphin hang teng akhoh a khoh, Koima kithahna ngam ahipoi.

tcz: Kangaichat pet tah a kalepeh kit ding thil eipe chu koi ham? Vannoija thil umjouse hi keija ahi.
en_web: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
en_kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
tcz_gospelgo: Levithan kisatpia ahoidoh aumpon, Vannoi mi koiman thajou ponte.

tcz: Leviathan tibah ho hoidan chuleh athahat oupe dan chule agongso hoidan ho kasei nomme.
en_web: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
en_kjv: I will not conceal his parts, Nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
tcz_gospelgo: Leviathan keng let dan le hatdan Naseipeh ing kate.

tcz: Avun khu kon alahdoh peh theija chule athoa um agalvon khu kon amulet pai thei ding ham?
en_web: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
en_kjv: Who can discover the face of his garment? Or who can come to him with his double bridle?
tcz_gospelgo: Athivun jeng jong koiman sukoh joulou, Aopvun jong kisunvang thei lou ahi.

tcz: Akhalhang khu kon akal keh a ahondoh ding ham? Ajeh chu aha khu tijat jat um behseh jeng ahi.
en_web: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
en_kjv: Who can open the doors of his face? His teeth are terrible round about.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahatu chalset sot khubang khu Kon akam akeh peh jou ding ham?

tcz: Alip ho chu pho banga agol gol a detchet a mahor kinam banga thakhat'a kinam detchet ahi.
en_web: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
en_kjv: His scales are his pride, Shut up together as with a close seal.
tcz_gospelgo: Atungtun vun la lumpho tobang ahin, Kimatsoh keiya songtum tobang ahi.

tcz: Kimatchet a umkhom ahijeh chun akah a hui jangkhat cha jong alut theipoi.
en_web: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
en_kjv: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.
tcz_gospelgo: Alip jouse akijopmat soh keiyin, Alipkah a heojang cha jong lut theilou ahi.

tcz: Alip khat chu aban'a alip chunga hub eh detchet a, khat leh khat kikam toa kimulet pai theilou ahi.
en_web: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
en_kjv: They are joined one to another, They stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
tcz_gospelgo: Alip jouse akikilmat cheh-in, Imachan abokhen theidol ahipoi.

tcz: Anah akhon tengle avahlap lap jengin, amitchang teni jong jingkah nichangsat pet toh abange.
en_web: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
en_kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
tcz_gospelgo: Anahhai teng meisi apahlah lah-in, Amitchang teni ma ninousoh tobang ahi.

tcz: Akamsunga konin meisi apahlah lah jin, meikou ahung vahdoh ji'e.
en_web: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
en_kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, And sparks of fire leap out.
tcz_gospelgo: Akamsunga meisi apah lah lah jengin, Meisi ahung kithotdoh jeng junge!

tcz: Meichunga twibel kisonga, twihu pot bangin anahhomma konin meikhu ahung kitung doh ji'e.
en_web: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
en_kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, As out of a seething pot or caldron.
tcz_gospelgo: Anahhom sunga meikhu akitunglet lut’in, Beltoa tumbo kilhut khu abang jenge.

tcz: Akamsunga konna meikou alendoh ji jeh chun, ahai husa chun meihol ahal kou jeng jin ahi.
en_web: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
en_kjv: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth out of his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahai leh meikouvin alengin, Akamsunga mei akouve!

tcz: Leviathan ngongchang thahatna chun chene jouse a kichat tijatna asosah e.
en_web: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
en_kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, And sorrow is turned into joy before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Alolchang atahbel bul’in, Akitopi akinlih deh deh-ui.

tcz: Aphe ho chu atah in chuleh adetchet in, akimulet thei poi.
en_web: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
en_kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Avun la anemkom abeihel’in, Thihjol hekon lel hel abange.

tcz: Alungchang chu song bangin atah in sumhei song bangin atah e.
en_web: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
en_kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
tcz_gospelgo: Gin beihel’in alungchang tah-in, Sumhei song tah-in atah-e.

tcz: Ahung kithodoh tengle thahat chungnung ho akicha jiuvin, kichat tijatnan amanchah kheh jin ahi.
en_web: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
en_kjv: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: By reason of breakings they purify themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Adindoh teng mihat tah tah jong akichan, Kichat’a thigam pai diu ahi.

tcz: Chemjam, tengcha, thalchang ahiloule tengcha neoho khat chan asutang joupoi.
en_web: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
en_kjv: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: The spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
tcz_gospelgo: Asatbut ding chemjamla aumpon, Tengcha hihen thalchang hileh asunbut ding aumpoi.

tcz: Chutah chun Job in Pakai chu adonbut tai.
en_web: Then Job answered the LORD:
en_kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in Pakai adonbut’in aseitai:

tcz: Thil ijakai bolthei nahi naleh, nanatoh koiman nasuh tang theilou chu keiman kahei.
en_web: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
en_kjv: I know that thou canst do every thing, And that no thought can be withholden from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thaneipen nahi kahei Pakai! Nangin nadeichan nabol theiye!

tcz: Thil hetkhen theina beija kathil hetkhen theina dongpa chu koiham? Tin nei donge. Hichepa chu kei kahi. Chule keiman kahet khah louhel thu kana sei kha tai.
en_web: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
en_kjv: Who is he that hideth counsel Without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that I understood not; Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopholou ken Nang chihna Iti kasonlel ding ham? Kahet chet lou jeng kaseitan, Het dia nasaval ahi kei din!

tcz: Ngaijin keiman nasei peh inge. Keiman nangma thu kadoh a chuleh nangin nei donbut ding ahi.
en_web: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
en_kjv: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei sunga ka-ngai din neihil’in, Neidoh ho kadonbut din naseiye!

tcz: Masanga chu nangma hi athu a bou kana jah tho ahin, ahinlah tun vang kamit tah in kamutai.
en_web: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
en_kjv: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: But now mine eye seeth thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla midangin eihil bep bou kahen, Tun vang kamit tah-in kamutai!

tcz: Kana thusei jouse kageldoh sohkei tai. Chuleh keima kakisih taiti vetsahnan, leivui leh vutvam lah a hin katouve.
en_web: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
en_kjv: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent In dust and ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei jouse kakijapin, Leivui le vutvam tobang hin lung kaheitai!” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin thu hijatpi hi Job koma asei nungin Teman mipa Eliphaz komah aseitai. Nangma leh nagol teni chunga kalung ahange. Kasohpa Job sei bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nanghon nasei pouve.
en_web: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
en_kjv: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Job jah a thu asei chai phat’in, Eliphaz jah a, “Kalhacha Job banga, nang le nagol te nin kachung thu nasei loujeh-in nachunguva kalung hange.

tcz: Hijeh chun bongchal sagi leh kelngoichal sagi ma kikai unlang kasohpa Job koma cheuvin, chuleh nangma ho a dingin kilhaina govam thilto gabol un. Kasohpan nangho dingin nataopeh untin chuleh keiman taona chu nangho minna kasan peh a, natoh dungjui uva kalethuh tahlou ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon kasohpa Job bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nasei pouve ati.
en_web: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
en_kjv: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun bongchal sagi le kelngoichal sagi Job henga kaiyun lang, kilhaina gabol’uvin. Job’in nataopeh-un tin, vetda lom hijongle chun, ataona chu sanpeh-uvinge. Ama bangin nang hon kachung thu adih-in naseipouve,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Teman mipa Eliphaz, Shuh mipa Bildad chule Naamat mi Zophar chun Pakai thupeh bangin agabol un chuleh Pakaiyin Job taona asanpeh tai.
en_web: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.
en_kjv: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
tcz_gospelgo: Eliphaz le Bildah chule Zopharin Pakaiyin ahilnau bangin abol’un, Pakaiyin Job taona asangtai.

tcz: Job chun aloi agolte dinga ataopeh phat in Pakaiyin vangphat nan akile sah in, tahbeh in Pakaiyin masanga aneijat sanga ajatni a tamjon apetai.
en_web: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
en_kjv: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
tcz_gospelgo: Job’in agolte thum ataopeh nungin Pakaiyin ama ahaodoh sah kit’in, masanga aneisanga ajat nia tamjon ahaosah tai.

tcz: Chutah chun asopi pasal holeh numeiho chuleh masanga akihetpi aloi agolte ahungun a in'ah an anehkhompi uvin ahi. Pakaiyin ama douna a achung hange thilse analhunsah ho jouse jal chun amapa chu alhem un chuleh alhamon un ahi. Chuleh amaho khat cheh chun amapa din thilpeh sum le sana khutjem ahin choipeh uve.
en_web: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
en_kjv: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Job sopi pasal ho le numei ho, chule agol lui ho ahungun, a-in a golvah abolpiuve. Pakaiyin abolgimna jouse chung thudol’a Job din lungmonna thu aseiyui. Mi khat khat’in sum phabep le sana khutjem khat cheh apeuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Job hinkho anukhat lang chu akipat tillai sangin phatthei aha boh jon, hijeh chun tun kelngoi sangsom le sangli aneiyin, sangong sao sang gup aneiyin, bongchal kop sangkhat aneiyin, chule sanganpi sangkhat aneitai.
en_web: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
en_kjv: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinkho kipatna lam sangin ahinkho kichailam chu Pakaiyin Job phat thei ahaboh cheh-e. Job’in kelngoi sangsom le sang li avul’in, sa-ngongsao sanggup avul’in, bong sang ni avul’in, sangan sang khat avul’e.

tcz: Aman jong Job chu chapa sagi apeh ben, chule numei jong thum jen apeh bei.
en_web: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
en_kjv: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa sagi aneiyin, chanu thum aneiye.

tcz: Amapan achanu masapen chu Jemiah asah in, anina Keziah asah in, chule athumna Keremhappuch asah e.
en_web: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
en_kjv: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
tcz_gospelgo: Achanu lenpen Jemimah asah-in, aban a nu Keziah asah-in, alhumpen nu Keren Happuch asah-e.

tcz: Gamsung jouse a numei lah a Job Chanute banga melhoi dang aumpoi. Chuleh apaovin amaho chu asopi pasal ho toh alunglhaina bang tah in asem khomin ahi.
en_web: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
en_kjv: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Job Chanute tobanga numei mel-hoi vannoi leiset’a anaumpoi. Apauvin asopi pasalte toh gou ahop peh soh keiye.

tcz: Hicheng nung hin Job chu kum jakhat le somli ahingin, achate leh atute khangli chan geijin amun ahi.
en_web: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
en_kjv: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Job chu kum ja khat le som li ahinbe nalaiyin, tu le tuson anei geiyin ahingin ahi.

tcz: Chutah chun Job chu hinkho bulhingset in ahingin, tehse mong monga hingin atehthi tai.
en_web: So Job died, being old and full of days.
en_kjv: So Job died, being old and full of days.
tcz_gospelgo: Job ahing lhumkeiyin ateh thitai.

tcz: Migiloute thuhil jom louva, michonse ho lamlhah dunga jong dingle lou; chule Elohim Pathen ginglou ho kikhop na dunga jong tou khompi lou mi chu anun nom ahi.
en_web: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
en_kjv: Blessed is the man That walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute thumop sang lou, Chonsete umchan jomlou, Pathen taitom nomte jop lou chu Mi nun nom tah ahin;

tcz: Hitobang mihochun Yahweh Pakai Dan thu a bou lunglhai na aneiyun, Yahweh Pakai Dan thu chu sun le jan in angaito jing jeng ui.
en_web: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
en_kjv: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; And in his law doth he meditate day and night.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Danthu nit akipapi jon, Danthu chu sun le janin asim jinge.

tcz: Hitobang mi hochu twi lonna luipanga kiphut, aphat cha hung gaji adojong gopjilou thingphung tobang ahi; hitobang miho jong chu atohna lam lam'uva alolhing jiuve.
en_web: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
en_kjv: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, That bringeth forth his fruit in his season; His leaf also shall not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang mi hi luipanga thingphung keh, Aphat cha hung gatheiya, Anan goptih neita lou tobang ahin, Atoh lam jousea alolhing theiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginglouho vang chutobang ahipoi: huilhoh mangle changvai tobangbep ahiuve.
en_web: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
en_kjv: The ungodly are not so: But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute vang chuti ahi pon, Huiya vai kithe bep ahiuve.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Yahweh Pakai gingloute chu thutan nikho tengleh themmo changdiu, michonse hon jong mikitah ho lah'a mun aneiloudiu ahi.
en_web: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
en_kjv: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset jong Pathenin themmo achan a, Midihte kikhopna lha thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho lamlhah ahetpeh jing in, Yahweh Pakai ginglou ho lampi vang manthahna'a lut diu ahi.
en_web: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
en_kjv: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: But the way of the ungodly shall perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte chu Pakaiyin apuiyin ahoidamin, Migilouten vang manthahna lam ajontauve.

tcz: Ipi dinga chitin namtin kitohmoa, thilphachomlou ngaito na a aphat'u amoh man chatvei u hitam?
en_web: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
en_kjv: Why do the heathen rage, And the people imagine a vain thing?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia namtin vaipin galguh agon’uva, Pannabei thilsea pangkhom hiuvam?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in lengdinga athaonupa dounan leiset lengte akikhom un, chule vaihom thunei hon jong thulhuh asem un, hitin asei ui.
en_web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
en_kjv: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset lengten gal abol’un, Avaihomteuvin Pakai adouvun, Pathen lhentum lengpa Adoutauve.

tcz: “Ei-kihennauva kon ahin kilhamlhao hitin, Elohim Pathen thaneina'a kon'in kilha ong-u hite” atiuve.
en_web: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
en_kjv: Let us break their bands asunder, And cast away their cords from us.
tcz_gospelgo: “Avaihom nauva konin kiteldoh-u hitin, Eigah nauva konin kisut lhamute,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in avan laltouna'a kon'in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, Yahweh Pakai a din nuijat umtah ahitauve.
en_web: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
en_kjv: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: The Lord shall have them in derision.
tcz_gospelgo: Van alaltouna konin Pakaiyin anuisat’in, Panna beiya agon jouseu adaithange.

tcz: Chuin Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu lunghang tah'in aphoh in, alunghan jah jeng chun amaho atijatsah tai.
en_web: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
en_kjv: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung phamon Pakaiyin agihsal’in, Lung hangin ahoh kichasoh tai.

tcz: Chutah in “Keiman kalhendoh lengchu kalhang theng Zion molvum a katousah'e,” ati.
en_web: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
en_kjv: Yet have I set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kalhang theng Zion a, Kalhentum leng laltouna katousah-e,” ati.

tcz: Keiman thugahna chu phongdoh inge; Yahweh Pakai in kahengah hitin asei e, “Nangma hi kachapa nahi, Keiman tunia nangma hi kahin nahi tai.”
en_web: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
en_kjv: I will declare the decree: The Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; This day have I begotten thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan, “Pakai thugahna phongdoh ing ting, Kajah a, ‘Nang hi kachapa, Tunia kahinsa nahi;

tcz: Kahenga nathum pouleh chitin namtin hi nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, vannoi leiset pumpi geija nagou kahisahding ahi.
en_web: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
en_kjv: Ask of me, And I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
tcz_gospelgo: Thumin, namtin vaipi gou losah inge, Leiset pumpi nang ding ahi.

tcz: Nangman amahohi thihjolla najep boh'a; belkhengpa bel kivoh chip banga ahal hal a nakoi ding ahi.
en_web: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
en_kjv: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi hi thih tenggol a najep cheh a, Leibel banga navohgoi ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Vo leiset lengte kichih theiyun; Chule leiset thutan ho nanghon thuhil ngaiphaovin.
en_web: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
en_kjv: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun hiche thugahna hi leng hon gelphauvin, Hiche kahilna hi leiset vaihomten hethem’uvin.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu ging tah in akin bol un, chule kithing pum in Ama chu houvun.
en_web: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
en_kjv: Serve the Lord with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
tcz_gospelgo: Gingkhen chan Pakai kinbol’un,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai lungsatna nachung uva achuh a namanthah masangun akengphang kolchah in chop un, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai lungsat na neocha jong eihodia deojah ahi. Atahsan nau Yahweh Pakai a koi jing ho chu anun nom ahiuve.
en_web: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
en_kjv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, And ye perish from the way, When his wrath is kindled but a little: Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithing thingin ahenga boh khup’uvin. Ajo le lung hang loi ding, Namanthah lo jeng diu ahi. Pakaiya kisel jingte chu Anun nom’ui.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, idia eisulam vaiding mi pung jing hitam! eidou din mitamtah akipandoh taove.
en_web: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
en_kjv: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! Many are they that rise up against me.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, eidouva atamcheh cheh-in, Kamelma atam behseh jengtai!

tcz: Ama kihuh doh na hi Elohim Pathen a aumpoi tin kalungthim in mitamtah'in aseijui. Selah.
en_web: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
en_kjv: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathenin panpi taponte,” tin Kamelmaten aseiyui.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai, nanghi eiveng tup, kalum'a kisoung nahi; Ka loupina le khodah ngam-a, gal jona eipeh jing nahi.
en_web: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
en_kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; My glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle O Pakai, Kalumdal nahin, gal neijosah jin; Khodah ngamin neilha jingnai. Title: 2 Sam 15.13-17.22

tcz: Keima O sangtah in Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Aman alhang thenga kon'in eihin donbut tai. Selah.
en_web: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
en_kjv: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, And he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Othong leuvin Pakai henga kataovin, Alhang thenga konin eihouve.

tcz: Keima kalum'in ka-imu jin; Yahweh Pakai in eichin tup'a eihoidam jeh'in, kajing-thou kit tai.
en_web: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
en_kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalup’a ka-ihmut teng, Pakaiyin eihoidam jeh-in kathoukit jie.

tcz: Keima doudin mihem sangsom sangjan ei umkimvel jongle kichakit taponge.
en_web: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
en_kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, That have set themselves against me round about.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelma asang sangin eium jongleh Kagingtapoi.

tcz: Hung thoudoh in O Yahweh Pakai; neihuhdoh'in, Elohim ka Pathen: Eidou hojouse khagu eivohchipeh in; nangma migilou ho hahemtah jong vopul soh ji nahi.
en_web: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
en_kjv: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung-o Pakai, neihuhhingin ka-Pathen! Kamelmate khagu suchip’in, Hapou loubangin koiyin!

tcz: Huh hingna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon bou ahi: Na phattheina jong namite chunga aume.
en_web: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
en_kjv: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: Thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Jo na chu Pakaiya kon ahin, Aman a mite phatthei boh jing hen!

tcz: Kakou teng neidon but'in, them eichan sah a O Yahweh Pakai; ka lhahsam nikho teng jong le nangman lunglet neipe ji; neikhoton lang kataona neingai peh tei in.
en_web: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
en_kjv: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: Thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: O them eichan a ka-Pathen, Kahung taove neihouvin! Kagimpet’in neihu jinge, Neikhoton kataona sangin!

tcz: Vo mihem chapate, nanghohin itihchanpi neisuh jum diu hitam? Itihchan ajehbei a nei thepmosah uva, itihchan pihi jouthu nachepi diu hitam?
en_web: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
en_kjv: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo mihemte phat aichan geiya neijumsouva, Ichan geiya pannabei nahol’uva jouthu najui diu ham?

tcz: Ahin nanghon heuvin, Yahweh Pakai in ama gingho Ama ding'in atum'in alhengdoh'e. Yahweh Pakai kakou tengleh Aman ei-donbut teijin ahi.
en_web: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
en_kjv: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: The Lord will hear when I call unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hethem’uvin Pakaiyin midih akilhendoh tai, Ahenga katao teng eisanpeh jie.

tcz: Ki sonlelnan kithing pumin umun, ahin chonset boldaovin; hichu nalupnao muna jong nalungthimu toh gelkhom jinguvin lang umdet jingun.
en_web: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
en_kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Gingkhen chan um’un chonse hih-un, Janteng thip beh cha nalup naa hiti hi giltah-in gel’un.

tcz: Lungthengsel a kilhai naho boljingun chule natahsan nao Yahweh Pakai a koi jingun.
en_web: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
en_kjv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil thengin kilhaiyun, Pakai henga ki-ngaiyun.

tcz: Hiho sanga phajo eimusah thei diu koi ham? tin mitamtah'in seiunte, Yahweh Pakai namaivah achun keiho neihinsu emsel un.
en_web: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
en_kjv: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tamtah atao teng, “O Pakai hamphatna neipeh beuvin, Lungset le khoton neiveuvin,” atiuve.

tcz: Nangman lengpitwi leh changle mim nengchat'a kilamdoh ho kipani sangin, kalungthim nakipasah tai.
en_web: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
en_kjv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla neipeh kipana hin Neh le chah don ding haotah ho sangin Eikipasah joi.

tcz: Keima Nanga dia lungmonga kalup a ka-ihmut ding ahi, Yahweh Pakai nei hoidoh inlang neivengtup in.
en_web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
en_kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: For thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, damsel’a neihoijeh-in, Kalup teng nomsel’in ka-ihmui.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka ocheng ho neingaipeh'in, Kalungthim a kataona jong neigelkhoh peh'in.
en_web: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
en_kjv: Give ear to my words, O Lord, Consider my meditation.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai kaseiho neingaipeh-in, Katao gin ngaiyin!

tcz: Panpi ngaija kakana neigelkhohpeh'in, ka lengpa le Elohim ka Pathen; ajeh chu nangma kom'a bou taovakahi.
en_web: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
en_kjv: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: For unto thee will I pray.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithopi ngaicha kap kahi, Ka-Pathen le kalengpa! O Pakai nangbou kataona nahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, jingkah teng kataona nei ngaipeh'in, jingkah seh leh nangma lam sang ingting kangai chat jouse nakom kahinlhut a kinemtah a ngah jingding kahi.
en_web: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
en_kjv: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah seh le kapengin najan, Nisa so teng neihou ding kinemin kataove.

tcz: Nangma thil phalouho chunga kipah ji pathen nahipon, migilou ho jong na angsuna aumthei ji pouve.
en_web: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
en_kjv: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Neither shall evil dwell with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse kipahji Pathen nahipon, Thil phalouto umkhom thei nahipoi.

tcz: Nangma angsunga mikiletsah ho a dingjou jipon; Yahweh Pakai nang man gitlou nale chonset bol jouse nathet soh hel e.
en_web: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
en_kjv: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kilsetsahte navetdan, Mi phaloute nahoi.

tcz: Nangin jouthu sei ho nasuh mang ding ahi; Yahweh Pakai in mijoulhep holeh tolthat ho athet ahi.
en_web: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
en_kjv: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: The Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
tcz_gospelgo: Jousei hatte nasu mangjin, Pumhatte le lepchete nakidah-e.

tcz: Keima din vang, Nangailut na bulhingsetjal chun na hongsung hunglut nange; Chule nangma ginle jana a nahouin theng mai a bohkhup a chibai kabohding nahi.
en_web: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
en_kjv: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: And in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset kidang jeh-in Keivang nahouin a hung theiying ting, Nahouin theng sunga boh khup’ing ting Nangma jatah a kahou ding nahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kamelma ten eijo lounadin nalamdih a neipui in. Kamasanga um lampi hi kajuidih nadin neihin lhun jang peh in.
en_web: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
en_kjv: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, kamelma atam behseh-e! Nadei bol din neipuiyin lang, Nalampi neijot jangsah-in.

tcz: Ajeh chu kamelmate kamsunga thutah apotthei tapon, asunglam'u jong setnajeng ahitai; Alol sung ujong lhankhuh abangin, alei ujong chuchi a kilhunglut kalbi abang e.
en_web: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
en_kjv: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate thusei tahsan thei aumpon, Mi suhmangna ding bou adeiyuve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ama ho khu gotna petan. Aduhabol nauhi amaho lhuh na hihen! Achonsetnao ho jeh'in delmang jeng'in, ajeh chu amahohin nangma dounan na atong'un ahi.
en_web: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
en_kjv: Destroy thou them, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, mo sonlang talen pen, Athilgon’uvin kipalsah-in, manthahsah jengin. Nang douna chonset tampi aboljeh-un Na-angsunga konin delmangtan.

tcz: Ahin koihileh nangma lhalim noi'a umho chu thanom'u hen! Nangma thangvahna lachu kipah tah'in sajingu hen! Amaho chunga nalhajah in hoidoh jing in lang, Nangma min ngailu jing ho jong kipa na lodim jing'u hen.
en_web: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
en_kjv: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalim’a kiselte vang kipah jing hen, Phat tinin kipala sau hen. Nangma jeh a nom sa ahijeh-un, Na-ngailute chu hoidam jingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nang'in michonpha ho phatthei naboh tei in. Nalungtoh te ngailut na ompho phatah achun nahoibit jing e.
en_web: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
en_kjv: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; With favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nathu nit chu phatthei naboh jin, Na-ngailut chu lumbangin nadalpehjie.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nei lung han san loujen in! Lungsat namoljol a chun neikhoukhah hih helin.
en_web: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
en_kjv: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, lung phamo jongle chun nei-eng boldan, Lunghang jongle chun talen neimatsah hih-in!

tcz: Neikhoto teijin lhasam le hatlou kahi Yahweh Pakai, neidam sah in kagu kachang jousen eichip ui.
en_web: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
en_kjv: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
tcz_gospelgo: Abeipai ding kahitai, neikhoton Pakai! Kagu kachangin eichip’e, neidamsah-in!

tcz: Kalhagao alengvai lheh jeng tai, O Yahweh Pakai itihchan pi hitia hi kaum ding hitam?
en_web: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
en_kjv: My soul is also sore vexed: But thou, O Lord, how long?
tcz_gospelgo: Kapumpin kana behseh jenge, Kithopi louva itih chan neikoi nah lai ding ham?

tcz: Hungkilen O Yahweh Pakai, kalhagao huh doh in. Namingailutna longlou jeh chun neihin huhdoh tei in.
en_web: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
en_kjv: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: O save me for thy mercy’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungin neihuhhingin Pakai, Neikhoton thinaa konin neihuhdoh loiyin!

tcz: Ajeh chu thina ahin nangma geldoh na aumpoi: lhankhuh a kona jong koiham nahin thangvah ding?
en_web: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
en_kjv: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In the grave who shall give thee thanks?
tcz_gospelgo: Mithi gama nangma geldoh jong aumpon, Navahchoi theiya jong aumpouve.

tcz: Ka ka kamao nan kachao lhatai; janseh a kakanan kajalkhun achin in, kaka na mitlhi hon kalupna jalkhun akotsah sohtai.
en_web: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
en_kjv: I am weary with my groaning; All the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaha nat behseh jeh-in veipai ding kahitan, Janseh a kaka kanan ka-ulsan kajalkhun alhop jin, Kalukhap jeng jong Kamit lhin alhop jitai.

tcz: Genthei a kaka nan kamit athimtan; kagalmiten eisuh genthei jeh'uvin apomhel jengtai.
en_web: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
en_kjv: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten eikasah sah nauva konin Kamit athimlon, kho kamuchen theipoi.

tcz: Gitlouna bolho jouse kakoma kon'in potdoh tauvin; Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in kakana eijahpeh tai.
en_web: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
en_kjv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kataona asangtai, Kakoma konin migiloute potdoh jengun!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in kangaichat a kathum na ho eihetpeh tan; kataona hi eidonbut ding ahitai.
en_web: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
en_kjv: The Lord hath heard my supplication; The Lord will receive my prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi ngaicha kakouna ajatan, Kataona asan ding ahitai.

tcz: Kagalmite jouse kijumsou henlang kithing pumin um uhen: Jum le ja pumin gangtah in kinungle taohen.
en_web: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
en_kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: Let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten thina khop’a jum le ja athoh diu, Kinloi tah a kisudonguva Pathenin adelmang diu ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen eihoidam din nangma kahin belle. Eipedoh a pang hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in, neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
en_kjv: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: Save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathen, neihoidam din naheng kahinjon’e, Kanung hindeltea konin neihuhdoh-in!

tcz: Achuti loule panpi ding bei a kaum a, keipi bahkai-jin mi abolset banga eiboset uva, ahal halla eibotel diu ahi.
en_web: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
en_kjv: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhdoh loule sakei sakai bangin eikai mangun tin, Koiman eihuhdoh joulou ding, katel kadah a eijanlo diu ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pathen keiman thil suhkhel kaneija, thildihlou kana tohdoh khah'a,
en_web: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
en_kjv: O Lord my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathen, keiman thilse kabol khah a,

tcz: Lungmonga kachenkhom pi khat chonphatlouna kalethuh a, ajehbeija kagalmi kanchom khah'a ahileh,
en_web: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
en_kjv: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
tcz_gospelgo: Kagol thilpha bol chu thilsea kathuh a, Ajeh beiya melma kachom leh;

tcz: Kagal mite khut-ah neipedoh jeng in lang kahin na lajengu hen, amahon tolla eichotpha jeng uhen chule kaloupi najouse bon lah'a kaithang jeng-u hen. Selah
en_web: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
en_kjv: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; Yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, And lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten eihindel del jeng hen eiman hen, Eisat lih jengu hen lang, Kalong damsa tollhanga jamu hen!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, lunghan in hungthoudoh'in, Doumit melpu kagalmite jeh in nang hung kichoisang in; Chule hung kipatdoh'in Elohim ka Pathen nathutan dihtah chu hinpolut in.
en_web: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
en_kjv: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, Lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: And awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, lung soutenin hung kipatdoh-in, Kamelmate to kidinten, nangin neipan hun! Nangin thudih na-ngeh jinge,

tcz: Namasangah chitin namtin kikhom soh hen: Ama ho chunga namun dih tah chu hin kimusah kit in.
en_web: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
en_kjv: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: For their sakes therefore return thou on high.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin mitang koukhomsoh-in Van a konin achunguva vaihomin.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu chitin namtin ho thu atan ahi: Kachondih naho nei phondoh peh tan, O Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu keiman them mo na kanei poi O hatchung nung.
en_web: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
en_kjv: The Lord shall judge the people: Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, And according to mine integrity that is in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin thutan vaihom nangma nahi, Kadih dungjuiyin Thu neitanpeh-in O Pakai, Themmona bei kahi nahenai!

tcz: Mi phalouho thil dihlou bolna kichai sah tan, chule michonpha ho chu domsangin. Ajeh chu nangman mihem lungthim gilsung ve Pathen dihtah chu nahi.
en_web: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
en_kjv: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: For the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dih nahi, Kadeiyu le ka-ngaiyu kholtoh-in. Migiloute phatmona sutangin Miphate kipaman pen.

tcz: Elohim ka Pathen hi kalum'a pang ahin, alungthim dih le akitah ho chu ahuhhing jin ahi.
en_web: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
en_kjv: My defence is of God, Which saveth the upright in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu eihoidampa ahin, Athu nitte ahuhhing jie.

tcz: Elohim ka Pathen hi thutan dihtah ahin, niseh'in miphalou chunga alung hangjingin ahi.
en_web: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
en_kjv: God judgeth the righteous, And God is angry with the wicked every day.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu dihtah a thutan ahin, Niseh-in migilou chunga alung hange.

tcz: Mihemkhat chu akisih louva ahileh, Elohim ka Pathen in achemjam kinol hem intin, athalpi kaosa akoijing ahi.
en_web: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
en_kjv: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin lung ahei louleh, Achemjam akinol hem jin; Thalpi aloiyin kamsalsan akoiyin,

tcz: Aman thina manchah gimneitah chu kigot intin athalpi meikou chu akapding ahi.
en_web: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
en_kjv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
tcz_gospelgo: Thal’an behsa thalchang kipat’in, Thalpi chang lheleh lah chun adoijie.

tcz: Miphalou hon setna avop un, umhelna le thilphalou va agaiun, jouthu ho ahinpen doh sah jiu ve.
en_web: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
en_kjv: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, And hath conceived mischief, And brought forth falsehood.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, migilouten itobang thilse agel’u hitam! Gim gantheina ding agongun jou aseiyui.

tcz: Amahon mi lhahlutna dingin kotong thuhtah alaijiuvin, ahinlah amaho joh alhalut jiuvin ahi.
en_web: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
en_kjv: He made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mi o-na dia thang akam nauva Amaho a-oh lih jiuve.

tcz: Midia set na abol hou chu amaho angsung joh in achuhjin ahi. Michunga chudinga thilse agon houchu amaho luchunga joh achujin ahi.
en_web: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
en_kjv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilse bol’uvin amaho asukhan, Ahusetnauvin amaho amavo lotai.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu akitahna jeh'in thangvah ing-ting, keiman Yahweh Pakai hat chung nung min chu ka thangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
en_kjv: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: And will sing praise to the name of the Lord most High.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih jeh-in Pakai kathangvah-in, Chungnungpen Pakai vahchoi la kasai.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam! naloupi nahi vanho sangin asangjon ahi.
en_web: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
en_kjv: O Lord our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth! Who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: O Yahweh ka-Pakaiyu, Leiset pumpia naminthangtai! Navahchoina ogin van a akithongdoh tan,

tcz: Nangin chapang hole naosen ho kamsunga nathahat naho nahil in, hiti chun nagalmi hole nangma douho nasuthipjin ahi.
en_web: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
en_kjv: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength Because of thine enemies, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangte la naosen geiyin lan asauve. Namelmate dounan kulpi nakaiyin, Nadou jouse nasutang soh tai.

tcz: Keiman janteng vanthamjol kavet akangaito jiteng, nakhut jung ho natoh in lhathah le ahsi ho agongtoh sel ui.
en_web: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
en_kjv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
tcz_gospelgo: Nasemsa vanthamjol le Nagoltohsa lha le ahsi ho kavet teng,

tcz: Mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagelkhoh'a, Mihem Chapa hi ipi dinga hibanga hi nakhohsah ham?
en_web: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
en_kjv: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi ipi hiya hibanga nagel khoh a, Mihem chapa hi ipiham hibanga nakhohsah?

tcz: Nang'in amaho hi Vantil sanga themchabou nemjep in nakoi jin, loupina le jana dimset in lallukhuh nakhuhpeh e.
en_web: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
en_kjv: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, And hast crowned him with glory and honour.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ban tah a nakoiyin, Loupi tah-in lal lukhuh nakhuhpeh-in jabolna napei.

tcz: Nangin nathilsemsaho jouse chunga vaihop na napen, thiljouse akhutnoija nakoitan ahi:
en_web: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
en_kjv: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
tcz_gospelgo: Nasemsa thil jouse chunga vai nahomsah-in, Thilsem aboncha ama noiya nakoiye:

tcz: Kelngoiho le bong ho chule gamsahang ho jouse,
en_web: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
en_kjv: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field;
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoite le gancha dang ho, gamsa ho geiyin,

tcz: Vantham jol'a vachate, twikhang len'a nga-ho chule twikhang len'a kijap jouse ahiuve.
en_web: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
en_kjv: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, And whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
tcz_gospelgo: Vachate le nga jouse Twikhanglen a ganhing ho geiyin.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam!
en_web: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
en_kjv: O Lord our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!
tcz_gospelgo: O Yahweh Ka-Pakaiyu, Leiset pumpia naminthangtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ing-kate. Thil loupi nabol ho hi seiphongle-inge.
en_web: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
en_kjv: (א) I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, kalungthim pumpin vahchoiying ting, Nabolsa thil kidang ho seichoi lenge.

tcz: Nangma jal a kipana a kadimset ding ahi. Namin in vahchoi la sang e, O Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung.
en_web: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
en_kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma jal’in kipa la sang ting, Hatchungnung Pathen navahchoi la sange.

tcz: Nang nahung dindoh teng kagal mite anungjam jiuvin, akiseplhu vin na angsunga athiden jitaove.
en_web: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
en_kjv: (ב) When mine enemies are turned back, They shall fall and perish at thy presence.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma nahung kilah teng kamelmate anung jam’un, kisep lhun athidentauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin kadih nalam a thu neitan pehin, navan laltouna'a kon'in thu adih'in nahin tan e.
en_web: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
en_kjv: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou satest in the throne judging right.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitah le thudih-in thu natanin, Keijong them neichantai.

tcz: Nangman namtin vaipi nalethuh in migiloute nasu-mang'in, amin'u tonsot'a din nathai mangtai.
en_web: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
en_kjv: (ג) Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi naphohsal’in, Migiloute nasumangjin, Geldoh kit louhel dingin Nanoi mangsohjitai.

tcz: Melmate chu nangin a-itih'a dingin nasumang in, khopi nasuh mang ho jong tun suhmil'in aumgam-tauve.
en_web: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
en_kjv: (ה) O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: And thou hast destroyed cities; Their memorial is perished with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmateu akichaisoh tan, Akhopi jouseu nasumangin, Koiman amaho ageldoh kit tapoi.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai hi tonsot leng ahin, thutanna dingin alaltouna atungdoh'in ahi.
en_web: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
en_kjv: (ו) But the Lord shall endure for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu tonsot din alengchang tan, Thutan din laltouna atoutai.

tcz: Aman leiset hi thudih'a achungthu atan a, namtin vaipi chunga hi dihtah'a vai ahop ding ahi.
en_web: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
en_kjv: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, He shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
tcz_gospelgo: Thudih-in vannoi vai apon, Namtin vaipi thu adih-in atanpeh-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi bolgentheija umho dinga hoidohna ahin, hahsatna nikho hoa dinga kicholdona kulpi ahi.
en_web: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
en_kjv: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Bolgentheiya umte dia Pakai hi kiselna kulpi ahin, Hesoh genthei pet’a hoidohna mun ahi.

tcz: Namin heho jousen nahin tahsan ui, ajeh chu, O Yahweh Pakai nangin nangma holte chu nadalha ngaipoi.
en_web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
en_kjv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: For thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, namin hesaten ki-ngai nan naneiyun, Naheng hinjon chan nadonda ngaipoi.

tcz: Jerusalem'a vaihom Yahweh Pakai vahchoinan lasauvin. Suhmil theilou atohdoh ho namtin jah a seiphongun.
en_web: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
en_kjv: (ז) Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion a vaihom Pakai vahchoila sauvin, Athilbol namtin gaseipeh-uvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman tolthat ho aphu alahjin, panpi beiho apanpin ji. Aman migentheiho kana jong nahsah mon akoijipoi.
en_web: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
en_kjv: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: He forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
tcz_gospelgo: Phula them Pathenin gentheite agel jingin, Aka ginu asumilpon, abolseteu talen amatsahjie.

tcz: Neikho to teijin O Yahweh Pakai; eibose teuvin ichan a eisuh genthei u hitam, thina kokhuh a kon'in neiloidoh'in.
en_web: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
en_kjv: (ח) Have mercy upon me, O Lord; Consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
tcz_gospelgo: Neilungset’in O Pakai, Ven, kamelmaten eibolset nau hi! O Pakai, thinaa konin neihuhdoh loiyin!

tcz: Zion chanu kelkot phunghoa lhangphong tah'a kathangvah theina dingin neihuhdoh'in, chutengleh neihuh doh jal a kakipa thanom ding ahi.
en_web: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
en_kjv: That I may shew forth all thy praise In the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem mite masanga kadin a, Kavahchoina jeh jouse kaseipeh theina din. Neihuhhing jal’a kipah thanom ding kahitai.

tcz: Midangho lhahlut nadia asem u kokhuh a chun Namtin vaipi alhalut un, athang kam uva chun amaho keng joh a ohtai.
en_web: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
en_kjv: (ט) The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipin khuh alaiyun, Akhuh laisauva alhalut’un athangkam’uva a-oh tauve.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi athutan dihna'a kon'in akilangdoh jin: Migilouho vang amaho thang-kamna'a a-ohden jiuvin ahi. Selah
en_web: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
en_kjv: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu adih a thu atanjal’in akiphongdoh tan, Migiloute vang athangkamsauva a-ohden soh tauve.

tcz: Migilouho vang lhankhuh a lhalut untin, hichu Elohim Pathen nahsah lou namtin vaipiho chunga got na jong ahi.
en_web: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
en_kjv: (י) The wicked shall be turned into hell, And all the nations that forget God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hephalou jouse, Migiloute aboncha thisoh hel diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah panpi ngaichaho chu nahsahmoa umjom jing loudiu: chule migenthei te kinepna jong tonsot a suhmil-a um louding ahi.
en_web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
en_kjv: (כ) For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: The expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaichate donlouva kikoi koi lou ding, Vaichate kinepna jong kisumil deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Hungthou vin, O Yahweh Pakai! Mihemho kinoise sah-hih beh'in! Nangma ginglou namtin vaipi ho chungthu hi tanin!
en_web: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
en_kjv: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: Let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungin Pakai, mihem kijosah dan, Na-angsunga namtin vaipi koukhomin themmo pen.

tcz: amahohi tijatnan lungkhamsah'in, O Yahweh Pakai. Namtin vaipi hi mihem maimai ahiu kihetdoh sah'in.
en_web: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
en_kjv: Put them in fear, O Lord: That the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte kiginsah-in Pakai, Thi thei mihem ahiu kihetdohsah tan.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, idia gam lhatah'a ding nahim? Genthei kathoh jiteng ibol'a kisel jia nahim?
en_web: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
en_kjv: (ל) Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, idia kidal khin khin a, Ngaichat pet leh kiselmang nahim!

tcz: Migilouten noise tah'in migentheite adel mangjiu vin, mi-o nadinga asem'u thang a chun amahojoh hin-o sah'in.
en_web: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
en_kjv: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: Let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute kiletsah-in vaichate abolseuve, Athang kamsauva osah-in.

tcz: Ajeh chu amhon thilselam a alung ngaichat hou akiletsah piuvin, mikilose ho apah chauvin, Yahweh Pakai chu ataitom-un ahi.
en_web: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
en_kjv: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, And blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin thilse atup akiletsah pin, Mi kilosen jong Pakai ataitomloi.

tcz: Migilou te vang Elohim Pathen holdin akiletsah val un, alungthim pumpiu vin jong Elohim Pathen aum poi atiuve.
en_web: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
en_kjv: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin Pakai aholpon, Akiletsah jeh-in Pathen agelkhohpoi.

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hi abol-lam lam uvah alolhing'un ahi. Achung uva hunglhung ding eng-bolna ho jonghi amupha jipouve. Amahon agal-mihou jouse chu ataitom-un ahi.
en_web: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
en_kjv: His ways are always grievous; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou chu atoh lam lama akhangtouvin, Pathen thutanna hephalouvin, amelma ahohdal thoi.

tcz: Amahon, kachung'uva thilse kiti chulouding ahi tin atahsan un; boina hoa kona aitih a ongthol ding kahitaove atiuve.
en_web: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
en_kjv: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: For I shall never be in adversity.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin, “kelel bei hel ding, Gentheina katolou hel ding ahi,” tin agel’e.

tcz: Akam-uvah sapsetna, joule nal, chule gihsalna adimset ui. Alei muh uva jong thilse le thilphalou jeng aum e.
en_web: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
en_kjv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: Under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaosap le jousei toh chule hutot to thon thu aseiyin, Geldet det louvin, thuse hotlam jeng aseiye.

tcz: Amahon khopam lam gamthip lah hoa mi achanglhi jiuvin, them-mona neilouho thading agojiuve. Amit un alhasam te umna aching lhi jingun ahi.
en_web: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
en_kjv: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: In the secret places doth he murder the innocent: His eyes are privily set against the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Venglai golchih kah dudnga touvin Monabei miho that din achanglhi. Atha nom miho chu Amit lhi lhan aching jinge.

tcz: Keipi bahkaiho bang'in akisel'un lhasam le hatloute mat jeng dingin angahun ahi. Sachangho bang'in tah-lelte chu len akhu khum un amandoh jitaove.
en_web: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
en_kjv: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei sachan bangin kisel’in Miho achanglhi le len, Tahlelte achang le len, Athanga a-o khah teng amanin akaimangjitai.

tcz: Lhasam a bolsetna toh te chu asugep jiuvin; miphalouho thahatna noi a chun alhalut jitaove.
en_web: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
en_kjv: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, That the poor may fall by his strong ones.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpaibei mi chu anoigep jin, Thahat changing avo-lhun ajamdenjitai.

tcz: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen in eimupha pouve atiuve! Aman amit sing intin, “Eihon ibol uhi mu hih beh inte” atiuve!
en_web: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
en_kjv: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: He hideth his face; he will never see it.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou chun, “pathenin bon khohsah lou, amit singta, eimutaponte,” ati.

tcz: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai, migiloute hi gotna petan, O Elohim Pathen! Hatlou lhasam te hin sumil hih beh in.
en_web: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
en_kjv: (ק) Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: Forget not the humble.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai migiloute talen pen, Gentheite gelkhoh-in!

tcz: Migiloute Elohim Pathen sam se pum puma iti ongthol diu ham? Amahon Elohim Pathen in eithemmosah pouvinte tin angai touve.
en_web: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
en_kjv: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin iti Pathen adonda a, “Talen eimatsah ponte,” ati thei ding ham?

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai nangin athilse bol-houhi namusoh keije. Nangin hicheho hi melchih inlang amahohi gotna pen. Hatlou lhasam ten atahsan nao nanga akoi un, nulou palou te jong nangin vengbit in.
en_web: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
en_kjv: (ר) Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, To requite it with thy hand: The poor committeth himself unto thee; Thou art the helper of the fatherless.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nangin namu na, Gim gentheile thoh hahsa namelchih jingin; Kithopi dinga kigosa jing nahi, Panpibei min nahinbel jin, Ngaicha geova um chu nakithopinai.

tcz: Hiche migilou mi-engseho hi abanjang-u heh bongin! abon-uva nasuhmang kahsen anung u deljingin.
en_web: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
en_kjv: (ש) Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: Seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou thilse bolte banjang vobongin, Abolkit louna diuvin thilse bolte talen pen.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi atonsot tonsot leng ahi! Elohim Pathen neilou nam mitechu gamsung akon a mangthah ding ahiuve.
en_web: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
en_kjv: The Lord is King for ever and ever: The heathen are perished out of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot tonsot’a Pakai chu leng ahin, Doihoute chu agamsunga kona mangthah diu ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin tah-lelte kinepna hi nahetsa ahi, nangin thon louva akana-u najahpeh'a nahin lhamon ding ahi.
en_web: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
en_kjv: (ת) Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, mi lhasamte taona na-ngaiyin, Natilkhoujin nahatsah jie.

tcz: Nangin nulou palou te leh bolgentheija umho chungthu adih'a natanpeh ding, chuteng athi thei mihem in amaho hi asuh lengvai theilou diu ahitai.
en_web: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
en_kjv: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That the man of the earth may no more oppress.
tcz_gospelgo: Bol gentheiya umte le chagate kagin na-ngai lhin, Mihemin asuh genthei kit louna diuvin athuu natan’e.

tcz: Keiman eiveng tup din Yahweh Pakai katahsan e. Hijeh achu, nangin ipi dia, “vacha bang'in nahoibitna dingin hiche molchunga khun galeng tan” natiham!
en_web: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
en_kjv: In the Lord put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
tcz_gospelgo: Kei-Pakaiya kisonga, I-atileh kajah a, “Vacha bangin molsang lama leng touvin,

tcz: Migilouhon athalchangu akhaoto suhtoh san akoi un aloisal tauvin ahi. Amahon munthip a kon-in milungdih ho ahinkap'un ahi.
en_web: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
en_kjv: For lo, the wicked bend their bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten thalpi akamsal’un, Muthim laiya mipha ho kap din Thalchangin adoitauve.

tcz: Dan leh thupehho akisuhset teng, michonphapa chun ipi abolthei nahlai dingham?
en_web: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
en_kjv: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
tcz_gospelgo: Kulpi achimsoh teng Miphan ipi abol thei nah lai ding ahm?” natiu ham?

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai chu a-houin munthenga chun aum e; Yahweh Pakai chun vanna kon'in vai ahinhom nalaije. Aman mijouse ahin vechilsoh keijin, leiset chunga mitin ahinkholtoh e.
en_web: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
en_kjv: The Lord is in his holy temple, The Lord’s throne is in heaven: His eyes behold, His eyelids try, the children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ahouin thenga achengin, Van a laltouna akidoi. Muntin a mitin aven, Athilbol anatoh-u ahesoh keiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha le migilou anigelin ahinkhol toh e. Aman thunoh baotam bol ho athen ahi.
en_web: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
en_kjv: The Lord trieth the righteous: But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin midih le migilou akholtoh jin, Pumhat mang ho vang alungthimin ahoi.

tcz: Aman migiloute chunga mei-am lenglung leh katsong meikong gojuh'a ajuhsah ding hui savetvut pumma gotna apeh ding ahi.
en_web: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
en_kjv: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, And a horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin migiloute chunga Kat le meikou asun khum ding, huipi savevu chu adousah ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai dihnahin thu adih'a kitan achepin, hijeh'a chu thudih chepi hochun Yahweh Pakai mai amudiu ahi.
en_web: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
en_kjv: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; His countenance doth behold the upright.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu adih-in thildih angailui; Thildh bolte chu a-angsunga um jing diu ahi.

tcz: Huhhing in, O Yahweh Pakai, michonpha mangthah ding ahitai! Leiset mihem te lah a mikitah jong abeitai!
en_web: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
en_kjv: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipanpiuvin Pakai, Pathen gingmi abeitan, mi kitah jong aumtapoi.

tcz: Heng le kom jengjong jouthu jengin akilhemtouvin, muhnal a lungthima kilhep lhahding jeng thu asei ui.
en_web: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
en_kjv: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: With flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Jouthu jengin akihouvun, Muh them kamthemin akilhemto touve.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in dangnal tah a thukisei ho hi asuh bei ding, kiletsahna thuchengho jonghi asuthip ding ahitai.
en_web: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
en_kjv: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, And the tongue that speaketh proud things:
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, muh them kamthema thusei ho sutangin, Sutangin kiletsah tah a thuseiya,

tcz: Amahon aseijun, eihon lungna chim set'in jouthu seiju hite, ajeh chu i-lei ikam'u eihoa hilouham, kon eisuh tang jou diuham? atiuve.
en_web: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
en_kjv: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamthema ideichan kisei thei, Inop nop kiseididng, kon rikham thei diu ham?” tiho hi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in adonbut in, “Keiman hatlou lhasamte chunga bolgenthei naho kamudohtai chule migenthei ho ka lemao jong kajatai. Tun keima kipan inting huhdoh dia eingaichat bangu va kahuh doh diu ahitai.”
en_web: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
en_kjv: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Ngaichat neiho nabol gentheiyuva, Nabolsetteu nasatah a aka jeh-un, Hung ing ting amaho hi lungmon kapeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kitepna hi thengsel'a ahin, dangka mei chunga sagivei kilhit theng tobang ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
en_kjv: The words of the Lord are pure words: As silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thutep jouse tahsan thei ahin, Dangka kisou jolsel, meiphunga kiloidoh, Vel sagi jen kisoujol tobang ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Yahweh Pakai nangin bol-hesoh'a umho nahuhdoh ding ahi, ti kaheuve, chule hiche kitahlou khang mitea kon'a tonsot geija dinga nahoidoh ding ahi,
en_web: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
en_kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, Thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Muntin amigilou jeng aumin, mitinin thilse bou aseiphauve O Pakai neihoidam jingun, Hiche khang mitea kon hin neihong jingun.

tcz: migilou te muntina vahle henlang migilou pen ho jong gamsung a kidomsang u jong le.
en_web: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
en_kjv: The wicked walk on every side, When the vilest men are exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihoidam jingun Pakai, Hitobang mitea kon hin neichingtup’uvin.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, phat itihchan geihi neisuhmil ding hitam? Itih chan keija kon'a nakiselmang ding nahim?
en_web: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
en_kjv: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, itih chan nei donda a, Ichan geiya vet louva neikoi ding ham?

tcz: Itihchan gei hiche hahsatna hi kathoh ding ham? Itih chan asun ajan'a lungkhamna dimset'a kaum ding ham? Itih chan kagalmiten hanla eisap khum diu hitam?
en_web: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
en_kjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart daily? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
tcz_gospelgo: Itih chan genthei kathoh a, Ichan gei sun le jan a lung hesoh a ka-um ding ham? Ichan geiya kamelmaten eikichepna diu ham?

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hung kiheiyin, neihin donbut tan! Katha kile dohsah'in, neithisah hih'in.
en_web: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
en_kjv: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
tcz_gospelgo: Neiven Pakai ka-Pathen, neihouvin, kamit hasah-in, neithisah hih laiyin.

tcz: “Ama hi kajou tai!” tin kamelma te hi ka lhuh nin kipasah hih beh in.
en_web: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
en_kjv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; And those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate chu, “Kajoutauve,” tisah dan, Kahamset hi amaho kithang-atna hisah hih-in.

tcz: Amavang namingailutna longlouvachu kingai jing kahi. Neihuhdoh jeh a keima kipa jing ding kahi.
en_web: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
en_kjv: But I have trusted in thy mercy; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset long louvin kaki-ngaiye, Neihuhhingna kipa pinge.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai vahchoi lan sang e ajeh chu Ama keidin thilpha tah eibol peh ati.
en_web: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
en_kjv: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, kadia naphat jal’in Navahchoi la sange.
