tcz: Mingol'in bou alungthim in “Pathen aumpoi” ati. Amaho hi lepche ngen ahiuvin, chule athilbol ujong adihlou jeng ahin, khatcha jong thilphabol aumpouve.
en_web: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
en_kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, There is none that doeth good.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol’in alunga, “Pathen aumpoi,” atin ahi. Mihem jouse asesa ahiuin, Melse tah tah thil abol’un, Thildih bol’a khat cha aumpoi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanna kon'in lei mihemte jouse ahinven, mikhattou aching tahbeh um-em, chule Elohim Pathen ngaicha'a hol-a um-em atin ahi.
en_web: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
en_kjv: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
tcz_gospelgo: Van a koin Pakaiyin Cingtheiya Pathen hol’a um’am, Tin mihem chate ahinvei.

tcz: Hinlah aumpoi, abon'un aki-heimang gamtauve, abonchauva lepche ngen ahiuvin, koimacha apha aumpoi khatcha jong aumpoi.
en_web: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
en_kjv: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte lam dihlouva achesoh tan, Aphatmo nau akibang cheh-e. Thildih bol khat cha aumpon, Khat a khat cha jong aumpoi.

tcz: Setna bolten hetna anei lou u hintem? Amahohin kamite changlhah bang'in aneuvin, Yahweh Pakai komin la taoding agelpouve.
en_web: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
en_kjv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “kamite bahgam get gut’a Thilse jeng bolte hin hetna aneilou mongu hiya, Kahenga jong hung tao louhel hiuvam?” ati.

tcz: Amahohi tijatnan alodim diuahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in athua nung ho aumpin ahi.
en_web: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
en_kjv: There were they in great fear: For God is in the generation of the righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ngailute vang Pathenin aumpin, thilse bolte hi kichat tijat’a mah thah diu ahi.

tcz: Migilou ten bolgentheija umho tohgon asuhsetpeh jiuvin, ahin Yahweh Pakai in amite ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
en_web: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
en_kjv: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, Because the Lord is his refuge.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bolten mi nun nem thilgon dunoh jongle, Ama chu Pakaiya kisel jing ahinai.

tcz: Zion molsang a kon a Israel huhdoh dinga koi hungding ham? Yahweh Pakai in amite aki-ledohsah kit teng, Jacob in kipana asap phon a, Israel in Elohim Pathen athangvah ding ahi.
en_web: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
en_kjv: O that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe Zion akona kon Israel ahuhhing ding ham? Pakaiyin amite apuikhom tengleh Jacob dia iti kipa uma, Israel dia nun nop iti um ding hitam?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai na intheng sunga, kon nangma nahou ding hitam? Koiham nalhang thenga na angsunga hunglut ding?
en_web: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
en_kjv: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, koiham nahouin a lut thei? Koiham, nalhang theng Zion a Nangma houtheiya?

tcz: Hitobang mi themmona bei, thil dihjeng bol, lungthim theng pumma thudih jeng seiho.
en_web: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
en_kjv: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh the truth in his heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijakaiya Pathen thu nit’a, THildih bol jing jeng; Thudih le thutah jeng seiji,

tcz: Akam a miseiset ding nomlou chule aheng akom chunga thilse bollou, ahiloule aloi agol chunga thilse seinomlou.
en_web: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
en_kjv: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his neighbour, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang house louhel mi, Agol apaite alam louva bol lou, Aheng akom seise lou,

tcz: Chonset kithang-atpiho theinomlou va, Yahweh Pakai dihtah a juiho ngaisanga, chuleh itobangin hahsa jongleh akitepna nitjingho.
en_web: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
en_kjv: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; But he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen isah loumi not thap theiya, Pakai gingte jabol jing, Itobanga hahsa hi jongleh Akitepna tuhcha a khel kit lou mi hiding ahi.

tcz: Athoi lalouva sumpa homho chuleh setna neilouho, ahethemlou ho lhemlha a phatchomna sum hol lou. Hitobang miho chu ahinkhouva dingdet jingding ahiuve.
en_web: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
en_kjv: He that putteth not out his money to usury, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin akan beiyin sum aphal jin, Themmonabeite hehnan nehguh akilahpoi. Koi hileh hitobanga chona thilbol mi chu Imachan asuh long louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Neihoibitnin O Elohim Pathen: ajeh chu nangahi kinem jing kahi.
en_web: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
en_kjv: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinbel’e Pathen, Neihoidamin!

tcz: O Kalhagao, nangman Yahweh Pakai koma Nanghi ka Pakai nahi nati, thilpha kaneijouse hi nanga kon bou ahi;
en_web: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
en_kjv: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: My goodness extendeth not to thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai koma, “Ka-Pakai nahin, Thilpha kanei jouse nangin neipeh ahi,” kati.

tcz: Leiset a Elohim Pathen lhentumte hi pachat umtah ahiuvin, amahohi keidinga kagal lamkai le kakipa thanop napen ahiuve.
en_web: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
en_kjv: But to the saints that are in the earth, And to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai dia kitah mite apha thei lheh jengun, alah-uva jao ding kakipana pen ahi.

tcz: Pathen dangho nung jui a delle ho chu alung khamnao kibejing ding ahi. Amaho thisan a kilhaina ganthat a pang ka hilou ding, a pathen nu jong kahoupeh loudiu ahi.
en_web: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
en_kjv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: Their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take up their names into my lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Doihouten gimna tampi akiboldoh-un, Akithoinauva pang pong ting, Adoiyu jong houpeh ponge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi ka chanding gou le ka phatthei channa khon chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in ka ijakai eichintup peh e.
en_web: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
en_kjv: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, kagoulupen nang nahin, ka-ngaichat abonchan neipei; Kakhonung thu jong nakhut’a aum’e.

tcz: Nangin neipeh gam jonghi gamphapen ahi, itobanga goupha kidang neipeh hitam!
en_web: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
en_kjv: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
tcz_gospelgo: Neithilpeh chengse akidang theiyin, Abonchan apha thei lheh jenge!

tcz: Ijakai eihilla ka Yahweh Pakai chu keiman thangvah inge; janteng jong le avel in eigeldoh sah jin eihil jie.
en_web: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
en_kjv: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: My reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
tcz_gospelgo: Eithumop jing Pakai kavahchoiyin, Jan teng jongle kalunggil’in eihil chah jinge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in eiumpi danhi keiman hetna kanei jinge. Amahi kakomma naichakhatna um ahi ti kahen hijeh chun keima lungthomhao ponge.
en_web: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
en_kjv: I have set the Lord always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eiumpi jing kahen, Naicha aumjeh-in iman eisulong ponte.

tcz: Hijeh hin keima kalung amongsellin chuleh kipanan kadimmin Elohim Pathen kathangvah e.
en_web: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
en_kjv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: My flesh also shall rest in hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh hin kakipah-in katha nom’e, Chule lung mongtah-in ka-um’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin thina mun a neidalha pon natin namitheng te jong lhankhuh a lhahlutsah pon nate.
en_web: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
en_kjv: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; Neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina thahat’a konin neichudoh tan, Na-ngailut mi chu noimigama nadalhapoi.

tcz: Nangin hinnalampi chu neimusah'in natin, neiumpi jal a kipana le nei umpina tonsot nopna chu nei pen nate.
en_web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
en_kjv: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; At thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna lampi neihil ding, Nei-umpi kakipah-in, a-itih, a din eilung lhaisah tai.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai adih thumna a kaka ogin hi nei jahpeh in, katao nahi nei ngaipeh in, lungthengsel le dih tah katao ahi.
en_web: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
en_kjv: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, thudih lenna dia katao ngaiyin, Panpi ngaicha kakougin khohsah-in! Lung thengsel’a kataona ngaiyin.

tcz: Kathem chan na neiphondoh peh'in, ajeh chu nangin thudih a natong namuchet ahi.
en_web: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
en_kjv: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih nahetjeh-in Them neichanin.

tcz: Nangin kalunggel ho napatep jin, janteng jongle kalungsung navelhaji. Nangin kapum changin neivechillin kathepmo na namupoi; kakamsung jenga jong set na potlou ding ahitai.
en_web: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
en_kjv: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungthim nahei. Janteng neihung vil jin, Neikholchil soh keiyin, kalung sunga thilse namudoh deh poi.

tcz: Keiman nathupeh Dan dungjuiin, migilou ho le mi-engseho ho khonung kajui ji poi.
en_web: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
en_kjv: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang bangin thuse ka seipon, Nathupeh kanit jingin, Hutot le pumhat kamangpoi.

tcz: Kakalson dan hin nalampi kajui jingin nangma lampia konnin kapotdoh pon ahi.
en_web: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
en_kjv: Hold up my goings in thy paths, That my footsteps slip not.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalampi kajui jingin, kapampot kha hih laiye.

tcz: Keima nangma komma taova kahi ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangin neisanpeh teiding kahei. Kataona hi lunglut tah'in neingaipeh in.
en_web: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
en_kjv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihouji kahen nahenga kataove Pathen! Hung kihei kit’in kasei neingaipeh-in!

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chu kidangtah in neimusah'in, agalmitea konna hoidohna ngaichaho chu nathahatna gimneitah chun nahuh doh ji e.
en_web: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
en_kjv: Shew thy marvellous loving-kindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee From those that rise up against them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset kidangtah hinphongin neihuhhingun, Nakoma ka-um tengu kamelmateuva konin kahoidoh theiyui.

tcz: Nangman namit teni na chintup jing bangin keima jong nei vesuijin. Nalhaving limnoija chun neisellin.
en_web: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
en_kjv: Keep me as the apple of the eye, Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
tcz_gospelgo: Namit chang bangin neihuh-in, Nalhaving noiya neisel’in;

tcz: Kavel a eidoujing migilouho a kon in eivengtup in, eithatgo kamelma hoa konnin nei huhdoh in.
en_web: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
en_kjv: From the wicked that oppress me, From my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloutea konin neihuhdoh-in. Mithat ngam melmaten eiumchah tauve;

tcz: Amahohi mi khotona bei ahiuvin akiletsah nao thucheng chu ngaitan!
en_web: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
en_kjv: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.
tcz_gospelgo: Khotona bei, kiletsah tah a thusei ahiuve.

tcz: Amahon eihin juilutnun eiumkimvel uvin tola selhuh dingin agomkom ahol un ahi.
en_web: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
en_kjv: They have now compassed us in our steps: They have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: Eiumchah kheh tauvin, kakiheina lam lama voh lhuh din eichanguve.

tcz: Anehding changlhih le keipi bahkai hangtah bang le keipinou vin gamthip lai matding avetlhih le tobang ahiuve.
en_web: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
en_kjv: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei sachan bangin eichanguvin, Boteljeng din eigouve.

tcz: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai kidintepin lang seplhu jengin! Nachemjammin migilouhoa konnin neihuhdoh in.
en_web: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
en_kjv: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
tcz_gospelgo: Hungin Pakai, kamelmate kadintepin, Akhup athal’in leh-in jouvin! Nachemjam hemhat panin Migilotea konin neihuhdoh loiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai naban thathatnin vannoia ama phatchomna ngaito hohi sumangin. Amavang nangma goulu hohi nangman vah va jing in. Achateu neijong suhnengpeh inlang ason apahteu goulo ding geija adalhah peh theina diuvin gontoh peh'in.
en_web: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
en_kjv: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, From men of the world, which have their portion in this life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: They are full of children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset mihaotea konin neihuhhingin, Athoh diuva nagonsa gentheina chu achate diuvin jong thoh khop hihen, Atuteuvin jong hin thoh khopset’u hen!

tcz: Monabeija hinkho Kaman jeh a namel kamu teiding ahi. Kathodoh tengleh nangma toh kimaitoa ikimuto ding chule kalungnachim tante.
en_web: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
en_kjv: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken vang adih lou kabol pon, Namu tei nange; Ka-ihmut khahlo teng, nei-umpi jing kipa pinge.

tcz: Keiman nangma kangailui Yahweh Pakai; Nangma hi kathahatna nahi.
en_web: I love you, LORD, my strength.
en_kjv: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Kahatna Pakai, Nangma ka-ngailui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kasongpi, kakulpi, chuleh eihuhhingpu ahin, Elohim ka Pathen hi kasongpi ahin eiveng tup jing ahi. Amahi kalumdal, eihuhhinga thahat chu ahin, chuleh kahoidohna munpi chu ahi.
en_web: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
en_kjv: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu eihoidam Kakulpi dettah bang ahi. Ka-Pathen chu eihoidam ahin, Eiumpi teng kalung monge. Keidin lungdal’in apang jin, Eihuh-in eihoidohjie.

tcz: Keiman thangvah dinga lomtah Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, aman kamelmatea konnin eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en_web: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
en_kjv: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kakouvin kamelmatea konin eihuhdoh-e. Vahchoiyun Pakai chu!

tcz: Thina khoisatna chun eiumkimvel tan, manthahna twipi chun eichup tan ahi.
en_web: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
en_kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina khaovin eikanchalsoh tan, Manthahnan lui bangin eilonvuh tai.

tcz: Damun lungkhamna chun eiumkimvelin, kalampi a thinan thang akam e.
en_web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
en_kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: The snares of death prevented me.
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigam khaovin eihenchalsoh tan, Kamasanga thina thang akikamtai.

tcz: Ka lungkham val phatnin Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, Elohim ka Pathen komma chun panpi ngaichan kataovin Aman ahouin thenga konnin kataona asangin ahi.
en_web: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
en_kjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry came before him, even into his ears.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagenthei teng Pakaiya kataovin, Eipanpi din ka-Pathen kakouve. Ahouin a ka-ogin angaiyin, Kithopi din ka-kagin ajatai.

tcz: Hi jouchun leiset akilingin akihot e. Molbul ho jeng jong kihot e ajeh chu Elohim Pathen lunghang a ahi.
en_web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
en_kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the hills moved And were shaken, because he was wroth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset akilingin akihottai; Molsang bulpi jouse akithingsoh tai. Ajeh chu Pathen lung hang ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nah hom a meikhu ahung potdoh in, meikou gimneitah akam a konnin ahungkou doh'in chuleh Mei-am al lenglung Ama-a konnin ahung koudoh'in ahi.
en_web: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
en_kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen nahhoma meikhu akitungdoh-in, akamsunga konin mi leolih thei maikoule mei-am ahungdoh-e.

tcz: Aman vanho chu ahongdoh'in meilom thimletlut chu ahin chotphan ahung kumsuh in,
en_web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
en_kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: And darkness was under his feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol aphetkeh-in, Meilhang jinglet lut chotphan ahungkumlhai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu vantil pipui khat chunga atouvin, huipi chu alhavingin amangin alengin ahi.
en_web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
en_kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: Yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
tcz_gospelgo: Cherub chunga touvin hamvil’in alengin, Khopihui lhavingin mangin akilhohsah-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu muthim in ahung kitom in, meilom twi jingletlut pumin ahung lhungin ahi.
en_web: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
en_kjv: He made darkness his secret place; His pavilion round about him Were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang thimlai akitomsah-in, Twi dimset meilhang thimket kut akitomsah-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vah'in ahintom chu meilom satah'in ahinkhu khum in gelchang le mei-am chu gojuh'in ahung julhan ahi.
en_web: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
en_kjv: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, Hail-stones and coals of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhang thimlaiya konin gel alhan, Meisi apah lah lah-in kol aphelah lah-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu vanna konnin ahung kisen in hatchungnung ogin chu gelchang leh mei-am koulah achun akithongin ahi.
en_web: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
en_kjv: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, And the Highest gave his voice; Hail-stones and coals of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin vanthamjolpi akithinsah-in, Hatchungnungpen ogin thong akijai.

tcz: Aman athalpi ahin kapmin agalmiho chu athe cheh'in, avah em lahlah chun amaho chu asuboi gamtan ahi.
en_web: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
en_kjv: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; And he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
tcz_gospelgo: Thalpi chang akap’in amelmate adeljamsoh tai; Kolphe vahlap lap’in alhan amelmate anojam’e.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin nagalmi ho napho a lunghangtah a nakisen chun twikhanglen ato geijin akikangin, leiset bulpi jouse jong akeuvin aumjie.
en_web: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
en_kjv: Then the channels of waters were seen, And the foundations of the world were discovered At thy rebuke, O Lord, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, namelmate naphoa, Lung hanga nahohsal tengleh; Twikhanglen tochin geiyin akimun, Leiset bulpi jouse geiyin akimudoh-e.

tcz: Aman vanna konnin akhut ahin lhangin eihin kaidoh'in, twipi thuh lah'a kon in jong eikaidoh'in ahi.
en_web: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
en_kjv: He sent from above, he took me, He drew me out of many waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Chunga konin Pakaiyin eisangin eituh-in, Lithuh laiya konin eikaidoh jie.

tcz: Aman kagalmi hattah tah ho a konin eihuh doh in, kasang a hatjo ka dougal hoa kon in eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en_web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
en_kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadoulel hel melma thahat tah, Hot le mah a eibol chengsea konin Pakaiyin eihuhdoh tai.

tcz: Hahsatna kato pettah'in amahon eihin delkhum un ahinlah Yahweh Pakai in eipanpin ahi.
en_web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
en_kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: But the Lord was my stay.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagenthei pet’a einokhum vangun, Pakaiyin eihoidam jingnai.

tcz: Aman kahoidohna mun nah eipuilut in eihuhdoh tai ajeh chu ama kipana kahi.
en_web: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
en_kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichat tijatnaa jong eipanpin, Eilung lhaijeh-in eihuhdoh tai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in kipaman eipen mona kaneilou jeh'in eikiledohsah tai.
en_web: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
en_kjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih kaboljeh-in Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, Themmonabei kahijeh-in phatthei eiboh-e.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai lampi kajui in, thilse lam jon'in Elohim Pathen'a kon'in kakiheimang poi.
en_web: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
en_kjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Danthu kanit jingin, Pathena konin kakihei mang khapoi.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chonphatna lampi kajui jingin, a Dan thupeh ho kapaidoh khapoi.
en_web: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
en_kjv: For all his judgments were before me, And I did not put away his statutes from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Adanthu kanitsoh keiyin, Athupeh kanit lou aumpoi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen masangah nolnabei kahin, chonsetna kon'in kaki kangse jing e.
en_web: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
en_kjv: I was also upright before him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei kahiya, adihlou bol lou kahi Pakaiyin ahesoh keinai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in Aman kipaman eipejin ahi. Aman themmonabei kahi amui.
en_web: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
en_kjv: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih kaboljeh leh themmonabei kahijeh a Pakaiyin kipaman eipeh ahi.

tcz: Mikitah kom'ah nangmatah jong nakitah'in, monabei ho kom'ah monabei nahi.
en_web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
en_kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; With an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai nadia kitahte hcunga nakitah-in, Achamkimte chunga nachamkimsoh-e.

tcz: Milungtheng ho kom'ah nalungtheng in ahinlah miphalouho kom'ah nakhohjin ahi.
en_web: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
en_kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; And with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
tcz_gospelgo: Alung thengte din nalung thengin, Agiloute vang doumah-in nabol’e.

tcz: Nangin mikineosah ho nahuhdohjin ahinla mikiletsah ho nasujumjin ahi.
en_web: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
en_kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But wilt bring down high looks.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nun nemho nahuhdoh jin, Kiletsahte vang nasuneove.

tcz: Nangin thaomei neidetpeh'in, Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen'in kamuthim jong neisalvah peh e.
en_web: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
en_kjv: For thou wilt light my candle: The Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nangin thaomei neivah peh-in, Kavel’a muthim nasalvah soh tai.

tcz: Nangma hatna chun kagalmi hi neisuhchip peh'in Elohim ka Pathen toh kapankhom poupou leh itobang bang sang hijongleh kakal ngapchan ahi.
en_web: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
en_kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop; And by my God have I leaped over a wall.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate nokhumna thei thaneipen, Akulpiu chop khup theina thahat neipei.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lampi chu nolnabei ahi! Yahweh Pakai kitepna jouse alolhing jinge. Amahi ahuhdoh ding ngaicha jouse dinga lum le pho ahi.
en_web: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
en_kjv: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of the Lord is tried: He is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang Pathen, atoh jousea chamkimsoh! Asei jouse ki-ngaina thei! Ama belte dinga Lumdal apang ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tailou pathen dang um'am? Elohim Pathen tailou songpi det dang um'am?
en_web: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
en_kjv: For who is God save the Lord? Or who is a rock save our God?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kiti chu Pakai bou ahin, Ikiselnau Songpi Pathen bou ahi.

tcz: Hiche Elohim Pathen hin eihatdoh sah'in kalampi jong hoibitnapen ahisah ahi.
en_web: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
en_kjv: It is God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Pathen hi eihetsah a, Kalampi suhong jing ahi.

tcz: Aman molsang hahsa chung dunga kadindet theina din kakeng jong sakhi keng bang'in atah sah e.
en_web: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
en_kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, And setteth me upon my high places.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakengto jong sakhi kengto abahsah-in, Molvuma dettah-in eidinsah theiye.

tcz: Aman kakhut teni jong galsatna a manthei dingin agongin, kabanjang jong sum-eng thalpi loithei dingin ahatsah'in ahi.
en_web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
en_kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, So that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakhutte ni galbolje ahil’in, Kaban thahat’in sum-eng thalvhang kaheh kontheiye.

tcz: Nangman nagaljona lum chu neipetan nabanjetnin neipanhun ahi. Neikithopina hin eithupi sah'in ahi.
en_web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
en_kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, neihuhhingin neihoidamtai; Nabanjet’in neituh jingin, Nathahat chun neichoi-an’e.

tcz: Nang man kakeng phang tenin alhonal louna dingin kalampi neikehlet peh'in ahi.
en_web: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
en_kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, That my feet did not slip.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachotna ding lampi jaotah-in nasemin Kakisap lhu khapoi.

tcz: Keiman kagalmite kadel'in kaman'in ahi; amahohi kajo kahsen katangpon ahi.
en_web: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
en_kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: Neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate kadeldel jengin kamanten, Kasuhgam kahsen kahai hih-e.

tcz: Amahohi ahung ki thodoh jou louna diuvin kasat lhun kakeng noijah akijammun ahi.
en_web: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
en_kjv: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: They are fallen under my feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasat chap soh keiyin athou thei tapouve; Ka-angsunga akijam’uvin akchotphai.

tcz: Nangin kagalsatna dingin thahatnan neivon in; Nangman kagalmite chu kakengphang noi a neikoipeh e.
en_web: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
en_kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Galsatna ding thahat neipen, Kamelmate jona neipetai.

tcz: Nangin angongchang'u neichotpha sah'in eivetda ho jouse chu kasumang sohtan ahi.
en_web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
en_kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; That I might destroy them that hate me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate nadeljamin, Eihotbolte kasumangtai.

tcz: Amahon panpi athummun koiman ahung huhdoh pouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai akouvun ahinla Aman adonbut pon ahi.
en_web: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
en_kjv: They cried, but there was none to save them: Even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithopi ding akou vangun koiman ahuhdoh poi; Pakai henga atao vangun adonbutpoi.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu huilah a vutvai kithethang bangin tol ah kagoibong sel'in, bonlhoh lah'a kasunat gamatai.
en_web: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
en_kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachilgoisel’in, hui lhoh mang thei Leivui kabahsah tai. Kholai dung bonlhoh bangin Kakengton kachil thang thange.

tcz: Nangin eihouse jing ho chungah galjona neipetan ahi. Nangin namtin vaipi chungah vaihom'in neipansah tan ahi. Kanahet phahlou miho jeng jong kalhachan ahungpang tauvin ahi.
en_web: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
en_kjv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; And thou hast made me the head of the heathen: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, doumah boltea konin neihuhdoh-in, Namtin vaipi chunga vaihomin neipansah tai; Kahetphah louhel mite jong Kalhachan napansah-e!

tcz: Kamin ajah jah'un kanoijah alut un gamchommi hojeng jong ka-anga akisunem gamtauvin ahi.
en_web: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
en_kjv: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: The strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamchom mite ka-angsunga akun’un, Kasei seiyin achon jengui.

tcz: Hansanna aneijou tapouvin kithing pumpum'in ka-ang ahinbel tauvin ahi.
en_web: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
en_kjv: The strangers shall fade away, And be afraid out of their close places.
tcz_gospelgo: Ameidoi soh tauvin, Akulpiuva konin kihotset sut’in ahung potdoh-ui.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ahing jinge, kasongpia apanjeh'in kathangvah e! Ka sochatna Elohim ka Pathen chu loupi jing tahen!
en_web: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
en_kjv: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; And let the God of my salvation be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Hing jing Pakai, kakiselna Songpi chu vahchoiyun! Eihuhhing Pathen loupina phongjal leuvin!

tcz: Amahi eibolse ho lethuh jinga Elohim ka Pathen chu ahin, aman namtin vaipi hi eisuhnem peh'in kanoijah eikoipeh tai.
en_web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
en_kjv: It is God that avengeth me, And subdueth the people under me.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman kamelmate eijosah tan, Kadougalte eijosah-in,

tcz: Chuleh kagalmitea konnin eihuhdoh'in nangman kagalmiten aphah joulouna munnah neikoijin, eidouva mi-engse hoa konnin neihoidohsah tan ahi.
en_web: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
en_kjv: He delivereth me from mine enemies: Yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: Thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin kanoiya alutsah soh tai! O Pakai, kamelmate neijosah tan, pumhat mitea konin neihoisamtai!

tcz: Hichejeh hin O Yahweh Pakai namtin vaipi lah'a nathangvah ingkate, na min vahchoinan la sang nge.
en_web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
en_kjv: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, And sing praises unto thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin jalah a nachoi-an ing ting, Navahchoi la sang’e.

tcz: Nangin leng a natun pa din goljona loupitah chu napetai; Chuleh nathaonupa David leh achilhahte chunga nalungset longlou namusah e.
en_web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
en_kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; And sheweth mercy to his anointed, To David, and to his seed for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Lenga atun chu Pakaiyin minthangtah-in gal ajosah-in, Adeilhenpa chu anailu jing jenge! Ddavid le ahilhahte tonsot’in angailui.

tcz: Vanho'n Elohim Pathen loupina aphongdoh un ahi. Vanthamjol hon jong akhut thepna atahlangui.
en_web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
en_kjv: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament sheweth his handywork.
tcz_gospelgo: Van mun jousen Pathen loupina aphongin, Vanthamjol’in jong akhutsoh aseidoh-e!

tcz: Anitin in aphongdoh jing jeng un; jansim janseh le amachu aseiphong jingui.
en_web: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
en_kjv: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night sheweth knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunin jing nikho aseipeh-in, Tujanin jingnilhah aseison peh-e.

tcz: Ocheng soh lou vin thu asei un; a ocheng'u hi akijakha ngaipoi.
en_web: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
en_kjv: There is no speech nor language, Where their voice is not heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Hetthei thucheng amansauva, Jah thei oginga apao lou vangun;

tcz: Ahinlah athu chun vainoi alodim in, thucheng jong chun vannoi leiset athechansoh in ahi. Vanthamjol hoa Elohim Pathen in nisa chenna ding asem peh e.
en_web: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
en_kjv: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahusau vannoiya akithangsoh tan, Leiset kolkimvel’a min ajasoh tai. Vanthamjol’a Pathenin nichang din ponbuh asonpeh-in,

tcz: Hihchu kichen jouva moulang emsel a ahung potdoh bangin avahchan jengin ahi. Kisongtah a lhaitet golseh a pango bang in haltah le kipah tah in aum e.
en_web: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
en_kjv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah teng jinei thah pa kipah tah bangle Kilhaitetnaa pang dingpa bangin ahung soh dohjie.

tcz: Vanmong langkhatna konnin nisa ahung sohdoh jin ajotna ding vanmong lang khat gei in ajui peh jie. Hiche asat a kon chun imacha ahoidoh ji poi.
en_web: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
en_kjv: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, And his circuit unto the ends of it: And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanmong lang khat’a pat Van mong lang khat ajon’e. Nisa satnaa hin thil akisel thei aumpoi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thuhil hohi achamkim in, lhagaova asuhhal jing in ahi. Yahweh Pakai Dan thu hohi tahsanthei tah ahin milham jong chihsah jengthei ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
en_kjv: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Danthu hi achamkimsoh-in, Tha akidosah jie. Pakai thupeh ho hi tahsan lomtah ahin, Lungthimbeite achihsah jie.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi adih'in, lungthim kipasah ji e. Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi akicheh'in lungsunga hetthem theina eipeuvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
en_kjv: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Danthu chengse adih cheh-in, Hicheng nit jing hin nom asauve. Pakai thupeh chengse akicheh-in, Lungthim sunga hettheina apetheiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginle jana neihi athengin ahi, hichehi tonsotna ding ahitai. Yahweh Pakai thutan hi adih'e; a etih a dih jing jeng ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: The judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hou hi thilphapen ahin, Beitih anei louhel ding ahi. Pakai thutan jouse adih cheh-in, Itih-in jong aphasoh keiye.

tcz: Hicheho chu sana sanga deiumjo ahin, sana thengpen sanga jong deiumjo ahi. Khoiju sangin jong alhumjon, akhoiphang dunga kilhoh lhatil sangin jong alhumjoi.
en_web: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
en_kjv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
tcz_gospelgo: Sanathengsel sanga dei umjo ahin, Khoiju thengsel sanga lhumjo ahi.

tcz: Hicheho hi nasohpa dinga gihsal na ahin, nathu nung hoa dia kipana chanvou lentah ahi.
en_web: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
en_kjv: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: And in keeping of them there is great reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hin nasoh keima ima eihetsah jin, Kanit jeh hin kipaman kasang’e.

tcz: Kalungsunga chonset kisel guh jouse hi itikahetdoh jouding ham? Hitobanga kiselgua setna hoa konhin neisilthengin.
en_web: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
en_kjv: Who can understand his errors? Cleanse thou me from secret faults.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman ama themmona akihetdoh loujeh-in, Kathemmona kisel chengsea konin neisil thengin Pakai!

tcz: Nasoh hi henasasa chonset bolna a konnin neihuhdoh'in! Hicheho hi kachunga vaihomsah hihbeh'in, chuteng keima chonsetna a konna kahoidoh ding ahi.
en_web: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
en_kjv: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
tcz_gospelgo: Hettoh lou chonset chengsea konin neihoidoh-in, Hiche ho chu neijotho sahdan! Chuteng chonset thilsea ongthol ing ting kachamkimsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Kakam a kon'a hung potdoh thucheng holeh kalungsunga kalunggel ho nalunglhaina hihen, O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi leh eihuhhingpu.
en_web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
en_kjv: Let the words of my mouth, And the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei ding chengse le kalunggel jouse hi Nang din santhei hihen, O Pakai, Kasongpi le Eilhandampu!

tcz: Na hahsat nikhon Yahweh Pakai'in nakana taona nadonbut hen. Jacob Pathen Elohim min chun thilse jousea kon in nahoidoh hen.
en_web: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
en_kjv: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Nagenthei nin Pakaiyin nalhamon hen, Jacob Pathenin nahoidam jing hen!

tcz: Aman ahouintheng a kon'in kithopina nahin pejing henlang Jerusalem a kon in nahin hatsah jinghen.
en_web: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
en_kjv: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
tcz_gospelgo: Amunthenga konin panpi hinsolpeh hen, Zion lhanga konin nahu ding hinsol hen!

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in namaicham thilto ho hingeldoh jinghen lang chuleh napumgo thiltoho jong khotona in nahin vetpeh jinghen.
en_web: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
en_kjv: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt sacrifice. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathilto chengse sanpeh hen, Nakilhaina chengsea lung lhai hen!

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in nalunga nangaichat nape henlang nathilgon jouse nalolhinsah soh keihen.
en_web: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
en_kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, And fulfil all thy counsel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin nadeichan napehen, Nathilgon jouse lolhinsah hen!

tcz: Nagaljona thu kajah tenguleh kipah'a kasapdiu ahi, chuleh Elohim ka Pathen u minna galjona ponlop kadopsangdiu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in natao na jouse donbut jing hen.
en_web: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
en_kjv: We will rejoice in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: The Lord fulfil all thy petitions.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng keihon nagaljo kipa piuving ting, Pathen vahchoiya naminthan kalop diu ahi. Nathum na-ngeh jouse Pakaiyin nape bukimsoh hen!

tcz: Tun keiman athaonu lengpa chu Yahweh Pakai in ahuhdohji ti ka hetai. Aman avan mun thenga kon a ahin donbut ding, chuleh athahatna nasatah a chu ahuhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
en_kjv: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; He will hear him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin alhentum lengpa gal ajosah kahen, Avan munthenga konin ahouvin, Minthangtah a galjona ding Thahat nasatah tah apei.

tcz: Namtin vaipi abankhat chun a sakol u leh sakol kangtalai hou akiletsah piuvin, ahin eihonvang Yahweh Pakai, eihon Elohim Pathen u minbou ikiletsahpi diu ahi.
en_web: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
en_kjv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: But we will remember the name of the Lord our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kon khat’in galsatna kangtalai ho akisonpin, Abangin asakolteu akisonpiuve; Keiho vang Pakai Ka-Pathenu thahat’a kisong kahiuve.

tcz: Namtin vaipi hohi hunglhu'u vintin chip lhadiu ahi, ahinla eihovang idindoh diu chule dehtah a idin diu ahi.
en_web: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
en_kjv: They are brought down and fallen: But we are risen, and stand upright.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilmanchah a kisongte kipal’uva lhu lham diu, Keiho vang kipatdoh ung ting kadin jang diu ahi.

tcz: Kalengpau chu galjona pe'n, O Yahweh Pakai! Panpi ngai a kakana neidonbut tei in.
en_web: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
en_kjv: Save, Lord: Let the king hear us when we call.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, kalengpau gal josah-in, Kakou tengu neihouvun!

tcz: Nathahatna ahi lengpa iti kipah hitam O Yahweh Pakai! Galjona napehjeh'in aman kipah'in kho asam e.
en_web: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
en_kjv: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nahatsah jeh-in Lengpa akipah-in; Gal najosah jeh-in atha nom’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin alungthim'a angaichan napen aman athumho khatcha jong nadapeh poi.
en_web: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
en_kjv: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Ataona nasangin, Alungdei napetai.

tcz: Nangin lolhin naleh houtheinan nalamto jin, aluchungah sana hoipen lallukhuh nakhuhsah'in ahi.
en_web: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
en_kjv: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
tcz_gospelgo: Phattheina tampi nahinpon, Sana lallkhuh nakhuhpeh tai.

tcz: Aman ahinkho nahoitup peh din athumjin, chule nangin ataona nasanpeh jie. Ahin nikho jong tonsot a din nasuh saopeh ji e.
en_web: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
en_kjv: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan hintheina athumin, Nangman napetai, tonsot tonsot’a hinna!

tcz: Nagaljona chun jabolna lentah achansah in, thupina le loupinan najemhoijin ahi.
en_web: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
en_kjv: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Napanpi jal’in aloupi lheh jengin, Leng loupe minthangin nalhai.

tcz: Nangin tonsot malsomnan naphungvuh in chuleh nangtoh umkhom a nopna kipana achun naphung vuh e.
en_web: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
en_kjv: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: Thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’in naphatthei boh achangin, Naumpi jing akipapi lheh jenge.

tcz: Ajeh chu lengpa'n Yahweh Pakai atahsan e. Hat chungnung ngailutna longlou chun alhuhna dinga konnin na hoidoh sah jingin ahi.
en_web: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
en_kjv: For the king trusteth in the Lord, And through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan Hatchungnung Pakai atahsanin, Pakai lungset longlou jal’in phatseh-in along monge.

tcz: Nangin nagalmiho chu namattup sohkei ding, nangma nadouho jouse chu thahattah na banjetna chu na mattup ding ahi.
en_web: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
en_kjv: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: Thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmate lengpan mankhom-in tin, Ahoa pang jouse amatsoh idng ahi.

tcz: Nangma nahung teng amaho chu meikong lah'a naselut ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai in alunghanna a asuhgam ding meikonga ahalgam ding ahi.
en_web: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
en_kjv: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: The Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung kilah teng Meisi kijep cheh banga ajep cheh ding ahi. Pakaiyin lung hanga abahgam diu, Meiyin ahalvamsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Achateu leiset chunga kon a nathaimang ding; amahon sonlepah aneikitlou diu ahi.
en_web: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
en_kjv: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan athagama Achi abo’u kiholmo hel didng ahi.

tcz: Amahon nangdounan thil gong jongleu, athilse gonhou chu lolhing louding ahi.
en_web: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
en_kjv: For they intended evil against thee: They imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
tcz_gospelgo: Akihoutoh-un lengpa douna asem’un, Ahivanga ajodeh lou du ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon nathalchang amaho kapna dinga nadoi chu amutenguleh kiheimang untin jammang diu ahitai.
en_web: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
en_kjv: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, When thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan ajalah-u thalpia akap’a, Anocheh a adeljamsoh diu ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai na thahat na nasatah a chun hungthou doh tan. Tumgin le lasah to thoa nahat na natoh chu kakipa pi diu ahi.
en_web: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
en_kjv: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahat jal’in kavahchoiyui Pakai, Nathahat vahchoiya lakasah diu ahi.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim, ka Pathen idia neidalhah hitam? Panpi ngai a kamao teng idia gamlha tah a um ji nahim?
en_web: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
en_kjv: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathen, ka-Pathen! I-bol’a neidalhah hitam? Napanpi ngaichan kasam sam jengin, Neipanpi deh hih hel’e!

tcz: Niseh in nangma kakoujie, Elohim ka Pathen, hinlah nangin nei donbut poi. Janseh jongleh kakou ogin naja jin, hinlah lungmon na kanei jipoi.
en_web: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
en_kjv: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathen, sunlaiyin kakouvin Neidonbut deh poi; Jan khovah-in kakouvin, Olnaneipe deh poi!

tcz: Israel'in athangvah jing laltouna-a tou nangmahi Atheng nahi.
en_web: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
en_kjv: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle Nangma nathengin, Laltouna natouvin Israelten navahchoiye.

tcz: Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan un, nangman amaho nahuh hing tai.
en_web: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
en_kjv: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapu kapateuvin naki-ngai nauvin, Nakisonpi jeh-un nahuhhingtai.

tcz: Naheng a akap un huhhing in a umtaove. Amahon nangma natahsan un nang man amaho nasujum poi.
en_web: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
en_kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga ataovun ahoidoh jiuvin, Nakisonpi jeh-un alungthoi khapouve.

tcz: Hinlah keima hi mihem a dia lhing joulou lungtol bang bep kahi. Mijouse dia thet umle musit umchu kahitai!
en_web: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
en_kjv: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Keivang mihem tobang kahitapoi, Lungtol bep kahitai.Kidah lenotthap’in kaumin, Mitinin eihouse se jengui.

tcz: Eimu jousen eihouseovin, aleiju adosah un, alu apeijun asei uve,
en_web: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
en_kjv: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Eimupha chanin eidaithangun, Lei eilhah khumun, lu eithin khum’ui.

tcz: “Ama pa hi Elohim Pathena ki ngai pa chu hilou ham? Achuti le a Pathen Elohim chu kihuhdoh sah hen! Yahweh Pakai in amahi angailut a ahileh aYahweh Pakai in huh doh hen!”
en_web: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
en_kjv: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: Let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakaiya kisong nahine, Iti Aman nahuhhing lou ham? Pakai dei nahileh Idia napanpi da hitam?” atiuve.

tcz: Nangin kanu naobusunga konin neina hoidamin nei pui galkai in, kanu a-anglum laija patna nangma tahsanje neina hil ahitai.
en_web: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
en_kjv: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: Thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, damsel’in neipensah-in, kasenlaiyin jongkanu noitwiyin neivah jinge.

tcz: Kahung pen a patna nangma ban thahatna a eikipelut a ahitai. Kahung penlhah a patna ka Pathen chu nangma nahi jing e.
en_web: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
en_kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: Thou art my God from my mother’s belly.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapen a pat kisonna kanei, Ka-Pathen nahi jinge.

tcz: Keija kon in gamla loujen in ajeh chu boina ahungnai in, koima dang eikithopi thei aumpoi.
en_web: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
en_kjv: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.
tcz_gospelgo: Genthei anaiye neidalha hih-in, Eipanpi ding aumpoi!

tcz: Bongchal ho'n aum kimvel bangin kagal miten eihin um kimvel taovin, Bashan bongchal khohlai hon eium kimvel taove!
en_web: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
en_kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
tcz_gospelgo: Basan phaiya bongchal hattah ho bangin, Kamelmaten eiumkimsoh tauve.

tcz: Hang tah le kisong tah Keipi bahkai in aneh ding aboltel bangin keima val lhum dingin akamkau ve.
en_web: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
en_kjv: They gaped upon me with their mouths, As a ravening and a roaring lion.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakeiyin asatha akisenpia abotel bangin, Kam homlet lut’in eikisen khumtauve.

tcz: Kahinkho hi twi banga kisunglha ahitai, kagu kachang hojong akilhep gamtan, kalungchang jong khoilu bangin ajunlha gamtai.
en_web: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
en_kjv: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted in the midst of my bowels.
tcz_gospelgo: Twi kisung lha bangin katha alhasamin, Kagu kachang alhoiyin, kalungthim khoiluijol abange.

tcz: Nisan asah gep leilhang bangin katha akanghel jengtai. Kaleijong kadang chungah akikamat tai. Nangin vutvai lah a neijam in athidin neida lhatan ahi.
en_web: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
en_kjv: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
tcz_gospelgo: THi dia leivui lah a neidalhah jeh-in, kalolbuh nelgo abangin, kadanga kalei abeh dentai.

tcz: Kagalmiten uichahon bangin eium kimvel taovin. Migilou honkhat in eium kimvel taovin ahi.
en_web: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
en_kjv: For dogs have compassed me: The assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: They pierced my hands and my feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Uihon bangin thilse bol hon eiumkimsoh tan, Kakhut le kakengphang. asunchen chentauve.

tcz: Kagu kachang hojong simthei ahisoh tan. Kagal miten eiveovin eivesalteh jengun ahi.
en_web: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
en_kjv: I may tell all my bones: They look and stare upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagu kachang adohsoh tan, Nehgam ding bangin kamelmaten eive changmel mol’ui.

tcz: Kavon hojong vang asan un akihom gamtaovin ahi.
en_web: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
en_kjv: They part my garments among them, And cast lots upon my vesture.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaponsil chang ding vang asan’un, kavon chengse akihomtauve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keija konin umgamla hih behin! Nangma kathahatna nahi neihung kithopi loijin.
en_web: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
en_kjv: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neidalha loujen O Pakai, Neihuhdoh louyin!

tcz: Nachemjam chun neihuhdoh in, kahinkho manlutah hi hiche uicha hoa kon in neihuhdoh peh in.
en_web: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
en_kjv: Deliver my soul from the sword; My darling from the power of the dog.
tcz_gospelgo: Chemjam masanga neihuhhingin, Ui tobang hoa konin neihuhhingin.

tcz: Keipi bahkai kam a kon in neiloidoh peh in lang hiche gambongchal hang kiteni ki a kon in neihuhdoh in.
en_web: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
en_kjv: Save me from the lion’s mouth: For thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakeite tobang hoa konin neihuhdoh-in, bongchal hang ho tobangte masanga kapang joupoi.

tcz: Kasopi pasal holeh numeiho kom a naminhi phongjal leng katin, Houbung kikhom holah a nangma kathangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
en_kjv: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathilbol kamite seipeh ing ting, Akhoppiuva navahchoila sange!

tcz: Ama gingho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah hen! Jacob chilhahte jousen amachu ging uvin! Israel chate jousen amachu jana peohen!
en_web: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
en_kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai lhachaten Ama vahchoiyun, Jacob chilhahten choi-an’uvin! Israel miten Pakai chibai boh cheh-un!

tcz: Ajeh chu aman migentheite thohgimna jouse chu anungsun pon, panpi ngaichatna a taona neiho angaipeh in ahi.
en_web: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
en_kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin vaicha gentheite Donlou le kidah-in aneipon; Ahenga atao chan’un ahouvin, Akiheimang den khapoi.”

tcz: Keiman Houbung kikhopna lah a nangma kathang vahding ahi. Nangma chibai boh ho angsunga kakitepna kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en_web: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
en_kjv: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nathilbol chengse jeh-in, Houbung khoppia vahchoiyinge Nahou dia kikhomho angsunga Katepsa kilhaina chengse penge.

tcz: Mivaichaten neovintin vaset diu ahi. Yahweh Pakai holte jousen amachu athangvah diu ahi. Alung thim u tonsotna kipah jingding ahiuve.
en_web: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
en_kjv: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: They shall praise the Lord that seek him: Your heart shall live for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaichaten aduchan aneh diu, Aheng hinjon jousen Pakai avahchoi diu ahi. Alungthimu khangtou jing hen!

tcz: Vannoi leiset miten Yahweh Pakai chu ahin hetdoh diu chuleh akom a hung kilediu ahi. Chutengleh namtin vaipi insung jousen a anga hungkun cheh diu ahi.
en_web: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
en_kjv: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Chitin namtinin Pakai ageldoh-uva, Leiset kolkimvel’a Pakai henga ahinjot diu, Namtinin Pakai chu achibai aboh diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu leng thaneina chu Yahweh Pakai ama a bou ahi. Aman namtin vaipi chunga vai ahom ahi.
en_web: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
en_kjv: For the kingdom is the Lord’s: And he is the governor among the nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hi leng achangtan, Namtin chunga vai ahom’e!

tcz: Leiset chunga mihaohon ankong sem untin chibai aboh diu ahi. Ahinkho kichai a leivui sohding athithei mihem jouse a anga kun cheh hen.
en_web: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
en_kjv: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: And none can keep alive his own soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kilsetsahte Pakai angsunga kun a, Thi theimihem jouse angsunga kun cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Ichate jouseuvin jong Ama kin ahinbol diu ahi. Ahung lhungding khang miten jong Yahweh Pakai kidanje chu ahin jahpeh diu ahi.
en_web: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
en_kjv: A seed shall serve him; It shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Khang nununga miten Pakai kin abol’uva, Khang masan khang nukhah jah a Pakai thu asei diu ahi.

tcz: Tua penglou laiho komma jong thudih a anatoh naho jouse hung kiseipeh ding ahi. Amahon athilbol natoh naho jouse ahin jahdiu ahi.
en_web: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
en_kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
tcz_gospelgo: Apeng loulai ho geiya “Pakaiyin amite ahuhhingtai,” ti kiseipeh diu ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu akelngoi keima eiching pa ahi, keiman lhah samna neiponge.
en_web: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
en_kjv: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu kelngoi chin a Eichingpa ahin, Keima lhasam ponge;

tcz: Aman hamhing dumlah lah a kelngoi bangin eikicholdo sahjin, kilinglou hel twiveina pang dungah eipuilei.
en_web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
en_kjv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leadeth me beside the still waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman hamhing dum lah lah a kelngoi kol’in Eikolsah jin, Kiling louva twi veina pang dunga eipui lei.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in katha akiledoh ji. Amintheng khohsahna jalin lamdih lang jenga eipuilen ahi.
en_web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
en_kjv: He restoreth my soul: He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin katha akidosah kit’in, Akitepsa bangin lamdih jenga eipuiye.

tcz: Thim jin napen phaicham palgalkai jongleng keima kichaponge, ajeh chu nangman naum jing in nateng gol le namoljol chun neihongin neilhamon jinge.
en_web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
en_kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina phaicham jinglah jotpa jong leng Neilhonpi jeh-in Ima kaging tapoi, Pakai Natenggol’in neihong in, namoljol’in neilha mon nai.

tcz: Ka melmate masangtah jenga jong nangin kaneh ding ankong neiluipeh in, naphat theina thao ka lujangah neinupeh in kadon ding khonjong phatthei na aletset in ahi.
en_web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
en_kjv: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate masang jenga jong, Kaneh ding dokanga neiluipeh-in; Kalua thao neinu peh-in, Kadon ding khon alet lhai.

tcz: Tahbeh in phatnale hepinan kahinkho lhung keiya eijui jingding ahi, chuleh keijong tonsot na Yahweh Pakai inn sunga kachenjing ding ahi.
en_web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
en_kjv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: And I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Phatna le hepi nan Kahinkho lhumkeiyin eijuiyin tin, Kahin kumkhoa Pakai in a kachen den ding ahi.

tcz: vannoi leiset le asunga umjouse hi Yahweh Pakai a ahi. Vannoi pumpi le asunga cheng mihemte jousehi Ama a jeng ahi.
en_web: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
en_kjv: The earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset le asunga um thil jouse Pakaiya ahin, Leiset le achung chengte Abonchauva Pakaiya ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman leiset khombul hi twikhanglen chunga atun ahin, twipi thuhlah a aphudet ahi.
en_web: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
en_kjv: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin twipi lailunga leiset asemdoh a, Twikhanglen chunga atundoh ahi.

tcz: Koiham Yahweh Pakai moul chunga kaldoh jouding? Koiham amunthenga dingthei ding?
en_web: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
en_kjv: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? And who shall stand in his holy place?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai lhangvuma kalthei koi hiya, Ahouin thenga lut thei koiham?

tcz: Akhut le Alungthim thengho bou, chuleh milim semthu houlou le jou seilouho bou hidiu ahi.
en_web: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
en_kjv: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lift up his soul unto vanity, Nor sworn deceitfully.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bol lou, milung theng, Doi houlou, jouthua kitep lou mi ahi.

tcz: Amahon bou Yahweh Pakai malsomna amudiu ahin, chuleh ahuh hingpao Elohim Pathen toh ki guijop na dihtah aneitheidiu ahi.
en_web: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
en_kjv: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi Pakaiyin phatthei boh-in tin Ahuhhing diu; Themmonabei ahinau Pathenin phongdoh inte.

tcz: Hitobang miho hinbou nangma naholthei diu chuleh Jacob Elohim Pathen nangma nachibai theidiu ahi.
en_web: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
en_kjv: This is the generation of them that seek him, That seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang mi chu Pathen henga hunguva, Jacob Pathen angsunga lut diu ahi.

tcz: Khanglui kelkot ho kihonglen un! Khanglui kotpiho kihong len un lang leng loupi chu lutsah un.
en_web: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
en_kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; And the King of glory shall come in.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo kotpi, nang ho kihong len’un, Kotpilui cheng kihongun; Loupi leng hung lutna din!

tcz: Koiham lengloupi chu? Yahweh Pakai hattah leh thupi tah, Yahweh Pakai koiman ajojou lou galhattah chu ahi.
en_web: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
en_kjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Leng loupe hi koi ham? Pakai Hatchungnung, Galjousoh Pakai ahi!

tcz: Khanglui kelkot ho kihong lennun, khanglui kotpiho kihong lennun, loupina leng chu lutsah un
en_web: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
en_kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; And the King of glory shall come in.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo kotpi, nang ho kihong ken’un, Kotpilui cheng kihongun; Loupi Leng hung lutna din!

tcz: Koiham lengloupi chu? Van Elohim Pathen sepai, Ama hi leng loupi chu ahi.
en_web: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
en_kjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Leng loupe hikoiham? Galjousoh Pakai, Ama leng loupe ahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kahinkho hi nang kapetai.
en_web: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
en_kjv: (א) Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai nahenga kataove!

tcz: Nang katahsan e Elohim ka Pathen! Nei jumso hihbeh in, chule kalel na a hin ka melmate kichoisang sah hihbeh in.
en_web: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
en_kjv: O my God, (ב) I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunga ki-ngai kahi ka-Pathen, Neijumso dan, kamelmate kipasah hih-in!

tcz: Nangma tahsan koimachan jumna ato loudiu ahi, amavang mijoulhep gojing honvang jumna ato diu ahi.
en_web: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
en_kjv: (ג) Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: Let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanga kisongten ima alel khapon, Nadoumah bolloi minbou aleljie.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lamdih chu neihil in; kajuiding lampi chu neiko peh in.
en_web: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
en_kjv: (ד) Shew me thy ways, O Lord; Teach me thy paths.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nalampi neihil’in, Abonchan neihetsah soh-in!

tcz: Nathutah chu neihil in hichea chun neipui in ajeh chu nangmahi eihuh hinga Elohim ka Pathen chu nahi. Nilhum kei keijin nanga hin kinepna kanei jinge.
en_web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
en_kjv: (ה) Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: For thou art the God of my salvation; On thee do I wait all the day.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathen nahin, neihuhhinge; Nadih ddudngjuiya hinje neihil’in, Nanga ki-ngaijingkahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai gol lui a patna neihin puinao nami khoto nale na mingailutna longlou hingeldoh in.
en_web: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
en_kjv: (ז) Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; For they have been ever of old.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, akhang khanga naphondohsa Namikhoto l enalungset long lou geldoh jingin!

tcz: Ka khangdon lai a kachonset gitlou naho neigeldoh peh hih inlang nami ngailutna longlouva neipuina johchu galdoh in, ajeh chu nangma milungset them nahi, O Yahweh Pakai.
en_web: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
en_kjv: (ח) Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy mercy remember thou me For thy goodness’ sake, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdon lai kachonset ho le katoh khel ho Nei-ngaidam tan. Lungset long lou le naphatna jal’in Neigeldoh jingin Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi apha ahin adih jengbou abol'e, aman lamdihlou vache ho jeng jong lamdih akopeh jinge.
en_web: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
en_kjv: (ט) Good and upright is the Lord: Therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai adih a aphat jeh-in Chonsete achena diu lampi ahil’e.

tcz: Aman mi kineosah hochu lamdih a apuijin, ama dei lampi chu ahil jinge.
en_web: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
en_kjv: (י) The meek will he guide in judgment: And the meek will he teach his way.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nun nemte lamdoh a a puiyin, Alungdei ahiljie.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kitepna nitjing holeh ama deipeh dungjuija chonho chu ami ngailutna longlou leh akitahna in apuihoi jinge.
en_web: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
en_kjv: (כ) All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungsetnan kitah tah-in apuiyin, Akitepna le athupeh nit ho apuiye.

tcz: Namin loupina dingin O Yahweh Pakai, ka chonsetna simjoulou neingai dam in.
en_web: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
en_kjv: (ל) For thy name’s sake, O Lord, Pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nakitepna nit’in, Neingaidamin kachonset atam behseh tai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ging ho chu koi ho hiuvam? Amaho che nading lampi chu Yahweh Pakai in avetsah ding ahi.
en_web: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
en_kjv: (מ) What man is he that feareth the Lord? Him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thu nit hon amaa kona Achena diu lampi akiholdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu khangtou untin achateovin jong gamsung alodingu ahi.
en_web: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
en_kjv: (נ) His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang miho hikhagntou diu, Achateuvin gamsung ahinlo diu ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi ama gingjing tedinga golphapen ahin, Aman hitobang miho chu akitepna ahiljing e.
en_web: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
en_kjv: (ס) The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; And he will shew them his covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu athu ngaite jol ahin, Amaho din akitepna asudet jie.

tcz: Kamit tenin Yahweh Pakaichu avejingin, aman kagalmite thangkol a kon in eihuhdoh jinging e.
en_web: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
en_kjv: (ע) Mine eyes are ever towards the Lord; For he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat tinin panpi ngaichan Pakai kaven, Aman tijat kichatna eihuhdohjie.

tcz: Neihin ang-ngatnin lang neikho ton, ajeh chu keima kachangseh a lungthom haotah a um a kahi.
en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
en_kjv: (פ) Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kiheiyin neikhoton Pakai, kachangin lhasam tah-in ka-ume!

tcz: Kaboi na ho akhoh se cheh un. Oh hichehoa konhin neihuhdoh in.
en_web: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
en_kjv: (צ) The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalung gimna cheng subeiyin, Kagentheina chengsea konin neihuhhing!

tcz: Kalung gimnahi neihet pehin chuleh kahah satna hohi neivet peh inlang kachonset naho ngaidam in.
en_web: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
en_kjv: (ר) Look upon mine affliction and my pain; And forgive all my sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Gentheiya kalunghemna neigel peh-in, kachonset jouse ngaidamin!

tcz: Ven galmi ijat mong kanei hitam chule ama hohin ichan geija eihotnu hitam!
en_web: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
en_kjv: (ר) Consider mine enemies; for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelma ijat pham, vetemin! Vetan itobang loma eihot’u hitam!

tcz: Neivengbit in! amaho akona hin kahinkho huhdoh in! nangma a kisel kahi neijumso hihbeh in.
en_web: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
en_kjv: (ש) O keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihongin neihuhhingin, Hoidohna din kahinjon’e. neijumsah dan.

tcz: Kitah nale thenna in eivengbit hen ajeh chu nanga hin kakinepna aum jinge.
en_web: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
en_kjv: (ת) Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; For I wait on thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang kisonna kanei ahin, Kaphatna le kakitahnan eidamsah hen!

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen Israelte hi aboi najouseu va kon in lhatdoh tan.
en_web: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
en_kjv: (פ) Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai namite Israel khu Agentheina chengseuva konin huhhingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai themmo na bei kahihi phongdoh tan, ajeh chu keiman kitah na neitah in hinkho kamang in nungchonlou hel in Yahweh Pakai a tahsan na dettah kaneije.
en_web: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
en_kjv: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanga kisonga thildih bol kahi, O Pakai them neichanin!
