tcz: Yahweh Pakai neipatep inlang neikhol chil in, kachondan leh kalungthim hi vechen mongin!
en_web: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
en_kjv: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; Try my reins and my heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Neikholtoh-in neipatep’in Pakai, kadei le kagel chengse photoh-in!

tcz: Ajeh chu neingailutna longlouhi keiman kahejing e, chuleh keiman nathudih dung jui in hinkho kamange.
en_web: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
en_kjv: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: And I have walked in thy truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset long louvin eipui jinge, Nakitahnan eilamkai jing ahi.

tcz: Keima mijouho tojong kakivop khompon, miphalhem ho deilam jong kachepipon ahi.
en_web: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
en_kjv: I have not sat with vain persons, Neither will I go in with dissemblers.
tcz_gospelgo: Phatchomna bei mito kakiloipon, Miphalhemho toh kakivoppoi.

tcz: Keiman migiloute kikhop na kathet in thilphalou hojong kanuse ji e.
en_web: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
en_kjv: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; And will not sit with the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi phalouto kakiloi nompon, Migilou kapeldoh jinge.

tcz: Themmona kaneilou vetsahna in kakhut kasil in namaicham kahin jon e O Yahweh Pakai,
en_web: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
en_kjv: I will wash mine hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Monabei kahi tin khut kasop’in, Katao teng namaicham kaveljie.

tcz: Thangvah la sapum in nakidan na ho kaphong doh e.
en_web: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
en_kjv: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, And tell of all thy wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah la kasan, Nathilbol kidang chengse kaseiphonge.

tcz: Na houin theng kangailui, Yahweh Pakai, naum pi na loipi tah kilan doh na mun chu.
en_web: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
en_kjv: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, And the place where thine honour dwelleth.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, naloupina ngahmun, Nachenna In chu ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Michonse ho thoh ding neithoh sah hih in, tolthat hoto kibang in neithep mo sah hih in.
en_web: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
en_kjv: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with bloody men:
tcz_gospelgo: Chonsete tih neisuhmang tha dan, Tol thatte toh neitha thadan!

tcz: Set bolnom nan akhutnu asuboh un, chuleh amahon phatseh in nehguh akilah un ahi.
en_web: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
en_kjv: In whose hands is mischief, And their right hand is full of bribes.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bol jingte, Nehguh kilah jing jengte toh.

tcz: Keiman hitobang hinkho chu kamangpon, kitahna hinkhoa kading jinge. Hijeh chun neilhat doh inlang nami hepina chun neipuijin.
en_web: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
en_kjv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang thildih kabol’e, Neikhoton neihuhhingin!

tcz: Tun keima tolgo lai a dettah in kadinge chuleh keiman lhangphong tah a Yahweh Pakai kathang vahding ahi.
en_web: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
en_kjv: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijatna jousea kaoidoh-in, Amite khoppi lailunga Pakai kavahchoiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi keidin vah leh huhhingna ahi. Chuti ahileh idia kakichat ding ham? Yahweh Pakaihi kakulpi, hahsatna a eihuhdoh pa ahi. Chuti ahileh ken idia kakithin ding ham?
en_web: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
en_kjv: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hi kameivah le eihuhhing ahin, Imacha kagingpoi. Tijatna chengsea Pakaiyin eihoidoh tai, Kicha kit taponge.

tcz: Migilou ten suhgamdia eihindel khum uva, kagalmite leh eidou teovin eihin nokhumteng uleh kipal lhuvintin chuleh lhugam diu ahi.
en_web: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
en_kjv: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, They stumbled and fell.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten einokhum’a eithagot vangun, Akipal’uvin alhutauve.

tcz: Galmi tamtah in eium kimvel jeng jongleh kalung linglao ponte, ijemtin thagam dingin eihin delkhum jongleo Elohim ka Pathen a lung mongtah a kaum ding ahi.
en_web: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
en_kjv: Though a host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai hon khat’in eium’u jongleh Kicha deh ponge.Melmaten eidel khum jongle Pathena ki-ngai jing nange.

tcz: Hiche thilkhat Yahweh Pakai henga kathum kadei pipen chu kahinkho lhumkeija Yahweh Pakai in na umding, Yahweh Pakai lolhinna a chu lunglhaisel a um a ahouin na aphatnaho geljinga hinkho manding hi ahi.
en_web: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
en_kjv: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; That I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya thil khatseh ka-ngeh-in, Hiche thilkhat kadei chu: Kahinkhoa a-Houin a chen ding, Aphatna kidangsa a, ama kipuisah ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hahsatna a konna eihoidoh sahding a Houin thenga chu eihoibit ding Aman mi maiphah louva songpi chunga eiselding ahi.
en_web: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
en_kjv: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: In the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; He shall set me up upon a rock.
tcz_gospelgo: Hahsat teng Aman eisel’in tin, Ahouin sunga mongtah a eikoiya, Songpi chunga eikhandoh ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu boina hon eihin lonkhum jong le Aman eihoi dam ding ahi. Ama houintheng sunga kipah le thanom tah a pumgo thilto kabolding semjang saipum a Yahweh Pakai thangvah la kasah ding ahi.
en_web: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
en_kjv: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: Therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi kavel’a um kamelmate kajoa, Ahouin sunga kipa otongin kilhaiying ting, Pakai vahchoi la sange.

tcz: Kahung taove neingai peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Namikhoto na pum in neidonbut in.
en_web: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
en_kjv: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakouna ngaiyin Pakai! Khoto tah-in neihouvin!

tcz: “Hungin lang neihoulim pin” nati chu kalungthim in ajan hitin adonbutne, “Yahweh Pakai kahunge”
en_web: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
en_kjv: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungthima, “Hungun neihouvun,” nati teng,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai neinung ngat hihbeh in. Na lunghan nan nasoh hi paidoh hihbeh in. Nangmahi eikithopi phapen chu nahijenge. Tun neipaidoh hih in; neidalha hih in, O Elohim Pathen ka huhing pu.
en_web: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
en_kjv: Hide not thy face far from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; leave me not, Neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai kahunge, kisel hih-in,” katijie. Neilung hand an, Neidel mang hih-in nalhacha. Eipanpi Nang nahin, Neidalhan neidonda hih-in, O Pathen Eihuhhhingpa!

tcz: Kanu le kapan eipaidoh jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakai in eikolchah jing ding ahi.
en_web: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
en_kjv: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the Lord will take me up.
tcz_gospelgo: Kanu le kapan eidalha jongleh Pakaiyin eiching nante.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kahinkho manding Dan neihil in lamdih jenga neipuiin, ajeh chu kagal miten eichang lhijingun ahi.
en_web: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
en_kjv: Teach me thy way, O Lord, And lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalampi neihil’in Pakai, Kamelma atame, lampheiya neipuiyin!

tcz: Amaho khut a neilhah lutsah hih in, ajeh chu amahon kabol louhel thil a themo eichan un, phatin in kachungah thilse abolgo jingun ahi.
en_web: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
en_kjv: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: For false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
tcz_gospelgo: Jouthua eihutot midel khum, Kamelmate kichepna din neidalha hih-in!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin, hiche mihing gam a kaum laisen Yahweh Pakai phatna kamu jing jeng ding kakinem e.
en_web: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
en_kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed To see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihing gansunga Pakai phatna kamuding kahei!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tahin ngah jingin, Hanginlang hatnin, Henge, Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in ngah jingin.
en_web: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
en_kjv: Wait on the Lord: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: Wait, I say, on the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin, Tahsanin, lung lha hih-in, Ahi, Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi nakom a kataove, Ngaipeh lou in neikoi hih beh in. Ajeh chu nangin neithip sanleh keijong lhadah ing kating kathi ding ahitai.
en_web: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
en_kjv: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: Lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
tcz_gospelgo: O Eipanpia Pakai kahung taove Ngaiyin kataona! Neihouda leh Noimigam jonte toh kajotsuh ding kahitai.

tcz: Hepina ngeh a neipanpi dia katao teng nei ngaipeh tei in, kakhut kahin domsang in namun theng lam kahinsan e.
en_web: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
en_kjv: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi ngaicha nahenga kataova, Nahouin Theng lam kasan teng,

tcz: Thilse bolnom jing a, akam uva thungei ngei seija alung sunguva thilse jeng gonle ho to nei sumang tha hih beh in.
en_web: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
en_kjv: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, Which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bol migiloute, Kamthem, lungthima hotna jeng dimte Amaho chutoh themmo neichantha dan!

tcz: Amahon achanding dol u athilse bolu toh kitoh in got na pejengin! Athilse bolu dungjui chetnin lethuh jengin! Michunga athilse bol gu'utoh kitoh in amaho chungah chuhsah in.
en_web: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
en_kjv: Give them according to their deeds, And according to the wickedness of their endeavours: Give them after the work of their hands; Render to them their desert.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bolte chu Abolset jeh-un talen pen. Athilse boljeh-un talen matsah-in, Achandiu dol chansah jengin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ipi abolham ti amahon anahsah pouve, Elohim Pathen khut sem ipi jeh a umham agel pouve, hijeh a chu aman abotel a tonsot gei a kitung doh lou diu ahitai.
en_web: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
en_kjv: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, Nor the operation of his hands, He shall destroy them, and not build them up.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai natoh iman agelpouvin, Athilsem jong ima asah pouve; Pakaiyin talen amatsah a Asuhmang hel ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen! Ajeh chu khotona kangaicha a kataona chu eijah pehtai.
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi ngaiya kataona eihoutai, Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kahat nale kalum ahi. Kalungthim pumpin amachu katah san e. Aman eikithopin kalungthim kipanan adim e. Thangvahna la'n keiman kasam phonge.
en_web: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
en_kjv: The Lord is my strength and my shield; My heart trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eipanpin eihoidamtai, Ken Ama katahsan’e. Pakaiyin eipanpin eikipasah-e, Kipah thanomin Ama kavahchoiye!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apei, amahi athaonu lengpa dinga ahoidohna kulpi ahi
en_web: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
en_kjv: The Lord is their strength, And he is the saving strength of his anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite ahoidamin, Alhentum lengpa apanpin ahuhhinge!

tcz: Namite huhhing in! Kelngoi chingpha bangin nagoulu Israel chu phatthei bohtan, chule tonsot in amahohi nabanjetnin puitan.
en_web: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
en_kjv: Save thy people, And bless thine inheritance: Feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai namite huhhingin! Namite phattheiboh-in! Kelngaoi chinbangin chingin, Lha louvin ching jingin!

tcz: Nangho vanmi hon Yahweh Pakaichu jana peuvin; Aloupi nale athahatna jeh in Yahweh Pakaichu jana pecheh un.
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, Give unto the Lord glory and strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Van miten Pakai vahchoiyun, Athahat loupina vahchoiyun!

tcz: Amin loupinajeh in Yahweh Pakai chu jabolcheh un. Athenna thupitah jehchun Yahweh Pakaichu chibai bohun.
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai min loupe vahchoiyun, Ahung kilah teng Athengpa anga boh khup’uvin!

tcz: Twipi chungah Yahweh Pakai ogin athong doh e. Vanthamjol ginbang in Elohim Pathen loupina akithonge. Yahweh Pakaihi twikhanglen chungah akithonge.
en_web: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth: The Lord is upon many waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi chunga Pakai ogin akijan, Loupi Pathenin van athingin, Twikhanglen chunga a-ogin akithonge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thaneitah ahi, Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thupitah ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord is powerful; The voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneitah le loup tah-in Pakai ogin akijai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin Cedar thing thupitah hojong aban tumboh gam e; Yahweh Pakai thupinan Lebanon Cedar thingho jong asubong soh gamtai.
en_web: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; Yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ogin husan ceder thing ho alhun, Lebanon lhang ceder thing geiyin alhutai.

tcz: Aman Lebanon moljeng jong bongnou bangin akichop sah e, Aman Hermon moljeng jong gambong bangin akichop sah e.
en_web: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
en_kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Lebanon lhang bongnou chom abahsah-in, Hermon lhang bongchalnou kinunkho abahsah-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai oginhi kolphe meivah gimneitah banga ginga ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ogin husan Kol aphetsah-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin chun gamthip gamgolai jeng jong akilinsah e; Kadesh gamgolai jong Elohim Pathen in akilin sah e.
en_web: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; The Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai oginin nelgam ahot lhingin, Kadesh nelgam akilingsoh hel’e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin gangpi phung phatah hojong ahot ling in, gammang jong asuchai hel e. Ahou in theng sungah mijousen “Aloupi” tin asam uve.
en_web: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
en_kjv: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, And discovereth the forests: And in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai oginin gangpi thing jouse athingsoh-in, Athingna jouse amut lhasoh tan, Houin sunga um hon, “Pathen loupe hen,” tin asam’ui.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu twipi chunga chun atouvin vai ahom e.
en_web: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
en_kjv: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; Yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi chunga Pakaiyin vai ahomin, Tonsot’in leng achangtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apen, Yahweh Pakai in amite chamna apen phatthei aboh'e.
en_web: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
en_kjv: The Lord will give strength unto his people; The Lord will bless his people with peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite ahatsah-in, Phatthei aboh-in along mongui.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh tahjeh in kahin thangvah e. Nangin kagalmite kachunga nakithang at sahpon ahi.
en_web: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
en_kjv: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhinga kamelmate neikichepna sah loujeh-in Nangma kavahchoiye Pakai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen panpi ngaichan kahin kouvin nangman ka tahsa nakiledoh sah tai.
en_web: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
en_kjv: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathen, neipanpi din kataovin, Nangin neidamsah tai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin lhankhuh a kon in neihin puidoh in, thina kokhuh a ka lhahlut na dinga kon in jong neihoidoh sah e.
en_web: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
en_kjv: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
tcz_gospelgo: Moimigama neisol tapon, Thikhul’a lut kon kahitan, Nangin neihinsah kit tai!

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna lasaovin! Amintheng chu choi an'un.
en_web: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
en_kjv: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, And give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vahchoi la sauvin Amithengte jousen! Amithengpa thilbol gel jingun, Ama thangvah jinguvin!

tcz: Ajeh chu alunghan hi phat chomcha bou ahijin, ami hepina vang hinkhoa ding ahi. Ka na nikho ho jong kipanin ajui pai jitai.
en_web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
en_kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
tcz_gospelgo: Alunghan phat chomcha bou, Aphatna hinkho lhumkeiya ahi. Kana jamkhat kal hilou, Kipana jing nikho asohjitai!

tcz: Keiman ka phatthei nikhon, “Imachan eisutang jouponte!” kanati.
en_web: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
en_kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung mongtah-in ka-umin, “Iman eijouponte,” kati.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami hepinahin muol bangin eisudettai. Keija kon a nakiheimang jiteng leh keima kading jou jipoi.
en_web: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
en_kjv: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
tcz_gospelgo: Keidin naphai Pakai, Molsang bangin kadin kulpi nahi. Kadia nakiselmang teng Kakichan katijai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nahenga kahung tao ahi. Nami hepina chu kathum in hitin kaseije,
en_web: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
en_kjv: I cried to thee, O Lord; And unto the Lord I made supplication.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahin kouve Pakai, Napanpi ka-ngaiye!

tcz: “Keima kathi alhankhuh a ka lhalut teng nangdinga ipi phachom dingham? Katahsa leivui in nang navah choi thei dingham? Nakitah na thu chu hiche hin aphondoh thei ding ham?
en_web: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
en_kjv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
tcz_gospelgo: “Thi leng nangdia i-phachom a? Thilkhul lut leng i-nakan em? Mithin navahchoiya? Nakitahje aphonjal thei diu ham?

tcz: Neihin ngaipeh in Yahweh Pakai neihin khoto in. O Yahweh Pakai neihin kithopin”
en_web: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
en_kjv: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihouvin Pakai, neikhoton! Neipanpin O Pakai!” kati.

tcz: Nangin kalung khamnahi kipah tah a lam nan neiheidoh pehtai. Nangin kalung khamna silpon neilahdoh pehin kipana silpon joh neisilpehtan ahi.
en_web: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
en_kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: Thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
tcz_gospelgo: Kagimna kon kipah-in neilamsah tan, Kagimna ponsil khel’in kipana neidip tai!

tcz: Hitiachu thipsan louva thangvahna la kasah jing theina dingin. O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen, keiman nangma tonsot in thangvah jing tange.
en_web: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
en_kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun umthim louvin Navahchoi la sange. Pakai, nangma ka-Pathen nahin, Itih-in thangvah tange!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neihuhdoh ding ngaichan nakom kahin bel e; Jumna neimusah hih behin. Neihuh dohin ajeh chu nangma chondihtah Elohim Pathen nahi.
en_web: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
en_kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed: Deliver me in thy righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihoidam din kahinjon’e Pakai! Neijumso lou jen-o! O Pathen dihtah, Kataove, neihuhhingin

tcz: Kataona najah nadin neingai peh tei in; neihung huhdoh loi in. Kakiselna songpin pang jing inlang, kahoidohna kulpi hijing in.
en_web: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
en_kjv: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: Be thou my strong rock, For a house of defence to save me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihouvin, neihuhhing tun! Kakiselna songpi kahoidamna hin, Eihongin neihuhhingin!

tcz: Nangmahi kasongpile kakulpi nahi namin loupina dingin kahahsatna a konnin neihuh doh in.
en_web: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
en_kjv: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiselna kulpi nahi, Nikitep bangin neipuiyin neilamkaiyin.

tcz: Kadougal hon kalhuhna dinga thang eikampeh naova kon in neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu kahoidoh nahi nangma a bou aum e.
en_web: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
en_kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: For thou art my strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Min thang eikampehnaa nei-osah dan, Kichatnaa neisel’in!

tcz: Kalhagao nangma khut a ka pedoh tai. Neihuhdoh in Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu nangmahi kitah jing Elohim Pathen nahi.
en_web: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
en_kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho nakhut’a kapei, Neihuhhing din, O Pakai! Kitah jing Pathen!

tcz: Phatchom nabei semthu pathen hou hokhu keiman kathet ahi. Kenvang Yahweh Pakai katahsan jing e.
en_web: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
en_kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: But I trust in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Doihou ho nahon, Kenvang nang katahsan’e.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou jeh in keima kipah thanom jing inge, ajeh chu nangin kaboina ho neihet peh jingin chuleh kalung gimna jouse nangin neihet thempeh jingin ahi.
en_web: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
en_kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: For thou hast considered my trouble; Thou hast known my soul in adversities;
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset long loujeh-in Kipah thanom ing’e. Kathohna namusoh tan, Kagimna nahesoh tai.

tcz: Nangin kadougal ho khutnah neipelutpon, lungmon na munjoh a neikoi jin ahi.
en_web: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
en_kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a large room.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate neimatsah pon, Jalentah-in kanopna chana neichesah tai.

tcz: Neikhoton Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu keima hahsatna a um kahin kamitlhin kamit akhutan ahi. Kahinnale katahsa abeipaiding ahitai.
en_web: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
en_kjv: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: Mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagentheiye, Neikhoton Pakai! Kaka kanan kamit chopai ding ahitan, Abeipai ding kon kahitai!

tcz: Lungkham a thipaiding kahitai, gentheinan kahinkho asuhchom tai. Chonset in kajaitha anem sah in asung langa beipai ding kahitai.
en_web: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
en_kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: Genthei lih pai ding kahitan, Kap lih didng kahitai! Hesoh-in kacholtan, Kagu kachang alhoisoh tai!

tcz: Kamelma ten eisamseovin, kaheng kakom ten eitheuvin ahi. Kagol kapaite jeng jongin eihin naingam tapouvin ahi. Lampi dunga eimu jongleh ajam mang gamji taove.
en_web: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
en_kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, But especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelma, kaheng kakom chengin Noise tah-in eiboltauve; Eihesa hon eiginguvin, Kholai dunga eimutengu ajamji tauve.

tcz: Keima mithisa bang leh bel kehsa bangin notthap in kaumtai.
en_web: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
en_kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
tcz_gospelgo: Athisa bangin eisumil’uvin, Leibel keh pai mangsa kabange.

tcz: Keima chung changhi thujoungen eikisei khum in tijatnan eium kimvel tan, kadougal ten keidounan thilse agong un kahinkho hi suhmang ding agouve.
en_web: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
en_kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: Fear was on every side: While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmate kihou lhih, Kavel’a tijatna jeng kajai. Kei dounan thil agongun, Tha din eigouve.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai keima nanga kingai jing kahin, “Nangma Elohim ka Pathen nahi!” kati.
en_web: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
en_kjv: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanga ki-ngai kahi Pakai, O Nang ka-Pathen!

tcz: Khonung kakhankho hi nangkhut a um ahin hitia tanglouva eidelle jinghoa konin neihuhdoh in.
en_web: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
en_kjv: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhut’a um jing kahi, Kamelma, eibolsetea konin neihuhdoh-in!

tcz: Nami khotona chun nasohpa hi hinsalvah in, namingailutna longlou chun neihin huhdoh tan.
en_web: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
en_kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me for thy mercy’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Khoton neiven nalhachapa, Nalungset long louvin neihuhhingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh in, ajeh chu panpi ngaichan nangma kakou jinge, miphalou hochu jumsah jon, amaho chu alhankhuh uvah thipsan sahtan.
en_web: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
en_kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai tin kakouve, Neivetda loujen-o! Migilou vetda chang hen, thildel’in noimigam jonsuh-u hen!

tcz: Jouthu pot na alei u suthip in, ami noise nao le Elohim Pathen mite a houset nao leichu suthip jengin.
en_web: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
en_kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; Which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Jousei, kiletsah, kithang-at Midihte noisea thusei jouse phoh tangin.

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma gingte dingin nangin ijakai nasuh nengpeh hi iti phat apha hitam. Panpi ngaicha a nakom a hungte nangman naphat thei in, vannoi mite mitmu changtah in nangman phatthei nabohjin ahi.
en_web: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
en_kjv: O how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; Which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee Before the sons of men!
tcz_gospelgo: Najabolte dia nakoipeh Thilpha chu iti kidan hitam! Natahsante mongtah a nahoidama Naphatje mitinin ahei.

tcz: Nangin amahochu suhsetding gohoa kon in na angsunga nahoi bitjin, chuleh ahousetnao leile danga kon in jong na angsungah nahoibit jinge.
en_web: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
en_kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
tcz_gospelgo: Min asuhsetna dia jong Naumpin mongsel’in nakoiye; Amelmateuvin aphin loh louna din Kiselna phalaiya nasel jinge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahin umhen, ajeh chu Aman angailutna longlou kidangtah chu eimusah jingin, kachen na khopi gal akinokhum a kon in jong eihoidoh sahtan ahi.
en_web: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Min einokhuma eiumchah-in jong, Kidangtah-in Pakaiyin eilungset’e!

tcz: Lunglinglao pum in keima kapengjah in, “Yahweh Pakai toh eiki sukhentai!” kati. Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangin nei kho to dia ka ka na neijahpeh in panpi ngaicha a kakouna neidonbut tai.
en_web: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
en_kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin akoma kona eidelmang ham, tin Kakicha lheh jengin; Eipanpi dia kataoteng, Aman eihou jing nai!

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen miteho Yahweh Pakai chu ngailu vin! Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in ama a kingai jingho chu ahuhdoh jingin ahi. Ahinlah mi noiseho chu engbolna nasatah apejin ahi.
en_web: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
en_kjv: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: For the Lord preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ngailu’vin amitheng jousen, Pakaiyin mi kitah ahoidamin, Aumchan dungjuiyin kiletsahte Talen amatsah jie.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakaija kinepna neiho jouse hatnunlang hangun!
en_web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
en_kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, All ye that hope in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kinem jouse Het’uvin hanguvin!

tcz: Oh, asei ngailou nahou ki angaidam a achon set nahou kisuhmang peh ho iti thanop um hitam.
en_web: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
en_kjv: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset chengse ki-ngaidama Asuhkhel jouse kichulnam mi chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ajihlutsa achonset nao athaimang peh a ahinkhou jongkitah tah a mangho chu iti kipa um a hitam!
en_web: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
en_kjv: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
tcz_gospelgo: Lepche lou, Pakaiyin mo achan lou Mi chu anun nom ahi.

tcz: Keiman kachonset kaphon nomlou chun katahsa chu amangthah anahin, niseh in kapeng in kamao jinge.
en_web: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
en_kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old Through my roaring all the day long.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset kaphondoh lout eng, Genthei thoh-in kapeng nilhum lhumjie.

tcz: Sun le jan in kipui dih na nakhujol chun eidou ve. Nipilai a nichangsat in asuhkang twihu bangin katha asukang hel jengin ahi.
en_web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
en_kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun le janin talen neimatsah-e Pakai, Nipi lai nisan daitwi akahgot bangin katha abeitai.

tcz: Akhon nan kachon setna nahenga kaphong in, kamo najouse selguh ding golou vin kasei tai “Kalouchal kasetna jouse Yahweh Pakai kom a phongdoh tang e” kati. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai nangin neingaidam e! Kachonsetna jouse abeisoh tai.
en_web: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
en_kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nahenga kachonset kaphon teng, Kasuhkhel jouse ka-imjipoi. Aboncha phondoh kadeiyin, Kachonset chengse nei-ngaidamtai.

tcz: Hijeh chun, phatpha umlai hin Elohim Pathen mite jouse naheng a taocheh uhen, hiche thutanna twilen lah a alhahlut lou nadiuvin.
en_web: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
en_kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Nigingte ngaichat chanin nahenga taohen, Gentheina twipi kinong bang jongleh Amaho hinpha ponte.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma hi kakiselna kulpi nahin; nangin boinana a kon in neihuh doh e. Galjona lan neiumkimvel tai.
en_web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
en_kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; Thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiselna nahi, Gentheina konin neihuhhingin! Neihoisamjeh-in Nahuhhhingna othongin lan sange.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in aseije, “Nahinkho a lampi phapen achu kapui le ding ahi. Keiman kathu mop a kavetsui jing ding nahi.
en_web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
en_kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Nachena ding lampi hil ing ting, Kathumop a kahilchah ding nahi.

tcz: Sakol le Sangan bangin hetna beiyin um hih in, ajo leh kamdal le thihkol bupeh a thunoiya ki koi nabah loding ahi.”
en_web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
en_kjv: Be ye not as the horse, Or as the mule, which have no understanding: Whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, Lest they come near unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakol ham sakolpol ham bangin ngol hih-in, tuhngoina dia kamdal kibupeh bang khun!” eiti.

tcz: Miphalou hohi lungkhamna tamtah in abomjin, ahinla Yahweh Pakai tahsan hovang angailutna longlouvin aum kimvel jingin ahi.
en_web: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
en_kjv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: But he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin genthei athoh-in, Pakaiya ki-ngaite vang lungset’in ahoidam’e.

tcz: Hijeh chun ama lungdei a chon ho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom jingun! Milung thengho jouse thanom tah in khosam un!
en_web: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
en_kjv: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo them change, Kipah thanom’uvin! Pakai thu ngaite, Kipa la sauvin!

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la kipah tahin saohen; milung thenghon Ama athangvah diuhi lomtah ahi.
en_web: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
en_kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: For praise is comely for the upright.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo themchangte Pakaiya kipah-un, Athua nung jousen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Semjang gin ngaitah in Yahweh Pakai thangvah un, tumgin jangsom ngaitah saijin nguiheo vin saovin.
en_web: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
en_kjv: Praise the Lord with harp: Sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
tcz_gospelgo: Semjang saiyin Pakai thangvah-un, Tumgingto thon Ama vahchoiyun!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvahnan lathah saovin; thepna neitah in selangdah saijun lang kipah tah in la saovin.
en_web: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
en_kjv: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.
tcz_gospelgo: Semjang ngeitah saiyin, othongin, Akoma kipa Lathah sauvin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thusei jouse chu atah ahin chuleh anatoh athilbol jouse chu tahsan thei cheh ahi.
en_web: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
en_kjv: For the word of the Lord is right; And all his works are done in truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thusei atah cheh-in, Anatoh nganse thei cheh ahi.

tcz: Adihleh apha kiti jouse chu Yahweh Pakai deilam ahin, Amingailutna longlou chun vannoi leiset hi adimin ahi.
en_web: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
en_kjv: He loveth righteousness and judgment: The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin adih le atah adeiyin, Alungset longlou leiset adim’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thucheng hin bou vanmun hi asem doh in, Ama thucheng haikhum chun ahsi jouse apendoh sah tai.
en_web: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
en_kjv: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kamchengin van mun chengse akisemin, Athuseiyin Ni, Lha, Ahsite akisemdoh-e.

tcz: Aman twikhanglen jong agamgi asempeh in chule twikhanglen jouse hi munkhat a aveikhom sah in akoidet in ahi.
en_web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
en_kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the depth in storehouses.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi lai munkhat’a aveikhomsah-in, Twikhanglen lithuh lai jouse akhol khom’e.

tcz: Vannoi leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakaihi jana peohen, chuleh mijouse a-angsung a kichatah in dingu hen.
en_web: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
en_kjv: Let all the earth fear the Lord: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset pumpin Pakai gingun, Vannoi miten Pakai jabol’un!

tcz: Ajeh chu ama thucheng khat in leiset khang akipatsah ahi! Ama thupeh a kitungdoh jeng ahi.
en_web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
en_kjv: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thuseiya konin vannoi akisemdoh-in, Athupeh akonin thil ijakai aumdoh tai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in namtin vaipi thil gon houchu asuhboi peh in, chuleh atohgon hou jouse chu asuhmo peh in ahi.
en_web: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
en_kjv: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: He maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi lunggel Pakaiyin asunoh-in, Athilgonu toh doh louna din asutange.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai thilgon vang tonsot in adet jing e, ama tohgot hochu itih a jong killing lou ahi.
en_web: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
en_kjv: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thilgon vang tonsot’a um jing Angaito aboncha beitih neilou ahi.

tcz: A pakaiju Elohim Pathen hikha nammite chu anunnom ahiuve, Yahweh Pakai in agoulo dinga alhen nammite chu anun nom ahiuve.
en_web: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
en_kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; And the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: A-Pathenu Pakai hikha nam mite Anun nom’ui; Pakaiyin amite dia alhendoh mite Anun nom’uve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanna konnin mihemte jouse ahin ven musoh kei e.
en_web: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
en_kjv: The Lord looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Vana konin Pakaiyin ahinven, Mitin mitang amusoh keiye.

tcz: Alaltouna a konin ahin ven leiset chunga cheng jouse hindan ahesoh keijin ahi.
en_web: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
en_kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh Upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Alaltouna phunga konin ahinven, Leiset’a chengte amusoh-e.

tcz: Alung thim u sempa ama ahijeh'in alung gellu le athilbol jouseo ahesoh kei e.
en_web: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
en_kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; He considereth all their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem lungthim Sempa ahijeh-in Athilbol jouseu jong ahesoh-e.

tcz: Gal manchah phapen in lengpa huhdoh jou pontin, hangta le hansan nan jong gal hat pa ahuh doh jou poi.
en_web: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
en_kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Asepaite hat jal’in lengpan gal ajoupon, Hat vangin sepaiyin gal ajoudeh poi.

tcz: Gal satna sakol khatnin jong gal na josah jouding ahipon, thahatna jousen jong nang nahuhdoh jouponte.
en_web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
en_kjv: A horse is a vain thing for safety: Neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Jo na dia sakolte jong pannabei, Athahat’un huhhing pouvinte.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in ama gingte, angailut na longlou va ki ngaijing ho avelhi jing e.
en_web: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
en_kjv: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his mercy;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athu nitte aching jingin, Alungset long louva ki-ngaite akivettup jinge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu athina diuva kon in ahuhdoh jin athigam nadiuva kon in ahuh dohjin ahi.
en_web: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
en_kjv: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi thinaa jong ahuhdoh jin, Kel le chah a jong ahinsoi.

tcz: Keihon Yahweh Pakaijah kinepna kakoi ui. Ajeh chu amahi eiki thopiu leh eilum uva pang ahi.
en_web: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
en_kjv: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: He is our help and our shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho Pakaiya kinem kahiuvin, Eipanpiuva eihoidamu Amabou ahi.

tcz: Ama a hin ilungthimu akipah in, ajeh chu eihon amin thenga tahsan na dettah inei un ahi.
en_web: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
en_kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai al’in kakipah-un, Amintheng katahsan’ui.

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou achun eium kimvel u hen, ajeh chu nang jenga bou ka kinepnao aum e.
en_web: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
en_kjv: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, According as we hope in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, Nanga kinem kahiuve, Nalungset long louvin eiumpi jingun!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu phat tin in thang vah in kate. Yahweh Pakai thagvah nahi kakam sunga gingdoh jingding ahi.
en_web: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
en_kjv: (א) I will bless the Lord at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thangvah jing ing ting, Avahchoi la sachim ponge.

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakaiya bou kithang at jing ding kahin; Panpi beite jouse lunglut cheh uhen.
en_web: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
en_kjv: (ב) My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Eikhoto jal’in Pakai vahchoiyinge, Bolganthei thoh ten ngaiyun kipah-uvin!

tcz: Hungun Yahweh Pakai loupi nahi seiphong khom u hitin amin hi choi-an khom u hite.
en_web: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
en_kjv: (ג) O magnify the Lord with me, And let us exalt his name together.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai loupe phongja’u hitin, Amin choi-an’u hite!

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai kom a kataovin aman kataona eisanpeh tai. Aman kakichatna jousea jong eilhat doh tai.
en_web: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
en_kjv: (ד) I sought the Lord, and he heard me, And delivered me from all my fears.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kahol len Aman eihoutai, Kagin jousea konin eihuh tai.

tcz: Ama panpi ding ngaicha jouse vah bangin hungvah doh untin, amai uva jachatna muthim jinglou helding ahi.
en_web: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
en_kjv: (ה) They looked unto him, and were lightened: (ו) And their faces were not ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengvai gentheiten ven akipah-un, Lungthoi kit louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Kahahsat behseh phat in kataovin Yahweh Pakai in eingai peh e; aman kaboina jouse eisuh lhap peh tai.
en_web: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
en_kjv: (ז) This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi beite ataovun Aman ahoutai, Agimna chengseuva anopsah tai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vantil chu hoidamna ahin; ama ging te aman aumkimvel in ahuhdoh jinge.
en_web: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
en_kjv: (ח) The angel of the Lord encampeth Round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thunitte chu Avantil a-ngasah-in, Kichatna tijatnaa kon ahuhdoh-e.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veovin, Yahweh Pakaija kisel jing mite chu iti kipa hitaovem!
en_web: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
en_kjv: (ט) O taste and see that the Lord is good: Blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai phatje kholtoh-in, Akoma hoidamte chu anun nom’ui.

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite ho Yahweh Pakai chu ging jingun ajeh chu ama ging jingten angai chat jouse amudiu ahi.
en_web: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
en_kjv: (י) O fear the Lord, ye his saints: For there is no want to them that fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amithengten Pakai thu ngaiyun, Ama thu ngaiten adei chan amui.

tcz: Keipi bahkai gol hat laitah jong agilkel jin, ahin Yahweh Pakai tahsandet jing hovang thilpha alhasam ngaipouve.
en_web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
en_kjv: (כ) The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: But they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakeiten jong an mulouvin kel athoh-un, Pakai thu ngaite vang thilpha alhasam khapoi.

tcz: Kachate ho hunguvin kaseihi kingai phaovin, chuleh keiman Elohim Pathen ginje kahilding nahiu ve.
en_web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
en_kjv: (ל) Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung ngaiyun chate, Pakai ginje nahil’unge!

tcz: Hinkho sottah leh phatthei na lhingset a hingnom umkha em?
en_web: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
en_kjv: (מ) What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good?
tcz_gospelgo: Hin noma hin ding nadeiya, Hin nomsel’a the thiding nadeileh,

tcz: Thuse seinan nalei tuhtangin lang chuleh nakam jong jouseinan mang hih in!
en_web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
en_kjv: (נ) Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuse sei dan lang, Tuhjou seisan.

tcz: Thilse a kon in kihai mangin lang thilpha bol in, chamna hol in lang hichu chepin.
en_web: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
en_kjv: (ס) Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse dalhan thilpha bol’in, Nalungthim pumpin chamna hol’in!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai mitin thilpha boljingho avesui jingin; panpi ngai a koute din akol tenin jong akihong jing e.
en_web: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
en_kjv: (ע) The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte Pakaiyin aching jingin, Ataonau angai lhi jinge.

tcz: Hinla thilse bolte chu dou mit nin aven, aman amin u leiset akon athaimang ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
en_kjv: (פ) The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bolte vang avetdan, Leiset’a koima ageldohsah poi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in panpi ngaichaho kouna angaipeh in. Aboi naova kon in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
en_kjv: (צ) The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, And delivereth them out of all their troubles.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte Pakaiya atao teng Aman ahouve, Agim gentheinauva konin ahuhdohjie.

tcz: Lungthim kisuchipte kom a Yahweh Pakai chu anai in; Alhagao kisu gimte ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
en_kjv: (ק) The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; And saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung kisihte henga Pakai aneiyin, Chonset gimpite ahuhhinge!

tcz: Michonpha hon boina tampi atohjiuvin, hinla Yahweh Pakai in phat tinin ahung huhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
en_kjv: (ר) Many are the afflictions of the righteous: But the Lord delivereth him out of them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan gimna tampi ato vangin, Hichengsea jong hin Pakaiyin ahuhdoh-e.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho gule chang ahoibit pehjin; khatchajong abohsah pon ahi!
en_web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
en_kjv: (ש) He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Midih chu Pakaiyin ahoidamjeh-in Agu aching khatcha jong akiheh bongpoi.

tcz: Hamset nan migiloute hinkho alah teiding, michonpha ho hotbol tejong got na chang tei diu ahi.
en_web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
en_kjv: (ת) Evil shall slay the wicked: And they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou chu thilsen atha ding, Midih vetda chanin talen amat ding ahi.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai in ama kin bolho vang alhatdoh ding, ama a kisel jing honjong themmo changlou diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
en_kjv: (פ) The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: And none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite ahuhhing ding, Alim belte ahoidam ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, eidou ho hi nangin kidoupin, ei kisatpi ho jong nangin kisatpin.
en_web: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
en_kjv: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: Fight against them that fight against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Einel’a chu nel’in lang, Eidouva xhu kidoupin Pakai!

tcz: Nalum leh naumpho hin kipat in. Galmun a din kigon lang neihung kithopin.
en_web: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
en_kjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for mine help.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalum le napho kengin Neihung huhdoh loiyin!

tcz: Eihin delkhum ho dounan natengcha leh nateng muh chu hin lam tan. “Keiman gal kajopeh ding nahi!” ti neijah sah tan.
en_web: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
en_kjv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nateng lung leh-in Eihindelte khu khon! neihuhhing din seiyin!

tcz: Eithat goho chunga hin jumnale jachatna lhun sah in, eigimbol a eisumang go hohi jumson lang nungno jeng tan.
en_web: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
en_kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Tha dia eigo chengse chu Noinunin lang jumson! Kathina ding ngaito ho chu Nungjam hen kisulongu hen!

tcz: Huilah a changvai alenmang bangin lenmang sah in, Yahweh Pakaija kon a vantil banga hung chu semmang sah in.
en_web: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
en_kjv: Let them be as chaff before the wind: And let the angel of the Lord chase them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kon Vantil’in deljam hen, Khohuiya changse kithe bangu hen!

tcz: A lam lhah nao thimsah inlang lhonalsah in, Yahweh Pakai vantil chun nungdel peh u hen.
en_web: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
en_kjv: Let their way be dark and slippery: And let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
tcz_gospelgo: Alampiu muthim hen nal hen, Pakaiya kon Vantil’in del jing jengu hen!

tcz: Keiman amaho kabol sepoi, ahin amahon kei matna dingin kotong eilai khum un ahi! Ken amaho kabol sepoi ahin amahon keimat nadin kotong alai uve.
en_web: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
en_kjv: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, Which without cause they have digged for my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh beiyin thang eikampeh-un, Kalhan lutna din khuh alaiyui.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho chunga hetman louvin mathahna hunglhung hen! Kei ona dia asem u kotong chu amaho manthahna hijo tahen.
en_web: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
en_kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: Into that very destruction let him fall.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla ahet lou kah-uva manthahnan aphah diu, Athangkam’uva oh didu, manthahna chu diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng keima Yahweh Pakai akakipa ding ahi. Eilhatdoh jeh a keima kipa thanom ding kahi.
en_web: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
en_kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: It shall rejoice in his salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Pakai jal’in kipah ing ting, Eihuhhing jeh-in nomsange!

tcz: Katahsa chunga kagu kachang jouse pum a Yahweh Pakai kathangvah ding ahi: “Yahweh Pakai koiham nangtoh kitekah theiding? Koidang ba ham mihatpa thaneina a kona panpi beipa huhdoh a chu?”
en_web: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
en_kjv: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, Which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
tcz_gospelgo: Kalunggil’in Pakaiyah, “Vo Pakai Nang banga, Mi huhaman kona tahlel chulha aumpoi,” tinge, Abolsetea kona tahlel chulha aumpoi,” tinge.

tcz: Engbolna dih louvin eithemmo sah un. Kahetphahlou jouthu a monna eikichan e.
en_web: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
en_kjv: False witnesses did rise up; They laid to my charge things that I knew not.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten eidounan thu aseiyun, Kahet phah lou thilse ei-ngoh-ui.

tcz: Amahon kathil phabol jengjong thilsen eile thuh un lung lhahnan kangui heltai.
en_web: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
en_kjv: They rewarded me evil for good To the spoiling of my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilpha jeng jong thilsen eithuh-un, Kadatmo behseh jenge!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin amahon anat tenguleh keiman amaho kalainatpi jin khaodip pon kakisil in anngol in amaho kataopeh jin ahi. Hinla kataona donbut louvin ahung kinung le jitai.
en_web: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
en_kjv: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
tcz_gospelgo: Adammo tengu lungkhama khaodip pon sil’a, Adamna diuvin an ka-ngol jin; kunin kataopeh peh jie.

tcz: Ka golpha le insung mi monga kagel jeh in kalungkham pin, eihinga kanu kalainatpi bang bangin kalainat pi jin ahi.
en_web: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
en_kjv: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopi le kagol ngaitah banga taopeh a, Nu pul dou banga Kaikua vah le le jia kahi.

tcz: Hinlah ken tunia boina katophat in amaho akipah un keidounan thanom tah in akiloi khomun, hiti chun kahetkhahlou miho kisan in tujeng in jong eino khum un; phat tin in eihouse jing jengun ahi.
en_web: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
en_kjv: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: Yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; They did tear me, and ceased not:
tcz_gospelgo: Kei genthei phat’in akipah jo’uvin, Kavel’a akikhom’uvin eidai thangun; Hetphah louhel mijengin Eideng deng jenguve.

tcz: Amahon einuisat un eitam seovin noise tah in eihagel khum un ahi.
en_web: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
en_kjv: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Elbai nuisat bangin einuisat’un, Mitt hip tenin ha eigel khum’uve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai itih changei pi neivet a donlouva neikoi ding hitam?
en_web: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
en_kjv: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, My darling from the lions.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai itih chan namohvet ding ham? Sakei tobangtea konin neihuhdoh-in, Neihuh hing loiyin!

tcz: Chutengleh mipi tamtah ki khom te lah a kipathu kahin seiding ahi. Mipi ho jouse masanga nangma kahin thangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
en_kjv: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Houbung kikhopnaa thangvah ing ting, Amasanguva Nangma vahchoi tange!

tcz: Kajolel nachung a hin eidou te kipa thanop sah hih beh in. Kamuiset nachung in jong ajeh bei a eivetda ho kitai sah hih beh in.
en_web: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
en_kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelma, jouseiho khu Kalelna chunga kipasah dan; Ajeh beiya eihote khu Kachunga kipa thanopsah hih hel’in!

tcz: Amahon chamna thu aseipouvin, amahon thepmona neilou atoh dingdol bep tongho dounan thilse agong jingun ahi.
en_web: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
en_kjv: For they speak not peace: But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Odamin thu aseipouvin, Cham deite chunga jouthu jeng asemthu’ve.

tcz: “Aha! Aha! ipi bol kigo nahi kamit tah un kamudoh taove!” tin asam uve.
en_web: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
en_kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, And said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
tcz_gospelgo: Akambem bemin eisam’un, “Chi, nathilse bol kamutauve!” atiuve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin hicheghi namusoh kei in nahesoh e, donlouvin koihih beh in O Yahweh Pakai. neidalha hihbeh in O Yahweh Pakai.
en_web: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
en_kjv: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, Nangin hiche hi namutan, Otdoh dsn, umthimdan Pakai!

tcz: Hungthoudoh in! eihuhdoh dingin hung dingdoh jengtan! Yahweh ka Pakai le Elohim ka Pathen kachung thuhi neitan peh in.
en_web: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
en_kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, kipat’in neihung hun, Ka-Pathen keidin hung pangin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim, kamo louna neiphon doh peh tan, ajeh chu nangma thudih a thutan nahi. Kaboina chung chon a kadougal te nuisat in neium sah hih beh in.
en_web: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
en_kjv: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai dih, Nangin them neichanin, Kamelmate kachunga kipasah dan!

tcz: “Veovin itup uchu imutaove! Tua hi ahingsan a inehchai diu ahitai!” tisah hihbeb in.
en_web: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
en_kjv: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
tcz_gospelgo: “Idei bangun ama khu isumangtauve,” tin Kachunga kipasah hih hel’in!

tcz: Kahahsatna nikhoa kipah ho sujum inlang jachat sah in. Kachunga hanla samhohi jumnaleh minsetnan lhuh khumin.
en_web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
en_kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: Let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagenthei jal’a kipah thanomte hi Lel’u hen kijumso cheh-u hen, Kasanga phajoa kigel ho chu Jum le ja thoh-in umu hen!

tcz: Ahin koi hileh keima ei huhdia hung ho jouse chu kipanalentah pen. “Yahweh Pakai aloupi e aman asoh hi lunglhai tah in phatthei aboh in lungmon na apei!” tin tanglouvin samjingu hen.
en_web: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
en_kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, Which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei themchan didng dei jousen Kipa othongin samu hen lang, “Pakai aloupin, alhachapa lolhin along lhaipi,” tin samu hen!

tcz: Chuteng keiman nathutan adihji samphong ingting niseh a nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
en_web: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
en_kjv: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness And of thy praise all the day long.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng nadihna phongjal ing ting, Nilhum lhumin vahchoiyinge.

tcz: Chonsetnin miphalou ho lungthim gilsungah thu aseijin ahi. Amahon Elohim Pathen ginna him him aneipouve.
en_web: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
en_kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, That there is no fear of God before his eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Setnan migilou lunggil’a thu aseiyin, Hijeh chun Pathen adondan ajabolpoi.

tcz: Akihisah naovin amaho le amaho akijou lhepmun ichan geija gilouleh phamo hiuvam ti akihet pouve.
en_web: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
en_kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, Until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama akigel sang val tan, Asetna Pathenin mudoh louva them chang din akigel’e.

tcz: Athusei anatohna hou jousehi adihlou leh kijou lhepna ngen ahi. Chingthei tah a natoh leh thilpha bol dinghi adatthei pouve.
en_web: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
en_kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuse aseiyin, jou jeng ahi, chihna le thilpha abolpoi.

tcz: Jankhosot in ahah un thildihlou tohgon tamtah agong jiuvin ahi. Atohdoh uhi apha khatcha aum poi. Thilsea konna kiheidoh ding angaito mong mong pouve.
en_web: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
en_kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Alupna jalkhun jenga jong thilse agon, Thilpha ima bol louvin, thilse jeng abol’e.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlouhi van bangin aki hohjale, nakitahna hin meilom kaina mun hohi akho khel e.
en_web: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
en_kjv: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; And thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nalungset longlou vana akilhungdoh-in, nakitahnan vanthamjol aphai!

tcz: Nadih na jong muolsang vum tobang ahi. Nathutan dihdan jong twikhanglen thuhtah abang e. Nangin mihemleh ganhing hojong kibanga nangailut ahi.
en_web: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
en_kjv: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadihna molsang bangin akikhangin, Nathutandih Twikhanglen thuh abange Sa le mihem nakhohsah gel’e.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou hi eti mamtam hitam! Mihem jousen nami ngailutna lhaving limnoija chun choldo na anei ui.
en_web: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
en_kjv: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, nalungset longlou akidangin, Nalhalim noiya kahoidam’ui!

tcz: Nainsunga nehkemlou ann a chun navah van, kanglou nalui a twi chun nadon sah e.
en_web: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
en_kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipeh-u an nengtah-in kaneuvin Naphatna twidonin don’uvinge!

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma mihem hung kondohna twinah nahin, keihon kamu u vahjonghi nanga kon ahi.
en_web: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
en_kjv: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna twinah phung nahin, Navah-in khovah kamu’ve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma ngailuho chung a nami ngailutna longlou chu londoh sah in, milung thengho chunga thu adih in tanpeh in.
en_web: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
en_kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahete chu lungset jingin, Midihte thilpha bolpeh jingin!

tcz: Mi kiletsah ho neichotpha sah hih in, ahilouleh miphalouho sot tol le neihisah hih in.
en_web: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
en_kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kiletsahte neidelkhumsah dan, Migiloute neino mangsah hih-in!

tcz: Ven! Thildihlou bolteho alhugam taove! Amahochu kithoudoh kit loudinga sot lhuh ahitaove.
en_web: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
en_kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma khun migiloute akisep lhun, Thou thei louvin akijamtauve.

tcz: Mikitahlou te chung a lungkham dan, thildihlou bolte jong thangse hih in.
en_web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
en_kjv: (א) Fret not thyself because of evildoers, Neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute jeh-in lungkhamdan, Thil dihlou bolte jong thangset dan,

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho khu hamhing banga molloi diu, nipilai pahchaho banga goplha loidiu ahi.
en_web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
en_kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hampa banging op lhan tin, Hamhing banga gop’a thi loi diu ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu tahsa inlang thilpha bollin. Chutileh gamsunga lungmongin chengin natin nakhan touding ahi.
en_web: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
en_kjv: (ב) Trust in the Lord, and do good; So shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin thilpha bol’in, Lung mongin gamsunga chengin.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai a kipah jingin, chutileh aman nalung sunga nangai chatchan napehding ahi.
en_web: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
en_kjv: Delight thyself also in the Lord; And he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kipah thanomin, Aman nalunga nadei chan napeh ding ahi.

tcz: Nabol natoh jouse Yahweh Pakai a pelut jengin, ama chu tahsanin chutileh aman nakithopi ding ahi.
en_web: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
en_kjv: (ג) Commit thy way unto the Lord; Trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kipen, Ama tahsanin Napanpi ding ahi.

tcz: Aman nathem na chu khovah banga muthimlah a avahdoh sahding ahi. Chuleh nachanchin jong sunlai nisa banga avahdoh sahding ahi.
en_web: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
en_kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, And thy judgment as the noonday.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin nadihna khovah abahsah a Sunlai nisa abahsah ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai masangah lungneng chan ngahhat in Aman ahintoh ding chu ngah hat in. Mi giloute ahaotheiukhu lungkhampi hih un, athilse gon ujong lunghimo peh hih in.
en_web: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
en_kjv: (ד) Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
tcz_gospelgo: Thoh hat’in Pakai natoh ngah jingin, Mihao lungkhampi dan, Thilse bol’a lolhing ho jong Lungkhampi hih-in.

tcz: Lungchom lunghan bolhih in! Lung sat a kon in jong kihei mangin. Nalung lhaso hih in hichun thilse lamma bou napui lut ding ahi.
en_web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
en_kjv: (ה) Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungkham lunghan boldan, Gentheina bou nalhut ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu migiloute kisumang ding ahin, amavang Yahweh Pakai tahsan a dingdet ho chun gamsung alodiu ahi.
en_web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
en_kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: But those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya ki-ngaiten gamsung alo diu, Migiloute vang kideldoh diu ahi.

tcz: Migilou hohi gangtah a mangthah diu ahin, amaho chu hol le jonglechun mangthai ding ahitaove.
en_web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
en_kjv: (ו) For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute beiloi ding, Hol jongle chun mupon nate.

tcz: Kisunem tah a umhon gamsung alodiu ahin, lungmong tah leh ninglhing tah a inchengdiu ahi.
en_web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
en_kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nun nemin gamsung lontin, Haotah le mongtah a um diu ahi.

tcz: Mi gilouten Elohim Pathen ngaisah miho douna ahinbol diu; Amahon engset sanna ahin nelpehdiu ahi.
en_web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
en_kjv: (ז) The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin mipha adouvin, Vetdan ha agel khum khum’e.

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, ajeh chu aman achung thu kitanna ding nikhou ahunglhun chu amui.
en_web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
en_kjv: The Lord shall laugh at him: For he seeth that his day is coming.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla abeivah diu ahetjeh-in, Pakaiyin migiloute anuisat’e.

tcz: Mi-engsen hon mivaicha ho leh suhgam theija umte that dingin achemjam u hin asatdoh un, athalpiu hin loisal uvintin, thilpha bolte chu ahin suhmang gotdiu ahi.
en_web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
en_kjv: (ח) The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, And to slay such as be of upright conversation.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahlel vaichate, thildih bolte thana din Migilouten chemjam satdoh-in thalpi akamsal’ui.

tcz: Hinlah achemjam un amaho lungchang asutpai johding chuleh athalpiu chu bong ding ahi.
en_web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
en_kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Achemjam’uva amaho thi diu, Athalpiuvin amaho akap lih ding ahi.

tcz: Ase bola thil tampi neisangin Elohim Pathen mite hia lhomcha nei aphachomjoi.
en_web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
en_kjv: (ט) A little that a righteous man hath Is better than the riches of many wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan themcha anei chu Migiloute gou sangin aphajoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu migiloute hatna chu kisumang ding, Pahen mite vang Yahweh Pakai in avenbit jing ding ahi.
en_web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
en_kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: But the Lord upholdeth the righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin migiloute thahat asuhbei ding, Midihte apanpi ding ahi.

tcz: Ani ania Yahweh Pakai in themmona neilou hochu avetsui ding, chule amahon tonsotna mang louding gou chu alodiu ahi.
en_web: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
en_kjv: (י) The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: And their inheritance shall be for ever.
