tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athu nitte agel khoh-in, Gamsunga tonsot’a cheng diu ahi.

tcz: Amahochu hahsat nikho jongleh kijumso loudiu kel lhah nikho jong leh angaichat ho anei teidiu ahi.
en_web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
en_kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat phatmo teng jongle genthei lou diu, Kel lha jongle nehkhop anei diu ahi.

tcz: Migiloute mangthai diu ahi, Yahweh Pakai dougal miho jong loulaija pahcha tobang ahiuve-mei banga hung mang loi diu ahi.
en_web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
en_kjv: (כ) But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute vang mangthah diu, Pakai melmate pahcha banga pul’a Meikhu banga leng mang diu ahi.

tcz: Migilouten asumpa lah u anungsah ngaipouvin, Elohim Pathen mite vang hongphal tah a peh jeng ahiuve.
en_web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
en_kjv: (ל) The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: But the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin bat din alan alesah kitpon, Miphan vang hongphal’in thil ahom jinge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatthei changhon gamsung alodiu ahin, aman asapset ho vang mangthah diu ahi.
en_web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
en_kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; And they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vangboh changten gamsung alo diu, Agaosapte kidel doh diu ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite, Yahweh Pakai in akalsondan avetpeh in, ahinkho mandan jouse aman akipapin ahi.
en_web: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
en_kjv: (מ) The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: And he delighteth in his way.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi achena lampia Pakaiyin apuiyin, Alung lhainate ahoiddam jinge.

tcz: Amaho chu kipal jongleu lhupai loudiu, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in akhut in atuh jing ui.
en_web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
en_kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: For the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiseplhuu jongle kijamden lou diu, Pakaiyin aphoh ding diu ahinai.

tcz: Phat khat lai chun khangdong kahin tun kateh tai, ahin Elohim Pathen mite paidoh a aumlam kahepon, achateo jong khutdon apangkhapouve.
en_web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
en_kjv: (נ) I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun katehtan, kahing sot lheh tan, Mipha Pakaiyin adonda jong kamu khapon, Achaten jong khutdonneh ahol ngaipoi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen miten khotona neitah in sumpa ahomjiuvin, chuleh achateojong phatthei achang jiuve.
en_web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
en_kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan manbeiyin thil ahom jingin, Bat din jong ahom thouve; Achate jong vangbohna ahiuve.

tcz: Thilse akonin kiheidoh in thilpha bol in, chutileh tonsot a gamsunga nachen ding ahi.
en_web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
en_kjv: (ס) Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse jamsanin thilpha bol’in, Chutile nachate gamsunga cheng jing diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in thudih bou adei in, Elohim Pathen in acha teu jong donlou a akoi louhel ding ahi. Aman ahoibit jing ding, Gitlou bol chate vang mangthah diu ahi.
en_web: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
en_kjv: For the Lord loveth judgment, And forsaketh not his saints; (לע) They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin thildih angailun, Amithengte adalha khapoi. A-itih-in ahoidam jingin, Migilou chate vang adelmang ding ahi,

tcz: Elohim Pathen chaten gamsung alodiu ahin, tonsotna cheng jingdiu ahi.
en_web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
en_kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihten gamsung alo’uva, Achenpha jing diu ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite kamsunga thudih apotjin adihle adihlou ahilthem jiuve.
en_web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
en_kjv: (פ) The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, And his tongue talketh of judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan chihhoi thu aseiyin, Itih-in jong akampha jinge.

tcz: Elohim Pathen Dan chu amaho changval din akisan un, hijeh a chu Ama lampi a konna vah lonle loudiu ahi.
en_web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
en_kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.
tcz_gospelgo: Alungthima a-Pathen Danthu aching jingin, Anitda ngaipoi.

tcz: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen mite achanglhi leuvin, suhmang nading lampi ahol jiuve.
en_web: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
en_kjv: (צ) The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin mipha aching lhin, Tha din agojie.

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in migiloute alolhin sah louhel ding Elohim Pathen in mikitah te patepna a aum tengu le themmo achan louhel ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
en_kjv: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pakaiyin midih chu Migilou kichepnan aneisah pon, Patepna achuh khah tah jongle Themmo achansah ngaipoi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ah kinem jingin. Alamlhong achun ching thei tah in lamjot in. Aman nadopsang a agam leiset nalosah ding ahi. Migilou te manthahvang namu ding ahi.
en_web: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
en_kjv: (ק) Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, And he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kinemin athupeh chengse nit’in, Aman lungset’a gamsunga nachensah ding, Migiloute kideljam namu ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman migilou le khotonabei te Lebanon gama Ceder thingphung phatah banga akhantouvu kamui.
en_web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
en_kjv: (ר) I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green bay tree.
tcz_gospelgo: Thoh lel aum migilou khat kahen, Lebanon a Cedar thing bangin mi chungvum a akikhang sange.

tcz: Ahin kanungvet kitle, ana beisoh taove! Ken kahol le vang in kamudoh joutapoi!
en_web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
en_kjv: Yet he passed away, and lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
tcz_gospelgo: Chomkhat jouva kajotpa leh aumtapon, Kahol vangin kamudoh joupoi.

tcz: Milungtheng holeh miphaho khu veovin, chamna adei hochu amakhouva thilphatah in angah jing ui.
en_web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
en_kjv: (ש) Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: For the end of that man is peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipha melchih-in, midih ching jingin; Cham dei min son le pah aneiyin,

tcz: Hinla thilse bolte suhmanga umdiu ahi; amahon khonung hinkho aneipouve.
en_web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
en_kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: The end of the wicked shall be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset vang asu amangun, Ason apah-u jong asubeihel tauve.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikitah te chu ahuhdoh jin; boina nikho hoa jong Amahi akulpiu ahi.
en_web: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
en_kjv: (ות) But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: He is their strength in the time of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte Pakaiyin ahuhhingin, Gentheipet jongle ahoidam’e.

tcz: Aman amaho chu akithopin, migiloutea kon in ahuhdohjin ahi. Aman amahochu ahuhdoh in, amahon ama a lungmon na anei un ahi.
en_web: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: He shall deliver them from the wicked, And save them, because they trust in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Apanpin ahuhdoh-in, Akom abeljeh-un migiloutea konin ahuhhinge.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lung phatmo nan neilethuh hih in, nalunghan jeh in jong neijep hih in!
en_web: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
en_kjv: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nalunghan teng Neibolgim hih-in!

tcz: Nathal changho kasunga akikam dentan, nakhuttum in neivo lhutan ahi.
en_web: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
en_kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathalpichangin neikap khan, Neikap lhutai!

tcz: Neilunghan khum jeh in katahsa pumpi hi anan, kachonset naho jeh in katahsa achip soh tai.
en_web: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
en_kjv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; Neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Neilunghan jeh-in hatah-in kanan, Kachonset ho jeh-in katahsa aveisei.

tcz: Kathepmo nan eilon khum in, agihdan poh jouhoi ahitapoi.
en_web: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
en_kjv: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonsetnan eilonvuh tan, pohgih hahsa tah-in akneiye.

tcz: Ngolhoi tah a kana chonset jehin, kamaha anasetan auidoh leotai.
en_web: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
en_kjv: My wounds stink and are corrupt Because of my foolishness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngol behseh jeh-in Katina anaikolsoh-in akomsoh tai!

tcz: Kathoh gimna hin ei kong konsah tai, lung gim tah in nilhum kei in kavah len ahi.
en_web: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
en_kjv: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakaiku ku jengin kijel lhop pai ding kahitan, Nilhum lhumin lunghem kathoh-e.

tcz: Khosih pi kasunga meikong bangin a allin, eidammo sahtai.
en_web: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
en_kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: And there is no soundness in my flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Khosih-in kanan Thipai ding kon kahitai!

tcz: Keima kalhasam in kapum in kagoi lhatai. Kalungthim natna a kon in kapeng pengin ahi.
en_web: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
en_kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Beipaiya kijel lhop pai ding kahitan, Nat thoh lel’in kalung gimtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin ipi kangai chat ham nahei, nangin ka khoisatna jouse najai.
en_web: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
en_kjv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, kadei ka-ngai nahen, Kataona najasoh keiye!

tcz: Kahaina hu alhasam tan katha beitai, chule kamit in jong kho amu tapoi.
en_web: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
en_kjv: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadip aphu phu jengin kathabeitai, Kamit jong athim tai!

tcz: Kangailut chengle kagol kapaiten kahivei hi akichaovin eidalha taove. Ka insung mite jengjong achomin aumtaovin ahi.
en_web: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
en_kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; And my kinsmen stand afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Hengle kom, golle paiyin einai ngampon, Katinaho jeh-in ka-insungmi jong akidalseuve.

tcz: Hiche jeng a jong chun kagalmi ten kathi nading thang akam nalai uve. Kaman thahna ding toh gon anei un, nilhum keijin kathi nading agong taovin ahi.
en_web: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
en_kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And imagine deceits all the day long.
tcz_gospelgo: Eithat nomhon thang eikampeh-un, Eisuse nomten suhmang din einokhum’ui. Suhmang din eigo go jenguve.

tcz: Hinlah ken eikigih naho jouse chu kakijah mosah in, chuleh amasang uvah apaomo bangin thipbeh in kaumtai.
en_web: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
en_kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; And I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-ngong bangin kho la kajapon, paomo bangin thujong kasei theipoi.

tcz: Imacha jahlouding kanom in chuleh donbutna jong donbutlou ding kanom e.
en_web: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
en_kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.
tcz_gospelgo: Khojalou mihou lou bangin Keijong ka-umtai!

tcz: Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma ngah jinga um a kahi. Nangin kataona neidonbut tei ding ahi O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen.
en_web: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
en_kjv: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: Thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai Nang katahsan’e, O Pakai ka-Pathen, nangin neihouvin!

tcz: Keima katao in, “kadougalte noise tah in eivetsah dan, kalhuhna a jong kitaisah dan.”
en_web: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
en_kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagimnaa kamelmate kipasah dan, Kalhahsamnaa kamelmate kithang-atda hen!

tcz: Keima tanglouva kathohgim na-ah akichaipai ding kahitai.
en_web: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
en_kjv: For I am ready to halt, And my sorrow is continually before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kana na jengten, Lhulham pai ding kahitai!

tcz: Hinlah kachonset naho kaphong-doh in, ka nachonna ho chu kakisih behseh jenge.
en_web: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
en_kjv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset chengse kaphongin Kakisih lheh jenge!

tcz: Keiman dougal khohtah tah ho kanei e; amahon ajeh beihel in eidou ui.
en_web: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
en_kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate damtheiyin ahat theiyui, Ajeh beiya eihoa atam lheh-e.

tcz: Amahon thilpha kabol chu thilsen eilethuh un, chuleh thilpha kachepi jing jeh in eidouvun ahi.
en_web: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
en_kjv: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; Because I follow the thing that good is.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih kabolgot jeh hin Thilpha jeh a thilsea eidouvah atam’e.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neidalhahih in Elohim ka Pathen kei a kon in um gamla hih behin,
en_web: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
en_kjv: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neidalha loujen-o Pakai, Kidal khin khin hih-in ka-Pathen!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai eihuh hingpa hungloi in lang nei kithopin.
en_web: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
en_kjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun neipanpin, O Pakai eihuhhingpu!

tcz: “Katohna chunga chingthei tah in thil bol ing kating, kathusei doh chenga chonseponge. Kavel a Elohim Pathen ginglou ho aumteng kalei kakituh tang ding ahi” tin kei le kei kakihou ve.
en_web: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
en_kjv: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman, “Ching theiyin na tong ing ting, Kakamin chonset thu seiponge; Kavel’a migiloute umlaidsen Imacha sei ponge,” kati.

tcz: Hinla hitia thipbeh a kaum a thupha jeng jong changkhat cha seilouva kaum chun kalung sunga lung gimna akhoh secheh in ahi.
en_web: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
en_kjv: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathip beh-in imacha kaseipoi, Thilpha jeng jong kaseipoi! Hinla kathohgim akhoh cheh cheh-e.

tcz: Kalunga kagelbe chan in kalung gimna akhoh cheh in, hiti chun seilou in kaum theipon ahi:
en_web: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
en_kjv: My heart was hot within me, While I was musing the fire burned: Then spake I with my tongue,
tcz_gospelgo: Kalung jongle kagimbe cheh-e; Hijeh chun paolouvin ka-umthei tapon:

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai leiset a kahinkhohi ichan a chom hitam neihin hetsah jing in, kahin nikhohi akisim jinghi neigeldoh sah in, kahin kho iti chom hitam?
en_web: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
en_kjv: Lord, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; That I may know how frail I am.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai, ichan kahin a itih kathi ding ham? Kahinkho itih bei ding ham neihil’in,” kati.

tcz: Nangin kahinkhov hi ichangeija chom a nasem hitam kakhut phang sangin jong asaojo poi. Nang dingin kahinkho lhum kei jong hi haikhat bou ahi soh tan, Mihem hinkho khat cheh jong hi haikhat cheh bou ahi.”
en_web: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
en_kjv: Behold, thou hast made my days as a handbreadth; And mine age is as nothing before thee: Verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Iti kahinkho hichanseh a neisempeh ham! Navetdanin kahinkho imachan namupoi. Tahbeh mongin mihem jouse hi Haikhat kah a hingbou ahi.

tcz: Mihem hinkho hi milom kitol bang bep bou ahin, kisah lunggim naho jong hetman lou kah in akichai loi ji tai. Gou ikhol khom un, kon ahin manding ham jong ihe doh ji pouve.
en_web: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
en_kjv: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilim kahei bep, Anatoh jouse pannabei, Neile gou apokhom khomin Koipen chang ding ahepoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai hoi a kinep na kakoi ding ham? Nanga bou kakinep na aum e.
en_web: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
en_kjv: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: I-baham Pakai kakineppi ding? Nanga kinem jing kahi!

tcz: Kaset bolnom na a kon in neihuh doh in, mingol ho neinoise sah hih in.
en_web: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
en_kjv: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset chengsea neihuhdoh-in, Mi-ngolte neinuiaat sah hih-in!

tcz: Keima na ansung a thipchet in kaum e; imacha jong kasei louding ahi.
en_web: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
en_kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin gim genthei neithohsah-e, Paopoh louvin umthim tange!

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nei engbol hih in! Nakhut gu dounan kachao lhagam tai.
en_web: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
en_kjv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem chonset chengse naphoh-in talen napen, Adeipen jong nget neh bangin nasubeijitai. Tahbeh mongin mihem hi Haikhat kah a hingbou ahi.

tcz: Kachonset u suhdih na dia neijep tengu le, kasah lut u chonsetna chu nget in aneh bang in ajun lhaji tan ahi. Tahbeh in mihem khat cheh hi haikhat bou ahi.
en_web: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
en_kjv: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang panpi ngaija kataona neingai pih in! kamit lhi lon nah sah mon koi hih in, ajeh chu keima hi namaljin bou kahin, kema masang a kapu kapa teu bang a kholjin vahle kahi bouve.
en_web: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
en_kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, And give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, And a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin Pakai, kakagin ngaiyin; Kakateng neipanpin. Kapu kapate banga chom khat kholjin le khopem bou kahi.

tcz: Hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah a kahin kho abei masang kakipa a kanui kit na din nalung han na, nagim bol na ho toh neichom khen in.
en_web: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
en_kjv: O spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathi kah beh a nopna kaneina din Neidondan neichanglha tan!

tcz: Panpi ding ngai in Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in kangah jing e, aman kahenglam ahin ngan kataona eisanpih tai.
en_web: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
en_kjv: I waited patiently for the Lord; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
tcz_gospelgo: Thoh hattah-in Pakai panpi ka-ngah-in, Aman eikhohsah-in kataona asangtai.

tcz: Aman lunglhah nathei kotong a kon in eikai doh in, buol sung a buon ngan lah a kon in eikai doh in tolgo chung a eidin sah in kakal sonna jong eisuh dih pih e.
en_web: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
en_kjv: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay, And set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijat umtah khokhuh a konin eikaidoh-in, Bolsung bon-ngan lah a eiloidoh tai. Songpi chunga mong tah-in eikhangdoh-in, Lung mongin eikoitai.

tcz: Kasah ding lathah khat eipen, I Pathen u Elohim vahchoi na ding la khat eipen ahi. Mitamtah in ana toh hin mu un tin adatmo ding u ahi. Hitia chu amahon Yahweh Pakai chu atah san diu ahi.
en_web: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
en_kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pathenu vahchoina la Lathah sahje eihil’e. Amupha chan tijauvin tin Pakai atahsanlo didu ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai tahsan na a ding det ho iti akipah tadiuvem, amahon mikiletsah ho chung a tahsan na anei pouvin ahilouleh semthu pathen limhou ho jong atahsan pouve.
en_web: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
en_kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
tcz_gospelgo: Doihou lou, pathen lhem houte jop lou Pakaiya ki-ngaite chu anun nom’e.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, nangin keiho ding in thil kidang tah tah neibolpeh taove. Neigon peh u thilho hi simjou sutjou hoi ahipoi. Nangto kibang ding koima cha aum poi. Na kidang natoh doh ho hi sim ding kagon, achaina gei kalhun lou ding kahei.
en_web: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
en_kjv: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: If I would declare and speak of them, They are moe than can be numbered.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathenu, Thil tampi neibolpeh peh jengun, Nang tobang koima aumpon, Kadiuvin thilgon kidang tah tah nagong’e. Atam behseh jengtan Ajat mong kaseijoupoi.

tcz: Nangman pumgo thilto ho a hin kipana nanei poi. Nei ngaisah thu ho chu tun kahechen tai, nangin chonset thoidam na thilto leh pumgo thilto jong nangeh poi.
en_web: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
en_kjv: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
tcz_gospelgo: Kilhaina gantha le thilpeh na-ngeh pon, Maicham phunga gan pumgo jong natipoi; Chonset ngaidamna pumgo thilto na-ngeh dehpoi, Kasei chan phate chan neingaipeh joi.

tcz: Hichun keiman kaseijin, “Ven keima kahung e. Elohim Pathen lekhabu a kisun bang in:
en_web: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
en_kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come: In the volume of the book it is written of me,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kenjong, “Hikoma ka-umin, Neihilchahna jouse Danthubua akisunin,

tcz: Nangma lungdei lam bolding hi katha anop na ahi, O Elohim Pathen, ajeh chu kalung sung a nangma Danthu hohi akisun lut tai.”
en_web: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
en_kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: Yea, thy law is within my heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungdei bol ding kadeiye ka-Pathen! Neihilna kalungthima kachinge,” kati.

tcz: Namite jouse lah a nathutan dih je hi kaphongdoh tai. O het themna nei Yahweh Pakai, nangma bang in kichaloubeh in kasei doh tai.
en_web: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
en_kjv: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: Lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung kakhopnaa neihuhhingnau Thupha kaphongdoh tai Pakai! Tang louhel’a kasei jing ding Nangman nahei.

tcz: Nadih jedan kipana thupha hi keiman kachang a din kalungthim a selguh in kakoi poi; Nakitah na le nami huhhing na thu kasei e. Nahoubung mithengte lah a namingai lut na long lou le nakitah na chu tanglou in kasei phong jinge.
en_web: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
en_kjv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
tcz_gospelgo: Huhhingna Thupha chu ka-impon, nakitahna le napanpi kasei jinge. Houbung kakhopnaa ka-umthimpon, Nalal loupina le nalungset longlou kaseiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin tanglou vin neingailu jing jeng in. Nangailut nale nakitahna chu neihoi bit jing sah in.
en_web: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
en_kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai neikhoto jing ding kahei, Nalungset le nalal loupinan eihoidam jinge.

tcz: Boinan eibom in sim a simjou hoi ahipoi! Kachonsetna akikhol sang in kalampi jong kamu thei tapoi. Kalujang a kasam sangin atamjo tan hansan na him him kanei jou tapoi.
en_web: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
en_kjv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: Mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; They are moe than the hairs of mine head, therefore my heart faileth me.
tcz_gospelgo: Simsen lou hahsatnan eiumkimsoh tan, kachonset hon seimantan kho kamutapoi. Kalujangsam sangin atamjon Kameidoilo tai.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! hung vah in Yahweh Pakai neipanpin.
en_web: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
en_kjv: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhingin Pakai! Neipanpin keima tun!

tcz: Eisumang gohohi jumson lang kisuhboi sah in, kahahsat nikho a kipah ho lungdong in nungjam sah in.
en_web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
en_kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; Let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Tha dia eigote chun Gal lel’u hem kisudongu hen! Kahahsatna kipah thanomte chu Nungjamu hen jahchau hen!

tcz: “Aha tun akimaikhah tai” ti a asei jeh un, jum nan kichao hen.
en_web: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
en_kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha!
tcz_gospelgo: Tot nopna eineiho chun Gal lel’u hen jum’u hen!

tcz: Nangkom hinbel jouse kipa nale thanop nan dimset uhen. Nami huhhing na kipapi hochun “Yahweh Pakai chu aloupi e” tin sam jing u hen.
en_web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
en_kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.
tcz_gospelgo: Naheng jin jouse kipah thanom hen! Nahuhhhingna thangvah ten, “Pakai chu loupe tah ahi,” Tin sei jing jengu hen!

tcz: Keidin vang gentheile vaicha kahi jeh in, Yahweh Pakai in alung sung a eihoi jing hen. Yahweh Pakai nang chu eikithopi le eihuhhingpu nahi. O ka Pathen Elohim khongai sot hih in.
en_web: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
en_kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, vaicha kalhahsam vangin Nangin neisumil deh poi! Eihuhhingpa ka-Pathen nahi Neipanhu loiyin!

tcz: Mivaichate khoto ho chu anunnom ahi! Amaho chu Yahweh Pakai in boina ato nao a kon a ahuhdoh diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
en_kjv: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: The Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaicha khotote anun nom’ui! Hahsa atokhah tengu pakaiyin apanpi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahoibit in ahinghoi jiu ve. Aman amaho chu gamsung ah phatthei aboh in galmiho akon na ahuhdoh ji e.
en_web: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
en_kjv: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; And he shall be blessed upon the earth: And thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu Pakaiyin achingin ahoidam’e. Gamdsunga anomlensah jin. Amelmatei kichepnan aneisahjipoi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in adam mo naova panpin tin adamdoh sahding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
en_kjv: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: Thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
tcz_gospelgo: Adammo tengu pakaiyin kithopin tin, Adamsah kit ding ahi.

tcz: “O Yahweh Pakai”, katao ahi “eilungset in, neidamdoh sah in ajeh chu nangma dounan kachonsetai.”
en_web: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
en_kjv: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman, “Nang dounan kachonsetai Pakai, Neikhoton neidamsah-in,” tin kataove.

tcz: Ahinla kadougal ten keima dounan thilse jeng asei un ahi. “Itih tah le athin suhmil in aum tadem?” atiu ve.
en_web: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
en_kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten setah tah-in eihouvun, kathia suhmil’a kaum ding adeiyui.

tcz: Kagol kapai bang in eihung vil jiuvin, hinla chomloukah in kachungchang guhthim thu asei khom leuvin, eidalhah tengu le muntin in aphonjal ji taove.
en_web: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
en_kjv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: His heart gathereth iniquity to itself; When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihungve ho along thengpon, Kaphatmoa chengse achingun, Apot tengu gamtin a Aseithangsoh tauve.

tcz: Eihot bolten keichung chang a thilphalou ngan aseijun, kachung a thilse ahung lhun dingbou adei un ahi.
en_web: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
en_kjv: All that hate me whisper together against me: Against me do they devise my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Eivetda chengse keithu akihou lhiuvin, Kachunga thilse cheh cheh agel’uve.

tcz: “Amahi thina thei hiveija na ahi” atiuve. “Amahi damdoh joulou ding ahitai!” atiuve.
en_web: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
en_kjv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Amahi athinattan, Damdoh kit taponte,” atiuve.

tcz: Katahsan pen kagol phapen, an kaneh khom pipa jeng jong keima eidouvin apang tai.
en_web: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
en_kjv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Which did eat of my bread, Hath lift up his heel against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaginchat tah, kagol phapen Kaneh khompi geiyin eidoutai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai neilungset in. Neidamdoh sah kitin amahohi kalethuh jou nadin!
en_web: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
en_kjv: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, And raise me up, that I may requite them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, neikhoton neidamsah-in, kamelmate chunga phu lange!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti kahei ajeh chu nangin kamelmate kachungah gal nalel sahtai.
en_web: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
en_kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachunga nalunglhai kahei, kamelmate neijosah hih-in,

tcz: Nangin kahinkho neihing hoipeh tai, ajeh chu keiman lhamonna kaneipoi, chuleh nangin atonsot a din na-angsung a neipui luttai.
en_web: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
en_kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih kabol jinge, neipanpin nate; Na-anga neikoi jing ding ahi.

tcz: Israel Elohim Pathen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen, Tonsot tonsot a hingjing pa chu. Amen chule Amen!
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Israel Pathen vahchoiyun, Tonsot tonsot’in Ama Vahchoiyun! Amen! Amen!

tcz: Sakhi sitwi chimset ngaichat dangchah bangin, kahin ngaicha e O Pathen Elohim.
en_web: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
en_kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
tcz_gospelgo: Sitwi votjen lha-ngai sakhi bangin, O Pathen Nangma ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Hingjing Elohim Pathen chu dangchah in kalha ngai e. Itih tahle kache a a-anga kachibai theiding ham?
en_web: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
en_kjv: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo hing jing Pathen ka-ngaiye! Itih leh na-anga chibai kaboh ding ham?

tcz: Sunle jan in lonlhi bou ann in kanei tai, kagal miten phat tin in ei enghouvun “Na Elohim Pathen hoija umham atiuve?”
en_web: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
en_kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
tcz_gospelgo: Sun le janin kakap’in, An neh khel’in kalhi along longe! Kamelmaten, “Na-Pathen hoiba ham?” tin Ei dodng dong jengui!

tcz: Kalung thim analheh ji e thil umdan hochu kageldoh ji teng: Elohim Pathen houin a mihonpi chutoh kilhon a, tanggol a Elohim Pathen inlam jon a kitol a thangvah la kisa a mihonpin golvah kibolji hochu!
en_web: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
en_kjv: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: For I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chesa kageldoh teng kalungnai. Japi toh lhonin Pathen HOuin kajonin, Mipi kijot kalamkaiyin, Thanomtah-in Pathen cahvhoi la san asam’ui!

tcz: Ibol a kei lunglha dah kahim? Ibol a kalung hibanga hesoh a ham? Keiman Elohim Pathen a kinepna giltah kanei in! Ken ama kathang vah kit ding ahi ka huhhing pu Elohim ka Pathen.
en_web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
en_kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? Hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him For the help of his countenance.
tcz_gospelgo: Idia hibang lung nommo Gentheiya um kahim? Pathen jenga kinem leng, Eihuhhing ka-Pathen vahchoi kit nange.

tcz: Tun keima kalung alhadah lheh jengtai, hinlah Jordan hung kondoh na, Hermon molsang lang hijong le kahin gel doh jing ding nahi.
en_web: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
en_kjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee From the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghel le lhachomtah-in, Mizar molsang, Hermon molsang Jordan dung lonna gamsunga kadingin, Namikhoto themje kagel jinge!

tcz: Nang man twipibang nakinon a naki ho twikhanglen gin chu kajai, nangma twipi kidilleh twipi kitol chun eihin lonvuh in ahi.
en_web: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
en_kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-ogin komtong te ni kah a athongin, Natwipi dil kinong laiyin eilonvuh tai!

tcz: Ahinlah niseh in Yahweh Pakai in angailutna longlou chun eiphung vuh jingin, chuleh janseh leh ama vahchoila kasajin hinkho eipe a Yahweh Pakai komma chun kataojin ahi.
en_web: GOD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
en_kjv: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, And in the night his song shall be with me, And my prayer unto the God of my life.
tcz_gospelgo: Sunteng jongle Pakai neilungset’in, Janteng kahinna Pathen henga la sang ting taovinge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi keima kakapme, ipi dinga neisuhmil hitam? Ipidinga kadougal te bol hesoh jeh a lunggima kavale jingding ham?
en_web: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
en_kjv: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
tcz_gospelgo: Eipanpi jing Pathen henga, “Idia neisuhmil’a, kamelmae gitlouna chengse Kadou dou jeng ham?” kati.

tcz: Eihou setnao hin kagep lhatan ahi, “Na Pathen hoija umham,” tin eidong jingun ahi.
en_web: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
en_kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; While they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
tcz_gospelgo: Melmaten ei-enghou hou jengun, “Na-Pathen hoiba ham?” tin eidongui!

tcz: Ipi dinga keima hiti lungkham kahin, epidinga hiti lungboi kahim? Keiman Elohim Pathen nah kakinepna koijing ting chuleh eihuhhing paleh ka Pathen chu avellin thangvah kit inge.
en_web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
en_kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, Who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen themmona bei kahi neiphongdoh in! Elohim Pathen ginglou hoa kon in nei vengdoh in, chutengleh mikitah lou holeh joupan hoa kon in neihuhdoh in.
en_web: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
en_kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen them neichanin, pathen heloute neidouhun, Migilou jouseitea konin Neihuhdoh-in!

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghi kakiselna Pathen Elohim nahi, ibol a neipaidoh hitam? Ibol a keima kadougal ten eibolset jeh a lunggim a kava lele dingham?
en_web: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
en_kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiselna Pathen nahime, Idia neidonda ham? Iti kamelmate gitlouna chengse kadou dou jeng ding ham?

tcz: Nadih na le navah na chu neihinsol peh in, hichun eilamhil hen. Hihochun nangma chenna muol theng chu eilhut hen.
en_web: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
en_kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Salvah-in nadihan phongin, Nalhangtheng Zion aeipui hen Nachenna Houin eilhut lhon hen!

tcz: Hikomma chun keima Elohim Pathen maicham achu kasemjang puma kathang vahding ahi, O Pathen Elohim.
en_web: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
en_kjv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy: Yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng namaicham phung jontange Pathen! Nangbou kanopna nahi. Kasem jang saiyin navahchoi la sange. O Pathen ka-Pathen!

tcz: Idia lungkham kahim? Ipidinga kalung lhadah ham? Keiman kakinepna Elohim Pathen a koi inge! Eihuhhingpa le Elohim ka Pathen keiman nangma thangvah kit inge!
en_web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
en_kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? Hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, Who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Idia hibang lung nommo Gentheiya um kahim? Pathen jenga kinem leng Eihuhhing ka-Pathen vahchoikit nange.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, phat sottah masanga kapu kapateo khanglai a nanatoh nathil bolho eina seipeh u chu keiho tah in kanakol un kanajaove:
en_web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
en_kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, khanglui lai, Kapu kapateu nikho laiya Thil kidang nabol chengse eiseipeh-un, kamit’in kamu’vin kanan kajatauve!

tcz: Nangin nangma helou namtin vaipi ho naban thahat in nana deljam in agam leiset uchu kapu kapateo nanapen ahi. Nangin agalmiteo nana suhlhuh peh in kapu kapateo chu nana chamlhat sah in ahi.
en_web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
en_kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; How thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi nadelmangin Namite gamsunga nachensah-e. Namite nakhantousah-e.

tcz: Amahon achemjam uva gal anajouva gam analah u ahipoi; aban thahat uva jong gal anajou ahipoi. Amavang nangma ban thahat leh namaivah chun gal nana jopeh ahibouve ajeh chu nangin amaho chu nana ngailun ahi.
en_web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
en_kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them: But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou hadst a favour unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung hi chemhem hat’a namiten alah-u ahipon, Athahat man’uva ajo’u jong ahipoi; Na-ngailut jeh le naumpi jeh, ahibouve.

tcz: Nangma kalengpa le Elohim ka Pathen nahin nangin Israel te dingin gal nana jo peh tai.
en_web: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
en_kjv: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverances for Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang kalengpa le ka-Pathen, Namite gal najosah-e.

tcz: Nangma thahatna jal a bou kagal miteo kanungno jouvu ahin naming a bou keihon eidouhou kachotphao ahibouve.
en_web: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
en_kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathahat kengin Kamelmateu kajoutauve!

tcz: Keiman kathalpi kasongpoi, kachemjamin eihuhdoh dingjong kakinempoi.
en_web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
en_kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kihinsona din kathalpi jong kasongpon, Kachemjam jong kasongpoi.

tcz: Nangma bouvin kagalmi teo chunga galjona neipeh u ahibouve, hitihin nangin eihotbol teo chu jumna napejin ahi.
en_web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
en_kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, And hast put them to shame that hated us.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmateuva konin neihuhdoh tauvin, Eihot bolteu najoutai.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen naloupina ho hi tantih neilou va ka samphon jing diu, chule a kumkho a ka thangvah jing diu ahi.
en_web: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
en_kjv: In God we boast all the day long, And praise thy name for ever. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma kavahchoi jing diu, Tonsot’a kathangvah diu nahi!

tcz: Ahinla tunvang nangin jumthetna neipaidoh u ahitai. Nangin ka sepia hou jengjong neilamkai peh tapouve.
en_web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
en_kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; And goest not forth with our armies.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla neipaiyun gal neilelsah tauve, Kasepaiteu to jong gal nakonkhompoi!

tcz: Nangin kagalmi teu va kon in neinung jamsah un chuleh eidou houchu kagamsung u nalosah tai.
en_web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
en_kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: And they which hate us spoil for themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmateu masanga neideljam’un, Kathil jouseu amahon akilah tauve.

tcz: Nangin kelngoiho bangin eikisat chen chen sah gamtaovin chitin vaipi lah a neithe thang gamtaove.
en_web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
en_kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; And hast scattered us among the heathen.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngaoi kisatchap neibahsah-un, Vannoi gamtina neithecheh doh tauve.

tcz: Nangin nasahlut namitehi manbai tah in najohdoh in man neilouhel toh nabah sahtai.
en_web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
en_kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
tcz_gospelgo: Man lhomchan nagel’in, Namite man baitah-in najoh mangtai.

tcz: Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise neichansah taovin kavelluva mite taitom le houset dingbep in neikoitaove.
en_web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
en_kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
tcz_gospelgo: Neibolnau kaheng kakomun amun, Eidaithangun einuisat tauve.

tcz: Nangin amaho totthang hoina bepseo neihisah taovin isahlou tah in alu eihih khum taovin ahi.
en_web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
en_kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, A shaking of the head among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi seichah din neibol’un, Lu eithin khumun einuisat tauve.

tcz: Ki taitom jingna a konhin kakile doh jouta pouvin kamai uva jumleh jachat mel kapu den taove.
en_web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
en_kjv: My confusion is continually before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,
tcz_gospelgo: Vetda jengin ka-umin, Jum le ja kathot-e!

tcz: Kajah uhi eitaitomteo housetna thucheng ngen ahin, kamit uva kamu houhi ahileh kachunguva phula nom dougal mite ngen ahiuve.
en_web: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
en_kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; By reason of the enemy and avenger.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihotbol kamelmate houset le ohin Ka-ngai ngai jengin ahi!

tcz: Hichenghi kathoh jeng vangun keihon nangma kasumil deh pouvin ahi. Kitepna thuchengho jong kasukeh deh pouve.
en_web: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
en_kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Neitepnau kasuh keh dauva, Nang kasuhmil lou vangun Hichengse hi kachunguva Alhungsoh tai.

tcz: Kalung thim un nangma kanuse deh pouvin nalampia konin jong kajam mangdeh pouve.
en_web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
en_kjv: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way;
tcz_gospelgo: Nangla lheptol’in kabol pouvin, Nathupeh chengse kanitda pouve.

tcz: Hinlah nangin sial chenna neldi gam anei suchipden taove, nangin thina le muthim neikhu khum taove.
en_web: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
en_kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, And covered us with the shadow of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla gamsahang lah a neidalhauvin, Muthim lhangkhal jing lah a neidondauve.

tcz: I jemtia keihon Elohim ka Pathen u min kasuh mil uva ahilouleh gamdang semthu pathen houna a kakhut u kalhandoh khah uva ahileh,
en_web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
en_kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathenu chibai kaboh dauva, Doi kahoutah-u jongleh,

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ahet teiding ahi ajeh chu Aman mihem lungthim a thuguh jouse ahet ahi.
en_web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
en_kjv: Shall not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahetdoh tei ding ahi, Ajeh chu kalungthim jouseu nahesoh-e.

tcz: Ahin, nangma jal in niseh in eiki thatnun; kelngoi bangin eiki that taove.
en_web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
en_kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunla Nang kahoujeh-un thading salhemin eikikoiyun, Tha dia koisa kelngoi bangin eikiboltauve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hung thoudoh in ibol a na imut ham? Hung thoudoh in! neipaidoh pai pai hihbeh un.
en_web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
en_kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast us not off for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thouvin Pakai! Idia na-ihmut ham? Kipat’in, donda hel din neigel hih-un!

tcz: Ipidinga namai naheimang ham? Kathohgim naoleh eibolset naohi nanahsah lou hitam?
en_web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
en_kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia kiselmang nahim? Kagenthei hesoh nau sumil hih-in!

tcz: Keiho leivui lah a kalhumat gam taove, bonlhoh lah a akhupbon kakijam taove.
en_web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
en_kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Tol’a eichit thangun, Kalel jeh-un leivui lah a kalumden tauve.

tcz: Hung kipatdoh inlang! Neikithopiuvin! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihung lhatdoh taovin.
en_web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
en_kjv: Arise for our help, And redeem us for thy mercy’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihung panpiuvin, Nalungset long loujeh-in neihuhhingun!

tcz: Kalungthim in thu hoi tah ahung kilang e. Keiman lengpa chungchang hiche jaila ngeitah hi lungchin in sei inge, ajeh chu kalei hi jaila themtah pa mol jap tobang ahi.
en_web: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
en_kjv: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungthima thu ngei adimtan, Lengpa kalachoiye! Lekhasunpa lekhamol gonsa bangin Labol din kalei akilehgotai.

tcz: Nanghi mihem jouselah a ahoipen nahi, nalei a thungei tamtah ahung potdoh e. Elohim Pathen amatah in tonsotna din phatthei naboh tan ahi.
en_web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
en_kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal mel-houpen nahin, Thusei nathemin, Pathenin vang naboh jinge!

tcz: O galhatpa! nachemjam chu hin kipoh in! nangmahi naloupi in nathupi e!
en_web: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
en_kjv: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, With thy glory and thy majesty.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachemjam kikon, Vo leng thahat! Naminthangin nalal loupi!

tcz: Nathupina a chun hung kivon in lang galjou dingin hung kondoh tem in, thutah leh thudih chuleh kisuhnemna hohi chejom sahdingin kondoh inlang datmo umtah tah thilho chu hung tongdoh tan!
en_web: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
en_kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously Because of truth and meekness and righteousness; And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih a panga adih a thutan din Galjou din sakol chunga hung touvin! Nathahat chun minthangtah-in Gal jouvin nate!

tcz: Nathal muh hochu ahem in nagal mite lungsung asunvang jeng tai. Namtin vaipi nakengto noija aumtaive.
en_web: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
en_kjv: Thine arrows are sharp In the heart of the king’s enemies; Whereby the people fall under thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathalpi chang ahem theiyin, Namelmate lungchang akap pai jel jel’e; Namtin vaipi Nakhomuh a aboh khup’ui!

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen nalal touna hi tonsot tonsot a chejom jing ding ahi. Naleng tengol a chu thudih tah a vai nahomding ahi.
en_web: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
en_kjv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: The sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, nalenggamin beitih neipontin, Thudih-in namite vai nahoppeh-e!

tcz: Nangin thudih tah a thutan nadeijin thilse nathet ahi. Hijeh chun Elohim Pathen, nangma Pathen Elohim chun thao nanu ahitai, lengdang sanga nang chungahi kipale thanopna thaotwi chu nasunlhah khum ahitai.
en_web: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
en_kjv: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin thilpha nadeiyin thilse nahoi; Hijeh chun Pathen, na-Pathenin lengdin nalhenge. Leng dang joouse sangin Kipa nopna napei!

tcz: Myrrh, aloes, chuleh cassia hon navon anamtui sel e. Saiha a kisem khopia chu tumging ngaitah a nakilamto ding ahi.
en_web: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
en_kjv: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, Out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Naponsil jouse myrrh le aloe gimvui anamin, Saihaa kijem leng inpia lathemhon nalem’ui!

tcz: Leng Chanute chu na numei nunnem te lah a aum un. Najet langa ophir sana hoipen ho a kijem lengnu ading e.
en_web: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
en_kjv: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: Upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
tcz_gospelgo: Naleng inpia lhacha numeiho jong Lengte chanu jeng ahiuvin, Nalaltouna jetlama lengnu adingin, Ophir gama sana hoipenin akijem’e!

tcz: O leng chanu te kathusei ngai un; amapa hi jabol un ajeh chu ama hi na Yahweh Pakai pau ahi.
en_web: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
en_kjv: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei ngaiyin lengpa jia kipuinu! Namite le na-insung mite geldatan!

tcz: Ajeh chu sahlut tah naji hi namel hoinan alunglhai sel e; jabol in, ajeh chu amapa hi na Pakai pa ahi.
en_web: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
en_kjv: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: For he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
tcz_gospelgo: Namel-hoi jeh-in lengpan deichan natin, Napu jong ahijeh a athu na-ngai ding ahi.

tcz: Tyre lengpa chanuten jong kipa thilpeh tampi nahung pehdiu ahi. Mihaoten nalung lhaina ding ahin holdiu ahi.
en_web: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
en_kjv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; Even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
tcz_gospelgo: Tyre gam miten thilpeh ding thil hinpon tin, Mihaoten nalung lhaina ahinhol diu ahi!

tcz: Mounu, leng chanu, chu kivon na sana a kisem sangkholchol a chu iti vet loupia hitam.
en_web: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
en_kjv: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: Her clothing is of wrought gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng inpia leng chanu aumin, amel-hoi lheh-e! Sana monkenga kijem poncho asil’e.

tcz: Hiche avon loupi tah kivon in lengpa kom lam a ahin pui un, anunjui nungah hochutoh apuilut un ahi.
en_web: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
en_kjv: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: The virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Aponchol jempah pumin lengpa henga apuiyun, Alhacha nu-ngah hon ajuiyun, abonin lengpa henga apuitauve.

tcz: Kipah tahle thanom tah a leng inpi sunga ahung akijot lut uchu iti lou a loupi hitam!
en_web: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
en_kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: They shall enter into the king’s palace.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipah thanomin ahungun, Leng inpia alut tauve.

tcz: Nachate jong apa tobang a leng hung hicheh ding ahiuve. Nangin amaho chu gam tamtah a lenga napan sah ding ahi.
en_web: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
en_kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo nangama kalengpa, Chapa tampi hingin, Leng changu hen napate khel’u hen, Leiset pumpi vaihomin pansah-in!

tcz: Khang jousea na min thanna kahin pohlut pehding ahi. Hijeh achu namtin vaipin tonsot a nahin thangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
en_kjv: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalabol hin naming seithang jingin tin, Akhang khanga min navahchoi diu ahi!

tcz: Elohim Pathenhi ikiselnao leh isongpiu ahi, boina nikho hoa eipanhu diuva kigosa ahi.
en_web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
en_kjv: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: I-kiselnau le ihatnau Pathen ahin, Genthei teng kithopi din eigo jingui.

tcz: Hijeh achu ling kihot henlang molle lhang chim henlang twikhanglen a kilehlut jongleh kicha tapouvinge.
en_web: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
en_kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun leiset pumpi kihot ling hen, Molsang jouse Twikhanglena kileh lut jongle I-kichat lou diu ahi.

tcz: Twikhanglen hi kinong henlang kitum jeng hen. Twikhanglen kinong a ahung letdoh jeng bang in muolle lhang jong kihot chimlha jeng hen.
en_web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
en_kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen kidil hen kinong hen, Thinglhang jouse hotjal jongle kichapoute.

tcz: Vadung khat in iPathen u khopia chun kipa thanopna ahin polut e.
en_web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
en_kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
tcz_gospelgo: Vadung khat alongin, Pathen khopi Chungnungpen Houin thenga kipana ahinlhut’e.

tcz: Hiche khopi achun Elohim Pathen achengin kisumang thei lou ding ahi. Nikho kipat a pat Elohim Pathen in avenbit jingding ahi.
en_web: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
en_kjv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopia chun Pathen apansan, Koiman khopi chu sumangponte; Jingkah matah a hungkona Khopi chu Pathenin akithopi ding ahi.

tcz: Leiset chung namtin vaipihi aboitan lenggam hojong akiling sohtan ahi! Elohim Pathen ahung kisen in ahileh leiset ajunlha gamtan ahi!
en_web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
en_kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi akichauvin, Lenggam jouse akilingsoh tauve; Pathenin lhang asamin, Leiset ajol lhatai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung hi ilah uva aum in, Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
en_kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve.

tcz: Hungin Yahweh Pakai thil loupi bolhi hungvetan, Hunginlang aman vannoi leiset asuhmang hi hungve tan.
en_web: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
en_kjv: Come, behold the works of the Lord, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungun Pakai natoh hung veuvin, Veuvin itobang datmo thil abol hitam!

tcz: Aman vannoi leiset pumpia galho hi atuhtang in athalpiu leh ateng chau heboh peh gamtan ahi.
en_web: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
en_kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariot in the fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya gal kisat jouse avotangin Thalchang aheh bongin, tengcha avobongin, Lum jouse ahal vamsoh tai!

tcz: “Thipchet un, chule Elohim Pathen kahi hi heovin! Vannoi leiset pumin eijabol cheh diu ahi. Leiset pumpia a hi dopsanga kaum ding ahi.”
en_web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
en_kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: “Umthim’uvin, heuvin Pathen kahi; Namtin vaipi lah a chungnungpen, Vannoiya thanei chungnungpen kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hatchungnung Elohim Pathenhi ilah uva aumme; Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
en_kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve!

tcz: Mijouse hungun! Nakhut benguvin! Elohim Pathen kom a kipah tah in thangvahna sam un!
en_web: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
en_kjv: O clap your hands, all ye people; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin vaipi kipah-in khut bengun! Othongin la san Pathen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung chu gimneitah ahi. Amahi leiset chunga leng thupitah ahi.
en_web: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
en_kjv: For the Lord most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ginpen ding Hatchungnungpen Pakai ahin, Leng loupe ahin, vannoiya vai ahom’e!

tcz: Aman imasang uvah namtin vaipi hi asonkun in eidougalteo jong ikengto noi uvah eikoipeh taove.
en_web: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
en_kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, And the nations under our feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin vaipi eijosah-un, Namtin vaipi chunga vai eihomsah-ui!

tcz: Gamtep gam chu, angailut Jacob chilhahate, kithang at tah a kijot eiho lodinga alhen ahi.
en_web: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
en_kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, The excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Chemun gam eipeuvin, Angailut amite hoithopi gam anapei.

tcz: Elohim Pathen chu gimnei tah in akal tou in, Yahweh Pakai chu sumkon gin kithong pum'in akal tou in ahi.
en_web: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
en_kjv: God is gone up with a shout, The Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin alaltouna ajontouvin, Kipana kholhang akisamin sumkon akimut’e! Pakai akitol toutai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin; ilengpau thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin!
en_web: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
en_kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
tcz_gospelgo: Sauvin Pathen vahchoi la! I-Lengpau vahchoi la sauvin!

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen hi leiset chung pumpi chunga leng ahi lasah pum'in thangvah un.
en_web: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
en_kjv: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi pumpi leng Pathen ahi, Sauvin avahchoina La!

tcz: Elohim Pathen alaltouna theng chunga atou in namtin vaipi lah'a vai ahom'e.
en_web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
en_kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen alaltouna thenga atouvin, Namtin vaipi vai ahompeh-e!

tcz: Vannoi leiset vaihomte Abraham Pathen Elohim mitetoh atoukhom'un ahi, ajeh chu leiset chunga leng jouse hi Elohim Pathen'a ahi. Amahi vannoi leiset chung muntin a jana achang'in ahi.
en_web: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
en_kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, Even the people of the God of Abraham: For the shields of the earth belong unto God: He is greatly exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi vaihomte Abraham Pathen mite toh akikhom’ui! Gal-hat jouse sanga hatpen Pathen ahin, Minthengtah-in vai ahom’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi iti loupia hitam, ichangei a pachat dinga lom hitam, i Pathen'u Elohim chu akhopia acheng'in alhangtheng'a atou in ahi!
en_web: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
en_kjv: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Aloupi Pakai chu, I-Pathenu khopi, Alhang theng chunga Loupi tah a vahchoi ding ahi!

tcz: Hichehi asang'in ahoilamdang'e. Leiset pumpi'n mu ding atup un athanom cheh ui. Lhangtheng Zion molhoi hi leng thupipa chenna khopi ahi!
en_web: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
en_kjv: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, On the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen molsang Zion, Asangin ahoiye; Leng loupipen khopi Vannoi dia kipana ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen amatah chu Jerusalem indan sung'a chun acheng'in ahi Amatah hi avengbit'a pang ahi akilang doh e.
en_web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
en_kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhopi kulpi sunga Pathen amatah Kulpidet’a apandan aphonge!

tcz: Vannoi mite lengho akigom'un hiche khopi dounan ahin nokhum'un ahi.
en_web: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
en_kjv: For lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng jouse akikhom’un Zion mol nokhum din ahungtauve!

tcz: Ahinla amahon amuchet phat'un atangchot jeng'un atijauvin ajammang gamtauve.
en_web: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
en_kjv: They saw it, and so they marvelled; They were troubled, and hasted away.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Zion molsang amuphat’un akichauvin, Atijauvin ajamtauve!

tcz: Amaho chu tijatnan numei naonei hon hahsatna atobang'in akithingleu jeng'un ahi.
en_web: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
en_kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, And pain, as of a woman in travail.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichan akihot lhulsoh tauvin, Numei naosoh ding bangin na asalheh-ui!

tcz: Ahin nang'in Tarshishte kong thupitah ho solam huijin asuhset bang'in nasuse tan ahi.
en_web: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
en_kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
tcz_gospelgo: Tarshish kong innei Khopihui kinonglai toh kha abangui!

tcz: Keihon hiche khopi loupina chu kanajaovin tunvang Elohim Pathen hatchungnung khopi chu keiho tah'in kamuchen tauvin ahi. Hiche hi iPathen'u Elohim khopi ahi; Aman tonsot a ahoi doh ding ahi.
en_web: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
en_kjv: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakai i-Pathenu khopi sunga Pathen natoh thu kanajauvin, Tun mit’in jong kamutauve; Pathenin akhopi ahoidam jing ding ahi.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, na houin theng sunga nangma kavahchoi lai un nami ngailut na longlou chu kagel jing ui.
en_web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
en_kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen nahouin sunga Nalungset long lou kageldoh-ui!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen namin ja dia kilom tah ahibang in leiset kolmong geija vahchoiya naum ding ahi. Najet lam ban thahat chu galjona a dimset ahi.
en_web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
en_kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Muntina min navahchoiyin, Leiset chunga naminthangsoh tai! Thudih-in vai nahomin,

tcz: Zion mol'a mipiho kipah uhen. Judah khopiho nathutan dihjeh hin kipah uhen.
en_web: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
en_kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, Let the daughters of Judah be glad, Because of thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih-in thu natan’e Zion mite kipah hen! Judah gam khopi jouse kipah hen!

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen mite cheuvin Zion khopi gakholchen'un akimvel'a kijot uvin ainsangho jong gasim'un.
en_web: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
en_kjv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen mite Zion kimvel’in kijot’un, Insang lai jouse simtoh-un!

tcz: Akhopi jouse jong gachon uvin lang akulpi bang nasa tah ho jong melchih'un, chule nang hon nason nachilhah teu naseipeh thei diu ahi.
en_web: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
en_kjv: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; That ye may tell it to the generation following.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopipal malchih-un, Akulpi kholtoh-un! Khangkit’a mite naseipeh diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Amahi hitobang mong Pathen ahi. Amahi tonsot tonsot geija dinga iPathen'u Elohim ahin Aman ithi tokah uva eipui hoi diu ahi.
en_web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
en_kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche Pathen hi tonsot’a i-Pathenu ahin, Phat jousea eilamkai diu ahi,” tiuvin.

tcz: Nangho mipite'n hichehi ngaijuvin! Nangho vannoi mite jouse'n ngaicheh uvin!
en_web: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
en_kjv: Hear this, all ye people; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi ngaiyun mitin vaipin, Muntin aching,

tcz: Milen le mineo, ahao avai in ngaisoh keijun!
en_web: both low and high, rich and poor together.
en_kjv: Both low and high, Rich and poor, together.
tcz_gospelgo: Alen aneo, ahao avaiyin Ngai cheh-uvin!

tcz: Ajeh chu kathuseiho hi chihna thu ahin, chuleh kalung'a kagel jong hi hetgilna dimset ahi.
en_web: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
en_kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuh tah-in lung kagel’in, Chihna thujeng kaseiye.

tcz: Keiman thuchih kaseiho chu giltah'in kagel'in hiti chun semjang sai a kitilkhou in thulem kaseiho suhlhap na kanei jie.
en_web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
en_kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuchih jeng ngai phang ting, Semjang saito thon hilchen inge!

tcz: Kagalmite'n eihin umkimvel'uva boinan eihin lhunkhum teng idia kakichat ding ham?
en_web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
en_kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
tcz_gospelgo: Melman eiumchah a, Aneile agouva kisong ho

tcz: Amahon anei agouhou atahsan un ahaotheinau a akiletsah ui.
en_web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
en_kjv: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
tcz_gospelgo: Ahao kiletsah piten eium jongleh Hitobang phatsea jong hin kakichapoi!

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in athina diuva kon'in amaho le amaho akihuhdoh joupouvin Elohim Pathen henga sum in ahinkhou akichoh thei pouve.
en_web: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
en_kjv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him:
tcz_gospelgo: koila ama kilhatdam theipon tin, Ahinkho manjat Pathen apeh jou deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Lhatdamna kitihi bailam tah a um ahipoi, ajeh chu koiman alhingset'in apejou poi;
en_web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
en_kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, And it ceaseth for ever:)
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem man akisim joupon, Ijat kipejongleh lhing ponte;

tcz: tonsot'a hingjing a lhanmun'a chelou hel nading chu.
en_web: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
en_kjv: That he should still live for ever, And not see corruption.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’a hing jinga Thina lhankhuh ajotda lou ding ahi.

tcz: Michingho chu nikhat thitei diu ahi, hiche mingol le lungel neilou ho banga anei agouhou chu adalhah cheh di'u ahi.
en_web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
en_kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, Likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, And leave their wealth to others.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol mivaichate thi bangin Michingte jong athin, Anei agou jouseu jong Midang adalhah pehji tauve.

tcz: Lhanmol chu atonsot inn'u ahitan achen jingna di'u mun chu ahitai. Anei agouho'u chu amaho min putsah jong leu.
en_web: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
en_kjv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem gampi le pua anapan vangun Alhankhuh-uva akijamji tauvin, Hikoma hin aumdenji tauve.

tcz: Aminthan nao chu sotlou ding ganhing ho bang'a thithou thou diu ahi.
en_web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
en_kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem aloupinan ahinso joupon, Ganchate thi bangin athi thouve.

tcz: Amaho hi min miching dan'in geljong leu mingol bang'a thina ato thou thou di'u ahi.
en_web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
