tcz: O Elohim Pathen, ka kiphinna hi neingaipeh tei in. Ka melmaten eigihnauva kon hin neihuh doh in.
en_web: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
en_kjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagentheiye Pathen, Kataona ngaiyin! Kagalte kakichai, Neihuhhingin!

tcz: Hiche engset lungput a tohgon nei mipiho a kon'in neiselmang in, hiche thilse bol hon hoa kon in.
en_web: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
en_kjv: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; From the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
tcz_gospelgo: MIgiloute thilsea konin neihoidoh-in, Mi-engsete thilgona konin neiselmangin.

tcz: Amahon chemjam kinolhem bang'in alei'u anolhem'un thalchang kikap doh bang'in thucheng ngaimo tah tah in mi adoi leleu ve.
en_web: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
en_kjv: Who whet their tongue like a sword, And bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
tcz_gospelgo: Aleiguiyu chemjam hem abangin, Athuseiyun thalchang bangin mi adot’e.

tcz: Themmona neilou miho chu akiselnauva kon in ahin kap un kichatna neilouvin gangtah in anokhum jiuvin ahi.
en_web: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
en_kjv: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
tcz_gospelgo: Jum le ja helouvin jouthu aseilouyun, thusen miphaho asuminseuve.

tcz: Thilse bol ding in amaho le amaho akitilkhou un chujongle aguh a iti thang kam ding ham, tichu agong'un ahi. “Hiche hi kon amudoh ding ham?” atiuve.
en_web: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
en_kjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who shall see them?
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse boldin akitil touvin, Thang kamna mun ahol’un, “Koiman eimupouvinte,” tin agel’ui.

tcz: Athilse gonpat'u chun hitin aseijun, “Hiche hi thilgon hoipen ahitai!” atiuve. Henge mihem lunggel le lungthim vang hi aphalou mong ahi.
en_web: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
en_kjv: They search out iniquities; They accomplish a diligent search: Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse jeng agongun, “Thilse tahbeh igongui,” atiuvin; Mihem lungthim le lunggel vang Het theihoisan ahipoi.

tcz: Ahinla Elohim Pathen amatah'in athalchang ahin kap ding gangtah a akaplhuh diu ahi.
en_web: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
en_kjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; Suddenly shall they be wounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pathenin thalpin ahinkap’in, het manlouvin amvosoh tai.

tcz: Amaho tah kampao in ahin thagam diu ahi, koi hileh amaho muchan chun alunghan khum uva alu ahihdiu ahi.
en_web: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
en_kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: All that see them shall flee away.
tcz_gospelgo: Athusei jeh-uva Pathenin asuhmang ding, Amupha chan tija lu ahih khum diu ahi.

tcz: Chujouteng mijouse kicha diu, Elohim Pathen thil boltheina kidangtah chu aphondoh diu, chuleh athilbol datmo umtahho chu ahin hetchen diu ahi.
en_web: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
en_kjv: And all men shall fear, And shall declare the work of God; For they shall wisely consider of his doing.
tcz_gospelgo: Abon a kichasoh diu, Pathen natoh agel’uva aseile diu ahi.

tcz: Mi chonphaho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom diu chuleh Ama chu kiselna ahin neidiu ahi. Koi hileh thilpha bolho jousen Elohim Pathen ahin vahchoidiu ahi.
en_web: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
en_kjv: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai natoh chu Midihten akipapi diu; Midihte Pakaiya hoidoh diu Miphaten Pakai avahchoi diu ahi.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, vahchoina thupitah chu Zion'a um nang'a dinga ahi. Keihon nang kom a ka kitepnau chu ka molso diu ahi.
en_web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
en_kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion: And unto thee shall the vow be performed.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, Zion lhanga vahchoi lom nahin, Kakitepnau pehdoh lom nahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu nang'in ka taona'u na sang'in, ka bonchauva nang kom'a ka hung di'u ahi.
en_web: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
en_kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin kataonau nasangin, Muntina min naheng ahinjon’e.

tcz: Ka chonsetnauvin eilonvuh jong le'u nang'in abonchan na ngaidam sohkei tan ahi.
en_web: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
en_kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset jal’un nahinhol’un, Kathemmo nauvin rijothouvin, Hinla nangin miho chonset Na-ngaidamjie.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, na muntheng a um nangkom naiding go ho iti akipa tadiuvem. Na houintheng sung a chu itobang kipana golnop in eingau hitam!
en_web: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
en_kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, And causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Even of thy holy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadeilhen mi, munthenga nahinpui chu Minun nom ahi. Na-insunga thilphaho Nahou-in theng vangbohnan kalungnau chimsah tante.

tcz: Kataona hou natoh hoitah in neidonbut peh uve, O Elohim Pathen eihuhingpau. Nangma hi leiset mite jouse kinepna nahin, gamlatah twikhanglen chung'a kongtolho geiyin nang chung a kinepna anei u ahi.
en_web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
en_kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; Who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
tcz_gospelgo: Gal neijosah-un neihouvun, Eihuhhingna diuvin thil kidang dang nabol’e! Leiset kolkimvel mite leh TWikhanglen gal’a miten na-kingainai.

tcz: Thahatna thupitah a na kivon a, na thahatna a mol le lhang jong hi na sem ahi.
en_web: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
en_kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; Being girded with power:
tcz_gospelgo: Nathahat’in mol le lhang natungdoh-in, Nathahat loupe mi namusah tai.

tcz: Twikhanglen kinong le kitum jong hi nasuthip in chuleh namtin vaipi kithong lellul jong na suthip tan ahi.
en_web: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
en_kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, The noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi kinonglai naphoh thip’in, Twi kidil lai nasuhaitai; Mipi kinonglul lul jong navohaiye.

tcz: Leiset chung kolmong gei a chenghon jong na kidanna hi adatmovin ahi. Nisa sona langa pat nilhum na mun geiya umho jong kipah a asaple diuva na tildoh ahitai.
en_web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
en_kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathildbol loupiho jeh hin Leiset pumpi akichatai; Nathilbol ho hin Leiset kolkimvel’a kipana alhut’e.

tcz: Leiset hi na gelkhoh in gon nachapnou in, leithao leh leipha na sodoh sah in ahi. Elohim Pathen vadung a chun twi nengchet in aum in; hichun louga chang le mim aput sah e, ajeh chu hiti dinga nangman natep sah ahitai.
en_web: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
en_kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: Thou greatly enrichest it With the river of God, which is full of water: Thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset khohsah nan go najuhsah-in, Nachap nouvin leipha nasoi. Luidung jouse twi nadip’in, Leiset ga napunsah-e! Nathilbol dan chu:

tcz: Lou kikhoiho gotwi in na chap kot jin, leilhangho na su nang in, changkongho jong na kibah sah in, gotwi in leiset na noudoh sah in hiti chun chang le mim nengchet a aumnadin phatthei na boh in ahi.
en_web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
en_kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Leichang tuhnemsa go najuhsah-in, Twiyin nachap nouvin, Go naphinsah-in leiset nachap nouvin, Hamthah louthah nadotsah-e.

tcz: Kumlhung keiya neh le chah ding nengchet in na gongtoh in leitah lah jeng jong leiphatah na so sah tai.
en_web: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
en_kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.
tcz_gospelgo: Naphat jal’in lhoga nalhinsah tan, Nakithahna lam lama Neng jeng jungin nalhai!

tcz: Gam golai gammang jeng jong hamhing dongset lah a sohdoh in, molpang jeng jong kipah tah in apahlha jengin ahi.
en_web: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
en_kjv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: And the little hills rejoice on every side.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungdong lah a kelngaoihon ademset’in, Mol le lhang pang dung vetnom nom aum’e.

tcz: Hamhing lah a kelngoihon adimset un chule phaichamho jong chang le mim adimlha jeng tai. Hi hojousen thong jejun asam un kipa la asaove.
en_web: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
en_kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with corn; They shout for joy, they also sing.
tcz_gospelgo: Jaolah jouse kelngoite adimin, Phaicham jouse chang adim’e. Thil ijakaiyin Kipa thanop la asauve!

tcz: Leiset mite jousen Elohim Pathen vahchoi cheh uhen!
en_web: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
en_kjv: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
tcz_gospelgo: Mitinin kipa othongin Pathen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Amin loupi chu vahchoilan saohen! Aloupina ji vannoi a sei leu vin.
en_web: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
en_kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: Make his praise glorious.
tcz_gospelgo: Amin loupe lan sauvin Loupi tah-in vahchoiyun!

tcz: Elohim Pathen henga sei in, “Na thilbol ho hi iti hoia lamdang hitam! Na melmate jeng jong na thaneina thupitah masang a akun jeng uve.
en_web: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
en_kjv: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen koma, “nathilbol iti kidan a, Nathahat iti let hitam! Namelmate kichan Na-anga aboh khuptauve.

tcz: Leiset chung thil jouse jong na angsung a dilsu cheh untin, nathangvahna la asahdiu, naming hi thongjenju a asahdiu ahi.”
en_web: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
en_kjv: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a cheng jousen chibai naboh-in, Navahchoila asauvin, naming vahchoila asauve.

tcz: Hung in lang ven Elohim Pathen in ipi atohdoh hitam, mipite dia itobang thil kidang atohdoh hitam!
en_web: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
en_kjv: Come and see the works of God: He is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungun mihemte lah a Pathen thilbol kidangtah hung veuvin!

tcz: Aman twipisan a jong lamgolai asem in, chule amite chu akeng'uva ache galkai ui. Hea chun eiho Ama ah ikipah un ahi.
en_web: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
en_kjv: He turned the sea into dry land: They went through the flood on foot: There did we rejoice in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Twikhanglen taolgo asosah-in, Ipu ipateuvin vadung longlai tolgo ajotdoh-ui! Hiche aboljeh hin Eiho ikipah thanom’ui!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman athahatna thupitah a chun tonsot in vai ahom e. Aman namtin vaipi chaloh sinsah aboncha ave lhisohkei in; koimacha Ama dounan hung kon da jeng hen.
en_web: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
en_kjv: He ruleth by his power for ever; His eyes behold the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin athahat’in lengvai apon, Namtin vaipi avelhi jingin, Doumah bolten jong adou-ngampouve.

tcz: Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen iPathen u Elohim thangvah cheh u henlang avahchoina la choh jejun sauhen.
en_web: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
en_kjv: O bless our God, ye people, And make the voice of his praise to be heard:
tcz_gospelgo: Namtinin i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Navahchoinau kithong hen!

tcz: I hinkhou hi Ama khut a um ahin, Aman ikipallouna diuva ikeng u eituhpeh u ahi.
en_web: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
en_kjv: Which holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eihing hoi nalaiyun, Eikipal lhuhsah hih laiyui!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen neipatep tauve; dangka bang in neisuhtheng taovin ahi.
en_web: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
en_kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, Nangin keiho neipatep’un, Sana meiya kilhatheng bangin neipatep tauve!

tcz: Na thangkol a neimat u ahitan chuleh ka tungtun uva sohchanna pohgih chu neipoh sah u ahitai.
en_web: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
en_kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
tcz_gospelgo: Pel’a neilhah sah-un, Pohgih hahsa tah neipohsah-ui!

tcz: Ka chunguvah midangho lam na jotsah in hiti chun keiho meilhum leh twisohlah neipal galkaisah uvin, hinla nehding nenna mun a neipuilut tauvin ahi.
en_web: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
en_kjv: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water: But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmate neichil thangsah-un, Meipi le twipi kapal galkaiyui! Tunvang hoidohna mun a neipuilut tauve!

tcz: Tun nahenga kakitepna subulhit din pumgo thilto pum in na houin ka hinjon e.
en_web: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
en_kjv: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin thenga pumgo thilto hinchoiying ting, Kakitepna chengse penge!

tcz: Henge, lunggim le kakhoisat nikho hoa nakoma kitepna ka na nei chu ahi.
en_web: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
en_kjv: Which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagimpet’a kaseisa Kakitepna jat lhingin penge!

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman kanei ho lah ka kelngoichalho hi namtwi pen ding le, ka bongchalho le ka keltahchalho hi pumgo thilto a ka hin katdoh ahitai.
en_web: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
en_kjv: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Maichama pumgo din kelngoi peng ting, Bongchalte le kelchatea kakilhai ding, Akigona meikhu vanlai jol’a Kitungdoh ding ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen gin le jana neijouse hung un lang ngai un, Yahweh Pakai in ipi eibolpeh am na seipeh ung ka te.
en_web: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
en_kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen gingten hung ngaiyun, Itobang thil loupe eibolpeh deiyinge!

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman Ama thangvah pum in panpi thumnan ka tao in ahi.
en_web: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
en_kjv: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathena panpi kathumin, Vahchoilan kathangvah-e!

tcz: Keiman ka lunsunga um ka chonset phongdoh lou hile Yahweh Pakai in ka taona eingaipeh louding ahi.
en_web: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
en_kjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear me:
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonset ho khohsah da leng, Pakaiyin kataona sang ponte.

tcz: Hinla Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh e! Aman khohsah tah in ka taona eingaipeh in ahi.
en_web: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
en_kjv: But verily God hath heard me; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunvang pathenin eihouvin, Kataona asangtai!

tcz: Ka taona eigelkhohpehjeh le amingailutna longlou kei a kon a eilahdohpeh lou jeh in Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in um hen!
en_web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
en_kjv: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his mercy from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Long louva eilungset jeh le Kataona asanjeh-in Pathen kavahchoiye!

tcz: Elohim Pathen lungsetthem hihen lang phatthei eiboh u hen. Amaivah chun eisalvah u hen.
en_web: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
en_kjv: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; And cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Neikhoton phatthei neiboh-un Pathen! Hepitah-in neiveuvin!

tcz: Leiset pumpi a nadeilam kilang hen, muntin a mihemten na mihuhhingna thahat chu heuhen!
en_web: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
en_kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy saving health among all nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng vannoiyin nadei hentin, Namtinin nahuhhingna hente!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen. Henge, namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen.
en_web: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
en_kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; Let all the people praise thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, Mitin vaipin navahchoi cheh hen!

tcz: Vannoi leiset pumpin nangma thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu namtin vaipi chung a hi thudih a vai hom nahin vannoi leiset pumpi hi na puihoi hoi le jinge.
en_web: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
en_kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: For thou shalt judge the people righteously, And govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin thu adih a natanpeh a, Namtin vaipi nalamkaijeh-in Namtin vaipin kipa nop la sau hen!

tcz: Namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen O Elohim Pathen. Henge, namtin vaipin thangvah u hen!
en_web: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
en_kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; Let all the people praise thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, Mitin vaipin navahchoi cheh hen!

tcz: Hiteng chuleh leiset in chang le mim gasosah intin chuleh Elohim Pathen, iPathen'un nengchet a phatthei eibohdiu ahi.
en_web: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
en_kjv: Then shall the earth yield her increase; And God, even our own God, shall bless us.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen, i-Pathen’un phatthei eiboh-un, Leiset ga alhung tai.

tcz: Henge, Elohim Pathen in phatthei eiboh un tin, chule vannoi leiset mihemte jousen Ama chu agindiu ahi.
en_web: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
en_kjv: God shall bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin phatthei eiboh tauve, Muntina miten Ama jabol cheh hen!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen hung kipat inlang namelmate hi thethang jeng in, Elohim Pathen doumah bolte jouse akihuhdohna diuvin jam uhen.
en_web: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
en_kjv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: Let them also that hate him flee before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen akipat’in amelmate anocheh tai, Ama hotbolten alel’un ajamtauve!

tcz: Amaho khu meikhu bang in mut mang in, meisalah a khoilu ajollhah bang in jollhahsah in, Elohim Pathen ansung a kon in migiloute mangthah jeng uhen.
en_web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
en_kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Meikhu kimut mang bangin, Melmate Pathenin adelmangtai; Meihul’a khoilu jolmang bangin, Pathen masanga migiloute amang thah tai.

tcz: Hinla miphaho chu kipah u hen. Amaho chu Elohim Pathen angsung'ah kipah u hen. Kipa thanopnan dimset u hen.
en_web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
en_kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: Yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte vang Pathen angsunga akipah thanom’un, Kipah thanomin a-aovui!

tcz: Elohim Pathen le amin thang vah la saovin! Meibanglom puile pa thangvahla chohthet in sauvin. Amin chu Yahweh Pakai kiti ahi–a angsung a kipah un.
en_web: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
en_kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Extol him that rideth upon the heavens By his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen la sauvin, amin vahchoila sauvin; Meilhang chunga tou Pathen lampi semjangun, Amin Pakai ahi, a-angdsunga kipah-un!

tcz: Pa neilou te dia Pa nahin, meithaiho hoidam jing nahi-hiche hi Elohim Pathen ahin aumna chu muntheng ahi.
en_web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
en_kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahouin thenga pansa Pathenin Chagate le meithaiho akhohsah-e!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in changkhatpu hinkho chu insungmi lhingtah in akoi in; Songkul a tangho chamlhat na apen akipa sah tai. Ahinlah thuanunglou ho chu nisan akahgepna neldigama achensah e.
en_web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
en_kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out those which are bound with chains: But the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin chenmun beite chenmun apen, Sohchangte kipah a nomlen din alhadoh-e. Pathen doumah bolte vang Hollei lah a achensahjie.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai na mite Egypt gama kon a na hin puidoh a chun, gamgo lah'a na hin puigalkai chun,
en_web: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
en_kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: O PAthen, namite napuidoh a, Nelgam najot galkaipi chun;

tcz: Israel Pathen Elohim, Sinai Pathen Elohim nangma masang'ah leiset akithing in vanhon go ahin juhlhahsah in ahi.
en_web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
en_kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped At the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved At the presence of God, the God of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Sinai pathen ahungin, Israel Pathen ahung jeh-in, Ling akihot’in, go ajui!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang man leigo chapnousah din go nengchet in neihin peuvin ahi.
en_web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
en_kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen, nengtah-in go najuhsah-in, Nagam leiset gosa nachapnouve!

tcz: Akhon nan hichea chun na mite na chensah in, neh le chah nengchetnin na pen, na mite ngaichat jouse jong na pe tai.
en_web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
en_kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: Thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chun namite achengun, Naphat jal’in caichate natoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thu chengkhat agahseileh mitamtah in hiche kipana thu chu apoleuvin ahi.
en_web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
en_kjv: The Lord gave the word: Great was the company of those that published it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin thu aphongin, Numeiho geiyin aphongjal leuvin,

tcz: Melmate lengho le asepaite ajamgam tauvin Israel numeiten athilkeo u achomgam peh taove.
en_web: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
en_kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: And she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lengho le asepaiteu ajamtai,” atiuve. Akichomdoh ho in’a numeiho akihom’ui.

tcz: Kelngoi hong a chengho jeng in jong nei le gou tamtah-alhaving teni dangka le amul sana a kisem vapal akimu uvin.
en_web: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
en_kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, Yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her feathers with yellow gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Vakhu lim sana kitomjol, Alhaving geiya sana thengsel’a kiloijol jong ajaove. Galpi nikhoa chu, Ibol’a kelngoi honga moh tou nahiuvem?

tcz: Hatchungnung chun Zalmon molchung'a buhbang kithejal bang'in melma lengho chu athejal gamtan ahi.
en_web: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
en_kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was white as snow in Salmon.
tcz_gospelgo: Zalmon lhanga thaneipen Pathenin Lengho athecheh nin, buhbang alhah sah-e!

tcz: Bashan a molho hi athupi thei lheh jeng uve, mol monghem tamtah'in vanthamjol a kilhungdoh jenge.
en_web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
en_kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; A high hill as the hill of Bashan.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo molsang vum sangtah, Pathenin chenmun dia alhenna, Iti thangset um nahim? Chua Pakai tonsot’a cheng ding ahi!

tcz: O molsang gumtahho ibolba thangthip tah a navet uham, Zion molsang Elohim Pathen in alhen na mun, tonsot a achen nading chu?
en_web: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
en_kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? This is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; Yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

tcz: Sakol-kangtalai simjoulou hon akolkhum Sinai mol a kon a hung'a amuntheng a lut ding ahi.
en_web: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
en_kjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
tcz_gospelgo: Akangtalai thaneiteh asang sang pumin, Sinaiya pat Pakaiyin muntheng ahinjon’e!

tcz: Nangma achung sang a na kaltou tengleh galhing a kiman tamtah na puitou ding, mipiho'a kon'a kipaman tamtah na san ding, nangma na douho a kon'a jong na san ding ahi. Hiche'a chu Yahweh Pakai eiho lah a cheng ding ahi.
en_web: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
en_kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: Thou hast received gifts for men; Yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal-hing tampi akaiyin, Munsang lam ajontouve! Doumah bol jongleur mihemtea konin Thilpeh tampi akisanin; Pakai Pathen chu Hikoma cheng ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen; eihuh hingpau Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Niseh a aman abanjang a eikai u ahi.
en_web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord, Who daily loadeth us with benefits, Even the God of our salvation. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh a pohgih eipoh hu Pakai vahchoiyun, Eihuhhinguva Pathen Amabou ahi!

tcz: Eiho Pathen hi mihuhhing Elohim Pathen ahi. Yahweh Pakai lengchungnung hin thina a kon a eihuhdoh u ahi.
en_web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
en_kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; And unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pathenu hi huhhing Pathen ahin, Pakai ama hi thinaa kona eihuhdoh-u Pakai ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amelmate luchangho asuhchip ding ahi, thilse jeng bolna a kipeho chu alugu u asuhchip ding ahi.
en_web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
en_kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, And the hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmate lu Pathenin atantei ding, Chonset lam jenga chete lu atan ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Bashan a kon'a ka melmate ka hinpui lhah ding ahi; twikhanglen lailung a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ahi.
en_web: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
en_kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Bashan a kona namelmate kahinpuiya, Twikhanglen thuh laiya kahinpuidoh ding;

tcz: Ka mite, nanghon athisan uva chu na keng u na kisoptheng diu, chuleh na uichahou jengin jong chan aneidiu ahi.”
en_web: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
en_kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, And the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng athisan lah-u nanoh a, Uichaten athisanu ava va ale diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen gal nahin jaova na hung kijot u chu muthei in ahung kilangdoh tai, Elohim ka Pathen le ka lengpa muntheng a na kijotlut u chu.
en_web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
en_kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; Even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen galjouva nahung kitol, Kalengpa Pathen Amuntheng phung jona hung Mintinin amusoh tai!

tcz: La saho amasang a aum un, tumging saiho a nung a aum ui; alai lunga chun nungah hon vohging theiho avouve.
en_web: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
en_kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; Among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
tcz_gospelgo: Lathemho alamkaiyin, Tumging themte anukhah-ui; Alailunguva Nu-ngah hon khatbeh abengui!

tcz: Israel mipite Elohim Pathen thangvah un; Israel hinkho hungkondoh naho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un.
en_web: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
en_kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: “Amite kikhopnaa Pathen vahchoiyun, Jacob chilhah jousen Pakai vahchoiyun!” atiuve.

tcz: Ven phung neocha Benjamin in ahin lamkai e. aban'ah Judah a kon a vaihomho, chule Zebulun le Naphtali a kon in vaihom tamtah ahung uve.
en_web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
en_kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, The princes of Judah and their council, The princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
tcz_gospelgo: Phung lhumpen Benjamin alamkaiyin, Abanin Judah lamkaihon aloiho aloiyun; Zebulun le Naphtali lamkaiten Anung ajuiyuve!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, na ban thahat chu jedoh in. Achesa nikho ho bang chun na ban thahat chu nahat na hung kilangdoh hen.
en_web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
en_kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, keho khel’a namanchah nathahat, Hiche nathahat chu phongjal’in!

tcz: Jerusalem a na houintheng ah leiset lenghon na hunglutna u thilho ahinchoijuve.
en_web: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
en_kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Shall kings bring presents unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengle lalten thilto tampia nahou nau, Jerusalem khopia nahouin a phongin!

tcz: Na melma namtin vaipiho, pang lah'a kisel gamsaho, ahatmo bongnouho lah a bongchalho hi phohsal in. Kisunem tah a ahunglutnau thil in sumlhonho hinchoisah in. Galbol'a thanom namtin vaipiho thethang in.
en_web: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
en_kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, Till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: Scatter thou the people that delight in war.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumpeng lah a lhale gamsa tobang Egypt mite phoh-in lang, Bongchal hon anoute lah a kinomsah tobang Namtin vaipi khu phoh-in; Adangkai choiya nahenga aboh khup Kahseuvin khu the cheh doh keiyin!

tcz: Egypt a kon'in kipa thilpeh ding'in thil mantamho hinchoi u hen, Ethiopia mite Elohim Pathen a akipehlutna uvin bohkhup uhen!
en_web: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
en_kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin palai hungun tin, Sudan mite Pathen lam Sanga tao diu ahi.

tcz: Leiset gam lengho'n Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen kom'ah vahchoila sauhen.
en_web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
en_kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset lenggam jousen Pathen pachat la sauvin, Sauvin Pakai vahchoi la!

tcz: Vanlaijol'a kon'a ogin hat tah hung kithongdoh a, masanglai vanho lah a ki tollepa vahchoila'n la sauvin.
en_web: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
en_kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; Lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangluiya vanthamjol, Hiche vanthamjil’a toupa Pathen sei ngaiyun Othongje jun sam’uvin!

tcz: Elohim Pathen thuneina hi mijouse hetsah un, aloupina chun Israelte ahinsalvah in athahatna hi vanho chung'ah akilang jing'e.
en_web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
en_kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the clouds.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thahat phongjal’un, vanthamjol’a athahat akilangin, Israel chunga alal loupitai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen hi amuntheng'ah gimneitah in aumjing'e. Israel Pathen Elohim'in amite chu thuneina le thahatna ape'n ahi. Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen!
en_web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
en_kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel is he That giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
tcz_gospelgo: Amunthenga ahung potdoh chun Pathen akidang behseh-e! Hiche Israel Pathen khu! Amana mite tha le jung apei! Pathen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Eihuhdoh in, O Elohim Pathen, twisoh hin ka ngong gei achuptai.
en_web: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
en_kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: O PAthen neihuhhingin, Twiyin ka-ngong gei achuptai!

tcz: Bonlhoh lah a hin ka lhalut cheh cheh tai; pansatna ding ka mujou tapoi. Keima twithuh lah a ka lhalut tan twisoh hin eichup tai.
en_web: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
en_kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Bon-ngan lah a kalha lhum cheh cheh-in, Leitah kachon kha tapoi! Lithuh lai kageitan, Twidil’in eilonvuh pai ding ahitai!

tcz: Panpi ngai a kaka na katha achollha tai; ka lolhomsung jong agolha tai. Ka ka kanan ka mit jong apomtan, Elohim Pathen in eipan pi ding kangah e.
en_web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
en_kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpi kakou kounan kacholtan, kalolbuh apeh-in anai! Eipanpi didng kavet vet nan kamit thim pai ding ahi!

tcz: Ajehbei hel a eivetdaho hi ka lujang a ka samjang sang'in atamjouve. Ka melmate hin jou thu jeng a suhmang ding eigouvin, hitihin ka guh louhel thil chu kanung peh din athum uve.
en_web: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
en_kjv: They that hate me without a cause are moe than the hairs of mine head: They that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: Then I restored that which I took not away.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh beiya eihotbolte Kasamjang sangin atmjo’uve! Melmaten joujeng eiseikhum’un, Ahat’uvin tha din eigo’uve! Thil kaguh louhel jong Eisah sah-uvin ahi.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen ichangei a ngol kahi nahenai; Ka chonsetnaho hi nang'a kon'in akiselmang theipoi.
en_web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
en_kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, kachonset ho nakoma akiselpom, Ka-ngoldan nahesoh keiye!

tcz: Keijeh in, nangma tahsan ho chu jumsah hih beh in, O van a lengchungnung Yahweh Pakai, kei jeh in nang ma houmi tehi kisuh jum na nei hisah hihbeh in, O Israel Pathen Elohim.
en_web: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
en_kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: Let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Thanei chungnungpen Pakai, Nachunga kisongte neijumsisah san; Vo Isreal Pathen, Nangma chibai bohte neujumsosah hih-in!

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma jal a housetna ka thoh ahi; jumna le jachatna kamai a adimset tai.
en_web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
en_kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma jal’a jumle ja kathoh a, Min a-eng alouva eihou ahi.

tcz: Ka sopiho tah jeng'in jong eikihetmosah tauvin gamchommi bangin eibol tauvin ahi.
en_web: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
en_kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother’s children.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite lah a kholjinmi kabangin, Ka-insung mite lah a gamchom mi kabange!

tcz: Na houin a ding a ka tompan jeh in eichaideh tan ahi, nangman na housetnau jouse chu ka chunga achu tan ahi.
en_web: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
en_kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin dia katom ngaival jeh-in Kalungsung meikouva kileu abgnin, Min na-enghouna jouse Keichunga achuh lo tai!

tcz: Kappum a an kangol a chun, noisetah in eihou un ahi.
en_web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
en_kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.
tcz_gospelgo: An ngol’a kakineosah vangin, Mihon enghou nan eineibep’ui!

tcz: Ka genthei phondohna a khaodippon ka kisil'a ahileh einuisat un ahi.
en_web: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
en_kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; And I became a proverb to them.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghema khaodip pon kasil jongle Nuijat nopnan eineiyui!

tcz: Keima hi khopi sung a jalhang a kihoulim nopna bep ka hitan jukhamhon kei chungchang thu totnopnan anei tauve.
en_web: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
en_kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; And I was the song of the drunkards.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholai dunga seichah-in eineiyun, Jukhamhon la-lhangin ei-oiyui!

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai naheng a katao jingin, tuchung beh neihin khoto ding kakinem e. O Yahweh Pakai na mingailut longlou chun katao nahi huhing na tahbeh a chun nei donbut in.
en_web: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
en_kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle nahenga katao jinge Pakai! Nadei phat phat’in neihouvin Pathen! Nalungset anasan, huhhing dia nakitepna nanit jinge Neihouvin Pathen!

tcz: Bonlhoh lah a kon hin neihuhdoh in; athuh jep a neilhahlutsah hihbeh in, eivetdaho lah a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang hiche twithuh lah'a kon hin neikaidoh in.
en_web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
en_kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Bon-ngan lah a neiloidoh-in, Kamelmatea konin neihoidoh-in, Twithuh lah a neiloidoh-in!

tcz: Twisohhat lai neichupsah hih in, ahilouleh twithuh gillai jong nei vallhum sah hih in, ahilouleh thina lhan kotong jong nei nehmang sah hih in.
en_web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
en_kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, Neither let the deep swallow me up, And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisoh neichupsah dan, Twitoa neilhahsah dan lang, Lhankhuh a neilhah lutsah dan!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka taona neingaipeh in, ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi kidangtah ahin, neikaihoi jing in, ajeh chu na mikhotona hi lolhingtah ahi.
en_web: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
en_kjv: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: Turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
tcz_gospelgo: Phaten a lungset long lou nahi, Neihouvin Pakai! Namikhotona alen’e Neihung vil’in Pakai!

tcz: Na sohpa a kon hin kisel mang hih in; gangtah in neidonbut in ajeh chu keiman boina nasatah ka toh tai.
en_web: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
en_kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha keidin kiselddan, Neihouvin kagim behseh tai tun!

tcz: Hung'in lang neihung lhatdoh tan; ka melmat a kon'in neilha-ong tan.
en_web: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
en_kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Deliver me because of mine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihung huhhingin, Melmatea konin neichu-lhan!

tcz: Nang'in eiki houset na eikijum bolna le ei kijachat sah naho jouse na hesohkei in ahi. Ka melmaten abol jouseu na hesohkei e.
en_web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
en_kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: Mine adversaries are all before thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate namusoh-in, Iti eivetdauva eijumsou, Ei-enghouna jouseu nahei!

tcz: Ami taitomnauvin ka lungthim asukeh in, kadailheh jeng tai. Mikhat seh hijong le lungset na eimusah um hen lang; Khattou hung kiheihen lang eihin lungmonsah le kanom e.
en_web: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
en_kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
tcz_gospelgo: Ei-enghou nau kalung naval’in, Alha lhop pai ding kahi! Eidip dappeh diu kakinepna la abeitan; Lungmonsah kahol vangin Khatcha eilungmonsah ding aumpoi.

tcz: Ahinla chutimalah in amahon ka nehdin gu eipeuvin amahon ka don ding'in juthuh eipeuve.
en_web: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
en_kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakel teng thinagu eipauvin, Kadangchah teng lengpitwi thuh eipeuve!

tcz: Amasang uva neh-le-chah dimset dokhang chu akipal nao soh henlang, ahaonau chu amaho ding'in thangkol hisah jeng tan.
en_web: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
en_kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: And that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
tcz_gospelgo: Agolvah bol’u manthahnan neiyu hen, kuttheng abol’u lhuh lhamnan neiyu hen!

tcz: Kho amutheilouna diuvin amit u chojeng henlang atahsao kithing thing in umsah jeng in.
en_web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
en_kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to shake.
tcz_gospelgo: Amit’u suchon! Ating akongu doisen tu hen!

tcz: Na lunghanna chu achung uvah sunglha jeng'in; na lunghanna meikong achun amaho chu kavam jeng in.
en_web: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
en_kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghan khum jingin, Nalungsat nan lonvuh-u hen!

tcz: A-in'u chu ahomkeo soh doh jeng henlang aponbuh u jong kihoh doh jeng hen.
en_web: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
en_kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; And let none dwell in their tents.
tcz_gospelgo: Ingapsih she-u hen lang, Agam ngah diu kaholmo hen!

tcz: Gotna napeh mi chun, akisuhkhah na chung uva jumbol na akoibe uve; akisukha ho chu natna abelap peh uve.
en_web: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
en_kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen namatsahho abolgentheiyun, Namavote genthei seichah-in aneiyui!

tcz: Achonsetnau setvum peh unlang, khatcha ongthol'in lha hihbeh in.
en_web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
en_kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: And let them not come into thy righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset jouseu melchih-in, Them chansah hih hel’in!

tcz: Amin u chu hinna lekhabu a konin thaimangpeh in; michonpha ho lah a kisimtha sah hihbeh un.
en_web: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
en_kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna lekhabua aminu kinoi mang hen, Midihte lah a kisimtha hih beh hen!

tcz: Keima natna thohgim in ka um e, O Elohim Pathen, na mihuhhingna thahat chun neihuhdoh in.
en_web: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
en_kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang na kasan kalhasam’e, O Pathen, neiphong dingin neihuhhingin!

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiman na min pachatna la'n sangting chule thangvahna pum'a jana ka peh ding ahi.
en_web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
en_kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song; And will magnify him with thanksgiving.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen vahchoila sang ting, Aminthan phongjal ing ting kathangvah ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu hichun kilhaina bongchal ki katdoh sang'a Yahweh Pakai chu alunglhaisah ding ahin, bongchal thaotah le akeng tin hoitah thilpeh kipe sang in jong aphajoi.
en_web: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
en_kjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox Or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hin bongchal a hou sangin Pakai lung lhingset sangin Pakai lung lhaijonte!

tcz: Mi kineosah ten a Elohim Pathen'u natoh muo vintin kipahdiu ahi. Apanpi dia Elohim Pathen holte jousen kitilkhouna neicheh uhen.
en_web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
en_kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: And your heart shall live that seek God.
tcz_gospelgo: Bolgenthei thoh ten amuteng kipah diu, Pathen chibai bohte kitikhou diu ahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Paka in ngaichageova umte taona angai in; Aman sohchang'a umho donlouvin akoi jipoi.
en_web: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
en_kjv: For the Lord heareth the poor, And despiseth not his prisoners.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaichat taona Pakaiyin angaiyin! Amite sohchangho asumilpoi!

tcz: O van-le-lei in Elohim Pathen vahchoi u henlang twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong vahchoi u hen.
en_web: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
en_kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset, Twikhanglen le Asunga cheng jousen Pathen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in Jerusalem ahuhdoh ding Judah khopiho asemphat ding ahi. Hiche'a chun amite cheng untin gamsung chu alodiu ahi.
en_web: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
en_kjv: For God will save Zion, And will build the cities of Judah: That they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Jerusalem ahuhhinga Judah khopi jouse asah phat ding; Amite chenguva gamsung alo diu,

tcz: Ama thu nitjing chaten gamsung chu louvin tin, chule ama ngailuho jouse hiche mun a chu lungmong a cheng diu ahi.
en_web: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
en_kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: And they that love his name shall dwell therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhachate chilhah hon alo’uva, Pathen ngailuten achenpha diu ahi.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! Yahweh Pakai, gangtah in hung in lang neihung kithopin.
en_web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
en_kjv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, neihuhhingin, Neipanpi loiyin Pakai!

tcz: Tha dia eiholten jumna toh uhenlang jachatsah in. Ka gentheipet a kipahho jachat thohpum in kinunglesah tan.
en_web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
en_kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Eithatgote chu kisudong hen Gal lel’u hen! Kagenthei kipapite chu Nungjamu hen vetdan umu hen!

tcz: Amaho chu tijat le jachat thohsah in, ajeh chu amahon “aphai tun ama ikhut uvah aumtai” atiuve.
en_web: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
en_kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame That say, Aha, aha.
tcz_gospelgo: Eidaithengle hon Agal lel jumpiu hen tijau hen!

tcz: Hinlah koi hileh nangma holte jousen nang a kipa-le-thanopna dimset muo hen. Koi hileh na mihuhhingna ngaichaho jouse chun “Elohim Pathen hi aloupi e!” tin samging'u hen.
en_web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
en_kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahinjon jouse kipah thanom hen, Namihuhhing kipapi jousen, “Pathen aloupi ngeiye,” Tin seijing jengu hen!

tcz: Hinla keidin vang vaicha le lhasam ka hi; O Elohim Pathen lungset tah in eipanpi din hung loi in. Nanghi eipanpi le eihuhhingpa na hi; O Yahweh Pakai geisang hih in.
en_web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
en_kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhasam le geochaovin ka-ume, Hung louyin O Pathen! O Pakai Eihuhhingpu Neipanpi loiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai eihuhdoh ding ngaichan na kom kahinbel e.
en_web: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
en_kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: Let me never be put to confusion.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihuh din kahinbel’e Pakai, Gal neilelsah hih-in!

tcz: Neihuhhing in lang neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu nangma adih na hi, na kol hinsung'in lang ka sei neingaipeh in, chule neichamlhatsah in.
en_web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
en_kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: Incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangbou adih nahi! Neipanpin neihoidoh-in; Ngaiyin neihuhhing loiyin!

tcz: Ka kisel jing theina din kahoidam na songpi hijing in. Keima huhhing ka chan theina ding'in thu peh chu pen, nangma ka songpi le ka kiselna na hi.
en_web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
en_kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiselna mundet, Kahoidohna kulpi detpen Kakiselna le kagalpal nahi.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim, miphalouho thaneina a kon'in neihuhdoh in, eibolse a mi engbolseho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
en_web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
en_kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou, engse, thilse bolte Thaneinaa konin neihuhdoh-in Ka-Pathen!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangbou ka kinepna na hi, O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi ka chapan laiya pat'a ka hin tahsan na hi tai.
en_web: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
en_kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: Thou art my trust from my youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakinepna nahi Pakai, Kaneo laiya pat kakisonpi nahi!

tcz: Henge, ka pen'a pat nang'in neina umpi jing in, ka nu naobu sung'a ka kijil'a pat'a neina chintuppat ahitai, hijeh a nangma ka thangvah jing hi datmo ding ahipoi.
en_web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
en_kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: Thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkhoa kakingaina nahin, Kapen lhah a pat neihoidam jinge; Phat tinin nangma vahchoiyinge!

tcz: Ka hinkho hi mitamtah din kihilna thei ahi, ajeh chu nangma hi ka thahatna le ka kiselna na hi.
en_web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
en_kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.
tcz_gospelgo: Hattah a neipanpi jeh-in Mihon kahilnan aneitauve!

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangma ka thangvah chim theilou na hi; Nilhum kei kei a hi na loupina ka phondoh jing ahi.
en_web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
en_kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise And with thy honour all the day.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhumkeiyin Nang kavahchoiyin, Naloupina kaphongjal lei!

tcz: Tua, ka tehphat hin neipaidpoh hih in. Ka tha'n ajolou teng neinungsun hih in.
en_web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
en_kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
tcz_gospelgo: The jong leng neidondan hih-in, Kachamo phat’in donlouvin neikoidan!

tcz: Ka melmate hi keima douna di'n akihoutoh tauve. Amaho hin thadoh ding eigo tauvin ahi.
en_web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
en_kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; And they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten eitha nom’un, Kei dounan akihousom’ui!

tcz: Amahon, “Elohim Pathen in anungsun tai che'u hitin gaman'u hite ajeh chu tuahi koiman apanpi lou ding ahi” atiuve.
en_web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
en_kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathenin adondatai, Gamandoh jongleur hen Ahuh ding aumpoi,” atiuve.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, munchom a potdoh hih in, Pathen ka Elohim neihung panpi loi in.
en_web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
en_kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
tcz_gospelgo: Neilhakang hih-in O Pathen, Ka-Pathen neipanpi loiyin!

tcz: Keima eihehseho hi sunem'in lang sumang jeng in, keima eibolsenomho hi sujum'in lang jachatsah in.
en_web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
en_kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Eidelkhumten gal lel’u hen mangthah-u hen, Eisusegote kijumsou hen vetda changu hen!

tcz: Keima vang neikithopi ding'a kinem jing ding ka hi; Keiman nangma ka thangvahbe jing ding na hi.
en_web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
en_kjv: But I will hope continually, And will yet praise thee more and more.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakineppi jinga Kavahchoi jing ding nahi!

tcz: Keiman nangma chonphatnaho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi. Keima thusei them hihih jong leng na mihuhhingna thahatna hi nilhumkei kei a ka phondoh jing ding ahi.
en_web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
en_kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness And thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Naphatna kasei lea, Nilhumkeiya nahuhhingna kasei ding; Hekim hih jong leng kasei ding ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thaneichungnung, keiman na thilbol nasatah tahho jeh a ka thangvah ding na hi. Thudih choija nangma bou na hi hi keiman mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
en_web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
en_kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
tcz_gospelgo: Thanei chungnungpen Pakai, Nathahat pah chang ting, Naphatna kaphonjal ding ahi.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in ka chapanlai a pat'a neinahil ahitai. Ken jong na thilbol kidangho hi midangho ka seipeh jing ding ahi.
en_web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
en_kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaneo laiya pat neihil jingin, Nathilbol kidang ho kasei jinge!

tcz: Tunvang keima ka tehtan ka sam akang tai neinungsun hih in. Tu khangthahte lah a hin na thaneina hi samphong lengnge. Kei nung'a hung ding miho lah a jong na thilbol datmo umtahho jong phongdoh ing kate.
en_web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
en_kjv: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; Until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, And thy power to every one that is to come.
tcz_gospelgo: The a kasam kantah vangin, neidonda hih-in O Pathen! Ahung ding akhang khanga Nahatna thuneije kaphon teng nei umpin!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen na chonphatna hi van sangpenho lah jong aphapeh e. O Elohim Pathen na thilbol kidangtahho hi koitoh na kitekahpi thei ding ham?
en_web: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
en_kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, Who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen nadih nan vanthamjol aphan, Thil nasatah tah nabol’in, Nakibahpi koimacha aumpoi.

tcz: Hahsatna nasatah tah neithohsah in ahinlah nang'in ka hinkho na kiledohsah ding ahi'n chule lhan lah a kon'in jong neikaidoh in.
en_web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
en_kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, Shalt quicken me again, And shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hesoh gentheiya neilha vangin, Neithahsem kit’in natin, Thina lhankhuh neimusah pon nate.

tcz: Nang'in lolhinna sangjo cheh a jong neikiledohsah ding avel'a neihin lhamon ding ahi.
en_web: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
en_kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi neijabolsah cheh a Neilhamon kit ding ahi.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiman semjangsaito tho'a nangma ka thangvah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangma na kitepna a na thon ngaipoi.
en_web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
en_kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, Even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing With the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Semjang seiyin vahchoiying ting, Ka-Pathen, nakitahna vahchoiyinge! Vo Isreal Pathen Theng, kasemjang saiyin navahchoi la sange!

tcz: Keiman nangma thangvahna la hi kipah tah'a thongleuva ka sah ding ahi, ajeh chu nang in neihunglhatdoh tan ahi.
en_web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
en_kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhingtai, kalung pumpin Navahchoi la sange! Kipa othongin nathangvah nan Semjang saito thon la sange!

tcz: Keiman nangma thilphabolho hi sun nilhum a ka seiphongle ding ahi, ajeh chu keima eibolsego chun jachatna le jumna atoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
en_kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: For they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Eisuse nomte najothoa vetda nachansah jen-in Nilhum lhumin nadihna thu seichoi lenge!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in na ngaisang thutan dihna chu lengpa hinpe jing'in, chule na chonphatna chu lengpa chapa hinpe tan.
en_web: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
en_kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king’s son.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, nadih banga thutanje lengpa hil’in, Adih a nathutanje lengpa hinpen!

tcz: Na mite chung'a thu adih in tansah in; genthei lengvaite jong aphalam achan dingdol chang jing u hen.
en_web: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
en_kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng namite adih a avaihom ding, Bolgentheite adih a avaipoh ding ahi.

tcz: Molsang dung hon jong mijouse ding'in haodohna sodohsah hen chule thinglhang in jong gapha sodohsah hen.
en_web: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
en_kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the little hills, by righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung mi haohen nom hen, Adih umdol hedoh hen!

tcz: Genthei lengvaite panhusah in lang alhasamho chate huhdoh hen chule misugentheite chu sumang jeng hen.
en_web: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
en_kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, He shall save the children of the needy, And shall break in pieces the oppressor.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan vaichate rhu dih-in tan hen, Pumhatte sunem hen ngaichate kithopi hen!

tcz: Vanlai jol'a nisa le lha avahjing laise'n tonsot in amahon nangma naging jing'u hen.
en_web: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
en_kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun And moon endure, throughout all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Nipi noi lhapi noiya, Ni le lha vah laisen namiten chibai naboh jing hen!

tcz: Lengpa chu amite lah a go'n leiset chung achapnou bang'in hamdongho tobang amite chapnou hen.
en_web: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
en_kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: As showers that water the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa hi jaolah a gophin bang hen, Gamsunga gobah lha bang hen!

tcz: Ahinkho lhumkeijin chonphatna hinkho chepi jing hen. Chule lha'n vah aneilaisen khangtou jing hen.
en_web: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
en_kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; And abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa damlai sen adih leng hen, Ni le lha um laisen hao jing hen!

tcz: Alenggam in twikhanglen khat a kon'in twikhanglen langkhat hoppha hen lang chule Euphrate vadung'a kon'in leiset mong langkhat gei hop hen.
en_web: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
en_kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the river unto the ends of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Alenggamin Twikhanglen jouse khokhong hen, Euphrates luiya pat kolmong gei hen!

tcz: Neldigam a ganchaching mite'n chibai aboh diu ahi; amelmate jong amasang a um nen le boh lah a chun lhu cheh unte.
en_web: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
en_kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Nelgam chengte lengpa anga boh khup hen; Amelmate tol’a boh khup’u hen!

tcz: Tarshish le gamlatah a cheng lhumlam lengte'n kai hin peuhen. Sheba le Seba a kon solam lengte'n kipa thilpeh hinchoiju hen.
en_web: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
en_kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
tcz_gospelgo: Spain lente le twikol lengthen Lengpa kai peu hen! Arabia le Ethiopia lengthen jong Lengpa kei peu hen!

tcz: Leng jouse a ang'a kun'untin namtin vaipi alhacha hung pang di'u ahi.
en_web: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
en_kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: All nations shall serve him.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng jouse a-angsunga boh khup’u hen, Namtin vaipi alhachan pangu hen!

tcz: Aman genthei lengvaite chu akom'a atao teng'uleh hin huhdoh intin, min abol genthei panpibeiho chu ahinpanhu ding ahi.
en_web: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
en_kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; The poor also, and him that hath no helper.
tcz_gospelgo: Donlouva um, angaicha geo, vaicha Ahenga tao chan lengpan ahinsoi!

tcz: Aman milhasamte neiloute akhoto'a ahin huhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
en_kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, And shall save the souls of the needy.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhasam le vaicha akhoton, Angaicha chan ahinsoi!

tcz: Pumhat a kibol thohgimna noija umho chu alhatdoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman amaho chu alainatpi ding ahi.
en_web: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
en_kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: And precious shall their blood be in his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumhat’a mibolgentheitea konin Ahuhhing jin, ahinkhou akhohsah-e!

tcz: Lengpa chu hingsot hen! Sheba sana chu ama kipe hen, amite'n taopeh jing'u hen chule nilhumkei in phatthei boh uhen.
en_web: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
en_kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: Prayer also shall be made for him continually; And daily shall he be praised.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa hingsot hen! Arabia gamma sana jouse chang hen; Phat tinin japin taopeh hen, A-itih-in achunga Pathen vangboh chu jing hen!

tcz: Agamsung'uva chang-le-mim nengchet hen, thinglhangvum geiyin chang-le-mim kehdoh hen. Thei gana thingphungho jong Lebanon thingphungho bang'in keh dimset'u hen. Chule mipite jong hamphung phat bang'in hinhoi u hen.
en_web: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
en_kjv: There shall be a handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga chang le min pung hen, Mol le lhang neh pha hen; Lebanon lhang chang phat bangin pha hen! Hampa loudong pha bangin Khopi jouse mihem dimsoh hen!

tcz: Tonsot in lengpa minthang hen, nisa asat laisen chejom jing hen. Namtin vaipi amajeh in phatthei chang'u hen.
en_web: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
en_kjv: His name shall endure for ever: His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him: All nations shall call him blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa min thang jing hen, Ni le lha man kahsen minthang hen! Namtinin pahcha hen Pathen vang thumpeh jingu hen Lengpa nopna ding khohsah-u hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Israel Pathen Elohim chu thangvah in um hen, Amabouvin thil kidang aboldoh thei ahi.
en_web: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Isreal Pathen vahchoiyun! Thil kidang dang bol Amabou ahi!

tcz: Amin loupi chu tonsot in thangvah in umhen! Vannoi leiset hi Ama loupina dimset hen, Amen, Amen!
en_web: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
en_kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: And let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Tosot’in amin loupe vahchoiyun! Aloupinan vannoi losoh hen! Amen! Amen!

tcz: (Hiche hi Jesse chapa David taona achaina ahi).
en_web: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
en_kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesse chapa David taona Abonchan akichaisoh tai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Isreal te din aphai, hitobanga lungthimtheng ho dinga chun.
en_web: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
en_kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, Even to such as are of a clean heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel ding, Milungthengte din Pathen apha mong monge!

tcz: Keima din vang, kalamjotna beikoncha bou ahitai. Kalamlhong anal in lhulham pai ding kahitai.
en_web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
en_kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipt.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenla kakisonlelpi deh jengin, Tahsan kalhaso deh chet’e!

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman mikiletsahho gitlou bol pum hijong leu akhangtou u kamuteng ka otchalheh jin ahi.
en_web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
en_kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahte umchan kathangsen, Migiloute phatthei kamuteng ka-otchai!

tcz: Amaho hi atahsa'u aphatheiyin, adamthei un, ahattheiyun lungkhamna imacha neilou dan'in aum jiuve.
en_web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
en_kjv: For there are no bands in their death: But their strength is firm.
tcz_gospelgo: Natla athoh pouvin, Adamtheiyun ahat’ui!

tcz: Amaho hin midang bang'in boina imacha aneipouvin midangho'n aneiyu lunggimna amahon imacha aneipouve.
en_web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
en_kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; Neither are they plagued like other men.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang bangin genthei athoh pouvin, Adang bangin hesoh athoh khapouve!

tcz: Amahon kiletsahna songmantam a kisem khivui bang'in aki ouvin, gitlouna chu pon bang'in akisil'un ahi.
en_web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
en_kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; Violence covereth them as a garment.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsah-in ngong avaiput’un, Pumhat jengin thil abol’ui!

tcz: Hiche miboltheiho hin alungsung uva angaichat chan'u anei un ahi.
en_web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
en_kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthimin thilse jeng agel’un, Agilou bolna ding bou angaitouve.

tcz: Amahon mi jahda dingngen aseijun kiletsah tah in midang chu suhmang ding ago uvin ahi.
en_web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
en_kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: They speak loftily.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang adaithangun ahouseuve; Akiletsah-un midang bolsetna ding agong’ui!

tcz: Amahon van douna'n thu asei uvin a-o cheng'un leiset pumpi asamsesoh jeng'un ahi.
en_web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
en_kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Van Pathen ahouseuvin, Leiset mite ahohsal’ui!

tcz: Hiti chun mipiho'n athusei u hi ajah uleh akicha uvin akisulungdong gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
en_kjv: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen gingte geiyin ajuitan, Aseiyu angai jengjiuve.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in ipi ahet am? “Hatchungnung in thilsohho hi ahena dem?” atiuve.
en_web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
en_kjv: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the most High?
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathenin hepha pontin, Hatchungnungin umdoh ponte,” atiuve.

tcz: Hiche migilouho hi veuvin hinkhonom amang un ahao tultul jeng'un ahi.
en_web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
en_kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, Who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute hitobang hi ahiuve, Akhopset aneiyun, aneibe jingui.

tcz: Imacha phachomlou ding'a lungthim theng ka put ham? Themmona beihel'a hinkho ka man hi mohseh ham?
en_web: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
en_kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, And washed my hands in innocency.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonselou thengsel’a ka-um hi Kei dinga pannabei mong ham?

tcz: Nilhumkei in imacha phatchomna ka mupon hahsatna ngen ka mu jo'n ahi, jingkah seh in lunggimna ngen in eilonvuh in ahi.
en_web: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
en_kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, nilhum lhumin neibolgimin, Jingkahseh leh neiphonsel’e!

tcz: Keiman hitiahi ka seikhah a ahileh na mi ka hilou hijeng inte.
en_web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
en_kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; Behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse kaseikhah tah leh Namite chon kajomlou hinte.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman miphalouho hi i-atileh khangtou cheh cheh u ham ti hetchet ding'in ka khol'in ahi. Ahinla iti hahsat hitam?
en_web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
en_kjv: When I thought to know this, It was too painful for me;
tcz_gospelgo: Gelchet tei kagon vangin keidin ahah behseh jenge!

tcz: Hichun O Pathen Elohim, nangma muntheng'a ka lut'in ahileh ajona in migiloute akhankho diu chu kahin hedoh tan ahi.
en_web: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
en_kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; Then understood I their end.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin thenga kakai phat’in Migiloute manthahna ding kahedoh-e!

tcz: Tahbeh in nang'in amaho hi lhuh nathei munjeng a nakoi ahin alhuh gam nadiu a kiling gih geh songpi chung a nakoi joh ahi.
en_web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
en_kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: Thou castedst them down into destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute khu kilindet’a nadinsah a Alhu lham ding salem a nakoi ahi!

tcz: Chomkah lou in amaho amahthahgam tauvin ahi, tijatna'n alhohmang gam tauve.
en_web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
en_kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitphet kah louvin amangthah jiuvin, Vet ngamlouvin abeiji tauve!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma na hung kipatdoh tengleh nang'in amaho ngolna chu na nuisat ding ahi, mikhat in jingkah lang'a amang anuisat tobang bou ahi.
en_web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
en_kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah teng janmang beibep ahiuvin, Nahung teng akilep mangji tauve Pakai!

tcz: Hijouchun ka lungsung analheh jeng'in, hiti chun ka sunggil lang achiplha jeng'in ahi.
en_web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
en_kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, And I was pricked in my reins.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunggim le lung donga Ka-um teng leh,

tcz: Keima vang mingol le thilhethemlou kana hi-Nang a ding chun khohephalou gamsa tobang bep ka na hi bouve.
en_web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
en_kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Gancha ngol bangin Pathen Nangma kaheji tapoi!

tcz: Henge keima nang'a ka hi jing'e, nang man ka jetlang na tuh jingnai.
en_web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
en_kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden me by my right hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanginla nei-umpi jingin Kakhut’in neituh jinge!

tcz: Na chihna'n eikaihoi jing in, munloupi tah chu neilhut ding ahi.
en_web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
