en_kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhon nileh loupia neilahna din Neihilchah-in neilamkai jinge!

tcz: Van a nang tailou koidangba ka nei ding ham? Leiset chung'a thildang jouse sang'in jong kalung in na ngaicha joi.
en_web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
en_kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vana jong nang tilou adang kaneipon, Nang kaneitan leiset’a idang ka-ngaichat ding ham?

tcz: Ka tahsa bei henlang ka lhagao lhadai jongleh, Elohim Pathen chu ka lungthim'a ka hatna ahijing'in Amahi tonsot a kei a ahijing'e.
en_web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
en_kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: But God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungle katahsa lhasam jongle Eihatsah jing Pathen ahi; Ka-ngaichat jing Amabou ahiye!

tcz: Ama dalhaho jouse chu mahthah ding ahiuve, ajeh chu nangma dalhaho jouse chu nangman na sumang jin ahi.
en_web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
en_kjv: For lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma dalhate mangthah tei diu, Nahenga kitahloute nasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinla keima ding'in Elohim Pathen kom nai hi iti phat a hitam! Keiman vang Yahweh Pakai Lengchungnung chu ka kiselna ahijing e, chule keiman na thilbol kidangho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
en_web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
en_kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, That I may declare all thy works.
tcz_gospelgo: Keidin vang Pathento kinaiya, Hatchungnung Pakaiya kisel, Athilbol kidang ho seiphong hi Thilphapen ahiye.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, idia hitihchan pi neipaidoh u hitam? Ipi ding'a na kelngoite douna a hichangeihi na lunghan ham?
en_web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
en_kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen, idia neidondau hitam! Kelngoi vah a navahsa Namite chunga Iti neilung han jing diu ham?

tcz: Khang masalai peh a nalhentum chate kahiu neisumil hih beh un, hiche nam nagoulu tum dia na ngeh jing chu kahiuve! chule hiche lei a na inn Jerusalem jong sumil hih beh in.
en_web: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
en_kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; The rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; This mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
tcz_gospelgo: Goulo dia nalhatdamsa phung mite, Khanglui laiya pat nakihensa Namite hingeldoh jingin, Napansatna Zion molsang geldoh jingin!

tcz: Hiche khopi kisumangsa a hin hungvahlen lang, na melmate'n na houin hi ichanggei a asuhset'u hitam hinven.
en_web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
en_kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; Even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
tcz_gospelgo: Khogem kisong lah a hin vah len, Houin thenga thilkeo jouse Kamelmateuvin asumang tai!

tcz: Hiche mun a hi na melmate'n haan la anasap u hitam, hiche mun a hi aponlap u ana khaisang'u ahi.
en_web: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
en_kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; They set up their ensigns for signs.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin thenga namelmaten hanla asauvin, Galjona ponlap atungdoh tauve!

tcz: Amahon gammang lah a thingtuhna a heicha analap u bang'in,
en_web: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
en_kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up Axes upon the thick trees.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahlam kelkotjol jouse Heichan atu lhu’vin achonpeh gamtauve!

tcz: Heicha le chempong toh tho'n anakhenchip'un ahi.
en_web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
en_kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof At once with axes and hammers.
tcz_gospelgo: Tingkhom kijempah jouse She-in avobongun heichan achen goi tauve!

tcz: Amahon namuntheng a na mintheng kitahdohho chu asuboh un,
en_web: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
en_kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, They have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin theng susen meiyin ahal’un, Nakihouna mun jeng jong asuboh tauce!

tcz: Chuban in jong “abonchan suseu hite” akitikit uvin, Elohim Pathen houna mun jouse jong anahallhah u ahitai.
en_web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
en_kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: They have burnt up all the synagogues of God in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Chilgep hel din eigouvin, Gamsunga muntheng jouse ahalvam’ui!

tcz: Keihon melchihna thil kidangtahho chu ka mudohjou tapouvin ahi. Themgaoho jouse la aumgam tapouvin, chule hiche hi itihleh kichai ding ti chu koimacha ahe aumpon ahi.
en_web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
en_kjv: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet: Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
tcz_gospelgo: Melchihna thil theng jouse abeitan, Themgaoho jong abeisoh tai; Itih chan hitia kiumding Koiman aseithei tapoi!

tcz: O Pathen Elohim ka melmate'u hi itihchanggei na kihousetsah ding ham? Namin theng hi tonsot a nasuh molphou sah ding hitam?
en_web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
en_kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, kamelmateu nakinuisat sah sah ding ham? Iti naming ataitom tom diu ham?

tcz: Ipi dia na banjet thahatna hi na chalohsah lou ham? Na khut thahattah chu mangcha'n lang amaho khu sugam tan.
en_web: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
en_kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? Pluck it out of thy bosom.
tcz_gospelgo: Idia neipanpi nom louvu ham? Idia khut kikhoitum nahim?

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi khangluilai a pat a leiset chung'a huhhingna hinpolut a ka lengpa na hi.
en_web: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
en_kjv: For God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Semtil’a pat Kalengpau nahi Pathen! Tamtah vei neihuhhingsau jong ahitai!

tcz: Nang man na ban thahat'in twikhanglen jong na lhehkhen in, twikhanglen a cheng sahemho luchang jong navohchip soh hel e.
en_web: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
en_kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathahat’in Twikhanglen navotanin, Twikhanglen dragonte lu navokeh-e!

tcz: Nangman Leviathan luchang jong nasuchip in atahsa neldigam a um ganhingho vahnan na mangtai.
en_web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
en_kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, And gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Sampi Leviathan luchang navokeh-in, Atahsa gamsa vahnan naneiye!

tcz: Nang man leiset a kum nakihei sah in leiset a kon'in twi tamtah na putdohsah in chule a-itih a kang khalou vadungho jong na sukang jin ahi.
en_web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
en_kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisan nasemdoh-in twinah nason, Luipi lentah tah nakansah-e!

tcz: Sun le jan jong nang'a ahin: nangman vanlai jol'a avahho jouse le nisa jong na sem in ahi.
en_web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
en_kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun le Jan nasemin, Ni le Lha natungdoh-e!

tcz: Nangman leiset gamgiho jouse jong na lhehkhen in chule nipilai le phalbilai jong na gongtoh in ahi.
en_web: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
en_kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.
tcz_gospelgo: Leist kolkimvel najih jol’in, Phalbi le Nipi nasemdoh-e!

tcz: Ven Yahweh Pakai hiche melmaho hin ichangei a nangma hi na houset'u hitam, ima hetkhenna neilou nam miten na min hi asuminseuvin ahi.
en_web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
en_kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, And that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, namelma, Pathen helouten Nanuisat’a nanotthapnau hi gel temin!

tcz: Hiche gamsa tobang miphalouho hi vapal tobang miphaho hi suhmangsah hihbeh in, na mite gentheina hi itihchan'in jong sumil hihbeh in.
en_web: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
en_kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: Forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Melma gilote kichepna din Panpibei namite hi dalha hih-in! Bolgenthei thoh a um Namite dumil loujenin!

tcz: Na kitepna kinep umtahho chu sumil hihbeh in, ajeh chu gamsung hi muthim le pumhat a natohna adimset e!
en_web: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
en_kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
tcz_gospelgo: Neikiteppi nau geldoh-in, Gamsung thimlai jousea pumhat’in mi akinon ahi!

tcz: Noise le chotpha a umte hi jumna tosah kit hihbeh in, amavang mivaicha le tahlelte na min choi-at sah in.
en_web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
en_kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Bolset thohte jumso dan! Tahlelte le vaichaten navahchoiyu hen!

tcz: Na melmate'n na housetnaho le na doumah mah asap a saptho jenghou hi nahsahmon koihihbeh in.
en_web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
en_kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kipanin nading kiseiyin Pathen! Pathen helouten nilhum lhumin nanuisat’ui!

tcz: Namel ten aseidoh uchu nungvet kit hih in ahiloule amaho phunchel jing na chu.
en_web: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
en_kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: The tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Namelmate kisen gin, nakidoupite pocheichoi Sumil loujenin!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma kahin thangvah e! Yahweh Pakai nangma nailama naumjeh in kahin thangvah uve. Muntin a um mipiten nathilbol kidangtah ho aphongdoh un ahi.
en_web: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
en_kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: For that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma kathangvah-ui Pathen, Nangma kathangvah-ui! Naloupije le nathilbol kidang ho Kaphongjal leuve!

tcz: Elohim Pathennin asei e, keiman thutanna phatkhat kagong e, keiman dihtah a thu katanding ahi.
en_web: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
en_kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “Kateppeh phat teng Kitoh chet’a thu katan ding;

tcz: Leiset hi kihot linghenlang mihemte tija jongleu leiset bulpi tuhchah jingding chu kahi.
en_web: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
en_kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing nam kim kithing thinga, Leiset kihot ling soh jong leh Leiset khompi katuhdet ding;

tcz: “Keiman mikiletsah ho kagih-in ‘kiletsah datan!’ Migiloulou ho komachun, ‘nakhut tumjel hihin!’
en_web: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
en_kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou kiletsah kaphoa,

tcz: Vanho dounan nakhut tum jel hihin, ahilouleh nahsah loutah in thu seihih in” kati.
en_web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
en_kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: Speak not with a stiff neck.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsah angah na diuva Kaseipeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ajeh chu, leiset chunga koimacha solam a kon hihen lhumlam-a kon hijongleh chuleh gamthip noi a kon hijongleh kihisah tah a akhuttum ajel louding aphai.
en_web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
en_kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, Nor from the west, nor from the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisolam ham nilhum lam ham, Sahlam ham lhanglam ham a Them channa hungsoh doh ding ahipon;

tcz: Ajeh chu thutan vaihom-a hi Elohim Pathen Amabou ahin, Amahin koipen ding doh ding ham ahi louleh koipen lhuding ham gonga Amabou ahi.
en_web: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
en_kjv: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and setteth up another.
tcz_gospelgo: Them le themmo chansah ding Thutan Pa Pathen bou ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in juphon gimnam twitoh kihal chu akhutna khonkhat in achoiye. Aman hiche ju chu thutan na mun a sunglut in, hichu migilou cheng in adon teitei diu adontheng heldiu ahi.
en_web: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
en_kjv: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; It is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: But the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin khon khat achoiyin, Alunghanna juthuh adimset’e; Ahinsun lhah teng Migilouten adousoh keiyuva Achim ava adon cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Hinla keima vangin, Elohim Pathen thil bol ho hi kaphondoh jengding; Jacob Elohim Pathen henga vahchoila kasha jingding ahi.
en_web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
en_kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang Jacob Pathen thu kasei jinga, Avahchoila kasah jing ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in asei e “Keiman miphalouho thahatna laichu kasuhchip ding ahinla michonphaho thahatna kahatsah beding ahi” ati.
en_web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
en_kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob Pathenin migilou tha asuh beiya, Midih vang hat cheh cheh ding ahi.

tcz: Judah a Pathen Elohim hi akijabol in, Israel a Amin hi aloupin ahi.
en_web: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
en_kjv: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gama Pathen akihen, Israel lah a amin akijabol jinge.

tcz: Jerusalem hi achenna ahin; Zion molchu a inn ahi.
en_web: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
en_kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling place in Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem Pathenin chen munin aneiyin, Zion molsanga apansai.

tcz: Hicheachun agalmite meikong tobang thalchang chu asubong in, a umphou le achemjamhou chuleh agalmachah houjouse jong asuhchip pehin ahi.
en_web: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
en_kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion mol’a Pathenin Melmate thalchang jouse, Alum jouseu leh chemjam ho Abonchan aheh bongin asumangtai!

tcz: Nangma hi tonsot a umjing mol ho sang in jong naloupi in nalamdang deh e.
en_web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
en_kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pathen naloupi ngeiye! Nagalte najona molsanga kona Nahung kilekit chun Nalal loupe ngeiye Pathen!

tcz: Eidou u galmi hangpenho jouse jong akisugep gam tauve. A imumil bang in kamasang uvah akijamdel tauve. Galmi koiman kamasang uvah akhutnu alamp ngapchat lou diu ahitai.
en_web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
en_kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: And none of the men of might have found their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmate gal-hang jouse Khut keovin aumsoh tan; Alongu akijamchap’in, Ahatnau le athepnau pannabei ahitai!

tcz: O Jacob Elohim Pathen nakam sunga nahaina hu chu ahung gindoh chun asakol jouse leh akangtalai jouseu akolchah sah soh jengin ahi.
en_web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
en_kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jacob Pathen, melmate nahohsal chun Sakolte le achung touho akijamchap tauve!

tcz: Nangma hitobang tah-a ginle ja naumhi datmo ding ahipoi. Ajeh chu nalunghan ahung deujah leh koiham na-anga ding ngam dingah?
en_web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
en_kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, mitinin nagingin, Nalunghan teng nakoma koima apang ngampoi!

tcz: Vanna konin nagalmite chunga thu nahin tan in, leiset hi akithingin na-ang sungah adingin ahi.
en_web: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
en_kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
tcz_gospelgo: Vana kon thu natan jin, Vannoi mite a-uhsa ngampouve!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nadingdoh-in mi engsete thu natan in leiset abol genthei a umte nahuhdohjin ahi.
en_web: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
en_kjv: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a bolgentheita umte huhhing din Thutan din nahung kipanjitai!

tcz: Mihemte hi nangma doumah a achonteng hichu naloupina kilandohna ahijon ahi, ajeh chu hiche chu nangma manchah-a pangbep ji ahi.
en_web: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
en_kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte lunghan chun navahchoina asojon, Gal’a hingdoh chengin kut bolnan aneiyui!

tcz: Na Pakai Yahweh, na Pathen Elohim heng a kitepna neiyin lang hichu nit'in, mijousen kichat umtah Elohim Pathen kom a pehdingdol hinpecheh hen.
en_web: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
en_kjv: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: Let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakitepna jat Pakai na-Pathen peuvin, Naivel’a namtin vaipin thilto peuvin! Pathenin mite akiginsah-in,

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman leng chate kiletsahna avochip in, lengten jong Ama ginle jana aneiyun ahi.
en_web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
en_kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kilatsah leng chapate asu nemin, Leng loupitah tah ho Akinlihsah deh deh-e!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kakouvin; henge, kasaptho jengin ahi. Oh, Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh tei inte!
en_web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
en_kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Othongje jun pathen kakouvin, Oginglet lut’a katao teng eihoujie!

tcz: Keiman hahsatna kato teng Yahweh Pakai chu kaholjin ahi. Jankhovah in vanlang sangin kakhut katungin kataojin ahi. Ahinla kalhagao in olna amujoupoi.
en_web: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
en_kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My sore ran in the night, and ceased not: My soul refused to be comforted.
tcz_gospelgo: Gim genthei teng Pakaiya kataovin, Ama kasana katao khovah vah vangin, Kalung mong thei deh poi.

tcz: Keiman Elohim Pathen kagelin apanpina ngaichatnan eilonvuh-in kamaojin ahi.
en_web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
en_kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kageldoh teng na kasan, Kakigel gel teng katah asei!

tcz: Nangman jankhovah in nei imutsahpon ahi, ajeh chu keima kalung ahesoh behsehin kataotheipoi!
en_web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
en_kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin jan ihmu mon eilhan, Kagim behseh-in kapaomo loi!

tcz: Keiman phat sottah chetasa hinkholui nopsahna chengchu kageldohjin,
en_web: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
en_kjv: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni masa lai kagel teng Kum masa lai jong kageldoh jie.

tcz: kipana dimsetna vahchoina la ana kisahna janhochu kalhagao lungthim a kakholchil tengleh tuhin masangtoh akibah louna kageldohjin ahi.
en_web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
en_kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: And my spirit made diligent search.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khovah-in kagel jin, Ka-ngaito chu hiche hi ahi:

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hin aitih a dia eipaidoh mong hitantem? Amahin khotona eimulou mong mong ding hitam?
en_web: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
en_kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favourable no more?
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakaiyin eidondan jinguva, Eilunglhai kit louhel diu hitam?

tcz: Angailutna longlouchu chemang monga hitam? Akitepna hochu lolhing lou mong ding hitam?
en_web: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
en_kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?
tcz_gospelgo: Eivetdauva Akitepna bei ngap hitam?

tcz: Elohim Pathen in eihepina chu asuhmil mong hitam? Eihepina kotchu akha mong hitam?
en_web: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
en_kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Eikhoto diu Pathenin asuhmil’a, Voujang natpi sanga lung hangjo hitam?” kati.

tcz: Hitihin keiman kaseijin, “hichehi kachanding mongchu ahi, chungnungpen'in ei engbol ahi,” kati.
en_web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
en_kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: But I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kalung natna pen chu, Pathen thahat abeitai,” kati.

tcz: Ahinla O Yahweh Pakai nanatoh hohi kahin geldohin, tuma sang peh-a nanatoh kidangtah hochu kageldohin ahi.
en_web: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
en_kjv: I will remember the works of the Lord: Surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nathilbol loupe tah tah geldoh ing ting, Masanga thil kidang nabol ho geldoh inge!

tcz: Hicheho chu kalung sunga amil theipon ahi. Nanatoh loupitah hochu gellouvin kaumthei jipon ahi.
en_web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
en_kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, And talk of thy doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Natohsa chengse ngai tong ting, Thil nasa nabolsa ho gel inge!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nalampi hi atheng e. Nangma tobang patheng dang um mong nantem?
en_web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
en_kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is so great a God as our God?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, nabolchan athengin, Nang banga loupe Pathen dang aumpoi!

tcz: Nanghi datmo kidangtah Elohim Pathen chu nahi ahi! Nangin chidang namdangte lah-a nabol theina gimneitah chu nakilandohsah ahitai.
en_web: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
en_kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kidang bol Pathen nangbou nahin, Namtin vaipi nathahat navetsah tai!

tcz: Naban thahatna a nami Jacob leh Joseph chilhahte chu nahuhdoh ahitai.
en_web: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
en_kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathahat’in namite Jacob le Joseph son ho nahuhhinge.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglensan chun namuphat in twichun nahinven akithingtan ahi! Twikhanglen chu asunglang ho ngeiyin akithingin ahi.
en_web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
en_kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: The depths also were troubled.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, twipin Nangma namu Phat’un, Lithuh tah tah ho jong kichan akidil’ui!

tcz: Meilhang in go ahin juhlhahsah in, van gin kithong chun vanthamjol chu agin akithonsah in ahi. Nakolphe thalchang chun ahin salvah in ahi.
en_web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
en_kjv: The clouds poured out water: The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilhanga konin go ajun, Vanthamjol pohlhong lhongin agingin, Kolkimvel’a kol aphelhap lhap’ui. Van ging akitoljul jul’in, Kolphen vannoi asahvah-in; Leiset a kilingin akihotnemtai!

tcz: Chimpei lah-a kon chun van gin ahung kithongin kolphe chun vannoi leiset ahin salvah in ahi! Leiset chu akithingin akihot-e.
en_web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
en_kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.

tcz: Nalampi chu twikhanglen'ah akilhunglutnin ahi, Nakeng nung twilah ajong akigollut e, ahinlah nakhonung koimachan amudoh joupoi!
en_web: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
en_kjv: Thy way is in the sea, And thy path in the great waters, And thy footsteps are not known.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi kinong lai najot paiyin, Twikhanglen thuh lai nagalkai vangin Nakhochotna nung akimudoh poi!

tcz: Nangin kelngoi chingpa hina in Mose le Aaron mangcha in namite hi kelngoi honbangin napuilen ahi.
en_web: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
en_kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngaoi chingpa bangin namite napuiyin, Mose le Aaron namangin Napuilen ahi!

tcz: O kamite ho, kathuhil hi ngaiyun. Kathusei a hin nakol'u hinsungun,
en_web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
en_kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahil ngaiyun kamite, kasei gal khoh-un!

tcz: ajeh chu keiman thulem a nahenga thu kaseiding ahi, keiman achesa thilsoh ho-a kon a kahin hilding nahi,
en_web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
en_kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
tcz_gospelgo: Thulem kaseiya, Khanglui lai thu kisel ho

tcz: eihon thusim ijahsa houleh ihetsahou, thusim ipu ipateuva kon a hung kiseilhapeh ho ahi.
en_web: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
en_kjv: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipu ipateuvin anasei, Ijah-uva ihetsau kahilchet ding ahi.

tcz: Eihon hiche thutah hohi icha inaoteu i-impeh loudiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh loupi tahtah hohi, athaneinale akidanna hohi ikhangthah houhi iseipehdiu ahi.
en_web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
en_kjv: We will not hide them from their children, Shewing to the generation to come The praises of the Lord, and his strength, And his wonderful works that he hath done.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thahat le anatoh loupi tah tah, Thil kidang abol ho, ichate diuva jong i-impeh lou diu Khangkit’a jong iseipeh diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman Jocob kom a Dan anapeh-a, Israel kom a thuhil ho anapeh ahi. Aman ipu ipateu atu achateu ahil diuva thupeh anapeh ahin,
en_web: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
en_kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Jacob to kitepna aphutdoh-in, Israelte Danthu anapei; Danthu hi achateu ahil din Ipu ipateu anaseipeh-e.

tcz: hitiachu ahunglhung ding khangthah ten ahet nadiuleh ahung pengloulai chapang ho dinga, chuleh aman amaho chapangte ahilsonna diuva ahi.
en_web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
en_kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; Who should arise and declare them to their children:
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu ho hi khangkit’a miten Kihilna aneiyuva achate ahilson diu ahi.

tcz: Hitiachu khangthah ahunglhun channa Elohim Pathen a kinepna thah aneisah nadiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh kidang thil loupi hochu asuhmillou nadiu chuleh athupehho anitjing nadiuva ahiljing diu ahi.
en_web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
en_kjv: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi amahon Pathen atahsan’uva, Athilbol asuhmil lou diu, Athupeh chengse anit jing diu ahi.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh ipi iputeu tobang talou a lungtahna, kiphinna, kitah louna Elohim Pathen a alungthim'u pehnom louna anei lou diu ahitai.
en_web: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
en_kjv: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Apu apateu banga Pathen tahsan det lou, Pathena ki-ngai lou, Thu nung lou Doumah mah a chonte hilou diu ahi.

tcz: Ephraim galsat hon thalchang akipoh vangun akinung hei un galmun a konin ajam tauve.
en_web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
en_kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Ephriam mihon thalpi le thalchang apat vangun, Gal nikhon ajamtauve!

tcz: Amahon Elohim Pathen toh akitepnau ajuitapouvin ama thuhil dinpi ding anom tapouvin ahi.
en_web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
en_kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathento akitepnau anit pouvin, Adanthua jong anung pouve!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ipi abolpeh uham thil kidangtah tah anabol hochu,
en_web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
en_kjv: And forgat his works, And his wonders that he had shewed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kidang abol amusau jong Anatoh ho geiyin asumiltauve.

tcz: napu napateu dinga thil kidang anatohdoh ho, Egypt gamsungle Zoan phaicham chunga, atohdohho asumil tauvin ahi.
en_web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
en_kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gam Zoan phaiya, Pathen thil kidang bol ho Apu apateuvin anavet vet jengu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman twikhanglen ana homkhen in twichu bang bangin aki khen in amaho anapui galkaiyun ahi.
en_web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
en_kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Twikhanglen avotanin, Apu apateu apui galakiyin, Twipi bang bangin akitinsah-e.

tcz: Sunleh meilhang in anapuijin, janleh meikong in anapuijin ahi.
en_web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
en_kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun teng meilhangin apuiyin, Janteng meikongin apuiye!

tcz: Aman gamthip gamm a songpia kon in adondiu twi anaputdoh sah-in ahi.
en_web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
en_kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink as out of the great depths.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya songpi apokhitsah-in, Leinoi lampeh a twi amaho adonsah-e.

tcz: Aman songpia konna twichu vadung bangin analondohsah in ahi.
en_web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
en_kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpia konin tei aputsah-in, Luidung lonin alonsah-e!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin neldi gam achun amahon chonset anabol'un hatchungnung dounan ana kiphin'un ahi.
en_web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
en_kjv: And they sinned yet more against him By provoking the most High in the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla amahon chonset abol jingun, Gamthip laiya jong Chungnungpen Pathen doumah jen gabol’ui!

tcz: Amahon alungsung uchu lungtahna neipumin Elohim Pathen ana patep un nehding anathumun ahi.
en_web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
en_kjv: And they tempted God in their heart By asking meat for their lust.
tcz_gospelgo: Henasa san Pathen apatep’un, Akel lung changun An neh ding athum’ui!

tcz: Amahon Elohim Pathen Amatah dounan thu anaseiyun “Elohim Pathen in gamthip gammah an eipejou pouve” atiuve.
en_web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
en_kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dounan, “Gamthip laiya Pathenin Neh ding eipeh mong diu hinam?

tcz: “Henge, songchu ajep'un twichu aputdoh nai, ahinla amite changlhah le sa me eipejou pouve” atiuve.
en_web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
en_kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, And the streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Can he provide flesh for his people?
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi avokhin, twi aputsah a Luibanga alonsah vangin; Amite eiho hi bu le sa eipeh thei diu hinam?” atiuve.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in hichehi ajahdoh phatnin alunghang lheh jengin, Jacob dounan alunghan na mei akoudoh jengin ahi! Hitihin Israel douna alung hanna ahung koudoh jengin ahi,
en_web: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
en_kjv: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: So a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also came up against Israel;
tcz_gospelgo: Aseiyu ajah hin Pakai along hangin, Alungna behseh-in Amite chu meiyin ahalvamtai!

tcz: ajeh chu amahon Elohim Pathen atahsan pouvin chuleh amaho akhoukhah diuvin jong ana tahsan pouvin ahi.
en_web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
en_kjv: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pakai la atahsan pouvin, Amaho huhhing jou din jong Anatahsan pouve!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in chungleng vanthamjol thu apen vankot jouse jong ahongdoh in,
en_web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
en_kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, And opened the doors of heaven,
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla pathenin Vanthamjol Kotpi chengse kihong din aseiyin;

tcz: Aman aneh dingun van a konin Mana gojuh in ahin juhlhah sah in van changlhah chu ahinpen ahi.
en_web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
en_kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, And had given them of the corn of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Vana konin buneh aneh thei Manna ahinsung lhai!

tcz: Amahon vantil buchu aneuvin, Elohim Pathen in alungna chimsetnun apen ahi.
en_web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
en_kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: He sent them meat to the full.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aduchat jouseu apen, Israelten vantilte an aneuve.

tcz: Aman solam huichu ahin nunsah in, Athahatnan lhanglang huijong anunsah in ahi.
en_web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
en_kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: And by his power he brought in the south wind.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin athahat’in sah le lhanga kon Huipi anunsah-in;

tcz: Aman aneh dingun sachu vutdi jat ahin juhlhah sahin, vachaho chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat ahin,
en_web: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
en_kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, And feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
tcz_gospelgo: Amite din luipanga neldi jat leo Vachate ahinlhon lutsahin;

tcz: Aman vachaho chu aponbuh sungu leh avel uvah ahin lenlhah sah in ahi.
en_web: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
en_kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchate chu abonchan Ngahmun lailung ponbuh veldung adimset’e!

tcz: Amahon oivasetin aneuvin ahi. Angaichat dungjuitah in apen ahi.
en_web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
en_kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: For he gave them their own desire;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aduchat’u apen, Israelten vachate kithan anetauve!

tcz: Hinla amahon angaichat dungjuija anehva masangu, akam sung uva sa aumpet jeng jong chun,
en_web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
en_kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla agilkel chim masangu, A-an neh laitah-uvin;

tcz: Elohim Pathen lunghana achung uvah ahung lhungtan ahileh Aman alah uva ahatpen pen hochu athat tan ahi. Israel khangthah anasapen hochu athat gamtan ahi.
en_web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
en_kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, And slew the fattest of them, And smote down the chosen men of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Achunguva Pathen along hangin, Israel mi, pasal lhentum Mi thahat lai lai athat tai!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin mipiho chun chonset aboljom jingun ahi, thilkidang ijat abol vangin atahsan dehpouvin ahi.
en_web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
en_kjv: For all this they sinned still, And believed not for his wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitipia aboltah vangin Israel achonse jingun; Thil kidang chujatpi abol vangin atahsanpouve.

tcz: Hiti chun ahinkhou chu lhuhgam na ahitan akum khouchu kichatnan adimtai.
en_web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
en_kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ahinkhou asuchomin, Kimlih leo leovin alhai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amaho ahin thapat phatnun amahon ajona langin Amachu ahin holtauvin ahi. Kisihna ahin neitauvin Elohim Pathen ahin holtauvin ahi.
en_web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
en_kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: And they returned and inquired early after God.
tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva mi phabep atha teng Adang ho ahenga ahungun, Lung aheiyun ahenga Lung laigil’in ataovui!

tcz: Hiti chun Elohim Pathen chu asongpiu ahi chuleh Elohim Pathen chu hat chungnung le ahuhhing pao ahi ahin geldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
en_kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the high God their redeemer.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng apanpiuva ahoidamu chu Hatchungnung Pathen ahi ahedoh jiuve!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin hichu kamnal a anaseijiu ahibouvin alei u mangchan jou anaseiyun ahi.
en_web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
en_kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, And they lied unto him with their tongues.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang joujeng aseiyun, Lung thengsel’in imacha aseipouve!

tcz: Alung sungu chu Elohim Pathen a ana petheng pouvin Elohim Pathen toh anakitep nauva jong ana dingdet pouvin ahi.
en_web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
en_kjv: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen din akitah pouvin, Akoma akitepnau jong alolhing pouve!

tcz: Hinla lungsetna dim Elohim Pathen chun achonsetnau anangai damun amahochu ana sumang deh pouvin ahi. Phat atamjon alunghan na anatuh tangin hiche bangchun ima ana tongdoh pon ahi.
en_web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
en_kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vang amite ahepi jingin, Amaho sumang louvin asetnau angaidam’e; Alunghan tamtah vei adamin, Alungset akitim nah nah-e!

tcz: Tahsa mihembep ahiuve ti ahejingin, hui anun leh heikhat kahbou ahin ahung kiletapoi ti ageldoh in ahi.
en_web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
en_kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
tcz_gospelgo: Khohui kitolmang banga Thi thei mihing ahiu ahe jinge!

tcz: Gamthip sunga ijatvei Ama douna ana kiphin jengu chuleh alungsung anatsah vangin,
en_web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
en_kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya ijat vei Pathen adouvuva, Ijat vei lung himoa alhau hitam!

tcz: Avel vel in Elohim Pathen thohhat nachu apatep jiuvin Israel Pathen Elohim chu asulunghang jiuvin ahi.
en_web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
en_kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, And limited the Holy One of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Avel vel’in Pathen apatep’un, Israel Pathen theng chu aphinseuve!

tcz: Amahon athahatna in agalmi houva kon a anahuhdoh u hi ageldoh joutapouve.
en_web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
en_kjv: They remembered not his hand: Nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmateuva kona ahuhhing nia Pathen thahat loupije asumil’ui!

tcz: Egypt gamsunga thil kidang ijat abolu hitam chuleh Zoan phaicham a athil kidang bol hochu ageldoh tapouvin ahi.
en_web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
en_kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan:
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gam Zoan phaiya thil kidang abol, Anatoh nasatah tah chu asumil tauve.

tcz: Vadungho thisan asosah a don mohella alha, vadung twi donmo hella alha jengchu.
en_web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
en_kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; And their floods, that they could not drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung jouse thisan asosah a Egupten don ding ahet lou asumil’ui.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amaho lah a thousi vaibong alansah a, uphohte alansah a agam ujong a suh set peh chu ahepha tapouve.
en_web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
en_kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt thousi vaibong alha khumin, Asugenthei lheh jengun, Uphohte alhan Agamsungu asugam geiyin ahepouve.

tcz: Aman achang jouseu khongbai aneh gamsah in alousoh jouseu jong khaokhopi anehgam sah e.
en_web: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
en_kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labour unto the locust.
tcz_gospelgo: Aloujaovuva khaokhopite alha a, Muchi chivo asuhgam jong ahaitauve!

tcz: Alengpithei jouseu gel avohlhah sah sohkei in, atheipiu phung jouseu jong daibang athagamsah in ahi.
en_web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
en_kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore trees with frost.
tcz_gospelgo: Alengpigau gel avohchaisah a, Atheichangu daibang athasah asumil tauve.

tcz: Agancha jouseu gel lah a dalhah in aumsah in, akelngoi houjong keh alhah lihsah sohtai.
en_web: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
en_kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
tcz_gospelgo: Aganchau gel avoh lihsah a Kelngoi hon jouse keh aselihsah ahetapouve,

tcz: Achung uva nasatah in alunghangin, alung dammona alung hanna, mi sumang vantil hon tamtah alhahkhum tan ahi.
en_web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
en_kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, By sending evil angels among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt alunghan a mithat Vantil asol’a Athasah a alunghemu ahetapouve.

tcz: Aman alunghanna achung uvah achuh sahtan, Egypt mite hinkho anahing hoipon, amangthah gamtan ahi,
en_web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
en_kjv: He made a way to his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;
tcz_gospelgo: Alung han gpaiyin, Gamna alha khuma athagam asumil’ui.

tcz: Egypt insunga achapa tahpen cheh athat in Egypt gamsung pumpia khangdongte pahcha amolsahtai.
en_web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
en_kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; The chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt insung jouse Pasal peng masa cheng athagam ahaitauve!

tcz: Hinla Aman amite chu kelngoi honbangin apuiyin gamthip noija bitkei in apui galkai tan ahi.
en_web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
en_kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi chingpa banga amite apuiya, Gamthip laiya apuidoh asumil’ui!

tcz: Aman mongtahin apuilen hijeh chun amahon kichatna aneipouve, chujongleh twikhanglen in agalteu alhoh mangpeh gamtai.
en_web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
en_kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichatsah louvin amite apuiyin, Amelmateu twipi achupsah asumiltauve.

tcz: Amaho chu Elohim Pathen in agamtheng abanjetna atundoh, molsang vum achun ahin puilut in,
en_web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
en_kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, Even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal’a alahsa molsang vum, Amunthenga amite apuidoh jong ahetapouve.

tcz: Amaho masangah namtin vaipi adelmang peh sohkeiyin, abonchauvin achan dingu gam ahoppeh chehin, Israel phung namtin abonchauvin ama ama ponbuh cheh a achensah tai.
en_web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
en_kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, And divided them an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite kitol chun agamsunga chengte adelmangpeh-in, Agam’u Israelte ahoppeh a, a-in’uva amite Achensah geiyin asumiltauve.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin amahon hatchungnung Elohim Pathen dounan thil abol jingun athupeh ho khatcha anitpeh pouvin ahi.
en_web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
en_kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, And kept not his testimonies:
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pathen Hatchungnung adou jingun, Apatep jiuvin athupeh ho anit pouve.

tcz: Apu apateu bangin avah mang-uvin jou jengin na atonguvin ahi. Amaho chu thalpi janglou bangin akitah pouvin ahi.
en_web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
en_kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisonpi mo thalchang kon bang le Kitahna bei apateu bangin Doumah abol jingui!

tcz: Amahon pathen dangho doiphung aphutdoh un Elohim Pathen alunghan sah uvin, chuleh semthu pathen ahoujeh-un Elohim Pathen athangthip sahtauvin ahi.
en_web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
en_kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
tcz_gospelgo: Doiphung tampi asemdoh-un Pathen aphin lung hangun, Doilim tamtah asemjeh-un Hatah-in along hansah-ui!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ajahdoh phat in hatah'in alunghangin Israel chu pumpai in apaimangtan ahi.
en_web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
en_kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel:
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol’u amujeh-in Pathen along hangin, Israelte apaimangtai.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in Shiloh achenna mun adalhan mihemte lah a aumna ponbuh chu adalhatai.
en_web: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
en_kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;
tcz_gospelgo: I-lah-uva achenmun Shiloh a Aponbuh geiyin Pathenin adondai.

tcz: Aman aloupina le athaneina hetna kitepna thingkong chu galmiho khutna apehdohtan ahi.
en_web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
en_kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the enemy’s hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahat le aloupi melchihna Kitepna thingkong chu imelmateu amatsah-e.

tcz: Ama amite chunga alunghan jeh-in agalmiteu athasah gamtan ahi.
en_web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
en_kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with his inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite alunghanin, Amelmateu athagamsah-e.

tcz: Gollhangho galah athigam tauvin, nungah ho akichenpidiu aumtapon ahi.
en_web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
en_kjv: The fire consumed their young men; And their maidens were not given to marriage.
tcz_gospelgo: Golhang jouse gal’a athitan, Nu-ngah hon ji ding aneitapouve!

tcz: Thempute athat gamtauvin ameithai houvin alhasetpi thei tapouvin ahi.
en_web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
en_kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempuho gal’in athat’un, Ajiteu jong akasah theipouve!

tcz: Ajonan Yahweh Pakai chu a-ihmua ahung khangdoh bangin ahung thoudoh in mihatpa hung kiltildoh bangin ahung kitildohin,
en_web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
en_kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, And like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
tcz_gospelgo: Ihmut’a kon thoudoh bangin Pakai ahung kipattan; Jukham pasal hattah bangin Pakai ahung kisentei!

tcz: Galmi hochu anungno in a-itih a ding jumna atosah tan ahi.
en_web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
en_kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: He put them to a perpetual reproach.
tcz_gospelgo: A—itih a gal lel a jum din, Amelmate anung non adeljamtai!

tcz: Ahinla Joseph chilhah hochu apaidohin, chuleh Ephraim phungchu alheng tapon ahi.
en_web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
en_kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph chilhahte jong apaiyin, Ephriam phung jong alatapoi!

tcz: Aman akhellin Judah leh angailut Zion molchu alhengin,
en_web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
en_kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.
tcz_gospelgo: Adeipen Zion lhanga Juda phung joh alhengtai!

tcz: hichea chun vanho san banga sang, leiset banga chah a-itih a umjing dingin houin khat atungdoh tan ahi.
en_web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
en_kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion lhanga van a a-in bangin Ahouin Theng akisah-e! Itih geiya kilong kit loudin, Leiset bangin asedettai!

tcz: Aman asohpa David chu akelngoi chinna a konnin anakoudoh'in analheng tan ahi.
en_web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
en_kjv: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha Davih alhengin, Akelngoi chinnaa akoudoh-e!

tcz: Aman kelngoipi le anou achin laijin akoudoh'in amite Israel Jacob chilhah hochu kelngoi chinna ching dingin anapansah tan ahi.
en_web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
en_kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him To feed Jacob his people, And Israel his inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi chingbanpi chu Israel lengpan atungin, Pathen mite chu kelngoi chinin achinsah tai!

tcz: David in amaho chu lungtheng tah leh chingtheitah in analamkaiyin ahi.
en_web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
en_kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
tcz_gospelgo: David ama ki-itcha louvin Khut them to thon amite alamakaite!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen chiding namdangten nanga dinga nanakilhendoh nagamchu ahinlo tauvin, na Houin theng asuboh'un chuleh Jerusalem chu khogemsa abahsah tauvin ahi.
en_web: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
en_kjv: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, namdangten Nagam ahindel khumtauve! Nahouin theng asuhboh-un, Jerusalem asuchimsoh tauve!

tcz: Amahon nasohte tahsa chu vantham jolla lengle vachate adalhahpeh tauvin, pathen mi thengte tahsaphe chu gamlah a ganhingho an le chahin apangtan ahi.
en_web: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
en_kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given To be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhachate muthong vah nan aneiyun, Atahsa longu sahang vah nan aneiyui!

tcz: Jerusalem kimvellah thisan hi twilon in along jengin mithi vuiding koimacha aumpoi.
en_web: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
en_kjv: Their blood have they shed like water Round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
tcz_gospelgo: Namite thisan tei kisung lha abahsah-un, Jerusalem kholaiya thisan teiyin alonge! thilong vui ding jong Mihem khatcha beh aumtapouve!

tcz: Kaheng kakomho noise dingleh kajet kavei a umho dingin noise le taitomin kaumtauve.
en_web: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
en_kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavel’uva chengten eng houle Daichatvai, nuisat’in eineiyui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai phat ichangeija kachung uva nalunghan ding hitam? Tonsot geijin em? Phat ichan geija nathangthipna chu meikong banga aljeng dingham?
en_web: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
en_kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
tcz_gospelgo: Neilunghan jing diu ham Pakai! Nalungset meibang kou jing ding ham?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nalunghanna chu nang na donnom loute chidang namdang holeh naminpan nomloute lenggam hochungah bunglhatan.
en_web: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
en_kjv: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, And upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: chibai naboh lou, nahenga tao lou Namtin vaipi chunga lung hang jon!

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon namite Israelte hi avallhum gamtauvin chuleh gamsung hi gamgem asodohsah tauvin ahi.
en_web: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
en_kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his dwelling place.
tcz_gospelgo: Namite athat gam’un, Nagamsung asumangtauve!

tcz: Kapu kapateu chonset jehin keiho neithep mosah hihbeh un! Nami khotonan gangtah'in kangaichatnu neisuh bulhitpeh un, achutilouleh kakinepnau beiding ahitai.
en_web: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
en_kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: Let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: For we are brought very low.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapu kapateu chonset jal’a Telen matsah sangin, Tun neihepiuvin, Akinemlel gam kahitauve!

tcz: O Pathen Elohim kasochatnau, neipanhu loiyun! namin loupina dingin neipanhuvin, kachonsetnau ngaidam inlang neihuh doh'un namin loupina dingin.
en_web: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
en_kjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: And deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, jabol nachan jingna din Kachonset’u ngaisamin, Neilhatdoh-un, neihuhhingun!

tcz: Ipi dinga chiding namdangte hin eihouset uva “A Pathen u Elohim hoilai a umham?” natisah nahlai dingham? Hiche chiding namdangho chunga naphulahna chu neimusahih in, ajeh chu amahohin nasohte thisan aso u ahi.
en_web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
en_kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? Let him be known among the heathen in our sight By the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
tcz_gospelgo: Ibol’a namtin vaipin, “Hoiba ham na-Pathen?” ati diu ham? Nalhachate thisan so jeh a Namtin vaipi telen namatsah Neimusah tauvin!

tcz: Sohchangho lhasetna hi ngaipehin, thidinga athu kitansa hohi huhdoh inlang nathaneina chu neivet sah'un.
en_web: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
en_kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee, According to the greatness of thy power: Preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
tcz_gospelgo: Tha dia kikoisate, Songkul lute kagin ngaiyin; Nathahat loupitah chun Amaho hi lhadoh-in jalensah tan!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kaheng kakom hon noise tah a nahousetnao hi ajat sagin lethuh tei in.
en_web: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
en_kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, naphin phin a namdangte hi Sagi veijenin lethuh ten!

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiho namite nangailutna ankonga kivah nakelngoiten akhang khangin nang vahchoi ungting, vahchoijing taovinge.
en_web: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
en_kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng, nakelngoihon tobang Namite keihon thangvah jing ung ting, Akhang khanga Nangma Kavahchoi jing diu ahitai!

tcz: O Israel neingaipehun, nangma Joseph chilhahte gancha hon ho banga puihoija kelngoi chin a chingpa. O Elohim Pathen Cherubim chunga laltouna a toupan naloupinavah hoi chu hin kimudoh sah in.
en_web: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
en_kjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ongiyin, Israel kelngoi chin a chinga, Joseph chilhah kelngoihon hoiya hoile Pa! Cherubim chunga touva,

tcz: Ephraim, Benjamin leh Mannaseh chungah hintah langin, nathahatna gimneitah chu neimusah unlang neihung huhdoh tauvin.
en_web: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
en_kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh Stir up thy strength, And come and save us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ephriam, Benjamin chule Manasseh phung hoa hung kiphongin, Thaneo tah-in hungin neihuhhingun!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma komah neihoilutnun, namaivah chun neihin salvah un, chuteng boule huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en_web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
en_kjv: Turn us again, O God, And cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, huhhing kachan na diuvin, Neihepiuvin, neitahsemkit’un!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, phat itihchan gei a kataona sanlou a nakoi dingham?
en_web: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
en_kjv: O Lord God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo, Pakai, thaneipen Pathen! Itih geiya namite taona nalunghan khum ding ham?

tcz: Nangin lungkhamna a ichan gei a neivah uva chuleh khondimset a mitlhi neilonsah diuham?
en_web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
en_kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; And givest them tears to drink in great measure.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh le chah khel’in lungdon neipeuvin, Don ding khel’in mitlhi longin neikoitauve!

tcz: Nangin hengle kom chiding namdangte taitomna neichansah tauvin kagalmi teuvin totnan einei tauve.
en_web: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
en_kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: And our enemies laugh among themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Jet le veiya namtinin gal eibol khumun, Melmaten eiphin phin’uve!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung nangma kom neingatsah un, namaivah chun neisalvah'un chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en_web: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
en_kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, And cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: O thaneipen Pathen, Huhhing kachan theina diuvin Neihepiuvin, neithah semkit’un!

tcz: Nangin lengpiga twi bangin Egyptma kon in neihin puidohun, nangin chiding namdangho nadel mangna nagamsunga neipuilutnu ahi.
en_web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
en_kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: Thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin Lengpiphung nahinpon, Namtin vaipi nadeljamin, Agamsunguva lengpiphung chu naphuttai!

tcz: Nangman keiho ding amun neisuhtheng pehun chuleh hichea chun keiho kajung khouvin gamsung chu kadimset tauve.
en_web: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
en_kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, And didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpiphung phuna din tol nalaiyin, Ajung leigil’a alut’in abah-in gam leiset alosoh tai!

tcz: keiho len molsangho atomjouvin, kabah houvin Cedar thingphung lentah tahho atomjouvin,
en_web: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
en_kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
tcz_gospelgo: Alimin mol le lhang alen, Abahhon cedar thing sangtah tah ho akhui!

tcz: keihon kabah hou lhumlam Mediterranean twikhanglen gei in kathejalun chuleh kajungun Euphrate vadung gei ka thejallun ahi.
en_web: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
en_kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, And her branches unto the river.
tcz_gospelgo: Abahho ajam jamin, Mediterranea Twikhanglen aphan, Euphrates luipi dung geiyin ajam’e!

tcz: Hinla tunvang, kabangu ipi dinga neivoh lhahpeh uva, hilang lampia hinhopa jousen kagao akiguh u hitam?
en_web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
en_kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, So that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
tcz_gospelgo: Idia atho naphat lhah a, Atohkha chanin aga jouse akiguh ham?

tcz: Gammanga kon in ngalchang hangin avallhum in, gamlah ganchahon kivahnan anei un ahi.
en_web: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
en_kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, And the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamvohten achonpeh gamtan, Gamsaten kivahnan aneiyui!

tcz: Hungkile kit in O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung, kahung tao un ahi. Van a konnin neihin veuvin kahahsatnau neihin vetpeh un, hiche lengpigui hi hin khoukhah'in.
en_web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
en_kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, And visit this vine;
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kihei kit’o thaneipen Pathen! Vana konin hinven, namite neihuhhingun!

tcz: Nangma tahin nanatu ahi. Hiche chapa hi nangma tahin nangma dinga nahin khoukhah ahi.
en_web: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
en_kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Naphusa, hiche lengpiphung thah, Hoitah a nakhandohsah hi hinson!

tcz: Ajeh chu keihohi thing banga eikitan bong bonga kagal miteuvin eihal lhah'u ahitai. Nangman navetsah chu amuteng uleh manthahnan juiju hen.
en_web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
en_kjv: It is burnt with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmateuvin ahalgep’un aphuh lhutauve! Lunghan khumin sumang jengin!

tcz: Mihem nangailut nacha nadeilhen chu hatsah-in,
en_web: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
en_kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Natundoh a nahatsah nalhensa namite vang Hoidamin vengtup jingin!

tcz: Chutengleh keihon itihchan injong nanungsun pouvinge. Nei suhal kit un chutileh namin avella kahin koukit theidiu ahi.
en_web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
en_kjv: So will not we go back from thee: Quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakoma konin kihei mangkit tapou vinge, Neihing hoiyun vahchoi jing unge!

tcz: Nangma komlang nei ngatsah kitnun, O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hatchungnung namaivah chun neihin salvah'un, chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en_web: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
en_kjv: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, Cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai thaneipen Pathen! Huhhing kachan theina diuvin Neihepiuvin neithah semkit’un!

tcz: Ei thahatsah u Elohim Pathen thangvahnan la sauvin, Jacob Pathen Elohim vahchoinan la sauvin.
en_web: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
en_kjv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Eipanpi Pathen, Jacob Pathen Vahchoi la othongin sauvin!

tcz: Sauvin! tumging tothon avahchoila sauvin voh gingthei vouvin, semjang kisai ginleh selangdah gin to thouvin,
en_web: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
en_kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.
tcz_gospelgo: Tumging tumin khutbeh bengun, Tumging ngeito thon semjang le Selangsan saiyin vahchoiyun!

tcz: Lhathah janle sumkon mut-uvin lang, lhalih janle lhalih nikhoa golvah bolteng sumkon mut uvin.
en_web: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
en_kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, In the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhathah ni le lhalih nin, Kut bolna din sumkon mut’un!

tcz: Ajeh chu hichehi Israel dinga chondan thupeh ahin Jacob Elohim Pathen thugahsa ahi.
en_web: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
en_kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, And a law of the God of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Israelte lah a Danthu, Jacob Pathen thupeh ahi!

tcz: Egypt gam a kon a ahungdoh uchun Aman Joseph komma hettohsah khat anaphutdoh tai. Keiman kahetchetlou thukhat kajan,
en_web: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
en_kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out through the land of Egypt: Where I heard a language that I understood not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Egypt gam adelkhum chun Hiche dan hi Israelte anapei! Keiman mi kihelou thusei ogin kajan:

tcz: Keiman apohgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih hahsa kathamsah tapoi.
en_web: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
en_kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were delivered from the pots.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman napohgih-u kadom lhan, Chehtum gihtah jouse ka-ngahsah tai.

tcz: Nagimna a kon in neihin kouvin keiman kahuhdohtai. Meivom lhangkhat kiheh chetchut laha kahin houjin, Meribah a twi umloupet in natahsah kapatepjin ahi.
en_web: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
en_kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nagenthei pet’a neikou chun Kanahuhhingtan; Meivom lhangkhal kakiselnaa konin Kahin donbut’e! Meribah twisam phunga jong Kanapatep’in ahi.

tcz: Ngai uvin O kamite, nangho gihna nasatah kapeh pet-hin, Vo Israel kaseihi nangai poupou uleh,
en_web: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
en_kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
tcz_gospelgo: Kahilchahna ngaiphan kamite, Israel, kasei nangai ding kadei lheh-e!

tcz: Nanghon imatihchan ajong gamchom mit pathen koipouvin nate, pathen lhem masanga kun pouvin nate.
en_web: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
en_kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
tcz_gospelgo: Doi semthu nakoi dauva, Houjong nahou thei lou diu ahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Egypt-a kon a nahin puidoh uva Yahweh Pakai na Pathen'u Elohim keima kahi. Nakam hakatnin ka-in keiman thilpha tamtah adimsetna kahin sunlut pehding ahi.
en_web: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
en_kjv: I am the Lord thy God, Which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a kona nahinpuidoh, Pakai na-Pathen chu kahi; Kam kan, an nabah inge!

tcz: Ahinla kamiten angainom pouvin, Israel'in Keima eingaicha pouve.
en_web: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
en_kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; And Israel would none of me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hinla kamiten kasei angaipon, Israel kathua anungpoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Keiman alouchallu dungjuijin amaho deilam lam a chondin kalha kangtai.
en_web: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
en_kjv: So I gave them up unto their own heart’s lust: And they walked in their own counsels.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun along katahsah-in, Adei deiyu kabolsah-e!

tcz: O kamiten kaseihi ngaipou pouleu, O Kamite Israelte hin eijuiju henlang kalampia hin chenom poupouleu!
en_web: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
en_kjv: O that my people had hearkened unto me, And Israel had walked in my ways!
tcz_gospelgo: O kamiten kasei ngai tavuo leh ! Kathua anun diu iti kadei hitam!

tcz: Ichan geija gang in agalmiteu kajopeh tadiuvem! Ichan geija gangtah'in akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kalha tadem!
en_web: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
en_kjv: I should soon have subdued their enemies, And turned my hand against their adversaries.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutileh amelmateu kajoa, Agal jouseu kajopeh ding ahi.

tcz: Koi hile Yahweh Pakai nahsah loute chu a-ang sunga kisuchipdiu atonsotna mahthahdiu ahi.
en_web: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
en_kjv: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: But their time should have endured for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihot bolte kichan ka-anga kun’un tin, Tonsot’a hesoh genthei athoh diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinla keiman nehthei aphapen a kavahding nahin, keiman songpia kon a kimu khoijua kavahdiu nahi.
en_web: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
en_kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: And with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho vang an thuipen kapeh-uva, Gam khoiju jadonsah diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Van a thutan na chunga Elohim Pathen in vai ahomin Van mite chunga athutan na aphondoh e.
en_web: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
en_kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; He judgeth among the gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanmite kikhopna a Pathenin vai ahomin, Pathen mite lailunga thu lhuhna asem’e!

tcz: Nangman itihchan hi miphalouho napanpia thudihlou ho nachelhah sah dingham?
en_web: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
en_kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, And accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ddih louva thutan ngauvin, Agiloute din lang neidauvin!

tcz: “Chaga leh vaichate chungah thudih chepin lang; tahlel tele engbolla umte chungah thudih phongdoh in.
en_web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
en_kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and needy.
tcz_gospelgo: Cahgate panpiuvin, Panpibei, lhasamte phat bol’un!

tcz: Panpi bei tele engbolla umte huhdoh in, miphalouho khut a konin huhdoh-in.
en_web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
en_kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: Rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute khut’a konin Lhasamle geochaote huhsoh-un!

tcz: Hinla mibolse ten imacha ahepouve; ama hokhu hetna lhasam ahiuve. Muthim noi a avah leuvin, leiset sungil lamgei in ahotling tai.
en_web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
en_kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; They walk on in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are out of course.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lungthimbei mi-ngolte! Khosuh khotou helougam nahiuve! Vannoi leiset’a Thudih khatcha aumtapoi!

tcz: Keiman kasei in, ‘Nang ho Pathen nahiuve; nangho hatchungnung chilhah te nahiu ve.
en_web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
en_kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; And all of you are children of the most High.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Chungnungpen chate, Pathen mite nahiuve,’ kati ahi;

tcz: Hinlah nangho mihem tabang bep a nathi diu, thunei vaihom dang ho banga nalhuh tei diu ahi.’”
en_web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
en_kjv: But ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla mihem thia nathiuva, Haosa chajeng jong athibanga nathi diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hung kipatin, O Elohim Pathen vannoi leiset hi athu tannin, ajeh chu chiding namdangho jouse jonghi aboncha nanga ahi.
en_web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
en_kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: For thou shalt inherit all nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen hungin leiset vaipon, Namtin vaipi namite jeng ahiuve.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, thipbeh in umhih'in! Na-ngong in umhih'in. O Pathen Elohim thipsan jeng hih in.
en_web: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
en_kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
tcz_gospelgo: Umthim loujen-o Pathen! Moh umthim hih hel’in!

tcz: Nagalmite cho leng lung khu najahlou ham? Kiletsah tah nagalmiho ahung kipatdoh khu nahet louham?
en_web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
en_kjv: For lo, thine enemies make a tumult: And they that hate thee have lift up the head.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, namelmaten gal ahinbol’un, Nahoten doumah ahinbol tauve!

tcz: Amahon namite douna dingin aguh in thil agong uvin, nangin napanhu mite dounan thilphalou agong uvin ahi.
en_web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
en_kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, And consulted against thy hidden ones.
tcz_gospelgo: Namite dounan guh-in thil agongun, Nahon jingte ahindoutauve!
