tcz: Amahon aseijun “Hungun hiche nam mite hi sumang uhite akitiuve, chutileh Israel hi isuhmit heldiu ahi” atiuve.
en_web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
en_kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hungun, Israel kiphah poh kit louna din, Hiche nam hi sumanghel’u hite,” atiuve.

tcz: Hiche tohgon ahi amaho akinop to uvin nang dounan kiloikhomna khat anei taove.
en_web: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
en_kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: They are confederate against thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang dou din akihoutoh-un, Nadouna thil agongkhom’ui!

tcz: Ama hohi Edom mite, Ishmael mite, Moab mite, Hagrit mite,
en_web: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
en_kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; Of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
tcz_gospelgo: Edomte, Ishmaelte, Moab mite leh Hagar mite;

tcz: Gebal mite, Ammon mite, Amelek mite chuleh Philistine leh Tyre akon mipiho ahiuve.
en_web: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
en_kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; The Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
tcz_gospelgo: Gebal mite, ammonte leh Amalekte, Philistiate leh Tyre mite;

tcz: Assyria miten jong ajopmun ahin, Lot chilhah hoto jong kiloikhom ahiuve.
en_web: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
en_kjv: Assur also is joined with them: They have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Assyria miten jong apanpin, Lot chilhah gal-hang jouse apangkhom’ui!

tcz: Amahohi Midian, Sisera, Jabin mite Kishion vadunga nabol bang bangin boljengin.
en_web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
en_kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
tcz_gospelgo: Midia mite le Kishon luiya Sisera le Jabin nabol bangin bol’in!

tcz: Amaho chu Endor lah nasumang in chuleh atahsa'u monlha chu leiset leipha sosahnan akimang in ahi.
en_web: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
en_kjv: Which perished at En-dor: They became as dung for the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu Endor a nathah’in, Tolgoa atahsau amonsah tai!

tcz: Nang in alamkai hochu Oreb le Zoab nabolna bang in sumang in lang chuleh avaipo ho chu Zebah le Zalmunna nabolna bang in thatdoh tan,
en_web: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
en_kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: Yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
tcz_gospelgo: Alamkaiteu Oreb le Zeeb nabol bangin bol’in, Zebah le Zalmunna najo bangin Avaihomteu jousoh keiyin!

tcz: ajeh chu amahon hitin aseijuve, “eihon hiche Elohim Pathen gam hohi eiho phatchom na dingin lahpeh-u hite” akitiuve.
en_web: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
en_kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves The houses of God in possession.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheho hin, “Pathen gam leiset chu Kilah-ute,” anatiuve.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen amahohi huilah a changvai akithejal bangin thejaltan!
en_web: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
en_kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; As the stubble before the wind.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, abonchauvin Vutvai kithe leh Changpol hui mutmang bahsah-in!

tcz: Meijin gammang ahal bang in chuleh meikong in molle lhang ahal lhah bang in hallha jengin,
en_web: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
en_kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, And as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
tcz_gospelgo: Gamkang kaa molle lhang Lhutvamhel bahsah jengin!

tcz: Huile gon melse tah a adelmang bang in delmang'in, nakhopi huijin kichat sah in,
en_web: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
en_kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, And make them afraid with thy storm.
tcz_gospelgo: Khohui semjamsah-in lang Nahuise lhoh mangsah tan!

tcz: Nasatah in sujumm in O Yahweh Pakai, namin a ahung kipehlut tokah un.
en_web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.
en_kjv: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek thy name, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitjum maijumin lhan, Nathahat hetdoh sah-in!

tcz: Amaho hi tonsotna jum ding leh kicha jing dingin melsetah'in thisah tan.
en_web: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
en_kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; Yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
tcz_gospelgo: Aitih-in kiphatlam le meidoiyin um’u hen, Jumle jan thigamu hen!

tcz: Hiteng chuleh amahon nangbou hi Hatchungnung leiset chunga thunei chungnung nahi hi hin hetau vinte.
en_web: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
en_kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, Art the most High over all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a vaihom chungnungpen, Pakai nangbou nahi heu hen!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nahou in hi iti kangailut hitam?
en_web: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
en_kjv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!
tcz_gospelgo: O thaneipen Pakai! Nahouin theng dei le ngai aumin;

tcz: Hiche a chu iti kaum nom hitam! Yahweh Pakai Hou inn chu kangaicha lheh jenge, kahina apumpin hingjing Elohim Pathen ah kakipana lan sange.
en_web: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
en_kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: My heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chua lhah ding kanom’e! Pakai Houin ka-ngaiyin, Kahinkho pumpin hing jing Pathen ah Kipa la kasai!

tcz: Inva jengin jong abuh akisah in, chuleh pengpalep injong intum akison e. Vo Yahweh Pakai hat chungnung, kalengpa le ka Pathen Elohim! Vachan jong namaicham kom a anou kicholdo nading abuh akisem ahi.
en_web: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
en_kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.
tcz_gospelgo: O thaneipen Pakai, Kalengpa le ka-Pathen! Nahouin a vatoute le pelpalep jengin jong Bu asauvin, namaicham phung vel’a nou a-op’ui!

tcz: Nahou inn'a chenghon ichangei a hinkho nopna anei'u hitam phat tin in nangma vahchoila asauve.
en_web: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
en_kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin apansaa, Navahchoi la sajingte anun nom’ui!

tcz: Athahatna Yahweh Pakai a kon a kimuho hinkho iti nop a hitam, alungsungun Jerusalem'ah akholjing jengun ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
en_kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the ways of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion jon a kijot’a, Nathahat’a kisongte anun nom’ui!

tcz: Beca phaicham ajot tengu jongle, twisam putna twinah tampi umna bangin abol'un, gotwi hunglha masapen in jong twikul tampi ahinsemdoh pehjiuve.
en_web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
en_kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; The rain also filleth the pools.
tcz_gospelgo: Kana Baca phaicham jot jong leu, Go masan twikul adipsoh a Kipana twisam phung ho tobang ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho akalson chan uva ahetbe cheh chehjingdiu ahin, amahon Jerusalem a Yahweh Pakai chu amudiu ahi.
en_web: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
en_kjv: They go from strength to strength, Every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
tcz_gospelgo: Akijot nauva ahat cheh cheh-un, Zion a Van mite Pathen chu Agamu tei diu ahitai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Ka Pathen Elohim hatchungnung kataona neingaipeh'in, O Jacob Elohim Pathen.
en_web: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
en_kjv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai thaneipen Pathen! Kataona ngaiyin lang, O Jacob Pathen! Neihouvin!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen kalengpauhi phatthei boh'in, amahi kaluum u ahi, nathaonusa nalhen pahi khotona musah jingin.
en_web: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
en_kjv: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, nathaonusa Kalengpau hi phatthei boh-in!

tcz: Munchom a ni sangkhat umsangin na Houin a nikhat um aphajoi. Miphalou inna chen sangin ka Pathen Elohim inn'a kotngah a pan aphajoi.
en_web: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
en_kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Mundanga ni sangkhat um sangin, Nahouina nikhat um aphajoi! Migiloute innom a chen sangin, Ka-Pathen inpi kotnga kanomjoi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hi eiho dia nisa le umpho ahi. Aman khoto nale loupina eipeuvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai in thildih jeng bol mihoa kon in thilpha alamang pon ahi.
en_web: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
en_kjv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: The Lord will give grace and glory: No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu eihoidam’uva, leng loupe, Jabolna le hepina vang eiboh pau ahi! Aman thildih bolte din Thilpha a-itpeh khah poi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nangma tahsan mihohi iti kipa um a hitam?
en_web: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
en_kjv: O Lord of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O thaneipen Pakai, Nanga ki-ngai jingte anun nom’ui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nagamsung'ah phatthei bohna nasunglhan ahi! Hiti chun nangin Israel phatthei naboh'in ahi.
en_web: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
en_kjv: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nagamsung nahepin, Israel nahaosah kittai!

tcz: Nangman namite chonsetna nangaidam in hichun achonsetnau jouse nalekhu peh e.
en_web: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
en_kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, Thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Namite toh khel jouse nachulnamin, Achonset chengseu na-ngaidamtai!

tcz: Nangin na lunghan na natuh tang'in, nalung hanna deujah jengchu naki kham jie.
en_web: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
en_kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: Thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
tcz_gospelgo: Achunguva lungsat nahaiyin, Nalunghan na-ngatai!

tcz: Ei suhal kit uvin, eihuhhingpau O Pathen Elohim! kachung uva nalunghan na tolmang kittan.
en_web: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
en_kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine anger towards us to cease.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Eihuhhingu Pathen, Neilungdamun neithahsem’uvin!

tcz: Kachung uva nalunghan jing jeng dingham? Nalung hanna khang jouse chung naumsah jing jengding hitam?
en_web: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
en_kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
tcz_gospelgo: Neilunghan jinguva, Lungdam louhel dng nahin?

tcz: Nei suhhal kit loudiu hitam? Namite kipa le thanom a aumjing thei nading a.
en_web: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
en_kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: That thy people may rejoice in thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Neihatsah kitleu chun, Namiten vahchoi ki tnau vinge!

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou chu neimu sah'in nami huhhing najong neipe uvin.
en_web: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.
en_kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, And grant us thy salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, longlouvin neilungset’un, Neipenpin neihuhhinguvin!

tcz: Elohim na Pathen chun ipi asei am, chingthei tah'in ngai in ajeh chu Aman mi kitah ho kom ah chamna thu asei e. Ahinla amaho angolna lampi uvah kilekit dahen.
en_web: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
en_kjv: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathen houlim ka-ngaiyin, Chonset ibol kit dau leh, Amite eiho chunga Cham leng din aseiye!

tcz: Tahbeh'in Ama gingte dingin huhing na naicha um a ahi. Chuti leh igamsung u jong aloupina dimding ahi.
en_web: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
en_kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; That glory may dwell in our land.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama jabolte huhhing nom jing, Huhhing dia igam’uva um jing ding ahi!

tcz: Ngailutna longlou leh thutah akimuto'in chonphat nale chamna akichopto lhon e.
en_web: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
en_kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailut le kitahna kilamtoa, Adidh le chamna kikoi ding ahi!

tcz: Kitah nahi leiset a kon a hungdoh ahi. Chuleh chonphatna chu van'a kon a mai lhaisel'a hung kumlha ahi.
en_web: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
en_kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; And righteousness shall look down from heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a kona gunchuna kitungdoh a Van a kona adih kikhai lha ding ahi.

tcz: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in phatthei boh hi ahin lonlhahsah ahin gam leiset a hi ninglhing tah'a ahin gadoh sah'a ikisan ji u ahi.
en_web: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
en_kjv: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; And our land shall yield her increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eihaosah diu Gamga pungding ahi.

tcz: Chonphat nahin Yahweh Pakai hung nading semtoh nading nikho asap masat ji ahi.
en_web: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
en_kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; And shall set us in the way of his steps.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih masantin, Pakai lampi anasem ding ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hung kisunem'in lang kataona neingai peh'in, neidonbut in ajeh chu napanpi ngaicha jing kahi.
en_web: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
en_kjv: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: For I am poor and needy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyin Pakai neihouvin! Lhasam le geo chaovin ka-um’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nanga dinga kiphaldoh jing kahi neihuhdoh'in ajeh chu nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahin, keima hi nakinbol kahin chuleh nangma hi katansan jingin ahi.
en_web: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
en_kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhingin nadia lepthol bei kahi, Nanga ki-ngai nalhacha kahi neihuhhingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami khotona neimusah jingin ajeh chu keiman Nangmahi ka koujing nahi.
en_web: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
en_kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: For I cry unto thee daily.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihepin ka-Pathen nahi, Nilhum lhumin nahenga kataove!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kipana neimusah jingin ajeh chu keimahi Nangkoma kiphaldoh jing kahi.
en_web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
en_kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona naheng ahunglhung tai, O Pakai nalhacha neikipahsah-in!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi naphatna jalla eingaidam jing nahi, nakomma panpi ngaichaho dinga longlou ngailutna dimsah nahi.
en_web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
en_kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; And plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Neibol phauvin nei-ngaidam’ui, Nahenga taote dia lungset chamkim nahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kataonahi khotonan neingaipeh'in gangtah a kap kahi neingaipehin.
en_web: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
en_kjv: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona nagiyin O-Pakai! Neihouvin panpi ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Kahahsat channa nangma kakouding ahin nangin neidonbut jingding ahi.
en_web: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
en_kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: For thou wilt answer me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihouji jeh-in, Kagim nin Nangma kakouve!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen! Semthu pathen ho nang tobang khatcha aumpoi, nabolthei ho bolthei jong aumpoi.
en_web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
en_kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; Neither are there any works like unto thy works.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai Nang tobang Pathen dang aumpon, Nabol tobang bol’a khatcha aumpoi!

tcz: Naemsa chitin namtin ho jong na ang a hungdiu chibai naboh cheh diu ahi Yahweh Pakai; amahon na mintheng avahchoi diu ahi.
en_web: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
en_kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come And worship before thee, O Lord; And shall glorify thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasemsa namtin vaipi nahenga kun cheh diu, Namin achoi-at diu ahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma bou Elohim Pathen nahin naloupin, nangin bou thil loupiho naboldoh jin ahi.
en_web: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
en_kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.
tcz_gospelgo: Thahat tah, thil loupe pi boldoh, Nangbou Pathen nahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, na lampiho neihil in, nathudih dung jui a hinkho kaman theina dingin, nangma loupina kadopsang jingna dingin lungtheng neipen.
en_web: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
en_kjv: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Neibolsh nom neihil’in Pakai, Nathu ngai molsonge! Lung sa-ih louhel’a Nakin bolje naihil’in!

tcz: O Yahweh ka Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen! kalungthim pumpin nangma nathangvah ingkate, phattin'in naloupina domsang jing tange.
en_web: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
en_kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: And I will glorify thy name for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathen, kalungthim pumpin vahchoiying ting, Nalal loupina tonsot Tonsot’in phongjal lenge!

tcz: Ajeh chu nei ngailut na hi akidange. Nangman thina kulkhuh a kon in nei huhdoh tai
en_web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
en_kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Neingailutna aloupi ngeiye! Thina lhankhuh geisa neichohing tai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai mijumso hatho keima dounan ahung ding doh un; misunoh phah a pang hon thading eigouve. Amahon nangma hi imachan nagel pouve.
en_web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
en_kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, And the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; And have not set thee before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, ija nagel lou, Mi kiletsah engse loiyin tha din eidel khum’ui!

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai Nangma hi khoto naleh ngailutna nei Elohim Pathen nahin lunghang vahlou chuleh kitahna leh tang theilou lungsetna dim a nahi.
en_web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
en_kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, Longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Nang vang hepi le ngailut them, Thoh hat jing, khoto them katah tah nahi!

tcz: Nami lungsetna chun noilang hinven lang nasoh hi tha neipen, nasohpa chapa kahi neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
en_kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thine handmaid.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kiheiyin neilungset’in, kanu banga nakinbol kahi; Neihatsah-in neihuhhingin!

tcz: Nei hepina melchih na chu hin tahlang'in chutileh eivetda hohin jumna amudiu ahi. O Yahweh Pakai neipanpin nei lungmonsah jingin.
en_web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
en_kjv: Shew me a token for good; That they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: Because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahot bolte jumsona din, Naphatje neimusah-in Pakai! Neipanpia neilhamon amu tengu jahchau hen!

tcz: Moltheng chunga chun Yahweh Pakai tundohsa khopi chu aum e.
en_web: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
en_kjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhang theng chunga Pakaiyin akhopi aphutdoh-e!

tcz: Aman Jerusalem khopi hi Israel khopi dangho sangin angailu joi.
en_web: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
en_kjv: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte khopi dang sangin, Pakaiyin Jerusalem akhohsah-e!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen khopi, nangma chungchang ahi itibang thuloupi tahtah kisei a hitam!
en_web: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
en_kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen khopi! Nachung thu loupin akiseiye!

tcz: Keima eiheho lah'a hin, Egypt le Babylon chule Philistine leh Tyre chuleh gamlha tah Ethiopia jong kasimtha e. Amaho hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove.
en_web: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
en_kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: Behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; This man was born there.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kathu ngai nam mite lah a, Egypt le Babylon kisim than; Jerusalem tolkon lah a Philistiate, Tyre mite le Sudante kasim thai,” ati.

tcz: Jerusalem chungchang a hitiahi kisei ding ahi, “amijousen nammi hina a thaneina chu akipapi cheh uve”, chule hatchungnung ama tah in khopi chu phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
en_kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: And the Highest himself shall establish her.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion thudol’a vang, Hatchungnungin phutdet’in tin, Namtin vaipi kikhol diu ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chitin namtin hi ajihlut teng, aseiding, “amaho jouse hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove” atiding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
en_kjv: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, That this man was born there. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin namtin vaipi asimtoh a, Abonchauva Jerusalem Khosung mia asim didng ahi.

tcz: Mipi hochun theile amut'uva la asahdiu, “Kahinkho hung kipat nahi Jerusalem ahi” atidiu ahi.
en_web: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
en_kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: All my springs are in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon,” I-phatheina jouseu Zion a hungkon ahi,” tia Lam’uva la asah diu ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, eihuhhing'a ka Pathen Elohim, sunleh nangma kakou in, jan leh nakom kahin nailut ji e.
en_web: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
en_kjv: O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
tcz_gospelgo: O Eihuhhinga Pakai Pathen! Sun nilhum jan khovah-in na-anga kakap’e!

tcz: Tun kakouna neijah peh'in lang katona neisan peh'in.
en_web: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
en_kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: Incline thine ear unto my cry;
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin lang, Panpi ngaicha kakagin ngaiyin!

tcz: Ajeh chu kahin khohi boina adim in, thinan eikainai chehcheh e.
en_web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
en_kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: And my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
tcz_gospelgo: Gentheina ten eibomin, Thipai ding kahitai!

tcz: Athisa bang bep kahitai, mithahat tah khat athahat na bei nungsang bep kahitai.
en_web: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
en_kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
tcz_gospelgo: Alaichat chat ho kabangin, Thabei pai ding kahitai!

tcz: Amahon mithi lah'a eidalha uvin lhan ah mithi lup'in kalum e. Keima hi suhmil in kaum tai, nami kaihoina a kon in eiki lamang tai.
en_web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
en_kjv: Free among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more: And they are cut off from thy hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Don louva thilong lah a kijam, Thasaa lhankhuh a lum tobang kahi; Napanhu phah lou, Nasuhmilsa ho tobang kahi!

tcz: Nang in kotong noinung pen athim pen ah neison lha e.
en_web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
en_kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In darkness, in the deeps.
tcz_gospelgo: Kochong tong lai thimsung, Lhankhuh sunga neileh lut tai!

tcz: Nalung han na gihtah chun eidelphan, hichu twi kinong bangin akinong'in eichup tai.
en_web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
en_kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Neilunghan anasa behseh jengin, Natwipi kidil’in eichup tai!

tcz: Keima hi doumah in neisem in kagol kapai ho neidelmang peh gamtai. Keima hi thang'ah ka-oh in kitoldoh theilouvin kaum e.
en_web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
en_kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagolte neidalhah sah tan, Avetda dauvin neisemin, kikul khup’a jamdoh thei lou kahitai!

tcz: Kamit lhin kamit achupmin kho muthei louvin kaum e. O Yahweh Pakai niseh'in na panpina kathum in nami lungsetna ngaichan kakhut teni kahin sange.
en_web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.
en_kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gimin kamit athimlon, Niseh-in kakoujin, Nangma sangin kataove Pakai!

tcz: Nathil kidang bol hohi mithi dinga phachom ding hinam? Mithi hungthodoh a nathangvah theiding hinam?
en_web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
en_kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? Shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilong damsa hi thil kidang bolpeh le chun, Thoudoh a navahchoi diu hinam?

tcz: Lhankhuh a kon in amahon nami ngailutna longlou hi ahin phongdoh theina diuvem? Suhmangna mun'a umhon nakitah nahi aphongdoh theina diuvem?
en_web: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
en_kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in destruction?
tcz_gospelgo: Lhan’a lumsa nalungset long lou seiya, Manthahna geisan nakitahna aseimong-um?

tcz: Muthim'in nathilbol kidang hohi aseiphong nadiuvem? Thil suhmil delna gama umhon na chonphat na hochu aseiphong theina diuvem?
en_web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
en_kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim gama thil kidang nabol amu’uva, Ihmut milna gama naphatna kihedoh nam?

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kakouve, niseh-a nakom a katao jingding ahi.
en_web: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
en_kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; And in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, napanpi ngeh-in, Jingkah she-in nahenga kataove!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ibolla kei nei paidoh hitam? Ibol a kei a kon a naki heimang hitam?
en_web: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
en_kjv: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai idia neidonda a, Velouva kiheimang nahim?

tcz: Kakhang don lai a pat a, kanatna hin thina komcha eina lhutsa ahitan, nagim neina masanga hin thabei leh lungkham tah'in kading e.
en_web: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
en_kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaneocha lhah gim genthei kathoh-in, Thi ding konchan ka-um jinge; Neigimbolna cheng kathoh na a Apang joulou kahitai!

tcz: Nalunghan na tijat umtah chun eilonvuh'in, tijat naumna chun eithabei sah e.
en_web: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
en_kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalunghan kadimtan, Neibolgimnaa mangthah pai ding kahi!

tcz: Hiche hochun sun nilhum in twisoh bangin kavel a eilon khum un ahi. Muthimhi kakinai pipen kagol in apang un ahi.
en_web: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
en_kjv: They came round about me daily like water; They compassed me about together.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hin twibang eichup nilhum lhumin, Jet le veiya eiumchah soh tai!

tcz: Nang man ka mite le ka ngailut cheng neilahpeh tai, Thimjing hi kaki naipi pen ka loi chu ahi tai.
en_web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
en_kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagol ngaitah tah jong neidalhah sah ten, Muthimlah a kalengtai!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai mingailutna longlou thuhi vahchoilan sajing tange, khangdong hole tehse hon nakitahna hi ajauvin ahi.
en_web: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
en_kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nalungset long lou Tonsot jailan oiying ting; Nakitahna hi itih-in Phongjal lenge!

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou hi itih hijongleh umjing ding ahi. Nakitah nahi vanho bangin aumjinge.
en_web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
en_kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: Thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset beitih neilou kahen, Nakitahn avan banga kidal jing ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hitin asei e “kalhendoh kasohpa David toh kitepna kanabol ahi. Hiche kitepna a hi kana kihahsel ahi.
en_web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
en_kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin, “kadeilhen mitoh kitepna kasemin, kalhacha David henga kakitep’in;

tcz: Keiman nachilhahte chu lenga katun jingding ahi. Amaho nalaltouna a chu tuapat tonsot gei a toujingdiu ahi.”
en_web: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
en_kjv: Thy seed will I stablish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Nachilhah khat leng chang jing ding, Nalengvai neina koipeh jing ding kahi,’ tin,” naseiye.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai van mite jousen nakidan nahohi navahchoi diu ahi. Nakitahna ho jeh'a hi simjoulou vantilten navahchoi diu ahi.
en_web: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
en_kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: Thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, thil kidang nabol ho Vanin lan asan; Nakitahna jalan a-oiyui!

tcz: Ajeh chu van gam a umho jouse koipen tah hi Yahweh Pakai toh tekah thei umbeh am? Vantil thupipen ho jengjong Yahweh Pakai toh tekah pithei um'am?
en_web: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,
en_kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? Who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?
tcz_gospelgo: Vana jong natobang aumpoi Pakai, Van mite khatcha jong Nangto kibang aumpouve!

tcz: Vantil thaneipen hojong Elohim Pathen ang'a kithing thinga ahibouve. Amahi alaltouna vel a dingho jousen jong agimnei na aphapouve.
en_web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
en_kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, And to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
tcz_gospelgo: Van mithengte kikhopna kijapen nahin, Nang gin nan adding cheh-ui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung sepai ho! Hoilai mun a nang tobanga thanei a umbeh am Yahweh Pakai? Nanghi kitahna lhingset nahi.
en_web: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.
en_kjv: O Lord God of hosts, Who is a strong Lord like unto thee? Or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thaneipen Pathen, Nahat kibahpi aumpon; Ijakaiya kitahpen nahi Pakai!

tcz: Twikhanglen jong nathanei na noia umma ahi. Nangin huipi le twipi kithoa twi kinong jong nasutang'in,
en_web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
en_kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen huneitah chunga vai nahomin, Twipi kinong lai naphoh thip jie!

tcz: twikhanglen'a um sa lenpen hojong na sugep in, Naban thahat in nagal mite jong nahocheh jitai.
en_web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
en_kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
tcz_gospelgo: Gul- lhempi Rahab nachilgoiyin, Naban thahat’in namelmate najoutai!

tcz: Vanho jouse jong nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi, vannoi a um thiljouse jong aboncha nanga ahin nangin nasem ahi.
en_web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
en_kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: As for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
tcz_gospelgo: Van la nanga, leiset jong nanga; Vannoi le asunga um jouse nasemsa ahi.

tcz: Nangin sahlang lhanglang jong nasem ahin, Tabor Mol leh Hermon mol'in jong naming athangvah ahi.
en_web: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
en_kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Sah le lhang nasemin, Tabor lhangle Hermon mol’in nahenga kipa la asai!

tcz: Nabantha hi iti hat hitam! Nakhut hi iti hat hitam! Najetlang jonghi nathahat loupitah'in adomsange.
en_web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
en_kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhut tha aham lheh-in, Naban-gol tha ahat’e!

tcz: Chonphat nale thudih chu nalaltouna khombul ahi. Longlou ngailutna le kitahna chu nalhachate bangin na ang sungah avahlen ahi.
en_web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
en_kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: Mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalaltouna adih le kitahna chunga akidon, Natohna chan a ngailut le kitahna akimui!

tcz: Elohim Pathen houna dinga kipa umtah kouna jaho chu anunnom ahiuve, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai amahohi na umpina vah a chu lhalediu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
en_kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, namaivah a vah lea, Kipa la sa chibai nabohte anun nom’ui!

tcz: Naminthan na kidangtah hohi amahon nilhum kei keija akipapi diu ahi. Amahon nachon phatna hi akithang atpiu vin ahi.
en_web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
en_kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: And in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Naphatna avahchoiyun, Nilhum lhumin nachunga akipah-ui!

tcz: Nangma hi amaho dinga thahatna loupitah chu nahi. Keiho thahat sah dinghi nangma kipana ahi.
en_web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
en_kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: And in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Minthangtah tah-in gal neijosah-un, Neingailut jal’un hanla neisah sah-ui!

tcz: Ahi, keiho hoidohna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon ahi. Chuleh Israel Elohim Pathen hin lengjong eipeh u ahi.
en_web: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
en_kjv: For the Lord is our defence; And the Holy One of Israel is our king.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, eihoidam diu nalhengdoh-in, Vo Israel Pathen theng, kalengpau napansah-e!

tcz: Masang lai in kitah tah a nangma jui namipite lah-a gaothu nana seijin ahi. Nangin nasei in, Keiman galsat ding kanalhengdoh'in keiman milhamho lah a kona lengding jong kanalhendoh ahi.
en_web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
en_kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Malaiyin nalhacha tahsan umte gaochannaa, “Sepai minthang khat kapanpin, Mipi lah a kalhendoh Mikhat chu laltona kapei,

tcz: Keiman kasoh David kana mudoh'in chuleh kathaotheng kana nun ahi.
en_web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
en_kjv: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:
tcz_gospelgo: Kalhacha David chu thao theng kanun, lengin katungdoh tai.

tcz: Keiman kakhut a kana dindoh sah a, kaban thahatna kahatdoh sahding ahi.
en_web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
en_kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaban thahat’a katuh jinga, kaban-gol tha kapeh ding ahi.

tcz: Agal miten ajoloudiu ahilouleh miphalou honjong athajou loudiu ahi.
en_web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
en_kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmaten adou joulouhel ding, Migilouten jong jouponte!

tcz: Keiman akidoupi hohi amasang tah a kasuhlhuh ding ahin chuleh ama douho jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
en_kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, And plague them that hate him.
tcz_gospelgo: Agalte kasuhgep’a, Ahotbol chan katha ding ahi.

tcz: Kakitahna leh kangailutna longlou hin aumpi jingding kathuneina jalla amahi atha kahatsah jingding ahi.
en_web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
en_kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: And in my name shall his horn be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngailut’a adia kakitah jing ding, Gal kajosah jing ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman twikhanglen chunga jong athaneina kalhunlut ding vadungho chung jenga jong vai ahomding ahi.
en_web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
en_kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, And his right hand in the rivers.
tcz_gospelgo: Alenggam Mediterranea Twilen apat Euphrates luipi geiya kakeh let ding ahi.

tcz: Chutengleh aman eihin kou intin, “Nangma kapa nahin ka Pathen Elohim, kasongpi le kasochatna nahi” atiding ahi.
en_web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
en_kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman kajah a, ‘Kapa le ka-Pathen, Eihoidama le Eihuhhingpa nahi,’ tinte.

tcz: Keiman Amahi kachapa masapen, leiset chunga leng thaneipen kahisah ding,
en_web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
en_kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, Higher than the kings of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa masapena kaneiya, Leng jouse sanga kachoi sang ding ahi.

tcz: Kangailut ding chuleh tonsot gei a kakhoto ding, amatoh kaki tepna hi angahtih umlouding ahi.
en_web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
en_kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, And my covenant shall stand fast with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Adin kakitepna nit jing ing ting, kakiteppina tonsot’a um ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman ama dinga ason apah ho kahoibit pehding, vangam'a nikhon beitih aneilou banga alaltounan jong beitih aneilouding ahi.
en_web: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
en_kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Alengvai neina Vanthamjol um jing bang ding, Achilhah khat leng chang jing ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah achilhahten kathuhil hohi apaidoh uva, kachedan hi ajuilou uva,
en_web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
en_kjv: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in my judgments;
tcz_gospelgo: “Achilhahten ka-Danthu anitdauva, Kathupeh ho banga chon lou,

tcz: ka Dan semhohi anit lou uva chuleh kathupeh hi angailou uleh,
en_web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
en_kjv: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;
tcz_gospelgo: Kahilchahna cheng nahsah moa, Kathupeh chengse anitdau vangleh,

tcz: keiman achonsetnao chunga gambol na mol kalap ding, chuleh athungailou naojeh-a kavoh diu ahi.
en_web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
en_kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonsetnau jeh a talen kapeh a, Abol khel jal’uva genthei kathohsah ding ahi.

tcz: Hijeng jongle kangailutna chu beideh louding kakitepna jong achunga kasuhmil deh louding ahi.
en_web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
en_kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
tcz_gospelgo: David vang kangailut jinga, Adia kakitepna kanit jing ding ahi.

tcz: Ahipoi, kakitepna chu kasuhkeh louding ahi; keiman kana seidoh saho chu changkhat jong kanung lahdoh louding ahi.
en_web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
en_kjv: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiteppina palkeh pong ting, Kateppeh khatcha bolda ponge!

tcz: Keiman David kommah kihahselna khat kana nei in chule atheng kahi jeh in jou seiponge.
en_web: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
en_kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness That I will not lie unto David.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamitheng pan itih a dia kitepsa kahitan, David joulhep ponge!

tcz: Ama chilhahte itihchan hijongleh chelha jingding alenggam jong nisa banga chelhumding ahi.
en_web: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
en_kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ason apah um jing ding, Ni le lha umlaisea alenggam kavettup jing ding ahi.

tcz: Vantham jolla kahettohsah nachu lhavah banga kikheltih aneitah louding ahi.
en_web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
en_kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a hettohsah phatseh a kanei, Lha banga alenggam um jing ding ahi,” nati.

tcz: Ahinlah nangin tuhin amachu nakahdoh tan chuleh napaidoh tai. Tuhin Nangma nathaonu lengpa chungah nalunghang tan,
en_web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
en_kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunla nalhentum lengpa nalunghan khumin, Donlouvin napaidoh tai!

tcz: nangin Ama toh nakitepna napaidohtan, nangin alal lukhuh jong vutvai lah-a nasep lhatai.
en_web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
en_kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha toh kitepna nasukeh-in, Alallukhuh vutbol lah a nasep luttai!

tcz: Nangin akhopiu bangho navohlhah pehtan chuleh akulpiu jong khogem nasodohsah ahitai.
en_web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
en_kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhopi pal jouse naloilhun, akulpi abonchan naloiphei!

tcz: Koi hileh ahin hopa jousen athilkeu u akichomgam hellun aheng akomho jousen anuisat'un ahi.
en_web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
en_kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: He is a reproach to his neighbours.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajotpa chanin athilkeo akiguh-un, Aheng akom jousen anuisat’ui!

tcz: Nangin agal miteu galjona namusahin, abonchauvin nakipasah'in ahi.
en_web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
en_kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Agalte najosah tan, Agalte kipah thanomin naumsah-e!

tcz: Nangin agal manchah u manmo naso'in chuleh galmunnah gal nalelsah'in ahi.
en_web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
en_kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Agal manchah jouse manmo nason, Galmuna gal nalelsah tai!

tcz: Nangin aleng tenggol nalahpehin chuleh alaltouna tolsenan naneipeh in ahi.
en_web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
en_kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Aleng tenggol nasat lhan, Alaltouna toljepnan naneiye!

tcz: Nangin aphat achang louvin natehset sah'in chuleh jumthet in nalhan ahi.
en_web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
en_kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Gollhang manlouvin nalhan, Jumle ja thoh-in nakoiye!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma hi hitiahi kisel jing jingding nahi hitam? Ichangei nalunghanna meikong jing jeng dingham?
en_web: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
en_kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? Shall thy wrath burn like fire?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nakisel thip beh ding hitam? Itih chan nalungsat meibanga kou jing ding ham?

tcz: Kahinkho hi itihchom a hitam geldoh'in, keihohi thitei dinga neisem'u ahi ti geldoh'in!
en_web: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
en_kjv: Remember how short my time is: Wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho chomdan geldoh-in Pakai! Ngaiton, thi theiya neisem cheh-u ahime!

tcz: Mihing koihi athi theilou ding um'am? Mihem koipen ham lhan a kon a ahoidohthei dingah?
en_web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
en_kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? Shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Thi lou ding koima aumpon, Lhana kivui lou didng jong aumpoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tumasanga neingailutnau chu ahet theina mudohthei ipi umam? David komma nakitepna hohi hoilang geija hitam?
en_web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
en_kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga neingailut nau hoiham Pakai? David dia nakitepna ho hoiba ham?

tcz: Nasohpa keimahi ichan gei a jumna kato hitam? Hiche nangma hedohlou mitehin eisapsetnau ichan gei a kathoh hitam?
en_web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
en_kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nalhachapa eiphin nau, Melmate gaosap kathoh hi gel jingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nadeilhen nalengpa hi nangma dou miten nahsah loutah'in abollun ahi! Achena chan a asujum un ahi.
en_web: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
en_kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhentum lengpa aphinseuve Pakai! Achena chana aphin phin jengui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umjing jenghen! Amen, Amen!
en_web: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’in Pakai vahchoiyin um hen! Amen! Amen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, akhang khanga nangmahi kachennao inn nahijenge!
en_web: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
en_kjv: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, akhang khanga Kakiselnau kulpi nahi!

tcz: Moul le lhang ho pen masang, vannoi le leiset hi natundoh masangin, thiljoue kipat a pat ajo na chen in jong, nang ma Elohim Pathen nahijing e.
en_web: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
en_kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi naphudoh a mol le lhang nasem maa jong, umjingsa Pathen, um jing ding Pathen nahi!

tcz: Nangin mihemhi anahina masa-a kile kitding'in nasollin leivui nalesosah kitjin ahi.
en_web: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
en_kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin mihem akisemna kile kit’a, Leivui nungso kit dingin naseiye!

tcz: Nangdin Kum sangkhat jeng jonghi achejing tunikho bangbep ahin, jan phat chomcha tobang bou ahi.
en_web: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
en_kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang din kum sang jong hi Nikhat bep ahin; Janhi kitolmangloi bep, Jan mangkal khat bep ahi!

tcz: Nangin twisoh bangin neilhohmang jiuvin mang sangin asot jodeh poi. Keihohi hampa jingkah langa hung pahdoh tobang bou kahiuve.
en_web: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
en_kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisoh milhoh bangin neilhoh mangun, Jan mangkal khat bep bou kahiuve! Jingkah daitwiya Hamdong noudoh bep kahiuve!

tcz: Hichu akhangdoh loijin ahinla nilhah langle agop lhajin athijitai.
en_web: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
en_kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhangdoh loiyin apah-in, Nilhah lam teng agop jin athijitai!

tcz: Keihohi nangma lunghan nan eisumang jitauvin chuleh nalung satnan eikichatsah'un ahi.
en_web: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
en_kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, And by thy wrath are we troubled.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalunghanin kamagnthah tauvin, Nalungsat’in kakihot lhul tauve!

tcz: Nangin kachonsetnao namasangah natahlang jin ahi, aguh a kachonset nauhi nakilandoh sahjin ahi.
en_web: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
en_kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonsetnau nave jingin, Guh thima kasetna jouseu namu jinge!

tcz: Nalungsat na noi a higjing kahinkhou ahin, kakumkhou jong lungsat nan abeiloi jitai.
en_web: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
en_kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We spend our years as a tale that is told.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalunghanin kahinkhou achomlon, Hai khat’in abeiji tai!

tcz: Kei hohi kum 70 hingding bep kahiuvin, kahat tah'uleh kum 80 bep hingding kahiuve, ahinla hiche sunga chun natna le boina bou ahin; amang loiji taovin, chule keiho kaleng mang taove.
en_web: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
en_kjv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; And if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, Yet is their strength labour and sorrow; For it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum somsagi bep kahing jiuvin, Damthei lheh jongleur, Kum somget bang bou kahingui! Kahin laiyun chol le nangin ka-umun, Hinkho alhing loi jin, kabeipaitauve!

tcz: Nalunghanna thahat koiham ahe thei dingah? Naging a nalungsat khohje gelkhoh a koi ham?
en_web: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
en_kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? Even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalunghan khohje hea koi hiya, Nalungsat’in itobang kichatna ahin lhut ding kon hem?

tcz: Kachih theina diuvin kahinkhou chomdan hi neihetsah taovin.
en_web: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
en_kjv: So teach us to number our days, That we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachih theina diuvin, kahinkho chomjeu neihil’un!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kaheng lam uva hung kile kit tan! Itihchan neikho ngai diu hitam?
en_web: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
en_kjv: Return, O Lord, how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih chan neilung han diu ham? O Pakai, nalhachate neikhotaouvin!

tcz: Jingkah seh le nalungset longlou chun kalungthim kipasah in, chutile kahinkhou lhumkei a navah choi la kasha jing diu ahi.
en_web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
en_kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho lhum’uva kipa nopla sa din, Jing khovah she leh long louvin neilungset’un!

tcz: Hesoh genthei kana thoh hou chuga kon in lunglhai na themkhat beh nei peu vin! Kakhoisat nao kumho jong kipana neisoh doh peh un.
en_web: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
en_kjv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Gentheina kum sunga neigimsahna jat mauvin, Kipan thanomin neilhauvin!

tcz: Nasohte hi nathilbol kidangtah hochu neimusah'un; kachilhah teuvin nathaneina loupitah chu mu uhen.
en_web: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
en_kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory unto their children.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathilbol nasatah ho nalhachate neimusah-un; Nathahat loupi chu kachateu musah-in!

tcz: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim un namalsom nauchu eimu sah uhen lang katohna jouseuvah lolhinna eipetao hen. Henge, katoh gao neiso peh un.
en_web: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
en_kjv: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ka-Pathenu, phatthei neiboh-un; Kabolchan neilo lhinsah-un!

tcz: Chungnungpen cholngah na noi a um chan chun hatchungnung lhalim noi a choldo na amu ding ahi.
en_web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
en_kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Chungnungpen Pakai kulsunga lut’a, Hatchungnung limdam noiya kisel chun

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chungchang a hiche hi kaphong e: Ama bou eivengbit ahin, kahoidam na mun ahi; Amachu ka Pathen Elohim ahin, keiman ama katah san e.
en_web: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
en_kjv: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: My God; in him will I trust.
tcz_gospelgo: “Eipanpia eihoidam, ka-Pathen Ka-kingaina nahi,” atitheiye.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman thangkol jouse a kon in nahuh doh intin thinathei hivei hoa kon a nahuhdohding ahi.
en_web: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
en_kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the noisome pestilence.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Pakaiyin thangkol sung le Thihel theina natna konin jong hoidoh nante!

tcz: Aman alhavinga nale khu ding ahi. A lhalim noi a nahoidoh ding ahi. Kitah tah a akihahsel naho chu nading a galvon le ompho ahi.
en_web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
en_kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, And under his wings shalt thou trust: His truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhavingin nakhuntin nasel nante; Akitahna luma nadalpeh ding ahi.

tcz: Jan a misu lung linglao ho kichat dan, sun lai a thalchang leng le ho jong kichat dan.
en_web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
en_kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
tcz_gospelgo: Jan teng kichapon natin, Sun teng gal nagin lou ding;

tcz: Jan noi a donthah nantna hivei gimnei tah ho kichat dan, sun lai a nadelkhum hesoh na jong kicha hih in.
en_web: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
en_kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthima hise lang hihen, Sun laiya mithat hijongle gingpon nate!

tcz: Nasih langa sangkhat lhu henlang, navel a sangsom thijongle, hiche boina hon nangma natoh khah lou ding ahi.
en_web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
en_kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; But it shall not come nigh thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakoma sangkhat din lhuh hen, Navel’a sangsom kijam jongle ima tipon nate!

tcz: Namit hah in lang vejeng in, itilom a migilou te chung a got na lhung hitam?
en_web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
en_kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold And see the reward of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Vele chun migilou Talen kimatsah chu namu ding ahi.

tcz: Nangin Yahweh Pakai chu napanpi ding a nakisem le, Yahweh Pakai chu nahuhdoh ding a nakigon ahi le,
en_web: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
en_kjv: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, Even the most High, thy habitation;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pakaiya kisel nahin, Hatchungnungin nahoidamtai!

tcz: Setna imachan najo lou ding ahi; natna hivei khatchan jong na inn ahinphah louding ahi.
en_web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
en_kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatsahnan napha pontin, Na-insunga manthahna lut ponte!

tcz: Chuteng le Elohim Pathen in navale nachan a navengbit din avantilte thu pen tai.
en_web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
en_kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachena lam lama nahoidam din Pathenin Avantilte nganse nante!

tcz: Nakeng chu songa nakisuhkhah louna dinga vantilten akhut uva nadopdiu ahi.
en_web: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
en_kjv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Songhoa nakeng kisuh khah louna din, Vantilten domkhang nauvin nate!

tcz: Nangin keipi bahkai ho nasuh goi a; gul hang ho chuleh gunei gul ho nalhonat gamding ahi.
en_web: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
en_kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakeihole gulte, sakei hangtah ho, Gulse ho geiya nachotpeh ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hitin ati, “keima eingailu ho kahuh hing ding ahi. Kamin a tahsan na nei ho chu kahoi dam ding ahi.
en_web: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
en_kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin, “Pakai kahi eihea nagilute chu Kahuhhinga kahoidam ding;

tcz: Amahon eihin kouteng uleh keiman kadonbut ding chuleh hahsatna ato tengu leh keiman kaumpi ding ahi, keiman amaho chu kahuhdoh a jabolna kachan sah ding ahi.
en_web: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
en_kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
tcz_gospelgo: eikou tengu houving ting, Agim tengu ka-umpi ding; Kahuhdoh a kachoi-at ding;

tcz: Keiman hinkho sotna kapehding chuleh kavenbit jingdiu ahi” ati.
en_web: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
en_kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, And shew him my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahuhhinga sot tah tah kahinsah ding,” ati.

tcz: Thangvah na Yahweh Pakai peh a, chung nungpen vah choi ding hi thil pha ahi.
en_web: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
en_kjv: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, And to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai Chungnungpen Pathen, Nangma thangvah le najabol lasah aphai!

tcz: Jingkah le nami ngailut na longlou sap phong a, nilhah le nakitah na sap phong hi thil pha ahi.
en_web: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
en_kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah seh le nalungset long lou phon a, Nilhah she a nakitahna phon ding;

tcz: Tumging jangsom to tho a lyre gin ngai tah to tho dia pha tah ahi.
en_web: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
en_kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; Upon the harp with a solemn sound.
tcz_gospelgo: Tumging thei jouse le Semjang gin ngeito tho hi aphai.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nei bol peh thil loupitah hochun kalung lai atong kha in, natohdoh ho jehchun keiman kipa la kasan ahi.
en_web: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
en_kjv: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nathilbol loupe hon eikipasah-e; Natoh thil nasa hojeh-in kipa la kasai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nanatohdoh hohi iti loupi hitam! nalunggel ngeito ho jong iti gil a gil jeng hitam.
en_web: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
en_kjv: O Lord, how great are thy works! And thy thoughts are very deep.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nathilbol anasan, Nalungel agil’e!

tcz: Mihem mai mai het jou hoi ahipon, chih na a lhasam hon jong hedoh jou pouvin te.
en_web: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
en_kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this.
tcz_gospelgo: Mingol het the idol ahipon, Lungthimbei hetkhen hoi ahipoi!

tcz: Migilou hochu hamhing bangin khangtou'un tin, thilse bolho chu pungthei jong leu, tonsot a suhmanga umdiu ahi.
en_web: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
en_kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou hamdong pha bang hen, Bol khel neiho khangtou jongleh; Aboncha kisumang diu ahi.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai, nangma vang, tonsot a dopsang a naum jing ding ahi.
en_web: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
en_kjv: But thou, Lord, art most High for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’a thahat jing nahi Pakai!

tcz: Namel ma te jouse mangthah tei diu ahi; chule gitlou na bol jouse suh chat vai a um diu ahi.
en_web: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
en_kjv: For lo, thine enemies, O Lord, For lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
tcz_gospelgo: Namelmate thigam’a, Migiloute kithecheh soh diu ahi.

tcz: Nangin keimahi bongchal bangin neihatdoh sahtan, chuleh nangin kipanan neimalsom tan ahi.
en_web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
en_kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
tcz_gospelgo: Keivang gambongchal bangin neihatsah-in, Vang neiboh-in neinopsah tai!

tcz: Kamit hin kagal mite lhuh amun; kana kol in jong eidou a migiloute gallel na thu ajai.
en_web: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
en_kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, And mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate kisuhgep kamun, Migiloute kagin kajai!

tcz: Michonphate chu chahthing bangin khangtou untin, Lebanon a Cedar thing banga hat tah khangtoudiu ahi.
en_web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
en_kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
tcz_gospelgo: Midih chu chahthing nanou bang ding, Lebanon lhang cedar thing bang diu ahi!

tcz: Amahohi Yahweh Pakai inn a kehdoh thingphung likeh ahiuvin, iPathen'u Elohim angsung a khangtouva ahiuve,
en_web: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
en_kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord Shall flourish in the courts of our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai insunga kiphut thing phung bang diu, I-Pathenu Houin thenga thing nanu bang diu ahi!

tcz: Teh nung jeng a jong ga aso nalai diu; chuleh phattin'a noujingleh hatjing diu ahi.
en_web: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
en_kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be fat and flourishing;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang thing hi ateh geiyin agatheiyin, Anou jingin atah jingin ahi!

tcz: Amahon aphon doh uva hitia hi asei diu ahi, “Yahweh Pakai chu adih jingin! Amachu kasong pi ahi! Ama a chun set na aumpoi!”
en_web: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
en_kjv: To shew that the Lord is upright: He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hin Pakai thudih aphongin, Eihoidampa monabei aseidoh-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi lengpa ahi! Ama loupi na in a kivon e. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai chu loupi na le hat nan akivon e. Leiset hi ading det in suh ling hoi ahipoi.
en_web: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
en_kjv: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; The Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: The world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu Leng ahin, Lal loupina kijem, thaneitah ahi. Leiset phudetsan akoiyin Kibotkang kit lou ding ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nalaltouna chu phat kisim masang a pat a umsa ahitai. Nangma jeng jong phat kipat masanga aumjingsa nahitai.
en_web: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
en_kjv: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nalaltouna long lou, Tonsot’a um jing jeng nahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglen akikhan tou e. Twisoh hi van gin abang tai; twisoh in gih tah in akinon sah e.
en_web: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
en_kjv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, Teikhanglen lithuh ho aging lul lul’un, Nangma choi-anin akithongje jui!

tcz: Hinlah twikhanglen kinong ging dem dum sang a nasa jo le, twipi pang a twinong kivoging sang in jong Yahweh Pakai thilbol thei na anasa joi.
en_web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
en_kjv: The Lord on high is mightier Than the noise of many waters, Yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Van a Pakai thaneitah-in vai ahomin, Twikhanglen kithong sangin ahatjon, Twikhanglen kithong sangin ahatjon, Twipi kidil sangin jong ahuneijoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai na Dan thu sem hohin kikhel tih anei poi. Navai hop na jong Yahweh Pakai, tonsot a theng jing jeng ding ahi.
en_web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
en_kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, Nadanthu ho abang ahijingin, Tonsot tonsot’a um jing ding ahi.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, phulaji Elohim Pathen, O phula ji Elohim Pathen nathutanna dihtah chu loupitah chu hung kilang doh hen.
en_web: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
en_kjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, phulah them Pathen! Nalunghan hinphongin!

tcz: Hungthou doh in, vainoi thutan pa. Mi kiletsah hochu achanding dol u chansah in!
en_web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
en_kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render a reward to the proud.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi thutan nahi, Kipat’in kiletsahte achanlom pen!

tcz: Miphalou hohi itih chanpi kipah diuham, ichan gei in em Yahweh Pakai?
en_web: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
en_kjv: Lord, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai itih chan migiloute nakipasah a, Ichan geiya nakichoisang sah ding ham?

tcz: Itih chan kiletsah tah a thu asei diu ham? Hiche migilou hohi itih chanpi kihatsah diu ham?
en_web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
en_kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? And all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahten lhajeng jungin thu aseiyun, Athilse bol’u kiletsah hoithonnan aneiyui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai amahon namite asuchip gamtauve. Nangma mite hohi amahon asugenthei'un ahi.
en_web: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
en_kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, And afflict thine heritage.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven Pakai na-ngailut namite, Abolgimun achilngem ngem jengui!

tcz: Amahon meithai hole gamdang mi chule chaga ho athat gam un ahi.
en_web: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
en_kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithai ho le chagate athat’un, Kagamsunguva kholjin ho athat’ui!

tcz: Amahon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in eive pouve chule, Israel Elohim Pathen in anasah poi.”
en_web: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
en_kjv: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, Neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakaiyin la eimu pouvin, Israel Pathenin ahephapoi,” atiuve.

tcz: Kigel pha kit un, mingol ho! Itihleh tahle nahin hethei diuvem?
en_web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
en_kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo hitobangloma ngol mihem ho, Itih ba nachih doh diu ham?

tcz: Na nakol sempa chu a nangong ham? Namit sempau chu amitcho a ham?
en_web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
en_kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhang sem Pathen chun ajah moa, Mit sem a Pathenin amu mom?

tcz: Aman chitin namtinte ana engbol in ahi, nangjong na engbol louding ham? Aman imajouse ahesoh kei in ahi, nangin ipi naboljong ahetsohkei louding ham?
en_web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
en_kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? He that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
tcz_gospelgo: Vaipi vengtup Pan talen apeh moa, Mitin thumop chun ahetmo ding ham?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mitin lunggel ahesoh kei e, imacha phatchomna neilou ahi ahesoh kei e.
en_web: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
en_kjv: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho ngaito Pakaiyin ahen, Athil ngaitou moh ahi ahei!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, nadanthu a nahil hole nasuhdih ho chu iti kipah u hitam?
en_web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
en_kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, And teachest him out of thy law;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nahilchah mihem, Nadanthu nahilthempa chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Migilou te kimat nading leiko tong akilai kah sen nangman amaho chu boina akon in lung ol na nape e.
en_web: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
en_kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute lhah lhumna ding khuh kilai kah, Gim genthei nikho sungin jong nacholdoh dah-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite nungsun ponte; Aman ami deitumte donlou in koi ponte.
en_web: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
en_kjv: For the Lord will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite dalha pontin, Agoulo mite donda ponte!

tcz: Thutan na mun a thudih kimu ding chuleh michonpha ho jousen apanhu diu ahi.
en_web: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
en_kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutanna in a thudih lenga, Midih jousen pha asah diu ahi!

tcz: Gitlou na akon a koiham eidal ding? Miphalou ho masang a ei din peh ding koi ham?
en_web: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
en_kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute eidouhu ding koi hiya, Thilse bolte eidouhu ding koiham?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in eina kithopi lou hile, keima thina lhankhuh mun a thipchet a ana kicholdo tading kahi.
en_web: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
en_kjv: Unless the Lord had been my help, My soul had almost dwelt in silence.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eipanpi lou hileh, Lhan muthim noiya lum tange!

tcz: “Keima kalhutai” tin kakap jah in, O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou chun eiphong dingin ahi.
en_web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
en_kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Pakai, kalhutai, nalungset long louvin Neiphong dingin!

tcz: Keima lungdon na a kadim teng, nami lungmon nachun kinep nale kipa na eipe ji e.
en_web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
en_kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gim genthei kathoh teng, Neilhamonin neikipasah-e!

tcz: Dandih lou a natong lamkai ho chun Yahweh Pakai kalang a pangding hi ati ngam nadiu vem?
en_web: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
en_kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by a law?
tcz_gospelgo: Thudih loud an asem, Dan dih louva thutante napanpi pon;

tcz: Themmo nabei ho dou din amaho akipun khom un mona neilou chungah thina chan in athepmo sah uve.
en_web: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
en_kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphate tha dia gong, Monabeite tha dia thutante napanpi poi!

tcz: Ahin Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim hi kakisel na songpi kakulpi chu ahi.
en_web: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
en_kjv: But the Lord is my defence; And my God is the rock of my refuge.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eipanpin, Ka-Pathenin eihoidam nai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in migiloute achonset nau chu ale thuh ding ahi. Achonset nau jeh a asuh gam ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai, iPathen uvin asuh gam ding u ahi.
en_web: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
en_kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, And shall cut them off in their own wickedness; Yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin agitlou jal’uva talen apeh ding, Achonset jal’uva asuhmang ding ahi; Pakai i-Pathen’un Amaho sumang nante!

tcz: Hungun, Yahweh Pakai vahchoiyu te! Eihuhdoh uva Elohim Pathen ah kipah tah'in vahchoila sau te!
