en_web: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
en_kjv: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungun Pakai vahchoiyute! Eihoidam Pathen a kipa la sauté!

tcz: Thangvah pum in a angsung jon u hite. Avahchoina la sau te.
en_web: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
en_kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, And make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah to thon a-anga lut’utin, Avahchoi la kipah-in sauté!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu loupitah Pathen Elohim ahin, pathen dang chung a leng loupi ahi.
en_web: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
en_kjv: For the Lord is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pakai hi Pathen loupe ahin, Semthu pathen dang sanga Leng hat ahi.

tcz: Mollen penle leiset laigil athuhlai abon'a Aman akhut a atuhchah ahi.
en_web: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
en_kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: The strength of the hills is his also.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin van le leiset pumpi, Leiko tongpen a pat lhang sangpen geiyin vai apoi.

tcz: Twikhanglen hi Ama a ahi, ajeh chu Ama sem ahi. Ama khut in leigo jonghi asem ahi.
en_web: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
en_kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: And his hands formed the dry land.
tcz_gospelgo: Asemsa Twikhanglen le atundohsa Leiset chunga vai ahom jinge!

tcz: Hungun, eisempau Yahweh Pakai angsungah dilsu-u hitin ama hou u te,
en_web: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
en_kjv: O come, let us worship and bow down: Let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.
tcz_gospelgo: Hungun, Eisempau Pakai anga kunin, Boh khup’in chibai boh cheh-ute!

tcz: ajeh chu Ama iPathen'u ahin, eihohi aman achinjing amite ihiuvin akaihoijing akelngoihon ihiuve.
en_web: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
en_kjv: For he is our God; And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu ama i-Pathenu ahin, Eiho avahsa amite, akaile kelngoi hon ihiuve! Tunin asei ngaiyun!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Israelten gamthipnoi masah a abol bangu leh Meribah a alungtah bang bangun nalung tahsah hih'un.
en_web: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
en_kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, And as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
tcz_gospelgo: “Meribah a napu napateu bangin lungtah dan, Massah gamthip a bangin lungtah dauvin,

tcz: Ajeh chu hilai munna chun napu napateuvin kathilbol ho chengse hi amu uvin chule eipatep'un ahi.
en_web: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
en_kjv: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikom dunga hin kathilbol munasan Napu napateuvin eipatep leuvin;

tcz: Kum somli sunga hin keima achung uva kana lunghang'in chuleh Keiman kasei in ahi, ‘amahohi keija kon a kinung heidoh mipi chu ahiuvin, keiman kasei dungjui a chon nomlou ahiuve.’
en_web: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
en_kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
tcz_gospelgo: Kum somli sungin kagim kathang anam leovun, ‘Itijong hiti lepcheuva, Kathupeh jouse anitdau ham’ kati.

tcz: Hijeh chun kalunghan jehin kana kihahsel'in: ‘amahohi kachol ngahna munna hunglut theilou heldiu ahi!’”
en_web: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
en_kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath That they should not enter into my rest.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungsan giltah-in kakitep’in, ‘Nacholdo mun diuva kapeh Gamsunga nalut louhel diu ahi,’ kati,” ati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kom ah lathah sauvin! Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin!
en_web: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
en_kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya lathah sauvin! Sauvin vannoi pumpin Pakaiya!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin amin thangvah un. Ami huhhingna kipa umtah chu niseh'in samphongin.
en_web: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
en_kjv: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; Shew forth his salvation from day to day.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vahchoi la sauvin amin choi-an’un; Eihuhhingnau Thupha nitinin phongjal’un!

tcz: Chitin namtin holah a athilbol kidangtah hohi samphong'in, Aman thil loupi tahtah abol hohi mijouse seipeh'un.
en_web: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
en_kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, His wonders among all people.
tcz_gospelgo: Chitin namtin lah a aloupina phongun, Athilbol kidang ho mitin lah a phongleuvin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi aloupi e! Amahi vahchoi dinga lompen ahi! Amahi pathen jouse sanga kichat umpentah ahi.
en_web: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
en_kjv: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Aloupipen Pakai, minthangtah a vahchoi lom ahi; Semthu pathen dang sanga jabol ding ahi.

tcz: Chidang namdang ho pathen hohi semthu pathen ngen ahiuve hinla Yahweh Pakai hin vanho asem ahi!
en_web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
en_kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: But the Lord made the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: Namdangten Pathen ahisah-u hi semthu bou ahin, Pakai vang hin Vanmun geiya asem ahi.

tcz: Gin na le jana-in aumkimvel ahi, thahatna le melhoina hin muntheng alosoh ahi.
en_web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
en_kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kimvel’a lal loupina jana dim, Amuntheng phung thahat le mel-hoi adem’e!

tcz: O chitin namtin vannoi mite ho, Yahweh Pakai hethem un Yahweh Pakai ahat nale aloupina hohi hethem un.
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, Give unto the Lord glory and strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset miten Pakai vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun aloupi le athahat!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu achan dinga lomtah loupi nale jana chan sah'un! Nathilpeh ding kichoiyin lang a-angsunga lut in.
en_web: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
en_kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai min loupe vahchoiyun! Thilto choiyin a-inpia hung lut’un!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu athenna loupina vah chutoh kitohin chibai boh'un. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi a-angsungah kithing jenghen.
en_web: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
en_kjv: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: Fear before him, all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinkho theng mel-hoiyin Pakai chibai boh-un; Pakai anga leiset pumpi tijau hen!

tcz: Chitin namtin hi seipeh un, “Yahweh Pakai in vai ahom e!” Vannoi hi adingdetna ahitan holingbut ahitapon ahi.
en_web: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
en_kjv: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: The world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: He shall judge the people righteously.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi jah a, “Pakaiyin lengvai apoi; Leiset akiphutdettai killing ponte; Thudih manga vannoi thu atan ding ahi,” tiuvin!

tcz: Vanho kipah hen chuleh vannoi leiset kipah-u hen! Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen thangvah'un.
en_web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
en_kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Lei le van kipah hen! Twikhanglen le asunga chengten Othongin oiyu hen!

tcz: Loujao holeh asunga kehho jouse jong kipahtah in hung gadoh sohkei uhen, gammang sunga thingphungho jousen jong
en_web: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
en_kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: Then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
tcz_gospelgo: Loujao ho le asunga keh jouse kipah hen! Gammang thing jousen kipa la sau hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai angsungah thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu Ama ahungtai! Leiset chungthu tan dingin ahunge. Aman vannoi mite le chitin namtinhi kitahna-a achungthu atanding ahi.
en_web: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
en_kjv: Before the Lord, for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He shall judge the world with righteousness, And the people with his truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset vaihom dia Pakai hung teng, Thudih le thuphaa vannoi mite thu atan ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Vannoi mite kipah hen! Twikhanglen akimvelle agamla penna um miho jong kipah uhen.
en_web: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
en_kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai aleng changtai! Leiset kipah hen! Kipah-un twikol gam jouse!

tcz: Amahi meilhang thim in atomin, chonphatna le thudih chu alaltouna khombul ahi.
en_web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
en_kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, meilhang jinglei loiyin atomin, Thudih le atah mangin vai apoi!

tcz: Amasang ah meikong aleng'in akidoupi ho ahallih gamin ahi.
en_web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
en_kjv: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his enemies round about.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasang meikouje jun alengin, Akimvel’a melmate ahalvamsoh tai!

tcz: Akolphe vah in vannoi leiset asalvah'in ahi. Leiset in amun akithing thingin ahi.
en_web: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
en_kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
tcz_gospelgo: Keh alhahsah teng vannoi asalvah-in, Leiset’in amun akihot lhul’e!

tcz: Molle lhangjong Yahweh Pakai masanga khoilu bangin ajunlha jengin ahi. Leiset pumpi Yahweh Pakai masanga hitiahi thil soh-a ahi.
en_web: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
en_kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhangsang jouse Pakai anga khoilu bangin ajol’in, Leiset pumpi Pakai anga ajolsoh tai!

tcz: Vanhon adih nale akitahna aphongdoh'in namtin'in aloupina amu'uvin ahi.
en_web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
en_kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the people see his glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanmun jousen Pakai dihna aphongin, Namtin vaipin aloupi amui!

tcz: Milim semthu doihou ho jouse, pannabei semthu pathen kiletsahpi hojouse jumle jachat athoh'un ahi, ajeh chu semthu pathen hojouse a-anga kun teidiu ahi.
en_web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
en_kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Doi hou chan ajah chan, Semthu pathen dang ho Pakai anga akuntauve!

tcz: Jerusalem in ajauvin akipah un chuleh Judah khopiho jouse jong athanom'un ahi. Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudih nahi.
en_web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
en_kjv: Zion heard, and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nathutan dih jal’in, Zion mite akipah-in, Judah khopi ho athanom’ui!

tcz: Nangma hi O Yahweh Pakai vannoi leisetna athupipen nahin, semthu pathen ho jouse chunga dopsang'in naumin ahi.
en_web: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
en_kjv: For thou, Lord, art High above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakai, leiset pumpi vaipo nahi; Semthu pathen dang ho sangin naloupi ngeiye! Amite ahoidamin migiloutea konin ahuhdohjie.

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai ngailuhon thilse nahot bollun ahi. Aman ami chonphate ahinkho-u ahuhdohjin ahi, chuleh miphalouho thaneina a konnin ahuhdohjin ahi.
en_web: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
en_kjv: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

tcz: Michonpha ho vah-in asalvah'in, chuleh milungdih ho akipah jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
en_kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte din khovah tan, Miphate din kipana ahune!

tcz: Koi hileh michonpha ho jouse kipah henlang amintheng chu thangvah'u hen!
en_web: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
en_kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; And give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihte Pakaiya kipah-un, Amintheng vahchoiyun!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ah lathah sauvin, ajeh chu Aman thil kidangtah tah aboldoh tai. Aban jet in gal nasatah ajou tai; Aban thengin huhhingna thahat amusah e.
en_web: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
en_kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya lathah sauvin! Pakaiyin thil kidang dang aboltai! Aban-gol ajen athahat’in Gal ajousoh tai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in galjona aphongdoh tai, chuleh adihna leh akitahna chitin namtin lah a aphongjal tai.
en_web: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
en_kjv: The Lord hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin galjo aphongdoh tan, Namtin vaipi athahat ahetsah tai!

tcz: Aman Israelte dinga ngailutna le kitahna nei a akitep nachu ageldoh'in ahi. Leiset kolmang gei in jong iPathen'u Elohim galjona hi amudoh tauve.
en_web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
en_kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte dia kitah dingle longlouva Lungset dia akitepna amolsoi! Leiset kolkimvel’a min I-Pathenu gakjo amusoh tai!

tcz: Leiset mihemten Yahweh Pakai ah kho sam'un; thangvahna bunglhauvin kipah tah'in thangvah la sauvin!
en_web: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
en_kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: Make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset pumpin Pakaiya kipa la sauvin! Vahchoiyun kipa lan, oiyun thanomin!

tcz: Tumging toh thon Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sauvin, tumging tothon langai chu sauvin.
en_web: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
en_kjv: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; With the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
tcz_gospelgo: Semjang saigin to thon Pakai vahchoi la sauvin!

tcz: Sumkon toh kelngoi ki gin kithong tohthon iPakai u Yahweh le ilengpau masanga chohjejun la sauvin.
en_web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
en_kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumkon le saki mut’un, Kipah-in oiyun Pakai i-Lengpau!

tcz: Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen athangvahna samphongun! Leiset chunga hinna nei jousen jom un.
en_web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
en_kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen le asunga chengten oiyun! Leiset le achung chengten sauvin kipa la!

tcz: Vadung jousen kipah'in akhut beng uhen! Thinglhang gam jousen kipah'in la sauhen,
en_web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
en_kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: Let the hills be joyful together
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung jousen khut bengun! Mol le lhang jousen Pakaianga kipa la sauvin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai masangah. Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu leiset chung thu tandinga hungding ahi. Vannoi hi thudih a athu atanding chitin namtin thuhi dihtah a atanding ahi.
en_web: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
en_kjv: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: With righteousness shall he judge the world, And the people with equity.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset vaihom din Pakai ahunge! Thudih le apha vannoi mite vai ahom ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Chitin namtin kithing thingjeng hen! Ama Cherubim teni kikah a laltouna a atouvin ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi kithing hen.
en_web: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
en_kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: He sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin lengvai apoi, Mitin vaipi tijau hen! Cherubim chunga laltounna atouve, Leiset killing hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Jerusalem ah loupitah'in atouvin ahi. Chitin namtin ho jouse chung vum a dopsang'in aum e.
en_web: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
en_kjv: The Lord is great in Zion; And he is high above all the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion a Pakai alaltai, Chitin namtin chunga achungnungpen’e!

tcz: Amahon namin gimneitah chu thangvah uhen, naminhi athenge!
en_web: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
en_kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; For it is holy.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitinin amin lal loupe vahchoi ding, Amabou atheng ahi!

tcz: Lengloupi thudih ngailua, nangin thildih hi nadomsang'in, thudih in kal nasong'in Israel lah-a thudih nachelhah sah'in ahi.
en_web: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
en_kjv: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; Thou dost establish equity, Thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneitah Leng, adih ngailu, Israel lah a thudih tungdoh, Thudih le apha napolut’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim hi dopsangin umhen! A-ang sungah bohkhup un, ajeh chu Amahi atheng ahi.
en_web: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
en_kjv: Exalt ye the Lord our God, And worship at his footstool; For he is holy.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Alaltouna maiya chibai boh-un, Amabou atheng ahi!

tcz: Mose le Aaron jongchu thempu ahilhon e, Samuel injong Amin anakouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai kom ah panpi ngaichan anakouvun ahi, chuleh Aman anahouvin ahi.
en_web: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
en_kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon the Lord, and he answered them.
tcz_gospelgo: Athempu lah a Mose le Aaron akisim than, Amina tao lah a Samuel jong apange; Thempuho Pakaiya atao tengu Aman adonbut jie!

tcz: Aman meilom lah a kon in Israel ho lah-a thu anasei in, amahon Yahweh Pakai in apeh-u Dan le thupeh hochu anajui un ahi.
en_web: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
en_kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: They kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
tcz_gospelgo: Meilom lah a konin Thempuho akihoupin, Danthule thupeh apeh hi Thempuhon amit’ui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen'u Elohim! nangin amaho nana donbut in ahi. Nangma hi amaho ding a mi ngaidam jing Elohim Pathen nahi, ahinla amaho achekhel teng uleh nagim boljin ahi.
en_web: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
en_kjv: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai ka-Pathen, namite taona nasangin; Achonset nau talen namatsah vangin, Namite din mi-ngaidam pathen nahi namusah-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi domsang'un chuleh Jerusalem a moltheng achun chibai boh'un ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi atheng ahi.
en_web: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
en_kjv: Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at his holy hill; For the Lord our God is holy.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Alhang thenga Ama chibai boh-un! Pakai i-Pathenu hi athenge!

tcz: Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai a kipana samphong'un,
en_web: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
en_kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiyin Pakaiya la sauvin!

tcz: kipah tah'in Yahweh Pakai chu chibai boh'un vahchoila sapum pumin a-angah hungun
en_web: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
en_kjv: Serve the Lord with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipah-in Pakai chibai boh-un, Kipa la san a-ang sunga Hung lut’uvin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen ahi tin hettohna phongdohun, Aman eisem uva eiho Ama a ihiu ahi. Eiho Ama mite ihiu vin a-an a kivah akelngoite ihiuve.
en_web: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
en_kjv: Know ye that the Lord he is God: It is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumil loujen’un Pakai chu Pathen ahi. Asemsate, Amaa ihiuve; Amite ahiuvin, akelngoihon ihiuve!

tcz: Thangvah pum in akulpi sungah lut un, vahchoi pum in ainsungah lut in, Akom a kipa thu sei un, amin thangvah'un.
en_web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
en_kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Ahouin kelkot’a lut’un, Vahcoi pumin a-inpia lut’un; Thangvah-un amin choi-an’un!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatna jehchun, ami ngailutna longlou hi tonsot in aumjinge, chuleh akitah nahi akhang khangin aumjinge
en_web: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
en_kjv: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; And his truth endureth to all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai nun nem ahi; Alungset longlou, Akitahna um jing jeng ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keiman nami ngailutnale nathudihna lan sange. Keiman nangma thangvah nahi lan sange.
en_web: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
en_kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakitehna le nathudihje Pakai ken lan sange!

tcz: Keiman monabei hinkho kaman theina dingin chingthei tah in um inge, itihleh eipanpi dinga nahungding hitam? Keiman ka insungah kitahna hinkho kaman jingding ahi.
en_web: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
en_kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nolnabeiyin chon nange! Kahenga itih nahung dem? Ka-insunga lungthengin um ing ting,

tcz: Keiman ipi hijongleh athenglou chuleh vet hoilou ho veponge. Thil adihlouva kitongho jouse kathet ahi, hichengse hitoh kaki timat louhel ding ahi.
en_web: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
en_kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse umsah ponge. Kipalna neisaho natoh kahon, Hiche ho hin eisuboh ponte.

tcz: Keiman dei umlou thil ho jouse hi kapaidoh sohkei ding thilgilou hojousea kon a kakidalse ding ahi.
en_web: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
en_kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung thengmon um pong ting, Thilse tongkha pong!

tcz: Aheng akom aseiseho jouse kadeplou helding ahi. Keiman akiphatsei leh akiletsah ho kadeplou ding ahi.
en_web: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
en_kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
tcz_gospelgo: Guhthima aheng akom house chu Kasuhmang ding; Mi kiletsah hoitho chu Nom lensah ponge!

tcz: Keiman tahsan um miho kaholdoh ding amaho chu kakivoppi ding ahi. Koi hileh oimothei hilou miho bouchu kakivoppi ding ahi.
en_web: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
en_kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung mi kitahho hebol ing ting, kaleng inpia kachensah ding; Lung thengsel ho chu Semang pachonga kapansah ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman milepche ho ka insunga kamanchah louding ahi.
en_web: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
en_kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Mijou kaleng inpia cheng lou ding, kakoma miphalhem um theilou ding ahi.

tcz: Aniseh'a katohding chu mi jonchih ho deldohding chuleh khopi hi hitiho tobanga konna hoidoh sahding hi kakin ahi.
en_web: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
en_kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; That I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Igamsunguva migiloute Niseh a katha tha jeng ding; Migilouse se Pakai khopia kona kadelmang ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in! Ka ngeh nahi neisanpeh in.
en_web: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
en_kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, And let my cry come unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin O Pakai! Najah din kakap’e!

tcz: Kei a kon in kiheimang hih'in, kahahsat phatleh khohsah tah'in neingaipeh in, kangaichat phatleh neihin gelkhoh in,
en_web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
en_kjv: Hide not thy face from me In the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: In the day when I call answer me speedily.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahesoh teng Neinungsun loujenin! Ngaiyin, kakou teng neihou loiye!

tcz: Ajeh chu kahinkho hi meikhu bangin abeipai jitai, kagu kachang hi asadohji tai.
en_web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
en_kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burnt as a hearth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho la meikhu bangin abeihei hoiyin, Kagu kachang meisa bangin Akihul let lut jenge!

tcz: Kalungsung hi anadohjin hamhing bangin agolha jitai, chutengle chun kagilkel jong abeipaiji tai.
en_web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
en_kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; So that I forget to eat my bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Hamgo kinoigep bangin kalungthim agon, Anjong kaneh nompoi!

tcz: Ajeh chu lunggim a kakhoisat sat jeh'in kavun le kagu hobou kahitai.
en_web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
en_kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapen pen nan Kagu lheng lhon bou aumtai!

tcz: Keima neldi gam a sumbupi toh kabangtai, gamlatah gamthip gam a sumbupi noutoh kabangtai.
en_web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
en_kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya songthoi ham kabangin, Khogem lah a simbupi ham kabange!

tcz: Keima kahah khovahjin, inting vumma vacha changkhat seh lunghel tah-a um kabange.
en_web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
en_kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the housetop.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalup vangin ka-ihmu thei pon, Intingvuma vacha chang khat tou kabange!

tcz: Kagal miten sun nilhum in eitaitom jingun, amahon eisamseuvin eitaitom jingun ahi.
en_web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
en_kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; And they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten eiphin nilhumkeiyun, Eidaithang hon kamin agaosap’ui!

tcz: Keima buneh jong vutvai jeng ahitai. Kadon na sunga jong kamitlhi alonglut tai.
en_web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
en_kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
tcz_gospelgo: Anneh khel’in vutvam kaleh-in, Twidon khel’in kamitlhi kaval’e!

tcz: Nalunghan na le nagimbol nachun eidom sang in eipaidoh tai.
en_web: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
en_kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu lungphamon neilunghan khumin, Neidom sangin neipai mangtai!

tcz: Kahinkho hi nilhah lang nilep bangin achemang loijitai. Keima hampa bangin kagop lhaloi jitai.
en_web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
en_kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho la nisa kihei bep ahin, Loudong gopsuh bep kahi!

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang nalaltouna a natoujing ding ahi. Naminthan na akhang khanga chelhajing ding ahi.
en_web: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
en_kjv: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; And thy remembrance unto all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla O Pakai, Nangma tonsot Leng nahin, Akhang khangin naminthang jinge!

tcz: Nangma hung kipat in natin Jerusalem hi nahin khoto ding ahi. Tuahi nangnam na khohsah phat ahin, tuhi na kitepna dungjui a mi kithopi phat ahi.
en_web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
en_kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: For the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
tcz_gospelgo: Hung kipat’in Zion khoton, Zion khoto phat alhingtai;

tcz: Ajeh chu namiten bang'a song jouse angailu uvin chuleh lamlenna vutvai hojeng jong angaisang'un ahi.
en_web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
en_kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And favour the dust thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisumang ta jongleh NalhachatenZion angailun; Khogemsa ahitah vangin, Zion chunga avoujang nauve!

tcz: Chujouteng leh chitin namtin ten Yahweh Pakai ang-a kithing thingding ahi,
en_web: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
en_kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipin Pakai gingun tin, Leiset leng jousen athahat gingunte!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem ahin thahsem kitding chutengle Ama aloupina-a hung kilang ding,
en_web: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
en_kjv: When the Lord shall build up Zion, He shall appear in his glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Zion asemphat teng, Alal loupina phongdoh tante!

tcz: Aman tahlelte taona ahin sanding Aman angaichat hou asanpehding ahi.
en_web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
en_kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, And not despise their prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Donlousa amite taona ngaiyin tin, Athum chanu bulhitpeh tante!

tcz: Khonunga khangthahho dinga kijihlut pehding hitiachu tua pengloulai hon Yahweh Pakai chu ahin thangvah dingu ahi.
en_web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
en_kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: And the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Apeng loulaiho geiyin avahchoi thei nan, Pakai natoh hi khatkit’a te din sundoh-in!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in van muntheng a kon a ahin vetsuh ding, Aman van a kon a leiset hi ahin vetsuh ding
en_web: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
en_kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin chunglam aumna muntheng Van a koninleiset ahinvei!

tcz: songkul tangte khoisatna ajahding thidinga themmo kichanho alha doh dinga,
en_web: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
en_kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
tcz_gospelgo: Songkul lute taona angaiyin, Tha dia thutansate alhasoh-e!

tcz: hiteng chuleh Yahweh Pakai minthanna chu Zion a lopna umding, chule Jerusalem a kithangvah ding ahi.
en_web: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
en_kjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;
tcz_gospelgo: Zion a Pakai kiseiphongsoh ding, Jerusalem a Aman kivahchoi ding ahi!

tcz: Mihonpi tamtah chu ahung ki khopkhom teng leh leng gam hojouse chu Yahweh Pakai chibai boh a hungdiu ahi.
en_web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
en_kjv: When the people are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Lenggam jousea chitin namtin kikhom’uva Pakai chu chibai aboh cheh diu ahi!

tcz: Aman kaban thahat akim laitah avolhun kahinkho asuchomtai.
en_web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
en_kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahat laiyin Pakaiyin katha asubeiyin, Aphat louvin kahinkho asuchom’e!

tcz: Hinla keiman Ama kakouvin, Oh Yahweh Pakai tonsot a hingjing kakhandon laitah ahin kahinkho lahih'in.
en_web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
en_kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen katahman neithisah dan! Tonsot kumkhoa hing jing nahi Pakai!

tcz: Kum tamtah achetai, nangin hiche leiset leibul nana lhungdoh'in, vanhohi nakhut tah'in nanasemdoh in,
en_web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
en_kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: And the heavens are the work of thy hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Semtil’in leiset nasemin, Van mun jouse nakhuttah-in nasemdoh-e!

tcz: hihojouse hung mangthah ding ahinlah nang tonsotna nahinjing ding ahi, amaho ponlui bangin hungvui lhantin, Nangin amaho chu von banga nakhelding chujouteng napai mangdiu ahi.
en_web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
en_kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
tcz_gospelgo: Nasemsa jouse mangsoh ding, Nang vang um jing ding nahi; Nasemsa ho ponset’a sea, Pon banga naseimoa, mangsoh diu ahi!

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang abang chu nahijingin ahi.
en_web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
en_kjv: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang vang abang nahi jingin, Nahinkho beitih aumpoi!

tcz: Nangma mite chate jouse lungmong a umdiu ahi. Achate chateho chu na-anga hung khanglen diu ahi.
en_web: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
en_kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachateu lung monga chenguva, Achilhah teu na-anga hoidam diu ahi.

tcz: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thagvah ingkate. Kalungthim pumpin amintheng choian inge.
en_web: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul: And all that is within me, bless his holy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin, Kahinkho pumpin amintheng choi-anin!

tcz: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate. Keidinga thilpha eibolpeh ho itihchan hijongleh sumil ponge.
en_web: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin, Aphat kidang ho sumil loujenin!

tcz: Aman kachonsetna jouse angaidam tai, chuleh kadam mona hojouse le kahivei hojouse eiboldam pehtai.
en_web: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
en_kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kachonset jouse angaidamin, Kaveiset adamsah soh tai!

tcz: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdohtai chuleh ngailutna leh khotona dimset in eiphungvuh tai.
en_web: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
en_kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
tcz_gospelgo: Lhankhuh gei dingsa eicho hingin, Lungset le hepitah-in phatthei eiboh-e!

tcz: Aman kahinkho hi thilpha dimset in eiphungvuh tai, Muvanlai bangin kakhandon hinkho akiledohsah tai!
en_web: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
en_kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; So that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkhon thilpha jengin eingoichon, Haljingin muvanlai bangin kahat jinge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chonphatna leh dihna chu suhgenthei a umte chu amusah ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
en_kjv: The Lord executeth righteousness And judgment for all that are oppressed.
tcz_gospelgo: Bolset thohte Pakaiyin akhoton, Thu adih lamin atanpeh-e!

tcz: Aman ahina tahbeh chu Mose kom ah anatahlang'in chuleh anatoh hochu Israel mipite lah-a anaphongdoh'in ahi.
en_web: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
en_kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, His acts unto the children of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athilgon Mose henga aphongin, Athilbol kidang ho Israel chate amusah-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi mikhoto them tahleh mihepi themtah lunghang vahlou chuleh longlou ngailutna a dimset ahi.
en_web: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
en_kjv: The Lord is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu hepi le lungset them, Lunghangvah lou, lungset longlouhel ahi!

tcz: Amahin phat tinnin eithepmosah pouvintin ahilouleh lunghang jingjeng ponte.
en_web: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
en_kjv: He will not always chide: Neither will he keep his anger for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi apho jing lou ding, Lung jong lung hang jing ponte!

tcz: Aman ichonset nauva jong ei engbol pouvintin chuleh Aman eiho chanding dol hotbolna jong einei pouvinte.
en_web: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
en_kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; Nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
tcz_gospelgo: Ichan diu dol talen eipepouvin, Ichonset nau le bolkhel ho jat’in eilethuh pouve.

tcz: Ama gingte chunga angailutna tanglou hi leiset chunga van asan banga hi sanga ahi.
en_web: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
en_kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Angailua jabolte din Pakai mingailut van chanin asange!

tcz: Aman eiho chonset nahi, solam le lhumlam akigam lhat bangin gamlatah in atolmang tai.
en_web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
en_kjv: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ichonset jouseu Niso le nilhum chanin atolmangtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi chapangte dinga apauva panga ahin, ama gingte dinga khoto them tahle ngailutna dimset ahijing e.
en_web: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
en_kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, So the Lord pitieth them that fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajabolte hi Pakaiyin Mipa chate hepi bangin ahepi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman ihatmonau eihet thempeh'un chuleh eihohi vutvai tobang bou ihiu ageldoh jingin ahi.
en_web: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
en_kjv: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin ikisemdol’u ahen, Leivuiya kon ihiu ahejinge!

tcz: Leiset chunga ihinkho hou jong hampa bangbep ahin, gam pahcha tobangin ipahdoh'un athi loikitji tai.
en_web: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
en_kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ihinkhou vang hampa bep, Hampa khan a khang chomcha pah bou ihiuve!

tcz: Hui ahung nung jin aitih a aumkhlou bang in bep in eimut mang ji taove.
en_web: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
en_kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Hui nun teng hampa amut mangin, Koiman amuphaji tapoi!

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai gingte din vang amingailutna nitin in aumjinge. Ami huhhing nanjong achate chateho gei in,
en_web: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
en_kjv: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai jabolte din vang Alungset guitanmo, akhang khanga aphatna um jing ahi!

tcz: hitobanga aDan thua kitahna nei ho le, athupeh jui jing ho din aumpeh jing e.
en_web: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
en_kjv: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his commandments to do them.
tcz_gospelgo: Athutep’a tah pante, Athupeh chan nit themte dia chute ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanmun hohi alaltouna in asemin; hichea kon in muntin chunga vai ahom e.
en_web: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
en_kjv: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin van a laltouna akidon, Ijakai chunga lengvai apoi!

tcz: Nangho vantilte ho, nangho mithupitahte ho, ana tongdoh a pangho Yahweh Pakai hi thangvah un.
en_web: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, That excel in strength, that do his commandments, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil hat, thaneitah hon vahchoiyun Pakai! Athupeh nit themten asei ngaiyun!

tcz: Ahi, nangho vantil sepaite ho alungdeilam boljinga Ama janlea pangjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
en_web: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
en_kjv: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha adei bol, van a thaneitah hon Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Asemsa ho jousen, chuleh alengam a umjousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un. Keima kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah jing ing kate.
en_web: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, all his works In all places of his dominion: Bless the Lord, O my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Alengvai neina chan a asemsaten Vahchoiyun Pakai! O ka-lhagao Vahchoiyin Pakai!

tcz: Kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai thangvah inge. O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim, iti lom a nathupi hitam! Nangma, naloupina le nathupina toh nakivon e.
en_web: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-lhagao Pakai vahchoiyin! O Pakai ka-Pathen naloupi ngeiye! Jabolna le Lal loupinan Nakijem’e!

tcz: Nangman khovah chu ponsil bangin nakisil in, Nangin vanho ahin ahsi hohi pondal bangin nadahdoh in;
en_web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
en_kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah loupin nakivonin, Pondal bangin van nasungin;

tcz: twimei chunga na iin natungdoh in, meilom chu sakol kangtalai in namangin, huihi nalhavingin namangin nalenglen ahi.
en_web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
en_kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: Who maketh the clouds his chariot: Who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi chunga in nasan, Meilhang kangtalaiyin namange’ Huipi chunga natouvin ahi.

tcz: Huihi sottol len namangin, meile meikong jong nasoh'in namangin ahi.
en_web: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
en_kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; His ministers a flaming fire:
tcz_gospelgo: Khopihui solchah-in nanaeiyin, Lhacha kolphe namange!

tcz: Nangin, itihchan hijongleh kil ling louhel dingin nangman vannoi leiset bul naphutdoh tai.
en_web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
en_kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be removed for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset bulpi naphutset’in, Kilong kit ponte!

tcz: Nangin twipi veihi leiset dingin ponsil in nasilpeh'in molsangho jong nachupsah soh hel in ahi.
en_web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
en_kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: The waters stood above the mountains.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chu Twikhangin nakhun, Molsang ho jong twiyin achup’e!

tcz: Nangin thu napehleh twipi chu alengmang jingin, na ogin ajahleh ajammang hel jenge.
en_web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
en_kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
tcz_gospelgo: Napho teng twipi akinongin, Na-ogin ajah tengu akitol tol jiuve!

tcz: Mol ho adingdoh in phaicham atonglha jengin nangin nathupeh bang bangin akijam jengin ahi.
en_web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
en_kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys Unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mol le lhang akhotan’un phaichama ahung longun; nasemna mun jousea alongui!

tcz: Chujouvin nangin twikhanglen hochu aphah nadiu chanbep naphahsah'in, hitiachu leiset hi avella achupkit louna diuvin nasemtoh tan ahi.
en_web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
en_kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset achup kit louna din Akhokal lou diu gamgi nasempeh-e!

tcz: Nangin twisamho naphuldoh sah'in kotong dunga nalonlutsah'in, vachaho chu molle lhanga konnin ahung lengsuh'in,
en_web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
en_kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, Which run among the hills.
tcz_gospelgo: Phaicham dunga twisam naputsah-in, Lhang le lhang kah a luidung nalonsah-e!

tcz: ganhingho jouse dingin twi nasuhmang peh'in ahi, chuleh sangan honjong dangnou nan anei un ahi.
en_web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
en_kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: The wild asses quench their thirst.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung hao hin gamsaten twi adon’un, Gamlah sa-nganten dang noun an aneiyui!

tcz: Vacha hon va pang dunga buh akisem un thingbah lah'a la asajiuvin ahi.
en_web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
en_kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, Which sing among the branches.
tcz_gospelgo: Vapang thingphung dunga Vachate busan kipah-in la asauve!

tcz: Nangin navan inmun a kon in molle lhang chunga go nahinjuhsah in chuteng nakhutsoh gachun leiset nasudimjin ahi.
en_web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
en_kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: The earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
tcz_gospelgo: Van a konin mol le lhang gotwi nachapsah-in, Leiset hi navangboh adimset’e!

tcz: Nangin hampa ho nakhandohsah in ganchaho, thingphungho le mihemho manchah pha nasodoh sah'in ahi. Chujongleh nangman leiset chunga amaho dingin nehpha nasodohsah'in ahi.
en_web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
en_kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man: That he may bring forth food out of the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: Gancha neh din hamhing napousah-in, Mihemin avatchaiya muchi tuna aneidin hampa nakesah-e!

tcz: Akipana diuvin adondiu lengpitwi nagonpeh in atahsauva akinu diuvin Olive thao nasosah'in, chule athaneina diuva nehding changlhah napen ahi.
en_web: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
en_kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, And oil to make his face to shine, And bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Akipana din lengpitwi napensah-in, Athanopna din olive thao napen; Akithadona din anneh napei!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in athingphung hohi phatah'in akhoukhah in, Lebanon ah Cedar thingphung ho akedohsah'in,
en_web: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
en_kjv: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai phusa thingphung, Lebanon lhanga Cedar ho Gotwi nengtah-in adou jingui!

tcz: hichea chun vachaten abu-u akison un chuleh vakang ten Cypress thing chunga inn akise un ahi.
en_web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
en_kjv: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
tcz_gospelgo: Cedar thing chung dunga vachaten bu asan, Chahthing phung dunga vakangten bu asai!

tcz: Molsang chungvum langa gamlah kelho achengun chuleh songpi hochu kollah saho dingin na phatah'in apangin ahi.
en_web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
en_kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; And the rocks for the conies.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsang dunga gamkelte achengun, Songkol khikah dunga kolsate akisel’ui!

tcz: Nangin lha nasemmin kum kiheichin aphongdoh e, chule nisan alhumding phatjong akihetne.
en_web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
en_kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum kiheichin melchihnan Lha nasemin, Nisa alhum phat akihet’e!

tcz: Nangin janjong nasem in, jan ahunglhung jin ahi, gammang ganchaho anunkho jiuvin ahi.
en_web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
en_kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: Wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan nasemin, khojin teng Gamsa jouse alhadoh jiuve!

tcz: Keipi nouhon amatdiu hochu angihjiuvin, Elohim Pathen in apeh'u amaho anchah hochu matdingin agemjiuvin ahi.
en_web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
en_kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their meat from God.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei noute sadel’in akisen sen’un; Neh ding Pathena akithum’ui!

tcz: Jingpitah leh abusung uva kicholdo dingin anungche jiuvin ahi.
en_web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
en_kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, And lay them down in their dens.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa so teng changsunga akileuvin, Akhosung dunga alum jiuve!

tcz: Hichejou tengle chun mipiho chu ama ama natohna dingcheh ajon un hicheachun nilhah gei in na atong ji tao ve.
en_web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
en_kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labour until the evening.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kah hin mihem avaikon’un, Nilhah geiyi na atongui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin thilho hi jatchom chom in nasem jinge! Nachihna a hiche hohi nasemdoh ahije. Leiset hi nathilsemsa ho adimset e.
en_web: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
en_kjv: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, thil hijatpi hi chingtah-in nasemin, Nasemsa leiset adimtai!

tcz: Hiti chun twikhanglen lentah leh kiphahjal tah nasem in, asunga ganhing achatthei alen aneo nasem in ahi.
en_web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
en_kjv: So is this great and wide sea, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen lentah le jaotah, Asunga ganhing len le neo adimset’ui!

tcz: Ven, kong inneiho akitol un, Leviathan jong twikhanglen'a kichem din nasem e.
en_web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
en_kjv: There go the ships: There is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi chunga kong innei akitol’un, Nasemsa Leviathanin alamtinjie!

tcz: Amaho jousen angaichat'u an amunadiu hi ngang chunga kingaicheh ahiuve.
en_web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
en_kjv: These wait all upon thee; That thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing hijat kel le chah khoto din, Abonchannasanglam avecheh-ui!

tcz: Anehdiu nangin napehteng uleh amahon achomkhom jiuvin nangin nakhut a nalhangdoh in namop jin hiti chun amaho lungna chimset'in navah jin ahi.
en_web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
en_kjv: That thou givest them they gather: Thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
tcz_gospelgo: Aduchanu napen, aneuvin; Anneh napen, anevaiji tauve!

tcz: Ahinla Nang, amahoa konna nakinunghei tengleh amaho kichadiu ahi. Nangin ahinna hu'u nalahdoh tengleh amaho thiding vutvai sohding ahitauve.
en_web: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
en_kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakihei mang teng akichauvin, Nahaisam sah teng athiuvin leivuiya akilekitji tauve!

tcz: Nangin nahu napeh tengleh hinna nasemdohji a, hiteng chuleh leiset maihi akithahsem kitjin ahi.
en_web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
en_kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: And thou renewest the face of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhagao napeh teng semdoh ahitauvin, Leiset’a amaho hi hinkho thah napei!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai loupina hi tonsotnin umjing jenghen. Yahweh Pakai in athilsem jousea hin kipana aneiyin ahi.
en_web: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
en_kjv: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: The Lord shall rejoice in his works.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’in Pakai loupe jing hen; Asemsa chunga pakai kipah jing hen!

tcz: Leiset hi avetleh akithing jengin molho jonghi akhoi khahleh meikhu alengdoh jengjin ahi.
en_web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
en_kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: He toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin leiset avet teng akilingin, Molsang dung athamleh akhulet lut’e!

tcz: Hinkho kanei laisen Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sange, kahai hu bei chan geijin jong ka Pathen Elohim thangvah ingkate.
en_web: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
en_kjv: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahin laisen Pakai choi-at la sang ting, Hinlai damsungin ka-Pathen vahchoi la sange!

tcz: Kalunggel ngaito jouse jonghi Ama lunglhaina hihen, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi kakipana ahi.
en_web: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
en_kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kipah thanom kahi, Kalasah chunga lung lhai hen!

tcz: Hiche leisetna konhin michonsete jouse mangthah gam jengu hen, miphalou ho jouse mangthah jengu hen. Kahina ho jouse pummin Yahweh Pakai thangvah ingkate, Yahweh Pakai loupina ding hitahen!
en_web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, And let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a chonsete kisugam hen, Migilou kilulah kit da hen! Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu sei in aloupina samphong'un. Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen ipi abol ham heuhen,
en_web: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: Make known his deeds among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Pakai, aloupina phongjal’un; Namtin lah a athilbol seichoi leuvin!

tcz: Aheng a la sauvin; henge avahchoila saovin. Athilbol kidangho hi mijouse seipeh'un,
en_web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
en_kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: Talk ye of all his wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vahchoiyun, Thil kidang abol ho sei leuvin!

tcz: Amintheng hi domsang'un, nangho Yahweh Pakai chibai bohte jouse kipah'un,
en_web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
en_kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipah-un Amaa ahiuve, Ama chibai hoh jouse kipah hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai athahatna chu kholchil in phattin'in amachu hol'un,
en_web: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
en_kjv: Seek the Lord, and his strength: Seek his face evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai panpi hol’un, Ama chibai boh jinguvin!

tcz: datmo umtah tah atohdoh ho chuleh thilkidang abolho, athupeh eipeh hou,
en_web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
en_kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kidang abol ho jeh leh Athutan dih jeh hin,

tcz: nangho asoh Abraham chate ho, Jacob chilhah ho alhendoh sate ho, geldoh'un.
en_web: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
en_kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha Abraham chilhahte le Alhenchom Jacob chilhahten Pakai gel jingun!

tcz: Amahi Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim ahin, Ama thudih nahi gamsung jousea akimudoh sohkeijin
en_web: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
en_kjv: He is the Lord our God: His judgments are in all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hi i-Pathenu ahin, Athupeh ho vannoi pumpi ding ahi!

tcz: Amahi akitepna itihchan hijongleh dingjing ahin, khang sangkhat dinga ana kipehdoh na,
en_web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
en_kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Akitepna nit jing ding, Athutep ho khang sang sanga anit ding ahi!

tcz: Abraham toh anasem kitepna chuleh Issac kom a ana kihahselna,
en_web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
en_kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac;
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham to akinopto na, Isaac athutep anit tei ding ahi!

tcz: Aman Jacob kom ah Dan khat apen anasuhdet in, chuleh Israel mipite dinga beithei lou kitepna ana sem in:
en_web: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
en_kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, And to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Jacob to kitepna asemchu, Tonsot tonsot’a um jing ding ahi!

tcz: “Keiman Canaan gam kapehding nahi, nang dinga jatchombeh'a kapeh natouphadiu gamchu ahi” anati.
en_web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
en_kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance:
tcz_gospelgo: “Canaan gam napeng ting, Nagoulo gam hiding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Aman hichehi hon lhomcha ahipet'uva, Canaan gama kholjin hon lhomcha ahipet uva anasei ahi.
en_web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
en_kjv: When they were but a few men in number; Yea, very few, and strangers in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen mite lhomcha ahi laiyun, Canaan gama akhopem’un;

tcz: Amaho namkhat a kon a namkhat, leng gam khatna kona leng gam khat a akholjin pet'uva asei ahi.
en_web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
en_kjv: When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people;
tcz_gospelgo: Agam gama avah leuvin, Lenggam khat’a konin achom khat’a acheuve!

tcz: Aman koimacha anasuh genthei sahpon ahi. Aman amaho huhnan namdang lengho chu anagih'in ahi.
en_web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
en_kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pathenin koima abolgenthei sah pon, Ahoidamna diuvin keng ho agihsal jie!

tcz: “Kami lhentum hochu tongkha hih'un, chuleh kathemgao hojong tongkhahih'un,” anati.
en_web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
en_kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, And do my prophets no harm.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kalhentum lhachate suse hih-un, Ka-Themgaote bolse hih-un!” ati.

tcz: Aman nehle chah hochu akhahtan'in Canaan gamah kel analhahsah'in ahi,
en_web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
en_kjv: Moreover, he called for a famine upon the land: He brake the whole staff of bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin gamsunga kel alhan, Neh le chah asumangtai!

tcz: hiti chun amaho masanga Egypt gammachun mikhat anasol masan ahi, amaho soh a anajoh Joseph chu ahi.
en_web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
en_kjv: He sent a man before them, Even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
tcz_gospelgo: Soh joh a ajoh-u Joseph chu Israelte masanga asol masan;

tcz: Amachu akengphang tenia thihkhao avouvin, angongchang'a thihkol a-opeh uve.
en_web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
en_kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in iron:
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph chu akenga thih khaovin ahen’un, Alol’a thih-kol’in ahen’ui!

tcz: Amang lolhinna dinga thil ahung sodoh tokah'in Yahweh Pakai in Joseph chu ahina tahbeh hetdohna dingin ana patepmin ahi.
en_web: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
en_kjv: Until the time that his word came: The word of the Lord tried him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thun athemna aphondoh a, Aseidohsa guilhun kahsen ahen’uve!

tcz: Hichejou chun Pharoah'in amachu agakousah'in alhadohtai; Gamsung vaipopan songkul kotchu ahonpeh tai.
en_web: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
en_kjv: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Egypt lengpa, namtin vaipo pan Joseph alhadoh-in achamlhatsah tai!

tcz: Joseph chu lengpa insunga thil jouse chunga vaihom dingin apansahtan ahi. Hiti chun lengpa thil ho jouse chungah vaipon ahung pangtai.
en_web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
en_kjv: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance:
tcz_gospelgo: Agamsunga apipun apansah-in, Anei jouse chunga vaipon akoitai!

tcz: Hiti chun aman adei bang tah in lengpa noi a vaihom pipuiho chu avaihop in chule lengpa thumop lea pang ho chu ahil ji tai.
en_web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
en_kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; And teach his senators wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa natong ho hithei leh Athumopte hilchah thei din apansah-e!

tcz: Hi jouchun Israel chu Egypt gam alhungtan, Jacob chu Ham gamsunga chun gamchom mi hinan ana chengtan ahi.
en_web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
en_kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob jong achen, Egypt gamsunga achengtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Israel mipite chu hapun'in apunsah tan hiti chun agalmite diuvin kichat aumleu tauvin ahi.
en_web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
en_kjv: And he increased his people greatly; And made them stronger than their enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite cha le nao apunsah-in, Akidoupiteu sangin tha aneisah-e!

tcz: Hichun Egypt te chu Israelte vetda dingin atildoh tan hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai mite dounan tohgon aneitauvin ahi.
en_web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
en_kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtilly with his servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite chu Egypt mite ahotsah-in, Alhachate khut thah lhau nan aneitauve!

tcz: Ahin Elohim Pathen nin asoh Mose chu ahinsol'in aman ana lhendoh Aaron chutoh asolthan ahi.
en_web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
en_kjv: He sent Moses his servant; And Aaron whom he had chosen.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun alhacha Mose le Alhendoh Aaron asol’e!

tcz: Amanin Egypt mite dounan melchihna kidangtah chuleh datmo umtah tah Ham gamsunga anatongdoh lhonnin ahi.
en_web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
en_kjv: They shewed his signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose le Aaronin Egypt gama Pathen vangin thil nasatah tah le kidang abol lhon’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Egypt chu mu anathimsah tan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Yahweh Pakai thupeh Israelte soldoh dingchu ananom pouvin ahi.
en_web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
en_kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his word.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Egypt gama thim ajinsah-in, Hinla Egypt miten athu angaipouve!

tcz: Aman twi thisan anasosah'in, ngaho dingin thina thei gu ahitan ahi.
en_web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
en_kjv: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
tcz_gospelgo: Aluidung twi jouseu thisan asosah-in, Nga jouse jong athatgamtai!

tcz: Uphoh honjong agamsung'u alonvuh jengin lengpa lupna dansang jenga jong alhailut jengun ahi.
en_web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
en_kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, In the chambers of their kings.
tcz_gospelgo: Agamsungu uphoh adimtan, Leng inpi geiyin adimtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thu aseileh thousiho Egypt mite chunga ahung chu'uvin, Egypt gam pumpi thousi vaibong'in alo jengin ahi.
en_web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
en_kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, And lice in all their coasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin thu apeh leh Thou vaisi ahung langin gamsung adimtai!

tcz: Aman go khel in gel anajuhsah'in, keh in agamsung'u anasepchap jengin ahi.
en_web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
en_kjv: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
tcz_gospelgo: Gotwi khel’in kol aphetsah-in Agamsunguva gel alhahsah tai!

tcz: Aman alengpithei uleh atheichang ujong asuhmangpeh'in athingphung houjong asatchap jengin ahi.
en_web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
en_kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; And brake the trees of their coasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpigui le theichang phung ho, Thingphung ho asumangsoh tai!

tcz: Aman thu aseileh khaokhote ahung kitollutnun khaokho noute jong simsenlou ahung kitollut tauvin ahi.
en_web: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
en_kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, And caterpillars, and that without number,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aseile, simsen lou Khaokhote ahung langin;

tcz: Amahon gamsunga ado eng jouse anechai jengun, loulai a anche louhing jouse jong achaidoh jengun ahi.
en_web: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
en_kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga hamdong jouse le Lhosah ga jouse anechaitauve!

tcz: Hiche jouchun Aman Egypt te insung jousea chapa tahpen ho aban thapeh'in ahi. Hiti chun aki letsah pipen ule aki panapen hou asuhbei peh'in ahi.
en_web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
en_kjv: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Egypt mite insunga Chapa peng masa jouse athatai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite chu sana le dangka dimset pum in Egypt'a kon in ahin puidoh'in, Israel phungho lah'a khat chajong akipallhua aumpouvin ahi.
en_web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
en_kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: And there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Israelte apuidoh-in, Amahon dangka le sana akiph-un Ahao theiyun ahat lheh tauve!

tcz: Egypt miten nana kichat behseh jeh'un apotdoh uchu ana kipapi lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
en_kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: For the fear of them that fell upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt miten akichauvin, Israelten adalhah-u akipapaive!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in sunleh meilom akhu khum sah'in janleh meikong in asalvah peh'in ahi.
en_web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
en_kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; And fire to give light in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin sun teng amite Meilhangin adal jin, Janteng meikong asalvah sahjie!

tcz: Amahon sa athum uleh vamim alhalutpeh'in a-oivana diuvin van changlhah mama chu anapen ahi.
en_web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
en_kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten athumjeh-un vanmite alhalut peh-in, Van akonin anneh apei!

tcz: Aman songpi chu ahomsah'in twi ahung kiphidoh sah'in gamchai lah'a vadung bangin alondonsah'un ahi.
en_web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
en_kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places like a river.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi ahongdoh-intwi aputsah-in, Nelgama vadung bangin alonsah-e!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman asohpa Abraham kom a akitepna atheng chu ageldoh'in,
en_web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
en_kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, And Abraham his servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha Abraham henga Akitepna theng chu agel jinge!

tcz: hijeh chun amite Egypt'a kon in amilhendoh chu kipah tah'in ahin puidoh'in ahi.
en_web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
en_kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, And his chosen with gladness:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin alhenchomte apuidoh-in, amahon kipa la san a-oiyui!

tcz: Aman gamsung mite Elohim Pathen helou chitin namtinte chenna chu alahpeh'in Ama mite hochu apen, hiti chun amahon mi tusa chang ga hochu aki-at'un ahi.
en_web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
en_kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: And they inherited the labour of the people;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin amaho hi midang ho gam alosah-in, aloumun jouseu atouphasah tai!

tcz: Hitiho jouse anachelhah sahchu amahon a Dan thupeh leh athuhil ho dungjui a achon nadiu adeijeh ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: That they might observe his statutes, And keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Amiten Adanthu ho le ahtupeh chengse Anit jingna diuva hitia abol ahi. Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Elohim Pathen chu aphatna jeh'in thangvahna peuvin.
en_web: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, alungset longlou ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah atohdoh hohi kon asim jou ding ham? Kon Amahi ahina bangtah'in athangvah joudem?
en_web: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
en_kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? Who can shew forth all his praise?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thilbol loupiho seijou ding hiya, Kithuh bep a vahchoi jou ding koi ham?

tcz: Mi ahina bangtah a pachatna pethei holeh phat tin a adih jeng bol hon kipana aneithei jengun ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
en_kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thupeh ho nit’a Thildih bol jing mi anun nom’e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin namite khotona namusah tengleh neihin geldoh'in lang neihin nai in neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
en_kjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
tcz_gospelgo: Namite napanhu teng neigeldoh-in Pakai! Amaho nahuhhing teng keijong neipansah-in!

tcz: Nalhendoh namite phatthei naboh nahoa keijong chan neineisah'in. Namite kipana a keijong neikipa sah'in. Nagou chang toh nangma thangvah khom kanom e.
en_web: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
en_kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Namite hamphat neimusah-in, Nagoulo mite kithang-at a anopnauva neipansah-in!

tcz: Kapu kapateu bangin keiho jong kachonse tauve, keihon kabolkhel tauve, keiho phaloutah'in kanachon tauve,
en_web: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
en_kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapu kapateu bangin kachonseuvin, Migiloule mi-engse kahiuve!

tcz: Egypt gam a ana um kapu kapateu chu Yahweh Pakai in thil kidang aboldoh ho chun atilkhou pouve. Amahon adinguva Yahweh Pakai phatna hochu ana sumil loiji tauve. Amahon twikhanglen san mun nachun Yahweh Pakai dounan ahung phunchel tauvin ahi.
en_web: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
en_kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; But provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a Pathen thilbol kidang ho chu Kapu kapateuvin ahethem pouvin; Analungset jingo chu asumil’un, Twisan phunga Hatchungnung dounan achon’ui!

tcz: Achuti jeng vangun, Amin loupe dopsangna dingleh athaneina thupitah chu akilandohna dingin amaho chu ana huhdoh thouthou jin ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
en_kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin vang akitepna bangin ahuhhingin, Athahat loupe musah din abol’e!

tcz: Aman twikhanglen sanchu akan-na dingin thu apen, Aman twikhanglen chu neldigam abahsah'in Israelte chu ahinpui galkai in ahi.
en_web: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
en_kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisan dung aseipeh leh akangin, Amite tolgoa apui galkaiye!

tcz: Hiti chun agalmiteuva kon in anahuhdoh jin, chuleh akidoupihoa kon in ana hoidohsah'in ahi.
en_web: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
en_kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahotbolteuva konin ahuhhingin, Amelmateuva konin ahuhdoh tai!

tcz: Twichu akinung ledoh sah'in agalmiteu akhukhum jin khatcha jong anahingdoh pouvin ahi.
en_web: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
en_kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: There was not one of them left.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmateuva vang twiyin achuptan, Khatcha beh akhenpoi!

tcz: Hitengle chun amiten akitepna chu atahsan jiuvin Ama vahchoina la chu asajiuvin ahi.
en_web: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
en_kjv: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun amiten athutep ho atahsan’un, Pakai vahchoi la asauve!

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in abolpeh houchu gangtah'in asumilji tauvin, Ama thuhil angahji pouvin ahi.
en_web: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
en_kjv: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Athilbol asumil loiyun, Athumop ngah louvin anopchon tauve.

tcz: Gamthip noi achun amaho tahsa ngaichat thilngen anathum'un hiche gamchai lah'a chun Elohim Pathen chu anapatep'un,
