en_web: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
en_kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya adu du athum’un, Pathen apatep’uve!

tcz: hijeh chun Aman angaichat'u chu anapen ahinlah nat na toh apehthan ahi.
en_web: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
en_kjv: And he gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip athum chanu apen, Gamna hise jong vang alansah-e!

tcz: Camp sunga umhochu Mose chungah athangthipmun chuleh Yahweh Pakai thempu theng Aaron a-ot'un ahi.
en_web: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
en_kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, And Aaron the saint of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamhtip laiya Pakai lhacha theng Mose le Aaron chunga athangset’u chun

tcz: Hichejeh chun leiset chu ahung kamkan, Dathan, Abiram leh akiphinho jouse chu anavallhum'in avuimangtan ahi.
en_web: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
en_kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset apoh khin Danthan achop lut’in, Abiramle ainsung mi achup’e.

tcz: Anungjui ho chungah meikong achun miphalou ho jouse chu meikong'in ahalgam tan ahi.
en_web: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
en_kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burnt up the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuiteu chunga meikou achun, Migiloute chu akavamsoh tai!

tcz: Sinai mol'a sana a kisem bongnou chu chibai aboh'un,
en_web: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
en_kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped the molten image.
tcz_gospelgo: Sanan bangchal lim asem’un, Hiche semthu doi chu ahoutauve!

tcz: Loupitah Elohim Pathen chu hampane bonglim toh analheh tauve.
en_web: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
en_kjv: Thus they changed their glory Into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenloupina chu hamhing nea Gancha limsemthun akheldoh-ui!

tcz: Amahon ahuhingpau, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau,
en_web: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
en_kjv: They forgat God their saviour, Which had done great things in Egypt;
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gama thil nasa tah tah bol, Ahuhhingpau Pathen asumil tauve!

tcz: Ham gam sunga thil kidang tamtah ahin boldohpeh pau, twikhanglen san na gimneitah thil ana tongdohpa a Pathen'u Elohim chu anasumil tauvin ahi.
en_web: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
en_kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, And terrible things by the Red sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gama datmo thil itobang abol’a, Twisan phunga tijat um itobang abol hitam!

tcz: Hijeh chun Aman kasuhmang ding ahi tin anaphongdoh tan ahi. Ahinlah Mose, lhendoh mipa chu Yahweh Pakai leh amipite kikah'a anadingtan, aman Yahweh Pakai kommachun alunghanna'a konna kile heija amipite chu asuhmang louna dingin ataotai.
en_web: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
en_kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin amite suhmang dia asei chun, Alhendoh lhacha Mose’in Pathen akidintepin; Miho asuhmang louna din Alungdamsah nah nah-e!

tcz: Mipite chu gam nom lutding chu ana nom tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in ana kitepna banga apuihoi dingchu ana nom tapouvin ahi.
en_web: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
en_kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word:
tcz_gospelgo: Lungtup gam chu aseiseuvin, Pathen thutep atahsan pouve!

tcz: Ajeh chu akaleh langin achon un, aponbuh sung uvah ana phunchel gam un, Yahweh Pakai thu anangainom pouvin,
en_web: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
en_kjv: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Aponbuh dunguva aphun phun’un, Pakai thusei angaipouve!

tcz: hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai chu lunghemtah'in ana kihahsel'in amahohi hiche gamthip noi a kathagam ding ahiuve anatitai.
en_web: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
en_kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, To overthrow them in the wilderness:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin khut ajah-in agihsal’in, Ganthip laiya athagam a,

tcz: Chutengleh ason apahteu chu chitin namtin lah'a kathejal sohding, chuleh gamla tah tah'a kaimang'a umdiu ahi ati.
en_web: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
en_kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands.
tcz_gospelgo: Achilhahteu gamtin athecheh a, Gamchoma athigamdah din aseiye.

tcz: Hiti chun, ipu apateu chu Baal leh Peor chibai bohna a anapang'un, mithi dinga kikatdoh sa jengjong ananeuvin ahi.
en_web: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
en_kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Peor a jong Ba’al ahouvun, Doi thisa houna sa aneuve!

tcz: Hitiho jehhin amahon Yahweh Pakai chu ana sulang hangun hijeh chun alah uva natset analangtan ahi.
en_web: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
en_kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: And the plague brake in upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbolu hin Pakai aphin hangun, Alah-uva gamna hise alangtai!

tcz: Ahinla Phenehas kitipa chun hangsantah'in nat se chu ana tingtan'in ahileh natset chu atangtai.
en_web: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
en_kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: And so the plague was stayed.
tcz_gospelgo: Phinehas akipat’in themmona neiho talen apen, Hichun gamna hise ahaitai!

tcz: Hijeh chun hichea patchun michonpha tin jana anapetauvin ahi.
en_web: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
en_kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness Unto all generations for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche abol hi Phinehas din Them channan akisimpeh-in itih a het jing ding ahitai!

tcz: Meribah-a jong Yahweh Pakai chu ana lunghansah'un hichun Mose chu anasuboi lheh'in ahi.
en_web: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
en_kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
tcz_gospelgo: Meribah twisam phunga mihon Pakai alunghansah-un, Hijeh chun Mose’n Genthei hesoh anathoh-e!

tcz: Amahon Mose chu analunghan sah'un ahileh aman ngolkaitah'in thu anaseilo tan ahi
en_web: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
en_kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, So that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose alungna behseh-in, Thu ngeimo tah tah anaseiye!

tcz: Israelten chidang namdang hochu Yahweh Pakai in thu anapeh dungjui in anasohjou pouvin,
en_web: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
en_kjv: They did not destroy the nations, Concerning whom the Lord commanded them:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thupeh bangin Chidang namdangte athat’un;

tcz: hichu hilouvin agamsung mite lah'a chun ana chenghal un achonnao phaloutah hochu ana joptauvin,
en_web: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
en_kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, And learned their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla akichengtouvin, Adoihouvu ajomtauve!

tcz: amilim doi houvu chu anahou un hichun alhuhnao asodohsahtan ahi.
en_web: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
en_kjv: And they served their idols: Which were a snare unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen miten doi demthu ahouvun, Amanthah lo tauve!

tcz: Amahon achateu kisan chu anakatdoh'un chuleh achanuteu jengjong thillha hounan anapedoh'un,
en_web: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
en_kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons And their daughters unto devils,
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan gam semthu doi hounan Achateu numei pasal atoh jengui!

tcz: amahon themmona neilou thisan anasouvin, achapateu leh achanuteu thisan chu Canaan mite doi hounan anamang'un tolthanan gamsung chu anasuboh'un,
en_web: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
en_kjv: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: And the land was polluted with blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Themmonabei chapang ho athat’un, Atoltha jeh-un gamsung asuboh-ui!

tcz: amahole amaho jong thilgilou bolnan anakisuboh'un adoihou thanopnau chu Yahweh Pakai mitmun jonthanhoi ana hidohtan ahi.
en_web: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
en_kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, And went a whoring with their own inventions.
tcz_gospelgo: Anatoh-un akisuboh-uvin, Pathena akitah tapouve!

tcz: Hichejeh chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna chu amite chungah anakoudoh jengin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in ama-a tum hochu ana kidah lotan ahi.
en_web: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
en_kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, Insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh hin Pakai amite chunga along hangin, Agoulo mite alo-lhatai!

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu agamsung nammite lah'a chun ana pedoh'in chuleh athet nammiteu chun amaho chungah vai anahomji tauvin ahi.
en_web: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
en_kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; And they that hated them ruled over them.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdangte khut’a ahenin, Amelmateu achunguva vaihomin apangui!

tcz: Agalmi houchun asugep jiuvin chuleh abolgimnao khut thahatna noi a anakoiji tauvin ahi.
en_web: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
en_kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmateuvin gantheitah-in abol’un, Khut thah lhau nan aneiyui!

tcz: Avel vellin Aman ahuhdohjin, ahinlah amahon Ama dounan akipedohji tauvin ahi, chutengleh amaho chu achonset jeh'un suhmangin aumji tauvin ahi.
en_web: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
en_kjv: Many times did he deliver them; But they provoked him with their counsel, And were brought low for their iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite avel vel’in ahuhdoh nan, Amahon adoumah jeng abol’un chonset’a alha lhumjitauve!

tcz: Ahijeng vangin ahahsat tenguleh Aman akhotokit jiuvin akanao angaipeh kitjitan ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
en_kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, When he heard their cry:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichan geiyin jong Pakaiyin ataonau angaiyin, Ahesoh nau akhohsah jing nalaiye!

tcz: Aman amaho toh akitepnao ahin geldoh kitji in angailutna chultheilou jeh in alung ahinhei kitji in,
en_web: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
en_kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhohsah jal’in akitepna ageldoh-in, Alungset longlou jeh-in lung aheijie!

tcz: Aman ganhing a amanteu khutnah khotona amusah kitji nalaijin ahi.
en_web: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
en_kjv: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captives.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh a hente mitmun Voujang nat nat aumsah jie!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen'u Elohim neihuhdoh'un! Chitin namtin lah'a konhin neichomkhom kitnun hitiachu namintheng kathangvah theina diuvin chuleh kipah a nangma kathangvah theina diuvin.
en_web: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
en_kjv: Save us, O Lord our God, And gather us from among the heathen, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhingun, Pakai ka-Pathenu! Namtin vaipi lah a konin neilongkhomun, Chuteng kipah-in Namintheng vahchoiyunge!

tcz: Israel Pathen Elohim, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un, Amahi tonsot'a pat tonsot geija hingjing Elohim Pathen ahi! Mi jousen “Amen” tiuhen. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Israel Pathen vahchoiyun! Tule tonsot’in vahchoi jingun! Mitinin, “Amen!” tiu hen! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi aphatjeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah hi tonsot'a dettou jing ahi.
en_web: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem chu, Alungset longlou ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nalhatdoh hitam? Achutileh phongdoh'in! Aman namelma holah'a kon a nahoidohsahhi miho seipeh'in.
en_web: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
en_kjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
tcz_gospelgo: Gim gentheiya kon Pakai lhatdamsaten hitin seiyun;

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman gam tamtah a kon in solamle lhumlam'a kon in, sahlam le lhanglam a kon in sohchangho ahin puikhom'in ahi.
en_web: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
en_kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamtin so le lhum a kon, Sah le lhanga kon kikhomho seiyu hen!

tcz: Miloi khat hi gamthip gam mah avah mang'un, in le lou beijin avah mang'un,
en_web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
en_kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; They found no city to dwell in.
tcz_gospelgo: Abang bang nelgama avah thaiyun, Chen mun khopi kimu louvin aum’ui!

tcz: Gilkil leh dangchah geovin a thiding konchan aum mun,
en_web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
en_kjv: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kel le chah athoh-un, Alhasamden gamtauve!

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” tin ahahsat nauva Pakai Yahweh akouvun, chuteng Aman agenthei nauva konnin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
en_kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahesoh teng Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva kon Pakaiyin ahuhdoh tai!

tcz: Aman amaho chu bitkei chan apuijin achenna theiju khopi khatna akoiyin ahi.
en_web: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
en_kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Achenna theiyu khopi jonin Lamjang keiyin Pakaiyin apuiyuve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupi tah jehleh thil kidang tahtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
en_web: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
en_kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi;

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman adangchah ho adangnou sah'in, agilkil'ho thilpha tamtah tothon a-oiva sahjin ahi.
en_web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
en_kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
tcz_gospelgo: Dangchahte adang nousah-in, Gilkelte anpha phan avah-e!

tcz: Miloikhat muthim lah athimlah pen a atouvin, lung gimna thihkhao vin ahen oh'in ahi.
en_web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
en_kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron;
tcz_gospelgo: Abang muthim lah a mai nguiyin atouvun, Sohchangte gentheiyin thihkhaovin ahen’ui!

tcz: Amaho Elohim Pathen thu dounan akiphin un, Elohim Pathen thumop chu anelpeh'un ahi.
en_web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
en_kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the most High:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu thaneipen Pathen thupeh ho adouvun, Ahilchahna anahsah pouve!

tcz: Hijeh chun Aman amaho chu akhut hamtah in avo lhun, amaho alhuh phatnun koima akithopidiu aumpon ahi.
en_web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
en_kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; They fell down, and there was none to help.
tcz_gospelgo: Toh hahsat jeh-in chol thi ding ahitauvin, Adin lhuh tengu panpi ding aumpoi!

tcz: Ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” atiuve. Hitengle chun Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en_web: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
en_kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Agenthei tengu Pakaiya ataovun, Pakaiyin agenthei nauva kon ahuhdoh tai!

tcz: Aman amaho chu muthimleh ahahsatnau thimjin banga thimlah a kon in apui galkaijin akihennao asutlhappeh'in ahi.
en_web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
en_kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bands in sunder.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim lah, mai nguiya atou nauvah apuidoh-in, Akihen nau thihkhao abotanpehsoh tai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu ami ngailutna thupitah jehleh thil kidangtah tah abolpeh jeh'in thangvah uhen,
en_web: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
en_kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi!

tcz: ajeh chu Aman sum-eng songkul kotpi avohlhahpeh'in chuleh akihennao thihkhao avohtan pehtan ahi.
en_web: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
en_kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum-eng kotpi jouse aphujal’in, Thih kotgol chengse atumbong tai!

tcz: Mingol themkhat chun boina asemuvin achonset jeh'un thohgimna atoh'un ahi.
en_web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
en_kjv: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol phabep chonset jeh-in, Abang bang gitlou jeh-in ahesoh-ui!

tcz: An le twi ngaichatnan athohlel lheh'un hiti chun amaho chu athiding kon ahiuve.
en_web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
en_kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Anhim him la alo-lha jengun, Athi tah bah ding ahitauve!

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neikithopin” tin ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en_web: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
en_kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, He saveth them out of their distresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Agenthei tengu Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva konin ahuhdoh tai!

tcz: Aman thu changkhat agahseijin aboldamjin, thina kotbul a kon in aloidohtan ahi.
en_web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
en_kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athu neinan adamsah-in, Lhankhuh gei dingsa achohingtai!

tcz: Ami lungsetna thupi tah jehleh amaho dinga thil kidang tamtah anabolpeh jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen.
en_web: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
en_kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi!

tcz: Kilhaina gantha pummin thangvahna peuhen, chuleh athilbol kidangtah ho jeh'in thangvahna peuhen.
en_web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
en_kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with rejoicing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah kilhai diu, Athilbol jousekipa la asah diu ahi!

tcz: Mi phabep chu kong innei mangchan twikhanglen'ah vannoi leiset kiveina lampi ajot un akitollun ahi.
en_web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
en_kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;
tcz_gospelgo: Abang Twikhanglena kong ineiyin akitolsuh-un, Twipi chunga kiveina abol’uve!

tcz: Amaho jonghin twikhanglen athuhlang tah'a Yahweh Pakai thuneitah'a anatoh naleh thil thupi tahtah abolna ho amu'vin ahi.
en_web: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
en_kjv: These see the works of the Lord, And his wonders in the deep.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin twithuh tolama Pakai thilbol kidang dang amudoh-ui!

tcz: Aman thu aseijin hui ahungnung doh'in twikhanglen ahin kinongsah'in ahi.
en_web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
en_kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin asol leh huipi anungin, Twipi akidil paiye!

tcz: Kong innei hochu vanlanga anuh touvin chule twi thuhlah'a ahung kilehlut kitjin kongtol hochu kichatnan akileh leuvin ahi.
en_web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
en_kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: Their soul is melted because of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: kong inneiho van vum vuma aleh-in, Twito lama alhalut kit’un; Hitobang kichat tijatnaa Miho kichan ameidoi gamtauve!

tcz: Amaho jukham ho bangin a-onle leuvin kichat tijat nan adim'un ahi.
en_web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
en_kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wit’s end.
tcz_gospelgo: Jukham bangin asuh atouvin alon leuvin, Athepna jouseu manmo asoh tai!

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neihuh'un” tin ahahsat phatnun Yahweh Pakai akouvun, Amanjong agimnauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en_web: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
en_kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Agenthei teng Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva kon ahuhdoh tai!

tcz: A-o neochakhat'in hui le guo kithochu athipsah'in chuleh twi kinong jong asutang'in ahi.
en_web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
en_kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
tcz_gospelgo: Huipi aphoh tangin, Twipi kidil athip del tai!

tcz: Hiche athip theina chu ichan gei a pha a phatthei bohna hitam? Kongchu kong mun'ah bitkeichan apuilut in ahi.
en_web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
en_kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
tcz_gospelgo: Athip del phat’in akipah-un, Ajotnau kong kaimun bitkeiyin apuiluttai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupitah jehleh thilkidang tamtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
en_web: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
en_kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi!

tcz: Nam lamkaiho masangleh, mipi kikhomho masangah japi hetthei doltah'in thangvahna peuhen.
en_web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
en_kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, And praise him in the assembly of the elders.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi khoppia Pakai loupe aphonjal’uva, Lamkaiho kikhopnaa avahchoi diu ahi!

tcz: Aman vadung jong neldigam aso sahjin, twisam putna munho jong gamgo leh adang chahna aso sahjin ahi.
en_web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
en_kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And the watersprings into dry ground;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin luidung jouse nelgo ason, Twisam phung jouse asing bingtai!

tcz: Aman ga phatah sona gam phatah jong ima sodoh louna chitwi-al gamgo asosah thei in ahi, agam sunga cheng mipite phatmo jeh'a hitiachu abolji ahi.
en_web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
en_kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung mite gitlou jal’in Leipha lai jouse hollei-chikhuh asotai!

tcz: Ahinlah Aman neldigam chu twikul asosah'in, chuleh gamgo jong twi putna mun aso sahjin ahi.
en_web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
en_kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, And dry ground into watersprings;
tcz_gospelgo: Nelgum lah a dim aveisah-in, Sephou lah atwisam aputsah-e!

tcz: Aman gilkel dangchah techu khopi semdoh dinga hiche mun a chu achensah ding ahi.
en_web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
en_kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city for habitation;
tcz_gospelgo: Neh ding beite chukoma achensah-in, pansatna ding khopi akisem’ui!

tcz: Amahon aloulai uva muchi kitheuvin tin lengpigui tu uvintin ga lhingsetna akilodiu ahi.
en_web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
en_kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, Which may yield fruits of increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi chivo tun lengpigui aphut’un, Lhoga tampi pi akilo’uve!

tcz: Aman ichan gei a phatthei aboh hitam? Amahon insungmi tamtah atungdoh'un chuleh aganchahou ninglhingset ding ahi.
en_web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
en_kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite vang apen cha le nao tampi ahingun, Agachau kemlouvin akoiye!

tcz: Ijemtia bolgentheina jalle, boina le hahsatna jalla umho mihem a akemsuh uva avaichat phatnuleh,
en_web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
en_kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low Through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Thoh genthei le hesoh jal’a Pathen mite lhasam a aum teng,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in alengteu hinpaidoh intin amaho gamgo laija pannabei in umsah leleu vintin,
en_web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
en_kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
tcz_gospelgo: Abolseteu chunga athangtomin, Nelgama avathaisah jitai!

tcz: hinla Yahweh Pakai in mivaichaho ahahsat nauva kon in kelngoihon phatah bangin ainsunga hinpunsah intin,
en_web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
en_kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, And maketh him families like a flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Genthei thoh amite vang ahuhsoh-in, Ainsungu jong kelngoihon bangin apunsah-e!

tcz: Miphahon hiche thilsoh hohi hinveu vintin kipahdiu ahinla miphalou hochu suhthipma umdiu ahi.
en_web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
en_kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihten amun akipah-un, Migiloute vang athip chel chul’ui!

tcz: Michingho jousen hitia thilsoh hohi lunggiltah'in hinheu vintin, amahon hitobang ikhankhouva kon a hi Yahweh Pakai mingailutna dihtah chu ahin mudohdiu ahi.
en_web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
en_kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, Even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Michinghon hiche hi geltoh hen, Pakai lungset longlou phongdoh- hen!

tcz: O Pathen Elohim kalungthim hi nang ah akinem jinge, ahijeh chun kalungthim pumpia nangma thangvah la kasha theihi datmo ding ahipoi.
en_web: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
en_kjv: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, Even with my glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen Nanga dettah a kisong kahi; Thouvin ka-lhagao Pathen vahchoi la sange!

tcz: Hungthouvin, katheile leh kasemjang, jingpi ihmuhi kavahchoilan sukhang'ing kate.
en_web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
en_kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipat’un sempi le semjang gin, Nipi lai suthong inge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai mitinlah'a hin nangma hin thangvah ingkate. Keiman chitin namtin lah a hin nangma vahchoila sange.
en_web: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
en_kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, namtin vaipi laiya thangvah ing ting, Mitin jalaiya vahchoiyinge!

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlouhi vanho sangin asangjon ahi. Nakitahna hin meilomlah ho aphan ahi.
en_web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
en_kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: And thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungset longlou van chan aphan, Nakitahna vanthamjol ageoye!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen vanho lah'a asangpen sangin namin hi dopsangin umjo hen. Naloupina leiset pumpi chung vumma hin vahdoh hen.
en_web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
en_kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: And thy glory above all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a naloupi phongin, Leiset’a nalalna tah langin!

tcz: Tuhin name ngailut tehi huhdoh tan. Naban thahatnan neidonbutnun lang neihuhdoh tauvin,
en_web: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
en_kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; Save with thy right hand, and answer me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabanthan neihuhhingun, Kataona sangin! Hiti hin nangailutte Huhhingin um’u hen!

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in athenna a chu hichehi akitepna ahi. “Keiman kipahtah a Sechemhi kabokhen ding, Keiman Succoth phaicham hi katetoh ding ahi.
en_web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
en_kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, And mete out the valley of Succoth.
tcz_gospelgo: Muntheng phunga konin Pathenin, “Gal’a kajoa Shechem kakehsoa, Sukkoth phaicham Kamite kahoppeh ding ahi.

tcz: Gilead hi kei a ahin, Manasseh jong kei a ahi, Ephraim kathih lukhuh ahin, ama a kon a hi kagalsat dingho hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Judah hi kaleng tenggol ahin ama a kon a hi kalengte hung kondoh diu ahi.
en_web: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
en_kjv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
tcz_gospelgo: Gilead Manasseh keiya, Ephraim kathih lukhuh, Judah kaleng tenggol ahi.

tcz: Hinla Moab hi kakeng silna kong ahin ama a kon a hi kasohte hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Keiman Edom chunga hi kakeng kasilding ahi. Philistia chunga galjona kasapkhum ding ahi.”
en_web: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
en_kjv: Moab is my washpot; Over Edom will I cast out my shoe; Over Philistia will I triumph.
tcz_gospelgo: Kanei kisilna konga Kaman ding; Philistinete hanla kasah khum ding ahi!” ati.

tcz: Koipenham kulpi kikaikhum khopi sunga eipuilut ding ah? Koiham Edom chunga galjona a eipuilut ding ah?
en_web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
en_kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, kulpi kikaikhum khopia eipuilut ding koi hiya, Edom a eipui ding koi ham?

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangin neipaidoh hitam? Nangin kasepaite toh galsat'a nakonkhom louding hitam?
en_web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
en_kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? And wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
tcz_gospelgo: Neidonda mongu hita a, Kasepaiteu gal nakonpi lou ding hitam!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kagalmite toh kidouna a hi neipanhu louding hitam, ajeh chu mihem kithopina hi aphachom aumpoi.
en_web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
en_kjv: Give us help from trouble: For vain is the help of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem panpi pannabei ahi, Kamelmateu neidou hu’vin!

tcz: Elohim Pathen toh pankhom hi thil loupi tahtah tohdoh theina ahi, ajeh chu Aman eikidoupi ho chu akengtoa alhopha ding ahi.
en_web: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
en_kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eipanpiu leh kajotei diu, Aman kamelmateu ajo ding ahi!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen koiham kathangvah ding, kei a kon in thipbeh leh gamla tah in umdan lang,
en_web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
en_kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
tcz_gospelgo: Kavahchoi jng Pathen, Umthim loujenin!

tcz: miphalouten eihousetna thujou eiseikhum teng u jong le thipbeh in umdan.
en_web: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
en_kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou jouseihon eidel khumun, Kachunga jouthu jeng aseiyui!

tcz: Thet umtah thucheng ho pum in eiumkim vel un, ajeh beihel'in eikisat piuvin ahi.
en_web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
en_kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; And fought against me without a cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachunga ase se aseiyun, Ajeh beihel’in eidel khum’ui!

tcz: Keiman amaho hi kangailui amaho dinga kataolai hin amahon thepmosah teiding leh suhmang dingin eigong jingun ahi.
en_web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
en_kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: But I give myself unto prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Adiu kakhohsah a kataopeh vangin Eidou doujengui!

tcz: Amahon thilpha kabol ho thilse jengin eilethuh'un, kangailutna hi vetda nan eithuh'un ahi.
en_web: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
en_kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaphatna asen eileuvin, kangailutna eihot bol’ui!

tcz: Amahon asei un, “Ama doudin miphalou khat hintungdoh un, achungthu kitan theina dinga athepmo sahding hinsol'un” atiuve.
en_web: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
en_kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: And let Satan stand at his right hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Athutan din migilou pansah-in, Amelma khat hehset sah-in!

tcz: Achungthu akitan teng amahi thepmosah uhitin, ataona chu chonsetnin simmu hite,
en_web: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
en_kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: And let his prayer become sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Athu kitannaa mochang hen, Ataona jong chonset’in kisimpeh hen!

tcz: Akum lhomsah uhite, michomkhat ama munna dinsah'u hite,
en_web: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
en_kjv: Let his days be few; And let another take his office.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithidoh loi hen! Midangin agou lo hen!

tcz: achate paneilou hisah uhitin aji meithai hisah'u hite,
en_web: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
en_kjv: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
tcz_gospelgo: Achate chaga soh hen! Ajinu meithai hen!

tcz: achate khutdo a moh vahlele hiu henlang, inn gem in vah mang jeng uhen.
en_web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
en_kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: Let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
tcz_gospelgo: Achate in le lou beiyin khut dou hen! Achen nau ingem lah a min deldoh-u hen!

tcz: Bat le tham houvin a in alou chuleh anei agou kichom u hen, kholgam mihon asum lodoh jouse lahpeh uhen,
en_web: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
en_kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let the strangers spoil his labour.
tcz_gospelgo: Athil khol anei jouse kilah hen, Kholgam min atohga kilo’u hen!

tcz: koimachan lungset dauhen; koimachan paneilouva um achate chu khoto dauhen.
en_web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
en_kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: Neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman khotoda hen, Adalhah chaga ho khohsah da hen!

tcz: Ason apah jouse thisoh hen. A inn sung pumpiu min jong akhang cheh a din lah doh in um mai hen.
en_web: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
en_kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; And in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
tcz_gospelgo: Achi abo gamhen, Khangkit teng min lutoa panda hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in apateu chonsetna ngaidam hihbeh hen, anu-u chonsetna jong lekhabua kon in kikahdoh hihbeh hen,
en_web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
en_kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
tcz_gospelgo: Apu apate thilse bol Pakaiyin gel jing hen, Anu chonset chengse ngaidam da hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in achonsetnau geldoh jinghen, chuleh aminjong mihemten geldoh hihbeh hen.
en_web: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
en_kjv: Let them be before the Lord continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Achonset jouseu Pakaiyin gel jing hen! Leiset’a kigeldoh kit da hel’u hen!

tcz: Ajeh chu mi koima ngailut aneipoi, aman mivaichaho leh tahlelte abol genthei e, chuleh lung gentheite thina a adellut e.
en_web: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
en_kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, But persecuted the poor and needy man, That he might even slay the broken in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi bolse, vaicha, tahlel panpibei thatgam Khoto ding gelpha louhel pa,

tcz: Ama mi samset athanom in; tun nang ama sugoi tan. Aman midang phatthei aboh khapoi; tun nangman ama jong phatthei boh hih in.
en_web: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
en_kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: As he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hansepa-gaosap chang hen! Mi phatna deiloupa koiman vangboh da hen!

tcz: Mi sapset hi amadinga aponsil, atwidon, abuneh tobang a angaito ahitai.
en_web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
en_kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, So let it come into his bowels like water, And like oil into his bones.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaochoi choijengpa, Agao jouse apum alongin dim hen! Thaotwi bangin Aguhom kah kah a long lut hen!

tcz: Tun amisapsetna chu hung kile henlang ama chunga pon bangin behdoh henlang angonga kong gah bangin kikhit chah hen,
en_web: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
en_kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, And for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Gao chun pontomin tom hen, Konggah kikanchal bangin kan hen!

tcz: Tun hiche sapsetna hochu eiseise hole eidem demho chungah Yahweh Pakai engbolna chujohen.
en_web: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
en_kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihouse sea kamelmate chu Pakai, hitobang hin talen pen!

tcz: Hinla O thaneipen Yahweh Pakai neidin pi in, nangma min khoto najal chun! Neihuh doh in ajeh chu nangma hi chutobangtah a pha le kitah nahi.
en_web: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
en_kjv: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathutep bangin keivang neipanpin, Nalungset hoidam jal’in neihuhdoh-in Pakai ka-Pathen!

tcz: Ajeh chu keimahi mivaicha le tahlel tah kahin kalungthim hi ana behseh jenge.
en_web: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
en_kjv: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaicha le lhasam kahin, Kalung laigil’a Na kasa behseh jenge!

tcz: Nilhah langa nisa lim achemang bang a mangthah ding kahi, min khaokhopi apaidoh banga eikipaidoh ahitai,
en_web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
en_kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah nilim bang kihei mang pai ding kahitan, Ganhing kimut man gbanga eikithing lha ahi!

tcz: Ka ann ngol na-a kon in kakengpah ho kisan atha aumtapon kavunleh kagu keubou kahitai.
en_web: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
en_kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kel kathoh thoh nan kakhup alhoiyin, Kagu lheng lhonkeo kahitai!

tcz: Keima hi muntin a mi totnopna bep kahitan amahon eimu tenguleh noisena'in alu-u eiheikhum jiuvin ahi.
en_web: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
en_kjv: I became also a reproach unto them: When they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
tcz_gospelgo: Eimupha chanin einuisat’in, Lu eithin khum khum jengui!

tcz: Nei kithopin O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
en_kjv: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai ka-Pathen neipanpin! Nalungset long louvin neihuhhingin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin ka chung ahi nangma natoh mong ahiti ahetchet nadiuvin musah'in.
en_web: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
en_kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; That thou, Lord, hast done it.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihuhhingpu nahi Kamelmate hetsah-in!

tcz: Hiteng chuleh amahon eisapset nom u jongleh eisamseuhen ajeh chu nangman phatthei neiboh ding ahinai. Amahon eihin delkhum tenguleh jumna akimudiu ahi. Ahinla nasoh keimavang kipah a kagalkai ding ahi.
en_web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
en_kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Eigaosap jongleur vang neiboh-in, Eibolseten gal lel hen, Nalhacha kei vang kipah inge!

tcz: Eitaitom jingho vang jumna ponbanga akikhu khumdiu ahin, suhnem a aum nao chun ponbanga atomkhudiu ahi.
en_web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
en_kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, And let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate vetda chang hen, Pon akijel bangin Jum le jan tomjolsel’u hen!

tcz: Ahinla kenvang Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu kasei jingding mijouse kom a kasei choile ding ahi.
en_web: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
en_kjv: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
tcz_gospelgo: Othongin Pakai thangvah ing ting, Japi kikhopnaa Ama kavahchoi ding ahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman tahlelte adinpi jingin suhmang ding gohoa kon in ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
en_web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
en_kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, To save him from those that condemn his soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin vaichapa apanpin, Tha dia thutansa chu ahuhhinge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ka leng pakai kom ah, “nagal mite kasuhnem a, nakengtoa kachotpha sah tokahsen kakhut jetlam naloupina mun tou jengin” ati.
en_web: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
en_kjv: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah a, “Namelmate chotpha kaneisah masangsen Kajet lam a tou jingin,” ati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in naleng gam thaneitah chu Jerusalem a kon a ahin lhundoh ding, nangin nagalmite chunga vai na homding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
en_kjv: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Zion a thaneitah a Leng tenggol nachoisah a, “Namelmate chunga Vai homin,” ati ding ahi!

tcz: Galsat'a nacheteng namiten thanomtah'a najuidiu ahi, nangma vonthenga nakivon ding chutengleh jingkah daitwi banga nisehleh natha kidodoh jingding ahi.
en_web: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
en_kjv: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness From the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Namelmate toh nakisat nil eh Namiten manbeiya napan hu diu; Lhang thenga jingkah daitwi banga Gollhang ho nahenga hung kikhom diu ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in kihahselna anei ahin akitepna chu asuhkeh louding ahi. “Nangma Melchizedek hina banga tonsot thempu nahiding ahi” ati.
en_web: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
en_kjv: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
tcz_gospelgo: Khelkit lou din Pakai giltah-in kaitep’in, “Malchizedek Themput bana Tonsot Thempu ding nahi,” ati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu najet langa dinga napuihoi jing ahi. Ama alunghanna ahung koudoh leh lengle lalho tamtah asuhlhuh ding ahi.
en_web: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
en_kjv: The Lord at thy right hand Shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai najetlama atou jinge, Athangtom tengleh Leng jouse asuhmang ding ahi!

tcz: Aman chitin namtin ajepding agamsunga thilong dimset ding, aman leiset pumpia lengle lalte aban vohlhuh ding ahi.
en_web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
en_kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; He shall wound the heads over many countries.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi thu atan’a, Galmuna thilong ajamchap ding; Leiset leng jouse Ajosoh ding ahi!

tcz: Ahinlah amavang lampi pang dunga long twi adon a hatdoh jingding ahi. Hitiachu amahi galjoupa hijengding ahi.
en_web: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
en_kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: Therefore shall he lift up the head.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan lampam luidunga twi donin tin, Tha kidoa, gal ajo ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Michonpha hotoh kikhop khomna chan ah keiman kalungthim apumpin Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate.
en_web: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. (א) I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, (ב) In the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Amite khoppia kalungthim pumpin, Pakai thangvah inge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai natoh hi iti kidan a hitam! Koi hileh ama a lunglhaina neijousen giltah a agel angaije.
en_web: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
en_kjv: (ג) The works of the Lord are great, (ד) Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thilbol jouse akidangin, Adei jousen het khentei agoi!

tcz: Athilbol ho jouse hin aloupina leh aja ngaina aphongdoh'in ahi. Athu adih nahi athon ngaipon ahi.
en_web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
en_kjv: (ה) His work is honourable and glorious: (ו) And his righteousness endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Abolchan ja aum cheh-in Alal loupe ta ngeiye! Aitih-in adih jing jenge!

tcz: IYahweh Pakaiju mi ngailutna le amikhotona hi iti kidan hitam tihi aman eigeldoh sahjiuvin ahi.
en_web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
en_kjv: (ז) He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: (ח) The Lord is gracious and full of compassion.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athilbol ho eisuhmilsah pouvin, Khoto them, hepi lhingset ahi!

tcz: Aman akitepna hi ageldoh jingin ama gingte chu nehle chah apejingin ahi.
en_web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
en_kjv: (ט) He hath given meat unto them that fear him: (י) He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: Agingte anneh apen, Akitepna ahaipoi!

tcz: Aman amite chu chidang namdangho gam alahpeh a amaho apeh achun athaneina thupitah chu akilandoh sah'in ahi.
en_web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
en_kjv: (כ) He hath shewed his people the power of his works, (ל) That he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
tcz_gospelgo: Athanei vetsah nan Midang gam jouse amite apei!

tcz: Athilbol ho jouse hi adih'in aphan ahi, chuleh athupeh ho jouse hi tahsan theicheh ahi.
en_web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
en_kjv: (מ) The works of his hands are verity and judgment; (נ) All his commandments are sure.
tcz_gospelgo: Abolchan a akitah-in adih-e! Athupeh chengse kisonpi thei ahi.

tcz: Hicheho hi tonsotna dihjing jeng ahin tahsan tahleh kitahna neitah a juiding ahi.
en_web: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
en_kjv: (ס) They stand fast for ever and ever, (ע) And are done in truth and uprightness.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupehho adih le atah a kipe, Tonsot’a umdet jing ahi!

tcz: Aman amite Manchu lhingsetna anapeh ahitai. Aman a mite toh akitepna chu tonsotna dinga asuhdet ahi. O ichan geija gimnei leh minthang hitam!
en_web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
en_kjv: (פ) He sent redemption unto his people: (צ) He hath commanded his covenant for ever: (ק) Holy and reverend is his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite ajalensah-in Tonsot’a din kitepna asempi! Athengle ahat Pakai ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginhi chihna dihtah kiphudohna khombul ahi. Athupeh hoitah a nit ho dingin chihna a khangtou cheh chehding ahi. Atonsotnin thangvah'in umjing tahen.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
en_kjv: (ר) The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: (ש) A good understanding have all they that do his commandments: (ת) His praise endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai gin hi chih kipatna, Athupeh nit chanin ima ahekhen theme; Tonsot’a vahcoi ding Amabou ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai ginna neija athupeh ho lunglhai tah'a juiho dinga iti kipa um a hitam.
en_web: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. (א) Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, (ב) That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Athupeh lung lhaisel’a nit jing Pakai jabol jing chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Achaten muntin a lolhinna aneiding ahi. Khangkhat lhingset a mipha ngen hina phatthei changdiu ahi.
en_web: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
en_kjv: (ג) His seed shall be mighty upon earth: (ד) The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipha chate chu gamsunga thanei ding, Achilhahte hampha diu ahi!

tcz: Amaho hung haodoh ding ahiuve chuleh athilpha bol u umjing jingding ahi.
en_web: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
en_kjv: (ה) Wealth and riches shall be in his house: (ו) And his righteousness endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Ainsunga nei le nga adimin, A-itih-in ahao jinge!

tcz: Michonpha ho dingin jan jengjong avah'in ahi. Amahohi ahongphal un, khotona aneiyun chuleh thudih achepiuvin ahi.
en_web: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
en_kjv: (ז) Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: (ח) He is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipha, khoto them chule midih din Muthim lah jenga jong Kho avah jinge!

tcz: Hongphal tah a sumpa hom hole thengtah'a akiveina chepiho phatthei changdiu ahi.
en_web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
en_kjv: (ט) A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: (י) He will guide his affairs with discretion.
tcz_gospelgo: Hongphal tah a thil hom, Lungthengsel’a natong chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Hitobang miho chu thilsen asuhmo joulou ding ahi. Mikitah hohi min asumil theipon ahi.
en_web: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
en_kjv: (כ) Surely he shall not be moved for ever: (ל) The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipha thon lou ding Kigeldoh jing ding ahi;

tcz: Amahohin thuse hung kithangho jengjong akichapon amahon Yahweh Pakai in ahoibit diuvin tahsan na dettah aneiyun ahi.
en_web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
en_kjv: (מ) He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: (נ) His heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan thuse kithang agingpon, Tahsan det’in Pakaiya aki-ngaiye!

tcz: Amahohin tahsanna dettah aneiyun kichatna aneipouvin ahi, chuleh akidoupi hojeng jong joteiding tahsan nan akimai topiuvin ahi.
en_web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
en_kjv: (ס) His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, (ע) Until he see his desire upon his enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Tijat lungdon abolpon, Amelmate gal lel ding ahekeove!

tcz: Hitobang hohin panpi ngaichaho hongphal tah'in apeuvin kiphaltah'in mitoh chan aching khomji nom un ahi. Atohphat nahou geldoh'in aumjingin ahi. Amahohin mi thujona leh jana achang'un ahi.
en_web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
en_kjv: (פ) He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; (צ) His righteousness endureth for ever; (ק) His horn shall be exalted with honour.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaicha chan hongphal tah-in apen, Mi khoto achim hih-e! Ahunei lheh jengin Min ajabol cheh-e!

tcz: Milungdihlou hon hichehi mu uvintin alung hanpi diu ahi. Amahon lunghang tah'in aha gel unte, chuleh akinepnau thonjeh'in jumthet in kilapdoh tauvin te.
en_web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
en_kjv: (ר) The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; (ש) He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: (ת) The desire of the wicked shall perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Miilouten hiche hi amuteng along hangui! Mitsat lhap lhap’in akilep mangun; Akinepna jouseu abeihel tai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvah'in umhen! Yahweh Pakai sohte ho thangvahna peuvin, Yahweh Pakai minchu choian un!
en_web: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, Praise the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Pakai lhachaten amin vahchoiyun!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minchu nunnom hen, tuleh tonsot gei a dingin.
en_web: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
en_kjv: Blessed be the name of the Lord From this time forth and for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Tu le tonsot’in Pakai min Vahchoiyin um hen!

tcz: Muntin a solam le lhanglam a kon in Yahweh Pakai minchu choiat in umhen.
en_web: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
en_kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same The Lord’s name is to be praised.
tcz_gospelgo: So le lhum a min Pakai min vahchoiyun!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi chitin namtin jouse sangin asangjon aloupina hi vanho jouse sangin jong asangjon ahi.
en_web: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
en_kjv: The Lord is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin namitn chunga lengvai apoi, Aloupina van sangin asangjoi!

tcz: Koi hintem Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim toh tekahpi thei chu, Amahi choisanga alaltouna a touva ahi.
en_web: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
en_kjv: Who is like unto the Lord our God, Who dwelleth on high,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai i-Pathenu tobang aumpon, Vanchung sanga cheng ahi!

tcz: Aman kisunemtah'in van leh leiset ahinven ahi.
en_web: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
en_kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold The things that are in heaven, and in the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung kunjin, Van le leiset avei!

tcz: Aman mivaichate vutvai lah'a kon in aphongdingin chuleh tahlelte munnom pen a kon in akaidingin,
en_web: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
en_kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
tcz_gospelgo: Leivui lah a konin vaichate akaithouvin, Angaicha chan agimnaa konin aphong dinge!

tcz: leng chate toh atoukhomsah'in Ama mite leng chapate jengto jong atoukhomsah'in ahi.
en_web: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
en_kjv: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu leng le lalte toh akijolsah-in, Amite milen milal ho toh akivopsah-e!

tcz: Aman chaneilou numeiho cha le nao apen minu nomsatah in asemdohjin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, To be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei ching nao neilou inching theiyin alhan, Cha aneisah-in kaipasah tai! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Israelte Egyptma kon a ajamdoh jouvun, Jacob insung miten hiche midangho gamchu adalhah phatnun
en_web: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
en_kjv: When Israel went out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
tcz_gospelgo: Israel chaten Egypt adalhah a, Hammah paomah gama Jacob chate apotdoh chun;

tcz: Judah gamchu Elohim Pathen muntheng a sohdoh tan Israel chu aleng gam asoh doh tan ahi.
en_web: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
en_kjv: Judah was his sanctuary, And Israel his dominion.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah chu Pakai mitheng ahin, Israel chu agoulo gam ahi!

tcz: Twikhanglen san chun ahungu amun ajam mangtan Jordan vadunga twi hojong ana kiheimang'in,
en_web: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
en_kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisan dungin aven ajamtan, Jordan lui alelontai!

tcz: Mol ho jong kelngoichal ho bangin akichom un thinglhang hochu kelngoinou bangin akichom leuvin ahi.
en_web: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
en_kjv: The mountains skipped like rams, And the little hills like lambs.
tcz_gospelgo: Mol le lhang ho kelchal chop’in achomin, Lhang sang jouse kelngoi chop’in achom’ui!

tcz: Twikhanglen san ipibol a na lhaimang loijeng ham? Jordan vadung ipibol a na lhaimang jengham?
en_web: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
en_kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? Thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Twikhanglen, ipi kichaa jam nahim? Vo Jordan lui ibol’a lelon nahim?

tcz: Mol ho nangho ipidinga kelngoichal banga nakichop uham? Thinglhang ho ipi dinga kelngoinou banga nakichop uham?
en_web: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
en_kjv: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; And ye little hills, like lambs?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Molsang ho, idia kelcha chop’a kichom nahiuvam? Lhangsang hon idia kelngoi chop nathou ham?

tcz: O leiset, Yahweh Pakai angsung'leh Jacob Elohim Pathen masangah kithing thingin um in.
en_web: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
en_kjv: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo leiset, Pakai ahunge, Jacob Pathen masanga kithingin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in songpi chu twi veina twikul asosah'in, songpi tahbetna kon in twisam alondoh sahjin ahi.
en_web: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
en_kjv: Which turned the rock into a standing water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi ho twikul sosah Songpi khikah a twisam putsah Pathen!

tcz: Keiho a ahipoi, O Yahweh Pakai keiho a ahipoi, amavang loupina jouse hi namingailut na longlou jeh a chun nang ding jingbou ahi.
en_web: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
en_kjv: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, keiho joh hilouvin, Nang jeng bou Lungset longlou le nakitahna jal’in Namin choi-anin!

tcz: Chitin namtin hohin a Pathen'u Elohim hoi a umham tia aseidingu ham?
en_web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
en_kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
tcz_gospelgo: Ibol’a namtin vaipin, “Na-Pathenu hoilam hitam?” atidiu ham?

tcz: Ka Pathen'u Elohim hi vanho chunga aum in thil adeidan dana abolji ahi.
en_web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
en_kjv: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathenu van a cheng, Adei dei bol jeng ahi!

tcz: Amaho semthu doihon vang sana le dangka a kisem ngenchang bou ahiuvin mihem khut in asemthu jeng ahiuve.
en_web: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
en_kjv: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon pathen ahisah vang, Sana le dangkaa kisem, Mihem khut’a kisemdoh ahibouve!

tcz: Amahon kam anei un ahinla apaotheipon, chuleh mit anei un kho amuthei pouvin,
en_web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
en_kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: Eyes have they, but they see not:
tcz_gospelgo: Semthu honk am aneiyun apao thiepoi, Mit aneiyun kho amupoi!

tcz: kol aneiyun ajathei pouvin, nahkui anei un anahthei pouvin,
en_web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
en_kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: Noses have they, but they smell not:
tcz_gospelgo: Nabeng aneiyun kho ajapon, Nahhom aneiyun gimnam ajapoi!

tcz: khut anei un ima tohnan amangthei pouvin chuleh keng anei un achele theipouvin, lolhom anei un ahin thucheng ahungdoh theipon ahi.
en_web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
en_kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: Feet have they, but they walk not: Neither speak they through their throat.
tcz_gospelgo: Khut aneiyun thil atham theipon, Keng aneiyun ache theipoi! Hujong ahusa theipouve!

tcz: Hitiachu doilim semthu hohi hiche tobang ahiuve, hicheho tahsan hojong hitobang machu ahiuve.
en_web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
en_kjv: They that make them are like unto them; So is every one that trusteth in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng sem a tahsan ho chu Asemsau doilim ho tobang cheh-u hen!

tcz: O Israel Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanhu na lum a pang ahi.
en_web: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
en_kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: He is their help and their shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel chaten Pakai tahsanun, Aman napanpiuvin Nahoidam jingui!

tcz: O thempuho Aaron ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amahi napanpia leh na lumdel a pang'a ahi.
en_web: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
en_kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: He is their help and their shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Thempua pang hon Pakai tahsanun, Aman napanpin nahoidam jingui!

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai gingjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanpi le nalumdal ahi.
en_web: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
en_kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: He is their help and their shield.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ginten Ama tahsanun, Aman napanpin nahoidam jingui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nahin geldoh jingin phatthei nabohjing ding ahi. Aman Israel mipite hi phatthei aboh ding ahi, chuleh thempuho le Aaron chilhah ho jong phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
en_kjv: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eihejingun phatthei eiboh diu ahi; Israelte le Pathen Thempuho phatthei aboh ding ahi!

tcz: Mithupi hihenlang milham hijongleh Yahweh Pakai ging hochu Aman phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en_web: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
en_kjv: He will bless them that fear the Lord, Both small and great.
tcz_gospelgo: Alen aneo ama jabol chan Phatthei aboh ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nangma nahin nachate ahin phattheina lhingset in napehen,
en_web: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
en_kjv: The Lord shall increase you more and more, You and your children.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin nang ho le nachilhah teu Cha le nao punsah jing hen!

tcz: Van le lei sem a Yahweh Pakai chun phatthei naboh hen,
en_web: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
en_kjv: You are blessed of the Lord Which made heaven and earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset sempa Pakaiyin vang naboh-u hen!

tcz: Vanhohi Yahweh Pakai a ahin, leiset vanghi mihemte apeh ahi.
en_web: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
en_kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord’s: But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Van hi Pakaiya ahin, Leiset hi mihem apei!

tcz: Mithin Yahweh Pakai thangvah la asatheipoi, ajeh chu amaho chu lhan munthip gam a che ahiuve.
en_web: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
en_kjv: The dead praise not the Lord, Neither any that go down into silence.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithisa lhanthip alutsan! Pakai avahchoiji poi!

tcz: Ahinlah eihon tu le tonsot geija Yahweh Pakai ithangvah theiju ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: But we will bless the Lord From this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho mihingin vang tu le tonsot’a Pakai ithangvah jing diu ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ka o eingai peh eikhoto dia katao na eisan peh jeh in keiman Yahweh Pakai kangailui.
en_web: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
en_kjv: I love the Lord, because he hath heard My voice and my supplications.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona sanga kathum eipe jing Pakai ka-ngailui!

tcz: Aman eihin ang ngat a kataona eingaipeh'in kahaithei laisea keima katao jing jingding ahi.
en_web: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
en_kjv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakou chanin Pakaiyin eihou jinge!

tcz: Thinan apon in eihin tomkhum e; lhankhuh gimneitah chun eihin lonvuh e. Keiman lungkhamna leh lunggimna ngen kamu e.
en_web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
en_kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, And the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavel’a thi theina adimin, Lhankhuh kichan ka-umtai!

tcz: hiteng chuleh keiman Yahweh Pakai min kakoujin, “Yahweh Pakai lungset'in neihuhdoh'in!” katijin ahi.
en_web: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
en_kjv: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiya kataovin, “Neihuhhingin Pakai,” kati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi itobang tah'a milungsetthem hitam! Chuleh itobang tah'a pha a hitam! iPathen'u Elohim hi ichangei a mikhoto them hitam!
en_web: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
en_kjv: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
tcz_gospelgo: Hepi them pakai pha! Eidipdappehjiu ka-Pathenu!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chapang lungthengtah atahsanna neijachu ahahsatna'a ahoidoh jin ahi. Keima thina toh kimaitoa kaum laitah'in aman eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en_web: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
en_kjv: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpibeite hoidam Pakai, Kakichat teng eihuhhinge!

tcz: Kalhagao, nacholdo namun hinjon kittan ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi keidingin aphalheh jenge.
en_web: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
en_kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai phatah kaneiye Kalungthim linglao loujenin!

tcz: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdoh'in kamitna mitlhi lonlouna dingle kakeng hi kakiselhuh louna dingin eiveng jenge.
en_web: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
en_kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.
tcz_gospelgo: Thita dingsa Pakaiyin eicho hingin, Gal eijosah-in ka-lhi atheh ngimtai!

tcz: Hiche leisetna kahin laisen Yahweh Pakai masanga kavahle jengin ahi.
en_web: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
en_kjv: I will walk before the Lord In the land of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihing chenna vannoiyah Pakaito kalhon jingnai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keima kagenthei behseh jengtai katiteng jongleh nangma katahsan jing nalai e.
en_web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
en_kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
tcz_gospelgo: “Eikinehgep hel ahitai” kati geiyin katahsan jing nai!

tcz: Kahahsat teng jongleh nangma kahin koujin ahi, ajeh chu hiche mitehi tahsan thei ahipouve.
en_web: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
en_kjv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
tcz_gospelgo: “koima kisonpi thei aumpoi,” aktin jong Katahsan jing thei nai!

tcz: Thilpha simjoulou eibolpeh jeh'a hi Yahweh Pakai chu ipi kapehding ham?
en_web: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
en_kjv: What shall I render unto the Lord For all his benefits towards me?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eibolphatna ho hi Ipia kalethuh jou ding ham?

tcz: Keiman huhhingna khon hi domsang'ing ting eihuhhing jeh'a amin kathangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihuhhing thangvah jal’in Pakaiya lengpitwi thilto penge!

tcz: Keiman amite ho jouse masangah Yahweh Pakai ah kakitepna nitjing ing kate.
en_web: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
en_kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord Now in the presence of all his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite khopi lailunga Kakitepna jat Pakai penge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in angailut mite athiteng leh alainatpi lheh jengjin ahi.
en_web: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
en_kjv: Precious in the sight of the Lord Is the death of his saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Amithengte thi hi Pakaiyin avelel lheh jenge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keima nasoh kahi, nangin kasoh channa'a kon in neihuhdoh tai.
en_web: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
en_kjv: Oh Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid: Thou hast loosed my bonds.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha kahi Pakai, Thi dingsa neichohing jal’in Kanu toh bangin Ken jong nakin bol jing nange!

tcz: Keiman thangvahna hi kilhaina gantha napengting Yahweh Pakai min'in taovinge.
en_web: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvahnan kilhaiying ting, Nahenga tao vinge!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai a kakitepna chu amite jouse masangah pengtin,
en_web: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
en_kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord Now in the presence of all his people,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kakitepna chengse, Namite khoppi lailung,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai houin ah Jerusalem lailungah subulhit'ing kate. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: In the courts of the Lord’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem kholai Pakai Inthenga kato ding ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Chitin namtin in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen, leiset chungcheng jousen thangvah cheh hen,
en_web: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
en_kjv: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: Praise him, all ye people.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipin Pakai vahchoiyun! Ami janel’in choi-an’un!

tcz: Amahi tonsot a kitahjing Yahweh Pakai ahin eingailutnao hi longlou ahijeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen.
en_web: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: And the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho din alungset anasan, Akitahna abang ahijinge! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un! Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en_web: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: Because his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge!

tcz: Israel pumpin avel in seikit hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en_web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: Let Israel now say, That his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel chaten, “Tonsot kumkon alungset jinge,” tiu hen!

tcz: Aaron chilhah holeh thempuhon avel in seikitnu hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en_web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Thempuhon, “Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge,” tiu hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ging jousen seikit uhen agailut thutah chun tonsot in athoh jing e.
en_web: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: Let them now that fear the Lord say, That his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ging jousen, “Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge,” tiu hen!

tcz: Kagenthei pet in Yahweh Pakai kom ah kataovin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in kataona asangin eilhadoh tai.
en_web: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
en_kjv: I called upon the Lord in distress: The Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai genthei pet’in Pakaiya kataovin, Eihuuvin eichamlhatsah tai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh ipi kakichat ding ham? kon I-eilothei dingham?
en_web: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
en_kjv: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eilhonpin ima kagingpoi, Kon i-eilo thei ding ham?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh Aman eipapin tin, eidou hochu kajosa tobanga kavetding ahi.
en_web: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
en_kjv: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eipanpi, kamelmate jo ding kakat jinge!

tcz: Mihem a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai kiselna a nei aphajoi.
en_web: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
en_kjv: It is better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in man.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem kisonpi sangin Pakaiya ki-ngaidet aphajoi!

tcz: Leng chapate a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai a kisel aphajoi.
en_web: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
en_kjv: It is better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in princes.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem lamkaite kisonpi sangin Pakaiya ki-ngaidet aphajoi!

tcz: Eidouva chidang namdangten eiumkimvel jongleh keiman amaho chu Yahweh Pakai thahatna jalla kasuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
en_kjv: All nations compassed me about: But in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmaten eiumkimsoh nan, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai

tcz: Amahon eiumkimvellun eidelkhummun ahi, ahinla ken amaho chu Yahweh Pakai hanta jallin kasumang gamtan ahi.
en_web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
en_kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
