tcz_gospelgo: Kavel’a adimset’un, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai!

tcz: Amahon khoi bangin eiumkimvellun eitommun, meikong a-al leng lungngin eileo tobangin eibolseuvin ahinla keiman Yahweh Pakai thahatna jallin amaho chu kasumangtan ahi.
en_web: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
en_kjv: They compassed me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns: For in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavel’a khoilhah kai abangun, Gamkang ka bangin adeuje ju’vin, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai!

tcz: Kagal miten tha tei ding eigouvin ahin Yahweh Pakai in eihuhdoh tai.
en_web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
en_kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: But the Lord helped me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eilonvuh jenguva eijotho phat’un Pakaiyin eipanpi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kathahatna leh kala ahin Aman galjona eipetan ahi.
en_web: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
en_kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, And is become my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin hatjou paojouvin eilhan Eihuhhing tai!

tcz: Kipana le galjona lahi michonphate ponbuh sungah akisan, Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjet in thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi!
en_web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
en_kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: The right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyun Pathen mite ponbuh dunga galjo la kisa! “Pakai thahat loupin gal ajouvin,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjetchun thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi.
en_web: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
en_kjv: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: The right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahat’in gal eijopeh-un, Galmang gal asat chaitai!

tcz: Keima thilouding kahin, Yahweh Pakai in eibolpeh thilho phongdoh dinga kahinjoh ding ahi.
en_web: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
en_kjv: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilou ding, kahin jinga Pakai thilbol kaponjal ding ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nasatah'in eijepmin, ahinlah eithisah pon ahi.
en_web: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
en_kjv: The Lord hath chastened me sore: But he hath not given me over unto death.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin eibolgim lheh vangin Eithisah deh hih nai!

tcz: Mikitah ho lutna kot chu neihondoh peh'in keima lut ing ting Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna kapehding ahi.
en_web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
en_kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Houin kelkot ho neihonpeh-in, Lu ing ting Pakai thangvah ing!

tcz: Hiche kelkot hohi Yahweh Pakai kom lhuntheina ahin michonpha hojong hicheahi lutji ahiuve.
en_web: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
en_kjv: This gate of the Lord, Into which the righteous shall enter.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Pakai kotpi ahi, Midih bou lut theiyinte!

tcz: Kataona neisanpeh jehleh galjona neipeh jeh'in nangma kathangvah e!
en_web: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
en_kjv: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, And art become my salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona sanga gal neijosah jeh-in Nangma kathangvah-e Pakai!

tcz: Insahon adeimova apaimangu inning'a songpi khomdet pennin apangtai.
en_web: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
en_kjv: The stone which the builders refused Is become the head stone of the corner.
tcz_gospelgo: Insahon deimoa apaiyu song chu Inning songpi khomdet penin apangtai!

tcz: Hichehi Yahweh Pakai natoh ahin mitvet dinga thilkidang tah ahi.
en_web: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
en_kjv: This is the Lord’s doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Pakai thilbol ahin, Vet din akidang lheh-e!

tcz: Hiche nikho hi Yahweh Pakai in asem ahin, eihon kipahtah leh thanomtah'a imandiu ahi.
en_web: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
en_kjv: This is the day which the Lord hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Pakai galjo ni ahi, Kipah thanomin lengkhomu te!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lungsettah'in neihuhdoh'un, O Yahweh Pakai lungset tah'in neilolhin sahtei teijun.
en_web: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
en_kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihuhhingun Pakai, neihuhhingun! Neilo lhinsah-un O Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minna hungpa chu anunnomme. Yahweh Pakai houinna kon in nangho phatthei kahinboh'un ahi.
en_web: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai min a hungpa anun nom’e! Pakai Houin akon vang kaboh-ui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Elohim Pathen, ichunguva hi vahjinga um a ahi. Kilhaina sa chu khaovin khitninlang maicham ki ho chutoh khitbeh'in
en_web: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
en_kjv: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, Even unto the horns of the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu Pathen ahin, adiuvin aphai! Thingna kichoiyin kut bolpan’un! Maicham kimvel’in kijot’un!

tcz: Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kavahchoi ding nahi! Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kachoisang ding ahi.
en_web: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
en_kjv: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathen nahi, thangvah inge! Naloupina phongjal lenge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna ho jeh'in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a umjing ahi.
en_web: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thupeh dungjui a chonho leh kitahna neiho chu kipah uhen.
en_web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
en_kjv: (א) Blessed are the undefiled in the way, Who walk in the law of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Nolnabeiya chon, Pakai Danthu jui Mihem chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Koi hileh a Dan thu nit a alungthim pumpia Ama holjing hochu kipah'u hen.
en_web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
en_kjv: (א) Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, And that seek him with the whole heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupeh jouse juiya Alungthim pumpia asei ngai chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Amahochun thilphalou achepi pouvin Yahweh Pakai deilampi joh ajui un ahi.
en_web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
en_kjv: (א) They also do no iniquity: They walk in his ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin bolkhel aneipon. Pakai Danthu jeng ajuiyui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nathupeh hochu phatah'a kanit diuvin neiseipeh'un ahi.
en_web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
en_kjv: (א) Thou hast commanded us To keep thy precepts diligently.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nangin Danthu neipeuvin, Kitah tah a jui din neihil’ui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kanitin hinkho Mandan ahin nangman neideipeh hinkho hi kilangdoh jengle kati e.
en_web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
en_kjv: (א) O that my ways were directed To keep thy statutes!
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilchahna nit’a Kitah tah ajui ding iti kakinep hitam!

tcz: Chuleh nathupeh leh ka chondan kavetkah teng kajum louding ahi.
en_web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
en_kjv: (א) Then shall I not be ashamed, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh chengse khohsah leng Jumna muponge!

tcz: Keiman nei thuhilna dihtah hochu kahet dungjui a kakimanding dol a kakimanchah theijeh'a nangma chu kathangvah ding ahi.
en_web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
en_kjv: (א) I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, When I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Dih tah a thu natan ho kasim teng Lungthengsel’in Nangma vahchoiyinge!

tcz: Neidalha hihbeh'in, keiman na Dan chu kanitjing ding ahi.
en_web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
en_kjv: (א) I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly. BETH.
tcz_gospelgo: Neidalha loujenin! Nadanthu ho nit nange!

tcz: Khangthah khatchu itileh ahinkho atheng theidem? Nangma thu angaileh hitheiding ahi.
en_web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
en_kjv: (ב) Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Gollhang hi itileh chontheng thei ding ham? Nathupeh ho anit leh hitheiyinte!

tcz: Keiman nangma mudoh teiding kagelkhoh'in ahi, nangma thupeh'a kon in neilam vai sahhih'in.
en_web: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
en_kjv: (ב) With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalung pumpin nakin bol kagoi, Nathupeh ho bangin neichonsah-in!

tcz: Nangma douna kachonset louna dingin kalungsung ah nathu chu kachensah jingin ahi.
en_web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
en_kjv: (ב) Thy word have I hid in mine heart, That I might not sin against thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang douva kachonset louna din Kalungthimin Nadanthu kaching jinge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kathangvah'e nathupeh nitji dan neihil in.
en_web: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (ב) Blessed art thou, O Lord: Teach me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavahchoiye Pakai! Nachondan jouse neihil’in!

tcz: Ka chonding dan nangin neipeh hochu keiman kasimphongjin ahi.
en_web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
en_kjv: (ב) With my lips have I declared All the judgments of thy mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipeh Danthu jouse Othongin velseiyinge!

tcz: Nei le gouva housangin na Dan thu chu juiding katha anomjoi.
en_web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
en_kjv: (ב) I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
tcz_gospelgo: Gou tampi neisangin Nathupehho jui kathanomjoi!

tcz: Neithupeh na Dan hochu keiman simjing ingting nei deipeh lampia chejing dingin kingaito jing nange.
en_web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
en_kjv: (ב) I will meditate in thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilchahna ho kasimin, Nathuhil ho kakholtoh-e!

tcz: Na Dan thu hohi kakipapin, juidinga neithupeh hojong sumil ponge.
en_web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
en_kjv: (ב) I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. GIMEL.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuho kakipapin, Nathupeh changse sumil ponge!

tcz: Nasohpa keima hi thilpha neibolpen kahinkhoa hi nathupeh kanit jingna dingin.
en_web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
en_kjv: (ג) Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, And keep thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha kei niphatbol’in Pakai, Dam’a nathuhil kanitna din!

tcz: Nathupeh hoa thudih kidangtah hohi kamuchet theina dingin kamit hi hadohsah'in.
en_web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
en_kjv: (ג) Open thou mine eyes, That I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthua thudih kidang ho Kamutheinan kamit hasah-in!

tcz: Keima hiche leisetna hi kholjin bep kahibouve nathupeh hochu keima nei impeh hihbeh'in.
en_web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
en_kjv: (ג) I am a stranger in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a chomchabou hing kahi, Nathupehho nei-impeh dan!

tcz: Phatin in keiman nachondan juiding ngaichatna hin eilonvuhtan ahi.
en_web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
en_kjv: (ג) My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat tinin nathutan ho kahet nomin Kalungthimin ka-ngaicha lheh-e!

tcz: Nangin mikiletsah hochu nahousejin, nathupeh a kon a pampet hochu nasamsejin ahi.
en_web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
en_kjv: (ג) Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, Which do err from thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kiletsah naphohsal jin, Nathupeh nitloute gaosap achangui!

tcz: Na Dan sem hohi kajui jingnai amahohi neinoise sahhih beh'in.
en_web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
en_kjv: (ג) Remove from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu kanit jingnai, Hiche ho hi neiphinsah dan neihousetsah dan!

tcz: Leng chapate ho toukhom u henlang keima dounan thu seijongleu keivangin na Dan semhohi juiding geljing nange.
en_web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
en_kjv: (ג) Princes also did sit and speak against me: But thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaipoho geiya kei douna akikhop vangun, Nasanthu ho kagel jing ding ahi.

tcz: Na Dan semho hi kakipapi lheh jenge ajeh chu hiche hohin chihna thu eihil jingin ahi.
en_web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
en_kjv: (ג) Thy testimonies also are my delight And my counsellers. DALETH.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilchahna ho kadeiyin, Eithumop’in apangui!

tcz: Keima leivui lah'a kijama kahitai nathu chun neisuhal kittan.
en_web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
en_kjv: (ד) My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalel’in leivui lah a kakijam’e! Natepsa bangin neisuhal kit’in!

tcz: Ka chondan, kaumchan nakom ah kaphongdoh tai, tun nadan semchu neisei pehtan.
en_web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (ד) I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: Teach me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonna jouse kaphongin neihouve, Nachondan ho neihil’in!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh chu neithem sah'in, chutengleh keiman natohdoh datmo umtah hochu kalungin geljing nange.
en_web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
en_kjv: (ד) Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuho neihetsah-in, Nathuhil kidang ho gel jing inge!

tcz: Lungkhamnan eibom in kakaptai, nakam changing neihaldoh sahkit tan.
en_web: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
en_kjv: (ד) My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagim behseh tai, Natepsa bangin neihatsah kit’in!

tcz: Mijou milepche hotoh neichom khen in, nathuhil kahetthem theinading thuguh chu neipen.
en_web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
en_kjv: (ד) Remove from me the way of lying: And grant me thy law graciously.
tcz_gospelgo: Lam hilouva neisol dan, Lungset’in Nadanthu neihil’in!

tcz: Kitah tah'a hinkho manding hi kakilhen ahitai, nathuhil dungjui a hinkho mandinghi kadinpi ahitai.
en_web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
en_kjv: (ד) I have chosen the way of truth: Thy judgments have I laid before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Thua nung tange, Nathutan ho kakhohsah tai!

tcz: Na Dan semhi katuhchah ahitai, O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh'in!
en_web: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
en_kjv: (ד) I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilbangin kachon nai Pakai, Neijumso loujenin!

tcz: Nathupeh hohi kajui jingding ahi, ajeh chu nangin hetthem theina neipeh jingding jehin.
en_web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
en_kjv: (ד) I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart. HE.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihetsah be ding jeh-in Nathupeh cheng kipah tah-in nit nange!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nathupeh chu neihillin, keiman achaina gei in juijing ing kate.
en_web: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
en_kjv: (ה) Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuhoa ipi kisei ham neihil’in Pakai! Abonchan nit jing jeng nange!

tcz: Nathuhil kajuijing theina dingin hetthem theina neipen. Kalungthim pumpin hichu natohman podoh ingkate.
en_web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
en_kjv: (ה) Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu neihilchenin nit ing ting, Kalungthima ching jing nange!

tcz: Nathupeh dungjui in neikalson sah'in hichu kakipanapen ahi.
en_web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
en_kjv: (ה) Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuho kakipana ahi Anit themje neihil’in!

tcz: Sum ngaichatna sangin na Dan thu hetthemding ngaichat theina neipejon.
en_web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
en_kjv: (ה) Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Nei le nga sangin Nadanthuho nit ding neithanopsah-in!

tcz: Thil phachomlou hoa kon in kamit heimangin lang nathuchengin neihindoh sah'in.
en_web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
en_kjv: (ה) Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; And quicken thou me in thy way.
tcz_gospelgo: Pannabeiya neithanopsah dan, Natepsa bangin neihepin!

tcz: Nangma ginle jana neiho napeh kitepna chu keima kom ah neisuhdetpeh'in.
en_web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
en_kjv: (ה) Stablish thy word unto thy servant, Who is devoted to thy fear.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei ngaite dia nathutep, Hiche nathutep chu nalhacha keidin sudet’in!

tcz: Kajumna hinkho hi neipailhah sah'in ajeh chu na Dan semho hi aphalheh jengin ahi.
en_web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
en_kjv: (ה) Turn away my reproach which I fear: For thy judgments are good.
tcz_gospelgo: Nei-engboldan kaginge, Nathutan ho akidang theiye!

tcz: Nathupeh hohi kajuinomlheh jenge naphatna'in kahinkho hi neithah sempeh kittan.
en_web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
en_kjv: (ה) Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness. VAU.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho kanit nom’e, Hinkhothah neipen, nangma dihtah nahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai namingailutna longlou tonsot hinna neiteppeh chu neipetan,
en_web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
en_kjv: (ו) Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Neingailut gilje neimusah-in Pakai! Natepsa banginneihuhhingin!

tcz: Chutileh eitaitom ho donbutje kahetding ahi ajeh chu keiman nathutep chu katahsan in ahi.
en_web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
en_kjv: (ו) So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: For I trust in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathua kisong kahin Eiphinse ho kadonbut thei ding ahi!

tcz: Phat tin in thutah jeng neisei sah'in ajeh chu nangma chondan thupeh a bouhin kinepna kanei in ahi.
en_web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
en_kjv: (ו) And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachondanhoa kinem kahi, Thutah neiseisah jingin!

tcz: Keiman nathupeh hochu itihchan hijongleh kanit jingding ahi.
en_web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
en_kjv: (ו) So shall I keep thy law continually For ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot tonsot’in Nadanthu nit jing nange!

tcz: Keiman chamlhatna tahbeh chu kaneitai, ajeh chu nangma thuhil juidinga kigo kahitai.
en_web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
en_kjv: (ו) And I will walk at liberty: For I seek thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilna jui ding kagoi, Kachamlhat tahbeh ding ahi!

tcz: Keiman nathupehho hi jahchalou hella lengte masanga jong kaphondoh ding ahi.
en_web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
en_kjv: (ו) I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, And will not be ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Jahcha louhel’a leng ho koma Nathupeh chengse kaphondoh ding ahi!

tcz: Keiman nang thupeh juidinghi kakipanapen ahitai ajeh chu hicheho hi keiman kadeilheh jengin ahi.
en_web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
en_kjv: (ו) And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh chengse kadeiyin Kanit nom jing nai!

tcz: Keiman na thupeh ho hi kadeilheh jengin chuleh jana jong kaneijin ahi, na Dan thu hohi giltah'in kagellin ahi.
en_web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
en_kjv: (ו) My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in thy statutes. ZAIN.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh ho kajan kadeiye, Nahilchahna ho gel jing nange!

tcz: Kakom a na kitepna chu geldoh'in hiche bouchu ahi kakinepna.
en_web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
en_kjv: (ז) Remember the word unto thy servant, Upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha kahenga nakitepna geldoh jingin, Hiche hin eikinepsah jinge!

tcz: Hiche nakitepna hin kahinkho akiledohsah kit'in kalungthim boina hoa kon in jong lungmon na eipen ahi.
en_web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
en_kjv: (ז) This is my comfort in my affliction: For thy word hath quickened me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagimpet jengin jong eilhamonin, Nathutep chun eikhou khah ahi!

tcz: Mikiletsah hon noise tah'in eibol jongleu keivang nangma thuhilhoa kon in kapotdoh pon ahi.
en_web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
en_kjv: (ז) The proud have had me greatly in derision: Yet have I not declined from thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahten eihou kha cheh chuh jongle Nadanthu nahsah mon kabolpoi!

tcz: Masanglai peh'a na Dan sem nachepi hochu kangaito leh O Yahweh Pakai hichechun eilhamon sahlheh jenge.
en_web: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
en_kjv: (ז) I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; And have comforted myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Malaiya nathutanho kagel leh, Hiche ho hin eilhamon’e Pakai!

tcz: Keima miphalou ho chunga kalung ahang'in ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathuhil apompouve.
en_web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
en_kjv: (ז) Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked That forsake thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten nadanthu apalkeh teng Kalung hang lheh jie!

tcz: Hiche kakholjinna munhi hoilai hijongleh na Dan thu semho hi kala ngeipen ahijinge.
en_web: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
en_kjv: (ז) Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaleiset hinkho chomcha sungin Nathupeh ho kalachoiye!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai jantengleh nangma nahina hi kalungsung ah akilangjin, hijeh chun nathuhil hohi kajui jingin ahi.
en_web: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
en_kjv: (ז) I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, And have kept thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai janteng Nangma kagel jin, Nadanthu umdol ka-ngaitoi!

tcz: Nathupeh juijinghi kahinkho mandan hitoh kilhon khoma ahitai.
en_web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
en_kjv: (ז) This I had, Because I kept thy precepts. CHETH.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho kanit teng Kipana kaneijie!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kachanding gouchu nangma nahi! Nathupeh juidingin kakiphaldoh jinge!
en_web: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
en_kjv: (ח) Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.
tcz_gospelgo: OPakai Nangbou kadeipenin! Nadanthu nit ding kakitep’e!

tcz: Kalungthim pumpi hi namalsomna ngaichajing kahi, Nakitepna bangin neihepi jingtan.
en_web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
en_kjv: (ח) I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Natepsa banga neihepi din Kalungthim pumpin kataove!

tcz: Kahinkho ka lam lhahdan hi kanung gel jin chutengleh na Dan thu juina dingahin ka lutkit ji tai.
en_web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
en_kjv: (ח) I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-umchan khankho kagel’in, Nahilna juidin kakitep’e!

tcz: Nathupeh juina dingahin gangtah'in kipelut jing nange.
en_web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
en_kjv: (ח) I made haste, and delayed not To keep thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh chegnse nit didn kinomsot louvin kakinotai!

tcz: Miphalou hon chonsetna a lhohlut teiding eigo jiuvin ahinla keima vang na Dan thuhilna a hin dettah'in kading jingin ahi.
en_web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
en_kjv: (ח) The bands of the wicked have robbed me: But I have not forgotten thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten thang eikampeh jongle Nadanthu kasumil poi!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hohi adih jeh'in jankhang jongleh kathoudoh'in nangma ka thangvah jin ahi.
en_web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
en_kjv: (ח) At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathutan ho dih jal’in, Nang vahchoi din jankimin kathouve!

tcz: Nangma thupeh juijing holeh nangma ging jingho dingin agolphao kahijinge.
en_web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
en_kjv: (ח) I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that keep thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeho nit’a nakinbolte toh loi le gol’in ka-um jinge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namingailutna tanglou hin leiset chunghi adipmin, na Dan thuhi neihil jingin.
en_web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
en_kjv: (ח) The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: Teach me thy statutes. TETH.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, leiset hi nalungset longlou adim’e, Neihil’in nachondan ho chu!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nakitepna dungjuijin thilpha tamtah neibolpeh tai.
en_web: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
en_kjv: (ט) Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nasei dungjuiyin Nalhacha kei neikhotoi!

tcz: Nathupeh hoachun kading jinge, hetna thepna leh thu adih'a tantheina thuguh chu neihil in,
en_web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
en_kjv: (ט) Teach me good judgment and knowledge: For I have believed thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehhoa kisong kahi, Chihna le hetna neipen!

tcz: Nangin neihilchah masang chun kana lamvaijin, tunvang nathu thun kanungtai.
en_web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
en_kjv: (ט) Before I was afflicted I went astray: But now have I kept thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen neimatsah masangin kachon khel jin, Tun vang nathu ka-ngaiye!

tcz: Nangman naphatna'in thilpha bou na bol jie, na Dan thuchu neihil in.
en_web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (ט) Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihepi khoto them nahi! Nachondan ho neihil’in!

tcz: Miphalou ho jouthu eisei khum jiuvin, ahinla kenvang kalungthim pumpin nathupeh ho dihtah'in kajuijing nai.
en_web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
en_kjv: (ט) The proud have forged a lie against me: But I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahten jouvin eidem jongleur kalungthim pumpin neihilna ka-ngai jinge!

tcz: Alungthim u ngol hoitah ahin; keivang nangma thupehho juijing hi kakipana ahijinge.
en_web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
en_kjv: (ט) Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahten ima hetna aneipon, keivang nadanthua kipah kahi!

tcz: Ka thohgimna chu keidinga thilphajo anahi, ajeh chu hichehin nathupeh juina ding langa lunglutna eipethei jin ahi.
en_web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
en_kjv: (ט) It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I might learn thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Eikibolgim chu keidin aphai, Hichun nadanthu eihil’e!

tcz: Nathuhil ho juiding hi sana le dangka simsenlou sangin aman atamjon ahi.
en_web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
en_kjv: (ט) The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver. JOD.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset sum jouse sangin Danthu neipeh hi amanlujoi!

tcz: Nangin neina gon a neinasemdoh ahin, tunvang nathupeh juina dinga hin hetthem theina neipen.
en_web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
en_kjv: (י) Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Neisemin, neihoidamin, Nadanthuho kahetna din hetna neipei!

tcz: Nangma ging ho jousen kei a konna hin kipa na mu u heuhen, ajeh chu keiman nathupeh ahin kinepna dihtah kanei in ahi.
en_web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
en_kjv: (י) They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; Because I have hoped in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathutep akisong kahijeh-in Jatah a nabolten eimuteng kipah-unte!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keiman na Dan semho adihdan hi kahethem tai, neisuhgim ji ding hi keidia thil phachom ahi.
en_web: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
en_kjv: (י) I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, And that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai nathutan jouse adih cheh-e, Nakitah jal’a neibolgim ahi!

tcz: Tuhin nasohpa neiteppeh bangin namingailutna longlou chun eilungmonsah jin ahi.
en_web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
en_kjv: (י) Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha neiteppeh bangin Nalungset longlouvin neilhamonin!

tcz: Kahintheina dingin namihepina chun neiumkimvel jingin ajeh chu neithuhilna hohi keidinga kipana leh lunglhaina ahi.
en_web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
en_kjv: (י) Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: For thy law is my delight.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthua kipah jing kahi, Kadamtheina din neihepin!

tcz: Keichung changa thujou seiho miphalou hochu jumle jachatna penlang, keivangin nangma thupehho chu kangai jingding ahinai.
en_web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
en_kjv: (י) Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: But I will meditate in thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Jouva eiheh kiletsahte kijumdsou hen, Kenvang neihilna kachin jing ding ahi!

tcz: Nangma Dan he themho leh nangma ging jingho chutoh nei ki vopkhom sah jingin.
en_web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
en_kjv: (י) Let those that fear thee turn unto me, And those that have known thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho hephachan, Jatah a nabol chan kahegna hungu hen!

tcz: Na Dan thu kajuina ahin bolkhel kaneilouna dingin neivengin, chutileh jumna leh jachatna kaneilou ding ahi.
en_web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
en_kjv: (י) Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; That I be not ashamed. CAPH.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal kalel a kajum louna din Nathupehho lhingkeiyin juithei tave leng!

tcz: Nangma huhdohna ding kangana lamma hin abeipaiding kahitai, ahinlah nathupeh ahin kakinepna adetjinge.
en_web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
en_kjv: (כ) My soul fainteth for thy salvation: But I hope in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathu kineppin neihuhhing ding Ka-ngah lel lheh tai Pakai!

tcz: Nakitepna ahung gulhunna ding vetnan kamit achahleutai, itih tahleh neilhamon dingham?
en_web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
en_kjv: (כ) Mine eyes fail for thy word, Saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
tcz_gospelgo: Neiteppeh kavet vetnan kamit akhamtan, “Itih tah le neipanpi dem,” kati!

tcz: Lengpi twipai savun ahun ahulgot bangin kagolhatai ahinlah na Dan thu juiding kasumil dehpon ahi.
en_web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
en_kjv: (כ) For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Meiya kihulgo lengpitwipai savun go kabangnan, Nachondan ho vang kasumil deh poi!

tcz: Itihchanpi hi kanga jingding hitam? Keima eibolse hohi itihleh aphu nalah dingham?
en_web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
en_kjv: (כ) How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
tcz_gospelgo: Itih chan ngah leng Eibolse ho talen namatsah dem?

tcz: Nangma thuhil nahsahlou mi kiletsah hohin keima kipalna ding ko thuhtah alaijun ahi.
en_web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
en_kjv: (כ) The proud have digged pits for me, Which are not after thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu nit lou kiletsah ten Kalhah lutna din khuh alaiyui!

tcz: Nathupeh jouse hi tahsan dinga lomtah cheh ahi. Ajeh bei a eidel lele hoa konhin neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
en_kjv: (כ) All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh chengse kisonpi thei cheh ahin, Min jouthun eidem dem’ui, neipanpin!

tcz: Amaho hin eichaidohpai got u ahitai, ahinla keiman nathupeh hohi kajuida dehpoi.
en_web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
en_kjv: (כ) They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Eithapai tahbah diu ahitan, Hinla nadanthu ho kapaipoi!

tcz: Na mi ngailutna longlou chun kahinkho hi huhdoh'in, chutileh na Dan thu kajui theiding ahi.
en_web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
en_kjv: (כ) Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth. LAMED.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuho kanit theina din Long louvin neilungset’in!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai tonsot a dinga nakitepna chu van a dettah'in aumjinge.
en_web: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
en_kjv: (ל) For ever, O Lord, Thy word is settled in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai nathu hi tonsot’a ding, Van aum jing ding ahi!

tcz: Nangin nanatundoh hiche leiset hi aumjing bangin nakitahna jong akhang khanga umjing ahi.
en_web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
en_kjv: (ל) Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhang khanga kitah jingnahin, Leiset naphutdet’in aum jinge!

tcz: Nathilgon jouse hi nathupeh dungjui in tuni chan geihin aumsohkei un ahi, ajeh chu amahohi aboncha nalhacha ahisoh kei un ahi.
en_web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
en_kjv: (ל) They continue this day according to thine ordinances: For all are thy servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseipeh bang bangin thil ijakai tuni geiyin aumun, Abonchan namanchah-in apang cheh-ui!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hin kipana hinkho'ah eihin khoukhah hihleh kagenthei lengvaina a kana mol lem ding ahitai.
en_web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
en_kjv: (ל) Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthua kipah jing lou hileng, Genthei thoh a kathiden ding ahitai!

tcz: Na thupeh Dan hohi itihchan hijongleh ka suhmillou helding ahi, ajeh chu hicheho hin eihinghoi ahi.
en_web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
en_kjv: (ל) I will never forget thy precepts: For with them thou hast quickened me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihinsona ahijeh-in Nathuhil ho nahsahmo hih hel’inge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nanga kahi; neihuhdoh'in! Ajeh chu nadan thu nitna a hin ka kihabol lheh jenge.
en_web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
en_kjv: (ל) I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanga kahi, neihuhhingin! Nathupehho nit tei kagoi!

tcz: Mi phalouhon suhmang dingin lampi dungah eichanglhi le jonguleh kei man vang na Dan thuhi kalung sungah thipbeh chan geljing nange.
en_web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
en_kjv: (ל) The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: But I will consider thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten thadin eichang jingun, Kenvang nadanthu kagel jinge!

tcz: Thiljouse hin akhonna aneisoh keije ahinlah na Dan thupeh hin akhonna aneipoi.
en_web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
en_kjv: (ל) I have seen an end of all perfection: But thy commandment is exceeding broad. MEM.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil jousen kikhonna anei cheh-in, Nang thupeh vang chamkimsoh ahi!

tcz: Oh, na Dan thupeh hi iti kahin dei hitam! Ni lhumkei kei in hicheho hi kageljin in ahi.
en_web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
en_kjv: (מ) O how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai nadanthu kadei lheh jengin, kagel nilhum lhum’e!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hohin kagal mite sangin eichihsah'e, ajeh chu hicheho hin phattin in eiveng jinge.
en_web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
en_kjv: (מ) Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh kachin jing jeh-in Kamelmate sangin eichihsah tai!

tcz: Na Dan thuhi phattin a ka geljing jeh'in eihilho sangin jong hetgilna ka neijotai.
en_web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
en_kjv: (מ) I have more understanding than all my teachers: For thy testimonies are my meditation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilna kachin jing jeh-in Eihil ho sangin kahethemjoi!

tcz: Na thupeh Dan ho kanitjing jeh'in kachunga upa tehse ho sangin jong kachingjo tai.
en_web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
en_kjv: (מ) I understand more than the ancients, Because I keep thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho kanit jeh-in Upate sangin jong kachingjoi!

tcz: Nathupeh dettah a kajuijing theina dingin thilse bolna a cheding kanompon ahi.
en_web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
en_kjv: (מ) I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might keep thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei kanit nom jeh-in Chon gitlou khatcha kabolpoi!

tcz: Nangin phate keicha neihil ahitah jeh'in na Dan thu juina a konnin ka ki heimang nompon ahi.
en_web: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
en_kjv: (מ) I have not departed from thy judgments: For thou hast taught me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihilpa Nangtah nahijeh-in Nahilna nahsah mon kabolpoi!

tcz: Na thupeh hi kapatep leh alhum lheh jenge, khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi.
en_web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
en_kjv: (מ) How sweet are thy words unto my taste! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
tcz_gospelgo: Namihil angei behseh-in, Khoiju sanga lhumjon kabol’e!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hohin hetthemna eipen; hiti chun hinkho adihlou lam a cheding hi kathet lheh ji e.
en_web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
en_kjv: (מ) Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way. NUN.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu chihnan kaneiyin

tcz: Nathupeh hi kakalsonna a eipuiding thaomei jin apangin, kalampi salvah ding vah'in apangin ahi.
en_web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
en_kjv: (נ) Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathu hi kakalsena thei thaomei ahin, Kalampi salvah a pang ahi!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh dihtah hohi kajuijing ding ahin, hiche dinga hi kitepna kananei ahitan avel a kakitep kitding ahi.
en_web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
en_kjv: (נ) I have sworn, and I will perform it, That I will keep thy righteous judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilna dihtah ho nitna dia Giltah a kakitepna molsonge!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nathutep dungjui in ka hinkho hoidoh sah'in ajeh chu kathohlel behseh jenge.
en_web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.
en_kjv: (נ) I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathoh lel behseh tai Pakai! Natepsa bangin neicho hingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah nahi kilhaina thilto bangin neisanpeh'in lang chuleh na Dan thupeh ho neihil in.
en_web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
en_kjv: (נ) Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, And teach me thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah a kataon asangin O Pakai! Nathupehho neihil’in!

tcz: Keima ka hinkho hi kilep ditdet in aum e, ahinlah na thuhil hi ka juidadeh pong e.
en_web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
en_kjv: (נ) My soul is continually in my hand: Yet do I not forget thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Thi ngam a pang jing kahin, Nadanthu kasumil poi!

tcz: Mi phalou hon ka kipalna dingin thang akam jingun ahi, ahi vangin nathupeh'a kon a ka ki heimang doh louding ahi.
en_web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
en_kjv: (נ) The wicked have laid a snare for me: Yet I erred not from thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouten thang eikampeh nan, Nathupehho kanitda deh poi!

tcz: Na Dan thu hi keidinga gou ahi, hicheho hin ka lungthim akipasah'in ahi.
en_web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
en_kjv: (נ) Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupeh chengse katonsot gou ahin, Kalungthima kakipana ahi!

tcz: Ka thini changei a na Dan thu nitding hi ka dinpi ahitai.
en_web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
en_kjv: (נ) I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes Alway, even unto the end. SAMECH.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathi ni geiya Nachondan ho jui din ka-umtai!

tcz: Kitahna neiloute hi kathet ahin keivang na thuhil ho jui dinghi katha nopna ahi.
en_web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
en_kjv: (ס) I hate vain thoughts: But thy law do I love.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung tho neiho kahon, Nadanthu kadei lheh jenge!

tcz: Nangma hi kakiselna leh kalumdal nahi, nathupeh hi kakinepna bulpi ahijinge.
en_web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
en_kjv: (ס) Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Eipanpea eihoidam nahin, Nathutep kakineppi!

tcz: Milung gilouho keija kon in potdoh'un, ajeh chu keiman ka Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi kajuinom e.
en_web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
en_kjv: (ס) Depart from me, ye evildoers: For I will keep the commandments of my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chedoh-un michonsete, Ka-Pathen thupeh chengse ni tnange!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, nakitepna bangin kahinjouna dingin tha neipen kakinepna hi neijumso hihbeh'in,
en_web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
en_kjv: (ס) Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: And let me not be ashamed of my hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinso dia neitepna bangin tha neipen, Kakinepna subei loujenin!

tcz: Nathahatnan neituh'in chutileh kahoidohding ahi, chutengleh nathupeh hi kachepi jingding ahi.
en_web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
en_kjv: (ס) Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: And I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Neituh le chun hing jouving ting, Nathupeh chengse khohsah jing nange!

tcz: Nathupeh a kon a potdoh hohi nangin napaidoh gamheltan ahi. Amahohi amahole amaho kijoulhep ahibouve.
en_web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
en_kjv: (ס) Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: For their deceit is falsehood.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu nit lou ho napamsen, Jouva athilgonu pannabei ahi!

tcz: Nangin mi-engse hochu leiset chunga konnin bohse bangin napaidoh jitan ahi, hijeh chun kei vangin na Dan thuho hi kajui nom e.
en_web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
en_kjv: (ס) Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset migiloute iman nasimpon, Kenvang namihilna hi kadeipen’e!

tcz: Nangma ginnan ka kithinge, na thutan dihtah ho jeh'in ki chatnan kadim e.
en_web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
en_kjv: (ס) My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments. AIN.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang gin nan kakithing thingin, Nathutan ho pi kakichai!

tcz: Keiman thudih tahleh kitahna neitah'in na katonge, kagal mite khut a neidalhahih'in.
en_web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
en_kjv: (ע) I have done judgment and justice: Leave me not to mine oppressors.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih le apha kabolnai, Kamelmate kachepna din neidalha hih-in!

tcz: Phatthei neibohding kinepna neipen, mi kiletsahho neibolsetsah hihbeh'in.
en_web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
en_kjv: (ע) Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhachapa neipanpi din seiyin, Pathen heloute neibolgimsah dan!

tcz: Nathutep dihtah chu asuh bulhit nadinga neihuhdohna dingchu kavet vetnan kamit achah leutan ahi.
en_web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
en_kjv: (ע) Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for the word of thy righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Huhdoh dia nathutep ngah a Namihuhhing kavet vetnan kamit akhamtai!

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chun nasoh hi neibolpha jingin, chuleh na Dan thuho chu neihil in.
en_web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (ע) Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, And teach me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Neilungset jing jengin, Nathupehho neihil jingin!

tcz: Na Dan thuhohi kahettheina dingin nasohhi hetthem theina neipen.
en_web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
en_kjv: (ע) I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha kahi, namihilna ho kahet theina din, Hetkhen themna neipen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tu hi nakipatna na tohphat ahitai, ajeh chu miphalouhon na Dan thu apal kehgam tauve.
en_web: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
en_kjv: (ע) It is time for thee, Lord, to work: For they have made void thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, migilouten nadanthu apalkehtai! Phoh-in lang sutang loiyin!

tcz: Tahbeh'in nathupeh hohi sana mantampen sangin kadeijon ahi.
en_web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
en_kjv: (ע) Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold; yea, above fine gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Sana thengsel le hoitah sangin Nathupehho kadeijoi!

tcz: Na thupeh hohi adihsoh kei in, hijeh'a chu lamdihlou hohi kathet ahi.
en_web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
en_kjv: (ע) Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; And I hate every false way. PE.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahilna chengse kajuiyin, Lamdih lou jouse kahoi!

tcz: Na Dan semhohi akidang theilheh jengin hijeh'a chu kalungthim pumpia kajui ahi!
en_web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
en_kjv: (פ) Thy testimonies are wonderful: Therefore doth my soul keep them.
tcz_gospelgo: Namihilna ho akidang lheh-e, Kalungthim pumpin kajuiye!

tcz: Na Dan thuhil'a hin vah akilangin hijeh chun milham minjong ahetheijin ahi.
en_web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
en_kjv: (פ) The entrance of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.
tcz_gospelgo: Namihilna hilchet hikhovah tobang, Khopolou chihsah jeng thei ahi!

tcz: Nathupeh ho kangaichat behseh jeh'in kaki gon chule kakam kah in kangah jinge.
en_web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
en_kjv: (פ) I opened my mouth, and panted: For I longed for thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho deichan Kakahel hol jenge!

tcz: Nangma ngailuho nabolna bangin hung kihei in lang nami khotona neimusah'in.
en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
en_kjv: (פ) Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-ngailute nabolna bangin, Hung kiheiyin neihepin!

tcz: Nakitepna dungjuijin kalhuh louna dingin neituh'in, thilse eijosah hihbeh'in.
en_web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
en_kjv: (פ) Order my steps in thy word: And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Natepsa bangin neilhuhsah dan, Thilse neijosah hih-in!

tcz: Eisugenthei hoa kon in neihuhdoh'in, hitiachu nathupehho hoitah'a kajuijing theina dingin.
en_web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
en_kjv: (פ) Deliver me from the oppression of man: So will I keep thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho kanit theina din Eibolsetea konin neihuhdoh-in!

tcz: Nasohpa kei ahin namaivah chu hin kilan dohsah'in chutengleh na Dan thuchu neihil in.
en_web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (פ) Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Namaivah-in neisalvah jingin, Nadanthu ho neihil jingin!

tcz: Mi hemten na thuhil ajuitah lou jeh'un kamit na hin mitlhi twi vadung bangin along'e.
en_web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
en_kjv: (פ) Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, Because they keep not thy law. TZADDI.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon nadanthu anit loujeh-un Ka-lhi twilonin alonge!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudihtah nahi, na Dan semho jong adih'e.
en_web: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
en_kjv: (צ) Righteous art thou, O Lord, And upright are thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai Nangma nadidh-in, Nadanthu akitah cheh-e!

tcz: Na Dan semhohi nolnabei ahin chuleh tahsanthei mong mong ahi.
en_web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
en_kjv: (צ) Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous And very faithful.
tcz_gospelgo: Dan nasemsa ho hi Achamkimin, adih-in aphai!

tcz: Ka galmiten na thupeh hi anahsah loujeh'un ka lunghan hi aki khonhel jengin ahi.
en_web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
en_kjv: (צ) My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmaten nathupehho anahsah loujeh-in, Kalung hang behseh jenge!

tcz: Na thutep hohi kapatep sohkei ahitan adih lheh jeng in keiman ka deilheh jenge.
en_web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
en_kjv: (צ) Thy word is very pure: Therefore thy servant loveth it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathutep thon mo ahin, Kadei lheh jenge!

tcz: Keima hi hetkhamlou leh notthap ka hivang in nathupeh hohi ka sumil dehpoi.
en_web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
en_kjv: (צ) I am small and despised: Yet do not I forget thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: koi isah loule ima kahi lou vangin, Namihilna ho kadonda poi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nanga hin tonsotna thudih na aum e, chuleh na thuhil dihtah ho jonghi nolnabei ahi.
en_web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
en_kjv: (צ) Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih a dih jing nahin, Nadanthu jong adih jinge!

tcz: Hahsat na le lung khamna in eilonvuh jeng jongleh nathupeh hohi keidinga kipana tahbeh ahijinge.
en_web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
en_kjv: (צ) Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: Yet thy commandments are my delights.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gim genthei kathoh nan Nathupehhon eikipasah jie!

tcz: Na Dan semho jouse jonghi adihjing jenge, hinna ka neitheina dingin neihet them sah'in.
en_web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
en_kjv: (צ) The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: Give me understanding, and I shall live. KOPH.
tcz_gospelgo: Namihilna ho adih jinge, Kahin theina din hetkhen themna neipen!

tcz: Kalungthim pumpin kataove O Yahweh Pakai neihouvin, keiman na Dan thuho chu kanit jingding ahi.
en_web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.
en_kjv: (ק) I cried with my whole heart; Hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthim pumpin nahenga kataove, Neihouvin Pakai, nathupehho nit nange!

tcz: Nangma kahin kouve Yahweh Pakai neihuh doh'in, na Dan thuho chu ka juijing thei nadin.
en_web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
en_kjv: (ק) I cried unto thee; save me, And I shall keep thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga kataove, neihuhhingin Nadanthuho nit nange!

tcz: Khovah masangin matah'in kathouvin, nathutep na chun kakinem in panpi kathum e.
en_web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
en_kjv: (ק) I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Niso man neipanpi din kataovin, Nathutep kakineppi!

tcz: Jan khovah'in kahah'in nathutep chu kagel jinge.
en_web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
en_kjv: (ק) Mine eyes prevent the night watches, That I might meditate in thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Namihilna ho kagel gel nan Jan khovah-in mitsing mon ka-um’e!

tcz: Nami ngailutna dihtah'a konchun O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang na Dan thu juina ahin neichoh hing kittan.
en_web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.
en_kjv: (ק) Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Guitan mon neilungset’in, neihouvin O Pakai! Neihepin, neihoidam sel’in!

tcz: Dan neilou miten eihung delkhum un ahi, amahohi nangma thuhilla kon in agamlha lheh'un ahi.
en_web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
en_kjv: (ק) They draw nigh that follow after mischief: They are far from thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu nit lou, Giloutah a eibolsete ahung naiye!

tcz: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai nangma naichan naum in ahi, chuleh nangma thupehho jouse adih'in ahi.
en_web: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
en_kjv: (ק) Thou art near, O Lord; And all thy commandments are truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla kakoma naum jing nan, Nathupehho kilonglou ahi Pakai!

tcz: Na Dan semhohi tonsot a ding ahije tihi kaneolai a patna kanahetsa ahitai.
en_web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
en_kjv: (ק) Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old That thou hast founded them for ever. RESH.
tcz_gospelgo: Masangin jong namihilna ho kasimtan, Tonsot’a um jin gdia nasei ahi!

tcz: Kathoh gimna hi venlang neihuhdoh'in, ajeh chu keiman na thuhil hochu ka sumil khapoi.
en_web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
en_kjv: (ר) Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: For I do not forget thy law.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathohna ven neihuhhingin Pakai! Nadanthu kasumil khapoi!

tcz: Keima langa pangin lang ka chung chang thu neiseipeh'in nakitepna bangin neihuh doh'in.
en_web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
en_kjv: (ר) Plead my cause, and deliver me: Quicken me according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipanhun chamlhat neimusah-in, Natepsa banginneihuhhingin!

tcz: Mi phalou hovang ki huhdoh louding ahiuve. Ajeh chu amahon na Dan thu hi anahsah pouve.
en_web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
en_kjv: (ר) Salvation is far from the wicked: For they seek not thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthuho nit lou, Migiloute huhhingin umponte!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namihe pina hi anasalheh jenge, na Dan semhohi jui ing kating ka hinkho hi neikile dohsah tan.
en_web: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
en_kjv: (ר) Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: Quicken me according to thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Neilainatpina alen’e Pakai! Neihepin, neihuhhingin!

tcz: Mitamtah'in asugenthei jin eisuboijin ahi, ahinlah na Dan thu juina a kon in kakiheimang dehpoi.
en_web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
en_kjv: (ר) Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; Yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
tcz_gospelgo: Mibolse melma kahao lheh nan, Nadanthuho kanitdapoi!

tcz: Hitobanga mikitahlou hohi ka muting leh ka lungnatpi lhehjin ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin na Dan thu hi anahsah pouvin ahi.
en_web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
en_kjv: (ר) I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; Because they kept not thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho la nit lou Mi lhemchavai ho kamuteng kalung ana behseh-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ven na thupeh hi ichangei a ka gelkhoh hitam, na mingailut na longlou jal in ka hinkho hi neilepeh kit in.
en_web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.
en_kjv: (ר) Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.
tcz_gospelgo: Namihilna ho kadeidan vetan Pakai! Milungset jing nahi neihuhhingin!

tcz: Na Dan hung kipatna thuguh chu thutah ahi, na Dan thu dihtah hohi tonsot a dingjing ding ahi.
en_web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
en_kjv: (ר) Thy word is true from the beginning: And every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever. SCHIN.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu migil chu atah ahin, Dihtah a thu natanho ho tonsot’a ding ahi!

tcz: Mi thanei hon dihloutah'in eibol seuve, ahinlah keiman nathupeh hi ka lungthim in ginna kanei jinge.
en_web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
en_kjv: (ש) Princes have persecuted me without a cause: But my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi huseten alam louvin eidel khum jongle Nadanthu kaging jingnai!

tcz: Khat touvin gou nasatah akimudoh bangin nathupeh ahin kakipah'in ahi.
en_web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
en_kjv: (ש) I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
tcz_gospelgo: Goukhol mudoh pa kipa bangin Nathutep ho kakipapi lheh-e!

tcz: Keiman jou le nal kitihi kathetnin ahinlah nathupeh hohi kagelkhoh'e.
en_web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
en_kjv: (ש) I hate and abhor lying: But thy law do I love.
tcz_gospelgo: Jouthu pou pou kalohsoh-in kahoi, Nasanthu vang kadei lheh-e!

tcz: Na Dan thu hohi adihjeh'in nikhat in sagivei thangvah na penge.
en_web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
en_kjv: (ש) Seven times a day do I praise thee Because of thy righteous judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathutan ho dih jal’in Niseh-in sagi vei vei kathangvah jinge!

tcz: Nang ma Dan thu ho gelkhoh na neiho jousen thahatna anei un ahi chuleh kipalna aneipou vin ahi.
en_web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
en_kjv: (ש) Great peace have they which love thy law: And nothing shall offend them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu ngailute lung mongin aumun, Akipal lhuhna diu imacha aumpoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaicha lheh jengin ahi, hijeh'a chu nathupeh ho hi ka juijing ahi.
en_web: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
en_kjv: (ש) Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, And done thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihuhhing din ka-ngah-in Nasei sei kabol’e Pakai!

tcz: Na Dan semhohi kahinjui jinge ajeh chu hicheho hi deium ka salheh jenge.
en_web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
en_kjv: (ש) My soul hath kept thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei jouse kanit’in, Kalungthim pumpin kadei lheh-e!

tcz: Ahi, keiman nathupeh hole na Dan semhohi kajui jinge ajeh chu nangin ka kiman chahna jouse nahen ahi.
en_web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
en_kjv: (ש) I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: For all my ways are before thee. TAU.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho le nahilna ho kajuiyin, Kabol katoh chan neimui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kahin kou nahi ngai in nangin neitep pehna bangin het them theina lungthim neipen.
en_web: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.
en_kjv: (ת) Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: Give me understanding according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Panpina kathum’e ngaiyin Pakai! Neiteppeh bangin hetkhen themna neipen!

tcz: Ka taona hi ngai in, nathutep na bangin nei huhdoh tei in.
en_web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
en_kjv: (ת) Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin lang, Nathutep bangin neihuhhingin!

tcz: Kakam a kon in thangvahna hi hung lengdoh jenghen ajeh chu nangman na Dan thu hohi neihil themtan ahi.
en_web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
en_kjv: (ת) My lips shall utter praise, When thou hast taught me thy statutes.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadanthu neihil jeh a Kavahchoi jing ding nahi!

tcz: Kalei in nathupeh hohi thangvah lan sa hen, ajeh chu nathupeh jouse hi adih'in ahi.
en_web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
en_kjv: (ת) My tongue shall speak of thy word: For all thy commandments are righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho adih jeh-in Nadanthu lachoiyinge!

tcz: Nei kithopina khutchu hin lhangdoh'in ajeh chu na thupeh ho juidinga kigotna kanei ahitai.
en_web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
en_kjv: (ת) Let thine hand help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathupehho kajui jinge, Eipanpi din kigo jingin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaichat jing ahi, ajeh chu nangma thuhil hohi kakipana ahijinge.
en_web: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
en_kjv: (ת) I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; And thy law is my delight.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai neipanpia neihuhhing ding ka-ngaiye! Nadanthua kipah thanom kahi!

tcz: Nangma ka thangvah jing theina dingin nei hing hoi in, chuleh nathupeh hohi eikithopin pangjing hen.
en_web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
en_kjv: (ת) Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thy judgments help me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang kavahchoina din neicho hingin! Neihilna hon eikithopiu hen!

tcz: Kelngoi banga vahmanga kahitai hungin lang neihung holdoh tan ajeh chu nathupeh hohi keiman kasumil theipoi.
en_web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
en_kjv: (ת) I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi vah mang banga kava mang vangin, Nadanthuho kasumilpoi, nalhacha keima neiholdoh-in!

tcz: Lungkham na leh lung gim na kato tengleh Yahweh Pakai kom kalhutjin ahileh Aman kataona asangjin ahi.
en_web: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
en_kjv: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, And he heard me.
tcz_gospelgo: Gim hesoh teng Pakai kakouvin, Aman eihoutai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai in mijoubol ho a konleh milepche ho a kon in neihuhdoh'in.
en_web: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
en_kjv: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, And from a deceitful tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Mijoute le lhemchavaitea konin Neihuhhingin Pakai!

tcz: Oh lepchena leigui mangcha ho, Elohim Pathen in nangho ipi na louvin tem? Aman nachunga engbolna ichan gei in apunsahbe dem?
en_web: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
en_kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, Thou false tongue?
tcz_gospelgo: Mijouho, Pathenin inalo diu? Itobanga nabolgim diu ham?

tcz: Nangma thalchang hemtah a naki sunding chuleh meihol sapehpoh naki desah ding ahi.
en_web: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
en_kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.
tcz_gospelgo: Galkappa thalcahng hemtah le Longlaobal meiya kito-am leng lung ducha nahiuvam?

tcz: Gamlatah Meshach lah'a ka chenchu kadanave, gamlatah Kedar ponbuh a ka chenchu ka thohlel ngeije,
en_web: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
en_kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, That I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva chen hi Meshech a chen le Kedar mite lah a chen nommo bep ahi!

tcz: Keima chamna deilah'a kachenhi kakhoplheh jengtai,
en_web: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
en_kjv: My soul hath long dwelt With him that hateth peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Cham deimote lah a kacheng sot behseh tai!

tcz: Keiman chamna kahol in, ahinlah keiman chamna thu kaseipou pouleh amahon gal bou adeijiu ve.
en_web: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
en_kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
tcz_gospelgo: Chamna thu kisei teng Gal asohji tauve!

tcz: Keima kadah'in thinglhanglam kavei, hichea kon a khu eipanpi hung hintem?
en_web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
en_kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, From whence cometh my help.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsang dunga kona Eipanpi hung dia kagaldot ding ham?

tcz: Vanle lei sem pa Paka a kon a eipanpi hung ahi.
en_web: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
en_kjv: My help cometh from the Lord, Which made heaven and earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset Sempa pakaiya kona Eipanpi hung ding ahibouve!

tcz: Aman nangma nakipalsah louding; nachingpa chu ihmu louding ahi.
en_web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
en_kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachingpan nave jing nai, Nakipal lhuhsah ponte!

tcz: Tahbeh'in Israel chingpa chu itihchan hijongleh ihmu lhulou ding ahilouleh ihmu louding ahi.
en_web: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
en_kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Shall neither slumber nor sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel chingpa chu Kisep lhun akijamden ngaipoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai amatah chu nachingpa ahi! Ama nakom a ading jingin nahoidohna lim in apang jinge.
en_web: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
en_kjv: The Lord is thy keeper: The Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin na-ngah jingin, Nahuh din najet’a adding jinge!

tcz: Sun leh nisan nasangpeh pontin, janleh lhavah injong nasubeipon te.
en_web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
en_kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun teng nisan sang ponnatin, Jan teng lhavah-in sal pinnate!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thilse jousea nahoidohsah in tin nahinkho chingjing nante.
en_web: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
en_kjv: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: He shall preserve thy soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin thilse jousea daldoh intin, Nahoidam jing nante!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in tuapat tonsot gei in navai kondoh leh nahung vailhun in nachingjing tahen.
en_web: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
en_kjv: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth, and even for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua pat tonsont geiyin Pakaiyin Navaikon navailhunin ching jing hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hou inn ah cheuhite tia kakom a asei u chun keima kakipahlheh jengin ahi.
en_web: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
en_kjv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai Houin a cheute” atiu chun Kakipah lheh jenge!

tcz: Vo Jerusalem tuhin keiho nakelkot sung langah kadingtao ve.
en_web: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
en_kjv: Our feet shall stand Within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun Jerusalem kulpi sunga Kadingsoh tauve!

tcz: Jerusalem hi dettah'a kisa khopi ahin apal jonghi detchetna kigenbitna ahi.
en_web: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
en_kjv: Jerusalem is builded As a city that is compact together:
tcz_gospelgo: Hoitah le kitoh chet’a kisem Jerusalem khopi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai mite Israel phungho jousen hicheahi kintheng bolla ahungnao ahi. Israelte chonna dan dungjui a Yahweh Pakai kom a thangvahna pedinga ahungnao ahi.
en_web: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, Unto the testimony of Israel, To give thanks unto the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupeh ddungjuiya Pakai thangvah dia Israel phung namkim kijot touna!

tcz: Hichea hin lengte thutanna laltouna hochu aum in David chilhah ho laltouna ahi.
en_web: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
en_kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel lengte ahungun, Mipi thutan din atoutauve!

tcz: Jerusalem a cham lenna din taovun, hiche khopi ngailu jouse khangtouhen.
en_web: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
en_kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem cham lenna din taovin; “Nakhohsah mite khangtou hen;

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, nakulpi sunga chamleng hen chuleh nakhopi sung khangtou hen.
en_web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
en_kjv: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhosung cham leng hen, Naleng inpi dunga lung mon um hen,” tiuvin!

tcz: Kainsung mite leh kagol kapaite khohsahna in keiman Jerusalem ah “Nanga chamna umhen” kati.
en_web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
en_kjv: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-inkote le kagolte khohsah jal’in, Jerusalem jah-a “Nasunga cham leng hen,” kati.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u insung khohsah na'in, O Jerusalem nang dinga aphapen chu kahol ahi.
en_web: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
en_kjv: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai i-Pathenu Houin khohsah jal’in Naphatna din katao jinge!

tcz: Van a alaltouna a tou O ka Pathen Elohim nangma munomna in kadah'in kahinvei.
en_web: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
en_kjv: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, van a nalaltouna lam Dah-in kahinvei!

tcz: Sohten amit uva apupao avetjing bangun Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim khotona ngaichan keihon kahin vejing ui. Hiti hin soh nungah honjong api'u chaloh akivetgeu jingun ahi.
en_web: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
en_kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, And as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, Until that he have mercy upon us.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohpan apu aki-ngainaa Sohnun api aki-ngaina bangin, O Pakai ka-Pathenu, neihepi masang seuvin Naheng lam jeng kaveuve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ka chung u vah khotona neipeuvin ajeh chu keiho hi vetda changsa ka hiuve.
en_web: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
en_kjv: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihepiuvin O Pakai, neihepiuvin! Hitobang hin min eihot bol’ui!

tcz: Ajeh chu keihohi mi kiletsahho housetna leh mikhoh ho tai tomnan eichupmu ahitai.
en_web: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
en_kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scorning of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihaote eihouse se jengun, Kiletsah gilouten eihou thanguve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh? Israelte jousen velseikit hen.
en_web: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
en_kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, Now may Israel say;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eipanpi dau hileh I-atiding nahet’um Israel?

tcz: Min eina delkhum pettah'un Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh,
en_web: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
en_kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, When men rose up against us:
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathenin eipanpi dau hivangleh Melmaten eidel khumu chun,

tcz: amahon alunghan u deojah pum in ahingin eina vallhum tauvinte.
en_web: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
en_kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, When their wrath was kindled against us:
tcz_gospelgo: Eilunghanjeh-uva Eibahgam hel theiyu ahi;

tcz: Twi chun einachup uvintin, twikhanglen chun einalhohmang diu ahitai.
en_web: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
en_kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul:
tcz_gospelgo: Twipin eichup’uva Twisoh chun eilhoh manghel theiyu ahi.

tcz: Hitiachu ichunguva twipi kitoltol ding ahiuve.
en_web: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
en_kjv: Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhanghoh ongje jun Eichupsoh hel diu ahi,” tiuvin!

tcz: Igalmiteu einasuhmang sah louva Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhite.
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmate eisuhmang sah dau Pakai chu thangvah jingute!

tcz: Eiho thang kampa a kon a vacha ahoidoh banga hoidoh ihiuve. Thangpou chu akivobong tan eiho ihoidoh tauve.
en_web: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
en_kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
tcz_gospelgo: Vacha thangkol’a toldoh bangin Eiho jong i-toldoh tauvin; Thangkol akibottoan tan, I-ongdoh tauve!

tcz: Hitobanga kithopina chu vanle lei sem ah Yahweh Pakai a kon a imu'u ahi.
en_web: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
en_kjv: Our help is in the name of the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset Sempa Pakaiyin eipanpiuve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai a tahsanna dettah neiho chu Zion mol tobag ahiuve. Amaho chu suhlinghoi hiloudiu a-itih'a detjing ding ahiuve.
en_web: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
en_kjv: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, Which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya ki-ngai jingte chu Zion molsang bangin suh linghoi hiponte!

tcz: Jerusalem mol'in aumkimvel bangin, tuleh tua dingin Yahweh Pakai chu amite kimvel a akisung jinge.
en_web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
en_kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So the Lord is round about his people From henceforth even for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khopi molsangin akol khum bangin, tu le tonsot’in Pakaiyin amite aumchan jinge!

tcz: Michonphate gam a chu miphalou te vaihomna leng teng gol in chan aneilou ding ahi. Achuti louleh michonpha ho jengin jong thilse ahinbol maithei ahi.
en_web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
en_kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; Lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilouvin midih gamsunga Vai ahom louhel ding; Ahomuleh midih chun Thilse abol lo diu ahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai miphaho lungthim nangma toh chekhom theiho chu nangin thilpha bolpeh jingin.
en_web: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
en_kjv: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nathupeh nit jing miphate Phatbol jingin!

tcz: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai lamdihlouva chete chu thildihlou bolte toh paidohtha jengin. Israelte lah'a cham lenghen!
en_web: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
en_kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, The Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: But peace shall be upon Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou talen napeh teng Nadanthu dondate jong talen pen! Israel lah a cham leng hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in sohchang hochu Jerusalem a ahinlepuilut kitphatchun, hichu mangtoh abang jengin ahi!
en_web: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
en_kjv: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, We were like them that dream.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Jerusalem eihin lhut kit phat’un Mang lheh lheh ahibouve!

tcz: Keiho lungna chim tah'a nuinan ka dimset jingun, ki pahtah'in la kasauve. Hichun chidang namdang hon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu aboldoh peh tauve” atiuve.
en_web: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
en_kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.
