tcz_gospelgo: Kambem bemin kanuiyun Kipa la kasauve; Chuin namdangten, “Pakaiyin thil loupitah abolpeh tauve,” atiuve!

tcz: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu eiboldoh pehtauve! Iti kipa um a hitam!
en_web: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
en_kjv: The Lord hath done great things for us; Whereof we are glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin thil loupitah eibolpeh nauve, Iti kipa um hitam!

tcz: Neldi gam a twilonglut hon athah semkit bangin O Yahweh Pakai kanei kagouhou hin kiledoh sah kittan.
en_web: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
en_kjv: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, As the streams in the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung kangsa twi dimkit bangin, Kagam lamuva neipui kit tauvin Pakai!

tcz: Mitlhi long pum pum a muchi tuten, kipah thanom tah'a aga akilodiu ahi.
en_web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
en_kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Mit lhi puma muchi tuten Kipah tahnomin aga kilo’u hen!

tcz: Kapjing pum a atuding muchi kipoh'a vaikonten, aga hinkipoh puma inmun kipahle thanomtah'in hung kileuhen.
en_web: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
en_kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kap puma muchi tua vaikon chu Lhoga pon kipa la san hung kile hen!

tcz: Insa-a hi Yahweh Pakai apan louleh, asahon mohseh'a asah'u ahi. Khopi ngah'a hi Yahweh Pakai ajao louleh, khongah ho pannabei a hahkhovah ahiuve.
en_web: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
en_kjv: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: Except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Insaa Pakai apan louleh Insa hon pannabeiya asah-u ahin, Pakaiyin kho a-nga louleh Kho-ngah ho mohseh a janhah ahiuve!

tcz: Jingkah matah'a nakipat uva jankhang gei a nehding an holna a na natoh'u pan nabei ahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in angailut achate hi a-ihmut sunguva hi ijakai agontohpeh ahibouve.
en_web: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
en_kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, To eat the bread of sorrows: For so he giveth his beloved sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: jingpi tah a nathouva Jan khangkima nalup’uva Hitobanga na nahatoh-u hi Pannabei ahibouve! Ajeh chu Pakaiyin aphatcha Amite acholdohdah nom ahi!

tcz: Veuvin, chatehi Yahweh Pakaija kon a gou ahin, naobu sunga kona aga kimu jonghi kipa thilpeh ahi.
en_web: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
en_kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate hi Pakai thilpeh ahin, Pakaiyin vang abohna ahi!

tcz: Khang don laija cha kineiho hi galsatpan akhutna thal changho akichoi tobang ahi.
en_web: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
en_kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; So are children of the youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdong laiya pasal’in chapate aneihi Gal-hangpa thalvhang ho tobang ahi!

tcz: Thal chang abom dimsetna kipohpa anun nom ahi. Amachu agalmite toh thutan na munna akimuto teng gal lel hilouhel ding ahi.
en_web: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
en_kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be ashamed, But they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
tcz_gospelgo: Thalchang banga chapa tampi neipa anun nom’e, Thupi phunga melmate akidintepi teng lel pote!

tcz: Koi hileh Yahweh Pakai ging geh'a um a Ama lunglhaina lampia kalsongho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en_web: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
en_kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; That walketh in his ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thu achon a athupeh Nit jing ho anun nom’ui!

tcz: Nangin nakhutsoh natohga naneh ding ahin, iti nakipading hitam na hinkho kiledoh ding ahitai.
en_web: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
en_kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Natohga nakivah teng Nahaova nom nasah ding ahi!

tcz: Nainsunga najinu jong lengpigui ga phatah banga phatthei punna hiding, ankong phunga an naneh khompi nachate melhoitah tah Olive thingbah lhoutah bangdiu ahi.
en_web: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
en_kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine By the sides of thine house: Thy children like olive plants Round about thy table.
tcz_gospelgo: Insunga najinu lengpigui gaphatah bang ding, nachapate olive bah lha banga Na-ankong dokhang vel’a tougol diu ahi!

tcz: Veuvin, Yahweh Pakai gingte phatthei achandingu chu hitobang hi hiding ahi.
en_web: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
en_kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thu nitpa chu Hitobanga hi phatthei chang ding ahi.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Zion a kon in phatthei nabohjing jinghen, nahinkho lhumkei in Jerusalem machalna mujing jingin.
en_web: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
en_kjv: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: And thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem All the days of thy life.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion konin Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen, Nahinkho lhumkeiyin Jerusalem phatna mun!

tcz: Natuson gei in jong hin munlang, Israel chungah chamleng hen!
en_web: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
en_kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, And peace upon Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangman vang Natuson geiyin hin mun! Israel lah a cham leng hen!

tcz: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi. Israel pumpin hichehi velsei uhen.
en_web: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
en_kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, May Israel now say:
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhangdonglaiya pat namelmaten naabolgim nau seiyin Israel!

tcz: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi, ahinla amahon khatveicha eijoukha pouvin ahi.
en_web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
en_kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: Yet they have not prevailed against me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kakhangdon laiya pat kamelmaten Engse tah-in einabolgim’un; Hinla eijoudeh pouve.

tcz: Katungtun hi maha adiptauvin, loukhoipan lou akhoi chehlah lahtoh abahsah jengun ahi.
en_web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
en_kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: They made long their furrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Katungtun ko cheh chuh-in a-at’un, Kangkuiya kikai abahsah-ui!

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai chu aphatjeh'in miphalouhon khaova eikan nao eisutlhap peh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
en_kjv: The Lord is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla Pakai dihtah chun Kihenna kul’a konin eilhadoh tai!” tin!

tcz: Koi hileh Jerusalem hot leh deimoa bolho jouse chu jumthet in ki nunglekit'u henlang lhuhpiu hen.
en_web: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
en_kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back That hate Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion hotbol chanin Gal lel hen nungjam hen!

tcz: Amahohi pannabei inchung vum a hampa kehtobang, akhan kilhit masanga goplha tobang hiuhen.
en_web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
en_kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth afore it groweth up:
tcz_gospelgo: Inchunga hamhing keh, Akikhanlhit masanga gopden tobangu hen!

tcz: Chang-at hon anotthap'u, chuleh chang kanhon adeimou hihen, chuleh hichelang hopa jousen, “Nachunguva Yahweh Pakai phattheiboh umhen keihon Yahweh Pakai mi in phatthei kahinboh uve” tin seihihbeh'u hen.
en_web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
en_kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
tcz_gospelgo: Chang-at pan amaimoa Changphal kanpan som ding aholmo bang hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in phatthei na boh hen, Yahweh Pakai min in nang ma phatthei ka boh uve, chule nang man na lam jot na chun hichi mi ho chun phatthei na chu sutang jou pou vin te.
en_web: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
en_kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: We bless you in the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajotpa ho khatchan jong, “Pakaiyin phatthei naboh-u hen, Pakai minin vang kaboh-ui,” tida hen!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lunglhahna kotong sunga kon in nangma panpina kahinthum e.
en_web: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
en_kjv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kokhuh sunga konin Kahin kouve Pakai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kakanahi ngai in, kataona hi neingaipeh'in.
en_web: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
en_kjv: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin lang O Pakai, Panpi ngaicha kakou ngaiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kachonset nauhi hoitah'a namelchih ding hileh, koiham O Yahweh Pakai ahingdoh ding?
en_web: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
en_kjv: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
tcz_gospelgo: Kachonsetnau melchih ding hile chun Themmo chang lou ding aumpoi!

tcz: Ahinla Nangin nangma ginje kahetthem theina diuvin ngaidamna neipejiuvin ahi.
en_web: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
en_kjv: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.
tcz_gospelgo: Kajabol chehna diuvin Neingaidam’uvin!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh ka Pakai nangma panpina kinem tah'in kangah'e. Henge, keima nangma a ki ngaijing kahi. Keiman athusei katahsan'in hichea kinem a ngahjing kahi.
en_web: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
en_kjv: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Kinemtah-in Pakai panpi ka-ngah-in, Athu katahsan jinge!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu ka ngahlel ngei e, kho ngahpan khovah ding angalel sangin kangahlel joi.
en_web: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
en_kjv: My soul waiteth for the Lord More than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan ngahhonkhovah nga lel sang chun Pakai ka-ngah lel joi!

tcz: Vo Israel, Yahweh Pakaija kinem in, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai ahin longlou ngailutna umma ahin chuleh ama a hin lhatdamna lhingset in aum in ahi.
en_web: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
en_kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord: For with the Lord there is mercy, And with him is plenteous redemption.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu lungset longlou Huhhing nom jing ahi, Tahsanin Israel Achonset chengeuva konin huhhinginte!

tcz: Amatah'in Israel chu achonsetna jouse a konna ahuhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
en_kjv: And he shall redeem Israel From all his iniquities.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, kalungthim akiletsah poi; kamit ha dan jong kihi sahna aumpoi. Keima hi thil thupitah in jong kakigel pon keimat phah din jong aloupi behseh e.
en_web: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
en_kjv: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, kiletsah kabangin, Hoitho ka-ngatai! Thil loupe tah tah jong kagelpon, Ahahsa behseh jong kadonpoi!

tcz: Hiche sang chun keima kahina kalung lhaipen lung ol heuvin kaum in ahi. Naosen anu noitwi ngaicha talou bang in lung ollin kaum in, naosen lungmonga aum bangin keijong kalhagao lungmong in aum e.
en_web: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
en_kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, As a child that is weaned of his mother: My soul is even as a weaned child.
tcz_gospelgo: Naosen anu pheichunga atip del bangin, Lung ol-heo, lung mongin ka-umjoi!

tcz: O Israel tule tonsotnin Yahweh Pakaijah lungmong'in ummin.
en_web: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
en_kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord From henceforth and for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel, tu le tonsot’in Pakaiya ki-ngai jingin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai David hi athohgim na jouse pum in hin geldoh'in.
en_web: LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
en_kjv: Lord, remember David, And all his afflictions:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, David gim gantheina ho Sumil loujenin-o!

tcz: Aman Yahweh Pakai ah kitepna gimneitah'in anase in ahi. Aman Israel Pathen Elohim ah kitepna ananei in ahi.
en_web: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
en_kjv: How he sware unto the Lord, And vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Hatchungnung Jacob Pathen, Nahenga David kitepna chu geldoh-in Pakai!

tcz: “Keima kain ah cheponge, keima kicholdo ponge,
en_web: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
en_kjv: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;
tcz_gospelgo: “In jon lou, Jalkhun jon louvin um ing ting;

tcz: keiman kamit kicholdo sah ponge ahilou leh kamit imutsah ponge,
en_web: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
en_kjv: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids,
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo louleh Ihmu louhel’in um inge;

tcz: Keiman ka Yahweh Pakai dinga inkhat sahna ding mun kamu kahsen, Israel Pathen Elohim a dingin muntheng kamu kahsen!”
en_web: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
en_kjv: Until I find out a place for the Lord, A habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Jacob Pathen dia Mun kamua Houin kasah peh masangsen,” anati.

tcz: Vetan hiche thing kong dinghi Ephrathah a aume ti kajaovin Jaar loujao dunga hiche mun hi kana mudoh tauve.
en_web: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
en_kjv: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: We found it in the fields of the wood.
tcz_gospelgo: Bethlehem a Kitepna thingkong thu kajauvin, jearim loujaova kamudoh-uve!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chenna mun a cheu hitin akengphang bul ah chibai boh'u hite.
en_web: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
en_kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: We will worship at his footstool.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai Houin a cheutin, Alaltouna maiya chibai boh-uhite,” katiuve.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thouvin nacholdona mun a chun luttan nathahat melchihna thingkong chutoh lutthatan.
en_web: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
en_kjv: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepna thingkong to lonin, Nathahatna kihetna pumin Tonsot’a um jing din Houn sung hinjontan Pakai!

tcz: Nathempuhon chonphatna ponsil chu kisil uhen; nalhacha dihtah hon kipa la sauhen.
en_web: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
en_kjv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathempute chondih jing hen, Namithengten kipa othongin samu hen!

tcz: Nalhacha David khohsahna jal in, nathao nusa lengpa chu paidoh hih'in.
en_web: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
en_kjv: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhacha David henga nakitepme, Nalhensa leng chu pai loujenin Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu David kom ah akihahsel in, kitepna nunglah doh kit louhel dingin: “Keiman nachilhah khat nalaltouna a katousah ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
en_kjv: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; He will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
tcz_gospelgo: David henga giltah-in nakitep’in, Suhmil louhel dia nakitep chun: “Nachapate khat leng kachansah ding, Naban’a hung vaihom ding ahi.

tcz: Nachilhah ten nangtoh kakitepna leh ka Dan sem holeh kathuhil hohi anit uva ahileh nalal touna hi chejom peh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
en_kjv: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachaten Kakitepna anit’uva, Kathupeh chengse ajuiyu leh; Achateu geiya tonsot’a Nang banga leng chang diu ahi,” nati.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem hi a inn chenna mun dinga adeilhen ahi.
en_web: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
en_kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Zion alhengin, Pansatna din adeiye!

tcz: “Hichehi tonsot a kacholngah na munding ahi” anati. Keima hiche mun a hi kachending ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi kadeilhen inn chu ahi,
en_web: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
en_kjv: This is my rest for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hikom hi tonsot’a kapansatna ding, Hilaiya hin vai kahom nom’e.

tcz: Keiman hiche khopi hi phatthei kaboh ding chuleh ijakai kasuhmang pehding ahi, keiman asunga um vaichate an kapehding,
en_web: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
en_kjv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion khopi adeichan nengtah a kapeh a, Asunga vaichate kavahva ding ahi!

tcz: athemputeu chonphatna pon kasilpeh ding, asoh dihtah hon kipa la asahdiu ahi,
en_web: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
en_kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Athempute abolchan phatthei kaboh a, Amiten kipah othonga la asah diu ahi!

tcz: Hiche mun a hi David thaneina khantousah ding, hiche kathaonupa hi kamite dinga thaomeivah hiding,
en_web: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
en_kjv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma hi David chilhah khat lal loupe kahisah a, Kalhentum lengpa vai neina ka-umsah ding ahi.

tcz: chuleh agalmite chu jumna le jachatna pon kasilpeh ding amavang leng loupitah kasosah ding ahi.
en_web: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
en_kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmate jumsong ting, Ama lenggam vang khangtouva kithang jing ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Veuvin, insungkhat hi kilungkhat tah'a achenkhom teng iti phat'a pha lunglhai um a hitam?
en_web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
en_kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity.
tcz_gospelgo: Vetan, sopi le sopi kipum khat’a Achenkhom teng Iti phat’a pha Lunglhai um hitam!

tcz: Hichehi Aaron chunga thao mantam kisungah aluchanga kon a akhamul lah'a longlha a avon mong chan a longlha suhpeh tobang ahi.
en_web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
en_kjv: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: That went down to the skirts of his garments;
tcz_gospelgo: Lua thao mantam kinua Khamul geiya jolsuh peh, Aaron khamul’a jolsuh a Asangkhol chol ngongkol geiya longsuh tobang ahi!

tcz: Kitohdel a Hermon mol chunga kon a longlha daitwi theng tobang a Zion mol a hung longlha chu ahi. Hichea kon a chu Yahweh Pakai in malsomna chu ahin phondoh'a hichu tonsot hinkhoa ding ahitai.
en_web: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
en_kjv: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: For there the Lord commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Hermon mol’a kikhol daitwi, Zion lhang geiya hung phinlha tobang ahi! Zion khopi dia Pakaiyin phattheina, Tonsot hinna atepsa ahitai!

tcz: Oh Yahweh Pakai sohte jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un, nangho Yahweh Pakai inn a jankhovah'a asohkin na tongten.
en_web: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
en_kjv: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, Which by night stand in the house of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khovah a Ahouin theng kinbol’a, Pakai lhachate hungun vahchoiyun!

tcz: Nakhut theng'u chu taona in domsang uvin lang Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
en_web: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, And bless the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin sunga Pakai lam sangin, Taovun vahchoiyun!

tcz: Van le leiset sempa Elohim Pathen chun, Jerusalem a kon in phatthei naboh tao hen.
en_web: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
en_kjv: The Lord that made heaven and earth Bless thee out of Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion khopia van le leiset Sempa Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai min chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai lhacha ten Ama chu thang vah un,
en_web: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; Praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Amin vahchoiyun Pakai lhachaten!

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai lhacha na tong, Elohim Pathen, houin sung a natong ten.
en_web: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
en_kjv: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, In the courts of the house of our God,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai i-Pathenu Houin sunga Lhacha ding jing nang hon!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un; amin ngaitah chu vahchoilan domsangun.
en_web: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
en_kjv: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchiyun Pakai nun nem chu, Mi khoto them ahi amin vahchoila sauvin!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jacob chu Ama a dingmong monga alhen ahin, Israel chu atumbeh'a amagou dinga agon ahi.
en_web: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
en_kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, And Israel for his peculiar treasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Jacob akilhenin, Israelte agou din akisem’e!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai aletna leh aloupina chu kahen, iPakai u Yahweh hi pathen dang sanga lenjo le loupijo ahi.
en_web: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
en_kjv: For I know that the Lord is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu loupije kahen, Pathen dang jouse sangin aloupi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in van le leiset chunga hin, twikanglen thuh sunga hin Aman along lhaina a adeidei abol ahi.
en_web: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
en_kjv: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, That did he in heaven, and in earth, In the seas, and all deep places.
tcz_gospelgo: Lei le van, Twikhanglen le asunga Pakaiyin adei dei abol jinge!

tcz: Aman meiho jonghi leiset chunga kon a alentousah ahin, Aman gojuh pet in koljong aphetsah'in, huijong hi athilkholna a kon in ahin lhadohjin ahi.
en_web: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
en_kjv: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; He maketh lightnings for the rain; He bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset monga konin gose huise ahintol’in, Gose lah a keh alhahsah jin, Khohui jouse jong Akholna ina konin ahintoldohjie!

tcz: Aman Egypt te insunga chun ainson in mihemle ganhing jong apeng masa jouse ana sugam in ahi.
en_web: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
en_kjv: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, Both of man and beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gamsunga chun Mihem le gancha peng masa ho athat gam’e!

tcz: Aman Egypt a chun Pharoah le amipi jouse douna in datmo umtah thil kidangho ana tongdoh'in ahi.
en_web: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
en_kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpa le avaibolte talen matsah nan Thil kidang datmo tah tah anabol’e!

tcz: Aman namlentah tah ho anavolhun leng thupi tahtah hojong ana satchap e.
en_web: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
en_kjv: Who smote great nations, And slew mighty kings;
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi asumang jengin, Leng hattah tah ho anthah’e!

tcz: Amor lengpa Sihon, Bashan lengpa Og chuleh Caanan lengho jouse anathat gam in ahi.
en_web: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
en_kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan:
tcz_gospelgo: Amor leng Sihon, Bashan leng Og, Canaan leng jouse anathattai!

tcz: Aman agam u chu Ama goulo Israelte gamtum dingin anapen ahi.
en_web: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
en_kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, An heritage unto Israel his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche leng ho gam jouse hi, Amite Israelte anapei!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namin hi tonsot a umjing ding ahi.
en_web: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
en_kjv: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; And thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, nangbou Pathena kithang ding, Akhang khanga miten nageldoh jing inte!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in amite chunga thutah'a vaihom ding asohte chunga khotona aneiding ahi.
en_web: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
en_kjv: For the Lord will judge his people, And he will repent himself concerning his servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite panpin tin, Alhachate voujang natpinte!

tcz: Chitin namtinte doilim hohi sana le dangka maimai mihem in asemthubou ahi.
en_web: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
en_kjv: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Namdangte pathen ho sana dangka kisemthu ahin, Mihem khut’a kisemthu ahibouvui!

tcz: Amahon kam anei un ima aseithei pouvin, mit anei un ima amuthei pouvin,
en_web: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
en_kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
tcz_gospelgo: Kam aneivangun apaothei pon, Mit aneivangun amuthei pouve!

tcz: kol anei un ima ajathei pouvin nahkui anei un ima anahthei pouvin ahi.
en_web: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
en_kjv: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhang aneiyun kho ajapon, Haijong ahaisa theipouve!

tcz: Doilim semthu ho jouse le hiche tahsanho jouse chu hitobang ngen ahiuve.
en_web: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
en_kjv: They that make them are like unto them: So is every one that trusteth in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho semdoh a tahsan jouse Adoi semthuu hito bang chih cheh-u hen!

tcz: Vo Israel Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! O thempu Aaron chilhahho, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un,
en_web: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: Bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten Pakai vahchoiyun! Pathen Themputen vahchoiyun!

tcz: O Levite Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Nangho Yahweh Pakai ginna neijouse Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
en_web: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: Ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Levite vahchoiyun, Ama chibai boh jousen vahchoi cheh-un!

tcz: Zion'a kon in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un ajeh chu Ama Jerusalema hin achengin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
en_web: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion khopia Pakai vahchoiyun, Ahouin, Jerusalem a vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphat na ho jouse jeh in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu ami ngailut na dihtah hi tonsot gei a longlou ahi
en_web: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem chu, tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Semthu pathen ho, Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en_web: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the God of gods: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Semthu pathen jouse Pathen thangvah-un, Tonsot’in alungset’jinge!

tcz: Pakai ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ajeh chu Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
en_web: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset pakai jouse Pakai thangvah-un, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Ama bou hin thil loupi ki dangtah chu abolji ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kidang bolthei Amabou ahin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Thepna giltah'a vanho hinsemdoh'a Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Achih nan vanmun jouse asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Twilah'a leiset umsah pa chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipi chunga leiset ajal’in, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Van a kon a vah semdohpa chu thangvah'un. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him that made great lights: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Ni le Lha asemin, tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Nisan sun a vai ahom in ahi, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: The sun to rule by day: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Sunlai vaihom din Nisa asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Chuleh lha leh ahsi hon jan ah vai ahom un ahi.
en_web: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: The moon and stars to rule by night: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Janlai vaihom din Lha le ahsite asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Egypt gam a apeng masapen ho anathagam jeh'in Amachu thangvahna peuvin. Ama mi ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot na longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Egyptte cha masa jouse athat nan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Aman Egypt ma kon in Israel ana puidoh'e, Ami ngailutna chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And brought out Israel from among them: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin Israelte apuidoh-in, TOnsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Aman akhut thahatna leh aban thaneina pum in na atongin ahi. Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en_web: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Aban-gol hatsanin apuipeh-in, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Twikhanglen san sukhen a chu Ama ahi, thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Twilensan dung avotanin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Aman Israel chu anapui galkai e, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en_web: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Twi lailunga amite apui galkaiyin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Aman Pharaoh leh asepaite twikhanglen sanlah'a analehlut in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt lengpa le asepaite twi achupsahnan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Gamthip noi a amite apuigalkai jeh'in thangvah na peuvin, Am ingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him which led his people through the wilderness: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Nelgama amite apui galkaiyin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Leng thupitah tahho anajeplhuh jeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: To him which smote great kings: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Leng hattah ho athat nan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Aman leng thahat tah tah ho anathat gam in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And slew famous kings: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Leng minthangtah tah atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Sihon Amor lengpa; Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Amorte leng Sihon atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Og Bashaan lengpa, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And Og the king of Bashan: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Bashan leng Og atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen in hiche lengho gamchu agoulo din amite anapen ahi. Ami ngailut na chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche leng ho gam amite apeh vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Asohte Israelten gam tumbeh'a alodiuva anapeh ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengho hi alhacha Israel apehdoh vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai!

tcz: Aman ihatmo nauvah eihin geldohjiu vin ahi. Amibngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: Who remembered us in our low estate: For his mercy endureth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Gal i-let tengu eisumil deh pouvin, Tonsot’in eilungset’ui!

tcz: Aman igalmihou va kon in eihuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
en_kjv: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: I-melmateuva konin eilhadoh-un, Tonsot’in eilungset jingui!

tcz: Aman hinkho neiho jouse dingin aneh achahdiu apejingin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing jouse neh ding apen, Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Van Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en_web: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
en_kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: For his mercy endureth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvah-un Van Pathen! Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

tcz: Jerusalem kageldoh phatnun Babylon vadungpang a chun katou un kakapgam tauve.
en_web: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
en_kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Zion khopi kageldoh phat’un, Babylon luipanga touvin kakaptauve!

tcz: Keihon kasemjang houchu mong thingbah chung dunga chun kakhai un ahi.
en_web: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
en_kjv: We hanged our harps Upon the willows in the midst thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Huisum phung dunga Kasemjangu kakhaiyui!

tcz: Hikom a chun soh a eihente houchun la sah sahding eigouvin, chuleh eisugenthei houchun kipahtah'a la sahsahtei ding eigouvin, “Jerusalem la ho chu khatpen beh neisahpeh'un” atiuve.
en_web: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
en_kjv: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; And they that wasted us required of us mirth, Saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh a eihenteuvin lasan eisol’un, Nopsahna anei diu, “Zion la neisahpeh-un,” Tin eisol’uve!

tcz: Ahinlah keihon hetkhahlou mi gam sunga hi Yahweh Pakai la hochu iti kasahdiuham?
en_web: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
en_kjv: How shall we sing the Lord’s song In a strange land?
tcz_gospelgo: Namdangte gamsunga Pakai vahchoila iti kasah diu ham?

tcz: Vo Jerusalem nangma kasuhmil uleh kakhut jetlam hin semjang pehdan sumil jenghen.
en_web: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
en_kjv: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her cunning.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem, Nang kasuhmil leh Khutngoiyin semjang saimon umtange!

tcz: Nangma kageldoh louva, Jerusalem chu kakipana sangpen sang a thupi a kagel lou le, ka leihi kadang chungah behden jenghen.
en_web: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
en_kjv: If I do not remember thee, Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; If I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakipa chungnungpenna kagel louva Nang kasuhmil khah leh, Hinkhoa lasa mon um jeng tange!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai Babylon sepaiten Jerusalem alonkhum niuva Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh tei in, “Sumang jengin,” “Toltoh sumat jengun” tin asam un ahi.
en_web: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
en_kjv: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, Jerusalem kilah nia Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh-in! “Phe lhasoh hel’uvn,” Atiu chu geldoh jingin!

tcz: O Babylon, nangma nakisu mang ding ahi. Nangin neibol nao bang banga nalethuh penpen chu anunnom ahi.
en_web: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
en_kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Babylon, nakisumangtei ding ahi! Neibolnau to kithuh a nabol chu nun nom hen!

tcz: Nachapangteu puimang a songpi chunga sepgoiho chu nunnom hen!
en_web: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
en_kjv: Happy shall he be that taketh And dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachasen jouse geiya chomkhoma, songpia jepgoi jeng chu nun nom hen!

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ingkate, pathen dangho masanga nang vahchoinan la sange.
en_web: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
en_kjv: I will praise thee with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai kalungthim pumpin kathangvah-in, Semthu pathente maiya navahchoi la kasai!

tcz: Nahou inn theng lang nga'ing ting nami ngailutna tanglou jehleh nakitahna jeh'in namin vahchoi ing kate, ajeh chu nakitepna hi namin loupinan asuhdet ahi.
en_web: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
en_kjv: I will worship towards thy holy temple, And praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahouin theng lamngan bohkhup ing, Nalungset long lou le nakitahna jal, Nathupeh gilje leh nathaneije namusah jal’in, Namin kavahchoiye!

tcz: Kataopet petleh nangin neidonbut in nangin thahatna neipen neitilkhou vin ahi.
en_web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
en_kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, And strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakou nin neihouvin, katha nakidosah tai!

tcz: Leiset chunga leng jousen nangma nathangvah diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathupeh ajauvin ahi.
en_web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
en_kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, When they hear the words of thy mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai leiset lengthen nathutep ho ajatauve, Nangma vahchoi tauvinte!

tcz: Amahon nathilbolho jehleh naloupi behseh jeh'a nangma thangvah la asahdiu ahi.
en_web: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
en_kjv: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: For great is the glory of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabol chengse le naloupi kidanje La asah diu ahi!

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma nalet lheh jeng vangin milham jong nakhohsah thouvin, ahinlah mikiletsah hoa kon in vang nakikhin gamlhan ahi.
en_web: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
en_kjv: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: But the proud he knoweth afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Lal loupitah nahivangin Lhasamte kho naton, kiletsahte nakoma akisel theipoi!

tcz: Keima lungkhamnan eiumkimvel jeng jongleh nangin kagalmite khutna konna neihoidoh ding ahinai. Nangin nakhut hinlhangdoh'in natin nabanjetlang thahatna a neihuhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
en_kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: Thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand shall save me.
tcz_gospelgo: Gim hesohna kadimset vangin, Neihoidam jingin; Kamelmate lunghan nadoudal’in, Naban thahat’in neihuhhingtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in keima hinkhoa athilgon achelhahsah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai na mi ngailutna dihtah chu atonsotna longlou ahi. Kachunga na natoh nahinpat hi subulhit tan.
en_web: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
en_kjv: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Natepsa aboncha nabolsoh ding ahi O Pakai tonsot’in nalungset toh ban chu Suchamkimsoh teiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin kalungthim nakholchil in neihechen sohkeitan ahi.
en_web: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
en_kjv: O Lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai neikholchil’in Neihesoh tai!

tcz: Nangin katouthimpet hihen, kadindoh pet hijongle nahei. Gamlhatah a kaum jeng vangin nangin kalung gel ngaito jouse nahei.
en_web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
en_kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, Thou understandest my thought afar off.
tcz_gospelgo: Kabol katoh jouse nahen, Gamla tah a konin kagel nahenkhen theiye!

tcz: Kakholjinpet hihen, inna katouthimpet hijongleh nangin neimun ahi, chuleh kabol jouse nahesoh kei e.
en_web: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
en_kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Chatloh in gcholdo jong leng namun, Kabolchan nahesoh keiye!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kathusei got jonghi kasei masangin nahejitai.
en_web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
en_kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, But lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapaodoh masang leh Kasei ding nahesohji tai!

tcz: Kamasanga nachen, kanunga jong neijuijin ahi, naphatthei bohna khutchu kaluchungah nangam'in ahi.
en_web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
en_kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thine hand upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nei-umkimsoh keiyin, Nathahat’in neihoidam’e!

tcz: Hitobang hetna hi keidingin aki dang val in, chuleh hitobang hetchet dinghi keidingin ahahsaval e.
en_web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
en_kjv: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihegil behseh jengin, Kagelphah hoidan ahipoi!

tcz: Nalhagaova kon a iti kajam mang thei dingham? Nanga kon a keima iti kajam mang theiding ham?
en_web: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
en_kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakoma kona iti kajamdoh a, Na-angsunga iti kajam mang ding ham?

tcz: Keima van a kaltou jongleng nangma naum in, mithigam ah lutjong leng nangma naum e.
en_web: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
en_kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanna kaldoh jong leng umin natin, Noimigama kumlha jong leng umin nate!

tcz: Keima jingkah lhaving in lengdoh ingting twikhanglen gallang peh'a gacheng jong leng,
en_web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
en_kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
tcz_gospelgo: Niso kalpeh a leng mang ing, Nilhum kalpeh acheng jong leng;

tcz: hichemun jenga jong chun nakhut in neikai hoi in natin, nathahat na in nei vengbit in nate.
en_web: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
en_kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma neilamkaiya, Chumun jenga jong neipanpi ding ahi!

tcz: Keiman muthim jah'a neisel in tijongleng chuleh kavel a vahjeng jong muthim sosah jongleng,
en_web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
en_kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; Even the night shall be light about me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mun neithim khum jengin, Kavel’a khovah thimtan,” tijong leng;

tcz: muthimlah'a kisel jing jongleng nanga kon a kakisel mangthei louding ahi. Ajeh chu nang dingin ajing jongchu sun banga vahding ahi. Muthimleh vah jong nangdingin thakhat ahibouve.
en_web: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
en_kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang din muthim jong ajingpon, Jan jong sunlai bep ahi; Nang din jin le vah akibange!

tcz: Nangin ka oisung a thil umjuse jong najopmat mat a kanu naobu sunga neigontoh ahi.
en_web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
en_kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: Thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahalsi sia neisemsoh keiya, Kanu oisunga neijopmatsoh ahibouve!

tcz: Hitobanga thil kidangtah'a neina gontoh jeh'in kathangvah'e! Na natoh nathil bol danhi datmo umtah ahi ti kalung thim apumpin kahe them e.
en_web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
en_kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Marvellous are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
tcz_gospelgo: Ginpen ding nahijal’in, kavahchoiye! Nabolchan kidanje le datmo umkalunggil’in kahei!

tcz: Keima jatchombeh'a kanu naobu muthimlah'a eina kigontoh jeng jongchun nangman neinavesui jingin ahi.
en_web: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
en_kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagu kachang kisemdoh chun, Kanu oisunga kitup keiyin eikijopmat’in; Het thei louva kahung khandoh chun, naobua ka-um nahejinge!

tcz: Kapen lhah masang a nang man nei namusa ahitai, nitin ka hinkhoa ka ki manchah na ding dan, phatche dungjui a ana kigongtoh chu nikhatcha jengjong achelhah masanga nalekhabua ana kigoltohsa ahitai.
en_web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
en_kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; And in thy book all my members were written, Which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapen lhah masangin neimutan, Kahinpat man kahin nikho jat najihdoh tai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kachung changa nalung gel nathilgon tohsaho chu iti mantama hitam simjou jai ahipoi!
en_web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
en_kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God: How great is the sum of them!
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen nageldoh het hahsa kasai, Ijat mong nagel hitam!

tcz: Asim jengjong keijo chi ahipoi, neldi halsiho sang in jong atamjoi. Kahung khahdoh gei injong nangin neina umpi jing nalai e!
en_web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
en_kjv: If I should count them, they are moe in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Simjou mong jong leng neldi sangin tamjon tin, Kakhahlo geiyin jong kakoma na-um jinge!

tcz: O ka Pathen Elohim miphalouho hi nasuhmang hitavele ong! Tolthat ho kahinkhoa kon in potdoh'un.
en_web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
en_kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen migiloute nathadoh ding kadeiyin, Pum hat miten eidonda theileh kati!

tcz: Amahohin na suminseu ve, nagalmi hohin namin hi asamseu ve.
en_web: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
en_kjv: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take thy name in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseise seuvin, Namin soudal nan thilse jeng aseiyui!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nahotbolte hohi keiman jong kahot louding ham? Nangma nadouho hi kenjong kathet louding ham?
en_web: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
en_kjv: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai nang hotbolte kahon, Nadoumah bolte kakidah lheh jenge!

tcz: Ahinai, nangman nathetho hi keiman pumthetna kathet ding ahi, ajeh chu nangma galmi ho chu keima galmi ho ahiuve.
en_web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
en_kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Hot’a tin kahon, kamelma bang banga kagel ahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neikhol chil in kalung neihet peh in; neipatep inlang kahina hi kilang doh sah in.
en_web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
en_kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts:
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen, neikholchil’in kalungthim hen; Neipatep’in kagel jouse mudoh-in!

tcz: Kasunga hi nangma douva thilse umnalai am nei nodoh peh inlang tonsot lampi a neipui tan.
en_web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
en_kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalunga agilou aumleh holdoh-in, Tonsot lampia neipuiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in, pumhat-a natong hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in,
en_web: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
en_kjv: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: Preserve me from the violent man;
tcz_gospelgo: OPakai migiloutea konin neihuhdoh-in! pumhattea konin neihoidanin!

tcz: ajeh chu alung sung'uva thilse jeng agong un, beitih um louvin gal abol jiuvin ahi.
en_web: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
en_kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; Continually are they gathered together for war.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse abol bol jengun, Kiboina jeng asodoh-ui!

tcz: Alei gui-u gul in mi achuh bang in amang chauvin, athuseidoh jouseu jong gul-gu tobang ahi.
en_web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
en_kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; Adder’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Aleiguiyu gul gunei lei abangin, Athuseiyu gulse gu abange!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou ho khutna kon hin neihoidoh in, pumhatna natong hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in; ajeh chu kakipal lhuhna din thisle jeng agong un ahi.
en_web: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
en_kjv: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man; Who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai migilouten thang eikampeh-un, Eisumang gotea konin neihoidamin!

tcz: Mi kiletsah hon kei matna din thang akam un, khao ajan-doh'un lampi dunga thang ei-kampeh'un ahi.
en_web: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
en_kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the way side; They have set grins for me. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Kiletsahten thang eikampeh-un, Ka-ona din lenpel eisonpeh-ui! Lam dung lhungin thang eikampeh-uvin ahi!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kom'a, “Nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahi!” O Yahweh Pakai, khotona dinga kataona nei sanpeh tan.
en_web: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
en_kjv: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: Hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai koma, “ka-Pathen nahi,” kati. Ngaiyin panpi kathum’e Pakai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, athahat pan-a eihuhdoh pa; nangman gal kisat nikhoa nei huhdoh ahi.
en_web: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
en_kjv: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ka-Pathen, eipanpi huneitah, Galpi ninneihoidamtai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, migilouho adei bang'in chesah hih'in, athilse gonhou chu lolhin sahhih'in; achuti louva ahileh kiletsahna dim diu ahi.
en_web: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
en_kjv: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: Further not his wicked device; Lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute deichat peh dan Pakai! Thilse agonu jong lolhinsah dan!

tcz: Kagal miten kachunga thil phalou tohgon anei jal un, manthah nan lhung u-hen.
en_web: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
en_kjv: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelmate kasangin hatsah dan, Eigihsalna jouseu achunguvah chuhsah-in!

tcz: Meiam kong chu alu chunguvah chuhsah'in, meilah'a seplut in; ahilouleh ajamdoh louna diu twiveina kotong'ah lhalut jeng u-hen.
en_web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
en_kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire; Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
tcz_gospelgo: Achunguva mei-am kisunkhum hen, Khuhsunga lhalut’uhen potdoh mohel’u hen!

tcz: Ka gamsung uva hin ajou jouva mihehse ho khantousah hihbeh'in, pumhat'a natong ho achunguva thilse chuhsah'in lang sumang in.
en_web: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
en_kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jouva mihehsete lolhing lel jing hen, Pumhatte thilsen lhunkhum hen sumang hen!

tcz: Hinlah suhgentheija umte Yahweh Pakai in asumil poi, ti kahen; Aman vaichate thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi, ti kahei.
en_web: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
en_kjv: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And the right of the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vaichate napanhu a, Tahlelte dihna napanpi kahei!

tcz: Tahbeh'in mi kitah hon namin athangvah diu, chule michonpha ho na kom'a cheng diu ahi.
en_web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
en_kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.
tcz_gospelgo: Midihten navahahoitei diu, Na-angsunga pansa diu ahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nangma kakouve, Panpi ngehna katao hi nei ngaipeh loijin!
en_web: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
en_kjv: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; Give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga kataove neipanpin Pakai! Ngaiyin kakouteng!

tcz: Kataona hi nahenga gimnamtwi kilhut bang'in chule kakhut teni kadopsang hi nilhah lang kilhaina gantha bang'in neisanpeh tan.
en_web: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
en_kjv: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; And the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona gamnamtui bangin sangin, Khut’a kasan hin nilhah kilhaina bangin gel’in!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kakam'a hin kamdal neikoipeh'in. Kakam sung nei vetpeh jing in.
en_web: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
en_kjv: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kamdal neikoipeh-in, Kakam simbingin paosah dan!

tcz: Thilse bolna din kalungthim aselam-a kon'in neihoidah sah in, thil dihlou bolna'a neipansah hih'in. Thildihlou bol hon aphat chompiu thangset umtah thil hoa chan nei neisah hih'in.
en_web: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
en_kjv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildih lou boldana le Migiloute kiloipidanna lung neipen! Migiloute golvahna a Pangkit hih hel’inge!

tcz: Miphan eiphoh hen hichu ngailutna joh ahi! Amahon eisuhdihna chu damna ahipoi, Miphalou hon thilse abol dounan katao jinge.
en_web: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
en_kjv: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: And let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, Which shall not break my head: For yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan eikhoto jal’a eiphoa talen eipeh thei, Migilou phat lhemna vang iding katipoi. Athilse bol jouseu dounaa Tao jing jeng kahibouve!

tcz: Alamkaiteu kol'a akisot lhah tengleh, miphalou hon kathusei angaidiu chuteng dih ahinsah diu ahi.
en_web: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
en_kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, They shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
tcz_gospelgo: Avaibolteu themmo akichansah teng, Kasei kitahdol miten hedoh tauvinte!

tcz: Songpi akikhet keh teng tol'a akitakeh bang in, miphalou ho gule chang ho jong vui louva kithe jal ding ahi.
en_web: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
en_kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, As when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingtum ki-eh keh a ahal hal’a lenglha bangin, Lhankhuh dunga agu achangu thang ding ahi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, panpi ngaijin na henga kataove. Nangma kakiselna kulpi nahi; amaho khut-a thina neitosah hih in.
en_web: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
en_kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: In thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang Nangbou kakisonpi Pakai ka-Pathen! Kiselnan kaneiye neithisah dan!

tcz: Kei ona dinga thang akam-uva kon in neihuhdoh in, thilpha lou jenga chon ho thangkol'a nei o-sah hih in.
en_web: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
en_kjv: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And the grins of the workers of iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Athanguva nei-osah dan, Thilse bolte thangkol’a neisut lhan!

tcz: Miphalou ho chu amaho thang kam-a chun oh uhen, kijam chap tauhen; keivang nei hoidoh sah'in.
en_web: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
en_kjv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima kitoldoh ing ting, Migiloute athangkam’uvah oh-u hen!

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Yahweh Pakai henga khotona kathum in ahi.
en_web: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
en_kjv: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; With my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya panpi kathumin, Ahenga kataove!

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai ang-sunga kakiphin in, kahahsatna jouse jong kaphongdoh'in.
en_web: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
en_kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahenga kakiphinin Kagimna chengse kaseikhum’e!

tcz: Kalhagao alam vai jitan, hinlah Yahweh Pakai nangbou nahi kachena ding lampi ei-hil ji. Kajotna lam'a chun ei-douten thang eikam peh jiuvin ahi.
en_web: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
en_kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked Have they privily laid a snare for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalhah dah teng jongle Pakaiyin kakiheina ding ahen; Kachena lampia chun Kamelmaten thang eikam khum’ui!

tcz: Keiman mikhat tou hunga eipanpi ding kangaichat lai jin, koiman amitsih jenga jong eive poi! Koimacha eikithopi ding aumpoi, kachunga thilsoh koiman imachan eigelpeh poi.
en_web: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
en_kjv: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, But there was no man that would know me: Refuge failed me; No man cared for my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakiheile le vangin Eipanpi ding kamupoi; Eihoidam ding aumpon, Eikhohsah jong aumpoi!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, keima na henga kataovin, “Nangma hi kakiselna nahi, kahinkhoa kangaichat pen nang bou nahi,” kati.
en_web: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
en_kjv: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge And my portion in the land of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipanpin a-Pakai! Eihoidampa Nang nahi Pakai! Kahillai damsungin Nangbou ka-ngaichai!

tcz: Kataona hi nei ngaipeh teijin, ei-kisunem behseh jeng tai! Ei-bolgenthei hoa kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ajeh chu amaho keisang in ahatval jeng tauve.
en_web: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
en_kjv: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
tcz_gospelgo: Alha lhoppai ding kahi, Ngaiyin panpi kathum’e! Kamelmate ahatval’ui, Neihuhhingin!

tcz: Songkul'a kon'in neihuhdoh loijin, chutileh nangma kathangvah thei ding ahi. Lolhing tah'a neibol jeh'a kajet le kaveija mikitah dim lha diu ahi.
en_web: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
en_kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may praise thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagimnaa konin ol neipen; Kadia naphat jal’in Namite khoppia navahchoiyinge!

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai, kataona ngaijin. Kangeh hi nei ngaipeh teijin! Nangma kitahna le dihna bang in, neidonbut in.
en_web: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
en_kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, Give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kataona ngaiyin Pakai! Nadihna jal’in kathum neigelpeh-in! Kitah tah nahi neihouvin!

tcz: Nalhacha hi nei patep hih in chule kachung thu jong tan hihbeh in, ajeh chu koima na ang-sunga adih aumpoi.
en_web: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
en_kjv: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: For in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
tcz_gospelgo: Neipatep loujenin nalhacha! Namit mua themchangjou aumpoi!

tcz: Ajeh chu kagal miten eihin del peh in, kahing chang in tolgoi nan ineijin, lhan khuh-a athisa umho bangin, kada kacham louvin muthim lah'a eiumsah tai.
en_web: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
en_kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground; He hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelman eidel’in Toljepnan eineitai! Songkul thim sunga eikhumin, Thilong damsa kabange!

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman kinepna ding kanei tapon, kalung sung kichatnan adim e.
en_web: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
en_kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalel behseh-in lhasam pai ding kahi!

tcz: Keiman khanglui nikho chesa ho kageldoh'in, nakhut tenia natohdohsa thil thupi ho kagel jing in ahi.
en_web: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
en_kjv: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni masa lao kageldoh-in, Nabolsa natohsa chengse ka-ngaitoi!

tcz: Kakhut tenin nahenglam kasang'in kataovin, Gamgo-in sadoh leuva twi angaichat bang in; keiman nangma kangaichan ahi.
en_web: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
en_kjv: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: My soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
tcz_gospelgo: Gotwi ngai leiset pohkhi bangin Nang ngaichan kasangin kataove!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nei donbut loijin, ajeh chu kahin kho bei pai ding ahitai. Keija kon'in kihei mang hih in, ijeh-inem itileh lhan khuh-a lhalut ho kabah ding ahi.
en_web: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
en_kjv: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakinemlal tai, Tun neihouvin Pakai! Thia mithigam jon ding kahitai, Don louvin neikoidan!

tcz: Jingkah sehleh nalungsetna longlou neijahsah in, ajeh chu keima kingaina nangbou nahi. Kalam lhahna jouse neihil them in, kahin kho hi nangma dia kaphal theng ahi.
en_web: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
en_kjv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaki-ngaina nahi, Jingseh le nalungset longlou neihetsah-in! Kataona naheng alhung jinge, Neihil’in hoilam kajot ding!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kagal mitea kon'in neihuhdoh in, nahenga kisel dinga hung jamlut kahi bouve.
en_web: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
en_kjv: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihoidam din kahinbel’e Pakai, Kamelmatea koninneihuhdoh loiyin!

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim nahi, nadeilam bolje neihil in, name khotona lhagao chun dettah'a pan kalah jingna din neipui jing in.
en_web: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
en_kjv: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: Thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pathen nahi, Nadeilam bolje neihil’in! Nalhagao nun nemtah chun HOidohna lampia neipuiyin!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, namin loupina ding in kahinkho hinghoi teijin. Ajeh chu nakitahna jal'in kahahsatna'a kon in nei puidoh tan.
en_web: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
en_kjv: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name’s sake: For thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
tcz_gospelgo: Natepsa bangin neihuhdoh—in Pakai, Nadih jal’in kagimna jousea neihuhhingin!

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chun, kagal mite manthahsan in! Chule nalhacha kahi, eidou ho jouse sumang hel in.
en_web: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
en_kjv: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul: For I am thy servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Neingailut jal’in kamelmate that’in, Nalhacha kahi eidoubolte sumangin!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un Amachu kasongpi ahi. Aman kakhut teni hi galsatje dan eihil in, chule kakhut jung hohi galsatna'a manchahje dan eihil ahi.
en_web: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord my strength, Which teacheth my hands to war, And my fingers to fight:
tcz_gospelgo: Eihoidama Pakai vahchoiyun! Galbolje eihil’in galkon din eigonge!

tcz: Amahi eipanpi phapen leh kakulpi ahin, kahoidohna pal leh eihuhdohpa ahi. Chitin namtin anoijah akunsahji ahi.
en_web: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
en_kjv: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I trust; Who subdueth my people under me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eipanpia eihoidampu, Kakiselna le huhhing, Hoidamna dia kaki-ngaina ahi! Namtin vaipi eisotkunpeh tai!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagel-lut'a, mihem chapa jeng jong ipi hija hibanga nakhohsah hitam?
en_web: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
en_kjv: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai, mihem ipi hiya hibanga nagelkhoh, Mihem chapa mai mai jong hibanga nakhohsah?

tcz: Ajeh chu mihem hi hai khatseh'a hing ahibouvin, ahin-nikho jong nisa-lep tobanga mangpai thei ahibouve.
en_web: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
en_kjv: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi haikhatseh bang hing, Ahin nikho jong nilim kihei mang bep ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vanho hinhong in hung kum lhan, molsang hohi tham'in lang meikhun len mangsah in.
en_web: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
en_kjv: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vanthamjol loikunin hung kumlhan, Molsang ho thamle chun meikhun len gmangunte!

tcz: Kehchang len-dohsah inlang galmite thejalsah in! Nathalchang kap inlang jamsah soh hel in.
en_web: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
en_kjv: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: Shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
tcz_gospelgo: Keh kisesah-in namelmate nocheh-in! Nathalchang kap’in deljamin!

tcz: Vanna kon'in nakhut hin lhang in, twithuh lah'a konleh kagalmite thaneina'a kon in nei huhdoh in.
en_web: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
en_kjv: Send thine hand from above; Rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, From the hand of strange children;
tcz_gospelgo: Chunga konin twithuh lah a neiloidoh-in, Namdangte ban thahat’a neichu lhan!

tcz: Akam'un jou jeng aseijun, thudih kaseije atiuvin akihahsel un, hinlah jou jeng aseijun ahi.
en_web: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
en_kjv: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, And their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon thudih la aseipouvin, Akihahselnau jong aseilepji tauve!

tcz: O ka Pathen Elohim, na henga lathah khat sange; selangdah jangsom kibut chu mangchan na vahchoila sange.
en_web: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
en_kjv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen kipa lathah sang ting, Semjang saiyin nahenga la sange!

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman lengho galjona napen! Nalhacha David jong athi nading chemjam'a kon in nahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
en_kjv: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: Who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengte gal najosah jin, Nalhacha David nahuhdoh-e!

tcz: Neihuhdoh'in! Kagalmite thaneina'a kon'in neihuhdoh'in, akam un jou jeng aseijun; thutah kaseiding ahi tin akihahsel-un, hinlah jou jengseh aseijun ahi.
en_web: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
en_kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, Whose mouth speaketh vanity, And their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
tcz_gospelgo: Kamelma engsetea konin neihuhdoh-in, Namdangte ban thahat’a konin neihuhdoh-in! Amahon thudih la aseipouvin, Akihahsaelnau jong aseilepji tauve!

tcz: Kachapateu akhandon laijun thingphung phatah bang in khanlhit sah in, ka chanuteu jong leng inpi jemhoi dinga kisem khompi hoitah ho bang u-hen.
en_web: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
en_kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; That our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
tcz_gospelgo: Kachateu gollhang ho Thingtoi dong khanpha bangu hen! Kachateu nu-ngah ho Leng inpi jepna khompah bangu hen!

tcz: Ka chang pang jouseu jong lousoh jouse pum'in dimsoh hen, kalou jaova kagan chateu asang sang in, sangsom som chan geijin pung hen.
en_web: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
en_kjv: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: That our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
tcz_gospelgo: Kachangpangu chang chichom chom dim hen! Kaloujaovuva kelngoiten nou snagsom cheng hingu hen!

tcz: Kagancha teu gai pha hen, veiset le apengsol um hih hel hen! Ka khopi sung jenguva jong lung gim khoisat beihel hen.
en_web: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
en_kjv: That our oxen may be strong to labour; That there be no breaking in, nor going out; That there be no complaining in our streets.
tcz_gospelgo: Bongpite nou pengsol le athol lha beiyin Neng jeng jungin pungu hen! Kakholai dunguva Ka le mao ogin kija hih beh hen!

tcz: Hitobang thilpha achunga lhung ho kipah uhen! chule a Pathen'u Elohim, Yahweh Pakai hikha nam mite chu kipah cheh'u hen!
en_web: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
en_kjv: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: Yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang vangphat chang Nam mi chu nun nom hen! A-Pathenu Pakai hikha Nam mi chu nun nom hen!

tcz: Ka Pathen leh kalengpa Elohim nangma choi at inge, chule itih chan hijong leh nangma thangvah jing ing kate.
en_web: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
en_kjv: (א) I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachoi-an inge ka-Pathen, kelengpa! Tonsot’in thangvah jing tange!

tcz: Niseh'a nangma ka thangvah jing ding, itihchan hijongleh nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
en_web: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
