en_kjv: (ב) Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh le thangvah ing ting, Tonsot’in vahchoi jing tange!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi athupin, Amabou thangvah dinga lom ahi; koiman athupina tejou ponte.
en_web: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
en_kjv: (ג) Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai loupipen, loupitah a vahchoi lom ahi! Aloupije kholsoh dan ahipoi!

tcz: Akhang khanga mihem ten Yahweh Pakai natoh apachat jing diu, thil kidangtah tah nabol ho aphonjal diu ahi.
en_web: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
en_kjv: (ד) One generation shall praise thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathilbolsa akhang khangin vahchoi ding, Nathilbol loupije phongjal’unte!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nalal loupina kidang leh nathilbol datmo umtah ho giltah'a kagel jing ding ahi.
en_web: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
en_kjv: (ה) I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, And of thy wondrous works.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon nalal loupije seiyun tin, Keiman thil kidang nabolsagel jing inge!

tcz: Nathilbol gimnei hohi mijouse kam'a kijadoh ding, keiman nathupi na ho kaphondoh ding ahi.
en_web: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
en_kjv: (ו) And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: And I will declare thy greatness.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon nathilbol natsatje seiyuntin, Keiman naloupije phongjal inge!

tcz: Kidangtah'a naphatna thusim hi mijousen aseiphong diu, keiman jong nadihna thu hi kipahtah'a vahchoila kasah ding ahi.
en_web: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
en_kjv: (ז) They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Naphatna jouse seiyun tin, Namikhotoje lan sauvinte!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi milungset them leh hepina'a dim, lunghang vahlou; lungsetna long lou ahi.
en_web: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
en_kjv: (ח) The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; Slow to anger, and of great mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Milungset khoto them Pakai, Lungset thingset lung hangvah lou!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi mijouse din aphai, Aman athilsem saho jouse chungah khotona lhingset apen ahi.
en_web: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
en_kjv: (ט) The Lord is good to all: And his tender mercies are over all his works.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin dia phasoh, Asemsa jouse lainatpi cheh!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nasemsa jousen na henga kipathu asei diu, chule nanungjui dihtah jousen nathangvah diu ahi.
en_web: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
en_kjv: (י) All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; And thy saints shall bless thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasemsaten vahchoiyune Pakai! Namiten thangvah-un nate!

tcz: Amahon nalenggam loupina asap phong diu, nathahatna atah-lang diu ahi.
en_web: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
en_kjv: (כ) They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;
tcz_gospelgo: Nalal loupe thaneije seiyuntin, Nathahat seichoi leuvinte!

tcz: Amahon natohdoh thil loupi ho mihem chate aseipeh diu, navaihomna lenggam loupi leh anatsat dan aphondoh peh diu ahi.
en_web: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
en_kjv: (ל) To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng mitinin nathilbol natsatje, Nalenggam lal loupe seichoi leuvinte!

tcz: Ajeh chu nalenggam hi tonsot lenggam ahin, nangin akhang khanga vai nahop ding ahi.
en_web: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
en_kjv: (מ) Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’a vaihom jing, Tonsot len gloupi nahi! Pakai-atepsa jousea akitah jingin, Abol jouse aphasoh keiye!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in alhuho athoudoh'in apohgih'in adelpha ho aphong dingin ahi. Aseidoh chan a kitah Yahweh Pakai ahin, atohna jousea lungset them ahi.
en_web: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
en_kjv: (ס) The Lord upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
tcz_gospelgo: Gim genthei thohte apanpin, Alhute akaidinge!

tcz: Mit jousen kinem tah'in nangma lam ahin ven, nangman amaho ngaichat dung juijin aneh diu napejin ahi.
en_web: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
en_kjv: (ע) The eyes of all wait upon thee; And thou givest them their meat in due season.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing jousen kinemtah-in naveuvin, Aduchat jouse nape jinge!

tcz: Nangman nakhut namang chan, hinkho neijouse hi agilkel adangchah nau nasuh bulhinpeh jin ahi.
en_web: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
en_kjv: (פ) Thou openest thine hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Bulhingin nape jingin, Gilkel jouse navahva cheh-e!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi atohna jousea kitahnan ajuijin, atohna chan'a ngailutna dim ahi.
en_web: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
en_kjv: (צ) The Lord is righteous in all his ways, And holy in all his works.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hi abolchan a adih-in, Atoh chan a mi ahepi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai henga taote Aman anailut jing in, tahbeh'a taote aumpi jing in ahi.
en_web: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
en_kjv: (ק) The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu akoma lungthengsel’a Taote henga anai jinge!

tcz: Aman gimna le jana neipumma ngaichatna neiho alolhinsah in, panpi ngaicha'a akanao angaipeh'in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
en_kjv: (ר) He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajabolte ngaichat chan apen, Ataonai ngaiyin ahuhhingjie!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Ama ngailuho ahuhdoh jin, hinlah miphalou ho vang asumang jin ahi.
en_web: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
en_kjv: (ש) The Lord preserveth all them that love him: But all the wicked will he destroy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama ngailu chan ahoidamsel’in, Migiloute vang sumanginte!

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu kathangvah jing ding, vannoi leisetna cheng jousen tonsot tonsot in Amin thangvah jing tauhen.
en_web: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
en_kjv: (ת) My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vahchoi jing inge; Asemsaten amintheng vahchoi cheh-un!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun! O kalhagao Yahweh Pakai vahchoi jin!
en_web: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Kalhan Pakai vahchoiyin!

tcz: Kahin laisea Yahweh Pakai kavahchoi ding, hinna hu kanei laisen ka Pathen Elohim vahchoi la sange.
en_web: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
en_kjv: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinlaisen vahchoiying ting, Kahinkhon ka-Pathen vahchoi la sange!

tcz: Leng chapate chunga natahsan koi hih'in, hichu panpi bei ahibouve.
en_web: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
en_kjv: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengle lalte kisonpi dan, Mihemin huhhing joupon nate!

tcz: Mihem chate hu abei teng leisetna akilekit-un leivui akisoh jin, hiche nikho lechun athilgon chengseu toh thi thading ahitauve.
en_web: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
en_kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemte athi teng vut asoh jin, Athilgon jouseu athi ni hin abeitai!

tcz: Hinlah apanpi dinga Israel Pathen Elohim neiho, chule Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen a kinepna neiho anunnom ahi.
en_web: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
en_kjv: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in the Lord his God:
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob Pathen panpi chu anun nomin, Jacob Pakai Pathena ki-ngai chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Aman van le leiset twikhanglen leh asunga um jouse anasem in, Aman imatih chan'a akitepna achepi jing ahi.
en_web: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
en_kjv: Which made heaven, and earth, The sea, and all that therein is: Which keepeth truth for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman van le leiset, Twikhanglen le Asunga um jouse asemin; Atepsa jouse abulhit jinge!

tcz: Aman suhgentheija umho thudih'in achungthu atanpeh in, chule agilkel te an apen ahi. Yahweh Pakai in songkul tangho alhadoh'in, achamlhat sah jin ahi.
en_web: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
en_kjv: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: Which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:
tcz_gospelgo: Bol hesohte khotonan thu atanin, Gilkelte neh ding an apei! Sohchangte Pakaiyin alhadoh-in;

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mitchoho kho amusah'in, alhu ho aphong ding in, michonpha Yahweh Pakai in angailun ahi.
en_web: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
en_kjv: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: The Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: The Lord loveth the righteous:
tcz_gospelgo: Mitcho kho amusah-e! Alhute akai dingin, midihte angailui!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in gamdang miho ahuhdoh in, Aman meithaiho leh chaga ho akhoton, amavang miphalou ho thilgon asuhbei peh'in ahi.
en_web: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
en_kjv: The Lord preserveth the strangers; He relieveth the fatherless and widow: But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
tcz_gospelgo: Igamsunguva cheng gamchom mi ahoidamin, Meithai chaga akhoton, migiloute thilgonho asumange!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in tonsotna vai ahomding ahi. O Jerusalem, Amahi akhang akhanga na Pathen hiding ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun!
en_web: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: The Lord shall reign for ever, Even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu tonsot leng ahin, Vo Zion, na-Pathenintonsot din lengvai apoi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen! iPathen'u Elohim vahchoi lasah ding hi iti phat-a pha hitam! Ijeh-inem itileh Ama lungset nan adimn in, vahchoi dia lomtah ahi.
en_web: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord: For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! I-Pathenu vahchoi la sah thilpha ahin, Avahchoi hi thildih, lung nachimna ahi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem aki ledohsah in, amangtasa Israelte ahin lepui kit in ahi.
en_web: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
en_kjv: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Jerusalem asemphan, Sohchang bulpute ahinlepuitai!

tcz: Aman lungthimna jong aboldam in, amaha jeng-u jong adamsah'in ahi.
en_web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
en_kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung kisihte adamsah-in, Amahau atomjolpeh tai!

tcz: Aman ahsi ho asim toh in, amin cheh'in akouvin ahi.
en_web: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
en_kjv: He telleth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahsi jat asimtoh-in, Amin cheh-in akouve!

tcz: I-Yahweh Pakaiju hi iti loupi hitam! Athaneina hi akhonna gei ahi! Athil hetthem theina jong mihem hetphah hoi ahipoi.
en_web: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
en_kjv: Great is our Lord, and of great power: His understanding is infinite.
tcz_gospelgo: Loupitah a thanei i-Pakaiyu ahin, Achihna tejou ahipoi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikineosah ho adomsang'in, ahin miphalouho vang toltoh alhobeh'in ahi.
en_web: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
en_kjv: The Lord lifteth up the meek: He casteth the wicked down to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nun nen ho achoisangin, Migiloute tolgoi nan aneiye!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la sauvin, semjangto thon Elohim Pathen vahchoila sauvin.
en_web: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
en_kjv: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; Sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai vahchoina la asauvin, I-Pathen diuvin tumging thei semjang saiyun!

tcz: Aman vanho meilom'in akhun, leiset'a go ajuh lhahsah in, chule molchunga hampa louhing akedohsah'in ahi.
en_web: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
en_kjv: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanthamjol’a mei ajamsah-in, Gotwiyin leiset achap nouve! Mol le lhanga hamhing apousah-e!

tcz: Aman gamsa ho neh ding apen chule va-ah nou ho apenteng aneh diu apejin ahi.
en_web: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
en_kjv: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.
tcz_gospelgo: Gancha hing jouse neh ding apen, Va-ah nouten an athum teng Avahva soh keiye!

tcz: Aman sakol thahatna leh mihem thahatna'a akison-jiu akipapi poi.
en_web: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
en_kjv: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakol hattah ho akipapi pon, Sepai hangtah jong along lhaipi poi!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Ama ging jing hole ami ngailutna longlou chunga kinepna neiho akipa pin ahi.
en_web: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
en_kjv: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Alungset longlouva ki-ngaiya, Ama jabolte chunga bou akipah-e!

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, Yahweh Pakai loupina vahchoijun! O Zion, na Pathen Elohim vahchoijun.
en_web: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
en_kjv: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem Pakai vahchoiyin! Vo Zion, na-Pathen vahchoiyin!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman nakelkot jol ho alhousah in, chule nakul sunga nachate phatthei aboh in ahi.
en_web: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
en_kjv: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakulpi kotgol alhousah-in, Namite phatthei aboh jinge!

tcz: Aman nagamgi tin-uva chamna alensah in, chule nagilkel nauvah an twitah'in navah uvin ahi.
en_web: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
en_kjv: He maketh peace in thy borders, And filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
tcz_gospelgo: Nagamgi jouse ahongbit’in, Suhlou chang tuipenin navah-e!

tcz: Vannoi leiset chunga thu-apeh teng jongleh aman gang in ahi.
en_web: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
en_kjv: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: His word runneth very swiftly.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a thupeh aneiteng, Aseibangin akitongdoh jenge!

tcz: Aman buhbang jeng jong samul abahsah jin, chule dai-kai jong vutvam kithejal abahsah jin ahi.
en_web: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
en_kjv: He giveth snow like wool: He scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: Buhbang ponphan aphan, Daibang vutvai kithejal abahsah-e!

tcz: Gel-chang jong song kisunglha abahsah jin, adapsah teng jong ama-anga ding jou ding koiham?
en_web: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
en_kjv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
tcz_gospelgo: Gel songchang kisunglha abahsah-in, Adapsah teng koima thoh jouhoi ahippoi!

tcz: Chujouteng Aman thu apen ahileh ajunlha gamji tan, Aman hui chu asol'in ahileh buhbangho chu twijin alongji tai.
en_web: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
en_kjv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng agahsei leh gel ajun lhan, hui anunsah le twiyin alonge!

tcz: Aman Jacob henga thu aseipeh in, Israel kom'a a Dan thupeh hole athuhil hochu ahilchen in ahi.
en_web: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
en_kjv: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Amite thu aseipeh-in, Danthu le ahilchahna Israelte Amahon jong Adanthu ahepouve! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Hitobang hi namdang ho jah'a aseipeh pon, amahon athuhil jong ahepouvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen!
en_web: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: He hath not dealt so with any nation: And as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanhoa kon'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanthamjol-a kon'in Amachu thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
tcz_gospelgo: VahchoiyunPakai! Van miten Pakai vahchoiyun, Chunga chengten vahchoiyun!

tcz: Avantilte jousen thangvah'un! Van sepaite jousen thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
en_kjv: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Vanmi janel, Avantil jousen Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Nisa le lha-in amachu thangvah'un! Aphelhet lhet ahsi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
en_kjv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni le lhan vahchoiyun, Ahsi vahtah tahhon vahchoiyun!

tcz: Achungsang lam'a um vantham jol'in thangvah'un! Meilom chung sangpeh'a um meitwi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
en_kjv: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that be above the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: Van chungnung penin jong vahchoiyin, Van vuma twipin jong vahchoiyin!

tcz: Thilsemho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin, ajeh chu Aman thu apen ahileh amaho chu ahung kisemdoh jengun ahi.
en_web: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
en_kjv: Let them praise the name of the Lord: For he commanded, and they were created.
tcz_gospelgo: Abonchauvin Pakai min vahchoi cheh-u hen! Ama thusah a kisem jeng ahiuve!

tcz: Aman tonsot geija dinga anagontohsoh ahitai. Ama Dan semchu itih hijongleh ki khokhel louding ahi.
en_web: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
en_kjv: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thusah a tonsot’a dia amun cheh akigol, Apalkeh lou diu gamgi kisempeh ahiuve!

tcz: Leisetna konnin thangvah'un, twikhanglen lailunga thilsemhon thangvah'un,
en_web: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
en_kjv: Praise the Lord from the earth, Ye dragons, and all deeps:
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a konin vahchoiyun Pakai! Lithuh lai jousea ngapi len lai jousen;

tcz: meileh gel hon, buhbang leh meilom hon thangvah'un, huileh adap asatnin Ama thu chu ngaijun.
en_web: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
en_kjv: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; Stormy wind fulfilling his word:
tcz_gospelgo: Kolphe le gellen, buhbang le meilhang ho, Athupeh a nung huise jousen vahchoiyun!

tcz: Mol leh lhangho, aga nei thingphung ho le Cedar thinghon,
en_web: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
en_kjv: Mountains, and all hills; Fruitful trees, and all cedars:
tcz_gospelgo: Molle lhang sang jouse, Gammang thing gathei jousen vahchoiyun!

tcz: gamsa ho le ganhingho jousen, ganhing neochacha ho le vachahon,
en_web: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
en_kjv: Beasts, and all cattle; Creeping things, and flying fowl:
tcz_gospelgo: Vahngoisa le gamlah sanamkim, Tol a vah le chunga leng jousen vahchoiyun!

tcz: leiset chunga lengho le mipite jousen, leiset chunga vaihom hole thutanho jousen,
en_web: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
en_kjv: Kings of the earth, and all people; Princes, and all judges of the earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Mipite le leng jouse, Leng le lal, vaibol jousen;

tcz: pasal khangthah ho le numei khangthah hon, tehse hole chapanghon,
en_web: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
en_kjv: Both young men, and maidens; Old men, and children:
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah gollhang, The le khang jousen vahchoiyun!

tcz: abonchauvin Yahweh Pakai min thangvah'u hen! Ajeh chu Aminhi aloupi lheh jenge, hiche Amin loupina hi leiset le vanho jouse sanga sangjo ahi.
en_web: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
en_kjv: Let them praise the name of the Lord: For his name alone is excellent; His glory is above the earth and heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Abonchan Pakai min vahchoi cheh-u hen! Amin loupipenin, aloupinan van le leiset akhokheltai!

tcz: Aman amite chu ki khat atundohpeh tan ahi, amadinga kitahna neijouse Aman angailut Israel mipite chu jana apetan ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: He also exalteth the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Adeitah amite Israel ahatsah jal’in, Abonchan Pakai avahchoitauve! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Yahweh Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin. Tahsan chate kikhopna ah avahchoila sauvin.
en_web: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, And his praise in the congregation of saints.
tcz_gospelgo: vahchoiyun Pakai! Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin, Tahsan nei amite khoppi sunga vahchoiyun!

tcz: O Israel nasempa chunga kipah'in, O Jerusalem mipite, na lengpau chungah kipah'un.
en_web: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
en_kjv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasempa chunga kipah-in Israel! Nalengpa chunga kipah-un Zion mite!

tcz: Khongpi gintoh semjang saito thon lampum pum'in Aminchu vahchoijun,
en_web: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
en_kjv: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
tcz_gospelgo: Lamin amin vahchoiyun! Avahchoi nan khong bengun semjang saiyuvin!

tcz: Ajeh chu amite chungah akipah'in, mi nun nem te chu jana lallukhuh akhupeh tai.
en_web: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
en_kjv: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai amite chunga akipah-in, Mi nun nemte choi-atnan gal ajosah tai!

tcz: Elohim Pathen chate chu hitobang jana achanjeh'un, jankhovah'in avahchoila sauhen,
en_web: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
en_kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: Let them sing aloud upon their beds.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal ajoteng Pathen mite kipah hen, Jan khovah-in kipa la sau hen!

tcz: Akhut'in chemjam hemtah kichoiyu henlang, akamsunguuvah kipah tah'in Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauhen.
en_web: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
en_kjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a twoedged sword in their hand;
tcz_gospelgo: Chemjam hemtah choiyin, Othongin Pathen vahchoiyu hen!

tcz: Chitin namtin ho chunga aphulah theina diuleh, namtin chunga engbolna apehtheina diuvin,
en_web: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
en_kjv: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, And punishments upon the people;
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin jousoh a Mitin talen matsah din;

tcz: alengteu thihkhao kola akihen'uva, chuleh alamkaiteu thihkhaova akikan theina diuvin,
en_web: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
en_kjv: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
tcz_gospelgo: Alengtau somkonsoh a, Alamkai jouseu thih khaova hen din;

tcz: achunguva thu kitanna dungjuija akitohdohna dingin. Hichehi Elohim Pathen chate chan loupitah achannao chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thusah a namtin talen matsah dingin! Hiche hi Pathen mite galjona ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin! Elohim Pathen chu Houin'ah thangvah'un, Avan chung thahatna mun nah thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
en_kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
tcz_gospelgo: Vahchoiyun Pakai! Ahouin a Pathen vahchoiyun! Van a jong ahatna vahchoiyun!

tcz: Athilbol thahatna kidangtah jeh'in amachu thangvah'un, aletna seijoulou jeh'in thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
en_kjv: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol minthang ho jeh-in vahchoiyun! Aloupina seithei loujal’in vahchoiyun!

tcz: Sumkon gin kithong pum'in vahchoijun, theile mut selangdah saito thon thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
en_kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: Praise him with the psaltery and harp.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumkon gin to thon vahchoiyun! Theile mut le selangdah saiyin vahchoiyun!

tcz: Khopi ginleh lam pummin vahchoijun, kuli leh tumging theito thon thangvah'un!
en_web: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
en_kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
tcz_gospelgo: Khong beh le lam to thon vahchoiyun, Semjang sai le kuli gin to thon vahchoiyun!

tcz: Khong gintoh thon thangvah'un, Khong gin kithong gimneitah chuto thon vahchoi jun,
en_web: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
en_kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: Praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
tcz_gospelgo: Khutbengun vahchoiyun! Hamlah lah-in khut bengin vahchoiyun!

tcz: Haina hu neijousen Yahweh Pakai thangvah na la sauvin! Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en_web: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
en_kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing namkimin Pakai vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

tcz: Hiche hi Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho ahi.
en_web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
en_kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel.

tcz: Hiche hi mihemten chihna le kigah chahna, thuchih kiseiho hi ipi kiseina ham, ti ahetdoh theina diu ahi.
en_web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
en_kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; To perceive the words of understanding;

tcz: Chule ahoi-apha adihlam'a kihilna kisan them'a adih le thudih agom'a kisanlut ding,
en_web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
en_kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, Justice, and judgment, and equity;

tcz: Chuteng milham ho dinga lunglim-geh'a hinna, chule khangdong hon hetna le thil detkhen themna anei diu ahi.
en_web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
en_kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion.

tcz: Miching jeng jong khodah'a thepna alambe ding, hetkhenna nei mihem in jong kihilchahna alambe ding ahi.
en_web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
en_kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; And a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

tcz: Hiche thuchih kiseiho le thil umdan hetthemna anei ding, miching hon thu asei teng, thulem aseidoh jouseu hettheina tha anei ding ahi.
en_web: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
en_kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi hetna dinga abulpi ahin, mingol hon vang chihna le hilchah nan asang thei poi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: But fools despise wisdom and instruction.

tcz: Kachapa, napan nahilna ngaijin lang, nanun nahilna jong sang teijin,
en_web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
en_kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, amanin nahilna jouse khotona lallukhuh'a nakikhuh ding, chule jana na ngong changa khivui oa naki'o ding ahi.
en_web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
en_kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

tcz: Kachapa michonseten jol lhah ding nago jong leu, athu'u nangai lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
en_kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

tcz: Amahon na henga ahin seidiu, “Hung'in cheu hitin mihem thadin ngah-ute; suhkhel neilou ho jong chu inop chabep uva ibol diuvin nga lhih tau hite.
en_web: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
en_kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

tcz: Ahing changa lhankhuh in aval lhum'a abah gam bang in, eihon jong ahing in bahgam-u hitin, thina kokhuh'a lhalutsa bang in, apum chang in val lhum gam tau hite.
en_web: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
en_kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; And whole, as those that go down into the pit:

tcz: Chuteng thil thupi tahtah imu diu, mi thil lelo ichomdoh hou chu in dimset'a isit diu ahi.
en_web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
en_kjv: We shall find all precious substance, We shall fill our houses with spoil:

tcz: Keiho kom'a chan hung neijin lang, sumdip kikhong in sum khol khom u-hite, tia ahinsei diu ahi.”
en_web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
en_kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; Let us all have one purse:

tcz: Hinlah kachapa, amaho toh kilhon khom hih hel'in, amaho lam lhahna akon chun kidalse jon,
en_web: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
en_kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho thilpha lou bolnan akeng-u ajangkhai in, gangtah in thisan aso jiuve.
en_web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
en_kjv: For their feet run to evil, And make haste to shed blood.

tcz: Hijeh chun vachan ao nading thang kikam amu teng, pannabei asoh jitai.
en_web: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
en_kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

tcz: Hitobang miho hin ama hole amaho thisan sodohna dinga midang achan lhih jiu ahin, amaho thina ding jenga bou mi achan jiu ahi.
en_web: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
en_kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.

tcz: Koi hileh hitobang pumtho changa ama phatchomna ding ngaito bang bep ahiuvin, thil lelo neipa ahivang in thina atoh jitan ahi.
en_web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
en_kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; Which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

tcz: Chihna hin lamlen lah'a kho asamjin, japi lah jenga jong ogin kithong tah'in apeng jin ahi.
en_web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
en_kjv: Wisdom crieth without; She uttereth her voice in the streets:

tcz: Chihna hi lamlen dunga jong apeng jah jeng in, khopi kelkot mai'a jong thu aphong doh jin ahi.
en_web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
en_kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: In the city she uttereth her words, saying,

tcz: “Vo mihemte, itih chanpi mihem mei meija hin ding nagot u-ham, anop nop'a paohon itih chanpi michunga nanop pao diu ham? Angol hon itih chanpi hetna nathet diu hitam?
en_web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
en_kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And the scorners delight in their scorning, And fools hate knowledge?

tcz: Kathumop nahi ngai phau vin, ajeh chu keiman nangho dinga kalunggel ngaito kasei ding, chuteng kathuseija kon chihna nalam doh diu ahi.
en_web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
en_kjv: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh keiman nang ho kakou un, nang hon nei donbut deh pouve. Kakhut ban in kahin sang uvin, iman jong nagel deh pouvin ahi.
en_web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
en_kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

tcz: Kahilna abonchan nadonse pouvin, kagihsal na jouse jong khatcha nadonse pouvin ahi.
en_web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
en_kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:

tcz: Hijeh chun hahsatna dinmun nalhun teng uleh kanuisat diu, manthah nan nalhun den tengu jong leh kanuisat ding nahiuve.
en_web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
en_kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

tcz: Huipi hattah banga manthahnan nahin lhun khum diu, chimpei banga hahsatna nahin to diu, chule gim le hesoh hoise tah in nalhun dendiu hijongleh ka khohsah louhel ding nahi tauve.
en_web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
en_kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, And your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish cometh upon you:

tcz: Hinlah amahon panpi ngaija eihin kou-diu, keiman kadonbut dehlou diu, gil tah'a eihol jing diu, ahin eihol doh jou deh lou diu ahi.
en_web: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
en_kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; They shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon hetna athet uvin, Yahweh Pakai gin ding jong alheng deh pouvin ahi.
en_web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
en_kjv: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of the Lord:

tcz: Amahon kahilna asang pouvin, kagih salna jouse jong pannabei aso tauvin ahi.
en_web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
en_kjv: They would none of my counsel: They despised all my reproof.

tcz: Chule amahon anop chabep uva atoh-gau aneh diu, thilpha lou angaito jouseu thao twi banga jol lha diu ahi.
en_web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
en_kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon lamdih jot louvin, milham ho chunga thina alhung lo jitan, lungthim beiho kiletsahna chu amaho manthahna asoh jin ahi.
en_web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
en_kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, And the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

tcz: Koi hileh kasei phatah'a ngaija chun lungmonna anei ding, gin ding neiloua lungmong sel'a cheng jing ding ahi.”
en_web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
en_kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, And shall be quiet from fear of evil.

tcz: Kachapa, kathusei ho na-ngaija, chule kathupeh ho gou banga na chintup jing ding,
en_web: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
en_kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And hide my commandments with thee;

tcz: Chihna thu nakhoh sah jing ding, chule lunggil tah'a thil hetkhen themna nanei ding ahi.
en_web: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
en_kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thine heart to understanding;

tcz: Hetgilna dingin peng jah-in, thil hetkhenna nanei thei nadin othong in peng jah in,
en_web: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
en_kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, And liftest up thy voice for understanding;

tcz: Dangka banga na hol ding; thil lutah kisel banga nahol ding ahi.
en_web: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
en_kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, And searchest for her as for hid treasures;

tcz: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai gin kiti nahetdoh ding, Elohim Pathen hetna jong nanei ding ahi.
en_web: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, And find the knowledge of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu chihna hi Elohim Pathen thilpeh ahin, Amakam sunga kon hetkhenna hung konji ahi.
en_web: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
en_kjv: For the Lord giveth wisdom: Out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

tcz: Milungtheng hodin hetkhen themna apejin, lung limgeh cha lamlha te chunga lum-in apang jitai.
en_web: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
en_kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: He is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

tcz: Mikitah ho lampi avetsuipeh in, amakoma kitah ho avengbit jing e.
en_web: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
en_kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, And preserveth the way of his saints.

tcz: Chuteng nang in chonphat na le thudih chu nahin hetdoh ding, chule lamdih'a cheje dan nahin kimu dohding ahi.
en_web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, And equity; yea, every good path.

tcz: Ajeh chu nalung sunga chihna hunglut intin, chule hetna lhingset nahin nei ding, hichun nakipa sah ding ahi.
en_web: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
en_kjv: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, And knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

tcz: Hetkhan them chihna chun nahin venbit ding, hetthemna chun nahoibit ding ahi.
en_web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
en_kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, Understanding shall keep thee:

tcz: Hichun aphalou lampia kon navenbit jing ding, miphalou le milhem chavei hoa kon nahuhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
en_kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, From the man that speaketh froward things;

tcz: Hitobang miho chu lamdih'a kon lamvaija, lamdih lou ajot diu ahi.
en_web: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
en_kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;

tcz: Amaho thil dihlou jeng bol ding athanom un, chule thil phalou jenga kiman chah athanop piuvin ahi.
en_web: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
en_kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

tcz: Amahon atohdoh jouseu aphalou ngan ahin, chule achonnau lamlhah jouse damun jeng ahi.
en_web: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
en_kjv: Whose ways are crooked, And they froward in their paths:

tcz: Chihna hin numei phalou akon nahoidoh sah ding, joulhep toh tho a tuhchah ding nagot uva kon nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
en_web: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
en_kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

tcz: Hitobang numei hin ajipa adalhah'a chule Elohim Pathen henga akitepna jong aheimil ahitai.
en_web: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
en_kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God.

tcz: Hiche numeinu hin a-insunga thina chan alhut ahin, alam lhahna jouse jong damun lam jeng ahi.
en_web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
en_kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead.

tcz: Ama henga lut pasal tapou mahthah ding, hinna lampi langa lutlou hel ding ahi tauve.
en_web: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
en_kjv: None that go unto her return again, Neither take they hold of the paths of life.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman mipha ho lampi najui jing ding, michonpha ho lampi jeng bou najot ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
en_kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen ging hon bou gam sung alo diu, chule mikitah hobou gam sunga cheng diu ahi.
en_web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
en_kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.

tcz: Amavang mi lungdih lou ho gam sunga kon kikai doh diu, chule lungthim dihlou ho chu gam sunga kon kipei doh jeng diu ahi.
en_web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
en_kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, And the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

tcz: Kachapa kahilna ho sumil hih beh in, Kathupeh ho na lung sunga chen sah jing in,
en_web: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
en_kjv: My son, forget not my law; But let thine heart keep my commandments:

tcz: Hichengsea kon hin, nakum ajop sau thei ding, chule phatheina bukim nachan theina ding ahi.
en_web: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
en_kjv: For length of days, and long life, And peace, shall they add to thee.

tcz: Itih chan hi jong leh kitah nale khotona nalha-kang lou ding, hiche teni hi na ngonga khivui oa naki o-ding, hichengse hi na lungthim sunga lekhajem banga naki-jih lut ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
en_kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the table of thine heart:

tcz: Chuteng Elohim Pathen le mipi lungdei lam nahung hi thei ding, minphatna naki-lam doh thei ding ahi.
en_web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
en_kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding In the sight of God and man.

tcz: Nalungthim pumpin Yahweh Pakai bou tahsan in, nangma hetna jenga kisong hih in.
en_web: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
en_kjv: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; And lean not unto thine own understanding.

tcz: Nalam lhah natin chenga Yahweh Pakai jeng naphondoh ding, chuteng Aman na lampi nakomu peh ding ahi.
en_web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
en_kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he shall direct thy paths.

tcz: Nangma mitvet jenga kichang chihsah boldan, Yahweh Pakai ging pum-in thilse dalhan.
en_web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
en_kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: Fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

tcz: Chutileh natahsa dinga damna hiding, chule nagu na chang dinga hatdohna hiding ahi.
en_web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
en_kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.

tcz: Nanei nagou chule ga masa jouse Yahweh Pakai jabol pum'in tohdoh in,
en_web: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
en_kjv: Honour the Lord with thy substance, And with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

tcz: Chutileh Aman nachang pang nasuh dimpeh a, nalengpi twi kholna jong aletset'a nasun dim peh ding ahi.
en_web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
en_kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

tcz: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakai in nasuhgim nachu nahsah mon koi dan, chule Aman nasuh dihna chu lungnop mo peh hih in.
en_web: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
en_kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; Neither be weary of his correction:

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in asuhdih hohi angailut jeh ahin, mipan acha dihtah asuhdihji banga aphosalji ahi.
en_web: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
en_kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

tcz: Chihna le hetthem theina kimu chu lungmonga kipah ding ahi.
en_web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
en_kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.

tcz: Ajeh chu chihna kitihi dangka sanga phachomjo ahin, chule aga chu sana sanga jong phachomjo ahi.
en_web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
en_kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, And the gain thereof than fine gold.

tcz: Chihna hi songmantam sanga mantamjo ahin, nangaichat thil ho jeng to jong tekah thei ahipoi.
en_web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
en_kjv: She is more precious than rubies: And all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

tcz: Hinkho sausah thei jong chihna hin akhut jet lam'a atuh chah ahin, haosatna le jabolna jeng jong akhutvei lam'a akituh chah ahi.
en_web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
en_kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; And in her left hand riches and honour.

tcz: Chihna hin kipa thanop na lampia napui ding, alampi jouse chu lung chamna jeng ahibouve.
en_web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
en_kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.

tcz: Chihna kisanlut chan dinga hinna thingphung ahin, chihna tuh chah jing ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en_web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
en_kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.

tcz: Chihna mangchan Yahweh Pakai in vannoi leiset ana tungdoh in, thil hetthemna jal'a vanmun ho asem doh ahitai.
en_web: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
en_kjv: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; By understanding hath he established the heavens.

tcz: Ama thil hetkhenna jal'a komtong ho kisemdoh a, meilhang pumpi jong gotwi a julhaji ahi.
en_web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
en_kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, And the clouds drop down the dew.

tcz: Kachapa, chihna tothon, thil datkhenji dan them in, namit vet in hiche ho jouse hi pannabei sosah hih in.
en_web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
en_kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche hohin nalhagao asuhnou jing a, nangong chang jenga jong khivui banga kijep thei ahi.
en_web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
en_kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.

tcz: Chuteng lungmonga nalam lhah le ding, nakeng jong kipal talou ding ahi.
en_web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
en_kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, And thy foot shall not stumble.

tcz: Kichatna beihel'a jalkhun najot ding, na imut teng jong leh lungmong tah'a na-imut ding ahi.
en_web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
en_kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

tcz: Kiging man louva thiding kicha hihbeh in, migilou hoa kon manthahna hung lhung ding jong nagin louhel ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
en_kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai bou na kulpi ahin, Aman nakeng jeng jong thanga ao-sah louhel ding ahi.
en_web: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
en_kjv: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, And shall keep thy foot from being taken.

tcz: Nathahat laisen na kithopi thei chan ding in, thilpha nabol peh ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
en_kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

tcz: Naheng nakom jenga jong chen lang hung kilen, jing le nale peh nanga tin, hinlah neinasan bol hihbeh in.
en_web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
en_kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.

tcz: Naheng nakom dounan thil gong hih beh in, ajeh chu amahon nakison piuva nakom'a cheng ahiuve.
en_web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
en_kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

tcz: Nachunga thilse bol-lou chu ajehbei in kinahpi dan,
en_web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
en_kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.

tcz: Chule pumthoa natong mihem chu thangsetpi hih in, alam lhahna tinchenga kon chu nakiven joh ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
en_kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, And choose none of his ways.

tcz: Hitobang milung dihlou chu Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, milungtheng vang chu Yahweh Pakaija kingai jing ahi.
en_web: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
en_kjv: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: But his secret is with the righteous.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asapsetna chu miphalou ho inchunga alhung jin, mikitah ho chenna in chu Yahweh Pakai in phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
en_kjv: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: But he blesseth the habitation of the just.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in minoise ho chunga noisena alhunsah jin, akineosahte chunga lunglhaina aneiyin ahi.
en_web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
en_kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: But he giveth grace unto the lowly.

tcz: Miching chun mite a kon jana akimu ding, mingol ho vang muda chang diu ahitai.
en_web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
en_kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: But shame shall be the promotion of fools.

tcz: Chapate, napauvin nahil chah nau ngai phauvin, giltah'a nahet them uva aphachom nasohdoh theina diuvin lunglut tah'in ngaijun.
en_web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
en_kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding.

tcz: Ajeh chu Keiman Dan phatah kapeh nahiuve. Hiche kathuhil chengse hi pelkeh hihbeh un.
en_web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
en_kjv: For I give you good doctrine, Forsake you not my law.

tcz: Keima kapa dinga chapa khatseh kahin, kanu mitvet jenga jong ngailut umtah chapa changkhat kahi.
en_web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
en_kjv: For I was my father’s son, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

tcz: Kapan hitin eina hil in, “Kathusei ho nalung in chensah jing in, ka thupeh jouse jong tuhdet jing in, hinna'a nanei ding ahi.
en_web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
en_kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: Keep my commandments, and live.

tcz: Kakam sunga kon potdoh thuchang ho sumil hih in, dalha hih hel in, chule chihna kisan in giltah in hetna neijin.
en_web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
en_kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: Forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

tcz: Chihna hi nungsun hih beh in, chihna hi ngaisang in, chutileh chihna hin nangma na umpi jing ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
en_kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: Love her, and she shall keep thee.

tcz: Hitobanga hi chihna bulpi hung kipan ahi. Chihna mutei ding gon, namu chan chu giltah'a hetdoh ding ngaiton.
en_web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
en_kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: And with all thy getting get understanding.

tcz: Chihna hi mutheijin domsang in, chuteng chihna chu nangma domsanga pang ding ahi. Chihna hi natuh chah jing poule, chihna chun jabolna namusah ding ahi.
en_web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
en_kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: She shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

tcz: Chihna hi nalu-changa delkop phatah'a pang ding, Lal-lukhuh hoitah khuh tobang nahi ding ahi.”
en_web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
en_kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: A crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

tcz: Kachapa kasei ngaijin lang, kathua nung in, chutileh na hinkho kijop sau thei ding ahi.
en_web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
en_kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

tcz: Keiman chihna lampi kahilsoh tan, chule chondihna lampi chengsea jong kapui tan ahi.
en_web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
en_kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

tcz: Nakal son-le teng jongleh nakipal lou ding, nalhai-le teng jongleh nakipal lhuh lou ding ahitai.
en_web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
en_kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

tcz: Ka thuhilna kisan in tuhchah jing in, hichu chingtup in, nang dinga hinna ahi.
en_web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
en_kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.

tcz: Milungthim phalou lam lhahna'a che dan, mipapse te lam lhahna'a jong vah-le hih in.
en_web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
en_kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And go not in the way of evil men.

tcz: Hitobang lampia kon chun kihei mang in, vah-lut louvin jotpai jeng in.
en_web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
en_kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, Turn from it, and pass away.

tcz: Ajeh chu thilse bol masa louvin ajan choldo jipouvin, mikhat tou akipalsah kahseu-vin, mu jong a-imu theiji pouvin ahi.
en_web: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
en_kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

tcz: Amahon phatlouna ga-a bou akivah un, pumtho chang'a anatoh uchu judon banga adon jiu ahi.
en_web: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
en_kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

tcz: Mi chonpha ho lam lhahna vang chu jing ninou bang in asoh jin, sunlai nisa asat bang in, avah cheh cheh jin ahi.
en_web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
en_kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

tcz: Amavang miphalou ho lam lhah chu muthim lah bang bep ahin, hoilaija kipal diu ham jong ahephaji pouvin ahi.
en_web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
en_kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.

tcz: Kachapa, kathuhil ho ngaiphan, kasei jouse lunglut tah'in ngaijin
en_web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
en_kjv: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

tcz: Hichengse hi namit mun mansah hih hel in, nalungthim sunga chensah jing tan.
en_web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
en_kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thine heart.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche kimu chan chun hinna'a anei ding, atahsa jeng jong adamsah ding ahi.
en_web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
en_kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

tcz: Khodah in limgeh chan um in, ajeh chu hinna gui hung konna asohjin ahi.
en_web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
en_kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.

tcz: Thudihlou nasei pai lhan, thuchavei kihoulimna nanei jong dalha tan.
en_web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
en_kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

tcz: Na mitte-nin ching geh in mive phan, namai changa nathilmu jeng jong adih hiding ahi.
en_web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
en_kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

tcz: Nakeng phang tenia nachotna ding vephan, ajeh chu nalam lhahna jouse kicheh ding ahi.
en_web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
en_kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

tcz: Jetle vei-a jong kiheile dan, thil dihlou lampia kon chun nakeng phang sepdoh in, kihei mang jeng tan.
en_web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
en_kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.

tcz: Kachapa, kachihna hi khohsah inlang ka thumop hi phaten ngaijin. Kathil hetkhen theina hi phatea nakol sunga nangai ding ahi.
en_web: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
en_kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, And bow thine ear to my understanding:

tcz: Ajeh chu thil hetkhen theina neijin natin, nakam sung jenga jong hetthemna um jing ding ahi.
en_web: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
en_kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.

tcz: Numei jong ho lei-chu khoiju lhumma lhum ding, athusei chan-u thao kinu sanga jolji ahi.
en_web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
en_kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as a honeycomb, And her mouth is smoother than oil:

tcz: Hinlah achaina chu guu-banga kha jia, chule hemto chemjam banga hemji ahi.
en_web: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
en_kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a twoedged sword.

tcz: Akeng tenin thina'a apui lutjia, noimi gam chan'a chelut ding ahi.
en_web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
en_kjv: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on hell.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin hinna lampi anahsah jipon, achena tincheng anoh phah jin, amanun-la akihet doh jipon ahi.
en_web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
en_kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, Her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun kachapa teho kasei ngaijun, kahilna thuchang hoakon hin jammang ding go hih beh un.
en_web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
en_kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, And depart not from the words of my mouth.

tcz: Hiche numeinua kon khun kidalseu vin, akotpi phung lam'a jong chenai ding go hih beh un.
en_web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
en_kjv: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house:

tcz: Hitia chu nabol lou ule, mihoa kon jabolna nachan lou ding, nahin kho sunga min nakhoto thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
en_kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, And thy years unto the cruel:

tcz: Hetkhah lou mihon nahatna le nahaona aboncha a-luo diu, natohga jouse jong michom beh in a-luo ding ahi.
en_web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
en_kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; And thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

tcz: Na hinkho ajona lam teng gim hesoh nato ding, natahsa pumpi manthahna aso diu ahi.
en_web: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
en_kjv: And thou mourn at the last, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

tcz: Chuteng nangin seijin natin, “Kigah chahna hi ichan-a kana thet a, phosalna hi iti kana thet hitam?
en_web: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
en_kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;

tcz: Keiman eihil ho thu kana donse pon, ka dinga thusei ho jeng jong kana donse tapoi.
en_web: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
en_kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

tcz: Tuhin mipi kikhopna'a kon keima mah thahna mun kalhun kon ahitai, tia nasei ding ahi.”
en_web: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
en_kjv: I was almost in all evil In the midst of the congregation and assembly.

tcz: Nangma twikhuh'a kon hung potdoh twi chu kidon jeng tan.
en_web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
en_kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.

tcz: Na twikhuh dunga twi put chu muntin'a hetdoh-a um'a chule kholai tinchanga um mong ding hinam?
en_web: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
en_kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, And rivers of waters in the streets.

tcz: Hichu nanga ding bouvin koiyin, nakom'a hung maljin vang nachan sah lou ding ahi.
en_web: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
en_kjv: Let them be only thine own, And not strangers’ with thee.

tcz: Na twikhuh chu phatthei chang tahen, nangma tah jong nasenji chunga kipah tan.
en_web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
en_kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: And rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

tcz: Na deitah na jinu sajuh golpai hoitah le sajuh chal hoitah bang in, phat tin in aman nahebolna nachunga lhung jing hen, amanu anglum jal'a kipah jing nahin, aman natuh chah jing hi nalungset phot chetna ahi.
en_web: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
en_kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravisht always with her love.

tcz: Kachapa, i-atileh numei chon chavei chu naki ngaipi jing a, hitobang numei kampao phalou chu a-anglum'a um ding nagot jing ham?
en_web: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
en_kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravisht with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a stranger?

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi mihem lam lhah jouse ve-jing ahin, alam lhah na jouse avet-jing ahi.
en_web: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
en_kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, And he pondereth all his goings.

tcz: Miphalou chu a chondih lounan akipalsah teijin, a chonsetna chun atuh chahji ahitai.
en_web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
en_kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

tcz: Ama chu kigah chana beija thina chang ding, a ngol-ga chun manthahna asoji ahi.
en_web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
en_kjv: He shall die without instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

tcz: Kachapa, naheng nakom dinga batsahna dinga kitung nahim, hetkhah lou mikhat tou batsahna dinga naum khah a,
en_web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
en_kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, If thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

tcz: Nangma thuseija kon kipalna naneija, nakama kon'a phondohsa thu chun nakipalsah khah leh,
en_web: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
en_kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

tcz: Kachapa, ka thuhil hi ngaijin lang bol ding gon, ajeh chu naheng nakom'in na chunga thu anei tah jeh in, chen lang naheng nakompa ang-sunga taovin.
en_web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
en_kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, When thou art come into the hand of thy friend; Go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

tcz: Jan choldo louvin, namit teni jeng jong sing-hih in, namit geija keh mitmul ho jong kichol da hen.
en_web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
en_kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids.

tcz: Sadelpa masanga sakhigol ajammang bang in, nangma tah kihuh hing ding gotan, vacha thangkol-a kitoldoh bang in nangma tah kihuh hing loijin.
en_web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
en_kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

tcz: Vo mi thase ho, cheuvin sihmi khu gave tim un, aum chan u-khun kihil un lang chingdoh tauvin.
en_web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
en_kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:

tcz: Amahon natonga agoi diu lengle gamvaipo, vaihom aneilou vang un,
en_web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
en_kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

tcz: Amahon nipi laija neh ding aki-khol khom un, khokhal teng nehding aki-khol khom theijun ahi.
en_web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
en_kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.

tcz: Hinlah vo mithase hiche mun'a hi itih chan na-imut ding hitam? Nalup mun'a kon itih phat'a thoding nagot hitam?
en_web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
en_kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

tcz: Na i-mut a, namoh kijam jeng a, nakhut chalo-sah louva namoh um jenga ahileh,
en_web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
en_kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:

tcz: Chule vaichat na chun gucha banga na hin lhunkhum ding, lhinlel na chun gal manchah choipa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi.
en_web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
en_kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, And thy want as an armed man.

tcz: Mi pannabei le mikitah lou chu thudihlou sei phong in ache leuvin ahi.
en_web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
en_kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, Walketh with a froward mouth.

tcz: Ajon chihnau amit lhap uva akilang jin, akhut jung uvin hichu akoh jiuvin ahi.
en_web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
en_kjv: He winketh with his eyes, He speaketh with his feet, He teacheth with his fingers;

tcz: Alungthim phatlou nauvin thilse agong un, tantih neilouvin kitomana ding jeng abol jiuvin ahi.
en_web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
en_kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, He deviseth mischief continually; He soweth discord.

tcz: Hiche ho jeh chun, amaho chunga gangtah in manthahna achujin, damdoh vah thei loua um diu ahi.
en_web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
en_kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; Suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in athet tah thil gup aum in, Ama ding in thil sagima adei lou aum in ahi.
en_web: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
en_kjv: These six things doth the Lord hate: Yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

tcz: Kiletsah mitvet, jou seina leigui, mona beija thisansoa panla khut teni,
en_web: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
en_kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood,

tcz: Thilse gonna lungthim, thilse bol dinga lhai keng teni,
en_web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
en_kjv: A heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, Feet that be swift in running to mischief,

tcz: Thujouseina-a jou sakhia pang, chule asopi lah-a kitomona muchi thea pangpa ahi.
en_web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
en_kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.

tcz: Kachapa, napa thupeh hohi jui jing in, chule nanun nahilna jong don louvin koi hih in.
en_web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
en_kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

tcz: Hichu nalung sunga chingtup jing in, na ngonga khivui on ki-o jing in.
en_web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
en_kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, And tie them about thy neck.

tcz: Hiche hochun nakal sonna jousea napui hoi ding, na-imut teng jongleh nachin tup diu, nahung khahdoh teng jongleh nahil'a pang kit ding ahi.
en_web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
en_kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

tcz: Ajeh chu thupeh chengse hi thaomeia pang ahin, kihilna jeng jong thaomei vah tobang, chule kiphosalna le kigah chahna jouse jong hinna lampia pang ahibouve.
en_web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
en_kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

tcz: Hichun numei phalouva kon navenbit ding, akam them jehju numeia kon chu nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
en_web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
en_kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

tcz: Melhoinu khu nalung in deicha hih beh in, amit vetdan akon in jong kilhep lhahsah hih hel in.
en_web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
en_kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

tcz: Ajeh chu numei kijohnu chu changlhah khat jengseh a jong muthei ahin, hitobang numei pasaltoh jongji chun pasal hinkho chu manthahna asoji ahitai.
en_web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
en_kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: And the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

tcz: Mihem khat chun adip-a mei-al apoh theijem? Chule aponsil jeng jong kavam louva akoi thei lou ahi.
en_web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
en_kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burnt?

tcz: Mihem khat chu mei-al chunga vahle theijem? Akengto phang teni jong kalouva akoi thei lou ahi.
en_web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
en_kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, And his feet not be burnt?

tcz: Aheng akompa jinu jonpi jong hiche tobang bep chu hiding, aheng akompa jinu lup khompi tapou chu Dan in amat tei ding ahi.
en_web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
en_kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

tcz: Gilkel khat chun neh ding deija thil aguh tah-a ahileh, hichepa chu mihemte muda chang cheh ahi.
en_web: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
en_kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

tcz: Hinlah gucha chu akimat khah tahleh, aguhdoh jat chu jat sagi jen'a ale ding, anei le agou jouse aguchat jeh'a asahna'a anei ding ahitai
en_web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
en_kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.

tcz: Chule mitoh jon thanhoi bolpa chu lungthim neilou ahin, thildihlou abolna chun manthahna alhun den ding ahi.
en_web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
en_kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: He that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

tcz: Amapa chun jumna maha aput ding, min amuda na jong beitih um lou ding ahi.
en_web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
en_kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.

tcz: Ajeh chu thangset kiti hin mihem alung sousah jin, datkhen um louva phulahna aneiji ahi.
en_web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
en_kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: Therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

tcz: Amapa chun leona man akilah nom lou ding, thil ijat pebe jong lechun asan thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
en_kjv: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

tcz: Kachapa, kathumop hi juijin, kathupeh chengse jong gou chin in ching jing-in.
en_web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
en_kjv: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.

tcz: Kathupeh chengse hinna nanei thei nadin nit jing in, kathuhil chengse namit chang naki chintup bang in chingtup in.
en_web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
en_kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.

tcz: Hichengse chu nasuhmil lou nadin khutjem bun kibun lang, nalungthim gil sunga lekhajem bang in kijih lut in.
en_web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
en_kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, Write them upon the table of thine heart.

tcz: Chihna hi naso pinu bang in ngailun, chule nagol ngaitah banga nakisem ding ahi.
en_web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
en_kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding thy kinswoman:

tcz: Hichun numei jong hoa kon navendoh ding, pasal toh jonthanhoi bol numeia kon chu nahoidoh ding ahi.
en_web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
en_kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the stranger which flattereth with her words.

tcz: Kain bang-kot akon kagal vet'a, polam kavet a hileh,
en_web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
en_kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

tcz: Japi lah'a jong kamun, gollhang ho kititna mun'a jong kamun, lungthim bei gollhang khat aum in ahi.
en_web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
en_kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,

tcz: Amapa chu, numei jong-nu inlam achun avah lejin, hiche numeinu in-jotna lam chu ajon jitai.
en_web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
