en_kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,

tcz: Jingkah khovah then then in jong, nilhah lam in jong, jan muthim lah'a jong, hiche lam'a chun ache jitan ahi.
en_web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
en_kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, In the black and dark night:

tcz: Chuin numei khat in amudoh tan, amanu chu noti-von a kivon, a-lua pon akikhuh in ahi.
en_web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
en_kjv: And behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and subtil of heart.

tcz: Hiche nuchu thunung lou khop in, jum le ja jong helouvin, in-a um thim thei louva keng javelvul a um ahi.
en_web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
en_kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; Her feet abide not in her house:

tcz: Kholaija um'a igel laijin, kailhanga akimun, munthip ningkoi lah jenga mi achang lhih jin ahi.
en_web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
en_kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, And lieth in wait at every corner.)

tcz: Gollhangpa chu amu teng angong koi pai ji-in, achop jitan, jum lou tah'in gollhangpa henga chun aseijin
en_web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
en_kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, And with an impudent face said unto him,

tcz: “Keiman chamna maicham sem ding tampi kaneijin, tuni hin kakitepna jouse pe tange,
en_web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
en_kjv: I have peace offerings with me; This day have I payed my vows.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma velhih-a hung potdoh kahin, lunglhai sel'a nangma hol'a kahung chu, hikom-a kamutai.
en_web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
en_kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

tcz: Kajalkhun jong Egypt gam'a ponnem jemhoi tah'a kapha jolsel ahi.
en_web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
en_kjv: I have deckt my bed with coverings of tapestry, With carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

tcz: Kajalkhun chunga myrrh namtui kathe in, aloes namtui le thingthal namtui tah kahin the ahi.
en_web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
en_kjv: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

tcz: Hungin, jankhovah geijin lungna chimtah in kinou ta hitin, kilungset hitin, jankhovah in kideito hite.
en_web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
en_kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: Let us solace ourselves with loves.

tcz: Ajeh chu kajipa inn-a aumpon, kholjin in mun gamla tah'a achen ahi.
en_web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
en_kjv: For the goodman is not at home, He is gone a long journey:

tcz: Asum bom a sum dimset'in akipoh in, lha kichai lam teng hung kile din achetai.”
en_web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
en_kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, And will come home at the day appointed.

tcz: Hitichun numeinun thungai tah tah aseijin ajol tan, ajonan athunun in, kamnal hiu hiu cha akihoupi tahjeh in gollhangpa jong anom tan ahi.
en_web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
en_kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, With the flattering of her lips she forced him.

tcz: Alungthou jah'in hichenu chu ajui tan, Bongchal in aki tha nading mun ajot bang le thang a-ohsa sakhi bang in numeinu nung chu ajuitai.
en_web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
en_kjv: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

tcz: Sakhi golpai thalpin alungchang athil pai bang leh, vacha banga ahinkho beina ding akihet phah tapon ahi.
en_web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
en_kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.

tcz: Hijeh chun ka chapate ho kathusei hohi lunglut tah in ngaijun, chule kakam sunga kon thu kisei hohi ngai phauvin.
en_web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
en_kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, And attend to the words of my mouth.

tcz: Hiche numeinu lam akhun nalungthim lamvai sah hih in, amanu lam lhahna tinchanga jong nache lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
en_kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, Go not astray in her paths.

tcz: Ajeh chu amanu hin pasal tampi manthahna aso-ahitan, sepai thahat lai jong asuhgam ahitai.
en_web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
en_kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

tcz: Amanu in jotna lampi hi noimi gam lampi ahin, thina lhankhuh sunga kilhung lut lampi ahi.
en_web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
en_kjv: Her house is the way to hell, Going down to the chambers of death.

tcz: Chihnan kho ahin sap teng jatei ding gon, chule thil hetkhen nan lhang asap teng ngaijin.
en_web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
en_kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? And understanding put forth her voice?

tcz: Lampi pam le lhangvum dung a, chihna chu ading le'in ahi.
en_web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
en_kjv: She standeth in the top of high places by the way, In the places of the paths.

tcz: Khopi lutna kelkot phung dung a, kholen tinchang maija, chule kotjum lutna thei jousea lhang asam in ahi.
en_web: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
en_kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors.

tcz: “Mijouse jah-a kakou ahin, mihem chapa jouse kakou ahi.
en_web: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
en_kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of man.

tcz: Milham ho nahiu vin, lunggel them hina din kihil un, mingol ho jeng in jong lunglut in ngaijun.
en_web: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
en_kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: And, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

tcz: Ngaitem un, keiman thil phachom tah nahil uvinge, kakam sunga kon thudih jengbou pot ding ahi.
en_web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
en_kjv: Hear, for I will speak of excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.

tcz: Ajeh chu kakam in thudih bou aseiji ding, adihlou sei kiti hi kakam in ajahda ahi.
en_web: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
en_kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

tcz: Kakam akon thu kisei jouse adih ahin, akikal le ache khel ding ima um lou ahi.
en_web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
en_kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing froward or perverse in them.

tcz: Kathu hil hekhen theipa chun adih akisan ding, hetthemna neipa dinga chu adih bou ahi.
en_web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
en_kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.

tcz: Sumlepai sang in kathu hil kilhen un, Sana thengsel sanga jong hetna naki lhen joh diu ahi.
en_web: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
en_kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.

tcz: Ajeh chu sana kijem pah sanga chihna hi thupi ahin, na lungdei chan toh kitekah thei ahipoi.
en_web: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
en_kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

tcz: Chihna hi keima kahin chingthei tah'a um kahi, hetna le thil hetkhen themna nei kahi.
en_web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
en_kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge of witty inventions.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna chun thilse ahotbol in, hijeh chun keiman kiletsahna le hoithona, thil aphalou, ahilou louva thu kisei chan chu kathet ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the froward mouth, do I hate.

tcz: Keima'a kon hin, chihna giltah le phachom tah'a kihilna aum in, asung thua hetna le thahat chu keija bou um ahi.
en_web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
en_kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

tcz: Keijal'a lenghon vai-apoh ahin, keijal'a bou vaihom ten adih'a thu tanna anei ahi.
en_web: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
en_kjv: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.

tcz: Keijal'a alen alal ten vai ahop jiu, chule keijal'a bou alal ten vai apoh theiyu ahi.
en_web: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
en_kjv: By me princes rule, And nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

tcz: Keima eingailu ho kangailun, giltah'a eihol ten eimu tei jiuvin ahi.
en_web: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
en_kjv: I love them that love me; And those that seek me early shall find me.

tcz: Keima haona le jabolna jousen eijui in, phattheina le haona chun eidalha jipoi.
en_web: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
en_kjv: Riches and honour are with me; Yea, durable riches and righteousness.

tcz: Ka thilpeh hohi sana sanga phachom ahin, sana thengsel sanga jong hoijoa, chule kanatoh jong sum le pai sanga phajo ahi.
en_web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
en_kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.

tcz: Keima thudih tah'a lamlha jing kahin, thutanna adih lam jeng chu kaho-ji ahi.
en_web: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
en_kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of judgment:

tcz: Keima eingailu hon gou alo diu kasem peh in, agou kholnau jouse kasuh dimpeh-jin ahi.
en_web: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
en_kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; And I will fill their treasures.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in atil abulla athilsem apat ei-umsah ahin, khanglui apat athilsem masapen kahitai.
en_web: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
en_kjv: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.

tcz: Atil-a leiset kisem masang, kum asang sang masanga pat keima tundohsa chu kahi tai.
en_web: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
en_kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Or ever the earth was.

tcz: Kapen chun anem, atong lai jong ana um pon, twi putna jouse jong khatcha ana um poi.
en_web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
en_kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; When there were no fountains abounding with water.

tcz: Mol le lhang kigol toh masang, chule thinglhang jouse kisemtoh masanga pat ana um kahitai.
en_web: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
en_kjv: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth:

tcz: Elohim Pathen in leiset le tollhang asem masang, vannoija leigum kisemdoh masanga pat um kahi.
en_web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
en_kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in vanho atundoh masanga um kahin, twikhanglen kuol khum vanthamjol alhundoh masanga jong um kahitai.
en_web: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
en_kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: When he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

tcz: Elohim Pathen in chunglam'a vanthamjol ho atundoh ahin, leinoija pat twi aput dohsah masanga jong um kahin,
en_web: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
en_kjv: When he established the clouds above: When he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

tcz: Twikhanglen geilah jong alet lhahna lou dinga asem toh, twipi jeng in jong athu angaina dinga asem toh, leiset khompi jouse jong atundoh masanga pat um kahi.
en_web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
en_kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, That the waters should not pass his commandment; When he appointed the foundations of the earth:

tcz: Keima tah jong akom-cha'a khut them bang um kahin, nitin le phat tin in akom-a kapansan kipatah in kaum jing in ahi.
en_web: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
en_kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: And I was daily his delight, Rejoicing always before him;

tcz: Elohim Pathen in mihemte chenna dia leiset atundoh ahin, keima jong kipah tah-in kaum in, mihemte lah'a thanopnan kadim e.
en_web: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
en_kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; And my delights were with the sons of men.

tcz: Hijeh chun kachate ho kasei ngaijun, kathu ngaija ka lampia che jing ho kipah ding'u ahi.
en_web: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
en_kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: For blessed are they that keep my ways.

tcz: Kathuhil ho ngaijun lang ching theijun, kahilchah-nau hi tuh chah jing un.
en_web: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
en_kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.

tcz: Ka thusei ngaija mihem chu anunnom hi ding, amachun nitin'a kakot phunga anga jing ding, ka kotpi phunga tatlouvin ading in ahi
en_web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
en_kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima eimudoh chan chun hinna akimu tan, chule Yahweh Pakaija kon in hepina achang'un ahi.
en_web: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
en_kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favour of the Lord.

tcz: Amavang keima eidonlou chan chun, ama le aman gimna akimu jin, keima ei hot chan chun, thina jeng angai chat ahibouve.”
en_web: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
en_kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.

tcz: Chihna kiti hin a-in akisahdoh in, khompi sagi jen atungdoh tan ahi.
en_web: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
en_kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, She hath hewn out her seven pillars:

tcz: Chihna kiti hin, neh le chah ding gancha phabep akitha jin, lengpi twi jong lhumkeijin ahel-in, chule chihna kiti hin an-nehna ding dokhang jeng jong atungdoh tan ahi.
en_web: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
en_kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table.

tcz: Munsang laija kon'in khopi sung mihoa kon chun, mikou din asohte asol in ahi.
en_web: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
en_kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: She crieth upon the highest places of the city,

tcz: Koi hileh milham a um jouse, “Kakom'a hung hen,” tin akousah in ahi. Chule koi hileh alungthim bei tapou chu, kou-un, ati.
en_web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
en_kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

tcz: “Hung un, kaneh ding khel in neuvin, kadon ding khel in lengpitwi don un.
en_web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
en_kjv: Come, eat of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

tcz: Milham in um hih un, giltah in hetkhenna neijin hinkho mang un,” ati.
en_web: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
en_kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; And go in the way of understanding.

tcz: Mi munem'a noisea, adih bolsah teiding gopan jong kisuh khahna aneilo-bep ahi.
en_web: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
en_kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: And he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

tcz: Hijeh chun mi munem pum-a adih bolsah teiding go-hih in, ajeh chu nahin mudalo thei ahi. Hinlah miching chu hil lechun nangailua pang jo-ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
en_kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: Rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

tcz: Miching chu nahil chan'a ching cheh cheh ding, hibang chun mikitah jong nahil chan'a ching cheh ding ahi.
en_web: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
en_kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi chihna bulpi ahin, mithengpa hetna nei chan chun giltah'a thu ahetdoh ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: And the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima jal'a na hinkho sao chom ding, na hinkho sunga nakum jong kibe tei ding ahi.
en_web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
en_kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.

tcz: Na chihna chu nangma goh-keuseh ding ahin, midang noisena nanei le mona chu na changseh a nakipoh ding ahi.
en_web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
en_kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: But if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

tcz: Numei ngol kiti chu akam tam in, amanu chu pannabei le jum helou ahi.
en_web: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
en_kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: She is simple, and knoweth nothing.

tcz: Amanu chu a-in kot phunga atoujin, kholai jenga jong mundoh lai a bou atoujin ahi.
en_web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
en_kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,

tcz: Amanun mi ama kincheh a kisalel akom'a hung kijot hochu “akou jin,”
en_web: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
en_kjv: To call passengers Who go right on their ways:

tcz: Chule milham ho koma chun kakom'a hung un tin, akouvin, lungthim beija um jouse tin akoujin ahi.
en_web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
en_kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: And as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

tcz: “Aguh'a kidon twi hi alhum in, aguh a kineji changlhah jong lungkim umtah ahi,” ati.
en_web: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
en_kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

tcz: Hinlah golhangpa chun hiche mun hi thina ahi ti, aheji pon, numeinu insunga lhung jinhon jong noimi-gam mithi kholna'a lhalut ahilam-u, akihet phahji tapouve.
en_web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
en_kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; And that her guests are in the depths of hell.

tcz: Solomon thuchih ho: Chapa chingin apa aki pasah jin; Chapa ngol vang anu ding in lungkham na bep ahi.
en_web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
en_kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

tcz: Gitlouna le engset jeh'a kilamdoh gouchu phat chompi thei ahipon, hinlah chondih nahin hinkho jeng jong ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en_web: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
en_kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: But righteousness delivereth from death.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha chu kelthoh in akoi jipon, chule milungthim phalou ho ngaichat akhohsah jipoi.
en_web: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
en_kjv: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: But he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

tcz: Khut chaloh sah nomlou thase chun vaichatna alhut ding, khut umthim thei lou chun haosatna amu ding ahi.
en_web: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
en_kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

tcz: Chapa ching in nipi laileh neh akikhol khomin, neh kikhol khom laija kinomsah chapa vang chun jumna amu tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
en_kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: But he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

tcz: Michonpha luchanga phattheina gobang in ajun, mikitah ho kamsunga vang pumtho changa thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
en_web: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
en_kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Mikitah chu akisumil thei jipon, mikitah lou ho min vang chomlou kah'a kisumil ding ahi.
en_web: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
en_kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: But the name of the wicked shall rot.

tcz: Miching in thu kisei chan asanje ahen, amoh a thusei vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
en_web: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
en_kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: But a prating fool shall fall.

tcz: Lungthim kitah a kalsonna chu monna ahin, achena tinchang kisuh boi-achu matdoh a um tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
en_kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

tcz: Aphalou lam galdot chun gimna asodoh jin, hangsan tah'a mi phohsal a sudih chun chamna asemdoh jin ahi.
en_web: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
en_kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: But a prating fool shall fall.

tcz: Michonpha kamsung chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, miphalou ho kamsunga vang ki nah na ding thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
en_web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
en_kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Kivetda nahin kinahna asodoh sah jin, ngailut na vang chun thilse jouse asel mang jitai.
en_web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
en_kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: But love covereth all sins.

tcz: Thil hetthemna neipa vang chun akamsunga kon thu aseidoh chan le chihna amu jin, lungthim beipa vang chun aphahsam a moltum adou jing ding ahi.
en_web: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
en_kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

tcz: Miching hon hetna akhol chen un, mingol kamtam hon hamset na akiloilut jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
en_kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

tcz: Mihaoho nei leh gou hi akulpia apang jin, vaichate neilal na vang chun manthahna asojin ahi.
en_web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
en_kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

tcz: Michonpha chun atohga dungjui'a hinna alhut jin, migilou ho phatchomna vang chun chonsetna alhut jitan ahi.
en_web: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
en_kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: The fruit of the wicked to sin.

tcz: Min ahilna ngaipha chun hinna lam ajot jin, min aphona ngaimahpa vang chu avah mang jitai.
en_web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
en_kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: But he that refuseth reproof erreth.

tcz: Alungthim'a mudana neipa chun jouthu jeng asei jin, mi enghotna thuseipa vang angol ahi.
en_web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
en_kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, And he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

tcz: Thu tamseina hin seikhel aumsah teijin, hinlah akam kihup them mi chu mi ching ahi.
en_web: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
en_kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: But he that refraineth his lips is wise.

tcz: Mikitah pa kamcheng hi dangka manlu tobang ahin, mikitah lou ho lungthim vang pannabei jeng ahi.
en_web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
en_kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.

tcz: Mikitah pa kamsunga kon in mitampi vah va na ding thu apot jin, mingol ho vang lungthim beijin amang thah jitauve.
en_web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
en_kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: But fools die for want of wisdom.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phattheina chan hi haodohna ahin, hichun lungkhamna asodoh sah jipon ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
en_kjv: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, And he addeth no sorrow with it.

tcz: Thilse bol hi mingol ding in kichep golnop abang jin, thil hetthemna neipa ding in limgeh a chon hi lungkimna ahi.
en_web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
en_kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: But a man of understanding hath wisdom.

tcz: Miphalou in mi akichat sahna chu ama chunga ale-lhun jin, mikitah ding in angaichat chan Elohim Pathen in apeh tei ding ahi.
en_web: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
en_kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: But the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

tcz: Khopi hui alan a gopi ajuh teng, miphalou chu atol tha jitan, hinlah mikitah vang tonsot geija tundoh ahitai.
en_web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
en_kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

tcz: Juthuh hin ha ajatsah bang le, meikhun mit athipsah bang in, mithase jong agolpa ding in doujou ahipoi.
en_web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
en_kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.

tcz: Elohim Pathen ginna hi hinkho sotna ahin, miphalou ho hinkho vang kisuchom ding ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

tcz: Mikitah ho kinepna chu kipana ahin, miphalou ho kinepna vang pannabei ahi.
en_web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
en_kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

tcz: Mikitah ding in Yahweh Pakai hi bitna ahin, thil phalou bolte dinga vang manthahna ahi.
en_web: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
en_kjv: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: But destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

tcz: Mikitah chu kisuloh lou hel ding, miphalou ho vang gamsunga kon'a kichon mang ding'u ahi.
en_web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
en_kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: But the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

tcz: Mikitah kamsunga kon in chihna apot jin, aphalouva thu motsei vang chu aleigui kitan ding ahi.
en_web: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
en_kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: But the froward tongue shall be cut out.

tcz: Mikitah chun akam sunga kon in lahthei aseidoh jin, miphalou ho kamsunga kon in vang thu chavei jeng apot jin ahi.
en_web: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
en_kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: But the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

tcz: Thil adihlouva kite hi Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, dihta a akilep-toa akite teng Yahweh Pakai ding in kipa aum-jie.
en_web: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
en_kjv: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: But a just weight is his delight.

tcz: Kiletsahnan ahin phah teng, muda nan ahin lhut paijin, milung neng ho ding in vang chihna aum jing e.
en_web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
en_kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: But with the lowly is wisdom.

tcz: Mikitah ho kamkeh loubeh a aum jiu hi, amasang-diuva lamhil a pang ahin, jou le nal'a thuseija lungthim dihlou hin, ajona leh manthahna aso-sah jitauvin ahi.
en_web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
en_kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: But the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lunghan niteng, nei le gou iman apang pon, dihna kiti hi thina dinmun a jong hoidohna a pang ahi.
en_web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
en_kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: But righteousness delivereth from death.

tcz: Chamdel a um mikitah chu alampi a-jang in, mikitahlou vang chu aphatlouna in alhup denji ahi.
en_web: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
en_kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

tcz: Mikitah te chu adihna in ahuhdoh jin, jou le nal a thuseina vang chun soh-a apanlo sah ahibouve.
en_web: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
en_kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: But transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

tcz: Miphalou chu athiteng akinepna jong pannabei ahin, Elohim Pathen sumilte dinga kinepna jong pannabei ahi.
en_web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
en_kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: And the hope of unjust men perisheth.

tcz: Mikitah chu gim le hesohna kon in akihuhdoh jin, miphalou vang chu gim le hesohna'a alhalut jitai.
en_web: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
en_kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.

tcz: Elohim Pathen sumil mi chun aheng akom manthana ding jeng asei jin, hinlah hetkhen na thahat nei jeh in mikitah te huhdoh in aum-jin ahi.
en_web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
en_kjv: A hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: But through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

tcz: Mikitah hon aphalam amano teng, khopi sunga mihemte akipah un, mikitah lou ho chunga manthahna alhun teng, mi akipah jin ahi.
en_web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
en_kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

tcz: Mikitah ho chunga phattheina jal in, khopi sung mite dopsang in aum un, hinlah mikitah lou ho thumot sei jeh'in khopi amangthah bep jin ahi.
en_web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
en_kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Aheng akom hebol lou-pa chu milungthim bei ahin, thil hetkhenna neipa vang chu thipbeh chan aum jin ahi.
en_web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
en_kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

tcz: Muntinna thu seilepa chun thuguh jeng jong aseidoh jin, hinlah tahsan theitah mi vang chun thuguh kiti a-im jon ahi.
en_web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
en_kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

tcz: Kilamhilna aum louteng mipi kipal tei ding, guhthim cha kithuhilna achun bitna aum teijin ahi.
en_web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
en_kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: But in the multitude of counsellers there is safety.

tcz: Hetlou miho batsah na dia athil tung chun atohga amu tei ding, thil tun ding deiloupa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
en_kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: And he that hateth suretiship is sure.

tcz: Mi ngailuthem numei chu jana chang tei ding, gitlouna vang chun noisena dimset akimu ding ahi.
en_web: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
en_kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: And strong men retain riches.

tcz: Mi ngailuthem chun phatchomna atoh doh ahin, mi kilose vang chun maha akilam doh-ji ahi.
en_web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
en_kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

tcz: Miphalou in jou le nal in tohman amujin, mikitah vang chun muchi pha atun aga alou jitan ahi.
en_web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
en_kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: But to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

tcz: Thildih tuhchah a ngailu chun hinna anei tei ding, aphalou lam jenga chepa chu thi tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
en_kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: So he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

tcz: Alungthim a thildih lou puho Yahweh Pakai in athet in, achena lam lam'a chamdel'a umte chunga Yahweh Pakai akipah jing in ahi.
en_web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
en_kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: But such as are upright in their way are his delight.

tcz: Hechen soh keijun, mi koihile engsetna nei chun talen amat ding, mikitah te vang huhdoh-a um tei diu ahi.
en_web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
en_kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

tcz: Limgeh a um lou numei kitihi vohpi nahko sunga sana chao kiba bep kheh ahi.
en_web: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
en_kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, So is a fair woman which is without discretion.

tcz: Mikitah ho dei le ngai chu, apha cha cha jeng ahin, mikitah lou ho kinepna vang chu lungsatna jeng ahibouve.
en_web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
en_kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

tcz: Itcha louhel'a hongphal mi chu ahao cheh cheh jin, mihem koi hileh apeh ding kisan nunglah achu lhasam cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
en_kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

tcz: Mi hongphal chun anei be cheh cheh ding, mi dang dinga twi chap chan chu ama chunga jong kichap ding ahi.
en_web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
en_kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

tcz: Chang hom-lou a koitup chah khehpa chu mipi sapset chang ding, hinlah kiphal tah'a chang homdohpa chunga vang phattheina lhung ding ahi.
en_web: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
en_kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

tcz: Giltah'a thilpha ngaito pan, lungkimna aneiyin, thilpha lou jong chu aphaloupa chunga aga chu-jitan ahi.
en_web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
en_kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: But he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

tcz: Nei le gou'a kisongpa chu ahomkeuva um tei ding, mikitah te vang thingna banga nou jing diu ahi.
en_web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
en_kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: But the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

tcz: Mi koi hileh a-insung vai hom tup lou chu huija leng le tobang bep ahin, chule mingol chun miching ho jenlea pang tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
en_kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: And the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

tcz: Mikitah natoh chu hinna thingphung ga tobang asoh jin, pannabeija kichih sahna hin hinkho manthahna alhut jin ahi.
en_web: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
en_kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that winneth souls is wise.

tcz: Leiset'a mikitah jeng bon akile thuh theileh, miphalou chunga ichan geija lhung ding hitam chule achonsete chunga ichan gei lhung ding hitam!
en_web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
en_kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: Much more the wicked and the sinner.

tcz: Koi hileh kigahna thet lou chun, hetna jong adeijin, min akhou khah ding deiloupa vang chu miching ahipoi.
en_web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
en_kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: But he that hateth reproof is brutish.

tcz: Mipha chun Yahweh Pakai lunglam atong jin, setna jeng tohgon neipa vang Yahweh Pakai in athetbol jin ahi.
en_web: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
en_kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

tcz: Phatlouna a kon in inchen amangthah jin, mi chondih ho vang chu koiman asuh-ling jou lou ding ahi.
en_web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
en_kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

tcz: Numei pha chu ajipa dinga lallukhuh ahin, jumna le jachatna'a um numei vang ajipa dinga agu achang chip tobang ahi.
en_web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
en_kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

tcz: Mikitah te tohgon chu adih a tanpeh ding, hinlah, lungthim dihloute thumop vang chu kijoulhepna jeng ahi.
en_web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
en_kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: But the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

tcz: Mikitah loute kamcheng chu thisan sona ding jeng ahin, mikitah ho kamcheng vang kihinsona jeng ahi.
en_web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
en_kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

tcz: Mikitah loute chu manthahnan alhut loiji tan, mikitah ho vang chu ding det cheh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
en_kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: But the house of the righteous shall stand.

tcz: Mihem hi alungdih jal'a pachat changji ahin, mihem lungphalou chu thetbolna achang-jin ahi.
en_web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
en_kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

tcz: Mi thupi tah banga chon a, neh le chah lhahsam sang in, lung lhaisel'a ana-kitohpa aphajon ahi.
en_web: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
en_kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better Than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

tcz: Mikitah hon agancha jengu jong khohsahna aneiyun, mikitah loutea kon ngailutna vang chu thangsetna ahi.
en_web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
en_kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

tcz: Mipontho chun agam leiset akhot-a neh ding aki khol ahin, pannabeija thil ngaitoa lhailepan vang ima aneiji pon ahi.
en_web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
en_kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: But he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

tcz: Mikitah lou in chu mangthah loi ding, mikitah ho vang chu thingphung phatah in ajung akhodet tobang ahi.
en_web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
en_kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: But the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

tcz: Mikitah lou chu akamsung sohsa aseikhel thucheng achun akipal jin, mikitah ding in vang gim hesoh akon in ajamdoh jitai.
en_web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
en_kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: But the just shall come out of trouble.

tcz: Mihem khat chun akam thep-ga anen alungkim jitan, hijeh achu mihem khat in na atoh teng achunga lelhun-ji ahi.
en_web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
en_kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: And the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

tcz: Mingol hon achena chan-u adih jeng in amu-jiuvin, mikitah vang chun min ahilna angaijin, lam dihlou apeldoh jin ahi.
en_web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
en_kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: But he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

tcz: Mingol in alunga adeilou chu aphongdoh paijin, mikitah vang chun min ahilouva athet bolna jong iman agel jipoi.
en_web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
en_kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: But a prudent man covereth shame.

tcz: Mikitah chun thudih aseiteng kicheh sel'in vetsahna aumjin, jou le nal-a thuseipa vang chun amacham cham in thu aseidoh-jin ahi.
en_web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
en_kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: But a false witness deceit.

tcz: Thu kiti hi, nasatah chemjam banga akidoulel jong aum jin, miching thusei vang chun mihem adamsah-jin ahi.
en_web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
en_kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: But the tongue of the wise is health.

tcz: Thutah beh seite kamsunga kon in, thudih jeng apot in, thujou seite kamsunga kon vang chu hetman louva manthahna sohji ahi.
en_web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
en_kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: But a lying tongue is but for a moment.

tcz: Thilphalou gong ho lung sunga thilse jeng dimset in achengin, thilpha jeng ngaito teding in kipana jeng ahi.
en_web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
en_kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: But to the counsellers of peace is joy.

tcz: Mikitah chunga thilse alhung jipon, miphalou te chunga vang gim le hesohna jeng alhung jin ahi.
en_web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
en_kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: But the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

tcz: Jou le nal jeng seiji leigui chu Yahweh Pakai in athet in, thudih a natong te chunga vang Yahweh Pakai akipah-jin ahi.
en_web: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
en_kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: But they that deal truly are his delight.

tcz: Miching hon achih-nau kiletsahpi louvin aum jiuvin, mingol hon vang angolnau chu aphongjal le-jitauve.
en_web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
en_kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

tcz: Lungdih pu-hon akhut'un vai ahom jiuvin, khut chalosah nom lou mihem chu soh-a pang tei ding ahi.
en_web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
en_kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: But the slothful shall be under tribute.

tcz: Lunggim a umpa chu atahsa agep liu jin, ngailutna thu ajah teng ama chu kipanan adim jitai.
en_web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
en_kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: But a good word maketh it glad.

tcz: Sihnei lang-neina nei lou mihem chun aloi agol ding in thupha jeng aseijin, mikitah loute vang chu abonchauvin amangthah jitauve.
en_web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
en_kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: But the way of the wicked seduceth them.

tcz: Natong nom lou chu nehding beija um ding, miching in vang nei le gou nengsel-a aset ding ahi.
en_web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
en_kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: But the substance of a diligent man is precious.

tcz: Mikitah lamlhahna chu hinna lampi ahin, lamdih lou chun thina alhut ding ahi.
en_web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
en_kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.

tcz: Chapa ching chun anu le apan ahilna angaijin, miduhdah lou vang chu min aphona jong iman-agel jipoi.
en_web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
en_kjv: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: But a scorner heareth not rebuke.

tcz: Chihna kamcheng in an-pha akimu thei jin, jou le nal jenga thuseipan vang pumthoa mu ding bou agel in ahi.
en_web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
en_kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: But the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

tcz: Alei kituh tang joupa chu kihinso tei ding, koi hileh alei tuhtang thei lou chu mangthah tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
en_kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: But he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

tcz: Mithase hon nehding tampi angaicha jiuvin, hinlah miching in nehding lungkim sel-in amujin ahi.
en_web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
en_kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

tcz: Mikitah in jousei abol ngaipon, mikitah lou vang chun jumna le ngailutna beijin na-atongdoh jin ahi.
en_web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
en_kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

tcz: Mikitah chu adihna jal in ahoidoh jin, miphalou vang chu chonsetnan apui mangthah jitai.
en_web: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
en_kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

tcz: Mi kimkhat chu hao akisah lheh jin, hinlah ima aneideh poi. Mi kimkhatma chu akivai chatsah lheh jin, hinlah nei le gou kimsel-in aneiyin ahi.
en_web: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
en_kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

tcz: Mihem khat chun anei le agou jal'a ahinkho akilhatdoh ahin, hinlah mivaicha ding in kilhatdoh jouna aum jipoi.
en_web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
en_kjv: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: But the poor heareth not rebuke.

tcz: Mikitah chu thaomei bang in avah jing in, miphaloute thaomei vang hetman louva mit ding ahi.
en_web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
en_kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

tcz: Kiletsahna jeh'in thungai loute akitoh thei jipon, kineosah a min ahilna kisante ding in vang chihna ahi.
en_web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
en_kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: But with the well advised is wisdom.

tcz: Gangtah'a kimu nei le gou chu hetman louva bei ding, nei le gou kholkhom lelepa-a vang chu tam cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
en_kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: But he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

tcz: Kinepna bang aso-lou teng, mihem lungthim atongkha jin, hinlah lungtup molsona chu hin-thingphung banga hing jing ding ahi.
en_web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
en_kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

tcz: Min ahilna ngainom loupa chunga manthahna lhung ding, koi hileh thupeh ngaisanga chu kipaman chang tei ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
en_kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

tcz: Miching mihilna chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, hitobang kihilna sang chan chun thina apeldoh teidiu ahi.
en_web: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
en_kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, To depart from the snares of death.

tcz: Lungdih kiti hin thilpha atongdoh jin, kitahna beihel mi vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
en_web: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
en_kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: But the way of transgressors is hard.

tcz: Miching ho chun akalson masang in ageltoh masa jin, mingol hon vang geltoh masa louvin, angolnau atah lang jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
en_kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: But a fool layeth open his folly.

tcz: Thupole miphalou chun miho lunggim hesoh alhut peh jin, ngansena chang tahsan um mi vang chun lungdamna jeng alhut jin ahi.
en_web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
en_kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: But a faithful ambassador is health.

tcz: Seingai loupa chunga chun gentheina le vetsetna alhung jin, min ahilna chan ngaipa vang chu jabolna chang tei ding ahi.
en_web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
en_kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: But he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

tcz: Ngaichat khat toh molso nahi hinkhoa dinga lungkimna ahin, hinlah thilse jamsan ding hi mingol hon athet jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
en_kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: But it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

tcz: Miching toh kivop chu aching in, mingol toh kivoppan vang setna ato tei ding ahi.
en_web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
en_kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: But a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

tcz: Chonseho chu setna ajui jiuvin, mikitah te vang chu phatthei nan ajui jing un ahi.
en_web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
en_kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: But to the righteous good shall be repayed.

tcz: Mipha chun atute khang geija din gou adalhah peh jin, chonseten akhol nei le gou vang chu michonpha ho ding ahibouve.
en_web: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
en_kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

tcz: Vaichaten lou alho teng, neh ding nengchat in akhol khom un, hinlah adihlouva thutan ten achom peh jitauve.
en_web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
en_kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: But there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

tcz: Achate mol'a jep loupa chun, mol aboh ding nom lou ahin, hinlah achate ngailutna neipa chun lungthim phatah mangchan ahil-jin ahi.
en_web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
en_kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

tcz: Mikitah chun lung nachim tah'a neh ding anei jing in, hinlah miphalou ho chu gelkel'a oi-thep ding ahiuve.
en_web: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
en_kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: But the belly of the wicked shall want.

tcz: Numeiching in ain-chen akisemtup in, numei ngol in vang amatah ain-chen sukeh in apangin ahi.
en_web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
en_kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: But the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

tcz: Lungdih'a lam jot chun Yahweh Pakai a ging in, hinlah achena jousea thilphalou gelpan Yahweh Pakai anahsah jipon ahi.
en_web: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
en_kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

tcz: Mingol in akijepna ding akiseidoh bep jin, miching hon vang ahoidoh nadiu akiseidoh jiuvin ahi.
en_web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
en_kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

tcz: Bongchal loukai ding umlou na-a chang akilamdoh ngai pon, ajeh chu bongchal thahat akon chang tampi kilam-ji ahi.
en_web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
en_kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: But much increase is by the strength of the ox.

tcz: Mi kitah hettoh sah-a apan teng jouthu asei ngai pon, mikitah lou hettoh sah-a apan teng jou le nal in thu aseijin ahi.
en_web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
en_kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: But a false witness will utter lies.

tcz: Michavai hon chihna ahol-un amu jou deh pouvin, hinlah thil hetthemna neipa ding in chihna hi nailam cha ahibouve.
en_web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
en_kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: But knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

tcz: Mingol hoa kon'in kikhin mang in, ajeh chu amaho kamsunga kon'in chihna thu kisei japon nate.
en_web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
en_kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, When thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

tcz: Milungthim ching hon ajot nadiu lampi akihet-un, mingol ho vang joulhepna jeng ahi.
en_web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
en_kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: But the folly of fools is deceit.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in miphalou aphohsal jin, michonpha hon vang Elohim Pathen lunglhaina akimu jiuve.
en_web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
en_kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: But among the righteous there is favour.

tcz: Mihem lungthim hin gim le hesoh ahen, midang in akipanau chu ahetthem peh-un ahi.
en_web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
en_kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

tcz: Migilou ho inchu kiphet lhah peh ding, mikitah ho ponbuh vang dettah a kisong jing ding ahi.
en_web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
en_kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: But the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

tcz: Mihem khat'in achena lampi chu dih-in agel jin, hinlah alampi chu ajonaleh thina ahi.
en_web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
en_kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.

tcz: Nuijat pat jeng in jong mihem alung kham jin, kipana jeng jong gimnan akichai-ji tai.
en_web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
en_kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of that mirth is heaviness.

tcz: Mikitah lou chu achena chan'a atohga aneh ding, hitobanga chu miphan jong atohga aneh ding ahi.
en_web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
en_kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: And a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

tcz: Mihem meimeija um chun akisei jouse atahsan jin, miching in vang achena ding akivet phet in ahi.
en_web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
en_kjv: The simple believeth every word: But the prudent man looketh well to his going.

tcz: Miching hon chingthei tah'in thilse apeldoh jiuvin, mingol hon vang ngol han pum'in na atong jiuve.
en_web: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
en_kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: But the fool rageth, and is confident.

tcz: Milungchom hon ngol hoitah in thil abol jiuvin, hinlah thil hethem mivang chu atomngai ahi.
en_web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
en_kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: And a man of wicked devices is hated.

tcz: Mihem meimeija um chu ngolna ahin, miching hon hetna kiti hi lallukhuh a aneiyu ahi.
en_web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
en_kjv: The simple inherit folly: But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

tcz: Thilse kiti phot chu thilpha masanga dilsu ding, miphalou ho jong mikitah ho kelkot phunga dilsu diu ahi.
en_web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
en_kjv: The evil bow before the good; And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

tcz: Mivaicha hohi ain-heng ho kisan in athet bol jiuvin, mihao ding in vang golpha atam jin ahi.
en_web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
en_kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: But the rich hath many friends.

tcz: Aheng akom ngailu lou mihem chu achonse ahin, mivaicha ho ngailua chu anunnom ahi.
en_web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
en_kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: But he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

tcz: Thilse jeng gel hon suhkhel anei tei jiuvin, thilpha jeng ngaito hon vang tahsanna le kitahna akimu jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
en_kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

tcz: Natoh hahsa kiti chun aphachom asoh tei ding, natoh beija thumot seina hin vaichat asoji ahi.
en_web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
en_kjv: In all labour there is profit: But the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

tcz: Miching ho ding in chihna hi lallukhuh in apang jin, mingol ho ding in vang ngolna hi pahvui banga aki-o jiu ahi.
en_web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
en_kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: But the foolishness of fools is folly.

tcz: Mikitah hettohsah a apan teng mi tampi huhdoh jin, hinlah thujou seina hin mihem amanthah sahji ahi.
en_web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
en_kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: But a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

tcz: Elohim Pathen ging kiti hi mihem dinga kisonna ahin, achate jeng jong ama'a kisel diu ahi.
en_web: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
en_kjv: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: And his children shall have a place of refuge.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin kitihi hinna twinah tobang ahin, ajeh chu mihem in thina jeng jong apeldoh-ji ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, To depart from the snares of death.

tcz: Gamsunga cheng mipite apunbe teng lengpa loupina ahin, hinlah mihem lhomcha ahiteng milen milal dinga pannabei ahibouve.
en_web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
en_kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

tcz: Koi hileh lunghang vahlou chun thil hetthemna anei ahin, kino thethua lungchomna vang chun ngol-hoitah atoh doh ding ahi.
en_web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
en_kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

tcz: Lungneng tah'a um hi tahsa damna ahin, hinlah thangthipna kiti hi gu le chang in adoulel ahi.
en_web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
en_kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: But envy the rottenness of the bones.

tcz: Mivaicha sugenthei hon asempau Elohim Pathen ataitom nau ahin, amavang nei lou genthei khoto them chun asempa Elohim Pathen agin ahi.
en_web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
en_kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: But he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

tcz: Miphalou chu toset atosah in alehkhup jin, mikitah ding in vang bitna aum jing in ahi.
en_web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
en_kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: But the righteous hath hope in his death.

tcz: Thil detkhen them mi chun chihna anei jing in, mingolte lungthim sunga vang chihna in mun aneipoi.
en_web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
en_kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: But that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

tcz: Thudih hin mihem namkhat adom sang in, hinlah chonsetna hin mihem nam pumpi muda achansah ahi.
en_web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
en_kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: But sin is a reproach to any people.

tcz: Lhacha chingtah'a natong hin, lengpa lunglam aboldoh jin, jachatna natongpa chunga lengpa alungkim jipoi.
en_web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
en_kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: But his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

tcz: O nem heova mi akidonbut teng alunghang jong alungdam theijin, ahinlah O ngailou tah'a thu kisei vang hin mi aphin lunghang jin ahi.
en_web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
en_kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: But grievous words stir up anger.

tcz: Miching ho leigui hin hetna le thepna thu jeng aphongdoh in, mingol ho kamsung invang ngolna thu jeng aphongdoh jin ahi.
en_web: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
en_kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: But the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in muntin hi amit tenin avelhih jing in, thilse le thilpha kibol jouse jong ahesoh keijin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
en_kjv: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, Beholding the evil and the good.

tcz: O nem heova thu kiseihi hinna thingphung tobang ahin, thu gilou seina leigui hinvang, mihem lungthim asusen ahi.
en_web: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
en_kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: But perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

tcz: Apan ahilna jahda mihem chu a ngol ahin, asuhkhel na chunga apan ahilna sang nga chu miching ahi.
en_web: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
en_kjv: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: But he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

tcz: Mikitahte insunga nei le gou tampi aum jin, miphalou din akilamdoh jeng jong chu gimna bep ahi.
en_web: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
en_kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

tcz: Miching kamcheng akon'in thupha jeng apot in, mingol lungsunga kon in vang hiche hi thil-hahsa ahi
en_web: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
en_kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: But the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

tcz: Miphaloute kilhaina gantha hi Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, mikitah ho taona vang Yahweh Pakai ding in lunglhai umtah ahi.
en_web: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
en_kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: But the prayer of the upright is his delight.

tcz: Miphalou chena lampi chu Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, thildih lam jenga chepa vang Yahweh Pakai hepina achangin ahi.
en_web: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
en_kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

tcz: Koi hileh lamdih jot nomlou chu engbolna achansah jin, min aphona sangnom lou hon athipi teidiu ahi.
en_web: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
en_kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: And he that hateth reproof shall die.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thilhet thei na hin mithi gam a um ahet dia lom ho jong ahet thei in, achutile mihem lungthim chu ichan geijin ahechen tadem!
en_web: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
en_kjv: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: How much more then the hearts of the children of men?

tcz: Adihlou a chonpan, min aphondoh ding anom pon, hichepa chu miching ho henga jong ache poi.
en_web: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
en_kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: Neither will he go unto the wise.

tcz: Lungthim kipanan mai alhaisah in, lungthim ahesoh teng lhagao jong angui jitai.
en_web: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
en_kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

tcz: Hetthemna neipan alunggil in hetna ahol jing in, mingol kamsunga kon in vang ngolna thu jeng apot e.
en_web: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
en_kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: But the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

tcz: Gim le hesoh'a um ho hinkho hi nitin'a thilsen abop ahin, lungthim kipah tah'a um hoding in golvah abang jing in ahi.
en_web: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
en_kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: But he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

tcz: Nei le gou tampi neija, gentheipi sang in, themcha bou neija Yahweh Pakai gin ding athupi joi.
en_web: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
en_kjv: Better is little with the fear of the Lord Than great treasure and trouble therewith.

tcz: Bongchal thaotah kitha'a kitomona aso-bep sang in, kingailutah-a ancheme neh khom aphajoi.
en_web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
en_kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

tcz: Milungkhoh in kinahna apunsah in, mi lungneng lunghang vahlou in kitomona jong akichamsah in ahi.
en_web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
en_kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

tcz: Mithase ho lamlhahna jouse lingle khao'in abap in, mikitah ho lampi vang lamlen kilhong peh-ji ahi.
en_web: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
en_kjv: The way of the slothful man is as a hedge of thorns: But the way of the righteous is made plain.

tcz: Chapa ching in apa akipa sah jin, chapa ngol in vang anu jeng jong iman agel-ji poi.
en_web: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
en_kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: But a foolish man despiseth his mother.

tcz: Lungthim beipa din ngolna chu lunglhaina ahin, thil hethempa vang ama chal peh jitai.
en_web: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
en_kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: But a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

tcz: Kithumopna alhahsam teng, tohgon ache khel jin, mi akithumop to teng lolhinna ahi.
en_web: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
en_kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: But in the multitude of counsellers they are established.

tcz: Phatah a kidonbut hi mijouse lunglhaina ahin, hijeh chun aphat toh kitoh a thu kisei hi aphat a pha ahi.
en_web: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
en_kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: And a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

tcz: Michingpa lamlhahna chu hinna lampia akilhung tou in, aman gotmun apeldoh jin ahi.
en_web: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
en_kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, That he may depart from hell beneath.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mi kiletsahho inn aphet lha jin, meithai ho gamgi vang aphet peh jipoi.
en_web: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
en_kjv: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: But he will establish the border of the widow.

tcz: Miphalou lunggel jouse Yahweh Pakai in athet in, Mi lungdih ho kamcheng soh vang Yahweh Pakai dinga lunglhai um ahi.
en_web: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
en_kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: But the words of the pure are pleasant words.

tcz: Koi hileh lamdih louva mutei ding gochan chun, a-insung dinga gimna alhut ahin, ajeh chu neh guh thetbol chan chun hinna amu ding ahi.
en_web: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
en_kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth gifts shall live.

tcz: Mikitah hon min thu asei teng, lunggil in adonbut ding dan angaito jin, hinlah mingol te kamcheng soh jouse thilphalou jeng twi kisung lha abang jin ahi.
en_web: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
en_kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

tcz: Miphalou hoa kon in Yahweh Pakai akidalsen, mikitah ho taona vang angai peh jin ahi.
en_web: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
en_kjv: The Lord is far from the wicked: But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

tcz: Mit-ha hoisel'a mi akivet teng midinga lungthim kipana ahin, thupha kiseidoh jousen mihem gu le chang adamsah ahi.
en_web: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
en_kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: And a good report maketh the bones fat.

tcz: Min ahilna ngainom mi chu, miching ho lah'a lha thei ding ahi.
en_web: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
en_kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life Abideth among the wise.

tcz: Koi hileh min ahilna sang thei loupa chun ahinkho agimsah ahin, ajehhcu min ahilna ngainom mi chun hetthemna anei tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
en_kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: But he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin hi chihna dinga kihilna ahin, chule kisuhnemna hi jabolna'a pang ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; And before honour is humility.

tcz: Mihem in alung sunga tohgon anei jin, kam kilhang sel'a thu kisei jong Yahweh Pakai in adonbut teijin ahi.
en_web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
en_kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, And the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

tcz: Mihem in angatna lampi chu amit-tenin aven adih jeng in agel in, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in alunggel ngaito jouse akhol chil jin ahi.
en_web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
en_kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But the Lord weigheth the spirits.

tcz: Nabol natoh abonchan Yahweh Pakaija pedoh jeng in, chutileh nathilgon aboncha lolhing ding ahi.
en_web: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
en_kjv: Commit thy works unto the Lord, And thy thoughts shall be established.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil jouse akiman chahna ding dol cheh'a aumsah ahin, migilou jeng jong hahsat nikhoa dinga aumsah ahi.
en_web: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
en_kjv: The Lord hath made all things for himself: Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikiletsah kiti athet in, hijeh chun hethem un, amaho chu gotna chang tei diu ahi.
en_web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
en_kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: Though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

tcz: Tahsan theija chonna le kitahna hin, themmona jeng jong adihsah in, Yahweh Pakai ginna jeh'in mihem in thilphalou apeldoh thei jin ahi.
en_web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
en_kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: And by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

tcz: Mihem chu achena lam jouse Yahweh Pakai lungdei ahitengleh, Yahweh Pakai in ama chu amelmate toh jong akichamsah jitai.
en_web: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
en_kjv: When a man’s ways please the Lord, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

tcz: Thildihlou pum'a kai-tampi kidon khom sang in, thildih'a lhomcha nei ding aphajoi.
en_web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
en_kjv: Better is a little with righteousness Than great revenues without right.

tcz: Mihem in alung in chena ding lampi akisem in, Yahweh Pakai in achena ding lam ako-peh jin ahi.
en_web: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
en_kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: But the Lord directeth his steps.

tcz: Lengpa kamsunga kon'in Elohim Pathen thusei ahung gingdoh jin, hijeh chun lengpan thu a tankhel jipon ahi.
en_web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
en_kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: His mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil adih in atetoh jin, hijeh chun thil ijakai Yahweh Pakai in atetohsa jeng ahi.
en_web: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
en_kjv: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: All the weights of the bag are his work.

tcz: Leng ho din thil adihlouva bol hi thet umtah ahin, ajeh chu Ama vaihomna hi thudih a kingam ahi.
