en_web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
en_kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: For the throne is established by righteousness.

tcz: Leiguia kon thudih kiseidoh hi lengpa din lunglhai aum in, ajeh chu lengpan thu adih'a sei chu angailun ahi.
en_web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
en_kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.

tcz: Lengpa lunghan nahi gihsalna ahin, hinlah miching chun lengpa lunghanna adamsah jin ahi.
en_web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
en_kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: But a wise man will pacify it.

tcz: Lengpa mailhai sel'a aum teng, damna akibe jin, lengpa lunglhaina jong hi, go hung phin lhaji meilhang tobang ahi.
en_web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
en_kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

tcz: Sana sang in chihna kimu dei aum jon, dangka sang'a jong thil hetthemna kisan ding ahi.
en_web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
en_kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

tcz: Michondih chu thilse lam'a kon'in akiheidoh jin, achena tinchenga limgehpa chu kihinso teiding ahi.
en_web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
en_kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

tcz: Manthah ding kon le kiletsahna ahung lhung loi jin, kipal lhuh ding konleh, lhagaova hoithana ahung um loi jitai.
en_web: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
en_kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.

tcz: Mikiletsah hotoh thil kichomdoh kihop sang in, kineosah a vaichate toh lhat khom anom e.
en_web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
en_kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.

tcz: Min ahilna ngaija chu khangtou jing ding, chule Yahweh Pakaija kisong chan chu anunnom ahi.
en_web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
en_kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: And whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

tcz: Mi-lungchingpa chu thil hethemmi kiti ding, chule lunglhaina'a thuseipan mi athujo tei ding ahi.
en_web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
en_kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

tcz: Chihna nei mi chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, mingol ho ngolna hi talen matna bep ahi.
en_web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
en_kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: But the instruction of fools is folly.

tcz: Miching lung sunga kon chihna thucheng hungpot chan chu, Dan toh akikal jipon, akamcheng soh jouse chu mi thununna ahibouve.
en_web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
en_kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.

tcz: Ngailutna'a thu kisei hi khoiju tobang ahin, lhagao le tahsa ding in antuitah damna ahi.
en_web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
en_kjv: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

tcz: Mikhat ding in lampi khat chu lamdih jeng in akimun, hinlah alampi chu ajona thina ahi.
en_web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
en_kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.

tcz: Natong gimpa hin, aneh ding gelna'a atoh ahin, ajeh chu aneh nomna alol chun achama atohsah ahitai.
en_web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
en_kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; For his mouth craveth it of him.

tcz: Mihem pannabei chun thilphalou jeng agel in, akamcheng soh jong melkah gin tobang ahi.
en_web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
en_kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: And in his lips there is as a burning fire.

tcz: Thilphalou bolpan, baotamna aso-sah jin, aguh a thuphong lepan golcha kingaitah jong asukhen in ahi.
en_web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
en_kjv: A froward man soweth strife: And a whisperer separateth chief friends.

tcz: Pumthoa natong hon aheng akom jeng jong atilseu-vin, chuting aheng akompa jong lamdih-lou alhung jitai.
en_web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
en_kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, And leadeth him into the way that is not good.

tcz: Koi hileh mit teni-singa phetsah jichun, thilpha lou jeng angaiton, muh phunsah sah pan jong thilphalou abolsoh ahita bouve.
en_web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
en_kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: Moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

tcz: Sam-kang liuva hinna hi, loupina lallukhuh ahin, adih jenga hinkho akiman teng, hitobanga hi hinkhosot thei ahibouve.
en_web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
en_kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, If it be found in the way of righteousness.

tcz: Ki hatsah sang in thohhat tah'a lungneng apha jon, alungput athua nunsah joupa chu, khopi khat nokhum'a kilah sang in aphachom joi.
en_web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
en_kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

tcz: Khutphang sunga vang akive jin, hinlah vang phatna leh phatlouna chu Yahweh Pakaija hung kon bou ahi.
en_web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
en_kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.

tcz: Insunga kiboina pum'a golvah bolsang in, an-keoseh kineh a lungmonga um aphajoi.
en_web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
en_kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of sacrifices with strife.

tcz: Soh chingtah chu apupa chapa ahin, chule adihlouva chonpa chunga jong vaihom in apang jin, hiche sohpa chu apupa nei le gou aboncha achapate toh sopi khat banga kihom ding ahi.
en_web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
en_kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

tcz: Thil solna bel chu dangka solna kimang ahin, mei-khuh sung hi sana solna ahi. Hinlah Yahweh Pakai hi lungput aboncha patepna ahi.
en_web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.
en_kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: But the Lord trieth the hearts.

tcz: Miphalou in akamsunga thilphalou seipa thusei bou angai nom in, chule mijou in jong jou le nal thoa leigui kilehpel chu angai nom in ahi.
en_web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
en_kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; And a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

tcz: Vaicha noisea tot chaveipa chun asempa Elohim Pathen ataitom ahin, mi vangset pat'a kipah chun gimbolna ato tei ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
en_kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: And he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

tcz: Tehse ho ding in atute hi alallukhuh-u ahin, chapate loupina hi apateu ahi.
en_web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
en_kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.

tcz: Mingol ho din thu ngaitah'a kisei hi pannabei ahin, milen milal te ang sunga jou le nal'a thu kisei jong pannabei ahibouve.
en_web: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
en_kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: Much less do lying lips a prince.

tcz: Aguh'a thilpeh kiti hi apepa din vangbohna tobang ahin, hijeh chun achena jousea khang ding ahi.
en_web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
en_kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

tcz: Koi hileh suhkhelna ngaidam thei chun, ngailutna angaichat jing ahin, hinlah miphul phul pan vang gol le pai akikhenpi jin ahi.
en_web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
en_kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

tcz: Mingol jakhat vei akichup sang in, thil hetthemna neipa ding in akihilna jeng jong asanji ahei.
en_web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
en_kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man Than an hundred stripes into a fool.

tcz: Engsetna nei mi chun doumah jeng ahol le jin, amatoh kitoh ding in sottol engse ahung lo jitai.
en_web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
en_kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

tcz: Mikhat in mingol khat angol pet'a akimaitopi sang in, vompi nou akilo-doh nungsanga api kimaitopi aphajoi.
en_web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
en_kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.

tcz: Mihem in thilpha khat thilsea alethuh teng, a-insunga thilse cheng jing ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
en_kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.

tcz: Kitoma ahung um teng twiput tobang in ahung pot jin, ajeh chu kitomona aso masanga kikhen tel aphajoi.
en_web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
en_kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

tcz: Athemmo lha kanga athem-jo mo chansahna hileh, Yahweh Pakai dinga anitah lhonna dei um lou ahi.
en_web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
en_kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, Even they both are abomination to the Lord.

tcz: Lungthimbei mingol in chihna kichohna ding sum akhol ngei poi.
en_web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
en_kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool To get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

tcz: Golngai chun phat tin in mi alungset in, sopi kiti hi hahsat petna kithokhom dinga hung peng ahibouve.
en_web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
en_kjv: A friend loveth at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.

tcz: Lungthim neilou mihem chu bat-san apang jin, hitichun aheng akom hoa batsah nan apang bep e.
en_web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
en_kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

tcz: Suhkhel ding ging lou mihem chun kinah baotam adei ahin, ain kotpi paopia kiletsah pan manthahna jeng agon ahibouve.
en_web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
en_kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: And he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

tcz: Mihem lungput dihlou kiti chu akhang thei pon, jou le nal seija pang kamsung jong vangsetna'a lhalut teiji ahi.
en_web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
en_kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

tcz: Chapa ngol hi ahingpa dinga gimna bep ahin, hiche mingolpa hing chu akipah thei poi.
en_web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
en_kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: And the father of a fool hath no joy.

tcz: Lung kipana hi damna pipen ahin, lamvaija um chu gu le chang dinga doulal um ahi.
en_web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
en_kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: But a broken spirit drieth the bones.

tcz: Thu adih a tan sang in, miphalou hon sum-guh ane jiuvin, thudih chu achekhel sah jitauve.
en_web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
en_kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom To pervert the ways of judgment.

tcz: Thil jouse hetthemna nei mi chun chihna lam jeng aven, ajon in, hinlah mingol chun leiset kol mang avelen ahi.
en_web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
en_kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

tcz: Chapa in apa lunggimna asodoh peh in, anu dinga gimna tah ahi.
en_web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
en_kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.

tcz: Mikitah ahilou lam'a leosah kiti apha pon, vaihom milen milal jep ding jong thildih ahipoi.
en_web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
en_kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, Nor to strike princes for equity.

tcz: Thu kisei ngaija chu hetna anei jin, chule lungneng tah'a thusei mi chun hetkhenna anei ahi.
en_web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
en_kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: And a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

tcz: Mingol jeng jong thipbeh cha aum teng, miching bang in akigel jin, hitobang michun akam akeh lou teng, miching tah bang in akigel-ji bouve.
en_web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
en_kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: And he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

tcz: Mihem ama changseh kikhoh sahpa chu ama dei lam jeng-ah akisalal jin, thildih lam ki manchahna jouse adoudal jin ahi.
en_web: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
en_kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh And intermeddleth with all wisdom.

tcz: Mingol in thil hetthem'a lunglhai ding kiti anahsah pon, ama lung ngaichat jeng bou akhoh sah-jin ahi.
en_web: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
en_kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But that his heart may discover itself.

tcz: Phatlouna ahung um teng, thangset nan ahin jui in, kijatona abei teng kimudana aum paijin ahi.
en_web: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
en_kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, And with ignominy reproach.

tcz: Miching kamsunga kon hung potdoh thuchang hohi twithuh tobang ahin, chihna jong hi vadung tehliu'a twilong tobang ahi.
en_web: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
en_kjv: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, And the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

tcz: Miphalou maija langnei hi angaina ahipon, mikitah chungthu adih'a tan ding jong suh-noh phah lou ding ahi.
en_web: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
en_kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, To overthrow the righteous in judgment.

tcz: Mingol thucheng hin mitoh kinahna ason, akamchenga kon in mol akisei doh bep jitai.
en_web: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
en_kjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for strokes.

tcz: Mingol kamcheng hi ama dinga amanthahna bep ahin, aleigui in ama le ama thangkol'a o-na ding akisemdoh bep ahi.
en_web: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
en_kjv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.

tcz: Aguh a thu poa pangpa thusei jihi, anneh tuitah tobang ahin, akamcheng sohdoh jouse jong mihem lungsunga alhalut paijin ahi.
en_web: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
en_kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, And they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

tcz: Atohna chunga mithase hi, mi manthah sahpa toh sopi ahi.
en_web: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
en_kjv: He also that is slothful in his work Is brother to him that is a great waster.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minhi kulpi nasatah tobang ahin, hijeh chun mikitah in abel-jin hoidohnan aneiye.
en_web: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
en_kjv: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

tcz: Mihaopa nei le gou chu ama din kulpi dettah tobang ahin, akihuh hingna dinga pal kikai bep bep ahi.
en_web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
en_kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own conceit.

tcz: Mihem amanthah kon leh, kiletsah nan adim jin, koi hileh akineosa masa chan chu jabolna chang ding ahi.
en_web: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
en_kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, And before honour is humility.

tcz: Thil hetchet masanga donbut jeng chun, ngol-houi tah jumna ato tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
en_kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, It is folly and shame unto him.

tcz: Mihem lhagao in dam-mona athoh jou in, hinlah lhagao adamlou teng thoh hahsa ding ahi.
en_web: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
en_kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a wounded spirit who can bear?

tcz: Chihna lungthim neihon phat tin'in hetbe ding adei-jun, hijeh chun miching hon hetna mube ding ago jing un ahi.
en_web: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
en_kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

tcz: Mihem kiti hi athilpeh chun lampi agonpeh-ji ahin, hijeh chun milen milal henga jong apuilut jin ahi.
en_web: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
en_kjv: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.

tcz: Mihem khat'in achung thu akikhol masah teng, adih in akimu nan, akihehpi dingpa ahung lhun'a akikhol chaisoh teng, achung thu kiseipan bep ahi.
en_web: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
en_kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; But his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

tcz: Vang vetna kiti hin baotamna abeisah jin, akidou teni kah'a jong thutan in apang e.
en_web: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
en_kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.

tcz: Sopi khat in asopi khat apanpi hi, kulpi dettah tobang ahin, hinlah kinahna aso teng khopi kelkot kikam chah kheh tobang ahi.
en_web: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
en_kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: And their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

tcz: Mihem in kamngai vang in an-neh ding akimun, koi hileh akamcheng tohga ne chan chu alungkim in ahi.
en_web: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
en_kjv: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; And with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

tcz: Kampao le leiguia kon in thi le hin akingam in, koi hileh adihlou'a thusei chan chun atohga aneh tei ding ahi.
en_web: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
en_kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: And they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

tcz: Pasal in numei ji-ding akimu teng, amapa chu anunnom ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija kon lung lhaina chang ding ahitai.
en_web: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
en_kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favour of the Lord.

tcz: Mivaichan khotona angaichat teng atao jin, hinlah mihao'in kiletsah to thon thu asei-jin ahi.
en_web: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
en_kjv: The poor useth intreaties; But the rich answereth roughly.

tcz: Gol le pai kiti hi apha-lhem manthahna thei jong aum in, hinlah gol le pai abang chu penpi tahbeh sopi sanga kinaipi jong aum in ahi.
en_web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
en_kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: And there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

tcz: Mingol thu motsei seipa sang in, hinkho mandan them'a vaichat aphajoi.
en_web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
en_kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

tcz: Mihem khat hetna beija hin hi apha pon, kin le donga chena lampi anoh phah thei-jin ahi.
en_web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
en_kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet, sinneth.

tcz: Mingol chu manthah nan apui mang teng, Yahweh Pakai mo achansah kit-jin ahi.
en_web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
en_kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: And his heart fretteth against the Lord.

tcz: Mihao ding in gol le pai thah thah asem jin, mivaichapa vang chu agol apai in jong adalha laloi jie.
en_web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
en_kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; But the poor is separated from his neighbour.

tcz: Hettosah'a pang jou le nal seipa chun, engbolna ato tei ding ahi.
en_web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
en_kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, And he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

tcz: Mihem ahongphal chun ahin-khohsah thei mi tampi anei ding, jou le nal'a thuseipa vang ong-doh lou ding ahi.
en_web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
en_kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

tcz: Mivaicha hi asopi ho jeng in jong athet bol jiuvin, achutileh agol apaiho chun ichan geijin athet tadiu vem? Vaichapan asam sam in hinlah adalha-ji tauve.
en_web: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
en_kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: How much more do his friends go far from him! He pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

tcz: Chihna kimupa chun hinkho manlut dan ahet ahin, thil hethem mi chu machal tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
en_kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: He that keepeth understanding shall find good.

tcz: Hettohsah jou le nal seija pang pan, engbolna ato tei ding, koi hileh thujou seichan chun thina apeldoh lou ding ahi.
en_web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
en_kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, And he that speaketh lies shall perish.

tcz: Mingol khat'in nomsatah'a hinkho aman ding adih thei pon, soh khat dinga milen milal chunga vaihompa hi ding jong dih thei him him lou ahi.
en_web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
en_kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

tcz: Lungput dihtah kiti hin, mi lunghanna asosah jipon, min ahilou lam'a abolna donse lou chu ama dia loupina ahi.
en_web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
en_kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

tcz: Lengpa lunghanna hi keipi ngih tobang ahin, alunglhaina vang hamhing lah daitwi in achap tobang ahi.
en_web: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
en_kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favour is as dew upon the grass.

tcz: Chapa ngol hi apa dinga hamsetna ahin, numei ajipa toh kicham thei lou chu, gotwi julha tobang ahi.
en_web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
en_kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

tcz: Nei le gou kiti hi pute patea kon kilo son-ji ahin, numei chingtah jia kimu hi Yahweh Pakaija kon ahi.
en_web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
en_kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: And a prudent wife is from the Lord.

tcz: Thasetna hin mi alhim i-mujin, Koi hileh athase chan chun kel athoh ding ahi.
en_web: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
en_kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

tcz: Thupeh nit chan kihinso tei ding, amavang thu kisei ija-sep lou chu thina ato ding ahi.
en_web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
en_kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; But he that despiseth his ways shall die.

tcz: Mivaicha kithopi chun Yahweh Pakai akithopi ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in atohman alethuh tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
en_kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; And that which he hath given will he pay him again.

tcz: Semphat thei le kinepna aum pat hin, na chapa phohsal jeng in, moh manthah sah ding vang gel hih hel in.
en_web: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
en_kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, And let not thy soul spare for his crying.

tcz: Milung chom chun gimna ato tei ding ahin, dalha jeng tan, ajeh chu nangma chunga jong gimna lhun lo ding ahi.
en_web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
en_kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: For if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

tcz: Min nahilna le nathumopna ngaiphan lang asanji them in, ajeh chu khonung teng chihna nanei theina ding ahi.
en_web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
en_kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

tcz: Nangman tohgon ijat nei jong lechun, Yahweh Pakai lungdei banga nagon ding bou athupin ahi.
en_web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
en_kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; Nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

tcz: Mihem akon kitahna hi deisah pipen ahin, lungput dihlou sang in vaichat aphajon ahi.
en_web: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
en_kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: And a poor man is better than a liar.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin hi kihin sona ahin, chule Yahweh Pakai gingmi chu alungkim jin, ama chu hamset nan alhun den lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
en_kjv: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: And he that hath it shall abide satisfied; He shall not be visited with evil.

tcz: Mithase hon bukong asoh jiuvin, chule akamsung uva het ding jong angapcha jipouve.
en_web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
en_kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

tcz: Mitot chavei ho chu gotna pi-lechun, chihna'a min anei thei ding; thil hethem mi chu gihsal le chun ahetna kibelap ding ahi.
en_web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
en_kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: And reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

tcz: Apa pumthoa del le anu del mangpa chu, jum le jachat hung konna chapa tia seiset chang ding ahi.
en_web: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
en_kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, Is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

tcz: Kachapa, min na hilna ngai datan, chule chihnan jong donse da jeng tan.
en_web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
en_kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction That causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

tcz: Hettohsah duhdah loupa chun, thudih jong adoudal jin, hitichun mingol in, akam sunga themmona aki loilut jitai.
en_web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
en_kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: And the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

tcz: Kijepna ding mol hi miphalou dinga kisem ahin, tungtun kijep jong hi mingol ho ding bou ahi.
en_web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
en_kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, And stripes for the back of fools.

tcz: Ju kiti hi nuijat le chatvei sosah ahin, khamna thei kiti jong hi kanah le baotamna jeng ahi. Khamna theija lop chu miching ahipoi.
en_web: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
en_kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: And whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

tcz: Lengpa lunghan kigin nahi keipi bahkai ngih tobang ahin, koi hileh lengpa phin lung hang chan chu ahinkhoa tijat umtah ahi.
en_web: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
en_kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: Whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

tcz: Kinah baotamna'a kon kidalse ding hi mijabolna ahin, mingol kiti chu mitoh kina'a baotamji ahi.
en_web: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
en_kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: But every fool will be meddling.

tcz: Koi hileh nipi laija natong nom lou chun, thaset jeh'a chang-at ding amujou lou ding ahi.
en_web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
en_kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; Therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

tcz: Mihem khat in alunggil'a angaito hi twi thuh tah tobang ahin, hinlah thil hetkhen themna nei mihem dingin; hitobang thuh tah chu twi thal'a athal ding ahi.
en_web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
en_kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out.

tcz: Mihem tampin ama ama kitahna cheh aphon ding, hinlah mihem kitah mong koiyin amudoh tadem?
en_web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
en_kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: But a faithful man who can find?

tcz: Hitobang mi chu lungthim dihtah'a lamlha pa ahin, anungjui-ah achapa te jeng jong phatthei chang ding ahi.
en_web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
en_kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: His children are blessed after him.

tcz: Athuthanna laltouna'a tou lengpan, ijakai amit tenin aven ase le apha atetoh jin ahi.
en_web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
en_kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

tcz: Mihem koiham, “Kalung thim kasutheng in; kachonsetna kon in katheng tai,” tia sei ngam ding?
en_web: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
en_kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

tcz: Thil tena dihlou le thil tena kitoh lou chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi cheh lhon e.
en_web: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
en_kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, Both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.

tcz: Naosen jeng jong achaloh aum chan in, itobang mi ahi aphongdoh in; hijeh chun athilbol chu adih ham athenga ham ti aseidoh theijin ahi.
en_web: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
en_kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, Whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

tcz: Kho jahna bikol hihen chule kho muna mit hijongleh, anitah'a Yahweh Pakai in asem ahi.
en_web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
en_kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, The Lord hath made even both of them.

tcz: Imut ding bou gel hih hel'in, ajeh chu vaichatnan nahin phah lo ding ahi; na mit teni hasah inlang vetan, chutileh an neh ding neng jeng junga nanei ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
en_kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; Open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

tcz: Thilchoa pang pan, “Man bei ahibouve,” atin, hinlah ama chu ache mang teng hoitho nan adim jitai.
en_web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
en_kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

tcz: Chihna le hetna kamsunga kon thucheng hohi, sana le song mantam sang in aman tamjon ahi.
en_web: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
en_kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

tcz: Hetkhah louhel mi kom'a thilman a kitungsa mipa chu, aponsil aboncha kichom peh a; chule hetphah louhel mite dinga hitobang mihem chu kiman jeng thei ahidem?
en_web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
en_kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: And take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

tcz: Koitobang khat dingin changlhah kigua kine hi atui chomdan'in angaito in, hinlah phat chomkhat jouteng akamsunga song chang tobang adim jin ahi.
en_web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
en_kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

tcz: Ki-thu mopto them na jeh'in thilgon ho alolhing thei jin, chingthei tah'a kilam kaina jeh'a galsat'a kikonji ahi.
en_web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
en_kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: And with good advice make war.

tcz: Akam tam le seiding hol'a chun thuguh jouse aseidoh jin, hijeh chun ngol the thua thuseipa chutoh kivop hih in.
en_web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
en_kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: Therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa gaosap chan chu, muthim lah'a athao mei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
en_kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, His lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

tcz: Apatna kino chenga kimuji nei le gou chu, achaina lam tengleh phattheina bei ding ahitai.
en_web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
en_kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.

tcz: “Keiman thilse ka lethuh ding ahi,” tin jong seihih in; Yahweh Pakai ngah in chule Aman na kithopi tei ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
en_kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; But wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.

tcz: Thil tena adihlouva kimangcha chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga dei-umlou tah ahi; chule thil asao le achom tena adihlou jong chu aphapoi.
en_web: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
en_kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; And a false balance is not good.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thusah jal'a bou mihem in akal asonji ahin, achutileh mihem in amacham tah'a akalsonna ding iti ahetkhen thei ding ham?
en_web: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
en_kjv: Man’s goings are of the Lord; How can a man then understand his own way?

tcz: Ama deidan tah a, “Hiche hi thil theng ahibouve,” tia sei chu; kipal lhuhna dinga thangkol kisong ahin, hiche hin Yahweh Pakaija kitepna le kigahna chu amin mai maija aphondoh ahi.
en_web: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
en_kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, And after vows to make inquiry.

tcz: Lengpa ching thei tah chun migilouho pum'a kijap bangin ajapdoh jin, achunga akol-in akipei lele sah jin ahi.
en_web: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
en_kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, And bringeth the wheel over them.

tcz: Mihem lhagao kiti hi Yahweh Pakai thaomei vah ahin, hijeh chun mihem lunggil hi ahesoh keijin ahi.
en_web: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
en_kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, Searching all the inward parts of the belly.

tcz: Kitahna le tantih neilouva ngailutna chun lengpa ahinso ahin, Alaltouna jeng jong ngailutnan ahendet ahibouve.
en_web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
en_kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: And his throne is upholden by mercy.

tcz: Gollhang ho loupina hi athahat jal-u ahin, tehse ho melhoina vang hi asam kan'u hi ahi.
en_web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
en_kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: And the beauty of old men is the gray head.

tcz: Thilse doudalna'a tahsa kijepna maha chu damdoi phatah ahin, hitobang kijepna chun mihem lung laigil geija asuhtheng ahi.
en_web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
en_kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: So do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in vadung twi alon sahna nom nom'a alonsah banga, lengpa lungthim jong ahei lele thei ahi.
en_web: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
en_kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: He turneth it whithersoever he will.

tcz: Mihem in achonna jouse chu amit mun dih asa-jin, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in mihem lungthim akhol chil jin ahi.
en_web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
en_kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: But the Lord pondereth the hearts.

tcz: Kilhaina gantha sang in, thildih bol'a thu adih a tan ding hi, Yahweh Pakai lunglhaina ahijoi.
en_web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
en_kjv: To do justice and judgment Is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

tcz: Kiletsahna lungthim pua mitha chule miphalou ho natoh aboncha chonset jeng ahi.
en_web: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
en_kjv: A high look, and a proud heart, And the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

tcz: Miching hon gunchutah'a tohgon anei jouseu abulhing thei jin, amavang amin mei meija natong ho alhasam teijin ahi.
en_web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
en_kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; But of every one that is hasty only to want.

tcz: Jou le nal thoa nei le gou kichom khom jouse amangthah ding bep ahin, thina thang kisong tobang ahibouve.
en_web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
en_kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

tcz: Thu adih'a tan ding mihon anahsah lou jeh un, miphalou pumthoa natong hon pannabei jin asumang jitauve.
en_web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
en_kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; Because they refuse to do judgment.

tcz: Themmona neipan lamdih ajot jipon, lungthim thengpa lam lhahna adih jing in ahi.
en_web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
en_kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: But as for the pure, his work is right.

tcz: Numei hanse khat toh in nom khat'a chenkhom sang in, chungden in-vum'a chen ding aphajoi.
en_web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
en_kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, Than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

tcz: Miphalou lhagao'in thilse jeng bou angai chan, aheng akom in jong ama'a kon'in khotona amu jipoi.
en_web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
en_kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: His neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

tcz: Panna beija mi tot chaveipa gotna akipeh teng, milham in chih-nan anei theijin chule miching ho akihil chan in hetna akibelep jie.
en_web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
en_kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

tcz: Mikitah chu miphalou in amelchih jing in, miphalou vang chu achunga hamsetna lhung tei ding ahi.
en_web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
en_kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: But God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

tcz: Koi hileh migenthei akateng kijahmosah chu, ama kana ahung lhun teng koiman ajah phah peh lou ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
en_kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

tcz: Aguh'a kipa thilpeh hin alunghang jong adamsah thei jin, koima hetlouva nehguh kipe hin lungsat jong adaisah jitai.
en_web: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
en_kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: And a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

tcz: Thu adih'a kitan hin mikitah akipasah in, hinlah miphalou ho ding in tijat umtah ahi.
en_web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
en_kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: But destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

tcz: Mi koi hileh hetkhen themna'a kon lamvaija vahmang chan chu, mithi hotoh kivop khomna ding mun ajot ahitai.
en_web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
en_kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding Shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

tcz: Tahsa nopsahna lamjeng lhangai hochun vaichatna akimudiu ahin, koi hijongleh jule noplenna-a kipe hochu itihchan hijongleh haodoh loudiu ahi.
en_web: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
en_kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

tcz: Koi hileh min akhoto ding jeng ngaicha a chu, vaicha pum'a um jing ding, chule ju-a lop jong haodoh thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
en_kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, And the transgressor for the upright.

tcz: Numei lungkhoh le lungsa jing, jia neija chen khom sang in, het phahlou neldi gam'a chen aphajoi.
en_web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
en_kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, Than with a contentious and an angry woman.

tcz: Miching chenna in-ah nei le gou lutah tah aum in, hinlah mingol in abonchan ane-mang jitai.
en_web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
en_kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man spendeth it up.

tcz: Koi hileh chonphatna lam khohsah a, chule mi khotona neipa chun jabolna amu tei ding ahi.
en_web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
en_kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy Findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

tcz: Miching mihatpa chenna khopi jong akholchil soh keijin, chule akisonpi pen-u kulpi jong alekhup'a asuhchim hel ding ahi.
en_web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
en_kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

tcz: Koi hileh thipkhen cha um'a lei kituh tang chu, gim le hesohna'a jong kivengdoh ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
en_kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.

tcz: Mi noise le kiletsahna jong hi, pannabeija tot chaveipa kiseina ahibouve.
en_web: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
en_kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, Who dealeth in proud wrath.

tcz: Mi thase ho chu aduchat uvin acham lou'a thina alhut ahi. Ajeh chu amahon akhut-u mangcha'a natoh ding anom pouve.
en_web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
en_kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; For his hands refuse to labour.

tcz: Miphalou hon nitin in anei asit jing un, miching in anei ahom in, akile lah ngai poi.
en_web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
en_kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: But the righteous giveth and spareth not.

tcz: Miphalou ho kilhaina gantha chu thet umtah ahina chungchon in, phatlouna lungpun hin phaldoh taleu, ichan geija thet um cheh ding hitam!
en_web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
en_kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: How much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

tcz: Jou le nal seija hettohsah'a pang ho suhbeija um ding, hinlah adih'a hettohsah'a pangpa thusei min angaipeh jing ding ahi.
en_web: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
en_kjv: A false witness shall perish: But the man that heareth, speaketh constantly.

tcz: Miphalou chu adihlou'in aki ngamsah jin, hinlah mikitah chun atoh masang in ageltoh masa jin ahi.
en_web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
en_kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: But as for the upright, he directeth his way.

tcz: Mihem chihna le hetkhen themna chule aguh a kithumop themna chengsea kon hin, Yahweh Pakai deh-jou ding aum poi.
en_web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
en_kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against the Lord.

tcz: Galsat nikhoa manchah din sakol gonsan aum in, hinlah gal-jona hi Yahweh Pakaija kon bou ahi.
en_web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
en_kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: But safety is of the Lord.

tcz: Haosatna sanga minphat kilhen ding apha jon, sana le dangka sanga jong, mihem lunglhaina um ding aphajoi.
en_web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
en_kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, And loving favour rather than silver and gold.

tcz: Mihao hihen mivaicha hijongleh akisu-khen thei aum poi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in anitah lhon'a asem ahi.
en_web: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.
en_kjv: The rich and poor meet together: The Lord is the Maker of them all.

tcz: Miching chun alungthim in hahsatna hung lhung ding avephan, ama le ama akivengdoh jin ahi. Hinlah mi lungthim bei le ima kholtoh louva machalpi chun gimna ato tei ding ahi.
en_web: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
en_kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: But the simple pass on, and are punished.

tcz: Kineosah pum le Elohim Pathen gin jeh'a kipaman chu haosatna jouse, jabolna chule hinna ahi.
en_web: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.
en_kjv: By humility and the fear of the Lord Are riches, and honour, and life.

tcz: Phatlouna jenga chonpa lam lhahna chu ling le khaovin abom jin, koi hileh ling le khao lah'a kiveng thempa chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
en_kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: He that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

tcz: Chapang chu lamdih jenga khoukhah in, chutileh akhanlhit geija asuhmil lou ding aki lhonpi jing ding ahi.
en_web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
en_kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: And when he is old, he will not depart from it.

tcz: Mihao in mivaichate chunga vai ahom in, chule sum bapa jong abatsah napa soh'in apang e.
en_web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
en_kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, And the borrower is servant to the lender.

tcz: Koi hileh thu adihlou'a tan chun hamsetna ato tei ding, amapa chu lunghang henlang mol-a pansa jongleh, apansahna mol chu atahsa chunga lechuh ding ahibouve.
en_web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
en_kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: And the rod of his anger shall fail.

tcz: Koi hileh midang mit-ha phatah'a vepa chu phatthei chang ding, ajeh chu aman aneh ding an chu vaicha ho apejin ahi.
en_web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
en_kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.

tcz: Miphalou chon chavei ho chu no-mang un, chutileh kinahna jong beiyin tin, baotamna jouse jong thip hel ding ahi.
en_web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
en_kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; Yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mi lungtheng chu angailun, Koi hileh O ngei sel'a thusei chun lengpa jeng jong gol le paija akisem thei ahi.
en_web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
en_kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, For the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hetna kiti hi Amit tenin ave-jing in, chule kitahna bei mi chu apaidoh jin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
en_kjv: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, And he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

tcz: Mithasen aseijin, “hichea khun keipi bahkai aum in, potdoh leng kholai dunga ei-tha ding ahi” ati.
en_web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
en_kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

tcz: Jonlungpu numeinu kamsung hi, kokhuh thuh tah ahin, Yahweh Pakai lung hansah chan chu hiche kokhuh sunga hi lhalut tei ding ahi.
en_web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.
en_kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: He that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.

tcz: Chapang lungthim sunga hi ngolna dimset ahin, hinlah achunga hilchahna aum teng, ngolna chu bei tei ding ahi.
en_web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
en_kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; But the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

tcz: Hao ding deija mivaicha sugentheija chule ahaopa pehbe mi chu vaichat nan aphah ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
en_kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, And he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

tcz: Nana hong phan lang miching ho thumop ngaiphan, chule kahetna hi nalung sunga het tei ding gon lang kisanlut in;
en_web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
en_kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche ho jouse hi nalung sunga nachin leh, nangma dinga lung nopna'a pang ding, chule aboncha nakam'a na phondoh thei teng, nalung lhai ding ahi.
en_web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
en_kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; They shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija nakison theina dinga, tunia hi keiman nangma jah-tah'a kaseipeh nahi.
en_web: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
en_kjv: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

tcz: Keiman nakom'a thumopna le hetthemna thucheng phatah tah kasutdoh peh nahi lou ham?
en_web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
en_kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things In counsels and knowledge,

tcz: Hitiahi nangman thutah hochu nahet them'a, chutengleh nahinsol ho ang-a thu adih'a na donbut theina dinga kahil nahi.
en_web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
en_kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; That thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

tcz: Najotho man'in mivaicha ho chom hih in, ama chu vaicha tahbeh ahi.
en_web: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
en_kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: Neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi amaho vengtup a pang ahin, koi hileh amaho sumang achu Aman asuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
en_kjv: For the Lord will plead their cause, And spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

tcz: Milung chom le lunghang jing hotoh kivop dan, chule mi lungsa jing hoto jong chekhom hih in.
en_web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
en_kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; And with a furious man thou shalt not go:

tcz: Hitia chu naum louleh ama tobanga nachon ding, chepaina'a nanei loa nahinkho lamvai ding ahi.
en_web: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
en_kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, And get a snare to thy soul.

tcz: Bat lahna'a batman a kitung doh ho bang in, batsah nan kimoh tun hih in.
en_web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
en_kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, Or of them that are sureties for debts.

tcz: Asahna ding ima naneitah lou jongleh, nalupna jalkhun geijin pedoh jeng tan.
en_web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
en_kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

tcz: Napu Napa khang apat gamgi melchihna song chu, nangman na chondoh lou ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
en_kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.

tcz: Lolhingtah'a natong khut them namudoh lou ham? Amachu lengpa ang-sunga bou ding ding, michavei masanga vang ding thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
en_kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.

tcz: Thunei vaihom khat toh ankong sohkhom dinga naum tengleh, na ang-sunga kiloi chengse chu melchih in.
en_web: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
en_kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, Consider diligently what is before thee:

tcz: Milop nahileh nalol chutoh chemcha kanbeh jeng in.
en_web: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
en_kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, If thou be a man given to appetite.

tcz: Vaihompa neh ding anho chu ducha hih in, ajeh chu nangma lhep lhahna ding an jeng ahi.
en_web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
en_kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: For they are deceitful meat.

tcz: Haodoh ding ngaito na boujeh in na-tong hih in, chule jou le phatlou a kon in haodoh ding jong ngaito hih in.
en_web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
en_kjv: Labour not to be rich: Cease from thine own wisdom.

tcz: Hitia haodohna dia namu chan chu miphetkah louva mang ding ahi. Ajeh chu chomlou kah'in muvanlai bang in vanlam angan aleng mang jitai.
en_web: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
en_kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? For riches certainly make themselves wings; They fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

tcz: Muda sasa'a navepa toh an nekhom hih in, aneh chu tuitah hijongleh ducha hih in.
en_web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
en_kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainty meats:

tcz: Amapa chu alung thim in aphun in, nangma jah din, “Haneh in lang, hadon in don in” tia asei vang chun alung thim in nathet bouve.
en_web: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
en_kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; But his heart is not with thee.

tcz: Nangman themcha naneh jong chu naloh lhah ding, chule lunglhai nathu nasei jouse jong pannabei soh ding ahi.
en_web: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
en_kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.

tcz: Mingol ho jah ding in houlim boldan, ajeh chu chihna thu nasei jouse imalouvin gel khaget inte.
en_web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
en_kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: For he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

tcz: Gol lui laija pat umsa gamgi song chu nabodoh lou hel ding, chule nu le pa neilou chagate lou-laia jong chelut hih in.
en_web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
en_kjv: Remove not the old landmark; And enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho lhatdohpa chu mihat tah ahin, alhatdohpa tah uvin amaho athumop a apanhu ding ahi.
en_web: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
en_kjv: For their Redeemer is mighty; He shall plead their cause with thee.

tcz: Nalung thim in nakihilna ngaisang in lang, hetthemna thu kisei chengse jong ngai phan.
en_web: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
en_kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, And thine ears to the words of knowledge.

tcz: Na chate chu gahna beijin koihih in, nangman mol-lam jong le chun thilou diu;
en_web: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
en_kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: For if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

tcz: Chule nangman achunga mol nalap-a ahileh, thina lampia kon nahuhdoh ding joh ahibouve.
en_web: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
en_kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, And shalt deliver his soul from hell.

tcz: Kachapa, nangman chihna lungthim nanei poule, keima jong kipah ding kahi.
en_web: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
en_kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, My heart shall rejoice, even mine.

tcz: Thudih chu nakam sunga kon nasei teng, keima lhagao jong kipah lheh ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
en_kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.

tcz: Nalung thim in mi chonsete thang thip-pi dan, amavang nitin a Yahweh Pakai nagin ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
en_kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: But be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.

tcz: Adih tah in nikho hung lhung dinga kinepna khat aum jing e, nangma kinepna jong mangthah lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
en_kjv: For surely there is an end; And thine expectation shall not be cut off.

tcz: Kachapa ngai tem in, chule chingthei tah in um in, nalung thim in lamdih jenga lam lhah ding ngaiton.
en_web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
en_kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thine heart in the way.

tcz: Ju-kham holah a lha-hih beh in, sane holah jenga jong jao ding geldan.
en_web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;
en_kjv: Be not amongst winebibbers; Amongst riotous eaters of flesh:

tcz: Ajeh chu ju le sa'a lop chan chu vaichat nan alhun khum diu, chule emut so nan atom u va ponse tobang diu ahi.
en_web: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
en_kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: And drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

tcz: Nahinga napa thumop ngai jing in, nanu jong ateh teng thetbol hih hel in.
en_web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
en_kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.

tcz: Thutah chu kisan lut in lang pedoh hih in, chihna le kigah chahna chule hetthemna jong nakisan lut ding ahi.
en_web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
en_kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; Also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

tcz: Chate adih teng apa athanom in akipah jin, chapa chingtah hingpa jong achapa chunga kipah lheh ding ahi.
en_web: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
en_kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: And he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

tcz: Hijeh chun nanu le napa kipah thanom in umsah jing in, chule nahing nu nanu jong kipah tah'in umsah jing in.
en_web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
en_kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, And she that bare thee shall rejoice.

tcz: O Kachapa, nalung thim neipen lang, kanun le khan abonchan namit tenin vepha tan.
en_web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
en_kjv: My son, give me thine heart, And let thine eyes observe my ways.

tcz: Numei kijoh hohi tijat um kokhuh tobang ahin, numei hija jonva le jong twikul tobang ahi.
en_web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
en_kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; And a strange woman is a narrow pit.

tcz: Amanu chun gucha michom tobang in mi achang lhih le jin, chule pasal tamtah akipal sah in asuchavei jitai.
en_web: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
en_kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, And increaseth the transgressors among men.

tcz: Koiham avangse a pang? Koiham genthei thoh a pang? Koiham mitoh kiphun? Chule Koiham aki-engsah?
en_web: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
en_kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? Who hath contentions? who hath babbling? Who hath wounds without cause? Who hath redness of eyes?

tcz: Hitobang miho chu ju-phung dalha louva tou chule jua lop ho ahiuve.
en_web: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
en_kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; They that go to seek mixt wine.

tcz: Ju chu asan keikui teng vehih beh in, chule khon na vetnom umtah hihen lang; bailam tah a gah don thei di hi jong le, vetding jong go-hih hel in.
en_web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
en_kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, When it giveth his colour in the cup, When it moveth itself aright.

tcz: Ajeh chu achaina teng gul gunei in mi achuh banga nachuh lo ding ahi.
en_web: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
en_kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, And stingeth like an adder.

tcz: Namit tenin thil kidang tahtah amu ding, nalunggel jeng jong kikalah lah ding ahi.
en_web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
en_kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, And thine heart shall utter perverse things.

tcz: Chule twikhanglen lailunga lum den banga nalup den ding, konga kitungdoh khom chunga umpa banga naum'a nalup den ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
en_kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, Or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

tcz: Chutengleh “amaho hin eivo tauve,” tia nasei ding, hinlah “eivoh nau maha ima kamupoi,” amahon eivo nauvin, ahinlah kathoh lal poi. Kakhahdoh teng aban kahol nah lai ding ahi, tia nasei ding ahi.
en_web: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
en_kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; They have beaten me, and I felt it not: When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

tcz: Miphalou ho umchan thangse hih in, chule hitobang miho chu kiloipi din jong ngaicha hih-in.
en_web: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
en_kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, Neither desire to be with them.

tcz: Ajeh chu alung thim un thilse jeng agong un, akamdung uva jou le nal jeng aseijun ahi.
en_web: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.
en_kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, And their lips talk of mischief.

tcz: Chihna jeh chun in akisadoh jin, chule hetkhen themna jal-a kitungdet ji ahi.
en_web: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
en_kjv: Through wisdom is a house builded; And by understanding it is established:

tcz: Hetkhen themna akon insung dann jousea, thil manlutah tah le; lung lhaina thilpha chom haona dimset-ji ahi.
en_web: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
en_kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled With all precious and pleasant riches.

tcz: Miching chu mi thahat sang in ahat jon, hetna nei mi jong atha hatpa sang in ahat cheh jin ahi.
en_web: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,
en_kjv: A wise man is strong; Yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh lungthim thepna jal-a gal kisatji ahin, chule gal jona jong thumop them hoa kingam ahi.
en_web: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
en_kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: And in multitude of counsellers there is safety.

tcz: Chihna hi mingol ho din meiphah ahipon, thutanna kotpi mai lah'in jong seiding aneiji tapouve.
en_web: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
en_kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: He openeth not his mouth in the gate.

tcz: Koi hileh thilse bol ding ngaito chan chu, jou le nal-a natongpa tia kikou ding ahi.
en_web: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
en_kjv: He that deviseth to do evil Shall be called a mischievous person.

tcz: Mingol ho thilse gonhi chonset ahin, mi ahilou lam'a tot chaveipa jong mi jousen athet ahibouve.
en_web: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
en_kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: And the scorner is an abomination to men.

tcz: Kidoupin nahin phah nikho teng jongleh lung lhadai hih in, ajeh chu lhahsamna'a nanei cheh ding ahibouve.
en_web: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
en_kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, Thy strength is small.

tcz: Thina lam jon-a kijot hokhu huhhing loijin, chule min athagamna dinga kipal-lhu ho jong huhdoh loijin.
en_web: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
en_kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, And those that are ready to be slain;

tcz: Nangman, “vetem in, keihon hiche hi kahe phapouve,” tin nasei in, Ama bouvin mihem lungthim akholchil-a ahet chin ji hilou ham? Nalhagao vea ching jing pan hitobang hi amelchih jing hilou ham? Aman mihem koi hileh atoh dungjui cheh-a lethuhna anei ding hilou ham?
en_web: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
en_kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; Doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? And he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? And shall not he render to every man according to his works?

tcz: Kachapa, khoiju hi don in atui lheh jeng e, khoi-phanga apat hung pot khoiju hi nele chun alhum'a lhum ahi.
en_web: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
en_kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; And the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

tcz: Chihna kiti hi nalhagao dinga hiche tobang chu ahi. Chule chihna hi namu jouva ahileh khonung dinga phachom tah ahi.
en_web: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
en_kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: When thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, And thy expectation shall not be cut off.

tcz: Miphalou bang in mikitah pa chu a-in pang dunga ga chang lhih hih in, mikitah pa in jong chomding gohih hel in.
en_web: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
en_kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; Spoil not his resting place:

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh mikitah kiti hi vel sagi jen lhu jongleh, athoudoh thei jin, hinlah miphalou ho chunga hamsetna ahung lhun teng akhup athal in aleh jitai.
en_web: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
en_kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: But the wicked shall fall into mischief.

tcz: Namelma akipal lhuh teng kipanan neihih hel in, aman kipal lhuhna ato khah jongleh kipa thanopna'a nanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
en_kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, And let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in hin mudoh leh, lunghanna'a anei loding ahi. Hijeh chun ama kon chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna peldoh in.
en_web: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
en_kjv: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, And he turn away his wrath from him.

tcz: Thilse bol ho jeh in nang le nang kisih hih in, chule achon chan-u jong thangsetpi dan.
en_web: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;
en_kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, Neither be thou envious at the wicked;

tcz: Ajeh chu miphalou ding in khonung thua kinepna abeiyin, chule migilou ho thaomei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
en_web: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
en_kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; The candle of the wicked shall be put out.

tcz: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa ging in lang, Anitah lhon-a athua nanun ding ahi.
en_web: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
en_kjv: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: And meddle not with them that are given to change:

tcz: Ajeh chu Amania kon hetman louva hamsetna hung lhung ding, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa'a kon hung lhung ding manthahna chu koiman ahe thei poi.
en_web: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?
en_kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; And who knoweth the ruin of them both?

tcz: Hicheho jouse jong hi miching ho thusei ahisoh keijin: Thutan-a langneina nei kiti jong hi thildih ahipoi.
en_web: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
en_kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

tcz: Migiloupa kom'a, “Nangman themmona nanei poi,” tia sei chu, mitin vaipi gaosap chang ding, namtin in athet ding ahi.
en_web: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
en_kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; Him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

tcz: Miphalou phohsal pa chu kipah thanom'a um ding, chule hitobang mi chunga chu phattheina lhung ding ahi.
en_web: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
en_kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, And a good blessing shall come upon them.

tcz: Thu kitohdel-a donbutna chu kigolngai kibeng chop avetsah ahi.
en_web: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
en_kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips That giveth a right answer.

tcz: Polam'a natoh ding abonchan kigontoh in lang, chule lou laija natohna ding aboncha naki gonsoh keija; chujou tengleh na chenna ding in sapan tan.
en_web: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
en_kjv: Prepare thy work without, And make it fit for thyself in the field; And afterwards build thine house.

tcz: Ajeh beijin naheng nakom dounan hettohsah in pang hih in, nakam sunga jouthu jong seitahih in.
en_web: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
en_kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; And deceive not with thy lips.

tcz: Mi kom'a “Kachunga anatoh bang banga keiman jong achunga katoh ding ahi; chule anatoh bang banga kalethuh tei ding ahi,” tin jong seidan.
en_web: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
en_kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

tcz: Keiman mithase khat loulai kahin jot pan, lungthimbei mikhat lengpilei kaho pan ahi.
en_web: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.
en_kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, And by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

tcz: Hiche loulai chu apum chang in lingle khao akhul lha jeng in, atollham jenga jong ling adimset in, apal jong achimsoh tan ahi.
en_web: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
en_kjv: And lo, it was all grown over with thorns, And nettles had covered the face thereof, And the stone wall thereof was broken down.

tcz: Hichun keiman kaven kagel in, hichea kon hin kihilna khat kaki mudoh in ahi.
en_web: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
en_kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

tcz: Jalkhun a imut jengseh, kichol ding bouseh, chule khut teni umthim sah-a kichol ding kati tai.
en_web: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
en_kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:

tcz: Gucha le michom in mi abulhu banga vaichat nan nahin lhun den ding, nahin delkhumpa bang banga kel thoa um ding nahitai.
en_web: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
en_kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; And thy want as an armed man.

tcz: Hiche ho jong hi Solomon thuchih jeng ahina nalai jin, Judah lengpa Hezekiah phat laija mihon ana jihdoh ahi.
en_web: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
en_kjv: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

tcz: Thugil chintup nahi Elohim Pathen loupina ahin, chule thil kholdoh kiti jong hi lengte loupina ahi.
en_web: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
en_kjv: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: But the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

tcz: Vanmun jouse asandan le leiset athuh bang hin, lengte lungthim sung jeng jong koiman ahedoh joupoi.
en_web: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
en_kjv: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, And the heart of kings is unsearchable.

tcz: Dangka'a kon in atheng lou jouse ladoh jeng in, thih khengpan bel-a khen ding atah chu aneinai.
en_web: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
en_kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, And there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

tcz: Lengpa thutanna mun'a kon chun migilou chu potdoh sah jeng in, chutileh lengpa laltouna mun'a chu thudih kiphut det thei ding ahi.
en_web: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
en_kjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, And his throne shall be established in righteousness.

tcz: Lengpa angsunga nama cham in chelut dan, chule milen ang-sunga jong kikum lut jeng hih in.
