en_web: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
en_kjv: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, And stand not in the place of great men:

tcz: Hitia hi, “Hiche mun'a hin hung kal touvin,” tia min nahin kou masat ding chu thilpha ahi. Chule milen milal umna imacham tah'a lut jeng chu thilpha ahipoi.
en_web: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
en_kjv: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; Than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince Whom thine eyes have seen.

tcz: Nangman thilkhat namu jeng man in, kihehna-in achun lhut jeng hih in, ajeh chu nahehpa chun najou henlang jumtale chun achaina ipi nabol ding hitam?
en_web: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
en_kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, Lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, When thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

tcz: Hiche sang chun, naheng nakompa toh chun nachung chang thu seikhom lhon in lang, thuguh kiti phot midang hetsah hih in.
en_web: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
en_kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; And discover not a secret to another:

tcz: Ajeh chu naseidoh'a midang khattou in jataleh aja khat chun, nahinle jumso nabep ding, chuteng namin setna chu beita lou ding ahi.
en_web: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
en_kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, And thine infamy turn not away.

tcz: Aphatcha ki hil na chu deium tah ahi, dangka bomma kikoi sana tabang ahi.
en_web: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
en_kjv: A word fitly spoken Is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

tcz: Mithusei phatah'a ngaipa ding in, adih a kiphona hi sanakol le sana pah-jem tobang ahi.
en_web: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
en_kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, So is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

tcz: Tahsan thei tah sottole sol khapa ding in, hiche sottole chu chang-at laija buhbang votjen tobang ahin; hitobang sottole hi apupa lhagao lungthim sung kido jing na ahi.
en_web: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
en_kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, So is a faithful messenger to them that send him: For he refresheth the soul of his masters.

tcz: Thilpeh khat pe-dinga kitepna neija peloupa chu, huijin apohle meilom goa julha lou tobang ahi.
en_web: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
en_kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift Is like clouds and wind without rain.

tcz: Thoh hattah'a natoh jeh'in vaihom khat jong akithu nun jou in, o nem heova thu kiseijin gu le chang jeng jong anemsah e.
en_web: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
en_kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, And a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

tcz: Khoiju naneh teng aphabep don in, ajeh chu nachim behseh ding; achaina leh naloh lhah lo ding ahi.
en_web: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
en_kjv: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, Lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

tcz: Naheng nakom in-sunga che behseh hih in, ajeh chu nahin thei chim lo ding ahi.
en_web: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
en_kjv: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; Lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

tcz: Koi hileh aheng akom hehsea panga chu, galsat dinga mi koukhom le chemjam hemtah chule thalchanga kikap tobang ahi.
en_web: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
en_kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour Is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

tcz: Gim le hesoh pet'a tahsan thei lou mikhat ngansena nei hi, habeija thilkhat kipet le keng phalou tollham chon-nal tobang bep ahibouve.
en_web: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
en_kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble Is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

tcz: Mi gim hesoh pet'a lasa'a chu, phalbi dap laija mi ponsil lahpeh tobang ahi.
en_web: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
en_kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, And as vinegar upon nitre, So is he that singeth songs to a heavy heart.

tcz: Nagalmi chu agil akel teng nehding changlhah pen, chule adang achah leh don ding twi pen.
en_web: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
en_kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

tcz: Hitia nabol pehchu alujang dim a mei-al sunpeh nahin, natoh-ga Yahweh Pakai in kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.
en_web: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
en_kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, And the Lord shall reward thee.

tcz: Sahlam khohui'in go ajuhsah jin, min adalhah nunga seisea chun lungphamo pua mi avetji ahi.
en_web: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
en_kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: So doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

tcz: Numei phunsi khat toh in khat'a chen khom sang in, inting vum ningkoi khat'a ichangseh a chen aphajoi.
en_web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
en_kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, Than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

tcz: Gam latah'a pet thupha kija chu, dangchah pet'a twi votjen kidon tobang ahi.
en_web: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
en_kjv: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, So is good news from a far country.

tcz: Mikitah khat in migilou khat pansatna ding lampi asempeh kiti chu, twisam putna le bonsan londohna twikun tobang ahi.
en_web: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
en_kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked Is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

tcz: Khoiju tamtah don jong aphapon, chule thuphalou tampi sei jong apha ahipoi.
en_web: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
en_kjv: It is not good to eat much honey: So for men to search their own glory is not glory.

tcz: Ama le ama kitim joulou michu, khopi chimsa apal jouse kivo lhua kidalha bep ahi.
en_web: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
en_kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit Is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

tcz: Nipi laija buhbang kheh ding le chang-at laija gojuh ding akilom pon, hijeh chun mingol jana peh hi thil hahsa ahi.
en_web: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
en_kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honour is not seemly for a fool.

tcz: Inva kichao hat le pelpalep lengle banga, ajeh beija kigaosapna chu gui lhung lou helding ahi.
en_web: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
en_kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, So the curse causeless shall not come.

tcz: Sakol dinga ajepna akisem peh'a, sangan akamdal akisempeh bang in, mingol jong chu ajepna dinga mol kisem ahi.
en_web: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
en_kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the fools’ back.

tcz: Mingol chu angolna totoh in lethuh jeng dan, chutibol lechun koiman nahetkhen thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
en_kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, Lest thou also be like unto him.

tcz: Mingol chu angolna dungjui in donbut'in, achuti louva ahileh ama mitmua ching kisa ding ahi.
en_web: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
en_kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own conceit.

tcz: Mingol khat chu thupolea naman chahle, nakeng kitanboh tobang chule thina gudon tobang nahi ding ahi.
en_web: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
en_kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

tcz: Mingol kom'a thuchih kisei chu alangngoi panna bei tobang ahi.
en_web: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
en_kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

tcz: Mingol jana kipe chu songsena bom'a, song chang ohden tobang bep ahi.
en_web: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
en_kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, So is he that giveth honour to a fool.

tcz: Mingol kam'a thuchih kiphongdoh jihi, jukham khut ling in asut vangpai tobang ahi.
en_web: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
en_kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

tcz: Migoi pan mingol ham ahilouleh jukham hamkhat goikha achu, mi lah-a thal mohkap kappa tobang ahi.
en_web: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
en_kjv: The great God that formed all things Both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

tcz: Mingol in angol thu avelsei sei hi, aloh dohsa avel'a jonkit uicha tobang ahi.
en_web: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
en_kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, So a fool returneth to his folly.

tcz: Mihem ama le ama achinga kigel ho sang in, mingol din kinepna aum joi.
en_web: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
en_kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

tcz: Mithase pan asam'in “Lamlen'a keipi bahkai aum e, khulai dunga jong keipi bahkai aum'e kahei!” ati.
en_web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
en_kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; A lion is in the streets.

tcz: Kotpi akol hom sunga akipei leji bang in, mithase jong ajalkhun chunga akihei le ji bouchu ahi jenge.
en_web: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
en_kjv: As the door turneth upon his hinges, So doth the slothful upon his bed.

tcz: Mithase chun akhut in bukong asoh jinan, hinlah akam geija akhut ledop ding athan ajou jitapoi.
en_web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
en_kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; It grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

tcz: Miching thumop them sagi sang in, mingol chu ama changseh mitvet in akichihsah jin ahi.
en_web: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
en_kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit Than seven men that can render a reason.

tcz: Akin louhel'a mi kinahna'a gaki kumpa chu, uicha lhaile abilkol'a matding go tobang ahi.
en_web: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
en_kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, Is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

tcz: Mingol chon banga chon-jia aheng akom meise kaikhum a, chule thina thei thalpia kap jenga chu,
en_web: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
en_kjv: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

tcz: Aheng akom jou'a lhemlha ahin, “Katot ahipoi,” tin aseije.
en_web: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
en_kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, And saith, Am not I in sport?

tcz: Meija man ding thing abei teng mei akon-theilou bang in, kiseiset tona abei teng kinahna jong athipdel jin ahi.
en_web: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
en_kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: So where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

tcz: Vutsa lah'a hol akonbei bangle, thinggo meija akonbai bang in; mitoh kina jingpa chun, kinahna beilamtah in asodohsah jing in ahi.
en_web: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
en_kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; So is a contentious man to kindle strife.

tcz: Thu kihou lhihna thei hol jing achu, an tuitah bang in aki ngaiton, mihem laigil sunga alut lhum mangjel jin ahi.
en_web: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
en_kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, And they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

tcz: Gitlou lungpua muh tuisel'a thu kisei chu, phatvet maija leibel kitomjol sel tobang bep ahi.
en_web: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
en_kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart Are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

tcz: Mi thet jinga akamsunga phatmona selpa, alungthim a lhep lhahna jeng toh kivop,
en_web: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
en_kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, And layeth up deceit within him;

tcz: Khotona neitah banga thu asei teng jongleh, hitobang mihem chu tahsan hih hel in; ajeh chu ama tobang mihem lung sunga hin deium loutah thil sagi achengin ahi.
en_web: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
en_kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: For there are seven abominations in his heart.

tcz: Mi ajoubolna chu jonchih tah in kisel doh jong le, mipi maija aphatlouna kiphong jah tei ding ahi.
en_web: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
en_kjv: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, His wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

tcz: Koi hileh mi lhah lutna dinga khuh laija chu, amajoh lhalut ding chule michunga chu dia songtum tanga chu, asongtum tah chu ama chunga hung kiletah lut ding ahibouve.
en_web: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
en_kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: And he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

tcz: Thujou seina leigui hin mi asuh genthei ho chu ahot bol cheh jin, chule thujou jeng seija leigui hin manthahna jeng atongdoh in ahi.
en_web: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
en_kjv: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; And a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

tcz: Jing nikhoa dingin kiletsah tothon thu seihih in, ajeh chu itobang nikho ahung lhun ding nahepoi.
en_web: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
en_kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; For thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

tcz: Nakamsunga nakipachat sangin, midang kipachat sah jon, chule nangle nang nakam sunga naki vahchoi sangin, hetkhahlou kholgam mi kivahchoi sah in.
en_web: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
en_kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; A stranger, and not thine own lips.

tcz: Songhi agih lheh in, neldi jong gihtah ahi. Hinlah mingol lunghanna hi neldi sanga jong gihjo nalai ahi.
en_web: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
en_kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; But a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

tcz: Lunghan hi giloutah ahin, lungsat in jong mi achup jin; hinlah thangthipna hi akhoh jon ahi.
en_web: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
en_kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; But who is able to stand before envy?

tcz: Aguh a kingailut sangin, lhang phonga kiphosal aphajoi.
en_web: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
en_kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

tcz: Gol phatah'a kon kimavona chu kitah jal ahin, melman eibeng chop vang kilhep lhahna ahibouve.
en_web: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
en_kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

tcz: Mihem aoi-vasa dingin khoiju jeng jong lohso nabep ahin, agilkilpa din vang an tuimopen jong alhum tobang ahi.
en_web: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
en_kjv: The full soul loatheth a honeycomb; But to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

tcz: Ain'a kon vahmangpa chu, abusunga kon lengmang vahcha tobang ahi.
en_web: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
en_kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, So is a man that wandereth from his place.

tcz: Thao le gimnamtui in mihem lungthim akipahsah jin, gim hesohna vang hin mihem lhagao athohlal sah jin ahi.
en_web: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
en_kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: So doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

tcz: Nagol hihen napagol hijongle nung sun hih in, hahsatnan nahin phah nikhon jong nasopipa in-a sunglha hih in; ajeh chu gam latah a um penpi sopi sang in, naicha um hengle kom aphachom joi.
en_web: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
en_kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; Neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: For better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

tcz: Kachapa, chingthei jin kalungthim kipa sah jing in, chutileh eidoupa jeng jong kadonbut thei ding ahi.
en_web: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
en_kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, That I may answer him that reproacheth me.

tcz: Milung ching in thilphalou hung lhung ding ahethem masan, ama le ama ahoidoh theije, hinlah milham vang chu kho hephalou tah in aum in, gim hesoh atoh jin ahi.
en_web: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
en_kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the simple pass on, and are punished.

tcz: Hetkhah lou mikhat batsah nadinga kitung pa chu, aponsil kichom peh jenga! Hetphalou mi dinga, hitobang mihem chu akipehdoh jeng thei nadem!
en_web: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
en_kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, And take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

tcz: Jingkah matah-a thouva othong jejua, phatthei osam chun aheng akom agaosap joh ahibouve.
en_web: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
en_kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It shall be counted a curse to him.

tcz: Tanglouva nilhum keija gojuh hi, numei phunse tohbang bep ahi.
en_web: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
en_kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike.

tcz: Hitobang numei phohtang theija chun, khohui geija aphotang jou ding ahin; akhutphang jet lam'a jong, thaotui akihamdoh thei ding ahi.
en_web: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
en_kjv: Whosoever hideth her, hideth the wind, And the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

tcz: Thihchun thih mama anol hemthei bangin, mihem jong khat in khat akikhelsah thei ahi.
en_web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
en_kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

tcz: Koi hileh theiphung phut chan in aga aneh bangin, koi hileh apupa ngaichat jouse hethem chu, mi jabolna achang teijin ahi.
en_web: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
en_kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: So he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

tcz: Twichung ivet teng mihem eima mai akilahdoh ji bangin, mihem kiti jong hi alungthim in aphondohji ahi.
en_web: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
en_kjv: As in water face answereth to face, So the heart of man to man.

tcz: Thina le thilse in bei tih aneilou bang chun mihem mit teni jeng jong thil vet achim joupoi.
en_web: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
en_kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; So the eyes of man are never satisfied.

tcz: Khangbel hi dangka lhahtheng na ding ahin, thuh khuh jong hi sana sonjolna'a kimang ahi; hijeh achu mihem jeng jong pachatna dinmun'a aum laitah a bou patepna changji ahi.
en_web: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
en_kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; So is a man to his praise.

tcz: Mingol chu lhengkong sunga suhdun changbong toh goitha jongleh chun, angolna laitah chu amatahsa'a kon potdoh dehlou ding ahi.
en_web: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
en_kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, Yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

tcz: Nakelngoi honte umchan hethem jingin, chule nabong honte jeng jong phaten vephan;
en_web: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,
en_kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, And look well to thy herds.

tcz: Ajeh chu haona hi tonsotna ding ahipon, lallukhuh jong hi akhang khang ding um hinam?
en_web: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
en_kjv: For riches are not for ever: And doth the crown endure to every generation?

tcz: Hampa apul chaisoh tengleh ana ahung noudoh kit jin, chule molchunga hampa louhing jouse jong kichom khomji ahi.
en_web: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
en_kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, And herbs of the mountains are gathered.

tcz: Nakelngoi teovin ponsil ding natopeh diu, chule nakelchateu vin jong loumun khat man natopeh diu ahi.
en_web: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
en_kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, And the goats are the price of the field.

tcz: Nadon khopset kelcha noitwi tatlouva um jing ding, chule na in-sung vahna dingle nalhacha nungah ho vahna dia jong lhingset ding ahi.
en_web: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
en_kjv: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, For the food of thy household, And for the maintenance for thy maidens.

tcz: Migilou chu koima dellou in ajam jin, mikitah vang chu keipi bahkai bang in hangtah in apang jin ahi.
en_web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
en_kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: But the righteous are bold as a lion.

tcz: Namkhat in suhkhel anei tengleh achunga thunei ding atam jin, hinlah namsung dinsotna ding hin, miching hetkhen themna nei angaije.
en_web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
en_kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: But by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

tcz: Miphalou vaichate gim le hesoh thohsahpa chu, gobah julha tobang ahin, khenchom aneiji poi.
en_web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
en_kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor Is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

tcz: Kivaipohna Dan thu nit te chun migilou ho adou jing ahi.
en_web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
en_kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: But such as keep the law contend with them.

tcz: Mi-engsen thu adih a kitan kitihi ahethem thei pon, amavang Yahweh Pakai holten phatah in ahethem un ahi.
en_web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
en_kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: But they that seek the Lord understand all things.

tcz: Mihao lungdihlou hisang in, mivaicha lungtheng hi aphajoi.
en_web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
en_kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, Than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

tcz: Chapa chingtah kiti chu Dan thu kitup tah'a juipa ahin, milungsel to kivop pan anu le apa jumna apohlut peh jin ahi.
en_web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
en_kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: But he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

tcz: Thil veikan dinga lha'a punbe sah pa chun, vaichate khotopa sakhao sung adip peh ahibouve.
en_web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
en_kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, He shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

tcz: Koi hileh Dan thu jahda jeh'a akol heimang achu, atao na jeng jong Elohim Pathen dinga thet um ahi.
en_web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
en_kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer shall be abomination.

tcz: Milungdih lamsea pui achu, amatah jong ama kokhuh sunga lhalut ding, hinlah milungdih vang chun gou phatah alo ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
en_kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit: But the upright shall have good things in possession.

tcz: Mihao kiti chu ama mitmun aching dan in akigel jin, hinlah hetthemna nei mivaichan achih louna amatdoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
en_kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; But the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

tcz: Mikitah ten goljona anei teng kipa loupina ahin, miphaloute ahung seilet tengleh mipi akidalse jin ahi.
en_web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
en_kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: But when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

tcz: Asuhkhel selmang chan chu khangtou louhel ding, chule hitobang hi chonset ahipoi ti seipa jong, mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
en_web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
en_kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: But whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

tcz: Phattin a Yahweh Pakai gingpa chu anunnom ahin, amavang milungtah pa vang chu manthahna chu tei ding ahi.
en_web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
en_kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

tcz: Migilou vaicha chunga vaihompa chu, keipi bahkai kitumlet lut le vompi midel hamthe thu tobang ahi.
en_web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
en_kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; So is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

tcz: Thil hetthemna neilou vaihompa chu, migenthei te engse tah a sugimpa ahin; amavang thildihlou thetpa vang chu ahinkho sotding ahi.
en_web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
en_kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: But he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

tcz: Tol thatpa chonset chung gihna chu, athi kahsea kichou mahthah ding, chule koiman adonlou ding ahi.
en_web: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
en_kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person Shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

tcz: Lung dettah'a lampi jotpa chu huhdoh a um tei ding, hinlah achena jousea akaleh akalouva chonpa vang chu hetman louva kisumang ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
en_kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: But he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

tcz: Koi hileh ama gam leiset lhoupa chun, neh le chah kimsel a anei ding; hinlah phatchomna beija donva lepa vang chu vaicha tei ding ahi.
en_web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
en_kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: But he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

tcz: Tahsan umtah pa chu phattheina chang jing ding, hinlah gangtah'a haodoh ding ngaito pan gimna ato lo ding ahi.
en_web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
en_kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: But he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

tcz: Langneina kiti hi apha ahipoi, hinlah mihem in thil neochan jong adihlou abol jeng theije.
en_web: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
en_kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: For for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

tcz: Mi kikhit them chu gangtah'a haoding mano ahin, hinlah hetman louva vaichatnan ahin lhun den ding ahepha jipoi.
en_web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
en_kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, And considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

tcz: Lei kileh pil'a thu alhem-a sei sang in, lung thengsel'a miphoh pan lung lhaina ahin mujoh ding ahi.
en_web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
en_kjv: He that rebuketh a man, afterwards shall find more favour Than he that flattereth with the tongue.

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa thilgua “Hiche hi chon dihlou akitipoi,” tia seija chu mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
en_web: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
en_kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, And saith, It is no transgression; The same is the companion of a destroyer.

tcz: Neipap kiloset hin kinahna asodoh sahjin, hinlah Yahweh Pakaija kingaipa vang chu haodoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
en_kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: But he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.

tcz: Ama lungthim jenga kisongpa chu angol ahin, hinlah chihna thua lamlha jingpa vang hoidoh ding ahi.
en_web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
en_kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: But whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

tcz: Koi hileh vaicha khotona'a dimpa chu lhasam louhel ding, amavang mivaichate khoto lou chu sapset chang ding ahi.
en_web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
en_kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: But he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

tcz: Migilouten vai ahomteng, mihem amacham cham in akidalse jin, hinlah hitobang miho chu abei teng; adih akhang in apung jitai.
en_web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
en_kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: But when they perish, the righteous increase.

tcz: Akiphona sangnom loupa chu, hetman louva huhdoh lel'a kisumang ding ahi.
en_web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
en_kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, Shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

tcz: Mikitah ho vaihom le thaneija apan teng, mipi akipah in athanom jin; hinlah miphalou in vai ahom tengle, mipi chunga gim hesoh alhung jitai.
en_web: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
en_kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: But when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

tcz: Chihna ngaisang pa din apa akipah jin, hinlah noti hotoh kivop jingpan vang anei le agou amangchai bep e.
en_web: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
en_kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: But he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

tcz: Thu dihtah'a atan jeh chun lengpan, gamsunga chen detna aphutdoh jin; hinlah nehguh kilah pan vang, gamsung amanthahsah jin ahi.
en_web: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
en_kjv: The king by judgment stablisheth the land: But he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

tcz: Aheng akom lhem a pang pan, akeng tenia akipal lhuhna ding thang akido ahibouve.
en_web: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
en_kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour Spreadeth a net for his feet.

tcz: Migilou chu ama le ama athangkam achun a-oh jin, mikitah vang chun la-asan akipah thanom jitai.
en_web: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
en_kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

tcz: Mikitah in vaichate dihna chu asuhmil peh ngaipon, migilou ding in vang hitobang thil hi het ahahsai.
en_web: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
en_kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: But the wicked regardeth not to know it.

tcz: Mi tot chavei hon khopi jeng jong meijin ahal lha jiuvin, miching hon vang lunghanna jeng jong apeldoh theijun ahi.
en_web: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
en_kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: But wise men turn away wrath.

tcz: Michingin mingol akinahpia ahileh, mingol chu alung hangin anuisat bep jin, hinlah lungkim na aum poi.
en_web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
en_kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, Whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

tcz: Mi thisan sohat hon nolnabei ho athet uvin, chule migilou in nolnabei mi chu thisan sodin ahol lejin ahi.
en_web: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
en_kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: But the just seek his soul.

tcz: Mingol alunghan pet leh im neilou in aum jin, miching vang chu ima seilouvin aim mang jitai.
en_web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
en_kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: But a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

tcz: Vaihom pan thujou sei akhohsah'a ahileh, ama thumop ho jouse chu migilou ngen soh diu ahi.
en_web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
en_kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, All his servants are wicked.

tcz: Vaichapa le asugentheipa jong kimuto ding, ijehinem itileh amit teni lhon hasah jong Yahweh Pakai ahi.
en_web: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
en_kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: The Lord lighteneth both their eyes.

tcz: Lengpan vaichate chu akitoh toa thu atanpeh a ahileh, alaltouna imatih chan a kiphut det ding ahi.
en_web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
en_kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.

tcz: Mol thoa kiphona hin chihna atah lang in, ama chamtah'a lhaji chapang chun anu ajumso teije.
en_web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
en_kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: But a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

tcz: Migilouhon vai ahom'uva thaneija apan tenguleh, bolkhelna atam cheh jin; hinlah mikitah hon migilou ho lhuhpet amu diu ahi.
en_web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
en_kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: But the righteous shall see their fall.

tcz: Nachapa nahil chah le tha ol-na nanei thei ding, chuteng ama jal'a nakipa ding ahi.
en_web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
en_kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; Yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

tcz: Gaothu kisei louna mun achun mipi alamvai jin, hinlah Dan thu nit chan chu anun nom ahiye.
en_web: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
en_kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

tcz: Thu cheng jengseh in soh chu athunun joupon, aman ahet vang in khohsahna anei thei jipoi.
en_web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
en_kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: For though he understand he will not answer.

tcz: Geltoh louva thusei namu khah em? Hitobang mihem sang chun mingol chunga kinepna aum joi.
en_web: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
en_kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

tcz: Sohkhat aneova pat hoithona'a hin khou khah achun, achaina teng ama nei le gou loa apan akimudoh jin ahi.
en_web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
en_kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become his son at the length.

tcz: Mi alungsa jenga chun kinahna asodoh jin, chule lunghanna'a dim jing michun bolkhel tampi anei lojie.
en_web: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
en_kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

tcz: Mihem kiti hi kiletsah nan ahinsuh nemji ahin, koi hileh alungthim a kineosah chan chu mi jabolna chang ding ahi.
en_web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
en_kjv: A man’s pride shall bring him low: But honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

tcz: Gucha kithopia pang chun ama hinkho tahbah jong adei pon, gaosapna thu ajah jeng vang in imacha aphongdoh jipoi.
en_web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
en_kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: He heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

tcz: Mihem a kingaina kiti hi kipalna ahin, Yahweh Pakaija kisongpa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
en_kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: But whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.

tcz: Mi tamtah in vaihompa lung lhaisah ding angaito uvin, hinlah thudih tanna hi Yahweh Pakaija hung konbou ahi.
en_web: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
en_kjv: Many seek the ruler’s favour; But every man’s judgment cometh from the Lord.

tcz: Mikitah ho din thu adih louva tanpa hi thet umtah ahin, chule migilou ding in jong adih jenga lamjotpa chu thet umtah ahi.
en_web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
en_kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: And he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

tcz: Jakeh chapa Agur thuseidoh ho hichea hi kiphong doh ahi. O Yahweh Pakai keima kachol in kalhasam lheh tai.
en_web: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
en_kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal.

tcz: Keima mihem khat hina angol-a kahi, chule mihem thil hetkhen themna bang in hetkhenna kainei tapoi.
en_web: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
en_kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, And have not the understanding of a man.

tcz: Keiman chihna thucheng kaja kha hih laijin, mithengpa kiti jong kaphongdoh kha naipoi.
en_web: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
en_kjv: I neither learned wisdom, Nor have the knowledge of the holy.

tcz: Elohim Pathen tailou koiham vanna kal touva hung kumsuh kit? Koiham akhut tum'a huituh theija? Koiham aponsil a twi chun thei? Koiham vannoi pumpi sem? Ama chu amin ipi ham chule achapa min ipiham? Nang in vang nahet chetset ahi.
en_web: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
en_kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in a garment? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

tcz: Elohim Pathen thucheng jouse hi adihsoh keijin, Ama henga kiselte ding in lim-in apang e.
en_web: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
en_kjv: Every word of God is pure: He is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

tcz: Elohim Pathen seidohsa thucheng belap hih hel in, achuti louva ahileh aman naphosal ding; mijou nahi lo ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
en_kjv: Add thou not unto his words, Lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thilni kangai chae, kathi kahsen hiche thilni hi nei-it peh hihbeh in.
en_web: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
en_kjv: Two things have I required of thee; Deny me them not before I die:

tcz: Amasan jouthu kaseilouna dingin neipan pin, aninan vaichatna le haona neipe hih in; keima nehkhop bep ding in neivah jing tan.
en_web: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
en_kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: Give me neither poverty nor riches; Feed me with food convenient for me:

tcz: Ajeh chu keima hung haobeh seh leng, “Yahweh Pakai chu koiham?” tia nangma douna thu kasei lo ding; vaicha behseh kit leng kaguchat lo kit ding, Elohim, ka Pathen mintheng kasuh thang bep ding ahi.
en_web: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
en_kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, And say, Who is the Lord? Or lest I be poor, and steal, And take the name of my God in vain.

tcz: Soh chu apupa kom'a heh hih beh in, ajeh chu aman nahin sapset a naje lo thei ahi.
en_web: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
en_kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, Lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

tcz: Mi kimkhat chu apute apate gaosap ngam jong aum in, hijeh chun apite anute chan geijin phatthei achang pouve.
en_web: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
en_kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, And doth not bless their mother.

tcz: Amaho mitmu jenga theng kisa jong aum uvin, hinlah athen lounauva kon in khatcha angim deh pouve.
en_web: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
en_kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, And yet is not washed from their filthiness.

tcz: Kimkhat machu amitmu uvin akichoi sang un, amit dang-chung uva chunglam ve jong aum un ahi.
en_web: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
en_kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.

tcz: Amahon chemjam tobang ha hemtah anei jun, chule aha jouseu jong chemcha hemtah tobang ahin; leiset chunga vaichate bahgam ding angaito uvin, mihem lah'a neilalte bah gam din akigo uve.
en_web: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
en_kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, And their jaw teeth as knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, And the needy from among men.

tcz: Vot'in nou ni anei jin, “Neipeh ben, neipeh ben,” ati lhon e. Chule chim louhel a thil thum aum in; thil in jong, “Alhingsel tai,” atideh pon ahi.
en_web: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
en_kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, Yea, four things say not, It is enough:

tcz: Noimigam achinga naobu ahin, leiset inla twi ducha jinga um, meika diuje jun la “Alhingsel tai,” atideh poi.
en_web: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
en_kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; The earth that is not filled with water; And the fire that saith not, It is enough.

tcz: Koi hileh apa mitche keh dan a, chule anu thua nung lou chu phaicham'a um va-ah ten akilo diu, mu-thong hon along aneh diu ahi.
en_web: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
en_kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, And despiseth to obey his mother, The ravens of the valley shall pick it out, And the young eagles shall eat it.

tcz: Kei ding in thil thum hi datmah umtah ahin, chule kahet khen thei lou thil Li aum in ahi.
en_web: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
en_kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, Yea, four which I know not:

tcz: Vanlaijol'a muvanlai lenna lampi, Songpi chunga gul kitholna lampi, Twikhanglen lailunga touna-kong kitolna lampi, chule pasal khat in nungah khat alungset jidan.
en_web: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
en_kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; The way of a serpent upon a rock; The way of a ship in the midst of the sea; And the way of a man with a maid.

tcz: Numei-jong chondan hi hiti ahi: an anen, amuh akitheh jol loijin, “Keiman thil dihlou ima kabolpoi,” tin aseije.
en_web: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
en_kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; She eateth, and wipeth her mouth, And saith, I have done no wickedness.

tcz: Thil thum hin leiset ahot-ling jin, thil Li vang leiset in athoh joupoi.
en_web: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
en_kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, And for four which it cannot bear:

tcz: Soh chu hung leng changa, chule mingol in a-oi vaset'a an anehji ahi.
en_web: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
en_kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; And a fool when he is filled with meat;

tcz: Min adeilou numei chun jiding pasal akimudoh jia, soh numei jin apinu akhel jiteng,
en_web: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
en_kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; And a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

tcz: Leiset chunga thilneo li aum in, hiche thil Li hohi achinga ching thei ahiuve.
en_web: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
en_kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, But they are exceeding wise:

tcz: Sihmi tehi mihem ahilou vang un ahat thei lheh jeng un, nipilai sung sen neh ding akikhol khom jiuvin ahi.
en_web: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
en_kjv: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

tcz: Boi ho jong hi mihem banga hat ahipouvin, hinlah songpi lah jenga jong ko akivu jiuvin ahi.
en_web: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
en_kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, Yet make they their houses in the rocks;

tcz: Khaokho ten jong leng aneipouvin, hinlah agol gol chan akitol jiuve.
en_web: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
en_kjv: The locusts have no king, Yet go they forth all of them by bands;

tcz: Daidep jong khu bailam tah'a nakhut a namat thei ahin, hiche jeng jong hi lengpa insunga cheng jing ahi.
en_web: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
en_kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, And is in kings’ palaces.

tcz: Thil thum phatah'a kijot del aum un, chule thil li jong chu akalseu akitoh del in ahi.
en_web: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
en_kjv: There be three things which go well, Yea, four are comely in going:

tcz: Sa jouse lah'a keipi bahkai hi ahat pen ahin, imacha masanga anung chon ngaipoi.
en_web: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
en_kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, And turneth not away for any;

tcz: Ahpi lah ahiteng ahchal in agep lele ahin, kelchal ahin, kel-hon lamkaijin apang in, lengpan amite henga thu aseija ahin lamkaiji ahi.
en_web: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
en_kjv: A greyhound; a he goat also; And a king, against whom there is no rising up.

tcz: Nangma mingol nahia, nang le nang kichoi sanga nahim, thilphalou khattou nangaitoa ahileh nakhut in nakam kisip chah jeng in.
en_web: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
en_kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, Or if thou hast thought evil, Lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh bongnoi imeh leh bongnoi ha asodoh jin, chule nah hom isip sip teng thisan apotdoh jin, ilung ahan jinga ahileh kinahna jeng asohsah jin ahi.
en_web: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
en_kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, And the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: So the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

tcz: Lengpa Lemuel anun anahilna thucheng ho aphondoh.
en_web: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
en_kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

tcz: “O kachapa, kanaobua kon'a kahin kachapa, ipi mong ham, kitepna vanga kahinsa kachapa?
en_web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
en_kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? And what, the son of my vows?

tcz: Nathahatna chu numei pedoh hih beh in, chule lengho sumanga pang ho chu lampi na ot louhel ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
en_kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

tcz: O Lemuel, lengho dinga judon kiti hi angai ahipoi, vaihom'a pang ho dinga khamna theija lop hi angai ahipoi.
en_web: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
en_kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes strong drink:

tcz: Ajeh chu ju adon tenguleh, thu adih'a kitansa le akiseisa chu aheimil diu; chutengleh gim hesoh changte dinga, adihnau chu asuhmil peh diu ahi.
en_web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
en_kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

tcz: Manthah nan aphah dingpa chu khamna thei donsah hih beh in, amavang alung hesoh val ho bou ju donsah tan.
en_web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
en_kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

tcz: Hitichun amaho cheng chu donsah inlang, avaichat nau asuhmil nadiu le agenthei nau tincheng asuhmil nadiu ahi.
en_web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
en_kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.

tcz: Ama ding kisei thei lou ho dingin seipeh in, chule achung uva thu adih in tanpeh in.
en_web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
en_kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb In the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

tcz: Nakam kah inlang thu adih'in tan in, vaichate le angaichate chunga thu adih'a tanna chu umsah jing in.” ati.
en_web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
en_kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, And plead the cause of the poor and needy.

tcz: Numei jipha tah kimu jou ding koiham? Amanu chu sana pah jem jouse sang in jong ahoi joi.
en_web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
en_kjv: (א) Who can find a virtuous woman? For her price is far above rubies.

tcz: Ajipan alungthim akison pi lheh in, ajeh chu amanun ajipa hinkhoa ijakai abulhinsah ding ahi.
en_web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
en_kjv: (ב) The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, So that he shall have no need of spoil.

tcz: Amanu chun ajipa chunga thilpha chom atongdoh jin, ahinkho sung in ajipa setna atongdoh ngaipoi.
en_web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
en_kjv: (ג) She will do him good and not evil All the days of her life.

tcz: Sa mul le tupat abolpeh jin, pontho tah in pat abol jin ahi.
en_web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
en_kjv: (ד) She seeketh wool, and flax, And worketh willingly with her hands.

tcz: Hitobang numei hi kiveina kong innei tobang ahin, nehle chah jong gamla tah tah a kon'in ahinpo jie.
en_web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
en_kjv: (ה) She is like the merchant’s ships; She bringeth her food from afar.

tcz: Jingkah khovah masangin athouvin ain-sung mite dingin neh le chah agong jin, chule asoh nungah ho nikhat sunga atohdiu agontoh peh jin ahi.
en_web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
en_kjv: (ו) She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth meat to her household, And a portion to her maidens.

tcz: Amanu achen loumun agaven acho pai jin, amanu khutsoh mong in lengpilei abol in ahi.
en_web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
en_kjv: (ז) She considereth a field, and buyeth it: With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

tcz: Amanu hin atai akigah in thanei tah in apang jin, aban thahat ajedoh jing in ahi.
en_web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
en_kjv: (ח) She girdeth her loins with strength, And strengtheneth her arms.

tcz: Amanu hin akiveina a natoh athilbol jouse thil phachom ahi, ti asumil ngaipon; jan khovah kahsen athaomei amit khapoi.
en_web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
en_kjv: (ט) She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: Her candle goeth not out by night.

tcz: Akhut teni le muikung akisip lhop jingin, chule akhut tenin patkong kung atuh jing jinge.
en_web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
en_kjv: (י) She layeth her hands to the spindle, And her hands hold the distaff.

tcz: Migentheite huhnan akhut alhang jingin, chujongleh alhasamte dingin akhut alhang jing in ahi.
en_web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
en_kjv: (כ) She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin ain chen buhbang hunglhah ding jong aging pon, ainsung mite abonchan ponlum in atom in hijeh chun alung monge.
en_web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
en_kjv: (ל) She is not afraid of the snow for her household: For all her household are clothed with scarlet.

tcz: Hiche numei hin ama le ama din jong ponsil akikhon in, aponsil jong tupat ponnem le ponsandup jeng ahi.
en_web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
en_kjv: (מ) She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; Her clothing is silk and purple.

tcz: Khopi kelkot phung jousea ajipa akilang doh jingin, gamsung upaho lah a atouteng jongle min ahesoh keije.
en_web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
en_kjv: (נ) Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin tupat ponnem akhongin akhonjou tengle akijoh jin, kivei miho henga jong konggah khao ajoh jin ahi.
en_web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
en_kjv: (ס) She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

tcz: Thahat le gunchuna hi hiche numeinu dinga hi aponsil tobang ahin, khonunga phat hung lhung ding jong lungkhamna beijin agaldot theijin ahi.
en_web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
en_kjv: (ע) Strength and honour are her clothing; And she shall rejoice in time to come.

tcz: Chingthei tah in thu aseijin, khoto tah a mihilna jong aneiyin ahi.
en_web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
en_kjv: (פ) She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And in her tongue is the law of kindness.

tcz: Insunga um thil jouse avetup sohkei jin, thaset jeh'a don louva akoi khatcha aumpoi.
en_web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
en_kjv: (צ) She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.

tcz: Hitobang numei hi achate ahung kipat doh jiuvin, numei nunnom nu tin asejun ahi; chule ajipa jeng in jong amanu hi apahcha lheh jie.
en_web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
en_kjv: (ק) Her children arise up, and call her blessed; Her husband also, and he praiseth her.

tcz: “Vannoi leisetna numei kitahleh numei lolhing tamtah aumme, hinlah nangin amaho nakhel sohkeije” ati.
en_web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
en_kjv: (ר) Many daughters have done virtuously, But thou excellest them all.

tcz: Kijep hoisel nahi lhep lhahna bep ahin, melhoi jong hi chomcha ding bou ahi; hinlah Yahweh Pakai ging jing numei hi pachat dinga lomtah ahi.
en_web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
en_kjv: (ש) Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: But a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

tcz: Hitobang numei chu atohdoh jouse jal'in kipaman peuvin, chule khopi kot phung tinchenga anatohdoh jousen; lhang phong in vahchoi cheh tahen.
en_web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
en_kjv: (ת) Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her own works praise her in the gates.

tcz: Hiche hi Thuhilpa, Jerusalem’a vaipoa pang, Leng David chapa thuseidoh ho ahi.
en_web: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
en_kjv: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khopia leng chang, David chapa, michingthempa thusei ho chu hicheng hi ahi.

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, “Ijakai ajehbei tobang ngen ahi, ajeh bei tobang ngensen ahi sohkeije,” ati.
en_web: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
en_kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingthempan thil ijakai hi pannabei jengin aseiye. Hinkho jong pannabei, ijakai hi pannabei ahi.

tcz: Nipi noija hi mihon atoh gim jeh’uva hi ipi aki mudoh uvem?
en_web: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
en_kjv: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
tcz_gospelgo: Hinkhon cholle nangin na natongun, ahivangin ipi phatchomna vetsah ding naneiyum?

tcz: Khang achemang in, khang ahung lhung kit in, hinlah leiset hin kikhelna aneikha hih laiye.
en_web: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
en_kjv: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem khang akichaiyin khang chom chom ahungin, leiset la baep’in aum jinge.

tcz: Nisa ahung sohdoh in chule alhum kit jin, chule kinotah’a kipandoh kit ding in akigopai jin ahi.
en_web: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
en_kjv: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa la asona ngaiya asoh jingin, alhumna ngaiya alhumin, chille nangin ahung kipat kitna ding mun a akile kit’in ahi.

tcz: Hui chu lhang lama anung in, chule sah lama ahung kihei jin ahi. Avel kol avelkol in, ahui nun chun akollin ahi.
en_web: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
en_kjv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
tcz_gospelgo: Hui jong sahle lhang, simle mal, kolkimvel’a avel vel’in anung kimvel vel jenge.

tcz: Vadung ho tuikhanglenna alonglut’uvin, hinlah twikhanglen adim thei deh poi. Chuti chun twi ho chu vadunga ahung kile kit jiuvin chule ahung longdoh un twikhanglenna chun alut kit jiuve.
en_web: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
en_kjv: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
tcz_gospelgo: Vadung jouse Twikhanglen la along lut’in, Twikhanglen la adim deh poi. Twi chu luidung nah dunga ahung kipanlit’in, avel’in ahung kitol kit’e.

tcz: Thil ijakai hi seithei lou hellin thachol chol a um'in ahi. Ijat imit uva imu vang un ilungnau achim poi. Ijat ina khang uva ijah jeng vang un ilunglhai jou pouve.
en_web: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
en_kjv: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil ijakai cholna jeng ahin, chol aum behseh jengin seijou jai ahipoi. Mit la vet achimpoi.

tcz: Achesa thusim kivelso kitna ahibouve. Masang peh’a ana kibol chaisa ngensen ahiuve. Nisa noija imacha thil athah tahbeh aum poi.
en_web: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.
en_kjv: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Asohsa thil chu hung soh kit ding ahi. Akibolsa thil chu kibol kit ding ahi. Vannou pumpia hin thil thah aumpoi.

tcz: Khatvei veileh mihon aseijun, “Imacha athah kiti aum poi,” atiuve. Hinlah tahbeh mong in alui ahi bouvin, imacha athah kiti hi aum poi.
en_web: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
en_kjv: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon, “ven, hikoma thil thah aum’e!” atiuve. Ahivangin hiche jong hi masang, ipen masangpeh-uva sohsa ahitai.

tcz: Achesa phatna ipi anasoh em ti igeldoh pouve, chule khang ahung lhung ding hoa jong tua i-thilbol houhi koiman ahetdoh lou ding ahitai.
en_web: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.
en_kjv: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
tcz_gospelgo: Masanglai thilsoh chu koiman ageldoh pon, tulai min jong khonung thilsoh ding le tukah a thilsoh ding geldoh ponte.

tcz: Keima, Thuhilpa hi Israelte leng kahin, chule Jerusalema chenga kahi.
en_web: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingthempa kei hi Jerusalem khopia, Israel chunga, leng kana change.

tcz: Hetkhen themna holdoh theina ding in keima ka kipum pehdoh jeng in, chule nisa noija na kitongdoh ho chengse hi chihna’a kholdoh ding in ka gel’e. Keiman kahin mudoh chu Pathen in mihemte henga aumna akiphondoh hi ahi.
en_web: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
en_kjv: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset’a kibol kitong thil jouse hi kholchil ding, phot chet din kakiteptai. Pathenin mihem abolna vang hi nopna him him ahipoi.

tcz: Keiman nisa noija thil ache jomho ijakai hi kavetna ahileh atahbeh in, abonchan ajeh bei aphachom lou ding tobangbep ahije.
en_web: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: vannoi leiset’a kibol thil jouse kamun, kaseipeh nahi, aboncha pannabei jeng hai. hui leng lai mat ding go bep akihi.

tcz: Adih lou chu aki sudih tahbeh joupon, chule amangsa jong chu akinung mukit tapoi.
en_web: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
en_kjv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
tcz_gospelgo: Akonsa le sujang theipon natin, aum loula simtha theipon nate.

tcz: Keima ka lungthima ka kihoulim in, ka seijin, “Ven, kamasanga Jerusalema leng changho vaihomlai sangin jong ka ching joi. Keima amaho khatpen sangin jong chih john a le hetjohna kaneije ,” kati.
en_web: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”
en_kjv: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungthimin, “kaminthang lheh tan, kamasanga Jerusalem a lengvaippote jouse sangin kachingjoi. Chihna le hetna jong ipi mong mong kiseina ahi kahetai,” kati.

tcz: Hiti chun keima ijakai chihna’a konna ngolna chule kingol sahna geija hetdohna ding in ka kalsong doh in ahi. Hinlah keima tah in kahetdoh chu hiche ho jouse hi pannabei thil tobangbep ahije.
en_web: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hetna le ngolna kibah lou je, chih le ngol kibah louje hetdoh kagoi. Hichea jong hin hui lenglai mat godol’in kakihei.

tcz: Ka chihna akibe cheh le ka gimna akibe cheh in, hetna akalbe cheh le lunggim na akibe cheh bepmin ahi.
en_web: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
en_kjv: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachih cheh le nalung gimbe cheh, nahetbe jep le nalung natbe cheh ding ahi.

tcz: Keile kei ka kihouvin, “Hung in nopsahna patep hitin, hinkhoa thilpha phaho vehite,” kati ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh-beihel tobangbep ahiti, keiman kamu doh in ahi.
en_web: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.
en_kjv: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and behold, this also is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Nom satah a uma, nopna hi hatchet tei kagoi. Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi pannabei ahi kamu dohtai.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman, “Nui jong hi ngolhoi ahi bouvin, nopsahna hol jong hin ipi phatna ahinsodoh em,” kati.
en_web: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
en_kjv: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
tcz_gospelgo: Nui ngolna ahiya, nopsah nan thilpha aso sah lou jong kahe dohtai.

tcz: Lunggel tampi gel jouvin, keiman judonna lungthim kipasah ding in kagel in ahi. Chule chihna ka holhol laijin, ngolhoithu jong kagel in ahi. Hiti hin keiman hiche vannoija hi chomcha ahinsunguva, mi atamjon kipana tah ahol hol-u chu kahetdoh nom in ahi.
en_web: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.
en_kjv: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, (yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom) and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachih nom behseh jeh-in, kisuh lipna din ju kadonin nom um ding kagoi. Leiset hinkho chomcha sunga hitia umding hi mihem dia thil phapen din kanegel’e.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman chenna ding in-len tahtah sah’a chule lengpilei hoi tahtah ho semdoh a kon hin, hinlona jeh hidiham tin kanagel in ahi.
en_web: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
en_kjv: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
tcz_gospelgo: Thil loupe tah tah katongdoh tai: in tampi kakisah-in, Lengpilei tampi kakibol’e.

tcz: Keiman hon tampi le kicholdona mun tampi kasem in, theiphung jat tintang kaphut dimin ahi.
en_web: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
en_kjv: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
tcz_gospelgo: Hon le pahcha lei kabol’in, thei gathei jouse kaphut’e;

tcz: Keiman thingphung mang keikoija ahung um doh theinan twichapna ding in twikhol khomna ding tampi jong kasem in ahi.
en_web: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.
en_kjv: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
tcz_gospelgo: achap nouna ding twikul kalaiye.

tcz: Keiman soh pasal hole soh numeiho jong ka chon chule ka-in muna pengden soh phabep jong ka neijin ahi. Chule keiman masanga Jerusalema ana cheng leng ana umsa ho sang in jong, gancha hole gan lentah tah ho geijin jong kanei tam jon ahi.
en_web: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
tcz_gospelgo: Soh tampi kachon, ka-insunga peng den soh jong tampi kavul’e. Kamsasanga Jerusalema leng ho sangin kahaojon gancha tamjo kaneiye.

tcz: Keiman lengtampi ho le agam sung uva dangka tamtah le sana tamtah ho ka kholkhom in ahi. Keiman numei hole pasal ho lah’a lasathem kidangtah tah kaki thalah in chule melhoitah tah thaikem ho jong ka neijin, pasal khat in alung’a adeichat chan chu ka neisoh kei jin ahi.
en_web: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.
en_kjv: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavaipohna gamsunga leng inpi thil kholna chengsea konin sana dangka kapokhomin kasevum leove. Kei nopsahna din numeiyin la asauvin, pasal deichat lom numei chamkim keiyin kaneiye.

tcz: Hiti chun keima ka masanga Jerusalema ana cheng ho jouse sang in ka loupi jon, chule ka chihna’n keima eidalha pon ahi.
en_web: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.
en_kjv: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaloupi lheh jengin, kamasanga Jerusalema cheng leng ho sangin loupin kaumdoh tan, kachihna athon ngaipoi.

tcz: Kalunga ka ngaichat chan kakilah ji'e. Nopsahna kiti pouva chun ka noplou na aum poi. Na hahsa toh jeng’a jong ka tha nom lheh in, katoh gimna jousea tohman ka kimu cheh in ahi.
en_web: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.
en_kjv: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadeichan kamun; nopsahna thei kalhaso ngaipoi. Katohdoh chan kahoithopin, hiche hi katohman ahimaiye.

tcz: Hinlah kana tohna jouse hi kavetna ahileh bulhit molso kiti hi ahahlheh in, ajeh bei ngensen ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahi. Hoilai mun hijong leh aphachom dihtah kiti hi aum deh poi.
en_web: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
en_kjv: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng tohdohna dia hahsa kathoh chengse kagel le imacha pang din aumdoh theipoi. Pannabei hui lenglai mat go bep kahi.

tcz: Hitia hi keiman chihna hitoh ki ngolsah nale ngolna hi ka tekah in ahileh (ajeh chu keima Lengpa tah ’in kabol banga hi koiyin abolthei ding ham?)
en_web: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.
en_kjv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhonna kheh a leng khat’in abol thei chu leng masa ho bolsa chubou ahi. Hijeh chun hcihna le chihgil chule ngolna umdol hi kagel pantai.

tcz: “Khovah hi muthim sanga aphatjoh bang in, chihna hi ngolna sang in apha joi, tin ka gel in ahi.
en_web: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.
en_kjv: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche vang hi kahetai—“Chihna hi ngolna sangin aphajon, muthim sanga khovah phatchom tobang ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu miching hon achena ding aki muchet masat un, hinlah angol chu muthima avah lei. Hinlah miching le mingol jong achanding’u aki banggel in ahi.”
en_web: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.
en_kjv: The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingin kaselna ding akihet’in, mi-ngol’in kho amupoi,” kati. Chule iboncha ithi cheh diu jong kahe dohtai.

tcz: Keima lunggel’a, “Aniuva thigel ding ahi. Keima mingol banga kichai ding kahijeh in, kachihna jouse hi amanlutna ipi hintem? Hiche hi aboncha ajehbei hisohkei ahije!” kati.
en_web: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.
en_kjv: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalungin, “Mi-ngol ho banga kathitei ding ahi. Achutile hibanga kahcih hi ipi kaphat chompim?” kati. Kei le ken, “Thil imcha cha phat chompi kaneipoi,” tin kaseiye.

tcz: Ajeh chu miching le mingol aniuva athigellin ahi. Miching chu mingol sanga aki geldoh ding aumbe dehpoi. Ahung lhung ding nikhohoa aniuva ki geldoh lou ding ahi tauve.
en_web: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
en_kjv: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is, in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
tcz_gospelgo: Miching geldohna jong aumppon, mi-ngol geldodhna jong aumppoi. Khonung tengle koiman eigeldoh pouvinte. Miching mi-ngol iboncha itih cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Hitia keiman lei hinkho kahotna ajeh chu, hiche nisa noija kibol doh jouse hi lungboina bep ahije. Ijakai hi ajehbei tobang ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahije.
en_web: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh hin mihem hinkho hi imacha ding katipoi, ajehc hu hinkhon gim hesoh tilou adang ima eipetheipoi. Pannabei hel ahin, hui lenglai man go bep kanahi.

tcz: Keiman hiche leiset chunga kana toh gimna jouse hi kahin thei chim ahitai, ijeh- iham itileh keiman ka lodoh jouse hi midang ka dalhah peh ding ahije.
en_web: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
en_kjv: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
tcz_gospelgo: Katohsa le kabolsa chengse phatchom nan kaneipon, kakhel’a pang dinga dia kadalhah ding kahei;

tcz: Chule keima panmun hinlo dingho chu ching diuha ahilouleh ngoldiu ha kon asei thei ding ham? Hinlah nipi noija keima boltheina le tohgimna jal'a phatchom pina kanei hohi, amahon ahin kimanchah diu ahitai. Itia ajeh bei soh hin tem!
