en_web: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
en_kjv: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: ama chu miching hithei, mi-ngol hithei-kon ija ahet’em? Hoijoh hile katohsa, kachihnan hiche leiset’a atohdoh chengse, aman alo ding ahi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahibouve.

tcz: Hitia hi keima, hiche vannoija hi ka tohgimna jouse hi aphatchomna ipi um'em tia lung lha tah’a uma kahi.
en_web: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
en_kjv: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Hibang hahsa na katoh chu kakisih lheh jenge.

tcz: Mi phabep chun chingtheile hetna neijin, chule themtah in atongun, amaho chun chutia atohgimgau chu atong louhel khat dinga chu adalhah teidiu ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh kihe lou ahin, lungnat umtah ahi.
en_web: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.
en_kjv: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachihna le nahetna, nathepna mangcha natohdoh chengse chu atong louhel khat nadalhah peh didng ahi. Pannabei hel, thil dih lou ahi!

tcz: Hitia hi mihon hiche hinkhoa hi atohgim nau jouse le alung gim nau jouseuva hi ipi akimu’u hinam?
en_web: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
en_kjv: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
tcz_gospelgo: Hinkhoa lung gim hesoh a na natoh a, ipi tohman nasan ding ham?

tcz: Atoh gimnau nikhoho chu thohgimna le lungnat nan adim un, jan ahi teng jongleh alung thim-u akicholdo theipoi. Chehi ajehbei tobangbep ahisoh keije.
en_web: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
en_kjv: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahinlai damsunga natohdoh chengsen thil dang sodoh pontin, lung gimna le lung natna bou asodoh ding ahi. Janin jong lung ol’in naum thiepoi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahi.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman ka gellin mihem in aneh’a chule adonna, anatoh’a lungkimna anei ding sanga phajo aum poi kati. Hiti hin, hiche nopsahna hohi Pathen khutna hungkon ahi, ti keiman ka geldoh in ahi.
en_web: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
en_kjv: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem toh thei thilpha pen chu-atohga neh a don ding, nomsa tah aum didng hi ahi.Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi Pathen peh a kimubou ahi kahedoh tai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Amalouva kon aneh’a, ahilou leh nop asah ding hiya ham?
en_web: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
en_kjv: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche tilou chu thil dang ipi neh a nomsa naum thei ding ham?

tcz: Pathen in chihna, hetna chule thanopna Ana lunglhaiho apeh ahi. Hinlah michonse khat chu neile gou ahaova ahileh hiche ahaona chu Pathen in alahmanga, ama lunglhaiho apeh ding ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh beihel aphachom lou ding ahibouve.
en_web: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin adei bolte chu chihna, hetna chule nopna apeh ahi; chonsete vang natong sumhol’a apansah a, alodohsah a akholsah kit’a, Pathen lungtohte peh dia akoisah ahi. Aboncha hi pannabei bep, hui lenglai man dia kigo bep ahibouve.

tcz: Ijakai dingin aphat aumcheh in, vannoija hin ijakai achat loh thei ding in phat aum cheh’e.
en_web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
en_kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche vannoi leiset a thilsoh jouse hi Pathenin asosah nom phat dungjuiya soh cheh ahi.

tcz: Penna ding phat aum in chule thiphat aum’e. Aphu phat aum in chule a‘at phat aum’e.
en_web: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
en_kjv: A time to be born, and a time to die; A time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
tcz_gospelgo: Pen phat aumsah-in, thi phat aumsah-e; Thing phu phat aumin, thing bodoh phat aum’e.

tcz: Atha’phat aum in chule asuhdam phat aum’e. Aphet lhah phat aum in chule asahdoh phat aum’e.
en_web: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
en_kjv: A time to kill, and a time to heal; A time to break down, and a time to build up;
tcz_gospelgo: Suhlih phat aumin, boldam phat aum’e. Sahdoh phat aumin, phet lhah phat aum’e,

tcz: Ka phat aumin chule nui phat aume. Lunghem phat aum in chule lam phat aume.
en_web: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
en_kjv: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; A time to mourn, and a time to dance;
tcz_gospelgo: Gim phat aumsah-in, nop phat aumsah-e; Lunghem phat aumin, lam phat aum’e.

tcz: Song sethang phat aum in chule song khopkhom phat aum’e. Ki-angkol phat aum in chule kihei mang phat aum’e.
en_web: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
en_kjv: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; A time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
tcz_gospelgo: Kidei phat aumin, kihotphat aum’e; Kichopto phat aumin, kichop lou phat aum’e.

tcz: Thil holphat aum in chule thilhol ngah phat aum’e. Akholkhom phat aumin chule athe cheh phat aum’e.
en_web: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
en_kjv: A time to get, and a time to lose; A time to keep, and a time to cast away;
tcz_gospelgo: Thil holdoh phat aumsah-in, thil mansah phat aumsah-e; Loidoh phat aumin, semang phat aum’e.

tcz: Abo-eh phat aumnin chule akhui bit phat aum’e. Thipbeh’a umphat aumin chule thusei phat aume.
en_web: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
en_kjv: A time to rent, and a time to sew; A time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
tcz_gospelgo: Bo-eh phat aumin, khuibit phat aum’e; Umthim phat aumin, paopoh phat aum’e.

tcz: Kingailut phat aumin chule kivetda phat aume. Kinah phat aum in chule kicham phat aum’e.
en_web: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
en_kjv: A time to love, and a time to hate; A time of war, and a time of peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Ki-ngai phat aumsah-in, kihot phat aumsah-e; Kisat phat aumin, kicham phat aum’e.

tcz: Ana tohhat man uva miho hin ipi akimu mong mong uvem?
en_web: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
en_kjv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
tcz_gospelgo: Itoh gimchengseuva kona ipi imudoh-um?

tcz: Pathen’in i-bonchau chunga pohgih eikoipeh cheh’u kamu doh tai.
en_web: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
en_kjv: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin pohgih hahsa eipohsah-u kahei.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, Pathen’in ijakai amachang cheh dingin hoisel in asem in ahi. Aman mihemte lungsunga tonsot akhum lut peh in, hinlah chuti ahijeng vang'in, mihem in Pathen tohgon apatna pat achaina geijin amu phapoi.
en_web: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
en_kjv: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman thil ijakai din phat kitoh che’tin akoiye, Khonung thu ding hetnomna eipeuvin, ahivangin athilbol lhingset’a het’a lung nachimpi ding eiphalpeh pouve.

tcz: Hijeh’a hi keiman, mihem chu akipa’a chule ijochan geijuva thanopna inei dingu sanga phajo dang aumpoi, tia ka gel lhah ahi tai.
en_web: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
en_kjv: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ihinlai damsunguva itoh thei chan toh a nopsah pi ding hi toh thei penin kahei.

tcz: Chule miho hin aneh’uva chule adon’uva chule atohgim gahou, athanoppi diu hi Pathen’in manbeiya athil peh-u chu ahi.
en_web: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
en_kjv: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ibonchauva itohga neh a don ding, nopsah pi ding ahi. Hiche hi Pathen thilpeh ahi.

tcz: Chule ipi hijongleh Pathen in athilbol chan chu achaina ahi jenge. Imacha gah koibe ding ahilouleh gah lahdoh ding aum poi. Pathen in alung gon chu mihem ten Ama agin ding’u hi ahi.
en_web: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
en_kjv: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thilbol jouse beitih neilou ding kahei. Bolbe thei jong hilou, lahdoh thei jong hilou ahi. Pathen thilbol khat chu-ibonchauva Ama eiginsah got’u ahi.

tcz: Tua hung sohdoh hohi tumasanga ana sohdohsa ahitai, chule khonunga hung soh ding ho chu tuma’a ana sohdoh sa ahitai, ajeh chu Pathen in hiho chu avel vella ahin um dohsah kitji ahije.
en_web: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
en_kjv: That which hath been, is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh ho le asoh ding ho hi asohsa ahitai. Asohsa chu Pathenin avel vel’a asosah ahibouve.

tcz: Nisa noija keiman ka mudoh kit chu, thutanna dan aphalou um ka hedoh’e. Tahbeh in , Dan Thutanna mun chu thudih aum poi.
en_web: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
en_kjv: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
tcz_gospelgo: Achung chonin, vannoiya hin thudih kiseiya thildih bolna dinga gitlouna namudoh ding kahetai.

tcz: Keimatah in ka lungthima, “Aphatcha Pathen in apha hileh ase hileh amichang cheh chu anatoh hou jouse jal'a achungthu’u atan ding ahi,” kati.
en_web: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
en_kjv: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachangseh-in, “Thilsoh jouse le thil kibol chengse hi aphat dungjui cheh a soh ahijeh-in, Pathenin midih le migilou thu kibanga atan ding ahi,” tin kagel’e.

tcz: Keiman mihemte dinmun thua kagel lin-Pathen’in mihemte henga amaho jong gancha hole gamsaho tobangbep ahiuve, ti aphochen in ahi.
en_web: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
en_kjv: I said in my heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho hi ganchate sanga phajo deh lou ihiu vetchetna dia Pathenin eipatep dol’un kahei.

tcz: Ajeh chu gamsaho le mihemte chan kibang ahinau aume-haitheina anei gel uvin chule thithei gel ahiuve. Hitia hi mihemin gamsa ho sanga phatchom john a tahbeh anei deh pouve. Ajeh bei iti hi’a hitam!
en_web: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.
en_kjv: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Hoi hileh-mihem hihen gancha hileh thei cheh ding ahi. Khat thi banga jong thi thou ahi.Ahoi hoi hiya thilsem gel ahi. Mihem jong gancha sangin aphachom dehpoi, ajehc hu hoijoh ding ahin hinlo aumpoi.

tcz: Ania munkhatna chekhoma ahi-vutna kona hung kondoh’uva ahin, aniuva vut kisohkit diu ahi.
en_web: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
en_kjv: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
tcz_gospelgo: Mun khat ajot lhon a, leivui sohgel ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemgel, leivui sohgel ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu koiham mihem lhagao akaltouvin chule gamsaho lhagao leisetna akumsuh’e ti, koi jin aphotchet thei jem?
en_web: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
en_kjv: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem lhagao van a akaldoh mongin, gancha lhagao lei noiya ache monge, ti kon asei thei dang ham?

tcz: Hitia hi keiman mihem dinga anatoh chunga akipa diu sanga phajo kamupoi. Eiho hi koiman ithi jou tenguleh nopsahna dinga thina’a konna eihin lepui ding’u ahi tapoi.
en_web: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
en_kjv: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thilpha pen a kagel chu itohsa chunga lung nom a um ding hi ahi. Bol thei dang ineipouve. Ithi nung tengu ipi aso ding hetdoh theina lampi ineipouvin ahi.

tcz: Avel in, keiman nipi noija kibol hesohna jouse ka mun ahi. Keiman akibol hesohho mitlhi lon kamun, alhamon ding’u koima aum poi. Agimbol hou chun thuneina lentah anei juvin, chule amaho khutnoija umho chun ima thuneina aneipouve.
en_web: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
en_kjv: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset’a thil dihlou kibol chengse kavei. Bolsetna thohte aka vangun koiman apanpi deh poi. Abolsetau chu thanei thu neiloi ahijeh-un koiman apanpi nagmpoi.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman kangel lhah chu, mithisa hohi mihingho sangin aphat johnau aum’e, kati.
en_web: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
en_kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Thia mangsa ka-otchajo tai; ahing nalaiho sangin amaho chun nom asajouve.

tcz: Ahinlah apeng lou laiho ding in gam cheng in apha chom jo nalaije. Ajeh chu nipi noija thilse kibol hohi amahon amukhah louvu ahi.
en_web: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
en_kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Athi le ahing sanga phajo cheh kit chu-apen a peng lou, vannoiya thil dihlou kibol mukha louhel ho chu ahiuve.

tcz: Chutah in keiman kamu doh chu mi atamjo hi lolhinna ding in akitilkhou uve, ajeh chu amaho aheng le akom-u mihou jeng ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobang aum den lou ding hija ahi.
en_web: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
en_kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon hibanga kihanlhoten a na atoh-u jong kahe dohtai; midang tohna thangset jal’a abol’u ahi. Hijongle hiche jong hi pannabei ahibouve.Hui lenglai mat ding kigo bep ahi.

tcz: ‘‘Mingol hon athasetnau khut akisip chah’u chu amahthahna ding’u ahi.’’
en_web: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
en_kjv: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon khut kikhoitum a an ngol’a thia chu angol’in bou aseiyui.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, “Khut khat dim thip khen cha nei ding hi khutni dimset aum den lou ding, tongimma nei sang in aphajoi.”
en_web: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
en_kjv: Better is a handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Dih khat nante, ahivnagin khut ong man louhel’a hui lenglai mat ding goa kiseimo jeng sangin, lung ol heocha themcha bou nei aphajoi.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija vetsahna jat chom beh khat kavet be kit in ahi.
en_web: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
en_kjv: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken hinkho sunga pannabei khat jong kamudoh-e.

tcz: Hiche hi mikhat ama changseh’a khosapa thudol ahin, cha khat jong neilou, sopi pasal jong neilou ahia, ajo channa tong gimma neile nga khol khoma ahi. Hiti chun amale ama aki dong in, “Koi dinga tonggima ka him? Tua hi ibola keiman nopsahna donse louva kahi hitam?” ati. Hiche ho jouse hi ajeh apol beihel le lung lhahna thei tah ahibouve.
en_web: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
en_kjv: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal khat hi achangseh-in achenge. Cha la neipon, sopi jeng jong aneipoi; ahivangin umthim thei louvin na atongin, anei chasun along lhaipipoi. Koi ding bep ngaitoa kicholdoh man louhel’a hibanga na atoh ham? Hiche hi pannabei, hinkho hahsa tah ahibouve.

tcz: Mini hi mikhat sang in aphachom joi, ajeh chu amani chu kihuto thei gel hilhonna lolhing thei ding ahi lhon’e.
en_web: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
en_kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
tcz_gospelgo: Khatseh sangin mi ni aphajoi, ajeh chu mi ni akitho theiye.

tcz: Mikhat chu alhuh’a ahi leh, khat joh chun akhut alhan doh’a akithopi thei ahi. Hinlah koiham khat chu achangin lhu taleh boimong mong ding ahi tai.
en_web: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
en_kjv: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
tcz_gospelgo: Khat joh sang lhu lhon jongle khat’in aphong ding theiye. Mi khatseh vang chu lhu ta le aphong ding aumtapoi.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, mini chu alup khom lhonna ahileh aki sang lum to gel lhon thei je. Hinlah mikhat chu iti lum doh jou ding hitam?
en_web: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
en_kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
tcz_gospelgo: Adap teng mi nin lumkhom alum asah thei ahin, nachangseh a iti lum nasah diu ham?

tcz: Mikhat achanga ding chu midang in adelkhuma chule ajo paithei ahin, hijongleh mini vang chu kinung thopto lhonna chule ajothei lhon ding ahi. Thumchu pha cheh’a ahi, ajeh chu khaohol thum'a kihal lhop chu bailam tah’a kibot tanlou ding ahi.
en_web: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
en_kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat nan lel chu mi nin ananjou tei ding ahi. Khao jang thum kihel lhop botan hahsa ahi.

tcz: Khangthah mivaicha le chingtah pachu tehse le lungngol koimahil lalou Lengpa sang in apha chom joi.
en_web: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
en_kjv: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
tcz_gospelgo: Leng tehse mi-ngol, thumop sang lou hisangin, vaicha khangdodng miching hi aphajoi.

tcz: Chutobang khangdongpa chu vaichatna a konna hung kithou dohtheija chule lolhing thei ahije. Ama chu songkulla umjong leh ama chu leng hung chang thei jong ahi nalaije.
en_web: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
en_kjv: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang gollhang chu songkul lutsa leng hung chang hijongle, vaicha chaga cha peng hijeng jongle aphajo nalaiye.

tcz: Hinlah amitakip chu athalhenga pangpa, khangdong chomdangpa koma chun aga lhailut jo jiuvin ahi.
en_web: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
en_kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya cheng mihem jouse kagel’in, hoikom ham alah-uva gollhang khat pen chu lengpa mun hilo ding umkahedoh tai.

tcz: Mihonpi chu kichai tih um louvin akoma chun ahung ding khom’uvin, hinlah khang ahung kikhel phat chun ama jong chu adeimo bolkittauvin ahi. Hijeh chun hiche ho jouse hi ajeh beile phatchomna bei ahi sohkeije.
en_web: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengin vai apohna sunga hin mipi simsen lou unman tin, lengpa athi teng atohsah koiman gelpha ponte. Hiche hi pannabei, hui lenglai mat dia kigoa tobang ahi.

tcz: Pathen houna in na nalut tengleh, nakol sung in lang chule na kam kihup in. Geltoh louva Pathenna kilhaina sem chu pha louva ahi.
en_web: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
en_kjv: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin kaidol ching theiyin. Kho pholou mi-ngolten abol’a kilhaina thil moh to to jeng sanga, thu ngaiya kihil them dia Houin kai aphajoi.

tcz: Kitepna geltoh louvin mohsem sem hih in, chule Pathen angsunga thil hinlhut loi ding kino hih beh in. Pathen chu vanna uma ahin, nangma hiche leisetna hi uma na hije. Hijeh chun na thusei chom hen.
en_web: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
en_kjv: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
tcz_gospelgo: Napaodoh masangin geltoh masan, chule geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna bol jeng dan. Pathen van a um, nang leiset’a um bou nahin, nasei dia lombep kalval’in imacha sei hih-in.

tcz: Naha chaloh behset naho hin kichol dothei louna mang namat sah ding, thu na tam seival hin mingol nasosah bep ding ahi.
en_web: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
en_kjv: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool’s voice is known by multitude of words.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung gim cheh le mangse naneibe cheh thei, thu nasei tam chan a ngol-hoi thu naseidoh be thei ahi.

tcz: Nangman Pathenna kitepna nanei tengleh, hichu jui lhung ding khongai sot hih in, ijeh inem itileh Pathen’in mingol ho chunga lunglhai na anei poi. Ama henga na kitepna jouse chu bulhit molson.
en_web: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
en_kjv: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen koma kitepna naneikhah le, tong doh loi jengin, Pathenin mi-ngol adeipoi, bol dia naseisa chu bol jengin.

tcz: Kitepna neija ahiala suhbulhit louva um sang in, imacha sei lou beh chu pha joa ahi.
en_web: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
en_kjv: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepsa bolda sangin, kitepna him him boldan aphajoi.

tcz: Nakam in na chonset sah hih beh hen. Nangman hou-in lhacha pa jah’a chun kitepna ka nanei chu ka seikhel ahitai tin nangle nang kihonnan sei hih in. Hichun Pathen a lunghan sah joh ding, chule aman natohdoh umsa chengse chu su-mang loget inte.
en_web: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?
en_kjv: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
tcz_gospelgo: Naseisan kipal dan, Pathen Thempu jah a geldoh louva nabol’in seidan. Idia Pathen nakiphin lung hang ding ham? Nabolse chu i-bol’a nasuh mangsah ding ham?

tcz: Mangmat le pannabei thilbol apunbe tobang'in, thu sei doh jong abai lam in ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen ging jon.
en_web: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
en_kjv: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mangle bul ijat neiyin lang, pannabei na ijat tongin, thu ijat sei jongle chun, Pathen nagin tei tei ding ahi.

tcz: Thanei tah khat in mivaicha chu agimbol hesoh namua chule gamsung pumpia thutahle chonphatna chu alamlouva akiheikoija ahiltah jongleh hichu datmo hih in. Ajeh chu achungnung penna thuneipa sanga chung nungjo chun agel khoh ahin, chule amaho sanga sangjo ho aum uve.
en_web: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.
en_kjv: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset vaipoten vaichate abol hesoh a, thu dih tanpeh louva, achan diu lom apeh d anamu jongle datmo hih-in. Vaihom thunei jouse chu asanga lenjo khat cheh-in ave-lhi, alenpen jong chu alen cheh khat’in avet lhi jing ahi.

tcz: Chu kal val in, leiset hi mi jouse phatchomna ding ahi; hitia chu lengpa alouma’a kihinso ahi.
en_web: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
en_kjv: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa jong alalna lhosoh chunga ki-ngam ahibouve.

tcz: Sum ngailu ho chun suma ning lhin tih anei lou diu. neile gouvin kipana dihtah apeh ding gel’a chun phatchompi ponte.
en_web: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
en_kjv: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum nadei behseh le, itih-in jong lung nachimna neipon natin; hao lung nagul le, nadei chanmusoh pon nate. Pannabei ahibouve.

tcz: Natamnei channa chu na suhmang huding mi tamcheh hung um ding ahi. Hijeh chun neile gou hi na khuttah’a konna aki toldoh navet tilou ipi aphat chomna nahet em?
en_web: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
en_kjv: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
tcz_gospelgo: Nahao cheh le naneh peh ding jong tambe cheh ahi. Naphat chompi pen chu nahao nahet tho chu ahibep’e.

tcz: Na tonggimho chun tamneh henlang, lhom neh jong leh a-ihmut’u anom’e. Hinlah mihao chun ih-mut nopna amu joupoi.
en_web: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
en_kjv: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Natong jing vang chun neh kham kimu hen kimu hih jongle nomsel’in a-ihmu theiyin, mihao vang chu anei lung jin pin ihmu mon akhovah jitai.

tcz: Nipi noija aboitah khat kamu doh kit aum ben ahi. Neile gou kikhol khom hi aneipa ding in aphat mona aum e.
en_web: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
en_kjv: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya thil melse tah khat kamui; mihon khonunga nom neh dingin sum akhol khol’un,

tcz: Sum hi apung dinga kikhol khom jong hi hahsatna ahinle sodoh jin, chule hiche jeh hin ijakai amanlo jibep’e. Achaina tengleh achate dinga ima pehson ding nei louvin aum jitai.
en_web: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
en_kjv: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: ahivangin hamsetna khat jeh hamin amoh suh mang hel jiuvin, atu acha ding khen louhel’in aumlo jitauve.

tcz: Eiho jouse hi i-hungpen uva banga sagohkeu le khut gohkeuva i-hinkho’u hi hung kichai ding ahi. Nei le gou inei hou kipoh thei ihi pouve.
en_web: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
en_kjv: As he came forth of his mother’s womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Imacha polut louva vannoiya ihung lut bangun, pohdoh neilouvin adalhaji tauve.Tong gim lheh jong leu hen ipohdodh theiyu khat cha aumpoi.

tcz: Chule hiche jong hi boi-umtah ahi. Mihon hiche vannoi adalhah’uhi ahungpen sanguva aphat john a aumpoi. Atohgim nau jouse hi amang thah bep ding ahibouve.
en_web: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
en_kjv: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
tcz_gospelgo: Dih louhel ahi! Ihung lut banguva potdoh kit ahiuve. Itong gim’un, hui lenglai mat ding geiyin igo’uvin, ipi ikimu’vem?

tcz: Ahinkho lhung keijuva lungkim louna, lunglhahna chule lunghanna meipi noija uma ahiuve.
en_web: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
en_kjv: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitsin khojin le gim hesoh thoh-in ihingun, lung gim le lung phamo chule nat hesoh ithoh-ui.

tcz: Hiti chu ahi vang'in, thilpha khat keiman kahin mudoh in ahi. Hichu mihem in nipi noija Pathen in apeh hinkho chomcha um sunga aneh’a, adon’a, chule anatoh chunga akipa thanop pia chule achan chunga alung lhai ding hi ahi.
en_web: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
en_kjv: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kamudoh bep’e. Thilpha pen chu min Pathenin apeh ahinkho chom cha sunga hi atohga alhosoh ne le don a nop sahna anei hi ahi; hiche hi mihem chan ahibep’e.

tcz: Chule Pathenna konna neile gou chule damtheina anei kipapina anei dinghi thilpha ahi. Nanatoh nathanoppia chule nahinkhoa nachan chu nalung oipia ahileh hiche hi Pathen thilpeh chu ahije.
en_web: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
en_kjv: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mihem chu haole gou pehen, nop sahnan neisah le atoh lo chu kipa pinte. Hiche hi Pathe thilpeh ahi.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija thil chombeh aphamo tah khat kamudoh aum in, hichu mihemte lah’a aum jing in ahi.
en_web: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
en_kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya hin thil dihlou kibol khat kamui.

tcz: Pathen’in mi phabep chu haona bulhingset le jabolna chule angai chatbe chan diu geijin apen, hinlah hicheho chu nopsah pina neithei manlouva koi-mi aumin ahi. Amaho chu athiuvin, chule midang hetphah loubeh mi khatnin anei le gou, thil lamdoh chu anopsahpi lheh jin ahi! Hiche hi hamsetna nat pithei leu pannabei ahibouve.
en_web: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
en_kjv: a man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin mihem khat nei le gou, jabolna, ijakai adeichan apen, ahivangin hicheng chu nop sahnan aneisah hih beh-e. APeh louhel khat’in nopsah nan aneijie.Hiche hi pannabei hel, thil dih lout ah ahi.

tcz: Mi khat in cha jakhat jen nei theijinte chule atehset geijin hingkhat nante. Hinlah amachun hinkhoa lungkimna neihih henlang, chule kivuina pha neita hihleh, ama dinga chu ahungpena athisa ana-hitaleh phajo ding ahi.
en_web: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;
en_kjv: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem khat’in cha ja khat jen nei hen sotpi hing hen, itih chan ahin vangin nop sahna neikha louhel le phate keichan kivui hihle, apenlhah lhah a thipai jeng naosen ma aphajoi, tin kagel’e.

tcz: Ama chu kum sangkhat val, nivei geijin hing ding hijongleh lungkimna aneitah lou ding ahi. Chule ama chun midang khat tobanga thina atoding, hichun ipi aphat chomsah ding ham?
en_web: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?
en_kjv: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
tcz_gospelgo: Kum sangni jen hing jongle hin nopna hephalou mihem sangin aphajoi.Anigel lhon’a mun khat jon a che lhon ahi.

tcz: Mijousen ahinkhou apum pia anholna’n kimai jun tin, hinlah anei lhingset diu ginchat aum poi.
en_web: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
en_kjv: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihemin atoh chan kamsung ding ahin, chimla achimdeh poi.

tcz: Hitia hi miching hohi mingolho sanga phachom jouva hilou ham? Mivaicha hon achih jeh’uva ipi phatchomna akimuva chule midang masanga iti chon ding akihet’uvem?
en_web: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?
en_kjv: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
tcz_gospelgo: I-atile mi-ngol sanga miching phajo ham? Mi vaichan hinkho manje ahet them chun ipi aphat chomsah mong ham?

tcz: Na nei lou na ngaichat sang in, nanei chunga lunglhaijon. Thilpha thilhoi nei nomna lunggel kiti hi aphat chomna bei kidel tobang ahi.
en_web: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
en_kjv: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Pannabei she, hui lenglai mat go bep ahi. I-khat ngaicha jinga um sanga nanei lung lhaipi chu thil phajo ahi.

tcz: Thil ijakai hohi kigong tupsa ngen ahiuve. Mi khat cheh hi ipi ahi ding’u tona kigong sapeh ahi tauve. Hijeh chun natonsot khankho ding chung chang thua jong Pathen nanel kallou ding ahi.
en_web: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.
en_kjv: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh jouse hi aso masanga gontohsa ahitan, mihemin asanga hatjo akinelpi thei lou jong ihecheh-ui.

tcz: Thu naha seitam chan-a ima phachomlou ahi. Ahileh hiche ho chu ipi phachom em?
en_web: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?
en_kjv: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakinelpi sot chan a pha mo cheh ahin, phatchom nan naneideh poi.

tcz: I-hinlonau pannabei nikho phabep sunga hi, i-hin nikhou hi iti kimang hoi thei pen ding ham ti koiyin ahet nem? I-hinkhou hi lelim tobangbep ahi. I-che nung tenguleh hiche leisetna hi ipi ahung lhung ding koiyin aseithei jem?
en_web: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?
en_kjv: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa lim banga kihei mang loi, hiche pannabei hinkho chomcha sunga hi mihemin ahinkho dia thilpha iti akihet thei ding ham? Athi nung teng leiset’a thilsoh ding kon ija ahet thei ding ham?

tcz: Minphatna kimu hi gimnam tuipen sang in jong amanlu joi. Chule napen nikho sang in jong nathi nikho phajoa ahi.
en_web: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.
en_kjv: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one’s birth.
tcz_gospelgo: Min phat hi thao namtui sangin aphajon, napen nikho sangin nathi in aphajoi.

tcz: Thina kin’a kimanchah hi golnop bolna mun’a gache sangin aphajoi. Ahimongin, mitin kithi ding ahijeh'in, mihingin hiche hi alunga agel ding doltah ahi.
en_web: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
en_kjv: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Golvah na in a lhah sangin lunghemna in a che aphajoi, ajeh chu mihing jousen athi ding sumil louvin aum theiye.

tcz: Lungkham hi muilhah sangin aphajoi, ajeh chu lungkham na hin i-chunga kisuhthengna ahin sodohji ahi.
en_web: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.
en_kjv: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
tcz_gospelgo: Nui sangin lungkham aphajoi; maiso hoimo sah jongle, lungthim he themna apetheijoi.

tcz: Miching khat chun thina chung chang hi aha gel’in ahi, hinlah mingol vang chun phatpha muding bou ageljin ahi.
en_web: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
en_kjv: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nopsah ding jeng gel mihem chu a-ngol’ah ahi. Michingin thina bou agelkhoh-e.

tcz: Mi ngol khat in apachat hisang in, miching khat oimo chan apha joi.
en_web: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.
en_kjv: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngolten navahchoi la sah sangun, naphoh ding miching nanei aphajoi.

tcz: Mi ngol nuijatna chu lingphung meiyin akah gin kija tobang ahin, imacha kah louvin aki chai jitai.
en_web: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.
en_kjv: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol nuigin chu linghema belto kihet tobang ahin, ajeh apol beihel ahibouve.

tcz: Miching chu aki-engbol teng angol lojin, chule guhthim thilpeh hin lungthim asuhmo bepji ahi.
en_web: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
en_kjv: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingin mi alepthol teng ngolchon ahitai. Nehguh nalah teng naming phat kisuhmang nahi.

tcz: Achaina hi apatna sang in apha jon chule kiletsah sang in, thohhat aphachom joi.
en_web: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
en_kjv: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil ijakai akipatna sangin akichina aphajoi. Kiletsah sangin thoh hat aphajoi.

tcz: Lunghan kitim them in, ajeh chu lunghan hin angoltoh kibang bep naso ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
en_kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung han gloi hih-inl lung ul jing hi ngol thubuh bou ahi.

tcz: “Achesa nikho phaho chu ngaicha gunset hih in, hichu mi chinga ahi poi.”
en_web: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.
en_kjv: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not inquire wisely concerning this.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih-in jong, “Itia tulai sanga masanga thil phajo ham?” tin sei hih hel’in. Hiche hi chih hoi thudoh ahipoi.

tcz: Sum nanei teng leh chihna hi phachom cheh ahi. Hinkhoa kho-sahna dinga ania phachom tah ahi.
en_web: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
en_kjv: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihing jouse chih lom tah ahi; chihna hi gou kilamdoh tobang ahin,

tcz: Chihna le sum hin ipi hijongleh nanei sah jeng thei ahinai. Hinlah chihna kiti bouhin na hinkho ahuhhing jou ding ahije.
en_web: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.
en_kjv: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
tcz_gospelgo: sumin asemdoh thei banga lungmon napethei ahi. Chihnan nahoidoh sah thei ding ahi-hiche hi hetna phat chomna ahi.

tcz: Pathen thilbol ho chu janom jeng in, ajeh chu aman ahe konsa chu koiyin asuh-jang jou ding ham?
en_web: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?
en_kjv: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thilbolsa gel’in.Pathenin asemkonsa chu kon ahejang thei ding ham?

tcz: Ning lhinga naum laisen kipah’in, hinlah hahsatnan nahinphah teng jongleh, ania Pathenna hungkon ahiti tahsan in. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin ima hiti mong ding ahiti, akisei thei poi kiti hi geldoh jing in.
en_web: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.
en_kjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil ijakai aphat thei pet le kipah-in, gim hesoh hung lhun teng, nopna le gimna Pathen a kon gel ahi geldoh-in; akit teng thilsoh ding ipi ahi nahepoi.

tcz: Keiman hinlona ajeh umlou tobangbep leiset hinkhoa hin, khangdong phatah tah ho athia chule migilou ho hinkho asot’uhi kamu doh in ahi.
en_web: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.
en_kjv: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pannabei kahinkho sung hin thil ijakai kamusoh tai; mipha thi thi jeng thei, migilou hing hing jeng thei ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun mohphat behset hih in, ahilouva ahileh chingval behset hih in! Idia nangmatah kisumang ding nahi ham?
en_web: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
en_kjv: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun phat behseh le chih behseh bol dan-idia nang le nang nakitha ding ham?

tcz: Chutima chun gilou behset jong bol hih in. Ngol hih beh in! Ipi dinga naphat lhin masanga thi ding nahim?
en_web: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
en_kjv: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
tcz_gospelgo: Engset val le ngol val jong boldan-idia naphat masanga nathi ding ham?

tcz: Hiche kihil naho hi lunggut in gel in, ajeh chu koi hitaleh Pathen ging mi chun; hitobang che valna hi ania hintoh ponte.
en_web: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
en_kjv: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonval tho dan. Hougut nahile lolhing thouvin nate.

tcz: Khopi sunga lamkai mi som sangin, miching khat chu gamcheng in ahat joi.
en_web: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
en_kjv: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaipo som khat’in khopi khat akithopi sangin, chihna hin mi ahatsah joi.

tcz: Leiset chunga hin mihem khatcha aphajeng bol chonse kha louhel aumpoi.
en_web: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
en_kjv: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a hin bol khel neilou thildih bol jing koima aumpoi.

tcz: Mi thusei jouse het ding go hih in, nasoh jeng in jong na gaosap get in nate.
en_web: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;
en_kjv: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi sei jouse ngai hih-in, nasoh pan nahoutom na jong jadoh get’in nate.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma tah jeng in jong midang na gaosap ji chu na henai.
en_web: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.
en_kjv: for oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin jong tamtah vei midang nahoutom nakihet chu me.

tcz: Keiman kajo channa chihna in kalunggel le kachonna eilamkai jing na ding in ka ngai ton ahi. Keimatah in kaseijin, “Keima chingthei ding in ka kigel lha tai.” Hinlah ka chuti theijou hihbeh in ahi.
en_web: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
en_kjv: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihnan hicheng hi kapatep soh tai. Chih ding kago lheh nan sophan hoi ahipoi.

tcz: Chihna hi gamlatah’a aum jing in chule holdoh jong ahah sai.
en_web: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
en_kjv: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
tcz_gospelgo: Hinkho umje dol hedoh jou ding koiham? Eiho din athuh val’in, hetdoh hahsa tah ahi.

tcz: Keiman muntina chun, chihna le hetkhenna chu iti hung umhija ham tin ajeh kahol in ahi. Keima tah in kholchilna neija konin gitlouna hi ngol jeh ahin, chule ngol kitihi lung chavai kiseina ahije, tiphot chenna kanei ahi tai.
en_web: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.
en_kjv: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle het ding gultenin sim kagon; chihna holdoh tei kagon, kahetnom cheng donbutna mudoh a, ngolna phatmo dan mong mong photchet ding kagoi.

tcz: Keiman kavet chil’a ahileh, duha-thuhtah numei chu thitheina thangkol sanga khohse joa ahichu ka kholdoh ahitai. Ami hebol jong kipalna thangkol bep ahi, chule akhut nemtah jong chu kihenna thihkol ahibouve. Pathen lunglhaina’a umho chu amanua kon’a hoidoh ding, hinlah chonse ho chu amanu thanga ga-oh ding ahiuve.
en_web: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.
en_kjv: and I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin thina sanga khohjo khat kamudoh-e. Hichu numei ahi. Numeiyin nadeichat teng thangkam kilhopel khah le khaova kihen nabah ding ahi; numeiyin nakoichah den teng thih khaova kihen bang bang hin nate. Pathen lung deiya chonpa vang jam doh nan tin, chonsepa vang oh den ding ahitai.

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, “Hiche hi keiman hoima lamjouse ahitheina ding kavet toh lea konna achaina kasem chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation
en_kjv: Behold, this have I found, saith the Preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
tcz_gospelgo: Michingthempan aseiyin, thil ijakai kakhol tohnaa kona hiche hi athem thema kamudoh ahi, tin aseiye.

tcz: Keiman kavel hol hol jeng vang'in, ka hol lona pentah chu kamu joupoi. Mi sangkhat lah’a khatbou gunchena nei pasal khat ahijouvin, hinlah numei khat jong akimu joupoi.
en_web: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.
en_kjv: which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
tcz_gospelgo: Thildang kahol vangin khatcha jong kamudohpoi. Pasal sang khat lah a jabol theidol khat bou kamun, numei khatcha jong kamupoi.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche hi kamui: Pathen’in miho hi gun chena neija asem ahin, hinlah amahon achang cheh-uva aphalou akilam doh-u ahibouve.
en_web: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
en_kjv: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi kasimdoh ahi; Pathenin baikhen cha eisemdoh-u ahin, eiho le eiho kisunoh den ahiuve.

tcz: Chihna neihi iti kidan hitam, thil ho geltohna neija chule ipi kiseina ahi phongdoh chihna hin, mihem amai avahsah in lungkhohna asunem theije.
en_web: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
en_kjv: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingin bou thil ho umdol ahethem’e. Chihnan mail lhaisel’in aumsah-in, amelse aselpeh theiye.

tcz: Nangman Pathen thua nung dinga nakitepna dung jui chun lengpa thu thun nung in.
en_web: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
en_kjv: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa sei sei bol’in, geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna neiloi hihin.

tcz: Natoh ding kin bollou ding in kigo hih in, chule lungthim phalou gongho tojong pan lakhom hih beh-in, ajeh chu lengpan abolnom nom abolthei ahije.
en_web: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
en_kjv: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpan abolnom nom abol thei ahi, hijeh chun a-angsunga konin potdoh loiyin, tijat umtah mun ahin umsot dan.

tcz: Athupeh chu thaneina in ajuijin, koima ananjou dingleh ipi dinga hitia nabol ham tia seithei ding aum poi.
en_web: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
en_kjv: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Thuneina neiya lengpa thil bol ahin, athilbol phoh ngam aumpoi.

tcz: Athua nungho chun talen man pouvinte. Miching ho chun adih bolna ding phat ahaimil pouvin chule abolje ahet tei ding’u ahi.
en_web: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
en_kjv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupeh nanit chan a nadia pha, michingin bou itih a ipi bol ding akihet thieye.

tcz: Ajeh chu thil ijakai bolna ding phat le bolje hetna phat mikhat chun hahsatna ato teng jongleh amuji ahi.
en_web: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
en_kjv: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil ijakai hi adih a bol phat umcheh ahi, eihon imacha ihepouve!

tcz: Ahimong in, ipi hunglhung ding ahi hephalou mipi chun iti hichu apel thei diu hitam?
en_web: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
en_kjv: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
tcz_gospelgo: Thil hungsoh dingla ihepouvin, eiseipeh theiyu jong koima aumpoi.

tcz: I-lah’uva ithi diu nikho atuhtang thei ium pouve. Hiche muthim galsatna, ito diu hi ahoidohna ding aum poi.
en_web: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.
en_kjv: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima thilou thei aumpon, nathina ding nikho vochon thei jong aumpoi. Hiche hi ijamdoh thei lou nau galmun ahi; lepthol’in jamdoh theipoute.

tcz: Hiche nipi noija che jinga, chal jinga um miho chun khat le khat kisuh khah tona aneiyu hi lunggil tah in kangaiton ahi.
en_web: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.
en_kjv: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya thil kibol n akitong chengse kagel gelle hicheng hi kamudoh-e, vannoiya hin mihem thanei phabep noiya adangsen gim hesoh athoh-e.

tcz: Keiman migilou ho jabol tah’a akivui kamui. Hinlah amaho hi houin sunga chu kijomtah’a athilbol phalouvu umna mun ma’a chun jabolna achanguve! Hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobangbep ahi kit’e.
en_web: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.
en_kjv: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahimonge, migiloute thia lhana akivui kamun, lhanphunga konin in lam jot pet’in, masanga thilse tampi abolnau khopia mihon, migilou kavuisa ho pachatna thu aseiyui. Hiche hi mohseh mong ahi.

tcz: Asukhel chu gimbolna akipeh paiji louva ahileh, miho chun thilse bol ding in ahung kitil khou doh jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
en_kjv: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi dia mipin thilse amoh bol bol jeng ham? Thilse bolte talen kimatsah vah vah loujeh ahi.

tcz: Hinlah mikhat chun chonset javei jen bol hen lang chule sotpi hing nalai henlang hijongleh, Pathen gingho dingin aphajo cheh ahiti, keiman kahei.
en_web: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
en_kjv: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
tcz_gospelgo: Chonsen thilse ja khat cheng bol jongle ahing thei thei nalaiye. Hiche hon asei kahedoh tai, “Pathen thu nanit pou le ima tiponte,

tcz: Migilouho chu lolhing lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Pathen ginna anei pouve. Nilhah lam lim tobangbep’in ahinkhou sotponte.
en_web: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
en_kjv: but it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang migilouvin hoidohna neiponte. Ahinkhou la nisa lim kihei bep, Pathenthu angai loujeh-uva donthi diu ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chule hiche hi i-chen nau vannoi leisetna ajehbeija ahideh poi. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin miphaho jong chu migilouho bolla akibol kom aum jiuvin, chule migilouho hi miphatah bolla akibol nau jong aumjie. Hiche jong hi ajehbei tobangbep chu ahi.
en_web: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
en_kjv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hiche hi ngol thubuh ahi. Vannoiya ipi soh tam; abang kom le midih-in migiloutalen mat ding amanin, migilouvin midih kipaman san ding asange. Hijeh chun pannabeiyin kaseiye.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman nuijat’umna chu ka phatsah’in ahi, ajeh chu mihon aneh uva, adon uva chule hinkho akipa thanoppi diu hi kaphat sahpeh ahi. Hitia chu Pathen’in amaho chu nipi noija ana tohgim nauva kon kipana khat anei theina diu ahi.
en_web: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
en_kjv: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Min nom asah ding bou dihjon kageltai; ajeh chu ahinkho lung nopna pen chu aneh a adon a nomsa um ding hi adeipen ahi. Hiche beh hi vannoiya Pathenin apeh hinkho anei laisunga abol thei ahi.

tcz: Keiman chihna kaholna’a hin, chule hiche vannoi leiset chunga miho pohgih poh kavet jingna’a hin, keiman kakholdoh chu sunle janna kichol tih um louva kho-sahna ka mudoh in ahi.
en_web: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
en_kjv: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
tcz_gospelgo: Kichihsah a vannoiya thilsoh hetdoh kagot chanin, sun le jan a hah khovah vah, tou nilhum thei nahi,

tcz: Keiman kahetdoh chu mihem koimachan Pathen’in nipi noija anatohdoh chu akholdoh joulou ding ahi, tihi ahi. Mihem koima chan ipi seijong leh miching penho jengin jong ijakai akholdoh joulou diu ahi.
en_web: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
en_kjv: then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further, though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thilbol khat beh nahetdoh thei louhel ding kahedoh tai. Itobanga khohsah-in gut jongle chun mudoh jou deh pon nate. Michingten het go nauvin tin, hedeh pouvinte.

tcz: Hiche jonghi keiman chingthei tah in ka khol in: Pathen ngaisah hole miching ho jong Pathen khutna uma ahiuvin, amaho hi Pathen’in ahepi ding hinauvem ti koima ahetoh’a aumpoi.
en_web: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
en_kjv: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thudol hi sopi le giltah-in kagel’in, Pathenin michingte le midihte natoh thilbol jouse athu nunin, angailut nau le amihot nau geiyin athu thun ahei theiye. Mihem koiman amsanga thilsoh ding ahepoi.

tcz: Mi tinin atonsot mun diu ngah jinga uma ahiuve, michonpha hihen, migilou hijong leh, mipha hihen, miphalou hijongleh, athenga kigel ho hiuhen, athenglou hijongleu, hou ngaisah hihen, hou ngaisahlou hijongleh, mipha hon jong michonse ho bangma’a Pathen’a kitepna neiho jong kitepna neilouho toh kithakhatma ahije.
en_web: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
en_kjv: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
tcz_gospelgo: Imacha akikhenna aumpoi. Midih le migilou, mipha l emiphalou, hougut le houbei, kilhaina thilto pe jingle pelou-kibanga thi cheh diu ahi.Mi chonse sangin mipha aphachom deh pon; kihahsel bolpa jong abol loupa sangin apha dehpoi.

tcz: Amitakip nipi noija umho jouse chan kibanga athiltou hi lungdon umtah ahi. Hitobang hohin thilpha bolbe nadinga ching thei lou’uva ahi. Chusang in amahon angol nau joh chu aki deilhen uve, ajeh chu amaho kinepna neilou ahiuve. Amasang uva imacha dang umlou thina bou chu uma ahi.
en_web: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
en_kjv: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi jouse kibanga thi cheh diu ahin, hiche jeng jong hi vannoiya thilsoh lah a dih lou thou thou ahi. Mihemte ahin leisen alung sungu thilse le ngolna dim, het man louva thiji ahiuve.

tcz: Mihing ding in kinepna bou aum’e. Ama hon asei uvin, “Uicha hing chu keipi thisa sangin aphachom joi.”
en_web: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
en_kjv: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang mihing gamsunga cheng chun kinepna phabep aneiteiye; uicha hin ghcu sakei thisa sangin aphachom’e.

tcz: Mihngho chun athi diu beh akihet’uvin, hinlah athisa hon imacha ahe tapouve.
en_web: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
en_kjv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahing’an thi ding akihet’in, athisan vang ima ahetapoi. Kipaman san ding jong anei tapouvin, koiman ageldoh tapouve.

tcz: Amahon ahinkhouva ipi hijongleh abholchanu chu ki-ngailut, ki-thet, ki-mitthip abonna achemangsa ahitai. Amahon hiche leiset chunga hin bolbe ding anei tapouve.
en_web: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
en_kjv: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Angailutnau le ahotnau, alung gul’u aboncha thi tha ahitauve. Hiche vannoiya thilsoh lah a pang kit louhel ding ahitauve.

tcz: Hijeh chun na-an chu kipah thanomtah in nen, chule na-lengpitwi chu lung kipah pum in don in, ajeh chu Pathen’in hichu aphatsah ahi.
en_web: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
en_kjv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
tcz_gospelgo: Chen kipah thanomin an kineh-in;lengpitwi kidonin lang kisuhal’in. Pathen din aphanai.

tcz: Von hoipen chun kivon in, chule lou namtui chu kinu-in.
en_web: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
en_kjv: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
tcz_gospelgo: Halpel’in thanom jing jengin.

tcz: Numei nangailutnu chuto nipi noija Pathen’in napeh nahinkho umpet chun kipahtah in hing khom in. Najia nanei chuto phaten hingkhom lhon in.
en_web: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
en_kjv: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya Pathenin pannabei hinkho naneisah sungsen nadeitah naji to nomsa lhonin. Pannabei nikho ho hi nomsan mangin, hibou chu nacholman ahibep’e.

tcz: Nabol chan chu hoitah’in bol tan. Ajeh chu nangma lhankhuh’a na chetengleh natoh ding um talou ding, tohgon jong um talou ding, hetna jeng jong umta pontin, chihna geija bei ding ahitai.
en_web: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
en_kjv: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
tcz_gospelgo: Natoh chan thakhen louhel’in tongin, ajeh chu nachena ding noimigama chun toh dingle lunggel, hetna le chihna jong abeitai.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija adang chom khat jong ka mudoh’e. Lhaija hat penpan jong kipaman amu jing ahipoi, chule galsatna hatpenpa jeng jong chu galjona chang jing ahipoi. Miching jong chu kelthoh’a avale jipet aum in, chule khut them hon jong lungkimna amudeh pouve. Chule lekhathem tahho jong chu lolhinna hinkho mang jinga ahipouve. Hiche ho jouse hi vang'in apohji ahin, hitia chu aphatcha amuna gatoh kha kiti ahi.
en_web: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
en_kjv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahetdoh kit thil khat chu-vannoiya hin lhai hatpa jengin jong kilhai tet ajoudeh pon, gal-hangpan jong gal ajo jing ahideh poi. Michingin neh le chah akimuchom a, lungthim chingin haona anei chom a, atongthempan tohmun sang alo chom deh ahipoi. Mitinin toset atoh cheh theiye.

tcz: Itobang phat hahsa hunglhung ding ahi koima asei theija aum poi. Ngalen sung’a um vacha athangkol sunga um tobang'in miho chu phulou helouvin hamset nan apha jiuve.
en_web: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
en_kjv: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
tcz_gospelgo: Itih a i-nati ding phat nakihetpoi. Hetman louva vacha thang-oh bang le, nga len a kijeldoh tobanga igel loupet tah-uva phat gilou khat’a oh denji ahiuve.

tcz: Hichea hin chihna themkhat keima vannoi khosah dan hin eilung lut sah aume.
en_web: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
en_kjv: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:

tcz: Khopi neocha khat asunga cheng mijong themkhat bou ahiuve, chule leng lentah khat chu asepai hotoh ahung un, khopi chu aum kimvel tauve.
en_web: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
en_kjv: there was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem tam beh lou chenna, khopi neo thim khat aum’e. Leng thanei tah khat hin adel khumtai. Khopi chu aum chah kheh-in, pal voh chim din agoi.

tcz: Mivaicha, michingtah khat chun hiche khopi chu iti huhdoh ding ahi ahen, chule hitichun huhdoh in aumtai. Hinlah hiche jou chun koima chan akoma kipa thu aseipouve.
en_web: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
en_kjv: now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sunga hin mi vaicha, ahivanga khopi huhdoh theina khop a ching khat acheng’e. Ahinla koiman ama chu iman agelpoi.

tcz: Hiti chun, chihna hi thahat sanga aphatjoh vang'in, miching chu avaichatleh mi nahsahmo achang e. Athuseidoh ho chu kipapi sotna koiman anei poi.
en_web: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
en_kjv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken kaei jing chu-chihna hi thahat sanga phachomjo ahin, hijongle koiman vaichapa chu michingin agelpon, asei jong koiman ngaisah-in aneippoi.

tcz: Leng ngolpa kisen aw jahsang in michingpan olcha thu asei jah nom aum joi.
en_web: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
en_kjv: The words of wise men are heard in quiet, more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngolte kikhopnaa lengpa kisen gin ngai sangin, thip beh cha miching houlim ngai aphajoi.

tcz: Galman chah hoa kivon kichei sang in chih thujah apha joi. Hinlah michonse khat chun apha tampi asuh mang thei joh ahi.
en_web: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
en_kjv: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
tcz_gospelgo: Chihnan gal manchah kimang sangin na ahatoh jon, ahin chonse khat’in thilpha tampi bolsa asuse theiye.

tcz: Gimnamtui bom chu thoulhe thisa ho uijin anamset sah jeng theijin, chuto bangma chun kingolsahna mai maijin chihna le jabolna sangtah chu mohseh asosah theije.
en_web: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
en_kjv: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
tcz_gospelgo: Thicheng phung thoulhen thao namtui kithe jong a-uisah theiyin, ngolna them khat’in chihna loupitah tah asumang hel theiye.

tcz: Miching theijin lamdih akilhen in, angol in adihlou chu aki lhen’e.
en_web: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
en_kjv: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand; but a fool’s heart at his left.
tcz_gospelgo: Michingin thildih bol’a, mi-ngol’in thildih lou bol hi chon ngai dol mong ahi.

tcz: Nangman mingol ho chu lamsuh akijot nauva nahetdoh jeng thei ahi.
en_web: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
en_kjv: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngol ngolna chu hephah lou lampi dunga akitopin jong ahedoh theiye; aman angol chu mitin ahetsah jin ahi.

tcz: Na vaihompa chu na chunga alunglhai louva ahileh mohthip san hih in! Thipkhen cha kitohpa chun asuhkhel lentah jong asem hoi thei ahi.
en_web: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
en_kjv: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunga vaipon nalung han teng, haina lekha peh dan; umthim beh le chun bol khel melse tah geiya ngaidam um thei ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija aphalou chombeh khat ka mudoh in ahi. Lengho le vaihom hon suhkhelna hoise tah aboldoh jiuve.
en_web: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
en_kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya hin thil dohlou-vaihomten thil dih lou tah abol’u kamudoh tai.

tcz: Amahon mingol ho thuneina len apeh doh’uva chule athunei dinga kilom tah ho asuhnem jiuhi ahi.
en_web: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
en_kjv: folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi-ngolte panmun len lai lai apeuvin, mihao ho nahsah louvin aumsah tauve.

tcz: Keiman soh ho jeng jong chu sakol chunga leng chapate tobanga atoudoh’u, chule leng chapate ho chu sohho tobanga lam ajotnu kamu tai.
en_web: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
en_kjv: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh ho sakol chunga touvin, milen milal ho kengin acheuvin ahi.

tcz: Twikul nalai tengleh na lhahlut thei ahi. Chule banglui chu nang in naphetlhah teng leh gul-in jong na chuh thei ahi.
en_web: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
en_kjv: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh a hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
tcz_gospelgo: Khuh laile chun nang lhalut’in natin, pal tumjal le chun gul’in nachuh ding ahi.

tcz: Song ima laiya nakon tengleh, song hungchima nalhuh khum thei ahi. Nang in thing natan tengleh, na heiga chun thing phata atan thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
en_kjv: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
tcz_gospelgo: Songtum tangle chun songin nasekhah ding ahi. Thing ehle chun thinghal’in nasekhah ding ahi.
