tcz: Chuin Babylon lengpan Hamath gam a Riblah mun’a athat gamtai. Hitobang chun Judah chu ama gam'a konin sohchangin aki kaimang tan ahi.
en_web: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
en_kjv: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

tcz: Nubuchadnezzarin alengchan kal kum sagi in soh chang a akaimang miho sangthum le somni le thum ahi.
en_web: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;
en_kjv: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

tcz: Chujouvin Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum som le getna in Jerusalem’a mi jaget le somthum le ni akai mangbe in ahi.
en_web: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;
en_kjv: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

tcz: Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum som ni le thum kumin sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan asol in Judah te jasagi le somli lang ahinkai in, abonun mi sang li le jagup ahiuve.
en_web: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.
en_kjv: in the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

tcz: Kum somthum le sagi lhinna Judah lengpa Jehoiachin soh chan kal Lhakao somthum le khat hiche kum chun Evil Merodach Babylon lengpa dinmun chu alotai. Judah lengpa Jehoiachin chu khoto manin songkul’ a konin alhadoh tai
en_web: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

tcz: Jehoiachin hepitah –in, sohchang khom leng dang ho sang in jong jana len cheh achansah in ahi.
en_web: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
en_kjv: and spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

tcz: Asohchanna vonho akhelpeh-in, ahinkho lhum keiyin lengpa dokhang ankong anejom jingpeh tan ahi.
en_web: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.
en_kjv: and changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

tcz: Chule aneh le chah dingin Babylon lengpa athini geijin tanglouvin ape jing tan ahi.
en_web: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
en_kjv: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

tcz: Phatkhat mi ana dimsetna Jerusalem khopi chu tunvang kho gem a sodoh tai. Chitin namtin laha ana minthang khopi chu tunvang meithai a sodoh tan ahi. Vannoi leiset lengnu dinmun ana lo chu tunvang soh dinmun alo jotai.
en_web: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!
en_kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! How is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, And princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

tcz: Jan khovah vah'in mitlhi long chutchut in akap in ana ngailu cheng holah a jong alhamon ding aum tapouvin aloi agol chengse la aheodah leh adou gal in apang gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.
en_kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: Among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

tcz: Galhingin Judah akai taovin soh channa leh engbolna athoh tan ahi. Gam dang nammite laha achengun kicholdona mun amujou pouvin ahi. Agalmite uvin a umkimvel’un jamdoh thei louvin akoichah tauve.
en_web: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
en_kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: She dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: All her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

tcz: Jerusalem lampiho akhul lhatan koi macha Pathen houna kin bol dingin ahung doh tapouvin, khopi kotpihola donlouvin aumgamtan athempu hou akhoisa gam tauvin anungah khangthah teu akhankho diu gelnan akap gam tauve.
en_web: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
en_kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: All her gates are desolate: her priests sigh: Her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

tcz: A sugenthei houhi a Pakaiyun apang un ajalou teuchu akhantou tul tul jengun ahi. Pakaiyin achonset jih uva Jerusalem chu aengbol uva achateo galhinga kiman a gamla tah’a kikaimang gamu ahitauve.
en_web: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.
en_kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; For the Lord hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: Her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

tcz: Jerusalem khopi, ahoinale aloupina chu amang thah ahi tai. Alamkaiteu jong neh ding ham hing mu joulou sakhigol toh abang gam tauvin, agalmiteo masanga jam doh nading tha jong anei jou tapouve.
en_web: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.
en_kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: Her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, And they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

tcz: Lung lengvaija Jerusalem avale laitahin, tumasanga aphatlai nikho agel doh’e. Tunla agalmite khutnoija aum tan koimacha apanhu ding aum tapoi. Agalmiteuvin ajep lhu’uvin alhu ho chu aveuvin anuisat’un ahi.
en_web: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.
en_kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries All her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, When her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: The adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

tcz: Achonset behseh jeh'in Jerusalem ponse bangin paimangin aumtan. Tumasanga anagel thupi hon, tuhin anoisetauve, ajehchu aponu kiho-lhah peha jumle jachat thoha um ahitaove. Hijeh chun hahdoh ngamlou hella khoisa jing jenga um ahitai.
en_web: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
en_kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: All that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: Yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

tcz: Amaho hin a khonung diu kigel phah louhelin jonthanhoina in akisuhboh uve. Amaho a kemsuh jing tauvin, a lhamon diu aphong ding diu koima aum tapoi. Pakai ka hahsetnao nei vetpeh un tin akap tauve.
en_web: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, LORD, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”
en_kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; Therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.

tcz: Galmiten ajokhophelun anei jouseu akichom tauve. Pakaiyin a Hou-in sunga lut dia anaphallou nam dangte chun ahouin sungu asuh boh pehu chu amudoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.
en_kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: For she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, Whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

tcz: Amiteu nehding hollin apeng jen jun tauvin, a hinjouna diuvin anei agouvu ajohdohun, vo Pakai neihin veuvin e-chan geija thet le kidah’a ka um’u hitam tin akap tauve.
en_web: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, LORD, and see, for I have become despised.”
en_kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; They have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: See, O Lord, and consider; for I am become vile.

tcz: Vo chele vahle, hilang hin hopa ho hiche thilsoh hi ija na gellou u-ham? Pathenin ka chunguva alunghan abuhlhah nale eibol gimnau hi vetem uvin.
en_web: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which the LORD has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
en_kjv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see If there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, Wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

tcz: Aman vanna konin meikong ahin sep lhan kagu kachang’u ahalgo tai. Aman ka lampi uva thang a kamin eile hoitauve. Aman eichom thengselun nilhum lhumin hahsatna eithoh sahun ahi.
en_web: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.
en_kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: He hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back; He hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

tcz: Ka chonsetnao khaovin eikanun sohchanna nam kolin eihenun ahi. Pakaiyin katha’u eisuh ngoi pehun kagal miteu komah eipedohun akhutuva chatmon ka um taove.
en_web: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
en_kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: They are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

tcz: Pakaiyin kalah'uva um kami hatteu thaneina asulhan kakhang thahteo suhmangna dingin galmite amangchan ahi, Pakaiyin lengpithei chilna akisuhchip bangin akhopi hoitah chu a suchip tan ahi.
en_web: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.
en_kjv: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: He hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: The Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

tcz: Hicheho jouse jeh'in kakapin kamitlhi kamaija alonglha jenjung jingin ahinlah koima eilhamon ding le eitilhembi ding aum pon ahi. Galmiten eijou khup del tauvin, kakhang thahte’u khonung ding jong abing tan ahi.
en_web: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”
en_kjv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, Because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

tcz: Jerusalemin panpi ngaiyin akhut alhang dohin ahinlah apanpi ding amu joupoi. Pakaiyin Ami Isrealte chunga, aheng akom ho chu agalmi asohdoh pehhan! Ama ho hi ponse banga paimanga um ahitai.
en_web: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. The LORD has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.
en_kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: The Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

tcz: Jerusalemin aseiyin Pakai hi adih’e, ajeh chu keiman ama dounan na kana tong’e, chitin namtinin ka thusei hi neingai pehun, ka thoh gimna hi neihet pehun, ka chanute’u leh ka chapate’u khol gamla taha galhingin eikaimang peh tauve.
en_web: “The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
en_kjv: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: Hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

tcz: Keiman kaloi kagolte koma kithopina kathumin amahonla eingai peh pouve. Ka themputeu leh ka lamkaiteu khopi sung’a kelin athi gam tauve, ahinkhou kihuhdohna ding aholun amu jou pove.
en_web: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
en_kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: My priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, While they sought their meat, to relieve their souls.

tcz: Pakai kalung lengvaina neivetpehin, ka chonset jeh'in ka lungthim ahesoh’e, kholai dung’a kitha tona aumin insung lang’a thilong aki jam’e.
en_web: “Look, LORD; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.
en_kjv: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; Mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

tcz: Ka lung gim ka khoisatna mitam tahin eijah pehin ahinlah koima chan eihung lhamon pon ahi. Ka galmiten kathoh gimna ajah phatun Pakai nangin neibolnao hi akipa piuvin ahi. Oh Pakai keiho thoh tobang banga amaho nathohsah dinga naseipihnao nikhochu lhunsah loiyin.
en_web: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.
en_kjv: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me: All mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: Thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

tcz: Pakai ka chonsetnao jeh'a nei engbol bangu chun amahon eibolsetnao hi venlang amahojong engbolin. Ka lengvainao hi atamvalin ka lungthim sung’u asuna lheh jeng’e.
en_web: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
en_kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; And do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

tcz: Pakai alunghan jal'in Jerusalem khopi hoitah chu muthim lhangkhalin atome. Isreal khopi hoi jouse vutvam asoh gam tan, vanchung sanga konin selhah in a um’e. Pakai a lunghan behseh jeh in ahou in jeng jong khoto na anei tapoi.
en_web: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
en_kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, And cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, And remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

tcz: Khotona beihel in Pakaiyin Isreal insung jouse a subeiyin, a lunghan nan Jerusalem kulpi len jouse a suchip gam’e. Aman aleng gam ule alengteu jong jum tahin tol jep nan anei gam tai.
en_web: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
en_kjv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: He hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; He hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

tcz: Pakai lunghan na noi a Isreal thaneina jouse a mangthah gam tai. Galmi ten ahin delkhum nauva jong a huhdoh tapon ahi. Aman Isreal gam pumpi chu meikong in ahal lhah bang in ahal gam tan ahi.
en_web: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.
en_kjv: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: He hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, And he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

tcz: Aman agalmite bangin amite chung a athalpi kaosan akoiyin, agollhang hoilai jouse thagam ding in atha aje doh in ahi. Loupitah Jerusalem chunga alunghan na meikong bangin abunglhan ahi.
en_web: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.
en_kjv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, And slew all that were pleasant to the eye, In the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

tcz: Pakaiyin Isrealte hi agalmi bang in a suhchip in, Aman loupitah Jerusalem chunga lungkham nale mitlhilon angahna beijin alhun khum sah’e.
en_web: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.
en_kjv: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, He hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, And hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

tcz: Aman houin jong honsunga buh kisa bang in a sulhun, Pakaiyin anikho thengho ahin, cholngah nikhoho le kut nikho thengho ahin suhmil thei leuvin asubei jin leng hole thempu ho jong a lungsat na noija a subei gam tan ahi.
en_web: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. The LORD has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.
en_kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: The Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, And hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

tcz: Pakaiyin amaicham jeng jong a nuse in, amuntheng jeng jong nahsah louvin akoiyin, Jerusalem lengpa inpi ho jong galmiho a pedoh’e. Amahon Pakai houin sung chu golnop kibolni bangin, o’thongje jun apoh chei choi jengun ahi.
en_web: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the LORD’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
en_kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, He hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; They have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.

tcz: Khopi hoitah Jerusalem chu apal jouse suhlhah ding angaiton, aman atoh gon bang bang in a sulhu soh tan ahi. Hijeh chun pal hole palvum jouse jong amasanga alhusoh tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.
en_kjv: The Lord hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: He hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: Therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

tcz: Jerusalem kelkot phung jouse jong tol ah aki jamchap soh helin, akel kot gol jouse jong aheh bongin a sumang soh tai. Jerusalem lengpa leh milen milal ho jong namtin vaipi laha akithe thangsoh taove. Danthu kitila abeitan Themgao hon jong Pakaiya konin mu anei tapouve.
en_web: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
en_kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; Her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.

tcz: Khopi hoitah Jerusalem sunga lamkaiho tolla thip beh chan atouvun, a lujang uva leivui a kinuvin, khaodip pon akisil un, Jerusalem nungah jousen jum le jachat tothon a kaiku jeng taove.
en_web: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
en_kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: They have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

tcz: Kamitlhi twi kan tokahin ka kap jingin, ka lungsung achip lhatai. Kholai dunga chapang neocha ho athileh aki saisaijuva, kamite hahsatna khankho ka mu jeh in ka lungthim sung jong akap doh jeng in ahi.
en_web: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
en_kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, My liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; Because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

tcz: Anuteu henga, Nehding le donding kangaichai tin athumun. Galsatpa galmunna akimavo bangin, kholai dunga thabeiyin apengun, anu teuvin apom nau chunga ahinkho’u abeithu thu jeng in ahi.
en_web: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
en_kjv: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? When they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

tcz: Hichan geija lungkhamna toh ho chunga ipi kasei thei ding ham? Vo Jerusalem Chanute, na lung hesoh naohi ipitoh kitekah ding ahm? Oh Zion chanu thengte iti ka lhamon jou ding na hiuvem? Ajeh chu nathoh gimnao hi twikhanglen bangin athuh jengin koiham na boldam jou diu vah?
en_web: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
en_kjv: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

tcz: Na themgao teuvinla jouthu ngen leh ngolhoi thu ngen na seipeh uvin, na soh chan nauva konna nahung kiledoh theina diuva na chonsetnau phondoh peh ding la ago pouvin, chutia bolsang in jouthu ngen jeng apat thu uvin, thil dihlou ngen na kinep sah jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
en_kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: And they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; But have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

tcz: Ache le avahle ho jousen na nel peh un khopi hoitah Jerusalem hi noise tah in atot chatvei khummun; “hiche hi vannoi leisetna khopi hoipen vannoi pumpin achoi sang uchu ham?” atiuve.
en_web: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”
en_kjv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

tcz: Nagalmite jousen na nelpeh un noise tah in anop nop na seikhumun, “suhmang dinga phat sottah ina nga’u chu tun ahung guilhung tai!” atiuve.
en_web: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”
en_kjv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: They hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche hi Pakaiyin a tohgon chu aboldoh ahin, hamsetna hunglhung dinga ana gonsa chu a suhbulhit ahi. Aman Jerusalem chu khotona beihella ana suhbei ahin, Aman agalmiteu chu amaho chunga thaneina anapeh ahi.
en_web: The LORD has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
en_kjv: The Lord hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: He hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, He hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

tcz: Khopi hoi Jerusalem, Pakai angah hakan kap in, Sun le jan in vadung bangin na mitlhi long hen. kicholdo hihhel in; Na mitlhi lon jong tansah dan.
en_web: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
en_kjv: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: Give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

tcz: Janlai jong leh thouvin pengjah jengin. Pakai angah na lung ngaichat twi bangin lonsah in. Nachateu dingin na taonao khut chu domsang jing un, ajeh chu kholai dung jousea gilkela lhalhop gamsoh ahitaove.
en_web: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
en_kjv: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches, Pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: Lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, That faint for hunger in the top of every street.

tcz: Vo Pakai hiche thoh gimna hi gel temin! Na chate hi hiti lom lom’a nabol jing ding hitam? Minuten a angsunga hung kitolchem, achateu kisanhi aneh jeng diu hitam? Thempu holeh themgao ho kisan hi Pakai houin sunga kithat jeng ding hitam?
en_web: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
en_kjv: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

tcz: Ven, lamlen dunga kijam chap ho khu – Khangdong le tehseho, Numei chapang holeh pasal chapang ho, Galmite chemjam a thijeng ahiuve. Na lung han petin nathat gamin, Lungsetna beihelin nabol’e.
en_web: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.
en_kjv: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: My virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; Thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

tcz: Golvah nikhoa mipi nakou khom bangin, Muntin jousea tijatna nakoukhom’e. Pakai lunghanna nikhon, Koi macha a sohcha le ahingdoh a um poi. Kahin khoukhah le kahin puihoi chate chengse, Galmiten a thatgamsoh heltai.
en_web: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.
en_kjv: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, So that in the day of the Lord’s anger none escaped nor remained: Those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

tcz: Pakai lunghanna tanggolla kon hungpotdoh thohgimna chu keima tahin kamuchet ahi.
en_web: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
en_kjv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

tcz: Aman vah jouse daltanin, Muthim laha eipuilut e.
en_web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
en_kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

tcz: Nilhum keijin avel vellin keima dounan ka chunga a khut a lamin ahi.
en_web: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
en_kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

tcz: Aman kaphe leh kavun agotsah jenge. Kagu kachang jong a sungoi jengin ahi.
en_web: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
en_kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

tcz: Aman lunggimna leh gentheina eisun khumin chatmo hellin eilha tai.
en_web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
en_kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

tcz: Aman mithisa ho bangin, Muthim laha eivuiye.
en_web: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
en_kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

tcz: Aman pal eikai khumin, Keima ka jamdoh thei tapoi. Thihkhao gihtahin jong eikan chah e.
en_web: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
en_kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

tcz: Keima kapengjah jeng vang'in, Aman ka taona adalten del tai.
en_web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
en_kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

tcz: Songpal sangtah in ka lampi akhah tannin; Ka lampi eisuh setpeh e.
en_web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
en_kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

tcz: Keima man dingin, Kei le vompi bang in kiselin eichang lei.
en_web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
en_kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

tcz: Aman ka lampia kon in eimanin eimal tel tel in, Hesoh genthei le panpi beiyin eilhai.
en_web: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
en_kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

tcz: Aman athal-pou aloisalin, Keima abidoiyin eineiye.
en_web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
en_kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

tcz: Ka lungchang laitaha, Athalchang chu a kaplut jenge.
en_web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
en_kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

tcz: Kamiten nuisatbepseu kahi tai. Nilhum keijin musetna la eisah khum uve.
en_web: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
en_kjv: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

tcz: Aman lunggimna jengin eisu dimin, Lungkhamna khacheh khon chu eidon sah e.
en_web: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
en_kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

tcz: Aman songchang eilhai sahin, vutvai laha eilehluttan ahi.
en_web: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
en_kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

tcz: Chamna chu eilah mang pehin, Phatthei channa ding chu keidin gelphah ahi tapoi.
en_web: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
en_kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

tcz: Ka loupina nikho akichai tan, Pakaiya ka kinepna jouse jong ahomkiu ahitai, tin kakap jah jeng tai.
en_web: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
en_kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:

tcz: Kathoh gimna leh ka lengvaina hinkho hin eisugim thei val jeng e.
en_web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
en_kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

tcz: Ka thohgimna le in le kagentheina hi, seiya seijou hoi ahita poi.
en_web: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
en_kjv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

tcz: Ahin hiche hi kahin geldoh teng, Kinepna kanei jou jin ahi:
en_web: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
en_kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

tcz: Pakai neingailutna dihtah chun beitih anei pon, Amikhotona jong atangdeh poi.
en_web: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
en_kjv: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

tcz: A kitahna hi longlou ahin, Ami khotona jong jingkah sehin athah jingin ahi.
en_web: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
en_kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

tcz: Kahinna ka lhagaovin aseijin Pakai hi keima gou ahi. Hijeh chun Ama a kakinepna hi umjing ahije.
en_web: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
en_kjv: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

tcz: Pakai ging jingte leh hinna dinga hol jing tedinga phatah ahi.
en_web: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
en_kjv: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaija konna huhhing na muna dinga thipbeh cha nga hat angaije.
en_web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
en_kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

tcz: Chu leh khan don laiya Ama angsunga kipehlut leh Ami thununna koljon kikhum lut aphai.
en_web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
en_kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

tcz: Ama chu Pakaiyin atohsah nomna dung juiyin thipbeh in aching seh in ngah jing hen.
en_web: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
en_kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

tcz: Amaho chun amaijun tollam ngatnu henlang kijammu hen ajeh chu amahon ajona leh akinepna’u dung jui'a amu thei diu ahi.
en_web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
en_kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

tcz: Amaho chun a ngei phe bengho chu alangkhat jong dopeh uhenlang agalmi ten anoise nau jong kisan u-hen.
en_web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
en_kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

tcz: Ajeh chu koi macha hi Pakaiyin apaidoh paipai aum poi.
en_web: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
en_kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

tcz: Aman lungkhamna asosahje vang'in ami khotona dimset jeh chun angailutna ahop jinge.
en_web: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
en_kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai hi milungkham sahle alungthim sunhat peh ahi along lhaina ahipoi.
en_web: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
en_kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

tcz: Mihon gamsunga songkullut hochu akelngoi tol chotpha jongle’u,
en_web: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
en_kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

tcz: Hitobang miho chun Pathen douna in midang chan ding dolho lahpeh jongleu,
en_web: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
en_kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

tcz: Chuleh aman a thutan nauva achanding dol’u thudih chu chansah hih jong leu, hitiho jouse Pakaiyin amu sohkei hilou ham?
en_web: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
en_kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

tcz: Pakai phatsah louva koiham thilho hung soh doh na ding thupeh neithei ding chu?
en_web: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
en_kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

tcz: Chungnungpen Pathen in thilpha le thilse ahin sosah ji hilou ham?
en_web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
en_kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

tcz: Chuti ahileh mihon eiho e-chonset jeh uva engbolna e-chan jiuhi i-kiphin thei ding uham?
en_web: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
en_kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

tcz: Chuti louvin, eihon e-chonnau hi kikhuol’u hitin chuleh Pakai kom’a iki lehei kit lou diu ham?
en_web: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
en_kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

tcz: Eihon e-lung thim ule e-khut’u Van Pathen anga domsangu hitin seiju hite,
en_web: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
en_kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

tcz: Keiho nangma dounan ka chonse tauvin nangman nei ngaidam pouvin ahi,
en_web: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
en_kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

tcz: Nangman nalung hanna neibuh lhah khum tauvin chuleh khotona beihelin neidel khumun nei that gam tauve.
en_web: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
en_kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

tcz: Mei lah’a na kiselin, katao na’u na kom ahung lhung jou tapoi,
en_web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
en_kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

tcz: Nangman chitin namtin laha thet le notthapin nei koitauvin ahi.
en_web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
en_kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

tcz: “Ka melmateuvin Keiho dounan thu asei sei jingun.
en_web: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
en_kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

tcz: Keiho kichat le tijatnan Ka dimset tauve, Ajeh chu keiho kimana, kisugepa amang thah kahitauve.”
en_web: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
en_kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

tcz: Ka miteu kisuhmang jeh'in, Ka mitlhi’u twilon in along e!
en_web: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
en_kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

tcz: Kamitlhiu tanglou helin alonge; Tang lou ding ahi,
en_web: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
en_kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

tcz: Pakaiyin Vanna konna ahin vetsuh, Ahin lainatpi tokah un,
en_web: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.
en_kjv: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

tcz: Jerusalem Chanute khankho gelnan, Ka lungthim hi apohkeh ding akisa jing’e.
en_web: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
en_kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

tcz: Keiman kasuhset louhel galmin, Vaacha bangin eideljam e.
en_web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
en_kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

tcz: Kokhuh’a ei nolutun, Ka chunga song eiset khume.
en_web: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
en_kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

tcz: Ka luchang geiyin twiyin eichupin, “Athi ding kahitai” tin ka peng jah’e.
en_web: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
en_kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

tcz: Ahin kokhuh sunga konin, Pakai, Nangma kahin kouve.
en_web: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.
en_kjv: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

tcz: Nangman ka kouna najan, “Kataona nei sanpehin, Panpi ngehna a kataona nei san peh e!”
en_web: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
en_kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

tcz: Keiman kahin kou chun nangma na hung in “kicha hih in” neiti.
en_web: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
en_kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

tcz: Pakai nangman ka thutanpa nahin, ka chung thu neiseipehin! Ajeh chu eihuhdoha Nang na hi.
en_web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
en_kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

tcz: Pakai amahon ka chunga i-chan geija thilse abol’u hitam namu sohkeiye, kathu nei kholtohpihin lang, kadihna neitahlang pehin,
en_web: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
en_kjv: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

tcz: Ka galmiten kei douna tohgon aneiyu Nangman nahesoh keiye.
en_web: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
en_kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

tcz: Pakai nangin eitaitomnao na jasoh keijin chuleh ka chunga thilse abolgot hou jong na hesoh keiye.
en_web: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,
en_kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

tcz: Ka galmite ka chunga akihou un Keima dounan akihou lhi jingun ahi.
en_web: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
en_kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

tcz: Amaho khu ven! Atoupetu hihen adinpetu hijongle, keima nuisatna la jeng asaove.
en_web: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
en_kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

tcz: Pakai ka chunga thilse abol jouseu hi, Amaho chunga chuhsahin.
en_web: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.
en_kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

tcz: Amaho hi lungtahna leh sei ngailouna lungthim penlang, Achunguva sapsetna chuh sah in.
en_web: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
en_kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

tcz: Achung uvah na lunghanna chuhsah inlang, Pakai vansem ho noi jahin amaho khu suhmang tan.
en_web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
en_kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.

tcz: Sana jong adeite khuta among joutai! Sana hoi pen jong amoljeng tai. Muntheng sunga um songmantam ho jeng, jong lam lhongp dunga athangsoh tai.
en_web: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
en_kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

tcz: Veuvin Jerusalem chate, Mipha chomtah tahsan hoitah tah sanga mantam jo hochu, Tun leibelho tobang'in aboltauvin ahi.
en_web: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
en_kjv: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

tcz: Sialte jengin jong anoute avah jiuvin, ahinla kami Isrealten avah pouvin ahi. Neldi gamma vacha len “Vagonsang” hon achasenteu anahsah lou bangun ama hon jong a nahsah pouvin ahi.
en_web: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
en_kjv: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: The daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

tcz: Dangchahin achateu lhei jouse adanga abehden jouve. Achateu gilkelin an aholun, Ahin koiman pehding aneipoi.
en_web: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
en_kjv: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

tcz: An twitah tah ana neji ho chun tun lampi dunga khut don apang tauvin ahi. Phatkhatna vonhoi tahtah anavon ho chun tun thilnen kikholna munhoa neh ding aholun ahi.
en_web: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
en_kjv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: They that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

tcz: Kamite chonsetna hi Sodom mite chonset na sangin alenjon ahi. Hiche munna chun hetman louvin suhmangna nasatah anachun koimacha akithopi thei ana umpoiye.
en_web: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
en_kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

tcz: Ka lengteu jong phatkhat chun amel hoidanu chu bongnoi leh buhbang sangin ana bangjon, amai’u jong songmantam bangin ana vah'in ahi.
en_web: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
en_kjv: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

tcz: Tunvang amelu jong meihol sangin avomjoi. Lampi dunga jong koiman ahedoh thei tapouve. Avunu jong agu uva abehdan gamin, thing go bangin, agon atah jenge.
en_web: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.
en_kjv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

tcz: Chamjamma kithat hochu gelkella thiho sangin avangphajo ahitaove. Ajeh chu lou laiya neh aput tahlou jeh'in kelthohin amangthah jitaove.
en_web: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
en_kjv: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: For these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

tcz: Masanga mi lainatpi theitah tah nute hon achateu chu neh dingin akihon gam tauve. Amahon gim hesoha konna hoi dohna dingin achateu chu ana nejengun ahi.
en_web: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
en_kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: They were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

tcz: Tunvang alunghanna a kon chun Pakai alungna chim tai. Alunghanna hoise tah chu abuhlhah ahitai. Jerusalema lunghanna mei ana kou dohin hichun khopi chu aleibul kiphuna gei chun ana hallha jeng’e.
en_web: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
en_kjv: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, And hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

tcz: Leist lengte ahin - Vannoi mite koiman - Jerusalem kelkot sunga galmi alutthei ding chu ana tahsan pouve.
en_web: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed That the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinlah a themgao ho chonsetna leh a thempu ho chonsetna jeh chun hiti hin anasohdoh tan ahi. Amaho chonset jeh'a themmona bei miho thisan kisoa, khopi kisuboh ahi.
en_web: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.
en_kjv: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

tcz: Amahohi lamlhongpi dunga ana vahle uvin mi thisana akisubohun koiman amaho atong kha ngam pouvin ahi.
en_web: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
en_kjv: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, So that men could not touch their garments.

tcz: Mipiten chemangun tin asamun aboh nahitauve, neitong khahihun atiuve. Amaho gamla tahin ajamun gamchom mite laha avahle uvin ahinlah koiman achensah nom pouvin ahi.
en_web: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”
en_kjv: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not, when they fled away and wandered: They said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

tcz: Pakai amatahin amaho hi apanpi nom tapouvin muchom chomma athethang gam’u ahitai. Mipihon jong thempuho hi anahsah tapouvin, alamkai hou jong jana anei tapouvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
en_kjv: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

tcz: Eihon i-pankhompi houvin eihung huhdoh diuvin ingaichauvin, eikithopi theiloudiu nam mite kom jenga jong panpi ingaichauvin a phachom pon ahi.
en_web: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
en_kjv: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

tcz: Thiding kichat jeh'in lampi dunga jong kavah le ngam pouvin, amahthah ding nikhou jong ahung naitan, amah thah ding ihitauve.
en_web: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
en_kjv: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

tcz: Igalmiteu hi mulaopi sangin jong aleng hat jon, Molsang chung dunga jammang go jong leuhen eimudohdiu ahin, gamthip langa kisel jong leuhen hiche munna jong chu eina chan nahlai dingu ahiye.
en_web: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
en_kjv: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: They pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

tcz: Eihon leiset nam pumpi jouse hoa konna eihuhdoh diuva ina monpiu Pakai thaonu i-engpau jeng jong, akiselna munna konin a mandoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
en_kjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

tcz: Vo! Edom mite Uz gamsunga hi nakipa theiju hinam? Ahin nangin jong Pakai lunghanna khonna konna hi na don tei ding ahi. Nang jeng jong na jukhamna munna sagoh keova naki koi ding ahi.
en_web: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.
en_kjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; The cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

tcz: Vo khopi hoitah Jerusalem, naki engbolna nihko kichai ding ahitai, Naki engbolna gamma konna nahung kile vahding ahitai. Ahinlah Edom naki engbolna hi kipan bepseu ahinalaiye; Nachonsetna ho jouse hung kiphongdoh vahding ahi tai.
en_web: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
en_kjv: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

tcz: Pakai ka chunguva thilsoh ho hi hingeldoh temin, ven ichan geija vetset ka chan’u hitam?
en_web: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
en_kjv: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: Consider, and behold our reproach.

tcz: Ka goulo diu chengse hi namchom miho achang tauvin, Ka in ka lou jouseu la gamchom miho’a ahitai.
en_web: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
en_kjv: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, Our houses to aliens.

tcz: Keiho hi nunei lou panei lou kahi tauvin, kanuteu jong meithai ahi gam tauve.
en_web: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
en_kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, Our mothers are as widows.

tcz: Ka dondiu twi jeng jong kakichoh thu diuvin aumdoh tan, Ti ding thing jeng jong kakichoh thudiu ahitai.
en_web: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
en_kjv: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.

tcz: Eihin nungdelteuvin eihin phah pai dingu ahitan, Keiho ka haisam tauvin, ahinlah kingahna ding mun ka neipouve.
en_web: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
en_kjv: Our necks are under persecution: We labour, and have no rest.

tcz: Neh leh chah ning lhinga kanei jouseu, Ka kihinso jou nadiuvin Egypt leh Asssyria khutna ka kipelut tauvin ahi.
en_web: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
en_kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, And to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

tcz: Kapu kapateu ana chonseuvin ahinlah amaho athi gamtauve, Hijeh chun amaho chan ding thoh gimna leh engbolna hi keiho chunga achu tan ahi.
en_web: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
en_kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.

tcz: Ka sohteu chu tun keiho Pakaiyin apang gamtauvin, ahinlah koima eihuhdoh diu aum pon ahi.
en_web: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
en_kjv: Servants have ruled over us: There is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

tcz: Gamsun’a pum hatin vai ahop jeh'in thiding kicha pum pumin anneh kakiholun ahi.
en_web: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
en_kjv: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives Because of the sword of the wilderness.

tcz: Kel khoh jeh'in ka vousou tapkonga changlhah kikang bangin avom gam tai.
en_web: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
en_kjv: Our skin was black like an oven Because of the terrible famine.

tcz: Kagal miteuvin Jerusalema numei ho Judah khosunga nungah khang dong ho kichep nan anei gamtauve.
en_web: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
en_kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, And the maids in the cities of Judah.

tcz: Ka lengteu jong akhutpiuvin akhaisangun, Ka lamkaiteu jong noise tahin ei bolpeh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
en_kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honoured.

tcz: Gollhang ho chu sumhei goi dingin akaimangun, chuleh pasal chapang ho chu tiding thing aputsahnauva a lonlele jeng tauvin ahi.
en_web: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
en_kjv: They took the young men to grind, And the children fell under the wood.

tcz: Lamkai ho khopi kelkot ngahin apang tapouve. Khangthahten lam leh la sah abol tapouvin ahi.
en_web: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
en_kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their musick.

tcz: Kana lam nao chu lung khamna asohdoh tan, Ka lungsunguva kipana abeitai.
en_web: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
en_kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

tcz: Ka luchang uva konin ka lallukhuhu alhamang gam tai. Ka chonset jeh'un ka chung uva sapsetna achu tai.
en_web: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
en_kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe unto us, that we have sinned!

tcz: Hijeh hin kalungu alhalhop tan chuleh kamit uvah mitlhi adimtan ahi.
en_web: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
en_kjv: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim.

tcz: Ajehchu Jerusalem hi akeosehin aki jam tan, Sialten lhat nan anei tauve.
en_web: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
en_kjv: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, The foxes walk upon it.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakai nangma abang na hi jing jeng e, nalal touna chu akhang khangin aum jing e.
en_web: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
en_kjv: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; Thy throne from generation to generation.

tcz: Ipi dinga nei suhmil jing nahlaiyu ham? Ipi dinga donlou dai louva neikoi nahlaiyu ham?
en_web: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
en_kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, And forsake us so long time?

tcz: O Pakai neikiledohsah kitnun lang nangma komma nei puilut kittauvin! Ka kipanao masa chu neipe kittaovin!
en_web: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
en_kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.

tcz: Ahilou leh neipui doh mong mong diu hitam? Ole Ka chunguva nalung hangjing nalai ham?
en_web: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
en_kjv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; Thou art very wroth against us.

tcz: Juda mi Babylon gam Chebar vadung pang a sohchang ho lah a kana umna kum somle kumthum alhin kum July 31 lhinni achun van ana kihongin chule Pathen thilmu theina chu kana mui.
en_web: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
en_kjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

tcz: Hiche hi Jehoiachin lengpa asohchan jou kal kum nga lhin kuma chu soh ahi.
en_web: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
en_kjv: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

tcz: (Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Buzi chapa Ezekiel thempupa kom a Babylon lenggam Chebar vadung panga aum petna anapeh ahin, chule Pakai khut chu achungah ana kingame)
en_web: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
en_kjv: the word of the Lord came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.

tcz: Keiman kavet pettah chun Sahlam a kon huipi gopi nasatah ahung kitol kamun, Meilhang lentah masanga kolphe toh kitho a vah pempumin ahunge. Meilom lah a chun meikou aumin, chule meikou lailunga chun khichang tobang meikou vahlap lap aume.
en_web: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
en_kjv: And I looked, and behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

tcz: Meilom lailunga kon chun mihem melput tobang thil hing thei li ahung doh e.
en_web: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
en_kjv: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

tcz: Maili leh lhaving li aneiyu tailouvin,
en_web: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
en_kjv: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

tcz: Akeng hou chu ajangpet in, akengphangu chu bongnou keng to abangin alange.
en_web: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
en_kjv: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

tcz: Alhaving li noicheh a chun mihem ho khut kamu doh e.
en_web: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
en_kjv: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

tcz: Ahingthei ho lhaving ho chu khat le khat akijop jel cheh in ahi. Khat cheh a chu akipat doh teng leh kihei louvin jangpet in masang lam ngan akijot jiuve.
en_web: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
en_kjv: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

tcz: Amasang uva chun mihem mai aneiyun, ajetlang uva chun keipi mai aneiyun, aveilang uva chun bongchal mai aneiyun, chule anung lam uva chun muvanlai mai anei cheh uve.
en_web: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
en_kjv: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

tcz: Khat cheh chun lhaving kijal doh kopni cheh aneiyun, kopn khat cheh chu akijal doh teng ganhing achom khat cheh lhaving chutoh akijop mat jel jengin, chule kop khat cheh chun atahsao akhu chah kheh cheh un ahi.
en_web: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
en_kjv: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

tcz: Amaho chu ipi hijongle lhagaovin alhenpeh nalam ngan ajet aveija kiheidoh lou hellin jangpet in ache pai jeng jiuve.
en_web: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
en_kjv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

tcz: Ganhing liho chu meihol ampem puma kou abangin, ahilouleh meisel lou vah pempum kide abangin, chule kolphe vah bangin amaho lah a chun aki nungtol akima tollun ahi.
en_web: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
en_kjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

tcz: Chule ganhing liho chu kolphe vahlap lap bang khun achom le jap jap jeng uvin ahi.
en_web: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
en_kjv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

tcz: Hitia keiman ganhing liho chu kavetna ahileh leiset chunga chun kangtalai kang ho chu akomuva chun kamun kang khat cheh chu amaho khat cheh a achandiu chu ahi.
en_web: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
en_kjv: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

tcz: Kangtalai khat cheh chu hoitah a vahsetna song en tobanga kisemin akimun, liho chu abpn uvin kibang cheh akimun, chule amaho chu kibang cheh a kisem ahiuvin kang khat cheh velkol a chu kangni na aneicheh uve.
en_web: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
en_kjv: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

tcz: Hiche ho chu akitol tengule kihei lou hella gamkai li a achu angat na lam lama chu kihei jeng thei ahiuve.
en_web: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
en_kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

tcz: Hiche kang li ho chu sang tah cheh ahiuvin, chule timul tho aumin, chule akang ho kimvel a chun met jeng mit jeng in atom dimsetne.
en_web: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
en_kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

tcz: Ganhing ho chu ache tenguleh kangtalai kang ho jong chu amaho toh thakhat'in achekhom jiuvin, chung langa alen tou teng uleh akang ho jong chu ache tou jiuve.
en_web: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
en_kjv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lift up from the earth, the wheels were lift up.

tcz: Ganhing ho lhagao chu akang ho a chu uma ahi. Hijeh a chu lhagao chena lam lama chu akang ho le ganhing ho jong che jiu ahi.
en_web: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
en_kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

tcz: Hiche ho chu ache teng uleh akang ho chu che jiu ahin, hiche ho chu adin teng uleh akang ho kinga ji ahi. Hiche ho chu chung langa alen tou tengu leh akanga chu ganhing ho lhagao uma ahijeh chun akang ho chu akipat doh jiuvin ahi.
en_web: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
en_kjv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

tcz: Aluvum uva kijal doh chu vanthamjol tobang khat akidalin songvalset vah'in avahsetne.
en_web: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
en_kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

tcz: Anoija chun ganhing ho lhavingu chu khat leh khat kijop cheh in akijal doh in chule alhaving ni chun atahsau khat cheh chu akhun ahi.
en_web: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
en_kjv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

tcz: Alen teng ule alhaving ho gin husau chu keima jah in twitam tah in twipang hattah a atagin ahiloule Hatchungung ogin ahiloule, sepai hon tamtah husa gin bangin kajan ahi. Adin teng uleh alhaving u chu akhailha jiuve.
en_web: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
en_kjv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of a host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

tcz: Alhaving u akhailhah uva adin teng uleh vanthamjol tobang valset chunga kon chun o khat in thu ahin seijin ahi.
en_web: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
en_kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

tcz: Achung vum'a chun songval duma kisem laltouna tobang khat akimun ahi. Chule hiche laltouna sangtah chunga kitousah pachu mihem lim leh melput tobang ahi.
en_web: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
en_kjv: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

tcz: Akongbuh akipat akilah dan chu khichang vala meikou olla kimujap bangin akimun ahi. Chule akongbuh noilamse chu meikou tobang'in akimvel vah pempum bangin akimun ahi.
en_web: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
en_kjv: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

tcz: Gojuh nikho a meilah a lhagui kimu bang khun avah pempum in ahi. Hiche hi Pakai loupina keiman kamu abangin, keiman hichehi kamu phat in kamai tollah kasulut in ahileh ogin khat in keima koma ogin kkhat anasei chu kajan ahi.
en_web: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
en_kjv: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

tcz: Ogin chun mihem chapa dingdoh in keiman nang koma thu seinom kaneije ati.
en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

tcz: Aman kajah a thu asei phat chun kasunga lhagao ahung lut in chuin kakeng phang tenin eidiinsah tai. Keiman kajah a thusei ho chu phatechan kangaije.
en_web: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
en_kjv: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

tcz: Mihem chapa keiman nangma hi Israel nam mite keima doumah mah bol nam mite koma kasol nahi. Amaho leh apu apateu hin tuni chanin keima eidou jing uve.
en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
en_kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

tcz: Amahohi milungtah leh milouchal te ahiuve. Thanei vaihom Pakai chun thu ahin seije ti aseipeh dinga kasol nahi tin eiseipeh e.
en_web: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
en_kjv: For they are impudent children and stiff hearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God.

tcz: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu amahohi doumah bol ahiuhi, nahetna hijeh a chu amaho lah hin themgao khat aum jinge ti beh henau vinte.
en_web: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
en_kjv: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

tcz: Mihem chapa amaho ahiloule athuseiju kicha hih in, ling leh khao thahpi chule midep thei aipi lah a um bang in nagih jong leu kicha hih in. Mitvom letlut a navet tengu jongleh nangma kicha hih in.
en_web: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
en_kjv: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

tcz: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu nangman kathusei hi nasei peh ding ahi. Ahinlah amaho hi doumah boljing nom mite ahijeh un kathusei ngai pouvinte.
en_web: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
en_kjv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

tcz: “Mihem chapa, nakoma ipi kasei ahi phaten ngaijin, doumah mah abol nauva khun jau hih beh in, nakam kan lang chule khat peh peh hi nen”
en_web: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
en_kjv: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

tcz: Hichun kavet leh vetan khut khat kaheng lama hung kilhung doh chu kamui. Hichun lekhajol khat achoijin
en_web: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
en_kjv: And when I looked, behold, a hand was sent unto me; and lo, a roll of a book was therein;

tcz: Alham lhan ahile alangto a thilhahna la ho, lunghemna thu cheng ho, chule manthahna thu kiphongdoh ho jeng dimset kamun ahi.
en_web: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
en_kjv: and he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
