en_kjv: The beginning of the word of the Lord by Hosea. And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Hosea henga thu asei masah chun akoma hitin aseiye, “Ji gakipui le chun numei chavai soh-in tin, nachateu jong anuu to bangunte. Kamiten jong eidalhah-uva kitah lou, chavai soh ahitauve,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Hosea in Diblaim chanu Gomer akichenpin ahile, chuin ahung gaiyin Hosea dingin chapa khat ahinpeh in ahi.
en_web: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
en_kjv: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hi Hosea’n Diblaim chanu, Gomer chu akichenpi. Chapa khat anei nung lhonin

tcz: Chule Pkaiyin aseiyin, amin “Jezreel nasah ding ahi, ati, ajeh chu keiman phat chomkhat jouleh Jezreel thisan kiso jeh'a Jehu lengpa alenggam talen kamat saha, Israel mite chamlhatna lenggam kasuhbei ding ahitai.
en_web: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Apu Jehun Jezreel phaiya tol atha jeh a Israel lengpa talen kamatsah vah ding jeh-in nachapa min hi ‘Jezreel’ sah-in. Jehu leng vai neina kasuh bei ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche niteng chuleh Jezreel phaichama Israel galhatna kasuhbei ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Jezreel phaiya Israel sepai tha neina kasuh bei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Gangtah in Gomer in nao ahinvop kitin, chanu khat ahing kit in, chuin Pakaiyin Hosea jaha aseikitin, nachanu hi amin, “Dipdamna-bei, ‘Ngailutna–bei’ (Lo- ruhamah) - ajeh chu keiman Israel mite hi kangailut tah louhel ding ahitai ahiloule kangaidam lou ding ahitai, ati.
en_web: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.
en_kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
tcz_gospelgo: Gomerin cha numei khat aneikit’in ahi. Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Israelte ngailu louva, achonset nau jong ka-ngaidam tah lou sing jeh-in nachanu hi amin ‘Ngailutlou’ sah-in.

tcz: Ahinla Judah mite chunga kangailutna kavetsah ding, Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kahuhdoh ding ahi, galhat mite galmanchah jeh, sakol le sakol kangtalai thahatna jeh hilouva Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kajosah ding bou ahi.”
en_web: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”
en_kjv: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah mite vang ngailu nange. Kei-Pakai, a-Pathen’un amaho huhhing ing ting, galmun a chemjam le thalpi, chule thalchang ham sakolte ham le sakol touthemte ham manchah a bol kagot ahipoi,” ati.

tcz: Ngailutna beiyin anoichep aban phatin- Gomer in nao ahin vopkit in chapa ani channa ahing kittai.
en_web: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
en_kjv: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
tcz_gospelgo: Gomer chanun noi aban nungin Gomerin nao avop kit’in chapa khat ahing’e.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amin chu-‘Kamite-hilou’ tin min sahin, ajeh chu Israel mite hi kamite ahitapouve, chule a Pathen-u jong kahitapoi,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
en_kjv: Then said God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hosea jah a Pakaiyin, “Israelte hi kamite ahitapouvin, keijong a-Pathenu kahitapoi, hiijeh chun nachapa hi amin ‘Kamite-hilou’ sah-in,” ati.

tcz: Hicheni teng chuleh, nasopipa chu Ami- ‘Kamite’ chule nasopinu chu-Rahamah- ‘Kangailut khat’ nati ding ahi.
en_web: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
en_kjv: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; And to your sisters, Ruhamah.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun name Israelte chu, “Pathen mite, Pakai ngailut ho,” tin minvon.

tcz: Nahingnu chu dondauvin, Dondauvin hitobang numei hi kaji ahipoi, keijong amadin aji kahipoi, ajon maiput hi kheldohhen, anoiteni kaha ajon na thangnam jong chu sutheng hen.
en_web: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
en_kjv: Plead with your mother, plead: For she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: Let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, And her adulteries from between her breasts;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo kachate, kaji bangin umta hih hen lang, keijong aji hita hih jong leng, nanuu gajol’un. Notia apan a mito ajon jon khu jol lhauvin ngahsah-un.

tcz: Achuti louva ahile keiman avon jouse kahodoh’a akeoseh’a kaum sah ding ahi.
en_web: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
en_kjv: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, And make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, And slay her with thirst.
tcz_gospelgo: Angah louhel le avon jouse lahpeh ing ting, apen nikho banga akeova kalha ding ahi. GAmkang golah bahsah ing ting, dangchah a kathisah ding ahi.

tcz: Achate jouse jong kangailut louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu ahung kigil’uva kon’a notia hung kigil ahitauve
en_web: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.
en_kjv: And I will not have mercy upon her children; For they be the children of whoredoms.
tcz_gospelgo: Achate jong khohsah-in hepi ponge, ajeh chu jum helou noti cha ahibouvui.

tcz: Ahingnu-u jong jachatna neilouva notia kijoh ahin, anaovop’a jong chu jumle ja helouva chon ahi.
en_web: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
en_kjv: For their mother hath played the harlot: She that conceived them hath done shamefully: For she said, I will go after my lovers, That give me my bread and my water, My wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Amapi jong, “Kadongmate koma lut leng, neh le chah eipeuvin tin, samul pon le tupat ponnem eipeh-uva, olive thao le ju eidonsah diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Amanun aseijin, eingailu midang ho koma lhaitange, kanehding an, kadonding twi eipeho chule kasilding samul le tupat ponnem eipeho koma chetange ati.
en_web: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
en_kjv: Therefore behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, And make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nu hi lingle khao kaikhum ing ting, pal kaget khum ding, alampi kakha bing ding ahi.

tcz: Angailu ho kom’a lhai jongle, anungu aphah jou lou ding ahitai, amaho chu holle le jongle mujong amujou lou ding ahitai. Chule amanun jong asei ding, tun chengting kaji masapa henga kilekit tange, ajeh chu tulai kaumchan sangin chulaija kaumchan anomjoi.
en_web: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’
en_kjv: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; And she shall seek them, but shall not find them: Then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; For then was it better with me than now.
tcz_gospelgo: Adongma ho delle le jongle, maipha pon tin, gahol hol jongle muponte. Chuteng, “Kaji masapa henga kile kit tenge, tulai sangin chulaiyin nom kasajoi,” tinte.

tcz: Hiche numeinu hin kana thilpeh ho anei jouse, sana, dangka, lengpiwi thah, olive thao, kathilpeh ho jouse Baal doi apegam tan ahi.
en_web: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
en_kjv: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, And multiplied her silver and gold, Which they prepared for Baal.
tcz_gospelgo: Baal hou nan nei jongle, sana la dangka, olive thao, lengpitwi le chang pejing hi Kei kahilam ahedoh hih hel’e.

tcz: Ahinlah kachang jong a atphat le kakilelah kit ding, lengpi twi thah jouse jong, kakilelah ding ahi. Asagoh keu hupna dinga kanapeh samul ponsil le tupat ponnem jong kanung lah kit ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
en_kjv: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, And my wine in the season thereof, And will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu lho lhun tengle kathilpeh-chang le lengpitwi kile lah ing ting, samul pon le tupat ponnem kapehsa jong kalahpeh a ponsil beiya kakoi ding ahi.

tcz: Tua hi akideipi ho mitmu changtaha, ajamo kahodohpeh ding ahi, ahin kakhut’a kona koiman amanu hi eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
en_web: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.
en_kjv: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, And none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Adongmate angsunga akeovin jam ing ting, koiman kakhut’a eichu lhah jou louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Agolnop kut hihenlang, a lhathah kut hihenlang, akumlhun kut hijongleh kasuhbei ding ahi.
en_web: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
en_kjv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, Her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Kumhei golnop abol chengse, kumlhun kut hihen, lha lhin kut hile, Choldo nikho kut ahiya, houthua kikhopna abol jouse kasuh tang hel ding ahi.

tcz: Alengpi gui jouse kavohsetna, chule atheichang phung jouse jong kavoh heo ding ahi.
en_web: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.
en_kjv: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, Whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: And I will make them a forest, And the beasts of the field shall eat them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama deichat sum a adongmaten apeh a asei, alengpigui ho le atheichang phung ho kasuhgam peh ding ahi. Alengpilei ho le apahcha lei jouse gammang lai kasosah ding, gamsaten achil thang diu ahi.

tcz: Baal doi masanga gimnamtwi ahalna ho kasuhset peh’a chule a sana jempah chengsea akivonna, adongma akideipi hotoh kei suhmilna dinga akijepna jeh'a talen kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burnt incense to them, And she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, And she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: kei eisuh mil a Baal houna gimnamtui ahalnam a, sanapah a kijem a adongmae adelle le lai, chuche phat angolna jeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Pakaiyin aseisa ahitai.

tcz: Ahin keiman hichenu hi kanung jollhah kitna, gamthip noiya kapui mang ding, chule awnem heuva kaki houlimpi ding ahi.
en_web: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
en_kjv: Therefore behold, I will allure her, And bring her into the wilderness, And speak comfortably unto her.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nu hi gammang noiya pui lut ing ting, onem heova houva kathu nun ding ahi.

tcz: Alengpi leiya kahin lepui kitna, Achor phaicham jong kinepna kotpi phung kasosah ding, hikoma chu amanun jong anungah lai banga adonbutna, Egypt gam'a ahung potdoh til banga eidonbut ding ahi.
en_web: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, And the valley of Achor for a door of hope: And she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, And as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: HIche nu hi alengpilai nungpeh ing ting, gimna phaicham jong kinepna kotpi kasosah ding ahi. hikoma hin anu-ngah laiya bangin kasei ngai nante, Egypt’a kona ahung doh til’a abol bang chun.

tcz: Hiche nikho chu ahunglhun nile Pakaiyin aseiye, Ka Pakai tilouva “Kajipa tia neikou ding ahi”.
en_web: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
en_kjv: And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; And shalt call me no more Baali.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengle ajinpan eikou kit’in tin, ama dinga Baal eiti kit louhel ding ahitai.

tcz: O Israel, namuha kona Baal min tamtah kasuh manga chule naminphah kittahlou ding ahi chule
en_web: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
en_kjv: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, And they shall no more be remembered by their name.
tcz_gospelgo: Baal min him him kaphah pohsah lou didng ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chule gam'a gamsa jouse le chunga leng vacha jouse toh kitepna khat kasema, thalpi kasuh beija chemjam kalensah lou ding, chuteng nakichat tahlou dingu, cham le lungmonga naimut dingu ahi.
en_web: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
en_kjv: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, And with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: And I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, And will make them to lie down safely.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche tengle kamite asuh khah louna diuva gamsate le vachate ti kitepna kasem ding ahi. Gamsunga gal manchah pou pou, chemjam jouse le thalpi jouse kasuhmang ding, kamite lung ol le lung monga kachensah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Keiman atonsot’a kajinua kasem ding nahitai, chutengle Chondihna le thutah kavetsah ding nahi.
en_web: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
en_kjv: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; Yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, And in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israel, jia kanei ding, Nadia kitah tah le dihtah kahiya, Long louvin lungset ing ting, kahepia Katonsot gouva kasem ding kani.

tcz: Hitia chu ken kitahna neitah-a jia kanei ding nahin, nangin jong Pakai chu nahetdoh ding ahiye.
en_web: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.
en_kjv: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: And thou shalt know the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakitepna nit’a Keiya kasem ding, Nangin Pakaiya nei nei ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheni chule, keiman nadonbut inge, Tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Hiche nikho tengleh keiman van mun ho jouse kahouva thu kasei ding, amahon jong, van mun jousen jong leiset jaha gojuh puma thu asei diu ahi.
en_web: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says the LORD. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, And they shall hear the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule kamite Israel taona sang ing ting, Leiset’a gotwi kanensah ding,

tcz: Chuteng leiset in jong awgin puma penga asapma adonbutna, chang, lengpitwi, chule olive thaovin jong adonbut ding, Jezeel jaha thu aseidiu ahi.
en_web: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
en_kjv: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; And they shall hear Jezreel.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’in gaphatah tah, Changle lengpiga, olive apunsah ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche phatteng chule keiman Israel dinga muchi katu ding, keima dinga kakhansah ding. Keiman ‘kangailupoi’ katiho koma ngailutna kavetsah ding, chule kami nahitapouve tia kaseiho koma ‘tun nangho kamite nahitauve’ tia kasei ding ahi. Chule amahon eidonbutnuva, ‘Nangma ka Pathen-u nahi’ eitidiu ahi.
en_web: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”
en_kjv: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; And I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; And I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; And they shall say, Thou art my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga kamite chensah ing ting, Kaphat tousah ding ahi. “Ngailut lou,” kitiho ngailung ting, “Kamite hilou,” kiti ho chu “Kamite,” tia kasei ding, Amahon, “Ka-Pathenu,” tia eidonbut diu ahi.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin kakoma aseiye, “Chenlang nainneipi ngailukittan, amanun michom dang toh jonthanhoina neijeng jongle ngailukitin. Hichun vetsah chu Israel mite pathen dang ho koma kiheimangu henlang, hou jongleu, Pathen in angailu jing nalaijuve.
en_web: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
en_kjv: Then said the Lord unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Akideipi to chonse jing numei khat gahel’in. Doichom chom houvu hen, milimdoi ho hounan lengpithei changlhah toh jingo jongle Israelte ka-ngailut jing banga, hiche numei chu na-ngailut tei tei ding ahi,” eiti.

tcz: Keiman amanu chu dangka som le nga chule butun pocha nga a kakile choh kit ahitai.
en_web: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
en_kjv: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for a homer of barley, and a half homer of barley:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun hiche nu man din dangka som le nga kapen, sakol chang kilogram ja le som nga pen kagachoi.

tcz: Chuin amanu koma kaseiyin, tuphat laihin, nangma midangtoh chule keima tohjong nakitimat hihlaiye.
en_web: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”
en_kjv: and I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nu hin sotpi ei-nga, notia jong pang lou ding, pasal dangto jong jong lou din kaseipeh-e. Kenjong ama ka-nga jing din kaseiyin ahi.

tcz: Hiche hin avetsah chu, Israel hi lengnu le lengpa neilouva chule gan kilhaina neilouva le thempu theng ahiloule milim doi jeng jong, phat sottah aneilou diu ahi.
en_web: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
en_kjv: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu Israelte jong phat sotpi leng le lamkai bei, kilhaina gan that lou, doikhom song jong phut lou, phunsanna dinga milimdoi ho le milim sem louva um diu ahi.

tcz: Ahin khonungleh, hung kilehei kitun tin, Pakai Pathen hengle alengpau David alhangaidiu; khonung teng leh, Pakai a Pathen’u phatna agin diu ahi.
en_web: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
en_kjv: afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi Pakai a-Pathenu henga ahung kihei phat khat hung lhungin tin, David chilhah leng khat koma hung kikhom diu ahi. Chuteng Pathen ging’un tin, thilpha apeh chengse kisan tauvinte.

tcz: Pakai thusei ngaiyuvin, O Israel mite! Ajeh chu Pakaiyin gamsunga chengte toh kinelna khat aneiye. “Kitahna aumpoi, kikhotona jong aumpoi, nagamsunguva Pathen hetna jong aumpoi.
en_web: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
en_kjv: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: For the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, Because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche gamsunga chengte douna Pakaiyin hehsetna khat apohdoh ahi. Ngaiyin Israel Pakai thusei hi: “Gamsunga kitahna l engailutna alengpoi, amiten jong Kei hi Pathenin eigel pouve.

tcz: Kihahselna jeng alengin, jouthu jeng akiseiyin, na kithatun chule naguchauvin, jonthanhoi nabollun, muntin jousea nakisatun, khatle khat nakithat touvin ahi.
en_web: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
en_kjv: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, And blood toucheth blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepna abol chengseu la apal keh jiuvin, jou aseiyun, tol athat’un, aguchauvin, chule akijonbol’ui. Chonval la apung cheh cheh-in, tol la akithat that jengtai.

tcz: Hijeh chun nagamsungu hi mihem lunghem bangin alunghemtan, gamsunga cheng miho jong alunggimsoh tauve. Chule mijousen phat namoh mansahuvin, gamlaha gamsaho jeng jong alunghem sohtauvin, chunga leng vachate jengjong alunghem gamtauve. Twilaha nga ho jeng jong, aum gam tapouve.
en_web: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
en_kjv: Therefore shall the land mourn, And every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, With the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; Yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung hung go-lhan tin, ijakai gopsoh ding ahi; gancha jouse le ganhing ho, ju le va, nga ho geiya thigam ding ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Koimacha nakhutjungin koh hihin, chule akiheh tojong koima umda jenghen! Ajeh chu keitoh kinelkal, nangjoh nahi, vo thempu.
en_web: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
en_kjv: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: For thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mipi kinah dau hen kihehto dau hen: vo Thempuho, nang ho bou kahehset nahiuve.

tcz: Hijeha chu sunlai changa jong nakipal lhuh ding, jan tengle themgao pa jong nakipal lhuh tha ding ahi.
en_web: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
en_kjv: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, And the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, And I will destroy thy mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Sunle jan a nakipal lhuh lhuh jeng diu, Themgao ho jong phachaom deh lou diu ahi. Ken nanu Israel hi kasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Thempu atam chenin, chonse kei douding atame.
en_web: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
en_kjv: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: Therefore will I change their glory into shame.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thempu natambe cheh-u le Kei dounan chonset nabolbe cheh-ui, hijeh a chu min najabolnau chu vetdana kaheidoh peh diu ahi.

tcz: Miten chonset thilto ahin pohlut chanin, thempuho athaouve.
en_web: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
en_kjv: They eat up the sin of my people, And they set their heart on their iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite chonset bol chu nanghon haodoh nan naneiyun, hijeh chun chonset nabolsah sah nom’ui.

tcz: Chule thempun bolkhat aneile, mipiten jong abolluve.
en_web: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
en_kjv: And there shall be, like people, like priest: And I will punish them for their ways, And reward them their doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi thoh gim banga nanghon jong genthei hesoh nathoh diu ahi! Thilse nabol jal’uva talen kamatsah a kahtohsah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Amahon neuvintin, ahijeng vanga gilkel ding ahiuve. Notin panguvin tin hinlah pungthei lou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu Pakai dalhan notia pang dingin, donlouvin akoitauve.
en_web: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.
en_kjv: For they shall eat, and not have enough: They shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: Because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachan diu kilhaina gantha sa nejong leu chun, gilkel thoh a naum jing diu ahi. Cha tam neina din doiphunga notin pang jong leu chun, doichom chom nahoujeh-uva cha nanei deh lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ju jeng, juthah jeng adonuvin, jun kamite aguhmang ahitai.
en_web: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
en_kjv: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ju lui jut hah don’in, kamite angol gamtauve!

tcz: Amahon thing khat pou adongun, molkang khattouvin akhonung thu-u aseipeh theiding atahsanun ahi. Milim doihou angaichat chun, angolsah-u ahitai. Amahon noti hi akichepnauvin, pathen dang ajenun ahi.
en_web: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
en_kjv: My people ask counsel at their stocks, And their staff declareth unto them: For the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, And they have gone a whoring from under their God.
tcz_gospelgo: Kungbul phung pou phunin asan’uvin, tenggol chun ahetnom’u aseipeh bangin agel’ui! Eidalhatauve. Notia pang numei bangin, doichom chom kom ajonsoh tauve.

tcz: Amahon molsangvumah, kilhainan gan athatuve. Amaho lhangvumah akaltouvun, gimnamtwi ahaluve.
en_web: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
en_kjv: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, And burn incense upon the hills, Under oaks and poplars and elms, Because the shadow thereof is good: Therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, And your spouses shall commit adultery.
tcz_gospelgo: Molvum doiphung dunga kilhaina abol’uvin, lhangvum vum, thingphung dang nou dunga kithoina gimnamtui ahal’un, ali nom sah jeh-in theoboh adah-uve. “Hiche kon hin nachanu jouseu notin apangun, namouteu mito ajong tauve.

tcz: Ahinlah ibola kagimbol dingham natia apanu leh ajon thanhoi jeh-a? O hetna lhasam mingol ho! thil hetkhanna nanotthap tauve. Namiten jong amaho bol bang bang abolluvin ahi.
en_web: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
en_kjv: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, Nor your spouses when they commit adultery: For themselves are separated with whores, And they sacrifice with harlots: Therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle athilbol jeh-u hin amaho talen matsah ponge, ajeh chu nangho tah jong doiphunga kijoh noti ho to kijot manga chonse, chule kilhaina thil toh khomji nahiuve. Thuchih-in, ‘Lungthimbei mite chu mangthah diu ahi’ ati bang diu ahi.

tcz: Israel, nang notin pangjeng jongle chun, Juda vang themmo chansah loujenin. Gilgal khopia hunglut dan, Beth-aven a jong hung lutdan.
en_web: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’
en_kjv: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, Yet let not Judah offend; And come not ye unto Gilgal, Neither go ye up to Beth-aven, Nor swear, The Lord liveth.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei dia Israelte nakitah lou vangun, Judahte vang hitobang thil hin athemmo pouve. Gilgal le Bethel mun a jong doihou din hung dauvin, hikoma chun hing jing Pathen minin kitepna jong bol sauvin.

tcz: Bongla gol louchal bangin Israel hi alou challe. Pakaiyin hamhing gam lentaha kelngoi avah banga, Israelte hi avah jing jeng ding hinam ong?
en_web: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
en_kjv: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: Now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
tcz_gospelgo: Lahlou sakol pol bangin Israelte vang alouchal behseh jengui. Hamhing lah a kelngoi vah banga iti kivah vah ding ham?

tcz: Israel hi achangin dalhan, ajeh chu amahi jonthanhoi toh kicheng ahitai.
en_web: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
en_kjv: Ephraim is joined to idols: Let him alone.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi doihouvin angol tauve. Anop nop’in um jengu hen.

tcz: Jukham hon khat chu noti ho toh alumkhomtauve. Aloupi diu sangin ajachat diu adeijouve.
en_web: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
en_kjv: Their drink is sour; they have committed whoredom continually: Her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
tcz_gospelgo: Ju adon khamset’un, notin apangun, jabol sangin jachatna adeijo’uve.

tcz: Khoppi huijin alhaving tenin achun chah kheh in Maicham hijat asemthu jouse jeh'a hi kijumso diu ahi.
en_web: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
en_kjv: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, And they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
tcz_gospelgo: Hui lhoh mang bang diu, doichom chom houjeh a jahcha diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi ngaiyin, nang thempuho. Lunglutin ngaiyin, nang Israelte lamkai. Nangho leng insung mite jousen jong ngaichehuvin. Ajeh chu nachunguva thutanna hi kingam sohkei ahitai. Nanghon Mizpah le Tabor khoa dingin kipalna thang nakamuve.
en_web: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
en_kjv: Hear ye this, O priests; And hearken, ye house of Israel; And give ye ear, O house of the king; For judgment is toward you, Because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, And a net spread upon Tabor.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Thempuho, ngaiyuvin! Ngai phauvin Israelte! Leng insung miten ngaiyuvin! Adih a thutan dia kigelte, nachunguva thu kitan lo ding ahitai! Mizpah a chun kipalnan napangun, Tabor lhanga lenpel’in nakisongun,

tcz: Kotong thuhtah in nachouvun thang nakampehuvin ahi. Ahinlah nathil bol hi kenjong kahin vetjing ahiye.
en_web: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.
en_kjv: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, Though I have been a rebuker of them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Acacia khopia thuh tah khuh kilai nabanguivn, hijeh a chu nabonchauva talen kamatsah ding nahiuve.

tcz: O Ephraim, keiman nang koitobang nahi kahenai. Nang keiya konin kisel theipon nate, O Israel, notinun ajipa adalhah bangin, kei neidalha tai, nangma thanghoitah-a kisubohdeh nahi ahitai.
en_web: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
en_kjv: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: For now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel itobang ahi kahenai, kakoma kisel theiponte. Numei kitahlou tobang ahi, amite jong eihou din alolhing pouve,” ati.

tcz: Nachon nauvin Pathen henga nakilesah thei tapouve. Ajeh chu nalahuva noti dinga lunggel jeng nagel jeh'un, Na Pathen-u umna lam nagel phatapouvin ahi.
en_web: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.
en_kjv: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: For the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, And they have not known the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi thilse bol hin a-Pathen komu ahin jot lutsah thei lou ahitai. Milimdoi ahou nom behseh-un, Pakai ahepha tapouve.

tcz: Israel chu akiletsahnan achunga aheh jingin, Ephraim chu aphatlouna-a kipal lhu ding ahin, Juda jong Israel le Ephraim toh kipal’a lhukhom tha ding ahi.
en_web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
en_kjv: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: Therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi kiletsahna chu amaho douvin apangtai. Achonset nauvin akipalsah-in alhuhsah tai, Judah te geiyin alhuh tha tauve.

tcz: Akelngoi jouseu le abong jouseuvin pumgo thilto Pakaiya hungbol jongleu, amu loudiu ahitai, ajeh chu amahoa kona kikhin gamla ahitai.
en_web: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
en_kjv: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; But they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai koma kilhaina din kelngoite le bong ho akai nauvin, ahivangin phatchom nan aneippouve. Pakai amudoh jou pouve, ajeh chu Aman adalhatauve.

tcz: Amahon Pakai chu kitahna beiyin anabol tauvin, hibangtah in jatdng mitoh cha anahing tauvin ahi. Tua hi mi sumongpa chun ama ho jong aloumunu jong asuhmongtha ding ahi.
en_web: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
en_kjv: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: For they have begotten strange children: Now shall a month devour them with their portions.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaidin akitah pouvin, achateu jong Pakaiya ahipouve. Hijeh a chu amaho jong agamsungu jong kisubei ding ahitai.

tcz: Gibeah khoa kelki mutuvinlang! Ramah khoa sumkon mutuvin, Beth-aven khoa galkonding in kiginna lhang samuvin. Vo Benjamin kiti hot hotin!
en_web: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
en_kjv: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, And the trumpet in Ramah: Cry aloud at Beth-aven, After thee, O Benjamin.
tcz_gospelgo: Gilead a gal konna din sumkon mut’un! Ramah khoa gal khongpi vouvin! Bethel khoa galsat din kho-lhang sam’un! Gal kon’uvin, Benjamin chilhah ho!

tcz: Ephraim dinga talen kapeh nikho leh ahomkeuva kijam ding, Israel phung laha thonlou hella kaphondoh ding ahi.
en_web: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
en_kjv: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: Among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen matna ding nikho ahung lhunge, Israel mangthah ding ahitai. Vo Israelte, hiche hi soh tei ding ahi!

tcz: Juda gam'a milen milalho jong gucha bangdiu, achunguva kalunghanna twilhabom bang ding ahi.
en_web: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
en_kjv: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: Therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah lamakien Israel asat’uva, agamsung alahpeh jeh-un kalung ahange. Hijeh a chu achunguva talen twipi kisunglha kabahsah ding ahi.

tcz: Ephraim hin thu adiha katan jeng jong asunoh phahtai. Ajeh chu amahi pannabeiya kipedoh-a vahthaile ahitai.
en_web: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
en_kjv: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, Because he willingly walked after the commandment.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel hi min abolsen, achanlom tah gamsung geiyin, panpi phachom louhel ho akineppi jal’in, min alahpeh tai.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keijong Ephraim dinga nget tobanga kahi ding, Juda insung dinga jong agotlhahsah-a pang ding kahi.
en_web: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
en_kjv: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, And to the house of Judah as rottenness.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel sumang ing ting, Judahte manthahna kalhut khum ding ahi.

tcz: Ephraim chu adammona akimu doh phat in, Judah chun amaha akimudoh phatin, Ephraim chu Assyria gam'a achen lenglenpa henga mi asole. Ahinlah aman hom naboldam theilou ding, amaha jong asuhdam thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
en_kjv: When Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah saw his wound, Then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, And sent to king Jareb: Yet could he not heal you, Nor cure you of your wound.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israel’in aveiset akimudoh a, Judah-in amaput akimudoh teng, Israel’in Assyria gam kumpipa henga panpi gathumin tin, amanla damsah a amaput boldam peh thei deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Keima Ephraim dinga keipi kabah ding, Judah dinga keipi golpai hattah kabah ding ahi. Kei mong mong in kabotel jengjung ding ahi. Keiman kalhoh manga koiman eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
en_web: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
en_kjv: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, And as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte le Judahte chu sakei midel khum banga kadel khum ding, atel adah-uva kajan a kadalhah ding ahi. Kakai mang teng koiman eichu lha theiponte.

tcz: Chuteng kagam langa kakile kit ding, Amahon athemmonau akihet dohuva, keima angsung ahinhol kit kahseu, kachenna muna kache ding, agenthei behseh tengule eihin holdiu ahi.
en_web: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
en_kjv: I will go and return to my place, Till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: In their affliction they will seek me early.
tcz_gospelgo: “Achonset jeh-uva athoh khopset’uva, eihung ho kahseuva, kamite hi kadonda ding ahi. Athoh gim behseh tengu eimudoh thei maiyu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hungun, Pakai henga kilekit tauhite. Aman ahal hallin eimal teldeh jongleu, tua hi ei-damsah kitdiu ahitai. Aman eimavou ahitan, tua hi imaha hou eitompeh dingu ahitai.
en_web: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
en_kjv: Come, and let us return unto the Lord: For he hath torn, and he will heal us; He hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin aseiun, “Pakai koma kile kit taute! Eibolgimu ahitan, damjong eidamsah teiyunte; eimavosau ahitan, imahau eitompeh tei lou diu ham?

tcz: Chomlou kahin ei-kiledohsah kituvin tin, chuteng eiho ama umna-a iumdiu ahi.
en_web: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
en_kjv: After two days will he revive us: In the third day he will raise us up, And we shall live in his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni ni nithum jou teng eisuhal’un tin, a-angsunga inom hin diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng eihon Pakai ihetdiu ahitai! Kihetthemu hitin, Pakai chu hettei tei ding gouhite. Ahung kumlhah ding teng eihetsah tei nauvinte. Ahiloule leiset chapkotna pangji khalgo banga hung Lenglha jeng ding ahi, tia asei dingu ahi.”
en_web: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
en_kjv: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: His going forth is prepared as the morning; And he shall come unto us as the rain, As the latter and former rain unto the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai het tei din goute. Jing kho avah tei tei bangle, chuh lai gotwiyin leiset achap nou banga, ihenguva hung tei ding ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: “O Israel le Juda, Ipi kabolpeh ding nahim?” tin Pakaiyin adonge. “Nangin nei ngailut nahi jingkah meibol bep ahin, nisan asahgot loi jeng daitwi bep ahibouve.
en_web: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
en_kjv: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? For your goodness is as a morning cloud, And as the early dew it goeth away.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israel le Judah, i-kalo didng ahiuvam? Jingkah daitwi kang loi bangin, nei ngailutnau abeiloiji tai, sun nisa daitwi kanghei hoi bep ahi.

tcz: Ka themgao ho nasatan tan din kasolin, Kakamsung thuseiya kona thatgam din kasol’e. Kathutan khovah banga kikhodoh tothon kasol’e.
en_web: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
en_kjv: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: And thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu thutanna le suhgamna thu pohsah a ka-Themgao te kahinsolpeh nahiuve. Nahenguva ka-ngeh hi akichen jenge;

tcz: Keiman kithoina sangin nei ngailutdiu kadeijon, Pumgo thito sanga, Keima neihetdiu kadeijon ahi.
en_web: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
en_kjv: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; And the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
tcz_gospelgo: kilhaina gantha sangin ngailutna kadeijon, pumgo thilto eipeh sangun kamiten eihet diu kadeijoi.

tcz: Ahinlah Adam bangin, kakitepna nasukehun, katahsan nasubei uve.
en_web: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.
en_kjv: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: There have they dealt treacherously against me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahinla gamsung ahung lut lut’un Adam mun a kakitepna asukeh tauve.

tcz: Gilead jong hi michonseho khopi ahin, Thisan sote kengto ngapna ahibouve.
en_web: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
en_kjv: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, And is polluted with blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Gilead khopi sung mihiloute le tolthat ho adimset’ui.

tcz: Michom hon mihem achanlhih banguvin, Thempuho jong ahon hon in akikhomuvin, Shechem jotna lampia mi athatuvin hitobang-tahin chonset thil jeng abolluvin ahi.
en_web: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
en_kjv: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, So the company of priests murder in the way by consent: For they commit lewdness.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempuho jong mi changlhi jing gucha hon abangui. Shechem mun theng lampi jenga jongmi athat’uve. Thilse hijatpi hi henasa saa abol’u ahitai!

tcz: Keiman Israel le Ephraim insunga tijat umtah thil khat kamudoh’e, Kamite noti in apangun, gamchom mite indoi hou nan akisaboiuve.
en_web: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
en_kjv: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: There is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel sunga kidah dah um kahitan, milimdoi houvin kamite akisubohsoh tauve.

tcz: Kami Israel themmona le doumah abolnao hi keiman hamphatnaa athahbeh-a semphat ding gojongleng; O Judah nang dingin jong chang atding tepsa a kikoi ahitai.
en_web: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
en_kjv: Also, O Judah, he hath set a harvest for thee, When I returned the captivity of my people.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Judah mite, nathilbol chengseu jeh a nang ho talen pehna ding phat khat kakoinai.

tcz: Keiman Israel kasuhdam nome, ahinlah achonset nao asang behsehe. Samaria hi jou le nal jeng seinaa dimset jeng ahiuve, Gucha insunga alut tan, michom ho polama ading jingui!
en_web: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
en_kjv: When I would have healed Israel, Then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: For they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, And the troop of robbers spoileth without.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamite Israel damsah a, haodoh sah kit kanop phat phat le, agitlou nau le thilse abol ho’u kamudohji tai. Khat le khat akilhem to’uvin; bang aphujal’un, aguchauvin; kholai dunga mi achom’ui.

tcz: Ken kamu sohlam koiman ahedeh pouve. Achonset nauvin alonvuh dimu, kamusoh keiye.
en_web: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
en_kjv: And they consider not in their hearts That I remember all their wickedness: Now their own doings have beset them about; They are before my face.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse hijat abol’u kagel jing didng hi lungin jong agel phapouve. Achonset nauvin avuh tauvin, kamu khel aumppoi.”

tcz: Gitlouna thil abolluvin, lengpa geiyin akipasahuvin, Lengpa chate jengin jong ajou thilbolu chu akipapiuve.
en_web: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
en_kjv: They make the king glad with their wickedness, And the princes with their lies.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mipin thilse bol’in lengpa le avaipote geiyin alhem lhauve.

tcz: Abonchauva hi mitoh kisubohsa jeng ahiuvin, Meilhum sunga kihulsa tobang jeng ahiuvin, Amahohi tapkonga meilhum asat kingah tobang chol kiso changbong akichankah kingah tobang ahiuve.
en_web: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
en_kjv: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, Who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
tcz_gospelgo: Mijong jeng le mi kitahlou jeng ahiuve. Mi ahotnau meilhum sung meisa abangin, kan ding changlhah kigon jou kah a changlhah kangpan mut kou hih jongle deoje ju tobang ahi.

tcz: Cholngah nin leng chapten ju adonun, tot chavai hotoh totnan mi anuisat khom.
en_web: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
en_kjv: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; He stretched out his hand with scorners.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa gaolvah nin lengpa le avaipote ju atul kham’un, asu-ngolsoh tauve.

tcz: Alungsungu jong lhummei salai abangin, jan khovahin lungdam mon aum’un. Jingkah leh mei salah lah bongin adiu jeju jiuve.
en_web: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
en_kjv: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: Their baker sleepeth all the night; In the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilse bolnom danu meilhum abangin, along hang khovah vah-un, jingkah teng meikou deojah jeng abangui.

tcz: Lhumphung salai abangun, alamkai hou jong avallhum sohun, Alenghou jong aban banin athat-un, ahinlah koimachan kakoma panpina athum pouve.
en_web: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
en_kjv: They are all hot as an oven, And have devoured their judges; All their kings are fallen: There is none among them that calleth unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Alunghan val jeh-un avaihomteu athat’un, alengteu aban banin athat’un, ahivangin kahenga taova aum hih hel’ui.

tcz: Israelte namtin vaipi pathen helou hotoh akihal sohtan, Changlhah kikang min sohlou tobangbep ahitauve.
en_web: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
en_kjv: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israelte hi changlhah alang kan minlou tobang ahiuve. Akimvel’uva namtin vaipi akison piuvin,

tcz: Gamchom mite pathen ahou-uvin, atha alhalhop sahin, nahinlah amahon akihet pouve. Aluchunga asamjengjong kangsoh ding ahitan, ahinlah akihet polaiye.
en_web: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
en_kjv: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: Yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
tcz_gospelgo: hitobang gamchom mite chunga kison hin athahat alah mang ahilam helouvin aum’ui. Amanna didu nikho dimtohsa ahitan, amahon la ahedoh pouve.

tcz: Israel kiletsahna chu amaho hehin apangin ahinla amaho Pakai henga ahung kiledeh pouvin, holding jong agong pouve.
en_web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.
en_kjv: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: And they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte kiletsahna amaho douna thu aseitai. Thil hijatpi soh tajongle kahenga hung kile kit ding agel pouvin, Pakai a-Pathenu eihol pouve.

tcz: Israel mite hi vakhu banga lungthim bei le nuijat umtah ahiuve. Egypt mitepou akouvin, Assyria gamsung lam pouva akitoluve.
en_web: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
en_kjv: Ephraim also is like a silly dove, without heart: They call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel hi lungthimbei vakhu tobang ahin, amasan amiten apanpi diuvin Egyptte akouvun, chuin Assyria lam asel’ui!

tcz: Chule achunguva len kikhu khum ding, chunga leng vacha banga kamat ding ahiuve, athilse bol chengseu jeh'a kabolgim dingu ahi.
en_web: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
en_kjv: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivanga achenna chan’uva lenpel kason a vacha banga kamatdoh ding ahiuve. Thilse abol chengseu jal’a talen kamatsah tei ding ahiuve.

tcz: Ohe ada ahiuve, ajeh chu kakoma konin akihei manguvin, eidouvin apanguve.
en_web: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
en_kjv: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: Destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: Though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe ada ahiuve! Eisalhauvin eidou tauve! Kasuhgam ding ahiuve. Kahuhhing nom vangin, jou jouvin eihouvui.

tcz: Lung thengsellin kakoma akappouve, hiche sang chun, ajalkhun chung dunguva atouvun, angahun ahi. Amahole amaho akisun chan chanun semthu milim pathen koma henga ju akithum un, kakoma imacha athum nompuve.
en_web: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
en_kjv: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, When they howled upon their beds: They assemble themselves for corn and wine, And they rebel against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungtheng sel’in kahenga atao pouve, chiding namdangte umchan bangin tol dunga akipehle leuve. Chang le lengpitwi athum tengu jongle chiding namdangte umchan atho’uve. Vo doumah bolte!

tcz: Keiman kahiluva kahatsah nom vanguvin, kei dounan thilse agong gonguve.
en_web: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
en_kjv: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, Yet do they imagine mischief against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kavahdoh a kahatsah vangin, kei douna jeng abol’uve.

tcz: Amahon Chungnungpen velouvin, muntin avele leuvin ahi. Amaho panabei thalpi chang lengkoi lebep ahiuve, agalmi tehon alamkaihou athading. Chuteng Egypt miten anuisat diu ahi.
en_web: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
en_kjv: They return, but not to the most High: They are like a deceitful bow: Their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: This shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Eida lhauvin, thabei, semthu pathen abel’ui. Kisonpi theilou thalchang kon tobang ahiuve. Alamkaiteu kiletsah thusei jal’a thisea thisoh diu, Egypt miten anuisat diu ahi.

tcz: “Pakai mite douna-a, galmite muvanlai banga hung ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon kakitepna asukehun ahi. Chule ka danthu dounan asukhel taove.
en_web: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
en_kjv: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, Because they have transgressed my covenant, And trespassed against my law.
tcz_gospelgo: “Gal sumkon mut loiyun, melmaten kagamsung chu, muvanlai lengsuh bangin ahindelsuh tauve! Kamiten amaho to kakitepna asukeh-un, kahilna thuhil adoutauve.

tcz: Ka Pathen keihon nangma kaheuve, tia Israel chu kaheng lama hungpeng ding ahi.
en_web: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’
en_kjv: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
tcz_gospelgo: A-Pathena eiseiyuva, kamitea akiseiyuva, eihet banga asei vangun,

tcz: Ahinlah tun ageisangtai, kami Israelten thilpha adeipouve.
en_web: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
en_kjv: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: The enemy shall pursue him.
tcz_gospelgo: thilpha apaitauve. Hijeh a hi amelmateuvin adel del jeng diu ahi.

tcz: Keimaa kon hilouvin, amahon lengho akitun dohuvin, apipui ho akisemun, hichu keiman kahephapoi. Paidoha aum nadiuvin, adangka le a sana houvin , milim akisemun ahi.
en_web: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
en_kjv: They have set up kings, but not by me: They have made princes, and I knew it not: Of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, That they may be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamiten leng ho akilhen vangun, acham cham a abol’u ahibouve. Kei phatsah louvin lamkai akilhen’ui. Amanthahna diuvin, sana le dangka adongkhom’un milimdoi akisem’ui.

tcz: Vo Samaria nabong nouvin nangma napampai ahitan, Kalung hanna nangma douna-a koudoh ahitai. Monabei ahina dingu chu itihchan hinalai dingham?
en_web: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
en_kjv: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; Mine anger is kindled against them: How long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria kho sung miten sanaa kisem bongchal lim ahouvu kahoi. Acunguva kalung hange. Itih tah le milimdoi ahouda diu ham?

tcz: Ajeh chu Israel a kona jong chuti ahi, khutthem miho thilsem ahin, Hijeh chun Pathen ahipoi, chuleh Samaria bongnou chu ahal halla kisuchip ding ahi.
en_web: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
en_kjv: For from Israel was it also: The workman made it; therefore it is not God: But the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel mi khut them khat’in asemdoh ahin, pathen ahinaisai poi. Samaria khopia kihou sana bongchal lim chu kisugep ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon hui chu muchi tua atu-u ahin, chimpei akiat dingu ahi. Hichun kung aneipon, adon jong chun nehding agadoh sah theilou ahi.
en_web: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
en_kjv: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: It hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: If so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
tcz_gospelgo: Huise tu ahiuvin, khopihui aki-at diu ahi. Chang min louna louma changlhah ding kilamdoh ponte. Kilamdoh mong jongle gamchom min nedoh bep’unte.

tcz: Israel mite vallhumin aumtai, tun amaho chu vannoiya chiding namdang ho lah-a lunglhaina umloubeh tobang hiding ahitauve.
en_web: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
en_kjv: Israel is swallowed up: Now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel jong namdang bep ahitan, pannabei bel kehsa tobang ahitai.

tcz: Ejeh inem itile amaho gamlaha sangan chang lhat bangin Assyria mite heng lama achetouvun ahi. Ephraim in kideipi din aki thalahe. Israel mite hi amale ama kijoh ahiuvin, angailut miho koma kijoh ahiuve.
en_web: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
en_kjv: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
tcz_gospelgo: Lahlou sa-ngan banga louchal Israelte anop nop’in akihei tauve. Assyria mite panpi ngai chan acheuvin, ahuh diuvin namdang ho tohman apeuve.

tcz: Ahinlah mi tamtah ho koma kijoh jongleu, nikhatle ka puikhom ding ahi.
en_web: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
en_kjv: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, And they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivanga abonchauva kakhop ding, talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Assyria kumpipan abolset tengu nasa asah behseh jeng diu ahi.

tcz: Israel in chonset pomang dingin maicham tampi asem jeh'in, maicham ho chu ama dinga chonsetna ding joh ahung hitai.
en_web: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
en_kjv: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, Altars shall be unto him to sin.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chonset suh beina dia Israelten maicham asembe vangun chonsetna ding mun tampi aneibe cheh-ui.

tcz: Dan tamtah kapeh vang'in, hiche ho chu hepha lou bangin angaitoi.
en_web: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
en_kjv: I have written to him the great things of my law, But they were counted as a strange thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi hilna ding simsen lou kajih doh tan, ahivangin datmo le thilchom beh-in agel’un apaitauve.

tcz: Israel miten gan-kilhaina thilto angailuvin, ahinlah hichu keidin pannabei ahi.
en_web: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
en_kjv: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; But the Lord accepteth them not; Now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: They shall return to Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahenga gam athat’un asa aneuve. Hijongle Kei-Pakai hi achunguva kalung lhaipoi. Hijeh a chu achonset’u kageldoh a, talen kamatsah ding, Egypt gama kanungsol kit ding ahi!

tcz: Israel in asempa asumilin, in thupitah tah asan, chule Judan kulpi nei khopi apunsah in ahi. Hijeh a chu keiman khopi ho chunga mei kasol ding, hichun, aleng inpihou akah chai ding ahi.
en_web: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
en_kjv: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; And Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: But I will send a fire upon his cities, And it shall devour the palaces thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israelten leng inpi tampi asemdoh-un, ahivangin Asempau asumil tauve. Judahten kulpi kikaikhum khopi tamtah asadoh-un, ahivanga leng inpiho le khopi chengse chu kahal lhahding ahi,” ati.

tcz: O Israel mipite, Namdangte ho bangin kipah hihun. Ajeh chu na Pathen a dinga tahsan umtalou, notia pang dinga nangmatah kijoh nahitai. Changphol chung jousea gamchom mite pathen- nahoutai,
en_web: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
en_kjv: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: For thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, Thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israelte, doihou ho banga kut nabol chengseu hi ngauvin. Na-Pathenu dalhan navah mangun, Ama din kitahna nanei tapouve. Gamsung pumpia Baal koma noti bangin nakijoh tauvin, aman napeh-uva nagel’u chang nadei lheh-ui.

tcz: Abonchauva changphola chang in avah va lou ding. Lengpithei konga lengpi thei in jong ato loudiu ahi. Lengpi twithah kichilin jong abonchauva ato louding, chang lou ding ahiuve.
en_web: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
en_kjv: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, And the new wine shall fail in her.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivanga nachangu beivah ding, olive thao beisoh a, lengpitwi jong lhasam ding ahi.

tcz: Hijeha chu Pakai gamsunga chengden lou diu, Ephraim vang chu Egypt gam'a kile kit ding ahi. Chujongle Assyria gam'a jong chu amahon an thenglou aganeh diu,
en_web: They won’t dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
en_kjv: They shall not dwell in the Lord’s land; But Ephraim shall return to Egypt, And they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai gamsunga Israelte chengsot lou diu, Egypt gama kile tol kit’uva, Assyria gamsungaanboh aga neh diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai houna dinga juning jong alhit lou dingu, kilhaina gantha ijat bol jongleu alungu lhai lou dingu ahitai. Aneh dingu changlhah jong chu kap le lunghema aneh diu ahi. Hitobang an ho chu abohkhat in atohkhah a boh bonga bohsoh ahitan, nehthei hijeng jongleh Pakai houin'a ato thei lou diu ahiye.
en_web: They won’t pour out wine offerings to the LORD, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, Neither shall they be pleasing unto him: Their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; All that eat thereof shall be polluted: For their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche migam sunga chu Pakai koma lengpitwiya kilhai thei lou diu, kilhaina gan jong atha thei lou diu ahi. Aneh chah-uvin anechan asuh boh a, thi-opsa kine tobang hiding ahi. Oivana dia kinebou hi ding, Pakai Houin a kitoh banga kisei thei louding ahi.

tcz: Phat neiya kibol kut chu, iti naboldiu ham, Pakai dia golvah nikholeh ipi boltauvin natem?
en_web: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
en_kjv: What will ye do in the solemn day, And in the day of the feast of the Lord?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai choi-atna kut bol phat hung lhun teng ipi abol diu hitam?

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho kisuhgamna jeh'a chemang ahitauve, Egypt in akhop khom dingu, Memphis in avui dingu ahi. Adangka kholnao mun nom ho chu ling dimding chule ahoubuh sunguva jong ling ho keh ding ahi.
en_web: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
en_kjv: For lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: The pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: Thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Manthahna hung lhun a mipi kithecheh teng, Egypt miten achop khom diu, alhoh khom’uva Memphis a vui diu ahi! Agouvu dangka le ain mun jouseu chu lingle khao dimset’a hung keh ding ahi.

tcz: Gotna kipehna ding nikho ho ahung lhungtan, kilethuhna nikho ho ahunglhungtai. Israel in hichu ahet ding ahi, nakhan gitlounao adimset jehle hotna lentah umho jeh chun “Themgao chu mingol ahin, chule lhagao mi chu michavai ahi.” tin naseiye.
en_web: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
en_kjv: The days of visitation are come, The days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: The prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, For the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
tcz_gospelgo: Talen matsah phat ahung lhung tan, athoh ding mipin athoh phat ahunglhungtai. Hiche hi asoteng Israel’in hanante. Nanghon, “Hiche themgaopa a-ngol’in, Pathen hu-lha khumpa hi atanangtai,” natiuve. Nachonset behseh jeh-un mipin hibang hin neiho’uve.

tcz: Themgao chu Israel pumpi Pathen dinga khongahpa ahin, ahijeng vanga chu achena chan-a thang kikampeh ahin, Pathen houin sunga jong hotna adimset tai.
en_web: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
en_kjv: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: But the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, And hatred in the house of his God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin amite Israel gihsal dia eihinsol ahi. Ahivangin kachena chan a vacha thang kikampeh bangin kipalsah neigo’uve. Pathen gamsung nah nah aching miten Themgaopa adouvuve ong!

tcz: Kamite natoh ho chu, tumasang Gibeah nikho laiya bangin asetnau anasabeh seh jengtai.
en_web: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
en_kjv: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: Therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Gibeah a aumchan bangun, kinepna beihel thilse jeng bol ahitauve. Pathenin achonsetnau gel jingintin, talen amatsah tei ding ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye, “O Israel, amasapen-a kanamu chun, gamgo lah-a lengpi theiga hingset bangin kamun ahi. Napu napateu kanamu chun, aphat laiya theichang agamasa amin banga kanamu ahin, ahivanginla amahon Baal-peor lampia acheuvin, amahotah akipelutun, jachat umtah milim houna munah akiheilut tauve. Hetman loukah in thet umtah chondihlou asohtauve. Chondihlou ahiphat un chonna dihlou milim ahou tauvin ahi.
en_web: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
en_kjv: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: But they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; And their abominations were according as they loved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel kamudoh til chun gammang laiya jam lengpigui tobang ahi. Napu napate kamu til chun, aphatcha theichang ga min mudoh kabangin ahi. Ahinla Peor molsang ahung geiyun Baal doi ahou pan’un, aseichat’u doiho bangin kidah dah aumdoh tauve.

tcz: Israel aloupina ho chu vacha banga leng mang ding, chahing jong umlou ding, agaijong umlou ding, naovop jong bei ding ahi.
en_web: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
en_kjv: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, From the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel loupina vacha banga leng mang loi ding, cha le nao jong aneikit lou diu, numei naovop l aumpon tin, nao peng jong umbe ponte.

tcz: Cha neimong mong jongleu, kasuh beiya pul kadousah ding ahiuve. Keiman kakiheimanga nachanga kadalhah tengle, hichu hahsatna nikho hiding ahi.
en_web: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
en_kjv: Though they bring up their children, Yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: Yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
tcz_gospelgo: Cha le nao vahdoh jongleu kathagam a khat beh kahoipeh lou didng ahi. Hiche mite kadalhah teng achunguva datmo umtah thil soh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Keiman Israel kavetlhih jing ahin, Tua a hoi banga hoi ahi. Ahinlah tua hi achate tha gamna dinga Israel kipuidoh ding ahi.
en_web: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
en_kjv: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: But Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, achateu min athagam peh kamui.

tcz: O Pakai namite dinga ipi iti kathum peh ding ham? Kathum ding chu nao penlhah louna dinga naobu, nao-an atwi beina ding ham!
en_web: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
en_kjv: Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche mite hi ipi nabolpeh dia ka-ngeh ding ham? Anumeite jouseu chinsah-in, vah ding chasen neisau hen!

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye, “Achon phatlou nau jouse hung kipatna hi Gilgal ahi. Hichea patna chu kavetda nau hung kipan ahitai. Kagamsunga kona amahohi katheh ngim ding ahi, ajeh chu amahon kadeilou chonset aboldoh jeh uva. Keiman kangailut kittah houhel dingu ahitai. Ajeh chu alamkai hou jong gucha ahibouve.
en_web: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
en_kjv: All their wickedness is in Gilgal, for there I hated them: For the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: All their princes are revolters.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Athilse bol chengseu hi Gilgal a hung kipan ahi. Gilgal a pat kahinvet da pan ahitauve. Thilse abol jeh-uva kagamsunga kona kadeldoh ding ahiuve. Alamkai jouseuvin eidouvun, lungset kit taponge.

tcz: Israel mite chu akigotdan danu alhasamun, Ajungu jong agolhagam tan ahi, Chule athingphung jong gatalou ding ahi. Chule cha hing namao jongleh katha ding ahi.”
en_web: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
en_kjv: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: Yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi ajung gosa, gathei lou thingphung tobang ahiuve. Cha le nao nei tapouvinten, nei mongu jongle a-it tah tah-u achateu kathagampeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ka Pathen in Israel mite chu apaidoh ding ahitai. Ajeh chu amahon kathu ngaipovintin, nitpouvinte. Amaho chu inneilouva namdang mite laha vahkoi leding ahiuve.
en_web: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
en_kjv: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: And they shall be wanderers among the nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha kapan Pathenin amite paiyinte; ajeh chu amahon athu ngaipeh aneipouve. Namtin vaipi lah a vah thai ding ahiuve.

tcz: Israel hi iti khanna khangtou hiuvem? Kihoithosahna lengpigui, aga bohkeng konga ga. Agamsungu ahao jep jepleh, gamchom mite indoi jong atamcheh chehin ahi.
en_web: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
en_kjv: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: According to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; According to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi lengpigui ga phatah bang ahiuve. Ahao cheh-ule maicham asembe cheh-ui. Agam gau apun cheh le, doikhom song asemhoi cheh cheh-un chibai aboh-uve.

tcz: Alungthimu jong jou le nal jeng adimset in, hijeha chu tua hi athemmo nau mo akipoh teidiu ahi. Alungthimu hoitalou hijeha chu gotna chang dinguahi. Pakaiyin amaicham jouseu jong asuhsetna, aphuh lhuh ding, adoikhom joseu jong asuh mang soh kei ding ahi.
en_web: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
en_kjv: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: He shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthima lepche jing miten achonset man athoh gim tei diu ahi. Pathenin amaicham jouse susen tin, doikhom dong jouse sumanginte.

tcz: Chutengleh amahon seijuntin, “Keihon leng kaneipouve, ipijeh-inem itileh keihon Pakai kaging tapouve, ahinlah kaneijuvin jong, ipi eibol peh behuvem?”
en_web: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear the LORD; and the king, what can he do for us?”
en_kjv: For now they shall say, We have no king, Because we feared not the Lord; What then should a king do to us?
tcz_gospelgo: Hetman louva hiche mite hin, “Pakai igin loujeh-un leng inei tapouve. Neijong leu hen leng chun eiho dia ipi aboljou nah ding ham?” tiuvinte.

tcz: Thu homkeo asei seijuvin, jouva kihahsel abol boljengun, kitepna asem semjengui. Hijeh chun loulaiya tucha nunga dumom keh dondoh bangin thinathei thu kitan chu ahung sohdohjinge.
en_web: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
en_kjv: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: Thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu homkeo aseiyun, jouva kitepna asem’un, chule pannabei kigahna asem’ui. Thudih thudihlou asouvin, lou laiya lounamse pungtel tul jeng abange.

tcz: Samaria khopia chengte chu, Beth-aven a bongnou lim kisem jeh'in abonchauvin akihot lhul gam tauve. Hiche milim kisem chung chang jeh'a hi amite lungkham diu, Amilim houna'a thempua pang ho jong hung kap diu ahi. Aloupina akitol mang jeh'a lunghem diu ahiye.
en_web: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
en_kjv: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: For the people thereof shall mourn over it, And the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, For the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria khopia chengte kichauvin tin, Bethel a sana bongchal lim kisem manjeh a lungthoi diu ahi. Amaho le milimdoi limbol’a pang Thempuho kap diu ahi. Sana giltah tah akikhodoh teng kapsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche milim doi jong hi Assyria gam'a kitol mang ding, Chule leng lenpa henga kai apeh diu ahi. Ephraim jong milim doi ahou jeh'a ajumin van ahol ding, Israel jong kijum soa jachatna akimu ding ahi.
en_web: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
en_kjv: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, And Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche sana milimdoi hi Assyria gam kumpi minthangpa kaiya peh dia apoh mang diu ahitai. Thumop ajui ho jal’a Israel min avetda a, jumle ja athoh ding ahi.

tcz: Samaria lengpa jong mangthah ding, twi chunga thinghal kilap bang ding ahi.
en_web: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
en_kjv: As for Samaria, her king is cut off As the foam upon the water.
tcz_gospelgo: Twichunga thinghal kilap banga, alengpau min akai mang ding ahi.

tcz: Israel chonsetna jouse kisubei hel ding, aven khoa khomol doiphung jouse jong kisubei ding, amaicham phung jouseu a jong lingle khao hung keh doh ding ahi. Molsang jouse jaha jong neikhu khumuvin atiuva, lhangsang jouse jaha jong neile’uvin ati dingu ahi.
en_web: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
en_kjv: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: The thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; And they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; And to the hills, Fall on us.
tcz_gospelgo: Aven lhangvum doiphung, Israelten milimdoi ahou nau mun chu min asuhmang ding ahi. Amaicham phunguva ling le khao hng keh ding, mipin molle lhang sang ho jah a, “Neisel’un, neikhu’vin,” tia asap diu ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Vo Israel, Gibeah nikho laiya pat nangma chonse jingjeng nahin, Khantoubena imacha naboldohbe ima aumpoi. Hiche jeh'a hi Gibeah khopi gallin alonkhum lou ding ham?
en_web: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
en_kjv: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: The battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gibeah a achonset’uva pat Israelten Kei douna chonset atang tapouve. Hijeh a chu Gibeah agal’in alap den diu ahi.

tcz: Themmona avelvella anei jeh uva, hil lel pholel mite doudinga keima kahunga amaho dou dia namtin vaipi kakhop ding ahi.
en_web: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.
en_kjv: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; And the people shall be gathered against them, When they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
