tcz_gospelgo: Hiche mi chonsete hi delkhum ing ting talen kamatsah ding ahi. Amaho dou din namtin vaipi pangkhomin tin, achonset chengseu jal’a talen amat tei diu ahi.

tcz: Ephraim hi phatea kihil themsa chang chil ding thanom jing bongnou gol tobang ahin, Angong chang jolsilsel chu kadep dep ahin, Ahin Ephraim namkol kabupeha, Judan jong, lou akai teitei ding, Jacob jengin jong louva thingtum akitah ding ahi.
en_web: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.
en_kjv: And Ephraim is as a heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; But I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, And Jacob shall break his clods.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israel hi phat khat’in bongla gol lahngoisa, chang chil ding gosadema um ahin, angong jolsel’a namkol pohsah a natoh hahsa jo hil kagot anahi. Judah chu lou kaiyin kamangin, Israel thingtum kakaisah-e.

tcz: Nangma ding chehin chondihna muchi tun kitu soh keiyuvinlang lungset longlou chu aga kilo sohkeiyuvin lang, nalung tah chu kikhoikeh in, tuhi Pakai holphat ahitai. Pakai ahunga huhhingna nachunguva goju banga ajuhsahna dinga, tuphat tah hi Pakai hol phat ahi.
en_web: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
en_kjv: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, Reap in mercy; Break up your fallow ground: For it is time to seek the Lord, Till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman, ‘Louthah thah kaiyun lang, thudih muchi tun tu’uvin, kahenga nakipeh lut jal’uva vangboh chu lhosoh ga bangin kilo’uvin. Na-Pakaiyu Kei henga nahung phat’u ahitai, kahunga vangbohna kabuh lhah khum ding nahiuve,’ kati.

tcz: Ahilah nanghon gitlouna chu lou kaijin nakaiyun, khan gitlouna na tun, lepchena ga naneove. Ajeh chu nanghon nangho lampi seh sehle nami hat tamtah hobou natahsanun ahi.
en_web: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
en_kjv: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; Ye have eaten the fruit of lies: Because thou didst trust in thy way, In the multitude of thy mighty men.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla thilsejo muchi tun natu’vin, aga nalou tauve. Najouseiman naneh-u ahitai. “Ajeh chu nakangtalaiho le nasepai tampi nakison piuvin,

tcz: Tua hi namite chunga galkhoh tah hunga nakulpiu kisuse ding, Minu chu achate chunga ahel hela kitatkeh ding ahi.???
en_web: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
en_kjv: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, And all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, As Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: The mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla namite gal’in hindel khumin tin, nakulpi chengseu asuhamng ding ahi. Shalman lengpan Betharbel khopi gal a asuhmanga, nu nao chapang jouse asuhgam hel nikho chutoh bang dingahi.

tcz: Nakhan gitlouna alet jeh'a, Bethel in nachunga na atoh ding ahi. Jingkah lamleh Israel lengpa chu kisumang hel ding ahi.
en_web: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
en_kjv: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness; In a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Bethel mite, nathilse bol’u melset veng vung jal’a hitobang thil chu nachunguva soh ding ahi. Gal kisat pat pat le Israel lengpa thipai jeng ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Keima tahin Israel alamjot dingdan kahil ahi, kakhutah-a katua kana lamkaiyu ahi. Ahinla aman ima ahepon, donin jong eiseppoi. Hitiho chu keima kanahi lam jong ahepouve.
en_web: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
en_kjv: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; But they knew not that I healed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Israel lamjotje hil’a kahin, Kamite ka-angjangin kapomin; Ahivangin amaho kakhou khahna Amahon ahepha hih hel’ui.

tcz: Keiman ngailutna khaoguile voujang natna khaovin kana lamkaiyin, angonguva namkol kibut lahdohpeha pangpa tobang kanahin chule anehdiu kana luipehe.
en_web: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
en_kjv: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: And I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, And I laid meat unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hepi le ngailun kakou lut’in, Kabengto kasip beh jingin; kabungin aneh diu an kapei.

tcz: Ahinlah hichangeijin kamite kahenglama ahung kile pouvin ahi. hijeh chun Egypt gamah kinungle uvintin, namphu in Assyria jennauvinte.
en_web: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
en_kjv: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, But the Assyrian shall be his king, Because they refused to return.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahivangin kaheng ahinjon nom pouvin, hijeh a chu Egypt’a kile kit tei tei diu, achunguva Assyria mite vaihom ding ahi.

tcz: Akhopi hou chunga gal kisat umding, kelkot phunga kotgol jouse ataboh soh keija kulpi phungdunga chemjam alapdiu ahi.
en_web: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
en_kjv: And the sword shall abide on his cities, And shall consume his branches, and devour them, Because of their own counsels.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhopi chengseu galten lonvuh-in tin, kulpi kelkot chengse atumboh diu ahi. Thilpha pena agel’u thil jeng abol jal’uva gal’in kamite asuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Kamite keiya kona kinungtol kitdiu, Chunung Penpa tia eikoudiu, Ahinlah jana tahbeh eipenom hihunte.
en_web: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
en_kjv: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: Though they called them to the most High, None at all would exalt him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakoma kona jamdoh dingbou aseiyun, apoh-u namkol jeh a peng peng diu, koimanla asut peh deh lou diu ahi.

tcz: O Israel keiman nangho iti kadop sang thei diu ham? Keiman nang ho hi iti kasoldoh thei dingu ham? Keiman nangho hi Admah banga iti kasuhmang thei dingu ham? Ahiloule Keiman nangma hi iti Zeboiim tobanga kakoi ding ham? Kalungchang sunglamah akibotkehin chule kami khotona aletlhatai.
en_web: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
en_kjv: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? How shall I deliver thee, Israel? How shall I make thee as Admah? How shall I set thee as Zeboim? Mine heart is turned within me, My repentings are kindled together.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Israel, iti kapaidoh jouva, Iti kadonda thei ding ham? Admah bol’a kabol theiya, Zeboiim banga kabol thei nahim? Kalungthimin hiti chu eibolsah ponte, Ka-ngailutna asang behseh bouve.

tcz: Kalungnat tijat chu boldating, Israel suhmang kitdin gong taponge. Ajeh chu keima Pathen kahin, mihem kahipoi. Keima Atheng, nalahuva um chu kahin, nangho hung suhmang ponge.
en_web: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
en_kjv: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: For I am God, and not man; The Holy One in the midst of thee: And I will not enter into the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghan vangin talen matsah dang ting, Israel suhmang kit da tange. Pathen kahin, mihem kahipoi, Naumpi jing Athengpa chu kahi. Lung hangin hung kit taponge.

tcz: Itihham nikho leh mipiten kanung ahinjui dingu ahi. Kei, Pakai, Keipi banga kitum ding, Kakitumteng, kamite kitihot puma lhumlam-a kona hung kile diu ahi.
en_web: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
en_kjv: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: When he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
tcz_gospelgo: “Amelmateu chu sakei kisen banga kakisen khum teng, kamiten eijui kit tauvinte. Lhumlam a konin eihin del del jengunte.

tcz: Vacha honte banga amaho Egype gamma kona hung diu ahi. Vapalte banga, ti-kiling dingu, amaho Assyria gam'a kona hung kinung lediu ahi. Chule keiman inpia kapui lutkit dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, And as a dove out of the land of Assyria: And I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin vacha len hin thouvin tin, Assyria gama kona vakhu len ahintho diu ahi. Keiman a-inlum’uva kahin puilut kit ding ahi. Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Israel mite huiyin akivahin, chule solam hui lhi chu nilhum lhumin anung ajuiyuve. Amahon jou le gitlouna akan khomun, Assyria mite toh akikhut jop’un Egypt gamsunga thao apolut’un ahi.
en_web: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
en_kjv: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: He daily increaseth lies and desolation; And they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, And oil is carried into Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah a pat nilhah geiya Israelten abol’u hi pannabei le manthahna bou ahi. Lepthol le pumhatna alah-uva apung jinge. Assyria mite toh kitepna asem’un, Egypt mite to kiveikhom din akihouvui,” ati.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Judah mite dounan ahin nokhumin ahi. Jacob chu achonna dungjuija talen apeh ding, anatoh dungjuiya alethuh ding ahi. Ana tohdohsa jouse anung lesohkei ding ahiye.
en_web: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
en_kjv: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways; According to his doings will he recompense him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Judah mite douna sei ding aneiye: Israel jong amite umchan khan chah jal’a talen amatsah ding ahi. Athilbol dungjuiyuva alethuh cheh ding ahinai.

tcz: Anu oisung a kipanin asopipa asuh gentheiyin, Mihem khat banga ahung pen phatin, Pathen jeng jong akibotpin ahi.
en_web: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
en_kjv: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, And by his strength he had power with God:
tcz_gospelgo: Apuluiyu Jacob jong chu apenkhoppi a-upa Esau toh anu oisung, naobua aumlai lhonin akisato lhone; Jacob akhandoh phat’in Pathen to akibon’e.

tcz: Henge, aman vantil akibotpin, aman ajouvin ahi. Chule kap pumin akoma phattheina akithumin ahi. Hiche-a Bethel a chun Pathen kimaiton akimupin ahi. Chule Pathen in akihoulim pin ahi.
en_web: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—
en_kjv: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: He wept, and made supplication unto him: He found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;
tcz_gospelgo: Vanil to akibonin ajouve, akap’in vangboh athum jenge. Bethel muna ipuluiyu Jacob henga pathen ahungin akihoupi.

tcz: Pakai Pathen van gam sepaite Pakai kitihi ama min chu ahi. Hijeh chun tun, na Pathen henga hung kile kittan. Ngailutna le thutah toh gomin sodohin chule aphat jousen ama jengah kingai jingin,
en_web: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
en_kjv: Therefore turn thou to thy God: Keep mercy and judgment, And wait on thy God continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahile tun Jacob son ho, na-Pathenu tansan’un lang adih-in chon’un, na-Pathenu panpina chu thoh hat tah-in ngah jinguvin.

tcz: Ahinlah chutiponte, mihem hohi sumkolvei tobang ahibouve. Akhuttaha thil tejia kiveipan mi abol genthei dingbou adeiye.
en_web: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
en_kjv: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: He loveth to oppress.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte jong Canaan mite bangin alepthol’ui; nahenguva thilcho ho lepthol’in, adih lou thilte nan atepeh-uve.

tcz: Israel akiletsahin, keima kahou nai, Keima dingin vang kakisane! Koiman ka jou bol eimandoh ponte, Ka chung thuhi nolna umlou ahi” ati.
en_web: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”
en_kjv: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: In all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho pin, ‘Ikivei kan’un haodoh ihitauve, lepthol’a ihaodoh- hi koiman eihehse thei pouvinte,’ tin aseiyui.

tcz: Ahin keima hi Pakai na Pathen chu kahi, Egypt a soha natana kona nahuhohpa chu kahi. Chule keiman ponbuh sunga kahindohsah kitthei nahi. Kum kiheisih leh golnopma nabol tobanga chu,
en_web: “But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
en_kjv: And I that am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt Will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu, gamthip laiya nahung vil pau, Egypt a kona hinpuidoh pan, ponbuh a nachen banguva kachensah kit ding nahiuve.

tcz: Nangho gihna dinga kathemgao ho kahinsolin, gao thilmu tamtah le thulem tamtah tothon kahin sol’e.
en_web: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
en_kjv: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, And used similitudes by the ministry of the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: “Themgaote jah a thu tampi kaseiyin, mu tampi kaneisah-e, chule Themgaote mangchan kamite kagihsal jinge.

tcz: Ahinlah Gilead miho chu pannabei ahiuve. Ajeh chu milim houvin apang uvin ahi. Amahon Gilgala bongchalin ganlhaina abollun, amaicham semhou chu loulaiya songtum kigoltoh abange.
en_web: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.
en_kjv: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: They sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; Yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Gilead a milimdoi pou ahouvun, hiche houchengse chu thigam diu ahi. Gilagal a Bongchal ho kilhainan aneiyun, chukoma maicham ho jong chu a-onglai jousea songtum alhuh lhuh-in aseuve,” ati.

tcz: Jacob chu Ram gamsunga ajamlut in Ram gam'a chun Jacob in ajiding kelngoi vah'in akiloi.
en_web: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
en_kjv: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, And Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapuluiyu Jacob Mesopotamia gama jamlut din aumin, hikoma chun ji kilo nan mi na tongin akelngoite achinpeh-e.

tcz: Themgao khat amanchan, Pakaiyin Egypt a konin Jacob le achilhah ho ahin puidoh tan ahi. Themgao khat jeh'a Israel mite hi imacha boilouva hungdoh thei ahiuve.
en_web: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
en_kjv: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, And by a prophet was he preserved.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Egypt gama sohchang Israelte puidoh avetup din Themgao khat asolpeh-e.

tcz: Pathen in Israel mite khacheh in aphoh in ahi, ajeh chu amaho achonset puma athi dingu jong chu ahet ahitai.
en_web: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
en_kjv: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: Therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, And his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten Pakai asulung hang lheh jengun, achonset jel’un thi din akilom’uve. Pakai asuh jum jal’uva Pakaiyin talen amatsah tei diu lom ahi.

tcz: Ephraim in thu aseiya mipi lungsung atongkhah teng, akicha jiuve. Ahinlah Ephraim mite chonsetna chu Baal doihou hi ahin, Hiche chun hahsat nale gentheinaa apuilut’u ahi.
en_web: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
en_kjv: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; But when he offended in Baal, he died.
tcz_gospelgo: Masang laiya Ephraim phung miten thu asei teng, Israel phung dang ho akichauve; mihon Ephraim phung chu jatah-in aveuve. Ahinla amahon Baal ahouvun achonsetauve, hijeh a chu athilo tei diu ahi.

tcz: Tunjong chonset aboljom jingun adangkau ho chu akhengun milim doi in tamtah tah asemun ahi. Hitobang milim doi hohi mihem khut themho semdoh jeng ahibouve. “Hichea hi kithou jiuva” Kapjiuva, “chule bongnou lim chu achopjiu ahi!”
en_web: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’
en_kjv: And now they sin more and more, And have made them molten images of their silver, And idols according to their own understanding, All of it the work of the craftsmen: They say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset abol jom jingun, hou din milimdoi, dangka akhengun, mihem lung suhtoa kigel doh, mihem khut’a kisem ho pou ahouvui. Amahon, “Hiche ho hi kithoinan neiyun,” tin aseiyui. Hitobang milimdoi ho hi min iti achop theiya, bongchal lim a kisemthu chu iti kitahsan theiding ham!

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu, jingkah meibol banga mangthah diu, ni asotengleh mangthah tobang jingkah daitwi hidiu, Changsi huiyin amut teng alenmang tobang, Meikhu, apotna a hungpot doh tobangbep hidiu ahi.
en_web: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.
en_kjv: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, And as the early dew that passeth away, As the chaff that is driven with a whirlwind out of the floor, And as the smoke out of the chimney.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche mite hi jingkah daitwi banga leng mang diu, sunlai nisa kahgot bang ding ahiuve. Changphol a changpol hui lhoh mangbangle, meikhu longa meikhu kitungdoh tobang bep hi ding ahiuve.

tcz: Keima hi na Pakai na Pathen chu kanahi. Egypt gam'a kon nanapuidoh pachu kahi. Nangman nahet ding chu kei tilou Pathen dang umlou ahi. Hiche jeh'a chu huhhingpu adang umlou ahi nahet ding ahi.
en_web: “Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.
en_kjv: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, And thou shalt know no god but me: For there is no saviour beside me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “kei hi Egypt a kona nahinpuidoh-u Pakai na-Pathenu kahi. Kei tilou Pathen dang nanei pouve. Keibou nahuhhingpu kahi.

tcz: Gamthipgama chu kachintup nahiuve, Gamgolah kel leh dangchah nagama chun,
en_web: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
en_kjv: I did know thee in the wilderness, In the land of great drought.
tcz_gospelgo: Nelgam go lah a kakhou khah-un ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah naneh tengule nalung lhaijun, nakipa tenguleh nakiletsahun nei sumil ji tauve.
en_web: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.
en_kjv: According to their pasture, so were they filled; They were filled, and their heart was exalted; Therefore have they forgotten me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin gampha nalut phat’un naming lhingun na-oiva tauvin, kiletsah hoithon neisumil tauve.

tcz: Hijeha chu tua hi keipi bahkai kabah ding, Lutnu banga lampama kakisel-a kanga diu,
en_web: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
en_kjv: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: As a leopard by the way will I observe them:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh achu sakei mibokhum banga kabokhum diu, lutnu michan banga nalampiuva kachan lhih ding nahiuve.

tcz: Vompin acha akichom doh banga kachom ding, Nalungchang kabokeh ding, Keipi bahkai gilkel in abotal banga
en_web: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.
en_kjv: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, And will rent the caul of their heart, And there will I devour them like a lion: The wild beast shall tear them.
tcz_gospelgo: Anou mansah savom midel le kabah ding, kabotel ding nahiuve. Sakei mibolna banga amun akaval lhum jeng diu ahi, chule gamsa hang mibolna banga natel nadah a kajan diu ahi.

tcz: Nangma ka suhmang dingkon cha nahitai. O Israel, Henge, napanpi jing keimatahin kasuhmang ding nahi.
en_web: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
en_kjv: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kasuhmang ding nahiuve, Israelte! Kon nakithopi jou ding ham?

tcz: Tua hi nahuhhing ding nalengpa hoiya umtam? Tuhin nahuh hing tahtao! Tua hi gamsunga milen milal ho chu hoiya umgam hitauvem? Na lengpaule na milen ho chun kei eiholluve.
en_web: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
en_kjv: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? And thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
tcz_gospelgo: Leng khat nathum’un, lamaki ding mi tampi na-ngeh-ui, hiche ho hin najet’u iti ahuhhing jou ding ham?

tcz: Kalunghan laitahin leng kana peuvin, Kalungat phatin abonchan kaladoh soh tai.
en_web: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
en_kjv: I gave thee a king in mine anger, And took him away in my wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung phamosa sa kapeh leng ho chu kalunghan phat’in kasumangtai.

tcz: Ephraim phatlouna cheng akidong khomin, Chule achonset jouse gotna a dingin akikoi khome.
en_web: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.
en_kjv: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israel chonset le themmona lekha ajihdoh soh tan, phate chan akikoihe tai.

tcz: Mipite chunga natna chu hungding ahitan Nao sonat tobang hiding ahi. Amaho chapang tobang ahiuve. Alethuhna ding chu apengtai, Apettaha penna chu ahung lhung tai. Ahinlah amaho chu oisunga umnalai ahiuve.
en_web: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.
en_kjv: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: He is an unwise son; For he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel hin kihinsona thei phat pha khat aneiyi, angol behseh jeh-in akisan thiepon, naosen penglha din naobua hungdoh ding ada tobang bep ahitai.

tcz: Lhankhuha kona kalhadoh ding ham? Amaho thina-a kona kalhat doh ding ham? Vo thina mamidena chu hoi baham? Vo noimigam, namisuhmangna hoiba hitam? Achunguva lungsetna kakoi lou ding ahiye.
en_web: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.
en_kjv: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: Repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche mite hi noimigama lutna dia konin huhdoh pong ting, thina thahat’a konin jong huhdoh ponge. Vo thina namidena hinpo lut tan! Vo noimigam, manthahna hinlhut loiyin! Hiche mite hi voujang natpi kit taponge.

tcz: Ephraim chu asopite ho jouse laha gaso pentah ahi, ahinlah Pakaiya kona hung, neldi gam'a kon hui chun asem gotding ahi. A twisam jouse kangin tin, anei agou jouse jong mangthah ding ahi. Thil manlu anei jouseu chu min achoma akipoh mong ding ahi.
en_web: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of the LORD coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.
en_kjv: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, An east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, And his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: He shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel hi pumping bangin nalhasil sel jongle, nelgama kon niso lama kon huisave vuhung nungin tin, teinah phungle twikul jouse asemgot ding ahi. Thil manlu jouse alhoh mang ding ahi.

tcz: Kilekitin O Israel, na Pakai na Pathen hengah. Ajeh chu nathemmona jeh'a lhu nahitai.
en_web: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
en_kjv: O Israel, return unto the Lord thy God; For thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israelte, Pakai na-Pathen henga hung kile kit tauvin. Chonset jal’a kipal lhu nahiuve.

tcz: Nasuhkhel ho chu ponlang Pakai henga kilekittan. Akoma seiyin “Kachonsetna jouse neingaidamin, hepitah in nei lalut in. Chutengleh keihon, nangma kachoisang dingu ahi.
en_web: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.
en_kjv: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: Say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: So will we render the calves of our lips.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kile kit’un, ahenga hitin taovun: “Kachonset’u ngaidamin, katao nau sangin, kakitepsau bangin navahchoi unge.

tcz: Assyria in eihuh jou pouve. Keiho jong sakolte chunga toupovinge, Tukalla lhah keihon jong kakhutsoh-u milim doi jah ah ‘ka Pathen’ katikit louhel dingu ahi. Nachunga hin nulou palouten hepina akimujin ahiye” tiuvin.
en_web: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
en_kjv: Asshur shall not save us: we will not ride upon horses: Neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: For in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Assyria miten eihuh joupontin, galsat them dakolten eidal jou pouvinte. Milimdoi kasemho’u chu ka-Pathen danun sei kit hih hel unge. O Pakai Nangin bel ding neiloute nahepiji mong ahi,” toiuvin.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye, “Tahsan um nahijeha kadamsah ding nahiye, Kangailutnan gamgi aneipoi, Kalunghan najouse aimatihchana dingin mangtahen.
en_web: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
en_kjv: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: For mine anger is turned away from him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kamite kinungpui kit ing ting, Lung giltah a kalungset ding, Achunguva lung hang kit taponge.

tcz: Keima Israel a ding hitange, Vanna kon-a hunglha daitwi chimset tobang hinge. Israel chu Lily pah tobang hiding ahi, ajung jong leipha laiya thuh taha keh hihen, Lebonan lhanga Cedar tobang hin.
en_web: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
en_kjv: I will be as the dew unto Israel: He shall grow as the lily, And cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte dia gamgo lah a Gotwi julhah kabah ding; Pacha banga pah diu ahi. Lebanon lhang thingphung banga jungkho det chet diu ahi.

tcz: Abah lha jong olive thing bangin, namtwi sellin Lebonan-a Cedar phung tobang hihen.
en_web: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
en_kjv: His branches shall spread, And his beauty shall be as the olive tree, And his smell as Lebanon.
tcz_gospelgo: Thing nanou banga hingdiu, Olive thing hoiya hoi ding ahiuve. Lebanon lhang cedar thing banga Muinam jen jun diu ahi.

tcz: O Israel, milim doi a konin gamlauvin! Keima nataonau donbutpa chu kahi chule navengtup pao chu kahi. Keima thingphung dumjing jeng chu kahi. Nathingga jouse chu keija kon ahiye.”
en_web: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
en_kjv: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten milimdoi ahoukit louhel diu, Ataonau sanpeh a kahoidam ding, Thingna dum jing banga kanou sah ding, Vangbohna amu jouseu Keiya kon ahi,” ati.

tcz: Jite jousen hitihohi hethemuhen, Thil hetkhenna nei jousen phatechan ngaijuvin. Pakai lampi chu adihin chule ajange, Chule midih ho jouse amatoh umkhom ding ahiuve. Ahilah Michonse ho kiseplhuva kijam dan ding ahiuve.
en_web: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
en_kjv: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? Prudent, and he shall know them? For the ways of the Lord are right, And the just shall walk in them: But the transgressors shall fall therein.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Pethuel chapa Joel henga anasei ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
en_kjv: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathuel chapa Joel koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Hiche thuhi ngaijun, nangho mipite chunga lamkaihon ngaijun, gamsung’a cheng jousen, Na thusimuva hitobang hi sohkha mong nam?
en_web: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
en_kjv: Hear this, ye old men, And give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, Or even in the days of your fathers?
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiphauvin upate, Judah gama chengten ngaiyuvin! Nangho khang hihen napu napateu khang hile, Hitobang thil hi soh khan am?

tcz: Hitobang thu hunglhung ding hi nachateu henga seipeh’un, chule nachateuvin jong achateu heng’a aseipeh son dingu ahi. Thusim hi akhang akhanga kiseipeh son peh ding ahi.
en_web: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
en_kjv: Tell ye your children of it, And let your children tell their children, And their children another generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nacha nanaoteu seipeh-un lang, Amahon jong acha anaoteu aseipeh diu, amahon jong khang kit kit’a Mite aseipehson son dingu ahi.

tcz: Khaokhopin anche louhing aneh jouvin, amoh cheng Khaokhopi chom dangin anekit in, abankit in jong khaokho danghon anen akichainan jong khaokhopi chom khat in anekit in ahi.
en_web: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
en_kjv: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; And that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; And that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten.
tcz_gospelgo: Khaokhopiten ahon honin andong aneuve, Khaokhopi masaloi neh moh aban banin anetai.

tcz: Khangun, nangho jukham ho, chuleh kapun, na kamsunguva ju lhumkei akisuh mong jeh'in, judon hat jouse kap sohkeijun.
en_web: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
en_kjv: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; And howl, all ye drinkers of wine, Because of the new wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo jukhamho, thouvun kap’un pangun julop ho. Lengpitwi thah thah semna ding Lengpiga chengse asumangtauve.

tcz: Ka galmite simsen lou gal sat dingin kagam sunga ahung kitollut tan ahi, hattah ahiuvin, atam dan ajat jong simsenlou ahiuvin, aha-ujong ahemdan keipi bahkai ha abangin ahi.
en_web: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
en_kjv: For a nation is come up upon my land, Strong, and without number, Whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, And he hath the cheek-teeth of a great lion.
tcz_gospelgo: Khaokhopi hon jamah-in igamsungu alonvuh tan, Ahuse behseh jengun simsen jong ahipouve. Ahau jong sakei ha bangin ahemtheiye.

tcz: Ka lengpi lei le ka theichang phung jouse jong eisuh gampeh tauvin ahi, abahgeijin amalngimun agolhasoh heltan tai.
en_web: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.
en_kjv: He hath laid my vine waste, And barked my fig tree: He hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; The branches thereof are made white.
tcz_gospelgo: Ilengpiguiyu asumangsoh-un, Itheichangna anechaisoh tauve. Ana anechaisoh-un abah agosh tai.

tcz: Avoma kijem nungah jinei joutil kabangin,
en_web: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!
en_kjv: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nuh-ngah-in adongma thilong aka bangin, Mipi nabonchan kap jenguvin.

tcz: Pakai Houin sunga lhosoh leh Lengpiga thilto hojong abeisohtan, hijeh chun Pakai Thempu kin bolla pang lhacha ho jong alunghem gamtauvin ahi, chuleh Pakai Thempuho jong akaptauve.
en_web: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.
en_kjv: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; The priests, the Lord’s ministers, mourn.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin a to ding chang le lengpitwi abeisoh tai, Pakai koma toding beijeh-in Thempute along dongtauve.

tcz: Loulai jouse jong aki sugamsohin, gamsung jong abeitai, gasoh jouse jong aki sumong sohtan, lengpithei jong aga tapon chuleh olive thao jong akichai gam tai.
en_web: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
en_kjv: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; For the corn is wasted, the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Loujao la akeovin akijamtan, Chang kisuhgam leiset geiyin adoulel’e. Cahngdong kisuhgam phat’in Lengpigui jouse agop soh tai. Olive thing jouse agamtai.

tcz: Vo loulhouho kinepna beijin lunglhauvin, Vo lengpilei lhouho, puldouvun Kapun, ajeh chu loulaija gasoh suhlouchang leh sakol chang abeitah jeh'in,
en_web: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
en_kjv: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, For the wheat and for the barley; Because the harvest of the field is perished.
tcz_gospelgo: Lunghem’uvin loubol jouse, Lengpilei bolte kap’uvin; Suhlou change sakol chang, Cahngdong mimdong asugamhel tauve.

tcz: Lengpigui agop tan chuleh theichang phung agop lhatan, kolbuthei phung, tum phung chuleh theithup phung, chule thingga phung jouse agop lhasoh tan, mijouse kipana jong agop lhasohtan ahi.
en_web: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.
en_kjv: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; The pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, Even all the trees of the field, are withered: Because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpigui le theichang phung agosoh tan, Agathei thing jouse aheovin athitai. Hijeh chun mipi kipana jong abeitan ahi.

tcz: Nangho thempuho jousen khaodip pon sillin kivonun lang, Pakai kinbol Jousen jan teng maicham phunga hungun, kap’un, ajeh chu na Pathen Hou-in a na lhosoh thilto ding leh lengpitwi thilto ding abeisohtan ahi.
en_web: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
en_kjv: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: Howl, ye ministers of the altar: Come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God; For the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
tcz_gospelgo: Khaodip pon sil’in kap’un, Maicham phung lhacha Thempuho! Houin akitol touvn jan khovah-in lung gim’un, Na-Pathen napeh diu chang le lengpitwi abeitai.

tcz: An ngolding phongdoh un, Pakai Hou-in sung leh gamsung a mipite lultahin kou khomun, gamsunga lamkaiho jouse koukhomun, chuleh hichea chun kap jahuvin.
en_web: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.
en_kjv: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land Into the house of the Lord your God, And cry unto the Lord,
tcz_gospelgo: Japi khom’un lang an ngol ding deiyun, Lamkai chengse le Judahte khomsoh-un, Pakai na-Pathenu Houin sunga Kap’un ahenga thum’uvin!

tcz: Pakai nikho ahung naitai, Pakai hatchungnunga konin manthahna nikho chu ahung lhung’e.
en_web: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
en_kjv: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, And as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Nikho ahung naiye, Hatchungnungin manthahna abol ding Nikho chu ahung naitai; Hiche hikhon itobang tijatna aso ding hitam!

tcz: Eima ho mitmu taha inehdiu kisumong hilou hija, I-Pathen’u hou-in a kona kipa leh thanopna jouse beisoh hilou ham?
en_web: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
en_kjv: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, Yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-andong jouseu kinechai jeng kamoh vet’un, Ka-Pathen Houin a jong kipana abeitai.

tcz: Leinoiya muchi kituho akihul gosoh tan, thil kikholna in jouse jong akeovin aum soh tai.
en_web: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.
en_kjv: The seed is rotten under their clods, The garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; For the corn is withered.
tcz_gospelgo: Leigo lah a muchi athi thu thun, Changsal’a koi ding changla abeitan, Cahngsal keosa ho hi alhenglhona kijam ahitai.

tcz: Gam laha gamsa jousen jong itobang taha kel athoh’u hitam! In'a kivah gancha ho jong alung dong gam tauve. Anehdiu abeisoh phatin, kelcha leh kelngoite ho jong alungdong gamtauve.
en_web: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
en_kjv: How do the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed, Because they have no pasture; Yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh ding hamhing umlou jal’in, Gancha jouse, bong le kelngoi hon Akel lel soh gamtauve.

tcz: Pakai nei kithopiuvin! Gamsunga hamdon jouse jong meiyin akagop sohtan, Thingphung jouse jong meikongin aleogop soh tai.
en_web: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
en_kjv: O Lord, to thee will I cry: For the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, And the flame hath burnt all the trees of the field.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, meikah banga hamhing le Thingphung jouse got jeh a nahenga tao kahi.

tcz: Gamlaha gamsa ho jeng jong na henga apeng tauve, ajeh chu vadung jouse jong akang gamtan, gamlah-a hamdon jouse jong meiyin akagop gam tai.
en_web: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
en_kjv: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: For the rivers of waters are dried up, And the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung joouse akan jeh-in Gamsa ho geiyin nahenga ataovui.

tcz: Tumging tothon Jerusalema samun, kalhang theng chunga, galkon dingin awthongin samun, mijouse kichan kitihot lhulsoh keijuhen, ajeh chu Pakai nikho chu ichunguvah ahung lhung tai.
en_web: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD comes, for it is close at hand:
en_kjv: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: For the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
tcz_gospelgo: Sumkon mut’un, Pathen lhang theng Zion a kiginna khongpi vouvin. Kithing thing jengun Judahte, Pakai Nikho hung lhungvah ding ahitai.

tcz: Hiche hi muthim lhangkhal kiheh nikho, meibol satah leh vomletlut jeng. Hetman louvin, molsang dung jousea chun galmi nasatah leh thaneitah ahung konun, hitobang hi tumasang’a ana um khalou, umjong hung umkitlou ding ahi.
en_web: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
en_kjv: A day of darkness and of gloominess, A day of clouds and of thick darkness, As the morning spread upon the mountains: A great people and a strong; There hath not been ever the like, Neither shall be any more after it, Even to the years of many generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim khojin nikho, Muthim lhangkhal kiheh ni hinte. Molsang meilomin atom bangin, Khaokhote ahon honin ahung kitol’ui. Hitobang thil hi soh kha loulai ahin, Sohjong soh kit lou ding ahi.

tcz: Amasang’u meiyin akachaiyin, anung sang’u meikongin aleo velvullun, amasang’u Eden honsung abangin, anung lamu vang imacha umlou ahomkeo ahi.
en_web: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.
en_kjv: A fire devoureth before them; And behind them a flame burneth: The land is as the garden of Eden before them, And behind them a desolate wilderness; Yea, and nothing shall escape them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hamhing jouse meikah bangin anechaiyun, Alut masanguva Eden hon tobang gamsung chu Adalhah nungle akeohel’in, Imacha cha pou louhel’in, aumtai.

tcz: Aum dan’u Sakolte abangun, sakol galsat bangin amalama alhai lhai jengun,
en_web: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.
en_kjv: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; And as horsemen, so shall they run.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolte lheh lheh ahiuvin, Galsat sakolte lhaiyin alhaiyui.

tcz: Ahu sanletlut jengun, sakol kangtalai tampi gin abangin,molsanglai jousea alhuh lhuhin akijamun,mei’in changpol akahgin bangin apoh chet chutin, galmuna pong dinga kigoltoh sepaite thahattah tobang ahiuve.
en_web: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.
en_kjv: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, Like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, As a strong people set in battle array.
tcz_gospelgo: Molvuma akichop doh tengule Kangtalai kitagih abangun, Gamkanglai meikah abahsah-un, GAlsat dia kigoltoh sepai hon jamah abangui.

tcz: Mipite jouse akicha gamtauvin ahi, amai nguisoh keijun, aki tihot hot gamtauve.
en_web: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
en_kjv: Before their face the people shall be much pained: All faces shall gather blackness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung neitel tul’ule mitin akichan, Mitin mai anguisoh heljie.

tcz: Gal hangtah bangin adalkhum khum jenguvin, Sepaite bangin paldung jouse atom lhahdeh jengun ahi.
en_web: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.
en_kjv: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; And they shall march every one on his ways, And they shall not break their ranks:
tcz_gospelgo: Gal-hangho midel khum abngun, Sepaite bangin pal dunga akal’ui. Malam non akitol tol jengun, Ajotnau khel louhel’in acheuvin,

tcz: Khat le khat jong akinehto pouve. Ajotna ding lampi cheh a jangpetin acheuve. Itobang umjong leh chehchao louvin ajotpai pai jengun ahi.
en_web: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.
en_kjv: Neither shall one thrust another; They shall walk every one in his path: And when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Khat masanga khat asingpoi. Tho kikaiho jong adelpeh jengun, Imacha chan asutang joupoi.

tcz: Khopi jengjong atomchah sohkeijun, paldung jousea avahcheh sohkeijun, insung jousea alutsohkeijun, gucha bangin kotneo ho a alutun ahi.
en_web: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
en_kjv: They shall run to and fro in the city; They shall run upon the wall, They shall climb up upon the houses; They shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi alonvuh jengun, Palvum vuma akaldoh-uvin; Intingvum geiya akaltouvun, Guchate bangin in bangkot Sung dunga alut lut jengui.

tcz: A masang’u ling akihot leovin ahi. Nisa leh lhathah geijin athim deltan, Ahsi in jong avah-u apetapouve.
en_web: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
en_kjv: The earth shall quake before them; The heavens shall tremble: The sun and the moon shall be dark, And the stars shall withdraw their shining:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung kitol tengu leiset akiling leuvin, Vanthamjol geiyin akithing jin ahi. Nisa le lha athim leuvin, Ahsite jong avahji tapoi.

tcz: Pakaiyin a sepaite thu ahin pen, Awthonga sappumin alamkaiyin ahi. Hiche hi thanei tah galmi ahije, amahon athupeh anit sohkeijui. Pakai nikho chu anasa behseh jengin, tijat aum lheh jengin, kichat aum lheh jeng’e. Koiham hiche nikho dou jou ding’a chu!
en_web: The LORD thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of the LORD is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?
en_kjv: And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: For his camp is very great: For he is strong that executeth his word: For the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; And who can abide it?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin asepaite kolphe bangin thu apen, Athu ngai sepaite tamtah le hattah ahiuve, Pakai Nikho itobanga kichat um hitam! Ahingdoh thei idng koiham?

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Pakaiyin aseije, “Phat umpetin ka hengah hung kiheijun, Na lungthim’u neipeuvin. Anngol pum, kap pumin Chuleh lhase pumin, hungun.
en_web: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
en_kjv: Therefore also now, saith the Lord, Turn ye even to me with all your heart, And with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tu hijeng jongle, Thangsel’in lung heiyun lang, Kap le lung kisih chule an ngol thon Kahenga hung kilt kit’uvin.

tcz: Lhase pumin na ponsil bot’eh hihun, ahin na lungsungu bot tel jouvin. Na Pakai na Pathen henga hung kile kitun. Ama mikhoto leh lungset them ahijehin lunghang vahlou chuleh ngilutna dimset ahi. Thilsea kon’a alung khelji thei ahi.
en_web: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
en_kjv: And rent your heart, and not your garments, And turn unto the Lord your God: For he is gracious and merciful, Slow to anger, and of great kindness, And repenteth him of the evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakisih nau chun nalung gim phongdoh-un, Ponsil botel maimaiyin alhingpoi. Pakai na-Pathen heng hinjon kit’un. Mi khoto them, hepina lhingset ahi; Athoh hat’in akitepna anit jinge; Talen matsah louva ngaidam go jing ahi.

tcz: Ama kisih henlang kile heikit jong leh kon ija ahet ding ham? chule anunga phatthei bohna lhosoh thilto hihen lengpitwi thilto hijong leh masanga banga Pakai na Pathena ding ahi.
en_web: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God.
en_kjv: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, And leave a blessing behind him; Even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the Lord your God?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai na-Pathen’un lung akhel’a, Changle mim phatheiya nalha theiyu ahi. Chuteng nang hon chang le Lengpiteiya Ama nahou theiyu ahi.

tcz: Jerusalem a sumkon kimutun lang, anngol ding phat phongdoh un, mipite koukhomun, phattheiboh pumin kikhom’un.
en_web: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
en_kjv: Blow the trumpet in Zion, Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
tcz_gospelgo: Zion lhanga sumkon mut’un lang, An ngol ding seiyun, japi khom’uvin!

tcz: Mijouse khom’un, upa ho, chapangho chuleh chapangsen geijin, Mouneipu chu aumna dan sunga kon in koudoh hen.
en_web: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.
en_kjv: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, Gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: Let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi koukhom’uvin, Houbung kikhopna sem’uvin; Upa cheng koukhom’un, Chapangho le naosen ho koukhom’un. Kichengtil hon jong Indan sung dalha hung diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai umna muna Pakai lhacha kin bol’a pang Thempupa chu hongcha le Maicham kikah laiya chun ding hen lang kap uhen, taona mang hen. “Pakai! namite hoidohin! tin.
en_web: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, LORD, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
en_kjv: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, And let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, And give not thine heritage to reproach, That the heathen should rule over them: Wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
tcz_gospelgo: Houin hongchal le maicham kah a Pakai kinbol Thempu ho kap a tao diu: “Pakai namite khoton, Namdang ho totna le daithangin neikoi dauvin, ‘Na-Pathenu hoilamba hitam?’ tin seidau hen,” atiuve.

tcz: Pakaiyin amite lungset hen chuleh thangset’in amite gamsung vengtup hen.
en_web: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
en_kjv: Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, And pity his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin agamsung khohsahna aneitan, Amite ahepitan ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin donbut nante.“Ven! keiman changleh lengpiga thah chuleh olive thao, nangaichat lhingsetin kahin thot’e, Chuteng leh nava a naneh uva, chimsetna na dondiu ahi; chutah leh kenjong namtin vaipi laha seiset’a ka umsah lou dingu ahitai.
en_web: The LORD answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.
en_kjv: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, And ye shall be satisfied therewith: And I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
tcz_gospelgo: Ataonau adonbut’in aseiye: “tua vang change lengpitwi olive thao Kapeh ding nahitauvin, Lung nachima nanei diu, Namdang miten totna le Daithanga nanei lou diu ahitai.

tcz: Keiman hiche galmi hohi sahlam gamkal’a kadalmong diu ahi. Keiman Amaho hi gamjao laha kasol mong ding ahi. Amasanga pangho jong twipi thia kadellut ding, chu a anai lama umho jong Mediterranan dillen’a kadellut ding ahi. Chutah le thillui namlet lutin kitungdoh inte, ajeh chu Pakaiyin thil lentah aboldoh tai.
en_web: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.
en_kjv: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, And will drive him into a land barren and desolate, With his face toward the east sea, And his hinder part towards the utmost sea, And his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, Because he hath done great things.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahlama hungkon khaokhote sugam ing ting, phabeppi nelgam sunga kadel lut’a, Amasa chengse Twimanga kalelut ding, Anunung chengse Mediterranea Twikhanglena kalelut ding ahi. Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilbolset chengseu jal’a kasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Kichahihun, kamite. Kipah unlang thanomun, Pakaiyin thil lentahho abol jeh'in.
en_web: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things.
en_kjv: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: For the Lord will do great things.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo loujaoho kicha hih hel’un, Pakaiyin nabolpeh thil ho jeh-un kipah thanomjo’uvin.

tcz: Kichahihun gamsunga gamsa ho jouse, gamsunga hampa ho gang taha Hung dondoh thah kitna eng kit ding ahi. Thingphung jouse jong hung ga kit ding ahi. Theichang phung leh Lengpi gui jong lhingsetin aga kitlhon tai.
en_web: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
en_kjv: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: For the pastures of the wilderness do spring, For the tree beareth her fruit, The fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
tcz_gospelgo: Gancha ho, kicha hih hel’un, Hamhing adumsoh tan, Gathei thingphung ho agatan; Theichangle lengpithei tampi agatai.

tcz: Kipahun, nangho Jerusalema um mite, kipahun na Pakai Pathen a. Akitahna vetsahna dingin aman gotwi ahin juhsah tai, chavang laiya jong ajuh sah kit ding chuleh gojuh lai jeng’a jong ajuh sah ding ahi.
en_web: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
en_kjv: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: For he hath given you the former rain moderately, And he will cause to come down for you the rain, The former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Zion mite, Pakai na-Pathenu Thilbol jal’in kipah thanom’uvin. Chavang go nengsel’in napeuvin, Phalbi gotwi le khallai gotwi nengtah-in napeuve. Chuteng Pakai panpi holchan huhinga um ding, Pakaiyin asei banga, Jerusalema um phabep jamdoh a, Kalhendohsa cheng hingdoh ding ahi,’ ati bang,” ati.

tcz: Changphol jouse jong chang dimsoh ding, chule umle bel jouse jong lengpitwi le Olive thao letlhasohhel ding ahi.
en_web: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
en_kjv: And the floors shall be full of wheat, And the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
tcz_gospelgo: Changphol jouse chang dimsoh ding, Lengpitwi le thao chilna khuh ho let lha ding ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseije, “Na mansah jouse namu kit ding ahi.” Thing lung nehjou sa, lungmul neh jousa, lungtol leh khaokhopi ten aneh jousa ho cheng na nungmu kit diu ahi. Nangma douna a hiche galmi hattah ho hinsol chu keima kahi.
en_web: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.
en_kjv: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, The cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, My great army which I sent among you.
tcz_gospelgo: Khaokhoten na-andongu anehgam kum sunguva Namansah chengseu kapeh kit diu ahi. Khaokhote hinsol’a jong Keima kahi.

tcz: Nehle chah nangaichat jouse namu kit ding ahi, chuleh na Pakai na Pathen na thangvah kit ding ahi, chutia chu, kamite chun jachatna amukitlou diu ahitai.
en_web: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
en_kjv: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, And praise the name of the Lord your God, That hath dealt wondrously with you: And my people shall never be ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh le chah nengtah a naneiyuva, Lung nachimtah a naum diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu navahchoi diu, Thil kidangtah nabolpeh Pau nathangvah diu ahi. Kamite kidaithang kit louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng leh keima kami Israelte laha aum’e ti nahet ding’u ahi, chule Keima na Pakai na Pathenu hing ting, chuleh Pathen dang aum poi ti nahet diu, chutia chu kamiten jachatna amukitlou heldiu ahitai.
en_web: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am the LORD, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.
en_kjv: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, And that I am the Lord your God, and none else: And my people shall never be ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng nalah-uva ka-um jing hetauvin nate, Israel, Koidang umlou Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu kahi hateuvin nate. Kamite daithanga kikoi kit louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh laitah ding chu Pakaiyin aseije, “Chuteng chuleh keiman Juda gamsung leh Jerusalem khopi hamphatna kasemphat teng,
en_web: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
en_kjv: For behold, in those days, and in that time, When I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Hicheteng chule Keiman Judah gam le Jerusalem Hamphatna kasem phat peh ding ahi.

tcz: Leiset pumpia galmi jouse Jehosaphet phaichama kakhop khom ding, Hichea chu thu katan ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Israel nam hi namtin vaipi laha alhoh thangsoh keiuvin, ka gamsung geijin akihomtauve”.
en_web: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
en_kjv: I will also gather all nations, And will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, And will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi khom ing ting, Thutanna phaicham kalhutsoh ding; Hikoma chu kamite abolnau jal’a Athuu katanpeh ding ahi. Israelte gamtin a athe thenguvin, Kagamsung, Israel akihomtel tauve.

tcz: Chuleh kamite chu soh dingin vang asanuvin, pasal chapang ho jong numei noti ho toh akilhehjiuvin, nungah khat geijin jong lengpitwi man din akijohjiuve, chule lengpitwi chu akham sasan adon jiuve.
en_web: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
en_kjv: And they have cast lots for my people; And have given a boy for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohchangho angsanin akihom’un, Noti l eju chohna din nu-ngah gollhang soh-in ajoh-ui.

tcz: Kei douna a ipibol nahiuvem, Tur le Sidon gam chule Philistia? Kei dinga nangho hi ipia kibol nahiuvem? Kei chunga phula dinga kigong nahiuvem? Nanghon kachunga phulah ding nagotuva ahileh, keiman jong natohnau chu hetman loukaha nachunguva ka sunlhahpeh diu ahi.
en_web: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
en_kjv: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, And all the coasts of Palestine? Will ye render me a recompence? And if ye recompense me, Swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Tyre, Sidon chule Philistia gam pumpi, ilo neigot’u ham? I-khat khat lethuh neigot’u ham? Neigot’u le mangangtah a kalethuh ding nahiuve!

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon keima dangka leh sana nalauvin, kakhol tupsa thil manlutah tah ho jeng jong na pomanguvin gamchom mite indoi houna a na koitauve.
en_web: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
en_kjv: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, And have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
tcz_gospelgo: Kasana dangka nachomgam’un, kagou chengse nahouin sunguva napolutsoh tauve.

tcz: Juda gam’a, Teko’ah kho’a cheng kelngoi ching hat, Amos kitipa heng’a, hiche thuhi ana lhung e. Judah gam’a Uzziah lengvaipoh lai chuleh Israel gam’a Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lengvaipoh laiya, ling kiho masang kum nina-a chu, hiche thuhi Amos in themgao thilmua anamu ahi.
en_web: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
en_kjv: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two year before the earthquake.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi Tekoa khoa kelngoi ching mi Amos thusei ho ahi. Ling kiho masang kum ni na, Judah gama Uzziah lal lai, Israelgama Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lal laiyin, thil hijat hi Pathenin Israel thudol’in aphongdoh tai.

tcz: Aman hitin aseije, “ Pakai ogin gimnei tah chu, Zion lhanga kon a hung kitum ding, chuleh Jerusalem khopia kon’a gamtin thong leuva hung ging ding ahi. Chuleh kelngoi ching ho hamhing dum jouse goplha ding, Carmel lhang’a hamhing ho geija goplha-a thigam dingu ahi.”
en_web: He said: “The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”
en_kjv: And he said, The Lord will roar from Zion, And utter his voice from Jerusalem; And the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, And the top of Carmel shall wither.
tcz_gospelgo: Amos’in aseiyin: “Zion lhanga Pakai akisenin, Jerusalema konin a-ogin akithonge. Hamhing jouse agopsoh tan, Carmel molsang hampa ageosoh tai,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Keiman Damascus khopi talen manlouva ka lha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amiten chonset abol bol jing uvin, anga deh pouvin ahi. Amahon Gilead mun’ah kamite chu thih kangkuiya chang kikui bangin abol’un, ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Damascus, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin asiyin, “Damascus kho mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a hi talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Galead mite sei theilouvin abolseuve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu Keiman Hazael lengpa inpi meiya kahal lhah ding, chuleh Ben-hadad lengpa kulpi jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.
en_kjv: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, Which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Hazael sahdoh leng inpia mei kahal’a, Benhadal lengpa kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman Damascus khopi kotpi ka tumboh ding, chuleh Aven phaicham a cheng miho katha gam ding ahi.
en_web: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: I will break also the bar of Damascus, And cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, And him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: And the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Damascu khopi kelkot jouse tumbong ing ting, Aven phaiya chengte le Betheden a vaihompa kadeldoh ding ahi. Syria gama chengte chu Kir gama sohchanga min akai diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Gaza khopi talen manlouva kalha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amiten chonset abol bol jeng’un, anga deh pouvin ahi. Amahon kho jousea miho abon’un sohchang in atolmang un, Edom gam’a soh in ajohdoh gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Gaza, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they carried away captive the whole captivity, To deliver them up to Edom:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gaza mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin Edom langa soh-in ajoh chai hel’uve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu Keiman Gaza khopi bang ho meiya kahal lhah ding, chuleh akulpi jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
en_web: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
en_kjv: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, Which shall devour the palaces thereof:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a hi Gaza kulpi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi jouse akah lhah ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman Ashdod mite ka suhgam ding, chuleh Ashkelon lengpa jong ka suhmang ding ahi. Chuteng Ekron douna-a keiman ka khut kalha ding, Chuleh Philistine mi ahing doh amoh chengse jong thigam diu ahi,” tin Hatchung nung Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
en_kjv: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, And him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, And I will turn mine hand against Ekron: And the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ashdod khopi le a Ashklon khopia vaihom ho kalahdoh ding ahi. Ekron khopi talen kamatsah a, Philistinete amoh chengse thigam ding ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Tyre khopi talen manlouva kalha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amiten chonset abol bol jengun, anga deh pouve. Amahon Israel toh sopi unao hina akitepnau asukeh’un, khojousea miho abon’un Edom gam’a soh chang in ajoh doh gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyrus, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, And remembered not the brotherly covenant:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tyre mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin soh-in Edom gama ajoh chai hel’uvin, jol le gol’a kitepna asemsau jong anit pouve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu, Keiman Tyre khopi bang ho meiya ka hallhah ding, chuleh akulpi jouse jong ka suhmang ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”
en_kjv: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, Which shall devour the palaces thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a hi Tyre khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Edom mite talen man louva kalha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon chonset abol bol jeng uvin, anga deh pouvin ahi. Amahon asopite, Israelte, chung’a chemjam apan’un adel jeng’un, dipdamna beijin aboltauve. Amahon, alungdam theilou jeh’un, asopite chu asat jing’un, chuleh nasatah in lunghang den in aum tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because he did pursue his brother with the sword, And did cast off all pity, And his anger did tear perpetually, And he kept his wrath for ever:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Edom mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Asopiteu Israelte chu sadel’in adel’un, voujang natpina aneipeh pouve. Alung hang han gjengun, lung damlou hel’in aum’uve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu Keiman Teman meiya kahal ding, chuleh Bozrah kulpi jouse jong ka suhmang ding ahi.
en_web: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”
en_kjv: But I will send a fire upon Teman, Which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Teman khopi kahal’a, Bozrah kulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Ammon mite talen man louva kalha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon chonset abol bol jeng uvin, anga dehpouvin ahi. Amahon gamgi kehbe na ding in, Gilead chu gal asat khum’un, numei gailai ho chemjam in agai acheuvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they have ript up the women with child of Gilead, That they might enlarge their border:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ammon mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah teiding ahi. Gam keh letna dia gal asat laiyun Gilead nupi gai geiyin ache jengui.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu keiman Rabbah khopi bangho meiya kahallhah ding, chuleh akulpi jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi. Hiche gal chu, chimpei nasatah kipei bang ding, chuleh huise gimnei tah gin bang’a, mi peng in husa kithong ding ahi.
en_web: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;
en_kjv: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, And it shall devour the palaces thereof, With shouting in the day of battle, With a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Rabbah khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi. Chuteng gal kisat khosam kithonga, kisatgin chu huise le gose kitho bang ding ahi.

tcz: Chutah leh alengpau leh leng chapate jouse abon’uva, migam’a sohchang ding’a kitolmang soh diu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And their king shall go into captivity, He and his princes together, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Alengpau le avaipote chengse sohchang dia kitol diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye. “Moab mite talen man louva ka lha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chun amahon chonset abol bol jeng un, anga dehpouvin ahi. Amahon Edom lengpa gu leh chang jouse meiyin ahal un, vutvam aso sah tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Moab, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because he burnt the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Moab mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Noise manjen she-in Edom lengpa gabuh jouse ahalvam’un vutdi asohsah-ui.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu keiman Moab gamsung meiya kahal lhah ding, chuleh Kerioth khopi kulpi ho ka suhmang ding ahi. Chuleh Moab mite chu gal’a ka leh mao na thum jeju lah’a, agalmi hon saki amut denuva thigam ding ahiuve”, ati.
en_web: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
en_kjv: But I will send a fire upon Moab, And it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: And Moab shall die with tumult, With shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
tcz_gospelgo: Moab gamsung kahal ding, Kerioth kulpi jouse kalhasoh didng ahi. Sepaiten sumkon mut’a kholhang asap tengu, Moab mite chu gal husa thigam diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng keiman alengpau ka suhmang ding, chuleh leng chapa teu jouse jong ka suhgam ding ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, And will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Moab gamsung vaihomte le gamsung lamkai jouse katha ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Keiman Judah talen manlouva ka lha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon chonset abol bol jengun anga deh pouvin ahi. Amahon Pakai peh chondan thuhil don louvin akoijun, chuleh athupeh jong anitdeh pouvin ahi. Apu apateu vamang na jou leh nal’a kilheplhahna ah avahmang gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Judah, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they have despised the law of the Lord, And have not kept his commandments, And their lies caused them to err, After the which their fathers have walked:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Kahilna la angaipouvin, kathupehho jong anit pouve. Apu apateu hou Pathen dihlou hon apui chatvaiyu ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu keiman meiya Judah kahallhah ding, chuleh Jerusalem khopi kulpi ho jong kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
en_kjv: But I will send a fire upon Judah, And it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gam kahal’a, Jerusalem kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Keiman Israel talen man louva kalha louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu, amahon chonset abol bol jeng un angadeh pouvin ahi. Amahon midih jong dangka lhomcha man in ajoh doh’un, chuleh tahlel vaichate jong kengchot to-khat toh aki lheh tauve.
en_web: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Israel, And for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; Because they sold the righteous for silver, And the poor for a pair of shoes;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Abat salel milungdih ho le kengchot to khat man jeng jong lepeh joulou vaichate soh-in ajoh-uve.

tcz: Amahon tahlel gentheite leivui lah’a achonlut nun, chuleh vaichate jong lampam’a asondoh un ahi. Apa leh achapa jong numei khat kom’a aga lumkhom ji lhon in, keima mintheng chu asuboh tauvin ahi.
en_web: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.
en_kjv: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, And turn aside the way of the meek: And a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, To profane my holy name:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi lhasam le panpi ngaite chotphan aneiyun, vaicahte lampia aneh doh-ui. Apa le achapan soh-nungah khat akitimatpi gel lhonin, hitobang hin kamintheng asuboh tauve.

tcz: Pathen houna maicham phung dung’a chun, aleiba teuvin, bat sahdoh kah’a ding’a apeh’u, ponsil ho akisil’un akijam leuve. Chuleh a Pathen’u houin sunga jong, thudihlou tah’a mi agap nau Lengpitwi adon uvin ahi.
en_web: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
en_kjv: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, And they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lhaina muntin a vaichate thil tun man a alah-u pon sil’in alum’ui. A-Pathenu Houin sunga jong sum batman a alah-u ju adon jiuve.

tcz: Amavang, kamite masang tah’a, Cedar thing banga sang leh Oak thing banga tah, Amor mite ana suhmang peh chu keima kahi. Keiman thingbah lah’a aga jouse jong ka sugam in, chuleh noi lam’a ajung geijin ka kaldoh in ahi.
en_web: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
en_kjv: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, Whose height was like the height of the cedars, And he was strong as the oaks; Yet I destroyed his fruit from above, And his roots from beneath.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahivangin kamite, nang ho khohsah jal’a, gangpi tah a tah, cedar thing san a sang Amor mite geiya kasuhmang ahi.

tcz: Egypt gam’a kon’a nahin pui doh uva chu keima kahi, chuleh kum somli jen nelphai gamthip’a nahinpuileu chu keima kahi. Hijeh’a chu nanghon Amor mite gamsung naloden theiju ahi.
en_web: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
en_kjv: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, And led you forty years through the wilderness, To possess the land of the Amorite.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin kahin puidoh-un, kum som li sungin gamthip noiya kapuilen, Amor mite gam chu nangho kapeuve.

tcz: Keiman na chapa teu phabep themgaovin ka pansah in, chuleh adangho jong Nazir ka hisah e. Vo Israel kamite, nangman hichehi ahipoi tia na seithei ding ham?” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, And of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Nagollhangteu phabep Themgaovin kapanssah-in, adang phabep jong Nazirin kapansah-e. Kasei hi dih lou ham Israel te? Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.

tcz: Ahivang in, nangman Nazir ho jong, ju na donsah in chonset na bolsah e. Chuleh themgao ho jong gao thu seilou ding’in naphoh thiptai.
en_web: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
en_kjv: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; And commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Nazir ho ju nadonsah-un, Themgaoten kathu aseiphong diu nakhah-ui.
