tcz: Hijeh’a chu, keiman thohgim tah’a kalha ding, bongkang changpal dimset kiheng’a uh jen jun bang’a kalha ding, kasuh nem ding nahi.
en_web: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
en_kjv: Behold, I am pressed under you, As a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang toljepna kanei diu, changing kangtalai adelnem kabehsah ding nahiuve.

tcz: Nalah uva akal jang pen jong jammang deh lou ding, chuleh atha hat pen jong pang jou dehlou ding ahi. Thahattah’a galsat hon jong, ahinkho akihuh doh joulou diu ahi.
en_web: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.
en_kjv: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, And the strong shall not strengthen his force, Neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kaljangtah jong jamdoh lou ding, thahat’a jong thabeiya, sepaite jong kihinso jou lou diu ahi.

tcz: Thalpi kap’a pangho jong ding det joulou diu, chuleh Sakol chung touthem ho jong, amaho leh amaho kihuhdoh jou lou diu ahi.
en_web: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.
en_kjv: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; And he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: Neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Thal thempa jong pang jou lou ding, kaljang jong jamdoh man louva, sakol touthemho jong kihinso jou deh ponte.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh gal hang pen’a panghon jong, agal manchah’u ase lhah diu chuleh ahindoh nadiuva jamdiu ahi”, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And he that is courageous among the mighty Shall flee away naked in that day, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chule sepai hangpenin jong manchah paiya jamding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho douna thu asei hi ngai jun, Vo Israel leh Judah mite, keiman Egypt gam’a kon’a kahin puidoh na insung pumpi douna-a kisei ahi.
en_web: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
en_kjv: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, Against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israelte, Egypt’a kona ahinpuidoh nam pumpi, nachung changuva Pakaiyin asei thu hi ngaiyuvin.

tcz: “Leiset chung mihem insung jouse lah’a, keiman nangho bou kahet nahiuve. Hijeh’a chu na themmo nau jouse chung’a, tei tu ding nahiuve”
en_web: “I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
en_kjv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
tcz_gospelgo: “Leiset namtin vaipi hijat lah a kahet le kakhohsah-nang ho bou nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nachonsetnau jong khoh deh a kigel, hicheng jeh tah a chu talen kamatsah tei ding nahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Ajotna ding mun kihoutoh masa louva, mini lampi khat’a kijot khom thei mong hinam?
en_web: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
en_kjv: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
tcz_gospelgo: Kihoutoh masa louva mi ni kholjin khom nam?

tcz: Neh ding kimat masah louva, gammang noija sakei bahkai hutum ngai am? Chuleh aneh ding ima kimat louva, sakei bahkai nou jong peng mong hinam?
en_web: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
en_kjv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? Will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
tcz_gospelgo: Sa manlou gamthip’a sakei kitum nam? Mat khah neilou sakei nou akosunga kithol lem?

tcz: Anchah beija kikam thang’a, vacha oh thei mong ding ham? Achonpil umlouva tol’a thang kikam chu kipil thei ding ham?
en_web: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
en_kjv: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? Shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
tcz_gospelgo: Thang kampeh louva vacha thanga oh ngaiyam? I-toh khah louva thang jangkam kipel ngaiyam?

tcz: Gal ginna pengkul kimut teng, khopi mite tija louva umthei ding ham? Pakaiyin abol louva ahileh khopi chung’a thilse moh lhun thei ding ham?
en_web: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?
en_kjv: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sunga gal sumkon kimut teng mipi kicha louva um theiyem? Pakai sol tilouva khosunga manthahna lut ngaiyam?

tcz: Dihtah mong in, Hatchungnung Pakaiyin, alhacha themgao ho henga phongdoh masa louvin, imacha aguh in abol hih hel e.
en_web: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
en_kjv: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, But he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha Themgaoho koma phongdoh masa louvin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin athilgon ima atongdoh ngaipoi.

tcz: Sakei bahkai akitumtai, hijeh chun, koiham akicha lou ding? Hatchungnung Pakaiyin thu asei tai, hijeh chun, koiham Pakai thuseiphong jal lou ding?
en_web: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
en_kjv: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? The Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei kisen teng kicha lou didng koi ham? Hatchungnung Pakaiyin thu asei teng, athusei phongdoh lou ding koi umngaiyum?

tcz: Hiche thuhi, Ashdod mipite leh lamkaite heng’a phongjal un, chuleh Egypt gamsung a milen milal ho heng’a sei phong leuvin. Tun, nangho Samaria leh akimvel’a molchung dung a hung kikhom uvin lang, Israel mite kibol gentheina leh acheh chao nau hi hungve uvin” ati.
en_web: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
en_kjv: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, And in the palaces in the land of Egypt, And say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, And behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, And the oppressed in the midst thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt le Ashdoh khopi leng inpi dunga chengte koma gaphongun, “Samaria kimvel lhang sang joudsea hung kikhom’un, akhosunga kinahla le kitonona, thilse kibol chengse khu veuvin,” tiuvin.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye, “Kamiten thudihtah’a thil bolje ahaimiltauve. Akulpi hou jong, pumhat leh guchat’a kichom khom nei leh gou dimset in akholkhom tauvin ahi.
en_web: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
en_kjv: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche miho hin ain jouseu pumhat le dih louva kichom doh thilkeo adip’un, lungthenje jong ahepouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye, “Melma na kidoupi khat ahung kon’e. Aman gamsung pumpi aumchah kheh ding, kivenna pal ho jong aloichim ding, chuleh akulpiu jouse jong asuh chim ding ahi.”
en_web: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
en_kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; And he shall bring down thy strength from thee, And thy palaces shall be spoiled.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu melma khat’in agamsungu umchah-in tin, akulpi chengseu asuhmanga, a-in ho’u jong achomgam ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Kelngoi chingpan sakei bahkai kam sunga kon’a kalngoi huhdoh agot’a, akeng teni leh abilkol khatseh bou achulhah ham ham ji bang a, Samaria khopi a nomsa tah’a cheng Israel chate leh Damascus khomite chu, alupnau jalkhun ningchong kah’a abong abaiya kiloidoh ding ahiuve.
en_web: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; So shall the children of Israel be taken out That dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingpan sakei nehmoh kelngoi keng ni ham ahiloule abilkol khatseh ham amudoh banga, tua insung choldo mun nomtah tah a aning anop’a chon Samaria khosung mite amoh themcha bou hingdoh diu ahi.

tcz: “Ngai uvin, chuleh Israel dounan gamsung pumpia thu gasei jun,” tin , Pakai, van Pathen chun aseiye.
en_web: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
en_kjv: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, Saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,
tcz_gospelgo: Tun ngaiyuvin, Jacob chilhah ten, Thanei Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin,

tcz: Hche nikho chuleh keiman achonset jal’a Israel chu talen ka matsah ding, Bethel kho’a milimdoi maicham’a saki ka satlhah’a, chuleh maicham phung jong ka suhmang ding ahi.
en_web: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
en_kjv: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: And the horns of the altar shall be cut off, And fall to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Israel achonset jal’uva talen kamatsah ni le Bethel a maicham sumang ing ting, maicham ningli saki chengse kiheh bonga tol’a lhamang diu ahi.

tcz: Chuleh mihaosa hon phalbi-in ding’a asah’u innom tah ho leh nipilai-in dinga asah’u inho jong, chuleh saiha-a kisa leng inpiho jong abon’a ka suhmang ding ahi.
en_web: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; And the houses of ivory shall perish, And the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Phalbi lai le nipi lai in jouse jong lhu lhama inngem soh diu, in len chengse jong kisumang ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Ka thusei ngaijun, Samaria gam’a cheng bongpi tobang ho, vaicha gentheite bolgim’a chuleh panpi ngaicha geuva um tahlel te noigep gep jiho, Ajiteu pasal ho jah’a,’ “Ju hin dom kit in don’u hite’’ tia peng jah jah vo numei ho!
en_web: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
en_kjv: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, Which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, Which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi ngaiyuvin Samaria khosung numeiho, Bashan phaiya kivah thao bongpi banga kivah thao ho, tahlelte bolsea, vaichate sugenthei, najipateu henga jut hum jing jeng ho!

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakai chu ama mintheng pan in aki hahsel tai, vetan, na chung’a hiche nikho chu hunglhung ding ahi; Mihon nanah hom uva ngakoi tobang thihkoija na kaimang dingu, Amitakip anukhahpen geija ngakoija na kaimang ding’u ahi.
en_web: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.
en_kjv: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, That lo, the days shall come upon you, That he will take you away with hooks, And your posterity with fishhooks.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pakai hi athen bangin akihahsel’in, “mihon thihkoiya nakoiyuva, amichang cheh thihkoiya nga kiman banga namatna diu nikho hung lhung ding ahi.

tcz: “Nangho kulpi pal chimlha lah’a na jamdoh diu, Na kulpiu sunga kon’a naki sep doh diu ahi,’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; And ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pal chim anaipen koma nakailut’uva polama napai mang diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: “Cheuvin, Bethel kho’a doihouna kilhaina thilto gabol un, Gilgal kho’a cheuvin, Pathen thungailou vin setna gabolbe be jeng tauvin, Jingkah seh in kilhaina bol un, chuleh nithum lhinseh in na hopsom hinchoi jun,’’
en_web: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,
en_kjv: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; At Gilgal multiply transgression; And bring your sacrifices every morning, And your tithes after three years:
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, Bethel a namuntheng phunguva cheuvin, deilheh nahiule gachonsetau! Gilgal’a cheuvin najochanin chonseuvin! Cheuvin, jingkah seh a kilhaina din dancha hintol tol jengun, nithum lhinseh le hopsom toh toh jenguvin1

tcz: “Na changlhah cholsosa chu Pakai thangvahna thilto in toh'in, chu ting, deichom’a nangma kipehna thilto jong pen; chuleh hichu muntin’a phongjal un seichoi le uvin!
en_web: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.
en_kjv: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, And proclaim and publish the free offerings: For this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord God.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipat’un thangvahna din changlhah thilto toh toh jengucin, chule natoval jeh-un kithang-at at jengun! Hitobang thil ho holnom nahiuve.

tcz: Na khopi jouseu chunga neh leh chah kalhahsam sah in, nachenna mun jouse uva nehding beihel in kalhan, kel ka lhunsah tan, Ahivang in nangho ka henga nahung kiledeh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And want of bread in all your places: Yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nakhopi jouseu kel lhahsah Kei kahin, ahivangin kaheng nahin jon deh pouve.

tcz: Na lousoh ga houvin gotwi angaichat khohlai tah in, go ka juhsah dan, kakham tang tai, Chuleh keiman khopi khat chung’a go kajuhsah in, khopi chomkhat chunga ka juhsah da ji’e. Louma khat chunga go kajuh sah jin, louma chomkhat chunga kajuhsah da ji e.
en_web: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.
en_kjv: And also I have withholden the rain from you, When there were yet three months to the harvest: And I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: One piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-anche louhingun gotwi lhahsah lou Kei kahi, Khopi khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotangin, loujao khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotange.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, miho chu khopi tin’a donding twi hol in akijot uvin, ahivang in amahon lungna chimset’a donkham twi aga mudoh pouve; Hichan gei hin jong, nangho kahenga nahung kile deh pouve,’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; But they were not satisfied: Yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Dangchah a thi din naum’un, khopi tam tah a min kho chom khat’a twi thal ding kinemin acheuvin, donkham cha jong amupouve. Hichan geiyin jong neihin jon deh pouve.

tcz: Keiman na honlei chengu leh nalengpi lei chengu chunga thinglung leh nget kachuhsah in; Na theichang phung jouseu leh na Olive phung jouseu jong abon'in khaokhoten anechai soh hel tauvin; Hichan gei hin jong nangho kaheng’a nahung kile deh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: When your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, The palmerworm devoured them: Yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nalhosoh ga chengseu semheo din huise kalansah-in, nahonlei jouseu le nalengpi lei jouseu, natheichang phungu, chule olive thingna jouse khaokhoten anegamtan, hichan gei hin jong neihinjongpouve.

tcz: “Egypt gamsunga kana bol bang in, keiman nangho chunga gamna hise kalhalut in; Na golhang jouseu gal in kasat lih soh in, chuleh na sakol jouseu jong akikaimang soh hel tai. Na kimvel’u namse leuvin mithi-ui nanah hom dim in nanah’un, Ahivang in nangho kahenga nahung kilekit deh pouve,’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: Your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; And I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: Yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Egypt s kalansah tobang gamna hise kalansah-in, nagollhangteu galmuna kathat gamin, nasakolteu kalahpehsoh hel’in, na-ngahmun dunguva thilong monsa uithe thu kanahsah-un, ahivangin neihin jondeh pouve.

tcz: ‘’Keiman Sodom leh Gomorrah ka suhmang bangin, na khopiu phabep ka sumang in; Nangho ahingdoh amoh chengse jong, meikong lah’a kon’a kikaidoh thingbong bep na hiuvin, Ahivang in nangho kahenga nahung kilekit deh pouve,’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And ye were as a firebrand pluckt out of the burning: Yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Sodom le Gomorrah kabolna bangin abang bang kasumangun, ahingdoh cheng jong gamkang ka akiloidoh mei leoheosa molkang nabangun, hichan gei hin jong neihinbel deh pouve,” tin Pakaiyin aseiyin;

tcz: Vo Israel, keiman nang jong hitobanga chu kabol ding, hamsetna nasatah nachunga ka lhunsah ding ahi. Hijeh chun, na Pathen toh kimaito din kigong in, vo Israel!
en_web: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
en_kjv: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: And because I will do this unto thee, Prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Israelte, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Hita kabolgot’u ahitan, kathutanna thoh din kigo jengun,” ati.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, Pakaiyin molsang jouse atungdoh in, khohui jouse jong anunsah in, chuleh alungngaito ho jong mihem kom’a aphong doh ji e. Aman jingkah khovah leh janlai muthim asemdoh in, chuleh leiset chunga mun sanglai jouse chotphan anei jin ahi. Pakai, van Pathen kiti chu ama min ahi.
en_web: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: The LORD, the God of Armies, is his name.”
en_kjv: For lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, And declareth unto man what is his thought, That maketh the morning darkness, And treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The Lord, The God of hosts, is his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hi molle lhang huile go sempa ahin, Alunggel mihemte ahetsah jin; Senlai nisa jong jan asohsah theiye. Leiset sanglai molvum vuma kengto angam’e. Pakai Pathen thaneipen kiti hi Ama min ahi!

tcz: Vo Israel mite, na chung uva thi-op la kasah khum’u hi ngai cheh tem’un!
en_web: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
en_kjv: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, Even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israel, hiche thivui la kasha khumu hi ngai tem’un:

tcz: Nungah tobang Israel chu akiseplhu tai, avel’a dingdoh kitlou dingin tollhanga akijam den tai.
en_web: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
en_kjv: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: She is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah tobang Israel alhutai, Kiphongdoh kit louhel ding ahi! Donlouvin tol’a akijamtan, Akaithou ding abeitan!

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Galsat mi sangkhat avaikon teng, mi jakhat bou hung kile jia, mi jakhat avaikon teng, mi somkhat bou hingdoh’a hung kile ji ahiuve’’ ati.
en_web: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
en_kjv: For thus saith the Lord God; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, And that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, To the house of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel sung khopi khat’a galkon sepai sang khat soldoh thei chun, ja khat bou ahung kile kit’e. Khopi khatman jakhat asoldoh le som khat she ahung kilei,” ati.

tcz: Tun, Pakaiyin Israel mite jah’a hitin aseiye,’ “Nahin na diuvin, kahenga hung kilekit tauvin,
en_web: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
en_kjv: For thus saith the Lord unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Israelte jah a aseiyin, “kaheng hinjon’un kihinsouvin!

tcz: Bethel kho’a doi-pathen houdin amaicham phunga cheda uvin, Gilgal leh Beersheba mun’a jong doi houdin lut dauvin. Ajeh chu, Gilgal khomite jong sohchanga kikaimang diu, chuleh Bethel khomite jing imalou soh uva mangthah diu ahi,’’ati.
en_web: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
en_kjv: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, And pass not to Beer-sheba: For Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, And Beth-el shall come to nought.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hou didn Beersheba a chedauvin, Bethel’a jong neihung hol dauvin, Bethel chu mohseh soh iddng ahi. Gilgal’a che dauvin, amite min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Nahin na diuvin Pakai kom’a hung kilekit uvin, achuti louleh, Pakai chu Israel chunga meikou kisunkhum banga hung deujah ding, naboncha uva nakah vam diu, Bethel kho’a na-doi-pathen uvin jong hichu aphelmit thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.
en_kjv: Seek the Lord, and ye shall live; Lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, And devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai kom jon leu chun hinlo jo’uvin nate. Nache daule Israelte chunga mei-am kisunkhum hung bang ding ahi. Hiche meiam chun Bethel khosung mite kavamin tin, aphelmit jou umponte.

tcz: Nanghon thudih chu na heikon un, hesoh gentheite din changkha kine nabah sah’un, Nanghon athudih laitah chu kidah um nasosah’un, tolsenan nanei tauve.
en_web: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
en_kjv: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, And leave off righteousness in the earth,
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi achan ding lom lepthol’a, thudih dunghei vaihei tho loi ada nahiuve!

tcz: Pakaiyin ahsi ho asem in, ahsi lah’a Bombel leh Ngambom lungthu jong asem e. Aman muthim lhangkhal jong jingkah khovah asosah in, sunlai nisa jong jan muthim asosah theiye. Aman twikhanglen’a twipi ho achopdoh in, leiset chunga aphilhah sah e. Ama chu amin Pakai kiti ahi.
en_web: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,
en_kjv: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, And turneth the shadow of death into the morning, And maketh the day dark with night: That calleth for the waters of the sea, And poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin ahsi hijat asemin, Bombel le ngambom lungthu jong asem’e. Muthim jinglai avahsah-in, Sunlaipi mu athimsah theiye. Twikhanglen twi achopdoh-in Leiset tolhanga aphi lhai. Amin jong Pakai ahi.

tcz: Aman athahat apan in, ahat leh apaote asumang in, akulpi jouseu jong asuhchim peh tai.
en_web: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.
en_kjv: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, So that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahat apaote le akulpi jouseu asumangtai.

tcz: Nanghon thu adih’a tanpa nahot bol’un, thutah seidoh ho jong nadal bol uvin na kidah thouve.
en_web: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
en_kjv: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, And they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo thutanna phunga thudih seite hotbol’a, thudih lou nelkal ho kidintepi jing ho!

tcz: Nanghon vaicha gentheite chotphan nanei jun, dihlou tah in kai don nopnan nanei jun, achang jouseu nalah peh jiuve. Hijeh chun, nanghon song-in hoitah tah nakisah vangun, asunga nachen louhel diu ahi. Chuleh lengpilei na deitah’a nabol uva tamtah naphu vang un, hicheho’a kon’a chu nanghon lengpitwi nadon louhel diu ahibouve.
en_web: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
en_kjv: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, And ye take from him burdens of wheat: Ye have built houses of hewn stone, But ye shall not dwell in them; Ye have planted pleasant vineyards, But ye shall not drink wine of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi vaichate bolsen, aching jouseu inhoi tah tah nasah-uva cheng thei louva, lengpilei hoitah tah a naphusau lengpitwi nadon lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu, keiman nasuhkhel u ijat hija, na chonset nau ichan geija nasa ham, ti kahesoh keije. Nangho hi nehguh kilah’a, midih bolgenthei ja pang nahiuve, chuleh thutanna mun’a vaicha tahlelte dihna selmang’a pang nahiuve.
en_web: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.
en_kjv: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: They afflict the just, they take a bribe, And they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachonset melsetjeu le naboljat’u thilse kahe jinge. Mipha bolsen, nehguh nalauvin, thutanna phunga vaichate themchan ding napheltan’ui.

tcz: Hijeh chun, hitobang phat phatlou laitah’a, akam kihup’a umthim beh chu, milung chingho ahiuve.
en_web: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
en_kjv: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; For it is an evil time.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang phat pha lou laiya umthim beh chu chihhoijo ahitai.

tcz: Apha chu ipi ham, hol uvin lang, thilse chu jamsan’un, chutileh nanghon na sei jiu banga, Pakai van Pathen chun na umpi jing thei diu ahi.
en_web: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
en_kjv: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: And so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahin theina diuvin thilse boldan, thilphajoh bol’uvin. Chutile nasei bangun Pakai Pathen thaneipen chun naumpi tahbeh diu ahi.

tcz: Thilse hotbol unlang, apha chu ngailuvin; chuleh thutanna munho chu thudih lenna hisah’un, chutileh Pakai van Pathen chun, amite ahingdoh amoh chengse chunga alungsetna akoi ding ahi.
en_web: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
en_kjv: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: It may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse hotbol’un, thilpha boljo’uvin, chule thutanna phunga thudih lensah-un. Chutile tegeiya hingna lai hiche nam mite hi Pakaiyin ahepi thei mai ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai van Pathen chun hitin aseije, khosung leh vengning koilah jousea thi-op ho ka leh mao o-gin dimlha ding, chuleh akap gunset dinga ka-je them hojong akondiu, ahi.
en_web: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
en_kjv: Therefore the Lord, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; And they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! And they shall call the husbandman to mourning, And such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Pakai thaneipen Pathenin aseiyin, “Kholai dung jousea ka le mao o-thong ding. Thi-opte lunghempi dinga loubolte geiya kikoulo ding ahi.

tcz: Lengpilei lai jousea mi kap thum jeju ding, ajeh chu Keiman amaho talen kamatsah’a kasuhgam hel soh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: For I will pass through thee, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpilei lai tina mi kap’intin, nangho talen kamatsah ding jeh a hicheng hi soh tei ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai.

tcz: Ohe, ada nahiuve! Pakai nikho chu hunglhung taleh tiho. Nanghon Pakai nikho chu ipi tobang ham nahepouve Hiche nikho chun khovah ahinpohlut louhel ding, muthim lhangkhal ahinlhut ding ahibouve.
en_web: “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.
en_kjv: Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! To what end is it for you? The day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.
tcz_gospelgo: Akineppite din Pakai Nikho chutijat umtah ahi! Hiche Nikho chun ipi thilpha nasodoh peh diu ham? Nangho din khovah hilou, muthim khojin nikho ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh nangho, Pasal khattou sakei bahkai kicha-a ajamleh vompin ana lamtin’a, vompia kon’a ajamdoh kit’a a-insung alhun’a, a-inbanga akingaileh akhut gul’in ahinchuh tobang nahi diu ahi.
en_web: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.
en_kjv: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; Or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei ginna jam’an savom ato tobang ahibouve. Insunga jamlut tobang atuhnaa gul’in achuh tobang ahi.

tcz: Chutia chu, Pakai nikho chu muthim leh lungjin nikho hiding, lung navah bei leh kipana beikei nikho hiding ahi.
en_web: Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
en_kjv: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Nikhoa chu mu thim ding, kho vah lou ding ahi; lung navah bei, lung jin nikho ahi.

tcz: Keiman kut nabol jouseu kahon kadei poi, khoppi theng nabol’u jong ka kipah dehpoi. Ajeh chu abon’a atah hilou na bolthu ngen’u ahibouve.
en_web: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
en_kjv: I hate, I despise your feast days, And I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Nakut bol jouseu kahon, kathoh nampoi!

tcz: Nanghon pumgo thilto nadeitah’uva nabol’u jong kamit a ka vetpih louhel ding nahiuve.
en_web: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
en_kjv: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: Neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pumgo thilto bol’un, changing kilhai jongleur chunsang ponge; kahenga to dia navah thaochet’u ganchate jong sanpeh pouvinge.

tcz: O thong jejua vahchoila nasah’u jong thip doh un, selangdah tampi ngeitah’a nasai ju jong ka ngainom poi.
en_web: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
en_kjv: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; For I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
tcz_gospelgo: Thumje jua la nasah-u jong ngauvin, naselangdah gin’u jong kangai nompoi.

tcz: Chusang in, thudih chu twilong hattah bangin nei musah un, chuleh kanglou twidung bangin chondihna chu lonsah’un.
en_web: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
en_kjv: But let judgment run down as waters, And righteousness as a mighty stream.
tcz_gospelgo: Chusangin thudih chu vadung twilong bahsah-un, adih chu kantih bei vadung long bahsah tau.

tcz: Vo, Israel mite, gamthip noija kum somli sunga chu, kilhaina gantha chuleh thilto chom chom ho chu kahenga nahinchoi jingu hinam?
en_web: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
en_kjv: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Israelte, kum somli sunga gamthip laiya kapui leu chun kilhaina gantha le thilto ka-ngeh poi.

tcz: Ahipoi, nanghon na-doi-pathen’u nalengpau Sakkuth leh ahsi pathen na kisem thu-u bou chu najen’un nahou-ve.
en_web: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
en_kjv: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, The star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla tua doilim kisem Sakkuth Pathen leng le ahsi pathen Kaiwam milimho nahou phat’un,

tcz: Hijeh’a chu keiman nanghohi Damascus kalpeh’a sohchanga ka kaimang diu nahi tin, Pakaiyin aseiyin, ama min chu Pakai van Pathen ahi.
en_web: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
en_kjv: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, Saith the Lord, whose name is The God of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Damascus khopi kalpeh a gal-hinga kakai tengu nakipohle diu ahitai,” tin asieyin ahi, Pakai, amin thaneipen Pathen kiti chun.

tcz: Ohe ada nahiuve, Jerusalem khopia nomsatah’a chengho, chuleh Samaria khopia lungmong tah’a khosa ho! Namtin vaipi lah’a naminthang lheh’un, chuleh mihon napanpina ngaichan nakom a ahung jiuve.
en_web: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
en_kjv: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, And trust in the mountain of Samaria, Which are named chief of the nations, To whom the house of Israel came!
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe nadau ahi-Zion lhanga nomtah a chengte, Samaria khopia lung mongtah a um, hiche nam lentah Israel milen milalte, mipin akithopi dia angaichat jing ho!

tcz: Amavang Calneh lhang galkaijun vetem un, chuteng Hamath khopilen a chun chepaijun, chuleh Philistine khopi Gath a jong chesuh un, nangho amaho sang’a phajo nahideh pouve, vetem un, amaho iti manthah hitauvem!
en_web: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?
en_kjv: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; And from thence go ye to Hamath the great: Then go down to Gath of the Philistines: Be they better than these kingdoms? Or their border greater than your border?
tcz_gospelgo: Calneh khopi gaveuvin. Hamath khopi minthang gaveuvin, kitolsauh-un Philistinete khopi Gath gaveuvin. Hicheng hi Judah le Israel lenggam te ni sanga phajo mong am? Agamu khu nang ho gam sanga lenjom?

tcz: Nanghon nachung uva hamsetna hunglhung vahlou dingin nagel’un, ahinlah, pumhat’a nathilbol’u chun thutanna nikho chu nakiloilut loijiuve.
en_web: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,
en_kjv: Ye that put far away the evil day, And cause the seat of violence to come near;
tcz_gospelgo: Manthahna nikho hung lhung lou din naseiyun, nathilbol chengseu hinla anaisah tel tul’e.

tcz: Ohe ada nahiuve, saiha-a kisem jalkhun’a kijamlea, chuleh nomtah’a kijaole ho, Kelngoinou lah’a adei dei kitha-a neho, chuleh bonghon lah’a athao adei lailai kitha-a neho,
en_web: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,
en_kjv: That lie upon beds of ivory, And stretch themselves upon their couches, And eat the lambs out of the flock, And the calves out of the midst of the stall;
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe nadau ahi-saihaa kisem jalkhun chunga kijaole lea, kelngoi thao lailaiya kivah ho!

tcz: Nanghon selangdah tum ging toh thon lakoila pou nasa uvin, chuleh kithepsah tah in David umchan na tho uvin, tumging thei manchah nakisem thu’uve.
en_web: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
en_kjv: That chant to the sound of the viol, And invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
tcz_gospelgo: David boldan danin la nabol’un, semjang saiyin nasaiyuve ong!

tcz: Nanghon khon dim dim in lengpitwi nadon’un, chuleh thao namtwi pen nakinu uvin, Na nampiu manthah chu lunggim nan nanei pouve.
en_web: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
en_kjv: That drink wine in bowls, And anoint themselves with the chief ointments: But they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Khon letlha hel hel ju nadon’un, gimnamtui pen nakinu’vin, Israel manthahna lung gimpi louvin na-um’uve.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu, nangho gal-hing’a sohchang masapen’a napan diu, chutah leh nomtah’a khosaho chu, anopsahnau abon’a beisoh hel ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.
en_kjv: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, And the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu min gal-hinga akai masah pen ding nahiuve. Chuteng nakut’u le golvah kibol kit lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakai chu, amatah min in akihahsel in, chuleh Pakai van Pathen ahina chun hitin aseiye, “Israel mite louchalna kaho in, chuleh akulpi sem’u jong ka kidah’e. Hijeh chun, hiche khopi leh asunga um chengse abon’a, amelmateu kapehdoh ding ahi,’’ ati.
en_web: “The Lord GOD has sworn by himself,” says the LORD, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
en_kjv: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, saith the Lord the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: Therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen, Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Israelte kiletsah hi kahoi, a-in’u loupe tah tah jong imacha ding katipoi. Akhopiu le asunga thil jouse amelmateu kapeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ijemtia insung khat’a ahingdoh mison khat aum nahlai leh, amaho jong chu abonchauva thisoh hel diu ahi.
en_web: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung khat’a mi som hingdoh nah nah jong thi thou thou ding ahi.

tcz: Insung mikhattou, amopohna dung jui'a asopu thisaho govam ding kigo-a, insunga kon’a lhilongho ahinputdoh phatleh, insungmi ahingdoh pen kom’a chu, midang jong um nalaijem? tia adoh khah leh, ama chun kihahsel’a “Aum poi, pao poh hih in! Pakai chu amin jeng jong iphah pohlou hel diu ahibouve,’’ ati ding, apho ding ahi.
en_web: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention the LORD’s name.’
en_kjv: And a man’s uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, To bring out the bones out of the house, And shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: For we may not make mention of the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithipa hengle kom, thivuiya pang chun alongu insunga akaidoh thoding ahi. Thivui pan insunga umpen pen jah a, “Khatbeh to naumkhom lou ham?” ati ding ahi. Chuteng ogin khat’in, “Aumtapoi,” tinte. Chutah le thivuipan, “Paopoh hih-in! Pakai min geiya iphah poh lou diu ahi,” tia asei ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu vetan, in loupitah tah hojong ahalsi sia kisugep ding, chuleh in neocha cha hojong kivo goisoh hel ding ahiuve,’’ tin Pakaiyin thupeh anei tai.
en_web: “For, behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
en_kjv: For behold, the Lord commandeth, And he will smite the great house with breaches, And the little house with clefts.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin suhmang dia asei teng ni lentah tah hihen neocha cha hijongle ahalsi sia leng mang jeng thei ahi.

tcz: Songpi chunga khu sakolte chomle le thei mong’a, hiche lah chu bongchal in loukaina-a akaithei mong ding ham? Hitobang chun, nanghon ngolhoi tah in, thu adih’a kitan chu thina gu-twi na sosah uvin, chuleh adihtah’a hung ga doh twitah chu nehmohel khacheh-chuh na sodoh gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,
en_kjv: Shall horses run upon the rock? Will one plow there with oxen? For ye have turned judgment into gall, And the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
tcz_gospelgo: Songpi chunga sakolte lhai theiya, min Twikhanglen langkon a akai theiyum? Nanghon akaleh beh-in thudih gutwi nasouvin, thildih dih lou nasouve.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon Lo-debar chunga nagaljonau chu nakithang-at piuvin, kiletsahtah in, eihon eiho thahat’a karnaim chu ilah’u hilou ham? na kitiuve.
en_web: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
en_kjv: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, Which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
tcz_gospelgo: Lodebar khopi nalah-u nahoithopiuvin ahi. Kiletsah tah-in, “Karnaim khopi ilah jengu iha lheh-ui,” natiuve.

tcz: “Vo Israel mite, nangho douding melma namkhat katildoh ding ahi,’’ tin Pakai van Pathen chun aseiye. ‘’Amahon nangho nagamsung uva nasuh genthei diu, sahlam’a Leb-hamath apat noilam’a Arabah phaicham geija nasuh genthei diu ahi,’’ati.
en_web: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says the LORD, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
en_kjv: But behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the Lord the God of hosts; And they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thaneipen Pathenin, “Vo Israel nagamsungu lo dia gamchom mi sepaite kahinsol ding ahi. Hicheho hin sahlam Hamath lamlen a pat lhanglam Arabah phaicham geiya nabol hesoh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakai chun, thil hicheng hi themgao thilmun keima eivetsah e. Pakaiyin khaokhote tamtah alomchang’a, gamsunga ahinlhalut keiman kamui. Hichu, loujaova lousoh-ga lengpa ding’a akikhop tup jou, aban’a ding lousoh-ga ahungdon doh thah phatlai ahi.
en_web: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.
en_kjv: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pakaiya konin mu kaneiye. Kathilmu naa hi-lengpan hamhing a-at nung, hamdong thah hung kepat dontah-in Pakaiyin khaokhote simsen lou asemdoh tai.

tcz: Khaokhoten gamsung’a hamhing aum jouse abonchan ane chaisoh hel tan ahi. Chu in ken jong, “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai, nahenga kataove nei ngaidam’un, kahindoh joulou diu ahitai. Ajeh chu, Israel hi neocha ahibouvin, na kidoupi kham jong ahipoi’’ tin ka sei tai.
en_web: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord GOD, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: By whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche mu kaneinaa hin-khaokhoten gamsunga ipi hile adong lai lai-hamhing jouse anechaiyun, hijeh chun kenjong, “Hatchungnung Pakai, mipi hi ngaidam jengin! Athigam lo diu ahitai! Alhom’un lhasam tah ahibouvui,” tin kaseiye.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin alung ngaito akhel in, “Hiche hi kibolda tahen!’’ tin Pakaiyin asei tai.
en_web: The LORD relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Namu bang hin kabolda tante,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin, Hatchungnung Pakai chun, themgao thilmun thildang khat eimusah kit e. Pakaiyin amite chunga gotna thutan khum ding in meikong hattah khat akouvin, hiche meikong chun kokhuh thuhtah tah jong akachai jeng in, chuleh gamsung pumpi jong ahalvam soh hel tai.
en_web: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.
en_kjv: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung Pakaiya kon thil khat kamu kit’e. Hichea hin Pakaiyin amite maiya halgam agoi. Meipi hin vannoi Twikhanglen lentah geiyin akavam jengin, gam leiset jong akapantai.

tcz: Chuin kenjong, vo hatchungnung Pakai, naheng’a kataove nei lungset’un bolda tan, ka hindoh joulou diu ahitai, ajeh chu Israel hi neocha ahibouve, na kidoupi kham jong ahipoi,’’ tin ka sei tai.
en_web: Then I said, “Lord GOD, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
en_kjv: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: By whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in kenjong, “Vo Pakai Pathen, namiten iti addoujou ding ham, nga jengin-alhom behseh-un lhasam tah ahiuve!” tin kataove.

tcz: Chutah chun Pakaiyin alungngaito akhel kit in,’ “Hiche jong hi kibolda tahen,’’ tin thanei pen Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: The LORD relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord GOD.
en_kjv: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Hiche jong bolda ding hitante,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin, Pakaiyin thildang khat, themgao thilmun eivetsah kit e. Pakaiyin akhut’a songkhai-in tena khat achoijin, pal kigensa kom’a ading’e. Aman hiche pal kigensa chu phatea dingdet jing hinam, tin atetoh len ahi.
en_web: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
en_kjv: Thus he shewed me: and behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kon mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin Pakai chu songkhai intenaa kitetoh a kigen bang koma adingin, songkhai intena chu achoiye.

tcz: Chuleh Pakai chun eidong in,’’Amos ipi namu em? eiti. Chuin kenjong ka donbut in, “songkhai-intena khat kamui’’ kati. Chutah chun Pakaiyin aseijin, “Hiche songkhai-intena kachoija hi, kamite ka tetoh ding, achonset nau jouse donlouva kakoi louhel ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kajah a, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Songkhai intena khat,” kati. Hichun Aman, “Bang onsa tobang kamite tetohna dia hiche songkhai intena hi Kaman ahi. Amaho talen matsah kagot hi lung hei lou ding kahi.

tcz: Na pului teu doipheng ho abon’a kisuse gamhel ding, Israel mite muntheng ho jouse jong ahomkeuva kijamsoh hel ding ahi. Chuleh Jeroboam insung khang gui jong kasuh gamhel ding ahi’’ ati.
en_web: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
en_kjv: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, And the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; And I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Isaac chilhahte doiphung jouse suhmang ding ahi. Israel muntheng geiya ahomsa kijam ding ahi. Jeroboam lengpa leng vai neina kasuhbei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Bethel khopia thempupa, Amajiah kitipa chun, Israel lengpa Jeroboam kom’a mi asol in, thu agalhut sah tai. ‘’Israel mite jalah tah’a, nakotphung ngeiya hin, Amos kitipan, nang douna leh dehnan thu aseijin, athusei doh hohi dou’a dou jou ahipoi.
en_web: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.
en_kjv: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
tcz_gospelgo: Bethel a Thempu Amaziah hin Israel lengpa Jeroboam henga thu athot’in, “Mipi jalah a Amos hin nang demna jeng aseiyin, athusei hi gamsungin adou jou tapoi.

tcz: Aman hitin aseiye, “Jeroboam hi chemjam’a loutei tei ding, sot lou ding ahitai. Chuleh Israel mite jong sohchang’a kikaimang diu ahi,’’ tin aga sei sah tai.
en_web: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
en_kjv: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
tcz_gospelgo: Amos sei chu, ‘Jeroboam galmuna thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunga thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin, Amajiah in Amos chu thu apen, “Vo mitva neipa, hilaimun’a kon in potdoh'in! Judah gamsung’a kilekit loijin, chuleh chua chun gaothu nasei nom nom seijin lang naneh ding ga kihol tan!
en_web: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,
en_kjv: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
tcz_gospelgo: Amaziah hin Amos aphoh-in, “Vo mitva neipa navaltai! Judah gam a kile kit’in chukoma thu gaseitan. Chule mihon tohman penauvinte.

tcz: Hilai Bethel khopia hin gaothu avel in hung seikit tahih in. Ajeh chu hilaimun hi, lengpa muntheng ahin chuleh gamsung pumpi dia jong muntheng Pathen houna mun ahi bouve’’ ati.
en_web: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
en_kjv: but prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.
tcz_gospelgo: Bethel a vang thu hung seikit hih-in. Nampi Houin, lengpa pathen houna mun ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Amos in adonbut in, “Keima themgao tah tah chu kahi pon, chuleh themgao guija peng jong kahipoi. Keima kelngoi ching’a pang mei mei kahin, theipi thingna ho malngim lea pangbou kahi.
en_web: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;
en_kjv: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
tcz_gospelgo: Amos chun, “Kei hi tohman neiya gaothusei Themgao kahipoi. Kelngoi chingmi, theipi na kivei kahi.

tcz: Ahivang in, kelngoi hon nung kajuina akon in Pakaiyin eikou doh tan, kajah’a aseitai. “Chenlang, kamite Israelte lah’a gaothu ga sei tan,’’ eiti.
en_web: and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
en_kjv: and the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pakaiyin kelngoi ching kahinaa eikoudoh a amite Israelte koma gaothusei dia eisol ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun, tunjong Pakai thusei hi ngaijin. “Nangman nasei jin; Israel dounan jong gaothu seidan lang, kamite dounan jong thuhil in pang hih in’’ nati.
en_web: Now therefore listen to the LORD’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’
en_kjv: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, And drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakai thusei ngaiyin. Israelte kaphoa, gaothu kasei ding najah dai.

tcz: Amavang, Pakaiyin hitin aseiye; “Na jinu chu khopi sung’a notia hung pang ding, chuleh na chapate leh na chanute chem. jam’a hunglou diu, na gamsung jong abeh beh’a kihom khen ding, chuleh nangma tah jong migam’a naga thiding ahi. Chuleh Israel chate jong agamsung uva kon’a gamdang’a sohchang’a kitolmang teitei ding ahiuve, ati,’’ tin aseiye.
en_web: Therefore the LORD says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
en_kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, And thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, And thy land shall be divided by line; And thou shalt die in a polluted land: And Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyin Amaziah Pakaiyin hiche hi naseipeh ahi, ‘Najinu kholai dunga notia panga, nachate galmun a thisoh diu; nagamsung kihomtel tel’a midang kipedoh ding, nangtah jeng jong chiding namdangte gamsunga nagathi ding ahi. Thon louhel’a Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akaimang tei diu ahitai,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin, hicheng hi, themgao thilmun keima eivetsah e. Hichu nipilaija theiga-min longkai khat dimset in akitung e.
en_web: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.
en_kjv: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold, a basket of summer fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchugnung pakaiya konin mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin theiga dimset paipeh khat kamui.

tcz: Hichun aman eidong in, “Amos ipi namu em?” eiti. Ken jong ka donbut in, “Longkai khat dimset nipilai theiga-min kamui’’ kati. Chuphat in Pakaiyin asei tai,’’ Hiche theiga-min namu bang’a hi, kami Israelte jong akichaina diu phat hunglhung ahitai. Keiman achunguva talen kamatsah ding hi, kakhongai tahlou ding ahi.
en_web: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
en_kjv: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin seidonge. Ken jong, “Theiga dimset paipeh khat,” kati. Hichun Pakaiyin, “Kamite Israel beina ding ahung lhungtai. Talen matsah kagot hi hai taponge.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, houin’a la kisa hojong abon’a kana la sohgam ding, mithi tampi khopisung muntin’a thang jeng ding ahi. Hiche hi keima thaneipen Pakaiyin ka sei doh ahitai.
en_web: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord GOD. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.
en_kjv: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord God: There shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chuleh leng inpia la kisa jouse lunghem kana kaheidoh ding ahi. Muntin a thilong jeng thilong jeng akijam ding, min thip beh cha apai pai jeng diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichehi ngai uvin, nanghon vaichate nachom gam’un, chuleh tahlelte kengchot phan nanei uve.
en_web: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
en_kjv: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, Even to make the poor of the land to fail,
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga vaichate sumanga, neilelte kengchotpha neihom hiche hi ngaiyuvin.

tcz: Nanghon, cholngah nikho hunglhun ding nangah lel un, houthua kut kibol nikho hojong kichaidoh loihen, natiuve. Ajeh chu, nanghon thil tena dihlou nasem’un, chang leh suhlou chang ho, aman val val in mi nachohsah uvin, thilcho leh thiljoh hojong jou leh nal in nalhemlha uvin ahi.
en_web: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;
en_kjv: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? And the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, Making the ephah small, and the shekel great, And falsifying the balances by deceit?
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho pin, “Choldo nikho ho beivah vah hen chang kijoh leu hen. Choldo Nikho beivah hen thil kijoh loi leh. Thil manval val lah a, thiltena lhem a te ding, thil cho le thiljoh ho lepthol’a thiltena dih lou kimang ding ahi.

tcz: Nanghon, changsi tol’a kiseplha toh changtah nachoh hel’un, hichu najoh’un, chuteng vaicha leh tahlelte chu soh din dangka pehkhat pouvin na kichoh un, chuleh kengchot tokhat poutoh nalheh’un ahi.
en_web: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”
en_kjv: That we may buy the poor for silver, And the needy for a pair of shoes; Yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
tcz_gospelgo: Suhlou chang manmo jong manlu tah a kijoh a, a bat salel, kengchot to khat man jeng jong pejou lou vaichate chu soh dia ikichoh diu ahi,” natiuve.

tcz: Tun, Pakai Israel Pathen chu, ama leh ama akihahsel in, “A itih’a jong, na thilse bolho kahaimil lou hel ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
en_kjv: The Lord hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Israel Pathen kahisel’in aseiyin, “Thilse abol chengseu sumil ponge.

tcz: Hiche jeh’a chu, gamsung pumpi ling kihot banga killing ding, chuleh gamsung chu Nile vadung twi solai banga, hung kinuh sang ding chuleh kemsuh kitding ahi’’, ati.
en_web: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.
en_kjv: Shall not the land tremble for this, And every one mourn that dwelleth therein? And it shall rise up wholly as a flood; And it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Ling kihot’a gamsung mi abonchauva lung hesoh diu ahi. Gam pumpi kihot ding . Nile va dung banga kinuh lap lap ding ahi.

tcz: “Hiche nikho chuleh, keiman sunlaiya nisa kalhumsah ding, chuleh sunchang laiya leiset chung mu ka thimsah ding ahi,” tin thanei pen Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, That I will cause the sun to go down at noon, And I will darken the earth in the clear day:
tcz_gospelgo: Sun laiya nisa kalhumsah a, khovah laiya leiset kathimsah ding phat hung lhung ding ahi. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.

tcz: Chuleh, golvah kut nabol jouseu kaleh maona-a ka heidoh peh ding, la nasah jouseu jong kala-a ka heidoh peh ding nahiuve. Nanghon,thi-op pon nakisil uva, lunghem jeh’a amitakip nalu nahotol diu, Nachapa khatseh na neisun thijeh’a lunghem bang’a kalha diu, Hiche nikho chu iti lainat um hitam!’’tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.
en_kjv: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, And all your songs into lamentation; And I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, And baldness upon every head; And I will make it as the mourning of an only son, And the end thereof as a bitter day.
tcz_gospelgo: Golnop kut nabol jouseu thivuina kaheidoh a, kipa la nasah chengseu lunghem kana kaehidoh ding ahi. Sam vouchaiya khaodip pon kasilsah diu, chapa khatseh thi kapi minu le mipa kabahsah diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu a chai ni geiya thoh lel hi ding ahi.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin, ‘’Hiche nikho chu ahung lhung’e. Keiman gamsung kel ka lhahsah ding, an leh twi ngaichatna kel hilou ding, amavang, Pakai thusei jah ding ngaichatna kel hiding ahi.
en_web: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the LORD’s words.
en_kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, That I will send a famine in the land, Not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, But of hearing the words of the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: “Gamsunga kel kalhahsahna ding phat ahung lhunge. Mipi kel thoh ding chu neh le chah ngaichat hipontin, twi ducha dangchah jong hipouvinte. Pakai thusei ngaicha gilkel le dangchah hiuvinte. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.

tcz: Miho, twikhanglen khat’a kon’a adang khat’a kitol leuva, chuleh gamkhat’a kon’a gamdang khat’a chediu, Pakai thusei jah ding holna-a, lhaito jeng jung diu. Ahivanga, amahon ahol’u chu amu louhel diu ahi.
en_web: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD’s word, and will not find it.
en_kjv: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, They shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi hin sah le lhang simle mal adel le jeng diu ahi. Muntin a Pakai thusei del leuvin tin, mu la mudoh deh pouvinte.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, nungah melhoitah holeh golhang thahatlai hojong Pakai thu jahding ngaicha-a lhulham soh diu ahi.
en_web: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.
en_kjv: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho tengle numei pasal khangdong thahat lai lai jong dangchah a lhu lham soh diu ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Samaria khopia jumlehja um doi ho’a kihahsel’a, Dan pathen min’a kihahselho, chuleh Beersheba pathen min’a kitepna bol ho, abonchauva kipallhu gan hel diu, a itih’a, thoukit talou hel diu ahi,’’ ati.
en_web: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”
en_kjv: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, And say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; And, The manner of Beer-sheba liveth; Even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria khopia milimdoi pan a kihahsel ji, ‘Dan a pathen jeh, Beersheba pathen jeh,’ tia sei chengse chu dinlhuhsoh hel diu, thou kit lou diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Keiman Pakai chu maicham phung kom’a adin kamun, Aman hitin aseiye, “Hou-in pumpi chu, akibulphuna jouse geija achimlhah kahsen, akingapna khompi ho jouse chu jep jep jeng inlang, intingvum, Chuleh athimoh ahingdoh chengse jong chu, keiman chemjam’a kasatlih soh hel ding, koimacha ajamdoh umlouhel ding ahiuve.
en_web: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.
en_kjv: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: And cut them in the head, all of them; And I will slay the last of them with the sword: He that fleeth of them shall not flee away, And he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
tcz_gospelgo: Maicham phunga Pakai din jing kamun, thu apen, “Houin khompi chengse luvum chu havoh voh-in von lang, in pumpi kilingsoh hen. Vojal’in mipi luvum a kitajalsah tan. Athimoh chengse galmun a kathagam ding ahi. Ahin gdodh ajamdoh beihel ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon noimigam geijin leiko kilaiju jong leh, keiman noimigam’a kon’a amaho kahin kaidoh diu ahi. Chuleh vanchung geijin amaho kaldoh’u jong leh, keiman van’a kon’a amaho ka kailhah diu ahi.
en_web: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
en_kjv: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; Though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
tcz_gospelgo: Noimigam geiyin jamsuh jongleur, kamatdoh tei tei ding, vanchung geiya kaldoh jongleur, kaloi lhahsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Carmel molsang vum’a amaho gakisel jongleu, hikom’a jong chu keiman amaho kaholdoh’a, kakaidoh diu ahi. Twikhanglen noilam peh’a amaho gakisel jong leu, Keiman gulpi ka sol’a, aga chuh den diu ahikit’e.
en_web: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.
en_kjv: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; And though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, Thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
tcz_gospelgo: Carmel molvum a kisel jongleur, kaholdoh a kamasoh didng ahi. Twikhanglen noiya kisel jongleur gul-lhempi sol ing ting kachuhsah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Chuleh amelma teuvin amaho chu sohchang in tolmang jong leu, keiman chemjam choiho katildoh’a, asatlih gam hel diu ahi. Hiche ahi, koiman amaho chunga manthahna kapohlut ding, chu teng mihem koiman amaho chu apanpi thei louhel diu ahi.
en_web: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.
en_kjv: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, Thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: And I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmateuvin gal-hinga akai tengle, athagam diuva kaseipeh ding ahi. Kithopi daa suhgam kagot mong mong ahitai, “a ti.

tcz: Pakai van Pathen in Leiset chung a tohkhah leh ajunlha jeng in, chuleh leiset chung cheng jouse alunghem lha jeng uvin ahi. Ajeh chu, twiso pet’a, Nile vadung kinuh lap lap’a akhantou bang in, gamsung pumpi jong akhang teltul in, chuin akemsuh kit in ahi.
en_web: For the Lord, the GOD of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
en_kjv: And the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, And all that dwell therein shall mourn: And it shall rise up wholly like a flood; And shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Hatchungnung, thaneipen Pakaiyin Leiset atham leh ling akihot’in, Leichung chengte alunghemsoh tauve. Leiset pumpi Nile vadung bangin akinuh lap lap’e.

tcz: Pakaiyin vanchung chu chennan aneiyin, leiset chunghi, aman kengto ngapnan akisem’e. Aman twikhanglen ho’a kon in, twi akoukhom in, leiset chunga go in ahinsunglha kit in ahi. Ama hi, amin Pakai ahi.
en_web: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—the LORD is his name.
en_kjv: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, And hath founded his troop in the earth; He that calleth for the waters of the sea, And poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin van a in asan, Leiset chunga vanthamjol adal’e. Twikhanglen twipi achopdoh-in, Leiset chapnou nana mange. Ama hi amin Pakai ahi!

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Vo Israel chate, nangho hi, Ethiopia mite sang’a keiman ka khohsah joh ding’a na kigel’u ham? Keiman Israel chu Egypt gam’a kon’a kahinpui doh’a, chuleh Philistine mite jong chu Crete gam’a kon’a keima man kahin puidoh hilou ham? Chuleh Syria mite chu, Kir gam’a kon’a ka hin puidoh ahiuve.
en_web: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says the LORD. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
en_kjv: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? And the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, nangho hi midang to ichomin kagelpon, Sudan mite bangin kagel’e. Nangho Egypt a kahin puidoh bang hin Crete a konin Philistinete kahinpuidoh-in, Kir a konin Syria mite kahin puidoh-e.

tcz: Keima thaneipen Pakaiyin, Israel mite achonset nau kavelhi jingin ahi. Keiman leiset chunga kon’a amaho hi ka suhmang hel ding ahi,’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, And I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; Saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hiche chonset dimset Israel lenggam hi kave vei, leiset chunga kasuhgam hel ding ahi. Jacob chilhahte vang abonin sugam ponge.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman thupeh kanei ding, midangho kibolna banga, kami Israelte jong, tengsa-a changchi kilohchil banga ka lochil ding, amavang changtah khat jong tol’a lhahsah louva kakoi ding ahi.
en_web: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.
en_kjv: For lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, Like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israelte hi tengsa changchi kiloh chil banga kalosah ding, namtin vaipi lah a kalothangsoh a, pannanbei chengse kapaidoh ding ahi.

tcz: Chuleh chonset bol jouse abon'uva chemjam’a thisoh hel diu, Thilsen eiho eipha pouvinte, tia seilele ho jouse jong, abon'uva thisoh heldiu ahi.
en_web: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
en_kjv: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, Which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite lah a chonset chengse galmun a thiden diu- ‘Pathenin thilse eiphahsah pouvinte,’ ti jouse thisoh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh keiman alhusa David lenggam chu kaphoh ding’a, katundoh kit ding ahi. Akulpi bangsesa ho kasemphat kit ding, chuteng achimsa jouse ka sahphat kit ding, chuleh aloupina mangsa chu ka tundoh kit ding ahi.
en_web: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,
en_kjv: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, And close up the breaches thereof; And I will raise up his ruins, And I will build it as in the days of old:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ingemsa tobang David lenggam kasemphatna ding Nikho khat ahung lhunge. Apal jouse semphang ting, katundoh kit ding ahi. Kasah phat’a masang laiya tobang kahisah ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng, Edom mi ahingdoh chengse chu Israel mite chang diu, chuleh kamin’a kihou namtin vaipi jouse jong abon’a alotha diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseidohsa chu aboldoh tei ding ahi.
en_web: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says the LORD who does this.
en_kjv: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, Which are called by my name, Saith the Lord that doeth this.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengle Edom gamsung jolou chengse Israelten ajo diu, Keiya hisa namtin vaipi ajotho diu ahi,” ati. Hiche sosah ding Pakai chun aseitai.

tcz: “Nikho ahung lhung’e’’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Lousoh ga leh lengpi ga ho, hetman louva khangloi loi uva, chang-atpa leh lengpitwi chilpa aphah thu ding ahi. Chuteng molleh lhang jousea lengpitwi dimsoh’a, lengpitwi lhum chu hoh banga longlha ding ahi.
en_web: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.
en_kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, That the plowman shall overtake the reaper, And the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; And the mountains shall drop sweet wine, And all the hills shall melt.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nikhoho chu ahunglhunge,” tin aseiye Pakaiyin; Loukaipan chang-atpa aphah thu ding, Lengpitwi childo pa Lengpiga loupan aphah thu ding ahi. Mol le lhang jouse lengpitwi dimsoh a, Alhang lhganga hoh a long ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman gamlatah’a sohchang kamite kahin lepuilut kitding, chuleh amahon khopi gemsa ho asahphat kit uva, chenna aneidiu ahi. Amahon lengpilei akibol’uva, amaho lengpitwi adon diu, chuleh honlei akibol uva, amaho lousoh ga aneh diu ahi.
en_web: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.
en_kjv: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, And they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; And they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; They shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite agamsunguva kahin puilut kit’a, Khopi gemsa jouse sephaa cheng kit diu ahi: Lengpilei bol’a kivah diu; Honlei bol’a kivah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Chuteng keiman amaho chu agamsunguva dettah’a ka chensah’a, ka phudet ding, Amaho kapehna gamsung’a kon’a, avel’a kikaidoh kitlouheldiu ahi, tin Pathen in aseiye.
en_web: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
en_kjv: And I will plant them upon their land, And they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, Saith the Lord thy God.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapehsa gamsunga kamite kachensah ding, Kikalkang kit lou diu ahitai,” ati. Pakai na-Pathen’uvin aseitai.

tcz: Hiche hi, Hatchunung Pakaiyin, Edom chungchang thu, Obadiah henga, themgao thilmua aphondoh chu ahi. Keihon Pakaija kon thu hung lhung kajauvin, Namtin vaipi lah’athupole palai khat a kisol in, “Amitakip kigosan um’un! Eiho kikou khom’u hitin, Edom douna gal satin konuhite,” tin asam tai.
en_web: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
en_kjv: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, And an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Obadiah gaothusei chu hiche hi ahi: Edom mite chung thudol’a Hatchungnung Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin Edom dounan thu asei in, “Keiman namtin vaipi lah’a, nangma kasuh neo ding, nangma don louva notthap’a na um ding ahi.”
en_web: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
en_kjv: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: Thou art greatly despised.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Edom jah a seiyin, “Lhasamin nalhang ting, Namtinin nanoise ding ahi.

tcz: Nalung sunga na kiletsahna chun na lheplhah ahi tai. Ajehchu, nangma song kulpi sunga na chengin chuleh molchunga chenna na kisemin, “Hilai mun gei a koiham eihol doh’a, eikai lha ding a” tin kiletsah tahin, na lungthimin naseiye.
en_web: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
en_kjv: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
tcz_gospelgo: Nahoi tho nan nalhem lhan, Nakhopi kulpi songthum jeng ahin, Molvum a in kisah nahi; Hijeh hcun naseiyin, ‘Eisu lhu jou ding koi ham?’ nati.

tcz: “Amavang, muvanlai bangin nang masang tahin leng sang inlang, ahsi holah'a chenna ding buhsa jongle chun, chukoma kon a chu keiman nangma kaloi lhah ding ahi,” tin Pakai in a seiye.
en_web: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, And though thou set thy nest among the stars, Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-in chu muvanlai bu banga sangtah a nasah a, Ahsite to akivet chep jeng vangin, Kaloilhah a kakai lhah ding nahi.

tcz: Gucha ho chu, jan teng hung’u hen lang na chom gam’u jong leh, amahon na nei na gou jouse ladoh chai deh pouvinte. Lengpi ga loukhoma pang hon jong, mivaicha gentheite dinga dalhah anei mong’u ahi. Ahinlah, namel maten vang nang leh na nei jouse abon’a phet gamhel diu ahi.
en_web: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
en_kjv: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) Would they not have stolen till they had enough? If the grape-gatherers came to thee, Would they not leave some grapes?
