tcz_gospelgo: “Janteng gucha ahungle alahnom bou alai. Mihon lengpiga alo teng them khat asalhateiye. Nang vang namelmaten nasuhgam hel ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, Edom gamsung pumpia, miching ho khat jong kakhen lou ding, chule Edom molsang dunga um miho hetna jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi, tin Pakai in aseiye.
en_web: “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
en_kjv: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, Even destroy the wise men out of Edom, And understanding out of the mount of Esau?
tcz_gospelgo: “Edom talen kamatsah ni leh amichingteu kasuhgam a, achihnau aboncha kasuhbei ding ahi.

tcz: Temnan galhat pasal phapen ho jong kisu lung donguva, kicha gam diu, chuleh Edom molsang chunga ho jong abonchaova kithat gam soh heldiu ahi.
en_web: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
en_kjv: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, To the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Teman gal-hangte tija lih diu, Edom gamsung sepaite aboncha min athagam ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu, nangma nasopi pa Israel chunga nakhan gitlouna ho avaltan, nang chunga jum leh jachatna dim ding chutah leh atonsot’a ding’a na kisumang ding ahi.
en_web: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
en_kjv: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, And thou shalt be cut off for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nasopite, Jacob chilhah ho nachomgama natha jal’a, nakisugam hel ding, a-itih a jum thoh a na um ding ahi.

tcz: Nangman, Israel chunga gal kibol khum nikho chun, nakihet mosahin, na kidalsen, amaho chu napanpi nompoi. Gamdang mi hon, Israelte nei le gou tampi apomangun, chuleh nasatahin Jerusalem khopi chu a susetauvin ahi. Hiche a hin, nangman nasopi Israel chu melma danin nagel tai.
en_web: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
en_kjv: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, In the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, And foreigners entered into his gates, And cast lots upon Jerusalem, Even thou wast as one of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Melmaten akelkot jouse aphutjal nikho, nangin jong napeldoh ni leh, Jerusalem gou jouse pomanga kihomsoh gamchom miho chutoh nabah ding ahi.

tcz: Na sopi soh changa kikaimang lai a, nangman amaho hamsetna chu, kipana nalah lou ding ahi. Kamiten gim hesoh athohpet’a, nangman a hamsetnau chu nakipapi lou ding ahi. Chuleh hiche hesoh genthei nikho’a chu, kiletsah ham-hoitho na bollou ding ahi.
en_web: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
en_kjv: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; Neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gama nasopite hamset chu nakipapi lou ding dol ahi. Ahamset nikhouva chu nakipa lou ding, agim nau chu nuisat hoh a nanei lou ding ahi.

tcz: Hitobang a kami Israelte, ahamset nikhouva, nangman agamsungu chu pumhata nalah lou ding ahi. Amaho hesoh gentheina chu, nangin kipana nalah lou ding ahi. Hiche nikho chuleh, nangman amaho nei le gou jong nachompeh lou ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
en_kjv: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity: Yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, Nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite khopi sunga chu agenthei hesoh nau nuisat a, ahamset nikhouva agou jouseu chomgam dia nalut lou diu dol ahi.

tcz: Nangma, lam kasom jousea nadin’a, Judah mi kihinsona dinga jam doh go ho, nachan’a na tha lou ding ahi. Ahing doh amoh chengse jong, hitobang nikho’a chu, namat’a melmate khut’a na joh dohlou ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
en_kjv: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; Neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajamdoh go ho mantan dia lamsom ajong nadin lou ding ahi. Ahamset nikhouva amaho hi amelmatau khut’a napehdoh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman namtin vaipi jouse chunga thu katanna ding nikho anai tai. Nangman Israel chung a nabol bang banga, na chunga kibol ding ahi. Na thilse boldoh ga jouse, nangma luchung’a hung le chuh sohkei ding ahi.
en_web: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
en_kjv: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; Thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei-Pakaiyin namtin vaipi thu Katanna ding nikho anaiye. Vo Edom, mi nabol banga nakibol ding ahi. Napehsa chu nachan kit ding ahi.

tcz: Ka lhangtheng chunga, kamite ho naval lhum bang’a, nangleh akimvel’a cheng namtin vaipi, na chunguva gotna kabuh lhah’a, na don diu ahi. Namtin vaipi jouse chu kham diu, ageina lam’u kihelouva mangthah ding ahiuve.
en_web: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
en_kjv: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, So shall all the heathen drink continually, Yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, And they shall be as though they had not been.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamiten talen ju kha tah adontauve, ka lhang theng chunga chun, ahinla akimvel’a cheng namtin vaipin akhacheh talen ju adon diu ahi. Ju donchimset’untin leng mang jel diu ahi.

tcz: Amavang, ajamdoh chengsen, Zion molsang chu kititkhomna a aneiyuva, hoidohna khopia anei dingu ahi. Chuleh akhopi jong chu athenga hung um ding ahi. Chuleh Israel mite hung kile kituva, anei agou hou abon’a akilo kit diu ahi.
en_web: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
en_kjv: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; And the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
tcz_gospelgo: “Zion molsanga phabep hung jamlut’un tin, alhang jeng jong muntheng soh ding ahi. Jacob chaten agoulo gamu chu alo kit diu ahitai.

tcz: Israel mite chu, meikong banga deujah diu, chuleh Edom mite vang, loujauva changkung gosa bang diu ahi. Joseph insung mite chu, Meikong leng leh meisi tobang hiding, loujaova umjouse akahvam ding ahi. Chutia chu, Edom’a koima ahing doh umlou ding ahiuve. Hiche hi, Pakai, keiman kasei doh ahitai.
en_web: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
en_kjv: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame, And the house of Esau for stubble, And they shall kindle in them, and devour them; And there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; For the Lord hath spoken it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob chate le Joseph chate chu meikou bang jeng diu, meiyin changpol akah banga Esau chate asuhgam diu ahi. Esau chilhah khatcha hingdoh ponte, Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.

tcz: Chuteng, Negev gam’acheng kamiten, Edom molsang ho atoupha diu, Judah gam’a thinlhang chin’a chenghon, Philistine phaicham alo diu, chuleh Ephraim le Samaria gam’a loujao ho atoupha diu ahi. Benjamin insung miten vang Gilead gam alo diu ahi.
en_web: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
en_kjv: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; And they of the plain the Philistines: And they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: And Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
tcz_gospelgo: “Judah gam lhanglama chengten Edom gamsung alo diu ahi. Lhumlam thinglhang bul’a chengten Philistia gam alah diu ahi. Israelten Ephraim le Samaria alah diu, Benjamin chaten Gilead alah diu ahi.

tcz: Israel chate, migam’a soh chang ho chu, agamuva hung kilekit din u, chuleh amahon Phoenicia gamsung le Zarephath gamsung geija atoupha diu ahi. Chuleh, Jerusalema kon’a, kikaimanga sahlam gam’a soh chang hon, Negev gamsung khopi ho chu, alokit diu ahi.
en_web: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.
en_kjv: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; And the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, Shall possess the cities of the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel gam sahlam a sohchang sepaite hung kile kit’untin Phoenicia alah diu, Zarephath geiya alah diu ahi. Sardis a sohchang Jerusalema umten Judah gamsung lhanglam khopi chengse alah diu ahi.

tcz: Ahing doh amoh chengse chu, Zion molsang a chetou diu, Jerusalem’akon’a Edom gamsung jousea vai apoh diu, chutah le Pakai amatah chu leng vaipo’a hung pang ding ahi.
en_web: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.
en_kjv: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; And the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema galjouten Edom delkhumintin achunga vaihom diu, Pakai amatah leng chang ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Amittai chapa Jonah kommah Pathen thupeh ahung lhung in,
en_web: Now the LORD’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
en_kjv: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Ni khat hi Amittai chapa Jonah koma Pakaiyin thu aseitai.

tcz: Kipat dohin lang Ninevah kiti khopi lentaha khun gihna thu gaphongdoh tan ajeh chu amite’u gitlouna hi kamu chen tan ahi.
en_web: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
en_kjv: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Khopi lentah, Nineveh a chen lang, khopi dounan thu gaseitan; khosung mite gitlou engsetna jouse kahetai,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Jonah akipat dohin Pakaiya konin akihei mangin Joppa kongkai munlanga achen kong sunga alut in atou man apen Tarshish lam jonin akitoltan ahi.
en_web: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
en_kjv: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin pakai thupeh peldohna din Jonah lamchom beh a akiheitai. Joppa achen, Spain gam jon ding kon gkhat amudoh-in, Pakaiya kona gamlat ding ngaoti nan, kong touman pen, Spain gam jon din gkong tol ho to akilhontai.

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin twikhanglen chunga chun huipi hattahin ahin nun sahin kong suhkeh theileu chun hui le go nasatahin ahin nuhtan ahi.
en_web: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.
en_kjv: But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Pakaiyin Twikhanglen chu huise hattah anunsah-in, huise chu ahat behseh jengin, kong inneichu apeichip pai ding ahitai.

tcz: Kong sepai ho chu thina khop hellin akichatauvin, lung lengvai pumin ama ama Pathen ngehnan ataovun, chuleh kong jankhaina ding chun kong sunga kon chun thil gehsa ho chu aseplha tauvin ahi. Ahinlah Jonah chu kong indan noinung penna akum lhan ana lummin kho helou khopin ana imu lhatan ahi.
en_web: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
en_kjv: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Kongtol ho atija lih gamtauvin, amichan cheh-in ama ama pathen kom cheh a ataovun, panpi athumtauve. Chujongle kong innei chu ajandomna din kong sunga thilkeo chu apaidoh doh tauve. Hichepat tah hin Jonah chu kong tolam indan sunga alut’in khomang meiyin a-ihmui.

tcz: Hichun kong sepai lamkai pa chun Jonah chu aga mudohin ajah a “A imupa ipi nangaito hitam thoudoh in na Pathen henga tauvin chutileh aman ithigam nadiuva konna hi eihuhdoh theidiu ahi” ati.
en_web: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”
en_kjv: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah chu kongtol lamkaipun amudoh-in ajah a, “I-atileh hitobanga ihmu a nahim? Thouloiyin na-Pathen henga panpi thumin tao loi tang-em. Chutile eilungset’uva eihinso theiyu hichu men,” ati.

tcz: Hitichun amaho akihouvun, khaije hiche vangsetna hi eiholah a koipen jeh hiding ham vang veuhite akitiuvin, vang avetauvin ahileh Jonah chunga chun achu tan ahi.
en_web: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
en_kjv: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
tcz_gospelgo: Kongtol ho akihouvun, “hitobang hamset itolo nau hi koipen ahiding vang san’uhitin holdoh temu hite,” akitiuve. Hitia abol’u le Jonah min ahung potdoh tai.

tcz: Hichun amahon Jonah komma ipi jeh'a hitobang vangsetna hi ichunguva chu hitam? Nang koi nahim? Ipi na tong na him? Hoiya konna na hung ham? Koigam mi nahim? tin adong tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”
en_kjv: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun amahon jong ajah a, “Ngoh thei mong nahim neihil’un. Hikoma ipi bol’a jong hung nahim? Hoiche gama hungkon, ipi jat mi nahim?” tin adongtauve.

tcz: Jonah in adonbutin, keima Hebrew mi kahin, Leiset leh Twikhanglen semma van Pathen ging jinga um mi kahi ati.
en_web: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, I am a Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Kei Hebrew mi kahin Twikhanglen le leiset Sempa Pakai Van Pathen hou mi kahi,” ati.

tcz: Jonah chun Pathen na konna hung jamdoha ahi chu a seidoh phat in amaho aha kichat behsehun, epi na bolkhel hitam atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
en_kjv: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kona jam ahijong chu Jonah hin aseipeh tai. Kongtol ho chu atija lih jel jengun ajah a, “Tijat umtah thil nabol hita chu men!” atiuve.

tcz: Twikhanglen chu aha khoh cheh cheh phat chun amahon nanghi i-nalo uleng hiche Twikhanglen hi thip thei ding ham atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
en_kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
tcz_gospelgo: Huise Chula akhoh cheh cheh jengin, hijeh chun kongtol hon, “Huise thipna dia nang hi i-kalo diu ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Hichun aman amaho koma chun keima hi nei dom sangun lang Twikhanglen'a hin neiseplut leu chun hichi twipi kinong hi tang tante “Ajeh chu hiche twipi kinong hi keijeh ahi” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Twikhanglen a neisep lut leu chun huise hi thip tante. Kei jal’a hiche huise nato khah-u kahenai,” ati.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in amahon ajo kham chanun kong chu leigo langa toldoh tei ding agongun ahinlah Twikhanglen kinong chu akhoh cheh jotan,
en_web: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
en_kjv: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle kongtol hon kong inneichu twi pamchin a toldoh tei din thahangsanin apangui. Ahinla huise chu akhoh cheh cheh tan, suhna ding ahetapouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho Jonah Pathen komma chun ataovun “Vo Pakai nei lungset unlang hichi pa chonset jeh'in nei sumang hihun chuleh heche pan thina ato jeh'in keiho mo neipehihbeh un, O Pakai nangin hichi mipa jeh'a hi hitobang thilse hi nasohsah ah bouve ti kahe tauve” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore they cried to the LORD, and said, “We beg you, LORD, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, LORD, have done as it pleased you.”
en_kjv: Wherefore they cried unto the Lord, and said, We beseech thee, O Lord, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O Lord, hast done as it pleased thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakai henga akap jengun, “Vo Pakai, hichepa tha nagot jeh-in keiho jong neitha tha dauvin! Hitobangpi hi Nang bol ahin, Nang mopohna bou ahi,” tin ataovui.

tcz: Hichun kongtol hon Jonah chu aman’un aselhahuva ahileh Twikhanglen kinong hoisetah chu athipchet jeng tan ahi.
en_web: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
en_kjv: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Jonah chu Twikhanglen a aselut’u le, apet pet’in huise chu athip del tai.

tcz: Kongtol ho chun Pakai thanei dan chu amudoh phatun akichalheh jingun pumgo thilto abolun kitepna anei tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows.
en_kjv: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the Lord, and made vows.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hin Kongtol ho akichatsah tan, pakaiya akilhaiyun, Ama kinbol din akitep lo tauve.

tcz: Hiche ngapi oi-sunga kon chun Jonah ataovin,
en_web: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
en_kjv: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish’s belly,
tcz_gospelgo: Twito lam ngapi oisunga konin Jonah chu Pakai a-Pathen koma ataovin:

tcz: Hiti hin aseijin ahi. Hitobanga hahsatna kato sung hin, keima Pakai henga kataovin Aman ka taona eisanpeh in ahi. Hiche thina lhankhuh tobanga konna nangma kahin kouvin Pakai nangman neihouvin ahi.
en_web: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
en_kjv: and said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; Out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Pakai, kagimpet’in kakouvin, Nangin jongneihouve. Noimigama konin kahin kouvin, Panpi ngaiya katao najai.

tcz: Nangin twipi thuhtah lah’a nei sonlut in, keima Twikhanglen lailunga kalhalut tai, hiche twipi chun eilonvuhin na twipi kinong gimnei noija hin neivui tai.
en_web: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
en_kjv: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; And the floods compassed me about: All thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen tothuh laiya neileh lut’in, Twipin eichupsoh tan, Natwipi kinonglaiyin Eilonvuh soh tauve.

tcz: Chujou chun Pakai nangin nanga konin neipai dohin, ahijeng vang'in keiman na hou in thenglam kahin ngat kit ding ahi.
en_web: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
en_kjv: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; Yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-angsunga kona paidoh a um, Na-Houin theng mukit dia kinem lou kahitai.

tcz: Na Twi kinong noija kalhaluttan chule hiche twipi hin eichup tan ahi. Twipi chun kapum pin eitom soh tai.
en_web: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
en_kjv: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: The depth closed me round about, The weeds were wrapt about my head.
tcz_gospelgo: Twipin wichuptan, akichisoh tai, Twikhanglenin eichupsoh hel ahitai, Twipi kidil’in eilonvuh tai.

tcz: Molsang bul geijin ka kikholuttan akelkot kikhah jing leisetin eikhen khum tan, ahin O Pakai, Pathen nangin hiche kokhuh a kon hin nei huhdoh tan ahi!
en_web: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.
en_kjv: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with her bars was about me for ever: Yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsang bulpi kaheitan, Kot kihontih umlou Gamsung kageitai. Hijongle vo Pakai ka_pathen, Lithuh laiya konin kahingin neipuidoh-in !

tcz: Ka hinkho hi alamvai teng Pakai nangma ka hin gel doh jin, lunggil tah’a katao na Hou-in sunga ahung lutjin ahi.
en_web: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
en_kjv: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: And my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahinkho beihel kahetan, Hijeh chun nahenga kataovin, Na-Houin theng sunga Kataona ogin najai.

tcz: Semthu pathen dihlou hou hon na mi hepina jong anung sun jitauve.
en_web: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
en_kjv: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Pananbei milimdoi houten, Nang dia akitahnau apaitauve.

tcz: Keiman vang nanga din thangvahna la sa pumin nanga dingin kiphaldoh jing ing kating, ka kitepna sa ho jong molso jing ding, ajeh chu huhhingna hi Pakai nanga kon bou ahi.
en_web: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”
en_kjv: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang navhachoi la sang ting, Nakoma kilhaiying ting kakitepna molsonge. Huhingna chu Pakaiya kon bou ahi!” tin ataove.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Pakaiyin nga chu thu apen ahileh Jonah chu tolgo chunga alohdohtan ahi.
en_web: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
en_kjv: And the Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin ngapi chu Jonah lodoh din asol’in, ngapin jong aseipeh bangin twi pamchin a alodoh tai.

tcz: Anivei channa in Jonah kom’a Pathen thu ahung lhung kit tan,
en_web: The LORD’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,
en_kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakiyin Jonah koma thu asei kit’in,

tcz: “Kipatdohin lang khopi lentah Nineveh a chen lang akhopi mite kom’a keiman nang kom’a ka seipeh sa thuhi gasam phongtan atin, ahi.”
en_web: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
en_kjv: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh thu hi Nineveh khopi minthang tah dudnga gaseitan,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Jonah akipat dohin Pakai thupeh dungjui in Nineveh langa achetan ahi. Nineveh hi khopi lentah ahin nithum lam kijot ahi.
en_web: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to the LORD’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
en_kjv: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jonah hin Pakai sei angaiyin, Nineveh khopi lentah, nithum sunga jong jotdoh lel a chun achei.

tcz: Jonah chu akhopi sunga alut in nikhat lhingset ajot pan tan ahi. Hichea chun Jonah in, “Ni somli jou tengleh Neniveh khopi hi akup athalla kileh ding ahi!” tin asam phong tan ahi.
en_web: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
en_kjv: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah hin khopi chu ajot panin, nikhat lhumkei ajot nungin lhang asamin, “Nisom li sunga hiche Nineveh khopi hi kisumang ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Nineveh mipiten Pathen thupeh chu atahsanun aneo pen’a pat alen pen geijin an angolun khaodip pon akisilun alungkham na’u chu aphong doh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
en_kjv: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nineveh khopi miten Pathen thusei cu atahsan tauve. Hijeh chun alungheiyu vetsahnaa mitinin an ngol’a, alen aneo aboncha khaodip pon sil cheh din pha asatauve.

tcz: Nineveh lengpan Jonah thusei chu ajahdoh phat in alaltouna a konin ahung kum lhan alengpon loupi chu ahohlhan khaodip pon chu akisilin ahi.
en_web: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
en_kjv: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: Nineveh khopi lengpan ajahsoh phat’in alaltouna akipatdoh-in, aponchol hoh lhan, khaodip pon sil’in, leivui lah a atoutai.

tcz: Hichun lengpa leh amilen amilal ten thupeh khat khopi sung pumpia aphongdoh un mihem hihen lang gancha ho hijong leh anneh twidon abollouhel ding ahi.
en_web: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
en_kjv: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
tcz_gospelgo: Nineveh khopi mite koma phonjal ding thu khat alhan, “Hiche lengpa le avaipote thupeh ahi Koimacha cha, mihem hihen bong ho hile, kelngoiho geiya an nei twidon um thei louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Mihem hihen gancha hijong leh lunggim lunghem pum’a, Pathen a lunggil taha taona iman diu pumhatna natoh leh ithilse bol nauva konna ikihei mang ding’u ahi, tin a phongdoh tan ahi.
en_web: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
en_kjv: but let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem jouse le gancha jousen jong khaodip pon asilsoh hel ding ahi. Mitinin thilse bol angah a, chonthanghoi angah diu, lung giltah a Pathen henga tao cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Ijeh innem itileh, Pathen jengin jong alung hin heijin tin eisuhgimna diuva kon’a eihin dohsah jing theiju ahi, atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
en_kjv: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile Pathenin lung aheiya, eihinso theiyu jong ahi!” ati.

tcz: Hitobang thil abol’u chu Pathenin amudoh a itobang taha thilse bolna a konna kihei manga kingai tom’a hiuvem ti amudoh phatin alung aheitan achunguva lhunsah dinga aseisa thilse chu abol datan ahi.
en_web: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
en_kjv: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungheiya athilbol’u hi Pathenin amutai; achon gitlou nau angah jengu chu amudohtan ahi. Hijeh chun Pathenin lung aheiyin, aseisa bangin talen amatsah tapoi.

tcz: Pathen in atohgon akhel chun Jonah alungnopmo sahlheh jengin hatah in alung hangin ahi.
en_web: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
en_kjv: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah hin nommo san along hangtai.

tcz: Hijeh chun aman Pathen henga alungnop mona aphongin Pakai in a ka kipat doh masanga kana sei hilou ham? Hiche jeh'a hi Tarshish lamma kache hilou ham, ijeh-inem itileh Pathen nangma hi lungset them, hepi them, lunghangvah lou, longlouva lungsetna nei jing Pathen thilsebol louva lunghei kit ji Pathen na hiti kahet jing sa nahi, ati.
en_web: He prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please, LORD, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.
en_kjv: And he prayed unto the Lord, and said, I pray thee, O Lord, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh hin ataovin, “Vo pakai, hitia hi nabol dia kaseisa hilou ham? Hijeh a chu Spain langa jamsoh tei kanagot ahi! Milungset them le mihepi them, thoh hat jing, khoto jing lunghei ding go jing talen matsah lougo nahi kahei.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai ka hinkho hi keija konin lamang tan, kei dingin hin sangin thi aphajo tai.
en_web: Therefore now, LORD, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
en_kjv: Therefore now, O Lord, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
tcz_gospelgo: Vopakai tunvang kahin sangin neithat le chun phajonte,” ati.

tcz: Chujou chun Pakaiyin “Hitia na lunghang jengpi hi dih na kisah hinam atin ahi”.
en_web: The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
en_kjv: Then said the Lord, Doest thou well to be angry?
tcz_gospelgo: pakaiyin adonbut’in, “nalunghanpi thei ipi ham?” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Jonah chu khopi a konin solam’a apotdohin lhambuh akisonin hiche limnoija chun atou in khopi chu epi hungsoh mong am tin atouvin ave tan ahi.
en_web: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
en_kjv: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah chu apotdoh-in khopi niso lama agatouve. Hikoma hin lim kisonin alim noiya atouvin, Nineveh khopia e-aso ding ve-lhi jingin aum’e.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in umphung khat akedoh sahin Jonah umna chu akhukhum sah in lim in ason peh tai, hitia hi bolphatna alung hesoh chu lungmonsah ding agon ahi. Hichun Jonah jong um-phungkhat in ajam khum chu akipah beseh jengin ahi.
en_web: The LORD God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
en_kjv: And the Lord God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin Jonah limbel din umphung khat akesah-in ahi. Jonah-in umphung akipapi lheh jenge.

tcz: Ahinlah ajing nikhoa kho ahungvah phat in Pathen in lung alhalut in umgui chu aneuvin ahileh um-phung chu anechaijun umphung jong chu agot lhahsah tai.
en_web: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.
en_kjv: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla ajing khovah lhah-in umphung chu Pathen thusah-in lungin anen athitai.

tcz: Nisa ahung so doh phat in Pathen in nisa aveven asat sah jing in, nisa chun Jonah lujang asal a ahileh amajong alhalhop jeng in athinom leo jeng in ahi. “Kei dingin hitia hin sangin thima apha joi” ati.
en_web: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa son Pathenin niso lam huisa alansah-in, nisan aluchang asah peh behseh phat’in Jonah chu alhu lham pai ding a hitai. Jonah chuathi nom leo jengin, “Thi leng kadeijoi,” tin aseitai.

tcz: Hichun Pathenn in Jonah jah’a, um-gui athia na lunghan jeng chu dih nakisah hinam? ati leh Jonah in adonbut nin “Heng’e thina changei ja lunghang ka hitai” ati.
en_web: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
en_kjv: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pathenin ajah a, “Hiche umphung jeh a lunghanna thei ipi naneiyem?” ati. Jonah chun adonbut’in, “Lunghang dia kilom mong, thi geiya lung hang thei kahi!” tin aseiye.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Nangin natu louhel hiche um-gui hi khan jong na khansah theilou jankah khatna mang thah kit ahi tai.
en_web: The LORD said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.
en_kjv: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin ajah a aseiyin, “Hiche umphung hi jankah a hung kehdoh, ajinga thi kit ahin, nang kesah jon ghilou nathisah hilou-ahivangin nalung natpi lheh-e!

tcz: Achutileh hiche Ninevah khopi lentah, akhosunga mihem sang jakhat le sang somni jen lhagao, muthim noija umnalai ho leh ganhing tamtah um hohi ka lainatpi lou ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”
en_kjv: and should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
tcz_gospelgo: Achutile Nineveh khopi lentah khu Ken ichan geiya ka-itjoh ding hitam! Ahimongin jong akhosunga khun monabei chapang mai mai jong milhing sang ja khat le sang som ni lahingin, gancha simsen lou to aumthai!” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Jotham phatlaija Micah henga anasei ahi. Ahaz le Hezekiah chu Judate leng ana hilhonin, Samaria le Jerusalem chungchang thua thil anamu sahin ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
en_kjv: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gama Jotham le Ahaz chule Hezekiah lengvai poh laiyin Moresheth khoa cheng Micah henga Pakaiyin asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakaiyin Micah henga Samaria le Jerusalem khopi te ni chung chang thudol abonchan aphongdoh-e.

tcz: Kigosan umun! Vannoija um chitin namtin jousen, ngaijuvin nangho vannoija um mitin vaipi jousen, Vo leisetle asunga umjousen ngaisoh keijun, Pakai thaneipenin Houin thenga konin nang ho dounan hettohsah in apang jinge.
en_web: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
en_kjv: Hear, all ye people; Hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: And let the Lord God be witness against you, The Lord from his holy temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipin ngaiyuvin; Leiset chung chengten jasoh keiyun! Hatchungnung Pakaiyin nangho douna aseiye. Ngaiyun, avan Houin a thu aseitai!

tcz: Ven! Pakai ahung’e! A van mun alaltouna a hin dalhaha, leiset munsang lai jouse ahin chotpha ding ahi.
en_web: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
en_kjv: For behold, the Lord cometh forth out of his place, And will come down and tread upon the high places of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai amunthenga konin ahungin, Hung kumlhan, molvum jouse achot ding ahi.

tcz: Molsang jouse akengto noija jolsoh ding, phaichama longluta, khoilu meiyin akah jolla, asuhlanga twi kisunglha bang ding ahi.
en_web: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
en_kjv: And the mountains shall be molten under him, And the valleys shall be cleft, As wax before the fire, And as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
tcz_gospelgo: Achot ten gmolsang jouse jolsoh din g, Molsang jouse molvuma twilhaisuh banga phaichama longlha diu ahi.

tcz: Ipi-jeh'a hitobang thil sohham! Ajeh chu Israel galbol jeh le Juda insung pumpi chonset jeh ahi – a nampumpi chonset jeh ahi;. Israel galbol hi koi pentah themmo kichansah ding ham? Samaria akhopiu! A milim doi hounau khopi lailung hoilai ham? Akhopiu Jerusalem ahi.
en_web: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
en_kjv: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, And for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen douna Israelte chonsea doumah abol jal’uva thil hicheng hi hungsoh ding ahi. Israel doumah bol hi koipen mochang ding ham? Akhopiu Samaria ngoh ding ahi! Judah gamsunga milimdoi kihou hi koi themmio ding ham? Jerusalem khopi themmi ding ham? Jerusalem khopi ngoh ding ahi!

tcz: Hijeh chun, kei Pakaiyin Samaria kho hi tollhanga alomchanga kasetna min lengpilei bolna bepma kaumsaha, lhang chunga songpal jouse jong phaichama katollhaha, khombul jouse jong kakal doh ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
en_kjv: Therefore I will make Samaria as a heap of the field, And as plantings of a vineyard: And I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, And I will discover the foundations thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Samaria khopi hi khogem kaso ding, lengpileiya bol thei kahisah ding ahi. Khopi sung thilse jouse phaicham khat’a kasun lhah ding, khopi bulpi khom jouse alheng lhol’a kajam ding ahi.

tcz: Khopi sunga milim doi kisem thuho jouse jong kavoh chip ding, alodoh agou jouse jong meiya kahal vamding, ajeh chu hiti ho jouse chu aboncha notiho mana kidong khoma kimu ahi.
en_web: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
en_kjv: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, And all the hires thereof shall be burnt with the fire, And all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: For she gathered it of the hire of a harlot, And they shall return to the hire of a harlot.
tcz_gospelgo: Milomdoi manlu tah tah ho kasuhgoiya, Houin a noti ho kipe chengse chu kahalvam ding, amilimdoi chengse alhuh lhuh a kise ding ahiuve. Semaria khopin hicheng hi leiphatna dia kithoina amanu ahin, tua vang melmaten munchom a doi hou dia akaimang diu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman lunghemin pul dou’inge. Kengchot se lou in keng keovin vahle ing’e. Sial bangin ham- ingting, chule sumbupi bangin lunghem- inge.
en_web: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
en_kjv: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stript and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, And mourning as the owls.
tcz_gospelgo: Micah hin aseiyin, “Hichejeh hin kap’in maovinge. Kalung gim vetsahna sagohkeo le kengto keova kavale ding ahi. Kamkei penin peng ing ting, va-ngongsao hamin ham ing’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin kamite abolsetna ma ha hi amelsebeh seh jeng tan, adamdohna ding ahahsabeh seh jenge, kamite Jerusalem kelkot phung ahung geitai.
en_web: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: For her wound is incurable; For it is come unto Judah; He is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria maha kiboldam thei lou ding, Judah jong hitobanga chu genthei thoh ding koncha ahitai; kamite chenna Jerusalem kelkot phunga manthahna ahung lhungtai,” ati.

tcz: Igalmi Gath jah a seipoh hihhel un, Beth Lephrah a jong kap hih hellun kinepna vetsahnan natahsao leivui laha kilihle leovin.
en_web: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
en_kjv: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: In the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal ilel’u hi Gath a kamelmateu gaseipeh dauvin: nakau jong musah hih-un. Beth Leaphrah mite, nalung gim chu vetsahnan leivui lah a kilih leuvin!

tcz: Nangho Shaphir- a um mite, sohchang kikai mong bangin, sagohkeole jahchan kile kit tauvin. Nang ho Zaanan mite kulpia konin potdohdatauvin. Nangho Beth-ezel mite lunghem un, nakhopiu khombul jouse akilon soh tah jeh in.
en_web: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
en_kjv: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: The inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; He shall receive of you his standing.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Shaphir mite, sagoh keo, jum le ja thoh-in ohchangin kitol’uvin. Zaanan khoa chengte akhopiuva konin apotdoh ngam tapouve. Bethezel kho mite lunghem najah tengu, kiselna aum loudol hetauvinnate.

tcz: Nangho Maroth a um miten vang panpina hung ding nangah lallheh jengui, ahinlah Pakaiya kona khaveng vung thutanna ahung lenglhan, Jerusalem kotpi phung ahung geitai.
en_web: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: But evil came down from the Lord unto the gate of Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin manthahna Jerusalem kom ahinlhut phat’in Maroth miten onthol ding angah lel lheh tauve.

tcz: Lachish khoa chengte, nasakol kangtalai a kaina ding bupeh unlang lhauvin, nangho Juda mite, khopi masapen nahiuve, nanghon Jeusalem chonsetna a napuilut’u ahitai.
en_web: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
en_kjv: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: She is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: For the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Lachish a chengten sakolte kangtalai to tolloiyun. Israelte nachonset nakom’un, Jerusalem geiyin nachonset sah tauve.

tcz: Moresheth-gat jong chu kilhahna ding thilpeh tilou hoidoh nading umlou ahitai. Aczib khopi mite, Israel lengpa dinga lheplhaha hung pang ding nahitauve.
en_web: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
en_kjv: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: The houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun tun Judah tan Moresheth Gath lhadoh tauvin. Isdrael lengthen Achzib khopia konin panpina imacha mutapouvinte.

tcz: O Mareshah mite nakhopi jou ding galmi nahenga kahinpuilut ding ahi, chule Israel lamkaiho, Israel loupina chu Adulam henga che ding ahitai.
en_web: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
en_kjv: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: He shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Mareshah mite, nakhopiu toupha din gmelma khut’a Pakaiyin naoehdoh diu ahitai. Israel lamkai loupe the the ho jong Adullam songkoa gakisel diu ahi.

tcz: Oh Juda mite ho, lunghem vetsahnan, nalujang sam kivotolunlang, muthong bangin lutol deldullin um uvin, ajeh chu nachate nahenga kona migama sohchanga kikai mong ding ahitauve.
en_web: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
en_kjv: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; Enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; For they are gone into captivity from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Judahte, na-it lai lai yu chapang ho lung gimpin sam kivochai jengun. Muthong bangin lutol’in um’uvin, nachateu akikaimangin sohchangin atol tauve.

tcz: Ajalkhun chunga alupna muna, ajan jan a thilse bolding ngaitoa gel gelho ada ahiuve, ijeh-inem itileh athodoh teng abol nathei tha aneiyu ahi.
en_web: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
en_kjv: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! When the morning is light, they practise it, Because it is in the power of their hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Jalkhuna mitsing louva thilse jeng gel jingte ada nahiuve! Jingkah khovah vah-in, agonsau thilse chu amasapenin abol pan jengui.

tcz: Gam phabep na deichat jong chu nakilah jengin ahi, mi koitobang ham insah na deichat jong chu nakilah jengin ahi.
en_web: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
en_kjv: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; And houses, and take them away: So they oppress a man and his house, Even a man and his heritage.
tcz_gospelgo: Loumun adei le alauvin, mi thil imacha cha abit’a aum theipoi.

tcz: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi, “Thilse naboljeha thilse kapeh ding; nanah homma kona na lolchang na bodoh jou lou ding, Chuleh kiletsah tahin lam jot hih'in, phat khohtah hung ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
en_kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, From which ye shall not remove your necks; Neither shall ye go haughtily: For this time is evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hahsatna lhun khumsah kagot nahiuvinm jamdoh theipouvin nate. Gim hesohna nato diu, hoi tho tah a lam najot lou diu ahitai.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chule nagal miten totnop na-a na nei ding, nang douna-a kiletsahna la asah ding, keiho amongthah kahi tauve, Pakaiyin kamite chanding akheltan, kakoma konin kachanding akilah dohtan ahi.
en_web: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
en_kjv: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, And lament with a doleful lamentation, And say, We be utterly spoiled: He hath changed the portion of my people: How hath he removed it from me! Turning away he hath divided our fields.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hi ahung lhun teng, nathoh nai mihon gim hahsa khohje kihilna hiche anoiya la hi asah diu: Amangthah hel kahitauve, Kagamu Pakaiyin alamangtan, Soh a eihenteu apedoh tai,” tiuvinte ati.

tcz: Pakai miten nagamgi iti kisekhen ham tia aei sangun, michom dangin nagamgi asekhen ding ahitai.
en_web: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
en_kjv: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot In the congregation of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi Pakai mite agamsung hi akilepeh ki tphat jongle nangho chan ding umponte.

tcz: Hitobang chu seitahih in, mipiten adonbutuve. Hitobng chun gaothu seidan.
en_web: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
en_kjv: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: They shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon eihil’un kajah a, “kakom’uva thu seiphong hih-in. Nasei phong ho chengse seiphong phong dan. Pathenin eihot louhel diu ahi.

tcz: O Israel insung mite, hitobanga hi thu kiseimong mong ding hinam? Pakai lhagao chu thohhat taha um mong hinam? Adih chu nabol nom leh, kilhamonna thu keija kona najah ding ahiye.
en_web: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
en_kjv: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, Is the spirit of the Lord straitened? Are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi gaosap chang a nagel ham? Pakaiyin lung alhaso hitam? Hitobangpi hi abolmong ding ham? Thildih bolte dia thilpha khoto to um asei lou ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Tutahin kamite eidoudin akipanun, galmite bangin, mi lungmonga umjong anung lamah asangkhol na holhah pehun, kiphatlam taha umho jong gal nabol khumuve.
en_web: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
en_kjv: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: Ye pull off the robe with the garment From them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “kamite nadel khum’un, inluma choldo nom a galmuna hung kile kit ho geiyin ponsil nihchen lahpeh kit din nachang lhiuve.

tcz: Kamite numeiho, nomtah a achennaova konin anodoh un, achateo asenhoa konin jong Pathen loupina alamang tauve.
en_web: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
en_kjv: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; From their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: kamite numeiho inluma konin nadeljam’un, achateu chu kavangboh changkit louhel din nahcom gamtauve.

tcz: Kipatdoh un! Chetauvin! Hikom mun hi na gamule na in-u ahipoi, nangho dinga chonsetna dimset mun ahi, chule themmona jeh'a kichai deh jeng nahiuve.
en_web: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
en_kjv: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: Because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipatdoh-in chen, hikoma lungmon abeitai. Nachonsetnauvin hiche mun jeng jong hi manthahna achuhsah ding ahitai.

tcz: Avetkah nan Themgao tamtah laha jousei themgao khat in, na kom ah, “Keiman tunia ju leh khamna theija Kipana Thupha kasei ding ahi!” ati.
en_web: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
en_kjv: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; He shall even be the prophet of this people.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche miten adeiyu Themgao chu jouthu le lepthol thu jeng seile lea, ‘Lengpitwi le ju nadon jing theina diuvin gaopeh nange,’ ti ho chubou ahi.

tcz: “Nikhat leh O Israel keiman kahin khop ding nahiuve, keiman akidalha amoh chengse kahin khop ding nahiuve, kelngoihonte banga hamhing laha kahin lonkhom kit ding nahiuve. Heng’e, na gamuva mi hung tam kit ding ahi.
en_web: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
en_kjv: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, As the flock in the midst of their fold: They shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kenvang kaikhom ung ting, Israel amoh chengse kachop khom ding ahi. Akulsung jon dia kihoikhom kelngoi hon banga kahoi khom ding nahiuve. Hamdong lah kelngoite dimset banga nagamsungu hi mihem tamtah hung dim kit ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Na lamkaiteuvin nakikai mong naova kona nasuhtup kitdiu ahi, chule nagalmiteu kelkot phunga kona na hong sunga nahung kile kit dingu ahi, na Lengpaovin na lamkai untin na Pakaiyu mong mongin na ventup jing dingu ahi”.
en_web: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
en_kjv: The breaker is come up before them: They have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: And their king shall pass before them, And the Lord on the head of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin lampi semdoh-in tin, amaho hi sohchanna muna konin puidoh-inte. Khopi kelkot phujal’un tin, jalen diu ahi. Alengpau –Pakai Amatah-in apuidoh diu ahi.

tcz: Ngaijuvin, nangho Israel lamkaihon, nangho adihlouva kona adih hekhen ho.
en_web: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
en_kjv: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, And ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipoten! Thudih khohsah dia kigel nang hon,

tcz: Ahinlah nanghon thilpha nahouvin, thilphalou nangailuve, nanghon kamite ahing changin avun nalip doh pehun, aphe jouse jong agua konin naleodohpehun ahi.
en_web: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
en_kjv: Who hate the good, and love the evil; Who pluck off their skin from off them, And their flesh from off their bones;
tcz_gospelgo: thilpha naho’uvin, thilse nadeijo’uve. Kamite vun nalip’un, apheu na-at lhauvin,

tcz: Kamite aphe naneovin, avun jouse nalip dohuvin, agu nahebohpehuvin asa’u, sa kihonna belsunga sa hon bangin na kihonuvin ahi.
en_web: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
en_kjv: Who also eat the flesh of my people, And flay their skin from off them; And they break their bones, And chop them in pieces, as for the pot, And as flesh within the caldron.
tcz_gospelgo: kamite nanegam tauve. Avun’u nalipdoh-un, aguu naheh bongun, aphe avouvu belsunga hontheiyin na-atpan pan’ui.

tcz: Chutengleh nahahsat genthei niuleh Pakai hengah panpina ngaichan nathum kitun, na taonao na sanpeh diuva naginchat mongu hinam? Thilse tampi nabol jou keijuva, Pakai angsunga thil na thumuleh, amit kale changa jong navet louhel diu ahi.
en_web: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
en_kjv: Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: He will even hide his face from them at that time, As they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai henga natao phat’u hung lhung ding, Aman la nahou lou diu ahi. Thilse nabol jal’un natao nau sang ponte.

tcz: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi. “Nang ho, themgao lhem hon kamite napui mong tauve! Anneh ding napeteu henga kichamna thun na kiteppiuvin, ahinlah nehding napenomloute hengah gal nabol khumun ahi.
en_web: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, That bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; And he that putteth not into their mouths, They even prepare war against him.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum apeh tengu chamna um ding seipeh a, apeh da tengu gal hung kon jeng dia thusei Themgaoten kamite alhemlha gamtauve. Hiche Themgaoho jah a hin Pakaiyin aseiyin,

tcz: Tua hi nangho jan muthim tobanga naum diu, themgao thilmu banga namu lou diu, ahitai. Muthimin na umkimvellu ahitai, chuleh nahin nikhou achaina lam hiding ahitai.
en_web: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
en_kjv: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; And it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; And the sun shall go down over the prophets, And the day shall be dark over them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo themgaoho, hingsot tapouvin nate! Nisan nalhum khum diu ahitai. Kamite lam hilouva napui jal’uva, Themgao thilmua jong ima namu lou diu, thilsoh ding imacha jong nasei thei lou diu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuteng gao thilmu neipa jong kijumso ding, chuleh mitva neipa jong kisih ding chuleh pon a na mai nakitom ding, ajeh chu Pathen’a kona donbutna namu tahlou jeh ahi.
en_web: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
en_kjv: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: Yea, they shall all cover their lips; For there is no answer of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Khonung thilsoh ding seiho chu aguilhun lout eng mi vetda chang diu ahi. Pathenin adonbut lout eng min avet neo diu ahi.

tcz: Ahivangin kei dingin vang katha ahat in, lhasam louvin Pakai Lhagao thahat nan kadim jing nai. Keima Pakai thutah leh ahatnan kadim jingnai Israel chonsetna hangsan tahin ka doudal jing’e.
en_web: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
en_kjv: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, And of judgment, and of might, To declare unto Jacob his transgression, And to Israel his sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Keivang Pakaiyin A-Lhagaoeidip’in, thahat eipen, thudih le hanna eipen, Israelte chonsetna chengse kaseipeh ngamin ahi.

tcz: Kasei ngaijuvin, Israel lamkaiho! nang hon thu adiha kitan natheuvin, akitoha thilbol nahei monguvin ahi.
en_web: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
en_kjv: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, And princes of the house of Israel, That abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipote, thudih deimoa, thildih chu adih louva kheldoh ho!

tcz: Nanghon Jerusalem jou leh nal chuleh thisan so pumin na sauvin ahi.
en_web: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
en_kjv: They build up Zion with blood, And Jerusalem with iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khopi chu tolthana ke thudih louva natousah-u ahitai!

tcz: Lamkaija panghon nehguh muna dingin thu natanuvin! Thempua panghon jong Pathen danbu sum lonan thu nahillun, Themgaova pang hon jong sum munana dingin gaothu aseijun, ahijeng vang'in Pakai jenga bou kingai in bou, naki seijuve. “Ema akhohpoi keiho heng lam ah hung un.” ajeh chu Pakai eiho laha aume natiuve.
en_web: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
en_kjv: The heads thereof judge for reward, And the priests thereof teach for hire, And the prophets thereof divine for money: Yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? None evil can come upon us.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sung vaipoten nehguh akilah-un, Themputen Danthu chu tohman neiyin ahilchen’un, themgaohom sum lo nan thu aphonguve. Abonchauvin Pakaiyin aumpi dol’in akiseiyuve. “Pakaiyin eiumpiuve,” ati cheh-ui.

tcz: Nangho jeh'a Zion lhang jong loulai kikai banga kikai ding, Jerusalem jong mangthah dinga kemsuh ding! Gammang soh tading, tule tua houin kisah namun khu.
en_web: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
en_kjv: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, And Jerusalem shall become heaps, And the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho jal’a Zion lhang hi loukaiya kikaiya, Jerusalem hi khogem doh ding, Houin kisahna lhang hi gammang thim lai soh ding ahi.

tcz: Ninunung leh Pakai Hou in molsang hi molsang jouse laha asang pena hung kitung doh ding, vannoi pumpia dinga munpipen hung hiding ahi. Hiche molsanga chu mitin vaipi hung long khoma Pathen ahou khom diu ahi.
en_web: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
en_kjv: But in the last days it shall come to pass, That the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, And it shall be exalted above the hills; And people shall flow unto it.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin kisahna molsang hi Molsang pen ahina ding nikho hung lhunga, Molle lhang jouse sanga Sangjo ding ahi. Namtin vaipi simsen louvin Hiche molsang chu hinbel’in tin,

tcz: Namtina kona mipite hung kikhoma asei diu, “Hungun Pakai molsang a kaltou uu hitin Jacob Pathen henga chun. Hiche muna chu aman lampi eihil dingu chule aman eihilnao lampia chu ichediu ahi. Chutengle eihon jong Pakai lampi semsa dung’a iche theidiu ahi.
en_web: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;
en_kjv: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, And to the house of the God of Jacob; And he will teach us of his ways, And we will walk in his paths: For the law shall go forth of Zion, And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Amiteuvin jong asei diu, “Pakai molsanga kal’u hitin, Israel Pathen Houin a cheute. Eibolsahnom’u eihil diu, Asemsa lampia iche diu ahi. Pakai hilchahna Jerusalema hungkon ahin, Zion a konin Pakaiyin Amite jah a thu seiye,” tiuvinte.

tcz: Pakaiyin namtin vaipi kaha chamna asem ding, chuteng leh mihon a chemjam’u tucha-a akikhen uva, atengcha’u jong kang kuija akikhendiu, namkhatin namkhat douna- a chemjam alap louhel diu ahitai.
en_web: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
en_kjv: And he shall judge among many people, And rebuke strong nations afar off; And they shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruninghooks: Nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin gamla naiya thaneitah tah Namtin vaipi kidou thu seichaminte. Agal chemjamu langkonin khengun tin, Tengcha jouse kangkuiya akhen diu, Namtin vaipi gal kon kit louva, Galsat dia jong kigo lou didu ahi.

tcz: Mitin chamnale lungmona-a khosadiu, miho jousen ama ama lengpigui limnoi le theichang phung noija nomsa taha hinkho amandiu, kichatna mong mong umtalou ding, Vana kona Pakai galmihon atepsa ahitai.
en_web: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.
en_kjv: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; And none shall make them afraid: For the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin lung monga um diu, Alengpilei le theichang leiya chenguva, Ahoh kicha ding beihel ding, Hiche Thaneipen Pakaiyin atepsa ahitai.

tcz: Akimvelluva mitinin ama ama doihou cheh-u Pathen in houjong leu, Eihon vang Pakai i-Pathen- u atonsot atonsot geija ijui jing diu ahi.
en_web: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
en_kjv: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, And we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi anam namin adoi-apathen cheh ngaiyintin, akihou cheh diu, eihon vang tonsot tonsot’a Pakai i-Pathenu ihouvuva athua inun diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho ahunglhun teng tah chuleh “A elbai jouse kakhop khomsoh keija, min adelmong jouse jong kakhopkhom ding chuleh keiman kasuh lhaset jouse jong kakhopkhom dingu ahi.
en_web: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
en_kjv: In that day, saith the Lord, will I assemble her that halteth, And I will gather her that is driven out, And her that I have afflicted;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakiyin aseiyin, “Talen kamatsah a, sohchang genthei thohte kakhop khomna din gphat ahung lhunge.

tcz: Koitobang alhasam jouse jong kakihin sosah chehdiu, migama kikai mongsa ho jong namlen ka sosah ding ahi. Chuteng keima Pakaiyin tonsot geija Jerusalema lengvai kapoh ding ahi.”
en_web: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
en_kjv: And I will make her that halted a remnant, And her that was cast far off a strong nation: And the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion From henceforth, even for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Elbai chatmoa, in a kona gamla tah gei ahitauvin, ahingdoh amoh chengse to abul kapatdoh a thah a, nam lentah kasosah ding ahi. Hichea pat hi Zion a pansa, tonsot tonsot geiya achunguva vai kahomding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nang Jerusalem chanu, Pathen mite chenna, lengvaipohna thaneitah nei, na vaihopna hung kile kitding ahi, nang man tamtah Jerusalem.
en_web: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And thou, O tower of the flock, The strong hold of the daughter of Zion, Unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; The kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem, kelngoi chingpa banga Pathenin amite achin jingna mun, nalenggam dinga khopi lenpen mun nahi kit tei ding ahi.

tcz: Ipi bolla tua hi genthei tah’a kap nahim? Na lamkai ding leng naneilou hitam? Na michingho thigama hitam? numei naosonat in aphah banga na nahi hitam?
en_web: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?
en_kjv: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee? Is thy counseller perished? For pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
tcz_gospelgo: Idia hibang othonga peng nahim? Iti namei naoso nat nabah ham? Leng beiya nauma, thumop them jouse thigam jeh ham?

tcz: Vo Zion chanu, numei naoso nat in aphah-a athohlal bang in kipeh le le jeng in. Ajeh chu tua hi nangman khopi hi nadalhah ding ahitai, gangtaha gamla taha Babylona nakikai mong ding ahitai.
en_web: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
en_kjv: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, And thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; There the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem mite, tua khopi dalha gamchang noiya nachen ding jeh-in, numei naoso nat bangin, na san kipehle le jengin. Babylon gam najot din gahitan, hijongle namelmatea konin pakaiyin nahuhhing nante.

tcz: Tua hi namtin vaipi nangma doudinga hung kikhom ding ahitai. Ahinlah hia chun Pakaiyin naveng intin, nagal mite-a kon in nahuhdoh nante.
en_web: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
en_kjv: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, That say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadelkhum din namtin vaipi akikhomtauve. Amahon, “Jerusalem hi suhmang tei tei ding ahi! Hiche khopi hi alheng alhol’in jam jengu hite,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah amahon Pathen lunggel le athilgon ahepouve. Pathen in ipibolla amite asuh gentheija, ajepma akhoptup kit ham ti hi, hiche nam miten ahetheipouve.
en_web: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
en_kjv: But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, Neither understand they his counsel: For he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin hiche nam mite hin Pakai lunggel ahepouve. Cahngphal kipukhoma kichilngem banga Pakaiyin talen matsah dia apuikhom lam akihet phah pouve.

tcz: Kipatdoh inlang nam hohi suchip in, O Jerusalem Keiman thih saki hole sum eng chaokol kapeh ding nahin, nam tampi ahel hella navoh chip ding ahi. Nangman agou anei hou amansah hou chu Pakai angsunga napeh lut kit ding ahi.
en_web: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to the LORD, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
en_kjv: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: For I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: And thou shalt beat in pieces many people: And I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, And their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Jerusalem mite, cheuvin namelmateu talen matsah-un! Aki thih to bang, atin sum-eng tobang bongchal hat’a kahatsah diu, namtin vaipi nasuhgep’uva, pumhat’a achomdoh-u neile gou chengse chu, Vannoi pumpi Pakai-Kei neipeh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Tun galsat dingin sepai jalamkai ho kigong tauvin, Jeruslem khopi, ikimvelluvah galmiten eiumkimvel tauve, galsatdin sepai mihonpi hung kikhom loijun. Amaho Israel lamkaipa satdin ahung kon taove.
en_web: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
en_kjv: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: He hath laid siege against us: They shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem mite, sepaite khomsoh loiyun! Galmin eiumchah tauve! Israel lamkaipu adelkhum tauve!

tcz: Ahinlah nangma, O Bethlehem Ephrahthah, Judah phunga aneopen nahi, hijongleh nanga kona hi kei dinga Israel sunga vaihom ding khat hung peng doh ding, Ama chu akipatna ahung kona gollui laipeha ahitan, ni masalai, lha masalaija umjing sapeh ahitai.
en_web: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
en_kjv: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, Though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, Yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; Whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Bethlehem, Ephrathah, Judah gamsunga kho neo pen hijongle chun, nasunga kona Israel vaipo ding khat kapensah ding, aphunggui jong khanglui laipeh a to kisut mat ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin amite naosonat thohnu naonei kahsea chu donlouva akoija ahaisending ahitai, chuteng leh amoh ahing nalai chengse chu amite henga hung kile kitding ahi.
en_web: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
en_kjv: Therefore will he give them up, Until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: Then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi chapa nei ding nu nao pen masangsea pakaiyin amite hi amelmateu khut’a pehdoh a donda dingahitai. Chujou teng agamsung mite, gamchoma sohchangte chu amiteu tik igom kit diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai thahat vanga ama chu dinga akelngoi hon chu avah ding ahiye. Hitia chu amite chu koiman asuhlong louding ahitai chule leiset kolmong geija atha’u ajeding ahitai chule amaho jong lungmonga chengdiu ahitai.
en_web: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
en_kjv: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, In the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; And they shall abide: For now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama ahung teng, Pakai thahat mangcha amite chunga vaihom ding, Pakai Pathen loupina jal’a vaihom ding ahi. Amite lung mongtah a cheng mitinin alal loupina aphondoh a,

tcz: Chuleh ama chamkonna hung hiding, Assyria miten gamsunga gal ahin boltinguleh, kelngoi chinga mi sagi le mipi laha milen milal miget pang diu ahi.
en_web: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
en_kjv: And this man shall be the peace, When the Assyrian shall come into our land: And when he shall tread in our palaces, Then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, And eight principal men.
tcz_gospelgo: aman chm alensah ding ahi.

tcz: Amahon Assyria gam'a chemjama vai ahopuva Nimrod gamsung jong vai ahop diu Assyria mite a kona hi amahon eihuhdoh diu ahi
en_web: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
en_kjv: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, And the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: Thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, When he cometh into our land, And when he treadeth within our borders.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal manchah thahat a Assyria mite ajo diu, Assyria miten i-gamsungu adel khum tengule eihuhdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng Israel amoh chengse mitin vaipi laha um uva, Pakaiya kona hungkumlha daitwi tobang ahilouleh hampa chunga go hung julha tobang hidiu ahitai.
en_web: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.
en_kjv: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people As a dew from the Lord, As the showers upon the grass, That tarrieth not for man, Nor waiteth for the sons of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel mi ahingdoh amoh chengse chu, namtin dia Pakaiyin alhahsah daitwi dapjen le hamhing chunga gophin tobang hi diu ahi. Pathen kisonpia, mihem chunga ki-ngai lou diu ahi.

tcz: Israel amoh chengse chu namtin vaipi laha um uva, kithe thang soh diu, gammang laha keipi bahkai um banga, chule kelngoi hon laha keipi bahkai nou banga umdiu, kelngoi chu ahung potdoh tih tengule abotel teldiu koimachan ahuhdoh theilou tobang hiding ahi.
en_web: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
en_kjv: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people As a lion among the beasts of the forest, As a young lion among the flocks of sheep: Who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, And none can deliver.
tcz_gospelgo: namtin vaipi lah a dalhah chengse chu gammang noiya hamjing lah a sakei neh hol bang diu; sakeiyin kelngoi amat khah teng, abokhum jenga, atel adah a ajan a, huhdohna thei beihel’a alha tobang hi diu ahi.

tcz: Nagalmi, nakidoupite chunga Israel in nadinpi ding, chule nagal mite kithat gamding.
en_web: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
en_kjv: Thine hand shall be lift up upon thine adversaries, And all thine enemies shall be cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel’in amelmate jothon tin, aboncha asuhgam diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh na sakolteu katha gamding, nakangtalai jouse jong ka suhset ding.
en_web: “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.
