en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, That I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, And I will destroy thy chariots:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiteng chule nasakolteu le kangtalai chengse kaimang in gting kasuhgam ding ahi.

tcz: Nakhutna na tohdoh phunsan jouse jong kasuh mongsoh helding
en_web: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.
en_kjv: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, And throw down all thy strong holds:
tcz_gospelgo: nagamsunguva khopi chengse sumang ing ting, nakulpi pal jouseu kaphet lhahsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Nakulpi jouse jong kasuhchim soh hel ding.
en_web: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
en_kjv: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; And thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
tcz_gospelgo: Namanchah jingo mitphel doi lathem sumang ing ting, phunsan them khat beh khenpeh pouvinge.

tcz: Milim doihouna nasem jouse jong kasuh mong soh ding.
en_web: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
en_kjv: Thy graven images also will I cut off, And thy standing images out of the midst of thee; And thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Namilimdoi jouseu le doikhom song jouse kasuhmang ding, nasemsau thil ho chibai boh kit tapouvin nate.

tcz: Nakoma kona asrins doi nahou jong ka suhmong ding chuleh nakhopi jouseu jong kasuh mongsoh helding ahi.
en_web: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
en_kjv: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: So will I destroy thy cities.
tcz_gospelgo: Angamsunguva nanungjai nuu-Asherah milimdoi loilhung ting, nakhopi chengseu kasuhgam dingahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin ipi aseijem ngaijuvin, kipat dohin lang na chung chang thuhi molsang jouse maijah ahetoh ding in phongdoh temin.
en_web: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
en_kjv: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, And let the hills hear thy voice.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyin Pakaiyin Israel adouna thu hi! Vo Pakai, kipat’in Israel nadouna thu seiyin; molle lhang jousen nasei ngaiyu hen.

tcz: Chule tun, O molsang jouse Pakai minel na thu kiseidoh hi ngaijuvin, aman amite chungah kinelna thu aseiye. Ami Israelte chunga gahna apeh ding ahi.
en_web: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
en_kjv: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord’s controversy, And ye strong foundations of the earth: For the Lord hath a controversy with his people, And he will plead with Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo molsang ho, tonsot leiset bulpi khom ho, Pakai thusei hi ngai tem’un! Pakaiyin amite douna thu khoh tah aneiye. Israel hehna thu alhut ding ahi.

tcz: O kamite, nachunguva ipi kabolset em? Nachunguva ipi kabol gentheina umem? Nei donbut un.
en_web: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
en_kjv: O my people, what have I done unto thee? And wherein have I wearied thee? Testify against me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo kamite, ipi kabolpeh um? Itobang pohgih kahim? Neidonbut’un.

tcz: Chujong leh keiman Egypt gam'a konin kahin puidohuvin chuleh nabulput na henlhah nauva konin kana lhatdoh tauvin ahi. Aaron, Mose chule Miriam nakithopi dinguvin kahin sollin ahi.
en_web: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
en_kjv: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, And redeemed thee out of the house of servants; And I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a konin kahinpuidoh-un; sohchanna konin kahuhdoh uvin; nalamkai diuvun Mosea le Aaron chule Miriam kasol’e.

tcz: Kamite, nageldoh lou-u mong ham? Moab lengpa Baalak chun itobanga thilse anagon hija, Beor chapa Balaam chun itobanga ana donbut ham, kamiten geldohuvin. Chule Acace muna kipana Gilgal chengeija nakholjinnao chu geldohuvin. Keima na Pakaiyuvin kakitahna a thil ijakai kabolpeh nahiuve.
en_web: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
en_kjv: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, And what Balaam the son of Beor answered him; From Shittim unto Gilgal; That ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo kamite, Moab lengpa Balak chun i-nalo got’uva, Beor chapa Balaamin iti adonbut’em geldoh tem’un. Acacia ngahmun a pat Gilgal gei lampi dunga thilsoh chengse chu geldoh tem’uvin. Hicheng hi geldoh-un chuteng nangho huhhingna kabol chengse chu hedoh tauvin nate,” ati.

tcz: Ipi thilpeh choija Pakai angsunga kalut dingham? Itobang maicham thil kapeh ding ham? Bongnou jeng pumgo thiltoa kachoilutna a ang sunga bohkhupma kapoh lut ding ham?
en_web: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
en_kjv: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, And bow myself before the high God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, With calves of a year old?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai van Pathen hou dia kahung teng ipi kachoi ding ham? Pumgo thilto dia bongnou hoipen kapeh ding ham?

tcz: Kelngoi chaljeng asang asang chule vadung sangsom jen dimset Olive thaotwi kapehleh lunglhai mong ding hinam? Ka chonset ngaidamna dinga kacha apeng masapen kapeha lunglhai ding hinam?
en_web: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
en_kjv: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, Or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
tcz_gospelgo: kelngoi asang sang kaiying, olive thao kanglou luiyin lonsah leng Pakai lung lhaiyin tem? Kachonset thoina kachapa peng masapen kapeh ding gam?

tcz: Vo mihem, Pakaiyin thilpha chu navetsahsa ahitai, Pakaiy in nanga kona adei chu ipiham? Thu adiha natanpeha, mi khoto ding nakhohsaha, chule na Pathen nunga kinemsahtaha lam najot ding hi ahibouve.
en_web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
en_kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; And what doth the Lord require of thee, But to do justly, and to love mercy, And to walk humbly with thy God?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahipoi, thilpha chu Pakaiyin eihil tauve. Aman eibolsah nomu chu hiche hi ahi: thilsih bol ding, tantih neilouva lungset umsah ding, kneosah nun nemtah a i-pathenu to kiloikhom jing ding ahi.

tcz: Nachiha ahileh Pakai ging in! Pakai ogin in Jerusalem a mijouse akouve. Sugenthei dingin Pakaiyin galmi ahin sol’e.
en_web: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
en_kjv: The Lord’s voice crieth unto the city, And the man of wisdom shall see thy name: Hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai gin chihna ahi. Aman khopi akouvin, “Ngaiyuvin khopi sunga kakhomhon!

tcz: Migilou insunga kikhol gitlouna, joulhepna chu ken ipi kasei ding ham? Gaosap na chunga thil adihlou kite chu kasuh mil thei ding hinam?
en_web: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
en_kjv: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, And the scant measure that is abominable?
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloute insunga chun lepthol’a alah-u gou akikhol’e. Kamah tah thiltena dih lou amangun,

tcz: Thil tena dihlouva kitea, hitobanga lhing louva kiveiho chu, keiman iti kathoh ding ham?
en_web: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
en_kjv: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, And with the bag of deceitful weights?
tcz_gospelgo: hitobang thiltena dih loule kicheh lou mang ho hi iti ka-ngaidam thei ding ham?

tcz: Nalahuva mihaothei hon jong pumhat jeng athouvin, nagam mite hon jong jou thu jeng aseijuve.
en_web: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
en_kjv: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, And the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: nalah-uva mihaohon vaichate kichepnan aneiyu, naboncha mijou jeng nahiuve.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman nang kadenpan nahitai! Na chonset jeh'a ahomkeova kajam nahitai.
en_web: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
en_kjv: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, In making thee desolate because of thy sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachonset jal’uva namanthahna diu thil kagon pan ahitai.

tcz: Nejong lechun nava theilou ding, na oisunga nagil keljing jeng ding, sum kikholdoh nan natin, ema na koidoh thei lou ding, nangin na kholdohsa chu keiman najou dingho kapeh ding ahi.
en_web: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
en_kjv: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; And thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; And thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; And that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: An nejongleu chun valou ding, kel nathoh thoh jongleur chun kheh doh nei pouvin nate; nakhendoh chengu jong galmun akasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Muchi natu jing jeng ding, ahinlah aga nalo louhel ding ahi, Olive thao naheh heh ding, ahinla nangman thaotui nanei lou ding ahi.
en_web: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
en_kjv: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; Thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; And sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
tcz_gospelgo: Chang tujongleu chun na-at lou diu; olive thing thao chil jongleur chun mang thei deh pouvin nate. Lengpitwi kisem joungleu chun nadon lou diu ahi.

tcz: Omri kitipa dan semsa najuijin, Ahab leng giloutah nung na juiyin, hijeh a chu mipi namu jousen ija nahsah louva nanuisat ding ahi.
en_web: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”
en_kjv: For the statutes of Omri are kept, And all the works of the house of Ahab, And ye walk in their counsels; That I should make thee a desolation, And the inhabitants thereof a hissing: Therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
tcz_gospelgo: Omri lengpa le achapa Ahab thilse bol chengse najom jal’uva hicheng hi soh tei ding ahi. Ama ni umchan thilgon najop jal’uva kasuhmang diu, japi hot’a naumdoh diu ahi. Muntin a min navetda soh hel diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ada kahitai! Ajeh chu thingga akilona nunga koiman nehding kimu talou bangbeple lengpi theiga leh theichang kichomna nung tabang in kaumdoh tai.
en_web: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
en_kjv: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, As the grapegleanings of the vintage: There is no cluster to eat: My soul desired the firstripe fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: kakinem tapo! Gilkel pet’a theichang ga holmo le lengpiga holmo kabangtai. Lengpiga jouse le thiecahngga ph alai jouse min alouheo tai.

tcz: Leiset chunga Pathen gingte la amangthah gamtan, mihemte laha lungdih pua khatcha Jong aumpon, thisan soa tolthat jeng ahiuve. Ami jousen asopi kipalna dinga thang kamjeng ahiuve.
en_web: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
en_kjv: The good man is perished out of the earth: And there is none upright among men: They all lie in wait for blood; They hunt every man his brother with a net.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga milungdih khatcha beh aumtapoi, Pathen dia kitah a abeitai. Toltha ding changlhi geh cheh ahiuve. Mitinin agamsung mi chanpi tha din ago’uve.

tcz: Akhutuvin thilse jeng a boluvin lung nachang mongin thilse aboluve. Thutanna pang milen milalhon jong nehguh ding akithum thum'un ahi.
en_web: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
en_kjv: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, The prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; And the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: So they wrap it up.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse bolthem jeng ahiuve. Vaihomte le thutan hon nehguh athum thum’un, mi thu nun theihon jong adei dei adeiyun, hiti hin akihoutoh toh-uve.

tcz: Alahuva aphapena kisei jong chu ling tobang ahin, lungdih pentaha kiseipa jong chu ponlah abang’e, min akailuht nadiu nikho leh talen amat nadiu nikho chu hung lhung ding ahitai.
en_web: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
en_kjv: The best of them is as a brier: The most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: The day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; Now shall be their perplexity.
tcz_gospelgo: Apha pen le lungdih pen a kiseiho jong pannabei nangtom lah tobang bou ahiuve. Themgaote kama agihsal banga Pathenin mipi talen amatsahna ding nikho ahung lhuntai. Tun akisudong tauve.

tcz: Koimacha tahsan hihin, nagol ngaitah jeng jong ahilou leh na inneipi jeng jong tahsan hih in.
en_web: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
en_kjv: Trust ye not in a friend, Put ye not confidence in a guide: Keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
tcz_gospelgo: Naheng nakom tahsan dan, nagol jong gingcha hih-in. Naji koma thusei jeng jong ching theiyin.

tcz: Chapan jong apa, chanun jong anu, mounu in jong atehpi chunga, namelma chu na insung taha kon hiding ahi.
en_web: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
en_kjv: For the son dishonoureth the father, The daughter riseth up against her mother, The daughter in law against her mother in law; A man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: Tulai hin mi chapaten apateu jeng jong a-ngol bol’ui, cha numei hon ma anuteu adouvun, mouthah geiyin atehpi chengseu to akinauve; min melma anei chu a-insung mite ahiuve.

tcz: Keiman Paki jeng bou eipanpi din vejing ingting, eihuhhing ka Pathen kanga jing ding ahi, Chutileh ka Pathen in kataona angai tei ding ahi.
en_web: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
en_kjv: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: My God will hear me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang Pakai ve-lhi jing ing ting, tahsan tah-in Pathen ngah jing inge, Aman eihuhhing nante. Ka-Pathenin kataona ngaiyinte.

tcz: Kagal miten duchatah in neive hihun, lhujong leng kathodoh kit ding ahi. Muthim laha toujong leng Pakai chu kameivah hiding ahi.
en_web: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
en_kjv: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: When I fall, I shall arise; When I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Imelmateu ichunguva akipana diu aumpoi. Lhua ihitauvin, hingjongle ithodoh kit tei diu ahi. Tun muthima um jongleur hen Pakaiyin kho vahsah kit nante.

tcz: Pakaiy in eigimbol jongle kathoh hat ding, ajeh chu ama dounaa kachonset jeh in. Ahinlah aman kachung thu hinkhol nante. Kei dinga thu atan masang sea kangai ngai ding ahi. Pakai in khovah a eipuidoh intin, chuteng chon dihna kamu ding ahi.
en_web: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
en_kjv: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, Until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: He will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai dounan ichonseuvin, chom khat vang alunghan ithot tei diu ahi. Akhonna vangle eihuh-un tin, dih louva min eibolnau chu asuhdih ding ahinai. Khovah eilhut’untin, eihuhhingu imu diu ahi.

tcz: Chuteng kamelmaten Pakai kei langa apan ahetdoh diu, na Pakai hoiya umem tia aseiju chu kijumsoa jahchabeh seh diu ahi. Hichenu chu kamit in noise taha avet ding ahi. Amanu chu lamlen kholai dunga min achotpha a leivui chil banga kichil ding ahi.
en_web: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
en_kjv: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her Which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God? Mine eyes shall behold her: Now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
tcz_gospelgo: Imelmateuvin hiche hi amu teng kijumso diu, “Pakai, na-Pathen hoilam hitam?” tia eidonguva melma ho chu ahiuve. Gal lel’uva min keng chotpha aneiyu, kholai lamlen dunga achil thang thangu imu diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche niteng chule Israel, nakhopi kisapha kit ding, chule nagamgi ho jong kikehlen ding.
en_web: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
en_kjv: In the day that thy walls are to be built, In that day shall the decree be far removed.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Jerusalem mite, khopi pal ho semphatna ding phat ahung lhunge. Hiche tengle nagamgiu jong kikeh len ding ahi.

tcz: Gam tamtah'a kona mipite hunga Assyria a kipana gam latah Egypt, Egypt a kipana Euphrate luipi changei, twipi leh mol ho kallanga, molsang jousea kona lhang sang jouse geija hung diu ahi.
en_web: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
en_kjv: In that day also he shall come even to thee From Assyria, and from the fortified cities, And from the fortress even to the river, And from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
tcz_gospelgo: Muntina konin namiten nahengu hinjon intin, niso lam Assyria gama kon, lhanglam Egypt tama kon, Euphrates luipang dunga kon, Twikhnglen gamla tah tah a kon le molle lhang sang lai laiya hung kon diu ahi.

tcz: Leiset vang hi agoh keova hunglum ding, ajeh chu masanga ana cheng masaho chonset jeh ahi.
en_web: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, For the fruit of their doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset vang hi achung chengte gitlou jal’a gamthip soh ding ahi.

tcz: O Pakai nakelngoi china tenggollin namite neichingun, nakelngoi honte neilam kaijun, gammang laha hin achangsehin cheng jong leo, amahohi Bashan gamle Gilead gam'a kelngoi lhat bangin lhauhen, gollui laiya bangin umuhen.
en_web: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
en_kjv: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, Which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
tcz_gospelgo: O Pakai, nalhensa namite hi kelngoi chingpa kelngoi chin bangin chingin! Gamthip laiya cheng jongleur, ajet aveiyuva gampha lah tampi aum’e. Masanglai aum banguvin, Gilead le Bashan hamhing phalaiya kivah-u hen.

tcz: Henge, tin Pakaiyin aseije. “Keiman thil kidang nasatah tah kabol peh diu Aigupta a kona nahung potdohuva kanabol banga kabol
en_web: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
en_kjv: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt Will I shew unto him marvellous things.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, Egypt’a kona neihin puidoh niu bangin thil kidang bol’in.

tcz: Leiset pumpia namtin vaipin kidang asah sahdiu, Pakaiyin nang hi dinga thil kidang abol tengleh jachatna aneidiu, anakoluva jong kho ajah lou diu ahitai.
en_web: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
en_kjv: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: They shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
tcz_gospelgo: Thahat lheh jongleur namtin vaipin amu tengu kisudong diu ahi. Dongman a nakhang kisip’a kam kihup diu ahi.

tcz: Gul banga levui aleija aledio, leisetna a-opma kithol ganhing banga umdiu ahi. Akulpiuva konna kihot hotna hung potdoh diu, akichat behseh jeh uva Pakai ahin beldiu ahi. Nangma jeh'a amaho hi abonchauva kichasoh kei ding ahiuve.
en_web: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.
en_kjv: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, They shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: They shall be afraid of the Lord our God, And shall fear because of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Leivuiya gul bangin kithol’un tin, akulpi dung tin’uva hung potdoh-uva, kicha kithing thing diu ahi. Kichat jeh a Pakai i-Pathenu ahinbel diu ahi.

tcz: Nang banga agoulo amite ahungdoh amoh chengse dinga themmona, ngaidamna, suhkhelna, subei soh thei Pathen koipen um ding ham? Pathen chu alunghang jing jengpoi, ajeh chu Pakai hi alungset longlou anei hi kipah jo ahibouve.
en_web: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
en_kjv: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, And passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? He retaineth not his anger for ever, Because he delighteth in mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, nang tobang pathen dang aumpoi; namite ahingdoh ho chonset na-ngaidamin; lunghan jing louvin, tantih beiya lungset din neideiyui.

tcz: Neihin lungset kit’un natin; ka chonsetnau chengse jong nakengto noija koi in natin; twikhanglen'a na lelutding ahi.
en_web: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
en_kjv: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; He will subdue our iniquities; And thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Neihepi kit tei diu ahi. Kachonsetnau chotphan, Twikhanglen noilam a sonlhan nate.

tcz: Jacob jong kitahna neitaha nabolla, long louva Abraham nalungset ding, masanglai a kapu kapateu koma na kihahsel banga nabol tei ding ahi.
en_web: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
en_kjv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, Which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakitahna le nalungset longlou namite, kapuiluiyu, Abraham le Jacob chihlhah ho hi, masanglaiya nakitepna bangin musah-in.

tcz: Hiche hi Nineveh khopi chung chang thudola thuphondoh, Elkosh khoa pat Nahum kitipan themgaovin thil’amu banga athil amu ho kisutna lekhabu ahi.
en_web: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
en_kjv: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea kisun cheng hi, Elkosh khoa mi Nahumin Nineveh khopi thudol’a themgao thilmua amu thu kisun ahi.

tcz: Pakai hi Pathen engsetah leh phula jing Pathen ahi. Aman a-lunghan teng phulah abol jin, Pathen in ama doudal te chung’a phu alah ding, A ma lunghanna chu a galmite chung a abuhlhah ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.
en_kjv: God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth; The Lord revengeth, and is furious; The Lord will take vengeance on his adversaries, And he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathenin kidoupi koima anop lensah pon, Adouva pangte talen amatsah cheh-e. Alunghan tengleh Alethusoh keiye.

tcz: Pakai hi kintah’a lunghang lou Thahattah ahi. Chule ajeh beijin Pakaiyin themmo nahi amoh ngaidam jipoi. Pakai hi chimpei le khopi huija alamlhan, Meilhang jouse jong hi akengphanga leivui jeng ahibouve.
en_web: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
en_kjv: The Lord is slow to anger, and great in power, And will not at all acquit the wicked: The Lord hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, And the clouds are the dust of his feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu along hangvah pon, Hinla thahat tah ahin, Themmona nei chengse Talen matsah louvin akoipoi, Pakaiyin lam ajot teng leivui akitungin, Meilhang jouse jong Ama chot khut leivui ahi.

tcz: Twikhanglen jeng jong aphoa ahileh twi akanghel jitan, vadung jouse jong abonchan atingkang soh hel jin ahi; chule Bashan phai le Carmel mol jong anitah lhon in agop lha jitan, Lebanon lhang noulai jong agop paiji tai.
en_web: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.
en_kjv: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, And drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, And the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman asei teng Twikhanglen jong kang jeng, Luiddung jouse jong twi bwiya alupsah ahi. Bashan phaiya lou ho tei kanga, Carmel molsang jong go jeng, Lebanon lhanga pahcha jouse Gosoh hel jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Pakai masanga molsang ho jeng jong akihot lingji tauvin, Thing lhang gam ho jong angimsoh jitan ahi; Chule Pakai angsunga leiset jong ahomkeovin Aum jitan, Vannoi pumpi leh asunga cheng jouse jong abeisoh jitauve.
en_web: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
en_kjv: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, And the earth is burnt at his presence, Yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai angsunga molle lhang jouse killing jeng, Lhang sang jouse amasanga jolsoh jeng ahi. Pakai hung kilah teng leiset kithinga, Leiset le amite kithing jeng ahi.

tcz: Pakai a-lunghan teng koiham Ama masanga ding ngam ding? Alung han deu jeju chu koiham athoh ngapcha ding? Ajeh chu alunghan teng mei-al kisung lha tobang ahin, Songpi jouse jong hi Pakai jeh-in apoh keh jitauve.
en_web: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
en_kjv: Who can stand before his indignation? And who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? His fury is poured out like fire, And the rocks are thrown down by him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai lunghanna hingdoh jou ding koiham? Alungset tijat umtah a hingdoh thei koi ham? Alunghan mei-am kisunglha abangin, Amasanga songpi ho geiyin leivuiyin aleng’ui!

tcz: Pakai hi nunnem tah ahin, Gim le hesoh nikhoa kisel na kulpi ahi; Amaa kiselji mihem ho chu Pakaiyin amelchih sohkei ahi.
en_web: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
en_kjv: The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; And he knoweth them that trust in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hi anun nemin, Gim hesoh nikhon amite ahoidamin; Aheng jon chan avetup theiye.

tcz: Ama kidoupite vang chu Twisoh hattah letjeng junga hunglong chu atolmang sah hel ding, Amelmate jong chu muthim khojing lah’a adel lut ding ahi.
en_web: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
en_kjv: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, And darkness shall pursue his enemies.
tcz_gospelgo: Amelmate chu twisoh laiyin atolmang abhsah-in, Ama doute chuathagam jin ahi.

tcz: Ipi dinga Pakai dounaa thilgon naneiju ham? Pakaiyin achaina hel’a asuh manghel ding; akisatpite chunga chu nivei phulah khel-a khatveija asuhgam hel ding ahi.
en_web: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
en_kjv: What do ye imagine against the Lord? He will make an utter end: Affliction shall not rise up the second time.
tcz_gospelgo: Ibol’a Pakai douna nagonu ham? Aman nasuhmanglo diu ahi. Adou chan chu khatvei she a asuhgam ding ahi.

tcz: Ama kisatpite chu lingleh khao kihel chom tobanga, mangthah bep diu, chule changpol gosa banga mangthah ahitauve.
en_web: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
en_kjv: For while they be folden together as thorns, And while they be drunken as drunkards, They shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
tcz_gospelgo: Lingnang kihel lhop le changpol gosa banga Meiya nahalvam diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai douna dinga tohgon neija, hangsan tah’a thuseija pang, nangmaa kon mihem khatbe hung louham?
en_web: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
en_kjv: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, A wicked counseller.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Nineveh, nakhosunga hi thilse jeng bol mi, Pakai dou khat hun gpeng doh ding ahi.

tcz: Pakai Pathen in hiti hin aseije: “Amaho hi thahat’u hen lang mi tamu jongleh abonchauva kisatgam’uva kitolmang del diu ahi. Nangma vang bol gentheijin ana um jongleh chun, tun nabol genthei kit tapong’e.
en_web: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, Yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite Israel jeh a asei chu hiche hi ahi: “Assyria mite hi hat hen lang tam jong leu, kisugam a amngthah diu ahi. Vo kamite, hesoh genthei kathohsah nahiuvin, avel’in bol kit taponge.

tcz: Chule tua ama namkol jon napoh chu kaloilhah peh ding, Chule na kikanna thihkhao jouse jong ka botan peh soh hel ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”
en_kjv: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, And will burst thy bonds in sunder.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunguva Assyria mite tha neina su lhang ting, nakan nau thih khao kabotan ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chule nangma Assyria te chung chang thudol’a Pakaiyin thu apen, namin pu ding cha le nao hung peng kitlou ding ahitai; ajeh chu Pathen lim nasemthu nahou naa kona milim kilhajol hole kikhengjol ho aboncha ka paimanga, chule nangma kivuina ding lhankhuh, jachatna tampi kasempeh ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”
en_kjv: And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, That no more of thy name be sown: Out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
tcz_gospelgo: Assyria mite gahna Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi: “Amin pu siu son le pah anei lou diu ahi. Adoi hounau houin dunga milimdoi ho kasuhmang ding ahi. Hing dia kilom ahitapouvin, Assyria mie din lhan kalaipeh tai,” ati.

tcz: Nagal mipan suhmang ding ngaiton ahung in, kihongphan Pasal pha pha kulpia pansah-in lang lampi vephan; chule nakong kigah in lang, nathahat pan in pang in.
en_web: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!
en_kjv: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: Keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Nineveh, min nahindel khumtai! Nasucheh ding thaneipa ahungtai! Kulpi geiya mi pansah-in, Lamlen dung nga sah-in! Galte to kisat din kigon!

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israel lal loupina banga Jacob lal loupina jong asemphat kit ding ahi; chule michomgam’a pang hon achom ngimsel’uva ahalsi sia asuh manguva amonsa alupsah-u ahitai.
en_web: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.
en_kjv: For the Lord hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, As the excellency of Israel: For the emptiers have emptied them out, And marred their vine branches.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte hi min achomgam, masang laiya aloupina tobanga semphat kit din Pakaiyin agotai.

tcz: Chule asepai gal-hat ho chu alumu asan soh keijin, A sepaiten abonchauvin pon san-ao akisil sohkeijun. Kangtalai jouse jong meisi bang in apah lah lah-in, Galsat dia akigoltoh tenguleh akipat kal’u angah lel’ui.
en_web: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
en_kjv: The shield of his mighty men is made red, The valiant men are in scarlet: The chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, And the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
tcz_gospelgo: Melma sepaiten lumsan achoiyun, Avon jouseu jong asan jeng ahi. Hindel khum jeng din ago’uvin. Asakol kangtalaiyu Meisi pah lah lah abangin, Asakolteu kengto jaten ten ahiuve!

tcz: Chule kholai dunga kangtalai jouse aki hon lul lul’un, Veng ningkoi dung jousea asuh lhai atou lhaijun, Chule meikong kidevah bangin achanthe thu’uvin, chujongleh kolphe vah bangin aphelap lap’uve.
en_web: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
en_kjv: The chariots shall rage in the streets, They shall justle one against another in the broad ways: They shall seem like torches, They shall run like the lightnings.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholai dunga kangtalai eijon junin alhaiyun, Kholai sunga adung avaiyin akitol’uve. Meikap bangin avahjep jep’in, Kholphe bangin akikhojen jun’e!

tcz: Chuleh vaibol’a pang ho akoukhom’uvin, ache nauva akipal lhugam tauve; chule amahon pal phungla adel loijun, asangkhol chol’u akihoh doh bangin akijal dep dop e.
en_web: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
en_kjv: He shall recount his worthies: They shall stumble in their walk; They shall make haste to the wall thereof, And the defence shall be prepared.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaihomte akoukhom’un, Malam noa kijotna kisep lhun alhuh lhuh-in alum’ui. Ahindelkhumten pal lam ajon’un, Lumho leiyin ado’uvin ahi.

tcz: Chujongleh vadung kelkot phung jouse akihong soh tan, Leng inpia mite a lungthoi soh tauve.
en_web: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
en_kjv: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, And the palace shall be dissolved.
tcz_gospelgo: Luipanga kelkot phung ho atumjal’un, Leng inpi sung tijat lungdon aumtai.

tcz: Lengnu avon asut lhauvin akai mang tauve, chuleh ajenle a pang nu-ngah ho akap kap’uvin, vahuite ham athouvin amao setsot’un, a-op achum achum jeng uvin ahi.
en_web: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
en_kjv: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, And her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, Tabring upon their breasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengnu soh-in akai tauvin, Alhachate vahui maovin amaovui. Chule dip le lai kidop’in aumtauve.

tcz: Chuleh Nineveh khopi hi twikul lentah hija asunga twi jouse long kanghel tobang ahitai. “Kho ngaijin!Kho ngaijin!” tin mihonpi chun asam asam jeng uvin, koima chala akinung hei tapoi.
en_web: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.
en_kjv: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: Yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
tcz_gospelgo: Twito kiting phujal abngin, Nineveh khopia konin ajam cheh tauve! “Kho ngaiyun! Kho ngaiyun!” tin akisam nan, Akinungheiya koimacha aumpoi.

tcz: Chule dangka kichom uvin lang Sana jong kichom’uvin! thil kikhol ho hi chom joutih aum tapon, chule gou hijat thil manlu ho jong hi abei thei tapoi.
en_web: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
en_kjv: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: For there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
tcz_gospelgo: Dangka sana kichoi’uvin! Khopi sunga gou dimset’in akikhol’e.

tcz: Hijeh chun chom uvin langchom ngimhel’un ahomsan koijun! Mihem lungthim alha lhopsoh tan, mihem khupbuh jouse akithing sohhel tai, mihem jouse akong akhasoh-in, mihem jouse maiadup soh hel tai!
en_web: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
en_kjv: She is empty, and void, and waste: And the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, And much pain is in all loins, And the faces of them all gather blackness.
tcz_gospelgo: Nineveh khopi asumangun, min adalhan, akeovin akijamtai! Mihem lung kichat’in anemsoh tan; Thabeiyin khupbuh kithing thingin, Mihem mai adangsoh tai!

tcz: Chule sakei bahkai ho kihenna hong chu hoilai hiya? chule sakei bahkai noute kihenna chu akosung chu hoilai ham? Sakei bahkai ten aneh diu sa akipohlut uva, asukin ding beihel’a anoute toh aneh nau chu hoilai ham?
en_web: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
en_kjv: Where is the dwelling of the lions, And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion, even the old lion, walked, And the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?
tcz_gospelgo: Sakei kokhuh tobang khopi hoiba hitam! Sakei noute tobang ho kivahna, Sakei challe pi kijot le na, Anoute mong tah a umtheina khopi chu!

tcz: Sakei bahkaipin anoute neh kham dingbep akitha jouvin, sakei bahkai pan jong api dingin sahing phabep akoije; Akosung jong chu sahing athasa adim set’in, chule ahong sung sahin botelsa adimset’e.
en_web: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
en_kjv: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, And strangled for his lionesses, And filled his holes with prey, And his dens with ravin.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakeichal’in sa athat jin, Sakeipi le anoute ahal hal’in aoppeh-in, akosung chu athasa Agu aphe adimset’in ahi.

tcz: Hichun thaneipen Pakai chun aseijin, vetan keima nang dou din kapang’e, chuleh na kangtalai jouse kahal vama, ameikhu ki tung let lut ding; chujong leh na sakei bahkai noute jong chemjama katha ding ahi; chule leiset chunga kona na kivah na ding sahing jouse katol mangsoh ding, nasot tol le a pang miho thusei awgin kijapha lou helding ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
en_kjv: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts, And I will burn her chariots in the smoke, And the sword shall devour thy young lions: And I will cut off thy prey from the earth, And the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Nakidoupi Kei kahi. Nakhangtalai jouse hall hang ting, naseipaite min galmun a athagam diu, midang nalahpeh thil aboncha kalahpeh ding nahi. Vannoiya nahusa hin hin kijadoh ki tlouhel ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: O he ada nahi, thisan dimset khopi, Jou le nal dimset’a mithil kichom jeng dimset, min nachom ngahtih neilouva , angahna beija na um ding ahi tai!
en_web: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.
en_kjv: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery; The prey departeth not;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo thisan sohat khopi nada ahi! Nanei nagou mi kichomgam ding bep ahitai!

tcz: Sakol kijep gin , kangtalai kitol gin, sakol kinunkho gin leh kangtalai kipei gin pikhu!
en_web: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
en_kjv: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, And of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaiyun, sakol kijep gin, Kangtalai kitah gin, Sakolte lhai gin le kangtalai kipei gin pi khu!

tcz: Chuleh sakol touthem hon adelkhum khum uvin, Chemjam kol aval lah lah jeng in Tengkol jong apah lah lah jeng’e; Sepaite akithatsa ho thilong alhuh lhuh-in akisen, mihem long simjou louvin alum in achung’a miho akipal lhu lhu jeng’ui!
en_web: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies
en_kjv: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: And there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; And there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
tcz_gospelgo: Sakol tou themten adel chum’un, Chemkol aval lah lah-in tengkol aphelap lap’in, thilong akisevum the thu jengin, Mithi long simsen ahitapoi. Thilong chunga mi akipal thu thu jenguve.

tcz: Thilsoh hijat pi hi sujohnu sujoh’a apan jeh’a soh ahin, Lungset set’a umdoh a thina thei theija kiheidoh ahitai; chule sujoh a pang chun sujoh’a apanna jeh a namtin vaipi geija apui chatvaija deichat chat’a aksemna jeh a chu mitin vaipi geija apui chatvai soh ahitai.
en_web: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
en_kjv: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, The mistress of witchcrafts, That selleth nations through her whoredoms, And families through her witchcrafts.
tcz_gospelgo: Noti tobang Nineveh khopin talen amantai! Manthahna lam a mijol heo hou nu!

tcz: Hichun thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, Keiman nang kadou nahi; na nihchol chen jong chu na maichang geija ka hodoh peh ding nahi; chuteng leh namtin vaipi hi na sagoh keova pi chu ka vetsah a Lenggam jouse hin na jamopi chu amusoh kei diu ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
en_kjv: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; And I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, And I will shew the nations thy nakedness, And the kingdoms thy shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Nineveh khopi, talen kamatsah ding nahi! Nakeovin jam ing ting namtin vaipi kavetsah ding, Najamo jouse amudoh diu ahi!

tcz: Keiman nang hi bonlhoh kase khum ding, muset set dia kabol’a, vet vet dia ka um sah ding nahi.
en_web: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
en_kjv: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, And will set thee as a gazing-stock.
tcz_gospelgo: Noise se le kidah dah a kabol’a Thilboh jouse kanot khum ding nahi. Namupha cham mihem chu Tija kinlih leu leu diu ahi.

tcz: Koi koi hijongleh namu pha jouse chu kin leu diu, Nineveh khopi hi akeohel’a kijam ahitai, kon aka ka ding hitam? a lhembi ding leh alungmon ding koi kiholpeh ding hitam? tia asei dingu ahi.
en_web: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? Whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
tcz_gospelgo: namudoh chan nungjam a, Nineveh khopi khogem asoh tai! Voujang natpia koi ham? Alhem lung mong nom koi ham?’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nile vadung panga chenga akimvela twipi veikol soh hel, twikhanglen pal banga neija twipi banga nei No-amon mite sanga phajo nahim?
en_web: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
en_kjv: Art thou better than populous No, That was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, Whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Nineveh, Egypt khopi Thebes sanga naphatjoh beh am? Thebes chu Nile luidung alongin, pal’in akikhang’e.

tcz: Ethopia chu aki hatsah na anahin, angahna bei Egypt jong akihatsahna ahi; Put khopi le Libya mite jong akithopia ana pangji ahiuve.
en_web: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.
en_kjv: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
tcz_gospelgo: Sudan le Egypt chunga vai apon, athahat akhonbei ahi; Libya jong akigolpi.

tcz: Hijongleh min apoh mang ahitan, sohchang dia che ahitai; achasen jouse akichilgoi sohtan, thingphung jouse jong akivogoi soh tauve; chule akhopi sunga migun ja um tahtah ho jong min vang asan’uvin akihom tauve; chujong leh akhopi sunga mi thahat lai jouse jong thih khaovin akihen sohtai.
en_web: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
en_kjv: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: And they cast lots for her honourable men, And all her great men were bound in chains.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Thebes kho mite jong sohchangin min akaitauve. Kholai lamkon tin a achateu minavo lih lih jengin ahi. Alamakiteu thihkhaovin akaiyun, sohchangte lah a ahomthanguve.

tcz: Nang jong ju nakham ding, namit kisucho ding, melma akona hoidoh na dia nang in kisel na ding na hol ding ahi.
en_web: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
en_kjv: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, Thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Nineveh, nang jong ju khamin ngol’in natin, melmatea konin jamdoh gon nate.

tcz: Nakulpi jouse jong theichang phung bep ahin, theichang ga masa tobanga akiho lhah leh anenompa kamsung'a lenglut jeng ahi.
en_web: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
en_kjv: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: If they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
tcz_gospelgo: nakulpi chengse jong theichang ga minsa tobang ahin, theichang phung chu loh le chun aga nakamsunga lenglut jel ding ahi! Namaha a nu didng damdoi aumpon, namaha damtheiponte. Namanthah thusim japha chan kipah-in khut abeng beng jengui. Tang louhel’a thilse nabolnaa hoidoh jou koi ham?

tcz: Vetan, na sepaija pang ho jong na cho lai sunga numei jeng ahitai. Chule naki doupite din nagam sung a kelkot jouse lentah tah-in akihong doh sohtai; na kelkot gol jouse jong hi meiyin akahvam soh hel ahitai.
en_web: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.
en_kjv: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: The gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: The fire shall devour thy bars.
tcz_gospelgo: nasepaite jong asildap soh tan, namelmate masanga pang jou ding abeitai. Nakelkot gol jouse meiyin akahvam ding ahi.

tcz: Kho ki-umna dingin twi gathal loijin, na kulpi jouse kikaidet loijin; bonlhoh lah a lenglut jeng in chule changpol chilgoijin, cheh deng loijin;
en_web: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
en_kjv: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: Go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
tcz_gospelgo: Min naumchah teng don ding twi kikhol’in, nakulpi chengse kaiphan! Leingan ho chu cheh a den din chilgoi loiyin, cheh denna ding gonsan koiyin.

tcz: Meiyin namoh kahvam theijin tin, chemjam in na vautan thei ding ahi; khaokhote kithat gam banga natha doh jeng thei ahi. chule nang ho le nangho khaokhote jat in kisim uvin lang khaokho te bang in kipunsah jeng uvin!
en_web: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.
en_kjv: There shall the fire devour thee; The sword shall cut thee off, It shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: Make thyself many as the cankerworm, Make thyself many as the locusts.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla ipi bol’in tong jongle chun meiyin halvaminnatin, ahiloule galmun a min that teiyin nate. Khaokhote banginnapunge!

tcz: Na mite kivei ho chu punsah jing in, vana ahsite sangin tamsah loijin; khaokhoten alha ajah jiuvin aleng mangloi jitauve.
en_web: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
en_kjv: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: The cankerworm spoileth, and flieth away.
tcz_gospelgo: Van a ahsite sanga tamjo kivei mi nasepdoh tai! Tunla khaokhoten lhaving jah a alen mang hel bangin, abeisoh tauve.

tcz: Chule namilen na milalte jong khaosut te beh ahiuven, nadanthu lekha them ho jong hi meibol kai nikhoa pal dunga khaokhote jinglei loiya toubep ahiuve.
en_web: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
en_kjv: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, Which camp in the hedges in the cold day, But when the sun ariseth they flee away, And their place is not known where they are.
tcz_gospelgo: Navaibolte jog khodap nikhoa bang dunga kibemchal chul khaokhote ahiuvin, nisa sat ten glen gmang jel’a, hoilam agei koiman ahet lou tobang bep ahiuve!

tcz: Vo Assyria lengpa na kelngoi ching ho a ihmu soh tauve; na milen na milalte jong akitalsoh tauvin ahi. chule namite jong molsang chung dung jousea akithe thangsoh’uvin, akou khom ding koimacha aumtapoi.
en_web: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
en_kjv: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: Thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Assyria kumpipa, nagam vaipote athisoh tai, namilen milalte jong akijamddap soh tauve. Namite molle lhanga akithe thangsoh-un, in a puilut jou koima aumtapoi.

tcz: Chule namaha nasil ngim peh ding koima aumpon, natina maha lah amelse behseh jengin ahi; ahinla nachung chang thudol japha chan akipah’uvin akhut abeng beng jeng uvin ahi. Ajeh chu tang louhela thilse nabol, koipen chunga hung lhung khalouva um kha em?
en_web: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?
en_kjv: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: All that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: For upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

tcz: Hiche hi Habakkuk themgaovin thilmu aneina thudol ahi.
en_web: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
en_kjv: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

tcz: Vo PAKAI, itihchan geija panpi ngaichaa kakou kou di hitam? Hinla nangin nei ngaipeh poi! “Muntina nosopma kibolna aum tai!” Ka kap in, hinla eipanhu dingin na hungpoi.
en_web: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
en_kjv: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear? Even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save?

tcz: Hiche gitlou kibol hohi kavet vet jing ding hitam? Hiche gim gentheina ho jouse hi ibol’a kavet vet jeng ding ham? Keiman kavet chanin mahthahna le nosopma kibolna hobou ka mudoh’e. Mi nelkal hat ho leh kinahpia hat mihonpi chun eihin umkimvel tauve.
en_web: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
en_kjv: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? For spoiling and violence are before me: And there are that raise up strife and contention.

tcz: Dan hi donlou tobangbep chu ahitai, chule thutanna munho’a jong thudih umtalou ahi. Migilou ho chun midih ho sanga gamchenga atamjoh jeh-uvin, thudih chu heikoija um bepma ahitai.
en_web: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
en_kjv: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: For the wicked doth compass about the righteous; Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

tcz: Pakai chun adonbut in, “Chitin namtin ho khu gahven chuleh kidangsa temin! Ajeh chu keiman nangma nikho laiya hi thilkhat kahin boldoh ding, mi koiham khattouvin seijongleh na tahsan louhel ding chu kahinbol ding ahije.
en_web: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
en_kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: For I will work a work in your days, Which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

tcz: Keiman Babylon mite ho, giloutah le nosopma mibol ho chu ka hin tundoh ding ahi. Amahon vannoi muntin apaltan’uva kijotle ding’u chule gam dang tampi ahinjo dingu ahi.
en_web: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
en_kjv: For lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, Which shall march through the breadth of the land, To possess the dwelling places that are not theirs.

tcz: Amaho hi gitlou abol nauva engsetah’a chonna ahiuvin, chutia abolnom chengseu chu abol’u ahi.
en_web: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
en_kjv: They are terrible and dreadful: Their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

tcz: Sakol aneihou jong lutnu sangin alhai hatjouvin, khomu chipchep a ngeihon lhakhom sangin jong ahoise jouve. Sakol kangtalaija touho chun gamlataha konin a sakol ho’u chu ahin thunun jeng uvin; Muvanlai lengle hon a anchah’u abokhumuva avallhum jiu kisei tobang ahiuve.
en_web: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
en_kjv: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, And are more fierce than the evening wolves: And their horsemen shall spread themselves, And their horsemen shall come from far; They shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

tcz: Oh, ahung tauve, abonchauvin nosopma boldin akunsuh tauve. A gancha hon hou jong chu nelphaija hui bangin ahung kitol’un, amasanguva asohchang ho’u ahin masot hou chu neldi tamin atam jeng uvin ahi .
en_web: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.
en_kjv: They shall come all for violence: Their faces shall sup up as the east wind, And they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

tcz: Amahon leng ho le leng chapate ho chu isahlou tah'in abolun, chule akulpi ho jouse chu isah loutahin aboluve.
en_web: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.
en_kjv: And they shall scoff at the kings, And the princes shall be a scorn unto them: They shall deride every strong hold; For they shall heap dust, and take it.

tcz: Amaho chu hui nung bangin akitolun chule achemang tauve. Hinla amaho sungil’a themona nei ahiuve, athahat uchu pathena nei ahiuve.”
en_web: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
en_kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, Imputing this his power unto his god.

tcz: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, nangma tonsotna um, ka Mithengpa Nangman nei theh manghel jeng hih nauvin nate na? Vo Pakai, ka Songpiu, nangman hiche Babylon mite hi eisudih dinguleh ka chonsetna ho’u atam jeh'a ei-gimbol dinguva na hinsol ahi.
en_web: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
en_kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; And, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

tcz: Nangma hila athenga nahin chule agilou chu n maikoh a umtheilou ahi. Chuti ahileh amaho do’ha joulhepna namitsat ding hijaham? Mi engsete chun asanguva chonphajo avallhumu jongleh thipbeh a naum ding hitam?
en_web: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
en_kjv: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, And canst not look on iniquity: Wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, And holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

tcz: Keiho hi ahinga kimandoh dinga le akithat dinga kiman ho tobangbep kahiuvem? Kei ho hi twikhanglen na um ganhing ho lamkai bei tobangbep ka hiuvem?
en_web: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
en_kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, As the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

tcz: Amaho kipanaa le golnop bolna dinguva, ngakoija eiki khaidoh dinga chuleh lensunga ohden bep ding bou kahi dingu hitam?
en_web: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
en_kjv: They take up all of them with the angle, They catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: Therefore they rejoice and are glad.

tcz: Chuteng leh amahon lenthang anei hou chu Pathen tobang'in houvun tin, chuleh amasanguva chun gimnamtwi halna nei uvinte. Amaho chun, “Hiche lenthang pathen hohin keiho eihaodoh sah’u ahi” ati ding’u ahi.
en_web: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
en_kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; Because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

tcz: Nangman ama ho hi hiti dinmuna hi nasolmangpai pai ding ham? Amaho hi phottohna beihella agaljouva hi i-tiha maipah jing dingu hitam?
en_web: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
en_kjv: Shall they therefore empty their net, And not spare continually to slay the nations?

tcz: Kagalvenna muna chun kaldoh ingting chuleh ka pansatna muna chun ding ing’e. Chu che muna kona chu Pakaiyin kajaha ipi aseiding ve’ing ting chuleh keima kiphinna iti eidonbut nem ti ngah-inge.
en_web: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
en_kjv: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, And will watch to see what he will say unto me, And what I shall answer when I am reproved.

tcz: Chutah in Pakaiyin kajah a, “Ka donbutna hi songpheng ho chunga jihdoh in, hiti henlang hileh, alhaile pa chun midang ho koma thu phatea agalhut thei ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
en_kjv: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, That he may run that readeth it.

tcz: Hiche ahung lhung ding kimu hi khonung’a ding ahi. Hiche hin achaina ding ahilchenin, chule hiche hin gu ilhungtei ding ahi. Ahung vaigeija ahijong leh, ngah hat in, ajeh chu kho ngaisot lou ding, hung lhung tei ding ahi.
en_web: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
en_kjv: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, But at the end it shall speak, and not lie: Though it tarry, wait for it; Because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

tcz: Mi kilesah chu vetem in! Amaho tah akisong uvin, chuleh ahinkho mandan’u chu akon chetchut nin ahi. Hinlah midih chu Pathena dinga tahsan aum nauva hing ding ahiuve.
en_web: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
en_kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: But the just shall live by his faith.

tcz: Nei le nga hao mana lungngahna thei ahidehpoi, chuleh mihoitho hon kicholdona anei hih uve. Amahon lhan tobang'in akamu chu ahonglenun, chuleh thina kisei tobang'in aphatai atipouve. Akiloset manuvin amahon namtina mi akhom khomuvin, chuleh mitampi chu aval lhum tauve.
en_web: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.
en_kjv: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, Who enlargeth his desire as hell, And is as death, and cannot be satisfied, But gathereth unto him all nations, And heapeth unto him all people:

tcz: Hinla asoh chan loi jengu hin amaho ajumso ding’u ahi. Amaho chun dai thanopna anei uva, Migucha nangho itobang lunghemna in nahinphah diu hitam? Tua hi nachan ding dol’u na kimu ding’u ahi! Alamlouva na hung hao dohu ahin, hinlah itih chanpi hi hitia na masot nahlai dingu ham?
en_web: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
en_kjv: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, And a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? And to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

tcz: Phulou helouva na leibatna houvin nachunguva thutanna nanei khum ding’u ahi. Na chunguva hungkiheijuva kicha le tija'a nadinpet’uva nanei jouseu nalahpeh dingu ahi.
en_web: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
en_kjv: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, And awake that shall vex thee, And thou shalt be for booties unto them?

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon namtin vaipi nei jouse nachom jeng’u ahin, tua hi ason achilhah ho jouseu chun nangho nei achom dingu ahi. Nanghon thinglhang gam pumpia tolthana naboluvin chuleh khopi ho chu alamlouva gimbolna in na lodimsah tauve.
en_web: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
en_kjv: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, All the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; Because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, Of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

tcz: Alamlouva phatchomna naholnauva konna in lentah tah nasahu hin itobang lunggim nan nahin lhunkhum ding’u hitam! Nagou haonauvin huhbit nachoh pehthei dingin na tahsan’un, hahsatna in aphah joulouna ding muna na insung mi busatsah a nahiuve.
en_web: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
en_kjv: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, That he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

tcz: Hinlah tolthana nabol jeh a hi, namin na jachat sah a chuleh nahinkhou nachan lo-u ahitai.
en_web: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
en_kjv: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house By cutting off many people, And hast sinned against thy soul.

tcz: Banga song hohin nangho douna a kholhang ahinsap doh ding, chule inchunga inkam kilhunna inching noilama kidap hon jong noplouna ahin phondoh ding ahi.
en_web: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
en_kjv: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, And the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

tcz: Tolthana le a lamlouva sumtong mu’a konna khopi sadoh ho itobang lunghem nan na hinphah diu hitam!
en_web: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
en_kjv: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, And stablisheth a city by iniquity!

tcz: Van Sepai ho Pakai chun namtin vaipi ahaonau hi vutvai kisopeh ding ahi tia ana thutepsa hilou ham? Na tampi atohdohu jong aboncha pannabei ahi.
en_web: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
en_kjv: Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts That the people shall labour in the very fire, And the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

tcz: Tihon twikhanglen in achup bangin, leiset hi Pakai loupina hetna in alodim ding ahi.
en_web: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
en_kjv: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, As the waters cover the sea.

tcz: Naheng nakom kham ngolsah a nangma itobang lungkhamnan nahinphah ding hitam! Nakhon chu achunguva na ngamin, amaho chu adasa sauvin a jachatpiu sagohkeu ahinau chu deitah a navet theina dingin nabollin ahi.
en_web: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
en_kjv: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, That puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, That thou mayest look on their nakedness!

tcz: Hinla kintaha na chunga minset sahna hung lhung ding ahi. Hungin, donin chuleh muthei din kilangdohin. Pakai thutanna khon’a kon chun hung donin, chule na loupinau jouse chu jachatna hin sodoh hen.
en_web: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
en_kjv: Thou art filled with shame for glory: Drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: The cup of the Lord’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, And shameful spuing shall be on thy glory.

tcz: Nanghon Lebanon gammang ho chu na satchaijui. Tua hi nangho kisatlha ding nahiuve. Nanghon gamsa ho chu na sumang hel’ui, hijeha hi amaho kicha a na um’u ahitai. Agamsung pumpia toltha naboluvin, chule khopi ho jong chu nosopa kibolna nadip dimu ahitai.
en_web: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
en_kjv: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, And the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, Because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, Of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

tcz: Mihem khutnin asem milim chu ipi phatchomna uma ahilouleh nalhemlhauva pang milim kilhajol chu phamonga hinam? Nakhut tahun asem thil tahsan chu ipi phatchomna ham, pathen kihoulimpi thei hilou chu!
en_web: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
en_kjv: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; The molten image, and a teacher of lies, That the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

tcz: Thinga kona kisem milimho jaha, “Khangin lang chule nei huhdoh un” tiho chunga itobang lunghemna in nanga’u hitam! Thusei theilou song milim kisem ho jah a, “Thoudoh un chuleh neihilun” natiuve. Milim khat nin ipi bol ding nahil theijum? Sana le dangka a kisem himaithei junte, hinla amahon asunguva hinna anei pouve.
en_web: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
en_kjv: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, And there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai hi Ahou In Thenga aum’e. Leiset pumpi a angsunga thipchet hen”.
en_web: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
en_kjv: But the Lord is in his holy temple: Let all the earth keep silence before him.

tcz: Hiche taona hi themgao Habakkuk in lakaija ahin sahdoh ahi.
en_web: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
en_kjv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

tcz: Pakai, nangma chung chang thuhi abonna kana jahsa ahi. Na thilbolho hi kadatmo lheh jengin ahi. Achesa kum ho’a nana bolsa ahi bangin, ka ngaichat dehset petlaitahu hin nei panpi kituvin. Chuleh na lunghan laitah a jong mikhoto them nahina chu geldoh in.
en_web: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.
en_kjv: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make known; In wrath remember mercy.

tcz: Keiman Pathen chun Edom gal lama patna gamthip ahinjot galkai kamu’n, Paran molchunga kona Mitheng Pachu ahung kamui. Avah emsengsung chun vanthamjol alodimin, chuleh leiset chung hi avahchoinan alodim jengin ahi.
en_web: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
en_kjv: God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of his praise.

tcz: Ahungna chu nisa hung sohdoh bangin akilang jenge. Akhutna konin vah ahung kikhodohin, athaneina kiselna muna kona hungdoh a ahi.
en_web: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
en_kjv: And his brightness was as the light; He had horns coming out of his hand: And there was the hiding of his power.

tcz: Amasanga amangthah ding ho akijotnun, chule anunglama pulin ahinjuipaijin ahi.
en_web: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
en_kjv: Before him went the pestilence, And burning coals went forth at his feet.

tcz: Ama adinleh leiset akithingin, avetna ahileh namtin vaipi akihot jenguve. Tonsotna ana um mol ho chu athechehin, chuleh a i-tiha thinglhang anaum ho chu asuchamin ahi. Ama Tonsotna Umpa chu ahi.
en_web: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
en_kjv: He stood, and measured the earth: He beheld, and drove asunder the nations; And the everlasting mountains were scattered, The perpetual hills did bow: His ways are everlasting.

tcz: Keiman Kushan miho chu lunglhatah a a’umu kamun, chule Median namte jong chu kicha a tijatah a a’umu kamui.
en_web: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
en_kjv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: And the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

tcz: Pakai, nangman lung hanga twi chu najepma, twipi chu kikhena hija ham? Amaho chunga lunghimoa nahim? Ahipoi, nangin huhhingna sakol kangtalai chu nahin sol ahijo me!
en_web: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
en_kjv: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers? Was thy wrath against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?

tcz: Nang in nathal le na thalchang koina na livathei chu napeije. Nangman leiset hi vadung twi ho lonna dingin na hongdohin ahi.
en_web: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
en_kjv: Thy bow was made quite naked, According to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

tcz: Mol ho akivetle akithingin, twi kinong chun amasanglama ahin nuhin ahi. Twi thuh tah chun ahin samdohin, akhut chun Pakai lam ahin sang’e.
en_web: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
en_kjv: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: The overflowing of the water passed by: The deep uttered his voice, And lift up his hands on high.

tcz: Nisa le lha chu nathalchang ho jangkeija alenna chule natengcha vallihleh chu akipeipet in vanlaijolla ading dentai.
en_web: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
en_kjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: At the light of thine arrows they went, And at the shining of thy glittering spear.

tcz: Nangman gamsung chu lunghangin napaltanin, chule chitin namtin chu lunghangin nachotpha tai.
en_web: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.
en_kjv: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, Thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

tcz: Na lhenchomte huhdoh dingin, nathaonute huhdohna dingin nakipat dohtai. Nangin migilou luchang chu na noigepin chule alua pat akengtou geijin najep pehtai.
en_web: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.
en_kjv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, Even for salvation with thine anointed; Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, By discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

tcz: Huipi hungnung banga hung kitola, beilamtaha Israel bahgam dinga go chu, nangin ama galvon maman nasumang’e.
en_web: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
en_kjv: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

tcz: Nangman twipi chu nasakolla na paljengin, chule twi thahattah chu sangtahin kiting denin na umsah jeng’e.
en_web: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
en_kjv: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, Through the heap of great waters.

tcz: Hiche thu kajah in kasungil akithing jengin, ka muh jong kichatnan aphusepsupmin, kakengteni jong akihot hotnin, chule kichat tijatnan kakithing jenge. Keiman ka chunguva gal hungbol mipi ho chu vangsetna nasatahin ahinphah dingu nikho chu thipkhencha kanga ahitai.
en_web: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
en_kjv: When I heard, my belly trembled; My lips quivered at the voice: Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, That I might rest in the day of trouble: When he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

tcz: Theichang phungho jong chu pahdoh hih uhenlang, lengpi guija lengpiga ho umhih hen; Olive phunga thao putdoh tahih jong leh, chuleh loujao hoa ima pou hih henlang chuleh ga sodoh tahih jong uleh; chuleh loujao hoa gancha ho thi’u henlang, ganhing ho jeng jong chu agoh in umu henlang hita jong leh;
en_web: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,
en_kjv: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labour of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no meat; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:

tcz: Keima Pakai a kipah nalai ding kahi! Ei huhhingpa Pathenna chu kipahna lai ding kahi!
en_web: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
en_kjv: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

tcz: Leng vaipo thaneipen Pakai chu ka thahatna ahi! Sa san bangin keng thaneina pen tin, munsang lai laiya jong eichopsah ding ahi. (Zai pipu chun: Hiche taona hi semjang khao tampi tothoa atumginga alamkai ding ahi.)
en_web: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
en_kjv: The Lord God is my strength, And he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, And he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

tcz: Amon chapa Josiah in Judah gam’a lengvai apohlaijin, Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Zephaniah kitipa heng’a ahin sei tai. Zephaniah chu Cushi chapa, Cushi chu Gedaliah chapa, Gedaliah chu Amariah chapa, Amariah chu Hezekiah chapa ahi.
en_web: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
en_kjv: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gama Amon chapa Josiah lengpa khanga Pakaiyin Zephaniah henga asei thu hiche hi ahi. (Zephaniah hi Hezekiah lengpa son ahin, Hezekiah cha Amariah ahin, Amariah cha Gedariah, Gedaliah cha Cushi, chule Cushi cha chu Zephaniah ahi.)

tcz: “Keiman leiset chung’a thil ijakai katheh ngimhel ding ahi”, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
en_kjv: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Keiman leiset thil jouse kasuhmang ding ahi.
