tcz: “Keiman mihem leh gancha katheh ngim ding, chung’a leng vacha ho katheh ngim ding, Twikhanglen’a nga ho jong katheh ngim ding ahi. Migilou jouse abong abaija kalha-a, kaset tup ding, leiset chung’a mihimte kasuhgam ding ahi”, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
en_kjv: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, And the stumblingblocks with the wicked; And I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem jouse, ganhing jouse, vachate le nga namkim, migiloute manthahna didng kabol ding ahi. Mihem namkim kasuhgam a, hinghoi kanei lou didng ahi. Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.

tcz: “Keiman kakhut tah’a Judah gam le Jerusalem kasugep ding, chuleh Ba’al doi hou ho jouse, anunung pen geija ka suhgam ding ahi. Keiman milim doi houna thempu ho jouse jong, koiman ageldohkit tahlou ding’a, ka suhmang ding ahi.”
en_web: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
en_kjv: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, And upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; And I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, And the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
tcz_gospelgo: “Jerusalem khosung mite le Juhdah gamsung mite abonchauva kasuhgam ding ahi. Baal doi houna halsi sia kasuhmanga, koiman Baal kinbol Thempuho jong ageldoh louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon, inting vum’a nisa, lhathah chuleh ahsi ho ahouvun, abohkhup jiuvin ahi. Amaho Pakai nung juiyin akiseijun, ahinlah amaho chu Molech Pathen hou joh ahiuve.
en_web: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,
en_kjv: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; And them that worship and that swear by the Lord, And that swear by Malcham;
tcz_gospelgo: Intingvuma kaldoh a nisa, lha chule ahsite chibai boh ho jong kasuhgam ding ahi. Kei eihouva, Kei dia tahpan dia kihalsel, chujou teng Milcom pathen mina kihahsel chan jong kasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Pakai nung ajui nauva kon’a nungjam kit ho, Pakai jong hol talouva chuleh dong talou ho chu, ka suhmang soh hel ding ahi.” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.
en_kjv: And them that are turned back from the Lord; And those that have not sought the Lord, nor inquired for him.
tcz_gospelgo: Nungjam a hung kile kit lou, kaheng hinjon lou, apui hoi diuva kahenga taolou jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakai angsung’a thipkhen in um'in, ajeh chu tijat umtah Pakai thutanna nikho chu anaitai. Pakaiyin amite asutu in, kilhaina gantha ding jong agong’e, chuleh aman amiho jong athensotai.
en_web: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
en_kjv: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: For the day of the Lord is at hand: For the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, He hath bid his guests.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Nikho anaitai, Pathenin thil bola got nikho chu; hijeh chun thip beh chan um’in. Pakaiyin amite hi kilhaina gamtha banga athagot ahi.

tcz: “Hiche thutanna nikho chuleh, keiman Judah pipuho leh leng chapate ho talen kamatsah ding, chuleh milim doihouna a chon ho jouse jong, abon’a talen kapeh ding ahi” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord’s sacrifice, That I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, And all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mi kathagam got nikho le vaipote le leng chapate chule namdangte chonchan jop jouse talen kamatsah ding ahi.

tcz: Henge, milim doihouna kin’a gapang tapou abon’a gotna kapeh ding, chuleh apupa insung dim’a um’a, pumhat leh duha-a thilbol ho jouse, abon’uva talen kamat sah ding ahi.
en_web: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
en_kjv: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, Which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
tcz_gospelgo: namdangte doi houva le adoi houvu in dimset dia miho that gama anei chasun chomgam ho chengse chu talen kamatsah soh ding ahi,” ati

tcz: “Hiche nikho niteng chuleh”, Pakai in aseiyin, “Nga kelkot a pat ka ogin kija ding chule khopi ningli jousea kithong soh ding ahi.”
en_web: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, That there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, And a howling from the second, And a great crashing from the hills.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche nikho le chun Jerusalem khopi nga-kelkot’a ka ogin kija ding ahi. Khopi sah thahna mun a jong ka le mao ogin kija a, thinglhanglama jong ogin husa nasa tah kija ding ahi.

tcz: Keithela touho lunghem in kap’un, ajeh chu kivei mi ho le sumkol vei mi ho kisumang ding ahi.
en_web: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
en_kjv: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, For all the merchant people are cut down; All they that bear silver are cut off.
tcz_gospelgo: Kivei mi ho thigam ahijeh-in, ka le mao ogin najah tengu, khoto lama change kap’uvin!

tcz: “Meisal kadet’a Jerusalem khopi thimlai jouse kakhol chil ding, chonset muthim noiya touva, Pakaiyin thilse hihen thilpha hileh boldeh ponte, tia sei ho gotna kapeh ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass at that time, That I will search Jerusalem with candles, And punish the men that are settled on their lees: That say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiteng chule thaomei devah a Jerusalem khosung kakhol ding, kisongtah a aning anop’a paova, ‘Itilam lam ahin Pakayin ipi abol ngaipoi,’ tia seiho chu talen kamasah soh ding ahi.

tcz: Anei agou jouseu kichomdoh jou keiding; A in jouseu ahom keuva kijam soh ding ahi. In thah sa jonguleh, chen thei dehlou diu; Lengpilei lhou jongleu, lengpitwi adonlou diu ahi.
en_web: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
en_kjv: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: They shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; And they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: A-in jouseu kisuchim a, anei chengseu kichomgam ding ahi. Asah sau in a cheng lou diu, abolsau lengpi leiya lengpitwi adon louhel diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: “Tijat umtah Pakai nikho chu ahung naiye. Genthei lilhon kana nikho, Pasal thahattah jeng jong kana nikho, Hunglhung vahding ahi.
en_web: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
en_kjv: The great day of the Lord is near, It is near, and hasteth greatly, Even the voice of the day of the Lord: The mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai nikho loupe tah chu anaitai-anai behseh jengtan, ahung kitol jel jul jengtai! Thohmo hel nikho, sepai hangpen jong lha lhop’a kap a pengjah ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho, Pakai lungsat kibuhlhah nikho chu – Genthei leh hesoh nasat nikho, Manthah leh ahomkeova um nikho, Muthim leh lunkham lungjin nikho, Muthim lhangkhal le meibol jin nikho,
en_web: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
en_kjv: That day is a day of wrath, A day of trouble and distress, A day of wasteness and desolation, A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chu lungsat nikho, gim gentheina, manthahna le mah thahna, muthim lung jinna, mitsin khojin,

tcz: Gal lhangsapna le sumkon kimut nikho, Khopi pal kinokhum leh gal nasataha kisatna nikho hiding ahi!
en_web: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.
en_kjv: A day of the trumpet and alarm Against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
tcz_gospelgo: galkon dia sumkon kimut ni, kulpi kaisa khopi ho le inchungsang ho delkhum dia gal-lhang kisap nikho hi didng ahi.

tcz: Pakai dounaa nachonset jeh uva, Mitcho banga kakimaile sah diu, Na thisan’u leivui laha kasunlhah ding, Chuleh natahsau tol'a among dinga kijam ding ahi.
en_web: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
en_kjv: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, Because they have sinned against the Lord: And their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
tcz_gospelgo: “Namtin mihem chunga hitobang manthahna kalhut khum ding jeh hin mitin mitcho banga kimail ele diu ahi. Kei dounan achonseuvin, tua hi athisanu teisih kisung lha bang ding, athilong, monsau tol’a kijam chap ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakai lungsat kibuhlhah nikho tengleh na sanauva jong na dangkauva jong na kihuhhing jou lou diu ahi. Pakai lungsat chun leiset jengjong avallhun jeng ding ahi. Aman leiset chung mi jouse asuhmanga asuhbeihel ding ahi.
en_web: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
en_kjv: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them In the day of the Lord’s wrath; But the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: For he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin lungsat amusah nikho le asana dangkauvin jong ahuhhing lou diu ahi. Vannoi pumpi hi alunghanna meiyin akahvam ding ahi. Leiset chung cheng jouse hetman louva haisama alha ding ahi.

tcz: Kikhou khom’un nabon’un, kikhomsoh keijun, nangho jum leh ja helou nam mite.
en_web: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
en_kjv: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo jumle ja helou nam mite! Hung kikhom loi tau,

tcz: Pakai thutanna nangchunguva alhum masangin, kikhom’un, Hui a changvai kisep mang banga na kisep mang kah in, kisih’un, Pakai lunghanna meikong banga aki buhlhah masang, chuleh Pakai lungset gimnei tah ahunglhun masangin, kisihun.
en_web: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.
en_kjv: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, Before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.
tcz_gospelgo: pahpul’a napul kah-u, pakai lunghan deoje jun naphah masangu, Pakaiyin lunghan aphondoh masang hin!

tcz: Gamsunga mi noinungten Pakai jeng hol’un, chuleh athupeh nit’un. Adih jeng’a thil bolding gouvin, chuleh nunem tahin hinkho mangun. Chutileh Pakaiyin, alunghan nikho’a na seldoh’uva chuleh sumang louva na huhdoh theiju ahi.
en_web: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.
en_kjv: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, Which have wrought his judgment; Seek righteousness, seek meekness: It may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thupeh nit jing, gamsung mi nun nemte, Pakaiya hung kiheilut loiyuvin. Thildih bol’un, pakai angsunga kineosah-uvin, chutile ijem tia Pakai lunghan nikho teng talen man louva nahoidoh theiyu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Gaza leh Ashkelon khopi jong ahomkeuva kidalha ding, chule Ashdod leh Ekron khopi jong kisuchim’a kidel jamdiu ahi.
en_web: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.
en_kjv: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: They shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaza kho sung a koima kikhen lou didng ahi. Ashkelon kho min dalha soh- intin, Ashdod kho mite nilanga kiseljamsoh ding ahiuvin, Ekron khosung mite khosunga kona kinodoh ding ahiuve.

tcz: Ada nahiuve! Nangho twikhanglen panga cheng Philistine mite, chuleh Canan gamsunga cheng ho jouse jong, hiche thutanna hi nangho chunga chuding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin nangho nabeikei kah’uva na suhgam dingu ahi.
en_web: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.
en_kjv: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Twikhanglen pamchin dunga cheng Philistinete ada nahiuve. Pakaiyin nachung thuu atantai. Khat beh jong khen neilouva nasuhgam hel diu ahi.

tcz: Philistine gam, twikhanglen pang ho, hamhing gamlah naso ding, chuleh kelngoi chingho pansatna leh ganchate kikholkhomna mun hiding ahi.
en_web: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
en_kjv: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen pang dung gam nanei joouseu gamchangnoi soh a, kelngoi chingho ngahmun sonna le kelngoite dia neh thei hamhing dimset ding ahi.

tcz: Judah mi ahingdoh amoh chengsen, hiche mun hi, kineh holna a aneidiu. Janteng Ashkelon a ingem ho’a jan choldo diu ahi. Chutahleh, Pakai a Pathen’u chun, khotona neitah a amite ahinvil ding chuleh asemphat kit’a hamphatna apeh ding ahi.
en_web: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.
en_kjv: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; They shall feed thereupon: In the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: For the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah mi ahingdoh hon nagamsung alo diu, kelngoihon vahna aneiyuva, Ashkelon khosung in hoa jan geh diu ahi. Pakai a-Pathen’un umpintin, ahaodohsah kit diu ahi.

tcz: “Keiman Moab mite ham hoithona kajan, chuleh Ammon mite ajumso nau kajai. Amahon kamite noise tah’a anuisat’uva chuleh isahlou tah’a gal abolden’u kamu tai.
en_web: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.
en_kjv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, And the revilings of the children of Ammon, Whereby they have reproached my people, And magnified themselves against their border.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipan Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Moab le Ammon miten kamite aphin’uva ahoutom nau kajan, agamsungu jong lahpeh dia hoitho tah a hamhoi tho’u kajai.

tcz: “Tun, keima ka hing jing’e,” tin Israel Pathen, thaneitah Pakai chun aseiye. “Moab leh Ammon mite kisugam ding, Sodom leh Gomorah banga kisumang soh hel ding ahi. Agamsungu jong ling le khao dimset, chikhuh jeng hiding, chuleh aitih’a ahomkeova kijam ding ahi.” Chuleh kamite ahingdoh chengsen, amaho adelmang’uva agam sungu achenden diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.
en_kjv: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, Even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: The residue of my people shall spoil them, And the remnant of my people shall possess them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikhel lou Hing jing Israel Pathen kahinaa kihahsel kahi-Moab le Ammon hi Sodom le Gomorrah banga kasuhgam ding ahi. Akhomun jouseu jong chikhuh soh didng, tonsot khogem a kijam a, lingle khao keh dimset ding ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengin amaho hi chomgam’untin, agamsungu alahpeh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Amahon akiletsah ga akisan diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pathen mite chu noise tah’a atot thang’uva, thaneipen Pathen douna abol’u ahi.
en_web: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: This shall they have for their pride, Because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakai mite aphin’uva, kiletsah hoitho abol jal’uva Moab mite le Ammon mite hitobanga hi talen kimatsah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Pakaiyin agamsunguva leiset Pathen umho jouse asuh mang ding, chutah leh amaho tija tah’a alha ding ahi. Chuteng namtin vaipin ama cheh gamsung a, Pakai Pathen chu bohkhupa ahoudiu ahi.
en_web: The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
en_kjv: The Lord will be terrible unto them: For he will famish all the gods of the earth; And men shall worship him, every one from his place, Even all the isles of the heathen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin hoh kichantin, leiset mite doihou jouse imacha lou aso ding, chutah l enamtin vaipin Pakai bou houva, agamsung cheh a chibai aboh diu ahi.

tcz: “Vo, Ethiopia mite nangho jong ka chemjam’a na lousoh hel diu ahi” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.
en_kjv: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Sudan mite jong athagam ding ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Pakaiyin sahlam gamho douna-a akhut tum alapding Assyria gam asuhmang peh ding ahi. Nineveh khopi jong ahomkeuva aumsah ding, panna bei nelphai gammgo banga akoi ding ahi.
en_web: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
en_kjv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; And will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Assyria suhamngna din tha jedoh-intin, Nineveh khopi chu khogem lah asosah a, twi bwina nelgam ahisah ding ahi.

tcz: Akiletsah piu khopi chu, bongte le kelngoite kivahna leh kolna hiding, chuleh gamsa jouse jong kol diu ahi. In-gemsa ho lah’a chu, sumbupi ho, saphute, chuleh muthong ho hung cheng diu, aham gin’u kholai sung kithong ding ahi. Cedar thing a kisa in jouse jong ki suchim gam ding, chuleh in kot ho jong thilse ho kinot dim gam ding ahi.
en_web: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.
en_kjv: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: Both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; Their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: For he shall uncover the cedar work.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoite le bong ho chule satinin kolle na bou anei diu ahi, khogem lah a hin simbupi hung chengin tin, bangkot dunga ham ham diu ahi. Kotpi phung dunga va-ahte hung hamlah lah-uvinte.Inthing cedar thinga kimang jouse jong alheng lhol a kijam a, akeova um ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche khopi chu ahi, kiletsah tah’a “Keima bou alenpen kahi” tia ama kichoi sang’a, kulpi detpen’a ana um chu. Ahinlah, tunvang ahomkeuva kijam ahitan, gamlah gamsate chenna mun ahitai. Avahle ajotpa jousen, akhut tum ajeldenun, nuijat nopnan aneitauvin ahi.
en_web: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
en_kjv: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, That said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: How is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! Every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Athahat kisonpia hamhoitho, lung mongtah a kigel khopi chu hitia hung um sing ahi. Khosung miten akhopiu chu vannoiya lengpen le minthang penin agel’ui. Itobang melsea gamsate kititna le gamthip lai hungdoh ding hitam! Ajotpa jouse kinleh leu leu diu ahi.

tcz: Hesoh gentheina kiboldoh jing, Ohe! ada ahi! Doumah mah bol’a kisuboh soh hel, Vo! Jerusalem khopi, kimatna khopi.
en_web: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
en_kjv: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe ada ahi-chonset le doumah bol, mite bolgim khopi!

tcz: Hiche khopi hin kisuhdihna him him adoudal in, koima thudih sei ging aum poi. Amahon Pakai chu atahsan pouvin chuleh ama Pathen’u kom jong anaideh pouve.
en_web: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.
en_kjv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; She trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thu la angaipon, gahna jong asangpoi. Pakaiya ki-ngai lou, apanpi jong ngeh lou ahi.

tcz: Khopi sung vaipo’a pangho chu, Sakei bahkai bangin kitumlet lutin, aneh ding bou akihol’un. A Thutan vaihom ho jong, kamkei hon, gilkei keija nilhah ngah’a, jan muthim lah’a nehding kihol’a, jingkah teng neh moh ima khenlouva umho tobang ahiuve.
en_web: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
en_kjv: Her princes within her are roaring lions; Her judges are evening wolves; They gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Avaibolte sakei kisen abngun, thutan ho jong kamkei gilkelte nehmoh dagu khovahsah lou tobang ahiuve.

tcz: A themgao ho jong , jouleh nal’a ama phatchomna ding kihol ngen ahiuve. Chuleh Thempua pangho jong , Pathen thupeh nitlouvin, Hou-in sung asuboh gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
en_kjv: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: Her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Themgaoten la khohsah neilou, mi lhem chavai bep; Thempuho jong thil theng suboh a, Pathen Danthu geiya adeilama kihei jen gahiuve.

tcz: Ahivang in, Pakaiyin khopi sung adalha pon, aumpi jing in, chuleh amaho din ima setna abolpoi. Aniseh in, aman thudih chu aphongdoh jing in, chuleh aman ima bolkhel anei poi. Amavang, thudih louva chonpa chem jum le ja lam ahepoi.
en_web: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
en_kjv: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: Every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; But the unjust knoweth no shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla khopi sunga Pakai pansaa itih a jong thildih jen gbol ahi. Niso she le amite din thudih-in na atong jingin ahi. Hiche jong hin midih louten kumle ja helouvin thildih lou jeng abol jinguve.

tcz: “Keiman nampi vaipi katheh ngim in, akisel nau kulpi bang le in ho jon ahomkeuvin kakoi tai, kholai dung ajong koima avahle aumpon, athip gamtai. Ajeh chu ahing doh amoh khat jong umlou ahitauve.
en_web: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
en_kjv: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Namtin vaipi kasugamin, akhopiu l ekulpi pala ho, intingvum sang jouse kasumangtai. Khopi jouse akamsel’in lamlen ho keovin akijamin, mihing abeihel tai.

tcz: Keiman kagel chu, tunvang hiche te hin eijabol intin, eiging tauvinte, kati. Ka hilchehna ho jong sang tei tauvinte, kati.Chu teng keiman achung'uva jepna pehkit dang’e, chuleh achennau inho jong kisuhmang kit dahen, kati. Ahivangin, amaho jingpitah In athouvun, abolngaiju setna jeng abolun, akhoh cheh cheh jingin ahi.”
en_web: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
en_kjv: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; So their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: But they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
tcz_gospelgo: Kabol gimna hi kamiten gel jinga, kagahna asan diu, chuteng eija lheh diuvin kanagel’e. Ahinla chomkah louvin chavai bubah-in alamkittauve,” ati.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye,” Hijeh chun khongai jin, ngahhat in, keiman hiche namtin vaipi gitlou bolte hohi, keima kadin’a, themmo kachan sah ding ahi. Ajeh chu leiset chunga lenggam ho kasuhkhom ding, achung'uva ka lunghanna khosetah meikong tobang chu kabuh khum ding ahiuve. Hiche ka lunghanna meikong chun leiset pumpi ahalvam ding ahi.
en_web: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
en_kjv: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, Until the day that I rise up to the prey: For my determination is to gather the nations, That I may assemble the kingdoms, To pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: For all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakiyin aseiyin, “Namtin vaipi hehse dia kakipat ngah-un. Kalunghan husa thamsah dia namtin vaipi le lenggam jouse khop khom dia kagel lhuh ahitai. kalunghanna meikouva leiset pumpi kahalvam ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng leh keiman namtin vaipi kamcheng ka sutheng’n kakhel peh ding, chute leh mitin in lung kitoh’a Pakai ahou cheh ding ahi.
en_web: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
en_kjv: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, That they may all call upon the name of the Lord, To serve him with one consent.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chuteng namtin vaipi lung heidah ing ting, kei tilou Pathen dang koma tao louhel ding ahiuve. Kei thubou ngaitauvinte.

tcz: Chuteng leh, Ethiopia vadung gal‘a umho, chehsa kamiten jong, thilto ahin choi uva apeh dingu ahi.
en_web: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
en_kjv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
tcz_gospelgo: Sudan gam lang peh a thechehsa kamiten jong kahenga kilhaina thilto ahinchoi diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, nangman jum le ja nathuh tah lou ding, ajeh chu keima douva napantah lou ding ahi. Keiman nalah uva kon’a mi kiletsah ho chuleh ama kichoisang ho ka paidoh ding ahi. Chuteng kalhang theng’a chu kiletsah hoithona um talou ding ahi.
en_web: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
en_kjv: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, Wherein thou hast transgressed against me: For then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, And thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
tcz_gospelgo: hiteng chule neidou jal’uva mit le maim oh aum lou din gnahitauve. Kelietsah hoitho chengse tolmang ing ting, kalhang theng chunga neidou kit louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Ahingdoh amoh chengse, amaho chu, abon’a mi lungneng leh mi kinem sah ho jeng ahitauve. Ajeh chu amaho chu Pakai min’a taojing ho ahiuve.
en_web: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
en_kjv: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, And they shall trust in the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi nun nem le kineosah chengse khen in gting, kahenga panpi ngaiya hun gjing diu ahi.

tcz: Akidalha Israel amoh chengsen, adihlou abolkit tahlou ding’u, jou leh nal’a jong khat le khat kilhem talou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu, amaho chu, koiman akichatsah tah lou dingu chuleh lungmong’a, nomsel’a aneh uva chuleh kichol diu ahitai.
en_web: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
en_kjv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; Neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: For they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel ahin gdoh chengin mi koima dih louvin bol pouvintin, jou sei lou ding, lhep lhah thu jong sei pouvinte. Lung mong le khangtouva um a, gin nei lou didng ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Vo, Zion chanu, O thongin la sauvin; Vo Israel kholhang sam in! Nalungthim pumpin kipah le thanom in um'in, Vo Jerusalem chanu!
en_web: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; Be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Israelte, kipa la sauvin! Vo Jerusalem nalungthim pumpin kipah-in!

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akhut’a na chungthu atan ding chu alamang tan, chuleh na melma te jouse jong anomang soh tai. Pakai amatah Israel leng ahin, nalah uva aching jing e. Nangman navel’a thilse nagin kit tahlou ding chuleh na gentheina jouse beisoh ding ahitai.
en_web: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
en_kjv: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: The king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: Thou shalt not see evil any more.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakiyin nathohna asubeitan, Namelmate atolmangdoh tai. Pakai, Israel Lengpan naumpiuve, Kichatna ding him him aumtapoi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, Jerusalem kiseipeh ding cu, “Vo, Zion, kipah thanom in, kicha hih in, natha jong lhahsam sah hih in!
en_web: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
en_kjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: And to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat ahung lhunge mihon Jerusalme jah a, “Kicha hih-in Zion khopi! Ban-gol jesal jingin!

tcz: Ajeh chu, na lailung uva Pakai na Pathen chu aching jing in, ama chu thaneitah huhingpu ahi. Aman thanom tah’a nakipapi ding, ami lungsetna chun na lungmon sah ding, nang dinga kipah thanom’a chuleh kipa la asah ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
en_kjv: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; He will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; He will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai na-Pathenin naimpi jinge, Athahat’in gal najosah tai. Pakaiyin kipapin natin, Alungset jal’in hinkhothah pen nate, Nachung change kipa la santé.

tcz: “Keiman nangho, kut nikho’a lunghem leh lhasa umho jouse, kakhop khom soh ding, chuleh nangho avel’a koiman nabolset kit tahlou dingu ahi.
en_web: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
en_kjv: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, To whom the reproach of it was a burden.
tcz_gospelgo: Kut laiya kipah ho bang ding ahi,” ati diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin: “hutotna ka-ngatan, Vetda nachan kasubeitai.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nangho bol genthei ja pangho chu nasatah’a ka bolgim ding ahi. Keiman alhasam holeh bel ding neilou ho jouse kahuh doh ding, chuleh muntin’a ana kidel magho, keiman kahin puikhom ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu, loupina leh minthana akpeh ding, amaho dinga ajumnao leh ajachat nau jouse chu kilamang ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
en_kjv: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: And I will save her that halteth, And gather her that was driven out; And I will get them praise and fame In every land where they have been put to shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat ahung lhungtai! Nabolse talen matsah ing ting, Elbai chengse kahuhdoh ding, Sohchangte inlama hin puiyinge. Jumle ja athohna chengseu Ginle jabolna kaheidoh a, Vannoi miten apachat diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, keiman nangho jouse ka khopkhom ding, inlam’a ka puilut kitding nahiuve. Keiman nangho, leiset chung namtin vaipi lah’a, minphatna leh minthanna kapeh ding, chuleh amitmu cheng uva Hamphatna kapeh ding nahiuve. Hiche hi, keima Pakai Pathen in ka seidoh ahitai.
en_web: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
en_kjv: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: For I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, When I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat ahung lhunge! Namite cheh chaosa puikhom ing ting, Vannoi minthang kihisah ding, Naphat theiya nahaodoh kit ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai.

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kum ni lhinna, Lhajing nisim som ni le ko nin, Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua henga Pakai in Haggai a konin thu ahinseiye.
en_web: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
en_kjv: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Darius Persia gamvaipoa apan kal kum ni lhinna, lha gupna, ni masapen nin Haggai Themgao kamin Pakaiyin thu ahinseiye. Athusei hi Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel, Shealtiel chapa le Thempu chungnung Joshua, Jehozadak chapa ding ahi.

tcz: “Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Hiche miten, ‘Pakai hou in sahphatna ding avatna laiye atiuve.’”
en_web: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
en_kjv: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai jah a aseiyin, “Hiche ho hi Houin sah phatna ding hilou laiyin aseiyui,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai in Haggai themgao kamin ahin seiye:
en_web: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: Then came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin mipi dingin hiche thu hi Haggai Themgao kamin aseiye:

tcz: “I-atileh ka in asesa kijam’a nang ho in nomtah taha chen nahiuvem?
en_web: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
en_kjv: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, And this house lie waste?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo kamite, idia nang ho, in phatah tah a chenga, Kei Houin asesa kijam ham?

tcz: Hiche hi Van Pakai sei ahi: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
en_web: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
en_kjv: Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunguva thilsoh mulou nahiuvem?

tcz: Muchi tamtah natudoh naovin, ahinlah lhomcha bou nakiat doh uve. An nane naovin, ahinlah navaset thei pouve. Twi nadon naovin, ahinlah na dangchah-u achimdeh poi. Von na kivon naovin, ahinlah lum nasah jou pouve. Na tohman jouseu jong akoina sumdip avangsa bangin amang pai ji'e!
en_web: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
en_kjv: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; Ye eat, but ye have not enough; Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; Ye clothe you, but there is none warm; And he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi tampi natu vangun lhosoh ga themcha bou namu’uve. Neh ding nanei vangun oivana kham ahipoi. Lengpitwi don ding naneiyun, chimna kham ahipoi! Ponsil naneiyun, lum nasahpi khamu ahipoi. Natong’an oivana amujoupoi.

tcz: Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
en_web: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.
tcz_gospelgo: I-tile hiti ho hi soh ahi namudoh louvu ham?

tcz: Tun thinglhang langa kal’uvin, thing gasuivin lang, ka in sa phauvin. Chutileh keima kalung lhaiding chule kaloupi thei ding ahi, tin Pakai in aseiye.
en_web: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; And I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun thinglhang lama kaltouvun; inthil gajongun Houin saphauvin; kalung lhai ding, eikihou dol’a eikihou ding ahi.

tcz: Tohga tampi nakineppi uve, ahinlah na vaicha cheh jouve. Chule na tohga’u in nahin pohlut tengu, ka sem mangpeh jitaove. Ipijha ham? Ajeh chu ka in ase san akijamin, ahinlah nang ho amitaki’in ama in nomtah tah kisahnan naki salel uve, tin Van Pakai sepai chun aseiye.
en_web: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
en_kjv: Ye looked for much, and lo, it came to little; And when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, And ye run every man unto his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lhoga tampi mu ding nakinem’un, amala lhomcha ahiji. Lhosoh in a nahinpoh lut tengu jongle kamut mangpehjitai. Idia kabol ham? Ka-Houin sesa um a, nading cheh bolna nakisah lel jal’u ahi.

tcz: Nang ho jeh'a van mun jousen gotwi daitwi atuhkih’a, chule leiset in jong ga asemdoh lou ahi.
en_web: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
en_kjv: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, And the earth is stayed from her fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu gotwi lha louva muchi chivo phalou-keh lou ahi.

tcz: Na louma dung jouse le na thinglhang jouseuva nichang kasat sahding – hiche nichang sat chun chang jouse agotsah ding, lengpi phung jouse jong, olive phung jouse jong, chule muchi chivo dang jouse jong agotlhah sah soh ding, hichun nang le na gancha jong kel natohsah diu, chule na tohga jouseu jong aboncha asuhset soh kei ding ahi.”
en_web: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
en_kjv: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, And upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, And upon that which the ground bringeth forth, And upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsunga gotwi kang a, molle lhang gosoh, bulei le lengpilei jouse go a, olive honlei jouse gosoh, muchi chivo jouse gotwi ngai, mihem le gancha chule thil ijakai gotwi ngaiya umsoh ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua chuleh ahingdoh Pathen mite amoh chengin Pakai a Pathen’u thusei anit tauvin ahi. Pakai a Pathenun ahinsol Haggai themgao thusei ajah doh-u chun mipin Pakai aging cheh taove.
en_web: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.
en_kjv: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Babylon a sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel le Joshua chule mipin Pakai a-Pathen’un bol dia aseipeh-u chu aboltauve. Pakai sole Themgao Haggai chu aging cheh-un asei angaiyui.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai thangkouva pang Haggai chun mipi jaha Pakai thupeh chu hitin: “Keiman ka umpi jing nauve, tin Pakai in aseiye,” atin ahi.
en_web: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: Then spake Haggai the Lord’s messenger in the Lord’s message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Haggaiyin Pakai thusei chu mipi aseipeh-in: “Kakitep ahitai-kaumpi jing ding nahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai in Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel lungthim ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua lunghtim ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh chengse lunghtim atildoh in ahi. Hiti chun van Pakai, a Pathenu hou in chu asapan taovin ahi.
en_web: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,
en_kjv: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,
tcz_gospelgo: Sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel, Judah gam vaipopa, Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi abonchauvin Houin sapha din Pakaiyin atildoh tai. Hijeh chun thaneipen Pakai a-Pathenu Houin asapantauve.

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhinna, lhalam som ni le khat nia atohpat’u ahi.
en_web: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
en_kjv: in the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Asah patnau chu Darius gamvaipoh kal kum nina, lhagup lhin, nisom ni le li ni ahi.

tcz: Chuin chuche kum leh chuche lha ma ma nisim somni le sagi nin Pakai in themgao Haggai koma thu ahin seikit tai.
en_web: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Darius leng chankal kum ni lhinna, lha sagi lhin, nisom ni le khat nin Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinsei kit’e.

tcz: “Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh cheng henga hitin seiyin:
en_web: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
en_kjv: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Haggai chu Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel le Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi jah a thu sei din asol’in,

tcz: ‘Koipen ham hiche in hejing nalaiya? – hiche houin – masanga aloupina leh ahoina he nalai? Hiche toh chun tedinga tua hi i-toh nabah sah uvem? Imacha hiloubeh toh abang jeng tai!
en_web: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
en_kjv: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? And how do ye see it now? Is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
tcz_gospelgo: “Houin loupije chu geldoh theiya nalah-uva mihem khat beh umlou ham? Itobanga namujiu vem? Tunvang imacha ahitapoi.

tcz: Ahin tun Pakai in aseiye: Zerubbabel hat’in. Thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua hat’in. Gamsunga umcheng mipi teho nang ho jong hat’uvin. Chuleh tun kipat-un, tong pan’un, ajeh chu keiman ka umpi naove tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
en_web: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; And be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; And be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: For I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle khatchan jong lungthoinan neidauvin. Tongpan’un, Ka-umpi jing nauve.

tcz: Egypt nahin dalhah uva, kakitepna bang bangin, kalhagao nalah uva, aum jing nai. Hijeh chun kichah hih hel’un.”
en_web: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
en_kjv: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, So my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt’a kona nahungdoh-u chun ka-umpi jing diuvin kakiteptai. Tunjong kaumpi jingui kicha hih-uvin.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itihleh Pakai Van Sepai chun hitin aseiye: Chomkhat jouleh van le leiset kaholing kit ding, twikhanglen leh gam go lai jouse jong ka holing ding ahi.
en_web: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
en_kjv: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, And I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
tcz_gospelgo: “Phat chomkah louva van le leiset, Twikhanglen kaholingsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Namtin vaipi kaholing ding ahi, chuleh athil khol jouseu hiche houin sunga hung kilhut soh ding, Loupi taha kadip soh hel ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiyin ahi.
en_web: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: And I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi lehkhup soh ing ting, anei agou chengseu hikoma kahin poh khom ding, Houin hi nei le gou dimset ding ahi.

tcz: Sana jong keiya ahin, dangka jong keiya ahi tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
en_web: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya sana dangka jouse aboncha Keiya ahi.

tcz: Masanga aloupina sanga hiche houin hi hung loupi jo cheh ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun seiyin ahi.
en_web: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
en_kjv: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: And in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin luipa sanga Houin thah loupijo cheh ding, chuteng kamite chamle lungmon, haona kapeh ding ahi,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin asei ahitai.

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhin kum, Ollha nisim som le get nin Pakai in themgao Haggai henga thu ahin seiye:
en_web: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Darius gamvaipoh kal kum ni na, lha ko lhin, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinseiyin,

tcz: “Hiche hi Pakai van sepai chun asei ahi. Hiche dan thupeh chung changa thudoh ho chu thempu ho dongin:
en_web: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: “Aban a kisei thudol’a hin Thempuhon ilo ding agot’um dong temin:

tcz: ‘nangho laha koipen hamkhat chun akithensosa satheng chu asangkhol chol a podoh henlang chule asongkhol chol chun changlhah ham ahilouleh anme ham, lengpi twi ham, olive thao twi ham ahilou jongleh nehthei khat pen pen chu tongkha taleh hichun thensah uvin tem? Thempu hon adonbut uvin,“Thensah ponte,” atiuve.
en_web: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”
en_kjv: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem khat touvin kilhaina sathenga kithat sahal khat tou aponsil’in kichundoh hen, hiche ponsil hin ipi thil hijongle: changlhah ham, an minsa ham, lengpitwi ham, olive thao ham, khat pen pen tongkha le, atoh khah pen pen chu sutheng theiyin tem?”a ti. Hiche thudoh hi adoh phat’un thempuhon, “Theng theiponte,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Haggai in adong in, “Mihem khat mithi long atohkhat jeh'a dan dungjuiya aboh a um chun hiche neh le chah ho chu tongkha taleh, abohsah ding hitam?” Chuin thempu hon adonbut uvin, “Henge abohsah ahitai,” atiuve.
en_web: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
en_kjv: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
tcz_gospelgo: Haggaiyin adong kit’in, “Mihem khat’in thilong tongkhan kisuboh taleh, aman atoh khah khah neh le chah ho chu boh thei ding ham?” ati. Thempuho, “Boh theiyinte,” atiiuve.

tcz: Chuin Haggai in adonbut in, “Hiche mipi le nam mite jong chu tobang chu ahiuve, tin Pakai in aseiye. Athilbol jouseu ahin chuleh athil todohu jouseu abon'a achonset uvin asuhboh sohji ahi.
en_web: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
en_kjv: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the Lord; And so is every work of their hands; And that which they offer there is unclean.
tcz_gospelgo: Haggaiyin aseiyin, “Pakaiyin aseiyin, hitobanga chu hiche nam mite chunga jong chuti ding ahin, atohdoh aboldoh chengseu jong chuti ding ahi; hiti hin maicham phunga atodoh chengseu jong abohsa jeng ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Pakai houin sahna dinga abul naphudoh masangun nachung uva ipi pi anasoh ham vephaovin.
en_web: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.
en_kjv: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, From before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Nachunguva thilsoh hi nahetdoh thei louvu ham? Houin sah phat napat masangun,

tcz: Na lou sohu thiltena som ni dinga nakinepiu chu som bou naki mubep un ahi. Lengpi twi tena somnga childoh dinga naginchat’u chu somni bou nate doh jouvin ahi.
en_web: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
en_kjv: Since those days were, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: When one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
tcz_gospelgo: chang kilogram ja ni jen tedoh din che leu chun kilogram jakhat bou umintin, lengpitwi litre jakhat thaldoh din lengpitwi bel gave leu chun litre som li bou um ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman nalouma jouseu ka motlhah sah’in, nget kaneh sah’in chuleh gelchang kalhah sah’in natohgau muchi chivo jouse kasumang in ahi. Hiche jouse nungin jong, ka henga nahung kile nom hih laiyuve, tin Pakai in aseiye.”
en_web: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.
en_kjv: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail In all the labours of your hands; Yet ye turned not to me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ke dohsah tei dia natu anche louhing jouse semchai din khohui hamve vun kalansah-in, lungnaheideh pouve.

tcz: Phatechan tuni nikho, Ollha nisim som le get ni, hiche nikho, Pakai Houin ding abul kiphu nikho hi ngaitouvin. Lunggil tahin gel’uvin.
en_web: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.
en_kjv: Consider now from this day and upward, From the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, Even from the day that the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid, consider it.
tcz_gospelgo: Tuni hi lha ko na, nisom ni le ni lhin na, Houin inmun kilaijou nikho ahi. Tua pat ipi hungsoh ding vetem’uvin.

tcz: Tu nikho, na changchi’u changsala aumpet’a kakitep ahi. Chang na at hih laiyui, lengpi twi le theichang phung le olive phung le kolbuthei phung hon ga asepdoh hihlai uve. Hijeng jongle tuni nikhoa pat’a phatthei kaboh ding nahi tauve.”
en_web: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”
en_kjv: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: From this day will I bless you.
tcz_gospelgo: Changsal keosoh hen, lengpiga heosoh hen lang, theichang ga heo hen, kolbuthei le olive thing ga heo ta jongle, tua pat vang phatthei kaboh diu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuche nikho ma ma, Ollha nisim som le get nikhon Pakai in anivei chanan Haggai henga thu ahinsei kit in:
en_web: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
en_kjv: And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuche lha, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin Pakaiyin Haggai kam a, thu asei kit’in,

tcz: Judah gamvaipo Zerubbel henga seipehin, Keiman vanho jouse le leiset kaholing ding koncha ahitai.
en_web: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.
en_kjv: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: athusei hi Judah gam vaipo, Zerubbabel ding ahin, “Ken Van le leiset kaholing a,

tcz: Leng gam jouse leh alaltounau jouse akhup athal’a kale ding, Sagol kangtalai le achunga tou jouse jong akhup athal’a kale ding ahi. Sakol jouse lhalhop soh ding chuleh achunga tou jouse amaho le amaho kithat todiu ahi.
en_web: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
en_kjv: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, And I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; And I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; And the horses and their riders shall come down, Every one by the sword of his brother.
tcz_gospelgo: lenggam jouse le athaneina chengse akhup athal’a kakoi ding ahi. Kangtalai ho le atol ho akhup athal’a kale a, sakolte thigam a, achung toute kithat to diu ahi.

tcz: “Hichu ahung lhung teng, ka lhacha Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel, jabolna kapeh ding nahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye. Keiman mohor kisemna khutjem banga kasem ding nahi, ajeh chu kalhendohsa nahi tai, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye. Pakai Van Sepai, Keiman tahin kasei ahi!” ati.
en_web: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
en_kjv: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, Will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, And will make thee as a signet: For I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho tengle kalhacha Zerubbabel, nang hi kamin a vaihom dia kalhendoh ding nahi. Kalhendohsa nahitai,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseitai.

tcz: Darius vaipoh kumni le lha get channa Iddo themgao chapa Berechiah chapa Zechariah komma Pakai thupeh ahung lhungin hitin aseije.
en_web: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
en_kjv: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Darius hin Persia gamvai apoh kal kum ni na, lha get nan Iddo tupa, Berechiah chapa, Zechariah Themgao henga Pakaiyin hiche thu hi aseiye.

tcz: Napateu chunga Pakai alung hang lheh jingin ahi.
en_web: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.
en_kjv: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah hi mipi aseipeh din aseiyin, “Kei-Pakai hi napu napateu chunga lung hang kahi,

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho kommah chun thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin ati, achutileh keijong nangho kom a kahung kile kitding ahi tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, And I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongle nang ho hi, ‘hung kit’un, Keijong nahenguva hungkit nange.’

tcz: Napu napateo bangin chonhih’un, amaho jaha chu themgao hon lhang asap piuve, thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ase lamma nachon nauva kon leh thilse na bolnauva kon in hungkile kit’uvintin aseije. Ahivangin amahon angai pouvin khohsah injong anei pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.
en_kjv: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: But they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateu umchan jop dauvin. Masangin themgao hon thilse boldin ail’un, chonse lou din asei peh-ui.Ahivangin kasei ngailou, kathu nit louvin aum’ui.

tcz: Napu napateu chu tuahi hoilamma umma hitauvem? Amaho leh themgao ho chu sotpeha thigamma ahitauve.
en_web: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
en_kjv: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live for ever?
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateu le Themgao ho chu abeisoh tai.

tcz: Ahinlah epi hijongleh kalhachate themgao komma kana phondoh ho jouse chu napu napateu khanglaijin kaseibang bangin ana guilhung sohtan ahi. Hiche dungjui chun amahon kisih in alungu ana heijun, Eihon thaneipen Pakaija kon in imudiu lom imu tauve, Aman kahin bolding ahi ati dungjuijin ahin tongdoh tan ahi.
en_web: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”
en_kjv: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, Did they not take hold of your fathers? And they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, According to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

tcz: Hijou chun aman ei seipeh in, “Hiche hi Pakaiyin Zerubbabel komma asei chu ahi, hunamma natoh naleh thahat vanga hilou ding amavang keima Lhagao vanga hiding ahibouve, tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en_web: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, Saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil’in Pakaiya konin hiche hi Zerubbabel seipeh din eihil’in, “Sepaite le thahat vang hilouva, Ka-Lhagao vanga najo tei ding ahi.

tcz: Imachan nang jou lou ding, mol sangpen jeng in jong Zerubbabel lampi chu asuh tang jou lou ding ama masanga chu phaicham sohjeng ding ahi. Zerubbabel hin houin semphatna a achaina song asettoh phattengleh, mipihon Pathen in phattheiboh hen, Pathen in phattheiboh hen!” tia asapdiu ahi.
en_web: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
en_kjv: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: And he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisuhmona ding molle lhang kikhangsang bang jongle, namasanga kitol mangsoh diu, Houin nasah phat’a, Inmun song nukhah pen nakoiteng, mipin sam’untin, ‘Ahoiye, ahoiye!’ tia aseidiu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaija kon nin thupeh chomkhat ahung lhung kit-in,
en_web: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
en_kjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya konin kahenga thu khat ahung lhung kit’in,

tcz: Zerubbabal hi Hou-in aleibul ana tungdoh a chu ahin, aman asahchai ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh hatchungnung Pakai chun eihin sol ahi ti na het diu ahi.
en_web: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
en_kjv: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; His hands shall also finish it; And thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Zerubbabel’in Houin mun asep joutai, Houin jong asah jou ding ahi. Asah jou teng kamiten ahenguva nang sol’a Kei kahi hedoh tauvinte.

tcz: Natoh ahina ding banga amachal lou jeh in alungthoi’un ahi, ahinla Zerubbabel hin houin asah chu atoh jom amuteng uleh kipah tauvinte. Thaomei sagi kiti hin Pakai mit-in vannoi leiset pumpi akholsoh vetsahna ahi.
en_web: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
en_kjv: For who hath despised the day of small things? For they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; They are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
tcz_gospelgo: tohban chalmo jeh-in lung himon aum’un, Zerubbabel’in Houin sah ban ajop jing amudoh tengu kipah thanom lheh-unte,” ati. Vantil chun kajah a, “Thaomei sagi hileiset pumpi musoh hel Pakai mit sagi ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Hijou chun keiman vantil chu ka dong in, hiche thaomei khom pang tenia Olive thingphung nihi ipi tina hintem,
en_web: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
en_kjv: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong, “Thaomeikhom jet le veiya olive thingphung te ni khu ipito tekah ba ham?

tcz: Thaotwi kisun lhah naji sana luong teni komma Olive thingbah teni khun ipi asatsat hin tem? kati.
en_web: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
en_kjv: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
tcz_gospelgo: Chule olive thaotwi lonna sana-long te ni kom a olive thing bathe ni khu ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge.

tcz: Aman eidong in na hetlou ham eiti. Keiman ka donbut in ka hepoi Pakai kati.
en_web: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
en_kjv: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Nahet lou ham?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Pu kahepoi,” kati.

tcz: Hichun aman, “Hiche hin thao kinusa leiset pumpi Pakai laltouna komma ding jing van mi teni chu avetsah ahi”ati.
en_web: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
en_kjv: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun aman, “Hiche te ni hi, leiset pumpi Pakaiyin alhachaa pang dia alhendoh te ni chu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Keima ka dahdoh kit in kavet leh lekhajol lengle khat kamun ahi.
en_web: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
en_kjv: Then I turned, and lift up mine eyes, and looked, and behold, a flying roll.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagah vet kit le, vanlaijol’a leng lekhajol khat kamui.

tcz: Vantil chun “Ipi namum” eiti. Keiman jong ka donbut in lekhajol lengle kamun, adunglam khuchang somthum chuleh availam khutchang somlenga tobang ahi.
en_web: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun ipi kamu eidonge. Kenjong, “Vanlaijol’a lengle, metre ka sao, metre li le keh len, lekhajol khat kamui,” kati.

tcz: Hichun aman eiseipeh in, “Hiche lekhajol hi leiset pumpia hung potdoh gaosapna ahi. Hiche lekajol dangkhat hin, koi hileh agucha a chu hiche gamma kon ahi kideldoh ahi ati, adangkhat hin koi hileh jou a kihahsel jong chu hiche gamma konna hi kidel doh ding ahi” ati.
en_web: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
en_kjv: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: For every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; And every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman kajah a aseiyin, “Hichejol’a khu leiset pumpi chunga thejal ding gaosapna kisun ahi. Lekhajol lang khat’a khu gamsunga gucha jouse nodoh ding kisun a, alang khat’a khu jou pan a kihahsl chengse tolmang ding kisei ahi.

tcz: Chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Keiman guchaho jouse insunga hiche sapset nahi kalhun sah ding ahin, chuleh kamin panna jou leh nalla kihehse ho insunga jong sapsetna kalhunsah ding ahi. Chuleh hiche ka sapsetna hi a insung uva umden intin, a insung pumpiu athing asong pumma ka suhmang ding ahi.
en_web: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
en_kjv: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, And it shall enter into the house of the thief, And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: And it shall remain in the midst of his house, And shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin hiche gaosapna lhadoh ding aseiyin, gucha jouse le jou pan a kihahsel’a thusei jouse insunga lut didng ahi. A-insunguva pansan tin, asuhgam hel’a adalhah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijou chun eiki houlimpi Vantil chu ahung in ka kom mah hitin aseije, “Khodah inlang ipi hunglhung ding ham galdot in” eiti.
en_web: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”
en_kjv: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chu ahung kilah kit’in, “Ven, thil chom beh khat ahungdoh kit’e!” ati.

tcz: “Ipi ham” tin kadong in ahileh aman eihin donbut in, hiche pocha hi chang tena ahin, hiche gamsung pumpia miho jouse chonset na ahi”ati.
en_web: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—
en_kjv: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong, “Ipi ham?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Pocha khat ahin, gamsung pumpi chonset to tekah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijou chun hiche pocha kikhuna thihgih chu ahongdoh in ahileh asunga chun numei khat ana touvin ahi.
en_web: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
en_kjv: And behold, there was lift up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
tcz_gospelgo: Pocha sin chu hahngeh a kisem ahi. Kavet le asin ahongdoh-un, pocha sunga chun numei khat atouve!

tcz: Vantil chun ahin seije,” hiche numeinu hi gitlouna vetsahna ahi, atin aman asinna thihtum gihchun alesin kitnin akhahchah tai.
en_web: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.
en_kjv: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun, “Hiche numei hi gitlouna to tekah ahi,” ati. Hichun numei nu chu pocha sunga asonlut’in asinkhumtai.

tcz: Hijou chun keiman chunglang kagah ven ahileh, lhaving nei numeini huilah a keima komlanga ahungleng lhon in ahi. Amani hin vacha kang bang in lha anei lhon in hiche pocha chu adamdoh lhon in vanlai jollah a lhon toupi hon tan ahi.
en_web: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
en_kjv: Then lift I up mine eyes, and looked, and behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lift up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagah vet le vasai lhaving tobang neiya, numei ni kaheng lam ngan ahung leng lhone. Pocha chu akhaidoh lhonin, alen mangpi lhontai.

tcz: Hiche pocha chu hoilang’a akoi lhon hitam tia Vantil chu ka doh leh,
en_web: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
en_kjv: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong Vantil chu kadongin, “Hoilam lhut agot lhon ham?” kati.

tcz: Aman hitin ei donbut’e, “Babylon khopi langa hiche pocha dinga chu hou in asah peh lhon ding ahi, hiche Hou-in chu akisah jou teng leh hiche pocha chu akitunna ding munna chu atun lhon ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, To build it a house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman eodonbut’in, “Houin asahna diuva Babylon gama apoh mang lhon ahitai. Houin chu asah jou tengu, pocha chu koiyuntin, chule hichu ahou diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hijou chun keiman chunglang kaven ahileh sakol kangtalai li sumang molsang teni kikah a kon in ahung doh in ahi.
en_web: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
en_kjv: And I turned, and lift up mine eyes, and looked, and behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaochan nan mu kanei kit’e. Sum-eng molsang ni kah a konin kangtalai li ahung kitoldoh-e.

tcz: Sakol kangtalai masa chu sakol san in ahin kaijin, ani channa chu sakol vommin ahin kaijin ahi.
en_web: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.
en_kjv: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
tcz_gospelgo: Kangtalai masapen chu sakolsan in akaiyin, anina chu sakolvomin akaiyin,

tcz: Athum channa chu sakol kangin ahinkai jin, ali channa chu sakolpol hattah ahiuve.
en_web: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.
en_kjv: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
tcz_gospelgo: thumna chu sakolvomin akaiyin, li lhinna chu sakolpol’in akaiye.

tcz: Vantil eihoulimpi pachu ka dong in, Pakai hiche khopi hi ipi hitam ka tileh,
en_web: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
en_kjv: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil jah a hin kenjong, “Pu, hiche kangtalaiho hi ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge.

tcz: Vantil chun eidonbut in, “Hiche hohi leiset pumpi Pakai masanga ding lhagao li hochu ahiuve ati. Amahohi anatong dinga hung potdoh ahiuve.
en_web: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
en_kjv: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Amaho hi kolkimvel ning lia khopihui ahiuvin, leiset pumpi Pakai ang sunga hung kondoh ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Sakol vommin akaihi sahlanga che ding, akang in akai hi lhumlama che ding chu leh apollin akaihi lhanglanga che ding ahi.
en_web: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
en_kjv: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolvom ho kai kangtalai chun sahlam Babylon lang ajonin, sakolkangte kaiyin lhumlam ajonin, sakolpolte kaiyin lhanglam gamsung ajon’e.

tcz: Hiche sakol hattah hohi leiset chung kholtoh leding a thanomtah a hung kipatdoh ahiuve. Chuleh Pakai chun aseijin,” cheuvin leiset chung gakhol tauvin” ati. Hiti chun amaho akhol toh din ache tauve.
en_web: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
en_kjv: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get ye hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolpolte akijotdoh phat’in leiset gakholtoh loi ding a-ngah lel’ui. Hijeh chun Vantil’in, “Leiset gakhol loiyun!” tin aseiye. Hiti chun agakhol tauve.

tcz: Hijou chun Pakaiyin eihin kouvin aseijin ahi, “Vetan, sahlang gamsunga dinga kitolho khu hiche sahlam gamsunga kalung hanna achen dai taovin ahi.
en_web: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
en_kjv: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil’in eihin kouvin, “Sahlam Babylon lang jon sakolten Pakai lunghan asuthip tauve,” ati.

tcz: Pakai thupeh ka kom ah ahung lhung kitnin hitin aseije
en_web: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
en_kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin hitin thu eiseipeh-e,

tcz: Babylon gamma konna sohchang hundoh holah a kon in Heldai leh Tebiah chuleh Judiah hichenghi puijin lang hiche nikho ma chun Zephaniah chapa Josiah hengah chen ati.
en_web: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
en_kjv: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
tcz_gospelgo: “Sohchang mi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah thilpeh ho hi choiyin lang, Josiah, Zephaniah chapa koma gache loiyin, Amaho hi abonchauva Babylon gama sohchang hung kile kit ahiuve.

tcz: Chuteng leh dangka le sana la uvin lang lallukhuh sem un thempu chungnung Joshediah chapa Joshua chu khuhpeh un,
en_web: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
en_kjv: then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest;
tcz_gospelgo: Athilpeh-u dangka le sana ho hin lallikhuh khat semin, Thempu chungnung, Joshua, Jehozadak chapa khu khuhpeh-in.
