tcz: Chuleh ama komma hitin seijun, hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin Abah kiti mikhat munna kon in hung khangtou tauvin tin chuteng leh aman Pakai Hou-in chu ahin tun doh ding ahi.
en_web: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.
en_kjv: and speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; And he shall grow up out of his place, And he shall build the temple of the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah a Thaneipen Pakai thusei seipeh-in, ‘Abah kitipa chu hung phattheiya, Pakai Houin asah phat ding ahi.

tcz: Hichepa hin Pakai Hou-in asahdoh a loupina jong hung in chang ing chuleh alaltouna-a jong hung touva chuleh alaltouna-a chu thempua hung pang ding chuleh akikah lhonna chamnale lungmonna,
en_web: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
en_kjv: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; And he shall bear the glory, And shall sit and rule upon his throne: And he shall be a priest upon his throne: And the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hin Houin saphan tin, leng khat chanlom tah change, amite chunga vaihom ding ahi. Alaltouna koma Thempu khat ding jingin tin, lung khat le chamnan na tong lhoninte,’ tin.

tcz: Chuteng leh lallukhuh chu Pakai Hou-in sunga kikoija Heldai, Tebiah chu leh Zephaniah chapa Josiah hetdoh jingna dinga kikoi ding ahi.
en_web: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.
en_kjv: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Lallukhuh hi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah le Josiah het jingna dia Pakai Houina kikoi jing ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hitia chu khol gamla tah a konna jong hung diu Pakai Hou-in sahna a hi hung pang ding, hiteng chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin eihinsol ahi ti nahet diu ahi. Nangin Pakai na Pathen thuthu nanunna ahileh hiti ahi hung guilhung ding ahi.
en_web: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”
en_kjv: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.
tcz_gospelgo: Muntin le gamtin a chengte hunguntin, Pakai Houin sapha hung pan gdiu ahi. Houin kisah phat jou teng, nahenguva Thaneipen Pakaiyin eihinsol hi nahetdoh diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu thupeh chengse nanit’u le thil hijetpi hi guilhung ding ahi.

tcz: Darius lengpa Vaipoh kumli channa lhako lhinna Chislea lha kiti nili lhinnin Pakaiyin Zechariah henga thu ahin seije:
en_web: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
tcz_gospelgo: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumli na, lha ko, Kislev lha, ni li nin Pakaiyin thu khat eiseipeh-e.

tcz: Hichun Bethel khomiten Saherzer le Regem-molech toh amiteu chu Pakai lunglhaina holdin asol tauve,
en_web: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,
en_kjv: when they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,
tcz_gospelgo: Bethel kho miten Sharezer le regemmelech chu amiteu to Pakaiya vangboh thum din, Thaneipen Pakai Houin a asol’un,

tcz: Chujong leh thaneipan Pakai Hou-in na thempu leh themgao hochu thu aga dong’e, “Keiman hitih chan khanga kahin bolngai banga chu lhanga lhinseh leh lunghem kabolla an kangol ding ham, kum hijat sunga kabol bang banga?” tin sei uvintin asol uve.
en_web: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
en_kjv: and to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
tcz_gospelgo: chule Thempuho le Themgaote chu thu gadonga, “Kum hijat sunga kahinbol jingo, lha nga lhin she le houin kisuhmang jal’a an ngol’a lunghem kabol’u hi kajom nah lai diu ham?’ ti din asol’uve.

tcz: Hiche ahin thanei pen Pakaiyin kajah in thu ahin seijin hitin ati.
en_web: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,
en_kjv: Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kajah a sei thu chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Gamsunga mite jahle thempuho jah a khun hiti hin seijin, nanghon lhanga lhin leh lha sagi teng leh lunghem anbollu khu, hiche kum som-sagi sunga hi keima dinga anngolla nahiuvem?
en_web: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
en_kjv: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
tcz_gospelgo: “Gamsung mite le Thempuho seipeh-in, kum som sagi sunga, lha nga le lha sagi lhinseh le an ngol’a lunghem athoh jui khu, Kei jabolna abol’u ahipoi.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon an naneh uva twi na donteng u-jongleh khun nangho le nangho dia na kineh uva chule nangho le nangho dia na kidon jiu hilou ham?
en_web: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
en_kjv: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
tcz_gospelgo: Aneh-uva adon tengu jongle oiva na dinga nea don ahibouvui,” ati.

tcz: Jerusalem khopia mi achen lai, neile gou thalhin lai akimvel dunga jong khopi tampi aumna lhanglam gamla gammon lai dung jong min achenpha laiya chu hicheng mahi Pakaiyin themgao masaho komma aphondoh sa hilou ham?” tin ati.
en_web: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
en_kjv: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khopi phatthei lai, khosung dimset’a mihem chen lai, khopi kimvel kholen dunga mihem chen dimset, lhanglam le lhumlam thinglhang bul dung geiya mihem chen dimset laiya Themgao masate koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Pakai thupeh chu Zechariah komma ahung lhung in hitin ati.
en_web: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
en_kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Zechriah jah a aseiyin,

tcz: Thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, min asopi kom ah ngailutna leh khotona nei tahin thudih in thu tanhen,
en_web: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
en_kjv: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, And shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
tcz_gospelgo: “Masanglaiyin kamite kaseipeh-in, ‘Thildih bol’uvin, khat le khat khoton kihepi to cheh-un.

tcz: Meithai hihen nuneilou pa neilou hijong leh kholjin hihen mivaicha hijong leh bol genthei hihen chuleh na lungthim in na sopi chunga thilse gel hihen,
en_web: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
en_kjv: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; And let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithai le chagate, nalah-uva cheng gamchom mi, chule koi hile neilel tapou bolse hih-un. Khat le khat kisuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin,’ kati.

tcz: Amahon nathuseiju ngaida uhenlang, nanung ngat’u henlang na thuseiju ajah lou na diuvin akollu sip jong leu,
en_web: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
en_kjv: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, And stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin kamiten lungtah tah-in ajadauvin ahi. Lungkot hong louvin aum’un,

tcz: A lungthi un nanahsah dau henlang danthu jong kihet mosah jongleu themgao masaho komma hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin ana phondoh ija tihih jong leu, hijeh achu hatchungnung Pakaija konna hung deojah jenga ahi.
en_web: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, And the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: Therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: alungthimu songtah-in atahsah-ui. Masang lai Themgaote kama kaseisa thu ho angai loujeh-un kalung hangtai.

tcz: Keiman amaho kakouva eingaipeh lou jeh'un amahon eihin kouteng ujongleh keiman jong kangai peh lou ding,ahi tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en_web: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;
en_kjv: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; So they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:
tcz_gospelgo: Thu kaseipet’a angai loujeh-un, atao tengu jongle kasangpoi.

tcz: Ama hohi ahet khah louvu chitin namtin lah a chimpei banga ka thethang gam ding ahi. Hitia chu agamsung uchu akeo hella kijam ding koi machan ahung vilkhah lou ding ahitan, agam nomtah uchu manlou asodoh sah u ahitai.
en_web: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
en_kjv: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not: Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: For they laid the pleasant land desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisoh thil lhoh bangin abonchauvin gamchom a cheng din kalhoh mangtai. Gam phatah hiche gam hi ahomkeovin akijamin, koimachan chennan aneitapoi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jou chun hatchungnung Pakaija kon in thupeh khat ahung kitnin hitin ati,
en_web: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
en_kjv: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Zion kangailut nahi agil lheh jeng in ahi, Jerusalem ka ngailut nahin eival-lhum jeng in ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, And I was jealous for her with great fury.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamite kakhohsah beh seh, khohsah val jeh a amelmate chunga kalunghan lo nah in Jerusalem kithopi nom jinga um kahi.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keima Zion ah kahung kilekit tai chuleh keima Jerusalema kachen ding ahi, chuteng leh Jerusalem khopi chu kitahna khopi kiti ding ahi, hatchungnung Pakai molchu moltheng kiti ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, And will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: And Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; And the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakhopi theng, Jerusalema hung cheng kit ding kahi. Khopi kitah, Thaneipen Pakai lhang chu lhang theng kiti ding ahi.

tcz: Hichehi hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, tesepu le tehsepi ho Jerusalem lam lhongpia hi mol akiphouva vahlediu khopi ningkoija toukhom diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, And every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei pasal tehse kembet net, tenggol phut’a lamjot ho chu kholai nin gkoi dunga hung tou kit diu ahi.

tcz: Khopi lamlhongpia chu pasal chapang holeh numei chapang ho akichemma dimset diu ahi.
en_web: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
en_kjv: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls Playing in the streets thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholai lemlen dunga kichem ding nu-ngah golhang hung dimset ki tdiu ahi.

tcz: Hichehi hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije tutahin hitiho chu Pathen mite hon lhom chalah-a hin hithei dingin gel ahahsai ahinla hatchungnungpen Pakai dinga ipi ahahsa um ding ham? tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, Should it also be marvellous in my eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hitobang thilsoh ding hi tua amoh cheng na mite lah a hingdoh ho gel din soh dia kilomlou hel ding ahin, Kei didn imacha ahimo poi.

tcz: Hichehi hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei ahi, veovin keiman kamite solamma konle lhumlama konna ka huhdoh ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, And from the west country;
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite min ahen nau gamsunga konin huhdoh ing ting,

tcz: Keiman ainnu Jerusalema lungmong sella kachensah diu ahi. Amahohi kamiteu hiding, chuleh keimahi a Pathenu kahiding thudih tahle kitahna neitah a achung'uva kavaihom ding ahi.
en_web: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”
en_kjv: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God, In truth and in righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema cheng dia niso le nilhum a kona kahinlepui kit ding ahiuve. Kamite hiuvintin, a-Pathenu, kitah le dih tah a chunguva vaihom kahi ding ahi.

tcz: Thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hat inlang na natoh hi tongchai in, hatchungnungpen Pakaiyin aseije, hiche Hou-in hi aleibul akigonna pat in themgao hon in asah chai diu daan ana seisau ahitai.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hanguvin! Ka-Houin sah phatna dia inmun kiset phat laiya themgaote thusei ho ma ma chu najah kit’u ahi.

tcz: Hou-in natoh ahung kipat tilchun natongho thaman ding leh gancha thaman peh ding sum ana umpon, jetle veija galmi ana umjeh in chele vale jong tijat anauma, ajehchu keiman mitinchu kana kidouto sahin ahi.
en_web: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.
en_kjv: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche masang chun mihem hihen gancha hile thalah didng akimujoupoi, melmate masanga hoidoh thei jong ana umpoi. Ken miho chu khat le khat kakisousah-e.

tcz: Tunvang kamite amoh chengse chu tumasanga kabol lou ding ahitai tin hatchungnungpen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en_web: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunvang hiche nam mite lah a ahingdoh chengse hi lamchonbeh-in kaboltai.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman nangho lah a chamdella phattheina muchi kitu tan ahi. Lengpithei hung gaphat in leiset in anche louhing hin sepdoh intin chuleh vanna konin daitwi hungneng ding ahitai. Hitichun keiman Judah le Israel amoh chengse chu phatthei bohna gou kalosah ding ahi.
en_web: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
en_kjv: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Chamle lung mongin vaikon’untin, alengpiguiyu gatheiya, leiset’in muchi chivo asemdoh ding, gotwi nengsel sing ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengse vangbohna hijatpi hikapeh ding ahi.

tcz: Namdang laha Judah le Israel chu sapset changmi kana hisah ahi. Ahinla hichu hita lou ding, tuahi keiman nanghohi kahuhdoh a phatthei konna nam mite kahisah diu ahi. Hijeh chun kicha hih in, hat in lang Hou-in sahphat kitna natohchu pantan.
en_web: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Juddah le Israel mite! Malaiyin gamchom mite khat le khat akigaosap’un,’Hitobang hamsetna Judah le Israel lhunkhum hin nang jong lhun khum hen!’ akitiuve. Ahivangin nahuhhing ung ting, hiche gamchom mite chu khat le khat,’Judah le Israel chunga lhung vangbohna cheng nang jong changing,’ kiti diu ahi. Hijeh chun hangtah-in pangun, kicha hih hel’un,” ati.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche hi hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei ahi. Napu napateu vin eina phin lunghang jeh in nangho chu kana engbol nahiuve.
en_web: For the LORD of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,
en_kjv: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Napu napateuvin eiphin lung hang phat’un, sumang din kagon, khelchom louvin kasumangtai.

tcz: Tunvang Judah mipite leh Jerusalem phattheiboh dinga gel lhuhna kanei ahitai. Hijeh chun kicha hih in,
en_web: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.
en_kjv: so again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang Jerusalem le Judah mite vang boh kagot ahi. Hijeh chun kicha hih-un.

tcz: Ahinla nangin hichehi na bol tei ding ahi. Khat le khat thutah kiseipeh touvin, chamna umdoh theina dingin thudih in thutan-un.
en_web: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,
en_kjv: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga hi naum diu ahi: Khat le khat thutah-in kihouvun. Thutanna phunga thudih mong mong, cham len theina seiyun.

tcz: Lunggel dihlouvin kichangto hih-un, thutah'a na kihahsel na petchah in lang jouleh nal seija na kipehna su tang jong in,
en_web: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: and let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Khat le khat susuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin. Jouvin kihahsel dauvin. Jousei le thudihlou, pumhat kahoi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche ahin hatchungnung Pakaija kon thupeh khat ahung lhung kitne,
en_web: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
en_kjv: And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye;

tcz: Hichehi hatchungnung Pakaija konna thupeh ahi. Lhali lhinna a na an-ngolna lha-nga channa a na-angolna a, lhasagi lhinna a na an-ngolna chuleh lhasom lhinna a na an-ngolna hochu Juda mipite dinga thanop nale kipana chuleh haldohna an-ngol hihen. Hijehchun thutahle chamna chu kolchah un,
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lha li, lha nga, lha sagi, chule lha som lhin na an ngol kibolji ho hi Judah mite dia kipa thanopna kut akiheidoh ding ahi. Thudih le chamna khohsah-uvin,” ati.

tcz: Hichehi hatchungnung Pathen in aseije, vannoi leiset khopia kon in chitin namtin mipite Jerusalema hung vahlut diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, And the inhabitants of many cities:
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakayin aseiyin, “khopi tina miten Jerusalem ahinjotna diu phat ahung lhunge.

tcz: Khopi khatna mite chun khopi khatna mite kom ah hungun Pakai phattheiboh thumdingin Jerusalema cheute atidiu ahi. Hatchungnung Pakai hou ding in cheute ati diu ahi keivang kakipattai, ati.
en_web: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies. I will go also.’
en_kjv: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, And to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi khat’a hung kon hon khopi choma hung kon ho jah a, ‘Thaneipen Pakai xhibai boh a ahenga vang thum ding kahiuve. Hungin kilhonute,’ ati diu ahi.

tcz: Mitamtah leh thaneitah nam miteho chu Jerusalema hung uvintin hatching nung Pakai phatthei bohna ahung thumdiu ahi.
en_web: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD.”
en_kjv: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come To seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, And to pray before the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin a mi, nam hunei tah tah ho thaneipen Pakai chibai boh dia Jerusalema hung diu, ahenga vang athum diu ahi.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Hiche nikho teng chuleh vannoi leiset a chitin namtin pao tintang a kon in michom chom somlekhat chengin hung uvintin Judah mikhat ponmang tuh uvintin, lungset tah in neikilhon piuvin ajehchu nangho hi Pathen nin na umpi uve tin kaja uve ati ding’u ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, Even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule gamchom mi som jen Judah mi khatseh koma hunguva, ‘Patheninnaumpiu kajauvin, Najotna mun’uva din kihon jengute,’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche hi Pakaija konna Ram gamleh Damascus khopi demna in Pakai thupeh ahung lhung in ahi. Ajeh chu Israel phungho leh mitin vaipi mitnin Pakai lambou ave tauvin ahi.
en_web: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—
en_kjv: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, And Damascus shall be the rest thereof: When the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi: Hadrach gamsung le Damasus khopi talen man din akoitai. Israelte khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi jong Paakiya ahibouve.

tcz: Damascus komma um Hanath leh Tyre le Sidon khopiho achih lheh vangun mahthah teidiu ahi.
en_web: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
en_kjv: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
tcz_gospelgo: Hadrach to kigamgi Hamth jong Pakaiya ahin, Tyre le Sidon chule athepna chengseu jong Pakaiya ahi.

tcz: Tyre hin galdouna phatah nei jong leh sana le dangka lamlenna vutvai bahsah jeng jongleu,
en_web: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
en_kjv: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, And heaped up silver as the dust, And fine gold as the mire of the streets.
tcz_gospelgo: Tyre hin kulpi akisemin, dangka sana ahao behseh-in imalou bangin aumtai!

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Tyre neilegou jouse achomkhom in twikhanglen'ah asep lhatan chuleh meiyin akahlhah ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
en_kjv: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, And he will smite her power in the sea; And she shall be devoured with fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla anei chasun Pakiyin alah mangpeh ding ahi. Anei agou jouse Twikhanglen a leh lut’intin, akhopi kavamhel ding ahi.

tcz: Ashkelon khopi hin Tyre a suhlhuh ding chuleh lungkhamna dimset ding ahi. Gaza tijatnan lodim intin, Ekron kinepna hung beiding Gaza lengpa hung kithat intin, Askelon a koima hung cheng lou ding ahi.
en_web: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
en_kjv: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, And Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; And the king shall perish from Gaza, And Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thilsoh hi Ashkelon khopin amudoh teng tija ding ahi. Gaza khopin mudoh-intin, a thoh lel lheh ding ahi. Ekron khopi jong chute ding, akinepna chengse beisoh ding ahi. Gaza lengpa thi ding, Ashkelon khopi ahomkeova um ding,

tcz: Ashdod khopi gam chom in ahin lodim ding keiman Palistine kiletsahna kasuh ding ahi.
en_web: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
en_kjv: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
tcz_gospelgo: Ashdod khopi jong nam choplop hung chengkhom diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche Philistine mi kiletsahte hi kasuhnem ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman akamsunga konna thisan dim atahsa phechu kaloidoh pehding chuleh ahakah uva konna kidah um pumgo thiltosa aneh hochu akamma konna ka loidoh peh ding ahi. Chu jong leh Philistine ahing doh hochun a Pathennu hinhou untin Judah phungkhat toh hung bang diu ahi. Ekron Philistine ten kamite hinjop untin Jubusite khatvei ana bol tobanga chu abol diu ahi.
en_web: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
en_kjv: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, And his abominations from between his teeth: But he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, And he shall be as a governor in Judah, And Ekron as a Jebusite.
tcz_gospelgo: Sa jong thisan puma aneh lou diu, nehmo ho jong aneh da diu ahi. Ahingdoh amoh cheng chu kamite lah a kisimtha a, Judah phungbah khat banga um diu ahi. Ekron jong, Jebua mite banga kamite to kisimtha diu ahitai.

tcz: Keiman ka Hou-in kaven tup jing ding chuleh agalmiteu a konna kahuhdoh ding, chuleh gamdang miten agam sungu ahin lonvuh louna diuva kavetsui ding ahi.
en_web: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
en_kjv: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, Because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: And no oppressor shall pass through them any more: For now have I seen with mine eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Kagamsung ki-ngang ting, sepaite kajotpa sah lou ding ahi. Vaipo giloute kamite bol gentheisah ponge. Itobanga kamiten ganthei hesoh athoh kamudoh tai,” ati.

tcz: Kipah-un O Zion mite, vo Jerusalem mipite galjona samphong un, Ven nalengpa chu ahunge, Amahi thudih le galjoupa ahi, ahinla amahi sangan nou chunga hungtou minunnemtah ahi.
en_web: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
en_kjv: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: Behold, thy King cometh unto thee: He is just, and having salvation; Lowly, and riding upon an ass, And upon a colt the foal of an ass.
tcz_gospelgo: VO Zion chate, hachangpan kipah-un! Kipah-in khosam’un, Jerusalem mite! Ven, nalengpau ahunge! Galjo minthangin ahungin; Nun nemtah-in sa-ngan chunga touvin, Sa-ngan nou lagol chunga touvin ahung!

tcz: Keiman Israel a konna galsatna sakol kangchu kalah doh ding chuleh Jerusalema konna galsatna sakol hochu kalah doh ding ahi. Keiman galmun na konna galmanchah hochu ka suhmang ding chuleh na lengpau chun chitin namtin lah a chamna ahinpohlut ding alenggam in twikhanglen langkhat a konna twikhanglen langkhat Eupharates vadunga konna leiset kolmang geija kijesal ding ahi.
en_web: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
en_kjv: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, And the horse from Jerusalem, And the battle bow shall be cut off: And he shall speak peace unto the heathen: And his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, And from the river even to the ends of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Israelte galsatna kangtalai jouse sumang ing ting, Jerusalema sakolte kakai mang ding; Galmuna manchah thlpi kaheboh doh ding ahi. Nalengpauvin namtin vaipia chamna semintin, Twikhanglen lang khat’a pat langkhat geiya vai ahoma, Euphrates luipia pat leiset mong geiya vai ahom didng ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nangho toh thisanna kimankhum kakitepna joh achu twi gotna kotong a konna na sohchang teu chu kalha doh ding ahi.
en_web: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
en_kjv: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kilhaina thisan a mohor namkhumsa Eikitepnau jal’a, Namiteu chamlhatsah ing ting, Twi beina sohchanna muna ongthonl diu ahi.

tcz: Na hoidoh nading munnah hung kilekit tan, kinepna neinalai sohchang ho nathoh gimnau khat cheh chunga chu phatthei bohna ajatnia kale thuhding nahiuve.
en_web: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
en_kjv: Turn ye to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Sohchang kinem jing ho, hung kile kit’un; Nalungmonna mun hinjon’uvin! Nathohgim nau jat nia vangboh dia Tua hi kateppeh nahitauve!

tcz: Judah hi kathalpi, Israel hi kathalchang chuleh Jerusalem hi ka chemjam nahiuve, galhatpa banga keiman Greekte douna kamanchah ding nahiuve.
en_web: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
en_kjv: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, And raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, And made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah hi sepai Thalpin mang ing ting, Isdrael hi Thalchanga Kaman ding ahi. Zion mite chamjam banga kaman’a, Greek mite satna kanei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakai chu namite chunga hung kilangding athalpi chu kolphe banga hung lengding, lalchung nung Pakai chun sumkon ahin mutna lhanglam neldi gamma chimpei banga gal ahinsat ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall be seen over them, And his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: And the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, And shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai amite chungvuma kitahdoh-intin, Athalchang kolphe banga alensah ding; Hatchungnung Pakaiyin sumkon mut’in tin, Lhanglama pat go le huipia hung kitol ding ahi.

tcz: Hatchung nung Pakai chun amite ahin huhdoh ding, amahon song lentahtah a ahinseuva gal ajo diu amaho chun jukham banga asapthodiu gal ajodiu ahi. Maicham chunga kithe khum thisan alon banga agalmiteu thisan alondoh sah diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
en_kjv: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, And subdue with sling stones; And they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; And they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin amite ngah-intin, Amahon amelmateu asuhgam diu ahi. Galmuna jukhan pen-ohjen jun banguntin, Amelmateu thisan alonsah diu; Kilhaina gan thisan long banga, Maicham phunga khona kisunglha bang ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheni chuleh Pakaiyin kelngoi chingpan amite ahuh doh banga amite ahuhdoh ding amaho chu lallukhuh kijapna song vahhoi banga gamsunga chu vahdoh diu ahi.
en_web: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
en_kjv: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: For they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho hi haung lhun teng. Pakaiyin amite ahuhhing ding; Kelngoi chingpan akelngoite Thidingsa ahuhdoh bang ding ahi. Lallukhuh a sum-eng pah banga Agamsunga vah jing diu ahitai.

tcz: Amaho chu iti kidanna iti hoiya hoi hitauvem? Gollhang hochu chaang nengchatna kivahthao diu, nungah hochu lengpithei thuha kivahthao diu ahi.
en_web: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
en_kjv: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung phat ding le hoi ding je chu! Cahngle lengpitwi vanga khangdong thahat diu ahi.

tcz: Pakaija kon in chavang laileh gotwi thum'un, ajehchu Amahi huipi leh twipi chule meilhang sempa ahi. Aman gohong hinjuh lhahsah intin loujaova anche louhing phattheina chamkim chang diu ahi.
en_web: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
en_kjv: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; So the Lord shall make bright clouds, And give them showers of rain, To every one grass in the field.
tcz_gospelgo: Chavang laiya go juhna din Pakaiyin taovun! Mei kaisah, dai lhahsah chule go juhsah Pakai ahin, mitin dia louma phatsah Amabou ahi.

tcz: Insung semthu Pathen hon thu dih lou asei uva, vangsang hon thudih lou ngen aphon doh jiuvin koima akipasah thei pouve. Hijeh chun kamite kelngoi hon bangin amahthah ji tauve, kelngoi ching aum loujeh in boina atohji tauve.
en_web: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
en_kjv: For the idols have spoken vanity, And the diviners have seen a lie, And have told false dreams; They comfort in vain: Therefore they went their way as a flock, They were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon doi asan’un, phunsan ho pou adongun, jouthu le ngol thubuh bou akimu’ve. Abang bangin mang aleuvin, lam hilou lama napuitauve; nalhamon nau jong pannabei ahi. Hijeh chun mipi hi kelngoi mangsa bangin suhna ding helouvin avah le leuve. Lamkai beiyin hesoh genthei athoh tauve.

tcz: Na kelngoi chingte chunga kalung hanna adeo jah jenge, keiman ama hohi ka-engbol ding ahi. Ajeh chu hatchungnung Pakaichu amite Judah panhu ding in ahung lhung tai. Aman amaho chu galsatna sakol hattah banga atun let ding ahi.
en_web: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
en_kjv: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, And I punished the goats: For the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, And hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kamite chunga vaipo gamchom miho chunga kalung hange, amaho khu talen kamatsah ding ahi. Jusahte kami ahin, Kei-thaneipen Pakaiyin kivet tep nange. Galsatna sakol hattah banga kanei ding ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho’a kon a hi in-ning songpia hung pang ding alah uva ponbuh kihenna leh akikhaina hung umdoh a, alah uva konna gal kapna thalchang hung lengdoh ding, Vaihomma pang ding jouse jong alah uva hung peng doh ding ahibouve.
en_web: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
en_kjv: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, Out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite chunga vaipo ding alah-uva vaihom le lamkai, sepai lamkai sing hung pengsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho hi galmunna galmunna galsat hattah tobang diu agalmiteu akengto uva achotpha diu ahi. Ajehchu agalsat nauva Pakaiyin aumpi diu ahi. Sakol tou themho geija ajosah ding ahi.
en_web: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.
en_kjv: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies In the mire of the streets in the battle: And they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, And the riders on horses shall be confounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Kholai dunga amelmateu bon-ngan lah a chil thang thang sepaite banga Judah miten gal ajo diu ahi. Pakaiyin apanpi jeh-uva gal asat diu, melma sakol touthem ho geiya ajo diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman Judah kahatdoh sah a Israel ka huhdoh ahi, amaho hi kakhotona jeh a kaki ledoh sah ding keiman kana paidoh khah lou hel banga kabol ding ahi, ajehchu Pakai keima hi atao na’u ngaija a Pathen u ka hi ding ahi.
en_web: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.
en_kjv: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph, And I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: And they shall be as though I had not cast them off: For I am the Lord their God, and will hear them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Judahte hatsah ing ting, Israelte kahuhdoh ding ahi. Abonchauvin voujang natping ting, In a kahinlepui doh kei ding ahiuve. Kapaidoh khah louhel bang diu, Pakai a-Pathenu kahi, atao nau sang inge.

tcz: Israel mitechu galsat hattah bang diu, lengpitwi in akipasah bang uva alung thimma kipah ding achilhah teuvin jong hichu amu uva kipahdiu alungsung uva Pakaija haldohdiu ahi.
en_web: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.
en_kjv: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, And their heart shall rejoice as through wine: Yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; Their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Israel sepai hattah bang diu, Lengpitwi donchima kipah ho bang diu ahi. Hiche agaljo’u hi ason apah-un geljingun tin, Pakai thilbol hi akipapi diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman kakouteng leh amaho hunglhaitho jeng diu ahi, ajeh chu keiman amaho chu dalhah lhonho lah a konna kalhat dohsa ahitauve, amaho tumasang bang banga pung kit diu ahi.
en_web: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.
en_kjv: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: And they shall increase as they have increased.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kamite kakoukhom ding, Huhdoh ing ting angaiya katamsah didng ahi.

tcz: Keiman chitin namtin lah a muchi kithe banga kana thethang gam vanga amahon mun gamla tah a konna eihin het doh diu ahi. Amahole achilhah te’u hingdoh ding Israel gamma hung kile kit diu ahi.
en_web: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.
en_kjv: And I will sow them among the people: And they shall remember me in far countries; And they shall live with their children, and turn again.
tcz_gospelgo: Namtin vaipi lah a thecheh jong leng, Gamla tah a kona eigeldoh diu ahi. Amaho le achateu ahingdoh cheng, In a hung kile kit diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman Egypt gamle Assyria a konna amaho chu kahin lepui doh’a agamsung cheh uva ka chen khom sah ding, mi adim letset tokah a amaho hi Gilead leh Lebanon gamsunga ka chenlut sah cheh ding ahi
en_web: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
en_kjv: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, And gather them out of Assyria; And I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; And place shall not be found for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt le Assyria kona In a kahinpui ding, Agamsunguva kachensah ding ahi. Gilead gam le Lebanon a chensah ing ting, Gamsung pumpi midim ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho dinga twikhanglen kakilenou sah a hahsatna twikhanglenna konna chu kapui galkaija Nile vadung chu kakansah ding Assyria te thupina kasuhchip sing chuteng Egypt te vaipohna kichaiding ahi.
en_web: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
en_kjv: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, And shall smite the waves in the sea, And all the deeps of the river shall dry up: And the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, And the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
tcz_gospelgo: Gim hesohna Twikhanglen kinong bangin jot’u jongle, Kei-Pakaiyin twi kinonglai kaphothip ding ahi. Nile lithuh geiya kansah a, Assyria hoitho tah nemlhan tin, Egypt hunei tah jong thabeiya um ding ahi.

tcz: Katha hanta kamite kahatdoh sahding chuleh kathuneina jal'a avalena nun nom uva vahle diu ahi tin Pakai keiman thu kaseitai ati.
en_web: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
en_kjv: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; And they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamite hatsah ing ting, Chibai boh a kathua nung diu ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin asei ahitai.

tcz: Vo Lebanon nakot jouse honglen in chuleh na Cedar thing jouse mei kahlhahsah tan,
en_web: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
en_kjv: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Lebanon, cedar thing jouse halvamna din Nakotpi chengse hongdoh loiyin!

tcz: Vo chahthingho, Cedar thing alhuhgam jeh in kapmin ajeh chu thing thupitah tahho alhu gam tauve. Kap uvin Bashan gangpi phungho ajeh chu gammang thingphung bitchah ho akisa tlha gam tai.
en_web: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.
en_kjv: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: Howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
tcz_gospelgo: Kap’in maovin, thinggi jouse le Cedar thing ho alhusoh tai; Thing minthangtah tah ho asugamtauve. Bashan phaiya gangpi thing hokap’in maovun! Gammang thimlai atuchaitauve.

tcz: Kelngoi chingho kale penkhu ngaijun, ajehchu agam phalai chengseu akisumang gamtai. Keipinou ho ham ngaijun, ajehchu Jordan phaicham thing jouse agam hel tai.
en_web: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
en_kjv: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: A voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaipote lunghemin akap’ui, aloupi nau amangtai; Sekeie kisen ginpi khu ngaiyun; Achen nau gammang lai Jordan pang atuchaitauve!

tcz: Pakai Pathen in hitin aseije: “cheuvin, thadinga kigong gancha hokhu gaching tan.
en_web: The LORD my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
en_kjv: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ka-Pathenin kajah a, “Thangam dia kikoi kelngoi hon chingpa bangin umin.

tcz: Achohon khohsahlou hellin kelngoite athat gamtauve. Ajoh hochun Pathen thangvah in umhen, ajeh chu keihi ka haotave kelngoiching ho jeng in jong khotona anei pouve.
en_web: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.
en_kjv: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: And their own shepherds pity them not.
tcz_gospelgo: Aneihon kelngoite thatgam’untin, talen man louva umdiu ahi. Asa kijoh-untin, ‘Vahchoiyun Pakai, ihaodoh tauve!’ tiuvinte. Kelngoi chingho jengin jong adipdappi pouve,” ati.

tcz: Hitobanga chu kenjong agamsunga chengho chunga khotona kaneilouding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla keiman amahochu aheng akomteu le alengteu khutna kapehdoh ding, amahon agam uchu asuhgam diu, ahinla keiman kahuhdoh loudiu ahi.
en_web: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says the LORD; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”
en_kjv: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: But lo, I will deliver the men Every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: And they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Leiset mi khat cha jong khoto taponge. Mihemho hi achunguva vaipote noiya kalutsah ding ahi. Hiche vaipoe hin leiset sugamhel’untin, akhut’uva konin chu-lha ponge,” ati.

tcz: Chuteng keiman thadinga kigong suhgentheija um ganchaho chu ka vesuijin ahi. Hijouchun kelngoi chingho mol chu ni kachoijin, khatchu ngailutna ahin, khatchu kipumkhatna ahi.
en_web: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.
en_kjv: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi choa joh hon eithalah-un, thadia kikoi kelngoite kachinge. Tenggol ni kalan, khat chu, “Deichom,” katin, khat chu, “Kipumkhatna,” kati Chuin kelngoi hon kachinge.

tcz: Keiman kelngoi ching miphalou thumchu lhakhat sung in ka sumang in ahi. Keima hiche kelngoi chinhi ka chim tan chuleh amaho jong achim tauvin ahi.
en_web: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
en_kjv: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi chingma ma midang thum, eiho jing chunga kalung hangjah-in, lha khat sungin athum’un kasumangtai.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman kasei jin, keima nangho kelngoiching hita ponge, na thiule thitauvin, min nathau jongleh nathat tauvinte chule ahing nalai hochu khat le khat kithat to jing un katin ahi.
en_web: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”
en_kjv: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kelngoihon jah a, “Ken naching tapouvinge. Athi thi ding kithi hen. Suhgam ding ding kisugam hen. Amoh ahing cheng jong khat le khat kisumangu hen,” kati.

tcz: Hichun Keiman ngailut kiti ka mol pachu kalan bohni kason hichun keiman chitin namtoh kinoptona kana sem chu kasuhbei ahitai ti vetsahna a kabol ahi.
en_web: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
en_kjv: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin “Deichom,” kisah tenggol chu kalan, Pakaiyin namtin vaipi to akitepna suhkehna din kahehbongtai,

tcz: Hichu amaho toh kikinoptona achaina ahitai. Gancha hon lengvai hochun keima eive uvin,hichehi Pakaiyin anatoh a thu asei ahitai etiuve.
en_web: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD’s word.
en_kjv: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin hiche nikho hin kitepna chu akisuhkeh tai. Kelngoi choa le joh hon eive lhi jingun, kathilbol chu Pakaiyin thuseina anei ahe jingui.

tcz: Hichun keiman akom uva kaseijin, na deijun nalung lhaina’u ahileh kathaman neipeuvin nalungu ahilouleh haijun kati. Hichun amahon katahman ding in dangka somthum eipeuve.
en_web: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
en_kjv: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken ajah-uva, “Nanop’u le katohman neipeuvin, nadaule kikoitauvin,” kati. Hijeh chun katohman din dangka somthum eipeuve.

tcz: Pakaiyin kakom ah hitin aseije. Hiche sum thupitah keima mankham bep dinga eikipe chu Pakai houin sum kholna-a chun lehluttan eiti. Hichun keiman jong dangka somthum chu kalan Pakai houin sumkholna munna chun kalehluttan ahi.
en_web: The LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD’s house.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Sum chu Houin goukholnaa koiyin,” eiti. Hijeh chun sum dangka somthum hi-manlu tah a agel’u chu-Houin goukholnaa kakoitai.

tcz: Chujouvin kamol khatpa kipumkhatna chu kalan bohni kason Judah leh Israel kipumkhatna chu akehtai ti kavetsahna ahitai.
en_web: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
en_kjv: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin tenggol nina, “Kipumkhatna,” kiti chu kahehbongin, Judah le Israel kipumkhatna akehtai.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin ka komma hitin aseije: “chenlang kelngoi ching phachom lou pan mun khu galo tan eiti.
en_web: The LORD said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingin pang kit’in, tua napan vang hi pannabeiya napan ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche hin avetsah chu keiman hiche nammite hi akelngoi teu athi amang umjongleh khohsahlou anousenho jong ka simlou adamlou jong jen nom lou adamthei hojong vah nomlou kelngoi ching phachomlou khat kapeh diu ahi” ati. Chuche tai louvin jong hiche kelngoi chingpa chun akelngoi thaopen pen hochu atin teni kikah geija abottel a anehjeng ding ahi.
en_web: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.
en_kjv: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, Which shall not visit those that be cut off, Neither shall seek the young one, Nor heal that that is broken, Nor feed that that standeth still: But he shall eat the flesh of the fat, And tear their claws in pieces.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat kakelngoite ching din kakoiyin, ahivangin aman mangthah goa kelngoite akithopi poi; amangla ahol pon, mapu jong aboldam poi; ahing cheng jeng jong avahva pon ahi. Athao lai lai akithan, atin kikah abottel kelngoi chingpa chu adana-e! Kelngoi hon adalhatai! Athaneina gal’in asuhbei hel ding, aban tha ngoiya, amitchang jetlem cho ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ohe! Kelngoi ching phachom lou ho, kelngoi hon dalhaho! Chemjamin abanjang asat tanpeh ding chuleh amitchang jetlang kikheudoh pehding, abangjong chu pannabei hiding, ajetlang mitchu chodel jeng ding ahi.
en_web: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
en_kjv: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! The sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: His arm shall be clean dried up, And his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

tcz: Israelte khankho ding chungchang a thuthot Pakaija konna hung chu hichehi ahi. Hichehi vanho hingoltoh a, leiset bulpi hinphutdoh, chuleh mihem sunga Lhangao hin khumpeh a Pakaija konna thuthot chu ahi.
en_web: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:
en_kjv: The burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, Which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, And formeth the spirit of man within him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hinsah a, Leiset semdoh, vanthamjol jaldoh Pakai, hiche Pakaiyin Israel thudol asei chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Veuvin Keiman Jerusalem kahin semding chu, avella hon Judah le Jerusalem ahin delkhum tenguleh jukham banga thabeija lamlele diu ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, When they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: “Jerusalem hi judonna khon tobanga kasemdoh ding ahi; akimvel’a namtin vaipin don’un tin, jukham banga lonle le siu ahi. Jerusalem khopi aumchah tengu, Judah gamsung khopi dang jouse jong min aumchah ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheni lechun ken Jerusalem hi songpi banga suhling hoi hilou kahisah ding, avella chitin namtin hon ahung kichop khumuva ahin delkhum teng uleh amaho le amaho kisuhkhahna hung hilo bep ding ahi
en_web: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.
en_kjv: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: All that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, Though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, Jerusalem hi songtum gihtah kabahsah a, dopkhang dia doa nammite chu kisanchat diu, vannoi namtin vaipi kithouva adel khum didu ahi.

tcz: Hicheni chuleh Pakaiyin ahi tin aseije: “Keiman asakollu kakichat sah ding chuleh achunga touho tijat na a ka hotling gam diu ahi. Keiman Juda mipite ka hin ang-ngat ding chuleh agalmiteu sakol mit kahin chotsah ding ahi.
en_web: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
en_kjv: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: And I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, And will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule asakolteu hoh kin ing ting, achunga toute ka-ngolsah soh didng ahi. Judahte vetup ing ting, amelmateu sakolte mit kachotsah ding ahi.

tcz: Chujong leh Judah phung mite amahole amaho kihou lim untin Jerusalem mipiten a Pathen-u hatchungnung Pakai thahatna change ahitauve ati dingu ahi.
en_web: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’
en_kjv: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength In the Lord of hosts their God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah le Judah phunga miten, ‘Jerusalema cheng Thaneipen Pakai Pathenin amite thahat apei,’ ati diu ahi.

tcz: Hicheni chuleh keiman Judah phung hochu thingkho koudohsah mei, ahilou leh chang phellhah a kolphe thaomei kivah kabahsah ding, amahon ajet avei uva cheng nammite ahallhah ding Jerusalem cheng mipi vang chu lungmonga cheng diu ahi.
en_web: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.
en_kjv: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like a hearth of fire among the wood, And like a torch of fire in a sheaf; And they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: “HIteng chule Judah phunga mite hi gamkang le changkung go lah a kihal meikou kabahsah a, akinel’a namtin vaipi asuhgam ding ahi. Jerusalem kho mite vang khosunga lung monga cheng diu ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin Judah phung amoh chengse chu galjona apeh masatding ajeh chu Jerusalem mipite leh David sonlepahte hin Judah phung amoh ho sanga hi loupina amudeh lou ding ahi.
en_web: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
en_kjv: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, That the glory of the house of David And the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem Do not magnify themselves against Judah.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei-Pakaiyin amasaa Judah sepaite gal kajosah a, David son le pah, chule Jerusalem sn lom jabolna chu, Judah gamsung san ding sanga thupijo deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheni lechun Pakaiyin Jerusalem mipite ahuhdoh ding, alah uva alhasam pen jeng jong leng David banga hatdiu chuleh David sonhochu Pathen toh bangding, amasang sang uva che Pakai vantil to bangdiu ahi.
en_web: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.
en_kjv: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; And he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; And the house of David shall be as God, As the angel of the Lord before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengle Jerusalema chengte Pakaiyin ngah-intin, alah-uva lhasampen jong David hat’a hat ding ahi. David chilhahten miho chu Pakai vantil, Pathen tah tah banga alamkai diu ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu hiche nile hin Jerusalem doudinga hung chitin namtin jouse chu ka suh mang ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will seek to destroy all the nations That come against Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Jerusalem delkhum dia kigo namtin vaipi koi hile kasuhmang ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche jouteng chuleh taona le ngailuitna lhagao chu David insungah Jerusalem mipite chunga kabuhlhah ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh asutpau keima chu eimu diu, min achapa khatseh chunga alunghom bang uva alunghom pidiu. Min achapa masapen athia alungnatpi banga alungnatpi diu ahi,
en_web: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.
en_kjv: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, The spirit of grace and of supplications: And they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, And they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, And shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
tcz_gospelgo: “David chilhahte le Jerusalema cheng midang ho jong hepina le taona Lhagao kasipsoh ding ahi. Mihem asutlihoh chu veuvintin, cha khatseh thijal’a laina tah a kap ho banga alainatpi diu ahi. Chapa peng masapen thi jal’a kap ho bangin lhase tah-in kap’unte.

tcz: Hichenia Jerusalema lungkham nale lung hemna chu Maggido phaichama Haddad-rimmon lungkhamna nasatah chu toh bang ding ahi.
en_web: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.
en_kjv: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, As the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule Jerusalem lunghem ka le mao chu, Migiddo phaiya Hadadrimmon dia lunghema kap ho kagin husa bang ding ahi.

tcz: Israel pumpi lungkhamna chu ama phung changcheh lungkhamna hiding chuleh jipa chengin ajinu chengutoh akikhenniu tobang hidiu ahi. David phungin achangin lungkhampin tin, Nathan phungin jong alungkham piding,
en_web: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
en_kjv: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; The family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; The family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung miten a-inko koa pul adou didu, David insungin a-insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon pul adou diu; Nathan insungin Nathan insungpul adouva, numeihon jong adou diu;

tcz: Hitia chu Levi phung jong chule Shimi phungjong chute ding ahi,
en_web: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
en_kjv: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; The family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
tcz_gospelgo: Levi insungin jong Levi insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu; Shimei insungin jong Shimei insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu:

tcz: Judah phung sunga ahing doh hoa konna hi achu atumma lungkham diu, chuleh ajipateu ajinu cheh-u toh akikhen niu lungkhamna hi ding ahi.
en_web: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
en_kjv: All the families that remain, Every family apart, and their wives apart.
tcz_gospelgo: insung dang dangin jong hitobanga hi ainsung cheh-u pul adouvuva, anumeiteuvin jong pul adou cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikhoteng chuleh David insung mite dingleh Jerusalem mipite ding in twinah khat kihongdoh intin, hiche twinah chun achonset nau leh athem lounaova konna asoptheng diu ahi
en_web: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
en_kjv: In that day there shall be a fountain opened To the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem For sin and for uncleanness.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, David chilhahte le Jerusalem mite chonset le doi houva kona sop theng dia twsam hung put ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh nahouvu semthu Pathen hohi amin-u kisan ana suhmil sohhel theina diuva gamsung pumpia semthu Pathen hojouse hi kasuh mang sohkei ding ahi. Chuleh lhangao boh vop themgao lhemho jong hiche gamma konna kadel doh ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, That I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, And they shall no more be remembered: And also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng gamsunga milimdoi min him him kaphahpoh sah lou ding ahitai. Ki-Themgaosah ho kasuhmanga, milimdoi hou nomna kasuhamng ding ahi.

tcz: Koitabang hamkhatnin gaothusei chu ajomma ahileh ahinga anu apa tahin nangin Pakai minna jouthu naseidoh jeh'in nathi teitei ding ahi tia aseipeh ding chuleh hitia chu asei teitei leh ahinga anule apa tah in chemma asutlih ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in the LORD’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, Then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; For thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord: And his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaothu seitei tei aumle, Pakai thu seiya kigel’a, ou jeng seipan atilo tei ding chu anule apan aseipeh ding ahi. Gaothu aseipet tah a anule apan asutlih jeng ding ahi.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh themgao ho jousen gao thudihlou asei uchu jachat piuvin tin, themgao vonjong vonngam tapouvintin, themgao tiajong kisei ngamta pouvinte.
en_web: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; Neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule mu nei Themgaovin ahoithopi lou ding, themgao umchan thoa, mipi lhep lhahna dia Themgao von jong avon lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chujongleh keima themgao kahipoi, loubolmi kahibouve kaneo a patna lou hinlhou kahi bouve atidiu ahi.
en_web: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’
en_kjv: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am a husbandman; For man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hisanga chu, ‘Themgao kahipoi, loubol mi, kahinkhoa lou natong kahibouvin, ‘Na-op le natungtuna mapon ho chu ipijeh ham?’ tia adoh khah le; ‘Kagol kapaite in a eivohnau ahibouve,’ ti hen,” ati.

tcz: Khat touvin ahileh naop achu ipi maha baham atiuleh aman kagol kapaiho in na eimavonau ahi atiding ahi.
en_web: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’
en_kjv: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

tcz: “Thoudoh in Vo Chemjam kakelngoi chingpa leh katohkhom pipa douna ding in tin hatchungnungpen Pakaiyin aseije. Kelngoi chingpa chu sat lhun, akelngoi hochu jam cheh nauvinte chuteng keiman kelngoiho chunga kakhutlam nange ati.
en_web: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says the LORD of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
en_kjv: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, Saith the Lord of hosts: Smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: And I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo chemjam, thouvin kakelngoi chingpa delkhumin. Thet’in, kelngoite kithe cheh nante. Kamite delkhum ing ting,

tcz: Hitichun gamsunga mipate chu hopthuma hopni kithat gam ding hopkhat chu gamsung a hi kidalhadiu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: It shall happen that in all the land,” says the LORD, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, Two parts therein shall be cut off and die; But the third shall be left therein.
tcz_gospelgo: gamsung mi hop thuma hop ni thigam diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman hicheng chu meilah a kon in puidoh ingting kasuhtheng ding ahi. keiman dangka bangin sutheng in ting sana banga kalhit theng ding ahi. Amahon kaminna eihin koudiu chujong leh ka hou ding ahi. Keiman amahohi kamite ahi kati ding ahin amahon Amahi Pakai le ka Pathen ahi atidiu ahi” ati.
en_web: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’”
en_kjv: And I will bring the third part through the fire, And will refine them as silver is refined, And will try them as gold is tried: They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: And they shall say, The Lord is my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng hop khat hingdoh chengchu, meiya dangka kilhatheng bangin, sutheng inge. Sana kipatep bangin patep ing ting, chuteng kahenga hung tao diu, ataonau kasan ding ahi. Kamite ahiu seipeh ing ting, a-Pathenu kahi phongdoh tauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Chingthei jun, ajehchu Pakaigam hunglhung ding ahi, hiche nikho lechun na-angsung tah uva min nathil nalo’u achom ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.
en_kjv: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, And thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupi tannaa Pakai touna ding nikho anaitai. Chuteng Jerusalem khopi min chomgamintin, namit mu tah a thil chomdoh kihom diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman Jerusalem satdinga chitin namtin kakhop ding, khopi hi alah diu, ima jouse hi achom diu, numeiho asuhset diu, mipi akehkhat galhinga kiman ding, chuleh amoh chengse chu khopi sunga kidalha ding ahiuve.
en_web: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
en_kjv: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; And the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; And half of the city shall go forth into captivity, And the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusale sat din Pakaiyin namtin vaipi koukhomintin, khopi alah diu in jouse achom’uva, numeiho abol thang diu ahi. Mipi keh khat hel sohchanga kitol diu, adangse vang khopi sunga konin kaidoh pouvinte.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh hiche chitin namtin hochu tumasanga banga chu kisatpi dinga hung kon doh ding ahiuve.
en_web: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
en_kjv: Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, As when he fought in the day of battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng Pakai kipat’a hiche namtin vaipi ho chu asat ding, gollui laiya asat banga asat ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh akeng in Jerusalem solang Olive molchunga chu hung ding ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh Olivet molchu kehni hung kisontin solamle lhumlam hung kikhenna phaicham lentah khat hung kijedohding ahi. Mol akehkhat chun sahlang hin jon intin chuleh akehkhat chun lhang lang ajotding ahi.
en_web: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
en_kjv: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, Which is before Jerusalem on the east, And the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, And there shall be a very great valley; And half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, And half of it toward the south.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng olive molsang, Jerusalem niso lama hung pansantin, olive molsang chu pohkeh a, akah a phaicham lentah umdoh ding ahi. Molsang keh khat sahlama kitolsuh ding ahi.

tcz: Nangho phaicham lam jonna nachediu Azal changei naphahdiu ahi. Judah lengpa Uzzah nikhoa lingkiho jeh a najammu tobang chu hiding ahi. Chujou teng Pakai ka Pathen chu hung intin amitheng te jousen ahin kilhonpi diu ahi.
en_web: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.
en_kjv: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; For the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: Yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake In the days of Uzziah king of Judah: And the Lord my God shall come, And all the saints with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Molsang kehni soa phaichama hi najamdoh diu; Judah lengpa Uzziah khanga ling kihopet’a napu napateu jamdoh banga najam diu ahi. Pakai ka-Pathen chu Vantilto lhonna hung ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheni lechun nisavah umlou ding,
en_web: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche phat hile dap lou didng, geltwi kai lou ding,

tcz: Ahinla sunchu hijengding ahi! Hichehi iti hithei ding ham tichu Pakaiyin bou ahet ahi. Angaija anaum sunle jan chu um talou ding ajeh chu nilhah lang jong leh vahvah jeng ding ahi.
en_web: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.
en_kjv: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, Not day, nor night: But it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
tcz_gospelgo: mujong thimponte. Janteng jongle khovah jing ding ahi. Itih phat le hitia um ding hi Pakaiyin bou ahei.

tcz: Hicheni lechun Jerusalema konna hintwi hung longdoh ding, akehkhat Dead Sea langa chentin akehkhat Mediterranean langa chen tin chuhleh khalla longlong jing ding ahi.
en_web: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.
en_kjv: And it shall be in that day, That living waters shall go out from Jerusalem: Half of them toward the former sea, And half of them toward the hinder sea: In summer and in winter shall it be.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche teng hile Jerusalema kona twitheng hung longa, akeh khat Twikhanglen twimang dunga lon glut’a keh khatma Mediterranea Twikhanglena long lut ding ahi. Kum lhung hel, chuh le khal’a jong long jing jeng ding ahi. Egypt miten lhambuh kut abol dau le, Jerusalem ache nomlou namtin vaipi chunga lang natseh chu Pakaiyin achunguva alhunsah ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng leiset pumpia Pakai hung leng chang intin, Pakai chu khatbou hiding ama minbou chu min ahin houding ahi.
en_web: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: In that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng leiset pumpia Pakai leng chang ding;mitinin Ama Pathen ahina bangin chibai boh-umtin, min khat’a ahet diu ahi.

tcz: Gamsung pumpi Judah sahlang Geba-apat Jerusalem lhanglam Rimmon geihi phaicham lentah hung hiding, amavang Jerusalem vang hi ama mun mama-a kikhang sang ding chuleh in ningkoi kelkot gei, chujouteng hannanol inting Vamampat lengpa lengpitwi chillhana nungei mi hungcheng dimsoh ding ahi.
en_web: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.
en_kjv: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: And it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, From Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, And from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahlam Geba pat lhanglam Rimmon gei, gamsung pumpi kilai Jerusalem kikhang sangpen ding; khopi chu Benjamin kelkot’a pat, masanga kelkot kisem nasa, inning kelkot phungpeh gei ding, Hananel intingvuma pat lengte lengpitwi chilna phung gei ding ahi.

tcz: Jerusalem hi mi hung dimding sapset chang talou helding, hung kisuse talou ding achaina keija hoibitna khopi hung hiding ahi.
