en_web: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.
en_kjv: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; But Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma hi manthah ding ging louhel’a, mipi ho lung mongtah a cheng diu ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Pakaiyin Jerusalem khopi satna nabol chitin namtin ho chunga suhgamna hoise ahin lhadingchu hitiding ahi. Akeng uva adinpet jeng uva jong chu atahsau monlha jeng ding, amit kosung uva jong amitchang’u monlha jeng ding chuleh akamsung uva jong aleiju monlha jeng ding ahi.
en_web: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.
en_kjv: And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people That have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, And their eyes shall consume away in their holes, And their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khopi sat namtin vaipi chunga Pakaiyin natset alansah a, ahing laiya atahsau natset’a monlha ding ahi. Amit’u le aleiguiyu vang monponte.

tcz: Pakai jepna achung'uva che ding amaho tijatna dim ding, amitakip atophah phah chunga akhutna alap jeng diu ahi.
en_web: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, That a great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; And they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, And his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteng chule Pakaiyin abonchauvin kisuh dongsah-intin, kichatmana min akinaipi pen pen abokhum jeng diu ahi.

tcz: Judaten jong Jerusalem huhna-a gal asat diu avel uva um nam dang ho gou, sana dangka chuleh nihchen ponsil tamtah akichom dohdiu ahi.
en_web: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.
en_kjv: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; And the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, Gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem huhna Judahten gal abol diu ahi. Namtin vaipi neile gou-sana, dangka, chule nihchen ponsil-thalhingset’a akichomdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche gamna hisehi sakolte le sakolpolte, sangong sauté leh sangante chunga jong chuleh galmite ngahmuna um ganchadang ho jouse chunga jong chusoh kei ding ahi.
en_web: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.
en_kjv: And so shall be the plague of the horse, Of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, And of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolte le sakolte, sa-ngongsaote le sa-ngante, melmate ngahmun a gancha jouse chunga tijat umtah natsat lang ding ahi.

tcz: Achaina teng, Jerusalem hinsatna galmiho hiche gamma hisea konna hoi doh hochu kumseh leh Jerusalemma chetou diu hatchungnungpen Pakai kiti leng chu aga hou diu chuleh lhambuh kut mang dinga che jeng diu ahi.
en_web: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations Which came against Jerusalem Shall even go up from year to year To worship the King, the Lord of hosts, And to keep the feast of tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem delkhum namtin vaipi lah a hingdoh amoh chengsen, kumseh le Thaneipen pakai, Leng chu Jerusalema chibai ahung boh diu, lhambuh kut ahung manji diu ahi.

tcz: Vannoi leiset a koinam hamkhat hatchungnung pen Pakai, kiti lengpa chu hou dinga che lou aum khah leh agam sung uva go ju lou ding ahi.
en_web: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.
en_kjv: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up Of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem To worship the King, the Lord of hosts, Even upon them shall be no rain.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi to bang nam min Thaneipen Pakai, Leng chu chibai ga boh ding adaule, agamsunguva gotwi lha lou ding ahi.

tcz: Egypt mite hiche kut a hi apan nomlou uleh Pakaiyin amaho chu namdang ho tobanga che nomlou ho chunga achuhsah gamna hise tobang bangchu achung'uva achuh sah ding ahi.
en_web: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.
en_kjv: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; There shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen That come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

tcz: Egypt leh namdang jouse hiche lhambuh kut mang dinga che nom lou jouse chunga chu hiche engbolna chu chu ding ahi.
en_web: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.
en_kjv: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, And the punishment of all nations That come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhambuh kut abol daule Egypt mite le namtin vaipi chunga bol hesohna dia hiche natset chu chucheh ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho hileh sakolte kikanna savunkhao chung dunga jong, “Pakai ja atheng,” tia kijih soh kei ding ahi. Pakai Hou-in sunga bel jouse jong, maicham maija khon ho tobanga athenga um ding ahi.
en_web: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.
en_kjv: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; And the pots in the Lord’s house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho chule sakolte khaova jong, “Pakaiya kikatdohsa,” tia kijih cheh ding ahi. Houin sunga anhonna bel ho jeng jong, maicham a khon ho banga theng ding ahi.

tcz: Atahbeh in, Jerusalem leh Judah gam sunga kho ho jouse jong hatchungnung pen Pakaija dinga atheng hi ding ahi. Pakai hou dinga hung jouse chun hiche bel hohi pumgo thilto ho honnadinga adeidei amantheidiu ahi. Chuleh hiche nikho lechun hatchungnung Pakai Hou-in ahi kivei mi ho um thei lou ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts: And all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: And in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem le Judah gamsunga anhonna bel ho geiya Thaneipen pakai chibai boh teng man dia kikhen ding ahi. Mipin kilhaina sa honna aneidiu ahi. Hiche teng hileh Thenneipen Pakai Houin a kiveimi umlou ding ahitai.

tcz: Pakaiyin Malachi mangchan Israelte koma thu athot in ahi.
en_web: A revelation, the LORD’s word to Israel by Malachi.
en_kjv: The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Israel mipi seipeh dia Malachi jah a asei thu chu hiche hi ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin hitin a sei’e, “Keiman nangho ka hingailu jing uve” ati. Ahinlah nanghon nei donbutnuvin “Iti nei ngailutnu ham” natiuve. Pakaiyin Esau chu Jacob sopi hilou ham? Ahinlah keiman Jacob kangailun ahi.
en_web: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the LORD, “Yet I loved Jacob;
en_kjv: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: Yet I loved Jacob,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin amite jah a, “nangho ka-ngalu jingui,” ati. Amahon, “Iti nei-ngailut’u ham?’ atiuve. Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “Esau le Jacob sopi ahi lhonin, ahivangin Jacob le achilhahte ka-ngailun,

tcz: Esau chu ka thet in chuleh keiman a thinglhang gam chu ka suhchai peh helin, agoulona ding gam chu Sialte lhatna neldi gam kaso sahin ahi.
en_web: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
en_kjv: And I hated Esau, And laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Esau le achilhahte vang kahoi. Esau chenna thinglhang gamsung kasuchaiyin, gamsate chenna din kapetai,” ati.

tcz: Esau chilhah Edom in hiti hin hinsei jintin, keiho nei suchip deluvin ahi. Ahinlah keihon kaga phah nauva konna kahung kile kituva ka kisem phat kitdiu ahi, atiuve. Hat chungnung Pakai chun hiti hin aseije. “Amahon sapha jong leu keiman ka phetlhah peh diu ahi. Amaho chenna chu mipha lou gam kiti ding chuleh amite’u chu Pakai lunghan jing na mite” kiti ding ahiuve.
en_web: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” the LORD of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom the LORD shows wrath forever.”
en_kjv: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, But we will return and build the desolate places; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; And they shall call them, The border of wickedness, And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Esau chilhah, Edom miten, “Ka-khopi jouse kisuse jongle kisah phat kit tauvinge,” tijongleu; Pakaiyin donbut’intin, “Sapha kit’u hen, kaphet lhah peh diu ahi. Mihon, ‘Migiloute gam,’ atiuve, ‘Tonsot’a Pakai lunghan nam mite,’ ati diu ahi,” tin te.

tcz: Nanghon a kisuhmang na chu na mit tah uva namu tengule nangin, “Tahbeh in, Pakai loupina hi Israelte gamgi kalpeh a mihon jong amu uve” tin seijin nate.
en_web: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “The LORD is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
en_kjv: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelten hiche hi amit tah a amu diu, chuteng amahon, “Israel gam kalpeh a jong Pakaiyin eilunghan’u ahi!” tiuvinte.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakai chun thempu ho komah hitin aseije. “Chan apa ajabol le, soh in a pakai pa agin ding ahi. Keihi napau le na Pakai pau kahile hoi chi ham nei jabolnau, hoiche ham nei jen nau? Nanghon ka min hi nahsah louvin nabolun ahi! Ahinlah nanghon na seijun kei hon namin nahsah louva kakoi khah um natiu’ve.
en_web: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’
en_kjv: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: If then I be a father, where is mine honour? And if I be a master, where is my fear? Saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
tcz_gospelgo: tahneipen Pakaiyin thempute jah a aseiyin, “Chapan apa ajabol teiyin, soh-in apu ajatei me. Na Pau Kei idia neijabol dau ham? Nahsah mon neibol’un, ‘Iti nahsah moa kabol’um? Pou neitiuve.

tcz: Nang hon ka maichama an thenglou na toh’un ahinlah nanghon iti danna nangma ka suhboh diu ham? natiuve. Nanghon Pakai maicham jana peh angaipoi natiu chu na suhbohu ahi.
en_web: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘The LORD’s table is contemptible.’
en_kjv: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; And ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the Lord is contemptible.
tcz_gospelgo: kamaicham phunga manmo thil jeng nato jeh-uva nei nahsahmou ahi. Nangho pin, ‘Iti nang jabol louva kakoi diu ham?’ natiuve! Kamaicham thang le dol’a nabol jeh-uva neija louvu ahi.

tcz: Nanghon ganhing mitcho pumgo thilto a nahin to uchu dih mong’a hinam? Chuteng leh nanghon a elbai le a damlou ganhing nato uchu dih mong hinam? Nanghon hitobang ho chu nagam vaipo ho kipa thilpehin gape leu chun a kipah nadiuvem? tin hatchungnung Pakai chun a seijin ahi.
en_web: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? And if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? Offer it now unto thy governor; Will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakoma kilhaina dia gancha mitcho ham, dammo ham, elbai ham khat nahin kaiyu hi thildih bol’a kigel nahiuvam? Hitobang gancha hingmo hi gam vaipo katnan ganeitem’un! Nakipia nathum thum napeh ding hinam?” ati.

tcz: Tun kipat un Pakaiyin nakhotona diuvin tao’un , ahinla hitobang thilpeh chu maichama napeh jingle Pakai chun iti khotona na musah ding ham? tin hatchungnung pen Pakai chun aseije.
en_web: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: This hath been by your means: Will he regard your persons? saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun themgaopuho, ichunguva Pathen lung lhaina din taovun. Nataonau asan lout eng, nang ho themmo ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche houin kot hi nangho laha khat pen penin khah chahleu chun kati lheh jeng’e, chuti leh hiche thil thonlou hung kikatdoh ho hi umlou ding ahi. Ajeh chu keima na chunguvah kalung lhaipoi chuleh na thiltou jong ka sanpeh lou diu ahi, tin van sepaite Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
en_kjv: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? Neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord of hosts, Neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Pannabeiya akamaicham phunga mei natikou kou sangun, khattouvin Houin kotpi jouse gakamchah le katitave! Nachunguva kalung lhaipoi; neithilpeh-u sang ponge.

tcz: Ahinlah namdanga kon mipiten jingkah nilhahin vanoi leiset pumpia hin gimnamtwi leh atheng hohi kamin loupina dingin a katdoh jingun kamin hi aloupi sahun chitin namtin laha hin kamin hi choisang in aum in ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en_web: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same My name shall be great among the Gentiles; And in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: For my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi kolkimvel lhungsoh min eijabol cheh nauve. Muntin a gimnamtui alhuntan’un, santhei dol tah kilhaina thil atoh nauve. Abonchan eijabol cheh-uve!

tcz: Ahinlah nangho natohdan hin ka min na sumin seuvin ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai dokhang hi kisuhboh jongle akhoh poi natiuvin thilthenglou pou na hintoh’un ahi.
en_web: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The LORD’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’
en_kjv: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted; And the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanghon vang kamaicham isah louva nabol’uva, deimosa neh le chah todohna nanei jeh-un nahsahmon neikoitauve.

tcz: Nanghon, kon Pakai alunglhaisah jou ding ham natiuvin ka thupeh na taitomun ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije “Gel uvin adamlou a elbai chuleh a ki gu doh gancha pou na hin katdoh jiuve, hichu ken iti ka sanpeh ding nahiuvem? tin Pakaiyin aseije”
en_web: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says the LORD of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says the LORD.
en_kjv: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! And ye have snuffed at it, saith the Lord of hosts; And ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; Thus ye brought an offering: Should I accept this of your hand? saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanghon, ‘Thilto to jong kachimtai!’ natiuvin, nanah neikhon khum’uve. Kahenga to dia nahin kaiyu jong gancha naguh thou ham, adammo ham, a-elbai ham ahi. Hitiho hi kasan peh dia nagel’um?

tcz: Koi hijongleh Pakai kom’a toh dinga kitepna neija aki lomlou joh hintoh chan chu sapsetna chang ding ahi. Chutengleh chitin namtin laha kamin hi mi gin le ja kahithei ding ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakai chun a seije.
en_web: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says the LORD of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
en_kjv: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, And voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: For I am a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, And my name is dreadful among the heathen.
tcz_gospelgo: kei peh dia tepsa kelngoi hon lah a kelngoi hoitah tah sel’a, kelngoi hingmoa kilhina boljia eilhem ho chu gaosap chang hen! Ajeh chu Leng loupe tah kahin, namtin vaipin eiging cheh-uve!” ati.

tcz: Tun thempu hon ngaiuvin hiche thupeh hi nangho dinga ahi.
en_web: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.
en_kjv: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin thempuho jah a aseiyin, “Hiche thupeh hi nangho ding ahi.

tcz: Kasei hi ngai’unlang ka min jabolna ding in lunggel thah na nei tan, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije. Achuti louleh na chunguva sapsetna nasatah kalhunsah ding ahi. Tahbeh in keiman ka sapsetsa nahitauve, ajeh chu nanghon kagihnau chu na gelkhoh pouve.
en_web: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says the LORD of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.
en_kjv: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, To give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and will curse your blessings: Yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Natoh nabol chan’uva neijadiu ahi. Kasei na-ngai louvu le kagaosap ding nahiuve. Nachan diu thil ho geiya kagaosap ding ahi. Kathupeh nagel khoh loujeh-uva kagaosapsa jong nahitauve.

tcz: Keiman na chilhahteu ka engbol a thilboh ho chu na maichanguva ka thekhum ding ahi. Chu tengleh na thilbol ho lah’a ka selut ding nahiuve.
en_web: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
en_kjv: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, And spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; And one shall take you away with it.
tcz_gospelgo: Natu nachateu telen matsah ing ting, namaiyuva kilhaina gan nathau eh kaloikhum diu-gancha eh puma kakaidoh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Chutengleh nanghon Levite toh nakitepnau achejom theina dinga gihsalna vopsah chu keima kahi chu nahin hetdoh ding’u ahi, tin hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, That my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah l ethempuho le Levite to kakitepna suhkeh louna dia hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahetdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Levite toh kitepna ka nanei nalopen chu na hinkhouva chamna nanei theina diuva kana peh’u ahi. Hiche hin amaho’a konna jana leh ginna kachantheina ding a hin amahon jana lentah eina peuvin kamin loupina dingin ana ding chahkheh’un ahi.
en_web: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.
en_kjv: My covenant was with him of life and peace; And I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, And was afraid before my name.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kakitepnaa hin hinnop le damtheina kateppeh-in, eijabolna diuva hiche chu kapeh ahi. Hiche lai chun eigingun eijabol nauve.

tcz: Amahon keija konna amu’u thupeh ho chu amiteu anape sonnun ahi. Amahon jou le tah chonna ana neipouve, amahon keidei lampi ana chepiuvin phatna leh chonphatnaa konin mi tamtah ahin le puidoh kit’un ahi.
en_web: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.
en_kjv: The law of truth was in his mouth, And iniquity was not found in his lips: He walked with me in peace and equity, And did turn many away from iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi thudih ahil’un, adih lou ahil pouve. Keito kitoh del’in aum’un; amaho she-in thildih abol pouvin, midang ho geiyin thilse abolsah dauve.

tcz: Pathena konna chihna leh hetthem theina hi thempu ho kom’a konna hung potdoh ding hitia chu mipi ho chu amaho kom’a thuhil ngaicha a cheji diu ahi. Ajehchu amaho hi hatchungnung Pakai thuhil pole ho ahiuve.
en_web: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, And they should seek the law at his mouth: For he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Min Pathen adih a ahet ding hi thempuhon ahil diu ahi. Kalungdei chu mipin Thempuho koma agahetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho hi Thaneipen Pakai sole ahiuve.

tcz: Ahin nangho thempuhon Pathen lampi na peltauve nang ho thuhila konin mi tachonsea alhalut tauvin ahi. Nanghon Levite toh ka kitepna chu na suboh tauvin ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en_web: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: But ye are departed out of the way; Ye have caused many to stumble at the law; Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: “Tunla Thempuhon lamdih napel tauve. Namihil’un mi tamtah apuisei. Nanghon kakitepna nasukeh tauve.

tcz: Hijeh achu keiman nang ho hi vannoi mite ho mitmu a kidah umtah leh noise umtah ka hisah nahitauve. Ajeh chu nanghon ka thu nangai pouvin, ka thuhil dungjuijin na chon pouvin mipi lah a sihnei langneina in na natongun ahi.
en_web: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.
en_kjv: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, According as ye have not kept my ways, But have been partial in the law.
tcz_gospelgo: kalungdei nadondauve, kamite nahil tengu langkaina nanei jeh-un, Kenjong ISraelte nahsahmoa ka-umsah ding anhiuve,” ati.

tcz: Eiho hi mipa khat cheh ihiu hilou ham? Eiho hi Pathen khatseh sem ihi louvu ham? Chuti ahileh iti danna eiho leh eiho ikilhep lhahuva ipu ipateu Pathen toh iki tepnau chu i-suhkehu hitam?
en_web: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?
en_kjv: Have we not all one father? Hath not one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, By profaning the covenant of our fathers?
tcz_gospelgo: Pa khat lhah ihi louvu ham? Pathen semcheh ihi louvu ham? I-bol’a kha le khat kitepna isuh keh-uva, ipu ipateu le Pthen kitepna nahsahmoa ibol’u ham?

tcz: Judah akitah poi, Jerusalem leh Israelte lah a thil dihlou tah ahung lhung tai. Juda miten semthu milim hou numeiho a kichenpiuvin Pakai muntheng a suboh tauve.
en_web: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.
en_kjv: Judah hath dealt treacherously, And an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; For Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, And hath married the daughter of a strange god.
tcz_gospelgo: Judahten Pathento kitepna asukeh-un, Jerusalem le Judah gam pumpia tijat umtah abol tauve. Pakaiyin a-it pen Houin asuhboh tauve. Pasal hon douhou numeiho akichenpiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitobang bol ho jouse chuleh hatchungnungpen Pakai henga thilto dihlou hin choi ho jouse hi Israel namlaha konin amaho hi hatchungnung Pakaiyin ka chomkhen tan ahi.
en_web: The LORD will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: The Lord will cut off the man that doth this, the master and the scholar, Out of the tabernacles of Jacob, And him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang thil bol jouse Pakaiyin Israel lah a konin kaidoh hen, Thaneipen Pakai dia thilto inam miteu lah a pang hih hel’u hen.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon thildang nabol’u jong aum’e. Pakaiyin na thiltou anah sahlou jeh leh alunglhai lou jeh, asan thei lou jeh'in Pakai maicham chung chu na mitlhi na chupsahin kap leh lunghem tahin na khoisa in ahi.
en_web: “This again you do: you cover the LORD’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.
en_kjv: And this have ye done again, Covering the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, Insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, Or receiveth it with good will at your hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang jong hi nabol’ui. Nathilto chengseu asan lou phat’in kap le maovin na-um’un, Pakai maicham phung chu lhi le nap nadiptauve.

tcz: Nangman na seijin, “Pakaiyin ipi dinga ka taona hi asan lou ham nati.” Keiman seipeh ing kate! Ajeh chu na khandonlaija na jinei a chu ahetoh a Pakai pang ahi. Ahinlah amanu naji hina a na kichen lhonna na kitepna lhon dungjuija kitah taha aum vang'in nang vang kitahlou tahin na hung chon tan ahi.
en_web: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.
en_kjv: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, Against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: Yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
tcz_gospelgo: I-atile nathiltou asanlou nadatmo’uve. Nasenji nakikhenpi jal’uva asan lou ahi. Najinu hcu natibah ahin, Pathen angsunga achunga kitah jing dia kitep ngalta, nakitepna nasukeh tai.

tcz: Pakaiyin naji toh pumkhat hidinga na goplhon hilou ham? Tahsa leh lhagaova ama a nahi lou ham? Chuleh aman adei chu ipi ham? Na kigop lhonna pat Pathenna nahi lhon hilou ham? Hijeh chun phatah in kingaiton lang na khandonlaija na jinu a chun kitah tahin um'in, ati.
en_web: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
en_kjv: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, And let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin hiche numei chuto tahsa le lhagao khat’a nagopsa hilou ham? Ipi ngaitoa abol hitam? Pathen midih tah hidia cha le nao naneipi ding ahi. Hijeh chun koiman ajinu kikhenpida hen.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman kida hi ka mah ahi! tin Israel Pathen in aseijin ahi. Na jinu chu na da leh ama chunga chu engsetna nalhut khum ahitai, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e. Hijeh chun ki tomla in na jinu chunga na kitepna lhon sukeh hihin.
en_web: One who hates and divorces”, says the LORD, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says the LORD of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.
en_kjv: For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: For one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: Therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Israel Pathenin, “Nupa kikhen hi kamah ahi. Pasal’in abol thang jong kaseipoi. Hijeh chun najinu chunga kitah jing dia nakitepnau sukeh hih hel’un,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Na kampaovin na Pakai chu suboi hihun; nang hon iti kasuhboi uvem? tiuvin nate: thilse bol hi Pakai mitmua thilpha ahin, ama lunglhaina ahi natiu hin Pakai chu nalung phatmosahu ahi, thu adihtaha tan Pathen chu um hinam natiu hin, nalung phatmosahu ahije.
en_web: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’
en_kjv: Ye have wearied the Lord with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the Lord, And he delighteth in them; Or, Where is the God of judgment?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakam tam behseh-un Pakaiyin ajadai. Nangho pin, “Iti eithei chim diu ham? Thaneipen Pakaiyin thilse bolte mipha agel’a, amaho chubou adeijoh ahi,” natiuve. Chuma le, “Thildih bol dia kigel Pathen chu hoiba hitam?” tin nahol’ui.

tcz: Veuvin keiman ka masanga lampi sujang dingin ka thu polepa ka sol’e, chutengleh na hol jing na Pathen chu pohphunga hou in a hung kilah jing ding ahi. Nanghon mukal na ngalel’u kitepna thu hungtei ding ahi, tin van janel Pakai chun asei’e.
en_web: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: And the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, Even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: Behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: thaneipen Pakaiyin, “Kalampi semtoh din kasolle sol nange. Chutah le nahol jingo Pakai chu hetman louva a-Houin hun glut jeng ding ahi. Na-nga jingo sole chu hunga kakitepna aphonjal ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: “Ahinlah ahung tengleh koi ham adoujou ding ah? Koiham ama ahung kilah tengleh amaija ding ngam dingah? Amachu thih kilhajol meikong al’lenglung tobang ding, ahilouleh pon sop bangna sabon tobang ding ahi.
en_web: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;
en_kjv: But who may abide the day of his coming? And who shall stand when he appeareth? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ sope:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hiche nikho hunglhun tang thoh jou didng koi ham? Ama hung kilah ten ghingdoh ding koi ham? Ama chu ponsop theng dabon hattah le thih gojolna mei-am hatah tobang ahi.

tcz: Sana lhajolpan, sana alhahjol banga, manthei louho a suhtheng ding, dangka leh sana asuhjol tobanga asuhjol ding chutengleh Pakai komma santheidol thilto ahin neithei ding ahi.
en_web: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness.
en_kjv: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: And he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, That they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Dangka goujol’a suthengpa banga thutam dia hung ding ahi. Thih-khengpan dang ka le dana agojol banga, Pakaiyin thildih apha ato theina diuva, Pakai sole pan Thempuho asuh theng ding ahi.

tcz: Hiteng le chun Pakaiyin akomma hung kichoilut Jerusalem leh Juda mipite thilto ho chu tumasanga banga ahin santhei kit ding ahi tai.
en_web: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years.
en_kjv: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, As in the days of old, and as in former years.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng masang laiya banga, Judah gam le Jerusalem miten Pakai dia thilto ahinchoiyu chu lung lhaina anei ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng chuleh keima thutan dinga na kom’u kahin nai ding phunsan themho, mijong ho, mijou ho, sum lo a na tong ho, thaman penom lou ho, meithai holeh, nulepa beiho chuleh gamchom mi na lahuva cheng ho chunga thu adiha tan nomlou ho chuleh keima seijui lou ho chu ka engbol ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e.
en_web: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And I will come near to you to judgment; And I will be a swift witness Against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, And against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, The widow, and the fatherless, And that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, Saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Thutan din nalah-uva hung kiphong ing ting, mitpheldoi themho le numei jonpi ho, jouva hettohsah ho, mi tohman lepthol ho, meithaiho le chagate, gamchom mi maljin ho-kinopsahna nei ho, Kei jalou chengse kahehset ding ahi.

tcz: Keima Pakai kahin kikhelna neilou kahi. Hijeh a chu nangho Jacob chate na kisumang soh louvu ahi.
en_web: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
en_kjv: For I am the Lord, I change not; Therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
tcz_gospelgo: “kei hi Pakai, kikhel lou kahi. Hijeh chun nnangho Jacob chilhahte namangthah hel hih laiyui.

tcz: Napu napateo khanglaija pat’in nanghon ka danthu ho na nahsah pouvin jui jong na jui pouve. Tun hung kile kit ding ka hi tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei’e. Ahinlah nanghon na sei jun keiho chebon ki che mang kha louva iti ka kile kit diu ham? na tiuve.
en_web: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’
en_kjv: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the Lord of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
tcz_gospelgo: Malai napu napateu bangin nan ghon jong Kadanthu jouse napeldoh-un nanit tapouve. Hung kile kit’un, nahengu hinjon inge. Nanghon, ‘Naheng kahinjot theina diuva ipi kabol diu ham?’ tin naseiyui.

tcz: Mihemin Pathen achom angai ham? Ahinlah nanghon nei chomun ahi! ahijeng vang'in nanghon na sei jun “Pathen chu iti ka chom diu ham?” na tiuve. Na hopsom to lou jeh ule thilto to ding na tolou jeh uva nei chom’uvah ahi.
en_web: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.
en_kjv: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadoh nahiuve, min Pathen alepthol theiyam? Alhem ngaipoi, nang hon vang neilhem’ui. Nanghon, ‘Iti kalhep’um?’ natiuve. Hopsoma hop khat le htilto peh dol’in neilhem’ui.

tcz: Hitia keima nei chom jeh uva na nam pumpiuva na ki gaosap sohkeiju ahitai.
en_web: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.
en_kjv: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, Even this whole nation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nam pumpin neilepthol jeh-un nabonchau chunga gaosapna achutai.

tcz: Hopsom jouse akholna munna hinlhut soh keijun chutileh ka hou in sunga nehleh chah lhingset ding ahi. Hiti a chu na bol uleh keiman van gam lang kot jouse ka hon lhah a phathei bohna lhingset a, akholna let lha gei ja ka hin sunlhah ding ahi. Hiti chun keima jeng jong hi nei patep mun tin hat chungnung pen Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.
en_kjv: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, That there may be meat in mine house, And prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, If I will not open you the windows of heaven, And pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
tcz_gospelgo: houin a neh le chah lhingset’a koi din hopsom ahop khat lhingkeiyin hinchouyun. Neive patep’un, van a bangkot chengse hongdoh ing ting thilpha jouse nang jeng junga kasun lhah peh ding anhiuve.

tcz: “Na chang le na min jong pha ding ahi, ajeh chu a susethei ho jousea konna ka ventup peh ding, na lengpi thei ho jong amin masanga lhulhop lou ding ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakai jin aseije.
en_web: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, And he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; Neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachangdong laiyu ganhingte duhmang sah pong ting, nalengpiguiyu gaboh keikoi ding ahi.

tcz: “Chuteng chuleh chitin namtin in mi nunnom ahiuve ati diu ajeh chu na gamsung chu kipana dimset ding ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseije.
en_web: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says the LORD of Armies.
en_kjv: And all nations shall call you blessed: For ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the Lord of hosts.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng nagamsungu chen mun pha soh a, namtin vaipin min nun nom nahisah diu ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin asei’e, “Nanghon kei dounan thupha loutah tah na sei’uve, ahinla nanghon nangma douna a ipi ka sei uvem?” na tiuve.
en_web: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says the LORD. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
en_kjv: Your words have been stout against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?
tcz_gospelgo: “Kachung change tijat jat um thu naseiyui,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Ahivangin nanghon, ‘Nathudol ipi kaseibeh-um?’ natiuve.

tcz: Nanghon, Pathen kin bolhi ipi phachom nam? na tiuve. A thupeh dungjui ja ichon’uva ipi phachom am, ahilouleh ka chonset jeh uvin ka kisih uve tia hatchungnung Pakai komma isei uva ipi phachom am? natiuve.
en_web: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of Armies?
en_kjv: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: And what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, And that we have walked mournfully before the Lord of hosts?
tcz_gospelgo: Nanghon, ‘pathen kinbol jong pannabei ahi. Asei sei bol jong i-phachom a, i-bolse chunga thaneipen Pakai koma kisih thusei jong ipi phachom ham?

tcz: Tua pat'in mi kiletsah ho phathei achangin, thilse bolho a haodohun Pathen engbolna thoh ngap ho jong ahao doh theije, na tiuve.
en_web: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’
en_kjv: And now we call the proud happy; Yea, they that work wickedness are set up; Yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi hoithote anompen a pang imuukhu me. Migiloute la hao thei keo hilouvin, Pathen phinna monga thilse abol’u jongle ahoidoh thouvui,’ tin naseiyui,” ati.

tcz: Chujou chun Pakai ging khencha umho chu khat le khat akihouvun ahileh Pakaiyin amaho kihouna chu angai pehin ahi. Pakai angsunga chun, Pathen ging jing holeh amin domsang nom jing ho geldoh jingna dingin lekhajol khat a amin’u aki pehlutin ahi.
en_web: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another; and the LORD listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name.
en_kjv: Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another: And the Lord hearkened, and heard it, And a book of remembrance was written before him For them that feared the Lord, and that thought upon his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai gingte akihou lim’un, aseiyu Pakaiyin ajatai. Pakai angsunga, Pakai ginga jabolte thudol lakhabu khat’a ajih luttauve.

tcz: “Amaho chu ka mite hi diu ahi” tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi. Keiman thu katanna nikho teng leh amaho chu atum be a kasahlut tah, ka gou hi diu, mipan athu ngai, acha thilsea konna ahoi doh banga, kenjong ama ho chu kahoidoh sah ding ahi.
en_web: They shall be mine,” says the LORD of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.
en_kjv: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord of hosts, In that day when I make up my jewels; And I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thaneipen pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amaho hi kamite hi diu, kachaloh ni nil eh, kalhentum chom beh hi di ahi. Akinbol jing chapa chunga mipa hepina dingahiuve.

tcz: Chuteng leh nanghon michonpha le michonpha lou nahet khenuva Pathen kin bol hole abollou ho na hetkhen thei diu ahi.
en_web: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.
en_kjv: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, Between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng kamiten avel’a, midih le migilou kibah louje, kakinbol pa le bol loupe kah a thilsoh amudoh ki tdiu ahi,” ati,

tcz: Hiche hi Abraham le David a kona hung kikhai lha, Messiah Yeshua khanggui thu kisun doh chu ahi.
en_web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
en_kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham chilhah David guiya peng Jesu Christa khanggui thusim hitia kisun ahi.

tcz: Abraham chapa chu Isaac, chule Isaac chapa chu Jacob, Jacob chapa chu Judah le asopite ahiuve.
en_web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
en_kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin Isaac ahingin, Isaac chun Jacob ahinge; Jacob hin Judah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge.

tcz: Judah chapa chu Perez le Zerah ahilhon in (Anu lhon chu Tamar ahi), chule Perez chapa chu Hezron, chule Hezron chapa chu Ram ahi.
en_web: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
en_kjv: and Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
tcz_gospelgo: Judah hin Tamara konin Perez le Zerah ahingin, Perez hin Hezron ahinge; Hezron chun Ram ahingin,

tcz: Ram chapa chu Amminadab, chule Amminadab chapa chu Nahshon chule Nahshon chapa chu Salmon ahi.
en_web: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
en_kjv: and Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
tcz_gospelgo: Ramin Aminadab ahinge; Aminadab chun Nahshon ahingin, Nahshonin Salmon ahinge;

tcz: Salmon chapa chu Boaz (Anu min Rahab) ahin, Boaz chapa chu Obed (Anu chu Ruth) chule Obed chapa chu Jesse ahi.
en_web: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
en_kjv: and Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
tcz_gospelgo: Salmonnin Rahab’a konin Boaz ahingin, Boaz hin Ruth a kon in Obed ahinge; Obed hin Jesse ahingin,

tcz: Jesse chapa chu Leng David, chule David chapa chu Solomon (Anu chu Uriah jinu Bathsheba) ahi.
en_web: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
en_kjv: and Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
tcz_gospelgo: Jessen David lengpa ahinge. David hin Uriah jinua kon in Solomon ahingin,

tcz: Solomon chapa chu Rehoboam ahin Rehoboam chapa chu Abijah chule Abijah chapa chu Asaph ahi.
en_web: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
en_kjv: and Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
tcz_gospelgo: Solomonin Rehoboam ahinge; Rehoboamin Abijah ahingin, Abijah chun Asa ahinge;

tcz: Asaph chapa chu Jehoshaphat ahin, Jehoshaphat chapa chu Jehoram ahin chule Jehoram chapa chu Uzziah ahi.
en_web: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
en_kjv: and Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
tcz_gospelgo: Asan Jehoshaphat ahingin, Jehoshaphat’in Joram ahinge; Joramin Uzziah ahingin,

tcz: Uzziah chapa chu Jotham ahin, Jotham chapa chu Ahaz chule Ahaz chapa chu Hezekiah ahi.
en_web: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
en_kjv: and Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
tcz_gospelgo: Uzziah chun Jotham ahinge; Jothamin Ahaz ahingin, Ahaz chun Hezekiah ahinge;

tcz: Hezekiah chapa chu Manasseh ahin, Manasseh chapa chu Amon ahin, chule Amon chapa chu Josiah ahi.
en_web: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
en_kjv: and Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
tcz_gospelgo: Hezekiah hin Manasseh ahingin, Manasseh chun Amon ahinge; Amonin Josiah ahingin, Babylon lama gal-hinga akai laiyun Josiah chun Jechoniah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge.

tcz: Josiah chapa chu Jehoiachin le asopi pasal ho ahiuve (Babylon a apuimang laiyuva peng ahiuve).
en_web: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
en_kjv: and Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

tcz: Babylon a puimang ahi jouvin: Jehoiachin chapa chu Shealtiel ahin, chule Shealtiel chapa chu Zerubbabel ahi.
en_web: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
en_kjv: and after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
tcz_gospelgo: Babylon lama gal-hinga akai nungun Jechoniah chun Shealtiel ahingin, Shealtiel chun Zerubbabel ahinge;

tcz: Zerubbabel chapa chu Abiud ahin, Abiud chapa chu Eliakim ahin, chule Eliakim chapa chu Azor ahi.
en_web: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
en_kjv: and Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
tcz_gospelgo: Zerubbabel hin Abiud ahingin, Abiud chun Eliakim ahinge; Eliakimin Azor ahingin,

tcz: Azor chapa chu Zadok ahin, Zadok chapa chu Akim ahin, chule Achim chapa chu Eliud ahi.
en_web: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
en_kjv: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
tcz_gospelgo: Azor chun Zadok ahinge; Zadok hin Achim ahingin, Achimin Eliud ahinge;

tcz: Eliud chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Matthan ahin, chule Matthan chapa chu Jacob ahi.
en_web: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
en_kjv: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
tcz_gospelgo: Eliud chun Eleazar ahingin, Eleazarin Matthan ahinge; Matthanin Jacob ahingin,

tcz: Jacob chapa chu Mary jipa Joseph ahi. Hiche Mary a kona hi Yeshua kiti Messiah chu ana peng ahi.
en_web: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
en_kjv: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob chun Joseph ahinge; hiche Joseph hi Messiah kiti Jesu hingnu Mary jipa ahi.

tcz: Achunga ki jihdoh ho hi—Abraham apat David chan gei khang som le li sung ahin, David apat Babylon a puimanga aum gei chu khang som le li sung ahin, chule Babylon a puimanga aum uva pat Messiah hung chan gei chu khang som le li ahi.
en_web: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
en_kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Abraham a pat Davin gei khang som le khang li ahin, David a pat Babylon lama gal-hinga akai mang geiyu chu khang som le khang li ma ahi kite’e; chule Babylon lama gal-hinga akai manguva pat Messiah pen gei chu khang som le li ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi Yeshua Messiah hungpen thudol ahi. Anu Mary hi, Joseph to kicheng dinga kitepna neisa ahi. Ahinlah aum khom masang lhon in, Lhagao Theng thilbol theina a nungah theng ahipet in, amanu hi naovop ahi akihedoh tai.
en_web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christapen um chan chu hiti ahi. Anu Mary cu Joseph to kicheng dinga kitepsa ahinm ahinla akigop masang lhonin Lhagao Thenga kona agai chu Mary hin akihet doh tai.

tcz: Chutah in, aji dingpa Joseph chu mipha ahijeh'in, japi het in jumna ape nom pon, hijeh chun guhthim'a kikhenpi din lunggel aneitai.
en_web: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
en_kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin ajipa joseph hi midih tah ahijeh-in Mary hi lhangphonga mipi seithanga umsah ding a nompon, guh thim cha akitepna lhon suh keh a kikheni din agoi.

tcz: Hitia lung angaito lai hin Pakai vantil khat ahenga ahung kilah in ajah a “Joseph, David chapa, Mary chu ji dia nakipui ding kicha hih in, ajeh chu naocha asunga umkhu Lhagao Thenga kona kijil ahi.
en_web: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph-in hitobang lung agel laitah hin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in mangin akimusah-in, “David chilhah Joseph, Mary khu kipuiya jia nei ding tija hih hel’in; ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thenga kona gai ahibouve.

tcz: Chule amanu hin chapa khat ahin nei ding, nangman amin Yeshua tia nasah ding ahi, ajeh chu Ama hin Amite achonset nauva kon'a ahuhhing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
en_kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa khat ahinding, amin Jesu nasah ding ahi; ajeh chu amatah hin amite achonset’uva klna ahuhhing ding ahi,” tin aseipeh-e.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi Pakai thupo, athemgao thusei gui lhunna dinga sohdoh ahitai:
en_web: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: thil chicheng hi Pakaiyin Themgao kama aseisa gui lhun theina dinga soh ahin, asei chun,

tcz: “Vetem un! Nungah theng khat in nao ahinvop ding ahi! Amanu hin chapa khat ahin ding chule amin Emmanuel asah dingu hichu ‘Pathen in eium piuve,’” tina ahi.
en_web: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
en_kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, nu-ngah chu gaiyin tin chapa khat ahin ding, amin ‘Emmanuel’ kiti ding ahi, Amin hi, ‘Pathenin eiumpiuve,’tina ahi” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin Joseph ahung khahdoh phat in, Pakai vantil thupeh bang in abol in, chule Mary chu ajidin akipui tai.
en_web: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
en_kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph a-imut khah phat’in Pakaiya kon Vantil’in ahil bang bangin abol’in, Mary chu ji dingin akipuitai;

tcz: Ahinlah achapa pen masang sen amanu hi kitoh khah pilou hel in aum in, chuin Joseph chun amin Yeshua asahtai.
en_web: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
en_kjv: and knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
tcz_gospelgo: ahin Maryn chapa ahinahin masangsen nupaa kitimatpina vang aneipi khah hih hel;e, Naosen ahung pen phat’in amun chu Jesu asah tai.

tcz: Leng Herod vaipoh laiyin, Judea gam Bethlehem a Yeshua ana peng in ahi. Hiche pet chun solam gamkai hoa kon in miching phabep Jerusalem khopia ahung un, amaho chun adong un,
en_web: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
en_kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
tcz_gospelgo: Judah gama Herod lengpa lal laiyin Bethlehem khopia Jesu ahung pengin, niso lama ahsi umdol hethem mihoJerusalem khopia ahungun,

tcz: “Juda nam mite lengthah hungpeng chu hoilaiya umham? Kei hon Ama ahsi hung sohdoh chu solam a kamu uvin chule Ama chu, hou dinga hunga kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
en_kjv: saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Judate chunga leng chang dia hung peng naosen chu hoiya um tam? Ama pen jeh a niso lama ahsi hung kilah kamu-va naosen chu chibai boh dinga hung kahiuve,” tin aseiyui.

tcz: Leng Herod chun hiche thu ajah phat in ama le Jerusalem a cheng jouse alung kham lheh jeng un ahi.
en_web: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
en_kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Athudoh-u ajah phat’un Herod lengpa ti Jerusalem mite ti along jing lheh tauve.

tcz: Aman thempu pipui ho leh hou dan thuhil ho akhom in “Messiah hoilai muna peng ding ham?” tin amaho chu adong tai.
en_web: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
en_kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
tcz_gospelgo: Hejeh chun Herod’in Thempu pipu ho leh mipi lah a Danthu lekha them ho akoukhom loiyin, “Messiah chu hoiya hung peng ding ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, “Judea gam Bethlehem a atiuve, ajeh chu themgao vin hiti hin ajih e:
en_web: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
en_kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Judea gamsung Bethlehem khopia peng ding ahi; ajeh chu Themgaopan hitin asun’e”

tcz: ‘Chule nangma, vo Bethlehem Judah gam'a um, Judah khopia vaipo holah a aneopen nahi poi, ijeh inem itileh nangma a kona vaipo khat, kami Israelte ching dingpa chu hung ding ahi,’” atiuve.
en_web: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
en_kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Vo Judea gama Bethlehem! Judah vaipote lah a itina ma jongleh aneopen nahipoi; Nanga kona kamite Israel lamkai ding khat Hung peng doh dong ahi,’ ati.” Atiuve.

tcz: Chutah in Herod chun miching ho chu guhthim in aki houpin, amahoa kon in ahsi akimu masat phat chu ahedoh tai.
en_web: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
en_kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, inquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Herod chun ahsi umdol hethem miho chu atimin akimupinm itih phat tah a ahsi hung kilah chu aphochentai.

tcz: Chutah in aman amaho chu aseipeh in, “Bethlehem a che uvin chule naosen chu ching thei tah in gahol un, ama chu namu teng uleh, hungkit un chule keima neiseipeh un, chutia keima jong kaga chea Ama chu kaga hou theina ding in,” ati.
en_web: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
en_kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin amaho chu Bethlehem lama asol’in, “Cheuvin lang naosen che phat chan gahol doh-un, keijong ka chea chibai kagabohna dinginm namudoh tenguleh neihung seipeh tauvin,” tin athu lhah-e.

tcz: Lengpa thu ajah jou uchun miching ho chu ache uvin ahileh, solam a ahsi amu uchu amasang uva ache peh in, Bethlehem lama apuiyun chule naosen umna mun chunga chun akingan ahi.
en_web: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
en_kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa thsei ajah pha’un akipatdoh paiyun, ahin mupeh sau niso lama ahsi chu amasanguva achepeh-in, naosen umna chung aphah phat’in aki-ngai.

tcz: Amahon ahsi chu amu phat uvin, amaho chu kipanan alungu alodim tai!
en_web: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
en_kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahsi amudoh kit phat’un akipah behseh jenguve!

tcz: Amaho insunga alut uva ahileh naosen chu anu Mary toh ana umkhom amu uvin, chuin amaho aboh khup uvin, Ama chu ahou tauve. Chuin amahon agou bom'u chu ahong doh uvin, ama chu Sana, Bego chule Myrrh kipa thilpeh in ape tauvin ahi.
en_web: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
en_kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin insunga agalut’u leh naosen chu anu Mary toh agamu thauvinm boh khip cheh-in chiabi aboh tauve. Chujongle agoubomu hongin thil manlu cheh-sana, bego chule myrrh atoh-un, thilpeh hicheng hi apetauve.

tcz: Chujouvin amahon adalhah tauvin ahileh, Pathen in amang uva Herod heng lama kile lou dinga agihsal jeh'u chun, lam chom aho uvin agam lam uva akile tauve.
en_web: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
en_kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod henglam ahopa kit louhelna diuva Pathenin amanguva ahilchah phat’ in lamchom khat ajuiyun agam olanguva akile kit tauve.

tcz: Miching ho ache doh jou uvin, Pakai vantil khat Joseph mang'in akilah in, “Kipatdoh in! Egypt gama naosen le anu chutoh jam uvin. Hiche mun achun hung kile kit dinga kaseipeh kahsen umden un, ajeh chu Herod in naosen chu tha dinga ahol ding ahi” tin aseipeh tai.
en_web: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
en_kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahsi umdol hethem miho che nungin, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat Joseph manga akilah-in, “Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Egypt langa jampinm kahinkou masangsen ta-umpi tan; ajeh chu herod’in naosen hi suhmang din angaiton ahol’e,” ati.

tcz: Chuche jan chun naosen chutoh anu Mary chu Joseph in apuiyin Egypt'a din, hiche mun chu adalha tauvin ahi.
en_web: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
en_kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph jong athouvin naosen le anu apuiyin janlaiyin Egypt langa ajampin,

tcz: Chule Herod thi kahsen chua chun aum den tauve. Hiche hi Pakaiyin themgao kam'a ana phondohsa: “Keiman ka Chapa chu Egypt a kakou doh e” ti gui lhunna ahi.
en_web: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
en_kjv: and was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod thi kahsen aga-umpitai. Hitobang thil hi Pakaiyin themgao kama aseisa, “Egypt’a konin kachapa kakoudoh tai,” ati chu guilhunna dinga soh ahi.

tcz: Miching hon angol bol'u Herod chun ahet doh phat in alung hang lheh jengtai. Aman chapang pasal jouse, miching hon ahsi so masat phat aseiyu totoh in, kum nia lhah noi-lamse Bethlehem sung le akimvel sea sepai ho asol in agatha sahtai.
en_web: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
en_kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahsi umdol hethem mihon alhim lhah ahetdoh phat’inHerod along hang behseh jeenginm mi asol’in ahsi umdol hethem mihoa kona naosen pen ahetdoh phat chutoh kitoh chet’in asimin, Bethlehem khopi le khovel dunga naosen pasal kum nia lhah noi lames se athagam sah tai.

tcz: Herod khansetna hi Pathen in themgao Jeremiah henga ana seisa:
en_web: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
en_kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremie the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hechea hin Jeremiah Themgao kama kiseia-

tcz: “Ramah ah ka awgin akijai-Kana le lunghemna nasatah chu! Rachel in achate akapin, amaho athitah jeh uvin, lhepbi ding anom tapoi,” kiti chu gui lhunna ahi.
en_web: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
en_kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ramah koa lhaset lunghem Ka le mao ogin nasatah akijan, Rachel in achate aka ka jengin, Athigam tah jeh-un lhepbi jou ahita poi,” kiti chu agui lhung tai.

tcz: Herod athi phat in, Pakai vantil khat chu Joseph henga amang in, Egypt a aumpet in ahung kilah in,
en_web: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
en_kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
tcz_gospelgo: Herod thi nungin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in, Egypt gama aumna a Joseph chu amangin kimusah-in,

tcz: “Kipatdoh in naosen chule anu chu Israel gam'a puikit in, ijeh inem itileh naosen tha ding ana goho chu athi tauve” tin vantil in aseipeh in ahi.
en_web: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
en_kjv: saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Israel gam jontan, naosen tha dinga hol ho athigam tauve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Joseph akipat doh in chule Israel gam lama Yeshua le anutoh ahung kile tauve.
en_web: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
en_kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph athoupaiyin, naosen le anu apuiyin Israel gamsung jonin ahung kile kit tai.

tcz: Ahinlah aman Judea vaipo thahpa chu Herod chapa Archelaus ahi ti ahetphat in, chuche mun a gache ding akicha tai. Ajan manga gihsalna amutah jeh in Galilee gam lam a ding in akipat doh tai.
en_web: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
en_kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Judea gama apa Herod khel’a Archelaus leng chan ajah doh phat’in Judea gama chenden ding Joseph akichanm amang ma akihil chah jeh chun Galilee gamsung joh ajonin,

tcz: Hiti chun hiche insung chu Nazareth kiti khopi khat a chun aga cheuvin chule hichea chun acheng tauve. Hiti chun themgao thusei “Ama Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi” kiti chu agui lhung tan ahi.
en_web: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
en_kjv: and he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
tcz_gospelgo: Nazareth khopia achengtai. Hiche hi Themgaohon, “Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi,” atiu gui lhunna dia chute ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho lai chun Twilutsah John chu Judea gamthip'a ahung in chule thu aseiphong in athupoh chu,
en_web: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
en_kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin John Baptist thu ahil lhang len,

tcz: “Nachonset nau dalha uvin chule Pathen lam a hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anaitai” ati.
en_web: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
en_kjv: and saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nachonset lung khel’unm ajeh chu van a lenggam chun hikom ahinpha tai!” tin asam’e.

tcz: Themgao Isaiah chun John chung chang hitin ana seiye, “Ama hi gamthip'a khosam aw chu ahi, Pakai hung nading lampi sem un, Ama ding in lampi theh ngim un” ati.
en_web: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
en_kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
tcz_gospelgo: John hi Isaiah Themgaovin anaseisa; “Gamthip laiya khosam ogin khat’in, “Pakai lampi semtoh-un lang, Alamlen semjangsan koiyinm tin aseiye,” ati chu ahitai.

tcz: John kivon na chu sangongsang mul kikhui ahin, chule akong kimvel achun savun konggah akigah in, chule khaokho le gamkhoiju chu an in anen ahi.
en_web: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
en_kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
tcz_gospelgo: John pon-ah chu sa-ngongsao mul ahin, akonggah savunm a-anneh khaokhote le gam khoiju ahi.

tcz: Mihonpi chu Jerusalem kimvel le Judea gam chule Jordan phaicham kimvela kon in, John ve ding le athusei ngaiya hung ahiuve.
en_web: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
en_kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the region round about Jordan,
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem khomite leh Judea gam pumpia mi, chule Jordan gamkol sung pimpia konin miho John henga acheuvin,

tcz: Chuin amahon achonset nau aphongdoh un, Jordan vadunga chun aman amaho chu baptize achansah in ahi.
en_web: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
en_kjv: and were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
tcz_gospelgo: achonset nau aphong cheh-un, Jordan vadunga john khut’in baptize achangtauve.

tcz: Ahinlah aman Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chu baptize chansah vea ahungu amun, amaho chu asosal in, “Nangho gul chilhah ho, Pathen lung hanna hung lhung dinga kon jam dohna dinga koiham nagih uva?
en_web: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
en_kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho leh Saducee ho tamtah ama khut’a baptize chang dia hung amu phat;in Johnin ajahuva, “Vo gulse son ho, kho nunga hung lhung ding Pathen lungsatnaa kona jamdoh dia thu namop’u koi peh ham?

tcz: Nachonset nauva kon'a nalung heiyu chule Pathen lam nangat'u chu, aphot chenna na hinkho uva tahlang un.
en_web: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
en_kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung khel’u natohgan phongdoh-un;

tcz: Nangho khat in khat komah, ‘eiho Abraham chilhah ihiuvin, huhbit in um nau hite’ tin kisei pehto hih un. Hichu imacha ahipoi, ajeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen in hiche songchang ho lah a kon a hi Abraham chate asemdoh thei ahi.
en_web: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
en_kjv: and think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Abraham son kihina chu,’ tin nalah-uva kiholim nan neidauvin; kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathenin hiche song ho geiya Abraham chilhah a asemthei ahi.

tcz: Tu jenga jong Pathen thu tanna heicha koisa a uma, thingphung ajung geiya kaldoh dia gonsa ahitai. Thingphung gapha hin sodoh lou jouse chu kiphuh lhu ding chule meilhum sunga kilehlut ding ahi.
en_web: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
en_kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingphung bul tin’a heicha aki phutsoh tai, aga pholou chengse kiphuh lhua meilhum sunga kileh lut ding ahi.

tcz: Achonsetna a kon'a lungheiya chule Pathen lam'a hung kihei ho chu, keiman twiya baptize kachansah ahi. Hinlah keima sanga gamchenga lenjo chu ahunge; keima hi ama soh, akeng chot choi dinga jong chu kilom kahi poi.
en_web: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung khel’u phot chetna twiya baptize kachansah nahiuvinm kei bana hungpa vang khu keisanga gamchenga chungnung jo ahinm kei hi akengchot te I sut dinga kilom jong kahipoi; ama chun Lhagao Teng le meikonga baptize nachasah diu ahi.

tcz: Aman changtah'a kona changsi khendoh dinga agodal akichoiya asep dia kigosa um ahi. Chule aman achangphol kimvel chu asuh theng'a changtah chu achang pang'a akhumlut ding, hinlah changsi chengse vang chu mei mit theilou meikong'a kilehlut ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
en_kjv: whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhut a chang japna achoiyin, phola chang jap ngimsel;in tin, chuteng achangtah ho changsal’a akhum tip ding, asi chengse vang mit thie lou meilhim sunga agovam ding ahitae,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshua chu Galilee a kon in, Jordan luiya John in baptize achansah ding in agachen ahi.
en_web: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
en_kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin Glilee gama konin Jesun Jordan lui ahin jonin, John khut’a bapize chang din ahung tai.

tcz: Hinlah John chun ana janom hihbeh in, “Keima hi nangman baptize nei chansah dia kiloma kahi, i-atileh kei koma hunga nahim,” ati.
en_web: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
en_kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin John anathu phan, ‘Keijoh nang khut’a baptize kachan dingsih a kei henga nahung tan’e!” anati.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hiche hi bol dinga lom ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in angeh jouse iboldoh tei ding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun John in Ama chu baptize achansah tai.
en_web: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut paiyin, “tun hit hin molso pou pouvinm ajeh chu hitobanga hi Pathen dei chan ibol bulhingsoh ding ahi,” ati, Hichen John jong anomtai.

tcz: Baptize achan jouva Yeshua twi lah'a kona ahung potdoh pet in, vanho chu Ama ding in ahung kihong doh in, chule Pathen Lhagao chu vakhu tobanga ahung kumsuh a chule achung'a aumden chu amun ahi.
en_web: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
en_kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
tcz_gospelgo: baptize achan jouva Jesu twiya kona apotdoh chunm ama din van akihongin Pathen Lhagao vakhu bang a hung kumlha achunga chu amui.

tcz: Chuin van'a kon aw khat in, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa dei umtah le ngailut umtah, kipana sangpen eipea chu ahi,” tin aseiye.
en_web: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
en_kjv: and lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin van a konin o-khat ahung ginginm “Ama hi kachapa deitah ahinm achugna kalung alhai ta ngeiye,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshua chu lhagao puiyin gamthip'a diabol lhep patep dingin aum tai.
en_web: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
en_kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jou hin Diabol lhep patep dingin Jesu chu Lhagaovin gamthip’ah apui toutai.

tcz: Ni somli le jan somli jen, an ngol ahijeh chun agil akel behseh jeng in ahi.
en_web: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
en_kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward a hungred.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisom li le jan som li geiya an ngol’a aum jouvin Jesu agilkeltai.

tcz: Hiche phat sung chun Diabol chu ahung in ajah a, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahileh, hiche songchang hohi changlhah akiso theina ding in thu pen,” ati.
en_web: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
en_kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun alhempatep chu ahungin ajah a, “Pathen chapa nahileh hiche song ho hi changlhah so na dingin seipeh-in,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ajah a, “Ahipoi! Pathen Thubun aseiye, Mihem changlhah bouva hingthei ahipoi, Pathen kam sunga kon hung potdoh Thua bou chu hing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
en_kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
