tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in “Pathen lekhabua kisun chun Mihem hi changlhah keova hing theilou ding, Pathen kamsoh thuhoa bou hing dinga kisei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Diabol chun khopi theng, Jerusalem hou in ting vuma chun adinsah kit in,
en_web: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
en_kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Diabol’in Jesu khopi thenga apui yin, Houin tingvum asang laiya adinsahin,

tcz: ajah a, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahileh, ki chomlhan!” Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun aseiye, “Aman avantil te nangma hongbit dinga thu apeh ding, chule amahon nangma akhut uva nadop doh dingu chutia chu nangman nakeng phang jeng jong songa nakita khah lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
en_kjv: and saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathen chapa nahileh keleh lha jengin, ‘songa nakisuh khah louna dingin Pathenin a-Vantilte thu pentin akhut’uvin nadom nauvinte,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun nai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thubun hitin jong aseiye, nangman Pakai na Pathen chu lhem patep hih in,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
en_kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseipeh paiyin, “Hitin jong, ‘Pakai na-Pathen patep a na -lhep chatvai louhel ding ahi,’ tin akisun’e,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin Diabol in molsang chungvum a chun apuiyin chule vannoi lenggam jouse le aloupina ho avetsah in ahi.
en_web: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
en_kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin diabol chunmolsang tah khat chunga Jesu apui touvin vannoi leiset lenggam jouse le aloupina chengseu avetsah soh keiyin

tcz: Aman ajah a, “Nangma naboh khup'a chule keima nei houva ahileh, keiman nangma aboncha hi kapeh ding nahi,” atikit in ahileh,
en_web: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
en_kjv: and saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah a, “Kahenga naboh khup’a chibai neiboh le hichengpi hi peng kate.” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah a, “Satan, hichea kon hin potdoh'in. Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun aseiye, nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nahouva chule Amabou najen ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
en_kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
tcz_gospelgo: chutah chun Jesun ajah a, “Chedohin Satan! ‘Pakai na-Pathen chu chibai naboh a, ama jeng bou nahou ding ahi,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun bouve!” atitai.

tcz: Chutah in Diabol chu ache mang in, chuin Vantil te ahung un, Yeshua chu ahung jen le tauve.
en_web: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
en_kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Diabol chun adalhatai. Hichun Vantilte ahungun Jesun angaichatna jouse ahung jenle tauve.

tcz: Yeshua chun John aman tauve tithu ajah phat in, Judea gam adalhan Galilee gama ahung kile kittai.
en_web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
en_kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
tcz_gospelgo: John songkul a akhum’u ajah phat’in Jesu jong Galilee gam langa akikhindoh tai.

tcz: Ama amasatah in Nazareth chen, chuin chu mun chu adalhan, Zebulun le Naphtali gamkai sung Galilee twipi panga, Capernaum khoa aga cheng in ahi.
en_web: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
en_kjv: and leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Nazareth kho dalhan achen, Zebulun le Naphtali gamsung, Galilee dillen pang, Capernaum khoa apansai.

tcz: Hichu Isaiah Themgao kam a Pathen thusei:
en_web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia aum hi Isaih Themgao kama kiseisa;

tcz: “Zebulun le Naphtali gam, twipi pam, Jordan vadung gal'a Galilee gam, chidang nam dang tampi umna mun,
en_web: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
en_kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
tcz_gospelgo: “Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam, Jordan gal’a Twikhanglen lampi; Namtin vaipi chenna Galilee,

tcz: muthim lah a touho chun vah loupi tah amu tauve, chule thina gam le alim a touho chu achung'uva kho avah tai,” ati chu agui lhunna ahi.
en_web: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
en_kjv: the people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim lah a chengten Khovah vah tah amutauvin; Thina muthim gama chengte chunga Kho ahung vah tai,” kiti chu gui lhunna dinga chuti ahi.

tcz: Hichea pat chun Yeshuan thu asei phong in, “Na chonset nauva kon in lung heiyun chule Pathen lama hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anai tai,” ati.
en_web: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
en_kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelaiya pat chun Jesun thu ahil lhanglen, “Van a Lenggam chun ahinphatai, nachonset lung khel’uvin,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat hi Yeshua Galilee twipi pam'a achea avale pet in, aman uchani—Simon, Peter jong kitipa le Andrew in twi lah a len asepet lhon agatoh e, ajeh chu amani ngaman a kivah lhon ahi.
en_web: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
en_kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
tcz_gospelgo: Galilee dillen panga Jesu ava le le pet’in nga man mi ni Peter kitipa Simon le anaopa Andrew Twikhanglen a lensep pet amui.

tcz: Yeshuan amani chu akouvin, “Hung lhon in, kanung hinjui lhon in chule keiman miho iti mat ding ahi navetsah lhon inge,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin ajah lhona, “Neijui lhonin mihem matje hil lhon inge,” atileh;

tcz: Chuin amanin apet tah chun alen lhon adalha lhon in chule Ama nung ajui lhon tai.
en_web: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
en_kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: alen lhon dalhan Jesu ajui pai lhontai.

tcz: Chule Ama chukom'a kon chun ache pai in ahileh, ucha dang mini Jacob le anaopa John kong sunga apau Zebedee toh atou khom uva len akhui phat pet'u aga mun, chuin Aman amani jong chu akouvin ahi.
en_web: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
en_kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ache kit leh ucha chom dang ni, Jacob le anaopa John kiti Zebedee to len anakhui phat pet’u amun, amani jong akouve.

tcz: Amanin chupet tah chun kong le apa adalha lhon in, anung ajui pai jeng lhon tai.
en_web: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
en_kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob le Johnin kong le apa Zebedee dalhan nung ajui lhontai.

tcz: Chule Yeshua chu Galilee gamkai sea akhol jin in, Judah te kikhopna intin ah thu ahil in, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len ahi. Chule Ama chun miho natna jouse le adamlou jouse chu aboldam in ahi.
en_web: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
en_kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Galilee gam pumpia Jesu ache le len japi houkhomna in tin ah thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len, mipilah a nat jat chom choma na ho aboldamin ahi.

tcz: Ama chung chang thu chu Syria geiyin aki thang doh in, hiti chun miho chun ana damlou jouse chu akom a ahin puiyuve. Chule itobang natna le hivei neiya nat thoh lel ho, thilha vop ho le alung chavai ho hihen, chule langthi ho hijong leh Ama koma ahin puiyun, aman amaho chu aboncha uvin aboldam sohkeiyin ahi.
en_web: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
en_kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Syria gam pumpia achung chang thu athangsoh tan, nat jat chom choma naa, natthoh lel, thilhavop, buh thi chule langthi ho jouse Jesu henga ahinpuiyun aman aboldamsoh keitai.

tcz: Ama chena chan a chun Galilee, Decapolis (Khopi som kitina), Jerusalem chule Judea gama kon le Jordan gal lama kon in, mipi tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin ahi.
en_web: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
en_kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judea, and from beyond Jordan.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutjongle Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea gam le Jordan gal langa konin mipi tamtah-in Jesu nung ajuitauve.

tcz: Nikhat hi mihonpi kikhom chu amu phat in, Yeshua chu moul chung a akaldoh in chule atou phat in aseijuite chu akimvel'a ahung kikhom un ahi.
en_web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
en_kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi amu phat’in Jesu molvuma akaltouvin atou leh aseijuite ahenga ahung kikhomtauve.

tcz: Chuin Ama apaodoh in amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pan in, ajah uva asei tai.
en_web: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
en_kjv: and he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesu apaodoh-in mipi thu ahil’in hitin aseiye:

tcz: “Lhagaova vaichaho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amaho'a ahi.
en_web: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lhagaova chimthih neilou ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam chu amahoa ahi!

tcz: Lhasetna neiho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lhamonga umdiu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
en_kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung lengvai ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin alhamon diu ahi!

tcz: Mi lungneng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon leiset chung pumpi alo diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
en_kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Milung neng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon leiset alo diu ahi!

tcz: Thudih a din jeh a gilkel dangchah thoh ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon lung nachimna anei diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
en_kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dei holna gilkel dangchah thoh ho anun nom’ui, Pathen deiya lung nachim diu ahi.

tcz: Mi lungset them ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lungsetna chang diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
en_kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi hebol ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin amaho ahebol ding ahi.

tcz: Mi lungtheng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
en_kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
tcz_gospelgo: Milung theng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.

tcz: Mi sucham ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
en_kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi sucham ho anun nom’ui, Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.

tcz: Adih boljeh a hesohna chang ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amahoa ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dei boljeh a bolset thoh ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam amahoa ahi.

tcz: Kanung jui nahi jeh uva mihon nahouset uva, nabol hesoh uva, jouva nabol'uva chule nang ho douna a thil phalou jouse aseiteng uleh Pathen phatthei boh chang ding nahi uve.
en_web: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
en_kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keima jal’a min nabolset, nahouset’uva chule nang ho douna jouthu le thu gilou ijakai naseikhum tengu leh anun nom nahiuve.

tcz: Nang ho kipah thanom'un chule hapan kipah uvin, ajeh chu van a nasan dingu kipaman alen e. Ajehchu amahon themgao masaho jong chu hitobanga hi anabol hesoh'u ahi.
en_web: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
en_kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang tah a hi nang ho sanga masajo Themgao ho jong anabol setsau ahitai! Kipah-un tha nom’un, van a nasan diu kipaman tampi akikoiye.

tcz: “Nangho leiset chi nahiuve. Hinlah chi chu a alna beitaleh ipin ki alsah kit tantem? Chule ima chan phachom tapon tin, pai mang le miho chotpha bep hiding ahi.
en_web: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
en_kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nang ho leiset chi nahiuve. Chi khu tamtah le ipia ki-alsah kit ding ham? A-al lou teng panna bei ahitan, akipai mang jin, min keng chotphan aneijitai.

tcz: ‘Nang ho vannoi vah nahiuve, lhang vuma khopi kisel theilou tobang chu nahi uve.’
en_web: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
en_kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hid.

tcz: Koiman thaomei avah in chujouleh lo akhu khum jipoi. Hisang chun akhom chunga aki tung in, in sunga um jouse avah chun asalvah jin ahi.
en_web: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
en_kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman thaomei avah-in lo akhu khum ngaipoi, thaomei khom chunga atungin insunga um jouse asalvahsoh keijie.

tcz: Hitobang chun navah uchu miho masang ah kilang hen, chuteng amahon na thilpha bol uchu mu uvin tin, van'a um na Pau chu avahchoi diu ahi.
en_web: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chun navah-u miho masanga kilang hen, chutileh min natoh phat nau muntin, van a um na-pau avahchoi diu ahi.

tcz: “Ipi jeh a hunga kahi nei hekhel hih un. Keima hi Mose Danbu ahilouleh themgao ho lekhajih subei dinga hung kahipoi. Asumang dinga hunga hijo louva, asubulhit a hung kahijoi.
en_web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
en_kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei hi Mose Danthu l eThemgao ho thuhil sumang dia hungin neigel hih hel’un, asumang ding hilouva amolso ding joh a hung kahibouve.

tcz: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, Van le leiset aman masanga Pathen Dan thu chu aguilhun sohkei masang sea, ajem neopen le ajem sipah geiya jong mang lou ding ahi.
en_web: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
en_kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, van l eleiset man kahse le thil jouse bei kah sea Danthu kisun lekhajem neopen le ahalsi khat jeng jong mang lou ding ahibouve.

tcz: Nang man thupeh aneopen na nahsah moa chule midang jong hitia chu nahil'a ahileh, Van gama chu aneopen nahi ding ahi. Hinlah koi hijongleh Pathen Dan thu juiya chule hiche ho chu ahil'a ahileh Van gama alen kiti ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche thupeh lah a aneopen khat susea, midang jong chu tibol dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama aneopen a pang ding, chu tobangma a anit them le midangin anit themna dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama alen a kisei ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah kahil chah nahiuve. Nangho na chonphat nau chu Dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho sanga aphat joh louva ahileh Van gam'a chu nalut louhel diu ahi.
en_web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Danthu them ho le Phrisee ho sanga nathem chan nau achung nun joh loule van aLenggamma nalut louhel diu ahi.

tcz: “Nanghon ipu ipateu jah a, ‘Tolthat hih in, koi hijong leh mithat chu thupi tanna dinga kicha jinga um ding ahi’ tia ana kiseipeh chu naja tauve.
en_web: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
en_kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
tcz_gospelgo: “‘Tol natah lou diu ahi, koi hijongle tol that chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi,’ tia malai mite jah a kiseisa chu najtauve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nangho jah a kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hijongleh khat chunga lunghanga chu athu kitan ding ahi. Nangman koiham khat chu mingol pannabei natileh thutanna mun'a kipuilut ding kicha'a um ding nahi. Nangman mi na gaosap'a ahileh Damun meidil'a kicha a um ding nahi.
en_web: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
en_kjv: but I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle asopi chunga lung hang chan chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi; chu jongle koi ahi asopi jah a, ‘Pananbei’ tia house jouse chu hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa athu kitan ding kipha lam jinga, chule asopi jah a, ‘Panabei mi-ngol’ tia house chan jong damun neidil’a lut ding kicha geova um ding ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman hou in a maicham thilto ding nachoiya, mi koiham khat in nangma kilung doupina nanei na geldoh a ahileh,
en_web: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
en_kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun maicham phunga thiltoh din hung t ajongle chun, chua chu nasopi nachunga lung himona nageldoh leh,

tcz: Maicham mun'a na thilto ding chu dalhan, gachen chuche mi chuto gakicham lhon in, chuteng leh hung in chule Pathen maicham'a kilhaina thilto chu napeh ding ahi.
en_web: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
en_kjv: leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
tcz_gospelgo: maicham maiya nathilto ding dalhan, nasopi chutoh gakicham masan, chujou teng hung kit’in lang thil chu Pathen koma toh-in.

tcz: Na kidoupi chutoh thutanna mun'a dinga na kilhon pina lampia chun, agan na theiyin kihou champi jeng in. Achuti louleh themmo na chanpa chun thutan vaihompa khut a napedoh intin, ama chun amopo khat khut a peson intin, chule songkul a na khumpai ding ahi.
en_web: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
en_kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
tcz_gospelgo: “Naheh pan thutanpu heng nalhut masangin lampia kichampin, achuti loule thutanpa koma nakai lut’in tin, thutan pan songkul ngah pa pehdoh-in natin, aman songkul’a nakhum lo ding ahi.

tcz: Hiti chu hita henlang hileh, nangman achaina pen sum nasah chai masang sea chu itinama jongleh chua kona chu nalha ong thol kit lou ding ahitai.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, paisa nongnai geiya napeh theng hel masangin songkul’a koin potdoh thei pon nate.

tcz: “Thupeh a thu ana kiseisa, ‘Nangman jonbol hih in’ kiti hi nana ja tauve.
en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
en_kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
tcz_gospelgo: “‘Mito najon lou ding ahi,’ tia kisei chu najatauve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hileh numei khat jon lunga ve achu amanu chutoh alunga jong ahitai.
en_web: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
en_kjv: but I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken vang kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle numei jon lung gul’a vea chun alungthima ajonpi ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun namit chu mitpha hikhat tou jongleh hichun na kipal lhuhsah a ahileh, kaldoh in lang paimang jeng in, nangma ding in natibah khat namansah chu na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in aphajoi.
en_web: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
en_kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun namit jelamin nachon setah l ekaldoh-in lan gpai mang jengin; tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin, natibah khat lhin lel ding aphajoi.

tcz: Chule nakhut jetlam in na chonset sah a ahileh sat lhan lang paimang jeng in. Ajeh chu nangma dinga na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in, natibah khat aman chu apha joi.
en_web: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
en_kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakhut jetlamin nachonset sah jong le sat lhan pai mang jengin, tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin natibah khat lhin lel ding aphakoi.

tcz: “Danbua thu kisun, ‘Pasal in ajinu ada ding leh amanu chu dana lekha apeh a ahetsah leh ahithei jenge’ tia kisei chu naja tauve.
en_web: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
en_kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
tcz_gospelgo: “‘Koi hileh ajinu daa chun jida na lekha pehen,’ kitisa ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, mikhat in aji chu pasal dang toh alup khom jeh tilouva thu dang jeh'a ada ahileh, amanu chu ajonsah ahitai: chule koi hi jongleh akidasa numei ki chenpia chu mi jong ahi.
en_web: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
en_kjv: but I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, mito ajonjeh tilouva jida chan chun ajinu ajonso ahin, dasa numei kichenpi jong chu mito jong-ah ahi.

tcz: “Chule malai mite ki seipehsa thu nana jahsau chu, ‘Nangman nakihahsel na chu sukeh hih in, nangman Pakaiya naki hahselna nabulhit tei ding ahi’ kiti ahi.
en_web: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
en_kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
tcz_gospelgo: “Chukit leh, ‘Nakitepna sukeh hih-in, nakitepna jat chu Pakai koma molson,’ tia malai mite kiseipeh chu najatauve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, imachan ki hahsel hih beh un! Van pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu van chu Pathen laltouna ahi.
en_web: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
en_kjv: but I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang nahihahsel louhel diuva kaseipeh nahiuve; van panin kihahsel dauvin, Pathen laltouna mun ahi,

tcz: Chule leiset pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu leiset hi akengto ngapna ahi. Chule Jerusalem pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu Jerusalem hi Leng loupi khopi ahi.
en_web: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
en_kjv: nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset panin jong kihahsel hih-un Pathen kengto ngapna ahi, Jerusalem panin kihahsel dauvin, Leng loupi khopi ahi,

tcz: Ka luchung pan beh a kaki hahsel ding hitante ti hih in. Ajeh chu nangman na samjang khat cha jong nakan sah thei lou chule na vom sah thei poi.
en_web: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
en_kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
tcz_gospelgo: naluchang jong panin kihahsel dauvin, nasamjang khat jeng jong nakansah navomsah theipouve.

tcz: Hinlah naki houlim nau chu ‘Henge, ka nom e ahilouleh ka nompoi’ tia sei chu hi jeng hen. Hi cheng kalval chu agi loupa a kon ahi.
en_web: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
en_kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseiyu chu ahile hijeng hen, ahida l ehida jeng hen; hiche kalval vang hcu Agiloupaa kon ahibouve.

tcz: “Dan thun gim bolna chu atotoh hi ding: Mit khat khel'a mi khat, chule ha khat khel'a ha khat hi ding ahi kiti chu naja tauve.
en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
en_kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
tcz_gospelgo: “‘Mit khel’a mit, ha khel’a ha,’ tia kiseisa chu najatauve.

tcz: Hinlah kaseipeh nahi uve, mi gilou lethuh hih un! Koiham khat in na ngeiphe jetlam abeh'a ahileh, na ngeiphe alang khat jong dopeh in.
en_web: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
en_kjv: but I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Agiloupa chu lethuh hih-un, chusangin nangeiphe jet lem benga chu naveilam jong dopeh-in.

tcz: Chule koi hileh nahehse aum a chule na sangkhol ah alah mang a ahileh na ponchol jong chu pehtha jeng tan.
en_web: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
en_kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
tcz_gospelgo: Hehset’a nasongkhol sung nung lah peh ding gopa chu nasangkhol ponungalenpa geiyin peh than.

tcz: Chule sepai khat in athilpo dia nacham louva, mile khat napui leh mile ni chan gathah peh in.
en_web: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
en_kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile nada nacham louva mile khat napuigoa chu mile ni geiyin kilhonpin.

tcz: Na henga thum ho chu pen, chule nangma koma bat a thum chu kihei mangsan go hih in.
en_web: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
en_kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga thil thuma chu pen, bat ding deiya jong peh louvin koidan.

tcz: “Danbu in, ‘Naheng nakom ngailun’ chule namelma chu hot bol in, tia asei chu naja tauve.
en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
en_kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
tcz_gospelgo: “‘Naheng nakom ngailut’a melma vang nahot ding ahi,’ tia kiseisa chu najatauve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, na melma teu chu ngailu uvin, na gaosap teu chu phatthei boh un, na hotbol teu ding in thilpha bol un, chule nahsah mo tah a nabol teu le na gimbol teu ding in taovun.
en_web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
en_kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Namelmateu ngailu’vin, nabolse jouseu taopehun;

tcz: Hitia na bol uchu nangho van'a um na Pau chate tahbeh nahiu kihetna ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga nisa vah apen, chule mi dih le mi dihlou chunga jong go ajuhsah in ahi.
en_web: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
en_kjv: that ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
tcz_gospelgo: chutilh van a um na-Pau chate nahi theidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga kibangin nisa asat sah gel’in, midih le midih lou chunga go ajuhsah gel’e.

tcz: Nang hon nangailu teu bou na ngailut uva ahileh, hichea chu ipi kipa man nasan diu um ding ham? Kaidong hon jong hitobang chu abolu ahi.
en_web: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
en_kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahimonga jong na-ngailute bou na-ngailut’u leh ipi kipaman namu diu ham? Kaidong chonse hon jong chutia abol’u hi louham?

tcz: Nang ho nagol teu dinga bou na phat uva ahileh, midang to ipi naki kheh nau um em? Hitobang chu milim houhon jong abolu ahi.
en_web: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
en_kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
tcz_gospelgo: Chule nasopi bou nasalam’u leh midang sanga nachungnun nau ipi um am? Pathen heloute jengin jong chutia abol’u hilouham?

tcz: Hijeh chun van a um na Pau chamkim ahi bang in, nangho jong chamkim un” ati.
en_web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
en_kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun vana um na-Pau chamkimsoh banga naphat chamkimsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Chingtheiyun! Midang pachat nachanna diuvin, mipi mu ding in thilpha bol hih un; chutia nabol leu vana na pauva kona kipa man mulou ding nahi uve.
en_web: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Houva nakitah nau miho mu ding deina nabol louna diuvin ching theiyun. Chutia nabol vangu leh van a um na-Pava kona kipaman nanei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ngaichat nei michu thilpeh napeh teng uleh, mi phalhem ho bang in bol hih un; amahon kikhopna in hoa le lamlhong hoa sumkon amut'uvin mi apanpina hou chu miho ahetsah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amaho hin kipaman amu diu abona akimu'u ahitai.
en_web: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
en_kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mi thil napeh teng, mipha lhem hon pachat deinaa Hou thua kikhopna in tin le lam lhong tin’a abol bangun, namasang sanga sumkon kimut bahsah hih hel’in. Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.

tcz: Hinlah nangman koiham khat ngaichat thil napeh tengleh, nakhut jetlam in abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih in.
en_web: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
en_kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi thil napeh tengleh, nathilpeh chu guh thim ahi theina din nakhut jetlama napeh chu veilam jeng jong hetsah dan.

tcz: Na thilpeh ding ho chu guhthim in pen, ijakai aguh-a mua napa chun nangma kipaman napeh ding ahi.
en_web: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
en_kjv: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.

tcz: Nangma natao tengleh, mi phalhem ho banga lamlhong pam leh kikhopna inhoa mitin in amu diu deina a tao nom hoto bang hih in. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, hichu bou ama hon kipaman asan diu chu ahi jenge.
en_web: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
en_kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
tcz_gospelgo: “Natao tengu leh mipha lhem ho toh bang hih-un, amahon mi mu ding deinan Hou thua kikhopna in tin a dindoh a tao le kholai lamkon dunga din a tao ding bou adeiyui. Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.

tcz: Hinlah nangma tao dinga nache tengleh nangma changseh chen lang, na nunglam kot khah in chule guhthima mu napa henga taovin. Chuteng napa, ijakai mupa chun, nangma kipa man napeh ding ahi.
en_web: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
en_kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang vang natao teng, na-indan sunga lut’in, kotpi kikam khumin, mit’a mu thei lou na-Pa hengah guh thimin taojon; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate.

tcz: Nangma natao teng leh, houdang ho bang in naseisa chu avel vel in seikit hih in. Amaho chun taona thucheng aman jiu chu avel vel'a sei jal a ataona chu sanpeh hi dinga aginchat'u ahi.
en_web: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
en_kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
tcz_gospelgo: “Natao tengu le chidang namdang ho bangin tampi kisei chu ajah chom ding ngaiton thu hom keo tamtah seidauvin.

tcz: Nangho amaho toh bang hih uvin, ijeh inem itileh vana um na Pauvin na ngaichat'u chu nathum masang uva ahetsa ahitai.
en_web: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
en_kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho umchan tho hih-un; ajeh chu nathum masanguva jong na-pauvin na-ngai chat jouseu ahetsa ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: Van'a um ka-Pau, namin jatah in umhen.
en_web: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
en_kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: ‘Van’a um ka-Pau, namintheng kijabol jing hen,

tcz: Na lenggam hung lhung loihen, Van'a nalung lhaina aum tobang in lei chunga jong na lung lhaina umhen.
en_web: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
en_kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalenggam hung lhung hen, Van’a bangin leiset’a nalungdei kim soh hen;

tcz: Tunia kangaichat'u anneh neipeu vin,
en_web: Give us today our daily bread.
en_kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunia kaneh khop diu an neh neipeuvin,

tcz: Keiho douna a chonse ho ka ngaidam bang un, keiho chonsetna jong ngaidam in.
en_web: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
en_kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
tcz_gospelgo: Eibolseteu ka-ngaidam bangun, Kasuh khelnau ngaidamin;

tcz: Chule lhepna thua nei nunsah hih un, ahin agiloupa a kon in nei huhdoh uvin.
en_web: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
en_kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset lona thei patepna neilhut dauvin, Agiloupaa konin neihuhdoh jo’uvin,’ tin.

tcz: Nang ho douna chonseho na ngaidam uva ahileh, vana na Pauvin nangho na ngaidam diu ahi.
en_web: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
en_kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
tcz_gospelgo: “Ajeh chu mi suhkhel na-ngaidamu leh van a um naPauvin jong nasuh khel nau ngaidamin te.

tcz: Hinlah midang na ngaidam nom lou uva ahileh, na Pauvin nangho chonsetna angaidam lou ding ahi.
en_web: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
en_kjv: but if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi suh khel na-ngaidam lou vanguleh, na-pauvin jong nasuh khel’u ngaidam ponte.

tcz: “Chule nang hon an nangol tenguleh, mi pha lhem ho bang in ki nguisah hih un, ijeh inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna din amaisou alam dansah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amahon kipaman hichea chu akimu-u ahitai.
en_web: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
en_kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
tcz_gospelgo: “An na-ngol tengu mipha lhem ho bangin ki-nguisah dauvin. Mipha lhem hon vang an angol’uvin, mi het ding deinan amaisou achom sah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.

tcz: Hinlah nang man an nangol tengleh, nasam kipon chule namai kiphet in.
en_web: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
en_kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin vang an na-ngol teng nalu thao kinujol’in, namai kiphet ngimjon;

tcz: Chutileh na anngol chu vana napa tailou koiman hepon tin, guhthim a na thilbol mua na Pa chun kipaman napeh ding ahi.
en_web: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
en_kjv: that thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
tcz_gospelgo: na-anngol chu miho hetsah louvin, guh thima um, na-Pa hetsah in; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate.

tcz: “Nget'in aneh heng thei le ap in asuhmang theina, chule gucha hon asuhset uva akiguh thei nau, hiche leiset chunga hin gou khol hih un.
en_web: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
en_kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
tcz_gospelgo: “Nget le thih-eh suhmang theina, guchan aphet vanga aguh mang theina leiset chunga gou khol hih-in;

tcz: Amavang nget le ap in asuh mang thei louna chule gucha hon jong asuhset uva aki guhdoh theilou nau van'a nagouvu kikhol un.
en_web: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
en_kjv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
tcz_gospelgo: chusangin nget le thih-eh suhmang thei louna, guchan jong aphet vanga aguh mang thei louna van a gou khol jo’uvin.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nagou umna a chu, nalung ngaichat'u jong um ding ahi.
en_web: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
en_kjv: for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nagou umnaa chu nalung cheng jing ding ahi.

tcz: “Namit hi natahsa dinga vahpea pang ahi. Namit aphat pet'a natahsa pumpi hi vahsoh keiya ahi.
en_web: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
en_kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mit hi tahsan meivah ahin, namit chim leh natahsa pumpi vahsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah namit hi aphat lou tengleh natahsa pumpi hi thimsoh jia ahitai. Chule vah neiya na kigel chu, thima hi tahbeh le hiche athim chu iti natsat ding hitam?
en_web: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
en_kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness?
tcz_gospelgo: Namit aphat lou vang leh natahsa pumpi thim jeng ding ahi. Hijeh chun nasunga vah thim taleh iti khoh ding hitam!

tcz: “Mihem koiman pakai ni aneikop theipoi. Ajeh chu aman khat chu thet bol in tin chule khat joh chu ngailun te; nangma khat a naki pehlut ding chule khat joh chu nanah sahmo ding ahi. Nangma Pathen le sum ani gel a lhacha a na pankop thei ahipoi.
en_web: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
en_kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
tcz_gospelgo: “Soh koiman Pakai ni kin abolkop joupoi, kop taleh khat hotbol’in tin, khat joh alungset ding, ahiloule khat’a hakaiya khat joh anahsahmo lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun Pathen kinbol le sum hol kop thei pouvin nate.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun nitin nehkhop ding an ahilouleh, twi ahilouleh ponsil thua nalung kham louna diu kaseipeh nahi uve. Hinkho hi an sanga thupi joa chule na tahsa chu ponsil sanga thupi joa hilou ham?
en_web: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
en_kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichejeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, hinkhoa neh le chah chunga lungkham bol dauvin, tahsa sille chen dingin jong lungkham hih-un; anneh twidon sanga hinkho thupi joa, nihchen ponsil sanga tah sa khoh jo hilou ham?

tcz: “Chunga leng vacha ho khu ven. Ajeh chu amaho khun tula atu pouvin, at la a at pouvin ahilouleh chang pang geiya aneilou vang un, vana um na Pauvin amaho khu avah nai. Chule nangho amaho sanga khu gamchenga na manlut joh'u hilou ham?
en_web: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
en_kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
tcz_gospelgo: Vanlai jol’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle changsal’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle van a um na-Pauvin avah nauve. Vachate sanga khu nang ho manlu jo nahi louvu ham?

tcz: Na lungkham na hou chun, na hinkhou them khat beh ajop saobe theiyem?
en_web: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
en_kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva lungkham hat’a ahinkho tong khat jopbe thei koi nahiuvam?

tcz: Chule sil le chen dinga ibol a lung khama nahiu vem? Lou jaova molhoipah khu ngaito uvin, iti khan'a hiuvin tem? Amaho khun natoh la atong pouvin, aponsil diu jong akibol pouve.
en_web: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
en_kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
tcz_gospelgo: I-bol’a nihchen ponsil jal’a lungkham nahiuvam? Gamlah apahcha ho khu iti khandoh ham gel phauvin, na la atong pouvin, sil ding patse bol’a ponkhong jong ahipouve;

tcz: Ahivang in Solomon chu aloupina jouse pum'in jong hicheho bang'in ahoi joupoi.
en_web: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
en_kjv: and yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong ahao dungjui tah akijep vangin hiche pahcha ho khat hoi bangin ahoi joupoi.

tcz: Chule Pathen in gamlah a pahcha jeng jong tunia uma chule jing le meisunga kilehlut ding bon hibanga hi ajep hoiya ahileh, nangma ding jong thon louva agel khoh ding ahi. Itia hiti loma hi tahsan na neilou nahiu hin tem?
en_web: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
en_kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
tcz_gospelgo: Gamlah hampa tunia kimu, jing teng gop’a meilhum sunga kileh lut ta ding bon Pathenin achuti jep hoi leh, Aman hiche ho sanga najep hoijoh lou diu ham? Vo tahsan lhomho!

tcz: “Hijeh chun ipi kaneh diu, ipi kadon diu? Ipi kachen diu hitam? Tin hiche ho thua hin lungkham hih un.
en_web: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
en_kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun, ‘Ipi kanehuva ipi kadon diu, ipi kasil’uva akchen diu ham?’ tin lungkham dauvin.

tcz: Hiche lunggel ho hin tahsan lou ho lunggel athu nun ahi, hinlah vana umna Pau chun hiti ho jouse na ngaichat uchu ahet ahi.
en_web: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
en_kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek): for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi Pathen hepha louten ahol’un, Nang hon na-ngai chat’u jong van a um na-Pauvin ahesoh keiye.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chung vuma chun Pathen Lenggam hol'un, chule chonpha tah in hing uvin, Aman na ngaichat chan'u chu napeh diu ahi.
en_web: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
en_kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle amasan Pathen dei le alenggam hol masauvin, chuteng adang ho chengse hi nakipehbe dingu ahinai.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun jinga ding in lungkham hih un, ajeh chu jinga ding hung um nante. Tuni gimna chu tuni khoa ding in apha settai.
en_web: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
en_kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Jing dingin lungkham hih-un, jing chun anikhoa ding hinkigel nan e. Nikho khat cheh-in agimpi khop cheh anei nai.

tcz: “Mi koima oimodan, chutile koiman na oimo lou ding ahi.
en_web: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
en_kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
tcz_gospelgo: “Oimo nachan louna diuvin midang oimo dauvin;

tcz: Ajeh chu midang na oimona banga chu, Pathen in na oimo ding ahi. Nangman mi nabolna bang banga chu nachunga kibol ding ahi.
en_web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
en_kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
tcz_gospelgo: mithu nakhol bang banga nathu kikhol cheh ding ahin, midang nabol nau dan dungjuiya kibol ding nahiuve.

tcz: Chule nangma mit a bohse hal um chu boipi louva, ibol a nasopi mit a bohse hal um chu kisah boipia nahim?
en_web: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
en_kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi dinga nasopi mit’a bohsi chu namelchih keova, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu mulouva um nahin?

tcz: Ahilouleh nangma mit a bohse hal um muthei louva, nasopi jah'a keiman na mit a bohse hal um chu na lahdoh peh inge, iti nati thei ham?
en_web: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
en_kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
tcz_gospelgo: Iti jong nasopi jah a, ‘Namit’a bohsi chu neilahdoh sah-in,’ tia nasei ngam a, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu don louva um nahim?

tcz: Vo mi phalhem! Nangma mit a bohse hal um chu amasan kilah doh le chun, nagol mit a bohse hal um chu ki chentah in muthei tan nate.
en_web: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
en_kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo mipha lhem, namit’a thinglong tejen chu kilahdoh masah l echun nasopi mit’a bohsi chu muchenin natin, ladoh thei tan nate.

tcz: Uicha ho khu thil theng pe hih un, chule vohcha ho ang sunga khun twikoh chang jong lehlha hih un, chuti bol leu chun hichu akeng uvin chil'un tin chule hung kile heiyuva nangho jong nahin bah diu ahi.
en_web: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
en_kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rent you.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil theng chu uichate peh dauvin, hung kiheiya nape lou diu ahi; vohchate masanga jong natwikoh chang sep lha hih-un, akengtoa achil thang bep diu ahi.

tcz: “Na thum uchu thum jomun, chutileh na thum uchu nakipe diu ahi; na holu chu holjom un chutileh na holu chu namu diu ahi. Nakiu uchu kiu jom un chutileh nakiu uchu kot ki honpeh ding nahiuve.
en_web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
en_kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
tcz_gospelgo: “Thum’un kipauvin nate, hol’un namudiu ahi; kiuvun nakihonpeh diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu athum chan akipen, ahol chan achang uve. Chule akiu chan kot aki honpeh in ahi.
en_web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
en_kjv: for every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth: and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile athum chan kipe ding, ahol’an amuding akiuva kihonpeh ding ahi.

tcz: Nangho minu mipa ten, na chate uvin changlhah pheng athum leh, hiche khel achu song napeh uvem?
en_web: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
en_kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva achapan neh ding changlhah athum l esong pea,

tcz: Ahilouleh amahon nga thum leu, amaho chu gul nape diuvem? Napeh lou diu ahi.
en_web: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
en_kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
tcz_gospelgo: nga athum leh gul peding koiham?

tcz: Chutia nangho chonset bol hon bon na chateu thilpha man beiya pehje nahet uva ahileh, hisanga chu gam chenga vana na Pau chun akoma thumte chu thilpha manbeiya apeh lou ding ham?
en_web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
en_kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloutah nang hon bon nachateu thilpha pehje nahet’uleh, van a um na-Pauvin ahenga thumte chu itobang tah a thilpha apeh ding hitam!

tcz: Hijeh chun imalam jousea mi dang in iti nabol leu na dei uvem, hitobang chun nang hon jong bol un. Hiche hi Dan bua kisun leh Themgao ho thuhil chu ahi.”
en_web: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
en_kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun min iti nabol le nadeiyum, nang hon jong hitobnagma chun bolpeh-uvin, hitia bolding hi Danthule themgaote thuhil to kitoh ahi.

tcz: “Nangho Pathen Lenggama chu kot jima kona bou nalut thei diu ahi. Ajeh chu manthahna lam lhong chu lenpi tah ahin, chule akot jong jaotah ahin, chua lut ding kilhen'a chu mi tamtah ahiuve.
en_web: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
en_kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
tcz_gospelgo: “Kot jim a lut’un, ajeh chu manna lam chu akot lentah ahin, alampi alenin, mitamtah hichea chun alut’ui.

tcz: Hinlah Hinna kot chu akichi lheh in, chule alampi jong ahah in chule mi lhomcha bouvin akimu diu ahi.”
en_web: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
en_kjv: because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna lam chu akot jong akichin, alampi ahah-in, hijeh chun alut’a mi lhomcha ahiuve.

tcz: “Na heng uva hung jia themgao lhem ho, kelngoi vona kivona ahia asunglam ngei hangtah ho chu kichih theiyun.
en_web: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
en_kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kelngoi phat’a kiphatsah, asung lam ngeihang tah tobang Themgao lhem nahenguva hungji ho koma kichih theiyun.

tcz: Nanghon amaho chu agauva, tichu achon nauva kona na hetdoh thei diu ahi: Mihon lingnang lah a kona lengpi ga alo jiuva, ahilouleh ling phunga kona theichang ga alo ngai jiu vem?
en_web: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
en_kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
tcz_gospelgo: Itobang ahiu atohgauva nahet diu ahi.Ling phunga lengpi theiga kilouva, meithai seltho linga theichang ga ikilou ngaiyam?

tcz: Thingphung pha chun gapha asodoh in, chule thingphung phalou chun ga phalou asodoh ji ahi.
en_web: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
en_kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin thing phung phalou ga aphapoi.

tcz: Thingphung pha chun ga phalou asodoh theipon, chule thingphung phalouvin jong gapha asodoh theipoi.
en_web: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
en_kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingphung phaa ga pha lou ga ngai lou, thing phung phalouva jong ga pha ga ngai lou ahi.

tcz: Hitia chu thingphung gapha sodoh louse chu kiphuh lhua chule mei sunga kileh lutji ahi.
en_web: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
en_kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Aga phalou thingphung jouse chu akiphuh lhun meilhum sunga akileh lutjitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun thingphung chu aga a kona hetdoh theina nanei bang un, miho chu achon nauva kona nang hon ahinau na hetdoh thei diu ahi.”
en_web: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
en_kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu mi atohgauva nahetdoh diu ahi.

tcz: “Keima, Pakai! Pakai! tia eikou tapou chu Van gam lut ding ahipoi. Vana kapa lunglhaina bol ho bou chu lut ding ahi.
en_web: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai, Pakai eiti chan chu van a lenggam lut lou ding, van a um ka-Pa deilam bol’a bou lut ding ahi.

tcz: Thutan nikho leh mitampi chun kajah a, Pakai! Pakai! Nangma min in gaothu kaseiyun, chule nangma min in thilha ho kano doh uvin, chule nangma min in thilbol theina kidang kaboldoh uve atidiu ahi.
en_web: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
en_kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Nikho chuleh mi tamtah hunguva, ‘Pakai, Pakai, keiho namin a gaothu seisa, thilha nodohsa chule thil kidang bolsa kahilouuvu ham? ati diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keiman, ‘Nangho itih in jong kahekha pouve. Pathen dan thu palkeh a nangho, ka koma kon in potdoh'un,’ tia ka donbut diu ahi.”
en_web: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
en_kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng ajah-uva phong tah a, ‘Vo Dan dih lou bolte, kakoma konin potdoh louyun, nang ho kahe kha hih hel’ui,’ kati ding ahi.

tcz: “Kathuhil ngaiya chule jui chan chu koi hijongleh, miching songpi chunga in kisahpa tobang ahi.
en_web: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
en_kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

tcz: Go hungju henlang, twi hungsoh hen chule hui hungnung henlang, hiche inchu hinsu jongleh, songpi chunga kisa ahijeh a chu lhulou ding ahi.
en_web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
en_kjv: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
tcz_gospelgo: Gon ajuh khuma, vadung in aso den a, huipin ahin mut vangin, hiche in chu aluden poi; ajeh chu a-inbul khom songpi chunga kiphut det chet ahi.

tcz: Hinlah ka thuhil ngaiya ahia la juilou chan chu mingol, nel lei chunga insa tobang ahi.
en_web: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
en_kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
tcz_gospelgo: Kathusei hicheng hi ja abol lou vang chu milungthimbei, nellei chunga in kisah toh kitekah ding ahi.

tcz: Go ahung juh a twi chu ahung soa chule hui chun hiche inchu asuh'a ahileh gimnei tah'in alhupai jeng tai,” ati.
en_web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
en_kjv: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Gon ajuh khuma, vadungin aso den a, huipin amut tengleh in chu alhujitan, alhuh chu melse tah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hicheng thu aseijou vin, mipi chun athu hil kidang asalheh jeng uve.
en_web: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun chujat asei chai chaiyin mipin athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jenguvin ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hou lamkai ho thuhil tobanga hillouvin, thunei tah in thu ahil in ahi.
en_web: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
en_kjv: for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile aman Danthu themho hil banga hil louva thunei tah banga ahil jeng thei ahi.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshua mol chunga kona ahung kuma ahileh, mipi atama tam'in anung ajuiyuvin ahi.
en_web: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
en_kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu molvuma ahung kumsuh chun mihonpin ahin juiyui.

tcz: Photlot in, “Miphah khat'in Ama akimu pin chule a-anga abohkhup in, ajah a, Pakai nalung ahileh nei damsah a chule nei thensah thei ahi,” ahung titai.
en_web: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
en_kjv: And behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun miphah khat ahungin akoma bohkhup’in, “Pakai, nalung ahileh neidam theng sah thei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule athamin, “Kalung ahi, dam jeng in, atin ahileh apattah in aphah chu atheng tan ahi.”
en_web: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
en_kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun athamin, “Kalung ahinai damthengtan,” ati leh, apettah chun aphahnat adamthengtai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Hiche thudol hi koima koma seihih in, chusang in nangma thempu koma gachen lang chule aman nave chil hen. Mose Danbua miphah ho athen teng thupehsa thilto ding chu gatoh tan. Hiche hi nathengtai ti ahetna, mipi lah'a na phondohna hiding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
en_kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded for a testimony unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Jesun ajah a, “Koimacha henga seidoh hih hel’in, amavang chen lang Thempu gakivetsah-in, nadamtheng hi phot chetna din Mose thu peh dungjuiyin nathilto ding lom gatoh tan,” tin ahil’e.

tcz: Chule Yeshua Capernaum ahung kile phat in, Rome Sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahung in chule ama chu atem in,
en_web: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
en_kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Capernaum khoa alut chun sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahungtaovin,

tcz: “Pakai, kasohpa alangthia ahin, jalkhun'a alume chule anatna chu athohlel lheh in ahi,” ati.
en_web: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
en_kjv: and saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai, in a um kalhacha chapang khat langthin agen thei lheh jenge,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah a, “Keima hung ingting chule kahung damsah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
en_kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, ajah a, “Hung damsah nang e,” atileh;

tcz: Hinlah sepai jalamkaipa chun, “Pakai, nangman ka-in neihung chotlut peh dinga lhingjou chu kahi poi. Na umna mun'ah thu chu hinsei lechun, kasohpa hi dam tante.”
en_web: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
en_kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
tcz_gospelgo: jalamkaipan adonbut’in, “Pakai, nang hi kei in sunga lut dinga kilom nahipoi, thu mai mai sei jong le chun kalhacha chapang chu dam jeng thei ahinai.

tcz: Hiche hi kahei, ajeh chu keima kachunga thunei lamkai lenho aum in chule keiman sepaite chunga thu kaneiye. Keiman, “Che uvin katileh ache uvin, ahilouleh hung un, katileh amaho ahung uve. Chule keiman kasohte jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol un katileh, amahon abol'uve,’” ati.
en_web: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
en_kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kei jong thunei ho noiya um kahin, kei noiya jong sepaite aum’uvin, khat pen pen jah a, ‘Chen,’ katile achen; achom dang khat jah a, ‘Hungin,’ katil eahunge; chule kalhacha jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol’in,’ katileh, abolji nai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in adatmo lheh jenge. Aman anung juiho jah'a aseiyin, “Thudih tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel ho jouse lah'ah hitobang tahsan hi kamu khapoi.
en_web: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
en_kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no not in Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Athujah hi Jesun kidang asa behseh jengin, anunga hung ho jah a, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Israelte lah jenga jong hitobnag tahsan len kamudoh hih laiye.

tcz: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, chidang namdang ho mi tamtah vannoi mun tina kona hung diu solama kon le lhum lama kona Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh Van gam'a golvah an nea tou ding ahiuve.
en_web: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
en_kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hi jeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, niso lam le nilhum lama kon a mitamtah hung kikhom’uva van a Lenggam a Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob toh ankong aumkhom diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Israel mi tamtah ho adiuva lenggam kigon peh ho chu polam muthim lah'a ale lut dingu, hichea chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
en_kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin lenggam chate dia kigel ho joh chu polam muthim lah a kileh lut diu, hikoma chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan Rome sepai jalamkaipa jah a aseiyin, “In lama kile tan. Ijeh inem itileh nangman na tahsan chu aguilhung tai,” ati. Chule soh khang dongpa chu apattah chun adamtai.
en_web: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Jesun jalamkaipa jah a, “Chetan, natahsan banga lhung ding ahinai,” atipeh-e.

tcz: Yeshua Peter In ahung lhun phat in, Peter jinu nu chu alupna a khosih natna neiya leltah a uma ahi.
en_web: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
en_kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Peter insunga alut leh, Peter nupanu nat lhut’a na a lum agatoh khai.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ama chu akhut athampeh in ahileh, akhosih chun adalhatai. Chuin ama athoudoh in Ama ding chun anneh ding agong in ahi.
en_web: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
en_kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun akhut agah tham leh anat lhut chun alhan, amanu ahung thoudoh paiyin ajen len apangtai.

tcz: Nilhah ahiphat in lhagaoboh vop mi tamtah Yeshua henga ahin pui tauvin. Aman lhagao gilou ho chu thu apen adamlou jouse chu aboldam tai.
en_web: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
en_kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah lamin thillhavop mi tampi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Aman thu cheng khatseh seiyin thilhaho anodoh-in, damloute adamsah soh keitai.

tcz: Hiche hin Pakai thu Isaiah themgao in asei, “Aman inatnau aladoh in chule ihiveiyu ala mangtai,” atichu aguilhunsah e.
en_web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
en_kjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang kiseisa, “Aman inatna jouseu le iveiset chengseu akilah-in apomangtai’” kiti chu guilhunna dinga chutiso ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan mihonpi akimvel'a aum amun, aman aseijuite chu dil langkhat a galkai ding in thu apen ahi.
en_web: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
en_kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
tcz_gospelgo: Akimvel’a mipi kikhom amudoh phat’in Jesun dil gal lang khat’a galkai ding asomtai.

tcz: Chuphat in Hou dan thuhil ho khat in ajah a, “Houhil, na chena chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
en_web: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
en_kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Danthu lekha them khat ahungin ajah a, “Houhil, nache che naa juiyinge,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Sial hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, chule vacha hon gena ding bu aneiyui, hinlah Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong aneipoi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
en_kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Gam-uiten ko aneiyun, chunga leng vachaten bu aneiyui; mihem Chapan mun aneipoi,” ati.

tcz: Aseijui dang khat in ajah a, “Pakai, in a gakile masang ting kapa gavui inge” ati.
en_web: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
en_kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiho lah a khat’in, “Pakai amasan kapa vui din neisol tadin,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan aseipeh in ajah a, “Tun neijui in. Lhagaova thihon ami thiu kivui nau vinte,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
en_kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Neijui jengin, mithi hon athilongu kivui nauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kong sunga alut in, chule aseijuite chutoh dil langkhat panga chun agalkai pan tauve.
en_web: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
en_kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu kong sunga alut’in aseijuiten akilhonpiuve.

tcz: Phutlot chang in, twipi kinong in dil chu ahin nuh in, chule twi kinong ho chun kong chu ahin nuh a ahileh kong sunga aluttai; hinlah Ama a'imun ahi.
en_web: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
en_kjv: And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Hetman louva dilpi chu khopihui hattah-in ahin nuh leh, twi kinongin kong chu achup pai ding ahitai. Jesu vang aihmu nalaiye.

tcz: Seijui ho chu aga che uvin, chule asukhang un, akou un, “Pakai nei huhdoh un, twiyin eichup diu ahitai,” atiuve.
en_web: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
en_kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
tcz_gospelgo: SEijuiten agasukhang loiyun, “Pakai neihuhhing loiyun twiyin eichup lih diu ahitai!” atiuve.
