tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga kicha a nahiu vem? Tahsanna neocha jong nanei lou uham?” ati. Chuphat in Ama aki patdoh in chule huipi le twipi kinong chu aphoh in, chuin phulou helouvin athip paitai.
en_web: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Vo tahsan lhom ho idia chuti kichat nahiuvem?” atin, athoudoh-in khopihui le dillen chu haphoa apho leh athip del jenge!

tcz: Seijui ho chun adatmo lheh'uvin, “Hiche mipa hi koi ham? Huipi le twipi kinong Ama thun anunge,” atiuve.
en_web: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
en_kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon adatmo soh keiyun, “Ipi mi bep hiya hui l edillen geiyin athu angai jeng hitam!” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshua chu dil langkhat pang agei tan, Gadarene gamkai alhung in ahileh lhagaoboh vop minin aki mupi lhon e. Amani chu lhan mun'a chengden lhona chule gilou huham behseh ahijeh lhon a, koiman hiche lam chu ahopa ngam lou ahi.
en_web: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
en_kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu agalkaiya Gadara gamsung alhunin, lhankhuh lah a hung kon thilhavop mi nin akimutopi lhon’e. Thilhavop te ni chu kichat aum behseh jeh-in aumna lhon lampi chu koiman ahopa ngampoi.

tcz: Amani chun ahinsam lhon in, ajah a, “Pathen Chapa, koi nahi hiya neihung suhboiyu ham? Nangma Pathen phat tep masanga hikom muna hi eisugim diuva hunga nahim?” ati lhon e.
en_web: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
en_kjv: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
tcz_gospelgo: Amani apengjah lhonin, “Vo Pathen Chapa, ilo ding neitiu ham? Akitep Phat lhin masanga keiho bolgentheiya hung nahim?” ati lhon’e.

tcz: Mun gamla tah a vohcha hon tampi loujaova lha a um uva ahi.
en_web: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
en_kjv: And there was a good way off from them a herd of many swine feeding.
tcz_gospelgo: Akom’uva kon chun muphah don khat’a hin vohcha tampi hon khat alhai.

tcz: Hiti chun Lhagaoboh vop teni chu atao lhon in, “Nei nodoh diuva ahileh vohcha hon sunga khun neisol un,” atiuve.
en_web: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
en_kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilhahon ahenga, “Neikaidoh tei diu leh hiche vohchate sunga khun neisol’uvin,” tin ataovui.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu thu apen, “Aphai, che uvin,” ati. Hiti chun lhagaoboh ho chu mitenia konin ahung potdoh un, chuin vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, chule vohcha jouse chu abon'un mol pang dillen sunga chun alhai lha uvin, twi lah'a chun alhalut gam tauve.
en_web: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun “Lut tauvin,” ati phat’in, ahung potdoh-un vohchate sunga aluttauve. Chutah chun Vohhonpi chu ha-lhaiyin alhaiyun, kol’ah a alhai lhauvin, dil sunga achomlut soh hel’auvin, twi lah a athidentauve.

tcz: Gancha chinga pang ho chu akoma khopia chun alhai lut un, lhagaoboh vop teni chunga thilsoh thudol chu amitakip aseipeh tauve.
en_web: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
en_kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in vohcha ching ho kho sunga ajamlut’un, thilhavop te ni chunga thusoh le athilmu jouseu agaseisoh tauve.

tcz: Chuphat in khopia miho jouse chu ahung potdoh un, Yeshua ahung kimu piuvin, amahon Yeshua chu ache mang'a chule amaho adalhahna diuvin atem un ahi.
en_web: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
en_kjv: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun kho sung mite abonchan Jesu henga ahungun, Ama chu agamsunguva kona potdoh din ajoltauve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kong khat'a akaldoh in chule dil chu agal kaiyin, ama khomun ahung kiletai.
en_web: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
en_kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu konga alut’in, ahung kile tol galkaiyin khopi sung ahung lhungtai.

tcz: Mi phabep chun langthi khat alupna pum in akoma ahinpui uve. Aman atahsan'u chu amu phat in langthipa jah a chun Yeshuan, “Lung nom in, ka chapa! Na chonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
en_kjv: And behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin mihon pasal langthi khat alupna pumin Jesu henga ahinpuiyui. Jesun atahsanu amuchet phat’in langthipa jah a, “Kihol lel hih-in chapa, nachonset jouse ki-ngaidam ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Hou danthu hil phabep chu amaho le amaho aki hou un, “Hiche hi Pathen taitomna ahi! Ama Pathen a kingaitoa ham?” atiuve.
en_web: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
en_kjv: And behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Danthu lekha them phabep’in, “Hichepan Pathen ataitom’e,” tin agel’ui.

tcz: Yeshuan alung'uva ipi angaitou chu ahen, hijeh chun amaho adong in, “Ipi dinga chutobang lunggel gitlouna ho nalung'uva naneiyu ham?
en_web: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
en_kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
tcz_gospelgo: Alung gel’u Jesun ahen, “Idia hitobang thilse nagel’u ham?

tcz: Nachonset ho kingaidam ahitai, tia sei, ahilouleh ‘Dingdoh in, chule lamjot in’ ti hoijoh baijo ham?”
en_web: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
en_kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Nachonset aki-ngaidamsoh tai,’ ti leh “Thouvin lam jottan,’ ti hoijoh seibai jom?

tcz: Hijeh achu Mihem Chapan leiset chunga chonset ngaidam jouna thaneina aneiye ti photchenna kapeh ding nahiuve atin, chuin Yeshua langthipa lama akiheiyin aseiyin, “Dingdoh in, nalupna kichoiyin, chule in-a chen!” ati.
en_web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
en_kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna tha anei kavetsah nahiuve,” atin, lang thipa jah a, “Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in na-inlam jontan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin ama chu ahung kichop doh thon, chule in-a achetai!
en_web: He arose and departed to his house.
en_kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Langthipa akipatdoh paiyin inlam ajontai.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hin mihonpi chu alungu kichatnan alo dimtai. Chule amahon hitobang tah a thuneina nei, mihem ahinsol jeh hin Pathen avahchoi tauve.
en_web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
en_kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin hiche hi amu phat’un akichauvin, ahinvangin mihemte chunga hitobang thaneina pea Pathen avahchoitauve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua avalea ahileh, mikhat Matthew kitipa chu kai adonna muna atou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin chule kaseijui in pang in,” ati. Hi chun Matthew akipatdoh in anung ajuitai.
en_web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
en_kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hikom chu dalhan ache leh Matthew kiti mi khat a kaidonna mun a tou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” atileh; Matthew akipatdoh-in ajuitai.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin, Matthew in Yeshua le Aseijuite ho toh chun kaidong adang ho chule midang minphatna neilou chonse ho chu jin-gun in a-ina akouvin ahi.
en_web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Matthew in a Jesun ankong aum phat’in kaidong ho tamtah l ethet umtah tah miho ahungun Jesu le aseijuite toh ankong aumkhom’uve.

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee hon hichu amu phat un aseijuite adong un, itia na jilkung pauvin amot mot'a thusei ho toh an aneh khom ham? atiuve.
en_web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
en_kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon hichu amuphat’un aseijuite jah a, “I-bol’a na Houhil pauvin kaidong ho le thet um tah tah ho to an aneh khom ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah phat in, “Mi damthei hon louthem angaicha pouve, ana damlou hon bou angai chauve,” ati.
en_web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
en_kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseiyu ajan, “Midamin louthem angaipon, adam louvin bou angaiye.

tcz: Aman aseiben, “Tun cheuvin chule Pathen Thubun ipi asei ahi ga kihil un: Keiman khotona bou kangeh ahin, kilhaina nabol diu ahipoi. Ajeh chu keima midih a kigel ho kouva hunga kahipon, chonse ahi kihet ho bou kouva hunga kahi,” ati.
en_web: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
en_kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman hepina bou kangeh-in, kilhaina ka-ngeh poi,’ kiti hi ipi kiseina ham gakhiltoh-un. Ajeh chu midohho kouva hung kahipon, chonset kouva hung joh kahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat hi John Baptist seijuiho chu Yeshua henga ahung un chule adong un, ipi iti dana keiho le Pharisee hon an ka ngol jiu tobanga na seijuiten an angol lou-u hintem? atiuve.
en_web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
en_kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
tcz_gospelgo: John seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “I-atileh keiho le Pharisee hon an-ka-ngol mat chet juva, nang seijuiten an ngol khah louvu ham?” tin ahung dongui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Golvah kibolna a jin ho chun moulang toh akipa khom pet'uva alunghem'u ngaiyintem? Chuti ponte. Ahinlah moulang chu nikhat le amahoa kona kipui mang ding ahi, chutah le an angol diu ahi.”
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adon but’in, “Kichen golvahna hung lha ho chu aji neipan alenkhomi laisea lunhham ngaiyam? Amavang aji neipa akom’uva kona akipui mang nikho hung lhung ding ahin, chutengleh kichen golvah a hung lha hon an ngol diu ahinai.

tcz: “Ajeh chu koiman ponsop nem lou ahal chun ponlui abeh jipoi, achutibol le abehna chun hiche pon chu aloi-eh ding ahi.”
en_web: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
en_kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment; for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koiman sopnem loulai ponhal’in ponlui abeh ngaipoi, beh leh abehnan pon lui chu bot-eh jontin, haset cheh lo ding ahi.

tcz: “Chukal valin koiman lengpitwi thah chu abom luiya akoiji poi. Ajeh chu abom lui chu pohkeh intin, chule lengpitwi chu jal ding, akoina bom chu seding ahitai. Lengpitwi thah chu abom thah a ikhum leh ania huhbit a um ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
en_kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle min savun peng lui sunga jong lengpitwi thah akhum ngaipoi, khum ta leh alengpitwi pen gchu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi long jal’a apeng jong mang lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a akikhum jin, lengpitwi le apeng anigel’in ahoidoh theiye,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thuho asei laiyin kikhopna in vaipopa chu ahung in chule amasanga ahung dilsun, “Kachanu tupet tah chun athi” hinlah nangma na hunga chule achunga nakhut na ngap'a ahileh nahinsah kit thei ding ahi, ahungti.
en_web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
en_kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
tcz_gospelgo: jesun hiche hi asei nalaiyin, vaihom pasal khat akom’a ahung bohkhup’in, “Tutah chun kachanu athitai, hinla hungin achunga na khut ngamle chun hingkit teiyinte,” tin ataove.

tcz: Hiti chun Yeshua le Aseijuite chu akipatdoh un, chule amato chun akilhon un ahi.
en_web: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
en_kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akipatdoh paiyin vaihompa to akilhon phat’in aseijuiten jong ajuitauve.

tcz: Chupet tah chun numei khat athilon tang louva gimthoh nu chu anung lama ahunge. Amanu hin apon mongkai chu ahung tham e.
en_web: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
en_kjv: (And behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
tcz_gospelgo: Lampia chun kum som-le kum ni thi longa dammi numei khat hi Jesu nunga ahungin apon mong kai atham’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama nun agel chu, keiman apon mongkai khu thamkha jeng jong leng kadam ding ahi, ati.
en_web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
en_kjv: for she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu kigel’a chu, “Apon mong jeng jong thamkha len gdam inge,” ati ahi.

tcz: Yeshua akihei kimvel in chule aman amanu chu amuphat in ajah a, “Chanu lungthoi hih in! Natasan in nadam thengsah ahitai,” ati. Chuche pettah chun amanu chu adam paitai.
en_web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
en_kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.)
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu agah kihei leh numei nu chu amun, “Kihol lel hih-in chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati. Hiche pet tah chun ama nu adamsel tai.

tcz: Kikhopna vaipopa in a Yeshua alhun phat in mihonpi chu achoh thethu jeng un chule thi opna a kimut theile ging chu ajatai.
en_web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
en_kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu vaihompa in a alut leh thi-opna akuli mut h leh mipi poh chei choiya um amun,

tcz: Amaho jah'a chun, “Potdoh tem un, chapang nu hi athia ahipoi, amahi a-ihmua ahibouve” ati. Hinlah mihonpi chun anuisat tauve.
en_web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
en_kjv: he said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nabonchan potdoh-un, chapangnu hi athi-ah ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve,” atileh amahon amoh nuisat atauve.

tcz: Mihonpi chu polama asoldoh jouvin, Yeshua agalut in chule chapang nu chu akhut a atuh in ahileh amanu chu ahung ding dohtai.
en_web: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
en_kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla mipi adeldoh phat’in Jesu insunga alut’in, chapangnu chu akhut’a akaileh chapangnu athudoh tai.

tcz: Hiche thil kidang kibol thuthang chu agamkai pumpi'ah akithe chansoh tai.
en_web: The report of this went out into all that land.
en_kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thusoh hi chuche gamsungse sea akithangsoh tai.

tcz: Yeshuan numei chapang nu in chu adalhah jouvin, anunga mitcho minin ahinjui peh in, amanin, “David Chapa neikhoto lhon in,” tin asam lhon in ahi.
en_web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
en_kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukom dalha a Jesu acheleh, mitcho mi nin ajui lhon’in, “Vo David chapa neilungset’in,” tin asam lhontai.

tcz: Amani chu aumna insunga ajuilut lhon in, Yeshuan adong in, “Keima hin khomu theina eineisah lhon ding ahi ti natahsan em?” ati. Ama nin adonbut in, henge, Pakai, katahsan lhone, tin asei lhontai.
en_web: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
en_kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung khat’a agalut phat’in mitcho tenin jong ajuilut lhontai. Hichun Jesun ajah lhon’a, “Namit lhon hahsah thei ding monga neitahsan lhon ham?” atileh; amanin jong, “Henge Pakai!” ati lhon’e.

tcz: Chuphat in Aman amit lhon atham in, chuin, “Natahsan lhon jeh a, hung hithei ding ahi” ati.
en_web: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
en_kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Jesun amit lhon athampeh-in, “Natahsan lhon bang in mit hah lhontan,” atileh;

tcz: Chutah in amit lhon ahah in chule kho amulhon tai. Yeshuan amani agih in, “Hiiche thuhi koima seipeh lhon hih in,” ati.
en_web: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
en_kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
tcz_gospelgo: hichun amitlhon ahah paitai. Jesun amani akham chah kheh-in, “Koima hetsah-lhon hih beh-in,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah amani apotdoh lhon in chuin Amin chu agamkai kimvela aseiphong lhon tai.
en_web: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
en_kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitchote ni chula apotdoh lhonin chuche gamkol sungse seah Jesu thudol athechansoh lhontai.

tcz: Amani apotdoh lhon phat'in lhagaoboh vop mikhat pao theilou chu, Yeshua koma ahin puiyuve.
en_web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
en_kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Agah potdoh-u leh thilhavop mi paomo khat Jesu henga ahinpuiyui.

tcz: Hitia Yeshuan lhagaoboh chu anodoh jouvin amapa chu apao theitai. Hichu mi honpin adatmo lheh jeng uvin, “Hitobang hi Israel lah a anasoh khahih hel le,” atiuve.
en_web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
en_kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thilha anodoh peh phat’in paomopa apaothei paitai. Chutah chun mipin kidang asauvin, “Israelte lah jenga jong, hitobang thil akimu kha hih laiye,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee hon, “Aman lhagaoboh chu Lhagaoboh ho Lengpa thahat vanga anodoh ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
en_kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out the devils through the prince of the devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon vang, “Thilha lengpa vanga thilhate adeldoh hichume,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Yeshua chuche gamkaiya khopi tinle khoneo tin a avahlen, akikhop nau inhoa thu ahil in, chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha chu aseiphong in ahi. Chuin Aman hivei ho le ana damlou ho aboldam in ahi.
en_web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
en_kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun khopi jouse l ekhoneo jouse achonsoh keiyin, Houthua kikhopna intin a thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhangin, veise dammo jouse aboldamin ahi.

tcz: Aman mihonpi amu phat'in, Aman amaho chu akhoto lheh e, ajeh chu amaho chu alungdong uvin chule panpi bei ahiuvin, kelngoi achingbei tobang ahiu amudoh in ahi.
en_web: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
en_kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi avet leh alainatpi lheh-e. Ajeh chu achingbei kelngoite bangin gim le da athoh-un, apan hu diu aumpoi.

tcz: Aman Aseijuite koma aseiyin, “Chang at ding atam lheh in, hinlah anatong ding alhom e.
en_web: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
en_kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Chang-at ding atam lheh nan, natonga alhom’e,

tcz: Hijeh chun chang atna lou muna natong ding ahin soldoh theina ding in, lou neipa Pakai henga taovun,” ati.
en_web: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
en_kjv: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
tcz_gospelgo: chang-at ding mi ahinsol be na din chang-at thunei Pakai henga taovun,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan aseijui som le ni ho chu akoukhom in chule amaho chu lhagao gilou ho nodoh theina le hivei namkim le natna ho damsah theina thuneina apen ahi.
en_web: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
en_kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseijui som le ni chu akoukhomin, lhagaoboh ho deldohna ding le dammo veiset jouse boldam theina tha aei.

tcz: Seijui som le ni ho min: Amasapen, Simon (Peter jong akitin), aban Andrew (Peter sopipa), James (Zebedee chapa), John (James sopipa),
en_web: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
en_kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah som le ni ho min chu: amasapenin Peter kisah Simon le asopipa Andrew ahin, adang Zebedee chapa t eni Jacob l easopipa John,

tcz: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew (kaidongpa ahin), James (Alpheus chapa), Thaddaeus,
en_web: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
en_kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alpheus, and Lebbeus, whose surname was Thaddeus;
tcz_gospelgo: Philip l eBartholomew, Thomas, kaidongpa Matthew, Alpheus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus,

tcz: Simon (Zealot mi) chule Iscariot'a kon Judas (ama matsah a pang), hi chengse hi ahiuve.
en_web: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
en_kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Canaan mi Simon, chule Jesu matsah a pang Judas Iscariot-hicheng hi ahiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan seijui som le ni ho hiti hin ahil in: “Nangho chidang namdang ho kom ahilou leh Samaria mite koma che hih un.
en_web: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
en_kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
tcz_gospelgo: Som le ni asoldoh chun Jesun hitin ahilchah-e: “Chidang nam dangte gamsung le Samaria mite khoi ho jot dauvin.

tcz: Pathen kelngoi mangsa Israel te koma bou che uvin.
en_web: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
en_kjv: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoi mang sa tobang Israel insung mite henga chejo’uvin.

tcz: Chule nache nauva Van gam chu ahung naitai ti phongdoh un.
en_web: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
en_kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Nache pum pum’un, ‘Van a Lenggam chun hikom ahin phatai,’ tin samleuvin.

tcz: Ana sudam un, mithi kaithou un, phahvei ho ngimsah un, chule lhagaoboh ho nodoh un. Man beiya kilah a nahi bang un, phaldoh jeng un!
en_web: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
en_kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
tcz_gospelgo: Ana damsah-un, mithi kaithouvun, aphah suthengun, thilha nodoh-un, manbeiya nakisanu ahi, manbeiyin homjal’un.

tcz: “Na sumdip uva sum, na konggah uvah sana dangka ahilouleh sum goi jeng jong kipoh hih-un.
en_web: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
en_kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;
tcz_gospelgo: Nasum dip sunga sana, dangka sumsan kipoh sauvin;

tcz: Kholjin na a sakhau jeng jong akop in pohih un, kengchot ho le tenggol jeng jong kiken hih un chule min najen phat uleh ki phalam hih un, ijeh inem itileh natonga chun aneh ding dol ahi.
en_web: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
en_kjv: nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
tcz_gospelgo: cholam ding sum thumna din sakhao jen gjong kendauvin, sangkhol tho ni ah hih-un, kengchot hihen tenggol hileh kendauvin. Ajeh chu natong’an aneh ding amu lom ahi.

tcz: “Khopi sung hihen, khoneo sung hijongleh nalut nauva chun lhunna theija kilom michu holdoh un chule khosung ho nadalhah kahse uvin hichepa in a chun umun.
en_web: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
en_kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
tcz_gospelgo: “Khopi hihen khoneo hileh naphah phah nauva nalhunsah nom miu holdoh-un, chukom nadalhah kahseuvin umpiuvin.

tcz: In nalut teng uleh phatthei na chu peuvin.
en_web: As you enter into the household, greet it.
en_kjv: And when ye come into a house, salute it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalut lut nau insung jah a, ‘Lungmon leng hen,’ tin salam cheh-uvin.

tcz: Achang dinga kilom in ahiuleh na phatthei nau chu umden hen, kilom lou in ahiuleh phattheina chu nunglah doh un.
en_web: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
en_kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung khattaouvin lamtoa nalhunsah-u leh salam’un lang, nalhunsah nom lou vangu leh salam datauvin.

tcz: Koi insung hihen, ahilouleh khopi sung hijongleh na lamdot lou uva, ahilouleh na thupoh-u angainom lou uleh, na dalhah ding teng uleh nakeng uva vutvai geiyin thing lhauvin.
en_web: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
en_kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung khattou le khopi khattouvin lamto loule lhunsah da akop’uva, nathu seiyu jong angaidau leh, nakengphanguva leivui geiyin thin lhah khum’un dalhauvin.

tcz: Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, thutan nikho teng chuleh chutobang khopin athoh ding chu, gitlouna dim khopi teni: Sodom le Gomorrah thoh gamchenga oljo ding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Thupi tan nikho leh chuche mun mite thoh ding sanga Sodom le Gomorrah khopi thoh baijjo ding ahi.

tcz: “Veuvin, keiman ngeihon lah a kelngoi tobanga kasol nahiuve. Hiti chun gul ho tobang'in chingthei jun chule vapal ho tobang in suhset khoiset neihih un.
en_web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
en_kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
tcz_gospelgo: “Veuvin, ngeihon lah a kelngoi kilha lut banga kasol nahiuve. Hijeh chun gul bangin ching theiyun, vakhu bangin lung nem’un.

tcz: Hinlah ching theiyun! Ijeh inem itileh thutan ho khut a nahin pehdoh diu chule ki khopna in hoa sakol jepna a nahin jep diu ahi.
en_web: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
en_kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
tcz_gospelgo: Chingtheiyun, mihon man’uvin natin Hou vaipoloi kikhopna nakai lut diu, Houthua kikhopna in dunga najep diu ahi.

tcz: Nangho kanungjui nahi jeh uva gam vaipo holeh leng ho ang sunga na chung thu'u kitan ding ahi. Ahin hichu vaipoa pangho le atahsan lou ho henga, keima thu nasei theina diu phat kijentah hung hi ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
en_kjv: and ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima jal’in vaipote le leng ho anga kailut’un tin, hinla amaho le chidang namdangte henga kathupha hettohsah a napan diu ahi.

tcz: Amahon nahin mat teng uleh, iti ka donbut ding ham tin lungkham hih un; nasei diu apettah a Pathen in napeh diu ahi.
en_web: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
en_kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia nakailut tengu leh nasei diu le nasei ding dol’un lung kham hih-un, apettah leh kipenauvin nate.

tcz: Ijeh nem itileh thuseija chu nangho hita louva na Pau Lhagao chun nang hoa kona thu ahin seidoh ding ahi.
en_web: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
en_kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nalunggel mai mai nasei diu ahipon, nasunguva cheng na-Pau Lhagao chun naman chah-uva asei ding ahibouve.

tcz: “Sopi khat chun asopi chu thi dinga apeh doh ding, apa chun acha tahbeh jong chu apehdoh ding chule achaten anule pa adou uva chule athasah diu ahi.
en_web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
en_kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pasal’in asopite aheh lih a, mipaten achate chutima abol diu, chaten jong anu apa adouva athiso cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Chule nanghon keima nung najuijeh uva nam jousen nahin hotbol diu ahi. Hijongleh achaina geiya thoh lhung jou chengse bou chu, huhhing a um ding ahiuve.
en_web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
en_kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima jal’a mitin hot le paiya na-um diu, hinla akhon ni geiya thoh lhumpa bou huhhinga um ding ahi.

tcz: Nang hon khopi khat abol hesohna nato teng uleh, aban khoa jam lut un. Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel kho jouse naphah masang uva, Mihem Chapa hi hung ding ahi.
en_web: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
en_kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi khat’a nabolset tengu khopi chom khat’a jam lut’in, tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve. Mihem Chapa hung kah a Israelte khopi jouse nachotsoh louhel diu ahi.

tcz: “Ahil uva pangpa sang in akihil ho alenjo ngaipoi chule soh ho jong apu sang in alenjo pouve!
en_web: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
en_kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
tcz_gospelgo: “Seijui chu ahilpa sangin achungnungjo pon, soh jong apu sangin achungnung ngaipoi.

tcz: Akihil ho chu ahilpau to abah uva chule soh ho jong apu uto abah diu chu phaset ahi. Chule keima insung pumpi neipa bon lhagao bohho lengpa eitiuva ahileh, ka insung mite chu hisanga phamo joa akou diu ahi.
en_web: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
en_kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
tcz_gospelgo: Seijui chu ahilpa tobang bep ahiya, soh apu toh abah joule aphaset ahi. Ainneipa bon Beelzebul ahisah ngamu leh a-insung mite ipi ahisah da diu ham?

tcz: “Hijongleh nagih uva pang ho chu kicha hihbeh un. Ajeh chu akisel guh jouse ki phondoh phat hung lhug ding ahi. Chule aguh a kisel jouse jong mi jouse het a um ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
en_kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mihem kichah hih-un. Ajeh chu phondoh louva sel mang ding aumpon, hetdoh louva im-mang ding jong aumpoi.

tcz: Tua keiman muthim lah a kasei hi, kho ahungvah tengleh lhang phonga ki phongdoh ding ahi. Keiman na koluva thol a kasei hi mi jouse jah dinga, in chunga kisam doh ding ahi!
en_web: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
en_kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthima kaseipeh-u hi khovah a naphonjal diu, guh thima kahil’u hi intingvuma naphonjal diu ahi.

tcz: “Na tahsau that go ho kicha hih un, amahon na lhagao atongkha thei pouve. Pathen bou ging un, Ama chun na lhagao le na tahsau asuhmang thei chule damun a akoi thei ahi.
en_web: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
en_kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa sunmang thei jongle lhagao that thei lou chu kichat dauvin, chusangin tahsa le lhagao akop’a damun a sol a sumang thei Pathen joh ginguvin.

tcz: Inva nin ijat amat na het em? Paisa khat man bou ahi. Hinlah inva khat jeng jong na Pau het louva leiset a lhalou ahi.
en_web: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
en_kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Vasah ni paisa khatseh man a kijoh ji lou ham? Ahivangin na Pau phatsah louva khat jeng cha jong tol’a kimoh selhah lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nalu uva nasam jang'u geiya kisim ahi.
en_web: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
en_kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho jong nalujang sam jouseu geiya simtohsa kikoi ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun kicha hih un, inva ho aboncha uva sanga manlu joa nahiuve.
en_web: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
en_kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kicha hih-un, vahsah ho sanga manlujo nahiuve.

tcz: “Hiche leiset chunga Keima mipiho lah a eiphongdoh a chu, Keiman jong vana Kapa ang sunga Ka phondoh ding ahi.
en_web: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi hile japi lah a Christa mi ahi kiphongdoh chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaphondoh ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche leiset chunga hi koi hijongleh, ei seilep chan chu Vana um Kapa ang sunga kaseilep ding ahi.
en_web: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hi leh Christa mi ahina japi lah a immang chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaseilep ding ahi.

tcz: “Keima leiset a hi chamna hinpo lut ding in nei gel hih un! Keima chamna poa hung hijo louvin, chemjam joh kahin poh ahi.
en_web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
en_kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
tcz_gospelgo: “Leiset chunga chambol’a hungin neigel dauvin, chambolma lah chemjama kidouna dinga hung kahibouve.

tcz: ‘Mikhat chun apa adou ding chule achanu chun anu adou ding, chule mounu tah chun atehpi adou dinga hunga kahi,
en_web: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh Mihem Chapa chu cholngah nikho chunga Pakai ahiye,” ati.
en_web: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
en_kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa hi Choldo nikho Pakai ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan akikhop nau in chu ajon paitai.
en_web: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
en_kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
tcz_gospelgo: Hikom chu dalhan Houthua kikhopna in khat’a Jesu aluttai.

tcz: Chu muna chun khut ngoi khat amudoh in ahi. Pharisee ho chun Yeshua adong un, “Cholngah nikhoa ana damsah na chu dan in aphal em?” atiuve. (Amaho chun Aman aphal'e tin seihen lang Ama themmo chansah na kinei hen atiu ahi).
en_web: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
en_kjv: and behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikhopn ain a chun pasal khut lang ngoi khat ana umin, alah-uva chun Jesu thilbol dihsah lou jeh a hehse nom mi phabep jong aum’e. Amaho hin, “Choldo nikhoa damlou boldam hi Danthu to kikal hilou ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Chuin Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon kelngoi khat twikul a cholngah nin lhalut hen lang hileh, lahdoh tei ding nagon lou diu ham? Thon moa na gon diu ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?
en_kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Choldo nikhon nalah-uva koiham khat kelngoi kokhuuh a lahlut taleh aneipan agakaidoh lou ding ham?

tcz: Chule kelngoi khat sanga mihem khat ichan geiya lujoa hitam? Tahbeh in cholngah nikhoa mikhat in thilpha abol ding chu dan in aphal ahi,” ati.
en_web: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
en_kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hi Kelngoi sanga gam chenga mantamjo ahi! Hijeh chun i-Danthuu hin Choldo nikhoa mi kithopi ding aphal’e,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Aman mipa jah'a chun, “Nakhut domin” ati. Hiti chun aman jong akhut adom in ahileh adamtai.
en_web: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
en_kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesun khut lang ngoipa jah a, “Nakhut langin,” ati. Khut ngoipan alhandoh jen gleh adamtan, adamlang bep bep ahitai.

tcz: Chuphat in Pharisee ho aki khom uvin, Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti tohgon anei tauve.
en_web: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
en_kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Pharisee h apotdohun Jesu thana ding akihousomtauve.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ipi agonu ahen, hiche mun chu adalhan chule mi atama tamin anung ajuitai. Amaho lah a ana damlou jouse aboldam in ahi.
en_web: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
en_kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all,
tcz_gospelgo: Ama than ding akihousomu ahet doh phat’in Jesu chukom dalhan apotdoh le japin ajuitauve. ana jouse aboldamin

tcz: Hinlah aman amaho chu koi ahi aphondoh louna ding un ahil chah in ahi.
en_web: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
en_kjv: and charged them that they should not make him known:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thusim chu midang aseipeh da diuvin ahilchah-e.

tcz: Hiche hi Isaiah thusei Ama chunga agui lhunna ahi.
en_web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
en_kjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang thil hi Isaiah Themgao kama kiseisa:

tcz: Ka lhacha Ka lhendoh hi ven, Amahi Ka cha deitah, Ka lung lhaina tah ahi. Keiman Ka Lhagao achunga kakoi ding, chule Aman chitin namtin lah'a dih tah'a thu atan ding ahi.
en_web: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
en_kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, kalhentum lhacha deitah, Kadeitah le kalung lhaina pen! Achunga ka-Lhagao chensah ingting, Chitin namtin lah a kathutan aphondoh ding ahi!

tcz: Aman doumah abollou ding, kisenlou ding, jalah a awsanga thu asei lou ding ahi.
en_web: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
en_kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
tcz_gospelgo: O-sanga mi anelkal lou ding, Kholai dunga jong lhang asap lou ding;

tcz: Aman pumpeng chip jong aheboh pailou ding ahilouleh khoilu thaomei kihal khu atha mit pai lou ding ahi. Aman thudih'a thutan chu jona aumsah kahsea ding ahi.
en_web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
en_kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahlelte dia nun nem ding, Panpibeite akhoto ding ahi! Dan dihtah a thu akitan kahsea Adou dou jeng ding ahi!

tcz: Chule Amin chu vannoi pumpi kinepna hi ding ahi.
en_web: In his name, the nations will hope.”
en_kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule namtin vaipin akineppi diu,” kiti chu guilhunna dia soh ahi.

tcz: Chujouvin lhagaoboh vop khat, ama chu mitcho le pao theilou ahin, Yeshua koma ahin pui tauve. Ama chu adamsah'in ahileh thu asei theiyin chule kho jong amu tai.
en_web: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
en_kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin thilhavop mitcho paomo mi khat hi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Jesun aboldam phat’in apao theiyin kho amutai.

tcz: Mi honpi chun adatmo uvin chule adong tauvin, “Hiche Yeshua hi David Chapa Messiah chu hi talou ding ham?” atiuve.
en_web: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
en_kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is this the son of David?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thil kidang bol hi japin adatmo behseh jengun, “Hichepa hi David Chapa hi-ngap ding hitam?” akitiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee ho chun thil kidang kibol thu ajah phat un, asei un, “Aman lhagaoboh ho anodoh datmo hih un. Aman athanei na hi lhagaoboh ho lengpa Satan thahatna kon ahibouve,” atiuve.
en_web: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
en_kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat’un, “Thilha lengpa Beelzebul thahat’a thilahte anodoh hichu me!” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan alunggelu ahen, chuin adonbut in, “Lenggam ama le ama kidou amah thahjin, chule khopi hihen insung hijongleh akidou chan chu ding jou lou ding ahi.”
en_web: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
en_kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
tcz_gospelgo: Alunggel’u ahet phat’in Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kilang khen a kidouto lenggam tapou mangthah ding, ki lang khen a kidouto khopi hihen insung hi jong le mangthah vah ding ahi.

tcz: Chule Satan in Satan anodoh a ahileh, amale ama kikhen tela chule kidouva hiding, a lenggam chu ding doh joulou ding ahi.
en_web: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
en_kjv: and if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
tcz_gospelgo: Satanin Satan anodoh leh akilangkhen ahitauvin, alenggam beivah ding ahitai.

tcz: Chule Keima Satan in thahatna eipeh ahileh nalah uva, lhagaoboh nodoh ho khula? Amahon jong lhagaoboh ho anodoh-u ahin, hijeh a chu na thusei uva chu themmo nahin chan diu ahi.
en_web: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
en_kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilha lengpa Beezebl thahat vanga thilhate nodoh a neiseiyu leh naseijui teuvin koi thahat vanga anodoh-u ba ham? Namo nau phongdoh a naseijuiteu pang diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Keiman Pathen Lhagao jal a lhagaoboh ho kanodoh a ahileh, Pathen Lenggam chu nalah uva hung lhunga ahitai.
en_web: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
en_kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Lhagao vanga thilhate nodoh kahi vang leh Pathen Lenggam chu nalah-u lhung ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Satan tobang leuva hat mi khat in athanei tah galut a chule aneiho gachom ding koi ham? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akan tuma chule a in chu aphet lhahpeh ding ahi.
en_web: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
en_kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mihat insunga lut chun ama somkon masa louva kon anei achom thei ngaiyam? Inneipa asomkon jou tengle bou anei achompeh ding ahi.

tcz: “Koi hijongleh Keima lama pang lou chun eidou ahi, chule koihileh Keima toh tong khom lou chun Keima douna a na atoh ahi.”
en_web: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
en_kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi hileh eipanpi lou chu eidou mong ahin, eilhoh khomhu lou mi chu athecheh a pang ahibouve.

tcz: “Ka seipeh nahiuve, itobang chonset kibol hihen chule Pathen taitomna thusei doh hijongleh kingaidam thei ahi; Lhagao Theng taitomna athusei doh vang ki ngaidam lou ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
en_kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte chonsetna le Pathen ataitom nai itobang hijongl eki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Mihem Chapa douna a thusei doh koi hijongleh ki ngaidam ding ahi, hinlah Lhagao Theng douna a thusei doh ho chu hiche vannoiya hihen, ahilouleh ahung lhung nalai ding vannoiya hijongleh ki ngaidam talou ding ahi.”
en_web: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.
en_kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa douna thusei jong ki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang hcu itih chan a jong ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi!

tcz: “Thingphung khat chu agan aphotchet ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat'a ahileh aga pha ding ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat louva ahileh, aga phalou ding ahi.
en_web: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
en_kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thingga pha deiyan thing phung pha nei angaiye, nathing phung aphat loule thingga phalou nanei ding ahi. Ajeh chu thingphung hi agan akihei.

tcz: Nangho gul chilhah ho! Mi gilouvin thupha le thudih iti nasei thei diu ham? Ajeh chu na lunguva nagel lhah chan uchu ipi hijongleh na phondoh ahitai.
en_web: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
en_kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
tcz_gospelgo: Gulse guiya peng ho, gitlou puma iti thupha nasei theidiu ham? Ajeh chu lungsung alet teng kamsunga hungpotdoh ahibouve.

tcz: Mipha khat chun alung gela thilpha kikhol jeh'a apha chu ahin phondoh ahin chule mi phalou khat chun alung gela thil phalou akikhol jeh a aphalou aphondoh ahi.
en_web: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
en_kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan athilpha kholna lung sunga konin thipha asodoh jin, misen athilse kholna lungsunga konin thilse asodoh jie.

tcz: Chule hiche hi ka seipeh nahiuve, mohthu nasei chengse chungchang thu chu thutanna nikhoa napeh ding ahi.
en_web: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
en_kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh masah nahiuve, thupi tan Nikho leh mintinin manlou thu asei jouseu geiya asuhto soh kei diu ahi.

tcz: Nathusei ho chun nathem chan ahilouleh na themmo chansah ding ahi.” ati.
en_web: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
en_kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseisau thu hoa chu nathem namo nahcung thu kitan diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat hou dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho Yeshua henga ahung un chule aseiyun, “Pu, na thuneina photchet na nangma a kon'in melchihna kidang khat kamu nom uve,” ahung tiuve.
en_web: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
en_kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu them phabep le Pharisee phabep’in Jesu jah a, “Houhil, thil kidang nabol kavetnom’ui,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Khang gilou le chon thanghoi khang miten melchihna ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khatbou kapeh ding chu Themgao Jonah melchihna hiding ahi.
en_web: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
en_kjv: But he answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu a-eojah-in, “Pathen hephaloute leh khang gilouva miten melchihna nahol’um? Jonah Themgao melchihna itlou melchihna dang kipelou ding nahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Jonah ngapi oisunga ni thumle jan thum aum banga, Mihem Chapa hi leilai gil a ni thumle jan thum um ding ahi.”
en_web: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
en_kjv: for as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngapi oisunga Jonah nithum le janthum athamden banga Mihem Chapa jong leiset Lailunga nithum le janthum thamden ding ahi.

tcz: “Thutan nikho teng leh Nineveh mite hung dingdoh uva, tulai khang mite hi themmo ahin chan diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Jonah thusei phonga chun lung aheiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon lung nahei nom deh pouve.
en_web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
en_kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupi tan nikho leh Nineveh kho mite chu hiche khang mite toh hung ding khom’uva themmo achan diu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Nineveh kho miten Jonah thuseu ajah phat’un chonset lung aheiyui; hinla veuvin Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e!

tcz: Sheba Lengnu chu thutan nikho tengleh tulai khang mite douna a hung ding'a themmo ahin chan ding ahi, ajeh chu ama mun gam latah a kon in Solomon chihna thu ngaidin ahung e. Tuhin Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon asei nangai pouve.
en_web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
en_kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupi tan nikho leh Sheba lengnu chu hiche khang mite toh idng khoma themmo achan ding ahi; ajeh chu leiset kolmang lang peh a konin Sheba lengnun Solomon chih thusei ahung ngai gunset theiye; tunla veuvin Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e!

tcz: “Lhagao phalou chun mikhat chu adalhah tengleh gamthip a aga chen, choldona ding ahol len, hinlah amu joupoi.
en_web: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
en_kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lhagaoboh hi mihem sunga apotdoh teng gamgo lah a avah len choldo mun ahol lelen, mu la amuji poi.

tcz: Chuteng aman aseiyin, ‘Keima ka hung potdohna pa koma gaki lekit tange ati. Hiti chun ahung kile kit in ahileh ahung dohna in chu koima ana umpon, ki theh ngim le kitup keicha aum chu amun ahi.
en_web: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
en_kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengleh, ‘Kahung potdoh namun ma ma a lut kit tange,’ atin, ahung kile kit leh, mihem chu sagoh keova kithen ngimsel’a um amun,

tcz: Chutah in lhagao chun ama sanga phaloujo lhagao sagi chu aga mun, chule mihempa sunga chun alut un acheng den tauve. Hiti chun ama chu masanga sang in akhohsejo chehtai.’ Hichu tukhang gilou mite hin, ahin hetchet diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
en_kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
tcz_gospelgo: ache kit’in ama sanga khohjo lhagaoboh sagi ma agapui ben, mihem sunga chun alut’un achenpha tauve; chutah chun mipa umchan hi amasa sangin akhoh cheh tai. Hiche khanga migiloute jong hung chuiti diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan mihonpi henga thu aseipet in, anule asopi pasal ho ahung un, polama aumun, akihou limpi nom uvin ahi.
en_web: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
en_kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi jah athu asei nalaiyin anu le asopite ama to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah angah-ui.

tcz: Chuphat in mi khat in ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopi pasal ho polama ading un, namu nom uve,” tin ahung seiyin ahi.
en_web: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
en_kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun mi khat hin Jesu jah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopite nang to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah na-ngah-ui,” atipeh-e.

tcz: Hinlah Aman adonbut in chule ajah a aseiyin, “Koiham Kanu? Chule koiham Kasopi ho chu?” ati.
en_web: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
en_kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah a thuseipa jah a Jesun, “Kanu koi hiya, kasopite koi koi hiuvam?” atin,

tcz: Chuin aman akhut chun aseijuite lam akoh in aseitai, “Veuvin, Kanu le Kasopite hohi!
en_web: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
en_kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: aseijuite akoh-in, “Ven kanu l ekasopite hi!

tcz: Ajeh chu Koi hijongleh Vana um Ka Pa lunglam bol ho chu Kanu, Kasopipa chule Kasopinu te ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
en_kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu koi hileh van a ka-pa lungdei bol’a chu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin hiche ni chun Yeshuan in chu adalhan chule dillen pama chun atouvin ahi.
en_web: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
en_kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

en_web: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
en_kjv: for this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche nam mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Akolseh gam’un, amit’u achosoh tai; Chutilou leh mit’in mu’vin tin naa ajah diu, kadamsah diu ahi,’ ati chu guilhung ahitai.
