en_kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
tcz_gospelgo: “Van a lenggam chu loulaiya gou kiselguh, mi khat’in amudoh a, ima akhu khuma kipah tah a chea anei jouse joh a hiche lou chu kichoh jeng tobang ahi.

tcz: “Chujongleh Van'a Lenggam chu kivei mi khat in twikoh chang manlutah ahol tobang ahi.
en_web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
en_kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
tcz_gospelgo: “Van a Lenggam chu sumkolvei min twikohchang manlu tah ahol tobnag ahi.

tcz: Aman twikoh chang man lutah chu amudoh phat in anei jouse ajoh doh in, chule lou chu achotai.”
en_web: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
en_kjv: who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikohchang chu amudoh phat’in acheloiyin anei jouse ajoh-in twikohchang chu achotai.

tcz: “Chule Van'a Lenggam chu nga matna len twi lah'a kiseplha a chule nga jouse man tobang ahi.
en_web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
en_kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
tcz_gospelgo: “Van a LEnggam chu min Twikhanglen lai lunga len aseuva nga tin nga tang amat khomu tobang ahi.

tcz: Len chu adimset phat in, hichu vapama aloidoh uvin, atou khomun chule nga aphaho chu aboma akoiyun, hinlah aphalou ho chu apai mang tauve.
en_web: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
en_kjv: which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
tcz_gospelgo: Len chu nga adim phat’in akaidoh-un, atoupin nga pha jouse paipeh sunga akhol’un, manmo chengse apaitauve.

tcz: Vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi. Vantil ho hunguvin tin michonpha hoa konna mi gilou ho ahin chom khendoh dingu ahi.
en_web: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
en_kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi khang kichai nikho jong chutobang ding, Vantilte kon’un tin midih lah a migiloute alhendoh diu,

tcz: Miphalou ho chu mei deujeju sunga chun lehlut uvintin, hichea chu kana le hagelna umding ahi.”
en_web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
en_kjv: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: meilhum deuje ju sunga alelut’uva, hikoma chu kap l ehagel gel’a um diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche hohi aboncha nahet nah uvem? atileh amahon “Henge,” atiuve.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Hicheng hi nahet chet tah-um?” atileh; Mihon, “Henge,” atiuve.

tcz: Chujouvin aman aseiben, “Van'a Lenggama Hou thuhila pang seijui hung hi ho hi, in neipan aneikholna muna kona Thutah gou alui le athah ahin pohdoh tobang ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
en_kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah-uvah, “Hijeh a chu Danthu them mi Van a Lenggam dia seijuiya pang chu akholna in a kona thil thah le alui hinpo doh doh jeng in neipa to bang ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche thusimho le vetsahna ho ahil jouvin, aman chuche gam chu adalhan,
en_web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
tcz_gospelgo: Thulem hijat asei jou phat’in chukom dalhan

tcz: Achenna khopi Nazareth lama ahung kiletai. Aman amaho hou kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet'in amitakip in adatmo uvin chule aseiyun, “Hoiya kona hiche chihna le thil kidang boltheina hoiya thaneina akilah ahidem?” tin asei-uve.
en_web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
en_kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun akho ajonin, Houthua kikhopna in dunga thu ahil le leh, mihon kidang asauvin, “Hitobang chihna l ethaneina hi houya akilah ham?

tcz: Amahon anoisebol uvin, “Ama thing thembol chapa ahi, anu Mary le asopi pasal ho—James, Joseph, Simon le Judah abonun ihecheh uve.
en_web: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
en_kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi thingthem bolpa chapa hilou haimo? Anu min jong Mary kitia, asopite Jacob, Joseph, chule Simon l eJudas hilou ham?

tcz: Asopi numeiho jouse jong ilah uva aumcheh uvin. Hiche ho jouse hi hoiya kona akihetdoh hintem?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
en_kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
tcz_gospelgo: Asopi numei ho jong ilah-uva cheng ahimeu? Hijat chihna le thaneina hi houya akilah hintem?” atiuvin,

tcz: Chuin amaho chu hatah in alung-lhalheh uvin, chule Ama atahsan nomta pouve. Chuphat in Yeshuan amaho aseipeh in, “Themgao chu ama insung le akhopia mite lah tilouvin mun jousea jabolna achange,” ati.
en_web: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
en_kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: asanda gam tauve. Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Themgao chu akho sung le a-insung tilou mundanga vang akija bol tei nai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin thil kidang themkhat bou aboltai.
en_web: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
en_kjv: And he did not many mighty works there, because of their unbelief.
tcz_gospelgo: Atah san loujeh-un hikoma chun Jesun thil kidang tampi abolpoi.

tcz: Galilee vaipopa Herod Antipas hin Yeshua thu ajah phat in.
en_web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
en_kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin gambih vaipo Herod-in Jesu thudol kithang ajan,

tcz: Aman asemang ho koma chun, “Hiche hi Twilutsah John athia thoudoh kit'a hitei inte! Hijeh achu hitobang thil kidang hohi aboldoh ahi,” ati.
en_web: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
en_kjv: and said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
tcz_gospelgo: alhachate jah a, “Hichepa hi athisa John Baptist chu thoukit hitei ding ahitai; hijeh a chu hitobang thil kidang ho hi abol thei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ajeh chu Herod in John chu ajinu Herodias (Herod naopa Philip ji ana hi) lung holna'a amat a songkul'a ahen ahi.
en_web: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
en_kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod hin anaopa Philip jinu Herodias thumop jal’a John chu songkul’a anakhum ahi.

tcz: John chun Herod jah'a “Amanu na ki chenpi hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi,” atipeh jing anahi.
en_web: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
en_kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu John hin Herod jah a, “Herodias nakichenpi hi Dan ngai ahipoi,” tia anaphosa ahi.

tcz: Herod chun John chu atha nom ahin, hinlah mipin adou diu chu kicha'a ahi, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgao khat ahi tia atahsan'u ahi.
en_web: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
en_kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod-in John anatha nom vangin mipin John hi Themgaova agel jeh-un tha jeng ding akichai.

tcz: Hinlah Herod in apen nikhoa golnop abol nauva, Herodias chanu alam chun ama alunglhai lheh jeng in.
en_web: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
en_kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod pen nikhon Herodias chanu japi lah a ahung lamin, Herod alung lhaisah lheh-e.

tcz: Hijeh chun amanu hin adei chan ipi hi jong leh pe dinga Herod in kitepna anei ahi.
en_web: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
en_kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Herod-in, “Ipi hijongle nadeipen pen kapeh jeng ding nahi,” tin aki hahselin akiteptai.

tcz: Anu ngeh dungjuiyin, “Nungahnu chun, keiman Twilutsah John luchang chu lheng konga kadeiye,” atitai.
en_web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
en_kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
tcz_gospelgo: Anu thumop dungjuiyin Herodias chanun, “Tutah-in John baptist luchang chu kongin hindomin neipen,” tin athumtai.

tcz: Chuphat in lengpan thu-asei chu akisih in, hinlah jin gunho masanga akitepna ahijeh chun, aman aki ngehna bang chun bol ding in asoltai.
en_web: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
en_kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oaths’ sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa alung kham lheh jeng nan, ankong phunga atoupi ho angsunga akitepna jeh chun John luchang apeh tei din anomtai.

tcz: Hiti chun Twilutsah John chu songkul'a alu atantai.
en_web: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
en_kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi asol’in Songkul’a John luchang agatansah-in,

tcz: Chuin alu chu konga ahung kidom in chule nungahnu chu apen, ama chun anu apetai.
en_web: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
en_kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
tcz_gospelgo: John luchang chu ahindop’uva nu-ngah chu agapeh-u leh, aman anu agapetai.

tcz: Khonung in, John seijui ho chu ahung un atahsa chu ahung lauvin chule avui tauve. Chutah in amaho aga che uvin, chuin Yeshua jah'a ipi soh a ham ahung hil tauve.
en_web: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
en_kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: John seijuite hunguva John long chu agavuiyu ahi; chujouva hunguva Jesu ahung hetsah-u ahiye.

tcz: Yeshuan thusoh chu ajah jah in, Ama munchom beh a konga aga chen, achanga aga umtai. Hinlah mipi chun hoilama chea ahi ahe uvin, chuin khopi tin'a kon in Ama chu akeng in ajui tauve.
en_web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
en_kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
tcz_gospelgo: John kibolna thusim ajah phat’in Jesun chukom dalhan achangseh-in gamthip laiya din kongin akitol tai. Mipin achedoh ahet phat’in akhopi chenguva konin ahungun Jesu nung ajuitauve.

tcz: Yeshua chu konga kona ahung kumlhah a ahileh mi honpi chu amun, chule Aman amaho chu akhoton chule anat nau adamsah tai.
en_web: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
en_kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu konga kona vaokama ahung potdoh leh mipi atoh paiyin, avet leh alainatpi lheh kengin, adamlou ho chu aboldamtai.

tcz: Hiche nilhah chun seijui ho ahung un chule aseiyun, “Hiche lai mun hi mun ningkoi ahin chule phat hi geisanga ahitai. Nangman mi honpi hi soldoh tan, amaho ache uva khotin'a aneh diu akichoh theina ding un,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
en_kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah phat’in aseijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “Hikom la gam thip lai ahin, nisa ma lhum pai ding ahitan, akho khoa acheuva neh ding agakichoh na diuvin mipi hi sol ngap tan,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hichu hithei ponte, nanghon neh ding peuvin,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
en_kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, ‘Ache louvu akhoh poi, nang hon neh ding peuvin,” ati.

tcz: Amahon adonbut uvin, “keihon changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni bou kaneiyuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
en_kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiten ajah a, “Changlhah pheng nga le nga ni seh bou kanei yui,” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiyin “Hichu hin choiyun,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
en_kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Changlhah le nga chu hinchoiyun,” atin;

tcz: Chutah in aman miho chu phoilah'a tou ding in asei pehtai. Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan vanlam aven, chule phatthei aboh in, chuin aman changlhah chu alan, ahehbal bal in, aseijui ho apen, amaho chun mi honpi chu apeuve.
en_web: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
en_kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
tcz_gospelgo: chule japi chu hampa dum lah a tou din asol’e. Chuin changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan, van lam ven Pathen athangvah-in, changlhah ho chu aheh bal bal’in seijuite apen seijuiten mipi ahoppeh tauve.

tcz: Amahon angaichat chanun ane uvin, aval chu seijuihon paipeh som le ni alohdoh uve.
en_web: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
en_kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
tcz_gospelgo: Japin anevaset cheh-un, anehval chengseu paipeh som le paipeh ni dimset alohdoh-ui.

tcz: Chuche nikho chun pasal cheh mi sang nga chun ane vaset uvin, numei leh chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
en_web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
en_kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
tcz_gospelgo: Anea chu numei chapang sim louvin pasal sang nga jen ahiuve.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Aman miho chu ain uva asol laiyin, aseijuite chu konga lut'a chule Dil gal langkhatna ana galkai ding in asol in ahi.
en_web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
en_kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Mipi alhah doh phat’in aeijuite chu masaa gal lang khat kai masa din kong kha tsunga alut sah-in asoltai.

tcz: Amaho ain uva asoldoh jouvin, ama mol chunga tao ding in akaldoh in ahi. Jan ahung hitan, Ama achangseh'in mol a aum tai.
en_web: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
en_kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi asoldoh nung in achangseh a mol chunga tao din akaltouve. Nilhah geiyin mol chunga Jesu achangseh-in aum’e.

tcz: Hiche pet chun, seijuiho chun hahsatna atoh un, tolgo laiya kona gamlatah geiyuva ahi tauve, hui hattah ahung nung in, chule amaho chun twipi kinong hattah chu akimaito piuvin ahi.
en_web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
en_kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche don hin kong chu dil lailung ageitai. Huiyin ale lama anuh jehin twi kinongin kong chu aleh le jengin ahi.

tcz: Jingkah pung thum don in Yeshua amaho heng lama ahung in, twi chunga lam ajot in ahi.
en_web: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
en_kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingkah lam nidan thum le nidan gup kikah-in seijuite heng jonin dil’a twi chunga Jesun lam ahinjot’e.

tcz: Seijuihon Aman twi chunga lam ahinjot chu amuvin ahileh akicha lheh jeng uve. Akichat jeh'un amaho apeng uvin: “Lhadam ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
en_kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
tcz_gospelgo: Twichunga lam ahinjot chu seijuiten amudoh phat’un, “Lhadam ahi,” tin kichan a-aosot jengui.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ahin hou paiyin, “Kicha hih un. Lungmong tah in umun. Hia ka um nai,” ati.
en_web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
en_kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I, be not afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ahin houpaiyin, “Lung linglao hih-un Kei kahibouve, kicha hih-un,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Peter in Ama ahin houvin, “Pakai, Nangma nahi monga ahileh, nahenga twi chunga lam kahin jotna ding in neihin seipeh in,” ati.
en_web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
en_kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin ahin houvin, “Pakai nang nahi nah leh twi chunga naheng kahinjotna din neiseipeh in,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan, “Henge, hungin” ati. Hiti chun Peter chu kong panga akum lhan chule Yeshua lam jon in twi chunga lam ajot tai.
en_web: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
en_kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Hungin,” atileh; Peter jong konga akumlhan, twi chunga achen Jesu heng ajontai.

tcz: Hinlah Peter in hui hattah nung leh twipi kinong amu phat in, akichan chule lhalhum ding in aumtai. Chuin aman asam in, “Pakai, nei huhhing in,” ati.
en_web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
en_kjv: But when he saw the wind boysterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla huiyin twi anon amuphat’in akichan alha lut pantan, apeng jah jengin, “Pakai, neihuhhingin!” tin asam tai.

tcz: Apettah chun Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule ama chu aman in, “Na tahsan aneo behseh'e, ipi dinga nei sonlel ham?” ati.
en_web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
en_kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun akhut’in agah manloiyin, “Vo tahsan lhom! I-bol’a natahsan lel ham?” tin aphoh-e.

tcz: Amani kong sunga alut lhon phat in, huipi athip heltai.
en_web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
en_kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le Peter kong sunga alut lhon phat’in hui jong athip tai.

tcz: Chuphat in seijuiho ahung un, Ama a-Hou tauve. Amahon, “Nangma Pathen Chapa tahbeh nahi monge,” atiuve.
en_web: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
en_kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in kong sunga um seijuiten Jesu chu chibai aboh-un, “Pathen Chapa mong mong nahibouve,” tin aphongtauve.

tcz: Amaho Dillen chu agal kaiyun, Gennesaret alhung tauve.
en_web: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
en_kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

tcz_gospelgo: Nahet thei lou mongu ham? Pasal sang nga lah a changlhah pheng nga nahop’uva chu amoh paipeh ijet nalo doh-uva,

en_web: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

tcz_gospelgo: chule pasa sang li lah a changlhah pheng sagi nahop’uva chu amoh long kai ijat nalodoh uvam?

tcz: Ipi iti dana changlhah chung thua kasei ahipoi ti hedoh theilou nahi uvem? Hitia hi avela kasei ahi, Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho chol lah achun kichih theiyun kati ahi,” ati.
en_web: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

tcz_gospelgo: Najh-uva changlhah thu bon kisei lou iti nahet khen thei louvuham? Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho gu phalou lah a kichih thie dia kaseipeh nahibouvui,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in anunung pena, Aman changlhah'a chol thu asei hilouva, Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho doha lhep lhahna thuhil aneiyuva achihthei diuva ahil chu ahedoh tauve.

en_kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun changlhah lah a kisoji chol asei hilouva’ Pharisee ho l eSedducee ho thuhil gu phalou lah a kichih thei dia asei joh ahi Seijuiten ahedoh tauve.

tcz: Yeshuan Caesarea Philippi ahunggei phat in, aseijui ho jah a “Mihon, Mihem Chapa hi koi ahi atiuvem?” tin adong tai.

en_kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu Caesarea Philippi gamkol ageiyin, “Mihem Chapa hi mihon koi ahisah-um?” tin asei juite adonge.

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, “Mi phabep chun Twilutsah John ahi atiuvin, mi phabep chun Elijah ahi atiuvin, chule adang phabepma chun Jeremiah ahilouleh themgao ho lah'a khatpen hinte,” atiuve.
en_web: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
en_kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Mi kim khat’in John Baptist ahisah-un, adangin ma Jeremiah ahiloule Themgao dang khat hiei din aseiyui,” atiuve.

tcz: Chujouvin, amaho chu thu adong in, “Nanghon koi ahi neitiu vem?” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
en_kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon jah a, “Nang hon koiba neihisah-uvam?” tin adonge.

tcz: Simon Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen hing Chapa nahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangma anunnom a nahi, John chapa Simon, ajeh chu nangman mihem koima'a kona nahet ahipon, vana ka-Pan na henga hiche hi ahin phondoh ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “John chapa Simon nanun nom’e! Hiche thudih hi tahsa mihema kon ahipon, vana um ka-Pan naphondohsah ahibouve!

tcz: Na henga kasei ahi, nangma Peter (Song) nahi, chule hiche Songpi (Christa) chunga hi Ka houbung Ka tundoh ding ahi, chule Damun thaneina in ajo joulou ding ahi.
en_web: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
en_kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a hi kaseipeh nahi Peter: nangma songpi nahin, hiche songpi inbul’a hi ka-Houbung kasah doh a, mithi kul kotpin jong anan joulou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule Keiman Van gam kot heh ho kapeh ding nahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou dinga na thupeh chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na noppeh chan chu vana jong kinop peh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
en_kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman van a Lenggam kot-heh kapeh ding, leiset’a nakha chan van’a jong kikhah ding, leiset’a nahon chan van a jong kihong ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin Aman aseijui ho jah achun koima koma Messiah ahi chu, aphondoh louna ding uvin hatah in agihtai.
en_web: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Jesun ama Messiah ahi chu mikoma aseidoh louna diuvin aseijuite akham chah kheh-in ahi.

tcz: Chuchea pat chun Yeshuan aseijuite koma kichen tah in, Jerusalem a aga che ding angai khohna aseiyin, chule aman hou vaipo loi le thempu le houdan thuhil hoa kona thil tampi gimnei hahsa ho athoh ding chu ahiltai. Ama ahin tha diu, hinlah anithum lhin nileh thina a kona thoudoh ding ahi.
en_web: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
en_kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea pat hin Jesun aseijuite jah a kichentah-in aseiyin, “Jerusalem a kachetei ding, upate le Thempu pipu ho chule Danthu them hon eibol gentheiyuva, eitha diu, hijongle nithum lhin nia Pathenin eikaithou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Peter chun Ama apuidoh in chule chutia thu asei chu haphon aphoh in, “Pakai Vanin jong oiponte, hiche hi na chunga lhung hih beh jeng hen,” atitai.
en_web: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
en_kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Peterin achangseh-in apuidoh-in, akihan lhon, “Pathen lungset’a hitobang hi nachunga chulou hel ding ahi Pakai!” tin aseiye.

tcz: Yeshua, Peter lama aki heiyin, ajah a, “Satan, kakoma konin chemang in! Nang hi keima dinga tijat um thangkol nahi! Nangman Pathen a kon hilouvin mihem lunggel a kona navet jeh ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
en_kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitah chun Jesu akiheiyin Peter jah a, “Kinung che jengin Satan! Neikipalsah lo ding ahi, Pathen deibanga lung gel louvin mihem deilam joh nagel’e,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Nalah uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chon nauva kona nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui diu ahi.
en_web: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Koi hi le eijui nom chu ama ki-ngaitom a, athingpel kiput’a eijui ding ahi.

tcz: Na hinkhou naki kolchah jom uva ahileh, na mansah dingu ahi. Hinlah nanghon keima jal'a nahin nau naphal doh uva ahileh, naki huhhing diu ahi.
en_web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
en_kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile kihinso nom chun athiloa, amavang Keima jal’a thi loa chun hinna anei ding ahi.

tcz: Chule vannoi apumpi nanga hihen lang, na hinna chan tale chun ipi phachom ding ham? Na hinna sanga man lujo ipi um nalaiyem?
en_web: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
en_kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu min vannoi leiset pumpi nei jongle ahinkho akisuh mang teng ipi phat chompi tem? Ahiloule min ahinkho lhenga ipi apeh ding ham?

tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa chu a-Pa loupinaa a-Vantilte toh hung ding, mitin atoh dungjui cheh tohman apeh ding ahi!

tcz: Chule Keiman thutah kaseipeh nahi uve, hikoma tupetna ding ho lah'a Mihem Chapa a Lenggama ahung masanga thilou ding aum uve,” ati.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

tcz_gospelgo: Nigup jouvin Jesun Peter le Jacob chule Jacob naopa John toh apuiyin amaho seh molchunga akal toupi.

en_web: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

en_kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles: one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Peterin Jesu agah houvin, “Pakai, hikoma i-umu anom lheh jenge, pha nasah le nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat-lhumbuh thum song inge,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah aman athusei pet chun meibang in amaho chu ahin tom khum un, chule vana konin aw khat in ahin-seiyin, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa ngailut tahbeh, ei kipa sah'a ahi, Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
en_web: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
en_kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pater thusei pettah hin meibang lhang khat’in amaho chu alekhun, meibang lah a konin ogin khat hin, “Hiche hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achunga kalung alhai ta-ngeiye, athu ngaiyun,” ati.

tcz: Seijui ho chu akicha behseh'un, chuin tol a amaiyu asulut tauve.
en_web: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

tcz_gospelgo: Ogin ajah phat’un seijuiho akicha behseh jengun, tol’a mai asulut gamtauve.

en_web: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
en_kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Molchunga kona ahung kumsuh phat’un Jesun amaho hi ahilchah masan, “Mihem Chapa thinaa kona kaithouva aum masangsen nathilmuu hi koima seipeh hih hel’un,” ati.

tcz: Chujou chun aseijui-ten Ama adong un, “Ipi jeh a Dan thuhil hon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kile ding ahi tia asei sei jingu hintem?” atiuve.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichun seijuiten, “I-bol’a ba Danthu them hon Elija hung masa tei dia aseiyu ham?” atiuve.

en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Elijah chu hung masa ahinai, aman thil ijakai agontoh masah ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve. Elijah ana hunga ahitai, ama chu isah louvin abol tauve. Chule chutobang ma'a Mihem Chapan jong athoh gim ding ahi,” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuvee, Elijah ahung tan, mihon ahettoh loujeh-un anop aningin aboltauve. Mihem Chapa jong chutobangma abol tei diu ahi,” ati.

en_web: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
en_kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
tcz_gospelgo: John Baptist thudol aseipeh-u ahi seijuiten ahedohtauve.

tcz: Mi tampi chun Ama chu mol chunga ana ngah tauvin, mikhat chu ahung in chuin Yeshua ang-ah adilsun chule aseiyin,
en_web: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

tcz_gospelgo: Mipi lah ahung geiphat’un pasal kha tJesu masanga ahung boh khup’in,

en_kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
tcz_gospelgo: Naseijuite henga kahin pui vangin aboldam theipouve,” tin ataove.

en_kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Vo tahsan bei khang lamvai mite! Itih chan ka-umpia kakho ngaiding nahiuvem? Chapang pa chu hinpuiyun!” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaoboh chu Jesun haphoa apho leh, hichepet tah chun chapang a konin ahung potdoh paiyin chapang pa adamtai.

en_web: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

tcz_gospelgo: Seijuite guh thim chan Jesu henga ahungun, “I-ati leh keihon kanodoh jou louvu ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Tahsan bulhing naneilou jeh'u ahi. Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsana aneova neo ankam mu tebep geiya naneiyuva ahileh, nanghon hiche mol jah'a hin, hichea kon khun kichon in tia nasei uleh, kichon thei ahi. Imacha ahimo ding aumpoi.
en_web: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be unpossible unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Natahsan lhom je-u ahi, tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, tah sanna ankam mu te neijong leu chun hiche molsang jah a hin, ‘Hikoma konin khukoma kichonin,’ tijongleu chun kichon jeng ding ahin, imacha bolmo nanei lou diu ahi.

en_kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
tcz_gospelgo: (hitobnag hi an ngol’a taona beiyin asoh doh theipoi,)” ati.

en_web: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
en_kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
tcz_gospelgo: Seijui chengse le Jesu Galilee gamsunga akilhon khom pet’un Jesun ajah-uva, “Mihem Chapa hi mite khut’a kipedoh ding ahin,

tcz: Ama atha diu, hinlah ani thum nileh athia kona kai thouva um ding ahi,” ati. Chuin seijuiho chu lunghem nan adim tauve.
en_web: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
en_kjv: and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon atha diu, amavang nithum lhin ni le kikaithou kit ding ahi,” ati. Seijuite alung kham lheh jengui.

tcz: Capernaum ahunglhun un, Hou'in a kaidong ho Peter koma ahung un chuin ajah a, “Na houhil pauvin Hou in kai apeh ngailou ham?” tin adong uve.
en_web: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
en_kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le aseijuite Capernaum a ahungu leh Houin kaidong ho ahungun Peter jah a, “Nahouhil pau hin Houin kai apehji lou ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: “Henge, apejie,” tin Peter in adonbut e. Chuphat in in sunga agaluttai. Hinlah aman thu asei masang in, Yeshuan anadong in, “Peter, ipi iti nagel em? Lengho khun ama mite kai adon jiu ha? Ahilouleh gal'a ajosa hou koma kai adonu ham?” ati.
en_web: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
en_kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin, “Apeji nai,” ati. Peter insung agalut leh Jesun ahin hou masan, “Simon iti nagel’em? Leiset lengte hin kai hihen sumlam man hijongle koi lah a don jiuvem? Gamsung mite lah a adon’um?” tin anadonge.

tcz: Peter in adonbut in, “Gal'a ajohou koma kai adong uve,” ati. Yeshuan aseiyin, “Chuti ahileh aphai, agam mite chu ongthola ahiuve.
en_web: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
en_kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin, “Gamchom mite lah a,” ati. Jesun, “Achutile gamsung mite ongthol’a hita chula.

tcz: Hijongleh, amaho lung thoisah pohite, hiti hin Dil a gakum lhan chule ngakoi galeh lhan. Nga namat masatpen kam chu keh in, chuteng nangman sana dangka apeh len khat namu ding ahi. Hichu choiyin lang, ini lhon ding in ga petan,” ati.
en_web: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
en_kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle kaidong ho lung himo louna din Twikhanglen achen nga gakoi le chun, nakoi doh masah pen chu akamsung kel le chun itokham bep sum namu ding ahin, hichu choiyin gapetan,” ati.

tcz: Hichepet chun seijuiho Yeshua henga ahung un chule thudoh aneiyun, “Van Lenggama chu koipen alenpen hi ding ham?” atiuve.
en_web: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
en_kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “Van a lenggama lenpen chu koi ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan chapang neocha khat akoma din akouvin, chuin chapang chu alah uva adinsah in.
en_web: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
en_kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun chapang khat akoulut’in, alai lunguva adinsah-in,

tcz: Chuphat in aseitai, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho nachonset nauva kona nakile heiyuva chule chapang neocha ho tobang nahung hilou uva ahileh, Van Lenggam a nalut louhel diu ahi.
en_web: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: and said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, nakikhel hel’uva chapang ho toh nabah louvu leh van a Lenggama lut pouvin nate.

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hijongleh chapang neocha ho tobanga kineosah mi chu, Van Lenggam a alenpen hi ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
en_kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche chapang te bep a kigel’a kineosah a ki-ngaitom chan chu van a Lenggama alen a pang ding ahi.

tcz: Chule koi hijongleh Keima khel a chapang neokhat sanga chun, Keima eisan ahi.”
en_web: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
en_kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule kamin a hitobnag chapang khohsah chun Keima eisan ahi.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon hiche aneocha ho lah'a khat Keima eitahsan achu chonsetna nalhahsah uva ahileh, sumhei lentah khat na ngong changa kihen henlang twikhanglen'a kileh lut lechun nangma ding in aphajoi.
en_web: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.
en_kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi hile aneocha hokhat tansan sudoiya chu angonga sumhei song lentah kikhai hen Twikhanglen akileh lut le ama din aphajoi.

tcz: “Vannoiya hi itobang gimnan ahinphah ding hitam! Ajeh chu miho chonse din alhem in ahi. Lhep patepna hohi pel theilou ahi, hinlah alhema pang mi chu iti hahsat ding hitan tem?
en_web: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
en_kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences: for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe vannoi mite nadau ahi! Ajeh chu mihemte tansan suhoi thei thil tampi aum’e. Kipalna chu hung umtei ding van gahin, hichea kipal lhuhna bol’a chu ada na-e!

tcz: Hijeh chun nakhut ahilouleh nakeng in chonset nabolsah leh tanbong in chule paimang in khutkhat ahilouleh kengkhat neiya tonsot hinna'a nalut chu, khut ni ahilouleh keng ni neiya tonsot meidila nalut sang in gamcheng in aphajon ahi.
en_web: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
en_kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nakhut ham nakeng hamin naahsan aduh doi leh tan bong in paimang jengin. Khut l ekeng kim a tonsot mitmo meidil’a nakile lut sangin khut lan gle keng lang beiya hin naa lut ding aphajoi.

tcz: Chule namit in nachonset sah'a ahileh, kaldoh'in lang chule paimang jeng in. Mit khat neiya tonsot hinna'a lut chu mit ni neiya meidila lut ding sang in aphajoi.”
en_web: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
en_kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Namit’in nakipalsah jong lekaldoh in pai mangin! Mit ni neiya damun meidil’a nakile lut sangin mit lang chon hin naa lut le chun aphajoi.

tcz: Ching theiyun, nanghon hiche ho lah a aneopen ho jong noise hih un. Ajeh chu van a avantil teu van a ka Pa ang sunga um jing ahiuve.
en_web: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche aneocha ho khat nahsahmoa nabol louna diuvin vhing theiyun; kaseipeh nahiuve, van a um avantilteuvin ka-Pa mai amu jingui.

tcz: Chule Mihem Chapa hi amangthah ho chu huhhing dinga hung ahi.
en_web: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
en_kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
tcz_gospelgo: (Ijeh-inam itile Mihem Chapa chu amangsa huhing dia ahi.)

tcz: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen lang, chule hiche ho lah a khat chu vahmang taleh amapa chun ipi aboldem? Aman adangse somko le ko chu mol achun dalhan tin chule amang chu holding a chedoh lou ding ham?
en_web: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
en_kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
tcz_gospelgo: “Iti nagel’um? Mi khat’in kelngoi ja khat neihen, khat pen pen che mang taleh, somko le ko chu molvuma dalha a che mang khatseh chu aahol lou ding ham?

tcz: Chule aman amu tengleh, tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chunga akipana chu avah manglou somko le ko sanga lenjo ding ahi.
en_web: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
en_kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, agamudoh teng ache mang lou somko le ko sangin amukit khatseh chunga akipah joi.

tcz: Hitobangma achu, hiche aneocha ho lah'a khatpen amah thah ding chu van a um Ka Pa lunglam ahipoi.”
en_web: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
en_kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche bangchun hiche aneocha ho khat man ding hi van a um naPau lungdei ahipoi.

tcz: “Tahsan nei mi dang khat nangma douna a achonset a ahileh, na chang in chen chule athemmona chu seipeh in. Aman nasei angaiya chule hichu aphondoh'a ahileh, nangman ama chu nathujo ahitai.
en_web: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
en_kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nasopi nachunga achonset tah leh, chen lang achangseh a aumpet’in athemmona gaphoh-in. Napho angai leh sopi neikit nahitan;

tcz: Hinlah nathujo joulou tah'a ahileh, nangman mikhat ahilouleh mini kipuiyin, gache kit in, hitia chu nangman nasei chu hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum in phochen hen.
en_web: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
en_kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
tcz_gospelgo: angai lou vang leh, Pathen lekhabua, ‘Mi ni le thum hettohsah a kichai thei ding,’ kiti dungjuiyin michom khat le ni puiyin chen.

tcz: Ama ada nahlaiya nasei angai louva ahileh, nachung thu chu houbunga lhut in. Chutengleh ama chun houbung thu angai louva ahileh, hichepa chu milim hou ahilouleh chidang nam dang in kisim jeng hen.”
en_web: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
en_kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as a heathen man and a publican.
tcz_gospelgo: napuiho thu geiya angai loule Houbung henga thulhut’in. Houbung thu geiya angai lou vang leh chidang namdang le kaidong ho bolna bangin bol tan.

tcz: “Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon leiset chunga najahda chan uchu vana jong kijada ding, chule leiset chunga naphal chanu chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou ding nati chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na phalpeh chan chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Dihtah akaseipeh nahiuve, ipi hijongle leiset’a nakhau chu van a jong kikhah ding, leiset’a nahon’u chu van a jong kihong ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche jong hi ka seipeh nahiuve: Nalah uva mi ni na kinop touva ipi hijongleh leiset chunga nathum chan'u chu, vana Ka Pan nang ho dinga abol ding ahi.
en_web: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
en_kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh kit nahiuve, leiset’a mini lung kitoh tah a nataovu leh van a um ka-Pan nabolpeh tei diu ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh Kamin a ni ahilouleh thum naki khop khom nau chana chun, Keima nalah uva kaum jing e,” ati.
en_web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
en_kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu hoikom hileh kamin a ni le thum nakikhopna chan’uva ka-umpi jingui,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin, Peter Ama koma ahung in chuin ajah a, “Pakai, mi koiham khat chu keima douna a achonset a ahileh, ijatvei kijoma kangaidam thei ham? Sagi vei chan gei ham?” ati.
en_web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
en_kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
tcz_gospelgo: Peter Jesu henga ahungin, “Pakai, kasopi kachunga chonse se jeng tahleh ijat vei ka-ngaidam ding ham? Sagi vei gei ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keiman najah'a sagi vei katipoi, hinlah sagi mun som sagi vei kaseina ahijoi.”
en_web: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Ken, ‘Sagi vei gei’ katipoi, sagi mun som sagi geiyin katibouve.

tcz: “Hiche jeh'a hi van Lenggam chu Lengpa khat in asohte toh, ama koma sum baho chuto sum suto dinga akou khom toh kitekah thei ahi.
en_web: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
en_kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile van aLenggam chu asohte sum chin suhto ding goa lengpa to tekah thei ahi.

tcz: Aman sum asuhto khom nauva chun, ama koma sum sang som bapa chu ahinkai tauve.
en_web: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
en_kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which ought him ten thousand talents.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum asuto pantan, talent sangsom bat soh khat ahinkai lut’un,

tcz: Aman asah joulou phat in, apupa chun aji leh achate chule anei jouse ajoh'a abat chu asah dingin thu apetai.”
en_web: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
en_kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
tcz_gospelgo: soh pan sum sahna ding aneilou hel phat’in ama jong ajinu le achate, anei jouse jong joh a abat sah doh sah tei din apupan thu alhuhsah tai.

tcz: “Hinlah ama chu apupa ang sunga chun abohkhup in chuin athum in, ‘Lungsettah in, nei khongaiyin, keiman abonchan pena nge’” ati.
en_web: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
en_kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chunsohpa jong akoma aboh khup’in adilsun, ‘Nei ngah ta din abonchan sadoh kit nange,’ tin ataotai.

tcz: Chuphat in apupa chun akhoto lheh in, chuin alhadoh in chule abat angaidam tai.
en_web: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
en_kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in apupan sohpa chu alungsen abat jouse angaidamin, alhadoh tai.

tcz: Hinlah aman lengpa ada lhah chun, asoh chanpi sum asang mai mai bapa koma chun achen, angonga aman'in chule apetpet in neipen atitai.
en_web: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
en_kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which ought him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche sohpa hi apotdoh doh-in asoh chanpi ama denarii ja khat bat’a chu atoh khan, atuh chah denin, alol ameh peh-in, Nabat chu neipen,’ tin anotai.

tcz: Asoh chanpi a-anga adilsun chule phat chomkhat bep anga dingin angeh in: Nei khongaiyin, keiman penange tin angeh jeng e.
en_web: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
en_kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
tcz_gospelgo: Asoh chanpi pa jong boh khup’in adil sun, ‘Nei ngah ta din sadoh kit nange,’ tin ataove.

tcz: Hinlah abat napa chun angah jou tapoi. Aman mi amatsah in chule batchu asah chaisoh kahsea dingin songkul a akhum tai.
en_web: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
en_kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin aman anop peh pon, abat chengse asahdoh kahsea din songkul’a agakhumtai.

tcz: “Soh achom dang hon hichu amuvin, alung nommo lheh tauvin ahi. Amaho lengpa koma acheuvin chule thilsoh chu agasei sohkei tauve.”
en_web: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
en_kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
tcz_gospelgo: Aumchan hi soh dang hon amu phat’un alung himo lheh jengun, athilsoh ho chu apu pau aseipeh tauve.

tcz: Chuphat'in lengpa chun angaidamsa pachu akoulut'in chuin ajah a, Nangma soh-gilou! Keima henga nathum jeh'a bat chujat jenpi chu kangaidam nahitai.
en_web: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
en_kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
tcz_gospelgo: Apupan hiche sohpa chu akoulut’in ajah a, ‘Soh gilou, kahenga natao tao jeh a nabat chengse kamoh ngaidam nahita me!

tcz: Keiman nangma kakhoto tobanga chu nasoh chanpi nakhoto ding hilou ham? ati.
en_web: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
en_kjv: shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Ken kalai natpi banga nang in jong nasoh chanpi chu nalai natpi ding hilo ham?’ tin aphoh tai.

tcz: Chuphat'in alung hang'ah lengpa chun abat aboncha asahchai kahsea dingin hichepa chu songkul'a akhumtai.
en_web: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
en_kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: HIti hin apupa alung hang jah-in abat chengse asahdoh kahsea din mi bol genthei ho khut’a apedoh tai.

tcz: “Vana um ka-Pa chun nanghon nasopiteu chu nalungil'uva na ngaidam louva ahileh nachung'uva hitia chu achutibol ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
en_kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nang hon jong lung giltah a nasopi na-ngaidam louvu leh van a um ka-Pan hitobanga chu nabol diu ahi,” tin Jesun aseiye.

tcz: Yeshuan hicheng thu asei jouvin, Galilee adalhan chuin Jordan vadung solama Judea gamkaiya achesuhtai.
en_web: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judea beyond Jordan;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thu hicheng asei jouvin Galille gam dalhan Jordan luigal Judea gamsung alhungtai.

tcz: Chuche muna chun mihon tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin, chuin Aman anaho adamsah tai.
en_web: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
en_kjv: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah lhonna, “Nangnin tahbeh mongin kagimna khon hi nahin don lhon ding ahiye. Hinlah keiman koi kajet'a ahilouleh kaveiya toudi ham? Ti thuneina kaneipoi. Ka Pan alhendoh a agonpeh ho ding mun ahiye, tin aseipeh tai” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Mitcho ni lampama anatouvin, Jesun ahin hopa chu aja lhonin, “Vo David Chapa kapu, neilungset’in,” tin asam lhon’e.

tcz: Amani chun, Pakai kho kamu nom lhon'e, ati lhon'e.

en_kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

en_web: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Kenjong thu khat dong ung ting naseidoh theiyu leh ipi tha neina kaneiye hiti ho hi kabol seipeh nau ivnge.

tcz: John chun miho baptize theina thuneina anei chu vana kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon bep bou ham?” ati. Amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Eihon vana kon ahi itiuva ahileh Aman ipi jeh'a eihon John thusei chu itahsan lou uham, tia eidoh dingu,
en_web: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
en_kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
tcz_gospelgo: John baptize bolji pa hin bol theina van a kon alah ha mihem a kona alah ham?” ati. Chuphat’in amaho le amaho akinel’un, ‘Van a kon ahi,’ tileu hen la, ‘Achutile i-bol’a natahsan dau am?’ tin tin!

tcz: Hinlah ama mihem bepbou ahi tin seileu hen, mipi oimo ichan diu ahi, ajeh chu miho chun John chu themgao ahi atiuve ti aseiyun ahi.”
en_web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
en_kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Mihem a kon ahi,’ ti ding la japi kichat aumin, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgaova agel cheh ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hiti chun achaina keiyin adonbut un, “Keihon kahe pouve,” atiuve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahitah le koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse kabol ham kaseipeh lou ding nahiuve” tin aseitai.
en_web: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
en_kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesu jah a, “Kahepoi,” atitauve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kahepoi,” atitauve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kenjong ipi thaneina jeh a hiche ho kabol sei peh deh pou vinge.

tcz: “Hinlah hiche thudol hi ipi nagel uvem? Mi khat chapa ni nei chun, alen jopa koma, ‘Chapa gache doh inlang, tunin lengpi leiya na gatong in’” ati.
en_web: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
en_kjv: But what think you? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
tcz_gospelgo: “Iti nagel’um? Pasal khat’in chapa ni aneiyin, apeng masa pa jah a, ‘Chapa, tunin lengpi leiya konin lang na gatongin,’ ati.

tcz: Chapa chun adonbut in, “Ka-e, kachelou ding ahiye,” atin hinlah chujoupeh chun alunggel akhel in agache tai.
en_web: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
en_kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
tcz_gospelgo: Achapan, ‘Kon ponge,’ ati. Ahinla chom khat jouvin lung aheiyin akontai.

tcz: Chuphat in apa chun chapa khatpa jah a, “Nangchen” atileh ama chun “Henge,” Hepa tin aseiyin, ahin aga chedeh poi.
en_web: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
en_kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipa chu achapa khat joh henga achen hitobangma a chu agaseileh, ‘Kon nange hepa,’ atin, konla akonpoi.

tcz: Chapa teni lah'a chu koijoh apa seingai hiya ham? Amahon adonbut un, Amasapa atiuve. Chuphat in Yeshuan ahil chen in, “Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaidong kitahlou ho le numei kijoh ho Pathen Lenggam a nangho masanga lut diu ahi.”
en_web: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
en_kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
tcz_gospelgo: Amani koi joh hin apa dei abol ham?” ati. Amahon, “Apeng masapan,” atiuve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve. nang ho sangin kaidong ho le noti ho Pathen Lenggama alutmasajo tauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Twilutsah John chu anahung in, chule adih'a hinna ding lampi chu nakopeh uvin, ahin nanghon ama chu natahsan pouve, hinlah kaidong ho le numei kijoh hon atahsan uve. Chule hiche aso nung in jong Ama natahsan nom pouvin chule nachonset nauva nakisih pouve.
en_web: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
en_kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile John chun adih a hinje lampi nahil’u ahitan, natahsan pouve; hichea hin kaidong ho le noti hon anatahsan’ui. Ama namutah vangun lungheiyin natahsan deh pouve.

tcz: “Tun thusim achom khat ngaiyun. Lounei khat hin lengpilei abol in, apal agen kimvel'in, lengpi theiga lhohna ding leiko alaiyin, chule gahvet suina ding in insang asan ahi. Chujouvin aman lengpilei chu alei-lhou ho khut'a apedoh in, chule gamchoma agache tai.”
en_web: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
en_kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
tcz_gospelgo: “Thulem khat ngai kit’uvin: mihaotah khat’in lengpi lei khat abol’in, akimvel’a tho akaiyin, lengpiga chilna leiko alaiyin, loubuh asan, kemsang adoi. Chuin lengpilei chu aleibol ho ngansen kholgama achetai.

tcz: Lengpiga alhun phat in, alei lhou'a pang ho koma asohte asolin ahi.
en_web: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
en_kjv: and when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Theiga lo phat’in lengpiga po din aleibol ho ngansen kholgama achetai.

tcz: Hinlah alei lhou hon asoh ho chu aman un, khat avouvin, khat athat un chule achom khat chu songa asep tauve.
en_web: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
en_kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpilei bol hon asoh te chu aman’un abang avouvin, abang athat’un chule abnag songin asep’ui.

tcz: Hichun alou neipa chun asoh atamjo cheh chu lengpi theiga lohkhom dingin asolin ahileh abolngai ngai anabol un ahi.
en_web: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
en_kjv: Again, he sent other servants moe than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin asol masah sohte sanga tamjo asol kit vangin, amahon abol ngai bang bangin anabol’ui.

tcz: “Achaina keiyin alouneipa chun achapa asolin, amaho chun achapa chu anajabol teiyunte tin agel'in ahi.”
en_web: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
en_kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhon na keiyin, ‘Kachapa beh jabol teiyunte,’ tin lengpilei bol ho henga achapa asoltai.

tcz: “Hinlah loubol ho chun achapa hung amu phat un, amaho khatle khat akihou un, ‘Agou lo’ dingpa hikoma ahunge. Hungun, ama that'u hitin agam hi eiho chan ding'in kiheidoh'u hite,” atiuve.
en_web: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
en_kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lengpilei bol hon achapa amudoh phat’un, ‘Hichepa hi agoulo dingpa ahi,’ that’u hitin agou eiho changute,’ akitiuvin,

tcz: Hitichun amahon aman'un, lengpi leiya kon in akaidoh un, chule ama chu athat tauve.
en_web: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
en_kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
tcz_gospelgo: aman’un lengpilei polama akaidoh-un athat tauve.

tcz: Yeshuan adong in, “Lengpi lei neipa chu ahung kile teng loubol ho chu i-lonte tia nagel uvem?” ati.
en_web: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
en_kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
tcz_gospelgo: “Lengpilei neipa chu ahung teng aleibel ho chu i-lotan tem?” ati.

tcz: Hou lamkai ho chun adonbut uvin, Aman mi-engseho chu melse tah in that intin, chule alengpi lei chu alougasoh achanding pethei midang henga apehdoh ding ahitai, atiuve.
en_web: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
en_kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “lengpilei neipan hiche migilou ho chu engbol’in tin asuhgam ding, lengpilei chu aphat cha aga pethei lengpilei bol thei dang khat petante,” atiuve.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan amahotah adong in, “Hiche hi nanghon Pathen Thutheng bua nasimdoh khah lou u ham? In-sa hon adei-lou song chu aning'ah apipen in apang tai. Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahi chule gahvet ding in aki-dange.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva,” Pathen lakhabua: ‘Insa hon deimoa apaiyu song chu. In-ning songkhom det penin apangtai! Hiche hi Pakai thilbol ahi, Imit mu’vin thil kidangtah ahi,’ kiti lai chu nasim khah louvu ham?

tcz: Keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa kona kiladoh a, chule phatea ga sodoh thei nam dang kipe ding ahi.
en_web: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
en_kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nakilah peh-uva apunbe sah thei nam mite kipedoh ding ahitai.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche songa kipal chan chu ahal hal'a chip ding chule alhuhkhum chan chu atagoi ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
en_kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile hiche song chunga kitat kha chan chu kisep chip jeng ding ahin, alhah khah pen pen jong atagep jeng idng ahi,” ati.

tcz: Thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho chun hiche thulem hi ajah phat un, amaho douna'a thusim kisei–loubol mi engse ahiu chu akihetdoh tauve.
en_web: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
en_kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee hon Jesu thulem sei ajah phat’un, amaho gotna asei chu ahedoh tauve.

tcz: Amahon Ama amatnom uvin, hinlah mipi chun Yeshua chu themgaova angaito jeh un akicha uvin ahi.
en_web: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
en_kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mat dia agot vangun mipi akichauve. Ajeh chu mipin Jesu chu Themgaova angaito cheh u ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu thulem dang jong aseipeh in ahi. Aman ajah uva,
en_web: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi henga thulemin aseikit’in,

tcz: “Van Lengam chu lengkhat in achapa jineina golvah loupitah abol thusim toh tekah thei ahi.
en_web: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
en_kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
tcz_gospelgo: “Van a Lenggam chu achapa dinga jinei golvah bol ding goa lengpa khat tobang ahi.

tcz: Neh le don ding gontupsoh ahiphat in, asohte asolin akikou ho chu agahetsah tauve. Ahin, amaho abon'un ahungnom tapouve.”
en_web: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
en_kjv: and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
tcz_gospelgo: Golvahna lha dia ki-ngeh chengse koukhom dia lengpan asohte asol vangin koima ahung pouve.

tcz: “Hiti chun aman asoh dangho chu amaho gaseipeh dingin asolin, Golvah anneh ding gontupsa ahitai. Bongchal hole gancha thaotah ho chu kithat a, ijakai kigong tupma ahitai. Ankong um ding'in hung un agatisah-e.”
en_web: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
en_kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh dang phabep asol kit’in, ‘Akikou ho jah a, “Bongchal ho le gancha thaotah tah kathat’in golvah ankong akigong tupsoh tai, golvahnaa hung lha cheh-un,” ati gatiuvin,’ ati.

tcz: Hinlah akikou ho chun anahsah pouvin chule ama lampi cheh'a ache tauve, khat alouva, achom dang khat akiveinaa,
en_web: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
en_kjv: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla akikouhon imachan agelpouve, abang louva akonin, abang ma kinchom choma achen,

tcz: Adang-sen asottol leho chu aman'un chule jachat umtah in abol'un chule athat tauve.
en_web: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
en_kjv: and the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
tcz_gospelgo: adangin ma asohte chu aman’un, melse tah-in avouvin athat tauve.

tcz: “Lengpa chu alung hang in, chule asepaite asoldoh in tolthat ho chu asumang'in chule akhopiu jong ahal tauve.”
en_web: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
en_kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burnt up their city.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa alung hang behseh tan, asepaite asol’in mithat ho asugamin, akhopiu ahalvamtai.

tcz: Chule aman asohte jah a, Golvah an gonsan aumtai, chule jin'a kikouho jong jaboltah a kilom ahipouve.
en_web: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
en_kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun asohte jah, ‘Kichen golvah akigong soh tai, ane dia kikouho la ahungpon,

tcz: Tun lamlhong aningkoi tin'ah cheuvin chule namu mu hou chu gakou uvin, ati.
en_web: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
en_kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
tcz_gospelgo: cheuvin lan gkhopi kelkot phunga namuphah chanu koi hileh golvah an ne din hinkhom’un, ati.

tcz: Hiti chun sohte chun amu chanu chu mipha le miphalou geiyin akou uvin ahileh, golvah in chu jin adim tai.
en_web: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
en_kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohte chu lamlen dunga acheuvin, amu phah chan, mise mipha ahinpuiyule kichen golvahna ami adimset tai.

tcz: “Hinlah lengpa chu jinho kimu pia ahunga ahileh, aman mikhat chu kichenna Golvah vona kivonlou amudoh tai.”
en_web: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
en_kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
tcz_gospelgo: ″Lengpan akikou jin ho ahung vet leh moupui golvah vonbei khat amudoh-e.

tcz: Aman ajah a, kichenna Golvah vona kivon louva iti dana hikoma naum ham tia adoh le imachan adonbut tapoi.
en_web: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
en_kjv: and he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah a, ‘Jol, moupui golvah vonbeiya iti hung lut nahim?’ ati vangin, ama la athip beh jenge.

tcz: Chutah in lengpa chun alhachate ho jah a akhut le akeng ho kan'un lang chule polam muthima lehdoh tauvin, hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi.
en_web: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
en_kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun lengpan lhacha ho jah a, “Akhut akeng kan’un lang polam muthim lah a paidoh-un, hikoma chu kap le hagel gel’a um ding ahi,’ ati.

tcz: “Ajeh chu mitampi kikouva ahi, hinlah mi themcha bou deilhen ahi,” ati.
en_web: For many are called, but few chosen.”
en_kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.
tcz_gospelgo: “Akikou atam lheh nan lhen doh vang lhomcha ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in Pharisee ho akihou-un Yeshua chu athuseiya kipal sah'a mat ding angaito tauve.
en_web: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
en_kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho apotdoh-un Jesu chu alona je khat het’a kinelpia kipalsah din akihou lhiuve.

tcz: Amahon aseijuiteu phabep asol'un, chule Herod lama pangho jong jaotha ahiuve. Amahon “Houhil,” mikitah nahi ti kaheuve. “Nangman Pathen lampi dihtah nahil'in koima dat-khen naneipoi chule maipha nave poi,” atiuvin ahi.
