en_web: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
en_kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon aseijuiteu phabep le Herodia loi phabep asol thauvin, “Houhil, nang hi midih nahin, Pathen lampi dih tah nahil’in, mile mi kah a dat naneipoi, chule mihem polam maiput gin nanei lou kaheuve.

tcz: “Tun hiche thua hi ipi nagel em neiseipeh'un: Caesar henga kai peh hi dih'am ole dihlou ham?” atiuve.
en_web: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
en_kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cesar, or not?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahile Caesar henga mikai kipe hi dih hai dih lou ham? Iti nagel’em?” tin adongui.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan alunggel'u phalou chu ahen, aseiyin, “Nangho mi phalhem ho! Ipi dinga doha'a neimat got'u ham?”
en_web: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
en_kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
tcz_gospelgo: Athilse gonu chu Jesun ahen, “Mipha lhem ho! Ibol’a kipalsah ding neigot’u ham!

tcz: Kai kipehna sum chu neivetsah un, ati. Ama hon Rome te sum avetsah tauve.
en_web: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
en_kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
tcz_gospelgo: Mikaiya napeh-u sum chu neivetsah-un!” ati.

tcz: Aman adong in, “Koilim le koipen min ham?” tin adong tai.
en_web: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun “Hiche suma hi koi lim le koi min chong-am?” ati.

tcz: Amahon adonbut'un, “Caesar a,” atiuve. Aman aseipeh in, “Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin, chule Pathen achu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
en_web: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
en_kjv: They say unto him, Cesar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cesar the things which are Cesar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Caesar lim le min,” atiuve. Hijeh chun Jesun “Ceasar a chu Caesar peuvin, Pathen a chu Pathen petau,” ati.

tcz: Aman adonbutna chu adatmo-uvin chuin achemang tauve.
en_web: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
en_kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi ajah phat’un kidang asa lheh jengun, Jesu dalhan achetauve.

tcz: Hiche nikho mama chun Sadducee hon mithi ho thokitna aumpoi ti hou lamkai ho Yeshua henga ahung un, hiche thudoh hi ahung bol tauve.
en_web: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
en_kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ni ma ma chun mithi thokit tahsan lou Sadducee loi Jesu henga ahungun,

tcz: “Houhil, Mose chun mi koi ham khat cha neilouva athi khahtah'a ahileh anaopa chun meithainu chu akichenpia chule acha chun aupa min apohding ahi ati.
en_web: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
en_kjv: saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
tcz_gospelgo: “Houhil, ‘Pasal khat cha neilouva athi leh asopipan ajinu avetpeh a chi akhaipeh ding,’ tin Mose’n aseiye.

tcz: Aphai, vetsahnan sopi pasal sagi aume. Atahpen pa chun ji aneiyin cha neilou vin athitai, chuti chun asopipa chun meithainu chu akichen pitai.
en_web: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
en_kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
tcz_gospelgo: Kalah-uva sopi pasal sagia peng aum’un, a-upapen ajine leh cha neilouvin athin, ajinu anaopa vet din adalhatai.

tcz: Hinlah asopi ani napa jong chu athitan, chule asopi athum channa pan amanu chu akichenpi tai. Asagina chan in hiti chun abonchauvin aum tauve.
en_web: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
en_kjv: likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopite chu nina pa, thumna pa, aban bain sagina geiyin athisoh hel tauvin ahi.

tcz: Achainan, numeinu jong athitai.
en_web: After them all, the woman died.
en_kjv: And last of all the woman died also.
tcz_gospelgo: Achaina keiyin numei nu jong athitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koipen ji hiding hitam? Ajeh chu asagi-uva chu amanu akichenpiu ahi” tin adong tauve.
en_web: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
en_kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin thokit nil eh numeinu hi koipen ji hitan tem? Ajeh chu aboncha jia anei cheh-u ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thule Pathen Thahatna nahet lou jeh uva nasuhkhel jiu ahi.
en_web: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, Pathen lekhabua thu hihen, Pathen thahat hijongle nahet pen’u aum loujeh a nakhel del’u ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu mithiho chu thokitna'a amaho kicheng talou, kichen jong kibolsah talou ahiuve. Amaho chu vana Vantilte tobang ahiuve.
en_web: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
en_kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile thokitnaa chu nu le pa kichen jong umlou, chen jong akichensahlouvu ahitan, van a Vantilte tobang ahitauve.

tcz: Hinlah tun, mithiho thokitna umham tithua Pathen Thua nasimdoh khahlouvu ham? Masang peh'a anathisaho Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob ho chu athijoupeh uvin, Pathen in aseiyin,
en_web: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
en_kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin mithi thokit thudol ahileh Pathenin naseipeh sau chu nasim khah louvu ham?

tcz: Keima Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi. Hitia chu Ama ahing ho Pathen ahin, athiho Pathen ahipoi,” ati.
en_web: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
en_kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ atilou ham? Pathen chu mithi ho Pathen ahipon, miheng ho Pathen joh ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mihonpi chun athusei ajah phat un, athuhil chu adatmo lheh tauve.
en_web: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
en_kjv: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin hiche hi ajah phat’un athuhil kidang asa behseh jengui.

tcz: Ahin aman Sadducee ho paomo hel'a alha chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat un, amaho akikhom un, ama thudohna neikit ding'in akinopto tauve.
en_web: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
en_kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Sadducee ho anel khup del jeng phat’in Pharisee ho akikhom’un,

tcz: Amaho lah'a mikhat Hou Dan thuthem khat chun hiche thudoh'a hi kipalsah ding agon ahi.
en_web: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
en_kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
tcz_gospelgo: alah-uva Danthu them khat’in apatep nan,

tcz: “Houhil, Mose dan dung juiya hoipen hi thupeh lenpen ham?” ati.
en_web: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
en_kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
tcz_gospelgo: “Houhil Danthu lah a thupeh lenpen hoiche ham?” atin adonge.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpia, nahinna pumpia chule nalungthim pumpia na-ngailut ding ahi.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
en_kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu nalungthim pum pia, nahinkho pumpia chule nahet theina pumpia na-ngailutding,’ kiti ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi thupeh amasa le alenpen ahitai.
en_web: This is the first and great commandment.
en_kjv: This is the first and great commandment.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi thupeh lenpen leh amasapen ahin,

tcz: Anina jong athupina kibang ahi. Nangma na kingailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi.
en_web: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
en_kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: thupeh lenpen nina chu: ‘Nang naki-ngailutbanga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding,’ kiti ahi.

tcz: Hiche thupeh tenia hi Dan thu apumpi le themgao hon angeh jouseu chu kikhaiya ahi,” ati.
en_web: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
en_kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupeh hiche te nia hi Danthu pumpi le Themgaote thuhil ki-ngamsoh kei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hipet chun Pharisee hon aum-kimvel un, Yeshuan amaho thudoh khat adongin:
en_web: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
en_kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho ahung kikhop phat’un Jesun amaho chu adongin,

tcz: “Messiah chung chang thua ipi nagel uvem? Ama koicha ham? ati. Amahon adonbut un, Ama David Chapa ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
en_kjv: saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
tcz_gospelgo: “Messiah thudol iti nagel’um? Koi chilhah ham?” ati. Amahon, “David chilhah ahi,” atiuve

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahileh iti dan'a David chun Lhagao Theng'in ahetsa'a kona Messiah chu ‘Ka-Pakai’ ati hintem?” Ajeh chu David chun,
en_web: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
en_kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun “Iti hinte ahile, Lhagao haikhum jal’in David jengin jong Ama chu, ‘Pakai,’ asah-in;

tcz: Pakai chun kapakai koma, Keiman na melmate kasuh nem'a nakengto noiya ka koi masang sen, kijabolna kakhut jet'ah tou jingin, ati.
en_web: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?
en_kjv: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Pakai chun ka-Pakai jah a, namelmate nakeng chotpha kakoisoh masangsen Kajet lama tou jingin,’ atin;

tcz: David in Messiah chu Ka-Pakai, tia akou thei leh, Messiah chu iti achapa hithei ding ham? ati.
en_web: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
en_kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
tcz_gospelgo: David-in Ama chu ‘Pakai atileh, Messiah chu achilhah a iti pen thei ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin koima chan ama chu adonbut thei tapouve. Chule hiche jouva pat chun, koiman thudoh abolngam tapouve.
en_web: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
en_kjv: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any moe questions.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thudoh chu koman cheng khat chan jong adonbut thei pon hiche nia pat chun koiman jong ima adong ngam tapouve.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan mi honpi le aseijuiho jah a chun,
en_web: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
en_kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi le aseijuite jah a,

tcz: “Hou Dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho Mose Danbu ho sutoh dinga houhil lamkaiya lhen doh ahiuve.”
en_web: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
en_kjv: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
tcz_gospelgo: “Danthu themho le Pharisee ho hi Mose Danthu hilchen a pang ahiuvin,

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon nahil chan'u chu bol un chule nahil nauva aseiyu ngaiyun, hinlah aum chan'u vang jui hih un. Ajeh chu amahon ahilu chu abol pouve.
en_web: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
en_kjv: all therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
tcz_gospelgo: ipi hijongle naseipeh-u nit’un bol jong bol’un, amaho chon bangin vang chondauvin.

tcz: Amaho hin mihon apoh joudiu kalval chonna angeh un, hinlah pohgih ngai jangna ding in akhut jung khat'u jong chasah lou ahiuve.
en_web: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
en_kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon pohgih hahsa akan’un milengkouva aputsah-uvin, akhut jung jeng chan jong akhoiloh dong agoupouve.

tcz: “Athilbol jouseu chu mimu dinga bou bol ahiuve. Abanjang uva taona bom akoiyun, asungah Pathen Lekhabua thucheng kijih aneiyun, chule amahon sangkhol chol mong kailha agei kikhit ho akiah-uve.”
en_web: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
en_kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
tcz_gospelgo: Abol atoh chanu mi mitmu din bou abol’un ahi. Danthuchih bom akibuu le akibeh chengseu chu apeh aletsah-ui.

tcz: Chule amaho hi anneh khomna dokhang mun thupi laiya touva chule hou-kikhopna in'a jabolna'a tou anom'uvin ahi.
en_web: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
en_kjv: and love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
tcz_gospelgo: Golvahna le Houthua kikhopna in dunga touna pipen adeiyun,

tcz: Amahon kailhang mun'a min jaboltah'a alem diu adeiyun, chule houhil ati diu adei-uve.
en_web: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
en_kjv: and greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
tcz_gospelgo: kailhangdunga min salam abol’a, ‘Rabbi,’ ati diu bou adeiyui.

tcz: “Koiman houhil nati diu janom hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil khat naneiyun, chule nangho nabon chauva sopite hina a kibang cheh nahiu ahi.”
en_web: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
en_kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon vang mi, ‘Rabbi,’ kitisah hih-un, ajeh chu Houhil khat bou naneiyun, naboncha sopi cheh nahiuve.

tcz: Chule hiche leiset chunga koima Pa sah hih un, ajeh chu vana um Pathen chu Lhagaova na-Pau ahi.
en_web: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
en_kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga koima, ‘Pa,’ sah hih-un, van a na-Pau khat bou aum’e.

tcz: Chule koiman nangho houhil tin kikousah hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil naneiyun, Messiah chu ahi.
en_web: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
en_kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho, ‘Lamkai,’ kitisah dauvin, lamkai khatseh, Messiah chu nanei nauve.

tcz: Nalah uva alen pen hinoma chu soh ahi angaiye.
en_web: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
en_kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah –uva alenpen chu nalhachauva pang ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah ama kichoisang ho chu kisu nem'intin, chule akingai nem ho chu kichoi sang ding ahiuve.
en_web: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
en_kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding, ama kineosah chu kichoi sang ding ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Mipha lhem ho! Ajeh chu miho maikoh'ah nanghon Van Lenggam kot chu nakhah'un ahi. Nang hola nalut pouvin chule midang ho jong alut diu na janom deh pouve.”
en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
en_kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Mipha lhem ho! Miho din van a Lenggam kot nakhah tan’un, nang ho la nalut thei deh pouvin, lut dia kigo ho geiyin nalutsah pouve!

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Nanghon meithai ho anei-agou thil chung'ah jachatna thei leuvin dohan nabol'un, chule hou ngaisah tah tobang'in mipi lah'a sotpi natao un ahi. Hiche jeh'a hi gimbolna nasatah kipe ding nahiuve.”
en_web: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
tcz_gospelgo: (Ohe Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Meithai ho in dunga sottah tah nataovun nabahgam jiuve. Hijeh a chu genthei hesoh chungnung nathoh diu ahi.)

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon mi khat na loilutna ding un, gam tina twikhanglen gal geiyin navah leuvin, chule khat touvin lung ahin heiya ahileh nangho amachu nivei jen Damun cha in nasem un, nangho jong nahiu ahi!”
en_web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Mi khatseh jong Juda hou housah din Twikhanglen jousea nakitol’un, gamkai jouose nachonsoh-un, nahousah tengule nangho sanga ajat nijen khoh jon Damun jon din nasemdoh jiuve.

tcz: “Mitcho lamhil ho! Itobang lunghemna in nahin pha diuvem! Ajeh chu nang hon Pathen hou-in'a kihahsel ima akhohpoi natiuve; hinlah hou-in sunga Sana'a kihahsel chu khoh'ah ahi, natiuve.”
en_web: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
en_kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe nadau ahi, ‘Koi hile Houin pan a kihahsel chu ajeh pon, Houin a kikoi sana pan a kihahsel vang ajeh theiye,’ tia mihil lamkai mitcho ho!

tcz: Mitcho mingol ho! Hou-in'a sana ahilouleh Hou-in sana suthenga chu hoijoh thupijo hintem?
en_web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
en_kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
tcz_gospelgo: Mitcho mi-ngol ho! Houin jeh a sana athenga kisimpi chu hoijoh thupi jom sana ham Houin ham?

tcz: Chule nanghon maicham muna kihahsel chu imacha akhohpoi, hinlah maicham chunga thil kipedoh'a kihahsel chu khoh ahi, natiuve.
en_web: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
en_kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuma leh, ‘Maicham pan a kihahsel vangin akijeh pon, maicham chunga kitoh thil-ho pat jeh-in je na aum theiye,’ na tiuve.

tcz: Itobang loma mitcho nahiu ham! Maicham chunga thilto kichoi chuleh thilto suthenga maicham joh chu hoiche thupijo ham?
en_web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
en_kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
tcz_gospelgo: Mitcho ho! Maicham jeh a a thilto thenga kisimpi chu hoijoh thupijom-maicham ham thilto ham?

tcz: Nangho maicham pan'a nakihahsel tenguleh hiche maichama kihahsela chule maicham chunga umho geiya chu kihahsela nahi tai.
en_web: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
en_kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu maicham pan a kihahsel chanin maicham chunga kitoh thil geiya apat tha a kihalsel ahitai.

tcz: Chule nangho Hou-in pan'a na kihahsel tenguleh hiche maicham munle maichama cheng Pathen'a kihahsel nahiu ahitai.
en_web: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
en_kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu Houin pan a kihahsel jong chun Houin sunga Chenga Pathen apat’a kihahsel ahi.

tcz: Chule van min pan'a nakihahsel teng Pathen laltouna le Pathen laltouna'a toupa'a chu kihahsel nahi ahitai.
en_web: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
en_kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule van pan a kihahsel’an jong Pathen laltouna min le achunga Toupa pan a kihahsel ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lung hemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon nahonsoh uva kona muchi neopen geiyin som'a khat napeuve, hinlah danthupeh akhohjo, adih'a thutan khotona chule tahsan nahsah in nagel pouve!”
en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Nang hon pudina le pa-thikhom chule jira-hicheng hi som a khat na toh jiuvin, Danthua thil khoh cheh, adih a thu tan ding, mi hepi ding le tahsan ding hicheng hi don louvin nakoi jiuve. Adang nabol’u chutoh kilhon a hicheng jong hi nabol diu ahi.

tcz: Mitcho lamhil ho! Thousi vaibong naval louna ding uvin twina lhiu vin, hilah nanghon sangongsang napum val uve!
en_web: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
en_kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel.
tcz_gospelgo: Lamkai mitcho ho! Nang hon thou vaisi nalhiuvin, sa-ngongsao napum val’ui.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon khon le kong chu apolam siltheng nathem un, hinlah nasung lamu, chip setna le kichang khohsahnan nadim uve.”
en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Khon le lheng polam nasil ngim’un, asunga la phumhat’a nathil lah-u le papsetna adimset’e!

tcz: Mitcho Pharisee ho! Amasan khon le kong chu asung soptheng un, chutengleh apolam jong chu hungtheng tante.
en_web: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
en_kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee mitcho ho! Khon chu asung silngim leu chun apolam jong ngim ding ahi!

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu lhan kiloibang tobangbep nahiuve, apolam vet hoi, hinlah nasunglam'u mithi gu le nen dimset nahiuve.”
en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Nang ho hi lhan kiloi bang, polam vet dia hoi, asung la mithigu le aboh anen ijakai dimset tobang nahiuve.

tcz: Polama vet ding'in midihho to nakilou uvin, hinlah nasung gil lamu phatlhemna le danbei nahibou uve.
en_web: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
en_kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin polam vet din dihtah bangin na-um’un, nasungu vang phat lhemna le chonsetna dimse nahiuve.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon napu napa teuvin anathau themgao hole Pathen ngaisah ho lhan chu nasemhoiyun ahi.”
en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Nang hon Themgaote lhan nasem’un, midih ho lhan khuh najem jem’un,

tcz: Chujongleh nanghon kapu kapateu phatlai chun keiho anahing leuveng themgao ho athanauva kajaolou beh dingu ahi, natiuve.
en_web: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
en_kjv: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Kapu kapateu khang laiya hing lileu vang Themgaote atha nauva pang kha pou vinge,’ tin na seiyui.

tcz: “Hinlah hitia nasei jeng vangun, nanghon themgao that ho sonle chi lhah nahiuve tiphot chetna nakiphondoh u ahiye.”
en_web: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
en_kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin Themgaote that’a pang ho chihlhah nahi nau nang hon naphongdoh tauve.

tcz: Cheuvin lang napu napa teuvin ana-patsau chu nanghon gabulhit un.
en_web: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
en_kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateu toh ban chu tong molso ngal’un!

tcz: Gulho, gulse chilhah ho! Damun thutanna chu iti napel thei mong ding'u ham?
en_web: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
en_kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo gulse son, gulsete! Damun a talen namat diu chu iti otdoh theiying natiu ham?

tcz: “Hijeh'a chu keiman themgao ho le miching ho chule Houdan thuhil ho na henguva ka hinsol ahi. Hinlah nanghon abang chu thingpela na khetbeh dingu, chule adangse chu hou ki khopna in'a najep dingu, chule khopi khat'a kona khopi choma nadelle dingu ahi.”
en_web: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
en_kjv: Wherefore behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
tcz_gospelgo: Veuvin Themgaote le miching ho chule Danthu them ho kahinsol peh-e, abang nathauva, abang thingpel’a nakhet beh diu, abangma Houthua kikhopna in dunga najep’uva, khotin a nadel le diu ahi.

tcz: Hitia chu michonpha Abel kitha'a pat Barachiah chapa Zechariah Hou'in maicham teni kikah'a kithat ho jouse chunga themmona nahin kipoh dingu ahi.
en_web: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
en_kjv: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche naboljeh-uva hi monabei Abel thisan kisoa pat, muntheng le maicham kah a nathau Berechiah chapa, monabei Zechariah thisan kiso geiya themmona bei miho thisan, tol’a long lha ho jeh a themmona chengse nachunguva chuh lo ding ahi.

tcz: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga hung lhung ding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hicheng jeh a themmona chu hiche khang mite chunga chu ding ahi.

tcz: “Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem themgao ho that le Pathen thupole ho that'a pangho! Ahpin anoute alhaving tenia a-opkhum tobanga nachateu itobang tah'a kakhoptup kigot hitam! Hinlah nanghon neiphal peh pouve.
en_web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
en_kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not?
tcz_gospelgo: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Themgao ho that’a, akisolpeh jouse songa a sep lih-ah! Ahpin anoute ahuikhom banga ijatvei nachate huikhom ding kagot hitam! Hinla neinoppeh poi!

tcz: Chule tun veuvin, na in'u chu dalhahsa le ahomkeo ahitai.
en_web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
en_kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu na-in kamdel’a kidalhah peh ding nahi!

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche thutahbeh hi kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga chu ding ahi!”
en_web: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
en_kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, tua pat, ‘Pakai min a Hungpa anun nom’e,’ nati masangseuva neimukit lou diu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan Hou'in leitol mun adalhah ding chun, aseijuite ho chun Hou'in kisahna in tampi ho chu avetsah uve.
en_web: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
en_kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin dalha apotdoh chun Jesu henga aseijuite ahungun, Houin kisah loupije vetsah agouve.

tcz: Hinlah aman adonbut in, “Hiche in kisadoh ho namu'vem? Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, abonchauva ki phelha sohkei ding, song hi khat chunga khat kise thom jong um lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Ahinai, aloupije hi vesoh keiyun, amavang kaseipeh nahiuve, song khat chunga khat kisethom hung umlou hel ding, kipehsoh kei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin, Yeshua Olivet mola atouvin, aseijuiho chu guh thim in akoma ahung un, hiti hin aseiyuve, “Nahung kitna ding melchihna ipi hiya chule vannoi kichaini itih le hi ding ham?” ahung tiuvin.
en_web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
en_kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
tcz_gospelgo: Olive molchinga Jesu atoupeh’in guh thim chan aseijute ahungun, “Hitobang thilse ho chu ith hung lhunga, nahung kit ding phat leh lseiset kichai ding chu ipia kimel chih ding ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan aheng uva, “Koima cha kipui khelsah hih un.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Ching theiyun koima kilhep lhahsah dauvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima min'a mi tampi hung ding u, keima Messiah kahi ahungti ding u, amahon mi tampi alhep lhah diu ahi.
en_web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
en_kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem tamtah kamin a hunguva, Keima Messiah kahi,’ atiuva mitampi alhep lhah diu ahi.

tcz: Chule nanghon galthu ho leh galbol khum dinga kigihna ho najah diu, hinlah kicha hih un. Tahbeh'a hiche hohi hunglhung ding, hinlah hichu achaina hipai jeng loulai ding ahi.”
en_web: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
en_kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
tcz_gospelgo: Gal kisat husa le gal kisat thukithang najah tdiu, hi jongle kicha hih-un; hitobang ho hi soh tei ding, amavang achaina hilou lai ding ahi.

tcz: Nam khat le nam khat gal'a kibolto ding, chule lenggam khat le lenggam khat kidou ding ahi. Vannoi muntin'a kel lhan tin chule ling hung kihot ding ahi.
en_web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
en_kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes in divers places.
tcz_gospelgo: Gam khat le gam khat kidouva, lenggam khat le lenggam chom khat kisat ding, muntin a kel lhantin, ling kihot ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche ho jouse hi amasa pena naosonat thoh ahahsat bang bep hi ding, adang jong hung umbe nalai ding ahi.
en_web: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
en_kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi naoso nat bang da kipatna ahi nalaiye.

tcz: “Chuteng nang ho, amahon namat uva, nabol engset diu chule nahin tha diu ahi nalaiye.
en_web: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
en_kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Min namat’uva midang ho khut’a napeh diu, talen namatsah uva natha diu ahi. Keima jal’a namtinin nahotlo diu ahi.

tcz: Chule mi tampi keiya kona kihei mang ding chule ki pedoh to'uva chujongleh ki hoto ding ahiuve.
en_web: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
en_kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah le mi tampi tahsan a pull ha a, khat le khat kipedoh toa kihoto diu;

tcz: Themgao lhem tamtah hung umdoh ding, mitampi alhep lhah diu ahi.
en_web: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
en_kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
tcz_gospelgo: Themgao lhem tampi sohdoh-in tin, mi tamtah alhep lhah diu ahi.

tcz: Chonsetna chu muntin'a pungcheh cheh ding chule mi tampi ngailutna'a hung dailha ding ahiuve.
en_web: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
en_kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
tcz_gospelgo: Chon chatvaina pung cheh cheh-in tin, mi tamtah ngailutna dailha diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah koi hileh akhonni geiya thoh lhum a chu huhhinga um ding ahi.
en_web: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
en_kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinla akhon ni geiya thoh lhumkeiya chu huhhinga umtei ding ahinai.

tcz: Chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha hi vannoi pumpia kihil lhang le ding ahi, hitia chu namtin in ajah diu; chujou tah le achaina hung hi ding ahi.”
en_web: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
en_kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule hiche Lenggam Kipana Thupha hi vannoi pumpia kiseiphonga kihettohsah ding, chu jou tengleh kichai ding ahibouve.

tcz: “Daniel themgaovin asei nikho chu nahin mu diu chule thet umtah chu mitmu tah'a munthenga ahung din namu diu ahi (Asim sim in gelkhoh hen).”
en_web: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
en_kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichejeh chun mi sumang thet umtah, Daniel Themgao kama kiseisa chu muntheng phunga adin namu tenguleh! (asim sim an he hen)

tcz: Chuteng leh Judea gam'a umho mol lama jam uhen.
en_web: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
en_kjv: then let them which be in Judea flee into the mountains:
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Judea gama um chengse molsang sanga jam’u hen.

tcz: In chunga um chu ins unga thil gakilah din kumsuh dahen.
en_web: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
en_kjv: let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
tcz_gospelgo: Inting vuma um jong insunga thilkeo kilah din kumlhah da hen.

tcz: Louva uma jong chun asang khol chol kilah ding in kile dahen.
en_web: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
en_kjv: neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
tcz_gospelgo: Loukon jong ponsil kilah din kile da hen.

tcz: Numei naovop hole naonoi chepsah minu ho ding in hiche nikho ho sung chu iti ahoiset tadem?
en_web: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
en_kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe, chulai ta a numei agaiya le nao noi chepsah nalai ho chu ada na-e!

tcz: Chule najam nau phat chu phalbi lai ahilouleh Sabbath nikho ahilouna ding in tao un.
en_web: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,
en_kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
tcz_gospelgo: Najam cheh nau phat chu phalpi lai le Choldo nikho ahilouna din taovun!

tcz: Ajeh chu vannoi kipat til apat anasoh khalou, chule hung um bekit talou ding thoh hahsa chungnung hunglhung ding ahi.
en_web: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
en_kjv: for then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengle hesoh genthei chungnung hung um ding, hitobang hi vannoi kisemtil’a pat tulai geiya soh kha louhel lai ahin, hung jong hungsoh kit lou ding ahi.

tcz: Tahbeh in, chuche thoh hahsa nikho chu kisuchom lou hileh, mihem khat jeng jong hoidoh lou ding ahi. Hinlah Pathen lhen chomte jal'a nikho chu kisu chom ding ahi.
en_web: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
en_kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche niho chu Pathenin asuhchom lou hileh tahsa mihing khat cha jong soh cha lou ding ahi, hijeh a chu lhenchomte jal’a hiche nikho hi kisuchom ding ahi.

tcz: “Chuche phat tengleh koiham khat touvin ven, Messiah hikoma aume ahilouleh khukoma aume atia ahijongleh tahsan hih un.
en_web: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.
en_kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichepet hileh min najahuva, ‘Ven, hiche hi Messiah ahi,’ ati ham, ahiloule ‘Hiche hi Ama ahi,’ ati ham hijongle tahsan hihuvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu Messiah lhem ho leh themgao lhem ho hung kipatdoh uvin tin, melchihna kidang le datmo umho chu ahin boldoh diu, ahitheileh Pathen lhen chomte tah jong alheplhah diu ahi.”
en_web: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
en_kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Messiah lhem le Themgao lhem tampi hung kisem doh-un tin, ahithei le bon thenchomte geiya pui mangna dia melchihna le thil kidang nasa tah tah ahinbol diu ahi.

tcz: Veuvin, keiman aphat lhun masanga kahil chah masah nahiuve.
en_web: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
en_kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
tcz_gospelgo: Veuvin, ahung lhun masanga kahil masah dem nahiuve.

tcz: “Hiti ahijeh chun, mi koiham khat touvin, ven, Messiah chu hikoma, ahilouleh gamthip a aume, atiu jongleh tahsan hih un.
en_web: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
en_kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahilouva, ‘Veuvin, Messiah gamthip laiya aum’e,’ atiu jongle chedoh a vet din gel dauvin; ‘Veuvin indan sung nunga aum’e’ tijongleu tahsan hih-un.

tcz: Ajeh chu kolphe chun solam ahinsal a chule lhumlam ahinsalvah pai tobanga, Mihem Chapa ahung jong chuti ding ahi.
en_web: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
en_kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kolphe nisolama ahung phet leh nilhom lam geiya asalvah banga Mihem Chapa hung kit ding chuti ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu muthong ho kikhop khom chun anaivela thilong uma ahi avetsah banga, hiche melchihna ho hin phat kichai ahung naitai ti ahil chet ahi.”
en_web: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
en_kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hoikom hileh thilong phunga muthong kikhom tei ding ahi.

tcz: “Hiche hesohna nikho ho chu akichai tengleh, nisa thim in tin, lha jong avah sohdoh tapon tin, ahsi ho jeng jong van'a kona pullha ding, chule van thaneina ho chu kihot lingsoh ding ahi.
en_web: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
en_kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
tcz_gospelgo: “Thoh genthei hesoh nikho kichaisohtengleh nisa thim a, lha jong vah talou ding, vanlaijol’a kona ahsite pul lhan tin, van a thaneina jouse kihot lingsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Chule achaina keiya Mihem Chapa ahung na ding melchihna van hoa hung kilang doh ding, chule leiset mite jouse chunga lunghemna um ding ahi. Amahon Mihem Chapa chu van meilhang lah'a thunei le loupi tah'a ahung amu diu ahi.
en_web: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
en_kjv: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah le vanlaijol’a Mihem Chapa melchihna hung kilang ding ahin vannoi leiset phungtin a min dip le lai kidoh’uva, van meilhang lah a Mihem Chapa thanei tah le loupe tah a hung amu dingu ahi.

tcz: Chule Aman avantil ho chu sumkon ginthong jeju chutoh, asoldoh tha ding, chule amahon alhen chomte chu vannoi muntina kona van le leiset kikah kigamlat napen geiya kona chu akhop khom diu ahi.”
en_web: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
en_kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa sumkon gin nasatah ho thoa Avantilte’asol ding, lhenchomte chengse van mong lang khat’a pat among lang khat geiya, kolkimvel ning lia akhop khom diu ahi.

tcz: “Tun theichang phunga kon in kihilna khat neiyu hite. Thingbah ho ahung dot a chule ana ho anou tengleh khal ahung naitai ti nahe uve.
en_web: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
en_kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
tcz_gospelgo: “Theichang phung hin thulem kihil’un. Ajih adot’a ana anou teng nipi naidol naheuve.

tcz: Hitobang ma chun hiche ho jouse namu soh tenguleh, Ama hung kitna ding anaitai, kotbul ahin phatai ti heuvin.
en_web: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.
en_kjv: so likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
tcz_gospelgo: Hihe chun hichengse hi namu tengu leh naiya hung ding koncha ahi heuvin.

tcz: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahi uve, hiche ho jouse hi akichai masangsea hiche nam mite hi suhmil'a um lou ding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, thil hicheng hi aguilhun masangsea hiche khang hi kichai lou ding ahi.

tcz: Van le leiset hungmang ding, hinlah Ka Thu hi mang lou ding ahi.”
en_web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
en_kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
tcz_gospelgo: Van le leiset mang ding ahin, kathusei ho vang mang lou ding ahi.

tcz: “Hinama jongleh, hiche ho hung lhunna ding chu vana Vantil ho hihen lang, ahilouleh Chapa Amatah in jong koima chan anikho le aphat tah ahepoi, Pa bouvin ahet ahi.”
en_web: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
en_kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche Nikho hi Pa tilou van a Vantilte le Chapan jong chule koimachan ahepoi.

tcz: “Mihem Chapa chu ahung kinungle teng, Noah nikholai tobang hi ding ahi.
en_web: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
en_kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa hungkit hi Noah nikho lai thilsoh banga hungsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Chuche nikho lai chun, twisanglet masang in, miho chun golvah abolun, chule golnop le kichenna ho Noah kong sunga alut nikho lhin kahsen abol'un ahi.”
en_web: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
en_kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
tcz_gospelgo: Noah nikho lai twisang let masang, Noah kong alut ni geiyin, mihon aneuvin adon’un, akichengun, chen jong akichensah-ui;

tcz: Twisang ahunglet'a chule amaho alhoh mang masang seuvin miho chun, ipi hungsoh ding ahi ahepha pouve. Mihem Chapa ahung teng jong leh chutima hung hi ding ahi.
en_web: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
en_kjv: and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
tcz_gospelgo: twisang lenin achup mang kahseuvin, kho helouvin aum’uve. Mihem Chapa hungkit jong chute ding ahi.

tcz: “Pasal nin louva na hintong khom lhon intin, khat kila'a khat johpa kida lhading,
en_web: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
en_kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng mi ni louva umkhom jong khat kila khat kida lha ding,

tcz: Numei nin sumheiya chang goikhom lhon in tin, khat kila a, khat ki dalha ding ahi.”
en_web: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
en_kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
tcz_gospelgo: numei ni sumhei khat’a chang goikhom te ni jong khat kila khat kida lha ding ahi.

tcz: “Hiti ahijeh chun nangho jong ki hongphan um un! Ajeh chu itih nikhoa na Pakai hung ding ahi nahe pouve.
en_web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
en_kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun na-Pakaiyu hung ding nikho nahet loujeh-un kiging phauvin.

tcz: Hiche hi heuvin: In neipa chun itih a gucha ahung ding kihetleh, ama ki hongphan um intin, chule a in chu phetvanga aumsah lou ding ahi.
en_web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
en_kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
tcz_gospelgo: Gucha itih a hung ding inneipan heleh kiging jinga um ding, a-in aphet vangsah lou ding naheuve.

tcz: Nang ho jong nakigin jing'u angaiye, ajeh chu Mihem Chapa chu nagel loupet tah uva hung ding ahi.”
en_web: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
en_kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as you think not the Son of man cometh.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun kiging jingin um’un, nakigin loupet tah-uva Mihem Chapa hung ding ahi.

tcz: “Soh tahsan um, phottohna neiya umpa chu apupa insung pumpia asoh dang ho, phatecha vepha'a aneh diu aphatcha gong tobang ahi.
en_web: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
en_kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
tcz_gospelgo: “Soh tahsan um le chingtah, a-insung mite aphat cha neh le choh hoppeh dia, insung vaipoa apun anganse chu koi ham?

tcz: A pupa chu ahung kile kit'a chule asohpa chun phate chan atoh ding dol atonge ti amua ahileh kipaman amuding ahi.
en_web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
en_kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
tcz_gospelgo: Apu hung teng hitobanga anatoh atokhah soh chu anun nom’e!

tcz: Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, a pupa chun hiche sohpa chu anei jouse chunga amopoh sah ding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chu apun anei jouse chunga vaipoa akoi ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche soh chu phata hih leh chule hitin gel henlang: Kapu hi niphabep set hung kile lou ding ahi, tihen lang,
en_web: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
en_kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
tcz_gospelgo: Soh gilou chun alung gel’in, ‘Kapu hungvah ponte,’ tin

tcz: aman soh pasal dangho chu votahen lang, nopneh bol hen chule jukham tahen lang hileh,
en_web: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
en_kjv: and shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
tcz_gospelgo: asoh chanpi chengse deng panta hen, anop nop nehen don taleh,

tcz: a pupa chu hetsah masatna nei louvin hung henlang chule agel loupet hitaleh,
en_web: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
en_kjv: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not ware of,
tcz_gospelgo: hiche sohpa chun agel lou nikho le ahet loupet tah a apu hung ding,

tcz: aman hiche sohpa chu asat tel tel'a chule mi phalhem ho lah'a akoi ding ahi. Hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
en_kjv: and shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: asohpa chu tum ni asoa, mipha lhem ho talen amatsah ding, hikoma chu kap le hagel gel’a um ding ahi

tcz: “Chuti chun Van Lenggam chu mounu loiho nungah som thaomei kiken a, moulang lamto dinga kigo hotoh ki tekah ding ahi.”
en_web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
en_kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche phat hileh van a Lenggam chu athaomeiyu kichoi cheh a ji nei dingpa lamto goah nu-ngah som tobang ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho lah'a nga chu angol uvin, chule adang nga chu aching-uve.
en_web: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
en_kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah nga chu lungthimbei ahiuvin, nga chu lungthim pha ahiuve.

tcz: Nga angol ho chun athao meiyuva ding'in thao akiken bulhing pouvin ahi.
en_web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
en_kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthimbei hon thaomei aken vangun thaotwi akeng pouve;

tcz: Hinlah adang nga ho vang chu aching theiyuvin thao bom'a thao akiken beuvin ahi.
en_web: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
en_kjv: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
tcz_gospelgo: lungthim pha hon vang athaomeiyuva det kham thaotwiya akenthauve.

tcz: Moulang chu ahung gei phat in, amaho aboncha uvin alulhu uvin chule a-ihmu tauve.
en_web: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
en_kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
tcz_gospelgo: Ji nei dingpa ahung geibehseh phat’in nu-ngah ho alu lhu’uvin, a-ihmusoh tauve.

tcz: Jan khangkim in khosam aw chun asukhang un, “Veuvin, moulang chu ahung tai! Hungdoh un chule lamto uvin!” ati.
en_web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
en_kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Jan khangkim laiyin ji nei dingpa ahungtai! Hungun galam touvin” akiti.

tcz: “Mounu loiho chu aboncha uvin athoudoh un, chule athaomeiyu akigot tauve.
en_web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
en_kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in nu-ngah ho athouvun thaomei akigot tauve.

tcz: Chuphat in adang nga angol ho chun aloi dang ho chu angah un, nathao twiyu chu phabep neipe uvin, ajeh chu kathao meiyu mitding ahitai” atiuve.
en_web: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
en_kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun lungthimbei hon lungthim pha ho jah a, ‘Kathaomeiyu thaotwi aumtapoi, thaotwi them khat beh neipeuvin,’ tin athum tauve.

tcz: Hinlah adangse chun adonbut un, keihon ibon-uva dingin kanei lhing pouve. Ajohna mun khat'a gache uvin chule nang ho ding gacho uvin ati.
en_web: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
en_kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lungthim pha hon adonbut’un, ‘Igom’uva din lhing ponte, chusangin cheuvin lang ajoh ho koma gakichoh vah tauvin,’ atiuve.

tcz: “Ahin amaho thaotwi choa ache kah un, moulang chu ahung tai. Chuphat in kigosa umho chu amatoh golvahna in'a chun ache khom'un chule kot chu akam tauve.”
en_web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
en_kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthimbei ho thaotwi choa ache lan’un ji nei dingpa ahung paiyin, kigingsa um chengsen kichen golvahna mun’ah akijot lut piuvin, kot kikhah tai.

tcz: Khonung in, mounu loi nga ho chu ahung phat un, polama ading un, akou-un, “Pakai! Pakai! Keidin kot hong in” atiuve.
en_web: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
en_kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chom khat jouvin lungthim bei nu-ngah ho ahungun, ‘Kapu, kapu, kot neihon’un!’ tin asamtauve.

tcz: Hinlah Aman alekou vin, “Kasei hi tahsan un, Keiman nangho kahe pouve,”
en_web: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
en_kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
tcz_gospelgo: Ji nei dingpan, ‘Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang ho kahe khapoi,’ ati tai.

tcz: “Hijeh chun nangho jong kihong phauvin! Ajeh chu nanghon kahung kile na ding nikho le phat chu nahe pouve,” ati.
en_web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
en_kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
tcz_gospelgo: “Anikho le anidan tah nahet loujeh-un kigingun.

tcz: “Chujongleh Van Lenggam chu mikhat khol gam latah a gajin doh toh kitekah ding ahi. Aman asohte akou khom in chule asum chu aum lou kah'a ding in amaho chu ngansena apetai.”
en_web: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
en_kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche phat hileh van a Lenggam chu khol gamla tah chedoh goa, asohte koukhoma, anei jouse asohte ngansepa thusim tobang ding ahi.

tcz: Aman khat chu dangka sumdip nga jen apen, michom khat dangka sumdip ni apen, chule anunung penpa dangka sumdip khat apen ahi. Amahon atha uvin ajokham cheh'a achan diu ahoppeh sohkei in ahi. Chujouvin ama khol jindin achetai.
en_web: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
en_kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh khat chu talent nga apen, khat talent ni apen, khatma chu talent khat apen, athan ajokhop cheh-in ahoppeh-in khol’a achetai.

tcz: “Dangka sumdip nga kilah sohpa chun asum chu aveikan in ahileh nga ma alodoh tai.”
en_web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
en_kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
tcz_gospelgo: Talent nga sangpa akipat’a kiveina aneileh talent nga ma aveikan bei.

tcz: Dangka sumdip ni sangpa jong chu natong in achen ahileh ni-ma alodoh betai.
en_web: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
en_kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
tcz_gospelgo: Talent ni sangpa akipat’a kiveina aneileh talent ni ma aveikan bei.

tcz: Hinlah dangka sumdip khat sangpa chun leiset ko alaiyin chuin apu sum chu avuitai.
en_web: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
en_kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
tcz_gospelgo: Talent khat sangpan vang lei alaiyin apupa sum chu asel tai.

tcz: Phat phabepset jouvin apupa chu akholchena'a kon in ahung kilen, chule asum chu iti amanchah uvem tin akou khom in, akholtoh in ahi.
en_web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
en_kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Phat sotpi nungin hiche soh ho pupa hi ahung kile kit tan, asohte toh som asutouve.

tcz: Dangka sumdip nga angan sepa chu ahung in nga-ma ahin choiben chuin aseiyin, Pu, nangman Dangka sumdip nga neipeh ahin, keiman sumdip nga-ma kamube e, ati.
en_web: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
en_kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained besides them five talents moe.
tcz_gospelgo: Talent nga sangpan talent nga ma ahinchoi ben, ‘Kapu, talent nga neipen, talent nga ma kavei kan bei,’ tin apetai.

tcz: “Apu chun apahcha lheh jeng in, ‘Nabol aphalheh jenge Ka sohpha le tahsan umtah nahi. Hicheng sum hi tahsan um tah a nachin ahin, tua hi keiman ngen sena tamjo cheh kapeh ding nahitai. Kipah thanom khomu hite!’”
en_web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
en_kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Apun, ‘Tahsan umtah soh pha, nabol pha lheh jenge! Thil themcha chunga kitah nahin, tampi chunga vai kahomsah ding nahi. Hungin napu kipana a hung kipah-in,’ ati.

tcz: “Dangka sumdip ni sangpa chun ahin nailut in, aseitai, ‘Pu, nangman veipung dinga neipeh Dangka sumdip nia kon in kasupung in’, ni-ma kamube e,” ati.
en_web: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
en_kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents besides them.
tcz_gospelgo: Talent ni sangpan, ‘Kapu, talent ni neipen, talent ni ma kaveikan bei,’ tin apetai.

tcz: “Chuin apupan, nabol aphai kasohpha le tahsan umtah, nangma sum lhomcha chunga tahsan umtah nahi, hiti chun tua mopohna tamjo cheh kapeh ding nahi. Kipah thanom khom'u hite!”
en_web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
en_kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Apun, ‘Tahsan um soh pha, nabol pha lheh jeng! Nang jong thil themcha chunga kitah nahin, tampi chunga vai kahomsah ding nahi. Hungin napu kipana a hung kipah-in,’ ati.

tcz: “Chujouvin, Dangka sumdip khat sangpa chu ahung in chuin aseiyin, ‘Pu, keiman nangma hi mi gumtah nahi ti kahen, naphuna louva na atjin, chule nalho louna'a nakhom khomji ti nahina kahei.
en_web: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
en_kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
tcz_gospelgo: Talent khat sangpa jong ahungin, ‘Kapu, mi kikhel nahikahen, natuna louva at theiya, nathe na louva jong chomkhom thei nahin,

tcz: Nasum chu mansah ding kana tijan, hijeh'a chu leinoiya kasel ahi. Ven, nasum hi kilelah kit in,’” ati.
en_web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
en_kjv: and I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
tcz_gospelgo: nang kagin jeh-in kachen natalent chu lei noiya kaseltai. Hiche hi nasum ma ma nakilah kit ahi,’ tin apetai.

tcz: “Hinlah apu chun adonbut in, nangma sohgilou le thase, Keiman kaphu louna'a ka-at nahet a, chule kalho louna leiya kakhop khom nahet ahileh,
en_web: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
en_kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
tcz_gospelgo: Apun jong, ‘Vo soh gilou le thase! Katuna louva ka-atjia kathe na louva kachomkham ji nahet ahiye ong!

tcz: ipi dinga kasum chu sum veipungna'a koi louva nahim? Chuti hen hileh athoi themkhatbeh toh mutha tadinga! ati.”
en_web: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
en_kjv: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasum chu sumkolvei ho koma apung dia nanakoi leh itim? Chutileh kahung phat’a kasumpi le akan kilah that a ding!

tcz: “Chujouvin aman thu apen, sum chu hiche sohpa a kon in ladoh uvin chule dangka sumdip som mupa koma peuvin.
en_web: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
en_kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepa talent chu lahpeh-un lang taleng som neipa chu petauvin,

tcz: Akipe kham kham phatea amanje heho chu, atamjo cheh kipe ding, chule bu-lhingset'a anei diu ahi. Hinlah imacha bollou ho chu lhomcha anei chasun'u jong kilah mangpeh ding ahiuve.
en_web: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

tcz_gospelgo: Chom khat jouvin chu koma ding miho ahungun Peter jah a, mong nahibouve, napao dan hin nakiphong doh tai,” atiuve.

en_web: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

tcz: Jingpi matah in thempu pipui holeh miho lah'a upa ho atoukhom kit un, Yeshua thana ding angaito tauve.

en_web: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

tcz_gospelgo: Jesu matsah a pang Judas chun, Jesu tha dia thu kitan ahetdoh phat’in akisih behseh jengin, dangka somthum chu Thempu len ho le upaho alepeh kit’in,

tcz_gospelgo: “Themmonabei tha dinga kapehdoh chu kathemmotai!” ati. Amahon la, “Keiho i-kin hiya ong? Nangin kivet tange,” atiuve.

tcz_gospelgo: Judas-in sum chu Houin sunga aseplhan, apotdoh paiyin agakikhai lihtai.

tcz: Thempu pipui ho chun sum nong chu aloh khom un, aseiyun, “Hiche sum hi Hou'in a sumkoina a koikhom nom ponte, ajeh chu mithana dinga ki pedohsa ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
en_kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempulen hon dangka chujat chu alauvin, “Hiche sum hi thisan man ahin, Houin sung sumkholnaa koi ngai ahipoi,” atiuve.

tcz: Aki houtoh jouvun, ajonan amahon bel dengpa honlei chohna ding in agellha tauve. Chule hichu gam pam mi kivuina ding in asem tauve.
en_web: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
en_kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
tcz_gospelgo: Akihoutoh phat’un gamdang miho lhan mol din, beldengpa lou mun achoh natauve.

en_web: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
en_kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu Rome gamvai popa angsunga adinsah tauvin, gamvaipon ajah a, “Judate lengpa nahim?” tin adonge. Jesun, “Chutia nasei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hinlah Thempu pipui holeh upa hon ama douna thu aseiyun, Yeshua athipbeh in ahi.
en_web: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
en_kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempulen ho le upaten ahehsetna thudol’a vang imacha adonbut poi.

en_kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’in Jesu jah a, “Mihon hijat’a nahehset nau hi najah lou ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan athemmosah naho'uva imacha adonbutlou jeh chun Gamvaipo chun adatmo lheh e.
en_web: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
en_kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thu cheng khat cha jong adonbut lou phat’in gamvaipopan kidang asa lheh jenge.

tcz: Kalchuh Kut kumseh le kiman jina'a chu mi honpin adeiyu khat gamvaipo chun sohchang khat alhadoh jiu ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Kalchuh kut sunga hi sohchang koi hileh japi dei pen pen khat Gamvaipon alhadoh peh ji ahi.

tcz: Hiche kum'a hi sohchang giloutah khat Barabbas atiu ana um'ah ahi.

en_kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin sohchang minse tah Jesu Barabbas-khat akihen’e.

tcz: Mihonpi chu Pilate in'a akikhop pet un, hiche jingkah chun, aman amaho chu adong in, “Nangho dinga koijoh ham kalha dohpeh diu? Barabbas ham ahilouleh Yeshua kiti Messiah hi kalha dohpeh diu ham?” ati.
en_web: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
en_kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi hung kikhop phat’in Pilate’n ajah uvah, “Jesu Barabbas kalhadoh peh diu ha, Messiah kiti Jesu joh kalhahdoh peh diu ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: (Amahin houlamkai hon Yeshua chu thangthip man'a amat'u ahi, ti ahe chen lheh in ahi).

en_kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Juda lamkaiten thangset suma Jesu apehdohu chu ahet ahi.

tcz: Pilate thutanna'a atoupet tah in ajinu chun hiche thuhi athot in: “Hiche themmona beipa hi limsah hih in. Ama jeh hin tujan ka-ihmutna'a chun kathoh gimlheh jenge,” ati.
en_web: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
en_kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutanna muna Pilate atoupet man ajinun thu ahin thot’in, “Themmona bei hichepa chu limsah hih-in, ama jeh hin tunin kamangin kathoh gim lheh jenge,” ati.

tcz: Hichepet chun thempu pipui holeh upa ho chun mi honpi chu atem un, Barabbas chu lhadoh'a auma chule Yeshua chu thisah ding in atil tauvin ahi.
en_web: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Thempulen ho le upa ten Jesu asuhmanga Barabbas joh alha na din mipi atilseuvin, angeh sah tauve.

tcz: Hiti chun Gamvaipopa chun adong kit in, “Koijoh hi lhadohpeh leuveng nalung uham?” ati. Mi honpi chun, Barabbas atiuve.
en_web: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
en_kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamvaipopan mipi adongin, “Hite ni kah a hoijoh kalhadoh peh ding nadeiyum?” ati. Mipin, “Barabbas!” atiuve.

tcz: Pilate in adonbut in, “Messiah kiti Yeshua hila ikalo ding ham?” ati. Amahon, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.

tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’n, “Ahile Messiah kiti Jesu hi iba kalo ding hitam?” ati. Mipin, “Thingpel’a khenbehtan!” tin asamtauve.

tcz: Pilate in “Ipi jeh inem? Ipi suhkhel len anei ham?” ati. Hinlah mi honpi chun aha sap cheh uvin, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
en_web: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
en_kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’n, “Ipi suhset aneiyam?” tin adonge. Miho la a-olheh lheh-in apengun, “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asam’ui.

tcz: Plate chun imacha phatchomna aum-louva chusanga boina asocheh ding chu amu phat in, aman cha-konga twi athum in chule mi honpi masanga chun akhut akisop in aseitai, hichepa thisan kisona'a hin themmona kaneipoi: Nanghon kimopoh tauvin'ati.
en_web: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol phat chomlou, boina asohjoh amu phat’in Pilate’in twi alan mipi angsunga khut asil’in, “Hichepa thina chung change mona po ponge, nang hon kivet tauvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin miho jouse chun, Ama thina chunga keiho le ka chateu geiyin mo kipoh naveh tangu tin ale donbut un ahi.

en_web: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

tcz_gospelgo: Chil set khumun, atneggol’in aluchang ajep’un

en_kjv: and set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu luvuma ahehsetna, “Hichepa hi Jesu Judate lengpa ahi,” tia kisun chu atah-uve.

tcz_gospelgo: Gucha michom ni jong Jesu jet le veiya akhetbeh thauve.

en_web: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

en_web: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

en_web: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

tcz_gospelgo: Pathen a kisong ahi me, Pathen lungdei ahileh tutah-in huhdoh hen; ajeh chu, ‘Pathen chapa kahi,’ ati me,” atiuve.

en_web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
en_kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
tcz_gospelgo: John chun sa-ngongsao mul ponin akivonin, savun konggah aki-gah-in, chule khaokhote anen, gam khoiju adon’e;

tcz: John'in, “Koiham khat hungvah ding ahitai, Ama chu keima sanga lenjo kei sanga lenjo cheh hi ding, keima akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong lom kahipoi.
en_web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
en_kjv: and preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
tcz_gospelgo: lhang asamin, “Kei sanga hatjo khat ka-nunga ahunge, kei hi kun’a akengchot khao sut lham dinga kilom jong kahipoi.

tcz: Keiman twiya baptize kachansah nahi uvin, ahivangin Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi!” ati.
en_web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
en_kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken nang ho twiya baptize kachansah ahin, Aman vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi,” ati.
