tcz: Nikhat Galilee gamsunga Nazareth khoa kon in Yeshua ahung in, Jordan vadung ah John khut'in baptize achangtan ahi.
en_web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai chun Galiee gam Nazareth khoa konin Jesu ahungin Jordan vadunga John khut’a baptize achangtai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua twi lah-a konin ahungdoh in, van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu bang in achungah ahungchu e.
en_web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
en_kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
tcz_gospelgo: Twi lah a ahung dindoh doh chun van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu banga hung lenglhaa achunga chu amui.

tcz: Van'ah aw ahung ging in: “Nangma kachapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeiye,” ati.
en_web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
en_kjv: and there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule vana konin O-khat’in, “Nangma kachapa deitah nahin, nachunga kalung alhai ta-ngeiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Lhagaochun gamthip'a apuimang paiyin,
en_web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
en_kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaovin Jesu chu gamthip’a anolut paiyin,

tcz: Chua chun ni somli Satan lhep patep in aum in, gamsa ho laha aum in, vantil hon avengkol un ahi.
en_web: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
en_kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: hikoma chun nisom li jan som li athamin, Satan lhep patep’in aume; chule gamsate toh alha khomin, chuin Vantilten ahung jen’uve.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin John songkul'a akhum jou un, Yeshua Galilee gamah achen, Pathen Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,
en_web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
en_kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
tcz_gospelgo: John amat nungun Jesu Galilee gama ahungin Pathenna kon Kipana Thupha alhangsam len,

tcz: “Pathen phattep ahung lhungtai,” tin asam peh in, “Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai. Chonset na kon kisih unlang, Kipana Thupha hi tahsan un!” atin ahi.
en_web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
en_kjv: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
tcz_gospelgo: “Phat alhinge, Pathen lenggam chun hikom ahinphatai; nalung heiyun lang Kipana Thupha hi tahsanun,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee Dillen pang ajotpana ah ngaman'a kivah le nehhol, Simon le asopipa Andrew chun dillen a ngamatna len anase lhon aga tohkhan ahi.
en_web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
en_kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Galilee dillen ajotpan nga man mi ni Simon le asopipa Andrew dillena lensep amui.

tcz: Yeshuan akou doh in, “Kanung hinjui lhon in, keiman miho matje nahil lhon inge!” atin ahi.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah lhon’ah, Neijui lhonin, mi manin pansah lhon inge,” atileh;

tcz: Chuin amanin alen adalha lhon in anung ajuipai jeng lhontai.
en_web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
en_kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: ama nin alen dalhan Jesu nung ajui pai lhontai.

tcz: Chuin twipanga kon themkhat ache chon jepleh Yeshuan Zebedee chapateni, James le anaopa John chun kong sunga len ana khuiphat pet lhon amun,
en_web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
en_kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
tcz_gospelgo: Them khat achebe kit leh Zebedee chapa Jacob le asopipa John jong kong sunga len anakhui phat lhon amun,

tcz: Amani chu akouvin ahileh, aman nin apau Zebedee toh kong sunga um thaloa agoihou chu adalha lhon in ajui lhontai.
en_web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
en_kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
tcz_gospelgo: ama ni jong akou kit leh, kong sunga chun apa Zebedee le thalah soh chengse dalhan Jesu nung ajui lhontai.

tcz: Yeshua le akilhonpiho Capernaum khopiah achelut'un ahi. Cholngahni ahung lhunchun houin'ah ache uvin, hia chun thu ahil pantan ahi.
en_web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
en_kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
tcz_gospelgo: Capernaum kho ahung lhun phat’un, Choldo nikhon Jesu Houthua kikhopna in’ah alut paiyin thu ahiltai.

tcz: Aman danthu sunho banga hillouva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh'in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asalheh-un ahi.
en_web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
en_kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
tcz_gospelgo: Athuhil japha chanin kidang asa lheh jengui; ijeh-inem itile Aman Danthu sun ho hil banga hil louvin thu neitah-in mi ahil’e.

tcz: Chuin hetloukah'in lhagao-boh vop mikhat houin'ah anaum in, ama chun ahin sampaiyin,
en_web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
en_kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
tcz_gospelgo: Houthua kikhopna ina chun mi lhagaoboh vop khat anaumin, amah in ahinsam pai jengin,

tcz: “Nazareth Yeshua, ipi dinga kalah'uva hung kikum nahim? Keiho suchimit dinga hung nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai—Pathen Theng chu nahi!” ati.
en_web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
en_kjv: saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nazareth Jesu, iti taute nati ham? Eisu mang diuva hung nahim? Nang koi nahi kahenai, Pathena kon Atheng chu nahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan amachu aphoh in, “Thip in! Ama a kon chun hungdoh in,” tin thu apen ahi.
en_web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
en_kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun lhagaoboh chu aphoh in, “Thip’in, amaa kon chun hung potdoh-in!” atileh;

tcz: Chuin lhagaoboh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapen in apeng in ahung potdoh tai.
en_web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
en_kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
tcz_gospelgo: lhagaoboh-in amapa chu aveingol’in, hapenin apengin amaa koin ahungpotdoh tai.

tcz: Mijousen kidang asauvin, thilsoh chungchanga chun khat le khat akidong un ahi. “Hiche hi ipi kihilna thuthah hikit hitam? Itobang thuneina hitantem! Lhagaoboh jeng in jong athupeh angaiye!” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
en_kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun mipin kidang asa soh keiyun, khat le khat akidong touvin, “Hiche hi ipi thu hitam! Thuhil Thah beh leh thu neitah a Aman lhagaoboh ho apho le angai jengui!” akitiuve.

tcz: Yeshua Christa thu chu Galilee gamsung pumpiah aki thangsoh pai jeng tan ahi.
en_web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
en_kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun Galilee gam kim vel’a gangtah-in Jesu min akithang soh tai.

tcz: Kikhopna in chu Yeshuan James le John toh adalhah jouvin Simon le Andrew in'ah alut un ahi.
en_web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
en_kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon houthua kikhopna in chu adalhanvin Jacob le John toh kilhonin Simon le Andrew ina alut paitauve.

tcz: Chua chun Simon nupanu chu khosih dammon analum e. Amahon adammo thu chu Yeshua ahetsah paiyun ahi.
en_web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
en_kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon nupa nu chu nat lhut a nan alumin, mihon anat thudol Jesu jah a aseipeh paiyui.

tcz: Hichun amanu koma chun achepheiyin akhut in atuh-in, akai thouvin atousah tai. Hichun akhosih chun alhatan, chuin amanu chu amaho neh ding sem in apangtai.
en_web: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
en_kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lift her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesu achen akhut atuh-in akaithou leh, anat lhut’in alha paitan, amanu jong ajen leuvin apangtai.

tcz: Nilhum jou nilhah-in mihon ana damlou leh, thilhavop ho chu Yeshua koma ahin puiyun.
en_web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
en_kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah nisa lhum lamin Jesu henga adammo jouse leh thilhavop chengse ahin puiyun,

tcz: Kho mite jouse chu ave din kot khah phunga akitit dimsoh jeng e.
en_web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
en_kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi sunga mi abonchan kot phung bul’a akikhom tauve.

tcz: Chuin Aman hivei chom chom veiya damlou mi tamtah adamsah'in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh'in ahi. Hinla Ama Christa ahi chu thilhahon ahet'u ahijeh-in thilhaho chu apaodoh sahpoi.
en_web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
en_kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun hivei chom chom veiya dammo tampi aboldamin, thilhavop ho jong anodoh peh-in, thilha hon Jesu ahetjeh-un apao poh a-uhsa aumpouve.

tcz: Khovahlhah masang ajing jingkah-in Yeshua athouvin, apotdoh in gamthip munah achen, chua chun taona agamang in ahi.
en_web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
en_kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingpi mahtah, khovah lhah masangin Jesu athouvin, gamthip’a achen hikoma chun agataove.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin Simon le aloiho apotdohun, chuin agamudoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
en_kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Simon le aloiten anung ajuiyun,

tcz: Amudoh phat un ajah-a, “Mijouse hinla Nang nahol cheh-un,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
en_kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
tcz_gospelgo: amudoh phat’uvin ajah a, “Mi jousen Nang nahol cheh-a!” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in “Khopi danga jong kahil lhangle theina din che ute, hiche dinga chu hung kahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah,” Anaivel kholen dom doma jong Thupha kaseiphong theina din cheu hite, hiche dinga chu hung vaikon kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Galilee gam sungsea achelen, akikhop nau intin'ah thu ahil lhanglen chule thilha adel dohpeh in ahi.
en_web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
en_kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Galilee gam a akholsoh keiyin kikhopna in tin’a thupha aseiphongin, thilha ho anodoh-e.

tcz: Chuin miphah khat Yeshua hengah kijen damsah dingin ahung in, adilsun, ajah a, “Nalung ahileh neidamsah'a neisuh theng thei ahi,” ahung titai.
en_web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
en_kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphah khat Jesu henga ahungin aboh khup’in ajah a, “Nalung ahileh neidam thengsah thei ahi,” tin ataotai.

tcz: Athusei chun alung atohkhah behseh jeh in, Yeshuan akhut alhang in atham in, “Kalung ahi,” atitai. Chuin, “Damthengtan!” ati leh,
en_web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
en_kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun alainat pin akhut alhangin athamin ajah a, “Kalung ahi damtheng tan!” atileh;

tcz: Apetpet'in aphah chu aphapai jengin, adamtheng tai.
en_web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
en_kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
tcz_gospelgo: chupet tah chun atiphah chu apha paiyin ama adam thengtai.

tcz: Chuin amapa chu khamgahna aneiyin asoldohtai.
en_web: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
en_kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
tcz_gospelgo: Apet tah chun Jesun agihsal paiyin

tcz: “Hichehi koima komah seidoh hih in. Hisang chun thempu koma chen lang gakivetsah'in. Mose dan thupehsa dungjuiya phah kijen damhon maicham thilto apeh ding dol chu choiyin lang gape tan. Hichu nadam thengna mipi het'a phondohna hiding ahi,” tin thupeh aneiyin ahi.
en_web: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
en_kjv: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah a, “ven, koima cha jah a seidan; amavang chen lang Thempu gakivetsah-in, miphah chu adamtheng tai ti phot chetna Mose’n kilhaina thilto peh ding aseisa chu gapetan,” atin asoldohtai.

tcz: Ahivang in amapa apotdoh in, thil umdol chu aseiphongle tan ahi. Hichea kon chun Yeshua chu mipin aum kimvelle jeng tan, hijeh chun lhangphong in khopi sunga alut thei tapoi. Hichun munthip thip lah-a aumjo tan, ahijeng vang'in muntina kon in mipin ahin jonlut jing nalaiyun ahi.
en_web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
en_kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mipa chu apotdoh-in athu hi muntin’a aseiphong pantai; athusoh hi ahaseiphong behseh phat’in Jesu kholen hoa lhang phongin alut thei tapon, gamthip thip’a achangin akitheh doh le len; mipin vang muntin’a kon in aheng ahinjon jon jenguve.

tcz: Nikho phabep jouva Yeshua Capernaum'a akile kit chun, in lama akile kittai ti muntin a ana thangsoh man kittan ahi.
en_web: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
en_kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho phabep nugnin Jesu Capernaum khoa ahung kitleh in’a aum ajasoh tauve.

tcz: Chomlou kah'in aumna in a chun mipi ahung kitit dim jeng in, umna ding kotphung polam jeng jong onglou khop'in mi adimlha jeng tai. Mipi chu Pathen thu ahil jing laiyin,
en_web: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
en_kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun mitamtah ahung kikhom’un, aum na diu mun, kotphung jeng jong a-ong tapoi. Hichun Jesun miho thu ahiltai.

tcz: Pasal li-in langthi khat pheh chunga ahin pulut un ahi.
en_web: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
en_kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphabep’in langthi mi khat ahenga ahin puiyun, lin ahinpou’ve.

tcz: Mipi atam behseh jeh chun Yeshua kom alutthei tahih un, hijeh chun Ama luchung don tah'a inchung alhong chu aphevang un, langthipa chu alupna pumin a angsunga akhailha jeng tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
en_kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi jeh chun Jesu henga apulu thei pouvin, aumna don inching aphet vangun, lang thipa chu alupna pumin akhai lhauve.

tcz: Atahsan uchu Yeshuan amun, langthipa jah achun, “Chapa, na chonset naho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
en_kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun atahsanu amudoh phat’in langthipa jah-a, “Chapa nachonset chengse aki-ngaidam tai,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah danthu sun phabep khat chua touho chun alungthim uva,
en_web: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
en_kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma tou Danthu them phabep chun agel’un,

tcz: “Ibola hitia chu thu aseiham? Hiche hi kitaitomna ahi. Pathen bouvin chonset angaidam thei ahi!” tin agel un ahi.
en_web: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
en_kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
tcz_gospelgo: “Ibol’a hi chepan hitobang thu asei jeng ham? Pathen ataitome. Pathen tilou koi dang chonset ngaidam jou umam?” atiuve.

tcz: Alunguva ipi agelu chu Yeshuan ahepai jeng in ajah uvah, “Ibola lung opkai le lungboi nahi uvem?
en_web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
en_kjv: And immediately, when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
tcz_gospelgo: Alungthim’uva chutobang agel’u hi Jesun alungin ahepai jengin ajah-uvah, “Ibol’a nalung gil’a chutobang nagel’u ham?

tcz: Langthipa koma, ‘Na chonset naho kingaidama ahitai’ ti toh ‘Thouvin, nalupna pheh chu kichoi inlang lam jottan,’ ti chu hoijoh baijo ham?”
en_web: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
en_kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
tcz_gospelgo: Langthipa jah a, ‘Nachonset chengse ki-ngaidam ahitai,’ ti leh, ‘Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in lam jot tan,’ ti hoijoh baijom?

tcz: Ahoi hita jongleh leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneiye ti, nahetna diuva photchenna kavetsah ding nahiuve, ati.
en_web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
en_kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
tcz_gospelgo: Hoi hileh leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat anei nahetna diuvin,” atin langthipa jah a chun,

tcz: Chuin langthipa lamah Yeshua akiheiyin, “Thouvin, nalupna pheh kichoiyin lang in lama chetan!” ati.
en_web: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
en_kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh nahi, thouvin nalupna kilah-in na-in langa kile kit tan,” ati.

tcz: Chutah chun langthipa chu akichom in, alupna pheh akilah-in japi lungdong ho mitmutah chun achedoh tai. Amaho chun kidang asalheh jeng un, “Hitobang himhim kamu kha pouve,” atiuvin Pathen avahchoi avahchoi tauve.
en_web: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
en_kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama jong akipatdoh paiyin alupna akilah-in japi mitmu tah a apotdoh jeng leh, amahon kidang asa behseh jengun Pathen athangvah-uvin, “Hitobang thilsoh kamu kha hih hel’e,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua apotdoh in dillen pangah achekit tan, chuah mipi ahenga hungho chu thu ahil e.
en_web: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
en_kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu dilen lam jona apotdoh kitleh mipi aheng’ah ahung kikhomun, aman thu ahiltai.

tcz: Chuin achephei leh, Alphaeus chapa Levi chu akaidonna mun'a atou amun ahi. Hichun ajah a, “Neijuiyin lang kaseijui hitan,” atileh ama chu akipatdoh'in anung ajuitai.
en_web: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
en_kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alpheus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia ache naa hin Alphaeus chapa Levi, kaidonna inmuna tou amun, ajah a,” Neijuiyin,” atileh; akipatdoh-in ajuitai.

tcz: Chujouvin Levin Yeshua leh aseijuite ain'a an nedin akouvin, chuleh kaidong ho le mi chonse ho tamtah jong akou than ahi. (Yeshua nungjui ho lah-a hitobang mi chu tamtah um ahi).
en_web: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Levi ina ankong aum phat’in kaidong ho le chonse ho tampin jong Jesu le aseijuite toh ankong aum khomun ahileh atam lheh tauve. Hichun anung jui

tcz: Dan thuhil ho lah-a Pharisee hon Yeshuan mi chonse holeh kaidong ho toh an aneh khom chu amu phat un, aseijuite jah-a, “Itidan a kaidong ho le mi chonse ho toh an aneh khom ham?” ati tauvin ahi.
en_web: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
en_kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu them ho le Phariseehon, chonse ho le kaidong ho toh an anehkhom amu’vin aseijuite jah a, “Itidana Aman kaidong ho le chonsete toh an aneh khom ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Hichu Yeshuan ajatan, hichun ajah uvah, “Atidam ten louthem angai pouve, adam louten bou angaiyui. Mi chonphate kouva hung kahipoi, lunghei dia mi chonsete kouva hungjoh kahi bouve,” atipeh un ahi.
en_web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
en_kjv: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hichu ajah phat’in ajah-uvah, “Atidamten louthem angaipoi, adamlouten bou angaiyui; Keijong adih ho kouva hung kahipon, chonse ho kouva hung kahi bouve,” ati.

tcz: Khatvei John seijui holeh Pharisee hon an angol laiyun, mi phabep ahungun Yeshua jah-ah, “I-atileh John seijuiho le pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijui hon an angolji louham?” tin adong un,
en_web: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
en_kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
tcz_gospelgo: John seijuiho le Pharisee hon an angolji jeh-un miho Jesu henga ahungun ajah a, “Itidana John seijuiho le Pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nang seijuihon angol ji louvu ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mou loma chehon golnop anei laiyuva an angol jiuvem? Achutilou ding hetsa ahi. Moulang in aumpi laiseuva an angol lou diu ahi.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kichen golvahna hung lha ho chu ajinei pan alenkhompi laisea an ngol’a um theiyum? Aji neipan alenkhompi dung seuva an ngol thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kon'a aki puimang ni hung lhung ding ahi—chuche nileh an angol diu ahi.
en_web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
en_kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang alah-uva kona aji neipa akipui mang nikho hung lhung ding ahin, hiche teng chuleh amahon an angol diu ahi.

tcz: Chujongleh, koiyin pon thah hal chu ponluiya abeh ngaiyem? Beh taleh abehna joh chun kai ehjo cheh intin, athah joh chun alui chu akaiset ding ahi.
en_web: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
en_kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman sopnem loulai pon hal’in ponlui abeh ngaipoi; beh leh abehna chun ponlui chu kaieh jon tin haset lo cheh ding ahi .

tcz: Chule koiman Lengpitwi thah savun pengluiya akhum ngaipoi; achuti kibol leh alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi le savun peng akop a mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bou uve,” ati.
en_web: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
en_kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle min savun peng lui sunga lengpitwi thah akhum ngai poi; khum taleh lengpitwi peng chu tumkeh intin, alengpitwi le apeng ho geiya manlo ding ahi. Hijeh a chu lengpitwi thah chu peng thah a khum ding ahi,” ati

tcz: Cholngah ni khat hin Yeshuan buleilai ajot in ahileh, aseijui ten ache pum un changvui chu asih pan tauvin ahi.
en_web: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldoh nikhon Jesun bulei lai ajotpa naa aseijuiten ache pum pum’un changvui akisiuve.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon Yeshua jah-a, “Vetang, ibola Cholngah nia bolngai lou abol uham?” atiuve.
en_web: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
en_kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pharisee hon ajah a, “Ven, hiche ho khun itidana choldo nikhoa bol ngailou abol’u ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “David le aloiho alhahsam uva agilkel pet'uva chu ipi-abolu nasim khah hih uvem?
en_web: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was a hungred, he, and they that were with him?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “David le aloite gilkel’a an ngaicha aum pet’uva chu ipi abol’u nasim khah louhel’u ham?

tcz: Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin Pathen in a alut in, Thempu tailou adang in aneh dia phal hilou changlhah ho chu anen, aloi ho jong apen ahi,” ati.
en_web: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
en_kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
tcz_gospelgo: Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin David chu Pathen Houin sunga alut’in, Thempuho tilouvin aneh ngailou, Pathen umjing hetna changlhah katdohsa chu anen aloite jong apei,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah-a aseipehben, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi. Cholngahni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi.
en_web: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle ajah-uva aseiyin, “Choldo nikho hi mihem khohsahnaa kisem ahin, Choldo nikho khohsahnaa mihem kisem ahipoi,

tcz: Hijeh chun, Mihem Chapa chu Pakai ahin, Cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati.
en_web: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
en_kjv: therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun Mihem Chapa hi Choldo nikho Pakai jong ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshua Judah ho Pathen houna in'a achekit leh, hichea chun mi khutlang ngoi khat agamui.
en_web: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
en_kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu houthua kikhopna ina alut kit leh, pasal khut langthi khat anaume.

tcz: Hichu cholngah ni ahijeh'in amel maten, ahehset theina diu achanglhi jing uvin ahi. Khutlang ngoipa chu cholngahnia adamsah-a ahileh, themmo chan ding tohgon aneiyu ahi.
en_web: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
en_kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon ahehset theina diuvin langthipa chu Jesun Choldo nikhoa aboldam got le got lou aching lhiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan khutlang ngoipa jah-a, “Hung in lang mipi masanga hung dingdoh-in,” atitai.
en_web: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
en_kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun khut langthipa jah a, “Alailunga hung dingin,” atin;

tcz: Chuin Ama doudal le nelkal-ho lang ngan akiheiyin ajah-uva, “Cholngahnia thilpha bol ding danthun aphal em, ole ase bolna ding nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinna huhdoh nikho ham, suhmang nikho joh ham?” tia adoh leh, amahon adonbut tapouve.
en_web: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
tcz_gospelgo: miho jah a, “Choldo nikhoa thilpha bol ngai ha, thilse bol ngai ham? Hinkho huhhing ngai ha suhmang ngai ham?” atileh; Amahon la athip chet jengui.

tcz: Hichun Aman lunghangtah in amaho chu avekim velin, alungtah jeh'u chun phamo asalheh in ahi. Hichun khutlang ngoipa jah a, nakhut lhang in, atin chuin alhang in ahileh, akhut chu adamtan ahi.
en_web: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
en_kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun miho chu lung hang pumin avegol’in, alung tah jeh-uvin alung gimpeh jon, lang thipa jah a, “Nakhut lhangdoh-in,” atileh, akhut alhandoh phat’in adamhel’e.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee ho chu apotdoh-un Ama suhmang theina ding angaito uvin, Herod solchah ho toh akihou toh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
en_kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun iloa Jesu suhmang theina ding Herodian ho toh kihou som din Phariseeho apotdoh paitauve.

tcz: Yeshua aseijuite toh dil lama chun ache uvin, mihon tamtah'in ajuiyun ahi. Amaho chu Galilee le Judah gam'a kon,
en_web: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
en_kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judea,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le aseijuite twikhanglen jona acheu lah, Galilee gama hung kon mipin jong ajuiyui; Judea gama hung kon,

tcz: Chule Jerusalem, Idumia, Solam Jordan luigala kon, Tyre le Sidon chunglam gam'a kon jong ahiuve. Athil bol kidang thuthanga kon in gamlatah tah'a kipan in ahung veuvin ahi.
en_web: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
en_kjv: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema kon, Idumea gam le Jordan lui gal’a kon, chule Tyre le Sidon gamkol sunga hung kon mipin anatoh ho ajah jeh-uvin ahenga ahunguve.

tcz: Yeshuan aseijuite asolin, mihonpin Ama lam ahin phutlou nadin kong gotsa-a akoi diuvin athuhil in ahi.
en_web: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
en_kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi atam behseh jeh chun aneh chinto louna diuvin Jesun aseijuite chu kongneo khat gotsa anakoipeh diuvin aseipeh-e.

tcz: Chuche nikho chun mi tamtah adamsah'in, hijeh chun adamlou ho chun Ama atohkhah theina ding un Ama lam chu ahin no tentun jeng un ahi.
en_web: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
en_kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tamtah aboldam ahitah jeh-in dammona nei jousen Ama chu toh khah tei ding dei nan ahindel jengun ahi.

tcz: Lhagaoboh vop ho vang chun Ama amu chan un, tolsenan akineiyun, a-ang sunga abohkhup un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa chu nahi!” tin asam jiuve.
en_web: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
en_kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaoboh ho hin Jesu amu tengu leh amasanga aboh khup’un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahi,” tin asamu’vin;

tcz: Ahin Aman lhagao phalou ho chu Ama koi ahi aphondoh louna diuvin agih in ahi.
en_web: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
en_kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
tcz_gospelgo: ahin la Ama aphondoh louna diuvin Jesun hakhamin akham chah-e.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshua molchunga akaltouvin, alhonpi dinga angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amahon jong ajuiyun ahi.
en_web: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
en_kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu mol chunga akaltouvin angaichat chengse akouleh, amaho ahenga achetauve.

tcz: Chuin mi somleni alhengdoh'in, asolchah dingin apansahtan ahi. Amaho chu Ama kilhonpi ding le thuhillhang le asollea pang ding ahiuvin,
en_web: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
en_kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mi som le ni alhengdoh-in, aminu solchah asah-in, akoma aum jingu va chule thuhil lhanglea jong asol doh theina dingin,

tcz: Chuleh thilha ho nodoh theina thuneina jong apen ahi.
en_web: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
en_kjv: and to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
tcz_gospelgo: thilha ho nodoh theina tha jong apei.

tcz: Hiche somleni alhen ho chu: Simon (Aman Peter asahpa chu),
en_web: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
en_kjv: and Simon he surnamed Peter;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia alhendoh som le ni chu: Peter tia aminvo Simon ahin,

tcz: James le John (Zebedee chapateni, Yeshuan, Boanerges (Van-ging chapate tina) tia amin aphohpehteni),
en_web: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
en_kjv: and James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; (and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:)
tcz_gospelgo: Zebedee chapa Jacob le John, ‘Van gin chate,’ ti naa amin lhon Boanerges asah te ni ahin,

tcz: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (Alphaeus chapa), Thaddaeus, Simon (mi kipum pehpa),
en_web: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
en_kjv: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alpheus, and Thaddeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
tcz_gospelgo: Andrew le Philip, Bartholomew le Matthew, Thomas le Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus le Canaan mi Simon,

tcz: Judas Iscariot (Ama johdohpa); hicheng hi ahiuve.
en_web: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
en_kjv: and Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him. And they went into a house.
tcz_gospelgo: chule ama matsah a pang Iscariot Juda toh ahiuve.

tcz: Khatvei Yeshua in khat'a alut leh, mihonpi ahung kikhomkit tauve. Hijeh chun Ama le aseijuiten an nehphat tahbah jong aneithei tapouve.
en_web: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
en_kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu ina ahung lut tai; mipi ahung kikhop kit phat’un an jeng jong anethei tapouvve.

tcz: Hichu ainkoten ajah phat uvin apuidoh dingin ahungui. “Ama hi angol a hita hi,” atitauve.
en_web: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
en_kjv: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
tcz_gospelgo: A-inkoten ajahdoh phat’un mat tho jeng din ahung kon’ui; ijeh-inem itile a ngol’a agel’u ahi.

tcz: Jerusalem a kon'a hung danthu sunho ma jong chun, “Amahi thilhate lengpa, Satan in avop ahi. Ama a kon'a chu thilhate nodoh theina tha anei ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
en_kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema kona hungsuh Danthu themhon jong Beelzebul vop hiya, thilha ho anodoh jong chu avaihompau thahat vanga anodoh-in aseiyui.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu akouvin, ahilchet na ding in, Satan in Satan iti anodoh thei ding ham?
en_web: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
en_kjv: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho akouvin ajah uvah thulemin aseiyin, “Satanin satan iti anodoh thei ding ham?

tcz: “Lenggam khat amite kikhentel'a kidouto chu mahthah-a lhutei ding ahi.
en_web: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
en_kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamsung khat atum apaiyin kikhentel hen kidouto taleh, hiche gamsung chu dingdoh thei lou ding ahi.

tcz: Hibang chun insung kikhentel chu chehchaova dingdoh theilou ding ahi.
en_web: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
en_kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
tcz_gospelgo: Insung khat jong kikhentel leh ding jou lou ding ahi.

tcz: Satan jong kisepkhen henlang ama le ama kidou taleh iti dingdet thei ding ham? Dingdoh joulouhel ding ahi.
en_web: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
en_kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Satanin Satan adouleh akikhentel ahitan, ding jou louva bei ding ahiye.

tcz: Seichenbe inge. Satan tobanga hat mi khat in'a chu koiham thanei tah'a galut'a chule aneiho gachom ding chu? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akantuma chutengle bou athil achomthei ding ahi.
en_web: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
en_kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman mihat ina lut’a ama kan masa louvin anei achom theipoi, akan jou teng le ain achom ding ahibouve.

tcz: Chule tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, itobang chonsetna le kitaitomna hijongle kingaidam thei ding ahi.
en_web: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte achonsetna chengseu le Pathen ataitom nau aboncha ngai dam chang diu ahin,

tcz: Amavang koihileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu imatih chan'a ngaidam changlou ding, hichu tonsot geiya ngaidam changlou ding chonsetna ahi,” ati.
en_web: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
en_kjv: but he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi; tonsot’a chonset themmo changa um ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hicheho aseinajeh pentah chu amahon Ama chu, “Lhagao phalouvin avop ahi,” ati jeh-u ahi.
en_web: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
en_kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaoboh vop a aseijeh-uva chutia asei ahiye.

tcz: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun inpoah ading un, Ama ahungdoh-a ki houlimpi ding in thu athot'un ahi.
en_web: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
en_kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu nu le asopite ahunguvin inpo’ah adingun, mi asol’uvin Jesu agakousah-ui.

tcz: Hipet chun mihonpi Yeshua kimvelin atou chahkheh-in, thupopa chun ajah-a, “Nanu le nasopite polamah aumun, nahin hol uve,” ahung tin ahi.
en_web: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
en_kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Akimvel’a tou mihon ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopite polama adingun nahol’ui,” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Koiham kanu? Koiham kasopiteho?” ati.
en_web: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
en_kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun miho chu adonbut’in, “Kanu chu koi hiya chule Kasopite chu koi koi hiuvem?” atin;

tcz: Chuin akimvela touho chu avegol in, “Ven, amaho hi kanu le kasopi ho ahiuve,”
en_web: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
en_kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: akim vel’a tou chengse avegil’in, “Hiche ho hi kanu chule kasopite ahiuve.

tcz: Koihileh Pathen lunglama chon hochu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati.
en_web: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
en_kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hijongle Pathen lungdei bol jouse chu kasopipa kasopinu chule kanu ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Avelin dil panga thu ahilpan kit tai. Mipi tamtah akoma ahung kikhom pai jeng un, Ama kong sunga aluttan ahi. Kong sunga chun atouvin, mipite chu vaokama atouvun ahi.
en_web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
en_kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun dil pang’a mi ahilpan kit leh, mipi ahung kikhomun, Ama dil laiya um kong khat sunga alut’in atouve. Mipi chengse vang twipam chin tol’a atouvui.

tcz: Amaho chu thulem'in thu tamtah ahil in,
en_web: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
en_kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi chu thu tampi thulem jengin ahil’in, athuhilnaa chun ajah-uva aseiyin:

tcz: “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa muchi then achen ahi.
en_web: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.
en_kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
tcz_gospelgo: “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa chu muchi then akondoh tai.

tcz: Athe atheleh abang lamsih-ah achun, hiho chu vachaten ahungloh un anegam tauvin ahi.
en_web: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
en_kjv: and it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia muchi athe naa hin muchi phabep lamsih a achun ahileh vachaten akilogam tauve.

tcz: Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna lah a achun, alei asalou jeh'in akehdoh jeng in,
en_web: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
en_kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi phabep ma songlheo chung, leipatnaa achun, leiset asa loujeh-in akedoh loi vangin

tcz: Ahivang in nisan ahin kah phat in asang gon, jung aneilou jeh'in agoplha paitan ahi.
en_web: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
en_kjv: but when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
tcz_gospelgo: nisan ahinsah teng jung anei lou jeh-in agopjitai.

tcz: Chule abang linglah-a achun, ling hochu ahung khang in chang phung dong nalaiho chu adep lihtan, ahinga aum tapoi.
en_web: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
en_kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi phabeh jong ling lah a achun, ling ho ahung khandoh teng adep lih jin, ga louvin aumlo jitai.

tcz: Adang ho chu leiphalaiya achun, ahung khang in agatan, hiho chu ajat somthum, ajat somgup, ajat jakhat cheng in apungtan ahi!”
en_web: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
en_kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi phabepse vang leipha laiya achun, akehdoh paiyin, akhangin, agan, somthum cheng, somgup cheng, chule ja khat chengin agai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en_web: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin aman ajah uva, “Angai na ding na neiyan ngai hen,” ati.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin aseijui somleni ho toh akimvela mi dangho toh aum khom pet in, amahon athulem seiho chu ipi kiseina ham tin adong un.
en_web: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
en_kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu achangseh a aum pet’in athuhil ja ho phabep le seijui som le ni chun thulemho thudol adongui.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Pathen gam thuguh chu nangho kipea nahi tauve. Hinlah thulema kaseina jeh chu polam miho jah ding ahi,
en_web: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah-uvah, “Nang ho vang Pathen lenggam thuguh chu kiseipeh nahitauvin, polama umte vang ijakai thulem jenga kisei ahi,

tcz: Hichu Lekhabun aseisa agui lhunna ding: ‘Ka thilbol amu tengule, ima jildoh hetdoh aneilou diu. Ka thusei ajah tengule, ima hetdoh aneilou diu. Achutiloule keima lam'ah hung kiheiyuntin, ngaidam chang get unte,’ kiti chu ahi,” ati.
en_web: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
en_kjv: that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
tcz_gospelgo: hitia chu ‘Ve jong leu amu chet thei lou diu, Ja jong leu ahet khen thei lou diu, chutilou hileh hung kihei kit’uva ngaidam chang ding ahiuve,’ tia kisei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Abanin Yeshuan akomuva, “Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahetlou monguham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet tadiu vem?
en_web: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will you know all parables?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Hiche thulem hi nahet khen louvu ham? Achutile thulem dang ho iti nahet thei diu ham?

tcz: Lou bolpan muchi athe chu Pathen thu midang koma kihil lhang tobang ahi.
en_web: The farmer sows the word.
en_kjv: The sower soweth the word.
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi thepan Thu athe ahi.

tcz: Muchi kithe lamsih-a chuhon avetsah chu ahileh, Pathen thu ja-a ahivanga Satan in ahung kilhoh mang pai toh tekah ahi.
en_web: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
en_kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu kithea lamsih a chu kiti ho hi thu ajah tah-u leh Satan ahung pai jenin asunguva lutsa thu chu alah mang pehji tai.

tcz: Songlheo chung leipatna lah-a chuhon avetsah chu, athu ajah jah-a thanomtah'a joppai jengho ahi.
en_web: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
en_kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
tcz_gospelgo: Chule songlheo chunga chu muchi kiti ho hi, thu ajah tah-u leh thanom tah a kisan jeng ho ahiuvin;

tcz: Ahivang in amaho chu jung neilou ahi jeh-un, apangsot jouji pouve. Pathen thutahsan jeh'a boina le suhgimna ato tengule, jung aneilou jeh-uvin alhupaiji tauve.
en_web: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
en_kjv: and have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time; afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla jung neilou ahiuvin apangsot pouve, athujah jeh-uva gim genthei nan ahinphah tengu leh akipal thu paiji tauve.

tcz: Ling lah a muchi kithehon avetsah chu Pathen thu ja a,
en_web: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
en_kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle linglah a chu muchi kiti ho hi, thu ajatauvin

tcz: Ahivanga leiset hinkho lungkhamna ten alodimsetna, haona lungthim chule thildang dang ngaichatnan thu chu adeplih jeh-a ga sodoh joulou tobang ahi.
en_web: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
en_kjv: and the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang hiche hinkho lungkhamna le hao ding deina, chule thil dang dang deichat nan thu chu adep lih jin, gadoh louvin aumloi.

tcz: Chule leipha laiya chuhon avetsah chu athu ja-a, hea jopte chu ahiuvin, abang ajat somthum, abang jat somgup chule abang ajat ja-a aga punsah beho ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
en_kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
tcz_gospelgo: Leipha laiya chu kiti ho vang hi, thu jaa kisan ho ahiuvin, abang somthum cheng, phabeh ma somgup cheng chule phabeh jong ja khat chengin apunguve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Koiyin meivah khu lo sung le jalkhun noiya atun ngaiyem? Koiman bolponte! Meivah chu avah hoiselna ding muna aki tungjin ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Thaomei kivah khu pocha kikhu khum ngai lou, jalkhun noiya jong kitung ngai lou hilou ham? Thaomeikhom chunga tun dia kivahji hilou ham?

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh thil kiselguh chengse chu achaina leh kiphongdoh ding, chuleh akiselguh jouse chu vahdoh ding ahi.
en_web: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
en_kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: Phondoh lou dinga kiselguh aumpon, chule hodoh lou dinga kikhu khum jong aumpoi.

tcz: Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en_web: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
en_kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hileh a-ngaina ding nakhang neiyan ngaihen,” ati.

tcz: Chuin ajah uva, “Najah chengseu chu lungluttah in ngaiyun. Phataha nangai chan uva, hetgilna nakipe diu ahi—chule kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.
en_web: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what you hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Nathujah u hi melchih-un. Nate bang banguva nakitepeh diu, akhohjoa bon nakibol diu ahi.

tcz: Koihileh kathuhil ngaiho chu hetbena kipehbe ding, ahinlah koihileh kathuhil ngailou chu ahetsa themkhat jong amahoa kon'a kilahmang peh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
en_kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu aneiya kipehben tin, aneilou vang aneilou vanga aneichasun jong kilahpeh ding ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Pathen gam umdol chu loubolmi khat'in leiya muchi athe tobang ahi.
en_web: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
en_kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseiyin, “Pathen leng gam chu min loulaiya muchi athe tobang ahi;

tcz: Asun ajan'a a-imut pet chuleh aha pet hijongleh, amuchi the chu ahung kehdoh-in, akhanglen in, hinlah aman hitia chu thil iti hung umdoh ham ahepoi.
en_web: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
en_kjv: and should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
tcz_gospelgo: jan leh a-ihmun, sun teng athouve; ahin muchi chu anakeh-in akhangdoh tai, aman vang iti kea iti khan ahi ahepoi.

tcz: Leiset'in acham in ahin gadohsah jin, amasapen in avui ahung dondoh in, chuteng achaina leh ahung gadoh in aminji tai.
en_web: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
en_kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’in acham chamin ahin gasah jin, amasan ananou ahin, abanin avui, chujou kit leh avuiya konin achang lhingjie.

tcz: Aga chu amin phatleh, a atphat ahitah jeh'in loubolpa achen, koiten a atpai jitai,” ati.
en_web: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
en_kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
tcz_gospelgo: Achang chu amin phat leh a-at phat ahitah jeh-in koiten a-at paijitai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiben, “Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? Ipi thulema ka hilchet ding hitam?
en_web: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
en_kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseiyin, “Pathen leng gam chu iti itekah-uva, ipi thulema isei diu hitam?

tcz: Ankam mu chang leiya kithe tobang ahi, hichu muchi lah-a aneopen ahi.
en_web: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
en_kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
tcz_gospelgo: Ankammu tobang vang ahi, leiset’a akithe teng vannoiya muchi dang jouse sangin aneo pen’e;

tcz: Ahivang in ahung kedoh tengleh hampa dang jouse sangin alenjon, abah lentah jong ahin sodoh jin, chutichun chunga leng vachate abah lim noiya ahung geh jiuvin ahi,” ati.
en_web: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
en_kjv: but when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
tcz_gospelgo: ahin akithe jou teng akehdoh-in, akhangin muchi dang sangin alenjoi, abah lentah tah asepdoh jin, chunga leng vachate jong aboh lim noiya ageh theiyui,” ati.

tcz: Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah mangchan amahon ahetthei diu kham thu ahil e.
en_web: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
en_kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin miho het thei kham khamin Jesun ajah-uva thu ahil’e.

tcz: Mihonpi jah-a thulem tilouvin imacha aseikhapoi. Ahinla aseijuite chengse vang chu guhthimin ijakai ahilchen jinai.
en_web: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
en_kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Thulem louvin vang ajahuva imacha asei khapoi; aseijuitevang atumin ijakai ahil chensoh nai.

tcz: Chuin nilhah in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Hung un, dil khu agal langa galkaiyu hite,” ati.
en_web: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
en_kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ni hin nilhah ahiphat’in Jesun aseijuite jah-a, “Dil gallang khat’a galkaiyu hite,” ati.

tcz: Chuti chun mihonpi chu adalha uvin, Yeshua chu konga akitolpi tauvin, kong dang phabep'in vang ahinjuiyun ahi.
en_web: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
en_kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun mipi adalhauvin, Jesu umna konga alut’uvin akitolpi tauve; hia chun kong dang jong aumin ahi.

tcz: Chuin khopi hui ahung nung in ahileh, twi kinong chu kong sunga ahung kinonglut matchet jeng tan, adimpai ding ahitan ahi.
en_web: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
en_kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin khopihui hattah ahung nungin, kong sunga twi akinong lut mat chattan ahileh, kong sung twi dim mai ding ahi tai.

tcz: Apet chun Yeshua chu kong mei lama lukhap kikhap'in ana ihmun, aseijuiten asukhang'un ajah-a, “Houhil, kalhummang gam dingu hi imalouva nagel ham?” atitauve.
en_web: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
en_kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu la kong meilama lukhap khap’in a-ihmui. Seijuiten asukhangun ajah a, “Houhil, keiho thigam ding kihita, khoh nasah lou ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshua akhah phat'in huipi chu aphoh-in, twi-nong jah-a, “Thipmin! Thipchet in!” tia thu apeh leh, apettah'in huipi chu athipchet jeng tan, kho aphaseltan ahi.
en_web: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
en_kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu athoudoh-in khopi hui chu haphon aphoh-in, twikhanglen jah a “Thip hel’in, umthimin,” atileh; huipi athip hel’in aumthimbeh tai.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Ibola nakichat uham? Tahsanna nanei nailou uham?” atitai.
en_web: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that you have no faith?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ajah-uva, “Ibol’a chute kichat nahiuvam? Tahsanna nanei loulai hel’u ham?” ati.

tcz: Seijui ho chu akithing jeng tauvin, “Hichepa hi koi mongmong hiya, huipi le twi-nongin jong athu angai ahitadem?” tin aki dongto tauvin ahi.
en_web: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
en_kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho la akicha behseh jengun, khat le khat akihouvun, “Hichepa hi hoi koibep hitaa, huipi le twikhanglen geiyin athu angai jeng ham?” atiiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuti chun dil gal langkhat lama, Gerasene gam agalkai tauvin ahi.
en_web: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
en_kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho twikhanglen gal langa Gerasa gamsung’ah ahung tauve.

tcz: Konga pat Yeshua ahung potleh, lhan'a konin lhagaoboh vop khat'in ahung kimupin ahi.
en_web: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
en_kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu konga kona apotdoh doh-in lhan lah a hungkon lhagaoboh vop mikhat’in akimutopi paijen’e.

tcz: Ama chu lhanmol'a cheng ahin, koiman atuhtang joulou, thih khaova jong ahen joulou-u ahi.
en_web: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
en_kjv: who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaoboh vop pa hi lhan lah jenga pansa ahin, koiman thih khaova jong ahen jou lou ahitai.

tcz: Bul atuhsah uva thih khaova jong ahen ji vang un thih khao chu asattan jin, bul chu atumkeh jin, koima chan abolngoi jou louhel ahitai.
en_web: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
en_kjv: because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
tcz_gospelgo: Bul akituh a thih khaova akikan vangin, thih khao jouse atumtan jin, bul ho aphukeh jin, koiman abol ngoi jou lou ahi.

tcz: Sunle jan in lhan mola chun aumin chule molchunga a-aole a-aolejin, songhem in ama aki-at chen jin ahi.
en_web: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
en_kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun le janin lhan lah a avah len mol chung dunga a-ao le a-ao len, songin aki-at chen chen jengin ahiye.

tcz: Gal a pat'in Yeshua ahin mun, ahung lhaijel in a-angah abohkhup in ahi.
en_web: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
en_kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
tcz_gospelgo: Gamla tah a konin Jesu ahin mun, ahung khaiyin a-ang’ah aboh khup tai.

tcz: “Pathen chungnungpen Chapa Yeshua, ipi dinga neihung suhboi got ham? Pathen min'a nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in,” tin apeng jeng tai.
en_web: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
en_kjv: and cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin going tah-in asam in, “Pathen chungnugnpen Chapa Jesu, ilo ding neitiu ham? Pathen mina ka-ngeh nahi neisu genthei hih beh-in,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah-a, “Mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh in, nang lhagao boh,” tin ano tai.
en_web: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
en_kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Mipa sunga kon chun hung potdoh-in, lhagaoboh,” atijeh a chutia asei ahiye.

tcz: Chuin, “Namin ipiham?” tia adohleh, aman adonbut in, “Tamtah kahi jeh'un kamin Janel ahi,” ati.
en_web: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
en_kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Jesun, “Namin ipi ham?” atileh; aman, “Tamtah kahijeh-un kamin, ‘Janel,’ ahi,” atin;

tcz: Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kon'a nodoh ahilouna ding un Yeshua henga hataovin ataotan ahi.
en_web: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
en_kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
tcz_gospelgo: chuche gamsunga kona asoldoh louna dingin hataovin ataove.

tcz: Hiche mun lhang pang khat'a chu voh hon tamtah kilha-a ahi.
en_web: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
en_kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
tcz_gospelgo: Akoma lhang panga chun vohcha tampi honk hat alhan,

tcz: Janelte chun, “Voh hon lah-a kaluttheina ding un neisol un,” tin athum tauve.
en_web: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
en_kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
tcz_gospelgo: lhagai ho chun, “Hiche vohchate sunga khu kalut theina diuvin nei sol tauvin,” tin Jesu henga ataovui.

tcz: Yeshuan jong aphalpeh tan, lhagaoboh ho chu ahung potdoh-un vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, hichun vohcha sangni jen chu halhaiyin alhaiyun, kol ah alhai lhauvin dil ah alhalut'un, twi lah-a chun alhumgam tauvin ahi.
en_web: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
en_kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand,) and were choked in the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun asol tai. Chuin lhagaoboh ho apotdoh-un vohchate sunga alut’u leh vohcha sang nijen, hon khat chu kol’a alhai lhauvin, twilena alha lut’un athi gamtauve,

tcz: Chuin ganching ho chu ajam un, khopi sung le loujaovah athu chu aseile tauvin ahi. Mipi chun ipi tidan hitam tin ave dingin ahung lhaipheiyun ahi.
en_web: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
en_kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
tcz_gospelgo: Vohcha ching ho chu ajam uvin thusoh hi khopi sung le loujao dunga aglhutsoh tauve. Hijeh chun athilsoh umchan vedin miho ahung uleh,

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kom ahung lhun un, thilha Janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lunglima anatou chu amuvin akicha lheh jeng uve.
en_web: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
en_kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu kom ahung lhun’un thilha janel voppa pon kisil’a lung lima anatou amu’vin, akicha lheh jenguve.

tcz: Chuin thilha voppa leh vohcha ho umchan achen achaiya mua hetoh hon thil umje chu aseipeh tauve.
en_web: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
en_kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilha voppa le vohchate chunga thilsoh amit tah a muhon ahung ho chu aseipeh-uvin ahi.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu agamsung uva kon'a potdoh ding in ahenga atao uvin ahi.
en_web: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
en_kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in mihon Jesu chu agamsunguva kona potdoh din ajoltauve.

tcz: Chuin konga alut konin masanga thilha voppa chun ama toh kilhon khom dingin angeh tai.
en_web: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
en_kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu konga alut pet’in ma sanga thilha voppan akoma aum jing na ding athume.

tcz: Ahivang in Yeshuan ajadan ajah a, “Na in a chen lang nain kote henga Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh a, iti nakhoto'em abonchan gaseitan,” atipeh tai.
en_web: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
en_kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajadan, “Na-ina chen lan gPakaiyin nakhotoa thil nasatah nabolpeh chu na-inkote gasei peh tan,” atipeh-e.

tcz: Chuin amapa chu akipatdoh in Decapolis (Khopi som) jousea Yeshuan thil lentah abolpeh chu lhangphong tah'in aseile pantai. Mijousen kidang asa lheh jeng un ahi.
en_web: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
en_kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ama achen Jesun thil nasatah abolpeh chu khopi som sunga aphongjal len, ajapha chanin kidang asasoh keiyuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua konga akitol in agal langkhat alhung in, hiachun mi honpi tamtah ahenga ahung kikhom un ahi.
en_web: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
en_kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu konga akile tolgalkai kit phat’in, ahenga mipi ahung kikhop jeh-un Ama twikhanglen panga aumden’e.

tcz: Hichun kikhopna in'a vaipo holah-a mi khat, amin Jairus chu ahung in, Yeshua amu phat in akengbulah abohkhup in,
en_web: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
en_kjv: And behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun houthua kikhopna in vaipo ho lah a Jairus chu ahungin, Jesu amu phat’in akhomuh a aboh khup paiyin,

tcz: “Kachanu khangdongcha thiding dinmun'in aumtan, lungset in hung in lang achunga nakhut hung ngam in lang, ahinna ding in neijen dampeh-in,” tin ahung taove.
en_web: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
en_kjv: and besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kachanu thi ding koncha ahitai, adamdoh a ahinthei teina din, hungin achunga nakhut hung ngamin,” tin ha-ngeh-in angeh tai.

tcz: Chuin Ama chutoh akilhon pheiyin, mi honpin jong ahin juiyun, atom lellul jeng un ahi.
en_web: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
en_kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu amato kilhonin achei. Ahin mipin ajuiyun, ajet aveiya aneh chinto jenguve.

tcz: Hikahlah chun numei khat jong kumsom le kumni athi longa damlou aum in ahi.
en_web: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
en_kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
tcz_gospelgo: Numei khat hikum som le kum ni jen athi longa damlou,

tcz: Louthem tamtah akivetsahna-a sum le pai anei jouse sumang jouva ahitan, imala phachom louvin khoh chehcheh a um ahi.
en_web: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
en_kjv: and had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
tcz_gospelgo: louthem mi tamtah akijensah a, anei chasun asuh mangsoh ahitan, ahivanga damdoh louva khoh cheh cheh jo ahi.

tcz: Amanu chun Yeshua thudol anajan, hijeh chun mi honpi lah achun ahung in Yeshua pon mong chu ahung tham tai.
en_web: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
en_kjv: when she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nu hin Jesu thudol ajan, mipi lah a Jesu nung’ah ahungin aponsil athamtai.

tcz: Amanu chu aki ngaiton, “Apon jengjong hi thamleng dam nange,” ti atahsan ahi.
en_web: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
