en_kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile, “Aponsil ho jeng jong tham kha leng damteiyinge,” ati ahi.

tcz: Chomloukah'in athiput chu akang in atang jeng tan, anat thoh lel a kon aol leh adamdoh dan chu atichunga akihettan ahi.
en_web: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
en_kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
tcz_gospelgo: Athi long chu akang heltan, aman jong atahsa natnaa kona adamtheng chu akihet paitai.

tcz: Chutah chun Yeshuan atichunga kon'a amidamsahna tha apotdoh chu akihet in, hichun mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, “Kapon thama chu koiham?” tin adongtai.
en_web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
en_kjv: And Jesus immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
tcz_gospelgo: Apet tah chun Jesun atichunga kona thaneina apotdoh ahe paiyin, mipi lah avekimvel’in, “Kaponsil ho thamkha koiham?” tin ahol’e.

tcz: Aseijuiten ajah-a, “Mipi hijat'in naneh le jeng uva, itidan'a, ‘Koiham eithama?’ tia dohna nabol ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
en_kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuiten ajah’a “Mipin naneh chinto jing mua iti, ‘Eithama koiham?” natiham,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Aman chuche bol a chu mudohna dingin avelen ahi.
en_web: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
en_kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun aponsil tham mi chu muleng tin ave-lei.

tcz: Amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kicha sasan kihot pum in ahung in a-angah abohkhup in, ama ahi akiseidohtai.
en_web: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
en_kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kichasa san ahungin kithing thingin a-anga aboh khup’in adih tah aseidoh tai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Boinu, natahsan in nadamsah ahitai. Lungmong in chetan. Na thohnatna chu kichai ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
en_kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Jesun ajah a, “Chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, lung mongin chen lang nanat genthei naa konin damtan,” ati.

tcz: Amanu koma thu asei jinglaiyin, thupole khat Jairus in'a konin ahung in, “Nachanu athitai. Houhil hi kisahboisah ngaitaponte,” tin Jairus komah ahung seiye.
en_web: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
en_kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thu asei nalaiyin, houthua kikhopna in vaihompa ina konin mi phabep ahungun, “Nachanu athitai, ibol’a Houhilpu nasuh lung gim ding ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Aki hounau chu Yeshuan ajatan, Jairus koma chun, “Kicha hih-in, tahsan poupoutan,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
en_kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseiyu chu ijasep louvin, houthua kikhopna in avaihom p ajah a, “Olmo hih-in, tahsan poutan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Peter, James le John (James naopa), hicheng tailou midang koiman ajuiding ajadan akijuisah poi.
en_web: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
en_kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Peter le Jacob chule Jacob naopa tilou midang akijuisah nompoi.

tcz: Kikhopna in vaihompa, Jairus in alhun'u chun, mihonpi chu anapoh cheichoi jeng un, kap le maova aum'u chu Yeshuan amun ahi.
en_web: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
en_kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
tcz_gospelgo: Houthua kikhopna in vaihompi in ahung lhun phat’un miho akap amao pohchei choiya um amun,

tcz: Chuin ama alut'in ajah uva, “Ibola hitia hi napo cheichoiyuva nakau ham? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, aihmu ahibouve,” ati.
en_web: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
en_kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
tcz_gospelgo: asung lhan ajahuvah, “Ibol’a pohchei choiya kap nahiuvem? Chapangnu hi athi ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Thi op mi honpi chun anuisat uve. Hichun aboncha uvin asoldohsoh in, chapangnu nu le pa toh chule ahin kilhonpi seijui thum ho chengsetoh chapangnu umna'a chun alut un ahi.
en_web: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
en_kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon anuisat tauve. Ahi vangin abonchauvin adeldoh-in, chapangnu nu le pa toh akilhonpi chengse toh chapangnu um naa alut tauve.

tcz: Chuin chapangnu khut chu atuh in, “Talitha koum,” atin ahi. Hichu “Boinu, kithouvin!” tina ahi.
en_web: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
en_kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel (I say unto thee) arise.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangnu chu akhut’in atuh-in ajah a, “Boinu thouvin kati nahi, tinan, “Tilitha koum,” ati.

tcz: Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, ading in lam ajotpai jeng tai. Amanu chu kum som le ni bou ahina laiye. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang asa lheh jeng un.
en_web: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
en_kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangnu chu athou paiyin lam ajottai; ama hi kum som le ni chapang ahi. Hichun mihon adatmo behseh jenguve.

tcz: Hiche thuhi koima ahetsah louna diuvin Yeshuan akhamgah in, chule amanun aneh ding an apeh diuvin thu apen ahi.
en_web: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
en_kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun jesun koimacha ahetsah louna diuvin akham chah kheh-in chule, “Chapangnu chu neh ding peuvin,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Chuin chua kon chun Yeshua ache doh'in, achenna Nazareth lama aseijuite toh ache tan ahi.
en_web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
en_kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun chukom dalhaa achenna khoa ahung leh, aseijuiten ahin juiyui.

tcz: Cholngahni ahung hi phat in Judah ho kikhopna in'ah thu ahil pan in, chuin athu hil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asa uvin, “Hichepa hin hoiya kon'a chihna le thibol theina hi chengpi hi akilah ahitadem?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
en_kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nikho lhin phat’in houthua kihopna ina thu ahil’in athuhil ngaiya mi tampin adatmouvin, “Hichepan hichengpi hi hoiya alah hi-nga na? Ama kipea hi itobang chihna hiya, hibanga bolmo kidang abol ham?

tcz: Chuin nuisat toh atho uvin, “Ama hi thingthem bol maimai, Mary chapa, chule James, Joseph (Joses), Juda le Simon sopipa ahibouve. Chule asopi numei ho jong ilah uva acheng uve,” atiuvin ahi. Amaho chu alung-u adong in ahivang in atahsan nom pouvin ahi.
en_web: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.
en_kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob le Joseph, Judas le Simon sopipa, Mary cha thingthembolpa chu hilou ham? Asopi numeiho jong ilah-uva aching meu?” atiuvin, kipal nan aneilo tauve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in ajah uva, “Themgao chu ama achenna gamsung le ainkote lah chule ama insung tailouvin mun dang jousea jabolna achang jin ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
en_kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Themgao chu mun dang danga akijabol vangin agamsung le amite lah chule a-inkote lah a kijabolji lou mong ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chukoma miten atahsan lou jeh'un ana damlou phabep khat chunga, akhut angapma adamsah tailou chun thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi.
en_web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
en_kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chun ana damlou phabep chunga khut angap’a adam sah tilouvin, thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi.

tcz: Atahsan lou dan'u chu adatmo lheh jeng e. Chuin kho anai dunga achelen thu ahil-le tai.
en_web: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
en_kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan louvu chu kidang asa lheh jenge.

tcz: Chuin aseijui somleni ho chu akouvin, lhagaoboh chunga thaneina apen, chujouvin mi ni-nin asoldoh tai.
en_web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
en_kjv: And he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
tcz_gospelgo: Seijui som le ni chu akouvin, lhagaoboh nodohna thei tha apen, mini nin asoldoh panin ahi.

tcz: Chule ajin nauva tenggol tailou ima dang, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga sum them jong—aken louhel diuvin thu apei.
en_web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
en_kjv: and commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu lamkah a dinga tenggol tilou changlhah hihen, sakhao hijongle, sumdip sunga jong sum apoh lou diuvin aseipeh-e.

tcz: Kengchot vang akise uva, sangkhol thoni vang aki ahlou diuvin aseipeh in ahi.
en_web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
en_kjv: but be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
tcz_gospelgo: Kengchot vang aseuva sangkhol chol tho ni aki-ah lou diuvin aseiye.

tcz: “Hoikom hijongle nachena chan uva, nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, khosung na potdoh kahse uvin umun.
en_web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Hoikom hijongle nalhun nauva kona napotdoh kahseuvin chukoma umden jingun;

tcz: Ahinlah koi kho hileh nahin lhunsah lou uleh, nathu seiyu ngailou khomite nadalhah tenguleh, dalhah ahitauve ti ahettohsah nan nakeng phang uva agam leivui chu thinglha uvin,” tin thu apei.
en_web: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
en_kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
tcz_gospelgo: hoimun hijongle min nalhunsah dauva nathu jong angai louvu leh, dalhauvin lang, ahettohsah nan nakengphanguva leivui thin lhah khum’uvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuti chun akipatdoh un, mihemten lunghei ding ahi ti chu ahil lhangle uvin,
en_web: They went out and preached that people should repent.
en_kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho apotdoh-uvin min chonset lung ahei teina din ahil lhang leuve.

tcz: Thilha tamtah jong anodoh'un, ana damlou tamtah jong thao anu uvin aboldam un ahi.
en_web: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
en_kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilha tampi anodohun, adamlou tamtah thao anu’vin, aboldam tauve.

tcz: Yeshua min gamtina akithan tah jeh chun, Leng Herod Antipas in hiti thu chu ajatan, mi phabep in, “Ama hi John Baptist athia kon'a thoudoh kit hinte. Hijeh'a chu thil kidang boltheina anei ahi,” tin aseiji uve.
en_web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
en_kjv: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamtina Jesu min kithang hi Herod lengpan ajadoh tai. Mi phabep’in, “John baptist chu thinaa kona thoukit’a hitobang thil kidang bol theina thahat hi anei hiya chu,” atiuvin;

tcz: Loikhat in, “Themgao Elijah ahi,” atiuvin, loikhat kit chun, “Malai themgao minthang ho banga themgao khat ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
en_kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: kon khat’in, “Elijah ahi,” atiuvin; adangsen vang, “Malai Themgao ho tobang khat hinah ta,” atiuve.

tcz: Herod'in Yeshua chung thu ajah phat in, “Alu katansa John chu athia kon'a hung thoukit hinante,” ati.
en_web: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
en_kjv: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod vang chun, “Alu katansa John chu hiya thoudoh kit hichu,” ati ahi.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod in anaopa Philip jinu Herodias chu aki chenpi ahin, amanu jal'a chu ama tah'in mi asola John chu amatsah a, akan'a songkula akhum ahi.
en_web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
en_kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Herod hin asopipa Philip jinu Herodias aki chenpi ahin, hiche nu jal’a hi mi asol’a John hi amasat a asongkul’a anakhum ahi.

tcz: John chun Herod jah a, “Nasopi ji jia naneiya naki chenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” anatin ahi.
en_web: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
en_kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Johnin Herod jah a, “Nasopipa ji nakichenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” tia aphosa ahi.

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot in ahot in, tha ding in atup in, ahivanginla Herod phalna louvin abol theipon ahi.
en_web: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
en_kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a hi Herodias hin John ahot’a athanom jing ahin, athat theipoi;

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod chun John chu michon phatah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahet jeh'in ajabolin, chuleh avesuiyin ahi. Herod'in John ahoulimpi teng ahimo ji lheh in, ahijeng vang'in, athusei angainom kit jin ahi.
en_web: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
en_kjv: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and a holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile Herod’in John hi midih le atheng ahi ahetjeh-in akichan apanpijitai. Athuhil ajah jongle along akichiah lheh jin, ahivangin kipah tah-in angaipehji nai.

tcz: Hinlah Herodias in phat gomkom anga jing chu Herod pen nikho chun ahung lhung tai. Chuche nikhoa chun gamvaipo natong alen alal ho, galsat-thalchoi lamkai ho chule Galilee gam'a milun ho chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi.
en_web: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
en_kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin nikho gomkom cha khat ahung um khan, Herod so nikho lhin nin golvah abol’in, amite lamkaiho le sepai vaipo ho chule Galilee gama milen milalte akouve.

tcz: Hiachun achanu chu ahung lut in, alam in ahileh leng Herod le atou khompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan, chuphat'in lengpan nungahnu jah achun, “Nagot chan thum'in, keiman peng kate,”
en_web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
en_kjv: and when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Herodias chanu ahung lut’in alam leh, Herod le a-ankong umpi chengse akitaisah lheh-e. Lengpan nu-ngah jah achun, “Nadei jouse kahenga thumin, Peng, kate,” atitai.

tcz: “Nathum chan chu kapeh ding ahi, ka lenggam akeh khat geiya jong kapeh thei nahi,” atitai.
en_web: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
en_kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod akihahsel’in, “Kahenga nathum jouse kagamsung keh khat geiyin penge,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amanu apotdoh in, anu komah, “Ipi kathum ding ham?” tia agadoh leh, anun, “John Baptist luchang thum in,” ahin titai.
en_web: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
en_kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
tcz_gospelgo: Nu-ngah chu apotdoh-in anu henga, “Ipipen kathum dingham?” agatileh; “John Baptist luchang,” tin aseipeh-e.

tcz: Chuphat'in amanu kintah'in lengpa hengah ahung loiyin, “John Baptist luchang tutah in konglheng khat'in neipe lechun kati penne,” tin athumtai.
en_web: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
en_kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
tcz_gospelgo: Apet tah chun nu-ngah jong lengpa henga ahungin, “Tutah hin John Baptist luchang ankong khat’a neipe le chun kadeiye,” ahung ti.

tcz: Chuin lengpa alunggim lheh jeng tan, ahivanginla mi masanga athutep le akihahselna chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun, amanu thil thum chu nahsahmon akoithei tapoi.
en_web: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
en_kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oaths’ sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpa chu alung gim lheh jengin, ahivangin a-ankong umpi ho ansunga akihahselna jeh chun adathei tapoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun asolchah hemchoi ho khat chu John lu gala ding in asoltan, ama achen songkul sungah alu agatang dentai.
en_web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
en_kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin lengpan a-ngah a pang sepia ho khat John lu la dingin asoltai. Ama achen songkul’a John lu agatanin,

tcz: Chuin alu chu kong khat'in ahin domin nungahnu chu apen, aman anu aga petai.
en_web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
en_kjv: and brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
tcz_gospelgo: ankong sunga ahindomin nu-ngah chu apetai. Nu-ngah chun anu agapen ahi.

tcz: Chuin aseijuiten ajah phat'un ahung un along chu ahung lauvin lhan'ah avui tauve.
en_web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
en_kjv: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
tcz_gospelgo: Athu hi John seijuiten ajah phat’un along ahung pu’vin lhan’a avuitauve.

tcz: Chuin solchah hochu anatoh nauva kon in Yeshua henga ahung kile uvin, akiman chah dan'u le athuhil danho uchu aseiyun ahi.
en_web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
en_kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah ho Jesu henga ahung kikhom’un, athilbol jouseu le athuhil’u aseipeh soh keiyui.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Hung un, munthip'ah chomkhat gakichol ute,” ati. Ijeh-inem itileh ahungle achele mi atam behseh jeng in, an jeng jong ne manlou ahi tauve.
en_web: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi ahung le ache le atam behseh phat’in an jeng cha jong ane man tapouvin, hijeh chun Jesun, “Abung in hung kikhin doh-un lang munthip lai khat’a kicholdouvin,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho munthip lam jonin kong in akitolphei tauvin ahi.
en_web: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
en_kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kongin akitol’un gam thip lai khat ajontauve.

tcz: Hinlah mi tamtah'in hitia akitoldoh uchu anamu uvin, hichun khopi mun chomchoma kon in mi tamtah chu twipang achun anache pheiyun, agal langa chun analhung masakit tauvin ahi.
en_web: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
en_kjv: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tamtah-in acheu amu’va ahet phat’un akimvel khopi jousea konin kengin anacheuvin, amaho sangin analhung masatauve.

tcz: Kong sunga kon Yeshuan kal ahin sedoh leh hitia mi honpi anaum chu Yeshuan amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh uchun alung asen, hichun amaho chu thil tampi ahil in ahi.
en_web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
en_kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu kong ahung potdoh le mipi kinonglul lul chu amun, achingbei kelngoite toh abah jeh-uvin alungset’in thu tampi ahil pantai.

tcz: Nilhah lam'in aseijuite ahung un ahenga, “Hikom hi gamthip ahin, phat hila agei lheh tan,
en_web: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
en_kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
tcz_gospelgo: Agei behseh phat’in aseijuite ahungun, “Agei behseh tan, ium nau ma gamthip lah ahin,

tcz: mi honpi hi ikimvel uva loujao le khosung hoa acheuva neh ding imathem aga kichoh diuvin soldoh tan,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
en_kjv: send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
tcz_gospelgo: miho hi cheuva akimvel loujao ho le kho dunga neh le chah akichohna diuvin soltan,” ahung tiuve.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nanghon aneh diu peuvin,” ati leh, “Ipi-em kapeh diu? Mi hijatpi vahna ding vang chu sum tampi kakilona diuvin lha tampi lut inte!” tin ahin donbut uve.
en_web: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
en_kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uvah, “Nang hon neh ding peuvin,” ati. Amahon, “Kacheuva changlhah denarii ja ni man kachoh-uva mipi neh dia kapeh diu ham?” atiuleh;

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum? Gave temun,” atin, hichun agave uvin, “Changlhah pheng nga toh ngani aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
en_kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum, gaveuvin,” ati. Agavet chet phat’un, “Pheng nga le nga ni ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mi honpi chu aboncha uvin hamhing eng lah-a chu ahon hon'a atousah diuvin aseijuite athu hil tan.
en_web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
en_kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mipi chu hamhing chunga aloi loiya tousah din aseijuite aseipeh-e.

tcz: Chuin amaho agol golin—ja khat cheng, som nga cheng in atou tauvin ahi.
en_web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
en_kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho chu agol gol’in ja khat cheng som nga chengin atoutauve.

tcz: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga toh nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in changlhah chu ahehbal bal in, a anguvah luipeh ding in aseijuite apen, nga ni jong chu ahoppeh soh keiyin ahi.
en_web: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
en_kjv: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin changlhah pheng ngale ngani chu alan, van lam aven, phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in mi ang’a luipeh din aseijuite apen, nga ni jong ahoppeh soh keiye.

tcz: Hichu amahon aneuvin, abonun aneva sohkei tauve.
en_web: They all ate and were filled.
en_kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin aneuvin avasoh keiyui;

tcz: Akivahva jouvun changlhah le nga aval chengse paipeh somleni aloh dimun ahi.
en_web: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
en_kjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
tcz_gospelgo: changlhah chu anong nai amoh paipeh som le ni dim le nga nong phabep toh aloh doh-uvin ahi.

tcz: Mi honpi kivahva chu numei le chapang ho sim louvin pasal cheh mi sang nga alhing in ahi.
en_web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
en_kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
tcz_gospelgo: Changlhah ne ho chu Pasal sang nga alhinguve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mi honpi chu alhadoh jinglai chun aseijuite chu, gal langkhat lama Bethsaida anagalkai masa ding in konga chun alutsah in asoltan ahi.
en_web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
en_kjv: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi alhah dohpet chun agallang khat, Bethsaida ache masa din aseijuite kong sunga alutsah loi jengin ahi.

tcz: Abonuva alhahdoh soh phat in, tao ding in mol chunga akal toutai.
en_web: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
en_kjv: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi alhah doh soh phat’in tao din molchunga akaltoutai.

tcz: Jansot lamin aseijuite chu dil lailunga kong chunga aumun, Ama achangin tolgo chunga aum den e.
en_web: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
en_kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah ahi phat’in kong la dil lai lung ageitan, ama changseh-in tol lhaga aum nalaiye.

tcz: Chuin amaho dil chunga konga akitol uva, hui le twi nong in anuh uva alungdon uchu amun, khovah ding kon lamin akeng in dil chunga lam ahinjot in, amaho chu khel ding agon ahi.
en_web: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
en_kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuite dil’a akitol nauva huiyin ale lama anuh jeh-uva alung gimu ahin mun, jingkah nidan li donin dil’a twi chunga kengin lam ahinjot’in, amaho khel din agoi.

tcz: Ahin amahon dil chunga kenga lam ahin jot amu phat'un thilha hinte atiuvin, a aosot jeng un ahi.
en_web: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
en_kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
tcz_gospelgo: Twi chunga lam jot’a ahung amu phat’un joumi danin agel’un a-aosot jengui.

tcz: Aboncha uva Amachu amu sohkeiyu ahin, atija lheh jeng un, ahivang in Aman amaho chu ahin houpaiyin ajah uva, “Ki chahih'un, hangsan uvin, keima hichea kaum nai,” ati.
en_web: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
en_kjv: for they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Ama amu cheh-uva kichasoh kei ahiuve. Chutah chun Jesun ahinhou paiyin ajah-uva, “Olmo hih-un, Kei kahi, kicha hih-uvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin kong chunga chun akaldoh in, hui jong athip jengtai. Amaho chu alungdong lheh jengui.
en_web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
en_kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
tcz_gospelgo: Aum nau kong sunga Jesu akaldoh phat’in hui athip del’in ahileh adatmolheh jenguve.

tcz: Ajehchu changlhah kidang thudol jong chu hephatalou ahitauve. Alungtah behseh nalam uva chuti ahi.
en_web: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
en_kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile changlhah chunga thilsoh jong gelpha talouva lungmoh chehjo ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin agalkaiyun Gennesaret gamsung alhung un, kong chu twipam chin'ah anga tauve.
en_web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
en_kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Genesaret, and drew to the shore.
tcz_gospelgo: Agal kaiyuva tolgo agei phat’un kong angauvin, Gennesaret lam ajontauve.

tcz: Chuin konga konin apotdoh doh un, miho chun anahepai tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
en_kjv: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
tcz_gospelgo: Kong adalhah lhah-uvin mipin Jesu anahepai jenguvin,

tcz: Agamsung uva alhai kimvel leuvin, chuah aume ti ahetna chanuvin ana damlou ho chu alupna pheh pumin ahinpu uvin ahi.
en_web: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.
en_kjv: and ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
tcz_gospelgo: agamsunga alhai leuvin, Jesu aumna ajah phahna chan’uva adamlou jouse alupna pumin ahin pupu jenguve.

tcz: Achena chan khoneo, khopi chule loujao gamkochong alutna chan'ah adamlouho chu japi kititna kailhang mun'ah alupsah un, apon mongkaibeh atham dingun ahenga ataovun ahi. Hichun athamkha chan chu adam jeng un ahi.
en_web: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
en_kjv: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
tcz_gospelgo: Khote sung hihen, khopi sung hijongleh, loujao dung geiyin, ache na chan’ah kailhang dung jenga jong adamlou ho alupdsah-uvin, apon mong kai beh atham sah din angeh-uve. Ama tongkha chan vang adamsoh keiyui.

tcz: Nikhat hi Pharisee holeh hou lamkai danthu sunho phabep Jerusalem a kipat'in Yeshua kimupi dingin ahung un ahi.
en_web: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema konin Pharisee ho le Danthu them phabep Jesu henga ahungun ahi.

tcz: Aseijuite mi phabep khat in dan nitlou leh, khut soplouva an aneh uchu ahung mudoh tauve.
en_web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
en_kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu seijuiten khutnen sil lha louva an aneh-u amutauve.

tcz: (Judah ho adehset'a, Pharisee hon akhang akhanga chonna dan dungjuiya khut phatea sopngim louva anehji lou u ahi.
en_web: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
en_kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pharisee ho le Judaten puchon pachon amangun, khut phatecha silngim masa louvin neh le chah abol ngaipouve.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, amahon kailhanga kicho hijongle twiya khut adelutlou leh ima anengai pouve. Hiche chu chonnangai tampi—khomho, belho, sum-eng chule jalkhun ho sopthengna kin-gun—hitobang chondan tampi anei lah-uva khat ahi.)
en_web: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
en_kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
tcz_gospelgo: Kailhang dunga kona ahungkile tengu jong le kisil lha louvin an anepouve. Chondan dang, khon ho, belcha ho, sum-eng bel ho, lupna ho geiya sop theng ding Dan tampi aneiyui.

tcz: Hiti chun, Pharisee holeh hou dan thuhil hon adong un, “Ipijeh'a naseijuiten akhang akhanga ichonna ngaiyu banga khut soplouva an aneh-uham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
en_kjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pharisee ho le Danthu them hon, “Itidana naseijuiten puchon pachon jui louva khut sil masa louva an aneh jiu ham?” tin Jesu adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Isaiah Themgaovin mi phalhem nangho chungchang thua: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung uvin eichoian un, alung thimula keiya konin gamlatah ahi.
en_web: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
en_kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah-uva, “Mipha lhem nang ho thudol hi Isaiah-an kitoh chet’a gaothu aseiya, hitia kisun ahi: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung’uvin eijabol’un, Alungthimu la keiya konin agamla lheh jenge;

tcz: Amahon eihouvuhi moh ahi. Mihem semthu lungsuhto ho chu Pathen thupeh dan'a ahil u ahi,’ tin anaseiye.
en_web: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
en_kjv: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Athuhil’u jong mihem thupeh jeng ahil jeh-un, Eihouvu jong hi mohseh ahi,’ tia asei chu.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen danthupeh ahibangtah chu nahsahmon nakoiyun nangho chonnamlhah joh natuhdetjo tauve.
en_web: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
en_kjv: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thupeh napaiyun, mihem chondan joh nanit’uvin ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nachonna ngaiyu natuh dettheina diuvin Pathen danthupeh tahbeh chu nahei lamdang uve.
en_web: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti jong hin ajah-uvah, “Pathen thupeh phatah-in napaiyun, nachondanu joh nitna ding na-ngaitouve ong?

tcz: Atekahnan, Mose'n Pathen'a hungkon danthu napeuve: ‘Nanu le napa jabolun,’ chule ‘Koihileh anu le apa housea chu thi jeng hen,’ ati.
en_web: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
en_kjv: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Mose’n ‘Nanu napa jabol’un,’ chule ‘koi hile anu apa douna thuse sei jouse chu thihel hen,’ ati ahin,

tcz: Hinlah mihon anu le apa koma, ‘Gelse hih'un, kahinpanhu joupoi, ajehchu kahinpeh ding chu Pathen'a dia kapeh dingin kakiteptai,’ tia aseitheiyu jongleh aphatmona aumpoi natiuve.
en_web: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
en_kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon la, ‘Mi khat touvin nu ham pa ham jah a, ‘Keivanga naphat chomna ding thil ho chu Pathen dinga thilpeh ahi,’ atileh,

tcz: Hiti chun nule pate agel-thupitah diu angaikhohpoi natiuve.
en_web: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
en_kjv: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
tcz_gospelgo: ama hin nu hihen pa hileh akithopi lou akhoh poi,’ tin

tcz: Hitia hi nangho chon-namlhah joh najui jing theina diuva Pathen thupeh hochu juilouva nakahlhah jiu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
en_kjv: making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
tcz_gospelgo: akhang khanga nahin juipeh-u puchon pachon jeh chun Pathen seisa nathaimil’uve. Hitobang hin thil tampi nabol’uvin ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin mipite chu athuhil ngaidin akouvin, “Nabonuvin ngaiyun, chule hetthem ding gouvin.
en_web: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
en_kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi chu ahenga akou kit’in ajah-uvah, “Nabonun kasei ngaiphauvin, hetoh-un.

tcz: Polama kon'asunga lutchun ima asubohpon; lungsunga kon'a hung potdoh joh chun asuhbohji ahibouve.
en_web: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
en_kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil imacha polama kona mihem sunga lut’a ama suboh thei aumpoi, asunga kona potdoh bou chun asuhbohji ahi!

tcz: Angaina ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en_web: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”
en_kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
tcz_gospelgo: (Angaina ding nakhang neiyan ngaihen, “) ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi chu adalhan insung alut leh aseijuiten thulem asei chun ipilamdol akoa avetsah ham tin adongui.
en_web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
en_kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi adalhah a insunga alut chun aseijuiten hiche thulem hi adong chen’uve.

tcz: “Nanghon jong nahet theilou laiyu ong? Natahsa sunga lut an nanehho chun nahin suhboh lou u ahi chu namu theilouvuham?
en_web: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho jong midang banga hetna lhasam nahiuvam, polama kona mihem sunga lut chun ama asuboh poi,

tcz: An nanehlut'u chu lungsunga lutlouvin oisungah alut in posona-ah ahungdoh jitai.” (Hitia kiseihi, Pathen mitmun an jouse hi santhei dol ahisoh keiye ti aphondohna ahi).
en_web: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
en_kjv: because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile alung sunga lut louvin, a-oi sunga lut’a aposo naa ahung potdohji dol hekhen theilou nahiuvem?” ati. (Hichea hin neh thei jouse athengin aseiye.)

tcz: Chule Aman aseibe kit'in, “Lungsunga kon'a hungpot chun mi asuhboh ahi.
en_web: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
en_kjv: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Mihem sunga kona hung potdoh bou chun mi asuhboh ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem iti leh mihem lungsunga konin apolamah—lunggitlou, jonthanhoi, guchat, toltha,
en_web: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
en_kjv: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mihem lung sunga konin lung gilou, jon thanhoi, guchatna, tolthana,

tcz: Midangtoh-jon, papset, gitlou, mi-dohabol, huhna, kimitthipna, kitaitom, hoitho, ngolna kitiho hi ahung sohdoh ji'e.
en_web: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
en_kjv: thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
tcz_gospelgo: mito jonna, papsetna, gitlou, engsetna mi doha bol, huhna,

tcz: Hiche thilpha louho hi lungsunga potdoh ahin, mihem suboh ji chu ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
en_kjv: all these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
tcz_gospelgo: thilse hichengpi hi misunga kona hung potdohjia mi asuhbohji ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan Galilee gam adalhan, sahlama Tyre gamsungah achetai. Hikoma chun in khat'a alhungin, aumna in chu koima hetsah anompoi, ahinlah akiselthei deh tapoi.
en_web: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
en_kjv: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into a house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hikom chu adalhan Tyre gamkai jonin achetai. In sunga alut’in, koimacha akihetsah nompoi. Ahinla akisel thei dehpoi.

tcz: Hiachun Ama thudol anajakha numei khat ahungin, akengbula ahung bohkhup in ahi. Amanu achanu chu lhagaoboh vop ahin,
en_web: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
en_kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
tcz_gospelgo: Achanu lhagaoboh vop numei khat’in ajahdoh phat’in ahungin akhomuh-a aboh khup jenge.

tcz: Achanu a kon'a lhagaoboh anodohpeh dingin ahung taovin ahi. Amanu chu Syrian Phoenicia tolkon, Gentile-ho ahijeh chun,
en_web: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
en_kjv: the woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei chu Greek mi ahin, Syria gam Phoenicia khoa peng ahi; aman achanu sunga thilha nodoh peh dingin athume.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah-a, “Amasapenin keima insung, Judate chateho kavahva masat tahdi ding ahi. Chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate masanga selhah angai ahipoi,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
en_kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-a, “Chate va masa ta diu hen, chate neh ban lahpeh a uichate se-lhah peh ding aphapoi,” ati.

tcz: Amanun jong, “Hichu ahinai, Pakai, hijongle dokhang noiya um uichan jong chate lhengkonga kon tolkhe changlhah nehmoh anehkhah jiu khula-em,” tin adonbut in ahi.
en_web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
en_kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman adonbut’in a jah a, “Pakai, uichaten jong dokang noiya anmal lhathang aneh jiu khu me,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Nadonbut hoilheh-e! Tuhin na-in'ah chetan, nachanu chu thilhan adalhatai,” atipehtai.
en_web: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
en_kjv: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei nu jah a hin Jesun, “Hiche nasei jeh chun chetan, nachanu sunga konin thilha chu apotdohtai,” atipeh-e.

tcz: Hichun Amanu jong a-in'a acheleh achanu chu jalkhun'a analup amun, lhagaoboh anapotdohtan ahi.
en_web: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
en_kjv: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei chu acheleh anao jalkhuna lum agatoh-in, asunga konin thilha anapotdoh tai.

tcz: Yeshuan Tyre gamkol sungse adalhan, Sidon ajotpan Decapolis gamkai ajotpeh in, Galilee Dillen alhungtai.
en_web: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
en_kjv: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Tyre gamkai ajot’in, khopi som ajotpeh-in, Galilee dillen ahung lhung tai.

tcz: Chuin anangong, pao jong paochen theilou khat hi ahenga ahin puiyun, achunga akhut angap dingin ataovun ahi.
en_web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
en_kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahenga mi na-ngong paojong paochen theilou khat ahinpuiyun achunga khut angap din ataovui.

tcz: Hichun Aman mipi lah'a konin apuidohin, akhutchalin akol sung akhoiyin,
en_web: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
en_kjv: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi adalhan achangseh-in apuidoh in akhut jungin anakhang te ni akhoipeh-e; chuin chil aphikhumin aleigui jong athampeh-in,

tcz: Achil aset in, alei athamin, chuin vanlam aven akhoisan, “Ephphatha,” ati. Hichu kihongin! tina ahi.
en_web: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
en_kjv: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
tcz_gospelgo: chujouvin van lam aven, akhoisan, ‘Kihongin,’ ti nan ajah a, “Ephphatha,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat tah chun ana avangin, aleigui jong akilham tan, kichehtah'in apaotheitai.
en_web: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
en_kjv: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
tcz_gospelgo: Apet tah chun ana avangin, aleigui akilhamin, oh louhel’in thu asei theitai.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamtan ahi. Ahinla amahon ahaseiphong cheh'un ahi.
en_web: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
en_kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun koimacha jah a aseidoh louna diuvin akham chah kheh-e; ahinla ahakham cheh le ahaseiphong cheh-un ahi.

tcz: Kidang asabehseh jengun, avel avelin, “Aman ijakai abol jouse hi aloupi lheh jenge. Nangongla ana avansah-in, paomola apaosah-e,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
en_kjv: and were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajapha chanin kidang asa behseh jengun, “Ijakai abol phasoh keiyin, nangong la kho ajah sah tan, paomo jong apaotheisah tai,” atiuve.

tcz: Hiche laichun mipi ho chu atamlheh jengtan chule neh ding ima aneilou jeh un Yeshuan aseijuite chu akouvin ajah uva,
en_web: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
en_kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelai chun mipi nasa tah ahung kikhop kit leh neh ding anei lou phat’un Jesun seijuite akouvin ajah-uvah,

tcz: “Mi honpi hi kakoma aumnau nithum ahitan, amahon nehding ima aneipouve,
en_web: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
en_kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
tcz_gospelgo: “Mipi kakoma nelou chalouva aumnao hi nithum alhingtan, kalungset lheh jenge.

tcz: Chule annelouvin a-inlam chan uva solleng lampia lhasampa ding ahiuve. Akimkhat hi gamlatah a kon hung ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
en_kjv: and if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
tcz_gospelgo: Abang hi gamla tah a hung ahuvin, gilkel dangchah pumin kisol jengleh lampi dunga lha lhop pe tei diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Aseijuiten adonbut un, “Hikom gamthip laiya mi hichengpi lhingset'a vahna ding changlhah kon hoiya alahding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
en_kjv: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuiten adonbut’un, “Hikom gamthip’a mi hichengpi vahna kham changlhah kon hoiya alah ding ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum?” ati leh, “Pheng sagi aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
en_kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun “Changlhah ijat naneiyum?” atileh; :P heng sagi atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Aman mihonpi chu tolla tou din asolin, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, athangvah-in, chujouvin ahehbalbalin a-angsunguva luipeh dingin aseijuite chu apen, amahon mipi anga chun aluipeh-ui.
en_web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
en_kjv: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mipi tol’a tou din asol’in, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, phatthei aboh jouvin mipi ang’a luipeh din aseijuite apetai.

tcz: Chule aseijuiten nga neochacha phabep khat jong aneiyun, hijong chu phatthei aboh-in a-angsunguva luipeh dingin asoltan ahi.
en_web: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
en_kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon nga phabep jong anei yun, hijong chu phatthei aboh jouvin miho ang’a luipeh din aseipeh-e.

tcz: Chuin amahon aneuvin, avasoh keiyun, anehmoh-u anong aval chu longkai sagi alohdoh-un ahi.
en_web: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
en_kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon anevasoh keiyuvin, aneh moh-u anong longkai sagi dim aloh doh-uve.

tcz: Amaho chu numei-chapang simlouvin mi sangli jen ahiuvin, anehva jouvun Yeshuan in lamah asoltauve.
en_web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
en_kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
tcz_gospelgo: Anea pasal sang li jen ahin, Jesun amaho chu alhadoh tai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Ama aseijuite toh konga alutpaiyun, Dalmanutha gam alhung tauve.
en_web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
en_kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin aseijuite toh konga alut paiyun Dalmanutha gamsung alhung tauve.

tcz: Pharisee hon Yeshua ahunglhung taiti ajah phatnun, kinelkalpi dingin ahungun ahi. Athuneina photchenna dingin van'a kon melchihna avetsah diuvin angeh-un ahi.
en_web: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
en_kjv: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho ahungun thu adong pan’uvin, apatep nan van’a konin melchihna ahol’uve.

tcz: Chuin alungsungah akhoisan, “Tukhang mite hin ibol a melchihna ahol uham? Tahbeha kasei ahi, hiche tukhang mite hi imacha melchihna kipelou ding ahi,” atitai.
en_web: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
en_kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu along gil’in nasa tah-in akhoisan, “Ibol’a hiche khang mite melchihna ahol’u ham? Ddih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche khang mite hi melchihna kipe louhel ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amaho chu adalhan, konga alut kit'in, langkhat panga dingin akipat dohtai.
en_web: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
en_kjv: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin miho adalhan konga alut kit’in gallang khat’a achetai.

tcz: Hinlah aseijuiten changlhah kipoh ding ahin haimil tauve. Konga chunla changlhah phengkhat tailou adang aum hihhel in ahi.
en_web: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
en_kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiten changlhah apo haiyun, kong sunga neh thei dan gneilouvin, changlhah pheng khat she bou aneiyuve.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu ahilchah-in, “Chingtheiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah-a kihongpha uvin,” ati.
en_web: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
en_kjv: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajahuvah, “Ching theiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah a kihong phauvin,” ati.

tcz: Hiche aseiya kon chun changlhah ahin poh haimil jeh-un amaho akihoulimun, akioimoto uvin ahi.
en_web: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
en_kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijiute akihou lhiuvin, “Changlhah inei pouve,” akitiuve.

tcz: Akihounau chu Yeshuan ahen, ajah uva, “Changlhah naneilou jeh uva ibola kioimoto le nahiuvem? Tugeiya nalunguva hedoh loulai nahiuvem? Hetthemna dinga nalungu hibangloma tah lheh jeng ham?
en_web: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
en_kjv: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu Jesun ahen ajah-uva, “changlhah nanei lou jeh-uva ibol’a kihou lhi chet chut nahiuvem? Tugeiya hejong hekhen louva lungmoh gam nahiu hitam?

tcz: Mit neiyuva—mutheilou nahiuvem? Nakhang neiyuva—jatheilou nahiuvem? Gel jong nagel dohlou monguham?
en_web: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
en_kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
tcz_gospelgo: Mit nineiya namu thei lou, nakhang nineia najah thielouvu ham? Gel jong nageldoh lou mong uham?

tcz: Mi sang-nga changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh-a chu amoh-ahal paipeh ijat nalodimum?” atileh amahon, “Somleni ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
en_kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi sang nga lah a changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh a chu anong paipeh ijat nalodoh um?” atileh; “Paipeh som le ni,” atiuve.

tcz: Mi sangli lah-a changlhah pheng sagi kihoppeh-a chu nehmoh aval longkai ijat nalodimum? ati kit leh, “Sagi ahi,” atiuvin,
en_web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
en_kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi sang li lah a changlhah pheng sagi kahopeh a Chula anong longkai dim ijat nalodohuvem?” atileh; amahon, “Longkai sagi” atiuvin,

tcz: “Achutile tugeiya jong hedoh loulai nahiu ham?” atin ahi.
en_web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun ajah-uvah, “Nahet khenu hitam?” ati.

tcz: Amaho Bethsaida alhun phat'un, mi phabep in mitchopa chu Yeshua henglama ahin puiyun, chule amahon atohkhah-a adamsah din angeh-uvin ahi.
en_web: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
en_kjv: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
tcz_gospelgo: Bethsaida ahung lhung rauve. Hichun mitcho mi khat Jesu henga ahinpuiyun, atham din ataovui.

tcz: Yeshuan mitchopa chu akhut in atuh-in, khosunga konin apuidohtan ahi. Chuin amit a achil aset in achunga akhut angam in, “Tua hi kho namum?” tin adongin ahi.
en_web: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
en_kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mitchopa chu khopam langa apuidoh-in, amit te nia chil aphin achunga khut angapjouvin ajah a, “Ipi pi na mun?” tin adonge.

tcz: Mipa chun akimvel dung aven, “Henge, miho kamun, ahinla kichentah'in ka muthei poi, thingphungte chat lele tobang'in kamui,” ati.
en_web: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”
en_kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama adah-in, “Mihem kamun, thingphung holheh lheh ahin, ahivangin ava leu kamui,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin amit akhut'in atham kit'in, ave changmelin ahileh adamhel jengtan, ima jouse kichentah'in amu thei tan ahi.
en_web: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
en_kjv: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
tcz_gospelgo: Amit te ni thampeh leh kichentah-in kho amutai. Ama jong adamin gamla tah a thil ho geiyin kichentah-in amutheitai.

tcz: Yeshuan ama asoldoh in, “Khosunga chun lutpa tahih-in,” tin akham'in ahi.
en_web: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
en_kjv: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun, “Khosunga lutda tan,” tin, ainlama asol mangin ahi.

tcz: Yeshua le aseijuiten Galilee gam adalha uvin, Caesarea Philippi koma khohoa chun ache leuvin ahi. Lampia alamjot laiyun thu adongin, “Keima hi mihon koi ahi eitiuvem?” ati leh,
en_web: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
en_kjv: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le aseijuite Casarea Philippi khoneo hoa ache leuvin, lampia Jesun aseijite jah a, “Mihon Keima hi koi ahi, eitiuvem?” tin adonge.

tcz: Aseijuiten, “Loikhat in John Baptist, loikhat in Elijah chule loikhat kit chun Nangma hi themgaoho lah a achom khat hinte atiuve,” tin adonbut uve.
en_web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”
en_kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Mi phabep’in, ‘John Baptist ahi,’ atiuvin; pha bep’in ma, ‘Elijah ahi,’ atiuvin; kon khat sen vang, ‘Themgao ho khat pen ninah ta,’ tin aseiyui,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Ahileh nanghonla keihi koi ahi neitiuvem?” tia adoh leh, Peter in, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adongin, “Nang hon la koiba ahi neitiuvem?” atileh; Peterin adonbut’in ajah a, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Yeshuan koimacha koma aseidohlou beh diuvin ahilchahtan ahi.
en_web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
en_kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun aman koima jah a asei louna diuvin hakhamin akham chah-e.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu Mihem Chapan thohgimna tamtah athoh-a, vaipo upa hole thempu pipuho chule danthu sunhon adoudal diu thuho aseipeh-e. Chule thalih-a auma, nithum jouleh thoudoh kit teiding ahi chu ahil pantan ahi.
en_web: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
en_kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva Mihem Chapan genthei hesoh tamtah athoh a upate le Thempu pipu ho, Danthu them hon asan dauva, atha diu chule nithum jouva athodoh kit tei ding thu ahilpanin,

tcz: Aman hichu phongtaha aseijuite koma asei jinglaiyin, Peter in apuidohin hitobang thuho chu aseilou din angeh-in ahi.
en_web: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
en_kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah-uvah phongtah-in aseiye. Hichun Peterin atumin apuidohin abelhatai.

tcz: Ahin Ama akiheiyin, aseijuiteho aven Peter chu aphoh-in, “Kanung lama chen, Satan! Nangman Pathen thulam gellouvin, mihem thulam jeng nagele,” atin ahi.
en_web: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
en_kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akiheiyin aseijuite aven Peter chu haphon aphohin, “Kinung le jengin Satan, ajeh chu nangin Pathen gel bang gel louvin mihem lung gel jeng na gel’e” ati.

tcz: Chuin Aman aseijuiho le mihonpi chu ahenglama akouvin, “Nalah-uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chonnauva kon'a nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui dingu ahi.
en_web: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
en_kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseijiute le mipi akou vin ajah-uva, :Koi hile eijuinom chu amatah kisumil hel’a athingpel akiput’a eijui ding ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh koi hile ahinna huhhing nom'a chun alhaso ding ahi. Amavang koi hile keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a ahinna lhaso'a chun akihuhhing joh ding ahi.
en_web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
en_kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile koi hile akihinso nom chun athi o ding, amavnag Keijal le Kipanathupha jal’a thi lo jouse kihinso na anei didng ahi.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh min vannoi pumpi neihenlang ahinna chan taleh, ipi phatchomna anei ding ham?
en_web: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
en_kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu min vannoi leiset pumpi neihen lang ahinkho kisuh mang ta leh ipi phat chompin tem?

tcz: Min ahinna khel'a ipi apeh dingham?
en_web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
en_kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle min ahinkho lhenga ipi apeh ding ham?

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh koihileh tulai chonthanhoinale chonsetna khanga keima le kathuhil jachatpi chu Mihem Chapan jong apa loupina-a vantil thengtetoh ahung nileh, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
en_kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijemtia mikhat touvin hiche chonse lekitah lou khanga hi Kei le kathuho ajachat pi leh Mihem Chapan jong Vantil thengte toh Apa loupinaa ahung teng leh ama chu ajumso ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan aseibe nalaiyin, “Keiman tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, tua hichea dingho kimkhat hi Pathen gam thaneitah'a ahung lhun amu kahseuva thina tepkhalou ding aumuve!” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hikoma ding ho lah ahin Pathen lenggam thu neitah a hung amu kah seuva thina tep kha lou ding aum’uve,” ati

tcz: Nigup jouvin Yeshuan Peter, James chule John atumbeh in molsang chungah apui touvin ahi. Chuah amaho angsung laitah-a Yeshua avou akikheltan,
en_web: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
en_kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nigup jouvin Jesun Peter le Jacob chule John toh achanguvin molsang chunga apuitouve. Chuin a-ang sunguvah avou akikhel’in,

tcz: Aponsil chu vah bangin aemleng jengin, leiya koiman pon hitobanga chu asop bang theilou khop'in abangin ahi.
en_web: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
en_kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
tcz_gospelgo: aponsil ho chu abanlot lot’in alhelah alh jengin, leiset’a koiman hitobangin asop bang theipoi.

tcz: Chuin Elijah le Mose ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua chu ahoulimpi lhonin ahi.
en_web: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
en_kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Elijah le Mose ahenguva ahung kilah lhonin Jesu toh akihou lim’uve.

tcz: Chuin Peter in, “Houhil, hikoma iumuhi eiho din anom ngeiye! Geldoh jingna din lhambuh thum song uhite—Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat,” atin ahi.
en_web: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
en_kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Peterin Jesu adonbut’in, “Rabbi, hikoma ium’u hi anome, Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elija ding khat, lhambuh thum song ung kate,” ati.

tcz: Hiche asei hi akichat behseh jeh'a seiding hetmoa asei ahi.
en_web: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
en_kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Akichat behseh jehuva sei ding hetmoa asei ahibouve.

tcz: Chuin meilhang khat'in amaho chu ahin lekhun, meilah-a konin aw ahung gingin, “Hichehi ka-Chapa deitah chu ahi, athu ngaiyun!” ati.
en_web: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
en_kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin meilhang khat’in ahile khu’uvin, meilhang lah a kon chun ogin khat hin, “Hiche hi kachapa deditah ahi, athu ngaiyun,” ati.
