tcz: Chuin amaho Jericho khopi alhungun, Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi sung adalhah ding kon'un mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahin juiyui. Chuti lai chun mitcho khat, Timaeus chapa Bartimaeus chu lampam'ah anatouve.
en_web: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
en_kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimeus, the son of Timeus, sat by the highway side begging.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho Jerichoa ahung tauve. Aseijuite le mipi nasatah toh kilhona Jesun Jericho adalhah chun Timaeus chapa mitcho Bartimaeus khutdopa chu lampama antouve.

tcz: Nazareth Yeshua chu nailam chan aum taiti ahet phatnin, “Vo David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam pantan ahi.
en_web: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
en_kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

tcz: Mi tamtah chun, “Thipmin!” tin ama chu aphoh-un, ahivangin aman ging cheh-in, “David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam kit'e.
en_web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
en_kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon umthim beh din aphohsl cheh-un, ahinla ama ahapen chehjengin, “David chapa, neikhoton,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah phatnin adingdenin, “Hilama hung din seipeh-un,” atin, amahon jong mitchopa chu aganai pheiyun, “Kipah thanomin! Hungtan, Aman nakouve,” atipeh-un ahin pui tauve.
en_web: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
en_kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesu adingin, “Gah kouvun,” atileh; mihon mitchopa akouvun ajah a, “Kinemin, kipatdoh-in nakouve,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Hichun Bartimaeus chun asangkhol-tho chu asut in akoilhan, chuin akichom touvin Yeshua heng ahin jon tai.
en_web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
en_kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun apon aleh lhan, akichom jang khaileh-in Jesu henga ahung tai.

tcz: Yeshuan, “Ipi bolpehleng nadeiyem?” tia adoh leh, mitchopan, “Houhil, kho muleng kati,” ati.
en_web: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah’a, “Ipi neibolpeh-in nati ham?” atileh; mitchopan, “Rabboni, kho neimusah-in,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah-a, “Chetan, natahsan in nadamsah tai,” ati leh, chupet tah chun kho amupai jengin, lamlhungin Yeshua ahin juitai.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun jah a, “Chetan, natahsanin nadamsah tai,” ati. Chutah chun aman kho amu paiyin lampia chun Jesu ajuitai.

tcz: Hiti chun Yeshua le aseijuiten Jerusalem ahinjon tauvin, Olive Lhanga Bethphage le Bethany kho alhung tauve. Yeshuan aseijui mi ni anache masadin asol masan,
en_web: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples
en_kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem kho koma Olive mol’a Bethphage le Bethany ageiyun Jesun aseijui mi ni asol’in,

tcz: “Che lhon inlang, namasang jon lhon'a khopi sunga khun lut lhonin. Nalut lut lhon leh sangannou kihen, achunga koima touna khahlou lai khat namu pai lhon ding ahi. Hichu sutlha lhon inlang hinkaiphei lhonin.”
en_web: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.
en_kjv: and saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah a, “Nagah galmu kho sunga khun lut lhon le chun mitouna khah lou sa-ngan nou kihen khat namupai lhon ding ahin, hinsut lhan hinkai lhonin.

tcz: Mi khat touvin, “Ibola nasut lhonham? tia ahin doh leh, ‘Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, chomkhat jouteng hinthahvah kit lhon nange,’ tilhon'in,” atipeh-e.
en_web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
en_kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat touvin, ‘Idia nabol lhon ham?’ ati leh, ‘A-Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, hinthah vahkit tante,’ tin seipeh lhonin,” ati.

tcz: Seijui teni achelhon in, khopi sung lamlen'a inkot poa kotphunga sangannou kihen agamu lhontan ahi.
en_web: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
en_kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amani ache lhon lehkot polam, khopi dsung lamlena sa-ngan nou kihen chu amun asut lhontai.

tcz: Chuin asut lhon leh akoma anadingho loikhat in, “Ibola sangannou chu nasut lhon ham?” atiuvin,
en_web: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
en_kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma ding ho khat’in, “Ibol nahiya sa-ngan nou chu nasut lhon ham?” ahinti.

tcz: Chuin amanin Yeshuan asei bang chun amaho komah aseilhonin ahile ahin phalpeh tauve.
en_web: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
en_kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanin Jesu ahil banga asei lhon leh alhatauve.

tcz: Sangannou chu Yeshua henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga apon'u asep'un, Ama achunga atoutan ahi.
en_web: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
en_kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin sa-ngan nou chu Jesu henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga pon aphauvin, Jesu atoutai.

tcz: Mipi atama tamin lampiah apon'u aphauvin, mi abangkhat in loulaiya theoboh asat'un lampiah aphauvin ahi.
en_web: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
en_kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon phabep’in loulaiya theoboh alhamun lampia aphauve.

tcz: Yeshua chu alailunga achesah'un, amasang lam le anunglama, “Pathen thangvah-in umhen! Pakai min'a hungpa chu anunnome!
en_web: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
en_kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin anung le ama kijot chengsen: “Huhhing hen! Pakai min a hungpe anun nom’e!

tcz: Lenggam hung lhung ding Pu David gam chu phattheiboh chang hihen! Chungnungpen'a Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen!” tin asam asam'un ahi.
en_web: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
en_kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pao David lenggam hung lhung chu nun nom hen!” tin asamtauve.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem khopia houin'a chun Yeshua agalut'in, ijakai avet kimvel sohkei jouvin, nilhah lam jong ahitan, apot in somleni ho cheng toh Bethany'a akilekit tauvin ahi.
en_web: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
en_kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesu Jerusalem khopi alut’in Houin a aluttai. Thil ijakai avetgolsoh leh nilhah lam ahitan, som le ni chutoh Bethany jonin apot dodh tauve.

tcz: Chuin ajingkah-in Bethany'a kon'a ahung potdoh leh agil akeltan ahi.
en_web: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
en_kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajinga Bethany a kona ahung ki le kit phat’un Jesu agilkeltai.

tcz: Hichun theichangphung amun, aga aum khattoule tia agavetle theiga phat lhingjep nailou ahitoh lhonin ado tailou aga ima amutapoi.
en_web: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
en_kjv: and seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamla thima theichang phung dod nei khat amun, aga um ding ging cha nave din achei. Ahinla aga phat ahiloujeh-in ado tilou ima dang amudoh tapoi.

tcz: Yeshuan thingphung jah-a chun, “Tukallhah koiman natheiga nekit tahih hen!” atitan ahi. Chutia aseichu aseijuiten anajauvin ahi.
en_web: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun theichang phung chu, “Tukal’in koiman naga nekit hih hel hen,” atileh; hichu aseijuiten ajauve.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem ahung lhun'un, Yeshua houin sunga alut in, asunga thiljoh holeh thilchoho anodoh pantan, chule sumlhengho dokhang le vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh tan ahi.
en_web: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
en_kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem ahung lhungun Jesu Houina alut’in asunga thiljoh le thil cho ho anodoh-in, sum lheng ho dokhang joouse le vapal joh ho touna alikhup peh-in,

tcz: Houin sunga chun koima thilkeo apohle ding ajanom tapoi.
en_web: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
en_kjv: and would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin sunga koi ma thil apoh le sah tapoi.

tcz: Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Thubua: ‘Ka-in chu namtin dinga taona in kitiding ahi,’ tia kisun hilouham? Ahin nanghon gucha michomho kokhuh in naso tauve,” atin ahousetai.
en_web: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
en_kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho ahil’in, “Ka-in chu namtin dia taona in kiti ding ahi,’ tia kisun hilou ham? Nang hon gucha michomho kikholnan nasemdoh tauve,” ati.

tcz: Hichu thempu pipui hole hou danthu themhon ajauvin ahile, athimah tauvin, Yeshua tha ding tohgon aneipan tauve. Hinlah mipin athuhil chu kidang asah-uva angainom jeh-u chun Ama chu akichauvin ahi.
en_web: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
en_kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu pipu ho le Danthu them hon ajauvin, suhmangna ding lampi aholtauve. Ahinla amihil chu mipin kidang asah cheh jeh-un akichauvin ahi.

tcz: Hiche nilhah chun Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi adalha tauve.
en_web: When evening came, he went out of the city.
en_kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah ahi phat’in Jesu le aseijuite khopia konin apotdoh tauve.

tcz: Ajing jingkah-a theichang phung chu ahin jotpau leh anagoplhasa-a aum chu amutauve.
en_web: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
en_kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingpi tah-in thiechang phung chu ahinho paule, ajung ajaa agop jeng chu amu’uve.

tcz: Chuin Peter in ageldoh-in, “Vetan Houhil, theichangphung nagaosap chu agoptai!” ati.
en_web: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
en_kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh chu Peterin agel doh phat’in Jesu jah a, “Rabbi, ven, theichang phung na gaosap chu agoptai,” atileh;

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen tahsanun,
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
en_kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Pathen tahsanun.

tcz: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh hiche mol jah-a, ‘Kichondoh'in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut tan,’ ati leh chutijeng ding ahi. Hinlah hichu tahsanna dihtah nei lelung-opkaina beihel ahi angaiye.
en_web: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
en_kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hile alungthima ginchat lelna beihel’a hiche mol khu ‘Kitol’in twikhanglen’ah kileh lut jengin,’ tia asei banga soh tei dia tahsan chun, asei bang banga soh ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu kasei ahi, nataova thil nathum chan chu namusan ngaito leuchun namu dingu ahi.
en_web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
en_kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu najah-uva kasei ahi, nataovuva thil nathum jouseu namusen gel leu chun namu diu ahi.

tcz: Chule atao dinga nadinpet leh van'a na-Pauvin jong nasuh khelnau angaidam theina din koi hijongle nadou uchu ngaidamun.
en_web: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
en_kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
tcz_gospelgo: Tao dia nadin pet le van’a um na-pan Jong nasuh khel jouseu angaidam theina din, koi itobang hijongle nalungdou chu ngaidamin.

tcz: Nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidamlou vangule van'a na-Pauvin nangho suhkhel jong angaidam louding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
en_kjv: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
tcz_gospelgo: (Nang hon mi na-Pauvin jong nasuh khel’u angaidam lou ding ahi).

tcz: Jerusalem ahung lhung kit tauvin, Yeshua Houin sungah agavahlen ahileh thempu pipui holeh danthusunho ahenga ahungun,
en_web: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
en_kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema ahungkit tauve. Jesu Houin sunga ava le pet’in Thempu pipu hole Danthu themho chule upa ho ahenga ahungun ajah-ah,

tcz: “Ipi thuneina'a hitihohi nabolham? Hitobang bolna dinga kon thaneina napeh ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
en_kjv: and say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
tcz_gospelgo: “Ipi tha neina a hiti ho hi nabol ham? Hicheng bolna ding hi kon tha napeh ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: “Keiman thukhat nadong uvingting neidonbut'un lang chuteng keiman jong ipi thuneina'a hichehi kabol ham naseipeh nauvinge,” tin Yeshuan adonbut in ahi.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Nang ho thu khat dong inge, neidonbut’un, chutengleh ipi tha neinaa hiti ho hi kabol seipeh nauvinge.

tcz: Hichun, “John chun twilutsah abol thuneina chu vanna kon ha, mihem a kon ham? Nei donbut'un!” tin adongtai.
en_web: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
en_kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
tcz_gospelgo: John Baptist chu van’a kon ha mihema kon ham? Neidonbut’un” ati.

tcz: Amaho le amaho akidongto uvin, “Vanna kon ahi tileu hen achutileh ibola John natoh natahsanlou uham tintin,
en_web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
en_kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho akinelden tauvin,” ‘Vana kon ahi,’ tileu hen la, ‘Ahileh ibol’a natahsan louvu ham?” tin tin;

tcz: Mihem a kon ahi iti ngam diu baham?” akitiuvin ahi. Amaho akichauvin ahi—mijousen John chu themgao tahbeh'a angaito cheh-u ahijeh chun.
en_web: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
en_kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihema kon ahi,’ iti diu ham?” akitiuve. Ahinla mipin John hi Themgao dih a agel jeh-in akichauvin ahi.

tcz: Achainan adonbut un, “Kahepouve,” atitauve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutile ipi thuneina'a hicheng hi kabol ham ti keiman jong naseipeh povinge,” atitai.
en_web: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
en_kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesu jah a, “Kahepouve,” atiuve. Chuphat’in ajah-uva, “ken jong ipi tha neinaa hichenghi kabol ahi naseipeh pouvinge,” atitai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan thulem in thu ahil pantan: “Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, akimvel ah pal agenin ahi. Chuin achilna ding khuh alaiyin, insang asan, chuin aleilhouho khut'ah lousan dingin apedoh in gamdangah achetan ahi.
en_web: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
en_kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah thulemin thu aseipanin, “Pasal khat’in lengpilei abol’in, tho akaikhumin, lengpiga chilna din khuh alaiyin, thing chung buh asan, chuin aleilhouho apedodh-in khol’a achetai.

tcz: Aga lo phat ahi phat'in ama chan ding chu lading in aleilhou ho henga asoh ho khat asoltai.
en_web: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
en_kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpiga lhun phat donin achan ding lengpiga la din aleilhouho henga soh khat asol’e.

tcz: Hinlah leilhouho chun amapa chu amanun avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin soldoh tauve.
en_web: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
en_kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
tcz_gospelgo: Aleilhou hon sohpa chu amanun avouvin khutgoh keovin asoltauve.

tcz: Chuin lou neipan asohho khat asol kit leh ama jongchu ajumso uvin, alu ahin vohpeh-uve.
en_web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
en_kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahin asoh khat asol kittai. Hichepa hi aluchang mapun alhauvin, jachat umtah-in anbol’ui.

tcz: Chujouvin achom khat asol kit'in ahile ama chu ahin that tauve. Chule adang asol ho jong abang ahin vouvin, abang ahin that un ahi.
en_web: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
en_kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh, chom khatma asol kit leh, amahi athat tauve. Hitobang hin soh tampi, abang avouvin, adangse athat’ui.

tcz: Asolthei ding khat bou aumtan, ama chu achapa deitah chu ahi. Lou neipan achainakeiyin, ‘Kachapa ahijeh'in anajabol nauvinte,’ tin ama chu asoltan,
en_web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
en_kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Chapa chang khat bou aneitai. Akhon nan, ‘Kachapa hi anajabol khat’u leh,’ tin ahenguva asol tai.

tcz: Ahinlah aleilhouho chu akihouvun, ‘Veuvin, agamngah ding, agou loding pa ahunge, khaiye! Thatdoh-utin agam hi eiho chang taute,’ aki tiuvin ahi.
en_web: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lengpilei lhou ho chun, ‘Hichepa hi agoulopa ahi, hungun that’u hitin agoulo ding eiho change hite,’ akitiuvin;

tcz: Thubua kisun: ‘Insahon adeimouva apaiyu song chu inning songin apangtan,

tcz: hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, vetdingin avetlom lheh-e,’ tia kisun chu nasim dohkhah-uvem?” tin adonge.

tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Pakai bol ahin, Imit vet’uva thil kidangtah ahi,’ tia kisun Pathen lekhabua chu nasim khah lou laiyu ham?” ati.

tcz: Chupet'a um hou lamkaiho chun—leilhou migilou ho chu amaho toh kitekahna'a kisei ahi tin agel tauvin, Yeshua chu matding ago tauvin ahi. Ahinlah mipiho akichat kit jeh-uvin, adalha uvin achemang tauve.
en_web: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

tcz_gospelgo: Amahon athulem sei chu agot nauva asei ahi aheuvin, mat din agouve; ahinla mipi agin jeh-un ada lhauvin ache mangtauve.

en_web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
en_kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu kinelpia gaman din Pharisee loi phabep le Herodias loi phabep ahenga asoltauve.

tcz: Hichun agacheuvin, “Houhil, Nangma midih nahin, koima gin naneipoi. Dihtah'a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahi chu kaheuve. Ahile neiseipehun—Caesar kai kapeh-uhi dihthei ding hinam ahiloule dihlou ding ham?”
en_web: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
en_kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cesar, or not?
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu ahungun ajah a, “Houhil, midih tah nahin, koi mai jamana thilbol jong hilou Pathen lamdih bou nahilji kaheuve. Caesar henga mikai kapeh-u Dan ngai hi na hilou ham? Kapeh diu ha kapeh da diu ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Kapeh diu ham, kapehlou diu ham? agatiuve. Yeshuan aphatlhemnau chu amudoh'in, adonbutnan, “Ibola neilunglah patep uham? Romte dangka-pumkhat hinchoiyun langnei vetsah un, chule naseipeh-uvinge,” ati.
en_web: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
en_kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun akiphat lhemsah-u ahen ajah-uvah, “Idia neilung lah-u ham? Denarius khat hinchoiyun venge,” ati.

tcz: Ahin choi phat'un, Yeshuan aven, “Hichea kinam hi koi lim le koi min ham?” tia adohleh, amahon “Caesar a ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
en_kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cesar’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinchoi phat’un, “Hiche hi koi lim le koi min ham?” atileh; amahon, “Caesar’a,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Chuti ahile aphai, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin,” atipeh tai. Adonbutna chu adatmo lheh jeng un ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cesar the things that are Cesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah-uva, “Caesar thil chu Caesar pauvin, Pathen thil chu Pathen peuvin,” ati. Hichun amah on adatmo lheh jengui.

tcz: Chujouvin Sadducee—mithi thokitna aumpoi tiho—chu ahengah ahung un, ajah-a thudoh aneiyun,
en_web: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

tcz_gospelgo: Mithisa thokit tahsan lou sadducee loi Jesu henga ahungun ajah a,

tcz: “Houhil, Mosen eithupeh dungjuiyun mi khattouvin cha neilouva ajinu adalhah'a, athi tah'a ahile, asopipa chun ajinu chu vehen lang asopipa phunggui amanlouna ding chun chi khaipeh hen tin akiseiye.
en_web: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
en_kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
tcz_gospelgo: “Houhil’ Mose’n ‘Pasal khat’in cha anei masanga aji athi le asopipan meithaini chu avet’a asopipa chu akhaipeh ding ahi,” tin ei sut peh-ui.

tcz: Achutile, tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. Amasapenpa chun ji aneiyin chikhai louvin athitai.
en_web: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
en_kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopi pasal sagite aumun, a-upapen ajinei jouvin chikhai louvin aumtai.

tcz: Aban'a pan amanu chu jin aneiyin chikhai louvin athin, athumnapa jong chutima chu ahin,
en_web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

tcz_gospelgo: Anichanna pan avetpeh kit leh amajong chikhai louman athin, chuin athum lhinna pa jong chutiman aumtai.

tcz: Hitichun akitol suhpeh tauvin, asagiuvin chikhailou ahitauve. Achainan numeinu jong chu athitai.
en_web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
en_kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin khat chan jong chu akhai apouve. Achainan numeinu jong athitai.

tcz: Ahileh tun neiseipeh-un, thokit nia amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem? Ijeh-inem iti leh asagiuva amanu chu jia anei cheh-u ahitai,” atiuve.
en_web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
en_kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithi thikitnaa athodoh tengu leh hiche nu hi koipen ji hitan tem? Ajeh chu asagiuva jia anei cheh-u ahi,” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasuhkhel'u chu Pathen thubua thu kisei nahethem pouvin chule Pathen thaneina nahet lou uhi ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Pathen lekhabu le athahat nahetjoh sangu aum loujeh a hiba nakheljiu hilouham?

tcz: Ijeh-inem iti leh mithiho athodoh tengu chule ji anei tahlou diu chujongleh kichensahna umtalou ding ahi. Hiche thudol'a hi vanna Vantilte tobang hiding ahitauve.
en_web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
en_kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mihem thinaa kona athodoh tengleh kichen abol paovin, kicheng din jong akilato tapouve; van’a Vantilte tobang ahitauve.

tcz: Ahileh, mithiho kaithouva aum diu thudol hi—Mose'n hamboh meikou thudol asutna-ah, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob thi jou khonungpeh-a Pathen in Mose koma, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ tia asei thu chu sim khalou nahiuvem?
en_web: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
en_kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
tcz_gospelgo: Mithi thokit thudol kisutna, Pathenin, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ atina nasim khah lou laiyu ham?

tcz: Chu dungjuiya chu ama ahingho Pathen ahin, athihoa ahipoi. Nanghon thuhettohlou suhkhelna lentah naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
en_kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama mithi ho Pathen ahipon, mihing ho Pathenjoh ahi. Nagel khel lheh-ui,” ati.

tcz: Chua hou danthuhilho lah'a khat in akihounau chu anajan, Yeshuan kichentah'a ahil chu ahechen in, hijeh chun aman Yeshua jah-a, “Thupeh jouse lah'a hoichepen hi thupipen ham?” tin adongtai.
en_web: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
en_kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu them ho khat ahung leh akinel’u ajan, Jesun kitoh tah a adonbut amun ajah a, “Thupeh lah a amasapen ipi ham?” atileh;

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thupeh pipen chu hichehi ahi: ‘Ngaiyun, vo Israel! Pakai Pathen hi khatseh bou ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
en_kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Thupah masapen chu, ‘Ngaiyuvin vo Israel, Pakai i-Pathenu chu Pakai khatseh bou ahi;

tcz: Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu, nalung pumpi, nahinna pumpi, nangaitona pumpi chule nathaneina jousea nangailut mong mong ding ahi.’
en_web: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
en_kjv: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh a chu nangman pakai na-Pathen chu nalungthim pumpia, nahinkho pumpia, nalung gel jouse leh natha neina jousea na-ngailut ding ahi,’ kiti ahin;

tcz: Anina jong kibangchet'in athupin ahi, hichu: ‘Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.’ Hicheteni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,” ati.
en_web: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
en_kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
tcz_gospelgo: anina chu, ‘Nangma naki-ngailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi,’ akiti. Hiche te ni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,’ ati.

tcz: Hou dan thuhilpan adonbut in, “Naseihoi ngeiye, Houhil. Nangman thudihtah in thu naseiyin Pathen khatseh bou aume, Pathen dang aumpoi nati-e.
en_web: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;
en_kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Danthu thempan ajah a, “Adih-e Houhil, Pathen khatseh tilou adang aumpoi, nati hi adih-in,

en_web: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
en_kjv: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

tcz: Danthuhilpan kichentah'a adonbut ajah phat'in Yeshuan ajah-a aseiyin, “Nangma Pathen Lenggam toh nakigamlat poi,” atipeh tai. Chukal chun koiman thudang adongngam tapoi. David Chapa Thudol Asei
en_web: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

tcz_gospelgo: Hetoh thema adonbut hi Jesun ahen ajah a, “Pathen lenggam to nakilat poi,” ati. Chukal’in koiman thu adong ngam tapoi.

en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
tcz_gospelgo: Houin a thu ahil pet’in Jeun, “I-atileh Danthu themhon Messiah chu David guiya peng ding ai atiu ham?

tcz: Ijeh-inem iti leh Lhagao Thengin ahil a konin David jengin jong, ‘Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah-ah, jabolna mun'ah kajet lamin touvin namelmate cheng nakeng chotphaa kaneisah masangsen,’ anatin ahi.

en_kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao Thenga konin David amatah-in, ‘Pakai chun ka-Pakai jah a, Keiman namelmate nakeng chotpha kakoisah masangsen, Kajet lama tou jingin,’ atin;

en_web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

tcz_gospelgo: David amatah-in ‘Pakai’ asah leh, iti ama guiya peng hithei ding ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Yeshuan aseibe kit'in, “Danthusunhoa konin kihongphauvin! Ajehchu amahon sangkhol chol kiah-a kholailenna chule kailhanga min chibai aboh diu athanoppiuve.
en_web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
en_kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun athuhilnaa chun, “Ching theiyun, thepna sangkhol chol ki-ah a vah le nom kailhang dunga min asalam ding deiya,

en_web: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

en_web: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

tcz_gospelgo: mei thaiho bahgama, mi mu dia sottah tah taoji hoa konin kihong phauvin, amaho hithemmo chugnnung chang diu ahi,” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Houin sum kholna maitah a atouvin, mihon sumkholna sunga sum alhah-u chu avei. Mihao hon sum tampi pi alhah lut’ui.

tcz: Chua chun vaichatah meithainu khat ahungin sumsan-nong pumni alehlut in ahi.
en_web: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

en_kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseijuite akouvin ajah-uvah, “Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, hiche meithai vaichanu hin midang jouse sangin sumkholna sunga atoh tam pen’e.

en_web: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
en_kjv: for all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mihon aneival’u atou ahin, hiche numei hin avaichat lheh vangin akivah hingna ding anei chasun aboncha ato ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua houin'a konin apotdohin, aseijuite khat'in aseiyin ajah-ah, “Houhil, vetemin hichea in len thupitahho hi! Abanga song lentahtah kimang ho khu athupi ngeiye,” ati leh,
en_web: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
en_kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge, ven, hiche in lentahho hung kisuchim sohkei ding ahi. Songkhat jeng jong khat chunga kisethom umlou helding ahi!” ati.

en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Hiche in loupitah kisa hinamu ong? Kisumanga song khat chunga song kise-thom him him umlou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua Olive Lhanga Houin jon'ah atouvin ahile, Peter, James le John chule Andrew ahenga ahungun, ajah'a adongun,
en_web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

tcz_gospelgo: Houin to kigalsai Olive mol’a Jesu atoupet’in Peter le Jacob, John le Andrew’in guh thim chan adongun,
