en_web: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
en_kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng aman inching dan lentah, suhngimsa gotsa kikoi khat navetsah lhonin tin, hikoma chun ibonchauva din anagong lhontan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin seijui teni chu apot lhon in, khopi sungah alut lhon in, akisei bang chun imajouse chu agatoh lhonin, Kalchuh Kut an ding chu agagong lhon tai.
en_web: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
en_kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuite ni achen, khopi sunga alut’in, thil ijakai asei bangin agatoh-in, kalchuhkut anagong lhone.

tcz: Hichun nilhah-in Yeshua aseijuite toh chua chun agalhung tauve.
en_web: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
en_kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah ahiphat’in Jesu som le ni chutoh ahungtai.

tcz: Atou uva an aneh laitah-un, Yeshuan aseiyin, “Tahbeha kasei ahi, tua kaneh khompi lah-a khat hin eipeh doh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
en_kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin touva an aneh laitah-un Jesun, “Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, nalah-uva khat, kaneh khompipa tah hi eipedoh a pang ding ahi,” atitai.

tcz: Amaho alungkham pan tauvin, banneichan khat khat in ahin dongui, “Kei kahim?” tin.
en_web: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
en_kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun alungkham pantauvin, khat khat’in ajah-ah, “Keivang kahilou ahinai ong?” tin adonguve.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho somleni lah'a khat, tua lhengkong kasokhompi hi ahi.
en_web: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
en_kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Som le nilah a khat, lhenga changlhah kadekot khompi pa hi ahi.

tcz: Mihem Chapa chu athi ding dol masanglai peh'a pat Thubua anakiseisa ahitai. Hinama jongleh, Mihem Chapa melmate khut'a pedoh-a johdohpa chu—Ohe, ada nading e! Ama chu apen'a anapenglou hile ama dinga phajo dinga!” ati.
en_web: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
en_kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed: good were it for that man if he had never been born.
tcz_gospelgo: Miihem Chapa vang chu aumchan didng kisun banga chetei ding ahin, ahivangin amajeh a Mihem Chapa kimat lo dingpa chu, ohe, ada na’e! penglou hileh ama dia phajo ta dinga!” ati.

tcz: Chuin a-anneh laitah'un Yeshuan changlhah phabep alan, hichu phatthei aboh in, chuin ahehbalbal'in aseijuiteho apen, “Hichehi katahsa ahi, neuvin,” ati.
en_web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
en_kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
tcz_gospelgo: An aneh laitah-un Jesun changlhah alan phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in amaho apen, “Kilah-un, hiche hi katahsa ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chule khon'a lengpitwi alan, phatthei aboh-in amahochu apen, chutichun abonchauvin adonsohkei tauvin ahi.
en_web: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
en_kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Khon jong chu alan athang vah jouvin amaho apen, abon Chauvin khona chun adonsoh keiyui.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah'uva aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka thisan, Pathen le amite kah'a kitepna thah um photchetna ahi. Hiche hi mi tamtah chonset ngaidamna dinga longdoh ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin ajah-uvah, “Hiche hi mi tamtah dinga kilhoh lha, kathisana kitepna ahi.

tcz: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman Pathen Lenggama athah-a kadon kit ni ding tailou lengpitwi hi kadonlou ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggama athah kadon kit ding nikho hung lhun kahsea lengpiga twi hi kadon lou ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun la asauvin, chujouvin apotdoh'un Olive Lhang lamah ache tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
en_kjv: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin la asah jouvun Olive mol lam jonin achedoh tauve.

tcz: Lampia achepet'un Yeshuan ajah'uva aseiye, “Nangho naboncha uva nalungthoi sohkeidiu ahi. Ijeh-inem iti leh, Pathen thubun: ‘Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavohlhuh ding ahi, chujou teng akelngoite chu chehchao diu ahi,’ ati.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
en_kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho nakipal lhuhsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu, ‘kelngoi Chingpa kavoh lhuh a kelngoite chehgam diu ahi,’ tin akisune.

tcz: Ahinlah keima thina-a kon kahung thodoh jouteng Galilee gam lama namasanguva kache ding chua chu neimu diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
en_kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle kathodoh jou teng Galilee gam lhung masajo ding kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Aboncha uvin lungthoi jongleu, kei vang lungthoi ponge,” ati.
en_web: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
en_kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin adonbut’in “Khat khat’in kipal lhu jong leu keivang kipal lhu ponge,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan, “Keiman tahbeh'a kasei ahi, Peter—nangman tu jan'a ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
en_kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, tujanle lea ah nivei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Peter in, “Kanompoi! Nang matoh thitha teiding hijongleng, naseilep hihhel ing kate,” atichang melin ahi. Chule abonchauvin achuti seicheh-un ahi.
en_web: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
en_kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Peterin, “Nang to kathi tha tei ding, kaseilep louhel ding ahi,” atichang mel’e. Abonchauvin achutisei cheh-uve.

tcz: Amaho olive thinglei lah-a Gethsemane atiu honsung achun ahungun, chuah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Keima katao sungsen nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun,” ati.
en_web: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
en_kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
tcz_gospelgo: Gethsemane kiti mun ahinphah phat’un Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Kagatao sungsen hikom’ah anatou jingun,” ati.

tcz: Aman Peter, James chule John akipuiyin, alunghem lheh jeng tai.
en_web: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
en_kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Peter le Jacob chule John apuiyin, kidang asa behseh-in nasatah-in alunghem pantai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Thina khop helin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai. Hikoma hin um unlang eina kiginpeh-un,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
en_kjv: and saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ajah-uvah, “Thina khop hel’in kalung hesoh tai, hikoma umun kiging jinguvin,” ati.

tcz: Chule amasang lamah neokhat ache chon'in tollah akhupboh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu Ama-a kon'a akitolmang theina dingin ataove.
en_web: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
en_kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule masang lama phabep ache chonin, tol’ah akhup boh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu akoma kona kitol mang din ijakai ahitheiye, hiche khon hi keiya konin tolmang tan; hinla Kei dei hilouvin Nang deijoh hihen,” ati.

tcz: Akapjah-in, “Abba, Hepa! Imajouse Nanga dinga hithei ahi. Ahitheile hiche gimthohna khon hi keiya konin kitolmang hen. Hinla Nangma lunggot bang joh hihen lang, keima lunggot bang hida hen,” tin ataotai.
en_web: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
en_kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not that I will, but what thou wilt.

tcz: Chujouvin ahungdohle khatteho chu ana imutlhuh-u ahung toh'in, Peter jah-a, “Simon, na-imut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga umjoulou nahim?
en_web: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
en_kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung phat’in khatte ho a-ihmut lhuh-u atoh khan, Peter jah a, “Simon, na-ihmut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga umjou lou nahim?

tcz: Lhepna-a nalhahlouna dingun, kigingun, taovun ijeh-inem iti leh lhagaovin agonan, tahsan ajolou ahi,” ati.
en_web: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
en_kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhepna nalhah louna diuvin kigingin tao jingun. Lhagaovin ago lheh nan, tahsa alhasame, “ati.

tcz: Chuin amaho adalhan, ache kit'in atao ngai bangin agatao kittai.
en_web: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
en_kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
tcz_gospelgo: Achedoh kit’in asei ngai bang seiyin agataove.

tcz: Chuin ahung kile kit'in ahile amaho chu ana-imut'u ahung toh kit'in, aimutso behseh jeh-un adonbutje ahepouve.
en_web: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
en_kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin ahungkit leh a-ihmut lhuh-u ahung toh khan, mit phah chet’a anaum jeh-un adonbutje jong ahetapouve.

tcz: Athumvei channa-a ahung kile kit chun ajah uva, “Tun i-mu uvin lang kithaol tauvin. Aphasettai, phat alhingtai. Hinla—veuvin, Mihem Chapa hi michonsete khut'a kipedoh ahitai.
en_web: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
en_kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
tcz_gospelgo: Thumvei channa ahung chun ajah-uvah, “Ihmua kicholdo nalai nahiu ong? Aphasettai! Nidan alhinge! Mihem Chapa hi michonsete khut’a pehdoh a um ahitai.

tcz: Kipat'un, chetauhite. Veuvin, eipedohpa hiakhun aumtai!” ati.
en_web: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
en_kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipat’un chetaute. Ven, eipedoh pan eihin phatauve,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hichu asei jou jouvin, hetman louvin, Judas, aseijuiho lah'a khat, chu mihonpi moltum le chemjam kichoi puma hungho toh ahung kilhon khom'in ahi. Amaho chu thempu pipui holeh hou lamkai hon ahinsol'u ahi.
en_web: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
en_kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thu asei nalaiyin, som le nil ah a khat, Judas chu Thempu pipu ho le Danthu themhoa kona, chemjam le moltum thoa hung miho chutoh ahung paitai.

tcz: Ajohdoh-a pangpa, Juda Iscariot chun melchihna ahil masan, “Namat diu chu chibai kaboh-a kachop penpen chu hiding ahi. Ama chu puimang un,” ati.
en_web: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
en_kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
tcz_gospelgo: Apedoh pan miho melchihna ahil masan, “kachop pen pen chu Ama ahi, manun lang kitup keichan kai mang tauvin,” ati.

tcz: Ahung lhun lhun'un Juda chu Yeshua hengah achen, “Houhil!” tin chibai bohnan achoptai.
en_web: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
en_kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Judas ahung lhunin Jesu ajon paiyin, “Rabbi,” tin achoptai.

tcz: Chuin akhut alhauvin Yeshua amantauvin ahi.
en_web: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
en_kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon achung’ah khut alhauvin amantauve.

tcz: Yeshua nungjuiho lah'a mi khat'in achemjam asatdohin thempu chungnung sohpa asat leh abilkol langkhat asatlhan ahi.
en_web: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
en_kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
tcz_gospelgo: Akoma ding ho khat chun chemjam asatdoh-in Thempulen sohpa asat jeng leh abilkol asat lhai.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Galguh bolho mandinga kon banga moltumle chemjam thoa keiman dinga nahung uham?
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah-uvah, “Gucha michom man ding banga, Kei man dia chemjam le moltum thoa hungkon nahiu ong?

tcz: Houin sunga kaum laiya ibola neimatlou uham? Niseh leh nalah'uva thujong kanahil jinge. Ahinlah Thubua thukiseisa aguilhunna dinga hitia hi thilsoh vang ahinai,” ati.
en_web: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
en_kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh a Houina thu kahil chunla neiman pouvin. Ama vang Pathen lekhabua kiseisa thu guilhung hiya hi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin aseijuite jouse akithecheh-un, ajamgam tauve.
en_web: They all left him, and fled.
en_kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in aloiten adalhauvin ajamtauve.

tcz: Alah'uva gollhang khat asangkhol tupat ponnem khatseh kiah aumin, ama chu ahungkon hon amat'ule,
en_web: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
en_kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
tcz_gospelgo: Tupat ponnem khatseh sil gollhang khat jesu nungjui ahin, ama hi amat’u leh,

tcz: Aman apon-ah chu akhut'uva adalhan, asagohkeovin ajam mangtai.
en_web: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
en_kjv: and he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
tcz_gospelgo: tupat ponnem chu dalhan asagoh keovin ajam mangtai.

tcz: Amahon Yeshua chu thempu chungnung hengah akaiyun, chua chun thempu pipui chengse le vaipo upa ho chule danthusunho ahung kikhomun ahi.
en_web: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
en_kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu Thempulen henga apuiyun, Thempu pipu ho le upa ho chule Danthu them chengse akikhomsohkeiyui.

tcz: Peter in galkangin ahin juipeh-in chule jangpet'in thempu chungnung inpi leitol sungnung geiyin ajuilutpeh in chua chun sottolleho lah'a atouve.
en_web: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
en_kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin galkanga ajuipeh-in Thempulen leltol geiyon ajui luttai. Chuin lhacha ho to atoukhomin mei a-oiye.

tcz: Asunglamah, thempu pipui holeh houlamkaiho chengsen Yeshua tha theinadia hehsetna le themmo channa ding pansattheina ding ahol un ahivanginla amupouvin ahi.
en_web: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
en_kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempupipu hole Hou vaipoloise sen Jesu thana thei hehsetna hettohsah ahol’un amu joupouve.

tcz: Jouthu tamtah'in ahehseuvin, ahinlah akitoh tapouvin ahi.
en_web: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
en_kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mitampin Jesu hehsetna hettohsah asei vangun, akitoh hih-ui.

tcz: Akhonna-in, mi phabep akipatdoh'un,
en_web: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
en_kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin miphabep adingdohun jouthun ahehseuvin,

tcz: “Amaa kon'a kajah-u chu: khut'a kisa hiche houinthenghi suse-ingting, nithum jouleh khut'a sahlou achom dang khat katundoh ding ahi,” ati-e tin ahin hehse tauvin ahi.
en_web: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
en_kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
tcz_gospelgo: “Amahin, ‘Hiche khut’a kisa Houin hi suseng ting, nithum sunga khut’a sah lou achom khat katundoh ding ahi,’ tia asei kajaove,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Ahivanginla hichea jongchun athuseiyu akitoh kitpouvin ahi.
en_web: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
en_kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea jong hin akitoh kit pouve.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung chu mipi masanga adingdoh in, Yeshua thudoh abolin, “Hitehon nahehnau thu aseiyuhi nadonbut lou dingham?” ati.
en_web: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
en_kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Thempulen chu alah-uva adingdoh-in Jesu adongin, “nadonbut lou ding ham? Hite hon nahehset nau hi ipiba ham?” atileh;

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan donbut louvin thipbeh'in aumin, chuin thempu chungnungin adongin, “Nangma Nunnom Chapa, Messiah chu nahim?” atitai.
en_web: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
en_kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu athip behin, adonbut poi. Thempulen chun adong kit’in ajah a, “Nangma nun nom Chapa, Messiah chu nahim?” atileh;

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kahi,” atin, chuleh, “Nanghon Mihem Chapa hi thuneina mun'a Pathen jetlam'a atouva chule van meilah-a ahung namu dingu ahinalaiye,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Kahi; Nang hon Mihem Chapa chu Tha neipen jet lama touva, Vanlaijol meilom lah a hung namu diu ahina laiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Thempu chungnung chun alunghan vetsahnan aponsil abotkeh-in, “Hettohsahna ipi iholbe nahlai dingu ham?
en_web: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
en_kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Thempulen chun athemputna sangkhol abot eh-in, “Hettohsah dang iding ititah diu ham?

tcz: Pathen ataitomna thu naja tauve. Nanghon iti nagel um?” atileh abonchauvin asam'un, “Athidinga lom ahi!” tin aeo lahlah jengun ahi.
en_web: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
en_kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ataitom na naja cheh tauve. I-lo ding natiuvam?” atileh; abonchauvin athi dia lomin athemmosah tauve.

tcz: Mi abangkhat'in achil asetkhum'un chule amit akanpeh-un, akhutnun achumun, “Gaothu neiseipeh-un,” tin eltolin ahouvun, angeiphe abengun apuimang tauve.
en_web: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
en_kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Abangin chil asset khumin, chuin amai atomun avouvin, ajah-ah, “Gaovin,” atiuvin; chuin lhachahon amanun angeiphe abengun, hiti hin abolpan tauve.

tcz: Hichepet'a chu Peter noilama leitola uma ahin, thempu chungnung ole numei khat ahungin ahile,
en_web: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
en_kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
tcz_gospelgo: Peter noiolam leitol’ah aum nalaiyin, Thempulen soh nu-ngah khat ahungin

tcz: Peter in mei aoi chu amun, amanu chun aven ajah a, “Nang jong Nazareth Yeshua toh kiloi nahi,” ati.
en_web: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
en_kjv: and when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
tcz_gospelgo: Peter mei oi chu amui. Peter aven, “Nang hi Nazareth Jesu toh kiloisa nahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahinlah Peter in, “Nasei chu kahehih hel'e,” tin adonbut'in, leitol maiya apotdohleh ahchal akhongtai.
en_web: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
en_kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin aseilep tan, “Kahepoi, ipi nasei ham kahe chenpoi,” atin, leitol maiya apotdoh le ah akhongtai.

tcz: Chuin sohnu chun amun akoma dingho jah-a, “Hichepa hi amaho lah'a khat ahi!” atikit e.
en_web: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
en_kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh nu-ngah chun amudohin avel’a ding ho jah din, “Hichepa vang hi amaho loi khat ahi,” ati pan kitai.

tcz: Ahinlah Peter akilepkittai. Chomkhat jouvin, akoma dingho chun, “Amaho lah'a khat mong mong nahi, ajehchu Galilee mi nahi-e,” atikit tauvin ahi.
en_web: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
en_kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
tcz_gospelgo: Paterin aseilep kit’e. Chomkhat jouvin akoma ding hon Peter jah a, “Nang hi amaho loi khat mong mong nahibouve, ajehchu Galilee gam mi nahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahivangin aman, “Kajou kasei leh gaosap chang inge—naseipau hi kahekha hihbeh-e!” atijeng tai.
en_web: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
en_kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Peterin kigaosap le kihahsel athopanin, “naseipau hi kahekhpaoi,” ati.

tcz: Chujou jouvin aniveina'in ah ahung khong paitan ahi. Chutah chun, Yeshua thusei: Ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati chu ageldoh tan, hakan akaptan ahi.
en_web: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
en_kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in ah lailha akhongpaitai. Hichun Peterin, “Ah nivei akhon kah a thumvei neisilep ding ahi,” tia Jesun asei chu agel doh-in alungna behseh-in hakan akaptai.

tcz: Chuin jingpi tah'in thempu pipuho, vaipo upa ho, danthusunho, chule hou vaipoloi chengse akihoupaiyun, Yeshua chu akan'un, akaiyun Pilate khut'ah apedoh tauve.
en_web: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
en_kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
tcz_gospelgo: Jingpi tah-in Thempuho le upaho, Ddanthu them ho le Hou vaipolai chengse akihoutoh paiyun, Jesu akan’un Pilate henga akaitauve.

tcz: Pilate in Yeshua adong in, “Nangma Judate Lengpa nahim?” ati leh, Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei chu adih-e,” ati.
en_web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
en_kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chun Jesu adongin, “Judate lengpa nahim?” atileh; Aman adonbut’in ajah a, ‘Nangsei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin thempu pipuihon thu tamtah'in ahehse tauvin ahi.
en_web: The chief priests accused him of many things.
en_kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu pipuhon jong thu tampin ahehse se jengui.

tcz: Pilate in adong kit'in, “Amaho hi nadonbutlou ding ham? Vetang thu hijat'a nahin heh-uhi?” Yeshuan adonbutlou beh phat'in Pilate in adatmo lheh jenge.
en_web: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
en_kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chun adong kit’in, “Nadonbut lou ding ham? Ven, nahehset set jengu khu?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut lou phat in, Pilate in adatmo lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
en_kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut louhel phat’in Pilate’n adatmo lheh jenge.

tcz: Vaipopa chena-ngai dol'a kumseh a Kut sungse leh, sohchang ho lah-a amipin athum pen penkhat chu alhadohpeh ji ahi.
en_web: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
en_kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
tcz_gospelgo: Kut sunga mihon athumpen pen sohchang khat Pilate’n alhadoh pehji ahi.

tcz: Chulai chun songkul'ah Barabbas atiu gamsung chohnoh-bol le tolthat khat aumin ahi.
en_web: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
en_kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
tcz_gospelgo: Kivaipoh deimoa galbol mithah ho toh songkul’a kihentha amin Barabbas kiti anaume.

tcz: Mihonpi chu Pilate henga acheuvin, angaina banga songkultang khat lhadoh din agaseiyui.
en_web: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
en_kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi akitol touvun Pilate’n sohchang alhadohpeh nagi banga bolpeh din angeh pantauve.

tcz: Chuin Pilate in, “Judate lengpa hi lhadohpeh leuveng nadeiyum?” tin asei tai.
en_web: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
en_kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’n adonbut’in ajah-uva “Judate lengpa hi lhadoh peh leng nadeiyum?” ati.

tcz: Ama chun thempu pipuihon thangset man'a apehdoh-u ahi ti chu ahet ahi.
en_web: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
en_kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Thempu pipuhon thangset suma apehdoh-u ahet ahi.

tcz: Ahivang'in thempu pipuihon Barabbas joh chu lhadohna dingin mipi chu atilseuvin ahi.
en_web: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
en_kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Thempu pipuhon Barabbas joh alhadoh pehna diuvin mipi atilseuve.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in ajah uva, “Achutileh Judah te Lengpa natipau hi i-kalo ding bahitam?” ati.
en_web: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
en_kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chun adonbut kit’in ajah-uva, “Acutile Juddate lengpa ahi natipau hi i-kalo ding ba ham?” atileh;

tcz: Chuin amahon asamkit'un, “Thingpela khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
en_web: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
en_kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asamtauve.

tcz: “Ijeh-inem? Ipi abolset em?” tia Pilate in asei vang'in, mipi chun ahasap cheh-un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
en_web: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
en_kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pilate’n ajah-uvah “Ib0l-inem? Ipi suhset aneiyem?” atileh; amahon, “Thingpel’a khen beh-in!” tin ahasap cheh tauve.

tcz: Mipite lunglhaina dingin Barabbas alhadoh-in, Yeshua chu ajep jouvun thingpela khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi.
en_web: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
en_kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi along lhaisah nom jeh-in Pilaate’n Barabbas alhadoh peh-in, Jesu joh chu ajep jouvin thingpel’a khetbeh din apedohtai.

tcz: Chuin hemchoi (Sepai) sottol hon Ama chu Praetorium atiu, vaipo inpi sunga chun akailut'un, sepai jouse akoukhom sohkeiyun ahi.
en_web: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
en_kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Pretorium; and they call together the whole band.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepaihon Jesu chu gamvaipopa inpi thutanna lhong laiya akailut’un, sepia hon pumpi akoukhom tauve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, leng-lukhuh tobanga linga kiphan chu akhuhpeh-ui.
en_web: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
en_kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Jesu chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, ling lukhuh apheh’un akhuh peh-uvin,

tcz: Chuin, “Judah te Lengpa, choianun!” tin, totnopnan chibai aboh-un ahi.
en_web: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
en_kjv: and began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: salam abol’un, “Hingsot’in Judate lengpa!” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin amaho chun peng tenggolin alu avo avouvin, chule achil asetkhum'un, totnopnan adilsu uvin chibai aboh-ui.
en_web: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
en_kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
tcz_gospelgo: peng tenggol khat’in alu avouvin, chil asset khum’ui; a-anga dilsun akun’uve.

tcz: Achainan ael-ela totnopna'a aboljouvun aponsan chu ahoh lhauvin, ama pon ale silpeh-un thingpela khetbeh dingin apuiphei tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
en_kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
tcz_gospelgo: A-el el-a tot nopna anei jouvun ponsandup chu ahoh lhauvin Ama pon asilpeh tauve.

tcz: Cyrene kiti gam kochong langa pat hungkon, Simon kitipa chutoh amaho chu lamkah-a akitohpa uvin, hichun ama chu achamlouvin Yeshuan ahinput thingpel chu aputsah-un ahi. (Simon hi Alexander le Rufus penna pa ahi.)
en_web: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.
en_kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
tcz_gospelgo: Loujaova kona hintoh kha, Cyrene gam mi, Alexander lle Rufus pa, simon chu sepaihon acham louvin aman’un Jesu thingpel aputsah-ui.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu lugu-mun atiu Golgotha mun'achun alhut tauvin ahi.
en_web: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
en_kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu “Lugu mun” Kiti Golgotha alhut tauve.

tcz: Chuah myrrh toh kihal lengpitwi apeuvin ahile Ama anompoi.
en_web: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
en_kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
tcz_gospelgo: Myrrh le lengpitwi kihal apeh vangun Jesun adonpoi.

tcz: Chuin thingpel'a akhenbeh-un, aponsil chu avangpha pha chang hen tin vang asangtauve.
en_web: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
en_kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun thingpel’a akhenbeh-un aponsil jouse chu koi ipi chang dingahmtin vang asanun akihomtauve.

tcz: Yeshua akhetbeh-u chun jingvai nidan ko ahitan ahi.
en_web: It was the third hour when they crucified him.
en_kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingpel’a Jesu akhetbeh nau chu jingkah lam nidan ko ahi.

tcz: Achunga chun ahehnau hetnan, “Judate Lengpa” tia kisun chu atah-un ahi.
en_web: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
en_kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
tcz_gospelgo: Achung thu hehsetna kisun chu, “Judate lengpa,” tia kijih ahi.

tcz: Ama toh gamsunga chohnohbol mi ni, khat aveilamah, khat ajetlamah akhenbeh-un ahi.
en_web: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
en_kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
tcz_gospelgo: Gucha hi, Jesu jet le veiya akhetbeh thauve.

tcz: “Ama michonse chochibol-ho toh akisimtha tai,” tia Lekhabua kisun chu aguilhungtan ahi.
en_web: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
en_kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
tcz_gospelgo: (Hichea hin, “Aman Dan sukeh ho toh akisim thatai,” tia kisei Pathen lekhabu thuchu aguilhung tai.)

tcz: Chuin achele avahle ho jousen akhasuh khumun, “Katei! Nangin houin kasuhchima nithum nileh kasahdoh kit ding ahi natin, tuchun kivet in.
en_web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
en_kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajotpa jousen akhasuh khumun, a-engkal nan, ‘Kadah, Houin susea nithum sunga tungdoh ding pa,

tcz: Nangma kihuhhing inlang thingpel'a kon chun hung kumlha tangem!” atiuvin ael-elin ahouvun ahi.
en_web: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
en_kjv: save thyself, and come down from the cross.
tcz_gospelgo: kihuhhingin lang thongpel chunga koin hung kumlha tang-em!” atiuve.

tcz: Chutobangma chun thempu pipui hole danthusunhon jong abol ui. “Aman midang ahuhhingin, Ama akihuhhing theipoi!
en_web: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
en_kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin Thempu pipu ho le Danthu themhon kidai naa aneiyun, “Midang la ahuhingnan, Ama akihuhing joupoi,

tcz: Kamu'uva kahettheina dingun Israelte lengpa chu tutah hin thingpel chunga kon'in hung kumlha hen!” atiuvin totnopnan abol'un ahi. Ama toh kikhet behtha teni jong chun hitichun asei lhon e.
en_web: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
en_kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kamu’uva katahsan theina diiuvin Israel lengpa Messiah chu tutah hin thingpel chunga konin hung kumlhan tem hen,” atiuve. Ama toh thingpel’a kikhetbeh tha te ni geiyin ahouse lhontai.

tcz: Chuin sunkim velhin gam jouseah nidan thum chan mu athimtan ahi.
en_web: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
en_kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Nidan som le ni sunkima pat nilhah nidan thum geiyin leiset pumpi chunga mu athimtai.

tcz: Hichun nidan thum dontah'in Yeshua hapen in apengin, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabach thani?” atitai. Hichu: “Ka-Pathen, ka-Pathen, ibola neidalhah hitam?” atina ahi.
en_web: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
en_kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah nida thum chun Jesu hapenin apengin, “Ka-Pathen, Ka-Pathen, ibol’a neilha hitam?” tinan “Eloi, Eloi lema sabachthni?” atileh;

tcz: Avel'a umho phabep chun Elijah akou hinte atiuve.
en_web: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
en_kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
tcz_gospelgo: akoma ding ho phabep’in ajauvin, “ven, Elijah akouve,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun mi khat alhaijelin, lengpitwi thuh-a twichop phon adelhop in, adontheina din peng tenggol leh chu ajah-in, amapa chun, “Khongaiyutin, Elijah ahung huhdoh-em veuhite!” ati.
en_web: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
en_kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mikhat alhaijel’in lengpitwi thuh lah a twichoppon ase-lhop’in, peng tenggol leh a atah-in adon din agah pen, ‘Limsah hih-un, adomlha dia Elijah hung nam veu hite,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kithongtah'in ahung peng kit'in ahai atantai.
en_web: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
en_kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesu hapenin apengin atantai.

tcz: Hichun Houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoilam geiyin aehlha paiyin, kehni akisotan ahi.
en_web: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
en_kjv: And the vail of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Houin pondal len chu ahunga pat anoi geiyin kehni akison, a-eh lhangtai.

tcz: Chule Rome sepai jalamkai khat'in thilsoh ijakai amu jouvin, “Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahimonge!” tin aphongdoh jeng tai.
en_web: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
en_kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Akoma ding sepia jalamkaipan hitobanga athi amun, “Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa mong mong ah!” tin aseitai.

tcz: Numei phabep chun thilsoh chu gal'a konin ahin galdot ui. Amaho lah'a chun Mary Magdalene toh Mary (James le Joseph dinga anu) chule Salome jong apangun ahi.
en_web: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
en_kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
tcz_gospelgo: Numei phabep’in jong galkanga pat’in aven, alah-uva Magdalene Mary le Jacob neojo le Joseph nu Mary, chule Salome apangin,

en_web: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Galilee gama alenlaiya juilea alhacha ho ahiuve; Chule numei dang tampi Jesun Jerusalema ahin lhontoupi hojong ahiuve.

tcz: Hichengse hi Cholngahni masang Kiginnia soh ahi. Chuin nilhahlam ahung hitan,

en_web: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
en_kjv: Joseph of Arimathea, an honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Arimathea khoa vaipo gin le ja umtah, Pathen lenggam ngah jinga um Joseph chu achen, Pilate henga ngampel’in alut’in Jesu long chu agathume.

tcz: Pilate in Yeshua chutia athiloi jeng ding chu atahsanpon, hijeh chun Rome sepai jalamkaipa chu akouvin Yeshua athi tahbeh hitam tin adongin ahi.
en_web: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
en_kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Athivah jeng chu Pilatein kidang asan, sepia jalam kai chu akouvin, athina sottam tin adonge.

tcz: Chuin Rome sepai jalamkaipan athi chu aphotchen phatnin along chu Arimathea Joseph koma apedohtai.
en_web: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
en_kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai jalamkaipaa kona het chet phat’in Pilatein Jesu long chu Joseph apetai.

tcz: Chuin Joseph chun along chu alalhan, tupat ponnem achon, hichun atomin, songpi kivut-hom lhan sungah chun alupsahtai. Chujouvin lhankot'a chun songlen khat atanglut'in, lhan chu asinnan ahi.
en_web: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
en_kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
tcz_gospelgo: Josephin tupat ponnem khat achon, Jesu long chu adom lhan, atomin songlhan kilao dsunga chun alupsah-in, lhankot achun song khat atang lut’in asingtai.

tcz: Chule Mary Magdalene toh Mary (James nu) chun Yeshua longdamsa akoinau chu avelhi jing lhon in ahi.
en_web: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
en_kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
tcz_gospelgo: Magdalene Mary le Joseph nu Mary Jesu alupsahna chu avelhi jinglhone.

tcz: Chuin Cholngahni nilhah ahung hia, cholngah nit akichai jouvin, Mary Magdalene, James nu Mary, chule Salome chu apotdoh'un thaonamtui gachoh-a Yeshua tahsaa nu ding in akigong uve.
en_web: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
en_kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo ni akichai phat’in Magdalene Mary l eJacob nu Mary chule Salome hicheng hi chea Jesu long nu nam din lou namtui achouve.

tcz: Hapta nimasapen jingpi matah niso kon vel in, amaho lhan lama chun agacheuvin ahi.
en_web: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
en_kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
tcz_gospelgo: Hapta ni masa ni, jingpi matah, nisa so-thin thenin numeiho chu lhan phung’ah ahungui.

tcz: Lampiah amaho akihouvun, “Lhankot song chu kon eitahdohpeh tauvintem?” aki tiuvin ahi.
en_web: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
en_kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
tcz_gospelgo: Numei ho chun, “Lhankot sin song kon eitahdoh peh diu ham?” tin akihouvun ahi.

tcz: Chuin ahung lhun phat'un avet uleh song chu tahdohsa'a anaum chu amutauve. Asong chu lenpitah ahi.
en_web: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
en_kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
tcz_gospelgo: Song chu lentah ahin, agah vet’u leh tahsohsan aumtai.

tcz: Hichun lhan sunga chu alut'ule gollhang khat ponbangleh kisil'a jetlam'a tou amu'uvin chuin amaho chu atijalheh jengun ahi.
en_web: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
en_kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhan sung a agalut’u leh ponbang sil’a gollhang khat jet lama anatouvin, akinlih deh jenguve.

tcz: Ahivangin vantil chun amaho jah-ah, “Nangho tijahih'un, nanghon thingpela kithat Nazareth Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi. Ama hikoma aumtapoi! Ama thinaa konin athoudohtai! Hungun, hung veuvin, hilai hi alonglupna chu ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
en_kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chun ajah-uvah, “Kicha hin-un, thingpel’a kithahsa Nazareth Jesu nahol’u ahin, Ama athoudoh-in hikom’ah aumtapoi. Ven, hikoma hi alupsah-u ahi.

tcz: Tun cheuvinlang Peter le aloiho komah Aman athi masanga anasei bang chun Galilee gam'a namasanguvah anache masatai, chua chu Ama namu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
en_web: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
en_kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule kile kit’un langa aseijuite le Peter jah a, “Ama nang ho sangin Galilee gam alhung masatai. Najah-uva aseisa banga chua Ama namu diu ahi,’ tin gaseipeh-un ati.

tcz: Numeiho chu atijauvin, kihot pumin lhan'a konin ahung potdoh'un, akichat behseh jeh-un imasei je jong ahepouve. Chuin amahon agan'a gangin seijuiho—Peter le aloiho komah agaseipeh tauvin ahi.
en_web: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
en_kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho lhana konin ahung potdoh-un helouvin ajamtauve. Atijat behseh jeh-un koima imacha aseipeh pouvin ahi.

tcz: Hapta nimasapen jingkah-a Yeshua athodohkit jouva akimutopi masatpen chu Mary Magdalene, asunga thilha sagi anodohpeh nu chu ahi.
en_web: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
en_kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Hapta ni-masapen ni, jingpia athodoh jouvin masanga asunga thilha sagi anodohnanu Magdalene Mary henga Jesu akilah masapen’e. “Numeihon gollhangpa sei chengse chu Peter le aloite akaigop’in aseipeh-ui.

tcz: Amanu chun seijui lunghemtah'a anaumho jah'a chun thilsoh umdolho chu agaseipeh tai.
en_web: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
en_kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu achen Jesu kiloipisa, ahijeh a lunghema kapte ho agaseipeh-e. Khonungin Jesun amaho amang chan atheng le suhmang theilou huhhing thu chu solama pat lhumlam geiyin athutsah tai, Amen!”

tcz: Ahivangin amahon athusei chu atahsanpouvin ahi.
en_web: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
en_kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Jesu ahindoh a Mary akimusah ajah vangun atahsan pouve.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin lim chombeh-in aseijuiteni Jerusalema kipan'a thinglhang lama cheteni komah akilah-in ahi.
en_web: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
en_kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin Jesun alah-uva mi ni gamlang jon’a ache na lhona lim chombeh pun akimusah-in ahi.

tcz: Amani achelhon in seijui dangho jah-a agasei lhon leh amahon atahsandeh pouve.
en_web: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
en_kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amani chea adang ho agaseipeh lhon vangin, amani thusei geiyin atahsan deh pouve.

tcz: Chuin ankong aum laitah'un seijui somlekhat-ho hengah Yeshua akilah-in athodohkit nunga amuho thusei atahsanlou jeh-u le alungtah jeh-un asosalin ahi.
en_web: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
en_kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin som le khat’in ankong aum laitah-un Jesu ahenguva akilah-in, athodoh jouva amuho thusei atahsan loujeh-u leh alungtah jeh-un aphoh-in ahousal’e.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Nangho vannoi leiset gamjouseah cheuvin lang thilsem mihem namtin jah-a hiche Kipana Thuphahi gahil lhang leuvin.
en_web: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah-uva, “Vannoi gamtin’a cheuvin, Kipana Thupha gaseiphongun.

tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan baptize chang jouse huhhinga um ding, atahsan lou vang chu them changa kikoi ding ahi.

en_kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsante chu melchihna hicheng hin ajuiya; Keima min a thilha anodoh diu, paochom chom athouva,

en_web: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
en_kjv: they shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
tcz_gospelgo: khut’a gulte adop sang diu; thina thei gutwi don jong leu imatilou diu ahi; ana dammo chunga khup angap’u leh dam ding ahi,” ati.

en_web: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
en_kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesun ajah-uva thu asei chai phat’in van’a lah touvin aumtan, Pathen jet lama atoutai.

tcz: Chuin amaho achedoh'un muntin'ah ahillhangleuvin anatohna chan'uvah Pakaiyin akithopiuvin, chule melchih nain ajuisah-in athuseiyu chu aphudetpeh-in ahi.
en_web: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
en_kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho vang chu acheuvin muntin’a alhangsam leuvin, athuseiyu chu Pakaiyin akithopin, melchihna tampin aphu det peh-e.

tcz: Mi tampin eiho lah'a ana guilhung thilsoh ho chungchang sutdoh agouvin ahi.
en_web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
en_kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
tcz_gospelgo: I-lah-uva hung guilhung chengse sutdohna mi tamtah-in abol pan banguvin,

en_kjv: even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
tcz_gospelgo: athilsoh kipat’a pat amit tah a mua athu lhachaa pang hon eihil bangun,

en_web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
en_kjv: it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
tcz_gospelgo: michungnung Theophilus, thilsoh ho hi ken jong kahet themsa banga ban neicha le kitoh tah a hinsut doh peh ding kaseiye;

tcz: chutia chu thutah nana kihil jouse chu ahimong nai ti nanop nading ahi.
en_web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
en_kjv: that thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
tcz_gospelgo: chutileh nakiseipehsa thilsoh ho hi nahet chet thei ding ahi.

tcz: Judea gam'a Herod leng ahi laiyin, Zechariah kiti Judah thempu khat ana um'in ahi. Ama chu Abijah thempu loi lah'a khat ahin chule a'inneipi Elizabeth jong chu Aaron thempu khailhah'a kon ahi.
en_web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
en_kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Judea gama Herod lengpa vaipoh laiyin Abijah themput dol’a thempu, Zechariah kiti khat aume. Ajinu chu Aaron chilhah ahin, amin Elizabeth akiti.

tcz: Zechariah le Elizabeth chu Pathen mitmun achonpha lhon'in, Pakai dan thupeh le chon na dan jouse chingthei tah'a jui ahilhon'e.
en_web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
en_kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
tcz_gospelgo: Anupa lhonin Pathen vet dia midih gel, nolnabeiya Pakai thupeh jouse le chondan chengse nit bukimsoh ahilhone.

tcz: Elizabeth in nao avop theilou jeh chun cha aneilhon pon, chule ani lhon'in hateh'in ateh gel lhon tai.
en_web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
en_kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
tcz_gospelgo: Elizabeth achinjeh-in cha vang anei lhonpon, teh la atehse lheh lhontai.

tcz: Nikhat Zechariah chun Hou'in sungah Pathen kin abolin, ajeh chu chuche hapta sunga chu mopohna chang ahi.
en_web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chon ngaiya Zechariah loiho panna ding nikhon, Pakai Houin thenga lut’a gimnamtui lhutnam na dia
