en_kjv: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: vang kisan chu Zechariah chunga achuh khah jeh-in aman Pathen angsunga themput kin anabol’in ahi.

tcz: Thil namtui akihal jing laiyin, mipi tamtah pamlangah ading'un taona amang uve.
en_web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
en_kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
tcz_gospelgo: Gimnamtui kilhutnam laisen mipi polama adingun ataovui.

tcz: Zechariah muntheng sunga aumpet in Pakai vantil khat ahengah ahung kilah in, maicham phung jetlam a chun adingin ahi.
en_web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
en_kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Zechariah henga Vantil khat ahung kilah-in, gimnamtui kilhut namna maicham jet lama chun ahung dinge.

tcz: Zechariah in hichu amuphat in akithing'in hatah in akicha tan ahi.
en_web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
en_kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil amu phat’in Zechariah alungkhamin kijong akichai.

tcz: Ahivangin vantil chun aseiyin, “Kicha hih'in Zechariah! Pathen in nataona asangtai. Na inneipi Elizabeth in chapa khat nahinpeh ding, chule amin John nasah ding ahi.
en_web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
en_kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Vantil chun ajah a, Zechariah, kicha hih-in, nataona akisangin, najinu Elizabeth in chapa khat ahin’a, amin John nasah ding ahi;

tcz: Nangman kipana lentah nanei ding, chule mi tampi ama pen a kipah ding ahi,
en_web: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
en_kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
tcz_gospelgo: kipah thanom lheh in natin, chule ama penjal’a mitampi kipah diu ahi.

tcz: ijeh inem itile ama chu Pakai mitmua hung len ding. Aman ju kiti le khamna thei thil kiti atohkhah thei lou ding. Ama chu apen masang jenga jong Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi.
en_web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
en_kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu ama hi Pakai mitmua nasatah hiya, lengpitwi hihen khamna thei ju hijong leh adon louhel ding, apenlhah a pat Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi.

tcz: Chule aman Israel mi tamtah Pakai a-Pathen'u henga alehei ding ahi.
en_web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
en_kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Israelte tamtah Pakai a-Pathenu henga alepui lut kit ding ahi.

tcz: Ama chun Elijah lhagao le thahat aken ding ahi. Aman mipiho chu Pakai hung na dinga agontup ding ahi. Mipa te lung achate chunga aheiya chule doudal lungput neiho michonphaho chihna akisan sah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
en_kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Elijah Themgao Lhagao le thahat aken’a, Pathen sol lea panga, mipate lunggel chate lama aheidoh a, thua nung loute chihna thudih agelsah-a Pakai dia miho kigosadema akoipeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Zechariah chun vantil jah'a aseiyin, “Hitobang hi aso ding ken iti kahet thei ding ham? Tun keima kateh tan, chule ka inneipi jong kum tamtah alhing tai,” tin adong tai.
en_web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
en_kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
tcz_gospelgo: Zechariah chun Vantil jah a, “Keila kateh lheh tan, kajinu jong tehsesa ahitan, cha kanei mong lhon ding chu iti kahet thei ding ham? atileh;

tcz: Chuin vantil chun aseiyin, “Keima Gabriel kahi! Pathen angsung tah a ding kahi. Ama ahi keima nahenga hiche kipana thupha podinga eihin sol ah;
en_web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
en_kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil’in, “Keima hi Pathen angsunga ding jing Gabriel kahin, hiche thupha hi najah a seipeh dia eihinsol ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah tun, nangman kasei natahsan pon, chujeh'a nangma nathipbeh ding chule nao apen tokah'a paothei louva naum ding ahitai. Ajeh chu kathusei chengse hi aphat cha guilhung tei ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
en_kjv: And behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, hichengse hi akitep phat cha hung guilhung tei ding ahin, kaseipeh natahsan loujeh a aguilhun nikho geiya paomoa naum ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Achutilai chun mipi hon Zechariah chu ahung potdoh ding angah jingun, ipi bol'a hibanga hi sot den hitam tin alungdong gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
en_kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin Zechariah chu a-ngah jingun, munthenga achuti sotden adatmo lheh jengui.

tcz: Achainakeiya ahung potdoh phat chun ama apaodoh thei tapon ahi. Chuin amahon amaiso le apaotheilouva kon chun Hou'in muntheng sunga chu mu anei hinte ti ahedoh un ahi.
en_web: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
en_kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahungdoh phat’in apaomo tan, muntheng sunga mu nei ahi mihon aheuvin, aman jong thilsoh umchan chu akhut’in athon, paomon aumtai.

tcz: Zechariah in Hou'in a athempu natoh hapta alhin phat in inlam'a akile tan ahi.
en_web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin thempu kin abol chaisoh phat’in Zechariah in lama ahung kile kittai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin ajinu Elizabeth chu ahung gai paiyin chule lhanga jen potdoh louvin aum thipbeh tan ahi.
en_web: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
en_kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho phabep nungin ajinu Elizabeth chun nao avop tan, lha nga sungin akiselgun, hiti hin,

tcz: “Pakai iti phat hitam!” tin aphongdoh in “Aman kacha neilou jeh'a jumna eilah mang peh tai,” ati.
en_web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
en_kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
tcz_gospelgo: “Teh nunga Pakaiyin nao eivopsah a, japi maiya kajachatna lahmang peh eigot ahi,” ati.

tcz: Elizabeth naovop kal lhagup lhin'in, Pathen in Gabriel vantil chu Galilee gam Nazareth kho ah,
en_web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
en_kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
tcz_gospelgo: Elizabeth gai kal lhagup lhin nan Vantil Gabriel chu Pathena konin Galilee gam Nazareth khoa

tcz: nungah theng Mary hengah asol'in ahi. Amanu chu Joseph kiti Leng David insung khailhah pasal khat toh kicheng dinga got'a um ahitai.
en_web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
en_kjv: to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
tcz_gospelgo: David chilhah Joseph toh kicheng dia kitepsa nu-ngah Mary henga akisol’e.

tcz: Gabriel chu amanu hengah akilah in aseitai, “Chibai, sahluttah nu! Pakaiyin naumpi,” ati.
en_web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
en_kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chu alut’in ajah a, “Nun nomin sah chungnung nu, Pakaiyin naumpi jinge!” ati.

tcz: Lungdong le lung kika lahlah pum in Mary'in vantil thusei chu ipi tina ahi agel tai.
en_web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
en_kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
tcz_gospelgo: Mary chu alung kichi-ah lah jengin, ipi thudol’a kilemna ahiding giltah-in agel’e.

tcz: “Kicha hih'in Mary,” tin vantil chun aseitan ahi, “Ajeh chu nangman Pathen lunglhaina nakimutai!”
en_web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
en_kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil’in ajah a, Mary kicha hih-in, Pathen lungdei namui.

tcz: “Nangma gaiyin natin chapa khat nahin ding chule amin Yeshua nasah ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
en_kjv: And behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
tcz_gospelgo: Na gaiya chapa khat nahin ding, amin Jesu nasah ding ahi.

tcz: Ama hung len ding chule Chungnung pen Chapa kiti ding ahi. Pakai Pathen in apu David laltouna apehding ahi.
en_web: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
en_kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thupi tah hiya Chungnungpen Chapa kitia, Pakai Pathenin apu David laltounaa atousah ding ahi.

tcz: Chule Israel chunga tonsot'a vai apoh ding, alenggam in beitih aneilou ding ahi!” ati.
en_web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
en_kjv: and he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob chihlhah te chunga lengvai pontin, alenggam chun beitih neita lou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mary'n vantil chu adongin, “Hinlah, hichu iti hithei ding ham? Keima nungah theng kahi,” ati.
en_web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
en_kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Maryn Vantil jah a chun, “Iti cha kanei thei ding ham, keila pasalto kakitimat khapon?” atileh;

tcz: Vantil chun adonbut in, “Lhagao Theng nachunga hung chu ding, chule chungnung pen thanei na in nalekhu ding ahi. Hijeh a chu naosen apeng ding chu atheng hiding chule ama chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi.
en_web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
en_kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil’in ajah a, Lhagao Theng nachunga hung chun tin, Chungnungpen tha neinan nahinlekhu ding, hijeh a hi apeng ding naosen theng chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi.

tcz: Ipi aval um ding ham, nasopinu Elizabeth in jong ateh nungin nao avop tai! Mi hon aching'ah ahi atiuvin, hinlah tun chapa khat avop'in lhagup alhingtai.
en_web: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
en_kjv: And behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanulamnu Elizabeth-in jong teh nungin chapa khat avop’in, achinga kiseinu agaiyin lhagup alhingtai;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen dingin ima ahimo aumpoi” ati.
en_web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
en_kjv: For with God nothing shall be unpossible.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pathen dingin imacha ahimopoi,” ati.

tcz: Mary'n adonbut in, “Keima Pakai sohnu kahi, kachunga lhungding nasei jouse hung guilhung hen,” ati. Chuti chun vantil chun amanu chu adalhatai.
en_web: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
en_kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat-’in Mary, “Ven, Pakai nalhachanu kei, nasei bangin kachunga guilhung hen,” ati. Hichun Vantil’in Mary adalhatai.

tcz: Ni phabep jouvin Mary jong Judea gam thinglhang lang,
en_web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
en_kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelai hin Mary akipat paiyin Judea thinglhang gam khopi khat’ah thanom tah-in achei.

tcz: Zechariah chen na khoa chun acheloi chal'in ahi. Amanu insung alut in Elizabeth chu chibai aboh'e.
en_web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
en_kjv: and entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Zechariah in’a alut’in Elizabeth salam agabol’e.

tcz: Mary'n chibai aboh gin ajah chun Elizabeth naosen chu a-oisung a chun ahung kichom in, chule Elizabeth chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan ahi.
en_web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
tcz_gospelgo: Mary salam chu Elizabeth-in ajah pet tah-in aoisunga naocha akichomin, Elizabeth chu Lhagao Theng adimtai.

tcz: Elizabeth in kipanan ka cheng ahinlon Mary jah'a chun aseitai, “Pathen in numei jouse chunga phatthei naboh ahitai, chule na cha jong anunnom'e.
en_web: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
en_kjv: and she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Elizabeth chun othongin asamin, Numei jouse lah a nunnom nu, nanaobu sunga um jong anun nome!

tcz: Ipi jeh'a hibanga jana kachan a ka pakai nu in eihung vil ham?
en_web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
en_kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
tcz_gospelgo: I-atile ka-Pakai hungnu lomlom kahenga hung jeng hitam!

tcz: Nei lemna awcheng kajah chun kasunga naocha kipah in ahung kichom'e.
en_web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
en_kjv: For lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu salam thu nasei kajah jah chun ka-oisunga naocha kipah-in akichom jenge.

tcz: Anun nom nahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aseichu abol ding ahi ti natahsan e,” ati.
en_web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
en_kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahenga Pakai thusei guilhung ding tahsan nu anun nome,” ati.

tcz: Mary'n adonbut in “Kalhagao vin Pakai achoi-an e.
en_web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
en_kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Maryn aseiyin: “Kahinkhon Pakai kachoi an’in,

tcz: Kalhagao eihuhhing pu Pathen chunga iti kipah thanom hitam!
en_web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
en_kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihuhhing Pakai Pathen chunga Kalhagao akipah-e.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman asoh numei nu dinmun ave jingin, chule tua pat'a khang jousen nunnom eiti diu ahitai.
en_web: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
en_kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: For behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu alhacha nu lhasam tah eigeldoh-in, Ven, tua pat akhang khanga miten Nun Nom nua eisei diu ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Hatchungnungpa chu atheng ahi, chule aman keima din thil loupi abol'e
en_web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
en_kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; And holy is his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Hatchungnungin thil nasatah eibolpeh-in, Amin jong athenge.

tcz: Aman ahepina akhang akhang'in ama gingte amusah jinge.
en_web: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
en_kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him From generation to generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama gingte chu akhang khangin alungset jinge.

tcz: Abanthahat chun kichat um tahtah thil abol'e! Aman mikiletsah le hoitho ho athecheh ji'e.
en_web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
en_kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; He hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Aban thahat ajesal’in thanei tah-in thil abol’in, Alunggel’uva kiletsah hoithote athecheh soh tai.

tcz: Leng chapate alaltounau-vakon in aloilhan mi kineosah te adomsang ji'e.
en_web: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
en_kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, And exalted them of low degree.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaihom thanei tah ho alaltouna konin aloilhan Tahlel chagate achoisangtai.

tcz: Aman agilkel te thil pha phan avah in chule ahao te khutgoh keovin asoldoh ji'e
en_web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
en_kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; And the rich he hath sent empty away.
tcz_gospelgo: Agilkelte antui tuiyin avah van, Mihaote khutgoh keovin asolmang’e.

tcz: Aman asoh Israel akithopin khoto dingin ageldoh'e.
en_web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
en_kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, In remembrance of his mercy,
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha Israel henga akitepna, I-pu i-paute Abraham le achilhahte henga aseisa,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hiche kitepna hi iputeu, Abraham, chule achate dinga asem ahi.”
en_web: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
en_kjv: (As he spake to our fathers), To Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot kumkhoa alungset long lou chu Ageldoh jing jenge,” ati.

tcz: Mary chu Elizabeth koma lhathum tobang aum jouvin a'inlam ah akile tai.
en_web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
en_kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
tcz_gospelgo: Mary chu Elizabeth koma lha thum jen anichongin, chuin in lama akile kittai.

tcz: Elizabeth chu anaoso phat alhin phat in amanun chapa khat ahingin ahi.
en_web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
en_kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
tcz_gospelgo: Elizabeth naoso phat alhingin chapa khat ahingtai.

tcz: Chuleh aheng akom le asopi chengin Pakaiyin akhoto naho ajahdoh phat un, mijouse amanu toh akipah khom cheh tauve.
en_web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
en_kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
tcz_gospelgo: Aheng akom ho leh aphung gol hon Pakaiyin nasatah a Elizbeth alungset hi ajauvin akipapi cheh-uve.

tcz: Naosen chu niget alhin in, amaho abon'un cheptansah dingin ahung'un ahi. Amahon apa banga amin Zechariah sahding agouvin,
en_web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
tcz_gospelgo: Niget lhin nin naosen chep tan din ahungun, apa min putsah a Zechariah hisah ding agouve.

tcz: ahivangin Elizabeth in, “Ahipoi, amin John ahi,” atitai.
en_web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
en_kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla anun ajadan, “Amin John kiti ding ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: “Ipi natim?” tin amaho ahung eojah jengun “Na insung uvah hitobang min chu aum khapoi,” atiuve.
en_web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
en_kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Elizabeth jah a, “Naphung sunguva chutobang minneikha bon um louva,” atiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun naosen min chu apan ipi akisah nom am ti mit-heiyin adongun ahi.
en_web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
en_kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in mihon apan ipi asah nom chu mit heiyin adongui.

tcz: Aman lekhasutna pheng athum'in, mijouse lungdong in alhan “Amin John ahi” tin ahinjih e.
en_web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
en_kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
tcz_gospelgo: Zechariah chun asutna ding pheng khat athumin, “Amin John ahi,” tia ajih leh abonchan adatmo soh hel’uve.

tcz: Chutah chun Zechariah jong ahung paothei tan chule Pathen avahchoi pan tai.
en_web: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
en_kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet tah chun Zechariah apaodoh jeng theiyin, Pathen avahchoiye.

tcz: Akimvel'a cheng chengse din kichatna alhung tan chule Judea thinglhang gam sungse ah thilsoh umchan chu akithejal soh tai.
en_web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
en_kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea.
tcz_gospelgo: Aheng akom jouse akichauvin, hiche thusoh hi Judea thinglhang gamsung athangsoh tai.

tcz: Chuche thilsoh jajouse chun athilsoh hochu alungin aching geh'un, “Hiche chapang hi ipibep ahungsoh tadem?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
en_kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Athusoh japha chanin alungthim’ah, “Hiche naosen khu ipi hungsoh ding ham?” ati cheh-ui. Ajeh chu Pakai ban thahat’in naosen chu aumpi jinge.

tcz: Chuin apa Zechariah chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan chule hiche gaothu hi aphongdoh in ahi:
en_web: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
en_kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Naosen Pa Zechariah Lhagao Theng adimin gaothu aseitai:

tcz: Vahchoiyun Pakai, Israel Pathen chu; ajehchu aman amite avil'in alhatdoh tai
en_web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
en_kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; For he hath visited and redeemed his people,
tcz_gospelgo: “Pakai, Israel Pathen vahchoiyute, Aman amite akithopin jalenna amusah tai.

tcz: Aman huhhing hattah khat asoh David khailhah a kon in eipeuve.
en_web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
en_kjv: And hath raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of his servant David;
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha David insunga konin Huhhing hattah khat saki bangin atungdoh tai.

tcz: Athemgao thengte henga malaiya akitepna banga
en_web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
en_kjv: (As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, Which have been since the world began:)
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi masang laiya Athemgao theng ho kama aseisa ahi.

tcz: Tua eiho igalmiteu vakon le eihotbolteu va kona huhdoh a umding ihitauve.
en_web: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
en_kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, And from the hand of all that hate us;
tcz_gospelgo: Imelmateu le eihot bolteu khut’a kona Eihuhdoh jing diuva thu atepsa ahin;

tcz: Aman ipu ipateu khotonan akitepna thengho ageldoh jingin–
en_web: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
en_kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, And to remember his holy covenant;
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pu i-Pateu alungset tei tei ding, Akitepna theng suhmil lou dia aseisa ahi.

tcz: Akitepna ipuluiyu Abraham koma anakitepna bangtah in
en_web: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
en_kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pu luiyu Abraham henga kihahsel’a, Imelmateu khut’a kona eihuhdoh diu,

tcz: i-galmiteuva kon in eihuhdoh uve, Pathen kichatna beihel'a ijen thei nadiuvin
en_web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
en_kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies Might serve him without fear,
tcz_gospelgo: Gin neilouva Ama kin ibol theiyuva,

tcz: Then na le chondihna a ihin laiseuva dingin
en_web: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
en_kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, All the days of our life.
tcz_gospelgo: Ihinkho lhumkeiyuva dih tah a akin ibol diu ati ahi.

tcz: Nithum jouvin achainakeiyin Houin sungah agamudoh lhonin, houhil ho lah a atouva, athuseiyu angaiya, chule thudoh anei chu amudoh lhon tai.
en_web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
tcz_gospelgo: Nithum nungin Houin sunga agamudoh lhonin, houhite lah a anatouvin, athuseiyu angaiyin dong jong adongjie.

tcz: Ama thusei jajouse chun athuhet le athudoh donbut ho chu adatmah lheh jeng tauve.
en_web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
en_kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
tcz_gospelgo: Athusei japhan chanin achih dan le athu donbut themdol chu kidang asalheh jenguve.

tcz: Anu le apan ima lunggel je jong ahelhon tapoi. Chuin anun ahinseiyin, “Chapa,” ipijeh'a hiche hi keini koma nabol ham? Napa le keiman munjouse kahol lhon'a lunggim a kahilhon tai, ati.
en_web: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
en_kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
tcz_gospelgo: Anu le apan amudoh lhon chun adatmo lheh jeng lhonin, anun ajah a, “Naosen, idia neihitibol jeng lhon ham? Veta, napa le ken lung dong tahin kahol hol lhone,” ati.

tcz: “Ahivanga ipijeh'a neihol khoh u ngai ham?” tin adongin, “Nahet lou u ham kapa in'a kaum ding mong ahi hi?” tin adonge.
en_web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah lhona, “Idia neihol khoh lhon ham? Ka-Pa insunga kaumtei ding nahet lhon lou ham?” atipeh-e.

tcz: Ahivangin ipi aseina ahi ahedoh lhon pon ahi.
en_web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
en_kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah lhona asei chu ahedoh thei lhonpoi.

tcz: Chuin amaho chutoh Nazareth lam'a a-kile un chuva chun anu apa thunoiya aumtai. Chule anun hitiho jouse hi alungthimah aguh'in avop jing in ahi.
en_web: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
en_kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin amani toh lhonin Nazareth khoa ahungin athu thu lhonin anunge. Anun thilsoh chengse hi alung gil’in aching jinge.

tcz: Yeshua chu chihna le atahsa in akhangin chule Pathen le mihem deisah na in aumtan ahi.
en_web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
en_kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu tahsa le chih nan akhang tou touvin, Pathen le mihem deiyin aumtai.

tcz: Rome gamvaipo Tiberius vaipoh kal kum somlenga lhin kum ahitan, Pontus Pilate chu Judea gamvaipo ahin; Herod Antipas chu Galilee gam vaipo ahin; asopipa Philip chu Iturea le Traconitus gamsungsea vaipo ahin; Lysanias chu Abilene gam vaipo ahi.
en_web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
en_kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
tcz_gospelgo: Tiberius Caesar lengchan kal kum som le nga lhin chun Pontius Pilate’n Judea gam vai apon, Herod-in Galilee gambih vai apon, asopips Philip’in Iturea le Trachonnitis gambih vai apon, Lysanias chun Abilene gambih vai apon,

tcz: Annas le Caiaphas chu thempu chungnung anahilhone. Hiche phatlai hin Pathen a konin gamthip lah'a um, Zechariah chapa John hengah thu ahung lhungin ahi.
en_web: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
en_kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Annas le Caiaphas them pulenin apang lhone. Hichepat hin gamthip’a um Zechariah chapa John henga Pathenin thu ahinseitai.

tcz: Chuin John chu amun amun'ah Jordan vadung pang langto gel'ah achen, mihon alungheiyu vetsahna a baptize achan nadiuvin thu ahil lhang len chule Pathen henga ngaidam chan nadia akilehei diuvin aseiye.
en_web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
en_kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
tcz_gospelgo: John Jordan luipang gamkol’a achelen, mihon lung aheiyuva batize chang diu, chuteng achonset’u ki-ngaidam ding thu alhangsam lei.

tcz: Isaiah chun John chungchang thu anaseiyin hitin ati, “Ama hi gamthip'a khosam aw ahi, Pakai hungna ding alampi semtoh un! Ama dingin lampi sutheng un,
en_web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
en_kjv: as it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
tcz_gospelgo: Isaiah themgao lekhabua chun akisunin: “Gamthip’a khosam ogin khat’in, Pakai lampi semtoh-un lang, Alamlen semjangsen koiyun.

tcz: Phaicham lah kidip ding, chule molboh ho le thinglhang lah kinot cham ding akon ho kisujang ding, chule mun phol lah ho kisunam ding,
en_web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
en_kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
tcz_gospelgo: Damkom jouse kidip chama, Mol le lhang jouse kilai cham ding, Lamkon jouse kisujanga aboh laise jong kisunam ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng leh mijousen amuding, huhhingna Pathen'a kon hung kisol chu,” ati.
en_web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
en_kjv: and all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutengle tahsa mihing jousen Pathen huhhingna amudoh cheh diu ahi,” akiti.

tcz: Mihonpi chu John henga baptize chang dinga ahung uchun, aman hitin aseiye, “Nangho gulse son ho! Koiham Pathen lunghan na hunglhung dinga kon jamdoh dinga nagihsal uvah?
en_web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
en_kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahenga baptize chang dia hung ho jah a chun Johnin, “Vogulse son ho, ahung lhung ding lunghanna jamdohna ding thu namop’u chu koiham?

tcz: Chonset'a kon lung naheiyule Pathen lam a nakile'u chu nahin dan uva konin tahlang'un. Nanghon khat le khat komah, ‘Bitna kanei nauve, ajehchu Abraham son kahiuve’ tin moh sei hih un. Hichu imacha ahipoi, ajehchu kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen in hiche song hoa kona jong Abraham son le pah asemdoh thei ahi.
en_web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
en_kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachonset lung nakhel’u phot chet nan nachon nauvin phongun; ‘Abraham chilhah kihina chu,’ tin kisonghih-un; ajeh chu Pathenin hiche song ho hi alah a Abraham chilhah a asemdoh thei ahi.

tcz: Tu jenga jong Pathen thutanna heicha gottupsa, thingphung ajungho tutan dinga phasadem'a um ahitai. Henge, thingphung aga phalou jouse chu phuhlhuh'a uma meilah'a selut hiding ahi.” ati.
en_web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”
en_kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingphungbul tin’a heicha kiphutsoh ahitan, aga phalou thingphung jouse kiphuh lhua meilhum sunga kileh lutsoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mihonpi chun adong'un, “Ipi kabol diu hitam?” atiuve.
en_web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
en_kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin John chu adongun, “Achutile ipi kabol diu hitam?” atiuleh;

tcz: John in adonbut in, “Sangkhol ni neiyin, khat chu avaicha ho peuvin. An neh ding neiyin agilkel te jong hoppeh in,” ati.
en_web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
en_kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: aman ajah-uvah, “Sangkhol chol ni neiyan aneilou hophen anneh neiyan jong chutiman bol hen,” ati.

tcz: Lepthol'a natong kaidong ho jong baptize chang din ahung un chule adong'un, “Houhil, ipi kaboldiu hitam?” atiuve.
en_web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
en_kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
tcz_gospelgo: Kaidong ho geiyin ahenga baptize chang din ahungun ajah a, “Houhil iti kachon diu ham?” tia adoh-u leh,

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Gamsung kivaipohna in angeh kalval in kai dong hih'un,” atipeh'e.
en_web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
tcz_gospelgo: Johnin ajah-uvah, “Nakiteppeh kalval’un lah dauvin,” ati.

tcz: “Ipi kabol diu hitam” tin sepai phabep khat in jong ahung dongun ahi. John in adonbut in, “Alamlouvin sum kilah hih'un ahiloule adihlouvin mi hehset bol hih'un, chule na losan'a chun lung lhaiyun,” ati.
en_web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
en_kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepaihon jong, “Iti kachon diu ham?” tin adongun, aman ajah-uva, “Sum hihen ipi hi jongle alam louvin koima ima lahpeh dauvin, nasandoh jat jat’in lung lhaiyuvin,” ati.

tcz: Mijousen Messiah chu hungvah dinga aginchat cheh u anahin, chule John chu Messiah chu hingap hitam ti ahetnom ten'un ahi.
en_web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
en_kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin alungthimuva John akatjingu Messiah hitheiya agel laith-un,

tcz: John in athudoh uchu adonbut in hitin aseiye: “Keiman nangho twiya baptize kachansah nahiuvin, hinlah keima sanga lenjo khat ahunge–nasatah a lenjo ahidan chu keima asoh hiding le akengchot khao sutlham dingin jong kalhing joupon ahi. Amachun nangho Lhagao Theng le meiya baptize nachan sah ding'u ahi.
en_web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
en_kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
tcz_gospelgo: Johin adonbut’in ajah-uvah, “Ken twiya baptize kachansah bou nahiuvin, keisanga hatjo khat ahunge, kei hi akengchot khao sut lham dia kilom jong kahipoi, aman Lhagao Theng le meikonga baptize nachansah diu ahi.

tcz: Ama phol jap-ngimna mangcha a changsi le atah lhehkhen dinga phasadem'a um ahitai. Chuteng aman changchilna phol asuhthenga changtah chengse chu achangsal'a asun'a asi ho vang chu mit theilou meilhum sunga aselut ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
en_kjv: whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhut’a chang japna achoiyin, phol’a chang jap ngimsel’in tin, chuteng achangtah ho changsal’a akhum tup ding, asi chengse vang mit theilou meilhum sunga agovam ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: John chun kipana thupha miho koma aseiphong na achun chutobang gihsalna kamcheng jong amangchan ahi.
en_web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
en_kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Johnin tilkhouna tamtah toh thon mipi chu Kipana Thupha aseiphongpeh-e.

tcz: John in jong lhangphong tah in Galilee gam vaihompa, Herod Antipas chu, Herodius, asopipa jinu, akichenpi jeh le athilse bol adang tamtah jeh chun demna aneiyin ahi.
en_web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
en_kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
tcz_gospelgo: Gambih vaipoa pang Herod jong chu asopipa Philip jinu Herodias akichenpi jeh le thilse dang tampi aboljeh-in aphoh-e.

tcz: Hijeh chun Herod in John chu songkul'ah akhum'in, achonsetna dangtoh hiche hi akibelap tan ahi.
en_web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
en_kjv: added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Herod chun John hi songkul’a akhumin thilse khoh cheh khat abolbe kit’e.

tcz: Nikhat mihonpi chu baptize achan laiyun, Yeshua amatah jong baptize achangin ahi. Ama atao leh vanho ahung kihongin,
en_web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
en_kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
tcz_gospelgo: Miho baptize achansah phat’un Jesu jong baptize achange. Chuin atao leh van akihongin,

tcz: chule Lhagao Theng, tahsa lim pu'in van vakhu bangin ahung kumsuh in achunga chun achu'e. Van'a kon chun aw khat'in hitin ahinseiye, “Nangma kangailut tah kachapa nahi, chule kipana lentah neihin pohpeh'e,” ati.
en_web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
en_kjv: and the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao Theng tahsa vouvin vakhu bangin achunga ahung leng lhan, van’a konin ogin khat’in, “Kadeitah kachapa nahin, Nachunga kalung alhai ta-ngeiye,” ati.

tcz: Yeshua chu kum somthum alhingtai, aman japi lah'a natoh ahinpat chun. Yeshua chu Joseph chapa tin akihen ahi. Joseph chu Heli chapa ahi.
en_web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
en_kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
tcz_gospelgo: Anatoh kipat chun Jesu kum som thum bang alhintan, mingaiton ama chu Joseph chapa ahi. Joseph chu Eli chapa ahi;

en_web: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

tcz_gospelgo: Eli chu Matthat chapa ahin, Matthat chu Levi chapa ahi; Levi chu Melchi chapa ahin; Melchi chu Jannai chapa ahin, Jannai chu Joseph chapa ahin,

en_web: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

en_web: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

tcz_gospelgo: Joda chu Joanan chapa ahin; Joanan chu Rhesa chapa ahin, Rhesa chu Zerubbabel chapa ahi; Zerubbabel chu Shealtiel chapa ahin, Shealtiel chu Neri chapa ahi;

en_web: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

tcz_gospelgo: David chu Jesse chapa ahin, Jesse chu Obed chapa ahi; Obed chu Boaz chapa ahin; Boaz chu Salmon chapa ahi; Salmon chu Nahshon chapa ahin;

en_web: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
en_kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa lhumin hivei chom chom veiya damlou neihon Jesu henga ahinpuiyun, Aman achung cheh-uva khut angamin aboldamsoh keiye.

tcz: Mi tamtah chu thilhavop ahiuvin; chule thilha ho chu athupeh'a kon in ahung potdoh'un, apengjah un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahi,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin ama Messiah ahi ahetjeh'u chun, aman amaho chu aphohthip in thu aseidoh sah tapoi.
en_web: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
en_kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tamtah sunga konin thilha ho apotdoh-uvin, “Pathen Chapa nahi,” tin asamui. Jesun amaho chu haphon aphoh-in apaopoh sahpoi, ijeh-inem itile amahon Messiah ahi ahe cheh-ui.

tcz: Ajing jingkah matah in Yeshua munthip lah khat ah achedoh tan ahi. Mihonpi chun amachu muntin aholle un, achaina kheh a amu phat uvin, aman amaho adalhah nalou diuvin atao tauve.
en_web: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
en_kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah phat’in Jesu apotdohin munthip lai khat’ah achetai; ahinla mipin Ama ahol hol jengui. Hiti hin ahenga ahunguvin adalhah louna dingun alhotauve.

tcz: Ahivangin aman adonbut in, “Keiman Pathen Lenggam Kipana Thuphahi khodang'a jong kaseiphong ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche dinga chu eikisol ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kho dang danga jong Pathen lenggam Thupha hi kaseiphong tei tei ding ahi. Hiche dia chu hung kisol kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuti chun akholjin abanjop'in, Judea gam pumpia akikhopnau in tin'ah thu ahillhang len ahi.
en_web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
en_kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Judea gam Houthua kikhopna in hoa jong ahil lhanglei.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee dillen panga thu asei laiyin, mihonpi tamtah'in Pathen thu ngainom na jal'in aneh chinto tauvin ahi.
en_web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Gennesaret dil panga adin pet’in Pathen thu ngai nom hon akimvel’a aneh chinto jengui.

tcz: Kong ni akeuva tuipi pamchin'a akingah amudoh tan, ajehchu ngaman mi ho chun adalhah uva alen'u akisop u ahi.
en_web: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
en_kjv: and saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun twipam chin’a kong ni kihen amui; ngaman kong neiho chu potdoh a len asoppet’u ahiye.

tcz: Kong khatpa sunga chun alut in, kong neipa Simon jah'a Yeshuan twi lah'a asot lut dingin aseiye. Hijeh chun kong sunga chun atouvin, mihonpi chu chua kon in thu ahil'in ahi.
en_web: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
en_kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Simon kong’a alut’in twipam chin’a kona kong chu tol lut jep din asol’in, chuin atouvin kong’a pansan mipi chu thu ahiltai.

tcz: Thu asei jouvin Simon jah'a, “Tun chen, lithuh langjep ah, nalen chu seplhan, nga themkhat manding in,” ati.
en_web: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
en_kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
tcz_gospelgo: Athusei jouvin Simon jah a, “Twithuh laiya tol lut’in nga matna din len sep lhauvin,” atileh;

tcz: “Pipu” tin Simon in ahin donbut in, “Jankhovah hel'a habol'a kabol u ahin chule ima manlou kahiuve. Hinlah nangman nasei ahileh len seplha kit inge,” ati.
en_web: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
en_kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
tcz_gospelgo: Simonin adonbut’in, “Pu, jan khovah hel’a imacha man lou kahiuvin, nang thupeh-in len septem unge,” atin,

tcz: Tu vang'in alen'u nga adimset in akehlha pan tai!
en_web: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
en_kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
tcz_gospelgo: len aseu leh nga tampi aman khauvin alen jouseu a-ehpai ding ahitai.

tcz: Kithopi angeh nauva konin akivoppi hou kong dang khat'ah ahung un, chule chomlou kah'in kong teni chu anigel'in nga adimset in alhalut paiding ahilhon tai.
en_web: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
en_kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kong danga pang aloiten ahung kithopi diuvin agah jap’ui. Amaho ahungun kong te ni chu nga akhol dimset’un ahileh alhalut deh deh jenguve.

tcz: Simon Peter in thilsoh ho amuchet phat in Yeshua masangah adilsun chule aseitai, “Oh Pakai, lungset in neidalhan–keima navel'a um ding'in kachonse behseh jenge,” ati.
en_web: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
en_kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilsoh hi Simon Peterin amuchet phat’in Jesu khomuh a aboh khup’in, “Pakai, neidalha jengin, michonse kahibouve,” atitai.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile nga chujat amat jeng uchu kidang asah val ahi, adangho jong chutima chu ahiuve.
en_web: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
en_kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
tcz_gospelgo: Peter le akiloipi chengsen nga chujat amat jengu chu kidang asabehseh jenguve.

tcz: Akiloipi teu, James le John, Zebedee chapateni jong chun kidang asalhon'e. Yeshuan Simon adonbut'in, “Kicha hih'in! tua pat'a miman joh'a napan ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
en_kjv: and so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon loite ni, Zebedee chpa te ni Jacob le John jong chutima chu ahilhone. Jesun Simon jah a, “Tija hih-in, tua lhah mi man’a napan ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chule tolgo lah alhun lhun uchun, amahon thil jouse adalhauvin Yeshua nung ajui tauve.
en_web: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
en_kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon kong te ni chu vaokama ahintoldoh-un ijakai adalhauvin Jesu ajuitauve.

tcz: Khokhat a hin Yeshuan phat sottah phah nat a dammo khat amui. Hiche mipa chun Yeshua amu chun amai tol'a asulut in adamsah din athum'e. “Pakai” tin aseiyin, “Nalung ahileh nei sudam theiyin chule nei sutheng theiye,” ati.
en_web: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu khopi khat’a aumpet’in akhosunga chun apum changa phah pasal khat aumin, Jesu amudoh phat’in a-angsunga aboh khup’in amaitol’a asulut’in, “Pakai, nalung ahileh eisutheng thei nahi,” tin atao tai.

tcz: Yeshuan akhut alhangin atham'in, “Kalung ahi” tin aseiyin, “Damin!” ati. Chupet tah chun phahnat na chu abeihel tai.
en_web: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
en_kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun athamin ajah a, “Kalung ahinai, damtheng tan,” atileh; apet tah chun aphah atheng jenge.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amapa chu koima jah'a thilsoh ho aseipeh louna din ahilchah tai. Aman aseipeh in, “Thempupa koma chen chule aman na vechil hen. Mose dan'in angeh dungjuiya atiphah nat kiboldam peh hon apeh dinga lom ho kichoiyin. Hiche hi japi lah'a suhthenga naum phondohna ahi,” ati.
en_web: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
en_kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima jah a asei louna din Jesun akham chah-in, “Chen, Thempu gakivetsah-in, nadam theng hettohsah nan Mose thupeh banga thilto ding gatoh tan,” tin asol’e.

tcz: Yeshuan chutia ahilchah jeng vang chun, athilbol theina thuho gangjep joh'in thejal ahin, chule mihonpi tamtah athusei ngai ding le anatnau damsah nomna jeh'in ahung uve.
en_web: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
en_kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla aumchan thudol akihathanjal cheh jengin athu ngai ding le aveiset kiboldamsah din mipi ahungbe cheh cheh jenguve.

tcz: Ahin Yeshua ataodin gamthip lah'a achemang jin ahi. Yeshuan Langthi Khat Adamsah
en_web: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
en_kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Jesu gamthip’a achangin achedoh jin agataojie.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan thu ahil laiyin, Pharisee phabep khat le hou dan thuhil ho ama kom naina ah atou uve. (Hiche miho hi Galilee le Judea chule Jerusalem gam pumpi khotin'a hungdoh hiuleh akilom'e). Chule Pakai misuhdam na thilboltheina chu Yeshua komah hatah in aumin ahi.
en_web: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikhat Jesun thu ahilpet’in Galilee gam le Judea gam khotin’a kon le Jerusalema hung kon Pharisee ho leh Danthu hil ho hikoma chun atouvui. Hichea chun Jesun mi adamsah theina din Pakai thahat’in aumpi.

tcz: Miphabep khat in elbai nakong khat alupna pumin ahin pouvin ahung uve. Insunga Yeshua kom pohlut tei agouvin,
en_web: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
en_kjv: And behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet tah hin mihon pasal langthi khat alupna pumin ahinpu’vin, put lut paiya Jesu angsunga jam din ago’uve.

tcz: hinlah mihonpi jeh chun aphajou tapouve. Hijeh chun inchungah akaldoh un inting aphelhauvin, chuin amahon adamloupa chu alupna pheh pumin mihonpi lah Yeshua maikoh laitah achun ahin khaisuh uve.
en_web: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
en_kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi jeh a aput lut thei louhel phat’un inchunga akaldoh-uvin cheh pheng vang kah a alupna pumin, mipi lailung, Jesu angsung dontah a agah khai lhauve.

tcz: Atahsan jeu amuchun Yeshuan mipa koma chun aseitai, “Gollhang, nachonset akingaidam tai” atipeh e.
en_web: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
en_kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsanu amu phat’in Jesun mipa jah a chun, “Golpa, nachonset jouse ngaidam ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee hole hou danthuhil hochu amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Amahi koiya kigel ham? Pathen taitom ahi! Pathen bouseh in chonset angaidam thei ahi,” atitauve.
en_web: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
en_kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
tcz_gospelgo: Athuseijeh chun Pharisee ho le Danthu themhon, “Hichepa hi koibeh hiya Pathen taitomna thu asei hi nga na? Pathen tilou koidangin chonset angaidam jou ding ham?” tin agel pantauve.

tcz: Yeshuan ipi agel'u ahen, hijeh chun amaho chu adongin, “Ipi jeh'a nalungsung uva hiche hi nadoh uham?
en_web: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
en_kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
tcz_gospelgo: Agel’u hi Jesun ahedoh paiyin ajah-uva “Ibol’a chutobang nagel’u ham?

tcz: Hoiche joh seidinga baijo em ‘Nachonset kingaidam ahitai’ kiti le ‘dingin lang lamjot tan’ tihi?” ati.
en_web: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
en_kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Nachonset jouse ngaidam ahitai,’ ti leh, ‘Thouvin lamjot tan,’ ti hojoh baijom?

tcz: “Hijeh a chu keiman Mihem Chapan leiset ah chonset ngaidam na tha aneiye ti kavetsah ding nahiuve,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan elbai nakong pa lam ngan akiheiyin aseitai, “Dingin, nalupna pheh kilahdoh in lang, inlam'ah chetan,” ati.
en_web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
en_kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
tcz_gospelgo: Hoi hileh leiset chunga mihem Chapan chonset jouse ngaidamna thahat anei nahetna diuvin,” atin, langthipna jah a, “Kaseipeh nahi, thouvin, nalupna kilah-in inlama chetan,” ati.

tcz: Chuin gangtah in, mihon avetjing layin, mipa chu ahung chomdoh in, alupna akilahdoh in, chule inlam Pathen thangvah pumin achetai.
en_web: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
en_kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
tcz_gospelgo: Langthipna mipi maiya ahung dingdoh paiyin, alupna akilah-in inlam jonin achen Pathen athangvah peh-e.

tcz: Mijouse chu lungdon nale tijatnan alodim un, chule Pathen avahchoiyun, “Tunin thil kidang ho kamu uve,” tin aphongdoh uve.
en_web: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
en_kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon adatmo soh keiyuvin Pathen thangvah to thon, atija thei lheh jengun, “Tunin thil kidang datmo umtah imutauve,” tin aseiyui.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan khopi adalhah le, kaidong khat amin Levi kiti akaidon na munah amun, “Neijuiyin lang ka seijui hin” tin Yeshuan asei tai.
en_web: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
en_kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin Jesu apotdoh leh kaidonna muna tou Levi, kaidongpa, chu amudoh-in ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Levi jong akipatdoh in, thil jouse adalhan ama ajuitai.
en_web: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
en_kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Levin ijakai dalhan akipat’in Jesu ajuitai.

tcz: Chujouvin Levin a'in ah Yeshua jin-ja-um hinan an-nehkhom abol in ahi. Levi tohkhompi kaidong tampi le maljin dang in jong an anekhom uve.
en_web: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
en_kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Levin a-in’a Jesu vah nan golvah lentah abol’in kaidong ho tampi le midang hon ankong aumpiuve.

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee hole ahou danthuhil houvin Yeshua seijui ho hengah aphunchel uvin, “Ipi dinga khutobang aboh hotoh naneh uva nadonkhom uham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
en_kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pharisee ho leh danthu them ho Jesu seijuite chunga aphun’un, “Ibol’a kaidong ho le chonsete toh naneh khomu ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Midamthei ten louthem angaicha pouve–adamlouten vang angaichauve.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho hi adonbut’in, “Adamin louthem angaipoi, adamlouvin bou angaiye.

tcz: Keima achonpha'a kigel ho kouva hung kahipoi, amavang chonse ahi kihetdoh'a lunghei dingho kouva hung'ah kahibouve” ati.
en_web: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
en_kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
tcz_gospelgo: Keijong midihsa kouva hung kahipoi, chonsete lungheisah dinga hung kahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat miphabep in Yeshua jah'a, “Tuilutsah John seijui hon an angol'un atao jom jing un, chule Pharisee ho seijui honjong chutima chun aboluve. Ipi jeh a nangma seijui hon phatseh'a aneh uva adon jing jengu hitam?” tin aseiyun ahi.
en_web: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
en_kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Jesu jah a, “John seijuihon an angol matchet’un taojong atao jiuvin, Pharisee seijuihon jong chutiman abol’ui; nang seijui hon vang aneuvin adon’ui” tin aseiyui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Moupui golvahna a maljin hon moulang toh mou aloplaiyuva an angol ngaiyum? Tahbeh in achutipoi.
en_web: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kichen golvahnaa hung lha ho chu aji nei pan aumpi pet’a an na-ngolsah theiyum?

tcz: Amavang moulang chu nikhat amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi, chuteng tah le amahon an angol diu ahi.” ati.
en_web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
en_kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang alah-uva kona aji neipa kipui mang phat hung lhung ding ahin, hiche sungsea chu an angol diu ahinai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thutekah hi apen ahi: “Koiman ponhal vonthah'a konin acheplhan chule vonlui behnan aneipoi. Ijeh inem itileh vonthah chu seding ahitai, chule hiche vonthah hal chu vonlui chutoh kijot lou ding ahi.”
en_web: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
en_kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho chu thulem khat jong aseipeh-in, “Koiman pon thah abot-eh jin ponlui behnan anei ngaipoi; behna taleh ponthah jong abo-eh ding ahin, chule ponthah hal jong chu ponlui chutoh alhoukitoh ponte.

tcz: “Chuleh koiman lengpitwi thah peng luiyah akhum ngaipoi. Ijeh inem itile lengpitwi thah chun savun peng chu aphutjah ding, lengpitwi chu kisujah ding chule peng chu kisuse ding ahi.
en_web: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
en_kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman lengpitwi thah jong savunpeng luiya akhum ngaipoi; khum taleh lengpitwi thah chun savunpeng atumkehding, lengpitwi moh lon kanga, savunpeng jong kisuh manglo ding ahi.

tcz: Lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a khum ding ahi.
en_web: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.
en_kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu lengpitwi thah savunpeng thah a khum ding ahi.

tcz: Ahin koima lengpitwi lui don'in athah chu adeiji tapoi. ‘Aluipa ma aphajenge’ atijiuve,” tin aseiye. Yeshua Seijuihon Cholngah Nikhoa Changvui Asiu
en_web: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
en_kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman lengpitwi lui adon nungin lengpitwi thah adon nompoi; ajeh chu, “Lengpitwi lui bou alhume,’ tin aseijie,” ati.

tcz: Cholngahni khat Yeshuan bulei lai ajot lai hin, aseijui ten changvui asihtan un, akhut uvah anoiyun, chang chu aneuvin ahi.
en_web: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
en_kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nia Jesun buleijao ajotnaa aseijuiten changvui asih-un, akinoiyun abah pantauve.

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee ho phabep in, “Ipi jeh'a nanghon dan nasuhkeh uva Cholngah nia bolngailou chang-ga nalolhah uham?” atiuve.
en_web: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
en_kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pharisee ho phabep’in “Ibol’a Choldo nia bol ngailou abol’u ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabua kisun David le aloiten agilkel pettah uva ipi anabol'u nasimdoh khah lou u ham?
en_web: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
en_kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was a hungred, and they which were with him;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “David le aloite agilkel’uva chu ipi abol’u nasim khah louvu ham?

tcz: Ama Pathen in'a alut'in, dan asukeh in, thempu ho bouseh in anehthei changlhah theng chu anen ahi. Akiloipi ho jong phabep khat apen ahi.” ati.
en_web: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
en_kjv: how he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
tcz_gospelgo: David chu Pathen insunga alut’in Pathen umjing hetna changlhah kitoh, Thempu tilouvin aneh ngailou chu anen aloite jong apei,” ati.

tcz: Chule Yeshuan aseiben, “Mihem Chapa hi Cholngah ni chung jenga jong pakai ahi” ati. Yeshuan Khut-Jetlang Ngoi Pasal Khat Adamsah
en_web: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajah-uvah, “Mihem Chapa hi Choldo ni Pakai ahi,” ati.

tcz: Cholngah nikho dang khat a Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil laiyin mikhat akhut jetlang ngoi khat aumin ahi.
en_web: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
en_kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nidang khat man Jesu Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in thu agahil’e. Hikoma chun pasal khut jetlam ngoi khat ana umkhai.

tcz: Hou danthuhil ho le Pharisee hon Yeshua chu avelhi keuvun ahi. Hichepa chu asuhdam poupouleh Cholngah nin na atonge tia ngohna neiding atiu ahi.
en_web: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
en_kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu them ho le Pharisee hon ahehset theina diuvin, Choldo nia mi aboldam aboldam lou achang lhiuve.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan alunggel'u ahen ahi. Akhut ngoipa jah'a chun, “Hungin lang mijouse masangah hung ding tem'in,” tin akou tai. Hijehchun mipa jong chu malangah ahungin ahi.
en_web: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
en_kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun alungthimu ahen khutlang ngoipa jah a chun, “Kipatdoh-in alailunga hung dingin,” atileh; ama akipatdoh-in ading tai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan anelkal ho jah'a, “Ken nangho thudoh khat kaneiye. Danthun Cholngah nia thilphabol aphal'am, ahilouleh thilse bolnading nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinkho huhhing nading nikho hai ahiloule suhset nading nikho ham?” ati.
en_web: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah-uva, “Kadoh nahiuve, choldo nia apha le ase hoijoh bol ngai ham? Huhhing ding ha suhmang ding ham? ati.

tcz: Aman amaho chu khat khat in ahin golvet vet in chule mipa jah'a chun aseitai, “Nakhut lhangdoh in” ati. Chutichun mipa chun akhut alhangdoh in ahile thahsemphat ahitai.
en_web: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
en_kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun abonchauvin avegolsoh keiyin khutlang ngoipa jah a, “Nakhut lhangdoh-in,” atileh; alhandoh phat’in akhut adamhel’e.

tcz: Hiche a hin Yeshua galmi ho chu alunghang un amachu ilo ding ham ti akihoukhom tauve. Yeshuan Seijui Ding Som Le Ni Alhendoh
en_web: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
en_kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun amaho athangtom behseh jengun Jesu i-lo ding thu akihousom tauve.

tcz: Nikhat hitiho jou sotloulaiyin Yeshua molchung khat ah taona mang din achetouvin, chule jankhovah in Pathen hengah ataove.
en_web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichelai hin Jesu tao dingin molchunga achen, jan khovah geiyin Pathen’ah ataove.

tcz: Ajing khovah in aseijuite jouse akoukhom soh keiyin amaho lah achun solchah dingin somleni alhengdoh in ahi. Amin hou chu hiche ahi:
en_web: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
en_kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah lhah phat’in aseijuite akouvin, alah-uva konin mi som le ni alhengdoh-in amaho chu amin’u solchah asah-e.

tcz: Simon (Peter asah), Andrew (Peter sopipa), James, John, Philip, Bartholomew
en_web: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
en_kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chun Peter asahpa Simon, asopipa Andrew, Jacob le John, Philip le Bartholomew,

tcz: Matthew, Thomas, James (Alphaeus chapa), Simon (Zealot tia kikou),
en_web: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;
en_kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon called Zelotes,
tcz_gospelgo: Matthew leh Thomas, Alphaeus cha Jacob, gam ngailu atiu Simon,

tcz: Judas (James chapa), chule Judas Iscariot (khonunga ajohdohpa) ahiuve. Yeshuan Mi Tamtah Na-Atoh Peh
en_web: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
en_kjv: and Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob chapa Judas, chule amatsah apangpa Iscariot Judas ahiuve.

tcz: Molchunga pat amaho ahungsuh uchun aseijui ho Yeshua toh, mun beh achamlai len khat ah adingun, anungjui tamtah chule mihonpi chun aumkimvel uve. Hichea chun mipi Judea gam pumpi le Jerusalem a kon chule sahlam Tyre le Sidon gam twipang langa pat'a hung jong aumun ahi.
en_web: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
en_kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu amaho hitoh ahung kumsuh-in jangcham lai khat’a adinge; hia chun seijui tamtah le Judea gama kon, Jerusalema kon, chule Tyre le Sidon twikol pang dunga hung mipi nasatah toh ahiuvin,

tcz: Amaho chu ama thusei ngai ding le anat nahou kijendam sah dinga hungu ahi; chule lhagao boh in asuh genthei hojong jendam in aumuve.
en_web: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
en_kjv: and they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
tcz_gospelgo: abonchauva Jesu thuhil ngai nom le adammo veiset nau kibol damsah dia hung ahiuve. Chule Lhagaoboh suh genthei ho jong aboldam soh keiye.

tcz: Mijousen ama chu tohkhah agocheh un ahi ajeh chu suhdam na thaneina chu ama a kona potdoh ahi, chule mijouse asudam in ahi.
en_web: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
en_kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu tahsaa kona thahat hungpot’a amaho adamsah theijeh chun japin Ama tham khah tei din ago’uve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite henglam ngan aseitai “Avaichate Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, Ijeh inem itile Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa ahi.
en_web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
en_kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akhodah-in aseijuite aven aseiye: “Vaichate anun nom nahiuve, Ijeh-inem itile Pathenlenggam nang hoa ahi.

tcz: Tua gilkel te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile lungnachima naum diu ahi. Tua kap te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile phat khatleh nanui diu ahi”
en_web: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
en_kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
