tcz_gospelgo: Tulaiya gilkelte anun nom nahiuve, Ijeh-inem itile nakivahva diu ahi. Tulaiya kapte anun nom nahiuve. Ijeh-inem itile nui ding nahiuve.

tcz: Phattheinan nangah uve, Mihem Chapa najui jeh uva mihon namuda uva napampai uva nataitom uva chule aphalouva nagaosap teng uleh.
en_web: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
en_kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa jal’a min nahot bol’uva, Migilouva nahouset, nadonda tengu leh anun nom nahiuve.

tcz: Hichu aso teng leh kipah un! Henge, kipah'in kichom un! Ijeh inem itile tohphatman lentah in Van-gam ah nangah uve. Chule geldoh jingun, apu apateu chun khanglui lai themgao hojong chutobang chun anabol uve.
en_web: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
en_kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia nahou niu chuleh kipah thanomin lam’un, ven, vana nasan diu tohman alen’e. Apu apateuvin jong Themgao ho hitobanga chu anabolsau ahi.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho ahaote ho, ijeh inem itile nakipanau chu tua bou naneiyu ahitai.
en_web: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
en_kjv: But woe unto you that are rich: for ye have received your consolation.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe mihaoho ada nahiuve, Ijeh-inem itile hinkho nom naneitauve.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho tua thaochet'a uma ninglhing te, ijeh inem itile gilkelna nasatah Phat khat'in nangah jing uve. Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam tua nui te, ijeh inem itile nanui nau chu kana le lunghem na kisoh ding ahi.
en_web: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
en_kjv: Woe unto you that are full: for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now: for ye shall mourn and weep.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe tulaiya oivaho ada nahiuve, Ijeh-inem itile gilkel nahin thoh diu ahi. Ohe tulaiya nuihi ada nahiuve. Ijeh-inem itile lunghema nakadiu ahi.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho japin apachat ho, ijeh inem itile apu apateu jong chun themgao lhem ho ana pachat u anahi. Melma Chunga Lungsetna Nei Ding
en_web: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you: for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe mi jouse seiphat chang ho ada nahiuve. Apu apateuvin jong Themgao lhem ho chutia anaseiyu ahi.

tcz: “Ahin, nangho thu ngainom ho, keiman kasei ahi, nagalmi teu ngailu'uvin! Namuda teu hengah thilpha bol'un.”
en_web: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
en_kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
tcz_gospelgo: “Kathu ngaiho kaseipeh nahiuve, namelmau ngailu’vin, nahot bolteu thilpha bolpeh-un,

tcz: Nasamse teu phattheiboh un. Nasukha teu dingin taovun.
en_web: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
en_kjv: bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
tcz_gospelgo: nagaosapteu phatthei boh-un lang, nabolseteu taopeh-uvin.

tcz: Mi khattou vin nabengphe langkhat abeh le, nabeng langkhat jong do peh in. Khattouvin na ponlen alah got leh na sangkhol jong peh than.
en_web: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
en_kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangeiphe lang khat beng chu lang khatjong dopeh-in, nasangkhol len lahpeh a chu nasangkhol sung nung jong peh than.

tcz: Athum chan chu pein; chule nathil nanga kona akilahdoh teng leh, nunglah ding gohih in.
en_web: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
en_kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga thil thum chan pen, mi lahsa nathil ipi hijongle nung thum kit hih-in.

tcz: Min nang nabol nadinga nadei dan bang bangin midang komah bol'in.
en_web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
en_kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: Min iti bol le chun nadeiyam chutobang chun miho bol’in.

tcz: Nangman nangailu ho bou nangailut le, ipi jeh'a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong angailuteu angailut u ahi!
en_web: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
en_kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-ngailuteu bou na-ngailut’u le ipi pachat nachan diu ham? Chonsete jengin jong angailuteu angailu’ve.

tcz: Chuleh nachunga thilpha bol ho kom bouseh a thilpha nabol leh, ipijeh a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong hichan chu abol'u ahi!
en_web: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
en_kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabolphateu jeng nabolphat’u leh ipi pachat nachan diu ham? Chonsete jengin jong chutia abol’u ahi.

tcz: Chuleh nangman nahin sajou ding hokom'a bou sum naphal leh, ipi jeh a nang kithang-at ding nahim? Michonse ten jong michonse te kom ma'a abon'a nungmu dinga aphal thei ahi.
en_web: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
en_kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
tcz_gospelgo: Mukit ding nakinep nau miho bou napeh-u leh ipi pachat nachan diu ham? Chonsete jengin jong apeh jat amukitna diu chonseho henga apejiuve.

tcz: “Nagalmiteu ngailu uvin! Amaho komah thilpha bol'un. Nungmu ding kinem louvin phal'un. Chuteng van'a kon natohphat man'u chu len ding ahi, chule Chungnung pen chate umchan tahtah natho diu ahi, ajeh chu ama hi kipaje helou hole migilou ho dinga pha ahi.
en_web: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
en_kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang namelmateu ngailu’vin, thilpha bolpeh-un, mukit ding imacha gel louvin thil homun; chutile kipaman nasatah nasan diu, Chungnungpen chate nahi diu ahi; ajehchu Ama chu khohsahna heloute le Migiloute khoto them ahi.

tcz: Napau mikhoto them ahi banga nangho jong khoto them nahi diu ahi. Midang Chunga Thu-Tanna
en_web: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
en_kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
tcz_gospelgo: Napau mi khoto them bangin mi khoto them’uvin.

tcz: Midang chungthu tan hih'in chule nang chungthu jong kitan louding ahi. Midang demna thu seihih in, achutiloule nachunga hung lhung ding ahi. Midang ho ngaidam in nang jong nakingaidam ding ahi.
en_web: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
en_kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
tcz_gospelgo: “Mi oimo hih-un, chutile oimo nachan lou diu ahi; mi them mosah hih-un, chutile themmo nakichansah lou diu ahi; ngaidamun, chutile ngaidam nachan diu ahi.

tcz: Pein, chutileh namu ding ahi. Nathilpeh chu aboncha a nangma kom hung kile ding ahi–akison chahkheh, lo chah kheh sa, mun a-on nadinga, letset'a chule naphei chunga kisunglha ding ahi. Napehdoh jat chun namu ding jat aphotchen ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
en_kjv: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
tcz_gospelgo: Peuvin chutile nakipe diu ahi; atena dimset, hongphal tah a kipea kiloh det kheh-a kison chah kheh alet lha hel’a kipe ding nahive; ijeh-inem itile mi natepehna ma maa nakitepeh diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan thutekah hicheng hi aseiye: “Mitcho khat chun midang kaihoi theiyin tem? Anilhon'a kokhuh a lhalut lhon talou ding ham?”
en_web: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
en_kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun miho chu hiche thulem hi aseipeh-in: “Mitchon mitcho alamkai theiyem? Anilhona kokhuh alha lut lhonlou ding ham?

tcz: Jillai ho ajilkungpau sangin alenjo poi. Amavang jillai khat bulhingset'a kichuh chu ajilkungpa tobang hiding ahi.
en_web: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
en_kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahilpa sangin seijui achungnung ngaipoi, akihil themsoh teng vang leh seijui tapou ahilpa tobang bang ahiji nai.

tcz: “Chuleh ibol'a naloi nagol mit'a bohhal um chu nalunggim pi ham nangma mit'a inkam uma chu?”
en_web: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
en_kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
tcz_gospelgo: “Ibol’a nasopi mit’a bohsi chu namelchih keova, nang mit’a inkam tejen chu mulouva um naham?

tcz: Nangma mit'a inkam kimu louva, “Jol, namit'a bohhal um chu nalahdoh peh inge, tia seiding iti nagel theiyuham? Miphalhem, amasan nangma mit'a inkam chu kilah doh masat in, chutileh nagol mit'a bohhal um chu abol ding dan nahet ding ahi. Thingphung Agan Aki-Hedoh In Ahi.”
en_web: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
en_kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.
tcz_gospelgo: Namit’a inkam tejen mudoh louva nasopi jah a, ‘Sopi, namit’a bohsi chu neilahdoh sah-in,’ nati theiham? Vo mipha lhem! Namit’a inkam tejen chu kilahdoh masah le chun nasopi mit’a bohsi chu kichentah a namutheiding ahi.

tcz: “Thingphung pha khat in ga phalou asodoh theipoi, chule thingphung phalou vin ga pha asodoh ngaipoi.
en_web: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
en_kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thingphung phan gaphalou asep ngaipon, thingphung phalouvin jong gapha asep ngaipoi.

tcz: Thingphung khat chu agan akihen ahi. Theichang ga lingphung hoa konin akilou khapoi, chule lengpiga jong lingboh ah akilou poi.
en_web: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
en_kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thingphung agan akihei. Min lingphunga theichang ga aloupon, lingboh lah a jong lengpithei ga aloujipoi.

tcz: Miphan alungsung thilkholna pha a konin thilpha asodoh in, chule migilouvin alungsung thilkholna phalouva konin thilse asodohe. Nasei chu ipi hileh nalungsunga hung kondoh ahi.
en_web: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
en_kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphan thilpha akholna alung gil’a konin thilpha asosah jin, misen thilse akholnaa konin thilse asodoh jie. Ajeh chu mihem lung gil’a kikhol chu athusei naa hung potdohji ahi.

tcz: “Hijeh a chu ibol'a ‘Pakai, Pakai’ tia neikou jing uham, kasei bon bollou uva?
en_web: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
en_kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseibon bol louva ibol’a, ‘Pakai, Pakai,’ neitiu ham?

tcz: Keiman koiham khat kahenga hunga, kathuhil ngaiya, chule eijui ho chu itobang hidiu ham navetsah unge.
en_web: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
en_kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
tcz_gospelgo: Ka henga hunga kasei ngaiya bol’a michu itobang ham vetsah unge.

tcz: Ama chu mikhat inkhat sa'a abulphu ding thuhtah'a laiya akhombul song chunga phut tobang ahi. Twi ahungso'a in chu ahin nuh jong leh dettah a kisa ahijeh chun adingdet kheh in ahi.
en_web: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
en_kjv: he is like a man which built a house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu lei thuh tah laiya abul songpi chunga tunga insapa tobang ahi. Twisang alet’a vadungin asokhum vangin phatah a kisadet ahijeh-in hiche in chu asulong jou tapoi.

tcz: Amavang koihileh athu ja'a chule nunglou hochu mikhat akhombul umlouva insa tobang ahi. Twipi ahungso'a hasuh a asuh le alhu pai ji tai.” ati.
en_web: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
en_kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built a house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hileh ja la ja naa bol lou chu abulpi bei leiset’a insapa tobang ahi. Vadungin asokhum teng hiche in chu alhupai jin, ain setdol chu amelse lheh jenge,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hiche ho jouse miho koma aseijou phat chun, Capernaum langah akile tai.
en_web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
en_kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi aseipeh nom jouse aseisoh phat’in Capernaum khoa aluttai.

tcz: Hiche lai chun Rome sepai jalamkai khat dinga asoh sahlut tah khat chu hatah in adammon thiding kon cha ahitai.
en_web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
en_kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai jalamkai khat hin sahtah soh khat aneiyin, asohpa hi ana lel lheh jengin athi pai ding ahitai.

tcz: Sepai jalamkai pan Yeshua chungchang ajahdoh phat in, aman ja umtah Juda upa ho asolin, ahinkou uva asohpa ahung damsah din asol'e.
en_web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
en_kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thudol ajah phat’in sepai jalamkaipan Jesu chu hunga asohpa boldam din akouding Juda mi upaho asol’e.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon jong ngehkhoh tah in Yeshua chun mipa akithopi din atao tauve. “Napanpina chang dinga lom khattou aumleh, ama hi ahi,” atiuvin ahi
en_web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
en_kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
tcz_gospelgo: UPaho hi Jesu henga ahungun khohsah tah-in ataovun, “Hichepa hi nabolpeh dia kilom mong ahi;

tcz: “Ajeh chu aman Juda miho eilungset un kikhopna in jong eisah pehuve,” atiuve.
en_web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
en_kjv: for he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu ijat’u alungset’in Houthua kikhopna in jong eisah peh-ui,” atiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshua jong amaho toh alhon'in achetai. Ahivangin in ahunglhun masangjep un, sepai jalamkai pan loi phabep asol'in hitin agasei sah e, “Pakai, ka-in'a hung dingin nang le nang kisugim hih in, ajehchu keima chutobang loma jana chang dinga kilom kahipoi.”
en_web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
en_kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesu amaho toh ahung kilhontai. In kom ahung gei phat’in sepai jalamkaipan aloite asol’in ajah a, “Pakai, hung kigimbol datan, ajeh chu ka-insung nahung lut ding hi kakilompoi.

tcz: Keima hungdoh a nangma toh kimuto dinga jong lhingjou lou kahi. Naum na'a kon chun thu chu seijeng'in, kasohpa suhdam'a umding ahi.
en_web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
en_kjv: wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu katahsa tah a nahenga hung dia jong kilom kisalou kahi; thun seitho jongle chun kasohpa chu dam jeng nante.

tcz: Ken hiche hi kahenai, ajehchu keima jong kachunga ho thunoiya um kahin, chule kenjong ka sepai ho chunga thuneina kanei ahi. Keiman “Chen” ti bouseh kasei le acheuvin, “Hungin” katileh ahung uve. Chule kasohte komah “Hiche bol'in kati leh abol jenguve,” atiuve.
en_web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
en_kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
tcz_gospelgo: Keijong mi thu noiya natong kahin, kanoiya natong sepaiho aum kit’e. Khat jaha, ‘Chen,’ katileh achen, achom khat jah a, ‘Hungin,’ katileh ahungjin; kasohpa jah a jong, ‘Hiche bol’in,’ katileh aboljin ahi,” agatisah-e.

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah doh phat in, atija lheh jenge. Mihonpi anungjui ho heng lam angan hitin aseiye, “Kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang tahsan na hi Israel pumpi sungah kamukha poi!” ati.
en_web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
en_kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hiche hi ajah phat’in amapa chu kidang asa behseh jengin, anung jui mipi lama akiheiyin, “Kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel lah a jong hitobang tahsan len kamudoh poi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin sepai jalamkaipa loiho chu a'inah akile tauvin ahileh sohpa damthengsel'a anaum chu amu'uvin ahi. Yeshuan Meithainu Chapa Athisa Akaithou
en_web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
en_kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung kisol ho in lama ahung kile kit’u leh sohpa chu adamsan agatoh tauve.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin Yeshua aseijui hotoh Nain kho langah acheuvin, mihonpi tamtah'in ajui uve.
en_web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
en_kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin Jesu Nain khoa alut’in, aseijuite leh mi tampin akilhonpiuve.

tcz: Thivui dinga hung kijotdoh honkhat khopi kelkot phunga chun atohkha uvin ahi. Khangdong athipa chu meithainu chapa changkhatseh ahin, chule khosunga pat mihonpi tamtah'in amanu aumpiu ahi.
en_web: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
en_kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi dongkot phung agah phah konchan ven, mithilong khat ahung kipudoh-in, athipa chu anun chapa chang khatseh a anei ahin, anu jong meithaisa ahitai. Khopi sunga pat mipin meithainu chu ahin lhonpiuvin ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin amanu amu chun, alungsung khotonan adimtan ahi. “Kap hih'in!” tin aga lhamon e.
en_web: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
en_kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin meithainu hi amudoh phat’in alai natpin ajah a, “Kap hih-in,” ati.

tcz: Chuin thikong lama chun achen atongkhan ahile apoho adingden'un ahi. “Gollhang” atin “Kaseipeh nahi, thoudoh in” ati.
en_web: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
en_kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
tcz_gospelgo: Anai lut’in thilong kong atham leh alongpu ho ading tauve. Aman, “Vo golhang, kaseipeh nahi, thoudoh tan,” atileh;

tcz: Chuin athiah pasal chapang chu ahung toudoh in thu aseipan tai! Chule Yeshuan anu anungpeh tan ahi.
en_web: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
en_kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
tcz_gospelgo: mithipa chu atoudoh paiyin thu aseiyin, chuin Jesun ama chu anu apetai.

tcz: Kichatna lentah in mihonpi chu alonvuh tai, chule amahon Pathen avahchoiyun, “Thil nasatah bolthei themgao khat ilah uvah akisepdoh tai,” atiuvin chule “Pathen in tunin amite aviltai,” atiuve.
en_web: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
en_kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi jouse atija behseh jengun Pathen avahchoiyun, “Pathenin amite ahung vil’in, i-lah-uva Themgoa nasatah khat asohdoh tai,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chule Yeshua chungchang thusoh Judea gam pumpi le akimvel thinglhang gamkai ho'ah the chansoh'in aumtai.
en_web: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
en_kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judea, and throughout all the region round about.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Jesu chung chang thudol hi Judea gam pumpi le akimvel gamkol dunga akithangsoh heltan ahi.

tcz: Twilutsah John seijui hon Yeshua thilbol jouse chu John aseipeh tauve. Hijeh chun John in aseijuite lah'a mini akouvin,
en_web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
en_kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuiten John jah a thilsoh hicheng hi aseipeh uleh Johnin aseijuite mi ni akouvin

tcz: chule adong dingin Pakai komah asoltai. “Nangma Messiah kanga jingu chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavet nahlai diu ham?” agatisah e.
en_web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
en_kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai henga asol’in, “Ahung ding chu Nang nahi hitam, ahilouleh achom dang khat ka-nga nah lai diu ham?” tin agadohsah-e.

tcz: John seijui tenin Yeshua amu lhon phat in aseilhon tai, “Twilutsah John in hiche dong dinga eihin sollhon ahi, Nangma Messiah, kanga jing pau chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavetjing nahlai diu ham?” atilhon e.
en_web: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
en_kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
tcz_gospelgo: Solle teni Jesu henga ahung lhonin, “John baptist chun, ‘Ahung ding chu Nang nahi hitam, ahiloule achomdang khat ka-nga nah lai diu ham?’ tia dong dinga nahenga eihinsol lhon ahi,” ati lhone.

tcz: Hiche pettah a chu Yeshuan mi tampi anatnau, adammo nahou asuhdam pet, lhagaoboh vop ho aboldam pet, chule khomulou ho kho amusah pet anahie.
en_web: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
en_kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet tah a hi Jesun amaho, hivei chom chom veiho, lhagao gilou vop ho aboldama mitcho jong kho amusah ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan John seijui teni chu aseipeh in, “John hengah kile lhon in lang nathilmu lhon le nathujah lhon chengse seipeh lhon tan–mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam ajot'in, miphah ho jendam ahin, nangong'in kho ajan, mithiho kaithouvin aumin, chule Kipana Thuphahi mivaichate hengah seiphong'in aumtai.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
en_kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesun solle te ni adonbut’in, “Kile kit’in John jah a chun nathilmu le najah lhon, mitchon kho amu’uva, elbaiin lam ajot’u, miphah ho suh thenga auma, na-ngongin kho ajah, mithisa kaithouva auma tahlelte Kipana Thupha akiseipeh hi gaseipeh lhonin;

tcz: Chule seipeh lhon'in, keima jeh a kiheimang louho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh'e,” ati.
en_web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
en_kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
tcz_gospelgo: chule keiya kipal lhuhna neilou mi chu-anunnom ahi,” ati.

tcz: John seijui tenin adalhah jouvin Yeshuan ama thudol mihonpi jah'a chun aseiyin ahi. “Itobang mi veding'a gamthip a chu nache uham? Ama chu huimut lingle peng don anem ham?
en_web: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
en_kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
tcz_gospelgo: John solle te ni che nungin Jesun John thudol aseiyin, “Gamthip’a ipi vedia cheji nahiuvem’? Huiyin peng amut ling ham?

tcz: Ahiloule ponsil mantamtah'a kivon mi mudinga nakiginchat um? Ahipoi, von hoitah kivon hole nomsatah'a hingho chu leng inpia bou akimui.
en_web: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
en_kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi vedia ba chadoh ji nahiuvem? Ponnem sil mi ham? Ven, von hoitah a kivona nom satah a um ho chu leng inpi dunga aumbouvui.

tcz: Themgao ve nahiu ham? Henge, chule themgao sanga chungnung jo ahi.
en_web: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
en_kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Achutile ipi vetnoma ba chedohji nahiuvem? Themgao ham? Ahi, najah-uva kasei ahi, Themgao sanga thupijo ahiye.

tcz: John chu Pathen Lekhabu in hitia aseipa chu ahi, Ven, keiman namasangah ka thu lhangsam kasol'e, chule aman nalampi namasanga asemtup ding ahi.
en_web: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
en_kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thudol hi, ‘Ven, kasolle Nang sangin kasol masai, Aman nachena lampi semsa anakoi ding ahi,’ tia kisun chu ahitai.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, anahing jouse lah'a, koima John sanga lenjo aumpoi. Ahin Pathen lenggam a aneopen jengjong chu ama sangin alenjon ahi!” ati.
en_web: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
en_kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, numei sung peng cheh ahivangin John pen geiyin ama sanga lenjo aumpoi, ahinla Pathen lenggama aneopen ama sangin alenjo nalaiye.

tcz: Hiche thu ajah tah'un, mipi jouse–kaidong ho jengin jong–Pathen lampi chu adih ahi ti apom'un ahi, ajeh chu amaho John khut'a baptize anachang ahiuve.
en_web: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
en_kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi le kaidong hon asei ajah phat’un, John baptist chansah dol’a baptize changsa ahijeh-un, Pathen apah chauve.

tcz: Amavang Pharisee hole hou danthu themhon Pathen thilgon apampaiyun ahi, ijeh inem itile amahon John tuilutsah chu apomlouvu ahi.
en_web: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
en_kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho le Danthu them hon vang John baptist khut’a baptize achan lou jeh-un adiuva Pathen thilgon chu apaituve.

tcz: “Tukhang mite hi ipi toh katekah tadem?” tin Yeshuan adongin “Iti kahilchet ding ham?” ati.
en_web: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
tcz_gospelgo: “Tukhang miho hi ipi to kitekah ding hi tam? Itobang mi hiuvem?

tcz: Amaho hi kailhang lah'a chapang kichem tobang ahiuve. Amaho aloi agol ho komah aphunchel un, “Keihon moupui golvah la kalhauvin, nalam pouve” hijeh chun thivuina la joh kalhauvin chule nakap pouve.
en_web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
en_kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi kailhanga tou chapang ho khat’in achom khat jah a, ‘Kuli kamutpeh-u le la nalam pouvin, Lapi kasah-u jongle nakap deh pouve,’ tia kihou ho bep ahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Tuilutsah John chun aphat ho changlhah neh ahiloule lengpitwi don kiti hohin asumang pon, chule nanghon, “Thilhavop ahi” natiuve.
en_web: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
en_kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile John baptist chu ahungin changlhah la nelou leng pitwi jong don louvin aum nan, ‘Thilhavop ahi,’ atiuvin;

tcz: Mihem Chapan, alangkhat'ah, anen adonin, chule naseiyun, “Milop jukham chule kaidong ho le chonse dang ho jol le gol!” natiuve.
en_web: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
en_kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa ahungin changlhah anen lengpitwi adon leh, ‘Ven, neh hat le lengpi twi loppa, kaidong ho jolpa hi,’ atiuve.

tcz: Ahinla chihna chu adih ahi ti anungjui ho hinkho'ah tahlangin aume, ati.
en_web: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
en_kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla chihna chu achaten adihna aphot chet ahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Pharisee ho lah'a khat in Yeshua toh nilhah an nehkhom din angeh in, hijeh chun Yeshua jong ama in'a chun achen an nedin atoutai.
en_web: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
en_kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee khat’in Jesu chu nehkhompi din akouvin, Ama Phariseepa in’a alut’in atoutai.

tcz: Chukom muna an aneh ding chu numei jonthanhoi a chonse khat in ahetphat in, amanun songval bom khat'ah thao namtui mantamtah kikhum ahinchoiye.
en_web: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
en_kjv: And behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche khopi sunga hin chonse numei khat aumin, Jesu Phariseepa in’a anne dia tou ahen songval bom khat’a thao namtui choiyin ahungin,

tcz: Chuin amanu chu adilsun Amapa kengmuh gal lam'a chun adilsun akaptai. Amitlhi akengmuh lamah avalhan, hichu asam in athehgo in ahi. Chuin akengmuh chu namtui athe in achop chuh chuh tan ahi.
en_web: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
en_kjv: and stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu nung, akhotaljum koma dingin, akap’in akengphang chu amitlhin asop’in, chuin asamin atheh ngimin, achop’in thao namtui chu anui.

tcz: Pharisee mipa anne a koupa chun hichu amuphat in ama le ama akihoulim in, “Hiche mipa hi themgao ahipou pouleh, itobang numei ham athamkha nu hi, amanu hi michonse ahi! ti ahet tei ding ahi,” atin ahi.
en_web: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
en_kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
tcz_gospelgo: Neh khompi dia kou Phariseepan hiche hi amu phat’in alung sunga, “Hichepa hi Themgao ahinah le ahung thama numei khu itobang mi ahi hentin, chonse ahijong he nah ta,” tin gel’e.

tcz: Chutah chun Yeshuan alunggel chu ahin donbut in, “Simon” tin Pharisee pa koma chun, “Thilkhat nakomah kaseinom'e” ati. “Sei jeng in, houhil” tin Simon in adonbut paiyin ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Simon nahenga seinom khat kaneiye,” atileh; aman, “Seijengin Houhil,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseipeh tai: “Mikhat in mini sum abatsah in–khatpa dangka ja-nga chule khat dangka som-nga.
en_web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
en_kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one ought five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Mi nin sumpa hom mikhat sum abat lhone. Khat’in denarii ja nga aban, khat pan som nga abai.

tcz: Ahin anigel lhon in asajou lhon tapon, hijeh chun hepi na neitah in angaidam in abat lhon akah peh tai. Chujou chun koijoh chun ama chu ngailu jon tem tia nagel em?” tin adongtai.
en_web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
en_kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
tcz_gospelgo: Asah lel lhon phat’in aman abat lhon angaidam tai. Hiche te ni koijoh hin ama chu hangailut jon tem?” atileh;

tcz: Simon in adonbut in, “Keigel in abat tamjopa chu,” ati. “Hichu adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseitai.
en_web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
en_kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon in adonbut’in, “Atamjo angaidam peh pa hin te kati,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Naseidih lheh-e,” ati.

tcz: Chuin numeinu heng lam ngan akiheiyin Simon jah'a aseitai, “Hiche numeinu hichea dilsu nu hi ven. Keima na'in a kahung lut chun, nangman tui kakenga vutkhu sillhah nading neipepon, ahivangin hiche nu hin amitlhi tuiyin asop lhan, chule asam in atheh ngim in ahi.”
en_web: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
en_kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei nu lam angan Simon jah a, “Hichenu hi ven! Na-ina kahung lut tan, kakeng silna din twibon neipe poi; hiche nu hin kakengphang te ni amit lhia asop’a asama atheh ngim ahi.

tcz: Nangman chibai neiboh pon, ahin kahung lut a pat hichenu hin kakengmuh achop chop jong anga hih laiye.
en_web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
en_kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin chop jong neichop pon, hichenu vang kahung lut’a pat tang louhel’in kakeng phang te ni achop chop jenge.

tcz: Nangman kalua olive thao nuding na gelkhoh pon, amanu vang hin kakeng phang thao namtuiyin anui.
en_web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
en_kjv: Mine head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin kalu jengbon thao nu louva, hichenun kakengphang te ni geiyin thao namtui anui.

tcz: “Kaseipeh nahi, amanu chonsetna ho–tamtah ahiuvin, ngaidam ahitai, hijeh a chu amanun ngailutna lentah eimusah ahi. Amavang mi akingaidam lhom chu akipah lhom in ahi” ati.
en_web: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
en_kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeha chu najah a kasei ahi, hichenun hibanga angailutna hi achonset tampi ki-ngaidam phot chenna ahin, lhomcha ki-ngaidampeh chun angailu lhome,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan numeinu jah'a, “Nachonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai” ati.
en_web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
en_kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amanu jah a, “Nachonset chengse ki-ngaidam ahitai,” atipeh-e.

tcz: Dokhanga tou miho chu ama ho le amaho akihouvun, “Hiche mipa hi koi hiya mi chonse jong angaidam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
en_kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
tcz_gospelgo: A ankong umpihon, “Chonset geiya ngaidam thei Ama hi koibep ham?” akitiuve.

tcz: Chule Yeshuan numeinu jah'a aseitai, “Natahsan in nahuhhing ahitai, lungmongin chetan,” ati.
en_web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
en_kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun numeinu jah a, “Natahsanin nahuhhing ahitai, lung monin chetan,” ati.

tcz: Chujou vin Yeshua anaivellah kho ho vilding in akipandoh in, Pathen Lenggam chungchang Kipana Thupha seiphong leh hillhang le akop in ahi. Aseijui somleni ho jong akipuiyin,
en_web: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
en_kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
tcz_gospelgo: Phatchom khat nungin Jesun khopi jouse le khote jouse aban banin achonlen, Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhang len, seijui som le nin jong alhonpiuve.

tcz: lhagaoboh vop'a kon le anatna kisudam numei phabep khat jong ahiuve. Amaho lah a chun Mary Magdelene, thilha sagi anodoh peh nu;
en_web: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
en_kjv: and certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
tcz_gospelgo: Numei phabep, lhagao gilouvop’a kona adamsa ho le natna chom chom kona adamsah hon jong alhonpiuvin, hiche ho lah a hin Magdalene kiti Mary, asunga kona thilha sagi anodoh pehnu,

tcz: Joanna, Chuza jinu, Herod sumkolveina vesuipa; Susanna; chule adang mi tamtah Yeshua le aseijui te anei agouva panpi na hintoh doh jing ho jong ahiuve.
en_web: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
en_kjv: and Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod neichingpa Chuza jinu Joanna, Susanna le adang ho tampi ahiuve. Numeiho hin Jesu le aseijuite chu amaho neiya konin ajenjiuve.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan thusim khat thulem'in mihonpi tamtah, kho chom chom'a kon hung kisutoa athusei ngaidinga hung ho komah hitin aseiye:
en_web: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:
en_kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi jousea konin mi ahung hung jengun Jesu koma mi tamtah akikhomun ahile Jesun thulemin thu khat aseiyin;

tcz: “Loubol mi khat amuchi tu dingin achedoh tai. Aloulai dungah athe len ahileh, muchi abang chu lamsih'a achun, chuva chun chotphan aumin, chule vachaten anedoh tauve.
en_web: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
en_kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
tcz_gospelgo: “Muchi thepa alouva muchi then akonin athe leh muchi phabep lamsih a achun, min achonlih-in, chunga leng vachaten akilodoh tauve.

tcz: Muchi adang songlah'a achui. Ahung khang doh'in, ahin akehdoh chu agoplha loiyin asunou ding alhomjeh in athidoh tai.
en_web: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
en_kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
tcz_gospelgo: Phabepma songlheo chunga achun, ahintheina ding leithao aum loujeh-in ahung kedoh vangin agop paijitan ahi.

tcz: Muchi adang chu linglah'a achun, ahung kehdoh in chule ling chun adeplih jitai.
en_web: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
en_kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
tcz_gospelgo: Phabep jong ling lah a achun, ling hon adep lihji tauve.

tcz: Muchi adang khat kit chu leipha laiyah achui. Hiche muchi chu akhang in, ga ahin son anakitu sangin ajat jakhat in agan ahi” ati. Hiche aseijouvin ahung pengjah jengin, “Koihileh angai na ding nakhang nei chan in angaiya ahetchet ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Other fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
en_kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Phabep vang leipha leiya achukhan, ahung khangdoh in ajat jakhat chengin agai,” ati. Hicheng asei hin asamin, “A-ngaina ding nakhang neiyan ngai hen!” ati.

tcz: Aseijui hon hiche thulem hi ipi kisei na ham adongun ahi.
en_web: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
en_kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thulem hi ipi kiseina ham, tin aseijuiten Jesu adongui.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon Pathen Lenggam thuguh nahet thei nadiuva phalpehna chang nahiuve. Amavang midangho hilna a thulem kaman hi Pathen Lekhabua kisun guilhun nadinga ahi: Ahin vet teng uleh, amu tahtah lou diu ahi. Ajah teng uleh, ahetthei lou diu ahi.”
en_web: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
en_kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Aman, “Nang ho hi Pathen lenggam thuguh chengse het dia kipea nahitauvin, adang ho vangin vejong leu amuchet thei lou diu jajong leu ahet khen thei lou diu jeh a a thulem jenga kiseipeh ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: “Hiche hi thulem kisei avetsahna chu ahi: Muchi chu Pathen thu ahi.
en_web: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
en_kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thulem chu hiche kiseina ahi; muchi chu Pathen thupha ahi.

tcz: Lamsih a chu muchin avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a ahivanga agiloupa hunga atahsan thei nalou ding le asochat lou na dinga alungsunga kon alahmang peh miho aseina ahi.
en_web: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
en_kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Lamsih a chu kitiho chu Pathen thupha jataa, ahivanga atahsan dauva huhhinga aum louna diuva, Diabol hunga alung gil’a Thupha chu alahmang pehji miho ahiuve.

tcz: Muchi songlah'a chu hon avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a chule kipah tah'a kisanta, ahivanga jung akhothuh loujeh uva phat chomkhat kah'a bou tahsan, lhepna atoteng uleh lhuji ho aseina ahi.
en_web: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
en_kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
tcz_gospelgo: Songlheo chung leipatnaa chu kitiho chu thupha ajah tenguleh kipah tah a kisanpai jenga, ahivanga jungbei ahijeh-uva chomkhat tahsan jong le patepna phat ahung lhun phat le pul lhaji miho ahiuve.

tcz: Muchi linglah'a chu hon avetsah chu, athu ja'a ahivanga athujah chu leiset gimna haosatna chule nopsahna hon atomchah a khangdoh thei talou ho aseina ahi. Hijeh chun apilhing thei tapouvin ahi.
en_web: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
en_kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
tcz_gospelgo: Linglah a chu kitiho chu thupha ajatauvin, ahinla hinkhoa lungkhamna tin cheng, haona le leiset nopsahna chengsen alonvuh a, aga pilhing thei louva um miho ahiuve.

tcz: Chule muchi leipha laiya chu chun milungtheng, lungthim pha, Pathen thu ja'a nung ho, chule lungneng tah'a ga tamtah sodoh ho aseina ahi. Meivah Lheng Akikhu Den Ngaipoi”
en_web: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
en_kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
tcz_gospelgo: Leipha laiya chu kitiho vang chu thupha ajah tengu leh lungthim phatah le dih tah akolchahkheh a aga pilhin kahsea pangdet jing miho ahiuve.

tcz: “Koiman meivah avah in chule lheng'in akhun ahiloule jalkhun noiyah asel ngaipoi. Meivah chu atunna ah akitungin, chuva chun avah chu insunga lut jousen amuthei bouve.
en_web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
en_kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koiman mei avah-in bel akhu ngaipon, jalkhun noiya jong atung ngaipoi. Ahung lut chanin meivah chu amusoh din thaomei akikhu khum jong ima aumpoi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile akiselguh jouse lhangphonga hung kipodoh ding, chule akiphongdoh lou jouse meivah noiya kipodoh ding mijouse kihetsah ding ahi.”
en_web: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
en_kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu khovah a kiphong doh lou ding ima akiselguh aumpon, phondoh a hetdoh lou ding akikhu khum jong ima aumpoi.

tcz: “Hijeh chun iti najah uvem chingtheiyun. Kathuhil ngai jouse, hetthem theina kipeh be ding. Amavang thungai louho chu, ahetsa dan'a agel hou jeng jong amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi.” ati. Yeshua Le A-Insung Mite
en_web: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
en_kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
tcz_gospelgo: Iti najah-um ching theiyun; ajeh chu aneiya kipah bea, aneilou chu aneiya agel chengse jong kilahpeh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua anu le asopiho amatoh kimudin ahung un, ahin mihonpi jeh chun ama kom nailut theilouvin aum tauve.
en_web: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
en_kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu nu le Jesu sopi pasal ho ahenga ahungu leh mipi jeh chun akom alut theipouve.

tcz: Koiham khat'in Yeshua aseipeh in, “Nanu le nasopiho polangah aumuve, chule nakimutopi nom uve,” atipeh tai.
en_web: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
en_kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon, “Nanu le nasopi pasal hon namu nomun pama adingui,” tin Jesu jah a aseipeh-ui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kanu le kasopi ho chu koi hileh Pathen thu ja'a athua nungho chu ahiuve” ati.
en_web: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
en_kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah-uva, “Kanu le kasopite chu Pathen thu jop’a bol ho chu ahiuve,” tin adonbut’e.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Dil gal langkhat ah galkaiyu hite” ati. Hijeh chun kong sungah alut'un akipatdoh tauve.
en_web: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

en_web: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

tcz_gospelgo: Johnin adonbut’in, “Pipu, mikhat namin a thilha nodoh kamu’vin, keoho toh lhona nang najui loujeh-in kakhamtauve,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih un, koihileh nadoudal lou phot chu nanga ding ahi” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Kham dauvin, nadou lou pouvu chu nang ho lama pan gahi,” ati.

tcz: Van'a lahtouva aumna ding phat ahung naitoh lhonin, Yeshua Jerusalem jon din dettah a kigellha pumin achen ahi.
en_web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
en_kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu lah touva aumna ding phat anai jep jep phat’in Jerusalema che din akiheitai.

tcz: Aman thupole ho Samaria khokhat'ah, availhun na dinga akigot theina diuvin asol masan ahi.
en_web: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
en_kjv: and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun solle ho asol masan, aamho chu acheuvin alhunna ding gonsa koipeh din Samaria miho kho khat’a alut’uve.

tcz: Ahivangin hiche khoa mipi ho chun Yeshua chu asang tapouve, ajehchu ama Jerusalem jona achejing lai ahi.
en_web: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria mihon Jesu chu Jerusalema jon a chego ahijeh-in asang tapouve.

tcz: James le John in hiche amudoh lhon phat in, amanin Yeshua jah'a, “Pakai, van'a kona amaho gouvam jeng ding mei ikou lhah diu ham?” atilhone.
en_web: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
en_kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuite ni Jacob le Johnin asandau hi amudoh lhon phat’in, “Pakai, vana kona meikou kakou lhah lhona kakahvamsah diu nadeiyem?” ati lhone.

tcz: Ahin Yeshua akiheiyin amani chu aphoh'in ahi.
en_web: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
en_kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akiheiyin amani chu haphon aphoh-e.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho khochom khat ah ache tauve.
en_web: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
en_kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin khodanga achetauve.

tcz: Amahon chutia lam ajot laiyun, koiham khat'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nache na chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
en_web: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
tcz_gospelgo: Alamjot laiyun pasal khat’in Jesu jah a, “Nache na chan a jui ing kate,” ati.

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Si-al hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, vachaten gena ding bu aneiyun, ahivangin Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding jeng jong aneipoi,” atipeh e.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Gam-ui hon koaneiyun, chunga leng vachaten jong bu aneiyui, Mihem Chapan vang alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong aneipoi,” ati.

tcz: Aman midang khat jah'a, “Hungin, neijuiyin” ati. Mipa chu anom in hinlah hitin aseiye, “Pakai, amasan inlam kileng ting kapa gavui masa tadinge,” ati.
en_web: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
en_kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
tcz_gospelgo: Michom khat jah a jong, “Neijuiyin,” ati. Ahinla aman, “Pakai, amasan cheng ting kapa gavui ta dinge,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Lhagaova thihon amithi hou kivuiyuhen! Nangma kin chu chele a Pathen Lenggam thudol seiphong chu ahi,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
en_kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Mithi chu mithi kivui din dalhan lang, chen Pathen leng gam thu seiphongjon,” ati.

tcz: Achom khat in aseiyin, “Henge Pakai, keiman najui inge, ahin amasan ka insungmi tetoh gakivailhah tadinge,” ati.
en_web: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
en_kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home in my house.
tcz_gospelgo: Midang khat’in jong, “Kenvang najui jeng inge Pakai, ahin amasan ina umho ga-lha tadinge,” ati.

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Koi hileh akhut'a langkon tuhta chule nunglam ve chu Pathen Lenggam a dingin alhing poi,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Loukai dia langkon tuhsa haidia kihei kit chu Pathen lenggam din aphachompoi,” ati.

tcz: Tun Pakai in seijui adang mi somsagi le ni alhengdoh in amaho chu akop kop'in khotin le muntin vilding agot naho ah asol in ahi.
en_web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
en_kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin Pakaiyin misom sagi le ni alhengdoh-in, chedia agotna khopi jouse le muntin’a ni nin asol masai.

tcz: Hiche ho cheng hi amaho ahilchahna ahi: “Lousoh ga khoptup ding atam, ahin natong ho alhome. Hijeh chun Pakai hengah taovun amachu ga chomtup dia mopo ahi; alouva natong ding mi ahin solbe nadin thum'un.”
en_web: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
en_kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
tcz_gospelgo: Amisol ho jah a, “Chang-at ding atam lheh jengin, natong’ah alhome; chang-at ding mi ahinsol na din chang-at na Pakai henga taovun.

tcz: Tun cheuvin, chuleh geldoh jingun keiman si-al lah'a kelngoi kisol tobanga kasol nahiuve.
en_web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
en_kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
tcz_gospelgo: Cheuvin, ven, ngeihon lah a kelngoinoute kilhalut banga kasol nahiuve.

tcz: Sum le pai ima kipoh hih'un, sakhao jong kipoh hih'un, kengchot akop'in jong pohih un. Chuleh lampi dungah khattou lem dingin kingapa hih'un.
en_web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
en_kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumbom hihen sakhao hileh kengchot ho geiyin kiken dauvin, lampi dunga jong koima salam bol dauvin.

tcz: Khattou in'a nalut teng uleh, amasan “Pathen lungmonna hiche in'a hin umhen” tin asauvin.
en_web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
en_kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalut nau in tin’a amasan, “Hiche in’a hin lung mon leng hen,” tiuvin.

tcz: Hichea cheng ho chu alungmon uleh, phattheina chu umden ding; achutilou uleh, phattheina chu nahenguva hung kile ding ahi.
en_web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
en_kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chu chamna dei mi aum leh ama chunga chu nalungmonu chun tin, aumlou vangleh nahenguva hung kile kit ding ahi.

tcz: In khat'a kon inkhat ah vahle hih'un. Munkhat bou ah um unlang, amahon napeh peh uchu neuvin chule don'un. Min phatah a najen nau sanding kiphalam hih'un, ajehchu anatong chun alosan amuding mong ahi.
en_web: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
en_kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche in’a chun pansauvin, amahon napeh peh-u chu neuvin don’un ajeh chu natong’an atohman asan lom ahi. In khat’a konin inchoma kichon dauvin.

tcz: “Khopi khat a nalut uva nasan uleh, namasanga ahin luidoh doh uchu neuvin.”
en_web: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
en_kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sung nalut’uva mihon nalamdot’u jong leh, na-anga aluiyu chu ne jengun;

tcz: Adamlou sudam'un lang seipeh'un, “Pathen Lenggam chu tun nakom uva aumtai” tiuvin.
en_web: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
en_kjv: and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: chukoma adamlou ho boldamun, ajah-uvah, “Pathen lenggam chun nakomu ahinphatai,’ tin seiph-un.

tcz: Ahin khopi khattou in nasan dauleh, alampiu dunga chun chedoh unlang seiyun,
en_web: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
en_kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sung nalut’uva mihon nalamdot lou vangu leh akhosung lamlen dunga potdoh-un lang,

tcz: Nakhopiu sunga vutkhu ho geiyin kakenguva kon'in kathing lhauve, nasoso kisoh dinga dalhah nahiuve ti vetsahnan. Chule hiche hi heuvin–Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai!
en_web: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
en_kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve thupi kitan nileh agilou Sodom kho chu chutobang khopi ho sanga phajep diu ahi.
en_web: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
en_kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
tcz_gospelgo: Najah-uva kasei ahi, thupitan nikhoa chuche khopi thoh sanga Sodom khopi thoh oljo ding ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nangau hitam, vo Korazin le Bethsaida! Ijeh inem itile nalah'a thilkidang kibol hohi agilou Tyre le Sidon khohoa kibol hitaveleh, sotlaiya pat'in amipihon achonset nauva kon lungheina nei untin, khaodippon kisil untin chule akisih'u tahlang nan aluchung uvah vutvam kiloi tauvinte.
en_web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
en_kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin, woe unto thee, Bethsaida: for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe Chorazin khopi nada ahin, ohe Bethsaida khopi nada ah! Ajeh chu nakhosunga na kitong thil kibol thahatna ho hi Tyre le Sidon a kibol hileh sot’a lungaheiyuva, vutvam kinu’va khaodip pon kisil’a tou diu ahitai.

tcz: Henge, Tyre le Sidon khopi teni hi thupi kitan nileh nangho sanga phajep diu ahi.
en_web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
en_kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupi tan ni leh nathoh diu sanga Tyre le Sidon thoh oljo ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nangho Capernaum mite, van-gam'ah jabolna chang nauvin natem? Nachan loudiu ahi, thina mun'a nachesuh joh diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
en_kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Capernaum nangma van geiya choisanga um ding nahim? Noimigama kikai lhading nahiubouve.

tcz: Chuin aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Koihileh nathuhil'u kisan a chun keijong eisan ahi. Chule napampai chan'u chun keijong eipampai ahi. Chule koihileh keima eipampai chan chun Pathen, eihinsolpa apampai ahi” ati.
en_web: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
en_kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hileh naseiyu ngaiya chun Kei seijong angai ahin, nang ho pamsea chun Keijong eipamse ahi; Keima eipamsea chun Eihinsolpa geiya apai ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Seijui somsagi leni ho ahung kileuvin, thanom tah in thulhut ahin bol'un ahi. “Pakai, thilhaho jeng jong kathu uvin anunge nangma min kapat ule,” atiuve.
en_web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
en_kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: Som sagi le ni ho chu kipah thanom tah-in ahung kile kit’uvin, “Pakai, Nangma min jal’in thilha ho geiyin kathu’uva anung jenguve,” atiuve.

tcz: “Henge” tin amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Satan van'a kona kolphe banga alhahsuh kamui!
en_web: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Vana kona Satam kolpha banga hung lhasuh kamui.

tcz: Veuvin, keiman nangho galmi thilboltheina chunga thuneina kapeh nahiuve, chule nanghon gul le aipi chunga lam najot diu chule nachilgoi dingu ahi. Imachan nasuhkhah loudiu ahi.
en_web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
en_kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, gul ho le aipi ho chotphana thei, chule melmapa chunga thahat kapeh nahiuvin, imachan nasuhset lou diu ahi.

tcz: Amavang lhagao gilou nathuuva anun jeh in kipah hih'un, ahin van-gam'a namin'u akijihlut jeh joh in kipah un,” ati.
en_web: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
en_kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule lhagao ho nathu’va anunjeh seh chun kipah hih-un, vana naminu akisutjeh-in joh kipahuvin,” ati.

tcz: Hiche pettah chun Yeshua Lhagao Thenga kipana adimset tan, chuin hitin aseiye, “O Hepa, van le lei Pakai, hiche thilho nangman aching le athem'a kigel hoa pat'a naselguh a, chapang ho henga naphondoh jeh in kakipah'e. Henge Pa, hitia kibol hin nangma nalunglhai sah'e,” ati.
en_web: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
en_kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet chun Lhagao Thengin Jesu kipana adimin hijeh chun aman, “Hepa, van le lei Pkai; thil hicheng hi michingte le lungthim themte na-impeh a, milham ho hengjoh a naphondoh jeh-in kapah chai. Henge, Hepa hitia bol hi nadeilam ahiye.

tcz: “Kapan keima imajouse chunga mopohna eipeh ahitai. Pa tailou koiman Chapa chu dihtah in ahepoi, chule Chapa tailou le Chapa in hetsah dinga alhen ho tailouvin koiman Pachu dihtah in ahepoi” ati.
en_web: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
en_kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Thil ijakai ka-pan eipehdoh ahitai; Pa tilouvin Chapa aheon, Chapa le Chapan aphodoh peh mi tilou koiman Pa ahepoi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amaho changseh aumpet un, aman aseijuite heng lam ngan aseiye, “Nathilmu chengseu mu ah mit hochu anunnom e.
en_web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
en_kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
tcz_gospelgo: jesun seijuite lama akiheiyin atumbeh-in, “Nang ho thilmu hi amu jouse vangpha ahiuve.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao ho le lengho tamtah'in nathilmu chengseu hi muding anagaldot jingu ahin, hinlah anamupouve. Chuleh najah houhi jah ding anagaldot jing'u ahin, hinlah anaja pouve,” ati.
en_web: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
en_kjv: for I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, nathilmun hi Themgao tamtah le leng tamtah-in mu atup lheh vangun amupha tapouvin, jehding adei lheh vangun najah tobangu ajapha tapouve,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat hou danthua them khat Yeshua patep dingin adingdoh in hiche thudoh hi adonge, “Houhil, tonsot hinna kanei thei nadia ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
en_kjv: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu patepna din Danthu themho khat adingdoh-in, “Houhil, tonsot kmelou hinna kanei theina dia ipi kabol ding ham?” atileh;

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mose dan in ipi asei em? Iti nasim am?” tin adongtai.
en_web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
en_kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Danthua ipi kisun nasimdoh-em?” ati.

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Nangman nalung pumpin, na lhagao pumpin, na thaneina pumpin, chule nalungthim pumpin Pakai naPathen chu ngailun. Chule nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” tin aseiye ati.
en_web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
en_kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman adonbut’in, “Nangman nalungthim pumpi le nahinkho pumpi, nathahat pumpi le nalung gil pumpia Pakai na-Pathen na ngailut’a chle nangma nakingailut ding ahi akiti,” ati.

tcz: “Adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Hichu bol'in chule nahin ding ahi!” ati.
en_web: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Nadonbut dih lheh-e, hiti chun bol le chun nahin ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mipa chun athilbol them akichan nom'in, hijeh chun Yeshua chu adongin, “Koiham kaheng kakom?” ati.
en_web: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
en_kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
tcz_gospelgo: Ama them akichan nomjehin Jesu jah a, “Kaheng kakom chu koipen ham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Yeshuan thusim khat in adonbut in: “Juda mikhat Jerusalem a pat Jericho lam jon in ajin suh in ahi, chule ama chu lamkah ah migucha michom hon abulu un, aponsil aholhah peh un, avouvin, chule athisa tobang'in lam pang'ah adalha tauve.”
en_web: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Adonbutnan Jesun,’Pasal khat Jerusalema konin Jericho lama avah lut’in, amahon aponsil ahoh lhauvin, avouvin athibang bangin adalha tauve.

tcz: Thempu khat in agatoh khan, hinlah mipa chuva akijam amu mu chun, lampi pang langkhat joh apal in adalhatai.
en_web: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
en_kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet tah hin Thempu khat’in hiche lampi chu ahokhan, mipa chu amudoh phat’in lamchom langa apeldoh tai.

tcz: Hou'in lhachale ho khat agachen chule chukom'a akijam chu amun, ahin aman jong lamsih lang khat ah apeldoh tai.
en_web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
en_kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin Levi mi khat man hikom chu ahinjot pan, mipa chu amudoh phat’in lamchom lang khatma apeldoh kittai.

tcz: “Chuin musit'a um Samaria mikhat ahung pheiyin, mipa amu chun, avoujang nat peh tan ahi.”
en_web: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
en_kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Samaria mi kholjin vah le khat’in ahintoh khan, amudoh phat’in alainatpi lheh jenge.

tcz: Akom ah ache naiyin, Samaria mipa chun akivohna maha chu ajen'in olive thao le ju asunkhum in, atompeh tai. Chuin mipa chu ama sangan chungah ahin puiyin, in khat ah ahin puilut in chukoma chun ajenlen ahi.
en_web: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
en_kjv: and went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipa chu anailut’n amaha chengse atompeh-in, thaotwi lw lengpitwi anun, atouna gancha chunga adomtoh-in, jinlhunin’a ahinpo lut’in ajentai.

tcz: Ajing in in-ngahpa chu dangka cheng ni apen, aseiyin, “Hichepa hi anavesui in. Achunga lutjat hiche sanga atamjoh khah le, kahung kit teng kapeh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
en_kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon denarii ni alan, jinlhun inngahpa apen, ‘Hichepa hi analimbol’in, sum nasuh mangbe leh kahung kit teng sa-nange,’ ati.

tcz: “Tun seiyin hiche mithum ho lah'a chu koipen tah chu hiche mipa gucha michom hon avoh pau dinga aheng akom hi ham?” tin Yeshuan adongtai.
en_web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
