en_kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng mi thum lah a hi gucha michomho lah a vah lutpa heng le kom chu koipen hinte natim?” atileh,

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Akhoto pachu ahi,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Adih'e, tun chenlang chutobang chun gabol tan,” ati.
en_web: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
en_kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: aman, “Ama hepi tah a bolpa chu,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Nang jong chen lang chutin gabol tan,” ati.

tcz: Yeshua le aseijuite Jerusalem lam jona achejing laiyun, khokhat ahung lhung un, chua chun Martha kiti nun a-in'a dingin alemin ahi.
en_web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
en_kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le aseijuite akholjin nauva kho khat’a alut tauvin, Martha kiti numei khat’in a-in’ah alhunsah-e.

tcz: Asopinu Mary chu Pakai kengbul ah atouvin, athuhil chu angaiye.
en_web: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
en_kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hin sopi numei Mary kiti khat aneiyin, ama chu Pakai kengbul’a atouvin aseichan angai ngai jenge.

tcz: Ahivangin Martha chu jan anneh lentah agon jeh chun alunggim in ahi. Yeshua komah ahungin ahung seitai, “Pakai dihtheilou nasah lou khattou ham kasopinu thipbeh a atouva ken natoh jouse katoh? Eihung kithopi na dingin hinsol in,” ati.
en_web: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
en_kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
tcz_gospelgo: Martha vang atoh idng tamjeh-in thu ngai manin aumpon, ahungin, “Pakai, kasopiun kachangseh a na eitohsah hi khoh nasah lou ngap ham? eikithopi din seipeh tang-em,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Pakai in amanu hengah aseiyin, “Ngailut Martha, nangma hitiho jouse chunga hi lunggima lung himo nahi.”
en_web: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
en_kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Martha adonbut’in, “Martha, Martha, thil tampi ngaitoa lung gim nahi.

tcz: “Thilkhat bouseh khohsah le lunggim nading aume. Maryn hichu akimudoh in, chule amanu a kona kilamang thei lou ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
en_kjv: but one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
tcz_gospelgo: Khohsah ding thil khatseh bou ahin, Maryn aphalai akilhentan, kilahpeh kit louhel ding ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Khatvei hi Yeshua munkhat ah taona mangin aume. Ahin chai chun, aseijuite lah'a khat akom'ah ahungin aseiye, “Pakai, taoje neihil'un John in aseijuite ahil bangin” ahung ti.
en_web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Munkhat’a Jesu ataovin, atao jouvin aseijuite khat’in ajah a, “Pakai, JOhn aseijuite taoje aahil bangin taoje neihil’un,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiyin, hitia hi natao dingu ahi: “Hepa, namin chu thengtah in kikoi hen, nalenggam hung lhung loi hen
en_web: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Natao teng hitin seiyun: ‘Pa namin theng kijabol jing hen, Nalenggam hung lhung hen;

tcz: Niseh a kangaichat u anneh nei peuvin
en_web: Give us day by day our daily bread.
en_kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh a kaneh diu anneh neipeuvin,

tcz: Chule kachonset nau ngaidam in, Kachunguva chonse ho kangaidam bangun chule lhepna ah nei lhahlut sah hih'un” ati.
en_web: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
en_kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiba jouseu ka-ngaidam bangun Kachonsetnau jouse ngaidamin; Chonset lo na thei petepnaa neilhut hih-un,’ tiuvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin taoding dan ahilben, hiche thusim hi amangchai: “Tekah nan nangma jankhang kim in naloi nagol in khat'ah nachen, changlhah pheng thum palah ding nadei jal'in naga chetai” Nangman akom'ah naseiyin,
en_web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho khatpenin jol neihan, ama chu jan khangkimin ahenga chehen lang ajah a, ‘Kajol, bat din changlhah pheng thum neipen.

tcz: “Kaloi khat tuchun eivil dingin ahung vailhungin, chule keiman ima nehsah ding kaneipoi, tin nathum tai.”
en_web: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
en_kjv: for a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him:
tcz_gospelgo: Kajol kholjin khat ahun lhungin aneh dia a-ang a luipeh ding ima kaneipoi, ti hen;

tcz: Chuleh tekahnan, ama chun alupna dan sunga kon chun, “Nei houloh tahih in. Kot jong tujana dinga kikhah ahitai, ka insungmi te le keima jong jalkhun'a kabon chauva umah kahi tauve. Nakithopi thei ponge,” ahin ti.
en_web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
en_kjv: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?
tcz_gospelgo: aman insunga konin, ‘Neisu gim hih-in kot akikhah tan, kachate jong kei jong jalkhuna aklumtauve, hung thouva nang ima pethei kahipoi,’ ati.

tcz: Hiche hi kaseipeh nahi–ihamtin ajol le agol ahijeh chun bolhih jongle, nangman kot sottah nasuh suh jenga ahileh, ama thoudoh intin nathil thum chan chu napeh ding ahi, jahcha lou hel'a napansot jeh'a chu, ati.
en_web: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
en_kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, ajol ahijeh chun thova ima peh ding go hih jeng jong leh, khatpan jummo tah a athum tun tun jeh chun thouvintin angaichat jat chu apeh tei ding ahi.

tcz: “Chule hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, thum jing jengun, chule nathum chu namu ding ahi.” Hol jingin chule namu ding ahi. Kot chu kiu jing in chutileh kot chu nakihonpeh ding ahi.
en_web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
en_kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh nahiuve, thumun namu diu ahi, kiuvin kihonpeh ding ahiuve;

tcz: Ajeh chu athum chan'in akisan in, ahol jousen amun. Chule kot kiu jouse akot kihonpeh ding ahi.
en_web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
en_kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile athum chan achangin, ahol’an amun, akiuva akihonpehji.

tcz: Ahilouleh ahtui athum nauva aipi napeh uvam? Henge nape pouve!
en_web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
en_kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
tcz_gospelgo: ahtui athum teng aipi peding’ah?

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangho mi chonsen bon nacha teu thilpha pehje nahet uleh, van'a um napauvin Lhagao Theng iti napehda diu ham athum ho jouse dinga” ati.
en_web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
en_kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
tcz_gospelgo: Migiloutah nang hon bon thilpha pehji nahet’u leh ichan geiya phajoa vana Pa Pathenin ahenga thumte Lhagao Theng apeh ding hitam!” ati.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan mi apaotheilou khat a konin thilha anodoh peh in ahi, chule thilha chu apotdoh jou chun, mipa chu ahung paodoh pan tai. Mihonpi chun kidang asauvin,
en_web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
en_kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thilhavop paomo khat anodoh leh, thilha apotdoh phat’in paomopa chu apao theiyin, mipin kidang asalheh jengui.

tcz: ahin miphabep khat chun, “Athilha nodoh chu lungdon ding ahipoi. Aman athilbol theina khu Satan, thilhate lengpa'a kona amu ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
en_kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi phabep’in vang, “Thilha ho nodohna dinga thilha lengpa Beelzebul’in tha apeh hibouva hi,” atiuve.

tcz: Adanghon, Yeshua patep nom nan, van'a kon melchihna kidang, athaneina photchetna a avetsah dingin angeh un ahi.
en_web: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
en_kjv: And other, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Konkhat man apatepnan vana kona melchihna avetsah diuvin a-ngeh-ui.

tcz: Alunggel u ahetan, hijeh chun aman aseitai, “Itobang lenggam hileh khat le khat kidouna a kibung khen kiti chu amangthah ding ahi. Insungkhat jong kidouna a kibung khen chu lhulham ding ahi.
en_web: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
en_kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
tcz_gospelgo: Alung gel’u ahen Jesun ajah-uvah, “Lenggam kikhentel’a ama le ama kidouva chu amangthah jin, insung kkhen tel jong alhujin ahi.

tcz: Nanghon keima Satan in eisuh thahat danin naseiyuve. Ahin Satan chu akikhentel'a ama le ama akidou le alenggam chu iti khantou tantem?
en_web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
en_kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
tcz_gospelgo: Satan jong kikhentel hen kidouto leh alenggam iti dinjou ding ham? Beelzebul kamanchah a thilha ho nodoh a neisei jeh-uva kasei ahi.

tcz: Chuleh kei chu Satan suhthahat kahi leh, nalah uva thilha nodoh ho la? Amahon jong thilha anodoh u ahi, hijeh a chu amahon nathusei jeh uva chu nahin dem diu ahi.
en_web: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
en_kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken thilha ho nodohna dia Beelzebul kamanchah leh nachateuvin koiba amanchah hiu ham? Hijeh a chu nachatauvin thammo nachan diu ahi.

tcz: Amavang keiman Pathen thahatna jal'a thilha kanodoh ahileh, Pathen lenggam chu nalah uva hunglhung ahitai.
en_web: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
en_kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilha ho nodohna dinga Pathen khutjung kaman ahivangleh Pathen lenggam nalah-uva hung lhung ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Satan banga mihat tah khat chu amanchah kimkeiya akivon a a'inpi akiventup teng leh anei agou ho bit ahi–
en_web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
en_kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
tcz_gospelgo: Mihat’in manchah akipat’a a-in aki-nga laisen anei chengse ahoiye;

tcz: ama sanga thahatjo khat'in ahung bulhu a, athaneina alahmanga, agal manchah achom'a, chule anei agou apoh mang ho ahopcheh kah'a chu.
en_web: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
en_kjv: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
tcz_gospelgo: mihatjon abulna ajotho teng vangleh akisonna galvon alahpeh jin, athil ho chompeh-in ahomjaljitai.

tcz: Koi hileh keimatoh pangkhom lou chu eidoudal ahi, chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.”
en_web: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
en_kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Keilama pang lou chu eidouvah ahin, eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahiye.

tcz: Lhagao gilou khat in mihem khat adalhah teng leh, nelgam lah dungah achejin, kicholna ding mun aholjin ahi. Ahin khatcha amulou teng leh aseijin, “Kahungdoh na mipa koma kile tange,” ati.
en_web: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
en_kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lhagaoboh chu mihem sunga kona apotdoh tengleh twibeina muntin’a avah len, choldo mun aholjie. Mun amu lou teng leh, “Kahung potdohna ka-in’a chun kile kit tange,’ atiji.

tcz: Hijeh chun akilen ahileh ana umnasa in chu akitheh thengsel'a chule kitup sel'a aumchu amun ahi.
en_web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
en_kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung leh akitheh ngima akigontoh amui.

tcz: “Chuin hiche lhagao chun ama sanga giloujo lhagao sagi ma amun, chule amaho abon'un hiche mipa sunga chun alut un aching tauve. Chuin chuche mipa chu amasa'a sangin akhoh cheh jitai,” ati.
en_web: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
en_kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin achen ama sanga gilou cheh lhagao sagi agapuiyin, mipa sunga chun alut’un achengtauve; chutah chun mipa um chan hi amasaa sangin akhoh cheh jon ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hitia thu asei lai chun, mihonpi lah'a kon chun numei khat in ahin kouvin, “Pathen in nanu phattheiboh hen–nahung kondoh na naobu, chule nahin chep noi jong,” ati.
en_web: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lift up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hiche hi asei nalaiyin, mipi lah a pangin numei khat’in ahinsamin, “Navop’a noitwiya navahdoh numei chu anun nom’e,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ahin hiche sanga chu Pathen thu ja'a anatoh a podoh ho chu anunnom cheh ahiuve” ati.
en_web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
en_kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun vang, “Pathen Thupha ngaiya nit ho chu anun nomjoi,” ati.

tcz: Mihonpin Yeshua anehchin to laitah in, aman hitin aseiye, “Hiche khang gilou hin melchihna kidang kavetsah dingin asei sei jenguvin; ahin melchihna kapeh ding chu Jonah melchihna bouseh hiding ahi.
en_web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
en_kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi ahung kikhopsoh phat’un Jesun, “Hiche khang hi khang gilou ahi, melchihna ahol vangun Jonah melchihna tilou adang kipe louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Ama chunga thilsoh chengchu Pathen in Nineveh mite henga asol ahi ti melchihna ahi. Mihem Chapa chunga thilsoh jong hiche miho dinga Pathen sol ahi melchihna ahi.”
en_web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
en_kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonah Nineveh kho mite dia melchihna ahibanga, Mihem Chapa hiche khanga dia melchihna pang ding ahi.

tcz: “Sheba lengnun, thupi kitan nikho leh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh ding themmo achanding ahi, ijeh inem itile ama mun gamlatah a konin Solomon chihna thungai dingin ahunge. Tun Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin nanghon athu nangai pouve.
en_web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
en_kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhang gam lengnu chu hiche khang mite toh hung thoudoh khoma thupi tannaa amaho themmo achansah ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile ama chu leiset kolmonga konin Solomon chih thu ngai din ahungin, ahinla ven, Solomon sanga loupijo khat hikoma aume.

tcz: Nineveh khomite jong thupi kitan nileh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh diu chule themmo achandiu ahi. Ijeh inem itile amahon Jonah thuseiya konin achonset nauva kon lungheina aneiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin, nanghon athu nangaipouve.”
en_web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
en_kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
tcz_gospelgo: Nineveh kho mite toh chu hiche khang mite toh hung thoudoh khoma thupi tannaa hiche khang mite hi themmo achansah diu ahi; ajeh chu amahn Jonah thusei phongin lung aheiyuve; ahinla ven, Jonah sanga loupijo khat hikoma aume.

tcz: “Koiman meivah avah in chule aselmang in ahilouleh lo akhukhum ngaipoi. Chusang chun, meivah atunna ah akitung jin, chua kon chun insung lut jousen avah amuthei bou uve.”
en_web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
en_kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koiman mei avah-in ningchong muthim’ah akoi ngaipon, lo jong akhu khum ngaipoi; ahung lut chan muthei din meivah khom chunga atungji bouve.

tcz: “Namit chu natahsa dinga vah hinpedoh meivah ahi. Namit chu ahoi laisea, natichung pumpi chu vah dimset ahi. Ahin, aphatmo teng, natichung chu mithum in atom ahi.
en_web: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
en_kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Namit hi natahsa meivah ahin, namit achim laisen natahsa pumpi avah-in, achim lou teng natipumpi athimjitai.

tcz: Vah kaneiye tia nakigel chu muthim tahtah ahipoi ti kiphot chen in.
en_web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
en_kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasunga um vah chu thim am avephan.

tcz: Vah'a chu nadimset'a, aning akah a muthim behlou nahileh, na hinkho pumpi chu, meivah vahtah in asalvah banga vahset ding ahi.” ati
en_web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
en_kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
tcz_gospelgo: Athimkom beihel’a natahsa pumpi avah leh meivah vah tah-in nasalvah banga apumpia vah jeng ding ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan thu aseilaiyin, Pharisee holah'a khat'in a-in'a anne ding in atem'in ahi. Hijeh chun ama alut in dokhanga atouna mun alotai.
en_web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
en_kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
tcz_gospelgo: ″Jesun thu asei chai phat’in Pharisee khat hin an nehpi din akouve; ama achen ankong aumtai.

tcz: A an-vailhun pan, amasa'a Juda chondan a khutsil bollouva an nedia atoulhah jeng chu amun adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
en_web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
en_kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin an neh kona akisil lou chu Phariseepan adatmo lheh-e.

tcz: Chuin Pakai chun amapa jah'a, “Nangho Pharisee hohin khon le lheng apolam siltheng chingthei tah'in nabol'un, ahin asunglam vang anen–kiloset nale gitlouna a dimset nahiuve!
en_web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakayin ajah a, “Tun ahile Pharisee nang hon khon le lheng apolam nasil ngim’un, nasungu la hunamalah le gitlou dimset ahi.

tcz: Vo mingol! Pathen in asung jong chule apolam jong asem gel hilou ham?
en_web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
en_kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthimbei ho, apolam sempan asung lam jong asem hilou ham?

tcz: Hijeh chun asung lang jong mivaicha ho thilpeh peh'a konin kisutheng un, chutile apumpia nathen dingu ahitai.”
en_web: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
en_kjv: But rather give alms of such things as you have; and behold, all things are clean unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun asunga thil ho chu vaichate peuvin, chuteng ven, nang ho dia thil jouse theng ding ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ajeh chu nanghon som'a khat nahon sung uva anche aneopen geiyin natoh dimdem'un, hinlah adih'a thutan le Pathen ngailut nakhohsah pouve. Henge, somakhat napeh diu mong ahinai ahivangin athupijo thilho notthap hih'un.”
en_web: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
en_kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe, tun vang Pharisee nadau ahi! Nang hon pudina le louna kha geiyin, anche louhing jousea soma khat napeuvin, thu adih-in natanpouvin, Pathen ngailut ding nadonpouve. Adang ho nabol’u toh kitoh a hiche te ni jong nabol diu ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ijeh inem itile nanghon kikhopna in dunga touna thupi hoa tou le kailhang mun lah'a navale nauva min chibai naboh ding nadeiyun ahi.
en_web: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
en_kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe Pharisee ho ada nahiuve! Nang hon Houthua kikhop na indunga touna pha pha nalhengun, kailhanga min nasalam diu nadeiyui.

tcz: Henge ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam! Ijeh inem itile nangho loulaiya lhankhuh kiselguh tobang nahiuve. Mihon lepthol kibol chu helouvin achungah lam ajot un ahi” ati.
en_web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
en_kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe ada nahoiuve! Heshen louva mihon achotpeh peh buikhuh ho tobang nahitauve,” ati.

tcz: “Houhil” tin Hou danthu them khat in ahinkouvin, “Nathusei chun keiho jong eisujum uve,” ati.
en_web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
en_kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
tcz_gospelgo: “Danthu them ho khat’in adonbut’in, “Houhil, hiche naseiho hin keiho nei-engkal’uve,” ati.

tcz: “Henge,” tin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu themho!” Ajeh chu nanghon pohjou lou ding houthua ngehna nasem uvin mipi na sugenthei uvin, hinlah nakhut jung khat jong apohgih'u ngaijang peh nadingin nalam khapouve.
en_web: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
en_kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Ohe, Danthu them nang ho jong ada nahiuve; Poh jouhoi hilou pohgih hahsa mi nagonpeh-un, nang hon nakhut muh jenga jong khoiloh din nagopouve.

tcz: Lungkham na itobangin nangau hitam! Napu napa teuvin malaiya anathau themgao ho lhan nasem uvin ahi.
en_web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
en_kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ohe nadau ahi! Napu napateuvin Themgao ho athat’un, nang hon alhanu nasempeh-ui.

tcz: Ahin tahbeh in, napu napa teuvin anabolkhel u napom u vetsahna a ahetoh'a napan u ahitai. Amahon themgaoho anathat'un, chule nanghon amaho najopnau photchetnan alhan nasem uve!
en_web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
en_kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateu thilbol chengse chu phatsah a ahettohsah nahiuvin, amaho athat’a pang’a nang hon alhan nasempeh-u ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen in achihna a nangho chungchang anasei chu, Keiman themgao le solchah ahenguva kasol ding, ahivanga amahon abang athauva abang abolset diu ahi.
en_web: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
en_kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen chihnan aseiyin, ‘Keinan nalha-uva Themgao ho le solle ho kasol ding, hiche ho chu abang bang athauva, adang abol hesoh diu ahi,’ ati.

tcz: “Chutia chu hiche khang mite hi vannoi kiphudoh a pat Pathen themgao kithat ho jouse chunga mopo diu ahi.”
en_web: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
en_kjv: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu vannoi kisemtil’a pat Themgao ho thisan kiso jouse hiche khang mite chunga hi,

tcz: Abel kitha a pat a Zechariah, maicham le muntheng kikah a kithat pa geiya hiche khang mite kingoh ding ahi.
en_web: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
en_kjv: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Abel thisana pat, maicham le muntheng kah a Zechariah thisan kiso geiya phu lahna ding ahi. Henge, kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche khanga hi aphu kila ding ahi.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu them ho! Ajeh chu mipi a kon'in hetna kot-heh mihoa konin naladoh un, nangho tah jong lenggam sungah nalut pouve, chule adang alut ding jong najada uve,” ati.
en_web: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
en_kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ohe Danthu themho nadau ahi! Hetna kot-heh nala mangun, nang ho geiyin nalut pouvin, lutkigo ho jong nalutsah pouve,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adalhah got toh kilhon in, hou danthu hilho Pharisee ho chun ahin galmimu cheh cheh un, chule thudoh tamtah doh a suh lunghang ding agouvin ahi.
en_web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
en_kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chukoma kona apotdoh phat’in Danthu them ho le Pharisee ho alung himo lheh jengun thu tampi adong lhoiyun,

tcz: Amahon thangkol'a osah ding hehset nathei thuseidoh sah ding atiu ahi.
en_web: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
en_kjv: laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
tcz_gospelgo: athuseiya mat din achang lhigeh jenguvin ahi.

tcz: Hiche pet chun, mihonpi chu asang ajan ahung khang in akisucheh chuh un chule khat le khat kichonkha ton aumun, Yeshuan hichun aseijuite henglam ahin ngan agih sal in, “Pharisee ho chol a konin kihong phauvin”—aphat lhemnauva kon'in.
en_web: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
en_kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi asang sang akikhop’a khat’in khat chunga lam ajot leu phat’un amasan Jesun aseijuite jah a aseiyin, “Pharisee ho phat lhemna chol lah a kiging phauvin.

tcz: Phat ahung lhunge, thil akikhukhum jouse kiphongdoh ding ahi, chule aguh'a umjouse jong mijouse koma kihetsah ding ahi.
en_web: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
en_kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
tcz_gospelgo: Hodoh lou dia kikhu khum aumpon, hetdoh lou dia kiselguh jong aumpoi;

tcz: Muthim'a nasei jouseu chu khovah a kija ding ahi, chule kot kikhakhum na a olcha nakiseipeh toujong chu inchunga mijouse jah'a kisamphong ding ahi! Gin Ding Koipen Ham?
en_web: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
en_kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu muthima naseiyu khovah akija ding, indan sung nunga mi nabenga naseiyu chu intingvuma kisap tho ding ahi.

tcz: “Ngailut umtah jol le gol te, natahsa that thei hochu kicha hih'un.” Hiche jou le chun nachungah ima abolthei tapouve.
en_web: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
en_kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kagol kapai nang ho jah a kasei ahi, tahsa thah theiya abana ima bol thei louho kicha hih hel’un.

tcz: Ahin kichat ding koi ham naseipeh unge. Pathen kichauvin, aman nangho tha nathei le damun'a lelut nathei thilboltheina tha anei ahi. Henge, ama ahi kichat ding.
en_web: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
en_kjv: But I will forewarn you whom you shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
tcz_gospelgo: Gin ding pentah vetsah unge: mithat’a da muna lelutna tah neiya Pathen bou gingun. Henge, kaseipeh nahiuve, Amabou ginguvin!

tcz: “Vasah nga man ijat ham–paisa ni man ham?” Ahin Pathen in khat jeng jong asumil pon ahi.
en_web: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
en_kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vasah nga khu Paisa ni man a kijohji lou ham? Ahin alah-uva khat jeng cha jong Pathen ang’ah suhmil’in aumpoi.

tcz: Chuleh nalu'a na samjang ho jengjong aboncha kisimtoh soh ahitai. Hijeh chun kicha hih'un; nangma vasah honpi jouse sanga manlujo nahi.
en_web: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
en_kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalu chunguva nasamjang jouseu geiya simtohsa kikoi ahi; kicha hih-un, vasah tampi sanga jong nang ho manlujo nahiuve.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh hiche leiset'a lhangphonga keima eiseidoh chan chu, Mihem Chapan jong Pathen Vantilte jaona'a aseidoh ding ahi.
en_web: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
en_kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hi le mihem angsunga Keima eiphongdoh chan chu Mihem Chapan jong Pathen Vantilte angsunga aphondoh sing ahi.

tcz: Amavang koi hileh hiche leiset'a eiseilep chan chu Pathen Vantilte masanga kiseilep diu ahi.
en_web: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
en_kjv: but he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hi le mihem angsunga eiseileppa chu Pathen Vantilte angsunga seilep’a um ding ahi.

tcz: Koihileh Mihem Chapa douna thusei chan chu kingaidam ding ahi, amavang koi hileh Lhagao Theng taitom'ah vang chu kingaidam louding ahi.
en_web: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
en_kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hi le Mihem Chapa douna thusei chu ngaidam chang ding, Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi.

tcz: “Chuleh kikhopna in'a vaipo hole thuneiho anga athu tan dinga nahin kai teng uleh, iti nakiven ding ham ahiloule ipi nasei ding thu ah lunggim hih un.
en_web: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;
en_kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Houthua kikhopna in dung le vaibol ho angsung, chule thunei ho angsunga nakailut tengu leh iti nakihon’a ipi nasei diu lungkham hih-un,

tcz: Ajeh chu Lhagao Theng chun apettah a seiding napeh diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
en_kjv: for the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
tcz_gospelgo: ipipen nasei diu apettah le Lhagao Thengin nahil nauvinte,” ati.

tcz: Chuin koiham khat'in mipi lah'a kon chun ahin kouvin, “Houhil, kasopipa jah'a kapa nei le gou eikihoppi nadingin seiyin,” ati.
en_web: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
en_kjv: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi lah a konin mi khat’in Jesu jah a, “Houhil, kasopipan gou eikihoppi din seipeh-in,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Jol, kon nangni kah'a thutan'a eipansah'a, hiti khati iti kagel lhah ding ham?” ati.
en_web: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Jol, nangni chunga thutan ding le thil hoppeh dia kon eitun beh em?” ati.

tcz: Chuin aman aseiben, “Chingtheiyun! Neipap kiloset kiti jouseah kivengun. Hinkho hi naneijat a kisim ahipoi,” ati.
en_web: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uvah, “Chingtheiyun neipap kiloset’a konin kikangseuvin, ajeh chu nei le gou bulhin jeh a mihem hing’ah ahidehpoi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin aman thusim khat aseipeh tai: “Mihao khat hin loumun khat, alei phatah, ga hoitah tah sodoh aneiyin ahi.
en_web: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
en_kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman thulem khat aseiyin, “Mihao khat louva neh le chah apung lheh-in,

tcz: Amapa achangin akihoulim in, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam? Ka lousoh ga jouse koina ding mun la kanei pon,’” ati.
en_web: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
en_kjv: and he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun aman, “Ipi kabol ding ham? Kalhosoh kholna idng mun a-ong tapoi,’ atin,

tcz: Chuin aman aseiyin, Kahetai! Kachangsal jouse phelhangting asanga lenjo cheh thahsah inge. Chutileh keiman ka chang le mim jouse kholkhomna ding dan ninglhingset in nei tange.
en_web: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
en_kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitin bol inge, kachangsal ho phe lhang ting asanga lencheh sange; hikoma kasuhlou chang jouse leh thil dang jouse koitange;

tcz: Chutengleh keima nomtah'a katouva keima le keiman hitia hi kasei ding ahi, “Kajol, nangman kumsottah a ding ninglhing set'a kikhol khom naneiye. Tun lung olmo hih in! nen lang, don'in lang, chule kipah in!” tinge ati.
en_web: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’
en_kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
tcz_gospelgo: chutengleh, “Kahinkho, kum tamtah nahding thil lhing set’in nakholsoh tai, choldon, nen, donin nomsa tah-in um tan,” tinge,’ ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Pathen in amapa jah'a chun, “Mingol! Tujan ma ma'a nathi ding ahitai. Chuteng leh nanatoh ga jouse hi koi chang tantem?” ati.
en_web: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
en_kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathenin ajah a, Mi-ngol, tujan teng nahinkho kisubei ding ahitai, hichea kholsa thil jouse hi koi chang ding hitam?’ ati.

tcz: “Henge, lei gouthil bouseh kholkhom'a Pathen toh haosatah'a kiguijopna neilou mi chu angol ahi” ati.
en_web: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
en_kjv: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich towards God.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hitobang mi hi ama chang dia gou khol’a Pathen lama hao lou ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin, aseijuite kom lang ngan Yeshuan aseitai, “Hiche jeh'a hi keiman nitin hinkho a dingin lunggim hih'un kati ahi”—neh le chah ninglhing set'a chule sil le chen lhingset'a kanei ding hinam tin.
en_web: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
en_kjv: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun seijuite jah a, “Hichejeh a chu ipi naneh-uva chule ipinasil’uva nachen diu natahsa din lungkham hih-un kati ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu hinkho hi anneh ding sanga lujo, chule natahsa jong sille chen sanga lujo ahi.
en_web: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
en_kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinkho hi neh le chah sanga thupijo ahin, tahsa jong nihchen ponsil sanga thupijo ahi.

tcz: Va-ah ho khu veuvin, amahon tula atu pouvin, at la a-at pouvin ahiloule khol la akholkhom pouvin, ajeh chu Pathen in avahnai. Chule nangho vacha ho sanga ama dinga loupijo nahiuve!
en_web: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
en_kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
tcz_gospelgo: va-ahte khu gel’un; muchi la atupouvin, atjong a-at pouvin, akholna ding in hihen changsal hijongle aneipouve; ahinla Pathenin avah nauve. Nang ho vachate sanga thupijo nahiuve.

tcz: Nalunggim nau jousen nahinkho phat bihkhat ajopbe theiyem?
en_web: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
en_kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho koipen hin lungkham hat vanga ahinkho tong chan ajopbe theiyem?

tcz: Chule lunggim nan imacha chutobang thil neocha jong alolhin sah theilouleh, thil lentah chunga jong lunggim chu ipi phachom ding ham?
en_web: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
en_kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
tcz_gospelgo: Chutia aneopen bon nabol thei louvu leh, thil dang dia iti lungkham nahiuvem?

tcz: “Lily pah ho le akhan doh dan khu veuvin. Amahon na jong atong pouvin chule avon hou jong akisem thei pouvin, ahin, Solomon jeng jong, aloupina jouse a akivon chun amaho tobang lom'in ahoijou poi.
en_web: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
en_kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
tcz_gospelgo: Lily pah ho khu iti khan ham ngaitouvin; natong jong ahipovin, thilkhuijong ahipouve; ahinla kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong athil loupi chengsea akijep vangin hiche ho khat sangin akijemhoi joupoi.

tcz: Chuleh Pathen in pahcha ho tunia uma jing a meilhum sunga selut ding bon kidangtah'a akhohsah'a ahileh, aman nangma thonlouva nakhohsah teitei ding ahi. Ipi bol'a hibanga tahsan na neo hi naneiyu ham?”
en_web: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
en_kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin hitobanga tunia loujaova keh jing teng meilhum sunga kileh lut tading hampa bon achuti jep hoi leh, vo tahsan lhom ho, nang ho ichan geiya nakhohsah-uva nihchen ponsil napeh diu hitam!

tcz: “Chuleh ipi kaneh ding ham ipi kadon ding ham tin lungboi hih'un. Hiche ho thil'a chun lunggim hih'un.
en_web: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
en_kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu neh le don ding gel’a nalunggim louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche thil hohin vannoi pumpia atahsanlou ho lungsung alodim'in ahi, ahivangin Napauvin nangaichat changseu chu ahemasa jitai.
en_web: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
en_kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi namtinin hichengse hi abol’u ahin, nang ho ding vang napauvin ahesoh nai.

tcz: Pathen lenggam chu thil jouse sangin hol'un, chule aman nangaichat chan'u napeh diu ahi.”
en_web: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
en_kjv: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Alenggam joh hol masauvin, chuteng hichengse jong nakipehbe nauvinte.

tcz: “Hijeh chun kicha hih'un, hon lhom ho, ajeh chu nangho lenggam peh ding hi napau dinga kipana lentah ahi.”
en_web: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
en_kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kicha hih-un hon lhom ho, nang ho na-Pauvin lenggam napeh nom’ui.

tcz: “Nanei nagou ho joh'un lang angaicha ho peuvin. Hichun van'a gou nakhol peh dingu ahi! Chule van-gam a sumdip hon chultih aneipouvin chule atovang aum khapoi. Nagou khol chu bitkeiya umding ahi; guchan jong aguhmang theilou ding ahi chule nget'in jong asuhset thei lou ding ahi.”
en_web: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
en_kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanei chengse joh-un lang vaichate to nan neiyun, guchan anailutna thei lou, nget’in jong asuhset thei louna vana kemlouva akikholna din sum bei theilou sumbom kisemun.

tcz: Nanei nagou umna'a chu nalung ngaichat jong aum ding ahi. Hetman Louva Yeshua Hung Kit Ding
en_web: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
en_kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nagou umnaa chu nalungthimu jong cheng jing ding ahi.

tcz: “Natohna dingin kivontup san umun chule nathaomei vahjing'un;
en_web: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
en_kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
tcz_gospelgo: “Nakong kigah-un nathaomei devah jingun.

tcz: Na Pakai pa moupui golvah na'a kon ahung kile ding nanga bangin. Chutileh ahung lhun'a kot ahinsuh teng leh kot nahonpeh a nalutsah thei nadia phasadema naum ding ahi.
en_web: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
en_kjv: and ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
tcz_gospelgo: KIchen golvahna ahung kilea kot akiu leh honpeh dia apu hung ding kho the ngaigeh miho tobang hiuvin.

tcz: Soh ho kiging jinga umho le ahung kile ding ngah jing ho chu kipaman kipediu ahi. Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, amatah in amaho chu atousah ding, atai akikhi ding, amaho chu atou uva aneh laiyuva chu ajen ding ahi.
en_web: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.
en_kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
tcz_gospelgo: Apupa ahung kit teng kiging jinga um ahung tokhah lhacha ho chu anun nom’ui. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, apun kong kigah-in tin, amaho ankong phunga atousah a, amatah ajenleuva pang ding ahi.

tcz: Ama jankim lah ahilou le khovah kon'a hung maithei ahi. Ahin, ahung pet a kiging jinga um sohte chu kipaman apehding ahiuve.”
en_web: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.
en_kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khangkimin hung hen, jing lam nida thumin hung jong leh, kiging jinga um atokhah ho chu nun nom ahiuve.

tcz: “Hiche hi hethem in, in-neipan itih phatchet'a gucha hung ding ham ti heleh, aman a-in chu veihonga aumsah lou ding ahi.
en_web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
en_kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
tcz_gospelgo: Inneipan gucha hung ding phat heleh a-in chu aphetvang sah louhel ding kichentah-in naheuve.

tcz: Nangjong kiging jinga naum jing ding ahi ijeh inem itile Mihem Chapa chu naginchat lou pettah uva hung ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
en_kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
tcz_gospelgo: Naginchat loupet tah-uva Mihem Chapa hung ding jeh-in nang ho jong kigingsa demin umun, “ati.

tcz: Peter in adong in, “Pakai hiche thutekah chu keihoa ding bou hai mijousea ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
en_kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin, “Pakai, hiche thulem hi keiho dia naseiha, mipi jah dia naseiham?” tin adonge.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Soh kitah le lung limgeh chu apakai pan insung pumpi le sohdang ho chunga jong mopohna apeh'a avahsah ho chu ahi.
en_web: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Tahsan um lemiching, apun aphat cha soh dang ho neh le chah hopehji dia anganse ding neiching michu koi hitem?

tcz: Apakai pa ahung kile a asohpan na phatah'a atoh ahung mu leh, kipaman umding ahi.”
en_web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
en_kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
tcz_gospelgo: Apu inlama ahung teng anatoh pet atolhah soh chu anun nom’e.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang soh chu apakai pan anei jouse chunga mopohna apehding ahi.
en_web: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
en_kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
tcz_gospelgo: Dihtah akaseipeh nahiuve, ama chu apun anei jouse chunga vaipoa apansah ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah, iti tantem asohpa chun, “Kapakai pa hi tem'in hung ponte” tin gelhen lang, asohdang ho vo hen, neh nom ne hen, ju kham kham jeng taleh?
en_web: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,
en_kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama vang sohpa khat hin, ‘Kapu ahung gei lheh tai,’ tihen lang soh pasal ho le numei ho vopan hen, aneh nom nehen adon nom don kham leh,

tcz: Apakai pachu seiphong masa lou leh ginchat umlou pettah in hungin tin, chuteng aman asohpa chu asat goi goi ding mikitah louho toh asolmang tha ding ahitai.
en_web: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
en_kjv: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not ware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche soh chun agel loupet tah le ahet loupet tah a apu hunga ama chu tumin aso ding, tahsanbei ho toh kibanga abolding ahi.

tcz: “Chule soh khat apakai pa dei he'a, ahivanga kigongtup lou chule akihilchah na ho tongdoh lou chu, nasatah a bolgimna ato ding ahi.
en_web: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
en_kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
tcz_gospelgo: “Apu dei chengse hea, ahivanga adei banga gonpeh lou, toh jong tohpeh loupa chu tamtah vei kijep ding ahi;

tcz: Ahivanga ahelou khattou chun thilse abol leh, ama chu gihsa louva kigimbol ding ahi. Koiham khat chu tamtah akipeh le, ama a kona chu tamtah kile ngeh ding ahi; chuleh khattou chu mopohna tamtah akipeh le, asanga tamjo chu kingeh ding ahi.”
en_web: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
en_kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang apu dei helouva kivoh lo na thei boldohpa chu kivo lhomjo ding ahi. Tamtah kipea chu tampi kibeng ding, thil tamtah a ki-nganse paa kona jong tampi ki-ngeh ding ahiye.

tcz: “Keima vannoi hi meiya tih dinga kahung ahi, chule akoudoh hitaleh katilheh jenge!
en_web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
en_kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
tcz_gospelgo: “Leiset’a mei hal’a hung kahi, hung kadoh jeng ta leh kati nave!

tcz: Keiman thoh hahsa tah baptize chanding kamakho'ah kaneiye chule hichu akimolso kah a kalung khamna iti san tam!
en_web: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
en_kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman baptize chan ding khat kaneiyin, akimolso kah a iti kaning noh hitam!!

tcz: Leiset a chamna hinpo dinga hunga nei gel'um? Ahipoi, keima miho kibung khensah dia hung'ah kahi!
en_web: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
en_kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a chambol’a hunga neigal’um? ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, kikhenna boljoh kahibouve.

tcz: Tua pat'a insung ho kikhentel diu ahitai, thum'in eijop uva, nin eidoudal ding–ahiloule nin eijop'a thum'in eidou ding ahi.
en_web: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
en_kjv: for from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu tua pat mi nga chenna insung chu kikhentel’a, mithumin ni adouva, nin thum adou ding;

tcz: Mipa chu chapa douna'a chule chapa chu mipa douna a kibungkhen ding ahi; chanu douna minu chule minu douna'a chanu; chuleh ateh in mou douna chule mouvin ateh douna'a kikhenna um ding ahi” ati. Phat Kihei-Dan Hetna
en_web: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
en_kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
tcz_gospelgo: pan achapa adouva, chapan pa adou ding; nun chanu adouva, chanun nu adou ding; tehpin amou nu adouva, mou nun tehpi adou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi lam aven aseiye, “Nanghon meibol lhumlam langa ahung umdoh phat le, nasei jiuvin, ‘go hung juding ahi’ natiuve. Chuleh nangho nadih uve.
en_web: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
en_kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mipi jah a, “Lhumlama meilom kikhom namu tengu ‘Go ju ding ahi,’ natipai jengun, jujong ajuji nai.

tcz: Lhanglam hui ahung nun teng leh, naseijiuvin, ‘Tuni chu salheh ding ahi’ natiuvin, chule achuti ji'e.
en_web: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
en_kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhang lam hui nun namu tengu ‘Sa ding ahi,’ natiuvin, sajong asai.

tcz: Nangho mingolho! nanghon leiset chunga van umje nasuto theiyun, ahin nanghon tuphat umdan naledoh thei pouve.”
en_web: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
en_kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo vanthamjol um ehan bon nasuhto theiyu leh iti tulai thil um chan nasuhto thei louvu ham?

tcz: “Ipi jeh'a nangho dinga adih chu naki gellhah thei lou u ham?”
en_web: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
en_kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
tcz_gospelgo: “Ibol’a thildih bolje kihil lou nahiuvem?

tcz: “Nangho thukitanna muna nahehse hou toh nache teng uleh, amun nalhun masang in kihoutoh pi ding gon. Achuti louleh thutan vaihompa masanga nahehse pan nakai ding, aman vaipopa henga napehdoh a, aman songkul'a nakhum ding ahi.
en_web: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
en_kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahehpa toh thutanpa heng najot lhon teng le lampia kihouchampi din gel’in, ajo le thutanpan vaibol henga napehdoh a, vaibol pan songkul’a nakhum ding ahi.

tcz: Chule hichu aso leh nangman achainapen sum geiya napeh doh masang sea itinama jong leh nakilhadoh louhel ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
en_kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahi, nabet jat nasah thenghel masanga nahung potdoh thei louhel ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin Pilate in Galilee gam mi phabep'in Hou'in a kilhaina gantha abollaiyun athat'e tithu Yeshua seipeh in aumin ahi.
en_web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
en_kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet tah chun mi phabep ahungun Pilate’n Galilee miho athaa athisanu doihouna thil toh achopel thu Jesu jah a aseiyui.

tcz: “Hiche Galilee miho chu Galilee gam midang ho jouse sanga chonse joa nangaito uvam?” tin Yeshuan adongin, “Hijeh a chu chutia thoh genthei athoh u ahi natiuvem?
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Hitobang thi gentheiya athijeh-uva chu Galilee midang ho sanga chonsejoa nagel’uvem?

tcz: Ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, nalung nahei uva Pathen lam'a nakihei lou uleh nangho jong mangthah ding nahiuve.
en_web: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
en_kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahipoi, najah-uva kasei ahi, lung nahei louvu leh ama ho banga namanthah soh hel diu ahiye.

tcz: Chuleh Siloam inting achima adellih mi somleget hochu la? Amaho chu Jerusalem a dinga michonse pen ho hitauvam?
en_web: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
en_kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahiloule Siloam intingvum achima adel lih mi som le get ho chu Jerusalema cheng midang jouse sanga chonsejoa nagel’uvem?

tcz: Ahipoi, chule kaseipeh kit nahiuve, nalung nahei lou uleh namanthah diu ahi” ati.
en_web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
en_kjv: I tell you, Nay: but except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahidehpoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, lung nahei louvu leh amaho banga chu namanthah cheh diu ahiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi ahinseiye: “Mikhat in ahonsung ah theichang phungkhat atun chule avel vel in aga umding ham tin ahung ve jin, hinlah amapa alung lhalheh jeng jin ahi.
en_web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
en_kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
tcz_gospelgo: jesun miho chu hiche thulem hi aseipeh-in, “Mi khat’in alengpi leiya theichang phung khat aneiyin, aga ahung hol leh amupoi.

tcz: Achainan honlhou pa jah'a, Kumthum hulteh kanga ahitai, ahin tuchan'in theichang khatbeh jong aga poi! Phuhlhu uvin,” ati. Honsungah mun alobep seuvin anohphah e, ati.
en_web: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’
en_kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
tcz_gospelgo: Aman honbolpa jah a, ‘Kumthum alhing tan, hiche theichang phung hi kahungvet le aga khat cha kamudohpoi, hijeh chun phuh lhu tan, leiset pamaisah a ikhoh a kihoi hoi ding ham?’ atileh;

tcz: “Hon lhoupan adonbut in, ‘Pakai phat khatvei peh ben, kumkhat umsah ben, chule keiman phatechan vesui ingting leiphat na ding tampi sung inge.
en_web: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
en_kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
tcz_gospelgo: honbolpan adonbut’in, ‘Pakai, tukum jong hoitadin keiman akimvel leiying ting leiphatna lou sung nange;

tcz: Khovei leh theichang imu le aphai. Imulou uleh, na phuhlhuh thei ahitai’ ati” tin aseiye.
en_web: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
en_kjv: and if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
tcz_gospelgo: chujou teng ahung ga nah leh aphan, aga lou vang leh phuh lhu tan nate,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Cholngah ni khat hi Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet hin,
en_web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
en_kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nin Jesun Houthua kikhopna in khat’a thu ahil’e.

tcz: Numei khat lhagaoboh in lam jot moa alha amui. Kum somleget jen tingbong'a dingjang thei louva alha ahi.
en_web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
en_kjv: And behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ven, hikoma hin kum som le get lhagao boh vop’a chatmo numei khat aumin, amanu hi ating bong ahin, achama ding jang theilou ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan amanu amu chun, ahinkouvin aseitai, “Ngailut umtah numeinu, nanat na'a kona kisudam'ah nahitai,” ati.
en_web: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
en_kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thy infirmity.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amudoh phat’in akoulut’in ajah a, “Numei, nachamonaa kona kilhadoh nahitai,” atin;

tcz: Chuin amanu chu atham'in ahileh amanu jong chupettah chun adingjang thei tai. Pathen iti avahchoi hitam!
en_web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
en_kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
tcz_gospelgo: chunga khut a-ngap leh, apettah chun ading jang paiyin, Pathen athangvah tai.

tcz: Ahivangin kikhopna in'a lhacha mopopa chun cholngah nia amisuhdam jeh chun nommo asan. “Hapta sunga nigup natoh nading um ahi,” tin mihonpi jah'a chun, “Hiche nikho ho a chun hungun, Cholngahni hilouvin” ati.
en_web: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
en_kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Choldo nia mi aboldamjeh-in Houthua kikhopna invaihompa alung himon, mipi jah a, “Natohna ding nigup jen uma chu, hungun hiche sung chun kiboldamah tau, Choldo nin vang hung dauvin,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Miphalhem ho! Nabon uva Cholngah nia na natoh sohkeiyu chula! Na bongchal ham ahiloule na sangan ham Cholngah nia akihenna a pat a sutlham'a tui donsah dia napui jiu hilou ham?
en_web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
en_kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
tcz_gospelgo: Amapa donbut nan Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mi pha lhem ho, nang hon Choldo nia nabongchal’u hihen na-sa nganu hijongleh nalhadoh jiuva, twi donsah dia twikhuh geiya nakaijiu hilou ham?

tcz: Hiche lungset umtah numeinu, Abraham chanu hi, Satan in kum somleget jen soh'a ahentang ahi. Cholngahni hijongleh chutobang suhdam chu dihlou ham?” ati.
en_web: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
en_kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
tcz_gospelgo: Achutileh hiche Abraham chilhah numei, Satanin kum som le get ahen hi akihennaa kona Choldo nia lhadoh ding hilouham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun agalmi ho asujum in, ahin mijousen thilkidang abolho jeh chun akipah tauve.
en_web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
en_kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hiche asei hin ama douho ajah chauvin, mipi vang thil loupi tah tah abol ho jeh-in akipah cheh-uve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Pathen Lenggam chu itobang ham? Iti katekah ding ham?
en_web: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
en_kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
tcz_gospelgo: jesun, “Pathen lenggam chu ipi toh katakah ding ham?

tcz: Ankam mu neocha tobang mikhat in hon'a atu tobang ahi; ahung khangin chule thingphung ahung kisoh e, chule vachaten abah tin'ah genading bu akisah jiuve,” ati.
en_web: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
en_kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Min honsunga atheji ankam mutobang vang ahi; ankam mu chu ahung khangin, thingphung te aphan, abah lah a chunga leng vachate geiyin ageh theiye,” ati.

tcz: Aman adong kit in, “Pathen Lenggam chu ipi toh kitekah ding ham?
en_web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
en_kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Pathen lenggam chu ipitoh katekah ding ba ham?

tcz: Nupi khat in changlhah asemna a amanchah chol tobang ahi. Changbong atena dimthum'a chol neocha akoi ahivangin, apumpin ahin thulha jin ahi,” ati.
en_web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
en_kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lenggam chu suhlou chang changbonga kisem chahlhah danthum noiya numeiyin avuiya achansoh kahsea akoi chol tobang ahi,” atikit’e.

tcz: Yeshua khopi hole khoneo tin'ah achen, achena chan'ah thu ahil'in, Jerusalem lam amano jinge.
en_web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying towards Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun khopi chengse le khote chengse ajotsoh keiyin, Jerusalemlam ajot pumin thu ahilpeh-e.

tcz: Koiham khat in ahin dongin, “Pakai, mi themkhat bou huhhing'a um ding ham?” ati. Aman adonbut in,
en_web: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
en_kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat’in ajah a, “Pakai, mithemcha bou huhhinga um ding hitam?” tin aseiye. Aman ajah-uva,

tcz: “Pathen Lenggam lutna a kotjim lam'a lutna dingin kihabol un, ajeh chu mi tamtah'in lutding agotding ahivanga losam diu ahi.
en_web: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
en_kjv: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kotjima lutding gel khoh-un, ajeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, mi tampin lut agot diu, lut thei lou ding ahiuve.

tcz: In neipan kot akam jou teng, geisang val ding ahitai. Nangma pamlam'a nadin'a kot nakiu ding chule natao ding, ‘Pakai, keiho dingin kot neihon peh un!’ nati ding, ahivanga aman nahin donbut diu, ‘Keiman nangho koi nahiu ahiloule hoiya kon nahiu kahekhapoi’ ati ding ahi.
en_web: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
en_kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence you are:
tcz_gospelgo: Inneipu akipatdoh a kotpi akha tengleh polama pansan kot kiuvun,’Pakai, kot neihonun,’ ti jong leu chun, aman, ‘Nang hi kahepouve, hoiya hungkon nahiuvem?’ tia asei ding,

tcz: Chuteng nanghon naseidiu, ‘Ahivanga nangma toh kaneh uva kadon uva, chule kalampiu lah dunga jong neinahil u chula’ natidiu ahi.
en_web: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
en_kjv: then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
tcz_gospelgo: chutengle nang hon, ‘Keihon na-angsunga an kinea twi kidona, nangin kakholai lamlen dunguva thuhil lea,’ nati diu ahi.

tcz: Chule aman hitia hi ahin donbut ding, ‘Kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman nangho kahekhapoi chule hoiya kona hung nahiu kahepoi. Kakoma konin potdoh'un, nangho thilse bolteho.’
en_web: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
en_kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence you are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongleh aman najah-uva, ‘Nang ho kahe khapoi, hoiya hungkon nahiuvem? Thil gilou bolte, neidalha loiyun,’ ati ding ahi.

tcz: Chumun'a chu ka le hagel um ding ahi, ijeh inem itile Pathen lenggam a chu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, chule themgao jouse namudiu ahi, amavang nangma nakipaidoh ding ahi.
en_web: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
en_kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob chule Themgao dang jouse Pathen lenggama aum namu diu, nang ho vang polama na-um’uva hikoma chu ka le hagel um ding ahi.

tcz: Chule miho vannoi pumpi–solam le lhumlam a pat, sah le lhang a pat–Pathen lenggam'a amun'u kilo dinga hung khom diu ahi.
en_web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
en_kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Niso lam, nilhum lam, sah lelhang kona miho hung Pathen lenggama ankong aum diu ahi.

tcz: Chule hiche hi kichin in: mi phabep tua mi-noinung pen dan'a umhohi khonung leh alenpen hidiu ahi, chule tua alenpen hohi aneopen hidiu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
en_kjv: And behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule ven, anukhah abang masan tin, amasa kon khat nukhah ding ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Hiche pet chun Pharisee ho phabep khat in ajah'a, “Hikoma konin potdoh'in nakihinso nom leh! Herod in nathatdoh nom'e!” atiuve.
en_web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
en_kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
tcz_gospelgo: hichepet hin Pharisee mi phabep Jesu henga anungun, “Hikoma konin potdoh-in nakholjin ban kijintan, Herod-in tha din nagoi,” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Cheuvin lang chuche si-al chu gaseipeh un, thilha kanodoh jing ding chule ana damlou kasuhdam jing ding, tunia jong jinga jong; chule anithum nile kahung lona kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Cheuvin hiche se-al chu gaseipeh-un, “Keiman tuni le jinga thlha ho kanodoh a, Mi kadamsah ahin, nithum lhin ni vang leh kanatoh molso tange,’ atitin.

tcz: Henge, tuni le jing, chule ajing kit le kalampia chu kachejom ding ahi. Ajeh chu Jerusalem tailouva themgao kithat theilou ding ahi.”
en_web: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
en_kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
