tcz_gospelgo: Kakholjin vang tuni le jing chule thaini geiya kachepeh ding ahinai, ajeh chu Jerusalem khopama Themgao mah thah ngailou ahi.

tcz: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le Pathen sottolle ho songa seplih khopi! Ijat vei ahpin anoute alhaving noiya a-opkhum banga nachate khoptup ding kagot ham, ahivangin neibolsah poi.
en_web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
en_kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgao ho thatgama, ahenga kisol ho songa seplih, ahpin anoute lhaving noiya ahiukhom banga ijat vei nachate hiukhom dia kagot hitam, ahinla nangin nadeipoi.

tcz: Chuleh tun, ven, na-in hi kidalha ahitai. Chuleh nangman neimu kitlou ding ahitai, ‘Pakai min'a hungpa anunnom'e!’ tia naseikit tokah'a,” ati.
en_web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
en_kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, na-in’u chu thip del’a kidalhah peh ding nahiuve. Kaseipeh nahiuve, ‘Pakai min a hungpa chu anun nom’e,’ nati phat’u hung lhun kahsea neimu kit lou diu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Cholngahni khat Yeshua nilhah an nedin Pharisee ho lamkai khat in'ah achen, chule miho chun phatah in avelhiuvin ahi.
en_web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nin Jesu Pharisee vaihom khat in’a an ne din achen, amahon ave lhi jingui.

tcz: Hiche a chun mikhat, aban le akengho pom khat aumin ahi.
en_web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
en_kjv: And behold, there was a certain man before him, which had the dropsy.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ven, amasanga thongpoh veiya na mi khat aume.

tcz: Yeshuan Pharisee hole danthu themho chu adongin, “Cholngah nikhoa misuhdam danthun aphal hai aphallou ham?” ati.
en_web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
en_kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Jesun Danthu hilthem ho le Pharisee ho jah a, “Choldo nia mi damsah ngai ham hilou ham?” atileh;

tcz: Amahon adonbut nom lou phat un, Yeshuan anapa chu atham'in chule asudam'in asolmang tai.
en_web: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
en_kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
tcz_gospelgo: amaho athip beh-uve. Aman mipa chu atuh-in aboldam phat’in asolmangtai.

tcz: Chuin amaho lam ngan aseitai, “Nangho cholngah nia natonglou koi naum uvam? Nachapa ham ahiloule na bongchal hamkhat kokhuh a alhahlut le, aladoh dinga nakino ji hih um?” ati.
en_web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
en_kjv: and answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho jah a, “Choldo nin nachapau ha nabongchal’u ham twikul sunga lhalut taleh nagakaidoh jeng lou diu ham?” atileh;

tcz: Avel'in adonbut thei kit tapouve.
en_web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
en_kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon adonbut thei tapouve.

tcz: Nilhah anne a hung jouse chun touna nom nom jabolna mun achu cheh'u Yeshuan amu phat in, aman amaho chu hiche thumop hi apen ahi.
en_web: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
en_kjv: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kikouhon touna pha pha akilhenu amu phat’in Jesun ajahuva thulem khat aseiyin,

tcz: “Moupui golvah na'a kouna namu teng uleh, jabolna munhoa tou hih un. Ijem tin nang sanga jabolna chang ding khat ana kikou khataleh ipi tin tem?”
en_web: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
en_kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
tcz_gospelgo: “Mi khattouvin moupui golvahnaa nahung kouvu leh, toumun phapena tou dauvin. Inneipa chun nang sanga thupijo midang akou mai thei ahi,

tcz: Kinneipa chun ahung seiding, “Natouna chu hiche mipa hi pen” atiding ahi. Chuteng nangma najah cha ding ahi, chutengleh dokhang noiya kikoi touna hoa chu natou ding ahitai!
en_web: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
en_kjv: and he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
tcz_gospelgo: nani lhona koupa chu hunga najah a, ‘Hichepa ji toumun ot’in,’ ati ding; chuteng nalungdon man’a toumun nu nungpenaa natou lo ding ahi.

tcz: “Chusang chun dokhang kengbul mun nemnung pen'a chun touvin. Chuteng kinneipan nahin muding nahenga hunga, ‘Jol, nang dingin mun phajep kaneiyuve!’ ahung tiding ahi. Chuteng nangma chu jin kikou dang ho masanga jana nachan ding ahi.
en_web: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
en_kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nakikou teng toumun nukhahpena touvin, chutileh nakoupa hunga, ‘jol, toumun sangjep’a kikhangdoh-in’ ati ding ahi. Chutengle natoupi chengse maiya jabolna anchan ding ahi;

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang chan chu suhnem'a umdiu ahi, chule akineosah chan chu dopsang'a umdiu ahi” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Akipatdoh-in apa heng jonin achetai. “Gamla tah ahung gei nalaiyin apan agalmun, alaina behseh jengin, alhaijel’in akoiyin achop chuh chuh tai.

tcz: Achapan ahin seitai, “Hepa, keima van le nangma dounan kachonse tai, chule tun nacha tiding jong kalhing jou tapoi,” ati.
en_web: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
en_kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
tcz_gospelgo: Achapan ajah a,’Hepa, van douna le nangma dounan kachonsetai, nachapa tidin jong kakilom tapoi,’ atileh;

tcz: Ahinlah apan asohte komah aseitai, Gang'un! Insunga ponsil hoipen pen hinchoiyun lang silpeh un. Akhutjung'a akibu ding khutjem le akise ding kengchot hinchoiyun.
en_web: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
en_kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
tcz_gospelgo: apan asohte jah a, ‘Von phapen tah galauvin vonpeh loiyun, khutjem bupeh-un, kengchot sepeh loiyuvin.

tcz: Chule bongnou ivahthao uchu that un. Eihon golvah loupi tah a ilop diu ahi,
en_web: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;
en_kjv: and bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
tcz_gospelgo: Bongnou thaotah chu gaman’un lang that loiyun, neu hitin kipa thanop bol’u hite,

tcz: ajehchu hiche kachapa hi athi anahitan, tua hi hung hingdoh kit ahi. Amangsa anahin, tua hi kimukit ahitai. Hiti chun golnop chu akipan tai.
en_web: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
en_kjv: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu hiche kachapa hi athisa hing kit’a amangsa kimudoh kit ahitai,’ ati. Hiti hin kipa thanop abol’uve.

tcz: Chutia aumlai chun, chapa a'upajo pachu loulanga um natong ahi. Inlam ahung kile chun, in'a chun tumging le lam gin ajatan,
en_web: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
en_kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ahin a chapa aupajo loukon pa chu ahung vailhunin inlam ahungnaijep jep leh tumging kitum leh mi lamgin ajan,

tcz: chuin asohte khat komah ipi thilsoh umham ti adongin ahi.
en_web: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.
en_kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
tcz_gospelgo: soh ho khat akouvin adonge.

tcz: Nasopipa hung kile ahi, tin aseipeh un, chuleh napan bongnou thaotah chu athapeh ahi. Damsel'a ahunglhun jeh'a ilop'u ahi, tin aseipeh tai.
en_web: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohpan ajah a, ‘Nasopipa chu ahung lhungtai, hijeh a chu napan hing le dama amikit jeh a bongnou thaotah chu athapeh ahi,’ ati.

tcz: A'upajo pachu alung hangin insung alut tapon ahi. Apa ahungdoh in ahung tem'e,
en_web: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.
en_kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out and intreated him.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichun apa ahung potdoh-in ajol jol jenge.

tcz: ahin aman adonbut in, Kum hijat hi nasoh banga kaum chule bol'in nati jouse kada na umkhalou ahi. Chuleh hiche phat jouse achun nangman kaloi kagol hotoh kaneh khom diuvin kelcha nou khatbeh neinape khapoi.
en_web: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
en_kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman apa adonbut’in, ‘Ven, kum hijat hin sohbangin na katohpeh-in, khatvei jeng cha jong nasei ngailouvin kaumpoi, ahinla kagol kapaite toh kakipa thanop khomna din kelnou khat jeng cha jong neithapeh khah poi.

tcz: Ahivangin hiche nachapan noti ho chunga nasum jouse aveichai nungin, nangman bongnou thaotah nathapeh in nalop peh e, ati.
en_web: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
en_kjv: but as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hiche nachapa, natiho toh nanei nagou chengse sumangpa, ahung phat’in bongnou thaopen nathapeh-e,’ ati.

tcz: Apan ajah'a aseiyin, “Ven, kachapa ngaitah, nangma kakomah naum jinge, chuleh kanei jouse jong hi nanga ahi.
en_web: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
tcz_gospelgo: Apan ajah a,’Chapa, nangma kakoma um jing nahin, kanei aboncha nanga ahi.

tcz: Eihon hiche kipa nikho hi ilop diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile nasopipa hi athi'ah ahitan chule hung hingdoh kit ahi! Amangsa anahin, hinlah tun akimutai!” ati.
en_web: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
en_kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nanaopa hi athisa hing doh kit, amangsa kimudoh kit ahijeh a ikipa thanop diu mong ahibouve,’ tin ajol’e,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseijuite aseipeh e: “Mihaotah khat ana um'in, aman neiching khat ima ma vesuiya anganse aneiye, ahin aneichin na ah akitah poi ti thulamleng ahunge.
en_web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
en_kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun seijuite jaha, “Mihao khat’in neiching khat aneiye. Neichingpan anei aman chatvai jeh-in min aheh-in ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun apansah pan ama chu akouvin aseitai, ‘Ipi ham nathu kajah hi? Na neichin ho sutup in lang neihin pen ajeh chu nachungthu kisei ding ahitai’” ati.
en_web: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
en_kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihaopan ama chu akouvin ajah a, ‘Nachung chang thu kajah hi ipi iti ham? Nanei chinjat sutohnloiyin tukal neichinga napan theilou ding ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Neichingpa akingaiton, “Tua ipi kabol ding?” tin akihoulim'in, “Kapakai pan la eihaisah ahitan, lei lai dingla katha ahatpon, chule thum ding la hibanga kikiletsah'a,
en_web: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
en_kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun neichingpa akigel’in, ‘Kapun kaneichin, eilahpeh dingla ahitan, ikati ding hitam? Loubol’a lei lai ding la kathan ajoupon, khutdo dingjong kajah achai.

tcz: aphai, eihaisah tengleh loi le pai tampi kaneiya amahon a-in'a eilhunsah nadiuvin hitin bol inge” ati.
en_web: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
en_kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaneichin kahai teng mihon a-in’uva eilhunsahna diu bol ding khat kahetai,’ atin;

tcz: Hijeh chun apansah pa sumba jouse chu ahungkhom uva athu seitoh ahina din akoukhom sohtai. Amasapa jah'a, “Ijat nabat ham?” atileh,
en_web: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
en_kjv: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
tcz_gospelgo: apupa sumba ho akouvin, amasapen pa jah a, ‘Kapu sum ijat nabat’em?’ atileh;

tcz: mipa chun adonbut in, “Keiman olive thao twipai dim jaget kabai” ati. Chuin neichingpan aseipeh in, “Aman kijihna lekha hi kilah loiyin lang twipai jali jih in” ati.
en_web: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
en_kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
tcz_gospelgo: aman, ‘Thao tae-na dim jakhat,’ ati. Aman ajah a, ‘Nathil simna hinchoiyin, tou loiyin ate-na som nga bou aunin,’ ati.

tcz: Ahileh nangin ijat nabat em? tin anina pa adonge. Keiman suhlou chang lhuh sangkhat kabai, tin ahin donbut'e. Neiching pan aseiyin, hin, lekha hi kilah in lang lhuh jaget in jih in, ati.
en_web: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
en_kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin achomdang khat jah a, ‘Nangin la ijat nabat nah laiyem?’ atileh; aman,’Suhlou chang ate-na jakhat,’ ati. Aman ajah a, ‘Nathilsimna hin lan, somget bou sunin,’ ati.

tcz: Mihao pa chun chuche chondih lou neichingpan chingthei tah a abol chu apahcha tan ahi. Adih ahi, hiche vannoi chaten avel uva ho toh kipol ding dan hi khovah chate sangin achingjouve.
en_web: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
en_kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun chondih lou neichingpan ching theitah a thil aboljeh-in apupan apahchai; ajeh chu hiche khang mite hi akibahpi houlah a khovah chate singin achingjo’uve.

tcz: Kijildoh ding chu hiche ahi: Vannoiya nagouthil ho se hi midang phatchomna le jol le gol kisem nan mangin. Chuteng, nalei gouthil ho jouse abeisoh teng cheho chun tonsot in'a dinga nanalem diu ahi.
en_web: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
en_kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaseipeh nahiuve, leiset gouvin gol le pai semun, gou abeiteng mihon tonsot chenmuna nalhunsah diu ahi.

tcz: Nangho thil neocha chunga nakitah ule, thil lentah ho chunga jong nakitah diu ahi. Amavang thil neocha chunga nakitahlou ule, mopohna lentah ho chunga jong kitahlou ding nahiuve.
en_web: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
en_kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil neochaa kitah lou mi chu thil lenpia jong kitah lou ahiye.

tcz: Chuleh leiset gouthil chunga tahsan naum louleh, kon vangou dihtah chunga natahsan dingu ham?
en_web: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
en_kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset gouva bon tahsan naum louvu leh goutahbeh chu kon nachinsah diu ham?

tcz: Chuleh midang thil chunga nakitah louleh ipi jeh a nangma thil chunga nakitahsan ding ham?
en_web: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
en_kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?
tcz_gospelgo: Midang gou neichinga ankitah louvu leh nang ho gou ding kon napeh diu ham?

tcz: “Koiman pakai ni sohna atongkop theipoi. Ajeh chu nangman khat namuda a khat nangailut tum ding ahi; khat dinga nakiphal theng'a khat nadonda thei ahi. Nanghon Pathen le sum sohna tongkhom thei pouvin nate,” ati.
en_web: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
en_kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
tcz_gospelgo: “Insung lhacha khatseh-in pipu ni ajenkop theipoi; jenkop taleh khatjoh ahot’a khat jog angailut ding, ahiloule khat chu akolchah joa a khat chu donlouva akoiding ahi. Nang ho Pathen le sum soh a napankop thei lou diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pharisee ho, sum ngailu dehset hon, ajasoh keiyun ama chu anelpeh un ahi.
en_web: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
en_kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum ngailu Pharisee hon Jesu thusei ho ajauvin anelpah khum’uve.

tcz: Chuin aman amaho jah'a aseitai, “Jalah'a miho mitmu'a michonpha nahinom, ahin Pathen in nalungthim ahei.” Hiche vannoi miten ajabol chu Pathen mitmua thet umtah ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed amongst men is abomination in the sight of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho hi mihem mitmua them kichan loi nahiuvin, Pathenin vang nalungthimu ahenai; ijeh-inem itile mihemte lah a sang tah a kijabol chu Pathen mitmue thet umtah ahibouve.

tcz: Twilutsah John phatlai chan'a chu, Mose dan le themgao ho thuhil chu nakai hoi leuva pang anahi. Ahin, tun Pathen Lenggam Kipana thupha chu seiphongin aumtan, chule mijouse lutding athanom in ahi.
en_web: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
en_kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
tcz_gospelgo: “John khang geiya chu Danthu l eThemgaoho th che ah ahi. Ama hung apat Pathen lenggam Thupha kiseiphong a ahin, amitakip’in asunga thahat lekhajem khat paidoh sangin van le lei kitolmang abaijoi.

tcz: Ahivangin danthu chu apanna umtalou tina ahipoi. Van le lei amanthah ding hi Pathen danthu neopen khat kilekhup ding sanga gamchenga baijo ahi.
en_web: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
en_kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

tcz: “Vetsahnan, mikhat chun ajinu ada'a midang khat akichenpi le ajong'ah ahi. Chuleh koihileh ajipan ahindasa numei kichenpi jong chu ajong'ah ahi” ati.
en_web: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
en_kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi hile ajinu daa achom khat kichenpi chan mito jong ahin, chule ajipan adasa numei kichenpi jong mito jong ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiye, “Mihaotah khat, ponsandup le tupet ponnem kisil'a loupitah'a kivon le niseh a nomsatah'a umkhat anaum in ahi.
en_web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
en_kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
tcz_gospelgo: “Mihao khat hin, ponsandup le tupat ponenm jeng asil jin, niseh-in aning anop’in aum jin ahi.

tcz: Akelkot phunga chun Lazarus kiti tiphah natna dimset, mivaicha khat aum jin ahi.
en_web: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
en_kjv: and there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
tcz_gospelgo: Apum changa phah mivaicha Lazarus kiti chu akotbul’a alumin,

tcz: Chutia Lazarus jong mihaopa dokhanga an lhajah ho ducha'a aumlaiyin, uicha ho ahung jiuvin atiphah namun ho chu ahung leh jiuve.
en_web: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
en_kjv: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
tcz_gospelgo: mihaopa ankong dokang chunga lhajah anmal chu aducha tun tun jenge; akhoh cheh kit chu, uichaten atipat laiho chu aleh-uvin ahi.

tcz: Achainan, mivaichapa chu athitan chule Vantilte Abraham koma um ding'in apotauve. Mihaopa jong athin avui tauve,
en_web: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
tcz_gospelgo: “Chujouvin mivaichapa chu athin, Vantilten Abraham jet lama din apotauve. Mihaopa jong athin avuitauve.

tcz: chule alhagao chu mithi ho lah'a achetai. Chua athoh gentheina mun achun, Abraham gamlatah a aum chule Lazarus akoma atou chu amun ahi.
en_web: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
en_kjv: and in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Damuna gim genthei athohna konin chunglam avet leh gamla tah a Abraham amun, ajet lama Lazarus jong amui.

tcz: Mihaopa chu ahung pengjah'in, ‘Hepa Abraham, themkhat neilungset in! Lazarus hinsol in lang akhutjung twiyah hin delut henlang kalei hung sudap hen. Keima hiche meikong lah a hin kahesoh lheh jeng'e,’” ati.
en_web: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
en_kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
tcz_gospelgo: Akouvin jah a, ‘Kapa Abraham, neikhoton, Lazarus hin sol’in akhut jungin twi ga dekot han lang kalei beh eihung dedap peh hen, ajeh chu hitobang meikou leh a gim genthei thoh-in kaum tai,’ ati.

tcz: Ahin Abraham'in amapa jah'a aseiyin, chapa, geldoh in, nangman nahinlai sungin nadei jouse naneisoh keiyin chule Lazarus in ima ananeipoi. Hijeh a chu tua hi ama hikom mun'a nomtah'a kiumsah a nangman hesoh nathoh ahitai.
en_web: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.
en_kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
tcz_gospelgo: “Abrahamin, ‘Chapa, naleiset hinkhon thilpha chengse namun, Lazarus chun thilse amui, tun aman kikoma nom asan, nangma chukoma gim genthei thoh-in naume.

tcz: Chule chuche tilouvin jong, ikikah uva hin eikhen uvah onghom lentah aume. Koiman hikom mun'a pat'a apal galkai thei lou, chule chua pat'a jong keiho kom lang koiman apal galkal thei lou ahi, ati.
en_web: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
en_kjv: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche kal jong chun i-kah-uva onghom lentah akikhangin, hikoma kona nang ho hin jon nom jong hung theilou ding, chukoma kona jongkoima hilama hung galkai theilou dinga kibol ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Chuin mihaopan asei kit in, Lungset tah in, Hepa Abraham, kapa in beh'a gasol in.
en_web: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—
en_kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, ‘Hepa achutileh Lazarus chu ka-inkote henga nasolna din kataove,

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman sopi pasal nga kaneiye, chule amachun hikom thoh gentheina muna ahung lou nadiuva aga gihsal ding kadeiye, ati.
en_web: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
en_kjv: for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu sopi pasa; nga kaneiyin, Lazarus chehen lang amaho chu gahil chah masa leh kati, achuti lou leh hiche danmuna hi hung kit diu ahitai,’ ati.

tcz: “Ahin Abraham'in aseipeh in, ‘Mose le Themgaohon agihsal nauve. Nasopi hon chua ipi asut'u hin kisimdoh nauvinte,’ atipeh e.
en_web: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
en_kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Abrahamin, ‘Ahilchah diuvin Mose le Themgaoho aneiyui, amaho hil ngai tauvinte,’ ati.

tcz: Mihaopan adonbut kit'in, ‘Ahipoi, Hepa Abraham! Koiham khat athilah'a kona akisol le, achonset nauva kona lungheina aneidiu chule Pathen lam'a kihei diu ahi,’ ati.
en_web: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
en_kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla aman, ‘Ahipoi kapa Abraham, mithi lah a kona mi khat che le bou lung ahei diu ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Abraham'in aseikit in, ‘Amahon Mose le Themgaoho thu angailou uleh, athilah'a konin khat thoudoh jongleh ngaideh pouvinte,’” ati.
en_web: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Abrahamin ajah a, ‘Amahon Mose le Themgaoho thu angailouvu leh mithi leh a konin mi khat thoudoh kit jong leh kithu nundeh pouvinte,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiye, “Chonset na dia lhepna hi aumjing ding mong ahi, hinlah itobang lungkhamnan anga hitam alhem'a pang mi chu!”
en_web: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
en_kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Kipal lhuhna thei thil chu soh thei ahinai, ahin kipalna bol chu ohe ada ahi!

tcz: “Na-ngongchanga sumhei song naki-o a twikhanglen'a nakilelut chu hiche aneocha ho nakipal lhuhsah sanga phachomjo ding ahi.
en_web: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
en_kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chun hitobang aneocha ho khat akipal lhuhsah sangin a-ngonga sumhei song lentah ki-opeh hen lang Twikhanglena kileh lut le phajo ding ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun chingtheiyun! Tahsan cha adang khat achonset leh, amachu sosal'in; chutia alung ahei le ngaidam in.
en_web: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
en_kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chingtheiyun! “Nasopi achonset leh phoh-in, lung ahei leh ngaidamin.

tcz: Hiche mipa chun ihamtia nikhat'a sagi vei nachunga thildihlou abol'a, abol phat jousea jong ngaidam athum leh ngaidam in” ati.
en_web: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
en_kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni khat sunga nachunga sagi vei, chonse hijongleh, nahenga ahunga sagi vei jen, ‘Kalung kaheiye,’ atileh na-ngaidam tei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Seijuiten Pakai jah'a aseiyun, “Tahsan na kangaichat be uve, iti kanei diu ham neisei peh un” atiuve.
en_web: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
en_kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah hon pakai jah a, “Katahsanu khansah ben,” atiuve.

tcz: Pakai in adonbut in, “Nanghon tahsanna ankammu te cha hijongleh naneiyuleh, hiche thing theimi phung koma hi, ‘Kibotdoh in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut in’ tijongleu chun nathu'u angai ding ahi! Sohpa Natoh Ding
en_web: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
en_kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin, “Nang hon tahsan na ankam mu tebep neiyun lang, hiche thing theimi khu, ‘Kibotdohin lang Twikhanglen lailunga kiphut lut’in,’ tijong leu chun nathuu ngai jenginte.

tcz: Soh khat chu aloukai na ham ahiloule akelngoi chinna ham'a pat'a ahung lut teng, apakai pan, ‘Hunglut in an nekhom hite’ tin tem?
en_web: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
en_kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
tcz_gospelgo: “Nalah-uva mi khat’in loubol’a pang ham, kelngao ching ham soh khat aneileh, ahung vailhun teng ajah a, ‘Hung loiyin ankong hung ki-um loiyin,’ ti nan tem?

tcz: Tiponte! Hitijoh hin seiyinte, ‘Ka anneh ding nei gonpeh in, natai kigeh in lang, kaneh sungsen neijen in. chuteng ajoujep le nenan nate’ atiding ahi.
en_web: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
en_kjv: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
tcz_gospelgo: Chusanga ajah a, ‘Kajan an neh ding gon, natai kigah-in lang kaneh kachah sungsen neijenin, chujou teng nangin nen natin don nannate,’ atijoh lou idng ham?

tcz: Chuleh apakai pan asohpa chu atoh dinga lom atoh jeh a apachat em? Apahcha deh poi.
en_web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
en_kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepa chun asohpan asei sei abol peh jeh a chu apachat hinam?

tcz: Chutobang a chu nanghon kathua nanun teng uleh hitia hi nasei diu, ‘Keiho soh lhingjoulou kanatoh diuva lom bou tong kahiuve’ nati diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
en_kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga hi nang hon jong nakiseipeh chengse nabol jou tengu jong leh, ‘Soh mai mai kahiuve, keihon katoh ding dol bep bou katoh-u ahi,’ tiuvin,” ati.

tcz: Yeshua Jerusalem lam jon'a achejom jing laiyin, Galilee le Samaria kigamgit na mun alhung tai.
en_web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Jerusalema achen Samaria le Galilee kah ahopeh-e.

tcz: Chutia khokhat agalut laiyin, chua chun miphah som gamla thimtah in adingun,
en_web: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
en_kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
tcz_gospelgo: Kho khat’a alut leh miphah som khat’in analamtouve. Miphah ho chu gamla thima adingun,

tcz: ahung eodoh un, “Yeshua, Pipu, nei khoto un!” atiuve.
en_web: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
en_kjv: and they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pipu, Jesu neikhotouvin,” tin asamuve.

tcz: Aman amaho chu aven, “Cheuvin lang thempuho gakimusah tauvin,” atipeh tai. Chutia acheuleh, aphah natnau chu suhtheng in aumtai.
en_web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
en_kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass that, as they went, they were cleansed.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho amu phat’in ajah-uva, “Cheuvin lang Thempu ho gakivetsah tauvin,” ati. Acheu leh adamthengsoh tauve.

tcz: Alah uva khat chun suhdam a aumchu akimu phat in, Yeshua hengah ahung kilen, “Pathen Vahchoiyin umhen!” tin apengjah tai.
en_web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
en_kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
tcz_gospelgo: Alahuva khat chun adamtheng akihet phat’in ahung kile kit’in oging tah-in Pathen athangvah-in,

tcz: Ama Yeshua kengbul'ah abohkhup in, athil bolpeh na chungah kipathu aseiyin ahi. Hiche mipa chu Samaria mi ahi.
en_web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
en_kjv: and fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
tcz_gospelgo: chule Jesu kengbul’a amai asult’in athangvah tai. Ama chu Samaria mi ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Mi som kasuhdam hilou ham? Adang mi ko ho la?
en_web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
en_kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Miphah som jen kisutheng hilou ham? Mi ko hoilamba hitam?

tcz: Koiman Pathen loupina peh ding ageldoh lou hitam hiche gamdang mipa tailou?” atin ahi.
en_web: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
en_kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche chidang namdangpa tilou khat chajong Pathen thangvah dia hung kile lou hiuvem?” ati.

tcz: Chule Yeshuan hichepa koma chun aseiyin, “Dingdoh in lang che tan, natahsan in nasuhdam ahitai,” ati. Pathen Lenggam
en_web: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
en_kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
tcz_gospelgo: chule khatpa jah a chun, “Thouvin lang chetan, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat Pharisee hon Yeshua adongun, “Pathen Lenggam itih le hung lhung ding ham?” atiuve. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lenggam chu muthei melchihna ah akihedoh thei poi.
en_web: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
en_kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon Jesu jah a Pathen lenggam hung lhung ding phat adoh nauva aman, “Pathen lenggam chu melchih theiyin ahungpoi.

tcz: Nanghon, ‘Hikom'ah aum'e’ ahiloule ‘hichea khun aume’ tin seithei pouvin nate, ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu nalah'uva aumtai” ati.
en_web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
en_kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here: or, lo there: for behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman, ‘Ven, hikom’ah aume,’ ahiloule, ‘Khukoma aume,’ atilou ding ahi. Ijeh-inem itile ven, Pathen lenggam chu nalah-uva aumtai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin aseijuite hengah hitin aseiye, “Phat ahung lhunge Mihem Chapa ahung kile na ding nikho mu nom'a naum diu, ahivanga namu lou diu ahi.”
en_web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
en_kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun seijuite jah a, “Nikhatle Mihem Chapa nikho namu nom lheh diu, ahivanga namu thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Mihon ahinsei diu, “Veuvin Mihem Chapa khukom'ah aume” ahilouleh hivah aume, atidiu ahi, ahivangin potdoh hih un, chule jui hih'un.
en_web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
en_kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon najah-uva, ‘Ven, khu koma aume,’ atiuva, ‘Ven, hikoma aume,’ atiu jongle chesauvin, anung del hih-in;

tcz: Ijeh inem itile kolphe ahung phet'a van mong langkhat'a pat mong langkhat gei asalvah soh banga Mihem Chapa hung ni jong chutobang hiding ahi.
en_web: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
en_kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu kolphen kolmong lang khat’a pat kolmong lang khat geiya vanthamjol asalvah jeng banga Mihem Chapa hung ni jong leh chuti ding ahi.

tcz: Ahin amasa'a Mihem Chapa hin thoh hahsa tampi athoh a hiche khang miten apampai diu ahi.
en_web: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
en_kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang amasa hesoh genthei tampi athoh a, hiche khang mite not thap’a um tei ding ahi.

tcz: Mihem Chapa ahung kile teng leh, Noah nikholai toh bang ding ahi.
en_web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
en_kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah nokholai bang a Mihem Chapa nikho ho jong chuti ding ahi.

tcz: Chuche nikholai chun mihon golvah neh le don chule kichen abol'un, Noah kongsunga alut'a chule tuisang ahunglet'a abonchauva asuhmang nikho geiyin nomsatah in hinkho amangun ahi.
en_web: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
en_kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon aneuvin adonun, akichengun, Noah kong sunga alut ni geiyin kicheng din akipetouvin, chutah-in twisang ahung lenin abonchauvin asumangtai.

tcz: Chule vannoi leiset jong Lot nikho lai toh bang ding ahi. Miho nitin akimanchah nauvah akisaboi un–neh le don, choh le joh, loulho le insah,
en_web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
en_kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin Lot nikho laiyin jong mihon aneuvin adonun, thil achouvin, hon abol’uvin in asauvin,

tcz: Lot in Sodom khopi adalhah ni jingkah chan in abol'un ahi. Chuin van'a konin mei le kath ahung julhan abonchauvin asumang soh tan ahi.
en_web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
en_kjv: but the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom khoa Lot apotdoh nikhon vang vana koin meikou l ekat ahung julhah abonchauvin asumangtai.

tcz: Henge, angaima banga kiseimona Mihem Chapa ahung kile kit ni geiya umding ahi.
en_web: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
en_kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa kiphondoh nikho jong chuti ding ahiye.

tcz: Chuche nikho chuleh indan chunga um chun insunga athil kisemtup din lutkit da hen. Mi louva kondoh jong inlam a kile da hen.
en_web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
en_kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikhoa chu inchunga uma inusunga thilkeo kilah din kumlhah da hen, chule loujaova um jong hung kile kit da hen.

tcz: Lot inneipi chunga ipi anasoh em geldoh un!
en_web: Remember Lot’s wife!
en_kjv: Remember Lot’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Lot jinu chu geldoh-un.

tcz: Nahinkho tuhchah jing nagot le namansah ding, chule nahinkho nachesah le, nahuhhing joh ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
en_kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile kihinso noma chun athilo ding, athiloa chun hinna aneiding ahi.

tcz: Chuche jan leh mini jalkhun khat'a lumkhom ding; khat kila ding, khatpa kidalha ding.
en_web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
en_kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche jan chuleh jalkhun khat’a lumkhom te ni jong khat kilaa khat kidalha ding ahi.

tcz: Nupi nin sumhei khat'a chang agoikhom lhon ding, khat kila ding khat kidalha ding,
en_web: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
en_kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei chang goikhom teni jong khat kilaa khat kidalha ding…

tcz: “Pakai, hitiho hi itih leh soh ding ham?” tin aseijuiten adongun ahi. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Muthong ho kititna achun mithi long naivel ah aume ti aphotchet banga hiche melchihna ho jong chun akichaina anaitai ti avetsah ahi,” ati.
en_web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
en_kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Hoikom hintem Pakai?” atiuleh; aman ajah-uva, “Thilong lupnaa chu muthong kikhom ding ahi,,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite ataojing nadiu leh alhahdai lou nadiu vetsahnan thusim khat aseipeh e.
en_web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,
en_kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
tcz_gospelgo: Lhadah louhel’a tantih neilouva atao jing theina din Jesun aseijuite chu thulem khat ahil’e.

tcz: “Khopi khat a hin thutan khat Pathen ginglou chule miho khohsah na jong neilou khat aumin ahi.
en_web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
en_kjv: saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
tcz_gospelgo: ″Khopi sung khat’ah Pathen ging lou mihem jong jalou thutan khat aume.

tcz: Chuche khopia meithai khat chu kinong chel'in ahung jingin, ‘Kagalmi hotoh kakiboinau hi thu adih in neitan peh'in,’ ahung tijin ahi.
en_web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
en_kjv: and there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche khopi sunga hin meithainu khat jong acheng’in, thutanpa henga ahung jin, ‘Kakihehpi sangin them neichanin,’ atijie.

tcz: Thutan pan phat chomkhat amanu chu isahlou tah in anakoiyin, ahin achainakeiyin hitin akihoulim in, Keiman Pathen kaging pon ahiloule miho jong hole tilou kahi,
en_web: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
en_kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chom khat chun aman don louvin akoinan, chom khat jouvin, ‘Pathen kagin daa mihem kajabol lou vangin

tcz: ahivangin hiche numei nu hin eisungol lhatai. Keiman thu adih'a tanlhah peh ahinadin vetpeh inge. Ajeh chu amanu hin athilthum jinga kon hin ei sulungvai lhatai,” ati.
en_web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
en_kjv: yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche meithainun eisuhgim jing jeh hin athem channa ding gelpeh tange, achutilou le hung jingin tin eisuh lung gim jing ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche chondihlou thutanpa a konin kihil un.”
en_web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
en_kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin aseiben, “Midih lou thutanpan ipi aseiyem ngaiyun.

tcz: “Ama jengin jong achaina a thu adih'a tandia ahin gellhah ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen in alhenchom te, ama koma asun ajan'a kapjing techu thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi ti nagel lou u ham? Amaho chu donlouvin koijing in te natim?
en_web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
en_kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
tcz_gospelgo: Sun le jan’a ahenga tao jing jeng alhenchomte chu Pathenin kithopi ding ngongkai louhel’a achunguva thu adih a atanpeh lou ding ham?

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, aman kinloitah a thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi! Ahinlah Mihem Chapa hung kit teng, leiset chunga hin mi ijat tahsan nei mudoh intem?” ati.
en_web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
en_kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Najah-uva kasei ahi, aman ngongkai louhel’a amaho them achansah loi ding ahi. Hijongle Mihem Chapa ahung teng leiset chunga tahsan hung toh nantem?” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi mi konkhat ama chonphatna a kisonga midang musit ho dingin aseiye:
en_web: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:
en_kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised other:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun mi ama bou them kichana midang jouse isah lou ho din hiche thulem hi aseiyin:

tcz: “Mi ni houin ah taona mangin ache lhon'e. Khat chu Pharisee mi ahin, chule adang khatpa chu musit umtah kaidong ahi.
en_web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
en_kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mi ni Houin a tao dingin achetou lhonin, khat chu Pharisee ahin, khat chu Kaidong ahi.

tcz: Pharisee mipa chu adingin hitin ataove: ‘Kakipah'e Pathen, adangho banga chonse kahilou jeh in. Ajeh chu lepthol in kabol pon, kachonse pon, chule jonthanhoi jong kabolpoi. Keima atahbeh in khuche kaidongpa tobang kahipoi!
en_web: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
en_kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
tcz_gospelgo: Phariseepa adingin chamtahin hitin ataove, ‘Pathen keima midang banga milop, kitahna bei, chonthanghoi, chule hiche Kaidong pa tobang khu kahi loujeh-in Nangma kathangvah-e.

tcz: Keiman hapta khat in nivei an kangol'in, kasum mu jat a konin soma khat kapei,’ ati.
en_web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
en_kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
tcz_gospelgo: Hapta khat sungin nivei an ka-ngol jin, kalamdoh jat hopsom hop khat kape jingin ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Ahivangin kaidong pachu gamlatah a adingin chule amit jeng'a jong vanlam ve ngamlouvin ataove. Chusang chun lungkham tah in aman a-op achum'in hitin aseiye, ‘O’ Pathen, neilungset in, ijeh inem itile chonse kahibouve, ati.
en_web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
en_kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kaidongpa vang chu gamla thimtaha adingin, dah a van lam jong ve-ngam louvin, adip alai akidop’in ‘Pathen neilungset’in keima michonse kahibouve,’ ati.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Pharisee pa hilou, hiche chonsepa chu Pathen ang-ah them achangin inlam akiletai. Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang hochu suhnem'a umding, chule akineosah hochu dopsang'a umdiu ahi,” ati.
en_web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
en_kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Phariseepa sangin hichepa joh hi them achangin a-inlama achesuh tai; ajeh chu koi hileh ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding, ama kisunem chu kichoi sang ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Nikhat nule pa phabep in achateu chapang neocha chaho chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh dingin ahin puiyun ahi. Ahivangin aseijuiten hichu amuphat un, anule apateu koma chun ama nasuboi bep uve tin ahouse uvin ahi.
en_web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
en_kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
tcz_gospelgo: Miphabep’in achateu chunga Jesun khut angap din ahinpuiyui Seijuien amun aphoh-uve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan chapang ho chu akouvin chule aseijuite hengah aseitai, “Chapang ho chu kahengah hung uhen. Jahda hih'un! Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu hiche chapang neocha tobanghoa ding bou ahi.
en_web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
en_kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Jesun chapang ho akouvin, “Chapang ho chu kahenga hungsahun, kham dauvin, Pathen lenggam chu hitobang ho ding bou ahi.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh chapang neocha banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu lutlou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
en_kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
tcz_gospelgo: sumil hih-un, chapang thilsan banga Pathen lenggam sang lou chu lut lou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Khatvei hou lamkai khat hin hiche thudoh hi adonge: “Houhil pha, tonsot hinna kanei thei na dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
en_web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
en_kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
tcz_gospelgo: Judate vaihom khat’in Jesu adingin, “Houhilpha, tonsot hinna kanei theina dia ipi kabol ding ham?” atileh;

tcz: “Ipi bol'a apha tia nei kou ham” tin aledoh in, Pathen bouseh dihtah'a pha ahi.
en_web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Ibol’a ‘Apha’ neiti ham? Pathen tilou apha aumpoi.

tcz: Ahin nathudoh donbut nan, thupeh ho nahet chula: “Nangman jon bol hih'in, tolthat hih'in, gucha hih'in, jouvin mi hehse hih in, nanu napa jabol in,” ati.
en_web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
en_kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupeh chengse nahet chu me. ‘Mito jong hih-in, tol that hih-in, gucha hih-in, jouthun hettphsah-in pandan, nanu napa jabol’in,’ kiti chu,” ati.

tcz: Mipan adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kachapan laiya pat kajui sohkei ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
en_kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman, “Kakhangdong laiya pat hichenghi kanitsa ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbutna thu ajah phat chun, hitin aseitai, “Nabol loulai thilkhat aume. Nanei jouse joh in lang hiche sum chu mivaicha ho pen, chutileh van'a gou nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hungin, neijuiyin,” ati.
en_web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
en_kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hichu ajah phat’in, “Nalhah samna khat aum nalaiye, nanei chengse joh-in lang sum chu vaichate petan, chutile vana gou nanei ding ahi; chuteng hungin neijuiyin,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin mipa chun hichu ajahdoh phat in alung kham lheh tan ahi, ijeh inem itile amachu haosatah ahi.
en_web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
en_kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi ajah phat’in mihao tah ahijeh-in alung nom mo lheh jenge.

tcz: Yeshuan hichu amuphat in, aseitai, “Mihaosa Pathen Lenggam alut ding hi iti hah hitam!”
en_web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
en_kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun alung himo natsatje amu phat’in, “Sum haoho dinga Pathen lenggama lut ding iti hah sat hitam!

tcz: “Atahbeh in, heobil hom'a sangongsao alut galkai ding hi mihaosa Pathen Lenggam a alut ding sangin abaijoi,” ati.
en_web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
en_kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihao Pathen lenggama lut sangin heobil homa sangonsang lut idng abaijoi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche akisei jajouse chun aseiyun, “Achutileh vannoi leiset'a koiham huhhing na chang jou ding?” atiuve.
en_web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
en_kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu ja hon, “Achutile koi huhhinga umjou ding ham?’ atiuve.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Mihem dinga hithei lou chu Pathen dinga hithei ahi,” ati.
en_web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
en_kjv: And he said, The things which are unpossible with men are possible with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Mihem dinga himo thil jouse dalhaa nang kijuita,” ati.

tcz: Peter in aseiyin, “Keihon nangma jui dingin ka-in'u kadalhauve,” ati.
en_web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
en_kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin, “Ven, keihon kanei jouseu dalhaa nang kijuita,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge” chuleh ka lhamon nahiuve, “Koihileh Pathen Lenggam jal'a a'in ham, ajinu ham, asopiho ham, ahiloule anu apa ham achate ham pedoh chan chu,
en_web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle Pathen lenggam jal’a in le lou ji le cha, sopi u le nao, nu le pa dalha jouse

tcz: tamtahvei tuhinkhoa hi lepeh'a umdiu chule ahunglhung ding khang'a jong tonsot hinkemlou amuding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
en_kjv: who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: koi ahin tukhanga ajat tamjo cheh mu lou ding le ahung lhung ding khanga tonsot hinna kimu lou idng aumpoi,” ati.

tcz: Seijui somleni ho atumbeh'in apuidoh in, Yeshuan ajah uva aseiye, “Ngaiyun, eiho Jerusalem chetou ding ihiuve, Mihem Chapa chungchang thudol'a themgao thusei jouse guilhun na ding mun chu ahi.
en_web: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
en_kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun som le ni atumin apuidoh-in ajah-uva, “Ven, Jerusalem ijon touvun, chule Mihem Chapa thudol’a Themgao ho lekhabu kisun chengse guilhung ding ahi;

tcz: Amachu Rome te khut'a pehdoh'a umding ahi, chule amachu tot thanghoi'a umding, jachat umtah'a kibol ding, chil kisetkhum ding ahi.
en_web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
en_kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Ama chidang namdangte khut’a pehdoh a um ding, tot nopna aneiyuva, a-eng eng a abol diu, chule chil aset khum diu ahi;

tcz: Amahon avoh'uva chule athadiu ahi, ahivanga anithum nileh thoukit ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
en_kjv: and they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
tcz_gospelgo: avoh-uva atha diu, ahivanga nithum ni leh thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahin, amahon hitiho thuhi khatcha ahethei pouve. Athusei ho athupije chu amaho a kona ki im mang ahi, hijeh a chu athusei chu amattoh thei lou u ahitai.
en_web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
en_kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiten aseiho hi khat cha jong ahechen theipouve. Ajeh chu akisei ho hi amaho dia kiselguh ahin, hijeh chun ipi kiseipen ahiding ahedoh theipouve.

tcz: Yeshuan Jericho anaisuh lai hin, mitcho khutdo khat lamsih'ah ana touve.
en_web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Jericho khopi ahung naichun, lamlen panga mitcho khat touvin khut adoi.

tcz: Aman mihonpi kijot khuto gin ajah phat in, ipi thu hitam ti adongin ahi.
en_web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
en_kjv: and hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitchopan lampia mipi kitol husa ajah phat’in ipithu ahi ding adonge.

tcz: Nazereth Yeshuan hikom chu ahopa ahi ti aseipeh tauve.
en_web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
en_kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Nazareth Jesun ahinjotpa ahi, aseipeh-uve.

tcz: Hijeh chun amapa ahung eojah tan, “Yeshua, David chapa, neilungset in!” ahintin ahi.
en_web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
en_kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ahinsamin, “David Chapa jesu, keima neilungset’in,” ati.

tcz: “Thip'in” tin masang langa miho chun ahutot tauvin ahi. Ahivangin ama awgingjep in ahapen cheh tan, “David Chapa, neilungset in!” ati.
en_web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
en_kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasanga chehon umthip beh dia haphoa apho vangun aman ahasap cheh-in, “David Chapa, neikhoton,” ati kit’e.

tcz: Yeshuan ajahdoh phat in, adingin mipa chu ahinpui lut diuvin athupeh tai. Mipa ahung nai toh lhonin Yeshuan adongin,
en_web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
en_kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu ading denin mipa chu ahinpui diuvin aseiye. Mitchopan ahin naiphat’in ajah a,

tcz: “Ipi nabolpeh leng natim?” tin adong tai. Aman, “Pakai, kho muleng kati!” ati.
en_web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
en_kjv: saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ipi eibolpeh le nati ham?” atileh; aman, “Pakai, kho neimusah-in,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Aphai, kho mutan! Natahsan in nadamsah ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah a, “Mu tan. Natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Apettah chun mipa chun kho amutai chuleh amapan Yeshua nung ajuiyin Pathen avahchoi tai. Chuleh amujousen jong Pathen avahchoi cheh tauve.
en_web: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
en_kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Apettah chun mitchopan kho amutan, Jesu ajuiyin Pathen athangvah tai. Mipin hichu amuphat’un Pathen athangvah chehuve.

tcz: Yeshua Jericho alut'in, chule akhopi sung chu ajot in ahi.
en_web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
en_kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Jericho alut’in kho sung ajotpeh-e.

tcz: Mi khat amin Zacchaeus kiti chua chun aume. Ama chu hiche lhang'a dinga kaidong pipu ahin, ahaova haosa ahitai.
en_web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
en_kjv: And behold, there was a man named Zaccheus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
tcz_gospelgo: Khosunga hin Zacchaeus kiti kaidong pasal khat ahengin, ahaova hao ahiye.

tcz: Aman Yeshua chu mutei ding agon, hinlah ama anem behseh jeh chun mihonpi lah'a chun amutheipoi.
en_web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
en_kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin Jesu chu amu nom lhehin, ahinla mi nem ahijeh-in mipin alen amupha poi.

tcz: Hijeh chun ana malhaijel'in lampi panga theiba phung khat'ah anakal'e, ajeh chu Yeshuan hiche lampi chu aho ding ahi.
en_web: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
en_kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun analhai masan, amuteina din ahung na ding lampia chun theiba chung khat’a anakaldoh-e.

tcz: Yeshua ahung phat chun, Zacchaeus chu avetouvin chule amin in akouvin, “Zacchaeus! gang'in, hungkum'in! tunia na in'a maljin kahi ding ahi,” ahinti.
en_web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
en_kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zaccheus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hikom chu ahinphah phat’in agada doh leh amun, “Zacchaeus, hung kumlha loiyin, tunia na-in’a kalhun tei ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Zacchaeus jong kinloitah in ahung kumlhan, Yeshua chu a'in ah kipah le thanom tah'in apuilut tai.
en_web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
en_kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
tcz_gospelgo: Zacchaeus, chu kinloi tah-in ahung kumlhan kipah tah-in Jesu alamtoi.

tcz: Ahivangin miho chu alungphamo uvin, “Michonse chungnung in'ah agalhung taget e,” tin aphunchel tauve.
en_web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
en_kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin amu’uvin, “Hiche michonsepa in’a khu lhung din ache teget’e,” tin aphuntauve.

tcz: Chuphat chun, Zacchaeus jong Pakai angsungah adingdoh in aseitai, “Pakai, kanei kagou akehkhat mivaicha ho peing'e, chule kai kadon na'a miho lepthol'a kabol aumleh, amaho chu ajatlin nungpeh inge!” ati.
en_web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
en_kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
tcz_gospelgo: Zacchaeus vang chu adingin Pakai jah a, “Ven, Pakai kanei chengse akeh khat vaichate peng ting, ada acham louva mi kalahpeh aum jong leh ajat lin leng’e,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tunin hiche in'ah huhhingna alhung tai, ajeh chu hiche mipa hin Abraham chapa dihtah ahi akimusah tai.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
en_kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajah a, “Tunin hiche insunga huhingna ahung lhungtai, ama jong hi Abraham chilhah ahiye.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Mihem Chapa chu amangsa holdoh le huhhing dinga hung'ah ahi,” ati.
en_web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
en_kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile amangsa holdoh a huhing dia Mihem Chapa hung ahi,” ati.

tcz: Mihonpi chun Yeshua thusei jouse chu angailha sohkeiyun ahi. Chule ama Jerusalem anaitoh kilhonin, aman thusim khat, Pathen Lenggam chu kipan pai dinga angaito'u suhdih nadin aseiye.
en_web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
en_kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Jerusalem ahung lhung deh deh tan, mihon ma Pathen lenggam hung lhung jeng dia agel jeh-uvin Aman thulem khat ahil’in,

tcz: Aman hitin aseiye, “Lengchapate khat mun gamlatah a leng gachanga hung kile kit dingin koudoh in aumin ahi.
en_web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
en_kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
tcz_gospelgo: ″Milun tah khat leng tha neina gakisana hung kile kit din kholgamla tah a cheding agon;

tcz: Achedoh masangin asohte lah'a mi som akoukhom in dangka mina som apen, ‘kachedoh sungin hiche hi nei veikan peh'un’ ati.
