en_web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
en_kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin amina tahsana Ama kisan chengse chu Pathen chate hitheina thu apetai.

tcz: Amaho penthah chu tahsa pen ngai'a mihem lung lam'a kona tahsa lungon'a penga ahipouvin, Pathen'a kon peng'a ahibou'uve.
en_web: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
en_kjv: which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu mihem thisan gui le tahsa dei chule mihem deiya peng hilouvin, Pathen guiya peng joh ahibouvui.

tcz: Hitihin Thu chu tahsapu mihem ahung kisoh in, chule ilah uva ahung chengtai. Ama lhadahlou ngailut le kitahna dimset ahin, keihon ama loupina, Pa Chapa changkhat seh ahina loupitah chu kamutauve.
en_web: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
en_kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu chu tahsaphe ahungdsoh-in, i-lah-uva ahung chengin, keihon aloupina, Paa kon Chapa chang khatseh loupina chu lungset le thutah lhingset’in kamutauve.

tcz: John chun Yeshua thudol ahettohsah in, mipiho henga asam'in “Hichepa hi ahi, athudol kana hettohsah chu, Kanunga mi khat ahungin, ama chu kei sanga gamchenga lenjo ahi, ajehchu ama keima masang peh'a anaumsa ahitai, kati chu,” ati.
en_web: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
en_kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Johin Ama thudol hettohsah nan lhang asamin “Keiman kaseipa, ‘Kanunga hungpa khu aum Jingsa ahijeh-in kei sangin achungnung joi,’ kiti chu Ama hi ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ama aning lhinsetna kona eiho jouse lungset vangbohna hi aban ban'a changa ihitauve.
en_web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
en_kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama bulhinset ahijeh-in eihon kinon jel’in lungsetna imutauve.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh danthu chu Mose a kon ahin, hinla lhadahlou Pathen mingailut na le kitahna chu Yeshua Messiah vanga hungah ahibouve.
en_web: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Danthu chu Mosea hung kipe ahin, lungsetna le thudih vang Jesu Christa jeh a hung umdoh ahi.

tcz: Koima Pathen mukha ana umpoi, Ahin atepi umlou, amatah Pathen Chapa chang khat seh, Pa lung to kinaicha umjing chun, eiho henga aphondoh ahitai.
en_web: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
en_kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman Pathen amu khapoi, Pathen hingjing khatseh chu Pa op’a beh jingpan bou aphondoh ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi Judate lamkai hon Jerusalem'a pat'a thempu ho leh Hou'in a sottol le ho, John henga “Nang koi nahim?” tia aga dohsah nauva, John in ahettohsah chu ahi.
en_web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
en_kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi John thu hettohsah chu ahi, Jerusalema hung kon Juda hon, “Koi nahim?” tia dong dia thempu hole Levi ho asol’u chun

tcz: Ama ahung kiphong doh paijin, “Keima Messiah kahipoi” ati jenge.
en_web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
en_kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: aman seilep louhel’in phongtah in, “Keima Messiah kahipoi,” ati.

tcz: Chuphatnin amahon adongun, “Achutile aphai, koi nahi ham? Nangma Elijah nahim?” atiuve. Aman adonbut'in “Kahipoi” ati. “Ahile kagin chatnu themgao chu nahim?” atiuve. Aman “Kahipoi” ati.
en_web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
en_kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun amahon adongun, “Koiba nahim? Elijah nahim?” atiuleh; aman, “Kahipoi,” ati. “Themgao nahim?” atiu jongleh, “Kahipoi,” tin adonbut’e.

tcz: “Achutile koi nahim? Eihinsol ho koma lhutding donbutna kangai chauve. Nangman koi kahi nakiti em?” atiuve.
en_web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
en_kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
tcz_gospelgo: Chu phat’in ajah a, “Koiba nahim? Eihinsol teu kaseipeh theina dinguvin, koi kahiba nakitim?” atiuleh;

tcz: John in adonbut'in Keima gamthip a khosam awgin'in, “Pakai hung nading lampi sutheng un,” tia Isaiah themgao thusei chu kahi, ati.
en_web: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
en_kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
tcz_gospelgo: aman, “Kei hi “Gamthip’a khosam ogin khat’in, Pakai lampi semjangun,’ ati tia Isaiah Themgaovin aseipa chu kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pharisai ho ahung kisol hochun,
en_web: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
en_kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee phabep jong ahinsol’un,

tcz: Ama adong un, “Messiah nahi louva, Elijah nahi louva, chule themgao nahilou le, ipi thuneina naneiya Baptize nachan sah ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
en_kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
tcz_gospelgo: amahon ajah a, “Messiah nahi louva, Elijah jong nahi hih a chule Themgao jong nahidrh lou leh ibol’a baptize nachansahji ham” tin adongui.

tcz: Chuin John in amaho jah'a, “Keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahin, ahinlah mipi lah'a nanghon nahet dohlou'u mikhat aume.
en_web: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
en_kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
tcz_gospelgo: Johnin amaho adonbut’in, “ken twiya baptize kachansahji ahin, nalah-uva nahet louvu khat adinge;

tcz: Ama keima nunga hung ahivangin keima ama soh dinga jong lhingjou lou chule akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi,” ati.
en_web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
en_kjv: he it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
tcz_gospelgo: kanunga hunga chu Ama ahin, Keima akeng chot khao sut lham didnga jong kilom kahipoi;” ati.

tcz: Hicheng chu Jordan vadung gal solam Bethany mun'a John in Baptize achansah na'a thilsoh ahi.
en_web: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
en_kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil hicheng hi Jordan luigal Johnin baptize achangsahji na, Bethany khoa thu soh ahi.

tcz: Ajingin John in amaheng lam'a Yeshua ahung amun, “Veuvin, vannoi chonset pomang Pathen kelngoinou khu,”
en_web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
en_kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon Jesu ahenga hung amun Johin, “Ven, Pathen kelngoi nou vannoi chonset pamang khu.

tcz: Amahi ahi keiman kasei, kanunga hunga kei sanga gamchenga lenjo, kati chu, ajehchu ama kei um masang peh'a ana umsa ahitai, ati.
en_web: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
en_kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman, ‘Kanunga hung khu aum jingsa ahijeh-in keisangin achungnung joi,’ katipa chu Ama hi ahi.

tcz: “Keiman ama Christa ahilam kana hepoi, ahivangin ama chu Israel lah'a phondoh'a aumna ding'a keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahi,” ati.
en_web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
en_kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken jong ama hi kahepoi, Israel lah a Ama akikhon doh theina dinga hung twiya baptize chansah kin kabol ahi,” tin

tcz: Chuin John in athu hettohsah nan, “Keiman van'a kon'a Lhagao Theng vakhu banga ahung lenlhah'a achunga aumden kamui.”
en_web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
en_kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: Johnin ahettohsah-in, “van a kona lhagao vakhu banga hung kumlhaa achunga chu kamui.

tcz: Keiman ama ahilam kana hepoi, ahivang'in Pathen in twiya Baptize chan sah dinga eisol chun, aman kakoma “Achunga Lhagao Theng achuh'a a umden namupa chun, Lhagao Thenga baptize ahin chan sah ding ahi,”
en_web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
en_kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken Ama kahepon, twiya baptize chansah dia eihonsolpan, ‘Lhagao hungkhumlhaa achunga chu namuna chu lhagao Thenga baptize chan sahpa ahi,’ ati.

tcz: “Chule keiman Yeshua chunga hicheng asopet hi kamun, hijeh'a chu amahi Pathen in alhen doh achapa khat seh chu ahi tia kahettoh sah ahitai,” ati.
en_web: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
en_kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu keiman kamutan Ama hi Pathen Chapa ahi, tia kahettohsah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ajing kit'in, John aseijui mini toh adinpet un,
en_web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
en_kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon John aseijuite mi nit oh adidngin,

tcz: Yeshuan ahinjotpa chu amun, ama chu aven, “Veuvin Pathen kelngoinou khu,” ati.
en_web: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
en_kjv: and looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God.
tcz_gospelgo: agahvet leh Jesun lam ajotpet amun, “Ven, Pathen kelngoi nou khu,” ati.

tcz: Chuin John seijui teni chun athusei chu ajalhon in, Yeshua nung ajuilhon tai.
en_web: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
en_kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuite nin John thusei hi aja lhonin Jesu nung ajui lhontai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua akihei leh amanin ajuilhon chu amun, “Ipi nangai chat lhon ham?” atitai. Amanin adonbut lhon'in “Rabbi” (Hichu houhil tina ahi) hoiya na umji ham? atilhon e.
en_web: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
en_kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akihei leh amanin ahinjui lhon amun ajah lhona, “Ipi nahol lhon ham?” atileh amanin ajah a, “Rabbi (Hichu Houhil tina ahin,) hoiya nalhun em?” tin adong lhone.

tcz: Chuin aman, “Hunglhon in hungve lhon in,” ati. Amani Yeshua toh akilhon khom lhonin, aumna chu agamu lhon tai. Chule hiche nikho chun aumkhom tauve. Hichu nilhangkai nidan li don ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
en_kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah lhona, “Hung in hung ve lhonin,” ati. Hijeh chun amani ache lhonin alhunna agamudoh-in, hiche ni chun amatoh aum khomtauve. Aphat hi nilhah lam nidan li don ahiye.

tcz: John thuseija, Yeshua nung jui teni lah'a khat joh chu, Simon Peter naopa Andrew chu ahi.
en_web: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
en_kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
tcz_gospelgo: John thusei jaa Jesu nungjuite ni lah a khat chu Simon Peter naopa Andrew ahi.

tcz: Andrew chun asopipa Simon agahol doh in ajah'a, “Keihon Messiah (Christa tina ahi) kamu tauve,” ati.
en_web: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
en_kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman asopipa Simon akimupi masah-in ajah a, “Keinin Messiah (hichu leng chang dia thao nusa kiti) chu kamudoh lhontai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Andrew in Simon chu Yeshua henga ahinpuiyin ahi. Hichun Yeshuan Simon chu aven ajah'a, “Nangma John chapa Simon nahi, hijongle Cephas kisah ding nahitai. (Hichu Peter tina ahi).”
en_web: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
en_kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
tcz_gospelgo: Andrewn Simon chu Jesu henga ahinpuiye. Jesun Simon chu aven, “Nang hi John chapa Simon nahin, nangma Cephas Peter nakiti ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ajingin Yeshua Galilee lam'a che dingin aume. Hichun aman Philip amun, ajah'a “Hungin neijuijin,” ati.
en_web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
en_kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon Galilee gama che ding akigon, Philip amudoh-e. Jesun ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” ati.

tcz: Philip chu Andrew leh Peter chenna khopi Bethsaida kho'a kon ahi.
en_web: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
en_kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip hi Andrew le Peter chenna Bethsaida khoa mi ahi.

tcz: Chuin Philip in Nathanael aholdoh'in ajah'a, “Mose le themgao hon athudol anasut'u amapa tah chu kamutauve. Ama chu Nazareth khomi, Joseph chapa, Yeshua ahi,” ati.
en_web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
en_kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip’in Nathanael amun ajah a, “Achung thu Mose’n Danthua asut, Themgaohon jong autpa chu keihom kamu’uvin, Nazareth khoa Joseph chapa Jesu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Nathanael in adatmo lheh in, “Nazareth khoa kon'a pha sohdoh thei hinam?” ati. Philip in adonbut'in “Hungin nangma tah in hungven” ati.
en_web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
en_kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathanael’in ajah a, “Nazareth khoa thilpha soh thei ding ong?” atileh; Philip’in ajah a, “hungun hung ven,” ati.

tcz: A kom lhon'a amani ahung lhon chu Yeshuan amun, ajah lhon'a, “Phat lhemna beihel mikitahpa, Israel chapa dihtah chu tun aumtai,” ati.
en_web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
en_kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathanael aheng lama hung Jesun amun, achung thu aseiyin, “Ven, Israel midih tah, phat lhem nabei mi khu,” ati.

tcz: Nathenael in adongin, “Iti neihet jeng ham?” ati. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip in naholdoh masanga theichang phung noiya na umpet'a chu kamu n ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
en_kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathanael’in ajah a, “Hoiya kona iti neihet ham?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Philip’in nakou masang, theichang phung noiya naum pet’a chu kamu nahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Nathanael tijatah'in, “Rabbi nangma Pathen Chapa, Israelte lengpa nahi,” tin aphongtai.
en_web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
en_kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: nathanael’in adonbut’in, “Rabbi, Nangma pathen Chapa nahin, Israel lengpa nahi!” atitai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adongin, “Theichang phung noiya na umpet kamu ahitai, kati jeh'a chu natahsan ham? Hiche sanga chungnungjo namu ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Theichang phung noiya naum pet’a kamu nahitai katijeh a chu natahsan ham? Hiche ho sanga lenjo cheh nahin muding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin ama jah'a, “Atahbeh kaseipeh nahi, nangman van akihon'a chule Pathen vantil ho Mihem Chapa chunga akaltou le akumsuh namu ding ahi, ajehchu ama tah chu van le lei kimatna kalbilei ahi,” ati. Cana khoa moupui golvah
en_web: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
en_kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle ajah a, “Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, van kihonga Mihem Chapa chunga Pathen Vantilte kaltou le kumsuh namu diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ajingin Galilee gamsunga Cana khoa kichena golvah kingon khat aumin ahi. Chua chun Yeshua nu jong aumiin,
en_web: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
en_kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
tcz_gospelgo: Nithum lhinin Galilee gama Cana khoa moupui golvah akibol’in, Jesu nu jong apange.

tcz: Chule hiche kingona'a chun Yeshua leh aseijui ho jong akouvu ahi.
en_web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
en_kjv: and both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu le aseijuite jong hiche moupui golvahnaa chun akouvui.

tcz: Golvahna aum petnin lengpi twi alhing tahih in, anu chun Yeshua jah'a “Lengpi twi anei tapouve,” ati.
en_web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
en_kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpitwi alhahsam phat’un Jesu nun ajah a, “Lengpitwi anei tapouve,” atileh;

tcz: “Ngailut umtah numei, hichu eiho boipidi ahipoi” tia Yeshuan adonbut ahi. “Keima phat lhing loulai hichu,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Numei, nang le Kei i-kin um am? Kaphat lhing loulai chu,” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin anu chun lhacha ho jah'a, “Aman najah uva asei ipi hijongleh bol un,” ati.
en_web: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
en_kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
tcz_gospelgo: Anun lhacha ho jah a chun, “Najah-uva asei chan bol jengun,” ati.

tcz: Akom tah uva chun Judate dan dung jui'a kisuhtheng na songbel lentah gup uma ahi. Bel khat chu twi-thei dim som nia pat somthum dol cheh ahi.
en_web: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
en_kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikom chu Judate chonna ngaiya kisuh thengna ding tia songbel twi atena ni ham thum ham dol cheh bel gup kitung ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan soh ho jah'a “Songbel ho chu twi sung dimun,” ati. Amahon songbel ho chu twi asung dim phatnun,
