en_kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman, ‘Kei hi Messiah kahipoi, ama sanga eihung kisol masa kahibouve,’ tia kasei chu nang ho tah ahettoh nahiuve.

tcz: Hiche hi ahi, mou kichenpia chu moulang ahin; chuleh moulang jolpa vang chu moulang koma adin'a moulang kitep na ajah chu akipana ahijenge. Hijeh chun ama lolhin na chun keima kipana dim'a eikoi ahi.
en_web: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
en_kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Mou change chu aji neipa ahin, aji neipa jol, a koma dinga athusei ngaiya chun a-ogin ajah leh hachangpan akipahjie. Keijong kakipahna achamkimtai.

tcz: Ama chu khangtou touding, chule keima kemsuh suh ding kahi. Vana hungkon Yeshua
en_web: He must increase, but I must decrease.
en_kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thupi cheh cheh ding, keima lhasuh jep jep ding kahi.

tcz: Ama chunga hungkon ahin, mijouse sanga chung nungjo ahi; Eiho leiset'a kon ihiuvin, leiset thu iseiyu ahi, ahivangin ama chu chunga kon ahijeh'in mi jouse chunga achungnungpen ahi.
en_web: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
en_kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chunga hungkon chu mi jouse sanga chungnungpen ahin, leiset’a kon vang chu leiset ahin, leiset thubou aseiye. Vana hungkon vang chu achungnungpen ahi.

tcz: Aman amu leh ajah chu ahettohsah ahi, ahivangin ama hettohsah chu koiman asangpoi.
en_web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
en_kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajahsa le amusa ahettohsahji ahin, ahinla koima athu hettohsah asangpoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hileh, athu hettohsah tahsan'a kisan chun Pathen dihtah chu apomdet ahitai.
en_web: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
en_kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hettohsah kisan chun Pathen chu adih-e tia anamdet ahitai.

tcz: Ama chu Pathen hinsol ahi, Aman Pathen thutah aseiye, ajeh chu ama Pathen lhagao dimset'a kipe ahi.
en_web: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
en_kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hinsolpan vang Pathen thuho aseiye; ijeh-inem itile Pathenin tepten Lhagao apepoi.

tcz: Pa chun Achapa angailun, chule ima jouse ama khut'a apetai.
en_web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
en_kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Pan Chapa angailun thil ijakai akhut’a apetai.

tcz: Hijeh chun, koi hijongleh Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. Pathen chapa thungailou vang chu tonsot hinna changlouva Pathen lunghan na thutan chu achunga chu ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
en_kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa tahsana chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; Chapa thu ngai lou vang chun tonsto hinna chu amu louhel ding, Pathen lungsatna achunga umden ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Pakai chun John sangin seijui tamjo asem'in miho Baptize achansah jinge ti Pharisee hon ajatauve ti chu Yeshuan ahetan ahi.
en_web: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
en_kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
tcz_gospelgo: John sangin Jesun seijui atam semjon baptize abol’e, ti Pharisee hon ajah-u chu Jesun ahedoh tan,

tcz: Hichun Yeshua amatah in baptize achansah lou vang'in, aseijuiten abol'u ahi.
en_web: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
en_kjv: (though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
tcz_gospelgo: (Jesu mongin baptize abolpoi, aseijuiten bou abol’ui).

tcz: Hijeh chun aman Judea gam adalhan Galilee gam'a akile tai.
en_web: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
en_kjv: he left Judea, and departed again into Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Judea gam dalhan Galilee lama akile kittai.

tcz: Aman alampi'a chun Samaria gamsung ajotpa in;
en_web: He needed to pass through Samaria.
en_kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi Samaria gam ajotpa tei ding ahin;

tcz: Chutichun Samaria mite khokhat Sychar mun chu ahung lhungtai; hiche mun chu Jacob in achapa Joseph ana peh loumun kom ahi.
en_web: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
en_kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria gama Sychar kiti khoa chun ahungtai; hikom chu Jacob’in achapa Joseph lou mun khat apehna kom ahiye.

tcz: Chukom'a chu Jacob twikul um'ah ahi, Yeshua chu lamsao ajotna'ah acholtan, twikul panga chun leltah in atouvin ahi; Hichu sunkim dontah ahi.
en_web: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
en_kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Hilaiya hi Jacob twikul um ahi. Sunkim don ahitan, Jesu chu alamjot thachol’in twikul koma atouve.

tcz: Hichun Samaria numei khat twithal dingin ahungin, Yeshuan amanu jah'a “Twi donding neipeh thei ding ham?” ati.
en_web: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
en_kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria mi numei khat twi thal din ahunge. Jesun amanu henga, “Twi don ding neipen,” ati;

tcz: Hichepet a chu Yeshua achangseh'a bou um ahi, ajehchu aseijuite khosunga anneh ding cho'a achedoh kah'u ahi.
en_web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
en_kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu seijui ho ma neh cho dinga khopi sung lama cheuvah ahitai.

tcz: Numeinu chu atija lheh e, ajehchu Judah hon Samaria miho chu athet uva imacha akikoppi ngailou'u ahi; hijehchun amanun Yeshua jah'a “Nangla Judah mi nahin, keila Samaria numei kahin, ipi dinga keikom'a donding twi nathum ham?” ati.
en_web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
en_kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? For the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria mi numeinun ajah a, “Iti Juda mi nangin Samaria mi numei kei koma don ding twi nathum ham?” ati. (Ijeh-inem itile Juda mi le Samaria mi ima kimangto lou ahiuve).

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in amanu jah'a “Pathen thilpeh nachan ding hi henlang, chule naki houpi hi koi ahi hele chun nangin keikom'a nathum joh ding, chule keiman nangma hintwi pedinga,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Pathen thilpeh hen lang chule nahenga, ‘Don ding neipen,’ tipa chu kihet le chun, nang joh-in ahenga thuma, Ama hinna twi pe ta dinga,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amanun ajah'a, “Pu nangman athaldoh nading khao le bel jong neilouva, twikul jong athuh in, hintwi nati chu hoiya nalah ding ham?
en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
en_kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun ajah a, “Pakai, athalna dingla naneipon, twikul ma thuh tah ahin, hinna twi chu hoiya nalah ding ham?

tcz: Chukit jongleh hiche twikul eina peuva kapului'u Jacob sang'a nangma chung nungjo nahim? Amatah in anadon'a achate leh agancha ho anadonsah'a hiche twi sanga phajo hoiya nalah ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
en_kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche twikul eisempeh-uva, ama jengin jong anadon, achate le aganchad ho geiya donsah, kapuu Jacob sanga chung nungjo nahim?” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Koi hileh hiche twi don'a chu dangchah kit ding ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amanu adonbut’in ajah a, “Koi hileh hiche twi don chan chu dang-chah kit ding ahin,

tcz: Ahivangin Keiman kapeh ding twidon jouse chu a itih'a dangchah kitlou ding, amaho chu asung uva hintwi put'a twinah theng soh ding, chule tonsot hinna chang ding ahiuve.”
en_web: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
en_kjv: but whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken kapeh ding twi dona vang chu dangchah kit louhel ding, kapeh ding twi chu asunga tonsot hinna twinah soh doh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a “Pu lungset in hiche twi chu kei neipen, chuteng avel'a kadang chah kitlou na ding, chuleh hilai mun'a twithal'a kahungkit lou nadingin,” ati.
en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
en_kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun ajah a, “Pakai, kadangchah louna ding leh hichan geiya twi thal’ kahung louna din hiche twi chu neipen,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Chenlang najipa gakouvin,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Chen najipa gakouvin hikoma hung kit’in,” atileh;

tcz: Amanun adonbut'in, “Keiman ji kaneipoi,” ati, hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Nasei dih'e, nangman ji kicheh naneipoi,” ati.
en_web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
en_kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun adonbut’in ajah a, “Keiman ji kaneipoi,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Nangin, ‘Ji kaneipoi,’ nati chu naseidih nai;

tcz: “Nangman ji ngatah naneitan chule tua naum khompi pa jong khu naji tah ahipoi, nasei dih lheh jenge,” ati.
en_web: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
en_kjv: for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu ji nga jen nanei ahitan, tua naneipa khu naji ahipoi, hichu nasei dih-e,” ati.

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Pu nangma themgao khat nahi.
en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
en_kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun ajah a, “Nangma Themgao khat nahi, ti kahe-tai.

tcz: Ahile neisei peh in ipi dinga keiho Samaria mihon, kapuluiteu bolbanga hiche Gerizim mol'a Pathen kahou'uva, ahivanga nangho Judah mihon Pathen houna ding mun chu Jerusalem bou ahi, natiu ham?” ati.
en_web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
en_kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapu kapateuvin hiche molchunga hin Pathen ahoujiuvin, nang hon ‘Jerusalem muna bou min ahou ding ahi,’ natiuve,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Numei neitahsan in nanghon Pathen nahou na dingu mun chu hiche mol'a jong hilou, chuleh Jerusalem'a jong hilou, phat chu ahung lhung e.”
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amanu jah a, “Numei neitahsanin, anng hon Pa chu hiche molchung jong hilou Jerusalem jong hideh louva nahou theina diu phat ahung lhunge.

tcz: Nangho Samaria mihon nahet chen lou u nahouvun, ahivangin keiho Judah mihon vang kahou'u ama chu kahet chen'u ahi; ajehchu huhhingna chu Judahte a kona hung ahibouve.
en_web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
en_kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon nahet lou nahouvu ahin, keihon vang kahet kahouvu ahi; ajeh chu huhhingna hi Judate lah a konbou ahi.

tcz: Ahivangin phat chu ahung lhunge, tutah hi ahi, ahou tahbeh hon Pachu Lhagao leh thutah'a ahouding phat; ajeh chu Pa chun chutobanga houho bou chu ama hou dinga ahol ahi.
en_web: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
en_kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pa chu ahou tahbeh hon lhagao le thutah a ahouna diu phat ahung lhungtan, tun hikomah aume; ajeh chu Pan hitobang miho chu bou Ama hou dia ahole ahiye.

tcz: Ajehchu “Pathen chu lhagao ahin, ahouten lhagao leh thutah'a ahou ding mong ahi” ati.
en_web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
en_kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chu Lhagao ahin, Ama houten Ama hina Lhagao va ahou mong diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Keiman Messiah hung ding chu kahenai, ama chu Christa ahi. Ama chu ahung tengleh aman ijakai eihil dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
en_kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun ajah a, “Keiman, ‘Thao kinu kiti,’ Messiah hung ding vang kahenai. Ahung teng leh ijakai eiseipeh nauvinte,” atitai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Keima Christa chu kahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

tcz: Hiche pettah chun, aseijuite ahung kiletauve, amahon Yeshua leh numeinu kihou chu amu'uvin, atija lheh jengun ahi, ahivangin koiman ajah'a, “Amanu henga ipi nathum ham?” ahilouleh, “Ipi dinga amanu naki houpi ham?” tia dong ngam aum pouve.
en_web: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
en_kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin Jesu seijuite ahungu leh numei khat toh anakihou chu adatmo lheh-un, ahivang in, “Ipi nadoh hiya,” ahiloule, “Hichenu khutoh ibol’a kihou nahim?” tia khat cha aumpouve.

tcz: Hichun numeinu chun a twibel chu twikul panga adalhan khosung lam'a alelhai kit'in miho jouse henga;
en_web: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
en_kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
tcz_gospelgo: Numeinun atwibel dalhan khopi sunga chen miho jah a,

tcz: “Hungun mikhat hungveu vin, aman kathilbol leh kachon na jouse aseidoh soh keiye, Ama hi Christa hitei yinte,” ati.
en_web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
en_kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
tcz_gospelgo: “Hungin kathilbol kachonna jouse eiseidoh peh jeng mi khat hung veuvin, hiche hi Messiah hikhat ding hi tam?” agati.

tcz: Chuin khosunga kon chun mipi tamtah ahung potdoh'un ama chu ahung veuvin ahi.
en_web: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
en_kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho khopia konin apotdoh-un Jesu henga ahungui.

tcz: Hichepet chun aseijuiten Yeshua heng'ah, “Rabbi an themkhat beh nen,” atiuve.
en_web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
en_kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kah lah a hin seijuiten, “Rabbi, an nen,” tin a-ngeh-ui.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho het phahlou anneh kaneiye,” ati.
en_web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
en_kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang hon nahet louvu neh ding an kanei nai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun aseijuite amaho akidong touvin, “Eiho chedoh kah'a mikhat touvin anneh ding ahin choipeh khat ham?” atiuve.
en_web: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
en_kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun seijuite khat le khat akihouvun, “Mi khattouvin neh ding ahinchoipeh ham?” akitiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ahilchen in ajah'uva, “Eisolpa Pathen lunggot lam bol leh akin subulhit chu keima anneh ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Keima anneh chu Eihinsolpa dei bol’a natoh molso ding hi ahi.

tcz: “Nanghon changphu'a pat chang at khom na ding lha li alut'e natiuvin ahi, ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi, khodah uvin loujao khu veuvin, chang amin in a-atphat val ahitai.
en_web: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
en_kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon, ‘Chang atna ding lha li aum nalaiye,’ natiji hih-um? Ven najah-uva kasei ahi, khodahun loujao dung veuvin, agusoh-in aminin a-at phat ahitai.

tcz: Chang-at chun atha man akisanji mong ahi, chule a-atkhom lousoh ga chu miho tonsot hinna'a apuilut chu ahi; chutia chu aphut pa le a atpa anilhon'a kipahkhom jiahi.
en_web: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
en_kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
tcz_gospelgo: atupa le a-atpa akipa khom theina didngin a-atpan tohman akisanin aga ronsot hinaa akhol’e.

tcz: Akisei ji bang chun, ‘mikhat in aphut in adang khat in a-at khomji,’” kiti chu adihtah ahi.
en_web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
en_kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun khat’in atun chom khat-in a-atji kiti hi adih-e.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman nangho, na phulou nauva a-atkhom dinga kasol nahiuve; midang in atoh gimnasa chu nanghon aga nakhop tup'u ahi. Samaria Mihon Yeshua Atahsan'u
en_web: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
en_kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken natoh gim lou nauva at dia kasol nahiuve, midangin atoh gim aatohgauva lut mahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Numeinu chun, “Kathilbol leh kachon na jouse eisei doh peh'e,” tia ahet tohsah'a kon chun, chuche kho'a Samaria mi tamtah'in Yeshua chu atahsan tauve.
en_web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
en_kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuche khopi sunga Samaria mi tamtah-in jong, “Kathilbol kachonna chengse eiseidoh peh-e,” tia nameinun ahettohsah jeh chun Jesu atahsantauve.

tcz: Chuin amaho Yeshua henga ahung'un, akom'uva umden dingin a ngeh'un ahi, chuin Yeshua chukom'a chun nikho ni achongden tan ahi;
en_web: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
en_kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
tcz_gospelgo: Samaria miho ahungun akom’uva nichong din angeh u leh, Aman chukoma ni ni aninchonge.

tcz: Chua aumsung chun mi tamtah'in athusei ajah'uva kon chun ama chu atahsan tauve.
en_web: Many more believed because of his word.
en_kjv: And many moe believed because of his own word;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thusei jal’in mi tampin atahsan beuvin,

tcz: Chuin amahon numeinu jah'a, “Nangma thu hettohsah jengseh hilouvin, keiho tah in ama thusei kajauvin, tun katahsan tauve, chuleh amahi vannoi huhhing dihtah ahi kahechen tauve,” atiuvin ahi. Galilee mihon Yeshua asan u
en_web: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
en_kjv: and said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: numeinu jah a chun, “Nangma thusei keova katahsanu ahitapoi, keiho tah-in kajauvin, chule hiche Pa hi Vannoi huhingpa ahi, kahetauve,” atiu vin ahi.

tcz: Chua ni ni achon jou chun, Yeshuan Galilee ajontai.
en_web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
en_kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ni ni jouvin Jesu chukom dalhan Galilee gama achetai.

tcz: Yeshua amatah in themgao chu achenna agamsung'a jabol na achangpoi, tia anasei dohsa ahi.
en_web: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
en_kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Jesu amatah-in Themgao achenna gama akijabol lou thu ahettohsah ahi.

tcz: Ahijeng vang chun Galilee miten ama chu ana sanguve, ajehchu amaho chu kalchuh kut laiya Jerusalem'a ana um uva, chumun'a Yeshua thilbol ho ana musoh keiyu ahi.
en_web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
en_kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
tcz_gospelgo: Galilee gam ahung lhun leh agam miten anasang cheh-ui; amaho jong kut a che ahijeh-un, kut laiya Jesun Jerusalema thil abol jouse amusoh keiyu ahiye.

tcz: Aman Galilee gamsung ajot'in twisih lengpi twi asosah na Cana kho'a chun ache kit'in ahi, chuche kho koma Capernaum kho'a chun vaipo milal khat a um'in, achapa chu ha dammo lheh jeng ahi.
en_web: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
en_kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
tcz_gospelgo: Galilee gama twisih lengpitwi asosahna

tcz: Chuin aman Yeshua chu Judea gam'a kon'in Galilee gam'a ahunge ti ajah phat in, amatah Yeshua henga achen, Capernaum geiya ahunga achapa ahung damsah dingin ataotai, ajeh chu achapa chu athikon cha ahitai.
en_web: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
en_kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepa hin Judea gama kon Jesu Galilee gama hung ajah phat’in ahenga achen, achapa athipai ding phat chun, hungsah a achapa dam sah din a-ngeh-e.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah'a, “Melchih na kidang hicheng hohi mulou hile chun neitahsan nadem?” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Melchihna le thil kidang namu lousen tahsan pouvin nate,” ati.

tcz: Hichun vaipopa chun, “Pakai lungset in kachapa athi masang in hungin,” tin ataotai.
en_web: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
en_kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengvaipoa pangpan ajah a, “Pakai, kachapa thi kah-in hungsuh jengin, “ati.

tcz: Yeshuan amapa jah'a, “Na in'ah kiletan nachapa ahinge!” ati. Chuin mipa chun, Yeshua thusei chu atahsan in, a inlam ajontai.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Chetan, nachapa ahingtai,” atileh; aman ajah a Jesu thusei chu atahsanin achetai.

tcz: Chuin mipa chu a In alhun masang in, asohten lampia ahung lamtou vin, achapa damtheng thu chu ahung seipeh uvin ahi.
en_web: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
en_kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama achesuh nalaiyin asohten ahung lamton achapa hindoh thu aseipeh tauve.

tcz: Hichun aman asohte jah'a, “Itih phat a chu damdoh ham?” tin adongin ahileh, amahon, “Janhi sun nidan khat dontah chun akhosih abeitai,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
en_kjv: Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman achapa itih don tah a phadom ahi adoh leh, amahon ajah a, “Jan hi nil hah lam nidan khat chun khosih-in alhatai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mipa chun hiche phat laitah chu, Yeshuan ajah'a nachapa ahinge tia aseipet tah ahi chu ahedohtan ahi; hiche jeh chun ama leh a Insung mite chengsen Yeshua atahsan tauve.
en_web: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
en_kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun apan, “Nachapa ahingtai,” tia Jesun ajah a aseipeh pet tah chu ahi, ahedoh tan, ama le a-insung pumpiuvin atahsan tauve.

tcz: Hiche hi Judea gam'a kon'a Galilee gam'a ahungna'a Yeshuan melchihna kidang abol aniveina ahitai.
en_web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
en_kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judea into Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Judea gama kona Galilee gam ahunglhun kal’a Jesun melchihna abol aniveina ahi.

tcz: Hiche jou chun, Judah ho kut nikho thengho jeh'in Yeshua chu Jerusalem'a akile kit in ahi.
en_web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Judate kut khat aumin, Jesu Jerusalema aga chetouve.

tcz: Khopi sunglam'a kelngoi kotphung koma chun, Bethsaida kiti twikul khat aum in akimvel'a chu leibuh nga kisa ahi.
en_web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
en_kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema chun kelngoi kotphunga Hebrew paova, “Bethzada” kiti twikul khat aumin, leibuh nga aume.

tcz: Hiche mun'a chu ana damlou mitcho, elbai, langthi, chatmo tampi lum ahiuve, ajehchu twi kicholing ngah jing'a um ahiuve.
en_web: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
en_kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche dunga hi ana damlou mitcho, elbai, nakong chatmo tampi um ahiuve.(Amaho hin twi kilin angau ahi;

tcz: Ajeh chu phatkhat kom kom leh Pakai Vantil hungkum lha jia, twi chu acholing ji ahi; chuleh twi kicholoh nung'a twilah'a kumlha masapen pen chu itobang natna hijong leh damhel ji ahi.
en_web: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
en_kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in, was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile phat khat khat leh Vantil twikul’a hi hung kumlhaa twi chu ahinsuh lingjia, hiche twi kicholong joutah leh chomlut masapen pen chu itobang hiveiya na hijongleh damhelji ahi.)

tcz: Hilai mun'a umho lah'a mikhat chu kum somthum leh kum get jen nakong chatmo'a lum ahitai.
en_web: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
en_kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma hin mi khat kum som thum le get jen na chatmo aume.

tcz: Yeshuan amapa chu amun, kum sottah damlou va um ahi ahen, amapa jah'a, “Nadam nom em?” ati.
en_web: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
en_kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chua alup Jesun amun, phat sotpi hichea hi lum ahi, ahen ajah a, “Nadam nom em?” atileh;

tcz: Nakong chatmo pa chun, “Pu kadam joulou hila, twi akicholing teng twikul'a eikoi lhavah ding mi kaneipon, keima kacheji le kalhun masangin midang amasa jitai,” ati.
en_web: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
en_kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
tcz_gospelgo: anapan adonbut’in ajaih a, “Pakai, twi hung kicholoh teng twikul sunga eidomlut dingla koima kaneipon, kacheleh kalhun kah-in min eikheljin achimlut masajitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kipat doh in nalupna pheh kichoiyin lam jottan,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Thouvin nalupn apheh kilah-in lamjot tan,” ati.

tcz: Apettah chun mipa chu adamtan ahi, hichun aman alupna pheh chu akijel doh in lam ajottai, hiche thil kidang aso ni chu Cholngahni ahi.
en_web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
en_kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
tcz_gospelgo: Apettah chun mipa chu adamhel’in alupna akijeldoh-in lam ajottai. Hiche nikho chu Choldo ni ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon hichu ajadauvin, akisu dampa jah'a “Cholngah nikho'a natoh phal ahipoi, nangman nalupna pheh nakichoiya lam najot chu dan ngai ahipoi,” atiuve.
en_web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
en_kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Judah on adamdohpa jah a, “Tuni hi Choldo ni ahin, nalupna nakiput jeng chu dan ngai ahipoi,” tin aphoh-ui.

tcz: Ahivangin amapan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Eisudampa amatah in kajah'a nalupna kichoiyin lam jottan eiti chula em,” ati.
en_web: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
en_kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman adonbut’in, “Eidam sahpan kajah a, ‘Nalupna pheh kilah-n lam jottan,’ eiti chume,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon, “Koi ham najah'a chutia sei chu?” atiuve.
en_web: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
en_kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Najah a, ‘Nalupna kilah-in lang lam jot’in,’ tia chu koipen ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Ahinla mipa chun, asudampa chu koi ahi ahepoi, ajeh chu Yeshua mipi lah'a achelut mangtan ahi.
en_web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
en_kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla adamdohpan amuna mi atam beheh phat’a, Jesu ache mang tah jeh-in, aboldampa chu koiham ahetapoi.

tcz: Ahivangin chom khat jouvin, Yeshuan amapa chu Houin'ah amun ajah'a, “Tua hi akisudam nahitai, chonse kit tahih in, ajole akhohjo cheh nachunga chuget inte,” ati.
en_web: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
en_kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Jesun ama hi Houin a amudoh-in ajah a, ‘Ven, adam nahitai; akhoh chehjo nachunga achuh louna din chonse kit ta hih-in,” ati.

tcz: Chuin mipa chun Judah vaipo ho jah'a ama sudam chu Yeshua ahi ti agaseitan ahi.
en_web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
en_kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipa chu achen Judda miho jah a adamsah chu Jesu ahi agaseitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua amatah in Cholngah nikho apalkeh jeh in, achunga bolsetna apantauvin ahi.
en_web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
en_kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia agaseidoh phat hin Choldo nikhoa hitiho aboljeh chun Judah on Jesu abolsetauve.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kapan aphat jousen na atongin, keiman jong katong jinge,” ati.
en_web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
en_kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho hi adonbut’in, “Tu chan geiya hi ka-Pan na atoh jing jeh a Ken jong katoh ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jeh tah chun, Judah vaipo hon Yeshua thana ding aha hol cheh tauvin ahi, ajehchu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh keo hilouvin, Pathen chu apa ahisah a chuleh Pathen toh kibanga aumjeh chu ahi.
en_web: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
en_kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Juda hon Jesu chu tha din ahahol cheh tauve; ijeh-inem itile aman Choldo nikho asuhkeh keo ahipon, Pathen chu Amaseh Paa aseiya, pathento kibanga akiseijeh ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ahilchen in, ajah'uva, “Thutah chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapa chun ama cham cham in ima abolpoi; Pan abol amu ho chacha bou chu aman abolji ahi, hijeh chun Pan abol jouse chu Chapan jong abol ahi.
en_web: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
en_kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun miho chu adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapan achamin ima abolpoi, Pa bol amuchan abol ahi; ajeh chu ipi hileh Pan abol chan chu Chapan jong abol ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Pan chapa chu angailun, anatoh athilbol jouse avetsah in ahi. Chule tahbeh in Pa chun hiche mipa kisuhdam na sanga chungnungjo avetsah ding ahi, hichu nanghon kidang nasah cheh dingu ahi.
en_web: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
en_kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pan Chapa angailun, atoh chan avetsah jin, nadatmo helna diuva hicheng sanga thupijo jong ahinvetsah ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pan mithi ho akaithouva ahinsah ji bang chun Chapan jong ahinsah nom ho chu hinna apeh ji ahi.
en_web: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
en_kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
tcz_gospelgo: Pan mithi ho athodoh a ahinsah banga, Chapan jong ahinsah nom chan ahinsah ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Pan koima thu atanpoi, aman thutanna leh thuneina jouse abon'a Chapa apeh ahitai.
en_web: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
en_kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
tcz_gospelgo: Pan koima thu atanpoi, thutan ding jouse apumpia Chapa apehdoh ahitai;

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, mijousen Pa ajabol banga Chapa chu ajabol cheh ding ahi; ajeh chu Chapa jabol lou chun ahinsol'a Pachu ajabollou ahi.
en_web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
en_kjv: that all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
tcz_gospelgo: hitia min Pa ajabol banguva mitinin Chapa ajabolna ding ahi. Chapa jabol lou mi chun asol’a Pa geiya ajabol lou ahi.

tcz: Keiman atahbeh chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, kathusei ngaiya chuleh eisolpa Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; amaho chu a itih'a chonset themmo channa geita louva thina akon'a hinna galkai ahitauve.
en_web: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kasei ngaiya Eihinsolpa tahsan chun tonsot hinna anei ahitan, thupi tan naa lut louva thinaa kona hinna galkai ahitai.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, phat chu ahung lhunge, tuhi ahi, mithi hon ka aw (Pathen Chapa aw) ajah ding'u, chuleh aja chengse hing ding ahiuve.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah akaseipeh nahiuve, mithihon Pathen Chapa ogin ajah-uva, ajaph chanin hina aneidiu phat ahung lhunin, tun hikoma aume.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pa chun ama'a hinna anei ahin, chuleh aman hiche hinna pe thanei na chu Chapa apeh ahitai.
en_web: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
en_kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
tcz_gospelgo: pa Amatah hinna bulpi ahibangin, Aman Chapa jong hinna bulpi hina apetai.

tcz: Chuleh aman mi jouse chung'a thutanna leh thuneina chu chapa apeh ahitai, ajeh chu ama Mihem Chapa ahi.
en_web: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
en_kjv: and hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem Chapa ahijehin jong Pan thupi tanna apetai.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho lung dong hih'un, phat chu ahung lhunge, lhankhuh'a mithi ho jousen Pathen chapa Aw ajah ding'u;
en_web: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
en_kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi datmo hih-un, ajeh chu lhankhuh dung alum mithihon aogin ajahna diu phat ahung lhunge,

tcz: Chuleh amaho thoukit ding, chuleh thilpha bol ho chu tonsot hinna a thoukit ding, chule thilpha lou bolho chu thupi tanna'a themmo chang'a thoukit ding ahiuve.
en_web: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
en_kjv: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
tcz_gospelgo: mithiho lhankhuh hoa kona hung potdoh-uva, thilpha bol chengse kikaithouva hing diu, thilse bol chengse vang kikaithouva athuu kitan ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuleh keiman kacham in ima kabol theipoi, Pathen in eisei peh banga thutanna kanei ahijeh'in, kathutan chu dihtah ahi, ajeh chu keima lunggot lam hilouva eisolpa ama lunggot lam'a kabol ahi.
en_web: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
en_kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman kachamin ima kabolpoi; pan eihil banga thu katanjeh-in kathutan adih-e; ijeh-inem itile keima dei khohsah louva Eihinsolpa lungdei kaholjoh ahi.

tcz: Chule kachungthu chu keima man kahet tohsah leh kathu hettohsah chu adih'a pomthei hilou ding ahi.
en_web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
en_kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman kachung thu kakiseihileh kathu hettohsah chu dih lou ding ahi.

tcz: Ahivangin keima chungthu chu midang khat'in jong ahettohsah'a ahileh tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, amapan ahettohsah keima chungthu jouse chu adih ahi.
en_web: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
en_kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei chung thu hettohsah achom khat aumin, ama hettohsah chu adih kahei.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon John Baptist henga thu kholtoh dingin mi nasol'un, chuleh aman kachung chang thu dihtah chu ahettoh sahtai.
en_web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
en_kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon John henga mi nasol’un, aman adih ahettohsah-e.

tcz: Keiman mihem a kon hettohsah kangaipoi, ahivangin nangho huhhing'a naum na ding'uva hiche hi kasei ahi.
en_web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
en_kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken mihem hettohsah chu kison nan kaneipoi, huh hinga naum theina diuva kasei ahibouve.

tcz: John chu meivah koujing leh vahjing tobang ahin, chuleh ama thusei chu nanghon chomkhat dinga bou nalunglut piu ahi.
en_web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
en_kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
tcz_gospelgo: John chu thaomei kivah vahchansel ahin, ama vah a chun nang hon chom khat nomsah ding nadeiyui.

tcz: Ahivangin, keiman John sanga chung nungjo hettohsah kaneiye-hiche kathuhil leh melchihna kidang kabol hi ahi. Chuleh Pan eisol lona photchenna dinga, hiche hohi kabol dinga eipeh ahi.
en_web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
en_kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima hettohsah vang hi John’a sanga thupijo ahi, ajeh chu ka-pan molsa dinga eipeh toh ding ho katoh chengse hin pan eihinsol kahi thudol ahettohsah ahi.

tcz: Chuleh eihin sol'a Pa amatah chun kachungthu ahettohsah ahitai, nanghon a imatih in ama aw najakha pouve, chuleh kimaito pin jong namukha pouve.
en_web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
en_kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihinsol’a Pa chun kachung thudol ahettohsah ahin, nang hon a-ogin jong najapouvin, alim jong namupouve.

tcz: Chuleh nalung sung'uva ama thusei achengpoi; ajehchu aman nangho dinga ahinsol keima hi natahsan pouve.
en_web: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
en_kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinsolpa natahsan loujeh-un nasunguva jong athu achengpoi.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen Lekhabu thu nahol'un, ajeh chu hiche ho chun tonsot hinna napeh dan'un nagel uve, ahivangin Pathen Lekhabu'a thuchun, keima thudol ahettohsah ahibouve.
en_web: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
en_kjv: Search the Scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabu hoa chu tonsot hinna neithei din nagel’un nasim jiuvin, hiche ho chun Kei thudol ahettohsah-u ahibouve.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon hiche hinna chu chantheina dingin keima henga nahung nompouve.
en_web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
en_kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahinna diuvin kakoma nahung nompouve.

tcz: Chule nangho phatsah peh chu keima dingin a ngaikhoh poi.
en_web: I don’t receive glory from men.
en_kjv: I receive not honour from men.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman mihem choi-at kakisonpipoi,

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, Pathen ngailutna chu nasung'uvah achengpoi ti kahei.
en_web: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
en_kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
tcz_gospelgo: nalung sunguva Pathen na-ngailut louvu kahenai.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima kapa min'a naheng'uva kahung ahin, nanghon neisang pouve. Ahinlah midangho chu amaho min'a naheng'uva ahungleh kipahtah in nasang'uve.
en_web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
en_kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima ka-pa min’a hung kahin, nang hon neisang pouve; achomdang khat ama le ama minin hung le amajoh chu sangun nate.

tcz: Chule nanghon natahsan theilou chu datmo aumpoi, ajeh chu nanghon khat leh khat kijabolto natha noppiuvin, Pathen khatseh ama ahung kon chu, jabol ding nakhoh sah pouve.
en_web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
en_kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon mihem choi-at kisonpiuva Pathen khatseh pachat didngjoh holl ou chu iti natahsan thei diuba ham?

tcz: Hijeng jongleh Pa ang'a themmon achansah ding'u chu keima kahipoi; nanghon nakinep piu Mose chun themmo na chan sah dingu ahi.
en_web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
en_kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama vang Keihin Pa henga kaheh-in gel hih-un, nang hon nakineppiu Mose chu naheh-uva pang ahi.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon Mose chu natahsan tahtah'u ahileh keima neitahsan dingu ahi, ajeh chu aman keima thudol asut ahibouve.
en_web: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
en_kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose natahsanu le Keijong neitahsan tei diu ahi, ajeh chu aman kei thudol asut ahibouve.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon Mose chu natahsan lou jeh'un kathu sei hohi nanghon iti natahsan dingu ham?” ati.
en_web: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
en_kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
tcz_gospelgo: Aman asut thuho natahsanlou vangu leh kathuseiho jong natahsan lou diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Yeshua chun Galilee dillen (Tiberias dillen tiajong kihe) agalkaiyin alangkhat gal langa chun achetan ahi.
en_web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
en_kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Jesu Tiberias dillen kiti, Galilee dillen agal kaitai.

tcz: Chuin mihonpi tamtah'in, melchih na kidang abolho leh anaho asuhdam amu jeh'u chun achena chan'a anung ajui tauve.
en_web: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
en_kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adammo ho aboldama melchihna kidang tampi abol amujeh-un mupin ajuitauve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu mol chung khat'a akal touvin, aseijui ho toh atoukhom'uvin ahi.
en_web: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
en_kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: jesu mol chunga akaltouvin, aseijuite toh atouve.

tcz: Hichu Judah ho kalchuh kut nikho koncha ahitai.
en_web: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
en_kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kalchuh kut kiti Judate kut anaitai.

tcz: Hichun mihonpi tamtah ama henglam jon'a ahung'u chu Yeshuan amun Philip jah'a, “Mipi hijat nehding changlhah hoiya ichoh dingu hitam,” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
en_kjv: When Jesus then lift up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akhoda leh mipi ahenga hung amun, Philip jah a, “Mipi hicheng neh khop ding hi changlhah hoiya ichoh diu ham?” ati.

tcz: Hiche hi Philip patep na a asei ahibouve, aman abol ding ageltoh sa ahitai.
en_web: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
en_kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Aman patepna asei ahi; ajeh chu ipi abol ding Aman akihetnai.

tcz: Hichun Philip in adonbut'in, “Eihon kum lhungin na tong jong leu hen mi hijat in themkhat khat'a aneh khop'u chohna ding kinga jouponte,” ati.
en_web: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
en_kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip chun adonbut’in, “Denari ja ni man changlhah kicho jongleh them kha khat’in jong chang pouvinte,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Simon Peter sopipa, Andrew chun ajah'uva.
en_web: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
en_kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuite lah a khat, Simon Peter sopipa Andrewn ajah a,

tcz: “Hilaiya chapang khat in changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni aneiye, ahivangin mipi hijat lah'a hicheng hi ipia pang kham ding ham,” ati.
en_web: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
en_kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
tcz_gospelgo: “Hikoma hin pasal chapang khat’in sap change kisem changlhah pheng nga le nga ni vang aneiyin, mi hijat lah a ipi khama pang ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Miho jouse chu tousah'un,” ati; chuin amaho chu abon'un hamhing chung'a chun atoutauve. (Numei chapang simlouvin mipilhing sangnga jen ahive).
en_web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
en_kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun “Miho chu tousah-un,” ati. Hikoma chu hamhing tampi umah ahin, miho chu atouvu leh amijat sangnga bang ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan changlhah chu alan, Pathen athangvah'in miho hoppeh dingin apedohtai; chujouvin aman nga jong chutima chun abol in, chuleh mipi ho chun avaset cheh in ane tauve.
en_web: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
en_kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun changlhah pheng ho chu alan athangvah jouvin miho chu atou nauva ahoppeh-in, nga te nijong chutiman abol’in, amahon agot chanin aneuve.

tcz: Hitichun amitakip ava soh phat'un, Yeshuan aseijui ho jah'a, “Tun neh moh chengse loh khom'un, moh suhmang hih un,” ati.
en_web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
en_kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon anehva soh phat’un Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Nehval anong nai geiyin, amang thah beihel’in loh khom’uvin, “ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon changlhah pheng nga-a kon'a mipi nehmoh anong aval chengse aloh khom'un ahileh paipeh som le paipeh ni aloh dim'un ahi.
en_web: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
en_kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun aloh khomun ahileh, sap change kisem changlhah pheng ngaa kon mihon anehmoh nong siu chu paipeh som le ni aloh dim’uve.

tcz: Chuin amahon, Yeshuan hiche melchih na kidang abol chu amuphat'un, atija behseh un, “Eihon themgao ina nga jingu chu ama hi ahi mong monge,” atiuve.
en_web: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
en_kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kidang abol mu hon, “Hichepa vang hi vsnnoiya hung dia kisei Themgao chu ahimong mongtai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin amahon Yeshua chu ada achamlouva alengpau hisah ding agotauve, ti ahet jeh in, ama achangin thinglhang lam'a akilep mangtan ahi. Yeshuan twi chunga lam ajot
en_web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
en_kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin mihon hunga achamlouva leng chansah din ago’uve, ti Jesun ahen, achangseh-in molchunga akitheh doh tai.

tcz: Chuin nilhah ahiphat in aseijuite dillen pang lam'a acheuvin, Yeshua angah tauve.
en_web: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
en_kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
tcz_gospelgo: Nilhah ahiphat’in Jesu seijuite dillen lama achesuh-un,

tcz: Ahivangin khothim geiya Yeshua ahung kile lou phat'in, amaho kongsunga alut'un, Capernaum lam jon'in akitol tauvin ahi.
en_web: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
en_kjv: and entered into a ship, and went over the sea towards Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
tcz_gospelgo: kong khat’a lut’in Capernaum join dillen chu apal’uve. Kho ajing lheh tan, Jesu la ahenguva ahung hih laiye;

tcz: Chuin phulou helouvin hui hattah khat in amaho chu ahinno khum'in twi kinong chu asang jep asang jep'in, akhohse lheh jengtai.
en_web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
en_kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
tcz_gospelgo: chule huipi hattah ahung nungin twipi akinong sang tul tul jenge.

tcz: Hitichun amaho mile li vel akitol lhungun, phulou helouvin Yeshua amaho lam jon'a twi chunga lam ahinjot chu amu uvin, akicha lheh jeng'un ahi.
en_web: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
en_kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Kilometer thum le li ham akitol’u leh Jesun twichunga lam ajot’a kong lang ahinjot amu’vin akicha lheh jengui.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan amaho akouvin, “Kicha hih'un keima kahi bouve,” ati.
en_web: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
en_kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Kei kahibouve, kicha hih-un!” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in aseijuiten, Yeshua chu kong sunga lutsah loi ding athanom'un hetman lou kah chun ajotnau mun alhung tauve.
en_web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
en_kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Ama kong sunga puilut ding agot’u leh, kong chun ajotnau tol aphapaitai.

tcz: Ajingin dillen panga mihonpi umho chun, seijui hon kong khat umsun chu alah'uva akitol'u chu amu'uvin chuleh amaho lah'a Yeshua ajaopoi ti aheuvin ahi.
en_web: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
en_kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon dillen gal lang khat’a um mipin chukoma kong dang beiya khatseh um chu amu’vin, chule hiche konga chun Jesu seijuite toh lut khom louvin, asdejuite achanguva chea Ama adalhah-u aheuve.

tcz: Chuleh Tiberias a kon'a hung lhung kong dang tamtah, Yeshuan changlhah phatthei aboh a mipin anehnau mun koma chu uma ahi.
en_web: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
en_kjv: (howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin athangvah jouva changlhah aneh nau mun kom, Tiberias a kona vang kong dang jong hung ahinai.

tcz: Hijeh chun mihonpi chun, Yeshua leh aseijuite chukom'a aum tapouve ti amuphat'un amaho jong kong hoa chun alut'un Yeshua hol in Capernaum lang agal kaitauvin ahi.
en_web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
en_kjv: when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesu le asei juite chukoma aumtapouve, ti ahet phat’un mipi chu acham chamin kong sunga alut’uvin Capernauma ahungun Jesu ahol’uve.

tcz: Chuin amahon dil gal lang khat'a Yeshua amuphat'un, “Rabbi nangma itih'a hilai mun nalhun ham?” atiuve.
en_web: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
en_kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Jesu chu dillen gal langkhat’a amudoh phat’un ajah a, “Rabbi, itih a hikoma hung nahi tah em?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon keima neihol'u hi neh ding changlhah kapeh jeh'a bou ahin, melchihna kidang kabol ho nahet chen jeh'uva ahipoi.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
en_kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve. Nang hon melchihna ho namu jeh-uva neihol’u ahipon, changlhah nachan’uva nanehva jeh-uva neihol’u ahibouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, amang thahji nehding holnan hibang lom'in kisugim hih'un, hisang chun mihem chapan napeh ding'u tonsot hinna joh chu hol'in kisugim jouvin; ajehchu Pa Pathen in keima hiche dinga chu Mohor einamdet ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
en_kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
tcz_gospelgo: Amangthah ji anneh holnan tong gim hih-un, Mihem Chapan napeh diu a-itih a um jing, tonsot hinna thei anneh holnan tong gim jo’uvin, ajeh chu Pa Pathenin Chapa chu tha neina mohor anamkhum ahi tai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Keihon jong Pathen'a ding na katoh nom'uve; ipi kabol dingu ham?” atiuve.
en_web: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
en_kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon jah a, “Pathen na katoh thiena diuva ipi kabol diu ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Hiche bou hi Pathen in nanghoa kon'a adei natoh chu ahi, ahinsolpa hi tahsan un,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Pathen na toh ding kiti chu ahin solpa natahsan diui hi ahiye,” ati.

tcz: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Nang katahsan thei nading'un ipi ham nabolthei melchihna kidang khat neimu sah un,” atiuve.
en_web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
