tcz: Chule nangho cheuvin, keima chethei ponge, ajeh chu keima phat alhing jep poi,” ati.
en_web: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
en_kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kut’a chun chetauvin, Keivang kaphat alhin loulai jeh-in hiche kut’a hin cheponge,” ati.

tcz: Chule thil hicheng aseijou chun Yeshua Galilee gam'a aumden in ahi. Lhambuh Kut laiya Yeshua
en_web: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
en_kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi aseiyin Ama Galilee gamsunga aumdentai.

tcz: Ahivangin asopiho kut'a achejou nung'un, mipi ho kimu sah louvin, Yeshua jong guhthim in achen ahi.
en_web: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
en_kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopi kut’a dia ache nungun Jesu jong lhang phong hilouvin guh thimin achetouve.

tcz: Kut lai chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua chu ahol'un, mipi lah'a khat khat henga chun Yeshua namu em? tin adong leuvin ahi.
en_web: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
en_kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
tcz_gospelgo: Kut laiyin Judah on Jesu ahol’uvin, “Ama chu hoiya um ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun mipi holah'a, Yeshua chung chang kinel bautam na asoh dohtan ahi, mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mipha ahi, atiuvin, ahivangin adang phabep chun Yeshua chu imacha hilou mi lhem chavai bou ahi, atiuvin ahi.
en_web: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
en_kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi lah a chun Jesu thudol’a kinel baotamna asoh-in, loi khat’in, “Ama hi mipha ahi,” atiuvin; abangin, “Ahipoi, mipi apui chavai boue,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahivangin Judah vaipo hon abol genthei diu ginna jal chun, Yeshua thudol panpi na mipi maiya ngamtah'a seiphong ding koima a umpouvin ahi.
en_web: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
en_kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda ho agin jeh-un koiman vang athudol lhang phongin asei ngampouve.

tcz: Chuin kut kibol kimlai tah chun, Yeshua Houin'ah achetouvin chuleh thu ahilpantan ahi.
en_web: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
en_kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
tcz_gospelgo: Kut lai tah-in Jesu Houina achetouvin thu agahil’e.

tcz: Athusei ajah'u chun Judah ho chu alung dong lheh un, “Hichepa hin kijil na neilou hel'a iti thil hijat hi ahet ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
en_kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Judah on adatmo lheh jengun, “Hichepan kahilna bon nei louva iti lekha hiti thep hi nga na?” atiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kathu hil hi keima cham'a hung kon ahipon, eihin sol'a Pathen'a kon ahi.
en_web: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
en_kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Kathuhil hi Keiya ahipoi, Eihinsolpaa ahibouve.

tcz: Koi hileh Pathen lunglam hol'a bol ding go'a chun kathu hil hi keima cham'a ham ahilou leh Pathen'a kon ham ti ahet ding ahi.
en_web: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
en_kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihinsolpa lung dei bolnom mi chun thu kihil hi Pathena kon ha, kachama kasei ham, ahet didng ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama cham'a thuhil chun, ama chang kichoi-at na adeiyun, ahivangin ahinsol pa jabol na leh choi-at na holpa vang chun thutah asei ahi, ama a chun jou aumpoi.
en_web: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
en_kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
tcz_gospelgo: koi hileh achama thuseipan Ama kichoi atna ding bou aholjin, ahinsolpa choi tana ding holpa vang chu adih ahin, ama sunga chun adih lou aumpoi.

tcz: Mose in danthu napeh'u ahin, ahivangin nangho khat in jong najui pouve, nanghon keima tha tahtah dinga neigot jingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
en_kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n danthu napeh-u hilou ham? Ahinla nang ho khat cha beh-in danthu chu namangpouve. I-bol’a tha dia neihol’u ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun adonbut'un, “Koiham nang tha dinga nagong'ah? Nanghi thilha vop nahi bouve,” atiuve.
en_web: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
en_kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin adonbut’un, “Nang hi thilhavop nahi. Kooiham tha dia nahol’ah?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman Cholngah nikhoa thil kidang khat kabol chu nanghon nadatmo lheh uve.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Ken na khat katongin nabonchauvin nadatmouve.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon jong nabol'uve, Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangtah in Cholngah nikhon mi chep natan peh jiuve; tahbeh mongin cheptan hi Mose danthu peh um masanga napului teuvin ana phudohsa ahitai.
en_web: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
en_kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision, not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers; and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaa kon ahilou vangin pu le patea konin Mose’n chaptan ding thu napeuvin, hijeh chun Choldo ni jeng jongleh mihem chep natanjiuve.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon nachapa teu cheptan nikho chu Cholngah ni ato khah jongleh Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangin hichu nabol jiuve, achutile ipi dinga keiman Cholngah nikho'a mi kasuh dam chu nanghon nalunghan piu ham?
en_web: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
en_kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
tcz_gospelgo: Mose Danthu suhkeh louna dia Choldo mikhoa mikhat chep akitan leh, Choldo bikhoa mikadamthengsah hel jeha i-bol’a kachunga lung hang nahiuvam?

tcz: Hijeh chun kun'un noilang veuvin, kingaito phauvin, chutileh adihtah chu nahet ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
en_kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Polam mitvet’a thu tan louvin adih bangtah-in tan’uvin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Jerusalem miho chu amaho leh amaho aki dong touvin, “Vaipo hon tha dinga agot jing'u chu hichepa hi hilou ham?
en_web: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
en_kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem Kon miphabep’in “Mihon tha dia ahol’u chu hichepa hi hilou naimo?

tcz: Amapa la hilaiya aum in, phongtah in mipi lah'a thu aseiyin, chuleh vaipo hon jong ima alopouve. Achutileh amahon jong hichepa hi Messiah ahi ti apom ngap'u ahitadem?
en_web: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
en_kjv: But lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla ve, aman lhang phongtah-in thu asiyin, amahonla ajah a imacha aseipouve. Vaipoten ama hi Messiah ahi tia ahet chet mongu hitam?

tcz: Ahivangin amapa hi hichu iti hithei ding ham? Eihon ama ahung konna kihesoh keiya, Messiah vang chu ahung tengleh koiman ahung konna ahetlou ding, hung kilah jeng ding ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
en_kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon hichepa ahung kina kihea, Messiah ahung teng vang leh koiman akonna ahet lou ding ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan Houin'a athuhil pet chun, ajah'uva, “Adih'e, nanghon keima neiheuve, chuleh kahung konna jong naheuve, ahivangin keima kacham'a hilaiya um kahipoi, keima eihinsolpa chu thudihtah ahi, chuleh nanghon ama chu nahe pouve.
en_web: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
en_kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hitea Houina thu ahilpet hin asamin, “Nang hon Keima neiheuvin, kahung konna geiyin naheuve. Ahinla Keima kachama hung kahipoi, Eihinsolpa chu dih tah ahin, nang hon Ama nahepouve.

tcz: Ahivangin keiman ama kahe chen'e, ajeh chu keima ama-a hung kon kahi, chuleh aman keima naheng'uva eihinsol ahi,” ati.
en_web: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
en_kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang Ama kahei, ajeh chu Amaa hung kon Ama sol kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin vaipo hon ama chu mat ding agouvin, ahivangin ama phat alhin lou lai jeh in, koiman achunga khut alhapouve.
en_web: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
en_kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mihon mat dingago’uvin, aphat lhin loulai jeh-in koiman achunga khut alhapouve.

tcz: Hichun Houin'a um mitamtah chun Yeshua atahsan tauve, chule amaho akihouvun, “Messiah ahung teng, hichepan abol kalval'a nasajo melchih na kidang abolnah ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
en_kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do moe miracles than these which this man hath done?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipilah a tampin Ama atahsanun, “Messiah hung teng jongle hichepa bol sanga tamjo melchihna abol mong ding hinam?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mihonpi chu, Yeshua thudol akihoulhih melmul'u chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat'un, thempu pipui hotoh kijaton, Yeshua man dingin Houin ngah ho chu asol tauvin ahi.
en_web: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
en_kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thudol’a mipi akinel baotam nau chu Pharisee hon ajauvin, hijeh chun thempu pipuho leh Pharisee hon Jesu man din lhacha ho asoltauve.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Keima nangho toh phat chomcha bou ka umkhom ding ahi, chuleh keima eihinsolpa heng'a kakile kit ding ahi.
en_web: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Phat chomcha ka-umpiuva, chutengleh Eihinsolpa henga kache ding ahitai.

tcz: Nanghon keima neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu ahi, chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
en_kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon neihol’uvaneimu lou diu, Kei umnaa la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Judah vaipo ho chun, hiche Yeshua thusei chu adatmo lheh un ahi, amaho akidong touvin, “Hichepa hi hoilanga che ding kigo ham? Oleh, amahi hiche gam dalha'a mun danga um Judah ho henga cheding kigo ahidem? Amahin Greek miho jeng jong agahil got hinte.
en_web: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
en_kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
tcz_gospelgo: Judaho akihouvun, “Hoiya che idng kigo hiya, eihon i-hol’uva imu lou diu ham? Chi dang namdang lah akithecheh Judate lah a chea, chiding namdang h gahil ding agot kha tham?

tcz: Chuleh ipi aseina mong ahidem? Nanghon neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung theilou dingu atihi,” akitiuvin ahi.
en_web: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
en_kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
tcz_gospelgo: Athusei, ‘Neihol’uva neimu lou diu, Kei umna la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,’ ati hi ipi atina mong ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin kut kichaini aniloupi pen nin, Yeshua mihonpi lah'a ading doh'in, ajah'uva, “Koi hileh adangchah'a chu kahenga hunghen.
en_web: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
en_kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Kut kichai ni, ni loupe nin Jesu adingin o-ging tah-in asamin, “Koi hileh adangchah a chu kahenga hung hen lang don hen,

tcz: Koi hileh keima eitahsan'a chu kahenga hunghen chuleh hungdon hen, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun aphondoh banga ama lung sunga kon'a chu twi hing luiya longdoh ding ahi,” tin asamtai.
en_web: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
en_kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lakhabun, ‘Keima eitahsana chu along sunga hintwi put’a luiya long ding ahi,’ ati banga um ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Aman twi-hing ati chu ama tahsan jouse chunga Lhagao aum ding aseina ahi, ahivangin Yeshua chu aloupina'a alut loulai jeh'in hiche Lhagao chu kipeloulai ahiuve.
en_web: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
en_kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Ama tahsanhon Lhagao akisan diu aseina ahi, ijeh-inem itile Jesu choi-at a aum loulai jeh a hiche ni geiya hi Lhagai kihom loulai ahi.

tcz: Chuin mihonpi chun, hiche asei chu ajauvin, alah'uva phabep chun, “Hichepa hi inga jingu themgao pachu hitei yinte,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
en_kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche aseiho hi mipi phabep’in ajauvin, “Hichepa hi Themgao tahbeh ahibouve,” atiiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin ahi, ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Hiponte, iti Messiah chu Galilee gam'a hungsoh doh thei ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
en_kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
tcz_gospelgo: Adang hon ma, “Hichepa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin, konkhat’in vang, “Galilee gama Messiah sohdoh din gong?”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabu'a kicheh tah'a kiphong dohsa bangin, Messiah chu David chilhah hiding, David khopi Bethlehem a kon hiding ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
en_kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabun, ‘Messiah chu David guiya kona Bethlehema hung sohdoh ding ahi,’ ati lou ham, David chenna khopia chu?” atiiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Yeshua chung chang thua, mihonpi chu akikhen tel gamtauvin ahi.
en_web: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
en_kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Ama jehin mipi akibung khentauve.

tcz: Chuleh alah'uva mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mat tei ding angaitou vin, ahivang in koiman achunga khut alhapouve. Judah vaipo hon Yeshua atahsan lou
en_web: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
en_kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
tcz_gospelgo: Abang bangin mat din ago’uvin, koi manla achunga khut alhapouve.

tcz: Chuin Houin ngah sottol le ho chu Yeshua manlouva ahung kile phat'un, thempu pipui holeh Pharisee ho chun ajah'uva, “Ibol'a ama nahin puilut lou u ham?” tin adongun ahi.
en_web: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
en_kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
tcz_gospelgo: Lhachaho chu Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee ho henga ahung phat’un amahon, “I-bol’a nahin kaidiu ham?” tin anadongui.

tcz: Houin ngah sottol le hon adonbut'un, “Keihon hichepa thusei tobang kaja khapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
en_kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhachahin adonbut’un, “Khu cheap thusei tobangin koiman thu asei khapoi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Pharisee hon anuisat un, “Nangho jong lhep lhah'a na um'u hitam?
en_web: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
en_kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon adonbut’un, “Doha nalhah-u hitalou ong?

tcz: Eiho lah'a vaipo ho leh Pharisee ho khat beh injong amapa chu atahsan em?
en_web: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
en_kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
tcz_gospelgo: Vaipo ho lah a khat beh le Pharisee mikhat beh-in atahsan em?

tcz: Khohelou mihonpi in dan thupeh ima ahetlou jeh'uva ama nung ajuiyu ahibouve, chuleh achung'uva Pathen sapset chuding ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
en_kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu hetoh lou hiche mipi vang hi sapset chang hiuva khu,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun masanga Yeshua toh gakimuto sa vaipo lah'a khat amin Nicodemus chun, ajah'uva;
en_web: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
en_kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva mikhat, masanga Jesu henga hungsa, Nicoddemua vang chun ajah-uva,

tcz: “Mikhat chu ama thu kija masa louva, achunga themmo chansah jeng chu dan ngai na ham?” ati.
en_web: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
en_kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
tcz_gospelgo: I-danthu’vin mi athu ngai masa loule athilbol muchen louva achung thu eitahsanji nah um?” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut un, “Nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Pathen Lekhabu'a phet inlang sim'in Galilee gam'a kon'a themgao sohdoh khalou hel ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
en_kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Hol’in vetang, Galilee kona Themgao sohdoh ngai lou chu,’” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun akikhop nau aki khen'un mijousen a-in cheh akijot tauvin ahi.
en_web: Everyone went to his own house,
en_kjv: And every man went unto his own house.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon inlam ajon cheh-un,

tcz: Yeshua chu Olive lhang lam'a akile kittai.
en_web: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
en_kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

tcz: Ahivangin ajing jingkah matah in ama Houin'ah ahungkit in ahi. Chuin hetman louvin, mihonpi khat aheng'a ahung kikhom'un ama atouvin, amaho chu thu ahiltan ahi.

en_web: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

tcz_gospelgo: Amanun, “Pakai, koiman themmo eichan tapoi,” ati. Jesun, “kenjong themmo kachan poi, chen lan gchonse kit ta hihin,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kachungthu keima tah'in kahet tohsah hi, hettoh sah dihtah ahi. Ajeh chu keiman kahung kona leh kajot na ding kakihet in, ahivangin hichu nanghon nahe pouve.”
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in jah-uva, “ken kachung thu hettohsah jong leng kahettohsah hi adih-e; ajeh chu hoiya hung kona hoi lam kajot kakihet’in, nang hon hoiya hungkona hoi lam kajot nahepouve.

tcz: Chule nanghon tahsa mihem hina dol'in ka chungthu natan'un, keiman vang koima chungthu chuti chun katan jipoi.
en_web: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

tcz: Ijemtia thutanna kabol tah jongle, kathu tan jouse abon'a dihtah ahi; ajeh chu keima kachang kahipon, eihinsol'a Kapa toh kahilhon'e.

tcz_gospelgo: ijehtin tan jeng jong leng kathutan adih-e, ajeh chu kachang kahinpon, Eihinsol’a pa chun eiumpi.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho danthu dungjui in minin kitoh tah'a ahettoh sah leh hichu hettoh sah dihtah'a kipom ahi.
en_web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
en_kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nadanthu va jong mini thu hettohsah chu adihna akisune.

tcz: Hijeh chun, keima tah hettoh sah khat kahin, chuleh eihinsol'a kapa chu hettohsah adang khat chu ahi.
en_web: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
en_kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachung thu hettohsah a pang Kei kahin, chule Eihinsol’a panjong kachung thu ahettohsah-e,” ati.

tcz: Hichun amahon adong'un, “Napa hoiya umham?” atiuve, Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nanghon keima neihe pouve, kapa jong nahe pouve, keima neihe leu chun kapa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ajah a, “Napa hoiya um ham?” atiuleh; Jesun adonbut’in, “Nang hon Keila neihepouvin, ka-pa jong nahepouve; Keima neihetsau hileh ka-Pa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chu, Yeshuan Houin sunga sumkhol na kiti mun'a athuhil pet'a asei ahi. Ahivangin anikho alhin jep loulai jeh in, koiman ama chu amanpoi.
en_web: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
en_kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi Jesun Houina athuhil pet’a thil kholna muna asei ahin, Ama phat ahung lhun loulai jeh-in koiman aman pouve.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Keima kache mang ding ahi, nangho kache na-a nahung thei pouve, ajeh chu na chonset nau chu nathipi ding'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva asei kit’in, “Keima che mang ing ting, nang hon neihol diu, ahinla nachonset’a nathiden’uvaa kache naa nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun miho chu akidong touvin, “Hiche pa hi ama leh ama kithat go khat ham? Chuleh kache na-a nangho nahung thei pouve ati hi ipi aseina ahidem?” atiuve.
en_web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
en_kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon, “Ama le ama kithat ngap ding ham, ‘Kache naa nahung thei lou diu,’ ati khu?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Nangho noiya kon nahiuvin, keima chunga kon kahi, chuleh nangho hiche vannoiya um nahiuvin, keima kahipoi.

tcz_gospelgo: Ama tahsan Jusa hojah a Jesun, “Nang hon kasei najom jingo leh kaseijui tahbeh mong nahiuvin,

tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Chapan jalensah leu chun najalen tahbeh diu ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Ka-pa koma kamu chukasei ahin, nang hon jong na-pauva kaona najah chan nabol’u ahi,” ati.

en_web: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
en_kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon napau thil bol nabol’u ahi,” ati. Amahon ajah a, “Keiho bolam kahipouve, ka-pau khat Pathen ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon ibol'a kathusei nahet thei lou'u ham? hiche hi nanghon kathu sei nangailou jeh'u ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Idinga kasei nahet khen thei louvu ham? Kahil hi-na-ngai jou loujeh-u ahibouve.

tcz: Nangho napau Satan chate nahi jeh'un, ama thilbol aphalou ho bol ding nanomui, ama chu atil'a pat'a tolthat ahin, ama-a thutah'a umlou jeh chun, phat jousen aman thutah ahot in ahi; aman jou asei chu achonna'a behden ahitai, ajeh chu ama mijou ahin, jou kondon na pa ahi.
en_web: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
en_kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho napau Diabol’a nahiuva napauva hung kon alungdei chu namolso namu ahi. Ama chu semtil’a pat tolthat ahin, thutah aum loujeh a atah a pang ngailou ahi. Aman thujou asei teng along chama aseiji ahi; ajeh chu jousei ahin, jou penna pa ahi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman nangho thutah kasei peh'u jongleh nanghon keima neitahsan theilou'u ahi.
en_web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
en_kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang atah kasei ahin, ahinla neitahsan pouve.

tcz: Chuleh nangho koipen in hettohsah kichehtah'a mi chonse kahina nei ngoh thei uvem? Achutileh na henguva keiman thutah kasei ahi, ibol'a neitahsan lou'u ham?
en_web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
en_kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
tcz_gospelgo: Michonse ahi eiti thei ding koipen nahiuvem? Atah kasei ahileh ibol’a neitahsan dau ham?

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hileh Pathen'a hiho chun kipah tah in Pathen thu angaiyun ahi; ahivangin nangho Pathen'a nahilou jeh'un athu na ngaipouve,” ati.
en_web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
en_kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathena kon chun Pathen thu angaiyin, nang hon thu na-ngailouvu hi Pathena kon nahilou jeh-u ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilha vop nahi tia kana seijingu hita lou ham?” atiuve.
en_web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
en_kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
tcz_gospelgo: Judahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilhavop nahi katiu hi dih lou ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kahipoi, keima thilhavop kahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kapa kajabol ahin, nanghon keima neija bol pouve.
en_web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
en_kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Keima thilhavop kahipon, ka-Pa kajabol ahin, nang hon Keima neijabol pouve.

tcz: Ahivangin, keiman keima chang kichoi-at kaholpoi, Pathen in keima eichoi sang dingbou ahi; ajeh chu ama thutan dihtah ahi.
en_web: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
en_kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman kaloupina ding kaholpon, ahol’a athutan khat aum nai.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho atahbeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh kathuhil ngaiya bol'a chu a itih'a thi lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Thilhavop nahi kahe tauve, Abraham leh themgao ho athigam tauvin, ahivangin nangman kathuhil nit'a chu a itih'a thilou ding ahi, nati.
en_web: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
en_kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon ajh a, “Thilhavop nahi tun kahetauve. Abraham athitan, Themgao jouse jong athitauvin, ahinla nangin, “Kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,’ nati.

tcz: Chule kapau Abraham sang'a chungnung jo nahim? Ama athitan, themgao ho jong athitauvin, ahileh nangman koi kahi tia naki gel ham?” atiuve.
en_web: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
en_kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
tcz_gospelgo: Kapu luiyu Abraham athitan, asanga lenjo nahim? Themgao jouse jong athigamtan, koipenba kahi nakitim?” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kichang choi-at na hol kahileh hichu keima ima hilou kahitai; ahinlah nanghon ka Pathen'u natiu kapa ama chun keima ei choi-at ding ahibouve.
en_web: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
en_kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Kei kichoi-an kahileh kaloupina chu ima ahipoi, nang hon, “Ka-pau ahi,’ natiu hiche ka-Pa chun eichoi-at joh ahibouve.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon ama chu nahe pouve, kenvang ama chu kahei, chuleh keiman ama chu kahepoi tileng keimatah hi nangho banga mijou kahi khah ding ahi, ahivangin keiman ama kahet jeh chun, amathu kangaiyin ahi.
en_web: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
en_kjv: yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu nang hon nahe hih laiyun, Kenvang kahenai; Ama chu kahepoi tileng nang ho banga jousei kahi ding ahi, Ken ama kahen athu kanit’e.

tcz: Chuleh napau Abraham chun keima nikho mu ding anagal dot ahin, chule aman hichu anamun chuleh akipah lheh jengin ahi,” ati.
en_web: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
en_kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-pau Abraham chu Keima nikho mu ding athanomin, amun akipah lheh jenge,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Judah ho chun ajah'a, “Nangma kum somnga bon lhinglou laiya, iti nangin Abraham kamutai nati ham?” atiuve.
en_web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
en_kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon ajah a, “Nakum som nga bon lhing lou laiya Abraham namusa hiya ong?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham masanga keima ana umsa jing kahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
en_kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham pem masanga jong um jing Keima kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuche phat chun, Judah hon ama sena dingin song akilah tauvin ahi, ahivangin alah'uva kon'in Yeshua chu akiseldoh in, Houin'a kon chun achemangtai.
en_web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
en_kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ase na didng song akilo phat’un Jesu achamin akiseldoh-in, Houina kon chun ache mangtai.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu avahlen ahileh, apen'a mitcho'a peng mikhat amun ahi.
en_web: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
en_kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu ache naa mi apen’a pat mitcho khat amui.

tcz: Hichun aseijuiten ajah'a, “Houhil, hichepa hi ipi jeh'a apen'a mitcho'a peng ham? Ama chonse ham? Oleh anu leh apa chonse a ham?” atiuve.
en_web: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
en_kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuiten ajah a, “Rabbi, hichepa mitchoa apen hi ama chonset jeh ha anu le apa chonset jeh ham?” tin adongui.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche hi ama chonset jeh jong ahipon, chuleh anuleh apa chonset jeh jong ahipoi; hiche a hi Pathen thahatna ama chunga akiphon na dinga ahibouve.
en_web: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
en_kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Hiche hi ama chonset vang jong ahipon; Pathen natoh ho kiphondoh theina dinga ama hi mitchoa peng ahibouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun eihon kinloi tah'a eisol pauvin einganse nau hi itoh dingu ahitai.
en_web: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
en_kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
tcz_gospelgo: Sun ahipet’a Eihunsolpa na i-tih tei diu hiveh ta, koiman na atoh thei louna ding jan hung lhung ding hita hi.

tcz: Ahivangin keima hiche vannoiya kaum laisea hi vannoi vah kahi,” ati.
en_web: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
en_kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya kaum laisea vannoi salvah kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin aman tol'ah achil aset in, achil a chun bonlhoh asemin chuleh hiche bonlhoh chu mitchopa mit'a aloiyin ahi.
en_web: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
en_kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hiche hi aseiyin, tol’ah achil aset lhan, achil’in bonlhoh asemin, mitchopa mit te nia aloiyin

tcz: Hichun aman ajah'a, “Chen Siloam (sol tina ahi) twikul'a nangma tah in gaki phetlhah in,” ati. Hijeh chun mipa chu achen agakiphet lhahtai, chuleh kho amun ahung kiletan ahi.
en_web: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
en_kjv: and said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
tcz_gospelgo: ajah a, “Chen lang Siloam (Siloam hi ‘sol’ kiti ahi) twikul’a gakiphet lhah tan,” ati. Ama achea agakiphet lhah leh kho amun ahung kile kittai.

tcz: Chuin aheng akom achenkhompi ho chuleh masanga amapa khutdo ji musa ho chu akidong touvin, “Toumun'a khutdo jipa chu hichepa hi hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
en_kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
tcz_gospelgo: Mitchopa heng le kom ho, khutdoa apan lai musa hon, “Touva khutdoji chu ama hi hilou haimo?” atiuve.

tcz: Mi phabep chun “Amapa chu ahi” atiuvin, chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa chu ahipoi akilopi joh ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi; hichun amapa chun, “Henge ama chu kahinai,” ati jengtan ahi.
en_web: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
en_kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
tcz_gospelgo: Abangin, “Ama ahinai,” atiuvin, kim khat’in, “Ahipoi, amato lim kilo ahibouve,” atiuve. Mitchopa ama tah-in, “Kei ama chu kahinai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adong'un, “koiham kho namu sah? ipi iti dan ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
en_kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ajah a, “I-atileh namit te ni hah hitam?” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun amapan ajah'uva, “Yeshua atipau chun bonlhon asem in, hichu kamit'a eiloi peh in chuin kajah'a ‘chen Siloam twikul'a nangma tah'in gaki phetlhah tan eiti,’ hijeh chun keima kachen kaga phetlhah leh kho kahin mu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
en_kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman adonbut’in, “Jesu kitipa khun bonlhoh asemin, kamit te nia aloiya, ‘Siloam a chen gakiphet lhah tan,’ atia, kachea kagaphet lhah leh kho kamu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adongun, “Amapa chu tua hoiya um tam?” atiuvin ahi, aman adonbut in, “Kahepoi,” ati.
en_web: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
en_kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ajah a, “Ama hoiya umtam?” atiuleh; aman, “Kahepoi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon masanga mitchopa chu Pharisee ho henga ahinpui tauvin ahi.
en_web: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
en_kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon masanga mitchopa chu Psarisee ho henga apuitauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yeshuan bonlhoh asem'a amapa asuhdam nikho chu Cholngah ni ahi.
en_web: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
en_kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun bonlhoh asema mitchopa mitt e nia aloiya ahasah ni chu CHoldo nikho ahi.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon amapa chu amit khomu dol abonchan adongun ahi, hijeh chun aman ajah'uva, “Aman bonlhoh chu kamit'a aloiyin, chuin keiman kaga phetlhah leh kho kamu jeng ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
en_kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee hon amapan kho amu thudol chu akhol kit’uvin ahileh aman ajah-uva, “Aman bonlhoh asemin kamit te nia aloiya kagasop lhah phat’a kho kamuthei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep chun, “Hiche mipa Yeshua hi Pathen a kon ahipoi, ajeh chu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh e atiuvin ahi.” Ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Iti michonse khat in hitobang melchihna kidang hohi abolthei ding ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah'a chun kibung khenna lentah a umdohtan ahi.
en_web: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
en_kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pharisee ho phabep’in, “Choldo ni anit loujeh-in hichepa hi Pathena kon loujeh-in,” atiuvin; abangman, “Michosen hitobang thil kidang ho abol thei ngai ong?” tin, hitobang hin alah-uva kibung khenna asohtai.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon, mitcho kho mupa chu adong kit'un, “Namit kho namu sahpa chu nangman koi ahi natim?” atiuvin, aman adonbut'in, “Themgao khat hiteiyinte,” ati.
en_web: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
en_kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon mitchopa jah a avel’in, Amahon namit ahasah jeh a chu nangin Ama chu koi ahiba natim?” atiuleh; aman, “Themgao ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jeng jong chun, Judah vaipo hon hiche mipa chu, mitcho anahia tua kho amu ahitai, tichu atahsan pouve, hijeh chun amahon anu leh apa akimu piuvin ahi.
en_web: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
en_kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon ama chu mitchosa ahi kho amu kit hi anu le apa kouva,

tcz: Chuleh amahon anu leh apa chu adong'un, “Hichepa hi apen'a mitcho'a peng'a hinam? Ahileh tua iti kho amuthei ham?” atiuve.
en_web: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
en_kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
tcz_gospelgo: amani jah a, “Hichepa hinachapa lhon, amitchosa peng niti lhonpa lhon, amitchosa peng nati lhonpa chu himong nam? Ahileh iti kho amu kitham?” tia adoh masang seuvin atahsanpouve.

tcz: Hichun anu leh apan adonbut'in, “Ama hi apen'a mitcho'a peng kachapa lhon ahi, kahe lhon e,” ati.
en_web: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
en_kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
tcz_gospelgo: Anu le apan adonbut lhonin, “Amahi kachapa lhon ahiya chule mitcho anahi chu kahe lhon nai;

tcz: “Ahivangin aman iti kho amu ham, koiyin amit adamsah ham, kahe lhonpoi; ama dong'un, amatah achungthu kiseitheiya upa ahitai,” atilhon e.
en_web: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
en_kjv: but by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
tcz_gospelgo: i-atileh kho amu kit’a, koipenin amit te ni ahasah ham vang kahe lhonpoi. Ama dongun, upa hita chu achung thu aman kisei nante,” ati lhone.

tcz: Hichu anuleh apan Judah vaipo ho kichat na jeh'a achuti seilhon ahi, ajeh chu amahon, “Koi hileh Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tia sei aum leh kikhop na in'a kon'a nomang ding tia ana phon dohsau ahitai.”
en_web: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
en_kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
tcz_gospelgo: Judaho aginjeh lhona anule apan hiche hi asei lhon ahi; ajeh chu Jesu hi Messiah ahi tia phongdoh pen pen Houthua kikhopna ina kona pamse ding tia Judahon dettah a kilolna aneisau ahi.

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu amanin ajah'uva, “Ama kidoh un amatah chu athu kiseithei ja len ahitai,” atilhon ahi.
en_web: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
en_kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu anu le apan, “Upa hita chu ama dongun,” ati lhon ahi.

tcz: Chuin amahon anivei nan mitcho khomupa chu akouvun, ajah'a, “Hiche thua hi Pathen bou loupi sah in, ajeh chu Yeshua kitipa chu michonse ahi, keihon kaheuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
en_kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
tcz_gospelgo: Anivei nan amahon masanga mitchopa chu akouvun ajah a, “Pathen choi-atnan adih seiyin, hichepa vang hi michonse ahi, keihon kahei,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun aman adonbut'in, “Ama michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi, ahivangin kahet chu hiche ahi, ‘keima mitcho kana hin tunvang kho kamutai,’” ati.
en_web: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
en_kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama adonbut’in, “Michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi; masang chun kamit achon tun kho kamui, tibou kahei,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adongkit tei teiyun, “Ama chun ipi abol'a iti namit chu asuhdam ham?” atiuve.
en_web: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
en_kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ajah a, “Aman i-nalom? Namit te ni iti ahasah ham?” atiuleh;

tcz: Aman ajah'uva, “Veuvin khatvei kaseisa ahitai, nanghon nangai pouve, ibol'a avel'a najah nom kit'u ham? Nangho jong ama seijui nahi nom'u ham?” ati.
en_web: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
en_kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would you hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
tcz_gospelgo: Aman amaho adonbut’in, “Nakiseipeh tauva na-ngaipouvin, i-bol’a najah nom kit’u ham? Ama seijuiya napan nom’uvem?” ati.

en_web: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
en_kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thu lhunna mai maiho bon Pathente akitiu jouthei lou ahin,

tcz: Ibol'a ken keima Pathen chapa kahi tia kasei leh, nanghon Pathen taitom nahi neitiu ham? Pan hiche dinga chu keima atumbeh'a eikhen doh'a eisuhtheng'a vannoiya eihinsol ahi.
en_web: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
en_kjv: say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
tcz_gospelgo: pan athensoa vannoiya ahinsol Keiman, ‘Pathen kataitoma naseiyu ham?

tcz: Eisol'a kapa natoh ho kabol louleh neitahsan dauvin.
en_web: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
en_kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman ka-Pa na katoh lou leh neitahsanda jengun;

tcz: Ahin, ama kin katoh ahivang leh, keima neitahsan theilou jongleh, melchihna kidang kabol hohi hettohsah nan neiyun lang, tahsan un. Chutileh nanghon Pa keiya aum'a chuleh keima Pa'a ka um chu hetauvinnate,” ati.
en_web: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
en_kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
tcz_gospelgo: katoh vang leh Keima neitahsan hih jongleu chun Keisunga Pa apansat’a chule Keima Pa sunga kapansat hi nahet chet vang nadiuvin, na kitong chengse beh hi tansan’uvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin avel'in amahon Yeshua chu matding ago kit'un, ahi. Ahivangin ama hiche mun'a kon chun apotdoh in amaho chu adalhatai.
en_web: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
en_kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun amahon mat din ago kit’un, Ama la akhut’uva konin atoldoh tai.

tcz: Chuin ama Jordan lui gallam'a amasa-a John in baptize ana bol na lam'a chun achen aga umtai.
en_web: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
en_kjv: and went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Jordan luigal lam, amasa Johnin mi baptize abolna muna chun achen, hia chun agathamtai.

tcz: Chua chun, mi tamtah'in anung ajuiyun, amaho chu akihouvun, “John in melchihna kidang ho anabolpon, ahivangin Yeshua thudol aseiho abonchan atah in alhungsoh keiye,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
en_kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi tampi ahenga ahungun, “Johnin melchihna ima abol hih nan, ahin hichepa chung thudol’a John thusei jouse vang adih soh keiye,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin chukom'a um mi tamtah ho chun Yeshua atahsan tauve.
en_web: Many believed in him there.
en_kjv: And many believed on him there.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma chun mi tampin Jesu atahsantauve.

tcz: Pasal khat amin Lazarus kitipa chu Bethany a cheng ahin, dammo na nei, chule asopiteni Mary leh Martha toh cheng khom ahi.
en_web: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
en_kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
tcz_gospelgo: Mary le asopinu Martha chenna Bethany khoa amin Lazarus atiu chu adammoi.

tcz: Hiche numeinu Mary hi ahi, Pakai kengbul'a thao nu'a asama theh ngima chu;
en_web: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
en_kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
tcz_gospelgo: Anapa chu, Pakai thao nua asama akeng thehgim nu, Mary sopipa Lazarus ahi.

tcz: Chule amanin a-ucha lhon in Pakai Yeshua heng'a thu athot lhon'in hitin asei lhon e, “Pakai nangailut nasopi naloipa hi adammo lhehtai,” atilhon in ahi.
en_web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
en_kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopi numei ten in ahenga mi asol lhonin, “Pakai, ven nalungset nagolpa asammoi,” agatisah lhone.

tcz: Hichu Pakai Yeshuan ajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Lazarus dammo nahi thina a kichai ding ahipoi, Pathen loupina dinga kibol'a ahibouve ati, hiche jeh a chu Pathen Chapa loupi na hungsoh doh dinga kitah lang joh ahi,” ati.
en_web: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
en_kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hichu ajah phat’in, “Hiche nat hi thina ding ahipoi, Pathen Chapa choisanga aumnadinga Pathen loupina ding ahi bouve,” ati.

tcz: Pakai Yeshuan, Mary, Martha leh asopipa Lazarus alungset lheh jeng vang chun;
en_web: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
en_kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Martha le asopinu chule Lazarus chu alungset lheh-e.

tcz: Hikom'a aum na mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu nini tobang aumbe nalaiyin ahi.
en_web: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
en_kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
tcz_gospelgo: Lazarus dammo thu ajah vangin aumnaa chun ni ni anichonbe nalaiyin;

tcz: Hichun aphat ahung lhin phat chun Pakai Yeshuan aseijui ho koma aseijin, “Eiho Judea gam langa kinungle kit tauhite ati.”
en_web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
en_kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judea again.
tcz_gospelgo: chujouvin aseijuite jah a, “Judea gama gachekit tauhite,” ati.

tcz: Ahin aseijuiten lung opkai na aneiyun, “Rabbi, ni ijat ham khat masanga chu Judea gam'a mihon songa selih ding nagot'u chula em,” atiuve.
en_web: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
en_kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiten ajah a, “Rabbi, tutah a Judah on songa sedia nahol’uva, hikoma chu nagache kit ding ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nikhat sunga hi nidan som le ni niseh a um ahi, chule sun a hi mi jousen lam ajotthei cheh ding ahi. Chuleh amahon kho amuthei nau chu ahileh vannoi vah anei jeh'u ahi.
en_web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
en_kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Nikho khat sunga nidan som le ni um hilou ham? Sun laiya vah le mi chun vannoiya khovah amujeh-in akisunpoi;

tcz: Ahin, jantengleh tijat natah jong aumin, kipal lhuh na thei jong aumin ahi, ajeh chu vah aumji tapon ahi,” ati.
en_web: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
en_kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
tcz_gospelgo: jan laiya vah le mi vang amasanga khovah aum loujeh-in akisuijie,” ati.

tcz: Hichun aman aseiyin, “Iloipau Lazarus a-imu lhatai” ati, “Amavang keima kache ding kaga thodoh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
en_kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi aseiyin, hiche jouchun ajah-uva, “Igolpau Lazarus chu a-ihmutai, ahin ama sukhanga che ding kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun seijuiten adonbut uvin, “Pakai, Lazarus chu a'imut leh damvah ding tina ahitai,” atiuve.
en_web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
en_kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiten ajah a, “Pakai aihmuttah le damtante,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahin seijui ho geldan'a chu kicholdo dinga a'imut aseiyin angaitouvin, ahin Pakaiyin asei chu Lazarus thi ahitai atina ahi.
en_web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
en_kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun la athitai tia aseina ahin, amahon angaiya ihmut aseinan agel’uve.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin aseichet pehin, “Lazarus chu athitai.”
en_web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Jesun ajahuva aseichanin, “Lazarus, chu athia ahitai;

tcz: “Chuleh keima kakipah lheh e, ajeh chu nang hon natahsan theina dingu ahi, hijongle tun hungun ahenga cheu hite,” ati.
en_web: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
en_kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: natahsan theina diuva chukoma ka-umlou chu nang ho din kakipah-e, ahenga gacheu hite,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Thomas minlhem ni neipa chun aloi aseijui ho lah'a aseitan, “Eiho jong cheu hitin, chu a Pakai toh gathi khom'u hite,” ati.
en_web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
en_kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Apengkop ahi, tia Thomas kitipan aseijui chanpi ho jah a, “Eiho jong amatoh i-thi than a diuva gacheu hite,” ati.

tcz: Yeshua Bethany kho'a ahung lhun chun Lazarus chu lhan khuh'a avui nau ni li ahitai ti aseipeh uve.
en_web: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
en_kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lien in the grave four days already.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu ahung leh Lazarus lhana alupsah nau chu ni li alhingtai ti aphotoh tai.

tcz: Bethany chu Jerusalem kom ahin, mile themkhat bouva gamla ahi;
en_web: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
en_kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
tcz_gospelgo: Bethany chu Jerusalem komcha, kilometer thum tobang ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Judah le midang tamtah achekhom'un, Mary leh Martha amani lungmon sah dinga hung'ah anaum'un ahi.
en_web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
en_kjv: and many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopipa lhon chung change lhamon dingin Juda hotampi Martha le Mary henga ahungui.

tcz: Hiti chun Martha in Pakai ahungtai tithu ajah phat'in amanu chu achen Pakai chu aga kimupin Mary vangchu inmun'ah aum dentai.
en_web: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
en_kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu hung ajah phat’in Martha chu alamdot din achen, Mary vang in’a atouve.

tcz: Hichun Martha in Yeshua koma aseitai, “Pakai nangma hilai mun'a hi ana um hile chun kasopi pa hi thilou ding ahi” ati.
en_web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
en_kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
tcz_gospelgo: Marthan Jesu jah a, “Pakai, nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga,

tcz: Ahin tunjong Pathen in nathum chan napeh ding kahe nai ati.
en_web: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
en_kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
tcz_gospelgo: tujengin jong ipi hileh Pathen henga nathum chan Pathenin peteiyin nete ti kahei,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Nasopi pa thou kit ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Nasopipa thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge kanom'e, Ni nunung nia thokit nia atho doh kit ding chu kahe nai,” ati.
en_web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
en_kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
tcz_gospelgo: Marthan ajah a, “Achai nikhoa thokitnaa athodoh ding chu kahenai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan amanu jah'a hitin aseiye, “Keima hi thokitna le hinna chu kahi; chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan chan chu thita jongleh thoudoh kit ding ahi.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
en_kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Keima thokit na le hinna kahin, keima eitahsana chu thijongle hing ding ahi;

tcz: Chuleh koi hijong leh ahinga keima eitahsan a chu itih hijongle thilou ding ahi. Martha hiche hi na tahsan em?” ati.
en_web: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
en_kjv: and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
tcz_gospelgo: chule mihing eitahsan chan a-itih a thilou hel ding ahitai; hiche hi natahsan em?” ati.

tcz: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge, Pakai Pathen katahsan'e, nangma hi Pathen Chapa Messiah vannoiya hung dinga chu nahi,” ati.
en_web: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
en_kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanun, “Henge Pakai, Nangma Pathen Chapa Messiah, vannoiya hunga chu nahi katahsane,” ati.

tcz: Hiche chu asei jouvin achemang in asopinu Mary guhthimin akouvin, “Houhil chu hikoma aumin, nakouve,” ati.
en_web: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
en_kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Marthan hiche asei jou hin achen asopinu Mary guhthimin akouvin, “Houhil chu hikoma aumin nakouve,” agate.

tcz: Chuin Mary in hichu ajah jah in gangtah in akipat doh in ahenga achetai.
en_web: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
en_kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Maryn ajah phat’in akipatdoh loiyin Jesu henga ahungtai.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua chu khopam'a Martha toh akimu to nalhon a chu umnalai ahin;
en_web: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
en_kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu khosung hung lut loulai, Marthan aga lamdotna muna chu um nalai ahi.

tcz: Hichun mipi ho Mary lha mon dinga umhon ama akipat doh'a kino thethu'a adalhah chu amu'u chun Lazarus lhan khuh langa gakap dingin agel'un, hichun amahon Mary nung chu ajuiyun ahi.
en_web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
en_kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
tcz_gospelgo: In’a Mary umpia lhamon Judah on ama kinloitah a achedoh chu amu’vin, lhanphunga gakap ding hinte, tin ajuitauve.

tcz: Hiti chun Mary chu Yeshua umna alhun phat'in ama chu amun akengphang bul'ah abohkhup jengin ajah'a, “Pakai nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga,” ati.
en_web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
en_kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
tcz_gospelgo: Mary chu Jesu umna ahung lhuna Ama amu phat’in akengbul’a aboh khup’in ajah’a, “Pakai, nangma hikoma umle chun kasopipa thi lou didnga!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan amanu aka amun ahin lhonpi mipi ho jong chu akau amun alung sunga lunghem tah le pohnat na neitah in a um uvin ahi.
en_web: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
en_kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Mary lunghem amun, ahin lhonpi Juda ho ma alunghem cheh-u leh, adip alai adap jengin ahimsan,

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ama ho chu adongin, “Hoiya nakoiyu hitam,” ati, mipi hon adonbut'un, “Pakai hungven,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
en_kjv: and said, Where have ye laid him? They say unto him, Lord, come and see.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hoiya navuiyum?” atileh; amahon, “Pakai, hungin hungven,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Yeshua akaptai.
en_web: Jesus wept.
en_kjv: Jesus wept.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu akaptai.

tcz: Hikom mun vel'a dingho chun aseiyun, “Veuvin iti angailut hitam,” atiuve.
en_web: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
en_kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold, how he loved him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Juda hon, “Ven, iti alungset hitam!” atiuve.

tcz: Ahin koitobang loichun hitin aseiyun, “Hiche pa hin mitcho ho kho amu sah hilou ham, chule Lazarus jong chu athida sah thei chula em,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
en_kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva phabep’in vang, “Mitchopa mitt e nibon hasah thei hichenpan ama hi athida sah thei lou ham?” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Hichun Yeshua chun lhan khuh ahin phah chun lunghem tah in aum in; chuleh alhan chu kohom khat ahin, akot chu song khat'a kising ahi.
en_web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
en_kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu adip adap kit jengin, lhanpunga ahung le lhan chu songko ham khat ahin, akot chu song khat’in akisinge.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah'a aseiyin, “Song chu tangdoh'un,” ati. Chule athipa sopinu Martha chun ajah'a, “Pakai tun a uitai, ijeh inem itile ni li ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
en_kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun, “Song khu tangdoh-un,” atileh; Mithipa sopinu Marthan ajah a, “Pakai, ni li alhingtan uitante,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Natahsan'u leh Pathen loupi na namu dingu ahi kati hilou ham?” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Natahsan le Pathen loupina namuding ahi, tia kaseipehsa hilou ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun amahon songpi chu atangdoh tauvin, hichun Yeshuan Vanlam aven “Pa nangman kataona na-ngai jeh in namin kathangvah e;
en_web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
en_kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lift up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun song chu atangdoh tauve. Hichun avan dah-in, “Panangin kataona nasanjeh-in kathangvah-e.

tcz: Chuleh nangman kataona na-ngai jinge, ti keiman kahenai, ajeh chu kakimvel a mipi ding ho hin nangma sol kahi hi ahin tahsan thei na dinguva kati ahibouve,” ati.
en_web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
en_kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang kataona nangai jinge, ti kahenai, ahin hiche kavel’a ding mipi hin Nangma sol kahi atahsan theina diuva amaho khohsahna akasei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan hasap tah in asam in, “Vo Lazarus, hung thou doh'in,” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Achuti vangin vaipoloi lah a jong mi tampin Jesu atahsantauve; amabou Pharisee hon Houthua kikhopna in’a eikaidoh khauvinte, tin atahsanu chu aphongdoh

tcz_gospelgo: Keima khovah kahin, eitahsana chu muthima aumden louna dinga vannoiya hung kahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Mi khattouvin kaseiho hi ja naa anit lou jongleh achung thu katanpoi; ajeh chu vannoi thutana hung kahipon vannoi huhhinga hungjoh kahibouve.

tcz: Koi hijongle keima eipampaiya kathuhil jong joplou chu, thupi kitan nile thutah kaseidoh hin achungthu atan ding ahi.
en_web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile eidei louva kaseiho jong sang lou chun athutan ding anei nai; kasei hi phat kichai nikhoa athutana pang ding ahi!

en_web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh0inem itile Keiman kachama kasei ahipon, Eihinsol’a Pa ama tah-in ipi iti kasei ding ham ti thu eipeh ahibouve.

en_kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi kahei. Hijeh a chu kasei hi Pan eiseipeh banga kasei ahi,” ati.

tcz_gospelgo: Chuin kisilna konga twi alheiyin, seijuite keng asilpeh-in, konga akivei tinot pon chun atheh pantai.

en_web: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
en_kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or that he should give something to the poor.
tcz_gospelgo: Kim khat’in Judas chun sumdip avop jeh a Jesun kut’a manchah ding khat tou choa asol ham, ahiloule vaicha genthei thil pea asol danin agel’uve.

tcz: Chuin aman changlhah hal chu akisanin hiche pettah chun apotdoh paijengtai. Hichu jan ahi.
en_web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
en_kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
tcz_gospelgo: Judas chun changlhah hal akilah-in apotdoh paitan, ahinla jan ahi.

tcz: Ama apotdoh chun Yeshuan, “Mihem Chapa choiat'in aumtai, ama ah Pathen jong choian'in aumtai;
en_web: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
en_kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Judas chedoh phat’in Jesun, “Tun Mihem Chapa choi-at’in aumtan, Ama jeh-in Pathen jong choi-at’in aume.

tcz: Chule Pathen in jong Chapa jeh'a choi-atna amu jeh a, aman chapa chu achoiat pai jeng ding ahi.”
en_web: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
en_kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama jeh a Pathen choi-at’a aumleh, Pathenin jong Ama achoi-at ding, apettah a choi-at ding ahi.

tcz: Chapang neocha ho nangho toh chomcha khat bou um ding kahi, nang hon neihol dingu, ahivanga Juda ho jah a kasei “Keima che na a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu,” kati ahi.
en_web: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
en_kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, phat chomcha bou kaumpi ding nahitauve, nang hon neihol diu, ahinla Juda ho jah a, ‘Kei che naa nang ho nahung thei lou diu,’ kati banga, tupet tah ajong kaseipeh nahiuve.

tcz: “Keiman nangho thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, nang ho khat le khat kingailuto cheh un; keiman nangho ka-ngailut bangu hin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu uvin.
en_web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
en_kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto na diuva thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, khat le khat naki-ngailutto chehna diuva Keiman nang ho kangailut nahiuve.

tcz: Nangho khat le khat nakingailut tocheh uva ahile hichun keima seijui nahiu vannoiya natahlang'u ahi,” ati.
en_web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
en_kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
tcz_gospelgo: Khat le khat naki-ngailutto cheh-u leh kaseijui nahiu mijousen ahet ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Simon Peter in adongin, “Pakai nangma hoilama nache ding ham?” atile Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tun nangma kache na a kanung nunga hung thei pon nate, phat chomkhat jou teng vangleh kanung nunga nahung ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
en_kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peterin ajah a”Pakai hoiya nache ding ham?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in, “Hoiya che jong leng tun nangin neijui theipon nate, khonung teng neijui nan nate,” ati.

tcz: Peter in ajah a “Pakai ibol'a tua nanung nunga kahung thei lou ding ham? Nangma jal'in kahinna jong penge,” ati.
en_web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
en_kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “keijlal’a nahinkho naphal ngam ong? Kichentah a kaseipeh nahi, thumvei neiseilep masanga ah khong lou ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keima jal'a nathi ding ham? Chutiponte, jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga kahekhapoi tia thumvei nei seilep ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
en_kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

tcz: “Nalung'u khamsah hih'un, Pathen tahsan'un, chule keima jong neitahsan'un.
en_web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
en_kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nang ho lungkham hih-un, Pathen tahsanun, keijong neitahsanun.

tcz: Kapa In'ah chenna ding indan ninglhingset in aume; umlou hi le najah uva kasei tah hih ding ham? Ajeh chu keima nangho dinga mun sema che ding kahi.
en_web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
en_kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pa in’a chena mun tampi a-ong’e, umlou hileh seipeh pouvinge.

tcz: Thil jouse gontup ahiteng leh, keima hung ingting, kaumna a chu naum jingthei nadiuva kahung puiding nahiuve.
en_web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
en_kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho ding mun kagon jouteng hung kit ing ting keima umna naum thei diuva kahenga dinga kahung pui ding nahiuve.

tcz: Chule nanghon kache na ding mun alampi nahe nauve,” ati.
en_web: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
en_kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon kachena didng lampi nahenauve,” ati.

tcz: Thomas in adonbut'in, “Pakai keihon nache na ding bon kihelou a alampi iti kahet dingu ham?” ati.
en_web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
en_kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
tcz_gospelgo: thomas chun ajah a, “Pakai, nache na ding bon kihe louva alampi iti kahet diu ham?” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan amapa chu adonbut'in, “Keima hi lampi le thutah chule hinna chu kahi; keima henga pat tailouvin koima Pa kom ahung theipoi.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Keima hi Lampi le Atah chunle Hinna chu kahi, Keiya kona chelou chu koima Pa kom alhung theipoi.

tcz: Chule nanghon keima neiheleu chun Kapa jong chu nahet dingu ahitai; tua pat'a vang nanghon amapa chu naheuvin chule namu tauve.”
en_web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
en_kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima neihe leu chun ka-Pa jong nahet diu ahin, tukal’in vang Ama chu namutauvin hejong nahetauve,” ati.
