tcz: Hichun Philip in adonbut in, “Pakai Pachu neimu sah'un, hichu keiho dinga phaset ahi,” ati.
en_web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
en_kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip’in ajah a, “Pakai, Pa chu neimusah-un, chutileh kalungnau chim ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip, keima hitih chan nangho toh kaum khom a jong chu neihet loulai ham? Chule keima eimua chun Ka-Pa amu ahitai; achutile Pachu neimu sah-un iti nati ham?
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Vo Philip, hitih chan nang ho ki-umpia neihet loulai ham? Keima eimua chun Pa chu amu ahitai; iti nangin, ‘Pa neimusah-un, nati ham?

tcz: Chule keima Pa a kaum a chule Pa jong keiya um ahi, hiche hi natahsan lou ham? Chule keiman nangho jah'a thu kasei chengse hi keima cham'a kasei ahipoi; Pachu keiya uma na atoh ahibouve.
en_web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
en_kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you, I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Pa sunga ka-uma, kei sunga Pa aum hi natahsan lou ham? Ken najah-uva kasei hi kachamtah a kasei ahipoi, kasunga cheng pa chun atoh ding dol kin abol ahibouve.

tcz: Keima Pa a kauma chule Pa jong keiya aume ti chu neitahsan jengun; ahilou jongle na kitong chengse jeh tah hin tahsanun.
en_web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
en_kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Pa sunga ka-uma Pa kei sunga aum hi tahsan’un; ahilou jongleh na kitong chengse jeh beh hin tahsan’un.

tcz: Atahbeh a, keima eitahsan'a chun kathilbol chengse hi aman jong abol ding ahi; asanga lenjo jo abol ding ahi, chule keima Pa henga kinungle kit ding kahitai.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima eitahsan chun katoh chengse hi atoj thei ding, Pa henga kache ding jeh hin eitahsana chun hisanga lenjo jong abol thei ding ahi;

tcz: Chule Pachu Chapan achoiat'a, chule nanghon thil jouse ipi hijongle Keima mina nathum chanu chu kabol peh ding nahiuve.
en_web: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
en_kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa chu Chapa jal’a choi-at’a aum theina dinga kamin a nathum chan’u chu kabolpeh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Chule Keima mina nathum dingu chu ipi hijongle kabolpeh ding nahiuve.”
en_web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
en_kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi hijongle Keima min a nathum chan’u kabolpeh ding nahiuve.

tcz: “Keima neingailut uleh kathupeh ho hi nanit dingu ahi.
en_web: If you love me, keep my commandments.
en_kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nei-ngailut’u leh kathupeh chengse nanit diu,

tcz: Keima Pa henga taoving ting chuleh aman nangho naumpi jing dingu Lhamon sah Lhagao napeh dingu ahi.
en_web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
en_kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman Pa henga kathuma Aman naumpi jing diu Kithopi khat nahinpeh diu ahi,

tcz: Amachu Lhagao Theng, thudih lampia napuiyuvah ahi; vannoiyin ama chu asang theipoi; ijeh inem itile ama chu mu jong amu pouvin, he jong ahepouve; nang hon vang naheuve, ajeh chu ama nangho sunga chenga ahi, umjong hung um ding ahi.
en_web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
en_kjv: even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
tcz_gospelgo: hichu kicheh tah lhagao, vannoiyin sang thei lou, mu jong mukha lou ahi. Nang hon ama naheuvin, aman na umpiuvin nasunguva acheng’e.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho avetup ding beiyin nadalha pouvinge; keima nahenguva hung kit ding kahi.
en_web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
en_kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nang ho dalhan chaga bangin koi pouvinge, nahenguva kahung kit didng ahi.

tcz: Vannoi mihon phat chomkhat jou le eimu tahlou dingu ahi, ahinla nanghon vang neimu dingu ahinai; Ajeh chu keima kahing jinge, chule nangho jong nahin dingu ahi.
en_web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
en_kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
tcz_gospelgo: Chom khat jouteng vannoiyin eimu diu ahinai. Ajeh chu Keima kahingin nang jong nahin diu ahiye.

tcz: Keima hinna a kathodoh kit teng, nanghon nahet chen diu ahi; keima Pa a kaum a chule nangho keima a naum diu chule keima nangho a kaum ding ahi.
en_web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
en_kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikhoa chu Keima Pa sungankachen chule nang ho Kei sunga nachen’uva, nang ho sunga Kei kachen nahetdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Koi hijongle kathupeh ho neiya chule nit chu eingailua ahi; chule keima eingailua chu Ka Pan angailut ding; chule keiman ama chu ka-ngailut a ahenga kakiphon ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
en_kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathupeh chengse neiya nit’a chun eingailut ahi, eingailua chu ka-Pa ngailut’a chenga Kenjong ama ka-ngailut’a ahenga kakiphondoh didng ahi,” ati.

tcz: Judas (Iscariot hilou, seijui achom khatpa) chun ajah'a, “Pakai, ibol'a nangma keiho henga nakiphona vannoi mi henga naki phon lou ding ham?” ati.
en_web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
en_kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
tcz_gospelgo: Iscariot hilou Judas chun ajah a, “Pakai, iti keiho henga nakiphon’a vannoi mite henga nakiphondoh lou ding ham?” atileh;

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah a, “Ei ngailu jouse chun kathu anit ding, chule Ka Pan amaho chu angailut ding, chule ahenguva kahunga amaho chu kachenpi ding ahi,
en_web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
en_kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Mi eingailua chun kathusei anit ding, ka-pan ama angailut’a ahenga kahunguva kachenpi dingu ahi.

tcz: Chule koi hijongle keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah'u hi keiya ahipoi, eisola Pa a chu ahibouve.
en_web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
en_kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which you hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eingailu lou vangin kathuseiho anitpon; nathujah-u hi Keikeo thu ahipon, Eihinsol’a Pa thu ahibouve.

tcz: Keiman nangho kaumpi pet'a thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
en_web: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
en_kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nalah-uva ka-umpet’a hi cheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve;

tcz: Ahinla Pan keima khel'a naki thopi dingu Lhagao Theng ahinsol teng, Ama chun thil jouse nahetsah dingu chule thil jouse kasei doh ho jouse avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahi.
en_web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
en_kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang Pan keima mina ahinsol got Kithopi lhagao Theng chun kaseipeh chengseu hi aboncha nageldoh kitna diuva ijakai nahilsoh kei dingu ahinai.

tcz: Lungmon kada lhah peh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un.
en_web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
en_kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
tcz_gospelgo: keima chamna mong kapehuva, chamna kadalhah peh nahiuve; kapeh-uhi vannoi mi peh tobang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kijong kicha dauvin.

tcz: Nahenguva thu kana seiho gel doh jinguvin ajeh chu keima kache mang ding ahin, ahin naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi; chule keima nei ngailut mongule kei sanga laljo Pa koma kache dinghi nanghon nei kipa pi joh dingu ahi.
en_web: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
en_kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
tcz_gospelgo: Dalha jong leng nahenguva kahung kit ding ahi,’ tia najah-uva kaseipeh chu najatauve. Pa chu Keisanga chung nung jo ahijeh-in, neingailut mongu leh Pahenga kache hi nakipa thanoppi diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche ho hi nahenguva kasei peh masat'u ahi, Ajeh chu thil hohi ahungso phattengleh nanghon natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
en_web: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
en_kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichengse hi ahung guilhun teng natahsan theina diuva aso masanga tua kasiepeh masah dem nahiuive.

tcz: Nangho toh kihou limna ding phat kanei lhomtai, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga vaihompa ahung nai tai, aman kachung ah tha aneipoi.
en_web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
en_kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Najah-uva tampi sei taponge, ajeh chu vannoi vaihompa ahunge; ahinla aman kachunga ima tha aneipoi;

tcz: Amavang Pan keiya kona a ngaichat chu kabol ding ahi, chutile vannoi in Pa ngailutna hi ahin hetthei dingu ahi, hunguvin eiho che jengu hite.”
en_web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
en_kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongleh Keiman Pa ka-ngailut jeh a eithupeh chan kabolji hi vannoiyin ahet tei ding ahi.

tcz: Keima lengpi gui kahi, chule kapa hi alhoungim hon neipa ahi.
en_web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
en_kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keima lengpigui tahbeh kahin, ka-Pa aleilhou ahi.

tcz: Chuleh keiya um abah aga lou ho chu aman apaidoh ji; chuleh aga chengse chu ahaga chehna dingin amal ngim jin ahi.
en_web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
en_kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Keiya keh abah galou chengse vang chu ahaga chehna din amal ngimjin ahi.

tcz: Kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahi tauve.
en_web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
en_kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Najha-uva kathusei chengse jeh a nang ho a-ngimsa nahitauve.

tcz: Chuleh nangho keiya umjingun, keijong nanghoa um inge, abah lengpi guia aumlou le achanga agathei lou banga chu nang ho jong keiya naum lou u le naga theilou dingu ahi.
en_web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
en_kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasunga cheng jingun, keijong nasunguva cheng jing inge. Lengpibah achanga aga thei lou banga, keisunga nachen louvu leh nang ho jong napun thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Henge, keima hi lengpigui chu kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Keiya umho chule keiman jong kaumpi jouse chun ga tamtah ahin sosah dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima louvin nanghon imacha nabol thei pouve.
en_web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
en_kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima lengpigui kahin, nang ho abahho nahiuve. Ama sunga kacheng banga keisunga cheng mi chu apung lheh jie; ajeh chu kei louvin nang hon ima nabol theipouve.

tcz: Mi keiya umlou chu pannabei abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chuleh agop jin chuleh achom khomun meikong sungah asep lut jiuvin ahile akavam jitai.
en_web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
en_kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi keisunga cheng lou chu thingbah kiheh lhaa kipaidoh agopji bangin akipaidohji; abah gopsa chengse chu akichom khomjin meiya akileh lut’in akavamjitai.

tcz: Ahin nangho keima a naum jinguva, chuleh keima thucheng ho nangho a aumle, nanghon nangai chat chan'u nathum thei'u ahi; chuleh naki bolpeh dingu ahi.
en_web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
en_kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keisunga nachen’uva, kasei chengse hi nasunguva achenleh nagot chan thumun kibolpeh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Nanghon theiga tamtah napunsah teng'ule keima seijui dihtah nahiuve, hiche jeh'a chu Pa choiat na um ding ahi.
en_web: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
en_kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseijui kicheh nahiuva hapun’a napun’u leh ka-Pa choiat’a umah ahi.

tcz: Pan keima eingailut bang banga keiman jong nang ho ka-ngailut nahiuve, hijeh chun kangailutna a hin umjingun.
en_web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
en_kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pan eingailut banga kenjong ka-ngailut nahiuve; ka-ngailut sunga cheng jingun.

tcz: Nanghon keima thupeh napom tengule keima ngailut na'a um nahi tauve; chule keiman jong hitobanga Pa thupeh kanit jing jeh'a, ama ngailut na a umjing kahi.
en_web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
en_kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-pa thupeh chengse kanit’a a-ngailut’a kachen jing bang hin kathupeh chengse nit leu chun ka-ngait’a nachen diu ahi.

tcz: Kakipana nangho a aum jingna ding le naki panau acham kimna dinga thu hicheng hi najah uva kana sei ahi.
en_web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
en_kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanguva kakipana achen jinga apilhinsetna dia hiche hi najah-uva kasei ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, “Keiman nangho kangailut bangin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu tocheh in um'un.
en_web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
en_kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathupeh chu ken ka-ngailut banguva nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto cheh diu hi ahi.

tcz: Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi.
en_web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
en_kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
tcz_gospelgo: Agol apaite dinga ahinkho phaldoh sanga lenjo ngailutna koiman aneipoi.

tcz: Kathu peh ngai ho chu kaloi ahi.
en_web: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
en_kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
tcz_gospelgo: thu kapeh cheng seu hi nabol’u leh kagol kapai nahiuve.

tcz: Keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahi tauve, ajeh chu soh in apupa thilbol ahepoi; tua nangho hi kaloi ngaitah nahiuve, ajeh chu Pan keima eihetsah jouse nangho kasei peh nahi tauve.
en_web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
en_kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Soh kati louding nahitauve, ijeh-inem itile soh chun apu thilbol ahepoi, gol le paite katijoh ding nahiuve, ajeh chu Paa kona kajah chengse ijakai kahetsah soh keiyu ahi.

tcz: Nang hon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh a nacheuva haga nagauva chuleh nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve. Ipi hijongle nagot chanu kamin a Pa henga nathumu chu aman napeh theina dingun,
en_web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
en_kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon neilhenu ahipon, nacheuva napunbe na diu leh, apungdoh chengse alhou theiya kamin’a nathum chan’u Pan napeh theina diuva keiman kalhen’a kapansah nahibouvui.

tcz: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, nangho khat le khat kingailu tocheh'un,” ati.
en_web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
en_kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto chehna diuva thu hicheng hi kapeh nahiuve.

tcz: Chule vannoiyin nahin vetda tengule geldoh un keima ei vetda masat'u ahi.
en_web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
en_kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vannoiyin nahot’u leh, nang ho nahot masanguva Keima eihot masahsau ahi heuvin,

tcz: Nangho vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin ama a chu angailut ding ahin; tunla nangho vannoiya nahi lou u, vannoiya kona keiman kalhen doh nahiuvin, hiche jeh a chu vannoiyin nahot'u ahi.
en_web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
en_kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
tcz_gospelgo: vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin amite alungset dingdol ahin, Keiman kalhendohsa, vannoiya nahilou phat’uva vannoiyin nahot’u ahiye.

tcz: Chuleh najah uva kathusei hi, “Soh apakai sangin achungnungjo poi,” kati chu geldoh-un. Amahon kei eibolseuva chu nang ho nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit dingu ahi.
en_web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
en_kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
tcz_gospelgo: Najahuva, ‘Soh apu sangin achungnungjopoi,’ kati chu geldoh jingun. Mihon Kei eibolset’u leh nang ho jong nabolset tei diu ahi, kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit diu ahi.

tcz: Amahon keima jeh'a hiche ho jouse hi abolsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon eisolpa ahet lou jeh'u ahi.
en_web: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
en_kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihonsol Pa ahet loujeh-uva Keima min jal’a hicheng hi nachunguva abol diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman kana seidoh lou hile amaho hi themmo chang pouvinte. Ahinla tun amahon achonset nau jeh chun thuphat bolthei pouvinte.
en_web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
en_kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Hunga ajah-uva kaseipeh lou hileh themmona aneilou diu ahin, tunvang achonset’u paomea akilepna diu aumtapoi.

tcz: Koi hi jongleh keima eidoudal'a chun Kapa jong adoudal ding ahi.
en_web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
en_kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima eihoa chun ka Pa jong ahoi.

tcz: Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile chonset aneilou dingu ahin; tuvang'in amahon keima le Ka-Pa kakop lhonin eimu tauvin, ho jong eihotauve.
en_web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
en_kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva koima bol khah lou thil kabol lou hileh themmona anei lou diu ahin, tunvang kanatoh chengse amu nasauva Kei le ka-Pa eihot thau ahitai.

tcz: Hiche hin Pathen lekhabuho a kisei, “Amahon ajeh beiyin eidoudal ui” kiti chu aguilhunsah ahi.
en_web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
en_kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla adanthu bu’uva, ‘Ajeh beiyin eiho’uva,’ tia kisun chu guilhung tei ding ahi.

tcz: Amavang keiman thumopthem–thutah Lhagao, chu kahin solding ahi. Pa Pathen a kona hung ding ama chun keima thudol aphondoh ding ahi.
en_web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
en_kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
tcz_gospelgo: “Paa hung kon Lhagao theng, Keiman Paa kona kahinsol ding Kithopi chu ahung teng leh kachung chang thudol ahettohsah ding,

tcz: Chule nanghon jong atil'a pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh-uva chu kathu hettohsah a napan dingu ahi.
en_web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
en_kjv: and ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
tcz_gospelgo: akipat til’a pat neikivop piu ahijeh a nang ho jong kathu hettohsah a napan diu ahi.

tcz: Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
en_web: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
en_kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nakipal lhuh louna diuva hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.

tcz: Chuleh phat hung lhung ding ahi, kikhopna in'a kona nahin kaidoh dingu, chutengle koi hileh nathat uva pang hon athil bol'u chu Pathen'a dinga napha tonga kingaito dingu ahi.
en_web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
en_kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
tcz_gospelgo: Houthua kakhopna in’a nakaidoh diu, nathat’uva pangpa chu Pathen natong’a aki-ngaito phat hung lhung ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi ipi jeh ham itileh amahon Pa Pathen ahet lou jeh ule keima eihetthei lou jeh'u ahije.
en_web: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
en_kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa le Kei eihet loujeh-uva amahon hicheng hi ahinbol diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinla hiti phat chu ahung lhun tengle keima tah'in kana seipehsa chengse hi nagel doh dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Chuleh keiman nangho jah'a kanasei masah lou na ajeh chu phat chomkhat kaumpi ding nahi jeh'u ahi.
en_web: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
en_kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng so na ding phat hi ahung lhun teng athudol’u kahilchah masahsau nageldoh theina diuva najah-uva thil hi chenghi kaseipeh nahiuve.

tcz: Ahinla tua keima eihin solpa henga kile kit ding kahitai, ahi nangho koima chan hoilam a che ding nahim tinjong neidong pouve.
en_web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
en_kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang Eihinsolpa henga che ding kahitan, koiiman, ‘Hoiya che didng nahim?’ tia dong’a jong naumpouve;

tcz: Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh'in nalungu lunghem nan adimjotai.
en_web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
en_kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang hicheng kaseipeh jeh-uva hi lunghem gam nahitauve.

tcz: Ahinla tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, keima kapotdoh chu nangho dinga phatchomna joh ahi, ajehchu keima kaum laisea nangho kithopi ding chu hung theilou ding ahi. Ahin keima kapotdoh teng, Lhagao Theng chu nangho henga kahin sol ding ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
en_kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hileh atah kaseipeh nahiuve; nang ho phat chomna dia Keima che mang ding kahi; kache louva ahileh Kithopi chu nahenguva hung lou ding, kachea ama chu kahinsolpeh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Ama chu ahung tengleh, aman vannoi mite hi chonset thudol, chonphat thudol, chuleh thutan thudol'a ahetphotsah ding ahi.
en_web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
en_kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
tcz_gospelgo: Kithopi chu ahung teng vannoi mite hi chonset thudol, adih thudol chule thutan thudol ahettohsah ding;

tcz: Chonset thudol chu, ijeh ham itile amahon keima eitahsan pouve.
en_web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
en_kjv: of sin, because they believe not on me;
tcz_gospelgo: chonset thudol chu keima eitahsan lou thu’u ahin,

tcz: Chonphat thenna ho hi chanthei ahi, ijeh inem itile keima Pa koma cheding kahi, chuleh nanghon nei mukhah lou diu ahitai.
en_web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
en_kjv: of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
tcz_gospelgo: adih thudol ahileh Pa henga kachea nang hon neimu lou diu thu ahin,

tcz: Chule tun thutanna ahung lhung tai ajeh chu vannoiya vaihompa hi athu tansa a uma ahitai.
en_web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
en_kjv: of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
tcz_gospelgo: thutah thudol chu hiche vannoi vaihompa thu kitan hi ahi.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche ho tilouva thildang tamtah jong kaseipeh nom nahiuve, ahinla nanghon tua nathoh joulou diu ahi.
en_web: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
en_kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
tcz_gospelgo: Najah-uva sei ding tampi kaneiyin, ahinla nang hon tuta din nadol joupouve;

tcz: Lhagao dihtah chu ahung teng vangleh ama chun thutah lam jousea nangho napuihoi dingu ahi, ijeh inem itile aman achama aseilou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi, chuleh khonung thusoh ding naseitoh peh dingu ahi.
en_web: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
en_kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
tcz_gospelgo: ahin atahbeh lhagao chu ahung teng, ama cham chama thu seilouva, ajah cha cha asei ding, kitahna lampi jenga napui hoiyuva, ahung lhung ding thil ho geiya naseipeh diu ahi.

tcz: Chule ama chun keima eichoiat ding ahi, ajeh chu kanei chengse chu aman alah a nangho nahetsah dingu ahi.
en_web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
en_kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Keiya chu alah a nahenguva aphondoh ding jeh chun Keima eichoi-at ding ahi.

tcz: Pa a kona thil jouse chu keima a kona ahisoh keiye, hiche jeh a chu kaphon doh ahi; Lhagao Theng chun ana phondoh ho chu aboncha keiya kona alahson ahiye.
en_web: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
en_kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa nei changse chu Keiya jong ahijeh a Keiya chu alah a nahenguva aphondoh ding ahi kati ahiye.

tcz: “Phat chomkhat joule nanghon neimu lou dingu ahitai; Ahinla phat chomkhat jouteng neimu kit dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
en_kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: “Chom khat jou teng neimu lou diu ahin, chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai,” ati.

tcz: Hichea chun aseijui ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Chom khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chuleh chom khat jou le neimu kit dingu, ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi, ati hi ipi aseina ahidem? akitiuve.
en_web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
en_kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
tcz_gospelgo: Aseijuite lah a mi phebep, khat le khat akihouvun, “Aman, ‘Chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai, ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi,’ ati hi ipi aseina ham?” akitiuve.

tcz: Chuleh phat chomkhat joule ati chu ipi aseina ham? Keihon kahe theipouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
en_kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun amahon, “Aman, ‘Chom khat jou,’ ati hi ipi aseina ham? Ipi aseina ham ihepouve,” akitiuve.

tcz: Adoh nom'u chu Yeshuan ahen ajah uva, “Chomcha khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat jou le neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khat le khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?
en_web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
en_kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
tcz_gospelgo: Adoh nomu hi Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho le nang ho ipi kidongto nahiuva, ‘Chom khat jou teng neimu lou diu ahin, chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai,’ kati chu

tcz: Tahbeh a nangho keima chunga nalhiso diu chule nalungu kham ding ahi; Ahinla vannoi mite dinga kipana ahiye, ajeh chu nangho nalungu sangtah'a boiding, ahinla nalung kham nau chu hetman louva kipana thupitah hiding ahi.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang ho nakauva namao diu, vannoi mite vang kipah diu ahi; lunghem jong leu chun nalunghem chu kipana soh ding ahinai.

tcz: Numei aso dinga anat tengle athoh gimlheh jin, acha chu asolhah teng vangleh vannoiya mihem khat apen jeh chun akipah jin ahile alungdon hesoh chu ahejitapoi.
en_web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
en_kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei naosoh ding khu aso phat alhin teng athoh gim lheh jin, nao aso lhah teng vang leh vannoiya mihem khat penlhah jeh a kipa jal’in athot gimna chengse chu asumiljitai.

tcz: Tua nangho nalunglhah dah nau hi, keima in nangho kahin vil kit tengle thanopna a nadim dingu, chuleh koima chan naguh mangpeh thei lou dingu ahitai.
en_web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
en_kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun nang ho jong nalunghem’un, ahinla keiman kahung vilkit diu ahinai, chutengle nalungthimu kipah a, nakipanau chu koiman nalahpeh thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche teng chule nanghon keima imacha neidoh'u jong ngaita ponte, thutah chu ahile, Pa henga nathum jengthei'u ahitai; ajeh chu keima mina nathum jeh uva na ngaichat hou chu suhbulhit a um ding ahi.
en_web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
en_kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikhoa chu nang hon ima neidoh lou dingu ahitai. Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, ipi hijongle keima min pan’a Pa henga nathum chan’u napeh diu ahi.

tcz: Chule hiche hohi masanga nana bolkhah lou'u ahiye, Keima min in thum'un chuteng namu diu ahi, chutengle kipana sangtah'a nanei diu ahi.”
en_web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
en_kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
tcz_gospelgo: Tugeiyin kaminin ima nathum hih laiyui; nakipanau achamkimsohna din thumun namu diu ahi.

tcz: “Keiman hiche ho jouse hi nangho jah'a alem a kasei ahi, ahin phat hung lhung ding chuteng chuleh keiman alema kasei tahlou ding ahi. Ahin Pathen ama hina tah'a kaphon doh ding ahi.
en_web: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
en_kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: “Najah-uva hicheng hi alem’a kasei ahin, Pa thudol chu alem hilouva kichentah a kaseipehna diu phat khat hung lhung ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh keima mina nathum dingu keima kanop tahlou ding ahi ajeh chu keima Pa henga nangho dinga taova kahi.
en_web: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
en_kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho thalhengin Pa henga taopeh nauvinge kati ahipoi, hiche nikhoa chu Kei min pan’a natao diu ahi;

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pa amatah in nangho na-ngailuve, ijeh inem itile nanghon keima nei ngailuvin, chuleh keima Pa a kona hung kahi natahsan tauvin ahi.
en_web: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
en_kjv: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile Keima neideiyuva Pathena hungkon kahi natahsan jeh-un Pa amatahin nadeiyu ahi.

tcz: Pa koma kona vannoiya hung kahin, vannoi kadalhah a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati.
en_web: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
en_kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Paa hung kon vannoiya hung lut kahin, vannoi kadalhan a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun aseijuiten adonbut'un, “Ven, tun nangin thu alem'a seita louvin phongtah in naseiye.”
en_web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
en_kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in aseijuiten, “Vent un nangman alem’a thu seilouvin phongtah-in naseidoh tai.

tcz: “Tuhin keihon ima jouse kahe chen tauve; Nangman thil jouse nahesoh hel'in, hiche ho jeh'in keihon katahsan tauve; nangma Pathen a kona hung kondon nahi ti katahsan tauve.”
en_web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
en_kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun kahetauve Nangin ijakai nahen, koiman ima nadoh ding angaipoi, hichea hin Pathena hungkon nahi katahsantauve,” atiuve.

tcz: Yeshuan adong'in, “Achainakeiya neitahsan'u hitam?” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
en_kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “Tubep’a natahsan’um

tcz: “Veuvin, nangho nabonchauva nava cheh soh keiyuva keima kachanga neida lhah dingu phat ahung lhungtai, ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi; ijeh inem itile Pan keima ei umpinai.
en_web: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
en_kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, nang ho nakithecheh-uva, na-inlam cheh nakijot’uva kachangseh a neidalhahna diu phat chu hung lhung ahitai; hijongleh Pa chun ei umpi jing jeh-in kachangseh kahi dehpoi.

tcz: Nanghon kachunga lungmon chamna nanei thei na dinguva thu hicheng hi kasei peh nahiuve, hiche leiset chunga hi nanghon thohgim hahsa tamtah nathoh diu ahiye, ahinla nalungu neosah hih'un, ajeh chu lungnom'un, keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.
en_web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
en_kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima sunga nachen’uva chamna nanei theina diuva hicheng hi najah-uva kasei ahi; vannoiyah gim genthei nathohui; amavang hangtah-in pangun Keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin, vanlam aven, “Pa naphat chu ahung lhunge; Chapan nangma na choiat thei na dingin na chapa choian in.
en_web: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
en_kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lift up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hicheng hi aseijouvin akhodah-in vanlam aven, “Pa, phat chu ahung lhungtai; Chapan nachoi-at theina din na Chapa choi-anin;

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu aboncha aman tonsot hinkemlou apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi.
en_web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
en_kjv: as thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama napeh chengse chu tonsot hinna apeh theina dia Nangin Ama chu tahsan hing mihem jouse chunga thu neina napeh ahi.

tcz: Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangman nasol Yeshua Christa tah chu ahet doh dingu, hiche hi tonsot hinna ahi.
en_web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen tah khatseh Nang le nahinsol Jesu Christa ahet diu hitonsot hinna ahi.

tcz: Chuleh nangman keima bol dinga neipeh chu kajouvin, chule leiset chunga nangma min ka choian tai.
en_web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
en_kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga toh ding neipeh chengse kachoisoh-in Nangma kachoian tai.

tcz: Chule tun, Pa vannoi leiset um masanga nangma toh ium laiya iloupina chun nangma tah toh kigomin nei choian in.
en_web: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
en_kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa, tun Nangin vannoi umdoh masanga ineisa Nangma loupina mong mongin neichoianin.

tcz: Vannoi leiset a neina peh ho chu keima in kahin tahlange. Amaho chu nangma a din aum jinguve, chule nangma in keima neipeh ahitan, amaho in nathu chu anit jing nauve.
en_web: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
en_kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
tcz_gospelgo: “Vannoiya kona neipeh miho henga naming kaphongdohtai. Nangman neipeh amaho hi nang mi ahiuvin, amahon nathu anit tauve.

tcz: Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve.
en_web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
en_kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunvang, Nangman neipeh thil chengse hi Nanga hungkon ahi ahetauve;

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen, chule keima hi nanga hung kon kahi jong atahsan tauvin, chuleh nangman nei hin sol ahiti jong atahsan tauve.
en_web: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
en_kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile neithupeh chengse amaho kapen, amahon hicheng chu akisanun, Nanga hungkon kahi kichen tah-in aheuvin, Nangmannei sol ahi atahsantauve.

tcz: Chuleh keima amaho dinga katao ahi, vannoi dinga katao ahipoi; Ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, Ijeh inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve.
en_web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
en_kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
tcz_gospelgo: “Nangman neipeh ho hi namite ahijeh-uva amaho dia tao kahin, vannoi dinga tao kahipoi;

tcz: Keima'a umjouse nanga ahi, chuleh nangma in keima neina peh ahitai. Ajeh chu amahon loupina eihin chansah'u ahi.
en_web: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
en_kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiya chengse Nanga ahin, Nanga chengse jong Keiya ahi; hijeh chun hiteho jal hin choi-at’in ka-ume.

tcz: Chuleh keima vannoiya hi kaumlou ding ahitai, amaho vang hi vannoiya aum nalaiyuve, chule keima nahenga hung ding kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahithei na dingun, nangman amaho hi vengtup'in.
en_web: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
en_kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima nahenga hunga vannoiya umlou ding kahitan, amaho vang vannoiya um nala ahiuve. Pa Theng, eini tobanga amaho pumkhat ahi theina diuvin neipeh naming chun amaho hi hongin.

tcz: Keima hikoma kaum sungin, amaho hi kana vengtup e. Amaho hi kaventup jal'in khat cha jong amangthah aumpouve, Pathen lekhabun anaseisa, manthahna lama chepa tailou chu.
en_web: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
en_kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho ka-umpilaiyin neipeh naminin amaho kahongin, ka-ngah tup’in, Pathen lekhabu thu gui lhunna dia amang thah dia pengpa tilou, alah-uva khatcha amangthah poi.

tcz: Chuleh tua keima nangma koma hunga kahitai, chule keima leiya kaum laiya chu kipa thanopnaa adim jing thei na dinguva kana seipeh sohhel ahitai.
en_web: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
en_kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang nahenga hung ding kahitan, asunguva kakipana anei chamkim soh theina diuva leiset’a hicheng hi kasei ahiye.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahilou jeh'un, vannoi miten ahotauve.
en_web: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
en_kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi nathu kapeh leh vannoiyin ahotauve; ajeh chu Keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahitapouve.

tcz: Chule keiman kathum chu amaho hi vannoiya konin ladoh in tia katao ahipoi, agiloupa natoh na'a kon in huhdoh in katijoh ahibouve.
en_web: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
en_kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi vannoiya kona nalahdohna dia tao kahipoi. Agiloupaa konin hongbit’in katijoh ahibouve.

tcz: Keima vannoiya kona kahilou banga, amaho jong vannoiya kon ahipouve.
en_web: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
en_kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima vannoiya kahi lou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahi pouve.

tcz: Chule nathutah chun amaho jouse hi sutheng in ajeh chu nangma thuhi thutah ahiye.
en_web: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
en_kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Atah chun amaho hi suthengin; nathu hi atah chu ahi.

tcz: Nangman keima vannoiya neina sol banga chu keiman amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahi.
en_web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
en_kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin vannoiya neisol banga amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahin;

tcz: Chule amaho jouse hi thutah'a suhthenga aum thei na dinguva amaho jal'a keima kisuthenga kahi. Yeshuan tahsan chate jouse dia taona anei
en_web: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
en_kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho jong atah a chu akiphal theng theina diuva amaho jal’a keijong kiphal theng kahi.

tcz: Keima seijui ho ding seh'a tao kahipoi, amaho thusei'a kona keima eitahsan ho jouse dinga jong taova kahi.
en_web: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
en_kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
tcz_gospelgo: “Hite ho keo dia tao kahipoi, amaho thuseiya kona eitahsan ho didnga jong,

tcz: Chule amaho chu pumkhat ahina dinguva, Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan thei na dinguva nangma keiya nauma keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong einia aum theina dinga katao ahi.
en_web: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
en_kjv: that they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa, nang Kei sunga nachen’a, Nang sunga keima kachen banga amaho jong eini sunga achen’uva, vnnoiyin nang sol kahi atahsan theina din abonchauvin pumkhat hileu kati ahi.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu loupina nangman neipeh ho chu kapetai, amaho eini banga pumkhat ahitheina dingu ahi.
en_web: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
en_kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
tcz_gospelgo: Eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahina diuvin Nang man neipeh loupina chu aamaho kapetai;

tcz: Keima amahoa kauma chule nangma keiya naum, abon'a khat a chamkim soh ahi. Chuteng vannoiyin keima neisol ahi ahetdiu chule keima nei ngailut banga hi amaho jong nangailut ahidan ahetthem diu ahi.
en_web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
en_kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin nei-ngailut banga amaho ka-ngailut jeh a Keima neisol hi vannoiyin ahetdoh a, chu le chamkimdel’a amaho pumkhat ahi theina dinga asunguva kachen’a Keima sunga Nang cheng nahi.

tcz: Hepa nangman neipeh loupina chu nangin neipeh ho hin amuthei na dingun, keima umna'a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; chule vannoi bul kiphu masanga nangman neingailut ahijeh chun.
en_web: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
en_kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: “Pa, vannoi kisemdoh masanga jong nei-ngailut jeh a neipehsa hiche kaloupina chu Nangin neipeh mite hin amu theina diuvin Kei umnaa chun amahojong umleu kaseiye.

tcz: Vo Kapa Theng vannoi leiset miten nangma nahethem theipouve, ahinla keiman nangma kahen, chule keima neisol hi seijui ho hin ahetauve.
en_web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
en_kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pa dih tah, vannoiyin nahet lou vangin Keiman Nang kahen, Nang sol kahi hite ho hinahetauve.

tcz: Keiman nangma hi amaho lah'a katah lang nahitai, chule keiman hiti a chu katah lang jing ding nahi; hiche teng chule keima nei ngailut naho chu amaho'a umding chuteng keima jong amaho a ka umjing ding ahi.”
en_web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
en_kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin nei-ngailutna hiche ngailut chu asunguva achen’a, Keijong asunguva kachen theina din amaho hi naming kahetsah tan, kahetsah jing ding ahi” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin apotdoh in Kidron vagal a hon umna'a chun aseijui hotoh agalkaiyun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho aluttauve.
en_web: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
en_kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi asei jouvin Jesu aseijuite toh alhondoh-in, Kidron hohlam gal’a honk hat um na-a chun Ama le aseijuite aluttauve.

tcz: Yeshua pedoh a pang Judas jong chun hilai mun chu ahet chen mama ahi, Ijeh inem itile Pakai Yeshuan aseijuite chu phat seh a ana pui jing ahi.
en_web: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
en_kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Hia chu Jesun aseijuite akikhoppi jing ahijeh-in amun chu ama mat sah a pang Judas jong chun ahei.

tcz: Chutah in Judas chun sepaihon chule thempu pipui ho le Pharisee hoa kona sottolle ho aloiyin, meivah, meisel, chuleh hem manchah athouvin hiche kom mun chu ahung lhung tauve.
en_web: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
en_kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men, and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Judas chun Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee hoa kona hung sepia loi khat le Houin ngah sepia ho chu ahinpuiyin, thaomei le mei sel den, manchah choiyin hikoma chun ahungtai.

tcz: Yeshuan achunga thil hunglhung ho jouse chu ahesoh keiyin ahi, hichun amaho kom lang chu ajonphei in adongtai, “Koi nahol'u ham?” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
en_kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun achunga hung lhung ijakai ahesoh keiyin ahung potdoh-in ajah-uva, “Koi nahol’u ham?” atileh;

tcz: Amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hungkon Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuvin ahi. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Ama chu kahi,” ati. (Judas, apedoh a pangpa chu, amaho lah'a chu dinga ahi).
en_web: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
en_kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon adonbut’un, “Nazareth Jesu chu,” atiuve, Ama ajah-uva, “Kei ama kahi,” ati. Ama matsah a pang Judas chu amaho toh dingkhom ahi.

tcz: Yeshuan, “Keima hi kahi,” ati chun amaho jouse chu anung chon'un tol'a alhu jengun ahi.
en_web: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
en_kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Kei Ama kahi,” atitah chun amaho anung chon’un tol’a alhu mat jengui.

tcz: Hichun avel'in adongkit in, “Nanghon koi nahol'u ham?” ati. Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hung Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
en_kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adong kit’in, “Koiba nahol’u ham?” atileh; amahon, “Nazareth Jesu chu,” atiuve. ahileh hite ho hi lhadoh jengtau,” atin;

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, amapa chu keima hi kahi, keima neihol'u ahijeh chun midang hohi soldoh tauvin,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
en_kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

tcz: Nangman keima neipeh chengse chu khatcha jong kaman sahpoi, tia asei chu guilhunna dinga chutia ahi.
en_web: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
en_kjv: that the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche thu asei chu, “Nangman neipeh chengse lah a khat cha kamansahpoi,” kiti chu guilhunma dinga asei ahi.

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter in achemjam asatdoh in thempu chungnung sohpa asatle ajetlam abilkol asatlha tai, sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.
en_web: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
en_kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peterin chemjam khat anei chu asatdoh-in Thempu chung nung sohpa asat jeng leh abilkol jetlam asat lhai; sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.

tcz: Ahinla Yeshuan Peter jah'a, “Nachemjam chu apai sunga koilut kit'in, Pan eipeh gentheina khon chu donlouva ka um ding ham,” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
en_kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun Peter jah a, “chemjam chu apaiya khum jengin, Pan eipeh khon chu kadontei ding hilou ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun sepai ho le apipui pau toh chuleh Juda ho sottolle hon Yeshua chu aman un akan tauvin ahi.
en_web: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
en_kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai loi le alamkaipau, Judate Houin ngah sepai hon Jesu chu aman’un, akan’uvin,

tcz: Annas henga apui masauve; Ijeh inem itile ama chu chuche kuma chu Thempu chungnung pen'a pang Caiaphas nupa pa ahi.
en_web: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
en_kjv: and led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
tcz_gospelgo: chuche kuma thempu chungnunga pang Caiaphas nupapa Annas henga akai lut masauve.

tcz: Hiche Caiaphas hi ahi, “Miho jouse dinga mikhat athi aphajoi,” tia Juda ho ana thumop chu. Peter in Yeshua aseilep
en_web: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
en_kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi dinga mikhat thi aphajoi, tia Judate thumop chu hiche Caiaphas hi ahiye.

tcz: Simon Peter chun, seijui dangho bangin, Yeshua chu anung ajui tan ahi. Seijui holah a khat chu Thempu pipui hotoh ana kihet jeh chun Thempu pipu pa umna gei chu Yeshua toh ana lutsah un ahi.
en_web: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
en_kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peter le seijui dang khat’in Jesu ajuiye. Hiche seijui dang kitipa hi Thempu chungnungpa hetsa mi ahin, Jesu toh kilhonin thempu chungnung inpi tolsunga aluttai.

tcz: Ahin Peter vang chu polanga phat chomkhat aumin, hichun seijui holah a khat thempu pipuipa toh kihe pa chun kelkot ngah a pang numeinu koma phalna athumin hichun Peter insunga apuilut tai.
en_web: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
en_kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
tcz_gospelgo: Pater vang chu lotpi polama adding dentai. Hijeh chun seijui dang Thempu chung nung hetsapa chu ahung potdohin, kotphunga ding nu-ngah nu jah aaseilep Peter chu ahinpui luttai.

tcz: Hiche numeinu chun Peter chu thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma hi hiche pa seijui ho khat nahi lou ham? Nangma nahi,” ati. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Kahipoi,” ati.
en_web: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
en_kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
tcz_gospelgo: Kotphunga ding nu-ngah nun Peter jah a, “Nang hi hiche mipa seijui khat nahilou haimo?” atileh; aman, “Kahipo,” ati.

tcz: Hiche koma chu soh hole sottol le hon adapjeh'a mei akitiuva dinmuna mei aoiyu ahin, Peter jong adingin meichu aoiyin ahi.
en_web: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
en_kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Adap jeh a hikoma chu soh ho le Houin ngah sepai hon song meihol akitiuva din mun’a mei a oiyu ahin; Peter jong alah-uva dinga mei oiya kisanglum ahiye.

tcz: Hikom insung langa chun Thempupan Yeshua chu thudoh anei'in, anungjui ho ipi ana seipeh'a chuleh ipi ana hilchah em tichu adongtan ahi.
en_web: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
en_kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnungin Jesu chu aseijuite thudol le athuhil umchan adodngtai.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Mipihon ahesoh keiye ipi kana hilchah, chule Houin a jong aphat jouse in mipi ho koma kana seipeh jinge, guhthima kana seipeh imacha aumpoi.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
en_kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Keiman vannoi jah aphongtah-in kaseiyin; Judate kikhop khomna jose Houthua kikhopna in le Houin a kahil jingin, guhthimin imacha kasei khapoi.

tcz: Ibol'a nangman hiche thudoh hohi neidoh ham? kathusei ngai ho le jaho chu nadoh thei lou ham? Ajeh chu amahon kathu hil jouse chu ahesohkei uve,” ati.
en_web: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
en_kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
tcz_gospelgo: I-bol’a nei doh ham? Ajeh-uva kasei ja ho chu dodngin, ven, ipi kasei ahenauve,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin ahile akoma Santri dingho lah'a khat in Yeshua ngeiphe abengin, “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati.
en_web: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
en_kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by stroke Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun hiche asei hin akoma ding Houin ngah sepai loi lah a khat’in a-ngeiphe abengin. “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kasei khel aumle neimu sah'un, ahinla thutah kasei doh jeh'a chu ibol'a neivoh uham?” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
en_kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Kasei khel leh adih lou chu photchetna vetsahin; adih kasei leh i-bola neidenham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Annas chun Yeshua chu ahentup'in Caiaphas Thempu chungnung heng lama asoltai.
en_web: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
en_kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
tcz_gospelgo: Annas chun Jesu akikan pumin Caiaphas henga asoltai.

tcz: Hiche phat dontah a chu Simon Peter chun dap asah jeh'a mei aki oi ahin, amahon adongkit'un, “Nangma hi amaho lah'a khat chu nahilou ham?” atiuve. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Keima kahipoi,” ati.
en_web: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
en_kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon peter chu adingin mei a-oiyin ahi. Mihon ajah a, “Nang jong hichepa seijui khat nahilou haimo?” atiuleh; aman aseilep’in; “Kahipoi,” ati.

tcz: Ahinla Thempu chungnung sohpa Simon Peter in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khat'in ajah'a, “Keiman Hon a chu nangma amato kamu nahi lou ham?” atin ahi.
en_web: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
en_kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnung soh Peterin abilkol asat lhah pehpa inkote khat’in, “Hon sunga ama hitoh kamu tha nahilou haimo?” atileh;

tcz: Hichun avel'in Peter in aseilep kit in, chule hetman louvin Ahchal akhong tai.
en_web: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
en_kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin aseilep kit’in, hichepet tah chun ah akhongtai.

tcz: Chutah chun amahon Caiaphas in a konin gamvaipo pa inlama Yeshua akaitauve; hichu jingkah ahina laiye; ahivangin kal chuh kut an aneh thei na dingun, akisuhboh louna dingun gamvaipo inpia chun amaho alutpouve.
en_web: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
en_kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Jesu chu Caiaphas in’a konin gamvaipopa inpi lama akaitauve; jingpi matah ahi nalaiyin, miho chu akisuh boh dauva kal chuh kut an aneh theina diuvin gamvaipo inpia chun alutpouve.

tcz: Hichun Pilate apotdoh in, amaho chu aga kimupin thudoh anei'in, “Hiche pa hin ipi abolkhel atoh khel um hitam?” ati.
en_web: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
en_kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun amaho toh kimuto din Pilate apotdoh-in, “Hichepa hi ipi thua nahehset’u ham?” atileh;

tcz: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Amapa khang-gilou ahilouleh nangma koma kahin lhut lou dingu ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
en_kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon adonbut’un, “Thilse abol lou hileh nahenga kahin kailut lou diu ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hiche chu ahitah le, nanghon nungpui tauvin, chuleh nangho dan dungjui in kitan lhah tauvin,” ati. Hiche phat chun Judah hon adonbut'un, “Keima ho Danthu dungjui'in koima thana ding tha kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
en_kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Kipuiyun lang nang ho danthu dungjuiyin athu kitantau,” ati. Judah on ajah a, “Mi tha theina ding eikiphal peh pouve,” atiuve.

tcz: (Hiche hin avetsah chu, Yeshuan athiding dan ana seidoh masah chu guilhunna ahi).
en_web: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
en_kjv: that the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun iti thia athi ding asei chu guilhunna dinga hiche hi soh ahi.

tcz: Hichun Pilate insung dan'ah alut'in, Yeshua chu akouvin, thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma Judate lengpa chu nahim?” ati.
en_web: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
en_kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chu gamvaipo inpi lama akile kit’in, Jesu chu akou lut’in, “Nangma Judate lengpa nahim?” tin adonge.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche thudoh ho hi nangma chama kon ham, ahiloule mi khat tou'in keima chung chang nasei peh ham?” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
en_kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in “Nangman hiche hi nachama naseiha, mikhat touvin kachung thu naseipeh khah ham?” atileh;

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut kit'in, “Keihi Juda mi kahi ham? Namite le thempu pipuihon kakhut'a eipeh nahi chu, ipi nabolsetba ham?” ati.
en_web: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
en_kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’n adonbut’in, “Kei ho Judate mi kahibeh ong? Na nam mite leh Thempu pipu hon kahenga nahin kailut’uva chu, ipiba nabol ham?” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi. Hiche vannoi a kon ana hitaleh keima dingin kaseijui hon gal eisat peh intin, Judate khut'a peh doh'a kaum lou ding ahi. Ahinla keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
en_kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Keima lenggam chu hiche vannoiya kon ahipoi, kalenggam vannoiya kon hileh Judate henga eikipehdoh louna dia eivengtup’a pang hon asat diu ahi; tunla Keima lenggam chu hichea kona kisemdoh ahipoi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in aseikit'in, “Ahileh nangma hi lengpa nahim?” atile Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Leng kahi chu nasei khai, Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoiya hunga kahi. Thutah hechan chun thutah ahinphot chen diu ahi” ati.
en_web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
en_kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’n ajah a, “Achutile leng nahi ong?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in “Nangin, Leng nahi,’ neiti. Atah chu kahettohsah theina dinga Keima hung penga hiche vannoiya hi hung kahi; koi hileh atah a kon tapouvin Keima ogin angai cheh-e,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut in, “Thutah chu ipi ham?” Hichun Pilate chu Juda mipi holah'a aga potdoh kit'in, ajah'uva aseitai, “Yeshua hi themmo na neilou ahi, ati. Yeshua tha dia alhuh sah'u
en_web: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
en_kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’in ajah a, “Atah chu ipi ham?” ati.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut le mikhat nakilha doh peh dingu chonna ngai khat naneiyui; hijeh chun Juda lengpa hi lhadoh peh leu veng nalungu ham?” ati.
en_web: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
en_kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
tcz_gospelgo: chujongle kalchuh kut nikhoa mi khat kalhadoh peh tei diu chonna dank hat naneiyun; hijeh chun Judate lengpa hi lhadoh pen leng nadeiyum?” ati.

tcz: Ahinla amahon asam'un, “Hiche pa hi hida hen, Barabbas joh,” atin asamtauve. (Barabbas chu doudal natong ahi).
en_web: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
en_kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun alesap kit-un, “hichepa hilouvin Barabbas joh bouve!” atiuve. Barabbas chu gucha michom ahiye.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu mol'a jep dingin apedoh tai.
en_web: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
en_kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Pilate chun Jesu amanin ajeptai.

tcz: Chuin sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh'un, Pakai chu akhuh peh tauvin ahi. Chuleh amahon ponsandup asilpeh un ahi.
en_web: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
en_kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh-un alua akhuh peh-un, ponsandup asilpeh-ui.

tcz: Chuin akoma ahungun, “Judate lengpa chibai,” atiuvin, totnopnan aneiyun chuleh abengphe abeh peh'un ahi.
en_web: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
en_kjv: and said, Hail, King of the Jews: and they smote him with their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahenga ahungun, “Judate lengpa hingsot’in,” atiuvin, Ama chu adengtauve.

tcz: Chuin Pilate agapot kit'in, ajah uva, “Veuvin akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
en_web: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
en_kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
