tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chu agapotdoh kit’in ajah-uva, “Ven, themmosahna theiima achunga kamudoh lou nahetna diuva nahenguva kahin puidoh kit ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshua chu ling lukhuh khuh le ponsandup kisil pum chun ahung potdoh'in, chuin Pilate in ajah uva, “Veuvin hiche mipa hi!” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
en_kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Jesu chu linglukhuh khuh le ponsandup pumin ahung potdoh-e. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Ven, Mihem hi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun thempu pipui hole Houin ngah'a pang sepai hon ama chu amuphat un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Nanghon natahsa tah in kai unlang thingpel'a khenbeh tauvin, keiman vang Yeshua hi amona kamu dohpoi,” ati.
en_web: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
en_kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu pipu hole Houin ngah sepai hon amudoh tah-un, “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in, thingpel’a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Nang hon kaiyun lang khanbeh tauvin; kenvang Ama themmona imacha kamudohpoi,” ati.

tcz: Judate lamkai hon adonbut uvin, “Keiho danpi dungjui'a ama hi athi dinga lomtah ahi, ijeh inem itile ama tah Pathen Chapa akihisah jeh chun,” atiuve.
en_web: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
en_kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon adonbut’in, “Keihon Dan khat kaneiyun, hiche dungjuiya hi ama Pathen chapa akihidsah jeh a thi dinga kilom ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in hiche thu ajah phat'in, atil'a sangin akicha cheh tan;
en_web: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
en_kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hiPilate’n ajahdoh phat’in akicha cheh kit’in,

tcz: Hichun Pilate chu inpi sunga alut kit'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nangma hoiya hung kon nahim?” ati. Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut pon ahi.
en_web: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
en_kjv: and went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
tcz_gospelgo: gamvaipo inpia alut’in Jesu jah a, “Nangma hoiya hungkon nahim?” atileh; Jesun la adonbutpoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pilate in ajah'a, “Nei houpi lou ding ham? Nangma lhadoh na ding jong chuleh thingpel a khetbeh na ding jong thu kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati.
en_web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
en_kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate chun ajah a, “Neidonbut lou ding ong? Nangma lhadohna ding tha kaneiya, thingpel’a khetbehna ding jong tha kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangman keima chunga imacha tha nanei nading aumpoi, amavang chunglam akon tilou'in, ati. Hiti ahijeh a chu keima eipeh doh'a pangpa chonset na achungnungpen e,” ati.
en_web: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
en_kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun adonbut’in, “Chunga kona kipe lou hile chun nangin kachunga thu nanei nanei louhel ding ahi; hijeh chun nakoma eipehdohpa themmona achungnungjoi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu lha doh dingin agongtan, ahinla Judah hon asam uvin, “Nangman hichepa hi nalha doh leh Caesar jol nahilou ahi; ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna'a thusei ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
en_kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh tah chun Pilate’n Ama lhadohna ding aholtai; ahinla Judah on, “Hichepa nalahdoh leh Caesar jol nahilou chu Caesar douna thusei ahi,” tin asamtauve.

tcz: Pilate in thu chucheng ajah phat chun Yeshua chu ahin puidoh in; chuin Pilate chu song lhongnal atiu (Hebrew paova Gabbatha) hichu thutanna'a touna, chunga chun atoutan ahi.
en_web: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
en_kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
tcz_gospelgo: thu hicheng hi ajah phat’in Pilate chun Jesu chu polama ahinpuidoh-in, Hebrew paova, Gabbatha’ kiti song lhongnal laiya kido thutan touna muna atoutai.

tcz: Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi; chuin Juda ho jah'a, “Veuvin na lengpau hi!” ati.
en_web: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
en_kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu kalchuh kut dia kigot ni sunkim don nidan som le ni lem ahitai. Pilate chun Judate jah a, “Ven, nalengpau hi,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho a-aosot jengun, “Sumangin, sumangin, thingpel'ah khenbeh-in!” atiuvin ahileh, Pilate in ajah'uva, “Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhet beh ding ham?” atileh; thempu pipuihon adonbut'un, “Keihon Caesar tailou leng dang kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
en_kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun amahon, “Thah’in, thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asamtauve. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Nalengpau thingpel’a kakhetbeh ding ong atileh; thempu pipu hon adonbut’un, “Caesar tilou keihon leng dang kaneipouve,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua khetbeh na dingin amaho koma ape dohtai, Hichun Judaten Yeshua chu apuidoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
en_kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in aman Jesu thingpel’a khetbeh din amaho apedoh tai.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu akai'un, chuin a thingpel akiput'in Lugu mun (Hebrew paova Golgotha) atiu mun chu jonin achetan ahi.
en_web: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
en_kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
tcz_gospelgo: aman athingpel akiput’in, Hebrew paova, ‘Golgotha’ kiti, ‘ Lugumun’ kiti lai jonin apotdohtan ahi.

tcz: Chuleh hiche mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu thingpel chung'ah akhenbeh tauvin ahi, chuleh midang pasal ni jong asih langto gel'a amatoh akhetbeh thau vin, Yeshua chu amani lai tah a akikhenbeh in ahi.
en_web: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
en_kjv: where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chun Jesu thingpel’a akhenbeh-un, midang ni jong asih langto gel’ah akhaiyun Jesu alai lhai.

tcz: Chuin Pilate in thingpel chunga simdoh ding atah in hichu, “Nazareth Yeshua, Judate lengpa,” tin atah doh in ahi.
en_web: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
en_kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’in amain chan ajih-in thingpel chunga atah-in, “Nazareth Jesu, Judate lengpa,” tin asune.

tcz: Chuleh Yeshua akhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahijeh chun, hiche min chu Juda ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew pao, Latin pao, chuleh Greek paova kisun ahi.
en_web: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
en_kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh nau mun chu khopi nai ahijeh-in, amin chan Hebrew pao le Latin pao chule Greek paova kijih chu Juda ho tampin asimsoh keiyui.

tcz: Hichun thempu pipuihon Pilate henga alungkim lounau aga lhut'un, Hiche kheldoh na dingin, “Judate lengpa” khel'a “Aman aseijin, ‘keima hi Judate lengpa kahi,’” tijoh a khel dingin aseitauve.
en_web: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
en_kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Judate Thempu pipu hon Pilate jah a, ‘Ama hi, ‘Judate lengpa,’ tin sutdan lang, aman, ‘Keima Judate lengpa kahi,’ tin aseiye, tin sunjon,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hithei ponte, ajeh chu keiman kana jihdoh sa chu kajih doh ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
en_kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
tcz_gospelgo: Pilate’in adonbut’in, “Kasutsa chu kasutsa ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chule Rome sepai hon Yeshua akhetbeh uchun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin sepai khat hal khat cheh in achang'un; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin; asangkhol chu khuilou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhungkei ahi.
en_web: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
en_kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepaihon Jesu chu thingpel’a akhetbeh jou phat’un aponsil chu alauvin, sepai khat cheh din hal li asouvin akihomtauve. Asangkhol chol chu akilah-u leh khui lou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhung kei ahi.

tcz: Hichun amahon aseiyun, “Atel tel'a bokeh sangin leh sangu hitin, vang vetaote, koi chang ding ham” atiuve; Hiche hi Pathen thua kijih guilhun na dinga kisei chu ahi. Hichun amahon von chu alehsang un vangvet nan aneiyun, hitichun anabol'un ahi.
en_web: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
en_kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rent it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun amaho khat le khat akihouvun, Pathen lekhabua, “Kaponsil chengse akihomun, Kasangkhol chol chang ding vang vetnan vang asantauve,” kiti chu gullhunna din, “Hiche hi bot-eh poute, koipen chang ding ham, vang santhou hite,” akitiuve. Sepai hon hitia chu abol’u ahiye.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun sepai hon hiti chun hicheng chu aboltauve, Ahin Yeshua thingpel koma chun anutoh, anu sopinu Mary (Clopas Inneipi) toh, Mary Magdalene ading jingun ahi.
en_web: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
en_kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thingpel phung koma chun Jesu nu le anu sopinu, Clopas jinu Mary chule Magdala Mary adding jingui.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan anu le angailut aseijui chu akom'a adin amu phat'in anu jah'a, “Numei ven nachapa chu,” ati.
en_web: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
en_kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun anu le anu koma dinga ngailut seijui chu amun, anu jah a, chun, “Numei, nachapa chu kivet’in, ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche aseijui pa jah'a aseijin, “Hiche hi nanu ahi,” atin hichun hiche aseijui pa chun Yeshua nu Mariam chu a-inlam'a apui tan ahi.
en_web: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
en_kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother. And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuipa jah ajong chun, “Nanu chu kivet’in,” atileh; hichea pat chun seijuipan amanu chu a-in’a chenpi din apuitai.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Yeshuan thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen Lekhabua thu chu guilhun sohthei nan, “Kadang achah-e!” ati.
en_web: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
en_kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jou hin Jesun ijakai akibulhitsoh tai, ti ahen, Pathen lekhabu thu guilhunna din, “Kadang achah-e,” ati.

tcz: Chuleh chukoma chu belkhat'a theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chule twichop phon a theitwi thuh dimset in hyssop mol leh'a atah-un akamtoh asutouvin ahi.
en_web: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
en_kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chu theitwi thuh bel khat’a kitung ahin, twichoppon theitwi thuh dimset’in achopsah-un hyssop molleh a atahuvin, akamtoh agah sutouve.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan theitwi thuh chu adonin, “Akichaitai,” ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadoh tan ahi.
en_web: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
en_kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun thietwi thuh chu achop’in, “Ijakai akibulhuttai,” atin; akaikun alhagao alhadohtai.

tcz: Chuin kigin ni ahijeh chun cholngah ni a thilong ho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin (cholngah ni Chula ni loupi ni ahin), Judah hon Pilate henga akenggu heboh dingleh along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.
en_web: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
en_kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was a high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
tcz_gospelgo: kigot ni ahitan, Choldo ni ma chu ni loupe ni ahi ding jeh-in, Choldo nia thingpel chunga thilong aumden louna din, thingpel’a kikhenbeh ho chu akengu heboh a along lah alhahna dingin Judah on Pilate henga athumtauve.

tcz: Hichun Rome sepai ho ahungun mi ni kikhai Yeshua toh kikhenbeh te ni keng chu ahehbong tauvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
en_kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijehchun sepaiho ahungun Jesu toh kikhetbeh that e ni amasapa le khatjopa kengho chu aheh bongtauve.

tcz: Amavang Pakai Yeshua kom ahin phah uchun, ama chu ana thitan ahi, hiphat chun Yeshua keng vang chu aheh bong tapouve.
en_web: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
en_kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu ahinphah phat’un athisa ahitah chu amu’uvin, akeng te ni aheh bong tapouve,

tcz: Hitia aum vang chun sepai ho khat in Yeshua nah chu tengcha a asut le apet pet chun thisan le twisih ahung pot tan ahi.
en_web: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
en_kjv: but one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
tcz_gospelgo: sepai lah akhat vangin anah tenga agahsut leh thisan le twisih ahung longdoh pai jenge.

tcz: Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahi; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi; chuleh aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
en_web: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
en_kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon jong natahsan theina diuva athilsoh hi amupa tah-in ahettohsah ahin, ahettohsah hi tahbeh ahin, asei hi atahmong ahi, ti ahechen khat aumnai.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi Pathen thua ana kisei doh banga, “Agu khat cha jong kihehbong lou ding ahi,” ati chu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng chu soh a ahitai.
en_web: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
en_kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
tcz_gospelgo: “Agu khat cha kiheh bong lou ding,” tia kisei Pathen lekhabu thu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng hi soh ahi.

tcz: Chule “Amahon tengcha'a asutpau chu avet dingu ahi” kiti toh.
en_web: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
en_kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabu mun kha man, “Asut pau chu avet diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea Joseph, Yeshua seijui khat, amavang Juda ho gin jeh a guh thima hia ahin, ama chun Yeshua long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga aga thum'in ahileh, Pilate'in jong ana phal'e. Hijeh chun ama ahungin Yeshua long chu apo mangtai.
en_web: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
en_kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Judate gin jeh a guhthima Jesu seijuiya anapang, Arimathea khoa Joseph chun Jesu long chu lah lhahna din Pilate henga agathum leh aman aphelpeh tan, hijeh chun ahungin along chu alalhan apoddohtai.

tcz: Chule Arimathea Joseph toh hung khom pachu Nicodemus ahin, ama hi Yeshua toh kimuto dinga jan muthim'a hungpa chu ahi. Nicodemus chun Myrrh leh Aloes thao namtui kihal, sel som sagi le nga a gih ahin choiyin ahi.
en_web: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
en_kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasa janlaiya ahenga hungsa Nicodemus jong ahungin myrrh le aloes kihal thao kilogram som thum ahinchoiyin ahi.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua long chu alauvin Judate chon na ngai bang in lounam tui toh tupat pon nemin atom tauvin ahi.
en_web: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
en_kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu long adomlha lhonin, Judate thivui ngaidol’in, gim namtui anun lhonin, tupat ponnemin atom lhontai.

tcz: Chuleh thingpel'a aki khetbeh nau mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin, hon a chu koima kivuina khahlou hel lhan thah khat uma ahi.
en_web: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
en_kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh nauva chun honk hat aumin, hon sunga chun lhan kisemthah koimacha kivuina khah louhel khat aume.

tcz: Hijeh chun Juda ho kiginni ahijeh chun lhan chu akomcha ahiman chun chukoma chun Yeshua chu avui tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
en_kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda ho kigot nima ahileh, lhan chu anailam jeh-in Jesu chu chukoma avuitauve.

tcz: Chuin hapta kipatna nimasa ni jingkah matah ahung lhungtan, kho jong vah chen loulai ahin, Mary Magdalene chu lhan a chun agachen ahileh song chu lhan a kona tahdohsa aum chu agamui.
en_web: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
en_kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo jou ni masa ni jingkah kho athim nalaiyin, Magdala Mary chu lhanphunga ahung leh song chu tahdohsan ana-ume.

tcz: Hichun Mary Magdalene chu alhai in Simon Peter leh Pakaiyin a-ngailut seijui pa henga hitin thu aga lhuttai, “Pakai longdamsa chu amahon apo mangtauvin, chule lhan khuh akon'a hoilanga akoiyu ham akihetapoi” agatin ahi.
en_web: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
en_kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu jong Simon Peter le Jesun a-ngailut seijui henga ahung lhaijel’in ajah lhona, “Pakai chu lhana konin apomangun hoilam alhut’u hitam akahettapouve,” ati.

tcz: Hiche jehchun Peter le seijui khatpa chu lhan khuh lam jon in ache lhontai.
en_web: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
en_kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Peter le seijui dangpa chu apotdoh lhonin lhan lama ahunglhone.

tcz: Hichun seijui teni chu hatah in lhan lam jon'in akilhaitet lhon in ahile seijui khatpa chun Peter akhokhel in lhan khuh apha masa tan ahi.
en_web: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
en_kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
tcz_gospelgo: ani lhona hung lhai khom ahi lhon vangin seijuidangpan Peter adalhan lhanphung ahung lhung masai.

tcz: Ama akunin asung avet le tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asunga alutpoi.
en_web: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
en_kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
tcz_gospelgo: Akuna lhansung agah vet leh tupat ponnem tol’a um chu amun, asung vang alutpoi.

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter chu ahung lhungtan, chuin lhan sunga chun alut tai; chuin tupat ponnem ho aum chuleh,
en_web: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
en_kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peter jong ahunjuipeh-in ahungin, lhan sunga alut’in ahileh tupat ponnem tol’a um bou amun,

tcz: Aluchunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva akijel'a atuma ana um aga mun ahi.
en_web: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
en_kjv: and the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
tcz_gospelgo: alu tomna pon chu tupat ponnem toh umkhom lou, kijel’a atumbeh a aum amui.

tcz: Hichun seijui alhung masajo pa jong chu lhan khuh sunga aga sunglhan, hichun amun atahsan tai.
en_web: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
en_kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun lhanphung lhung masa seijui dangpa jong lhan sunga alut leh amu chenin atahsantai.

tcz: Hiche masangsea chu amahon Pathen thu akisei doh “Pakai Yeshua chu thi ding chuleh hungthou doh kit ding ahi” tichu ana tahsan thei lou'u ahi.
en_web: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
en_kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabua thinaa kona thoudoh kit ding ahi, kiti chu ahetkhen loulaiyu ahi.

tcz: Hichun amahon Inlam ahin jon tauvin ahi.
en_web: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
en_kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuite ni a-in lama akile kit lhontai.

tcz: Mary vang chu lhan khuh pam'a chun ading in akap'in aka pum chun lhan khuh sung chu aga ven ahi.
en_web: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
en_kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
tcz_gospelgo: Mary chu lhanpama adingin akap kap’e. Akapuma lhansung kuna agah vet leh,

tcz: Hichun aban abang Vantil ni Yeshua long alupsah nauva chu khat alulhuna atouva khat akeng todop'a atou amui.
en_web: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
en_kjv: and seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu long ajam nauva alulama khat akeng lama khat ponbang sil cheh Vantil ni atou lhon agah mui.

tcz: “Ngailut umtah numei nangma ibol'a kap nahim?” tin Vantil teni chun ahindongin ahi. Hichun amanun adonbut'in, “Ajeh chu amahon Ka Pakai apomang tauvin, chuleh along damsa chu hoiya akoiyu keiman kahe tapoi,” ati.
en_web: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
en_kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
tcz_gospelgo: amanin ajah a, “Numei, i-bol’a kap nahim?” ati lhon leh; aman ajah lhona, “Amahon ka-Pakai apomangun, hoiya akoiyu kahetapoi,” ati.

tcz: Chutia aseijou chun ama aki nungheiyin ahileh, Yeshua adin amun, ahin Yeshua ahi chu ahepoi.
en_web: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
en_kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun aseiyin, agah kihei leh, Jwsu adin amun Jesu ahilam ahepoi.

tcz: Yeshuan ahin dong'in, “Ngailut umtah numei ibol'a kap nahim?” ati. Amanun honlei ngahpa ahisah in, “Pu, hoilaiya nakoi hitam Ka Pakai long chu, neisei peh in keiman gapo mang ing kate,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Numei i-bol’a kap, nahim? Koi nahol ham?” atileh amanun honlei ngahpa chu ahisah-in, ajah a, “Pu, nangin napoh mang ahileh, ken kipoh tnege, hoiya nalupsah ham neihil’in” ati.

tcz: “Mary!” tin Yeshuan ahin koutai. Mary chu Pakai henglam a ahung kihei in akap'in, “Rabboni,” ati (hichu Hebrew paova, “houhil,” tina ahi).
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amanu jah a, “Mary!” atileh; amanu akihei loiyin Hebrew paova houhil tin an, “Robboni!” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Neitong khahih in; ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laiye; ahin chen lang kasopi ho jah'a gaseiyin, Ka-Pa, nangho Pa, Ka Pathen nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun amanu jah a, “Neituh chah hih-in, ka-Pa henga kakaltou hih laiye; ahin kasopite henga chen lang ajah-uva, “keima ka-Pa, nang ho pa chule ka-Pathen, nang ho Pathen henga kakaltouve, tin aseiye gatin,” ati.

tcz: Mary Magdalene chun seijui ho akimupin, hitin aseiye, “Keiman Pakai chu kamutai,” ati. Chuin amanu chun athusei ho chu asei peh tai. Yeshua Aseijuite Henga Akilah
en_web: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
en_kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
tcz_gospelgo: Magdala Mary chu achen seijuite henga chun, “Pakai chu kamutai,” atin chuleh thil dang amanu jah a aseiho jong chu agaseiye.

tcz: Nikho kipat ni nilhah chun aseijuite Judah ho gin na jeh'a kot kikha khuma um ahiuvin, hichun Yeshua ahungin amaho lah'a ahung dingin ajah'uva, “Nachung'uva lungmon umhen,” ati.
en_web: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
en_kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo jou nimasa ni, nilhah lamin Judate gin jeh a seijuite umna in kotpi chengse kikha khumsoh ahin, ahinla Jesu ahungin alah-uva adingin, ajah-uva, “nalahuva cham leng hen,” ati.

tcz: Aman hiche chu aseijou vin amaho chu akhut thihkil maha le anah tenga kisut na maha avetsah tan ahi. Hichun amahon Pakai amu'u chun seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
en_kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche asei jou chun seijuite chu akhut te ni le anah avetsah-e. Seijuiten Pakai amu phat’un akipah lheh jengui.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin avel'in ahoulimpi kit in, “Nachunguva lungmon chamna umhen, chuleh Pan keima eisol banga nangho kasol nahiuve,” ati.
en_web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
en_kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva aseikit’in, “Nalahuva cham leng hen,” atin; Pan keima eisol banga nang ho kasol nahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Pakai in aseijui ho chu ahu ahai khum in, “Lhagao theng kisan un.”
en_web: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
en_kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu aseiyin amaho ahu alha khumin ajah-uva, “Lhagao kisan’un.

tcz: “Nanghon koitobang ham khat chu achonsetna nangaidam uva ahileh kingaidam ahitauve, ahin nanghon nangaidam louleh amaho chu kingaidam lou ahijenge,” ati.
en_web: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
en_kjv: whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon michonset ho na-ngaidamu leh ngai dam chang diu, themmo nachansahu leh themmo chang ding ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Seijui som le ni holah'a khat Thomas (Didymus atiu) vang chu Yeshua hung kilah a chu amaho lah'a ana umlou ahi.
en_web: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
en_kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu hung kilah pet chun som le ni lah a khat, Thomas pengkop kitipa chu anaumpoi.

tcz: Amahon aseipeh un, “Keihon Pakai chu kamutauve,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin Thomas chun, “Keiman akhut phanga thingkil maha kamua kakhut junga kakhoiya, anah kakhut a katham kahsen keiman tahsan ponge,” ati.
en_web: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
en_kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijui dang hon ajah a, “Keihon Pakai kamutauve,” atiuleh; aman ajah-uva, “Akhut phang te nia thingkil maha chengse kamua, thingkil maha ho chu kakhutjunga kakhoiya, anah kakhut tah a katham lousen tahsan ponge,” ati.

tcz: Niget jouvin seijuite insunga aumkhom pettah'un, hia chu Thomas jong um'ah ahi. Aumnau in chu kot kikhah soh keiya ahi, hinlah hetmanlou kah'in, amasa'a bangin, Yeshua alah uva ana dingin ahi. “Chamnan nalon khum'u hen,” ati.
en_web: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
en_kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Niget jouvin aseijuite chu insunga aumun, Thomas jong alah-uva apange. Kot jouse akikha vang chun Jesu ahungin alah-uva adingin, “Nalah-uva cham leng hen,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjung in hinkhoiyin, kakhut teni hi ven; chuleh nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah tham'in; chuleh gingcha lel tahih in, tahsanin,” ati.
en_web: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
en_kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
tcz_gospelgo: Abanin Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjungin hikom hi khoiyin, kakhut te ni hi ven, nakhut hin lhangin kanah thamin, tahsan lel ding ahipoi, tahsan jengin, ati.

tcz: “Ka Pakai le Ka Pathen!” tin Thomas chun ahin phongdoh tai.
en_web: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
en_kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
tcz_gospelgo: Thomas chun adonbut’in ajah a, “Ka-Pakai le ka-Pathen!” ati.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangman neimu jeh a neitahsan ahi. Mulouva tahsan ho anun nomui,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah a, “Neimu jeh a natahsan hiyah ong? Mu louva tahsan ho chu anun nom’ui,” ati.

tcz: Hiti tah a chu Yeshuan aseijuite ang sunga melchihna kidang tamtah abol ahin, hiti ho chu hiche lekhabu sunga hin akisunlut poi.
en_web: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
en_kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche lekhabua kisun lou Jesun asiejuite mitmua melchihna abol tampi aum nalaiye;

tcz: Ahinla nanghon Yeshua chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa, ahi chu natahsan uva chule natahsan vanguva ama min a hinna nanei theina dinguva hichengse hi hiche lekhabua hi kisun'ah ahibouve.
en_web: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
en_kjv: but these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
tcz_gospelgo: akisun cheng jong hi Jesu chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa ahi, ti natahsan’uva hiche natahsan jeh-uva chu hinna nanei theina diuva kisun ahibouve.

tcz: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua chu seijui hotoh Galilee dillen panga akimuto kit'un, hiti hin ana um'in ahi.
en_web: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
en_kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
tcz_gospelgo: hicheng nug hin Jesu amatah Tiberias dillena seijuite henga akilah kit’in, hiti hin akilahin ahi.

tcz: Simon Peter le Thomas (Didymus atiu) chutoh, Galilee gam'a Cana khoa mi Nathanael toh, Zebedee chapa teni toh chuleh seijui dang nitoh umkhom'a ahiuvin;
en_web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
en_kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu Simon Peter, pengkoppa kiti Thomas, Galilee gam Cana khoa Nathaniel, Zebedee chapa te ni chule aseijuite lah amidang ni jong ahiuve.

tcz: Simon Peter in, “Keima nga manin chenge,” ati. Hichun amahon ajah'a, “Keiho jong kahung dingu ahi atiuvin ahi.” Chuin acheuvin kong sung khat ah aluttauve, ahin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.
en_web: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
en_kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peterin ajah-uva, “Keima nga manin kiche tange,” ati. Adang hon ajah a, “Keiho jong nang to kilhon cheh tah tau hen,” atiuve. Hijeh chun apotdoh-un kong sunga alut’un, ahivangin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouve.

tcz: Jingkah matah in Yeshua chu vapam'a adin seijui hon amuuvin, hinlah ama chu koi ahi ageldoh pouve.
en_web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
en_kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah lhah lhah in Jesu vaokama adingin, seijuiten Ama ahilam ahepouve.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin amaho chu akouvin, “Sopite ho, nga ijat namat tah uvem?” ati. Ahin amahon adonbut'un, “Imacha Kaman pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
en_kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Gollhang, nga matsa nanei louvu ham?” atileh; amahon adonbut’un, “Aumpoi,” atiuve.

tcz: Hichun aman, “Nalen'u chu kong jetlam'a gaseplha temun, hiteng chule namat dingu ahi,” ati. Hichun amahon aseu le nga atama atam jeh chun akaidoh joutapouve.
en_web: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ajah-uva, “Kongsih jetlama chun len sep leu chun namat diu ahi,” ati. Hijeh chun aseu leh nga atam mat behseh phat’un len chu akaijou tapouve.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai ahi,” ati. Hichu Peter in Pakai ahi ati chu ajah phat in asangkhol aki-ah loiyin, (asagoh keova um ahin) dillen a chun achom lhan chule vapam lam chu ajon'in ahi.
en_web: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
en_kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Jesun angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai chu ahibouve,” ati. Simon Peterin Pakai ahibouve, ti ajah phat’in, dsagoh keova um ahijeh-in sangkhol aki-ah loiyin dil’a achom lhan,

tcz: Adangse vang chu kong sunga atouvun, len chu vapam langa kaidoh ding agong'un, ajeh chu len a chu nga dimset ahin chule amaho vapam alhun nadingu chu tong jani tobang achebeu ngaiyah ahi.
en_web: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
en_kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
tcz_gospelgo: seijui dang ho vang chu konga ahung kitol’un, tola kona gamla lou, tong ja ni tobang bou kilat ahiuvin, nga dim set len chu ahinkaipeh-ui.

tcz: Amaho vapam alhun uchun songmeihol meiya kitih le achunga nga kikoi chuleh changlhah, jing-an a nehding, amu'uvin ahi.
en_web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
en_kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Tolgo ahung geiphat’un, song meihol meiya kitih a nga kigou leh changlhah amu’uve.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah'a, “Namatsau nga chu themkhat hinchoiyun,” ati.
en_web: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
en_kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesun ajah-uva, “Tutah a namat’u nga chu phabep hinchoiyun,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter kong sunga alut'in len chu vapam langa akai doh in ngalen ja khat le som nga le thum dimset len chu agakaiyin, nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-eh pon ahi.
en_web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
en_kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon Peter chu konga akaldoh-in nga len jeng dimset len chu tolgoa akaidoh leh, nga ja khat le som nga le thum ahin, achuti tam lheh vangin len chu a-ehpoi.

tcz: Hiphat chun Yeshuan, “Tun nangho hungun lang jing an hung kineh tauvin,” ati. Ahinla aseijui holah a chun khat cha beh in jong, “Nang koi nahi ham?” tin adong ngam pouve. Amahon Pakai ahi chu ahesoh keiyun ahi.

en_web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

tcz_gospelgo: Jingan aneh jouvun Jesun Simon Peter jah a, “John chapa Simon, hiche ho sanga hi nei-ngailut joh hinam?” atileh; aman ajah a, “Kakelngoite vah-in,” ati.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati. Anivei nan ajah'a, “John chapa Simon nangman neingailut'em?” ati kit tai. Aman ajah'a, “Henge Pakai ka-ngailut nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati.
en_web: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
en_kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
tcz_gospelgo: Ani vainan ajah a, “John chapa Simon, nei-ngailut’em?” ati kit leh; aman ajah a, “Heng’e, Pakai kalungset nangman nahenai,” ati. Aman ajah a, “Kakelngoite chingphan,” ati.

tcz: Yeshuan athumvei nan adongkit in, “John chapa Simon, keima hi nei ngailut tahbeh mong hinam?” ati. Thumveijen, “Neingailut'em?” atijeh chun Peter chu alungthim anommo lhehtan, ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahe sohkeiye, keiman nangma kangailut na jouse nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in” ati.
en_web: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
en_kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
tcz_gospelgo: Athum veinan ajah a, “John chapa Simon, nei lungset’em?” atileh; thumvei jen chutia ajah a, “Neilungset’em? Atijeh chun Peter along gimtan, ajah a, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahenai; nang kalungset hi nahejinge,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Kakelngoite vahin,

tcz: “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nakhandon lai chun nangma deibang tah'in navon nakivon thei in, chuleh nangma nop nop na lama nache theiye, ahinla nakum ahungtam tan chujongleh nahung pilhingtan, hijeh a chu nakhut ho nahinjal doh'a midang koitobang in navon nahin vonpeh ding chuleh nache nom louna lam lama napui dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
en_kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichentah a kaseipeh nahi, naneo laiyin nakong nakigah jin nadeina lam lama nachen, na-upat teng vang leh nakhut te ni najah a midangin nakong nagah peh ding, nadeilou lam lama napui ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichu ama iti thia athiding Pathen achoiat ding chu hetsah na a ati ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah'a, “Kanung hin jui in,” ati.
en_web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

tcz_gospelgo: Hiche asei hi itobang dol’a iti thia Pathen achoi-at ding ham atina ahi. Hiche asei jou hin ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” ati.

en_web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

tcz: Hichun hiche asei chu, hiche seijui chu thi louding ahi, tin sopite lah'a athangtan ahi; ahinla Yeshuan ama jah'a chu, “Ama chu thilou ding ahi, ati ahipoi. Kahung kahsen umhen, tileng hichu nangman ipi ding natim?” ati ahibouve.
en_web: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
en_kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun athu hi sopite lah a akithangin hiche seijui chu thi lou ding in akiseiye. Jesun ama chu thi lou ding ahi, tia asei ahipon, “Ama khu kahung kahsen umsah nom leng nang dia ipi iti-am?” atijoh ahibouve.

tcz: Hicheng thu hettohsah a chule hicheng thu suna hi hiche seijui chu ahin; ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi, ti kaheuve.
en_web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
en_kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichengse hettohsah a panga sundoh hi hiche seijui chu ahin, ama hettohsah hi atahbeh ahi keihon kaheuve.

en_web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichepet hin mikhat ahenguva ahungin, “ven, songkul’a namihen ho’u khu, Houin a adingun mipi thu ahil’uve,” ati.

en_web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

tcz: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga ahinpuilut un, amaho chu thempu chungnung in thu adongun,
en_web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

en_web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
en_kjv: saying, Did not we straitly command you that you should not teach in this name? and behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.

en_web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
en_kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Israelte achonset chengseu ngaidama aumna dia chonset lung heina apehna din ama chu Pathenin ama jetlama vaipo le huhhingpan achoisangtai.

tcz: Keiho hi hiche thudol hettohsah chu kahiuvin, chuleh athua nungho dinga Pathen in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
en_kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu ho ahetoh a chu Pathenin athua nung ho apeh Lhagao Theng le keiho kahiuve,” atiuve.

en_web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

tcz_gospelgo: Ajapha chan alung hang beseh jengun Solchah ho chu thadoh jengdia akiloltauve.

tcz: Ahin houvaipoloi lah a mikhat, Pharisee mi amin Gamaliel, amapa chu hou danthu them le mijousen ajabol mikhat ahin, adingdoh in miho chu chomkhat pamlanga soldoh dingin thu apen ahi.
en_web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Hou vaipoloi lah a Pharisee mi, amin Gamaliel kiti, Danthu hilthem, mi jousen ajasohkei, ama chu adingdoh-in Solchah ho chu phat chom khat polama soldoh dingin aseiyin,

tcz: Tu masang chun Theudas kiti mikhat anaumin, ama chu milen khat bangin ana um'in ahile mihem jali valin anung ana jui un ahi, ahin ama chu anathat'un ahileh anungjui ho chu lamchom cheh a anavahcheh gamun, abol atoh hou jouse imalou asohtan ahi.
en_web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
en_kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile tu masngin jong Theudas kiti mi khat anaumin, ama le ama i-khat hidainnin akiseiyin, pasal phabep jen, ja li bangin ajop’uvin, ahinla ama atha phat’un anungjui chengse akithe chehsoh-in, imacha lou asoh tai.

tcz: Amapa jouchun hichu min kisut lai ahin, Galilee mi Judas kiti mikhat anaum kitin ama jong chun anungjui mitampi ana neiyin, ahin athat kitun ahile anungjui ho jouse chu ana kithecheh kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
en_kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin leiset mi kisim laiyin Galilee mi Judas ahung kipan kit’in, mipi phabep geiyin akijuisah-e; ama jong hi amang thah tah, anungjui chengse jong akithecheh tauve.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche mite hi ima lohih un, moh lhaong uvin, ajeh chu amahon angaitouva abolgot'u hi amaho lungchama ahile chomkhat joule hungmang paiding ahi.
en_web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
en_kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu tu hiche thua jong kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche mihoa kon hin kikangseuvin lang don dauvin, ijeh-inem itile hiche jong hi mihema kon le lunggel chule natoh ahile kisumang thou ding ahi;

tcz: Ahin Pathena kona ahileh nasuhmang jou lou dingu, nangho le nangho Pathen toh kidoubep nahilo dingu ahi!” ati.
en_web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
en_kjv: but if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathena hungkon ahivangleh nasuh mang joulou diu ahi, ajo leh Pathen kidoupi nahilo diu ahi,” ati. Gamaliel thun anungun,

tcz: Chuin ama thumop chun akilol tauvin, solchahho chu akouvun ajep uvin, chujouvin Yeshua mina thu aseikit tahlou nadingun agihsalun alha tauvin ahi.
en_web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
en_kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah ho chu akou lut’uvin, avoh juvun Jesu min’a thu asei louhelna diuvin hatah-in agihsal’un alhadoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga kon chun apotdoh un, Yeshua mina suhgima aumjeh uchun akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
en_kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah ho chu Hou vaipoloi kikhopna maiya konin achedohun, chuche Min jal’a hesoh genthei thoh a kiloma akibol’u chu akipah lheh jengui.

tcz: chule aniseh in Houin le ainson tin'ah “Yeshua chu Messiah ahi,” tichu ahil'un asamphong jom jingun ahi.
en_web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
en_kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Niseh-in Houin le a-in tin’uva tang louhel’in thu ahil’un, chule Jesu chu Messiah ahi Kipana Thupha asiphong jingui.

tcz: Ahin aniseh a atahsan akibejing phat in alah uva phun noina le kilunglhaito louna aumdoh tan, hichun Greek pao tho atahsanho chun Hebrew pao tho atahsanhon niseh-a neh le chah kihopna-a meithaiho akhohsah pouve tin aphunnoi tauvin ahi.
en_web: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
en_kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai chun seijuih mijat apunbe cheh cheh phat’un niseh a thil kihopnaa ameithaiho’u anah sah peh pouve, tin Greek pao tho Juda-numeiho chu Hebrew mite chunga aphun’un, akah-uva kinahna asodoh tai.

tcz: Chuin solchah somleni hochun atahsanho chu abonchauvin akou khom uvin, “Keiho solchahho hin Pathen thuhilna-a phat kaman diu ahin neh le chah a hi kaboilou ding dol-u ahi.
en_web: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
en_kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in som le ni chun seijui jouse akoukhom’un, “Keihon Pathen thu seiphong kangah-uva dokhanga ankong sem’a kapan diu adihpoi;

tcz: Hijeh chun sopite ho, nanghon jaumtah, lhagao le chihna a dim mi sagi lhengdoh uvin lang ama ho chu neh leh chah a mo kapohsah dingu ahi.

en_kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun sopite, hiche kin’a kapansah diuvin, nalah-uva konin Lhagao le chihna dim mia nahettohsau sagi lhengdohuvin;

tcz: Chutileh keiho solchah ho hin taona le Pathen thuhila phat kamanthei dingu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
en_kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
tcz_gospelgo: chuteng keiho tah vang taona le hill hang kin’a kipumpeh jo’uvinge,” atiuve.

en_kjv: whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho chu Solchah ho angsunga adinsah-u leh, Solchah hon ataopeh-uvin achunguva khut a-ngamtauve.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pathen thu achaljah tan, jerusalema seijuiho mijat hapunin apungin, Thempu ho lah a tamtah jong tahsan thun anung tauve.

tcz: Chuin Stephen chun, Pathen lungset nale thaneina dimset in thil kidang le melchihna tampi mipiho masanga abol in ahi.
en_web: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
en_kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Stephen chu lungset le thahat adamtan, mipi lah a melchihna le thil kidang lentah tah aboldoh tai.

tcz: Ahin nikhat chu chamlhat miho kikhop khomna a konin mi phabep, amaho chu Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, le Asia gam'a kona Judah mi ahiuvin amaho chu ahungun Stephen chu ahung kinelpi tauvin ahi.
en_web: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
en_kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun akiminvo na banga chamlhat miho Houthua kikhopna in kitia konin mi phabep, Cyrene gama, Alexandria, Cilicia le Asia a hung kon ho akipatdoh-un Stephen chu akinelpiu leh,

tcz: Ahin Stephen in chihna le Lhagao dimset puma aseidoh thucheng ang a chun koima adingjou pouvin ahi.
en_web: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
en_kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
tcz_gospelgo: aman chihna le Lhagao thu asei chu anel thei tapouve.

tcz: Chuin amahon mipi themkhat atildoh-un amaho koma chun Stephen in “Mose le Pathen ataitom,” thu kajauve atiuvin ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in amahonmi phabep, “Amah in Mose le Pathen taitomna thu asei kajauve,” tia sei dingin atlseuvin ahi.

tcz: Hiche asei-uchun mipichu alung handoh sah-uvin, chuin upa hole houdanthu hilho chun Stephen chu aman uvin vaipoloi anga ahin puilut un ahi.
en_web: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
en_kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun mipi le upa ho, Danthu themho aban tilset’uvin, amaho achunga achu’vin, aman’un Hou vaipoloi kikhop naa akailut’un,

tcz: Chuin jouthu hettoh sahna asemun, “Hiche mipa hin Houin theng dounale Mose dan dounan thu aseiyin,
en_web: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
en_kjv: and set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
tcz_gospelgo: jouthua hettohsah-uvin, amahon, “Hichepa hin Muntheng le Danthu douna thu tang louhel’in asei sei jengin,

en_web: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
en_kjv: for we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
tcz_gospelgo: Nazareth Jesun hiche mun hi asuhmanga Mose’n eipeh-u chondan ho hi akheldoh ding ahi,’ tia asei jong kajauve,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Hichepettah chun vaipo loiho jouse chun Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahi, ajeh chu Stephen maiso chu vantil ho maibanga vahset ahi.
en_web: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
en_kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa tou chengsen Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahileh amai chu Vantil maiso bangin amu’uve.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung chun Stephen chu adongin, “Hiche hehna thu hohi dih em?” ati.
en_web: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
en_kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnungin, “Hichengse hi hiti mong ham?” atileh;

tcz: Chuin Stephen in adonbut in, “Sopite le Pateho ngaiyuvin, Ipuluiyu Abraham Haran a achen masang, Mesopotamia gam'a aumlaiyin Loupi Pathen chu ahenga ana kilah in,

tcz_gospelgo: Stephenin adonbut’in, “Ngaiyuvin sopite le pate ho: Penna bulpipa Abraham chu Haran aching dia ache masang, Mesopotamia gama achen laiyin loupina Pathen ahenga ahung kilah-in
