tcz: Chuin Abraham'in Chaldea gam ahin dalhan apa thikah in Haran a anachengin, chujouvin tua nachennau gamsunga hin ahin puilut in ahi.
en_web: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
en_kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ama Chaldea gama konin achen Haran a achengtai. Apa thi nungin tua nachen nau hiche gamsunga hin akichon lutsah-in,

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in akengto ngapna dingkham gambeh neocha jong ana pepoi. Ahin Abraham'in chapa aneiloulai vang'in nikhatle ama le ason achilhah ten hichegam hi alodingu ahi tin Pathen in ana thutep-in ahi.
en_web: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
en_kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla agam leiset halsi khat, kengpeh thol jeng cha jong ama din apepoi; cha anei lou vangin, agam chu ama le anunga achilhahpa apeh din thu anatep’e.

tcz: Chuleh Pathen in aseikit in nason nachilhate jong migama kum jali sohchang le bolgima um dingu ahi
en_web: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
en_kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin hiti hin achilhah te chu mi gama gapem’uva, mihon sohna atohsah diu, genthei hesoh a abol diuvin aseiye.

tcz: Ahin soh-a kai nam mite chunga keiman thu katan ding, achaina le hiche gam'a hi hung kile kit uva keima eihoukit dingu ahi ati.
en_web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
en_kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin aseiyin, ‘Amahon sohna agatoh peh-u nam mite chu thu katan khuma, chujou teng Abraham chilhahte hung kitoldoh-uva hiche lai mun’a Keima kinbol’a eihou diu ahi,’ ati ahi.

tcz: Chule Pathen in jong Abraham chu cheptana kitepna thu anapen, chuin Abraham'in achapa Isaac ahin phat in aniget nin chep anatan in, chule hiche kitepna chu Isaac in jong Jacob ahina, chuleh Jacob in apului-u somleni ahinchan geiyin jong ahin boljom jingun ahi.
en_web: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
en_kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Abraham chu cheptan ding kitepna thupeh apen, hijeh chun Isaac ahingin niget nin chep atanpeh-in, Isaac-in Jacob, Jacob’in penna pate somle ni ahingin chep atanpeh-e.

tcz: Chuin hiche puluiho chu asopipau Joseph chunga ana thangthip uvin, hijeh chun Egypt gam'a sohding in anajohdoh uvin ahi. Ahin Pathen in anaumpi jingin,
en_web: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
en_kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
tcz_gospelgo: “Penna pate chu Joseph chunga athang thip’un Egypt gama ajoh mangun, ahile Pathenin aumpi jingin,

tcz: Gentheina ho jouse a konin anahuhdoh in Egypt lengpa Pharaoh angsunga lungsetna anapen ahi. Chule Pathen in Joseph chu kidangtah chihna anapen hijeh chun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpia vaipon ana pansah in chuleh a leng inpia jong mopon ana pansah in ahi.
en_web: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
en_kjv: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
tcz_gospelgo: ahesoh genthei tin tanga konin ahinhuhdoh pehin, Egypt lengpa Pharaohang’a lungset le chihna apen, hijeh chun lengpan Egypt gam pumpi le ama insung pumpia vaipon asemtai.

tcz: Ahin Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga kel ahunglha tan ahileh gentheina sangtah ahunglhung tan hijeh chun ipuiluiteu jong nehding neilouvin anaum un ahi.
en_web: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
en_kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Egypt gam punpi le Canaan gam pumpia nahiuve kel alhan, gentheina lentah ahung, lhungin, i-puteuvin neh le chah akimu joutapouve.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in Egypt gamsunga neh aum nalaiye ti ahet phatin achate-ipuiluiteu chu neh choding in asolin ahi.
en_web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
en_kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Jacob’in Egypt gama anneh aume, ti ajah phat’in i-puteu chu khatvei chan nan agah solpai jenge.

tcz: Anivei channa a anache uchun Joseph chu a sopite henga ana kiphongin chuin asopite chu Pharaoh henga anapuilut in ahi.
en_web: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
en_kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
tcz_gospelgo: anivei chan na Joseph-in asopite akihetdohsah tan, Jacob insung chu Pharaoh geiyin ahetai.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in mi asolin apa Jacob le ainsungmite somsagi le nga hochu ahenga dingin agakousah tan ahi.
en_web: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
en_kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Joseph-in jong apa Jacob le a-inkote mihem som sagi le nga jen chu gakou din mi asol’in,

tcz: Chuin Jacob chu Egypt gam'a anache in athitan ahi chule ipuluiteu jong anathi tauvin ahi.
en_web: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
en_kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob jong Egypt’a ahung suh tai. Hichun ama ahin i-puteu ahin athitauvin,

tcz: Chun alongdamsau chu Shechem a ahin pouvin Abraham'in Hamor chapate koma anachohna lhanmuna chun avui tauvin ahi.
en_web: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
en_kjv: and were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
tcz_gospelgo: alongu chu Shechema alepoh-uvin, Shechem muna Abrahamin Hamor chatea kona dang kaa achohsa lhan’a chun avuitauve.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham koma athutep guilhunna ding phat anaitah jehchun miho chu Egypt gam'a chun hatah in apungun.
en_web: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
en_kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
tcz_gospelgo: “Pathenin Abraham koma akihahsel’a a thupeh phat chu ahung lhinpai ding phat’in, Egypt gama mipi apungtel tul jengun,

tcz: Ahin Joseph hephalou lengthah khat Egypt lengvaipoa ahung pan phat in,
en_web: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
en_kjv: till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
tcz_gospelgo: Joseph hephalou leng chom khat hung letdoh geiyin apunguve.

tcz: Hiche lengpa chun imiteu chu doha in abolin asugentheiyin chule achasen houchu athi nadingin anu le apa teu chu hunam'in ana paidoh sah in ahi.
en_web: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
en_kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
tcz_gospelgo: Lengchompa hin ijat miteu heltah-in dohan abol’in, i-pu i-pateu chu achasen jouseu ahing aum louna din acham louvun polama apaidoh sah jenge.

tcz: Hichephat laitah chun Pathen mitvet a chapang hoitah Mose chu anapengin, anu le apan inmun'ah lhathum hoitah in anasin lhonin ahi.
en_web: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
en_kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai tah hin Mose apengin Pathen din it aum lheh jenge; lha thum sungin apa insunga avah-un,

tcz: Chuin anu le apan Mose chu apaidoh lhontan ahileh Pharaoh chanun ana kimudoh in ama cha bang bangin ahin vahkhang tan ahi.
en_web: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
en_kjv: and when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
tcz_gospelgo: ama jong apaidoh phat’uvin Pharaoh chanun akilah-in achapa vah-in ahin kivahdoh tai.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu Egypt gamsung chihna ho jouse ahilun ahile ama chu thusei le natoh a thahattah'a hung hitan ahi.
en_web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
en_kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose chu Egypt mite chihna jouse ahil’un, athusei jouse le antohna chan a pheltah ahiye.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu kum somli ahung hi phat hin nikhat chu asopite-Israel techu agavetan ahile,
en_web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
en_kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: “Mose chu kum som li alhin phat’in asopi Israel chate gavil ding alungthima aumdoh tai.

tcz: Egypt mipa khat'in Israel mikhat alamlou tah'a abol chu amun chuin Mose chu ahungin Israel mipa chu ahuh in Egypt mipa chu athattan ahi.
en_web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
en_kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat hi adih loutah a kibol amun, ama chu akithopin aphu lahnan Egypt mipa chu athattai.

tcz: Mose chun hiche Israel mite chun Pathen in keiho huhdoh dinga eihinsolpeh ahi ti geldoh nauvinte tia anagel vang chun Israel mite chun anageldoh pouvin ahi.
en_web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
en_kjv: for he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose gel’a chu Pathenin ama khut mangchaa ama hochu huhhingna apeh got ahi asopiten kihetnah tau atileh, amahon ahepouve.

tcz: Chuin ajing nikhon amite agavet a ahileh, Israel mini ana kina lhonin hijeh chun aman jong chamna nasem kigon hiche miteni koma chun “Nangni sopi khat nahi lhon louham? Ipi dinga nakinah lhon ham?” atin ahile,
en_web: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
en_kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
tcz_gospelgo: ajingin ahenguva ahung kit leh mi ni akina lhonin, aman akah lhona chamna thu aseiyin, ‘Mi te ni, sopi cha hlhona ibol’a khat’in khat adih louva kibol nahi lhon ham?’ ati.

tcz: mikhatpa chun Mose chu ahin sondoh in, kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham? tin ahin dongin,
en_web: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
en_kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla a-inhengpa adih louva bolpa joh chun Mose chu asondoh-in, ‘Keiho chunga vaipo le thutana kon natun beh am?

tcz: “Janhia Egypt mipa khat natha banga chu keima jong neitha got ham?” atin ahi.
en_web: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
en_kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou didst the Egyptian yesterday?
tcz_gospelgo: Janhia Egypt mipa natha banga chu tha ding neigot ham?’ ati.

tcz: Chuin Mosen hichu ajah phat chun, Egypt gam'a konin ajamin Midian gam apemin hiche muna chun chapa ni ahingin ahi.
en_web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
en_kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche athusei jeh hin Mose ajamin Midian gama agapemin, hikoma chun chapa ni agahinge.

tcz: Chuin kum somli jouvin Vantil hamboh meikongin Mose chu Sinai mol toh kinai gamthip a chun ana kimupi in,
en_web: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
en_kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kum som li lhinin Sinai mol gamthip laiya Vantil khat hamboh lah meikongin Mose henga ahung kileh-e.

tcz: Chuin Mosen hichu amun athilmu chu kidang asah in, achenaiya agavet kigot le Pakai awgin chun ahin kouvin,
en_web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
en_kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thil amu hi Mose’n adatmon, ga ve chen dia anailut leh Pakai o ahung gingin,

tcz: “Keima napuluiteu Pathen kahi, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen kahi,” ahin tin ahile Mose jong akicha behseh jengin avengam tapon ahi.
en_web: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
en_kjv: saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ ati.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in aseiyin, “Nakengchot sutlhan ajeh chu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi.
en_web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
en_kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Nakeng te nia konin nakengchot te ni sut lhan, ijeh-inem itile nadinna chu muntheng ahi.

tcz: Egypt gam'a kamite gentheina kamutan, akanau aw kajan ahuhdoh dinga hungkumlha kahitai, hijeh chun tun keiman nangma hi Egypt gam'a kanungsol kit nahi,” ati.
en_web: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
en_kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
tcz_gospelgo: Egypt gama kamite kibolsetna kaven kamu chentai, chule apen gin’u kajan apuidoh diuva hung kumlha kahi; hijeh chun tun hungin Egypt’a kasol ding nahi,’ ati.

tcz: Chuin “Kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham?” tia asanlou pau chu, Pathen in hamboh lah'a kona akimusah vantil jalchun vaipo dingle thutan dingin Pathen in Mose chu alesol kit in ahile.
en_web: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
en_kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hiche Mose amahon apaidal’uva, ‘Vaipo le thutan a kon na tun beh am?’ atipau, hichepa tah hi Pathenin hamboh lah a ahenga hung kilah Vantil ban thahat’a ama ho vaipo le huhdoh din asoltai.

tcz: Mose'n thil kidang le melchihna tamtah pumin Israelte chu Egypt gam'a konin ahinpuidoh in twipisan le gamthip chu kum somli sungin ahung galkaiyun ahi.
en_web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
en_kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin Israelte ahinpuidoh chun Egypt gama jong Twikhanglen san mun le gamthip noiya kum som li sungin thil kidang dang le melchihna tampi anabol’e.

tcz: “Chuin Mose amatah in Israelte koma anaseiyin, Pathen in keima tobang themgaokhat nangholah-a kona asodohsah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
en_kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Mose hi ahiye Israel chate jah a, ‘Pathenin nasopiteu lah a kei tobang Themgao khat natundoh peh diu ahi,’ tia sei chu.

tcz: Mose chu gamthip a ipuluiteu toh Pathen mite kikhop khomna-a anaumkhomin, Sinai Molchunga valtil in thu aseipeh chun, khonunga eiho jouse pehson dingin hinna thu eina lahpeh-uvin ahi.
en_web: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
en_kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
tcz_gospelgo: Gamthip laiya Houbunga anapanga, i-pu i-pateu toh pang khoma Sinai mol’a Vantil toh kihouva, eiho pehson dia hinna Thupeh lapa chu ama hi ahin,

tcz: Ahinlah Ipuluiteu chun Mose thusei anangai pouvin Egypt gam'a kinungle ding ana deijo un ahi.
en_web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
en_kjv: to whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
tcz_gospelgo: i-pu ipateu ama noiya alut nom pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun Egypt lam angai cha jingun,

tcz: Ipuiluiteu chun Aaron koma aseiyun, “Eilamkai thei ding-u pathen lim themkhat neisempeh-un ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona eihin puidoh pau Mose hi iti hitam kahetapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
en_kjv: saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Aaron jah a, ‘Kamasanguva lamkai din Pathen lim tobang ho neisempeh-un, ajeh chu Egypt’a kona eihin puidoh pau hiche Mose chu achunga ipi soh hitam kahetapouve,’ atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuin bongnou toh kilou milim khat asem uvin, hiche milim henga chun kilhaina gantha asemuvin, athilsem uchu akipapi uvin ahi.
en_web: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
en_kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun amahon hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche koma hin kilhaina abol’uvin, akhut’a asemsau thi ho ja nan golnop abol’uve.

tcz: Chuin amahoa konin Pathen akihei mangin, Vana ahsiho chu apathenu hidingin adalhatan ahi! Chuin themgao lekhabun asei “Vo Israel kum somli gamthip'a nathamlaiyuva nahin choiyu kilhaina gantha le thilto ho chu keima henga ding ham?
en_web: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
en_kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathenin akihei mang khumin van’a ahsite hou din amaho chu apehd0h-in, Themgao ho lekhabua kisun bangin: ‘Vo Israel insung mi, kum som li sung gamthip laiya Sa thao le kilhainaa neihou louvu hilou ham?

tcz: Ahipoi, nanghon Molech ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemthu-u chu napole ji bouvui, hijeh a chu nangho Babylon gamsung chana soh-a kasol ding nahiuve,” ati.
en_web: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
en_kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
tcz_gospelgo: Moloch houna ponbuh po leuvin, Rephan ahsi pathen limsemthu napo leuvin Hiche nasemsau thil ho hi houdin nago meu! Hijeh a chu Babylon kal’a katolmang diu nahiuve,’ akiti.

tcz: Ipuluiteu chun gamthip noija chun Houbuh chu anapole un Pathen in Mose henga anamusah lim bang bang chun ana tungdoh ji-un ahi.
en_web: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
en_kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of Witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
tcz_gospelgo: I-pu i-pateuvin gamthip laiya, Alim kigon namu bang bangin ponbuh san,’ tia Mose jah a thusei Pathenin avetsah hettosah na Houbuh chu neiyun,

tcz: Kum phabep jouvin Joshua lamkaina a ipuluiteuvin hiche gam'a kona Pathen in ananodohho khopimun analo-uchun Pathen Houbuh chu anapolut un Leng David khang chanin ana um'in ahi.
en_web: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
en_kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
tcz_gospelgo: hiche hi i-pu i-pateuvin alason’un, Joshua lamkainaa Pathenin i-pu i-pateu masanga chiding namdangte anodoh a amahon gam alo lai geiyun ahinpo lut’uvin, David nikho lai geiyin aume;

tcz: David chu Pathen mitmun deium ana chang'in, aitih a Jacob Pathen chenna ding Houin sahna dingin anathumin ahi.
en_web: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
en_kjv: who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
tcz_gospelgo: David chu Pathen angsunga lungset achanjeh-in Jacob Pathen Inmun amudoh din athume.

tcz: Ahin hiche houin chu Solomon in ana tungdoh in ahi.
en_web: But Solomon built him a house.
en_kjv: But Solomon built him a house.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla in chu Solomonin asahpeh bouve.

tcz: Hijeng jongle hiche khut a kisa houin a chun Chungnungpen Pathen chu achengpoi tin, Themgaovin aseiye.
en_web: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
en_kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinvangin Chungnungpen chu khut’a kisa in’a achengpoi, hichea hin Themgaopan:

tcz: “Van kalaltouna ahin leiset kakengto ngapna ahi, chutobang chenna ding inpha chu neisahpeh thei ding ham?” tin Pakai chun adongin ahi.
en_web: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
en_kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Pakaiyin, “van kalaltouna ahin, Leiset kakengto ngapna ahi; Nangin itobang in neisah peh ding ham? Kacholdo mun ding hoikom ham?

tcz: Van le leiset ania kakhut a kasem hilou ham? tia asei banga chu.
en_web: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
en_kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
tcz_gospelgo: Ijakai Keiman kakhut tah a Kasemsa hilou ham?” tin aseiye,’ ati.

tcz: “Nangho milouchalte, thutah'a dinga alungthim le ana ngong teho, aimatih chana Lhagao Theng nadoudalu hilou ham? Hichu na pului teuvin ana bola nanghon jong nabolu ahi.
en_web: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
en_kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
tcz_gospelgo: “Milou chalet, lungthim le nabeng te nia cheptanlou ho tobang, napu napateu bangin nang hon Lhagao Theng nadoudal jing jengui.

tcz: Napului teuvin ana bolgim lou themgao khat umem? Chondihtah Messiah hungding thu ana sei masaho chu ana that un amatah jong namatsah un na that un ahi.
en_web: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
en_kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateuvin Themgao koipen bolset louva akoiyum? Alhacha Theng hung masanga anaseiphong masa chengse athat’uvin, nang hon tuna ma najoh doh-un nathattauve,

tcz: chule Vantil a kona nalah son u Pathen danthu jeng jong henasa san nanit pouvin ahi,” ati.
en_web: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
en_kjv: who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
tcz_gospelgo: chule Vantiltea kona Danthu kilahsaon nang ho nahiuvin, nit la nanit pouve,” ati.

tcz: Stephen in athemmo nau thu asei chun Judate lamkai ho chu alunghansah lheh jengun chuin amachu akhuttum ajel khumun ahi.
en_web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
en_kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Asei chengse ngaiho chu alungthimu atongkhan athimah cheh-un Stephen chu ha agoikhum cheh-uve,

tcz: Ahin Lhagao Theng dimset'in Stephen chun vanlam aven ahileh Pathen loupina le Yeshua Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna adin chu amun ahi.
en_web: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
en_kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
tcz_gospelgo: Stephen vang chu Lhagao Thengin adim pai jengin, van lah agah vet leh Pathen loupina le Pathen jetlam a Jesu adin amun;

tcz: Chuin aman amahojah a, “Ven vankot akihona chule Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna mihem chapa adin kamui,” ati.
en_web: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
en_kjv: and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, van akihon’a Mihem Chapa chu Pathen jetlama ding kamui!” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon akhut'un anakol akisip-un apengjah un amachu anokhum jengun,
en_web: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
en_kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun amahon hahohin ahoh-uvin anabeng akisip cheh un, ahonjangin adel lut’uvin,

tcz: Khopi pamlanga akaidoh-un songin asep-un, chuin ama themmo chansah hochun avon chu asut-un Saul kiti khangdongpa kengbul'a chun akoiyun ahi.
en_web: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
en_kjv: and cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi polama aleh doh-un songin aseptauve. Ahetoh a pang hon Saul kiti gol-lhang khat kengbul’a aponsil’u akoiyuve.

tcz: Chuin songa asepettah-un Stephen chu ataovin, “Pakai Ka lhagao lan,” ati.
en_web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
en_kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Stephen songa asepet’u chun aman ahin samin, “Pakai Jesu, ka-lhagao lan!” tin aseiye.

tcz: Chuin abohkhup in apengjah jengin, “Pakai abolho jouseu hi amaho chonsetin simpeh hih-in,” atin hiti chu athitan ahi.
en_web: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
en_kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun aboh khup’in going tah-in asamin, “Pakai, hiche chonsetna hi amaho chunga simdan!” ati. Hiche hi aseiyin akijamdap deltai.

tcz: Saul jong chu Stephen kitha amittah a muho lah'a khat ahin, amatah in jong aphatsah ahi. Chuin hiche nikhoa kipat chun Jerusalema Houbung suhmangna dingin suhgentheina lentah ana kipan tan ahile Solchahho tailou tahsan chate jouse chu Judea le Samaria gam'a ana kithe cheh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
en_kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho hin Jerusalema Houbung chunga hesoh gentheina lentah achutan, Solchah ho tilou adangse Judea gam le Samariagama ajamchehsoh heltauve.

tcz: Chuin Pathen a dinga kipumpeh mi themkhat in Stephen chu lunghemtah in ana vuiyun ahi.
en_web: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
en_kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hougut mi phabep’in Stephen chu avuiyun, hakan akauve.

tcz: Ahin Saul chu achelen Houbungho chu ana sugentheiyin, a in tina alut in numei pasal akaidoh in songkul'a anaseplut jin ahi.
en_web: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
en_kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
tcz_gospelgo: Saul vang chun Houbung suhmangna din in tin’a alut’in numei pasal aman’in ajendoh doh jengin songkul’a akhum thu thui.

tcz: Ahinlah akithecheh tahsan chate chun achena lam lam uvah Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu alhangsamle tauvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
en_kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi ajamcheh ho chu avah leuvin Kipana Thupha thu aseiphongin apangjo tauve.

tcz: Vetsahnan, Philip chu Samaria khopi sunga analut in miho koma Messiah chu ana samphong in ahi.
en_web: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
en_kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip jong Samaria khopia achesuh-in miho jah a Messiah chu aseiphongtai.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun Philip thusei chu lungluttah in ana ngai uvin ahi.
en_web: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
en_kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi hon asei chengse ajah uva melchihna abol ho amu phat’un lung khat tah-in Philip thuseiho chu lung lut cheh-in angaiyui.

tcz: Chuin lhagaoboh tampi anodohin ahileh amaho chu apenguvin apotdoh tauvin chule lhangthi le elbai tampi jong aboldam in ahi.
en_web: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
en_kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mi tamtah a konin lhagaoboh ho hapenin apengun ahung potdoh doh jengun, ;angthi ho le elbai ho geiya damdoh dodh jeng ahiuvin,

tcz: Chuin hiche khopi achun kipana lentah alhungtan ahi.
en_web: There was great joy in that city.
en_kjv: And there was great joy in that city.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi sunga chun kipana tampi asohdoh tai.

tcz: Chuin Simon kiti doithemmi khat hiche gam'a chu kumsotpi anauma ahin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria mite chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi.
en_web: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
en_kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi sunga hin amin Simon kiti mitphel doithem khat aumin, Samaria jat mite chu mitpheldoi avetsah a ama le ama i-khat hiya kiseilen lheh ahin,

tcz: Mijouse aneova pat alen changeiyin hichepa chu “Milen khat-Pathen thahat” tia aseiyu ahi.
en_web: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
en_kjv: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hi aneova pat alen geiyin lung lut tah-in athu angaiyun, “hichepa hi pathen tha hat chungnung kiti chu ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chule ama chun adoiya kona phatsottah kidang satah-a anaumsah jeh-u chun amahon aseijouse chu abonchan angai jiuvin ahi.
en_web: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
en_kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
tcz_gospelgo: phat sottah amitpheldoi chu amaho kidang tah a avetsah jingjeh-in lung khat tah-in angai nasauve.

tcz: Ahivangin mipi ho chun Philip in Pathen lenggam thule Yeshua Christa mina thupha asei chu atahsan tauvin, hijeh chun numei-pasal tampi twiyin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
en_kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Philip’in Pathen Lenggam le jesu Christa mina Kipana Thupha aseiphong tahsan chengse chu numei jong pasal jong baptize achansahtai.

tcz: Hichun Simon jengin jong atahsan in twiyin baptize achangtan, chule Philip chena chana anung ajuitan, Philip in melchihna le thil kidang lentah tampi abol chu kidang asalheh jengin ahi.
en_web: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
en_kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
tcz_gospelgo: Simon amatah jengin jong atahsanin, baptize achan jouvin Philip toh akiloiyin, melchihna le tha neina nasatah tah a thil kidang abol ho amu leh adatmo lheh jengin ahi.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria miten Pathen thu asang tauve ti ajah phat'un Peter le John chu asol tauvin ahi.
en_web: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
en_kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria khopin jong Pathen thu akisantauve, ti ajah phat’un ahenguva Peter le John asolpeh-un,

tcz: Chuin alhun lhun lhonin hiche tahsan thahho chu Lhagao Theng achanna dingun atao tauvin ahi.
en_web: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
en_kjv: who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
tcz_gospelgo: amani ahung suh lhonin amaho chu Lhagao theng achan theina diuvin ataopeh lhone;

tcz: Chule tahsan thahho chunga chu Lhagao Theng hungloulai ahi, ajeh chu amaho chu Yeshua mina bou baptize chang nalaiyu ahi.
en_web: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: (for as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pakai Jesu min’a baptize chang bep ahinalaiyun, alah-uva khat beh jong Lhagao Theng chang loulai ahi.

tcz: Chuin Peter le John in hiche tahsan thahho chunga chu khut angap lhona ahileh amaho chu Lhagao Theng achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Chunin Peter le Johnin achunguva khut a-ngap lhon leh Lhagao Theng achang tauve.

tcz: Chuin Simon in Solchahho khutngap jeh a miho Lhagao Theng achanu chu amun ahileh aman jong sum peha hiche thahat chu kichoh ding agon,
en_web: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
en_kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah te ni khut ngap’a kona Lhgao Theng kipeh chu Simonin amun amani chu sumapen,

tcz: “Kenjong hiche thaneina hi neijing kate chutile kenjong miho chunga khut kangap teng amaho jong Lhagao Theng chang dingu ahi!” ati.
en_web: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
en_kjv: saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

tcz: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Nasum le nangma suhmangin umtha tan ajeh chun Pathen thilpeh hi chohtho dingin nangaitoi,
en_web: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
en_kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Peterin ajah a, “Nasumle nangma manthan, Pathen thilpeh suma chohjou dol’in nagel’in ahi!

tcz: Hichea hin nangman chan naneipoi, ajeh chu Pathen mitmun nalungthim adihpoi.
en_web: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
en_kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen maiya nalungthimput adih loujeh-in hiche thua hin namu jong aumpon, chan jong naneipoi.

tcz: Hijeh chun nachonset lungheiyin lang, Pakai henga tao lechun aman nachonset lungput angaidam maithei ahi.
en_web: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
en_kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun hiche nathilse gel’a kon hin lung heiyin, nalungthima hitobang nagel hi angaidam theina din Pakai henga taovin.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma hi thangthipna a dimset leh chonset'a kihen-oh nahi kamuchen tai,” ati
en_web: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
en_kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile cheikha khaveng vung banga kha adih louva kihen nahi kamui,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Simon chun Peter koma, “Hitobang kichat umtah naseiho hi kachunga alhun lou nadingin Pakai koma nei taopeh in,” ati.
en_web: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
en_kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Simonin adonbut’in, “Nasei chengse hi khatcha kachunga achuh louna din nangmin Pakai henga kei khel’in neitaopeh lhonin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Samaria-a Photchet nale Pathen thu lhangsapna aneijou lhon chun, Peter le John chu Jerusalem jonin ahung kile lhon in Samaria kho muntampi ah ahung kibangpa lhonin Kipana thupha ahin lhangsam peh lhonin ahi.
en_web: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
en_kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
tcz_gospelgo: Peter le Johnin Pakai thu ahettosah lhona aseisoh phat lhonin Jerusalema ahung kile kit lhonin, Samaria miho kho tamtah a Kipana Thupha asei phong peh lhone.

tcz: Philip vang chu Pakai vantil, “Lhanglam a Jerusalem a pat Gaza jotna gamthip'a chesuh lampi a khun chetan,” atipeh in ahi.
en_web: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
en_kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in Philip jah a thu aseiyin, “Kipatdoh-in lang Jerusalema kona Gaza jotna lamlena khun lhanglama chesuh temin,” ati; alam len chu donlouva kikoithip ahitai.

tcz: Chuin akipatdoh in achesuh tan ahileh Ethiopia gouching mikhat akimupin, ama chu Ethiopia lengnu noiya natong lentah nukiso ahin, hiche nukiso chu Jerusalema Pathen houva che ahi.
en_web: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
en_kjv: And he arose and went: and behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
tcz_gospelgo: Philip jong akipat’in acheleh ven, Ethiopia mi nukiso, Ethiopia lengnu Candace Semangpa, agou chengse chunga vaihom, Jerusalema Pathen hou dia ‘hung,

tcz: Chule ahung kile lama kangtalaiya hungtouva Isaiah themgao lekhabu hi gingtah-a ahin sim ahi.
en_web: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
en_kjv: was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: akile kit lamin akangtalai chunga atounaa Isaiah Themgao lekhabua asim’e.

tcz: Chuin Lhagao Theng in Philip henga chun ahin seiyin, “Chenlang Kangtalaiya khun kilhon khom lhonin,” ati.
en_web: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
en_kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Lhagaovin Philip jah a, “Chen lang hiche kangtalai khu lhonpin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Philip chun aheng anaiyin ahileh mipan Isaiah themgao lekhabu asim chu ajan, hichun Philip in adongin “Nasim chu ipi kiseina ahi nahet nah em?” atile,
en_web: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
en_kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Philip alhailut jeng leh Isaiah themgao lekhabu asimgin ajan, hichun, “Nasim chu nahet hinai?’ atileh;

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Eihil ding mikhat aum loule iti kahet ding ham?” atin ahi. Chuin mipa chun Philip chu akouvin hungin lang kangtalaiya toukhom hite ati.
en_web: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
en_kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
tcz_gospelgo: aman, “Hoiya, mikhattouvin eihilchet lou leh iti kahet ding ham?” atin, Philip chu hung ‘kaldoh a amatoh toukhom din agah kouve.

tcz: Chule Pathen lekhabu sunga asimmun chu hiche hi ahi, “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi nou bangin akaiyun, kelngoinou amul vouho angsunga thipbeh cha-a aum bangin, ama jong akam keh pon ahi.
en_web: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
en_kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Pathen lekhabu asimna laimun chu hiche hi ahi: “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi bang le Kelngao nou amulvoupa ang’a paopoh lou bangin kam cheng khat jong keh louvin aum’e.

tcz: Akineosahna lamin achunga adih a thutanna aumtapon, koipen'in akhang thusim asei ding hitam? Ijeh inem itile a hinkho chu leiset'a kona alahdoh'u ahitai.”
en_web: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
en_kjv: in his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kineosahnaa thu adih-in atanpeh pouvin, Ama khaggui hi kon asei ding hitam?Ajeh chu leiset’a kona ahinkho kiladoh ahitai,” kiti lai ahi.

tcz: Chuin nukiso chun Philip chu adongin, “Themgaopa hin ama chung chang thudol asei ham ahiloule midang khat thudol asei ham nei seipeh in,” atin ahi.
en_web: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
en_kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
tcz_gospelgo: Nukisopan Philip agah houvin, “Neihil chen temin, Themgaopan ama chung chang thua ha, midang khattou thua hiche hi asei ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin in Philip jong chuche Pathen lekhabu muna kona pansa in Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu aseipeh pantan ahi.
en_web: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
en_kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

tcz: Chuin ache che lhonin ahile twi umna khat ahin phah hon phatin Nukiso chun, “Ven! Hikoma khun twi aume! Baptize kachanmo nading ipi um'em?” ati.
en_web: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
en_kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
tcz_gospelgo: Lampia ahung kijot jot lhon leh twi veina khat’a ahung lhonin, nukisopan agah houvin, “Ven twihi, baptize kachanmona ding ipi um am?” atileh;

tcz: Chuin akangtalai lhon chu akham lhonin, twi lah'a chun akumsuh lhonin Philip in ama chu baptize achansah tan ahi.
en_web: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
en_kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin nukisopan kangtalai chu angah din aseiyin, anilhonin akumlha lhonin twi lah a chun Philip le nukisopa alut lhonin, Philip’in nukisopa chu baptize achansah tai.

tcz: Chuin twi lah-a kona ahung potdoh lhon chun Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alamang tan ahile, nukiso chun Philip chu amupha tapon, ahin alampi a chun kipah thanom tah'in achetan ahi.
en_web: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
en_kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
tcz_gospelgo: Twi lah a kona ahungkaldoh phat lhonin Pakaiya kon Lhagaovin Philip chu alhoh mangin nukisopan amukit tapon, ahivangin ache na lampia kipah tah-in achepaitai.

tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Philip chu Azotus khopia akimudoh-in, chule aman Caesatea alhun kahsen achepeh-in Kipana Thupha asei phongpeh-e.

en_kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

en_web: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ama tol’a akileh lhan, ogin khat’in ajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a nangin neibol set set ham?” ati.

en_web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
en_kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla aman, “Vo Pakai nang koi nahim?” atileh; Aman, “Keima nabolset jing Jesu chu kahi;

tcz: Tun kipatdoh in khopi sunga khun lut-in nabol ding ho nakiseipeh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
en_kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongleh kipatdoh-in lang khopi sunga khun lut’in, chuteng ipi nabol ding kiseipeh nan nate,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Saul toh kilhon khom ho chu paopoh loubeh-in aum tauvin ahi, ajehchu Saul koma thusei aw chu ajauvin ahin koima la amu pouvin ahi.
en_web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
en_kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhonpi miho chu paopoh uhsa beihel’in adding thip chet’un, ogin chu aja nauvin koima amupouve.

tcz: Chuin Saul chu tol'a kona ahung dindoh-a amit ahasah-le kho amutapon hijeh chun alhonkhompi hon akhut-in akaiyun Damascus khopi sung alut tauvin ahi.
en_web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
en_kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
tcz_gospelgo: Saul chu tol’a konin ahung ding doh-in amit te ni ahasah vangin imacha amutapon, hijeh chun mihon akhut’in akaiyun Damascus khosunga apuilut tauve.

tcz: Chuin khopi sunga chun nithum sungin an nelou twidon louvin aumden tan ahi.
en_web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
en_kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
tcz_gospelgo: Nithum sungin khomu louvin aumtan, nelou donlouvin aumtai.

tcz: Chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan mikhat amin Ananias kitipa chu Pakaiyin akimusah in “Ananias!” tin akouvin ahileh amapan, “Hikoma kaumnai Pakai!” atin ahi.
en_web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
en_kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Damascus khopia hin amin Ananias kiti seijui khat aumin, Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa Pakaiyin ajah a, “Ananias,” atileh; aman, “Ven Pakai ka-um’e,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in “Namasanga lampi jangkeiya khun chenlang Judas in'a khun galut tan, chule insunga khu nalut tengle Tarsus gammi Saul kitipa chu gahol tan ajeh chu ama kahenga ataopettah ahi.
en_web: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
en_kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for behold, he prayeth,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pakaiyin ajah a, “Kipat’in lang, ‘Lamjangpet kiti khosung lamlen khu jonin, Judas in’a tarsua a lungkon Sual kitipa chu gaholin; ven, ama ataopet ahin,

tcz: Chule hichepa khun Ananias kiti mikhat ahenga hunga aluchunga khut angap'a chutengle kho amukit ding khu kamusah ahi,” ati.
en_web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
en_kjv: and hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: aman Themgao thilmua mu aneina Ananias kiti mikhat hunga kho amukit theina dia achunga khut a-ngap ding amui’,’ ati.

tcz: Ahivangin Ananias in adonbut in “Pakai hiche mipa hin Jerusalema tahsan chate kichat umtah-a abol genthei thu mitam tah-a kona kajah ahitai,
en_web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Ananias chun adonbut’in, “Pakai, hiche mipa thudol itobang tah aJerusalema name thengte ijat’a abolset hitam, ti mi tamtah a kona kijataa;

tcz: chule hoilai mun hijong le nangma min kouho jouse amat a songkul'a akhum thei nadinga thempu pipuihon thaneina apeh'u ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
en_kjv: and here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
tcz_gospelgo: chule hichea nangma min pan’a tao jouse jong matna ding Thempu pipu hoa kona thu neina anei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Chen ajeh chu Saul khu chidang namdangte le lengho chuleh Israelte henga kathu lhangsam dinga kalhendoh ahitai,
en_web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
en_kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pakaiyin ajah a, “Chen, ama hi namdangte le leng ho, chule Israel chate angsunga kamin po le dia manchah a kalhen ahi;

tcz: Chule tua hi kamin jal'a itobang genthei athoh ding ham kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
en_kjv: for I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile Keima min jal’a ijatvei hesoh genthei athoh ding jong kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Ananias chu achen ahileh Saul chu amutan hichun aluchunga akhut angamin aseitai, “Sopi Saul, kho namukit nading le Lhagao Thenga nadimsetna dinga lampia nakimusah Pakai Yeshua chun nahenga eihin sol ahi,” ati.
en_web: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
en_kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ananias chu achen insunga alut’in Saul chunga khut a-ngamin, Sopi Saul, Pakai, Lampia nahenga hung kilah Jesu chunk ho namukit theiya Lhagao Theng nadimsetna dinga eihinsol ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin apettah chun lip tobang thilkhat Saul mit a kon chun ahung kilehlhan ahileh Saul chun kho amutan ahi. Chutah chun Saul chu akipatdoh in baptize achangtan ahi.
en_web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
en_kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized,
tcz_gospelgo: Apettah chun amit te nia konin nga lip tobang ahung lup lhan ahileh kho amukittan, chuin akipatdoh-in baptize achangin,

tcz: Chujouvin Saul chun an themkhat anen ahileh athahatdoh kit tan, chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan chate koma chun nikho phabep aum den tan ahi.
en_web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
en_kjv: and when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
tcz_gospelgo: an aneh le atha akilt kittai.

tcz: Chule apettah chun Yeshua thudol chu asamphong pantan kikhopna in tin'ah, “Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahi,” tin asamle tan ahi.
en_web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
en_kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: apet pet chun Houthua kikhopna in dung jousea Jesu kiti hichepa chu Pathen Chapa ahi, tin asamle tai.

tcz: Chuin athu lhangsap japha jousen kidang asauvin, “Hichepa hi Jerusalema Yeshua seijuiho suhmang ding gopa chu hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi. Chule “Hikoma hi seijuiho man dingle kanchoma thempu ho henga kaidinga hung hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi
en_web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
en_kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin asei japha chanin adatmo lheh jengun, “Jerusalema hiche min’a tao jouse subei hei hoi chu hichepa hi hilou hiya, chule amaho chu kanchom’a thempu pipuho henga akailut theina dinga hung hilou ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Saul thulhangsap chu ahung thahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahileh Damascus khopia um Juda mite chun Yeshua chu Messiah ahi ti avetsahna apeh ho chu anel jou tapouvin ahi.
en_web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
en_kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Saul chu asei ahattou tel tul tan, Jesu chu Messiah ahimongtai, tin Damascus khopia Juda ho chu anelkhupsoh keiye.

tcz: Chuche phat chomkhat jou chun Judah mite phabep khat ahung khomun ama chu thading agouvin,
en_web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
en_kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho sot thimpi nungin Saul that din Juda ho akihousom’un,

tcz_gospelgo: athilgonu hi Saul’in ahedohtai. Saul thana din khopi dongkot jouse asun ajanin a-ngah-un,

tcz: Hijeh chun seijuiho mi phabep khat chun jankah in Saul chu boma akhumun khopi bang onglai khat'ah khaovin akhai lha tauvin ahi.
en_web: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
en_kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
tcz_gospelgo: ahivangin janin aseijuiten pollanga akhumun kulpi pang’a akhai lhatauve.

tcz: Chuin Saul chu Jerusalem ahung lhunin, seijuiho kimupi ding agon ahileh amaho abonun akichauvin ahi ajeh chu seijui dihtah ahiding chu atahsan lou-u ahi!
en_web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
en_kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalema ahung phat’in seijuite toh kiloikhom ding agon, ahinla amahon Saul chu seijui khat hi dia atahsan lou jeh-un akichauve.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas chun Saul chu solchah ho henga apuilut in Damascus lampia Saul in Pakai akimupi thule Pakaiyin Saul henga asei thuho abonchan solchah ho henga aseipeh in chule Damascus khopia Saul in Yeshua mina hangsan tah-a thu asei jong chu aseipeh in ahi.
en_web: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
en_kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Barnabas-in Paul solchah ho henga apuiyin, ajahuva itobanga lampia chu Pakaiamu’a, Pakaiyin ajah a thu aseiya, chule Damascus khopia chu aman itobang tah a hangsan’a Jesu min’a thu asei ahilchentai.

tcz: Chuin Greek pao tho Juda te toh akinil un ahile Juda miho chun thading agouvin ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Greek chon’a chon Juda ho akihoupin akinel pin, hi jeh chun tha din agot lotauve.

tcz: Seijui hon chuche thu ajah phat'un Caesarea lama apuisuh un achenna Tarsus lama asol mang tauvin ahi.
en_web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
en_kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla sopiten ahetdoh phat’un Saul chu Caesarea ahinpuisuh-un Tarsus lama asolmang tauve.

tcz: Chuin Judea gam le Galilee gamsung chule Samaria gamsung pumpia Houbung chu mongtah-in aumtauvin chule seijui hon Pakai agin jeh'u chun athahat cheh cheh uvin ahi. Chule Lhagao Theng in aumpi jeh-u chun seijui jong akibe jingin ahi.
en_web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Judea le Galilee chule Samaria gam pumpi Houbunga vang chamna alengtan, akiphut det cheh cheh-in, Pakai gingin aumin, Lhagao Thengin lhamonin, panpin amija apungtel tul’e.

tcz: Chujongle Peter chu munkhat a konin munkhat ah avahle len chuin Lydda khopia seijui ho vilding in ahung kumsuh in ahile,
en_web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
tcz_gospelgo: Peter chu gamtin’a ava le naa Lydda a mithengte heng geiyin ahungtai.

tcz: Hikoma chun Aeneas kiti mikhat langthi-a kumget jen jalkhun a lumpa chu agamudoh tan,

tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chun Aeneas kiti mi khat amudoh-in, ama chu langthia kum get jen jalkhun’a kijam ahi.

en_web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

tcz_gospelgo: Amapa jah a hin Peterin, “Aeneas Jesu christen nadamsah ahitai, kipatdoh-in lang nalupna kigot’in,” atileh; ama akipatdoh pai jenge.

tcz: Chuin Lydda le Sharon khopi sunga mijouse chun Aeneas in lam ajot-a avale chu amu-uvin, abonchauvin Pakai lamah ahung kihei tauvin ahi.
en_web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

tcz_gospelgo: Hichu Lydda le Sharon a cheng jousen amu’vin Pakai lama akiheisoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Joppa atiu mun a chun seijui mikhat Tabitha (Greek paova Dorcas) atiu chu aumin, amanu chun midang dingin thilpha abol jingin, genthei ho akithopi jingin ahi.
en_web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
en_kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung dammo in athitan ahileh atahsa chu asiltheng-uvin vuidingin indan chungnunga chun alupsah tauvin ahi.
en_web: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche lai hin amanu anan athitai; mihon asil jou phat’uvin indan chungnunga alupsahui.

tcz: Ahivangin seijuiho chun Peter chu Lydda koma aume tithu ajauvin hijeh chun mini asol-uvin, Peter henga “Lungset tah-in aganna thei penin hungin,” tin aga kousah tauvin ahi.
en_web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
en_kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
tcz_gospelgo: Lydda hi Joppa komcha ahijeh-in seijuihon Peter Joppa aum ahet phat’uvin mi ni asol’un, “Lungset’in kinomsot louhel’in kahenguva hung jengin,” tin aga ngehsah-uve.

tcz: Chuin Peter chu akouva cheteni chutoh ahung kile khomin ahileh ahung lhun lhun chun amahon Peter chu indan chungnunga chun apuitouvun ahileh insunga chun meithai ho adimset uvin kap pumin a sangkhol hou-le von dang Dorcas in adam laiya anabolpeh houchu avetsah'un ahi.
en_web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

tcz_gospelgo: Amahon, “Sepai jalamkai Cornelius, midih le Pathen ging, Juda vaipi seiphat mi chun nangma a-in’a kousah a nathusei ngai dia Vantil Thengin ahil ahi,” atiuve.

en_web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
en_kjv: not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: japi heng ahilou vangin Pathenin hettohsah a pang dia alhentum keiho heng ahin; hiti chun thinaa kona athodoh nungin Amatoh kanekhom kadon khom’uve;

tcz: Chule Yeshua chu mihing le mithi ho jouse thutan ahi ti thudol hi hille ding le hettoh sah dinga keiho hi thu eipeh-u ahi.
en_web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
en_kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
tcz_gospelgo: chule mipi henga Ama hi Pathenin mihing le mithi thutan dinga atun ahitai ti kasap leuva kahettohsah diuvin eithu lhah-uve.

tcz: Ama tahsan ho jouse Amin jal a achonset nau kingaidam ding ahi tia themgao ho jousen ahettoh sah-u chu ama chu ahi,” ati.
en_web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
en_kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Themgao jousen Ama thudol ahttohsah-u ahin, koi hileh Ama tahsan jouse chu Ama min jal’a chonset ngaidamna amu ding aseiyui,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Peter in thu hicheng asei jing laiyin athu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung chutan ahile,
en_web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
en_kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
tcz_gospelgo: Peterin hiche hi asei nalaiyin thu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng achutai.

tcz: Peter toh hung khom Judah mi atahsan ho chun chidang namdang te chunga jong Lhagao Theng akipeh chu kidang asalheh jengun ahi.
en_web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
en_kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdang ho chung geiya Lhagao Theng kipe akibuh khum jeng chu Peter toh hung lhon cheptan mi atahsan loiyin adatmo lheh jenguve.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itile amahon paochom paochoma thu aseiyuva Pathen avahchoi uchu ajah-u ahi.
en_web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
en_kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile paochom chom thoa Pathen avahchoiyu chu ajah-u ahi. Chutah chun Peterin adonbut’in,

tcz: Chuin Peter in adong un, “Eiho banga Lhagao Theng changa hiteho baptize chanlouna dinga twi kham theiya koi umam?” ati.
en_web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
en_kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
tcz_gospelgo: “Eiho chan banga Lhagao Theng changtaa hite ho Baptize channa ding twi kham theididng koiham?”

tcz: Chuin aman Yeshua Christa mina baptize chang dingin amaho chu thu apetan, chujouvin Cornelius in amaho henga nikho phabep um ding'in alhotan ahi.
en_web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
en_kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun amaho chu Jesu Christa min a baptize chang din aseitai. Amahon Peter chu niphabep beh nichong dingin alhoutauve.

tcz: Chidang namdang ten Pathen thu akisan thu chu Judah gam'a um solchahho le seijui dangho henga gangtah in alhung tan;
en_web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
en_kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
tcz_gospelgo: solchah ho le Judea gamsunga sopiten chiding namdangten jong Pathen thu akisanu hi ajatauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Peter Jerusalem ahung lelhun phat in Judahmi atahsanho chun ana oimo un;
en_web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
en_kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
tcz_gospelgo: Peter Jerusalema agalhun touleh cheptan loiyin ama ana oimouvin,

tcz: “Chidang namdang te insunga nalut in chule an jong naga neh khompie,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
en_kjv: saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ibol’a cheptan lou miho henga chea an nehkhompi nahim?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho heng-ah thilsoh jouse kicheh tah-in aseipeh in hitin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
en_kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Peter akipanin aban chan ajah-uvah aseipeh-in,

tcz: “Keima Joppa khopia kauma katao jing laiyin gaochangin mu kaneiyin, lekha pheng lentah tobang aning lin vana konin ahung kikhai lhan, keima komtah ahung geiyin;
en_web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
en_kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
tcz_gospelgo: “Joppa khopia katao leh gao kachangin, Thengao thilmua mu kanei na-a thilpheng hep hop khat van’a kona aninglia hung kikhai lhaa, keima komcha hung ki-nga kamun,

tcz: Chuin keiman hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sung chu kaven ahileh leiset chunga umsa akengli hole gamsa chule aop a kithol le chunga leng vacha kamun,
en_web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
en_kjv: upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
tcz_gospelgo: phatecha kavet chenset leh neh thei ganhing nam kim, chunga leng vachate kamui.

tcz: Chuin vana kona awgin khat kajan ‘Peter thoudoh inlang kitha inlang nen’” ati.
en_web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
en_kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ogin khat hin kajah a, ‘Peter, kipat’in that’in lang nen, ati kajai.

tcz: Ahipoi Pakai, keiho Judah te chona danin aboh le athenglou tia asei jouse imacha kane khapoi kati.
en_web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
en_kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla keiman, ‘Hithei hih hel’inte Pakai, thilboh le atheng lou imacha kakamsunga lut kha louhel ahi,’ kati.

tcz: “Ahin vana kona awgin chun avelin ahin seikit in, ‘Pathen in asuhthengsa thilkhat chu athenglou tihih in,’” ati.
en_web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
en_kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin ogin chun van’a konin nivei chan nan eihindohbut’in, ‘Pathenin asuh thengsa chu bohsa hih-in, eiti.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu thumveijen kijomin eimusah in chujouvin abonchan vana akikhai tou kit tan ahi.
en_web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
en_kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin thumvei ahung kibol’in van’a akitol toutai.

tcz: Chutah chun Caesarea a kona mithum hung kisol ho chu kaum nau inmun ahung lhung paiyun ahi.
en_web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
en_kjv: And behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cesarea unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ven, hichepet tah ahi Caesarea kona kahenga hung kisol mi thum chu kalhunna in maiya ana ding tauve.

tcz: Chuin Lhagao Theng in kahenga ahin seiyin amaho chutoh kilhon'a chule amaho chidang namdang ahijeh'a ima lungthoina neilou dingin ahin seiyin ahi. Chuin sopi migup chun ei kilhonpiuvin gangtah in ahin solpau in chu kaga lhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
en_kjv: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaovin ma lung sa-ih louhel’a amaho chutoh lhona kache din eiseipeh-e. Hicheng sopi gup ho jong hin eilhonpuiuvin, mipa insunga chun kaluttauve.

tcz: Chuin amapa chun thilsoh umchan jouse chu keiho henga chun aseiyin, ahenga vantil akilah-a Joppa a mi solin lang Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan,
en_web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
en_kjv: and he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
tcz_gospelgo: Mipa chun kajah-uva a-in a Vantil ding amun, ‘Joppa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gakousahtan,

tcz: Chutengle aman nang le na insungmi te jouse huhhing nathu naseipeh ding ahi! ati.
en_web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
en_kjv: who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: aman nang le na-insung pumpi huhhinga naum na diu Thupha naseipeh dingu ahi,’ ati thu aseitai.

tcz: Chuin Peter chun aseikit in, “Thusei kahinpan in ahileh abul'a eiho chunga ahung kibuh lhah bangin ama ho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung kibunglhan,
en_web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
en_kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajahuva thusei kagah kipat panbep leh abul’a eiho chunga achuh bang chun amaho chunga jong Lhagao Theng achutai.

tcz: Chun Pakaiyin ‘John in twiya baptize achansah ahin ahinlah nangman Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dinga ahi’ tia Pakai thusei chu kalunga ahung kilang in ahi.
en_web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
en_kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kenjong Pakaiyin, ‘Johnin twiya baptize achansah ahin, nang ho vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi,’ ati chu kageldoh-e.

tcz: Chule eihon Pakai Yeshua Christa itahsan nikhouva Pathen in eipeh-u Lhagao Theng chu chidang namdang te jong apeh ahitah le kei chu koi kahi-a Pathen masanga kadin ding ham?” atin ahi.
en_web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
en_kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
tcz_gospelgo: Chutia Pathenin Pakai Jesu christa itahsanuva eipeh-u thilpeh tobang chu amaho jong apeh leh, kei koi kahiya Pathen kakham thei ding ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin midang hon chuche thu chu ajah phat-un athip tauvin Pathen avahchoi tauvin ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun, “Pathen in chidang namdang tedinga jong chonset lunghei nading le tonsot hina akisan thei nadinguva phatpha apeh hi imu tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
