en_kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon hiche hi ajah phat’un aneldauvin, Pathen avahchoiyun, “Ahile Pathenin chiding namdang te jong hinna dia lung heina apeh ahita ong!” atiuve.

tcz: Alangkhat ah Stephen thijouva seijuiho kibol gentheina jeh a jamcheh ho chu Phoenicia, Cyprus le Syria gam'a Antioch changeiyin ajamun, chule Judah te henga bou Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
en_web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
en_kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
tcz_gospelgo: Thoh hahsa asoa Stephen kitha lo jeh a jamcheh chengse chu Phoenicia le Cyprus chule Antioch geiyin acheuvin, koima dang jah a seilouvin Judate henga Thu chu aseileuve.

tcz: Hijeng jongle Cyprus le Cyrene gam'a kona Antioch khopia che seijui phabep ho chun chidang namdang te henga Pakai Yeshua thu alhangsam uvin ahi.
en_web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
en_kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin alah-uva phabep Cyprus le Cyrene miho, Antioch ahung lhun phat’un Greek miho toh akihouvun Pakai Jesu aseiphongtauve.

tcz: Pakai thahatna amaho chunga aumjeh chun chidang namdang te laha mitam tah in Pakai lama lung aheiyun atahsan tauvin ahi.
en_web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
en_kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu Pakaiyin aban thahat’in ahu jingun, hijeh chun Pakaiya atahsan mitamtah akihei luttauve.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalema Houbung in hiche thu ajah phat-un Barnabas chu Antioch'a asol tauvin ahile,
en_web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
en_kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hi Jerusalema Houbungin ajatan, hijeh chun Barnabas chu Antioch geiyin asol’un,

tcz: Amun alhun phat in Pathen phatthei bohna chu amun akipah lheh jengin hichun aman seijui ho chu Pakaiya dihtah-a umjing dingin atilkhouvin ahi.
en_web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
en_kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: ama ahungleh Pathenin alungset nau amun akipah lheh jengin, ama ho chu Pakaiya lunggil tah a um chah jing din atilkhouvin ahi;

tcz: Ajeh chu Barnabas chu miphatah Lhagao Thenga dimjing le Tahsanna a dettah mi ahin, mitam tah Pakaiyah ahin puilutbe uvin ahi.
en_web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
en_kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh ch Barnabs hi mipha le Lhagao Theng dimset chule tahsan det mi ahi. Mi tampi Pakaiya alutbe tauve.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas chu Tarsus lama Saul hol dingin ana chepai tan ahi.
en_web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
en_kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
tcz_gospelgo: Barnabas chu Saul hol din Tarsus a achen,

tcz: Chuin amu phat-in Antioch lama ahin nungpui kit in amani Antioch houbunga chun kumlhung keiyin aumden lhonin mipi tamtah ahiljing lhonin ahi. Hiche Antioch'a hi seijui ho Christian tia akou masat penu ahi.
en_web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
en_kjv: and when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people, and the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
tcz_gospelgo: Saul amudoh phat’in Antioch a ahinpuiye. Kum khat lhingset amanin miho chu Houbunga akikhoppi ji lhonin, mi tampi ahil lhonin, hiche Antioch khoa hi seijuite chu ‘Chritian’ ahinsah masah pen’u ahi.

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin themgao phabep Jerusalema kon Antioch'a acheuvin,
en_web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
en_kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin Themgao phabep Jerusalema konin Antioch a achesuh-ui;

tcz: Amaho lah'a Agabus atiu themgaopa chu kikhop khomna khat'a ading doh in lhagaovin Rome gamsung pumpia kel nasatah hunglhung ding ahi tin aphondoh sah tan ahi (Hiche gaothu hi Claudius vaipoh laiyin aguilhung in ahi).
en_web: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
en_kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cesar.
tcz_gospelgo: chuin alah-uva amin Agabus kitipa chu akipatdoh-in Lhagao thahat’in vannoi pumpia kel lhah ding asei masan, hiche hi Claudius nikho laiyin aguilhunge.

tcz: Chuin Antioch'a um seijui ho chun Judah gam'a um sopi hoa dinga kithopina thot dingin agel lha tauvin ahile abonchauvin atamthei penin atohkhom tauvin ahi.
en_web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
en_kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judea:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun seijuite chu ajikham cheh a thil tokhoma Judea gama sopite thot dingin akiloltauve;

tcz: Chuin hiche athil tokhomu chu Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema Houbung upa ho khut a apehlut lhon dingin nganse na anei tauvin ahi.
en_web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
en_kjv: which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
tcz_gospelgo: adongkhom’un Barnabas le Saul khut’ah Houbung upate agah thot’ui.

tcz: Chuin hiche phatlai chun Leng Herod Agrippa chun Houbung sunga seijui phabep ho chu ahin sugim pan tan ahi.
en_web: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
en_kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin Herod lengpan Houbung mi konkhat chunga ban-gol khautah-inna atongin abolsetai.

tcz: Chuti chun John sopipa solchah Jacob chu chemjamin ana thattan ahi.
en_web: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
en_kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
tcz_gospelgo: John upa Jacob chu chemjamin athattai.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hin Judah te akipahsah chu Herod in amu phat in Peter jong chu aman in, (Hiche thilsoh hi Kalchuh Kut kimanlai ahi).
en_web: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
en_kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
tcz_gospelgo: Amitha hin Juda miho along lhaisah amun, Peter jong amatbe kit’e, aphat hi cholsolou changlhah kut lai ahiye.

tcz: Chuin ama chu Songkul'a akhum tan angah dingin Sepai lili a kiloikhom loili akoiyin ahi. Herod in Kalchuh Kut kichai tengle mipi anga Peter chu dinsah dinga lung angaito ahi.
en_web: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
en_kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Peter amat chun songkul’a akhumin, mi li lia kiloi sepaiho chun kilhauva a-nga diduvin apedoh-in, kalchuh ku tkichai tang mipi ang’a puidoh dingin agoi.

tcz: Ahin Peter songkul'a aum phat chun Houbung mite chu lunglut tah in ama dingin atao tauvin ahi.
en_web: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
en_kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin songkul’a akhumtan, ahinla Houbungin ama din lung luttah-in Pathen henga ataopeh-uve.

tcz: Chuin mipi anga dinsah dinga agot jan chun Peter chu sepai ni kikah a thihkhao ni a kihena ihmu ahin; angah ho jong chu kotbula ding'ah ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
en_kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod-in Peter chu puidoh dinga agotin jan chun Peter, a-ngah sepaite kah a a-ihmun, thih khao nin akihenin, kotpi bul’a jong a-ngah a pang sepaiho adding jingui.

tcz: Chuin hetmanlou kah in vah hattah khat in aumna mun chu ahin salvah in chule Pakai vantil chu Peter angsunga ahung dingin, chuin Vantil chun Peter pangpeh abengin “Thoudoh loiyin,” tin asukhang tan ahile akihenna thih khao jong chu akilham tan ahi.
en_web: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
en_kjv: And behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ven, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat ahung kilah-in, akikhumna bom sung avahcahnsel’e; Vantil chun Peter pang abengin asukhangin, “kipatdoh loiyin!” ati. Chutah chun akhut te nia akihenna thih khao te ni chu akilhamtai.

tcz: Chuin Vantil chun Peter jah-a “Kivondoh loiyin lang na kengchot kisen,” asei bangin Peter in aboltan ahile Vantil chun “Napon kisil in lang kanung hinjui jin,” tin thu apetan ahi.
en_web: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
en_kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Vantil chun ajah a, “Nakong kigahin nakengchot te ni kise loiyin,” ati. Aman chutin aboltai. Chuin ajaha, “Naponin kihiutup loiyin neihin juiyin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Peter in aumna mun chu adalhan Vantil nung chu ajui tan ahi. Ahin Peter in thilsoh jouse chu gaochanga munei bangin akigelin atah tah ahilam ahedoh pon ahi.
en_web: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
en_kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
tcz_gospelgo: Peter apotdoh-in ama chu ajuitai; hichea chun Vantil thilbol chu atahbeh a soh-in agelpon, gaochanga mu aneiyin agelbouve.

tcz: Chuin amanin kot ngah masa le anina akhel phat lhonin khopi sung lam jotna a thih kot phung chu agei lhonin, kot chu amani dingin achamin akihong jengin, chuin amani achedoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajot lhung lhonin ahile, hichun Vantil chun ama adalha pai tan ahi.
en_web: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
en_kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil le Peter chun kotngah masa le ani na akhel lhon leh khopi sung lutna thih kotkha apha lhonin, kotkhah chu ama ni dingin acham tah-in akihong jengin, apotdoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajui lhonleh Vantil chung Peter adalhapaitai.

tcz: Chuin Peter in kho ahin hedoh tan, “Thilsoh chu atah ahi! Pakaiyin a Vantil ahin solin Herod lengpa leh Judah lamkai hon kachunga abolgot'u thilsea konin eihuh doh-e,” ati.
en_web: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
en_kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: hichun Peter akhangdoh lap’in “Tua vang Pakaiyin avantil ahinsol’a Herod ban thahat le Judate kinepna chengsea eihuhdoh ahitai, ti kahedoh tai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin aman thilsoh ho ahin hetdoh phat in John Mark nu Mary in'a achetan ahile mitam tah ana taokhomun,
en_web: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
en_kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahetdoh phat hin Peter chu aminchom Mark kiti John nu Mary in’a ahungleh mi tampi kikhomin anataovui.

tcz: Chuin aman kot chu akiuvin ahile soh numei Rhoda kiti nu chu kot hong dingin ahung in ahi.
en_web: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
en_kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman kot pi nung chu akiu leh donbut din amin Rhoda kiti lhacha numei khat ahunge,

tcz: Chuin numei nu chun Peter awso ahi ahetdoh phat chun kot jong hong louvin insunga anung lhailut in miho jah-a chun “Peter kotbula adinge!” agatin ahi.
en_web: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
en_kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
tcz_gospelgo: ahin Peter ogin ahi ahetdoh phat’in akipah behseh jengin kot honta louvin alhai lut’in kot po lama Peter din thu chu agaseiphong jo tai.

tcz: Chuin miho chun amanu jah a “Angol thim nahim,” atiuve, ahin amanu chun ahi mong monge ati phat chun amaho chun akhutile “Alhagao hinah ta,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
en_kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mihon amanu jah a, “A-gol’a nahi,” atiuve. Amanun atah mong ahi thu asei tei tei vangin, amahon, “A-Vantil hiya chu,” atibep’ui.

tcz: Alangkhat'ah Peter in kot chu akiu kiu jengin ahi. Achainakeiya amahon kot chu ahona avet'u le Peter chu amu phat un kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
en_kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Peterin kot akiu kiu jeng phat’in agah hon’u leh ama amu cheh-un kidang asalheh jenguve.

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho chu thipbeh a um ding'in akhut in avetsah in, amaho koma chun Pakaiyin kidangtah a songkul'a kona ahin puidoh dan thusim chu asei peh tan ahi. Chule “Hiche thu chu Jacob le asopiho seipeh un,” atin ama hikoma kon chun munchoma achetan ahi.
en_web: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
en_kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Peterin athip behna diuvin khut ajap’in, Pakaiyin itobanga kidangtah a songkul’a kona ahin puidoh ham, ti thu aseiyin, “Hicheng thusoh hi Jacob le sopite gaseipeh tauvin,” atin, apotdoh-in munchoma achetai.

tcz: Chuin kho ahung vah phat in sepai ho chun i-atileh Peter chu songkul'a kona potdoh thei ham tin alung dong lheh jeng uvin ahi.
en_web: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
en_kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah vah-in Peter chung change thusoh jeh chun sepaiho lah a boina lentah asodoh tai.

tcz: Chuin Herod lengpan sepai ho koma chun Peter chu phatecha ahol nadingun thu apen ahin lah amu deh lou phat un, songkul ngah a pang sepai ho chu thudoh aneiyin ajonan amaho chu athat tan ahi. Chujou chun Herod lengpa jong Judah gam dalhan phat chomkhat um ding'in Caesarea ajon tan ahi.
en_web: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
en_kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judea to Cesarea, and there abode.
tcz_gospelgo: Herod chun Peter ahol’a amudoh jou lou phat’in a-ngah a pang ho thu atantai. Amavang chu Judea gama konin Caesarea achesuh-in chukoma aumdentai.

tcz: Tun Herod lengpa chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga alung hang lheh jeng tan ahileh amahon thalheng in mi asol uvin amaho chun Herod lengpa noiya natong Blastus chu athujo jouvun Herod lengpa toh chamna semding in aga thum tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Tyre le Sidon gamsunga ding neh le chah hi Herod lengpa gamsunga kona hungji ahi.
en_web: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
en_kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
tcz_gospelgo: herod chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga along hang lheh jenge; hijeh chun agam miho loikhat ahungun, lengpa Semanga pang Blastus chu athu nun’un cham lensah din athum’ui; ijeh-inem itileh agam miteu chun Herod lengpa gama neh le chah akilah-u ahiye.

tcz: Chuin Herod in athum nau chu asanpeh in akitep nikhou ahung lhunin Herod in aleng von ahin kivon in, aleng touna-a atouvin amaho koma chun thu asei tan ahi.
en_web: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
en_kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Akitepniuvin Herod chun lengpon chol akisil’in, laltouna atouvin, ajah-uva thu aseiye.

tcz: Chuin mipi ho chun “Hiche hi mihem awso ahipoi, Pathen aw ahi,” atiuvin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
en_web: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
en_kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mipin asam’un, “Mihem ogin ahibouve,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mipi hon chutia asap pettah-u chun Herod in Pathen loupina peh sangin ama akiloupi sah tan ahile Pakai vantil in Herod chunga natna ahin lhunsah tan, chuti chun lungin anen athitan ahi.
en_web: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
en_kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman loupina chu Pathen pelouva aumjeh-in hiche pettah chun Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in adengin, lungin anen athitai.

tcz: Alangkhat'ah Pathen thu chu akithe jal jingin seijui apung jingin ahi.
en_web: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
en_kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thu vang achal jal’in akhatou cheh tai.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema akin hon achai lhon phat in John Mark apui lhon in akile tauvin ahi.
en_web: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
en_kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
tcz_gospelgo: Barnabas le Saul vang chu kin achaisoh lhon phat’in aminchom Mark kiti John chu ahinpui lhonin Jerusalema konin ahungkile kit lhontai.

tcz: Antioch Houbung sunga Themgao le mihil ho chu, Barnabas, Simeon (mivompa), Lucius (Cyrene mi), Manaen (Herod Antipas golpa), chule Saul ahiuve.
en_web: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
en_kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
tcz_gospelgo: Antioch khoa Houbunga chun Themgao le mihilphabep aumun; amahon chu Barnabas, Nigerkiti Simeon, Cyrene gam mi Lucius, gambih vaipo Herod toh seilet tha Manaen chule Saul ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin Nikhat amaho hin an ngola Pathen ahoukhom pet-un Lhagao Theng in amaho koma chun “Barnabas le Saul chu kakouna natong dingin lhandoh tauvin,” ahin tin ahi.
en_web: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
en_kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu Pakai kinbol’a an a-ngol laitah-un Lhagao thengin, “Kakouna natong din Barnabas le Saul neipedoh-uvin,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon an ngola taona hatah-a anei jouvun amani chunga chun khut angam un, ataopeh jouvun asoldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
en_kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun an ngol’a atao jouvun achung lhona thenso khut ngap abol’un asoldoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Saul chu Lhagao Theng in asoldoh lhon tan ahile, amani Seleucia kongkai muna achesuh lhon in chuin Cyprus twikol jon dingin konga atou lhon tan ahi.
en_web: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
en_kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao Theng sol’a konin Barnabas le Saul chu Seleucia ajonsuh lhonin, chua pat’in Cyprus lama akitol lhontai.

tcz: Chuche muna Salamis khopi alhun hon phat in Judah te kikhop khomna hoa alut lhon in Pathen thu asamphong le hon tan ahi. Chule John Mark jong amani kithopi dingin akilhon uvin ahi.
en_web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
en_kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
tcz_gospelgo: Salamis kho alhun phat lhonin Judate Houthua kikhopna in hoa Pathen thu aseiphong lhonin, akithopi lhon ding John jong ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin amani twikol sung pumpi a chun khopi khat a kon in khopi khat ah avahle lhonin Paphos chan in achelhon in ahile hiche lai muna chun Bar-Yeshua kiti Judah mi doichoi le themgao lhemkhat akimupi lhon in ahi.
en_web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
en_kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: Twikol gamsung achotsoh-uva Paphos kho ahung gei phat’in Juda mi Temgao lhem, mitpheldoi them Bar-Jesu kitipa chu amudoh tauve;

tcz: Chule amapa chu gamvaipo miching tah Sergius Paulus koma uma ahi. Chuin gamvaipo pa chun Pathen thu angai nom jeh chun Barnabas le Saul chu akou tan ahi.
en_web: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
en_kjv: which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hi twikol gamvaipopa, Sergius Paulus, milung chingtah chutoh kihe ahin, gamvaipopan Pathen thu asei lhon ngai dingin Barnabas le Saul chu akouve.

tcz: Ahinlah Elymas kiti doichoi mikhat ahung kikum lut in gamvaipo chun Barnabas le Saul thusei chu atahsan louna tei dingin hiche teni thusei hi ngaipeh hih in tin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
en_kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chun mitpheldoi thempa Greek paova amin Elymas jong atipau chun amani thusei adoudal len gamvaipopan atahsan louna ding aboltai.

tcz: Chuin Paul tiajong kihe Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset in, chule aman doichoi mipa chu aven,
en_web: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
en_kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Paul kitipa Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset’in amapa chu ave changel’in,

tcz: “Nangma Diabol chapa, Jou le jona milhemlha, thilpha jouse dinga melma pa! Pathen lamdih a kona mihem puimang ding hi nangah louhel ding ham?
en_web: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
en_kjv: and said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
tcz_gospelgo: “Vo thilpha jouse doudal, lhep lhahna le nambolna dimset, Diabol son, Pakai lampi dih heikonle ding nabol hi natat lou lai ding ham?

tcz: Ven tun Pakai mijep na khut chu nachunga hung chu ding chule namit choding phat chomkhat khovah namulou ding ahitai.”
en_web: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
en_kjv: And now behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun ven, Pakaiyin nachunga khut alhatai, phat chom khat sunga nisa vah him him namu loudidng ahi,” atileh; apettah chun meijing le muthimin ahintomin, kho amulou jeh chun akhut’a kaile ding mi aholtai.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu gamvaipo chun amu phat in ama jong seijui ho lah a ajao tan ahi ajeh chu Pakai thudol thuhil chu kidang asah val jeng ahi.
en_web: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
en_kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Gamvaipopan thilsoh chu amun Pakai thudol kihilna kidang asan atahsantai.

tcz: Chuin Paul le alhon khompi ho chun Paphos dalhan Pamphylia jon dingin konga akitolun Perga muna akinga tauvin, chule hiche muna kon chun John Mark chu Jerusalem lama akile tan ahi.
en_web: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le aloite ni chu Paphos a konin akitol’un Pamphylia gama perga kho alhungun, Johnin amani dalhan Jerusalema ahung kile kittai.

tcz: Ahin Paul le Barnabas vang chu keng lam in Pisidia gam'a Antioch chan achelhon in, chuin cholngah nikhon amani jong kikhom dingin kikhop khomna in ah alut lhon tan ahi.
en_web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
en_kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le Barnabas vang achepai lhonin Pisidia gama Antioch kho alhung lhonin Choldo nikhon Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in atou lhontai.

tcz: Chuin angaiya Mose le Themgao lekhabu asim jouvun kikhopna-a lamkai hon amani koma chun “Sopi teni mipi ho tilkhouna dinga seinom nanei honle hung sei lhonin,” tin phat apeuvin ahi.
en_web: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
en_kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthubu le Themgao lekhabu akisim chaiyin Houthua kikhopna in vaihonpan miho asol’in ajah lhona, “sopite ni mipi tilkhouna ding thu nanei lhon leh sei lhonin,” agatisah-e.

tcz: Chuin Paul ading doh in akhut alhang in mipi ho chu thipbeh cha-a um ding'in aseiyin, chuin aman aseitai, “Israel mite hole Pathen ging'ah chidang namdang teho, ngaiyuvin,
en_web: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
en_kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Paul adingdoh-in khut ajah-in aseiyin: “Israel mite le Pathen gingte jousen ngaiyun.

tcz: Hiche Israel nampi Pathen chun ipu ipateu ana lhengdoh in Egypt gam'a chun apunsah uvin chule thahattah nampi khat in ahin semdoh tan ahi. Chuin athahat nan Egypt mite khut ah asoh chan nauva konin ahin huh doh in,”
en_web: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
en_kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with a high arm brought he them out of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Isreal mite Pathen chun i-pu i-pateu analhengdoh-in, Egypt gama apemlaiyun achoi len lheh jengin, aban thahat panin ahinpuidohtai.

tcz: Gamthip noiya kum somli jen ahin puiyin,
en_web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
en_kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum som li tobang sungin pa naovah bangin gamthip noiya akhan chah-u aven,

tcz: Chuin Canaan gamsunga nam sagi jen asumang in, agam sungu chu Israel ten aloding in apetan ahi.
en_web: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
en_kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
tcz_gospelgo: chuin Canaan gamsunga mihem nam sagi asuhmang phat’in agam’u chu agoulo diuvin apen,

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hi kum 450 sunga soh ahi. Chujouvin Israel chate chunga vaihom ding in Pathen thutan vaihom ho ana pen ama ho chun Samuel themgao pa khang chanin vai anahom un ahi.
en_web: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
en_kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: kum ja li le som nga geiyin achenguve. Hiche nung chun Samuel Themgao nikho lai geiyin amaho chu Thutan vaibol ho apen ahi.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun leng ana thum'un, ahile Pathen in Benjamin phunga kon Kish chapa Saul chu ana pen ama chun kum somli lengvai anapon ahi.
en_web: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
en_kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin amahon leng athum’u leh Pathenin Benjamin phunga Kish chapa Saul chu kum som li geiyin akoipeh-e.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Saul chu leng muna konin ana ladoh in David chu ana tung tan ahi. Pathen in David thudola hitin ana seiye “Keiman kalung gottah mi Jesse Chapa David kamutai, aman kalunggot jouse abol ding ahi” ati.
en_web: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
en_kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Saul chu apaidoh nungin aleng thudol’a hin Keiman kalung dei tah David, Jesse chapa kamudoh tai, aman kalungdei chan abol ding ahi,’ tin hettohsahnan aseitai.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Israelte huhdoh dinga athutep Yeshua chu leng David insunga kon ahi.
en_web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
en_kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: David chilhah a kon hin thutep dungjuiyin Pathenin Huhhingpa Jesu chu ahinlhut tan ahi.

tcz: Ama ahung masang in twilutsah John in Israel mipi jousen chonset lung aheiya Pathen koma akilekit uva chule twiya Baptize achanna dingu thu ana lhangsam in ahi.
en_web: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
en_kjv: when John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu kiphondoh masang hin Johnin lungheiya baptize chan ding thu Israel mipi henga aseiphonge.

tcz: Chuin John in atoh ding kin achaiphat in aman adong in “keihi Messiah nei hisah uham? Kahipoi! Ahin Ama hungvah ding ahi, chule keima akengchot khao sutlha a pang asolchah khat dinga jong lhing jou kahipoi.”
en_web: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
en_kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
tcz_gospelgo: John chun atoh achaisoh ding konin, ‘Nang hon kei hi koiya neigel’um? Keima Ama chukahipoi; amavang ven, kanunga khat ahunge, kei hi Ama kengchot khao te ni sut lham dia jong kilom kahipoi,’ ati.

tcz: Sopite, Abraham son ho le chidang namdang Pathen ging mite ho, Hiche huhhingna thuphahi eiho dinga hung kisol ahi.
en_web: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
en_kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
tcz_gospelgo: “Abraham chilhah sopite le nalah-uva Pathen ging miho, hiche Huhhingna thu hi eiho henga hung kithot ahitai.

tcz: Jerusalem mite le alamkai teuvin themgao hon Yeshua thudol aseiyu ahilam ahepouve. Chusang in themmo achanun hiche jeng jong hin cholngah niseh a themgao ho thucheng aguilhun sah ahi.
en_web: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
en_kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Jerusalema ilengteu le avaipouteuvin Ama chu anahedoh pouvin, Choldo niseh le kisimji Themgao thuseiho hcu guilhunsah nan hekhen louvin Ama chu themmo achan’un,

tcz: Chule dan dung juiya tha nading themmo najong amu pouvin, ahin Pilate henga chun atha teitei nading in angeh un ahi.
en_web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
en_kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
tcz_gospelgo: athina thei lom themmona amudoh jou lou geiyun jong Pilate henga atha na din a-ngeh-uve;

tcz: Chuin themgao vin achungchang thudol asei jouse aboljou soh phat un, thingpel chunga konin ala lhauvin lhanah alup sah tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
en_kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
tcz_gospelgo: achung chang thudol kisei jouse asuh bulhingsoh phat’un thing chunga akikhainaa konin adom lhauvin avuitauve.

tcz: Ahivangin Pathen in thina-a konin akaithou kittai.
en_web: But God raised him from the dead,
en_kjv: But God raised him from the dead:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathenin Ama chu thinaa konin akaithouvin,

tcz: Chuin nikho phabep jouvin Galilee a kona Jerusalem lampia akilhon khompi ho henga ama akiphong in tun amaho Israel mite henga hettoh sah in apang uvin ahi.
en_web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
en_kjv: and he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
tcz_gospelgo: nikho phabep pi sungin Galiee gama pat Jerusalem lama alhonpi miho henga akilah jin, amaho chu tua hi mipi henga hettohsah a pang ahiuve.

tcz: Tunia keiho hiche laiya hi Pathen in ipu ipateu henga ana kitepna thupha choiya hung kahiuve.
en_web: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
en_kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
tcz_gospelgo: Chule pu le pate henga hungsoh dinga kiteppeh thutep chu keihon kipah tah a kaseiphongu ahi,

tcz: Chule hiche hi ason achilhah eiho jouse henga Pathen in Yeshua akaithou vanga aguilhunsah ahi. Hiche thudol hi Psalm lekhabu nina in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Nangma kachapa, tunin keima napa kahitai.”
en_web: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
en_kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche chu Pathenin achateu eiho henga aguilhunsah nan Jesu chu akaithouvin, athudol hi labu ninaa akisunin: ‘Nangma kachapa, Tunia kahin nahi,’ akiti.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in lhana monlha bep ding hilouva thina-a kona kaithou dinga ana thutepsa ahi. Pathen in aseiyin, “David henga kakitepna phattheina kiselguh chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
en_web: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
en_kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
tcz_gospelgo: Mon mangna mu louhel dinga Pathenin thinaa kona akaithou thudol chu hiti jong hin aseiye: ‘Keiman David kipe thonlou le atheng Phattheina kapeh ding nahiuve,’ akiti.

tcz: Psalm lekhabu dang khat'ah ahilchen be in, Nami theng chu lhan'a namon den sah lou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
en_kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman labu munchom khat’a jong aseiyin: ‘Nalhentum lhachapa chu Nangin mon mang dia naphaldoh lou idndg ahi,’ akiti.

tcz: Chule hiche thuhi David aseina ahipoi, ajeh chu David chun ama khang sunga Pathen lunggot lam abol jouvin athi in apu apate toh akivui khomin chule atahsa jong amon mang tan ahi.
en_web: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
en_kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
tcz_gospelgo: David vang chun ama khang laiyin Pathen toh akivuithan, mon mangna amutan,

tcz: Ahipoi! Hiche thuhi Pathen in atahsa mon mang louva akaithou midang khat kiseina ahi.
en_web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
en_kjv: but he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin akai thou kitpan van gmin mangna amupoi.

tcz: Sopite ho, ngaiyun! Hiche Yeshua vanga chonset ngaidamna aum thudol lhangsama kahiuve.
en_web: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;
en_kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche hi nahet cheh diu ahi sopite, Jesu jal’a chonset jouse ngaidamna thudodl nahenguva kaseiphongu ahin, Mose Danthua kona them nachan jou louna jouseuva chu

tcz: Koi hijong le ama tahsan chan chu Pathen anga themchanga kisim ding ahi chule hiche hi Mose dan in aboltheipoi.
en_web: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
en_kjv: and by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
tcz_gospelgo: koi hile atahsan chan them chang’ah ahi.

tcz: Chingtheiyun! Themgao thusei hohi nangho chunga chuh sah hih un, ajeh chu amahon hitin aseiyuve;
en_web: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
en_kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Themgaoho thusei nachunguva ahung chuh louna din ching theiyun:

tcz: “Veuvin mi nuisat ho, kidang sauvin lang thidoh un, ajeh chu nangho phat laiyin thilkhat kabolin, hiche thil khat kabol chu mikhat in naheng uva ahung sei jong le natahsan pouve.” ati.
en_web: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
en_kjv: Behold ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which you shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Veuvin nahsahmo ho, Kidang sauvin lang mangthah-un; Ajeh chu nanikho laiyun thil Hitobang thil hi min seipeh jong leu chun natahsan lou hel diu ahi,’ tia asei chu,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chu kikhopna in'a konin apotdoh lhonin ahile mipi chun akham uvin hapta kit le asei lhon jouse avelsei kit lhon dingin angeh-un ahi.
en_web: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
en_kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
tcz_gospelgo: Akikhendoh phat’un mihon Choldo nikit jongleh ajah-uva hiche ho aseipeh kit diuvin a-ngeh-uve.

tcz: Chuin Judah mi tamtah le hougut Judah houva lut mitampi chun Paul le Barnabas chu ajui tauvin ahile amanin amaho chu Pathen milungsetna a umdet jing ding in atil khou lhon tan ahi.
en_web: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
en_kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Houthua kikhopna in’a akikhendoh dodh-uvin Juda mi tampi le Juda houva kilalut ah hougut tampin Paul le Barnabas nung ajuiyun, amanin amaho chu Pathen lungset naa umdet jing din atilkhou lhone.

tcz: Chuin a-hapta kit in khopi sunga mipi atamjo Pathen thungai ding in ahung khomun ahi.
en_web: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
en_kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nikit’in akhothing hel tobangin Pakai thu kisei ngai didngin akikhomtauve.

tcz: Ahin Judah mi abang chun mipi chu aveu vin ahile athangse uvin, hijeh chun Paul thusei jouse chu anelkal un ahi.
en_web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
en_kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi kihonlel lul’a akikhop jengu chu Juda hon amudoh phat’un athangseuvin, Paul thuseichu ataitom’un anel kale tauve.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun hangsan tah in alhangsam lhonin asei lhon tai, “Nangho Judah te henga Pathen thu kalhangsap masah lhon ding hi ngaikhoh ahi, ahin nanghon napampai uva, nangho le nanghon tonsot hinna changdia lomlouva thu nakitan tah jeh un, chidang namdang te henga kache lhon ding ahitai.
en_web: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
en_kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Paul le Barnabas hangtah-in thu asei lhonin, “Pathen thu hi amasaa nang ho seipeh lou khoh ahin, nang hon napai manguva tonsot hinna chang dia kilom nakisah louvu leh, ven chiding namdangte henga kihei tauvinge.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in, ‘vannoi leiset pumpia huhhing na thupole dinga, chidang namdang te lah-a vah'a kasem lhon nahi,’ atia chu chidang namdang te lah a eisol lhon ahitai,” ati lhon e.
en_web: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
en_kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin keiho hitia hi eiseipeh-u ahi: ‘Keiman nang hi chidnag nam dang salvah dia katun’a, Vannoi pumpia sochatna lampi dia katun nahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin chidang namdang ten hiche thu ajah phat un hapan akipah in Pakai athangvah un chule tonsot hina chang dinga kilhengdoh ho jouse chu seijui in apang tauvin ahi.
en_web: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
en_kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdang hon hicheng hi ajah phat’un akipah-un Pakai thu kisei chu achoi-an’un tonsot hinna chang dia kigosadema um hon atahsan tauve.

tcz: Chuin hiche gamkai sung se achun Pathen thu chu akithe jal tan ahi.
en_web: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
en_kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Pakai thu hiche gamkol sungsea chun achalsoh tai.

tcz: Chuin Judah techun hougut numei ho le khopi sunga lamkai ho chu atil seuvin Paul le Barnabas chu khopi sunga konin adel mang sah tauvin ahi.
en_web: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
en_kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Juda mihon hougut numei lal ho le khopi sunga lamkaiho atilseuvin, Paul le Barnabas abolset sah-uvin agamkol sunguva konin adeldohsah tauve.

tcz: Chuin amanin apampai lhon vetsahnan akenglhona khobon athing lha lhonin Iconium ajon lhon tan ahi.
en_web: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
en_kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanin amaho dounan akeng phanga leivui athin lhah khum lhonin Iconium lama ache lhontai.

tcz: Chule Seijui ho chu kipana le Lhagao vin adimset tauvin ahi.
en_web: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijui ho vang chu kipana le Lhagao thengin adimsetu’ve.

tcz: Chuin angai ngaiyin Iconium muna jong Paul le Barnabas chu Judah te kikhopna insunga alut lhonin thanei tah in thu alhangsam kit lhonin ahile Judah te le chidang namdang mitampin atahsan kit uvin ahi.
en_web: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
en_kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
tcz_gospelgo: Iconium khoa Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut khom lhonin, hitima chun thu asei lhon le Judate le Greek mi tampin atahsan tauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Judah te mi konkhat in Pathen thu sanglou vin chidang namdang te lungthim sunga Barnabas le Paul dounan thina thei gu akhum peh un ahi.
en_web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
en_kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Juda mi atahsang lou hon sopite dounan chiding namdang ho atilseuvin adsulung hangtauve.

tcz: Ahin solchah teni chu hiche lai muna chun sottah aumden lhonin Pakai mi ngailutna thu chu hangsan tah in alhangsam jing lhonin chule athu lhangsap lhon chu atah ahi vetsahna dingin melchih na le bolmo kidang tampi abol lhonin ahi.
en_web: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
en_kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin ama ni sotpi anichong lhonin, alungsetna thu hettohsah a amani khut’a melchihna thil kidang tampi bolsah Pakaiya hangtah-in thu asei jom jing lhone.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche khopi sunga miho chu lunggel ni in akihom khen un, konkhat chun Judah te ajop un konkhat ma chun solchah teni thu ajop un ahi.
en_web: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.
en_kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun khopi sung miho chu kehni akisouvin, abang Juda miho langa apangun, abang solchah te ni lama apangui.

tcz: Chuin chidang namdang mitam tah le Judah techun alamkai tehou toh kithon songa se-a delkhum ding lung angaito tauvin ahi.
en_web: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
en_kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla chiding namdang ho le Juda mi phabep’in alamkaiteu toh kithon amani chu nahsahmoa bol’a songa seding agouvin ahile,

tcz: Chuin Solchah hon chuche thu ahet lhih phat un Lycaonia gamsunga Lystra le Derbe khopi chule akimvel gamhoa dingin ana jamlut tauvin,
en_web: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
en_kjv: they were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
tcz_gospelgo: amanin ahetdoh lhon phat’in Lycania khopi Lystra le Derbe chule akimvel gamsunga ajamlut lhontai;

tcz: Chule hiche gamsunga chun kipana thupha chu asam phong le tauvin ahi.
en_web: There they preached the Good News.
en_kjv: and there they preached the gospel.
tcz_gospelgo: hikom dunga jong chun Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhone.

tcz: Chuin Lystra-a aumpet un, Paul le Barnabas chun apena pat a akeng phang chatmoa lam pumjot theilou mikhat amu lhonin amapa chu atouvin,
en_web: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
en_kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:
tcz_gospelgo: Lystra khoa chun apen’a pat kengbai, itih a jong lamjot louhel, akeng chasah thei lou hel pasal khat atouvin ahi.

tcz: Chule Paul thusei chu angaiyin ahi. Chuin Paul in amapa chu ave jangkei in ahile amapa chun damna dinga tahsanna anei chu amutan ahi.
en_web: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
en_kjv: the same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
tcz_gospelgo: Amahin Paul thusei angaiyin, Paul’in avechangmel’in ahileh damsah theina kham tahsan anei chu amun,

tcz: Chuin Paul in aw sangtah in akouvin, “Dingdoh in!” ati. Chuin mipa chu akichomin lam ajot tan ahi.
en_web: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
en_kjv: said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
tcz_gospelgo: oging tah in, “nakeng te nin ding jangin,” ati. Mipa chu ahung kichomdoh jengin avah le paitai.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun Paul thilbol chu amu tauvin ahile amaho pao vin asam un, “Hiche miteni hi mihem lima um pathen ahi!” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
en_kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lift up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin Paul thilbol chu amu phat’uvin Lycaonia paovin oging tah-in, “Eiho lah a Pathen ho chu mihem lim’a hung kumlha ahitauve!” tin asamtauve.

tcz: Barnabas chu Greek mite pathen Zeus ahin Paul chun thuseiya pang ahijeh chun Hermes ahi ati tauvin ahi.
en_web: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
en_kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
tcz_gospelgo: Barnabas chu Zeus asah-un, Paul chu thusei lamkai ahijeh-in Hermes asah-uve.

tcz: Chuin Zeus houbuh chu khopi pamlama umah ahin, houbuh a natong thempu ho le mipi ho chun bongchal le pahvui khopi kelkot phunga chun ahin pouvin solchah teni ding chun kilhaina agong tauvin ahi.
en_web: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
en_kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule khopi maiya ahouin kisa Zeus doi Thempupan bongchal ho ahinkaiyin pahvui ho jong ahinchoiyin dongkot phunga mipi chutoh amani hounaa kilhaina gan tha din agouve.

tcz: Ahin solchah Paul le Barnabas in thil umchan thu ajah lhon phat in atija behseh lhonin avon lhon asat-eh lhonin mipi lah a konin ajam lhon tan, aw sang tah in asam lhonin,
en_web: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
en_kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla solchah te ni Barnabas le Paul’in ajahdoh lhon phat’in aponsil abottel jeng lhonin mipi lah a alhai lut lhonin apengjah lhontan,

tcz: “Golteho, ipi dinga hitobang hi nabol uham? Keini hi nangho tobanga mihem mai mai kahi lhon bouve! Hiche panna bei thilhoa kona van le leiset, twikhanglen le asunga thil umjouse sempa Pathen hingjing henga nahung lut nathei diuva kipana thupha kahin poh lhon ahi bouve.
en_web: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
en_kjv: and saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
tcz_gospelgo: “Miho, idia hiti ho hi nabol’u ham? Keini jong nang ho banga mihem kahi lhonin, hitobang pannabei thil hoa kona hi van le leiset chule Twikhanglen le asunga um jouse Sempa, Pathen hing jing henga nakiheina diuva Kipana Thupha kaseipeh lhon nahibouvui.

tcz: Phat masa lai chun namtin ama ama lung lam cheh a ache theina dingin ana phal in ahi.
en_web: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
en_kjv: who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman khang masa laiyin chitin namtin hi Ama dei cheh a chon din alhan,

tcz: Ahin amaho koma jong chun Ama hina le aphatna kiphong louvin ana umsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman go le dai aphat chan napeuvin anche louhing aphatsah in, nangho dingin neh le chah ning lhingset in napeuvin nalungu kipanan adim in ahi,” ati lhon e.
en_web: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
en_kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
tcz_gospelgo: ahivangin Ama ipi ahichu hettohsahna beiyin akoidehpoi, ajeh chu thilpha aboljin, van’a konin gotwi napeuvin, muchi chivo gaphat, kumkihei chin nakoipeh-un, neh le chah napeuvin, nalungthimu kipa le thanopna adim jinge,” ati lhone.

tcz: Thu hicheng asei jou lhon chun amani houna dinga kilhaina bol dinga kigong mipi chu anah nah in akham jou lhonin ahi.
en_web: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
en_kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi asei lhonin amani houna dinga gan athagot’u chu asutang nah nah lhone.

tcz: Chuin Antioch le Iconium a konin Judah te mi phabep ahung lhungun mipi chu athujo uvin, Paul chu khopi pam lamah akaidoh un songa asep un athitai tin adalhauvin ahi.
en_web: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
en_kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chun Antioch le Iconiuma kona hung Juda mihon mipi chu athu anun’un Paul chu songin asesah-un, athi ahitai, tin khopi polama akaidohtauve.

tcz: Chuin seijui ho avela atoukhom pet un Paul chu athoudoh kit in khopi sunga anung lut kit in ahi. Chuin ajing in Barnabas toh Derbe lama ding in achekit lhon tan ahi.
en_web: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
en_kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla akoma seijuite adin pet’uvin Paul athoudoh-in khopi sunga aluttai; ajing nikhon Barnabas toh Derbe lama ache lhontan ahi,

tcz: Chuin Derbe a kipana thupha alhangsap jou lhon a mi tampi seijuiya asem jou lhon phat in, Paul le Barnabas chu Lystra, Iconium, le Pisidia gam'a Antioch geiyin akile kit lhon in,
en_web: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
en_kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche khopia chu Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhona, seijuitampi asemdoh jou lhonin Lystra le Iconium chule Antioch lama ahung kile kit lhonin,

tcz: Seijui ho asuhat kit lhon in, tahsan na a dingdet jing dingin atilkhou lhon in, chule Pathen lenggam lutna dinga gentheina le hahsat na tampi athoh ding danu jong ahetsah lhon in ahi.
en_web: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
en_kjv: confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: genthei hesoh tampi thoh a Pathen lenggama ilut mong diu ahi tin tahsana pang det jing dingin seijuiho atilkhou lhon in alungu asuhal lhon’e.

tcz: Chule Paul le Barnabas chun houbung tina upa apansah lhonin, chuin upa a apansah lhon ho chu taona le an ngol pumin atahsan ngap nau Pakai khut'ah apelut tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
en_kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung jousea Houbung upa alhenpeh lhonin, an ngol’in ataovun, atahsanpau Pakaiyah upa ho chu apedoh doh jenguve.

tcz: Chuin amani Pisidia jotpaiyin Pamphylia chan achekit lhon in ahi.
en_web: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
en_kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le Barnabas-in Pisidia ajotpa lhoin Pamphylia alhung lhonin,

tcz: Chuin Perga muna thu asei jou lhon in Attalia a achesuh kit lhon in ahi.
en_web: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
en_kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
tcz_gospelgo: Perga thu aseiphong jou lhonin Attalia achesuh lhontai.

tcz: Achainan, kong in akitol lhon in ahung kipat doh nalhon Syria gam'a Antioch muna akile kit lhon tan ahi. Hiche lai muna tahsan chaten Pathen mingailutna natoh tongdoh dinga anganse nau atong molso lhon tan ahi.
en_web: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
en_kjv: and thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Chua konin kongin akitol lhonin, ahintoh chaisoh lhon hiche natoh tong dinga Pathen lungsetnaa akipehdohna lhon khopi, Antioch jonin ache lhontai.

tcz: Chuin Antioch ahung lhun lhon toh kilhon in houbung mipi akou khom lhon in Pathen in amani a kona thil abol jouse le chidang namdang tedinga jong tahsanna kot ahon dan thudol ahettohsah lhon in ahi.
en_web: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
en_kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung lhun lhon phat’in Houbung mi abonchan akhom lhonin, Pathenin amani amanchah a atoh jouse aseidoh lhonin, chiding namdangte dia tahsan lam kihon thu asei lhon’e.

tcz: Chuin hiche laiya chun seijui ho toh sotpi aumkhom tauvin ahi.
en_web: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
en_kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Antioch khoa seijuite toh sotpi aumkhomna lhon chu phat chomcha ahipoi.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas Syria gam'a Antioch muna aum jing lai lhon in, Judea gam'a kon in mi phabep ahung un “Mose dan dung juiya chep natan lou uleh huhhing'a naum thei lou dingu ahi,” tin seijui ho chu thu ahung hil'un ahi.
en_web: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
en_kjv: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Judea gama konin mi phabep ahungun sopite chu, “Mose Danthu dungjuiya chepnatan louvu leh huhhingin umthei pouvin nate,” tin ahiltauve.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun amaho thuhil chu dih asah lhon lou jeh chun nasatah in akinel tauvin ahi. Ahin achaina chan na akihoulhah thei tah loujeh un Houbung chun Paul le Barnabas chu amun houbung mi themkhat toh Jerusalema hiche thudoh chung changa solchah ho le upa ho toh kihou khom ding in ahin sol tauvin ahi.
en_web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
en_kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thudol’a chun Paul le Barnabas toh akihanel lheh jengun akinahso phat’un athu ngaito khom din Paul le Barnabas to midang phabep toh Jerusalema chea Solchah ho le upaho toh kihoutoh din alhengdoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Houbung in Jerusalem a dinga ahin sol houchu Phoenicia le Samaria gamsunga akinga pauvin, seijui ho ahin ho pauvin chidang namdang ho lunghei thu chu aseiyun ahile ama ho hapan akipah un ahi.
en_web: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
en_kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung sol’a konin amaho acheuvin Phoenicia le Samaria ajot pepeh-un, chidnag namdang ho Pathena akiheilut thu aseipeh-u le sopite cheng akipah lheh-ui.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem alhun un Barnabas le Paul chu solchah ho le upa ho jaonan houbung mipi chun ana lemun, chuin amanin Pathen natoh ho abonchan asei lhon tan ahi.
en_web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
en_kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem alhun phat’un Houbung miho le Solchah ho chule Houbung upahon analamtouvin, ama hon ajah-uva Pathenin amaho amanchah a na atoh chengse aseiyuve.

tcz: Ahin Pharisee ho lah a kona seijui ho themkhat ading doh un “Chidang namdang atahsan hon Mose dan dung juiya chep atanu ngai ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
en_kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin atahsansa ahivanga Pharisee loi hinalai mi phabep akipatdoh-un, “Amaho chu chep tanpeh a Mose Danthu anit tei diu ahi,” tin asei yui.

tcz: Chuin solchah ho le upa ho chu hiche thua boina ho seilham ding in akikhomun ahi.
en_web: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
en_kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah ho le Houbung upaho hiche thu ngaito ding hin akikhom tauve.

tcz: Akikhop khom nauva chun, phat sottah akihoulim jouvun Peter ading doh in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, phat masa a kona Pathen in nang ho lah a kona keima hi chidang namdang ten kipana thupha ajah thei nadingu le atahsan na dinguva eilhen ahi chu nahe sohkeiyuve,
en_web: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.
en_kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Tamtah a kholtohna anei nungun Peter akipatdoh-in ajahuva, “Sopite, masang chun nang ho lah a kona keima kama hi chiding namdangten Kipana Thupha ajah-uva atahsanna diuva keima Pathenin eilhendoh chu naheuve,

tcz: Pathen in mihem lungthim ahen, eiho eipeh bang uva chidang namdang te jong Lhagao Theng apeh hin Pathen san ahi nau ahettoh sah ahi.
en_web: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
en_kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
tcz_gospelgo: chule mei lungthim hesoh Pathenin ahenguva ahettohsah-in, eiho eipeh bangun amaho jong Lhagao Theng apei;

tcz: Eiho le amaho kikah a kikhenna asem pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman tahsan na-a alungthimu asuh theng ahitai.
en_web: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
en_kjv: and put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
tcz_gospelgo: ei ho le amaho kah a dat neichom louvin tahsanin alungthimu asuthengtai.

tcz: Chuti ahi jeh chun, ipi dinga chidang namdang seijui ho chu eiho le ipu ipa teuvin jong anapoh joulou pohgih chu ipohsah uva Pathen ichou dingu ham?
en_web: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
en_kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahileh ibol’a tua ipu ipateu leh eihon jong ipoh jou louvu namkoljon chu seijuite lengkouva naseuva Pathen napatep’u ham?

tcz: Eiho ibonchauva ichan diuva lomlou Pakai Yeshua mingailut vanga huhhing'a um ihiu chu iheuve,” ati.
en_web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
en_kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon vang Pakai Jesu lungset vanga tahsan jal’a huhhinga eiho i-um diu banga amaho jong chute dinga katahsanu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Paul in amani jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang te lah a melchih naleh thil kidang abol thu asei lhon chu mipi chun thipbeh in angaiyun,
en_web: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
en_kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
tcz_gospelgo: Akikhom mipi chu athip chet jengun, Barnabas le Paul’in Pahtenin amani amanchah achidang namdangte lah a melchihna ho le thil kidang aboldoh ho asei lhon chu angaisoh keiyuve.

tcz: Asei jou lhon in, Jacob ading doh in hiti hin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, kathusei hi ngaitemuvin,
en_web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
en_kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
tcz_gospelgo: Amanin thu asei chai lhonin Jacob’in adonbut’in, “Sopite kasei ngai ta diuvin!

tcz: Chidang namdang te lah a kona Pathen in ama dinga mi akilah tillai thu chu Peter in aseiya kon in ija tauve,
en_web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
en_kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Simonin chiding namdangte Pathenin avil’a alah-uva kona ama min’a ding mi alhendoh thu aseitai.

tcz: Chule hiche chidang namdang te lunghei thudol hi themgao hon ana phondoh masah sau ahitai, ajeh chu hiti hin akisun in ahi.”
en_web: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
en_kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Themgaoho thusei toh akitoh soh keiyin hitin akisune:

tcz: “Chujou tengle kakile kit a, David in lhusa kasem phat a, asesa kasah phat kit'a chule kasem phat kit ding ahi.
en_web: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up
en_kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Hiche nung hileh Keima hung kile kit’ing ting, Alhusa David houbuh chu kasah phat’a; A-in gem jouse kasah phat ding, Katundoh kit ding ahi;

tcz: Chutengle mijouse, chidang namdang te jaona a keima dinga kakou jousen Pakai ahin hol ding ahi tin,
en_web: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’
en_kjv: that the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutia chu mihem amoh chengsen Pakai ahol theiyuva, Kamin a kikou chiding namdang jousen jong ahol thei ding, atin,

tcz: Hitiho jouse phat sottah masanga kona hetsah ji Pakai chun aseiyin ahi.
en_web: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
en_kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: khanglui laiya pat hicheng thil ho hetsah Pakaiyin aseiye,’ kiti ahi.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun keima thutan chu hiche hi ahi, chidang namdang te Pathen lama lungheina neiho dinga pohgih igot peh lou dingu ahi.
en_web: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
en_kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun chidang namdang ho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho chu bolgenthei dau hite, tin ka-ngaitoi;

tcz: Chusang chun, milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, hetphah lou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, tin jih thou hite.
en_web: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
en_kjv: but that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang amaho chu lekha thot’u hitin, doi houna thil thenglou neh, jon thanghoi, alol kimeh a kithatsa le thisan neh a kona kitim them din hil’u hite;

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche Mose danthu ho hi khopi jouse le cholngah nikho seh a khang tamtah dinga Judah te kikhopna in'a kisei jing ahi.” ati.
en_web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
en_kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile khanglui laiya pat Mose’in khop jouseah athusei ding anei jingin, Choldo nikho seh leh ama thudol Houthua kikhopna in jouse akisim jenge;” ati.

tcz: Chuin solchahho le upa hon Jerusalem houbunga konin mi phabep alheng doh un, amaho chu Paul le Barnabas toh Syria gam'a Antioch houbunga akihoulhah nau thu hettoh sah dingin asoluvin ahi. Akilheng doh teni chu houbung lamkai Judas (Barsabbas tiajong kihe) le Silas ahi.
en_web: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
en_kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah ho leh Houbung upaho chule Houbung pumpi lung gel’in alah-uva kona mi lhendoh a Paul le Barnabas toh Antioch khoa sol din pha asauvin, Barsabbas kiti Judas le Silas, sopiten ajabol cheh te ni chu alhengun,

tcz: Chuin hiche lekha thot hitia kisun hi apohsah un ahi: “Hiche lekha thot hi solchahho le upa ho chule Jerusalema um sopihoa kon ahi. Hiche hi Syria gam'a Antioch le Cilicia a um chidang namdang te henga dinga kisun ahi.” Chibai!
en_web: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
en_kjv: and they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
tcz_gospelgo: aban’a kisei bang hin asun’un amani khut’a athot tauve; “Solchah ho leh Houbung upa, sopite chengsen, Antioch leh Syria chule Cilicia gama um chidang namdang ho lah a sopite chengse kasalam’ui.

tcz: “Hichea kona mi phabep in athuhil uva nahung suhboi uva, nahung suh lunghangu chu kaheuve, ahin amaho chu keihon kahin sol u ahipoi!
en_web: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
