en_kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho lah a konin mi koi koiham kei ho thupeh louhel’in ahungun thu tampin nahung sulung jingun lung ling laovin nakoiyui, ti kajauve;

tcz: Hijeh chun kilungkhat tah a kakinopto nau toh lhonin keiho khel in ingailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul hi nangho henga kahin sol uvin ahi.
en_web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
en_kjv: it seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun keihon lung khat tah-in mi lhendoh a amaho chu nahenguva i-ngailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul toh hinsol tha ding pha kasauve,

tcz: Amani hi Pakai Yeshua Christa mina ahinna chan ngam ahi lhonin ahi.
en_web: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a ahinkho phal ngam cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Chule nahin thudoh chung changuva kakihou lhah nau hettoh sah dinga Judas le Silas hi kahin sol u ahi.”
en_web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
en_kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Judas le Silas kahinsol’u ahin, amanin jong hiti amaho hi thuchangin seipeh nauvinte.

tcz: “Ajeh chu nangho chunga hicheng thil themkhat tailou pohgih poh sahlou ding hi Lhagao Theng leh keiho dinga phajo ahi;
en_web: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
en_kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thengin jong keihon jong akhoh cheh ho tilou pohgih hahsa dang na chunguva koi lou ding pha kasauvin,

tcz: Hicheng thil themkhat ho chu: milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, het phahlou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, hiche hi najuiuva ahileh alhingsel ahitai.”
en_web: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
en_kjv: that ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
tcz_gospelgo: limsemthu houna doisa, hicheng hi neh dauvin, jon thanhoiya konin kikangse leu chun pha ding hi, damsel’uvin,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin thupoho chu Antioch alhunun seijui ho abonun akou khomun hiche lekha thot chu ape tauvin ahi.
en_web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
en_kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu alhah doh phat’un Antioch khoa achesuhuvin, mipi akhop khomsoh phat’uvin lekha thot chu apetauve.

tcz: Chuin hiche tilkhouna lekha thot chu asimun ahile houbung ho chunga kipana adimset tan ahi.
en_web: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
en_kjv: which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho chun asimu leh tikhouna thuho chu akipapi lheh jenguve.

tcz: Chuin Judas le Silas chu ani lhonna themgao ahi toh lhonin seijui ho tilkhouna le atahsanu suhhat na thutampi asei lhon in ahi.
en_web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
en_kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
tcz_gospelgo: Judas le Silas hi anilhona Themgao gel ahilhonjeh-in sopite chu thu tampin atikhou lhonin ahatsah cheh lheh lhon’e.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat aum jou lhonin seijui hon amani chu lungmong sel'in Jerusalem houbunga ale sol kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
en_kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma chom khat set aum jou lhonin ahinsol ho henga dingin sopiten amani chu lung mongin alhadoh tauve.

tcz: Paul le Barnabas vang chu Antioch a aum den lhonin, hilaiya chun midang ho toh Pathen thu ahil'un alhang samun ahi.
en_web: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
en_kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le Barnabas chu Antioch khoa mi tamtah toh aum khom lhonin, Pakai thu ahil chenin aseiphong lhon’e.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Paul in Barnabas jah-a aseiyin, “Kile kit hitin Pathen thu ilhangsapna khopi jouse chu gavil kit hitin seijui ho iti um hinauvem gave hite,” atin ahi.
en_web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
en_kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat chom khat nungin Paul chun Barnabas jah a, “Hungin Pakai thu i-naseiphongna khopi jousea chekit hitin sopite chu itobanga iti nauvem gave hite,” ati.

tcz: Barnabas jong anomin chule John Mark jong puiding anomin ahi.
en_web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
en_kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Barnabas-in Mark kitipa John chu amani toh kilhona pui din angaitoi.

tcz: Ahin John Mark in Pamphylia muna ana haisan lhona, natoh na a anajao jom tah lou jeh chun ama puikit ding chu Paul akikam khonteh in ahi.
en_web: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
en_kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Paul’in Pamphylia amani dalhaa na tohkhompi nom lou mi chutoh kilhon khom lou ding thilpha pen ahisah e.

tcz: Chuphat chun akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas in John Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lama ding in konga akitol tan ahi.
en_web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
en_kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Paul le Barnabas akihanel ten lhon phat’in akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas chun Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lam jonin kongin akitol’in,

tcz: Paul chun Silas akilhen in, chule tahsan chaten Pakai ngailutna kivoppi dingin asoldoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
en_kjv: and Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in vang Silas akilhenin, sopiten jong Pakai lungsetnan alhadoh-un, ama jong akipatdohtai.

tcz: Chuin Syria le Cilicia gamsungah avah len houbung ho atilkhou le tan ahi.
en_web: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
en_kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul chun Syria le Cilicia ajotpeh-in Houbung jouse atilkhoupeh-in ahi.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Derbe ah ache masan chujouvin Lystra ah achen ahile hikoma chun seijui khang dong Timothy kiti mikhat anaum in ahi. Ama chu anu Judah mi ahin, apa vang chu Greek mi ahi.
en_web: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.
en_kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
tcz_gospelgo: Paul chu Derbe kho le Lystra khoa ahunge. Ven, Lystra khoa chun apa Greek mi, atahsan Juda numei khat cha amin Timothy kit seijui khat aumin,

tcz: Timothy chu Lystra le Iconium muna angaisang loi tahu seijui khat ahi.
en_web: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
en_kjv: which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hi Lystra kho le Iconium khoa sopite jousen aseipha lheh jengui.

tcz: Chuin Paul in ama chu alhonpi ding in adei sah in, hijeh chun akilhon khom masang lhonin Judah ten achom mu lou nadinguvin Timothy chu chep tan nading angaiton ahi. Ajeh chu mijousen apa Greek mi ahi chu ahet u ahi.
en_web: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
en_kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in Timothy hi kilhonpi ding adeijeh-in, chute dunga um Judah on apa Greek mi ahi ahetjeh-uvin apuiyin chep atanpeh e.

tcz: Chuin amani chu khopi khat a konin khopi khat'ah avahle lhonin seijui ho chun Jerusalema solchahho le upa ho thulhuhna chu phatecha ajui cheh nadingun thu ahille lhon tan ahi.
en_web: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun amahon khopi jouse achonsoh keiyun, Jerusalema Solchah ho le upaho kilolna chengse chu nit din miho apeleuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuti chun houbung ho chu atahsan nau suh hat in aumin chule nisih in akhanglen jep jep un ahi.
en_web: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
en_kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Houbung ho chu tahsan lama ahat cheh cheh jengun, niseh-in amijat apun be be jenguve.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chu Phrygia le Galatia gamsunga akholjin jom lhon tan ahi ajeh chu Lhagao Theng in Asia gamsunga Pathen thulhangsap ding chu ajahda ahi.
en_web: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
en_kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Asia gamsunga thu asei diu Lhagao Thengin akham jeh-in Phrygia le Galatia gamkol sungse ajotsoh keiyun,

tcz: Chuin Mysia gamgi ahung lhun lhon phat in Bithynia jon ding in akihei toulhon in ahile hiche gam'a achelhon ding jong chu Pakai Lhagao in aphal pon ahi.
en_web: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
en_kjv: after they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
tcz_gospelgo: Mysia gam gal ahung gei phat’uvin Bithynia lut ding akigot’u leh Jesu Lhagaovin aphalpeh pouve;

tcz: Hijeh chun kihei tou talouvin Mysia gamsunga achepeh lhon in Troas kongkaimun chan achelhon tan ahi.
en_web: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
en_kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chunMysia gam ajot paiyun Troas a achesuh tauve.

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Paul in mu aneiyin: Athilmu achun Greece sahlam gam'a um Mecedonia akonin mikhat ahung ding in “Mecedonia gam'a hung in lang neihung kithopiuvin,” tin ahung taovin ahi.
en_web: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
en_kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jan chun Paul agaochan naa mu aneiyin, Macedonia mi khat hi ahungna dingin ataovin, “Macedonia hung galkaiyin neihung kithopiuvin,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiho Mecedonia jonin kache tauvin, hiche gam'a kipana thupha lhangsam dinga Pathen in eikouvu ahi chu kahe tauvin ahi.
en_web: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
en_kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in gaochan naa mu anei jou jou hin Pathenin Kipana Thupha chu miho hil dinga eikouvu ahi, tin kagel’uvin Macedonia gama chelut ding kasompaitauve.

tcz: Chuin keiho Troas a konin konga katouvun jangjalin kacheuvin Samothrace twikol a kakinga pauvin, ajingin Neapolis kalhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
en_kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
tcz_gospelgo: Troas a pat kakitol’uvin paljangin Samothrace kajon’un, ajing nikhon Neapolis kalhunguve;

tcz: Hichea kon chun Mecedonia gamsunga khopi lenloi Rome te khosatna Philippi kalhung tauvin, hichea chun nikho tampi ka nichongun ahi.
en_web: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
en_kjv: and from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
tcz_gospelgo: hichea kon chun Macedonia gam kolsunga khopi minthang pen, Rome mite tolpi Philippi kalhung tauve. Hiche khopia hin nikho phabeppi kanichongui.

tcz: Chuin cholngah nikhon khopi pamlama naicha a um vadung panga chun miho taokhom inte tia kagel jeh-u chun kacheuvin, hiche muna numei phabep anaum khom ho koma chun katouvun thu kaseiyun ahi.
en_web: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
en_kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nikhon taona mun khat aume, ti kaginchat nau khopi dongkot polam vadung panga chun kacheuvin, katouvun numei hung kikhomho jah a thu kaseitauve.

tcz: Chuin Numei ho lah a chun Lydia kiti Thyatira gammi khat aumin ama chu ponsadup mantam tah a sumkolvei mi ahin chule ama chu Pathen hou jong ahi. Aman ka thuseiju chu phatechan angaiyin ahile Pakaiyin alungthim kot ahin hongin Paul thusei chu ajop tan ahi.
en_web: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
en_kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
tcz_gospelgo: Kathuseiyu ngaiya numei khat chu amin Lydia ahin, Thytira khopia hung kon, ponsandup joh a pang, Pathen hou khat ahi, Paul thuseiho lung luttah a angaina din Pakaiyin along kot ahonpeh tai.

tcz: Chuin amanu chu a insung mi jouse to baptize achangun, chule ama nun adongun “Pakai seijui dihtah ahi neitiuva ahile keima in'ah hung lhung unlang kajin in hung pangun,” tin anop tokah uvin angeh tan ahi.
en_web: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.
en_kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu hi-ainsung mite to baptize achan phat’in, “Pakai tahsan tah beh a neigel’u leh ka-in’a hung lhunguvin,” tin eijol’uvin, eithu nun tauvin ahi.

tcz: Nikhat taona ding muna kache suh uva ahile lhagaoboh vop soh numei khat kamu uvin, amanu chun khonunga hung lhung ding thu aseiya aPakai tedinga sum tampi pi alo ji ahi.
en_web: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
tcz_gospelgo: Taona muna chu kacheu le khonung thusoh ding seiya apute dinga phatchomna lentah mupeh lhagaoboh vop soh nu-ngah khat hin eitoh khauvin ahi.

tcz: Amanu chun Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin aw sangtah in asamin, “Hiche miho hi Chung Nungpen Pathen sohte ahiuvin, chule huhhing'a naum theina dingu thu ahung seiyu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
en_kjv: the same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nu hin Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin, “Hiche miho hi Pathen chungnung pen lhachate ahiuvin, huhhingna lampi nahung hil’u ahi,” tin asam sam jenge.

tcz: Hiti chun nikho tampi abolin ahile Paul jong alunghang tan, chuin akiheiyin asunga cheng lhagaoboh koma chun aseiyin, “Yeshua Christa mina thu kapeh nahi, amanu sunga konin pot in,” atile, apettah chun adalhatan ahi.
en_web: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
en_kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin nikho tampi sungin abol jinge. Paul’in athei chimjeh phat’in akiheiyin lhagao jah achun, “Hiche nua koon chun hung potdoh jengin, tia Jesu Christa min a kasol nahi,” atileh; hichepet tah chun lhagao chu apotdoh tai.

tcz: Chuin apakaiteu chun haosatna dinga akinepna jouseu akephat in Paul le Silas amanun kailhang muna thunei vaihom ho masanga akailut tauvin,
en_web: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
en_kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the market-place unto the rulers,
tcz_gospelgo: Aputeu akinepnau phatchom na aneidiu sum mu na ding abeitai, ti amudoh phat’un Paul le Silas chu aman’uvin kailhang mun’a vaipoho ang sunga akailutauve;

tcz: “Hiche Judah miho jeh hin khopi sung pumpi boina asou sang tai” tin khopi vaihom ho henga asam tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
en_kjv: and brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
tcz_gospelgo: hitia hi thutan vaihomho heng alhut phat’un, “Hiche mi te ni hi Juda mi ahi lhonin, i-kho sungu asuboi lheh jeng lhontai.

tcz: Chule “Eiho Rome mite chonna toh kitoh lou chon dan thu ahilui,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
en_kjv: and teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama nin Rome mi eiho dinga jop thei lou le lah thei lou chondan sodoh dingin ago lhon’e,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mipi chu Paul le Silas dounan akikhom uvin, thing tenggol mangcha a ajep theina dingun khopi vaihom ho chun mipi chu thu ape tauvin ahi.
en_web: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
en_kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipin ma amani anokhum jeng phat’uvin, vaipoten aponsil lhon ahoh lhauvin mol’a voh din thupeh aneitauve.

tcz: Chuin melsetah a avoh jouvun songkul'a akhumun, songkul ngah ho henga chun phatechan anga tup dingun thu apeuvin ahi.
en_web: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
en_kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
tcz_gospelgo: Mol’a tamtah vei avoh jouvun songkul’a akhum’uvin, songkul ngahpa chun kitup keiya a-nga din ahilchah tauve.

tcz: Hijeh chun songkul ngah hon asung dan langpeh a akeng teni akan khomun akoi tauvin ahi.
en_web: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
en_kjv: who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga hil chahna aneijeh-uvin songkul ngahpan songkul sung nung lama akoiyin, akhochong lhon’a bul atuh-in ahi.

tcz: Chuin jankhangkim laiyin Paul le Silas chu atao lhonin Pathen avahchoi lhonin ahile sonkula tangho chun angaiyuvin ahi.
en_web: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
en_kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan khangkim donin Paul le Silas Pathen henga atao lhona la asah lhon le sohchang dang hon angaiyuve;

tcz: Chuin phulou helouvin lingpi nasatah ahung kihot in, songkul khombul ho chu ahin hottan ahile, songkul kot jouse akihong tan, akihen na jouseu jong akilham tan ahi!
en_web: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
en_kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.
tcz_gospelgo: hichun photlot louvin lingnasa tah ahung kihot’in ahile songkul bul ahot kangsoh tan, apettah chun kotpi jouse akihong don tan, akihen nau bul jouse geiyin akilhamsohtai.

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa ahung khah doh le songkul kot jouse ana kihon amu phat chun asunga umho jouse jammang gam ahitai tin achem asatdoh in ama le ama akithat kigon ahi.
en_web: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
en_kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
tcz_gospelgo: Songkul ngahpa ahung kin khah le kotkhah jouse kihongsa um chu amun, sohchang jouse jamdoh hitante, tin ama kithah din achemjam asatdoh jenge.

tcz: Ahivang in Paul chun asamin, “Khongaiyin nang le nang kithat hih in! keiho kabon chauvin kaum nauve!” atin ahi.
en_web: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
en_kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul’in going tah-in asamin, “Kithat didng kigo hih hel’in keiho ka-umsoh keinauve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun mei akidet in asungdan langa alhailut in Paul le Silas masanga kithing pum pumin akisep lhutan ahi.
en_web: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
en_kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in aman meivah athum loiyin alhai lut’in, kichaa kithing thingin Paul le Silas angsunga alhu jengin,

tcz: Chuin polama ahin puidoh lhonin, “Pu huhhing'a kaumna dinga ipi kabol ngaiyem?” ati.
en_web: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
en_kjv: and brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
tcz_gospelgo: chuin amani chu ahinpuidoh-in, “Put e ni, huhhinga ka-umna dinga kabol khoh pen ding ipi ham?” atileh;

tcz: Amanin adonbut in “Nang le na insung miten Pakai Yeshua tahsanun chutile huhhing'a naum dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
en_kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanin, “Pakai Jesu tahsan le chun nang le na-insung mi huhhinga naum diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun ama le a insung mite to Pathen thu aseikhom tauvin ahi.
en_web: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
en_kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin ama le a-insunga um chengse jah a Pakai thu aseipeh lhontai.

tcz: Chuin hiche ni jan ma ma chun songkul ngahpa chun akijepna maha lhon chu asop theng peh lhon in, chuin a insung mite jouse toh baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
en_kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nidanle le hin janlaiyin songkul ngahpan amani chu apuiyin, avoh nau maha jouse asop theng peh-in, a-insung mite le ama baptize achangtai.

tcz: Hiti chun amani ding chun a insunga ankong aluidoh peh un Pathen atahsan jeh-u chun ainkouvin akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.
en_kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin amani chu ain’a ahinpuitouvin a-angsung lhona ankong aluipeh-in, Pathen atahsan jeh chun a-insung mite jouse to kipah thanom khom-uve.

tcz: Ajing jingkah in khopi vaihom ho chun songkul ngahpa henga, “Hiche mite chu soldoh in!” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
en_kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, Let those men go.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah phat’in vaipoten mi man sole ho asol’uvin, “Mi te ni chu lhadoh tauvin,” agatisah-ui.

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun Paul hengah aseiyin, “Khopi vaihom hon nang le Silas soldoh tan atiuvin ahi, hijeh chun lungmong in che hon tan,” ati.
en_web: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
en_kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun songkul ngahpan athu sei chengsu hi Paul jah a aseiyin, “Vaipoten nangni lhadohna thu sei din mi ahinsoltai; hijeh chun tun hungdoh lhonin lang lung mongin ch lhontan,” ati.

tcz: Ahivang in Paul in adonbut in, “Keini hi Rome mi kahi lhon in kholtoh louva mipi angsunga eivoh'u ahin, guhthima eisoldoh got'u chu hithei lou ding ahi. Hijeh chun amaho tah hungu henlang eisoldoh'u hen,” ati.
en_web: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
en_kjv: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahi vangin Paul’in miho jah achun, “Rome mi kihiya themmona beiya amahon japi maiya eivouva songkul’a eikhum’uva, tua guh thim’a iti tilhadoh diu ham? Hitheiponte, amahon eihung puidoh-u hem,” ati.

tcz: Chuin hiche thu chu khopi vaihom hon ajah doh uva Paul le Silas chu Rome mi ahi ahet doh phat un,
en_web: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
en_kjv: And the sergeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans,
tcz_gospelgo: Mi man sole hon athu hi vaipote heng alhut’u le, Rome mi ahi ti ajah phat’un akicha cheh kit’un,

tcz: Songkul'a ahungun amani koma chun ngaidam athum tauvin ahi. Chujouvin amani chu apuidoh uvin khopi sung dalha hon tan tin ataovun ahi.
en_web: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
en_kjv: and they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun aheng lhona kiphat lam thu ahung seiyun, apuidohuvin khopia kona potdoh dingin ajoltauve.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chu songkul'a kona ahung potdoh lhon phat in Lydia in'ah akile kit lhon in hiche in a seijui ho chu atilkhou lhonin chuin amanin khopi chu adalha lhon tan ahi.
en_web: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
en_kjv: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun amani songkul’a apotdoh-in Lydia avepa lhonin sopite to akimuto’uvin, atil khou lhonin apotdoh lhontai.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chun Amphipolis le Apollonia khopi ajot peh lhon in Thessalonica ahung lhung lhon tan ahi. Hichea chun Judah te kikhop na in aum in ahi.
en_web: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
en_kjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
tcz_gospelgo: Amphipolis le Apollonia jotpaiya Thessalonica khoa ahung lhon leh hia chun Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in khat aum’e.

tcz: Chuin abolngai bang in Paul chu Judah te kikhopna in'ah cholngah nikho thum kijom in achen Pathen lekhabu a pansan miho chu akihoulim pijin,
en_web: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
en_kjv: and Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
tcz_gospelgo: Achonna ngai banga Paul chu ahenguva alut’in, Choldo nikho thum sungin Pathen lekhabua konin mipichu akinelpi jin,

tcz: Miho koma chun themgao hon asei banga Messiah chun genthei athoh'a chule thina a kona kaithouva aumding thudol ahil chen jin ahi. Chule “Hiche Yeshua athudol kaseipa hi Messiah chu ahi,” atin ahi.
en_web: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
en_kjv: opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Messiah chun gin genthei athoh tei ding le thinaa kona atodoh tei ding thu ahilchenin phot chena aseipeh-in, “Nahenguva kaphondoh hiche Jesu hi Messiah chu ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Athusei ngaiho lah a Judah mi phabep le Pathen ging Greek mi chule numei mithupi phabep jaonan Paul le Silas thusei chu ajop uvin amani toh'a pang khom tauvin ahi.
en_web: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
en_kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun alah-uva mi phabep’in dih asauvin paul le Silas ajop’un, Pathen ging Greek mi tampin chule numei lal ho lah a jop’a jong atamuve.

tcz: Ahivang in Judah mi loikhat chu athangthip uvin hijeh chun kailhang dunga boina sem ho chu akoukhomun mipi atilseuvin, Jason in chu abulhu un, Paul le Silas chu mipi lah a kaidoh ing in ahol uvin ahi.
en_web: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
en_kjv: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Juda miho athangseuvin, khopi sung lamlen dunga pananbei mithase phabep akhomun, khopi sunga boina lentah asosah-uvin, Jason in abulu’vin, Paul le Silas ahol’un mipi lah a kaidoh din ago’uve.

tcz: Chuin amani amu lou phat uvin, Jason le seijui dang phabep chu khopi vaihom ho mansanga akaidoh un, chule mipi chun asamun, “Paul le Silas hin vannoi pumpia boina asosah lhon ahin tun eiho khopi sunga jong boina aso hon tai,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
en_kjv: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
tcz_gospelgo: Amani amu lou phat’un Jason le sopite phabep pi khopi sung vaipote angsunga akailut’un, “Hiche ho hi vannoi akhup athal’a leh ho chu ahiuvin, hikom ahinphah-u ahitai,

tcz: “Hiche thilsoh hi Jason in a-in'a alhunsah jeh ahin, chule amahon Caesar dounan achonun Yeshua kiti leng dang khat aume,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
en_kjv: whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Jason hin amaho alhunsah-in, ‘Jesu kiti leng chom khat aum’e,’ tin Caeasar thupeh chengse kal lhahnan abonchan na atongui,” tin asam’uve.

tcz: Hiche thudol hin Khopi mite le vaihom ho nasatah in alungboi sah tan ahi.
en_web: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
en_kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi ajah phat’un mipi le khopi sung vaipote jong anoh lheh jenguvin,

tcz: Chuin vaihom ho chun Jason le seijui dangho chu hunam'in akilhadoh theina dingun man apeh sah un chuin alhadoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
en_kjv: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
tcz_gospelgo: hijehchun Jason le midang hoa kilhadoh man alauvin amani chu alhadoh tauve.

tcz: Hiche ni jan ma ma chun seijui hon Paul le Silas chu Berea a dingin asoldoh tauvin, chuin amani Berea alhun lhon phat in Judah te kikhopna in'ah alutkit lhon in ahi.
en_web: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
en_kjv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopiten kinloi tah-in ajan janin Paul le Silas chu Berea khoa asoltauve; alhun lhon phat’in Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut lhon’e.

tcz: Berea mite chu Thessalonica mite sangin alungthim kot-u akihong jon, Paul thusei chu lunglut tah in angaiyun ahi. Niseh in Pathen Lekhabu asim jingun Paul le Silas chun thudih asei lhon hinam tin akhol chil un ahi.
en_web: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
en_kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
tcz_gospelgo: Berea khoa Juda miho chu Thessalonica khoa ho sangin along lenjo’uvin, lung opkai louhel’in thu asangun, athilsoh ho chu chute mong nam tin niseh le Pathen lekha to avetoh jiuve.

tcz: Hiche toh kilhon chun Judah mi tampi leh Greek mithupi numei le pasal tampin atahsan tauvin ahi.
en_web: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
en_kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin mi tampin atahsan lo tauvin, Greek mi numei lel ho le pasal ho jong atahan atam’uve.

tcz: Ahin Thessalonica a um Judah mi phabep in Paul le Silas in Berea a Pathen thu asei lhon'e ti ahetdoh phat un ahung un mipi atildoh un boina asosah un ahi.
en_web: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
en_kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Thessalonica khoa Juda mihon Barea khoa jong Paul’in Pathen thu asei phong ahet phat’un chukoma jong mipi ahung tiles kit tauve.

tcz: Chuin seijui ho chun thakhat tah in Paul chu twipi gal langkhat ah asoldoh un, Silas le Timothy vang chu aumden lhon in ahi.
en_web: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
en_kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
tcz_gospelgo: chuphat’in sopiten Paul chu Twikhanglen pamlama asol pai jengun, Silas le Timothy vang chua aumden lhon’e.

tcz: Paul thah doh a che ho chun Athens kho chanin alhon piuvin, chuin Silas le Timothy jong gangtah a Paul kom alhun lhon nading thu ahinpouvin Berea a ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
en_kjv: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul gathah hon Ahen khopi geiyin apuiyun, Paul’in Silas le Timothy chu ahenga hung loi ding adeina thupeh kengin ama ho ahung kile kittauve.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Athens khopi a Silas le Timothy anga sung chun khopi muntina milim ho chu amun alungthim ana lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
en_kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in Athen khopia Silas le Timothy a-nga pet’in khopi sunga limsemthudoi dimset’a kikoi amudoh-in alunng nalheh jenge.

tcz: Chuin ama kikhopna in'a alut in, Judah miho le Pathen ging chidang namdang hotoh Pathen thun akihoulim khomuvin, chule niseh in jalhanga jong amuho jouse koma asei jin ahi.
en_web: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
en_kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Houthua kikhopna in’a miho le Pathen ging ho toh akinel’in, kailhangdunga jong niseh leh ato phah chant oh akinel nel ji’e.

tcz: Hitichun Epicurean le Stoic chihgilna nei miho toh akinel'un, chuin Yeshua le athodoh chung chang thudol aseiyin ahile, amahon, “Hiche kamtam pa hin ipi hetkhah lou thukhat asei ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah a konkhat chun, “Hetphah lou pathen thu asei hile akilome,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
en_kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Epicurea loi le Stoic loi chihgut mihon Paul akinelpiuvin, alah-uva mi kon khat’in, “Hiche kamtam belbulpa hin ipi asei ding hi-nga na?” atiuvin, adang hon ma, “Gamdang miho hou, doi le kao asei ahitoh-e,” atiuve. Hiche hi ama Jesu le athodoh kit thu aseiphongjeh ahi.

tcz: Chuin amahon Paul chu khopi vaihom ho anga apuilut un, “Hiche thuhil thah hi keiho koma hung sei kit in,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
en_kjv: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Paul chu aman’un Areopagus molvum kikhopnaa apuiyun, “Hiche nasei thuhil thah hi kahetbe thei diu ham?

tcz: “Nang man thil chombeh thukhat naseiyin, hichu keihon kicheh tah in kahet nomuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
en_kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kajah-uva nasei abang bang hi alamdang lheh jengin, hijeh a chu hiche ho hi ipi kiseina mong ham ti kahet chet nom’u ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: (Hiche thuhil thah thudol a hin Athens mite le gamchoma kona hungkhom miho chun aphatseh in kihoulim nan anei tauvin ahi).
en_web: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
en_kjv: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
tcz_gospelgo: Athens kho mite le akhosunga cheng gamdang mi abonchauva ima dang gel louva thuthah thah seina le ngai naa phat amanjiu ahi.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu mipi kikhopna a chun ading doh in, hitin aseiyin ahi. “Athens mite ho, nangho hi imalam jousea hougut tah nahiuhi kamudoh in ahi;
en_web: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
en_kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul Areopagus lai lunga adingin miho adonbut’in, “Athen kho mite, ima lam jousea nang ho hi hougut tah nahiu kamui.

tcz: Ajeh chu kavah len ahile pathen kihouna muntheng tampi kamun, hiche maicham phung holah-a chun ‘hetphah lou pathen'a ding’ tia kisun khat kamudoh in ahi.” Keiman kasei hi hiche nahet phah lou u Pathen thu chu ahi.
en_web: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.
en_kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nahou mun chengu kavet le naa ‘Hetphah lou Pathen ding,’ tia kijih maicham khat kamu doh-e. Hiche nang hon het louva nahouvu hi keiman nahenguva kahung seiphong ahi.

tcz: Hiche Pathen chu vannoi leiset le asunga thil umjouse sempa ahin, hijeh chun Ama chu khut a kisa houin'a acheng pon,
en_web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
en_kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset le asunga um thil jouse sem Pathen, van le leiset Pakai chu mihem dem thu doiphung dunga apansapoi;

tcz: Chule mihem khut in angaichat ho apethei pon ahi ajeh chu aman ngaichat anei poi. Ama chun ahingthei jouse hinna apeh ahin, angai cha jouse ngaichat asuh bulhit peh ji ahi.
en_web: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
en_kjv: neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
tcz_gospelgo: thil ngaichat nei banga mihem khutsoh a jen lun glhai thei jong ahipoi; Amatah-in mi jouse ahinsah, ahaitheisah a chule thil ijakai apeh joh ahibouve.

tcz: Aman mihem khat a kona leiset pumpia namtin asemdoh ahin, namkhat hung kitundoh le lhahsuh ding jong aman ahet masah sa ahi, chule agamgi geiya aman adatkhen sa ahi.
en_web: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,
en_kjv: and hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
tcz_gospelgo: Aman mihem khat’a kona leiset chunga chang ding chitin namtin hijat asemdoh a, gamgi asekhenpeh cheh a aphat teppeh a achensah ahi;

tcz: Athilsem lona jeh chu namtin in ama ahol'uva amu theina dingu ahi ajeh chu ama eihoa kona gamla tah a umlou ahi.
en_web: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
en_kjv: that they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
tcz_gospelgo: amahon Pathen chu kinemtah a hol’uva amaikhah thei na diuva ahol ahin, ahinla Ama chu eiho koimacha dia jong gamla lou ahiye;

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho ama a ihin uva ama'a ichale theiyuva chule ama'a ihiu ahi. Nangho zaila cheng khat'a jong, “Eiho ama chilhah ihiuve” tin akisun in ahi.
en_web: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
en_kjv: for in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile: ‘Eiho Ama jal’a hinga, Chatloh, chule Amaa ihiuve,’tin nalah-uva chiguh sun hon aseiyui; ‘Tahbeh-in eiho ama chilhah ahiuve,’ tin aseinauve.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun eihon Pathen chu khutthem hon sana dangka ahiloule songa asemu milim hotoh ite loudiu ahi.
en_web: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
en_kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho jong Pathen chilhah ihijeh-uva chu mihem lunggel le khut them man chah a sana ham, dangka ham, song ham a limsemthu tobang chu Pathen hinte tia igel lou diu ahi.

tcz: “Hetlouva nabol laiyuva chu Pathen kimumosah ahin, ahin tua hi hoilai hijong le mijousen chonset lungheiya ama lam ahin bel nadinga thu apeh ahitai.
en_web: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
en_kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
tcz_gospelgo: Het loulai khang chu Pathenin avet thim ahin, tun vang mutin’a mi jouse lung aheina diuvin thu apei,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman vannoi thu atan ding nikho atepsa ahin, thudih'a thutan ding mikhat apansah in, ama chu mijouse mudin thina a konin akai thouvin ahi,” ati.
en_web: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
en_kjv: because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: ipijeh-inem itileh aman amilhendohpa amanchah a thudih a vannoi leiset hi thu atanna dinga nikho khat atepsa ahitan, hiche hi tahsan din amilhendohpa chu thinaa konin akaithoutai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul in thokit thudol asei chu ajauvin ahileh mi konkhat chun anuisat un, ahin adangho chun “Hiche thudol hi olleh kangai nom kit-ui,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
en_kjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
tcz_gospelgo: Thinaa kona thodoh kit thu ajah phat’un, mi phabep’in anuisat uvin, adang hon vang, “Hiche nasei hi ka-ngaikit nom’ui,” atiuve.

tcz: Hiti chun Paul in akihoulim nau achaiyin ahi.
en_web: Thus Paul went out from among them.
en_kjv: So Paul departed from among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul alailunguva konin apotdohtai.

tcz: Ahivang in amaho lah a mi phabep chun atahsan un anung ajui tauvin ahi. Amaho chu, vaipo loiho lah a mi Dionysius, Damaris kiti numeinu chule adang mi phabep ahiuve.
en_web: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
en_kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi phabep’in vang akilhonpiuvin atahsan tauve, alahuva hin Areopagus a kikhomji lah a mi Dionysius le Demaris kiti numei khat le adang ho jong ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Athens a kon in Corinth achetan ahi.
en_web: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
en_kjv: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jou vin Paul’in Athens dalhan Corinth ajontai.

tcz: Chuin hikoma chun Judah mi Aquila chu amun, amapa chu Pontus gam'a peng ahin, Italy gam'a kona Claudius Caesar in Rome a kona Judah te jouse ahin nodoh phat a ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhung til ahi lhone.
en_web: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
en_kjv: and found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Claudius lengpan Judate aboncha Rome a kona potdoh dia thu apeh jeh a Italy gama kona ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhungtil, Pontus gama peng Juda mi amin Aquila kiti chu akimupin, aheng lhona achen,

tcz: Paul chu amaho in'ah alhung in na atong khom jiuvin ahi ajeh chu ama banga pon-in sah them cheh ahiuvin ahi.
en_web: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
en_kjv: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
tcz_gospelgo: pon in sem ahicheh jeh-uvinm akiveinau akitha khat ahijeh chun akom lhona apansan na atongkhom’uve.

tcz: Hiti chun cholngah nikho seh le Paul chu kikhopna in'a achen Judah te le Greek mite chu thu ahil jin ahi.
en_web: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
en_kjv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo niseh leh Houthua kikhopna in’a Juda ho l eGreek mite chu thu aseitohpi jin jol lut tei din agoji’e.

tcz: Chuin Silas le Timothy jong Mecedonia a kona ahung suh lhon phat chun Paul in aphat nei jousen Pathen thu alhangsam in, Judah te koma Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin asam phong le tan ahi.
en_web: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
en_kjv: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Macedonia gama kona Silas le Timothy ahung lhun phat’in, Paul chu thu seiphongin bou apangin, Juda ho henga Jesu chu Messiah ahidol ahettohsah-e.

tcz: Ahin Paul chu adoudal uva alunghan sah jeh un, Paul in aponsil a leivui athing lhan, “Nangho thisan nangho chung ma ma ah chu hen, keima them mo nabei kahi, tunia pat'a chidang namdang te henga kasap phong ding ahitai,” atin ahi.
en_web: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
en_kjv: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla amahon adoudal’un, ataitomuleh, Paul’in aponsil ho athingin ajah-uva, “Manthaina naneiyu leh nang hon ma nakipoh diu ahi! Keiman themmona kaneipoi! Tua kalvang chiding namdang te henga kachei!” ati.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna inkoma cheng Pathen ngaisah mi Titius Justus in'ah chun alut tan ahi.
en_web: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
en_kjv: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun chua konin achen Pathen ngaisah tah mi amin Titus Justus kitipa in’a aluttai; ama in chu Houthua kikhopna in bantah ma ahi.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai loi Crispus le a-insunga umjousen Pakai atahsan un, chule Corinth a um midang tamtah'in jong Paul thusei chu ajauvin, atahsan un baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
en_kjv: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
tcz_gospelgo: Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Crispus chun a-insung mi chengse toh Pakai atahsanin, chule athu ja Corinth mi tampin jong atahsanun baptize achangtauve.

tcz: Jankhat Paul henga Pakaiyin gaovin akimusah in hitin ahin seiyin, “Kicha hih in! Paodoh in! Umthim hih in!
en_web: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
en_kjv: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
tcz_gospelgo: Jan’a Paul’in Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa Pakaiyin, “kichat dan, umthim louhel’in seijom jingin;

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman nangma kaumpi nai, chule hiche khopi sunga hin koiman nabulhu lou ding nabol gim lou diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche khopi sunga mitamtah hi keiya ahi,” ati.
en_web: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
en_kjv: for I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Keiman ka-umpi jingin, koiman suhset dia nanokhum lou ding ahi; ijeh-inem iti le hiche khopi sung jenga jong mihem tampi kaneiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Corinth a kum khat le akeh aumden in Pathen thu ahil len ahi.
en_web: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
en_kjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Paul kum khat le lhagup alah-uva apansan Pathen thu ahil hil jenge.

tcz: Ahin Gallio chu Achaia gamvaipoa ahung pan phat in Judah miho chu Paul dounan ahung sousang kit uvin, gamvaipo anga athu tan dingin ahin puiyun,
en_web: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
en_kjv: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
tcz_gospelgo: Achaia gam gamvaipoa Gallio apan laiyin Juda ho apangkhomun Paul aman’uvin thutannaa ahinkailut’un,

tcz: “Paul in eiho dan toh kikal a Pathen hou dingin mi ajol e,” tin aheh seuvin ahi.
en_web: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
en_kjv: saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichepa hin chonna dan nagilouva Pathen hou din miho ajol lha lhai,” atiuve.

tcz: Ahin Paul in akihonna thu asei toh lhon in Gallio in ahehse ho koma chun, “Judah miho, Ngaiyuvin, naheh nau thua hi thildih lou ahiloule thilse ajaukhah a ahile naheh nau hi kasanpeh ding nahiuve,
en_web: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
en_kjv: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi Paul pao akigot leh Gallio chun Juda ho jah a, “Vo Juda ho, namiheh nau hi suhkhelna ham khan gitlouna ham thu hileh kangaipeh ding nahiuvin,

tcz: Ahin tun naheh nau thuhi thudoh mai mai, min mai mai, ahiloule Judah te danthu mai mai ahijeh'in nang hon kivet sui tauvin, hitobang thuhi katan nompoi,” atin,
en_web: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
en_kjv: but if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho Danthua le min ho thudol vang nang hon kivet tup tauvin, hiche hoa hin keima thutanin pang ponge,” ati.

tcz: Thutanna in na kon in ahin soldoh tan ahi.
en_web: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
en_kjv: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin thutanaa konin aban nodohtai.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai Sosthenes chu mipi chun amanun, thutanna inmai laitah a chun avotauvin ahi. Ahin Gallio chun iman jong agelpeh pouve.
en_web: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
en_kjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Sothenes chu aman’un thutanna in mai laitah a avoh jeng vangun, Gallio chun donin aseppoi.

tcz: Chujouvin Paul chu Corinth ah phat chomkhat aum in chuin sopite ho koma lhahna thu aseiyin, akinaipi Cenchrea ajon tan ahi. Hiche laiya chun Paul in Judah te chona dan dung juiyin akitepna phat alhin phat in asam avoulhan, chuin Priscilla le Aquila toh Syria lam jon in konga akitol tauvin ahi.
en_web: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
en_kjv: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila: having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul chu nisot tah sopite toh aumkhomin, chuin amaho chutoh akilhan, Priscilla le Aquila toh lhonin Syria lam ajontai. Cenchreas khoa kitepna anei jeh-in sam akivoi.

tcz: Chuin Ephesus kongkaimun ahung lhun un, hichelaiya chun Paul in amani adalhan ama chu kikhopna in na alut in Juda techu asuhtoh peh in ahi.
en_web: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
en_kjv: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
tcz_gospelgo: Ephesus kho ahung lhun’un Paul’in amani dalhan, Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in Juda ho toh thu asuitoh-ui.

tcz: Hichea chun umsot jep ding in ana temun ahin anoppeh pon ahi.
en_web: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
en_kjv: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon nichong sot jep dia alho vangun anompon,

tcz: Adalhah ding kon chun, “Pathen lunglam ahile kahung kile kit ding ahi,” tin Ephesus a kon in konga akitol kit tan ahi.
en_web: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
en_kjv: but bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho toh akilhan, “Pathen lungdei ahileh nahenguva hung kit nange” atin, Ephesus khoa konin apotdohtai.

tcz: Chuin Caesarea kongkaimuna aki nga kit in, hichea kon chun Jerusalem houbung agavil in chuin Antioch a akile kit tan ahi.
en_web: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
en_kjv: And when he had landed at Cesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul Caesarea khopia akumlhan, Jerusalema achetouvin Houbung miho salam agabol’in, Antioch lama achesuh paitai.

tcz: Phat chomkhat Antioch a aum jouvin Paul chu Galatia le Phrygia lama akile kit in, seijui ho akimupi kit in asuhat kit in ahi.
en_web: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
en_kjv: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma chomkhat aum nungin akipatdoh-in Galitia le Phrygia gamkol muntin akhol len, seijuite aphutdet len ahi.

tcz: Alang khat'ah Egypt gam Alexandria a konin thusei them tah le Pathen Lekhabu thu hetah Judah mi Apollos chu Ephesus ahung lhung in,
en_web: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
en_kjv: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda mi Alexandria peng, amin Apollos kiti khat Ephesus khopia ahungin, amahi thusei them le Pathen lekhabua themtah jong ahi.

tcz: Ama chun Pakai lampi thu ahil in, chule midang ho chu dihtah le Lhagaova thaneitah in Yeshua thudol ahil in ahi. Ahinlah ama chun twilutsah John bou ahet ahi.
en_web: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
en_kjv: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
tcz_gospelgo: Apollos chu Pakai lampi kihil themsa, Lhagaova gunchu tah ahin, Jesu thudol aseiyin kitoh chet’in ahilnan, ahivangin John baptize chandol chubou anahei.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a hangsan tah a thu asei chu Priscilla le Aquila in ajah lhon phat in ama chu akoudoh lhon in Pathen thu kicheh tah in ahil chenbe lhon in ahi.
en_web: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
en_kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi akipat’in Houthua kikhopna in’a hakattah-in thu aseiye; ahinla Prisilla le Aquilan athusei ajah lhon phat’in apui lhonin Pathen lampi chu kichentah-in ahilchen lhone.

tcz: Chuin Apollos in Achaia gam'a che ding lung agel jeh chun sopite hon ama chu atil khouvun, chule Achaia gam'a seijui ho ding chun lekha khat athot un kipah tah a analem ding un angeh un ahi. Chuin alhun phat in Pakai mingailut jal'a atahsan ho jouse dinga mi phachom tah asoh tan ahi.
en_web: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
en_kjv: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
tcz_gospelgo: Apollos chu Achaiiiia gama ache nom phat’in sopiten atilkhou’un seijuiten anasan theina diuvin phatseina lekha jong asutpeh-ui. Ahung lhunin lungset vanga atahsante chengse hatah-in akithopi;

tcz: Judate chu lhang phongin thaneitah in anelkhup jin, Pathen thu dung juiyin Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin ahil chen jin ahi.
en_web: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
en_kjv: for he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile Jesu chu Messiah ahidol Pathen lekhabua konin phot chetna tampin Juda ho chu japi maiya anel khuptai.

tcz: Chuin Apollos Corinth a aum jing lai chun Paul jong chuche gamkai sunga chun avah len Ephesus ahung lhun chun seijui tampi amun amaho koma chun,
en_web: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
tcz_gospelgo: Apollos Corinth khopia aumpet’in Paul chun sahgam lam alhahpeh-in Ephesus khopia ahungle hikoma chun seijui phabep amun,

tcz: “Natahsan uva chu Lhagao Theng nachan nah uvem?” tin adong in ahile, amahon “Kachang pouve, Lhagao Theng aume akiti lam jong kajakha pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
en_kjv: he said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche ho jah achun “Natahsan’uva chu Lhagao Theng nachanu hinam?” atileh; amahon ajah a, “Lhagao Theng aum’e, tobon kija kha loulaiya,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin aman adong kit in “Ahileh ipia baptize chang nahiuvem?” ati. Amahon jong “John baptize chanin,” atiuve.
en_web: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
en_kjv: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John’s baptism.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Paul’in, “Ipipen tah a ba baptize chang nahiuvem?” atileh; amahon, “John baptize chansah bangin,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “John baptize chan chu chonset na a kon lunghei na ding bou ahi, ahin John jeng in jong miho jah a chun ama jouva hung ding pachu tahsanun,” ati, hichu Yeshua aseina ahi.
en_web: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”
en_kjv: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul’in, “John chun lung heina dinga baptize achansah a, anunga hung dingpa, Jesu chu atahsan theina diuva miho aseipeh ahibouve,’ ati.

tcz: Chuche thu ajah jah un abonchauvin Pakai Yeshua minin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
en_kjv: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu ajah phat’un amaho Pakai Jesu minin baptize achangun,

tcz: Chuin Paul in achung'uva khut angamin ahile, Lhagao Theng achung'uva ahung chutan, chule abonchauvin paochom athouvin gaothu asei tauvin ahi.
en_web: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
en_kjv: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in achunguva akhut te ni a-ngap le Lhagao Theng achunguva ahung chun, amahon paochom chom thon gaothu aseitauve.

tcz: Amaho chu abonun mi somleni ahiuve.
en_web: They were about twelve men in all.
en_kjv: And all the men were about twelve.
tcz_gospelgo: Abon’un mi som le ni tobang bep ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu kikhopna in'ah alut in hapta thum sungin hangsan tah in thu aseiyin, thununsah teina ding in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin ahi.
en_web: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
en_kjv: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: paul chu Houthua kikhopna in’ah alut’in, kicha louhel’in lha thum sungin miho chu Pathen leng gam thu asuitohpin, jollut tei din agoi.

tcz: Ahin mi konkhat chu alouchal uvin thu kisei chu sanglouvin, lhang phongtah in asei seuvin ahi. Hijeh chun Paul in kikhopna in chu adalhan seijui ho chu akipui doh'in Tyrannus muna thuseina in khat'ah niseh in akihoulim pitan ahi.
en_web: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
en_kjv: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mi phabep alouchal’a atahsan louvu toh chule mipi maiya chuche Lampi chu aseiset phat’uvin Paul’in amaho chu adalhan, seijuite apuidoh-in, niseh le Tyrannus kihilna in’a akihoulimpiji’e.

tcz: Hiti chun kumni jen abol'un ahile Asia gamsung pumpia Judah te le Greek mi abonchauvin Pakai thu chu ajatauvin ahi.
en_web: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
en_kjv: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum ni sunga hitia hi abol lehAsia gama cheng, Juda ho le Greek mite geiyin Pakai thu ajasoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in Paul chu bolmo kidang bolthei na tha ape tan ahi.
en_web: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
en_kjv: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin thil kidang seithei louhel hel Paul khut’in aboltan,

tcz: Chuti chun ultheh pon hihen lang achunga kai pon poupou hijong le achoiyun adamlouho chunga akoiyun ahile adamlou nau chu adamin asunga lhagao phalou ho jong ajamdoh jin ahi.
en_web: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
en_kjv: so that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul ultheh pon le a-op tomna pon ho san achoiyun ana damlouho henga apoh lut’u leh anat nauvin alhauvin lhagaoboh jo jong apotdohjitai.

tcz: Chuin Judah miho phabep khopi khat'a konin khopi khat ah avah leuvin, lhagao boh ho anodoh un, amaho chun Pakai Yeshua min pat ding agouvin, “Paul in alhangsap Yeshua mina thu kapeh nahi, hungpot in!” tin asei jiuvin ahi.
en_web: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
en_kjv: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Juda mi vahvei doithemnaa kivah loiyin jong lhagaoboh vopte chunga Pakai Jesu min apan’un, “Paul’in aseiphongle Jesu jal’a kahahsel nahiuve,” atitauve.

tcz: Hitia thil bol chu thempu lenloi, Sceva chate pasal sagi ho ahiuve.
en_web: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
en_kjv: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia bol ho chu Juda mi thempu pipu Sceva chapate ahiuve.

tcz: Ahin chutia nikhat abolgot kit laitah un lhagao boh chun, “Yeshua le Paul chu kahenai, nang koi nahiuvem?” atin ahi.
en_web: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
en_kjv: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lhagaoboh chun adanbut’in ajah-uva, “ken Jesu kahen Paul jong kahenai; nang ho koi nahiuvam?” ati.

tcz: Chuin lhagao boh voppa chu amaho chunga achomlut in amaho chu athajo in asugim tauvin ahile amaho chu sagohkeo le maha pun ajamdoh tauvin ahi.
en_web: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
en_kjv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leapt on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin lhagaoboh voppa chu achomin achunguva achuh jengle mi ni athajo paiyin, abonchauva athajosoh phat’in in’a kon chun sagoh keo le mapun ajamdoh tauve.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu Ephesus khopi sunga Judate le Greek mite hengah gangtah in akithe jal tan ahile, khopi sungah kichat tijatna adim tan, Pakai Yeshua min chu nasatah in ajabol tauvin ahi.
en_web: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
en_kjv: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
tcz_gospelgo: Athusoh hi Ephesus khopia cheng Juda mi jouse le Greek mi jousen ahesoh tauvin, akicha lheh jenguve; hijeh chun Pakai Jesu min aloupi cheh tai.

tcz: Chuin seijui tamtah ho chun achonset thilbol'u aphong tauvin ahi.
en_web: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.
en_kjv: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahnsan ho jong ahungun japi maiya atahsanu chu aphongdoh-un athilbol’u aseidoh tauve.

tcz: Chuin doichoi ho mitam tah'in jong a lekhabu-u ahin choi khom uvin, mipi ang sung laitah a agouvam tauvin ahi. Hiche alekhabu-u chu dangka tamtah man ahi.
en_web: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
en_kjv: Many also of them which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitpheldoi them tampin alekha jouseu ahinpo khom’un mitin mitmun ahalvam’uve; ahalvam sangsom nga alhinge.

tcz: Hiche Pakai natoh thudol chu muntina akithe jaltan thahat tah'in na atong tan ahi.
en_web: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
en_kjv: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Pakai thu hahattah-in akhang touvin ajousohtai.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin lhagao vin asoljeh chun Paul chu Jerusalem ache masang in Mecedonia le Achaia gam'a ding in achen, “Chujou tengle Rome a kache ding ahi,” tin aseiyin ahi.
en_web: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
en_kjv: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilsoh hicheng kichai nung hin Paul’in alungthimin Macedonia le Achaia gam chotsoh a Jerusalema chepai ding. “Hiche kichai soh teng Rome kagamutei ding ahi.” Ati.

tcz: Chuin ama Asia gam'a phat chomkhat aum nalaiyin, Timothy le Erastus chu akithopi ding in Mecedonia a amasol in ahi.
en_web: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
en_kjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin alhacha Timothy le Erastus Macedonia gama, asol’in, ama Asia gama chom khat aum nalaiye.

tcz: Chuche phatlai chun Ephesus ah hiche kithuhilna lampi chung changa boina khohtah khat ahung umdohtan ahi.
en_web: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
en_kjv: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lai hin chuche Lampi thudol’a boina chu thuneo them ahitapoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Demetrius kiti mikhat aumin, ama chu dangka a sumkolvei mi ahin, aman khutthem ho chu dangka in Greek te pathen Artemis lim akhen sah in hoitah in akoiyin ahi.
en_web: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
en_kjv: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile dang ka kheng them Demetrius kiti mi khat hin Artemis doilim houna inlim dangkaa asemdoh a, dangka kheng themho dia kiveina asohdoh chu thil neocha ahipoi.

tcz: Chuin aman anatoh kibah piho chu akou khomin ajah uva: “Mipi ho hiche sumkolvei na hi ihaodoh nau ahi,” ati.
en_web: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
en_kjv: whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche miho hi le asumkol veinau kibahpi chengse akoukhomin, “Mihem ho, hiche akiveinauva kona haodoh ihiunahecheh-ui.

tcz: “Ahin najah uva namu bang un, hiche Paul hin miho jouse koma khut a kisem limho hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi tin aseiyin mijouse alhemlha tai, chule hiche thuhi Ephesus khopi bouseh a asei ahipon Asia gamsung pumpia asei le ahi!
en_web: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
en_kjv: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
