tcz_gospelgo: Ephesus khopi sung goh hilouvin Asia gam pumpi chansah pai ding ahitan, hiche Paul hin mihem khut’a kisemthu ho hi Pathen ahipoi, tia mi aloi loiya tamtah ajol lhah a aheimang gam ahitai, ti mujong namu’uvin he jong naheuve.

tcz: Ahinai! Isumkolvei nau mijousen nahsah moa akoi ding thubou kasei ahipoi, ahin Artemis pathen houna in thupina jouse aman a, chule Asia gamsung pumpi le vannoi pumpia hiche pathen houna aman thah ding jong hi kagelkhoh tah khat ahi!” ati.
en_web: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
en_kjv: so that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi ikiveinau manlou asoding kichat aumgoh hilouvin ipathen len nu Artemis houin geiya nahsahmoa hung kibol’a, Asia gam pumpi le vannoi pumpin ahou cheh Pathen len nu geiya suhjuma hung umtah bah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichun akikhom miho chu alung hangjah jeng uvin, “Ephesus mite pathen Artemis alen'e,” tin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
en_kjv: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon hichu ajah tah-un along hang lheh jengun, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e,” tin asam cheh-ui.

tcz: Hichun khopi sunga miho chu alung boilah lah jeng uvin, mipi chun Paul hin kilhonpi Macedonia gam'a kon Gaius le Aristarchus chu amanun golseh vetna muna chun akailut tauvin ahi.
en_web: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
en_kjv: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun akhothingiin alingsoh jengun, mihon Paul toh hung jinkhom Massssedonia gam mi Gaius le Aristarchus chu aman’un japi lemkhomna in’a alhoh lut jengui.

tcz: Chuin Paul jong chu lut ding agon, ahin seijui hon analut sah pouvin ahi.
en_web: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
en_kjv: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul chu japi lailunga agalutnom vangin seijuiten aphal pouve;

tcz: Chuin Asia gamsung a Paul loi le gol milen milal phabep in Paul henga thu ahin thot un, golseh vetna muna lut loubeh ding in ahung taovun ahi.
en_web: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
en_kjv: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
tcz_gospelgo: Asia gam vaipo aloite phabep man japi lenkhomna in’a ahunglut louhelna din mi ahinsol’un ahung kham’ui.

tcz: Golseh vetna mun sunga chun mipi chu apeng lah lah un mi abangin thilkhat asamun, abangin thildang khat asamun, hiti chun aeu lah lah jenguvin, abangloi chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu jong ahepouvin ahi.
en_web: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
en_kjv: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
tcz_gospelgo: Akikhom chengse chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu ahetchet loujeh-un aboi lhehjengun, abang in thu khat asamun, kimkhat man thuchom khat asam’ui.

tcz: Chuin mipi lah a um Juda miho chun Alexander chu mipi masanga ahin sondoh un thilsoh thudol ahil chet dingin asolun ahi. Chuin aman mipi ho chu aphoh thip in houlim ding agon ahi.
en_web: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
en_kjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi phabep’in vang Judah on japi maiya ahinsot lut’u Alexander chu a ngoh-un, hijeh chun Alexanderin japi maiya akihonna seidin khut ajep’e.

tcz: Ahinlah mipi ho chun amapa chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat un, hatah in asamkit un, “Ephesus Artemis alen e, Ephesus Artemis alen e!” tin nidan ni lang asamun ahi.
en_web: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
en_kjv: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin mihon ma chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’un, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e!” tin o-khat tah-in nidan ni jen asam sam jengui.

tcz: Ajo jo nan khopi vaipopa chun mipi ho chu aphoh thip in aman, “Vo Ephesus mite, Ephesus khopi hi vana kona hung khelha Artemis len lim houin ngah ahi hi mijousen ahet ahi,” ati.
en_web: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
en_kjv: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun khopi sung lekha sunpan mipi aphoh thip’in, “Ephesus kho mite, Ephesus khopia hi Artemis len nu le van’a kona hung lenglha song theng kikoi ahi kon ahetmoa nabol’u ham?

tcz: “Hiche thutah hi koiman aseilep theilou ahijeh'in nangho thipkhen chan um unlang imacha kinothethun bol dauvin.
en_web: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.
en_kjv: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thil ho hi seitoh ahilou het’a thip beh a na-um’uva kholtoh louva jong chu namoh bol lou diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche napuilut-u mite hin houin'a konin imacha agudoh pouvin, eiho pathen dounan jong ima asei pouve.
en_web: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
en_kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea nahinkai lut jengu miho jong hi houin choma la ahipouvin, Pathen nu taitoma jong ahipouve.

tcz: Amavang Demetrius le anatoh kibahpi khutthem hon amaho hehset nading thu aneiyuva ahile thutanna in honsan aum jinge, chule gamvaipoho henga jong athu agasei theiyu ahi. Amaho koma khun ga kihehsah tauvin.
en_web: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
en_kjv: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun Demetrius le atoh khompi khut them hon mi khattou chunga lung lhai louna aneiyule kihehna in honsa ahin, thutan vaihom ho jong aum nauve, akiheh nom nom gakiheh tauhen.

tcz: Chule ahehnau thudang aumle vang angaiya kikhopna in'a athu tanding ahi.
en_web: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
en_kjv: But if ye inquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kalval’a thudang nahol’u aum vangleh angaiyin khoppilen teng seitoh ding ahibouve.

tcz: Ajeh beiya boina soh ahijeh'in ajole Rome vaipoten ichunguva thu ahin tan khah diu ham tin kichat nan kadime. Ajeh chu Rome vaipoten tuni thilsoh thudol hilchen dingin eihin dongule ima isei thei lou diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
en_kjv: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day’s uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu tuni boina thua hi mipi tilsea eiki-ngoh diu tijat kichentah a seithei ding jong i-umpouvin ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin mipi sousang na chu athip phat in Paul in seijui ho chu agakousah in atilkhou jouvin, damselun tin akikhen pin ama Macedonia lamah achetan ahi.
en_web: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
en_kjv: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi boina athip phat’in Paul’in seijuite akoukhomin, amaho atilkhou nungin akilhahpin Macedonia gam jonin akipatdohtai.

tcz: Chuche gamsunga ajotpa na khopi jousea seijuiho atilkhou peh in chuin Greece khopi chanin achesuh tan ahi.
en_web: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
en_kjv: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
tcz_gospelgo: Macedonia gamkol sungse se achotsoh a tilkhouna nasatah anei jouvin Greek gama ahung lhungtai.

tcz: Chuin hiche khopia chun lhathum sung aumin, Syria gam lama konga kinung tolding angaiton ahile Juda mi phabep in thading agot-u ahetdoh phat in Macedonia lang joh jotpa ding in akile kit tan ahi
en_web: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
en_kjv: and there abode three months: and when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche gama chun lhathum achamin, Syria gam jon’a achegot leh Judah on achanlhih jeh-un, Macedonia gam jot lhungkei kit din akigotai.

tcz: Ama chu mi phabep toh alhon in ahi. Amaho chu: Berea a kon Pyrrhus chapa Sopater, Thessalonica a kon Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe a kon Gaius, Timothy, chule Asia gam'a kona Tychicus le Trophimus ahiuve.
en_web: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
en_kjv: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Beroea khoa Pyrrhus chapa Sopater chun alhonpin, Thessalonica khoa Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe khoa Gaius le Timothy, Asia gam mi tychicus le Trophimus jong ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho chu ana masauvin Troas muna eina ngah un ahi.
en_web: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
en_kjv: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi anacheuvin troas khoa eina ngah-ui;

tcz: Chuin Kalchuh kut kichaiyin Macedonia gam'a Philippi khopia konin konga katouvun ninga jouvin Troas muna amaho heng kalhung uvin, chuin hiche muna chun hapta khat kaumun ahi.
en_web: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
en_kjv: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
tcz_gospelgo: keiho vang cholsolou changlhah kut jouvin phillippi khopia konin kongin kakitol’un ni-nga lhin nin Troas khoa ahengu kalhungun, hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui.

tcz: Chuin nimasa nin seijuiho toh Pakai anjon jong dingin kakikhomun hichea chun Paul in amaho henga thu aseiyin, ajing a ama chekit ding ahitah jeh chun jankim chan ahoulimin ahi.
en_web: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.
en_kjv: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
tcz_gospelgo: Choldo nikho jou ni masa nia changlhah nekhom din kakikhop’u le Paul’in ajing nikhoa che ding agot jeh-in jan khangkim geiyin miho thu ahil hil jenge.

tcz: Hiche kakikhop nau indan chungnunga chu meivah tamtah kide ahi.
en_web: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
en_kjv: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
tcz_gospelgo: Chungnung indan kakikhop nauva chun meivah tampi akivah-e.

tcz: Chuin Paul in phat sottah thu asei jeh chun bangkot koma tou gollhang chapang khat amin Eutychus atiu chu aihmutso beh seh jeh chun aihmulhutan ahile bangkot a kon chun in danthum a sanga chun akileh lhan noilama athisain aga muvin ahi.
en_web: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.
en_kjv: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chu gollhang amin Eutychus kiti khat bangkot geiya tou ahin, Paul’in thu aseisot jeh chun golhangpa hi aihmut asoh behseh jengin, anaihmu lhutan, chungnung indan thumnaa konin alha mangin ahileh athisan agaphongdoh-ui.

tcz: Chuin Paul akumsuh in abungin akhut in hiche gollhang chapang pachu apomin, “lungdong hih un ahing nalaiye” ati.
en_web: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
en_kjv: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul akumlhan golhangpa akoichah denin, “Tija hih-un, ajeh chu asunga ahinkho aum nalaiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amaho indan chungnunga akaltou kit-un Pakai anjon changlhah aneuvin ahi. Hiti chun Paul in thusei abanjom kit in khovah lhah phat in aman adalha tauvin ahi.
en_web: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
en_kjv: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
tcz_gospelgo: paul akaltouvin changlhah ahehbal bal’in, anen, jingkah khovah lhah geiyin miho to akihoulimin, chuin apotdohtai.

tcz: Alangkhat ah gollhang chapang pa jong chu akisuhkhah na beihel in inlam'a akilen ahileh mijouse chu alungmong lheh jengun ahi.
en_web: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
en_kjv: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon gollhangpa chu ahingin akipuiyun seithei louhel’in along mongui.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Assos chanin kenglamah ana chepeh in, keiho konga kacheuva chule ama kalahpa nadiuva agontoh ahi.
en_web: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
en_kjv: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon kong lam kajon’un, Paul chu kong sunga lalut din Assos lama kakitol’ui; ijeh-inem itile aman hiche geiya chu kenglama che ding agot ahiye.

tcz: Chuin hiche muna kon chun ama jong keihotoh konga katoukhomun Mitylene chan kacheuvin ahi.
en_web: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.
en_kjv: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in Assos mun’a eikimupi phat’un konga kalalut’uvin Mitylene lang kajontauve.

tcz: Ajing in Kios twikol kakhokhel un, akit-in Samos twikol kajot paikit un chule nikhat jouvin Miletus twikol kalhung uvin ahi.
en_web: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
en_kjv: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
tcz_gospelgo: Chua konin konga kakitol’un ajing nikhon Chios gal kalhungui; athai nin Samos kalhungun, athai nin Miletus kalhung tauve.

tcz: Chuin Asia gamsunga aumsot nom lou phat in Paul in konga touva Ephesus khopi jotpai ding lung angaito tan ahi. Kinotah a cheloiya ahithei le Pentecost masanga Jerusalem lhun teiding ati ahi.
en_web: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
en_kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Paul’in ahithei leh Pentecost nikhoa Jerusalema lhun tei ding agot jeh-in, Asia gama umsot louna din konga kitol’a Ephesus khopi chu palam ajotpa ding agot ahitai.

tcz: Ahin Miletus kalhun un Ephesus Houbung a um upa ho henga ahung kimupi diuvin thu athot tan ahi.
en_web: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
en_kjv: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in Miletus khoa konin Houbung upaho kou din Ephesus khoa mi asol’e.

tcz: Chuin amaho ahung lhun phat un aman “Nanghon naheuve, Asia gamsung kahung chotlut nikhoa pat tuni chanin,
en_web: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
en_kjv: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
tcz_gospelgo: UPaho ahenga ahung phat’in Paul chun ajah-uvah, “Asia gam kahin chotlut’a pat hitih chan’a hi itobang nang ho toh kalhat khom umchan naheuvin,

tcz: Kineosah tah le mitlhi pumin Pakai na katongin, Judate a kona gimbolna tamtah jong kathoh in ahi.
en_web: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
en_kjv: serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
tcz_gospelgo: Juda hon eichan lhih jinguva thoh hesoh tampi kachunga alhunvangin nun nemtah le mit lhi pumin Pakai kin kabol jing jin;

tcz: Chule nangho jahding imacha imlouvin, japi lah le intin'ah kahilleuvin ahi.
en_web: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
en_kjv: and how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
tcz_gospelgo: itobang tah a in beihel’a thil phachom ding chu japi lah hihen intin hijongle nang ho kahilji hitam!

tcz: Juda te le Greek te henga thukhat seh hichu, chonsetna a kon lungheiya chule Pathen lama kiheiya, chule Pakai Yeshua tahsan ding thubou chu kasei jing ahi.
en_web: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
en_kjv: testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Juda ho hihen Greek mite hijongle kibang cheh-in Pathen lama lung aheiyuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa atahsanna diuvin kahetsahji’e.

tcz: Tun keima Lhagaovin Jerusalema cheding in eisom tan, ipin einga ham jong kahepoi.
en_web: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
en_kjv: And now behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
tcz_gospelgo: Chule tan ven, Lhagaova kigahna jeh-in Jerusalem lam kajonin, chukoma kahcunga ipi ahung lhun ding kahepoi;

tcz: Khopi tina Lhagao Theng in eihetsah bangin thohgim nale songkul tanna tailou ima kahepoi.
en_web: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
en_kjv: save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi jousea kanchalna le hesoh gentheinan ei-nga jing bou Lhagao thengin eihetsah ahi.

tcz: Ahin Kahinkho hi Pakai Yeshuan einganse na banga midang te henga Pathen mingailut na kidangtah kipana thupha sapphong na natoh na a kamanchah lou le thildang aman nading kahepoi.
en_web: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
en_kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Pathen lungset Kipana Thupha hettohsah ding Pakai Jesua kalah katoh ding kin hi kamolso poule kahinkho jeng jong hi imacha man din ka-it chapoi.

tcz: Chule tunia Pathen Lenggam thudol kaseipeh miho hin keima eimukit tah lou diu ahi.
en_web: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
en_kjv: And now behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva chelae Pathen langgam seiphongle kahin, ahinla ven, nang hon kamai namukit louhel diu tan kahetai.

tcz: Tu nikhoa hi kaphondoh ahi, keiman kitah tah a kaseipeh nahiuvin nalah uva koi tobang khat tonsot thina toh aumkhah a ahile keima thepmo ahi tapoi.
en_web: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
en_kjv: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu tunia kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amangthah um jongleur chun mi kapopoi;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in nangho hetsah dinga adeisah jouse imlou hel a kasei peh nahi tauve.
en_web: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
en_kjv: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile nahenguva Pathen lungdei apumpia hetsah lou in mang kaneipoi.

tcz: Chule tun, chingtheiyun, nanghon Pathen kelngoi hon, a thisan'a achohdoh houbung, chu vah unlang chingtup un, hiche dinga chu Lhagao Theng in upa a napansah-u ahi.
en_web: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
en_kjv: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichih thieyun lang nachin diuva Lhagao Thengin napeh-u kelngaohon chunga jong ching theiyun, Pathenin athisana achohsa a-Hobung chu ching them’uvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu kadalhah tengu le nangho lah a kona ngeihang tobang thuhillhem hunglut a kelngoi ho hi khatcha ahin hoilou ding kahei.
en_web: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
en_kjv: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Kache nungle ngei giloutah tah nalah-uva hung lut’a kelngoihon hi adep louhel dingkahetai;

tcz: Chule nangho lah jenga jong hi mi phabep in amaho thu ahinjop a thutah chu akaleh a ahin hil dingu ahi.
en_web: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
en_kjv: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho lah akona jongmi hung kipat’uva thu akaleh akalouva seiya seijuite phabep geiya apui manguva akijuisah diu ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho kiging phauvin! Kumthum sunga asun ajana mitlhi tamtah puma kaumpiu chu geldoh jingun.
en_web: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
en_kjv: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kiging phauvin, kum thum sunga tang louhel’a sun le jan’a mit lhi puma nachang cheh-uva katilkhou jing chu geldoh jingun.

tcz: Chule tunia hi keiman nangho hi Pathen le amingailutna thu alhenchomte toh goulo khom dinga natungdoh theiyu thua chu kanganse nahiuve.
en_web: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
en_kjv: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule tua hi nang ho khantousah thei le suh thengsa ho lah a gou chankhomsah thei Pathen le alungset thua nang ho kakhum lut nahitauve.

tcz: Keiman koima dangka le Sana chule nihchen ponsil hoi kaotcha poi.
en_web: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
en_kjv: I have coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima dangka sana, nihchen ponsil kadeipoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu kakhut a kona keima ngaichat le kaum khompi ho ngaichat ding katoh a kakivah ahi.
en_web: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
en_kjv: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kei le kaloi ho ngaichat chan hiche kakhut te ni hin abol bulhit jing nang ho tah-in nahet’u ahi.

tcz: Chule na hatoh a toh'a migenthei ho kithopi ding dan keima tah hinkhoa namu-u ahitai. Pakai Yeshuan ‘Akisan ho sanga apeho nunnom jo ahi’ ati chu geldoh jing un.”
en_web: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
en_kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu amatah-in,’Lah sangin peh nopnajo ahi,’ ati chu geldoh jinga na hatoh a alhasam chatmo ho kithopi theina dia thil ijakai najui diuvin kavetsahsoh tauve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin thu asei jouvin adilsun amaho toh ataokhomun ahi.
en_web: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
en_kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in thu hicheng aseiyin dilsun abonchauvin ataopitai.

tcz: Amaho abonchauvin akap'un akikoiyun damselin tin akikhen tauvin ahi.
en_web: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
en_kjv: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul’s neck, and kissed him,
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in abonchauvin akap-un, Paul akoiyun achop’uve;

tcz: Neimu kit tah lou diu ahi ati jeh chun amaho abonchauvin lungngui tah in ama chu kong muna agathah tauvin ahi.
en_web: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
en_kjv: sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
tcz_gospelgo: ajahuva, amai amukit lou diu aseijeh tah jong chun na asa behseh jengun ahi. Chuin kong mun geiyin ahung thah-ui.

tcz: Chuin Ephesus houbung upa ho henga lhahna thu asei jouvin, Cos twikol jonin konga kakitolun, ajing in Rhodes kalhung un chule chua kon chun Patara kajonun ahi.
en_web: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Cos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
tcz_gospelgo: Upaho toh kakilhauvin jangkeiyin kongin kakitol’un Cos kalhungui; ajingin Rhodes kalhungun, chua konin Patera kalhunguve;

tcz: Chua kon chun Phoenicia jonding kong khat ah katoudoh un,
en_web: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
en_kjv: and finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
tcz_gospelgo: chuin Phoenica jotpa ding kong khat kamu’vin, kong chun katouvun kakitoltauve.

tcz: Chule Cyprus twikol chu kagalmu phat un, veilama kakiheiyun Syria gam'a Tyre kongkaimun ah kakinga uvin hichea chun konga thilho chu asolhauvin ahi.
en_web: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
en_kjv: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
tcz_gospelgo: Cyprus twikol akimu phah phat’in veilam ngan kapel’un Syria lam jonin kakitol paiyun, konga thil solhah ding aumjeh-in Tyre khopia ka-ki-ngauve.

tcz: Chuin vapam achun kavah leuvin ahile seijui phabep kaga mudoh un, amaho koma chun hapta khat kaumun ahi. Hichea seijuiho chun Lhagao Thenga konin gaothu aseiyun, Paul chu Jerusalema chejom lou dingin aseiyun ahi.
en_web: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Seijuiho kaholdohun hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui; Lhagaova konin amaho hin Paul Jerusalema ache ding ajadauve.

tcz: Chuin hapta kichaiya konga kanung kaldoh ding phat un, mipi jouse, numei chapang jaonan, khopi sunga konin vapam chan'ah ahung kumsuh un, hichea chun, dilsun kataovun,
en_web: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
en_kjv: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho chujat kanichon jouvun kakipatdoh-uvin kholjin ban kamasot tauve; hichea hin seijuite chu ajite achateu pumin khopi kulpamgeiyin eihung thah-un, Twikhanglen pamchin’a dilsun kataovun, khat kaht’in kakilhauvin,

tcz: Chule lhahna thu kaseiyun chuin keiho konga toudoh ding in kacheuvin, amaho jong inlam cheh a akile tauvin ahi.
en_web: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
en_kjv: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
tcz_gospelgo: keiho kong sunga kakaldoh-un, amaho inlama akiletauve.

tcz: Tyre kadalhah jou uva kakingah nau masapen chu Ptolemais ahi. Hichea chun sopi numei le pasal ho chibai kaboh pauvin amaho henga chun nikhat kakibangpa uvin ahi.
en_web: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
en_kjv: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
tcz_gospelgo: Twichung kholjin chainan Tyre a konin Ptolemais gei kaki tol’un, hikoma chun sopite salam kabol’un akom’uvah nikhat kanichongui.

tcz: Ajing in Caesarea lamah kache paiyun, an homle dinga mi sagi kilhengdoh ho lah a mikhat Evangelist Philip in'a chun kalhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
en_kjv: And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Cesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon kakipatdoh-un Caeasarea kalhungun, sagi lah a Philip Evangelist pu in’a kalut’uvin amatoh ka-um khom’uve.

tcz: Amapa chun chanu jinei lou li aneiyin amaho chu abonun Lhagao thilpeh gaothu seina achangun ahi.
en_web: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
en_kjv: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
tcz_gospelgo: Philip hin cha nu jinei loulai cheh li aneiyin, amaho hi gaothuseiyin apangui.

tcz: Chuin nikho tamtah jouvin Lhagao thilpeh gaothuseina chang Agabus kiti mikhat, Judea gam'a konin ahung in.
en_web: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
en_kjv: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho phabeppi chukoma ka-um laiyu hin Judea gama konin amin Agabus kiti Themgao khat ahungsuh-in,

tcz: Paul konggah chu alan, ama khut le keng chu asomin, “Lhagao Theng in aphondoh ahi, hiche konggah neipa hi Jerusalema Judate lamkai hon amat uva chidang namdang te henga apeh doh dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
en_kjv: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul’s girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that oweth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: kahengu ahinjonin Paul konggah chu alan akhut te ni le akeng te ni akikanin, “Lhagao Thengin hitia hi, Jerusalema Juda mihon hiche konggah neipa akan’uva chiding namdang ho khut’a apehdoh diu ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin hiche gaothusei kajah phatun keiho le amuna um seijui hon Paul henga Jerusalem ache lou na dingin kataovun ahi.
en_web: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu kajah phat’un keiho le chukoma um mihon Paul chu Jerusalema chetou lou din kaholtauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Paul in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga kap nahiuvem? Kalungthim nasujun uve! Keima chea songkul tanding mai mai hilouvin Pakai Yeshua min a thidinga jong gotsa kahitai,” ati.
en_web: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
en_kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Paul’in adonbut’in, “Ibol nahiuva kap’a kalung nasuhdoiyu ham? Ajeh chu kanchal ding keo hilouva Jerusalema Pakai Jesu min’a thi dinga kogosadema um kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin keihon kahet chet phat un imacha kaseibe tapouvin, “Pakai lunglam himaihen,” katiuvin ahi.
en_web: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
en_kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
tcz_gospelgo: kathu nun joulou phat’un kahaiyun, “Pakai lunggot got himai hen,” katitauve.

tcz: Chujouvin kathilhou kagong tup un Jerusalema dingin kache tauvin ahi.
en_web: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho phabep jouvin kakigouvin Jerusalema kachetouvun,

tcz: Chuin Caesarea a konin seijui phabep in eilhon piuvin, chuin Cyprus gammi seijui masaloi Mnason in'ah eipui lut un ahi.
en_web: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
en_kjv: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
tcz_gospelgo: Caesarea konin seijui phabep’in eilhonpiuvin, amaho hin kalhunna dingpau, Cyprus twikol’a mi Mnason kitipa in’a chun eipuilut’uve.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem kalhun un amuna um sopi numei le pasal hon phatechan eina vailhunun ahi.
en_web: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
en_kjv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
tcz_gospelgo: Jerusalem kalhun’u le sopiten kipah tah-in eina sangui.

tcz: Ajing in Paul jong Jacob toh kimuto ding in keiho toh kalhonun, hichea chun Jerusalem houbung upa ho jouse jong aumun ahi.
en_web: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
en_kjv: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajingnikhon keiho toh lhonin Paul chu Jacob kimupin achen, upaho chengse jong akimkeiyui.

tcz: Chuin chibai aboh jouvun Paul in Pathen in chidang namdang te chunga kidang tah a na atoh ho abonchan aseitan ahi.
en_web: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
en_kjv: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho asalam soh phat’in Paul’in alhacha natohnaa kona chiding namdangte lah a Pathen thilbol chengse chu abonchan aseitai.

tcz: Chuin Paul thusei ajah phat un Pathen avahchoiyun ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun “Ngailut umtah sopipa Juda mi sang tamtah'in jong atahsan uva chule Mose danjong phatecha ajui uhi nahet em?
en_web: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
en_kjv: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon hichu ajah phat’un Pathen avahchoiyuvin ajah a, “Sopi, atahsan te lah a Juda mi sang ijat pang tam ti namui, abonchauva Danthua tom ngaitah ahiuvin,

tcz: Ahinlah Jerusalema Judami atahsan ho hin, nangman chiding namdang te lah a cheng Juda mi seijui hon Mose dan anungsun dingun thu nahil e ti ajauvin, achateu chep atan lou diu chule chonna dan adang dang jong ajui lou diuvin thu nahil e ti aheuvin ahi.
en_web: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
en_kjv: and they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
tcz_gospelgo: nang hin chiding nam dan glah a cheng Juda mihon Moses Danthu apaiyuva, achateu chep tandaa chule puchon pachon adonda diuvin ahil’in asei lei tin min aseipeh-uve.

tcz: Nangma nahung hila ahet teiding'u ahin, ipi ilo diu hitam? Atiuvin ahi.
en_web: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
en_kjv: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi iti ding hitam? Nahunghi la ajah tei diu ahitan;

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche nabol ding hi pha kasauve. Hichea hin kitepna neijou mili aumun, aluchang'u kivotol dinga kigong ahiuve.
en_web: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
en_kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin i-khat seipeh unge hichu bol’in; kitepna neisa mi li kaneiyun,

tcz: Amaho toh hin lhon inlang Houin a gakisutheng unlang, chonna dan dungjuiya sam avo nadingun seipeh in, chutile mihon athujah jouseu hi alhem ahin, chule nangma tah jeng in jong Judate dan ajuinai ti hi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
en_web: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
en_kjv: them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho hi puiyin lang acholamu topeh-in, nangma jeng jong amaho hitoh kisuthengin, chutile sam akivo thei diu ahin, chuteng nangma nasa tah-a chondan nit mi nahi, nachung change thu kithang jou ahidol mitinin ahet soh diu ahi.

tcz: Chidang namdang seijuite vang chu lekhathot a isei jouseu banga chon dingu ahi. Milim anga kikatdohsa an aneh lou dingu, thisan ahiloule hetlou sa aneh lou dingu, chule jonthanhoina a kona kikangse dingu ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
en_kjv: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan chiding namdang ho thudol vang hi limsemthu houna doithil neh lou ding, thisan neh lou ding, alol kimeh a kithatsa neh lou ding le jonthanhoi bol lou ding thua lekha ithotsu ahitai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu ajing in hiche mili ho toh chun Houin a acheuvin, kisuhtheng na achelhah pi un, chule mipi angsunga chun phongtah in kisuhthengna nikho kichai niding le amichan cheh a kilhaina abol diu thu aseiyin ahi.
en_web: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
en_kjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Paul’in miho chu apuiyin, ajing nikhoa amatoh kisuh thengna kin abolsoh phat’uvin itih tah le kisuh thengna nikho kichaiya chule amaho mi khat khat dia chu kilhaina gantha itih a kibol ding ham, ti hetsah din Houin agalut’e.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi kichai konin Asia gam'a kona Juda mi phabep in houin sunga Paul amudoh phat un, mipi chu atilseuvin aman tauvin ahi.
en_web: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
en_kjv: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
tcz_gospelgo: Nisagi alhin ding konchan Asia gama hungkon Juda mihon Houin sunga Paul amudoh-un, japi atilseuvin achunga khut alhauvin aman’un,

tcz: Chuin amahon aseiyun, “Israel mite nei kithopiuvin! Hiche mipa hin muntina eiho dounan thu asei jing in, chule mijouse koma Judate chonna dan ajui lou nadingun thu aseiye. Houin dounan thu aseiyin, chule Houin jenga jong chidang namdang te ahin puilut in asuboh in ahi” atiuve.
en_web: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
en_kjv: crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
tcz_gospelgo: “Israel mite, neipanhu’uvin, muntin’a mipi le Danthu chule hiche mun douna thu hil lepa ama hi ahi; hiche keo chu hilouvin Houin sunga Greek miho ahinpuilut’in hiche Muntheng phung ho asubohtai,” tin asamtauve.

tcz: (Ajeh chu hiche masang jep'a chu Paul chu khopi sunga Ephesus mi Trophimus toh amu thau ahi. Paul chun hiche mipa chu Houin'ah puilut teiyinte tia agelu ahi.)
en_web: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
en_kjv: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
tcz_gospelgo: Miho chun Paul le Ephesus gam mi Trouphimus khopi sunga akiloile amujeh-uva Houin sunga jong apuilut tei dia agin mou ahi.

tcz: Chuin hiche ahehset nau hin khopi sung chu ahotling tan, chule boina asousang tan ahi. Chuin Paul chu houin'a konin gangtah in akaidoh un kelkot akhah chah tauvin ahi.
en_web: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
en_kjv: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun khopumpi akithingun, mipi alhaikhom loiyun Paul chu aman’uvin Houina konin akaidoh-un, kotpi chengse akhah paitauve.

tcz: Chutia Paul tha ding agot laiyun, Jerusalem mite asousang thu chu Rome sepaite vaipi popa heng alhung tan ahi.
en_web: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
en_kjv: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon Paul tha dia agot lai tah-un Jerusalem kho pumpi boi thu hi sepai vaipipo kam ahung lhungin,

tcz: Gangtah in asepai hole alamkai hotoh mipi lah a chun achesuh tauvin ahi. Chuin mipi chun sepai vaipi popa le asepai ho hung kumsuh chu amu phat un Paul avoh'u chu anga tauvin ahi.
en_web: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
en_kjv: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
tcz_gospelgo: aman jong apettah chun sepai jalamkaiho le sepaihon apuiyin aselsuh jengu leh, mihon sepai vaippipo le sepaiho amuphat’un Paul avohda tauve.

tcz: Chuin vaipipo chun Paul chu akan'in, thihkhao nia hen ding in thu apen, chuin mipi ho koma chun hiche mipa hi koiham chule ipi abolset ham tin adong tan ahi.
en_web: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
en_kjv: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun sepai vaipipon anailut’in Paul amanin, thih khao nia kan din aseiyin, chuin, koihiya ipi asuhset ham ti akholtoh-e.

tcz: Chuin mi abangkhat in thilkhat asamin, chule abangkhat chun thildang khat ma asamun ahi. Chutia mipi eu jeh le kicheh loujeh chun ima thudih ahedoh thei tapon, hijeh chun Paul chu kulpi sunga apuilut ding'un thu apetan ahi.
en_web: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
en_kjv: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin mipi lah a abangin thuchom asamun, phabep khat man thuchom beh asamui; hitia chu aboi behseh jeh-u chun ipi mong iti ham ti ahetdoh thei lou phat’in Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut din aseijotai.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu kulpi sung alut kigon ahile mipi ho jeh chun alut thei tapon hijeh chun ama ventup nading in sepai hon alengkouvun aput thouvin ahi.
en_web: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
en_kjv: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Japi aphut deng dung phat’un kalbileiya alempet’in jong Paul chu sepaihon adop thobouvui;

tcz: Chuin mipi ho chun anung ajuiyun “Thatdoh un, thatdoh un,” tin asamun ahi.
en_web: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
en_kjv: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu mipin ahinjuipeh-un, “Sumangun!” tin asam jengui.

tcz: Chuin Paul kulpi sung alhut ding konun, vaipipo koma atauvin, “Nakoma thukhat kasei thei ding ham? ati. Chuin vaipipo chun kidang satah in Greek pao nahet em, tin adong in ahi.
en_web: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
en_kjv: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
tcz_gospelgo: Paul kulpi sunga akailut kon’un aman sepai vaipopa jah a, “Nahenga thu them khat sei theiying em?” ati leh; aman, “Greek pao nahet’em?

tcz: Nangma Egypt mi, masang laiya miho tilsea mi sangli gamthip'a loidoh pachu nahi louham?” ati.
en_web: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
en_kjv: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hi Egypt mi, tu masang jep’a mihem sang li jen gamthip laiya loidoh a jelen gal bolsah chu nahilou ham?” ati.

tcz: Paul in adonbut in “Kahipoi, keima Tarsus gam'a khopi thupitah Cilicia a kon Judah mi kahibouve amaho toh hin nei kihousah in,” atin ahi.
en_web: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
en_kjv: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Paul’in, “Keima Cilicia gam Tarsus khoa cheng Juda mikahin, khopi mai maiya mi kahipoi; nahenga kataove mipi jah a thu neiseisah-in,” ati.

tcz: Chuin vaipipo chun anoppeh jeh chun, Paul chu kalbi a chun ading in mipi ho chu thipbeh a umdingin atemin, chuin mipi thipchet'a aum phat in amaho pao Aramaic in ahoulimin ahi.
en_web: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
en_kjv: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai vaipipon aphalpeh phat’in Paul kalbileiya adingin mipi akhutjap leh, athip chet phat’uvin Paul’in Hebrew paovin thu aseiyin:

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “Sopite le jaumtah pateho, kakihonna thu kasei hi ngaiyuvin,”
en_web: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
en_kjv: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: “Sopite le pate ho tua na angsunguva kakihonna thu kasei ding hi nei ngaipeh-uvi,” ati.

tcz: Amaho paova thu asei chu ajah phat un mipi ho chu athipchet jengun,
en_web: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
en_kjv: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in a jah-uva Hebrew paova thu asei ajah phat’un ahathip chehuvin, hichun aman:

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “Keima Tarsus gam'a Cilicia khopia peng Juda mi kahin, chule chihna thepna lama Jerusalema Gamaliel noiya hung seilen kahi. Ama noiya hung seilen khat kahi jeh chun Judate dan le chonna ho phatecha hung kijil kahi. Tunia nangho jouse banga hi Pathen a dinga tompan tah mi kana hin ahi.
en_web: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
en_kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous towards God, as ye all are this day.
tcz_gospelgo: “Kei hi Cilicia gam Tarsus khopia cheng Juda mi kahin, hiche khopia Gamaliel khonung juiya, ipu apateu Dan dungjuiya kikheltah a them, tunia nang ho banga hi Pathen dinga tom ngaitah kahi;

tcz: Chule anung juiho ka sugentheiyin, abang kathat jin, chule numei pasal kamanin songkul'ah kakhum jin ahi.
en_web: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
en_kjv: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche Lampi juiho chu thina geiyin kabolsen, numei pasal’in kakanin songkul’a din kapedoh doh jin,

tcz: Thempu chung nung le kivaihom na upa hon hiche hi eihetpeh-u ahi. Ajeh chu Damascus a um sopi Judate henga kahunga Christian ho kamat a suhgenthei dinga Jerusalema ka hin kai nadinga amaho koma phalna lekha kahin kichoi ahi.”
en_web: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
en_kjv: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there, bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
tcz_gospelgo: athu hi Thempu chungnung le upa chengse ahetoh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Damascus khoa um sopite gamat’a kanchal jenga Jerusalema hinpuiya talen matsahna ding lekha kipoh-in kachei.

tcz: Ahin Damascus khopi lut ding kon lampi laitah ah, hichu sunkim ahin, hichun vana konin vah hattah khat in kakimvel ahin kho tan,
en_web: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ddamascus kho kom kageiyin, sunkim don hin phulou helouvin van’a konin vah nasatah ahung vahin kakimvel asalvah soh jenge,

tcz: Keijong tol'a kalhu jeng in ahile aw khat kajan, “Saul, Saul, ipi dinga neibolset jing ham?” ahin tin ahi.
en_web: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
en_kjv: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
tcz_gospelgo: keila tola kalhutan, kajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a neibolset set ham?” ti ogin khat kajai.

tcz: Chuin ken jong, “Nang koi nahim?” kati. Chuin aw chun eihin donbut in “Keima nabolset jing Nazareth Yeshua chu kahi” ahin tin ahi.
en_web: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
en_kjv: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong kadonbut’in, ‘Koi nahim Pakai?’ katile, aman kajah a, ‘Nabolset set Nazareth Jesu chu kahi,’ ati.

tcz: Chuin kakilhonpi miho chun vah chu amuvin, ahin kakoma thusei aw chun ipi asei ham ahe pouve.
en_web: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
en_kjv: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalhonpi hon vah chu amu’vin kahenga thuseipa ogin vang chu ajapouve.

tcz: Hichun “Ipi kabol ding ham Pakai” tin kadong in ahile, Pakaiyin eihin donbut in “Thoudoh inlang Damascus khosunga khun lut in chuteng ipi nabol ding nakisei peh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
en_kjv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun keiman, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam Pakai?’ katile, Pakai chun kajah a, ‘Kipatdoh-in lang Damascus khopi sunga lut’in, hikoma chu natoh dia kigo chengse aboncha nakiseipeh ding ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Vah hattah jeh a kamit in kho amutah lou jeh in kalhonpi ho chun kakhut in eikaiyun khopi sunga eikailut un ahi.
en_web: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
en_kjv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
tcz_gospelgo: Vah loupe behseh jeh-in kho kamutapon, kalhonpi hon khut’in eikaiyun Damascus khosung kaluttai.

tcz: Hichea chun Ananias ana cheng in ama chu Pathen gingtah mi ahin Judate dan juithem tah le Damascus khopia um Judate jousen angaisang tah mi khat ahi.
en_web: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
en_kjv: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
tcz_gospelgo: “Damascus khoa chun Juda mihon aseiphat cheh-u, Danthu dudngjuiya Pathen ngaisah tah, Ananias kiti mi khat aumin,

tcz: Ama chu kakoma ahung ding in, “Sopipa Saul kho mukit tan atin ahile apettah chun ama chu kamu tan ahi.”
en_web: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
en_kjv: came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hi kahenga ahungin kakoma adingin kajah a, ‘Sopi Saul, kho mutan,’ eitileh, hichepettah chun kamit akikeovin ama kamutai.

tcz: Chuin aman, “Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot lam heding le, dihtah pa mua, chule athu ngai dinga nalhen ahitai” ati.
en_web: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
en_kjv: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin aman, ‘Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot he ding le Adihpa mua akamsoh ogin ja dinga nalhen doh ahitai;

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman namu hole najah ho jouse chu nasei phong le-a ama thu hettoh sah a napan ding ahitai.
en_web: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
en_kjv: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile nang man nahin mu le najahsah chu Ama dinga mitin henga nahettohsah ding ahi.

tcz: Ipi nakhongai nahlai ham? Kipat doh in lang baptize chang tan, Pakai min kouvin lang nachonset soplhan eiti.
en_web: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
en_kjv: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun tua ibol’a kho ngai ngai nahim? Kipatdoh-in baptize changing lang, nachonset soplhahna din Ama minin taovin,’ eiti.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem kahung kile chun Houin ah dilsun kataovin ahile,
en_web: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance
en_kjv: And it came to pass that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
tcz_gospelgo: “Jerusalema kakile kit phatin Houina katao le Themgao thilmun mu kaneiyin,

tcz: Gaovin Yeshua kamun aman, “Kipat loiyin! Jerusalema kon in jamdoh in ajeh chu hiche laiya miho hin keima thudola nathusei asan lou dingu ahi” ati.
en_web: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
en_kjv: and saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
tcz_gospelgo: hichea chun Pakaiyin kajah a, ‘Kinloi tah-in Jerusalema konin potdoh loiyin, ajeh chu mihon Kei chung chang thudol nahettohsah hi asan lou diu ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Ahin keiman kaseiyin, “Pakai kikhopna in tin aseijui ho kasuh gentheiya songkul'a kakhum jong ahesoh keiyuve”
en_web: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
en_kjv: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong, ‘Pakai, amaho tah-in nangma tahsan ho Houthua kikhopna intin’a kalut’a kamatjia chule kavohji chu aheuve;

tcz: Chule nasoh pa Stephen aselih pet uva asangkhol sutlhah hou akoinau koma ding jong chu kanahinai, kati.
en_web: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
en_kjv: and when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
tcz_gospelgo: chule nathu hettohsah Stephen thisan kiso jong chun akoma kadidngin pha kasan, athat ho ponsil jouse kachoipeh ahi,’ kati.

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin, “Chen gamlha tah a chidang namdang te lah a kasol ding nahi!” ati.
en_web: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Aman kajah a, ‘Chen, ijeh-inem itile gamla tah a chiding namdang ho henga kasol ding nahi,’ eititai,” ati.

tcz: Hichun mipi hon chuche Paul thusei chu ajah phat un asamuvin, “Hitobang michu delmang un, ahing dinga jong lom ahipoi!” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
en_kjv: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lift up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu hicheng asei athip nauvin, chutah-in a-o khoset’in lhang asam’un, “Hitobang mi chu leiset’a konin sumang jengin, ama chu ahing dia kilom ahipoi!” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun a sangkholu asut un, vanlama vutvai atheuvin ahi.
en_web: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
en_kjv: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
tcz_gospelgo: Chutitah chun kho asam’un aponsil’u aleh-un, van lama leivui akitunsah jengun ahile,

tcz: Chuin Sepai vaipopa chun, Paul chu inpi sunga apuilut sah in, mipi achunga chubang tah a alunghannau ajeh seidoh sah ding ngaito nan jepsah ding in thu apetan ahi.
en_web: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
en_kjv: the chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
tcz_gospelgo: sepai vaipi pon Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut’a, ama douna chutobang tah akho asap jengu chu phot chetna dinga jep din asol’e.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu jep dinga ahin kan phat un aman akoma ding sepai lamkai pa henga chun, “Rome mikhat athemmo na khol masa louva jep ding chu dan in aphal hinam?” tin adong in ahi.
en_web: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
en_kjv: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
tcz_gospelgo: Sepaihon savun khaova akan phat’un Paul’in akoma ding sepai jalamkaipa jah a, “Themmosahna bon um loulaiya Rome mi jep ding chu nang dia dan ngai hinam?” ati.

tcz: Chuin sepai lamkai pan chuche ajah phat chun sepai vaipopa koma achen, “Ipi bol nahim? Amahi Rome mi hibouva hila!” atin ahi.
en_web: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
en_kjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai jalamkaipan hichu ajah phat’in sepai vaipipo henga achen a jah a, “Ipi bol kigo nahim? Ajeh chu hichepa khu Rome mi hibouva khu men!” agate.

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipopa chu Paul henga ahung in, “Nangma Rome mi nahim? seiyin,” tin adong tan ahile Paul in jong “Kahinai,” ati.
en_web: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
en_kjv: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun sepai vaipipo chu ahungin ajah a, “Rome mi nahi mong-em neiseipeh-in?” atileh; aman, “Kahinai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipopa chun aseiyin “Keijong sum tampi kapeh jouva Rome mihina chang kahi bouve,” atin ahile Paul in “Keivang kapena pat'a Rome mi a peng kahi,” ati.
en_web: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
en_kjv: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun sepai vaipipo adonbut’in, “Ken Rome mi hina hi sumtamtah a kichoa,” atileh; Paul’in, Keivang pen’a hisa kahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Rome mi kahi ati ajahdoh phat in thudong dinga kigong sepai ho chu gang tah in apot doh tauvin ahi, chule sepai vaipopa jong chun chutobang thupeh anei jeh chun akicha lheh jeng in ahi.
en_web: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
en_kjv: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
tcz_gospelgo: Apettah chun achung thu kholchil kigo ho chu ahaiyun alhamkangun, sepai vaipipopa jong Paul Rome mi khat ahi ahetdoh a chule ama anakan jeng chu akichatai.

tcz: Ajing nikhon Paul chung changa boina thu hetdoh nading in sepai vaipopa chun Judate kivaihom na a lamkai hole thempu ho chu hungkhom ding in thu apen, chule amaho masanga ding dingin Paul chu ana lhadoh tan ahi.
en_web: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
en_kjv: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nikhon sepai vaipipon ipijeh pen’a Judah on Paul aheh-u chu hetdohna din Paul akanna alhamin, Thempu pipu ho le Houvaipoloi chengse kikhomsoh din aseiyin, chuin Paul chu ahinpuidoh-in a-angsunguva adinsah-e.

tcz: Chuin Paul in houvaipo ho chu ave changmel in, “Sopite ho, Pathen angsunga se le pha hetkhen na kicheh tah neiya hing jing kahi!”
en_web: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
en_kjv: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in Houvaipoloi chu avechangmel’in, “Tuni geiya hi Pathen angsunga lung sa-ihna beihel’a hing jing kahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung Ananias chun Paul toh kinaiya umho koma chun amuhsom abehpeh dingun thu apen ahi.
en_web: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
en_kjv: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Thempu pipu Ananias chun Paul koma dingho chu akam behpeh din asol’e.

tcz: Ahin Paul in, “Phatlouna a dim miphalhem pa! Pathen in nangma nabeh ding ahi, itobang thutan mi nahiya nangman dan napal keh a chutobang a eibeng dinga mi thu napeh ham?” ati.
en_web: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
en_kjv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Paul’in jong ajah a, “Vo bang kiloibang, Pathenin nang nadenjoh ding ahi! Dan toh kikal’a keima deng dia mi nasol ham?” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul kimvela ding ho chun, “Pathen thempu chungnung chu na housal ngam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
en_kjv: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God’s high priest?
tcz_gospelgo: Akoma ding hon, “Nangin Pathen Thempu chungnung chutia nahouset jeng ong?” atiuleh;

tcz: Paul in adonbut un, “Sopite ho, neingai damun, thempu chungnung ahilam kanahet lou ahi, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ‘nalamkai te chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi’ tin akisune” ati.
en_web: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
en_kjv: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in, “Ama Thempu chung nung ahilam kahetlou ahi sopite, ajeh chu, ‘Namite chunga vaipo chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi,’ tinakisun nai,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Paul in houvaipoloi ho kikhopna a chu Sadducee hole Pharisee ho kihal ahiu ahet doh phat chun, hatah in asamin, “Sopite ho, kapu kapate khanga pat'a Pharisee mi kahin! Thokit thudola kinepna kanei jeh a kachung thu kitan ahi!” atin ahi.
en_web: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”
en_kjv: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in miho chu akehkhat Sadducee ahiuva akeh khat Pharisee ahiu ahetdoh phat’in, Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa chun ahinsamin, “Sopite, keima Pharisee chapa Pharisee kahin, mi thi thokit kinepna thu dol’a kathu kibol’a ahi,’ ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chu hopnin aki homkhen tauvin ahi.
en_web: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
en_kjv: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in chutia aseiphat’in Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho kah a kinel khenlotauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Sadducee ho chun mihem thokitna, vantil, chule lhagao um thudol atahsan lou-u ahi, ahin Pharisee ho vang chun aboncha-a hi atahsanu ahi.
en_web: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
en_kjv: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Sadducee loiyin mi thi thokit hihen Vantil hileh chule lhagao geiya aumsah louvu ahin, Pharisee loiyin vang aboncha aumsah-u ahinai.

tcz: Chuin akah uva boina asousang tan, hou danthu hila pang Pharisee phabep chun thuneitah in, “Hichepa chunga hin thildih lou ima aumpoi, lhagao ahiloule vantil in ahenga thu asei hitei ding ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
en_kjv: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees’ part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti tah chun apoh veng vung jengun, Pharisee loi lah a Danthem ho phabep adingdoh-uvin mipi anellun, “Keihon hichepa chunga thildih lou ima kamupouve, lhagao ahim Vantil ahim khattouvin ajah a thu asei hi hih ding ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin akah uva kitomona asan cheh cheh phat in sepai vaipopa chun Paul chu kehni sokhauvin te tin, sepai ho chu asollin Paul chu hunam in aga huhdoh sah in kulpi sunga apuilut sah tan ahi.
en_web: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.
en_kjv: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
tcz_gospelgo: Akihanelten phat’un sepai vaipipon Paul chu abotel diu ham ti akichan, sepaiho chu chesuh a alah uva kona pumhat’a Paul chu gakaidoh a kulpi sunga lhoh lut jeng din aseipeh-e.

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Paul henga Pakai akilah in, “Paul, lungneo hih in, hiche Jerusalema keima nei phondoh banga hi Rome a jong kipana thupha hettoh sah a napan ding ahi” ati.
en_web: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
en_kjv: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajing nilhah-in Paul koma Pakai adingin, “Lung ngamin, Jerusalema kathu nahettohsah banga Rome khopia jong nahettohsah tei ding ahi,” tin aseiye.

tcz: Ajing jingkah in Juda miho phabep akiloiyun Paul itha tohkah uva an ineh lou diu ahi tin akihahsel tauvin ahi.
en_web: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
en_kjv: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah lhah-in Judaten thilgon aneiyun Paul atha masangseuva anneh twidon abol louhel diuvin akihahsel’un akihan lho cheh tauve.

tcz: Chutia kigahna sem chu abonun mi somli avaluvin ahi.
en_web: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
en_kjv: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia mi philna thil gong ho chu mi som li val ahiuve.

tcz: Chuin amaho thempulen hole upa ho henga acheuvin aga seiyuvin, “Paul katha tokah uva ima nelou dinga kihahsel kahiuve,” aga tiuvin ahi.
en_web: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
en_kjv: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi Thempu pipuho le upaho henga acheuvin, “keihon Paul katha masangseuva neh le chah bol louhel dia khoh tah a kihahsel’a kihan lho kahitauve.

tcz: “Hijeh chun nangho vaipo hon sepai vaipopa henga gaseiyun lang Paul chu achungchang thudol kholchet be ding in houvaipo ho anga hin nung puikit in tin gathum uvin, chuteng le keihon ama chu lamkah a katha diu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
en_kjv: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would inquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun tun nang hon Houvaipoloi toh kithoa Paul thudol kholchil’a bol dingveh kisauvin, sepai vaipipon nahenguva ahin puina din gahetsah-un; hikom ahinphah kah a that dia kigosadem’a um kahitauve,” agatiuvin ahi.

tcz: Ahin hiche tohgon chu Paul sopinu chapan ajah lhih phat in kulpi sunga alhailut jelin Paul henga aga sei tan ahi.
en_web: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
en_kjv: And when Paul’s sister’s son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla anachan lhih-u thilgon hi Paul sopinu chapan ajadoh-in, hijeh chun achen kulpi sunga alut’in Paul jah a agaseitai.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Rome sepai jalamkai khat akouvin, “Hiche khangdong pa hi sepai vaipi popa henga puilut uvin ajeh chu seiding thupitah khat aneiye,” ati.
en_web: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
en_kjv: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in Paul chun sepai jalamkaiho khat akouvin, “Hiche gollhangpa hi sepai ding khat aneiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuin Sepai jalamkai pa chun aseiyin, “Songkul'a um Paul chun eikouvin, hiche khangdong pa hin sepai vaipipo henga seiding thupitah aneiye atin eihin puilut sah ahi,” atin ahi.
en_web: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
en_kjv: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun aman agollhangpa chu apuiyin sepai vaipipo heng alhut’in, “Sohchang Paul khun eikouvin hiche gollhangpa hin nakoma seiding khat aneijeh a nahenga eihin puisah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun akhut in atuh in, “Ipi ham nasei nom chu?” tin adong tan ahi.
