en_web: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
en_kjv: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai vaipipon ama chu akhut’in atuh-in munchoma apuidoh-in guh thim chan adongin, “Kakoma sei ding ipi naneiyem?” atile,

tcz: Chuin Paul sopinu chapa chun, “Jing nikho tengle Juda mi phabep in houvaipoloi anga dinsah kit dinga nahenga kona achungthu kholbe ding kisa a Paul ahung puidoh got diu ahi.
en_web: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
en_kjv: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would inquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
tcz_gospelgo: aman, “Jing teng Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa achung chang thudol kichen cheh a kholtoh idng banga Paul hi napuisuhna didnga nahenga ngeh ding tin Juda ho akiloltauve.

tcz: Ahin soldoh hih in ajeh chu mi somli valin lamkah a chanlhih a chuleh atha tokah uva ima nelou ding in akihahsel uve, chule tua hi nangma thulhuh bou angau ahitai,” tin asei tan ahi.
en_web: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
en_kjv: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them moe than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun athu’u lahpeh hih-in, ajeh chu mi som li valjen Paul atha masangseuva um’uva nangma thupeh ngah maiya um nahitauve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun khangdong pa henga, “Keima koma hiche thu nahung sei hi koima hetsah hih in,” tin agihsal tan ahi.
en_web: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
en_kjv: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in sepai vaipipon gollhangpa chu alhadoh-in, “Hiche neihung seipeh hi koimacha naseipeh louhel ding ahi,” tin agah chah tai.

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun sepai jalamkai ni akouvin “Tujan nidan ko tengleh Caesarea jon ding in sepai jani gotsan koi lhonin, chule tengchoi sepai jani le sakol sepai somsagi jong gong tup lhonin.
en_web: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
en_kjv: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai vaipipon sepai jalamkai ni akouvin, “Tujan nidan koa Caesarea che din sepai ja ni le sakol sepai som sagi toh, teng choi sepai ja nit oh gonsan koi lhonin;

tcz: Chule Paul touna ding sakol khat jong gong lhon in lang gamvaipo Felix henga kitup selin gathah un,” atin ahi.
en_web: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
en_kjv: and provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
tcz_gospelgo: chule gamvaipo Felix henga bitkeiya pui lhungna din Paul touna ding sakol ho jong ngaitopeh lhonin,” atin;

tcz: Chuin gamvaipo ding chun lekha khat ajih in,
en_web: He wrote a letter like this:
en_kjv: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
tcz_gospelgo: hiti chun athu dol hi lekha ajih-in:

tcz: “Jaumtah gamvaipo Felix, Claudius Lysias akon in salam!” tin athot in ahi.
en_web: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
en_kjv: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
tcz_gospelgo: “Lal chungnungpen gamvaipo Felix, Claudius-in salam kahinboh-e.

tcz: Chuin ajing kho ahungvah phat in Paul in miho chu an neding in asolin, “Lungkham tah'a an le twi natoh khah lounau haptani ahitai.”
en_web: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
en_kjv: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah niso ding phat’in Paul’in an ne din asol’in abonchauva jah a, “Sei ding get ding helouhel’a nelou cha lou, tep lou don louva na-um kal’u tuni nisom le ni li alhingtai;

tcz: “Tun lungsettah in nangho phatchomna ding in an netauvin ajeh chu nasam'u jangkhat jeng jong mangthah louding ahi.” ati.
en_web: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
en_kjv: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not a hair fall from the head of any of you.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh a chu anne dinga ka-ngeh nahiuve, nakihinso theina diuva natha nei dom nadiu vin, ajeh chu nalu chunguva samjang khat jeng cha jong mangthah louhel ding ahi,” ati. Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul ahuhdoh nom jeh-in athilgon u chu asutangin, twijap thei chan jap galkaiya tolgo anakai masa din aseiyin,

tcz: Chuin changlhah phabep alan Pathen athangvah in aheh balbal'in anetan ahi.
en_web: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.
en_kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia asei jou hin changlhah chu alan mi jouse angsunga Pathen athangvah jouvin aheh bal’in anepantai.

tcz: Hichun midangho jong ahung lunglen doh un amahon jong an anetauvin ahi.
en_web: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
en_kjv: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun miho ahung lung ngam tauvin amahon jong an anepantauve.

tcz: Kabon chauva konga touchu mi jani le somsagi le gup kahiuve.
en_web: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.
en_kjv: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
tcz_gospelgo: Kong sunga um chu mihing jani le som sagi leh gup kahiuve.

tcz: Chuin konga touho jousen an aneh jou phat un kongchu asujang un, asunga um suhlou chang ho chu aseplha tauvin ahi.
en_web: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
en_kjv: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi jousen an anehva phat’un kong chu ajankhai domna din kong sunga suhlou chang chu Twikhanglen a aleh lut tauvin ahi.

tcz: Chuin jingkah kho ahung vah phat in, aumnau vapang chu hoilai ahi ahetapouvin ahi. Ahin twi-ninglutna vapang khat amudoh un, ahithei le kong huhna-a chu hilaimuna chu tollut ding tin angaito tauvin ahi.
en_web: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.
en_kjv: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah phat’in kongtol hon gam leiset chu ahetapouvin, ahin twilen pang ningkoi khat amu’vin, ahithei leh hikoma chu kong tol lut’a galkai din akihousomtauve.

tcz: Chuin thihhat ho alha lhauvin, twikhanglen'a adalha tauve. Chuin chuchetoh thakhat'in kongkhe kanna chu alham lhauvin, hui chena lama pondal atungdoh un, vapam lam chu ajon tauve.
en_web: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
en_kjv: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun konghenna khao chengse alha lhauvin Twikhanglena aleh lut’uvin, chule kongkhe kanna khao asut lhauve; chutengleh huiyin aputlut theina diuvin ponjal atungdoh-un twiningkoi lam chu ajontauve.

tcz: Chuin twi kinong ni kisuhtona kalut khatauvin ahile, kong manghem chu tol'a akiphut dentai. Chuin kong mailam chu long louhelin aohdentan, kong meilam chu twi kinong chun hatah in ahin sutan ahile kong chu akeh pantan ahi.
en_web: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
en_kjv: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla kong chu twikinong ni kisuhtonaa alut khan kong mong chu nel lei lah a akiphut lutdentan, achalbe thei tapoi, chuma leh twikinong chun hanuh a anuh jeh-in anung lama ahal hal’in aleng lhan akeh pan tai.

tcz: Chuin sepai ho chun songkul tangho chu twi aje galkaiyuva asochat louna dingun thading agouvin ahi.
en_web: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
en_kjv: And the soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohchang ho chu akijap galkaiyuva ajamdoh thei louna diu tin sepaihon abonchauva tha ding thilgon aneitauve.

tcz: Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul chu ahing hoinom jeh chun ajadan, twi japthei theiyin anajap galkai masat dingin thu apetan ahi.
en_web: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;
en_kjv: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:

tcz: Chule adang twijap theilou ho chu kong sunga um thingpeh ham ahiloule kongse hel hoa chu kitol dingin thu apen ahile, abonchauvin twipanga bitkeiyin asohchauvin ahi.
en_web: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
en_kjv: and the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
tcz_gospelgo: adang amohse chu khunpeh le konghalse pouva kitol galkai din aseiye. Hitia chu aboncha tolgo geiya kishinso na um ahi.

tcz: Chuin kasochat phat un, Malta twikol a um kahiu chu kahedoh tauve.
en_web: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
en_kjv: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakihonso phat’uvin twikolgam chu Malta akiti ti kahedoh tauve.

tcz: Hiche twikol a cheng mite chu apha lheh jeng un, go ajuh a adap jeh chun, twi panga chun mei atih un eina lamtouvin ahi.
en_web: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
en_kjv: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
tcz_gospelgo: Koitoh kisamkai khah loulai agam mihon datmo tah-in eikhoto’uvin, go juh jeh a adap phat chun mei eitipeh-un eilamdot chehui.

tcz: Chuin Paul in meiya tiding thing khut dimkhat ahin choiyin meichunga chun alehlut in ahile, mei asat jeh chun gul gunei khat ahung kithol doh in akhut chu achun ahi.
en_web: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
en_kjv: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul’in thingkang lom khat achomdah-in meiya atileh, meisa hul chun gulse khat ahungdoh-in akhut achun akikhaiden jenge.

tcz: Akhut a gul akikhai den chu twikol mite chun amuuvin, khat le khat akihouvun, “Tolthat hitei ding ahi! Twipi chunga ahung sochat vanga thudih chun ahing dinga aphallou ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
en_kjv: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet Vengeance suffereth not to live.
tcz_gospelgo: Koitoh kisamkai khah lou agam mihon paul khut’a gul kikhai chu amudoh phat’un khat le khat akihou lhiuvin, “hichepa vang hi tolthat mong mong ahin, Twikhanglen setto naa ahindoh jeng vanga thudih chun ahing hoi lou dingsam ahiye,” akitiuve.

tcz: Ahin Paul in akhut'a gul chu meilah a athing lhan ahile ama imacha atipon ahi.
en_web: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
en_kjv: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Paul’in gulse chu meilhum sunga athing lhan a-ima aloudeh poi.

tcz: Miho chun itih le ahung pomin ahiloule ahung moh lhuh dem tia angau ahi. Ahin sottah angauva ima tilouva aum chu amu phat un alunggel u akikhel tan, pathen hiding ahi atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
en_kjv: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
tcz_gospelgo: Agam mihon vang hung pom ding ham ahi loule phulou helouvin lhua thi didng ham, tin a-ngah jingui; sotpi chutia angauva imacha atilou phat’in along gel akhel’uvin Paul chu Pathen khat danin aseitauve.

tcz: Hiche kakingah nau twipanga chu twikol pipuipen Publius atiu chun gam anei ahin, ama chun eilem'un nithum sung in khoto tah in eivah un ahi.
en_web: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
en_kjv: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kona gamla behseh lou mun khat’a hin twikol haosapu amin Publius kitipan loumin aneiyin, amahin thanom tah-in eisangun nithum sungin eivah gunset’uve.

tcz: Chutia kaum sungu chun Publius pachu khosih le ehthit in hatah in ahung dammon ahile, Paul alut in achunga khut angamin ataopeh in ahileh ahung dam tan ahi.
en_web: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flixe: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
tcz_gospelgo: Publisu pa chu khosih le eithit veiya dammoa lum ahin, Paul’in agaven, achunga khut angamin ataopeh-in aboldamtai.

tcz: Chuin twikol sunga damlou jouse chu ahin puiyun ahile abonun adam tauvin ahi.
en_web: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
en_kjv: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
tcz_gospelgo: Hitabong thilsoh aumdoh phat hin twikol gamsunga cheng ana damlou neichanin ahinpuiyun abonchan adamsoh keiyuve.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun mihon eijabol lheh jeng tauvin, konga kache kit diu phat chun angai cha thil jousen eikithopi un ahi.
en_web: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
en_kjv: who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
tcz_gospelgo: Agam mihon keiho jabolnan thilpeh tampi eipeuvin, konga kitol kagot phat’un kangaichat ding dol jouseu kong sunga eihung thah peh-uve.

tcz: Chuin kongke jouva pat lhathum jou phalbi laitah in, pathen lim alu ni neiya kisem Alexandria konga chun kakitol kit tauvin ahi.
en_web: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”
en_kjv: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
tcz_gospelgo: Lha thum jouvin Alexandria hung kon kong, ‘Pathen cha pengkop,’ tia kiminvo, phalbi sungsea chukom twikol gama nichong denpaa chun kakitol kit tauve.

tcz: Chuin Syracuse muna kakinga pauvin nithum kakibangpa uvin ahi.
en_web: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
en_kjv: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
tcz_gospelgo: Syracuse kaimun’a kaki-ngauvin nithum kanichonguve.

tcz: Hichea pat chun Rhegium lama kakitol kit un ahile, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui hattah in ahung nung in hichun ajing in Puteoli mun kalhung tauvin ahi.
en_web: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,
en_kjv: And from thence we fet a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
tcz_gospelgo: Chua konin kakitol velkil leuvin Rhegium kalhungun, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui ahung nungin, ni ni lhin hin Puteoli kalhungu.

tcz: Hichelai muna chun seijui ho ana umun, amahon eikouvun hapta khat lam kaum khomun, chujouvin Rome kajon tauvin ahi.
en_web: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
en_kjv: where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
tcz_gospelgo: Puteolia chun sopite phabep kamudoh-un, akom’uva ni sagi nichong din eikouvui. Hitia chu Rome hung lhung kahiuve.

tcz: Chuin Rome a um sopi hon keiho kacheu thu ajah phat un Appian a mipi kikhopna muna eihung kimu piuvin ahi. Chuleh adanghon jinlhun in thum'a eihung lhun piuvin ahi. Hichu Paul in amu phat in akitilkhou lheh jeng in Pathen athangvah in ahi.
en_web: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
en_kjv: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
tcz_gospelgo: Rome a um sopiten kathuu ajah phat’un Appius kailhang le Jinlhun in thum geiyin keiho lamto din ahungun, amaho amu phat hin Paul’in Pathen athangvah-in along ngamtan ahi.

tcz: Chuin Rome kalhun phat uvin, Paul chu achangin inchom khat ah aumsah un sepai ho angasah un ahi.
en_web: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
en_kjv: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
tcz_gospelgo: Rome kalhun phat’un Paul chu a-ngah a pang sepai chutoh ama changseh a cheng din phalna aneipeh tauvin ahi.

tcz: Rome alhunkal nithum jouvin Paul in amuna Judah te lamkai ho chu akou khomin, “Sopite ho, Jerusalema eimanun, eiho mite leh ipu ipa teu chonna dan ima kasuhkhel lou vang'in Rome mite khut'a eipedoh un ahi.
en_web: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,
en_kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
tcz_gospelgo: Nithum jouvin Paul’in khosunga Judate lamkaiho akoukhomin, ahung kikhopsoh phat’un ajahuvah, “Sopiho, i-nam miteu douna hihen ipu ipateu chondan douna hijongle imacha kabolset aum lou vangin Jerusalema pat Rome mite khut’a sohchanga eihung kipedoh ahitai.

tcz: Rome ten kachung thu akholun thina changei ding themmona ima amudoh lou jeh un lhadoh ding in eigong un ahi.
en_web: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
en_kjv: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachung thu akhol chil’u chun thina thei lom ima kabolset aumdoh loujeh-in eina lhadoh nom tauve.

tcz: Ahin hiche thulhuhna chu Judah vaipo hon adoudalun ahi, hijeh a chu kamite themmo chansah nomhih jong leng Caesar in kachung thu atan ding chu ngaikhoh kasah ahitai.
en_web: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
en_kjv: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahina Juda mihon aneljeh-un, ka-nam mite douna imacha sei ding kanei lou vangin Kumpipa henga kacham louvinthu kalhuttai.

tcz: Tunia nangho kahin koukhom lona chu ikihoulim khomuva, chule Israel te kinepna Messiah chu ahung taiti katahsan jeh a kihen kahina thu kahil chen nomu ahi,” ati.
en_web: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
en_kjv: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh tah a hi nang ho toh kimutoa kihoulimpi dia kakou nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile Israel kinepna ijeh a keima hiche thih khaova hi kihen’ah kahibouve,” ati.

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut un “Judea gam'a konin lekhathot kamu pouvin, chule ahung holah a konin jong nangma hehset na thu ima kaja pouve.
en_web: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
en_kjv: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun amahon ajah a, “Keihon jong Judea gama kona nathudol lekha thot la kimu louva, hikoma sopite khatcha beh-in jong nagit louna thudol thulhut’a le houlima jong umlouva,

tcz: Ahin keihon jong natahsan thudol chu kahet chet nomuve ajeh chu hiche thudol kisei na mun jousea akiseiset na thubou kaja jiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”
en_kjv: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
tcz_gospelgo: hi jongle la nalung ngaito mong mong nanga konin kajahbe nom nauve; ajeh chu hiche Houbih vang hi muntin gamtin’a seiset’in aumtin ahi ti kei hon jong kanaheuve,” atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuin phat akitemun, aphat tep nikhou chun mitamtah Paul umna'a chun ahung khomuvin ahi. Chuin Paul in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin miho tamtah chu Pathen lekhabua konin Yeshua thudol ah ajoltan ahi. Hiti chun jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose danthu le themgao lekhabua konin ahoulim in ahi.
en_web: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
en_kjv: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho khat ateppeh –un, apansatna ina’a chun mi tampi ahung kikhom’uve; Paul’in amaho chu jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose Danthu le Themgaoho lekhabua konin hilchetna abol’in, Pathen Lenggam thudol ahettohsa-in, Jesu chu tahsansah tei din ajoltai.

tcz: Chuin mi phabep in athuhil chu ajop un, konkhat in atahsan pouvin ahi.
en_web: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
en_kjv: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul thuseiho chu abangin atahsan lou vangun abang vang anomtauve.

tcz: Chuin amaho le amaho suhnel tounel akitho jouvun hiche thuhi Paul koma konin achainan angaiyun ache tauvin ahi. Hiche athu ngaiyu chu hiche hi ahi: “Lhagao Theng in napu'u Isaiah henga ana phondoh thu chu adih ahi.
en_web: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
en_kjv: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu akihoutoh thei loud phat’uvin Paul’in anoiya thu khat hi asei jou phat’in apotdoh tauve; athusei chu: “Lhagao Thengin Isaiah Themgao kamin napu napateu henga phatah-in anaseiyin,

tcz: ‘Hiche mite koma khun chen lang gasei tan, kathusei hi najah tengule ipi kiseina ham nahet lou dingu, kathilbol namu tengule ipi kabol nahetthei lou dingu ahi.
en_web: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.
en_kjv: saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
tcz_gospelgo: hitin: “Hiche mite henga hin chen lang gaseiyin, ‘Ja vang najah tei diu ahin nehetkhen thei lou diu, Mujong namu tei diu navet chen thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche mite lungthim hi atah dentan, chule anakol uvin kho ajapon, chule amit'u asing tauvin ahi. Hijeh a chu amit uvin amuthei hih a, chule anakoluvin ajah theilou, chule alungthim uvin jong ahethem thei hih un, keima suhdam dingin jong kahenga ahung kihei thei tapouve,’
en_web: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
en_kjv: for the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Anabenguvin thu angaichimtan, Chutilou hileh amit’uva avet chet theiyuva Alungthim’uva ahetkhen them diu, Kadamsahna dia kahenga hung kilekit diu ahi,’ ati bang chun;

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche thuhi nanghon jong nahet diu kadei ahi, Pathen'a kona huhhing na thuhi chidang namdang te henga jong kipe ahin chule amahon jong asanu ahitai,” ati.
en_web: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
en_kjv: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
tcz_gospelgo: hichu kihet cheh-un, hiche Pathen mihuhhingna thu hi chiding namdangte henga kithot ahitan, amahon angai tei diu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Aman hiche thuho aseijou chun, Juda hon adalhauvin, chule amaho le amaho akihanel lheh jeng tauve.
en_web: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
en_kjv: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: (Paul’in hicheng asei jou hin Judah on ada lhauvin hanel’in akineltauve.)

tcz: Chujou kumni sung chun Paul in ama sumin insan man akipeh in Rome ah achengin ama vila che jouse chu analemin,
en_web: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
en_kjv: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chun Paul’in inman akipeh-in kum ni sung in achengin, ahenga hung jouse lamdot’in

tcz: Chuti chun hangsan tah in Pathen Lenggam thudol asam phonglen, chule Pakai Yeshua Christa thudol chu ahil len koi machan ana kham tang joupon ahi.
en_web: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
en_kjv: preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him. The end of the Acts of the Apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Lenggam thu aseiphongin, koima asunoh beihel’in phongtah in Pakai Jesu thudol ahil lhang lei.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua soh, solchah hidinga Pathen lhendoh, Ama Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kisoldoh, Paul'a kon ahi:
en_web: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
en_kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha malaipeh'a Pathen in Lekhabu thenga a-Themgao ho ana thutepsa,
en_web: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
en_kjv: (which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

tcz: Kipana Thuphahi Achapa thudol ahi. Ama chu leiset ahinkho'a Leng David insunga ana penga ahi,
en_web: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
en_kjv: concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

tcz: Chule Ama chu Lhagaotheng thahat'a athilah a kona kaithouva aum chun, Pathen Chapa chu avetsah tai. Ama Yeshua Christa i-Pakaiyu chu ahi.
en_web: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
en_kjv: and declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

tcz: Christa jal'a Pathen in solchah hina chanpha le thuneina eipeh uhi muntina chidang namdangte, Pathen in abolpeh-u seipeh a, amahon atahsanuva chule seingai ahi diu chu Amin loupina ding ahiye.
en_web: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
en_kjv: by whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

tcz: Chule nangho jong Yeshua Christa a dinga hiche chidang namdang akikou ho lah a napan'u ahitai.
en_web: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
en_kjv: among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

tcz: Rome khopia um Pathen ngailu ho chule Ama mithengte hiding a kikouho jouse dinga jih a kahi.
en_web: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: to all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Keiman nangho jouse henga kasei masah nom chu, keiman Ka Pathen chu Yeshua Christa jal'in kathangvah-e, ajehchu Ama natahsanu thu chu vannoi mun jousea kisei ahitai.
en_web: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
en_kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

tcz: Keima nangho dinga taojom jinga kahi hi Pathen ahetoh ahi. Sun le jan'in kalung pumpia a-Chapa Kipana Thupha seiphonga kapanna ahin, nangho le nangaichat-u thudol'a Pathen henga taova kahi.
en_web: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
en_kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you, always in my prayers,

tcz: Kataona ajeh pipen khat chu, Pathen phatsah a phat kijenpet kamua, nangho achaina pena hung mu noma kahi hi ahi.
en_web: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
en_kjv: making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman nangho hungvil kanop'a chutia chu nangho Pakaiya nahatdoh theina dinguva kithopia Lhagao thilpeh hungpeh ding kati nahiuve.
en_web: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
en_kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end you may be established;

tcz: Eiho ikikhop khom tenguleh, keiman natahsan nauva tilkhou ding kanom'in, chule nanghoa kona jong kitilkhou ding kakinemin ahi.
en_web: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
en_kjv: that is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, nangho hungvil ding tamtahvei kana gongin, hinla tuchan hin eisumo aum jinge. Keiman chidang namdang mi adanghoa kon'a kamu tobang'in, nangho lah a jong toh'a chule Lhagao ga mu kanom'e.
en_web: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
en_kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

tcz: Keiman khantouna vannoi leiset miho umna mun'a hihen, mun danga lekhathem le athemlou lah hijongle mopohna lentah neiyin kakigel'e.
en_web: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
en_kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

tcz: Hiti chun, keima jong Rome khopia nangho henga hunga Kipana Thupha seiphong ding kanom'e.
en_web: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
en_kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

tcz: Ajehchu, keima hiche Christa Kipana Thupha chung chang thua hin kajah achapoi. Hichea hi Pathen thahat in na atoh a, atahsan chan chu ahuhhing ahi; Judahte masa ding chule chidang namdangte jong hiding ahi.
en_web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
en_kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha hin Pathen in amitmua iti chonpha eisemu ham ti eihiluve. Hiche hi akipat'a pat achaina gei tahsan jal ahi. Pathen thubun asei dung juiyin, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” kitia ahi.
en_web: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
en_kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in michonse, migilou agitlou nauva thutah sunem ho dou dingin, alunghanna Van'a kon'in ahin vetsah in ahi.
en_web: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
en_kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

tcz: Amahon Pathen thudol thutah chu aheuve, ajehchu Aman amaho ahetsah masah ahitai.
en_web: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
en_kjv: because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

tcz: Ajehchu vannoi kisema pat mihon leiset le van amu'uve. Pathen in athilsem jousea kon hin, Ama mutheilou ahina gunneina ho kichentah in amuuvin, tonsot athaneina le Pathen ahina chonna ho geiya ahet'u ahi. Hitichun, Pathen ahetlou jeh uva them achanna dingu aumpoi.
en_web: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
en_kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

tcz: Ahin, amahon Pathen aheuve, hinlah amahon Pathen houvin ahou nom pouve, ahilouleh thangvahna apenom pouve. Chule amahon alunggel uva Pathen chu itobang ahidem ti ngolhoi lunggel aneiyuve. Hitichun, alung gelu athi'in chule alungu anohphah dentai.
en_web: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
en_kjv: because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

tcz: Ching tah a akiseinau chun angolsah gamu ahitai.
en_web: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
en_kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

tcz: Chule loupitah tonsot'a hing jing Pathen hou louvin, amahon semthu, mihem le vacha, ganhing le a-oma kithola limho asemun ahou-uve.
en_web: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
en_kjv: and changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

tcz: Hitichun, Pathen in amaho chu alung ngaichat-u dungjuiya jachat umtah boldoh dinga anungsun ahitai. Hichea kona chu, khat'in khat chunga atibah-u chu abol diuva, thenlouna lama apehdoh ahitai.
en_web: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
en_kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

tcz: Amahon Pathen dihtah chu kiveinan, jouvin alheng tauve. Hitichun, amahon Asempau tah chu hou sangin, Pathen thilsemsa chu ahou'un chule ajen'ui, Ama chula tonsot'a vahchoi dinga lomtah ahi, Amen.
en_web: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
en_kjv: who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Pathen in amaho chu ajachatnau lung ngaichat uva chu anungsun ahitai. Numei ho jeng jong angai dola kitimatna tibah aneiyu chu akale lamin amangchauvin, numei le numei kitimat nom'in, kingaichaton aum gamtauve.
en_web: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
en_kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

tcz: Chule Pasal ho jong numeito kingaichat tona neija lupkhomgo talouvin, pasal chun pasal akichenpi chu ngaichat nan adimun ahi. Pasal in a-pasal chanpi chunga jachat umtah abol'un, chutichun, hiche chonset boljeh hin, amahon tahsa chunga gimna achandiu dol cheh akimu'un ahi.
en_web: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
en_kjv: and likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one towards another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

tcz: Amahon Pathen phondoh ding ngolhoija ageljeh un, aman amaho angolnau lunggel chu donlouva akoiya chule amaho chun abollou beh dingu abolu ahitai.
en_web: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
en_kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

tcz: Ahinkho man'u chu, gitlouna tincheng, chonset, kiloset, mithetbol, milop, mitha, kidou-kinah, kiduhabol, dou lungput, chule kiseiset abol'ui.
en_web: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
en_kjv: being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

tcz: Amaho nunglama kona misunji ahiuvin, Pathen ahotbol'un, giloutah, kiletsahtah chule ham hoithoa ahiuve. Amahon chonset thah alamdoh uvin, chule amaho anuleh apateu thua nunglou ahiuve.
en_web: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
en_kjv: backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

tcz: Hetna neiding ago pouvin, akitep nau sukeh a ahiuvin, lungthim bei ahiuvin, chule hepina neilou ahiuve.
en_web: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
en_kjv: without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

tcz: Amahon Pathen thutan dihna chun hitobang bol ho chu thi dinga lom ahiuve ti aheuvin, hinla aboltei tei uve. Akhohcheh chu, amahon midang chu chutobang bol ding'in atilkhou'un ahi.
en_web: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
en_kjv: who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

tcz: Nangman hitobang miho chu themmo chan theiya lom ahi nati; hinla nangma tah hitobang maa chu phalouva nahi, hichea hin them nachanna ding aumpoi. Nangman amaho agilou le gimbolna chang dinga lom ahiuve, natina a chu nangma tah kithemmo chan nahitai. Ajeh chu, nangma midang thutan'a panga chun hitobangma chu nabol'in ahi.
en_web: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
en_kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

tcz: Chule eima hon Pathen Thutandih ahinaa chutobang bol ho chu koi hijongleh achungthu atanding ahi, ti iheuve.
en_web: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
en_kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

tcz: Nangman midang hochu hiche ho aboljeh'uva athu-u natan'a ahileh, chutobang ma a nangman nabol jeh a Pathen in nachung thu atan dinga kon'in hoidoh nange tia nakigel ham?
en_web: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
en_kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

tcz: Nangman Pathen itobang tah a nachunga lungset them, thohhat le lung dehat hiya ham tihi hedoh louva nahim? Hichehi, ima hilouva nagel nahlai ham? Nangman hitobang lungsetna hi nachonset lung khelna ding ahi, ti mudoh loulai nahim?
en_web: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
en_kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

tcz: Hinlah nangma nalungtah a, chule nachonsetna kona nalung nahei louva ahileh, nangman lunghanna chu nakikhol khom ahitai. Ajehchu, Pathen thutan dihna alunghanna nikho chu hung lhung ding ahiye.
en_web: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
en_kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

tcz: Pathen in amichang cheh chu athilbol totoh'a athu-u atan ding ahinalaiye.
en_web: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
en_kjv: who will render to every man according to his deeds:

tcz: Aman thilpha bol'a pontho a lungdehat ho, chule loupina le jabolna chule thithei louna Pathen in agonpeh holjing ho, chu tonsot hinna apeh ding ahi.
en_web: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
en_kjv: to them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

tcz: Ahivangin, Aman kichang khohsah a kichamsah ho, thutah thua nunglou ho chule chonphatlou thua nung ho chu achunguva alungsatna le alunghanna chuding ahi.
en_web: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
en_kjv: but unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

tcz: Thilse bol miho chunga chu hesoh genthei le lungdonna khohtah chu amasa a Judah mite chunga chua chule aban'a chidang namdangte chunga lhung ding ahi.
en_web: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
en_kjv: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

tcz: Hinlah thilpha bol ho jouse chunga chu loupina le jabolna chule cham-lungmonna chu Pathen'a kon'a hung ding ahi, Judah mite masan tin chule chidang namdang ho hiding ahi.
en_web: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
en_kjv: but glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen hin maipha avepoi.
en_web: For there is no partiality with God.
en_kjv: for there is no respect of persons with God.

tcz: Chidang namdangte chu achonset tenguleh Pathen Danthu kijih aneilou'u ahi vang'in, Danthu beiya kisumang ding ahiuve. Chule Judah mite Pathen Danthu neiho chu hiche Dan thu ajui lou nauva chu athu-u kitan ding ahi.
en_web: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
en_kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthu moh ngailhah mai mai hin Pathen themchanna eisodoh peh dingu ahipoi. Danthu jui'a bolteho bou chu Amit mua chonpha eihisah dingu ahibouve.
en_web: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
en_kjv: (for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

tcz: Pathen Danthu kijih neilou chidang namdangte jeng'in bon apenpiu a-lungthim'u Danthua anungun, Danthu ajahkhahlou vang'un, amaho le amahon Danthu akisem'un ahi.
en_web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
en_kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

tcz: Amahon alung sunguva Danthu natoh kisim ahi chu asulang'un ahi, ajehchu selepha hetna alungthimun ahettohsah-u ahi. Chutichun, amaho le amaho lunggel chun themmo sahna ahilouleh them chansahna aumsah uvin ahi.
en_web: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
en_kjv: which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

tcz: Chule thuhil kiseiphong le chu hiche hi ahi; Pathen in Yeshua Christa amanchah a, amichang cheh hinkho thuguh atanding nikho chu hung um ding ahi.
en_web: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: in the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

tcz: Nangho Judah mia kiseiya Pathen Danthua kinem nahiuvin, chule Amatoh kiguijopna phatah neija kisonna nei nahiuve.
en_web: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
en_kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

tcz: Alungdeilam naheuvin, Adanthua kihil'a nahi jeh uva, adih ipi ahi chu nahet-u ahitai.
en_web: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
en_kjv: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

tcz: Nangma mitcho lamhil'a panga chule muthim lah a lamvaiho khomusah dinga kigel'a nahi.
en_web: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
en_kjv: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

tcz: Nangman michinglou ho chihsah a chule chapang ho Pathen henglam jotna hiltheiya kigel'ah nahi. Ajeh chu Pathen Danthu hetna bulhingset le thutah hetna neiyin nakingaiton ahi.
en_web: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
en_kjv: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

tcz: Chuti ahileh midang hil'ah nangma, nangma tah kihil louva nahim? Nangman midang guhchat louding natia nangman naguhji ham?
en_web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
en_kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

tcz: Nangman jonbol adihpoi natia, hinla nangman jon nabol em? Nangman milim hou themmo nachan'a, hinla nangman milim houna kon'a kigudoh thil ho namanchah em?
en_web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
en_kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

tcz: Nangman Danthu nahet nakiletsahpi lheh jengin, hinla, nangman Danthu napalkeh jeh in Pathen jalou nahi.
en_web: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
en_kjv: thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

tcz: Pathen thun asei, “Nangho jeh in chidang namdang hon Pathen min ataitomuve,” kiti hi datmo hih un.
en_web: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
en_kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

tcz: Judah mite chonna ngai cheptan hi Pathen Danthu ahi tia najui lebou naphatchompi ding ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen Danthu chu najui louva ahileh cheptanlou chidang namdang ho sanga naphat chompina joh aum dehpoi.
en_web: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
en_kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

tcz: Chule chidang namdang ho chun Pathen Danthu ajuiyuva ahileh Pathen in amaho chu Amitea aphondoh lou dingu ham?
en_web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
en_kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, cheptan louchidang namdang Pathen Danthu juiho chun nangho Judah mi cheptanho chule Pathen Danthu neiho hijongleu chun najuilounau chun themmo nahin chanlou ding'u ham?
en_web: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
en_kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma Judah mi hina atahbeh chu nule pa akon'a peng nahi jeh, ahilouleh cheptan chonna chu najui jeh a nahi ahipoi.
en_web: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
en_kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

tcz: Judah mi tahbeh chu alung put Pathen mitvet'a dih a ahije. Chule cheptan dihtah jong chu Danthu kijih jui mai mai chu ahipoi. Chusangin, Pathen Lhagaova kon'a alunggel kikhel na ahinsodoh ahibouve. Chule alunggel kikhel chun miho pachat ding hollouvin, Pathen vahchoina asoding chu aholjoh ding ahi.
en_web: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
en_kjv: but he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

tcz: Achutileh Judah mikhat hina ipia phachom ham? Cheptan chondan juijong apanna um hinam?
en_web: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
en_kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

tcz: Henge, aphatchomna ho atam'e. Amasapen'in, Pathen thu kiphongdoh hi aboncha Judah mite kinganseuva ahi.
en_web: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
en_kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

tcz: Ahinai, amaho phabep tahsan thejin aumpouve, hinla amaho tahsan theija aumlou nauva Pathen chu tahsan umlou kisohthei ahisah ham?
en_web: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
en_kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

tcz: Chuti thei ponte, amichang cheh jousei hijeng jongleu, Pathen adih-e, Pathen lekhabun ama chung chang thua, “Nangma na-thuseija chu nadihna photchetna umding, chule thutanna mun'a jong najo ding ahi” ati.
en_web: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
en_kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

tcz: Hinlah, mi koitobang khat touvin sei inte, “Eiho i-chonsetnau hin phatna lunggel asoi, ajehchu, hiche hin miho chu Pathen ichan geiya chonpha hitam ti amu dohsah ahi,” atiuve. Chuti ahileh Aman eigimbol tenguleh aphatmona umem? (Hichehi mihem hina lunggel kisei ahi).
en_web: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
en_kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

tcz: Chuti ponte! Pathen hin adih chu abollou hitaleh, iti chu vannoi thutan'a pang thei ding ham?
en_web: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
en_kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

tcz: Hinlah mi phabep khattouvin, “Itia Pathen in chonse tiathemmo eichan ding ham? Ajehchu keima lungthen lounan Ama kitahna le Aloupina aphondoh cheh lou ding ham?” tiuvinte.
en_web: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
en_kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

tcz: Chule mi phabep ho chun taipongnain, “Iha chonset cheh uleh aphatna aumjoi tin naseiuve,” eitiuvinte. Hitobanga thusei hochu themmo chansah ding dol ahiuve.
en_web: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
en_kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

tcz: Chuti ahileh eiho Juda mite hi midang ho sangin iphajouve tia thulhuhna ibol dingu hitam? Chuti theiponte, ajehchu eihon mijouse, Judah mi hihen chidang namdang mi hijongleh, chonset thaneina noiya uma ihi tauve, tia iphondoh-u ahitai.
en_web: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
en_kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

tcz: Pathen thubun asei dungjuiyin, “Koima michonpha aumpoi; khat jong aumpoi.
en_web: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
en_kjv: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

tcz: Koima aching tahbeh aumpoi. Koima Pathen hol aumpoi
en_web: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
en_kjv: there is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

tcz: Abonchauvin akiheimang tauve, abonun pannabei asohgam tauve. Koima apha bol'a aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.”
en_web: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
en_kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

tcz: Thumanlou aseiyun, lhankhuh kihong namse tobang ahiuvin ahi. Aleigui-u jouseinan adimset-un, anephu noijuva kon'in gulsegu ahung valhai.
en_web: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
en_kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

tcz: Akam'u jong gaosapna le thugilou seinan adimuve.
en_web: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
en_kjv: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

tcz: Mithana ding in akaljanguve.
en_web: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
en_kjv: their feet are swift to shed blood:

tcz: Mahthahna le lunggimnan ajui jinguve.
en_web: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
en_kjv: destruction and misery are in their ways:

tcz: Lungmonna kimuna ding ahetapouve.
en_web: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
en_kjv: and the way of peace have they not known:

tcz: Amahon Pathen ginna tahbeh aneipouve.
en_web: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
en_kjv: there is no fear of God before their eyes.

tcz: Gahsei jeng dingin Danthu chu akipehna ho a dingbou ahin, hiche Dan kipeh lona jeh chu miho athuphat louna dingu ahi. Chule vannoi pumpi Pathen masanga themmo ahiuve, ti vetsahna ding ahi.
en_web: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
en_kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthupeh jui man'a koima themchang ding ahipoi. Danthu hin ichangeiya chonse ihiuvem ti bou eivetsah-u ahi.
en_web: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
en_kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

tcz: Hinlah tuvang hin Danthua hilouvin Pathen Lekhabua kona masangpeh a eiteppeh u, Pathen chonphatna hi eivetsah'u ahitai.
en_web: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
en_kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

tcz: Eihon Yeshua Christa a itahsan nau ngaplhahna tahbeh ineijeh uva Pathen chonphatna chu chang ah ihitauve. Chule hichehi koi koi hijongleh atahsan jouse dinga ahin, koipen ihiuchu imacha akhohna umlou ahi.
en_web: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
en_kjv: even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

tcz: Ajehchu amitakip chonsea ahitai, Pathen loupina chu changpha joulou ihitauve.
en_web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
en_kjv: for all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

tcz: Hinlah, Pathen in ichan diuva lomlou khotona einei jal'uva, michonpha'a eiphondoh-u ahitai. Aman ichonset jeh uva themmo eichannauva kon'a Christa Yeshuan ei-chamlhatsah'u ahitai.
en_web: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in Yeshua chu chonset jeh a anakatdoh ahitai. Yeshuan ahinna ahung katdoh a, athisan asodoh chu Ama tahsanho Pathena chonphatna chu changdiu ahitai. Achesa phat masaho a anachonseho gimbolna chu penom louva alungdehat johhin Pathen thutan dihna atahlang ahi.
en_web: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
en_kjv: whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

tcz: Ajehchu aman tupet'a ipi ahinbol doh ding chu agaldot ahi. Hichehi Pathen phatna le chondih ahinaa achonphatna vetsah dinga, michonsen Yeshua ahin tahsan teng amitmua achonpha tia aphondoh ahitai.
en_web: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
en_kjv: to declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

tcz: Chuti ahileh eihon Pathen in eisan theina dinguva ikisonpi thei dingu tohdoh inei uvem? Aumpoi, ajehchu eiho them ichannau hi Danthu jui jal'a kon ahipoi, tahsan jal ahibouve.
en_web: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
en_kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

tcz: Hitijeh hin, eiho Pathen to ikichamu hi tahsan jal ahi, Danthu jui jal ahipoi.
en_web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
en_kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

tcz: Achungchon'a, Pathen hi Juda mite Pathen bou hiya ham? Ama chidang namdangho Pathen jong hilou ham?
en_web: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
en_kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

tcz: Pathen khat bou ahi, chule Aman mihem to kilungtona anei chu Judah mite hihen, chidang namdang ho hijongleh tahsan jalbou ahi.
en_web: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
en_kjv: seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

tcz: Tahsan jal'a Danthu suhmilthei ahitai, tina ham? Ahidehpoi! Tahbeh a seiding in, eihon tahsan inei tenguleh Danthu chu isuh bulhit'u ahitai.
en_web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
en_kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

tcz: Mihem lam dol a sei dingin Abraham chu Juda mite tahsan phutdohpa ahi. Pathen toh kilungto theina dinga ipi ahinbol doh em?
en_web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
en_kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

tcz: Athilpha bol chun Pathen santhei asodoh sah a ahileh, aman kisonpi ding ananei ding ahitai. Hinla, hichu Pathen lama dingin ahitheipoi.
en_web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
en_kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen thubun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'in, chule hiche atahsanna jeh chun Pathen in michonphan asimtai!” tin eiseipeh uve.
en_web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
en_kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

tcz: Mihon na atoh tenguleh anatoh man'u chu thilpeh akitipoi, amahon akilodoh-u ahijoi.
en_web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
en_kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

tcz: Hinlah miho michonphaa kisim ho chu, anatoh jal'u hilouvin, michonse ho ngaidampa Pathen atahsan jal'u ahibouve.
en_web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
en_kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

tcz: David'in jong michonpha tia kiphongdoh ho chu natoh jal jeh ahilou thudol ana seijin ahi.
en_web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
en_kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

tcz: “O seingailou ahinauva kingaidama, achonset-u mukit loudia kisuhbeipeh ho chu iti kipa um hitam!
en_web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
en_kjv: saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

tcz: Ahinai, achungchang thu'u Pakaiyin achonsetnau jih lutsa akoi noimang peh'a um michu iti kipa um hitam!” ati.
en_web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
en_kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

tcz: Tua hi Judah mite dinga bou phatthei channa ham? Ahilouleh chidang namdang cheptanlou ho dinga jong hiya ham? Ahinai, eihon jong Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in themchang a anakoi ahitai, ti inasei jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
en_kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

tcz: Ahin, hichu iti hung hithei'ah ahidem? Ama chep kitan jouva bou themchang hiya ham? Ahilouleh cheptan masang joh ham? Chentah a seiding in, Abraham chu Pathen in cheptan masanga analah ahitai.
en_web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
en_kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

tcz: Cheptan hi Abraham'in tahsan aneiye ti amelchihna ahi. Chule Pathen in ama chu michonpha tia asan'a chule aphondohna chu cheptan masangpeh ahitai. Hijeh'a hi, Abraham hi cheptanlou atahsanho dinga apau ahi. Atahsan nau jeh a chu amaho michonpha tia kisima ahitauve.
en_web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
en_kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

tcz: Chule Abraham hi cheptan ho dinga jong lhagaova apau ahi. Hinla hiche hi Abraham cheptan masanga tahsan anei tobanga tahsan neihoa ding bou ahi.
en_web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
en_kjv: and the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, Pathen in vannoi pumpi hi Abraham le achilhahte apeh ahin, hichu Pathen Danthu ajui jeh-u ahipon, chusanga tahsan jal'a kijopmatna phatah anei jaljoh ahi.
en_web: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
en_kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

tcz: Pathen Thutep hi danthu juihoa dinga bou hitaleh, tahsan ngaitalou ding ahi. Chule thutep hi ajeh bei hiding ahitai.
en_web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
en_kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthu hin athupeh ho jui dinga gimbolna jengbou ahin lhut ding ahi (Dan suhkeh louna dingin lampi khat bou aum'in, hichu Dan neitah lou ding chu ahije).
en_web: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
en_kjv: because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

tcz: Chutia chu, thutep hi tahsan jal'a kimu'ah ahin, manbei thilpeh-akipea chu ahi. Abraham tahsan tobang inei uva ahileh Mose Dan ijuiyu hihen, ijuilouvu hijongleh eihon ibon'uva imu teidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Abraham chu atahsan jousea dinga pa ahi.
en_web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
en_kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

tcz: Hiche hi ahi Pathen Lekhabun asei, “Keiman nangma namtin mipa a kasem nahitai” tia Pathen in ajah a anasei chu. Hiche ahitheina chu Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'a athisa hinsahkitna chule imacha louva kona thil thah asemdoh thei tahsan na jeh ahi.
en_web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
en_kjv: (as it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

tcz: Kinepna ding umlouna jenga jong Abraham chu akinem jingin, ama namtin dinga Pa ahung hiding tahsanna aneiyin ahi. Ajehchu Pathen in ajah a, “Chutia a chu son le chilhah tampi nahin neiding ahi,” atipeh ahi.
en_web: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
en_kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

tcz: Chule Abraham chu kum 100 nailam ahi jengin jong hitia atahsa chu athi tobang ahitah vang'in, chule Sarah naobu jong chu avoitah vang'in, atahsan chu adai lhadehpon ahi.
en_web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
en_kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred year old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:

tcz: Abraham chun Pathen thutep longlouvin atahsan'in ahi. Tahbeh in atahsanna chu ahatcheh in chule hichea chun Pathen loupina apen ahi.
en_web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
en_kjv: he staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

tcz: Pathen chun akitepna ipi hijongleh aboldoh ding ahi ti hetchetna kicheh aneiye.
en_web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
en_kjv: and being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

tcz: Chule Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in michonpha tia asem ahitai.
en_web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
en_kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

tcz: Chutia Pathen in ama michonphaa asem chu Abraham dinga bou phachoma ahipoi. Eiho phatchompi dinga jong kijih a ahi.
en_web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
en_kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chu itahsan uva ahileh Pathen in eiho jong michonpha'a eisem dingu ahi, ti hetchetna eipeuve.
en_web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
en_kjv: but for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

tcz: Ichonset jeh uva Ama chu thi dinga pehdoh a uma ahin, chule hinna a Ama kaithouva aum hin Pathen to eisuhcham'u ahitai.
en_web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
en_kjv: who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun, Pathen mitmua tahsan jal'a kisudih ihi tah jeh uvin, Pakai Yeshua Christa thilbol dohsa jal'a chu Pathen to kicham'a ihi tauve.
en_web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
en_kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

tcz: Christa chun itahsan jaluva hiche ichan diuva kilomlou hamphatna chu tu idinmun uva hi eipuilut'u ahitai, chule eiho lungngam tah le kipah tah a Pathen loupina chu changkhom ding ihiuve.
en_web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
en_kjv: by whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

tcz: Eihon hahsatna le patepna ho ito tenguleh ikipa thei jiu ahi, ajehchu hitobang itouva kon'a hi thohhatna ikisin dingu ahi.
en_web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
en_kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

tcz: Chule thohhatna chun chonchanpha sosah intin, chule ichonchan phatnau chun huhhing kinepna chu kisonpina ahin sodoh ding ahi.
en_web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
en_kjv: and patience, experience; and experience, hope:

tcz: Chule hiche kinepna chun eilunglhah sah pouvinte. Ajehchu eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hintem ti ihedoh tauve, ajehchu Ama hin a-Lhagaotheng chu Ama ngailutna ilungu lodim dingin eipetauve.
en_web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
en_kjv: and hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

tcz: Eihon kinepna imacha neilou hel'a ium laitah uvin, aphatchan Christa chu ahung'in michonse eiho ding in ahung thitan ahi.
en_web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
en_kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

tcz: Midih khat dingin mi atamjo thi dingin kiphal pouvinte, mipha dehset dinga thi dinga kiphaldoh khattou umjeng jong leh.
en_web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
en_kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

tcz: Ahivangin, Pathen in eingailut dehset nau vetsahnan, eiho chonset a ium laitah uvin Christa chu eiho dia thi dingin ahinsoltai.
en_web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
en_kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

tcz: Chule Christa thisan jal'a eiho Pathen mitmua chondih a eikisemuva ahitah jeh in, Pathen themmo chana a kon'a chu eihuh doh teiding'u ahi.
en_web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
en_kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

tcz: Ajehchu Achapa thi jal'a Pathen to kiloikhom kit theina ineiyu ahitah a ahileh, Achapa hin jal'a chu amelma ihinauva kona huhhing'a umtei ding ihiuve,
en_web: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
en_kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

tcz: Hijeh chun, tun, Pathen to kigui jopna phatah inei jaluvin kipah thei ihitauve, ajehchu i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun Pathen jol-le-gol'in eisem tauve.
en_web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
