en_kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

tcz: Adam achonset phat chun vannoiyah chonset ahunglut in, Adam chonsetna chun thina ahin polut'in, chutichun thina chu mitin chungah achutai, ajeh chu mijouse chonseah ahitai.
en_web: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
en_kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

tcz: Ahinai! Danthu kipeh masang jengin jong miho chu anachonseuve. Hinla palkeh ding Danthu ana umlou lai jeh in chonset chu chonset anakitipoi.
en_web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
en_kjv: for until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

tcz: Hiti chun, Adam'a kipat Mose phat chan geiyin Adam banga chonset anabol lou Pathen Thupeh ana palkeh lou ho jong anathiuve. Hiche Adam chu ahung dinga kisei Christa vetsahna ahije.
en_web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
en_kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

tcz: Ahin Adam chonsetna le Pathen Thilpeh man-lutah chu kibang louhel ahi. Ajehchu hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun mitampi chunga thina ahin pohlut ahitai. Hinla, chusanga lenjo cheh chu Pathen milungset kidang chule ngaidamna athilpeh mitampi dinga apeh, michom dang, Yeshua Christa, a apeh hi ahi.
en_web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
en_kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

tcz: Chule Pathen lungsetna manbei thilpeh in ahinsodoh chuto, mikhat chonset'in ahinsodoh chu gamchenga phatchomna nei ahi. Ajehchu, Adam chonset chun themmo channa alhut'in, hinlah Pathen manbei thilpeh chun ichonsetnau atamlheh vang'in, Pathen to kichamna asodoh in ahi.
en_web: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
en_kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

tcz: Ajehchu, hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun, mitampi chunga thina ahinsodoh ahi. Hinlah chusanga lenjo chu Pathen milungsetna kidangtah le achonphat thilpeh hi ahi, ajeh chu hiche kisan jouse chun hiche mikhat, Yeshua Christa, jal'a chonset le thina kona jona anei ding ahi.
en_web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.

tcz: Henge, Adam khatvei achonset chun, amichang cheh themmona ahin polut'in, hinla Christa khatvei chonphatna natoh chun Pathen to kigui jopna pha le hinkhothah amichang cheh ding ahin lhuttai.
en_web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
en_kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

tcz: Ajehchu mi khat'in Pathen sei angailou jeh in, mi tampi chonsea ahung hitai. Hinlah, michom dang khat Pathen thua anunjeh a, mi tampi achonphaa kisem ding ahitai.
en_web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
en_kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

tcz: Pathen Danthu kipeh hi miho jousen itobang loma chonse ahiu akimudoh theina dingu ahi. Hinla, miho chu achonse khohse cheh un ahileh, Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chu aning lhinbe cheh tai.
en_web: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
en_kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

tcz: Hijehchun, chonset chun mijouse chunga vai ahoma chule thina ahinpoh lut tobang'in, tunjong Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chun vai ahomjon, hichun Pathen toh kichamna chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'a tonsot Hinna ahin sodohtai.
en_web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
en_kjv: that as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in alungsetna kidangtah eichansahbe chehna dinguva ichonset jing dingu ham?
en_web: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
en_kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

tcz: Chuti thei ponte. Eiho chonsetna'a thisaho chu iti dan'a chuti bep'a chu ihinjom nahlai dingu ham?
en_web: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
en_kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

tcz: Ahilou jongleh eiho Christa Yeshua to kijop matna'a baptize chang chengse hi, Ama thina'a thitha ihiu nasuhmil'u hitam?
en_web: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
en_kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

tcz: Ajehchu eiho baptize ichan'u hi Christa toh thithaa chule kivuitha ihitauve. Ajehchu Pa thaneina loupitah chun Christa athia kona akaithou banga chu, tua hi eiho jong hinkho thah a ihinthei dingu ahitai.
en_web: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
en_kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

tcz: Ama thina a thikhom'ah ihiu banga chu, Ama thokit banga eiho jong hinna'a kaithouva umkit ding ihiu ahi.
en_web: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
en_kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

tcz: Eihoa um ihinau milui chonsetna chu Christa to khetbeh tha ihitah jeh uva, chonset in ihinkho uva tha aneina chu lahmanga um ding ahi.
en_web: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
en_kjv: knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho Christa toh ithiuva chu chonset thaneina noija kon eichamlhatsah-u ahitai.
en_web: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
en_kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

tcz: Chule eiho Christa toh thithaihitah jeh uva, eiho Amato ihin dingu ahi ti iheuve.
en_web: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
en_kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

tcz: Christa chu athilah a kona thoudoh'a ahitah jeh a, hiche hi ihetchen'u ahi, chule Ama chunga thinan thu aneitah loujeh-a Ama thikit talou ding ahi. Thina chun achunga thu aneitah lou ding ahitai.
en_web: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
en_kjv: knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

tcz: Ama athia chu chonset sulha dinga khatvei thia ahitai. Hinla, tua Ama ahintah jeh a, Pathen loupina dinga Ama dia hinga ahitai.
en_web: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
en_kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

tcz: Hijeh a hi nangho jong chonset thaneinaa chu athia nakigel dingu, chule Christa Yeshua jal'a ahinga nakigel dingu ahitai.
en_web: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

tcz: Hijehchun, natahsau thithei chunga hin tahsa lung ngaichat lam'a chonna dingin chonset vaihomsah hih hel'un
en_web: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
en_kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

tcz: Natibah chengu chu hoipen hijongleh chonset bolnaa man dingin pedoh hihbeh-un. Chusang'in, Pathen ah kipe thengun, ajehchu nangho athisa nahiuvin, hinla tun hinna naneitauve. Hijehchun, natahsa pumpiu chu Pathen loupina dingin adihlam bolna in manguvin.
en_web: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
en_kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

tcz: Nangho Danthu noija naum tahlou jeh uvin, chonset soh nahi tapouve. Chusangin, Pathen lungsetna noija chamlhat nahi tauve.
en_web: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
en_kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

tcz: Achutileh aphai! Pathen lungsetna chun Danthu noija kona eilha ongu ahitahleh, ichonset jom jing thei nahlaiyu ahi tina ham? Hiti chu hithei ponte.
en_web: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
en_kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

tcz: Koi hijeng jongleh asoh hidinga nakipehna pen dinga chu athua naum ding chu geldoh louva nahim? Nangma chonset soh nahithei, hichun thinaa napuilut ding, ahilouleh chonphatna hinkho Pathen seingaina hinkho naman thei ahi.
en_web: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
en_kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

tcz: Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Khatvei chu chonset soh nana hiu ahin, hinla tun nanghon hiche thuhil kahil nau hi nalung pum piuvin nangaiyuve.
en_web: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
en_kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

tcz: Tua hi nangho chonset soh nahiuva kona nachamlhat'u ahitan, chule chonphatna hinkhoa sohna natoh-u ahitai.
en_web: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
en_kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

tcz: Na mihinauva lhahsamna aumjeh a, hichea kiseiho jouse hi nahet theina dinguva soh thudol'a vetsahna a kasei ahi. Tumasang sea chu thenlouna le chonkhel na a sohchanga nahiu ahin, hichun chonset'a lhahlut thuh chehna a napui lut'u ahi. Tua hi nangho chonphatna soh a nakipeh lut joh dingu, hichun nathen sah dingu ahi.
en_web: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
en_kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

tcz: Nangho chonset soh nahipet uva chu thilpha bolna lama chamlhat nanahiuve.
en_web: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
en_kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

tcz: Chule hichun, aga ipi asodoh em? Nanghon nanabol hou chu najachat piu ahitai, hicheho chun tonsot themmona a napuilut dingu ahi.
en_web: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
en_kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

tcz: Hinlah tun, nangho chonset thaneina noiya ongthola nahi tahjeh uva Pathen sohte hung hia nahi tauve. Tun, nanghon hicheho hi nabol'u hin thenna le tonsot hinna ah nalha theitauve.
en_web: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
en_kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh chonset natohman thina ahi, hinla Pathen in manbeiya athilpeh hi, i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua jal'a Tonsot Hinna ahi.
en_web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

tcz: Tuhin sopi deitahte, Danthu he nanghon mikhat chunga chu dan'in aji hin laisea bou thu anei ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
en_web: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
en_kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man, as long as he liveth?

tcz: Avetsahnan, numei khat in ji anei tengleh Dan chun aji hin laisea thu anei ahi. Hinla amapa athi teng vangleh akichenna lhon Dan chu amanu chunga kimang thei talou ahi.
en_web: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
en_kjv: For the woman which hath a husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of the husband.

tcz: Hitichu ahin, ajipa hinlai sungin michom khattoh kicheng taleh, amanu chu jonbol hiding ahitai. Hinla ajipa chu thileh hiche jineina dan'a chu ongthol ahitan chule amanu chu jinei jongleh jonbol ahitapoi.
en_web: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
en_kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

tcz: Hitichu ahi, kasopi deitahte, hiche akiseilona ajehchu Christa toh nathi thau chun Dan thuneina'a kon'a athia nahiu ahitai. Chule nangho athia kona thoudohpa chuto thakhat nahiu ahitai. Hichea kona chu, Pathen'a dinga gapha ihinso doh theiyu ahitai.
en_web: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
en_kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

tcz: Eiho milui ihinau chun ei-thunun laiseuva chonset lung ngaichat in eiho chung'a na atoh ahi. Chule Dan hin hiche thil phalou ngaichatna chu ahin kondohsah a, hichun chonset ahin jia, thina asodoh ji ahi.
en_web: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
en_kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

tcz: Ahin tun, eiho Dan'a kona eikilha onguva ahitah jeh chun hiche Danthu'a chu athia ihitauvin, chule Dan thaneina'a chu sohchang ihitapouve. Tua hi Pathen lhachana itoh thei diu ahitai. Danthu lekha jem thua nungho lamakai chu hitalouva, lampithah, Lhagaova hing ihi joh-u ahitai.
en_web: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
en_kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, keiman Pathen Danthu chu chonsea ahitia kaseina ham? Ahipoi! Tahbeh in Dan chun kachonsetna eimusah ahin, keiman mi thilnei thangset aphapoi ti kana hepon, Danthu chun, “Minei thangse hih in,” ti eihet dohsah ahibouve.
en_web: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
en_kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

tcz: Hinlah, chonset in hiche thupeh amangchan keiya neipap kilosetna lung ngaichat jouse chu atildoh in ahi. Dan chu umlou ahileh, hiche tha chu aneilou lai ahi.
en_web: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
en_kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

tcz: Phat khat'in Danthu hetna neilouvin kana hingin, hinla keiman, thupeh in, vetsahnan, neipap kiloset lou ding tia eihil kahetdoh chun, chonset thaneina chu kachungah ahung lhunge;
en_web: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
en_kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

tcz: chuleh keima athia kahitai. Hitichun, keiman Danthupeh hochun hinna ahinlhut ding doltah hinlhut talouvin Lhagao thina joh ahinlhut taiti kamudoh e.
en_web: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
en_kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

tcz: Chuche thupeh ho chu chonset'in thuneinan aneiyin chule eilhem lhatai. Hiche chun, thupeh chu amangin eithattai.
en_web: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
en_kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, Danthu hi athengin chule athupeh ho jong atheng le adih chule apha ahi.
en_web: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
en_kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

tcz: Hinlah hichu iti hithei hintem? Danthu, aphachun, kathina ding ahin tohdoh jeng ham? Hiti lom chu hiponte! Chonset chun apha chu amanchah a, thina dinga kathemmo channa ahin lhutahi. Hitichun, chonset hi ichan geiya hoise ahidan mudoh theijin aume. Pathen thupeh pha chu thilphalouva dingin amangcha e.
en_web: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
en_kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

tcz: Hitichun, Danthu chu aboiyah ahipoi, ajehchu hichu lhagao thu ahin, chule apha ahi. Ajehchu keima lei mihem kahi val behseh jeh in, chonset soh kahin, boina chu keiya kon ahi.
en_web: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
en_kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima le keima kakihechenpoi, ijeh inem itileh adih chu kabol nom'in, hinla keiman kabolpoi. Hisang chun, kathet chu kabolin ahi.
en_web: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
en_kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

tcz: Ahin keiman kathilbol chu adih ahipoi, tia kahetleh hiche hin Danthu hi adih-e, ti kanopna eivetsah ahi.
en_web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
en_kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

tcz: Hitichun, ase bol'a chu keima hitalouva chonset keiya um chun abol ahi.
en_web: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
en_kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

tcz: Chule keiya phatna imacha aumpoi ti kahei, tichu-hiche chonset mihina kanei chun thilpha kabol nom in, hinlah kabol theijipoi.
en_web: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
en_kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

tcz: Thilpha chu kabol nom'in, hinla kabol jipoi. Aphalou chu kabol nompon, hinla keiman kabol jitai.
en_web: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
en_kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

tcz: Ahin kabol nomlou chu kabola ahileh abola chu keitahbeh hitalouva, chonset keiya um chun ahinbolji ahi.
en_web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
en_kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

tcz: Keiman hiche umdan hi kahetai. Keiman adih chu kabol nom'in, keiman adihlou joh chu kanabol jitai.
en_web: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
en_kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

tcz: Keiman Pathen Danthu kalung pumpin kabol nom'in ahi.
en_web: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
en_kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

tcz: Hinlah kasunga hin athunei chom khat aum'in, hichu kalungthim to kidouva ahi. Hiche thaneina hin keiya um chonset soh eihisah ahitai.
en_web: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
en_kjv: but I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

tcz: Ohe, itobang tah'a mikhoto um kahi hitam! Koiyin hiche tahsa chonset le thitheina vaihomna a kon'in eihuhdoh tantem?
en_web: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
en_kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

tcz: Pathen thangvah in umhen! Adonbutna hi IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa a um ahi. Hiti umdol chu hinven: Kalungin Pathen Danthu ajui nom'in, hinla keiya chonset mihina aumjeh hin keima chonset soh kahitai.
en_web: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
en_kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

tcz: Hitichun, tun Christa Yeshua a hiho (tahsa thua chonlou lhagaova chonho) dingin themmo channa ding aumtapoi.
en_web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
en_kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

tcz: Ajehchu nangma Amaa nahitah jeh in, hinna pea Lhagao chun chonset thuneina thinaa kon'a nachamlhat sah ahitai.
en_web: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
en_kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

tcz: Mose Dan chun eihuhhing jou pouve, ajehchu ichonset nomnau imihinau alhahsam jal jeh ahi. Hijehchun, Danthun atoh joulou chu Pathen in Achapa chang khat eiho tahsa melpua ahin sol'a atohdoh ahitai. Chule hiche tahsa achu Pathen'in eihoa um ichunguva chonset thuneina chu suhbeina dinga Achapa chu kilhaina a apehdoh ahitai.
en_web: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
en_kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

tcz: Aman hiche abol chu Danthu in dihna angehna chu eihoa lungna chamkim sahna dinga ahin, eihon ichonset nom nau thua inun louna dingu ahi.
en_web: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
en_kjv: that the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

tcz: Chonset'in avaihom ho chun chonset thil bou agel jiuvin, hinla Lhagao Theng'in athunun miho chun Lhagao lunglhaina ho agel ding'u ahi.
en_web: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
en_kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

tcz: Hijeh chun, nachonset nomnau lungthim chun na-thununuva ahileh thinaa napuilut ding'u ahi. Hinla, Lhagao Theng'in nalungthim'u athunun a ahileh, hinna le lungmonna hiding ahi.
en_web: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
en_kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

tcz: Ajehchu chonsetna lungthim hin Pathen adou jinge. Hichu Pathen Danthu toh kikal ahi, chule juijong ajuilou ding ahi.
en_web: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
en_kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, achonset nomnau lunggel'in athujo miho chun Pathen alunglhai thei louhel dingu ahi.
en_web: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
en_kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

tcz: Hinlah nangho nachonset nom nau lungthim in na-thunun'u ahitapoi. Nasung uva Pathen Lhagao achen vangleh nangho Pathen Lhagao chun na-thunun'u ahitai. (chule nahetdiu chu, asunga Christa Lhagaovin chenna a aneilou chengse chu ama a hilou hel ahiuve.)
en_web: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
en_kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

tcz: Chule Christa nasung uva cheng ahi, hijeh a chu chonset jeh in natahsau thiding hijong leh, Lhagao chun hinna napeh u ahi ajeh chu Pathen a kisudih nahi tauve.
en_web: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
en_kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

tcz: Yeshua athi lah a kon'a kaithoupa Pathen Lhagao nasung uva chenga ahitai. Chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua chu athia kona akaithou banga, nasung uva Lhagao um Ama chu amanchah a natahsau thithei chu Hinna apeh ding ahi.
en_web: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
en_kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

tcz: Hijehchun sopi deitahte, nachonset lung ngaichat'u thua nunna dingin imacha a mopohna nakilah dingu aumpoi.
en_web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
en_kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

tcz: Ajehchu chonset thua nanun le nathi teiding ahi. Hinlah Lhagao Theng thahatna jal'a nachonset lungngaichat chu natha vangleh nahin ding ahi.
en_web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
en_kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Lhagao puihoiya umjouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve.
en_web: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
en_kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

tcz: Hijehchun nangho Lhagao nachan'u chun kichatsetna soh channa nasou ahipoi. Chusang'in Pathen Lhagao changa nahiuvin, hiche jal'a chu chapa-lamthu hina nachan'u ahitai. Hitia chu, tua eihon Ama chu Abba Hepa tia ikouvu ahitai.
en_web: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
en_kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

tcz: Ajehchu Ama Lhagao le eiho lhagao akijopmat chun Pathen chate ihiu aphotchen ahitai.
en_web: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
en_kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

tcz: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uva goulo ding jong ihitauve. Tahbeh in, Christa to Pathen loupina chu lokhom ding ihitauve. Hinla eihon aloupina ichan khompi dingu ahileh, agimthoh jong hi ichankhompi dingu ahi.
en_web: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
en_kjv: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

tcz: Tupet'a ithohgim nau hi khonunga Aman ahin phondoh ding loupina chutoh tekah thei ahipoi.
en_web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
en_kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

tcz: Ajehchu thilsem jouse hin khonunga hung lhung ding, Pathen chateho kiphondoh nading nikho chu kinemtah'a ngah jing'a um'u ahi.
en_web: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
en_kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

tcz: Thilsem jouse hi ama lungdeilou lam'a Pathen gaosapna chang ahitauve. Ahin kinem tah'a,
en_web: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
en_kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same, in hope,

tcz: thilsem hohin Pathen chate thina leh amonmang thei a kon chamlhatna loupia ahinkhom nading'u nikho chu galdot jing ahiuve.
en_web: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
en_kjv: because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

tcz: Ajehchu eihon athilsem jouse ngahlel a, naosonat thoh tobanga penga tuchan geiya um uva ahi, ti iheuve.
en_web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
en_kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

tcz: Chule eiho atahsan ho jong isunggil uva Lhagaotheng inei jaluva khonunga loupina hung lhung ding galdot'a ihiuve. Ajehchu, eiho itahsau hi chonset le gimthohna a kona ontholna imu diu kinem'a ngah a ihiuve. Eiho jengin jong kinepna neija Pathen in Acha-lamthute hina a ngansena lhingset tahsaa vouthah eithutep'u jong ngah a ihiuve.
en_web: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
en_kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

tcz: Eiho huhhing'a i-um'u hin hiche kinepna hi eipeh-u ahi (eihon ineisau ipi ham khat chu mudinga kinem ihipouve).
en_web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
en_kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

tcz: Hinlah eihon ipiham khat ineilouvu chu ngah a ihiuleh eihon thoh hattah le kinem'a ingadiu ahi.
en_web: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
en_kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

tcz: Chule Lhagaotheng chun eiho ilhahsamnauva eipanhu jinguve. Avetsahnan, eihon adoltah a Pathen'a iti itao diu eideipeh uchu ihepouve. Hinlah Lhagao Theng hi eiho dingin athuchenga seitheilouvin apeng peng'in taopehna eineiyun ahi.
en_web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
en_kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

tcz: Chule lunggel jouse hesoh a Pa chun, Lhagaovin athusei chu ahen ahi, ajehchu Lhagao chun atahsan eiho dingin Pathen lunglam chuto kitoh dingin eithumpeh uve.
en_web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
en_kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho le Ama lunggon a akouho dingin imalam jousea aphatna dingu abolpeh ahi, ti iheuve.
en_web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
en_kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Amite ahet masah ahi, chule hichu Ama asopite lah a apeng masapen ahitheina ding hunghia ahitai.
en_web: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
en_kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn amongst many brethren.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho alhendoh jouvin, amaho chu akoma akouvin ahi, chule Aman akou jouvin amaho chu Amato dinmun thakhat'in asem'in, chule dinmun thakhat'a asem ho chu Aloupina jong apetai.
en_web: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
en_kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

tcz: Hitobang loma kidangtah thil abol thudol hi ipi isei dingu hitam? Pathen chu eiho lama apanle koi eiho dou dia pang thei ding ham?
en_web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
en_kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

tcz: Aman a-Chapa tahbeh bon chu khen dehlouva, chusanga eiho jouse dinga eihungpeh doh jengtah uva ahileh, thildang jouse jong eipehlou dingu ham?
en_web: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
en_kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

tcz: Pathen in Amite alhendoh ho dinga chu koiyin themmo eichan ngam dingu ham? Koimacha umlou ahi; Ajehchu Pathen Amatah in kichamna einabol peh-u ahitai.
en_web: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
en_kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth:

tcz: Chuti ahileh koiyin themmo eichan tauvintem? Koima cha umlou, ajehchu Christa Yeshua eiho din anathin chule thina a kon'in eiho dingin athoudohtai, chule Ama Pathen jetlam jabolna mun'a atouvin, eiho dingin eithumpeh jinguve.
en_web: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
en_kjv: who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

tcz: Christa ngailutna'a kona eikhenthei dingu aumdem? Eihon hahsatna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh gimbolna ahilouleh gilkelna ahilouleh kiphahsamna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh thichan geiya gihsalna ho itou hin, Aman eingailu tapouve tia isei dingu ham?
en_web: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
en_kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

tcz: (Pathen lekhabun asei dung juiyin, “Ajehchu nangma jal'in niseh in eikithat un, keiho hi kelngoi bangin eikithat jiuve,” ati).
en_web: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
en_kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

tcz: Achutipoi. Hicheho jouse chungvuma chun ei hon galjona loupitah, eingailupau Christa jal'in ineithei tauve.
en_web: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
en_kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

tcz: Chule keiman kigel lhahna kicheh kanei hi, koimachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou ding ahitai. Thina hihen, hinna hijongleh, vantilte hihen, lhagao engseho hijongleh, imachan eikhen theilou ding ahi, tia dettah a katahsan ahitai.
en_web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
en_kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

tcz: Chunga Van mun'a thaneina hihen, leichunga hijongleh-tahbeh a sei dingin, thilsem jouse lah a imachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou dingu ahi tihi i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua a kiphongdoh a ahitai.
en_web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Keiman thudih kasei hi Christa ahetoh ahi. Ase le apha hetna kaneiyin chule Lhagao Theng aphotchetna ahi.
en_web: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
en_kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

tcz: Kalungthim hi hatah in lunghemna le lung kicholdo theilou gimnan kadime.
en_web: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
en_kjv: that I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

tcz: Ajeh chu kamite Judah mite kasopiho dingin, keima Christa'a kona a-itih a gaosap chang kahinom'e; hichun amaho ahuhhing jou ding hileh kati ahi.
en_web: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
en_kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

tcz: Amaho Israel mite ahiuvin, Pathen cha-lamthu hina changah ahiuvin, Pathen in aloupina amaho heng alhut ahitai. Aman amaho to kitepna aneiya chule a-Danthu apehdoh ahiuve. Aman amaho chu ahoutheina dinguva michonpha a asem ahin, chule athutep kidangtah ahin pehdoh ahiye.
en_web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
en_kjv: who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

tcz: Amaho hi Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob son le chilhahte ahiuvin, chule Christa amatah chu mihem lamdola sei dingin Israel mi anahi, chule Ama Pathen ahin, thil jouse chunga vaihoma ahin, chule tonsot'a vahchoi ding'a kilom ahi.
en_web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
en_kjv: whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in Israel techu athutep lamdola abolpeh lougot hitam? Ahipoi, Israel nam sunga peng jouse chu abonuva Pathen mite ahidehpouve.
en_web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
en_kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

tcz: Abraham chilhah himan'a Abraham chate tia kisim jenga ahipoi. Ajehchu Pathen thun Isaac a naphunggui kisut ding ahi ati chun, Abraham'in chapa dang anei henasa asei ahi.
en_web: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
en_kjv: neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

tcz: Hichehi, tahsalam a Abraham'in ahindoh chate jouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve tia seina ding aumpoi. Thutep chate bou chu Abraham chate tia kisima ahije.
en_web: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
en_kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in athutep, “Khovei tuphat tengleh keima kahung kile kit ding Sarah chun chapa khat ahinding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
en_kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

tcz: Hiche achapa chu ipuluiyu Isaac ahi. Aman Rebekah akichenpi chun mi-ni apengkop'in ahi.
en_web: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
en_kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

tcz: Hinlah amani ahung penlhah masang lhon'in, thilpha ahilouleh thilse abol masang lhon'in, Pathen'a kon'a thulhut amu ahi (Hiche thulhunga kona chu Pathen in Ama lunggon dungjuiya akouji ahi, tihi ahi.
en_web: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
en_kjv: (for the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

tcz: Amaho phat le set jeh jong ahidehpoi tihet ahi). Amanu koma, “Nachapa atahpa chu anaopa kinbola hung pang ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
en_kjv: it was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

tcz: Pathen thun, “Keiman Jacob kangailun, hinla Esau chu kapampai ahi,” ati.
en_web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
en_kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

tcz: Chuti ahileh, eihon Pathen chu athilbol adihpoi itiuvem? Ahideh poi!
en_web: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
en_kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in Mose jah a, “Keiman ka khotona'a kalhendoh penpen chunga kalhut ding, chule kahepina chu kalhendoh pen chunga kalhut ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
en_kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen khotona chu Ama kigel lhah thuthu hiya ahi. Eihon ilhen theiju jong hilou, toh'a itohdoh theiju jong ahidehpoi.
en_web: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
en_kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen lekhabun, anaseisa chu Pathen in Pharaoh jah a, “Keiman kathahatna nachunga katahlang na dinga keiman nangma kalhen nahin chule kaminthanna leiset pumpia kathejal dinga nahi,” tia anasei pehsa ahi.
en_web: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
en_kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

tcz: Hijeh'a chu, Pathen in ami khotona chu mi abangkhat chunga avetsah a chule aman midang lungsung chu asuhtah a asei angaipeh lou ahi.
en_web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
en_kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, nangman, “Iti dan'a athu jalou ho chu a oimo hintem? Aman amaho abolsah chan chu abol'u hijeng lou ding ham?” tin nate.
en_web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
en_kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

tcz: Ahipoi, hichu seihih in. Nangma mihem maimai'in Pathen nanel ngam ham? Thilsem khat chun asempa jah a chu, “Ipi dinga hitobang bep'a hi neisem ham?” tia asei ngaijem!
en_web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
en_kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

tcz: Bel dengpa chun leiset'a kon'a belho asem tengleh ama chun aleiset leingan chu aphabep khat ajem ding'a asem'a chule phabep khat loi chu nen koina a jong asemthei hilou ham?
en_web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
en_kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

tcz: Hitobangma chun, Pathen in jong alunghanna le athahatna vetsahna dingin thaneina aneiyin, chule alunghanna chuhna ho chunga jong thohhat tah a anga'a amahthahna diu gonsa akoipeh ahitai.
en_web: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
en_kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much long-suffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

tcz: Hiche abol hi aloupina ho dung juiya, aloupina tahlangna dinga mi akhotona chu kilangdoh cheh dinga agon ahi.
en_web: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
en_kjv: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

tcz: Chule eiho Aman alhendoh ho lah'a hi Judah mite leh chidang namdang ho chunga hijongleh eiho jong ijaouve.
en_web: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
en_kjv: even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

tcz: Chidang namdangte chung chang thua Pathen in Hosea Themgao henga gaova aseidohsa, “Kamite hilouho chu keiman kamite tia tuapat kakou ding ahitai, chule keiman kangailut louho chu kangailut ding ahitai.
en_web: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
en_kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

tcz: Chule amaho kamite nahi pouve kitina mun'a chu Pathen Hing chate kiti ding ahiuve.
en_web: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
en_kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

tcz: Chule Israel chung chang thua Themgao Isaiah chun ahinsamdoh in, Israel mite chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat tam'in tam jongleh, amoh them bou sohcha ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
en_kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin leiset chunga thutanna gangtah le achaina pena dinga ahinbol ding ahi.
en_web: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
en_kjv: for he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

tcz: Chule Isaiah chun mundanga hitima chun aseiyin, “Ven sopite Pakai chun ichateu themkhat hi ahoidoh lou hileh eiho hi Sodom banga eikithat chaihel uvintin, Gomorrah banga eisuhmang dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
en_kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

tcz: Hicheho jouse hi ipi kiseina hintem? Chidang namdang te Pathen chondan juilou ahivangun, amaho chu Pathen lungtoh dia kisema ahitauve. Chule tahsan hin hiche hi ahin hitheisah ahi.
en_web: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
en_kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

tcz: Hinlah Israel mite Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga kihabol ho jeng jong Danthu ajui jeng vangun alolhing joupouve.
en_web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
en_kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

tcz: Ipijeh a lolhinglou hiuvem? Ajeh chu amahon Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga Ama tahsan sangin Danthu ajuiyuve. Ama ho alamlhahnauva songpia kipal ahitauve.
en_web: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
en_kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

tcz: Pathen lekhabun amaho gihsalna ananei'in, ajah uva, “Keiman Jerusalema songpi khat kakoiyin, hichun miho akipalsah'e, amaho lhuh kamna songpi khat ahi. Hinla koihileh Ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
en_kjv: as it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, kalunga kagelkhoh jingle Pathen'a kataona hi Israel mite huhhing'a aumna dingu hi ahi.
en_web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
en_kjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

tcz: Amahon Pathen'a thanopna aneinau chu ipi ahi kahei, hinla hichu hetkhenna beiya kipehna nei ahiuve.
en_web: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
en_kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen in miho chu Ama a dinga athemchan thudol hi ahethei pouve. Pathen tohgon chu amahon asan nomlou jeh uvin, amaho lung ngaito jui'a Pathen themchanna mu ding chu alunggon'u ahi.
en_web: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
en_kjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa chun Danthu kipehlona ajehchu anasuh bulhitsa ahitai. Hiche jal'a chu Ama tahsan jouse chu Pathen themchanna asodoh ahitai.
en_web: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
en_kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

tcz: Ajehchu Mose chun Danthua mikhat themchanna dinga athupehsa chu nit ding ahi, ati.
en_web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
en_kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

tcz: Hinlah tahsanjal'a Pathen themchan theina ding chun, “Nangman nalung thima koi vana gakal ding ham (Christa chu vana kona agapuilhah ding kiseina ahi).
en_web: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
en_kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

tcz: Chule koi mithiho lah a gakumsuh ding ham? (Christa chu hinsah kitna ding in) tihih un.
en_web: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
en_kjv: or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

tcz: Tahbeh mong'in, hitin ati. Athupoh chu ahung nailheh-e; hichu nakam sungle nalung sunga aume.” Chule chuche thupeh chu keihon kalhangsap'u tahsan thudol chu ahi.
en_web: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
en_kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

tcz: Nangman nakam'a Yeshua chu Pakai ahi tia naphondoh-a chule Pathen in Ama chu athilah a kon'in akaithoutai ti nalungsunga natahsan tah-a ahileh huhhing'a um nahi ding ahitai.
en_web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
en_kjv: that if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

tcz: Ajehchu nalung sunga natahsan chun Pathen themchanna chu nachan sah ahitai, chule na-phondoh chun nangma huhhing'a naumsah ahitai.
en_web: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
en_kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

tcz: Pathen lekhabun eiseipeh-u dungjuiyin, “Koi hijongleh ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi” ati.
en_web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
en_kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

tcz: Hiche thudol a hin Judah mite le chidang namdang ho thakhat ahitai. Amahon Pakai khat aneikhom'un, Ama kou jouse chu lungsetna bulhingset apei.
en_web: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
en_kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

tcz: Ajehchu koihileh Pakai min'a taochan chu huhhing'a umding ahi.
en_web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
en_kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

tcz: Hinlah amahon Ama atahsanlou uleh a-huhhing theina dinga iti akou thei dingu ham? Chule Ama thudol anajah khah lou u ahileh iti ahin tahsan thei dingu ham? Chule koiham khat'in aseipeh louva ahileh amahon iti achungchang thu ajah thei dingu ham?
en_web: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
en_kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

tcz: Chule akisol aum louhela ahileh, koipen gachea amaho thu agaseipeh dingu ham? Hichejeh a chu Pathen thubun, “Kipana Thupha poa vahle ho keng iti hoiya hoi hitam,” ati ahi.
en_web: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
en_kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

tcz: Hinlah amichang cheh in Kipana Thupha chu anasang pouve, Ajehchu Isaiah Themgaovin, “Pakai kathupoh-u tahsan'a koi ham?” anati.
en_web: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
en_kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

tcz: Hitichun, tahsan chu thujah a kon ahin, hichu Christa chung chang thujah a kon ahi.
en_web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
en_kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

tcz: Hinlah ken kadongin, “Israel miten thu hunglhung thu chu ajah tahbeh-u hinam?” Henge, ajanauve. “Thu hunglhung chu leiset kolkimvel'a akithe chansoh in, chule thuchu vannoi mun jousea alhungsoh-e.”
en_web: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
en_kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

tcz: Hinlah ken kadong'in, “Israel mipiten ahet khen mong'u hinam?” kati'e. Henge, aheuve, ajehchu Mose phatlai jeng jong chun Pathen in aseijin, “Keiman nangho namkhat hiloulai hojong miho thangset sah dinga ngolnaa chu kalunghansah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
en_kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

tcz: Chule khonungin Isaiah chun, lung ngam tah in Pathen'a kon'in hitin aseiye, “Keiman kamite kamudoh dingho chu einahelou miho hiding ahiuve. Keima eidonlou beh ho chu keiman kakimudoh sah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
en_kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

tcz: “Hinlah, Israel chung chang thua, Pathen in aseiyin, nilhum keiyin keiman amaho chunga kakhut kajah in, hinla amaho seingai louleh engset hatte ahiuve,” ati.
en_web: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
en_kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long have I stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

tcz: Ahileh Pathen in Ami Israel techu anungsun hitam? tin kadonge. Chuti chu ahipoi! Keima tah Israel mi kahi, Abraham chilhah khat kahin, chule Benjamin phunga mi kahi.
en_web: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
en_kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

tcz: Ahipoi, Pathen in Amite anungsun poi, amaho chu atil abula analhensa ahiuve. Hiche chungchang thua Pathen thun ipi aseiyem? Elijah Themgao in Pathen koma anopmosahna Israel mite chungthua aphongdoh in chule aseiyin,
en_web: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
en_kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,

tcz: “Pakai, amahon na-Themgaoho athat'un chule namaicham phungho aphelha tauve. Keima changsehbou eiki-dalha a ahitai. Chule tun amahon keima jeng jong tha ding eigouve,” ati.
en_web: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
en_kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in ipia adonbut nageldoh em? Aman, “Ahipoi, Keiman Baal anga dilsukhalou mi sang sagi adang kanei nalaije,” ati.
en_web: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
en_kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

tcz: Tulaiya jong chutima ahi, Israel mi phabep chu Pathen lungsetna jal'in tahsan umtah ahinalai uve. Aman ami hepina chang dinga kilom louva amaho alhendoh jal'a ahi.
en_web: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
en_kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

tcz: Chule hichu Pathen lungset them ahina jal jeh-in athil phabol jeh-u ahipoi. Ajehchu, hiche thudola hi Pathen lungsetna chu ahina banga hitalou ding, manbei chule chan dinga kilom hilouva ahitai (Hinlah hichu natohjal hitaleh, lungset jal hithei talouhel ding ahitai, achuti louleh natoh chu natoh hitalou ding ahije).
en_web: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
en_kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

tcz: Hijehchun, hiche umdol hi hiti ahi: Israel mi atamjo hin Pathen lunglhaina ding gunchuten'a ahol vang'un amujou pouve. Pathen in alhendoh phabep honbou amu uve; hinla adangse lungthim chu suhtah cheh a um ahiuve.
en_web: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
en_kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded,

tcz: Pathen lekhabun asei, “Pathen in amaho chu a-ihmut milsah ahitai. Tuni chan geiya hi amit'u aphelpeh hi amutheilouna dingu ahi, chule akol'u asip'u hin ajahtheilouna ding'u hiya ahitai.”
en_web: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
en_kjv: (according as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

tcz: Chutima chun David'in aseiyin, “Amahon anopneh nau dokhang chu akipalnau thangin panghen, doha a kibol'a akimatna diu chu ima tiponte tin gelu hen. Phatthei achan'u chu akipalna diu hihen, chule amahon achan diuva kilom chu kimu uhen.
en_web: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
en_kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

tcz: Amahon amit uva amutheilouna ding'un kho mulouvin umuhen, chule alungthim'u chu a-imatih a bojang theilou din umhen,” ati.
en_web: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
en_kjv: let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

tcz: Pathen mite chu kipal lhu'uva chule kithoudoh theilouva umden diu hiya hitam? Chuti theiponte! Amaho seingailou ahinau chu Pathen in chidang namdang ho huhhing'a aum sahna dingu ahi. Hichehin, Amite chun thangthip pehna ahin nei uva amaho ding tah-a ahin kilethum theina dingu adeipehjeh ahijoi.
en_web: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
en_kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

tcz: Tua hi chidang namdang ho ahaosatnau hi Israel miten Pathen in Huhhingna apeh-u imacha a aselou jeh-u ahin, chea kona hi amahon achaina pena ahin kisan tenguleh vannoiyin gamchenga phattheina amube chehna diu chu alung ngaito ahi.
en_web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
en_kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

tcz: Keiman hiche kasei jouse hi nangho Gentile ho dinga ahi. Pathen in keima hi Gentile ho lah a dinga solchah a eilhen ahi thudol kasei khohten ahi.
en_web: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
en_kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman chidang namdang nanghon naneiyu huhhingna hi Israel miten nahin thangset peh theina dingu kangaitoa kagelkhoh hi amaho themkhat beh kahuh doh theina ding kati ahi.
en_web: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
en_kjv: if by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

tcz: Ajehchu amahon akisan nomlou uva pat Pathen in huhhingna hi vannoi mundang jousea dinga aphaldoh ahin, amahon ahin kisanthei tenguleh kidang jocheh ding ahi. Athiho dinga hinna hung hiding ahitai.
en_web: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
en_kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

tcz: Chule Abraham le ipului hou adangse chu athigam'un, amaho chilhah ho theng diu ahi. Ajehchu changbong chu atheng ahi banga maicham'a dinga kikheng doh jong chu atheng ahi. Ajehchu thingbul chu athenleh abah jong chu theng ding ahiye.
en_web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
en_kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

tcz: Hinlah Abraham chilhah phabep chu tanboh in aumuve. Chule nangho chidang namdangte, gam Olive thingphung bah hoa kon nahiuvin, kijopmat tha bou nahiuve. Hijeh chun tun, nanghon jong Pathen'a kona phattheina Abraham le achilhahte kithutepsa chu changa nahi tauvin, Pathen deilhen Olive thinga haona lhingset phattheina chu chang'a nahi tauve.
en_web: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
en_kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in amongst them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

tcz: Hinlah akisubong'ah abah hoa kijopmat nahijeh un nahoithouva nakiletsah lou dingu ahi. Nangma abah maimai nahi, aphung chu nahipoi.
en_web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
en_kjv: boast not against the branches: but if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

tcz: Nangman, “Aphai, hiche abahho kisubong chu keima to kijopmatna theiding ahi” tia nasei thei ahi.
en_web: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
en_kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

tcz: Ahinai, hijongleh geldoh in: chuche abahho akisuhboh nau ajehchu amahon Christa atahsan lou jeh-u ahi, chule nangman natahsan jeh-a naum ahi. Hijehchun, kichoisang hih in, ahin ipi sohthei ding ahi thua kichajon.
en_web: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
en_kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not high-minded, but fear:

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in abahho bon chu ahinghoi louva ahileh, nangma jeng jong nahing hoi ponte.
en_web: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
en_kjv: for if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

tcz: Pathen hi lungset them ahidan le akhoh je hedoh in. Athu ngailou ho dinga chu lungkhoh a ahi, hinla athua nungho dinga lungset them ahi, amilungsetna natahsan jom jingu ahitah leh, hinlah tahsan nangah ule nangho jong kisat lha ding nahiuve.
en_web: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
en_kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

tcz: Chule Israel mi chun atahsanlou nauva alungu ahin heiyuva ahileh, amaho chu kijop mat kit thei ahi, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu aphunga chu ahinjop mat kittheiyu ahi.
en_web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
en_kjv: And they also, if they bide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

tcz: Nangho angai monga gam Olive thingbah kisatlha nahiuve. Hitia chu Pathen in angaiya kon hilou Olive thingtoh najop mat'u ahin, atil'a pat abahho chu Olive phung chutoh ajopmat kit ding chu kijopmat cheh ding ahi.
en_web: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
en_kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, hiche thuguh hi kahet chetsah noma, hichu nakimoh letsah louna dingu kati ahi. Israel mi phabep'in lungtahna aneiyu hi chidang namdang ho Christa a ahung nadingu amijat bulhin loulai jeh bou ahitai.
en_web: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
en_kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

tcz: Chule hitia chu Israel jouse huhhing hidiu ahi. Pathen lekhabun aseiye, “Jerusalem'a kona huhhing dingpa chu hung ding ahi, chule aman Israel mite chu Pathen ngaisah louna'a kona alehei ding ahi.
en_web: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
en_kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

tcz: Chule hiche hi ama hoto kitepna hiding ahi, Keiman amaho chonsetna kalah mang ding ahi.”
en_web: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
en_kjv: for this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

tcz: Israel mi tampihi Kipana Thupha melma'a pang'ah ahiuvin, chule hiche hin chidang namdang nangho phatchomna napeh-u ahi. Hijeng jongleh amaho angailut mite ahiuve, ajehchu aman apuluiyu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob alhendoh ahi.
en_web: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
en_kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen thilpeh hole Aman akou ho chu kikhelkit talou dingu ahi.
en_web: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
en_kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

tcz: Khatvei chu chidang namdang hon Pathen ana douvu ahi, hinla Israel miten Ama adouvu chun Pathen in nangho nalungset joh-u ahitai.
en_web: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
en_kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

tcz: Tun amaho doulung pua ahiuvin, Pathen mihepina chu nahengu hung lhung ahi, hitia chu amaho jong Pathen mihepina chu achan theina dingu ahi.
en_web: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
en_kjv: even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

tcz: Pathen in amichang cheh lungsetna achan theina dinguva ami changcheh chu seingai louva akhumchah ahitai.
en_web: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
en_kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

tcz: O Pathen haona le chihna chule hetna hohi iti kidan hitam! Alampi ho le alunggel ngaito hetphah jouding ahipoi.
en_web: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
en_kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

tcz: Ajehchu koiham Pakai lunggel hedoh joujai dinga? Ama thumop themna geiya hea koi umem?
en_web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
en_kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?

tcz: Chule koiham apeh tamval behseh jeh a lepeh kit dinga chu?
en_web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
en_kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

tcz: Ajehchu imajouse hi Ama'a kona hunga chule ijakai hi Ama thahatna'a uma, chule hichu ama loupina dinga gon ahije. Loupina jouse tonsot'in Ama a hijing hen! Amen.
en_web: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
en_kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

tcz: Chule hiti chun sopi deitahte, kahin ngeh nahiuve, Pathen in ijakai nabolpehtah jeh uvin Amadin natahsau chu peuvin. Hichu ahing chule athengsel kilhaina–Pathen santhei dol tah hihen. Hiche hi adihlam'a Ama houtheina chu ahi.
en_web: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
en_kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

tcz: Nanghon tulai vannoi chonna le umchan khosahna ho jom hih-un, ahin Pathen'in mithah hina lungthah napeu henlang nalunggel ngaitonau khel hen. Chutengleh Pathen in nangho dinga apha le lunglhaina chule chamkimna nagonpeh-u chu nahin het ding'u ahi.
en_web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
en_kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

tcz: Pathen in chanpha le thuneina eipeh jal a hiche thua hi kahilchah nahiuve: Nangho nahina tahbeh-u kalval'in phajon kigel hih-un. Nangho tah nakigel nauva Pathen in tahsan eipeh dung juiyun ahibepchan kigel'un.
en_web: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
en_kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
