tcz: Itahsauvin tibah tampi anei cheh in chule tibah khatcheh in panna aneicheh-un ahi.
en_web: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
en_kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

tcz: Hitobangma chun Christa tipum jong chutima ahi. Eiho tipum khat chung'a tibah tampi ihiu ahin, chule eiho ibonchauva khat cheh hi khat tibah ihiu ahi.
en_web: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
en_kjv: so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

tcz: Alungsetna'a Pathen in thilpeh jatchom chom cheh eipeh-u ahin, hichu phatah a iboltheina dingu ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen in gao thusei theina napeh a ahileh, Pathen in napeh tahsan nanei dungjuiyin seijin.
en_web: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
en_kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh nachan chu midang kithopina dinga ahileh, phatah in kithopinan bol'in. Nangma mihil'a napanleh, phatah in hil'in.
en_web: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
en_kjv: or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh nachan chu midang tilkhouna ahileh, tilkhouvin; hongphalna lama thilpeh nachan ahileh hongphal tah in pedoh in. Pathen in lamkai hina boltheina napeh leh, namopohna chu gelkhohna neijin. Chule nangma milungset themna thilpeh nachan'a ahileh kipah tah in bol'in.
en_web: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
en_kjv: or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

tcz: Midang chu angailu tobang bep'in umhih'un, ngailutahbeh uvin. Adihlou chu thetbol'un, thutah chu kolchah kheh-un.
en_web: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
en_kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

tcz: Nangho khat le khat kingailutna dihtah in kihepito them'un, chule khat le khat kijabolna thanop piuvin.
en_web: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
en_kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

tcz: Thase hihbeh un, ahin natoh ponthouvin chule Pakai kinbol chu thanopnan neiyun.
en_web: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
en_kjv: not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

tcz: Ama a ikinepnauva kipah thanom'un. Hahsatna a thoh hat-un, chule taojom jing'un.
en_web: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
en_kjv: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

tcz: Pathen mite ngaichatna a kithopina neiyun. Jindot them dan kichuh jinguvin.
en_web: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
en_kjv: distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

tcz: Nabolse teu chu phattheiboh un. Amaho chu gaosap hih un, Pathen in phatthei abohna dingin taopeh un.
en_web: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
en_kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

tcz: Akipahho kipapiuvin, chule akap ho kapiuvin.
en_web: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
en_kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

tcz: Khat le khat kitoh del'in cheng khomun. Milham hotoh kiloikhomna neina dinga kiletsah hoitho bolhih un. Chule ijakai hesoh keiyin kigel hih un.
en_web: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
en_kjv: Be of the same mind one towards another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

tcz: Miphalou chu aphalou cheh a lethuh hih un, nangho ja umtah nahiu chu mijousen amuna dingin bolun.
en_web: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
en_kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

tcz: Nabol jouseu chu amichang cheh to kichamna dingin bol'un.
en_web: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
en_kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

tcz: Gol lepaite, phuba lah bol hih'un, Pathen dihtah lung hanna chu otdoh jouvin. Ajehchu Pathen thubu in, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu lethuh nange” ati.
en_web: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
en_kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

tcz: Chusangin, “Namelmateu chu agil akelleh vahva set-un, amaho adang'u achah leh adon ding peuvin. Hitia chu naboluva ahileh alujanguva mei-am setkhompeh nahi dingu ahi.”
en_web: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
en_kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

tcz: Setna chun najou hih uhen, hinla setna chu thilpha in jou jouvin.
en_web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
en_kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

tcz: Amitakip thunei vaipo ho thua nungtei diudol ahi. Ajehchu thuneina jouse hi Pathen'a kon ahin, chule thuneina panmun hoa Pathen'in amaho apansah ahi.
en_web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
en_kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

tcz: Hijeh a chu koi hijongleh athuneiho douva chu Pathen tohgonsa douva ahiuvin, chutia chu gimbolna ama hon akimu dingu ahi.
en_web: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
en_kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

tcz: Ajehchu thuneiho khu thilpha bolho dinga kichat ding hilou ahiuve, hinla thilse bolho chunga ding bou ahi. Thuneiho kichalouva na-umnom em? Adih chu bol'in, chuteng amahon najabol dingu ahi.
en_web: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
en_kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

tcz: Thuneiho khu thilpha bol dinga kisol doh Pathen sohte ahiuve. Hinla aphalou nabol'a ahileh kichatna neijon, ajehchu amahon gimbol theina thaneina aneiyu ahi. Amaho chu thilphalou bolho gimbol dinga Pathen in asol ahiuve.
en_web: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
en_kjv: for he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangho amaho thuneina noija nakipehlut dingu ahi, na-engbollouna ding'u jengseh a bou hilouva, se-le-pha hetna lunggel neitheina dinga jong ahi.
en_web: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
en_kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

tcz: Hiche jehchun kaisum peuvin, ajehchu Solkal natong ho chun lhalo amudiu dol ahi. Amaho chu atoh nau lamdol'a Pathen lhacha natong hiuva ahi.
en_web: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
en_kjv: For for this cause pay you tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

tcz: Nangman bat nanei chu sadoh in. Nanghon Solkal kaisum dongho peuvin, chule thunei vaihom ho jabolna peuvin.
en_web: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
en_kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

tcz: Khat le khat kingailut tona tailouvin koimacha koma bat neihih un. Nangman naheng nakom chu nangailut a ahileh Pathen Dan thupeh in angeh chu nasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en_web: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
en_kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

tcz: Ajehchu thupeh chun, “Nanghon jou sei hih un, nang hon tolthat hih un, nangho gucha hih un, nanghon mi nei thangset bol hih'un” ati ahi. Hichengse chule hitobang adangho chu hiche thupeh khat, “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun” ti hin akaigom soh'e.
en_web: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
en_kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

tcz: Ngailutna hin midang alam louvin abolpoi, hijeh chun ngailut hi Pathen Danthu suhbulhitna ahi.
en_web: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
en_kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

tcz: Ajehchu nanghon ichangeiya, phat bei dingkon kinona ding phat hitam ti naheuve. Khangun, ajehchu itahsan masatlai sanguvin tuhin huhhing ichanna dingu ahung naitai.
en_web: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
en_kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

tcz: Jan hi kichai ding kon ahitai, huhdoh a iumna dingu chu hunglhung ding ahitai. Hijehchun, muthim natoh ponsenen tobang chu paidoh un. Chule chonphatna hinkho, khovah galvon chonphatna galvon vah-emsel chu kivon un.
en_web: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
en_kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho sunlai mi ihiuvin, mi jousen eimu theina dinguva kitup keicha hinkho iman dingu ahije. Muthim natohna ngolpithei kikhop khomna hoa jaolouvin, chule jukham jonthanhoina hinkho ahilouleh kinahna le kimit thipna hoa jaohih-un.
en_web: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
en_kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

tcz: Chusangin, Pakai Yeshua Christa to hinkho mankhomna chu kivon'un. Chule nangho tahsa ngaichat suhbulhit nomna lunggel phalou ho a chun kipelut hih-un.
en_web: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
en_kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

tcz: Tahsanna'a lhasam midang tahsan chanpi khat chu sanguvin, chule alunggel dih hen, dih hih jongleh kinelpi hih un.
en_web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
en_kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive you, but not to doubtful disputations.

tcz: Vetsahnan, mikhat'in ipi hijongleh nehthei ahi tin gel'in te. Hinla tahsan cha adang khat chun se le pha hetna alunggel thua anun jeh chun anche hing bou nen te.
en_web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
en_kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

tcz: Ipi hita jongleh nehthei ahi tiho chun anelou ho chu musit dauhen, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu alah cheh-u ahiye.
en_web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
en_kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

tcz: Nang koi nahi a midang sohho themmo nachan thei ding ham? Amaho apakai pauvin adindohna diu hihen, alhuhkamna diu hijongleh athu hintan nante. Chule Pakai panpina jal'a, amaho dingdet uva chule apachatna changdiu ahi.
en_web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
en_kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

tcz: Chutima chun, mi koihamkhat chun nikho khat chu nikho dang sanga theng jon koiyintin, michom dang ho vang'in nikho jouse kibang in gelunte. Nangho khat cheh in ipi nikho hijongleh nalhen'u chu lahthei ding dol hijeng ah ahi.
en_web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
en_kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

tcz: Nikho jatchom beh khat Pakai houna a mangho chun Ama jana a achutiman'u ahi. Ipipen anneh hijongleh nea chun Pakai jabolna'a aneh ahi, ajehchu amahon aneh masanguva Pathen athangvah-u ahitai. Chule abangloi khat chun anneh anehlou loi umsah unte; ahin amaho jong chun Pakai alunglhai nomjeh uva abol'u ahin, Pathen athangvah nau ahi.
en_web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
en_kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho eima ho chang dinga hinga ihi pouvin, ahilouleh eiho chang dinga thi ding ihipouve.
en_web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
en_kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

tcz: Ahin, ihinuleh Pakai jabolna'a hin ding, chule ithi uva ahi jongleh Pakai jabolna a thi ding ahi. Hijeh chun eiho hingu hitin, ahilouleh thi jongleu hen, Pakaiya ihiuve.
en_web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
en_kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Christa chu ahing nalaiho leh athisaho Pakai ahi theina dinga khatvei ana thia chule thoudoh kit ahi.
en_web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
en_kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

tcz: Hijehchun, ipi atileh nangman tahsanna neimikhat chu themmo nachan thei ham? Ipi jeh a tahsanna nei mikhat chu namusit ham? Eiho ibonchauva Pathen thutanna anga ding ding ihicheh uve tihi geldoh in.
en_web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
en_kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Pakaiyin kahinna a kahahsel ahi. Khup jouse Ka-angsunga hung dilsu cheh dingu, chule lei jousen Pakai aphondoh uva chule avahchoi dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
en_kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

tcz: Henge, eiho khatcheh in eima chung chang thu Pathen koma iphon cheh dingu ahi.
en_web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
en_kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

tcz: Hijeh chun khat le khat ki-oimotona neitapou hite. Hisang chun tahsan kibahpi michomkhat kipalna le lhuhna neisah pouhite.
en_web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
en_kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.

tcz: Keiman Pakai Yeshua thuneina le hetkhenna kanei jal'in ipi hitaleh hiche neh ding dol chu neh aphatmona kaum sahpoi. Hinlah mikhat touvin hichu aphapoi ti atahsan'a ahileh ama dinga chu phamoa ahi.
en_web: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
en_kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

tcz: Chule sopi khat chu nangma anneh jeh a alunglhah a, hichu nangman naneh teitei leh, ngailutna neiya chon nahilou ahitai. Nathil neh jeh chun a-dinga Christa thisa khat chu sumang go hih in.
en_web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
en_kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

tcz: Chujongleh nangman pha dinga natahsan chung changa koiman nagel hoimo taponte.
en_web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
en_kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu neh le don thujengbou hipontin, chusang a phatna le cham-lungmonna, chule Lhagaothenga kipana hinkho man'a joh hiding ahi.
en_web: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: for the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

tcz: Hitia lung ngaitoa Christa lhachana toh'a, Pathen lunglhai ding, chule midangin nanatoh chu aphatna aphondoh dingu ahi.
en_web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
en_kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, houbung sunga kilung hetthemna le khatle khat kisadohtoa umna ding lunggut uhite.
en_web: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
en_kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

tcz: Naneh jaljeh in Pathen natoh chu suse hih-un. Geldoh un, an jouse hi nehthei cheh ahi, hinla tahsannei midang khat kipalna ding ahileh, hichu dihlou ahi.
en_web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
en_kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

tcz: Saneh ahilouleh judon ahilouleh imadang bol chun atahsan khat akipalsah ding'a ahileh bollou chu phajoa ahi.
en_web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
en_kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

tcz: Nangman ipi nabol thudol'a ima asetna aumpoi tin tahsan'innate, hinla hichu nangma tahle Pathen kikah thua koiyin. Koi hileh aphai tiagela abolna chunga ki-oimona lungthim neilouho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en_web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
en_kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

tcz: Hinlah nangman thilkhat chu nehding ham, hilou ham ti thudol'a lungsa-ihna naneiya, hichun aneh teitei a ahileh achonsea nahitai. Ajehchu nangman natahsan chu najuilou ahi tai. Hijehchun, nangman adihpoi tia nagelkhat chu nabol'a ahileh achonsea nahitai.
en_web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
en_kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

tcz: Eiho ahat chengse hin, chang kilung lhaiding hollouva, hicheng thua lunggel lhahsamna neiho chu ikhohsah ding'u ahi.
en_web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
en_kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

tcz: Eiho hin midangho chu adih boldinga ikithopiuva chule amaho chu Pakaiya ikisahdoh sah dingu ahi.
en_web: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
en_kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa jeng jong ama leh ama kilunglhai ding ana gelkhoh poi. Pathen thubu in asei dungjuiyin, “Vo Pathen, nangma najumso ho jumna chu kachunga ahung chutai,” ati.
en_web: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
en_kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

tcz: Chutobang thuchengho chu Pathen lekhabua ikihilna dinguva masang peh a ana kijihsa ahi. Chule Pathen thubun kinepna eipeuvin chule Pathen thutep ho guilhunna dinga thoh hattah angah dinga ei-tilkhou'u ahi.
en_web: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
en_kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

tcz: Hiche thohhat le tilkhouna hi, Christa Yeshua nungjui hina ding doltah ahi jal'in, Pathen in nangho khat le khat kilungtona hinkho mangkhom ding'in napanhu tauhen.
en_web: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one towards another according to Christ Jesus:

tcz: Chutengleh nangho nabon chauva aw khat'a i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chu vahchoiya chule loupina Pathen napeh thei dingu ahi.
en_web: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: that ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen loupina pehtheina dingin Christan nangho nasan banguvin, nangho jong khatle khat kisangtouvin.
en_web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
en_kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us, to the glory of God.

tcz: Christa chu Judah mite henga soh a ahung chu Pathen in apu apateu henga ana thutepsa akitahna chu vetsahna dinga hung ahi, ti geldoh un.
en_web: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
en_kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

tcz: Chidang namdang hon Pathen loupina apeh uva, akhotona chu achunguva alhunna dinga Ama jong hung'ah ahi. Hiche hi Labol pan jong hiti hin anajih-e: “Hiche jeh a hi Keiman nangma chidang namdang ho masanga kavahchoi ding; Namin Vahchoina La ho kasah ding ahi.”
en_web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
en_kjv: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

tcz: Chule munchom khat'a jong hitin akisun e, “Nangho chidang namdang ho, Amitetoh kipah thanom'un.”
en_web: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
en_kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

tcz: Chukit jongleh, “Chidang namdang nanghon nabon chauvin Pakai chu vahchoiyun. Nangho vannoi mite jousen Ama vahchoiyun.”
en_web: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
en_kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

tcz: Chule munchom khat'a Isaiah in aseiyin, “David Laltouna a toudingpa chu hung ding chule Aman chidang namdang ho lah a vai apoh ding, amahon Achunga akinepnau angaplhah dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
en_kjv: And again Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

tcz: Keima kataona hi nangho Ama natahsan jal uva, Kinepna Bulpi Pathen chun, kipana le cham-lungmonna kimkeiya nadip dimna dingu hi ahi. Chutengleh nangho Lhagaotheng thahatna jal'a kinepna neiya lung ngamnan nalung'u alodim theina ding kati ahi.
en_web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, nangho phatnaa dimset nahiuve ti kichentah in kahe'e. Nanghon hiche thudol hohi phatah a nahet'u ahitan, nangho khat le khat kihilto theiyanahi tauve.
en_web: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
en_kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

tcz: Ahinah vang'in, hiche thudol phabep hi avel a nageldoh kit theina ding uva lungngam tah-a kahinjih ahi. Hiche hi Pathen mi-hepijal ahipen'e.
en_web: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
en_kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

tcz: Keima hi chidang namdang nangho dinga Christa Yeshua a kona thupole ding'a achombeh-a ei-kilhengdoh ahi. Keiman Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh uhi nangho Pathen'a ding'a santhei doltah a kipetheng sel'a naum uva, Lhagaotheng jal'a suhtheng nahina ding'u ahi.
en_web: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: that I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

tcz: Hijehchun keiman Pathen na katohna a Christa Yeshuan keima eimanchah-a aboldoh ho jouse kathanoppi theina hi ajeh uma ahi.
en_web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
en_kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

tcz: Christa in keiya kon'a athil boldohho tilou kisonpi ding imadang kaneipoi, keiman chidang namdang ho henga kathupoh le alah uva kanatoh hi Pathen henga amaho puilut ding kati hi ahi.
en_web: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
en_kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

tcz: Amaho melchihna le datmo kidangho chule Lhagaotheng thahatna chun alunguva nopna anei sah ahi. Hitia hi keiman Christa Kipana Thuphahi Jerusalema pat Illyricum lampi geiya kapehdoh soh ahitai.
en_web: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
en_kjv: through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

tcz: Keima lungtup pipen hi midang in houbung aphudohnasa mun ho a che sang a Christa min kiphahpoh louna muna Kipana Thupha ga-seiphong ding hi ahi.
en_web: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
en_kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

tcz: Keiman Pathen thubu'a kisei kahin juipeh chu hitia thu kiseina mun'a, “Ama chung chang thu kiseilouna hon amu diu, chule Ama chung chang thu jakha louhon ahetdoh dingu hi ahi.”
en_web: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
en_kjv: but as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

tcz: Tahbeh mong'in, nangho kavilna dingu khongaisot a kaum hi hiche mun hoa thuseiphonga kana kalson jing jeh ahi.
en_web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
en_kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

tcz: Hinlah tun, hiche gamkai hoa kon'a hi nangho kahung vilnom ahiye.
en_web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
en_kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

tcz: Keiman Spain kagavil nom'in, kagavil phat le Rome a kahung kibanpa ding ahi. Chule nangho toh kipah tah-a ikiloikhom jouvu phat chomkhat jou tengleh nanghon kakholjinna a ding neigon peh thei ding'u ahi.
en_web: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
en_kjv: whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

tcz: Hinlah kahung masang'a Jerusalem'a kagachetei ding, chuche mun'achu atahsan ho thilpeh kagapeh ding ahi.
en_web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
en_kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

tcz: Ajeh chu Mecedonia le Achaia gamhoa um tahsanhon Jerusalem'a tahsan holah-a avaichaho ding neitokhomna lung gutten'a aneiyu ahi ti namu uve.
en_web: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
en_kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahon hiche abol jeh uhin akipahlheh uve, ajehchu achung'uva bat lentah neiya kigel'u ahi. Chidang namdang hon Kipana Thupha thu'a Lhagao vangbohna hi Jerusalem'a um tahsan hoa kon'a ana kisan'u ahijeh'in, amahon sum-le-pai a akithopi uhi abolthei sun'u dan'in agel uve.
en_web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
en_kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

tcz: Keiman hiche sum hi kagapeh doh a chule amaho thilphabol hi kaga suh-bulhit teng, keiman Spain lampia kon'a nangho kahung vil ding'u ahi.
en_web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
en_kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

tcz: Chule keima kahung tengleh Christa in phattheina lhingset chanvou eichansah diu hi kichentah in katahsan'e.
en_web: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
en_kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa min'a kangeh nahiuve, keima toh Pathen heng'a taonaa kithokhom'u hite, chule keima ding in neitaopeh un kati ahi. Hiche hi keima nei-ngailut jaluvin Lhagao Thengthilpeh chun bol'un.
en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
en_kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

tcz: Pathen sei ngailou ho Judea gam'a umhoa kon'a huhdoh a kaumna dingin neitaopeh un. Chuche mun'a tahsan neihon sumkitoh khom kapoh hi asan nomna dingun jong taovun.
en_web: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
en_kjv: that I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

tcz: Chutah le, Pathen lunggot lam ahia kipah thanom tah a naheng'u kahung'a iki tilkhou to theina dingu kati ahi.
en_web: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
en_kjv: that I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

tcz: Chule tuhin chamna leh lungmonna eipeuva Pathen chun nangho jouse na umpi jing tauhen. Amen.
en_web: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
en_kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Keiman Cenchrea Houbunga lhacha natonga pang isopinu-u, Phoebe, seiphatna kapeh ahi.
en_web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
en_kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

tcz: Pathen mite lah a jabol'a kilom in amanu hi ana lemun. Aman ngaichatna aneichan'in kithopina anapeuvin, ajehchu amahi mitampi ana kithopijia, chule adeh'a keima eikithopia ana pang jing ahi.
en_web: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
en_kjv: that ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a lhachana katoh khompi teni Priscilla le Aquila chibai kahinbol e.
en_web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

tcz: Tahbeh mongin keima pan huna'a ahinkho lhona hahsatna atolhon ahin, amani chunga hin keigoh hilouvin chidang namdang houbungho jong akipahlheh uve.
en_web: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
en_kjv: who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

tcz: Chujongleh a-in lhon'a kikhom houbung jong chu chibai kabol'in ahi. Ka golngaitah Epenetus chibaiyun: Ama hi Asia gamkaiya Christa nungjui amasapen ahi.
en_web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
en_kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

tcz: Nangho phatchomna dinga natong gima Mary chu kachibai anapeuvin.
en_web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
en_kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

tcz: Andronicus le Junia Judah nam mi ka chankhompi, keitoh songkul kalut khompi ho chibai bolun. Amaho hi solchah ho lah a jana sangtah changa ahiuvin, chule keima masanga Christa nung juiya anapang masa ahiuve.
en_web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
en_kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

tcz: Ampliatus Pakaiya kagol ngai chibaiyun.
en_web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
en_kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

tcz: Urbanas Christaa katoh khompiu le kagolngai Starkis chibaiyun.
en_web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
en_kjv: Salute Urban our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

tcz: Christa seiphat chang miphatah Apelles chibaiyun chule Aristobulus insung mite kachibai anabolun.
en_web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
en_kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.

tcz: Herodion, ka Judah chanpi chibai anabolun. Narcissus insung pumpia kona Pakai mite chibaiyun.
en_web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
en_kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

tcz: Tryphena le Tryphosa Pakai natong teni hile Persis amaho Pakaiya dinga tong gimtah a kiseh ho jong hi chibaiyun.
en_web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
en_kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

tcz: Pakaiyin Amaa dinga achoma alhendoh Rufus chule anu ngaitah, keima dinga jong nua pang chu chibaiyun.
en_web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
en_kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

tcz: Asyncritus, Philegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas chule sopite ho amahoto kimuto chengse chibai anapeuvin.
en_web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
en_kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

tcz: Philologus, Julia, Nareus le asopinu, Olympas chule aumpi mithengte jouse kachibai anapeuvin.
en_web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
en_kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

tcz: Christian kingailutna a khat le khat kichibaiyun. Christa Houbung ho jousen chibai nahin boluve.
en_web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
en_kjv: Salute one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

tcz: Chule tun keiman kangehbe nomu chu, ka sopi deitah teho, kibung khenna le miho tahsan lhahdaisah nangho thu nakihilu akaleh a hilhoa kon'in kichih theiyun. Amahoa kon chun kikangseuvin.
en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
en_kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

tcz: Hitobang miho chu Christa lhacha natong hilouva amaho lung deiya natong ahiuve. Thusei them le kam ngeiyin dohan themmona neilou ho alhemlhauvin ahi.
en_web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
en_kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

tcz: Hinlah amitin'in nangho Pakaiya seingai nahiu aheuve. Hiche hin eikipasah lheh e. Keiman nangho thilpha bolnaa nachih uva chule adihlou poupouva kona na kikangse dingu kadeipeh nahiuve.
en_web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
en_kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

tcz: Pathen'a kon cham-lungmonna chun: Satan hi nakengto noiyuva akoivah ding ahitai. I Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen!
en_web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
en_kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

tcz: Katoh khompi Timothy in chibai nahinpe uve; chutima chun Lucius, Jason, chule Sosipater, Judah nam mi kachan khompi hon jong chibai nahin boluve.
en_web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
en_kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

tcz: Keima Tertius, hiche lekhathot Paul thalhenga ajih a pang hin, Pakai nungjuiho lah a khat hinan chibai kahin boluve.
en_web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
en_kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

tcz: Gaius hin chibai nahin peuve. Ama kalhunna pa ahin, chule Houbung pumpi vailhun'a pang ahi. Erastus kiti khopi sumchingpa hin chibai nahin boluve, chule isopiu Quartus in jong chibai naboluve.
en_web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
en_kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa milungsetna chun nabon Chauvin umpiuvin. Amen.
en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen lung cham'a kilhengdoh Yeshua Christa solchah Paul le isopiu Sosthenes a kon ahi.
en_web: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
en_kjv: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungdeiya Christa Jesu solchah dinga kikou Paul le sopi Sosthenes-in,

tcz: Keiman Pathen houbung Corinth a um nangho Pathen in amithengte hiding a akouho henga kahin sut ahi. Aman Christa Yeshua jal'a athenga nasemu ahi, munjousea Christian ho jouse, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa, amaho le eiho dinga Pakai, min hinkou ho jouse abolna banga.
en_web: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
en_kjv: unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
tcz_gospelgo: Corinth khoa Pathen Houbung, Christa Jesua kisuthenga, atheng dinga kikou ho le muntin’a um miho, amaho le eiho dinga i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a kikou chengse henga,

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungset le cham lungmon napeuhen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le chamna nahenguva hung lhung hen!

tcz: Nangho tua hi Christa Yeshua a nahi jalun chule lungsetna thilpeh napeh jalun keiman ka Pathen chu kathangvah jingin ahi.
en_web: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu ti nakigop jeh-uva nachunguva kipe Pathen lungsetna jeh chun nang ho jel’in phat jousen ka-Pathen kathangvah jing’e,

tcz: Ama a kona na houbungu hi Pathen in imalam jousea nahaosah u ahin, thusei thepna le hetthemna jouse hi naneiyu ahi.
en_web: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
en_kjv: that in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu, Amato nakigop’u hin ima jousea, thuseina hihen hetna hijongle nahaosah-u ahitan,

tcz: Hiche hin keiman Christa chung thu kaseipeh uhi adih e ti aphotchen ahi.
en_web: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
en_kjv: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
tcz_gospelgo: nang hoa hi Christa thudol hettohsahna phudet’a aum banga,

tcz: Nanghon tua lhagao thilpeh tintang nangaichat hou chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa hungkitna ding kinem'a ngah a nahi jeh uva naneiyu ahitai.
en_web: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: so that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh ding na-ang nauva Lhagao thilpeh chan khel nanei louna diu ahi.

tcz: Aman achaina geiya nahatsah uva, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung niteng nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu ahi.
en_web: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman nang ho akhon ni, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nikho geiya natuh chah jinguva monabeiya nakoi diu ahi.

tcz: Pathen hi tahsan umtah ahina jal'a Aman aboldinga asei chu thonlou hela ahinbol ding ahin, chule Ama chun Achapa Pakai Yeshua a chan neikhom dinga nangeh u ahitai.
en_web: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
en_kjv: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Achapa Jesu Christa, i-Pakaiyu vanga kiloikhomnaa nakoulut’u Pathen chu kitah tah ahiye.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thuneina'a kangeh nom nau chu nangho khat le khat kilungtoh tah in umun. Houbunga kibung khenna umhih hen. Chusang in lungkhat kisauvin, lunggel le lungtup kithakhat hiuvin.
en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
en_kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nabonchauva nakinopto cheh-uva, nasei jouseu akitha khat’a, lunggel le ngaito kitha khat nahina diuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min jal’a ka-ngeh nahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu kasopi deitahte, Chloe insung mite phabep in kitohmoa naum u thu chu kajah a ahung seiyuve.
en_web: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
en_kjv: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile kasopite, nalah-uva kinah baotam alen chu Chloe insung miten kajah a kichentah-in eiseipeh tauve.

tcz: Nangho lah a mi phabep in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi,” abangkhat loiyin, “Apollos nung kajuiye,” ahilouleh, “Peter nungjui kahi,” ahilouleh “Christa bou kajui ahi,” natiuvin ahi.
en_web: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
en_kjv: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei chu hiche ahi, nang ho amitakip, “Keivang Paul loi kahi, keima Apollos loi kahin, keima Peter loi kahi, chule keima Christa loi kahi” natiuve.

tcz: Christa chu loituma achom cheh'a nakhen'u hitam? Keima Paul hi nangho dinga kikhenbeh a kahim? Nalah uva Paul mina baptize kibol naumuvem? Na um hihnauve!
en_web: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
en_kjv: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
tcz_gospelgo: Christa chu kihomtel hitam? Paul la nang ho din thingpel’a akikhet beh pon, ole Paul min’a baptize chang ngap nahiuvem?

tcz: Nalah uva Crispus le Gaius tailou khatcha baptize kanabollou jeh in Pathen kathangvah e.
en_web: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
en_kjv: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
tcz_gospelgo: Cripus le Gaius tilou nang ho khat beh baptize kachansah loujeh-un kakipah-e,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh tua hi koimachan kamin in baptize einabol'e eititheilou dingu ahitai.
en_web: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
en_kjv: lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche hi koima kei min’a baptize changa nakisei thei louna diu ahiye.

tcz: (Oh ahinai, keiman Stephenas insung pumpi jong chu baptize kanabolnai, ahinlah koima dang baptize kabolbe kahepoi).
en_web: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
en_kjv: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
tcz_gospelgo: Stephanas insungmite vang baptize kachan sah nan, hiche kalval vang midang koima baptize kachansah kahepoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Christan keima baptize bol le dinga eisol ahipoi, Kipana Thupha seiphongle dinga bou eisol ahi. Christa thingpel chun athaneina aman louna dinga chihna thudol asei kahilou ahi.
en_web: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
en_kjv: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
tcz_gospelgo: Christan baptize kachansah dinga eisol ahipon, Kipana Thupha sei phong dingjoh a eisol ahibouve, Christa thingpel thu chu ahomkeo ahilouna dinga chihna thujong kasei lou ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu thingpel thuhi mahthahna lam manoho dinga ngol hoitah thu ahi. Hinlah eiho huhhingna chang ho dinga Pathen thahatna ahi.
en_web: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
en_kjv: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Thingpel thu hi amangthah ho dia ngol kai tah ahin, huhhinga um eiho din vang Pathen thahatna ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thubun aseima bangin, “Keiman miching ho chihna chu kasuhbei ding, chule milungching chihna chu imacha hilouva kakoi ding ahi” ati.
en_web: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
en_kjv: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabua kisun chun, “Keiman miching ho chihna kasuh manga, het themna neiho hetna moh kahisah ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, chihgilna neiho, lekhathem ho, chule vannoi lungthim themnaa minelkal hat ho iti tauvintem? Pathen in hiche vannoi chihna chu angola amu ahibouve.
en_web: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
en_kjv: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
tcz_gospelgo: Miching hoiya uma, lekhathem hoilam ham? Tukhang minel them hoiyaba um ham? Pathenin hiche vannoi chihna hi ngolna ahisah lou ham?

tcz: Pathen in Achihna a vannoiyin mihem chihnaa Ama ahetdoh lou dingu ahi ti amu jeh a, angol ho thusei banga kathuseiyu hin atahsan ho ahuhhing nadinga amanchah ahi.
en_web: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
en_kjv: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen chihnaa hin hiche chihna vannoiyin mangcha Pathen ahetdoh thei lou phat’in, ngol kai thua kigel hiche thu kisei phong tahsan ho joh huhhing ding hi pha asai.

tcz: Van'a kona melchihna thum Judah nam mite dinga hichu ngolthu ahin, chule Greek mite, mihem chihna hol ho, dinga jong ngol thu ahi.
en_web: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
en_kjv: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
tcz_gospelgo: Judaten melchihna a-ngeh-uvin, Greek mihon chihna ahol’ui,

tcz: Hitia hi keihon Christa kikhetbeh thu kaseiyu hi Judah nam mite lunghan kondohna ahunghin chule chidang namdang hon pannabei thu kisei ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
en_web: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
en_kjv: but we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon vang thingpel’a kikhenbeh Christa chu kaseiphongu ahi; hiche hi Judate din kipalna ahin, chidnag namdang ho dia ngolna ahi;

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in huhhing dinga akou ho dingin vang, Judah mi hihen chidang namdang hijong leh, Christa chu Pathen thahatna le Pathen chihna ahigel e.
en_web: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
en_kjv: but unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla Juda mi hihen Greek mihijong le akikoute dinga Christa chu Pathen thahat le Pathen chihna ahiye.

tcz: Hiche Pathen in ngol tah a tohgon anei hi mihem achingpen tohgon sangin jong achingjon chule Pathen thalhahsamna chu mihem thahatpen sangin jong ahatjo nalaiye.
en_web: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
en_kjv: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathen dia ngol kei chu mihem chihna sangin achingjon, Pathen dia hatmona chu mihem hatna sang in ahatjo nalaiye.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho geldohtemun, Pathen in nanakou pet'u chun hiche vannoi lamdol a aching'ah ahilouleh athaneiyah ahilouleh ahaovah naum pouve.
en_web: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
en_kjv: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite nakikou dol’u chu vetem’un, tahsaphe dol’a chingtah jong nahipouvin, thahat tahbeh jong nahipouve; phunglun laiya mi jong nahideh pouvin ahi;

tcz: Chusangin, vannoiyin angol'a agel ho'u chu Pathen in ching kisaho jachatsahna dinga alhendoh ahi. Chule Aman thaneilou ho jong chu thaneitah a kigel ho jachatsahna'a alhendoh ahi.
en_web: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
en_kjv: but God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
tcz_gospelgo: amavang Pathenin vannoiya mimol ho hi miching ho jumso dia alhendoh a, vannoiya mihatmo ho hi mihat ho jumso dinga Pathenin alhendoh ahiuve.

tcz: Pathen in hiche vannoiyin anahsahmo ho, imacha louva agel ho, chu alhendoh a, vannoiyin thupitah a agelho imacha hilou sosah dinga manchah dinga alhendoh ahi.
en_web: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
en_kjv: and base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin vannoiya mi lhasamho le nahsahmoa kikoi ho alhen’a, aumsa thil ho imacha lou sosahna dinga aumlouhel thil ho geiya aumsah ahi.

tcz: Akhonna keiya, koimacha Pathen angsunga akiletsah hoitho umlouna ding ahi.
en_web: that no flesh should boast before God.
en_kjv: that no flesh should glory in his presence.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi Pathen angsunga mihing khat cha kiletsah thei louhel ding ahiuve.

tcz: Pathen in Christa Yeshua toh nagop khomu ahitai. Iphatchompina ding uva Pathen in chihna tahbeh chu Ama ahisah ahitai. Christan eiho Pathen toh isuhchamu ahitah jeh in, Aman eiho athenga chule athengsel a eisem uva, chule chonset'a kona eilha ongtholu ahitai.
en_web: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
en_kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen vanga nang ho hi Christa to hingkhom nahiuvin Christa chu Pathena kon eiho chihna, them chamna, kisuh thengna le lhatdamna ahin,

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh Pakai chungthua bou kisongin,” ati ahi.
en_web: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
en_kjv: that, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabua, “Akisonga chu Pakai vangin kisong hen,” tia kisun banga um ahi.

tcz: Sopite ho, keima nahenguva kahung masat chun Pathen in guhthima athilgon kasei phongna dingah thugiltah ho le ngainom nom chihguh thusei naho kamangchapoi.
en_web: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
en_kjv: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nahenguva Pathen thuguh phongjal dia kahung chun kamthem le chihna manga hung kahipoi.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh keima nangho toh kana umkhom pet chun, thildang jouse suhmila, thingpela kikhenbeh Yeshua Christa thubou chu kagel dinga kalunggon ahitai.
en_web: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
en_kjv: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang ho lah a thingpel’a akhetbeh pau Jesu Christa tilou ima dang helou hel dinga kihan lho kahitai.

tcz: Thalhomtah in naheng uvah kichageu le kithing pumin kana hungin ahi.
en_web: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
en_kjv: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima nahenguva lhasam tah le kichatah chule kihot hot’a hung kahin,

tcz: Chule kathupoh le kathu seiphong chu hetbai lamtah ahi. Chingkeo leh ngehtuntun'a thuseina neilouvin Lhagao Theng thahatna bou kana songin ahi.
en_web: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
en_kjv: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
tcz_gospelgo: kathusei le kathuseiphong chu chihna thugil tah akisei ahipon, lhagao le athahat phondohna joh ahibouve;

tcz: Hiche kabol hi nanghon mihem chihna chu tahsan louva Pathen thahatna natahsan johna ding'uva kabol ahi.
en_web: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
en_kjv: that your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche hin natahsan’u chu mihem chihna vang hilouva Pathen thahat vanga ahijoh photchetna ahiye.

tcz: Hijongleh keima apilhingsa tahsan ho lah a kaum tengleh, keiman chihna thu panin kaseiyin, hiche vannoiya chihna tobang ahilouleh chomkah louva kisumilji vannoi vaipohoa tobang'in kaseipoi.
en_web: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
en_kjv: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
tcz_gospelgo: Apilhingsa ho henga vang chihna thun jong kaseiji nauvin, amavang hiche leiset chihna le amang thah ding leiset vaipote chihna jong ahipoi;

tcz: Ahipoi, keihon chihna thu kaseiyu hi Pathen thuguh ana kiselguh chu ahi–akiselguh atil a kiphongdoh khaloulai, vannoi kibulphudoh masanga eiho iloupina diuva atohgon ana umsa chu ahi.
en_web: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
en_kjv: but we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
tcz_gospelgo: amavang leiset um masanga Pathenin iloupina diuva gotsa akoi, kiselguh, Pathen chihna thuguh joh chu kaseijiu ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah hiche vannoi vaipoten ahethei hihbeh uve, hetaveleu, amahon loupi Pakai chu thingpel a akhetbeh louhel dingu ahi.
en_web: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
en_kjv: which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu hiche leiset vaipote khat chan jong ahepouve, ajeh chu heule loupina Pakai chu thingpel’a akhetbeh louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche chu ahi Pathen lekhabun, “Koima mit nin amulou le koima nakolin ajah khahlou chule koima lunga jong kondoh khalou Pathen in Ama ngailu ho dinga agonsa ahi” tia asei chu.
en_web: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
en_kjv: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Mit mukhah lou, naa jah khah lou, Mihem lungthima jong lutkha loulai, Pathenin ama ngailuho dinga agonsa chu,” tia kisei bang chun,

tcz: Hinlah eiho hengah Pathen in hicheho chu a-Lhagaovin eihil tauvin ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Lhagaovin ijakai akholdoh a chule Pathen thuguhho chu eivetsah u ahitai.
en_web: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
en_kjv: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
tcz_gospelgo: lhagao amangchan Pathenin eiho henga aphongdoh tai; ajeh chu Lhagaovin thil ijakai akholchil jin, Pathen selguh ho geiyin ahildohjie.

tcz: Koiman mikhat lunggel ahepoi, amipa lhagao bouvin akihet ahi, chule koiman Pathen lunggel ahepoi, Pathen Lhagao bouvin ahet ahi.
en_web: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
en_kjv: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga cheng mihem, lhagao tilou mihem umdol thil ho chu koipen ham ahea? Hitobang chun Pathen umdol thil ho chu Pathen Lhagao tilou koiman ahepoi.

tcz: Chule eihon Pathen Lhagao ikisan tauve (vannoi lhagao ahipoi), hijeh a chu Pathen in manbeiya eipeh u thil kidangtah ho chu ihet theiyu ahi.
en_web: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
en_kjv: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathena kona manbei thilpeh eipeh ho’u ihet theina diuva vannoi leiset lhagao ikisanu ahipon, Pathen Lhagao joh ahibouve.

tcz: Keihon hiche ho kaseipeh uhi, mihem chihna thuchengho mang'ah kahi pouve. Chusangin, Lhagaovin eipeh u thucheng kamang chauve, Lhagao thutah ho chu Lhagao thuchenga kahilchet jiu ahi.
en_web: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
en_kjv: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ho chun hilson chihna thu hoa seilouva, lhagaova kihilna dungjuiya Lhagao neiho henga Lhagao thudih kahilchet’uva kaseijoh-u ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Lhagao lam gellou ho chun Pathen Lhagaova kona thudih ho chu asangthei pouve. Amahon ngolthua agel jeh uvin ahethei hihbeh uve, ijeh inem itileh lhagao lam gelkhoh ho bouvin Lhagao sei chu ahe theiye.
en_web: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
en_kjv: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa lam mihemin vang Pathen Lhagao thil ho chu akisanjipoi; ajeh chu ama din hichu ngolna ahin, Lhagao dol’a phot chet ding ahijehin hejong ahe theipoi.

tcz: Lhagao lam gel hon imajouse aman lutdan ageldoh theiyun, hinlah amaho tah chu koiman amanlut dan'u geldohna aneithei pouve.
en_web: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
en_kjv: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaova hingmi vangin ijakai aphochen theiyin, midangin vang ama chung thudol atan theipoi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, “Koiham Pakai lung ngaito hea, koiham Ama hiltheina geiya hetna neiya chu?” Hinlah eihon hicheho jouse hi ihe tauve, ajehchu eihon Christa lunggel chu ihetauve.
en_web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
en_kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ajeh chu koiham Pakai lungthim hea, Ama hil thei ding mi chu?” akiti. Eihon vang Christa lungthim ineiyui.

tcz: Sopite, keima nangho toh kaum khom pet'in Lhagao miho lah a thusei tobang'in naheng uva thu kasei theipoi. Keiman nangho jah a vannoi mite tobanga thusei ding in ahilouleh Christian hinkhoa chapang neocha ho lah a thuseiya kasei dingin naum uve.
en_web: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
en_kjv: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Lhagao chenna miho henga bangin keiman nang ho henga thu kasei theipon, tahsaphe mihem, Christa sunga cheng naosen henga sei banga kasi ahibouve.

tcz: Keiman nangho bongnoiya kavah uva, an-ham'a kavah lou ding nahiuve, ajehchu nangho ahamjep nehna dingin nahi thei hihlaiyuve.
en_web: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
en_kjv: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman noitwiya kavah-uva anham kapeh loulai nahive, ajeh chu nahe theihih laiyuve. Tujengin jongnahe thei hih laiyui,

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nangho nachonset nomnau lunggel in nathujo nalaiyuve. Nangho naki thangsetto nalaiyun chule khatle khat kinahle kisaovin naumuve. Hichun nangho nachonset nau lungchangin nathunun nahlaiyu aphotchet hilou ham? Nangho vannoi mite hin'a hingnalai nahi lou u ham?
en_web: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
en_kjv: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile tahsaphe mihem nahi nalaiyuve. Nalah-uva kithangsetto le, khat le khat kinah kiphun aum laisea chu tahsa mihem hiya mihem chon chon’a chon nahiu hilou ham?

tcz: Nangho lah a khat in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi”, atia chule achom dang khat'in, “Keiman Apollos nung kajui ahi” atileh nangho vannoi mite chon'a chon'ah nahiu hilou ham?
en_web: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
en_kjv: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
tcz_gospelgo: khat’in, “Keima Paul loukahi,” atia; adang khatman, “Keima Apollos loi kahi,” ati laisea chu namihem chon’u hilou ham?

tcz: Adih a sei dingin, Apollos chu koihiya, Paul chu koi ham? Keini hi Kipana Thupha natahsanna ding uva Pathen lhacha natong kahi lhonin, Pakaiyin eingansena lhon toh kitoh a kahil lhon ahi.
en_web: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
en_kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahimonga Apollos chu ipi hiya, Paul chu ipi ham? Amani hi lhacha natong, amani jal’a natahsan’u ahin, koijoh ahilhona Pakai thilpeh nei cheh ahilhon’e.

tcz: Keiman nalungsung uva muchi katulut ahin, Apollos chun atwi achap a chule Pathen chu akhansah a pang ahibouve.
en_web: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
en_kjv: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman kaphu ahin, ahin Apollos-in twi achap’a, Pathenin akhansah ahi.

tcz: Koichu aphut'a panga, ahilouleh atwichap koiham ti chu akhohjo dehpoi. Akhohjopen chu Pathen akhansahpa chu ahi.
en_web: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
en_kjv: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun aphutpa jong ima ahidehpoi; akhansah Pathen bou thupi ahi.

tcz: Aphut a panga le atwichap'a panga chun lunggon thakhat aneigel lhon ahi. Chule anatoh gut jal lhon'a chu kipaman amu lhon ding ahi.
en_web: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
en_kjv: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
tcz_gospelgo: Aphutpa le atwichappa akibang lhonin, atohgim dungjui cheh a tohman asancheh lhon ding ahinai.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh keini Pathen natong kahi lhonin chule nangho Pathen lou nahiuvin, Pathen in nahiuve.
en_web: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
en_kjv: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.
tcz_gospelgo: Keini Pathento tongkhom kahi lhonin, nang ho Pathen loulai, Pathen insah nahiuve.

tcz: Pathen lungsetna kachan jal'a keiman insa themtah tobanga abul kaphudoh ahitai. Tua hi midangin achunga chu asah u ahi. Hinlah hiche khombul chunga sadoh a pangho chun ching theitah a asah dingu ahi.
en_web: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
en_kjv: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
tcz_gospelgo: Eikipe Pathen lungsetna dungjuiya, insa themtah banga abul kaphu ahitan, midangin achunga asahjom ahi. Asachanin iti asah kivet them hen.

tcz: Keihon abul kaphudohsau kalval koiman adang phut theilou ding ahiuve, hiche abul chu Yeshua Christa ahi.
en_web: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Abul kiphutsa Jesu Christa tilou koiman abul dang phutdoh theiponte.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche abula saachun amanchah nom nom amanchah thei ahi-Sana, dangka, songmantam, thing, bi ahilouleh pol amanchah thei ahi.
en_web: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
en_kjv: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
tcz_gospelgo: Koi ahin hiche abul kiphut chunga chun san an ashen, dangkan ashen, dong mantamin, ashen lang, thingin ashen, hampa ham changpol hamin sajong le,

tcz: Hinlah thutan nikho lechun itobanga in asah ahi kipatep ding ahi. Mikhat natoh chu ichan'a luaham ti avetsah ding ahi.
en_web: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
en_kjv: every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.
tcz_gospelgo: min atoh cheh chu hung kiphongdoh cheh a, min atoh cheh chu meiya kipatep ding ahiye.

tcz: Natoh chu aumdena ahileh, hiche insa achun tohphat man akisan ding ahi.
en_web: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
en_kjv: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khat natoh a-insah chu adin jou nah leh tohman asan ding;

tcz: Hinlah natoh chu meiyin akahvam'a ahileh insa'a pang chu haman'a mang ding ahitai. A insa'a chu huhhing hinantin, ahin ama chu meikahna a kona hungsohcha tobang bep hiding ahi.
en_web: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
en_kjv: If any man’s work shall be burnt, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
tcz_gospelgo: mikhattou anatoh meiyin akahvam vangle tohman asan lou ding ama tah vang huhhing chang ding, mei pi pal galkaipa tobang hiding ahi.

tcz: Nangho nabonchauva kigoma Pathen hou-in nahiuva chule Pathen Lhagao chu nanghoa chenga ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
en_web: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
en_kjv: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Houin nahiuva nasunguva Pathen Lhagao achen chu nahet louvu ham?

tcz: Koi hileh hiche hou-in sumanga chu Pathen in asuhmang ding ahi. Ajehchu Pathen hou-in chu thenga ahin, chule nangho hiche hou-in chu nahiuve.
en_web: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
en_kjv: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
tcz_gospelgo: Khattouvin hiche Pathen Houin chu asuhmang le Pathenin ama asuhmang ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen Houin chu atheng ahin, nang ho a-Houin chu anahiuve.

tcz: Nanghon kijoulhepna kingahdoh uvin. Nangho tulai vannoi leiset lamdola chinga kigel'a nahiuleh chingtah beh nahina ding uva angol nahiu angaiye.
en_web: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
en_kjv: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima ama kilhen lha hih hen; nalah-uva khattou tulai khanga dia chinga kigel aumle, achihna din ngoljo hen.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathena dinga angol ahi. Pathen lekhabu thun asei dungjuiya, “Aman michingho chu achihnau thangkol'a a-osah in,”
en_web: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
en_kjv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem inem itile hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathen koma ngolna ahibouve; ajeh chu Pathen lekhabua akisunin: “Aman miching ho chu Ajonchih nauva amudohji,” akitin;

tcz: chule “Pakaiyin miching ho lunggel ahen, imacha phatchomna umlou ahi ahei” kiti ahi.
en_web: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
en_kjv: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule avel’in: “Pakaiyin miching ho lung gel jouse Aboncha pannabei ahi ahenai,” akiti.

tcz: “Hiti ahijeh chun lamkai mihem khat juijeh in hoitho hih in. Ijeh inem itileh ijakai nanghoa ahi.
en_web: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
en_kjv: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun koima mihemin kisonda hen; ajeh chu ijakai aboncha nang hoa jeng ahin,

tcz: Paul ahilouleh Apollos ahilouleh Peter ahilouleh vannoi ahilouleh hinna le thina tua le khonunga ding hijongleh, aboncha nanghoa ahi,
en_web: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
en_kjv: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
tcz_gospelgo: Paul hihen Apollos hile, Cephas ahin, vannoi ahin, hinna hihen thina hijongle, tupet le khonung geiya aboncha nang hoa ahibouve.

tcz: chule nangho Christaa nahiuvin, chule Christa chu Pathena ahi.”
en_web: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
en_kjv: and ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho Christa mi nahiuvin, Christa chu Pathen’a ahi.
