tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva mi phabep’in jonthan hoi apat jeh-uva nikhat sungseh a mihem sang som ni le sang thumin athi lo jeh-in jonthanhoi bol poute.

tcz: Ahilou jongleh Christa chu patep pou hite, amaho lah a phabep in achutibol uvin chule gul in achulih uvin ahi.
en_web: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
en_kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
tcz_gospelgo: Alah-uva mi konkhat’in Pakai apatep jeh-uva gulsen achuh lihgam jeh-in eihon patep pou hite.

tcz: Chule phunset bolpou hite, alah uva phabep aphunset jeh uvin, mithat vantil in amaho chu asuhmang louvin ahi.
en_web: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
en_kjv: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
tcz_gospelgo: Alahuva abang bang akiphin jeh-uva misumang Vantil’in asuh mangjehin kiphin hih-vin.

tcz: Hichengse achunguva anasodoh chu eiho dinga vetsahna a soh a ahi. Amaho thudol kisun hi eiho khang kichai koma ho kichihtheina dinga ahi.
en_web: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
en_kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
tcz_gospelgo: Achunguva thilsoh hichengse hi vetkah dinga soh ahin, chule khang nu nunga mi eiho pho tangna dinga kisundoh ahiye.

tcz: Nangma adingdet a nakigela ahileh, nalhuh louna dingin ching theijin.
en_web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
en_kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun koi hile adinga kigel’an alhuh louna din ching thei hen.

tcz: Na hinkhoa lhepna nato hohi midangin atoho toh akikhehna aumdehpoi. Chule Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nangman nadinpi joulou ding kalval chu Aman nachunga achuh ding phal ponte. Nangman lhepna chu nato tengleh, Aman nathoh jouva naki huhdohna ding lampi nagonpeh ding ahi.
en_web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
en_kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem doulel lhepna na chunguva achukhapoi, Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, Nathan adoujou kalval’in lhepna anchunguva chuh sah ponte, chule lhepna chuto kilhon’a nathoh jouvuva nahoidohna diu lampi nasempeh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun, kasopi deitahte, milim houna'a konin jamdoh un.
en_web: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
en_kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun ka-ngai tahte, doihou jamsan’un.

tcz: Nangho lung geltoh thei mi nahiuve. Keiman kasei hi adih ahi tia na tahsan uva ahileh nangho kigel phauvin.
en_web: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
en_kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung khomto mi nahijeh-uva kasei ahi, nang hon kigel toh-uvin.

tcz: Eihon Pakai Anjon kibolna'a khon'a phatthei chu iboh tenguleh, eihon Christa thisana chu chan neiya ihilou uham?
en_web: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
en_kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
tcz_gospelgo: Phatthei channa khon’a phattheiboh i-ngeh tengu, hiche hi Christa thisan donkhomna hilou ham? Chu le changlhah ihebaljiu khu Christa tahsa changkhomji ihilouvu ham?

tcz: Chule eiho mitamtah ihivang uvin, eiho ibonchauva changlhah lum khat a chu nekhoma ihiuvin, hichun eiho tipum khat ihiuve ti vetsahna ahi.
en_web: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
en_kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin changlhah pheng khatseh ahin, eiho tampi jong hi tahsa khatseh ihiuve; ijeh-inem itile ibonchauva changlhah pheng khat changkhom ihiuve.

tcz: Israel mipite chu gelun, amaho chun maichama kikatdoh ho chu lungkhat tah a aneh khomjiu hilou ham?
en_web: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
en_kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa dol’a Israel khu veuvin; maicham thilto neho khu maicham thil changkhom cheh hilou ham?

tcz: Ipi seinoma kahi dem? Keiman milim houna'a kikatdoh anneh chu ipi vetsahna ahi katina hintem? Ahilouleh milim kisem thu hohi pathen ho ahiuve katina ham?
en_web: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
en_kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi kaseiyem? Doi houna kinei neh le chah chu ikhat ahi katia; ahiloule limsemthu doi khu ikhat ahi katim?

tcz: Ahipoi, hichu ahi naisaipoi. Hiche avetsahna thil kitoh ho hi lhagao boh ho koma kibol'a ahin, Pathena kikatdoh ahipoi. Chule nangho lhagao boh hotoh najao kop dingu kanompoi.
en_web: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
en_kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Katipoi, chidang namdangten kithoina aneiyu chu thilhaho apeh-u ahin, Pathen apeh-u ahipoi, hijeh a chu thilhaho to chan naneikhom diu kadeilou ahiye.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai khon'a le lhagaoboh ho khon'a chu nadon theidehlou dingu ahi. Pakai dokhang le lhagaoboh dokhanga nanehkop thei dehlou dingu ahi.
en_web: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
en_kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon Pakai khon le thilhaho khon’a nadonkop thei lou diu, Pakai dokhang le thilhaho dokhanga ankong na-umkhom thei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai chu thangthip sahna ikondohsah u hingap a ham? Ama sanga ihat joh uva nagelu hitam?
en_web: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
en_kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahiloule Pakai chu thangset sahna dia iphin lung hang diu ham? Ama sangin la ihatjo pouvin!

tcz: Nangin “Keiman ipi hijongleh kabol ding phal ahi” nati, hinla ijakai nangma dinga phatchomna ahipoi. Nangin, “Ipi hijongleh kabol dia phatsah ahi” nati, hinla ima jouse aphachoma ahidehpoi.
en_web: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
en_kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ijakai bolngai ahi,” akitin, ahinla aboncha khantouna ahidehpoi.

tcz: Nangma dingseh a phatna ding chu gelkhoh hih in, hinla midang phatna ding gelkhoh un.
en_web: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
en_kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman ama changseh phatna ding hol louvin midang phatna ding holjo hen.

tcz: Hitia chu se le pha hetna a thudoh bol louvin kailhanga sa kijoh tapou khu naneh thei ahi.
en_web: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
en_kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
tcz_gospelgo: Kailhang sajohna mun’a thil kijoh ipi hile hetchetna dia dongtoh le louvin nejengun.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh leiset hi Pakaiya ahin, chule asunga umjouse jong hi Ama a ahi.
en_web: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
en_kjv: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga um jouse hi Pakaiya ahi,” tin akiseiye.

tcz: Atahsan lou koi ham khat'in in'a nilhah an nedinga nakouva ahileh temna namu chu nanop'a ahileh sanpeh jengin. Na angsunga aluichan chu se le pha hetna thua ima dohna neilouvin sa chu nejengin.
en_web: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
en_kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen tahsanlou min an nea nakouva nache nom’u le na-angsunguva aluichan chu hetchetna dongtoh le louvin nejenguvin.

tcz: (Hinlah khat touvin, hiche sa hi milim houna'a kikatdoh a ahitai, atia ahileh na seipehpa se le pha hetna jal jeh chun nehdin gellhahna neihih in).
en_web: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”
en_kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang, “Hiche hi doiphunga kithoina sa ahi,” atile, naseipeh pau jeh le lung gel’a hetchetna aumtah jeh-in neh dauvin,

tcz: Mi koiham khat'in agel ding jeh man a chu kachamlhatna imalou soh ding ham?
en_web: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
en_kjv: conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other’s: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
tcz_gospelgo: nang lung gel’a hetchetna mai kasei ahi pon, khatpa joh a chu kasei ahi. “Iti keima chamlhatna chu mi dang lung gel maiyin atuh oh thei ding ham?

tcz: Keiman anneh jeh a chu Pathen kathangvah theiya chule hichu kanopsahpia ahileh, ipi jeh a anneh mana keima eiki oimo ding ham?
en_web: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
en_kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman lunglhaisel’a kisanga, thangvah puma kasan chu kon eitaitompeh ding ham?” tin nate.

tcz: Hijeh chun nanghon naneh u hihen nadon'u hijongleh, ahilouleh ipi nabol'u hijongleh, abonchan Pathen loupina dingin bol'un.
en_web: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
en_kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hinneuvin don jong leu chun nabol jouseu Pathen loupina din bol’uvin.

tcz: Judah mite hihen lang, ahilouleh chidang namdang ho hijongleh, ahilouleh Pathen houbung hijongleh lungthoisah hih un.
en_web: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
en_kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
tcz_gospelgo: Judate hihen Greek miho hile chule Pathen Houbungmite dia kipal lhuh nan um dauvin lang,

tcz: Kei jengin jong kabollam jousea hi mitin lunglhaisahna ding kabol ahi. Keima dinga aphatpen mana kabol ahipoi, mitampi huhhing'a aum theina dinga midang dinga aphapen chu kabol joh ahi.
en_web: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
en_kjv: even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: keiman kachangseh a phatchomna ding hol louva, ijakaiya mitin lunglhaina kahol’a huhhinga aum theina diu kabol bangin bol’uvin.

tcz: Chule keima Christa dungsun kahi bangin, nangho jong keima dungsun hiuvin.
en_web: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
en_kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman Christa umchan ka-jop bang hin keima umchan jom-uvin.

tcz: Nanghon nalunguvah keima neigel jingun, chule naheng uva kathuhilu thu chu najuiyuve, ti kahet hin keima kakipah lheh in ahi.
en_web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
en_kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that you remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima neigeldoh jinguva nang ho kapeh kihilna chengse natuh chah jing jeh-uvin nang ho kaseiphai.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon thilkhat nahet dingu keiman kadei chu-Pasal chu Christa lama mopoa ahin, numei chu ajipa henga mopoa ahi, chule Christa chu Pathen henga mopoa ahi.
en_web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
en_kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Christa mitin luchang ahiya, pasal numei luchang chule Christa luchang Pathen ahidol hinahet diu kadeiye.

tcz: Pasal in ataopet ahilouleh lhagaothu aseipet a alu akhua ahileh Christa ajalou ahi.
en_web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
en_kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal koi hile lukhuh khuh puma taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseiya ham chun aluchang Christa i-asah lou ahin;

tcz: Hinlah numeiyin alu khuh louva ataova, ahilouleh Lhagao thu aseidoh a ahileh ajipa chu ajalou ahin, hijeh a chu hiche hi alu kivoutol tobang ahitai.
en_web: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
en_kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
tcz_gospelgo: numei koi hile lukhuh louva taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseya ham jong chun aluchang ajipa i-asah lou ahi, ama nu chu alikiveltol nu tobangma ahibouve.

tcz: Ahin amanu hin alu pon'a akhukhum nom louleh, aman asam jouse atan lhah ding dol ahitai! Ahin numei dinga asam tan lhah ahilouleh asam vomui chu jachat um ahijeh a, amanu chun ponlu khu chu akiken ding ahi.
en_web: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
en_kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeiyin lukhuh akhuh lou ngal ding le asam kivotol hen, sam kivotol chu numei dinga jachatna ahile lukhuh akhuh a pha jeng ahi.

tcz: Pasal in Pathen ahoupet a alua ima akoilou ding ahi, ajeh chu pasal chu Pathen lima kisema chule Pathen loupina sulanga ahi. Chule numeiyin Pasal loupina asuhlang hiya ahi.
en_web: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
en_kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal vangin Pathen lim le loupina aput jeh a lukhuh akhuh lou ding ahi; numeiyin pasal thupi na aphondoh ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh mimasa chu numeiya kona ahipon, hinla numei masa chu pasala kon ahi.
en_web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
en_kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pasal hi numeiya kondoh ahipon, numeijoh pasal’a kondoh ahibouve.

tcz: Chule pasal chu numei dinga kisema ahipon, ahin numei chu pasal dinga kisema ahi.
en_web: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
en_kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule numei khohsahnaa pasal kisem ahipon, pasal khohsahna joh numei kisem ahi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu numeiyin thuneina noiya um kahi ti vetsahna a, alua ponkhu akivon ding ahi, ajeh chu vantilte avet jingu ahi.
en_web: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
en_kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Vantilte jal’a numeiyin ajipa noiya ahichu aluchanga achin ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai mite lah a, numeiho chu pasala kona chamlhat ahilou tobang'in, pasal ho jong numeiya kona chamlhat ahipouve.
en_web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
en_kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pakaiya hinkhoa hin pasal beiya numei ima ahipon, numei beiyin jong pasal ima ahipoi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh numei masa chu pasala kona hung uma ahijeng vang'in, pasal dang khat khat cheh hi numei khat a kona hung peng doh a ahi cheh uve.
en_web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
en_kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu pasal’a numei akondoh banga Pasal jong numeiya peng ahi, ahinla thil ijakai Pathena kon cheh ahiye.

tcz: Nangho cheh dingin thu kitanun. Numei hin alu pon kikhu louva mipi lah a Pathen henga atao ding chu dih a hinam?
en_web: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
en_kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon geltoh-uvin, numei lukhuh khuh louva Pathen henga ataoji chu kilom nam?

tcz: Pasal in sam asaova aput ding chu ama dinga kilom louva hilou ham?
en_web: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
en_kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal dia sam hoisao hi ama dinga nahsahmona ahi, thil umdol mongin jong nahil louvu hiya,

tcz: Chule numei dinga asamsao hi akiletsahpi le athanoppi hilou ham? Ajeh chu hichu amanu dinga khukhum dinga kipea ahi.
en_web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
en_kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
tcz_gospelgo: numei dia samsao hi thupina ahi umchanin nahil louvu ham? Ipijeh-inem itile samsao chu akhujol dinga kipe ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche thudola hi khattou anelkal nom aumleh, eihon hiche tailou hi chonna ding dang inei pouve, chule Pathen houbung danghon jong anei deh pouve, ti hi kaseidoh nom ahi.
en_web: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
en_kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla koitobang anel’a aumle, hiche thudol’a hin eihon chonna lhongpi mong ineipouvin, Pathen Houbungten jong aneipoi.

tcz: Ahivangin tun anoiya kithuhilna hoa hin, nangho kapahcha theipouve. Ajeh chu nangho nakimuto tenguleh thilpha sanga aphalou ding joh boldoh a hileu chun akilouve.
en_web: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
en_kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that you come together not for the better, but for the worse.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hilchahna kapeh diuva hin kaseipha pouve, ajeh chu phat jep jepna dia kikhom hilouvin setna cheh joh dia kikhom nahiuve.

tcz: Amasan, houbunga nakikhop khom tenguleh nalah uva kibung khenna aume tithu kajan, chule hichu ichan hamin katahsanin ahi.
en_web: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
en_kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasa penin nang ho Houbunga nahung kikhopji tengle loitum tuma nakikhenjiu thu kajan, tahjong katahsan thim thim’e.

tcz: Hinlah, ahinai, nalah uva kibung khenna soh mong ding ahinai chutia chu nangho adih'a umho hetdoh'a naumna ding uva ahi!
en_web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
en_kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalahuva lah thei tah miho ahung kiphondoh a hetdoh a aum theina diuva nasunguva lung gel ngaito chom jong um ding mong ahinai.

tcz: Nangho naki khop khom tenguleh, nangho Pakai Anjonna'ah nalunglut tahtah pouve.
en_web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
en_kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla mun khat’a nahung kikhop khom tengule Pakai jan anjon nehna dingdol ahipoi,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh nalah uva mi phabep chu midang to nehkhom ding golouvin nangma an cheh nakineh pai jenguve. Hiti chun, abang khat gilkel in aum un, adang phabep akhamji tauve.
en_web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
en_kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu amitakip’in ama jan an cheh akineh masah jin, abang khat’in kel athoh jin, adang khatma akham avan aum’e.

tcz: Ipi ham? Nehna le donna dinga nangma nangma in cheh neiya nahi lou u ham? Ahilouleh nanghon Pathen houbung chu imacha hilou sosah ding goa chule avaichaho jachatsah goa nahiu vem? Keiman ipi kasei ding hitam? Nangho ka pachat diu nanop'u vem? Hichung chang thua hin napahcha hih uvinge!
en_web: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
en_kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
tcz_gospelgo: Nehna ding donna ding in neilou nahiuvem? O-le Pathen Houbung chu nahsahmoa bol’a aneiloute jachatsah nahiuvem? Ipi kaseipeh diu ham? Kaseiphat diu ham? Hiche thua vang pahcha pouving’e.

tcz: Ajehchu, Pakai Amatah a kona kalahson chu nangho kapehson kit nahiuve. Pakai chu mat dinga pehdoh a aum jan chun, Pakai chun changlhah phabep ala in,
en_web: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
en_kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya kona kalah nang ho kapehson’u thuhil chu hiche ahi, Pakai Jesu apehdoh jan chun, aman changlhah alan,

tcz: Hiche a chun Pathen athangvah in ahi. Chuphat in Aman ahehbalbal'in chuin aseiyin, “Hiche hi nangho dinga kipedoh katahsa ahi. Keima neigeldoh jingna dingun hiche hi bol'un,” ati.
en_web: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
en_kjv: and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
tcz_gospelgo: phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in, “Hiche hi nang ho khel’a pang katahsan chu ahi, neihet jingna diuvin bol’un,” ati.

tcz: Hitobangma chun an aneh jouvun, Aman khon'a lengpitwi chu ala in, aseiyin, “Hiche khon hi Pathen le Amite kitepna thah ahi–kathisan a kitepna suhdetna chu ahi. Hiche hi nadon laiseuvin keima geldohna in bol'un” ati.
en_web: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
en_kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobangma chun jan anneh jouvin khon chu alan, “Hiche khon hi kathisan’a kitepna thah ahi, nadon chan’uva keima neigeldoh jing na diuvin bol’un,” ati.

tcz: Ajehchu nanghon hiche changlhah hi naneh chanseuva chule hiche khon'a hi nadonlai chanseuva nanghon Pakai thina chu ahung kahsea naphondoh u ahi.
en_web: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
en_kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche changlhah naneh-uva hiche khon’a nadon laiseuva ahung kit kahsea Pakai thina chu naphondoh jingu ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun, koi hijongleh lomlouhel'a hiche changlhah chu nea, ahilouleh hiche Pakai khon'a chu don'ah aumleh Pakai tahsa le thisana chu themmo chang ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
en_kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun koi hile alam louva changlhah chu nea ha, ahiloule Pakai khon’a kona don hamchu Pakai tahsa le thisan douna chonsea kisim ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu changlhah chu naneh masangule khon'a chu nadon masanguva nangma tah kivetchilna nanei dingu ahiye.
en_web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
en_kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem amacheh kikhol chil hen lang akikhol dungjuiyin changlhah chu nehen, khon’a konin jong don hen.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa tahsa chu naneh masangu, ahilouleh nadon masang uva Christa tahsa chu najabol louva ahileh, naneh le nadon a chu Pathen thutanna nangma chung tah a nakilhut hiya ahi.
en_web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
en_kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakai tahsa chu ipi kiseina ahi helouva nea don’a chun, aneh a adon’a kona achung thu akitan ahi.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu nangho mitamtah thalhoma chule naa chule phabepset jong athia nahi tauve.
en_web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
en_kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu nalah-uva mi tamtah chatmoa na-chea ahin, aihmu mil’a jong atam lheh tai.

tcz: Hinlah eimaho tah kikholtoh a hileuhen, Pathen in hitia hi ichung uva thutanna aneilou ding ahi.
en_web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
en_kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho kikhol chil masa leu hen thutanna ichuh khah lou diu ahi;

tcz: Amavang Pakaiyin ithu'u atan'a thununna noiya eikoiyu tengleh, vannoi toh themmo ichantha lou diu ahi.
en_web: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
en_kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongle vannoi to ithuu akitan tha louna din Pakaiyin eikholchil’uvin eigah chah tauve.

tcz: Hiti chun kasopite, nanghon Pakai Jan Anjon boldinga nakikhop ji tenguleh, khatle khat kingah touvin.
en_web: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
en_kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kasopite, anedinga nahung kikhop tengule khat le khat ki-ngah khom’uvin.

tcz: Agilkel tahbeh monga nahiuleh, in'ah kineh jengun, chuti henlang hileh nakikhop khom tenguleh nangma chunga thutanna chu nakiloilut lou ding ahi.
en_web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
en_kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahung kikhop tengule thutannanachuh louna diuvin, koihile agilkel’a chun a-in’a hin kineh hen. Thudang dang ho thudol vang kahung tengle sutoh nang ‘e.

tcz: Tun, sopi deitahte, Lhagaovin thilboltheina jatchom beh eipehnau chung chang thua neihin dohnau thudol hi, nang hon nahet khel dingu keima kanompoi.
en_web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
en_kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Lhagao thilpehdol helouva na-um diu kanompoi.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen nahet masangu chun, nangho hi lhagaova lamvaiya chule paotheilou lim semthu houna a puimanga um nahi tauvin ahi.
en_web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
en_kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdang nahi laiyuva chu limsemthu doi paomo ho noiya kun’a, hiche ho chun napui mangjiu naheuve.

tcz: Hiti thua hi nang hon nahet dingu kadei chu, koima Pathen Lhagaova kona thusei chun Yeshua gaosap pontin, chule Lhagao Theng panna louvin Yeshua chu Pakai tithei ponte.
en_web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu kahetsah nahiuve, Pathen Lhagao puihoi mi koiman, “Jesu gaosap chang hen,” atipon, chule Lhagao Thenga konlouvin koiman, “Pakai Jesu,” ati thei poi.

tcz: Lhagao Thilpeh jat chom chom uma ahin, hinla Lhagao khat'a chu lhagao thilpeh jouse aboncha hung kipan ahi.
en_web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
en_kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao thilpeh tampi aumnan, ahinla apea Lhagao khat bou ahi;

tcz: Lhacha natohna jatchom chom aumin, hinla eihon Pakai khatma kin chu ibolu ahi.
en_web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
en_kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: chule lhacha natoh tampi aumvangin Pakai khatseh bou ahiye;

tcz: Pathen in jatchom chomin na atongin, hinla Pathen katma chun eiho ibonchauva sunga na atongin ahi.
en_web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
en_kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
tcz_gospelgo: chuma le natoh gotchom chom aumin, ahinla Pathen khatseh bou ahin, aman thil hichengsea chu na atohji ahibouve.

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh hi eiho khat cheh eikipeuva ahin, hiche jal'a chu eiho khat le khat ikihuto theiyu ahi.
en_web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
en_kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
tcz_gospelgo: Amitakip hi japi phat touna dia Lhagao kiphondoh na hetna thilpeh khat cheh kipea ahi.

tcz: Lhagao chun mikhat a thumop themna apeh ahin, hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat chu thu hetkhen themna apen ahi.
en_web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
en_kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche Lhagaova kona chu mi khat chihna thu kipea, michom khat chu hiche lhagaoma maa kona chu hettheina thu kipea,

tcz: Hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat tahsannaa hatna apen, chule michom dang khat chu Lhagao chun ana damlou damsah theina thilpeh apen ahi.
en_web: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
en_kjv: to another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
tcz_gospelgo: chom khat jong hiche Lhagaova kona hi tahsan kipea, hiche Lhagaova kon kit’a hi midang khat damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh kipea,

tcz: Aman mikhat chu thil kidang dang ho boltheina thaneina apein, chule achom dang khat chu Pathen Thuseidohna apein ahi. Aman michom dang khat thu kiseidoh chu Pathen Lhagaova kon ahi ahiloule lhagao chom danga kon ahi phottohna apein ahi. Chukit jongleh michom dang khat chu hetlou paoho thotheina apen, chule achom dangma chu akisei chu ipiham ti ledoh theina apein ahi.
en_web: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
en_kjv: to another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
tcz_gospelgo: midangkhat chu thil kidang bol theina kipea, adang khatma gaothu seitheina kipea, mikhatma chu Lhagao le Lhagao dat khen themna kipea, khat jong paotin tang hetna kipea, khatma paotin tang ledoh jouna kipea ahin,

tcz: Hiche Lhagao Theng chu khat ahin, lhagao thilpeh jouse hompa chu ahiye. Ama bouvin itobang lhagao thilpeh chu koi chang ding ham tichu khat cheh dinga agellhuh ahi.
en_web: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
en_kjv: but all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla hichengse bol’a chu hiche Lhagao khatseh chu ahin, aman angaito le adei dungjuiya amichan cheh a ahoppeh ahi.

tcz: Mihem tahsa hin tibah tampi aneiye, hinla tibah tampi hin tipum chu ahin semdoh ahi. Chutobanga chu Christa tahsa jong uma ahi.
en_web: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
en_kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa pumkhat sunga tibah tampi aumin, tahsa tibah tampi ahivangin tipum khat bou ahi, Christa jong chuti ahiye.

tcz: I-lah uva abang phabep Judah mi, phabepma chu chidang namdang ho, chule phabep chu chamlhat ahiuve. Hinla eiho jouse hi Lhagao khat'a chu baptize changa ihiuvin, chule eiho jouse Lhagao khatma a chu chan neikhoma ihiuve.
en_web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
en_kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu eiho Juda mi hiu hen Greek mi hijongleu hen, soh hiu hen chamlhat hijongleu hen, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva tahsa khat’a baptize changkhom, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva donkhom ihiuve.

tcz: Ahinai, tipum hin tibah jatchom chom aneiyin, tibah khat bou ahipoi.
en_web: For the body is not one member, but many.
en_kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile tahsa hi tibah khatseh ahipon, tampi ahibouve.

tcz: Keng chun, “Keima khut kahilou jeh in keima tipum'ah kajaopoi” tileh hichun tipuma chu ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
en_web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
en_kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
tcz_gospelgo: Kengphang hin, “Khut kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule bilkol chun, “Keima mit kahi loujeh in keima tipuma kajaopoi,” tileh hichun tipuma ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
en_web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
en_kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
tcz_gospelgo: Chule bilkol hin, “Mit kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Tipum jouse chu mit hitahen lang hileh, iti kho najah ding hitam? Ahilouleh nati pumpi chu nakol khat hitaleh, ipia anam najah thei ding hitam?
en_web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
en_kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa pumpi hi mit hita le hoiya khojahna um ding ham? Apumpin khojahna hita le hoiya gimnam jahna um ding ham?

tcz: Hinlah itahsau hin tibah tampi aneiyin, chule Pathen in khat khat cheh hi aphatsahna mun muna akoi cheh ahiye.
en_web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
en_kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang Pathenin tibah ho hi khat khat’a tahsa puma adeina laimun cheh a aphulut ahi.

tcz: Tahsa chun tibah khatseh neitahen lang hileh tipum khat chu iti datmo um hiding hitam?
en_web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
en_kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
tcz_gospelgo: Aboncha hi tibah khat seh hita le tipum hoiya umtan tem?

tcz: Ahinai, tibah tampi aumin, hinla tipum khat bou ahi.
en_web: But now they are many members, but one body.
en_kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang tibah atam vangin tipum khat bou ahi.

tcz: Mit chun khut jah a, “Keiman nangma kangaichapoi” atithei louhel ding ahi. Luchang chun keng jah a, “Nangma kangaichapoi,” atitheilou hel ahi.
en_web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
en_kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
tcz_gospelgo: Mit hin khut jah’a, “Nangma ka-ngai chatna aumpoi,” ti theilou, chukit le luchang hin kengphang te nijah a, “Nang ni ka-ngai chapoi, “ti thei lou ahi.

tcz: Tahbeh in, tibah ho lah a athalhom pen le aphatchomna neibeh louva igel hou hi angai khoh pen joh ahinom jiuve.
en_web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
en_kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti titah sanga tahsa pumpia um tibah hatmoa kigel chengse hi akhohjo a pang cheh ahiuve.

tcz: Chule eihon igelkhoh beh lou u ijabol behlou hou hi eihon phatah a ivettup uva itom jiu ahiye. Hiti chun, eihon akimulou dingho hi phatechan ivesui jiuvin ahi.
en_web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
en_kjv: and those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon jong nahsah louva kigel tibah ho chu ikhohsah jo’uvin, itibah hoimoa um lai jouse jong ijemhoijo jiuvin,

tcz: Ja ding dol tibah ho hi phatecha vetsui jong angai jipoi. Hitia hi Pathen in tipum hi akoikhoma agunchelou tibah ho hi jabolbena le vetsui jepna apeh ahi.
en_web: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
en_kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche kijepna ho chu itibahhoi ho hin angai chapoi. Ahinla Pathenin tahsa pum hi asuton, alhasam tibah ho chu akhohsah cheh joi,

tcz: Hiche hin tibahho dinga kitona ahinsodoh theina dinga, tibah jouse khatle khat kikhohsah tona ahin umdohsah theina ding uva ahi.
en_web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
en_kjv: that there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
tcz_gospelgo: hitia chu tahsa pum sunga kikhenna aumdaa, hisanga chu tibah ho khat le khat akigel khoh to cheh na diu ahijoi.

tcz: Tibah khat in athoh gima ahileh, tibah jousen hichu athoh gim piuvin, chule tibah khat chun jabolna akimua ahileh, tibah jouse chun akipa huvin ahi.
en_web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
en_kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu tibah khat’in athohgim le tibah jousen athoh gimpia, tibah khat seiphat achan le tibah dang jouse jong kipah khom ihiuve.

tcz: Nangho jouse hi nabon chauva Christa tipum nahiuvin, chule nangho khat khat cheh hi hiche tibah a chu panga nahiuve.
en_web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
en_kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho Christa tipum nahiuvin, khat cheh chu atibah nahiuve.

tcz: Hichea hin, Pathen in houbunga dinga tibah a alhendoh ho chu aume: Amasan solchah ho, abanin themgao ho, athumnan mihil ho, chubana melchihna kidang dang bol ho, adamlou damsah theina, midang panpi theina, lamkai hina lhagao thilpeh chang, hetlou pao hoa thusei theina.
en_web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
en_kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Houbung sunga hi amasatah a Solchah ho, aninaa themgao ho, thum channaa mihil ho, chuban’a bolmo kidang bol ho, abankit’a damtheina lhagao thilpeh chang ho, thilphachom bol ho, vaipo them ho, paochom chom tho thei ho atun ahi.

tcz: Eiho jouse solchah ihiuvem? Eiho jouse hi themgo ihiuvem? Melchihna kidang boldoh theina inei sohkei uvam?
en_web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
en_kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
tcz_gospelgo: Aboncha Solchah hiuvam? Abonchauva themgao hiuvam? Abonchauva mihil hiuvam? Abonchauva bolmo kidang bol thei hiuvem?

tcz: Adamlou damsah theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyuvam? Paochom tho theina thilpeh nanei mong hinam? Eiho jouse hetlou pao ledoh theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyu vem?
en_web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
en_kjv: have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
tcz_gospelgo: Abonchauva damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh neila hilouva ong? Aboncha pao chom thoa hi-ngal louva ong? Aboncha pao ledoh theila hilouva ong?

tcz: Hitia chu nanghon aphachom pen lhagao thilpeh ho chu nalung gut dingu ahi. Hijongleh tun keiman mijouse dinga aphapen hinna lampi chu navetsah uvinge.
en_web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
en_kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Lhagao thilpeh lencheh ho hadel’un. Lampi phachehjo kavetsah diu ahinalaiye.

tcz: Keiman leiset chunga pao jouse le vantil ho paogeiyin thothei ingting, hinla midang ngailu louvin um taleng, keima chu sum-eng kivoging le khutbeh kibeng gin tobang bep kahi ding ahi.
en_web: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
en_kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman mihempao jouse le Vantilte pao tho thei jong leng, ngailut kanei loule sum-eng dah kivonging le khutbeh kibeng ging bep kahi.

tcz: Keiman Pathen Thu seitheina thilpeh nei ingting, chule Pathen in aguh a athilgon ho jouse hetkhenna neiyin chule mol ho jouse tolmangsoh theina tahsan chu nei nama jongleng, keiman midang chu kangailut louva ahileh, imacha kahilou hiding ahi.
en_web: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
en_kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have no charity, I am nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman gaothu sei dohna kaneiya thil imguh jouse jong seidoh a hetna jouse kanei thei, mol tolmang helna thei tahsan geiya kanei thei ahin, ngailut kanei loule imacha kahipoi.

tcz: Keiman kanei chasun chu mivaicha peingting chule kati pumpi hi pedoh leng, hichu kaki letsah pithei ahi, hinla keiman midang chu ngailu lou hitaleng, keiman imacha phatchomna kaneilou ding ahi.
en_web: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
en_kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaicha gentheite vahna kanei jouse kato thei, katahsa geiya meiya govam jeng dia kaphal ngam thei ahinan, ngailut ka nei loule phatchomna kaneideh poi.

tcz: Ngailut hi athohhat in chule hepina nei ahi. Ngailut hi athangthip poi ahilouleh aham hoithopoi ahilouleh akiletsahpoi,
en_web: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
en_kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailut nan athoh hat jingin, hejong ahepin, athangsepon, akithang-at pon, akiletsahpoi;

tcz: ahilouleh a-engsepoi. Ama dei bou angeh gunsetpoi. Lung himo pina aneipon, chule akibol phat louna ho aching denpoi.
en_web: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
en_kjv: doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
tcz_gospelgo: alam louvin achonpon, ama chang phat chomna aholpon, alung hang baipon, thil phalou jat amelchihpoi;

tcz: Adih louva kibol akipapi pon, hinla thutah chun ajo tengleh akipahji.
en_web: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
en_kjv: rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
tcz_gospelgo: thildih louva akipahji pon, thudih akipapijie;

tcz: Ngailutna hi amoh lung lhadai jipoi, atahsanna alhadai jipoi, aphat tinin akinem jin, chule itobang hahsatna hijongleh athohjouve.
en_web: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
en_kjv: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
tcz_gospelgo: imajousea athoh hat’in, imajousea atahsanin, ima jousea akinemin, ijakaiya athoh tun tun’e.

tcz: Pathen Thusei dohna le hetlou paoho a thusei naho chule hetkhenna kidang dehset neina jong apanna bei ahung hiphat umding ahi. Hinla ngailutna hi imatih chan'a um jing ding ahi!
en_web: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
en_kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailutnan beitih neiponte. Gaothu seidoh um jongle beiding, paochom chom tho um jongle hai ding, hetna um jongle bei ding ahi.

tcz: Tua ihetthei nau hi alhasamin chule akimpon ahi, chule Pathen Thusei dohna thilpeh geiya hi aboncha hijoulou kiphasam nalai ahije.
en_web: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
en_kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile ihetnau le gaothu iseidoh nau hi bukim lou ahi;

tcz: Chamkimna chu ahunglhun phat tengleh, abulhing lou sehi panna beisoh ding ahitai.
en_web: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
en_kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
tcz_gospelgo: abulhing chamkim ahung tengle akimlou chengse bei ding ahi.

tcz: Keima chapang kanahi chun, thusei lunggel chule ngaitona chu chapang bangin kaumin ahi. Hinla keima khangdong kahung hichun, chapang ngol naho chu kajom tapoi.
en_web: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
en_kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachapan laiyin chapang thuseiyin kaseiyin, chapang lung gel’in kagel’in, chapang thil ngaiton ka-ngaitoi; pasal lhing kahiphat’in vang chapan lai thil jouse kapaitai.

tcz: Tua thilho hi chamkim louva phatvet a kichenlouva ivet'u tobangbep ahin, chuphat teng vangleh ijakai thengsel'a chamkim keiya imu dingu ahitai. Tua kahet jouse hi akimpon chule abulhingpoi, chuteng vangleh ijakai chamkim keiya kahet ding ahitai, Pathen in eihet chamkim kei tobang hiding ahitai.
en_web: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
en_kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu eihon tugeiya phatvetsunga lim kichen louva imu’u ahin, ajo tah le kimaitoa imudiu ahi; tu chan geiya kahet kimlou ahin, ajo tah le eihet kimsoh banga kahet kimsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Thil thum hi aitih a umden ding ahi–tahsan, kinep chule ngailut-chule hiche ho lah a hin ngailut achungnung pen'e.
en_web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
en_kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun tahsan, kinep, ngailut hicheng thum hi um jing ahin, hicheng lah a ngailut athupipen’e.

tcz: Ngailut hi nalungtup sangpen'u hihen. Hintin Lhagao thilpeh thilbol theina aphadehset chu-adehset'a Pathen Thuseidoh theina lhagao thilpeh chu nalunga na ngaichat'u hihen.
en_web: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
en_kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailutna del jingun, Lhagaothilpeh ho tup’un lang, ahideh-in Pathen thu seidohna ding hatup’uvin.

tcz: Ajehchu nangman pao chomchom thotheina thilpeh chu changin lang, miho chun na thusei heta hih ule, nangma Pathen tobou kihoulima nahi ding ahitai. Nangman Lhagao thahat'a thu nasei chu hinan natin, hijongleh hiche ho chu het hahsa hiding ahitai.
en_web: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
en_kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
tcz_gospelgo: Paochom thoa thusei chun mihemte koma sei ahipon, Pathen henga asei ahi, ajeh chu koiman ahetpeh poi, aman Lhagaova thuguh asei ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thusei doh a vang chun midang ahatsah a, atilkhouva chule amaho chu alhamonsah ahi.
en_web: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
en_kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen thu seidoh vang chun mihemte koma khantouna ding le tilkhouna chule lungmonna sei ahi.

tcz: Paochom chom thoa chu amatah kitil khouva ahin, hinla Pathen Thusei doh a chun Houbung apumpia athahatsah ahi.
en_web: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
en_kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Paochom thoa vang ama khantouna ding bou akisei ahin, Pathen thu seidohpa vang chun Houbung akhantousah-e.

tcz: Nabonchauva paochom chom nathotheiyu hileh katilheh in, hinla nabon chauva Pathen Thusei doh theina joh neileu chun kadeijoi. Ajeh chu Pathen Thusei doh chu houbung apumpia kitil khouna dinga pao chomchom tho sanga kiphamo joa ahi.
en_web: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
en_kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
tcz_gospelgo: Paochom thoa thu nasei cheh diu kadeiyin, ahinla Pathen thu naseidoh diu kadei cheh-e, Houbungin akisan’a khantouna anei theina dia aledoh aum loule paochom thoa thusei sangin Pathen thu seidohpa chu gamchengin aphachomjoi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte ho, keima nakomuva hung ingting hetlou pao khat in thu seileng, hichu iti naphat chompi thei dingu ham? Hinla keiman thu kiphong doh a kona ahilouleh hetsahna jat chombeh a kona ahilouleh Pathen Thusei doh a kona ahilouleh thuhila kona naphat chomna dingu kahin pohpeh u hileh kati.
en_web: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
en_kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
tcz_gospelgo: Tun sopite, nahenguva hunging paochom thon thuseiying, thu phondoh ham, hetna ham, gaothu seidohna ham ahiloule hilchetna ham mangin seipeh dau leng ipi naphatchompi diu ham?

tcz: Tumging manchah ho: theile ahilouleh selangdah ho jengjong hinna neilou ahivanga paocheng kicheh tah a thu kisei toh tekah thei ahiuve. Ajeh chu ahiding banga suhging ahilouleh koima chan agin ngei chu ahetdoh theilou dingu ahi.
en_web: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
en_kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chun hinna bei thil ging thei, kuli ahim, selangdah ham akimut teng agin akicheh loule ipi kitho ahi kon iti ahetdoh ding ham?

tcz: Chule sumkon mutgin akicheh louleh, sepaiho chun galsatna a dinga kikou ahiu iti ahetdoh thei dingu ham?
en_web: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
en_kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile sumkon mutgin akichet loule koi galkon dia kigo thei ding ham?

tcz: Chutobang chu ahi nangho jong, nang hon miho chu ahetlou paovin gahou leu chun, nang hon ipi naseiyu chu amahon iti ahet dingu hitam? Mun onglaiya thusei tobang bep nahiu ahitai.
en_web: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
en_kjv: So likewise you, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu paochom thoa thu nasei tengu nasei cheng akicheh loule ipi naseiyu kon iti ahetdoh ding ham? Hui lhoh mang ding bep’a aseiyu ahibouve.

tcz: Vannoiya hin paojat chom chom tampi aumin, chule pao kiti hin athuko aum cheh e.
en_web: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
en_kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya hin aging thei ogin atam lheh jengin, khat cha jong ajeh bei aumpoi.

tcz: Hinlah keiman paokhat chu hetahih leng, thuseipa dinga chu gamdang mi kahi ding, chule thuseipa chu keima dinga gamdang mi hiding ahitai.
en_web: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
en_kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman hiche ogin chu ipi kiseina ham he hih leng aseipa dia keima pao helou kahitan, amachu kei dinga pao helou ahitai.

tcz: Chule nangho dinga jong chutima chu ahi. Nangho Lhagaovin thilbol theina apeh thua hetnomna neneiyu ahin, houbung apumpia tilkhou theina ding chu hol'un.
en_web: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
en_kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin nang hon jong aban’a Lhagao thilpeh hol nahiuvin, hichea chun lolhin chehna din Houbung khantouna ding ho hahol’uvin.

tcz: Hitia chu paochom chom thoa chun akiseidoh ho chu ledoh theina dinga jong tao ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
en_kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
tcz_gospelgo: Paochom thoa thusei chun ipi kisei ham aledoh theina din tao hen.

tcz: Ajehchu keima paochom chom thoa kataova ahileh, kalhagao chu atao ahinan, hinla ipi kasei chu keiman kahepoi.
en_web: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
en_kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu keima paochom thon tao leng kalhagao vang atao nan, kalung gil’a van aga aumpoi.

tcz: Chuti ahileh ikatia pha ham? Keima Lhagaovin tao ingting, chule kahetna thuchenga jong tao vinge. Keiman Lhagaovin la sangting, chule kahet thei thuchenga la sang kate.
en_web: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
en_kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahile iti dingba ham? Lhagaova katao tengle lung gil’a katao tei ding, Lhagaova la kasha teng lung gil’a jong kasah tei ding ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu nangman Pathen chu lhagao bouva na vahchoi ahileh, nangma nahe loubeh ho tochun Pathen chu iti navahchoi khom thei dingu ham? Nangman ipi nasei ahijong helou ho chu thangvahnaa iti nangma to pangkhom thei dingu ham?
en_web: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
en_kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin phattheiboh ngeh nan Lhagaovin tao le chun kikhopna mun’a um milham chun ipi naseila helouva nang thangvahnaa chu, “Amen,” iti ati thei ding ham?

tcz: Nangman thangvahna chu phatah in penan nate, hinla nangma thangvahna chun miho chu thahatsahna pechomdeh ponte.
en_web: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
en_kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin phatah-in thangvahna sei jong le chun khatpa chun akhantoupi lou ahi.

tcz: Nangho chengse koipen sanga pao kaha thothei joh jal jeh hin Pathen kathangvah in ahi.
en_web: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
en_kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than you all:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho sei sanga paochom thoa thu kaseitamjoh jeh-in Pathen kathangvah-e.

tcz: Hinlah houbung kikhop khomna a keiman hettheiya thucheng nga seidoh ding chu hetlou paova thucheng sangsom seisang in kanomjoi.
en_web: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
en_kjv: yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin Houbung sunga paochom thoa thu cheng asang sang kasei sangin mihil chah na dia kalunggil’a thu cheng nga seh sei kadeijoi.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, hicheho hetkhenna a hin chapang ngol bang hih un. Aselam ahipouva ahileh khohelou chapang tobang hiuvin, hinla hetkhen themna lampang thua pilhing tah hiuvin.
en_web: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
en_kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, lung gel’in chapang hih-un, nunsetna lama chapangun lang, lung gel’in vang pilhinguvin.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen Thubua akisun'e, “Keiman kamite ho jah a pao jahkhahlou ho kaman ding chule gamdang mi ho kamanchah ding ahi. Ahijeng vang'in, hiche jenga jong chu amaho kasei thua nunglou dingu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
en_kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabua Danthu kisun: “‘Paochomhel tho ho, Michom beh ho kamsunga Keiman hiche mite henga thu kasei ding, Hijongle amahon kasei ngaipouvinte,’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye,” akiti.

tcz: Hitia hi nangman paochomchom tho hi atahsan ho dinga hilouva atahsan louho dinga amel chihna ahi ti nahetai. Pathen Thuseidoh vang hi atahsanlou hoa ding hilouva, atahsan hoa ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
en_kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu paochom tho hi tahsan loulai ho dinga melchihna ahin, atahsansa ho ding ahipoi; Pathen thuseidoh vang hi atahsansa ho ding ahin, atahsan loulai ho ding ahipoi.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, hitiho hetna neilou ahilouleh atahsanlou ho hu'ah na-houbung uva hungu henlang, chule amichang cheh in hetlou paova thu kisei chu jataleu amaho chun angol uva ahitai tia agel dingu ahi.
en_web: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
en_kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung pumpi kikhom hen lang amitakip’in paochom thoa thu aseipet’in milhamho ham atahsan lou lai hoham hung lut jengle, a-ngolgam dol’a namudoh lou diu ham?

tcz: Hinlah nangho jousen Pathen Thu naseiyuva, atahsan lou khat ahilouleh miho hicheho hetna neilou nakikhop nauva hung uleh, amahon chonsetna kigeldoh uvintin chule nathuseiyu chun athu atan ding ahi.
en_web: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
en_kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang mi jousen Pathen thu aseidoh pet’in atahsan loulai ham milham khat hung lutkha ta le, ajah chengsen asosol’a aboncha chu a-oimoa pang ding,

tcz: Amahon angaiyuva ahileh, aguhthim thu uchu kilangdoh intin, chule amaho chu akhup uva dilsu uvintin chule Pathen ahou uva, “Hikom'a nalah uva hin Pathen aume ati dingu ahi.”
en_web: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
en_kjv: and thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
tcz_gospelgo: alungthim selguh jouse kiphongjal’a, chutah le amai tol’a asuh lut jenga Pathen chibai aboh ding, “Tahbeh mongin nalah-uva Pathen aum’e” tia aphonjal ding ahi.

tcz: Aphai, kasopiteho, seichom leuhen, Nangho nakikhop khom teng uleh mi khat'in lasa hen, midang khat'in thuhil hen, achom dangma chun Pathen in ahenga gotchombeh a aphondoh chu sei hen, mikhat'in paochom chom tho henlang, chule michom khat in ipi kiseina ahi chu ledoh hen. Ahin akibol jouse chu nangho jouse tahsan hatsahna hihen.
en_web: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
en_kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi iti dingba ham sopite? Nakikhop khom tengu amitakip, la sah dingnei jong, thuhil ding nei jong, thuphon ding nei jong, paochom tho ding nei jong, ledoh ding neiyan jong, aboncha chun khantousahna jeng hihen.

tcz: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum kalvalin paoho thoda hen. Amaho chun amasan khatbou seisah uhen, chule amahon aseiyu chu mikhat'in ipi asei chu ledoh peh pai hen.
en_web: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
en_kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiham khat paochom thoa thuseiya na-umu le, mi ni ham, atam penin thum geiyin, khat khat’in kilhau hen chule mi khat’in akisei chu ledoh hen.

tcz: Hinlah koima alethei aumlouva ahileh, amaho chu nakikhop nauva chun thipbeh in touvu hen, chule achang uvin Pathen koma seijo uhen.
en_web: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
en_kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pao ledoh ding aum lou vang le Houbung kikhopna ama chu umthim hen, ama changseh le Pathen henga seijo hen.

tcz: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum'in gaothu seiyuhen, chule midangsen akiseidoh cheng chu datkhenna neiyuhen.
en_web: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.
en_kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
tcz_gospelgo: Gaothu seidoh ho jong chu mi ni ham thum ham geiya aseiyuva, adang hon aseiyu ageltoh diu ahi.

tcz: Ahin koiham khat'in Pathen Thu aseiya chule michom dang khat in Pakaiya kona thuphondoh amu leh, Thuseipa chu thip jeng hen.
en_web: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
en_kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang mi atou thim khattou henga thu ahung kiphondoh le amasapa chu thip hen.

tcz: Hitia hi Pathen Thusei hon thuseina phat banneicha anei cheh dingu, hitia hi amichang cheh in hetna anei dingu chule kitilkhou ding ahitauve.
en_web: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
en_kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mi jouse akitilkhouva aboncha alung mon theina diuva nabonchauva khat khat’a gao thu naseidoh theiyu ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thusei chun alhagaovu kithunun theina aneiyun, chule ama phat akinga theidiu ahiye.
en_web: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
en_kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets:
tcz_gospelgo: Themgao ho gaotheina chuThemgao ho thu noiya um ding ahi;

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi akisunohphah thei Pathen ahipoi hinla cham-lungmon Pathen hijoa ahi, Pathen mithengte ho kikhop khomna jouse ngai bangin.
en_web: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
en_kjv: for God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pathen hi lungnoh phahna ding hilouva chamnajo ahibouve. Mithengte Houbung jousea chonna bangin,

tcz: Numeiho hi houbung kaikhomna a thipbeh ding ahiuve. Amaho dingin thusei chu alompoi. Amaho thunoiya um dingu, chonna danin asei tobang hidiu ahi.
en_web: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
en_kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung kikhopna numeiho umthim beh-u hen, ajeh chu amaho hi thuseina kipelou ahiuve; chusangin Danthun asei bangin thua nungjo diu ahi.

tcz: Amahon thudoh nom aneiyuva ahileh ajipateu inmuna akidoh dingu ahi, ajeh chu numei ho dinga houbung kikhop khomna a thusei chu umdan dihlou ahi.
en_web: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
en_kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
tcz_gospelgo: I-khat khat hetnom aneiyu jongle a-in’uva ajiteu akidoh diu ahi, ajeh chu numei dia Houbung kikhopna thusei chu jachat um ahi.

tcz: Ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi nangho Corinth mite ho a pat'a hung kipan'ah ahi tia ngaitoa nahiuvem? Nangho kom bouva Thu hi kipedoh a nangaitou ham?
en_web: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
en_kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
tcz_gospelgo: O-le Pathen thu hi nang hoa kona hungjah doh pan ha, ahiloule nang ho komseh a bou hung lhung ham?

tcz: Nangho themgaova nakigel uva ahilouleh lhagao mia kigel nahiuleh, keiman nangho kaseipeh hi Pakai Amatah a kona thupeh ahi.
en_web: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
en_kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Khattou Themgaova kigel’a Lhagao thilpeh changa kibol aumle nahenguva kalekhasut hi Pathen thupeh ahi kihet them hen.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon hiche hi nahet dohlou uva ahileh, nangho tah jong hetdoh nahilou dingu ahi.
en_web: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
en_kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
tcz_gospelgo: Koitobang khat’in anahsah loule ama nahsah louva kikoi ding ahi.

tcz: Hitihin, kasopi deitah teho, Pathen Thusei nomna neiyun, chule paochom chom tho jong jada hih un.
en_web: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
en_kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kasopite, gaothu seidoh ding gut’un lang, chule paochom thoa thusei ding jong khamhih-un;

tcz: Hinlah imalam jouseah kitup tah le kisuhsela bola hiuvin.
en_web: Let all things be done decently and in order.
en_kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang ijakai hoitah le kitup keiyin kibol cheh hen.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, tumasanga naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahung lhangsap thu chu keiman nahin geldoh sahkit uvinge. Chupet chun nasang uvin chule tugeiyin nading det jing nauvin ahi.
en_web: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
en_kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also you have received, and wherein ye stand;
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nahenguva kaseiphong Kipana Thupha, nakisan’uva pansatna naneiyu chu kahetsahnom nahiuve;

tcz: Keiman najah uva kaseipeh u thu chu natahsan jom jing uva ahileh hiche Kipana Thupha chun nahuhhingu ahi–apat a pat'a adihlou thu chu tahsana nahilou pouva ahileh.
en_web: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
en_kjv: by which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: nahenguva kathusei phonga chu napandet jingu le hiche vanga chu huhhinga um ding nahiuve, achutiloule mohseh a natahsan’u ahibouve.

tcz: Keiman naheng uva akhohpen tah keima henga ana kipe chu kahin pehson nahiuve–Christa chu Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin ichonset jal'un athin ahi.
en_web: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
en_kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu amasapen’a nang ho kapeh, kathulah chu ahile Pathen lekhabua kisei dungjuiyin eiho chonset chengse khel’in Christa athin,

tcz: Ama chu akivuiyin, chule Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, ani-thum nin athoudohtai.
en_web: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
en_kjv: and that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
tcz_gospelgo: ama chu avuiyun, chuin Pathen lekhabua kiseibangin nithum nin kaithouvin aumtai;

tcz: Ama chu Peter in amun chujouvin somle ni ho chun amu uve.
en_web: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
en_kjv: and that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
tcz_gospelgo: hichun Cephas henga akilah-in, chujouvin som le ni henga,

tcz: Chujouvin, khatveiyin anung jui mi janga val hon khatvei mun amuvin ahi, amaholah a atamjo ahing nalaiyun, hinla phabep chu athi tauve.
en_web: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
en_kjv: after that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche ban hin sopite mi ja nga valjen henga khatvei lah-in akilah-in, alah-uva atamjo tugeiyin ahing nalaiyun, phabep vang athitauve;

tcz: Chupet in Jacob in ama chu amun chujouvin solchah jousen amu uve.
en_web: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
en_kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: abanin Jacob henga akilah-in, chule solchah jouse henga jong akilah-e;

tcz: Achaina keiyin, aphat louva peng bangin, keiman jong Ama chu kamun ahi.
en_web: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
en_kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhon nan aphat louva peng tobang kei henga jong ahung kilah-in ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu keima solchah ho jouse lah a imacha hiloupen kahi. Ahimongin Pathen houbung ana gimbol hesoh a kahi jeh hin solchah ti dinga jong kiloma kahipoi.
en_web: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
en_kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Solchah ho lah a alhumpen kahin, Pathen Houbung kabolset jeh chun Solchah tiding jong kakilompoi;

tcz: Hinlah tun ipi thu um jongleh kahi ahi, Pathen in alungsetna chu kachunga asunlhah ahitah jeh hin-chule hichu phatchomna bei ahidehpoi. Ajeh chu keiman solchah dangho sangin na kaha tohgimjon, hinla hichu keijoh hita louva Pathen in alungsetnaa keiya na atoh ahijo bouve.
en_web: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
en_kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
tcz_gospelgo: hijongle Pathen lungset jal’a keima hiche hi hikha kahibouve, chule alungsetna hi kei dia ima pang lou ahipoi, amaho chengse sangin kaha toh gim cheh jon, keivang kahipoi, eiumpia Pathen lungsetna joh chu ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah hiche hi neiseipeh un-Christa chu thinaa konin athoutai katiu leh, itidan'a nalah uva phabep in athiho thokitna aumpoi tia nahiu ham?
en_web: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
en_kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thinaa kona kaithouva aumdol kiseiphong lea, itia nalahuva koi koihamin mithiho thokitna umlouva aseiyu ham?

tcz: Ajehchu athiho thokitna aumlouva ahileh Christa jong chu kaithouva um dehlou hiding ahitai.
en_web: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
en_kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
tcz_gospelgo: Mithi thokitna aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou hinte;

tcz: Chule Christa chu kaithoulou anahita leh, thu kaseiphong leu hi mohseh hita ding, chule natahsan'u jong chu mohseh hiding ahitai.
en_web: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
en_kjv: and if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
tcz_gospelgo: chutia Christa kaithouva aum lou mong le kathuseiphongu jong moh ahin, natahsanu jong pannabei,

tcz: Chule solchah keiho jouse jong hi Pathen lamdola jousei kahi dingu ahitai-ajeh chu keihon Christa chu Pathen in lhan'a konin akaithouve kana tiu ahi. Hinlah thokitna aumlouva ahileh hiche kisei chu dih theilou ding ahitai.
en_web: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
en_kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
tcz_gospelgo: mithiho kaithouva aum loule Pathenin Christa akaithou lou ahin, akaithouva akiseijeh a Pathen douna hettosaha pang Pathen dia jouthua hettohsah a pang mia eikimandoh diu ahi.
