tcz: Chule athiho thokitna chu umlou hitaleh, Christa chu kaithou hilouding ahitai.
en_web: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
en_kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mithiho kaithouva aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou ahin,

tcz: Chule Christa chu kaithou hilou anahi khah leh, natahsanu chu panna bei hiding chule nangho hi nachonset nauvin themmo nachanjing nahlai dingu ahiye.
en_web: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
en_kjv: and if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
tcz_gospelgo: chutia Christa kaithouva aum loule natahsan’u jong phachom lou, tugeiya nachonset chengseuva um jing nalai nahiuve.

tcz: Hiche chung chang thua hi, Christa tahsana thiho jouse chu mang thah hidiu ahitai.
en_web: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
en_kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Christa hinkhoa ihmu milsa chengse jong amangthah gam ahitai.

tcz: Chule Christa itahsanu hi tuhinkhoa ding bou hita leh, vannoiya midang jouse sanga khoto umpen ihi dingu ahitai.
en_web: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
en_kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutia Christa to hingkhom dia ikinepnau hi tu hinkho sung mai maiya ding ahile, mi jouse lah a eiho hi voujang natna theipen ihiu diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah, Christa chu athiho lah a konin kaithou ahitah behnai. Ama athiho jouse lah a aga masapen chu ahitai.
en_web: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
en_kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun vang Christa thina konin kaithouvin aumin, a-ihmu milsa ho thokit tei ding photchehnan apangtai.

tcz: Hitia hi mikhat jal'a vannoi a thina ahunglhun banga chu, athiho lah'a kona thokitna hi michom khat jal'a hiding ahi.
en_web: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
en_kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem khat jeh a thina aumdoh bangin, mihem khatjeh-in thina kona thokitna aumdoh tan,

tcz: Eiho ibonchauva Adama hungkon ihijeh uva ithi sohkei dingu ahi tobanga, Christaa hiho jouse chu hinkho thah kipe ding ahi.
en_web: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
en_kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
tcz_gospelgo: Adam sunga pen jeh-in mi jousen athilon, hitobanga chu Christa sunga um jeh a mi jouse kicho hing ding ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah hiche thokitna thudol a hin akigontoh dol aume. Christa chu ga kiloh masapen ahi, abana Christaa thiho jouse chu Ama ahungkit tengleh kaithouva umding ahitai.
en_web: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
en_kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi amichang cheh ama phat phat’a kilhah tho ding ahi; Christa hung teng amite hintin,

tcz: Aman vaipoho le athunei ho chule athanei ho chu asuhmang soh jou tengleh, Lenggam chu Pa Pathen koma apehdoh a chujou tah leh achaina hung hiding ahi.
en_web: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
en_kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
tcz_gospelgo: achaina hipaiya, Christan vaihom na jouse le tha neina jouse chule thahat tin cheng asuhmangsoh teng Lenggam chu Pa Pathen apeh ding ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa hin Amelmate jouse chu akengto noiya akoi tokahsea vai ahom tei ding ahi.
en_web: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
en_kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin agalte jouse ajoa akengto noiya alutsah masangsea Christan lengvai apoh tei ding ahi.

tcz: Chule melma anunungpen akisumang ding chu thina ahi.
en_web: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
en_kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
tcz_gospelgo: Suhmang ding gal nukhah pen chu thina ahi;

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Pathen in ijakai Ama thunoiya akoisohkei ahitai,” ati. *(Hichea, “ijakai Ama thuneina noiya akoi” kiti hin Pathen Ama akijaosah thapoi, Ama chun Christa hi Athuneina apehdoh joh ahibouve).
en_web: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
en_kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun, “Aman ijakai akengto noiya akoisohtai,” ati. Ijakai athu noiya kikoisoh lah a hi ijakai athu noiya koisohpa tah vang chu kisimtha lou ahi akichen’e.

tcz: Aman ijakai athunoiya akoisohkei tengleh, Chapa Amatah jong chu Pathen thunoiya kikhum lut intin, Pathen Achapa ijakai chunga thuneina pepa chu, ijakai a achungvuma imalam jousea athunei hiding ahitai.
en_web: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
en_kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin ijakai Christa thu noiya alutsah soh teng, Pathen chu abonchakei chunga ahitheina dinga, thil ijakai aboncha anoiya lutsahpa noiya chu Chapa jeng jong lut ding ahi.

tcz: Athisaho kaithouva umlou ding ahia ahileh, thi jal'a baptize chanlona ajeh ipiba hitantem? Athiho chu nikhat le kaithou ding ahilou leh ipi bol ngaiya ham?
en_web: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
en_kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
tcz_gospelgo: Mithi ho dia baptize chanpeh ho, ahile ititauvintem? Chutia mithi ho kaithouva aum loule ibol’a amaho dia baptize chang hiuvam?

tcz: Chule ipi dinga aphat phat a keiho hin kahinkhou hi hahsatna kathoh jiu hintem?
en_web: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
en_kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
tcz_gospelgo: Chule keihon jong ibol’a nidan telchan’a kichat tijat kathoh jingu ham?

tcz: Ajehchu kasopiteho, kihahselna theijin keiman anitinin thina kakimaitopi jinge. I Pakaiyu Christa Yeshuan nanghoa anatoh hi keima kakiletsahna tahbeh chu ahi.
en_web: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
en_kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, i-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu hinkhoa kanei, nang hoa um kakisonna pan’a niseh a thijing kahi.

tcz: Chule gamsaho toh (Ephesus khomite toh) kakidel lona ipi phatchomna hintem? Athisaho thokitna umlou ding ahia ahileh? Chule thokitna aum louva ahileh, “Eiho kivah'u hitin, donu hite, ajeh chu ajinga kithi tading chu!” itidiu ahitai.
en_web: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
en_kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem hina maiya Ephesus khoa gamsaho to kisat kahile kei dinga ipi phachom ham? Mithi ho kaithouva um lou mong ahile: “Neu hitin dontah tau hene, Jingteng eiho kithita ding’an,” kiti bang chun boltah tau hen.

tcz: Chutobanga thusei ho chu kingol bolsah hih un, ajeh chu, “kivoppi phalouvin chon chan phalou asoji,” kitia ahi.
en_web: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
en_kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
tcz_gospelgo: Ima kipui chatvaisah hih-un: “Kivoppi phalouva Minunphat asusei,” akiti.

tcz: Adih chu ipipen ahi geltoh uvin lang, chule chonse tahih un. Ajeh chu hiche hi naja chatna ding uva kasei doh ahi, nangho mi phabep Pathen he tahbeh lou nahiuve.
en_web: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
en_kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not: for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung dihtah pu’uvin chule chonset dauvin, ajeh chu abang bang Pathen hetna neilou na-um’ui; najahchat diuva kasei ahi.

tcz: Hinlah khat touvin, “Mithiho itobanga thoudoh dingu ham? Itobang tahsa pum anei dingu ham?” tin dongun te.
en_web: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
en_kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
tcz_gospelgo: Mi abang khat’in, mithi ho kaithouva iti uma, chule itobang tahsavou pua kikaithou diu ham?” tinte.

tcz: Itobang ngol hoi thudoh hitam! Nangman muchi tol'a natu chu athi kahsen ahung kehdoh theipoi.
en_web: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
en_kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
tcz_gospelgo: Lungthimbei! Nangin muchi natu chu athi loule akehdoh ngaipoi.

tcz: Chule nangman leiset a nakoi chu suhlouchang mu hihen ipi pen chu natulut hita jongleh aphung ahung khang ding chu ahihih laiye.
en_web: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
en_kjv: and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin natu chu khonunga hung khangdoh aphung lhingset chu ahipon, suhlou chang hihen muchi dang hijongle muchi chang mai mai natulut hibouve;

tcz: Chutengleh Pathen in ahin hisahnom ding vouthah chu ahinpeh ding ahi. Muchi khat cheh a kona chu thingphung chom chom hung khang touva ahi.
en_web: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
en_kjv: but God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin adei banga tahsa asempeh a amuchi jat dungjui cheh a tahsa apeh ahibouve.

tcz: Chutobangma a chu tahsa pum jong jatchom chom ahi, mihem tahsa pum le ganhingho tahsa pum, vacha ho tahsa pum, chule ajat chombeh nga tahsa pum geiya uma ahi.
en_web: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
en_kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsaphea hing jouse tahsaphe jong akibangpoi; mihem’a achomin, gancha tahsaphe achomin, vachate tahsaphe achomin, nga hoa achom’e.

tcz: Leiset a tipumho aum tobang'in, Van'a jong tipumho aumin ahi. Van'a tahsapum loupina chu leiset'a tahsapum loupina toh ajatchomin ahi.
en_web: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
en_kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
tcz_gospelgo: Van tahsa ho aumin, leiset tahsa ho jong aum’e; ahinla van’a ho loupina achomin, leiset’a hoa jong achomin ahi,

tcz: Nisa hin loupina jatkhat aneiyin, lhale ahsi hon jong khat cheh hina ma anei cheh uve. Ahsiho jeng jong khat khat hi aloupinau ajatchom cheh in ahi.
en_web: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
en_kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisa loupina achomin, lha loupina achomin, ahsite loupina jong achome. Ahsi khat loupina jong ahsi dang khat sangin achomin ahi.

tcz: Mithiho thokitna jong chutobangma chu ahi. Leiset a itahsau hi ithiteng uleh leinoiya iphumlut jiuvin, hinla aitih a hing jing dinga hung thoudoh ding ahiuve.
en_web: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
en_kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
tcz_gospelgo: Athi ho thokit jong hitobang chu hi ding ahi. Mon mang theiya kivuilut ahin, mong mang thei louva kikaithou ding ahi;

tcz: Itahsau hi abong abaija kiphumlut a ahin, hinla hicheho hi loupina a hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Amaho hi thanei louva kivuilut'ah ahin, hinla thahat'a hungthoudoh ding ahiuve.
en_web: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
en_kjv: it is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
tcz_gospelgo: jum le ja thoha kivuilut ahin, loupina kikaithou ding ahi; longdamsa kivuilut ahin, thahat tah a kikai thou ding ahi;

tcz: Amaho hi angaiya mihem vouphea kivuiya ahiuvin, hinla amaho hi lhagaolam vouphea hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu angaidol'a tahsa vouphe aum tobanga chu lhagaolam dola vouphe aumin ahi.
en_web: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
en_kjv: it is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
tcz_gospelgo: tahsavou pua kivuilut ahin, lhagao tahsavou pua kikaithou ding ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thubun, “Mimasa Adam chu hinna nei mihem ahunghi,” tin eiseipeh uvin ahi. Hinlah Adam nunungpa chu, Christa kiseina, hinna pea Lhagao ahi.
en_web: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
en_kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Pathen lekhabua hitobang hin, “Mihem masa Adam chu tahsa hing khat ahidoh-in, Adam ninapa vang lhagao chohing ahi,” akiti.

tcz: Amasa tahsa tipumho hung um masaa chujouva lhagaova tipumho chu khonunga hung uma ahi.
en_web: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
en_kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasa chu lhagao vou ahipon, tahsavou joh ahin, aban’a chu lhagaovou ahi.

tcz: Mimasa Adam chu leiset leivuiya kona kisema ahin, mihem aninapa Christa chu Vana kona hung'ah ahi.
en_web: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
en_kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem masa chu leiset leivuiya kon ahin, Mihem ninapa vang van’a kon ahi.

tcz: Leiset mite hi leiset mihem chuto akilou uvin, chule van'a mite chu van'a hungkonpa tobang ahiuve.
en_web: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
en_kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
tcz_gospelgo: Leivuiya chengse chu leivuiya konpa tobang ahiuvin, van’a chengse jong chu van’a konpa tobang ahiuve;

tcz: Tua hi eiho leiset a mihempa tobang chu ihiuvin, phatkhatle vana hungkonpa tobang chu ihunghi dingu ahi.
en_web: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
en_kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
tcz_gospelgo: leivuiya konpa lim ilo banguva van’a konpa lim jong ilo cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, keiman kaseihi, itahsapheu hin Pathen Lenggam alotheipoi. Hiche thithei tahsaphe hin tonsot'a umding gou alotheipoi.
en_web: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
en_kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kasei ahi sopite, tahsaphe le thisanin Pathen Lenggam alo theipon, mon mang theiyin jong monmang theilou alo thei poi.

tcz: Hinlah keiman thuguh kidangtah naphondohpeh uvinge. Eiho jouse ibonchauva ithi sohkei dingu hilou, hinla ibonchauva vouso kikhel ding ihiuve.
en_web: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
en_kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, thuguh kaseipeh-ui, ibonchauva i-na ihmut milsoh lou diu, ibonchauva

tcz: Hichu phulou helouva, mitphetkah sunga sumkon nunungpen chu hung kimutging ding ahi. Ajeh chu sumkon chu ahung kimut ging tengleh, Pakaiya anathisaho chu vou kikhel a thoudoh diu ahi. Chule eiho ahing chengse ivouvu kikhel ding tonsot'a hingding ihitauve.
en_web: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
en_kjv: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
tcz_gospelgo: sumkon gin nukhah pen’a chu mitphet kah, hai khat sunga ikikheldoh soh diu ahi; ijeh-inem itile sumkon hung ging ding chule mithi ho mon mang thei lou dia kikai thoudiu, eiho jong ikikhelsoh kei diu ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu athi ding itahsau hi thilouhel ding tahsavouva kikhel ding, athithei itahsau hi athitheitalou tahsa voupua kikhel ding ahitai.
en_web: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
en_kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mon mang thei hin mon mang lou akivon’a, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon ding ahi.

tcz: Chuteng, athiding tahsa ineihou hi athi talou ding tahsahoa ahung kikhel tengleh, hiche Pathen Thubu in asei, “Thina chu jonain avallhumtai”
en_web: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
en_kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu mon mang thei hin mon mang thei lou chu akivon’a, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon teng le Pathen lekhabua kisun thu cheng; “Jo nan thina aval lhumtai,

tcz: “Vo thina, hoibaham namijo na? Vo thina, hoibaham namide na?” kiti chu guilhung ding ahi.
en_web: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
en_kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo thina, najo na hoiba ham? Vo thina, hoiba ham namidena?” kiti chu guilhung ding ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu chonset hi thina a dinga midep'a panga ahi, chule Danthu hin chonset thaneina apeh ahi.
en_web: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
en_kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina midena chu chonset ahin, chonset thahatna Danthu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman chonset le thina jo jou theina I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'in eipeuvin ahi.
en_web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a jo na eipeuva Pathen chu thangvah-in um hen!

tcz: Hijeh chun, kasopi deitah teho, hat'un chule suhlong theilouvin pangun. Pakaiya dingin thanomtah in tong jingun, ajeh chu nathil bolu chu Pakaiya dingin phatchomna bei imacha aumpoi ti naheuve.
en_web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
en_kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as you know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun kasopi deitahte, dettah-in suhlong hoi hilouvin pangun, Pakai hinkhoa natoh jouseu chu pannabei ahilou nahetjehuvin, phat jousen Pakai kinbol nan thalhing jing jenguvin.

tcz: Tun Jerusalema Pathen mite dinga neitokhomna sum thua neihin doh nauva hin, nang hon jong Galatia gamkai pumpia houbungho henga ajui dingu kapeh chu najui dinguva katem nahiuve.
en_web: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
en_kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithengte dia sumto khom thudol vang chu Galatia gama Houbung ho kathu lhah banga nang hon jong nabol diu ahitai.

tcz: Hapta seh a ni masapen nileh, nasum kilodoh uva kon chun atatoh kham bep anakoi doh uvin. Keima kahunglhuna khatvei lah a kahung lahkhom tokah ngah hih uvin.
en_web: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
en_kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahung teng sumdon khom bol louna din Choldo jou nikhat ni le nang ho amichang cheh-in atojou kham dungyin sepkhen hen khol hen.

tcz: Keima kahung tengleh, nathilpeh u Jerusalema podinga nalhen doh hou dinga seiphatna lekhathot kajih ding ahi.
en_web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
en_kjv: And when I come, whomsoever you shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahung teng kilom nasahpen pen’u chu lekha sutpeh ing ting nathilto’u chutoh Jerusalem solnang’e.

tcz: Chule keima dinga amaho toh lhon ding chu ahimona aum louva ahileh, keima tojong kaki lhon theiyu ahi.
en_web: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
en_kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima tah chea aphat jongle keima eikilhonpi nauvinte.

tcz: Keima Macedonia kache jou tengleh nangho vil dinga naheng uva kahung ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Macedonia a kona hung kholjin ding kalunggon ahi.
en_web: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
en_kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
tcz_gospelgo: Macedonia gam kachotsoh teng nahenguva hung nang’e, ajeh chu Macedonia gam chonle dinga kigo kahi;

tcz: Ijem itileh phat chomkhat, phalbi sunga nangho to umkhom kanomin, chujou tengleh aban kachena ding alampi nei gonpeh uva neisol theiyu ahitai.
en_web: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
en_kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
tcz_gospelgo: kache na chan’a neithah le theina diuva ijem itile nahenguva phat chom khat ka-uma, phalbi sungsea bon kachamden thei ahi.

tcz: Tuchunga hi nangho chomcha hungvila chule aban chebe ding ti kagongpoi. Keima kahunga Pakaiyin eiphatsah ahileh chomkhat beh um ding kanop ahi.
en_web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
en_kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile tuchunga hi palama jotpa ding kadeipon, Pakai phatsah ahile phat chom khatpi nakom’uva nichonding kakinem’e.

tcz: Tutadi hin, Pentecost Kut lhunkah a dingin Ephesus khopia hin um inge.
en_web: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
en_kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
tcz_gospelgo: Ephesus khoa Pentecost geiyin nichong ing’e;

tcz: Hikoma natoh lentah tohna dingin kot lentah akihongin, hinla eidouva mi tamtah aumun ahi.
en_web: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
en_kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu keima din natoh machalna din kot lentah-in akihongin, eidouva jong atam lheh jeng’e.

tcz: Timothy ahung tengleh, engbolna ima neihih un. Aman keima Pakai natoh katoh tobanga hi Pakai na chu atoh ahiye.
en_web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
en_kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
tcz_gospelgo: Timothy nahenguva ahungle nalah-uva kiphalam louhel’a alhah theina din vephauvin; ajeh chu keibanga ama jong Pakai natong ahi;

tcz: Koiman amahi hutum le gihna nei dauhen. Ama kaheng lama ahung kile tengleh na phatthei nau pumin hinsol un. Amahi atahsan midangto ahung kilhon ding kakinemin ahi.
en_web: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
en_kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun koiman nahsah mon bolda hen. Kaheng ahung lhun theina din lung mongin hinthah leuvin, ajeh chu kei le sopiten ama ka-anga jingo ahiye.

tcz: Tun isopiu Apollos chung changa hin–keiman ama chun atahsan sopi dang ho toh nahung vilna dingun katemin ahi, hinla tutadin ama achenom hih laiye. Aman phat kijen dom phat dang anei teng nahung vil dingu ahi.
en_web: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
en_kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopi Apollos thudol vang, sopite to lhon’a nahenguva ahungna dia katem jing ahinan, tupettah a ding vang anompoi, akimandom teng hung nante.

tcz: Kihong phauvin, Tahsanna'a chun dingdet'un, Lung ngam'un. Hat'un.
en_web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
en_kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
tcz_gospelgo: Kigingphan, tahsan’a pang det’un, pasal umchan thon, hat’uvin.

tcz: Chule nabol jouseu chu ngailutna in bol'un.
en_web: Let all that you do be done in love.
en_kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabol jouse ngailut neiya kibol hihen.

tcz: Stephanas le ain sung mite abonchauva Greece a aga masapen ahiuve ti nang hon naheuvin, chule amaho hin Pathen mite kin bolnaa ahinkhou aman jengu ahi. Kasopi deitah teho, kangeh nahiuve,
en_web: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
en_kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nang ho kangeh nahiuve. Stephanas insung mite hi Achaia gamsunga Pathen tahsan ga masa ahiuva, achamtah-uva mithengte kinbolna kipeh-u naheuvin,

tcz: Amaho le midang ho kiphal thengtah le lunglut tah a natong ho thunoiya kipelut un.
en_web: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
en_kjv: that ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon jong hitobang miho le atohgimpi chengseu umchan najop theiyu ahi.

tcz: Stephanas, Fortunetas Chule Achaicus hikom mun ahungu hin eikipasah lheh jengin ahi. Nanghon hikoma kithopina neipeh theilou u chu amaho hin eikithopiu ahi'e.
en_web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
en_kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Stephanas le Fortunatus chule Achaicus te ho hilama ahungu kakipah lheh-e; ajeh chu amahon nalhin lelna jouseu abulhit’un,

tcz: Amaho nangho dinga kitilkhouna phatah ahibang uvin, keima dingin jong ahiuve. Hitobang loma phatah a lhacha kinbol ho jouse chu nakipapi nau navetsah tei diudol ahi.
en_web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
en_kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
tcz_gospelgo: ahungu hin kei le nang ho lhagao akidosah lheh jeng’e. Hijeh chun hitobang ho hi hethem’uvin.

tcz: Asia gamkai sunga hilam a houbung um hon, Aquila le Priscilla chule ain'a kikhom houbung chun Pakaiya chibai nahin bol uve.
en_web: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
en_kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
tcz_gospelgo: Asia gama Houbung jousen nasalam’ui. Pakaiya hinkhompi Aquila le Prescilla, chule a-in lhona kikhom Houbung miten hatah-in nasalam’ui.

tcz: Sopite ho hikoma umho jousen chibai nahin thot uve. Khat le khat Christian kingailutnan chibai kibolun.
en_web: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
en_kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with a holy kiss.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite chengsen nasalam’uve. Kisopi chop thengin khat le khat kisalamto cheh-duvin.

tcz: Hiche hi keima PAUL in kakhuttah a kajih kichibaina thucheng ahi.
en_web: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
en_kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche salamna hi keima Paul khut tah a hung kon ahi.

tcz: Koitobang Pakai ngailu lou auma ahileh, ama chu gaosap changa ahi. Ka Pakaiyu hungin!
en_web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
en_kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be anathema, Maran-atha.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Pakai ngailu lou chu gaosap chang hen! Maranatha.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen.
en_web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu milungset nan umpiuvin.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a kangailutna nabon chauva chunga umhen. Amen.
en_web: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
en_kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. ¶ The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu hinkhoa ka-ngailutnan nabonchauvin umpiuvin.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen lunglama Christa Yeshua solchah a pang Paul le isopiu Timothy a kona Corinth a um Pathen houbung le Greece gamkol sungsea Pathen mithengte hodinga lekhathot ahi.
en_web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
en_kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa Solchah Paul le sopi Timothyn Corinth khoa Pathen Houbung le Achaia gamsung pumpia mitheng jouse henga,

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungset le chamna hung lhung hen.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa henga chun vahchoina jouse umhen. Pathen chu mi khoto them le lhamonna jouse hung konna Pa ahi.
en_web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
en_kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu Christa Pa Pathen, hepina chengse Pa le lungmon konna Pathen chu phattheiboh chang hen.

tcz: Aman kahahsat nau jousea eilhamonu ahin keihon jong midang kalhamon theina dingu ahi. Hahsatnan amaho aphah tenguleh, Pathen in keiho eilhamonu tobanga chu amaho jong kalhamon theina dingu ahi.
en_web: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
en_kjv: who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman genthei hesoh kathotna chan’uva eilha mon’uvin, keihon jong Pathen’a kamu’u hiche lungmonna chun genthei hesoh toh kha jouse kalhamsah theiyui;

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh keiho Christa dinga kaha thohgim cheh uva ahileh, Pathen in atamjo cheh a alhamonna Christa jal'a eihin sunlhah peh be dingu ahi.
en_web: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
en_kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thoh gentheina twikhanglen tobang chun keiho jong eichup jengu leh, Christa jal’a kakisun’u lungmon nan jong eichup diu ahi.

tcz: Keiho hahsatna hon eidelpha jengu jongleh hichu nangho lhamonna le huhhing nachanna dingu ahiye! Ijeh inem itileh keiho tah lhamonna kachan tenguleh, keihon nangho kalhamon tei ding'u nahiuve. Chuphat leh nanghon keiho thohsa chu thoh hattah a nathoh thei dingu ahitai.
en_web: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
en_kjv: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho genthei hesoh thoh a eikilhau le, hichu nang ho lhamonna ding le huhing nachanna diu ahi; keiho eikilhamon’u l ekeiho thoh hesoh tobang nathoh nauva lung nengtah a nathoh jeh-uva Pathenin nalhamonsah theina diu ahiye.

tcz: Nanghon keiho thohhahsa thohna'a nathoh jal uva, Pathen in keiho eilhamon nauva chu nangho jong nalhamon dingu kakinemun ahi.
en_web: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
en_kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule hesoh gentheinaa chan naneiyu l elungmonnaa jong chan nanei diu kaheuvin nang ho dinga kakinep nau adet jinge.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, keihon Asia gamkaiya hahsatna ichan geiya katou ahi thudol chu nahet ding uva lom ahi katiuve. Keihon kathohjou kalval'un engbol nale lungdonna katoh un, chule keiho chu ahing dingin kaki ging cha tapouve.
en_web: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
en_kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Asia gam’a kachunguva hesoh gentheina hung chu hi helouva naum diu kanompoi; kathauvin ajo kalval’a genthei hesohna nasa tah-in eidelpha jeng phat’un hing din jong kakihol tapouve.

tcz: Atahbeh in thi dingin kaki gingmo tauve. Hiti ahitah jeh chun keimaho a kingam talouvin, Pathen athiho kaithoupa a bou chun kalungu kangaijo tauve.
en_web: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
en_kjv: but we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon kachunguva hi thina dinga thu kitan ngap’a kagel leuvu ahitan, amale keiho le keiho kisong louva mithi ho kaithou Pathen’a kakisonna joh diuva chute ahibouve.

tcz: Chule Amachun tahsa thina thei vangsetnaa kona eihuhdoh u ahin, chule eihuhdoh kit dingu ahi. Keihon Amaa kakisonnau kangam lhauvin, Aman eipanhu uva eihuhdoh jom jing dingu ahi.
en_web: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
en_kjv: who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chun hitobang, thina khoh tah a kona chu eina huhdoh-u ahin, ei huhdoh kit diu ahinai, tukal’a jong eihuhdoh diuva kakinep nau hi,

tcz: Chule nangho keiho dinga nataonau chu neipanhu nau ahi. Chuphat leh mitamtah in thangvahna apeh dingu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Pathen in alungsetnaa eiho huhbit ichanna dinguva taona tamtah kimang chu asan ahitai.
en_web: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
en_kjv: you also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon taonaa neihu diu ahin, chutia chu mi tamtah-in eitaopeh nau donbutna eikipeu phattheina chengse jal’a chu mi tampin thangvahna anei diu ahi.

tcz: Keihon lung ngamtah le selepha hetna thenga a kaseitheiyu chu Pathen peh thenna hinkho le nangho toh khosah khomna a lung dihtah pua kaumu hi ahi. Keiho kachihnauva kisonglouvin Pathen lungsetna a kakisongun ahi. Hiche hi keiho vannoi mite masanga, adehset'a nangho masanga kachonnau chu ahiye.
en_web: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
en_kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-wards.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakison nau chu hiche hi ahi: vannoiya kachon namlhah-u le nang ho kabolnau hi tahsaphe chihnaa kabol’u ahipon, lung thengsel le lung navahpel’a Pathen lungset jal’a bol kahiu kahet themnau lung gil hi hettohsah a pang ahi.

tcz: Kalekhathot'u hi aki ima beihela ahin, chule imacha nahet mo dinguva akijih doh a aumpoi. Nanghon neihin hetthemna dingu nikho ahunglhun ding kakinemin ahi.
en_web: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
en_kjv: For we write none other things unto you, than what you read or acknowledge; and I trust you shall acknowledge even to the end;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile keihon nasim thei diu le nahet diu tilou ima kasunpouve, nahet khongsoh diuva kakinepna chu,

tcz: Tun nanghon keiho nei hethem hih jong leuchun, I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung kit niteng le chun, keihon nangho kakisonpi tobanguva hi nanghon jong nei kisonpi dingu ahi.
en_web: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
en_kjv: as also you have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: keihon jeng jong neihet phol phah vangun, keihon nang ho kakisonpi banguva hi Pakai Jesu Nikho ni vang le neikisonpi dingu ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangho hetkhen themna le tahsanna ka photchet nom bang uva hi, nangho aniveina a hungvil kit ding kati hi phattheina athop'a kachansah nom un ahi.
en_web: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
en_kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that you might have a second benefit;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ginchatna jal’a hi lungsetna avel vel’a nanei theina diuva nang ho henga hung masah ding kanatup ahin,

tcz: Hichu, amasaa Macedonia kachena lampia chule Macedonia a kona kahung kilena lama dinga jong kati ahi. Chujou phatleh nanghon keima Judea kachena a dinga neisolpai thei dingu ahi.
en_web: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
en_kjv: and to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judea.
tcz_gospelgo: Judea gam’a neihung thah theina diuva nang ho hinhopaa Macedonia gam jot ding, chule Macedonia gama kona hinhopa kit ding kagot ahi.

tcz: Ipi iti lamdola katohgon kakhel ham ti thua neidoh nom dingu kagingchai. Katohgon chu phottohna umlouva gonga neigelu vem? Vannoi miten “Henge” atiu chu “kanompoi” tina a asei tobang uva sei hidinga neigelu ham?
en_web: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
en_kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche bol kagot’a doi beiya lung linglao beh kahim? O-le tahsaphe lunggel’a, “Heng’e, heng’e,” moh tia, “Ahipoi, ahipoi,” moh ti ding kagot beh ham?

tcz: Pathen tahsan umtah ahi tobanga chu, keihon nangho koma kathuseiyu hi “Henge” ahilouleh “Kanompoi” tia kheltolea kahi pouve.
en_web: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
en_kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nahenguva kathuseiyu chu, “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti thei ahipoi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen Chapa Yeshua Christa chu “Henge” tileh “Ka nompoi” ti thuchenga lunggel kichiah ding ahipoi. Silas, Timothy chule keihon naheng uva kaseiphongu chu ama ahi, chule Ama hi Pathen in “Ahi” tia asei–anamdetna chu ahi.
en_web: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
en_kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kei le Silvanus chule Timothy, keiho seiphong jal’a nasunguva cheng Pathen Chapa Jesu “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti ding ahi pon, ama sunga chu, “Kanom nai,” tina umdoh jeng ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen thutep jouse chu Christaa avela “Henge” tia hungvel gindoh kit'ah ahi. Chule Christa jal'a chu eihon, “Amen” itiu (hichu “Henge”) awcheng hi aloupina dinga Pathen kom geiya gingdoh a ahitai.
en_web: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
en_kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thutep chengse chu amasunga hi, “Ahinai,” kitia; hichejeh tah a chu Ama jal le eiho jeh a choi-at ahichehna dia Pathen henga, “Amen,” kitiji ahi.

tcz: Pathen chun nangho toh Christaa dingdet hikhom dinga eigon uva chule einganseu ahitai.
en_web: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
en_kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
tcz_gospelgo: Christa hinkhoa dia keiho le nang ho gom’a eisudet’uva thao einu’va chu Pathen ahin,

tcz: Aman eiho ijakai Ama a hidinga eithutep u aphotchetna masa hinan ilungsung uva Lhagao Theng akhumin Ama hinna eichan tha tauve.
en_web: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
en_kjv: who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman eiho mohor einamkhum’uva, lhagaova khamgahna chu i-lungthim sunguva eipeh-u ahi.

tcz: Keiman thutah sei kahi photchetna a Pathen hi keima chung chang thua ahetoh hidinga kakou ahi. Corinth a kahung kilekitlou chu kahaphosal louna dingu kagel jeh ahi.
en_web: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
en_kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kakhohsah jeh a tugeiya Corinth a kahung lou hi kahinkhoa ahetoh Pathen pan’a ka kou ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keihon natahsan nau chu natoh'a iti pohdoh ding ham tithua kahil got'u hi nachung uva vaihom kanopjeh u ahipoi. Nangho natahsan nauva nadindet'u ahi jal'a, nangho kipana na dimsetna ding uva nangho toh tohkhom kanop'u ahi.
en_web: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
en_kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
tcz_gospelgo: Natahsan thu’uva kipuchansah kahipouve, nakipana diuva natoh khonpiujoh kahiuve, ajeh chu tahsanin nadingdet nauve.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman nangho hungvil kit'a nagimnau kibelapna ding chu boltah lou dinga kagel lhah ahitai.
en_web: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
en_kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung phatmo sah dia nahenguva hung kit lou dinga kei le kei kiphatsah kahitai;

tcz: Ajeh chu, keiman nangho lunghem sah taleuveng, kon eikipasah ding hitam? Atahbeh in koima dang hilou kalung hemsah ho joh chu hung hiding nahiuve.
en_web: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
en_kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu nasulung hangu leng, hiche kalung phatmo sah ho tilou chu konba eikipasah tan tem?

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a naheng uva dinga kajih ngai banga kahin jih hi keima kahung tengleh, kipana sangpen eipe ding ho chun eilung natsah louna dingu kati ahi. Nangho nakipa jal uva ka kipana hung umdoh theibou ahi ti hi nabon chauva nahet'u ahi.
en_web: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
en_kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu kahung teng le eikipasah dinghon eilung phat mosah louna diuva hiche hikahinsut ahi, ipijeh-inem itile kei kipana chu nang ho nabonchauva nakipa nauva kaginchat tahbeh ahiye.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot kajih chu lunghemna lentah neija, lunggimna neipuma chule mitlhi tamtah sohleuva nangho lungnat ding chu deilou jeh a, ichan geiya nangho kangailut'u ham ti hi nahet joh dingu kati ahiye.
en_web: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
en_kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that you should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho lung phatmosahna ding hilouva thalhingset’a nang ho dia ngailutna kanei hinahetdoh theina diuva, lung hesoh genthei tampi, lungkham chule mit lhi long longa hiche hi kahinsut ahibouve.

tcz: Keiman hiche hoa hahsatna hinlhutpa amatah hin keima eisuh lungnat sangin nangho nabon chauvin nalung natsah uve ti thudol kasei hi seivala thusei chu kahipoi.
en_web: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
en_kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiham khat’in lung phatmona aboldoh le kaima eilung phatmosah ahipoi, nabonchauva nabol khoh behseh louna diuva miphabep nalung himosah-u ahibouve.

tcz: Nangho atamjo chengsen kilungkhat tah a ama douna a thu natan uva chu gimbolna ama dinga aphakhopset kipea ahi.
en_web: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
en_kjv: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang thua hi japin ama a-oimo chu phaset ahin,

tcz: Hinama jongleh, tua ama chu ngaidama chule lhamon joh ding ahitai. Achuti louva ahileh amahi lunglhah behsehna chun thunun khaget inte.
en_web: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
en_kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon ama chu lung gim behseh a, alhah lhop pailouna dinga na-ngaidam’uva natil khoujoh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun, tun ama hi na ngailut nau chu photchetna neipeh un tia kangeh nahiuve.
en_web: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
en_kjv: Wherefore I beseech you that you would confirm your love towards him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama dia ngailutna nakicheh sah diuva ka-ngeh nahiuve.

tcz: Keiman kabol ji ngai banga nangho henga kahin jih hi nangho patepna a, phatea thua nung nahiu hinam ti kavet nau ahibouve.
en_web: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
en_kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho imalam jousea thua nungte nahiu photchetnaa akipatepnau chu hetdohna dinga hiche hi kahinsut ahinai.

tcz: Ama hi na ngaidam tenguleh keima tah in jong ka ngaidame. Chule keiman ka ngaidam dingdol chengse kangaidam tengleh, keiman Christa thuneina'a nangho phatchomna dinga ka ngaidam ahi.
en_web: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
en_kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon mi khattou na-ngaidamu le kenjong ama chu ka-ngaidam thouve, hitia chu khattou ka-ngaidam le Christa angsunga nang ho jal’a kabol ahin,

tcz: Hichu Satan in eithujo thei louna dingu hiya ahi. Ajeh iham itileh ama lunggon phalou ho chu ihetsau ahi.
en_web: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
en_kjv: lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
tcz_gospelgo: Satanin eijotho louna diu ahi, ajeh chu eihon ama dohna lungthim ihaiyu ahipoi.

tcz: Keima Troas khopia Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kahung chun, Pakaiyin keima dingin thusei theina kot eihonpeh in ahi.
en_web: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
en_kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dia Troas a kahung chun Pakai dinga katohna dingkot lent ah-in akihonge;

tcz: Hinlah kasopipa Titus chu nanghoa kona thupoh hinpoa hunglhung loulai ana hi jeh chun, keiman lung olna kana nei theipon ahi. Hitia chu keiman nangho kadalhah uva Macedonia gam'a ama gahol dinga kana che ahitai.
en_web: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
en_kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
tcz_gospelgo: ahivangin kasopi Titus kamudoh loujeh-in kalungthim akicholdo theipon, hijeh chun miho kalhadoh-in Macedonia lama kahungtai.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman sohchanga eikoiyu hin Christa a jona a chu eipuilut'u ahitai. Tua hi aman eiho Christa hetna thuhi gimnamtui tobanga muntina seichoile dinga eimanchah u ahitai.
en_web: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
en_kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa hinkhoa galjonaa eikijotkhompi jinguva, keiho mangchaa Christa hetdohna le phondohna chu muntin’a gim namtui banga either chansoh-uva Pathen chu thangvahin um jing hen.

tcz: Kahinkhou hi Christa atobanga Pathen henga gimnamtui hungnamdoh a ahitai. Hinlah hiche gimnamtui hi Huhhing'a umho dinga hihen amangthah ho ding hijongleh gimnam chom choma namdoh a kahi tauve.
en_web: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish:
en_kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen koma kei ho hi Christa dinga huhinga umsate heng le amangthah ding ho heng geiya jong gim namtui kahiuvin,

tcz: Keiho hi amangthah ho dingin kichat um thina gimnam le mahthahna kanamu uve. Hinla huhhingna chang ho dingin keiho hi hinna pea gimnam kanam uve. Hitobang tah a tohding kingansena chang dinga kiloma koi hintem?
en_web: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
en_kjv: to the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
tcz_gospelgo: athi dingin thipo kanam’un, ahin gdin jong gim namtui kanamuva. Hicheng dinga chu akhomto soh thei koiham?

tcz: Keiho hi chang phatchomna hola thusei phong lea kahi pouve ti nanghon naheuve. Keiho hi Pathen in eivet jingu ahi ti hea lung dihtah pua chule Christa thuneina a thusei phonga panga kahiuve.
en_web: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
en_kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho vang Pathen thu kiveina mang miho tobang kahipouve, lung thengseljoa Pathena kona Pathen angsunga Christa to hingkhoma thusei kahi bouvui.

tcz: Keimaho le keimaho kichang seiphat bol a kahiuvem? Keiho hi midangho banga seiphatna lekha poa hung ding kahiuvem? Ahilouleh amaho thalhenga lekhathot jih dinga kon na nganseu vem? Koima umponte.
en_web: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
en_kjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho le keiho kiseipha pan kit kahiuvem? O-le konkhat banga nahenguva ding hihen nang hoa kon hijongle seiphatna lekha thot neilou khoh mi kahibeh-um?

tcz: Keihon seiphatna lekha kangeh u chu nangho tah nahiuve. Na hinkho man danu hi kalung sunguva kijihlut mitin in asim theiyu chule nalah uva napha katoh u mihon ahin hetdoh u chu ahitai.
en_web: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
en_kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho hikeiho dinga lekha thot, ka lunggil’uva kisun’a, mitinin asim’a ahet nahiuve;

tcz: Nangho hi Christa a kona lekhathot chu nahiuvin, nalah uva lhachana katoh doh'u kavetsah'u nahi tauve. Hiche lekhathot hi lekhatwiya kijihdoh hilouvin, Pathen hing lhagao toh kithoa kijihdoh chu ahi. Hichu songpheng chunga lekhajem chu hita louva mihem lungsunga kona kijih doh chu ahi.
en_web: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
en_kjv: forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
tcz_gospelgo: keiho lhacha kapan’uva nang ho hiChrista lekha thot kichentah nahiuvin, songpheng chunga lekha twiya kisun ahipon, mihem tahsa lung chang’a Pathen hing lhagaova kisunjo ahi.

tcz: Keihon hicheho jouse chunga kakison nau chu Christa jal'a Pathen katahsanu chu ahi.
en_web: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
en_kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kisonna hi Christa jal’a Pathen henga kaneiyu ahi.

tcz: Hichu keima hon keiho changseh bou abol dinga gunchena neija kahiuve katinau ahipoi. Gunchena kaneiyu hi Pathena kon ahiye.
en_web: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
en_kjv: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
tcz_gospelgo: Keihoa kona bulhing dinga seithei, keiho chamin ima kahipouvin, kabulhin nau hi Pathena konjo ahin,

tcz: Aman keiho hi Amaa Kitepna Thah lhacha ho hidinga boltheina eipeh u ahitai. Hiche Kitepna hi akijih dohsa Danbua kon hilouva, Lhagaova kon ahijo bouve. Kitepna Lui akijihdoh sapa chu thina a kichaiya ahin, hinla Kitepna Thah a Lhagaovin hinna apeh ahi.
en_web: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
en_kjv: who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman keiho hi jih tho Danthu hilou Lhagaova kitepna Thah kinbol lhacha theiya eisem’u ahi; ajeh chu jih tho Danthu chun thina asodoh-in, Lhagaovin vang mi ahinsoi.

tcz: Lamlui, songphenga kijih chun thina asodoh in ahi, loupina nasatah Israel mipi ten ana vetngam lou u Mose maivah'a kipan ahivangin. Ajeh chu amaivah chu Pathen loupina toh vahtha ahin, hiche vah chu akem suhsuh in amang jenge.
en_web: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
en_kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
tcz_gospelgo: Thi lo na ding bep’a akin kibol songpheng chunga kijih tho Danthu jeng bon chubanga aloupia, amaivah loupina chu amolsuh suh ahi vanga, Israel chaten Mose mai avet chang ngam louvu le, 8Lhagaova dinga lhacha kinbolna chu ijat’a loupe da ding ham?

tcz: Tua hi eihon Lhagao Thengin hinna apeh jeh a lampi thah a chu loupina lenjo lampi thah a chu iginchat diu hilou ham?
en_web: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
en_kjv: how shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

tcz: Lamluiya themmo channa polut bon chu aloupia ahileh Pathen toh kilungtoh lampi thah chu iti loupi jocheh ding hitam?
en_web: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
en_kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Themmo chan na dinga lhacha kinbolna bon aloupi le them channa dinga lhacha kinbolna loupina chun tamtah a akhokheljoh ding ahi.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin lampithah a Kitepna Thah aloupi dan hi loupina masa chuto tekahpi thei ahipoi.
en_web: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
en_kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu loupe tah akigel chu hiche hin aloupina adeh lhah phat’in aloupi thei tapoi.

tcz: Hitia lampilui chu kheldoh ahitah a ahileh, ichan geiya athah tonsot'a um chu loupijo cheh ding hi tam?
en_web: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
en_kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile aloupina molsuh suh bon athupi le tonsot’a loupe den jing jeng ding chu gamchenga thupijo ahi.

tcz: Hiche lampi thah chu eiho eikipeuva ahitah leh eiho hatah a lungngam ding ihitauve.
en_web: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
en_kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kinepna hi kanei jehuva hijat vei hi phongtah a hakatji kahiuve.

tcz: Eiho hi, Mosen aloupina amai pon'a akhu khum Israel mipi ten avetngam lou u tobang chu ihipouve, hiche aloupina chu kemmang dinga kigongsa ahi.
en_web: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
en_kjv: and not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
tcz_gospelgo: Amaivah molmang hel Israel chaten amu louna diuva ponlu kikhuhji Mose tobang kahipouve.

tcz: Ahivangin mipite lunggel chu atahsahjo cheh in, chule tuni geiyin jong Kitepna Lui akisim doh chanin, hiche ponlukhu chun amaiyu akhu khumun, thutah chu ahekhen theiji tapouve. Chule hiche ponlukhuh hi Christa tahsan jal'a bou kisubei theiyah ahi.
en_web: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
en_kjv: but their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama ho chu alunggel’u atah jo cheh tai. Tuni chan geiyin Kitepna Lui asim tengulehiche ponlukhuh chu kihohdoh louvin aumden jing nalaiye; ijeh-inem itile Christa to hinkhom tengle bou kihohdohji ahi.

tcz: Ahi, tulai nikho jengin jong Mose lekhabuho asimlai chanun, alungthimu hiche ponlukhu chun atomjin, chule amahon ahekhen theiji tapouve.
en_web: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
en_kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Tuni geiya hiche Mose Danthu chu asim tengu le alungthimu pon lukhuh kikhujol banga kikhu khumji ahi.

tcz: Hinlah mi koiham khat chu Pakaiya ahung kihei tengleh, ponlukhu chu lahdoh ahitai.
en_web: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
en_kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
tcz_gospelgo: “Aman Pakai heng ajot lut teng ponlukhuh chu ahohdohji,” akiti.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule Pakai Lhagao umna chan chu chamlhatna ahi.
en_web: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
en_kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, Pakai Lhagao umna chan acham-lhat aum’e.

tcz: Chutia chu eimaho jouse ponlukhu kiladoh chengse hi Pakai loupina chu mua chule tahlang'ah ihitauve. Chule Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule eiho Ama loupina mela chu kikhel cheh cheh a ihitauve.
en_web: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
en_kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho maikhu lou chengse, phatvet’a kive banga Pakai loupina kimusah ho hi Pakai kisah Lhagao chun loupina khat’a kona loupina cheh lim khat’a eikheldoh-u ahitai.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in, Pathen in ami khotona a hiche lhacha natohna hi eipeh u ahitah jeh in, keiho kalungu alhadah dehpoi.
en_web: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
en_kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset vanga hiche lhacha kinbolna kanei khah jeh-uvin keiho kalhadah hih hel’ui;

tcz: Keihon jachat um aguh a thilbol jouse le doha lheplhahna lungthim kapaiyun ahi. Keihon koima lheplhah ding kago pouve, ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi alam louvin kamangcha pouve. Keihon Pathen masangah thutah kaseiyun, chule hiche hi milungdih jousen aheuve.
en_web: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
en_kjv: but have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
tcz_gospelgo: jachatna thilguh chengse kapai lhauvin, doha lungthima chon lou, Pathen thu seilep louvin Pathen maiya mitin vetchah dingin phongtah-in thudihin kachon’uvin, keiho le keiho kiseiphatna kabol’uve.

tcz: Keihon Kipana Thupha kaseiphongu hi ponlukhu lea kiselgua uma ahileh, hichu amangthah dingho a ding bou ahi.
en_web: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
en_kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijentia ka Thupha seiphongu jong hi akikhu mang akisel ahijongle amangthah dia bou kikhu mang hiding ahin,

tcz: Satan, hiche vannoi pathen hin, atahsan louho lungthim amotsah ahijeh a, amahon Kipana Thupha vah loupitah hi amudoh theilouvu ahi. Hiche Pathen lima um, Christa loupina thudol hi hetkhen theina anei pouvin ahi.
en_web: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
en_kjv: in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho chu hiche vannoi pathenin Pathen lim mong monga hung um Christa loupina Kipana Thupha khovah amu thei louna diuva atahsan lou nau lungmit asuhchot peh ahi.

tcz: Keiho hi kachung chang thu'u seiphonglea vahlea kahi pouve ti nanghon nahe nauve. Keihon Yeshua Christa hi Pakai ahi, chule keiho hi Yeshua jal'a nangho lhacha natonga kahiuve ti seiphong kahiuve.
en_web: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
en_kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile keiho le keiho kiseiphongle kahipouvin, Jesu Christa chu Pakai ahije kaseijuva, chule Jesu jal’a keihojoh hi lhachaa pang kahidolu kaseiyu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in, “Muthim lah a vah umhen” tia asei chun hiche vah chun ilungsungu asalvah tai, hichu eihon Pathen loupina chu Yeshua Christa maiya kona imudoh uva ihet theina dingu ahi.
en_web: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu, “Muthim lah a konin kho hungvah hen,” tia Pathen ma ma chun Christa meiya Pathen loupije hetna khovah chu keiho lungthim ahinsalvah sah ahitai.

tcz: Tun eiho hiche vah hin ilung sungu asalvah in, hinla eima hotah hi leibel kehthei tobanga hiche gou manlu hi ichinu ahi. Hiche hin keihoa thaneina kidang tah hi Pathena hungkon ahin, keihoa tah ahipoi, ti aphot chenna ahi.
en_web: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
en_kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon hiche leibel’a gou kachin’u hi thaneina chungnungpen chu keihoa kon hilouva Pathena hungkon ahije photchetna ahi.

tcz: Keiho hi hahsatna hon aningtin'ah eidel phauvin, hinla eiki tatgoi pouve. Kalungu akichiah jin, hinla kalung lhapai jeng pouve.
en_web: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
en_kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
tcz_gospelgo: Hoima lam jousea eikineh chintouvin, ahivangin eikisu ngem deh pouve; lung dongin ka-um’uvin, ahinla kalung lhadeh pouve;

tcz: Keiho delkhumin kaum un, hinla Pathen in einungsun deh pouve. Keiho eikison op uvin, hinla eiki sumangpai pouve.
en_web: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
en_kjv: persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
tcz_gospelgo: eikinojam leuvin, ahivangin donlouvin ka-umdeh hih-ui; eikijep lhu-vin, ahinla eikisumang deh pouve;

tcz: Katahsau hin kagim thoh nauvah Yeshua thina a chan kanei jingun, hichu katahsauva Yeshua a hinna chu akimudoh na ding katiu ahi.
en_web: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
en_kjv: always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
tcz_gospelgo: Katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina dingin katahsauva hin Jesu thin achu kapole jingui.

tcz: Henge, keiho hin Yeshua na katoh jaluvin thina thei dinmun chan geiyin kaum uve, hitia chu katah sauva thina chun Yeshua a hinna chu phot chenna aumna ding ahi.
en_web: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
en_kjv: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Thitheina katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina din, kahin vangun Jesu jel’in athi dingin eikipedoh jinguve.

tcz: Hitia keihon thina kimaitopi dia hinkho kamanu hi nangho dinga tonsot hinna asodohna ding katiu ahi.
en_web: So then death works in us, but life in you.
en_kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu keiho sunga thinan na atoh jinga, nang ho sunga hinna um’ah ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keihon tuni geiya thu kasei phongu hi tahsanna Lasunpan ana phondohsa, “Keiman Pathen katahsanin, hiti chun thu kaseiye,” ati tobang kaneiyu ahi.
en_web: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
en_kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabun, “Katahsan jeh a thu kasei ahi,” ati bang chun, keihon jong tahsanna Lhagao chu kaneiyuva, hijeh a chu keihon katahsan’uva thu kaseiyu ahi;

tcz: Eiho Pathen, Pakai Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chun eiho jong Ama toh chule Amaa dinga nangho toh eikaithou dingu ahi ti iheuve.
en_web: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.
en_kjv: knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pakai Jesu kaithoupa chun Keiho jong Jesu to eikaithou thauva nang ho to eihin dinkhomsah diu kaheuve.

tcz: Hichengho jouse hi nangho phatchomna ding ahi. Chule Pathen lungsetna mitampi chunga alhuncheh cheh tobanga hi thangvahna loupi tah, chule Pathen chu loupina chang cheh cheh ding ahi.
en_web: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
en_kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungsetna ahapunbe cheh a mihon Pathen loupina athangvahbe chehna diuva ijakai aboncha nang ho jal’a ahisoh keiye.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiho kalhadah hihhel uve. Katahsau hin thina lam chu hinnai jeng jongleh, kalhagaovu hi anitinin ahalcheh cheh in ahi.
en_web: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
en_kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun kalung lhapouve, kamihem tahsau po nung hi akem jing vangin, kasung lam’u hi ani nin athah cheh cheh jeng’e.

tcz: Ajehchu tupet kagim nauhi neocha bou ahin chule sotpi umbe talou ding ahi. Hinla hicheho hin keiho dinga loupina gamchenga phajo le sotjo ahinso doh sah ding ahi.
en_web: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
en_kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche jangkhai cha phat chom khat kathoh gim nai hin hachunga chungnungjoa tonsot’a ding loupina eisemdoh peh diu ahi;

tcz: Hiti chu ahin, keihon hahsatna hi tupet'a kavet theiyu ahi vang'in, kave pouve; chusangin keihon mit'a kimu theilou lamjoh chu kagaldot'u ahi. Ajeh chu tua kimu thei ho hi chomkah a hung mang ding ahitai, hinla eihon imutheilou hou hi tonsot geiya um ding ahi.
en_web: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
en_kjv: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu mithei thil kakat pouvin muthei lou thiljoh kakatjo’uve; ijeh-inem itile muthei thil chu phat chom khat’a ding ahin, muthei lou thil chu tonsot’a ding ahiye.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon kaheuve, hiche leiset ponbuh a kachenu hi kiphelha jongleh (hichu ithiuva, hiche leitahsa hi idalhah tenguleh), eiho dinga tonsot tahsapum Pathen Amatah in eisempeh u, mihem khut'in asem hilou, van'a in inei dingu chu kaheuve.
en_web: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
en_kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, a house not made with hand, eternal in the heavens.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu hiche ponin tobang kaleiset in’u hikiphe lha jongle khut’a sah lou Pathen’a kon tonsot in van’a kaneiyu kahenauve.

tcz: Tupet itahsauva hin ithachol jiuvin, chule vonthah kivon ding tobang'in vanvou chu ingaicha uvin ahi.
en_web: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
en_kjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ponin sunga kap le penga ka-umu hi khut’a sah lou van in’a chen kal ngah lel kahiuve;

tcz: Ajehchu eihon vanvou tipum chu inei dingu ahin, tahsa pum neilou lhagao ho tobang ihi lou dingu ahi.
en_web: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
en_kjv: if so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
tcz_gospelgo: hichea chu kachen tengu le sagoh keova eiki-imsah lou diu ahitai.

tcz: Hiche leiset tahsa puma ihin sung uva hin eiho ikap-un chule imaovun ahi, hichu eiho thi noma chule tua itahsau hi abei ding ngahlel ihipouve. Chusanga eihon itahsau athah chu kivon noma, hiche thithei tahsa hi hinnan avallhum ding chu ngaicha joa ihiuve.
en_web: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
en_kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche ponin a kachen laiyuva hi pohgih hahsa pao kap a peng kahiuvin, hichu katahsan in hi paidoh jeng ding deina ahipon, van in’a chenjoh a hin nan thina aval lhum ding deina ahijoi.

tcz: Pathen Amatah in hiche hi eiho dinga agon ahin, chule hiche photchetna a chu a Lhagao Theng eipeh u ahi.
en_web: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
en_kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche dinga chu Pathenin eigontoh-uva khamgahna Lhagao geiya eipeh-u ahiye.

tcz: Hiti chun keiho hiche tahsa a kahinlai sung uva hi Pakai to in'a umkhom'a kahi pouve ti kahetnau hi kisonpi khopset theiya hetna nei kahiu ahi.
en_web: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
en_kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu lung ngam’a um kahiuvin, chule hiche tahsaa kachen laiseuva hi Pakaiya kon’a gamla tah a kihindal kahi kaheuve.

tcz: Ajehchu keiho tahsan jal'a hinga kahiuvin chule hichu mit'a muthoa kon ahipoi.
en_web: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
en_kjv: (for we walk by faith, not by sight:)
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu tahsan’a khosa kahiuvin, mitvet maiya kahipouvin ahi.

tcz: Ahi, keiho alhing keiya kisonna nei kahiuvin, chule keiho leilam tahsaphe a kona hi kikangse ding kahiuve, chutah le bou keiho Pakai to umkhom ding kahi tauve.
en_web: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
en_kjv: we are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalung ngamlo nau chu hiche tahsa in’a kachenu hi dalhaa Pakai in’a chen ding gam chenga deijo kahi tauve.

tcz: Hitia hi keiho hiche tahsaphepun umuving ting, ahilouleh hiche tahsa a konin chom umu jong leng, kalunggonu chu Ama lunglhaina ding hola kahiuve.
en_web: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
en_kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hikom in’a cheng ung, chukom in’a chensa jong leuveng Ama lung lhaisah dingbou katuppi pen’u ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eiho jouse hi Christa masanga thutanna'a ding cheh ding ihiuve. Eimaho khat cheh hin hiche leiset itahsauva, thilpha hihen thilse hijongleh iboldoh dungjui uva ikisan cheh dingu ahi.
