en_web: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
en_kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mitinin tahsaa athilbol pha le se tohman akisan chehna dinguva ibonchauva Christa thutanna masanga ikilah cheh diu ahinalaiye.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon Pakaiya kamopohnau hetkhen themna kaneijeh uvin, keihon midang ho thujona teidinga hatah a kiseh a kahiuve. Keiho kitah tah'a tonggima ka hiu Pathen in ahen chule nanghon jong nahet'u kakinemun ahi. Pathen toh kicham'un
en_web: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
en_kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai ginje kahetjeh-uva miho katemu’va thunun kagot’u ahin, Pathen dia vang hetsa kahiuvin, chule nang hon nalunggil’uva neihet diu kakinem’e.

tcz: Keiho le keiho kiseipha kit a neingaitou ham? Ahipoi, keihon nangho neikisonpina dinguva ajeh kapeh ahin, hichu nanghon lunggila kona lhachana tonglouva mi mutheibep dinga lhachana tongho nadonbut theina dingu ahi.
en_web: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
en_kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that you may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva hung kiseipha ki tkahipouve, mihem lungthim lam velouva maivet’a ki song ho chu nadeh jouna diuva kei ho neikisonpi theina diuva phat kapehjoh-u nahiuve.

tcz: Keiho hi ngolmana tomngaina neiya neigeluva ahileh, hichu Pathen loupina ding ahi. Chule keiho hi achingtah a neigeluva ahileh, hichu nangho phatchomna ding ahiye.
en_web: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
en_kjv: For whether we be besides ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kangol’ule Pathen ding ahin, kachihule nang ho ding ahi.

tcz: Ahoichu hitaleh, Christa ngailutna chun eithunun u ahitai. Eihon Christa chu mijouse dinga thia ahitai ti itahsan uva ahileh, eima ho jong imilui uva chu thia ihitauve.
en_web: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
en_kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa ngailutnan eituh khom jeng jeh-uva japi khel’a khat athitah jeh a, japi thisoh dol’a ki-ngaito ahin,

tcz: Ama mitin dinga thia ahitah jeh a chu Ama a hinna kisan ho chu amaho dinga hingjom talou ding ahitauve. Chusanga, amaho chu adinguva thia chule thoukitpa Christa ding joh a chu hing ding ahitauve.
en_web: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
en_kjv: and that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh a chu ahing ho chu amahoding mai maiya hing hilouva, amaho dia thia thoudoh kitpa dinga chu ahin theina diuva amaho khel’a Ama chu thia ahitai.

tcz: Hitiahi keihon midangho chungchang thua mihem lunggela donsuhtoa thuseina kabol tapouve. Phatkhat chu keihon Christa chu mihem lunggel ngaiton kana ngaito uvin ahi. Tunvang keihon kageluhi ajatchom behtai.
en_web: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
en_kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun tukal’a lhah koima tahsa dol’in kahetapouve; Christa jong tahsa dol’a kanahet nau um jongle tukal’in vang chutin hetapou vinge.

tcz: Hiche hin Christian hunghi jouse chu mithah ahitauve tina ahi. Amaho chu abepbep hitalou ahitai, ajeh chu hinkho lui chu chemang ahitai. Hinkho thah kipan ahitai!
en_web: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
en_kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are past away; behold, all things are become new.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu koi hi le Christa to hingkhom chu thilsem thah soh ahitan, atil’a kisem masa chengse kitolmang ahitai, ven thil thah asohtai.

tcz: Chule hicheho jouse hi Christa jal'a Ama koma eilepuikit'u ahitah jeh in Pathena kona thilpeh ahije. Chule Pathen in miho chu Amatoh kichamna dinga ngansena eipeh u ahi.
en_web: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
en_kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ijakai hi Christa jal’a keiho le ama kihouchamna boldoh a, chule hiche kihouchamna dinga lhacha kin eibolsah-uva, Pathena hungkon jeng ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi Christa a uma, miho chonsetna chu amaho dounaa simta louva, vannoi hi Amatoh kichamna asem ahitai. Chule aman hiche kichamkitna thuhi ahin pohlut ahitai.
en_web: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
en_kjv: to wit, that God was in Christ reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin Christa hinkho sunga chu vannoi le ama kihoutohna asem’a, asuh khelna chengseu asimpeh daa, chule hiche kihouchamna thu chu keiho sunga eikhumpeh-u ahi.

tcz: Keiho Christa Palai kahiuve, chule Pathen in nangho henga thusei dinga keiho eimanchah u ahi. Keihon nangho, Christa amatah in angeh banga kangeh nahiuve, “Pathen toh kicham'un.”
en_web: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
en_kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu keiho Christa dinga palai kahiuvin, Pathenin eimanchah-uva a-ngeh ahin, keihon Christa jal’a kathum nahiuve, pathen to kicham’un.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa, achonse khaloubeh chu, eiho lhatdoh dinga akatdoh ahi, chutia chu eiho Pathen toh Christa jal'a suhdih'a iumna diu ahi.
en_web: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
en_kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset helouhelpa chu, Ama hinkhoa Pathen dihna ichan theina diuvin eiho khel’in, Pathenin chonsen asemtai.

tcz: Pathen to tongkhom kahi jal'un, hiche Pathen milungset them ahina thilpeh kidang tah nakisan uhi, imacha louva nakoi louna dinguva kangeh nahiuve.
en_web: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
en_kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Amato tongkhom kahijeh-uva Pathen lungsetna namu’ chu mohseh nahisah louna diuva katem nahiuve;

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in, “Aphat chan keiman nataona kasange. Huhhingna nikhoa chu, keiman kapanhu nahitai. Ahimongin ‘phat kijenpet’ chu tuhi ahi. Tuni hi Huhhingna nikho ahi,” ati.
en_web: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
en_kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pathen lekha bun: “Lah phat chan nataona kasangin, Huhhing nikhon nangma kahui,” ati. Ven tu hi lah phat mong ahin, ven tu hi huhhing nikho ati.

tcz: Keiho hinkho kiman chah hi koima kipalsah lou tei ding katiu ahi, chule kalhacha natoh uhi koiman ei-oimolou teina dingu kagel'un ahi.
en_web: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
en_kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhacha kinbolna hi nolnabei ahina dinga koima masanga kipal lhuhna dingkikoi lou ahi.

tcz: Thil kabol chanu hi, Pathen lhacha tahbeh kahiuve ti katahlah u ahi. Keihon boinaho le hahsatna ho chule settona ho tintang thohhat tah in kathoh uvin ahi.
en_web: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
en_kjv: but in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Pathen lhacha kinbol kahinauva keiho le keiho ijakaiya kipah chaa, lung dehat tah a hesoh genthei jou se le thoh hahsa, tosetna tin cheng,

tcz: Keiho hi eikivo uvin, songkul'a eikikhum uvin, mihonpi lunghang kimaitopia kahiuvin, tha ngoilhah geiya tonggima kahiuvin, jan ihmut theilou, chule anne louva um thoh'a kahiuve.
en_web: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
en_kjv: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
tcz_gospelgo: eikivohna jouseu, songkul lutna ho gei, japi eikitilset pehna jouseu hi le, choldo lou, ihmu lou le nelou chalou kahiuvin;

tcz: Keima ho tah kahina uva thenna nei, hetkhen themna nei, thohhatna nei, lungsetna nei, kasung uva Lhagao Theng chenga ahin, chule ngailutna dihtah neiya khosa jinga kahiuve.
en_web: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
en_kjv: by pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
tcz_gospelgo: lung thengsel le hetna, thoh hatna, khotona, Lhagao Theng vangin ngailutna giltah-in kaneiyun,

tcz: Keihon thutah chu tahsan umtah'a seiphonga kahiuve. Pathen thahatna chun keihoa na atongin ahi. Keihon chonphatna galvon chu ka khut jetlam uvah melma nonan kamanguvin, chule kaveilam uvah kihon nan kaneiyun ahi.
en_web: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
en_kjv: by the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
tcz_gospelgo: thudih le pethen tha hat’in kapngun, dihna galvonin kamangun, jel le vei kahongui;

tcz: Keiho hi mihon eijabolu henlang ahilouleh imacha hilouvin eibolu jongleh, amaho chun eiseiseu henlang ahilouleh eipahchau jongleh Pathen natonga kahiuve. Keiho kitahna nei kahiuvin, hinla mihon kitahna nei louvin eingai touve.
en_web: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
en_kjv: by honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
tcz_gospelgo: jabolna hihen jumso na hijongle, seiphatna ahiya seisetna ahiya, thudih kaseiyu jongle jouseiyin eiki bol’uve;

tcz: Keiho hi mihet tah kahi vangun, koiman eihepha pouve. Keiho hi thina toh kinai chan kaum uvin, hinlah tugeiyin kahinguve. Keiho hi eikivo uvin, hinla eithat doh deh pouve.
en_web: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
en_kjv: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
tcz_gospelgo: suhmilsa kabah vangun kihedoh thouvui; athisa kabah vangun, ven kahing jinguve; eikibolgeh lheh kabangun, eikithat paipouve;

tcz: Kalungu anajin, hinla keiho kakipah jinguve. Vaicha tah kahiuvin, hinla keihon midang lhagaova kahaosah uve. Imacha kaneiden'u aumpon, hinla ijakai kaneiyun ahi.
en_web: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
en_kjv: as sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
tcz_gospelgo: lunghem tah eikibahsah vangun kakipah jingui; vaicha lheh kabangun ahila mi tamtah kahaosah tauve;imacha neilou kabanguvin ahinla ijakai kanei kimsoh nauve.

tcz: Vo, deitah Corinth mite keihon kitah tah in nangho kabolun, chule kalungu nangho henga akihongin ahi.
en_web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
en_kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Corinth mite kalungthimu lentah a kihonga, nahenguva kambem bema thu kaseiyu ahi.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailut nau akiphasam pon, hinla nang hon keiho chunga ngailutna neipe pouve.
en_web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
en_kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasunguva lungnoh phahna ima kibol lou ahin, nang ho kilhaset sum’a kisunoh phah lou nahiuve.

tcz: Nangho hi kacha tahbeh banga kagel'a nei lethuh diuva kangeh nahiuve. Nalungu keiho dingin hong uvin!
en_web: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
en_kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate henga thusei banga kasei ahi, keiho bol lethuh nan nalungu hong len’uvin.

tcz: Atahsan lou ho toh pangkhom hih un. Itidan'a chonphatna chun gitlouna to chan aneikhom thei ding ham? Itidan'a muthim chu khovah to umkhom thei ding ham?
en_web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
en_kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan lou ho to namkoljon khat pokhom hih-un, ajeh chu adih le dan dih lou ipia kikop theiya, o-le khovah-in muthim to ipi aneikhom beh am?

tcz: Christa le Diabol chun iti kitona anei thei lhon ding ham? Atahsan lou khat le atahsan khat chun iti chan anei khom thei ding ham?
en_web: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
en_kjv: and what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
tcz_gospelgo: Christa le thilha ipia kihou theiya, 0-le atahsan le atahsan lou ipi chan kihom theibeh am?

tcz: Pathen hou-in le milim ho houna in akilungtona ipi umem? Ajeh chu eiho Pathen hing hou-in ihiuve. Pathen in aseibang chun, “Keima amaho sunga kachena chule alah uva kavale ding ahi. Keima amaho Pathen kahiding, chule amaho kamite hiding ahi.”
en_web: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
en_kjv: and what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Houin le doilim sem thu ipia kihoutoh theiyem? Ijeh-inem itile eiho Pathen hing Houin ihiuve. Ajeh chu Pathenin hitin aseiyin: “Keima alah-uva kachen’a ka lhat le ding, A-Pathenu kahiya, amaho kamite hidiu ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun, “Tahsan louho lah a kon chun hung potdoh'un, chule amahoa konin kikang seuvin, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Amaho thilthenglou chu tongkha hih un, chutileh keiman nangho kalem dingu ahi.”
en_web: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
en_kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun miho lah a konin hung potdoh-un, Amaho chu dalhauvin,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Thilboh chu tongkha hih-uvin, Keiman kalamto ding nahiuve.

tcz: “Chule keima na Pa-u kahiding, chule nangho kachate nahi dingu ahi,” tin Pakai Hatchungnung in aseiye.
en_web: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
en_kjv: and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima na-Pau hing ting, Nang ho kachate nahi diu ahi,” tin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye.

tcz: Hicheng thutep ho ichan jeh uvin, sopite ho, itahsau ahilouleh ilhagaovu suboh thei hoa kon chun ipipi lamah hijongleh eimaho kisuthengu hite. Chule eihon Pathen iginjeh uvin thenna chamkim lama kihabolu hite.
en_web: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
en_kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaitahte, thutep hicheng hi ineijeh-un tahsa le Lhagao suboh thei jousea konin kisuthengu hitin, Pathen ging’a then chamkimsoh a hin ding ngaitou hite.

tcz: Nangho keiho dingin lung kihongin umun. Keihon koima alamlouvin kabol khapouvin, koima kapuikhel nau jong aumpoi, koima cha jong kaphat chomna diuvin kamang chapouve.
en_web: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
en_kjv: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalung neihonpeh-un, koima adih louvin kabol pouvin, koima kasuse pouvin, koima kichungtoh lapnan kabol pouve.

tcz: Hiche hi nangho themmo chansahna a kasei ahipoi. Masanga kaseipeh banguvin nangho hi kalung uva kagel khoh uvin, chule nangho to hintha a chule thitha ding kahiuve.
en_web: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
en_kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die and live with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho mosona dinga kasei ahipoi, ithiu le thisap ding ihin’ule hingsap dia kalunga kavop jingo thu kasei ahitai.

tcz: Keiman nangho kisonpina lenpen kaneiyun, chule keiman nangho kakithang-at pilheh jeng uvin ahi. Nanghon neiha tilkhou lheh uvin, chule kahahsat nau jouse a jong nanghon nei kipasah uvin ahi.
en_web: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
en_kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva ngamtah tah a kasei ahin, kisonpitah tah ajong avumval’in kakipah lheh jeng’e.

tcz: Keiho Macedonia kaga lhun uchun lunga kicholdo theina kanei pouve. Hoimalam jouse lung kichiahna katoh un, polama kidouna ho aum toh, lungsunga kichatna kaneiyuve.
en_web: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
en_kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
tcz_gospelgo: Macedonia kahungu chun tahsaa choldona neilou kahiuvin, muntin, a gentheina jeng ahin, polama mito kinahna jeng lung sunga kichatna jeng ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in alunglha ho atilkhouvin, Titus hunglhun hin eitilkhou tauve.
en_web: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
en_kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin lung lhadaisa ho tilkhou kit thei Pathenin titus hung lhun chu tilkhou nan eineiyui.

tcz: Ama hunglhun hin eikipasah uvin, adehset'in nanghoa kona tilkhouna thu aman ahinmu chun keiho eitilkhou lheh jeng uvin ahi. Nang hon neimu nom lheh u thudol aseiya chule thilsoh jeh a nalung khamnau, chule keima dinga na kiphaltheng nau thu kajah chun, kipanan kadimset jenge!
en_web: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
en_kjv: and not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahung mai mai jeh hilouva, nang hoa kona lungmon thu ahin lhut, itobanga neimu nom’uva, neigimpi dol’u chule neihuh nom dol thuu aseijeh ahiye. Hiti chun eikihapasah cheh jeng’e.

tcz: Chutobang thuhahsa lekhathot kahin thot chu, apet'a kakiphatlamna khat aum vang'in, nangho dinga phat chomkhat anat lheh ding vang chun, kiphatlam na kaneipoi.
en_web: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
en_kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
tcz_gospelgo: Lekha kahin thot chun nalunghemsah jengu jongle kakisih dehpoi; hiche lekha thot chun phat chom khat’a ding hijongle nalunghemsahu kahetdoh a chu nommo kasha ding sol ahitan,

tcz: Kahin thot chu tun kalung akipahtai, nangho kalung nopmosah u chu hijo louvin, nalung nat'u chun nakisih sah uvin, chule na hinkho man danu nakhel theiyun ahi. Hichu Pathen in amiten anei ding uva adei ahi, hitia chu nangho keihon nasetna dingu imacha kabolnau aumpoi.
en_web: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
en_kjv: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: tun vang kakipah tai; amavang nalunghemu kakipapi ahipon, nalunghemu chun lungheina asosah jeh ahi; Pethen deilama lunghemna chu natoh-u ahitan, kei ho jeh a manthahna ima naneipouve.

tcz: Ajehchu lungkhamna Pathen in eideipeh u chun chonset'a kona eipuidoh uva hichun huhhingna asodoh ahi. Hitobang lungkhamna chun kisihna asodohpoi. Hinla vannoi lungkham nan kisihna asodoh joulou ahin, hichun lhagao thina asodoh sah ahiye.
en_web: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
en_kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen deiya lunghem chun lungheina asojin huhhinga nasodoh jin ahi; leiset thudol’a lung gim nan vang thina asodohji ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche Pathen ngaisahna lungkhamna in na hinkhoa ipi asodoh vetemin! Hitobang tah lunggutna, hibangtah a lungthenna nanei nau, hitobang tah a lunghimona, hitobang loma kihonna, hitobang loma nei munom tennau, hitobangtah a na gutchu pottho nau, hitobang tah a adihlou gimbolna. Nangho tah in thil ijakai adih bol angaina thudol nei hung vetsah tauve.
en_web: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
en_kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen deiya lunghem nan itobang tah a nachunguva na atoh ham ven, lunghanna, kichatna, nagichatna, tom ngaina, thu adih lama kitan ding deina asosah tai. Hiche thu dol’a chun themmonabei nahiu akichetsahtan ahi.

tcz: Keiman chuche pet'a lekha kajih lona ajeh chu, adihlou bola chu koi hiya ahiloule koiham adihlou bola ngoh ding chu tithua hola kahipoi. Keiman nahenguva Pathen mitmua kahin jih lona ajeh chu nang hon keiho dinga ichan geiya kiphalna naneiyu hitam ti naki mudoh theina dingu ahi bouve.
en_web: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
en_kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun lekha chu kahin thot jeng vangun, adih lou bolpa le adih bolpa jeh a kahin thot ahipoi, Pathen maiya keiho dinga itobang gunchu nahiu phondohna dingjoh kati ahibouve.

tcz: Keiho tah hiche hin eitilkhou nau chu, Titus nana lamto nauva amaa kipana chu nang hon ama nabon chauva nanalem uva chule nalung olsah nau chu, keiho kipa thanopna dehset ahiye.
en_web: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
en_kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu eikitilkhou chom’uva ahi. Keiho cheng kitilkhouna chungvuma Titus lhagao nakidosah jehuva akipa jeh chun keiho jong kakipah chom lheh jenguvin ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangho hi ichan geiya ka kiletsah piu chule nei lunglhah sahlouvu thudol kaseipehsa ahitai. Keiman nangho thutahbeh kaseipeh jing nahiuvin chule tua hi Titus henga kakisonna thu kaseijong adih monge ti photchet ahitai.
en_web: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
en_kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama koma chu nang ho kakisonpiuva ahile nang hon neijumso dauvin, ajeh chu nahenguva thutah jeng kaseiyu ahin, hiche Titus henga kakison nau chu atahje kiphonchen ahitai.

tcz: Tuhin aman nangho atila sangin naha gelkhoh cheh tauvin ahi ajeh chu nang hon ama gin le ja umtah puma nabon chauva nalem uva asei nangai jalu ahi.
en_web: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
en_kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.
tcz_gospelgo: Itobangtah a thua nung dia kigosadema um nahiule kithing thinga gingkhen cha ama nalamtou ageldoh chanin nakhoto nau akhang khang jeng’e.

tcz: Keiman nangho tahsanna bulhingset'a kanei nahi jeh uva tua hi kipah tah a uma kahitai.
en_web: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
en_kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunguva ijakaiya kakisonpi thei jeh-uvin kakipah lheh jengin ahi.

tcz: Tua hi kasopi deitahte, Macedonia gamkaiya houbung ho Pathen in akhohsah a, amanchah a na atohho thudol nahet ding uva kadeipeh nahiuve.
en_web: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
en_kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Mecedonia Houbung ho kipe Pathen lungsetna hi nahet diu kadeiye;

tcz: Amaho hin hahsat na tintang'ah patepna atoh un, chule amaho avaicha lheh jenguvin ahi. Hinla amaho hi kipana chamkimin akipah uvin, hongphalna lama ahaonau chu along letlha jeng tauve.
en_web: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
en_kjv: how that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu gim genthei nasatah thoh a patepna atokhah vangun hitobang lah a hin akipanau achung chonjo nalaiyin, avaichat lheh vangun teptena val’in hongphal tah-in thil apejengui.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman kahettohsah chu amaho hin apeh diuva kilom khamset chu apehdoh u hita louvin, chusangin akalvalin apeuvin ahi. Chule hichu amaho lung chamtah a abolu ahi.
en_web: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
en_kjv: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
tcz_gospelgo: Hetoh a kasei ahi athauvin ajochan, akalval geiyin jong apeuvin, achamtah-uvin

tcz: Amaho hin avel vel in Jerusalem khopi sunga tahsanho thilpeh pehding thua eingeh jomun ahi.
en_web: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
en_kjv: praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
tcz_gospelgo: mithengte dia lungsetna lhacha kinbolnaa chu pankhah tei deinan kahenguva a-ngeh-uve.

tcz: Keihon ka ginchat kalvalun amahon aboluve, ajeh chu amaho chondan hi-amasa tahin Pakaiyah akipedoh uvin, chujouvin Pathen in amaho bol dinga adei tobang'in keiho eipeuvin ahi.
en_web: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
en_kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kaginchat kalval’u ahitan, amasan amaho tah Pakaiya akiphaldohuvin, chuin Pathen di bangin keiho henga akipedoh jengui.

tcz: Hiti chun keihon Titus, na thilpeh masat uva natilkhou uva panga anahin, ama chu naheng uva ahung kilekit'a chule hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh hi bulhit dinga kanganseu chu ahi.
en_web: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
en_kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche lungsetna kin anabol pansa Titus chun nang ho lah ajong abol molsoh dinga katilkhou jingo ahi.

tcz: Nangho atamjoa–tahsannaa, thusei themna lama, hetna lama, gutchuna lama, chule keihoa kona ngailutna-hicheng hoa lolhinna nei nahiuto lhon'a thilpeh lama jong lungset neiya na lolhin dingu kati ahi.
en_web: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
en_kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon katildoh-uva ijakaiya nahaodoh-uva tahsan, thusei, hetna lengailutna tilkhouna tin chenga nabulhin banguvin, hiche lungset thilpeh a jong hin bulhingsoh-uvin.

tcz: Keiman nanghon hiche hi bolteiyun tia kaseina ahideh poi, houbung dangho abol dinga athanop lheh jeng vang uva, hiche hi nangailut nau atahbeh ahidan photchenna lampi khat ahi.
en_web: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
en_kjv: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
tcz_gospelgo: Chondan dungjuiya kasei ahipoi, na-ngailut nau atahbeh ahidol kholdoh teina di amidnag ho mi kithopinaa athanop dol’u kasei ahibouve.

tcz: Nanghon I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa lungsetna a hongphal tah ahi chu nahe tauve. Ama ahao jeng vanga nangho jal'a vaicha hung kisoh a ahitai, hitia chu Ama vaichat jal'a chu Aman nangho nahaosah theina dingu ahiye.
en_web: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
en_kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lungstna chu naheuve; haotah ahin, avaichatna chu nang hon nahaolo nadiuvin nang hojal’in amatah vai chan ahung umdoh tai.

tcz: Hichea kathumop nau chu: Nanghon kum khat masanga nanapatsau chu jotei ding gong'un, ajeh chu nangho tah hiche pehdohna lama lunggel hin nei masapen nahiuvin chule apandoh masapen nana hiuve.
en_web: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
en_kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thua hin kagel seipehung’e: ningkum chun nang ho mi kithopi nom le akithopi masapen nahiuve.

tcz: Thanom tah a nana patdoh u natoh chu tua hi nasuh bulhit diu ahi. Nanei dung juiyun napeh thei chan peuvin.
en_web: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
en_kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which you have.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua hi natoh patsau chu nachaisoh ngal diu ahi. Nang ho mi kithopi tha nom nahiuvin, hijeh chun nathauvin ajochanin bulhitsoh jenguvin.

tcz: Naphaldoh u chu pehnomna lungthim neiya nahi pouleh santhei tah hiding ahi. Chule nanei dung juiyun, nanei louvu chu pego louvin, nanei khamun peuvin.
en_web: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
en_kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem khat’in kithopina thilpeh apeh nomten le Pathenin apeh ding jet mong teptena aneipon, apeh ding jat bep chu asanpeh ahibouve.

tcz: Ahimongin, na thilpeh u chun midang hinkho nom amansah a, nangho tah na hahsat dingu chu kasei ahipoi. Akitoh akilom hiding kaseina ahi.
en_web: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
en_kjv: For I mean not that other men be eased, and you burdened:
tcz_gospelgo: Midang ho pohgih ngai janga nang ho pohgih punsah dingngaito kahipoi. Chamgol’a tetph chet ding ahijoi.

tcz: Tua hi nangho naning lhinu ahin, chule panpi ngaiho napanpi theiyu ahi. Khonung teng, amaho aninglhin uva chule nanghon na ngaichat uva ahileh napanhu theiju ahi. Hitia hi, thil ho hi kibanga um thei ahi.
en_web: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
en_kjv: but by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
tcz_gospelgo: Tulai nang ho neival chu amaho lhahsam hunan kimangle nang ho nalhahsam tengu amaho neival’a kidit thei ding, hitia chu chamgaol’a kisutoh dingahi.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei, “Tamtah lakhom hoa aval aumdoh dehpon, chule themcha bou lakhomho chun aphaset aneiyuve,” ati.
en_web: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
en_kjv: as it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabun: “Atam kilopan jong aval’in akilah dehpon, Lhomcha kilodoh pan jong lhasam chomin akilah dehpoi,” ati bang chu hi ding ahi.

tcz: Ahin Pathen thangvah un! Keiman nangho chunga thanopna kanei tobang'in Titus jong thanopna apen ahi.
en_web: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
en_kjv: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Titus lungthim sunga nang ho khoto theina tilkhouna chutobang khumpeh Pathen chu thangvah-in um hen!

tcz: Titus hin kangeh nau hi anasangin nangho navil kit uvin ahi. Ahimonga, amahin chenomna neiya nahung munomu ahi.
en_web: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
en_kjv: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva hung dinga ka-ngeh-u le nom’a ahitan, hiche jong hi achamtah a nahenguva hung dia kigosademsa anahitai.

tcz: Keihon sopi dang khat jong Titus to kahin solthauvin ahi. Amahi Kipana Thupha seiphonga pang ahina a houbung ho jousen aseiphat'u ahi.
en_web: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
en_kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung tin’a Kipana Thupha asei phong jeh a minthangtah sopi khat jong titus ti kahinsol thauve.

tcz: Amahi houbung hon Jerusalema dinga sum kitoh khom ho podinga anganseu ahi-hiche kipedoh hi Pakai loupina kipehna chule ipanhu nomnau vetsahna ahi.
en_web: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
en_kjv: and not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
tcz_gospelgo: Chutijeng goh ahipon, Pakai ama tah loupina dinga hiche thilpeh lakhom ding le keihon jong kakithopi nom’u vetsahna ding monga kalhonpi le diuva Houbung hon alhendohdau ahiye.

tcz: Hiche hongphal tah a thilpeh kipedoh chung chang thua kiginmona tapou chu vesui dinga kholjin khom kahiuve, ajeh chu koiman kathilbol nauva mo eichan louna diuva gelkhohna nei kahiuve.
en_web: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
en_kjv: avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
tcz_gospelgo: Hongphal tah a kitohdoh hiche thilpeh kabol lenauva hi koiman eidem louna diuva chingthei tah a thilbol kahiuve.

tcz: Keiho hi Pakai angsunga jathei tah a umding gelkhoh a kahiuvin, chule midang koi koi hijongleh jathei kahiu hi amudoh dingu jong kadeiyu ahi.
en_web: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
en_kjv: providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilpha bol katup’u hi Pakai mitmu maiya hilouva mihem mitmua jong ahi.

tcz: Keihon isopihou lah a khat mun tamtah'a phatna tamtah nei, agutchuna kaphottohsau hi amaho toh kahinsol thauve. Nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong amahi thanomjo cheh ahi.
en_web: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
en_kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon mun tamtah a aguncheje kaphottohsau isopiu khat jong amani to kahinsol thauve, nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong kitlkhoujah jeng’ah ahitai.

tcz: Titus thudol donga aum khat touva ahileh amahi nangho kithopina dinga keitoh tongkhoma ahi tin seiyun. Chule sopite ho houbung hon amatoh ahinsol thau ahin, amaho hin Christa jabolna ahinlhutna dingu ahi.
en_web: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
en_kjv: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellow-helper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Titus vang hi nang ho dinga kapankhompi le katoh khompi ahin, isopite niu hi Houbung ho solchah, Christa loupina ahilhon’e.

tcz: Hiti hin amaho hi nangailut nau ana vetsah un, chule houbung ho jouse henga nangho kakisonpiu hi photchetna ana peuvin.
en_web: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
en_kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hokakisonpiu adih dol Houbungho maiya phot chet ahina din amani hi na-ngailut nau kichentah-in chansah-uvin.

tcz: Keiman Jerusalema atahsan ho dinga thilpeh a lhacha natoh thudol'a kahin jih ding chu angaikhoh e tin kagelpoi.
en_web: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
en_kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
tcz_gospelgo: Mithengte kinbol thudol vang hinahenguva lekha hinsut ding valjo din bon kagel’e.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman nanghon nakithopinom ten'u ahiti kahei, chule nangho Greece gamkaiya um hohin kum khat masanga kithopina naneinom uva nahin thot kigot'u anahi thudol chu Macedonia houbung ho henga kithang attah a ana seilea kanahi tai. Atahbeh in, nanghoa thanopna um chun Macedonia a um atahsanho mitampin ahin pehpat nauva atilkhou uva panga nahiuve.
en_web: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
en_kjv: for I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mi nakithopi nomjeu kahenai; hijeh a chu kisongtah a Macedonia mite henga jong ningkum’a apat nang ho Achaia miten thil ijakai gonsadema nakoiyu thu kasiepeh ahi. Natom nagi vauvin amaho geiya atildoh ahiye.

tcz: Hinlah keiman hiche sopite ho hi nakigot mongu ahi photchetna a amaho kaseipeh a kahinsol ahi, chule nasumu chu khopkhom sohkei hiding ahi. Keiman nangho kakisonpi nauva mo eikichan ding chu kanompoi.
en_web: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
en_kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
tcz_gospelgo: Nachunguva kakison nau chu thu hom keo ahilouna dinga sopi cheng hi kahinsol ahi; kasei jing bangin nepeh diu gonsademin um’uvin.

tcz: Keima Macedonia a atahsan phabep ho chuto hung uving ting, nangho chungchang thu kaseijo uvin nakigot lou u chu hung mudoh khaleu, nangho nalungu lhailou ding, sei sei ngai talouva keiho kalungu lhai talou ding ahi.
en_web: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
en_kjv: lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Macedonia miho to hung lhonin lang kigo louva na-um’u hung toh kha leu, nang ho jum ding katipon, chubanga kipaopi chu kajachat lo diu ahi.

tcz: Hitia chu keiman sopiho hi keima hung masanga hinsol masah a, na thilpeh dingu chu gotsa nakoiyuva ahina ding kati ahi. Hinla keiman hichu lunga nopna neiya thilpeh ahi ding kadeiyin, phunchel puma peh ahi ding kanompoi.
en_web: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
en_kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu nakitepnau thilpeh chu gonsa koi dinga hiche sopite hi nahenguva hung masa ahiuve; thilpeh ding chu gonsan ana umle lhan lhaisel’a napeh-u kichen ding, cham louva kila hilou ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi geldoh in loubol mi muchi lhomcha tua chun aga lhomcha alokhom ding ahi. Hinla hongphal tah a tua chun ahongphalna tobangma akilokhom ding ahi.
en_web: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
en_kjv: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thua hin alhom tun alhon at ding atam tuna tam at ding ahi.

tcz: Nangma ho cheh in nalunggel uva ijat napeh dingu nakigel lhah u angaiye. Chule pehih beh un ahilouleh seihat vang'in pehih un. “Ajeh chu Pathen in lunglhaisela pe mi chu angailun ahi.”
en_web: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
en_kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisih pum le peh lou khoh man hilouvin mitinin along dei bang cheh a apeh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile lung lhaisel’a pea chu Pathenin angailui.

tcz: Chule Pathen in na ngaichat jouseu hongphal tah a napeh dingu ahi. Chutengleh nanghon na ngaichat chan'u chu nanei dingu chule nanei letset uva aval'a midang nato thei dingu ahi.
en_web: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
en_kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound towards you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
tcz_gospelgo: Imalam joousea ijakaiya bulhingsoh nahiuva, ntoh theina diuva Pathenin lungsetma lhingset, aval hel’a jong napeh theiyu ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Amahon alungcham tah un chule hongphaltah in mi vaichate apeuve. Athilpha bol hou chu a imatih chan a kigeldoh jing ding ahi.”
en_web: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
en_kjv: (as it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Aman atheijal’in vaichate atoi. Ama dihna chu tonsot’a um jing ahi,” ati bangin.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi loubol mi dinga muchi-chivo pea ahin chule neh ding changlhah pea ahi. Hitobangma chun, Aman nathil neisa hou hin punbe sah intin chule nasung uva konin hongphalna lentah sodoh theina tohga nahin sodoh peh nauvinte.
en_web: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
en_kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
tcz_gospelgo: Muchi tupa muchi pea, anne dingpa changlhah pea Pathenin muchi napeuvin tin, akhandohsah ding, anthem chan nau ga chu apunsah ding ahinai.

tcz: Ahi, imalam jousea ninglhingin umun natin, chutengleh nangho aphatseh in hongphal jing tauvin nate. Chule keihon nathilpeh u chu angaichaho koma kalhut tenguleh amahon Pathen athangvah dingu ahi.
en_web: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
en_kjv: being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho jal’a nathipeh chengseu jeh a chu mi tampin Pathen athangvah theina ding le phat tin’a hongphal tah a napeh jingna diuva Pathenin hahaova nahaosah diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh a kona thilpha ni hung sohdoh ding chu-Jerusalema atahsan hon angaichat u kimu uvintin, chule amahon kipah le thanom tah a Pathen thangvahna aphondoh dingu ahi.
en_web: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
en_kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh-inem itile hiche lhacha kinbolna hin minthangte ngaichat atokeo jong ahipon, mi tamtah a kona Pathen thangvahna avum val’a umdoh lo ahitai.

tcz: Nangho lhacha natoh jal'a chu, amahon Pathen loupina apeh thei dingu ahi. Amaho chunga le atahsan ho jouse chunga nahongphal nau hin Christa Kipana Thupha thua nanung uve ti aphotchen ding ahi.
en_web: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
en_kjv: whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lhacha kinboln ale Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha tahsan thua nanun’u to chule ipi hile nanei chasun’u ama ho le midang ho geiya nakihoppi jeng jeh-uvin Pathen achoi-an tauve.

tcz: Chule Pathen in nangho henga lungsetna longletset napehtah jeh uva, lung giltah a gelkhohna neiya nangho dinga hungtao ding ahiuve.
en_web: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
en_kjv: and by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin nachunguva lungsetna nasatah aneijeh chun amahon jong lung gilten’a nataopeh diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche athilpeh hi thu aseidoh dinga kidang behseh ahijeh hin Pathen thangvah in umhen!
en_web: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
en_kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilpeh sei thei louhel jeh hin Pathen thangvah-in um hen!

tcz: Tua hi Paul keiman Christa lungneng tah le nunnem tah ahina jal'a kangeh nahiuve–nang hon keima hi kamihina a mikichase chule gamlatah a lekhathot kajihna a bou lung ngamna nei dan in neigel uvin ahi.
en_web: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
en_kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi keima Paul, kimaitoa kimu teng moh nem nem a, naum lou nauva hakat’a kithangpan, Christa nun nem le khoto na pan’a katem nahiuve.

tcz: Aphai, tua hi katemnau chu keima kahung tengleh keiho hi mihem hina lunggela lung ngama eingaito hou chuto lungngama kaumu ngailou ahina dinga kangeh nahiuve.
en_web: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
en_kjv: but I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsaphe ngaichat kihol le dol’a eiseiho’u henga hakattah a thusei ding dol’a kagel hikahung teng kamanchah louna dinga nahenguva katao tho ahi.

tcz: Keiho mihem kahiuvin, ahivangin mihem galsat in gal kasat pouve.
en_web: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
en_kjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsaphe vou pua vah le vang kahi nauvin, amavang tasaphe dinga galsat kahipouve.

tcz: Keihon Pathen thahat tah gal manchah chu kamanguvin, vannoi galmanchah ho mihem lunggel pansat-na le kinelkalna lhemho chu ahipoi.
en_web: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
en_kjv: (for the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile kagal manchah ho’u hi tahsa gal manchah maimai ahipon Pathen dinga thilbol theitah kulpi suhset theina manchah ahibouve. Jouthua kinelna joouse kadeh lhauvin,

tcz: Keiho hin mihon Pathen ahetdohna ding uvin kiletsahna in adoudal thei jouse kasumang uvin, keihon amahoa dou lungput jouse chu kaman tup un chule Christa thua nung dingin kahil uvin ahi.
en_web: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
en_kjv: casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hetdohna douna dinga insang bang kitouson son ho geiyin kaloi lhu’uvin lung gel ngaito nei jouse gal-hingin kaman’uvin Christa thun kanunsah-uve.

tcz: Chule nang hon sei ngaina lhingset nanei jou uleh, keihon sei ngailou ho chu amichang cheh a gimbolna kapeh dingu ahi.
en_web: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
en_kjv: and having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho thua nanun bulhinset tengule thua nung lou jouse talen pe dinga kidgosadem kahitauve.

tcz: Nang hon gahvet a akilom ding ho naveuvin ahi. Christa a kahi tia kigel ho chun amahon akigelna bang uva keiho Christa a kahiuve ti ahet dingu ahi.
en_web: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
en_kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Maikoh a thlho veuvin. Khattou Christa mia akigel le, amatah chun hiche hi gel kit hen, ama Christa mi ahibangin keiho jong kahiuve.

tcz: Keima hi Pakaiyin thuneina eipeh kalvala kisona neiyin eikigel inte. Hinla ka thunei nau hin nakisahdoh sah u ahin; hichun nasuhlhah diu hilou ahi. Hitia kathuneina keiman ka manchahna a hin jahcha ponge.
en_web: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
en_kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho suhmangna ding hilouva, nang ho sahdohna dinga Pakaiyin eipeh katha nein au hi kisonpi val jep jong leng kakisih deh poi.

tcz: Keiman lekhathot kajih hoa hi nangho kichatsah ding kagot ahipoi.
en_web: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
en_kjv: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
tcz_gospelgo: Lekha thot hoa chun nang ho kichatsah go mai mai hidang’e.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh mi phabep in, “Paul lekhathot hohi thugil tah ahin chule thanei tah ahi, hinla ama hi thalhom ahi chule athusei hojong pannabei ahi bouve,” atiuve.
en_web: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
en_kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
tcz_gospelgo: Khatouvin, “Paul lekha thot ho hi anasa theiyin ahuham theiye, ahungtengle la tahsa kamsel dol, athusei pannabei ahibouve,” tinte.

tcz: Hitobang miho chun keiho tahsa tah a kahung lhun teng uleh keiho gamla tah a lekhathot a thunei tah'a kaseiyu banga khautah a thu katan dingu ahi, ti hi ahet uva pha ahi.
en_web: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
en_kjv: Let such a one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang gelpa chun hiche hi kihet hen: lekha thot ho’a nakibol nau banga chu nalah-uva aki-um teng jongle nakibol diu ahithouve.

tcz: Oh, olmo hih un, keihon nangho koma minasa tah a kiseiho tobanga chu keiho jong kidang tah chu kahiuve tia seina chu kanei pouve! Ahin amaho chu amaho lah a khat le khat kivetkah uva, amaho le amaho hin dan a kitekahna nei ahibouve. Datmo umtah ahiuve!
en_web: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
en_kjv: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves amongst themselves, are not wise.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang mi amachang kichoi sang ho to kibangin kakisei nom hih-un, tejong kakite nagp cha pouve; amaho le amaho akitekah tengule hetna beiya ngol’a ahitauve.

tcz: Keima ho thuneina kallama keihon kisonna neideh pouvinge. Pathen in toh ding kin keiho einganse nau hop sunga bou chu kisonna kanei dingu, hichu nangho toh itohkhom nau chan gei hiya ahi.
en_web: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
en_kjv: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho vang eiteppeh nau gamgi kalval’in kisongpou ving’e, hiche gamgi chu Pathenin eitedoh peh-u ahin, gamgi chun nang ho jong nahop’u ahi.

tcz: Keihon nachung uva thuneina kaneiyuve tia kaseiyuhi akalval a seiyah kahi pouve. Ajeh iham itileh keiho hi Christa Kipana Thupha thudola Corinth khoa ana hung masa pen kahiuve.
en_web: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
en_kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Koima cha hung masanga nahenguva Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha hinpo lu tkeiho kahiuvin, nakithang at piu jong leng gamgi kakhokal ddeh pouvin ahi.

tcz: Midangin apatdohsa natoh chunga kisonga chule hichu keiho natoh ga ahi tia sei kahi pouve. Chusanga, nalah uva kanatoh uhi ahopsung kehletbea aumna dinga natahsan'u akhantou ding kinem a kahiuve.
en_web: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
en_kjv: not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun eikitep nau gamgi kal, midang toh na chunga kithang-at kahipouvin, kagamgi kol sunguva natahsan’u akhan jinga keiho tohna jong akikeh len chehna dinga kinemjo kahibouvui

tcz: Chutengle nangho umna kallam peh'a koima dangin atohlouna muna kacheuva Kipana Thupha chu seiphongna kanei thei dingu ahitai. Chutengleh keiho hi midang gamhop sunga natong ahi tia dohna umlou ding ahitai.
en_web: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
en_kjv: to preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile nang ho kalpeh gamdanga jong Kipana Thupha kaseiphong theiyuva, midang gamsungatohna chunga kithang-at pi louva ka-um jingdiu ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh, Pakai'a bou kisongin,” ati.
en_web: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
en_kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabun, “Koi hile akisonga chu Pakaiya kisong hen,” ati.

tcz: Miho chu amaho kiseipha ahiuva ahileh, ima phatchomna ding aum gunpoi. Pakaiyin amaho chu aseiphat ding chubou akiphamo pen ahi.
en_web: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
en_kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Amale ama kiseipha chu imacha ahipon, Pakai seiphat chubou thu ahi.

tcz: Mingol tobanga kaumna a jong nei hetthem diu kakineme. Henge, nangho tah in nei hethem un.
en_web: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
en_kjv: Would to God you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngol hoi thim jeng jongle neingai them diu kadeiye; amavang nei ngai themsau jong ahinai.

tcz: Keima nangho dia katom ngaina hi Pathen tomngaina jaljeh ahi. Keiman nangho jipa khat, Christa mou theng hidinga kalhendoh nahiuve.
en_web: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
en_kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen tom ngaina pan’a nang ho dia tom ngai kahi, jipa khatseh Christa tokicheng dinga nu-ngah khat banga kitepna kabolpi kaholsa nahitauve.

tcz: Hinlah Gulin lungthim doha pana Eve alheplhah tobang chun Christa lama lung thengsel le lungthim kehlou beh a napan nau chu suhboh in umkhante ti katijat peh nahiuve.
en_web: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
en_kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin gul’in lepthol dohaa Eve lhep lhah bang chun Christa dinga nalungput dih nau lenathen nau chu asuhchat vai ding kati ajai.

tcz: Mi khat touvin, keiho hung seiphong Yeshua hilou achom dang khat thu joh ahung seiya, ahilouleh Lhagao jatchom, nakisan u tobang hilou, ahung seiphonga, ahilouleh natahsan sau sanga jatchom Kipana Thupha ahungsei jongleh akisei tapou namoh tahsan kigot uve.
en_web: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
en_kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khattou hunga keiho seiphong khah lou Jesu chom khat hung seiphong ham, nachan khah ngai louvu lhagao chang ham, ahiloule nasan khah louvu Kipana Thupha kisan ham aum le phaten ngai them’uvin.

tcz: Hinlah chutobang thuhil choi solchah achungnunga kiheho sanga noinung jon keima chang kakigel hih e.
en_web: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
en_kjv: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche solchah chungnung ho sanga noinung deh-in kakigelpoi.

tcz: Keima hi thusei kijil them tah chu hi hih nange, hinla ipi kasei kakihet nai. Hiche hi tun hethem tauvin nate tin kagel'e, ajeh chu avel vel'a iphotchen u ahitai.
en_web: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
en_kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuseiyin lhachom jong leng, hetnan kalhachompoi; hiche hi ima lam jouse ahithei lam cheh a kaseipeh sa nahiuve.

tcz: Keima kaki neosah a chule nanghoa kona lemukit ding kinem louhel'a Pathen Kipana Thupha seiya naheng uva kahunga, nangho kajabolna hi bolkhel kahi hitam?
en_web: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
en_kjv: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
tcz_gospelgo: Choisanga naum theina diuva kakisuh nem’a lo beiya Pathen’a kon Kipana Thupha kaseipeh-u chu achonsea kahim?

tcz: Keiman houbung danghoa kona athil tokhom'u chu kakhop khoma nangho henga manbeiya lhacha natoh kanei thei ding kati ahi.
en_web: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
en_kjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kinbolna dinga Houbung dang ho kachom’a na katohpeh nahibouvui.

tcz: Chule keima nangho to kaumkhoma chule kihinsona ding imacha kanei loupet in jong koima sum lamah pohgih kapohsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu Macedonia akona hung sopiho chun kangaichat jouse eihin pohpeh tauve. Hiti chun keiman nangho dingin pohgih kapohsah khapouvin chule kapohsah lou hel ding nahiuve.
en_web: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
en_kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome to you, and so will I keep myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva ka-um laiyin jong kalhahsamna jousea koima din tolou khoh kahipoi; ajeh chu Macedonia gama kona sopite ahungu chun kangaichat jose lhingkeiyin ahipouve, imalam jousea nang ho tolou khoh louva kihongdoh jing kahin, kakihondoh jing ding ahi.

tcz: Christa a thudih chu keiya aumjing akicheh laisea, hiche thudola kaki sonna hi Greece pumpia koiman eikham theilou ding ahi.
en_web: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
en_kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thutah kasunga achenjeh-in Achaia gamkol sungsea hiche kakisonna hi imachan eikhatan louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Ipi dia em? Nangho kangailut loujeh u ham? Keiman kangailut nahiu Pathen in ahenai.
en_web: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
en_kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh ham? Nang ho ka-ngailut lou jeh ham? Pathenin ahenai!

tcz: Hinlah keiman kanabol jing chu kabol jom ding ahi. Hiche hin amahon kisonpina ding phat kijen aholuva anatoh u chu keiho natoh tobang bep ahi atiu chu abei theina ding hiya ahi.
en_web: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
en_kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho toh banga tonga kiseiya kisonna neiya kiseiho akison lo nau abei theina dinga ipi hile kabol banga hi kaboljom jing ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche miho hi solchah lhemho chu ahiuve. Amaho hi doha thuhtah'a natong ho Christa solchahho a kisei ahiuve.
en_web: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
en_kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile amaho chu solchah lhem, lhep lhahna natong, Christa solchah banga kilep ahibouvui.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kadatmopoi. Satan jeng jong chu avah tah vantil tobanga kisoh thei ahi.
en_web: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
en_kjv: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
tcz_gospelgo: Datmo ding ahipoi, ajeh chu Satan bon Vantil vah tah limin akilep jin ahi.

tcz: Hitia chu asohte ho jong chu chonphatna sohtea kisem thei ahiuve. Achaina tengleh athil gilou boldoh hou jeh a gimbolna chang ding ahiuve.
en_web: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
en_kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha ho chu thildih kinbol lhacha bangin kilep jengu jongle datmo behseh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu atoh dungjui cheh-uva achaina amu diu ahinai.

tcz: Kasei kit ahi, hitia thu kasei hi keima angolin neigel hih un. Hinla hitia chu neigelu ahi jongleh, keima angol tobanga kaumpet'in jong, mingol tobanga nagel nau pumin, kasei ngaiyuvin.
en_web: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
en_kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaseikit ahi, koiman lungthimbeiyin eigelda hen; eigel’a aum jongle them kha tbeh kisonna kanei theina din hiti chun neila jenguvin.

tcz: Hitobang kisonna hi Pakaiya kon ahipon, hinla mingol thuseiya kasei ahijoi.
en_web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
en_kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei vang hi Pakaiyin eiseisah ahipoi, hiche kisonna thudol’a hi mi-ngol thusei katho ahitai.

tcz: Midang hon bon tahsa mihem hina a atohdoh hou akison piuva ahileh, ken jong kaki sonna seiyinge.
en_web: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
en_kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitamtah bon tahsanphe dol’a akison’u le keijong kisonga kahi.

tcz: Nangho chingtah a kigel'a nahiu hilou ham, hinla nang hon angol ho chon chan nahethem nauve.
en_web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
en_kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho miching nahijeh-uva mi-ngol ho nangai them’u ahi.

tcz: Nangho hin koiham khat touvin sohchang bol'a nabol uva, nanei jouseu akilah uva, nanghoa phatchomna akimu uva, imajouse athu uva aheiyuva, chule namaiyu abeh gei uvin jong na hethem theiyuvin ahi.
en_web: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
en_kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu min soh a nahen’u ham, nathin lhah-u ham, natuh chah-u ham, nakhai sangu ham, na-ngeiphe abeh-u ham geiyin nathoh ham ham’uve.

tcz: Chutobang bol dinga keiho thalhom val kahiu hi kajachat piuve tia kasei ahi! Hinla ipilam dol'a kisonna aneinau hijongleh–mingol banga kaseikit ahi–keijong chutobanga kisong thei kahi.
en_web: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
en_kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
tcz_gospelgo: Jahchasa saa kasei ahi, keiho kadoi lheh jenguve; mi-ngol thusei katho ahi, ahanga aumle keijong kahang’e.

tcz: Amaho Hebrew mi hiuvem? Keima jong chutima kahi! Ama ho Israel mi hiuvem? Keima jong hitima chu kahi! Amaho Abraham chilhah hiuvem? Keima jong hiti chu kahi!
en_web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
en_kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
tcz_gospelgo: Hebrew hiuvam? Keijong kahi! Abraham chilhah hiuvam? Keijong kahi.

tcz: Amaho Christa soh hiuvem? Mingol thusei bang bep kahi ding kakihet'e, hinla keiman kaha jen jocheh in ahi. Keiman kaha tohgim cheh in, songkul'a eikikhum matchet in, simjoulou khop in eikijep in, chule thina avelin kaki maito pin ahi.
en_web: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
en_kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa lhacha hiuvam? Mi-ngol thusei jeng inge, kei kahahi cheh-e! Hatah-in katong gim jon, songkul kalut tam jon, teptena kal val’in eikijep tam jon, atamjon kathideh chet chet’in,

tcz: Munchom chom Juda-nam lamkai hon nga-veijen khaohol a jepna somthum le ko vei cheh einavo uvin ahi.
en_web: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
en_kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
tcz_gospelgo: nga vei jen Judah on som li vei jepna din khatvei lhan eijep’uvin,

tcz: Keima hi thihjol ah thumvei jen eina vouvin ahi. Khatvei songa eikisep in, thumveijen kongke katoh in, khatvei chu nikhat le jankhat twikhanglen'a kaumdenin ahi.
en_web: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
en_kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwrack, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
tcz_gospelgo: thumvei Rome mihon mol’in eijep’un, khatvei songin eikisep’in, thumvei kongke katoh khan, Twikhanglen lailunga jan khat le sun khat kachamin,

tcz: Keima lamsaotah tah kana kholjinin ahi. Keiman vadung hoa le gucha michomho lah a vangsetna katoh in ahi. Keiman kamite, Judah nam'a konle chidang namdang ho lah a konin vangsetna katoh in ahi. Atahsan kahi tia ahia atahbeh ahilou jeh uvin amahoa konin tosetna katoh in ahi.
en_web: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
en_kjv: in journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
tcz_gospelgo: Kakholjinna tamtah a gin’a gin ding jeng, twilet ding, gucha ho, keima mite, chiding namdang ho, khopi sung setto ding, gamthip laiya setto ding, Twikhanglen’a setto ding, sopi lhem ho gingin kamah thah-e.

tcz: Keima ihmumon, na katong gimin, chule kathoh gimin ahi. Keiman dapthoh in kithing thingin eisulum jouding ponbeiyin kaumin ahi.
en_web: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
en_kjv: in weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Chol le nangin katongin, ihmu louvin ka-umin, gilkel dang chah kathoh-in, nelou chalouvin ka-um lhoiyin, ponsil lhasamin dap kathoh lhoiyin,

tcz: Chuti chun, hiche ho jouse kalvalin, keiman houbung ho jouse dingin gelkhohna pohgih kaneiyin ahi.
en_web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
en_kjv: Besides those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: thil dang dang kiseita hih jongle niseh-in Houbung ho kalung gimpina hin eidelpha jing’e.

tcz: Koiham athalhom keiman athalhomna chu kapohhu pi nomlou? Koi ham akipui lamvai keiman kalunghanpi lou?
en_web: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
en_kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
tcz_gospelgo: Alhasam koi kahu lou um a? Akisep lhu koi lalung natpi lou um am?

tcz: Keima kisong ding hileng, keima ichan geiloma thalhoma kahim ti thil hoa bou kisong ding kahi.
en_web: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
en_kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithang-at mon gding hijongle kalhahsamna hoa hibou kithang-at din gkahibep’e.

tcz: Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua Pa, Ama chu tonsot'a vahchoi jing dinga kilomtah ahin, keiman jou kaseipoi ti ahenai.
en_web: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
en_kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot’a vahchoi jing ding Pakai Jesu Pa Pathen chun jousei kahilou ahenai.

tcz: Keima Damascus a kaum chun, Leng Aretas in Gamvaipoa apansah pa chun keima matdohna dingin khopi kotpi hoa chun angah akoiyin ahi.
en_web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
en_kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
tcz_gospelgo: Damascus a Aretas noiya gamvaipo pan keima matna din Damascus khopi kulpi kot a-ngah jinge.

tcz: Amaa kona kaki huhdoh theina dingin keima chu khopi bang kotneova kona bom'a khailhah tho kanahi.
en_web: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
en_kjv: and through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla bangkot’a chun bom khat’in eikhai lhauvin ama khut’a konin kajamdohtai.

tcz: Hiche kisonna ho hin phatna boldoh ponte, hinla keiman hinseibe nalai inge. Keiman seinomlou hijong leng Pakaiya kona thilmu kanei hole thil kahenga hung kiphongdoh ho seiyinge.
en_web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
en_kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Phachom hih jongle kakison tei ding angaiye, amavang Pakaiya kon Themgao thilmua kimu ho thuphon ho bou seiying’e.

tcz: Kum som le li masangjep chun keima van dan thum channa geiyin lahtouvin kanaume. Keiman hichu katahsa pum'a ha ahilouleh katahsa jaolouva hiham, keiman kahepoi-Pathen bouvin ahet ahi.
en_web: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
en_kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such a one caught up to the third heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman Christa to hingkhom mi khat kahen, kum somle li ahitai ama chu can thum channa geiyin lah touvin anaumin, tahsa puma ha, tahsa pum hilou ham kahepoi, Pathenin ahenai.

tcz: Ahin Pathen bouvin katahsa puma ham ahilouleh katahsa jaotha louva ham ahenai. Hinlah keiman kahet chu,
en_web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
en_kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
tcz_gospelgo: Ken hiche mihempa chu kahen, tahsaphe pum ha, tahsaphe pum hilou ham vang kahepoi, Pathenin ahenai,
