tcz: Keima Pathen gam loupi muna eiki latouvin, mihem koiman aseitheilou thil ho thuchenga hilchet joujai hilou ho datmo umtah thil ho chu kajai.
en_web: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
en_kjv: how that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
tcz_gospelgo: ama chu Paradise mun’a akilhoh toutan, hikoma chun tho thei louhel thucheng, mihem kama seidoh thei louhel agajai.

tcz: Hitobang hetna nei hi kisonpi thei khopset ahi, hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi. Keima kalhahsamna bouva kisong inge.
en_web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
en_kjv: Of such a one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang mi hibou kison ping ting, kei le kei vang kalhahsamna ho tilou ima kisonpi pong’e.

tcz: Keima kisong nom jongleng keiman thutah chu kasei ding ahijeh'in, kakisonna chu kangol man hilou hel ding ahi. Hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi, ajeh chu keiman koima chan kahinkhoa amu kalvalu ahilouleh kathuseiya ajah kalval uva eipachat dingu kanompoi.
en_web: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
en_kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
tcz_gospelgo: Kithang-at nom leng, adih kasei idng jeh-in ngol hoi kahilou ding ahi; hijongle min eimua kathusei ajah to kitoh lou, achungnungjoa kachunga lung gel anei lou na dingin kithang-at pong’e.

tcz: Keiman chutobang Pathena kona kiphongdoh ho chu kachan ahijeng vang'in, keima kiletsah louva kaumna dingin, katahsa chunga hin ling khat, Satan a kona asolchah khat, keima eisunem ding le kakiletsah louna dingin eiki koipeh in ahi.
en_web: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
en_kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahenga kiphongdoh thil loupe behseh jeh a kakichoi-at val louhel na dingin katahsaa hin eidot ding satan sole lhinghem khat eikipen, kakichoi-at louna dia eichum dingin aum’e.

tcz: Keiman munchom chom'ah thumvei jen Pakaiyin eilahmang pehna dingin kangeh in ahi.
en_web: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
en_kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi eilah mangpehna din Pakai henga thumvei kataotai.

tcz: Aman kasei chanin, “Kalungsetna hi nangman na ngaichat dehset chu ahi. Ka thahatna hi thalhomnaa kiha langdoh joa ahi.” Christaa thahatna chun keiya na atoh theina dinga ka thalhom pet tua hi kipahtah a kakisonpi ding ahi.
en_web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
en_kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin aman kajah a, “Kalungset hi nang dia lhinset ahi, ajeh chu lhahsamnaa thahat suh chamkima umjo ahi,” ati. Hijeh a chu Christa thahat keiya achen jing theina dinga kalhahsamnaa jongkipah thou a kisong sing kahi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Christa thaneina chun keiya na atoh theina dinga, keima tah hi katha lhomna a lunglhaijia kahi, chule jumsonaho, hahsatnaho, gimbol hesoh thoh naho, chule boinaho hi Christa jal'a kathoh ahi. Ajeh iham itileh keima kalhahsam tengleh kahat ji ahiye.
en_web: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
en_kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

tcz: Nanghon keima mingol tobanga nei umdohsah uva hitobanga hi kisong'ah kahi. Nanghon keima seiphatna nei jihpeh ding dolu ahi, ajeh chu keima imacha kahidehlou vang hin chuche solchah achungnung dehset ho sang jong chun kanoinungjo dehpoi.
en_web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
en_kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu lhahsamna tin cheng, bolsetna, hesoh gentheina, bol gentheinaho, chule doubolna ho geiya christa jal’a lunglhaisel’a kasanjoh ahitai; ajeh chu kahatmo kom le kahatjo jin ahi. Ngol’a kanahitai; ahinla neiseiphat jeh-uva nang honneichuti chonsah-u ahi; ajeh chu imacha hi lou beh hijong leng chuche solchah minthanga kiseiho sanga chu noinungjo lou kahi.

tcz: Keima nangho toh kaumpet'in, keima tah in solchah kahi tin photchenna kana petai. Ajeh iham itileh keiman nalah uva vetsahna ho le akidang datmoho chule bolmo kidang ho thohhat tah in kabolin ahi.
en_web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
en_kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: Solchah khat kahina dol chu thoh hat to thoa nalah-uva melchihna ho, bolmo kidang kibol ho, chule thil kidang kibol hoa chu kichensah ahitai.

tcz: Thil khatseh nalah uva bol louva kana koi houbung dang jousea kanabol ngaiji chu, nangho sum le paiya pohgih sahna kana nei louvu hi ahi. Hiche kabol khelna jeh hin neihe themun!
en_web: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
en_kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipipen tah a Houbung dang ho sanga kabolset chom’uvem, nahenguva kithopina ding ngeh louhel’a kakoiyu tilouva? Hiche kitoh louva kabol jeh vang chun neingai dam’uvin.

tcz: Tua hi keima nangho henga athumveina a hung ding kahitai, chule nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahi ding kanompoi. Keiman nathil neiyu chu ka deichat ahipon-nangho kamu nom joh u ahi. A'ipi chu hitaleh, chapang neo hon anu le pateu anneh ding apeh'u angaipoi. Alangkhat joh a hi, nule pate joh'in achateu nehding apeh u ahi.
en_web: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
en_kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, nahenguva hung ding kakigotna hiche hi thumveina ahitai; ahinla nang ho pohgih hahsa p edinga kigo kahipoi, ajehchu nanei nangau hol le kahipon, nang ho bou kakhohsah ahi. Chaten nu lepa dinga sum khol ngai ahipon, nu le pan bou chate sum akhol peh ding dol ahi.

tcz: Keima kipah tah a kiphaldoh a chule nangho dinga kanei jouse phala kahin, ahijeng vang'in keiman kaha ngailut cheh le nei ngailut mo cheh cheh uvin kahei.
en_web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
en_kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
tcz_gospelgo: Keivang chu nang ho dinga kimang jouhel ding kahiye. Keiman kangailut behseh jeh-uva lhasamjoa neingailut diu ham?

tcz: Keima nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahilou nalah uva phabep anomin ahi. Hinla nalah uva phabep in keima hi doha thuh a chule lungthim thema nanghoa phatchomna kimun neigel uvin ahi.
en_web: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
en_kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho phgihsah lou kahidol’in kigel le, lungthim doha thuh tah a nan gho kamatdol’in nasei kit’ui.

tcz: Hinlah keiman naheng uva kahin sol ho lah a koipen'in nangho phatchom pina aneiyem?
en_web: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
en_kjv: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva kahinsol miho khattouva chu lungthim doha kabolnau umkham?

tcz: Keiman Titus chu nangho hungvil dinga kangansea chule sopi midang khat amato kahin soltha a chu Titus in nangho phatchom pina aneina umem? Henge aneipoi! Ajeh chu eihon lhagao kithakhat ineiyuvin chule khat le khat khonung juiya ihiuvin, ipilam hijongleh hitobangma'a chu boljia ihiuve.
en_web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
en_kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
tcz_gospelgo: Titus chu kahinsol tha ahi; Titus chun nalung thim bol khattouvu ham? Ama le kei Lhagao khat’a kilhon khom kahilon louham? Keng kho khat lha khom kahi louvu ham?

tcz: Keihon hitiho kaseiyuhi nanghon keima ho kithemchanna a seiyin nei ngaito uvin nate. Ahipoi, keiho Christa sohte kahinauva hiche hohi kaseiyu ahin, chule Pathen ahetoh a panga ahi. Ipi pi hijongleh kabol chanu hi kasopi deitah teho, nangho hatsahna ding katiu ahi.
en_web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
en_kjv: Again, think you that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichan’a hi nahenguva keiho kithen hon beh kahiuvem? Pathen maikoh a Christa kisonpia kaseiyu ahibouve; ngaitah te, aboncha hi nang ho sahdohna dingahi.

tcz: Ajehchu keima kahung tengleh nangho a kamu ding chu keiman dei louva, chule nanghon kadonbut ding nadeilou dingu aum ding chu katijatpi ahi. Keiman nangho kina le kisauva, kithangsettoa, kilunghantoa, kichang khohsah a, miseisehat'a, mi themmo chan'a, louchalna neiya, chule alomlou tah a chon'ah naumkhah diu kakichat ahi.
en_web: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
en_kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla kahung tengle kadei banga nachon louvu hung tohkha get ing ting, nang hon jong nadei banguva neimu lou diu ham, ti kakiphalam lheh jeng’e. Nalah-uva kinah, kithangset, lunghan, kitumsah, kiseiset, kihoulhih, hamhoitho, kitomona um thei ahi.

tcz: Ahiye, keima kahung kit tengleh keima namasang uva Pathen in eisuhnema kaum ding chu kati ajai. Chule nangho mi tampi hin nachonset nau aluisa chu nadalhah loulai jeh uvin kalung anan ahi. Nangho nathen lounau, jonlungputna chonthanghoina chule nopchon nomna a nalunglut uvin ahi.
en_web: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
en_kjv: and lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile kahung kit teng ka-Pathenin nang ho maiya eideh lhan tin, masanga then louna lam, jonthanhoi pan’a huh le lop pan, lung kisih louho jeh a chu kaka lo ding ham tin kati ajai.

tcz: Nangho vila kahungna thua tuhi athumna hung hiding ahitai (chule Pathen Thubun asei dungjuia, “Hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum chun ipipen thudol hijongleh aphudet ahi” tia kiseiya ahi).
en_web: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
en_kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi nahenguva kahung thumveina ahi. Pathen lekhabun, “Ahetoh mi ni ham thum h am jeh a bou thu tan dinga kikoi ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Aniveinaa kahungvila chu chonset bol ho chu keiman kana hilchahsa ahiuve. Tua hi keiman avela amaho chule adangho jouse chu kana hilchah a, keiman masanga kanabol ngai banga, abankit teng amaho chu kakhen louhel ding ahi.
en_web: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
en_kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
tcz_gospelgo: Ani veina nalah-uva kaum chun masanga chonse ho hihen koi hi le kagihsal cheh ahin, tua nang hoa kona kagamlat vangin kagih nahiuve; ajeh chu kahung kit le kakhen louhel dingnahiuvin ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangho jouse Christan keiya thu asei phot chenna na ngaichat jouseu chu kapeh ding nahiuve. Christa chu nangho toh kipol na a hatmoa ahipon, Ama nangho lah a hattah ahi.
en_web: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
en_kjv: since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
tcz_gospelgo: Christan kei eimanchah monga thusei kahi photchetna nadei chan namudiu ahinai, nang ho dia ama chu lhasam deh ahipon, thahat tah ahibouve.

tcz: Ama chu hatmoa thingpela kikhenbeh ahijeng vang'in, Ama tua hi Pathen thahatna'a hinga ahi. Eiho jong Christa tobanga chu thalhoma ihiuvin, hinla eiho Amatoh hintha ding ihitauvin chule Pathen thahat chu inei thei dingu ahitai.
en_web: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
en_kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu lhasam tah banga thingpel’a akhetbeh vangun Pathen thahat nan ahinsah tai. Ijeh-inem itile kei Amato kahinkhom diu ainai.

tcz: Natahsanu adih tahbeh hinam tithua vetchilna neiyun. Nangma tah kipatep'un. Yeshua Christa hi nalah uva aum mongnai ti nahet chet tahbeh u ahijeh'in; achuti louva ahileh natahsanu kicheh tah beh ahina patepna chu nalhinlel'u ahitai.
en_web: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
en_kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan’a um mong nahi nah um nang ho kipatep’un, nang ho kikhol chil’uvin; nasunguva Christa Jesu cheng chu nakihetdoh louvu ham?

tcz: Nangmaho tah naki patep tenguleh, nanghon keiho hi solchah hina thuneina chu kakiphasam pouve ti nanghon nahetdoh dingu kakinemin ahi.
en_web: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
en_kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho kathon louvu hi nahet diu kakinem’e.

tcz: Keiho Pathena katao nau chu nanghon keiho suhdih ding noplouna jeh a adihlou chu nabollou dingu hi Pathena katao nau ahi. Keiho hung masang in adihtah chu bol uvin, keihon kathunei nau kavetsah joulou diu tobanga kilang ding hijongleh, kahung lhun tengu leh kathunei nau kaphotchet sah dingu ngaikhoh ponte ti kakinem uve.
en_web: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
en_kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon thilse nabol louna diuvin Pathen henga kataopeh jingui; keiho lolhin phondohna ding mai hilouvin, keiho lolhing lel dol’in umu jong leng nang hon thilpha nabol theina diu ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon thutah chu kadoudal pouve, hinla thutah jal a chu kadin jing dingu ahi.
en_web: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
en_kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem iitle keihon thutah dou nan ima kabol thei pouvin, thutah chubou kabol’u ahiye.

tcz: Keiho thalhom tobanga kaumu hin nangho nahat tahbeh nauve ti avetsahna a keiho kipah kahiuve. Nangho napilhin dingu hi kataonau ahi.
en_web: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
en_kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho naat’uva keiho kalhahsam tengule kakipah jiuve; nang ho nachamkimsohna diuvin jong kataopeh ji nalaiyui.

tcz: Keima kahung masanga hiche naheng uva kajih hi keima kahung tengleh nangho khautah a kabollouna ding kati ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin thuneina keima eipeh hi nangho thahatsahna ding kati ahin lhahdah ding katiu ahipoi.
en_web: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
en_kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Suhphatna ding hilouva sahdohna dinga Pakaiyin eipeh thaneina, hiche katha neina hi kahung tengle khoh veng vunga kamanchah louna dinga gal’a kona hiche lekha hi kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, hicheng thua hin ka lekha thot hi khumkhana hinnei inge. Lung kipah tah in umun. Pilhinna lam manouvin. Khatle khat kitilkhouvun. Kilungtoh tah le chamna'a hingun. Chutah le ngailutna chule cham-lungmonna Pathen in naum piuhen.
en_web: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
en_kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua lhah sopite, kipah tah nom’un, chamkimsoh keiyun, lungmongun, lung khat hiuvin, kcihamdel’un, chutile ngailut le chamna Pathenin naumpi jing diu ahi.

tcz: Christian kingailutna'a khat le khat kichibaiyun.
en_web: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
en_kjv: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
tcz_gospelgo: Thengsel’in khat le khat kibengchopto cheh-un, Mithengten nasalamui.

tcz: Hichea Pathen mite jousen chibai nahin peuve.
en_web: All the saints greet you.
en_kjv: All the saints salute you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu Christa lungset, Pathen ngailut, chule lhagao theng kithopinan nabonchauvin umpi jing hen!

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi solchah Paul, mihem lhen le mihem thuneina vanga hilou, Yeshua Christa Amatah le Yeshua athia kona kaithouva Pa Pathen pansah pa, a kon ahi.
en_web: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
en_kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
tcz_gospelgo: Mihema konle mihem vanga hilou, Jesu Christa jeh le athilah akona Jesu kaithouva Pa Pathen jal’a solchah keima Paul

tcz: Hikoma sopite ho jouse panna a Galatia houbung ho henga lemna thu kahin thot nahiuve.
en_web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
en_kjv: and all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
tcz_gospelgo: le ka-umpi sopite chengsen Galatia gam Houbung ho henga,

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungset le chamna hung lhung hen,

tcz: Ichennau vannoi gitlouna a kona huhdoh ichan theina ding uvin, Pa Pathen lunggon dungjuiyin, Yeshuan ahinna eiho chonset jal'in ahungpe tan ahi.
en_web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
en_kjv: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen lungdeiya hiche khang gilouva eiho huhdoh din Jesu Christa chu eiho chonset jal’in Ama akitoh doh jengin ahi;

tcz: Atonsot tonsot a dingin loupina chu Pathena hijing tahen! Amen.
en_web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen chu tonsot geiyin loupina chang jing hen: Amen.

tcz: Nangho Christa ngailutna khotona a kona, Ama a dinga nakoupau Pathena kona nakihei mang loi jengu hi kahin datmo lheh jeng nahiuvin ahi. Nangho hin lampi achombeh najuiyu ahitai.
en_web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
en_kjv: I marvel that you are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa lungset jal’a nakoupauva kona tukah seha thupha chom khat’a nakihei jengu chu kadatmolheh-e;

tcz: Hinlah Kipana Thupha tahbeh chu ahitapoi. Christa chungchang thua thudih heikoi hon nangho na ngol bolu ahitai.
en_web: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
en_kjv: which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupha dang chula aum sampon; mi phabeh vang aum’un, amaho hin nang ho suh ling laova Christa Kipana Thupha chu akaleh ahei ding agot’u ahibouve.

tcz: Keihon nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphongu kalvala Kipana Thupha chom dang khat seiya auma ahileh keiho hiuving ting ahilouleh vana kona vantil khattou hijongleh Pathen gaosapna achunga umhen.
en_web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
en_kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin keiho hiuving lang van’a Vantil khat hijeng jongle nakiseipehsau Thupha tilou thupha chom seiphong aumle ama chu gaosap chang hen.

tcz: Keihon kaseisau kavelsei kit ahi. Nanghon nanajopsau kalvala Kipana Thupha achom seiphonga aumleh ama chu gaosap chang hen.
en_web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
en_kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei masah sau banga tua jong kaseikit ahi, “Natahsansau hilouva thupha chom dang khattouvin nahung seipeh khah-u le ama chu gaosap chang jeng hen.”

tcz: Mitmua miho seiphat hol a kahipoi, Pathena kon joh chu kahol ahi. Miho lunglhaisah ding chu kalunggon ana hitaleh keima Christa soh hilou kahi ding ahitai.
en_web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
en_kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua hi mihemte lung lhaisah goa kahi, Pathen lung lhaisah go kahim? O-le mihemte lungdei hol mong kahim? Mihemte lungdei holna lai kahile Christa soh kahilou ding ahi.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, keiman nangho kahetchensah nomu chu Kipana Thupha thudol kaseiphong hi mihem lunggel ngaitoa kingam'a ahipoi.
en_web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
en_kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keiman kaseiphongle Kipana Thupha chu mihema kon ahilouje kahilchen nahiuve.

tcz: Keiman kathupohle hi mihem a kon ahipon, koiman eihil ahipoi. Chusanga, keiman Yeshua Christan kahenga aphondoh hoa kona bou kamu ahiye.
en_web: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi hema kona kalah jong ahipon, koi man eihil jong ahipoi; Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh a konjoh ahibouve.

tcz: Juda mite hou lama itobang loma katompana Pathen houbung chu keiman kanabolset hitam ti naheuve. Keiman hichu suhmanghel kanagot ahi.
en_web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
en_kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
tcz_gospelgo: Malai Juda hou gut kahilaiye kachon nam lhah najauvin, Pathen Houbung chu tepte na kalval’a bolsea suhmang ding go kahin,

tcz: Kapu kapaten achepiu houlam chonna lamdol a keima Judah mi kachan khompi ho sanga gamchenga chung nung joa kana hi ahi.
en_web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
en_kjv: and profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
tcz_gospelgo: chu jongle kapu kapateu Houdan thua katom panjeh-in Juda hou thudol’a kakhang golpi tamtah kakho khelsoh keiye.

tcz: Hinlah keima kapen masang jenga jong, Pathen in eilhendoh a, chule Alungsetna kidangtah a chu eikou ahi. Ajeh chu hichun Ama alung lhaisah ahi.
en_web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
en_kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla ka-nu oisunga ka-um laiya pat eisepkhensa Pathen chun alungset jeh-in eikouvin,

tcz: keiman Kipana Thupha Yeshua thu chu chidang namdang ho koma kaphondoh na dinga AChapa chu kahenga aphondoh ahi. Hichu ahunghi phat in, keiman mihem khattou to kihoutohna dingin kamoh kino jengpon ahi.
en_web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
en_kjv: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
tcz_gospelgo: chidang namdangte henga Achapa kaseiphong theina din kahenga aphongdoh tan, hichea hin katoh ding dol tahsaphe le thisan pu mihem kadongpai jengpoi,

tcz: Chule keima masanga solchah himasaho to kihoutohna dingin Jerusalema kakaltou dehpoi. Chusangin, keima Arabia gam lama kachemangin chule khonungin Damascus khopia kahung kinungle kit in ahi.
en_web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
en_kjv: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me: but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
tcz_gospelgo: kei sanga solchah hi masa Jerusalema umhohenga jong kachedehpoi, Arabia gama kaga chen, chuin Damascus khoa kahung kilekit bouve.

tcz: Chujou kum thum alhinin, Peter to kiheto dingin Jerusalema kaga chetouvin, chule amato chun ni som le nga kaumkhomin ahi.
en_web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
en_kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
tcz_gospelgo: Kumthum nungin Cephas henga imahetoh din Jerusalema kaga chetouvin, amato nisom le ninga ka-um’e;

tcz: Hiche pet a chu seijui dang kakimupi khat chu Pakai sopipa Jacob chu ahibouve.
en_web: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
en_kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
tcz_gospelgo: hichepet chun Pakai sopipa Jacob tilou solchah dang kamupoi.

tcz: Keiman Pathen masanga nahenguva kahinjih a kaphondoh hohi jou apangpoi.
en_web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
en_kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva lekha kahinsut hi, ven Pathen maikoh a jou kaseipoi.

tcz: Hiche kagavil jou chun keima Sahlamsang Syria le Cilicia gam sunga kagalut in ahi.
en_web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
en_kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung chun Syria le Cilicia gamkol sunga kahungtai.

tcz: Chule hiche pet achu Judea gam'a houbung ho chun keima einahetchen loulaiyu ahi.
en_web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
en_kjv: and was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche geiya hi Judea gama Christa Houbungte mitmua het lou lai kahi,

tcz: Amahon miho seinaa ahet u chu, “Eiho eigimbol hesohpau chun asuhmang got tahsan chu tun aseiphong tai” tin aseiyuve.
en_web: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
en_kjv: but they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
tcz_gospelgo: “Masanga suhmang dia eigopau chun tun khatvei suhmang ding agot tahsan chu kipah tah-in asei phonglei,” tibou ajah-u ahin,

tcz: Chule amahon keima jal'in Pathen avahchoiyun ahi.
en_web: So they glorified God in me.
en_kjv: And they glorified God in me.
tcz_gospelgo: chu le keima jeh a Pathen avahchoi choi jengu ahi.

tcz: Chuin kum som le li jouvin Jerusalem'ah Barnabas to kaga che kit in, chule Titus jong ahung jaotha nalaiyin ahi.
en_web: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
en_kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum som le li jouvin Titus kapui lhonin Barnabas to Jerusalema kaga chetou kitlhon’e.

tcz: Chuche muna kaga che chu Pathen in gache dinga eihetsah jeh ahi. Chuchea kaum pet chun houbung lamakaiya kiheho chu atumbeh in kakimupin, chule amaho chu chidang namdang ho henga Kipana Thupha kaseiphong kaseipeh in ahi. Keiho thukhat kakisah louva ahileh katohgimna ho jouse mohseh sohthei ahi ti kahen, chule kilhaitet na a kalhai hi mohseh ahi ding kanompon ahi.
en_web: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
en_kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chu Pathen thuphondoh jal’a chetou kahin miho jah a chun chidang namdang ho lah a Kipana Thupha kaseiphong thudol kahil chenin, lamkai dom dom ho vang chu atumbeh in kaseipeh-in, katoh masah le tulai katoh ho manlou aso lou nading ka-ngaitoi.

tcz: Chuin amahon eidinpi uvin, chule kalhonpi Titus jong chu chidang namdang mi ahijeng vang'in cheptantei ding ahi ti angeh deh tapouve.
en_web: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
en_kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
tcz_gospelgo: Chukoma ka-umpi Titus chu Greek mi ahivangin cheptansah tei ding agopouve.

tcz: Hiche thudola thudoh ahung umdoh jong chu chuche muna Christian kahi tia kisei, sopi lhem ho guhthima hung kipuilut ho ahiuve. Amaho chu guhthim cha a hung kithollut a eivetlhih leuva chule Christa Yeshua a ka chamlhat nau hi ahung lahmang got'u ahi. Amaho chun eisoh chansah got'u ahin chule amahon Juda mi chonna ho chu juisah tei eigot u ahi.
en_web: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
en_kjv: and that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
tcz_gospelgo: Athudol hi alhema sopia kisemthu, Jesu Christa to ineikhomu jalena sumang dia mi ve-lhi dinga ilah-uva hunglut khaa, eiho sohchansah ding go ho hinpoh lut ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah amaho khut noiya kipehlutna chomkhat jengcha jong kanei man pouve. Keihon kipana thupha thutah chu nangho dingin huhbit kanomun ahi.
en_web: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
en_kjv: to whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana Thupha tah ahidol hi nang ho chunga aum jingna din nidan khat jeng jong amaho noiya hi kikhumlut kha lou kahiuve.

tcz: Chule keiman kathu seiphong banjoma seibe ding jong aneideh pouve (amaho lamkai pipu ahinau chu keiman imachomin kagel sang dehpoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen chun dat aneipoi).
en_web: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
en_kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
tcz_gospelgo: Lamkai dom doma kiseihoa konin jong, ipi kihisah-u jongle ka-i aloudeh poi, Pathenin mihem maijan avepoi, ginle ja umdol’a kiseiho chun ima eibolpeh chompouve.

tcz: Chusangin amahon Peter chu Judah mite lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga akinganse tobanga keima hi chidang namdang ho lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga eikinganse ahi ti aheuve.
en_web: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
en_kjv: but contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti tah sangin cheptan ho henga Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga Peter kinganse banga chidang namdangte lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga eikinganse amu’uve.

tcz: Ajehchu Peter chunga solchah hina a natonga Pathen mama chun kei chunga jong na atoh a chidang namdang ho henga kaseiphong le ahi.
en_web: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
en_kjv: (for he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me towards the Gentiles:)
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile cheptan ho dinga Peter solchah a akisemdoh banga chidang namdang ho dinga keima solchah a eikisemdoh ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun Jacob, Peter chule John hohi houbung khompiho tia kiheuva ahin, amaho chun keiya Pathen thilpeh kachan hi aheuvin, chule amahon Barnabas le keima jong atoh khompiuvin eisanguvin ahi. Amaho chun, amahon Judah nam mite ho lah a thu aseiphong bang uva chidang namdang ho koma kasei phong jom dingin eitilkhouvun ahi.
en_web: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
en_kjv: and when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungsetna eikipe aheuvin, Cephas le Jacob chule Johnin kapan khom’uva, kei le Branabas chidang namdang lah a chule amaho cheptan ho lah a natong dingin khut jetlamin eina sanguve.

tcz: Amahon eitem nau khat vang chu avaicha ho ipanpi dingu chu aseipenu ahin, hichu ken jong kabolnom ahi.
en_web: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
en_kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Kageldoh jing ding adeiyu chule ken jong katoh nom jeh a hatah akagel jing vaicha gentheite ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Peter Antioch a ahung chun, athilbol dihlouna anaum jeh in, amaikoh a kasosalin ahi.
en_web: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
en_kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Antioch khoa Cephas ahung chun kichentah a themmona anei jeh-in amaichangtah a kaphoh jenge.

tcz: Ahung lhun masah chun cheptanlou chidang namdang Christian hotoh ana nekhomin ahi. Hinlah chomkhat jouvin, Jacob kiloipi ho ahunglhun phat un, Peter chun anehkhompi jom nom tapoi. Cheptan teiding ahi tia seiho chun a-oimo ding akichat tah jeh u ahi.
en_web: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
en_kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Jacob henga kona miphabeh hung masangin chidang namdangte to an anekhomin, amaho hung phat’in cheptan ho akichat jeh-in aki- nung khinin akitumsah tai.

tcz: Hichea kon chun, Judah Christian dang ho jong chun Peter phatlhem umchan chu ajomun, chule amaho jal chun Barnabas jeng jong chu amaho phatlhemna chun apuimang uvin ahi.
en_web: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
en_kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
tcz_gospelgo: Judate mi adang hon jong ama ajop thol’un, aphat lhem nauva chun Barnabas geiyin apui manglo tauve.

tcz: Amahon Kipana Thupha Thutah thudol chu ajuilouvu kamu doh phat in, midangho jouse masanga chun Peter jah a, “Nangma penlamdola Juda mi nahi ahin, Judate chonna chu imacha hilouva nagela chule chidang namdang ho hin banga nahin ahin, iti dana chidang namdang ho chu Judah te chonna a chonsah goa nahim,” ti kaseipeh tai.
en_web: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
en_kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Kipana Thupha kitah dungjuiya achon louvu kamudoh phat’in japi maikoh tah a Cephas kasosal’in, “Judate chilhah apeng nangbon Judate chondan banga um lou ibol’a chidang namdang te chu Juda te chondan thosah ham gao nahim?” kati.

tcz: Nangho le keima pendol a Judah mi ihiuvin, chidang namdang ho tobanga chonsea ihipouve.
en_web: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
en_kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho pendol’a Juda mi ihiuvin, chidang namdang chonse hoa kon ihipouve.

tcz: Hinama jongleh, mikhat chu Danthu jui jal'a hilouva, Yeshua Christa a tahsan jal'a them changa ahi ti iheuve. Chule eihon Christa Yeshua chu tahsan'ah ihitauvin hia chu Pathen to dihna changkhoma ihitauve, hichu Danthu ijui jeh u hilouvin, Christa itahsan jalu ahi. Ajeh chu koima danthu jui jal a themchang ding aumpoi.
en_web: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
en_kjv: knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Jeu Christa tahsan tilouva Danthu dungjuiya natoh vanga mihem them achanlouje iheuve; hijeh a chu eihon Danthu dungjuiya natoh vang hilouva Christa tahsan jal’a them ichan theina diuva Jesu Christa chu itahsanu ahi; Ijeh-inem itile tahsa a mihing koima Danthu dungjuiya natoh vanga them chang lou ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah ihamtin Christa tahsan jal'a Pathen toh kichamna hol ihiu hihenlang, chuteng eihon achonse jing nalai ihiu kimudoh taleu hen itin tem? Christan eichonset sah u hitam? Hiti chu ahipoi.
en_web: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
en_kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
tcz_gospelgo: Themchan teina dia kihabolnaa jong Christa sunga chonse ihiu akimudoh le Christa chu chonset lhacha ham? Ahinai saipoi.

tcz: Chusanga, keiman danlui kaphetsa chu kathah sahdoh kit a ahileh keima achonsea kahi.
en_web: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
en_kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu ken kaphetsa kasah phat kit le kasuh khel photchetna jo ahibouve.

tcz: Kami lui chu Christa to kikhenbeh tha a kahitai, ahing nalai hi keima hita louva, Christa chu keiya hinga ahi bouve. Hiti ahijeh chun tua tahsa a kahin hi Pathen Chapa eingailua chule keima dinga kipedohpa tahsan jal'a hinga kahi bouve.
en_web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
en_kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima chu hinga ahipon, Christa joh keisunga hing ahibouve, tua tahsaphea kahin hi keima eingailua keijal’a kipedohjeng Pathen Chapa tahsan jeh a hing kahiye.

tcz: Keima Pathen milungsetna mohseh hisah ho lah a kapangpoi. Ijeh ham itileh danthu juiya a Pathen anga them eichan dingu hitahen lang hileh Christa chu ahung thi ngailou ding hiya ahitai.
en_web: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
en_kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungset hi moh kahisah poi, ajeh chu Danthu jal’a them kichang hile Christa thi chu pannabeiahi.

tcz: Vo Galatia mingol ho! Ipi doi le aiyin thilse lama dia nalhim uham? Ijeh ham itileh Yeshua Christa thingpel chunga athi lim chu atah a namu u tobang leuva kichen tah a nakihet chet sah'u ahitai.
en_web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
en_kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo khopolou Galatia miho Jesu Christa thingpel’a kikhetbeh dol namitmu changtah-uva kichentah a kisundoh taa, kon najol lhah-u ham?

tcz: Hiche thudoh pen hi kahin dong uve: Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Mose Dan najui jalu hiya ham? Ahi hihbeh e! Nanghon Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Christa thudol kisei chu najah jalu ahiye.
en_web: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
en_kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Lhagao nakisanu chu Danthu dungjuiya natoh vang ha tahsan thu najah-uva kon ham?’ nanghoa konin kahet nom’e.

tcz: Ichan gei loma phottohna bei nahiu ahitadem? Lhagaova Christian hinkho najotpat nauva hi itidan a mihem nakihabol vang uva chamkim dinga nakigelu hintem?
en_web: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
en_kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
tcz_gospelgo: Iti chuti lungthimbei nahiuvem? Lhagao thua kipan’uva tua tahsaphea chaidoh ding nagot’u ham?

tcz: Kipana Thupha jal'in nathoh genthei lheh jengui. Atahbeh in mohjen seh hiponte, dihnam? Nanghon tua hi aboncha na paidoh got u hitam?
en_web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
en_kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Hi chengpi hi mohjen seh a thoh gim nahiuvem? Tah ahile mohjen seh ahi-ngut’e.

tcz: Nanghon Danthu najui jeh uva chu Pathen in Lhagao Theng napeh uva chule nalah uva thil kidang aboldoh hiya ham? Ahidehpoi! Ajeh chu Christa thudol kithuhilna chu nanghon na tahsan tauve.
en_web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
en_kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao napeuva, nalahuva thil kidang ho boljipa chun Danthu dungjuiya na natoh jeh-uva abol ha, tahsan thu najah-uva kona abol ham?

tcz: Hitobangma chun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin chule Pathen in Ama chu atahsan jal'in chonphan asemtai.”
en_web: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
en_kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin, Abraham in Pathen atahsan in hichu ama din themchansah nan akisikpehtai,” tin akiseiye.

tcz: Abraham chate dihtah ho chu Pathen a atahsan ngamdet ho ahiuve.
en_web: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
en_kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh chun mi atahsan chengse chu Abraham chatea kisimjoh ahidol nahet diu ahi.

tcz: Ipi ngaibem, Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu atahsan jal uva chonpha ahi tia aphondohna dinga hiche phat chu Pathen Thubun anagaldot sa ahitai. Pathen in hiche Kipana Thupha hi masang peh a ana thutepsa chu, “Nanga kona namtin phatthei chang ding ahi,” kitia anahisa ahi.
en_web: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
en_kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lekhabun tahsan jal’a chidang namdangte themchan ding ahet masah dol chu Pathenin Abraham jah a Kipana Thupha anaseiphong masan “Nang jal’a chidang namdang jouse jong vangboh chang diu ahi,” anati.

tcz: Hijeh chun Christaa atahsan ngamlha ho jouse chu Abraham tahsan jal'a phatthei achanna chu chang ding ahiuve.
en_web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
en_kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu tahsan nei chengse chu tahsan neipa Abraham vangbohchang khom ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah danthua kisonga Pathen to kilungtona hol ho chu Agaosapna chang ding ahi, ajeh chu Pathen Thun, “Pathen Dan lekhabua kisun thupeh jouse juiya chule nitsoh keilou chu koi hijongleh gaosap chang ahi,” ati.
en_web: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
en_kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
tcz_gospelgo: “Koi hile Danthubua kisun chengse nitjom jing lou chu gaosap chang ahi, “tia akisut jeh-in, Danthu dungjuiya natong chengse chu gaosap chang ahiuve.

tcz: Hiti chun koima chan Danthu jui jeh a Pathen lungtona aneijou ding ahipoi ti akichen'e. Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” ati.
en_web: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
en_kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Danthu dungjuiya chonjeh a koima Pathen anga them chang lou hel ding ahi; ajeh chu, “Tahsan jal’a them changpa bou hing ding ahi,” akiti.

tcz: Hiche tahsanna lampi hi Danthu juina lampi to kikhetah ahi, ajeh chu danthu chun, “Danjui vanga mi khat'in hinna anei ahi” kitia ahi.
en_web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
en_kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Achujongle Danthu chu tahsan’a tobang ahipoi, “Danthu ho nitpa chun Danthu ho hinna anei ding ahi,” kiti ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah Christan Danin gaosapna aphondoh a kona eihuhdoh u ahitai. Ama thingpel chunga akikhetbeh pet a chu, Aman achunga gaosap ichanna diu chu akilah ahitai. Ajehchu Pathen Thun hitin aseiye, “Thing chunga kikhaisang a chu koi hijongleh gaosap changa ahi” ati.
en_web: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
en_kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
tcz_gospelgo: Danthua kisun chu, “Thinga kikhai sang tapou chu gaosap chang ahi,” kiti ahijeh-in, Christa chu eiho jal’in gaosap achangin, Danthu gaosapnaa koin eihung lhatdamtauve.

tcz: Christa Yeshua jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu Abraham phatthei abohna mama a chu phatthei aboh ahi, hitia hi eiho atahsan ho hin tahsan vanga Lhagao Theng athutep hi ichan diu hiya ahi.
en_web: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
en_kjv: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Abraham vang kiboh chu Jesu Christa jal’a chidang namdangte jong achan theiya tahsan vanga tepsa Lhagao chu ikisan theina diu ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, hichea hin nitin hinkhoa dinga vetsahna khat aume. Koiman kinoptona umsa khelthei hilou chu amoh kahlhah theipon ahilouleh asempha theipoi. Hiche jong hi hitima chu ahi.
en_web: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
en_kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, mihem ngaidol’a kasei ahi, mihem ngaidol mongin jong suhdetsa kitepna chu koiman isah louvin abolpon, koijong akoibe ngaipoi.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham le acha chu thutep ho anape e. Chule hetding chu Pathen Thubu chun “Achateho” tia achilhah tamtah koma athutep bangin aseipoi. Chusangin, “Achapa koma” atin-hichu Christa kiseina ahi.
en_web: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
en_kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutep chengse chu Abraham le achilhah kipea ahi. Mi tampi kiseina banga, “Chule nachihlhah ho din,” kiti louvin, khatseh seina bangin, “Chule nachilhahpa din,” akitin, Ama chu Christa ahi.

tcz: Keiman kasei got chu hiche ahi: Pathen in Abraham to akitepna chu kum jali le somthum jouvin Pathen in Mose Danthu apeh geiyin jong ima hilouvin akikoi theipoi. Chutile Pathen in athutep chu asuhkeh hiding ahitai.
en_web: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
en_kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kisei ahi: Pathenin asuhdet’a aphondohsa kitepna chu kum ja li le somthum nunga umdoh Danthun thutep chu man mo asosah a ason amang thei ahipoi.

tcz: Ajehchu goulo ding chu Danthu jui jal'a kinei ding hitahen lang hileh, Pathen thutep kisan jal hitalou ding ahi. Hinla Pathen in lungset them ahina jal'a Abraham athutep hiya ahi.
en_web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
en_kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Goulo ding chu Danthu jal’a ahile thutep jal’a hilou ahin, ahinla Pathenin thutepsa jeh a Abraham apeh ahibouve.

tcz: Chuti ahile Danthu chu ipi jeh a kipea hintem? Hiche kipeh lona jeh chu thutep toh kilhon a miho chu achonset'u mudoh sahna ding ahiye. Hinlah Danthu kipeh chu thutep Chapa chu ahung kahsea dinga bou kipe'ah ahi. Pathen in Danthu hi vantil hoa kona Mose khut a apeh ahin, ama chu Pathen le mihemte kah a palaija panga ahi.
en_web: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
en_kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu hi ipi ding ba ham? Suhkhel phondohna dia kikoibe, thutep kipe chilhahpa hung kah a ding ahin, Vantilte kimanga palaipa khut’a kitungdoh ahi.

tcz: Chuti ahileh Pathen Danthu le Pathen Athutep kikah a akikalna ipi umem? Aum hihbeh e! Danthun hinkho thah eipehtheiyu hihen lang hileh, hichu juijal a eihon Pathen to kilungtona ineithei dingu ahitai.
en_web: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
en_kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Achutile Danthu hi Pathen thutep to kikal ham? Ahinai saipoi; micho hing theina thaneiya Danthu kipe hile hiche Danthua chu them chan na um ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thubun aphongdoh in, eiho jouse chonset a sohchang ihiuvin, Yeshua Christa tahsan jal a bou Pathen thutep chamlhatna chu changa ihiuve.
en_web: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
en_kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a atahsan chengse thutep chu akipeh theina diuva Pathen lekhabua thun ijakai chon set noiya akhumchah ahitai.

tcz: Christaa tahsanna lampi inei masang uvin eiho hi Danthu noiya vettup a uma inahi uve. Eiho hi huhbitna kul sunga chu tahsanna lampi ahung kilahdoh masangsea uma inahiu ahi.
en_web: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
en_kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan thu hung lhun kah, ahung lhung ding tahsan kiphondoh kah a chu Danthu noiya ki hen kikhakhum ihiuve.

tcz: Lamchom jep in hinsei inge. Christa hung masangsea hi Danthu chu eipuihoiyuva panga anahin, tahsan vanga Pathen to kilungtona inei masang seuva dinga eihuhbit uva panga ahi.
en_web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
en_kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu tahsan vanga them ichan theina diuva Danthun eina kaihoiyuva Christa henga eipui naiyu ahi.

tcz: Tun tahsanna lampi chu hunga ahitan, eipuihoi ding uvin Danthu chu ingai chatbe tapouve.
en_web: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
en_kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan thu hung lhun kalvang eikaihoi nau noiya chu ihitapouve.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Christa Yeshua na tahsan jal uva nabon chauva Pathen chate nahisoh keiyu ahi.
en_web: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a Pathen chate nahiu ahitai.

tcz: Chule Christa to baptize chang'a kigomkhom ho chun, vonthah kivon tobanga Christa chu akivon u ahitai.
en_web: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
en_kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Christa sunggil’a baptize changsa nang hon Christa chu nakivon’u ahi.

tcz: Juda mi ahilouleh chidang namdang aum chom tapoi, sohchang ahilou leh chamlhat, pasal le numei aumdeh tapoi. Ajeh iham itileh nangho nabon chauva Christa Yeshua a khat nahi tauve.
en_web: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche a hin Juda mi le Greek mi kidatna, soh le chamlhat kikhena, pasal le numei kibahlouna aum tapoi, ajeh chu Christa sung gil’a nabonchauva pumkhat nahiu ahitai.

tcz: Chule tun nangho Christaa nahi tauvin, Abraham chate tahbeh nahiuve. Nangho agoulo ding nahiuvin, chule Abraham henga Pathen thutep chu nanghoa ahitai.
en_web: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
en_kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu Christa mi nahijeh-un, Abraham chilhah nahiuvin, thutep goulo jong chu nang hon chan ding ahitai.

tcz: Hiti lam hin gel uvin. Mipa khat chu athia chule achate neo nalai ho dinga goulo ding adalhah peh tah a ahi jongleh, hiche chapang ho chu apau nei jouse chu chang diu hinama jongleh, ahung letdoh kahse uva chu soh ho sanga achungnun johnau ima chom aum deh pouve.
en_web: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
en_kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
tcz_gospelgo: Goulo dingpa chu thil ijakai neipa ahivangin aneo laisen soh to imachom ahipoi kati ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu apauvin ateppeh-u kum alhin kahse uva aching hoiyuva pangho thu thua chu nung ding ahiuve.
en_web: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
en_kjv: but is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
tcz_gospelgo: Apan atep phat lhin kahsen akaihoi ho le in-ngah ho thu noiya bou aume.

tcz: Eiho dinmun jong Christa ahung masanga chutobangma chu inahiu ahi. Eiho hi chapang ho banga chu hiche vannoiya hi lhagao thubul ho thudol a soh changa ina hiuve.
en_web: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
en_kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu eiho jong ipilhin masanguva vannoi leiset lekhajembul noiya soh chang inahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah aphat chet chu ahung hi phat in, Pathen in Achapa chu numeiya kona hungpeng din, danthu noiya kipelut din ahinsol tan ahi.
en_web: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
en_kjv: but when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla phat alhinset phat’in Pathenin a-Chapa ahinsol lhan, Danthu dungjuiyin numei sunga ahungpengin,

tcz: Eiho Dan-thua sohchangsa ho hi Achatea eisem uva, chamlhat ihina dingun, Pathen in Achapa ahinsol tai.
en_web: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
en_kjv: to redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu noiya umho lhatdoh a eiho chalam thu ihina diuvin ahung’e.

tcz: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uvin, Pathen in Achapa Lhagao chu ilung sung uva ahinsolin, Abba Pa tia koutheina einei sah tauve.
en_web: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
en_kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate nahiu kichetna dinga Pathenin a-Chapa Lhagao chu i-lung sunguva ahinlha lut’a, “Abba hepa,” tia ikoujiu ahi.

tcz: Tun nang chu soh nahi tapon, Pathen Cha tahbeh nahi ahitai. Chule nangma Acha nahitah jeh a, Pathen in agoulo dinga nasem ahitai.
en_web: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
en_kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ahijeh chun soh nahitapon, chapa nahitan, chapa nahijeh chun Pathen jal’a gouloa pang ding jong nahitai.

tcz: Chidang namdang nanghon Pathen nahet masang uva, auma jong hilou pathen ho soh a chu napanu anahi.
en_web: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
en_kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen nahet masnguvin aumdol monga Pathen hilou ho lhachan napangui;

tcz: Hiti chun tun Pathen nahe tauvin (ahiloule Pathen het nahi tauve tileng), iti dana chu nangho avela hiche vannoiya lhinlelna le lhagao thubul ho pannabei thudola sohchang kit dinga naki pehlut dingu ham?
en_web: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
en_kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
tcz_gospelgo: tun vang Pathen nahetauvin, lamkhat’a Pathen het jong nahituvin, i-atile sonlel um lhasam tah Danthu lekha jembul lam’a kihei kit’a, abul lama sohna toh nom kit nahiuvem?

tcz: Nanghon Pathen lunglhaisahna dinga nikho ho ahiloule lhaho ahiloule kum kihei chin ahiloule kum ho geiya nanit u ahi.
en_web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
en_kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon nikho phabep le lha phabep chule kum kiheichin ho pou nanit jiuve.

tcz: Nangho katijat peh uhi, ijemtia nangho chunga katohgim nau jouse hi mohseh hibep a hitam tihi ahi.
en_web: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
en_kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho dinga katoh gimna jouse moh nahisah diu kati ajai.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, kangeh nomnau chu nangho hicheho a kona na chamlhatna ding uva, keima tah jong nangho chidang namdang te banga kaum hi, hiche danho a kon in keima bang hin ongtholun. Keiman nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphong masat chun alam louvin neibolse pouve.
en_web: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
en_kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keitobang hiuvin, keijong nang ho tobanga um kahi; nang hon adih louvin neibol pouve.

tcz: Keiman naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahin poh chun keima kana dampoi ti na geldoh jing diu ka gingchai.
en_web: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
en_kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
tcz_gospelgo: Katahsa dammo jeh a Kipana Thupha kahung seipeh masah lo’u nahetsau ahi;

tcz: Ahin kadin mun umdan chun neisan louna ding uva lhep patepna nato jeng vangun, nang hon nei nahsahmo bol pouvin ahilouleh keiya konin nakihei mang pouve. Chuti louvin neina sanguvin, nanghon neina lhunsah uvin, chule Pathen vantil khat bangin ahilouleh Christa Yeshua Amatah nasan diu bangtah chun neibol phauvin ahi.
en_web: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: katahsa veiset chu nang ho dinga patepna ahijeng vangin thei le hot’in neibol pouvin, Pathen Vantil bang tah le Jesu Christa bang tah-in neisang jo’uve.

tcz: Chuche pet a nakipa nau le na thanop nau lungthim chu tua hoilamba hitam? Hithei bon henlang hileh namit u chu nakaldoh uva keima neipeh jeng thei diuva kaginchat nahiuvin ahi.
en_web: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
en_kjv: Where is then the blessedness you spake of? for I bear you record, that if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
tcz_gospelgo: Chubanga nakipa nau hoilamba hitam? Hithei le namit chang te ni geiya kaldoh a neipeh nom leu jengu kichentah a kahettoh jing ahi!

tcz: Tua hi keiman thutah kaseipeh jeh uva namelma uva kapan hitam?
en_web: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
en_kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
tcz_gospelgo: Thutah kaseipeh jeh-uva nagal’u kahi ngap hitam?

tcz: Chuche thuhil dihlou ho chun nangho lung lhaisahna dingin akiha bol uvin, hinla alunggon'u apha ahipoi. Amaho chun nangho keima a kona nachom khen jeng got uhi, nang hon amaho bou najuina dingu ageljeh u ahi.
en_web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
en_kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that you might affect them.
tcz_gospelgo: Miho chun thilpha dinga natom ngaipiu ahipoi, pamse dinga bou nadeiyu ahin, hiti ho dinga chu natompanpi bol’u ahibouve.

tcz: Mi khat touvin nangho dinga thilpha bolnomna aneiya ahileh, apha jenge; keiman nangho kaumpi pet jeng bou hilouvin aman boljing hen.
en_web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
en_kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman ka-umpi pet maiya hilouvin thil ijakaiya thilpha ding jenga tompan ding aphai.

tcz: Vo kacha deitahte! Keiman nangho dinga naosonat thohlel banga kathoh gim kit hi nanghoa Christa lim asodoh kahsea ding hiya ahi.
en_web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
en_kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
tcz_gospelgo: Kachate, nasunguva Christa lim le mel akigondohsoh masangsea numei naoso nat thoh banga kathohgimpi kit nahiuve.

tcz: Keima hi nangho toh tupet'a kaum khom hileh kati lheh e, chule kapao awcheng kakhel nome. Hinlah hitobanga kigamlatna hin ipi lamsanga kakithopi thei dingu kahe jengpoi.
en_web: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
en_kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
tcz_gospelgo: Tugeiya na kom’uva um’a ka-oso chombeh a hou ding kadei lheh jeng ahi, ajeh chu nachung thu’u kalung agim’e.

tcz: Danthu noiya umnom hon neiseipeh un, Danthun ipi mong asei nahet chet mong hinam?
en_web: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
en_kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Danthu noiya um nom ho na seipeh-un, Danthu najah khah louvu ham?

tcz: Pathen Lekhabun aseiye: Abraham'in chapa ni aneiyin, khat chu sohnu akon ahin chule khat chu numei ongthol nua kon ahi.
en_web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
en_kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
tcz_gospelgo: “Abrahamin chapa ni aneiyin, khat sohnu sunga peng ahin, khat jalen nu sunga peng ahi,” tin akisun’e.

tcz: Sohnu chapa chu mihem lungtup a Pathen thutep suh bulhit gotna ahi. Hinla aji tahbeh nu chapa chu Pathen thutep dungjuiya guilhungah ahi.
en_web: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
en_kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohnu sunga peng vang chu tahsaphe pen ngaidol’a peng ahin, jalen nu sunga peng vang thutep guiya peng ahi.

tcz: Hiche numei teni hi Pathen kitepna ni vetsahna ahi lhone. Numei masanu Hagar hi Sinai Mol'a kona Danthua asohchan nau chu vetsahna ahi.
en_web: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
en_kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi tekah a kihilna thei ahi; Numei te ni hi kitepna ni vetsahna ahin, khat nu hi Sinai molsanga hung kon ahin, hiche nu chate chu soh natong ding ahiuve, hiche nu chu Hagar ahi.

tcz: Chule tun Jerusalem hi Arabia gam'a Sinai Mol tobang hiya ahi, ajeh chu ama le achate Danthua soh changin aumun ahi.
en_web: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
en_kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
tcz_gospelgo: Hagar hi Arabia gama Sinai molsang lim’a um ahin, tuali Jerusalem vetsah apang, achate to soh chang ahitauve.

tcz: Hinlah numei chom dang nu, Sarah chu Van Jerusalem vetsahna ahi. Ama numei ongthol ahin, eiho nu ahi.
en_web: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
en_kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
tcz_gospelgo: Jalen nu vang chu chunga Jerusalem lim’a um ahin, ama chu inu’u ahiye.

tcz: Isaiah themgaovin, “Vo chaneilou numei kipah thanomin, cha hing khalouhela, naosonat thoh khalouhelnu, kipah tah in awthong jejun samin! Ajeh chu numei chahinglou nun ajipato umkhomnu sangin chate ahaojo tai,” ati.
en_web: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
en_kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many moe children than she which hath a husband.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile “Vo ching-a cha neilou nu kipah-in, Naoso nat thoh khalou nu kipa othongin kho samin; Ijeh-inem itile jipa luppi sangin, Don lou dailouva kikoinu chate atamjoi,” tin akisun’e.

tcz: Chule kasopite, nangho Isaac banga chu thutep chate nahiu ahi.
en_web: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
en_kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nang ho jong Isaac banga thutep chate nahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah tun nanghon danthu najui dingu deisah ho chun, Ishmael-mihem kibol hat'a hungpeng cha chun, Isaac–Lhagaova hungpeng cha chu agimbol tobanga nagimbolu ahi.
en_web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
en_kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
tcz_gospelgo: Chulaiya tahsaphe dol’a pengpan Lhagao lama pengpa asumang got banga tua jong chuti ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thubun hiche thua hi ipi asei em? “Sohnu le acha chu nodoh tha tan, ajeh iham itileh soh numei cha chun ongtholnu cha chuto gou lokhom thei ponte” ati.
en_web: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
en_kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hichea hi Pathen lekhabun ipi aseiyem? “Sohnu chu achapato kaidoh than, ajeh chu sohnu chapan jalen nu chapa to gou lokhom theiponte,” ati.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, eiho hi sohnu cha ihipouve, ongtholnu chate joh ihiu ahiye.
en_web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
en_kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, hichea hin eiho sohnu chate ihi pouvin jalen nua joh ihibouvui.

tcz: Hitia hi Christa chun tahbeh monga eichamlhat sah u ahitai. Tun chamlhat nahiu chu photchen nan umden un, chule Danthua sohchanna a kihen ohkit tahih un.
en_web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
en_kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
tcz_gospelgo: Jalenna inei theina diuva Christan eilhatdoh-u ahitai. Hijeh chun dingdet jingun, soh namkol jona chun kihen oh kit tahih-un.

tcz: Ngaiyun! Keima Paul in hiche hi kasei peh nahiuve. Nanghon cheptan chu Pathen to kilungtona dinga kiphamoa nagel jing uva ahileh Christa chu nangho dinga ima phatchomna hitalou ding ahi.
en_web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
en_kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, nahenguva thusei hi keima Paul kahi, nanghon chaptan thu najop’u le Christan imacha naphat chomsah lou diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman velseikit inge, nanghon cheptan'a Pathen lung lhaisah nagot nahlai uva ahileh, nanghon Mose Danbua kisun jouse chonna dan ho najui diu ngai nalai tina ahi.
en_web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
en_kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
tcz_gospelgo: Cheptan thu jop chengse kahettohsah nahiuve, hitobang mi chun Danthua kisei chengse atohdoh ding abat nalaiye.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Danthu juiya Pathen lungtona nana got'u ahileh nangho Christa a kona satlhah nahiu ahitai! Pathen lungset chan'a kona pullha nahiu ahitai.
en_web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
en_kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu juiya themchan go ho chu Christaa kona kisat lhaa, lungsetnaa pul lha nahitauve.

tcz: Hinlah Lhagaova hing'ah eihon Pathen in chonphatna eithutep u chu tahsana thanoma ngah jinga um ihiuve.
en_web: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
en_kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho vang Lhagao chun tahsan jal’a them chang dia kinem’a ei ngasah-u ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eihon Christa Yeshua a itahsanu ingap lhah uva chu cheptan ahiloule cheptan louvin ima phatchomna aum tapoi. Athupi pen chu ngailutna a kiphongdoh tahsan hi ahi.
en_web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
en_kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa to hinkhomnaa hin chaptan le tan lou imachom ahipoi, ngailutnaa tong hat jing tahsan thupi ahi.

tcz: Nalhaitet jaonau aphanai. Thutah nung najui nauva kona koi ham nanunghei kit uvah?
en_web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
en_kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalhai toh lheh meu! Thutah na-ngai nauva koiham nasu tanguvah?

tcz: Pathen hilou beh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman chamlhatna dinga nakouvu ahi.
en_web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
en_kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kijol lhahna hi nakoupauva kon ahipoi.

tcz: Hiche thuhil dihlou hi chol neocha changbong lah a kilhah tobang ahi!
en_web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
en_kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
tcz_gospelgo: Chol themchan changlhah lhon pumpi achansohji ahi.

tcz: Pakaiyin thuhil dihlouva kona nahonbit dingu katahsan in ahi. Nalung nohphahsah uva chu Pathen in koipen hijongleh achung thu tanhen.
en_web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
en_kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that you will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
