tcz_gospelgo: Pakaito hinkhomnaa imachan nasuhmo lou diuva nang ho hi kason lheh jeng nahiuvin, koi hijong le akhohpoi, nasumo pen penu chu athu kitantei ding ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, keiman tugei hin nangho chep natan diu ahi tileng–mi phabep in kaseiyin alauvin–chuti ahileh ipi jeh a tugeiya hi keima eikigimbol hesoh hintem? Christa thingpel jal a Huhhingna thu seiphonga panglou hileng koima alungthoiya umlou ding ahi.
en_web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
en_kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keiman chaptan thu kaseiphong lai hile ibol’a eikibolse se ding ham? Kaseiphong tahbah hile Thingpel thudol hi kipal lhuhna hilou ding ahi.

tcz: Chuche boina sodoh ho, cheptan sah a imacha hilou nasogo hou chu amaho tah imacha hilou kisoh ule kati lheh jenge.
en_web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
en_kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho suling lao ho chu amaho kisumangsih seh leu kadei lheh-e.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh kasopi teho, nangho chamlhat hinkho mang dinga kikou nahiuve. Hinlah na chamlhat nau chu ngailutnaa khat le khat kijentonan mang jouvin.
en_web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
en_kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nang ho jalen dia kikou nahiuvin, hiche jalenna hi tahsaphe lama jaothauna mai din mang hih-un, khat le khat ngailut’a kijento nan mang jo’uvin.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Dan pumpi chu hiche thupeh khat a hi kingam'a ahi, hichu “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.”
en_web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
en_kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Danthu jouse jong hi thugol khat, “Nangma naki-ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” kitia hi bukimsoh ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah nangho aphatseh a nakipeto uva chule kivallhumto sau sauva uma nahiu leh kihongpha uvin, khat le khat kisuhmang tona theiya ching theiyun.
en_web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
en_kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed ye be not consumed one of another.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang khat le khat kiketto sao sao le kibahgamto sao sao nahi khah-u jong le nakisuhmang hel louna diuvin ching theiyun.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh'in Lhagao Thengin nahinkhou kaihoi hen kati ahi. Hiti chu hileh nanghon nachonset nomnau lung ngaichat chu nabol lou dingu ahitai.
en_web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
en_kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenvang, “Lhagaovin chon’un chutile tahsaphe lunggul chu namolso lou diu ahi,” kati ahi.

tcz: Chonset nomna lungchang in thilse abolnomin, hichu Lhagaovin abolnom chuto kikala ahi. Chule Lhagao chun chonsetnomna lung ngaichat to kikal ngaichatna eipeh u ahitai. Hicheteni hi kidou jing jenga ahijeh a nangman nalunggot apha jong chu nabol theilou ahi.
en_web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
en_kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu tahsaphe lunggul chu Lhagao lama to kidouva, Lhagao lama chu tahsa phea to kidou ahin, nang hon nabolnom nom nabol louna diuva hicheng chu kidouto ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah nangma Lhagao chun nathunun tengleh nangma Mose Danthua chu na mopohna umlouva ahitai.
en_web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
en_kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi nang ho Lhagaovin napuiyu le Danthu noiya um nahipouve,

tcz: Nangho na chonset lung ngaichat thua nanun teng uleh, hichea kon chun: kingaichat tona lama chonhoilou, then louna, lungguh a chonset nopsah ngaichatna,
en_web: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
en_kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
tcz_gospelgo: tahsaphe lam natoh chengse chu kichentah a: jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh,

tcz: Milim houna, doichoina, kihotna, kinahna, kimit thipna, kilunghan khum tona, chang phatchom holna, kidouna, kibung khenna,
en_web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
en_kjv: idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

en_web: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

tcz_gospelgo: Min ama ama natoh cheh kikholtoh hen, anatoh chu aphatnah le midang titah louva ama le ama jeng jong kipah chaa kichoi an thei ahi.

en_web: For each man will bear his own burden.

tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kilhem chavai hih-un, Pathen chu nelpeh dan ahipoi; ajeh chu mihemin atu tu a-at ding ahi.

tcz: Achonsetnau lung ngaichat suh bulhitna dinga hing ho chun hiche chonset nomna chonna a chu akemmang theile thina chu aki-atdiu ahi. Hinlah Lhagao lung lhaina a hing ho chun Lhagaova kona tonsot hinna a aki-at dingu ahi.
en_web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
en_kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-ienm itile tahsa dol’a tupan tahsaphea kona kemmang theiga alo ding, Lhagao dol’a tupan jong Lhagaova tonsot hina aloding ahi.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun apha bolna a lhadah pou hite. Imoh lhahdah lou uleh aphatcha phattheina tohga i-at dingu ahi.

en_web: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chu Aman vaipo thunei jouse chung, thahat le piputna jouse chunga loupipen minchang ahitai.

tcz: Pathen in thil ijakai Christa thuneina noija akoiya chule houbung phatchomna dinga thil jouse chunga aluchanga atun ahitai.
en_web: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
en_kjv: and hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin thil ijakai Christa kengto noiya akoi soh a, Houbung dinga Ama chu ijakiya ima jouse luchang ahisah ahitai.

tcz: Chule houbung chu atahsa ahin, hichu Christa in ijakaiya Amaa adimsah a, abulhinsah a achamkimsah ahitai.
en_web: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
en_kjv: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung chu Christa tahsa ahin, tahsa chu aluchang to akijop teng thil ijakai subukimpa chu bulhingset ding ahi tai

tcz: Nangho khatvei chu nasei ngailou nau le na chonset nau tamtah jeh a athia nahi tauve.
en_web: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
en_kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga chu nasuh khel nau le nachonset nauva thisa nahiuve;

tcz: Nangho vannoi mite adang chengse tobanga chu chonset a hing nahiuva, Diabol thua nananun'u ahin, akimulou vannoi thuneiho thununna noiya uma nanahiuve. Amahi Pathen thua nunglou ho lungsunga natonga lhagao chu ahi.
en_web: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
en_kjv: wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche laiya chu hiche vannoi leiset khang um chan dungjuiya na chonuva, vanlai jol’a thunei vaipo ho nung juiya, tulai Pathen ngaisah loute lah a natong lhagao thusah a chon’a nahiuve.

tcz: Eiho jouse hitia chu ihin jiu anahin, tahsaa ilungtup hou le ichonset nau lung ngaichat ho chu juiya inahiu ahi. Eiho ihinau ngaiya chu midang dang ho tobanga eiho jong Pathen lunghanna noiya uma inahi tauve.
en_web: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
en_kjv: among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
tcz_gospelgo: Phat khat laiya Juda mi keiho jong hitobang chu kahiuvin, katahsapheu ngaichat lamjenga chon, tahsaphe lunggul le lungtup a chon kahiuvin, midang banga keiho jong lunghanna chate kanahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen hi khotona a haotah ahijeh'in, chule Aman eingailut lheh jeh uvin,
en_web: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
en_kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathen he-pina bulhingset, ami-ngailut ning lhing sel’in eingailuvin,

tcz: Eiho ichonset jeh uva athia inahi jeng vangun, Aman Christa chu athia kona akaithou tah jeh in, hinna chu Aman eipeh u ahitai (Nangho hi Pathen lungsetna jal'a bou huhhing nahiu ahi).
en_web: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
en_kjv: even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
tcz_gospelgo: suh khelna-a ithi laitah-un Christa to eicho hing khomtauve, lugnset vanga huhhingchang nahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Aman eiho thinaa konin Christa to eikai thou tha tauvin, chule Amatoh vanmun hoa eitou sah tauve, ajeh chu eiho Christa Yeshua to hing khoma ihi tauve.
en_web: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: and hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: Amato ei kaithou thauva, vangam, Jesu Christa hongsunga eitou sah-u ahi tai.

tcz: Hitia chu Pathen in ahung lhung ding khanghoa alungsetna atepibei haosatna chu avetsahna a chule ichung uva hepina chu eiho jouse dinga athilbol jouse chu Christa Yeshua a eimu sah u ahitai.
en_web: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
en_kjv: that in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness towards us through Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu ahung lhung ding khanga Jesu Christa sunggil’a eikhoto nau lungsetna letset jeng chu eivetsah theina diu ahiye.

tcz: Nanghon natahsan pet uva chu Pathen in alungsetnaa na huhhingu ahitai. Chule nanghon hichu na kithang atpi theiyu ahipoi, Pathena kona thilpeh khat ahiye.
en_web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
en_kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile tahsan jal’a lungset man’a huh hing chang nahiuvin, hichehi nang hoa kona hilouva Pathen thilpeh ahibouve.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eiho Pathen khutsoh ihiuve. Aman eiho Christa Yeshua a athah a eisemu hi, Aman masanga pat a eiho dinga atohgon thilpha ho chu iboldoh theina dingu ahi.
en_web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
en_kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho Pathen semsa ihiuvin, Pathenin ichonna diuva ana gon masah chengsea chu ichon theina diuva natoh pha chengse tong dia Jesu Christa sunggil’a kisemdoh ihiuve

tcz: Nangho chidang namdang ten gampam mi nahiu sumil hih un. Nangho hi chep kitanlou Pathen tahsanlou tia Juda miten nakouvu ahi, acheptanu kisonpia neiya, hichun atahsa uva bou amelchihna uma, alhagaovu vang hilou ahi.
en_web: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
en_kjv: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time passed Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa phea chidang namdang nahilaiyu, tahsa khut’a cheptan mihon cheptan lou nahi sah laiyu khang chu geldoh-uvin;

tcz: Chuche laiya chu nangho Christa beiya nana hin'u ahi. Nangho Israel namsung mia kona khendoh a pamse nahiu ahin, chule nanghon Pathen in amaho toh akitepnaho chu nana hepouve. Nangho hiche vannoiya hi Pathen neilou le kinepna neilouva nahinu ahi.
en_web: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
en_kjv: that at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche laiya chu Christa to kimat lou, Israel lhangpi kiloikhomnaa pang lou, thutep jal’a kimu kitepnaa pangkhalou, hiche leiset’a hi kinepna bei le Pathen helouva um nahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah tua hi nangho Christa Yeshua to nahin khomu ahitai. Khatvei chu Pathena kona gamlatah nahiu ahin, tuavang hi Christa thisan jal'a Ama koma kipui naiya nahi tauve.
en_web: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
en_kjv: but now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua vang Jesu Christa sunga na umtah jeh-un masanga na gamlat vangun Christa thisan jal’a ngai dam nahitauve

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Christa chun eiho henga cham-lungmon ahinpoh lut ahitai. Aman Juda-mite le chidang namdang te kikah a kikhenna daltan abanglai a panga chu Atahsa tah a thingpel chunga khat a agopkhomsoh ahitai.
en_web: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
en_kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
tcz_gospelgo: Christa chu eiho kichamna ahi. Aman kikhena bang lai chu aphe lhan, kidouna chu atahsa phen asumangin, Judate le chidang namdang te pumkhat asotai.

tcz: Athina a kon chun aman chidang namdangte hoptha lou hiche chonna dan ho chu achaina asem ahitai. Aman hiche abollo na ajeh chu Judahte le chidang namdangte kikah a kichamna umsah a anamniuva kona mithah khat semdoh ding ati ahi.
en_web: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
en_kjv: having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
tcz_gospelgo: Aman namnia kona Amato hingkhom dinga mithah khat asemdoha chamna asemdoh na dinga Danthu chu athupeh chengse le adan jouse toh asuhmangtha ahi tai.

tcz: Anilhon a chu tipum khat a agop khomtheina dinga Christa chu ania dinga thingpel a thia, chujala chu namthah asemdoh a, chule aniu kah a kitomona chu asuhmang ahitai.
en_web: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
en_kjv: and that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
tcz_gospelgo: Thingpel’a athi chun Christan kidouna chu atahsa tah-in asumangin, jat ni chu asuchamin, Pathen henga tahsa pumkhatseh asemdoh tai.

tcz: Aman hiche kichamna thupha chu Amaa kona gamla tah a um chidang namdang mi nangho henga, chule anailama um Juda-mite henga ahin lhut ahitai.
en_web: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
en_kjv: and came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun ahungin Pathen to kigamlat namdang nang ho heng le Pathen to kinai Judate henga hiche chamna Kipana Thupha hi ahung seiphong tai.

tcz: Tua hi eiho jouse hi Christan eibolpeh u ahitah jeh a, hiche Lhagao Theng vanga chu Pa henga ihung theiyu ahitai.
en_web: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
en_kjv: for through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Christa jal’a chidang namdang le Judaten iloi niuva Lhagao khat’a Pa henga lut theina ineiyu ahi je.

tcz: Hitia chu tua hi chidang namdang mi nangho hi kholgam mi le gampam mi hitalouva, Pathen mithengte jouse toh agam mi hina naneikhom'u ahitai. Nangho Pathen insungmi chu nahi tauve.
en_web: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
en_kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun nang ho maljin le khopem nahi tapouvin, Pathen mithengte chan khompi le a-insung mite nahitauve.

tcz: Akigoma eiho hi Ama in chu ihiuvin, solchah ho le themgao ho bulphuna a chu kisadoh a ihiuve. Inninga songpia panga chu Christa Yeshua Ama tah ahi.
en_web: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
en_kjv: and are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa chu inning song khomdet ahin, sholchahho le Themgao ho songset chunga nang ho kisadoh nahiuve.

tcz: Eiho chingtheitah a Amato kijopmat a ihiuvin, Pakai dinga hou-in theng khat ihiuve.
en_web: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
en_kjv: in whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto a holy temple in the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa chun in kisa chengse chu aloikhomsoh keiya, Pakai Houin theng hi dinga akhantousah ahi;

tcz: Ama vanga chu chidang namdang nangho jong Pathen in a-Lhagaova chenna in'a anei chu nahi tauve.
en_web: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
en_kjv: in whom you also are builded together for a habitation of God through the Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga chu nang ho jong adang chegse to kisakhom Pathenin Lhagaova chenna anei theina dia kisa doh nahiuve

tcz: Hicheng jouse hi, Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul keiman chidang namdang nangho phat chomna ding kagelna ahi.
en_web: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
en_kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu chiding namdang nang ho jal’a soh changa kihen keima Paul,

tcz: Gah ngaito dia kiloma chu, Pathen in alungsetna homjal dinga mopohna keima eipeh hi chidang namdang nangho henga ahin lhut ahi naheuvin ahi.
en_web: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
en_kjv: if ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungset vanga nang ho dinga hiche kinbolna eikipeh hi najahsau ahi tan,

tcz: Keiman agomlama kana jihna a, Pathen in athuguh alunggon chu keima eihetsah ahitai.
en_web: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
en_kjv: how that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
tcz_gospelgo: thil kiselguh kahenga kiphongdoh a kihetsah dungjuija paltan’a kahinsutsa jong ahitai;

tcz: Keiman kajihsa nasim uva kon chun, Christa a hiche tohgon thua kahet gil dan hedoh thei tauvin nate.
en_web: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
en_kjv: whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
tcz_gospelgo: simpou pou leu chun Christa selguh thil kahet themdol hetauvin nate.

tcz: Hiche hi khang masa ho'ah Pathen in ana phongdoh pon, hinla tun a Lhagao jal in Aman asolchah thengho le themgao ho henga hiche hi ahin phongdoh tai.
en_web: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
en_kjv: which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
tcz_gospelgo: Tulaiya Lhagaovin Christa solchah theng ho le Themgao ho henga aphondoh bang hin khang masa laiyin mihem chate akihetsahpoi.

tcz: Chule hiche hi Pathen lunggon ahi: chidang namdang le Juda mite Kipana Thupha tahsan Pathen chate ho chun ahaona gou chu kibang chet a chang ding ahiuve.
en_web: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
en_kjv: that the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
tcz_gospelgo: Athuguh chu Jesu Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha hung lhun hin chidang namdang ten jong Judate to gou lokhomna le tahsan khat hikhomna chule thutep chankhomna aneitauve

tcz: Ani lhona chu tipum kibang ahigel lhon in, chule ani lhona phattheina thutep chu chang gel ahi lhon hi Christa Yeshua a ahi jal jeh ahi.
en_web: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
en_kjv: whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilbol thei thahat le Pathen lungset manbeiya thilpeh eikipe dungjuiya hiche Kipana Thupha lhachaa eikipansah ahitai.

tcz: Keima Pathen mite lah a imacha hiloupen hijeng jongleng, Aman Christa a gou kichaitih umlou chidang namdangho seipeh dinga alung gon chu lungset mana keima heng ahinlhut ahitai.
en_web: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
en_kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Mitheng te jouse lah a alhumpen kahi vangin Christa haoje akhona bei Kipana Thupha hi chidang namdangte henga seiphongna ding lungsetna hi eikipei;

tcz: Keima hi hiche thuguh tohgon um chu mitin seipeh dinga eikilheng doh ahin, Pathen ijakai sempa chun, atil abula pat a aguh a akoisa ahitai.
en_web: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: hichu thil ijakai sempa Pathenin ama sunga tonsot’a akoi thilgon kiselguh chu mitin kamusah a,

tcz: Hicheho jousea Pathen lunggon chu houbung mangcha a, chihna a van munhoa ahaona chu mutheilou vaipoho le athunei ho jouse henga phondoh ding ati ahi.
en_web: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
en_kjv: to the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
tcz_gospelgo: tulaiya Houbung jeh a Pathen chihna jat chom chom ahidol hi vanlaijol’a vaihom thuneite hetsahna ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi tonsot'a atohgon ahin, hichu Christa Yeshua i-Pakaiyu jal'a atohdoh ding ahi.
en_web: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chunga kimolso tonsot’a gonsa thilgon dungjuiya um ahiye.

tcz: Christa jal leh Ama itahsan jal uva, tua hi eiho lungngam tah leh kisong tah a Pathen angsung ilut theiyu ahitai.
en_web: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
en_kjv: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama itahsan jal’u le Amato ihinkhom jeh-uva lung ngamna le hanna neiya ahenga lut ngam ihitauve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, hiche mun a keima chungthu kikholna ho jeh hin lunglha hihbeh un. Nangho jeh a keiman kagim thoh hi nanghon sahtah nahiu kihet un.
en_web: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
en_kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun nang ho jeh a hesoh genthei kathoh hi lung thoi hih-un, hiche hi naloupinau joh ahibouve

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi kagel chun, keima ka dilsun, Pa henga ka taovin ahi.
en_web: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu dilsua Pa henga taoji ka hin,

tcz: Ama hi van chunga hihen, leiset chunga hijongleh ijakai sempa ahi.
en_web: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
en_kjv: of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
tcz_gospelgo: hiche Pa vanga hi vanmun jouse le leiset chunga phungtinin kiminvo na aneiyu ahi;

tcz: Keima kataona chu ahileh, aloupina, aLhagao Theng a kona aman nangho sunggila kona thahatna beitih nei louva napeh dingu hi ahi.
en_web: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
en_kjv: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
tcz_gospelgo: Aman aloupi haoje akhonna beiya kona thahat le thilboltheina a-Lhagao vanga nami-sung nunguva dia napeh theiyuva,

tcz: Chutengleh Christa chun Ama natahsan jaljeh uva nalungsung uva achen theina ding ahi. Pathen ngailutna a chu na jungkho uva chule nahat dohna ding uvin thuhtah in kivuilut un.
en_web: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
en_kjv: that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
tcz_gospelgo: tahsan jal’a Christa chu na lungthim sunguva achen theiya,

tcz: Chule nanghon Pathen mite jousen anei dingu ahi bangin, tahsan theina thaneina chu neiyun–Angailutna chu ichan geiya len a, saova, sang a, chule thuh a hitam!
en_web: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
en_kjv: may be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
tcz_gospelgo: hitia chu mithengte chengse to Christa ngailutna jaoje le saoje, chule asanje le athuhje het khen jouna na nei theiyuva,

tcz: Nanghon Christa ngailutna hi tepkha teiyun! hiche hetchet ding chu hetjoujai hihih jong leh. Chutengleh hinkho bulhingset pum chule Pathena kona thilboltheina puma nakisem pilhing diu ahi.
en_web: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
en_kjv: and to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
tcz_gospelgo: hetna jouse khokhelsoh hel Christa ngailutna nahet theiyuva, ijakai chamkimsoh hel Pathen chamkimna nabulhin thei na dingu ahije

tcz: Tun loupina jouse chu, athilbol theina hattah a kona isunguva natong'ah, ithumu ahiloule igel'u kalval a hetjoujai hilou subulhit thei, Pathen a hita hen.
en_web: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
en_kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
tcz_gospelgo: I-sunguva natong jing athahat dungjuija ithum sangule igel sanguva thil ijakai thahat tah a bolthei Pa,

tcz: Houbung sunga chule Christa Yeshua a chun akhang khangin, atonsot tonsot'in loupina ama a hijing tahen, Amen.
en_web: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama henga chun Houbung sung le Jesu Christa hongsunga akhang khangin tonsot geiyin loupina um jing tahen: Ame

tcz: Hiche jeh chun, Pakai kin bolna a sohchang keiman, Pathen in nakouvu ahitah jeh in, nakikou nau totoh in chonun tia nakom uva katao ahi.
en_web: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
en_kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
tcz_gospelgo: akai dia sohchang keiman na kikounau to kitoh a chon dia ka-ngeh nahiuve;

tcz: Phatseh in kineosah un chule lungneng un. Khat chu khat chungah thoh hat'un, na ngailut nau jaljeh in khat in khat suhkhelna a kihepito cheh un.
en_web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
en_kjv: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
tcz_gospelgo: phat jousen nunnem in, chonnem jingun, thohhat to thon, ngailutnan khat le khat kingai themun;

tcz: Lhagaova pumkhat hina dingin kiseh un, khat le khat chamna in kikan khomun.
en_web: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
en_kjv: endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaova pumkhat hina chu tuhchah jing din kihabol’un, cham nan kikan khom jingun,

tcz: Ajehchu nangho hi khonunga loupina kinem'a kikou nahi bangun, tipum khat ahin chule Lhagao jong khat ahi.
en_web: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
en_kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
tcz_gospelgo: nakikounau kinepna khatseh ahibangin tipum khat, Lhagao khat ahi;

tcz: Pakai khat, tahsan khat chule baptize chan khat bou ahi,
en_web: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
en_kjv: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai khat, tahsankhat, baptize channa khat,

tcz: Chule Pathen khat le Pa chu imajouse chung vum'a uma ahin, chule imajousea uma ahiye.
en_web: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
en_kjv: one God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
tcz_gospelgo: mi jouse Pa, ijakai chunga um, ijakaiya natong, ijakai ya umsoh Pathen khatseh ahi

tcz: Hiti chu hijongleh, Aman eiho khat cheh hi manbei thilpeh aguntah chu, Christa hong phalna jal in, eipe cheh uvin ahi.
en_web: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
en_kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thilpeh tepte na dan dungjuija eiho mi khat cheh hi lungsetna thilpeh khat cheh eipeh-u ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Ama achung sanglama akaltou chun, sohchang ho apuiyin chule Amite chu manbei thilpeh ho ape-in ahi,” akiti.
en_web: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
en_kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua: “Ama chung sanga akaltou chun Gal-hing kiman tampi akaitouvin; Mihemte jong thilpeh Tampi apei,’ ati

tcz: Melchih in, “Ama akaltou chun” kiti hi: Hiche hin Christa chu vannoi anoinung lama gakumsuh a ahi tina jong ahi.
en_web: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
en_kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: “Ama akaltouvin,” kiti hi, ‘Leiset noinung geiya akumlhai,’ tilou adang ipi kiseina ham? 10Akum lhapa chu ijaki asuh bulhitsohna dinga vanmun jouse chungvum’a kaltoupa ma ma chu ahi.

tcz: Chule Ama agakumsuh a chu vanho jouse sanga jong sang joa kaltouva ahi, hitia chu Aman vannoi pumpi hi Amatah in adimset sah ahi.
en_web: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
en_kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

tcz: Tun hiche ho hi Christa in a houbung dinga manbei thilpeh'a apeh ahi: Solchah ho, Themgao ho, Evangelist ho, Pastor ho chule Mihil ho ahiuve.
en_web: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
en_kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Aman miho thil apehho chu: abang sohchah hi na, abang Themgao hi na, abang evangelist hi na, abang Pastor hi na le mihil hi na ahin,

tcz: Amaho amopoh nau chu Pathen mite chu Pathen natohna a pang ding chule Christa tipum, houbung chu sahdohna dinga ahi.
en_web: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
en_kjv: for the perfecting of the saints for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: ama ho hin mithengte chu lhacha natohna lam le Christa tahsa sahdohna ding lama agontoh-uva,

tcz: Hiche hi eiho ibon chauva chutobang tahsanna a kipumkhat a chule Pathen chapa hetna lama Pakaiya ipilhin theina ding uva, Christa a idim uva chule chamkimna a ichejompeh theina dingu ahi.
en_web: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
en_kjv: till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: eiho chengse hi tahsan’a pumkhat ihikahseu le Pathen Chapa ihet kahseu, mi kikhan lhit ihiuva chule Christa pilhin dung chan iphah kah seuva abol diu ahi.

tcz: Chutengleh eiho chapang ho banga pilhing louva iumlou dingu ahitai. Eiho hi thuhil thah hui hung nung tobang ahung ho chun eimut lonle le lou dingu ahitai. Eiho hi mihon jouva eihin doha bol teng uleh thutah banga chingtheitah a asei dingu ahi.
en_web: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
en_kjv: that we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu ei ho chapang banga mi suhmangna dinga doha thuh a kipodoh ho le mihem lungthim gilouva kon kihilna lhem ho chu kipui chatvaisah a hui nung jousen amut ling le alhoh mang theibep tobang ihilouna diu ahi.

tcz: Chusangin, eihon thutah chu ngailutna neiyin seiyu hite, imalam jousea khangtouva Christa (Houbung Luchang), Atipum (Christa tahsa) dinga ihi theina dingu ahi.
en_web: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
en_kjv: but speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti sanga aluchang hiya Christa chu thil ijakaiya ikhantouna diu va ngailut neiya thuttah isei jing diu ahi;

tcz: Aman atipumpi chu chamkim keiya asuhto sohkei ahi. Tibah hon ama ama kin hoitah a akibol cheh uva ahileh hiche hin tibah dang jong akhantou sah ahi, hitia chu tipumpi chu damthei le khangtouva chule ngailutna dimset hiji ahi.
en_web: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
en_kjv: from whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaa kona tahsa pumpi hi kitoh chet’a kisuto khoma kisolmat cheh, tahsa pumpi hi tibah dang chengse hin atuhmat soh keiya, atoh ding dol cheh abol’uva ngailutnaa asahdoh a akhantousah-u ahi je

tcz: Pakai thuneina'a hiche hi kasei ahi: chidang namdang ho bolngai bangin bol tahih un, ajeh chu amaho tah kinepna beiya lungnoh phah bep ahiuve.
en_web: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
en_kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai pan’a hiche hi seiya kahettohsah nahiuve: chidang namdang ten lung chatvai aput’uva achon bangun chon hih-un;

tcz: Alunggelu muthim lhangkhal kiheh ahin, amaho Pathen in hinkho apehna uva konin akihei mangun, Pathen in amaho apeh u lungthim chu akhah chah un chule Ama dounan alungu atahsah cheh un ahi.
en_web: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
en_kjv: having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
tcz_gospelgo: amaho kho pholouhel le alungtah behseh jeh-uva ahetnau lung thimsoh a Pathen hin naa chu kipaidoh ahitauvin,

tcz: Amahon jachat lamjong ahepouve. Amaho tahsa lung ngaichat nan ahinguvin chule then louna lam jousea akipeuvin ahi.
en_web: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
en_kjv: who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
tcz_gospelgo: jumle ja helouva um’uva acham cham’uva huh lam le thil theng lou tinchang to chule lop lam bolna dinga kipedoh ahitauve

tcz: Hinlah hichu Christaa kona nakihilu ahipoi.
en_web: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
en_kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho vang Christa chu hitobanga hi kihil nahipouve;

tcz: Nanghon Yeshua thu najah u ahitan, chule Amaa kona thutah chu kihil'a nahi tauve.
en_web: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
en_kjv: if so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu laigil’a cheng thutah banga Ama chu najah-uva chule Amaa kihila nahiule

tcz: Na chonset luiyu chonna le masang nahinkhou then louna lung ngaichat le doha lhahna chu pailha uvin.
en_web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
en_kjv: that ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon masang chonna dol’a chon, joulhep ding ngaichatna lunggul’a ha set cheh cheh milui chu napai lhah-uva,

tcz: Chusangin, Lhagao chun nalunggel ule ngaito nau suthahjo hen.
en_web: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
en_kjv: and be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
tcz_gospelgo: nalungthimu Lhagaova kisemthah a,

tcz: Na chonnau athah Pathen lim tobang pu–chonpha tahbeh le atheng chu kivonun.
en_web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
en_kjv: and that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: chule thutah dungjuiya adih le athenga Pathen lim banga kisemdoh mithah chu nakivon diu ahi

tcz: Hijeh chun jousei pailha tauvin. I-heng le ikom ho henga thutah chu seitau hite, ajeh chu eiho jouse hi tipum khat a chu jaova ihisoh keiyuve.
en_web: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
en_kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun jou pailhan, nangho khat cheh chu aheng akomto thutah jengin kihou hen; ijeh-inem itile eiho khat cheh hi tibah khat ihi bouvui.

tcz: Chule chonset sodohna lunghan chun na thunun da tauhen. Nalunghan pet pum in nisa kilhum khum sah hih un.
en_web: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
en_kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
tcz_gospelgo: Lung hangkha tajong leu chun chonse hih-un; nalung han u chu nisan lhumkhum hih hel hen

tcz: Ajehchu lunghan na hin Diabol dinga pansatna apeh ahi.
en_web: and don’t give place to the devil.
en_kjv: neither give place to the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule agilou pa chu mun ot hih hel’uvin.

tcz: Gucha nahileh, guhchat ngajeng in. Chusang chun, nakhut teni chu thilpha hatoh nan mangchan, chujou teng angaicha ho chu hongphal tah in pen.
en_web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
en_kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Gucha chu gucha kit ta hih hen, chusangin alhasam ato theina din akhut tah-in napha tong gim hen.

tcz: Paongeilou le thuphalou seihih in. Nasei chasun chu apha le aphachom ding hihen, hiti chun nathusei ngaiho dinga kitil khouna sohdoh hen.
en_web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
en_kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakam’uva konin thuse khat cha potda hen, amavang ajah ho lung lhaina din khantou theina dinga akhoh dungjuija thupha potjo hen.

tcz: Na hinkho mandan u chu Pathen Lhagao Theng lung himosahna hida hen. Aman Amaa mong monga lhatdamna nikhoa nangho huhhing na channa ding uva namel chih u ahitai.
en_web: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
en_kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhatdoh nikhoa dinga mohor nakinam nau Pathen Lhagao Theng chu lung phatmosah hih-un. 31 Thukha jouse leh lungsat, lunghan, kinah, kitaitom, chule gitlounajouse nang hoa konin pai mangun.

tcz: Lungdam louna jouse, lungsat, lunghan, thungai lou sei, chule seiset oimona, chule chonchan phalou jouse chu paimang un.
en_web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
en_kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

tcz: Chusangin, khat le khat kilungsetto cheh un, lungneng un, khat le khat kingaidam touvin, Christa in nangho na ngaidam bang uvin ngaidamun.
en_web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
en_kjv: and be ye kind one to another, tender hearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho khat le khat kihepito cheh-un, lung nemun, Pathenin Christa sunggil’a na-ngaidam bangun ki-ngaidam’uvin

tcz: Hijeh chun imalam jousea Pathen umchan jomun, ajeh chu nangho Ama deilhen chate nahiuve.
en_web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
en_kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun Pathen sahtah chate nahijeh-un Amato bah ding ngaitouvin.

tcz: Ngailutna dimset hinkho manguvin, Christa in avetsahna nung chu juiyun. Aman eingailut uva, chule Amatah hung kipedoh a Pathena dinga gimnam tuiya kipedoh a ahitai.
en_web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
en_kjv: and walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
tcz_gospelgo: Christan eiho eingailut’uva eiho jal’a Pathen henga maicham thilpeh gimnamtui banga Ama akipehdoh jeng bang chun ngailutnan chon’uvin.

tcz: Nalah uva jon-thanhoina, thenlouna, ahilouleh chipset umdahen. Hitobang chonsetnaho hin Pathen mite lah a mun aneipoi.
en_web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
en_kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named amongst you, as becometh saints;
tcz_gospelgo: Mithengte umdol’in jong thule then louna jouse chule papset thudol nalah-uva kiphapoh hih hel hen;

tcz: Phatchomna bei thusim seiho, ngol-hoi thusei, alam louva totnaho-hiche hohi nangho hina ahipoi. Chusangn in, Pathen thangvahna sohjo hen.
en_web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
en_kjv: neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
tcz_gospelgo: chule jamo le thumotsei, tothanghoi hicheng jong chu umda hen lang, chusangin thangvahna thu kiseijo hen.

tcz: Nahet chet diuva pha chu–jonthanhoi, thenlouna, ahilouleh michipse ho Christa le Pathen Lenggam lutlou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu michipse kiti hi milim hou ahin, hiche vannoi thil hohi pathena anei ahitai.
en_web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
en_kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang hon hiche hi nahetdiu ahi, koi hile jonthanhoi bol, thilthengloubol, chule papsea le doilim semthu houva chun Christa le Pathen lenggam sunga mun aneipoi

tcz: Hiche chonset hoa kithem chan ho dohan lhahih hel un, ajeh chu Pathen lunghan chu Ama seingailou ho jouse chunga chu ding ahi.
en_web: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
en_kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima thu homkeovin kilhep lhahsah dauvin, hiche ho jeh taha chu thua nung lou chate chunga Pathen lunghan hung chuji ahi.

tcz: Hiche mihon thil abol nauva hin jao hihbeh in.
en_web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
en_kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiteho chutoh imacha kikop hih-un.

tcz: Ajehchu nangho khatvei chu muthim lhangkhal kihehleu lah a uma nana hiuvin, hinla tun nanghon Pakaiya kona vah chu naneiyu ahitai. Hijeh chun vahmite hin'in hing uvin.
en_web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
en_kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho muthima na umsa nahiuvin, tua vang Pakai hongsunga khovah changkha nahitauvin, hijeh chun khovah chate bangin chon’un.

tcz: Ajehchu hiche vah nasung uva kona hungvah doh chun apha le adih chule thutah ahin hindoh sah ding ahi.
en_web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
en_kjv: (for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itileh khovah ga chu phatna jouse le adih chule thutah ahin,

tcz: Pakai lunglhaina ipi ahi chu chingthei tah in holdoh un.
en_web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
en_kjv: proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai lung lhaina ding chu pho toh-uvin;

tcz: Phatchomna bei agiloupa le muthim natoh hoa chun pan lahih un, chusangin sosal jouvin.
en_web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
en_kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
tcz_gospelgo: muthima um tohga beiho chuto imacha kikop hih hel’un, amaho chu sosal’un phohsal jou’uvin.

tcz: Pathen ngaisahlou hon guhthima athilbol hou hi gahsei dinga jong jachat umtah ahi.
en_web: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
en_kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile amaho guthim natohho chu seidoh ding jongjachat umleo ahi.

tcz: Hinlah amaho lungput phalou chu achungu vah'in ahinsal tengleh kilang doh ding ahi.
en_web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
en_kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu ijakai hi isosal’a iphonjal teng le khovah chun aphong doh jitai.

tcz: Ajehchu vah'in ijakai atahlang ding ahi. Hiche jeh a hi hitia hi kiseiya ahi, “Vo ihmumil, athilah a konin thoudoh in, chule Christa in nangma nasalvah ding ahi.”
en_web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
en_kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile ijakai phong doh a chu khovah ahi. Hichejehchun: ‘Vo ihmumil khangin, Athi lah a konin thoudoh-in: Chuteng Christan nasalvah ding ahi,’ tin akiseiye

tcz: Hijeh chun itobang hinkho mang nahiu ching theiyun. Mingol ho tobang'in hinkho mang hih un, achingho tobang'in hing jouvin.
en_web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
en_kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun iti nachon’um ching theiyun, lungthimbei ho banga um louvin, michingho bangin um’un;

tcz: Tulai nikho phalou lah a hin phat kijenpet cha hi mang themun.
en_web: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
en_kjv: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
tcz_gospelgo: phat hi kitup keiyin mangun, ajeh chu tulai nikho hi apha tapoi.

tcz: Lung geltoh louvin chon hih un, hinla Pakaiyin ipi nabol ding uva adei chu hedoh un.
en_web: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
en_kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun lungthimbeiyin umdauvin, Pakai lungdei ipiham het ding ngaitouvin.

tcz: Lengpitwi don khamhih un, ajeh chu hichun nahinkhou amah thah sah ding ahi. Chusangin, Lhagao Thenga dimset un.
en_web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
en_kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
tcz_gospelgo: Lengpituiyin kham hih-un, hichea chun manthahna aum’e; chusangin Lhagaovin dimsetjo’uvin;

tcz: Vahchoina la ho le Pathen houna la chule lhagaolam laho nangma ho lah a sauvin, chule nalunggilun Pakaiya tumging tothon sauvin.
en_web: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
en_kjv: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
tcz_gospelgo: tumging to thon Lhagao lan khat le khat kihou limun, tumging tumin kitohdel’in Pakaiya nalunggil’in la sauvin.

tcz: Chule imalam jousea Pa Pathen chu IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa minin thangvah un.
en_web: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
en_kjv: giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Imatih chanin ima lam jouse a dingin i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa minin Pa Pathen thangvah jingun;

tcz: Chule akalvalin, Christa jana jal in khat chu khat thua kitulut'un.
en_web: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
en_kjv: submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa ja nan khat thun khat nung uvin

tcz: Nute ho, Pakai thua nung tobang'in najipa teu thu thun nungun.
en_web: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
en_kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeiho Pakai thua nung bangin napasal teu thun nungun;

tcz: Ajehchu jipa khat chu Christa Houbung luchang ahi tobanga jipa chu ajinu dinga aluchang ahi. Ama hi Atahsa pum, hichu Houbung Huhhingpu chu ahije.
en_web: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
en_kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
tcz_gospelgo: ajehchu Christa chu atahsa Houbung huhhinga le aluchang ahi banga, pasal chu numei luchang ahi.

tcz: Houbung Christa thua nung ahibangin, hitobangma chun nute ho jong najipa teu thunoiya imalam jousen umun.
en_web: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
en_kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung Christa thua anun banga numei ho jong ima lam jousea apasal teu thua nung diu ahi. 25 Pasal ho, Christan Houbung angailut’a, adinga Amatah akipeh doh jeng bangin najiteu ngailu’vin.

tcz: Chule nangho pate hon, Christa in Houbung angailut tobang chun, najinu teu chu ngailuvin. Aman amanu dinga ahinkho apeh'a
en_web: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
en_kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

tcz: amanu chu athen'a chule angimsel na dinga Pathen Thule baptize kibol'a kona asilngim ahi.
en_web: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
en_kjv: that he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
tcz_gospelgo: Christan angailut Houbung chu twiya asilngim’a thua asuh thengna dinga abol ahi,

tcz: Hiche aman abol hi amanu hi Amaa dinga Loupi tah Houbung chu ahia anenlai, ahilouleh akohlai, ahilouleh adang nolna thei mun umlouna dinga abol ahi. Chusanga, amanu hi atheng le nolna bei hiding ahije.
en_web: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
en_kjv: that he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
tcz_gospelgo: hichu Houbung hi Ama angsunga loupitah leh thengsel, nolnabei le avonkom beihela adinsahna ding ahi.

tcz: Hitobangma chu, jipa tehon jong ajinu teu chu atahsau banga angailut dingu ahi. Ajehchu mihem khat ajinu ngailua chun amatah kingailua ahi ti avetsah e.
en_web: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
en_kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu pasal hon ajiteu chu ama ho tahsa banga angailut diu ahi. Ajinu ngailupa chu ama kingailua ahiye.

tcz: Christa in a-Houbung avettup tobang chun koiman ama tahsa ahotbol ngaipoi, chusangin avah jingin chule avetup jinge.
en_web: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
en_kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu koiman imatih chanin atahsa ahokhahpoi, Christan Houbung abolna bangin, avah khangin ahebolji bouve.

tcz: Chule eiho Ama tipuma atibah ho ihiuve.
en_web: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
en_kjv: for we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho hiChrista tahsa tibah ihiuve.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei tobang'in, “Pasal in apa le anu adalhah'a, chule ajinua beh ding ahi, chule ani lhona khat a kigom khom lhon ahitai.”
en_web: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
en_kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: “Hichejeh a hi mihemin anu apa lhakanga ajinu akolchahjoh ding chule amani tikhat hilhon dinga hi,” akiti.

tcz: Hichea hi thuguh kidang tah uma ahi, hinla hichea hi Christa le houbung khat ahina vetsahna ahi.
en_web: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
en_kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hi giltah ahin, keiman Christa le Houbung thudol’a bou ka sei ahiye.

tcz: Hijeh a hi avela kasei ahi, pasal khat cheh in amatah akingailut tobanga ajinu chu angailut teiding ahi, chule jinu chun ajipa chu aja ding ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
en_kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nang ho amichang cheh a ding jong ahin, hijeh chun mi ama aki-ngailut bangin ajinu ngailu chehhen, chule numeiyin jong ajipa jabolcheh hen

tcz: Chateho, Pakaiya nahitah jeh uvin nanu le napa teu thun nungun, ajeh chu hiche hi thildih bolding dol chu ahi.
en_web: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
en_kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate Pakai jal’in nanu napa thun nungun, hichu adih ahi.

tcz: Napa le nanu jabolin. Hiche hi thutepto kigoma thupeh amasa ahi.
en_web: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
en_kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
tcz_gospelgo: “Nanu napa jabol’in,” kiti hi thutep lah a thupeh masapen ahin,

tcz: Nangman napa le nanu najabola ahileh, “nangma dinga thil ijakai hoile pha hung hi ding, chule leiset chunga hi na hinkho sot ding ahi.”
en_web: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
en_kjv: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: “Naphat theiya leiset chunga nahinkho sotna dingin,” jong akati.

tcz: Pateho, nachateu chu sasahna nanei nauva kona lunghan sahna bol hih'un. Chusangin, Pakaiya kona thununna le thuhilnaa seiletsah jouvin.
en_web: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
en_kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pate ho, nachateu sulung hang hin-un, Pakai deiya gahchah le tilkhouna lamjoh a seiletsah jo’uvin

tcz: Soh ho, leiset a napakai teu phatah a jabolna le ginna nei pumin athu uva nungun. Nanghon Christa najen ding bangtah u chun jen un.
en_web: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
en_kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Sohho, Christa thua nanun banguvin, kichat le kihot pumpum in lung jangkeiyin tahsa lama napakaiteu thua nungun;

tcz: Amaho chun na vet-vet pet bouva hilouvin, phat jousen lunglhaisah un. Christaa sohchang nahijal un, Pathen lunglam chu nalung pum piuvin bol un.
en_web: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
en_kjv: not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
tcz_gospelgo: mihem vethoiding maiya hilouvin, hinkhopumpin Christa soh hiuvin, Pathen lungdei chu tonguvin;

tcz: Halpel in na tongun, miho dinga hilouvin Pakaiya dinga natong hijouvin.
en_web: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
en_kjv: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
tcz_gospelgo: mihema hilouvin Pakai lama lunggel’a soh natong hiuvin;

tcz: Geldoh un, Pakaiyin thilpha bol jeh a, eiho khat khat cheh hi tohman eipeh cheh dingu ahi, soh hihen, achamlhat ah hijongleh,
en_web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
en_kjv: knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu soh hihen chamlhat hile thilpha bol chanin Pakaiya kona kipaman asancheh diu naheuve.

tcz: Hitobangma chun pakaiho, nasohteu chu hitima chun bol un. Amaho chu hutum-gihsal bolhih un, nanghon nani lhona vana Pakai khat naneiyu ahi geldoh-un chule Ama chun koima maipha avepoi.
en_web: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
en_kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiya pang ho, sohho chu tobangma chun bol’un, hutum gihsal bol dauvin, ajeh chu ama ho le nang ho nagom’u va Pakai chu van’a aumin, Aman koima dat le langkaina aneilou na heuve

tcz: Achaina keiyin: Pakaiya chule athahat thilbol theinaa chun hat un,
en_web: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
en_kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
tcz_gospelgo: Achaina keiyin Pakaiya pansan athahhat athilbol thei nan kitilkhouvun.

tcz: Pathen galvon ho jouse kivonun hitia chu Diabol doha tintang ho nanan jou sohkeina diu ahi.
en_web: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
en_kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Diabol lungthim gilou chengse masanga napan jouna din Pathen galvon lhingkeiyin kivon’un;

tcz: Ajehchu eiho tahsaphe le thisanpua (mihem) melmato chun kidouva ihipouve, hinla agilou vaipo hotoh chule mutheilou vannoiya athuneiho toh, hiche vannoi muthim lah a hattah a thanei vaipo hotoh, chule van munhoa lhagao gilou engse hotoh kidouva ihiuve.
en_web: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
en_kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile eiho thisan le tahsaphe to kibon ihipouvin, van mun tin’a lhagao gilou engse ho, hiche vannoi muthimvaipo ho, thu neiho, vaihom ho to kidou ihiubouvui.

tcz: Hijeh a chu, nikho phalounia melma chu nadou jou theiyuva, nalethuh jouna dingun Pathen galvon chengse panun. Chujongleh gal akichai jouva jong nangho nadindet jom jingna dingu ahi.
en_web: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
en_kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nikho phalou nia nadin jouva, akhonna geiya dingdet’a nanan jouna diuvin Pathen galvon lhingkeiyin pan’uvin.

tcz: Nadin nauva chun pang det un, thutah konggah in kigah un, chule tipum chu Pathen chonphatna galvon in kivonun.
en_web: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
en_kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thutah chu konggah bang in kigah un, adih chu ompho bangin panin dingun; 15 cham na Kipana Thupha chu kengchot kisesa bangin gotsan kikoiyun,

tcz: Kipana Thupha a kona bulhingset a kigosadema naumtheina dingun chamna chu kengchot in kiseuvin.
en_web: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
en_kjv: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

tcz: Hicheng jouse chungvuma chun, Diabol meikou-thalchangho chu suhmit na dingin tahsan lumdal chu dom sangun.
en_web: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
en_kjv: above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
tcz_gospelgo: hicheng chunga chun agiloupa thalpi meikong tobang chu nasuhmit jouna diuvin tahsan chu lum bangin kidal nan neiyun;

tcz: Huhhingna chu lukhuh in neiyun, chule Lhagao chemjam Pathen Thu chu panun.
en_web: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
en_kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
tcz_gospelgo: chu le huhhingna chu thih-lukhuh bangin kikhuh-un, Lhagaova kon Pathen Thu chu chemjam bangin mangun;

tcz: Lhagaovin phat bih nei jousea le thilsoh jousea tao jingun. Limgehchan umjingun chule muntina mithengte ho jouse dingin nataonauva pangdet jingun.
en_web: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
en_kjv: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
tcz_gospelgo: hiche na ding hin Lhagao mang chan ijakaiyin phat jousen tao jing un lang, chujongle tantih neilouvin phat jousen kiging jingun, mithengte din jong taopeh jinguvin;

tcz: Chule keima dingin jong taovun. Pathen in aphat phat cha thuho eipeh a ngamtah a Pathen thuguh Kipana Thupha alunggon chu Judah mite le chidang namdangho jouse ding ahi hi kahil chet theina dingin.
en_web: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
en_kjv: and for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
tcz_gospelgo: chule keima din jong Kipana Thupha thugil hi paodoh a thu ka sei teng kichentah a het theiya kaseidoh theina dingin neitaokop jingun,

tcz: Keima Pathen Palai kahi naa, hiche thu kaseiphong jeh'a thihkhaova kihena kahi. Hiti ahijeh chun, Ama dinga kaseiphong dingdola lung ngamtah a kasei jing theina dingin neitaopeh un.
en_web: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
en_kjv: for which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche dinga hi thihkhaova kihen’a leng palai kahin, hiche laitah a hi kasei dingdol lom hangtah a kaseina ding ahi

tcz: Tychicus hin keiman ipi kabola chule itobanga kimanchahna kanei ahi thudol bulhing keiya naseipeh dingu ahinai. Ama hi Pakai natohnaa sopi deitah le kithopipha tahsan umtah ahi.
en_web: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
en_kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai hinkhoa lhacha tahsan um sopi deitah Tychicus-in keima umchan ipi kabol nahetnom chengseu nahetsah nauvinte.

tcz: Ama naheng uva dinga kahinsol lona ajeh hi-nangho tilkhou ding le keiho ikatiu hetsah ding kagelkhoh u ahi.
en_web: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
en_kjv: whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho thudol nahet nom chengseu hetsah ding le nalungthim til khou ding ngaitoa ama hi nahenguva kahinsol ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, cham-lungmonna in naumpiu hen, chule Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun ngailutna le kitahna napeuhen.
en_web: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin ngailut le tahsan chule chamna sopite henga um jing hen.

tcz: Pathen milungsetna chu tonsot'in i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailuho jouse chunga umhen.
en_web: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
en_kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. ¶ Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa ngailut ho chengse chu kemthei louvin lungset nan umpi jingu hen

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul le Timothy'a kon ahi. Keiman Philippia um Pathen mitheng teho Christa Yeshua a um upa ho le deacon ho jouse dinga kajih ahi.
en_web: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
en_kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa soh te ni Paul le Timothyn Philippi khoa um Jesu Christa tahsan mithengte le Houbung lamkai chengse, lhacha chengse henga:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa konin lungset le chamna nachunguva um hen.

tcz: Nangho kalunga kageldoh chanin Ka Pathen kathangvah jinge.
en_web: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
en_kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kageldoh phat le ima tih chanin ka- Pathen kathangvah jinge;

tcz: Keiman taona kamanseh le kipah thanom tah in nangho jouse dingin kathumpeh jiuve.
en_web: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
en_kjv: always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
tcz_gospelgo: Phat jousen thangvah to thon nang ho chengse dingin katao jing jengin,

tcz: Ajehchu Christa Kipana Thupha hillhangna thudol a, najah masat niuva pat tuni changeiyin nangho katohkhompi nahi jing uve.
en_web: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
en_kjv: for your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
tcz_gospelgo: Akipat nia pat tuni geiya Kipana Thupha kinbol thudol’a neikithopi jeh- un hitia chu kabol ahi.

tcz: Chule keiman nanghoa natohpha tongpan ah Pathen chun Christa Yeshua ahungkit nikho lhin masangsea Anatoh chu ajoma abulhit teiding ahi ti katahsan akichenin ahi.
en_web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin nang ho sunga thilpha bolpa chun Jesu Christa nikho geiya amolso tei ding dettahin katahsan’e.

tcz: Nangho nabonchauva thudol a keiman lung hitia kagel hi adih ahi, ajehchu nangho kalungsunga kagelkhoh jing nahiuve. Hichea hi keima songkul-lut thudol hihen chule Kipana Thupha lam dol a kihonna thu kaseina hihen chule thutah'a phudetna lam thudol hijongleh, nangho nabonchauva keima toh Pathen lungsetna kachan khompi nahiuve.
en_web: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
en_kjv: even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabonchauva thudol’a hitia lung kagel hi adih-e; ajeh chu kalungthim’a kavop jing nahiuve. Nanghon eikipe lungsetna thudol’a kabulput kahen lhahna hihen lang Kipana Thupha lama kihonna thusei le phudetna ding dol hijongle neichankhompi cheh-u ahiye.

tcz: Ichangeiya nangho kangailut nahiuva chule Christa Yeshua milungsetnaa chu nangho nabonchauva kangai lheh u ahi chu Pathen in ahenai.
en_web: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Nabonchauva lung gil’a ka-ngailut nau kisei hi Jesu Christa lainatpina ka-ngaiyu eihettohpia Pathen ahijenge.

tcz: Nanghoa ngailutna chu aha lonlhah cheh cheh a chule nangho hetna le hetkhenna a nakhantoube chehna dinguva katao ahi.
en_web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
en_kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kataona lopen chu: ngailut naneiyu chu agil cheh cheh a, hetna gelkhenna aletsetna ding kati ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman ipipen chu kiphamoa ham ti nanghon nahetdiu kadeisahpeh nahiuvin, hitia chu Christa ahungkit nikho hunglhun kahsea ngailutna theng le nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu kati ahi.
en_web: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
en_kjv: that ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile nanghon thilpha datchilje nahet-uva, Christa nikho ni le thengsel le nolnabei nahi diu,

tcz: Nangho huhhing nachannau hi ga sona lama nadim jinguva, Yeshua Christa a chonphatna nahin khouva nasodoh theiyuva ahileh Pathen loupina le vahchoina hung hiding ahi.
en_web: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
en_kjv: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ unto the glory and praise of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa vanga Pathen loupina le vahchoina dinga thildih ga chu nadim dingu ahi.

tcz: Chule kasopite, nanghon kahinkhoa ahung sohsaho chengse chu ipipen chu hita jongleh Kipana Thupha machalsahna dinga soh ahi tihi nahet dingu kadeiyin ahi.
en_web: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
en_kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keima chung chang thusoh hi Kipana Thupha machal na joh ahidan nahet diu kadeiye.

tcz: Ajeh chu amitakip, hiche leng inpia umho eivesuiya pang sepai ho chan gei hin Christa jal a thihkhaova kihen kahi ti ahetsoh keiyu ahi.
en_web: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
en_kjv: so that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh hin kabulput kahen lhah hi Christa seijui kahijeh ahi Pretorian sepai ho le midang jouse henga aphongdoh tai.

tcz: Chule keima songkul'a eikikoi jeh a hikoma um atahsan jousen lungngamna le hansanna aneiyuva Pathen thu chu kichatna neilouva aseitheiyu ahi.
en_web: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
en_kjv: and many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
tcz_gospelgo: Chu le kabulput henlhah hi sopite atamjon amun, hanlo na cheh-in aneiyun, gin bei hel’a thusei ding angamlotauve.

tcz: Mi phabep ho chun Christa thu chu kimit thipna le midehnan aseiphongun, chule mi phabep hon lungdih pun aseiyuve, kiti ahi.
en_web: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
en_kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
tcz_gospelgo: Atahbeh-in mi abangin thangset sum le kinahna bep’in Christa aseiphong leuvin, phabep’in vang thilpha deina aseiphongu ahinai.

tcz: Amaho chun Kipana Thupha hongbit a panga kahi aheuvin, keima eingailut jeh uva aseiphongu ahi.
en_web: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
en_kjv: the one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
tcz_gospelgo: Kon khat’ in jong Kipana Thupha panhuna thusei kahi ahetjeh uva ngailutna aneiyu ahi.

tcz: Midangho vang chun Christa thu aseiphongu chu, chang phatchomna lunggel, lungdihpua hilou, thihkhauva kakihen hi bolgenthei bea kaumna ding ngaitoa thuseiphonga ahiuve.
en_web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
en_kjv: but the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
tcz_gospelgo: Kon khatsen vang kabulput henlhah na hi genthei kathoh be cheh ding dei naa lung theng louva Christa asei phongu ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah hichu imacha akhohpoi. Alung gonu chu dihlou hihen, adih hijongleh, Christa thuchu akiseiphong poule kipah a kahi. Chule kipah jomnalai ding kahi.
en_web: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
en_kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh mong ham? Phat lhemna hihen atahbeh hijongle, ipi lam ahiya Christa chu kiseiphong thou ahin, hijeh chun kakipah-e, chule kakipa jing ding ahi;

tcz: Ajeh chu keima dinga nataovu chule Yeshua Christa Lhagao panpina chu, keima eikilhadohna hunghi ding ahi.
en_web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inam itile nang ho tao kop jing jeh le Jesu Christaa kona Lhagao panpina jeh a hiche hi huhhinga kahung umna ding ahi kahei.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman ginchatna le kinepna bulhingset kanei chu, keima jachatna a kachuhlou helding, hinla keima Christa dinga masanga banga lung ngama kaumjom ding ahi. Chule kahinkho hi hinna hihen, thina hijongleh Christa jabolna hung soh ding ahi ti katahsan e.
