en_web: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
en_kjv: according to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
tcz_gospelgo: Kadei gilpen le kakinepna chu katoh dingdol kin pel louva kabol jing theiya, a-itih phat hihen tutah jeng hijongle hakattah a kapan ngam’a hinna hihen thina hijongle katahsa pumpia hi Christa choi-at nading hi ahipen’e.

tcz: Ajehchu keima dinga hin kiti hi Christa dinga hin ahin, chule thi chu aphajo cheh ahi.
en_web: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
en_kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile keima din hin chu Christa ahin, thi chu hamphatna ahi.

tcz: Hinlah tahsaa kahinle, keiman Christa dinga tohga phajo kaboldoh ding ahi. Hijeh chun hoijoh hi aphajo ham ti kahepoi.
en_web: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
en_kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla tahsaphea hin hi tohga pha sona joh ahile, hoijoh lhen kah ding kahepoi.

tcz: Keima lung ngaichat ni neiya lunggel kichi-ah a uma kahi: Keima kache a Christa toh umkhom chu gamchenga keima dinga phajo'ah ahi.
en_web: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
en_kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
tcz_gospelgo: Ni kaha lhenjoh ding helouva moh lunggim kahi, kitel doh a Christa to umkhom ding kadei lheh jenge, hichu kei dinga gam chenga phajo ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah nangho khohsahna a tahsaa kahinjom ding hi kiphamo joa ahi.
en_web: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
en_kjv: nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin la tahsaphea kahin nah lai ding hi nang ho dia khoh jo nalai ahi.

tcz: Nangho jouse tahsanna a nakhantou-uva chule kipana a hetna naneitheina dinguvin, keima hingnalai ing ting nakithopi jomuvinge, ti ginchat hi kaneiyin kahen ahi.
en_web: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
en_kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun um nalai ing ting nabonchauva ka- umpia kipana le tahsan dol’a nakhan tou be na diuva kakithopi ding hi kaginchat’a kahet ahi.

tcz: Chule keima nangho henga avela kahung kit tengleh nanghon Christa Yeshua a kisonna naneibe chehna dinguva kahinkhoa ipi aboldoh ham ti nahet dingu ahi.
en_web: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
en_kjv: that your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu nahenguva kahung kit teng keima jeh a Jesu Christa to nahinkhom nauva kisonna nanei be chehna dingu ahi.

tcz: Chukalvalin, nangho van-gam mite chonin chon un, Christa Kipana Thupha to kitoh in hinkho manguvin. Chuti chun keiman kahunga nangho kahungmu u hihen ahilouleh athua nachung thu'u kajah tho hijongleh, nangho lhagao khat le lungkhatpua nadin khomuva chule Kipana Thupha thua tahsan gal nasatu thudol chu henange.
en_web: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
en_kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
tcz_gospelgo: Keima na henguva hung ing, hung mun, muhih jong leng, Kipana Thupha tahsan lam’a lung khat tah a napan khom’uva, Lhagao khat’a na din khom jing u kajah theina din nanun nakhan, nakhosah dol’u chu Christa Kipana Thupha to kitoh pou pou hen;

tcz: Chule namelmateu kichatsahna a chun kichahih beh un. Hichu amaho kisuhmangna dinga amelchihna hung hiding, hinla nangho vang Pathen Amatah chun nahuhdoh dingu photchetna ahi.
en_web: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
en_kjv: and in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakidoupi-teu masanga kicha louhel’a napan’u chun amaho dinga manthahna ahi-dol aphotchetsah a, nangho dia huhingna ahije amusahding, hiche hi Pathena hungkon ahin,

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho Christa tahsanna a chanpha seh changa nahi pouve, hinlah Ama jal a hahsatna jong thoh dinga chanpha changa nahiuve.
en_web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
en_kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
tcz_gospelgo: Christa jal’a Ama tahsan mai hilouva Ama ding jong nathohgimpi diuva chan kipe nahiuve;

tcz: Hijeh chun masanga thoh gim puma kagalsat namu uvin, tujeng in jong naja soh keiyun ahi.
en_web: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
en_kjv: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu masanga thohgim’a gal kisat chu namu’ vin, tun jong najauvin ahi.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun Christaa hina jal a kitilkhouna um nam? Angailutna a kona lhamonna um nam? Lhagaova kiloikhomna um nam? Lung nemna le kikhotona um nam?
en_web: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
en_kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
tcz_gospelgo: Christa to hinkhomnaa hi kitil khounaa, um dia, haldoh theina ngailut a um dia, Lhagaova kiloi khomna a um dia, dipdam le kilai natpina a um ding le,

tcz: Chuti ahileh nanghon neikipasah tahbeh uvin, chuti chun lung pumpia thukhat kisauvin, khat in khat ngailu uvin, chule lunggel kithakhat neiyin chule doi kithakhat hiuvin.
en_web: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
en_kjv: fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakipana hi suchamkimun, lungthim kitha khat-in, ngailutna chu neicheh- in, thu khat kisauvin, lung khat hiuvin;

tcz: Chang kilunggel bol hih in, midang pachat hol hih'in. Kineosah in, nangma sanga midang chu aphajon gelin.
en_web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
en_kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Moh hamhoitho le kiletsah man’a imacha bol louvin, lung nem heo chan khat’in khat chu ama sanga phajoa gel cheh hiuvin.

tcz: Naphatchomna dingbou velouvin, midang phatchomna ding jong ven.
en_web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
en_kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman ama changseh ding mai gel louvin midang ding jong gelkhoh cheh hiuvin.

tcz: Christa Yeshuan anei lunggel ngaito tobangma chu nanghon jong neiyuvin.
en_web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa sunga cheng lungput chu nang ho sung gil a jong cheng ding ahi.

tcz: Ama Pathen ahijeng vang'in, Pathen toh kibah a, kolchah den chu abolpoi.
en_web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
en_kjv: who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman Pathen lim le mel aput jing jeng vangin, Pumhat’a Pathen to kibah ding agel naisaipoi;

tcz: Chusangin, Pathen ahina dinmun chu alhakangin, soh hina a kingainemna aneiyin chule mihem ahungkiso chun mihem pen ngaiyin ahung pengin,
en_web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
en_kjv: but made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chamtah-in keohel’in akilhan, Soh lim le mel akivon jon, Mihem khat bangin mihem mel’in ahung kilah-in,

tcz: Pathen seingaina jal'in Ama akineosah jengin chule thingpela migilou thina dinmun akilhentai.
en_web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
en_kjv: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina chan geiyin achamtah-in akineosah-in, Thingpel’a thina chan geiyin thun anunge.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Pathen in jabolna sangpen chan gei chun achoisangin chule min dang jouse lah a min chungnung pen chu Ama apeh ahitai.
en_web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
en_kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pathenin Ama chu munsangpen chungvuma akhansanga, Min jouse sanga minthangpen apeh ahin;

tcz: Hitia chu Yeshua mina Van mun'a, chule leiset chunga, chule leinoiya hijongleh khupnei jouse dilsu diu,
en_web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
en_kjv: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu van le leiset chule leiset noiya cheng jousen Dilsua Jesu min’a chibai aboh diu;

tcz: Chule paonei jousen Yeshua Christa hi Pa Pathen loupina dinga Pakai tia aphondoh cheh dingu ahi.
en_web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
en_kjv: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule lei jousen Pa Pathen loupina dinga Jesu Christa chu,’Pakai’ tia aphondoh cheh diu ahi.

tcz: Kangaitah teho, keiman nangho kaumpi petuva kahilnaho nangai bangu chun tu kaumlou pet dehset hin Pathen chu jana lentah le kichatna naneiyu photchetnan, huhhingna chu nahinkho'uvah anatoh in sodoh un.
en_web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
en_kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ahijeh chun kadeitahte, sei na-ngai jing banguvin keima umpet maiya hilouvin, tu ka-umlou pet jengin jong kicha cheh-in ki thing thingin huhhing nachan nau molsona dingin na tongun.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen nasung uva natonga chun Alunglhaina tohdohna dinga ngaichatna le tohdoh theina tha napeuhen.
en_web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
en_kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh inem itile alungnachim ding deichat-na le toh nomna dinga nasunguva natong chu Pathen ma ma ahibouve.

tcz: Nabol chasun'u chu phunchelna le nelkalna jaotha louvin bolun.
en_web: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
en_kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
tcz_gospelgo: Ima jouse phunchel louhle le kinel baotam louhel’in bol’un;

tcz: Hitia chu koima chan Pathen chate nahi nauva nalheplhah louna dingun hiche khang gitlouna le vahkoi mite lah a vannoiya hinna vah chu vahdohsah un.
en_web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
en_kjv: that ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
tcz_gospelgo: chutia chu hiche khang lamvai le vah koiho lah a hi nolnabei le themmona neilou, themmona bei Pathen chate nahiuva, vannoiya nisa banga navah theina diuvin,

tcz: Hinna thuchu tuhchah un hitia chu Christa ahung nitengleh keima kilhaitetna a kajao hi mohjenseh a lhai kahilou, mohseh a tonggima kahilou chu kisonpia kaneitheina ding ahi.
en_web: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
en_kjv: holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu hinna thu seipeh-un; chutile Christa Nikho teng kison-naa kanei theiya, kagimna le kacholna chengse hi moh ahilouje kichen ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kahinkho hi Pathena dia kilhaina a tuisun a kasunlhah ding hijongleh kipah ingting nanghoa tahsan umtah'a Pathena nakikatdoh tobangu hiding ahi. Keiman hiche kipana chu chan neithei nahi cheh dingu kadeipeh nahiuve.
en_web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
en_kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
tcz_gospelgo: Natahsan jal’uva Pathena thilpeh le natohnaa hin kahinna thisan hi kisung lhahel jongle kakipah-in nabonchauva chunga kakitai piuve.

tcz: Henge, nangho kipah unlang, keiman jong nakipa huvinge.
en_web: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
en_kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun kipah-un lang keijong neikipa piu-vin.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua lunglhaina ahileh Timothy hi nangho vila hinsol ding kati ahi. Chuteng chuleh nangho iti naumu aman eihil a konin keidingin jong kisuhhalna hinte.
en_web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
en_kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachung chang thuu kajah teng kitilkhouna kanei theina dinga nahenguva Timothy hinsol vah ding Pakai Jesu jal’in kakinem lheh jenge.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho phatna ding lungdihpua lunggel ngaitona nei Timothy tobang nagelkhoh diu kahehih e.
en_web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
en_kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachung chang thuu lung thengsel’a gel khoh a ama tobang midang kaneipoi.

tcz: Midangho hin ama ama phattouna ding kigelkhoh'ah ahiuvin Yeshua Christa lam thu chu agelkhoh pouve.
en_web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mi- dang hon amaho ding jeng bou aki-hol’uvin, Jesu Christa thudol’a imacha agelkhoh pouve.

tcz: Hinlah Timothy hin amatah ahinan photchenna aneiyin, hiti hin chapa le apa tobang'in kipana thupha seiphongnaa keimatoh tongkhom ahi ti nanghon naheuve.
en_web: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
en_kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
tcz_gospelgo: Timothy vang aphat chomje naheuve, ajeh chu chapan apa akithopi banga Ki-pana Thupha thua hi soh na tong banga keima eitoh hu ahiye.

tcz: Hilai muna kachung thu ipi aso aphotchetna aum tengleh ama nangho henga hinsol ding kati ahi.
en_web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
en_kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun keima umchan ding dol akihet phat phat le ama hi hinsol ding kinem jing kahi.

tcz: Chule Pakaiya kakisonna chu nanghoto kimuto vahding hi kakineme.
en_web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
en_kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima tah jong kahung loi ding hi Pakaiya konin kagingcha lheh jenge.

tcz: Tutadia dingin Epaphroditus nahenguva hinsol ding kangaito ahi. Amahi sopi dihtah tohkhompi ahi.
en_web: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
en_kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngailutna kinbol dia na-solchah-u, kaseipai chanpi le toh khompi, sopi Epaphroditus hi na-henguva hinsol loi ding khoh kasa-tai;

tcz: Aman namu nomlheh jenguvin nahenguva kahinsol e. Chule ana dammo thudol najah uchu phamo asalheh jenge.
en_web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
en_kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
tcz_gospelgo: ama dammo thu najah-u chu nommo asa lheh jengin, hijeh chun nabonchauvin namu nom lheh jenguve.

tcz: Tahbeh in ama ana dammon chule thidehchet anahi'e. Hinla Pathen mikhotona chu achangin chule keima eikhoto dehset ahi. Ajeh chu keima lungkhamna chung chona lungkhamna kaneibe louna ding hiya ahi.
en_web: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
en_kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile anan athideh chet jenge, ahivangin Pathenin akhoton, amaseh hilouvin keijeng jong lunggimna sangson kanei louna din eikhotoi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu ama nangho koma hinsol ding kagelkhoh ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon ama namu tenguleh nakipa uva chule nangho kalung olmopeh tahlouna ding ahiye.
en_web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
en_kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama namu tengu nakipa kit theiyuva kalunggimna jong alhom dom theina dinga ama hi kahinsol loi jeng ahi.

tcz: Christian kingailutna chun kipah thanomtah in ama analemuvin chule hitobang mihi jabolna nei chu thilpha ahi.
en_web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
en_kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun Pakai jal’in Kipana tincheng to thon anasangun lang, hitobang mi hi jabol’uvin;

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Christa natohna a ahinkho ahahsatna ato ahi. Chule nanghon mun gamlatah a kona naboltheilou diu jeh a nangho thalhenga keima dinga aman eibolpeh ahi.
en_web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
en_kjv: because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile aman keima neijen nauva abang khai jouse bulhitna din ahinkho geiyin atohdoh jengin, Christa ding natohnaa athilo deh chet jenge.

tcz: Kasopi ngaitah teho, ipi chu hita jongleh Pakaiya kipah thanom'un. Hitiho seiding hi kachimpoi, chule hiche hi natahsanu honbitna ding ahijoi.
en_web: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
en_kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, tukalse vang Pakai chunga kipah jingun. Nang ho dia aphat chomjeh-in kasutsa velsut kit ding kachimdehpoi.

tcz: Chuche uicha ho lah a chun chingtheiyun–kihongphauvin, hitobang miho chun thilse abolun, hitobang miho chun huhhing channa dinga chep natan diu ahi atiuve.
en_web: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
en_kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
tcz_gospelgo: Uichate chu kivet phat’un, thilse bol ho chu kivet phat’un lang cheptan lou khohsah ho chu kivetphet’uvin.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eiho Pathen lhagaova kon a Pathen hou cheptan tahbeh ihiuvin, Yeshua Christa natoh chaisa a chu kingamdet'a, tahsalama kisonna neilou ihiuve.
en_web: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
en_kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen Lhagaova Pathen chibai boh a Christa Jesu jal’a kisonna nei, tahsaphea kisong lou eiho hi cheptan dihtah ihiuve.

tcz: Keima tahsalam boltheina jeh a kisong jeng jongleng kisong thei kahi. Tahbeh mongin midangin tahsa lama kisonna aneitheile keiman kisoncheh theina kaneiye.
en_web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
en_kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsaphea cheptan kisonpi ding hijongle kiphat lamna kaneipoi. Khattouvin tahsaphea cheptan chu akisonpi dingle ken kakheljoi.

tcz: Keima ni-get nia cheptan kahin, Israel mi hina pen-gui chu kaneiyin, chule Benjamin phunga kon Hebrew mi atahbeh chu kahi. Judate Dan juina lama hakattah Pharisee ho lah a mi kahi;
en_web: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
en_kjv: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
tcz_gospelgo: Niget nia chep kitan, Israel chilhah, Benjamin phung Hebrew chilhah Hebrew mi, Danthu dungjuiya Pharisee kahin,

tcz: Keima katom ngai behseh jeh in houbung chu hoisetah in kana gimbol in, chule chonphat lamdol a keima danthua nolnabeiya jui bukima kahi.
en_web: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
en_kjv: concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
tcz_gospelgo: tompan jeh a Houbung bolsea pang, them channa dia Danthu lamdol’a nolnabei kahi.

tcz: Keiman hichehohi atila chu manlutah a kana ngaisang anahi, hinlah tun keiman Christan anatoh chaisa jal'in hiho chu mohseh in kageltai.
en_web: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
en_kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hitobang phatchomna kanei hi aboncha Christa jal’a pannabei thil’a kagel ahitai.

tcz: Christa Yeshua chu Pakai ahi tia kahet a pat'in hiho jouse chu pannabei bep in kagel tai. Keiman Christa chu kaphatchompi theina dinga thil adang jouse chu nen kikholkhom tobang bep'a kangaitoa kanungsun ahitai.
en_web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
en_kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-Pakai Jesu Christa hetna hin akhokhelsoh hel phat’in thildang jouse hi manthahna, imacha hilouva ka-ngaito ahin, Ama jal’a thil ijakai hi kapaidoh a, Christa chu kaphatchompi theina dinga adang hi eh tobanga kagela

tcz: Danthu juina a keima chonphatna chu hitalouva Amatoh thakhat kahia hitia chu keima Christa tahsan jal a chonpha eikisima ahitai. Ajeh chu tahsan jal'a Pathen in eiho chonpha a eisemu ahitai.
en_web: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
en_kjv: and be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunggil’a keima kakimudoh a, themchanna chu Danthu vanga kanei hilouva, tahsan jal’a Pathena hungkon them channa, hiche themchanna chu Christa tahsan vanga kanei theiya,

tcz: Keiman Christa chu kahet nomin, agimthohna chu thoh khoma, athina chu chankhompi kahi theina ding chule Ama thinaa kona kaithoupa thahat thilbol theina chu kachan theina ding kati ahi.
en_web: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
en_kjv: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama le athokit thahatna kahet’a athohgimna chu kathoh khompia, athina banga chu kathi nom ahin,

tcz: Hitia chu ipi iti jongleh keiman thinaa kona thokitna chu kachan teiding ahi.
en_web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
en_kjv: if by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: kajo pou le thinaa kona jong katho doh ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman hicheho chu kaneitai kati ahipoi, ahilouleh keima chamkimna chu chang kahitai katipoi. Hinlah keima Christa Yeshuan einei banga hi keiman jong hiche chamkimna chu kaneina teiding kadel ahi.
en_web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman kalahsa ahiloule chamkimsaa jong kahipoi; Christa Jesun keima eimat khah banga ken jong mat khah tei ding kagot joh ahibouve.

tcz: Kasopiteho, keiman hichu kanei hih laiye, hinla hiche thil khat bou hi kagut ahi. Keiman achesa thil chu kasumilin, kamasanga ipi umham ti kagelkhoh in ahi.
en_web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
en_kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keiman mankha taa keiya hisah mongin kagelpoi, kagel khat vang hi achesa thil jouse chu kasumil jin, masang lama thil ho kadeljoi;

tcz: Keiman kilhaitetna chu achaina geiya lhailhunga chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua a eikounau van kipaman sanna ding mun chu hadel'a del kahi.
en_web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa jal’a chunga Pathen kouna dungjuiya hatman sanna dia abidoi mun chu hadel’a del kahi.

tcz: Lhagaova apilhing chengsen hichehoa hin kinoptou hite. Ipiham jeh a lungkim louna nei aumle, hijong chu Pathen in naseichet peh tauvinte.
en_web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
en_kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun eiho apilhingsa sen hitobang hin lung gel’u hitin, ijemtia khattouvin thilchom agel jongle hijong chu Pathenin nahenguva phongdoh nante.

tcz: Hinlah eihon imasonnau chan geiya hi i-tuhchah diu angaiye.
en_web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
en_kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle eihon iphah sau chan geihin chon’u hite.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, keima umchan tobang hin nangho jong um uvin, chule keimaho nung juiya pangho um chana konin kihil uvin.
en_web: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
en_kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nabonchauvin keima umchan jom’uvin. Navetkah diuva chon keiho umchan jop ho vechen’uvin.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh masanga kanaseipeh matchet jiu bangun chule tua jong kamit a kamitlhi puma kaseipeh u ahi, amaho chu achonnau chun Christa Thingpel melmaho ahiuve ti aphotchenu ahi.
en_web: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
en_kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mitampi achon nau hi najah-uva tamtah vei kaseisa ahitan, tua jong kap puma kasei ahi, amaho hi Christa Thingpel douva ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho chun mahthahna lam amanouve. Amaho atumpiu chu a pathenu ahi, akithangatnau chu jachat akimuna diu, amaho chun tuhinkhoa dingbou agelu ahi.
en_web: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
en_kjv: whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun akikhon nau chu manthahna ahin, a-pathenu chu agilpiu ahi; akithang at nau chu jumna ahin, leiset thil ho jeng bou agel’uve.

tcz: Ahinlah eiho Pakai Yeshua Christa chenna van-gam mite ihiuve. Chule eiho huhhingpu ahungkitna ding chu kinem'a ngah jinga ihiuve.
en_web: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho vang igammi hinau chu van chunga hung kipan ahin, hichea kona chu Huhhingpa Pakai Jesu Christa hung ding kinemtah a i-ngau ahi;

tcz: Aman itahsau thithei hi alah a, Amaa banga loupina vouphea akhel ding, Aman thil ijakai athuneina thunoiya akoi banga athua ahin nunsah ding ahi.
en_web: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
en_kjv: who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman athilbol thei thahatna chu thil ijakai hi anoiya akoisoh a, eiho tahsa manmo hi Ama tahsa loupi tah lim’a akhel doh ding ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun kasopi deitahteho, Pakaiyah umdet jingun. Kasopi deitahteho keiman nangho kangailu uvin chule kamunom uve, ajeh chu nangho hi kakipana le kanatohna kalallukhuh nahiuve.
en_web: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
en_kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun kasopi ngaitah le deitah te, kakipana le kalal lukhuh ho, hibang tah hin ngaitahte Pakai hinkhon dingdet jinguvin.

tcz: Tun keiman Euodia le Syntyche hengah, Pakaiya nahi lhon jeh in nakitomo nalhon chu umsah lhon tahih in tia kangehlhon nahi.
en_web: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
en_kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Euodia le Syntyche chu Pakai jal’a kihoutoh dinga deichom tah a ka-ngeh ahi lhon’e.

tcz: Chule nangma katohkhompi dihtah, nangman hiche numei teni hi kithopin, ajeh chu amani hi mi dang kipana thupha seiphong pehnaa gun chutah a pang lhon'ah ahi. Amani hi Clement to chule Hinna Lekhabua amin kisun dang hoto tongkhoma ahiuve.
en_web: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
en_kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahi, kanamkoljon put khompi ginchat umtah nang jong ka-ngeh nahi, hiche numei ho hi kithopin, ajeh chu amaho ahiuvin, Clement ahin, adang dang katoh khompi chengsen Kipana Thupha thudol’a hatah a eitoh khompiu ahin, hinna lekhabu sunga hicheng min hi aumtai.

tcz: Pakaiya kipahtah in umjingun. Avel'in tikit inge–Kipahtah in umjingun.
en_web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
en_kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chunga kipah jingun, tikit leuvinge kipah-un.

tcz: Amitakip in naum nauva nabol jouseuva lunggel toh them nahiu hehen. Pakai hungloi tading ahi geldoh un.
en_web: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
en_kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachon nem’u chu mihem jouse het hihen. Pakai ahung naiye.

tcz: Imacha lungolmona neihih un, chusangin, imalam jousea dingin taovun. Nangaichat chu Pathen henga seiyun, chule athilbol dohsaho jal in thangvahna peuvin.
en_web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
en_kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Imacha lungkhamna nei hih hel’un, ahin ima lam jousea taona le thumna mangin thangvah to thon nathum jouseu Pathen hetsah-uvin.

tcz: Chuti henlang hileh Pathena cham-lungmonna, ijakai hetna a khelsohkeiya chun, nalungu le nalungthimu Christa Yeshua a nahi jaluva chu napeh dingu ahi.
en_web: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuteng hetna jouse kho-khelsoh Pathena hungkon cham nan Christa Jesu to nahinkhom nauva nalung thim’u le nalunggel jouseu ahonbit ding ahi.

tcz: Chule tun, kasopi deitah teho, achaina keiyin-akitah lam, ja-umdollam, adihlam, athenglam, lungset umle pachat umlam, aphalam le pachat theilama auma ahileh hitiho hi lunggel un.
en_web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
en_kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, tukalsen vang ipi hile thutah dia kilompen, ja-thei doltah, adih dia ginchat pen, thengpen dia kilom, santhei doltah, thucheng ngei pen, ipi hile phatna dia lom auma pachat na thei aumle, hiti ho hi gel them’uvin.

tcz: Nanghon keiya kon a nakihilsa hou, nasansa ho-u chule keima a kon a najahsa hou le namusahou nitin in juiyun. Chuteng cham-lungmon Pathen chun naumpi dingu ahi.
en_web: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
en_kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule keiya kona nakihil’uva nalahsau, najahsau chule namusau chengse chu nang hon jong bol’uvin, chuteng cham konna Pathenin naumpi jing diu ahi.

tcz: Nanghon keima neigelkhoh kitnau jeh a Pakai iti kavahchoi hitam! Nanghon keima neigelkhoh jinguve ti kahei, hinla nanghon chutia kithopina thei phat kijen namulouvu ahi.
en_web: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
en_kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitih nunga kaphatna ding nahin thah bol kit leuvu hi Pakai chunga hapan kakipah lheh jenge; nagot jingsau vang ahinan, phat kitup kom namu loujeh-u ahi.

tcz: Hichu kangaichat umjeh a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kanei khama chu lung lhaiya umje kahet ahi.
en_web: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
en_kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
tcz_gospelgo: Kalhahsam man a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keima hi kahi bang bep’a lung lhaiya umje kihil themsa kahintai.

tcz: Keiman imacha neilouva um ahilouleh ijakai neiya umje kahen ahi. Itobang phat hunglhung dinga jong, oivaset ahilouleh keltah a umje jong chule ninglhingset hihen lhomcha hijongleh hiche thuguh chu kahet ahitai.
en_web: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
en_kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
tcz_gospelgo: Vaicha tah a umje kahen, neng jeng junga umje jong ka hei; ima jouse le ijakaiya oivaset a umje le gilkel tah a umje, ning lhingset le vaicha tah a umje thuguh kihil them kahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima thahat eipea Christa jal a chu ijakai bolthei kahi.
en_web: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
en_kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihatsahpa Christa vanga ijakai bol thei kahi.

tcz: Hitima chun, nanghon tupet kahahsatna a neipanhu uhi nabol phalheh jenguve.
en_web: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla kagenthei pet tah a neikithopiu hi nabolpha lheh-ui.

tcz: Philippia um nanghon nahenguva Kipana Thupha kahinpohpeh uva chu, nahetma banguvin, sum le paiya eikithopia nangho bou nahiuvin chule Macedonia a kona kagakholjin patkit chun koima houbung in achutibol pouvin ahi.
en_web: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
en_kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana Thupha kipat til, Macedonia kadalhah chun nang ho tilou Houbung koimacha peh le lah thudol’a eikithopi aum louje Philippi mi nang hon nahet’u ahi.

tcz: Thessalonica kho a kaumpet jengin jong kithopina khatveiseh hilouvin avel in neihin thot uvin ahi.
en_web: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
en_kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
tcz_gospelgo: AjehchuThessalonica khoa ka-umpet jeng jong chun ka-ngaichat hunnan avel vel’in neihin thot’uve.

tcz: Keiman hiche kaseihi nanghoa thilpeh chu kangaichat ahipoi. Chusangin, lungsetthem nahijal uva kipaman nasandiu chu kadeijoh ahi.
en_web: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
en_kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilpeh chu kadei man ahipoi, nangho dinga aga apun ding joh chu kadei joh ahibouve.

tcz: Tupet in kangaichat jouse kaneiye-chukalval in Epaphroditus khut a nathil peh u chun ninglhingset in eineisah'e. Hicheho chu kilhaina gimnamtui kihal Pathena dinga santheile lunglhai umtah ahi.
en_web: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
en_kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well pleasing to God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijakai neipeh nau lekha hiche hi ahin, kaning lhingin, nang hoa kona santhei doltah, kikilhaina tobang thilpeh gimnamtui, Pathen lungdei lamtah kamun, kanei bulhingsettai.

tcz: Chule hiche Pathen, keima eigelkhohpeh a chun, aloupinaa Christa Yeshua a ahao dungjuiyin nangaichat jouseu chu pebukim nauvinate.
en_web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho jong ka-Pathenin ahao dungjuiyin loupinan Jesu Christa hinkhon na-ngaichat chan’u subulhit nante.

tcz: Tun I-Pau Pathen'a chun loupina jouse atonsot atonsot in umjing hen! Amen.
en_web: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
en_kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pau Pathen chu tonsot, tonsot geiyin loupi jing jeng hen: Amen.

tcz: Pathen mithengte jouse, Christa Yeshua a hiho jouse chu keima a konin salam anapeuvin. Sopite kaumpi chengsen salam nahin peuvin ahi.
en_web: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
en_kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu hinkhoa hing mitheng josue salam’uvin, Kaumpi sopiten nasalam’uve.

tcz: Chule Pathen mithengte adang dangho jousen salam nahin thot uve, adehset in Caesar insung mitea konin salam napeuve.
en_web: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
en_kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cesar’s household.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitheng jouse ahideh chun Caesar insung miten nasalam’ui.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagaovu umpi hen.
en_web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. ¶ It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetnan nalhagaovu umpi jing hen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen in alunglama alhendoh Christa Yeshua solchah Paul le i-sopiu Timothy a kon ahi.
en_web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
en_kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa solchah a pang Paul le sopi Timothyn

tcz: Pathen mithengte Colossae khopia um, Christa a tahsan umtah sopiho henga dinga kahin jih'u ahi. I Pau Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en_web: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: to the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Colossae khoa um Christa sunggil’a mithengte le tahsan um ho, i-Pau Pathena konin lungset le chamna na chunguva um jing hen.

tcz: Keiho nangho dingin katao jingun chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen chu kathangvah jingun ahi.
en_web: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
en_kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho phat jousen nang ho din kataovun, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen kathangvah jingui.

tcz: Kipana Thupha thutah nanajah patniuva pat nangho dinga kinepna vana kikoipeh nahi tauve.
en_web: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
en_kjv: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Jesu Christa hinkhoa natahsanu le mitheng jouse na-ngailut’u ka jauvin,

tcz: Ajeh chu keihon Christa Yeshua a natahsanu chule Pathen mite jouse nangailut u thudol kanaja tauve.
en_web: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
en_kjv: for the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho dinga kinepna chu van’a kholsa ahitai, hichu Kipana Thupha thutah thudol’a chun najatauvin,

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha nahenguva hung chu vannoi muntin a kisol a ahitai. Pathen milungsetna kidangtah thu najahpat uva chule thutah thu chu nahet chet niuva pat a nahinkhou akikhel banga gasoa hinkhoho akikhelsah ahi.
en_web: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
en_kjv: which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche nahenguva ahung lhun a pat nalah-uva aumdol bangin vannoi pumpia aga pung lheh jengin, najah niuva pat Pathen lungsetna chu thutah-in amachal jingin ahi.

tcz: I-sopiu deitah katohkhompiu Epaphras a kon in jong Kipana Thupha nanahe tauve. Amahi Christa lhacha tahsan umtah le nangho thalhenga eikithopiuva pangah ahi.
en_web: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
en_kjv: as ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi nang hon kangailut tah-u le sohna katoh khompiu Ephras a kona nahetdoh-u ahin, ama hi Christa dinga keiho cheng thalhenga tahsan umtah le lhachaa pang ahin,

tcz: Amahin Lhagao Thengin napeh u ngailutna naneiyu thu eiseipeh u ahi.
en_web: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
en_kjv: who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: ama hin lhagao vin napeh-u ngailutna naneiyu chu eiseipeh-u ahi.

tcz: Nangho thu kajah niuvapat nangho dinga tao jinga kahiuve: hichu Alunglam nahet bulhingset uva chule Lhagaolama chihna le hetthemna napehna dinguva tao kahiuve.
en_web: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
en_kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche kajah niuva pat chihna tincheng le Lhagao jal’a Ama lungdei lam hetna le datkhen dol nadimsetna diuvin nang ho din taopeh le thumpeh na tang louhel kahiuve; 10 hichu imalam jousea Pakai lung lhaina to kitoh a nachon theiyuva, thilphalam natohana jouse a naga theiyuva, Pathen hetna lama jong nakhan touvuva,

tcz: Hichea chu nahinkho mandan u Pakai jabolna le lunglhaina ahijinga, chule nahinkhou chun gapha asodohna dinga, chule Pathen hetna a nakhantou becheh cheh theina dingu hi ahiye.
en_web: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
en_kjv: that ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

tcz: Kataonau jong hi, nangho athaneina loupi jal a nangho thahatsah a thohhatle lungdehat nangaichat dungjui uva napeh uva kipana a nadim letsetna dingu ahi.
en_web: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
en_kjv: strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
tcz_gospelgo: aman athahatna loupi tah a kona thil ijakai thoh hat tah a na thoh theina diuva kidang tah a nahatsah-uva kipah tah a

tcz: Vah'a cheng Amithengte chuto goulo ding Apeh chu changkhom dinga eisemuva Pachu thangvah jingun.
en_web: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
en_kjv: giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho chengse khovah laiya leng amithengte to lengkhom dinga lomtah a gongtoh Pa chu nathangvah theina diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Amahin muthim lenggama kona eihuhdoh uva chule Alungset Chapa Lenggam mia eisemu ahitai.
en_web: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
en_kjv: who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
tcz_gospelgo: Aman muthim khojin tha neinaa kona eihuhdoh-uva, a-Chapa deitah lenggam sunga eipuilut’u ahitai.

tcz: Athisana chamlhatna eichohdoh peh uva, ichonsetnau jengjong angaidam ahitai.
en_web: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
en_kjv: in whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
tcz_gospelgo: Achapa jal’a chu lhatdohna le chonset ngaidamna ineiyu ahi.

tcz: Christa chu mutheilou Pathen chu muthei limpua hung ahi. Ama thil kisem masangpeh a ana umsa chule thilsem jouse chunga thunei vaihoma ahi.
en_web: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
en_kjv: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa chu mu theilou Pathen limpu ahin, thilsem jouse sanga masajo ahi;

tcz: Ajeh chu Ama jal a Pathen in ijakai vana hihen chule leichunga umho hijongleh, imutheiyu le imutheilouvu hijongleh anasem ahi-laltouna ho, lenggamho, vaipoh naho, chule thuneinaho akimuphalou vannoi pumpia um, aboncha Ama jal le Ama dinga kisema ahi.
en_web: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
en_kjv: for by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile ama jal’a thil ijakai, van a hihen leiset chunga hijongle, muthei le mumo ho, laltouna ho le loinehna gam ho gei, vaihom thu neina ahin, thil ijakai hi Ama jalle Ama dinga kisem ahi;

tcz: Ama imacha um masangpeh a anaumjingsa ahin, chule Aman thilsem jouse akhut a atuh ahi.
en_web: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
en_kjv: and he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
tcz_gospelgo: chule Ama chu thil jouse masanga anaum jing ahin, thil ijakai hi Amato akijopmat teng ding det ahiuve.

tcz: Christa hi houbung luchang (hichu Ama tipum) ahi. Ama abul kipatna, thinaa kon a thoudoh jouse chunga thuneipa ahijeh a, ima jousea masapen ahi.
en_web: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
en_kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu atahsa Houbung luchang, abul ahin, ima lam jousea amasat jingna din athiho lah a jong athoudoh masapen’e.

tcz: Ajeh chu hichu Pa lunglam ahi.
en_web: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
en_kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijehinem itile Chapa sunga hi Patheinin chamkimkeiya chenpha adei ahi;

tcz: Chule Christa a hi Pathen hina bulhingset um thingpel chunga Christa thisan kiso chun kichamna asem a; van'a umho hihen chuleh leiya umho hijongleh Pathen in ijakai Ama a dinga chamna chu asem ahitai.
en_web: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
en_kjv: and, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Ama jal’a thil ijakai aboncha ahenga suhchamsoh a, Ama vangle a-Thingpel thisan jal’a leiset chunga um jouse le vanlaijol’a um jouse kah a chamna asem ahitai.

tcz: Hichehin, masanga nangho Pathen a kona gamlatah a naum uva, nalunggel u phaloule chonna phatlou jeh a amelmate nanahiu ahiye.
en_web: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
en_kjv: And you, that were sometimes alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
tcz_gospelgo: Masang laiya thilse nabol’uva lunggel’a nadou laiyun Pathena kona pamse nahiuvin,

tcz: Chuti jongleh, tua hi Christa hin atahsa tah a thina ato ahitah jeh in, Amatah in kichamna chu asem ahitai. Hiche hin, themmona neokhat jong neitalouva athenga le nolna beiya Ama angsunga nadinsah u ahitai.
en_web: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
en_kjv: in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
tcz_gospelgo: tua vang Ama angsunga nolna beihel le boh beh lou, athenga dinsah dinga tahsaphe pua athina tahsa jal’a chu nakicham piu ahitan;

tcz: Hijongleh nanghon hiche thutah hi natahsan jomuva chule nadin detjom dingu ahi. Kipana Thupha nanajah uva nakisan u photchetna a kon chun kiheimang gohihbeh un. Hiche Kipana Thuphahi vannoi leiset munjousea kihillhanga ahitai, chule keima Paul hi Pathen lhacha hina a seiphong dinga eikingansea ahitai.
en_web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
en_kjv: if ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
tcz_gospelgo: tahsan’a nadindet jinguva, dettah le longlouva, najahsau Kipana Thupha kinepnaa chu long louhel’a napandet jing dingu ahi. Hiche Kipana Thupha chu vannoi thilsem jouse henga kiseiphongsoh ahitan, keima Paul jong hiche lhachaa chu pang ka hi.

tcz: Katahsatah a nangho dinga kagimthoh hi kakipah-e, ajeh chu keiman Christa hesoh thohna'a atipum, hichu Houbung, kathoh khompi ahi ti kahet ahi.
en_web: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
en_kjv: who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
tcz_gospelgo: Tun nang ho dinga hesoh genthei kathoh jouse hi kakipapi. Ajeh chu katahsaphea thohna hin atahsaa kisim Houbung thalhenga Christa gimgentheina bangkhai jouse asuh bulhit ahi.

tcz: Pathen in Ahoubung lhacha kinbol dinga eingansea Athupoh chu poa nangho henga phongdoh dinga hunga kahi.
en_web: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
en_kjv: whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche dinga chu Pathen gouching kahiya, na henguva Pathen thu lhingkeiya seiphong dinga eiki-ngense dungjuiya keima lhachaa pang kahi;

tcz: Hiche thupoh hi kum aja ja a chule akhang khanga aguh a kikoi chu, tua hi Pathen mite henga kilangdoh a ahitai.
en_web: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
en_kjv: even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
tcz_gospelgo: hiche thuguh hi tonsot tonsot, akhang khanga ki-im ahin, tua vang amithengte henga kiphongdoh ahi tai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa a ahaona le aloupina chu chidang namdang nangho jong nahetsah nom hin Aloupina nachantha nomu ahi ti aphotchetna ahi.
en_web: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
en_kjv: to whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin hiche thuguh thalhinje le loupije itobang lom ahi chu namtin henga hilchet ding adeitan, hiche kinepna loupipen nasunguva Christa achen hi ahi.

tcz: Hijeh a hi keihon midang Christa thu kaseipeh uva, amitakip Pathen in chihna eipeh jouseu mangcha a hilchah le thuhilna kaneiyu hi, amitakip Christa to akiguijopnau chamkimsahna dinga ahi.
en_web: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
en_kjv: whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
tcz_gospelgo: Amabou hi kaphonjal’uva mitin kathumop’uva, chihna top’a mijouse kahilchah-u ahi; ajeh chu amitakip hi Christa dinga pilhingsaa kadinsah nom’u ahi.

tcz: Hijeh a hi keima tonggima kiseh tah a kapan a, kasunga Christan thahattah'a anatoh a chu kingam'a kahi.
en_web: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
en_kjv: whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nadinga hi Aman kasunga eikhumpeh thahat tah a natong jing ahatna chu mangchaa kiseh tah a tonggim ka hi.

tcz: Keiman nangho le Laodicea a um houbungho chule tahsaa kakimupi loulaiho chengse dinga nasatah a kapohnat peh uhi nahet dingu kalunggot ahi.
en_web: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
en_kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho ding le Laodicea khoa um ho ding chule tahsaphea kamai mukha lou hel ho ding geiya itobang tah a kihabol kahije hi nahetdiu kadeiye.

tcz: Keiman amahohi alunguva lhamonna aumtheina dinga amahohi tilkhouva chule ngailutnaa akikandet uva, hitia hi amahon Pathen lunggon thuguh Christa Amatah a um chu ahetdoh theina dingu kangaito ahi.
en_web: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
en_kjv: that their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God and of the Father, and of Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu alung thimu akilhep bi theiya, ngailtunaa akikankhom’uva, hetkhenna lhingset, neng jeng junga aneiyuva, Pathen selguh Christa chu ahetdohna diu ahi.

tcz: Ama a chu chihna le hetna gou aboncha kisela ahi.
en_web: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
en_kjv: in whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga chun chihna le hetna gou jouse akisel’e.

tcz: Hiche kaseipeh uhi koimachan doha pana nangho mohthua na lheplhah louna dingu ahi.
en_web: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
en_kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi koiman seithem’a nanel lhah louna diuva kasei ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman tahsa a nalah uva kaumlou vang'in, lhagaovin kaumpiuve. Chule keiman nachondih ule Christaa natahsan det u thu chu kipahtah in kave jinge.
en_web: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
en_kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa hin nalahuva lha hih jong leng lhagaovin nang ho to kalhahkhomin, kigah chah tah a napan det jeu le Christa natahsanjeu kipah-in kaseijinge.

tcz: Chule tun, nanghon Christa Yeshua chu Pakaiya nakisan bangu chun, Ama chu juijomun.
en_web: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
en_kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa chu Pakai dinga nakisan’u ahitah jeh-in, Amato hingkhom’un;

tcz: Nakihilsa banguvin, Ama a jungkho uvin lang, thutah'a chun kisahdoh un, chule thangvahna dimletset in hinguvin.
en_web: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
en_kjv: rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga jung khouvin, kisadoh-un, nakihil banguvin tahsan nan kiphutdet’un, thangvah nan bulhingset’uvin.

tcz: Mihem lunggel leh hiche vannoi lhagao thuneihoa hungkon chihgut lekhathemna le doha lheplhah a na-umlouna dingun chingtheiyun, hichu Christa a kon ahipoi.
en_web: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
en_kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman chihgut lekha themna le mihemte pehson doha lhep lhahna thei moh thu homkeiuva gal-hing banga nakai mang louna diuvin ching theiyun, hichu vannoi leiset chondan dungjui bou ahin, Christa-a tobang ahipoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Christa mihem tahsaa chu Pathen hina bulhingset a chenga ahi.
en_web: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
en_kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Christa sung, atahsa sunga chu Pathen, a-Pathen hina chamkimsoh a pansa ahin,

tcz: Chule nangho hichea chu kisuchamkima nahiuve, amachu piputle thuneina jouse luchang ahi.
en_web: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
en_kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
tcz_gospelgo: vaipoh thu neina jouse luchang Christa to na hinkhom tengu le nang ho jong chamkimji nahiuve;

tcz: Nangho Christa henga nahunguva chu aman lhagaova chep natan peh-u ahitai, hinla hichu tahsaa cheptan ngai chu hitalouvin, chonna ngai chonsetnomna chu atanlhah ahibouve.
en_web: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
en_kjv: in whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh, by the circumcision of Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga chu nang ho khut’a kitan hilou, cheptan nahiuvin, tahsaphe pu tahsa chu ponse selhah banga napaiyuva, Christa dinga chep kitan nahiutauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu baptize nachanuva chu Christa toh kivuitha nahi tauve. Chule nanghon Christa kaithoupa Pathen thahat chu natahsan jaluva Amatoh hinkho thah a kaithouva uma nahi tauve.
en_web: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
en_kjv: buried with him in baptism, wherein also you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile baptize nachan’uva chu amato kivuitha nahitauvin, Pathenin Ama chu thinaa athodoh kit, hiche thokitna chu tahsan jal’a amato thoukhom kit nahiutauve.

tcz: Nachonset nau le chonsetnom naho chu paidoh a um ahiloulai jeh a nangho athia nanahiu ahi. Pathen in ichonsetnau angaidam tahjeh a Christa to eihin khomsah u ahitai.
en_web: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
en_kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho chonset’a thisa, natahsapheu jong cheptan lou nahiuvin, Pathenin Christa to nachohing khom’uva ichonsetna jouseu angaidamsoh ahitai.

tcz: Aman eiho dounaa themmo chansahna bat lekhabua kijih chu akah a, chule thingpel'a akhetbeh tah jeh a alahmang ahitai.
en_web: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
en_kjv: blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
tcz_gospelgo: Eidou dal’uva pang khut’a kisun kihilna lhongpi Danthu chu Christan anoi manga, hichu asumangsoh-in Thingpel’a akhetbeh tai.

tcz: Hiti chun aman lhagao lama vaipohole thuneiho chu athaneinau alahpeh a, thingpel'a agaljona jal'a chu amaho chu lhangphonga maimoh-a alha ahitai.
en_web: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
en_kjv: and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
tcz_gospelgo: Christan vaipoh thu neina jouse ahoh lhasoh-in, atahsa chun abonchan ajousoh-in, kichentah-in aphongjal’e.

tcz: Hijehchun nangho naneh u ahiloule nadonu ahiloule nikho khat achoma nitloujeh ahiloule lhathah nikho nit ahilouleh choldo nikho thua koiman na-oimo dauhen.
en_web: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
en_kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of a holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh-in koiman anneh thu, donthei thu, kut thudol, lhathah nit dol ham le Choldo Nikho thudol hamin nachung thuu khol da hen:

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh cheho chu atahbeh hunglhung ding vetsahna ho ahibouvin, hinla Christa chu atahbeh a hung hitai.
en_web: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
en_kjv: which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: hichengse chu ahung lhung ding thil ho lim’a um ahin atahsa tahbeh chu Christaa umjo ahibouve.

tcz: Koima kineosah lhema le vantil ho houna thua kipui mangsah hih un. Hitobang mi chu athilmu u thudol akip akoiyin aseiyun, amaho chun lhagao lam lunggel aneipouvin, tahsaa thaset lunggelin ahoithosah uvin,
en_web: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
en_kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puft up by his fleshly mind,
tcz_gospelgo: Themgao thilmu bang mukisaa, ale lama kichonnemsah, Vantilte ho pou chibai boh nom mi koimacha nasan diu kipaman chu lahmangsah hih hel’un, hitobang miho hi mihem lunggel lam jeng agel jeh-uvin huilhoh mang theibep ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho chu aluchang Christa to kijopmatlou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Aman tipumpia agu kisuhtona le kikilmat tona chu akhut a aloikhoma Pathen in akhansah dungjuiya aumsah ahi.
en_web: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
en_kjv: and not holding the head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu atahsa pumpi Pathen thilgon banga akhantouna dinga tuhgom’a kilmatsoh guchin thagui chengse kigopsohna aluchang chutoh kimat lou ahitauve.

tcz: Nangho Christa to thithaa nahitah uleh, hiche vannoi lhagao thaneinaa kona nachamlhatsah u ahitai. Chuti ahileh ipi itia vannoiya hingnalai banga chu vannoi chonna dan kihilna,
en_web: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
en_kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset bulpi lhagao hoa kona ontholna dia Christa to thikhom nahitah-u le ibol’a leiset kihilna lhongpia pansat’a hing ding goa nahiuvem?

tcz: Tham hih in, tep hih in, tuh hih in kitiho najui nahlaiyu hintem?
en_web: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
en_kjv: (touch not; taste not; handle not;
tcz_gospelgo: “Tham hih, tep hih, tongkha hih,” kiti ho chu.

tcz: Hiche kipuina dan hohi mihem thupeh le thuhil ahin, ahung kimanchah toh lhon a mangthai ding thil ahibouve.
en_web: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
en_kjv: which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hin akimanchah teng mangthahji thilho aseidoh ahin, aboncha hi mihem thupeh le thuhil jeng ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche chonnadan kijuihohi chihtoh a ahi, hichehoa hin eimatah lungchama hou, eima tah kingaitoma kingainemna chule tahsa kithununna angaiyin ahi. Hinla hicheho hin mikhat lung ngaichat phalou jona apechompoi.
en_web: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
en_kjv: which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body, not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hin ki engbol’a hougutna le kichon nemsah chule tahsa tibah engtim’a kitimna jal’in chihna gong apun, ahinla tibah ho kitiman dinga imacha phachom louhel ahibouvui.

tcz: Nangho Christa toh hingkhoma nahiuleh, Pathen jetlam'a touva Christa umna chunglam chu veuvin.
en_web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
en_kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho Christa to kaithou tha nahitah-u le chunglam Pathen jet lama Christa kitousahna mun’a thil ho jeng bou hol’un.

tcz: Nanghon leiset thil ho geljo louvin, chunglam thilho geljo uvin.
en_web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
en_kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga thil ho hilouvin chung lam thil ho jeng gel’uvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho hiche hinkhoa dia athia nahi tauvin, nahinnau atahbeh chu Pathen a Christa toh kisela ahi.
en_web: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
en_kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang ho athisa nahitauvin nahinnau chu Pathen sunggil’a Christa to kiseltha ahitai.

tcz: I-hinnau Christa ahung kilah phatteng nangho jong Amatoh loupia kilangkhom ding nahiuve.
en_web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
en_kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahin nau Christa ahung kilah teng, nang ho jong Amato loupi tah a nakilah khom diu ahi.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, leiset chunga natibah chengu: jon lungput, thenlouna, huh lungput, lungdihlou ken, chule kiloset hichehohi milim houna ahin, abonchan thisah sohkeiyun.
en_web: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
en_kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun leiset chunga natibah chengseuva natong jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh, lungtup gilou, milim hou tobang papset hicheng hi that gam’uvin.

tcz: Hiche chonsetna ho jeh hin thua nunglouho chungah Pathen lunghanna chun alhun khumjin ahi.
en_web: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
en_kjv: for which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng jeh hin thua nung lou chate chunga Pathen lunghan achujin ahi.

tcz: Hicheho hi vannoiya dinga nanahinlai uva chu anaboljia nahiuve.
en_web: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
en_kjv: in the which ye also walked sometime, when ye lived in them.
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga nang ho jong hichenga hi ana chon’a ana hing nahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah tuhin: lunghan, lungsat miduhabol, Pathen taitom, thuthanghoi seina kam, hichengho hi pailhauvin.
en_web: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
en_kjv: But now you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun vang lungsat, lunghan, mitthip, taitom, nakamsunguva kona thujahmo sei jouse hi aboncha napai mangsoh diu ahij.

tcz: Khatle khat jouvin kiheh hih un, ajeh chu nanghon milui hinkho le anatoh chu napaiyu ahitai.
en_web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
en_kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
tcz_gospelgo: Khat le khat thujouvin kihou hih-un; ijeh inem itile mihem lui chu achonna jouse pum’a ponse lelhah banga nale lhahsau ahitai.

tcz: Nanghon nasempau nahet nau lungthim chu panun chule mithah chu kivonun chule Ama tobang hiuvin.
en_web: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
en_kjv: and have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama limtobanga Sempa chu kichentah a na hetna diuva tang louhel’a semthah jing jeng limthah chu nakivon joh-u ahi.

tcz: Hiche hinkhothah a hin hi Juda mi nahiha, chidang namdang nahim? Cheptanmi nahiha, cheptanlou nahim? Lekha helou akhangtou loulai soh chu nahiha, ongthol nahim? Christa chu eiho dinga ima jousea ininglhinnau ahitai.
en_web: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
en_kjv: where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Greek hihen Juda hile, cheptan le cheptan lou, koito kisamkai khah lou le khosuh khotou helou, soh, chamlhat aum thei poi Christa chu imajouse hisoh a, ijakaiya umsoh ahitai.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Pathen lhenchom mithengte deiumtah angailut namthenga lhendoh nahitah jeh uvin–mikhotona lunggel, mihepi, kineosah, nunnemna lungthim, thohhatna in kivonun.
en_web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
en_kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen lhentum mitheng, angailute nahijeh-un lainatna, khotona, kineosah nunmen, thohhat hicheng chu kivonjou’vin.

tcz: Khatle khat kidemdaito cheh un, kingaidam tona neiyun, akina khattou auma ahijongleh Christa chun nangaidam banguvin nanghon jong ngaidam'un.
en_web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
en_kjv: forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
tcz_gospelgo: Khat le khat kidemdaito cheh-un, khat’in khat chunga kiphinna anei jongle kingaidamto jengun; Christan nang ho na-ngaidam bangun nang ho ki-ngaidam’uvin.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chunga hin ngailutna chu kivonun, hichu kikankhomna phachamkim pen ahi.
en_web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
en_kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng jouse chunga hin kikankhomna chamkimpen ngailutna neiyun.

tcz: Chule Pathena cham lungmon chu nalunguva vaihomsah un, hichea dinga chu nangho jong tipum khat'a chamlen dinga kou nahiuvin chule thangvah jingun.
en_web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
en_kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
tcz_gospelgo: Christaa hungkon cham nan nalung sunguva vai homhen, hiche dinga chu tipumkhat’a kikou nahiuve. Chule thangvah jinguvin,

tcz: Christa thu chu chihna jouse tothon nasung uva cheng dimset hen; khat le khat tumgingtoh tholan houlan, chule lhagaolan kihilun chule kitilkhou touvin, nalung gil un Pakai choi-atnan lasauvin.
en_web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
en_kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thu nasunguva dimset’in cheng jing hen, chihna tin chengin kihilto kithumop to’uvin, tum ging to thon, houlan, thangvah to thon Lhagao lan nalung sunguva Pathen din sauvin.

tcz: Chule thua hihen, natoh a hita jongleh, nabol jouseu chu Pakai Yeshua minin bolun lang, Ama jal'in Pa le Pathen chu thangvah un.
en_web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
en_kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule ijakai nabol jouse thu lam ahin natoh lam ahin abonchan Pakai Jesu minin bol’uvin, Ama jal’in Pa Pathen thangvah jingun.

tcz: Ji numeiho, Pakai mitmua dih ahina jal in najipa teu thunoiya kipelut un.
en_web: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
en_kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Numeiho Pakai dia lomtah-in pasalte thun nunguvin.
