tcz: Pateho, najinu teu ngailu uvin chule amaho chunga lunghimona neihih un.
en_web: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
en_kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
tcz_gospelgo: Pasal hon numeite chu ngailuvin, nunbol dauvin.

tcz: Chateho, imalam jousea nanule napateu sei thun nungun, hichu Pakai lunglhainapen ahi.
en_web: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
en_kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, imalam jousea nu le pa te thun nunguvin, ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai lung lhaina ahi. 21Pate, nachateu alungbei lo louna diuvin sulung hang hih-un.

tcz: Pateho, nachateu chu sulungphamo hih un, lunglhahnan neiget uvinte.
en_web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
en_kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

tcz: Sohteho, tahsalam hina dungjuiyin napakai teu seithua nungun, mihem lunglhaisahna a mitmu soh hilouvin, Pathen ging hinan lungdihpun umun.
en_web: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
en_kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
tcz_gospelgo: Sohte, mihem mitvet maiya hilouvin, Pakai gin nan lung jangkeiyin imalam jousea tahsa lamdo’a pakaite thun nunguvin.

tcz: Chule ipi hileh nabol'u chu Pakaiya lunggilin bolun, mitmu soh hilouvin Pakai jal abol hiuvin.
en_web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
en_kjv: and whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi hile nabolchan’u chu mihemte dia hilouvin Pakai dinga bol bangin lung thim pumpin bol’uvin.

tcz: Pakaiya goulo ding tohman nachan dingu ahi chu heuvin: ajeh chu nangho Pakai Christa kinbol nahiu ahi.
en_web: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
en_kjv: knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakai koma kona goulo ding kipaman nasan diu naheuve. Sohna natoh nau chu Pakai Christa ahi.

tcz: Ahin thilse bola chu nahileh nathilse bol chu nakimu ding ahi. Hichea hin maipha vetna aumpoi.
en_web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
en_kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu thildih lou bol’an a thildih lou bol man asan ding ahin, hichea hin maipha vetna aumpoi.

tcz: Pipua pang ho nanghon jong vana APipu khat naneiyu geldoh uvin lang nalhachahou chunga adih le ahoi bol hiuvin.
en_web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
en_kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaite, yan’a Pakai khat naneiyu heuvin lang sohte chu dih kei le jangkeiyin bol’uvin.

tcz: Nangho taonaa ponpan tothon lunglimgeh in umun, chule thangvahna lunggel neijun.
en_web: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
en_kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
tcz_gospelgo: Tao nan phangdet jingun, hichea chun kiging jinguvin thangvah to thou’uvin.

tcz: Pathen in keihoa Christa a athuguh alunggon chu aphondoh theina dingin, keiho dingin taovun. Hiche jeh a hi keima thihkhauva eikihen ah ahi.
en_web: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
en_kjv: withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin keiho dinga thu seiphongna ding kot ahondoh a, songkul’a eikihenlo na Christa thuguh seiphong theina dingin keiho din jong neitaokop jinguvin.

tcz: Keiman hiche thupeh hi kicheh tah a kaseiphong theina dingin neitao peh un.
en_web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
en_kjv: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile kasei ding dol chu kichentah a kasei thei ding ahi.

tcz: Tahsan neilouho lah a chun chingtheitah in hinkho mangun, chule phat kijen pat chu aphachom pen din mang un.
en_web: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
en_kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
tcz_gospelgo: Polam miho koma chihna mangchan chon’un, phat chu kitup keiyin mang chauvin.

tcz: Nanghon amitakip dinga donbutna dihtah nanei theina dingun, na kihoulim nau chu lungsetna thucheng le lahthei ding cheh hihen.
en_web: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
en_kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how ye ought to answer every man.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathuseiyu chu phat jousen onemheo le kitoh chet, thanop um jing hen, chule thu nadong jouseu kitoh chet’a donbut din kigosadem hiuvin.

tcz: Pakaiya sopi deitah, lhacha natohna a tahsan umtah chule lhachana katohkhompi Tychicus hin kaumchan thudol abonchan nangho hinseipeh nauvinte.
en_web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
en_kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai dinga tahsan um lhacha le soh, sopi deitah Tychicus hin kachung chang thu nahetnom chan naseipeh nauvinte.

tcz: Keiman amaa kona nachung changthu u chu kahetchentheina dinga chule amahin nalungu amonsah theina dingin nahenguva kahinsoltai.
en_web: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
en_kjv: whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hin kaumchan thuu nahetsah-uva nalung thimu atilkou ding deinaa nahenguva ama kahinsol ahi.

tcz: Chule amatoh kilhondin amin Onesimus, nalahuva tahsan umtah le sopi deitah toh'in nang ho heng lama kahinsol thauve. Amani hin hikoma nakitong thudol ijakai hetsah lhon nauvinate.
en_web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
en_kjv: with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
tcz_gospelgo: Amato lhonin tahsan umle dei umtah sopi Onesimus, naloipau hin hikoma thilsoh nahetnom chan nahil nauvinte.

tcz: Songkul kalut chankhompi Aristarchus in salam napeuve, chule Barnabas sopinu chapa Mark in jong salam napeuve (Mark hi nahenguva ahunga ahileh anasangun tia achungchang thua thupeh namusau ahitai).
en_web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
en_kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
tcz_gospelgo: Kasoh chanpi Aristarchus-in nasalam’ui, Barnabas inkopa Markin jong, ama thudol hi thupeh namusau ahitan, nahenguva ahung jeng khat le ana lamtouvin.

tcz: Chule Yeshua (Justus kitipa chu) jong hin salam napeuve. Hichengho chengse bou hi cheptan holah a kona Pathen Lenggam chalsahna dinga katohkhompiho ahiuvin, amaho hi keima dinga monpi umtah ahiuve.
en_web: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
en_kjv: and Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Justus Jesun jong nasalam’uve; chepten holah akona Pathen lenggam thudol’a kanatoh khompi hicheng hi bou ahiuvin, amaho hi kalungmonpi lheh jengin ahi.

tcz: Yeshua Christa lhacha le nakiloi khompiu Epaphras in salam napeuve. Nanghon Pathen lunglam najui bukimkei uva chule nachamkimna dinguva ama nangho dinga gunchua taojing jenga ahi.
en_web: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
en_kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho lah a mi khat Epaphras Jesus Christa soh, ama jong chun nasalam’ui; ama hi Pathen lungdei pumpia bulhingset’a nanun theina diuva nang ho dinga gunchu tah a tao jinga, nadindetna diuva thum jing ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman amahi-nangho dinga, Laodicea umho le Hierapolis a umho chengse dinga taonaa gunchu lheh jenga ahi, ti kahettohsah ahi.
en_web: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
en_kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile amahin nang ho ding le Laodicea a um ho chule Hierapolis a um ho dinga hatah a athohgima na atoh hi keima mongin kahettohsah ahiye.

tcz: Louthem deiumtah Luke le Demas teni hin salam napeuve.
en_web: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
en_kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailuttah louthem Luke le Demas-in jong nasalam’ui.

tcz: Laodicea khopia um sopite ho le Nymphas chule a-in'a um houbung miho salam anapeuvin.
en_web: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
en_kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Laodicea um sopite Nympha chule a insunga kikhom Houbung chu salam’uvin.

tcz: Chule nanghon hiche lekhathot hi nalah uva akisim jouteng, Laodicea houbung sunga jong sim theiding ngaito uvin; chule chutima chun Laodicea a lekhathot jong chu anasim teiyun.
en_web: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
en_kjv: And when this epistle is read amongst you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekha hi nahenguva akisimjou teng Laodicea Houbung henga jong akisimdohna din ngaitouvin, chutobangman Laodicea kona lekha thot jong nang hon nasim’uvin.

tcz: Chule Archippus jah a chun, “Pakaiya kona nakisan akinbolna natohna hi chingtheiyin lang subulhit in” tihi seipeh in.
en_web: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
en_kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Archipus jah a, “Pakai vanga nangman lhacha panmun namu chu namolso theina dingin chingtheiyin,” tin hil’uvin.

tcz: Hiche hi keima Paul'in kakhut a kasut salamna ahi. Nanghon thihkhaova kihen kahi geldoh un. Lungsetna in naumpiuhen. Amen
en_web: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
en_kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen. ¶ Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche salam thu hi keima Paul khut’a hungkon mong ahi. Kabulput hi geldoh jinguvin. Lungset nan umpi jingun.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Paul, Silas chule Timothy a kon ahi. Keihon Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa a hiho Thessalonica Houbung mite henga kahin thot nahiuve. Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
en_web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le Silvanus chule Timothyn Pa Pathen le Jesu Christa to hingkhom Thessalonica khoa Houbung mite chunga lungset le chamna hung lhung hen.

tcz: Keihon nangho jouse jal'in Pathen kathangvah jingun chule nangho dingin kataojom jinguvin ahi.
en_web: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
en_kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon phat jousen nang ho din Pathen kathangvah jingun, katao nauva tang louhel’in nang ho kamin phah jinguve.

tcz: Keihon Pa le IPathen un nangho chung thua kataonauva, tahsan umtah'a natoh nau, ngailutna neiya nathil bol hou chule IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal a thoh hattah'a kinepna naneiyu chu kageldoh ui.
en_web: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
en_kjv: remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
tcz_gospelgo: Itobang tah a natahsan’u natoh a napoh doh theiyuva, ngailut jal’a iti natoh hat’uva, chule i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a nakinep nauvin itobanga nathoh hatsah-u chu i-Pau Pathen angsunga kageldoh jinguve.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, Pathen in nangailu uvin chule Pathen in Amite hidingin nalhengdoh tauve, ti kaheuve.
en_web: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
en_kjv: knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ngailut sopi deitah le alhentum nahiu kaheuve.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh u chu thucheng jengseh a hilouvin, thaneina to kilhon a Lhagao Thengin hetchetna lhingset napeh u ahitai tia keihon kaseiyu chu thutah ahi. Chule keihon nangho kagel khohnau nangho toka umkhom laiyun kahin danuvin nahe tauvin ahi.
en_web: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
en_kjv: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nahenguva Kipana Thupha kahung lhut’a chu thuhomkeova ahipon, thahat le Lhagao Theng vanga ahin, kaseiyu chu chamkimsoh ahi; nang hojal’a hiche hin keiho itobang kahiu ahetsah chu nang hon naheuve.

tcz: Hiti chun nanghon kathuseiyu chu nangho dinga hahsatna khohtah Lhagao Thenga konin kipah tah in nasangun ahi. Hiti chun nanghon keiho le Pakai umchan chu najom un ahi.
en_web: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
en_kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu thu kisei chun gim genthei tamtah nahin pohlut peh vangun Lhagao Theng jal’in kipah tah-in nasangun, keiho le Pakai umchan banga umtei ding nago ham’uve.

tcz: Hitichun nang ho Greece a tahsan saho jouse-Macedonia le Achaia gam jousea vetjui thei nahung hitauve.
en_web: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
en_kjv: so that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Macedonia le Achaia gam’a tahsan mite vetkah ding doltah-in naumdoh tauvin ahi.

tcz: Chule tun, Pakai thu chu Macedonia le Achaia gamkallam peh geiyin, hoilai mun hijongleh kachenau chan ah Pathen natahsannau thudol hi aseiyui. Keihon koima koma hithu chu kasei diu angaipoi.
en_web: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.
en_kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang hoa konin Macedonia le Achia gamsunga Pakai thu akiphonjal keovin akingapon, Pathen lam’a natahsan detjeu chu gamtin’a akithangsoh tan, hijeh chun keiho sei sei angaipoi.

tcz: Ajehchu amahon phatah a eina lamtonau thudol aseiyun, chule nangho milim houna'a kona Pathen hing le dihtah kinbol dinga nalung naheiyu thudol aseijom jinguve.
en_web: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
en_kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kahung vil’uva, nang hon neisan jeu, doilim semthu nahou nauva kona itobang Pathen lama nakiheiyuva, Pathen hing jing dihtah hou dia hungkihei nahiu mi tamtah-in jong aseiyuve.

tcz: Chule amaho chun Pathen Chapa–Pathen in athilah a kona akaithou Yeshua, vana kona ahung ding ngah jinga uma nahiu thudol aseiyun ahi. Ama hin ahunglhung ding thutanna kichat umtah'a kona eihuhdoh u ahi.
en_web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
en_kjv: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule ahung lhung tei ding lunghannaa kona eihuhdoh-uva Jesu thinaa kona kaithouva umpa, Achapa van’a kona hung dingpa na-nga jeu chu aseiyu ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, nangho kahung vil uhi mohseh ahipoi ti nangho tah in naheuve.
en_web: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
en_kjv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nangho kahung vil’u chu mohjenseh ahilou nahenauve.

tcz: Keiho nangho koma kahung masang jep uva Philippia ichan geiya gimbol hesohna katouvem ti nanghon naheuve. Hinama jongleh IPathen un Ama kipana Thupha chu ichan geiya doudalna aum vang'in, lung ngamtah a nangho koma kaseidoh thei nadiuvin hansanna eipeuve.
en_web: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
en_kjv: but even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahetsau bang chun Philipi khoa hesoh genthei tah le jachat umleuva eikibol vangun ka-Pathen’uva kitilkhouna neiyin, Pathen a hungkon Kipana Thupha chu adouvah atam lheh jeng vangin nahenguva seidin kapangui.

tcz: Hiti chun kathu seiphongu hi lheplhahna thu ahilouleh lungdihlou pua ahilouleh doha lheplhahna ima seina kanei pouve ti nanghon naheuve.
en_web: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
en_kjv: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile ka-ngeh nau hi pannabei ahipon, athenglou jong ahipon, lheplhah na jong ahipoi.

tcz: Ajehchu keiho hin Pathen a kona photchetna neiya Kipana Thupha thusei lea panga kahiuve. Kalung gonu hi miho lunglhaina hollouva Pathen lunglhaina kahol joh u ahi. Ama bou chun kalung put u ipi ahi ahet ahi.
en_web: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
en_kjv: but as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti malah Pathenin Kipana Thupha thua nganse lom eisah-uva eiphasah jeh-uva kaseiyu ahin, mihem lung lhaisah ding golouva, kalungthimu patep tohsa Pathen joh kalung lhaigot’u ahibouve.

tcz: Nanghon nahet ngaima bangun keihon joulhep doha a nangho thunun kagopouve. Chule Pathen hi ijakai ahetoh a ahi, keihohi nasumu chanthei nadinga nangho toh jol le gol'a um'ah kahipouve!
en_web: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
en_kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
tcz_gospelgo: Imatih chan’a pachat lhem thu mang lou kahiuvin, nahetsa bangun papset khu nan jong ima kamangji pouve. Pathen ahetoh a pang ahi.

tcz: Christa solchah kahiu hi mihem pachat channa dingin keihon nangho hihen midangho hijongleh, koima cha lung kahol pouve.
en_web: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
en_kjv: nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hoa hihen midanga kon hijongle mihema kona pachat kahol pouve.

tcz: Christa solchahho hina jal a keihon nanghoa kona ngehna kanei theiyu ahi, hinla keiho nangho laha lung nengin kaum jouve ahilouleh keiho hi minun achate an apeh a avah a chule avetsui tobang kahiuve.
en_web: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
en_kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa solchah kahi jeh-un pohgih hahsa pohsah jeng theiyu jong leng; ahinla minu them tah-in achate akhoukhah them bangin nang ho din nun nem tah kahiuve.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailut behseh jeh un nangho to Pathen Kipana Thupha seh seh a chan neikhom pi hilouvin, kahin nau jong nangho dinga kaphal ngamu ahi.
en_web: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
en_kjv: so being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
tcz_gospelgo: Ka-ngailut nau agil behseh jeh-in Pathen Kipana Thupha kachanpi nom keova ahitanpon, kahinkho geiyuva kahop nomi ahitai; ajeh chu nang ho ka ngai lu lheh jenguve.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, nalahuva ichan geiya katoh gimu hitam ti hi geldoh lou nahiuvem? Nahenguva Pathen Kipana Thupha seiphong na dinga, nangho pohgih pohsah kanop lou jeh un, sun le jan'in na katong gim un ahi.
en_web: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
en_kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun sopite, itobang tah a nang ho koima cha dinga pohgih kahilouna diuva chol le nang, a sun le jan’a na katoh-uva, nang ho Pathen Kipana Thupha seipeh ding kagot’u chu geldoh jingun.

tcz: Nangho tah keiho hettohsah nahiuve–chule Pathen jong chuti ahi-keiho hi nangho atahsan ho jouse a dinga kipumpeh a, lungdih pua chule themmona neilou kahiuve.
en_web: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
en_kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan mi nang ho henga kachon nau athenje adihje chule nolnabei ahije ahetoh-a nang ho le Pathen nahiuve.

tcz: Chule keihon nangho khat khatcheh hi Pan achate abolna bangtah a kabol'u nahi.
en_web: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
en_kjv: as you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
tcz_gospelgo: Pan achate abolna banga nang ho khat cheh kabol’u chu nang hon naheuve.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangeh uva, katilkhou uva chule katem nau chu nangho Pathena dinga lomtah a nachonna dingu kati ahi. Ajeh chu aman aLenggam le aloupina a chan nei dinga nakouvu ahi.
en_web: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
en_kjv: that ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Katilkhouvun, kalhamon’un, aloupina le alenggam chan khompi dinga nakoupau Pathen lungdei dol’a nahin theina diuvin khat cheh-in kahettosah-uve.

tcz: Hichejeh chun, keihon Pathen thangvahna kangadeh pouve, ajeh chu nanghon keihoa kona thu chu nasanu chun, kathuseiyu chu moh mihem thuseiyin nalapouve. Nanghon kathupoh uchu Pathena kon ahi tin nasanguve–hichu hijong hiyah ahi. Chule hiche thuhin nangho tahsan neihoa na atoh jom ahi.
en_web: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
en_kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle atahbeh monga Pathen thu ahijeh chun kathuseiyu chu mihem thu banga gel louva Pathen thua najah jeh-uvin Pathen kathangvah jing jengui; hiche thu chun atahsan nang ho lah a na atong jinge.

tcz: Chutima chun sopi deitahte, nanghon nagam miteuva kona gimbol hesohna nathoh u ahi. Hitia hi, nanghon Judea gam'a Pathen houbung ho umchan najomu ahi, amaho chun Christa Yeshua atahsan jeh uva, amiteu Judah ho khut a gimbol hesoh athoh u anahi.
en_web: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
en_kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile sopite, Jesu Christa to hingkhom Judea gama Pathen Houbung mite umchan jom nahitauve, ajeh chu ama hon Juda mite khut’a athoh banguva nanghon jong nagam miteuva kona nathoh gim’u ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu Juda ho lah a phabep chun themgao ho anathat un, chule phabep chun Pakai Yeshua jeng jong chu athau anahi. Tun amahon keiho jeng jong eibol hesoh uve. Ama hon Pathen alunglhai pouvin chule mi jouse to kikala natong ahiuve.
en_web: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
en_kjv: who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
tcz_gospelgo: Judamiten Pakai Jesu le Themgao ho athat’un, keiho einodoh jengun, achunguva Pathen alung lhai nai saipon, chu le mitin doumah chang ahiuve.

tcz: Amahon chidang namdang ho lah a huhhingna Kipana Thupha kaseiphong le diu eijada gouve.
en_web: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
en_kjv: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdangte huhhinga aum theina diuvva thu kaseipeh diu geiyin eisutang go’uve; hichu achonset nau pilhin molsona ahitai. Hijeh chun akhon nan Pathen lung hanna achunguva achutan ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, phat chomkhat a dinga nangho to eiki chomkhen jouvin (kalungun vang nangho nadalha dehpouve), kajo chanun hungkit kagouve, ajeh chu keihon nangho kamukit nom lheh jengu ahi.
en_web: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
en_kjv: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, chomkhat ikikhen kangu hi, lungthim mit’a milmo nahivangun, ka-ngai lut’un namaiyu mukal ka-ngah lel lheh-uve.

tcz: Keiho kihambol tah in nangho kom kahung nomun, chule keima Paul jong avelvelin kahung gon, hinla Satan in eisuboijiuve.
en_web: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
en_kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nahenguva hung din kakigouvin, ahideh chun keima Paul’in jong hung ding kagot loi ahitan, Satanin eisumo jiuve.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua ahung kilekit nikhoa a-anga idin tengu leh ipia kinepna le ipin eikipasah uva, chule ipi chu kachandiu tohman le lallukhuh hiding hitam? Hichu nangho nahiuve!
en_web: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
en_kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu ahung kit teng le a-angsunga keiho kinepna, kipana, kichoi-atna lallukhuh ding nang ho nahilouvuham?

tcz: Henge, nangho keiho kisonpi le kipana nahiuve.
en_web: For you are our glory and our joy.
en_kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang ho hi keiho loupina le kipana nahiuve.

tcz: Kanan joulou helu ahung hi phat in, keima ho chang Athens a umden dingin kakigel lhatauve.
en_web: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
en_kjv: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun kathoh jou loutah phat’un Athen khoa kachunga eidalhah diu pha kasauvin,

tcz: Chule Timothy hi nang ho vil ding in kahinsol tauve. Ama hi isopiu le Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong naa Pathen na katoh khompiu ahiye. Aman nang ho nahatsah uva, natahsan nauva natil khouna dinguva kahinsolu ahi.
en_web: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
en_kjv: and sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Kipana Thupha jal’a Pathen kinbolnaa tohkhompi isopiu Timothy chu nang ho dinkhompi ding le natahsan thudol’uva natil khou diuvin kahinsol’uve,

tcz: Chule nanghon hahsatna nato chung changuva chu lung olmo tah a naum louna dinguva navetup dinguva ama kahinsolu ahi. Keiho vang hiti hahsatna ho toh mong dinga eikigonguva ahi ti naheuve.
en_web: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
en_kjv: that no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
tcz_gospelgo: chutile hiche thoh gim gentheinaa hin koiman nasuh lung ling lao lou diu ahi. Hiche hesoh genthei hi ithoh tei diu ahi nahenauve.

tcz: Keihon kaumpipet jenguva jong hahsatna hung lhungloi jeng thei ahi tia kahilchah nau chu, nahet banguvin, amahon ahinboldoh jeng tauve.
en_web: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
en_kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nakom’uva ka-um laiyuva hiche hesoh genthei kathoh diu hi kaseipeh masah dem nahitauvin, hitia chu hung lhung ahi naheuve.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh a, kathoh joulou phata, natahsan nau det jinga hinam ti kaphotchet nomjeh a Timothy kahinsol anahi. Achuti louleh alhempa chun nanghoa aphapen chu akilahdoh a chule kanatohnau hi mohseh bep hitam tia tija'a um kanahi ahi.
en_web: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
en_kjv: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu lhepna chun lhem lha taleu chun katohna jouseu moh ahikhah ding hi kathoh jou lou phat’a natahsan’u hechen dinga nahenguva Timothy kahinsol jeng ahi.

tcz: Hinlah tun Timothy ahung lhungin, nangho tahsan le ngailut thu ahung lhuttai. Amahin keihon kahung vilnau thudol chu kipahtah in nageldoh jingun chule keihon nangho kamunom tobangun nanghon jong neimu nomuve ti thulhut aneiye.
en_web: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
en_kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
tcz_gospelgo: Tun vang nakom’uva kona kahenguva Timothy ahung lhungin, natahsan’u le na-ngailut nau kipana thupha, phatjousea phatah-a neigeldoh jinguva keihon kamu nombang uva neimu nom’u thu ahin lhuttai.

tcz: Hitihin kasopi deitahte, nangho tahsannaa nahat jing jaluvin, keihon hahsatna le gimbolna kathoh laitah jenguvin jong hatah in nei tilkhouvun ahi.
en_web: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
en_kjv: therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress, by your faith:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun sopite, hesoh genthei nan eichup jeng vangun natasan’u chun kakitilkhou lheh jengui.

tcz: Nangho Pakaiya nadin det jingu kahet jalun keiho hinna thah eipeuve.
en_web: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
en_kjv: for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nang ho Pakai dia nadindet jeh-un tun keiho din jong hinlo aumtai.

tcz: Nangho jeh a Pathen iti kathangvah u hitam! Pathen angsunga kalutnauva keiho hi, nangho jal hin hapan kakipah uve.
en_web: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
en_kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho jeh le nachung chang thu’va i-Pathennu angsung kipana le thanopna hijatpi kaneiyu hitoh kitoh chet’in Pathen chu iti kathangvah tadiuvem?

tcz: Pathen in eikimuto sah kit uva nanghoa tahsan a-onglai chu dipdimna dinga nangho dinga sunle jana tao jinga kahiuve.
en_web: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
en_kjv: night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
tcz_gospelgo: Namaiyu kamu’uva natahsan’u lhahsam kabulhit theina diuvin sunle janin giltah-in katao jing jenguve.

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun nahenguva eihin puiloi jeng tauhen.
en_web: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
en_kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pau Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesun nahenguva kalampiu hinlhungjang hen.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailutnau alon letset tobang'in, Pakaiyin nangho khatle khat kingailutna le mijouse ngailutna chu khansah hen chule longlet doh hen.
en_web: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
en_kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one towards another, and towards all men, even as we do towards you:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho khat le khat ki-ngailutna le mitin na-ngailut nau chu Pakaiyin khantousah jing hen, nang ho ka-ngailut nau to bahsah hen.

tcz: Hichea kon hin, nangho I-Pakaiyu Yeshua amithengte jouse toh ahungkit niteng, I-Pau Pathen angsunga nadin tenguleh, aman nalungu hatsah hen, nolna beiyin koihen chule athengin hinkoi hen. Amen.
en_web: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
en_kjv: to the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun nalungthimu phudet hen lang, i-Pakaiyu Jesu amithengte jouse to lhon’a ahung kit tengle i-Pau Pathen angsunga nolnabeiyin nakoiyuhen.

tcz: Achainakeiyin sopi deitahte, Pakai Yeshua mina kahintem nom nau chu kanahil tobanguvin Pathen lunglhainna hinkho mangun. Nangho hitia hi nana kiman chahsau ahi bangin tua jong nahabol cheh dinguvin kahin tilkhou uve.
en_web: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
en_kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, tukalse vang Pathen lungdeilama iti chon ding dol keihoa kona nalahsau banga nachon theijuva, hitia chu nabol be chehna diuva Pakai Jesu jal’a kathumu’va ka-ngeh nahiuve.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon nangho Pakai Yeshua thuneina'a ipi kahilu nageldoh uve.
en_web: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
en_kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakai Jesu vanga itobang thupeh kapeh-u nang hon nahenauve.

tcz: Pathen in nangho dinga alung gon chu nathenuva, jonthanhoiya kona nakikangse dingu hi ahi.
en_web: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
en_kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin nanghoa kona adei chu then ahin, hijeh a chu jonthanhoiya kona nakitim diu ahi.

tcz: Chutah le nangho khatcheh hin atahsa kivettup nahiuva chule thenna le jathei hinkho naman dingu hi ahi.
en_web: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
en_kjv: that every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho amitakip chun atibah cheh chu itobanga kitim thema, theng le jabol’a umsah ding nahet diu dol ahi.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen le alamlhah umdan hephalou milim houna neiho bangin jon lung puhih un.
en_web: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
en_kjv: not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen helou chidang namdangte banga huh napat lou diu ahi.

tcz: Hiche thudol ahin, Christian sopi khat chun ajinu engbolna ahilouleh dohabolna alamlouvin neihih un, ajeh chu khohtah amasanga kagihji nau bang chun Pakaiyin hitia chonseho chu alethuh ji.
en_web: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
en_kjv: that no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche thudol’a hin koimachan asopi dohan bolda hen, masanga kaseipeh-uva chule kahttosahsau bang chun hitobanga chonho chunga hi Pakaiyin phu alah tei ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in eikouvu hi thenlouna hinkho mang ding hilouvin, hinkho thenga hing ding ihijo bouvui.
en_web: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
en_kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin athenglou dia eikouvu ahipon, atheng dia eikoujoh-u ahibouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, koi hijongle hiche hoa chona dan juilou chu mihem thuhil juinom lou ahitapon, A Lhagao Theng eipeuva Pathen deilou jeh joh ahiye.
en_web: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
en_kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hiche jop lou chun mihem ajop lou ahipon, a-Lhagao Theng napepau Pathenjoh ajop lou ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah keihon nangho henga khatle khat kingailut ding thua kahin jih khoh u angaipoi, ajeh chu Pathen in khatle khat kingailu uvin tia nahilsau ahitai.
en_web: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
en_kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisopi, ngailut thudol’a hin nahenguva hinsut khoh angaipoi, ajeh chu khat le khat ki-ngailutje Pathena kona kihilsate nahitauve.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, nanghon Macedonia pumpia tahsanho jouse nangailut nau navetsah sau ahitai. Hitima chun, sopite, amaho chu hatah a nangailut cheh diu kangeh nahiuve.
en_web: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
en_kjv: And indeed ye do it towards all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle Macedonia gam pumpia sopite abonchauva hitia chu nabolsau jong ahitai. Nahabol be chehna diuva ka-ngeh-u ahi, sopite.

tcz: Masanga keihon nangho kana hilsa bangu chun, thip beh a hinkho manding gelkhoh uvin lang, natoh diu cheh kigelkhoh uvin chule nangma khutcheh a natonguvin.
en_web: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
en_kjv: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
tcz_gospelgo: Kangkhen cha umje kihil’un, nakin cheh kibol’in, kahilsau bangin nakhut cheh-in na ki tohgim’uvin.

tcz: Chutengleh Christian hilou hon nahinkho man dan'u chun najabol untin, chule midanga nakingaiyu ngailou ding ahitai.
en_web: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
en_kjv: that ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti bol leu chun polam mite sei phat nachan’uva, lhahsamna nanei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Chule tun sopi deitahte, nangho kinepna neilou miho tobanga lunghema naum louna dinguva Pakaiya thisa ho chung chang thudol nahet teiding'u kanom uvin ahi.
en_web: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
en_kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, kinepna bei miho banga naum louna diuvin a-ihmumilte thudol helouva naum diu kanompouve.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh Yeshua chu athin, chule Ama chu ahingdoh kittai ti itahsan uva chule Yeshua chu Ahungkile tengleh, Pathen in tahsansa ho chu Amatoh ahinlepui ding ahi ti itahsanu ahi.
en_web: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
en_kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Jesu athia athodoh kit itahsan jeh-un, Jesu tahsan’a ihmumilte chu Pathen in Amato ahinpui kit ding jong itahsan’ui.

tcz: Keihon hiche hi Pakaiya kona kalah u kaseiyu ahi: Pakai hungkile tengleh ahingnalai eiho hi anathisaho sanga Amato kimuto masajo ding ihipouve.
en_web: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
en_kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi Pakai thusah akona kaseipeh nahiuve, ipijeh-inem itile Pakai hungkit ni geiya eiho ahinga kidalha chengse hi itinama jong le a-ihmumilte sanga masajo lou ding ihiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai Amatah chu van'a kona thupeh aw ahinsap ding, vantil pipu aw gintoh, chule Pathen sumkon kouna awgin tohthoa van'a kona hungkum ding ahi. Amasa, Christian anathisa ho alhankhuh uva kona thoudoh ding ahiuve.
en_web: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
en_kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakai ama tah ogin to, Vantil pipu ogin to chule Pathen sumkon gin to kithoa van’a kona hung kumlha ding, chu tengle Christa jal’a thisa chengse thoudoh masa diu ahi.

tcz: Chujou tengleh, eiho ahing nalai chule leiset chunga umnalai chengse hi amaho chutoh Pakai chu vanlai jol'a meilhanglah a kimuto dinga lahtouva ium dingu ahi. Chutengleh eiho Pakai toh a'itih a iumkhom jing dingu ahitai.
en_web: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
en_kjv: then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujoutah le eiho ahing nalai amoh chengse hi amaho chutoh vanlaijol’a Pakai lamto dinga meilom’a ikitoltou dingu ahi; hitia chu imatih chan’a Pakai to iumkhom jing diu ahitai.

tcz: Hiti hin khat le khat hiche thuhoa hin kitilkhouto uvin.
en_web: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
en_kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ahijeh chun hiti thu ho hin nang ho khat le khat kitilkhou jingun,

tcz: Tun kasopi deitah teho, hicheng kisei jouse hi iti hungsoh a chule itihle hung hiding ham tithua nangho koma kahinjih mongu angaipoi.
en_web: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
en_kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, aphat le achang thudol hi nahenguva hinsut angaipoi,

tcz: Ajehchu naginchat lou pettah uva Pakai hungkilekit nikho chu, jana gucha tobang ahung ding ahi.
en_web: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
en_kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu janlaiya gucha ahung banga Pakai nikho chu ahung lhun ding nang hon kichentah a nahetsau ahi.

tcz: Mihon “Ijakaiya chamnale bitna aume” tia asei laitah uleh numei naosonat thohgim tobanga, jana gucha hung banga achunguva manthahna chu hunglhung ding ahi. Chule hoidohna umtheilou ding ahitai.
en_web: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
en_kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon, ‘Chamle lungmon aum’e,” atilai tah-u le numei naoso nat banga photlot louva manthahna chu achunguva hung chuphung jeng ding, koimacha hoidoh louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah sopi deitahte, nangho hiche thudol a hi ima helouva uma nahi pouve, chule Pakai nikho chu gucha tobanga ahung ding chu nanghon nadatmo diu ahipoi.
en_web: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
en_kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nang ho vang muthima um nahitapouvin hiche nikho chun gucha banga nahinlap den lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nangho nabonchauvin vahle sunlai chate nahiuvin, eiho muthim le janlai chate ihipouve.
en_web: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
en_kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nang ho nabonchauva khovah le sunlai chate nahiuve. Eiho hi janlai muthim lah a um ihipouve;

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun kihong phauvin, midangho bangin ihmu hih un. Kigingin um unlang chule lung limgeh in umun.
en_web: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
en_kjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun midang ho banga ihmu louvin, lung limgeh chan kihong jingu hite.

tcz: Jan phat le miho ihmu jiuva chule judon hon ju adonkham jiu phat ahi.
en_web: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
en_kjv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile a-ihmua jong janin bou a-ihmun jukham ho jong janin bou akham’ui,

tcz: Hinlah eiho lung limgeh in vah'a umu hitin, tahsan le ngailut lum panu hite, chule huhhingna lukhuh chu lungngam tah in kikhuh u hite.
en_web: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
en_kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
tcz_gospelgo: eiho vang sunlaiya limgeh ihiuvin, tahsan le ngailut ompho bangin kivon’u hitin, huhhing dia kinepna chu thih lukhuh bangin kikhuh-u hite.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in eiho chunga alunghanna abuhlhah khum ding hijolouva, I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'a huhhingna chang dinga eilhendoh joh u ahi.
en_web: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu eiho hi Pathenin lungsat khum dinga ei lhenu ahipon, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a huhhing chang ding joh a eikouvu ahibouve.

tcz: Hiti chun Christa ahung kile tengleh eiho ithiu hihen ahilouleh hing jong leuhen, Ama eiho dinga athi jal a chu a-itih a dia Amato i-umkhom jing dingu ahitai.
en_web: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
en_kjv: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho hah jingu hen ihmu jongleu hen Amato ihinkhom jingna diuva Ama eiho khel’a thia ahitai.

tcz: Hitichun nabol ngaisau tobang chun, khat le khat kitil khou touvinlang chule kisadohton khat le khat umun.
en_web: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
en_kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon nabol ngai banguvin khat le khat hiti hin kitilkhou to’uvin kihuto’uvin.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, Pakai natohnaa nalamkai hou chu jabolun. Amahon nalah uva atong gim'un, chule lhagao lama nakaihoijuva panga ahiuve.
en_web: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
en_kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, ka-ngeh nahiuve, Pakai jal’a nalh-uva mi phabep kikoiya, nalamkai diu le nahilchah diuva natong ho chu ja lomtah-in ja’uvin.

tcz: Amaho chu jana lentah peuvin lang chule anatoh jal un lunggilin ngailuvin. Chule kichamdelin khatle khat cheng khomun.
en_web: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
en_kjv: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Anatoh nau jal chun ngailut nan hajan jabol’uvin. Nasunguva kichamdel’un.

tcz: Sopite ho, kahin ngehnau chu mithase ho chu gihsal un. Akichaseho tilkhouvun. Atha lhasam ho phaten khohsah in vesuiyun. Amitakip chunga thoh hat'un.
en_web: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
en_kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, thase ho phohsal’un, lung lhachom tilkhouvun, alhasam kithopiuvin, mi jouse dia thoh hat dinga ka-ngeh-u ahi.

tcz: Koiman ase chu asea alethuh louna dingin vephauvin, chusangin khat in khat chunga chule mijouse chunga thilpha boljing ding gouvin.
en_web: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
en_kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
tcz_gospelgo: Chingtheiyun, koiman setna chu setna thuh louvin, chusangin phat jousen khat le khat din jong chule mi jouse din jong thilpha bol ding go jinguvin.

tcz: Phatseh in Kipah thanomun.
en_web: Always rejoice.
en_kjv: Rejoice evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Ki pah jingun,

tcz: Taona man ngahih helun.
en_web: Pray without ceasing.
en_kjv: Pray without ceasing.
tcz_gospelgo: tang louvin taovin,

tcz: Itobang phat'in naphah jongle thangvahna neijingun, ijeh ham itileh Yeshua Christa a hia nangho dinga Pathen lunglam ahi.
en_web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
en_kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
tcz_gospelgo: imalam jousea thangvah jingun; ijeh-inem itile hiche hi Jesu Christa jal’a nang ho dia Pathen lungdei lam ahi.

tcz: Lhagao theng chu sumit hih un.
en_web: Don’t quench the Spirit.
en_kjv: Quench not the Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao chu pheltan dauvin,

tcz: Gaothuseiho nahsahmoa dai chatvai bol hih un.
en_web: Don’t despise prophecies.
en_kjv: Despise not prophesyings.
tcz_gospelgo: gao thusei jong nahsah modauvin;

tcz: Hinlah akisei jouse patep cheh un. Apha chu kolchah un.
en_web: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
en_kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang ima jouse patep soh keiyun apha chu kolchah jingun;

tcz: Gitlouna chichom choma konin kihei mangun.
en_web: Abstain from every form of evil.
en_kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
tcz_gospelgo: thilse tapou peldoh soh keiyuvin.

tcz: Tun cham-lungmon konna Pathen chun imalam jousea nathensah uhen, chule nalhagaovu le nahinnau chule natahsau chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung masangsen nolna beiyin koihen.
en_web: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Chamna bulpi Pathenin nang ho nasuthengsoh keiyu hen; i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hungkit teng nolnabei nahina diuvin nalhagao, nahinkhou, natahsau bitkeiyin koi hen.

tcz: Nakou Pau chu tahsan umtah ahijeh'in, Pathen in hichu ahin molso ding ahi.
en_web: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
en_kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakoupau tahsan umtah ahin, nabolpeh tei diu ahi.

tcz: Sopi deitahteho, keiho dingin hung taovun.
en_web: Brothers, pray for us.
en_kjv: Brethren, pray for us.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, keiho din jong neitaopeh-uvin.

tcz: Sopite ho jouse chu Christian kingailutna in chibai bolun.
en_web: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
en_kjv: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.
tcz_gospelgo: Kibengchop thengin sopite jouse salam’un.

tcz: Keiman Pakai mina thu kapeh nahiuve, hiche lekhathot hi sopite jouse henga kisimdoh hen.
en_web: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
en_kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekha hi sopite jouse henga nasimna diuva Pakai thahat’a kathugah nahiuve.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa lungsetna in na umpiu hen.
en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen. ¶ The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset nan umpiuvin.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Paul, Silas chule Timothy a kon ahi. Keiho hin I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa a hi ho Thessalonica houbung henga kahinsut u ahi.
en_web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
en_kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Paul le Silvanus chule Timothyn i-pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa jal’in Thessalonica khoa Houbung henga:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa konin chamna le lungsetna nachunguva um hen.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, keihon nangho jal in thangvahna kanei jingui, ajeh chu natahsanu akhangtou jingin chule nangho khatle khat nakingailutnau akhangtou cheh cheh in ahi.
en_web: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
en_kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all towards each other aboundeth;
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, natahsanu seithei louhel’a akhantou jeh le nabonchauva khat le khat ki-ngailutna apunjal jeh-in keihon tang louhel’a nang ho dia Pathen thangvah vah jeng ding hi akitoh lheh-e.

tcz: Keihon nangho gimbol hesoh nathohnau jouseuva tahsan naumnau thu chule hahsatna natou thudola thohhat le tahsan naumnau thu chu kisonpi tah in Pathen houbung dang ho koma kaseiyuve.
en_web: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
en_kjv: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon thohgim le bolsetna hichengpi douva hi natahsan jom jeh-un Pathen Hou bung dang ho henga nang ho kaki thang-at pi lheh jengui.

tcz: Chule Pathen in hiche gimbol hesoh thohna hi athutan dihna avetsahnom hintin, chule a Lenggama dinga loma nasemuva, hichena dinga chu thoh hahsa nathoh u ahi.
en_web: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
en_kjv: which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nathoh jeh-uva hi nathoh lo na pen’u Pathen lenggam dinga lah thei lom nahi diu, hichun Pathen thutan dihje photchetna aphondoh ding ahi.

tcz: Athutan dihna jal a aman gimhesoh a nabolhou chu alethuh ding ahi.
en_web: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
en_kjv: seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen dihtah chun nabol gen theiteu chu kitoh chet’a thohgimna apeh ding ahi;

tcz: Chule Pathen in nangho gimbol hesohna thoh ho le keiho dinga I-Pakaiyu Yeshua vana kona ahung kilah tengleh kicholdona eipeh dingu ahi. Ama Avantil thahattah ho to hung kilang ding ahiuve.
en_web: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
en_kjv: and to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
tcz_gospelgo: hiche hi van’a kona Pakai Jesu A-Vantil thanei tah te to ahung kiphondoh teng Pathenin nang ho hi nathoh gimna jouseuva kona keiho puma eilhadoh diu,

tcz: Pathen sei ngailouva chule IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa Kipana Thupha joplou ho chunga meikou jejua thutanna ahinlhut dingu ahi.
en_web: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
en_kjv: in flaming fire, taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: meikou deuje ju apat’a Pathen heloute le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Kipana Thupha jop lou jouse chunga phu alah ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu Pakaiya kona kikhendoh dingu chule aloupina thaneinaa kona a-i-tih a dinga tonsot gimbolna a mahthah dingu ahiuve.
en_web: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
en_kjv: who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho talen mat ding chu tonsot’a thoh ding man thahna, Pakai angsung le aloupina thanei tah akona tolmang hel ding ahiuve.

tcz: Ama chuche nikhoa ahung teng chuleh Aman amithengtea kona loupina amuding-atahsan ho jousea kona vahchoina akimu ding ahi. Chule hichea hin nangho jong najao uve, ajeh chu nanghon Ama thudol kaseipeh u chu natahsan tauve.
en_web: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
en_kjv: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi amithengtea kona loupina le atahsan jousea kona jabolna kisan dinga Pakai ahung nikho le chuti ding ahin, keiho hettohsah tahsan nahijeh-un atahsan lah a nang ho jong napangui.

tcz: Hitia hi i-Pathen u chun Ama kouna totoh'a hinkho namansahna dinguva keiho hi nangho dinga taojoma kahiuve. Nanghon natahsan Pau chun thilpha natohsah jouseu chu nabulhit molsona dinguvin thaneina napeuhen.
en_web: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
en_kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin i-Pathen’uvin akouna to kitoh a nasan’uva, thilpha ding nadei jouseu le tahsan vanga natoh chu athahat’a amolso soh keina din tang louhel’in nang ho kataopeh jingui.

tcz: Chutengleh i-Pakaiyu Yeshua chu nahinnau dung juiyin jabolin umintin, chule amatoh jabol a naumtha dingu ahitai. Hiche ho jouse hin hisah theiya um chu i-Pathen u lungsetna le Pakai Yeshua Christa jal ahi.
en_web: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu i-Pathenu le Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetna dungjuiya nang ho jal’a i-Pakaiyu Jesu min choi-at’a auma, nang ho Amasunga naum diu deina ahi.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, tun keihon I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa hungna ding thule Amakoma ikikhop khom dingu thudol a seichetna hinnei uvinge.
en_web: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
en_kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hungkit ding thudol le amato ikikhop khom diu thudol’a hi kangeh-u nahiuve.

tcz: Pakai nikho chu ahunglhung'ah ahitai tiho jeh in nangho bailamtah in suhlongin ahilouleh lung tijan umhih'un. Amaho chun lhagaova vetsahna eikineiye, phondohna eikipei ahilouleh keihoa konin lekhathot kaneiye tijongleu tahsan hih un.
en_web: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
en_kjv: that ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhang kisam khat tou hihen, Lhagaova kon hihen, thu kithanga kon hihen, keiho lekha thot’a kondol’a kisei hijongle, Pakai nikho chu hung lhungsa dol’in gel’un lang lung ngaito kisuh noh phahsah le lung linglaovin um hih hel’uvin.

tcz: Amahon ipi thu aseiyun nathujo dauhen. Ajeh chu hiche nikho chu ahunglhun masanga Pathen douna nasatah hunglhung ding chule danbeipa-manthaina mihempa kiti chu hung kilangdoh ding ahi.
en_web: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
en_kjv: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
tcz_gospelgo: Imacha lamin jong koima kilhep lhahsah dauvin; ajeh chu Pathen doumah bolna hung lhung masa ding, mangthah dia peng dan bei agiloupa hung kiphongdoh ding ahina laiye;

tcz: Ama kichoisang ding, chule mihon pathen atiuva aumsah u tapou chu ajahda ding chule amatah Pathen kahi tia hung ki Pathen sah ding ahi. Ama Pathen hou-in'a lut a, keima Pathen kahi ahungti ding ahi.
en_web: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
en_kjv: who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
tcz_gospelgo: amahin dou apat’a, Pathen min pu jouse le houdia kibol thil jouse chunga kichoi sanga, hitia chu acham cham’a Pahen houin geiya jong touphaa aneiya, hung kipathensah ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangho kaumpi pet uva hiche thuho jouse hi kaseipehsau chu nageldoh lou u hitam?
en_web: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
en_kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti jouse hi kaumpi laiyuva kaseipehsau chu nageldoh louvu ham?

tcz: Chule nanghon ama chu ipin atuh tang denham ti naheuve, ajeh iham itileh ama aphat lhinteng lebou hung kilang doh ding ahi.
en_web: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
en_kjv: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
tcz_gospelgo: Akitep phat tah a ahung kiphon dohna dinga tua ipin atuh kih ahi naheuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche danbeipa hin guhthima na atoh pat ahitai chule atuhtangpa hi lampia kona akiheidoh masangsea hitia hi umthim ding ahi.
en_web: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
en_kjv: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Danbei chun guh thimin na atong jinge; alailunga kona akilah mang kaha dinga bou atuhkih a chu ahen-oh ahibouve.

tcz: Chujoutah leh Mihem dan neiloupa hung kiphong doh ding, hinla Pakai Yeshua chun akama ahaidoh hua chu amapa atha ding chule ahungna aloupina chun asuhmang ding ahitai.
en_web: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
en_kjv: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
tcz_gospelgo: Danbeipa ahung chu kiphon doh tah le Pakai Jesu ahungkitna dinga hung kilah paiya akamsunga kikhong doh huiya athaa, asuh mang ding ahi.

tcz: Hichepa hin Satan natoh ama thaneina hilou chu ahinpat ding chule melchihna ho le thil kidang dang boldoh theina tha anei ding ahi.
en_web: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
en_kjv: even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
tcz_gospelgo: Danbeipa hung chu Satan thahatna to hung kilhon ding, thaneina tin cheng le melchihna ho chule jouva bolmo kidang tampi bol theina to hung kilhon diu ahi.

tcz: Aman mahthahna lampia cheho chu doha lheplhahna pana angolbol ding ahi, ajeh chu amahon huhhing achan theina dinguva ngailutna le thutah chu akisan nomlouvu ahi.
en_web: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
en_kjv: and with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
tcz_gospelgo: Huhhing a aum na diuva adih ngailutna akisan loujeh-uva manthahna lut dia umsa ho chu melse tah a alhep chatvai diu ahi.

tcz: Hitia chu Pathen in amaho chu hatah a lheplhahna a achuhsah ding, chule hiche jouthuho chu amahon atahsan dingu ahi.
en_web: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
en_kjv: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pathenin achunguva joulhepna alhunsah ahin, hichea kon hin amahon thujou atahsan’un,

tcz: Chutengleh amahon thutah chu tahsan tah sanga agilou chu athanoppi jeh uva themmo chang diu ahi.
en_web: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
en_kjv: that they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: thutah tahsan louva thujouva nomsa chengse chu athuu kitan cheh ding ahi.

tcz: Sopite, keiho dingin vang nangho Pakai ngailut ho jal a bou Pathen chu thangvahna kapeh dingu tailou adang kahepouve.
en_web: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
en_kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai dia sah tah sopite, ima-tih chan’a nang ho dinga Pathen thangvah hi kabol diu lomtah kin ahi; ijeh-inem itile thutah tahsan jeha Lhagao Theng jal’a Pathenin nang ho hi huhhing chang masa loi dia nalhendoh-u ahitai.

tcz: Aman huhhing'a naumna dinguva nakouvu ahi thua keihon Kipana Thupha kaseipeh nahiuvin; tua hi nanghon i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa loupina a chu chan naneikhom theiyu ahitai.
en_web: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa loupina nachan theina diuva Aman nang ho hi, keihon Kipana Thupha kaseipeh-uva kona nakouvu ahi.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse gel pumin, sopi deitahte, keihon nangho tahsa a kaumpi pet u hihenlang ahilouleh lekhathot a kon hijongleh nangho dingdet'un lang chule kathuhilu chu kolchah jinguvin.
en_web: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
en_kjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or by our epistle.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun sopite, kathuseiyuva kon hihen lang lekha thot’a kisun hijongle, ka hilsau chengsea chun dingdet jingun.

tcz: Tun i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Amatah le eingailu uvah I-Pau Pathen le Alungsetna jal a tonsot lhamonna chule kinepna kidangtah eipeuva chun,
en_web: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
en_kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Amatah le i-Pau Pathen, tonsot lungmonna le lungsettah a ngailut kinepna eipepau chun

tcz: Thilpha nabolna le naseinau jousea nalhamonu henlang chule nahat dohsah tauhen.
en_web: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
en_kjv: comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
tcz_gospelgo: imalam jousea natoh pha le thupha seinaa nalungthimu tilkou hen lang phutdet jing hen.

tcz: Achainakeiyin sopi deitahte, keiho dingin hungtaovun tia kangeh nahiuve. Nangho henga anahung tobanga chu Pakai thuhil hi alhunna chan a gangtah a akithejala chule jabol'a aumtheina dingin taovun.
en_web: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
en_kjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, tukalse vang nang ho lah a banga Pakai thu hi gangtah a seiphonga choi-at’a aum na din keiho dingin neitaokop jingun.

tcz: Chujongleh amitakip tahsannei ahiloujeh uvin, keiho migilou le miphalou hoa kona huhdoh kachan theina dinguvin taovun.
en_web: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
en_kjv: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
tcz_gospelgo: chujongle mihon atahsansoh loulai jeh-un mihem gilou le engse hoa kona kahoidoh theina diuvin jong neitaokop jinguvin.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai hi tahsan umtah ahin, Aman natha hatsah uvintin, chule agiloupa a konin nahuhbit nauvinte.
en_web: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
en_kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai chu tahsan umtah ahin, aman naphut det’un tin agiloupa konin nachingtup jing nauvinte.

tcz: Chule keiho Pakaiya kakisonnau chu–nanghon kathupeh u chu naboluva chule naboljom dingu ahi ti kakisonpiu nahiuve.
en_web: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
en_kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai jal’a nang ho kaginchat jeh-uva natoh ngai bang natoh jingna diuva thu kapeh na hiuve.

tcz: Pakaiyin nalungthimu Pathen ngailutna hetkhenna le phondohna bukim keiyin chule Christa a kona thohhatna lama napuiyu hen.
en_web: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
en_kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungthimu chu Pathen ngailutna le Christa thohhatna lama Pakaiyin kaihoi hen.

tcz: Chule tun, sopi deitahte, Pakai Yeshua mina hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahiuve: tahsannei sopiho jouse thasea hinkho mangho chule keihoa kona kathuhilu juilou hoa konin kikhindoh un.
en_web: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
en_kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, sopi koi hile akahleh akalouva chon, keiho hilchahna to kitoh a chon lou mi jouse chu nakiloikhompi louna diuva Pakai Jesu Christa min pan’a thu kapeh nahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon keiho umchan najom diu adol ahi. Keiho nangho toka umkhom laiyun kathase khapouve.
en_web: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
en_kjv: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
tcz_gospelgo: Nakom’uva tong louva ka-umlouvu, keiho umchan itobanga najop’u nang hon na heuve.

tcz: Keihon kaneh manu pelouvin koima an kanepouve. Keihon koima kapohgih sah louna dinguvin sun le jan in katong gimuve.
en_web: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
en_kjv: neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
tcz_gospelgo: Koima an manbeiyin kanepouvin, nang ho koimacha pohgih kahi khah louna diuvin gim genthei hahsa thoh-in sun le janin na katongu’ve.

tcz: Keihon neivah dinguva thupeh kapeh thei nahiuve, hinla keihon najui dinguvin vetsahna kapejo bou uve.
en_web: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
en_kjv: not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuneina kaneilou jeh-u ahipoi, keiho umchan najom theina diuva nang ho vetsahna monga kabol’u ahibouve.

tcz: Keihon nangho kaumpi pet jenguva jong, hiche thupeh hi kapeh u nahi, “Natong nomlou hon nehding kimulou ding ahiuve,” tihi.
en_web: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
en_kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile i-umkhom pet’uva koi hile natong nom lou chu anjong nehsah lou dia nang ho thu kapehsau ahitai.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nangho phabep thasetah in hinkho namanguvin, natoh nanom pouve chule midang natohna chunga kikum naumuve.
en_web: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
en_kjv: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nalahuva kon khat akaleh akalouva chon, natong louva mi sinmo le bep thu kajauve.

tcz: Keihon hitobang miho chu thu kapeuvin, chule Pakai Yeshua Christa minin amaho chu kangeh uve, amaho chun ageltoh uva chule akihinsona diuva na atoh diu hi ahi.
en_web: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
en_kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang miho hin thip beh cha na akitoh-uva an akineh diuva Pakai Jesu Christa min pan’a thu kapeh-uva katilkhouvu ahi.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, nangho lah a adangse dinga kasei chu, thilpha bolnaa chimhihbeh uvin.
en_web: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
en_kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nang ho vang thilpha bol nan chimtih neilou jen’un.
