tcz: Hiche lekhathot a keiho seingailou ho chu melchih uvin, amahoa konin kichom khendoh leu chun amaho jahcha tauvinte.
en_web: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
en_kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekha thot’a keiho thu ngailou chu nang hon melchih-un lang, ajachatna din kivoppi dauvin.

tcz: Amaho chu melma ho gelin gel hih un, hinla sopi nabolna bangun sosalun.
en_web: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
en_kjv: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle melma banga bol louvin sopi bangin hilchahjo’uvin.

tcz: Tun Cham-lungmon kona Pathen chun cham-lungmon imatih chanin chule phat jousen nape jingu hen. Pakaiyin naumpi jingu hen.
en_web: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
en_kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
tcz_gospelgo: Chamna bulpi Pakaiyin imalam jouse le ijakaiya chamna napeu hen. Pakaiyin nabonchauvin umpiu hen.

tcz: Hiche hi keima Paul in kakhuttah a kajih chibai bohna ahi. Hitia keima tah in lekhathot kajihna ho photchennaa hitia hi kabolji ahi.
en_web: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
en_kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche salam hi keima Paul khut’a hungkon, lekha thot jousea melchihna a hitia kasutji ahi.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa milungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpi tauhen.
en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. ¶ The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakai Jesu Christa lungset nan nabonchauvin umpiuvin.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua solchah, Pathen eihuhhingpu'u thupeh le kinepna eipeuvah Christa Yeshua pansah, Paul, a kon ahi.
en_web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
en_kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
tcz_gospelgo: I-kinep nau Jesu Christa le Eihuhhinguva Pathen thusah a Jesu Christa Solchah Paul’in

tcz: Keiman tahsan jal a chapa deitah Timothy henga dinga kasut ahi. Pa Pathen leh Pakai Yeshua lungsetna leh khotona chuleh chamnan naumpihen.
en_web: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: tahsan jal’a cha dihtah Timothy henga: i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa le Pa Pathen’a konin lungset le hepi chule chamna hunglhung hen.

tcz: Macedonia jona kanache laiya Ephesus mun'ah uminlang thuhil dihlouho suthip in kati bangin, aphachomlou thusim seileh khanggui thuseina'a kihoulimna ho chu anasutangin, hiche ho chun Pathen tahsanna lama khantouna asosah theipon ahi.
en_web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
en_kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
tcz_gospelgo: Mi abang bangin thuhil dih lou ahil louna diuva phoh tang dia Macedonia lam kajot kon’a ka-ngeh bangin Ephesus umdenin,

tcz: Aphachomlou thusim seileh khanglui thuseina-a kihoulimna ho chu anasutangin, hiche ho chun Pathen tahsanna lamah khantouna asosah theipon ahi.
en_web: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.
en_kjv: neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon semthu thusim ho pou le akhonna bei khanggui thusim aseiho’u chun miho lung lutsah hih-in, hiche ho hin tahsan vanga ki mu Pathen gou-thilho sangin kinel baotam na jeng bou asosah-e.

tcz: Keiman nang kathuhilna-a katup chu ahileh tahsan chate jouse hi lungthim thengtah a selepha hetkhenna toh tahsan kicheh tah a kona ngailutna adimsetna diu kati ahi.
en_web: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
en_kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla hiche thupeh kipeh lo na lungthim theng tah le ngailut lunggel chule tahsan kicheh tah a hung kon ngailutna khantousah ding thu ahibouve.

tcz: Ahinlah mi phabep in alakhel gamtauvin, amaho chu hichehoa konin akihei mang gamun thilpha chomlou kihoulimna'ah akimangcha gam tauvin ahi.
en_web: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
en_kjv: from which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kimkhat hichenga kon hin akihei mangun avah koi leuvin mohkihoulim nan akimang gamtauve.

tcz: Amaho hi Mose dan thuhil juidanin aumun ahinlah amahon thutahbeh seija aseivangun athuseihou jong akihetchet pouvin ahi.
en_web: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.
en_kjv: desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
tcz_gospelgo: Akison nau jong kicheh lou, thusei jong kichen lou, hejong hekhen louvin Danthu hil’in apan nom’ui.

tcz: Eihon dan hi ahiding banga imanchah leh aphai tihi iheuve.
en_web: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
en_kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu hi adoltah a mangpa dia thilpha ahi i-heuve.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh dan hi thildih bol ho dinga kisema ahipon, dan nitlou, thilsebol ho, Pathen helou hole chonseho, thiltheng subohho, anule apa thatho chule mithat ho dinga kisema ahibouve.
en_web: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
en_kjv: knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hitin akimui, Danthu hi midih pa ding ahipon, Dan sukeh ho le hutuh lel ho, Pathen heloute le chonse ho, atheng lou ho le aboh ho, pa that ho le nu that ho, mihem that ho,

tcz: Dan hi jonthanhoiya kipeho, pasal leh pasal kikoiho, chule mihem a kiveiho, mijouho, kitepna sukeh ho,
en_web: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
en_kjv: for whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
tcz_gospelgo: mito jonpan ho, ki-ngai-jong ho, mihem gumang ho, joubol ho, jouva kihahsel ho chule ipi hijongle adang adih lama kihilna to kikal jouse bol ho ding ahibouve.

tcz: I-Pathen un eingansena dungjuia hiche loupi tah Kipana Thupha kahilna toh kikal a chon ho jouse dinga kisema ahi.
en_web: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
en_kjv: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
tcz_gospelgo: Kihilna dih chu keima eikivopsah kipa umtah Pathen loupina Kipana Thupha dungjuija kihilna chu ahi.

tcz: Hiche natohna dinga thahat eipea I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa kathangvah-e. Aman akinbol dingin tahsan theiyin eigelin, eipansah-in ahi.
en_web: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
en_kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
tcz_gospelgo: Keima tahsan theiya eigel’a lhacha eipansah, thahat eipea i-Pakai Jesu chunga kakipah lhehjenge.

tcz: Keima tumasanga Christa min taitoma kana pana thilse bolhat kanahin, amite kanabolset jeng vang'in Pathen khotona chu kachangin ahi. Ajehchu keiman hetthemlou jeh le tahsan loujeh a kanabol ahi.
en_web: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
en_kjv: who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
tcz_gospelgo: Masang chun ataitom le abolse chule pumhat jengin kana pangin, ahinla hiti ho chu atahsan lou kahijeh a hetoh louva kabol ahijeh-in Patehnin eihepin,

tcz: O, I-Pakai chu ichangeiya milungset them le khoto them hitam! Aman Yeshua Christa-a konin tahsanna le lungsetna chun eina sudimtan ahi.
en_web: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa jal’in i-Pakaiyu milungset chu tahsan le ngailut pumin keidin alet lha jengin ahi.

tcz: Christa hi michonsete huhhing dingin vannoiya hin ahungin ahi tihi tahsan umtah thuhil ahin, mijousen sanding doltah ahi, chuleh hicheho lah a chu keima hi achonse chungnungpen kahi.
en_web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
en_kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonsete huhhing dinga Jesu Christa vannoiya ahung hi tahsan dinga lhingset thu ahi; choset ho lah a keima akhoh pen kahin,

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in khotona eina musah hin, Yeshua Christa hi mijouse lah-a chonsepen in jong atahsanleh tonsot hinkemlou aneithei ding ahi ti ahetdoh theina diuva keima hi vettoh thei pipena eimanchah ahi.
en_web: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
en_kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hintahsan’a tonsot hinna nei ding ho vetkah a pang dia Jesu Christan thoh hatna chengse chu amasapen’a kei chunga photchetna abol nom jeh a hita chu eihepi lheh jeng ahi.

tcz: Loupina le jangaina jouse atonsot atonsot in Pathen a hijing tahen! Amahi tonsot leng, mutheilou, thitheilou, amabouhi hiche Pathen chu ahi, Amen.
en_web: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Tonsot Lengpa, thi-tih neilou, mutheilo Pathen khatseh chu jabolna le loupina tonsot tonsto’in chang jing hen: Amen.

tcz: Kachapa Timothy, nachunga gaothua anakiseiya kon a hiche thuhil hi kapeh nahi. Hiche hin Pakaiya dinga nagalsatna-a nahatsah ding ahi.
en_web: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
en_kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai phatah banga hichenga chu gal nasat theina ding, masanga nachung chang thua kisei masa ho dungjuiya napan theina dia hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi chapa Timothy.

tcz: Christa a natahsan chu tuhdet in chule se le pha hetna nalungsung chu sutheng jingin. Miphabep khat'in hiche selepha het theina lungsung chu amang khel'un atahsannau kong chu akehgamtan ahi.
en_web: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
en_kjv: holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away, concerning faith have made shipwrack:
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan le hetkhenna pha nei jingin, mi bangin hiche hi anahsah loujeh-un tahsan asuhmang lo tauve.

tcz: Hymenaeus leh Alexander teni hi vetkah thei ahilhon e. Keiman amani chu Pathen ataitom kitlhon louna dinga Satan khut a kapehdoh lhon ahitai.
en_web: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
en_kjv: of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama ho lah a hin Hymnenaeus le Alexander jong apangin, ama ni hi Pathen ataitom lhon louna dia hilchah ding in Satan koma kapeh doh tai.

tcz: Amasapen in mijouse dinga tao dingin kangeh-un ahi. Pathen hepina achan theina dingun thum'un, chuleh amaho dingin thangvahna peuvin.
en_web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
en_kjv: I exhort therefore that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
tcz_gospelgo: Amasapen’a ka-ngeh nahiuve, thumna le taona, midang taopehna chule thangvahna ho mijouse dinga,

tcz: Lengho leh thuneina muna umho dingin taovun, hitia chu Pathen jana neipuma lungmong tahle chamdel a hinkho imantheina diuvin.
en_web: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
en_kjv: for kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
tcz_gospelgo: leng ho le thunei vaihomte din neiyun, chuti le Pathen ging le gun che na puma chamdel le lung mongtah a hinkho iman thei diu ahi.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh hichu thilphatah eihuhhingpau Pathen lahthei doltah ahi.
en_web: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
en_kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichu eihuhinguva Pathen mitmua santhei thilpha ahi.

tcz: Aman mijouse hi huhhing'a aumtheina dingleh thutah hetna ahinneithei diu hi eideipeh u ahi.
en_web: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
en_kjv: who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen chun mihem josue huhhinga aum’a thutah het theiya ahung um diu hi adeiye.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen khatseh leh mihemte kikah-a chamna eisempeh theiyuvah palai khatseh Yeshua Christa aumin ahi.
en_web: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen khatseh ahin, Pathen le mihemte kah a palai jong khat bou ahi- Mihem Jesu Christa chu,

tcz: Aman mijouse dingin ahinna mangchan chamlhatna eichohdoh peh tauvin ahi. Hiche hi Pathen in vannoi mite aphatcha ahetsahnom chu ahi.
en_web: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
en_kjv: who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chamtah-in mi jouse lhatdoh nan a hung kipen, hettohsahna chu aphat cha um doh ahi.

tcz: Chule hiche tahsan thu leh thutah thuhi chidang namdangte lah-a hilchen ding leh seiphong dinga keima hi solchah-a eikilhengdoh ahitai. Keiman kaseivalpoi thutah bou kasei ahi.
en_web: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
en_kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche dinga hi aseiphong dingle solchah dia eikipansah ahi tah kasei ahin, jou kaseipoi, thutah le tahsan thua chiding namdangte hil’a pang kahi.

tcz: Pathen houkhomna mun jousea, mihon lunghanna le kinelbautam neilouva Pathen lama akhuttheng adop uva taona amandiu kadeiyin ahi.
en_web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
en_kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun muntin’a pasal hon lung hang lou hel le kinel baotam louhel’a khut theng dom’a atao diu kadeiye.

tcz: Chuleh numei hohi adolbep chan kijemu henlang kiphalam khenchan umuhen. Akivondiu bepchan kivon u henlang, asampheh danuvah chingtheiyuhen, sana le dangka mantam ahilouleh thilman lutah kivona kilelahna neidauhen.
en_web: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
en_kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobangma chun numeiho jong nihchen ponsil dol’in gingkhen le chinghtei tah-in amaho tah kivon’u hen; sampheh hoi le sana ham, twikohchang ham, ponsil hoi ham, thil mantam pen ham a kijem louvin

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen ngaisah kahi ti numeiho chu achonphatnauvin kijemjoleu aphai.
en_web: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
en_kjv: but (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ginje phong doh thei numei umdol’in thilpha bol’in kijemjou’u hen.

tcz: Numeihon kangkhencha leh ginggeh cha a um kithemchuh uhen.
en_web: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
en_kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
tcz_gospelgo: Numei chu imalam jousea thua nungkhen chan thip beh chan kihiljou’u hen.

tcz: Numei hohi pasalho chunga thunei dingleh thuhil dingin thu kapepoi, thipkhen chan thu ngaileu kati.
en_web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
en_kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihil dingle pasal chuang tha nei din numei kangensepoi, chusangin umthim ngit nget jou’u hen.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in Adam asem masan chujouvin Eve asemin ahi.
en_web: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
en_kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Adam kisem masa chujouva Evi ahi.

tcz: Chuleh Satan in alheplhah chu Adam ahipon, numeinu joh chu ana lheplhah-a chonset hunglut ahi.
en_web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
en_kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
tcz_gospelgo: Adam chu lhep lhah a um ahipon, numei nu joh lhep lhah a um’a, themmochangkha ahibouve.

tcz: Ahinlah numeiho hi tahsannale ngailutna'a, thenna le chonnema aum jingleh achahin uva kona huhhing'a umding ahiuve.
en_web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lung lim-geh leh kisuthenga, tahsan le ngailut neiya aum jom jing le numei chu acha neinaa jong kihinso jing ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi tahsanthei ding doltah'a kisei ahi. “Khattouvin Houbung Upa hi ding natoh anopleh amachun ja umtah panmun adei ahi.”
en_web: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
en_kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
tcz_gospelgo: ‘Koi hile Houbung lakai nom chun natohpha adeichat ahi,’ ti hi tahsan theidol thu ahi.

tcz: Hijehchun Houbung Upa ding chu ja umtah nolnabei hinkho mang hiding ahi. Aji ang'a kitah ding, ama le ama kitimjoumi hiding, chingthei tah a hing hiding, chule minphat na nei hiding ahi. Jindot them chule mihilthem hiding ahi.
en_web: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
en_kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Houbung lamkai ding chu nolnabei, numeikhatseh jia nei, kitimthei, lung limtah, kitup tah, jin dotthem, mihil them,

tcz: Ama chu julopmi ahiloule agilou hilou ding ahi. Ama chu milungneng hiding, mitoh kinahat hilou ding, chule sum ngailu lou mi hiding ahi.
en_web: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
en_kjv: not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
tcz_gospelgo: ju nelou, mideng lou, nun nema doubol lou, sum ngailu lou,

tcz: A-insung kipohtupjou mi, achaten ajathei le athua nunsah joumi hiding ahi.
en_web: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
en_kjv: one that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
tcz_gospelgo: a-insung phatea kipoh tupthei, ja umtah a achate athua nunsah thei mi hiding ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu a-insung akivettup joulouleh Pathen houbung chu iti avettup jouding ham?
en_web: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
en_kjv: (for if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
tcz_gospelgo: Ama insung bon poh tupje helouvan Pathen Houbung iti apoh tup thei ding ham?

tcz: Houbung Upa ding chu tahsanthah hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu hung kiletsah intin Diabolin asuhlhuh ding ahi.
en_web: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
en_kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu tahsan thah hilou ding ahi, ajo le kiletsah jeh a Diabol themmo chan naa ama jong chuh lo ding ahi.

tcz: Chujong leh, pam a miho seiphat changmi hiding ahi, achuti louleh miseiset achanna-a kon chun Diabol thangkolah ohkhaget inte.
en_web: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
en_kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Seiset achan a Diabol thanga a-o khah lou na dinga polam mite sephat jong hi ding ahi.

tcz: Chutobang ma chun deacon panmun loding ho jong chu ja-um mi chuleh kitahna neimi hiding, ju'a lopmi hilou ding, sum a kitahlou mi hilou ding ahi.
en_web: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
en_kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung lhacha ding jong migin ja um ma, kamtam lou, ju lop lou, alam louva sum veikan lou,

tcz: Tahsan thugil tua kiphongdoh thudol'a kipeh theng nanei, chule lungthengsel a hing mi hidiu ahi.
en_web: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
en_kjv: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
tcz_gospelgo: lung ngaito thengsel’a tahsan thua thilguh hetna nei mi hi diu ahi.

tcz: Amahohi Deacon a akipansah masanga hoitah a kholchil masat ding, alhin uva ahileh Deacon panmun a pang ding ahiuve.
en_web: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
en_kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho kipatep masau hen, nolnabei ahiule lhachaa pang diu ahi.

tcz: Hitobangma-a chu ajiteu jong ja um mi hiding, miseiset hat hilou ding, amale ama kitimjoumi hiding chuleh anatohna jousea jong kitahna neimi hiding ahiuve.
en_web: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
en_kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajiteu jong hitobanga chu migin ja um, jouva mi hehse lou, kitimthei, ijakaiya tahsan um mi hi diu ahi.

tcz: Deacon ho chu jikhat neimi hiding chuleh achateu leh a-insung kivetsuijou mi hiding,
en_web: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
en_kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhacha ho chu numei khatseh jia nei hi cheh-u hen, achateu le a-insunga kitup’a po-them cheh hiu hen.

tcz: Deacon natohna a lolhingtah michun mipia kon a jana changdiu hichun Yeshua Christa atahsannau toh tahsan aumnau asuhpung ding ahi.
en_web: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile phatah a lhacha kinbol mihon din mun pha akisemdoh-un, Christa Jesu sunga um tahsan thudol’a hangtah-in apang ngam’ui.

tcz: Nakom u hunglhunvah ding kinepna kanei jing vang'in tun hiche hohi kahin sun e.
en_web: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
en_kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
tcz_gospelgo: Hunga nangma mu loi ding kinem’a hiche lekha hi kasut ahi.

tcz: Ijemtia keima kahunggei khah leh Pathen insung mite iti chondiu ham ti nahettheina dinga kati ahi. Hiche hi hingjing Pathen houbung ahin, hichu thutah kingapna khombul ahi.
en_web: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
en_kjv: but if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijemtia kahung gei khat le thutah bul le khompi- Pathen insunga chu iti chon ding nahetna dia kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Kinelna beihel in, hiche hi itahsan nauthugil loupitah chu ahi. Christa chu mihem a hung kilanga Lhagaovin atahlanga vantil hon amuu ahi. Ama thuhi chitin namtin lah-a akiphong jal in vannoi miten atahsan un chuleh loupitah in van ah lahtouvin aumtai.
en_web: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
en_kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hou thuguh kiphongdoh aletdol chu hiche ahi: “Ama tahsaphen akiphongdoh-in, Lhagaovin them achangtan; Vantilte mit mun aum doh-in, Chitin namtin lah a seiphongin aumin, Vannoija min atahsan tan, Loupin lah touvin aum tai.”

tcz: Tun Lhagao Thengin kichehtah-in eiseipeh-un, ni nunung teng mitamtah, tahsan dihtah-a kona pullha ding, amahon thilha hoa kona lhagao dihlouho thuhil ajui diu ahi.
en_web: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
en_kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
tcz_gospelgo: Ni nu nung lam le mi abang bang tahsan naa dailhauva jousei lhagao ho le thilha ho thuhil’a ahung lung lut diu thu, lhagaovin kichentah-in aseiye.

tcz: Amaho chu thuhillhem chule mijouho ahiuvin, selepha ahetnau lungthim chu athisa ahi.
en_web: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
en_kjv: speaking lies in hypocrisy, having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang phat lhem na ho hi alunggel’u kisou tahsa mijou hoa hung kon ahi.

tcz: Amahon jinei hi adihpoi atiuvin chuleh thutah hea tahsanten thangvah taona puma aneh diuva Pathen in asemho chu nehding adihpoi atidiu ahi.
en_web: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
en_kjv: forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama ho hin jinei ding akham’un, atahsan hon thutah hetna jeh a thangvah puma akisan diuva Pathenin asemsa neh thei dolchu neh ding ajadauve.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thilsemho jouse hi thangvah taona puma ikisana ahileh aphamo umlou paidoh ding jong umlou ahi.
en_web: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
en_kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thilsem chengse aphasoh keiye, thangvah pum’a ikisan le imacha pai ding aumpoi.

tcz: Ajehchu hiche hi Pathen Thule taonaa santhei ding dol a kisuthenga ahiti iheuve.
en_web: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
en_kjv: for it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathen thu le taonaa kisuthengsoh ahitai.

tcz: Timothy nangin hichehohi sopiho koma nasei chetpehleh nangma, tahsan thua kikhoukhah chule thuhilpha juiyah, Christa Yeshua lhacha lomtah nahi ding ahi.
en_web: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
en_kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin nahinjuipeh thuhil pha le naki khou khahna tahsan thu ho chu sopite pe le chun Jesu Christa lhacha phatah nahi ding ahi.

tcz: Amavang Pathen deilou gollui thusimho le thuchavai ki houlimna hoa konin kidalsen lang Pathen dei hinkhoa kipuikhangna ah kipelutjon.
en_web: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
en_kjv: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang thilboh, numei tehse ho loulimna ho chu pai mangin; natahsa tah-in hou ngaisahna lam’a kichuh themjon.

tcz: Tahsalam phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphanai, ahinla Lhagaolam dol a phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphajoi, ajeh chu hichehin tuhinkhoa dingleh khonunga dinga phatchomna tah ahi chu thutep uma ahi.
en_web: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
en_kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile tahsa lama kichuna jong them khat thil phachom ahinan, Pathen houlam’a kichuhna hi tu hinkho ding hinhen, kho nung hinkho dinga hijongle aphat chom na thutep umsa ahi.

tcz: Hichehi tahsan theidol tah-a kisei ahin, mijousen asanding doltah ahi.
en_web: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
en_kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hi tahsan um, imalam jousea san dinga kilom tah ahi.

tcz: Hiche ding jeh-a hi hatah a itoh-u ahin, tohjong itohjom jing dingu ahi, ajeh chu, mijouse huhhingpu ahidehset a tahsan chate Huhhingpu hingjing Pathena ikijopnau uma ahi.
en_web: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
en_kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
tcz_gospelgo: Hing jing Pathen, mitin huhhingpu, ahideh a atahsante huhhingpa chunga ikinep jeh-un itong gim’un ikiseh lheh jengui.

tcz: Hiche thu hohi hil inlang amaho chu hetthemsah teiding khohsah-in.
en_web: Command and teach these things.
en_kjv: These things command and teach.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu hicheng hi pen lang, hil’in.

tcz: Nakhandonjeh hin mi nahsahmo theiyin umhih-in, amavang nathusei dan leh nahinkho mandan in, namingailutna-in, natahsan hinkho kimanchah danleh thenna hinkho naman danin atahsan ho vetjui theiyin um'in.
en_web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
en_kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
tcz_gospelgo: nachapan jeh chun koiman noise bol da hen, hisang chun thulam, chonchan lam, ngailutna le tahsa lam chule themna lam in atahsante vetsui theiyin umjon.

tcz: Keima kahung kahsen, Pathen Thu simna in, tahsan chate tilkhouna-in chuleh thuhillam in anaponthon.
en_web: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
en_kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahung kahsen Pathen lekhabu simna lam le mi tilkhou lam, chule mihil lamin anaponthon.

tcz: Houbunga Pakai lhachaten nachunga khut angap uva nachungchang thua themgao thuphondoh naa kona Lhagao Thilpeh nachan chu nahsahmo hihbeh-in.
en_web: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
en_kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
tcz_gospelgo: Themgao hon thu aseiyuva upa hon nachunga thenso khut angap’uva nakipe Lhagao thilpeh nachan khahchu nahsah mon boldan.

tcz: Hichenga hin lungluttah-in pangin. Nakhantouna hi mijouse het a akilah dohtheina dingin nanatohna-a hin kipumpeh jingin.
en_web: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
en_kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
tcz_gospelgo: Mijouse anga nakhantou akiphondoh theina din hichengse hi bol’in hiche hoa hin lung lut’in.

tcz: Nathuhil dungjui chun kimangchan, hichu chepi jingin chutileh Pathen in phatthei naboh ding chuleh nathuhil jahojong phatthei chang diu ahi.
en_web: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
en_kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachung chang ahin, nathuhil ahin, kiging phan, hichenga chun pansan, ajeh chu hiti hinbol le chun nangma tah le nathuja ho nahuhdoh ding ahije.

tcz: Upa tehseho chu phoh hih-in, napa tobang'in jana neitah'in jolthon, khangdong pasalho chu napenpi nasopitah tobang'in kihoupin,
en_web: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
en_kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
tcz_gospelgo: Upa chu phohsal hih-in, napa tobangin tilkhou thon; khangdong ho chu sopi bol’in,

tcz: Nupi tehseho chu nanu tobang'in gel inlang, nasanga dongjo numeiho chu napenpi nasopinu tobang'in lungthengtah-in kaihoiyin.
en_web: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
en_kjv: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
tcz_gospelgo: nupi ho nubol’in, nu-ngah ho nanaote bangin thengsel’in i-lam jousea kaihoiyin.

tcz: Ajending koimacha neilou meithai hochu jana neitah-in kaihoiyin,
en_web: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
en_kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithai tahbeh ho chu meithai jabol dol’in jabol’in.

tcz: Ahinlah chate le tute nei ahiuleh amopohnau masapen chu a-insunga Pathen mikhotona apohdoh dingu, ahinguvah anule apateu phatna ngailutna-a alethuh diu ahi. Hichu Pathen lung lhaina ahi.
en_web: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
en_kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithai chun tu le cha anei le amaho hin amasan a-insunguva Pathen hou ngaisahna kichuh-u hen, ahinvah dohho lungset thuh kihil masau hen; ijeh-inem itile hiche hi Pathen maiya santheidol tah ahi.

tcz: Amavang leiset chunga ainsungmi umtalou meithai dihtah hochun Pathena akingapnau ngaplhahna aneitheiyun, Pathen in apanpina diuvin sunle jan in ataojingun ahi.
en_web: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
en_kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
tcz_gospelgo: Meithai kicheh tah achanga um vang chu Pathena kinem’a sun le jan’a thumna le tao naa kipe jing jeng ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah meithai nopsahna hinkhoa kimang chajing hovang ahinlai sunga jong athisa ahiuve.
en_web: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
en_kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsa nop sahnaa kimang nu vang chu ahing laiya thisa ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu miseiset achanlouna diuva hiche thupeh hohi napeh ding ahi.
en_web: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
en_kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu seiset achan louna diuvin thupeh hicheng hi pen.

tcz: Ahinlah koihileh ama sopite ding khohsahna neilou adeh deh'a ama insung mite ding khohsah louho chun tahsan dihtah chu apaidoh-u ahitan, hitobang ho chu atahsanlouho sanga khohjo ahiuve.
en_web: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
en_kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin koi hile amite ding ngaito lou, ahideh a a-insung mite ding ngaito lou chun tahsan ataitom ahitan, atahsan loupa sanga khohjo ahitai.

tcz: Kithopi dinga amin kikhum meithaiho chu alhompen a kum somgup hiding, ajipa anga kitahna ana neimi hiding ahi.
en_web: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
en_kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
tcz_gospelgo: Kum somgup noiya mi hilou chu meithaiya sut thei ahi, pasal khatseh jia nei mi,

tcz: Amachu achate ahin khoukhahna a athilphabol jeh'a mijouse jana changmi hiding, maljin khoto, tahsan kibahpiho kisunemtah a jenmi hiding, hahsatna tohho kithopi nommi hiding ahi.
en_web: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
en_kjv: well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
tcz_gospelgo: thilpha bolnaa seiphat chang, khou khahje themsa, jindot them, mithengte keng silpehsa, genthei hesoh kithopia imalam jouse a thilpha bolna kipum peh mi hi ding ahi.

tcz: Khangdong meithaiho vang panglou diu ahi, ajeh chu Christa dinga akipehnau sanga atahsau ngaichatna chu hatjoding jineikit nomdiu ahi.
en_web: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
en_kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdong meithai ho vang pansah dan, ijeh-inem itile jinei ding adeichat tengu le Christa deimo lamtah-in aum doh jiuvin,

tcz: Hiche chun kitepna aneisau chu asuhkeh-a themona changdiu ahi.
en_web: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
en_kjv: having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
tcz_gospelgo: atahsan masah apailhah jeh-un themmo achanlo jiuve.

tcz: Chuleh amaho chun thaset hinpanuntin intina vahle untin, thuchavai seina'a kipeuvintin, mi natohna-a gakikum lediu chuleh akinlouva thuseina'a gakamjao lediu ahi.
en_web: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
en_kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuche tilouvin jong thaset apan’un muntin’a akholai lengun, thaset keoseh hilouvin amuh them kamjauvun, sei ding lomlou thupou aseiyui.

tcz: Hijeh chun hitobang khangdong meithai hohi ajineikit uva cha aneidiu, inchen akisemdiu kaphatsah ahi. Chutileh melma chun amaho chu aseisetna diu agomkom aneilou diu ahi.
en_web: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
en_kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijehchun khangdong nalai ho chun ji aneiyuva cha ahindiu, insung akiphouva melma chu thilse bolna phat adei banga apeh louhel diu kadeijoi.

tcz: Ajehchu amaho lah a phabep khat hi achelengun, Satan nung ajui tauve tihin eitijat sah'in ahi.
en_web: For already some have turned away after Satan.
en_kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
tcz_gospelgo: Mikonkhat jong Satan nung juiyin akihei mang tavue.

tcz: Tahsancha numei khat chun sopi meithai aneiya ahileh amaho chu phatah-in kivetsui henlang mopohna houbung chunga ngapdahen. Chutileh houbungin achangseh'a cheng meithaiho phatah-a avetsuithei dingu ahi.
en_web: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
en_kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan numei khattouvin meithai ho anei khah le hiche ho chu kithopi hen; chutile meithai tahbeh ho chu Houbungin akithopi thei ding ahi.

tcz: Houbung Upa akin phatah-a tongho adehset athupha lhangsapna le thuhilna-a hapanho chu jana pehding chuleh atohman jong phatah a pehding ahi.
en_web: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
en_kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: Upa lamkai pha, thu seiphong le thuhil lama hapan’a pang ho chu tohman ajat ni chan amu diu lom tah ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Bongchal changchila chu amuh kikan hihhen chujongleh natonga chu atohman asanding lomtah ahi,” ati.
en_web: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
en_kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabun, “Bongchal chang chilpet amuh som hih-in,” atin, chule “Natong’an tohman asan lomtah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Houbung lhacha khat chunga hehna aumleh hettohsah mini, mithum aumlouleh lahih in.
en_web: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
en_kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahetoh mi ni le thum alhin loule upa khat kihehna chu la hih-in.

tcz: Adanghon kichatna aneitheina dingin achonseho chu mipi angsunga sosal'in.
en_web: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
en_kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
tcz_gospelgo: Midangin kichatnaa anei theina din achonse ho chu japi masanga solsal’in.

tcz: Pathen leh Yeshua Christa chuleh vantil sangpen ho mitmua hiche thuhi kapeh nahi, hiche thupeh hohi langnei naleh sihneina koimacha koma neilouvin mangchan.
en_web: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
en_kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen le Jesu Christa chule lhentum Vantilte angsunga giltah a kahil chah nahi, thupeh hicheng hi mangin lang phochen louvin thu tandan, chule lang neiyin jong ima bol hih-in.

tcz: Houbung sunga Pakai lhacha napansah ding tengleh kino hihbeh in. Midang chonsetna-a kinunat hih-in, nangle nang kisuthengin.
en_web: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
en_kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
tcz_gospelgo: Kintheng tong ding ahi tin koima chung a thenso-khut ngamloi hihin, midang ho chonsetnaa jong pandan, thenna din nangle nang kiging jingin.

tcz: Tuisih jengseh donhih in, naveiset jeh leh nagilpi damlouna jeh in lengpitwi themkhat khat anamang jitan.
en_web: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
en_kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
tcz_gospelgo: Nagilpi nat jeh le nadammo veiset jing jeh chun twisih keo jeng don louvin lengpitwi them khat mangin.

tcz: Miphabep chonsetna hi mijouse het in akilangin, suhdihthei ahi. Ahinla miphabep chonsetna hi khonungle bou hung kilang ding loi aume ti sumil hih in.
en_web: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
en_kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem phabeppi hi achonset nau kilang tah ahin, hichun thutan na mun alhut loi jengin, phabepse chonsetna vang, khonung teng akiphongjibouve.

tcz: Chutobang chun miphabep thilpha bol hi mipi het in akilangdoh theiyin, chuleh miphabep in thilpha abol hi phatkhat lebou hung kilang doh ding ahi.
en_web: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
en_kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin natoh pha jong kilang tah ahin, kilangdoh lou aum jongle kisel thei ahideh poi.

tcz: Sohhon Pathen min leh athuhil taiponga aumsah louna dinguvin a Pakai teu ginleh jabolna lhingset apehjing diu angaiye.
en_web: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
en_kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen min le kihilna hi taitoma aum louna din namkoljon po nalai soh chengsen leiset’a a pakai teu chu gin le jabol lomtah a anei diu ahi.

tcz: Chuleh apakai teu chu tahsan chate anahi khah jongleh sopi ahijeh chun nahsahmon boldau hen, chusang chun hajencheh joh uhen, ajeh chu anatoh-u phatchompi hochu angailut u tahsan chate mama ahiuve. Timothy, hiche thuhi hilin, anitchehna diuvin tilkhouvin.
en_web: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
en_kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsansa pakaiya neikha hon jong sopi ahi tah man’a nahsah moa abol lou diu ahi; chusangin hajen cheh jou’u hen, ijeh-inem itile atohgau akisan nau miho chu tahsan nei le ngailutna neimi ahitauve.

tcz: Mi phabep in kathuhilu hi ana khel maitheiyu ahi, ahinla hichehi Pakai Yeshua Christa thuhil phachomtah chu ahi. Hiche thuhil hin Pathen deilam hinkho akhantousah ahi.
en_web: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
en_kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khattouvin thuhil chom dang ahil’a, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thudih chengse le hou ngaisahna thuhil’a lung lut lou aum le,

tcz: Koitobang khat in hicheto kitohlouva thuhil aumleh amachu thuhila nunglou chule hetna lhasama ahi. Hitobang michun hiche thudih hi aheimanggot ahi. Hichehin kinel bautamna asodohsah jia achaina chu kimitthipna, kibungkhen, kidemto, chuleh kiginmoto phaloutah asodohsah ji ahi.
en_web: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
en_kjv: he is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
tcz_gospelgo: ama kichoisang bou, imacha la helou, kinel kalna ding thu hol le ding hivei aveiyin, hichea chun kithangset, kitaitom, phaloutah a, kiginmo asohjin,

tcz: Hitobang hohin phat tinin thilphalou asodohsah jin ahi. Alungthim'u asuboh un thutah anungsun tauvin ahi. Hitobang miho ding in Pathen lama lunglut dana aumu hi tahsa lama haodohna ding tohgonbep ahijin ahi.
en_web: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
en_kjv: perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
tcz_gospelgo: kinah nah jeng leh manthahna hi thutah hepha talou mihem ho lunggel’a hung kon ahin, Pathen hou thu jeng jong sumkol veina nei ding ago’uve.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen ngaisahnatoh kilhon'a lungnachim hinkho hi haona tahbeh ahi.
en_web: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
en_kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla lung lhaisel’a Pathen houlam’a gunchu hi, phatchomna lentah ahi.

tcz: Atahbeh-in, eihon leiset a hin ima ihinpolut pouvin, chuleh idalhah tenguleh ima ipohdoh diu aumpon ahi.
en_web: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
en_kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile leiset chunga imacha i-hin polut pouvin, imacha i-pohdohthei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Hijehchun eihon neh le von ineiyuleh ilunglhai jeng diu angaiye.
en_web: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
en_kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu neh le chah nihchen ponsil ineiyu le eiho dia lhingset ahije.

tcz: Ahinlah ahaodoh nom loihohi lhepna ah alhajiuve chuleh ngolhoitah le hamset umtah ngaichat hohin manthahna-a alehlutji bep in ahi.
en_web: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
en_kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
tcz_gospelgo: Hao lunggul ho chu mihemte suhgamna le manthah naa lhah mangsah hel thei ngolna tin cheng le kisuh khahna thei lung guljouse a lhah lut theina lhepna thangkol’a a-oh jiuvin ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu sum ngaichatna hi thilphalou jouse hung konna ahi, chuleh sum ngaichatna hin miphabep tahsan dihtah a konin alamvaisah-in lunggimna tamtah-in amaho asuhnatlo ji bep in ahi.
en_web: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
en_kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu sum ngailuthi setna jouse bulpi ahin, sum mu ding ngaitona kiha bolna lam’a mi kimkhat tahsan’a konin akihei mangun, amaho le amaho thoh natna tampin akisuh khah lojiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah Timothy nangma vang Pathen mi nahijeh in hiche thilse hoa kon in jammangin lang lungnengtah le thohhatna neitah-in ngailutna le tahsanna neipumin Pathen deilam le chonphatna del in.
en_web: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
en_kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pathen mi, nangman hechengse hi jamsanin; adih, Pathen houlam, tahsan, ngailut, thoh hat, nunem hicheng joh chu hol jingin.

tcz: Tahsan dihtah chuna-in galsat phachu sat'in. Pathen in nakouna tonsot hinkemlou chu tuhchah in, hichu ahetoh mitamtah masanga phatah a naphondoh ahitai.
en_web: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
en_kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahetoh mi tampi angsunga phondoh phatah naphondohna dinga nakikouna bangin kipaman tonsot hinna san nadin tahsa kilhai tetna lam’a hatah-in pangin.

tcz: Mihem hinkho pea Pathen angsungleh Pontius Pilate masanga hettohsahna phatah pea Yeshua Christa angsunga hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi.
en_web: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
en_kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
tcz_gospelgo: Thil ijakai hinsah Pathen le Pontius Pilate angsunga phondoh phatah neiya, hettohsahna bol, Jesu Christa jal’a hiche thu hi kapeh nahi,

tcz: Tohdinga nakipe chu bulhingset in tongin, chutileh tuapat le Pakai Yeshua hungkit kah in koimachan themmo nachanponte.
en_web: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: that thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: nangman i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kilah kit kahsen thupeh hi boh beh louhel le seiset na beihel’in ching jingin.

tcz: Lengho Lengle Pakaiho Pakai anunnom leh hat chungnung Pathen amabou chun Christa chu aphatcha vana kona ahin kilahdohsah ding ahi.
en_web: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
en_kjv: which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
tcz_gospelgo: Nun nom jing, thanei khatseh, leng jouse leng le pakai jouse Pakaiyin achamtah a phat ahin phon doh ding ahi,

tcz: Amabou hi thithei louna hinna nei ahin aumna chu vahbehseh-a koimachan aphah theilou, mihem mit in amuphahlou ding ahi. Loupina le thaneina jouse atonsot tonsot'in Amaa hijing tahen! Amen.
en_web: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
en_kjv: who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: ama bou thi-tih nei lou, ngailut thei hoi hilou, khovah a cheng, ama chu koiman mu khah lou, mihemin mu jong mu thei lou ahin, ama jenga chun jabolna le thahatna tonsot geiyin um jing hen, Amen.

tcz: Hiche leiset a haosaho chu akiletsah louna diuleh kisonpi thei hilou asum u chu kisonna a aneilouna diuvin hilchah in. Ingaichat hou ning lhingset'a eipeuva Pathen joh kisonnan neiyuhen.
en_web: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
en_kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
tcz_gospelgo: Tu hinkhoa vannoi leiset thil’a, hao ho chu ahoitho louna diuvin hilchah-in, kichetna bei gouva ki-ngai louva, imanchah diuva thil jouse eipe jinguva Pathen joh a ki-ngaiyu hen:

tcz: Asum u chu thilpha bolna a aman diuvin seipeh in. Thilpha bolna lama ninglhingu henlang alhasamho khotona hinneiyuhen. Chuleh midang koma phaldoh dingin phattin in kigosan umjing'u hen.
en_web: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
en_kjv: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
tcz_gospelgo: thilpha aboluva, napha tohna a atha lhin theiyuva, ahongphal’uva, mito chan kikop theiya aum’uva,

tcz: Hitia chu abol uleh gou kikhol khonunga dinga akhombul phatah nei hidiu chutia chu hinna tahbeh chu atekhah thei dingu ahi.
en_web: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
en_kjv: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
tcz_gospelgo: khonung hinkho dinga bul phatah gou akikhol’uva, hinkho tahbeh chu atuh chah jingna diuvin til khouvin.

tcz: Timothy, Pathen in nangansena chu kichintup in. Nadou hotoh Pathen deilou ngolhoi tah a kihoulimna ho, amahon chihna atiuva kon chun kiheimangin.
en_web: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
en_kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Timothy, nangma na kichinsah chengse chu hongtup’in; lam dih lou tah a hetna dol’a kisei, Pathen suhmilna le kinel baotamna chu peldoh jon.

tcz: Mi phabep in hitobang ngolnaho chu ajui uvin tahsanna akonin alamvai tauve. Pathen mikhotona chun nabon un naumpiu hen.
en_web: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
en_kjv: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen. ¶ The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi phabep’in hiche chihna chu aneidol’in aseiyun, tahsan lam’a abidoiyu asuh khel lo tauve. Lungsetnan umpiuvin.

tcz: Hiche hi Yeshua Christa solchah hidinga Pathen lunglhaina-a lhendoh a um Paul lekhathot ahi. Keima Christa Yeshua tahsan a kon hinna athutep seiphong dinga eikisol'ah ahi.
en_web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
en_kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu sunga hina thutep dungjuiya, Pathen lungdeiya, solchah Paul’in,

tcz: Kangailuttah kachapa Timothy dinga kajih ahi. Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailutna le khotona chuleh lungmon na chun naumpi hen.
en_web: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
en_kjv: to Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Cha deitah Timothy henga: Pa Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le hepina chule chamna nachunga um hen.

tcz: Timothy, kapu kapaten apom banga selepha hetna lunggel thengtah puma kapom Pathen chu nang jal'in kathangvah e. Asun ajan in kataona a nangma kageldoh jinge.
en_web: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
en_kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
tcz_gospelgo: Lung ngaito thengsel’a pu le patea pat kahou Pathen chung nunga kipa thanop na kaneiyin, sun le jan’a thumna kanei chanin tang louhel’in nangma kageldoh jing jenge.

tcz: I-kikhen a namitlhilon chu kageldoh in, nangma kamukit nom lheh jenge. Chule iumkhom kit tengleh keima kipana a dimset ding kahitai.
en_web: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
en_kjv: greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
tcz_gospelgo: Namit lhi lon kageldoh jing jeh-in kakipa chamkim theina din nangma mu kal ka-ngah lel lheh-e.

tcz: Natahsan dihtah chu kageldoh e, ajehchu napi Lois leh nanu Eunice a anaumdim masa tahsan chu nachan khompi ahi. Chule hiche tahsan chu nang'ah dettah in aum jinge ti kahen ahi.
en_web: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
en_kjv: when I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga napi Loisi le nanu Eunice sunga chenga tahsanna kicheh tah nasunga cheng chu kageldoh-in, hichu nasunga achen jing ding kaging chai.

tcz: Hichejeh achu, nachunga kakhut kangap a Pathen in lhagao thilpeh napeh chu nasuhlang jing dinga kahin geldohsahkit nahi.
en_web: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
en_kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu nachunga thenso- khut ka-ngap jeh a Pathen thilpeh nachan chu meibanga na konsah kitna dinga kahin geldoh sah kit nahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in tijatna le meisanna Lhagao eipepouve, amavang thohhatna, ngailutna chule kitimthemna joh eipeuve.
en_web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
en_kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile meidoi-na dinga Pathenin Lhagao eipeh-u ahipon, thahatna le ngailutna chule kitim theina ding joh ahibouve.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu chung thu midang seipeh ding jahcha hih beh-in, chuleh ama jeh a songkul katan jeh hin keima jong neijachatpi hih in. Pathen in napeh thahatna chu kengin lang hiche kipana thupha jeh a hi thohgimna toh dingin kigosan um'in.
en_web: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
en_kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun i-Pakaiyu thudol hettohsahnaa jong meidoi hih-in, ama jal’a sohchang kei chung thua jong jahcha hih-in, chusangin Pathen songin Kipana Thupha thudol’a hahsa thoh jon.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in eihuhdoh uva hinkho thenga hing dinga eikouvu ahi. Hichehi eiho ichandiu lom a eibolpeh-u ahipon, amavang phat kipat masangpeh a ama tohgon dungjuia abol ahibouve, amikhotona Yeshua Christa a kona eivetsah nom jal u ahi.
en_web: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
en_kjv: who hath saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eiho na-tohho vang hilouva ama thilgon dungjui le alungset jal’a kouna thengsel’a eikouvuva, eihuhhingu ahibouve, hiche lungsetna chu vannoi khang kipat masanga Jesu Christa sunggil’a eina pehsau ahin,

tcz: Tun eihuhhingpau Yeshua Christa ahung kilah chun hiche hohi eihet chetsah u ahitai. Aman thina thahat chu asumangin athupha hi mangchan thithei louna leh hinna lampi chu eisalvah peh tauvin ahi.
en_web: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
en_kjv: but is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
tcz_gospelgo: tua hi eihuhhinguva Christa Jesu hung kilah a kona hung kiphongdoh ahitai; aman thina chu asubeiyin, Kipana Thupha jal’in hinna le thi-mo na chu khovah a aphongdohtai.

tcz: Chule Pathen in hiche kipana thuphahi hillhangle dinga solchah khat'a eilhendoh ahitai.
en_web: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
en_kjv: whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Kipana Thupha hi sei-phong ding le Solchah ding chule mihil dinga eikipansah ahi.

tcz: Hichejeh-a chu, keiman hiche songkul'a hi kathohgim ahi. Ahinlah keima kajah achapoi, ajeh chu keiman katahsan chu kahechenin chuleh ama ahungkit kah-a achunga kakingap lhahna dungjuiya hi eikaihoi jing ding ahi ti katahsanin ahi.
en_web: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
en_kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu hichengpi hi kathoh gim ahin, ahivangin kajachatpi poi; Ijeh-inem itile katahsanpa chu kahetna, hiche nikho geiya chu chin dinga eikivop-sah jong hi ahonbit ding kasong lheh-e.

tcz: Keima a kona nahet thuhil dihtah Yeshua Christa a nanei tahsan le ngailutnaa kisemdoh chu chepin.
en_web: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiya kona najahsa thuhil kicheh-a nanei, vettoh a juithei chengse chu Christa Jesu sunga cheng tahsa le ngailut nan tuh jingin.

tcz: I-sunguva chengah Lhagao Theng thaneina a kon chun nangman nakingansena thutah manlutah chu chingthei tah in kichin tup in.
en_web: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
en_kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakivopsah thilpha chu eiho sunga cheng Lhagao Theng panin ngah phan.

tcz: Nahet ngaima bangin Asia gamkaiya kona hungho jouse Phygelus le Hermogenes changei chun eidalhagam tauvin ahi.
en_web: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
en_kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
tcz_gospelgo: Phygelus le Hermogenes pumin Asia gamsunga mi jousen ei-nung ngatsoh hel’u hi nangman nahetsa ahitai.

tcz: Pakaiyin ahepina giltah chun Onesiphorus leh ainsungmite umpi hen ajehchu aman eihung vil in eihung tilkhou jinge. Kabul put jongchu aman eijachat pipon ahi.
en_web: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
en_kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Onesiphorus insung mite chu hepi hen; aman kabulput hi jachat pi louhel’in kalung asuhal mat chet jengin ahi.

tcz: Ama Rome a ahung chun eihung mudoh kahsen muntin'ah eihol len ahi.
en_web: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
en_kjv: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
tcz_gospelgo: Rome khoa ahungin jong eihung hol hol jengin, eimudoh teiye.

tcz: Pakai chu ahung kilekit nileh angailutna giltah chun umpi hen, chuleh Ephesus mun a chu itobang tah a phachom'ah hitam nangman nahesohnai.
en_web: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
en_kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin hiche Nikho chule Pakaiya konin hepina musah tei hen, Ephesus khoa lhacha kin abol chengse chu nangin phatah-in nahei.

tcz: Timothy kangailuttah kachapa, Yeshua Christa a um Pathen in napeh hiche lungsetna a chun hat in.
en_web: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachapa nangma vang Christa Jesu sunga um lungset nan pan-san, hat jingin, thaphan.

tcz: Tahsan theitah hettohsah tamtah'in asuhdet kathuhil hochu nangman najatan ahi. Tun nangin hiche thutah hohi tahsan thei miho chu hilin, chutileh amahon midangho koma apehdoh sondiu ahi.
en_web: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
en_kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahetoh tamtah a kona kasei najahsa chengse chu tahsan um mihemho pe-sonin, chutile amahon midang ho ahil thei diu ahi.

tcz: Yeshua Christa sepai phatah bangin ahahsa kathohhi neithohpin.
en_web: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu sepai phatah bangin genthei hahsa hi thoh gim-pin.

tcz: Sepai galkap pet koima leiset hinkho thil ho dingin akisalelpoi, ajeh chu hiche chun sepaiya apansahpa alunglhai sah theipon ahi.
en_web: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
en_kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
tcz_gospelgo: Sepai koima apansahpa lung-dei bolnom chun hinkhosunga ding lung gelnan akisumo ngaipoi.

tcz: Chuleh golseh kitetna ajong koiman dan juilouvin kipaman asang ngaipoi.
en_web: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
en_kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
tcz_gospelgo: Gol-seh bol min jong Dan dungjuiya abol loule koiman jo na lallukhuh asang theipoi.

tcz: Chule natong hat loubol mi jong atohga nemasapen a pang dingdol ahi.
en_web: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
en_kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
tcz_gospelgo: Loubol’a pang na-tong gim mi chun agam ga-a chan anei masah pen ding ahi.

tcz: Kathusei hi hoitah'in geltoh them in, Pakaiyin hichehohi nahetthem sahding ahi.
en_web: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
en_kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasei hi ipi ahi nagel toh ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin hetkhen na napeh ding ahinai.

tcz: Yeshua Christa hi leng David chilhah ahin, athia kona kaithouva um ahi tia kathuhil hi phat tinin geldoh jingin.
en_web: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
en_kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana Thupha kaseiphong dungjuiya David guiya peng, thinaa kona thoudoh Jesu Christa chu geldoh-in;

tcz: Chuleh hiche kipana thupha thohgimna hohi kato ahi. Amavang Pathen thuhi akikham tang theidehpoi.
en_web: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
en_kjv: wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Kipana Thupha jeh a chu akhang gilou banga thih khaova kihen kahin, ahivang in Pathen thu chu akihen tang dehpoi.

tcz: Pathen in alhendoh ho dinga huhhingna le Christa a tonsot loupina ahinpohlut ding ahiphot le itobang thohgimna hijongleh thohding kanom in ahi.
en_web: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
en_kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elects’ sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu lhen chomten Christa Jesu sunga kisel sochatna le tonsot loupina aneidoh theina diuva amaho dinga hichengpi kathohgim ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi tahsan umtah thuhil ahi: Amatoh ithikhom uleh amatoh ihinkhom diu ahi.
en_web: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
en_kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hi tahsan umtah ahi: “Amato ithikhom’u le amato ihinkhom diu,

tcz: Amatoh ithohgim khom uleh amatoh ivaihom khomdiu ahi, ama iseilep uleh amanjong eiseilep diu ahi.
en_web: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
en_kjv: if we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
tcz_gospelgo: Ithoh lhumkeiyu le amato lengvai ipoh khomdiu,

tcz: Ahinlah eihon kitahna neihih jongleu hen amachu kitahjing ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama chu amaleh ama kiseilep theilou ahi.
en_web: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
en_kjv: if we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho tahsan bei hijongleu hen, Ama tahsan umtah ahi; Ajeh chu ama le ama akiseilep ngaipoi.”

tcz: Nangman hichethu hohi mijouse geldohsah in, chule phatchomna bei mohthu pouva akinel bautam louna dingun Pathen anga hilchah in. Ajehchu hitobang kinelna hochun ajaho lungthim asuhset ding ahi.
en_web: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
en_kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti ho hi miho geldohsah jingin lang, thu homkeova akinel baotam louna diuvin Pathen ang-sunga hilchah-in, hiche ho hin ima aphat chomsah pon, aja ho akhup athal’in achuh lo ji bouve.

tcz: Pathen lunglhaina nachan theina dingin ama a dingin kiphal thengin, gunchun Pathen thuhi jachatna beihelin adihna bangtah in hilchenin lang ponpanin.
en_web: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
en_kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kipatep them changsa banga Pathen koma, din jouna din nang le nang kiha-bol’in, kijumso na beihel natong mi hinadin thutah chu jangkeiyin mangchan.

tcz: Pathen nahsah louna thu phachomlou ngolkai thu kihoulimna'a konin kikangse in,
en_web: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
en_kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
tcz_gospelgo: Houthu seisetna moh thuhom keova kihoulimna ho chu peldoh-in, ajeh chu hiche hoa tha-nom ho chu Houthu ngaisahmo na lam’a haltou cheh cheh jo ahiuvin,

tcz: Hitobang thuphalou hohi tahsa a hivei phalou tobanga, Hymenaeus le Philetus chunga soh tobanga chu, kithejal ji ahi.
en_web: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
en_kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;
tcz_gospelgo: chule athuseiyu jong chun masemon machal banga aneh chal tel tul diu ahi; hiche ho lah achun Hymenaeus le Philetus jong apang lhone’e.

tcz: Amahohi thutah'a kona lamvai ahiuvin, mithiho chu thoudohsa ahitauve atiuvin miphabep khat tahsanna lama konin alehei tauvin ahi.
en_web: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
en_kjv: who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin thutah aho-khel’uvin, thokitna chu akichaisan aseiyun, mi phabep tahsan alehei-peh tauve.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen thudih hi khombul kiphut detchet bangin adingdet jingin achungah hiche thuhi akijih in ahi, “Pakaiyin ama hochu koikoi ahi ahen chuleh Pakai mite chu thilsea konin akiheimang jiuve,” akiti.
en_web: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
en_kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathen khom-phu chu dettah-in ading nai, “Pakaiyin amaa chengse ahe nai,” tin mohor akinam khumin; chujong le, “Pakai min minphah chan chu adihlouva konin kikhin mang hen,” akiti.

tcz: Mihao insunga chun sana le dangka a kisem thilkeo ngen aumpon thingle leibel jong aumin, amantamho chu kinthupia kimang chading ahin, aman lhomho chu nitina manchah hiding ahiuve.
en_web: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
en_kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
tcz_gospelgo: In lentah sunga khun sana le dangka bel jeng aumpon, thingbel le leibei ho jong aum’e; amaho chu abang sahlut dol aumin, abang sahlut lou dol aum’e.

tcz: Nangma nakisuhtheng jinga ahileh kinloupia manchahthei thilkeo thupi chu nahi ding ahi. Nahinkho chu theng ding Pakaiyin thilphachoma amanchah dinga kigosa jing chu nahi ahi.
en_web: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
