en_kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
tcz_gospelgo: Seisa thilse chengsea kona kithensodoh mi chu sahlut dol tah, akisuthengsa, Pakai dinga natong thei, thilpha bol dinga kigosadem ahitai.

tcz: Khandonlai lungngaichat ho jousea konin jammangin, amavang chonphatna, kitahna, ngailutna le chamna chu hadel in, lungthengsel a Pakai kom beljingho toh kiloikhomin,
en_web: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
en_kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangdonglai lunggul chengsea konin jamin, lung thengsel’a Pakai min pan ho chutoh adih tahsan, ngailut chule chamna holjon.

tcz: Avel in seikit inge, ngol hoitah, ima hetohlouva kinel bautamna hoa konchun kikangse doh in, hichun kinahna asodohsah jin ahi.
en_web: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
en_kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngolkai le lungthimbei ho kinelna chu peldoh-in, hichea chun kinahna asohdohji nahei.

tcz: Chuleh Pakai lhacha chun mitoh kinah abollou ding, amavang mijouse angailut ding, mihilthem hiding, chuleh mihahsa ho chu adepthem ding ahi.
en_web: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
en_kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai soh natong chun doubol angai ahipon, chusanga mi jouse khoto them, mi-hil them, lungde-hat hiya,

tcz: Thutah doudal hochu kangkhen chan hilthem in ajeh chu amaho lungthim chu Pathen in aleheiya thutah chu ahin hetthem thei diu ahi.
en_web: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
en_kjv: in meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
tcz_gospelgo: lungnemtah a adouho chu apuijang joh ding ahi. Ijem itile Pathenin amaho chu thutah ahin hetdohna dinga lungheina phat apeh theiya,

tcz: Hiteng chuleh amaho hung khangdoh untin, Diabol thangkol a kona hoidoh theidiu ahi. Ajeh chu aman amaho chu adei deiya abolthei dinga gal hinga anamat ahitai.
en_web: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
en_kjv: and that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
tcz_gospelgo: Dia-bol’in amat’a alungdei lamtah a ahinga ahen nau thangkol’a kona hung toldoh thei diu ahi.

tcz: Timothy, ni nunung tengleh phat hahsa hunglhung ding ahi ti nahet ding ahi.
en_web: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
en_kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ninu nung lam le phat hahsa tah ahung lhun ding hi hen.

tcz: Ajehchu mihon amachang kingailutna le sum ngailutna jengbou ahinnei diu ahi. Amahohin kiletsahna le husetna, Pathen taitomna, nulepa thungai louna chule kipaje helou hung hitei diu ahi. Amahon thenna hinkho hi ahin nahsahlou diu ahi.
en_web: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
en_kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mihemten ama chang cheh ki-ngailutna, sum homthona, nom ham hoitho, kichoisang, Pathen taitom, nuthu pathu ngailou lam’a lung lut’uva, phatna ngaisah lou le aboha um gam’uva,

tcz: Amaho chun ngailutnale ngaidam jouna aneilou diu, miseiset hat hidiu chule ama kitim jouna neilou hidiu ahi. Amahohi kichat um phatna hoa ahiuve.
en_web: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
en_kjv: without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
tcz_gospelgo: khotona bei, hepina neilou, jouthua hehse hat, ti kitim lou, tuhngoi mo, phatna hotbol,

tcz: Amahon aloi agol ho hinpedoh untin, i-ang untin, kiletsahnan dimuntin, Pathen ngaisah sanga nopsahna ahin ngaichat joh diu ahi.
en_web: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
en_kjv: traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
tcz_gospelgo: lepche, dingchanglou, kiletsah, Pathen ngaisah sanga tahsa nopsahna ngaisahho hidiu ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu hougut hiuvintin, ahinlah amahon Pathen thaneinale athilbol theina ajahnomlou diu ahi. Hitobang hoa kon hin kikangsen,
en_web: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
en_kjv: having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
tcz_gospelgo: Hou-ngaisah lim’a um’uva, hou-ngaisah-na tha neije la janom lou, hite hoa kon jong chun kihei mangin.

tcz: Amaho doha lungthim in mi insunga alutjiuvin, tahsa ngaichatnan alodim chonset pohgih poa numei tikitimlou ho alhemlhauvin gal hingin amanjiuvin ahi.
en_web: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
en_kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
tcz_gospelgo: Ama-ho lah a kimkhat doha lungthimin mi intin’a alut jiuvin, chonset poh-gih jeh a lung ngaichatna tampin apui lon le numei ho chu gal-hing kiman bangin aman jiuvin,

tcz: Hitobang numeiho hin, thuhil thah hi ajui jingun ahinlah thutah chu ahethem pouvin ahi.
en_web: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
en_kjv: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: hito-bang numeiho chula akihil jing vangun thutah hetnaa chu hung lut thei louhel ahiuve.

tcz: Jannes le Jambres tenin Mose adoudal lhon bang chun amaho hin thutah chu adoudalun ahi. Amahohin lungthim chavai aneiyun tahsan lhem achepiuvin ahi.
en_web: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
en_kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Jannes le Jambres chun Mose adoudal ihon banga hite ho jong hin thutah chu adoudal’uva, lungput sesa, tahsan thudol’a lolhing lel mi ahitauve.

tcz: Ahinlah amahohi hitiahi hoidoh sottaloudiu Jannes le Jambres banga chu itobanga ngol hiuvam ti nikhatleh mijousen ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en_web: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
en_kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla amaho sao tah chejou deh lou diu ahi, akisei te ni chunga thilsoh banga chu angolnau mitin koma kichenset’a kilangdoh ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah Timothy keiman, nangma ipi thu kahil, chule ipi iti kahin chule kahinkhoa kalunggon nahet ahinai. Hiti chun nangman katahsanna, kathohhatna, kangailutna chule kathoh lhumkeina hohi nahe chen nai.
en_web: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
en_kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin najuipehsa chu keima mihil chonchan, lungtup, tahsan thoh hat, ngailut, lungde-hat,

tcz: Ichan geiya gimbol hesohna chule hahsatna kathoh hitam ti nahenai. Chule keiman Antioch, Iconium chule Lystra khohoa bol-hesohna kathoh hohi nahei, hinla Pakaiyin hicheho jousea konin eihuhdoh tai.
en_web: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
en_kjv: persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
tcz_gospelgo: bolsetna chengse le gim hesoh ho chu ahin, Antioch le Iconium chule Lystra khosung dunga chu itobang tah a bolsetna kidang dang kachung-a hung lhung hitam, hichengsea kon jong chun Pakaiyin eihuhdoh soh keiye.

tcz: Ahiye chule koi koi hijongleh Christa Yeshua a Pathen ngaisahna hinkho mangnom jouse chun bolhesohna athohtei ding ahi.
en_web: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
en_kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule koi koi ahin Christa Jesu sunga Hou-ngaisah-a hinnom jousen bolsetna athoh tei ding ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah migilouho leh milhem lhaho chu hung pungcheh cheh ding ahiuve. Amahon midangho alheplhah uva chule amaho tah lheplhah a umding ahiuve.
en_web: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
en_kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
tcz_gospelgo: Migilou ho le kilep them mihem ho chu phamo cheh cheh diu, midang alhep lhah banguva amaho min alhep lhah diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah nangma nana kihilsa thilhoa chu tahsan umtah nahi ding ahi. Nangman hicheho chu adih ahin, chule nahil ho chu natahsan thei ahiuve ti nahenai.
en_web: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
en_kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
tcz_gospelgo: Nang vang dettah a natahsan, nakihilsa chengsea chun ding det jingin, na-hil’a pang ho chu koi ahiu nahe nai.

tcz: Nangma naneova pat a Thuthengbu hi nana kihilsa ahin, chule amaho chun huhhingna nakisan theina dinga chihna chu napehsonu ahitai.
en_web: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: and that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu sunga tahsanna jal’a huhhingna napui-lut thei chih-na napethei Pathen lekhabu chu nachapan laiya pat nahetsa ahitai.

tcz: Pathen thubu hi aboncha Pathen Hu haikhum ahi chule hichu eiho dinga ipi chu adih chule ipi chu adihlou ham ti ihinkhouva eihet dohsah dingu ahi. Idihlou tenguleh eisudih diu chule ipi chu adih ham ti eihiluva panga ahi.
en_web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
en_kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin hu alhakhum Pathen lekhabu chengse chu kihilna ding, kipho na ding, kipuijang na ding le adih lam’a kichuhna dinga pha-tah ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen in amite chu abolsah nom thilpha tincheng bolna lama boltheina dimset inei theina diuva kigotna lampi ahi.
en_web: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
en_kjv: that the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile Pathen mi chu kitoh chet’a um theiya natoh pha chengse tohna kigosadem’a um ding ahi.

tcz: Keiman Pathen le alenggam tungdoh a hung ding Christa Yeshua, ahingho le athiho chungthu tana pang dingpa angsunga, lungguttah a katilkhou nahi:
en_web: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
en_kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen le mitin ahing athi thutan ding Christa Jesu maiya, chule ahung kilah kit ding le Alenggam pan’a guntah a kahilchah nahi,

tcz: Pathen Thu chu seiphong in. Phat kijenpet hihen, hihih jongleh kigosademin um'in. Thohhattah in sudih in, phoh in chule phatah a hilpumin namiteu chu tilkhouvin.
en_web: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
en_kjv: preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
tcz_gospelgo: thu chu seiphong len, aphat hihen aphat lou hijongle, lung nengtah-in miho chu hilto gomin athemmo nau hetsah-in, sosal’in, tilkhouvin.

tcz: Ajehchu mihon thuhilpha le adihtah a kihilna thu angainom lounau phat hunglhung ding ahi. Amaho chun alung ngaichat u ajui uva, anakolu thahtun tun'a um chun angainom ding thubou hilding mihil akikou dingu ahi.
en_web: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
en_kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mihon thuhilpha kicheh chu ngai thei louva, abilkol’u thahtun tun’a ama ama lung ngai-chat dungjuiya mihil akikhop khom diu phat hung lhung ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho chun thutah chu adeilou dingu chule akisemthu thusimho pou adel le dingu ahi.
en_web: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
en_kjv: and they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule amahon thutah akona abil-kol ahei manguva, semthu thusim lam’a hung lung lutjo diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah nangma aphat totoh'a imalam jousea lunggel kicheh hina neiyin. Pakaiya dinga gimhesoh thohding kichatna neihih in. Kipana Thupha thu chu hilin chule Pathen in lhacha natohna napeh chu tongdoh in.
en_web: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
en_kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang vang imalam jousea lung limgeh chan umin, hahsa thoh gimin, Evangelist na tongin, nalhacha na-toh chu bulhit molson.

tcz: Keima vang kahinkho hi Pathena dinga maichama kisunglha kahitai. Ka leihinkho kichaina ding ahung naitai.
en_web: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
en_kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Ije-inem itile keima hi eiki-katdoh ahitan, kapotdohna ding phat ahung lhungtai.

tcz: Keiman kidouna chu kasat chaitai, keiman lhaitetna chu kajo ahitai chule tahsanna a kapangdet e.
en_web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
en_kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
tcz_gospelgo: Golseh phatah kaseh joutan, kilhai tetna ka chaiyin, tahsan kamolsotai.

tcz: Chule tua hi kipaman kasan ding gotsa koi ahitai. Pakai, thutan dihtah pa chun, ahungkile nitengleh chonphatna lallukhuh chu eipeh ding ahi. Chule hiche kipaman san ding chu keima chang dingseh hilouva Ama hung kilah ding nikho ngaicha geova ngah jing ho dinga jong ahi.
en_web: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
en_kjv: henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
tcz_gospelgo: Tukal se-a vang keima dinga themchan na lallukhuh chu koisa ahitai, dih tah a thutan Pakaiyin hiche Nikho chu le eipeh ding ahi, kei keo hilouva ama hungkit ding ngailu jouse jong ahiuve.

tcz: Timothy, lungsettah in agan nathei chanin hungin.
en_web: Be diligent to come to me soon,
en_kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
tcz_gospelgo: Kahenga hungvah na din hung kihabol’in;

tcz: Demas chun tu hinkho thil ho angaichat jeh in keima eidalhan, Thessalonica lama achetai. Crescens chu Galatia ah achen, chule Titus Dalmatia ah achetai.
en_web: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
en_kjv: for Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Demas chun tulai vannoi hi angailut jeh-in eidalhan, Thessalonica a achetai; Crescens chu Galatia lama achen, Titus ma Dalmatia lama achei;

tcz: Luke bouseh kakoma aume. Nahung phatleh Mark chu hinpuiyin, ajeh chu ama lhacha natohnaa eipanpi phachomtah hiding ahi.
en_web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
en_kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
tcz_gospelgo: Luke changseh-in eiumpi. Mark hinpuiyin lang hung lhonin, ajeh chu ama chu kei dinga lhacha kinbolnaa phachom tah ahi.

tcz: Keiman Tychicus chu Ephesus a kasol in ahi.
en_web: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
en_kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Tychicus vang Ephesus lama kasoltai.

tcz: Nahung phatleh Troas khoa Carpus koma kadalhah Sangkholchol chu hinpo teiyin. Chujongleh kalekhabu ho, adeh'a kalekhajol ho chu hinpon.
en_web: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
en_kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahung teng Troas khoa Carpus khut’a kadalhah kasangkhol len le lekhabu ho, ahidehchun savun lekhabu ho chu hinpon.

tcz: Alexander, sum-eng khengpa chun eigimbol lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin athilbol dungjuiyin achungthu tan nante.
en_web: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
en_kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
tcz_gospelgo: Sumsan kheng Alexander chun giloutah-in eibol’in, Pakaiyin athilbol dungyuiyin lethuh nante.

tcz: Amaa konin chingtheiyin, ajeh chu amahin isei jouseu hadouvin adouvin ahi.
en_web: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
en_kjv: of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chunga hin nang jong hung kigingphan, ajeh chu aman ithusei hou’u hi hatah-in adoudal’e.

tcz: Thutanna anga eikipui masat chun koima eikilhonpia aumpoi. Amitinin eidalhauve. Ama ho dounaa ima sodahen.
en_web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
en_kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakihonna thu kasei masah pen chun koima chan eihupon, abonchan eidalhasoh hel’uve; hichu amaho themmon kisimpeh da hen.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai chun eidinpin chule thaneina eipei hitia chu keiman chidang namdang ho jouse henga Kipana Thupha kalhangsap chu ajah theina dingu ahi. Chule aman thina theiya konin jong eihuh dohtai.
en_web: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin keima jal’a thu kiseiphong chu lhingset’a akiphondoh a chidang namdangten ajahsoh keina diuvin Pakaiyin eidinpin tha eipen, chule Phaisameigeo kamsunga konin eihuhdohtai.

tcz: Henge, hitia chu Pakaiyin gitlouna eihin nokhum theiya konin eihuhdoh intin, chule avan gam'a bitkeiya eipuilut ding ahi. Pathena chun loupina jouse umjing tahen! Amen.
en_web: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin thilse bol jousea konin eihuhdoh intin, van chunga A-lenggam sunga din eihuhhing nante. Loupina chu tonsot tonsot geiyin amaa hijing hen: Amen.

tcz: Priscilla le Aquila teni chule Onisephorus insunga umho jouse chu keikhelin analemin.
en_web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
en_kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
tcz_gospelgo: Prisca le Aguila chule Onesiphorus insung mite chu salamin.

tcz: Erastus Corinth a aumdenin, chule keiman Trophimus chu Miletas ah damlouvin kadalhatai.
en_web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
en_kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
tcz_gospelgo: Erastus chu Corinth a aumdentai. Trophimus adammon Miletus a kadalhatai.

tcz: Phalbi ma-in hikoma hung teijin. Eubulus in chibai nahinbol e, chule Pudente, Linus, Claudia chule sopi ho jousen jong chibai nahinbol uve.
en_web: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
en_kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Phalbi masanga hung tei din hung kihabol’in. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Caludia le sopi jousen nahin salam’ui.

tcz: Pakai chun nalhagaovu umpi hen. Chule Amilungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiuhen.
en_web: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
en_kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. ¶ The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin na-lhagao umpin, Lungsetnan naumpi jingu hen.

tcz: Hiche Lekhathot hi Pathen soh chule Yeshua Christa solchah, Paul'a kon ahi. Keima Pathen in alhendoh saho laha tahsan thudol seiphong ding le Pathen mite hindan ahetthem theina diu thutah chu hil dinga ei kisol ahi.
en_web: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
en_kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen soh natong, Jesu Christa Solchah a pang Paul’in Pathen lhenchomte tansan dungjui le hou ngaisahna dungjuiya thutah ahetnau to kitoh,

tcz: Chuche thutah, jou seitheilou Pathen in vannoi bul kiphudoh masanga ana tepsa, chun tonsot hinna aneiyu chu kisonna apeh ahi.
en_web: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
en_kjv: in hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
tcz_gospelgo: tonsot hinna dia kinepna, vannoi, khang kipat masang a pat jou seithei lou Pathen thutepsa,

tcz: Chule tua aphat alhintaha hiche thuhi aman ahin phondoh'a, keihon mijouse laha kasei phongleu ahi. Hiche hi eihuhhing uva Pathen a kona thupeh, ama na tong dinga keima ei kinganse ahi.
en_web: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
en_kjv: but hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
tcz_gospelgo: ama dei phat cha athu hung kiphongdoh a, eihuhhingpau Pathen thupeh dungjuiya keima eiki-nganse chu:

tcz: Keiman, kakikop pi tahsanna jal'a kachapa dihtah, Titus henga kasut ahi. Pa Pathen chule eihuhhing uva Christa Yeshuan chamna le lungmon nape tahen.
en_web: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
en_kjv: to Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
tcz_gospelgo: kikop khom cheh tahsan dungjuiya chatah tah Titus henga: Pa Pathen le eihuhhingpau Christa Jesua konin lungsetna le chamna nachunga um hen.

tcz: Keiman nangma Crete twikol a kadalhah chu, inatoh lhon nasuhbulhit a chule kahilna banga khopi tinchenga upa ho napansah na dinga kadalhah nahi.
en_web: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
en_kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Thil kibol bulhing lou chengse naboltup soh a chule khopi jousea upa ho napansah na dinga Crete a kadalhah nahi.

tcz: Upa khat chun nolnabei hinkho amanding ahi. Ainneipi dinga kitahna neimi hiding, chule achate chu atahsan chonchatvaina lamle thua nunlouna lama seiset changlou hiding ahi.
en_web: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
en_kjv: if any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
tcz_gospelgo: Pansah ding chu koi hile nolnabei, numei khatseh jia nei, achate jong tahsan neisa, seiset chang lou, vah thai lou, thua nung khen hidiu ahi.

tcz: Upa khat chu Pathen insunga gouching ahi, hijeh a chu nolna beiya hinkho amanding ahi. Ama chu kichamsah, lungsabai, ju'a loplou hiding, alamlouva sum ngailu mi hilouding ahi.
en_web: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
en_kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Houbung lamkai chu Pathen gouching ahijeh a nolna bei, kicham sah lou, lungsabai lou, ju nelou, mideng lou, alam louva kilose lou mi hiding,

tcz: Maljin phatbol mi, a-in'a jin alhunle kipah, chule Pathen ginga, chondihtaha hinkho mang mi hiding, thilpha ngailu, lunglimgeh, chondih, amachang kitimthei, Pathen ging mi hiding ahi.
en_web: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
en_kjv: but a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
tcz_gospelgo: chusanga jindot them, thilpha dei, lung limgeh, midih, hougut mi, kitim them mi hiding ahi.

tcz: Tahsan umtah thu ana kihilna ho detchet a tuhchah mi hiteiding ahi; chutileh aman midang ho chu kihilna hoitah a atilkhou thei ding chule mi nelkal hatho jong athemmonau akomu peh thei ding ahi.
en_web: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
en_kjv: holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuhil kicheh mangchaa tilkhouna abol theiya chule adouho nelkelna chu alekhup theina dinga kihilna dunguiya ginchat umtah thu chu tuhchah mi hiding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu adoudal ah mi tamtah panna bei thuseiya thanom chule milhemlha tamtah aume. Hiche hi ahideh'a cheptan vanga sochatna um ahi tia sei holah'a aum nom e.
en_web: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
en_kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
tcz_gospelgo: Thua nung lou atam lheh jengun thu motsei seiya milhen chavai adim’ui, amaho chu cheptan ho lah a atamdeh-ui.

tcz: Amaho chu suhthip ding ahiuve, ajeh chu athuhil dihlou uva kon chun insung tamtah apuimangun ahi. Chule hiche athilbol u chu sum ngailut jeh a bou abolu ahi.
en_web: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
en_kjv: whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi akam’u suhbing loiding ahi, ajeh chu alam louva phatchom ding holnan hil louhel ding thu ahil’un, miphabeh insung asucheh gamtauve.

tcz: Amaho lah jenga jong, mi khat, Crete a kona themgao khat, in amaho thudol hitin aseiyin, “Crete miho hi abon'uva mijou, gam sahang, chule mithase nehlop ahiuve” ati.
en_web: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
en_kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon laha khat athemgao ho’u khat’in: “Crete miho chu mijou jeng, Gamsa gilou tah, thase neh hatte ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hichehi adihtah mong ahi. Chuti ahijeh chun amaho hi tahsan kicheh mi ahi nadingun hatah in phohsal in.
en_web: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
en_kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hettohsah hi a dih monge. Hijeh chun amaho tahsan kicheh mi ahina diuvin hatah-in phohsal’in.

tcz: Thutah'a kona mi puikon thei, Juda ho moh thusimle miho thupeh ah lunglut dauhen.
en_web: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
en_kjv: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutah pai manga. Juda miho thusim semthu le mihemte thupeh hoa chun lung lut dau hen.

tcz: Alung theng dinga imajouse thengsoh kei ahi, ahinlah akisuboh atahsanlouho ding vanga athenga khatcha umlou ahi, ajeh chu alunggel ule selepha hetna alungsungu bohji a ahi.
en_web: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
en_kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
tcz_gospelgo: Milung theng ho dia ijakai athengin, akisubohsa ho le atahsan lou ho din imacha athengpoi, alungthimu le alung ngaito nau bohsoh ahitai.

tcz: Hitobang miho chun akamsunguva Pathen kahenai tin aphongdoh nauvin, ahinlah ahinkho mandan uvin aseilep un ahi. Amaho chu thet umtah, thungailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama panna bei ahiuve.
en_web: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
en_kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hedanin aphongdoh nauvin, atoh nauvin la ataitom’uve; amaho hi hot umtah le thu ngailou ahiuvin, natohpha ijat hile tongdia kiloma ahitapouve.

tcz: Titus, nangman vang, kithuhilna dihtah dungjuiya hinkho manding dan domsang in.
en_web: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
en_kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin vang thuhil kicheh to kitoh chubou nasei ding ahi.

tcz: Upa lang jep ho chu mi kitim them, ja umtah, lunglimgeh cha a hing, ahithei na diuvin hil'in. Amaho chun tahsan dettah aneiyuva chule ngailutna lethohhat na a adimset diu ngai ahi.
en_web: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
en_kjv: that the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
tcz_gospelgo: Upa ho chu lung neng tah, ima khohsah nei, lung limgeh, tahsan neiya kitimthem, ngailut nei, thohhat hiu hen.

tcz: Chutobangma chun, nupi tehse lang jep ho jong chu Pathen jatah'a hinkho mang din hil'in. Amaho chu mihehse hatle ju a lop hilouva, chusanga midang thilpha ipi ahi ahildiu ahi.
en_web: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
en_kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
tcz_gospelgo: Nupite jong chu jathei dol’a gingkhen cha hiu hen, jousei hat hilouva, jua kitimo hel hul’a sohchang bang lou diu thilpha hil’in pangjo’u hen,

tcz: Hiche nupi tehse lang jep hochun nutil khangdongho chu ainneipute chengu ngailut leh achateu ngailutje ahil diu,
en_web: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
en_kjv: that they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
tcz_gospelgo: nutil khangdong ho chi ajiteu le achateu ngailutje kisinsah-u hen lang,

tcz: Lung limgeh le thengsel'a umding, ama in'a natong mi hiding, chule naphatong le ainneiputeu noiya kun ahina diuva ahildiu ahi. Chutile Pathen thu chu jachatna a asosah lou diu ahi.
en_web: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
en_kjv: to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung khaikhi them, atheng, insung minu pha, mipha, ajipate chengu thu noiya kunjel u hen lang, Pathen thu chu taitomin umsah dau hen.

tcz: Hitobang machun, khangdong ho chu limgeh cha-a hingdin tilkhouvin.
en_web: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
en_kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang ma chun khangdong ho jong lung khaikhi them dia natilkhou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nangma tah jong imalam jousea amahon thilpha bolna lama avettoh a ajui nadingun um'in.
en_web: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
en_kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
tcz_gospelgo: Nangman tah jeng jong imalam jousea vetkah theiya thilpha nabol ding, namihilnaa nakitahje, ja naum je,

tcz: Thutah chu hilin, chutileh nathuhil chu adem thei lou dingu ahi. Chuteng eiho dem'a pang hochu jahchauva chule ichunguva seiding ima aneilou dingu ahi.
en_web: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
en_kjv: sound speech that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
tcz_gospelgo: nathusei kichehje chu kimusah-in, chutile eidouteu chu kijumsoa ichunguva thuse seiding aneilou diu ahi.

tcz: Sohho chun apakaihou thuphat jousea angai jing dingu chule ajochan uva alunglhaisah diu ahi. Amahon nelkal dauhen,
en_web: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
en_kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
tcz_gospelgo: Soh ho chu ijakaiya apakaiteu thu noiya nungjel thei, nelkel louhel’a lung lhaisahjo hiuhen.

tcz: ahilouleh guhchat bol dauhen, amavang imalam jouseah ginchat theile apha ahinau vetsah uhen. Chuteng eihuhhing uva Pathen chungchang a kithuhilna chu dei umtah asodoh dingu ahi.
en_web: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
en_kjv: not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Ima guh a kiseldoh louvin ijakaiya tahsan thei mong ahi nau thilpha chu vetsahjo’u hen; chutile imalam jousea eihuhhinguva Pathen thuhil chu ajep hoi thei diu ahi.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen mihepina hung kilah-a mijouse huhhing na chu ahinlhut ahitai.
en_web: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
en_kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mihem jouse huhhingna dinga Pathen milungset chu hung kilang doh ahitai.

tcz: Chuleh eiho Pathen ngaisah lou nale chonset nopsahna a kona kiheimang dinga kihilchah ihiuve. Hiche gitlouna leiset a hi lunglima, chondihna a chule Pathen ngaisahna neiya ikhosah dingu ahi,
en_web: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
en_kjv: teaching us that denying ungodliness and worldly lusts we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun hou-ngaisah louna le vannoi leiset ngaichat jouse pai manga, lung limgeh le adih chule Hou-ngaisah tah a tulai khanga hi ihin theina diuva eihilchah-u ahi.

tcz: chutia kinep umtah chuche nikho loupitah Pathen hatchungnung le eihuhhing uva Yeshua Christa loupina hung kilah ding ni chu katjinga um ihiu ahi.
en_web: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Chule thanop umtah kinepna, Pathen nasatah le eihuhinguva Jesu Christa loupi tah hung kilah ding kat jinga ium diu ahi.

tcz: Aman chonsetna jousea kon eisoptheng diu, i-onthol nadiu, chule ama mitea eisem uva napha tong dinga apumpia kiphaltheng ihina ding uva ahinkho manbeiya eipeh u ahi.
en_web: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
en_kjv: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa chun gitlouna chengsea kona eisuh thenguva, tom ngaitah a thilpha bol ami lhentum tea eisemdohna diuva eiho khel’a ama kipedoh jenga eilhatdoh-u ahitai.

tcz: Nangman hichengse hi nahil'a chule tahsan chate chun abol diuva natilkhou ding ahi. Angaikhoh dungjuiya nangman amaho suhdih na tha nanei ahi, hijeh chun koimacha nathusei nahsahmo bolsah hihhel in.
en_web: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
en_kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng se hi nasei ding, thu neina lhingset’a natilkhouva nahilchah ding ahin, koima chan nahsah mon nabolda hen.

tcz: Tahsan chate chu solkal le avaipoho thunoiya umdingin geldohsah in. Amaho chu seingai, thilpha boldia phat jousea kigosadema umjing hidiu ahi.
en_web: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
en_kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu vaipo ho le thunei ho thu noiya um ding, sei ngaiya thilpha jouse boldinga kigosadema um ding geldohsah jingin.

tcz: Amahon mi seisetle kinah abollou diu ahi. Chusanga nunnem nale kineosahna dihtah chu mijouse avetsah diu ahi.
en_web: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
en_kjv: to speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
tcz_gospelgo: Koima taitom louhel le koima kinahpi lou, chon nem’a, mijouse chunga nun nem dingin jong hilphan.

tcz: Eihojong, khatvei chu, lungthimbei le seingailou inahiu ahi. Eiho lamdihlou lama puilonlea inaum uva chule tahsa lungngaichat le nomsahna tamtah soh a inaum'u ahi. Ihinkhou chu gitlouna le kithangsetto naa dima, chule khatle khat kihotoa ina umu ahi.
en_web: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
en_kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile eiho jong masanga chu lungthimbei le seingailou, gamvasoh a lung gul le nopsahna ding tampi noiya sohbanga kihen, thilsea um, kithangset toa hing, hotna dim’a khat le khat i-nahiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah–“Eihuhhing uva Pathen chun amingailut nale khotona ahin tahlang phat chun,
en_web: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
en_kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin eihuhhinguva Pathen phatna le mihem ahepina ahung kilahdoh phat’in,

tcz: aman eihuhhing tauve, eiho chonphat vang le natoh vang hilouvin amihepina vang'in. Aman ichonsetnau jouse asoptheng in, penthahna eipeuvin, Lhagao theng vang'in hinkhothah eipeuvin ahi.
en_web: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
en_kjv: not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
tcz_gospelgo: eihon adih a thil inabol’uva inatoh jeh-u hilouva, amihepi jal’a eihuhhinguva Penthahna twiya asil’a, Lhagao Thenga asemthah a,

tcz: Aman hongphal tah in Yeshua Christa vang'in ichunguvah Lhagao theng chu abunglhan ahi.
en_web: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
en_kjv: which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
tcz_gospelgo: hiche Lhagao Theng chu eihuhhingpau jesu Christa jal’a ichunguva leiset’a abuh lhah ahitai.

tcz: Amihepina vang'in michonphan eisimun chule tonsot vangou lodia kisonna eipe tauve.”
en_web: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
en_kjv: that being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu amilungset vanga them ichan theijuva, tonsot hinna kineppi dungjuiya goulo chu ichan theina diu ahi.

tcz: Hichehi tahsan umtaha kisei ahi, chule nangman hiche thuhil hi hatah a nadopsang ding kadeiye chutia chu Pathen tahsan ho chun thilpha bolding agelkhoh nadingun. Hiche thuhil hohi pha a chule mijouse dinga phachomtah ahi.
en_web: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
en_kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hi tahsan umtah ahin, nangman hiti thudol’a hin Pathen tahsante chu thilpha bolna lam jenga dettah a dindet theina diuva lung nagelsah ding kadeiye. Hiche ho hi mihemte dinga pha, thil phachomtah ahi.

tcz: Ngolhoi thua kihoulimna hole khanggui thua kinel bautam Judaho danthu dola kinah, hichenga kon chun kikhindoh in, hitiho chu phatchom nading ahipoi, phat mansah bep ahibouve.
en_web: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
en_kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang ngol-hoi thudol le khanggui thusim kinel baotam, Danthu dol’a kinah hichenga kon chun kihei mangin, ajeh chu hiche ho hi phatchomna bei manthahna ahibouve.

tcz: Mihon nalah uva kibung khenna asemuleh, amaho chu khatvei nivei gihsal in. Akalse limsah tahih in.
en_web: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
en_kjv: A man that is a heretick, after the first and second admonition, reject;
tcz_gospelgo: Loitum sem mi chu khat vei nahilchah kal’in donda tan,

tcz: Ajeh chu chutobang miho chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahiuvin, amaho le amaho achonset nauvin themmo achan ahi.
en_web: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
en_kjv: knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
tcz_gospelgo: ajehchu hitobang mi chu lungthim sesa chonse ahin, acham chama them mo kichan ahi.

tcz: Keman Artimas ahilouleh Tychichus nahenga kahin solgot ahi. Khat pen pen ahunglhun lhon tengleh Nicopolis a ahithei chan in kimupi ding neigon, ajeh chu, chukoma chu phalbi sungsea umdia kakigel lhah ahitai.
en_web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
en_kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga Artemas hihen Tychicus hile kahinsol teng Nicopolis khoa kahenga hungding hung kihabol’in, ajeh chu hikoma hi phalbi sungsea cham dinga kagel lhuh ahitai.

tcz: Dan thusun Zenas le Apollos chu akholjinna lhon'ah nabolthei chan'in kithopin. Angaichat lhon jouse bolpeh a aumna dingin vesuiyin.
en_web: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
en_kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu them Zenas le Apollos chun ima lhahsamna anei lhon louna din hinsoldoh loi dingin lungthim giltah-in kithopin.

tcz: Imiteu jong chun midang ngaichat khohtah tah neiho chunga thilpha bol na lamah kiha bol uhen, chutileh gasolouva umloudiu ahi.
en_web: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
en_kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
tcz_gospelgo: Imiteu jong chu angaichat’u kintoh din napha tohna dingin phat manchahje kichuh-u hen, tohga beiyin mohumdau hen.

tcz: Hikoma kaum khompi chengsen nasalamui. Lungsettah in, tahsan chate eingailuho jouse salam einapeh pih'un. Pathen mihepinan nabonchavin naumpi jing tauhen.
en_web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
en_kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. ¶ It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
tcz_gospelgo: Kaumpi chengsen nasalam’ui. Tahsan jal’a igolteu chu salamin. Lungset nan nabonchauvin umpihen.

tcz: Paul a kon in salam Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua chung chang a Kipana Thupha seiphongjeh a songkullut Paul le sopi Timothy teni a kon ahi. Keiman ngailut umtah, tohkhompi, Philemon henga,
en_web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
en_kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
tcz_gospelgo: Chrita Jesu Jal’a sohchang Paul le sopi Timothyn, ingailut tah-u le itoh khompiu Philemon,

tcz: chule isopinu'u Apphia chule kasepai chankhompiu Archippus, chule na-in'a kikhom houbung henga dinga kahinsut ahi.
en_web: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
en_kjv: and to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
tcz_gospelgo: isopi nuu Apphia, i-sepai pankhom piu Archippus le na-insunga kikhomji Houbung henga,

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le lungmon napeu hen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le chamna nachunguva um hen.

tcz: Philemon, nangma dinga katao tengleh ka Pathen kathangvah jingin ahi.
en_web: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
en_kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
tcz_gospelgo: Katao chanin phat jousen nangma kageldoh jingin ka-Pathen kathang vah jinge;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai Yeshuan atahsan le Pathen mite jouse nangailut thudol kana jajingin ahi.
en_web: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
en_kjv: hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu Pakai Jesu lam le mithengte chunga ngai lutna le thasan nanei thu kajai;

tcz: Chule eihon Christa a ineiyu thilpha jouse hetna le hetchetna hin nanga um natahsan chu thilpha boldohna asona dingin kataopeh jinge.
en_web: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
en_kjv: that the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: natahsan jeh a kikhop khomna hin Christa jal’a ei ho sunga um thilpha jouse hi hetchetna aumdoh teina dinga kataoji ahi.

tcz: Kasopi, nangman Pathen mite nahepina hin alungthimu nasuhalin, na-mingailutna hin kipana tahbeh le lungmonna eipei.
en_web: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
en_kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Na-ngailut thu dol’a hin hapan kakipah-in kakitil khou lhehjenge, ipijeh-inem itile nangma jeh-in mithengte lunggil jeng jong akisuhal lheh jengin ahi sopi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman lung ngamtah a napanpina Christa jal'a kangeh hi nangman naboltei dia kilomtah ahi.
en_web: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
en_kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
tcz_gospelgo: Christa jal’in angaidol’a nangma thupeh jeng ding ngam jongleng,

tcz: Hinlah ikingailutna jaljeh a, keiman kahin ngehnom joh ahi. Hiche hi keima, kum upa tah le Christa Yeshua jal'a tupet'a songkullut, Paul'a kona taona ahi, tin neigelpeh in.
en_web: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: ngailutna jeh a ka-ngeh tho joh ahi; hiche hi palaiya pang tu jenga jong Christa Jesu jal’a sohchang Paul kahi.

tcz: Keiman hiche kacha Onesimus hi nakhotona namusah dinga kangeh nahi. Keima songkul'a kaumpet in tahsanjal'in apa kahung hi.
en_web: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
en_kjv: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
tcz_gospelgo: Kasoh chan naa kahinsa, kachapa Onesimus dinga kangeh ahi.

tcz: Tumasanga chu Onesimus hi nangma dinga phachomlou anahi maithei ahi, hinla tua amahi eini dinga phatchomna higela ahitai.
en_web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
en_kjv: which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
tcz_gospelgo: Phat khat’a chu nang dinga amahi phachom lou ahin, tua vang nang le kei dinga pha chomtah ahitai.

tcz: Keiman amahi nahenga dingin kalungthim pumin kahinsole.
en_web: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
en_kjv: whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi nahenga kahinsol’in, hichepa hi kakhotona lung laigil’a hung ahi.

tcz: Keiman amahi hiche thihkhaova kakihen sunga hi Kipana Thupha seiphongnaa nangma thalhenga eikithopi dia umdensah ding kalunggon ahi.
en_web: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
en_kjv: whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana Thupha jal’a kasoh chan na muna hi nangma khel’a lhacha kinbol’a eipanpeh dinga kakihen den nom lheh jeng ahin,

tcz: Hinlah nangma phalpehna louvin imacha kabol nompoi. Nangma lungchamtah a neikithopi ding, seihat vanga bolchu hidahen kati ahi.
en_web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
en_kjv: but without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
tcz_gospelgo: ahinla nangma lung hilounaa ima nacham louvin kabolsah nompoi, chutia chu nathilpha bol chu chamlouva hilouva, nachamtah a naboljoh ding aphai.

tcz: Nangman phat chomkhat a dinga Onesimus hi namansah chu aitih a naumpiden theina ding hinte.
en_web: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
en_kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi tonsot geiya nanei theina dinga chomkhat dia nakoidoh jong hithei ahi;

tcz: Amahi nangma a dinga soh chu hijomtalouva, soh sanga chungnungjo, sopi deium dehset, keima dinga hung hi ahitai.
en_web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
en_kjv: not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
tcz_gospelgo: soh maimai ahitapon, keidin soh sanga chung nung jo sopi deitah ahin, nang din vang Pakai jal le tahsa jal’a hahi deh ahiye.

tcz: Hijeh chun keima hi natoh khompia neigela ahileh keima neilem ding tobang chun amahi analemin.
en_web: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
en_kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu nangin kei hi chan khopia neigel le kei khel’in ama hi analemin.

tcz: Aman nangma chu ipipena alamlouva nabolna umkham, aman bat nanei aumkhah a ahijongleh hichu keima bat in sun in.
en_web: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
en_kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
tcz_gospelgo: Aman na chunga suh khel anei ham, bat anei ham ahijongle, hijong chu kei chunga del din sim jengin.

tcz: Keimatah Paul in kakhuttah a hiche hi kajih ahi: Keiman sahpeh nange. Chule keiman nangin lhagaova neibat chu neisah dingin seiponge.
en_web: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
en_kjv: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Paul’in kakhut tah a kasut ahi, keiman le peh kit nange; nangma tah-in kei neibat chu nasahna dinga kasei ahipoi.

tcz: Tahbeh in, kasopi, Pakai jal'in hiche hi nei gelkhoh peh'in kati ahi. Christa ah hiche tilkhouna hi neipen.
en_web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
en_kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chu ahi sopi, Pakai jal’in nangin keima neilung lhaisah jon, Christa jal chun kalung laigil suhal jingin.

tcz: Keiman, hiche lekhathot kajih hin, kangeh banga aphajocheh a nabol ding kaging chai.
en_web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
en_kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasei ngai jing jeh a kahinsut ahin, Kasei kalval’a jong nabol ding kahei.

tcz: Chukal val'in, keima dingin lhunna ding indan neinagonpeh in, ajehchu Pathen in nataonaho asan a chule keima nahenga kahung vahjet kit ding kakineme.
en_web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
en_kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule kalhunna ding indan eina gonpeh-in, ajeh chu nataonau jeh a nang hodia eikipehdoh tei ding kakinem lheh jenge.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a songkul kalutpi Epaphras hin nangma lemnathu aseiye.
en_web: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
en_kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
tcz_gospelgo: Christa Jesu jeh a kasoh chanpi Epaphras-in nahinsalam’e;

tcz: Chutima chun Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule katohkhompi Luke teho hin nangho lemnathu aseiyuve.
en_web: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
en_kjv: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
tcz_gospelgo: katoh khompi cheng Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule Luke hite hon jong nasalam’ui.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagao umpi hen.
en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. ¶ Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu Christa milungset nan nalhagaovu umpihen.

tcz: Masanglai chun Pathen in tamtahvei chule gotchom chomin ipu ipateu henga themgao hoa konin thu anaseiye.

tcz: Chule tuphat nunung pena hin Aman eiho henga Achapa a konin thu ahinseitai. Pathen in Chapa chu ijakai goulo dinga athutep sa ahin chule Chapa a kona vannoi pumpihi anasem ahi.
en_web: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
en_kjv: hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
tcz_gospelgo: ninunung phat hin Chapan eiho henga thu ahinseitan, Chapa hi ijakai goulo dinga atun ahin, ama jeh a vannoi jong asemdoh ahi.

tcz: Chapa chun Pathen loupina vah akilahdoh sah in, chule Pathen chondan dihtah chu aphongdoh tan ahi, chule Aman athupeh thahattah jal'a ijakai atuhchah ahi. Aman ichonsetnauva kona eisilngim jouvu phat chun, Ama jabolna mun Pathen jetlam'a atouvin, Van mun'a loupitah in atoutai.
en_web: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
en_kjv: who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
tcz_gospelgo: chapa chun Pathen loupi vah le alim tahbeh chu apodoh-in, thanei tah athu chenga thil ijakai hi atuh chah jing ahin, chonset’a kona suh thengna abol jou phat’in lal loupi chungnung pen jet lama atouvin,

tcz: Hichun avetsah chu, Pathen in apeh min chu amaho minsanga chungnungjo ahi tobanga chu, Chapa chu vantil ho sanga gamchenga chungnungjo ahi.
en_web: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
en_kjv: being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantilte sanga gamchenga minphajo gou alojeh-in, amaho sangin achungnungjotai.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Yeshua koma asei chu vantil ho khatpen komah, “Nangma kachapa nahi, tunia hi keima napa kahung hi ahitai,” tin aseidoh khapoi, Chule Pathen in, “Keima Apa hingting, chule Ama kachapa hiding ahi,” tin aseikit in ahi.
en_web: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
en_kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Vantilte koipen jah a itih a chu: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati khah em? Chujongle: "Keima apa kahi ding, Ama kachapa hiding ahi, " atim?

tcz: Chule Aman achapa chungnungpen chu vannoiya ahinpui chun, Pathen in, “Pathen vantil ho jousen Ama houcheh un.”
en_web: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

tcz_gospelgo: chukit le ijakai sanga masapeh achapa vannoi leiset’a ahinpui ding chun aseiyin: "Pathen Vantil jousen Ama chu chibei boh cheh-u hen, " ati.

tcz: Vantil ho thudola Aman aseijin, “Aman avantilte chu hui bangin asoldoh in, asohte chu meikongto abahsah e,” ati.
en_web: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
en_kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Chul vantilte chung thudol’a aseiyin: "Aman a-Vantilte chu hui asosah-in, Alhachate chu meikong asosah-e, " ati.

tcz: Hinlah aman Chapa jah a, “Vo Pathen, nalaltouna chu atonsot tonsot'in aum jinge, nangman leng tenggola thutah'in vai napon ahi.
en_web: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
en_kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa thudol’a vang: "Vo Pathen nalaltouna chu tonsot tonsot geiya um jing ahin, Kitahna tenggol chu Nalenggam tenggol ahi.

tcz: Nangman thutandih nadeijin, chule aphalou nahotbol e. Hijeh a chu vo Pathen, na Pathen in thaonanua, kipana thao chu midang chung sanga nachunga asunlhah ahitai,” ati.
en_web: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
en_kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin adih na-ngailun, Dan dih lou nahot bol’e; Hijeh a chu Pathen, na-Pathenin thao nanua, Naloite jouse sanga nachoi sanga olive thao nanu ahi, " atibouve.

tcz: Aman Chapa jah a aseikit in, “Vo Pakai, atil in, nangman leiset bulhi nanaphutdoh in, chule van hohi nakhuttah a nasem ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: Chule: Vo Pakai, nangman semtil’in Leiset bulpi naphutdoh-in, Chule van ho jong hi nakhutsem ahi.

tcz: Hiche hohi mangthah diu, hinlah Nangma aitih a umjing ding nahi. Hiche hohi ponbanga chul lhaloi dingu ahi.
en_web: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
en_kjv: they shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi mangthah diu ahin, Nang vang um jing ding nahi; abonchauva ponsil banga chulsoh diu ahi.

tcz: Nangman hicheho hi pon kijeltum banga najeltum ding, ponlui banga napaidoh ding ahi. Hinla nangma angai chu nahi jingin; nangma aitih a nahin jing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
en_kjv: and as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
tcz_gospelgo: Aboncha hi ponlhe banga najeldoh a Ponsil banga nakheldoh ding ahi. Nang vang nabang nahi jingin, Nakum jong beitih um lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule Pathen chun vantil ho khatpen koma, “Namelmate kasuhnema nakengphang noiya kakoi masangsen, kakhut jetlam jabolna a touvin,” tin aseikhapoi.
en_web: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
en_kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi Vantilte koipen jah a: "Keiman namelmate nakengchotpha kaneisah masangsen Kajet lam’a tou jingin, " ati beh em?

tcz: Hijeh chun vantil ho hi lhachabou ahiuvin-huhhingna gouloding ho kinbol dinga kisoldoh lhagaoho ahibouvui.
en_web: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
en_kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
tcz_gospelgo: Vantilte chu abonchauva lhacha kinbol lhagao, huhhingna goulo ding ho jenle dinga hinkisol hilou hiuvem?

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a chu eihon ithujah u thutah hi chingtheitah a ingaidiu ahi, achuti louva ahileh hichea kona hi ikiheimang theiyu ahi.
en_web: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
en_kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh tah a hi ithujah chengseu hi lung nachang cheh a i-ngai diu, achutiloule ikimoh tolmang diu ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: hitobang huhhingna nasatah hi nahsah mo leu hen iti isochat diu ham? Athu hi akipatnaa Pakai tah-in aseidoh a, ajahon eiho henga aphotchetsah-u ahin,

en_web: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
en_kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin jong melchihna tampi le thil kidang tampi, bolmo kidang tampi to thoa adei dungjuiya Lhagao Theng ahoppeh a ahettoh sahpi ahi.

tcz: Chule akalvalin, tua iseiyu ahung lhung ding vannoi jong vantil ho thuneina ding ahipoi.

en_kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak:

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nangman vantil ho sangin noi nung jon nasemin chule amaho hi loupina le jabolnan lallukhuh nakhuhsah in ahi.

en_web: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

en_web: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

tcz: Pathen in, chate tamtah loupina a apuilut theina dinga amadinga alhena chule amajala ijakai asem ahi.

tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile ama vanga thil ijakai umsah-a, ama jal’a ijakai hinsah pan chapa tamtah loupinaa apui lut ding jeh a amaho huhhingna phutdohpa chun gim genthei athoh a asuh cham ding chu kitoh ahi.

en_web: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
en_kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

en_web: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
en_kjv: saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

en_web: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
en_kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold, I, and the children which God hath given me.

en_web: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu chapangte hi thisan le tahsaphe kikop ahiuvin, aman jong amaho tobangin alim’u ahung louvin hitia chu thina jal’a thina chunga thunei vaipo, hiche Diabol chu suhmang ding agot ahi;

en_web: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
en_kjv: and deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
tcz_gospelgo: chule thina kichat jeh a hinkhoa soh a kihen chengse chu lhadoh ding agot ahi.

tcz: Chapa chu vantil ho kithopi dinga hunga ahipoi tijong iheuvin ahi. Abraham chilhah ho panhu dinga hunga ahi.
en_web: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
en_kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: ama chun vantilte ding akhohsahjo pon, Abraham chilhahte ahujotai.

tcz: Hichejeh a chu, Amatah jong chu imalam jousea eiho, asopite, tobang ahithei nadinga sem ngai ahi, chutia chu ama Pathen masanga lungset them le tahsan umtah thempu chungnung ahithei nadinga ahi. Chujeh a chu aman miho chonset pomang dinga kilhaina abol theibou ahi.
en_web: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
en_kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi chonsetna chengse akichulnam theina dinga, Pathen henga tahsan umtah le mihepi Thempu chungnunga apan theina dinga sopite lim le mel bang banga aumdoh ding hi kilomtah ahi.

tcz: Aman thohhahsa athoh lhumkeiya chule patep naho athoh tah jeh a, eihon patepna ichan tengu jongleh aman eipanpi theiyu ahi.
en_web: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
en_kjv: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi ama tah-in gim genthei ahoth a lhep patep’a aumjehchun, lhep patep’a umho chu akithopi theitai.

tcz: Chule hiti chun kasopi deitahte, Pathena nahitah jeh ule vana dinga kikou hoto chan neikhoma nahitah jeh uvin, kaphondoh u hiche Yeshua keihon Pathen thupole Thempu chungnunga kaneiyu hi phatechan geilun.
en_web: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
en_kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh chun van kouna changkha sopi thengte, i-hou thu’uva solchah le Thempu chungnung Jesu chu gelkhoh-uvin,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Mose chu Pathen insung pumpia akingansena a tahsan umtah ahi bang chun, Ama jong alhengdohpa Pathena dinga tahsan umtah ahi.
en_web: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
en_kjv: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen insung pumpia Mose akitah banga ama jong apansahpa dinga kitah tah ahi.

tcz: Hinlah, Insapa chu ainsah sanga vahchoina achan dinga kilomtah ahi banga Yeshua chu Mose sanga gamchenga loupina chang dinga lomtah ahi.
en_web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
en_kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile in sanga, in sadohpa jabolna achanjoh banga Mose sanga Jesu chu gamchenga loupijo dia kilom ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh inkhat cheh hi asapa uma ahin, hinla ijakai hinsadohpa chu Pathen ahi.
en_web: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
en_kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu in jouse hi asadoh khat um cheh ahin, ahinla thil ijakai hi Pathenin asadoh-e.

tcz: Mose chu sohkhat hina a Pathen in'a tahsan umtah hiya ahi. Ama natoh hi khonunga Pathen in ahin phondoh ding vetsahna hiya ahi.
en_web: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
en_kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
tcz_gospelgo: Khonung thusoh ding kisei ding ho hettohsahnaa Mose chu Pathen insung pumpia tahsan umtah lhachan anapange.

tcz: Hinlah Christa chu Chapa hina a Pathen insung pumpia kingansea ahi. Chule eiho Pathen insung hina a ilungngamnau le Christa a ikinepnauva chu ikison jom dingu ahi.
en_web: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
en_kjv: but Christ as a Son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
tcz_gospelgo: Christa vang chu Pathen insunga Chapa thunei pen ahin, eihon i-hakat nau le ikison nau chule kinepna hi ituh chah jingu le ama insung ihidiu ahibouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiye, “Tunia nanghon a aw najah uva ahileh,
en_web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
en_kjv: Wherefore, as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le

tcz: Israelten keima gamthip a eipatep uva, chua dou lungchang aken uva abol bangu chun nalungu tahsah hih un.
en_web: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
en_kjv: harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
tcz_gospelgo: Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun Nalung tahsah hih-un, Gamthip laiya kipatep nikhoa bangin:
