en_web: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
en_kjv: when your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napa teuvin eipatep’un eideh-uve, Kanatoh kathilbol amu’uvin

tcz: Hitichun keima amaho chunga kana lunghang in, chule kaseiyin, ‘Alungthimu keiya konin akiheimang jingun ahi. Keiman kasei thua anung nom pouve.’
en_web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
en_kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum som li sungin. Hijeh a chu hiche khang mite chunga lung hanga, ‘Amaho hi lungthim chavai mong ahiuvin, Hijeh chun kalampi jouse ahepouve,’ kati ahi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu kalunghanna a kahahsel amaho keima choldona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve, kati ahi.”
en_web: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
en_kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.
tcz_gospelgo: Hia chun kalunghan jeh a kihahsel’a: ‘Amaho kacholdoh mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati aihye.

tcz: Chuti ahileh sopi deitahte, Pathen hing jinga kona kiheimangna aso louna dingin chingtheiyun, lungthim gitlouna le tahsanlelna neihih un.
en_web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
en_kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Pathen hing jinga kona pul lhahna dia nalah-uva mi koi hile tahsan louva lungthim gilou pu aum louna din ching theiyun.

tcz: Tuni akiti thei petcha hin nangho khatle khat kihilchah uvin, hiti chun bolleu chun nangho lah a koima chonset a lhalut le Pathen dounaa lungtah naumlou dingu ahitai.
en_web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
en_kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva chonset lhep lhah a lungtah cheh cheh aum louna din, "Tuni’ kiti aum laisen nangho khat le khat kitilkhouto jingun.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho achaina geiya Pathen songa ithoh uva itahsan masah pet uva banga idindet uva ahileh, Christa toh aneijousea chu chan neikhoma ihi dingu ahitai.
en_web: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
en_kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile abul’a pat’a i-hung kison nau chu akhon nigeiya ituh chah jing pouvu le eiho hi Christa to chan kikop ihitauve.

tcz: Akisei chu geldoh un, “Tunikhoa a aw najah uva ahileh, Israelten abol bangu chun nanghon nalungu tahsah cheh hih un.”
en_web: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
en_kjv: whilst it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin akiseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun nalung tahsah hih-un, " akiti.

tcz: Chule koi hiuvem amaho a aw ajah jeng vanguva Pathen douna a kimangchaho chu? Mosen Egypt a kona ahinpuidoh ho chu hilou ham?
en_web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
en_kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
tcz_gospelgo: Ja taa doumah bol’a chu koi koi ham? Egypt’a kona Mose vanga hung potdoh chengse hilou ham?

tcz: Chule koiham kum somli jen Pathen lung hansah ho chu? Amaho chu chonsetbol mipite, atahsau long damsa gamthip'a kijamden ho chu hilou ham?
en_web: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
en_kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
tcz_gospelgo: Kum som li sunga koi chunga lung hang ham? Chonsea gamthip laiya along lumden ho chung hilou ham?

tcz: Chule Pathen in kihahselna aneipet a kacholngahna a lut louhel dingu ahi atia chu koiho koma thu aseiyem? Asei ngailou miho koma hilou ham?
en_web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
en_kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho acholdo mun’a lut louhel dinga ahahsel khum ho chu hiche thu ngailou ho chu hilou ham?

tcz: Hiti chun amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin acholngahna ah aluttapouve ti imutauve.
en_web: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
en_kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin atahsan loujeh-uva alut thei louvu imutauve.

tcz: Acholdona a lut ding thua Pathen kitepna tuchanin adingjing nalaiye. Hijeh a chu, nalah uva mi phabep khattou chuche thutep chu tepkhalou ding naum khahdiu kichatna a eiho kichatah le kithing puma iumdiu ahi.
en_web: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
en_kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kichau hite, achutiloule acholdo mun’a lut theina ding thutep um jeng jongle nalahuva khattou athon’a um khante.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh hiche Kipana Thupha Pathen in kicholdona a asem hi-amaho koma akiphongdoh ahitah banga eiho koma jong kiphongdoh a ahitai. Hinla amahon aphatchompi pouve, ajeh chu amahon Pathen sei ngaiho tahsan chu akikoppi pouve.
en_web: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
en_kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile eiho jah banga ama hon jong Kipana Thupha ajah-u ahinan, ahivangin athu jah-u chun amaho aphat chomsah poi, ajehchu ajahon tahsan’a asanlouvu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho atahsan ho hi acholngahna a lutthei ihiuve. Hinla adangho dingin vang Pathen in, “Kalunghanna a kahahsel ahi: Amaho kacholdona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve,” ati. Hiche cholngahna hi vannoi asemlaiya pat a gotsa akoi ahivangin.
en_web: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
en_kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Atahsan eiho vang hi choldo mun’a chu lut ihiuve, hitia aseibang chun: "Kalunghan jeh-in kakihahsel’in, ‘Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati, " akiti. Leiset bulpi khom kiphu til’a pat natoh thilsem chu akichaisa ahitah vangin.

tcz: Hiche hi gotsa koi ahi ti ihetnau ajeh chu Pathen Thubu munkhat'ah ni sagi thudol hitihin akisune, “Ni sagi nin Pathen anatoh na jousea konin akicholdo tai.”
en_web: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
en_kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuma le mun khat’a Ni sagi ni thudol aseiyin: "Chuin Nisagi lhin nin anatoh chengsea konin Pathen akicholdoi, " ati.

tcz: Hinlah munchom khatma ah Pathen in, “Amaho kacholdona muna lutlouhel dingu ahi,” ati.
en_web: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
en_kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
tcz_gospelgo: Chukit le hichea hin: "Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi, " ati.

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen choldona chu miho luttheina dingin aume, hinla hiche Kipana Thupha jamasaho chun Pathen sei angailou jeh uchun alut theitapouve.
en_web: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
en_kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief,
tcz_gospelgo: Kipana Thupha ja masahon thu angai lou jeh-uva alut lou vangun, hichea lut ding chu mi aum jing nalaiyin,

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in acholdona a luttheina dingin phat chomkhat agonpeh in, chule hiche phat chu tunihi ahi. Pathen in hiche hi David a konin khonung in anaphongdoh in, “Tunia Ama aw najah tengleh, nalung tahsah hih un,” atikit in ahi.
en_web: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
en_kjv: again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
tcz_gospelgo: chuin "Tuni" kiti nikho dang khat atep kit’in, athu hi khonungin David kama aseiyin, akisei masa bang chun. "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Nalung tahsah hih-un, " ati.

tcz: Tun Joshua chun hiche choldona hi ananeisah ahitah leh, Pathen in choldona nikhochom hung lhung nalaiding aseitahlou ding ahi.
en_web: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
en_kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Joshuan amaho chu acholdosah hita le, aman kho nunga nikho dang khat um kit ding thu hi aseilou ding ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh a chu, Pathen mite dinga choldona chombeh khat nga jing ding umnalai ahi.
en_web: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
en_kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen mite din Choldona khat aum nalaiye.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in vannoi asemjouva acholdo banga chu, Pathen cholngahnaa lut ho chu atohgimnauva kona choldoa ahitauve.
en_web: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
en_kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh-inem itile Pathen jeng jong anatoh na akona acholdo banga Pathen choldo mun’a lut pa chu anatoh akona kicholdo ahitai.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun ijochanun chuche cholngahna a chu lutding kiseh u hite. Hinla eihon Israel mite banga Pathen sei ingailou uleh ilhuh diu ahi.
en_web: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
en_kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
tcz_gospelgo: Thu ngailouna jeh a lut louho umchan jop’a alut lou ium louna diuvin, chua lut’a choldo cheh din kihabol’u hite.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen Thuhi ahinga le thaneitah ahi. Hemto chemjam ahempen sanga jong hemjoa ahin, hinna le lhagao chule gukisuhtona le lhin jong sukhen thei ahi.
en_web: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
en_kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile Pathen thu hi hing jing le na tong hat jing, hemto chemjam sanga jong hemjo, hinna Lhagao gu kisuhtona le lhin, hicheng geiya sukhen theihel’a sun thei, lunggel le lungthim ngaito hetoh paijen jeng thei ahi.

tcz: Thilsem jouse lah a imacha Pathena kona kiselthei aumpoi. Ijakai amitmua sagohkeo chule kihongsa ahi, chule Ama ichonnau jouse sutoh dingpa chu hiya ahi.
en_web: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
en_kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen maiya kilang lou thilsem aumpon, ichung thu i-lhutna ding pau mitmua chu thil ijakai hi asagoh keova kijam cheh ahibouve.

tcz: Hiti chun eihon Thempu chungnung, Pathen Chapa Yeshua, van mun galut ah, chu ineiyu ahitah jeh in, Ama itahsanu hi kolchah jingu hite.
en_web: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
en_kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
tcz_gospelgo: Van mun jouse jotpaiya Thempulen, Pathen Chapa Jesu ineijeh-un iphondoh-u tahsan chu tuhdet jing u hite.

tcz: Hiche ithempu Chungnung uhi ilhahsamnau hethem tah ahi, ajeh chu Aman eiho banga patepna jouse ato ahin, ahivangin chonselou ahiye.
en_web: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
en_kjv: For we have not a high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile ihatmo lhahsam nauva eihu theilou Thempu chungnung nei ihipouvin, eiho banga imalam jousea lhep patepna tohsa, ahivanga chonsetna bei thempu chungnung ineiyui.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun eilungset uva IPathenu Laltouna a chun lung ngamtah in hungu hite. Chukoma chu eihon hepina le ingaichat khoh dehset tenguleh lungsetna panpina imu diu ahi.
en_web: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
en_kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun panpi i-ngai kom’u le alungset vanga hepina le panpina ikilah theina diuvin hangtah-in lungset laltouna chu nailut’u hite.

tcz: Thempu chungnung chu midang thalhenga Pathen koma galut ji ahi. Aman amaho thilto chu Pathen koma apeha chule achonset jeh uva maichama thil atou chu akatdoh ji ahi.
en_web: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
en_kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnung jouse hi chonset jal’a thilto ho le kilheina gan tha ho Pathen koma tohdoh dinga, mihem ho thalhenga mihem te lha a kiladoh a kipansah ji ahi.

tcz: Chule Amahi ima helou le seingailou ho jeng jong lungnengtah a bolthei ahi, ajeh chu Amatah jong hiche lhahsamna thunoiya chu kipelut a ahi.
en_web: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
en_kjv: who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
tcz_gospelgo: Amatah jeng jong lhahsam nan aumkimvel soh jeh chun imaheloute le lamvaite lung de-hattah a abol thei ahinai,

tcz: Hichejeh a chu Ama le midang ho chonsetna ho jeh a chu kilhaina aboltei hiji ahi.
en_web: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
en_kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu mipi dinga kilhaina abol lou akhoh banga amatah jeng dinga jong achonset nau jeh a abol lou khoh ahi.

tcz: Chule mi koima thempu chungnung chu jabolna tah achan jeh a ahinom mana moh hi jengthei ahidehpoi. Ama chu Aaron tobanga hiche natohna dinga hi Pathen kouna chang mi hiding ahiye.
en_web: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
en_kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Aaron bang chun Pathenin akouna jeh tilouvin koiman hiche jabolna kintheng hi acham chamin akilah theipoi.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a Christa jeng jong chu Thempu Chungnung hina na atoh jeng vang chun Amatah kichoian dehlouva ahi. Ama chu Pathen deilhen changa ahin, ajah a hitia hi asei ahi, “Nangma ka Chapa nahi. Keima tunia na Pa kahunghi ahitai.”
en_web: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
en_kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made a high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chun Christa jengin jong Thempu chungnung hi-na ding hi achamtah a kichoi-at nan aneipon amavang ajah a seipeh pan: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati.

tcz: Chule munchom khat ah, Pathen in ajah a aseiyin, “Nangma Melchizedek themputna tobanga tonsot thempu nahi,” ati.
en_web: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
en_kjv: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobangma hin mun khat’a jong aseiyin: "Melchizedek themput dungjuiya Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi, " ati.

tcz: Yeshua chu leiset a anaum laiyin, Aman taona le thumna aneiyin hapen in apengin kana le mitlhi tothon thinaa kona ahuhdoh theipa henga chun ataove. Chule Aman Pathen aginlheh jeh chun Pathen in ataonaho chu angaipehtai.
en_web: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
en_kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsaphe pua aum lai nikhon thinaa kona ahuhhing theipa henga Jesu chu o-thong leu le mit-lhi pumin thumna le taona neiya, Pathena akipeh thengjeh-in ataona aki-ngaipehin ahi.

tcz: Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahijeng vang'in, Aman athohgimna a chun sei angaiyin ahi.
en_web: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
en_kjv: though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
tcz_gospelgo: Chapatah ahijeng vangin thoh hesoh thoh-in thua nunje akihil them’e.

tcz: Hiti hin, Pathen in thempu chungnung hina chamkim tah in asemin, chule asei ngai jouse dingin tonsot hinna bulpin asemtai.
en_web: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
en_kjv: and being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama achamkimsoh phat’in ama thua nungte jouse din tonsot sochatna bulpin apangin,

tcz: Chule Pathen in Ama hi Melchizedek banga Thempu chungnunga apehdoh ahitai.
en_web: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
en_kjv: called of God a high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Melchizedek themput dungjuiyin Thempu chungnung asahtai.

tcz: Keihon hiche thudol hi tampi kaseibe nomun, hinla hilchet ding ahahsai, adeh in nangho lhagaolam dol ah nalungmo un chule na ngainom diu chu ginchat aumpoi.
en_web: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
en_kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thudol’a hin sei ding tampi kaneiyun, ahinla nakolseh tah jeh-un ahilchet ahahsai.

tcz: Tahsan cha nahung hinau sotpi ahunghitan, tua hi midang hil theiding nahiu ahitai. Chusangin, nanghon midang khat in Pathen Thubul lam nahildiu nangaicha nalaiyuve. Nangho hi naosen noitui ngaicha nalai chule anham nethei loulai tobang nahiuve.
en_web: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
en_kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitih chanpi hi mihil thei nahi diu ahitan, chutitah sangin khattouvin Pathen thubul kipatna lhongpi ho hil leu chun na-ngaikit nalaiyui, anham hilou bongnoitwi ngai nalaiyin naum’uve.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh noichep nalai chu naosen hinalaibep ahin, chule thilpha itibol ding ham chu ahetloulai ahi.
en_web: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
en_kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile bongnoitwiya kivah nalai chu chapang ahijeh-in adih thudol’a hetna ima aneipoi.

tcz: An ham chu akikhanlhit hoa ding ahi, amaho chun akithemchuh uva kona adih le adihlou hetkhenna aneiyu ahitai.
en_web: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
en_kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Anham vang chu mi kikhan lhitsa ho ding ahin, amaho chu ahet thei nau mangchaa ase apha datkhenje themsa ho chu ahiuve.

tcz: Hijehchun eihon Christa thudol thubul lam avel vel'a kihilna ngatau hite. Chusangin masotjou hitin hetna lam'ah pilhin ding gouhite. Tahbeh mongin eihon thilsebolnaa kona lunghei chule Pathen a itahsan nau ngaplhah thudol a thubul lam kithah pat kitna ingaicha tapouve.
en_web: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
en_kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith towards God,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh chun Christa thu bul kipatna lam chu dalhau hitin, philhinna ding lamjoh del’u hite; natoh thisa hoa kona lunghei ding bul phut kit louvin, Pathen tahsan thupou,

tcz: Baptize chan thudol, khutngap thudol, mithi thokitna, chule tonsot thutanna thudol a kihilbena nangaichat u ahitapoi.
en_web: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
en_kjv: of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: batize thua kihilna pou, thenso-khut ngap ham, thinaa kona thokit thu ham, chule tonsot’a dia thutan thupou velsei daute.

tcz: Chule hitia hi Pathen phatsah ahileh, eihon aban hetbena lam imasot dingu ahiye.
en_web: This will we do, if God permits.
en_kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche jong chu Pathenin pha asah le ibol diu ahinai.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh khatvei lhagao mitvahna neisa–vanlam thilphaho hetna nei chule Lhagao Theng chankhompi hitasa ho,
en_web: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
en_kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile khatvei khovah changsa ho, van’a kon thilpeh chu atep khah-uva, Lhagao Theng changkhasa,

tcz: Pathen thu aphatna ho tepkha a chule ahunglhung ding khangho umdidol hetna neitasa,
en_web: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
en_kjv: and have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
tcz_gospelgo: chule Pathen thu phat dan tep khaa, khang hung lhung dinga thaneina hesa ahiuvin,

tcz: chujouva Pathen a kona kiheimang ho chu: Pathen Chapa sangnomlou, Ama chu thingpel to avela akilbeh kit ahin, chule mihonpi lah a jachatsahna'a atahlah ahitah jeh chun akisihkitna dinguva hinlepui chu thil hahsatah ahi.
en_web: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
en_kjv: if they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
tcz_gospelgo: amaho hi alhuh tah-u le, amaho tumtah a Pathen Chapa chu Thingpel’a khen beh kit’a lhang phong tah a taitoma aumsah-u ahitan, lungheina dinga semphat kit thei hoi ahitapouve.

tcz: Vana kon go hunglha chun leiset achapnouvin chule loubol mi dingin Pathen phattheina gapha ahin sodoh in ahi.
en_web: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
en_kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathen kona phattheiboh achan jeh a leiset’in achunga ju-lha jing jeng gotwi adon’a, aphatchomna diuva lou kibolpeh ho dinga anche louhing ahinsep dohji ahin,

tcz: Hinlah lou chun lingphung le nangkai hinsodoh henlang hileh, panabei hiding ahitai. Loubolpa chun hiche lou chu themmo chanpai intin chule ahalvam jeng ding ahitai.
en_web: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
en_kjv: but that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
tcz_gospelgo: amavang ling phung ho le simbiling ho asepdoh le pannabei ahitan, gaosap anaiyin, achaina govam ding ahi.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, keihon hitihin sei jengu jongleng, nangho chungchang thu akisei ahipoi ti kaheuve. Keihon katahsanu chu aphajo, nangho huhhing chana thudola hinte tihi ahi.
en_web: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
en_kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, hitia kasei vangun thilpha cheh le huhhingna nanei jeh-un nachung thu’va kagin chat nau aum nai.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen chondih louva ahipoi. Aman nanghon ichangeiya ama dinga kisalunggima nahiu chule nanghon tugeija naboljomu atahsan dangho nakhohsahnau navetsah u chu asuhmil lou ding ahi.
en_web: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
en_kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu mithengte kin nabolsau chu nabol jingu ahin, Ama min ngailutna naphondoh-u ahitah jeh-in, hiche natoh nau asuhmil ding chu Pathen adih lou ahipoi.

tcz: Kagelkhoh tah u chu nahinkhou umsungin atahsan midangho chu ngailu jomun, hichun nakinepnau chu atah hung himong ding ahinai ti aphotchet teina ding ahije.
en_web: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
en_kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
tcz_gospelgo: Akhonna geiya kinepna chu lhingkeiya akihetdoh kahsea natompan ngai banguva nang ho khat cheh hi napan diu kadei lheh jengui.

tcz: Chutileh nangho lhagao lama amol le ima khohsalou nahilou dingu ahitai. Chusanga Pathen thutep loding ho tahsan le thoh hat umchan nungjuiya nahi dingu ahi.
en_web: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
en_kjv: that ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile nathaset lou diu, tahsan le thoh hat jal’a thutep gou lo chang ho umchan jom nahidiu ahiye.

tcz: Vetsahnan, Pathen in Abraham koma thutep ananeiye. Ama sanga hettohsah lenjo dang aum tahlou jeh in Pathen chu Amatah minin kihahselin,
en_web: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
en_kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Abraham thu atep chun ama sanga len jodang aum loujeh-in ama changseh akihahsel’in

tcz: “Keiman thonlou hela phatthei kaboh ding, chule keiman nachilhah ho chu simjou louva katamsah ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
en_kjv: saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman phatthei kaboh tei tei ding, punjong kapunsah ding nahi, " ati.

tcz: Chuti chun Abraham'in thohhattah in angah'in, chule Pathen thutep chu achangtai.
en_web: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
en_kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Abrahamin thoh hattahin thutepga akimutai.

tcz: Hitia hi mihon kihahselna aneiji tenguleh amaho sanga lenjoa chun akihahsel jiuvin chule hiche kihahselna chu kidohna ngailouvin akiphutdetjin ahi.
en_web: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
en_kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle mihemten amaho sanga chungnung jo chu kihahselna aneijiu ahin, chule thu kichetna dinga kihahsel na chun akah-uva kibaona jouse asuh chaiji ahi.

tcz: Pathen Amatah jonghin athutep chang hon alung akhel kit louna photchennan, kihahselna achun amajong aumin ahi.
en_web: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
en_kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
tcz_gospelgo: Thutep goulo ding ho henga chu alung ngaito chu khelkit louhel ding ahidol kichentah a avetsah nom jeh a Pathenin kihahselna chu palai banga anei ahi.

tcz: Hitia hi Pathen in Athutep le akihahselna chu apehdoh gel ahije. Hicheteni hi khelkit thei ahitapoi, ajeh chu Pathen joutheilou ahije. Hijeh a hi, Ama henga kipelut a kiselho chun kinepna imasanguva um chu ituhchah jinguva ahileh kisonna phatah ineitheiyu ahi.
en_web: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
en_kjv: that by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia chu hiche thilbol nia kona hi Pathen kikheltih neilou le itih a jou thei lou ahi hea, hite ni jeh a ama koma kisel eiho hin imasanguva kikoi kinepna chu tuh chah dinga nasa tah a kitilkhou ihiuve.

tcz: Hiche kinepna hi ilhagao dinguva kingapdetna a phatah le tahsan umtah ahin, hichun pondal noiya Pathen muntheng sunga eipuilut theiyu ahi.
en_web: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
en_kjv: which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the vail;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kinepna chu hinkho dia thihhat aiya ineiyu ahin, kichentah le dettah pondal sung lam geiya lut pai ahi.

tcz: Yeshua chu chuche muna eiho dinga analut a eiho dinga tonsot thempu chungnung Melchizedek dinmuna uma ahitai.
en_web: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
en_kjv: whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made a high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma chu Melchizedek themput dungjuiya tonsot’a dia thempu chungnunga pang Jesu chu eiho thalhenga analut masa ahitai.

tcz: Hiche Melchizedek hi Salem khopia Leng ahin chule Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahi. Abraham'in lengho douna agal asat chu ajoa ahung kile chun Melchizedek hin akimupin chule phatthei bohna apen ahi.
en_web: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
en_kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Melchizedek Salem leng pa hi Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahin, Abrahamin lengho agatha ahung kilekit lam chun Melchizedek-in agalamton phatthei aboh-e.

tcz: Chuphat in Abraham'in galsatna a achomkhom jouse lah a hopsoma hopkhat chu Melchizedek apen ahi. Melchizedek kiti min hi “Thutandih Lengpa chule Salem lengpa kiti hi ‘Chamna lengpa,’” kiseina ahi.
en_web: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
en_kjv: to whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu Abrahamin athil chomdoh jousea konin som a khat apen, amasaa Mechizedek hi ‘Kalengpa dih’ tina ahin, chujongle ‘Salem lengpa’ jong hin chamna lengpa kiti ahi.

tcz: Apa le anu ahilouleh apu apa min kisutna aumpon–apatna umlou, ahilouleh ahinkho kichaina jong aumpoi. Ama tonsot thempu ahin, Pathen Chapa to kilouva ahi.
en_web: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
en_kjv: without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi nubei pabei, khanggui thusim neilou, hinnikho kipatna le kichaina bei, Pathen Chapa tobang ahin, a-itih a thempua pang jing jeng ahi.

tcz: Chuti ahileh hiche Melchizedek hi ichan geiya lena hitam ngaito temin. Israel te mipa, Abraham jaumtahpa chun hiche hi ahet a agalsatnaa athillah hoa kona hopsoma hopkhat apeh jeng hi!
en_web: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
en_kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
tcz_gospelgo: Lung gel’in ngaitouvin, ipului bulpiu Abrahamin athilchom hopsom a hop khat apehpa chu itobanga len hitam!

tcz: Tun, Mose Dan chun thempuho, Levi son ho, Abraham chilhah jong hiho, chun Israel mipi lah a kona hopsoma khat chu akilah diu angeh in ahi.
en_web: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
en_kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
tcz_gospelgo: Abraham chilhah ahicheh vangun Levi chilhah thempu mun chang ho chun Danthu dungjuiya asopiteu hijongle miholah akon hopsom’a khat lahna ding thu aneiyu ahi.

tcz: Ahin Melchizedek, Levi son hilou chun, Abraham a konin soma khat chu akilah in ahi. Chule Melchizedek chun Pathen thutep ho anachangsa, Abraham chunga phattheina apen ahi.
en_web: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
en_kjv: but he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahile Levite khangguiya kimatna bon neilou Melchizedek chun Abrahama konin hopsoma hop khat alan, chule thutep kisanpa chu phatthei aboh jenge.

tcz: Chule kidoh ngailou hel chu phattheina pepa thaneina chu phattheina changpa sanga chungnung joa ahi.
en_web: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
en_kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule mineojon asanga lenjoa kona phatthei boh khat akilah uvin, khatjoh a vang hin akilahpa chu hing jing ahidol hettohsahna aum’e.

tcz: Thempuho hopsom donga pangho chu thithei mihem ahiuvin, hiti chun Melchizedek chu amaho sanga chungnungjoa ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama ahing jing ahi.
en_web: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
en_kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

tcz: Hiche banjoma chu, eihon Levi mite som a khat donga pangho chun apuluiyu Abraham'in hopsoma hopkhat anapeh jeh a chu amahon jong Melchizedek chu hopsoma khat chu apeh u ahi.
en_web: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
en_kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle Abraham jeh chun, hopsom’a hop khat kilahpa Levi jeng jong chun hopsom’a hopkhat apei tia sethei ai.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Levi chu anapen loulai jeng vang chun ama hung kon dohna Abraham tibah a chu uma ahin, hichea chu Melchizedek in amaa hopsoma hopkhat analah ahitai.
en_web: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
en_kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajehchu Melchizedek chun Abraham agalamto pet’a hi Levi chu apu Abraham taiguiya um nalai ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun Levi thempu hina Dana kingapna chun Pathen lunggon chu chamkimsah jou hitaleh Pathen in ipi dia themputna achombeh a Levi le Aaron thalhenga Melchizedek thempuhina tobang chu aphudoh ngaiding ham?
en_web: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
en_kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi dia Danthu kipeh lo na Levite themput dol’a chu chamkimsohna umthei hile Aaron themput dol’a kisei louva Melchizedek thempu chom dang khat umdoh khoh ngai ding ham?

tcz: Chule thempu hina chu akikhel tah a ahileh phatsahna dan jong chu kikhel ding adoltah ahi.
en_web: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
en_kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche achung chang thudol akikhel le Danthu jong kikhel teiji ahi.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh thempu ikihoulimna dingpau hi phung choma ahin, hiche phunga kona chu thempu natong anaum khaloulai ahi.
en_web: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
en_kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche achung chang thudol kiseipa hi phung chom’a kon ahin, hiche phunga kon hin koimacha maicham phunga lhachan apang kha hih laiye.

tcz: Keiman kahin seinom chu IPakai chu Judah phunga hungkon ahin, chule Mose chun hiche phunga kona thempu hung umdoh ding anaphapoh hihbeh in ahi.
en_web: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
en_kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
tcz_gospelgo: Akichen veng tai, ajeh chu i-Pakaiyu chu Judah phunga hung kon ahin, hiche phunga themput dol hi Mosen ima aseipoi.

tcz: Hiche kikhelna hi thempu gotchom beh Melchizedek tobang khat hung kilangdoh a ahitai.
en_web: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
en_kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
tcz_gospelgo: Melchizedek tobanga chu thempu chom dangkhat akitundoh phat hin athu hi gamchengin akichen kit tai.

tcz: Yeshua thempu hina hi tahsalam dol a Levi phunga mihina ngaichatna pachu hitalouvin, suhmangthei hilou hinna thaneina a konjoh hiya ahi.
en_web: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
en_kjv: who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama themputna hi tahsaphe Danthu thupeh dungjui ahipon, mantih neilou hinkho khat tha neinaa konjoh ahibouve.

tcz: Chule David, Labu jihpan, hiche hi apodoh in, “Nangma tonsot thempu hina Melchizedek a tobang chu nahi,” ati.
en_web: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
en_kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah nan: Melchizedek themput dol’a Nangma tonsot dia thempu nahi,” akiti.

tcz: Ahi, thempu hina a kingeh alui chu alhahsama chule pannabei ahitah jeh a achombeh a kikoidoh a ahitai.
en_web: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
en_kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujongle thupeh masa chu alhah sam jeh le aphatchom loujeh-in akinoi mangtai.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh danthun ima achamkim sahna aumpoi. Hinla tun eihon kinepna phajo ikisonpiuvin, hichea chu eihon Pathen kom inaitheiyu ahi.
en_web: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
en_kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Danthun imacha achamkimsah lou phat’in, kinepna pha cheh khat ahung kipolut tan, hiche kinepna jeh hin Pathen kom anailut’uve.

tcz: Hiche athahbehpa hi kihahselna gimneitah a kibol'a ahi. Aaron son ho chun hiche kihahselna jaotha louva hi thempuna atoh u ahi.
en_web: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
en_kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi kihahselna beiya ahipoi, adang ho vang chu kihahselna beiya thempua pang anahiuvin,

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua chung chang thua kihahselna khat aumin ahi. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in ajah a aseijin, “Pakaiyin kihahselna chu akilahtai chule akihahselna chu asuhkeh loubeh ding ahi; Nangma tonsot'a thempu nahitai,” ati.
en_web: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
en_kjv: (for those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
tcz_gospelgo: Ama vang hi ajah a kihahsel na to lhon’a kiseipeh-a “Pakai akihahseltai, Lung akhel kit lou ding ahi; ‘Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi,’ tin,” ati.

tcz: Hiche kihahselna jal a hi, Yeshua hin kitepna phajo Pathen to kinei chu aphat atep a panga ahi.
en_web: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
en_kjv: by so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche dungjui hin Jesu chu Kitepna phajo phutdet’in apangtai.

tcz: Chonna luinoiya chun thempu tampi anaumuvin, thina chun anatohna muna umden theilouna asodoh u hiya ahi.
en_web: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
en_kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
tcz_gospelgo: Chule masanga chu thi nan asuhmoa aumden jing thei loujeh-uva mi tampi thempua anapang ahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua chu tonsot'a uma ahijeha thempu ahina jong tonsot'a ding ahitai.
en_web: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
en_kjv: but this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichepa vang hi tonsot’a um jing jeng ahijeh-in themputna chu adang khat’a kichon thei ahipoi.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Aman khatveiya le tonsot geiya dinga Ama jal a Pathen kom hinnaiho thalhenga Pathen koma taopeh dinga Aman huhhing jou theina tha anei ahi.
en_web: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
en_kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi hing jing ahijeh-in ama jal’a Pathen henga hung lut jouse chu amaho thalhenga taopeh a, abonchauva ahuhhing chamkimsoh thei ahi.

tcz: Ama thempu chungnung ingaichat u ahina chu Ama athenga le nolna bei, chonsetnen behlou hel ahi. Ama chonsehoa kona chom uma ahin, chule van mun a jabolna sangtah mun changa ahi.
en_web: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
en_kjv: For such a high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh chun chutobang thempu chungnun, athen a theng lepthol bei, boh beh lou le chonsete lah a kona kikhenhel, van mun ho jouse sanga chungnung joa kitung doh chu eiho dinga kilom mong ahi.

tcz: Thempu chungnung dang tobang ahiloujeh a niseh a kilhaina thilto abol ngaitalou ahi. Amaho chun amasapen tah a amaho chonset jeh a chule aban'a midangho chonsetna jeh a kilhaina asemjiu ahi.
en_web: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
en_kjv: who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu dang ho banga aman niseh le amasaa ama chonset then sona ding chule miho chonset then sona dinga kilhaina gantha atolou akhoh poi, ajeh chu amatah kilhai na gantha dia akitodoh jeh chun khat veiyin asubulhittai.

tcz: Danthu chun thempu chung nungho alhendoh jiho chu mihem lhahsam jal a ahi. Hinla Danthu kipehdoh jou nunga chu Pathen in Achapa chu kihahsel puma alhendoh a, chule Achapa chu Tonsot themput chungnung chamkima asem ahitai.
en_web: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
en_kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
tcz_gospelgo: Danthun lhahsamna nei mihemte thempun anapansah jin, amavang Danthu nunga hung umdoh kihahselna tun vang tonsot’a dia chamkimsoh Chapa chu apansah tai.

tcz: Tun thu kiseilona jeh pen tah chu: Eihon jaumtah Laltouna muna toupa, Van mun'a Thempu chungnung jabolna changa, chu ineiyuve.
en_web: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
en_kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such a high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
tcz_gospelgo: Akisei thulu chang pen chu: eihon hitobang thempu chung nung hi ineiyun, ama chu Van’a Chungnung pen Lalatouna jet lam’a atouve,

tcz: Chuche muna Aman Van mun'a aman houbuh sunga lhachana atohna mun chu, Pathen houna mun dihtah Pakaiyin asahdoh ahin, mihem khut'a kisadoh ahipoi.
en_web: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
en_kjv: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
tcz_gospelgo: chukoma mihem tundoh hilouva Pakai tundoh ponbuh tahbeh, muntheng chungnung sunga achamtah a kin theng bol’a pang ahi.

tcz: Chule thempu chungnung ho chun thilpeh ho le maichama katdohna aneijiu ahijeh chun, iThempu Chungnungu jong chun maicham thilto ding aneitei ding ahi.
en_web: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
en_kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnung jouse thilto hinchoi ding le kilhaina gantha toh dinga kitung ahin, hiche Thempu chungnung jong hin todoh thil khat aneitei ding ahi.

tcz: Ama chu leichunga hi uma hileh Ama thempu jong hinom ponte, ajeh iham itileh Danin angaichat maicham thilto chu bol dinga thempu tampi um uva ahinai.
en_web: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
en_kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama hi leiset chunga um hile Thempu jong hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu Danthu dungjuiya Thempuho lah athilto hinchoi ding aumnauve.

tcz: Amaho chun vana Pathen hou atahbeh limso chu hiche thempu ho chun agongso umdan athou ahibouve. Ijeh ham itileh Mose chun Pathen houbuh asahgotpet chun, Pathen in hiche gihsalna hi ahinpei: “Molchunga agongso um dingdan kavetsah tobanga chu naboldohna dingin photchenna neiyin,” ati.
en_web: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
en_kjv: who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
tcz_gospelgo: Mose’n ponbuh ason ding kon’a akihilchahnaa, "Ajeh chu ven, molsang chunga nakivetsah lim dungjui banga ijakai nabol ding ahi, " ati banga chu leiset’a thempu ho hin van chunga thil um lim le ale thoa kintheng bol ‘u ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah tun Yeshua, IThempu Chungnungu hi thempu natoh lui sanga gamchenga chungnungjo tohding nei ahitah jeh hin, thutep phajohoa Pathen to kitepna phajo eiho dinga palai hiya ahi.
en_web: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
en_kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun vang Jesu chu kintheng bolna pha chungnung achangtai; ajeh chu hiche hi ama palainaa kisemdoh kitepna pha cheh le thutep pha jo chunga kiphutdoh ahi.

tcz: Kitepna masa chu akisuhmona umlou hileh, kitepna anina akhelding gon ngaitalou ding ahitai.
en_web: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
en_kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepna masa chu nolnabei hile ni lhinna pamun ding kihol khoh ponte.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in miho chu athemmo nau amu ahitah jeh in, hitihin aseiye: “Pakaiyin aseiye, Keiman Israel le Judah mite toh kitepna thah kasemna nikho hunglhung ding ahi.
en_web: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
en_kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Juda:
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pathenin miho chunga nolna amujeh-in aseiyin: "Ven, keiman Israel insung chung, Judah insung chunga Kitepna thah khat kasemdohna ding Nikho ho ahung lhunge’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.

tcz: Hiche kitepna hi apu-apateu keiman kakhut a amaho kapuiya, Egypt gam'a kona kahinpuidoh pet a tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Amaho chu keima to kitepna a tahsan um ahitapouvin, hijeh a chu kanung-ngat ahi” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en_web: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
en_kjv: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kitepna chu Apu apateu kakhuttah a katuh a Egypt gam’a kona kahin puidoh nikhoa Amaho to kasemdoh tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amaho kakitepnaa aum jing pouvin, Kenjong amaho kadonlou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.

tcz: “Hinlah Keiman hiche nikho chuleh kitepna thah Israel mitetoh kanei ding ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Keiman ka danthu alunggeluva kakoipeh ding, chule alungsunguva kajihlut peh ding ahi. Chule keima aPathenu kahi ding, chule Amaho kamite hiding ahiuve.”
en_web: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
en_kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
tcz_gospelgo: Nikho hijat nunga keiman Israel insung kakiteppiding Kitepna chu hiche hi ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye: Alunggil’uva Kadanthu ho peng ting, Hiche ho chu alungthim’uva kasut’a, Amaho dia a-Pathenu kahi ding, amaho kamite hidiu ahi.

tcz: Chule amahon aheng akomuva ho hihen, akinaipiu sopiho kom hijongleh, “Nanghon PAKAI nahet'u angaiye” tia nahilu ngaitalou ding ahi. Ajeh chu aneopen a pat alenpen geiyin keima eihet chensau hiding ahitai.
en_web: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
en_kjv: and they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile tolsung khat’a achenpi le Koi ahiya asopi jah a, ‘Pakai hen, tia Ahil lou diu ahitai. Ajeh chu aneopen’a alenpan geiya Abonchauva eihetsoh diu ahitai.

tcz: “Chule keiman agitlounahou kangaidam ding, chule achonsetnau keiman kageldohkit tah louhel ding ahitai.”
en_web: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
en_kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile asuh khel nauva jong kahepia, achonset nau jong kageldoh kit lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Pathen in kitepna “thah” thudol aseiteng, hichun amasa chu donlouva akoi ahitai. Hichu tua aphat kichaiya chule hungmangloi ding ahi kitia ahitai.
en_web: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
en_kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea ‘Athah’ kiti hin amasa chu aluisah tan, ipi hile luiya, tehse chu abei ding kon ahitai.

tcz: Hiche Pathen le Israelte kikah akitepna masa a chu leiset chunga Ama houna mun le Ama houna chondanho uma ahi.
en_web: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
en_kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
tcz_gospelgo: Kitepna masa jong chun kintheng bolna Danthu le leiset’a muntheng ananeiye.

tcz: Hiche houbuh chu dannia kihom khena ahi. Dan masa sunga chu thaomeikhom khat, dokhang khat, chule dokhang chunga chu changlhah theng pheng ni uma ahi. Hiche dan hi “Muntheng” kitia ahi.
en_web: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
en_kjv: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile houbuh akisondoh teng indan masapen’a chu thaomei khom le do khang chule Pathen um hetna changlhah to aumin, hilai chu "Muntheng" akiti.

tcz: Abanah pondal khat aumin, chule hiche pondal nung lama adan sung nung um chu “Muntheng” pena kitin ahi.
en_web: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
en_kjv: And after the second vail, the tabernacle which is called the holiest of all;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ban’a Houbuh pondal dan ni na chu "Muntheng chung nung" akitin,

tcz: Hiche dan sunga chun Sana maicham kihal namtui aumin chule thinga kisem thingkonglen Kitepna Thingkong chu aninglia sana jenga kitoma ahi. Thingkong sunga chun sana a kisem bel khat aumin, belsunga chun-Manna, Aaron Tenggol hungpah ado um chule Kitepna Songpheng teni jong aume.
en_web: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
en_kjv: which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
tcz_gospelgo: asunga chu gimnamtui halna sana maicham le kitepna thingkong-sana kitomkhum chu um ahin, kitepna thingkong sunga chu manna umna sana bel le Aaron tenggol pahmum chule kitepna songpheng ni chu um ahi.

tcz: Chule Kitepna Thingkong chunga chun Pathen loupina Cherub ni aumin, alhaving teni chun Kitepna kong chung, lhatdohna mun, chu atomkhum jengin. Hinla hitiho jouse hi tun achen achaiyin ihilchen joupouve.
en_web: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
en_kjv: and over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercy seat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
tcz_gospelgo: Achunga chu Cherubim loupitah ni uma, alhaving hoa chonset ngaidam kinbolna mun chu ale lhon ahin, hiti ho hi achen achaiya tua seijou ahipoi.

tcz: Hicheho jouse amun akigontup chun, thempuho chu indan masa pena chu aniseh a lut uva kilhaina natoh ho chu atoh jingu ahi.
en_web: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
en_kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin akisemin, hiche houbuh dan masa sunga chun lhacha kinbol molsoh dingin thempuho alut jing jiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Thempu chungnung bou chu Muntheng pena chu lutthei, chule kumkhat'a khatvei bou galut thei ahi. Ama chun ama le amiten hetlouva chonset abol dohhouva kilhaina a thisan chukoma akat ji ahi.
en_web: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
en_kjv: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
tcz_gospelgo: Asung nung dan nina avang chun kumkhat sungin thempu chungnung changseh khat vei bou, thisan choilou hilouva, amatah le mipin hettoh louva achonset na ho’u thenso dinga galutji ahi.

tcz: Hiche chonnaho Lhagao Thengin aphondoh chu ahileh Muntheng pen a luttheina chu Houbuh le chuchea kimanchahna dan ho manchah ahilai sung sen gahmohlut ahithei poi tihi ahi.
en_web: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
en_kjv: the Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao Thengin kichentah a asei chu ahile, Houbuh dan masa adin laisea muntheng’a lutna lampi chu kilangdoh lou ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi tuphat umdol vetsahna khat hiya ahi. Ijeh inem itileh thilpeh le kilhainaho thempuhon akatdoh u chun thilto ding hinchoi ho dingin selepha hetna alungthimu chu athensah joupoi.
en_web: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
en_kjv: which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi tulai phat sunga thilsoh ding tekahna ahin, thil to kilhaina gantha kichoijia kitoh ho hin kilhaina neiho het khenna lunghtim umdol bangin asuchamsoh theipoi.

en_kjv: and let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
tcz_gospelgo: Chule ngailutna le thilpha bolna lam’a khat le khat kisuh lip jing ding phate chan gel’u hite.

tcz: Chule eiho ikikhop khom dingu hi mi abang khattou anahsahmo umjongleh nahsahmo pouhite, hinla khat le khat tuhin, adehset in ahungna ding nikho anai ihet u ahitah jeh hin kitilkhou tou hite.
en_web: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
en_kjv: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kon khat’in akikhop nau donda achon nau banga bol louvin, Nikho chu ahung nai dol namu ahitan, hatahin kitilkhou to chehjo’u hite.

tcz: Ngaitahteho, eihon thutah hetna inei nunguvin henasan chonset bolleu hen, hiche chonsetna ho khukhumna ding longlhenna chu umkit talouva ahitai.
en_web: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
en_kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu thutah hetna kisan nung hin eihon chonset henasan boljom jing leu hen, chonset suh mangna ding kilhaina gantha kikhenlou ahitan,

tcz: Pathen thutanna kichat umtah chule alunghanna meikou deujeju chun namelmateho akahvam ding ahi.
en_web: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
en_kjv: but a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
tcz_gospelgo: doumah bol jouse bahgam hel ding le kavam hel ding tom ngaina meikong le thutanna ngah a kicha jinga um ding ahitauve.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Mose dan chu ajuinom lou auma ahileh khotona beihela hettohsah mi ni ahilouleh mi thum'a kona kithatjia ahi.
en_web: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
en_kjv: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Mose Danthu nahsah lou chu mi ni hihen thum hile hettohsah jeh a hepina beihel’a kithat ding ahi.

tcz: Geltemin Pathen Chapa akengtoa chotphaa koiya, eithensah uvah thisana kitepna chu ima hilou le aboh a gela jachatna a chuhsah, chule Pathen lungsetna ichunguva hin lhunsah Lhagao Theng pampaija koiho, chun ichangeiya khohse jo gimbolna amu dingu hitam!
en_web: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
en_kjv: of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahile Pathen Chapa keng chotpha nei, akisuh thengna Kitepna thisan suhboh a chule lungsetna Lhagao daithang ho chun itobang khohjo cheh talen amat diu kilom nasah um?

tcz: Ijehham itileh eihon hitia seidohpa chu iheuve, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman kalethuh teiding ahi.” Ama chun hitin jong aseiye, “Pakai chun amite thu atanding ahi.”
en_web: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
en_kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile: "Phulah chu kei kin ahi, Keiman lethut nange, " Chukit le: "Pakaiyin amite chung thu atan ding, " tipa chu koi ahi keihon kaheuve.

tcz: Hingjing Pathen khut tenia chu gimthohna tijat umtah ahi.
en_web: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
en_kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hing jing khut te nia chuh khah ding chu kichat umtah ahi.

tcz: Nanghon Christa thu nakijil pattil laiyu chu nung geldoh un. Gimbol hesohna khohsetah thohnaa jong tahsan umtah nahiu chu geldoh uvin.
en_web: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
en_kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
tcz_gospelgo: Masanga khovah nachan nung geiyuva jong hesoh genthei hahsa tah thoh a napan laiyu nikho ho geldoh-uvin.

tcz: Khatvei komle japi lah'ah aeng engin nakibol jiuvin chule nakivo jiuvin chule khatvei komle genthei nathoh khompi hou napanhu jiuvin ahi.
en_web: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
en_kjv: partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chun genthei thoh pum puma japi vetchah din naum’un, ahinla nang hon jong hitobang thoh ho chu nathoh piu ahiye.

tcz: Songkul sunga kikoiho toh genthei nathoh khomuvin, chule nanei jouseu nanghoa kona akilahdoh in jong kipana in nagel nalai uvin ahi. Nanghon nangho dinga aphajo kikoipeh a aitih a umjing ding nangau ahi naheuve.
en_web: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
en_kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile songkul lut ho geiya nathoh piuva, chule apha cheh le a-itih a um jing ding gou nanei nahet jeh-uvin naneiyu kichom jeng jong kipah tah-in nathoh jo’uve.

tcz: Hijeh hin hiche Pakaiya nakingainau na-ngaplhah u tahsanna hi paidoh hih un. Hichea hin tohman nasan dingu lentah aume.
en_web: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
en_kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hin kipaman lentah nasodoh peh jeh-uvin nakison nau chu paimang hih hel’uvin.

tcz: Tua nangaichat u hi thohhat tohthoa lungdehat ahin, hiti hin Pathen lunglam chu boljomun. Chuteng Aman nateppeh jouseu namu dingu ahi.
en_web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
en_kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh -inem itile Pathen lungdei bol’a thutep kisan na din thoh hat jing ding angaiye.

tcz: “Ijeh ham itileh hetmanlouva hung dingpa chu hungding chule geisang lou ding ahi.
en_web: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
en_kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu: "Chomcha khat jou teng Ahung ding pa chu hunga Geisang lou dig ahi;

tcz: Chule Ka michonphaho chu tahsan jal'a hing ding ahiuve. Hinla akihei manga aumkhah le kalung lhailou ding ahi.”
en_web: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
en_kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan jal’a kei dia midih changa chu hing ding, Anung chon vang achunga kahinkho kapeh lou ding ahi, " ati.

tcz: Hinlah eiho hi manthahna dinga kihei mangho ihipouve. Eiho tahsan umtah ho, alhagao huhhing'a umding ho ihiuve.
en_web: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
en_kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho vang manthahna dinga nung chon ho ihipouvin, tahsan jal’a hinkho hoidoh a um ho ihibouvui.

tcz: Tahsan kiti hi ikinepnau khat atahbeh a hung sohding ahi tia lunggila kisonna ahi; hichun imulouvu thil hoa lungmonna eipeuvin ahi.
en_web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
en_kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan hi kinepna atahbeh a lah a, muthei lou thil ahisa koi ding hi ahi.

tcz: Atahsan jal uvin malai mi hon min phatna akimu uvin ahi.
en_web: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
en_kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu tahsan jal’a upate chu hettohsah a kipansahji ahiuve.

tcz: Tahsan jal in vannoi pumpi hi Pathen thupeh a kisem ahi ti iheuvin, tua imu hou hi akimuthei thil hoa kona kisema ahipoi ti iheuve.
en_web: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
en_kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh a Pathen thusah a vannoi kisem le akilangdoh kha lou thil hoa kona muthei thil hung umdoh dol ihet’u ahi.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abel chun Cain sangin kilhaina thilto santhei aboldoh in ahi. Abel kilhaina thilto chun ama michonpha ahi ti atahlang in, chule Pathen in athilto chu asange ti akihen ahi. Abel chu athina asotlheh tah vang'in, aman vetjuithei atahsanna jal'a kon chun thu eiseipeh nalaiyun ahi.
en_web: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
en_kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh a Abel’in Cain sanga Pathen henga kilhaina gantha thilto phajo atojeh-in, amidih hi na hettohsahna amun, Pathen jengin jong athilto ho chu ahettohsah tan, chule athi nung geiyin thu asei thei nalaiye.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Enoch chun thina tohlouvin vana lahtouvin aumtai–“Ama akimutapoi, ajeh chu Pathen in alah ahitai.” Ijeh inem itileh ama lahtouva aum masang chun, Pathen sulunglhai mi ahi tin anakihen ahi.
en_web: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
en_kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Enoch chu thina mulouvin atahsa akheldoh peh-in, Pathenin atasan akheldoh peh jeh-in koiman aholdoh joutapoi; tahsa kheldoh a aum masanga Pathen koma lung lhaina kimu ahi hettohsahna aum’e.

tcz: Chule tahsanna pang louva Pathen suh lunglhai kiti hi thil hithei hoi ahipoi. Chule koi hileh Ama henga hungnom chan chun Pathen aumin chule lungdihpua Ama hol ho chu tohphatman apei, kiti hi atahsan ding ahi.
en_web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
en_kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun tahsan beiya Pathen lung tohoi ahipoi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen aum je le ama holte chengse tohphat man apeh dol hi ama kom nailutten atahsan tei diu dol ahi.

tcz: Tahsan jal in Noah chun twisanglet'a kona ama insung huhdohna dingin kong lentah asemin ahi. Aman tumasanga anasoh khalou thudol hoa chun Pathen in agihna chu sei angaiyin ahi. Atahsan jal'in Noah in vannoi mitin themmo achan'in chule aman tahsan jal'a chonphatna chu akisantan ahi.
en_web: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
en_kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Noah chun kho nung thilsoh ding muphah lou thua hilchahna thu angaiyin, ama le a-insung huhhingna din kong innei khat asem’e, hichea hin vannoi themmo achanin, tahsan’a them channa jal’in goulo chu achangtei.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abraham chu Pathen in a'in dalha dinga akouva chule gouva alodinga ateppehna gam'a che dinga akou chun thun ananung'e. Aman hoilama ache ding jong kihetlouvin anapotdoh jenge.
en_web: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
en_kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Abraham chu potdoh a goulo dia akisan ding mun’a lut din akikou chun thun anungin, hoilam jot ding ahet lou vangin apotdoh jenge.

tcz: Chule Pathen in ateppeh gam alhun jengin jong tahsan jal'in chua chun achengin ahi-ijeh ham itileh ama gampam mi bangin ponbuh in achengin ahi. Chule Isaac le Jacob thutep chang gel teni jong hitima chun aumlhon e.
en_web: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
en_kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in tepna gamsunga hung kholjin bangin apem len, tepna gam alopi ding Isaac le Jacob chutoh ponbuh sunga acheng leuve.

tcz: Abraham chun malam a kinepna neitah a tonsot'a abul kiphutdoh khopi, Pathen in agontoh le asahdoh khopi, chu avetjing ahi.
en_web: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
en_kjv: for he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Abrahamin Pathen gontoh le asah doh bul dettah chu akat jing’e.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Sarah jeng jong chu aching'ah ahia chule atehlheh tah vang chun cha aneitheiye. Amanu hin Pathen in akitepna asuhbulhit ding ahi ti atahsanin ahi.
en_web: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
en_kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in athuteppeh pa chu tahsan umtah ahidol ahetjehin acha nei phat akilet tah vangin Sarah-in naovopna thei tha aneitai.

tcz: Chuti chun nampumpi khat chu athisa tobang mikhat a kon mi atama tam, vana ahsi ho jat le twikhanglen panga neldijat, hung hidoh ahiuve, asimje jong umlou ahiuve.
en_web: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
en_kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun mithikonsa paa kon chun van’a ahsite jat le Twikhanglen kama neldi jat hel simsen lou chilhah apeng doh tai.

tcz: Hiche mite jouse hi Pathen in ateppeh u chu tahsanpumin athigam tauve. Amaho hi thutep chu achangpouvin, hinla gamla tah a konin agaldot'un chule alemuvin ahi. Amahon leiset chunga hi maljin le khopemle kahi ti anomuve.
en_web: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
en_kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chengse hi tahsan ahitauvin, thutep chengse chu akisan man louvu ahitai; ahinla gamla tah a konin amu’uvin alem’un, chule amaho chu leiset chunga kholjin le khopem ahiu aphongdoh tauve.

tcz: Ahimongin hitia sei hohin gamkhat, hichu amahoa ahimong nai tia kou ding, agaldot'u ahi.
en_web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
en_kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hitobang thusei ho hin pugam pagam ahol dol’u aphondoh u ahibouve.

tcz: Amahon ahung potdohnau gam chu nung ngaichatkit leu, ana kilekit thei mama ahiuve.
en_web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
en_kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho ahung kondoh nau gam chu geldoh kit hileu kilekitna ding phat gomkom jong anei diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah amaho hin mun phajo agaldot'u ahi, hichu van gam ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen chu a Pathen'u tia kikou ding jahchalou ahi, ijeh ham itileh amaho ding khopi khat asem ahi.
