en_web: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
en_kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
tcz_gospelgo: Tua la amahon aphajo cheh khat, van gam chu atup’u ahijeh-in, Pathen jeng jong amaho Pathen a kikou ding jahcha lou ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman amaho dinga khopi khat agonpeh ahitai.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abraham Pathen in apatep chun Isaac chu akatdoh jengin ahi. Pathen thutep ho changpa, Abraham, chun achapa changkhat “Isaac chu katdoh dingin kigosademin aumin ahi,
en_web: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
en_kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Abrahamin patep’a aum chun thutep changpa tahsan vangin achapa chang khatseh, Isaac chu kilhaina gantha banga todoh jeng din agoi.

tcz: Pathen in Isaac a kona nachilhah kisim ding ahi,” tia anaseipehsa ahijeng vang chun.
en_web: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
en_kjv: of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chule Isaac a kon ahi nachilhah kisim ding ahi, " tia kiseipeh ahin,

tcz: Abraham chun Isaac chu athitah jongleh Pathen in ahinsah kitthei ahi tin agelin ahi. Chuleh atahbeh in, Abraham chun achapa chu athia kona akilemu kit tobanga lahthei ahitai.
en_web: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
en_kjv: accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin athisa jong akaithou kit thei chu agel jon, tekah a seidin Isaac chu anung chankit nai.

tcz: Isaac in achateni, Jacob le Esau, khonunga phattheina ateppeh chu tahsan jal ahi.
en_web: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
en_kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Isaac chun kho nung teng phatthei chang din Jacob le Esau phatthei aboh-e.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Jacob chu ateh a chule athikonin, Joseph chateni chu phatthei aboh in chule atenggol chunga akingaiyin, akunin Pathen ahoutai.
en_web: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
en_kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Jacob-in athi ding konin Joseph chapate ni phatthei aboh gol’in, atenggol chunga aki-ngamin Pathen alhaiye.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Joseph chu athi konin, lung ngamtah in Israel mipite chun Egypt adalhah dingu thu aseiye. Aman amaho chun Egypt adalhah tengu jongleh agu-achangho chu apoh dinguvin thu apen ahi.
en_web: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
en_kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Joseph chun athi ding konin Egypt gama kona Israel chate potdoh ding ageldoh-in, ama gu le chang thudol’a thu apei.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose nulepa chun apen'in lha thum jen asel lhonin ahi. Pathen in cha lamdang tahkhat apeh lhon ahi chu ahelhon in, chuti chun lengpa thupeh thua nunlou ding jong chu akichalhon pon ahi.
en_web: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
en_kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in anu le apan Mose apen nungin lha thum asel lhonin, ama chu naosen mel-hoi tah ahidol amu lhonin, lengpa thu peh jong kicha louvin aum lhon’e.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose chu ahung kikhanlhit phat in, Pharaoh-chanu chapa kitiding anom tapon ahi.
en_web: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
en_kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh a Mose’n akhan lhit phat’a Pharoah chanu chapa kiti ding da ahi.

tcz: Ama chonset nopsahna a umsang chun Pathen mite kibol hesohna chu thohkhompi ding alheng jotan ahi.
en_web: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
en_kjv: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset’a chomkhat nopsah sangin Pathen mite to gim hesoh thoh khom ding akilhenjoi.

tcz: Aman Christa jal'a thoh hahsa thoh chu Egypt gouloding sanga chungnungjon agel'e, ijeh ham itileh ama chun kipaman lentah chan ding chu agaldot ahi.
en_web: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
en_kjv: esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Tohman san ding avetjoh jeh chun Egypt gama gou jou se sangin Messiah kihousetna chu thupijon agel’e.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose chun Lengpa lunghan ding jong chu akichapon Egypt gam adalha jengin ahi. Aman muthei loupa lam chu amit'a vejing ahijeh'in amason jom jingin ahi.
en_web: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
en_kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in lengpa lung han ding ging louvin Egypt gamadalhan, mit muthei loupa chu amu bangin abol’e.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mosen Israel mipite chu Kalchuh Kut mang jing dingin thupeh apen chule mithat vantil chun chapa peng masapen ho athalouna dingin thisan chu kotbul ah athekhumin ahi.
en_web: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
en_kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in kalchuh kut aphutdoh-in, cha peng masa sumang Vantil chun amahoa asuh khah louna din thisan chu athekhumsah-in ahi.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Israel chate chun Twipisan chu tolgolai lamjot bangin ajot galkaiyun ahi. Hinlah Egypt miten ajuigotna lamuvin abonchauvin twi lah'a alhalut gamtauve.
en_web: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
en_kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh-in Israel chaten Twikhanglen chu tolgo jot’in ajot galkaiyun, Egypt miten chutia bol agot’u le twiyin achup lih gamtauve.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Israel mite chun Jericho kulpi chu ni sagi avelun, chule kulpi bangho chu achim in ajal lhatai.
en_web: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
en_kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh a Israelten Jericho khopi ni sagi avel’u le, khopi pal achimtai.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in notinu Rahab chu ama chenna khopi mite Pathen sei ngailou ho tochun amantha tapoi. Ijeh ham itileh aman gamvelhi ho chu phatechan analamdot in ahi.
en_web: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
en_kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jeh a Rahab notinun gam ve-lhi ho lung monga alhunsah jeh chun thu ngailou ho to akisuh mang tha tapoi.

tcz: Ipi ijat kaseibe nahlai ding ham? Tahsan neiho–Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel, chule themgao ho jouse thudol velsei chu saoval ding ahi.
en_web: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
en_kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi kaseibe ding ham? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel chule themgao ho chengse thudol seisoh kei ding phat’in toh ponte.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in amaho hin lenggam ho alehkhup uvin, thudih in vai ahomun, chule Pathen in ateppeh houchu achangtauve. Keipiho kam asippeh uvin,
en_web: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
en_kjv: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan na jel’in lenggam tampi ajouvun, adih aphutdet’un, thutep akisan’un, Phaisameigeo kam asingun,

tcz: meikou achendaiyun, chemjam hema konin thinaa asohchauve. Athalhomnau chu thahatna asohdoh in ahi. Amaho galsatna a ahat un chule sepai jouse chu gal asatsah uve.
en_web: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
en_kjv: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
tcz_gospelgo: meikou laipi aphel mit’uvin, chemjem hem’a konin ahoidoh un, lhahsam na konin ahatdoh-uvin, galmun’a hatah ahiuvin, gamdang sepaite adeljam tauve.

tcz: Numei hon jong angailut hou chu athinauva konin ahingin akimu kit un ahi. Hinlah midang phabep chu gimbol hesoh athoh un, chamlhat ding deina a Pathen nungat anomdeh pouve. Amahon thokitna ahunglhun jouva hinkho phajo chu akineppiu ahi.
en_web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
en_kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
tcz_gospelgo: Numei hon amithi sa ho’u thoudoh kit akisan’uvin adang ho jong thokitna phajo cheh aneina diuvin huhdoh a aum diu anom pouvin, hesoh genthei thoh-in aumjotaove.

tcz: Mi phabep chu nuisat achangun, chule atungtunu chu jepna mahaho jeh in atan chetchut'e. Adangho chu songkul sunga thihkhaova hen ahiuve.
en_web: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
en_kjv: and others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
tcz_gospelgo: Abang bang jong elbol le jepna thoh, bulput le songkul lut’in aum’uve.

tcz: Phabep chu songa aseplih un, phabepma thing atna ah akehso un, chule mi phabep chu chemjam a athat un ahi. Phabep jen chu kelngoivun le kelchavun kiahpumin, lhasam le engsetah in abol'un, chule abolseuvin ahi.
en_web: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
en_kjv: they were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu songin asep’un, thing-at’in a-attan’un, chemjamin athat’uvin, kelngoivun le kelcha vun kisil’in avah leuvin, vaichat le bolset thoh, genthei hesoh bolset’in aum’uve;

tcz: Amaho hiche vannoi ding hin apha behseh un ahi, gamthipho le molchunga avahvei leuvin, leikole songko hoa akiseluvin ahi.
en_web: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
en_kjv: (of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: vannoi leiset hi amaho umna hoi ahitapon, gamthip lai le mol le lhanga avah leuvin, songko dung le leiko dunga akisel’ui.

tcz: Amaho jouse hin atahsan jal uvin minphatna akilodoh tauve, ahijeng vang'in amaho khatbeh in jong Pathen in athuteppeh jouseu chu achangdeh pouve.
en_web: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
en_kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi hijat chu tahsan na jeha hettohsah a apan vangun thutep ga chu alopha pouve;

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in eiho dinga thilphajo akheh ahin, hitia chu eiho louva amaho chamkimna changlou ding ahiuve.
en_web: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
en_kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
tcz_gospelgo: eiho beiya achamkimsoh thei louna diuva Pathenin ibonchauva dinga thilphajo cheh khat amu masah ahi.

tcz: Hijehchun, tahsan hinkhoa jong hettohsah mihonpi nasatah in eiumkimvelu ahin, ichunguva kaijing ipohgih u eihatmosah u, adehset'a einohphahsah uva chonset hi pailhau hite. Chule thohhattah in Pathen in imasanguva akoi kilhaitetna a hin lhaiyuhite.
en_web: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
en_kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
tcz_gospelgo: Hettohsahna hijat pin meilhang banga eiumkimvel jehuvin einoh phahsah jouseu le ichunguva kaijing chonsetna hi pailhan, thoh hat tah-in imasanguva kilhai tetna lama hin lhaiyu hite.

tcz: Eihon hiche hi, itahsanu akipatna le achamkim sahpa, Yeshua, lam jeng vea ibol'u ahi. Aman kipana amuding jeh chun, thingpel gimna chu anathoh in, jumna le mai mohna ijaseplouvin aumin ahi. Tun, Ama Pathen laltouna muna jabolna a atoutan ahi.
en_web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
en_kjv: looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Tahsan bulpi le kikhomna Jesu lam kat jingute; aman amasanga koisa um kipana jeh chun jum le jachatna nahsah louvin thingpel’a thina geiyin athoh-in Pathen laltouna jet lam’a atoutai.

tcz: Michonse hoa kona adoudalnau natoh jouse thoh lhumkei pachu geldoh un, chutile nangma thachola naum louding chule moh ngahnomna naneilou ding ahi.
en_web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
en_kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahinkhouva nalhah dah-uva nalel louna diuvin, chonseten amadouna a thuse chujatpi aseiyu dou lhumkeipa chu geldoh jingun.

tcz: Among'in, nangho chonset douna a napan nauvah hinkho katdoh chan geiyin nathoh gimpouve.
en_web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
en_kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset louna lam’a nang ho thisan long leuvin napang hih laiyuve.

tcz: Achate hina jal'a Pathen in nahenguva tilkhounaa athusei chu nasuhmilu hitam? Aman hitin ati, “Ka chapa Pakai thununna chu imalouvin gelhihbeh in, Aman nasuhdih tengleh lunglhahnan neihih in.
en_web: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
en_kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
tcz_gospelgo: Tilkhouna dinga nang ho chapate dol’a nakisei nau chu nasuhmil’u ahitai: "Kachapa, Pakaiyin nabolgimna chu isah louvin geldan, Aman naphosal teng jongle lung lhadeh hih-in;

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pakaiyin angailut chu athunun ahi, chule Acha hina a alah chan chu agimbolji ahi.”
en_web: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
en_kjv: for whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin angailut chu abolgim’a, Chapa dia akisansa chu ajepji ahibouve, " kiti chu.

tcz: Nanghon hiche Pathena kona thununna chu nasan uva ahileh Pathen in achate tahbeh hina a nabolu ahi. Koiham apan athununlou chapa najah khah um?
en_web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
en_kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
tcz_gospelgo: Bolgimna chu thoh tun tun’un, Pathenin chapate banga nasungse nau ahibouve; Pan chapa koipen gahchah louva akoiyem?

tcz: Pathen in achate jouse abolna banga nathunun louva ahileh nangho jaocha nahiu chule chatahbeh hilou nahiuve.
en_web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
en_kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate louvin um leu chun chapa tahbeh hilouva bolamcha nahi diu ahi.

tcz: Eihon leiset a ipateu eithunun hou chu ijaboluva ahileh, chusanga chu ilhagaohou le tonsot'a umjing iPau thua chu nungcheh lou ding ihiuvem?
en_web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
en_kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche kalval’in jong tahsaphea eigah chah diuvin pate ineiyun amaho chu ijabol lheh-ui; achutile Lhagao ho thudol’a Pa koma chu ihinna diuva i-halut cheh joh lou diu ham?

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh leiset a ipateuvin eithununnau hi kum phabep sunga dinga abolthei chan gei uva dinga aboljiu ahi. Hinla Pathen in eithunun nauhi eihon Ama thennaa chu chanpha ineikhom theina dingu ahiye.
en_web: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
en_kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chun aphasah lam lam’uva ni chom khat kahseh a dinga bou eigah chah jiu ahin, Pathenin vang eiho phatna ding, ama thenna ichan theina diuva eithoh gimsah jiu ahibouve.

tcz: Thununna hi apet a anom khatcha aumpoi–thoh hahsa ahi! Hinla hitia kichuhna neisaho dinga chu cham-lungmonna hinkhoa hinna aneithei dingu ahi.
en_web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
en_kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
tcz_gospelgo: Gahchah na hi apet tah le lung nopna ahipoi, lhaset nan akigel bouve; ahinla kho nung teng le hita bolgimna thoh ho ding hin them channa din cham nan ahung gadoh jin ahi.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun thacholsa nakhut'u chun tuhchah phakit henlang chule khup ngoisa ho chu thahatsah kit'un.
en_web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
en_kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun khut ngoi hon domsangun lang, khup ngoi ho jong ding janguvin;

tcz: Nakengphang teniuva ding uvin lampi jangkeiyin jot'un chutileh thalhom le elbaihon kiseplhu louva, thanei tah a lam ajotdiu ahitai.
en_web: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
en_kjv: and make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
tcz_gospelgo: Kengbaiya chu chatmoa um louva, adamjohna dingin nalampiu kisem jenguvin.

tcz: Amitakip to kitohdel a hinding gelkhoh un, chule hinkho thenga hing dingin kiseh un, thenna hinkho manglou hon Pakai chu amulou dingu ahi.
en_web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
en_kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi jouse to kichamna ding le thenna ding hadel’un, hiche tilouva chu koiman Pakai amu louhel ding ahi.

tcz: Pathen milungsetna changlel a naum louna dinguvin nangho khat le khat kivephauvin. Kihongphauvin koiman thinathei lunggitlou kengpumin nahinkho man suhboi dauhen, mitampi suhboh thei ahi.
en_web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
en_kjv: looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
tcz_gospelgo: Koima Pathen lungsetna changlel aum louna ding le thingkha jung dondoh a tamtah asuhmo banga nasuhboh louna dingin ching theiyun.

tcz: Chingtheiyun koima Esau tobanga chonlambei ahilouleh Pathen ngaisahlouna neiya cha masapen hina chanvou chu an khoukhat neh a kijoh doh umkhauvin nate.
en_web: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
en_kjv: lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
tcz_gospelgo: An neh khat man dinga a-upat kijoh Esau banga alop’a le chonthanghoi bol naum louna diu vin ching theiyuvin.

tcz: Aman khonungin apa phatthei bohna chu achannom vang'in kisihna dinga vaigei behseh ahitah jeh in kisih a kappuma ahol vang'in akiphalpeh tapoi.
en_web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
en_kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile kho nunga goulo tei ding adei chat vanga lunghei kitna ding mun anei tah lou jeh-in mit lhi puma ahol vangin vangbohna akipeh lou naheuve.

tcz: Nangho Israel ten Sinai mol a amuu meikou, muthim lhangkhal kiheh, chimpei aumna mun, molchung mun tobanga chu hunga nahi pouve.
en_web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
en_kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang ho toh khah thei molvum, meisi pah lah lah lai, muthim lai, thimpi lah, chule khopihui lah a hungvah lut nahipouvin,

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh amaho chun sumkon kimut ginglenglung chu ajauvin chule tijat umtah awgin chu ajah uva konin Pathen in ajah uva thu aseitahlou dingin ataovun ahi.
en_web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
en_kjv: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
tcz_gospelgo: sumkon gin le thu kisei gin ki thong lah jong ahipoi; hiche japha ho chun ajah-uva thu chu akisei kit louna din ataojo tauve.

tcz: Mihonpi chun Pathen Thupeh, “Ganchan mol chu atohkhah jongleh songa selih ding ahi,” kiti chu kidang asauvin anunglhuh ui.
en_web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
en_kjv: (for they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu, "Molvum dung chu gancha ho jeng jong atongkha chan songa selih ding ahi, " tia thu kisei chu athoh jouhel’u ahi.

tcz: Mose amatah jengin jong amittaha amuchun atijavalin aseitai, “Keima kati ajan chule kakithing thing e,” ati.
en_web: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
en_kjv: and so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake;)
tcz_gospelgo: Chule hiche thil hung kilah chu kichat um behseh jeng ahin, Mose’n jong aseiyin, "Keima kakichan kakihot hot jenge, " ati.

tcz: Ahin, nangho Zion Mol, hingjing Pathen khopi, Van Jerusalem, chule asangsang simsenlou vantil ho kikhopna mun chu lhunga nahi tauve.
en_web: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
en_kjv: but ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho vang Zion molvum, Pathen hing jing khopi, Van Jerusalem, Vantil asang sang lah hung lhunga, kipah thanom

tcz: Nangho Pathen cha apeng masa, van'a aminu kisun ho lah a chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho Pathen ijakai chunga thutanpa henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho tua chamkima kisem chondih ho lhagao umna van gam'a chu hunga nahi tauve.
en_web: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
en_kjv: to the general assembly, and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
tcz_gospelgo: le van’a kisun lutsah apeng masa chengse kikhopna, mi jouse thutan Pathen kom, them changsa ho Lhagao suh chamkimna mun,

tcz: Nangho Pathen le miho kikah a palaiya pangpa Yeshua henga chu hunga nahi tauvin, chule thisan kithekhum muna chu hunga nahi tauve, hichu Abel thisan tobanga phuba lahna dinga ka-na awgin chu hilouvin, ngaidamna thu asei ahitai.
en_web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
en_kjv: and to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu palainaa kisemdoh Kitepna Thah a chu hung nahitauvin, hiche thisan kitheikhum na chun Abel thisan sangin thilpha jo cheh sei ding aneiye.

tcz: Najah uva thuseipa thu chu ngailouva naum louna dinguvin kichih theiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Israel mipiten bon Mose, leiset'a athupole palaipa, sei angailou jeh uva asochatlou uva ahileh, eihon vana kona thuseipa thu chu ingailou uleh ihoidoh louhel dingu ahi.
en_web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
en_kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh: for if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
tcz_gospelgo: Ching theiyun thuseipa chu jopda khauvin nate; ajeh chu leiset’a thuseipa thujop louho bon ahoidoh jou lou le, van’a kona thuseipaa konin kiheimang leu hen ihoidoh louhel diu akichen jenge.

tcz: Pathen in Sinai Mola kona thu asei chun a awgin chun leiset ahotlingin, hinla tun thutep chom dang khat eineiyuve, “Keiman leiset jengseh kaholing ding ahipon, vanho jong kaholing ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
en_kjv: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea ogin chun leiset seh bou aholingsoh ahin, tun aman athu tep’in aseiye, "Keiman leiset keoseh hilouva Van geiya khatvei seh akaho ling ding ahi, " ati.

tcz: Hiche hin thilsem jouse kihotlingsoh a chule kichondoh ding ahi ti avetsah e, hitia chu akiling theilou ho bou umden ding ahi.
en_web: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
en_kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
tcz_gospelgo: Hikoma, "Khatvei seh, " kiti hin thilsem jouse kiholingsah a kitolmang ding kichentah-in aseiyin, hitia chu suh ling theilou chengse umden ding ahi.

tcz: Eihon Lenggam khat akiling louhel ichan diu ahijeh'in, kichatna thenga Ama houna le ginna neipum in thangvah'u hitin chule Pathen lunglhaina peu hite.
en_web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
en_kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun suh longhoi hilou Lenggam ikisan jeh-un thangvahna neiyu hitin, ginna le jabolna pumin alungdei lamtah-in Pathen lhachan pangu hite.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh IPathenu chu mivallhum meikong ahi.
en_web: for our God is a consuming fire.
en_kjv: for our God is a consuming fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile i-Pathennu chu mi kavamhel thei meikou tobang ahi.

tcz: Sopi hina a khat le khat kingailut tona neijom jingun.
en_web: Let brotherly love continue.
en_kjv: Let brotherly love continue.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisopi ngailutna um jing hen.

tcz: Nanghon kholjin hungho chu phatbol ding sumil hih un, ijeh ham itileh hitia bol a vantil ho hetlouva lhunsah khah aumun ahi!
en_web: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
en_kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
tcz_gospelgo: Maljin lhunsah ding hailou jen’un, hitobang hoa hin abangin jong Vantilte geiyin alhunsah tauve.

tcz: Songkul'a nangho tah aumsa bangin kigelun lang, songkul'a umho chu geldoh un. Nanghon natahsauva gimbol natna amahon athoh u nangho tah in nathoh sau ahi tobang'in, alamlouva kibolho jong chu geldoh un.
en_web: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
en_kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohchang kihen ho chu toh kihentha bangin kigel’in lang, tahsaphea um jing nahi heuvin lang genthei hesoh thoh te chu geldoh jinguvin.

tcz: Imalam jousea kichenhi jabolun, chule kichenna a kitahna hi khat'in khatchunga neiyun. Pathen in chonthanghoi bol ho le jonbol ho thu atanding ahi.
en_web: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
en_kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
tcz_gospelgo: Kichen hi mi jousen jabol cheh hen, jalkhun jong kisuhboh da hen; jonthanhoi bol le mijito jonga chu Pathenin athu atan ding ahi.

tcz: Sum ngailu hih un; nanei chung'ah lungkimna neiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in aseisa ahitai, “Keiman nangma kalha louhel ding nahi. Keiman nangma kachanglha lou hel ding nahi,” ati.
en_web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
en_kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Sum ngailut hinkhon kimang hih-un, nanei chengsen lung lhai jo’uvin; ajeh chu aman, "Keiman kadonda louhel ding, dajong kada lhah louhel ding nahi, " ati.

tcz: Hijeh a chu eihon lungngam tah a, “Pakaiyin eikithopin, hijeh a keima kichalou ding kahi. Miho bep'in ka chunga ipi abol diu ham?” tia isei theiyu ahi.
en_web: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
en_kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu eihon kisongtah a isei theiyu chu: "Eipanpia chu Pakai ahin kicha ponge, Mihemin i-eilo ding ham?" ti hi ahi.

tcz: Na lamkaiyu Pathen Thu nahil hou chu geldoh un. Ahinkhouva thilpha ahinsodoh hou chu gelun, chule atahsanu vettonthei chu juiyun.
en_web: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
en_kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalamkaiteu nakom’uva Pathen Thu naseipeh teu chu geldoh-un lang, anun akhan’u phatah-in geldoh-uvin, atahsan’u chu tho’uvin.

tcz: Yeshua Christa hi janhi, tuni chule a-i-tih a ahina abang ahijinge.
en_web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
en_kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa chu janhi tuni chule tonsot’in abang ahijinge.

tcz: Hijeh chun thuhil lamdang le gotchom'ah lunglut hih helun. Na thahatnau hi Pathen lungsetnaa hungkon ahibouvin, anneh thudola chonna hoa kon ahipoi, hiche thua kisalunggim hon ima phatchomna aneipouve.
en_web: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
en_kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Thuhil gotchom chom kilhoh mangsah loujen’un, lung hi lungsetna aphudet aphan, neh le chah a phu ding ahipoi, hiti neh le chah thua chonte chun phat chom nan aneideh pouve.

tcz: Eihon maicham khat, thempuhon Houbuh sunga nehtheina thaneina aneilouvu, ineiyun ahi.
en_web: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
en_kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbuh a lhacha kintheng bol hon aneh thei lou nau maicham aneiyui.

tcz: Chonna lui dungjuiya thempu chungnung chun gancha thisan chu Munthenga chonset maicham thiltoa ahin choilut ahin, chule gancha ho tahsa pumho chu khopi pamlama ahalvam jiu ahi.
en_web: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
en_kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burnt without the camp.
tcz_gospelgo: Thempu chungnung hon chonset thensona ding gancha ho thisan chu muntheng chungnunga ahin choilut jiuvin, atahsapum ho vang chu polama agouvamji tauve.

tcz: Hitobangma a jong chu Yeshua chun khopi kotpi polama chu gim athoh a chule thia athisan'a amite athensah ahi.
en_web: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
en_kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun ama thisan’a mipi suh thengna dingin Jesun khopi kelkot polam’a thina athoh tai.

tcz: Hiti chun eiho Ama henga kulpi pam lama chun gachedoh uhitin, chule Aman jachatna apoh chu gapoh hu-ute.
en_web: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
en_kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh-in ngahmun polam, ama henga potdoh-u hitin, ahouset nau chu gathoh hu hite.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh hiche vannoiya hi indet aumden ding ineipouve; eihon ahunglhung ding in inga nahlaiyu ahi.
en_web: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
en_kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hikoma hin eihon khopi det inei pouve, ahung lhung ding khopi joh chu i-hol’u ahibouve.

tcz: Hichejeh chun Yeshua vanga Pathen vahchoi jingna eihon Amina ikitahnau phondohna kilhaina neijom jingu hite.
en_web: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
en_kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Jesu jal’in vahchoina ho chu Pathen henga kilhaina bangin bol jingu hite, hiche hi ama min phongdoh ho kamsungsoh aga ahi.

tcz: Chule thilpha bol le ngaichatna neiho to chan neikhom ding sumil hih un. Hitobang kilhaina ho hi Pathen lunglhaina ahi.
en_web: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
en_kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Kikhoto them’a chule ima kikop del chu hai hih-un, hitobang hi Pathen lung lhaiselna kilhai na ahi.

tcz: Lhagaova nalamkai hou thun nungun, chule ipi aseiyu bol un. Amaho hi nalhagaovu honbitna a natong ahiuvin, chule amaho Pathena mopoa ahiuve. Amaho chun kipahtah a aboltheina dingu le lunghimo puma bol louna dinguvin, ajeh phatah in peuvin. Hichu nangho dinga phatchomna hilou hel ding ahi.
en_web: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
en_kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalmakaiteu thun nungun lang athu ngaiyun, nang ho ding thua mopo ahijeh-un, nahinkhou avettup jing jengu ahi; hiti hin bol leu chun kipah diu ahin, achuti loule lungna diu, nang ho dia phachom lou ding ahi.

tcz: Keiho dingin taovun, ijeh ham itileh selepha hetna kaneiyu hi akicheh in chule kabolnalam jouseuvah jana neitah in hinkho kaman nomuvin ahi.
en_web: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
en_kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho neitaokop jingun, ima lam jousea hoikom hijongle adih kabol nom jeh-un hetkhanna lungthim phatah neiya kigingcha kahiuve.

tcz: Chule adeh'a keima nangho kom agangthei pena kahungtheina dingin taovun.
en_web: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
en_kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho henga dia eikilhadoh vahna dinga neitaopehna diuva atumbeh a kahin ngeh nahiuve.

tcz: Tun cham-lungmon kona Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua, kelngoiho Achingpipa, thina a kona kaithoupa, athisan a tonsot kitepna namdet nom pa chun–
en_web: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
en_kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
tcz_gospelgo: Chamna Pathen, tonsot kinepna thisan jal’a kelngoite ching minthang i-Pakaiyu Jesu thinaa kona hinpuidoh kit pan

tcz: Nangaichatnau jousea alunggot bolna dingin nabulhinsah uhen. Ama chun Yeshua Christa thuneina jal in, nachung uva thilpha lamjousea Ama lunglhaina dingin sodoh hen. Loupina jouse tonsot atonsot in Amaa hijinghen! Amen.
en_web: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: alungdei lam bol dingin thilpha jousen navon kimsoh-u hen; Jesu Christa jal’in amasanga alung lhaina bol din ichunguva bol hen, Christa chu tonsot tonsot geiyin loupi jing hen: Amen.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte kangeh nahiuve, hiche tilkhouna chomcha kajih hi gelkhoh uvin.
en_web: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
en_kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, kitilkhouna thu hi angaije them dia ka-ngeh nahiuve, ajehchu keiman paltan’a nahenguva kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Keiman nahet dingu kadei chu isopiu Timothy chu songkul'a konin ahinlha doh tauve. Ama hikoma ahungvah a ahileh nanghoto kimuto dinga kahin lhonpi ding ahi.
en_web: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
en_kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
tcz_gospelgo: Isopiu Timothy alhadoh-u anaheuvin, ahungvah le nang ho vea kahung teng hinpui nange.

tcz: Chuche mun a nalamkaihou le tahsannei ho jouse analemun. Italy a tahsan neihon lemna nahin thot ui.
en_web: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
en_kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalamkaite jousen le mithengte chengse salam’un; Italy gam miten nasalam’ui.

tcz: Pathen milungsetna chu nabonchauva chunga umhen. Amen.
en_web: Grace be with you all. Amen.
en_kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen. ¶ Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungset nan nabonchauvin umpi hen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa soh, Jacob a kon ahi. keiman Judah mi atahsan ho Israel phungsom le ni gamtina kithecheh ho henga dinga kajih ahi. Chibai!
en_web: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
en_kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa soh Jacob-in gamtin’a kithecheh phung som le phung ni henga salam.

tcz: Sopi deitahteho, nangho hahsatna hon nahinphah tenguleh, hichu hachangpa kipana dinga chanpha changin kingaitouvin.
en_web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
en_kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, patepna tin chenga nachuh tengule kipanan geljo’uvin;

tcz: Ajehchu natahsanu chu akipatep tengleh, natahsan chu khanglen ding ahi ti naheuve.
en_web: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
en_kjv: knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu natahsan’uvin amolso tengle thoh hat asosah chu naheuve.

tcz: Hijehchun khansah un, ajeh chu nathoh hatnau chu ahung khan'a abulhin tengleh nangho nabulhinuva chule nachamkim uva, imacha kiphahsamna neilou nahi dingu ahi.
en_web: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
en_kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
tcz_gospelgo: Ima lhahsamna beihel’a apumpia nachamkimsoh theina diuvin, thoh hatna natoh chun tong molso hen.

tcz: Nanghon chihna na-ngaichat uva ahileh, hongphaltah IPathen'u koma chun thum'un, chutileh Aman napeh dingu ahi. Nathum jeh uva chu Aman nahouset louhel dingu ahi.
en_web: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
en_kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva chihnaa lhasam aum le it louhel le house louva peji Pathen henga thum hen, chutile kipe ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah Ama koma nathum tenguleh Pathen bou natahsan chu kicheh hen. Lunglinglau hih un, ajeh chu atahsan detlou mi chu twikhanglen kinong le detna neilou huimut lon le tobang hiding ahi.
en_web: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
en_kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering: for he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang athum’an lung opkaina beihel’in tahsanna jal’in bou thum hen, lung opkaina nei vang chu Twikhanglen twi hui mut lonle tobang ahibouve.

tcz: Hitobang mi chun Pakaiya kona imacha muding kinepna neihih hen.
en_web: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
en_kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang mihem chun Pakaiya kona ima mu ding kiholda hen,

tcz: Amaho kiphaldohna chu Pathen le vannoiya kihom khen'ah ahiuvin, chule abol jouseu chu detna neilou ahiuve.
en_web: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
en_kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
tcz_gospelgo: lungtho nei pasal, akiheina lam jousea lung det lou ahi.

tcz: Tahsan cha avaicha hon kisonna ding khat chu aneiyuve, ajeh chu Pathen in amaho ajabol ahitai.
en_web: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
en_kjv: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
tcz_gospelgo: Sopi lhachomin choi-at’a aum chu kithang-atpi hen.

tcz: Chule mihao ho chu Pathen in asuhnemu chu kithang-atnan neijou hen. Amaho chu loujaova pahcha neocha tobanga mola ahitauve.
en_web: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
en_kjv: but the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihaovin jong suhnem’a aum kithang-atpi hen, ajeh chu hao hi hampa banga pulloi ding ahi.

tcz: Nisa sat chu ahungsa cheh cheh in hampa chu asang gop in: Pahcha neocha chu apul in chule ahoina jong amollha jitai. Hitobang a chu, mihaoho jong athilbol doh jouseu toh mollha jeng diu ahiuve.
en_web: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
en_kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nisa hamvevua ahung sat teng hampa agop jin, pahcha ho apul’in, apahhoi jong amoljitai; hitobanga chu mihao chu akiheina lam jousea molmangji ahitai.

tcz: Patepna le lhepna a thoh hattah'a pang ho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh ding ahi: Chujoutah chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho athutep hinna lallukhuh chu amahon asan dingu ahi.
en_web: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
en_kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhepna thoh ham hampa chu anun nom’e; ijeh-inem itile aman athot doh tengle Pathenin ama ngailute peh dinga athutepsa hinna dinga lallukhuh chu akisan ding ahi.

tcz: Chule nanghon lhepna nato tenguleh geldoh un, “Pathen in eilhep patep ahi” tin hinsei hih beh un. Pathen chu thil dihlou bol dingin akilhem patep khapoi chule Ama chun koima alhem khapoi.
en_web: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
en_kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhepna toh khapan, "Pathen in eilhem pate’e, " ti da hen; ajeh chu Pathen hi thilsen alhemjou pon, aman jong koima alhem patep poi.

tcz: Lhep patepna hi eima ho lung ngaichatna a hung kipanjia hichun eidoha boljiuva chule eipui mang jiu ahi.
en_web: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
en_kjv: but every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi ama ama lunggul chun ajol lhah a akaimang jia lhep patep’a umji ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche lung ngaichatna ho hin chonset natoh ahin sodohji ahi. Chule chonset chu akhangtou dia akiphal teng leh, hichun thina ahin sohdoh ji ahi.
en_web: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
en_kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lung gul phalou chu naovop banga avop’a, chonset ahindoh a, chonset chu apilhin tengle thina asohdohji ahi.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopite, puimang theiyin umhih'un.
en_web: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
en_kjv: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopi deitahte, dohan lha hih-un.

tcz: Ipi hileh apha le achamkim chu I-Pau Pathena hungkon ahi, Ama chun van hoa vah jouse asem ahi. Ama akichonle theile banga kikhel jing ahipoi.
en_web: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
en_kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilpeh pha chengse le thil-hoi chamkim josue chu chunga kon ahin, khovah Pa Pathena hung kumlha ahi, ama chu kikhel lou, ale jeng jong kihei mang lou ahi.

tcz: Ama chun eiho dinga Athutah chu eipeh tah jeh uva pengthah dia eilhendoh u ahi. Chule eiho hi athilsem jouse lah a agou manlu tah chu ihung hiu ahitai.
en_web: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
en_kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
tcz_gospelgo: Athilsem chengse lah a aga masapen ihi theina diuva aman adei banga thutah a eihin’u ahitai.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, hiche hi heuvin, nangho thungaina lama gang uvin lang, thuseiyin kino hih un.
en_web: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
en_kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi heuvin sopi deitahte. Mitin thu ngaiyin jangkhai cheh hen, thuseiyin ngai kham cheh hen, lungsat’in jong ngai kham cheh hen.

tcz: Mihem lung hanna hin Pathen ngaichat chonphatna ahin lhutpoi.
en_web: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
en_kjv: for the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mihem lunghan hin Pathen din adih atong doh poi.

tcz: Hijeh chun, anen anamse chule na hinkhouva aphalou jouse chu paidoh un, chule Pathen in nalunguva akhum Thu chu kisanun, ajeh chu hichun na lhagaovu ahuhhing thei ahi.
en_web: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
en_kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun thilboh jouse le git louna ho letset thil ho pai lhauvin, nahinkhou huhhung thei lung sunga kiphut lutsa thu chu lung nemin kisanjou’vin.

tcz: Pathen Thu chu moh ngaitho hih un. Pathen Thun asei chu bolteiyun. Achuti louva ahileh nang le nang ki-ngolbol nahi ding ahitai.
en_web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
en_kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama le ama kilhem lhaa, thu chu moh ngai mai mai hilouvin atongjoh hiuvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman Thu chu nangaiya chule najui louva ahileh, phatvet a namai vea tobang nahi ding ahi.
en_web: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
en_kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile thu chu ngaiya abol’a hilouv mi chu phatvet’a ahinkho umdol kivet mai mai tobang ahin,

tcz: Nangma le nangma nakivet jouva nache mang tengleh, itobang lim pua nahi nasumil jitai.
en_web: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
en_kjv: for he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
tcz_gospelgo: ama le ama akiven, ache mangjin, apettah chun itobang ahi asumiljitai.

tcz: Hinlah nangman nachamlhat sahthei achamkim kei dan chu chingthei tah'a navet a, chule hichun ipi asei nasuh mil louva najui leh, Pathen in hichu nabol jeh a phatthei naboh ding ahi.
en_web: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
en_kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang chamkimsohna Danthu chamlhatsah thei chu vechenkeiya hichu bol jinga, aja mai hilouva, sumil lou hel’a natoh a podoh jing jeng, hitobang mi chu athilbolnaa nun nom ding ahi.

tcz: Nangma hou ngaisah a nakigel a ahia nakam nathunun louva ahileh, nangma tah kingol bol nahin, na Pathen hou chu pannabei hiya ahi.
en_web: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
en_kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi khattou hougut’a kigel’a, aleituh tang lou, alungthim kilhep lhah a chu ahougut jong chu moh ahi.

tcz: Pa Pathen mitmua hou thengsel le adihtah chu–meithai ho chule nuneilou le pa neilou ho alunglhah nauva gakhotoa chule vannoiyin suhboh ding jahnom lou hiya ahi.
en_web: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
en_kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Chagate le meithaiho agenthei hesoh nau vil’a, vannoi leiset’a kona boh beh louhel’a ama le ama kihongdoh jing thei mi chu Pa Pathen dinga hougut theng le boh beh lou ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, loupitah IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa tahsanna neiya nakiseiyuva iti dana nanghon khohsah tum naneitheiyu hintem?
en_web: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
en_kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, loupi tah i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa tahsan mi nahijeh un langnei, sihnei nabol lou diu ahi.

tcz: Vetsahnan, nakikhop nauva chun khat tou ponsil lultah le von mantamtah kivonin hung henlang, chule midang khat avaicha le vonnen deh'a kivon khat jong chu hung lut tahen lang,
en_web: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
en_kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nakikhop nauva chun ponhoi lul tah sil’a sana khutjem kibu pasal khattou hung lut hen, chule ponse dildel kisil vaicha khutdo khat jong hung lut le,

tcz: Nanghon mihaopa chu khohsah tum le touna nomlai peuvin lang, hinla avaicha pa jah a chun nangma hikom a khu nagadin thei ahi ahilouleh tollhanga hi natouthei ahi natileu, hi chun–
en_web: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
en_kjv: and ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
tcz_gospelgo: nang hon ponsil lul kisilpa veuvin lang ajah a, "Nangma hikoma hin phatechan touvin, " tivuin; chule khutdo pa jah a, Nangma dingto, " ahiloule, "Hikoma kakeng khop dop a khun touvo, " tileu chun;

tcz: Hiche dat neiya nathil bol'u chu lungthim gilou puihoi nahiu hilou ding ham?
en_web: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
en_kjv: are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
tcz_gospelgo: nalah-uva dat neiya thu gilou lamtah a vaihom nahilou diu ham?

tcz: Kasei hi ngaiyun, kasopi deitahte, Pathen in vannoiya hi avaicha chu tahsan naa hao dinga alhendoh hilou ham? Ama ngailuho dinga Lenggam atep peh chu amaho chun alo dingu hilou ham?
en_web: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
en_kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopi deitahte, ngaiyuvin. Vannoi leiset’a vaichate hi Pathenin tahsanna hao ding le ama ngailute dinga athutepna goulo ding lenggam chu chang dia alhendoh hilou ham?

tcz: Hinlah nanghon avaicha ho chu nahsah mon nabol tauve! Mihao ho chu nabolseuva le thutanna'a na puilut jiu hilou ham?
en_web: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
en_kjv: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nang hon vaichate chu nahsah mon naboltauve. Thu tanna phunga nakailut’uva, nabol gentheiyu chu mihao ho hilou ham?

tcz: Amaho tah chun Yeshua Christa chu ataitomuva, amin ja um chu nakipoh u hilou ham?
en_web: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
en_kjv: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
tcz_gospelgo: Nakikounau Min phatah taitoma jong amaho hilou ham?

tcz: Henge atahbeh in, nanghon Pathen Thubua dan juidia kisei: “Na heng nakom chu nangma na kingailut bangin ngailun,” kiti chu najui uleh aphai.
en_web: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
en_kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Pathen lekhabua leng Danthu dungjuiya, "Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun, " kit banga bulhit na hiule, nabol pha jengui.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon khat sanga khat he bol nahiuva ahileh, achonsea nahiuve. Danthu sukeh athemmoa nahi tauve.
en_web: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
en_kjv: but if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
tcz_gospelgo: Dat naneiyu vangle chonset bol nahiuvin, Danthu sukeh dol’a themmo chang nahiutauve.

tcz: Ajeh chu dan jouse nit a khat sukeh a chu Pathen danthu jouse sukeh to kibanga ahi.
en_web: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
en_kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Danthu apumpia nitsoh a kigel, ahivanga khatseh sukhel’a chu aboncha chunga themmo chang ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen, “Jon bol hih in,” tipa mama chun, “Tolthat hih in,” jong ati ahi. Hitia chu nangman mi natha a, jon nabollou chu hijongleh nangman dan chu napalkeh ahitai.
en_web: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
en_kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile, "Jonthanhoi bol hih-in, " tipa chun, "Tol that hih-in, " jong ati ahi. Jonthanhoi bolda jong le chun tol natha le Danthu sukeh nahitai.

tcz: Hijeh achu, ipi nasei hihen ahilouleh ipi nabol hijongleh, nangma nacham lhatsah dan chun nathu atanding ahiye.
en_web: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
en_kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem jalensah ji Danthu a athu kitan ding miho bangin hiti chun thu seiyun, hitobang chun na tongun.

tcz: Midang chunga hepina neilou chu amaho chunga hepina kipelou ding ahi. Hinla nangma hepina nei nahia ahileh, Pathen in nachung thu atan teng nahepi ding ahi.
en_web: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
en_kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hepina neilou chu thutanna a hepina beihel’a kibol ding ahi, hepi nan vang thutanna ajoji mong ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, Nanghon katahsan aume tiuvin lang, hinla nachonnaa navetsah umhih taleh ipi phatchomna hin tem? Hitobang tahsanna chun koipen ahuhhing jou dem?
en_web: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
en_kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, khattou tahsan neiyin kisei hen, natoh la nei hih le ipi phachom em? Hitobanga tahsanna chun ama ahuhhing thei lou ding hilou ham?

tcz: Vetsahnan, nangman sopipa ahilouleh sopinu khat chu neh ding neilou ahilouleh silding neilouvin um henlang,
en_web: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
en_kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
tcz_gospelgo: Sopi pasal ham sopi numei ham khat chu ponbei le nikho khat an neh ding lhasamin um hen,

tcz: chule nangman, “Damselin, nikho pha mangin; lumsan chule neva set'in”—tinlang, hinla nangman hichepa chu anneh ding pelou ahilouleh silding jong pelouvin umle chun, hichun ipi phatna aboldoh em?
en_web: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
en_kjv: and one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be you warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
tcz_gospelgo: nalah-uva khat chun, "Chamdel’in kile kit’in, lumsan lang vasettan, " ti hen, tahsa ngaichat thil ima pelouvin um le hichu ipi phachom em?

tcz: Hijehchun, nangman, tahsan jengseh aphachompoi ti namutai. Thilpha bolna asodoh louva ahileh, hichu athia le pannabei ahije.
en_web: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
en_kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin natoh beiyin tahsan chu achangseh a athisa ahi.

tcz: Tun hiche hi koiham khattouvin anelkal theiye, “Tahsan neiloi aumin, abang khatloi chun thilpha abol theiye” atiuve. Hinla kasei ahi, “Nangman thil pha nabol louva ahileh iti natahsan chu neimusah thei ding ham?” Keiman ka tahsan chu ka tohphat'in navetsah inge.
en_web: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
en_kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea jong hin khattouvin, "Nangman tahsan naneiyin, keiman vang natoh kaneiye, " tinte. Natoh bei natahsan chu neivetsah temin, kenjong tahsan jal’a kanatoh chu vetsah inge.

tcz: Nangman tahsan kaneiye nati, ajeh chu Pathen khat ahi ti na tahsan e. Nangdin aphai! Lhagao gilouho jengin jong hiche hi atahsanun, chule akichat nauva kihot hot ah ahiuve.
en_web: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
en_kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangman Pathen khatseh ahidol natsahsan ahi ong? Aphai tahsanin; ahinla thilha hon jong atansan’uva kihot hot jeng ahiuve.

tcz: Itobanga ngolkai hitam! Tahsan chu anatoh beiya athisa ahiti namuthei tah em?
en_web: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
en_kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
tcz_gospelgo: Vo, pannabei mihem, natoh bei tahsan phatchom lou hi nahet nom mong em?

tcz: Ipuluiyu Abraham chun achapa Isaac chu maichama akatdoh jeh a athilbol chun Pathen mitmua chondih tia kisima ahi geldohlou nahiu vem?
en_web: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
en_kjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
tcz_gospelgo: Ipuluiyu Abraham in achapa Isacc maicham chunga atodoh jeng jeh a hiche natoh chu them achanlo hilou ham?

tcz: Nanghon atahsan le athilbol ho chu achekhom e, ti namuuve. Atahsan chu anatoh in asuh chamkim ahitai.
en_web: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
en_kjv: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu atahsan le athilbol chengsen na atoh khoma, tahsan chu natoh-in asuh chamkim joh ahi;

tcz: Hitichun Pathen Thubun asei dung jui in, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin, Pathen in atahsan jal in chonpha tin ama chu asim tan ahi.” Ama chu Pathen golpa tinjong akikouve.
en_web: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
en_kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
tcz_gospelgo: chule hichea hi Pathen lekhabu thusei; "Abraham in Pathen atahsanin, hichu ama din themchan nan akisimpeh tai, " kiti hi agui lhunge, chujongle ama chu Pathen jol kisah ahitai.

tcz: Chutichun, eihon ithilbol jeh uva Pathen anga midih hina chu ichan theiyu ahin, tahsan jengseh a kon ahipoi, ti imudoh tauve.
en_web: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
en_kjv: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea kon hin tahsan keoseh jal hilouva, toh molso jeh a mihem them kichansah dol namutauve.

tcz: Rahab notinu chu vetsahna chom khat ahi. Amanu hi athilbol jal'a Pathen anga midih hina chu chang theiya ahi, ajeh chu aman gam velhi teni chu asel a chule lampi chom lama bitkei cha asoldoh jeh ahi.
en_web: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
en_kjv: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chun Rahab notinun lamthamho alhunsah a lamchom’a asolmang, hiche natoh jeh a chu them kichansah hilou ham?

tcz: Haitheina hu aumlouleh tahsa phatchomna aumlou tobanga hi, thilpha bolna natoh ho beiya tahsan chu athi ahibouve.
en_web: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
en_kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti hin Lhagao bei tahsa athisa ahibangin, natoh bei tahsan jong athisa ma ahibouve.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, mitampi hi houbunga mihilin pang hih un, ajeh chu ahila pangho chunga thutanna chu gihjo cheh ding ahi.
en_web: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
en_kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, nang ho tampi mihil’in pan dauvin, ajeh chu mihil ho hi ichung thuu khoh cheh a akitan ding naheuve.

tcz: Ahimongin, eiho jousen suhkhel tampi ineijiuve. Ajeh chu eihon ileiyu kithunun jou leuhen, eiho chamkim ihi dingu ahi chule thil danga jong kitim jou ihi dingu ahi.
en_web: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
en_kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu eihon kisuhmona tampi itoh khajiuve. Thusei naa kipal lou mi chu pasal lolhingtah, atahsa geiya apumpia tuh tang thei ahiye.

tcz: Eihon sakol lentah khu idei dei nauva ichesah theina dinguvin akamdal ikoipeh uvin ahi.
en_web: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
en_kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
tcz_gospelgo: Ithu’va anun theina din sakolte khu akamsunguva kamdal ivopeh-u le atahsa pumpia igot gotna kihei ahiuve.

tcz: Chule Kong innei lenpitah jong chu ahehna neocha a chu atolpan achesah nomna lam lama aheiya, hui hat jongleh athunun ahi.
en_web: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
en_kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, kong innei ho khu, lentah ahiuvin, hui hattah-in atol ahivangin, ahehna neocha khat’a aheh pan adeina lam’a aheile ahibouve.

tcz: Hitobang maa chu lei hi thil neocha thil thupi tahtah ho seithei hiya ahi. Ahin mei-am neocha khat in gammang lentah akah lhah jengthei chu ahi.
en_web: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
en_kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu Lei jong hi tibah neocha ahivangin thil lentah a kichoisang ji ahi. Ven, gamkang iten len jongle meisi hal khat’in iti akahvamji hitam!

tcz: Chule leigui hi mei kong tobang ahi. Hiche hi vannoi gitlouna dimset, natahsa pumpi suboh ahi. Hiche hin nahinkho pumpi meiya ahalthei, ajeh chu hiche hin meidil meikou chu akahsah ahi.
en_web: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
en_kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue amongst our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
tcz_gospelgo: Lei hi meikou, adih lou dimset, vannoi leiset ahi; Lei hi itibah lahuva anakiphut lut ahin, tahsa pumpi hi asuhboh jia, khang lhum keiya, mei banga akah velkol’a hiche meikou hi Damun’a hung kon ahi.

tcz: Miho hin ganhing jouse, vacha ho, a-op a kitholho chule ngaho avah ngoi theicheh-e,
en_web: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
en_kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing namkim, vacha namkim, tol’a kithol ho, twiya cheng ho ahiuvin vah-ngoi thei ahin, mihemin avah ngoi jiuve.

tcz: Hinlah koiman lei hi avah ngoi joupoi. Hiche hi kicholdo theilou le gilou, thina thei gu dimset ahi.
en_web: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
en_kjv: but the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
tcz_gospelgo: Leivang hi mihemte koiman avah ngoi joupoi, um thim thei lou thilse, thina gu dimset ahi.

tcz: Khatvei kom le hiche hin IPakaiyu le Pachu avahchoiyin, chule khatvei kom le Pathen lima kisem chu agaosap jin ahi.
en_web: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
en_kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon hiche lei hi Pakai le Pathen thangvah nan jong imangun, chule Patheinin ama lim tobanga asem mihemte gaosap nan jong imang jiuve.

tcz: Chutia chu kamhom khat ma a kona chu phatthei bohna le gaosapna hung kisunglha khom jia ahi.
en_web: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
en_kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
tcz_gospelgo: Thangvahna le gaosapna hiche kamsung khat’a hi hung kondoh khomji ahi. Kasopite, hiche ho ahitiji hi adol ahipoi.

tcz: Twinah khat a kona chu twi thengsel le twi kha putdoh khom ngaiyem?
en_web: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
en_kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
tcz_gospelgo: Twisam phung khatseh kosunga kona twi lhum le twikha putkhomji mong em?

tcz: Theichang phungin olive ga asodoh theija ahilouleh leng piguiyin theichang ga asodoh theiyem? Ahipoi, nangman twitheng chu chitwiya konin nathaldoh thei poi.
en_web: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
en_kjv: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, theichang phunga olive ga theiya, lengpiguiya theichang ga theiyem? Chitwiyin jong twitheng asemdoh theipoi.

tcz: Nangma nachih a chule Pathen lamlhah ho chu nahet a ahileh, jabolna lama hinkho naman chu aphotchenna hihen chule chihna a kona natohpha kineosahna hinsodoh hen.
en_web: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
en_kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge amongst you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva aching le hetna nei koi ham? Ama chun chihnaa hungkon nunnem nan a nun akhan le anatoh phan vetsah hen.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon kithangthip tona naneiyuva chule nalunguva chang phatchomna hollea nahiuleh, thutah lekhuna a kiletsahna pum le jouvin thu seihih un.
en_web: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
en_kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang nalungthimu’va kithangset kilungdou, kichang chuna aumle nakichoiat lou diu thutah douna jong thujo nasei lou diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu kithangthip le chang phatchomna holna ho hi Pathen'a hungkon chihna chu ahipoi. Hiti hohi leiset thudol, lhagao thu hilou chule lhagao gilouva kon joh ahi.
en_web: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
en_kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chihna chu chunga hungkon ahipon, leiset’a kon, Lhagao thudol hilou, thilhaa kon ahibouve.

tcz: Ajeh chu, kimit thipna le chang phatchomna umna mun a chu phatlouna jouse le kitomona namu ding ahi.
en_web: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
en_kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kithangset le kichang chuna umna chan’a kinahna le khansetna jong um tei ahi.

tcz: Hinlah, chunga kona chihna hi amasapen a atheng ahi. Chujongleh chamna ngaichatna, phat jousea lungneng, chule midang thua jong nung nom tina ahi. Khotona dimset le thilpha bolna asodoh in ahi. Koima lama langkaina aneipon chule lungdih pun aum jinge.
en_web: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
en_kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
tcz_gospelgo: Chunga kona hung chihna vang chu amasan athengin, chuin kichamdel, kitohdel, nun nemheo, thu nungjel, hepina dimset’a ngailutna gadohji, phat lhemna le lang neina beihel ahi.

tcz: Chule kicham ding deiho dinga chamna muchi kitu ding chule chonphatna tohga chu amuding ahitai.
en_web: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
en_kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule themchanna ga chu chambolte dinga chamnaa kitu ahi.

tcz: Nalah uva kinah le kidel ho hi ipia kon ham? Nasung uva ngaichat dihlou ho chu kidouva hilou ham?
en_web: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
en_kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva gal kisat le kinah ho hi hoiya hungkon ham? Natibah dunguva kona nomsahna ding ngaichatna ho kisattoa hungkon hilou ham?

tcz: Naneilouvu chu na deiyun, hichu mutei na gongun chutia na got nalamun nathat jiuve. Mi dang thilnei nathangseuvin, hinla na neithei pouvin, hiti chun nanghon gal nasatun amahoa kona lahdoh pehding na gouve. Ahijeng vang'in, nanghon nadeiyu chu nanei theipouve, Pathen koma nathum loujeh u ahi.
en_web: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
en_kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahagut lheh-un, neila nanei pouvin; thangset sumin tol na that jiuvin, ahinla nanei theideh pouve; hijeh chun nakinauvin, nakisat’uve. Nanei lounau hi Pathen henga nathum loujeh-u ahibouve.

tcz: Chule nathum jeng vangun namudeh pouve, ajeh chu nalung gonu chu abona dihlou ahi-nang ho nopsahna ding bou na deijeh u ahi.
en_web: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
en_kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
tcz_gospelgo: Nathum vangun namu theipouve, ajeh chu natahsa nopsahna ding jenga nagot’uva nathum dol’u aphat loujeh ahi.

tcz: Nangho jonbolteho! Vannoito kigolvop theina hin Pathen melma a nasemu ahi geldoh lou nahiu vem? Seikit inge: Nangho Vannoito na kigolvop uva ahileh, Pathen melma a kisema nahiu ahitai.
