en_web: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
en_kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jonthanhoi bol ho! Vannoi to kihouthei hi Pathen to kigalna ahi nahet louvu ham? Hijeh a chu koihile vannoi to kijol’a chu Pathen douva ama le ama kisemdoh ahi tai.

tcz: Pathen Thubun Pathen Lhagao isunguva cheng hin thangsetna a eidip dimu ahi kiti hi ipi nagel uvem?
en_web: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
en_kjv: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, the spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
tcz_gospelgo: O-le Pathen lekhabua kisei, "Aman i-sunguva achensah Lhagao hi thengse ten’a ahol jing ahi, " kiti hi mohseh a nagel’u ham?

tcz: Hinlah Ama hin hitobang lung gitlou ngaichatna idou jouna dinguva lungsetna eichan cheh joh u ahi. Pathen Thubun, “Pathen in akiletsah ho adouvin, akineosah ho akhoto'e,” ati.
en_web: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
en_kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin lungsetna apeh hi alenjjo cheh-in hijeh chun: "Pathenin kiletsahte chu adoudal’in, Anun nem ho chu lungsetna apejie, " ati.

tcz: Hitichun, Pathen masanga kineosah un. Diabol chu douvun chutileh nanghoa konin jamdoh tante.
en_web: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
en_kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen koma kipe lut’un, Diabol chu kidinte piuvin, chutile ama nakom’uva konin jamtante.

tcz: Pathen kom nailut un, chutileh Pathen in nahin nailut dingu ahi. Nakhut u sutheng un, michonse nangho; nalungu sutheng un, ajeh chu nangho Pathen le vannoi kikah ah nalungthimu akikehsotai.
en_web: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
en_kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen kom nailut’un, chutile ama nakom’u hung nailut ding ahi. Nakhut’u suthengun, chonseho; nalungthim suthengun, lungthoneiho!

tcz: Nathilbol chunguva kisihna mitlhi longdoh hen. Lungkhamna le lunghemna tahbeh soh hen. Nuina sangin kana, chule kipana sangin lhasetna sohhen.
en_web: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
en_kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
tcz_gospelgo: Kisih-un, lunghem’un chule kap’un; nanuiyu chu ka-na chule nakipau chu lungkhamna soh hen!

tcz: Pakai masanga kineosah un, chuteng Aman jabolna'a nadopsang dingu ahi.
en_web: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
en_kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai mitmun kisunem’un, chutile aman nachoisang diu ahi.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, khat in khat dounan thuse seihih un. Nangho naki oimo touva chule khat in khat chung thu natan u ahileh Pathen danthu chu oimoa chule athutana napanu ahitai. Hinla naboldiu dol chu danthu najui diu bou ahin, athutan ding nahi lou u ahi.
en_web: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
en_kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, khat le khat kisei seto hih-un; koi hile asopi seisea ham, ahiloule asopi thu tan’a ham chun Danthu aseiset’a chule Danthu chunga thu atan ahi. Nangin Danthu chung thu natan vang le anit’a hilouva athu tanjoh nahibouve.

tcz: Danthu pea pang Pathen bou chu Thutanpa ahi. Ama bou chu huhhingthei ahilouleh sumangthei hiya ahi. Achutileh, nangman naheng nakom chunga thutan theina ipi thu naneiyem?
en_web: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
en_kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
tcz_gospelgo: Danthu pea le thutan khatseh bou ahin, ama hin ahuhhing theiya, suh jong asuh mang thei ahi; naheng nakom chung thu tan’a pang nang koi nahim?

tcz: Tun veuvin, “Tuni ahilouleh jing tengleh khopi khat a gacheu hitin chule chuche mun a chun kum khat ga-umu hite. Chumuna chun sumkol gakiveiyu hitin chule sumpung holuhite,” natiuve.
en_web: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
en_kjv: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
tcz_gospelgo: Tun ngaitem’un, nang ho kimkhatsen, "Tuni ham jing ham le eiho khopi khatpen a cheu hitin kum khat gatham’u hitin, gakiveiyu hitin, sum veikan’u hite, " tin naseiyui.

tcz: Jing nikhoa itobang hinkho naman diu nahet uvem? Nahin khou chu jingkah twimei tobang ahi-hikoma chomkhat uma, chujoule chemang tobang ahi.
en_web: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
en_kjv: whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow: for what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
tcz_gospelgo: Jing teng nahinkhou itobanga aum ding bon helou hel’uva. Ajeh chu nang ho hi twimei chomcha khat hung kilahjia mangkit loiji tobang bou nahiuve.

tcz: Gahsei dia pha chu, “Pakaiyin eidei peh u ahileh eiho hingu hitin chule hiche ahilouleh khuche bolu hite,” tiuvin.
en_web: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
en_kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
tcz_gospelgo: Hisanga chu, "Pakai lungdei ahia ihin nah-u le hiche hihen khuche hile bol’u hite, " natijoh diu ahi.

tcz: Achuti louva natoh gon uva nakiletsah piuva ahileh hitobang kiletsah a thusei chu phalouva ahi.
en_web: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
en_kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Tunla nang ho nahamhoitho na jouseu pi chu nakithang-at pi lheh-ui; hitobang kithang-atna ho hi phalou ahi.

tcz: Geldohun, nanghon nabol dingu chu ipi ahi henasa'a nabol lou u chu chonset ahi.
en_web: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
en_kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun thilpha bolje he naa bol lou mi chu achonse ahi.

tcz: Hinveuvin, nangho mihao hon: Kap'un chule lunghem pumin maoleuvin, ajeh chu tijat um hahsatna ho jouse na masanguva aume.
en_web: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
en_kjv: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
tcz_gospelgo: Tun mihao hon ngaiyuvin, nachunguva hesoh genthei hung lhung ding ho jeh hin kap’un lang maovun.

tcz: Nagou thilhou amonlha gamtai, chule napon hoitah tah hou jong nget in ane heng gamtai.
en_web: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
en_kjv: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
tcz_gospelgo: Nanei jouseu amon mang tan, naponsil jouseu lungin anetai.

tcz: Na sana hou le na dangka hou panna bei asoh gamtai. Na gou thil hou na sahlut u chun na tahsau chu meikah banga aneh mang ding ahi. Hiche gou nakhol khomu chu thutan nikhoa dinga nangho dounaa hung pang ding ahi.
en_web: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
en_kjv: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire: ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
tcz_gospelgo: Nasana nadangkau thih-eh souvin anehengsoh tan, hiche thih-eh chu nang ho douna hettohsah a panga, meikah machal banga natahsau jong aneh gam ding ahi. Nang hon la ni nu nunga din gou nakhol’uvin ne!

tcz: Ajeh chu ngaiyun! Naloulhou atohman nalhimlhah peh hou ka awgin ngaiyun. Atohman napehlou hou chun nangho dounan kho ahin samui. Ajeh chu nalouuva tohman napehlou hou kana aw chu Van Pakai sepaite nakolsunga ahung lhung tai.
en_web: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
en_kjv: Behold, the hire of the labourers which have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, nalou laiyuva chang-at sum thalah ho doha nabol’uva tohman napeh louvu chun kho asamin, hiche chang-at ho khosap ogin chu Hatchungnung Pakai nabeng’a aluttai.

tcz: Nanghon leiset chunga hi nomsatah a nahinkhou namanu ahin, na ngaichat chasunu chu nasuh bulhit u ahi. Nangho nakivah thaovu hi nakithana diu nikhoa dinga nahi tauve.
en_web: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
en_kjv: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho leiset chunga nomsa le ninglhingin nachengun, kilhaina gantha nikhoa tha ding bangin nakivah thao cheh’uve.

tcz: Nanghon suhkhel neilou ho chu themmo nachanuva chule natha vangun, amaho chun nalethuh pouve.
en_web: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
en_kjv: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon midihpa chu themmo nachan’un, nathat tauve. Aman la nadou thuh pouve.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, Pakai hungkilena ding na-nga nauva thoh hat un. Loubol mipan thoh hattah'a goju masa le goju nunung angaji khu ngaito uvin. Amaho chun chang amina chang atphat man lutah chu kinem tah in angah uve.
en_web: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
en_kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Pakai hungkit kahsen thoh hat’uvin. Ven, loubol min ga pha manlu tah asodohna dingin leiset chun twilha masa le lha nukhah chu thoh hattah-in angah ngah jeng jie.

tcz: Nangho jong thoh hat'un, lung det'un, ajeh chu Pakai hung na ding anaitai.
en_web: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
en_kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho jong thoh hat jingun; Pakai hungkitna ding anai tah jeh hin, nalungthimu phutdet’uvin.

tcz: Sopite, khat le khat kiphun lou jenun, achuti louleh themo changin umget uvinate. Ajeh chu veuvin-Thutanpa chu kot'a adinge!
en_web: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
en_kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, nathuu kitan louna din khat le khat kiphun hih-un, ven Thutanpa chu kotphunga adingtai.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, thohhatna thudola avetsahpi dingin, Pakai mina thusei themgao ho veuvin.
en_web: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
en_kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite, Pakai min’a thuseiya pang Themgao ho hesoh genthei le thot hatna jouse chu vettoh a jui din kilah-uvin.

tcz: Thohgimna thoh jouho eihon jabolna lentah ineiyuve. Vetsahnan, nanghon Job thoh hat chu nana heuve. Ajonaa Pakaiyin ichan geiya akhoto hitam, ajeh chu Pakai hi lungset dimset le khoto them ahi.
en_web: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
en_kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, eiho athoh lhumkei ho chu nun nom ihiu ahi. Nang hon Job thohhat najauvin, achaina Pakaiyin ipi abolpeh jong naheuve; ajeh chu Pakai hi hepina le khotona dimset ahi.

tcz: Ahin adehset'in, kasopiteho, van panin ahilouleh lei panin, ahilouleh ipi pen min hijongleh kihahsel hih beh un.
en_web: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
en_kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, ima jousea akhohpen chu: kihahsel hih-un, vanpan in jong kihahsel hih-un, leiset panin jong kihahsel dauvin, ipi pi hi jongle panin kihahsel hih-un; thutanna noiya nachuh khah louna diuvin "Henge" natiu le tijengun, "Ahipoi, " natiu jongle tijengun.

tcz: Nalah uva hahsatna thoh um'em? Natao jing diu ahiye. Chule thangvahna ding ajeh neihon Pakai chu avahchoi jing diu ahi.
en_web: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
en_kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva hesoh genthei thoh um am? Ama chu taohen. Kipah thanom’a um am? Vahchoi la sahen.

tcz: Nalah uva ana damlou um'em? Nanghon houbung upa ho ahunguva, nachung uva Pakai mina thao anuuva chule taona aneina dinguva nakou diu ahi.
en_web: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
en_kjv: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva adammo um am? Ama chun Houbung upate kouhen, amahon ama chu Pakai minin thao nu’hen, taopeh-u hen.

tcz: Hitobanga tahsan neitah a taona chun ana chu adamsah a, chule Pakaiyin nadamsah dingu ahi. Chule nanghon chonsetna chu nana bolu ahileh ngaidam chang ding nahiuve.
en_web: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
en_kjv: and the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutile tahsan jal’a taona chun adammopa chu ahuhdoh a, Pakaiyin ama akaithou ding, chonsetna abol khah jongle hichu ngaidam chang ding ahi.

tcz: Na dam theina dingun nachonset'u khat in khat koma phong unlang, chule khat chu khat dingin taovun. Michonpha lung gutten'a ataona chun thaneina lentah aneiyin chule kidangtah ahinbol doh e.
en_web: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
en_kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nadam theina dingun khat’in khat koma nachonset phongun lang, khat le khat kitaopeh to’uvin. Midihmi tao peh na chu nasatah a natong thei ahi.

tcz: Elijah chu eimaho tobangbep mihem ahin, chuti ahijeng vang'in lung giltah a gojuh louna dinga ataova ahileh kum 3 le akeh leiset a go ajutapon ahi.
en_web: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
en_kjv: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
tcz_gospelgo: Elijah chu eiho pendol banga mihem ma ahivangin, gojuh louna dinga lung luttah a atao le, kum thum le lhagup sungin leiset chunga go ajupoi.

tcz: Chutah in ama ataokit in ahileh vana konin go ajun chule leiset'in aga asodohtai.
en_web: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
en_kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin ataokit le Vanin gotwi ahinpen leiset’in anche louhing ahinsepdoh tai.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, nalah uva thutah'a kona avahmanga naumuva ahinlepui kitah auma ahileh,
en_web: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
en_kjv: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
tcz_gospelgo: Kasopite, nalah-uva thutah a kona lamvai aum a, ama chu khat touvin ahinlepui kit le,

tcz: Koi hita jongleh michonse hin lepuiya chu, hiche mi chu thinaa kona huh doh ahin chule chonset tampi ngaidamna ahinlhut ding ahi
en_web: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
en_kjv: let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
tcz_gospelgo: hitobang chonse khat alamvainaa kona hinlepui kit a chu lamvaipa lhagao chu thinaa kona ahuhdoh a chule chonset tampi jong akhupeh ding ahi, hethem’uvin.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa solchah Peter a kon ahi. Keiman Pathen lhendoh mite gamchom mi dinmun a, Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia chule Bithynia gamkai hoa cheng ho henga kajih ahi.
en_web: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
en_kjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa Solchah Peterin Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia chule Bithynia gama kithecheh lhenchom sohchang ho,

tcz: Pa Pathen in nanahet uva chule masang peh a nalhendoh uva, chule a Lhagaovin nasuhtheng u ahitai. Hichea kona chu nanghon asei na ngaiyuva chule Yeshua Christa thisan a nasop thengu ahitai. Pathen in lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeh be be jengtau hen.
en_web: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
en_kjv: elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa Pathenin ahet masah dungjuiya Lhagaova kisuthengsa, thua nung dinga Jesu Christa thisan kithekhum ho henga lungset le chamna nachunguva pung jal hen.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen ah vahchoina jouse umjing tahen. Ama milungsetna let jeh'a eiho pengthah a ihiu hi Pathen in Yeshua Christa chu athilah a kona akai thou jal jeh ahi.
en_web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
en_kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
tcz_gospelgo: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa, ahepina bulhin dungjuiya thina a kona Jesu Christa thodoh jal’a hing jing kinepnaa eihing thah kit’uva Pathen chu nun nom hen;

tcz: Chule eihon gou simjou lou loding ineiyui-gouchan ding chu vana nangho dinga kikoiya ahi.
en_web: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
en_kjv: to an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
tcz_gospelgo: kemthei lou le boh beh lou chule

tcz: Chule natahsan jaluva chu, Pathen in athahat'a hiche huhhingna hi nakisan kahseuva na honbit uva, mi jousen amutheina dinguva ni nununga hung kilang ding ahi.
en_web: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
en_kjv: who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho jong tahsan jal’a phat chaina teng phondoh dia gotsa kikoi huhhing na chu chang dia Pathen thahatnaa nakihongbit’u ahi.

tcz: Hijehchun kipah tahbeh un. Nanghon phat chomkhat a dinga patepna hahsa tampi nathoh dingu ahivangin, kipana kidangtah namasanguvah aume.
en_web: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
en_kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin phat chomkhat din patepna lamchom choma lung hem tah a nathoh tei diu hi jong le, hatah-in kipah tahnom’un;

tcz: Hiche patepna ho hin natahsanu chu akicheh monge ti avetsah ding ahi. Meiyin apatep banga natahsan u chu patep'a uma ahin chule sana maimai sanga natahsan nau mantamjo ahivanga, sana kilhantheng banga natahsan u chu kipatep'ah ahi. Hijeh a chu natahsan u chun patepna tintang ato jouva hattah a aum den a ahileh, Yeshua Christa chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh teng chuleh nangho dinga vahchoina le loupina chule jabolna tamtah ahin lhutding ahitai.
en_web: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
en_kjv: that the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: hichun meiya patep nung jenga jong mangthei nalai sana sanga munlujo natahsan’u aphot chensah a, Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh teng vahchoina le loupina chule jabolna namupeh diu ahi,

tcz: Ama namu khah louvang uvin nangailu uve. Tuhin Ama namu loulai vanguvin, Ama natahsan tauve; chule nangho kipana loupitah phondoh theihoi hilou chun nakipah tauve.
en_web: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
en_kjv: whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu mu louva ngailua, tuchan geiya jong mu louhel’a tahsan’a seithei louhel’a hapa kipah a loupina dimset nahiuve;

tcz: Ama natahsan jeh uva ahung sohdoh chu na lhagaovu huhhing channa ahung hitai.
en_web: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
en_kjv: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu natahsan lou na pen’u nahinkhou huhhingna nakimu’u ahitai.

tcz: Hiche huhhingna thudol, lungset man'a huhhingna nangho dinga kigong chu ahi, themgao hon gaova anasei laiyuva ahetchet nom'u chu.
en_web: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
en_kjv: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kipe ding lungsetna thudol gaothu anaseidoh Themgao hon hiche huhhingna thudol hi gunchutah a ahol’uva akholtohsau ahitai.

tcz: Amahon itih phat a ahilouleh itih a asunguva um Christa Lhagao chun Christa gimthohna le khonunga Aloupina kidangtah thudol chu akihou piuva, anaseipeh masah u ham ti chu adatmo uvin ahi.
en_web: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
en_kjv: searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
tcz_gospelgo: Koipen tah-in itobang dol’a itih phat laiya, asunguva cheng Christa Lhagaova kona, Christa thohgim ding le nunga aloupina ding ho chu ahettohsah masah a aphondoh ahidol, amahon akholtoh-u ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu athupohhou amahoa dinga hilouvin, nanghoa ding joh ahi ti seipeh anahiuve. Chule hiche Kipana Thuphahi nangho koma Vana kona Lhagao Theng thahatna'a seiphonga pang ho chun ahin phondoh u ahitai. Hiche hi akidanna kit chu vantil tenjong lung gutten a hicheho hi avetvet'u ahi.
en_web: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
en_kjv: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
tcz_gospelgo: Alhacha kinbol ho’u hi achang tum diuva hilouva, nang ho ding ahije ahenguva akiphongdohin, athudol hi tun van’a kona hinkisol Lhagao Theng jal’in Kipana Thupha nahung seipeh ho’uvin nahetsah tauve, hiche ho hi Vantilte jengin jong vetgun atup lheh jengui.

tcz: Hijeh chun, phatechan gelun chule kitim themun. Yeshua chu vannoiya ahung kilah tengleh nachunguva lungsetna huhhingna hung lhung ding chu galdot un.
en_web: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
en_kjv: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun kong kigah bangin nalungthim gil’in kigingun lungnemin Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh teng nakipe diu lungsetna a chun lhingset’in kinem jingun.

tcz: Hiti chun, Pathen thua nungte bangin hinkho mangun. Nalung ngaichat u suhbulhitna dingin masang nahin khouva chun kinungtol kit hih un. Chupet a chu aphajo ding nahet loulaiyu ahi.
en_web: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
en_kjv: as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
tcz_gospelgo: Sei ngai chate bangin um’un, masang na-ngol laiyu lunggul’a chonna chu jom hih-uvin,

tcz: Hinlah tun, Pathen nadei lhenpau athen tobanga chu nangho jong imalam jousea nathen dingu ahi.
en_web: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
en_kjv: but as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
tcz_gospelgo: chusangin nakoupau athen bangin nang ho jong nun le khan thengun,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun, “Keima kathen jeh hin nangho jong thengun,” ati.
en_web: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
en_kjv: because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
tcz_gospelgo: ijeh-inem itile, “Keima kathenjeh-in nang ho jong thengun,” tin akisun’e.

tcz: Chule geldoh uvin, natao nau Vana Pa chun koima lungset tum aneipoi. Aman natoh dung juiyuva nachung thu'u atan ding ahilouleh kipaman napeh dingu ahi. Hitia hi gamsunga kholjin nahi nauva hi Ama jana neiya nagin lhungkei dingu ahi.
en_web: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
en_kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
tcz_gospelgo: Mi anatoh dungjui cheh a langneina beihel’a thutanpehji pa chu Pa nasah ngal’u ahile hikoma nakhopem sung seuvin ama chu ging lhumkeiyuvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon nahe tauve, Pathen in napu napa teuva kona kiloson hinkho panna beiya kona hi lhatdohna man apeh ahitai. Chule hiche lhatna man apeh chu sana ahilouleh dangka thila ahipoi.
en_web: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
en_kjv: forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
tcz_gospelgo: Napu napateu hinpehson chonna homkeova kona mangthei sana le dangkaa kilhatdoh nahi louvu naheuve.

tcz: Chonset bei, nolnabei Pathen kelngoinou, Christa thisan manlutah a chu kilhat nahiuve.
en_web: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
en_kjv: but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
tcz_gospelgo: Nolna beihel le bohbeh louhel kelngoi nou Christa thisan lu tah a kilhatdoh nahibouvui.

tcz: Pathen in ama chu vannoi kiphudoh masangpeh a nalhat diuva alhendoh chu, hiche ninununga hi Ama hung kiphongdoh a ahitai.
en_web: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
en_kjv: who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu vannoi leiset bul kiphu masanga hetsa ahin, phat kichai kona hi nang ho khohsahna jeh a phondoh ahung um ahibouve.

tcz: Christa jal'a Pathen nahin tahsanu ahitai. Chule nanghon Pathena natahsan u le nakinep nau chu nangap det'u ahitai, ajeh chu Aman Christa chu thinaa konin akaithouvin chule loupina lentah chu napetauve.
en_web: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
en_kjv: who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama jal’a natahsan’u le nakinep nau chu Pathen koma aum theina dinga Christa thinaa kona kaithouva loupi sah Pathen tahsante nahiu ahitai.

tcz: Nangho thutah thua nanun phat uva nachonset nauva kona thenga nahi tauve, hijeh a chu tua hi nangho sopi hina a nangho ngailutna dihtah chu nakineito diu ahitai. Nalung gil pum piuvin khat le khat kingailu touvin.
en_web: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
en_kjv: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
tcz_gospelgo: Kisopi ngailut thengsel dinga thutah thua nunga nahinkhou nasuh thengu ahitah le khat le khat lungthim giltah-in ki-ngailuvin.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho penthahna hi abeiloi ding tuhinkhoa ahipoi. Hinna thah naneiyu hi aitih a umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu hichu Pathen Thuhing jing tonsot'a um jinga kon ahi.
en_web: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
en_kjv: being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho hi tonsot’a um jing Pathen Thuhing jal’a athi thei hilouva thimo chilhah akona avel’a pengkit nahitauve.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Mihemte hi hampa tobangbep ahi, ahoinau jong loujaova pahcha pah tobangbep ahi. Hampa agopjin chule apah chu amolloiji.
en_web: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
en_kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu: “Tahsa mihing jouse hampa tobang ahin, Aloupina jouse jong hampa tobang ahi; Hampa agop jin, apah apuljitai;

tcz: Hinlah Pakai Thu chu imatih chan'a umjing ding ahi.” Chule hiche thuhi Kipana Thupha nahenguva kiseiphong chu ahi.
en_web: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
en_kjv: but the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai thu vang tonsot’in aum jingnai,” akiti. Hiche thu hi nahenguva Kipana Thupha kiseiphong chu ahi.

tcz: Hiti chun umchan phalou ho, mi lheplhahna jouse, phatlhem, mithang thipna, chule ngainom umlou thusei jouse pailhauvin.
en_web: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
en_kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
tcz_gospelgo: Gitlouna jouse le doha lhep lhahna jouse phat lhemna ho le thangsetna ho chule kiseisetna jouse pai lhauvin,

tcz: Naosen sohthah ho bangin, lhagao bongnoi thengsel chu ngaichauvin chutileh lhagao huhhingna a chu na kikhanlhit thei dingu ahi.
en_web: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
en_kjv: as newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
tcz_gospelgo: naosen pengthah bangin huhhingna lama khantouna nanei theina diuvin, halpi beihel Lhagao bongnoi chu ngaicha jingun.

tcz: Tun nanghon Pakai phatna chu natekhah u ahitai.
en_web: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
en_kjv: if so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu nang hon Pakai mi khotona chu natep khahsau ahitai.

tcz: Nangho Christa, Pathen Hou-in hingjing inning songpi, henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Ama chu miho pampai ahin, ahinlah Pathen in jana lentah chang dinga alhendoh joh ahitai.
en_web: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
en_kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Pakai, hing jing, Songpi, mihemten apai vanga Pathen dia lhentum manlu tah henga chun hunguvin,

tcz: Chule nangho, song hingho Pathen in lhagao hou-in a dinga asahdoh chu nahiuve. Akalval ipi um'em, nangho Ama dia thempu thengho nahi tauve. Yeshua Christa Palai hina a Pathen lunglhaina theiya lhagaova kilhaina-thilto chu bol'ah nahi tauve.
en_web: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: nang ho jong song hing jing tobanga Lhagao in khat’a kisadoh a Thempu thengloi hiding, Jesu Christa jal’a Pathen santhei dol’a kilhaina Lhagao thilto toh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Keiman Jerusalema inning songpi kakoiyin, jabolna lentah dinga kilheng dohsa ahi, chule koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chu lungsetna changlouva umloubeh ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
en_kjv: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekha bua hitin akisun’e: “Ven, Zion a Songpi katun khu, Inning khompi lhentum manlu tah ahi; Ama tahsan chan chu Jum kimusah louhel ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Tahbeh in, nangho Ama tahsan hon Pathen in apeh jabolna chu nahetpeh un. Hinlah Ama pampai ho din “insahon adeimouva apampaiyu song chu tun inning sonpin apangtai.”
en_web: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
en_kjv: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nang ho atahsante din manlu tah ahin, athasan lou ho din vang: “Insa hon deimoa apaiyu Songpi chu Inning khompipenin apangtai,” akiti.

tcz: Chule “Ama miho kipalsah chu ahin, chule amaho lhuhna songpi chu ahitai.” Amaho akipalnau ajeh chu amaho Pathen Thun anung pouve, chule amaho dinga kigong achandiu chu akimu tauve.
en_web: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
en_kjv: and a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule: “Kisuh khahna Song, Kipal lhuhna Songpi asohtai,” akiti. Thu chu angai loujeh-uva kipal lhu ahitauvin, hiti dinga chu umdoh ahitauve.

tcz: Ahin nangho hitobang chu nahi lou u ahi, ajeh chu nangho lhen tum mite nahiuve. Nangho leng-thempu ho, namtheng, Pathen nei chu nahi tauve. Hijeh a chu, nanghon midang ho Pathen phatna chu navetsah theiju ahitai, ajeh chu Aman muthim lah a kona avah loupi kidangtah a chu napuilut u ahitai.
en_web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
en_kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
tcz_gospelgo: Nangho vang nam lhentum, Lengpa dia thempu, namtheng, Pathen mite nahiuvin, hitia chu muthima kona ama khovah kidangtah a nakoudoh Pau phatna chengse chu naphondoh diu ahi.

tcz: “Masanga chu amite hina photchenna neilou nahiu ahin, tua hi nangho Pathen mite nahiu ahitai. Masanga chu khotona anachanglou nahiu ahin, tua hi Pathen khotona chu changa nahi tauve.”
en_web: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
en_kjv: which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
tcz_gospelgo: “Phat khat chun Pathen mite nahipouvin, Tunvang amite nahitauve; Hepina chang lou nahiuvin, Tun vang hepina nachangtauve,” akiti.

tcz: Deitahte, “chomkhat a dinga khosa chule gamchom mi” nahiu toh kilhon'a kagihsal nahiuve, nangho nalhagaovu douva pang vannoi lung ngaichat hoa konin kikang seuvin.
en_web: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
en_kjv: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, kholjin le sohchang bangin Lhagao to kigalto jing tahsepha lunggul jousea kona kihei mang dinga ka-ngeh nahiuve.

tcz: Naheng nakom atahsanlou to cheng khom nahiu chu heuvin lang, chingtheiyun. Chujouleh amahon thildihlou bol a themmo nachan ujongleh ja theiya naum nau chu mudoh uvintin, chule Aman vannoi thu atan teng Pathen chu jana apeh dingu ahi.
en_web: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
en_kjv: having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
tcz_gospelgo: Chidang namdang ten nang ho thilse bol’a naseina jenguva jong nanun nakhanu chu phatsah-uvin, chutile natohphatna jouseu amu’va, athudol akikhol toh nikho le Pathen avahchoi diu ahi.

tcz: Pakai jal'in, mihem thuneina jouse jabol un, Lengpa chu gamneipa ahinaa jading ahi,
en_web: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
en_kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai jal’in mihem phudoh thuneina jousea nungun; lengpa chu aboncha chunga vaipo ahin,

tcz: ahilouleh thunei aman alhendoh hijongleh jana pen. Ajeh chu lengpa chun thildihlou bolho gimbol dinga chule thilpha bolho jabolna pedinga amaho chu ngansena apeh ahi.
en_web: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
en_kjv: or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
tcz_gospelgo: gamvaipo ho chu thilse bolte talen matsah ding le thilpha bol ho seipha dinga Pakai sol ahiuve.

tcz: Ja umtah'a hinkho naman diu chu Pathen lunglam ahi, hichun alamlouva ngolhoitah a themmo nahin chanhou chu asuhthip ding ahi.
en_web: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
en_kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile thilpha kiboldoh chengsea lungthim beiho ngolna kasanmo hel’a lha ding hi Pathen lungdei lam ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho chamlhat nahiu ahi, hinlah nangho Pathen sohte nahiuve, hiti ahijeh chun nachamlhatnau chu thilse bolnan neihih un.
en_web: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
en_kjv: as free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Jalente bang hiuvin, amavang jelenna chu gitlou khuna neilouvin, Pathen sohte bangin um’uvin.

tcz: Amitakip jabolun, chule Christian nasopi chu ngailun. Pathen gingin, chule lengpa chu jabol in.
en_web: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
en_kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi jouse jabol cheh-un, kisopitna ngailu’uvin, Pathen gingun, lengpa chu jaboluvin.

tcz: Chule nangho sohho naputeu thuneina chu jana neitoh thon sanguvin. Amahon bol'un tia nahilu chu bolun-amaho chu mihepithem le lunggel toh them ahiseh-u hilouvin, mi engse ahiu jongleh bolun.
en_web: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
en_kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
tcz_gospelgo: In mun lhachate ijakaiyin naPakaiteu gingun athu’uvin nunguvin, mipha ho le anun nem ho keo jong hilouvin, milungkhohho thun jong nungun.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen lunglhaina chu nanghon adih ahi ti nahet'u chu naboluva chule alamlouva nakibol nauva jong thohhattah a napan dingu ahi.
en_web: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
en_kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile mikhattouvin Pathen ahet khen them jeh a athoh ding lom lou gim genthei hesoh athoh le hichu ama dinga vangbohna hijo ahi.

tcz: Ahinai, thilse boljeh a nathoh hatnau chun ima chanding nanei pouve. Hinlah thilphabol jeh a gimbolna nathoh uva thohhattah a napanuva ahileh, Pathen nachunguva lunglhaiyah ahi.
en_web: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
en_kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu chonsetna jeh-in min deng hen lang thip beh-in thoh thoh jeng leu chun ipi phachom am? Chusangin thilpha bolna chunga hesoh genthei thoh thoh leu chun hichu Pathen dia kipana ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christan nangho dinga gimbol hesoh athoh banga chu gimthohna ding hijongleh thilpha boldinga nakouvu ahi. Ama navettoh uva najui dingu chule akhonung najui dingu ahiye.
en_web: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
en_kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
tcz_gospelgo: Christan nang ho dia hesoh genthei athoh a vetkah ding khat nadalhah peh-uva, nang hon ama khonung najui diu deinaa, hiche dinga chu kikou nahiuve.

tcz: Ama achonse khapoi, koima cha jong alhemlha khapoi.
en_web: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
en_kjv: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
tcz_gospelgo: “Aman chonset abolpon, Akamsunga jong doha lhep lhahna akimudohpoi,” akiti.

tcz: Ama ajumsou jong chun alethuhpoi, agimhesoh thoh pet in jong akithuhpoi. Aman achungchang thu adihtah a thutan jing Pathen khut a angam lhan ahi.
en_web: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
en_kjv: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
tcz_gospelgo: Houset achanin ahouse thuh pon, athohgim pet’in jong agihsalpoi; dihtah a thutanpa koma akipedohjoi.

tcz: Amatah in atahsa chunga ichonsetna hou thingpel chunga chun apoi, hichu eiho chonsetna lama ithiuva chule chonphatna lama ihin theina dingu ahi. Ama kijepna mahahoa chu nanghon damna namu u ahi.
en_web: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
en_kjv: who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman eiho chonset jouse atahsaphen apon, thingpel chunggeiyin apodoh-in, chonsetna jousea i-thiuva, themchanna a ihin theina diuvin aboltan, ama kijepna mahan eidamsah tauve.

tcz: Nangho masanga chu avah manga nana hiu ahin, hinlah tun na Chingpau, na lhagaovu Kaihoipa henga chu hung kilekit'ah nahi tauve.
en_web: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
en_kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho kelngoite banga vahcheh gam nahitauvin, tua nahinkhou vettuppeh Pa le na chingpau henga hung kilekit nahitauve.

tcz: Chutima chun, nangho ji numei hon napasalteu thuneina chu kisan uvin. Chutengleh, amaho lah a Kipana Thupha joplou aum tah jongleh, thuchenga seilouva na Pathen ngaisahnau navetsah uchun thu aseijoh ding ahi. Amaho nathujona ding uchu,
en_web: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
en_kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche bang chun numei jouse najipateu noiya kunjel’uvin, chutile thu ngailou ho jeng jong chu numeiho khanthem jeh a thu phalouva kihinsojo ding ahi;

tcz: Nanghon thenna le jana hinkho naman'u amuuva kon hiding ahi.
en_web: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
en_kjv: while they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
tcz_gospelgo: nagin themjeu le nakhan themu, boh beh louhel chu vetsah-uvin.

tcz: Polam hoina khohsahnan sampheh a kijep hoi, thil mantam sana khi-o ahilouleh ponsil hoi hoa kijem ding gelkhoh hih un.
en_web: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
en_kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
tcz_gospelgo: Sampheh hoi le sana khi-o, leiset ponsil nihchen hoiya, polam thil’a kijem louvin,

tcz: Nangho sunggila kona hoina, chultheilou lungneng le thip khen cha um, hichea chu nakijep joh dingu ahi, hichu Pathena dinga manlutah ahi.
en_web: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
en_kjv: but let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen angsunga manlu tah, chul thei lou, Lhagaova nunnem le lungnem, lungthimgil’a mihem giltah joh chun kijem’un.

tcz: Hiche hi malai numei theng masa ho amaho tah akijep hoinau chu anahi. Amahon Pathen atahsanun chule ajipateu thuneina chu anakisan u ahi.
en_web: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
en_kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile masang laiya numei theng, Pathen’a kinem jing ho jong chu hitia hi anakijem ahiuvin, ajipateu thu thun anung’ui.

tcz: Avetsahnan, Sarah chu ajipa Abraham, thun anungin, chule ajipa chu ka-pakai tin akouve. Najipa teuvin ipi ahinbol dingu kichatna neilou hel'a nanghon thilpha chu naboluva ahileh ama chanute nahiu ahi.
en_web: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
en_kjv: even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
tcz_gospelgo: Sarah jong chu Abraham thun anungin, amapa chu Pakaiti geiyin aseiye; nang hon imacha ginglouhel’a amanu thilpha bol tobang chu nabol’u le achate nahiuve.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, pasal nanghon najinu teu jabolun. Nijinu teu chuto umkhom'a nahiu toh kilhon in hetkhen themna neijin bolun. Ama nangho sanga thalhomjo hitheinante, hinlah Pathen in hinkho thah a hinkho naman khompi dinga napeh-u chu ahi. Nataonau adal louna dingin amaho chu nabolna dingdola chun bolin.
en_web: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
en_kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobangma chun pasal hon jong numei ho chu alhasamjo, bel kehbai tobang ahi heuvin, jabol chansah-un lang, lungsetna hinkho naneikhomu jong ahijeh-in, chenkhompiuvin, chutile nataokhom nau suh noh phah a um lou ding ahi.

tcz: Achainakeiyin, nangho jouse lungkhat kisauvin. Khatle khat kigelkhohto uvin. Sopi hina in kingailu touvin. Lungneng unlang chule kineosah cheh un.
en_web: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
en_kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
tcz_gospelgo: Achai nan nabonchan lungkhat hiuvin, kilainatto cheh-un, kisopi ngailut’un, kidipdap to’uvin, nun nem’un lang,

tcz: Setna chu asen lethuh hih un. Mihon najumso tenguleh jumso kitna ding lunggel hih un. Hisang chun phattheiboh jouvin. Hichu Pathen in nabol dinga nakouna chu ahi, chule Aman hiche jal a chu phatthei naboh ding ahi.
en_web: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
en_kjv: not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
tcz_gospelgo: setna chu setnan thuh dauvin, houset chu house thuh hih-un, chusangin phatthei bohjo’uvin, ajeh chu phatthei boh lo dinga kikou nahibouvui.

tcz: Ajehchu, Pathen Thubun asei chu, “Nangman hinkho chu nakipapia, nikho kipa um tampi namu noma ahileh, naleigui chu thilse seinaa konin kihuh tup in, thilpha bolin chule namuh chu jou seina a konin kikangsen.
en_web: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
en_kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile: “Hinna ngailut ding deiya, Nikho phaho mu ding nom’an Gitlouna akonin alei tuh tang hen, Akamin jong doha lhep lhahna seida hen.

tcz: Thil phalouva konin kiheimangin, chule thilpha chu bol in.
en_web: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
en_kjv: let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu agilouva konin kihei mang hen thilpha boljo hen. Chamna hol hen lang hichu jui jing hen.

tcz: Thildih bolho chu Pakaiyin ntin a avetsui ahi, chule ataonau ngaina in anakol asung jinge. Hinlah Pakai chun thilse bol ho dounaa amai angat jing ahi.”
en_web: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
en_kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin midihte ave-lhi jingin, Atao nau angai lhi jing jenge; Thilse bolte Pakaiyin avesal jinge,” ati.

tcz: Tun, nanghon thilpha nabol nomuva ahileh koiham nasugim dinguva?
en_web: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
en_kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho thilpha bolna dinga tom ngaitah nahiule, kon nabolset diu ham?

tcz: Thildih boljeh a hahsatna nato tah uva ahijongleh, Pathen in hichea chu nale thuhding ahi. Hijehchun, amaho gihsal jeh chun lung himo ahilouleh kichat bol hih un.
en_web: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
en_kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla adih jal’in hesoh genthei thoh tahbeh jong leu chun anun nom nahiuve. Amavang hite ho ginna chun kicha loujen’un, lung jong lungkham hih-un.

tcz: Chusanga nangman Christa chu nahinkhoa Pakaiya nanei ding hiya ahi. Chule koiham khat'in na-Christian hina anakinepna thudol chu nadoh a ahileh hilchenin.
en_web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
en_kjv: but sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang nalungthim’uva Christa chu Pakai ahina bangin athengin geljingun, nasunguva um kinepna thudol chu adonga aum le kitoh chet’a donbut din phat jousen kigosademin um’uvin.

tcz: Hinlah hiche hi lungneng le jatheiyin bolin. Selepha nahetna chu thengin koiyin. Chua chu mihon nangho douna a thu aseiyuva ahileh amahon Christa a nahijeh uva hinkho phatah naman chu amu tenguleh jahcha dingu ahi.
en_web: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
en_kjv: having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungnem le ginggeh chan bol’un, ima datkhenna pha neiyun, chutile Christa jal’a nachonphat nau seise ho chu athuseiyuva kijumso diu ahi.

tcz: Geldoh in, thilphalou boljeh a gimthoh sanga chu, thilpha bol jeh a gimthoh chu Pathen deilam ahijoi.
en_web: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
en_kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
tcz_gospelgo: Thilse boljeh a hesoh genthei thoh sanga, Pathen lungdei lam ahile thilpha boljeh a genthei hesoh thoh chu gamchenga phajo ahi.

tcz: Christa chun a-itih a dinga khatvei athohgim ahi. Ama achonse khapoi, hinlah ama Pathen kom a chu bit keicha lhun theina dinga chonseho jeh a thia ahi. Aman tahsa tah a thina ato ahin, hinlah Ama Lhagaova kaithouva uma hingdoh kit ahi.
en_web: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
en_kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu chonset jeh a nang ho dia Chritan hesoh genthei khatvei thoh a athoh a, midih lou ho dinga midih chun athoh a, nang ho Pathen kom na lhut theina diu abol ahin, tahsaphea thia Lhagaova hing ahitai.

tcz: Hiti chun, Ama gachea lhagao songkul'a kihenho koma aga seiphong ahitai.
en_web: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
en_kjv: by which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagaova chea, Lhagaova songkul lut ho henga thu agahil lhang lea,

tcz: Amaho hi masanglai peh a Noah chun kong anasui laiya Pathen in thoh hattah'a anga laiya Pathen thua nung louva ahiuve. Hiche tijat umtah twisanglet'a lhah lhumna dinga kona chu mi get bou sohchaa ahiuve.
en_web: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
en_kjv: which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
tcz_gospelgo: Noah nikho laiya Pathenin lungde hattah a angauva, Kong innei kisui laisea Pathen thu ngailou lhagao ho chu agahil ahi; twisanglet’a kong sunga sohchaa chu mihem themcha, get seh bou ahiuve.

tcz: Chule hiche twi chu baptize chan vetsahna ahi, hichun tua hi nahuhhingu ahi, tipuma anen pailhahna hilouva, Pathen lama selepha hetna kichehna ding ahi. Yeshua Christa thodoh kit jal a hichun na atoh ahiye.
en_web: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
en_kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Tua chuche twisanglet lim’a kibol Baptize chan hin tahsaphe nen suhthengna hilouva, lungthim gelkhen themna phaa Pathen henga kitepna kisem’a, thinaa kona Jesu Christa thodoh jal’a nahuhhingu ahitai.

tcz: Tun Christa chu van'a gachea ahitan, Ama Pathen bantah a jabol channa muna touva ahitai, chule Vantilte le athuneiho chule thaneiho jousen Ama thuneina asangun ahi.
en_web: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
en_kjv: who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa chu van’a akaltouvin Pathen jetlam’a atouvin, Vantil jouse le thuneina, thahatna jouse ama noiya alutsoh tai.

tcz: Hiti chu ahin, Christa chun tahsaa athoh gim tah jeh in, Ama a um lungput chu nanghon jong naneiyu angaiye, chule gimthoh dingin kigosan umun. Ajeh chu nanghon Christa jal a tahsa lama gim hesoh nathoh uva ahileh chonset chu najou tauve.
en_web: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
en_kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
tcz_gospelgo: Christan tahsphea athohgim bang chun nang ho chutobang din kivon’uvin, ajeh chu tahsaphea thohgima chu chonset’a kona ong doh del ahi.

tcz: Nanghon nahinkhou aum chengse chu nangma ho lung ngaichatlam chu holtalouva, Pathen lunglam joh chu bol nomna nanei dingu ahitai.
en_web: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
en_kjv: that he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuti ahijeh-in tahsaphea nahinna dingu phat um nalai sea jong hin, mihem lunggul lama hilouvin, Pathen lungdei lamjoh-in hungun.

tcz: Nang hon chidang namdang nahilai uva chu Pathen ngaisahlouna lunggotlam nathanopnau, chonhoilou le tahsa lung ngaichat, kinopvahna le jukhamna chule motchon tothoa lamna, chule milim houna'a tijat jat um nanabol u chu aphaset ahitai.
en_web: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
en_kjv: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile khohsa louhel’a phat sotpi hi chidang namdangten atohnom lam jonthanhoi, huh, jinuh hat, nopsahna, julop, dan neiloule semthu doilim houlam’a kimang nahiuvin, hichu pha set tante.

tcz: Amahon setna chu twisoh banga motchon le man thahna thei thil ho aboluva chu nathanoppi tahloujeh uva chu nana kivoppi hou chun adat mouva hitia chu naseiset u ahibouve.
en_web: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
en_kjv: wherein they think it strange that you run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi nang hon amaho chonval manthahna chu najop lou phat’uva kidang saa natai pongjiu ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah geldoh un, amahon amitakip ahing le athiho chung thutan ding Pathen chu akimutopi diu ahi.
en_web: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
en_kjv: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihing le mithi thutan dinga kigosadempa ang’a amahon achung thuu akipeh lut diu ahinai.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Kipana Thupha thu chu tua athiho henga kiseiphonga ahitai-hichu amaho midang jouse banga athi diu gonchaisa ahiuvin, tua hi amaho Pathen toa-i-tih a dinga lhagaova hing jing dinga gonsa ahitauve.
en_web: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
en_kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu mithi ho jeng jong tahsaphea ahin laiyun, mihemdol’in athuu kitanta jong le, Pathen lama Lhagaova ahinna diuva Kipana Thupha agaseipeh ahiuve.

tcz: Vannoi kichaina ding phat hung lhung pai ding ahitai. Hiti ahijeh chun lungdih tah pun chule tao jingna dingin limgeh chan umun.
en_web: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
en_kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil jouse kichaina ding anai tai. Hijeh chun tao dingin lunglimgeh le kitim themin um jingun.

tcz: Athupi penin, khat le khat kingailutna nangho khat in khat chunga neiyuvin, ajeh chu ngailut hin chonset tamtah akhun ahi.
en_web: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
en_kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Imajouse chungvuma nang hon khat le khat ki-ngailutna giltah neiyun, ajeh chu ngailut nan chonset tampi jong akhujol theiye.

tcz: Nehding ngaicha ahilouleh umna ding hol a chu kipahtah in na-in'a lhunsah un.
en_web: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
en_kjv: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
tcz_gospelgo: Phunchel louhel’in khat le khat kilhunsah to’uvin.

tcz: Pathen in nangho khat chang cheh hi lhagao thilpeh ho napeh cheh u ahi. Hichu khat le khat kijen nan mangun.
en_web: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
en_kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lungsetna Jatchom chom gouching phatah bangin, amitakip Lhagao thilpeh akisan cheh chu khat le khat kijento nan mang chauvin.

tcz: Thusei theina lhagao thilpeh nakipe em? Chuti ahileh Pathen in nang koma thu asei bangtah in seijin. Midang kithopina thilpeh nachan em? Pathen in thahat le thaneina napeh chu panin bol'in. Chutileh nabol jouse chu Yeshua Christa jal in Pathen loupina hung hitheiyinte. Aimatih chanin loupina le thaneina jouse chu Ama a hi jing hen! Amen.
en_web: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile thuseiyan Pathen thubou seihen; lhacha kinbol’an jong Pathenin apeh thahat dungjuiyin bol hen; chutile ima jousea Jesu Christa jal’a Pathen chu vahchoiya um jing ding ahi, Jesu Christaa loupina le thahat tonsot’a um jing jeng ahi: Amen.

tcz: Deitah teho, nanghon patepna meikou banga hahsa nathoh u chu, thil nahet khahlou hel'u nato'u tobang'in datmo hih un.
en_web: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
en_kjv: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, nang ho patepna dia nalah-uva meikou banga hung um chu, thil kidang nachunguva soh bangin datmo hih-uvin.

tcz: Chusangin hapan kipah jouvin–ijeh inem itileh nanghon Christan athoh gimna a chu chan neikhoma nahiuve, hitia chu Aloupina kipana kidangtah chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh tengleh nanghon namuva nanei dingu ahi.
en_web: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
en_kjv: but rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
tcz_gospelgo: Chusangin ama loupina ahung kiphondoh teng le lhingset’a nakipana diuvin Christa thohgimna chu thoh khompijo’uvin.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun Christian nahi jeh uva najachatsah tengu jongleh kipah un, ajeh chu loupina Pathen lhagao chu nachunguva uma ahi.
en_web: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
en_kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho Christa min jal’a houset nachan’u le anun nom nahiuve, ajeh chu loupina le Pathen Lhagao nachunguva hung chua ahitai.

tcz: Hinama jongleh nathoh gimnau chu tolthat hijeh, guhchat jeh, setboljeh, ahilouva ahileh midang chunga kikum jeh hida hen.
en_web: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
en_kjv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalah-uva koi hile toltha jeh ham, guhchat jeh ham, mi tohna chunga khut lhah jeh ham jeh-in thohgim da hen.

tcz: Ahin Christian hijeh a thohgim chu jachatna ding ahipoi. Amina kikou nahi jal in Pathen chu vahchoiyin!
en_web: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
en_kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Christian hijeh a thohgim’a chun jachatnan neida hen, Christian min chun Pathen choi-anjo hen.

tcz: Ajeh chu thutanna phat hung lhunga ahitai, chule Pathen insung pumpia kipan ding ahi. Chule thutanna chu eihoa akipat a ahileh, Pathen Kipana Thupha joplou ho chan ding chu iti tijat um hiding hitam?
en_web: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
en_kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu thutanna ding phat hung lhunga Pathen insunga kipanding ahitan, eiho chunga akipat masah le, Pathena kon Kipana Thupha ngailoute akichaina ding chu ipi hitan tem?

tcz: Chukit jongleh, “Mi dih chu huhhing ahahsatleh, Pathen ngaisahlou chonseho ititauvin tem?”
en_web: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
en_kjv: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu: “Midih dinga huhinga um ahahsat le Pathen ngaisah loule chonseten hoilam asuh diu hitam?” akiti.

tcz: Hitia chu Pathen lunglhaina a gim nathoh uva ahileh, adih chu boljom jingun, chule nahinkhou chu nasempau Pathena ngamlhauvin, ajeh chu Aman itinama jongleh nalha kanglou dingu ahi.
en_web: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
en_kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pathen lungdeiya hesoh genthei thoh ho chun hitobanga chu thilpha abol jinguva ahinkhou tahsan umtah Asempau khut’a apehdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Chule tun, houbung hoa Upa ho henga, keima jong Upa khat hina a Christa gimthohna a chan kachan khompi hina a kathumop nom nahiuve. Chule, keima jong, Ama loupina a chu vannoiya ahung kilah teng chuleh aloupina chu chang khom ding kahi. Upat nachan khompiu keiman nahenguva kahin ngeh nahiuve:
en_web: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
en_kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
tcz_gospelgo: Christa thohgimna hetoh le ahung kiphongdoh ding loupina chankhompi chule na-upat piu khat kahijeh a nalah-uva upate ka-ngeh nahiuve;

tcz: Pathen in chin dinga nanganseu kelngoi hon chengse chu chingun. Lungcham tah in, lunghimo louhelin bolun-nanghon ipi phatchomna kakimudoh theidem ti hilouvin, Pathen na natoh nom joh jeh uvin bol jouvin.
en_web: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
en_kjv: feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
tcz_gospelgo: nalah-uva Pathen kelngoi hon um chu chingphauvin, bol lou phamoa vetup hilouvin, Pathen deidol’in lung chamtah-in boljo’uvin, alam louva phatchom ding deina jong hilouvin, lung guttenin bol’un.

tcz: Na kinganse hou chunga kipiputsahna bol louvin, na umchanhoi chu vetsah in puihoi jouvin.
en_web: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
en_kjv: neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
tcz_gospelgo: Nakichinsah ho chunga kipiput sah louvin, kelngoi honin avetsuiya, ajui thei din umjo’uvin.

tcz: Chule Kelngoi ching pipu ahung kilah teng chuleh, nanghon aitih a abeitih umlou loupina le jabolna Lallukhuh chu nachan dingu ahi.
en_web: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
en_kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu kelngoi Chingpipu ahung kilah teng le nang hon chul thei lou loupina lallukhuh chu nasan diu ahi.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, nangho khangdong hon jong Upa vaihom ho thuneina chu noppeh un. Chule nangho nabonchauvin, khat in khat kineosah pumin jenun, ajeh chu “Pathen in akiletsah chu adouvin, akineosah mi vang chu alung lhaina ahi.”
en_web: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
en_kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang chun khangdong ho jong upate thun nunguvin. Nabonchauvin khat’in khat chunga din kineosahna chu ponsil bangin kivon’un; ijeh-inem itile: “Pathenin mi kiletsahte adoudal’in, Kineosate chu lungsetna apei,” akiti.

tcz: Hiti chun nangho Pathen thahattah thaneina noiya umun chule aman aphatcha jabolna tohthoa nachoisang dingu ahi.
en_web: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
en_kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Pathen ban-gol kha tah noiya kisunemsoh keiyun, chutile aman aphat cha nachoisang thei diu ahi.

tcz: Nalung khamnahou le nagelkhoh hou chu Pathena peuvin, ijeh inem itileh aman nachung chang thu nagelkhoh pehnai.
en_web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
en_kjv: casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
tcz_gospelgo: Nalungkhamna jouseu Ama chunga sep lhauvin, ajeh chu aman nakhankho diu agel nai.

tcz: Kichih theiyuvin! Namelmau pipu, Diabol jeh chun kihong phauvin. Ama keipi bahkai kitum tobang'in vallhum ding mi ahol in ahi.
en_web: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
en_kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
tcz_gospelgo: Lung limgeh-un, kigingphauvin. Nakidoupi Diabol chu Phaisameigeo kitumlet lut banga, koi hijongle val lhum jeng dia vah lea ahol ahi.

tcz: Ama dounaa dingdet un, chule natahsan nauva chun hat'un. Vannoi pumpia nasopiu Christian ho chu nangho banga thohgimna atocheh u ahi.
en_web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
en_kjv: whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Nadoupau chu tahsan nan kidinte piuvin, vannoiya nasopite jousen jong hitobang hesoh genthei thoh hahsa hi athohsoh keiyu nahetsau ahi.

tcz: Pathen in amikhoto themna Christa Yeshua jal a tonsot aloupina chu chang dinga nakouvu ahitai.
en_web: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
en_kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us into his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
tcz_gospelgo: Lungsetna tin cheng kimsoh Pathen, Christa jal’a aloupina dinga tonsot’a dia nakoupauvin, chom khat gim genthei nathoh jou tengu le nasem phat’uva, nasuhdet diu ahi.

tcz: Amaa thaneina chu tonsot tonsotin hijing hen! Amen.
en_web: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
en_kjv: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu tonsot geiyin tha hatna chang jing hen: Amen.

tcz: Tahsan umtah sopi Silas, nangho koma seiphatna kapeh, ama kithopina jal a hiche lekhathot chomcha hi nahenguva dinga kahin jih ahi. Nakomuva dinga kahin jihlona ajeh chu nanghon tua hi Pathen lungset nachan tahbeh u ahi tia tilkhouna le photchetsahnaa ding ahi. Hiche lungsetna a hin ding det un.
en_web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
en_kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
tcz_gospelgo: Kageldol’a tahsan umtah sopi Silvanus kamanchah a hichelekha thot chomcha hi kahinsut’a, Pathen lungsetna atahbeh ahidol hi tilkhouva kahettohsah nahiuve; hichea chun dingdet jingun.

tcz: Hikom Rome muna na-houbung chanpiu le kachapa Mark in jong chibai nahin peuve.
en_web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
en_kjv: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhenchom nahipiu Babylon gama um nu le kachapa Mark-in nasalam’ui.

tcz: Christian kingailutna chun khat in khat chibai kibohtouvin. Christa Yeshua a umho jouse cham-lungmonna in na umpiu hen.
en_web: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
en_kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailut nan kichopto’uvin, khat le khat kisalam’uvin. Christa to hingkhom jouse nachunguva cham leng hen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa soh le solchah, Simon Peter a kon ahi. Keiman tahsan manlu tah kanei khompi ho henga kahin jih ahi. Hiche tahsan hi thutandih le pha nahin peuva eihuhhing uva le IPathenu Yeshua Christa jal jeh ahi.
en_web: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
en_kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu Christa soh, solchah a pang Simon Peterin, huhhingpa Jesu Christa le i-Pathen’u dihna jal’a keiho to kibang cheh a tahsanna chang jouse henga:
