tcz: Nanghon Pathen le IPakaiyu Yeshua nahet nau lama nakhantouna dingun Pathen in nangho lungset le cham-lungmon napeh be jingu hen.
en_web: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
en_kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nahet nauva konin lungsetna le chamna nachunguva lhingset’in pungjal hen.

tcz: Aman Pathena kona thahatna anei jal'in, Pathen ngaisahna hinkho iman theina dinguvin Aman ingaichat jouseu eipetauve. Ama dinga eikoupau hin Ama hetna ineiyuva kona Aloupina kidangtah le ahoipen hina jal'a eihon hicheho jouse hi ikisanu ahi.
en_web: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
en_kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
tcz_gospelgo: Ama loupina le aphatna chankhompi dinga eikoupau ihet jehuva, Pathen ngaisah a hintheina dia, thil ijakai aboncha a Pathen thahatna kona eipeh-u ahitai.

tcz: Chule aloupina le ahoipen hina jal'in Aman thutep lentah le manlutah eipetauve. Hiche athutep ho hi Pathen ahina a chan neikhompina le mihem lung ngaichat vannoi kisuhbohna a kona onthol theina ahi.
en_web: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
en_kjv: whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these you might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust:
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoiya umsa tahsa lunggul manthahnaa kona jamdoh a, hichea kona chu Pathen hinna lim chu ichankhompi theina diuva, hiti thudol’a chu thutep chung nung pen manlu tah chu eipeh-u ahi.

tcz: Hicheho jouse jal hin, Pathen thutep ho channa dingin kihabol un, natahsan nau chu umchanhoi pendoh nan neiyun, chule umchanhoi penna chun hetna,
en_web: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
en_kjv: and beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh tah chun najo chanin bol’un lang phatna chu natahsan’u belap sah-un, phatna chu hetna be lap sah un,

tcz: chule hetna chun chang kitim themna, chule chang kitim themna chun thohhatna chule thohhatna chun Pathen ngaisahna,
en_web: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
en_kjv: and to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
tcz_gospelgo: hetna chu kitim themna belap sah-un, kitim themna chu thoh hatnan belap sah un, thohhat na chu Pathen ngaisah nan belap sah-un;

tcz: chule Pathen ngaisahna chun sopi hina a kigelkhoh tona a amichang cheh ngailutna sodoh hen.
en_web: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
en_kjv: and to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen ngaisahna chu kisopi ngailutnan belapsah un, kisopi ngailut chu ngailut nan belap sah-uvin.

tcz: Hitia nakhan toube cheh nauva chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa hetna a chu gasoa chule phatchomna nanei dingu ahi.
en_web: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile nang hon hicheng hi bulhingset’a naneiyule, hichun i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nahet nauva chatmo le ga beiya nakoi louhel diu ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hichea khantouna neilou ho chun chomcha ding bou amuu ahilouleh mitchouva, amaho achonsetnau masaa kona chu kisilngima ahiu asuhmil jiu ahitai.
en_web: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
en_kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see far off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng neilou mi chu mitcho, khomu lou ahin, masang achonsetna chengsea kona kisop thengsa ahichu asumiljitai.

tcz: Hitichun sopi deitahte, nanghon Pathen in nakouvu adeilhenna a chu najaovu ahi photchennan, kiseh in tonggimun. Hiche hohi bolleu chun, nangho nalhah manglou hel diu ahi.
en_web: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
en_kjv: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun sopite, nakikou nau le nakilhendoh nau chu kichetsahna din kihabol cheh kit’un; chuti bol leu chun itih chan ajong nakipal lhuh lou diu ahi.

tcz: Chutengleh Pathen in IPakaiyu le Huhhingpu Yeshua Christa tonsot Lenggama luttheina dia phalna namu dingu ahitai.
en_web: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: for so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti dol’a chu i-Pakaiyu le huhhingpa Jesu Christa tonsot lenggam sunga lutna thei lhingset’a nanei diu ahiye.

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu, hiche ho thudol hi keiman avel a kageldoh sahkit jing ding nahiuve-nangho hichu nahetsau le hiche thutah nakihil sauva chu nadin det u ahitai.
en_web: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
en_kjv: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be stablished in the present truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon nahetsau le naneisau thutah achu dettah a pangdet hita jong leu chun hiti hohi geldohsah jing dinga kagot ahi.

tcz: Chule hichebou hi adih chu ahin, keiman kahinlai sunga kavel geldoh sah jing ding nahiuve.
en_web: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
en_kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche pon-in tobang tahsaphea kahin laisea, hiti thudol hea nang ho geldohsah jinga, mit hah jinga umsah ding hi dih kasai.

tcz: Ajeh chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah vahding ahitai ti eiseipeh ahitai.
en_web: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
en_kjv: knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan eihetsah dungjuiyin pon-in tobang hiche katahsa hi kadalhah loiding kahetai.

tcz: Hitia hi keima kache nung jong leh hiche hohi nana geldoh jingna dinguva keima kiseh tah a pang jing ding kahi.
en_web: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
en_kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
tcz_gospelgo: Kapotdoh nung teng geiya hiche ho hi nageldoh jing theina diuva kajochan’a na habola kabol ding ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu keihon IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa thaneitah a ahung thudol nangho kaseipeh u chun semthu thusim seiya kanahi pouve. Keihon aloupina gunchena bulhingset kamit tah uva kana mu u chun,
en_web: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
en_kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
tcz_gospelgo: Keihon i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa le ahung kit ding thu nang ho kahetsah-uva chu semthu thusim pou mangchaa seikahipouvin, alal loupina mittah a mua kaseiyu ahibouve.

tcz: Pa Pathena kona jana le loupina Aman anamu ahitai. Pathen loupi thaneinaa aw chun ajah a, “Hiche hi keiman kangailut tah, kipana sangtah eipea ka Chapa ahi,” ati.
en_web: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
en_kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile aman Pa Pathena kona jabolna le loupina akisan’a, lal loupi chungnungpen a kona ahenga hung ging 0-chun “Nangma kachapa deitah nahin, nachunga ka lung alhai ta-ngeiye,” atipet tah chun

tcz: Keihotah in Amatoh moltheng chunga kaumpet'un vana kon in hiche aw chu kajauvin ahi.
en_web: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
en_kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
tcz_gospelgo: ama le keiho molvum theng chunga ka-umkhomuve, hiche ogin chu van’a kona hung ahi kajauve.

tcz: Hiche hetchetna neijal hin, keihon themgao ho thupoh kaseiphongu hi kakihason chehna theiyu aumin ahi. Amahon ajih u thudol hi phatah a vetsuina naneiyu angaiye, ajeh chu athuseiyu hi muthimlah a meivah kidevah tobanga, kho ahungvah lhah kahsea, chule Christa Jing Valpa chu nalung sunguva kona ahung vahdoh kahsea ding ahi.
en_web: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
en_kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Themgao thusei chu ginchatna dettah kaneiyun, nang hon jong khoh sah leu chun aphai, ajeh chu hiche hi munthim laiya khovah lhah geiya kivah tobang le nalungthim sunguva dia Jingvalpa vah tobang ahi.

tcz: Hicheho jouse chunga hin, Pathen Lekhabua themgao thusei dohho hi themgao ama hetna lungthima hungpeng ahipoi, ti nahetdoh'u ngai ahi.
en_web: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
en_kjv: knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
tcz_gospelgo: Amasa hiche hi nahet diu ahi, Themgao thusei kisundoh jouse hi koiman achamtah a aledoh a ahilchet theidol ahipoi;

tcz: Ahilouleh mihem lung gela kona jong ahipoi, chuche themgao ho chu Lhagao Thengin athunun uva, chule amahon Pathena kona aseidoh u ahi.
en_web: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
en_kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu gaothusei khat cha beh jong hi mihem lungdeiya hung um doh ahipoi, Lhagao Theng cho-thouva mihemhon Pathena kona aseidohji ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah Israel lah a jong themgao dihlouho ana um tobanga chu nangho lah a jong thuhil dihlou hung um ding ahiuve. Amaho chun chingthei tah a mahthahna thei thuhil phalou ahil dingu chule aPakaiyu amaho chodohpa geiya ahinseilep nahlai dingu ahi. Hitiahi, amaho tah in phulou helouva amah thahna dingu ahin kilhut dingu ahi.
en_web: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
en_kjv: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Mipi lah a Themgao lhem ho anaum banga chu, nang ho lah a jong mihil lhem ho hung sohdoh diu ahi; amaho hin manthahna thuhil lhem ahinpoh doh-uva, amaho chodoh Pakai jeng jong aseilep diu, man gangtah a achunguva manthahna akilhut khum diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho thuhil phalou le jachat umtah ajonthan hoinauhi mitampin ahinjui ding ahiuve. Chule hiche thuhil choiho jeh'a hi thutah lampi hi seiset a hung um ding ahi.
en_web: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
en_kjv: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
tcz_gospelgo: Tampin ahuh nau nung ajuiyuva, amaho jeh a chu thutah lampi jeng jong taitom’a hung um ding ahi.

tcz: Ama ho chun chingthei tah a jou aseiyuva, nasum'u chu ahin kisip tup dingu ahi. Hinlah Pathen in amaho chu masangpeh a themmo achansau ahin, chule amah thahna dingu chu kho ngaisot lou helding ahi.
en_web: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
en_kjv: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
tcz_gospelgo: Jou thua kiloset sumkolveina nahin nei dingu ahi; ahinla masanga pat achung thuu kitansa chu akipel hih laiyin, asumang pau jong alulhu hih laiye.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in vantil achonseho jeng jong akhendehlou ahi. Aman amaho chu muthim lhangkhal kiheh gomtong sunga, Damuna chu alelut jenga, thutanna nikho lhin kahsea dinga akhum tup ahi.
en_web: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
en_kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin Vantil chonse ho jeng jong khen louhel’in Damun’a aleh lut jengin, hikoma chun Thupi tan ngah din muthim lah a thih khaovin ahen’e.

tcz: Chule Pathen in vannoi mi masa jong chu-Noah le ainsung mi sagi tailou anakhen dehpoi. Noah chun vannoi mite chu Pathen thutandih thua anahilchah ahi. Hitia hi Pathen in vannoi pumpia Ama ngaisah louho twisang let'a asuh manga Noah ana huhdoh ahi.
en_web: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
en_kjv: and spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen helou leiset, leiset masa, twisang alet khumsah a asuh mang chun khen aneipoi, them channa thuseiphonga pang Noah le adang mihem sagi chubou akhendoh-e.

tcz: Khonungin, Pathen in Sodom le Gomorrah khopi teni jong themmo achanin, vutvai kisetkhomna mun asohtai. Aman amaho chu Ama ngaisah lou ho chunga ipi ahungso ding avetsah ahitai.
en_web: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
en_kjv: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
tcz_gospelgo: Sodom le Gomorrah khopi te ni chung thu atan jong chun vutvam asosah jengin, Pathen ngaisah lou ding mite chunga thu soh vetkah nan asumangtai.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Lot jong chu midih ahijeh'in Sodoma konin ahuh doh e, ajeh chu akimvel a jachat umtah'a huhna nei migilou ho chu alungnat pin ahi.
en_web: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
en_kjv: and delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
tcz_gospelgo: Huh lama kipe, chonseho jal’a hesoh gentheiya um midih Lot chu ahuhdoh-e.

tcz: Ahi, Lotchu midih khat anahin, ama chun miho phatlouna ani ania ajah le amu ho chu alung thimah athoh gimpin ahi.
en_web: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
en_kjv: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hiche midih chu alah-uva chenga, danbeiya athilbol ho’u ani nia amua, ajah le them changa um ahinkho jeng jong hesoh genthei thoh a um ahitai.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman namui, Pakaiyin Ama ngaisah ho chu thoh hasatna atonauva kona iti ahuhdoh ding ahen, Aman migilou chu hahsat thutanna nunung nikho lhinkah jenga jong gimbolna munah akoiye ahenai.
en_web: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
en_kjv: the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
tcz_gospelgo: Pakaiyin Pathen ngaisahte patep’a aum nauva kona huhdohje ahen, adih lou ho thutan nikhoa talen matsah dinga koije jong ahei;

tcz: Aman adehset in huh lung ngaichat neiho le thuneina neiho ijaseplou ho chunga alung hang dehset in ahi. Amaho hi akiletsah uvin chule alouchalun, kichatna neilou hel'in achungnung thuneiho jong atai tomun, kicha'a kithin ding jong ago pouvin ahi.
en_web: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
en_kjv: but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
tcz_gospelgo: ahideh chun tahsaphe lunggul lam jenga kipea chon ho, Vaipopa nah sah lou ho ahiuve. Amaho hi angol han’un, alung chamin achon’uvin, loupina changsa ho jeng jong taitom ding akicha pouve.

tcz: Hinlah vantil ho, gamchenga thanei joa le thahatjo ho, chun chungnungjo thaneina neiho chunga chun Pakaiya konin taitomna thucheng alhutngam pouve.
en_web: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
en_kjv: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Vantilte chu amaho sanga thunei le thaneijo ahi vangun, Pakai ang sunga amaho houset’a taitomna ima ahinlhut pouvin ahi.

tcz: Hiche thuhil dihlou ho hi lung geltohlou gamsa tobang ahiuvin, alungphut dung jui uva chon, ahing chang uva mat'a chule suhmang theibep dia penga ahiuve. Amahon ahetlouvu aseiseuvin, chule ganhingho banga kisumang ding ahiuve.
en_web: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
en_kjv: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche miho vang hi lungthimbei, gamsa tobang, amangthah dinga mihem ngaiya pang mai mai ahiuvin, hetna beiya taitom ahiuve; hijeh a chu amanthahna diuva mangthah tei diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho amanthahna dingu chu thilse abolnau jaljeh a atohgao asan dingu ahi. Amahon sunlai nipi noiya ase bolding chu lunga thanopna aneiyuve. Amaho chu lungsetna bei le setbol mi, nalah uva um ahiuve. Amaho mi doha bolna a athau anomun, nanghotoh nakiloikhom nauva an naneh khomnauva alhauve.
en_web: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
en_kjv: and shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
tcz_gospelgo: Alam louva abol man’u adih lou akisan diu; sun chang laiya aning anop’a chonjeng hi lung nachimna ageluva, boh beh le nolna um ahiuvin, doha nalhep’uva nopsahna dinga nang ho to ankong aumkhomjiu ahi.

tcz: Amahon amit uva jon abol'un chule chonset angaichatnau lungkimna aneipouve. Amahon lungdetna neilou ho chonsetnaa apuilut un, chule chipsetna lama phatah a kikhoukhah a ahiuve. Amaho Pathen gaosapna noiya hinga ahiuve.
en_web: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
en_kjv: having eyes full of adultery and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: a heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
tcz_gospelgo: Amit’u la jongthanhoi na ding adimset’in, chonset bol la atang theipouve; hinkhoa dindetna beiho chu ajol lhauvin, sumselna lam jenga kihil themsa lungthim aneiyun, sapset chang chate ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho lamdih a kona pampet'a ahitauvin, chule Beor chapa Balaam, thilse bola sumlo nompa khonung juiya ahiuve.
en_web: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
en_kjv: which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon lam jang adalhauvin, lamhilouva akihei mang gam’un, athil dih lou bolnan sum deichaa Besor chapa Balaam lampi joh ajuitauve.

tcz: Hinlah Balaam chu ngoltah a amason got pet'in asangan chun mihem aw in thu ahinsei doh in, ama chu aphoh jengin ahi.
en_web: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
en_kjv: but was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Balaamin Dan asuh khel jeh chun pho na achangtan, Paomosa-nganin mihem paovin thu aseiyin Themgaopa ngolna chu asutang tai.

tcz: Hiche mite hi twivei talou twinah kang chu ahiuvin, ahilouleh meibol hung um huiyin amutmang tobang ahiuve. Amaho hi athimpen muthim lah a mahthahden ding ahitauve.
en_web: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
en_kjv: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi twi kangsa, twisamphung ho le khopi huiyin alhoh mangji meilhang ho tobang ahiuvin, amaho dinga muthim lhangkhal jing lai chu kikheh khol ahitai.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho pannabei, ngolhoi tah a hamhoithouva ahin, athuseiyuva lamvaina a umho lah a kona hung jamdoh ho chu tahsa lam huhna lung ngaichatnaa miho athujouva lheplhah bai chu athunun jou jiu ahi.
en_web: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
en_kjv: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu amahon hamhoi tho nan, manlou pou aseiyun, vahthai ho lah a um, hung jamdoh nah nah ho jong tahsaphe ngaichat, huhna lama ajol lhajiuve.

tcz: Amahon chamlhatna thutep mi aneipiuvin, hinlah amaho tah chonset le kisuhbohna a sohchang ahiuve. Ajeh chu nangho athua nananun pet uva chu asoh a lut nahi tauve.
en_web: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
en_kjv: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajol lhah ho’u chu jalen din atepeh-un, amaho tah jongla kemmang thei soh a kihen joh ahi tauve, ajeh chu galjoupan ajosa chu soh a anei ngai mong ahinai.

tcz: Miho chun IPakaiyu le huhhingpu Yeshua Christa ahet tenguleh hiche vannoi Phatlouna a kona hi ongdoh a ahiuvin, chujou tengleh chonsetna a akihen ohkit uva chule asohchan kit tenguleh, amaho chu amasa sangin akhohjo cheh jitauve.
en_web: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
en_kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile i-Pakaiyu le huhhing pa Jesu Christa hetna jal’a vannoi leiset kisuhbohna tin chenga jamdohsa mihem chu, hichenga akihen-oh kit’a hicheng chun ajokit teng le aum chan’u chu amasaa sangin gamchengin akhoh cheh jitai.

tcz: Amahon chonphatna lampi chu ahet uva chujouva hinkho thenga hin ding thupeh nahsah louva abol sanguvin, chonphatna lampi chu anahetlou beh u hihenlang hileh phajo ngap ding ahi.
en_web: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
en_kjv: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hi jeh chun ahet nunguva, amaho kipe, thupeh thenga kona akihei mang sangun, dihna lampi chu ahet’a ahet lou hel’u hile pha jotading ahi.

tcz: Amahon hiche thuchih: “Uichan alohlhahsa anekitjie, kiti hileh, Vohcha kisil ngimsa bonlhoh a akibolkit ji'e,” tia kisei hi aphotchen u ahitai!
en_web: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
en_kjv: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and, The sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
tcz_gospelgo: “Uiyin aloh anehkit jin, silngimsa vohcha bonlhoh lah a akibol kitji,” kiti paochamtuh hi amaho chung thua adih lheh jengin ahi.

tcz: Kagol ngaitah teho, hiche hi nahenguva dinga ka lekhathot ani channa ahitai, chule ani gel'a hi nalung gelu pha chu suhthouna ding le nalung thimu suhthah chehna ding kalung ngaito ahi.
en_web: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
en_kjv: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, hiche hi kalekha thot ni lhin na ahitai, lekha te nia hi, thoh hatna jeh a lung ngaito thengsel nanei theina dinguva geldohsah a kahinsuh thoujiu ahi.

tcz: Masang peh a themgao thenghon ipi aseiyu, chule IPakaiyu le Huhhingpun na solchah teu henga ipi thu apeh nageldoh dingu kalung gon ahi.
en_web: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
en_kjv: that ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
tcz_gospelgo: Masang laiya Themgao theng ho thuseina le Pakai le huhhingpa thupeh solchahhoa kona najahsau chu geldohsah kitna ding jong ahiye.

tcz: Akhoh dehset a kageldoh sahkit nomu chu ni nunung lam leh jontai hat ho hung ding ahiuve, amaho chun thutah chu ataiponguva chule amaho lung ngaichat dungjuiya chon ding ahiuve.
en_web: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
en_kjv: knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
tcz_gospelgo: Amasan hiche hi heuvin, ni nukhah teng mi jontai hatten jontai jeng apat’uva, ama tahsaphe lunggul lam jenga hung chon diu,

tcz: Amaho chun, “Yeshua hungkit ding ahi tia thutep chu itiba hitam? Ipu ipateu masanga vannoi kisem til laiya pat in tuchan geiyin ijakai angai chu ahi jinge,” tia ahinsei dingu ahi.
en_web: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
en_kjv: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon, “Ahung kitna ding thutep chu hoi lamba hitam? Ajeh chu ipu ipateu la athisoh tan, thilsem jouse hi la semtila’ bep bep’in aum jingin,” atiu diu ahi.

tcz: Amahon Pathen in van hohi thu apeh a asem a, chule Aman leiset hi twiya kona ahin umdohsah a chule twiya aum kimvel sah ahi, tihi alungcham tah in asumil un ahi.
en_web: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
en_kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile amahon Pathen thusah a kona masang laiya pat van umsa ahile, twi lah a kon, twi jeh a leiset kisemdoh jong hi henasa kihetmo sah ahiuve.

tcz: Chujouva chu Aman twi chu amanchah a vannoi aluipa chu twisanglet'a asuh mang ahi.
en_web: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
en_kjv: whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh a chu chulai vannoi leiset chu twisanglenin achup’a manghel ahitai.

tcz: Chule hiche thum'a ma a chu tua vanho le leiset jong hi meiya dinga kikhol khoma ahi. Amaho hi thutan nikhoa dinga kikoitup'a ahiuvin, chutengleh Pathen ngaisah lou ho kisu manghel jeng diu ahitai.
en_web: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
en_kjv: but the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche Pathen thu ma maa chu tulaiya van le leiset jong hi Pathen hephalou te chung thu kitan’a kisuhmang nikhoa dinga kikhen’a, meiya halvam dinga kikheh khol ahi.

tcz: Hinlah kangaitah teho, nanghon hiche thilkhat hi sumil hih un. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dingin nikho khat jong chu kum sangkhat tobang chule kum sangkhat jong chu nikho khat tobangma ahi ti heuvin.
en_web: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
en_kjv: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo deitahte, Pakai dia nikho khat hi kum sang khat tobang ahin, kum sang khat jong nikho khat tobang ahidol hi sumil loujenun.

tcz: Mi phabep in Pakai chu athutep lam dol a geisang hidinga agel u chu hilou ahi. Ahipoi, ama nangho jal a thoh hat joh'ah ahibouve. Aman koimacha suhmanga aum ding adeipoi, chusanga mitin lung akisih dingu adei ahi.
en_web: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
en_kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
tcz_gospelgo: Mi kon khat’in ngongkaiya agel vangun, thutep dol’a Pakai chu angongkaipoi; koima manthah ding adeilou jeh a abonchauva lung aheisoh manna diuva, nang ho jeh a, kho-ngaisot ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai nikho hi gucha banga kigin loupet le hung lhung ding ahi. Chutengleh vanho jong meikouva kisubei ding, chule asunga umjouse hi thutanna chang diu ahiuve.
en_web: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
en_kjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burnt up.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla Pakai nikho chu gucha banga hung ding ahin; ahung ni le chun van ho chengse ging lul lul’a, kitolmang hel ding, thilbul chengse meikouva jol mangsoh ding, vannoi lseiset le asunga um na kitong jouse jong kavam soh hel ding ahi.

tcz: Hitia hi ikimvel uva umjouse hi kisumang ding ahiuva ahitah leh, nangho la ichan geiya thenna le Pathen ngaisah a nahin dingu ham?
en_web: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
en_kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga hi thil jouse hung kisumang ding ahitah jeh-in, itobang dol ham’a nakigot diu akhoh tai, nun le khan, thenna lam, Pathen ngaisahna,

tcz: Pathen nikho ahung lhun ding chu katjinga chule kinem'a ngahjinga um ding ahi. Hiche nikhoachu, Aman vanho chu meiya ahal ding, chule thil ho chu meikonga junlha gam ding ahitauve.
en_web: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
en_kjv: looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hungkitna ding nikho ho ngah jingle sunai jinga naum diu ahi; ahung lhun nikho le van ho chengse meiya kouva vamhel ding, thilbul chengse jong meiyin akah a jolmangsoh ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah eihon Aman athutep Van thahho le leiset thah chu kinem'a ingau ahi, hichea chu Pathen chonphatna dimset ahi.
en_web: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
en_kjv: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon ama thutep, adih jenga umna, vanthah le leiset thah chu i-ngau ahi.

tcz: Chule hitia chu, deitahte nanghon hichengse hi ahung lhun ding nanga pet un, ama mitmua atheng le nolnabeiya kichamdela hinding kihabolun.
en_web: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
en_kjv: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun deitahte, hicheng hi kat jinga naum nauva, ama henga nolna beihel le boh beh louva nahung mudoh theina diuvin, chamdel’a um din kihabol’un.

tcz: Chule geldoh un, IPakaiyu thohhatna chun miho huhhing'a umna ding phat apeh ahi. Hiche hi isopiu Paul jengin jong Pathen in chihna apeh a chu nahenguva ajih ahi.
en_web: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
en_kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
tcz_gospelgo: Chule sopi deitah-u Paul’in ama kipe chihna dungjuiya nahenguva ahinsutsa bang chun, huhhing channa dia i-Pakaiyu mi kho ngaisotje hi gel’uvin.

tcz: Alekhathot jousea hiche thudol hi asei ahi. Alung gel phabep aseiho chu hethahsa aumin, chule ima hetna neilou holeh dinmun detlou ho chun Pathen Thudang aboljiu bang chun lamchom lang akosah un, chule hiche hin amanthahna dingu ahinsodoh ding ahi.
en_web: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
en_kjv: as also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
tcz_gospelgo: Alekha thot ho sunga chu hiche thudol ho asei ahin, asunga chun het hahsa tah tah jong aumin, hiche ho hi lungdet lou hon Pathen lekhabu dang abolna bangun ahilkon le jiuvin, amaho manthahna akiboldoh lo jiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, phat lhin masanga kahin jih masat ahi. Kihong phauvin, hitia chu chuche migilou ho suhkhelna chun napui mang louna dinguvin chule nadindet pet u lhaso khaget uvinate.
en_web: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
en_kjv: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun deitahte, nang hon vang hemasauvin lang, kiging phauvin, achutilou le Danbeiho manthahna chun nalhoh mang thauva, panmundetsa chu nalhaso khah diu ahi.

tcz: Chusangin, nangho I Pakaiyu le Huhhingpa Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna le hetna a chun khangtou jingun. Abonchan Ama a chun tule a-itih a dingin loupina hijing tahen! Amen.
en_web: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
en_kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Chusangin i-Pakaiyu le huhhingpa Jesu Christa lungsetna le hetnan khangtou jingun, Amaa chun loupina tu le tonsot kum khon um jing hen: Amen.

tcz: Keihon nangho koma kahillhang leu-atil abula pat'a ana umjing, kanakol uva kajahsau, kamit uva kamusau chule kakhut uva kathamsau Hinna Thu chu ahi.
en_web: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
en_kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hi semtil’a umsa, kajahsau, keihon mit’a kamusau, chule khut’a kathamsau chuche hinna thudol chu ahin,

tcz: Amatah hinna ahi chu keiho henga kiphongdoh ahitai chule keihon Ama chu kamutauve, chule tua hi keihon kahettohsah uva chule Amatah Tonsot Hinna ahi tia kaseiphongu ahi. Ama Pa toh ana umsa chujouva keiho henga hung kiphongdoh'ah ahi.
en_web: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
en_kjv: (for the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
tcz_gospelgo: hiche hinna chu ahung kilangdoh tan, chuche tonsot hinna, Pa koma um jingsa, keiho henga hung kilangdoh chu vechen’a hettohsah a, nahenguva kaphondoh-u ahi.

tcz: Keiho tah in kamuchet uva chule kajahsau chu nangho henga kahillhangu ahin, hichu keiho toh ikiloikhom theina dingu ahi. Chule keiho toh kiloikhomna hi Pa le AChapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhomna ahi.
en_web: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiho to ikiloikhom theina diuva kamusau le kajahsau chu nahenguva kaphondoh-u ahi. Keiho kiloikhomna hi Pa le Achapa Jesu Christa to kiloikhomna ahi.

tcz: Hicheho chengse kajih uhi nanghon keihoa kipana nanei bulhing-chamkim theina dingu ahi.
en_web: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
en_kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
tcz_gospelgo: Kakipa nau achamkimsohna dinga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Keihon Yeshua a kona kajahsau thupoh chule tua nahenguva kaphondoh u chu hichehi ahi-Pathen chu vah ahi, chule Ama a chu muthim umlouhel ahi.
en_web: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
en_kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen hi khovah ahiye, ama sunga muthim aum louhel hi keihon amaa kona kajah-uva, nahenguva kaphondoh-u thu kithot chu ahi.

tcz: Hijeh achu eihon Pathen to kiloikhom kahi itiuva ahia lhagao muthim lah a vahle nalai ihiuleh eiho thutah chu jui jing lou ihiu ahi.
en_web: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
en_kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho amato kiloikhom’a kiseiya muthim sunga ivale vangule, jousei ihiuvin, thutah dungjuiya na tong lou ihiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen vah'a aum banga vah'a chu eiho iumuva ahileh, eiho khat le khat kiloikhom ihitauve, chule Achapa Yeshua thisan chun ichonsetnau jouse a kona eisil thengu ahitai.
en_web: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
en_kjv: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama khovah sunga aum banga, eiho jong khovah sunga ivale vangule, eiho khat le khat kiloikhomna nei ihiuvin, Acha pa Jesu thisanin chonsetna chengsea kona eisop thengsoh-u ahi.

tcz: Eiho chonsetna neilouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eima hotah kilhemlha ihiuvin, thutah'a hinga ihi lou u ahi.
en_web: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
en_kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho chonset neilouva ikisei vangule, eiho le eiho kilhem lhaa, thutah chu isunguva um lou ahi.

tcz: Hinlah eihon ichonset u Ama koma iphondoh uva ahileh, Ama chu ichonsetnau ngaidam dinga tahsan umle kitah ahin, chule gitlouna jousea kona eisil theng theiyu ahi.
en_web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
en_kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon ichonsetna jouseu iphondoh vangule, ichonsetna jouse ngaidam ding le then louna jousea kona eisutheng diuva, ama chu tahsan umtah le dihtah ahi.

tcz: Eiho chonse khalouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eihon Pathen jou seiya ingoh u chule Athu chun ilunguva mun aneilou ahi ti ivetsah u ahi.
en_web: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
en_kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho chonse louva ikiseiyule, ama chu ijoubol’uva athu eiho sunga umlou ahi.

tcz: Kacha deitahte, nachonset louna dinguva hiche hi nahenguva kahinjih ahi. Hinlah achonse aumtah a ahileh ichung thu'u eiseichampeh thei dingu chonphatah Yeshua Christa chu inei nauve.
en_web: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
en_kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
tcz_gospelgo: Kachate, nachonset louna diu vin hicheng hi nahenguva kahinsun’e. Ahin khattou chonse jeng tajongle, Pahenga eisei champeh diu, dih tah Jesu Christa ineinauve.

tcz: Amatah hi ichonset nauva kona lhatdohna dinga hung kikatdoh a ahitai–chule eiho chonset jengseh hilouvin vannoi mite chonset jaljeh jong ahi.
en_web: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
en_kjv: and he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman chu eiho chonset jouse thoina ahi, eiho chang jenga jong hilouva vannoi pumpi ding jong ahi.

tcz: Chule eihon Athupeh ho ijuiyuva ahileh Ama chu iheuve tia iseitheiyu ahi.
en_web: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
en_kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupeh chengse init’u le ama ihetsau ahidol kichen ding ahi.

tcz: Koiham khattouvin, Keiman Pathen kahei tihen Pathen Thupeh ho jui hih henlang hitaleh, amatah chu mijou ahin, chule thutah'a chu hinglouva ahi.
en_web: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
en_kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Khattouvin, “Ama kahetai,” atia, athupeh chengse la anit loule mijou ahin, asunga thutah umlou ahibouve.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thu jui'a chu Ama ngailutna ivetsah tahbeh u ahi. Hichea hin Amaa hinga ihiuve ti ihetnau ahi.
en_web: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
en_kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Athu nit’a vang chu, hiche anitna jeh a chu Pathen ngailutnaa kisuchamkimsoh ahitai. Hichea hi ama sunga um ihiu iheuve.

tcz: Koihileh Pathena kahinge tiho chun Yeshua banga abol diu ahi.
en_web: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
en_kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga um jinga kiseiya chu Christa chonchan banga chontei ding ahi.

tcz: Deitahte, keiman nangho henga thupeh thah kajih ahipoi; atil abula naneisau thupehlui chu kahin jih joh ahi. Hiche thupehlui chu–khat le khat kingailut ding masanga najahsau chu ahi.
en_web: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
en_kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, nahenguva thupeh thah kahinsunpoi, semtil’a pat nanei sau thupeh lui chu ahibouve; na jahsau chu hiche thupeh lui thu hi ahi.

tcz: Hiche thupeh hi athah jong ahi. Yeshua chu hiche thupeh a chon'ah ahin chule nangho jong hichea hi nachon diu ahi. Ajeh chu muthim hi hungmang ding chule vah tahbeh chu hungvah doh a ahitai.
en_web: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
en_kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
tcz_gospelgo: Muthim beisoh deh deh a, khovah tah beh hung vah pan thudol, nang ho le Christa sunga um thutah thudol thupeh thah jong nahenguva kahinsun nai.

tcz: Koiham khattouvin, “Keima Vah'a kavahlei,” tihen hinlah Christian asopi khat chu hotboltaleh, hichepa chu muthim lah a umnalai ahi.
en_web: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
en_kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
tcz_gospelgo: Khovah sunga um’a kiseiya, asopi hotbol nalai chu tugeiya muthim sunga um ahibouve.

tcz: Koipen hijongleh sopi midang khat angailut'a ahileh vah'a chu chon'ah ahin, chule koima kipal lhuh sahlou ahije.
en_web: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
en_kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopi ngailua vang chu khovah sunga umah ahitan, ama sunga hin kipal lhuhna aumpoi.

tcz: Hinlah sopi michom dang khat hot bola chu muthimlah a uma chule vahlea ahi. Hitobang mi chun achena ding lampi ahepon, muthim chun amit chotsah ahi.
en_web: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
en_kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Asopi hotbol nalai vang chu muthim sunga um, muthim sunga vah le ahin, muthimchun amit te ni achotsah jeh-in, hoilam ajot jong ahepoi.

tcz: Pathen chate ho dinga kajih ahi, ajeh chu Yeshua jal'a nachonset u ngaidam nahi tauve.
en_web: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
en_kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, Ama min jal’a nachonset jouseu ngaidam ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Tahsan naa pilhing ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu atil abula pat'a anaumsa Christa chu nanghon naheuve. Tahsana khangdong nangho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon agiloupa chu nakidou piuva najou ahitai.
en_web: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
en_kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Pate, semtil’a pat ama chu nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi. Khangdong ho, agiloupa nanan jou phat’uva Nanghenguva kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Nangho Pathen Chate ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pachu naheuve. Tahsan'a pilhing nangho henga kajih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Christa chu naheuvin, Ama chu atil abula anaum jingsa ahi. Tahsanna khang dong nangho henga kahin jih ahi, ajeh chu nangho nahat uvin chule Pathen Thu nalung sunguva achenge, chule agilouto nakidouvu chu najou tauve.
en_web: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
en_kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangte, Pa chu nahet phat’uva Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahi. Pate, Ama chu semtil’a pat nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai. Khangdong ho, nathau aphat’a Nasunguva Pathen thu aum jinga, Agiloupa chu nanan jou phatu’va Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai.

tcz: Hiche vannoi hi ngailu hih un ahilouleh vannoiyin napeh u jong ngailu hih un, ajeh chu nanghon vannoi nangailut tenguleh, nanghon Pa ngailutna chu nanei lou u ahi.
en_web: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
en_kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset le leiset sunga um thil ho ngailu hih hel’un; koi hile vannoi leiset ngailua chu Pa-ngailutna asunga um lou ahi.

tcz: Ajeh chu vannoiyin tahsalam lung ngaichat ho, mitmua deichatthei ho, chule ithilbol doh hou chule ineihouva kiletsah pina apehthei ahi. Hitihohi Pa a kon ahipoi, ahin hiche vannoiya kon joh ahi.
en_web: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
en_kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile vannoi leiset’a um chengse tahsaphe lung ngaichat le mit te nin jon lunggul’a amu, chule hinkhoa kimoh vahchoi-hiti ho hi Paa hungkon ahipon, vannoi leiset’a konjoh ahibouve.

tcz: Chule hiche vannoi le miho lung ngaichatna ho jong akem tul tule. Hinlah Pathen lunglambol ho chu tonsot'a umjing ding ahiuve.
en_web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
en_kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Vannoi leiset le athil ngaichat lunggul abeikon ahitan, Pathen lungdei lam nol’a vang chu tonsot’a um jing ding ahi.

tcz: Cha ngaitahteho, phat nunung chu ahitai. Christa doupa ahunge ti naja tauve. Chule Christa dou tampi ahung kilangtai. Hichea kon hin phat kichai kon ahunghitai ti naheuve.
en_web: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
en_kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapangte, nidan nukhah ahitan, Christa doupa hung ding najah banguvin, tun Christa douho tampi asohdoh tauve; hichea kon hin nidan nukhah ahi ihetauve.

tcz: Hiche miho hin i-houbung hou adalhauve, hinlah amaho eihoto houbunga ium khom tahbeh khapouve, chuti lou hileh eiho toh umkhom diu ahitai. Adalhah u chun, amaho hi eihoa ahipouve ti aphotchen ahi.
en_web: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
en_kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi ilah-uva kona potdoh ahiuvin, eiho lah a vang apang pouve; eiho lah a pang hileu iumkhom jing diu ahi; ilah-uva apan louvu akiphondoh theina dia potdoh ahitauve.

tcz: Hinlah nangho hitobang chun naumpouve, ajeh chu Lhagao Theng nachung uvah ahung tan chule nangho jousen thutah chu nahesoh keiyuve.
en_web: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
en_kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho vang Athengpa thaonu changkha nahiuvin, hijeh chun ijakai nahesoh keiyui.

tcz: Hichea keiman nangho koma kajih hi thutah nahe pouve tia kasei ahipon, ahin nanghon thutahle jouthu akibahlouna naheuve.
en_web: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
en_kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutah nahet loujeh-uva nahenguva kahinsut ahipon, hiche nahet’uva, thujou ho hi thutah akon ahilou nahet jeh-uva kahinsut ahibouve.

tcz: Chule koiham jouseipa chu? Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahipoi ti chan chu Christa dou ahi.
en_web: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
en_kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu Christa hisah louva seileppa, jousei ahiloule koi dangba hiding ham?

tcz: Koi hileh Chapa seilep chan chun Pa aneilou ahi. Hinlah Chapa phongdoh chan chun Pachu anei ahitai.
en_web: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
en_kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa seilep jousen Pa aneilou ahin, Chapa phongdoh jousen vang Pa anei ahi.

tcz: Hitiahi, atil abula pat'a nakihiluva chu tahsan umtah'a napandet dingu ahi. Hichu nabol ahileh, nangma Pa le Chapa toh kiloikhoma nahi ding ahi.
en_web: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
en_kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon semtil’a pat najahsau chu nasunguva um jing hen; semtil’a pat najahsau nasunguva aum vang le, nang ho jong Chapa le Pa sunga um jing nahiuve.

tcz: Chule hiche kiloikhomna ithanop nau hi aman eithutep peh u Tonsot Hinna chu ahi.
en_web: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
en_kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
tcz_gospelgo: Amatah-in eitep’u athutep chu tonsot’a hinna hi ahi.

tcz: Keiman hicheng thil ho kajih hi nangho napui lamvai dinghou chung chang thua nangho kagih nahiuve.
en_web: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
en_kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng hi nang ho lhem lhaji ho thudol’a kahinsut ahitai.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon Lhagao Theng naneiyuve chule Ama nangho sunga achenge chule ipi chu thutah ham tithua koiman nahil dingu ngaikhoh ahitapoi. Ajeh chu Lhagao chun imalam jousea nahil dingu ahi, chule Aman ahil chu thutah ahi, Ama ah jou apangpoi. Hiti chun aman nahilsau bang chun, Christa to kiloikhomna nei jingun.
en_web: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
en_kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang hon vang ama thaonu chu nakisan’uva, nasunguva aum jeh-in, nahil diu midang koima na-ngaicha pouve; amaa kona naneiyu thaonu chu thutah hiya, jousei ahilou jeh-in, ijakai thudol nahilsoh nauve. Hejih chun aman nahil bangun amasunga um jinguvin.

tcz: Chule tun, cha deitahte, Christa toh kiloikhomna neijingun, ajeh chu Ama ahung kilah tengleh nanghon lung ngamna bulhingset nanei dingu chule jahcha a chon talou ding nahiuve.
en_web: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
en_kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule tun chate, ama ahung kilah teng kisonna ineiyuva, ahungkit tengle maimohna ineilouna diuvin, ama sunga um jing jenguvin.

tcz: Eihon Christa chu chonpha ahi ti ihettah jeh uvin, koi hijongleh adih bola chu Pathen cha ahiuve tijong iheuve.
en_web: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
en_kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one which doeth righteousness is born of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu adihje nahet’ulle, adih bol jouse hi amaa kona pengdoh ahidol jong nahet diu ahi.

tcz: Veuvin, Van'a um IPauvin ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam? Ajeh chu Aman Achate tin eikou tauve–chule eiho jong ihi tahbeh u ahi! Hinlah hiche hi vannoiya hihon Pathen Chate ihiu hi ahephapouve, ajeh chu amahon Ama ahetlou jeh u ahi.
en_web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
en_kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
tcz_gospelgo: Veuvin, Pathen chate i-kisah thei na diuva Pan eipeh-u ngailutna hi iti natsat hitam! Chule hichu hijong ihitauve. Hijeh a hi Vannoiyin eihet louvu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen jong ahepouve.

tcz: Ngaitah teho–eiho Pathen chate ihiu ahitai. Chule ipi ihi dingu tun akilangdoh hih laiye. Hinlah eihon ihet'u chu Christa ahung kilah teng chuleh eihon Ama ahina tahbeh a imu dingu ahitai.
en_web: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
en_kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, tun eiho Pathen chate i-hitauvin, ahivangin ipi ihung hidiu akichen hih laiye. Ama ahung kilah teng le eiho jong ama to ibah diu vang iheuve, ajeh chu ama ahi na banga imu diu ahi.

tcz: Chule Ama hung ding kinem'a ngah jingho chu Ama athen banga amaho jouse jong thenga umding ahiuve.
en_web: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
en_kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama jal’a hiche kinepna nei chan chu ama atheng banga ama jong kisuhtheng ahi.

tcz: Koihileh chonset bol chun Pathen Danthu apalkeh ahi, ajeh chu chonset jouse hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi.
en_web: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
en_kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile chonset bol’an Danthu to kikal abol ahi, ijeh-inem itile Danthu to kikal chu chonset ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Amatoh hingkhom chu chonsejom lou ding ahiuve. Hinlah chonset boljom jing mi chu Ama heloulai ahilouleh Ama koi ahi hechenlou ahi.
en_web: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
en_kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama sunga chu chonset beihel ahijeh a chonset pomang dinga ama hung kilah ahi naheuve.

tcz: Koi hileh Amaa umjom jing mi chu chonselou ding ahi. Hinlah achonse jom jing chu koi hileh Ama chu heloulai ahilouleh hetkhenna neiloulai ahi.
en_web: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
en_kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile ama sunga um jouse achonsepoi; achonse jousen ama chu mujong amukhah lou, het jong ahet khah louvu ahibouve.

tcz: Cha deitahte, hiche chungchang thu'ah koiman nalhep lhah dauhen: Mihon adih tia ahol tenguleh, Christa chu chondih ahi banga amaho chondih a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi.
en_web: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
en_kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, koima kilhep lhahsah hih-un; koi hile thildih bol’a chu Christa adih banga ama jong midih ahi.

tcz: Hinlah miho chu achonset jom jing tenguleh amaho chu Diabol a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi. Ama chu atil abula pat'a anachonse peh ahi. Hinlah Diabol natoh ho sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung anahi.
en_web: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
en_kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
tcz_gospelgo: Chonset bol’a vang chu Diabol’a kon ahi, ajeh chu Diabol chu semtil’a pat hung chonse jing ahi. Hichejeh tah a chu Diabol natoh sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung kilah ahi.

tcz: Pathen insung mia peng ho chun chonset aboljom jing pouve, Pathena hinna chu amahoa um ahijeh ahi.
en_web: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
en_kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen’a kona pengdoh jousen chonset aboljom jing poi, ajeh chu Pathen muchi chu ama sunga aum jingin ahi. Chujongle Pathen’a kona pengdoh ahi jeh in achonset jing ding chu ahitheipoi.

tcz: Hitichun, tun koiho hi Pathen chate hiuva chule koiho chu Diabol chate hiuvem ti iseithei tauve. Koi hileh chonphatna a hinglouho chule midang tahsan chankhompi ngailulou ho chu Pathena ahipouve.
en_web: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
en_kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Pathen chate le Diabol chate umdol akichen’e. Thildih bol lou jouse le asopi ngailu lou jouse chu Pathen’a kon ahipoi.

tcz: Hiche hi atil abula pat a nana jahsau chu ahi: Eiho khatle khat ikingailut dingu hi ahi.
en_web: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
en_kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut diu hi najahsau semtil’a pat thu thot chu ahi.

tcz: Eiho Cain tobanga agilouva ihipouve, ama chun asopipa anatha ahi: Ipi jeh a atha hintem? Ajeh chu Cain chun aphalou abola chule asopipa chun chonphat abol jeh ahi.
en_web: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
en_kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
tcz_gospelgo: Agiloupaa kon, asopi that’a pang Cain to ibah lou diu ahi. Ipijeh pen a aman asopi atha ham? Ajeh chu ama natoh chengse agilou jeng ahia, asopipa a jouse adih jeng ahijeh ahi.

tcz: Hijehchun, sopi deitah te, vannoiyin nahot uva ahileh datmo hih un!
en_web: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
en_kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo sopite, vannoiyin nahot’u le kidang sahih hel’un.

tcz: Eihon Christian isopihou ingailut u ahileh, eiho thinaa kona hinna a galkai ihitauve. Hinlah ngailutna neilou chu athisa ahi.
en_web: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
en_kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile eihon isopiteu ingailut jeh-uva thinaa kona hinna galkai i-hi tauve. Angailu lou vang chu thinaa um jing nalai ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh sopi michom khat hotbola chu alung sunga tolthat ahitai chule tolthat ho chun asunguva Tonsot Hinna aneipouve.
en_web: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
en_kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile asopi hotbol tol that ahin tolthat lung sunga tonsot hinna aum lou iheuve.

tcz: Eihon ngailutna atahbeh ipiham ti iheuve, ajeh chu Yeshuan eiho dinga ahinna chu ahung pehdohsa ahitai.
en_web: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
en_kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman eiho dia ahinkho apeh jeng jeh hin, hichea hin ngailutna ihetauve; hijeh a chu eihon jong sopite dinga hinkho ito doh diu thil khoh tah ahi.

tcz: Koiham khat chun sum neihen lang sopinu ahilouleh sopipan angaichat he hen lang, hinlah khotona neitahih leh–hichepa chu Pathen ngailutna a iti umthei ding ham?
en_web: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
en_kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother hath need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
tcz_gospelgo: Khattou hinkhoa ning lhingin um hen lang chule asopi ngaichat neiya um amu nasan achung changa lainatpi da le, ama sunga chu Pathen ngailut na iti um thei ding ham?

tcz: Kacha deitahte, eiho khat le khat ikingailu uve tin sei maimai pouhite, atahbeh chu ichonnauva vetsah u hite.
en_web: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
en_kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, eihon thuhom keo le kamsung jengseh hilouvin, natoh le thutah in ngailu hite.

tcz: Ichonnauvin thutah'a hinga ihiu avetsah ding ahi, hitia chu Pathen masanga idin tenguleh lungngam tah a ium dingu ahi.
en_web: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
en_kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi eiho thutah apang ihidan’u ihet’uva, ama angsunga ilungthima ikison diu ahi.

tcz: Ikithemmo channau aum jeng jongleh Pathen chu eimaho lunggel sanga lenjoa ahijeh'in ijakai Aman ahet ahinai.
en_web: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
en_kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
tcz_gospelgo: I-lung thim’un ei-oi mo tengu jongle, Pathen chu eiho lungthim sanga lenjoa ima jouse hesoh ahiye.

tcz: Kagol ngaitahte, eimahon kithemmo channa ineilouva ahileh, Pathen komchu lungngam tah a inailut theiyu ahi.
en_web: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
en_kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence towards God.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, ilungthim’un ei-oi mo louvu le Pathen henga lung ngamna ineiyun,

tcz: Chule ipi hijeng jongleh ithum chanu chu Amaa kona imuthei dingu ahi, ajeh chu eihon Ama sei ingaiyuvin, chule Ama lunglhaina chu ibolun ahi.
en_web: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
en_kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
tcz_gospelgo: hijeh chun thum inei tengu jongle athupeh jouse init’uva, a-angsunga alungdei lam jeng ibol jeh-un, amaa konin akisan jiuve.

tcz: Chule hiche hi Ama thupeh ho ahi: Eihon Achapa Yeshua Christa itahsan uva chule Aman eithupeh banguva eiho khat le khat ikingailut dingu ahije.
en_web: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
en_kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
tcz_gospelgo: Athupeh chu achapa Jesu Christa min’a itahsan’uva, aman eipeh-u thupeh banga khat le khat ikingailut diu hi ahi.

tcz: Pathen Thupeh ho nit a juiho chu: Amatoh kiloikhom ahiuvin, chule Ama jong amahoa chu uma ahi. Chule eihon eihoa Ama aume ti iheuve, ajeh chu Aman Lhagao eipeh u chu isunguva achengin ahi.
en_web: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
en_kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile athupehho nit’a chu Christa sunga um ahin, Christa jong ama sunga um ahi; hichea hin aman eipeh-u Lhagao jal’in ama isunguva aum i-heuve.

tcz: Deitah teho, Lhagaovin aseisah dana thuseiya kingaito koi koi hijongleh tahsan hih un. Nanghon amaho hung konna lhagao chu Pathen akon hinam ti patepna nei masauvin. Ajeh iham itileh themgao lhem tamtah vannoiya aumtai.
en_web: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
en_kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, Lhagao tapou tahsan dauvin, lhagao ho chu Pathen’a kon hinam patep masauvin; ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga Themgao lhem tampi asohdoh tai.

tcz: Hiche hi eihon Pathen Lhagao ineiyu kihetna ding ahi. Mikhat chu themgao hia akiseiya Yeshua Christa chu tahsaphe le vou pun ahunge ti aphondoh a ahileh hiche michun Pathen Lhagao anei ahi.
en_web: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
en_kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Lhagao chu hichea hi nahet diu ahi. Jesu Christa tahsaphe pua ahungna phongdoh Lhagao tapou chu Pathen’a kon ahin,

tcz: Hinlah koi hamkhat chun themgao kahi tia akiseidoh a ahiala Yeshua chung chang thudih chu aphondoh louva ahileh, hichepa kiphondohna themgao kahi tia akisei chu Pathen a kon ahipoi. Hitobang michu Christa dou lhagao vannoiya hung ding ahi tia kisei najah u chule hichea hi uma ahitai ti nahetna dinguva ahi.
en_web: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
en_kjv: and every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof you have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
tcz_gospelgo: hitia Jesu phong doh lou lhagao jouse chu Pathena kon ahipoi, hiche tah chu Christa doupa, ahung ding najahsau chu ahin, tutah a jong hi vangnoiya um-ah ahitai.

tcz: Hinlah nangho Pathen a nahiu ahitai, kacha ngaitah teho, nanghon hiche mite hi najosau ahitai, ajeh chu nasung uva cheng Lhagao chu vannoiya cheng lhagao sanga chu lenjoa ahi.
en_web: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
en_kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate, nang ho Pathen’a kon nahiuvin, hiche ho chu nanang joutauve; ijeh-inem itile nasunguva umpa chu vannoiya umpa sangin achungnungjoi.

tcz: Amaho chu vannoiya hiuva ahin, hijeh a chu vannoi lunggellam thua aseidoh jiu ahin, chule vannoiyin aseiyu angaiyu ahi.
en_web: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
en_kjv: They are of the world, therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi vannoi ya kon ahiuvin, hijeh achu vannoi thudol jeng aseiyule, vannoi athua nung ahi.

tcz: Hinlah eiho Pathen a ihiuve, chule Pathen heho chun eiho sei angaiyuve. Hiche hi mikhat chun thutah lhagao aneiham, ahilouva ahileh lheplhahna lhagao changa ham ti ihetnau ahiye.
en_web: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
en_kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho vang Pathen’a kon aihiuvin, Pathen hepan ithuu angaiye, Pathen helouvan vang ithuu angaipoi. Hichea hi eihon Lhagao tah le lhagao lhem ihetdoh-u ahi.

tcz: Deitah teho, eiho kingailu jom jingu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna neija chu Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna nei chu Pathen cha ahin chule Pathen ahei.
en_web: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
en_kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, eiho khat le khat ki-ngailu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen’a kon ahi; hijeh chun ngailut neiya chu Pathen’a kona peng ahin, Pathen ahei.

tcz: Hinlah koi hitaleh ngailutna neilou chun Pathen ahetlou ahi. Ajeh iham itileh Pathen chu ngailut ahi.
en_web: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
en_kjv: He that loveth not, knoweth not God; for God is love.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailut neilouvin Pathen ahepoi, ajeh chu Pathen hi ngailut ahi.

tcz: Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam ti eivetsahnau chu Achapa chang khatseh chu vannoiya hi ahinsol ahitai, hitia chu Ama jal a eihon tonsot hinna ineitheina dingu ahi.
en_web: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
en_kjv: In this was manifested the love of God towards us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chapa jal’a eihon hinna inei theina diuva Pathenin Achapa chang khatseh vannoiya ahinsol, hichea hi eiho sunga Pathen ngailutnachu kiphongdoh ahitai.

tcz: Hiche hi ngailutna tahbeh ahi–eimahon Pathen ingailut u ahipoi, hinlah Aman eiho eingailut uva chule ichonsetnau chu lahmangna dinga Achapa chu maichama ahin katdoh ahitai.
en_web: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
en_kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hi ngailut um ahi, eihon Pathen ingailut’u ahipon, amajoh-in eingailut’uva, eiho chonset thoina dinga Achapa ahinsol ahibouve.

tcz: Deitah teho, Pathen in hichan geiya hi eingailut'u ahijeh'in, eiho khatle khat ikingailut diu ahi.
en_web: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
en_kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, Pathenin eiho chutia eingailut’u le eiho jong khat le khat iki-ngailut diu dol ahi.

tcz: Koimachan itih in jong Pathen amukhapoi. Hinlah eimaho khatle khat ikingailut touva ahileh Pathen chu eihoa uma chule Ami ngailutna chu eiho akiphondoh na ihiu ahi.
en_web: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
en_kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
tcz_gospelgo: Koiman imatih-in Pathen amukhapoi, eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut’u le Pathen eiho sunga uma chule amingailut chu eiho sunga chamkimsohji ahi.

tcz: Chule Pathen in a Lhagao eipeh u hi eiho Ama a ihingun chule Ama eihoa aume, ti photchenna ahi.
en_web: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
en_kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathenin eipeh-u ama Lhagao jal hin eiho ama sunga i-um’uva chule ama eiho sunga aum iheuve.
