tcz: Chukalval in, eimahon imit tah uvin imuvin chule tun Pa chun Chapa hi vannoi huhhingpu dinga ahinsol ahi ti iphongdoh theiyun ahi.
en_web: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
en_kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Pan Chapa vannoi huhhing dinga ahinsol hi keihon kamu’uva kahet tohsah-u ahi.

tcz: Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi tia akama phongdoh ho chu asunguva Pathen chenga ahin, chule amaho Pathen a hinga ahiuve.
en_web: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
en_kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi phongdoh chan asunga Pathen um ahin, ama Pathen sunga um ahi.

tcz: Eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut u hitam ti iheuve chule eihon Angailutna tahsanna chu ineitauve. Pathen hi ngailut ahi chule ngailutnaa hing jouse chu Pathena hinga chule Pathen asunguva uma ahi.
en_web: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
en_kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Pathenin eiho sunga ngailutna anei hi eihon iheuvin itahsan’uve. Pathen chu ngailut ahin, ngailut sunga um michu Pathen sunga um ahin, chule ama sunga Pathen um’a ahi.

tcz: Chule eiho Pathena ihin jeh uva, ingailutnau chamkim cheh na dinga khang khang jing ahi. Hitia hi thutanna nikhoa jong kichatna ineilou dingu ahi. Chusanga lung ngamna neiya Ama kimupina ineitheiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho hiche vannoiya hi Yeshua tobanga ihinu ahitai.
en_web: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
en_kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
tcz_gospelgo: Thupi tan nikhoa lungngamna inei theina diuva hichea hi eiho chunga ngailutna kisuchamkim ahi; ajeh chu hiche vannoiya hi eiho jong ama tobanga um ihiuve.

tcz: Hitobang ngailutna hin kichatna aneipoi, ajeh chu ngailutna bulhingset chun kichat chu anodoh ahi. Eihon kichatna ineiyuleh gimbolna chan ding kichat jal ahi, chule hiche hin Angailutna bulhingset in ihechen hih laiyuve ti avetsahna ahi.
en_web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
en_kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngailut sunga kichat aumpoi, ngailut chamkim chun kichat anodohji; kichat hin talen mat ding aneijeh ahin hijeh chun kichajing mi chu ngailut sunga achamkim theipoi.

tcz: Aman eingailut masat jeh uvin eihon Pathen ingailuve.
en_web: We love him, because he first loved us.
en_kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman eingailut masah jeh a eihon ingailut’u ahibouve.

tcz: Koiham khat in, “Keiman Pathen kangailui,” ti hen, hinlah Christian sopi khat chu hotbol taleh, hichepa chu mijou ahi, ajeh chu eihon imutheiyu miho ingailut louva ahileh, imuthei lou u Pathen chu iti ingailut dingu ham?
en_web: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
en_kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
tcz_gospelgo: Khattouvin,” Pathen ka-ngailui,” ti hen, asopi hotbol le, mijou ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amusa asopibon angailut loule, amulou Pathen chu angailut thei lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chule Aman hiche thupeh hi eipeuve, hichu-Pathen ngailuhon a Christian chanpiu sopiho chu angailut dingu ahi.
en_web: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
en_kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hijongle Pathen ngailu chun asopi angailut tei ding thupeh Christaa kona ineiyu ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahi ti tahsana chu Pathen cha ahitai. Chule koi hileh Pa ngailua chun Achate jong angailut ding ahi.
en_web: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
en_kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hileh Jesu hi Christa ahidol tahsan jouse chu Pathen’a kona peng ahi; chule koi hile ahingpa ngailua chun ahinsa acha jong angailui.

tcz: Eihon Pathen ingailut uva chule Athupeh ho init uva ahileh Pathen chate ingailuve ti iheuve.
en_web: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
en_kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon Pathen ingailutuva, athupeh chengse init’ule hichea hin Pathen chate ingailut’u iheuve.

tcz: Pathen ngailut kiti hi Athupeh ho nit hi ahi. Chule Athupeh ho chu pohgih ahipoi.
en_web: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
en_kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile athupeh chengse init’u hiche laitah chu Pathen ngailutna ahi, chule athupeh ho chu pohgih hahsa jong ahipoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen chate tapou chun hiche vannoi gitlouna hi ajo ahitai, chule hiche jona chu itahsan jal'u ahi.
en_web: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
en_kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu Pathena kona peng jousen vannoi hi anan jou ahitan, hiche vannoi nang joupen tah chu itahsan’u hi ahiye.

tcz: Chule hiche vannoi douna a kisatna hi koiyin ajoding ham? Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi ti tahsan ho bouvin ajo ahi.
en_web: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
en_kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
tcz_gospelgo: Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahina tahsan mi chun vannoi ajo ahitai.

tcz: Chule Yeshua Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahina kiphonna chu twiya baptize channa le Thingpel chunga athisan sonajeh jal ahi, twisih jengseh a hilouvin, twi le thisan jal ahi. Chule Lhagao jong chun hichu ahettohsah in adih ahi ati.
en_web: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
en_kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Twisih le thisan jal’a hungpa chu Jesu Christa ahi, twisih keoseh hilouvin, twisih le thisan jal ahi. Hiche hettosah chu Lhagao ahi, ajeh chu Lhagao hi thutah ahi.

tcz: Hitichun, eihon hiche hettohsahna thum hohi ineiyuve–
en_web: For there are three who testify:
en_kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah thum aumin,

tcz: Lhagao, Twi, chule Thisan–Chule hiche thum hohi khat ahiuve.
en_web: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
en_kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao le twisih chule thisan ahi, hicheng thum hi khat’a longkhom ahi.

tcz: Eihon mihem hettohsahna itahsan uva ahileh, Pathena kona hettohsahna chu iha tahsan cheh dingu hiya ahi. Chule Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahitai.
en_web: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
en_kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon mihem hettohsah bon isan’u le Pathena hettohsahna chu achungnungjoi, ajeh chu aman Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahi.

tcz: Pathen Chapa tahsan jouse chun alung sunguva hiche hettohsahna hi adih ahi ti itahsanuve. Hiche tahsan lou ho chun Pathen chu ajouve tia aseiyu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah chu atahsan lou jeh u ahi.
en_web: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
en_kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Chapa tahsan chun asunga hettohsahna anei ahin, Pathen tahsan lou vang chun Pathen ajousah ahi; ajeh chu Pathenin Achapa thudol ahettohsah, hiche hettohsahna chu aman atahsan tapoi.

tcz: Chule Pathen in ahettohsahna chu hiche hi ahi: Aman tonsot hinna eipetauve, chule hiche Hinna chu Achapa koma uma ahi.
en_web: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
en_kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche hetohsahna chu Achapa sunga um hinna, hiche tonsot hinna, Pathenin eipeh-u hi ahi.

tcz: Koi koi hileh Chapa neiya chun Hinna anei ahitai. Koi koi hijongleh Pathen Chapa neilou chun Hinna aneilou ahi.
en_web: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
en_kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
tcz_gospelgo: Koihile Chapa neiyan hinna aneitan, Pathen Chapa neilou chun hinna aneipoi.

tcz: Pathen Chapa mina tahsan nangho henga hiche hi kahinjih ahitai, hichu Tonsot Hinna nei nahiu nakihetdohna dingu ahi.
en_web: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
en_kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Nang ho Pathen min’a tahsan chengsen tonsot hinna naneiyu nahetna diuva hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.

tcz: Chule Aman ipi hijongleh alunglhaina hoa ithum chanu chu eingaipeh uve ti tahsanna ineiyuve.
en_web: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
en_kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
tcz_gospelgo: Eihon ipi hijongle ama lungdei lama ithum chan’u aman eingai peh jeh-uva, hiche hi eihon ama koma lung ngamna ineiyu ahi.

tcz: Chule eihon ithum tenguleh Aman eingaipeh uve ti ihettahjeh uvin ipi hijongleh Aman eipeh dingu ahi tijong iheuve.
en_web: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
en_kjv: and if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipi hijongle ithum chan’u eingaipeh ihet jeh-uvin, ipi tobang hileh akithum chan chu amaa kona ineisan ihetauve.

tcz: Nangman Christian sopi khat chun thina khop chonsetna hilou abol namua ahileh nataopeh ding ahi, chule Pathen in ama chu ahinsah ding ahi. Hinlah chonsetna thina khop geiya bol'ah aume chule keiman chutobang bol ho dingin taovin kati ahipoi.
en_web: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
en_kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
tcz_gospelgo: Khattouvin asopi chu thi lo hel theina chonset ahilou vanga chonset bol amu le taopeh hen lang hinso hen; thi lo hel theina hilouva chonse chubou kisei ahi. Thi lotheina hel’a chonset aumin, hitobang dia chu tao dinga kasei ahipoi.

tcz: Gitlou boljouse hi chonset ahi, hinlah chonset kitipou chun thina a apuilutpoi.
en_web: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
en_kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih lou jouse chu chonset ahin, ahinla thi lo theina hel lou chonset jong aum’e.

tcz: Eiho Pathen chaten chonset boljom jingna aneipoi ti iheuve, ajeh chu Pathen Chapan amaho chu akolchah a ahuhbit u ahi chule Agiloupa chun amaho atong khapoi.
en_web: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
en_kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Pathena kona penga chu achonse jom jing poi, Pathena kona peng chun ama angah jingin, hijeh chun agiloupan atongkhapoi.

tcz: Eiho Pathen chate ihiuve chule vannoi ikimveluva umhi Agiloupa thuneina noiya uma ahi ti iheuve.
en_web: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
en_kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
tcz_gospelgo: Eiho Pathena kona ihiuva, vannoi pumpi agiloupa noiya aum iheuve.

tcz: Chule Pathen Chapa chu ana hunga chule hetkhen themna chu eihungpeh u ahitai-chutia chu eihon Pathen dihtah chu ihettheiyu ahi ti iheuve. Chule tua hi eiho Pathen dihtah toh ihinkhom theiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho Achapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhom ihitauve. Ama chu Pathen dihtah le Tonsot Hinna ahi.
en_web: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
en_kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen Chapa thutah ihet theina diuva thil hetkhen themna lungthim eihungpeh-u chu iheuve; eiho thutah, Achapa Jesu Christa sunga chu um ihiuve. Ama chu Pathen tahbeh le tonsot hinna ahi.

tcz: Chapang deitahte, nalunguva Pathen munlothei ding ipi hita jongleh hia kon chun kikhin mangun.
en_web: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
en_kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Chate doilim semthu hou lah a kihong phauvin.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman thutah'a kangailut, lhendoh numei Ja-umnu le achate chule keima jengseh hilouva, thutah heho jouse hetdia jong kajih ahi.
en_web: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
en_kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
tcz_gospelgo: Upa keiman lhentum Numei lalnu chule achate changse, thutah a ka-ngailut, kei chang hilouva, thutah heho jousen jong angailut ho heng,

tcz: Ajeh chu thutah chu isunguva chenga chule eihotoh atonsot a umjing ding ahi.
en_web: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
en_kjv: for the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
tcz_gospelgo: eiho sunga um jing, tonsot geiya eiumpi jing diu thutah jal’in:

tcz: Pa Pathen le Achapa Pakai Yeshua Christa a hungkon–ngailutna le thutah'a ilah uva umjing ding, Lungset, hepi, chule Cham-lungmon chun naumpi jinguhen.
en_web: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
en_kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
tcz_gospelgo: Pa, Pathen le Pa Chapa Jesu Christa konin thutah le ngailut jal’a lungsetna le hepina, chamnan eiumpi jing diu ahi.

tcz: Pa chun athupeh bang tah a nachateu phabep thutah dungjuiya hinkho aman jal'in kakipapi lheh jenge.
en_web: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
en_kjv: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
tcz_gospelgo: Nachate konkhatse Paa kona ikisan’u thupeh dungjuiya chon kamun, kakipah lheh jengin ahi.

tcz: Keiman nangma numei ja-umnu kahin geldohsah naa kajih ahi, eiho khatle khat kingailua ium dingu ahi. Hiche thupeh thah ahipoi, hinlah atil abul'a pat'a inanei jingu chu ahi.
en_web: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
en_kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule tua hi hung tao kahi-lalnu, nahenga thupeh thah jong hinsun louva, khat le khat iki-ngailutto chehna diuva, semtil’a pat ineisau chu ahibouve.

tcz: Hiche kaseina jeh chu, vannoiya hin milhemlha tampi asohdoh tauve. Amaho chun Yeshua Christa hi tahsaphea hung tahbeh ahi ti asei le pouve. Hitobang mi chu milhemlha le Christa dou ahi.
en_web: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
en_kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu vannoiya hin doha mi-lhem lha tampi asohdohtai, amaho hin Jesu Christa tahsanphea ahung hi aphongdoh nompouve; doha mi lhemlha, Christa douva chu ama hi ahi.

tcz: Kihong phauvin, hahsatah a nahin neidoh u chu namansah louna dinguvin. Chingtheiyun, chutileh abulhingset a tohman namu dingu ahi.
en_web: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
en_kjv: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
tcz_gospelgo: Natohsa chu na-ngah louva tohga lhingset’a nasan na diuvin, nang ho ching theiyun, kivephauin.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche thuhila kona vahmang ho chu Pathen to kijopmat lou ahiuve. Hinlah koi hijongleh Christa thuhila umjing ho chu Pa le Chapa to kigui jop jingna nei ahitai.
en_web: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
en_kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile Christa thuhil’a um louva, akalval’a chon’a chun Pathen aneipoi. Thuhil’a um jing vang chun Pa le Chapa anei kop ahitai.

tcz: Koiham khattou hijongleh nakikhop khom nauva ahunga Christa thuhil thutah chu akalea ahil leh hitobang mi chu na in'a kou hih in, ahilouleh tilkhouna ima neihih un.
en_web: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
en_kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
tcz_gospelgo: Koi hile hiche thuhil keng louva nahenguva hunga chu san dauvin, na-in’uva lhunsah hih-uvin, kam phan jong hou dauvin.

tcz: Hitobang mi ho tilkhouva chu koi hijongleh anatoh phalouva chu chan aneikhomu ahitai.
en_web: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
en_kjv: for he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile ama kamphaa houva chun ama toh gitlou jouse jong achankhompi ahitai.

tcz: Keiman nangho koma thutampi seibe ding kanei nalaiye, hinlah keiman lekhapeh le lekha-twiyin kajih nompoi. Ajeh chu keiman nangho hung muloi ding kakinepna ahi. Chule kimaitoa nangho to kihoulim ding kanom'e. Chutengleh ikinepnau chamkim tante.
en_web: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
en_kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenguva hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhapheng le lekhatwi maiya sut kanompoi, nakipa nau achamkimsohna dinga nahengu hungphah a kimaitoa kamchenga ikihoulim diu kakinem’e.

tcz: Pathen lhendoh nasopinu chatea konin chibai kahinpeuve.
en_web: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
en_kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhentum nasopi nu chaten nasalam’uve.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman kagol ngaitah, Gaius, thutah'a kangailut henga kajih ahi.
en_web: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
en_kjv: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Upa keiman thutah beh a kangailut, kadeitah Gaius henga:

tcz: Deitah, nangma lhagaova nahat banga chu tahsa a jong nadam thei ding hi imalam jousea naphatpet ahiding kaginchat ahi.
en_web: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
en_kjv: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaitah, nahinkhoa phatthei nachan banga, ima lam jousea naphat theiya, nadam jingna din kataopeh jie.

tcz: Tumasang jep'a thuhila pang kholjin phabep hung kileho chun tahsan naumna le thutah'a hinkho naman thudol chu eiseipeh uvin, eikipasah lheh uve.
en_web: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
en_kjv: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Sopite phabep ahung uva nangma thutah a nachon hetsahjing banga, nathutah dol eihung hetsah-u iti kakipa hitam!

tcz: Keiman kachaten thutah ajuiyu thudol kajah'a kipana sanga lenjo adang kanei theipoi.
en_web: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
en_kjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Kachate thutah a achon kajah a kakipa sanga chungnungjo kipana kaneipoi.

tcz: Golngaitah, nangman nahetlou mi ahivanguva thuhila pang kholjin vahle ho nagel khohna hin, Pathena tahsan umtah nahi ti aphongdoh in ahi.
en_web: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
en_kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaitah, hetphah lou maljin hung hijongleu, sopite nabolna, natohna chu nakitah lheh jenge:

tcz: Amaho chun hikoma houbung jah a ngailutna neiya nanabolna thu chu aseiyuvin ahi. Hiti chun Pathen lunglhai sahnan hitobang thuhil ho ding chun thilgot pehna neijom teijin.
en_web: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
en_kjv: which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
tcz_gospelgo: amahon jong ngailut nanei chu Houbung angsunga ahettohsah-uvin, Pathen deidol bangin amaho hi ajin nauva anathahson le chun pha lheh inte.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho Pakai jal'a kholjin lea ahiuvin, chuti chun amahon tahsan neilouho koma imacha lalou ahiuve.
en_web: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
en_kjv: because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Christa min khohsah jal’a hungpot jeng ahiuvin, chidang namdangtea konin imacha akilah pouve.

tcz: Hijeh chun eima ho tah in amaho hi ikithopiu ngai ahi, hitia chu amahon thutah thu ahilnauva amaho tohkhompi ihitheina dingu ahije.
en_web: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
en_kjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
tcz_gospelgo: Thutah a atohnau hi ikithopi theina diuva hite ho tobang hi ilem diu thil khoh tah ahi.

tcz: Keiman houbung henga hiche thudol hi kajih in, hinlah Diotrephes, lamkai hinomna neipahin, keiho toh imacha a chan eineikhompi nompouve.
en_web: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
en_kjv: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
tcz_gospelgo: Houbung henga thu them khat kahinsun’in, ahinla alamkaiyuva pang nom Diotrephes chun ei nahsah pouve.

tcz: Keima kahung teng ama thilbol phabep le keiho dounaa athuseiya eimosonau thuphalou aseiya aboldoh ho kaphondoh ding ahi. Aman kholjin vahle thuhil ho alhunsahlou bou hilouvin, amaho kithopina jeng jong pehlou dingin aseiye. Chule amaho chun akikhop nauva, aman amaho chu houbunga konin anodoh in ahi.
en_web: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
en_kjv: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu kahung le athilbol, achonna, eiseiset nauva thu gilou asei jouseu kasosal ding ahi; hicheng abol jong hi achim hih laiyin, sopite chu alhunsah dan lhunsah dia go ho geijin aja da nalaiyin, amaho chu Houbunga konin anodoh jenge.

tcz: Golngaitah, hichepa vettoh thei ahilou hin nangma nalung lutsah hih hen. Aphabou chu juiyin. Thilphabol ho chun Pathen chate ahiu aphotchennau ahin, chule thilsebol ho chun Pathen ahet lou u ahi ti Thutah'in hettoh sahna aneibouvin ahi.
en_web: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
en_kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ngaitah, ase jom louvin, apha chubou jomin. Thilpha bol’a chu Pathena kon ahin, thilse bol’an vang Pathen amu loulai ahi.

tcz: Amitakip in Demetrius aseiphauvin ahi. Eimaho tah in hitima chu ama chung chang thu iseitheiyu ahi, chule keihon thutah kaseiyu nanghon naheuve.
en_web: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
en_kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
tcz_gospelgo: Demetrius chu mi jousen aseiphan, thutah-in jong aseiphai; chule keihon jong ama kaseiphauvin, kahettohsah nau thutah ahidol nangin nahenai.

tcz: Keiman seibe ding tampi kaneiye, hinlah keiman hichu lekhathot'ah kahin sei nom poi.
en_web: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
en_kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
tcz_gospelgo: Nahenga hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhatwi le lekhamol maiya sut ding kadeipoi.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma toh kimaitoa kimuto vahding kakinemin ahi. Chuphat leh kimaitoa ikihoulim ding ahi.
en_web: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
en_kjv: but I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangma muloi ding kakinemin, chutengle kimaiton kamchengin kihou nau hi te.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa soh le Jacob sopipa, Jude a kon ahi. Keiman, nangailu uleh Yeshua Christa venbitna noiya nahongbit jinguvah, Pa Pathen in akouho jouse dinga hiche lekhathot hi kahinjih ahi.
en_web: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
en_kjv: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
tcz_gospelgo: Jacob naopa, Jesu Christa soh natong Jude chun, Pa Pathen ngailu jouse le Jesu Christa dinga kikouva kikheh khol ho henga;

tcz: Pathen in nangho hepina, cham-lungmonna chule ngailutna napeh be jingu hen.
en_web: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
en_kjv: mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
tcz_gospelgo: Hepina le chamna chule ngailutna nachunguva hapunin pung hen.

tcz: Deitah teho, keiman nangho henga eiho jousen chan ineikhom'u huhhingna thudol hi kahinjih got ahi. Hinlah tun keiman achom dang khat, Pathen in amithengte henga khatveiya apehdoh tahsanna a pandet ding thujoh hi jihlouva phamo dan in kagel tai.
en_web: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
en_kjv: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Deitahte, nahenguva ineikhom cheh-u huhhingna thudol lekha hinsut kagot pettah-in khatvei mi thengte kipedohsa, tahsan thua napot tho diu deina tilkhouna joh a, hinsut ding khoh kasajotai.

tcz: Hiche kiseilona ajeh hi Pathen ngaisahlou phabep nahoubung sung uvah ahunglut un, Pathen milungsetna kidangtah hin thenlouna hinkho man aphatsah dan'in aseidoh'uvin ahi. Hitobang mi ho themmo channa hi masang apat'a kisun ahitai, ajehchu amahohin Ipipu'u khatseh le IPakaiyu aseilep un ahi.
en_web: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
en_kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile eiho lah a hin hitobang thudol’a achung thu tan’a themmo chang dinga koisa Pathen helou mi phabep guh thimin ahung lut’uvin, amaho hin Pathenin eipeh-u lungsetna chu huhna lamin aheidoh-un, chule ipipu le i-Pakaiyu Jesu geiyin aseilep tauve.

tcz: Hijeh a chu, hicheho jouse hi nahetsau hijongleh avel a kageldohsah nomu chu, Pakai chun Israel nam mite chu amasatah in Egypt'a konin ahuhdoh in, hinlah tahsan theitah a umjom louho chu khonungin asumangin ahi.
en_web: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
en_kjv: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
tcz_gospelgo: Khatvei chu nahetsau hitajongle, Pakaiyin mipi chu Egypt’a kona ahuhdoh a, anichan naa atahsan lou jeh-uva asuh mang hel thudol hi nang ho kageldohsah kitnom nahiuve.

tcz: Chule Pathen in thuneina ahibep apeh kalvala chon, aumnau mun dalha a potdoh vantil ho chu muthim lah a songkul'a thihkhauva ahen chahkheh a, athutanna niloupini chu ngah a uma ahiu chu keiman kageldoh sah kit nahiuve.
en_web: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
en_kjv: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
tcz_gospelgo: Atha neinau panmun tuh det louva, apanmun dalhaa Vantilte jeng jong aman, ni loupi chungnung ni le athuu tan dinga tonsot thihkhaova ahen’a, muthim lah a akoi ahi.

tcz: Chule Sodom le Gomorrah chule akinaipi khopi ho chu thenlouna jonthanhoina chule numei le pasal kingaichatna phalou dimset ahiuve ti sumil hih un. Hiche khopiho chu meiyin suhmangin aumin, tonsot meidil a Pathen thutanna um dinga gihna ahitai.
en_web: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
en_kjv: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them, in like manner giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah chule akimvel dunga khopi ho, alam loutah a huh le jonthanhoi lam a kipeuva, japi hilchahna dinga tonsot meikouva kihalvam’a achung thuu kitan talen kimatsah chu geldohuvin.

tcz: Hitima chun, hiche mi ho–amangmat uva kona thuneitah'a kigel ho hin, thenlouna in hinkho amanguvin, thuneiho anelkal uvin, chule boltheina kidang bol ho jong ajontaiyun ahi.
en_web: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
en_kjv: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin hite hon mudih lou anei jeh-un tahsa asuboh-un, Pathen thunei vaipohna asan dauvin, loupina chengse ataitom jiuve.

tcz: Hinlah Michael, vantil lah'a athanei pen khat, jeng jong chun Diabol chu taitoma houset angampon, hinlah, “Pakaiyin nasamse hen,” tibou aseiye. (Hiche hi Michael'in Mose long chungchanga Diabol toh akinel pet a thilsoh ahi).
en_web: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
en_kjv: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil pipu Michael jengin bon Mose long chung thua Diabol to akinel chun taitoma houset ding, chule achung thu tan ding angam pon, “Pakaiyin nahouse hen,” atijoi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche mihohin ahetchenlouvu thil ho chu nuisat hoh'in aneiyuve. Amaho hi lunggel asuhsah neilou gancha ho bangin, ahinauvin ahinphut dung juiyin amoh bolbol uvin, chuti chun amahotah in amanthahna diu akiloilut jiuve.
en_web: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
en_kjv: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin ahettoh lou ataitom jiu ahin, gancha ho banga atichunguva hetna ho hin amaho asuhmang gamjoh ahitai.

tcz: Amaho hi itobang lunggimnan angau hitam! Ajehchu amahon asopipa thatpa, Cain lampi chu ahotauve. Balaam bangin, miho sum deichatnan alhemlhauve. Chule Korah bangin, doulung aputnauva amah thahlo tauve.
en_web: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
en_kjv: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
tcz_gospelgo: Achung’u thu akhoh-e! Amaho Cain lampi kijot’a tohman duchatnaa Balaam lampia cheuva, Korah-in doumah abolnaa chu mangthah gam ahitauve.

tcz: Hiche mihotoh hin Pakai ngailutna geldohna a an nehkhom nanei tengu leh, amaho hi twinoiya songpi um tobang, nakong'u kesah thei ahiuve. Amaho hi jachatna neilou kelngoi ching amabou kikhohsah ho ahiuve. Amaho hi leiset chung lama hung kitol lea ahiala go a julhalou meibol tobangbep ahiuve. Amaho hi chavang laiya thingphung, nivei thisa, aga sodohlou ajung geiya kibotdoh tobang ahiuve.
en_web: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

en_web: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

en_web: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

en_kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun nathilmu chengse, aum ho hi le tu nung teng hung um ding ho hi sunin.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Ephesus khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche hi ahsi sagi akhutjet lama choiya, thaomei khom sagi ho lah a vahle pa chun thu hitin aseiye.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

tcz_gospelgo: “Ephesus Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi choiya, sana thaomei khom sagi lah a vah le chun hitin aseiye,

tcz: Keiman nathilbol ho jouse kahei. Natohgimna ho le thohhattah a napanna kamun ahi. Migilouho nathoh joulou kahei. Solchah kahi tia kiseiho nakhol tohlea amahola solchah hilou, jousei ahiu nangman namandoh jengin ahi.
en_web: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman nanatohjouse le thohgim thohda nathoh jouse kahei; solchah la hilouva solchah kihisah ho jong napatep’in, ajou nau namandoh-in, hiti hin migilou ho chu nathoh nom hih hel’e.

tcz: Nangman keidingin lhadah louvin thohhahsa nathoh in ahi.
en_web: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nachunga lunglhai louna hiche hi kaneiye. Amasa tobang'in nangman neingailu tapoi chujongleh nakingailu tapouve.

en_web: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
en_kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun hoikoma kisep lhu nahim, geldoh-in, chule lung heiyin lang, natoh masah chengse chu tong kit’in; chutia lung nahei loule nahenga hung ing ting nathaomei khom chu akitunnaa kona kachon mang ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche hi nangma goh hilouva keiman jong kathet Nicolaitan ho thilphalou bol chu nahot ahi.
en_web: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
en_kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijongle Nicolai mi ho natoh keiman kathet ho chu, nangin jong nathen, phatna hiche vang hi naneiye.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiyah chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen. Koi koihileh jona neichan chu Pathen gamloupi akona keiman Hin thingphung ga kapeh ding ahi.
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu Pathen honsunga keh hinthing ga chu neh dia kapeh ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Smyrna sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche thuhi athisa hiya hijongleh tua hung hingkit, amasa le anunungpen a hungkon ahi.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
en_kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
tcz_gospelgo: “Smyrna Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akipatna le akichaina, thia hingkit chun hitin aseiye:

tcz: Keiman nathoh gimna le navaichatna kahei-hinla nangma nahao nai! Nang dounaa Pathen taitomho kahenai. Amahon Juda mi kahi atiuvin, hinla ahipouve, ajeh chu amaho kikhopna in chu Satan a ahi.
en_web: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
en_kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman nathohgim hesoh navaichat kahenai, ahinla nahaove; Juda midan a kiseiyuva hila hi-ngal lou, Satan kikhopna hungkon hon taitomna aneiyujong kahei.

tcz: Hahsatna nangman nahin thohding ho chu kicha hih in. Nangho lah a mi phabep chu Diabolin apatep naa songkul'a nahin khum dingu ahi. Nangman ni-som nathoh gim ding ahi. Hilah nangman thichan geiya tahsan nauma ahileh keiman hinna lallukhuh chu kapeh ding nahi.
en_web: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
en_kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahin thot gimna ding ho hi kicha hih hel’in. Ven, nang ho patepna dinga nalahuva abang bang Diabol’in songkul’a ahinkhum ding, ahivang nisom bou nathothgim diu ahi. Thina geiyin thot-in tahsanin, Keiman hinna lallukhuh kapeh ding nahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiyin chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen. Jonanei mi chu thininan achunga thu aneilou ding ahitai.
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu thi ni nan asuh nat louding ahi.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pergamum sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hiti hin sun in. Hemto chemjam choipaa kona thu chu hiche hi ahi.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:
en_kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
tcz_gospelgo: “Pergamum Houbung solle henga chun thitin sunin: ‘Hemto chemjam hemtah neipan hitin aseiye:

tcz: Nangma Satan laltouna kidona khopia chu chenga, ahijeng vanga keima dinga kitah a napan chu kahenai. Chuche Satan khopia nalahuva kathu hettohsah tahsan umtah Antipas kitha chan geiyin jong keima neiseilep nomdehpoi.
en_web: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
en_kjv: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman nachenna mun, Satan laltouna chu kahei; Kei dinga tahsan um, kadinga hettohsah pha Antipas atha laiyu nikhon jong Keiya um tahsan nadalha pon, kamin natuh det jinge; Antipas chu Satan chenna mun, nang ho lah a athau ah.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nangma chunga lunglhai louna themkhat kaneiye. Nangman nalah uva Balaam in athuhil Israel mite kipalna ding Balak avetsah tobang thuhil ho navethim in ahi. Ama chun milim kihouna a kikatdoh anneh le jonthanhoina neidingin thu ahilin ahi.
en_web: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
en_kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivang in na chunga demna phabep kanei ye, ajeh chuIsreael chate masanga kipal lhuhna ding koiya, doilim semthu houna sa nehsah a, chule jonthanhoi patsah dinga go Balak hilchah a Balaam thuhil choiya mi phabep naneiye.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, nangman Nicolaitan ho thuhil jui nalahuvah nanei nalaiye.
en_web: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
en_kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang hin nangin jong Nicolai mi ho thuhilchoiya mi phabep naneiye.

tcz: Nachonsetna ho kisih in achuti louva ahileh keima nahenga phulou helouva kahunga chule amaho chu kakamsung chemjama kasat ding ahi.
en_web: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
en_kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun lung heiyin, achutiloule nahenga kahungvah jel’a kakamsung chemjam them’a amaho chu kasat gam diu ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiyin chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen. Koi koihileh jona neichan chu vana kiselguh manna chu kapeh ding ahi. Chule keiman khatchang cheh a songkangkhat kapeh ding ahi, chule song chunga chu akisanpa tailou, koima dangin ahettheilou minthah kijihdoh ding ahi.
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na thuseina neiyan Houbung hohenga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu selguh manna kapeh ding, chule che songval chunga chu minthan khat kijih ahi, akisanpa tilou koima ding in asimthei lou hel ding ahi.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Thyatira khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche hi Pathen Chapa, amitteni meikou tobang jeng, akengphang teni jong sum-eng kipot jolsel tobang ahi.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:
en_kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
tcz_gospelgo: “Thyatira Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amit te ni meikou pah lah lah tobang, akengto te ni sum-eng kinotval tobang Pathen Chapan hitin aseiye, “Keiman natoh josue le na ngailut je, natahsan le nalhacha natoh, chujongle nathot hatje, natohna jouse amasa natohsanga aphatjoh kahenai.

tcz: Keiman nathilbol ho jouse kahei. Keiman nangailutna, natahsanna, nalhacha natohna, chule thohhattah a napanna kahenai. Keiman nangma imalam jousea namachal jingna ho kahenai.
en_web: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
en_kjv: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nachunga lunglhai louna hiche hi kaneiye. Nangman chuche numeinu–Jezebel amatah themgao nua kisei chun kasoh ho apui lamvaiyin ahi. Amanu hin jonthanhoi boldingin thu ahil in chule milim houna a kikatdoh anneh anehsah e.
en_web: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
en_kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nachunga cemna kaneiye, ajeh chu Jezebel kithemgaosah nu chu nacham lhan, aman kasohte jonthanho lam ahil’in, doilim semthu houna sa nehsahdin ajol lhai.

tcz: Keiman amanu akisihna ding phat kapen, hinla amanu themlouna a konin akiheimang nompon ahi.
en_web: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
en_kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken amanu chu along heina ding phat kapen, hila aman ajon thanhoinaa konin lung aheidehpoi,

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman amanu hi gimthohna jalkhun'a kalelut ding ahi. Chule aman ajonpi ho chu akisihlouva chuleh athilsebolnaa kona alung aheilouva ahileh gimthohna nasatah athoh dingu ahi.
en_web: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
en_kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, keiman amanu hi jalkhun chng se na kanei ding, hiche jonthanghoi thilbol josue a kona lung ahie louvu le ajonpi chenrsen jong thoh gentei chungnung athoh diu ahi.

tcz: Keiman amanu achate kavoh a thidiu ahi. Chutengleh houbung hon keima hi lunggel jouse le amichang cheh lung ngaito Hepa kahi hi ahet dingu ahi.
en_web: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
en_kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
tcz_gospelgo: Thina kaman a achate jouse kathagam ding, chuteng le Houbung jousen lung ngaito chengse le lungthim josue hethei kahi ahet diu, chujong le anatoh dung jui cheh-uva amitakip kalethuh ding nahiuve.

tcz: Hinlah keiman jong Thyatira khopia cheng, hiche thuhil dihlou juilouho dinga jong thulhut ding kaneiye. Hiche kalval keiman nanghoa ngehbe nei ponge.
en_web: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.
en_kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahila Thyatira a um amoh cheng, hiche thuhil jop lou, Satan thugil kiti helou chengse nachunguva pohgih dang koibe peh pouvinge.

tcz: Keima kahung masangsea naneisunu chu nakituhchah dingu bou hi ahi.
en_web: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
en_kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin nanei sun’u chu kahung kahsen tuhdet jingun.

tcz: Kasei achaina geiya ngaiho jona neijouse dinga chu chitin namtin chunga thuneina kapeh ding ahi.
en_web: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
en_kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
tcz_gospelgo: Chule galjouva, kanatoh ho achaina geiya nit jing chu namtin vaipi chunga thu neina kapeh ding,

tcz: Amaho chun chitin namtin chunga thih tenggola vai ahom ding chule leibel banga amaho chu avohchip ding ahi.
en_web: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;
en_kjv: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
tcz_gospelgo: aman amaho chu kelngaoi chin bang thih tenggol’a achin’a, leibel kivochip banga abol ding,

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiyin chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Sardis khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi neiya chule ahsi sagi neipa thulhut chu ahi. “Keiman nathilbol jouse, chule ahinga minchena jouse naneiye ti kahei-hinla nangma athi nahi.”
en_web: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
en_kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
tcz_gospelgo: “Sardis Houbung solle henga hitin sunin: ‘Pathen Lhagao sagi le ahsi sagi neipan hitin aseiye, “Keiman nanatoh josue kahen, amin’a hinga nahin, athisa nahibouve.

tcz: “Khangdoh in! Amohthem aumden ho suhat'in, ajeh chu amoh them umdenho jeng jong hi athikon cha ahitauve. Ijeh ham itileh nachonna ho hi Pathen mitmun thutah to akigamlat lheh jenge.
en_web: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
en_kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
tcz_gospelgo: Khangin lang hah jing jengin, amoh cheng, athikon ho dindetsah-in; ajeh chu ka-Pathen mitmua nanatoh ho achamkimsoh kamudoh poi.

tcz: Nangman najah sa, chule natahsan masah achun umdenin. Kisih in chule kaheng lama hung kihei kit in. Nangma nakhahdoh kitlouva ahileh keima phulou helouva naginchat loupet tahle gucha tobanga kahung ding ahi.
en_web: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
en_kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh chun atil’a itobanga nakisan’a, iti najah-em geldoh jingin, nit phan, lung heiyin. Hijeh a chu nahajing loule gucha banga kahung ding, itih phat le naheng kahinsuh ding nahet lou ding ahi.

tcz: Chuti jongleh, Sardis houbung a aponsilu gitlouna a kisubohlou miphabep aumuve. Amaho chu kilomtah ahijeh uva keima toh ponbang kisila vahle ding ahiuve.
en_web: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
en_kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis, which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
tcz_gospelgo: Amvang aponsil’u kisuh nen lou mi phabep Sardis a aum’un, amaho hi ponbang vamleh sil’a Keito kilhon le ding ahiuve, ajeh chu amaho chutidia limtah ahiuve.

tcz: Jona neijouse chu ponbang kisila vahle cheh ding ahiuve. Keiman aminu chu Hinna Lekhabua kanoimang louhel ding, chusanga keiman aminu chu Kapa angsunga le Vantilte masanga keiya ahiuve tia kaphondoh ding ahi.
en_web: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
en_kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
tcz_gospelgo: Galjouva chu amaho kivonna ponbang vamleh a kivon ding, chule hinna lekhabua kona Keiman amin kathai mang louding, ka-Pa angsung le a-Vantilte angsunga ama min chu kasei doh ding ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neija chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.”
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Philadelphia houbunga um thupo henga hitin sun in: Hiche thuhi athenga le adih'ah, akhut'a David Kot heh choiya Aman ahon le koiman khah theilou chule akha chu koima chan hongtheilou pa a kon ahi.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
en_kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
tcz_gospelgo: “Philadelphia Houbung solle henga thitin sunin: ‘Atheng le atahbeh, David kanglongheh neiya, aman ahon le koiman khah thei lou, aman akha le koiman hong thei lou, ama chun hitin aseiye.

tcz: Keiman nathilbol jouse kahei, chule keiman nangma dingin kot kahongin koiman akhatheilou ding ahi. Nangma thalhomtah nahi, Achuti vang'in kathusei nangaiyin chule neiseilep poi.
en_web: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
en_kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman nanatoh jouse kahenai, ven, koman akha thei lou na-angasunga kot honsan kakoiye; tha them khat vang naneiyin, kathu nanit’in, kamin nasei leppoi.

tcz: Ven, Satan kikhopna a jaoho–jousei Juda mi kahi tia ahivanga hilou ho, chu ada achamlouva amaho chu ahunguva chule nakengphang bul'a kakunsah ding ahiuve. Amahon nangma kangailut nahi ti hetsahna aphondoh thei dingu ahi.
en_web: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
en_kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, Satan kikhpna pang ho phabep, acham cham’a Juda mi kihisah a, hila hilouhel, jousei ho chu kapehdoh ahin, ven keiman nang ka-ngailut hi ahetdoh theina diuva, na-anga sung, nakhophang bul’a boh khup’a chibai kahung bohsah ding ahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman kathupeh ho thohhattah a najui ahijeh'in, vannoi pumpi a patepna khoh chungnung hiche vannoiya hiho dinga hung ding patepna akona kahoidoh ding nahi.
en_web: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
en_kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin thoh hat dinga kasei nanit jeh a vannoi leiset pumpi chunga patepna ahung lhun’a, leiset chung cheng jouse akipatep phat teng le ken jong nang kahuhdoh ding nahi.

tcz: Keima ka hungloi ding ahi. Koimachan nalal lukhuh chu nalahpeh louna dingin kolchah jingin.
en_web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
en_kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahungvah jet ding ahi, nalal lukhuh koman nalahpeh louna din nanei sun tuuhdet jingin.

tcz: Jona neiho jouse chu ka Pathen hou-in'a khombul a kapansah ding ahi, chule amahon hichu adalhah tahlou dingu ahi. Chule keiman achunguva ka Pathen min kajih ding chule amaho ka Pathen khopi mite hiding ahiuve–Jerusalem thah, vana ka Pathena kona hungkumlha mun'a chu. Chule keiman achunguva kaminthah kasut ding ahi.
en_web: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
en_kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
tcz_gospelgo: Galjouva chu keiman ka-Pathen Houin khom’a kasem ding, hikoma kona chu potdoh louhel ding ahitan, achunga ka-Pathen min le ka-Pathen khopi Jerusalem thah, van’a ka-Pathen koma kona hung kitol lha, min kasut ding ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Laodicea khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche thuhi Amen kitipa–tahsan umtah le hettohsahna dihtah, Pathen thilsemthah a hungkon ahi.
en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
en_kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
tcz_gospelgo: “Laodicea Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amen, Hettohsahpa, Tahsan um, Atahbeh, Pathen thilsem jouse Bulpi chun hitin thu aseiye.

tcz: Nangman thil nabol jouse chu kahei, hiti chun nangma sa jong nasapon, votjong navotpoi. Keiman nangma khat joh sang nahi ding chu kadeipeh nahi.
en_web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
en_kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keiman nanatoh jouse kahen, vot la navot pon, sa la nasapoi. Navot le votngal’in lang, nasat le san gal le chun pha kasai.

tcz: Hinlah nangma twilum tobangbep nahin, sajong salou, votjong votlou nahijeh a kakama kona kaphidoh dingkon nahi.
en_web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
en_kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitia hi lumheo bep nahiya, sa la san gal lou, vot la votngal lou nahijeh hin kakamsunga kona kakhondoh ding kon nahitai.

tcz: Nangman kahaove, kadeichan kaneiyin, imacha kangaichapoi nati. Ahinla nangma adapen, khoto umtah, vaichatah, mitcho chule sagohkeo nahi chu nakihetpoi.
en_web: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
en_kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itil nangin, ‘Kahaove, sum kaneiye, imacha ngaichat kaneipoi,’ natin; nang tah chu adapen le khoto umpen, vaichatah le micho chu le sagohkeio nahilam nakihet poi.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiman nangma kathumop nom chu keiya konin sana kichoh in–Meiya kilhathengsel sana chu kichoh in. Chutengleh nangma nahao ding ahitai. Chujongleh keiya konin ponsil bangleh kichoh in chutengleh sagoh keova naumna chu jahcha taponatin, chule mamit a dinga mitlou jong chu kho namuna hiding ahi.
en_web: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
en_kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
tcz_gospelgo: Nahaona dia kakoma, kilha thengsel sana kichoh ding le, nakisil’a najamo kimudoh lou na dia nakhu jol ding pon bangle kichoh a, kho namu theina dia mitlou kichoh dinga kathu mop nahi.

tcz: Keiman kangailut chan kasuhdih jia chule kathunun ji ahi. Hiti chun gunchun chule nalunggel dihlouva konin hung kihei kit'in.
en_web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
en_kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
tcz_gospelgo: Keiman kalungset chan kaphosal’a kaoblgimji ahi, hijeh chun tompan in lang lung heiyin.

tcz: Ven! Keima kot'a kadingin chule kot kakiuve. Nangman ka aw najah a chule kot nahon'a ahile keima hunglut ingting chule loi le gol hina a an kaneh khompi ding nahi.
en_web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
en_kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, kotkha bul’a ka dingin kakiu jinge, khattouvin ka-ogin ajah a kot eiho leh, ahenga kahung sung lhah a ama chu an kaneh khompia, aman jong eineh khompi ding ahi.

tcz: Jona neiho chu koikoi hileh keiman jona kaneiya ka-Pa Laltouna a katoukhom banga hi amaho jong chu kalaltouna a katoukhom pi ding ahi.
en_web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
en_kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Galjouva chu ken jong kajoa ka-Pa to alaltouna katoukhom banga hi keito kalaltouna toukhomna thei thu kapeh ding ahi.

tcz: “Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.”
en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
en_kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
tcz_gospelgo: Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen!” tin aseiye” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman kavetleh vana kotkhat akihon kamun, chuin aw kana jahsa mama chun kajah a thu asei chu sumkon kimutging toh abangin ahi. Aw chun kajah a, “Hilai muna hungkal touvin, chule keiman hiche jouva ipi hungsoh ding ahi naseipeh inge,” ati.
en_web: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
en_kjv: After this I looked, and behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng jou hin vetan, van’a kot khat honsa um kamun, chule kajah masat pen ogin chu sumkon gin tobang ahin, kahenga thu aseiyin, “Hilama hung kaltouvin, hicheng nunga soh tei ding thil ho chu kavetsah ding nahi,” eiti.

tcz: Chule apettah chun keima Lhagaovin kaumin, chule van'ah laltouna kamun chuin koiham khat achunga atou kamun ahi.
en_web: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
en_kjv: And immediately I was in the spirit: and behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Apettah chun Lhagaovin kaumtan, hichun ven, van’a laltouna khat akidon, laltouna chunga chun koiham khat atouve;

tcz: Laltouna a toupa chu songmantam vah'a vahjenga ahin–songmantam ajempol le asandang tobang ahi. Chule vah hung kikapdoh chu songmantam-eng vallah lah tobang chun Alaltouna kimvel chu lhagui bangin atomin ahi.
en_web: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
en_kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
tcz_gospelgo: atoupa chu jasper song le sardis song bangin alange, chule laltouna kimvel’a chun lhagui aumin, emerald song tobangin akimui.

tcz: Laltouna somni le lin Ama akimvel un, chule upa somni le li hia chun atouvui. Amaho chun abonchauvin ponbang akivonun chule aluchunguva sana lallukhuh akikhuh cheh uve.
en_web: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
en_kjv: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna kimvel’a chun laltouna som ni le li akidon, laltouna ho chunga chun ponbang jeng kisil’a alua sana lal lukhuh jeng kikhuh, upa som ni le li atouvui.

tcz: Laltouna a konin kolphe le van ginglullul chu ahung kithongdoh in ahi. Chule laltouna masanga meivah sagi meikong banga vah ahungvah in ahi. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi ho chu ahi.
en_web: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
en_kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna a kon chun kolphe avah lap lap’in, o-agingin, van akithinge; laltouna maiya chun mei kou jing jeng thaomei sagi aumin, hiche ho chu Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve.

tcz: Chule Laltouna masanga chun Songval tobanga vah, phatvet twikhanglen valset, kolphemeivah tobang chu ahungvah in: chule Laltouna lailung le akimvel a chun hinnanei li, amasang le anunga amit jeng amitjeng nei chu kamui.
en_web: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
en_kjv: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
tcz_gospelgo: Lalouna maiya chun Crystal song tobang, phatvet banga kimu, Twikhanglen aumin, chule laltouna lailung le akimvel’a chun, anung le amaa amit jeng amit jeng dimset ganhing li aum’ui.

tcz: Hiche Hinnanei li ho lah a a-khatna chu keipi tobang ahi; a-nina chu bongchal tobang ahi; a-thumna chun mihem mel apui; chule a-lina chu muvanlai lenpet tobang ahi.
en_web: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
en_kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing masapen chu Phaisammeigeo tobang ahin, ganhing ni na chu Bongnou tobang ahin, ganhing thumna chun mihem mai tobang aneiyhin, gang hing li lhinna chu Muvanlai lengpet tobang ahi.

tcz: Hinnanei li ho hin lhaving gup aneicheh uvin, chule alhavingu chun amit'u asunglam le apolam asim cheh uvin ahi. Suntin le jantinin amaho chun, “Athenge, athenge, athenge, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung–Anaumjingsapa, tua uma chule ahung umnalai ding” tin asamjom jingun ahi.
en_web: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
en_kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
tcz_gospelgo: Ganhing li ho chun lhaving gup cheh aneiyun, akimvel le anung lam amite jeng ahiuve; chule sun le janin choldo louhel’in la asauvin: “Atheng, Atheng, Atheng, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung ahin, Aumsa le aum jing chule ahung um ding,” atiuve.

tcz: Hinnanei li ho chun loupina le jabolna chule thangvahna chu Laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hingjingpa) chu apeh tenguleh,
en_web: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
en_kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ganhing li ho chun tonsot’a hing jing jeng, Laltouna kitousah Pa chu achoi-at’a, ajabol’uva chule athangvah tengu le,

tcz: Upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chule laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hing jingpa) masanga chun, alallukhuh u chu akoilhauvin, chule aseiyun,
en_web: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
en_kjv: the four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
tcz_gospelgo: upa som ni le li jong chu laltouna kitousah Pa angsunga chu lhujiuva, tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pa chu chibai abohuva, laltouna maiya chu alal lukhuh-u aselhah-uva, hitia asei yuva:

tcz: “O Pakai ka Pathenu, Nangma loupina le Jabolna chule thaneina changa loma nahi. Ajeh chu nangman ijakai nasemin, chule amaho hi nangma phatsah a uma chule kisema ahiuve,” atiuve.
en_web: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
en_kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ka-Pakaiyu le ka-Pathenu, Nangma bou loupina le jabolna chule tha neina changa lomtah nahi; Ajeh chu nangin thil ijakai nasemin, Nangma deiya kisem doh a um ahiuve,” Atiuvin ahi.

tcz: Chutah'in keiman Laltouna a toupan akhut jetlam'a lekhajol khat achoi chu kamun ahi. Lekhajol chu asung lam le apolam kijihgel ahin, chule hichu sinkhana sagin mohor akinam khum in ahi.
en_web: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
en_kjv: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna Toupa khut jetlama chun, asung lam apolam, alangtoa kisun, mohor sagi jen jinamkhum, lekhajol khat kamui.

tcz: Chuin keiman vantil hattah khat aw sangtah'a kho asap kajai: “Koiham hiche lekhajol sinkhana kinam khum hi ahong dinga kiloma chu?” ati.
en_web: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
en_kjv: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Vantil hattah ogin sang tah a samphong lea, “Hiche lekhajol mohorkinam ho sut lhaa lham jou dinga lom chu koipen ham?” ti khat kamui.

tcz: Hinlah vana hihen, ahilouleh leichunga hihen chule leinoiya hijongleh lekhajol chu ahongthei le asimthei ding akimutapoi.
en_web: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
en_kjv: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla van’a hihen leiset’a hijongle, leiset noi geiyin lekhabu chu ahongdoh theiya le avetheiya aumtapoi.

tcz: Chuphat in keima hakan kakaptai, ajeh chu lekhajol chu ahong ding le asim ding'ah koima akimutapon ahi.
en_web: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
en_kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun lekhabu phong doh thei le avetheiya akimudoh lou phat’in hakan kakaptai.

tcz: Hinlah upa somni le li holah a khatchun kajah a aseiyin, “Kaptahih in! Ven, Judah phunga Keipi, David Laltouna a toudingpa chun jona aneitai. Amahi lekhajol hong dinga le a sinkhana sagi lhamlha dinga kiloma ahi,” ati.
en_web: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
en_kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea chun upaho lah akhat’in kajah a, “Kap hih-in, ven, Juda phunga phaisameigeo, David Jung chu hiche lekhabu phongdoh ding le amaohor sagi chu lhamla didnga galjousa ahitai,’ eiti.

tcz: Chuphat'in keiman Kelngoinou khat akithatsa lheh lheh chu Laltouna le Hinnanei li ho kahlah a chule upa somni le li ho kahlah a adin chu kamun ahi. Ama chun ki-sagi aneiyin, chule vannoi muntina kisoldoh a Pathen lhagao sagi, mit-sagi jong neiya chu ahi.
en_web: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
