en_kjv: And I beheld, and lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ganhing li ho le upahon aumkimve’u laltouna lailunga chun Kelngoinou kithatsa lheh lheh khat ding kamun, ki le mit sagi gi aneiye; chule hiche ho chu leiset chun gpumpia hung kisol lha Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve.

tcz: Ama chu ahung pheiyin chuin Laltouna a toupa khut jet lama kon chun lekhajol chu aladoh in ahi.
en_web: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
en_kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chu ahingin laltouna Toupa khut jetlama konin lekhajol chu alai.

tcz: Chuin aman lekhajol chu alahphat in, Hinnanei-li ho chule upa somni le li ho chu Kelngoinou masanga chun akuncheh tauve. Khat khat cheh in akhut uva selangdah, chule sana khon gimnamtwi dimset a kikoi, Pathen mite taona chu akichoicheh un ahi.
en_web: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
en_kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Alah phat’in ganhing li ho le upa som ni le li chu kelngoinou angsunga chun abohkhup cheh-uvin amaho khat cheh-in akhut’uva selangdah khat le sana sumlheng dung’ah, mithengte taona chu, gimnamtui bangin akichoi cheh-ui.

tcz: Chule amaho chun lathah khat hiche thucheng hohin asaove: “Nangma lekhajol chu la a chule asinkhana chu lhamlha dinga kiloma nahi. Ajeh chu nangma akithatsa nahin chule nathisanin mitampi chu–phungtina kon, paotina kon chule mijouse le namtina konin Pathena dingin nalhatdamtai.
en_web: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
en_kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin lathah khat asauvin: “Lekhabu kilah ding le Mohor ho lhamlha hong din nangbou nakilom’e; Ajeh chu nangma kithatsa nahin, Nathisan’a phungtin le paotin tanga kon Mitin mitanga kona Pathen mi hi dinga nachohdohsa ahitan,

tcz: Chule nangman amaho chu IPathen uva dingin Lenggam thempuhoa nahisah'in, chule amahon leiset chunga vai ahom dingu ahi.”
en_web: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
en_kjv: and hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Nangin amaho chu i-Pathenu dia Thempu Lenggam’a nasemdoh ahitan, Hijeh a chu leiset chunga lengvai aph diu ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin kavekit in ahileh keiman mi asangsang, simsenlou laltouna kimvela um Vantilte ho le sahem-hing ho chule upa ho awgin chu kajan ahi.
en_web: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
en_kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kagah vet leh laltouna le ganhing ho chule upaho kemvel’a ding, Vantil tampi ogin kajan, amaho chu ajat sangsom jet tamtah sang jat alhinguve.

tcz: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun la asauvin, “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu–thaneina le haonaho chule chihna le thahatna chule jabolna le loupina chule phattheina chang dinga lom ahi.”
en_web: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
en_kjv: saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin ogin sangtah-in aseiyun: “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu Boltheina tha, haona, thahat, Jabolna, loupina chule Vahchoina kisan dinga lomtah ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuin keiman vana le leichunga chule leinoiya le twikhanglen'a hinna nei jousen vahchoila asah u kajan, “Phattheina le jabolna chule loupina chule thilbolthei thahatna chu Laltouna a toupa chung'ah chule Kelngoinou chung ah atonsot tonsot'in umhen” atiuve.
en_web: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
en_kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin van, leiset chung, leiset noiya, Twikhanglen sunga, thilsem kiti jousen aseiyu kajah chu: “Laltouna chung Toupa le Kelngoinou, Tonsot tonsot geiyin vahchoina le choi-atna, Lopina le thunei vaipohna chang jing hen,” kiti ahi.

tcz: Chule Hinnanei-li ho chun “Amen!” tin aseiyuve. Chuin upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chuin Kelngoinou chu ahou tauvin ahi.
en_web: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
en_kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitah chun ganhing li hon, “Amen,” atiuvin, upa chengsen jong abohkhup’un chibai abohtauve.

tcz: Keiman kavetleh, Kelngoinou chun lekhajol sinkhana sagia kinam lah a amasapen chu alhamlhatan ahi. Chuphat in Hinnanei-li ho lah a khat chun van-gin tobang'in thu ahinseiyin, “Hungin!” ati.
en_web: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
en_kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Kelngoinou chun mohor sagi ho lah a khat alhap lhah a ahondoh kamun, chule ganhing li lah a khat’in ogin sangtah a asap’a, “Hungin,” ati kajai.

tcz: Keima kadah in ahileh sakol kang khat adin kamui. Achunga toupa chun thalpi khat achoiyin, chule aluchunga lallukhuh khat akhuhsah uvin ahi. Amahi galkisatna tampi chu jou dinga chule gajoutei dinga hungkondoh ahi.
en_web: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
en_kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun vetemin, sakol kang khat kamun, achunga toupan gophel khat achoiyin, ama chu lallukhuh khat apeuvin, galjouva jousoh peh din akondohtai.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nina chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei-ninapa chun aseiyin, “Hungin” ati.
en_web: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
en_kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
tcz_gospelgo: Mohor ni na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing ni nan, “Hungin,” ati kajan ahi.

tcz: Chuphat in sakolchom, asan khat, chu ahung kilahdoh in ahi. Achunga toupa chu chemjam ahema hemkhat akipen chule leiset chunga cham-lungmonna lamang dingin thuneina akipei. Chule chua chun gal aumin chule mitamtah akithat muntinah aumin ahi.
en_web: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.
en_kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun sakol chom, asan khat ahungdoh-in, achunga toupa chun leiset chung chamna alah manga, mihem khat le khat kithatona thu aneina akipen, chemjam lentah khat jong apeuve.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana athumna chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei–athum napa chun, “Hungin” ati kajai. Keima kadah in kavetleh sakolvom khat kamun, chule achunga toupa chun agih tetohna tokhat chu akhut'a atuh in ahi.
en_web: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
en_kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Mohor thumna alhap’a ahondoh paht’in, ganhing thum lhin nan, “Hungin,” ati kajai. Hichun vetemin, sakolvom khat kamun, achunga toupan thil tena khat achoiye.

tcz: Chule keiman Hinnanei–liho lah a aw-khat kajai, “Suhlouchang lhah pheng-khat ahilouleh sakol changlhah pheng thumchu nikhotha khat manjat hiding ahi. Chule Olive thao le lengpitwi chu mohmahthah sah hih in,” ati.
en_web: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”
en_kjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ganhing li ho lah a kona hung ging tobanga kajah ogin khat chun, “Suhlou chang khai khat’in denarii khat amanin, sakolchang khai thumin denarii khat aman’e; hijongle thao le lengpitwi chu suboh hih-in,” ati.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana alina pachu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman Hinnanei lina pa chun asei, “Hungin” ati kajan ahi.
en_web: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
en_kjv: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
tcz_gospelgo: Mohor li na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing li lhin nan, “Hungin” ati kajai.

tcz: Keima kadadoh a ahileh keiman sakol eng-dang khat kamui. Achunga Toupa chu Thina akiti, chule akilhonpi chu Lhankhuh ahi. Anilhona hi leiset chunga hoplia hopkhat chunga thuneina kipea, chemjama, kel'a le natnaa chule gamsa hang khut'a thitheina uma ahi.
en_web: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
en_kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun vetemin, sakol engdang khat kamun, achunga toupa min chu “Thina” ahin, chule thikhol khul’in anung ahinjuipeh-e. Chemjam le gilkel, gamna hise chule leiset gamsaho mangchaa, leiset hop lia hop khat thatgam dinga thahat kipe ahiuve.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nganapa chu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman maicham mun noiya chun Pathen Thu jal'a kithatsa ho chule athu hettohsah nauva kithat a thiho lhagao chu kamun ahi.
en_web: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
en_kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
tcz_gospelgo: Mohor nga lhin na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in, maicham phung noiya chun Pathen thujeh le nettoh sahna jal’a kithatsa lhagao ho kamui.

tcz: Amaho chun Pakai koma asamun, “Vo hatchungnung Pakai, theng le kitah, itih chanpi hi nangman vannoi miten keiho chunga athisan sonau thisan phuba lah ding chu nakhongai nahlai ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en_web: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
en_kjv: and they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chun going tah-in asamun, “Vo pipu, Atheng le kitah, leiset chung chengte chunga keiho phulaa thutan louva itih chan um ding nahim?” atiuve.

tcz: Chutah in amaho khatcheh chu ponbang silding apecheh uvin ahi. Chule amaho chu chomkhat kicholdo be nalai dingu, asopitehou Yeshua a asoh chanpiteho chu martyr chang nalaidingho chun ahinjop masang seuva anga dinguva kiseipeh uva ahi.
en_web: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
en_kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho khat cheh chu poncho bangle apeuvin, asohchanpi chengseu le adopiteu, upaho kitha banga kithat ding ho akimsoh kahsea chom khat kho-ngai dingin akiseipeh tauve.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana gupna chu alhap kavet'a ahileh chua chun ling nasatah akihot'in ahi. Hiti chun nisa chu ponvom tobang'in athimin, chule Lha jong chu thisan tobang'in asantai.
en_web: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
en_kjv: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
tcz_gospelgo: Mohor gupna chu alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ling nasatah kihot kamun, nichang khaodippon vom bangin avomtan lhachang pumpi jong thisan bangin asan jenge;

tcz: Chule vana Ahsi ho jong chu hui hattah in theichang ga adonglai chang'a amutlhah tobang'in leiset a apullha gamtai.
en_web: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
en_kjv: and the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
tcz_gospelgo: van’a ahsite chu huipi hattah-in theichang phung amut’a, apul lhah bangin tol’a apul lhatai.

tcz: Chule vanthamjol jong chu lekhajol tobang'in akijel in, chule mol ho le twikol umnaho jouse jong chu aumnau mun akichondoh tai.
en_web: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
en_kjv: And the heaven departed as a scrole when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule-van chu lekhajol kijel mang bangin amanghel tan, mol le lhang jose, twikol gam jouse pumin aumna mun cheh a koninakichon mangtauve.

tcz: Chutah in–Leiset Lengho, vaipo ho, lamkai pipuho, mihaoho, thaneiho, chule sohho le ongthol-chamlhat ho-abonchauvin songkoa chule molchunga songpi ho lah a chun akiselun ahi.
en_web: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
en_kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun leiset leng jouse le milen milalte, sepai lamkai pipu ho, mihao hole thahat ho, soh jouse le chamlhat ho geiyin songko dung le mol dunga songpiho khi kah dunga akiseltauve.

tcz: Chule amaho chun molchung le songpi ho chunga konchun ahinsamdoh un, “Kachunguva hunglhuvin chule Laltouna a toupa le Kelngoinou masanga lunghanna a konin neisel un.
en_web: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,
en_kjv: and said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin mol le lhang chule songpiho jah a, “Nei opkhum” un lang, laltouna Toupa maikoh le Kelngoinou lungsatnaa konin neisel mangun;

tcz: Ajeh chu alunghanna nikho tijat umtah chu hunglhunga ahitai, chule koiham chua kona hoidoh ding chu,” atiuve.
en_web: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”
en_kjv: for the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
tcz_gospelgo: ajeh chu alungham nau nikho nasatah ahung lhungtan, hichea pang jou dding koi ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman vantil li leiset kolning-li a adin'u kamun, amahon leiset chunga anunlouna dinguvin huinun-li chu atuhtangun ahi. Thingphung hoa thingna khat jong akiling pon, chule twikhanglen jong phatvet mai bangin ajolsel jenge.
en_web: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
en_kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nung hin leiset chung le Twikhanglen chunga chule thingphung khat cha chunga jong huianun louhelna dinga, leiset ning lia kon huipi tuh tang din, leiset ning lia Vantil li adin kamui.

tcz: Chule keiman vantil chomkhat Solama kona ahunga Pathen hing mohor achoi chu kamun ahi. Chule amachun hiche vantil-li, leiset chung le twikhanglen suhset theina thaneina kipeho jah a asamin,
en_web: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
en_kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Pathen hing jing mohor choiya, niso lama hung kaltou Vantil chom khat kamun, ama chun going tahin asamin, leiset le Twikhanglen suhsetna dinga thu kipe Vantil li ho jah a chun,

tcz: “Keihon Pathen Mohor chu Asohte ho chalpanga kanampeh masang seuvin leiset ahilouleh twikhanglen ahilouleh thing ho susehih un,” ahinti-e.
en_web: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
en_kjv: saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keihon i-Pathenu sohte chalpanga melchihna mohor kanamsoh kahseuvin leiset le Twikhanglen chule thingphung ho hi suse hih-un,” ati.

tcz: Chule keiman mi ijat chu Pathen Mohor kinam khum hiuvem–Israel nam sunga kona mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li ahiuve, ti kajan ahi.
en_web: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
en_kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin mohor kinamsa mijat kajah le, Israel phungtin’a kona mohor kinamsa chengse chu sang jakhat le sangsom li le sang li alhing’e.

tcz: Judah phunga kona mi sang som le ni, Reuben phunga kona sang som le sang ni, Gad phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en_web: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Judah phunga kona mohor kinamsa sangsom le sang ni, Reuben phunga kona sangsom le sangni, Gad phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,

tcz: Asher phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Naphtali phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Manasseh phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en_web: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Asher phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Naphtali phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Manasseh phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,

tcz: Simeon phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Levi phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Issachar phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en_web: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Isachar were sealed twelve thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Simeon phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Issachar phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,

tcz: Zebulun phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni ahiuve.
en_web: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
en_kjv: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
tcz_gospelgo: Zebulun phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona sang som le sang ni.

tcz: Hiche jou chun keiman mi atama tam, sima simjou ding hilou chitin namtina kon, phungtina kon, mitina kon chule paotin a kona Laltouna mai chule Kelngoinou anga adinu chu kamui. Amaho chun ponbang jeng akivonun, chule akhut uva lusu-bah akichoi cheh uvin ahi.
en_web: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
en_kjv: After this I beheld, and lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin mipi kihon lel lul jeng, simjou lou, chitin namtin le phung tin’a kon, mitin mitang le paotin paotanga kon, abang jenga kivon’a, akhut’uva lusu na kichoiya, laltouna masanga, kelngoinou angsunga ding kamui.

tcz: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun asamuvin, “Huhhingna chu Laltouna a toupa IPathen uva kon le Kelngoinouva kon ahi,” atiuve.
en_web: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
en_kjv: and cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ogingtah-in asam’un: “Hunhingna chu laltouna Toupa, I-Pathenu le Kelngoinouva ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Chule vantil ho jouse chu Laltouna kimvela, chule upa ho kimvela, chule Hinnanei-li ho kimvela chun adinguvin ahi. Chule amaho Laltouna angsunga chun alhu uvin amaiyu tol'a asulut un chule Pathen chu ahouvun ahi.
en_web: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
en_kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna le upaho chule ganhing li ho kimvel’a ding jing Vantil jouse, laltouna masanga chun amaiyu tol’a asulut’uvin Pathen alhaiyun,

tcz: Amahon avahchoiyun, “Amen! Phattheina le loupina le chihna le thangvahna le jabolna le thaneina chule thahatna chu IPathen uva a-i-matih chanin hijinghen, Amen” tin asamuve.
en_web: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
en_kjv: saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: asei cheh-un: “Amen, phattheina le loupina, Chihna, thangvahna jousea, jabolna Thuhatna thu neina jouse tonsot tonsot geiya I-Pathen’uva ahijinge, Amen,” atiiuve.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil ho lah a khat chun kajah a, “Hiche abang jenga kivon ho hi koiho hiuvem? Hoiya hungkon hiuva ham?” eiti.
en_web: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”
en_kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin upa ho lah a khat’in eihin houvin kajah a, “Hiche ponabng jenga kivon ho hi koi hiuva, hoiya hungkon hiuvam?” tin eidonge.

tcz: Chuin keiman ajah a, “Pu nangman nahenai” tin kaseiye. Chuphat in aman kajah a, “Amaho hi Thohhahsa phat sunga thiho ahiuve. Amaho hin aponsil'u chu kelngoinou thisana akisop ngimuva chule bangleh ah ahitai.”
en_web: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
en_kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Kenjong ajah a, “KaPakai nangin nahenai,” kati. Chuin aman kajah a, “Hite ho hi bolgen thei hesoh hahsa hinthoh doh a Kelngoinou thisan’a avon jouseu kisop bang ho vhu ahiuve.

tcz: “Hijeh a chu amaho hi Pathen Laltouna masanga dinguva olmo louva sun le jana Houin sunga chu kicholdo manlouva Pathen ajenu ahi. Chule Laltouna a toupa chun amaho aumna diu apeh ding ahi.”
en_web: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
en_kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh a chu Pathen laltouna masanga um’iva, asun ajan’a a-Houin sunga lhacha kin abol’u ahi; chule laltouna Toupa khun amaho hi ponbuh kison khum banga alekhu diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho gilkel kit talou dingu chule dangchah kit talouhel dingu ahi; nisasat in jong amaho akahkhah tahlou hel dingu ahi.
en_web: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
en_kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon gilkel dangchah athoh kit louhel diu, nisan jong san gtalou diu, asa jong thoh lou iddng ahiuve.

tcz: Ajeh chu Laltouna a toupa chu amaho kelngoi chin'a aching dingpa hiding ahi. Aman amaho chu Hintwi lonna muna apuilut ding chule Pathen in amit uva kona amitlhiu atheh hulpeh dingu ahi.
en_web: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
en_kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile laltouna lailunga um Kelngoinou khu achinguva pang, hintwi nah dunga apuihoi le ding, Pathenin amit lhi jouseu atheh hulsoh ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana sagi lhinna lekha jol chu alhap a ahileh van mun pumpia nidan keh khat tobang chu athip chettai.
en_web: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
en_kjv: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
tcz_gospelgo: Kelngoinouvin mohor sagi na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in van chunga nidan keh khat set athip chet’e.

tcz: Chuin Pathen masanga ding jing vantil sagi ho chu kamun chule amaho chu sumkon sagi akipen ahi.
en_web: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
en_kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Pathen masanga ding jing Vantil sagi chu kamun, amaho chu summon sagi apeuve.

tcz: Chutah chun vantil chomkhat gimnamtwi halna sanabom kichoiyah ahungin, chuin maicham muna chun adingin ahi. Chule gimnamtwi tamtah chu Pathen mite taona chuto haltha a sana maicham muna laltouna maiya sunlhah dingin ama chu akipen ahi.
en_web: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
en_kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin gimnamtui halna sana lhengkong khat choiya, Vantil chom khat ahungin maicham phunga chun adinge. Ama chu, mithengte taona belap peh dinga laltouna mai, maicham phunga chu todoh dingin, gimnamtui tampi apeuve.

tcz: Gimnamtwi kihalna meikhu chu Pathen mithengte taona chuto maichama vantil chun asunlhahna muna konin Pathen koma akaltouvin, alhungtai.
en_web: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
en_kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil khut’a konin gimnamtui khu chu mithengte taona kilhonin Pathen angsunga akikhotoutai.

tcz: Chutah in vantil chun gimnamtwi kihalna boma chun maichama mei chu akoilut'in chuin leiset chunga aseplhai; chutah chun aw tampi ahung gingin, van aginglul lulin, kol aphejap jap'in chule lingpi tijat umtah chu akihot'in ahi.
en_web: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.
en_kjv: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Vantil’in gimnamtui halna lhengkong chu alan, maicham phunga mei-al chu aham dimin, leiset chunga athe lhah le, van aginglul lul jengin, ogin akithongin, kol aphen, ling akihottai.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil sagi chun asumkon cheh u chu gingtah a mutcheh dingin akigo tauve.
en_web: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
en_kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
tcz_gospelgo: Sumkon sagi choi Vantil sagi ho chu sumkon mut din akigotauve.

tcz: Vantil akhatna chun asumkon amut in ahileh gelchang le meikou thisanto kihal chu leiset chunga ahung kisep lhatai. Leiset hop-thum'a hop-khat meiyin akatai, thingho hop-thum'a hop-khat akalhan, chule hamhing jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akavamtai.
en_web: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
en_kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil masapenin sumkon amut le, thisan to kihal, gel le meikou ahung umdoh-in, leiset chunga alhai; hichun leiset chung hop thum’a hop khat akavamin, thingphung ho jong hop thum’a hop khat akavamin, chule hampa louhing jouse akavamsoh tai.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil nina in asumkon amut'in ahileh, meikou moul lentah tobang chu twikhanglen'a akilehlut tai. Hiti chun twikhanglen'a twi chu hop-thum'a hop-khat thisan akisohtai.
en_web: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
en_kjv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil ni nan sumkon amut le, meikou alleng lung, molsang lentah tobang khat Twikhanglen lailunga akileh lut jengin, Twikhanglen hop thum’a hop khat thisan asoh-in,

tcz: Hiti chun twikhanglen'a hinna nei jouse hop-thum'a hop-khat athigam tai, chule twikhanglen'a konglen jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akisuse gamtai.
en_web: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
en_kjv: and the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen lailunga ganhing hop thum’a hop khat athin, kong ho jong hop thum’a hopkhat asumang tai.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil thumna chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh ahsi lentah khat vana konin ahung lenglhan, kolphemeivah tobang'in asal jenge. Hichu vadung ho chunga le twinah ho hop-thum'a hop-khat chunga achun ahi.
en_web: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.
en_kjv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil thum nan sumkon amut le, kolphe meivah banga vah leng lung ahsi lentah khat van’a konin ahung lhan, luidung ho hop thum’a hop khat chung le teinah ho chunga achui.

tcz: Ahsi min chu akha akiti. Hichun twi hopthum a hop-khat akhatsah in, chule twi akhat jeh chun adon ho atama tam athitauve.
en_web: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
en_kjv: and the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ahsi chu amin Gamsai akisah-e. Chuin twihop thum;a hop khat Gamsai bangin akhatan, hijeh chun mihem tamtah hiche twikhat jeh chun athitai.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil-lina chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh Nisa chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, Lha chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, chule Ahsi ho jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chengse chu abonun athimtai. Chule nikho jong chu hop-thum'a hop-khat athimtan ahi. Chule jan jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chu athimtai.
en_web: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
en_kjv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil li nan sumkon amut le, nisa hop thum’a hop khat, lha hop thum’a hop khat, ahsi ho hop thum’a hop khat akivosen, abonchauva hop thum’a khat athimtan, sunlai jong hop thum’a hopkhat athimtan, janlai jeng jong hop thum’a hop khat athimtai.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman kaven, chule mulaopi khat huilah a alengle chun alenpumin gingleng lungin ahinsamin: “Vantil thum achaina hon asumkonu ahinmut tenguleh hiche vannoiya chengho dingin tijat aume, tijat aume, tijat aume,” ati.
en_web: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
en_kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kavet le vanlaijol’a leng le lea Muvanlai khat kamun, hichun going tah-in asamin, “Hiche Vantil thum sumkon mut dia kigo ho khun amut tengu le leiset chung chengte dinga, Ohe da na ahi, da na ahi, da na ahi!” ati.

tcz: Chujouchun vantil a-nga na chun asumkon amut in ahileh vana kona Ahsi khat leiset'a ahung lenlhah kamun, chule ama chun amongbei onghom kot-heh chu achoiyin ahi.
en_web: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
en_kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Vantil nga na sumkon amut le, van’a kona ahsi khat leiset chunga hung lha kamun, hi che chu akhonbei thamko kot heh apeuve.

tcz: Aman hichu ahon a ahileh meilhum nasatah a kona hungpot tobang meikhu ahungdoh in, chule nisavah le hui chu meikhua konin avomsoh jengin ahi.
en_web: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
en_kjv: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman akhonbei thamko chu ahondoh le, tham ko sunga konin lhumpi kideng khu bangin meikhu ahung kitungdoh leng lung jengin, nisa le vanlaijol atimtai.

tcz: Chujouvin meikhua pat in khaokhoho ahung potdoh uvin, chule leiset a ahungkum lhauvin chule amaho chu aipi mide natna thaneina kipeuva ahi.
en_web: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
en_kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin meikhu lah a kon chun khaokhopi tamtah leiset chung ahung dimtan, hiche ho chu leiset chunga aipi tha neina tobang apeuve.

tcz: Amaho chun hampa ahilouleh anchephung ahilouleh thingphung ho asuhsetlou dingu, amavang mihemho Pathen mohor achalpanguva kinam ding nomlou ho asuh genthei dingu ahi.
en_web: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
en_kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi leiset chunga hampa louhing le anche dong chule thingphung khat cha jong asuhset lou didu, achalpanguva pathen mohor kinamkhum lou mihem ho chubou asuhset diuva kiseipeh ahiuve.

tcz: Amaho chun athalou dingu ahivangin lha-nga jen asuhgim dingu, aipin amidena natna a chu amaho adenat uva agimbol dingu ahiye.
en_web: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
en_kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi hitobang thu neina kipeuva ahi. Chule hiche ho mihem bolgentheina chu aipin mi ade teng anat tobanga na ding ahi.

tcz: Chuchelai le chun mihon thina ahol dingu ahiala amujou lou dingu ahi. Amahon thina angaichat lheh dingu ahiala thina chu amahoa kona jammang ding ahitai!
en_web: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
en_kjv: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche nikho lai le hin hiche mihem ho hin thina ahol tho diu, ahivanga amu louhel diu ahi; thi nom ten ten un tin, ahivanga thina chu akom’uva kona jamdoh didng ahi.

tcz: Khaokhoho chu sakolho galsatna muna dinga kigo tobang ahiuve. Amaho chun aluchunguva Sana-lallukhuh tobang aneiyun, chule amaiyu chu mihem maitobang ahi.
en_web: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
en_kjv: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche khaokhopite limso dol chu galsat dinga kigotohsa, sakolte tobang ahin, aluchunguva sana lallukhuh tobang jeng akhuh-un, amaichangu mihem mai tobang

tcz: Amaho chun alu uvah numei samtobang apu'uvin chule ahau chu keipi-bahkai ha tobang ahi.
en_web: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
en_kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
tcz_gospelgo: Asam’u numei sam tobnag ahin, ahau chu Phaisameigeo ha tobang ahi.

tcz: Amahon galvon akivonu chu thih a kisem ahi chule alhavingu hugin chu sakol kangtalai chunga touva galsatna mun del galmi tobang ahiuve.
en_web: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.
en_kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hin thil a kisem ompho tobang cheh ompho aneiyun, alhaving gin’u galmun jon’a lhai sakol tamtah khotogin tobang ahi.

tcz: Amahon mei aneiyu chun aipi midena tobang gu aneiyun, chule lha-nga jen miho chu suhgim theina thaneina aneiyuve.
en_web: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
en_kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
tcz_gospelgo: Aipi bangin mei aneiyun, eipi bangin jang aneiyui: ameiyuva chu lha nga geiya mihem suhsetna thei tha aneiyu ahi.

tcz: Alengpau chu amongbei lei-onga hungkondoh vantil chu ahi; amin chu Hebrew paovin Abaddon akitin, chule Greek paovin Apollyon akitin–Asumang pa tina ahi.
en_web: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
en_kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hin akhonbei thamkoa Vantil chu lengvaipon aneiyun, Hebrew paovin misumang tin an, apollyon ahi.

tcz: Kichat tijat umtah akhatna chu kichaiya ahitai, hinla ven, kichat tijat umtah ni hung be ding ahi!
en_web: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
en_kjv: One woe is past; and behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
tcz_gospelgo: Da na masa akichaitan, ven, hicheng nunga hi da na ni hung nalai dingahiye.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil agupna chun asumkon amut in ahileh, keiman Pathen angsunga kikoi sana maicham ki-li umna muna konin aw khat ahung gin doh kajan ahi.
en_web: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
en_kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil gup nan sumkon amut le, Pathen angsung, sana maicham nin glia selki chengsea konin ogin khat kajan,

tcz: Chule aw chun sumkon kichoi vantil agupna jah a, “Euphrates Vadung Lentah a kihen vantil-li ho chu lhadoh in,” ati.
en_web: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
en_kjv: saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil gup lhinaa, sumkon choipa jah achun, “Luipi lentah Euphrates dunga kihen Vantil li ho chu lhadoh tan,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil-li ho, hiche phat a chule anikho le alha chule akum sungsea dinga leiset chunga miho hop-thum'a hop-khat that dinga kigongsaho, chu alhadoh tauve.
en_web: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
en_kjv: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun mihem hop thum’a hop kkhat that dinga chuche nidan le nikho, lha le kum’a dia gotsadem’a um Vantil li chu akilhadohtai,

tcz: Keiman sepaihon amijat'u chu kajan, hichu sakol chunga tou niel-jani alhinguve.
en_web: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
en_kjv: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
tcz_gospelgo: chule sakol galmi jat eikiseipeh chu sang ja ni jatni dol’in kajai.

tcz: Chule kamitlha a chun keiman sakol ho le achunguva touho kamun ahi. Achunga touho chun galvon aki-ah uchu asanthip le adumvom chule a-eng ahije. Sakol ho chu aluchangu keipi-bahkai tobang, chule akamuva kona mei le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang ahung potdoh e.
en_web: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
en_kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
tcz_gospelgo: Sakolte le achunga touho luchang tobang, akamsunguva konin meikou le meikhu chule kath jeng ahung kikhodoh doh jenge.

tcz: Hiche gamna hise thum-ho: meikong le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang hiche sakol ho kam'a konin ahung potdoh'in ahileh leiset chunga miho chu athattan ahi.
en_web: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
en_kjv: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
tcz_gospelgo: Meikou le meikhu, kath, gama hicheng thum akamsunguva hungkondoh chun mihem hop thum’a hop khat athat gamtai.

tcz: Amaho thaneina chu akam uva le amei uva uma ahi. Ijeh inem itileh ameiyuva chu gulluchang tobanga boh a, hichun miho asuhnat theina tha apeh ahi.
en_web: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
en_kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile sakolte chu athahat nau akamsungu le ameiyuva um ahin, ameiyu chun gul bangin luchang aneiyin, hiche hoa chu mi abolgim’u ahi.

tcz: Hinlah hiche gamna hisea thilouho chu athilse bolnauva konin alungu aheideh pouvin chule Pathen lam asang dehpouve. Amahon thilhaho le sana a, dangkaa, hah a, songa chule thinga milim kisemho–milim semthu kho mutheilou, kho jatheilou, chatloh theilou ho chu ahoujom jinguvin ahi.
en_web: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.
en_kjv: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
tcz_gospelgo: Gamna hichenga kithat lou, mihem amoh chengsen jong akhutsem athilsem’uva konin lung aheideh pouvin, kho muthei lou, kho jathei lou, vah le thei lou, sanaa kisem doilim ho le dangkaa kisem, sum-eng, thing, song pouva kisem doilim ho, chule thilha ho ahouvu jong atangdeh pouve.

tcz: Chule amahon amithanauva konin, ahilouleh thilha ahounauva konin, ahilouleh thenlouna hoa konin chuleh aguhchatnauva konin lung aheideh pouvin ahi.
en_web: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
en_kjv: neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
tcz_gospelgo: tol athau, mitpheldoi achoi nau, jonthanhoi abolnau chule aguh chat nauva lung aheidoh pouve.

tcz: Chutah in vantil hattah achom dang khat meibolin akimvelin, aluchunga lhagui um chu vana konin ahung kumlhan ahi. Amai chu nisa bangin avah in chule akengphangteni chu meikhompi ho to abang jenge.
en_web: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
en_kjv: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chom, tha neitah khat, meilom’a kivon’a van’a kona hung kumlha kamun, aluchanga lhagui akiveiyin, amaichang nichang tobang ahin, akeng te ni chu meikou lom kitungdoh tobang ahi;

tcz: Chule akhut a chun lekhajol neokhat akiphongkeosa aumin ahi. Ama chu akeng jetlam chu twikhanglen sunga adingin chule akeng veilam chu tolgo lai'ah apansan ahi.
en_web: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
en_kjv: and he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
tcz_gospelgo: akhut’a lekhajol neocha phoh kehsa khat achoiye. Akeng jetlamin Twikhanglen achotphan, veilamin leiset chung achon’e.

tcz: Chule ama chu keipi bahkai kitum'ah bangin agin kithongleuvin thu aseiye. Chuin ama chun kho ahinsap phat in, van gin sagi chun ahin donbut e.
en_web: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
en_kjv: and cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule Phaisameigeo kitum bangin ogin tah-in kho asamin, hitia kho asap chun van-gin sagi ahung gingtai.

tcz: Chuin van gin sagi chun thu aseiyin, keiman kajihgotan ahi. Hinla keiman vana konin aw khat kajan hitin aseiye, “Vang in sagi in athusei chu sel'in, jihdoh hihbeh in,” ati.
en_web: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”
en_kjv: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
tcz_gospelgo: Vangin sagin thu asei chun keijong lekhaa sutdoh kagoi; “Van-gin sagi thusei chu melchih thon lang lekha sutdan,” eiti.

tcz: Chupet a vantil twikhanglen chunga le tolgo laiya adin kamu chun akhut jetlam vanlam'ah adomsangin ahi.
en_web: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky
en_kjv: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Twikhanglen le leiset chung chontoa ding Vantil kamu chun akhut jetlamin van lam asangin,

tcz: Ama tonsot tonsot'a hing jing van le asunga umjouse, leiset le asunga umjouse, twikhanglen le asunga umjouse sempa mina chun akihahselin, ahi. Ama chun aseiyin “Khongaisot be talou ding ahitai.
en_web: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
en_kjv: and sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
tcz_gospelgo: van le asunga um jouse, leiset le asunga um jouse, Twikhanglen le asunga um jouse Sempa, tonsot tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pa min panin akihahsel’in, “Phat sotta lou ding ahi;

tcz: Vantil sagina chun asumkon ahin mut tengleh Pathen in kidang tah a athilgon chu guilhung ding ahi. Asohte themgao hon aphondoh banga chu hung guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
en_web: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.
en_kjv: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil sagi lhinna ogin phat, sumkon amut teng le, aman asohte Themgao ho henga aphondoh banga Pathen thilgon kiselguh chu hung guilhung ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in van'a kona aw chun eikihoupi kit in, “Gachen, lekhajol kihongsa chu twikhanglen chung le tolgo laiya ding vantil khut a konin galan,” eiti.
en_web: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
en_kjv: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin van’a kona ogin kaijah chun kahenga thu ahinsei kit leuvin, “Chen lang Twikhanglen le leiset chun chontoa ding Vantil khut’a phoh kehsa um lekhajol khu galan,” eiti.

tcz: Hiti chun keima vantil koma chun kagachen chule amajah a chun lekhajol chu neipen tin kagaseitai. Aman, “Henge, kilah in lang, nen. Nakama dinga khoiju lhuma lhum ding, hinla na-oisung dinga thuhcheh chuh jeng ding ahi,” eiti.
en_web: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
en_kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Vantil henga chun kachen lekhajol neo chu eipeh din kaseiye. Aman kajah a, “Kilah-in lang nen, na-oisunga thuh-in tin, nakamsunga vang khoiju lhum banga lhum ding ahi,” eiti.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman lekhajol neocha chu vantil khut a kon chun kalan chuin kanetai! Hichu kakam'ah alhumin, hinla kaval phat in, kaoisunga chun athuhdohtai.
en_web: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
en_kjv: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
tcz_gospelgo: Ken jong Vantil khut’a kon chun lekha jol chu kalan kaneh jeng le, kakamsunga khoiju lhumin alhumin, ahila kaneh jou chun ka-oisunga athuh cheh chuh jenge.

tcz: Chuphat in keima eikiseipeh in, “Nangman mitampi ding, namtin dinga, paotin le lengho dinga gaova thu nasei tei ding ahije,” eiti.
en_web: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kajah a, “Nangman mitin mitang, chitin namtin, paotin paotang chule leng ho thudol’a gaothu naseikit ding ahi,” eikiti.

tcz: Chupet in keima tetohna mol eikipei, chule keima eikiseipeh in, “Chenlang Pathen Hou-in le maicham gatenlang chule Pathen houho jat simdoh in.
en_web: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.
en_kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun tenggol lheh lheh thil ten a mol-lhon khat eikipen, :Kipatdoh-in lang Pathen Houin le maicham khu tedoh-in, khukoma Pathen houho chengse jong simtoh-in.

tcz: Hinlah apolam vang tehih in, ijeh inem itileh hichu chidang namdang ho kipea ahitai. Amaho chun khopi theng chu lha-somli le ni atoupha dingu ahi.
en_web: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
en_kjv: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
tcz_gospelgo: Amavang Houin polam leitol khu khenni lang tedoh dan, ajeh chu iche lai khu chiding namdangte kipedoh ahitan, amahon khopi theng chu lha som li le lha ni sunga kengto chotpha anei diu ahi.

tcz: Chule athu hettohsah teni chu thaneina kapeh ding, chule amani chu khaodip pon'a kivon lhon'a chule ni sang khat ni jani le ni somni le gup; sunga gaothu aseilhon ding ahi.”
en_web: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
en_kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule kathu hettohsah te ni chu thu neina kapeh a, ama nin khaodip pon kisil’a, nikho sang khat l eja ni to somgup sunga gaothu asi lhon ding ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hiche themgao teni hi Olive thing teni chu ahin, vannoi pumpi Pakai masanga dinga thaomeikhom teni chu ahi.
en_web: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.
en_kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche te ni chu leiset Pakai ang’a ding jing Olive thingphung te ni le Thaomei khom te ni chu ahi lhon’e.

tcz: Koihileh amani alamlouva bol auma ahileh, akamlhon'a kona meikong lengdoh a chule amelmateu chu akahvam ding ahi. Hitia hi koi hijongleh amani alamlouva bol ho chu thi diu ahi.
en_web: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
en_kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche te ni hi khattouvin bolset ding agot jousea akamsunglhon’a meikou hung deujah jia, amelmate chu akahvam jengji ahi; amani bolset go jouse chu hitobanga hi kithat tei ding ahijenge.

tcz: Amanin van gotwi jong ajuhlouna dinga khamtang jeng thei thaneina, gaothusei theina anei lhon ahi. Chule amani hin vadung hole twipi ho chunga thisan sosah theina thuneina aneilhonin, chule leiset jeng jong hi gamna hise alhunsahnom nomna lhona alhunsahthei lhon ahi.
en_web: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
en_kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
tcz_gospelgo: Amani hi gaothu asei lai sungse lhon’a go juh louna dinga vanlaijol geiya khah chah jeng thei tha nei ahi lhon’e. Chu jongle amani hin twiho geiya thisan sosah theina tha anei lhon’e, chule adei phat phat lhon’a leiset’a jong gamna hise alansah nom nom lansah theina tha anei lhon ahi.

tcz: Amanin ahettohsah lhon natoh achai lhon tengleh, amongbei lei-onga kona hungdoh sahem chun amani dounaa gal ahinbol ding, chule amani chu ahinjo ding chule atha ding ahi.
en_web: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.
en_kjv: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hite ni hin hettohsah abolchai lhon teng l eakhonbei thamkoa hung potdoh sahem chun achung lhon’a gal abol’a, ajoa ani lhon’a atha ding ahi.

tcz: Chule atahsa lhon chu Jerusalem khopi lamlhongpia kijamden ding, hiche khopi chu avetsahna a “Sodom” le “Egypt” kisah a ahin, a Pakaiyu thingpel'a akhetbehnau khopi chu hiya ahi.
en_web: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
en_kjv: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
tcz_gospelgo: tekah a Sodom le Egypt kisah khopi lentah, a-Pakaiyu Thingpel’a kikhetbeh na khopi sung lamlen a chu along lhon kijam ding ahi.

tcz: Chule ni thumle akeh sunga chu mi jouse, phung jouse, pao jouse chule namtin jouse chun atahsau chu avetvet dingu ahi. Koiman athilong lhon chu vui ding aphatsahlou diu ahi.
en_web: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
en_kjv: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and a half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
tcz_gospelgo: Mitin mitang, phungtin, paotin tang le chitin namtin’a kon miten nithum le akeh geiya along lhon chu avet ve jeng diu ahi; along lhon chu lhan a vui ding nom lou diu ahiye.

tcz: Mijouse hiche vannoiya hiho chun vetnom'a avetvet jeng diu chule amaho bol hesoh'a pang, hettohsah teni ahilhon jeh'a kipana jal-a thilpeh kithotto diu ahi.
en_web: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
en_kjv: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chung chengte jouse amani chunga kipah thanomuva, khat le khat deichom thil kithot to ding ahiuve; ijeh-inem itile hiche Themgao te ni hin leiset chung chengte abolgim lheh jeng lhon’e.

tcz: Hinlah ni thumle akeh jou tengleh Pathen in hinna hu alhakhumpeh lhona, chule amani hung dingdoh lhon ding ahi! Amani vejouse kichatna dim diu ahi.
en_web: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.
en_kjv: And after three days and a half the spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla nithum le akeh nungin Pathen’a konin hinna hu ahungin asung lhon’a alut phat’in, amani mupha chan akicha lheh jenguve.

tcz: Chutengleh vana kona aw gingtah khat chun themgao teni chu, “Hikoma hin hungtou lhonin!” tia ahin kouding, chule amani chu vanlama meilhang khat'a amelmateuvin avetvetpet lhona kaltoulhon ding ahi.
en_web: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
en_kjv: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun, “Hikoma hung kaltou lhonin,” tia ajah lhon’a thu sei van’a kon ogin nasatah khat aja lhonin, amelmateuvin avet vet pet tah-in van jonin meilom khat’in akitoltou lhontai.

tcz: Apettah chun gimneitah in ling ahung kihot in ahileh, khopi chu hop som a hop khat suhbeiyin aumtai. Hiche ling kihoa chun mi sang sagi athitai, chule amitin chu akichauvin, atijauvin chule van Pathen chu loupina apeuvin ahi.
en_web: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
en_kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche pettah hin ling nasa tah akihot’in, khopi hop som’a hop khat achimtan, ling kihot chunmihem sang sagi athin, athimoh cheng atijat lot’uvin Pathen avahchoilo tauve.

tcz: Kichat tijat umtah nina chu kichaiya ahitai, hinlah ven kichat tijat umtah athum na hunglhung pai jeng thei ahitai.
en_web: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.
en_kjv: The second woe is past; and behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamna ni na akicahitan, ven, gamna thumna chu hung lhung vahjet ding ahi.

tcz: Chujou vin vantil asagi na pan asumkon amut'in ahileh, vana konchun aw tampi hung kithongdoh'a kisam akijan: “Vannoi hi tun I-Pakaiyu le A-Christa Lenggam ahung hitai, chule Aman atonsot atonsot a vai ahomding ahi,” ati.
en_web: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
en_kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil sagi nan sumkon amut le van’a konin ogin nasatah tah tampin ahinjomin: “Vannoi leiset chunga lengvaipohna chu I-Pakaiyule a-Christa chang ahitan, Aman tonsot tonsot’a lengvai apoh ding ahi,” atiuve.

tcz: Upa somni le liho chu alaltounauva konin Pathen anga amaiyu tol'a asulut'un abohkhup un, chule Pathen chu ahou tauve.
en_web: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
en_kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Pathen angsung, laltouna tou, upa som ni le li ho chu bohkhup’in tol’a mai asulut’un Pathen alhaiyun,

tcz: Chuin amaho chun, “Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, a uma chule ana umjingsa Nangma kathangvah uve, ijeh ham itileh tun nangman nathaneina loupi chu nakilah tan, chule vainahom pantai.
en_web: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.
en_kjv: saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
tcz_gospelgo: aseiyuvin: “Vo Pakai Pathen Hachungnung, Aum jingsa le aum jing jeng, Keihon nangma kathangvah-ui; Ajeh chu nangin nathahat chungnung mangchan lengvai napotai.

tcz: Chidang namdang ho alung hanglheh tauvin, hinlah tun, nalunghanna phat chu hunglhunga ahitai. Tuhi athisaho thutan phat ahi; chule na themgao ho hihen, namithengte chule nangma min ging jouse, aneopen a pat alenpen geiya tohphatman peh phat ahi. Leiset chunga mahthahna hinlhut ho jouse suhmangna phat hunglhunga ahitai,” atiuve.
en_web: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
en_kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ipijeh-inem itile namtin vaipi along hangun, Hichun nangma lunghan ahung lhung paiye; Mithi ho thutanpeh phat, Nasoh Themgao ho, naming gangkhen cha um namithengte, Alen hihen aneo hijongle kipaman peh phat, Leiset sumang ho suhmang phat ahungtai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chutah in van munah, Pathen Hou-in kot akihong in chule Hou-in sunga Kitepna Thingkong chu akimuphan ahi. Kawl ahungphen, van agingin, chuin vanthamjol pumpi akitol in, chule lingpi ahung kihot in, gel nasatah jong ahunglhan ahi.
en_web: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
en_kjv: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun van’a Pathen Houin akihongin,, chule a-Houin sunga um kitepna thingkong chu akimui; chuin kolaphen, ogin akithongin, van aging lul lul’in, ling akihot’in, gel len nasatah alhai.

tcz: Chupet chun keiman vana thil kidangtah khat kaveven ahileh numei khat Nisa a kijem, akengto noiya Lhathah um kamun, chule alua lallukhuh a chun Ahsi som le ni aumin ahi.
en_web: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
en_kjv: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
tcz_gospelgo: Van’a melchihna lentah kha ahung kilah-in, nisaa kijem, akengto te nia lhachang um, aluchunga ahsi som le ni lallukhuh a kikhuh numei khat ahi.

tcz: Amanu hi naovop ahin, chule naosonat athoh jeh in apengin, naosonatna chu athohgim lheh jengtai.
en_web: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
en_kjv: and she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche nu hi agaiyin, naoso nat thohgimin hapenin apenge.

tcz: Chupet in van kavet'a ahileh thil kidang achom khat kamudoh kit in ahi. Keiman dragon lentah asan khat chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule ki som aneiyin, chule aluchanga chun lallukhuh sagi akikhuh in ahi.
en_web: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
en_kjv: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
tcz_gospelgo: Van’a melchihna achom khat jong ahung kilah-in, vetan, Dragon san, lentah, ameiyin vanlaijol’a ahsite hop thum’a hop khat ajep’in, leiset chunga asep lhai.

tcz: Amei chun vana Ahsi hop thum'a hop khat aloilhan, chuin leiset chunga ahinleh lhatai. Ama hin numei nu nao nei ding chu angah in, ahung penlhah lhah le anao chu vallhum dinga kigong ahi.
en_web: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
en_kjv: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule nao aso lhah lhah le val lhum jeng din Dragon chu numei nu masanga ading jinge.

tcz: Amanu hin chapa khat ahingin, ama chun chitin namtin chunga thihtengol-a vai ahinhom ding ahi. Chuin acha chu dragona konin akipomangin chule Pathen henga lahtouvin aum in chule alaltounaa aumtai.
en_web: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.
en_kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin amanun naosen pasal khat ahingin, naosen hin namtin vaipi chung thih tenggol choiya vai apoh ding ahi. Hichun naosen chu akisalhah peh-in Pathen heng, alaltounana maiya akilhoh toutai.

tcz: Chuin numeinu chu Pathen in agonpehsa ni sang khat le ni jani le ni som gup sung chun, ama vetup din gamthip lam'a ajamdoh in ahi.
en_web: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
en_kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in numei nu chu gamthip lama ajam mangin, hikoma chu nikho sang khat le ja ni to somgup geiya akivahna ding mun Pathenin agonpehsa ahi.

tcz: Chuphat in Van mun'a gal ahung umtai. Michael le avantil ten dragon le ama vantilte chu asattauvin ahi.
en_web: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
en_kjv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Van’a gal asoh-in, Michael le a-Vantilte chu Dragon to akisat tauve. Dragon le a-Vantilten jong asat thuh-uvin,

tcz: Chuin dragon chun gal chu aleltan, hiti chun ama le avantilte chu vana konin nodoh ahitauve.
en_web: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
en_kjv: and prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: aivangin Dragon ahatjou tapon, akhon nan van’a amaho ding mun akiholmotai.

tcz: Hiche dragon lentah chu—masanglai peh'a gul kiti Diabol ahilouleh Satan, vannoi pumpi lhemlhapa ahin, ama chu avantilte jouse toh leiset a ahin kinolhatai.
en_web: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
en_kjv: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun Dragon len, khangluipeh a gulpi, Diabol le Satan kiti, vannoi pumpi lhemlhapa chu leiset chunga akisonlhan, a-Vantilte jong ama pumin akisot lhah thai.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman aw gingleng lung khat vanthamjol-a akisap kajai. “Achainakeiyin-sochatna le thahatna chule IPathen'u Lenggam chule a-Christa thuneina chu hunga ahitai. Ijeh ham itileh isopiteu hehsepa, IPathen masanga sun le jana hehsepa, chu leiset'a akison lhatai.
en_web: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.
en_kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin van’a konin ogin nasatah khat kajan, hichun aseiyin: “Akhon nan i-Pathenu huhhingna le tha neina, Lenggam, chule a-Christa thu neina akiphongtai; Ijeh-inem itile isopiteu hehsepa, I-Pathenu angsunga sun le jan’a amaho hehsepa chu akisonlhatai.

tcz: Chule amahon ama hi Kelngoinou thisan le athu hettohsah jal-a ajo ahi. Chule amahon ahinkhou angailupouvin, thigeija kiphaldoh a ahitauve.
en_web: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
en_kjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
tcz_gospelgo: Amahon ama chu Kelngoinou thisan jal le Ahettohsah nau thu vanga ajou ahitai; Ajeh chu amaho hinkho geiya Itcha louhel’a thi geiya pang lhumkei ahiuve.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Vo vanho kipah uvin! Chule vana cheng ho, kipah uvin! Hinlah leiset chunga le twikhanglen'a kichat tijat hunglhung ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh diabol chun phat chomcha bou anei ahi chu akihetjeh'a, lunghanna sangpen a leiset'a hung kumlha ahitai.”
en_web: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”
en_kjv: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichejeh hin vanmun jouse le asunga cheng jouse kipah-un, Ohe, leiset le Twikhanglen ada nahiuve, Ajeh hcu lungsat chungnung neiya phat chomcha anei hea Lunghang tah a Diabol nahenguva hung kumsuh ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Dragon chun leiset chunga nolhah'a aum chu akihet phat in, aman chapa hingnu numeinu chu anungdelpeh in ahi.
en_web: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.
en_kjv: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset chunga akisot lhah amu phat’in Dragon chun naosen pasal khat hing’a numei chu anung adel le jenge.

tcz: Hinlah amanu chu mulaopi lentah lhaving tobang lhaving ni, gamthip'a chu ama dinga gotsa mun'a chu agalenlutna ding kigonpeh ahi. Chua chu amanu hi kivetup a chule dragon a kona chu ahoidoh nading phatkhat, phat ho chule phatkeh khat chu kihongbit ding ahi.
en_web: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
en_kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuphat’in numei nu chu gulpi masanga akikhindal’a, kumthum le akeh geiya akivahna ding mun gamthip lama alen mang theina din Muvanlai lentah khat lhaving te ni apeuvin ahi.

tcz: Chuphat in dragon chun numeinu chu twisoh lhohsah'a aumna dingin akama kon chun twisoh ahinsosah in ahi.
en_web: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
en_kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin gulpin akamsunga twi vadung long bangin alondoh dah-in, numei nu nung adelsah-in, lhoh mangsah din agoi.

tcz: Hinlah leiset in amanu chu akithopin akam akan chule dragon kam'a kon hunglongdoh vadung twisoh chu avallhumin ahi.
