en_web: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.
en_kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahivangin leiset’in numei chuakithopin, hiti hin leiset’in kam akan, Dragonin akamsunga alondohsah twi chu achopkang hel’e.

tcz: Chuin dragon chu numeinu chunga chule numeinu sonle chilhahho Pathen Thupeh ho jui'a, chule Yeshua jal-a ahinau kituh chah ho chunga chun alung hangin ahi.
en_web: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.
en_kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in Dragon chu numei nu chunga along hangtan, hijeh chun Pathen thupeh chengse nit’a, Jesu thu hettohsah nei, amanu chate amoh chengse chutoh kisat din akondohtai.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman sahem khat twikhanglen'a kon hungpot doh chu kamun ahi. Sahem chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule aki som, chule lallukhuh som akikhuh cheh uvin ahi. Aluchang cheh chunga chun Pathen taitomna thucheng akijih in ahi.
en_web: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.
en_kjv: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglen’a kona sahem khat hung kaldoh kamun, ki, som, luchang sagi aneiyin, aki som chunga chun lallukhuh khat cheh aumin, chule aluchang ho chunga taitom min apui.

tcz: Hiche sahem hi lutnu tobang ahi, hinlah akeng chu vompi kengto abangin chule akam chu keipi kamto abangin ahi! Chule dragon chun sahem chu athahatna, athaneina, alaltouna chule athuneina loupi chu apetai.
en_web: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
en_kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahem kamu chu lutnu to abangin, akeng te ni chu savom a tobang, akam chu Phaisameigeo kam tobang ahi. Dragonin sahem chu atha neina le alaltouna chule athu neina nasatah apetai.

tcz: Keiman sahem luho lah'a khat chu damdoh jou talou ding hile kilom mahapu chu kamun ahi. Hinlah amaha putna chu adamdohtai! Hiche thil kidangtah chu vannoi pumpin adatmo lheh jengun chule sahem thunoiya chun akipelut tauve.
en_web: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.
en_kjv: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Aluchang ho khat chu thi thei hel’a kimavo tobang ahin, ahinla akimavona chu damdoh kit’a ahitai. Vannoi pumpin kidang san aveuvin, sahem nung hcu ajuiyui.

tcz: Amaho chun sahem chutobang tah'a thaneina pepa chu Pathen houvin ahou un, chule sahem jong chu ahou un, “Sahem tobanga lenchungnung koi umintem? Koiham ama dou ngapcha ding,” atiuve.
en_web: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”
en_kjv: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
tcz_gospelgo: Athu neina sahem apeh jeh-in mihon Dragon chu ahouvun, sahem jong chu ahouvun, “Hiche sahem ti kibang koi hiya, kon adouva akisatpi thei ding ham?” atiuve.

tcz: Chuphat in sahem chu Pathen taitomna khoh setah chu seidoh dinga phatsahna kipea ahi. Chule ama chu ipi hijongleh abol nomchan chu boldinga thaneina lha som li le ni phalna kipea ahi.
en_web: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.
en_kjv: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahem chu hamhoithona le taitom thuseina kam apeuvin, lha som li le lha ni geiya thilbolna ding thu neina apeuve.

tcz: Chule amachun hoisetah'a Pathen dounaa taitomna–Amin le Achenna mun taimona thuho aseiyin ahi.
en_web: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.
en_kjv: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Pathen taitom thu seinan kam akeh pantan, amin le achen mun chule van’a chedng jouse ataitomtai.

tcz: Chule sahem chu Pathen mithengte kisatpi dinga, chule amaho chu jou dinga phalna kipea ahi. Ama chu phungtin le miho le pao chule nam jouse chunga thuneina kipea ahi.
en_web: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.
en_kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithengte to kisat’a abonchauva ajo na din thilbol theina apeuvin, phung tin le mitin tang, paotin tang le chitin namtin chunga thu neina jong apeutauve.

tcz: Hiche vannoiya hiho jouse chun ahou diu ahi. Amaho chu vannoi kisem masang peh'a pat'a Akithatsa Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kisunlou chengse chun ahou tauve.
en_web: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.
en_kjv: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah le leisetchung chedng, leiset bul kiphudoh til’a pat kithatsa Kelngoinou hinna lekhabua amin kisut lou chengsen sahem chu ahou diu ahi.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.
en_web: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
en_kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
tcz_gospelgo: “Angaina ding na neiyan ngai hen!

tcz: Koi hileh songkul-a lut dinga kigongsaho chu songkullut ding ahiuve. Chule chemjam'a lou dinga kigongsaho chu chemjama thi diu ahi. Hiche hin athudoi chu Pathen mithengte chun thoh hattah'a gimbol hesohna athoh a chule tahsan umtah hiding ahiuve.
en_web: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
en_kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Sohchang ding chu sohchang tei ding, chemjam hema lou ding jong chu chemjam hem’a lou tei ding ahi. Hichea hi mitheng dinga thot hat le tahsan ngai ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman sahem chomdang khat leiset a kon ahung potdoh kamui. Ama chun kelngoi bang in ki ni aneiyin, ahin sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan; hinlah ama chun dragon tobang'in thu aseiye.
en_web: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
en_kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun leiset’a kona sahem chomdang khat hung kaltou kamun, hichun kelngoi ki tobang ki ni aneiyin, Dragon thusei bangin aseiye.

tcz: Ama chun sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan, chule ama chun leiset chung pumpi le mijouse chun sahem masapa athi chan geiya dinga kimavo chu Pathen-houva hou dingin angeh in ahi.
en_web: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
en_kjv: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun sahem masa thu neina lhingset’in aneiyin, sahem masa masanga thil abol’e. Hiche hin sahem kasa, thi thei hel’a kimavoa damdoh kit chu leiset le asunga chengte jouse ahousah tai.

tcz: Ama chun datmo um tahtah thil kidang abol in, ama chun mihon avet pettah uva mei jeng jong chu vana kon leiset'a ahin lenlhahsah in ahi.
en_web: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.
en_kjv: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun thil bolmo kidang nasatah tah, mihemte mitmu changtah a, van’a kona leiset chunga meikou lenlhahsah geiyin abol theiye.

tcz: Aman thil kidang abol jouse chu sahem masapa tha lhenga chu aboltheina dinga aphatsah peh ahin, chuche dung juiya ama chun leiset pumpia mi jouse jouva lhepna anei ahi. Aman miho chun sahem nasapa thinathei leuva kimavopa hung damdoh kit lim lentah chu sem dingin thu apen ahi.
en_web: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.
en_kjv: and deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahem maiya thil bolmo kidang bol theina kipea chu leiset chung change jouse apui chatvaiya, leiset chung chengte chu chemjam’a kisat khaa, ahivanga hing nalai sahem lim sem ding aseipeh thu asei theiya,

tcz: Hiche milim kisemthu chu hinna petheiya thusei thei dingin phatsah pehna akineiyin ahi. Chuphat in sahem lim kisem chun thu apen koi hileh ahoulou jouse chu thi ding ahi, ati.
en_web: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.
en_kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
tcz_gospelgo: sahem lim hou chun thu asei theiya, sahem lim hou lou jouse akitha theina dinga, sahem lim sunga hu khumlut peh theina jong kipea ahitai.

tcz: Ama chun amitin aneo le alen, ahao le avai, chamlhat le soh hijongleh khut jetlam ahilouleh achalpanga melchihna chu kitah dingin asolin ahi.
en_web: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;
en_kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
tcz_gospelgo: Sahem chun mihem jouse, aneo alen, ahao avai, jalen le soh, abonchauvin acham louvin akhut jetlam ham, achalpanguva ham a melchihna abol’e.

tcz: Chule koiman chuche melchihna neilouvin johtheilou ding ahilouleh chotheilou ding, hichu sahem min ahilouva ahileh amin khel-a number hiding ahi.
en_web: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.
en_kjv: and that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun chuche sahem melchihna, amin ham ahiloule amin mohor neilou chun imacha cho thei lou, joh jong joh thei lou ahi.

tcz: Hichea hin chihna angaiye. Hetkhen themna neimi chun sahem number in ipi kiseina ahi hedoh hen, ijeh inem itileh hichu mihem number ahi. Ama number chu 666 ahi.
en_web: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
en_kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin chihna angaiye. Lungthim’a hethem’an sahem mohor chu sutoh hen, ijeh-inem itile hiche hi mihem mohor ahin, mohor number chu jagup le gup ahi.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman Kelngoinou chu Zion Mol chunga adin kamun, chule Ama chutoh mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li chalpanga Ama min le Apa min kijih chu kamun ahi.
en_web: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
en_kjv: And I looked, and lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.
tcz_gospelgo: Ven, Zion molsang chunga Kelngoinou ding kamun, ama min le a-Pa min achalpanguva kijih cheh mi sang ja khat le sang som li le sang li to adding khom’e.

tcz: Chule keiman vana kon twikhanglen kinong gin tobang leuva hugin ahilouleh van-gin kitol tobang chu kajan ahi. Hiche gin umdan chu selangdah tampi kitumging tobang leuvin ahung kithongdoh in ahi.
en_web: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
en_kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin van’a konin twipi tamtah gin tobang le van-gin nasatah tobang ogin khat kajan, ogin kajah chu selangdah salhon aselangdah cheh asaigin’u to abange.

tcz: Hiche lasaho tamtah chun lathah kidangtah chu Pathen Laltouna masangleh Hinnanei li ho masang chule upa somni le li ho masanga chun asauve. Hiche la hi koimacha dang in sathem theilou mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li leiset a kon lhatdam changho bouvin asahtheiyu ahi.
en_web: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.
en_kjv: and they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche ho hin laltouna mai le ganhing li ho chule upate masang chun lathah khat asauvin, leiset’a kona lhatdamsa mi sang ja khat le sang som li le sang li tilou koima hiche la chu kichuh thei lou ahi.

tcz: Amaho hi nungah-thengsel ho tobanga kivet tupna nei ahiuvin, Kelngoinou chu achena chan-a juiya ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi vannoi leiset mitea kon'a Pathen le Kelngoinou dinga kikatdoh theng lhatdam changsaho chu ahiuve.
en_web: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
en_kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi numeito kisuboh louhel, suhset lou na-ngah tobang ahiuve. Ache na chan a kelngaoinou nungjui ahiuvin, Pathen ding le Kelngoinou dinga aga masaa pang dinga, mihemete lah a kona kilhatdo ahitauve.

tcz: Amaho hi jou seikha louhel, nolna beihel hinkho mang ahiuve.
en_web: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.
en_kjv: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Akamsunguva thujou pot lam kihekha louhel, nolnabei ahiuve.

tcz: Chule keiman vantil chom dang khat vantham jol'a lenglelea tonsot Kipana Thupha chu hiche vannoi mite namtin, phungtin, paotin, chule miho jah a,
en_web: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
en_kjv: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
tcz_gospelgo: Vanlaijol’a Vantil chom khat leng le le kamun, ama chun leiset chung cheng chitin namtin, phungtin, pao tin paotang le mitin mitang henga phonjal ding tonsot Kipana Thupha aneiye.

tcz: “Pathen gingun, Amaa loupina peuvin. Ijeh ham itileh Aman thu atanna ding phat hunglhunga ahitai. Vanho le leiset, twikhanglen le twinah ho jouse sempa chu Hou un,” tin asamin ahi.
en_web: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”
en_kjv: saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
tcz_gospelgo: Aman ogingtah-in aseiyin, “Pathen gingun lang, alou, aloupina vahchoiyun, ijeh-inem itile aman thu atanna ding phat ahung lhung tai; van le leiset, Twikhanglen le twisamphung jouse Sempa chu chibai boh-uvin,” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin vanlai jol'a vantil chom dang khat in ama chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Babylon hi achim-a ahitai, chuche khopi lentah chu achimtai, ajeh chu amanu hin vannoi namtin jouse ajonthanhoi jeh'a lunghanna lengpiju chitin namtin le phungtin adonsah ahi,” ati.
en_web: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
en_kjv: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
tcz_gospelgo: anina Vantil chom khat man anung juiyin aseiyin, “Ajonthanhoi lunghanna lengpitwi ji chitin namtin jouse donsah nu, Babylon khopi chungnung chu achimtai, achimtai!” ati.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil thumna chun amani nung chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Koi hileh sahem le alim chu Pathen houva hou ahilouleh amelchihna achalpang ahilouleh akhut jetlam'a kibeh achun,
en_web: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
en_kjv: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
tcz_gospelgo: Thum lhin na Vantil chonkhat man anung juiyin ogingtah-in aseiyin, “koi hi le sahem alim hijonle houva, achalpang ham, akhut ham a mohor kinam’a chun

tcz: Pathen lunghanna khon'a chu lhingsetna kisung lha a umsa chu adon ding ahi. Chule amaho chu mei le kath'a Kelngoinou le avantil thengte masanga chu kisugim diu ahi.
en_web: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
en_kjv: the same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen lunghanna lengpitwi ju, imacha to hal louhel, gotsa kikoi chu adon khat tei ding, Vantil theng ho mang sang le Kelngoinou angsunga mei kou le kath a hesoh gentheiya kibol ding ahi.

tcz: Amaho kigimbolna meikhu chu a-itih a ding ahi, chule amaho kigimbolna chu sun le jana angah tih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh amaho chun sahem le alim chu ahou'un chule ama melchihna akisan uvin ahi.
en_web: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
en_kjv: and the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
tcz_gospelgo: Hitobang ho kibolgimna chun tonsot tonsot’a kitung cheng chung jeng ahin, chuche sahem le alim chibai boh ham, ahiloule amin mohor kinam khum ham chu sun le jan’a oltih nei lou ahitauve,” ati.

tcz: Hiche hin Pathen mithengte chun gimbol hesohna thoh hattah'a athoh diu, athupeh ho anit diu, athupeh ho anit uva chule Yeshua atahsan nauva alung-u angapdet diu ahi.
en_web: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”
en_kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin Jesu tahsan’a Pathen thupeh chengse nit, mintheng te din thot hat angaiye.

tcz: Chule keiman vana kon in aw khat in hitia asei kajai, “Hiche hi jihdoh in: Tua pat'a Pakaiya thiho anunnomui. Ahiye, tin Lhagaovin aseiye, amaho anunnom monga ahiuve, ijeh inem itileh amaho anatoh gimnauva kon'a kicholdoa ahitauvin; athilpha boluvin anung-u ajuiye.”
en_web: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
en_kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun van’a hungkon ogin khat kajan, “pakai dinga thiho chengse chu tua lhah a anunnom ahitauve, tin sunin; ahiye, Lhaggaovin aseiyin, ‘Amaho chu atohgim nauva kona choldo ahitauvin, atoh phat jouseuvin anungu ajuiye,’ tin,” ati.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman meibol bangleh khat kamun chule meibol chunga toupa chu Mihem Chapa lheh lheh ahi. Ama chun Sana lallukhuh alua akikhuh in chule akhut a chun koite hemtah khat akichoi in ahi.
en_web: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
en_kjv: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
tcz_gospelgo: Vetan, meibang lhang khat kamun, meilhang chunga chun Mihem Chapa tobang khat atouvin, alua lallulkhuh akhuh-in, akhut’in koite hemtah khat achoiye.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chom dang khat Hou-in a kon chun ahungin, meibol chunga toupa chu asamin, “Koite chu kilap pantan, ijeh ham itileh chang atphat chu hunglhunga ahitai: leiset chunga chang ga chu min ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
en_kjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Houin’a kon chun Vantil chom khat ahungdoh-in, meilhang chunga tou pa henga ogingtah-in asamin, “Nakoite panin chang at tan, a-at phat ahung lhungin, leiaet chang akoijoutai,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun meibol lah'a toupa chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampan in, chule leiset pumpi chu akiat chaitai.
en_web: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
en_kjv: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun meilhang chunga Toupan akoite leiset chunga alamtan, leiset chung-at’in aki-at tai.

tcz: Hiche jou chun, van Hou-in a kon chun vantil chom khat ahungin, chule ama jong chun koite hemtah khat aneiye.
en_web: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
en_kjv: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
tcz_gospelgo: Van’a Houin sunga kon chun Vantil chomdang khat ahung potdoh-in, aman jong koite hemtah khat aneiye.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chomkhat, meiya kon'a suhmang theina thaneina neipa chu maicham'a konin ahunge. Ama chun koite hemtah choi vantil chu ahinsamin, “Na koite chu tun kilap pan in lang leiset lengpiga aboh a konin khom khomtan, ijeh ham itileh athutan dinga min'a ahitai,” ati.
en_web: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
en_kjv: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin meikou chunga thu nei Vantil chom khatma Maicham phunga konin ahung potdoh-in, koite hemtah kichoipa henga chun ogingtah-in asamin, “Nakoite hemtah chu lamin lang leiset’a lengpiga ho khu aminsohtai at khomtan,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun vantil chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampanin, chule lengpiga chu Pathen lunghanna lengpiga hehna a chun asepluttan ahi.
en_web: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
en_kjv: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hijeh chun Vantil’in akoite alamin leiset chung lengpiga boh ho chu a-at khom khomin, Pathen lunghan lengpiga hehna lentah khuh sunga chun asep luttai.

tcz: Lengpithei gaho chu khopi pamlam'a lengpiga hehna a akichillut tan, chule lengpiga hehna a kon chun thisan chu vacha hunglongdoh bangin; mile jakhat le somget saovin twilon in alongin, chule sakol kamdal chan ahung geidoh in ahi.
en_web: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
en_kjv: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi polam, lengpiga chilna mun’a chil’u len, lengpiga chilna mun’a konin thisan ahung putdoh-in, sakol kamdalgeiyin achuptan, kilometer jathum geiyin anal’e.

tcz: Chutah in keiman datmo umtah thilsoh kidang khat vana kamun ahi. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise achaina sagi ho chu akhut uva achoiyun, hichun Pathen lunghanna chu asuhbulhit ding ahi.
en_web: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
en_kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Van’a datmo umtah le lentah melchihna khat kamun, gamna kichaina sagi neiya Vantil sagi ahiuvin, hiche hoa hi Pathen lungsat kichai ahitai.

tcz: Keiman kamasanga chun phatvet twikhanglen meitoh kihal chu kamui. Chule achunga chun sahem le alim chule anumber ama thalhenga kimang, chunga galjou miho jouse adin-u chu kamun ahi. Amaho chun abonchauvin akhut'uva Pathen in apeh-u selangdah akichoicheh uvin ahi.
en_web: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
en_kjv: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun meikou tokihal, phatvet tobang Twikhanglen, sahem le alim, amin mohor kinam nang jou chengse akhut’uva Pathen selangdah choiya, phatvet tobang Twikhanglen panga ding kamui.

tcz: Chule amaho chun, Pathen sohpa Mose la le Kelngoinou la chu asauvin: “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, nathilbol ho akidangin chule Aloupi lhehjenge. Vo namtin Lengpa, nalamlhah ho dihtah le kitah tah ahi.
en_web: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
en_kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hin Pathen lhacha Mose le Kelngoinou la asauvin: “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, Nathilbol ho hi anasan akidange; Chitin namtin dinga Lengpa, Nalampi jouse adih-in akitah-e!

tcz: Vo Pakai, koiham nangma naging'a chule loupina napelou dinga! Ajeh chu nangma bou athenga nahi. Namtin vaipi hung intin nangma masang'a nahung hou diu ahi, ajeh iham itileh nathilpha bol ho chu hung kiphongdoh'a ahitai.”
en_web: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
en_kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
tcz_gospelgo: Vo Pakai, koiham nagging louva Namin vahchoi lou idng chu? Ajeh chu athenga nang bou nahi. Hijeh a chu chitin namtin hunguva Na-angsunga bohkhup’uva chibai naboh diu ahi; Ajeh chu nathilbol dihho akiphongdohtai,” atiuve.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman kaven ahileh vana Houin chu kamun, Pathen Houna kong chu ahung ki hongdoh jenge.
en_web: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
en_kjv: And after that I looked, and behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin van’a hettohsahna Houbuh muntheng kihondoh kamun,

tcz: Vantil sagi ho, gamna hoise sagi choi ho chu Houin a kon ahungdoh un ahi. Amaho chun ponbang vamleh nolnabei sana jem chu alengkouva akibandoh un ahi.
en_web: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
en_kjv: and the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
tcz_gospelgo: muntheng phunga konin gamna sagi neiya Vantil sagi ahungdoh tauve. Amaho chu tupat ponnem, abangleh-in akivon’un, sana pheh-in a-opkongu akiveiyui.

tcz: Chuphat in Hinna nei li ho lah'a khat chun Pathen tonsot tonsot'a hingjing, lunghanna dimset sana khon chu vantil sagi ho chu khatcheh apen ahi.
en_web: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
en_kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun ganhing li ho lah a khat’in Vantil sagi ho chu tonsot tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pathen lungsetna demset cheh, sana lhengkong sagi apei.

tcz: Hou-in sung chu Pathen loupina le thaneina meikhu chun adip dimset jenge. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise sagi chu asunlhah chai masangse chun koima Hou-in sunga chun aluttheipon ahi.
en_web: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
en_kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin Pathen loupina le athu neina jeh-in muntheng chu meikhu adimset jengin, Vantil sagin gamna sagi abulhitsoh masangsen koimacha muntheng phunga chun alut thei tapoi.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman Hou'in sunga kon'a vantil sagi ho jah'a aw kithongleuva thu kisei kajah chun, “Gacheuvin lang Pathen lunghanna sumlheng sagi ho chu leiset chunga gasung lhatauvin,” ati.
en_web: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”
en_kjv: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Houin’a kona Vantil sagi ho henga ogingtah a thu kisei kajan, “Cheuvin lang Pathen lungsetna dimset lhengkong sagi chu leiset chung gabung lhauvin,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun vantil khatna chun Hou'in chu adalhan chuin asumlheng chu leiset chunga asunlhah'a ahileh, sahem melchihna kilah ho ahilouleh sahem houho jouse chunga chun hoisetah'a tipom'a natna tina-maha ahung umdohtai.
en_web: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
en_kjv: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Vantil masapen achen leiset chunga alhengkong chu agasun lhan le, sahem melchihna neiya alim hou, mihem ho chunga netna hoisetah, uilut nat alangtai.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil nina chun asumlheng chu twikhanglen'a asunlhah'a ahileh, twi chu mithisa thisan tobang ahijenge. Chuin twikhanglen'a umjouse athigamtai.
en_web: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
en_kjv: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil ni nan alhengkong chu Twikhanglen chunga asun lhan le, tolthi thisan bangin thisan asoh tan, Twikhanglen sunga um ganhing jouse athisoh tai.

tcz: Chuin vantil thumna chun asumlheng chu vadung le twinah'a asunlhah'a ahileh, thisan asohgamtai.
en_web: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
en_kjv: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil thum nan alhengkong chu luididng jouse le twinah phung jousea asun lhah le, thisan asoh gamtai.

tcz: Chule twi chung jousea thunei vantil chun asei kajah chu, “Vo Athengpa, nangman hiche thutanna hi naneitah jeh in, adihtah a anaum jingsa nahi.
en_web: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.
en_kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun twipi jouse thu nei Vantil chun asei kajan, “Hicheng thu natan naa hin nadih-in nathenge, Aum jing le aumsa Nangma;

tcz: Amahon namithengte le na themgao ho thisan asotah jeh uvin, nangman amaho chandinga kilom'a nagel thisan chu dondinga napeh ahitai” ati.
en_web: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
en_kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
tcz_gospelgo: Mithengte le Themgao ho thisan asouvin, Adoh diuva thisan napeh hi achan diu lom tah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chule keiman maicham'a konin aw khat kajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Ahinai Pakai Pathen, Hatchungnung pen, nathutanna ho hi adih in chule akitah e,” ati.
en_web: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
en_kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin maicham phunga kona thu kisi kajan, “Ahinai, Vo hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, Nathutan ho hi akitah-in, adih cheh-e,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil li-na chun asumlheng chu nisa chunga asunglhan ahileh, amitin chu ameisa sat chun akatan ahi.
en_web: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
en_kjv: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil li nan alhengkong chu nichang asun khum le, mihemte chumeisaa ahugot dingin thu akipetai.

tcz: Amitin meisat chun akatan, chule hiche gimna hoise hinsodoh'a Pathen min chu agaosap un ahi. Amaho chu achonsetnau lunggel akhel deh pouvin, chule Pathen lam'a lungheina aneipouvin, chule Ama loupina apenom pouvin ahi.
en_web: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.
en_kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihem ho chu nisa save vun ahulgot gam phat’in, gamna ho chung geiya thu neipa, Pathen min geiyin ataitom’un, Pathen vahchoi din jong lung aheidoh pouve.

tcz: Chuin vantil nga na chun asumlheng chu laltouna a tou sahem chunga chun asunglhan ahileh, alenggam chu muthim sunga aluttai. Amite chun lunghemin aha-u ageltauvin ahi.
en_web: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
en_kjv: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil nga nan alhengkong chu sahem laltouna chunga asun lhah le, sahem lenggam sung athimsoh-in, anat thoh lel jeh-un, mihon aleiyu apet den’un,

tcz: Chule amaho chun anat thoh ule anatnau maha jeh chun van Pathen chu agaosap uvin ahi. Hinlah amaho chu thilphalou abol-uva konin alunghei dehpouvin, chule Pathen'a ahung kiheideh pouve.
en_web: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.
en_kjv: and blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
tcz_gospelgo: anat thohgim jeh-u le ti-na ho jeh chun Van Pathen geiyin ataitom’uvin, anatoh athilbol’uva konin lung aheipouve.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil gupna chun asumlheng chu Euphrates Vadung len'a chun asunglhan ahileh hichu akang jeng in, hiti chun solam lengho galmi, sepaite chu kisunoh phahna beihel in lhumlang ngan ahung kijotlut tauve.
en_web: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
en_kjv: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil gup nan alhengkong chu luipi len Euphrates a asun lama hung kon leng ho din lampi akihong doh tai.

tcz: Chule keiman lhagao gilou thum uphoh ho tobang jeng chu dragon, sahem chule themgao lhem kam'a konin ahung potdoh kamun ahi.
en_web: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
en_kjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Dragon kamsung, sahem kamsunga kona hungdoh, ephoh ho tobang lhagaoboh thum kamui.

tcz: Amaho chu lhagaophalou thil kidangtah tah bol ahiuvin, Chule amaho chu vannoi vaipo ho jouse koma gachedoh uva; Pakai chu gal-a kidoupi dinga Hatchungnung Pathen thutanna niloupi hunglhung dinga chu akhop khom diu ahi.
en_web: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
en_kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche ho hi thilha lhagao ahiuvin, melchihna aboljiu ahi; hiche ho hi cheuva, Hatchungnung Pathen nikho ni le galsat dinga leiset pumpia leng jouse gapuikhom agot’u ahi.

tcz: “Ven, keima gucha tobanga gel loupet'a hung ding kahi! Keima eingah jinga, sagoh le jahcha a avale louna diuva aponsil-u gottupsa kikoi ho chu anunnom ahiuve.”
en_web: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
en_kjv: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, gucha bangin kahunge, ponbeiya vah lea, asagohkeo akimudoh louna dinga hah jinga aponsil kivet phat jing mi chu anun nom’e” ati.

tcz: Chule lhagao phalou ho chun vaipo ho jouse le galmi, sepai ho chu Hebrew paova Armageddon kiti mun'a chun akhom khomun ahi.
en_web: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.
en_kjv: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin amaho chu Hebrew paova, “Armageddon” kiti laiya chun apuikhomsoh tauve.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil sagi na chun asumlheng chu vanlaijol-a asunglhan ahi. Chuin Hou'in sunga laltouna a kon chun aw sangtah'a kisam kajah chun, “Akichaitai!” ati.
en_web: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
en_kjv: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil sagi nin alhengkong chu vanlaijol’a asun lhah jeng le, Houin laltouna phunga konin nasatah-in o ahung gingdoh-in, “Akichaitai,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in van ahung gingpoh lah in chule agin chu akitol in, chule kol aphejap jap jenge. Chuin ling nasatah le hattah chu ahungkihot jenge, leiset chunga mihem achen'a pat chutobang sohkha loulai anahi!
en_web: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
en_kjv: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun kol aphen, ogin akithongin, van aging lul lul jengin, leiset chunga mihem kilahdoh a pat jingpi jouse lah a jong um kha lou lai, lingpi nasatah khat ahung kihottai.

tcz: Babylon khopi lentah chu hopthum akiso jengin chule chitin namtin khopiho chu achim gamin, songbong kisekhomho asohgamtai. Hiti chun Pathen in Babylon chonsetna jouse chu ageldoh in, chule amanu hi alunghanna hoisetah chu khon-a kon amanu chu adonsahtai.
en_web: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
en_kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
tcz_gospelgo: hichun khopi jouse achomsoh tai. Khopi lentah Babylon chu Pathen angsunga akigeldoh tan, alunghan na lengpiga ju-khon donsah dinga peh din aumtai.

tcz: Chule twikol ho jouse jong aum gamtapon, chule molho jouse jong akisucham sohtai.
en_web: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
en_kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun twikol gam jouse jong akihomosoh tai.

tcz: Gel nasatah alhan, chule gelsong talent khat toh kibanga gih chu vana konin noilama miho chunga ahunglhan ahi. Gel tijat umtah'a gamna ahunglhun jeh chun miho chun Pathen agaosap tauve.
en_web: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.
en_kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah-in gel len, khatseh agih dol jong talent khat to kibang hel, van’a konin mihemte chunga ahung lhan, hiche gamna hi anatsat behseh jeh-in mihemten gel lhah gamna jal hin Pathen ataitom tauve.

tcz: Vantil sagi sumlheng choi ho lah'a khat chu kahenga ahungin, chuin eihouvin, “Neihin juiyin, chutileh keiman noti lentah, twi tamtah chunga vaihomnu chunga thutanna hunglhung ding chu navetsah inge.
en_web: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
en_kjv: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
tcz_gospelgo: Lhengkong sagi choiya Vantil sagi holah a khat ahungin kajah a thu aseiyin, “Hungin, twitampi chunga tou, noti len nu chunga thu kitan vetsah inge;

tcz: Amanuto chun vannoi leiset lengho jonguva, chule hiche vannoi leiset mite chu jonthanhoiya akhamnau leh ju'a amanuto jonguva ahi,” ati.
en_web: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
en_kjv: with whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabiters of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
tcz_gospelgo: leiset leng hon noti nu toh jonthanhoi na leng piga ju chu leiset’a chengte jouse khamsoh ahitauve,” ati.

tcz: Hiti chun vantil chun keima Lhagaova gamthip mun'a eipuiyin ahi. Keiman chuche mun'a numei khat chu sahem santhip, lu sagi neiya chule ki som nei, chule Pathen taitomna dimset kijihna chunga atou chu kamui.
en_web: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
en_kjv: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun aman lhagaovin gamthip eipuitai. Hichea hin achunga taitomna min jeng kikun, alu sagi, akisom nei, sahem danthip khat chunga numei khat touva kamui.

tcz: Numeinu chun ponsandup le asanthip akisilin chule ahoiya hoi, sana le khisong mantam chule twikohchanga akijem in ahi. Amanu hin sana a kisem jukhon, jamo thu kisun dimset chule ajonthanhoiya athenlounaho chu akhut'a akichoiyin ahi.
en_web: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
en_kjv: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
tcz_gospelgo: Numei nu chun pon sandup le pon santhip asil’in, sana, khisong mantam jeng le twikoh changing akijemin akhut’a chun thet umtah tah thil ho le ajonthanhoi na nen demset sana khon khat achoiye.

tcz: Chule achalpanga chun min kidang le datmo umtah kisun: “Babylon khopi lentah, vannoi leiset'a numei kijoh jouse le jamo thusei dimset nu,” akitin ahi.
en_web: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”
en_kjv: and upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
tcz_gospelgo: Achalpanga chun selguh min akisunin, “Babylon len, noti jouse le leiset’a thil thet um jouse konna nu,” akiti.

tcz: Keiman amanu akham'a Yeshua thu hettohsah'a pang ho Pathen mithengte thisan adonkham a aum pet chu kamun ahi. Kadatmo behseh in amanu chu kave vejeng in ahi.
en_web: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.
en_kjv: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule numeinu chun mithengte thisan le Jesu thu hettohsahte thisan adonkhamset kamui. Hiche nu kamu chu kidang kasa behseh jenge.

tcz: Vantil chun, “Ipi dinga nachuti datmo ham?” Keiman hiche numeinu le alu sagi chule aki som nei, sahem chunga atou thuguh khu naseipeh inge.
en_web: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
en_kjv: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin Vantil chun kajah a, “Ibol’a kidang nasah ham? Khuche numei le apolea, aluchang sagi, aki som nei, sahem thuguh khu keiman seipeh inge.

tcz: Sahem namu chu phatkhatna ana-uma ahi, hinlah tua umtalou ahi. Ajeh chu amahi lei-ong amongbeiya kon'a hungpotdoh kitding, chule tonsot mahthahna a chelut ding ahi. Chule hiche vannoi leiset mite, vannoi leiset kisem masanga pat'a aminu Hinna Lekhabua kisunlou jouse chun, sahem thisa ahung hindoh kit chu adatmo lheh diu ahi.
en_web: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.
en_kjv: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
tcz_gospelgo: Namu sahem, anu umsa hiya, umtalou khu, akhonbei thamkoa kona hung kaltouva, manthahna vah lut ding ahin, chu teng leiset chung chengte, vannoi bul kiphudoh a pat hinna lekhabua min kisun lou hon, aumsa hiya, umta lou, hung kit ding, sahem chu amu tengu adatmo lheh jeng diu ahi.

tcz: Hichea hin hetkhenna lunggel nei angaina akimudoh-e: Sahem alu sagi chu numeinu vaipohna, mol sagi ho vaihomtu ahi. Amaho hi leng sagi jong vetsahna ahiuve.
en_web: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
en_kjv: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichea hin lungthim le chihna angaiye. Aluchang sagi chu molsang dsagi ahin, hiche ho chunga hi numei ni kitousah ahi. Hiche ho hi leng sagi jong ahiuve.

tcz: Leng nga ho chu alhusa ahiuvin, agupna pa tua hi vaipo ahi, chule asagina chu hungnalai ding, hinlah avaipohna chomcha bou hiding ahi.
en_web: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
en_kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
tcz_gospelgo: Nga alhutan, khat aumnalaiyin, khat ahung hih laiyin, ahung tang le phat chom khat beh umtei ding ahi.

tcz: Sahem asanthip anaumsa, ahia umjom talou chu leng aget channa ahi. Amahi sahem sagi tobangma ahin, chule ama jong mahthah nalam manoa ahi.
en_web: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
en_kjv: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
tcz_gospelgo: Aumsa hiya, umtalou sahem, sagi lah a khat chu get lhin na ahin, manthahna vah lut ding ahi.

tcz: Sahem aki som ho chu leng som athaneinau pan'a vaihomna neiloulai ahiuve. Amaho chu sahemtoh phat chomkhat vai ahom khom diu ahi.
en_web: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
en_kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Aki som namu ho chu leng som ahiuvin, lengvaipohna anei lou laiyu ahi, nisan kah khat sunga sahem chutoh thakhat tah a, lengte banga, thu neina aneikhom diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho hi abonchauva amachu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu ahi.
en_web: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
en_kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho hi doi kitha khat ahiuvin, athahat athu nei nau sahem chu apetauve.

tcz: “Amaho kitho khomuva Kelngoinou chu kisatpi dinga kondoh diu, hinlah Kelngoinou chun amaho chu ajo ding ahi, ajeh chu Ama pakai jouse PAKAI le leng jouse LENGPA ahi. Chule Aman akouva, alhendoh'a chule tahsan umho chu Amatoh umkhom diu ahi,” ati.
en_web: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
en_kjv: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho Kelngoinou to kisat diu, ahivanga Kelngoinouvin amaho ajo ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile am apakaiho Pakai le leng ho Leng ahi; aumpi chengse jong koudodhsa le lhenchom, chule tahsan nei ho ahiuve,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chun kajah a, “Notinu vaipohna twi tamtah kiti hin chitin namtin le paotin'a kon mihonpi chu kiseina ahi.”
en_web: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
en_kjv: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun kajah a, “Noti nu kitousahna twipi namu ho chu mitin mitang, lhangpi kikhom khom, chitin namtin le paotin paotanga mi ahiuve.

tcz: Sahem asanthip le aki som ho chun abonchauvin Notinu chu athetbol tauve. Amahon amanu hi sagoh keova alha diu, asa aneh diu, chule atibah aneh mohchengseu chu meiya ahalvam diu ahi.
en_web: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.
en_kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
tcz_gospelgo: aki som namu le sahem chun noti nu chu ahot diu, achom keohel’uva, asagoh keova akoiyuva, atahsa geiya aneh chaiyuva, meiya ahalvam diu ahi.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in alunggel uva tohgon, asuhbulhit thei dinghou akhumpeh ding ahi. Amaho chun sahem santhip chu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu, chule hitia chu Pathen Thu chu suhbulhit-a umding ahi.
en_web: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
en_kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
tcz_gospelgo: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thusei chengse guilhunsoh masangsea dinga, amaho chu lungdoi kitoh tah a alengvai neinau sahem apehdoh-uva, Pathen lungdoi atohdohna diuva, hi tobang lunggel chu Pathenin alungthim’uva akhumpeh ahi.

tcz: Chule hiche numeinu nangman gaova namu hi, vannoi lengho chunga vaipoa khopi chu ahi.
en_web: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
en_kjv: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule nangin namu numei nu chu leiset leng ho jouse chunga lengvaipoa pang khopi len chu ahi,” ati.

tcz: Hicheng jouse nung chun keiman vantil chomkhat vana kon'a thuneitah'a ahung kum lhah kamun, chule leiset chu avah in asaljengin ahi.
en_web: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
en_kjv: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
tcz_gospelgo: Hicheng nung hin Vantil thu nei tah khat van’a kona hung kumlha kamun, leiset hi aloupi nan asalvahsohjenge.

tcz: Ama chun aw gingtah in asam in: “Babylon chu achimtai, Khopi lentah chu achimtai! Ama lhagao phalou chenna ahung hitai. Ama lhagao namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin, muthong namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin chule anamse le kichat umsa-ho umna mun ahitai.
en_web: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!
en_kjv: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, And is become the habitation of devils, And the hold of every foul spirit, And a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
tcz_gospelgo: Ama chun going leng lung tah-in asamin aseiye: “Achimtai, achimtai Babylon len, Thilha ten chen nan aneitauve; Lhagaoboh jouse kikholna, Vacha bohjouse le thet um jouse kikholna asohtai.

tcz: Ajeh chu chitin namtin vaipi chu amanu jonthan hoina lung ngaichatnaa chonchatvaina ju'a alhutai. Vannoi lengho amanutoh ajong khomun ahi. Amanu nopsahval a kon'a vannoi leiset sumkol veiho haodoh gam'a ahitauve,” ati.
en_web: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
en_kjv: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu aman ajonhuhna lengpiga ju chu Chitin namtin jouse adonsah tai; Leiset leng jouse amanu to ajonguvin, Amanu nopsahna val’a konin leiset’a kiveihon ahaolotauve,” ati.

tcz: Chutah in keiman aw chomkhat vanna konin kajai, “Kamite, amanua konin hungdoh un, amanu chonsetnaho chu kikoppi hih un, achuti louva ahileh amanutoh gimbolna nathoh khom diu ahi.
en_web: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
en_kjv: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, That ye be not partakers of her sins, And that ye receive not of her plagues.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun van’a kona thu kisei ogin khat kajan: “Hiche nua kon chun potdoh-un kamite, Ajo le amanu chonsetna ho changkhauvin natin, Ajo le athoh ding gamna ho thoh khauvin nate.

tcz: Ajeh chu amanu chonsetna ho chu van sang in asangin, chule Pathen in amanu thilse bolho chu ageldoh in ahi.
en_web: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
en_kjv: For her sins have reached unto heaven, And God hath remembered her iniquities.
tcz_gospelgo: Ajeh chu amanu chonsetna ho Van geiyin akikhangdoh tan, Athemmona jouse Pathenin ageldohtai.

tcz: Amanun michunga abolna tobang'in achunga boluvin, athilse bolho jeh in ajatnin lethuh un. Aman midang dingin kichatna ju'a kisem chol jaona chu khon-a ahaltai, hiti chun amadingin chan-ni akisemben ahi.
en_web: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
en_kjv: Reward her even as she rewarded you, And double unto her double according to her works: In the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanun napeh bangin pethuh-un, Athilbol achonna dungjuiyin ajat nin lethuh-uvin. Chih tah a ahhalkhomna khon’a chun Ajat nin chih cheh-in halkhompeh-uvin.

tcz: Ama akichoi sanga chule kinom sahtah'a hinkho amanjeh chun, tun atotoh dingin gimthohsahna le lunghemna lhutpeh un. Amanu hin alungsunga kithang atna neitah in, keima kalaltouna a lengnu kahi, keima hi panpibei meithai kahihih in, hitia chu keima kalunghemna ding aumpoi, ati.
en_web: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
en_kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, So much torment and sorrow give her: For she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, And am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
tcz_gospelgo: akiloupisah a kinopsah val bangin Sugentheiyun lang sulung hem’uvin; Aman alungthim sunga ‘Lengnu banga toukahin, Meithai kahipoi, itih chan hijongle Lunghemna muponge,’ atijeh chun

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche gamna hoise ho hin, nikhat sunga ahinphah ding–thina le lunghemna chule kel'in ahinphah ding ahi. Amanu hi meiyin akahvamhel ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh Pakai Pathen amanu thutanpa chu hatchungnung ahi,” ati.
en_web: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
en_kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, Death, and mourning, and famine; And she shall be utterly burnt with fire: For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamna jousen nikhat’in lhunden hen, Thi lunghemna chule kelle chah nan, Amanu meikouvin leolih jeng hen. Ajeh chu achung thu tan Pakai Pathen chu thanei tah ahi,” ati.

tcz: Chule vannoi lengho amanu jonpiho le ama kinomsahna thanoppi ho chun amanu kigona meikhu kitungdoh chu amu tenguleh alung hempi diu ahi.
en_web: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
en_kjv: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, Shall bewail her, and lament for her, When they shall see the smoke of her burning,
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu to jonga nom sakhom, leiset leng hon agovamna meikhu amudoh tengu le dip le lai akidop’a, amanu akacham diu ahi.

tcz: Amaho chu gamlatah a ding'uva amanu thohgim chu tijatah'a avet diu ahi. Amaho chun ahinsapdoh uva, “Iti gimneiya nagimnei hitam! Vo Babylon, khopi lentah nu! Phat khatsung sehseh in Pathen thutanna nachunga alhung jenge,” ati diu ahi.
en_web: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
en_kjv: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, Saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! For in one hour is thy judgment come.
tcz_gospelgo: Amanu thoh genthei akichat jeh-un, gamla tah a dingun tin: “Ohe, ohe, khopi len, Bebylon khopi dettah, Nidan kha khat sungin nachung thu akitan chaitai!” atidiu ahi.

tcz: Vannoiya kiveimiho chu hungkap uva chule alunghem pidiu ahi, ijeh ham itileh athilhou chodinga koima akidalha aumtapoi.
en_web: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:
en_kjv: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; For no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
tcz_gospelgo: Leiset’a kiveimihon jong koiman athil’u achohpeh lou phat’in amanu chu lhase tah-in akauve.
