en_kjv: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
tcz_gospelgo: Sahem le sahem masanga datmo kidang melchihna tampi boljia, hotobang melchihna hoa hi sahem mohor kinam khum, alim houho chu pui chavaiji Themgao lhem chu aman’un, anigel lhon in ahing laiyin kath meikou deuje ju lah a a leh lut tauve.

tcz: A sepai hou jouse chu sakol kang chunga toupa kamsung'a kon'a chemjam hemtah chun asatlih gam tauve. Chule muthongho chu mithiho tahsa lungna chimset in anetauvin ahi.
en_web: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
en_kjv: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
tcz_gospelgo: Chule amoh chengse chu sakol chunga Toupa kamsunga kona hung potdoh chemjam chun athat gamin, vachate jousen atahsapheu chu achim avan aneuve.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman vantil khat vana kon hungkum lha a amongbei leiko kot heh kichoi, chule akhut'a kot heh khao jong kichoi chu kamun ahi.
en_web: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
en_kjv: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Akhonbei thamko hehna le thih khao akhut’a choiya Vantil khat van’a kona hung kum lha kamui.

tcz: Aman dragon–hiche gullui, diabol kiti Satan chu amanin chule thihkhaova chun kum sangkhat a din ahentai.
en_web: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
en_kjv: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun khangluiya gulpi, Diabol, Satan Dragon chu aman in kum sang khat din ahentai.

tcz: Vantil ama chu amongbei kohom'ah alehlut in, chule kum sangkhat kichai masangsea koima alheplhah louna din Satan chu akhah chah in, akam khum tan ahi. Chujouleh chomkhat adia ama chu kilhadoh ding ahi.
en_web: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
en_kjv: and cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiti chun akhonbi thamko sunga aleh lut’in, akandenin, kum sang khat kichai kahsea namtin apui chatvai louna din mohor anamkhumtai. Hiche nung hile phat chom khat dinga kilhadoh tei ding ahi.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman laltouna ho chule achunga tou miho chu thutan theina thuneina kipeuva ahi kamudoh in ahi. Chule keiman Yeshua thu hettohsah'a panjeh le Pathen Thu seiphongna jeh'a alol kitan ho lhagao chu kamun ahi. Amaho hin sahem ahilouleh alim chu ahoupouvin, chuleh achalpanga ahilouleh akhut uva kibeh ding nomlou ahiuve. Amaho tahsaa hung hingdoh kit ahiuvin, chule amahon Christa to kum sangkhat lengvai ahomkhom diu ahi.
en_web: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
en_kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun laltouna phabep le achunga touva, thutan ding kipedoh ho le Jesu thudol hettohsah jeh le Pathen thu jeh a alu kitanho, sahem le alim chibai boh louhel, achalpangu le akhut’uva melchihna moho kinam lou ho lhagao kamun, amaho hi hingdoh a Christa to kum sang khat lengvai apoh khomu ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi thokitna masa ahi. (Mithiho adangse vang kum sangkhat kichai kah sen ahung thoudoh pouve.)
en_web: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
en_kjv: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
tcz_gospelgo: Kum sang khat kichai kahsea vang chu mithi amoh cheng thoudoh lou ding ahiuve.

tcz: Thokitna masa a chan neijouse anunnom chule atheng ahiuve. Thi ninan amaho chungah thuneina anei tapoi, amavang amaho Pathen le Christa thempu a pang uva chule amatoh kum sangkhat vai ahomkhom diu ahi.
en_web: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
en_kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thodoh masaa pang kha chu anun nomin athenge; thi ni nan achunguva thu anei lou ding, Pathen le Christa Thempua panguva, Ama to kum sang khat lengvai apoh khom diu ahi.

tcz: Kum sangkhat chu ahung kichai tengleh, Satan chu asohchanna a kon puidoh hiding ahi.
en_web: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison
en_kjv: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
tcz_gospelgo: Kum sang khat alhin teng Satan akihenna a kona kilhadoh a,

tcz: Ama chitin namtin ho lhemlha dinga kipatdoh ding, Gog le Magog kitia chu leiset kolkimvel'a akhopkhom ding ahi. Aman amaho chu galsatna a dinga akhopkhom ding, galmi hattah, twikhanglen panga simjoulou neldi jat hiding ahi.
en_web: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
en_kjv: and shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
tcz_gospelgo: leiset ning lia cheng chitin namtin Gog le Magog, Twikhanglen neldi jat pi chu gal bolsah dial hem chavaiya puikhom dinga kondoh ding ahi.

tcz: Chuin keiman amaho chu leiset phaicham pheng pumpi hop'a akaltou-u kamun, chule Pathen mite le khopi theng chu ahin umkimvel tauve. Hinlah vana konin mei ahung lenglhan mi nokhum galmiho chunga achun chule amaho chu ahalvamtai.
en_web: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
en_kjv: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
tcz_gospelgo: Amaho chu leiset kho khongin ahung kon’un, mithengte Ngahmun le Pathenin a-it tah khopi chu aumkimvel tauve. Ahinla van’a konin meikou ahung leng lhan amaho chu akavamtai.

tcz: Chuphat in diabol, amaho lhemlhapa chu, meisa al-lenglung sunga chun akilehlut tai, sahem le themgao lhem jong chu aleh luttha tauve. Chua chun amaho chu sunle jan a-itih a gimbol hesohna athoh jing diu ahitai.
en_web: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
en_kjv: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Chutah chun sahem le themgao lhempa kiselutna kath le meidil sunga chun miho lehm chavai Diabol chu asep lut tauve, hikom a chu amahon sun le jan, tonsot tonsot geiya gim hesoh chungnung athoh diu ahitai.

tcz: Chuin keiman laltouna kang le achunga toupa kamun ahi. Leiset le van'a-angsunga konin ajammangin, hinlah kiselna ding mun aneitapoi.
en_web: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.
en_kjv: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun laltouna lentah, akang khat le achunga Toupa kamun, amasanga konin van le leiset ajam mangin, van le leiset din mun akihol motai.

tcz: Keiman athisaho, alen le aneo Pathen laltouna maiya adin'u kamun ahi. Chule lekhabuho aphongun, Hinna Lekhabu jong aphoh thauvin ahi. Chule athisa ho chu lekhabuhoa kisun dung juiyin achungthu-u chu akitantai.
en_web: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
en_kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin laltouna masanga mithi ho alen aneo adinu kamun, chule lekhabu ho akiphongtai; hichea hin lekhabu achom khat, ahinna lekhabu kit chu akiphong doh-e; hiche lekhabu hoa kisun dungjuiyin mitho ho chu anatoh dungjui cheh-in athuu atan tauve.

tcz: Twikhanglenin amithisa chu ahinlehdoh in, chule thina le lhankhuh in jong amithisa ahinlehdoh in ahi. Chuin abonchauvin atoh dung juiyun achungthu'u akitan chaitai.
en_web: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
en_kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
tcz_gospelgo: Twikhanglenin asunga um mithi ho ahinleh doh-in, thina le thina gamin jong asung lhona um mithi ho ahinleh doh lhonin, amichang cheh anatohdungjui cheh-uvin athuu atanpeh tauve.

tcz: Chuphat in thina le lhankhuh chu Tonsot meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve. Hiche Tonsot Meidil chu Thinina ahi.
en_web: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
en_kjv: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin hina le thina gamchu meidil sunga aleh lut tauve, meidil hi thini na ahi.

tcz: Chule koi hijongleh Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kimulou tapou chu Tonsot Meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve.
en_web: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
en_kjv: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna lekhabu sunga amin kiholdoh louse chu meidil sunga aleh lut lut jenguve.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman Van thah le leithah kamui, ijeh inem itileh vanlui le leilui chu manga ahitai. Chule twikhanglen jong chu chemanga ahitai.
en_web: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
en_kjv: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
tcz_gospelgo: Chujouvin Vanthah le leiset thah kamui; ajeh-inem itile van masa le leiset masa chu kitolmang ahitan, Twikhanglen jong aumtapoi.

tcz: Chule keiman khopi theng Jerusalem thah chu van Pathena kon'a mou aji dingpa hoitah'a akivon'a ahung kumlhah kamun ahi.
en_web: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
en_kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin aji ding pa henga dia kigosadem, jinei din gnu banga jijem, Pathen kom, van’a hung kitol lha khopi theng Jerusalem thah chu kamui.

tcz: Keiman laltouna a kon'a aw hung kisam gin kajan, aseiyin, “Ven, Pathen chenna in chu mihemlah ahung hitai! Ama amahotoh chengkhom intin, chule amaho chu Ama mite hiding ahiuve. Pathen Amatah chun amaho aumpi diu ahi.
en_web: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
en_kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna a kona ogingtah a thu kisei khat kajan, “Vrn, Pathen chenna in chu mihemte lah ahitai, Pathenin amaho achenpia, amaho amite hidiu, Pathenin amaho achen pia a-Pathenu hiding ahi.

tcz: Aman amit uva kon'a amitlhiu atheh ngimpeh ding, chule thina jong umkit talou ding ahilouleh lungkhamna ahilouleh kana ahilouleh natna umtalou ding ahi. Hicheng jouse hi a-itih a umtalou ding ahitai,” ati.
en_web: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
en_kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
tcz_gospelgo: Amit’uva kona amit lhi jouseu atheh hul peh ding, thina umta lou ding, lung hem na le ka-na, thohgimna jong umta louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu thil masa chengse kitolmangsoh ahitai,” ati.

tcz: Chule laltouna a toupa chun aseiyin, “Ven, keiman ijakai kathah semtai, ati. Chule ajouchun aman kajah a, Hiche hi jihdoh in, ijeh ham itileh keiman najah'a kasei hi tahsan umtah le adih ahi,” ati.
en_web: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
en_kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
tcz_gospelgo: Laltouna Toupan aseiyin, “Ven ijakai kasemthahsoh ahitai,” ati. Chujongle aseiyin, “Hicheng thu hi tahsan umtah, thutah cheh ahi, sunin,” eti.

tcz: Chule amachun hiti hin aseiyin, “Akichaiya ahitai! Keima Alpha le Omega kahi, Akipatna le akichaina chu! Adangchah jouse chu keiman Hinna twi nah'a kon'a twi chu manbeiyin penge.”
en_web: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
en_kjv: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin kajah a, “Akichaitai, Keima Alpha le Omega, akipatna le akichaina kahi, Adang chah a chu hinna twinah a twi don ding manbeiyin penge.

tcz: Jona neiho chu hiche phattheinaho hi chang diu ahi, chule keima Amaho din Apau hing ting chule amaho kachate hiding ahiuve.
en_web: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
en_kjv: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
tcz_gospelgo: koi hile gal jouva chuthil hichengse hi chang ding, keima a-Pathen kahiya, ama kachapa hi ding ahi.

tcz: Hinlah akichaseho, atahsanlouho, akisubohho, tolthat ho, jonbol ho, doichoiho, milim houho chule mijouho, amaho jouse chan ding chu meidil al-lenglung meikou mittheilou lhummei chu hiding ahi. Hiche hi thi nina ahi.
en_web: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
en_kjv: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahin meidoi ho, tahsan bei ho, thet um ho, tolthat ho, jonthanhoi bol ho, doichoi ho, doilim houho, chule jousei ho jouse kath le meikou dil deuje ju sunga chu um siu ahi; hiche hi thi ni na ahiye,” ati.

tcz: Chuphat in sumlheng sagi gamna hoise sagi nunungpen choi vantil sagi ho lah'a khat chu ahungin, chule kajah'a aseiyin, “Hungin keito che hite! Keiman kelngoinou jidingnu, Mounu chu navetsah inge,” eiti.
en_web: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
en_kjv: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
tcz_gospelgo: Gamna nukhah sagi dimset, lhengkong sagi choi, Vantil sagi lah a khat chu ahungin kajah a thu aseiyin, “Hungin, Kelngoinou jinu ding mouthah chu setsah inge,” eiti.

tcz: Hiti chun aman Lhagaovin keima molsang alentah khat mun'a eipuiyin, chule aman khopi theng, Jerusalem chu Pathen'a kon'a vana pat ahung kumlhah eivetsah in ahi.
en_web: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
en_kjv: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
tcz_gospelgo: Hichun Aman Lhagaovin molsang lentah khat chungvuma eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van’a kona hung kumlha Jerusalema eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van’a kona hung kumlha Jerusalem khopi theng chu eivetsah-in,

tcz: Hichu Pathen loupina toh ahungvah doh in chule songmantam tobang'in aemsel in jasper songmantam crystal thenin athengselin ahi.
en_web: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
en_kjv: having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen loupi nan akijemin ahi; avahje dan chu song mantam, jasper song le crystal val vah abange.

tcz: Khopi kulpi bang chu alenin chule asangin, kelkot som le ni aum in, vantil som le ni ho chun angau ahi. Chule Israel phungsom le ni ho min chu akelkot a chun akisunin ahi.
en_web: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
en_kjv: and had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
tcz_gospelgo: Apal chu lentah le sangtah ahin, kelkot som le ni ahin, kelkot ho chunga hcun Vantil som le ni aumin, chule kelkot ho chungma chun Israel phung som le ni min akisun’e.

tcz: Khopi solam, sahlam, lhanglam chule lhumlam jousea chun kelkot thum cheh aumin ahi.
en_web: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
en_kjv: on the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
tcz_gospelgo: Nisdo lama kelkot thum, sah lama kelkot thum, lhanglama kelkot thum, nilhum lama kelkot thum aum’e.

tcz: Khopi kulpi-pal chun khombul som le ni aneiyin, chule achunga chun Kelngoinou solchah som le ni ho min akisunin ahi.
en_web: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
en_kjv: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi pal chu akhombul som le ni ahin, achunga chun Kelngoinou solchah som le ni min akiun’e.

tcz: Vantil kahenga thuseiya chun khopi le akelkot ho, chule abang chu tena ding in akhut'ah sana a kisem thiltena mollhon achoiyin ahi.
en_web: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
en_kjv: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Kahenga thuseiya chun khopi le kelkot ho chule apal te-na didng sana tenglhon khat achoiye.

tcz: Aman atetoh jouvin khopi chu aningli ahin, chule aletdan chu asanchanma ahi. Chule khopi chu adungle avai chule atun kibang ahin, mile sang khat le jali cheh ahi.
en_web: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.
en_kjv: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
tcz_gospelgo: khopi chu aning li kitoh a, adung avai kibang, Aman thil te-na tenglhon’a khopi chu ate le, kilometer sang ni le ja ni to som nga asaovin, adung avai, asandol kibangsoh kei ahi.

tcz: Chujouvin aman kulpi bang chu atetoh'a ahileh feet jani le som le gup in asan ahi (hichu mihem tetohna dungjuia vantil atetoh ahi).
en_web: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
en_kjv: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
tcz_gospelgo: Chuin apal ate le tong ja khat le tong som li le li alhinge; mihem thil te-na chu Vantil’in jong aman ahi.

tcz: Kulpi bang chu jasper songa kisem ahin, chule khopi chu sana theng haithengsel then'a theng ahi.
en_web: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
en_kjv: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
tcz_gospelgo: Pal chu jasper song jenga kigen ahin, khopi jeng jong chu phatvet then’a theng, sana thengseh a kisa ahi.

tcz: Khopi kulpi bang chu khombul songa songmantam som le nia kisem ahin, khatna Jasper ahin, ani na Sapphire, athum na agate, ali na emerald,
en_web: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire; the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
en_kjv: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
tcz_gospelgo: Khopi pal khombul song chu khisong mantam jatchom chom’a kijem ahi; khombul masapen chu jasper, ani na sapphire, athumna chalcedony, li lhina emerald,

tcz: anga na Onyx, agup na Carnelian, asagi na Quartz, aget na Beryl, ako na Topaz, asom na Chrysoprase, asom le khatna Jacinth, asom le nina amethyst, hichengse hi aboncha khi song jeng ahi.
en_web: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
en_kjv: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
tcz_gospelgo: nga lhinna sardonix, gupna sardis, sagi lhina topaz, som na chrysoprase, som le khatna jacinth, som le ni na amethyst song jeng ahi.

tcz: Kot som le ni ho chu twikohchanga kisem ahin, kot khat cheh chu twikoh chang khat cheh a kon ahi! Chule alamlen chu sana thengsel ahin, haithengsel then-a thengsel ahi.
en_web: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
en_kjv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
tcz_gospelgo: kelkot som le ni chu twikoh chang jenga kisem ahi, kelkot khat khat chu twikohchang khat cheh akisem ahi; kho pi sung lamlen chu phatvet banga lim kimudoh thei sana thengsel ahi.

tcz: Keiman khopia chun Hou'in kamupoi, ajeh chu Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung chule Kelngoinou chu a Hou'in hiya ahi.
en_web: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
en_kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung le Kelngoinou Houin a apantah jeh in kho pi sunga chun Houin kamupoi.

tcz: Chule khopi chun nisavah ahilouleh lhavah jong angaitapoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen loupina chun khopi chu asalvah jenga chule Kelngoinou chu vah'a pang jeng ahi.
en_web: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.
en_kjv: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
tcz_gospelgo: Pathen loupe nan asalvah jinga, Kelngoinou chu thaomei vah a apanjeh-in khopi chun asalvah ding nisa le lha jong angai chapoi.

tcz: Chitin namtin chu avah noiya vahle ding, chule vannoi leiset lengho khopi sunga chu aloupinau pum'a lutdiu ahi.
en_web: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
en_kjv: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
tcz_gospelgo: Chitin namtin khopi vah a chu vah leuva, leiset leng jousen jong aloupi nau asunga ahinpoh lut diu ahi;

tcz: Akelkot hou chu kikhatih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh jan umlou ding ahitai.
en_web: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
en_kjv: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
tcz_gospelgo: jan jong aumchom tah loujeh chunkelkot ho chu sun laiya jong kikhah chom lou ding ahitai.

tcz: Chule chitin namtin ho chun aloupinau le jabol achannau chu khopi sunga chu ahinpoh lut diu ahi.
en_web: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.
en_kjv: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
tcz_gospelgo: Mihon chitin namtin loupina le jabolna asunga ahinpoh lut diu ahi.

tcz: Chuche mun'a chu imacha aphalouva, jachat umtah milim houna le lungthen louna ho imacha luttalou ding, Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua kisunho chengse bou chu lutding ahi.
en_web: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
en_kjv: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
tcz_gospelgo: Itina ma jong le aboh jouse le thet umtah thilbol’a, jousei ho, khopi sunga chu lut louhel diu, kelngoinou hinna lekhabu sunga amin kisunsa ho chubou lut diu ahi.

tcz: Chujouvin Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna a kon'a hunglongdoh vadung khat Hin-twi, crystal then'a thengsel vantil chun eivetsah in ahi.
en_web: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
en_kjv: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna a kona hungput, crystal song val’a val, hintwilui dung chu eivetsah-e.

tcz: Hichu lamlhong pipena konin ahung long lhan ahi. Vadung alangto gel a chun hinthing akeh in, aga jatchom chom som le ni agan, alha seh'a ga jinga ahi. Athing doho jong namtin damna dinga loule-aiya pang ahi.
en_web: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
en_kjv: In the midst of the street of it, and of either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
tcz_gospelgo: Luidung chu khopi lamlen lai lunga alongin apang langto gel’a hinthing akeh-in, lhaseh le aga jin jat chom chom ga somle ni aneiye; chujongle athingna ho chu ahitinnamtin boldamna ahi.

tcz: Sapsetna kiti umta louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna chumun'a um ding, chule asohten Ama ahou diu ahi.
en_web: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
en_kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
tcz_gospelgo: Gaosap changsa jouse beisoh ding ahi. Khopi sunga chu Pathen le Kelngoinou laltoina bouuma, asoh ten ama ajenle diu,

tcz: Chule amahon amai amu diu, Ama min chu achalpanguva kijih ding ahi.
en_web: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
en_kjv: and they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
tcz_gospelgo: amahon amai amu’va, achalpanguva ama min um ding ahi.

tcz: Chumun'a jan umta louhel ding, thaomeivah le nisa vah jong ngaitalou hel ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Pakai Pathen achunguva vahding, chule amaho chun tonsot atonsot-a vai ahom diu ahi.
en_web: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
en_kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
tcz_gospelgo: Jan jong umta lou didng, thaomei vah le nisa vah jong angaichat louhel diu ahitai; ijeh-inem itile Pakai Pathenin amaho asalvah jing ding, tonsot tonsot geiya lengvai apoh diu ahitai.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil chun kajah a, “Nangman najah chengse le namu chengse hi tahsan umtah le thutah jeng ahi. Pakai Pathen, athemgao ho tilkhounaa chu avantil asol-a asohte thil hunglhungvah ding ho aseipeh ahi.”
en_web: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
en_kjv: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun kajah a aseiyin, “Hicheng thu hi tahsan um le thutah jeng ahi, Themgao ho Lhagao Pakai Pathen chun ahungso loi ding thil asohte vetsah dinga a-Vantil ahinsol ahi.

tcz: “Ven, Keima kahungloi jeng ding ahi! Hiche lekhabua themgao ho thusei kijihdoh ho ngaiya chu anunnom ahi.”
en_web: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
en_kjv: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, kahung loi ding ahi. Hiche lekhabua gao thusei ho nit’a chu anunnom ahi,” ati.

tcz: Keima John hi, hichengse ja'a chule mua chu kahi. Chule hicheng keiman kajah'a kamu phat chun, keiman ama chu Pathen houva houna dingin kakigotan ahi.
en_web: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
en_kjv: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
tcz_gospelgo: Thil hicheng jaa mua chu keima John kahi. Kajah a kamu phat’in thil hicheng eivetsah a Vantil chu chibai boh din akengphang bul’a kaboh khuptai.

tcz: Hinlah aman aseiyin, “Ahipoi, keima neihou hih in. Keima nangma le nasopite themgaoho lah'a khat tobanga, Pathen sohpa khat hiche lekhabua thu kisun juiya chu kahi. Pathen bou houvin,” eiti.
en_web: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
en_kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
tcz_gospelgo: Ahinla aman kajah a aseiyin, “Bol hih-in, keijong nang le nasopite Themgaoho, chule hiche lekhabua thu ho nit ho lah a nasoh natoh khompi khat kahibouve. Pathen bou chibai boh-in,” eiti.

tcz: Chujouvin aman eihilin, “Hiche lekhabua themgao thuseidoh hohi mohor namkhum hih in, ijeh inem itileh aphat chu anaitai.
en_web: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
en_kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
tcz_gospelgo: Vantil chun kajah a, “Hiche lekhabua gaothu seidoh hi imchah hih hel’in, ajeh chu phat anaitai.

tcz: Phatlouna thilbol chun aphalou boljom hen, asea chu setna boljom hen; midih chun adih boljinghen, athenga chu thengjom jing hen,” ati.
en_web: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
en_kjv: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
tcz_gospelgo: Adih lou chun adih lou bol jing hen, aboh a chun thilboh bol jing hen, midih chun thildih bol jing hen, mintheng chu theng jing hen.

tcz: “Ven, keima kahung vahding, keiman mi jouse athilbol dung juicheh uva lethuhna kapeh cheh diu ahi.
en_web: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
en_kjv: And behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
tcz_gospelgo: “Ven, kahungloi ding ahi, mitin atoh dungjui cheh a peh ding keiya tohman chu kahinpoi.

tcz: Keima Alpha chule Omega chu kahi, Amasapen le Anunungpen, a-Patna le akichaina chu kahi,” ati.
en_web: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
en_kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
tcz_gospelgo: Keima Alpha le Omega, amasa le anukhah, akipatna le akichaina kahi,” ati Jesun.

tcz: Aponsil kisop theng hochu anunnom ahiuve. Amaho chu khopi lutna kot hoa chu lutdinga kiphalpeh diu chule Hinthing ga chu aneh diu kiphalpeh ding ahiuve.
en_web: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
en_kjv: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
tcz_gospelgo: Hinna thingga neh theina le khopi kelkot dunga lut le theina dinga avon’u kisop theng ho chu anun nom’ui.

tcz: Khopi pamlam'a chun–uicha ho, doichoiho, jonthanhoi bolho, tolthat a pangho, limsemthu hou ho, chule jouva hingnom ho jouse aum uve.
en_web: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
en_kjv: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
tcz_gospelgo: Uicha ho le doichoi ho, jonthanhoi bol ho, tol that ho, doilim semthu hou ho, chule jouva thilbol nom jouse polama um diu ahiye.

tcz: “Yeshua Keiman, hiche thuhi Hobungho henga galhut dinga ka vantil kasol ahitai. Keima David dinga ahungkonna le alaltouna lodingpa chu kahi. Keima jingvalpa vahtah chu kahi,” ati.
en_web: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
en_kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
tcz_gospelgo: “Keima Jesun hicheng thu hi Houbunga um nang ho hettohsah dinga ka-Vantil kahinsol ahi; Keima David Jungpi, achilhah, jingvalpa vahtah chu kahi,” ati.

tcz: Lhagao le Mou chun asei lhonin, “Hungin,” ati. Hiche thusei ngaiho chu, “Hunguhen,” ati. Koipen hijongleh adangchah'a chu hunghen. Koipen hijongleh angaicha chanin hintwi chu manbeiyin donhen.
en_web: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
en_kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
tcz_gospelgo: Lhagao le Mouvin, “Hungin,” ati. Ajapha chanin, “Hungin,” ti hen. Adangchah chan hungun; angaicha chanin hinna twi chu manbeiyin kilah hen.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche lekhabua themgao thusei kijih jaho jah'a phongtah'a kasei ahi: Hichea thu kisun koiham khattouvin koibe aneiya ahileh ama chunga chu Pathen in asunga kisun gamna hoise hi akoipehbe ding ahi.
en_web: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
en_kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche lekhabua gao thuseidoh ho japha jouse henga kahettohsah ahi: koi hile hicheng belap a aum le, hiche lekhabua kisei gamna ho chu Pathenin achunga abelap peh ding,

tcz: Chule koihileh hiche themgao lekhabua thu kisun athuchengho khattou aladoh aumleh, Pathen in amachu Hinthinga kon le khopi thenga kon'a achanding hiche lekhabua kisun chu alahmang ding ahi.
en_web: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
en_kjv: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
tcz_gospelgo: hiche gao thusei hoa kona alamanga aum jongle, hiche lekhabua kisei Khopi Theng le hinna thingphunga kona Pathenin achan alahmang ding ahi.

tcz: Hicheho jouse chunga tahsan umtah hettohsah'a panga chun aseiyin, “Henge, Keima hungvah ding kahi!” ati. Amen! Hungin, Pakai Yeshua!
en_web: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
en_kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
tcz_gospelgo: Hiche thu hettohsah pan, “Henge, kahungvah ding ahi,” ati. Amen Vo Pakai Jesu hungin!

tcz: Pakai Yeshua lungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiu hen.
en_web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
en_kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
tcz_gospelgo: Pakai Jesu milungset’in mitin umpi jing hen!
